creators.bio_zh: 设计师兼工程师，联合创办了 Normal——多人联机框架 Normcore 和 VR 运动游戏 Nock 的开发商，并为跨设备的 AR/VR 交互制作原型。
creators.why_zh: 他的原型让手机 AR 用户与头显用户共享同一空间，成为跨现实多人互动的早期范本。

creators.name: Julian Triveri (anaglyph)
creators.role: Solo developer of Lasertag for Quest
creators.bio: Independent developer who builds Lasertag, a co-located mixed-reality laser tag game for Quest 3 that uses real-time depth to map rooms.
creators.why: Lasertag uses the Quest depth sensor and synced room scanning so laser beams and hits respect every real obstacle, shared across all players.
creators.role_zh: Quest 游戏 Lasertag 的独立开发者
creators.bio_zh: 独立开发者，打造了 Lasertag——一款面向 Quest 3 的同处一地混合现实激光枪战游戏，利用实时深度信息为房间建图。
creators.why_zh: Lasertag 借助 Quest 深度传感器和同步的房间扫描，让激光束和命中判定尊重每一个真实障碍物，并在所有玩家之间共享。

creators.name: Stijn Spanhove
creators.role: XR developer at In The Pocket; Snap Spectacles creator
creators.bio: Belgian XR developer who builds rapid AR-glasses proofs of concept for Snap Spectacles and Meta AI glasses, often pairing them with generative AI.
creators.why: He prototypes what AR glasses plus AI can do in daily life, from a real-world ad blocker to drawings that become playable worlds.
creators.role_zh: In The Pocket XR 开发者；Snap Spectacles 创作者
creators.bio_zh: 比利时 XR 开发者，为 Snap Spectacles 和 Meta AI 眼镜快速构建 AR 眼镜概念验证，常与生成式 AI 结合。
creators.why_zh: 他为 AR 眼镜加 AI 在日常生活中的可能性制作原型，从现实世界的广告拦截器，到变成可玩世界的手绘图画。

creators.name: Pavlo Tkachenko
creators.role: AR developer and Snap Spectacles lens creator
creators.bio: AR developer who builds Spectacles lenses, often with Stijn Spanhove, and won a Spectacles Community Challenge with his generative lens Bubbles.
creators.why: His lenses make AR glasses feel playful and physical: generating objects from a prompt, or flying a plane with head movement.
creators.role_zh: AR 开发者、Snap Spectacles 镜头创作者
creators.bio_zh: AR 开发者，常与 Stijn Spanhove 合作开发 Spectacles 镜头，并凭借生成式镜头 Bubbles 赢得了 Spectacles 社区挑战赛。
creators.why_zh: 他的镜头让 AR 眼镜变得好玩又富有身体感：根据提示词生成物体，或者用头部动作驾驶飞机。

creators.name: Creature
creators.role: Small XR studio (Starship Home)
creators.bio: Small independent studio behind Starship Home, a narrative mixed-reality game for Quest 3.
creators.why: Starship Home rebuilds your real room as a spaceship interior, replacing windows and walls with space views while you care for alien plants.
creators.role_zh: 小型 XR 工作室（Starship Home）
creators.bio_zh: 小型独立工作室，推出了面向 Quest 3 的叙事型混合现实游戏 Starship Home。
creators.why_zh: Starship Home 把你的真实房间重建为宇宙飞船内部，用太空景观取代窗户和墙壁，而你则在其中照料外星植物。

creators.name: Niantic (John Hanke)
creators.role: Game studio; makers of Ingress, Pokémon GO and Peridot
creators.bio: Spun out of Google in 2015 under John Hanke, Niantic built the location-based AR games Ingress and Pokémon GO and the Lightship AR platform.
creators.why: Turned the whole planet into a shared game board and made phone AR a daily habit for hundreds of millions of players.
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室；Ingress、Pokémon GO 和 Peridot 的开发商
creators.bio_zh: Niantic 于 2015 年在 John Hanke 带领下从 Google 独立出来，打造了基于位置的 AR 游戏 Ingress 和 Pokémon GO，以及 Lightship AR 平台。
creators.why_zh: 它把整个星球变成了共享的游戏棋盘，让手机 AR 成为数亿玩家的日常习惯。

creators.name: 8th Wall (Erik Murphy-Chutorian)
creators.role: WebAR platform, acquired by Niantic in 2022
creators.bio: 8th Wall, founded by Erik Murphy-Chutorian in 2016, made markerless AR run in the mobile browser without an app and powered thousands of WebAR campaigns.
creators.why: Removed the app-install barrier so any link could open an AR world.
creators.role_zh: WebAR 平台，2022 年被 Niantic 收购
creators.bio_zh: 8th Wall 由 Erik Murphy-Chutorian 于 2016 年创立，让无标记 AR 无需安装应用即可在手机浏览器中运行，支撑了数千个 WebAR 营销活动。
creators.why_zh: 它消除了安装应用的门槛，让任何一个链接都能打开一个 AR 世界。

creators.name: Novarama
creators.role: Game studio; creators of Invizimals
creators.bio: Barcelona studio founded by Daniel Sánchez-Crespo that made the Invizimals series for PSP, PS Vita and PS3, which used a camera and marker trap card to capture creatures on the player's table.
creators.why: Invizimals (2009) was one of the first mass-market handheld AR games and made marker-based AR a playground hit a decade before ARKit.
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室；Invizimals 的创作者
creators.bio_zh: 由 Daniel Sánchez-Crespo 创立的巴塞罗那工作室，为 PSP、PS Vita 和 PS3 制作了 Invizimals 系列：玩家借助摄像头和标记“陷阱卡”在自己的桌面上捕捉生物。
creators.why_zh: Invizimals（2009）是最早的大众市场掌机 AR 游戏之一，比 ARKit 早十年就让基于标记的 AR 成为操场上的热门游戏。

creators.name: SCE London Studio
creators.role: Sony first-party studio (EyeToy, EyePet, Wonderbook)
creators.bio: Sony's London Studio pioneered camera games from EyeToy to EyePet and the Wonderbook, an AR book peripheral for PS3.
creators.why: Showed that a TV, a webcam and a printed card could make a believable virtual creature live in the living room.
creators.role_zh: Sony 第一方工作室（EyeToy、EyePet、Wonderbook）
creators.bio_zh: Sony 的 London Studio 开创了摄像头游戏，从 EyeToy 到 EyePet，再到 PS3 的 AR 书本外设 Wonderbook。
creators.why_zh: 它证明了一台电视、一个摄像头和一张印刷卡片，就能让一只可信的虚拟生物住进客厅。

creators.name: Nintendo
creators.role: Game and hardware company (3DS AR Games, Face Raiders)
creators.bio: Nintendo shipped AR Games and Face Raiders on every Nintendo 3DS in 2011, using AR cards and the handheld's cameras, and later co-created Mario Kart Live with Velan Studios.
creators.why: Put camera AR preinstalled in tens of millions of handhelds and kept finding playful uses for it.
creators.role_zh: 游戏与硬件公司（3DS AR Games、Face Raiders）
creators.bio_zh: Nintendo 于 2011 年在每台 Nintendo 3DS 上预装了 AR Games 和 Face Raiders，利用 AR 卡片和掌机摄像头进行游戏；后来又与 Velan Studios 合作推出了 Mario Kart Live。
creators.why_zh: 它将摄像头 AR 预装进数千万台掌机，并不断为其找到有趣的用法。

creators.name: Velan Studios (Karthik & Guha Bala)
creators.role: Game studio; Mario Kart Live and Hot Wheels Rift Rally
creators.bio: Founded by brothers Karthik and Guha Bala, Velan Studios builds mixed-reality games that pair real RC cars with camera-based AR tracks.
creators.why: Mario Kart Live turned the player's living room into a racetrack seen from a real kart's camera.
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室；Mario Kart Live 与 Hot Wheels Rift Rally
creators.bio_zh: 由 Karthik Bala 和 Guha Bala 兄弟创立，Velan Studios 打造将真实遥控车与基于摄像头的 AR 赛道相结合的混合现实游戏。
creators.why_zh: Mario Kart Live 通过真实卡丁车上的摄像头，把玩家的客厅变成了赛道。

creators.name: Google Creative Lab
creators.role: Google's in-house creative team (Experiments with Google)
creators.bio: Google Creative Lab makes open-source experiments that show new uses of Google tech, including a series of ARCore experiments such as Just a Line, Drawalong AR, Sounds in Space and Lines of Play.
creators.why: Produced some of the most shareable, open-source phone AR experiments, often with artists and dancers.
creators.role_zh: Google 内部创意团队（Experiments with Google）
creators.bio_zh: Google Creative Lab 制作开源实验项目，展示 Google 技术的新用途，其中包括一系列 ARCore 实验，如 Just a Line、Drawalong AR、Sounds in Space 和 Lines of Play。
creators.why_zh: 他们常与艺术家和舞者合作，创作了一批最易于传播的开源手机 AR 实验。
creators.based_zh: 纽约 / 伦敦 / 悉尼

creators.name: Jonas Jongejan
creators.role: Creative technologist, Google Creative Lab
creators.bio: Danish creative technologist who built early ARCore experiments at Google Creative Lab and wrote the openFrameworks addon ofxARCore.
creators.why: His 2017 AR Wormhole and ARCore drawing prototypes helped set the playful tone of Google's AR experiments.
creators.role_zh: Google Creative Lab 创意技术专家
creators.bio_zh: 丹麦创意技术专家，在 Google Creative Lab 构建了早期 ARCore 实验，并编写了 openFrameworks 插件 ofxARCore。
creators.why_zh: 他在 2017 年制作的 AR Wormhole 和 ARCore 绘画原型，帮助奠定了 Google AR 实验轻松有趣的基调。

creators.name: Jeri Ellsworth
creators.role: Hardware engineer; co-founder of castAR and Tilt Five
creators.bio: Self-taught chip designer who built AR glasses at Valve, then spun them out as castAR (2013) and later Tilt Five, a retro-reflective tabletop AR game system.
creators.why: Two times she pushed a different idea of AR: glasses plus a retro-reflective board so shared holograms sit on a real table.
creators.role_zh: 硬件工程师；castAR 与 Tilt Five 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 自学成才的芯片设计师，曾在 Valve 开发 AR 眼镜，随后将其独立为 castAR（2013），之后又创办 Tilt Five——一套基于逆反射材料的桌面 AR 游戏系统。
creators.why_zh: 她两度推动了另一种 AR 理念：眼镜配合逆反射游戏板，让共享的全息影像稳稳地停在真实桌面上。

creators.name: Directive Games
creators.role: Game studio; The Machines (ARKit launch title)
creators.bio: Directive Games built The Machines, a tabletop multiplayer strategy game in Unreal Engine that Apple showed on stage when ARKit launched in 2017.
creators.why: The Machines was the first big demonstration of competitive multiplayer AR on a real table.
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室；The Machines（ARKit 首发游戏）
creators.bio_zh: Directive Games 用 Unreal Engine 打造了桌面多人策略游戏 The Machines，Apple 在 2017 年 ARKit 发布时将其搬上了舞台演示。
creators.why_zh: The Machines 是在真实桌面上进行竞技多人 AR 的首次大型展示。

creators.name: Snap Inc. (Snapchat Lenses)
creators.role: Camera company; Snapchat Lenses and Lens Studio
creators.bio: Snap turned face filters into a mass medium with Snapchat Lenses (2015), then added World Lenses, Lens Studio for creators, Landmarkers and Local Lenses.
creators.why: Built the largest daily AR audience and opened it to independent lens artists.
creators.role_zh: 相机公司；Snapchat Lenses 与 Lens Studio
creators.bio_zh: Snap 通过 Snapchat Lenses（2015）把面部滤镜变成了大众媒介，随后又推出了 World Lenses、面向创作者的 Lens Studio、Landmarkers 和 Local Lenses。
creators.why_zh: 它建立了规模最大的日常 AR 受众群体，并向独立镜头艺术家开放。

creators.name: Ines Alpha
creators.role: 3D digital makeup artist
creators.bio: French artist who creates 3D 'e-makeup' that grows from faces as AR filters and face-tracked videos, working with musicians, fashion brands and Prada Beauty.
creators.why: Invented a new genre of surreal, non-human beauty made for the camera instead of the skin.
creators.role_zh: 3D 数字化妆艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 法国艺术家，以 AR 滤镜和面部追踪视频的形式创作从面孔上“生长”出来的 3D“电子妆容”，合作对象包括音乐人、时尚品牌和 Prada Beauty。
creators.why_zh: 她开创了一种为镜头而非皮肤而生的、超现实且非人类的美的新类型。

creators.name: Johanna Jaskowska
creators.role: AR designer; creator of Beauty3000
creators.bio: Polish designer whose Instagram effect Beauty3000 (2018), a glossy chrome face mask, went viral and helped launch the AR filter-artist scene.
creators.why: Beauty3000 reframed face filters as art about beauty and identity rather than puppy ears.
creators.role_zh: AR 设计师；Beauty3000 创作者
creators.bio_zh: 波兰设计师，她在 2018 年推出的 Instagram 特效 Beauty3000——一款光亮的铬金属质感面具——迅速走红，推动了 AR 滤镜艺术家群体的兴起。
creators.why_zh: Beauty3000 把面部滤镜重新定义为关于美与身份的艺术，而不只是小狗耳朵。

creators.name: Marc Wakefield
creators.role: AR effects artist; co-founder of Augmented Reality Design Studio
creators.bio: Illustrator turned AR artist whose Spark AR world effects and character filters have been used by millions, including work for U2; he runs Augmented Reality Design Studio with Susie Wakefield.
creators.why: One of the first illustrators to make a career of turning drawn worlds into Instagram AR.
creators.role_zh: AR 特效艺术家；Augmented Reality Design Studio 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 由插画师转型的 AR 艺术家，他的 Spark AR 世界特效和角色滤镜已被数百万人使用，其中包括为 U2 创作的作品；他与 Susie Wakefield 共同经营 Augmented Reality Design Studio。
creators.why_zh: 他是最早一批以把手绘世界变成 Instagram AR 为职业的插画师之一。

creators.name: Paige Piskin
creators.role: AR filter creator (Snap Lens Studio, Spark AR)
creators.bio: Official Snap Lens Creator whose makeup, fashion and cartoon filters have been used billions of times; she also teaches lens making.
creators.why: Made AR makeup and cartoon-face lenses a pop medium and documents her process openly.
creators.role_zh: AR 滤镜创作者（Snap Lens Studio、Spark AR）
creators.bio_zh: Snap 官方认证镜头创作者，她的妆容、时尚和卡通滤镜已被使用数十亿次；她也教授镜头制作。
creators.why_zh: 她让 AR 妆容和卡通脸镜头成为一种流行媒介，并公开分享自己的创作过程。

creators.name: Tonchidot (Takahito Iguchi)
creators.role: Startup; Sekai Camera AR app
creators.bio: Tonchidot, led by Takahito Iguchi, showed Sekai Camera at TechCrunch50 in 2008: an iPhone app that let people leave floating 'air tags' of text, photos and sound in places.
creators.why: Sekai Camera was one of the first social, location-anchored AR apps, years before AR clouds.
creators.role_zh: 初创公司；Sekai Camera AR 应用
creators.bio_zh: 由 Takahito Iguchi（井口尊仁）领导的 Tonchidot 在 2008 年 TechCrunch50 大会上发布了 Sekai Camera：这款 iPhone 应用让人们可以在各个地点留下漂浮的文字、照片和声音“空中标签”。
creators.why_zh: Sekai Camera 是最早的社交化、锚定于地点的 AR 应用之一，比“AR 云”概念早了好几年。

creators.name: Layar (Raimo van der Klein, Claire Boonstra, Maarten Lens-FitzGerald)
creators.role: Mobile AR browser company
creators.bio: Layar launched in 2009 as the first mobile AR browser, overlaying geolocated 'layers' of information on the camera view, and later moved to interactive print.
creators.why: Created the first open platform where anyone could publish geolocated AR content for phones.
creators.role_zh: 移动 AR 浏览器公司
creators.bio_zh: Layar 于 2009 年推出，是首个移动 AR 浏览器，在摄像头画面上叠加带地理位置的信息“图层”，后来转向互动印刷品领域。
creators.why_zh: 它创建了第一个开放平台，让任何人都能为手机发布基于地理位置的 AR 内容。

creators.name: Otavio Good (Quest Visual)
creators.role: Creator of Word Lens
creators.bio: Otavio Good founded Quest Visual and built Word Lens (2010), which translated printed signs live in the camera view; Google acquired it for Google Translate.
creators.why: Word Lens was a 'magic' AR moment that replaced real-world text in place, on a 2010 iPhone.
creators.role_zh: Word Lens 创作者
creators.bio_zh: Otavio Good 创立了 Quest Visual，并开发了 Word Lens（2010）——它能在摄像头画面中实时翻译印刷标识；后被 Google 收购并整合进 Google Translate。
creators.why_zh: 早在 2010 年的 iPhone 上，Word Lens 就能原地替换现实世界中的文字，带来了“魔法般”的 AR 时刻。

creators.name: Within (Wonderscope)
creators.role: Immersive studio; Wonderscope AR stories for kids
creators.bio: Within, co-founded by Chris Milk and Aaron Koblin, made Wonderscope (2018), an iOS app of AR stories where children speak characters' lines aloud to move the story forward.
creators.why: Wonderscope made voice-driven AR storytelling for children, with the child as an actor inside the story.
creators.role_zh: 沉浸式工作室；面向儿童的 Wonderscope AR 故事
creators.bio_zh: 由 Chris Milk 和 Aaron Koblin 联合创立的 Within 推出了 Wonderscope（2018）：一款 iOS AR 故事应用，孩子们需要大声念出角色台词来推动剧情发展。
creators.why_zh: Wonderscope 开创了面向儿童的语音驱动 AR 叙事，让孩子成为故事中的演员。

creators.name: Climax Studios
creators.role: Game studio; ARise, Towers for Tango
creators.bio: UK developer that made early phone AR games for Google Tango and ARKit, including the perspective puzzle game ARise.
creators.why: ARise made the player's physical viewpoint the puzzle mechanic.
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室；ARise、Towers for Tango
creators.bio_zh: 英国开发商，为 Google Tango 和 ARKit 制作了早期手机 AR 游戏，其中包括视角解谜游戏 ARise。
creators.why_zh: ARise 把玩家的实际观察视角变成了解谜机制。

creators.name: Kunabi Brother
creators.role: Indie studio; Euclidean Lands
creators.bio: Small Viennese studio (Miro Straka) behind the rotating-cube puzzle game Euclidean Lands and one of the first ARKit ports.
creators.why: Brought a Monument Valley-style rotating puzzle onto the tabletop with ARKit on day one.
creators.role_zh: 独立工作室；Euclidean Lands
creators.bio_zh: 维也纳的小型工作室（Miro Straka），推出了旋转立方体解谜游戏 Euclidean Lands，也是最早移植到 ARKit 的游戏之一。
creators.why_zh: 在 ARKit 发布第一天，就把《纪念碑谷》式的旋转解谜搬上了桌面。

creators.name: Mighty Coconut
creators.role: Game studio; 57° North (Merge Cube), Walkabout Mini Golf
creators.bio: Indie studio that made 57° North, a choose-your-own-adventure story played on the handheld Merge Cube, before its VR hit Walkabout Mini Golf.
creators.why: Turned a foam cube held in the hand into a tiny diorama stage for a branching story.
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室；57° North（Merge Cube）、Walkabout Mini Golf
creators.bio_zh: 独立工作室，在推出 VR 热门作品 Walkabout Mini Golf 之前，制作了 57° North——一款在手持 Merge Cube 上游玩的互动冒险故事。
creators.why_zh: 它把手中的泡沫立方体变成了分支故事的微型立体布景舞台。

creators.name: Merge Labs (Merge Cube)
creators.role: AR/VR toy and education company
creators.bio: Merge makes the Merge Cube, a patterned foam cube that phones track so a hologram can be held and turned in the hand, used widely in schools.
creators.why: Made a cheap physical tracker that turns AR into something children can hold.
creators.role_zh: AR/VR 玩具与教育公司
creators.bio_zh: Merge 生产 Merge Cube——一个印有图案的泡沫立方体，手机可以追踪它，让人把全息影像拿在手中翻转查看，已在学校中广泛使用。
creators.why_zh: 它做出了一个廉价的实体追踪器，让 AR 成为孩子们可以握在手里的东西。

creators.name: Novum Analytics
creators.role: Indie studio; Night Terrors AR horror
creators.bio: Small studio behind Night Terrors, a crowdfunded phone AR survival horror game played at home in the dark with headphones.
creators.why: Night Terrors used the player's own house, mapped by the phone, as the haunted set.
creators.role_zh: 独立工作室；Night Terrors AR 恐怖游戏
creators.bio_zh: 小型工作室，推出了众筹手机 AR 生存恐怖游戏 Night Terrors，玩家需要戴上耳机，在黑暗的家中游玩。
creators.why_zh: Night Terrors 把手机扫描出的玩家自家房屋当作闹鬼的布景。

creators.name: The LEGO Group (Hidden Side)
creators.role: Toy company; LEGO Hidden Side AR sets
creators.bio: LEGO's Hidden Side line (2019) combined physical building sets with a phone app that revealed ghosts haunting the model.
creators.why: Merged physical construction play with an AR layer that reacts to the built model.
creators.role_zh: 玩具公司；LEGO Hidden Side AR 套装
creators.bio_zh: LEGO 的 Hidden Side 系列（2019）把实体积木套装与手机应用相结合，应用能显现出盘踞在模型中的幽灵。
creators.why_zh: 它把实体搭建游戏与一个会对搭好的模型作出反应的 AR 图层融为一体。

creators.name: Mojang Studios (Minecraft Earth)
creators.role: Game studio; Minecraft Earth
creators.bio: Mojang and Microsoft built Minecraft Earth (2019–2021), a location-based AR game where players built life-size Minecraft structures in the real world.
creators.why: Let players build and play inside life-size voxel builds together on the street.
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室；Minecraft Earth
creators.bio_zh: Mojang 与 Microsoft 合作打造了 Minecraft Earth（2019–2021），这是一款基于位置的 AR 游戏，玩家可以在现实世界中搭建真实尺寸的 Minecraft 建筑。
creators.why_zh: 它让玩家在街头一起搭建真实尺寸的体素建筑，并在其中游戏。
creators.based_zh: 斯德哥尔摩，瑞典 / 雷德蒙德，美国

creators.name: Zenka (Zenka Caro)
creators.role: AR artist
creators.bio: Artist who from 2012 made AR street art, murals, postcards and linoleum prints that came alive through Aurasma on phones.
creators.why: An early fine-art user of phone AR, turning prints and walls into animated works years before ARKit.
creators.role_zh: AR 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家，自 2012 年起创作 AR 街头艺术、壁画、明信片和麻胶版画，通过手机上的 Aurasma 让它们活起来。
creators.why_zh: 她是早期将手机 AR 用于纯艺术创作的人之一，比 ARKit 早好几年就把版画和墙面变成了动态作品。

creators.name: Tender Claws (Samantha Gorman & Danny Cannizzaro)
creators.role: Immersive game and art studio
creators.bio: Studio led by Samantha Gorman and Danny Cannizzaro that makes experimental VR and AR works such as Virtual Virtual Reality, The Under Presents and the AR pet TendAR.
creators.why: TendAR made an AR creature that literally feeds on the player's facial expressions and emotions.
creators.role_zh: 沉浸式游戏与艺术工作室
creators.bio_zh: 由 Samantha Gorman 和 Danny Cannizzaro 领导的工作室，创作实验性 VR 与 AR 作品，如 Virtual Virtual Reality、The Under Presents 以及 AR 宠物 TendAR。
creators.why_zh: TendAR 创造了一只真正以玩家面部表情和情绪为“食物”的 AR 生物。

creators.name: SCE Japan Studio (The Eye of Judgment)
creators.role: Sony first-party studio
creators.bio: Sony's Japan Studio co-created The Eye of Judgment (2007) with Wizards of the Coast, a PS3 card battle game read by the PlayStation Eye camera.
creators.why: The Eye of Judgment was the first major console AR game, turning a physical trading-card mat into a 3D battlefield.
creators.role_zh: Sony 第一方工作室
creators.bio_zh: Sony 的 Japan Studio 与 Wizards of the Coast 合作推出了 The Eye of Judgment（2007）——一款通过 PlayStation Eye 摄像头读取卡牌的 PS3 卡牌对战游戏。
creators.why_zh: The Eye of Judgment 是第一款主流主机 AR 游戏，把实体集换式卡牌垫变成了三维战场。

creators.name: Scott Snibbe
creators.role: Interactive artist; founder of Snibbe Studio and Snibbe Interactive
creators.bio: Media artist whose late-1990s/2000s 'Screen Series' turned projector light and a viewer's shadow into an interactive medium; he later produced Björk's Biophilia app and led Snibbe Interactive's museum installations.
creators.why: Boundary Functions and the shadow works are the canonical examples of projection AR that needs no device: the body itself is the controller.
creators.role_zh: 互动艺术家；Snibbe Studio 与 Snibbe Interactive 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 媒体艺术家，他在 1990 年代末至 2000 年代的“Screen Series”把投影光和观者的影子变成了互动媒介；后来他制作了 Björk 的 Biophilia 应用，并领导 Snibbe Interactive 的博物馆装置项目。
creators.why_zh: Boundary Functions 和他的影子系列作品，是无需任何设备的投影 AR 的经典范例：身体本身就是控制器。

creators.name: Camille Utterback
creators.role: Interactive installation artist; MacArthur Fellow (2009)
creators.bio: Artist whose camera-based projections (Text Rain with Romy Achituv, the External Measures series, Liquid Time) render the moving body as a painterly, living trace. Associate professor at Stanford.
creators.why: Text Rain (1999) is one of the most taught interactive artworks ever: bodies catching falling letters is still the clearest demo of body-driven mixed reality.
creators.role_zh: 互动装置艺术家；麦克阿瑟学者（2009）
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家，她基于摄像头的投影作品（与 Romy Achituv 合作的 Text Rain、External Measures 系列、Liquid Time）把运动中的身体呈现为富有绘画感的鲜活痕迹。现任斯坦福大学副教授。
creators.why_zh: Text Rain（1999）是被教授最多的互动艺术作品之一：用身体接住飘落的字母，至今仍是身体驱动型混合现实最清晰的示范。

creators.name: Karolina Sobecka
creators.role: Artist and researcher (gravitytrap, Flightphase)
creators.bio: Polish-born artist who projects responsive animals and figures into public space — from shop windows to buildings passing by a moving car — and later turned to cloud and atmosphere research.
creators.why: Sniff and Wildlife put real-time, camera- or sensor-driven characters into the street years before phone AR, making public space itself the display.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者（gravitytrap、Flightphase）
creators.bio_zh: 出生于波兰的艺术家，将能够回应观众的动物和人物投射到公共空间——从商店橱窗到在行驶车辆旁掠过的建筑——后来转向云与大气研究。
creators.why_zh: Sniff 和 Wildlife 早在手机 AR 出现前多年，就把由摄像头或传感器实时驱动的角色带上街头，让公共空间本身成为显示屏。
creators.based_zh: 纽约，美国 / 巴塞罗那

creators.name: Klaus Obermaier
creators.role: Media artist, director, choreographer and composer
creators.bio: Austrian artist who has projection-mapped moving dancers since 1998 (D.A.V.E., Vivisector) and, with Ars Electronica Futurelab, made real-time interactive body projection with Apparition (2004) and a stereoscopic Rite of Spring.
creators.why: He pioneered projection mapping onto live moving bodies — AR on the performer rather than on a screen.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家、导演、编舞家、作曲家
creators.bio_zh: 奥地利艺术家，自 1998 年起在运动中的舞者身上进行投影映射（D.A.V.E.、Vivisector），并与 Ars Electronica Futurelab 合作，以 Apparition（2004）实现了实时互动身体投影，还创作了立体版《春之祭》。
creators.why_zh: 他开创了在运动中的真人身体上进行投影映射——让 AR 出现在表演者身上，而非屏幕上。

creators.name: MIKIKO / ELEVENPLAY
creators.role: Choreographer and stage director; founder of the dance company ELEVENPLAY
creators.bio: MIKIKO choreographs Perfume and BABYMETAL and leads ELEVENPLAY, whose decade-long collaboration with Rhizomatiks (Daito Manabe, Motoi Ishibashi) produced dances with drones, robot cubes, AR overlays and mixed-reality stages.
creators.why: She is the choreographer who made drones, projection and mixed reality into dance partners rather than stage effects.
creators.role_zh: 编舞家、舞台导演；舞团 ELEVENPLAY 创始人
creators.bio_zh: MIKIKO 为 Perfume 和 BABYMETAL 编舞，并领导 ELEVENPLAY。舞团与 Rhizomatiks（Daito Manabe、Motoi Ishibashi）长达十年的合作，诞生了与无人机、机器人立方体、AR 叠加以及混合现实舞台共舞的作品。
creators.why_zh: 正是这位编舞家让无人机、投影和混合现实成为舞伴，而不只是舞台特效。

creators.name: Random International (Hannes Koch & Florian Ortkrass)
creators.role: Art studio
creators.bio: Studio founded in 2005 that makes camera-driven installations where matter reacts to the viewer's presence — mirrors that turn to stare, light that paints your reflection, rain that stops where you walk.
creators.why: Rain Room made 'reality that responds to your body' a mass-audience experience without any headset or screen.
creators.role_zh: 艺术工作室
creators.bio_zh: 成立于 2005 年的工作室，创作由摄像头驱动的装置，让物质对观者的存在作出反应——会转过来凝视你的镜子、描绘你倒影的光、在你走过之处停下的雨。
creators.why_zh: Rain Room 让“回应你身体的现实”成为一种无需头显或屏幕的大众体验。
creators.based_zh: 伦敦，英国 / 柏林，德国

creators.name: Rafael Lozano-Hemmer
creators.role: Media artist; founder of Antimodular Research
creators.bio: Mexican-Canadian artist whose 'relational architecture' uses surveillance cameras, robotic projectors and biometric sensors to let the public take over city squares and façades; represented Mexico at the 2007 Venice Biennale.
creators.why: Body Movies and Under Scan are defining works of public-space projection AR, where your shadow reveals hidden portraits on a building or square.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家；Antimodular Research 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 墨西哥裔加拿大艺术家，他的“关系建筑”利用监控摄像头、机器人投影仪和生物识别传感器，让公众接管城市广场和建筑立面；曾于 2007 年代表墨西哥参加威尼斯双年展。
creators.why_zh: Body Movies 和 Under Scan 是公共空间投影 AR 的代表作：你的影子会在建筑或广场上揭示隐藏的肖像。

creators.name: Daniel Rozin
creators.role: Artist; professor at NYU ITP
creators.bio: Israeli-American artist who builds 'mechanical mirrors': grids of wood, trash, pegs, steel or toy penguins moved by motors to reflect the viewer captured by a hidden camera.
creators.why: His mirrors turn a camera feed into physical pixels — the most tangible form of a reality filter.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；NYU ITP 教授
creators.bio_zh: 以色列裔美国艺术家，打造“机械镜子”：由木块、垃圾、木钉、钢片或玩具企鹅组成的阵列，在电机驱动下映照出隐藏摄像头捕捉到的观者。
creators.why_zh: 他的镜子把摄像头画面变成了实体像素——这是“现实滤镜”最可触摸的形式。

creators.name: Adrien M & Claire B (Adrien Mondot & Claire Bardainne)
creators.role: Digital art and performance company
creators.bio: Company combining juggler-programmer Adrien Mondot and visual artist Claire Bardainne; their live, physics-driven projections (eMotion software) and AR books/exhibitions make drawings breathe around dancers and visitors.
creators.why: They extended projection-mapped dance into hand-held AR: pop-up books and drawn exhibitions come alive through a tablet.
creators.role_zh: 数字艺术与表演团体
creators.bio_zh: 由杂耍艺人兼程序员 Adrien Mondot 与视觉艺术家 Claire Bardainne 组成的团体；他们基于物理模拟的实时投影（eMotion 软件）以及 AR 书籍与展览，让手绘图像在舞者和观众周围呼吸起来。
creators.why_zh: 他们把投影映射舞蹈延伸到手持 AR：立体书和手绘展览通过平板电脑活了起来。

creators.name: Romain Tardy
creators.role: Visual artist; former core member of the AntiVJ label
creators.bio: French artist who co-shaped AntiVJ's architectural projection mapping (Déshérence, O (Omicron)) and now builds site-specific light and projection installations that treat buildings and landscapes as narrative surfaces.
creators.why: O (Omicron) on Wrocław's Centennial Hall is a reference piece for projection mapping that reveals — rather than decorates — the architecture.
creators.role_zh: 视觉艺术家；AntiVJ 厂牌前核心成员
creators.bio_zh: 法国艺术家，参与塑造了 AntiVJ 的建筑投影映射（Déshérence、O (Omicron)），如今创作场域特定的灯光与投影装置，把建筑和地景当作叙事的表面。
creators.why_zh: 在弗罗茨瓦夫百年厅上呈现的 O (Omicron) 是投影映射的参照之作——它揭示建筑，而非装饰建筑。

creators.name: Yannick Jacquet (Legoman)
creators.role: Media artist and art director; former AntiVJ member
creators.bio: Visual artist known as Legoman in the AntiVJ label; his mapped installations mix physical print, mechanism and projection so that drawn machines and images appear to move on paper and walls.
creators.why: Mécaniques Discursives shows how a static print plus precise projection becomes a living machine — a low-tech, highly teachable form of spatial AR.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家、艺术总监；AntiVJ 前成员
creators.bio_zh: 在 AntiVJ 厂牌中以 Legoman 之名为人所知的视觉艺术家；他的映射装置融合了实体印刷品、机械结构与投影，让纸面和墙上的手绘机器与图像仿佛动了起来。
creators.why_zh: Mécaniques Discursives 展示了一张静态印刷品加上精准投影，就能变成一台鲜活的机器——这是一种低技术、非常适合教学的空间 AR 形式。

creators.name: URBANSCREEN
creators.role: Artist collective and studio for architectural projection
creators.bio: Collective founded in 2005 that pioneered large-scale 'architectural staging' — façade projections such as 555 KUBIK and the Sydney Opera House sails — and 'augmented sculptures' where projection and custom-built forms are designed together.
creators.why: 555 KUBIK (2009) is one of the viral works that defined 3D projection mapping as an art form.
creators.role_zh: 建筑投影艺术团体与工作室
creators.bio_zh: 成立于 2005 年的团体，开创了大规模“建筑演出”——如 555 KUBIK 和悉尼歌剧院风帆上的立面投影——以及“增强雕塑”，即投影与定制造型被一体设计。
creators.why_zh: 555 KUBIK（2009）是将 3D 投影映射确立为一种艺术形式的病毒式传播作品之一。

creators.name: Refik Anadol
creators.role: Media artist; founder of Refik Anadol Studio
creators.bio: Turkish-American artist who turns architecture into 'data paintings' with large-scale projection and, later, AI-generated 'data sculptures' on building façades and immersive rooms.
creators.why: WDCH Dreams projected a machine's 'memories' of an orchestra onto Frank Gehry's concert hall, extending projection mapping into data and AI.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家；Refik Anadol Studio 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 土耳其裔美国艺术家，用大规模投影把建筑变成“数据绘画”，后来又在建筑立面和沉浸式空间中创作 AI 生成的“数据雕塑”。
creators.why_zh: WDCH Dreams 把机器对一支管弦乐团的“记忆”投射到 Frank Gehry 设计的音乐厅上，把投影映射拓展到了数据与 AI 领域。

creators.name: Miguel Chevalier
creators.role: Digital artist
creators.bio: Mexican-French pioneer of computer art since the 1980s whose generative, interactive floor and vault projections (Magic Carpets, Fractal Flowers, Digital Supernova) respond to visitors walking through them.
creators.why: Magic Carpets turned historic floors into generative, body-responsive carpets of light that anyone can play with.
creators.role_zh: 数字艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 墨西哥裔法国艺术家，自 1980 年代起就是计算机艺术的先驱；他的生成式互动地面与穹顶投影（Magic Carpets、Fractal Flowers、Digital Supernova）会对穿行其间的观众作出反应。
creators.why_zh: Magic Carpets 把历史建筑的地面变成了生成式的、会回应身体的光之地毯，任何人都可以在上面玩耍。

creators.name: Hellicar & Lewis (Pete Hellicar & Joel Gethin Lewis)
creators.role: Creative studio
creators.bio: London studio (active c. 2008–2015) that built camera- and Kinect-driven installations with openFrameworks, from mirror-like feedback walls to Somantics, an interactive app for autistic children.
creators.why: They showed how openFrameworks computer vision could turn a gallery or shop into a playful body-responsive space.
creators.role_zh: 创意工作室
creators.bio_zh: 伦敦工作室（约 2008–2015 年活跃），使用 openFrameworks 打造由摄像头和 Kinect 驱动的装置，从镜像般的反馈墙到为自闭症儿童设计的互动应用 Somantics。
creators.why_zh: 他们展示了 openFrameworks 计算机视觉如何把画廊或商店变成趣味十足、回应身体的空间。

creators.name: Jiabao Li
creators.role: Artist; assistant professor at UT Austin
creators.bio: Chinese-born artist and designer whose work uses AR, projection and performance to let people perceive the world through bats, glaciers and plankton.
creators.why: EchoVision and Nocturnal Fugue turn mixed reality into a way of sensing like another species.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校助理教授
creators.bio_zh: 出生于中国的艺术家和设计师，她的作品运用 AR、投影和表演，让人们通过蝙蝠、冰川和浮游生物的方式感知世界。
creators.why_zh: EchoVision 和 Nocturnal Fugue 让混合现实成为一种像其他物种那样去感知的方式。

creators.name: Marlena Myles
creators.role: Artist (Spirit Lake Dakota)
creators.bio: Dakota artist who uses AR public art, animation and projection to restore Dakota language, stories and place-knowledge to the land of the Twin Cities.
creators.why: Her Dakota Spirit Walk is a model of site-specific AR used to reclaim Indigenous presence in public space.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家（Spirit Lake Dakota 部族）
creators.bio_zh: 达科他族艺术家，运用 AR 公共艺术、动画和投影，将达科他语言、故事和地方知识重新带回双子城的土地。
creators.why_zh: 她的 Dakota Spirit Walk 是运用场域特定 AR 在公共空间中重申原住民存在的典范。
creators.based_zh: 圣保罗（明尼苏达州），美国

creators.name: Jakob Kudsk Steensen
creators.role: Artist working with ecology and game engines
creators.bio: Danish artist who builds ecological worlds from field recordings, scans and game engines; his Serpentine commission The Deep Listener brought them into Kensington Gardens as location-based AR.
creators.why: The Deep Listener is a benchmark for AR that makes you listen to a park's species rather than just look at objects.
creators.role_zh: 以生态和游戏引擎为媒介的艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 丹麦艺术家，用野外录音、三维扫描和游戏引擎构建生态世界；他为 Serpentine 创作的委约作品 The Deep Listener 以基于位置的 AR 形式把这些世界带入了肯辛顿花园。
creators.why_zh: The Deep Listener 是 AR 的一个标杆：它让你去聆听公园里的物种，而不只是观看物体。

creators.name: Olafur Eliasson
creators.role: Artist; Studio Olafur Eliasson
creators.bio: Icelandic-Danish artist whose light, colour and perception installations (The Weather Project) extended into AR with Wunderkammer and the children's climate app Earth Speakr.
creators.why: He makes perception itself the artwork, whether through coloured shadows in a gallery or AR objects in your home.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；Studio Olafur Eliasson
creators.bio_zh: 冰岛裔丹麦艺术家，他关于光、色彩与感知的装置（The Weather Project）通过 Wunderkammer 和儿童气候应用 Earth Speakr 延伸到了 AR 领域。
creators.why_zh: 他让感知本身成为艺术作品，无论是画廊里的彩色阴影，还是你家中的 AR 物件。
creators.based_zh: 柏林，德国 / 哥本哈根，丹麦

creators.name: KAWS (Brian Donnelly)
creators.role: Artist and designer
creators.bio: Artist whose COMPANION figures moved from street art and toys into giant inflatables and, with Acute Art, some of the most widely seen AR sculptures and AR packaging.
creators.why: His AR releases showed that a collectable AR sculpture can reach millions of phones, not just gallery visitors.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、设计师
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家，他的 COMPANION 形象从街头艺术和玩具发展为巨型充气雕塑，并与 Acute Art 合作推出了一些观看人数最多的 AR 雕塑和 AR 包装。
creators.why_zh: 他的 AR 作品证明，一件可收藏的 AR 雕塑能够触达数百万部手机，而不仅是画廊观众。

creators.name: Raymond Salvatore Harmon
creators.role: Artist, filmmaker and muralist
creators.bio: American artist working across graffiti, experimental film and painting; MIRAGE combined an architecture-scale painted wall with a mobile AR layer.
creators.why: MIRAGE is an early example of a mural designed from the start to be completed by AR.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、电影人、壁画家
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，创作横跨涂鸦、实验电影与绘画；MIRAGE 将建筑尺度的彩绘墙面与移动 AR 图层结合在一起。
creators.why_zh: MIRAGE 是一件从一开始就被设计为需要 AR 来完成的早期壁画作品。
creators.based_zh: 伦敦，英国 / 洛杉矶，美国

creators.name: Will Pappenheimer
creators.role: Artist; co-founder of Manifest.AR; professor at Pace University
creators.bio: Artist and founding member of the Manifest.AR collective (2010) who has made location-based AR interventions for over a decade — dancing glitch figures, falling voxels that 'paint' sites, and AR at the Venice Biennale.
creators.why: He is one of the artists who defined AR as an uninvited public-art intervention from the Layar era onward.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；Manifest.AR 联合创始人；Pace University 教授
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家，Manifest.AR 团体（2010）的创始成员，十多年来持续创作基于位置的 AR 介入作品——舞动的故障人形、为场地“上色”的下落体素，以及在威尼斯双年展上的 AR 作品。
creators.why_zh: 从 Layar 时代起，他就是将 AR 定义为不请自来的公共艺术介入的艺术家之一。

creators.name: Chris Milk
creators.role: Director and immersive artist; co-founder of Within
creators.bio: Music-video director who moved into interactive and immersive work; The Treachery of Sanctuary turned visitors' shadows into flocks of birds before he co-founded the VR company Within.
creators.why: The Treachery of Sanctuary is one of the most-watched body-tracking projection works of the Kinect era.
creators.role_zh: 导演、沉浸式艺术家；Within 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 音乐录影带导演，后转向互动与沉浸式创作；在联合创办 VR 公司 Within 之前，他的 The Treachery of Sanctuary 把观众的影子变成了成群的飞鸟。
creators.why_zh: The Treachery of Sanctuary 是 Kinect 时代观看次数最多的身体追踪投影作品之一。

creators.name: Shunichi Kasahara
creators.role: Researcher, Sony Computer Science Laboratories; leads Cybernetic Humanity Studio (OIST)
creators.bio: Sony CSL researcher who builds perception-bending systems: first-person view sharing (JackIn), out-of-body telepresence, EMS-accelerated reactions and real-time face morphing. Earlier co-created exTouch and Second Surface at the MIT Media Lab.
creators.why: He treats AR as 'Superception' - engineering the sense of self by swapping, splitting and delaying what you see and do.
creators.role_zh: Sony 计算机科学研究所研究员；领导 Cybernetic Humanity Studio（OIST）
creators.bio_zh: Sony CSL 研究员，打造扭转感知的系统：第一人称视角共享（JackIn）、灵魂出窍式远程呈现、借助肌肉电刺激加速反应，以及实时人脸变形。早年曾在 MIT Media Lab 参与创作 exTouch 和 Second Surface。
creators.why_zh: 他把 AR 视为“Superception”（超感知）——通过交换、拆分和延迟你所看到与所做的，来设计人的自我感。

creators.name: Ivan Poupyrev
creators.role: Interaction scientist; Sony CSL, Disney Research, Google ATAP (Soli, Jacquard); CEO of Archetype AI
creators.bio: Built early tangible AR at Sony CSL and HIT Lab, then turned everyday matter into interfaces at Disney Research (Touché, Botanicus Interacticus, Ishin-Den-Shin) and Google ATAP (Soli radar, Jacquard textiles).
creators.why: He makes the physical world itself the input surface - plants, water, skin, fabric and air become sensors for mixed reality.
creators.role_zh: 交互科学家；曾任职于 Sony CSL、Disney Research、Google ATAP（Soli、Jacquard）；Archetype AI 首席执行官
creators.bio_zh: 他早年在 Sony CSL 和 HIT Lab 构建了早期的可触摸 AR，随后在 Disney Research（Touché、Botanicus Interacticus、Ishin-Den-Shin）和 Google ATAP（Soli 雷达、Jacquard 智能织物）把日常物质变成了界面。
creators.why_zh: 他让物理世界本身成为输入表面——植物、水、皮肤、织物和空气都成了混合现实的传感器。

creators.name: Ken Nakagaki
creators.role: Assistant Professor, University of Chicago; directs the Actuated Experience Lab (AxLab)
creators.bio: Former MIT Tangible Media researcher who builds shape-changing lines, robot swarms and mechanical shells that make digital information physically move around people.
creators.why: His actuated tangibles are the physical twin of AR: instead of overlaying pixels, the room's objects reshape and move themselves.
creators.role_zh: 芝加哥大学助理教授；主持 Actuated Experience Lab（AxLab）
creators.bio_zh: 曾任 MIT Tangible Media 研究员，打造可变形的线、机器人集群和机械外壳，让数字信息在人们周围以实体方式移动。
creators.why_zh: 他的驱动式可触摸界面是 AR 的实体孪生：不是叠加像素，而是让房间里的物体自己变形、移动。

creators.name: Yuta Itoh
creators.role: Associate Professor, University of Tokyo (Augmented Vision Lab); formerly Tokyo Tech and TU Munich
creators.bio: Researches optical see-through displays that do more than add graphics: they subtract light, fix eyesight and show the future path of moving objects.
creators.why: He reframes AR glasses as 'vision augmentation' - hardware that rewrites the light reaching your eye.
creators.role_zh: 东京大学副教授（Augmented Vision Lab）；曾任职于东京工业大学和慕尼黑工业大学
creators.bio_zh: 研究光学透视显示器，让它们不只是添加图形：还能削减光线、矫正视力，并显示运动物体的未来轨迹。
creators.why_zh: 他把 AR 眼镜重新定义为“视觉增强”——一种改写进入你眼睛的光线的硬件。

creators.name: Pedro Lopes
creators.role: Associate Professor, University of Chicago; directs the Human Computer Integration Lab
creators.bio: Builds interfaces that actuate the user's own body - electrical muscle stimulation, chemical and thermal haptics - to give mixed reality physical weight and to let objects 'tell' your hands how to use them.
creators.why: He turned the human body into the output device of AR: your muscles feel the virtual wall.
creators.role_zh: 芝加哥大学副教授；主持 Human Computer Integration Lab
creators.bio_zh: 打造驱动用户自身身体的界面——肌肉电刺激、化学与温度触觉——为混合现实赋予实体的重量，并让物体“告诉”你的双手该如何使用它们。
creators.why_zh: 他把人体变成了 AR 的输出设备：你的肌肉能感受到虚拟的墙。

creators.name: Michael Nebeling
creators.role: Associate Professor, University of Michigan School of Information; Information Interaction Lab
creators.bio: Creates rapid prototyping tools that let non-programmers make AR/VR from paper, Play-Doh and video (ProtoAR, 360proto, XRDirector).
creators.why: He democratised AR design: sketches on paper become working AR prototypes in minutes.
creators.role_zh: 密歇根大学信息学院副教授；Information Interaction Lab
creators.bio_zh: 开发快速原型工具，让不会编程的人也能用纸张、培乐多彩泥和视频制作 AR/VR（ProtoAR、360proto、XRDirector）。
creators.why_zh: 他让 AR 设计走向大众：纸上的草图几分钟内就能变成可运行的 AR 原型。

creators.name: Lightform (Brett Jones & Kevin Karsch)
creators.role: Projected-AR hardware/software startup; Brett Jones was lead author of IllumiRoom and RoomAlive
creators.bio: Lightform built the LF1/LF2 projector-camera units and Lightform Creator so anyone could scan a scene and projection-map it in minutes.
creators.why: Turned research-grade projector-camera AR (IllumiRoom, RoomAlive) into a consumer tool for 'projected AR' murals and objects.
creators.role_zh: 投影 AR 软硬件初创公司；Brett Jones 是 IllumiRoom 和 RoomAlive 的第一作者
creators.bio_zh: Lightform 打造了 LF1/LF2 投影仪-摄像头一体设备和 Lightform Creator，让任何人都能在几分钟内扫描场景并完成投影映射。
creators.why_zh: 它把研究级的投影仪-摄像头 AR（IllumiRoom、RoomAlive）变成了面向消费者的工具，用于制作“投影 AR”壁画和物件。

creators.name: Rajinder Sodhi
creators.role: HCI researcher (UIUC PhD); worked at Microsoft Research, Disney Research and Qualcomm on projected and haptic AR
creators.bio: Co-created LightGuide (projected hand-movement guidance), BeThere (3D mobile telepresence with spatial input) and Disney's AIREAL air-vortex haptics.
creators.why: LightGuide is one of the clearest demonstrations that AR can guide the body by drawing directly on the hand.
creators.role_zh: HCI 研究者（UIUC 博士）；曾在 Microsoft Research、Disney Research 和 Qualcomm 从事投影与触觉 AR 研究
creators.bio_zh: 参与创作了 LightGuide（投影式手部动作引导）、BeThere（支持空间输入的三维移动远程呈现），以及 Disney 的 AIREAL 空气涡旋触觉技术。
creators.why_zh: LightGuide 是最清晰的示范之一：AR 可以直接在手上作画，从而引导身体动作。

creators.name: Autodesk Research (Fraser Anderson, Tovi Grossman, George Fitzmaurice et al.)
creators.role: Corporate HCI research group
creators.bio: Autodesk's UI research group builds AR tools for making and learning: projected pen overlays, AR movement mirrors, assembly-tutorial authoring and two-way MR remote instruction.
creators.why: A decade of practical, craft-centred AR interaction ideas (YouMove, PenLight, AuthAR, Loki) that map directly onto teaching.
creators.role_zh: 企业 HCI 研究团队
creators.bio_zh: Autodesk 的用户界面研究团队为制作与学习打造 AR 工具：投影式笔迹叠加、AR 动作镜像、装配教程创作工具，以及双向 MR 远程指导。
creators.why_zh: 十年来积累的一批务实、以手艺为核心的 AR 交互构想（YouMove、PenLight、AuthAR、Loki），可以直接应用于教学。

creators.name: Madeline Gannon
creators.role: Artist-roboticist; principal of ATONATON
creators.bio: Designs ways for people to communicate with machines - from projection-mapped on-skin 3D modelling (Tactum) to industrial robots that watch and follow visitors (Mimus).
creators.why: Tactum made your own forearm the canvas and controller for designing wearables in projected AR.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家兼机器人专家；ATONATON 主理人
creators.bio_zh: 设计人与机器沟通的方式——从投影映射到皮肤上的三维建模（Tactum），到会注视并跟随参观者的工业机器人（Mimus）。
creators.why_zh: Tactum 把你的前臂变成了画布和控制器，让你在投影 AR 中设计可穿戴物品。

creators.name: Denis Kalkofen
creators.role: Associate Professor, Flinders University; formerly Graz University of Technology (ICG)
creators.bio: Specialist in AR visualization: X-ray and ghosted views of hidden structure, compact labels, and retargeting manuals and video tutorials into 3D AR instructions.
creators.why: He solved how AR should show what is inside or behind real objects without confusing depth.
creators.role_zh: 弗林德斯大学副教授；曾任职于格拉茨技术大学（ICG）
creators.bio_zh: AR 可视化专家：研究隐藏结构的 X 光式与半透明视图、紧凑标注，以及将说明书和视频教程转换为三维 AR 指引。
creators.why_zh: 他解决了 AR 如何在不造成深度混淆的前提下，展示真实物体内部或背后的内容。
creators.based_zh: 阿德莱德，澳大利亚 / 格拉茨，奥地利

creators.name: Magic Leap Studios
creators.role: In-house content studio of Magic Leap
creators.bio: Produced Magic Leap's showcase spatial experiences - the 2015 gym-whale concept, Create, Dodge, Mica and Undersea - to show content that respects real room geometry.
creators.why: Their demos defined the vocabulary of headset MR: creatures that know your furniture, digital humans that share your table.
creators.role_zh: Magic Leap 内部内容工作室
creators.bio_zh: 制作了 Magic Leap 的一系列空间体验展示作品——2015 年体育馆鲸鱼概念片、Create、Dodge、Mica 和 Undersea——用以展示尊重真实房间几何结构的内容。
creators.why_zh: 他们的演示定义了头显 MR 的语汇：认得你家具的生物、与你同桌而坐的数字人。
creators.based_zh: 种植园市（佛罗里达州），美国

creators.name: ILMxLAB (Lucasfilm)
creators.role: Lucasfilm's immersive entertainment studio
creators.bio: ILM's immersive lab made Star Wars mixed-reality experiments with Magic Leap, from the 2016 'Lost Droids' test to Project Porg.
creators.why: Showed how beloved characters can inhabit your real living room and respond to you.
creators.role_zh: Lucasfilm 旗下沉浸式娱乐工作室
creators.bio_zh: ILM 的沉浸式实验室与 Magic Leap 合作开展了星球大战混合现实实验，从 2016 年的“Lost Droids”测试到 Project Porg。
creators.why_zh: 展示了深受喜爱的角色如何住进你真实的客厅，并对你作出回应。

creators.name: Microsoft HoloLens team (Alex Kipman, Kudo Tsunoda & Microsoft Studios)
creators.role: Platform team and first-party studio for HoloLens
creators.bio: Shipped the first self-contained holographic computer and its launch apps - RoboRaid, HoloStudio and the Minecraft tabletop demo.
creators.why: Established gaze + air-tap + voice as the grammar of headset AR and made spatial mapping playable.
creators.role_zh: HoloLens 平台团队与第一方工作室
creators.bio_zh: 推出了首台独立运行的全息计算机及其首发应用——RoboRaid、HoloStudio 和 Minecraft 桌面演示。
creators.why_zh: 确立了“注视 + 空中点击 + 语音”作为头显 AR 的交互语法，并让空间建图变得可玩。

creators.name: Meta Reality Labs (Quest mixed reality)
creators.role: Platform team behind Quest Presence Platform showcases
creators.bio: Built the Presence Platform showcases The World Beyond and First Encounters that teach Quest users what passthrough MR can do.
creators.why: First Encounters' punch-through-your-wall moment is the canonical demo of scene-aware passthrough MR.
creators.role_zh: Quest Presence Platform 展示作品背后的平台团队
creators.bio_zh: 打造了 Presence Platform 展示作品 The World Beyond 和 First Encounters，向 Quest 用户展示透视 MR 的能力。
creators.why_zh: First Encounters 中一拳打穿你家墙壁的那一刻，是场景感知透视 MR 的经典演示。

creators.name: Apple (ARKit / visionOS teams)
creators.role: Platform company
creators.bio: Apple's ARKit and visionOS teams released SwiftShot, the first multi-user ARKit sample game, and the Vision Pro showcase Encounter Dinosaurs.
creators.why: Their showcases set expectations for shared tabletop AR and for creatures that notice you in spatial computing.
creators.role_zh: 平台公司
creators.bio_zh: Apple 的 ARKit 和 visionOS 团队发布了首款多人 ARKit 示例游戏 SwiftShot，以及 Vision Pro 展示作品 Encounter Dinosaurs。
creators.why_zh: 他们的展示作品为共享桌面 AR，以及空间计算中会注意到你的生物，设定了行业预期。

creators.name: Figmin XR (Overlay)
creators.role: Independent team behind the mixed-reality creation app Figmin XR
creators.bio: Figmin XR is a HoloLens-born, now Quest/Vision Pro app where you sketch, collect and script 3D objects that live and collide with your real room.
creators.why: It is a pocket 'mixed-reality sandbox': paint, physics, AI-scripted characters and room geometry in one tool.
creators.role_zh: 混合现实创作应用 Figmin XR 背后的独立团队
creators.bio_zh: Figmin XR 诞生于 HoloLens，如今登陆 Quest 和 Vision Pro；你可以在其中绘制、收集和编写三维对象的脚本，让它们在你的真实房间中存在并发生碰撞。
creators.why_zh: 它是一个口袋里的“混合现实沙盒”：绘画、物理、AI 脚本角色和房间几何集于一个工具之中。

creators.name: Danlin Huang
creators.role: Designer-researcher; China Academy of Art School of Design Innovation
creators.bio: Designs speculative mixed-reality rituals and tools - shared mushroom-mask MR, body-posture oracle glyphs, AR origami tutoring - often with Botao Amber Hu.
creators.why: Her work turns MR headsets into props for collective ritual and embodied speculation rather than screens.
creators.role_zh: 设计师、研究者；中国美术学院设计智造学院
creators.bio_zh: 设计思辨性的混合现实仪式与工具——共享蘑菇面具 MR、身体姿态神谕符号、AR 折纸辅导——常与 Botao Amber Hu 合作。
creators.why_zh: 她的作品把 MR 头显变成集体仪式与具身思辨的道具，而非屏幕。

creators.name: Owlchemy Labs
creators.role: VR/MR studio (Job Simulator), owned by Google
creators.bio: Makers of Job Simulator and Vacation Simulator, now leading hand-tracking design research and mixed-reality play on Android XR.
creators.why: Known for the most physical, comedic hand interactions in XR, now carried into passthrough MR.
creators.role_zh: VR/MR 工作室（Job Simulator），隶属 Google
creators.bio_zh: Job Simulator 和 Vacation Simulator 的开发商，如今在 Android XR 上引领手势追踪设计研究和混合现实游戏。
creators.why_zh: 以 XR 中最具物理感、最富喜剧性的手部交互著称，如今这种风格也延续到了透视 MR 中。

creators.name: Cyborn
creators.role: Belgian VR/MR game studio
creators.bio: Creators of Hubris and the Quest 3 mixed-reality town builder Wall Town Wonders.
creators.why: Wall Town Wonders turns ordinary room walls into a living miniature city - a vertical-surface MR idea few others explored.
creators.role_zh: 比利时 VR/MR 游戏工作室
creators.bio_zh: Hubris 以及 Quest 3 混合现实小镇建造游戏 Wall Town Wonders 的开发商。
creators.why_zh: Wall Town Wonders 把普通房间的墙面变成了生机勃勃的微缩城市——这是很少有人探索的“垂直表面” MR 构想。

creators.name: Vitukhin Serhii
creators.role: Unity/AR developer; early HoloKit community developer
creators.bio: Built some of the first HoloKit + ARKit stereo demos in 2017, including a co-located multiplayer drone shooter shown at SIGGRAPH 2017.
creators.why: Early proof that a cardboard phone headset could host shared, co-located stereo AR games.
creators.role_zh: Unity/AR 开发者；HoloKit 社区早期开发者
creators.bio_zh: 2017 年构建了最早一批 HoloKit + ARKit 立体演示，其中包括一款在 SIGGRAPH 2017 上展示的同处一地多人无人机射击游戏。
creators.why_zh: 早期证明了纸板手机头显也能承载共享、同处一地的立体 AR 游戏。

creators.name: Keijiro Takahashi
creators.role: Creative coder; developer advocate at Unity Technologies Japan
creators.bio: Unity Japan engineer who open-sources hundreds of real-time VFX, depth-camera and ML-tracking experiments on GitHub and uses them in live concert visuals.
creators.why: His Rcam/Bibcam/Metavido line turned the iPhone LiDAR into a volumetric AR camera for live VFX, and every experiment ships with source code students can run.
creators.role_zh: 创意编程者；Unity Technologies Japan 开发者布道师
creators.bio_zh: Unity 日本工程师，在 GitHub 上开源了数百个实时视觉特效、深度相机和机器学习追踪实验，并将它们用于现场演唱会视觉。
creators.why_zh: 他的 Rcam/Bibcam/Metavido 系列把 iPhone LiDAR 变成了用于现场视觉特效的体积化 AR 摄像机，而且每个实验都附带学生可以直接运行的源代码。

creators.name: Trixi Studios (Chip Sineni)
creators.role: Chicago VFX / AR studio led by Chip Sineni
creators.bio: Small animation and VFX studio that built early Project Tango and ARKit experiments, including the viral a-ha 'Take On Me' AR portal.
creators.why: Its 'Take On Me' portal (2017) showed that phone AR could reproduce a hand-drawn music-video world you can walk into, live in camera.
creators.role_zh: 由 Chip Sineni 领导的芝加哥视觉特效 / AR 工作室
creators.bio_zh: 小型动画与视觉特效工作室，构建了早期的 Project Tango 和 ARKit 实验，其中包括走红网络的 a-ha《Take On Me》AR 传送门。
creators.why_zh: 它的《Take On Me》传送门（2017）展示了手机 AR 能在摄像头画面中实时重现一个可以走进去的手绘音乐录影带世界。

creators.name: Stuart Langfield
creators.role: Director and designer
creators.bio: Film and motion director whose 2017 Super Mario AR test rethought a side-scroller as a ring-shaped level wrapped around the player.
creators.why: His Super Mario AR prototype is a textbook case of redesigning a 2D game format for the space around the player instead of porting it flat.
creators.role_zh: 导演、设计师
creators.bio_zh: 电影与动态影像导演，他在 2017 年制作的 Super Mario AR 测试，把横版卷轴游戏重新构想为环绕玩家的环形关卡。
creators.why_zh: 他的 Super Mario AR 原型是教科书级的案例：为玩家周围的空间重新设计 2D 游戏形式，而不是把它平面地移植过来。
creators.based_zh: 温哥华，加拿大 / 英国

creators.name: Jelle Vermandere
creators.role: Game developer and YouTuber
creators.bio: Belgian maker who builds mixed-reality games that use real objects and his body as controllers: a real football, RC cars, a smart Rubik's cube, a heart-rate monitor.
creators.why: He shows, step by step on YouTube, how computer vision and cheap hardware turn everyday objects into game controllers for AR-style play.
creators.role_zh: 游戏开发者、YouTuber
creators.bio_zh: 比利时创作者，打造以真实物体和自己身体为控制器的混合现实游戏：真实的足球、遥控车、智能魔方、心率监测器。
creators.why_zh: 他在 YouTube 上一步步展示计算机视觉和廉价硬件如何把日常物品变成 AR 式游戏的控制器。

creators.name: Tomás García
creators.role: Animator, character designer and AI artist
creators.bio: Argentine animator (ex-PepperMelon, MTV redesign) whose June 2017 ARKit tests of a moon landing in his kitchen and a Falcon 9 landing in a pool went viral in the first weeks of ARKit.
creators.why: His playful ARKit sketches showed how animation craft plus a correct sense of scale makes phone AR feel magical.
creators.role_zh: 动画师、角色设计师、AI 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 阿根廷动画师（曾任职于 PepperMelon，参与 MTV 品牌重塑），他在 2017 年 6 月发布的 ARKit 测试——厨房里的登月、泳池里降落的 Falcon 9——在 ARKit 问世最初几周迅速走红。
creators.why_zh: 他那些趣味十足的 ARKit 小品表明，动画手艺加上准确的尺度感，就能让手机 AR 显得充满魔力。
creators.based_zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯，阿根廷

creators.name: Can Büyükberber
creators.role: Immersive new-media artist
creators.bio: Turkish-born artist working with projection mapping, domes, VR and AR; Adobe's immersive artist in residence and an early ARKit experimenter.
creators.why: He moves the same generative sculptures across projection, print, dome, VR and AR, a clear model of how one visual idea can live in many realities.
creators.role_zh: 沉浸式新媒体艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 出生于土耳其的艺术家，创作涉及投影映射、球幕、VR 和 AR；曾任 Adobe 沉浸式驻留艺术家，也是早期的 ARKit 实验者。
creators.why_zh: 他让同一件生成式雕塑在投影、印刷、球幕、VR 和 AR 之间流转，清晰地示范了一个视觉构想如何栖身于多种现实。
creators.based_zh: 旧金山，美国 / 伊斯坦布尔，土耳其

creators.name: Judith Amores
creators.role: Researcher (MIT Media Lab PhD; Microsoft Research)
creators.bio: HCI researcher who built playful AR prototypes from Barcelona to MIT Media Lab and Google Creative Lab, and multi-person AR at Microsoft Research with Jaron Lanier.
creators.why: Co-author of three of Google's 2017 AR Experiments (Draw and Dance, Paper Cubes, Invisible Highway), each a compact, teachable AR interaction idea.
creators.role_zh: 研究者（MIT Media Lab 博士；Microsoft Research）
creators.bio_zh: HCI 研究者，从巴塞罗那到 MIT Media Lab 和 Google Creative Lab 都制作过趣味 AR 原型，并在 Microsoft Research 与 Jaron Lanier 合作研究多人 AR。
creators.why_zh: 她参与创作了 Google 2017 年 AR 实验中的三项（Draw and Dance、Paper Cubes、Invisible Highway），每一项都是精巧、易于教学的 AR 交互构想。

creators.name: Anna Fusté
creators.role: Creative technologist and researcher (MIT Media Lab alumna)
creators.bio: Catalan creative technologist whose AR work uses paper, textiles and robots as tangible interfaces, from Google AR Experiments to MIT Media Lab research on computational thinking.
creators.why: She keeps making AR out of cheap physical materials (paper cubes, fabrics, toy robots), which is exactly what classrooms can reproduce.
creators.role_zh: 创意技术专家、研究者（MIT Media Lab 校友）
creators.bio_zh: 加泰罗尼亚创意技术专家，她的 AR 作品以纸张、织物和机器人作为可触摸界面，从 Google AR 实验到 MIT Media Lab 关于计算思维的研究。
creators.why_zh: 她坚持用廉价的实体材料（纸立方体、织物、玩具机器人）制作 AR，而这恰恰是课堂可以复现的。
creators.based_zh: 剑桥（马萨诸塞州），美国 / 巴塞罗那，西班牙

creators.name: Aidan Wolf
creators.role: AR developer; co-founder of Dream Park
creators.bio: Long-time Snap AR developer who made DoodleLens (doodles into AR), multiplayer Snapchat lenses and Spectacles games, and now builds 'downloadable' mixed-reality theme parks with Dream Park.
creators.why: He turns every new AR capability into a playful, instantly shareable game, from doodles that come alive to whole streets turned into playgrounds.
creators.role_zh: AR 开发者；Dream Park 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 资深 Snap AR 开发者，制作了 DoodleLens（把涂鸦变成 AR）、多人 Snapchat 镜头和 Spectacles 游戏，如今与 Dream Park 一起打造“可下载的”混合现实主题公园。
creators.why_zh: 他把每一项新的 AR 能力都变成好玩、可即时分享的游戏，从活过来的涂鸦到被整条改造成游乐场的街道。

creators.name: Alessio Grancini
creators.role: AR engineer; Snap Spectacles developer relations (ex-Magic Leap, Morphosis)
creators.bio: Italian architect turned AR prototyper: SCI-Arc Gehry Prize thesis on a world-scale AR game, XR lead at Morphosis, prototype engineer at Magic Leap, now building and teaching Spectacles lenses at Snap.
creators.why: He carries architectural thinking into AR and ships a constant stream of hackathon prototypes that pair spatial computing with AI.
creators.role_zh: AR 工程师；Snap Spectacles 开发者关系（曾任职于 Magic Leap、Morphosis）
creators.bio_zh: 由意大利建筑师转型的 AR 原型开发者：在 SCI-Arc 以一款世界尺度 AR 游戏的毕业论文获得 Gehry Prize，曾任 Morphosis 的 XR 负责人、Magic Leap 原型工程师，现于 Snap 开发并教授 Spectacles 镜头。
creators.why_zh: 他把建筑思维带入 AR，并持续推出将空间计算与 AI 结合的黑客松原型。
creators.based_zh: 洛杉矶 / 旧金山，美国

creators.name: Luke Hurd
creators.role: AR effects creator and educator (Spark AR, Lens Studio)
creators.bio: Early Instagram/Spark AR effect creator and teacher whose YouTube breakdowns explained face-mesh, occlusion and segmentation tricks; later built branded AR for National Geographic/NASA JPL and Coachella.
creators.why: He made social-AR craft legible, publishing full breakdowns of how his viral effects actually work.
creators.role_zh: AR 特效创作者、教育者（Spark AR、Lens Studio）
creators.bio_zh: 早期 Instagram/Spark AR 特效创作者和教师，他在 YouTube 上的拆解视频讲解了面部网格、遮挡和分割技巧；后来为 National Geographic/NASA JPL 和 Coachella 打造了品牌 AR。
creators.why_zh: 他完整公开了自己那些爆款特效背后的实现方式，让社交 AR 的手艺变得清晰易懂。

creators.name: Torin Blankensmith
creators.role: Creative technologist, real-time graphics artist, Parsons adjunct
creators.bio: Ex-Google Creative Lab technologist (co-built AR Wormhole) and co-creator of Shader Park; his free MediaPipe and body-tracking plugins for TouchDesigner put camera-based body interaction in thousands of students' hands.
creators.why: He turns webcam hand and body tracking into open tools and short, remixable mixed-reality sketches that are ideal for teaching.
creators.role_zh: 创意技术专家、实时图形艺术家、Parsons 兼职教师
creators.bio_zh: 前 Google Creative Lab 技术专家（参与打造 AR Wormhole），Shader Park 的共同创作者；他为 TouchDesigner 开发的免费 MediaPipe 与身体追踪插件，把基于摄像头的身体交互交到了成千上万名学生手中。
creators.why_zh: 他把网络摄像头的手部与身体追踪变成开放工具和简短、可再创作的混合现实小品，非常适合教学。

creators.name: Fabin Rasheed
creators.role: Artist, designer and technologist (Nurecas)
creators.bio: Indian artist-designer who prototyped ARKit sculpting, multiplayer AR and AR drone control in 2017-18, presented an Adobe MAX Sneak, and now makes generative art.
creators.why: His early ARKit tools treated the phone as a sculpting and play space, and he keeps moving between interaction design and art.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、设计师、技术专家（Nurecas）
creators.bio_zh: 印度艺术家兼设计师，2017–2018 年间制作了 ARKit 雕刻、多人 AR 和 AR 无人机控制原型，在 Adobe MAX 上展示过 Sneak 项目，如今从事生成艺术创作。
creators.why_zh: 他早期的 ARKit 工具把手机当作雕刻和游戏的空间，并持续在交互设计与艺术之间穿梭。

creators.name: Hart Woolery (2020CV)
creators.role: Founder and CTO, 2020CV
creators.bio: Computer-vision developer whose company 2020CV trained its own mobile hand, face and pet tracking models to make InstaSaber, YoPuppet, SpeakingPuppy and Snap lenses.
creators.why: He built phone hand tracking years before platforms shipped it, and wrapped it in instantly fun ideas like a paper-tube lightsaber and hand puppets.
creators.role_zh: 2020CV 创始人兼首席技术官
creators.bio_zh: 计算机视觉开发者，他的公司 2020CV 自行训练了移动端手部、面部和宠物追踪模型，并据此推出了 InstaSaber、YoPuppet、SpeakingPuppy 以及多款 Snap 镜头。
creators.why_zh: 他比各大平台早好几年就实现了手机端手部追踪，并把它包装成即刻好玩的创意，比如纸筒光剑和手偶。

creators.name: Sallia Goldstein
creators.role: Technical artist and Snap Lens Creator
creators.bio: LA-based 3D technical artist whose career began with a viral Snapchat lens; she has built lenses for Coachella, UFC and LACMA and teaches in Snap's Lens Academy.
creators.why: Her body-tracked VFX lenses show how far simple template tweaks and restraint can go in social AR.
creators.role_zh: 技术美术、Snap 镜头创作者
creators.bio_zh: 常驻洛杉矶的 3D 技术美术，职业生涯始于一款走红的 Snapchat 镜头；她为 Coachella、UFC 和 LACMA 制作过镜头，并在 Snap 的 Lens Academy 授课。
creators.why_zh: 她的身体追踪视觉特效镜头展示了在社交 AR 中，简单的模板调整加上克制的设计可以走多远。

creators.name: Velvet Spectrum (Luke & Morgan Choice)
creators.role: 3D design and animation studio
creators.bio: Studio of Australian visual artist Luke Choice and Morgan Choice, known for colorful 3D typography, who extended their work into Snapchat lenses and Adobe Aero AR pieces.
creators.why: They show how an illustration/motion studio can translate its visual language into playful AR without heavy engineering.
creators.role_zh: 3D 设计与动画工作室
creators.bio_zh: 由澳大利亚视觉艺术家 Luke Choice 与 Morgan Choice 组成的工作室，以色彩缤纷的 3D 字体设计著称，并将创作延伸到 Snapchat 镜头和 Adobe Aero AR 作品。
creators.why_zh: 他们展示了一个插画/动态影像工作室如何在无需繁重工程的情况下，把自己的视觉语言转化为趣味 AR。
creators.based_zh: 阿斯托里亚（俄勒冈州），美国

creators.name: Phil Walton
creators.role: Official Snap Lens Creator and author
creators.bio: Lens creator behind the viral 'Potato Boss' lens and author of The Designer's Guide to Snapchat's Lens Studio.
creators.why: His Potato Boss lens proved that the simplest face-AR joke can travel worldwide.
creators.role_zh: Snap 官方镜头创作者、作者
creators.bio_zh: 走红镜头“Potato Boss”的创作者，著有《The Designer's Guide to Snapchat's Lens Studio》。
creators.why_zh: 他的 Potato Boss 镜头证明，最简单的面部 AR 笑话也能传遍全球。

creators.name: Christian Marclay
creators.role: Visual artist and composer
creators.bio: Swiss-American artist known for sound and collage works such as The Clock, who created an audio AR lens for the Centre Pompidou with Snap.
creators.why: He used AR not for visuals but to turn a whole museum into a playable musical instrument.
creators.role_zh: 视觉艺术家、作曲家
creators.bio_zh: 瑞士裔美国艺术家，以 The Clock 等声音与拼贴作品闻名，曾与 Snap 合作为蓬皮杜中心创作了一款音频 AR 镜头。
creators.why_zh: 他运用 AR 并非为了视觉，而是把整座博物馆变成了一件可以演奏的乐器。
creators.based_zh: 伦敦，英国 / 纽约，美国

creators.name: Jun Rekimoto
creators.role: HCI researcher; professor at the University of Tokyo and deputy director of Sony CSL
creators.bio: Interaction researcher who built NaviCam (1995), the first handheld ID-recognition AR system, and the 2D-barcode tracking later known as CyberCode, followed by landmark work on augmented tabletops, multi-touch and telepresence at Sony CSL and the Rekimoto Lab.
creators.why: He invented the handheld 'magic lens' form of AR and marker tracking years before ARToolKit, and kept producing inspiring spatial-interaction ideas for three decades.
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者；东京大学教授、Sony CSL 副所长
creators.bio_zh: 交互研究先驱：1995 年做出世界上第一个手持式、可识别物体 ID 的 AR 系统 NaviCam，以及后来被称为 CyberCode 的二维码追踪；之后在 Sony CSL 和暦本实验室持续产出增强桌面、多点触控和远程临场等里程碑式研究。
creators.why_zh: 他比 ARToolKit 更早发明了“手持魔法透镜”式 AR 和标记追踪，三十年来不断提出启发空间交互的新点子。

creators.name: Myron Krueger
creators.role: Computer artist and 'artificial reality' pioneer
creators.bio: Computer artist who from 1969 built responsive environments such as GLOWFLOW, METAPLAY and Psychic Space, culminating in VIDEOPLACE, where live video silhouettes of visitors interact with graphic creatures and each other.
creators.why: VIDEOPLACE invented full-body, camera-based interaction without gloves or goggles, the direct ancestor of Kinect games, shadow installations and body-tracked AR.
creators.role_zh: 计算机艺术家；“人工现实”先驱
creators.bio_zh: 自 1969 年起创作 GLOWFLOW、METAPLAY、Psychic Space 等“会回应的环境”，最终做出 VIDEOPLACE：观众的实时视频剪影可以和图形小生物、也可以和远处的另一个人互动。
creators.why_zh: VIDEOPLACE 最早实现了不戴手套、不戴眼镜、只靠摄像头的全身交互，是 Kinect 游戏、影子装置和人体追踪 AR 的直系祖先。

creators.name: Krzysztof Wodiczko
creators.role: Artist; public-projection pioneer; professor at Harvard GSD
creators.bio: Polish-born artist who since the early 1980s has projected images onto monuments and façades in more than eighty cities, later animating statues with the faces, hands and voices of veterans, migrants and workers.
creators.why: He turned architecture and monuments into speaking bodies long before projection mapping had a name, and pioneered live, wearable-camera input for public projections.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；公共投影先驱；哈佛大学设计研究生院教授
creators.bio_zh: 出生于波兰的艺术家，自 1980 年代初在八十多座城市把影像投到纪念碑和建筑立面上，后来更让雕像“借用”退伍军人、移民和工人的脸、手与声音开口说话。
creators.why_zh: 在“投影映射”这个词出现之前，他就把建筑和雕像变成会说话的身体，并率先把头戴摄像头的实时画面接入公共投影。

creators.name: The Macula
creators.role: Projection-mapping collective
creators.bio: Czech audiovisual collective (with members such as Michal Kotek, Lukáš Duběda, Dan Gregor and Amar Mulabegović) that made some of the most-watched architectural mappings of the 2010s, from Prague's Astronomical Clock to Liverpool's Liver Building.
creators.why: The 600 Years showed the world that a medieval monument could be taken apart, rebuilt and set alive with light, and became a reference piece for every mapping student.
creators.role_zh: 投影映射艺术团体
creators.bio_zh: 捷克视听艺术团体（成员包括 Michal Kotek、Lukáš Duběda、Dan Gregor、Amar Mulabegović 等），2010 年代创作了多件传播极广的建筑投影，从布拉格天文钟到利物浦皇家利物大厦。
creators.why_zh: 《The 600 Years》让全世界看到：一座中世纪建筑可以被光“拆开”、重建并赋予生命，至今仍是投影映射课程的必看范例。

creators.name: INITI (Dan Gregor)
creators.role: Interactive projection studio
creators.bio: Studio of visual artist Dan Gregor, a founding member of The Macula, making interactive projection works such as the laser-pointer instrument Archifon (with musician Floex), smartphone-controlled mappings and the INITI Playground projection games.
creators.why: INITI turns projection mapping from a show you watch into something the crowd plays with, using laser pointers, phones and bodies as controllers.
creators.role_zh: 互动投影工作室
creators.bio_zh: 视觉艺术家 Dan Gregor 的工作室，他也是 The Macula 的创始成员之一；作品包括与音乐人 Floex 合作、用激光笔演奏的建筑乐器 Archifon，由观众手机控制的投影装置，以及 INITI Playground 投影游戏平台。
creators.why_zh: INITI 把投影映射从“看的表演”变成“大家一起玩的东西”，激光笔、手机和身体都是控制器。

creators.name: 1024 Architecture (François Wunschel & Pier Schneider)
creators.role: Art and architecture studio for light, mapping and stage structures
creators.bio: Studio founded in 2007 by François Wunschel and Pier Schneider that builds scaffold structures, stages and façades animated by projection mapping, LEDs and lasers, and co-developed ideas behind the MadMapper software.
creators.why: From the voice-controlled façade of Perspective Lyrique to Kinect-mapped dancers and 1D arcade games, they show how mapping becomes interactive architecture.
creators.role_zh: 以光、投影映射和舞台结构为媒介的艺术与建筑工作室
creators.bio_zh: 由 François Wunschel 与 Pier Schneider 于 2007 年创立，用脚手架结构、舞台和建筑立面承载投影映射、LED 与激光，并参与了 MadMapper 软件背后的许多想法。
creators.why_zh: 从用声音控制建筑表情的《Perspective Lyrique》，到 Kinect 追踪舞者身体的投影、再到一维像素街机，他们展示了投影映射如何变成可互动的建筑。

creators.name: Marshmallow Laser Feast
creators.role: Immersive art studio (Robin McNicholas, Barney Steel, Ersin Han Ersin)
creators.bio: London studio founded in 2011 (with Memo Akten as an early co-founder) that moved from real-time projection mapping, lasers and drone shows to multi-sensory VR and mixed-reality installations about nature, breath and perception.
creators.why: Their pieces make invisible systems of nature perceptible, and often mix a headset with physical touch, smell or wind, which is a strong model for embodied spatial design.
creators.role_zh: 沉浸式艺术工作室（Robin McNicholas、Barney Steel、Ersin Han Ersin）
creators.bio_zh: 2011 年成立于伦敦（Memo Akten 是早期联合创始人之一），从实时投影映射、激光和无人机表演，一路走向关于自然、呼吸和感知的多感官 VR 与混合现实装置。
creators.why_zh: 他们的作品让自然界中看不见的系统变得可感知，并常常把头显与真实的触摸、气味或风结合起来，是具身空间设计的绝佳范例。

creators.name: Craig Winslow
creators.role: Light artist and projection designer
creators.bio: Designer and light artist known for Light Capsules, a series that uses projection mapping to temporarily restore faded 'ghost sign' advertisements painted on old buildings, made during an Adobe Creative Residency.
creators.why: Light Capsules is a perfect small-scale AR idea: point a projector at history and a wall briefly shows what it looked like decades ago.
creators.role_zh: 光艺术家、投影设计师
creators.bio_zh: 设计师与光艺术家，代表作是 Light Capsules 系列：在 Adobe 创意驻留期间，他用投影映射把老建筑外墙上褪色的手绘“幽灵广告”暂时恢复成当年的样子。
creators.why_zh: Light Capsules 是一个完美的小尺度 AR 点子：把投影仪对准历史，墙面就短暂地回到几十年前的模样。

creators.name: Stanley Donwood (with Radiohead)
creators.role: Artist; Radiohead's long-time visual collaborator
creators.bio: British artist who has made every Radiohead album cover since 1994 with Thom Yorke, and whose drawings became explorable worlds in the PolyFauna app and the KID A MNESIA EXHIBITION.
creators.why: His collaborations show how a band's visual universe can become a space you walk through, look around in and discover, rather than an image you look at.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；Radiohead 长期视觉合作者
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家，自 1994 年起与 Thom Yorke 一起设计了 Radiohead 的所有专辑封面，他的绘画后来在 PolyFauna 应用和《KID A MNESIA EXHIBITION》中变成可探索的世界。
creators.why_zh: 他的合作展示了乐队的视觉宇宙如何从一张被观看的图像，变成一个可以走进去、环顾四周、慢慢发现的空间。

creators.name: Anna Zhilyaeva (Anna Dream Brush)
creators.role: VR painter and live performer
creators.bio: Russian-born, Paris-based artist who paints three-dimensional 'volumist' works in Tilt Brush and Open Brush, often filmed in mixed reality or performed live, including a VR interpretation of Delacroix at the Louvre.
creators.why: Her mixed-reality videos show a painter's body and a room filling with brushstrokes that float in real space, a clear picture of what spatial drawing can feel like.
creators.role_zh: VR 画家、现场表演艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 出生于俄罗斯、定居巴黎的艺术家，用 Tilt Brush 和 Open Brush 创作三维“体积主义”绘画，常以混合现实方式拍摄或现场表演，曾在卢浮宫用 VR 重新演绎德拉克洛瓦的名作。
creators.why_zh: 她的混合现实视频把画家的身体和漂浮在真实空间里的笔触同时呈现出来，直观地展示了“在空间中绘画”是什么感觉。

creators.name: Christopher Manzione
creators.role: Sculptor; founder of the Virtual Public Art Project; Manifest.AR member
creators.bio: Sculptor who in 2010 founded the Virtual Public Art Project, one of the first platforms for site-specific AR sculpture on smartphones, and joined the Manifest.AR collective of AR artists.
creators.why: Placing a 30-foot virtual sculpture in Prospect Park in 2010 was an early proof that AR could be public art rather than information overlay.
creators.role_zh: 雕塑家；Virtual Public Art Project 创始人；Manifest.AR 成员
creators.bio_zh: 雕塑家，2010 年创立 Virtual Public Art Project，这是最早在智能手机上展示特定场地 AR 雕塑的平台之一；他也是 AR 艺术团体 Manifest.AR 的成员。
creators.why_zh: 2010 年在展望公园放置一座 9 米高的虚拟雕塑，早早证明了 AR 可以是公共艺术，而不只是信息叠加。

creators.name: Claire Hentschker
creators.role: Artist working with photogrammetry, VR and found footage
creators.bio: Carnegie Mellon-trained artist who extracts 3D space from film frames and found videos with photogrammetry, as in Shining360 and Dead Mall Chunks, and co-created an ARKit re-code of Jeffrey Shaw's Golden Calf with Golan Levin.
creators.why: She shows that any video already contains a hidden 3D space you can recover and walk through.
creators.role_zh: 以摄影测量、VR 和现成影像为材料的艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 毕业于卡内基梅隆大学的艺术家，用摄影测量从电影画面和网上找到的视频中提取三维空间，代表作有 Shining360、Dead Mall Chunks，还与 Golan Levin 合作用 ARKit 重新实现了 Jeffrey Shaw 的《Golden Calf》。
creators.why_zh: 她让人看到：任何一段视频里都藏着一个可以被恢复、可以走进去的三维空间。

creators.name: Nick Hardeman
creators.role: Creative technologist; interactive installation developer
creators.bio: Creative coder and openFrameworks contributor who has worked with Design I/O on Living Library, Studio Play and Elements, and makes body- and voice-driven interactive installations of his own.
creators.why: GLADES turns ecological damage into something you feel through your own silhouette, a clear model for body-tracked projection with a message.
creators.role_zh: 创意技术专家；互动装置开发者
creators.bio_zh: 创意编程者、openFrameworks 贡献者，曾与 Design I/O 合作 Living Library、Studio Play、Elements 等项目，也创作自己的身体与声音驱动的互动装置。
creators.why_zh: GLADES 让观众通过自己的剪影亲身感受生态破坏，是“带有观点的人体追踪投影”的清晰范例。

creators.name: Moritz Waldemeyer
creators.role: Designer and engineer of light, wearables and interactive installations
creators.bio: German-born London designer who engineered Hussein Chalayan's video and laser dresses, stage costumes for U2, OK Go and Rihanna, and interactive light sculptures for brands and galleries.
creators.why: He treats the body and architecture as carriers of light, from a dress that becomes a screen to a sculpture that reveals a hidden image from one viewpoint.
creators.role_zh: 光、可穿戴与互动装置设计师兼工程师
creators.bio_zh: 出生于德国、工作于伦敦的设计师，为 Hussein Chalayan 设计了视频裙和激光裙，也为 U2、OK Go、Rihanna 打造舞台服装，并为品牌和画廊创作互动光雕塑。
creators.why_zh: 他把身体和建筑都当作光的载体：从能变成屏幕的裙子，到只有在某个视角才显露隐藏图像的雕塑。

creators.name: Tin Drum (Todd Eckert)
creators.role: Mixed-reality production company
creators.bio: Studio founded by Todd Eckert that produces large-scale mixed-reality performances for headsets, including Marina Abramović's The Life, Ryuichi Sakamoto's KAGAMI and the mixed-reality play An Ark.
creators.why: Tin Drum proved that a whole audience wearing headsets in one room can share a live-feeling concert or play with a volumetric performer.
creators.role_zh: 混合现实制作公司
creators.bio_zh: 由 Todd Eckert 创办的工作室，专门为头显制作大型混合现实演出，包括 Marina Abramović 的《The Life》、坂本龙一的《KAGAMI》和混合现实戏剧《An Ark》。
creators.why_zh: Tin Drum 证明了：一整场戴着头显的观众可以在同一个房间里，与一位体积捕捉的表演者共享一场仿佛现场的音乐会或戏剧。

creators.name: Supermassive Games
creators.role: Game studio; developer of Wonderbook: Walking with Dinosaurs and Start the Party!
creators.bio: British studio best known for Until Dawn; for Sony it built camera-based PlayStation Move and Wonderbook titles that put players and paper books inside the game image.
creators.why: It turned the living-room camera feed into a stage where a paper book or a motion controller becomes a dinosaur dig site or a party prop.
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室；Wonderbook: Walking with Dinosaurs 与 Start the Party! 的开发商
creators.bio_zh: 以《直到黎明》闻名的英国工作室，曾为索尼开发多款基于摄像头的 PlayStation Move 和 Wonderbook 游戏，让玩家本人和纸质书直接出现在游戏画面里。
creators.why_zh: 它把客厅摄像头画面变成舞台：一本纸书可以变成恐龙挖掘现场，一根体感手柄可以变成派对道具。

creators.name: Moonbot Studios (William Joyce, Brandon Oldenburg)
creators.role: Storytelling studio; makers of Wonderbook: Diggs Nightcrawler and the IMAG-N-O-TRON AR book apps
creators.based_zh: 什里夫波特，美国路易斯安那州
creators.bio: Oscar-winning studio behind The Fantastic Flying Books of Mr. Morris Lessmore; it built interactive picture-book apps and a film-noir Wonderbook game that treat printed pages as windows into animated worlds.
creators.why: Moonbot showed how a picture book can stay a real book while its pages open into animated scenes through a camera.
creators.role_zh: 叙事工作室；Wonderbook: Diggs Nightcrawler 与 IMAG-N-O-TRON AR 绘本应用的创作者
creators.bio_zh: 凭《神奇飞书》获得奥斯卡的工作室，做过多款互动绘本应用和一部黑色电影风格的 Wonderbook 游戏，把印刷书页当作通往动画世界的窗口。
creators.why_zh: Moonbot 证明了绘本可以保持纸书的样子，同时透过摄像头在书页上展开动画场景。

creators.name: Wingnut AR (Peter Jackson, Alasdair Coull)
creators.role: AR studio founded by Peter Jackson and Fran Walsh
creators.bio: Wellington studio staffed largely by former Weta Digital artists; creative director Alasdair Coull premiered its Unreal Engine tabletop battle on stage when Apple launched ARKit at WWDC 2017.
creators.why: Its WWDC demo showed film-grade, cinematic tabletop AR on an ordinary iPad on the first day ARKit existed.
creators.role_zh: 由 Peter Jackson 与 Fran Walsh 创立的 AR 工作室
creators.bio_zh: 位于惠灵顿、成员多来自 Weta Digital 的工作室；创意总监 Alasdair Coull 在 2017 年 WWDC 苹果发布 ARKit 时，现场首演了用 Unreal Engine 制作的桌面战斗演示。
creators.why_zh: 它的 WWDC 演示在 ARKit 诞生当天，就在普通 iPad 上呈现了电影级的桌面 AR 画面。

creators.name: Halfbrick Studios
creators.role: Game studio; creator of Fruit Ninja
creators.bio: Australian studio whose swipe-to-slice Fruit Ninja moved from phone touchscreens to Kinect body tracking and then to hand-tracked play in the Apple Vision Pro living room.
creators.why: Halfbrick keeps re-mapping one simple verb, slicing, onto each new body interface, a clean case study in porting a mechanic across realities.
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室；《水果忍者》的开发商
creators.bio_zh: 澳大利亚工作室，其招牌作《水果忍者》从手机触屏的划切，一路走到 Kinect 全身追踪，再到 Apple Vision Pro 在客厅里的手势游玩。
creators.why_zh: Halfbrick 把“切”这一个简单动作不断移植到新的身体交互方式上，是跨现实移植玩法的清晰案例。

creators.name: Loóna (Sergey Gonchar, Andrew Yanchurevich, Dmitry Doryn, Eugene Nevgen)
creators.role: App studio from the MSQRD founders; makers of Loóna
creators.based_zh: 伦敦，英国 / 华沙，波兰
creators.bio: Founded by the team behind the MSQRD face-filter app, Loóna began as a calming bedtime app and was rebuilt for Apple Vision Pro as a spatial puzzle game with an AI creature.
creators.why: Loóna shows how calm, tactile assembly of small 3D dioramas can make mixed reality feel cozy.
creators.role_zh: 由 MSQRD 创始团队组建的应用工作室；Loóna 的开发者
creators.bio_zh: 由人脸滤镜应用 MSQRD 的创始团队创办，Loóna 最初是一款睡前放松应用，后来为 Apple Vision Pro 重新打造成带有 AI 小生物的空间拼图游戏。
creators.why_zh: Loóna 证明了在混合现实里慢慢拼装小型立体场景，也能带来安静、治愈的触感体验。

creators.name: Kluge Interactive (Synth Riders)
creators.role: Immersive game studio; developer of Synth Riders
creators.bio: Studio founded in 2008 that makes the VR rhythm game Synth Riders, which added a free passthrough mixed-reality mode for the Meta Quest 3 launch.
creators.why: Its mixed-reality update lets a dance-rhythm game spill notes and rails into the player's own room.
creators.role_zh: 沉浸式游戏工作室；Synth Riders 的开发商
creators.bio_zh: 成立于 2008 年的工作室，开发了 VR 节奏游戏 Synth Riders，并在 Meta Quest 3 发布时加入了免费的透视混合现实模式。
creators.why_zh: 它的混合现实更新让节奏舞蹈游戏的音符和轨道直接涌进玩家自己的房间。

creators.name: Onix-Systems
creators.role: Software studio; Unity AR/VR development team
creators.based_zh: 克罗皮夫尼茨基，乌克兰
creators.bio: Ukrainian software company founded in 2000 whose Unity team built early HoloKit X co-located duel demos plus object-recognition and indoor-navigation AR prototypes.
creators.why: Its HoloKit X duels are compact, teachable examples of two people fighting in the same room through shared ARKit sessions.
creators.role_zh: 软件公司；Unity AR/VR 开发团队
creators.bio_zh: 成立于 2000 年的乌克兰软件公司，其 Unity 团队为 HoloKit X 做了早期的同场对战演示，也做过物体识别和室内导航类 AR 原型。
creators.why_zh: 它的 HoloKit X 对战演示短小精悍，清楚展示了两个人如何通过共享 ARKit 会话在同一房间里对战。

creators.name: Kasimir Lehto (Reality Crisis)
creators.role: Co-founder and game director, Reality Crisis (Skatrix)
creators.bio: Former pro snowboarder turned filmmaker and game designer; in 2018 he co-founded Reality Crisis, which makes the AR skateboarding game Skatrix with skate legend Rodney Mullen and is co-published by Niantic.
creators.why: Skatrix turns any curb, bench or sofa into a skate spot for a finger-controlled virtual skater.
creators.role_zh: Reality Crisis 联合创始人兼游戏总监（Skatrix）
creators.bio_zh: 从职业单板滑雪运动员转型为电影人和游戏设计师；2018 年联合创办 Reality Crisis，与滑板传奇 Rodney Mullen 一起开发 AR 滑板游戏 Skatrix，并由 Niantic 联合发行。
creators.why_zh: Skatrix 让任何路沿、长椅或沙发都变成滑板场地，由手指操控的虚拟滑手在上面做动作。

creators.name: Zappar (Caspar Thykier & team)
creators.role: AR platform company; makers of ZapWorks and ZapBox
creators.bio: London company founded in 2011 that runs the ZapWorks/Mattercraft WebAR tools and made ZapBox, a cardboard mixed-reality headset that uses printed markers and a phone camera.
creators.why: ZapBox proved that room-scale mixed reality with tracked controllers could be built from a phone, cardboard and printed codes.
creators.role_zh: AR 平台公司；ZapWorks 与 ZapBox 的开发者
creators.bio_zh: 成立于 2011 年的伦敦公司，运营 ZapWorks/Mattercraft 网页 AR 工具，并推出 ZapBox——一款用手机摄像头识别打印标记的纸板混合现实头显。
creators.why_zh: ZapBox 证明了只用手机、纸板和打印出来的码，也能做出带追踪手柄的房间级混合现实。

creators.name: Metaio (Thomas Alt & Peter Meier)
creators.role: AR software company; makers of the Metaio SDK and junaio browser
creators.bio: Munich company founded in 2003 whose tracking SDK, Creator tools and junaio AR browser powered much pre-ARKit phone and kiosk AR; Apple acquired it in 2015.
creators.why: Metaio prototyped ideas years early, from the LEGO box kiosk to heat-trace touch on any surface.
creators.role_zh: AR 软件公司；Metaio SDK 与 junaio 浏览器的开发者
creators.bio_zh: 成立于 2003 年的慕尼黑公司，其追踪 SDK、Creator 工具和 junaio AR 浏览器支撑了 ARKit 之前的大量手机和展台 AR 应用；2015 年被苹果收购。
creators.why_zh: Metaio 常常提前多年做出原型，从乐高包装盒展台到用指尖余温把任何表面变成触摸屏。

creators.name: Ogmento (Ori Inbar, Oriel Bergig, Nate Hagbi)
creators.role: AR games developer and publisher (later Flyby Media)
creators.bio: Co-founded by Ori Inbar in 2009, Ogmento published location-based AR games and demoed hand-sketch and SLAM tech from its Israeli R&D team; it became Flyby Media, which Apple acquired in 2016.
creators.why: Ogmento let players draw a track or a machine on paper and play it instantly in AR, years before phone SLAM was common.
creators.role_zh: AR 游戏开发与发行商（后更名为 Flyby Media）
creators.bio_zh: 由 Ori Inbar 于 2009 年联合创办，Ogmento 发行基于地理位置的 AR 游戏，并展示了其以色列研发团队的手绘识别和 SLAM 技术；后更名为 Flyby Media，2016 年被苹果收购。
creators.why_zh: 早在手机 SLAM 普及之前，Ogmento 就让玩家在纸上画出赛道或机械装置，立刻在 AR 里玩起来。

creators.name: Ryan Hickman
creators.role: Robotics and AR product lead; co-founder of TickTock AI
creators.bio: Co-founded Google's Cloud Robotics group and worked on Project Tango before co-founding TickTock AI in 2017, where phone SLAM and AR became the brain and remote control of a home robot.
creators.why: TickTock treated the AR view as a map you can tap to send a real robot somewhere.
creators.role_zh: 机器人与 AR 产品负责人；TickTock AI 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 曾联合创立谷歌云机器人小组并参与 Project Tango，2017 年联合创办 TickTock AI，用手机的 SLAM 和 AR 作为家用机器人的大脑和遥控器。
creators.why_zh: TickTock 把 AR 画面当成一张可以点按的地图，点一下就把真实机器人派到那个位置。

creators.name: Jun Nishida
creators.role: Assistant Professor, University of Maryland; director of the Embodied Dynamics Lab
creators.bio: Designs wearables that let people borrow each other's bodies: EMS suits that share muscle activity, exoskeletons that shrink your hands, and head-mounted rigs that give you a child's eye height. Previously at the University of Tsukuba, Sony CSL and Pedro Lopes's lab in Chicago.
creators.why: He augments the body instead of the view, turning perspective, grip and muscle tone into shareable, remixable media.
creators.role_zh: 马里兰大学助理教授，Embodied Dynamics Lab 负责人
creators.bio_zh: 他做的可穿戴设备让人可以“借用”别人的身体：用肌电刺激共享肌肉动作的装置、把手“缩小”的外骨骼、把视线降到孩子高度的头戴设备。曾在筑波大学、Sony CSL 以及 Pedro Lopes 的芝加哥实验室工作。
creators.why_zh: 他增强的不是画面而是身体，把视角、握力和肌肉状态变成可以分享、可以混编的媒介。

creators.name: Jason Orlosky
creators.role: Associate Professor, Augusta University; director of the AR/VR lab; runs the JEOresearch channel
creators.bio: Did his PhD with Kiyoshi Kiyokawa at Osaka University on head-mounted text and vision augmentation (Fisheye Vision, ModulAR, Halo Content). Now builds eye-tracked AR tools, open-source eye trackers and accessibility demos.
creators.why: He treats AR glasses as a new pair of eyes: wider, zoomable, predictive and polite about where text should go.
creators.role_zh: 奥古斯塔大学副教授，AR/VR 实验室负责人，运营 JEOresearch 频道
creators.based_zh: 佐治亚州奥古斯塔，美国
creators.bio_zh: 在大阪大学师从清川清，博士研究头戴显示中的文字布局与视觉增强（Fisheye Vision、ModulAR、Halo Content）。现在开发基于眼动追踪的 AR 工具、开源眼动仪和无障碍演示。
creators.why_zh: 他把 AR 眼镜当成一双新眼睛：视野更宽、可以变焦、能预测运动，还懂得把文字放在不打扰人的位置。

creators.name: Kiyoshi Kiyokawa
creators.role: Professor, Nara Institute of Science and Technology (NAIST); head of the Cybernetics and Reality Engineering Laboratory (CARE Lab)
