creators.bio: Pioneer of occlusion-capable optical see-through displays (ELMO) and long-time ISMAR leader. His CARE Lab explores 'reality modulation': changing what you eat, see and feel with video see-through headsets.
creators.why: His lab treats the headset as a tool to rewrite everyday perception, from turning somen into ramen to muting visual noise.
creators.role_zh: 奈良先端科学技术大学院大学（NAIST）教授，Cybernetics and Reality Engineering Laboratory（CARE Lab）负责人
creators.bio_zh: 可遮挡光学透视显示器（ELMO）的先驱，长期参与 ISMAR 的组织工作。他的 CARE Lab 研究“现实调制”：用视频透视头显改变人吃到、看到和感受到的东西。
creators.why_zh: 他的实验室把头显当作改写日常感知的工具，从把素面“变成”拉面，到给视觉噪声降噪。

creators.name: Balasaravanan Thoravi Kumaravel
creators.role: Researcher, Microsoft Research (Redmond); HCI researcher on mixed-reality collaboration
creators.bio: Built Loki, TutoriVR, TransceiVR and DreamStream during his PhD at UC Berkeley with Björn Hartmann, all about bridging people inside and outside headsets. At Microsoft Research he works on generative and NeRF-based spaces for remote collaboration.
creators.why: He keeps asking how someone outside the headset can see, point and teach inside it, and builds a working bridge each time.
creators.role_zh: 微软研究院（雷德蒙德）研究员，研究混合现实协作的 HCI 学者
creators.based_zh: 华盛顿州雷德蒙德，美国
creators.bio_zh: 在加州大学伯克利分校随 Björn Hartmann 读博期间做了 Loki、TutoriVR、TransceiVR 和 DreamStream，都在解决头显内外的人如何沟通。在微软研究院，他研究用生成式 AI 和 NeRF 搭建远程协作空间。
creators.why_zh: 他一直在追问：头显外的人怎样看到、指向并教会头显里的人，而且每次都做出了能用的桥梁。

creators.name: Peter Mohr
creators.role: Researcher, Institute of Visual Computing, Graz University of Technology
creators.bio: Works with Denis Kalkofen and Dieter Schmalstieg on turning existing manuals and how-to videos into 3D AR instructions, and on using a phone as a tracked controller for headsets.
creators.why: He shows that the world's pile of paper manuals and YouTube tutorials can be recycled into spatial AR guidance.
creators.role_zh: 格拉茨工业大学视觉计算研究所研究员
creators.bio_zh: 与 Denis Kalkofen、Dieter Schmalstieg 合作，把现有的说明书和教学视频自动转成三维 AR 指引，还研究把手机变成头显的追踪控制器。
creators.why_zh: 他证明了成堆的纸质说明书和 YouTube 教程都可以被“回收”，变成空间化的 AR 指导。

creators.name: Stefanie Zollmann
creators.role: Professor of Computer Science, University of Otago; co-leads the Visual Computing Otago group
creators.bio: Began with X-ray visualization and drone flight planning in AR at TU Graz, then built AR for stadium spectators, historical rephotography and sports coaching in Otago.
creators.why: She takes AR outdoors at real scale: construction sites, drones in the sky and rugby matches seen from the stands.
creators.role_zh: 奥塔哥大学计算机科学教授，Visual Computing Otago 小组联合负责人
creators.bio_zh: 在格拉茨工业大学时研究 AR 中的透视（X-ray）可视化和无人机航线规划，之后在奥塔哥大学做体育场观赛 AR、历史照片重摄和运动训练。
creators.why_zh: 她把 AR 带到户外的真实尺度：工地、空中的无人机，还有看台上看到的橄榄球比赛。

creators.name: Tobias Langlotz
creators.role: Professor, University of Otago (Human-Computer Interaction / Computational Glasses)
creators.bio: Former TU Graz researcher who co-built early smartphone AR authoring and browsers, now works on 'computational glasses' that correct color vision, guide gaze by modulating saliency, and render virtual objects with a real camera's quirks.
creators.why: He pushes AR from adding stickers to editing human vision itself, pixel by pixel.
creators.role_zh: 奥塔哥大学教授（人机交互 / 计算眼镜方向）
creators.bio_zh: 曾在格拉茨工业大学参与早期手机 AR 创作工具和 AR 浏览器的研发，现在研究“计算眼镜”：矫正色觉、通过调节显著性引导视线，以及按真实相机的特性渲染虚拟物体。
creators.why_zh: 他让 AR 从“贴贴纸”走向逐像素地编辑人的视觉本身。

creators.name: Carmine Elvezio
creators.role: Researcher and developer, Columbia University Computer Graphics and User Interfaces Lab
creators.bio: Long-time engineer and researcher in Steven Feiner's lab, behind virtual-replica remote assistance, NASA stowage guidance, hybrid AR sheet music and urban-data tabletops for HoloLens-era AR.
creators.why: He turns AR task guidance into working systems that mix headsets, phones and tablets in one workflow.
creators.role_zh: 哥伦比亚大学计算机图形与用户界面实验室研究员兼开发者
creators.bio_zh: 长期在 Steven Feiner 实验室担任工程师和研究者，参与了虚拟复制品远程协助、NASA 空间站物资收纳指引、混合式 AR 乐谱以及城市数据沙盘等 HoloLens 时代的 AR 项目。
creators.why_zh: 他把 AR 任务指导做成真正能跑的系统，让头显、手机和平板在同一流程里协作。

creators.name: PRELOADED
creators.role: Games studio (London) making games with purpose, including AR and VR for museums and broadcasters
creators.bio: Independent studio known for educational and cultural games. With BBC Studios it made BBC Earth - Micro Kingdoms: Senses for Magic Leap, narrated by Stephen Fry.
creators.why: Micro Kingdoms lets you switch into an ant's or spider's senses inside your own living room, a model for sensory storytelling in AR.
creators.role_zh: 伦敦游戏工作室，专做有目的性的游戏，包括为博物馆和广播机构制作的 AR/VR 作品
creators.bio_zh: 以教育类和文化类游戏著称的独立工作室。与 BBC Studios 合作为 Magic Leap 制作了由 Stephen Fry 旁白的 BBC Earth - Micro Kingdoms: Senses。
creators.why_zh: Micro Kingdoms 让你在自家客厅里切换成蚂蚁或蜘蛛的感官，是 AR 感官叙事的范例。

creators.name: Sean Follmer
creators.role: Associate Professor of Mechanical Engineering, Stanford University; director of the SHAPE Lab
creators.bio: Co-created inFORM at the MIT Media Lab, then founded Stanford's SHAPE Lab, which builds mobile shape displays, tabletop swarm robots and, more recently, body-anchored audio augmentation.
creators.why: He makes the physical world itself programmable, so pixels can become pins, robots or sounds attached to people.
creators.role_zh: 斯坦福大学机械工程系副教授，SHAPE Lab 负责人
creators.based_zh: 斯坦福，加利福尼亚州，美国
creators.bio_zh: 在 MIT Media Lab 参与创作 inFORM，之后创立斯坦福 SHAPE Lab，研发可移动形状显示器、桌面群体机器人，近年还做附着在人身上的声音增强。
creators.why_zh: 他让物理世界本身变得可编程：像素可以变成针阵、机器人，或是跟着人移动的声音。

creators.name: Hirokazu Kato
creators.role: Professor, NAIST; head of the Interactive Media Design Laboratory; creator of ARToolKit
creators.bio: Wrote ARToolKit with Mark Billinghurst in 1999, the marker tracker that seeded a generation of AR. His NAIST lab later built AR pop-up books, wearable projection surfaces and, with Christian Sandor, the HoloLens game HoloRoyale.
creators.why: His free tracking library put AR into thousands of hands, and his lab kept testing what those markers could become.
creators.role_zh: NAIST 教授，Interactive Media Design Laboratory 负责人，ARToolKit 作者
creators.bio_zh: 1999 年与 Mark Billinghurst 一起写出 ARToolKit，这个标记追踪库带动了整整一代 AR 开发。他在 NAIST 的实验室后来做了 AR 立体书、可穿戴投影交互面，并与 Christian Sandor 合作开发了 HoloLens 游戏 HoloRoyale。
creators.why_zh: 他的免费追踪库把 AR 交到成千上万人手里，他的实验室也一直在探索这些标记还能变成什么。

creators.name: Christian Sandor
creators.role: Professor, Université Paris-Saclay; formerly led the Magic Vision Lab (UniSA), NAIST and the XR Lab at City University of Hong Kong
creators.bio: Trained at TU Munich, he built the Magic Vision Lab in Adelaide (BurnAR, AR X-ray, space-distorting AR), then co-directed AR research at NAIST and CityU Hong Kong. He calls the goal 'indistinguishable AR'.
creators.why: His demos make AR feel physical: hands that seem to burn, walls you can see through, and space that bends to show what is behind you.
creators.role_zh: 巴黎-萨克雷大学教授；曾领导南澳大学 Magic Vision Lab、NAIST 研究组及香港城市大学 XR Lab
creators.bio_zh: 在慕尼黑工业大学接受训练，之后在阿德莱德创建 Magic Vision Lab（BurnAR、AR 透视、空间扭曲 AR），又先后在 NAIST 和香港城市大学主持 AR 研究。他把目标称为“无法分辨的 AR”。
creators.why_zh: 他的演示让 AR 有了身体感：看起来着火的手、能看穿的墙，以及弯折过来让你看到身后的空间。

creators.name: Wayne Piekarski
creators.role: Creator of the Tinmith outdoor AR backpack and co-creator of ARQuake (Wearable Computer Lab, University of South Australia); later developer advocate at Google
creators.bio: With Bruce Thomas at the University of South Australia he built Tinmith (1998-2006), a backpack computer with a head-mounted display and pinch gloves, used for ARQuake and for modelling buildings outdoors in AR.
creators.why: Twenty years before Pokemon Go, he was walking campus lawns shooting AR monsters and sculpting buildings with gloves.
creators.role_zh: Tinmith 户外 AR 背包系统作者、ARQuake 联合作者（南澳大学可穿戴计算实验室），后任 Google 开发者布道师
creators.based_zh: 阿德莱德，澳大利亚 / 旧金山，美国
creators.bio_zh: 1998–2006 年间与 Bruce Thomas 在南澳大学打造了 Tinmith：一套带头戴显示器和捏合手套的背包电脑，被用于 ARQuake，以及在户外用 AR 直接为建筑建模。
creators.why_zh: 比 Pokémon Go 早二十年，他已经在校园草坪上射击 AR 怪物，并戴着手套“雕刻”建筑了。

creators.name: Marpi (Mateusz Marcinowski)
creators.role: Digital artist; founder of Marpi Studio
creators.bio: Polish-born digital artist who builds generative, multiplayer ecosystems of creatures, plants and landscapes that audiences grow and play with from screens, projections and their own phones.
creators.why: He treats every visitor's phone as a controller for a shared living artwork, and his 2017 ARKit tests (an IKEA-labelled apartment, an invisible de Young exhibition) showed how quickly those worlds can spill into physical space.
creators.role_zh: 数字艺术家，Marpi Studio 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 波兰出生的数字艺术家，擅长用生成算法搭建由生物、植物和地貌组成的多人生态系统，观众可以通过屏幕、投影或自己的手机让这些世界生长、变化。
creators.why_zh: 他把每位观众的手机都变成共享艺术品的遥控器；2017 年他用 ARKit 做的实验（给公寓家具贴上“宜家”标签、在 de Young 博物馆搭建看不见的展览）展示了这些虚拟世界如何溢出到真实空间。

creators.name: Paris AR Studio (Snap)
creators.role: Snap's in-house augmented reality studio for culture, museums and music
creators.bio: Opened by Snap in 2022, the studio co-creates Lenses and Spectacles experiences with institutions and artists such as the Louvre, Versailles, Centre Pompidou, JR, Daft Punk and the Royal Philharmonic Orchestra.
creators.why: It is the most prolific producer of museum- and heritage-scale social AR, turning landmarks, artworks and concerts into free Lenses that millions of people can open on their phones.
creators.role_zh: Snap 旗下专注文化、博物馆与音乐的 AR 工作室
creators.bio_zh: Snap 于 2022 年在巴黎成立的内部工作室，与卢浮宫、凡尔赛宫、蓬皮杜中心、JR、Daft Punk、英国皇家爱乐乐团等机构和艺术家合作开发 Lens 与 Spectacles 体验。
creators.why_zh: 它是博物馆和文化遗产级社交 AR 最高产的制作方，把地标、名作和演唱会做成免费 Lens，让数百万人用手机就能打开。

creators.name: Anne Horel
creators.role: Digital artist; official Snap Lens creator and TikTok AR ambassador
creators.bio: Paris-based artist who moved from viral GIFs and Vines into face filters in 2019, and since 2022 folds generative AI into pop, kitsch and surreal AR effects with over 130 million views.
creators.why: Her filters show how an artist's personal visual language, not technical tricks, can make face AR feel like wearable art.
creators.role_zh: 数字艺术家，Snap 官方 Lens 创作者、TikTok AR 大使
creators.bio_zh: 常驻巴黎的艺术家，从爆红的 GIF 和 Vine 短片起步，2019 年开始做脸部滤镜，2022 年起把生成式 AI 融入波普、媚俗又超现实的 AR 特效，累计浏览量超过 1.3 亿。
creators.why_zh: 她的滤镜证明，让脸部 AR 变成“可穿戴艺术”的关键是艺术家自己的视觉语言，而不是技术花招。

creators.name: Arthur Bouffard
creators.role: AR creative developer and technical artist; Snap Lens Ambassador
creators.bio: Award-winning Lens developer known for physics-heavy, VFX-polished Lenses and city-scale Landmarker experiments; he joined Snap's Paris AR Studio as a technical artist in 2026.
creators.why: His Lenses look like post-produced VFX shots yet run live on a phone, and he publishes the project files so others can learn the tricks.
creators.role_zh: AR 创意开发者、技术美术，Snap Lens 大使
creators.bio_zh: 获奖 Lens 开发者，以物理模拟丰富、特效精致的 Lens 和城市级 Landmarker 实验著称；2026 年加入 Snap 巴黎 AR 工作室担任技术美术。
creators.why_zh: 他的 Lens 看起来像后期合成的特效镜头，却能在手机上实时运行，而且他会公开工程文件，方便别人学习。
creators.based_zh: 阿姆斯特丹，荷兰 / 巴黎，法国

creators.name: Xulipa (Allan Yde)
creators.role: AR/XR game developer and Lens Studio educator
creators.bio: Danish developer who builds multiplayer AR games for Snap Spectacles and headsets, most notably the wizard-duelling game Wand Duel, and publishes Lens Studio tutorials on YouTube.
creators.why: He turns bleeding-edge glasses into social play and uses the same tools for accessibility, such as a Lens that works as a digital cane for blind users.
creators.role_zh: AR/XR 游戏开发者，Lens Studio 教程作者
creators.bio_zh: 丹麦开发者，为 Snap Spectacles 和头显开发多人 AR 游戏，代表作是巫师对决游戏 Wand Duel，同时在 YouTube 上发布 Lens Studio 教程。
creators.why_zh: 他把最前沿的眼镜变成多人游戏场，也用同样的工具做无障碍设计，比如一个充当盲人“数字手杖”的 Lens。

creators.name: Dom Scott
creators.role: Creative technologist and light artist
creators.bio: Maker of sound-reactive LED installations and Burning Man art-car electronics who co-developed the free, GPU-accelerated MediaPipe plugin for TouchDesigner with Torin Blankensmith.
creators.why: The MediaPipe plugin he co-built put face, hand and body tracking into thousands of TouchDesigner artists' hands with no install.
creators.role_zh: 创意技术专家、灯光艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 擅长制作随声音变化的 LED 装置和火人节艺术车电路，并与 Torin Blankensmith 共同开发了免费、GPU 加速的 TouchDesigner MediaPipe 插件。
creators.why_zh: 他参与开发的 MediaPipe 插件免安装即可使用，让成千上万的 TouchDesigner 艺术家都能用上脸部、手部和身体追踪。

creators.name: Florencia Raffa
creators.role: AR artist; Snap Lens Network creator and TikTok Effect House ambassador
creators.bio: Argentine illustrator turned AR artist who makes Lenses and effects for Snapchat, Instagram and TikTok, and now prototypes mixed-reality utility apps for Meta Quest 3.
creators.why: She moves between playful face filters and practical mixed-reality tools, placing 2nd in the XRCC hackathon's Meta utility track.
creators.role_zh: AR 艺术家，Snap Lens Network 创作者、TikTok Effect House 大使
creators.bio_zh: 从插画师转型的阿根廷 AR 艺术家，为 Snapchat、Instagram 和 TikTok 制作 Lens 与特效，近年开始为 Meta Quest 3 开发混合现实实用工具的原型。
creators.why_zh: 她在俏皮的脸部滤镜和实用的混合现实工具之间自如切换，曾在 XRCC 黑客松 Meta 实用工具赛道获得第二名。

creators.name: Yegor Ryabtsov
creators.role: AR developer and Lens creator for Snapchat and Spectacles
creators.bio: London-based developer behind the Spectacles painting app Artel and the physics puzzle game Trajectory: The Object Liberation Front, which won Best Innovative Lens at Lens Fest 2025.
creators.why: He pushes AR glasses toward full creative tools and narrative games, and openly explains his builds on YouTube.
creators.role_zh: Snapchat 与 Spectacles 的 AR 开发者、Lens 创作者
creators.bio_zh: 常驻伦敦的开发者，作品包括 Spectacles 空间绘画应用 Artel，以及获得 Lens Fest 2025“最佳创新 Lens”的物理解谜游戏 Trajectory: The Object Liberation Front。
creators.why_zh: 他把 AR 眼镜推向完整的创作工具和叙事游戏，并在 YouTube 上公开讲解自己的制作过程。

creators.name: Don Allen Stevenson III
creators.role: XR creator, educator and former DreamWorks specialist trainer
creators.bio: Former DreamWorks Animation trainer who became a full-time XR creator, making wearable AR fashion, full-body Lenses and mixed-reality sketches, and now teaching creative AI tools.
creators.why: He shows how fast a single artist can turn pop-culture moments into wearable AR, often building a filter within hours and livestreaming the whole process.
creators.role_zh: XR 创作者、教育者，前 DreamWorks 培训专家
creators.bio_zh: 曾在 DreamWorks 动画担任培训师，后成为全职 XR 创作者，制作可穿戴 AR 时装、全身 Lens 和混合现实草图，如今也教授创意 AI 工具。
creators.why_zh: 他示范了一个人能多快把流行文化事件变成可穿戴 AR：常常几个小时就做出一个滤镜，并把全过程直播出来。

creators.name: Andrew Mendez
creators.role: Researcher, engineer and early Lens Studio creator
creators.bio: Cornell Tech Connective Media graduate who was one of Snap's first featured Lens Studio creators in 2018, mixing computer vision research with playful Lenses such as MathArt and Smile Rater.
creators.why: He brought an ML researcher's mindset to early social AR, treating Lenses as quick experiments in intelligent, perception-aware interfaces.
creators.role_zh: 研究员、工程师，早期 Lens Studio 创作者
creators.bio_zh: 康奈尔科技校区 Connective Media 专业毕业，2018 年成为 Snap 首批重点推介的 Lens Studio 创作者之一，把计算机视觉研究和 MathArt、Smile Rater 等趣味 Lens 结合起来。
creators.why_zh: 他以机器学习研究者的思路做早期社交 AR，把 Lens 当成快速验证“能感知环境的智能界面”的实验。

creators.name: Anrick Bregman (Studio ANRK)
creators.role: AR/VR director; founder of Studio ANRK
creators.bio: Director and official Snap Lens creator whose Studio ANRK makes AR apps, Lenses, VR films and installations, from Bosch's painted creatures to restored Egyptian artefacts.
creators.why: He brings film-director storytelling to AR, using volumetric capture, photogrammetry and Lenses to put art history and real people into everyday space.
creators.role_zh: AR/VR 导演，Studio ANRK 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 导演、Snap 官方 Lens 创作者，他的 Studio ANRK 制作 AR 应用、Lens、VR 影片和装置，从博斯画中的怪物到修复后的古埃及文物都做过。
creators.why_zh: 他把电影导演的叙事能力带进 AR，用体积捕捉、摄影测量和 Lens 把艺术史和真实的人放进日常空间。

creators.name: Irene Alvarado
creators.role: Creative technologist (Google Creative Lab, later GitHub Next)
creators.bio: Designer-engineer who built playful ML and AR experiments at Google Creative Lab, including NormanAR, Move Mirror and Teachable Machine, before working on GitHub Copilot.
creators.why: Her experiments turn research tech (ARCore, PoseNet) into open-source toys that anyone can try and remix.
creators.role_zh: 创意技术专家（曾任职 Google Creative Lab、GitHub Next）
creators.bio_zh: 兼具设计与工程背景，在 Google Creative Lab 参与了 NormanAR、Move Mirror、Teachable Machine 等机器学习与 AR 实验，之后参与 GitHub Copilot 的研发。
creators.why_zh: 她的实验把 ARCore、PoseNet 这类研究技术变成人人能玩、能改的开源小作品。

creators.name: James Paterson (Presstube)
creators.role: Animator and artist; creator of the Norman VR animation tool
creators.bio: Canadian animator and Presstube founder who hand-draws frame-by-frame animation, and built Norman with Google Creative Lab so artists can animate directly in 3D space in VR.
creators.why: Norman and NormanAR connect the oldest animation craft, drawing each frame by hand, to room-scale VR and phone AR.
creators.role_zh: 动画师、艺术家，VR 动画工具 Norman 的作者
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大动画师、Presstube 创始人，擅长逐帧手绘动画，与 Google Creative Lab 合作开发了 Norman，让艺术家能在 VR 中直接于三维空间里画动画。
creators.why_zh: Norman 和 NormanAR 把最古老的动画手艺——一帧一帧手绘——接到了房间尺度的 VR 和手机 AR 上。

creators.name: Jelmer Verhoog
creators.role: Mixed-reality designer-developer; early ARKit prototyper
creators.bio: Dutch designer-developer who, weeks after ARKit's 2017 announcement, built Model3AR and the hit app AR Airplanes, and later led mixed-reality projects at Sopra Steria in Oslo.
creators.why: Model3AR was one of the first viral proofs that phone AR could show a real product at true scale in your driveway.
creators.role_zh: 混合现实设计师兼开发者，ARKit 早期原型作者
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰出生的设计师兼开发者，2017 年 ARKit 发布几周后就做出 Model3AR 和下载量达 40 万的 AR Airplanes，之后在奥斯陆的 Sopra Steria 负责混合现实项目。
creators.why_zh: Model3AR 是最早一批走红的案例之一，证明手机 AR 能把真实产品按原尺寸放到你家门口。

creators.name: Oscar Falmer
creators.role: AR developer; former Apple AR evangelist and Snap AR developer relations lead
creators.bio: French developer who made TweetReality, the first AR Twitter client, and a series of ARKit concept apps in 2017-2018, then spent years as an AR evangelist at Apple and Snap.
creators.why: His quick concepts (business cards, menus, a social feed in space) became templates for how everyday information could live in AR.
creators.role_zh: AR 开发者，前 Apple AR 布道师、Snap AR 开发者关系负责人
creators.bio_zh: 法国开发者，2017—2018 年做了第一个 AR 版 Twitter 客户端 TweetReality 和一系列 ARKit 概念应用，之后多年在 Apple 和 Snap 担任 AR 布道工作。
creators.why_zh: 他那些快速做出的概念（名片、菜单、悬浮在空间里的社交信息流）成了“日常信息如何进入 AR”的范本。

creators.name: Jonathan Forder
creators.role: AR/game developer (Discover Studios)
creators.bio: Game and AR developer who, at Discover Studios in 2017, built an ARKit prototype that drops a flat, cartoon-shaded character and set into a real room.
creators.why: His cartoon prototype showed that phone AR does not have to be photoreal: a hand-drawn look can sit convincingly on a real floor.
creators.role_zh: AR / 游戏开发者（Discover Studios）
creators.bio_zh: 游戏与 AR 开发者，2017 年在 Discover Studios 做了一个 ARKit 原型，把卡通渲染的角色和场景放进真实房间。
creators.why_zh: 他的卡通原型说明手机 AR 不一定要追求照片级真实，手绘风格同样能稳稳地“站”在真实地板上。

creators.name: Bjarne Lundgren
creators.role: iOS developer and early ARKit game prototyper
creators.bio: Developer who shared some of the first ARKit game prototypes in 2017, including tic-tac-toe on a table and a down-ball tennis game played across the living-room floor.
creators.why: His tennis demo showed that a phone could turn an ordinary living room into a sports court within weeks of ARKit's release.
creators.role_zh: iOS 开发者，ARKit 早期游戏原型作者
creators.bio_zh: 2017 年最早分享 ARKit 游戏原型的开发者之一，做过桌面井字棋，以及在客厅地板上来回击球的“地板网球”游戏。
creators.why_zh: 他的网球演示说明，ARKit 发布仅几周，手机就能把普通客厅变成球场。

creators.name: Russ Maschmeyer
creators.role: Designer and product lead; ex-lead of Shopify's Spatial Commerce lab, Primer co-founder
creators.bio: Interaction designer who turned a hacked Kinect into a musical instrument for his SVA thesis, led search design at Facebook, co-founded the AR home-design app Primer, and ran Shopify's Spatial Commerce lab (2021-2024) before leading GenAI design at Meta and moving to Stripe in 2026.
creators.why: His lab turned each new API or headset (RoomPlan, Quest Pro eye tracking, Vision Pro) into a public 'what if' prototype within weeks and explained how every one was built.
creators.role_zh: 设计师、产品负责人；Shopify Spatial Commerce 实验室前负责人，Primer 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计师。在 SVA 读研时把破解的 Kinect 做成音乐乐器，之后在 Facebook 主导搜索设计，联合创办 AR 家装应用 Primer，2021–2024 年带领 Shopify 的 Spatial Commerce 实验室，随后去 Meta 负责生成式 AI 设计，2026 年加入 Stripe。
creators.why_zh: 他的团队总能在新 API 或新头显（RoomPlan、Quest Pro 眼动、Vision Pro）发布后几周内，做出一个公开的“如果……会怎样”原型，并把做法完整讲清楚。

creators.name: Mikko Haapoja
creators.role: Developer; former AR/VR development manager at Shopify
creators.bio: Toronto developer who spent almost ten years at Shopify on 3D/AR/VR product media, the BFCM live globe and Sidekick, contributed to google/model-viewer, and joined Opendoor in 2026.
creators.why: His daily phone-scanning diary shows that capturing reality, including its glitches, is itself a creative AR skill.
creators.role_zh: 开发者；Shopify 前 AR/VR 开发经理
creators.bio_zh: 多伦多开发者，在 Shopify 工作近十年，参与 3D/AR/VR 商品媒体、BFCM 实时地球和 Sidekick 等项目，也为 google/model-viewer 贡献过代码，2026 年加入 Opendoor。
creators.why_zh: 他坚持每天用手机扫描一件东西，证明“捕捉现实”（连同它的故障）本身就是一种有创造力的 AR 能力。

creators.name: Shopify Spatial Commerce Team
creators.role: Shopify's AR/VR and spatial-commerce prototyping lab
creators.bio: A rapid-prototyping crew of engineers, designers and artists at Shopify (growing out of the earlier Shopify AR/VR team) that explored AR, VR and AI for shopping and published its prototypes and open-source tools such as Tracky and Handy.
creators.why: Each prototype is framed as one public question, such as 'What if your room had a reset button?', which makes their work a ready-made set of classroom briefs.
creators.role_zh: Shopify 的 AR/VR 与空间商务原型实验室
creators.based_zh: 加拿大与美国（分布式团队）
creators.bio_zh: Shopify 内部由工程师、设计师和艺术家组成的快速原型小组（前身是 Shopify AR/VR 团队），探索 AR、VR 与 AI 如何改变购物，并公开发布原型和 Tracky、Handy 等开源工具。
creators.why_zh: 他们把每个原型都写成一个公开的问题，比如“如果你的房间有一个重置键会怎样？”，本身就是现成的课堂命题。

creators.name: Max van Leeuwen
creators.role: AR artist and creative technologist; Snap Lens Studio ambassador; co-founder of Max & Liisi
creators.bio: Dutch digital artist trained in visual effects at the Netherlands Film Academy who moved into real-time augmented reality, first at the Amsterdam AR studio GoSpooky and then with Liisi Mononen as Max & Liisi. He builds playful Lens Studio and Spectacles experiments, open-source tools and commercial lenses (Olivia Rodrigo, Snapchat), and led AR discovery workshops and an XR Sunday Social talk at A+E Lab in Chatham.
creators.why: He turns everyday things around him (a rug, a painting, his living room, the sun) into playful AR prototypes and openly shares how each one is built.
creators.role_zh: AR 艺术家、创意技术专家；Snap Lens Studio 大使；Max & Liisi 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰数字艺术家，在荷兰电影学院学习视觉特效，后来转向实时增强现实：先在阿姆斯特丹 AR 工作室 GoSpooky 工作，之后与 Liisi Mononen 组成 Max & Liisi。他用 Lens Studio 和 Spectacles 做各种好玩的实验、开源工具和商业滤镜（Olivia Rodrigo、Snapchat），也曾在查塔姆的 A+E Lab 带领 AR 入门工作坊并在 XR Sunday Social 上演讲。
creators.why_zh: 他把身边的日常物件（一块地毯、一幅画、自家客厅、甚至太阳）变成好玩的 AR 原型，并且公开分享每个作品是怎么做出来的。

creators.name: Instituto Stocos (Muriel Romero, Pablo Palacio & Daniel Bisig)
creators.role: Interactive dance research group: choreographer, composer and AI/software artist
creators.bio: Spanish-Swiss collective of choreographer Muriel Romero, composer Pablo Palacio and AI researcher Daniel Bisig that builds pieces where sensors read the dancer's body and drive swarm simulations, synthesised voice, robotic lights or a self-playing piano. Bisig, now at Zurich University of the Arts and Motion Bank, co-facilitated the Choreographic Coding Labs at A+E Lab in 2022, 2025 and at the Royal Ballet and Opera in 2026.
creators.why: They make the dancer the only performer on stage who plays everything else: light beams, piano keys and simulated swarms all answer to her gestures.
creators.role_zh: 互动舞蹈研究团体：编舞、作曲与 AI/软件艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 由编舞家 Muriel Romero、作曲家 Pablo Palacio 和 AI 研究者 Daniel Bisig 组成的西班牙-瑞士团体。他们用传感器读取舞者身体，驱动群体模拟、合成人声、机器人灯光或无人弹奏的钢琴。Bisig 现任职于苏黎世艺术大学和 Motion Bank，曾在 2022、2025 年的 A+E Lab 以及 2026 年皇家芭蕾与歌剧院的 Choreographic Coding Lab 担任带领人。
creators.why_zh: 舞台上只有舞者一个表演者，却由她“演奏”一切：光束、琴键和虚拟群体都回应她的动作。
creators.based_zh: 马德里，西班牙 / 苏黎世，瑞士

creators.name: Tim Murray-Browne
creators.role: Artist and creative technologist making interactive body-sound installations
creators.bio: British artist who builds open-ended interactive installations and dance pieces where movement tracked by cameras and sensors shapes sound, light and AI imagery, from the touring Cave of Sounds to the AI self-portrait Self Absorbed. He took part in the 2022 Choreographic Coding Lab at A+E Lab and wrote about it as 'embodied thinking'.
creators.why: He designs interactions you understand with your body rather than your mind, inviting people to explore without instructions.
creators.role_zh: 创作身体-声音互动装置的艺术家、创意技术人
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家，擅长开放式互动装置和舞蹈作品：摄像头和传感器追踪人的动作，进而塑造声音、灯光和 AI 图像，代表作从巡展多年的 Cave of Sounds 到 AI 自画像 Self Absorbed。他参加了 2022 年 A+E Lab 的 Choreographic Coding Lab，并把那次经历写成关于“具身思考”的文章。
creators.why_zh: 他设计的互动靠身体而非头脑去理解，邀请人们在没有说明的情况下自由探索。

creators.name: Clémence Debaig (Unwired Dance Theatre)
creators.role: Dance artist, maker and creative technologist; founder of Unwired Dance Theatre
creators.bio: French-born, London-based dancer who worked in software before returning to dance; she builds her own wearables, haptics and motion-capture systems to let audiences influence live dancers, locally or across the internet. Her company Unwired Dance Theatre stages telematic and WebXR performances, and she was a participant at the 2022 Choreographic Coding Lab at A+E Lab.
creators.why: She hands the audience real control over a dancer's body and costume, turning interaction design into an ethical question about care and harassment.
creators.role_zh: 舞蹈艺术家、创客与创意技术人；Unwired Dance Theatre 创办人
creators.bio_zh: 生于法国、定居伦敦的舞者，曾在软件行业工作后重返舞蹈。她自己制作可穿戴设备、触觉装置和动作捕捉系统，让观众在现场或通过网络影响舞者。她的舞团 Unwired Dance Theatre 做远程与 WebXR 演出；她也是 2022 年 A+E Lab Choreographic Coding Lab 的参与者。
creators.why_zh: 她把控制舞者身体和服装的权力真正交给观众，让交互设计变成一个关于关怀与骚扰的伦理问题。

creators.name: Freya Björg Olafson
creators.role: Intermedia artist working with performance, video, motion capture and XR
creators.bio: Icelandic-Canadian intermedia artist whose solo performances stage the body against screens, avatars and internet footage: AVATAR (2009) on online self-display, HYPER_ (2013) with UV light and 3D projection, and MÆ – Motion Aftereffect (2019) on how XR changes the body. She joined the 2nd Choreographic Coding Lab at A+E Lab in 2025.
creators.why: For fifteen years she has performed what screens, avatars and headsets do to the human body, often before these technologies became mainstream.
creators.role_zh: 以表演、影像、动作捕捉和 XR 创作的跨媒介艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 冰岛裔加拿大跨媒介艺术家，她的独舞让身体与屏幕、化身和网络影像对峙：AVATAR（2009）探讨网上的自我展示，HYPER_（2013）用紫外光和 3D 投影，MÆ – Motion Aftereffect（2019）讨论 XR 如何改变身体。2025 年她参加了 A+E Lab 第二届 Choreographic Coding Lab。
creators.why_zh: 十五年来她一直在舞台上演绎屏幕、化身和头显对人体的影响，而且往往早于这些技术普及。

creators.name: Zhou Zhou
creators.role: Media artist and PhD researcher in human-machine improvisation
creators.bio: Chinese media artist and PhD researcher between the UAL Creative Computing Institute and London Contemporary Dance School. His dance works use motion capture, live neuroimaging and AI pipelines to let performers and audiences reshape the digital space around them; at the 2026 CCL at the Royal Ballet and Opera he built We Say, We See, a voice-to-image installation.
creators.why: He wires the dancer's body and even brain activity directly into the stage world, so the environment improvises with the performer.
creators.role_zh: 研究人机即兴的媒体艺术家、博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 中国媒体艺术家，在伦敦艺术大学创意计算学院与伦敦当代舞蹈学院攻读博士。他的舞蹈作品用动作捕捉、实时脑成像和 AI 流程，让表演者和观众重塑周围的数字空间；在 2026 年皇家芭蕾与歌剧院的 CCL 上，他做了语音生成图像的装置 We Say, We See。
creators.why_zh: 他把舞者的身体甚至脑电活动直接接入舞台世界，让环境与表演者一起即兴。

creators.name: Harshini J. Karunaratne
creators.role: Interdisciplinary artist and creative technologist
creators.bio: Artist trained in interactive media at NYU Abu Dhabi who works with projection mapping, gesture sensors, dance and live visuals for stage, media facades and installations. At the 2026 CCL at the Royal Ballet and Opera she built a transmedial Hades from fragments of the RBO archive.
creators.why: Her early prototypes show how cheap found materials, a projector and a hand sensor can already make a responsive sculpture.
creators.role_zh: 跨领域艺术家、创意技术人
creators.bio_zh: 在纽约大学阿布扎比分校学习交互媒体的艺术家，为舞台、媒体立面和装置创作投影映射、手势传感、舞蹈与实时影像作品。在 2026 年皇家芭蕾与歌剧院的 CCL 上，她用 RBO 档案碎片搭建了一个跨媒介的冥府。
creators.why_zh: 她早期的原型说明：几件废旧材料、一台投影仪加一个手势传感器，就能做出会回应人的雕塑。
creators.based_zh: 阿布扎比，阿联酋 / 伦敦，英国

creators.name: Chelly Jin
creators.role: New media and performance artist working with movement, code and biosensors
creators.bio: Korean-American artist (MFA Media Arts, UCLA) who combines expressive programming, biosensors, projection and contact improvisation in performances and installations about belonging and healing. Her piece do.we.touch was made at the 2022 Choreographic Coding Lab at A+E Lab.
creators.why: She turns invisible body signals such as heartbeat and brainwaves into light that everyone in the room can see.
creators.role_zh: 以动作、代码和生物传感器创作的新媒体与表演艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 韩裔美国艺术家（UCLA 媒体艺术 MFA），在表演和装置中结合诗意编程、生物传感器、投影与接触即兴，探讨归属与疗愈。作品 do.we.touch 诞生于 2022 年 A+E Lab 的 Choreographic Coding Lab。
creators.why_zh: 她把心跳、脑电这些看不见的身体信号变成全场都能看见的光。

creators.name: Chelsi Alise Cocking
creators.role: New media artist, product designer and researcher
creators.bio: American new media artist and MIT Media Lab alumna whose installations use computer vision to make movement and faces visible in new ways; she has also designed products at Dropbox and Adobe. She took part in the 2022 Choreographic Coding Lab at A+E Lab with dancers Raianna Brown and Lenataa Goka.
creators.why: Her work asks a simple question, what if we could see our own movement, and answers it with real-time light trails in open space.
creators.role_zh: 新媒体艺术家、产品设计师、研究者
creators.bio_zh: 美国新媒体艺术家，MIT 媒体实验室校友，用计算机视觉让动作和面孔以新的方式显现；她也曾在 Dropbox 和 Adobe 做产品设计。2022 年她与舞者 Raianna Brown、Lenataa Goka 一起参加了 A+E Lab 的 Choreographic Coding Lab。
creators.why_zh: 她的作品问了一个简单的问题——如果能看见自己的动作会怎样？——并用空中实时出现的光迹来回答。
creators.based_zh: 波士顿，美国 / 纽约，美国

creators.name: Irini Kalaitzidi
creators.role: Choreographer, dancer and creative coder
creators.bio: Greek choreographer and developer who builds her own motion-capture and Kinect tools to create sound instruments inside the moving body and dances between humans and stick-figure agents. She took part in the 2022 Choreographic Coding Lab at A+E Lab with filmmaker Stathis Doganis.
creators.why: She treats the whole moving body as a musical instrument and the stick figure as a dance partner.
creators.role_zh: 编舞、舞者、创意编程者
creators.bio_zh: 希腊编舞家兼开发者，自己搭建动作捕捉和 Kinect 工具，把身体变成会发声的乐器，也让人与火柴人形象一起跳舞。2022 年她与影像创作者 Stathis Doganis 一起参加了 A+E Lab 的 Choreographic Coding Lab。
creators.why_zh: 她把整个运动中的身体当成乐器，把火柴人当成舞伴。

creators.name: Julie C. Stamm
creators.role: Dance and media artist working with sensing, feedback and neuroaesthetics
creators.bio: Germany-based dance and media artist with a background in contemporary dance and neuroaesthetics research (Goldsmiths) who designs live-camera performances, pressure sensors and participatory games that translate movement into data and back into experience. At the 2026 CCL at the Royal Ballet and Opera she made Horrorscope, a walking game based on sea-level-rise maps.
creators.why: She keeps the technology visible on stage, so the audience watches people and machines negotiate meaning in real time.
creators.role_zh: 研究感知、反馈与神经美学的舞蹈与媒体艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 定居德国的舞蹈与媒体艺术家，有当代舞和神经美学研究（伦敦大学金史密斯学院）背景，设计实时摄像表演、压力传感器和参与式游戏，把动作转成数据，再转回体验。在 2026 年皇家芭蕾与歌剧院的 CCL 上，她做了基于海平面上升地图的行走游戏 Horrorscope。
creators.why_zh: 她让技术在舞台上保持可见，观众看着人和机器实时地协商意义。

creators.name: Naoto Hieda
creators.role: Live-coding artist and creative technologist
creators.bio: Japanese artist known for glitchy live-coded visuals in Hydra and long-running improvised sessions with dancer Jorge Guevara, where the webcam image of the dancer is fed through code in real time. He was a participant at the 2nd Choreographic Coding Lab at A+E Lab in 2025, where he also filmed interviews with fellow participants.
creators.why: He makes the code and the camera part of the choreography, so glitches become a duet partner.
creators.role_zh: 现场编程艺术家、创意技术人
creators.bio_zh: 日本艺术家，以 Hydra 现场编程的故障风格影像闻名，并与舞者 Jorge Guevara 长期即兴合作：舞者的摄像头画面被实时送进代码处理。2025 年他参加了 A+E Lab 第二届 Choreographic Coding Lab，还在现场采访了其他参与者。
creators.why_zh: 他把代码和摄像头也变成编舞的一部分，故障成了舞伴。

creators.name: Samuele Albani
creators.role: Artist and researcher in interactive sound and social choreography
creators.bio: Italian artist and computational-arts researcher (Goldsmiths) who designs collaborative instruments played by the distance, touch and poses of two or more people, using wearables and camera-based pose detection. At the 2026 CCL at the Royal Ballet and Opera he replaced one of the two players of his instrument distanze with an AI agent.
creators.why: His instruments need two bodies: the music lives in the space and intimacy between people.
creators.role_zh: 研究互动声音与社交编舞的艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 意大利艺术家、计算艺术研究者（伦敦大学金史密斯学院），设计由两人或多人的距离、触碰和姿态演奏的协作乐器，使用可穿戴传感器和基于摄像头的姿态识别。在 2026 年皇家芭蕾与歌剧院的 CCL 上，他把乐器 distanze 两位演奏者中的一位换成了 AI 代理。
creators.why_zh: 他的乐器需要两个身体：音乐存在于人与人之间的距离和亲密感里。

creators.name: Fabio Lattanzi Antinori
creators.role: Artist working with data sculpture, public art and AI
creators.bio: Italian-born, London-based artist who turns live data streams such as the price of search keywords into public sculptures, LED signs, karaoke machines and generative choirs. At the 2026 CCL at the Royal Ballet and Opera he trained a language model on AI platforms' Terms and Conditions and had synthetic voices sing them.
creators.why: He makes invisible data economies audible and visible in physical, often public space.
creators.role_zh: 从事数据雕塑、公共艺术与 AI 创作的艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 生于意大利、定居伦敦的艺术家，把实时数据流（例如搜索关键词的广告价格）做成公共雕塑、LED 标牌、卡拉 OK 机和生成式合唱。在 2026 年皇家芭蕾与歌剧院的 CCL 上，他用 AI 平台的用户条款训练语言模型，再让合成人声把条款唱出来。
creators.why_zh: 他让看不见的数据经济在实体空间、往往是公共空间里被看见、被听见。

creators.name: Alexander Whitley Dance Company
creators.role: Choreographer and dance-technology company
creators.bio: British choreographer whose company builds stage works and installations around motion tracking, responsive light and live motion capture, working with Marshmallow Laser Feast, Memo Akten, Children of the Light and creative technologist Luca Biada. He is a Sadler's Wells New Wave Associate and spoke with AΦE at the Physical-Digital Digital Innovation Network event.
creators.why: For more than a decade he has treated sensing technology as a dance partner, so the stage lighting and projections watch, learn from and answer the dancers.
creators.role_zh: 编舞家；舞蹈科技团体
creators.bio_zh: 英国编舞家，他的舞团围绕动作追踪、响应式灯光和实时动作捕捉创作舞台作品与装置，合作者包括 Marshmallow Laser Feast、Memo Akten、Children of the Light 和创意技术专家 Luca Biada。他是 Sadler's Wells 的 New Wave 合作艺术家，曾与 AΦE 一同参加 Digital Innovation Network 的 Physical-Digital 活动。
creators.why_zh: 十多年来他把感知技术当作舞伴：舞台上的灯光和投影会“看”舞者、向舞者学习，并对舞者作出回应。

creators.name: Zelia ZZ Tan
creators.role: Choreographer, dancer and hybrid-performance artist; co-founder of TechDanceLab
creators.bio: Hong Kong choreographer and former City Contemporary Dance Company dancer who makes hybrid performances in which dancers share the stage with motion-captured avatars, projections and AR. She co-founded TechDanceLab, studied Interactive Media for Performance at CalArts and led the 'Choreographing the In-Between' hybrid dance workshop and a collaborative lab at A+E Lab in 2025.
creators.why: She choreographs the relationship between a dancer and their own avatars, turning motion-capture glitches and delays into material for the dance.
creators.role_zh: 编舞家、舞者、混合表演艺术家；TechDanceLab 联合创办人
creators.bio_zh: 香港编舞家，曾是城市当代舞蹈团舞者。她创作的混合表演让舞者与动作捕捉化身、投影和 AR 同台。她联合创办了 TechDanceLab，在 CalArts 攻读表演互动媒体，2025 年在 A+E Lab 带领了“Choreographing the In-Between”混合舞蹈工作坊和一次协作实验室。
creators.why_zh: 她编排的是舞者与自己化身之间的关系，把动作捕捉的故障和延迟也变成舞蹈的材料。

creators.name: Pell Ensemble (Rebecca Evans)
creators.role: Digital dance company led by choreographer Rebecca Evans
creators.bio: Cross-disciplinary dance company directed by choreographer Rebecca Evans that makes digital dance works for stage, streets and classrooms, from an interactive audience-data game to a walking AR trail and dance-and-code workshops with UCL and Studio Wayne McGregor. Evans spoke alongside AΦE at the Digital Bodies + Virtual Spaces symposium and the Digital Innovation Network.
creators.why: She uses dance as a way into computing, so audiences and school students program, vote and walk their way into the choreography.
creators.role_zh: 由编舞家 Rebecca Evans 领导的数字舞蹈团体
creators.bio_zh: 由编舞家 Rebecca Evans 主理的跨学科舞团，为剧场、街道和课堂创作数字舞蹈：从用观众数据驱动的互动游戏，到步行 AR 路线，再到与 UCL、Studio Wayne McGregor 合作的舞蹈编程工作坊。Evans 曾与 AΦE 一同在 Digital Bodies + Virtual Spaces 研讨会和 Digital Innovation Network 上发言。
creators.why_zh: 她把舞蹈当作进入编程的入口，让观众和中学生通过编程、投票和行走进入编舞。

creators.name: Katie Dale-Everett Dance (KDE Dance)
creators.role: Dance company working with motion capture, VR and participatory technology
creators.bio: Company led by choreographer Katie Dale-Everett that combines dance, verbatim theatre and emerging technologies such as motion capture, VR and live camera feeds, often for wellbeing and young audiences. It presented Playscape: How to Build a Galaxy at the Digital Bodies + Virtual Spaces symposium with AΦE.
creators.why: Her pieces use technology to swap presence between people, letting audiences borrow another body's view or co-create a galaxy with avatar dancers.
creators.role_zh: 运用动作捕捉、VR 与参与式技术的舞蹈团体
creators.bio_zh: 由编舞家 Katie Dale-Everett 领导的舞团，把舞蹈、纪实剧场和动作捕捉、VR、实时摄像画面等新技术结合，常面向身心健康议题和青少年观众。舞团曾与 AΦE 一同在 Digital Bodies + Virtual Spaces 研讨会上展示 Playscape: How to Build a Galaxy。
creators.why_zh: 她的作品用技术在人与人之间交换“在场”：观众可以借用另一个身体的视角，或与化身舞者一起建造一个星系。

creators.name: Birmingham Royal Ballet (Virtual Stage)
creators.role: Ballet company with an immersive-technology programme
creators.bio: One of the UK's leading ballet companies, which under Carlos Acosta launched the Virtual Stage programme to explore AR, VR, motion capture and real-time graphics with partners such as Holosphere, including city-wide AR ballet trails. Its creative digital producer Tom Rogers joined AΦE on the Physical-Digital panel at Sadler's Wells.
creators.why: A classical company that lets ballet characters step out of the theatre onto phones and lets dancers drive 35-metre real-time backdrops with their bodies.
creators.role_zh: 设有沉浸式技术项目的芭蕾舞团
creators.bio_zh: 英国一流芭蕾舞团之一。在 Carlos Acosta 领导下启动了 Virtual Stage 项目，与 Holosphere 等伙伴一起探索 AR、VR、动作捕捉和实时图形，其中包括遍布城市的 AR 芭蕾路线。舞团的创意数字制作人 Tom Rogers 曾与 AΦE 同场参加 Sadler's Wells 的 Physical-Digital 论坛。
creators.why_zh: 一家古典舞团，却让芭蕾角色走出剧院、跳进手机，也让舞者用身体驱动 35 米长的实时背景。

creators.name: Collusion
creators.role: Art and technology commissioning organisation (ART // TECH // PLAY)
creators.bio: Cambridge-based producer that commissions interactive and projection-based public artworks, often co-created with young people in King's Lynn and the East of England, and runs the ART // TECH // PLAY artist network where AΦE spoke about their VR and AR work.
creators.why: It turns whole town centres into playable spaces with projection games, AR trails and body-tracking stories made with local young people.
creators.role_zh: 艺术与科技委约机构（ART // TECH // PLAY）
creators.bio_zh: 总部在剑桥的制作机构，委约互动和投影类公共艺术，常与金斯林及英格兰东部的年轻人共创；它运营的 ART // TECH // PLAY 艺术家网络曾邀请 AΦE 分享 VR 与 AR 创作。
creators.why_zh: 它把整个城镇中心变成可以玩的空间：投影游戏、AR 路线，以及与当地年轻人一起做的身体追踪故事。

creators.name: Violeta Ayala
creators.role: Quechua filmmaker and XR / AI artist
creators.bio: Bolivian Quechua documentary filmmaker (Cocaine Prison, The Fight) who moved into VR, AR and AI with Prison X and Huk, the Jaguaress, building Indigenous-futurist characters that respond to viewers. She spoke about Las Awichas at the University of Nottingham VIP Studio event alongside AΦE.
creators.why: She replaces the fixed film with Andean characters that listen, watch and answer the viewer in the room.
creators.role_zh: 盖丘亚族电影人、XR 与 AI 艺术家
creators.based_zh: 玻利维亚 / 澳大利亚
creators.bio_zh: 玻利维亚盖丘亚族纪录片导演（Cocaine Prison、The Fight），之后转向 VR、AR 与 AI，创作了 Prison X 和 Huk, the Jaguaress 等作品，打造会回应观众的原住民未来主义角色。她曾与 AΦE 一同在诺丁汉大学 VIP Studio 活动上介绍 Las Awichas。
creators.why_zh: 她用会倾听、会观察、会回应现场观众的安第斯角色，取代放完就结束的电影。

creators.name: Keiken (Hana Omori, Isabel Ramos, Tanya Cruz)
creators.role: Collaborative art practice working with AR filters, game worlds and performance
creators.bio: Cross-dimensional collective that builds online worlds, Instagram AR face filters, game-engine environments and performances about future bodies and empathy, including the ongoing Morphogenic Angels world shown at Serpentine and at Hellerau's Blackbox Whitecube XR symposium.
creators.why: They make wearable AR filters and playable worlds that ask how technology could make us feel for other beings.
creators.role_zh: 以 AR 滤镜、游戏世界和表演为媒介的协作艺术团体
creators.based_zh: 伦敦，英国 / 柏林，德国
creators.bio_zh: 一个“跨维度”艺术团体，搭建网络世界、Instagram AR 人脸滤镜、游戏引擎场景和表演，思考未来的身体与共情。她们持续创作的 Morphogenic Angels 世界曾在 Serpentine 和 Hellerau 的 Blackbox Whitecube XR 研讨会上展出。
creators.why_zh: 她们用可以“戴上”的 AR 滤镜和可玩的世界追问：技术能否让我们体会其他生命的感受？

creators.name: NONOTAK (Noemi Schipfer & Takami Nakamoto)
creators.role: Audiovisual light and projection duo
creators.bio: Studio of illustrator Noemi Schipfer and architect-musician Takami Nakamoto that builds immersive light and sound architectures from projection on layered translucent screens, kinetic light and live performance. Their performance SHIRO opened the Blackbox Whitecube XR symposium at Hellerau where AΦE showed 0AR.
creators.why: With only projected lines on scrims they fold space around the viewer and put the performers inside the illusion.
creators.role_zh: 视听灯光与投影二人组
creators.bio_zh: 由插画师 Noemi Schipfer 和建筑师兼音乐人 Takami Nakamoto 组成的工作室，用多层半透明幕上的投影、动态灯光和现场表演搭建沉浸式光与声的建筑。他们的表演 SHIRO 为 Hellerau 的 Blackbox Whitecube XR 研讨会开场，AΦE 的 0AR 也在同场展出。
creators.why_zh: 只用投在纱幕上的线条，他们就能把空间在观众周围折叠起来，并让表演者置身幻象之中。

creators.name: DARKFIELD (David Rosenberg & Glen Neath)
creators.role: Immersive audio theatre company; artistic directors David Rosenberg and Glen Neath
creators.bio: DARKFIELD builds shows inside shipping containers fitted out as a séance room, an airliner cabin or a hotel, then turns the lights off completely and tells the story through 360-degree binaural sound and physical effects. During the pandemic its DARKFIELD RADIO app moved the same trick into people's own kitchens and living rooms.
creators.why: They prove that sound alone, placed precisely around your head in total darkness, can overwrite the room you are sitting in, which is the core promise of AR without any screen.
creators.role_zh: 沉浸式声音剧场团体；艺术总监 David Rosenberg 与 Glen Neath
creators.bio_zh: DARKFIELD 把集装箱布置成降神会房间、客机机舱或酒店，然后彻底关灯，只靠 360 度双耳立体声和实体特效讲故事。疫情期间，他们的 DARKFIELD RADIO 应用把同样的手法搬进观众自家的厨房和客厅。
creators.why_zh: 他们证明了：在完全黑暗中，只要把声音精确地放在你头部周围，就能覆盖你所在的真实房间——这正是不需要屏幕的 AR 的核心。

creators.name: Cybersaur Arts (Josh Garner)
creators.role: Community digital-arts company; projection and visualisation artist Josh Garner
creators.bio: Cybersaur Arts runs projection-mapping, lighting and interactive visual projects with young people and communities in Medway and Kent, often for Electric Medway and The Historic Dockyard Chatham. Workshops teach TouchDesigner, Resolume, projection mapping and movement sensors, and the results end up on building facades and festival nights.
creators.why: They turn drawings made by local people into large projected creatures and heritage trails, a practical model for community-made spatial media.
creators.role_zh: 社区数字艺术团体；投影与视觉艺术家 Josh Garner
creators.bio_zh: Cybersaur Arts 在梅德韦和肯特地区与青少年及社区合作做投影映射、灯光和互动影像项目，常与 Electric Medway 和查塔姆历史船坞合作。工作坊教大家使用 TouchDesigner、Resolume、投影映射和动作传感器，成果最后投到建筑立面和节庆夜晚上。
creators.why_zh: 他们把当地居民的手绘变成巨型投影生物和历史寻访路线，是社区共创空间媒体的实用范例。

creators.name: Arcade (Arcade Ltd)
creators.role: Spatial design and AR studio ('The Spatial Agency')
creators.bio: Arcade was a digital practice founded by architects, technologists, game developers and strategists that used AR and VR to connect people to places through play. Its 2019 projects included A Vixen's Tale for Welsh National Opera, an AR guide for the SEA LIFE London Aquarium, a Madame Tussauds app that animated wax figures, and an AR literary trail for the Roald Dahl Museum.
creators.why: Its architect-led AR mixes built physical sets with phone overlays, so the real object and the digital layer are designed together.
creators.role_zh: 空间设计与 AR 工作室（自称“The Spatial Agency”）
creators.bio_zh: Arcade 由建筑师、技术人员、游戏开发者和策略顾问共同创立，用 AR 和 VR“通过游戏把人与地方连接起来”。2019 年的项目包括为威尔士国家歌剧院做的 A Vixen's Tale、伦敦 SEA LIFE 水族馆的 AR 导览、让蜡像“活过来”的杜莎夫人蜡像馆应用，以及罗尔德·达尔博物馆的 AR 文学步道。
creators.why_zh: 它由建筑师主导，实体布景与手机叠加层一起设计，真实物件和数字层互为一体。

creators.name: Elly Oldman
creators.role: Illustrator and author of The Infinite Drawing
creators.bio: French illustrator who has drawn a single endless black-and-white picture, The Infinite Drawing, a little more each day on Instagram. She turned it into a giant wall fresco and floor puzzle whose characters come alive in augmented reality, animated by the studio &Friends with AR by Artefacto, and toured it to Rennes and A+E Lab's ALT*ASH in Ashford.
creators.why: She shows how a hand-drawn line illustration can become an AR playground where the whole wall is the marker and the story.
creators.role_zh: 插画师，《无尽之画》（The Infinite Drawing）作者
creators.bio_zh: 法国插画师，每天在 Instagram 上把同一幅黑白画作续画一点，形成“无尽之画”。她把这幅画做成巨型壁画和地面拼图，画中角色通过增强现实活动起来（动画由 &Friends 制作，AR 由 Artefacto 开发），先后在雷恩和 A+E Lab 的 ALT*ASH 展出。
creators.why_zh: 她展示了手绘线稿如何变成 AR 游乐场：整面墙既是识别图，也是故事本身。

creators.name: Naho Matsuda
creators.role: Visual artist working with language, data and public space
creators.bio: German-Japanese visual artist whose site-specific works examine language, communication and everyday power structures. EVERY THING EVERY TIME, produced with FutureEverything, turns live data from a city's sensors and systems into anonymous poetry on a street-side split-flap display; it has run in Newcastle, at SXSW and in Ashford for ALT*ASH.
creators.why: She makes the invisible data layer of a city readable on the spot, without a screen or an app.
creators.role_zh: 以语言、数据与公共空间为创作对象的视觉艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 德日混血视觉艺术家，作品多为特定场域创作，探讨语言、沟通方式和日常权力结构。与 FutureEverything 合作的 EVERY THING EVERY TIME 把城市传感器和系统产生的实时数据改写成匿名诗句，显示在街边的翻牌显示屏上，曾在纽卡斯尔、SXSW 以及 ALT*ASH 的阿什福德街头展出。
creators.why_zh: 她不用屏幕和应用，就让城市看不见的数据层在现场变得可读。

creators.name: Sarah Ticho
creators.role: XR director and founder of Hatsumi; co-director of Soul Paint
creators.bio: Artist and producer working where immersive technology meets health and wellbeing. With Niki Smit she directed Soul Paint, a VR body-mapping experience in which people paint where they feel emotions on and around a virtual body; it won the SXSW 2024 XR Special Jury Prize, and she co-founded the XR Health Alliance.
creators.why: Soul Paint uses 3D drawing on a body as a language for feelings that words cannot reach.
creators.role_zh: XR 导演、Hatsumi 创始人；Soul Paint 联合导演
creators.bio_zh: 在沉浸式技术与健康福祉交叉领域工作的艺术家和制作人。她与 Niki Smit 共同执导 Soul Paint：一个 VR 身体地图体验，参与者在虚拟身体上和周围画出自己感受情绪的位置。该作品获得 2024 年 SXSW XR 评审团特别奖；她还是 XR Health Alliance 的联合创始人。
creators.why_zh: Soul Paint 把“在身体上立体绘画”变成表达情绪的语言，说出语言说不出的感受。

creators.name: Camille Dunlop
creators.role: Digital, spatial and speculative designer
creators.bio: Architecture-trained designer who has worked with the speculative design studio Superflux and teaches Cinematic and Videogame Architecture at the Bartlett (UCL) and at Central Saint Martins. As a 2025 A+E Lab artist in residence she built Anatomy of Embodied Ecologies, a live Unreal Engine landscape of the Thames Estuary mudflats that reacts to the bodies in front of it.
creators.why: She uses a game engine as a living ecosystem that audiences disturb and shape with their movement.
creators.role_zh: 数字、空间与思辨设计师
creators.bio_zh: 建筑背景的设计师，曾与思辨设计工作室 Superflux 合作，并在伦敦大学学院巴特莱特建筑学院教授“电影与游戏建筑”、在中央圣马丁任教。作为 2025 年 A+E Lab 驻地艺术家，她创作了 Anatomy of Embodied Ecologies：一个以泰晤士河口泥滩为原型、能对面前人体做出反应的 Unreal Engine 实时景观。
creators.why_zh: 她把游戏引擎当成活的生态系统，观众用身体动作去扰动和塑造它。

creators.name: HsienYu Cheng (鄭先喻)
creators.role: Artist and software developer; interactive and bio-electronic installations
creators.bio: Taiwanese artist and software developer (born 1984, Kaohsiung) whose humorous electronic installations, software and bio-electronic devices question how technology conditions human behaviour. His works include a cube that locks up and drains visitors' phones, a 7-metre drawing machine whose operator cannot see the result, and an AI follow-spot that tracks passers-by; in 2024 he led A+E Lab's Hi-Tech Garden workshops connecting children to plant biodata.
creators.why: He designs interactions around constraints and absurd rules, which makes people notice how machines already steer them.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、软件开发者；互动与生物电子装置
creators.bio_zh: 台湾艺术家兼软件开发者（1984 年生于高雄），以幽默的电子装置、软件和生物电子设备，追问科技如何规训人的行为。作品包括会锁住并耗尽观众手机电量的方盒、操作者看不到画面的 7 米长绘画装置，以及用 AI 跟随路人的追光灯；2024 年他在 A+E Lab 主持 Hi-Tech Garden 工作坊，让孩子通过植物生物数据与植物“对话”。
creators.why_zh: 他围绕限制和荒诞规则来设计互动，让人意识到机器早已在操控我们。

creators.name: Cyril Diagne
creators.role: Artist, designer and ML engineer; co-founder of ClipDrop, former artist in residence at the Google Arts & Culture Lab
creators.bio: French creative technologist who co-founded the Lab212 collective, taught interaction design at ECAL and spent five years at the Google Arts & Culture Lab before co-founding ClipDrop (acquired by Stability AI). His 2020 AR Cut & Paste demo, which lifts real objects into Photoshop with a phone, became one of the most shared AR+ML prototypes ever.
creators.why: He shows how a tiny open-source prototype that joins phone AR with a machine-learning model can redefine an everyday gesture like copy and paste.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、设计师与机器学习工程师；ClipDrop 联合创始人，曾任 Google Arts & Culture Lab 驻留艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 法国创意技术人，曾参与创立 Lab212 艺术团体，在 ECAL 教授交互设计，并在 Google Arts & Culture Lab 工作五年，之后联合创办 ClipDrop（后被 Stability AI 收购）。他 2020 年发布的 AR Cut & Paste 演示——用手机把现实物体“剪”进 Photoshop——是传播最广的 AR+机器学习原型之一。
creators.why_zh: 他证明了一个把手机 AR 和机器学习模型接在一起的小型开源原型，就能重新定义“复制粘贴”这样的日常动作。

creators.name: Cao Fei
creators.role: Multimedia artist working across video, virtual worlds, VR and AR
creators.bio: Chinese artist whose work on automation, labour and virtual life runs from the Second Life city RMB City (2007) to the VR piece The Eternal Wave and several AR commissions. She created the AR-enhanced BMW Art Car #18 and the Trade Eden walk for Apple's [AR]T program.
creators.why: She has spent two decades treating virtual worlds as real places to live and work, and brings that view into phone AR and VR.
creators.role_zh: 横跨影像、虚拟世界、VR 与 AR 的多媒体艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 中国艺术家，关注自动化、劳动与虚拟生活，作品从 Second Life 中的《人民城寨》（RMB City，2007）一直延伸到 VR 作品 The Eternal Wave 和多件 AR 委托作品；她为 BMW 创作了带 AR 体验的第 18 号艺术车，并为 Apple [AR]T 项目创作了街头 AR 作品 Trade Eden。
creators.why_zh: 二十年来她一直把虚拟世界当作可以生活和劳动的真实场所，并把这种视角带进了手机 AR 和 VR。

creators.name: Alicja Kwade
creators.role: Sculptor and installation artist
creators.bio: Polish-born, Berlin-based artist whose sculptures question time, space and how we perceive reality. With Acute Art she made an AR version of LinienLand (2019) and the AR-BEIT series of interactive AR sculptures.
creators.why: Her AR sculptures turn her physical ideas about parallel worlds into objects that move, react and can be placed anywhere.
creators.role_zh: 雕塑与装置艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 出生于波兰、定居柏林的艺术家，雕塑作品追问时间、空间以及我们如何感知现实。她与 Acute Art 合作完成了 LinienLand 的 AR 版本（2019）和可交互的 AR 雕塑系列 AR-BEIT。
creators.why_zh: 她的 AR 雕塑把关于平行世界的实体构想变成了会动、会回应、可以放在任何地方的物件。

creators.name: Nick Cave
creators.role: Visual and performance artist, known for his Soundsuits
creators.bio: American artist, dancer and educator (not the musician) whose wearable Soundsuits hide the body and turn it into sound and colour. For Apple's [AR]T program he created Amass, an AR installation available inside every Apple Store, and an AR walk with his Soundsuits.
creators.why: He translated a body-based sculpture practice into shared AR spaces that anyone could step into inside a shop or on a street.
creators.role_zh: 视觉与表演艺术家，以 Soundsuits（声音服装）著称
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家、舞者和教育者（并非同名音乐人），其可穿戴的 Soundsuits 把身体包裹起来，化为声音与色彩。他为 Apple [AR]T 项目创作了可在全球所有 Apple Store 体验的 AR 装置 Amass，以及一条以 Soundsuits 为主角的 AR 城市漫步路线。
creators.why_zh: 他把以身体为核心的雕塑实践转译成共享的 AR 空间，任何人在商店里或街头都能走进去。

creators.name: Pipilotti Rist
creators.role: Video and installation artist
creators.bio: Swiss artist famous for immersive, colour-saturated video installations. Her [AR]T Walk piece International Liquid Finger Prayer (2019) sent groups racing through city streets after a singing, shimmering AR form.
creators.why: She brings the playful, bodily energy of her projection rooms to a city-scale AR chase game.
creators.role_zh: 影像与装置艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 瑞士艺术家，以色彩饱和、令人沉浸的影像装置闻名。她为 [AR]T Walk 创作的 International Liquid Finger Prayer（2019）让参与者成群在城市街道上追逐一个会唱歌、闪闪发光的 AR 形体。
creators.why_zh: 她把投影空间里那种顽皮、身体化的能量，带进了城市尺度的 AR 追逐游戏。

creators.name: Carsten Höller
creators.role: Artist and former scientist making participatory perception experiments
creators.bio: Belgian-born artist trained as an entomologist, known for slides, Upside-Down Goggles and flickering light works. He made the portal walk Through for Apple's [AR]T program and the 7.8 Reduced Reality App with Acute Art, which flickers phone screen, torch and vibration at 7.8 Hz.
creators.why: He treats AR as a perception experiment on the viewer rather than as a way to place objects.
creators.role_zh: 曾是科学家、创作参与式感知实验的艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 出生于比利时、受过昆虫学训练的艺术家，以滑梯装置、倒置眼镜（Upside-Down Goggles）和闪烁灯光作品闻名。他为 Apple [AR]T 项目创作了穿越传送门的 AR 漫步作品 Through，并与 Acute Art 合作推出 7.8 Reduced Reality App：让手机屏幕、闪光灯和振动以 7.8 Hz 频率闪烁。
creators.why_zh: 他把 AR 当作作用于观者自身的感知实验，而不仅是往空间里摆放物体。

creators.name: Nathalie Djurberg & Hans Berg
creators.role: Artist duo combining clay animation, sculpture and music
creators.bio: Swedish duo: Djurberg makes unsettling claymation worlds and Berg composes their hypnotic scores. They made the VR piece It Will End in Stars with Acute Art (2018) and the AR fairy-tale walk This Is It for Apple's [AR]T program (2019).
creators.why: They carry handmade, dark fairy-tale characters into VR and AR, where the creatures watch and react to the visitor.
creators.role_zh: 结合黏土动画、雕塑与音乐的艺术二人组
creators.bio_zh: 瑞典艺术二人组：Djurberg 创作令人不安的黏土动画世界，Berg 为其谱写催眠般的配乐。他们与 Acute Art 合作了 VR 作品 It Will End in Stars（2018），并为 Apple [AR]T 项目创作了童话式 AR 漫步作品 This Is It（2019）。
creators.why_zh: 他们把手工捏制、带暗黑童话气质的角色带进 VR 和 AR，让这些生物会注视并回应观众。

creators.name: John Giorno
creators.role: Poet and performance artist (1936-2019)
creators.bio: American poet who pioneered Dial-A-Poem and turned short lines of text into colourful paintings and performances. His [AR]T Walk piece Now at the Dawn of My Life (2019) placed a rainbow trail of his words over city streets.
creators.why: He shows that pure text, set in colour and placed in the street, can be a complete AR artwork.
creators.role_zh: 诗人与表演艺术家（1936–2019）
creators.bio_zh: 美国诗人，开创了 Dial-A-Poem（拨号听诗），并把短句诗文变成彩色绘画与表演。他为 [AR]T Walk 创作的 Now at the Dawn of My Life（2019）在城市街道上铺开一条由他的诗句组成的彩虹之路。
creators.why_zh: 他证明了只要给文字配上色彩、放进街道，纯文本本身就能成为完整的 AR 作品。

creators.name: Nina Chanel Abney
creators.role: Painter and public artist
creators.bio: American painter whose bold, flat, graphic compositions mix abstraction and figuration to capture the pace of contemporary life. Her first AR work, Imaginary Friend (2020, Acute Art), launched in parks and squares from London to New York.
creators.why: She turns a flat painting style into a companion character that meets people in public space.
creators.role_zh: 画家与公共艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 美国画家，以大胆、平面化的图形构图融合抽象与具象，表现当代生活的节奏。她的第一件 AR 作品 Imaginary Friend（2020，与 Acute Art 合作）在伦敦到纽约的公园和广场同步上线。
creators.why_zh: 她把平面绘画风格变成一个在公共空间里陪伴路人的角色。

creators.name: Koo Jeong A
creators.role: Installation and drawing artist
creators.bio: Korean artist known for quiet, site-specific works about everyday objects, scents and near-invisible gestures. Her AR ice cube density (2019) was Frieze's first augmented reality artwork, followed by the Prerequisites 7 drawings and the AR architecture OLO.
creators.why: Her floating AR ice cube proved that a single, almost invisible object can hold its own among bronze sculptures.
creators.role_zh: 装置与绘画艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 韩国艺术家，以安静、依场地而生的作品著称，关注日常物件、气味和近乎隐形的动作。她的 AR 冰块 density（2019）是 Frieze 艺博会第一件增强现实作品，之后又有 Prerequisites 7 系列动态素描和 AR 建筑 OLO。
creators.why_zh: 她那块悬浮的 AR 冰块证明，一个几乎看不见的物件也能在青铜雕塑之间站稳脚跟。

creators.name: Julie Curtiss
creators.role: Painter and sculptor
creators.bio: French-born, New York-based painter whose surreal images of hair, food and female archetypes read almost like sculpture. Lune (2021) was her first AR work, made with Acute Art.
creators.why: Her AR figure uses the viewer's own movement against them, turning the act of looking into the subject of the work.
creators.role_zh: 画家与雕塑家
creators.bio_zh: 出生于法国、定居纽约的画家，以头发、食物和女性原型为题材的超现实画面近乎雕塑。Lune（2021）是她与 Acute Art 合作的第一件 AR 作品。
creators.why_zh: 她的 AR 人物把观众自己的移动变成对抗观众的机制，让“观看”本身成为作品的主题。

creators.name: Ho Tzu Nyen
creators.role: Artist and filmmaker working with history and theory
creators.bio: Singaporean artist who makes films, installations and performances that start from historical and philosophical texts; he represented Singapore at the 2011 Venice Biennale. His AR work Language (2022, Acute Art, National Gallery Singapore) stages texts of the Kyoto School depending on where you point your phone.
creators.why: He uses the phone's direction (sky, ground, horizon) as the structure of a story, not just as a camera.
creators.role_zh: 以历史与理论为素材的艺术家、电影人
creators.bio_zh: 新加坡艺术家，以历史和哲学文本为起点创作电影、装置与表演，曾代表新加坡参加 2011 年威尼斯双年展。他的 AR 作品 Language（2022，Acute Art 制作、新加坡国家美术馆委托）会根据手机指向的方向，演绎京都学派的不同文本。
creators.why_zh: 他把手机的朝向（天空、地面、地平线）当作故事结构，而不仅仅是一台摄像头。

creators.name: Marco Brambilla
creators.role: Video installation artist and director
creators.bio: Italian-Canadian artist known for dense video collages built from found footage and early use of 3D in video art. With Acute Art he made the VR work Creation (Megaplex) and The Four Temperaments AR (2020) starring Cate Blanchett.
creators.why: He puts a performer's direct address into floating AR objects, so the viewer's position changes the drama.
creators.role_zh: 影像装置艺术家与导演
creators.bio_zh: 意大利裔加拿大艺术家，以用现成影像素材拼贴出的密集视频作品和较早在影像艺术中使用 3D 技术著称。他与 Acute Art 合作了 VR 作品 Creation (Megaplex) 和由 Cate Blanchett 主演的 The Four Temperaments AR（2020）。
creators.why_zh: 他把演员对镜头的直接独白放进漂浮的 AR 物体里，让观众站的位置改变戏剧效果。

creators.name: AΦE / A+E Lab (Aoi Nakamura & Esteban Lecoq)
creators.role: Immersive dance company and lab; creators of AR, VR and AI-driven dance works
creators.bio: Dancer-choreographers Aoi Nakamura and Esteban Lecoq (both ex-Jasmin Vardimon Company) run AΦE, whose works move dance into VR (WHIST), shared AR (0AR) and AI-driven LED installations (LILITH.AEON); their A+E Lab in Chatham hosted the UK's first Choreographic Coding Lab in 2022.
creators.why: They treat AR and VR as a stage for live bodies rather than a gadget, and 0AR is one of the earliest touring multi-user AR dance pieces.
creators.role_zh: 沉浸式舞蹈团体与实验室；AR、VR 与 AI 驱动舞蹈作品的创作者
creators.bio_zh: 舞者兼编舞 Aoi Nakamura 与 Esteban Lecoq（均曾任职 Jasmin Vardimon Company）创立 AΦE，把舞蹈带进 VR（WHIST）、多人共享 AR（0AR）和 AI 驱动的 LED 装置（LILITH.AEON）；他们在查塔姆的 A+E Lab 于 2022 年举办了英国首届 Choreographic Coding Lab。
creators.why_zh: 他们把 AR 和 VR 当作承载真实身体的舞台而不是炫技工具，0AR 是最早进行巡演的多人 AR 舞蹈作品之一。

creators.name: Frieder Weiss
creators.role: Interactive video designer and 'engineer in the arts'; creator of the EyeCon motion-tracking software
creators.bio: Software artist who since the mid-1990s has built camera-tracking systems that turn dancers' movement into live projected light and sound, from Palindrome's EyeCon pieces to Chunky Move's Glow and Mortal Engine and stage visuals for opera, circus and pop.
creators.why: Glow and Mortal Engine are the reference works for projection that reacts to the body in real time, the ancestor of every body-tracked AR effect.
creators.role_zh: 交互影像设计师，自称“艺术里的工程师”；动作追踪软件 EyeCon 的作者
creators.bio_zh: 软件艺术家，自 1990 年代中期起开发摄像头追踪系统，把舞者的动作实时转化为投影光影和声音，作品从 Palindrome 的 EyeCon 系列，到 Chunky Move 的 Glow、Mortal Engine，再到歌剧、马戏和流行音乐的舞台视觉。
creators.why_zh: Glow 和 Mortal Engine 是“投影实时回应身体”的标杆作品，可以说是今天所有身体追踪 AR 特效的前身。

creators.name: Mark Coniglio / Troika Ranch (with Dawn Stoppiello)
creators.role: Interactive dance-theatre company; Mark Coniglio created the Isadora media software and the MidiDancer sensor suit
creators.bio: Composer-programmer Mark Coniglio and choreographer Dawn Stoppiello founded Troika Ranch in 1994, making works in which sensor suits and live camera tracking let dancers trigger and shape video, sound and light; the tool Coniglio built for this, Isadora, became a standard in live media performance.
creators.why: They pioneered the dancer as the controller of the media on stage, and their tools and methods still shape how artists wire bodies to projections.
creators.role_zh: 交互舞蹈剧场团体；Mark Coniglio 开发了媒体软件 Isadora 和传感舞衣 MidiDancer
creators.bio_zh: 作曲家兼程序员 Mark Coniglio 与编舞 Dawn Stoppiello 于 1994 年创立 Troika Ranch，用传感舞衣和现场摄像头追踪让舞者触发并塑造影像、声音和灯光；Coniglio 为此开发的 Isadora 后来成为现场媒体表演的常用工具。
creators.why_zh: 他们率先让舞者成为舞台媒体的“控制器”，他们的工具和方法至今仍影响着艺术家如何把身体和投影连在一起。

creators.name: Motion Bank / Choreographic Coding Lab
creators.role: Dance research project (Forsythe Company, now Hochschule Mainz) and the travelling Choreographic Coding Lab format
creators.bio: Motion Bank grew out of The Forsythe Company in 2010 to build digital dance scores and annotation tools; since 2013 its Choreographic Coding Labs have gathered coders and dancers in Frankfurt, Berlin, Melbourne, New York, Amsterdam, Chatham, London and elsewhere to prototype movement-driven software and art.
creators.why: The CCLs are a rare, recurring place where creative coders learn choreographic thinking, and many body-tracking and projection prototypes started there.
creators.role_zh: 舞蹈研究项目（源自 Forsythe Company，现属美因茨应用技术大学）及巡回举办的 Choreographic Coding Lab
creators.bio_zh: Motion Bank 于 2010 年从 The Forsythe Company 发展而来，研究数字舞谱和标注工具；2013 年起，它的 Choreographic Coding Lab 在法兰克福、柏林、墨尔本、纽约、阿姆斯特丹、查塔姆、伦敦等地召集程序员和舞者，一起做由动作驱动的软件与艺术原型。
creators.why_zh: CCL 是创意程序员系统学习编舞思维的少有场所，许多身体追踪和投影原型都诞生于此。

creators.name: Gibson/Martelli (Ruth Gibson & Bruno Martelli)
creators.role: Artist duo working with motion capture, AR and VR dance
creators.bio: Choreographer Ruth Gibson and VR artist Bruno Martelli have worked since 2000 with motion capture and game engines, turning dance into AR prints (MAN A), room-scale VR and participatory mocap performances (DAZZLE, PAN+TILT, nino).
creators.why: They find playful formats for letting audiences dance with and inside captured choreography, from dazzle-camouflage AR prints to live avatar balls.
creators.role_zh: 以动作捕捉、AR 与 VR 舞蹈创作的艺术家二人组
creators.bio_zh: 编舞 Ruth Gibson 与 VR 艺术家 Bruno Martelli 自 2000 年起用动作捕捉和游戏引擎创作，把舞蹈变成 AR 印刷品（MAN A）、房间尺度的 VR 和观众参与的动捕演出（DAZZLE、PAN+TILT、nino）。
creators.why_zh: 他们不断发明好玩的形式，让观众与被捕捉下来的舞蹈共舞、甚至走进舞蹈内部，从迷彩图案 AR 印刷品到现场虚拟化身舞会。

creators.name: Compagnie Nicole Seiler
creators.role: Choreographer and video artist; dance works built on projection, video games and audio walks
creators.bio: Swiss choreographer Nicole Seiler makes dance pieces that pit the body against its image: projections mapped onto dancers (Pixel Babes, Shiver), video-game bodies in public space (K Two), dancers watched through city windows (Living-Room Dancers) and a geolocated smartphone audio walk (Palimpsest).
creators.why: Her pieces are clear, low-tech experiments in how projected or imagined images reshape a real body and a real place.
creators.role_zh: 编舞兼影像艺术家；作品以投影、电子游戏和声音漫步为基础
creators.bio_zh: 瑞士编舞 Nicole Seiler 的作品让身体与自身的影像对峙：投影映射到舞者身上（Pixel Babes、Shiver），电子游戏式的身体出现在公共空间（K Two），观众透过城市窗户观看舞者（Living-Room Dancers），以及基于地理定位的手机声音漫步（Palimpsest）。
creators.why_zh: 她的作品是清晰而低技术的实验，探讨投影或想象中的影像如何重塑真实的身体和真实的场所。

creators.name: Christian Mio Loclair / Waltz Binaire
creators.role: Dancer (Prince Mio), creative coder and founder of Waltz Binaire
creators.bio: Former popping battle dancer turned creative technologist who built Kinect-projector dance pieces and dance-game prototypes before founding the Berlin studio Waltz Binaire, whose Pathfinder came out of the Choreographic Coding Lab.
creators.why: He comes at body tracking from street dance, so his systems are designed around improvisation and flow rather than fixed choreography.
creators.role_zh: 舞者（Prince Mio）、创意程序员，Waltz Binaire 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 曾是 popping 斗舞舞者，后来成为创意技术人，先后做过 Kinect 加投影的舞蹈作品和舞蹈游戏原型，之后在柏林创立工作室 Waltz Binaire；其作品 Pathfinder 诞生于 Choreographic Coding Lab。
creators.why_zh: 他从街舞出发做身体追踪，因此他的系统围绕即兴与律动来设计，而不是固定编舞。

creators.name: Geoffrey Alan Rhodes
creators.role: Filmmaker and AR artist; founding member of Manifest.AR
creators.bio: Experimental filmmaker who turned augmented reality into a way of re-editing cinema: his 52 Card Cinema pieces, made at York University's AR Lab, map film shots onto playing cards. He co-signed the 2011 AR Art Manifesto, taught at the School of the Art Institute of Chicago and now teaches in Shanghai, where he builds AR museum and history tours.
creators.why: He treats AR as a new film grammar, so a deck of cards, a banknote or a riverbank becomes a montage you can hold and rearrange.
creators.role_zh: 电影人、AR 艺术家；Manifest.AR 创始成员
creators.based_zh: 芝加哥，美国 / 上海，中国
creators.bio_zh: 实验电影导演，把增强现实变成重新剪辑电影的手段：他在约克大学 AR Lab 创作的 52 Card Cinema 系列，把电影镜头映射到一张张扑克牌上。他是 2011 年《AR 艺术宣言》的联署人之一，曾任教于芝加哥艺术学院，现在上海任教，继续做 AR 博物馆与历史导览项目。
creators.why_zh: 他把 AR 当作一种新的电影语法：一副扑克、一张钞票、一段河岸，都能变成可以拿在手里重新排列的蒙太奇。

creators.name: Caitlin Fisher
creators.role: Digital-literature author; director of the Augmented Reality Lab, York University
creators.bio: Electronic-literature writer (the award-winning hypertext novel These Waves of Girls) and York University professor who founded one of the first art-focused augmented reality labs. Her lab built SnapDragonAR and a string of tabletop AR poems, pop-up books and history projects.
creators.why: She pioneered AR as a literary form: poems and stories that unfold on cards and tabletops in your hands.
creators.role_zh: 电子文学作家；约克大学增强现实实验室（Augmented Reality Lab）主任
creators.bio_zh: 电子文学作家（获奖超文本小说 These Waves of Girls 的作者），约克大学教授，创办了最早以艺术为导向的增强现实实验室之一。实验室开发了 SnapDragonAR 工具，并做出一系列桌面 AR 诗歌、AR 立体书和历史叙事项目。
creators.why_zh: 她很早就把 AR 当作一种文学形式：诗和故事在你手中的卡片与桌面上展开。

creators.name: Nathan Shafer
creators.role: AR artist, comics author and educator
creators.bio: Alaskan artist who uses geolocated and marker-based AR to tell Alaskan stories: vanished glacier edges, domed cities that were never built, and Indigenous-language portraits made with schools. He later moved into AR comics and games with Native and autistic characters.
creators.why: His Exit Glacier project made climate change visible on the spot by showing where the ice used to be.
creators.role_zh: AR 艺术家、漫画作者、教育者
creators.based_zh: 安克雷奇，阿拉斯加，美国
creators.bio_zh: 阿拉斯加艺术家，用基于地理位置和标记的 AR 讲述阿拉斯加的故事：消失的冰川边缘、从未建成的穹顶城市，以及与学校合作、用原住民语言标注的肖像。后来他转向 AR 漫画和游戏，塑造原住民与自闭症角色。
creators.why_zh: 他的 Exit Glacier 项目在冰川现场标出冰舌当年的位置，让气候变化一眼可见。

creators.name: Lily & Honglei (Lily Xiying Yang & Honglei Li)
creators.role: Artist duo working with painting, animation, virtual worlds and AR
creators.bio: Chinese-American artist collaborative based in Flushing, New York, whose paintings, Second Life worlds and AR interventions reflect on censorship, urbanization in China and immigrant life. They took part in Manifest.AR's Venice, Bushwick and ZERO1 interventions and received a Creative Capital award.
creators.why: They place politically loaded Chinese icons, from the Great Firewall to Mao's crystal coffin, into Western public space where no one can remove them.
creators.role_zh: 以绘画、动画、虚拟世界与 AR 创作的艺术家二人组
creators.bio_zh: 旅居纽约法拉盛的华裔艺术家组合，作品横跨绘画、Second Life 虚拟世界和 AR 介入，关注审查、中国城市化与移民生活。他们参与了 Manifest.AR 在威尼斯、布什维克和 ZERO1 的 AR 介入，并获得 Creative Capital 资助。
creators.why_zh: 他们把带有强烈政治意味的中国符号（防火长城、水晶棺）放进西方公共空间，而且谁也拆不掉。

creators.name: Naoko Tosa
creators.role: Media artist; professor at Kyoto University
creators.bio: Japanese media-art pioneer who, from the early 1990s, built interactive characters that read human emotion (Neuro-Baby), installations that reveal the unconscious feelings between two people (Unconscious Flow) and 'cultural computing' systems based on Zen. She is now best known for Sound of Ikebana, high-speed films of fluid shaped by sound.
creators.why: Decades before affective computing was mainstream, she made artworks that react to what you feel rather than what you click.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家；京都大学教授
creators.bio_zh: 日本媒体艺术先驱。从 90 年代初起，她做出能读懂人类情绪的互动角色（Neuro-Baby）、揭示两人之间潜意识情感的装置（Unconscious Flow），以及基于禅宗的“文化计算”系统。如今她最有名的作品是 Sound of Ikebana：用声音塑形液体的高速摄影影像。
creators.why_zh: 在情感计算还远未普及的年代，她就让作品回应你的“感受”，而不是你的点击。

creators.name: John Cleater
creators.role: Architect and AR artist (Cleater Studio)
creators.bio: Architect who began using the Layar AR browser in 2011 to float animated 'Sky Pavilions' over the High Line, Venice and his own garden, and who curated Peeling Layers of Space Out of Thin Air, an open-field show of AR architecture at Omi International Arts Center.
creators.why: He showed how architects can build weightless, site-specific pavilions in the sky with nothing but a phone.
creators.role_zh: 建筑师、AR 艺术家（Cleater Studio）
creators.bio_zh: 建筑师，2011 年起用 Layar AR 浏览器，把会动的“天空亭子”（Sky Pavilions）悬浮在高线公园、威尼斯和自家花园上空，并策划了在 Omi 国际艺术中心旷野中举办的 AR 建筑展 Peeling Layers of Space Out of Thin Air。
creators.why_zh: 他证明了建筑师只用一部手机，就能在天空中搭建失重的、与场地相关的亭子。

creators.name: Phoenix Perry
creators.role: Game designer, artist and educator; founder of Code Liberation Foundation
creators.bio: Designer of physical and embodied games who founded the Code Liberation Foundation to teach women and non-binary people to code games, and who later led physical computing at Goldsmiths and UAL's Creative Computing Institute. Her work ranges from Kinect-driven music performance to Bot Party, a game played through skin contact.
creators.why: She makes the body, touch and gesture the controller, turning technology into a reason for people to physically connect.
creators.role_zh: 游戏设计师、艺术家、教育者；Code Liberation Foundation 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 专注身体与实体游戏的设计师。她创办了 Code Liberation Foundation，教女性和非二元性别者编写游戏，之后在 Goldsmiths 和 UAL 创意计算学院教授物理计算。作品从 Kinect 驱动的音乐表演，到通过皮肤接触来玩的游戏 Bot Party。
creators.why_zh: 她把身体、触碰和手势当作控制器，让技术成为人们彼此接触的理由。

creators.name: Patrick Lichty
creators.role: Media artist, curator and writer; member of Second Front
creators.bio: Media artist and theorist who co-founded Second Front, the first performance-art group in Second Life, animated projects for The Yes Men, and joined Manifest.AR's early AR interventions. He writes widely on virtual worlds, AR and 'Techspressionism'.
creators.why: He carried the activist prank logic of The Yes Men and Second Front into geolocated AR.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家、策展人、写作者；Second Front 成员
creators.bio_zh: 媒体艺术家与理论家，联合创办了 Second Life 中第一个行为艺术团体 Second Front，为 The Yes Men 的项目制作动画，并参与了 Manifest.AR 早期的 AR 介入。他长期撰写关于虚拟世界、AR 与 “Techspressionism” 的文章。
creators.why_zh: 他把 The Yes Men 和 Second Front 那种行动主义恶作剧的思路，带进了基于地理位置的 AR。

creators.name: Alan Sondheim
creators.role: New-media artist, poet and theorist
creators.bio: Pioneer of internet text art and codework who has spent decades making performances that mix Second Life avatars, motion capture and live bodies, often with singer Azure Carter and choreographer Foofwa d'Imobilité. He was an Eyebeam resident and an endorser of the AR Art Manifesto.
creators.why: His mixed-reality performances blur where the avatar ends and the dancer begins.
creators.role_zh: 新媒体艺术家、诗人、理论家
creators.bio_zh: 网络文本艺术与 codework 的先驱，几十年来持续创作把 Second Life 化身、动作捕捉和真人身体混在一起的表演，常与歌手 Azure Carter、编舞家 Foofwa d'Imobilité 合作。他曾是 Eyebeam 驻留艺术家，也是《AR 艺术宣言》的联署人。
creators.why_zh: 他的混合现实表演让人分不清化身在哪里结束、舞者从哪里开始。

creators.name: Foofwa d'Imobilité
creators.role: Choreographer and dancer
creators.bio: Swiss choreographer and former Merce Cunningham Dance Company dancer, known for Dancewalk, long dance-walks through cities, and for hybrid pieces mixing dance with sport, virtual worlds and motion capture, including performances with Alan Sondheim.
creators.why: He brings a trained dancer's body into mixed-reality experiments, so the physical performer and the virtual layer answer each other.
creators.role_zh: 编舞家、舞者
creators.bio_zh: 瑞士编舞家，曾是 Merce Cunningham 舞团舞者，以在城市中长距离“舞步行走”的 Dancewalk 闻名，也创作把舞蹈与运动、虚拟世界、动作捕捉混合的作品，其中包括与 Alan Sondheim 的合作表演。
creators.why_zh: 他把专业舞者的身体带进混合现实实验，让真实表演者与虚拟图层互相呼应。

creators.name: Damon Loren Baker
creators.role: Artist and developer
creators.bio: New York artist and developer in the Manifest.AR circle who co-created the AR Sun Project with Mark Skwarek and showed LAPSE at the 2010 Bushwick Augmented Reality Intervention.
creators.why: The AR Sun Project he co-created is one of the simplest and most poetic early geolocated AR ideas: a replacement sun for cities that can no longer see the real one.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、开发者
creators.bio_zh: 纽约的艺术家与开发者，属于 Manifest.AR 圈子，与 Mark Skwarek 合作了 AR Sun Project，并在 2010 年布什维克增强现实介入展中展出作品 LAPSE。
creators.why_zh: 他参与创作的 AR Sun Project 是早期地理定位 AR 中最简单也最有诗意的点子之一：给看不见太阳的城市一颗替代的太阳。

creators.name: Steve Mann
creators.role: Wearable-computing pioneer; professor at the University of Toronto (EyeTap, mediated reality)
creators.bio: Built and wore head-mounted computers and cameras from the late 1970s onward, streamed his life from a Wearable Wireless Webcam in 1994 at MIT, and invented the EyeTap, which turns the eye itself into a camera and display. He coined 'mediated reality' and 'sousveillance' and keeps teaching wearable AR at the University of Toronto.
creators.why: He treated AR not as adding labels but as computationally rewriting what the eye sees (diminishing, amplifying, making invisible waves visible), decades before smart glasses existed.
creators.role_zh: 可穿戴计算先驱；多伦多大学教授（EyeTap、介导现实）
creators.bio_zh: 从 70 年代末起就自己制作并长期佩戴头戴式计算机和摄像机；1994 年在 MIT 用“可穿戴无线网络摄像头”实时直播自己的生活；发明了 EyeTap，让眼睛本身同时成为摄像机和显示器。他提出了“介导现实”（mediated reality）和“逆向监视”（sousveillance）等概念，至今仍在多伦多大学教授可穿戴 AR。
creators.why_zh: 早在智能眼镜出现几十年前，他就把 AR 理解为用计算重写眼睛所见：可以削弱、放大现实，也能让看不见的波动变得可见，而不只是往画面上加标签。

creators.name: Thad Starner
creators.role: Wearable-computing pioneer; professor at Georgia Tech; technical lead on Google Glass
creators.bio: Has worn a head-up display and one-handed Twiddler keyboard daily since 1993, co-founded the MIT wearable computing project, and runs the Contextual Computing Group at Georgia Tech. He was a technical lead and manager on Google Glass and works on sign-language recognition, passive haptic learning and head-worn assistants.
creators.why: He lived inside his own prototypes for decades, so his demos show what an always-on heads-up assistant is actually like in conversation, at work and at play.
creators.role_zh: 可穿戴计算先驱；佐治亚理工学院教授；Google Glass 技术负责人之一
creators.bio_zh: 自 1993 年起每天佩戴头戴显示器和单手 Twiddler 键盘，是 MIT 可穿戴计算项目的联合发起人，现主持佐治亚理工学院的 Contextual Computing Group。他曾担任 Google Glass 的技术负责人和经理，研究手语识别、被动触觉学习和头戴式智能助手。
creators.why_zh: 他几十年如一日“住”在自己的原型里，因此他的演示真实展现了一个始终在线的抬头助手在对话、工作和游戏中究竟是什么样子。

creators.name: Bruce Thomas — UniSA Wearable Computer Lab
creators.role: Professor; founder of the Wearable Computer Lab at the University of South Australia
creators.bio: Founded the Wearable Computer Lab at the University of South Australia, where Tinmith and ARQuake (with Wayne Piekarski) took AR outdoors around 2000. The lab later became a centre for spatial augmented reality: projecting interfaces onto foam, clay and mock-up control panels for design and prototyping.
creators.why: His lab kept asking how you would actually build, sculpt and prototype with AR, from backpack computers outdoors to projector-lit foam models on a workbench.
creators.role_zh: 教授；南澳大学可穿戴计算机实验室（Wearable Computer Lab）创始人
creators.bio_zh: 创建了南澳大学可穿戴计算机实验室。2000 年前后，实验室与 Wayne Piekarski 一起用 Tinmith 和 ARQuake 把 AR 带到了户外；之后又成为空间增强现实（SAR）的重镇，把界面投影到泡沫、黏土和控制面板模型上，用于设计和快速原型。
creators.why_zh: 他的实验室一直在追问“如何真正用 AR 来建造、雕塑和做原型”，从户外背包电脑一直做到工作台上被投影点亮的泡沫模型。

creators.name: Ruofei Du
creators.role: Interactive perception and graphics lead at Google XR
creators.bio: Researcher at Google who leads work on depth-based AR interaction (DepthLab, which shipped in the ARCore Depth API), AI-driven captions and agents for XR, and the open-source XR Blocks framework. Before Google he built mixed-reality social platforms such as Geollery at the University of Maryland.
creators.why: His projects turn raw perception (depth maps, speech, object detection) into a library of small, reusable AR interactions that others can copy.
creators.role_zh: Google XR 交互感知与图形研究负责人
creators.bio_zh: Google 研究员，主导基于深度的 AR 交互研究（DepthLab，已进入 ARCore Depth API）、面向 XR 的 AI 字幕与智能体，以及开源框架 XR Blocks。加入 Google 之前，他在马里兰大学做了 Geollery 等混合现实社交平台。
creators.why_zh: 他的项目把原始的感知数据（深度图、语音、物体识别）变成一套小巧、可复用的 AR 交互，别人拿来就能模仿。

creators.name: Alex Olwal
creators.role: Research scientist and tech lead at Google (AR, wearables, interaction)
creators.bio: Interaction researcher who built early spatial and mobile AR systems at KTH and Columbia, then worked at the MIT Media Lab and Google on wearables, captioning glasses and interfaces hidden in everyday materials.
creators.why: He repeatedly finds a small physical trick (a holographic window, a light sensor under a phone, a microphone array) that makes an AR idea work without heavy hardware.
creators.role_zh: Google 研究科学家、技术负责人（AR、可穿戴、交互）
creators.bio_zh: 交互研究者，早年在瑞典皇家理工学院（KTH）和哥伦比亚大学做空间 AR 与移动 AR 系统，之后在 MIT Media Lab 和 Google 研究可穿戴设备、字幕眼镜，以及隐藏在日常材料中的界面。
creators.why_zh: 他总能找到一个小小的物理巧思（全息窗口、手机下方的光传感器、麦克风阵列），不用笨重硬件就让 AR 想法成立。

creators.name: Mar Gonzalez-Franco
creators.role: Research scientist leading the Blended Interaction Research & Devices lab at Google (formerly Microsoft Research)
creators.bio: Neuroscientist and computer scientist who studied embodiment and avatars in VR, then led mixed-reality research at Microsoft Research before moving to Google. Her team explores AI agents, cross-device input and interaction with real objects in XR.
creators.why: She brings perception science into MR design: her demos exploit how attention, body ownership and space really work to make impossible interactions feel natural.
creators.role_zh: Google 研究科学家，领导 Blended Interaction Research & Devices 实验室（曾任职微软研究院）
creators.bio_zh: 神经科学与计算机科学背景，长期研究 VR 中的具身感与虚拟化身，曾在微软研究院主持混合现实研究，后加入 Google。她的团队探索 XR 中的 AI 智能体、跨设备输入以及与真实物体的交互。
creators.why_zh: 她把感知科学带进 MR 设计：她的演示利用注意力、身体归属感和空间感知的真实规律，让“不可能”的交互显得自然。

creators.name: Timoni West
creators.role: Designer; former head of XR research at Unity Labs (EditorXR, Carte Blanche, Unity MARS)
creators.bio: Led Unity Labs' XR research team, which prototyped authoring VR inside VR (EditorVR, Carte Blanche) and then Unity MARS, a tool for building AR apps that adapt to any real room. She speaks widely on designing tools for spatial computing.
creators.why: She focused on the tools rather than the apps: how non-programmers could author spatial content with their hands and how AR content can be described by rules about the room instead of fixed coordinates.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；曾任 Unity Labs XR 研究负责人（EditorXR、Carte Blanche、Unity MARS）
creators.bio_zh: 曾领导 Unity Labs 的 XR 研究团队，先后做了“在 VR 里编辑 VR”的原型 EditorVR 和 Carte Blanche，之后推出 Unity MARS：一个让 AR 应用自动适配任何真实房间的创作工具。她经常分享空间计算工具的设计思路。
creators.why_zh: 她关注的是工具而不是单个应用：非程序员如何用双手创作空间内容，以及如何用“关于房间的规则”而不是固定坐标来描述 AR 内容。

creators.name: SPACE10 (IKEA's research and design lab)
