creators.role: Research and design lab funded by IKEA (2015–2023); producer of the Everyday Experiments series
creators.bio: IKEA's independent research lab in Copenhagen explored future living through food, architecture and technology until it closed in 2023. Its Everyday Experiments platform commissioned studios such as FIELD, Bakken & Bæck, Random Studio, Yuri Suzuki and Nicole He to prototype small spatial-computing ideas for the home.
creators.why: Everyday Experiments is a catalogue of short, playful 'what if' AR prototypes about ordinary domestic life, each one small enough to rebuild in a classroom.
creators.role_zh: IKEA 资助的研究与设计实验室（2015–2023），Everyday Experiments 系列的发起者
creators.bio_zh: IKEA 在哥本哈根设立的独立研究实验室，围绕食物、建筑和技术探索未来生活方式，于 2023 年关闭。它的 Everyday Experiments 平台邀请 FIELD、Bakken & Bæck、Random Studio、Yuri Suzuki、Nicole He 等工作室，为家居生活制作小型空间计算原型。
creators.why_zh: Everyday Experiments 是一套关于日常家居生活的“如果……会怎样”式 AR 原型合集，短小、好玩，每一个都小到可以在课堂上复刻。

creators.name: FIELD (FIELD.IO / FIELD.SYSTEMS)
creators.role: Creative studio for art, design and technology
creators.bio: Studio working with code, data, moving image and spatial experiences for clients and cultural projects. For IKEA and SPACE10's Everyday Experiments it built several LiDAR and AI-driven AR prototypes, from a room that plays music to elephants that measure your furniture.
creators.why: Their Everyday Experiments pieces take one childlike gesture (stacking, measuring, listening) and make it the whole AR interaction.
creators.role_zh: 艺术、设计与技术创意工作室
creators.based_zh: 伦敦，英国 / 柏林，德国
creators.bio_zh: 工作室用代码、数据、动态影像和空间体验为品牌和文化项目创作。为 IKEA 与 SPACE10 的 Everyday Experiments 制作了多个基于 LiDAR 和 AI 的 AR 原型，从会演奏房间的乐器到帮你量家具的大象。
creators.why_zh: 他们在 Everyday Experiments 中的作品都抓住一个孩子般的动作（堆叠、测量、聆听），并让它成为整个 AR 交互。

creators.name: Scatter / Depthkit (James George, Alexander Porter, Yasmin Elayat)
creators.role: Volumetric filmmaking studio and makers of the Depthkit capture software
creators.bio: Grew out of the open-source RGBDToolkit that paired a depth sensor with a DSLR. Scatter makes volumetric documentaries such as CLOUDS, Zero Days VR and The Changing Same, and sells Depthkit, the capture tool behind many volumetric AR and VR pieces, including Terminal 3.
creators.why: They made volumetric capture cheap enough for artists, which is why so many AR holograms of real people exist at all.
creators.role_zh: 体积影像工作室，Depthkit 捕捉软件的开发者
creators.bio_zh: 前身是把深度传感器和单反相机结合起来的开源工具 RGBDToolkit。Scatter 制作了 CLOUDS、Zero Days VR、The Changing Same 等体积影像纪录作品，并推出 Depthkit——许多体积 AR 和 VR 作品（包括 Terminal 3）背后的捕捉工具。
creators.why_zh: 他们把体积捕捉的门槛降到艺术家也用得起，如今才会有这么多“真人全息”的 AR 作品。

creators.name: Google ATAP (Advanced Technology and Projects)
creators.role: Google's hardware research group (Project Tango, Spotlight Stories, Soli, Jacquard)
creators.bio: Google's small, deadline-driven skunkworks, started from Motorola. Project Tango, led by Johnny Lee, put depth sensing and motion tracking into phones in 2014 and paved the way for ARCore; Spotlight Stories turned the phone into a window onto 360° animated films; Soli brought radar gestures into products.
creators.why: Project Tango was the first time a phone understood the room it was in, and most of today's phone AR descends from it.
creators.role_zh: Google 的硬件前沿研究部门（Project Tango、Spotlight Stories、Soli、Jacquard）
creators.bio_zh: Google 内部以短周期冲刺著称的小型研发团队，源自摩托罗拉。由 Johnny Lee 领导的 Project Tango 在 2014 年把深度感知和运动追踪装进手机，为 ARCore 铺平道路；Spotlight Stories 把手机变成观看 360° 动画短片的窗口；Soli 则把雷达手势带进了产品。
creators.why_zh: Project Tango 第一次让手机真正理解自己所处的房间，今天大部分手机 AR 都是它的后代。

creators.name: Eyal Ofek
creators.role: Computer vision and XR researcher (formerly Microsoft Research; now University of Birmingham)
creators.bio: Worked on the first real-time time-of-flight camera (ZCam), then spent many years at Microsoft Research on projector-camera systems, AR layout, haptic VR controllers and walking-based VR, co-authoring IllumiRoom and RoomAlive with Hrvoje Benko and Andy Wilson.
creators.why: His projects bend the real environment into the virtual one: re-laying out AR to fit a room, turning a walk down a street into a VR adventure, or hiding changes in plain sight.
creators.role_zh: 计算机视觉与 XR 研究者（曾任职微软研究院，现任伯明翰大学）
creators.bio_zh: 早年参与第一台实时飞行时间深度相机 ZCam，之后多年在微软研究院研究投影-相机系统、AR 布局、VR 触觉控制器和行走式 VR，与 Hrvoje Benko 和 Andy Wilson 合作了 IllumiRoom 和 RoomAlive。
creators.why_zh: 他的项目把真实环境“折叠”进虚拟世界：让 AR 布局自动适配房间，把一次街头散步变成 VR 冒险，或者在你眼皮底下悄悄改变场景。

creators.name: Asad J. Malik (1RIC / Jadu)
creators.role: AR director and founder of Jadu
creators.bio: Pakistani-born director whose studio 1RIC made volumetric AR narratives for HoloLens and Magic Leap that premiered at Tribeca and Sundance. He then founded Jadu, a multiplayer AR fighting game with holographic characters.
creators.why: He uses life-size volumetric people in your own room to make you uncomfortable in a meaningful way, turning AR into a medium for empathy and politics.
creators.role_zh: AR 导演，Jadu 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 出生于巴基斯坦的导演，他的工作室 1RIC 为 HoloLens 和 Magic Leap 制作体积影像 AR 叙事作品，先后在翠贝卡和圣丹斯电影节首映。之后他创立了 Jadu，一款以全息角色对战的多人 AR 格斗游戏。
creators.why_zh: 他把真人大小的体积影像人物放进你自己的房间，让你产生有意义的不适感，把 AR 变成关于同理心和政治的媒介。

creators.name: Johnny Chung Lee
creators.role: HCI researcher; Wii Remote hacker; led Project Tango at Google
creators.bio: Did his PhD at Carnegie Mellon on projector-based tracking, where light sensors hidden in a surface let a projector find and follow it. His 2007 Wii Remote videos (head-tracked 3D, a $50 interactive whiteboard, finger tracking) reached millions; he later worked on Kinect at Microsoft and led Project Tango at Google.
creators.why: He showed again and again that a cheap sensor plus one clever idea (track the head, not the scene) can produce spatial illusions that expensive systems had not made popular.
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者；Wii 遥控器改造达人；Google Project Tango 负责人
creators.bio_zh: 在卡内基梅隆大学攻读博士，研究基于投影仪的定位追踪：把光传感器藏在物体表面，投影仪就能自己找到并跟随它。2007 年他用 Wii 遥控器做的视频（头部追踪 3D、50 美元的互动白板、手指追踪）被数百万人观看；之后他在微软参与 Kinect，又在 Google 领导 Project Tango。
creators.why_zh: 他一次次证明：一个便宜的传感器加一个巧妙的想法（追踪人的头，而不是场景），就能做出昂贵系统都没能普及的空间错觉。

creators.name: Clara Bacou
creators.role: 3D artist and Snapchat Lens creator
creators.bio: Street artist turned 3D and AR artist who makes Snapchat and Spectacles Lenses, digital sculptures and branded AR, from the 2019 Spectacles 3 launch lenses to the dragon-flock Spectacles Lens Blazer.
creators.why: Her Spectacles 3 lens fills everyday places with giant hand-drawn butterflies, a simple way to show how you see your own world.
creators.role_zh: 3D 艺术家、Snapchat 镜头创作者
creators.bio_zh: 从街头涂鸦转向 3D 与 AR 创作，为 Snapchat 和 Spectacles 制作镜头、数字雕塑和品牌 AR，作品从 2019 年 Spectacles 3 首发镜头到引导龙群飞行的 Spectacles 镜头 Blazer。
creators.why_zh: 她的 Spectacles 3 镜头让巨大的手绘蝴蝶飞满日常场景，用很简单的方式表达“我眼中的世界是什么样”。

creators.name: Ninsky
creators.role: AR developer (Lens Studio, Spectacles)
creators.bio: Lens Studio developer who posts AR effect experiments and co-developed the Spectacles racing game Specs Racer with Max van Leeuwen.
creators.why: One short experiment turns a sunny summer street into a snowfield, showing how quickly AR can overwrite the season.
creators.role_zh: AR 开发者（Lens Studio、Spectacles）
creators.bio_zh: Lens Studio 开发者，发布 AR 特效实验，并与 Max van Leeuwen 合作开发了 Spectacles 赛车游戏 Specs Racer。
creators.why_zh: 一个小实验就把阳光明媚的夏日街道变成雪地，展示了 AR 改写季节有多快。

creators.name: GoSpooky
creators.role: Social and AR agency (Amsterdam / New York)
creators.bio: Agency founded in Amsterdam that grew out of Snapchat and Instagram AR lenses and now also runs social campaigns; its in-house R&D team publishes AR prototypes on Snap Spectacles, Quest 3 and Google's Geospatial API.
creators.why: Its R&D clips turn one platform feature (world meshing, LiDAR raycasts, city-scale localisation) into one playful action you understand in seconds.
creators.role_zh: 社交媒体与 AR 创意公司（阿姆斯特丹 / 纽约）
creators.bio_zh: 创立于阿姆斯特丹，从 Snapchat 和 Instagram AR 镜头起家，如今也做社交媒体营销；公司内部的研发团队持续发布基于 Snap Spectacles、Quest 3 和 Google Geospatial API 的 AR 原型。
creators.why_zh: 它的研发短片总能把一个平台功能（环境网格、LiDAR 射线检测、城市级定位）变成一个几秒就看懂的好玩动作。

creators.name: Lusion (Edan Kwan & team)
creators.role: Real-time 3D and WebXR studio co-founded by creative technologist Edan Kwan
creators.bio: Bristol studio known for award-winning WebGL sites and R&D; co-founder Edan Kwan also made the generative piece Bilibala Holala for the KIKK 2018 AR exhibit. Its AR work ranges from browser-based WebXR product placement to the Quest mixed-reality showcase Spatial Fusion with PHORIA and Meta.
creators.why: They bring film-grade real-time rendering into AR, and show that the browser alone can host serious mixed reality.
creators.role_zh: 实时 3D 与 WebXR 工作室，由创意技术专家 Edan Kwan 联合创办
creators.bio_zh: 布里斯托的工作室，以屡获大奖的 WebGL 网站和技术研发著称；联合创始人 Edan Kwan 还为 KIKK 2018 AR 展创作了生成式作品 Bilibala Holala。他们的 AR 作品从浏览器里的 WebXR 商品摆放，到与 PHORIA 和 Meta 合作的 Quest 混合现实展示项目 Spatial Fusion。
creators.why_zh: 他们把电影级的实时渲染带进 AR，也证明了只靠浏览器就能承载像样的混合现实体验。

creators.name: Matt DesLauriers
creators.role: Generative artist and creative coder (canvas-sketch)
creators.bio: Canadian artist now in the UK who works with code and generative systems, author of the open-source canvas-sketch toolkit. Beyond prints and web works he builds public installations such as LUMOS in Toronto and TEMPEST on Reykjavik's Harpa facade, and made Quantum Spyglass for the KIKK 2018 AR exhibit.
creators.why: His installations reduce interaction to one bodily signal (warmth, a button press) and let light carry the response.
creators.role_zh: 生成艺术家、创意编程者（canvas-sketch 作者）
creators.bio_zh: 现居英国的加拿大艺术家，用代码和生成系统创作，开源工具 canvas-sketch 的作者。除了版画和网页作品，他也做公共装置，例如多伦多的 LUMOS、雷克雅未克 Harpa 音乐厅立面上的 TEMPEST，并为 KIKK 2018 AR 展创作了 Quantum Spyglass。
creators.why_zh: 他的装置把交互简化成一个身体信号（体温、按下按钮），再让光来回应。

creators.name: Jaume Sanchez Elias
creators.role: Creative technologist (WebGL, WebXR)
creators.bio: Web developer and 'pixel burner' behind clicktorelease.com and many three.js experiments and tools, now working on WebGL and WebXR interfaces at DeepMind. He made Transcendence for the KIKK 2018 AR exhibit and keeps publishing face, hand and depth experiments in the browser.
creators.why: He turns each new browser capability (face mesh, hand tracking, depth photos) into a quick, playful sketch that others can copy.
creators.role_zh: 创意技术专家（WebGL、WebXR）
creators.bio_zh: 网页开发者、自称“像素燃烧者”，clicktorelease.com 的作者，做过大量 three.js 实验和工具，现在在 DeepMind 做 WebGL 与 WebXR 界面。他为 KIKK 2018 AR 展创作了 Transcendence，并持续发布基于浏览器的人脸、手势和深度实验。
creators.why_zh: 每当浏览器多了一项能力（人脸网格、手部追踪、深度照片），他都会很快做出一个好玩又容易模仿的小实验。

creators.name: Gamgie (Clément Rignault)
creators.role: Visual artist; real-time particles for circus, dance and mapping (Oxipital)
creators.bio: French visual artist who performs and designs real-time particle visuals with the Oxipital engine (Unity and TouchDesigner), for circus companies tracked with Augmenta, museum projection pieces and a video-mapped show deep inside the Gouffre de Padirac cave.
creators.why: He treats particles as a partner that reacts to acrobats and voices, so the projected image feels alive rather than playing back.
creators.role_zh: 视觉艺术家；为马戏、舞蹈和投影映射制作实时粒子（Oxipital）
creators.bio_zh: 法国视觉艺术家，用 Oxipital 引擎（Unity 与 TouchDesigner）现场操控和设计实时粒子影像：为用 Augmenta 追踪的马戏团演出配视觉，做博物馆投影作品，还在 Padirac 地下溶洞深处完成了一场投影映射演出。
creators.why_zh: 他把粒子当作会回应杂技演员和人声的搭档，让投影画面像是活的，而不是在播放。

creators.name: Christian Brinkmann
creators.role: Audiovisual artist working with plant electrophysiology
creators.bio: Hamburg-born audiovisual artist (b. 1989) trained in audio engineering and electronic music, who now captures the electrical signals of living plants and turns them into responsive sound and light with TouchDesigner, Ableton Live and Unreal Engine.
creators.why: Floral Resonance makes an invisible conversation between a person and a plant audible and visible through touch.
creators.role_zh: 研究植物电生理的视听艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 1989 年生于汉堡的视听艺术家，学过音频工程、做过电子音乐，现在采集活体植物的微弱电信号，再用 TouchDesigner、Ableton Live 和 Unreal Engine 把它们变成会回应观众的声音与灯光。
creators.why_zh: Floral Resonance 让人与植物之间看不见的“对话”通过触摸变得可听、可见。

creators.name: Palindrome (Robert Wechsler)
creators.role: Interactive dance company led by choreographer Robert Wechsler; co-developers of EyeCon and MotionComposer
creators.bio: Founded in New York in 1982 and based in Germany since 1991, Palindrome made some of the first dance pieces in which video motion tracking, skin contact, muscle and eye signals play the music and light, mostly with engineer Frieder Weiss. Since 2012 its work has centred on MotionComposer, a camera device that turns any movement into music for people of all abilities.
creators.why: For three decades they have treated the stage as a sensing space where touch, gaze and gesture become sound, a direct ancestor of body-driven AR.
creators.role_zh: 由编舞家 Robert Wechsler 领导的互动舞蹈团；EyeCon 与 MotionComposer 的共同开发者
creators.bio_zh: Palindrome 1982 年创立于纽约，1991 年迁往德国，主要与工程师 Frieder Weiss 合作，做出了最早一批让视频动作追踪、皮肤接触、肌电和眼动信号来演奏音乐、控制灯光的舞蹈作品。2012 年起，他们的重心转向 MotionComposer——一台能把任何动作变成音乐、面向各种能力人群的摄像设备。
creators.why_zh: 三十年来，他们一直把舞台当作会感知的空间，让触碰、目光和手势变成声音，是身体驱动型 AR 的直系前辈。

creators.name: visiophone (Rodrigo Carvalho)
creators.role: Audiovisual artist and researcher; co-founder of Boris Chimp 504 and Openfield
creators.bio: Rodrigo Carvalho, working as visiophone, builds real-time systems where dancers, visitors and sound drive particles, lasers and light, from Kinect dance pieces in Barcelona and Austin to laser instruments and light installations with Openfield and the audiovisual duo Boris Chimp 504. He also made early prototypes at Motion Bank's first Choreographic Coding Lab.
creators.why: He turns the body into a live controller for visual space with small, readable systems that students can rebuild in an afternoon.
creators.role_zh: 视听艺术家与研究者；Boris Chimp 504 与 Openfield 的联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: Rodrigo Carvalho 以 visiophone 为名，打造让舞者、观众和声音实时驱动粒子、激光与灯光的系统：从巴塞罗那和奥斯汀的 Kinect 舞蹈作品，到与 Openfield 合作的激光乐器和灯光装置，再到视听二人组 Boris Chimp 504 的现场演出。他也在 Motion Bank 首届 Choreographic Coding Lab 上做过早期原型。
creators.why_zh: 他用小而清晰的系统把身体变成视觉空间的实时控制器，学生一个下午就能复刻。

creators.name: Kat Sullivan
creators.role: Creative technologist, dancer and educator working with motion capture and game engines
creators.bio: A dancer turned creative technologist, Kat Sullivan builds tools that read and transform the moving body, from a Kinect system that labels body language to live motion capture that multiplies one ballerina into a whole corps in Unreal Engine. She contributed a quality-visualising tool to the Choreographic Coding Lab and teaches 3D and mocap pipelines.
creators.why: She pairs a dancer's eye with game-engine tooling, so her pieces show what motion data can do for a performer rather than to one.
creators.role_zh: 创意技术人、舞者与教育者，擅长动作捕捉与游戏引擎
creators.bio_zh: Kat Sullivan 是从舞者转型的创意技术人，她开发读取并改造身体动作的工具：从给肢体语言贴标签的 Kinect 系统，到在 Unreal Engine 里把一位芭蕾舞者实时复制成整个群舞的动作捕捉作品。她为 Choreographic Coding Lab 贡献过动作质感可视化工具，也教授 3D 与动捕流程。
creators.why_zh: 她把舞者的眼光和游戏引擎工具结合起来，作品展示的是动作数据如何帮助表演者，而不是摆布表演者。

creators.name: OpenEndedGroup (Marc Downie, Shelley Eshkar, Paul Kaiser)
creators.role: Digital art group pioneering motion-captured drawing, 3D projection and AI-driven artworks
creators.bio: Marc Downie, Shelley Eshkar and Paul Kaiser made landmark dance-and-data works with Merce Cunningham, Bill T. Jones and Trisha Brown (Hand-drawn Spaces, Ghostcatching, Biped, Loops), then took the same hand-drawn, motion-captured figures into sidewalks, building facades, interactive 3D rooms and VR, all built with their own open-source environment Field.
creators.why: They showed early that captured human motion can live outside the screen, walking across pavements and facades as drawn light.
creators.role_zh: 开创动作捕捉手绘、3D 投影与 AI 驱动艺术的数字艺术团体
creators.bio_zh: Marc Downie、Shelley Eshkar 和 Paul Kaiser 与 Merce Cunningham、Bill T. Jones、Trisha Brown 合作，完成了 Hand-drawn Spaces、Ghostcatching、Biped、Loops 等舞蹈与数据的里程碑作品；之后又把这些手绘风格的动捕人物带到人行道、建筑立面、互动 3D 房间和 VR 里，全部用他们自己的开源环境 Field 制作。
creators.why_zh: 他们很早就证明，被捕捉下来的人体动作可以离开屏幕，化作手绘般的光影在路面和建筑外墙上行走。

creators.name: Mária Júdová
creators.role: Media artist working across dance, VR and biodata-driven performance
creators.bio: Mária Júdová makes performances and immersive works where the body drives the digital layer: light that follows a dancer's heartbeat and breath in body(input);, a drone played as an instrument, VR pieces built from motion-captured dancers such as DUST, Camouflage and the Kykeon trilogy made with tanzmainz and Motion Bank.
creators.why: She keeps VR and interactive media anchored in real, breathing bodies, often with a live audience watching both worlds at once.
creators.role_zh: 横跨舞蹈、VR 与生物数据驱动表演的媒体艺术家
creators.based_zh: 布拉迪斯拉发，斯洛伐克
creators.bio_zh: Mária Júdová 的表演和沉浸式作品都由身体驱动数字层：body(input); 里灯光追随舞者的心跳与呼吸，一架无人机被当作乐器演奏，DUST、Camouflage 以及与 tanzmainz 和 Motion Bank 合作的 Kykeon 三部曲等 VR 作品则由舞者的动捕数据构成。
creators.why_zh: 她让 VR 和互动媒体始终扎根于真实、会呼吸的身体，常常让现场观众同时看到两个世界。

creators.name: Marion Tränkle / NOW
creators.role: Light artist and scenographer; co-founder of the performance collective NOW
creators.bio: Marion Tränkle designs light and scenography for performances that turn body signals into space, working with dancer-researcher Roos van Berkel and composer Ivo Bol as NOW. Their pieces map performers' EEG to lasers ((UN)FOCUSSED), score eye blinks (BLINK), measure bouncing bodies on a trampoline and light up a former panopticon prison.
creators.why: She makes invisible body data, brainwaves, blinks, elasticity, legible as light in a room.
creators.role_zh: 灯光艺术家与舞台美术设计师；表演团体 NOW 的联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: Marion Tränkle 与舞者兼研究者 Roos van Berkel、作曲家 Ivo Bol 组成 NOW，为那些把身体信号变成空间的表演设计灯光与舞台：把表演者的脑电映射为激光（(UN)FOCUSSED），为眨眼谱曲（BLINK），测量蹦床上身体的弹性，还点亮了一座旧圆形监狱。
creators.why_zh: 她把脑电、眨眼、弹性这些看不见的身体数据，变成房间里可读的光。

creators.name: Kianí del Valle
creators.role: Choreographer and director of KDV Performance Group
creators.bio: Puerto Rican choreographer Kianí del Valle leads KDV Performance Group and works as a movement director for musicians and visual artists. With the Barcelona studio Hamill Industries and AI researchers from UPC she created Engendered Otherness, a dance ensemble in which computer vision turns her movement into a chorus of generated creatures, followed by the stage work CORTEX.
creators.why: She choreographs with the machine's eye in mind, letting AI-generated partners respond to a live dancer on stage.
creators.role_zh: 编舞家，KDV Performance Group 总监
creators.bio_zh: 波多黎各编舞家 Kianí del Valle 领导 KDV Performance Group，也为音乐人和视觉艺术家担任动作指导。她与巴塞罗那工作室 Hamill Industries 以及 UPC 的 AI 研究者合作创作了 Engendered Otherness：计算机视觉把她的动作变成一群生成出来的生物组成的“舞团”，之后又推出舞台作品 CORTEX。
creators.why_zh: 她在编舞时就考虑机器的视角，让 AI 生成的舞伴在台上回应真人舞者。

creators.name: Pablo Ventura
creators.role: Choreographer working with robots, motion tracking and algorithmic dance
creators.bio: Spanish-born choreographer Pablo Ventura ran Ventura Dance Company in Zurich, staging dancers alongside industrial robots (ZONE, with robotlab), commissioning the hanging robot Kubic from Louis-Philippe Demers, building a computer-aided Choreography Machine and using motion tracking to let dancers play sound and leave traces in space.
creators.why: He treats machines, robots and algorithms as dance partners, which makes his pieces a clear reference for embodied interaction with non-human agents.
creators.role_zh: 与机器人、动作追踪和算法舞蹈打交道的编舞家
creators.bio_zh: 生于西班牙的编舞家 Pablo Ventura 在苏黎世经营 Ventura Dance Company：让舞者与工业机器人同台（与 robotlab 合作的 ZONE），委托 Louis-Philippe Demers 制作悬吊机器人 Kubic，开发计算机辅助的 Choreography Machine，并用动作追踪让舞者演奏声音、在空间中留下痕迹。
creators.why_zh: 他把机器、机器人和算法当作舞伴，这让他的作品成为与非人类对象进行身体互动的清晰参照。

creators.name: Jeremy Hight
creators.role: Writer and locative-media pioneer
creators.bio: Jeremy Hight co-created 34 North 118 West (2002), one of the first GPS-triggered narratives, and wrote the essay on 'narrative archaeology' that framed locative storytelling. He later joined the Manifest.AR circle and staged AR interventions, including a mock battle with Mark Skwarek across Washington DC.
creators.why: He gave locative and AR art a literary theory: the city as a text you read by walking through it.
creators.role_zh: 作家，定位媒体先驱
creators.bio_zh: Jeremy Hight 参与创作了最早的 GPS 触发叙事之一 34 North 118 West（2002），并撰写了“叙事考古学”一文，为基于位置的叙事奠定了框架。后来他加入 Manifest.AR 圈子，做过多次 AR 介入，其中包括与 Mark Skwarek 在华盛顿特区上演的一场 AR 大战。
creators.why_zh: 他为定位艺术和 AR 艺术提供了文学理论：城市是一本靠步行来阅读的文本。

creators.name: Andrew Roth
creators.role: Technical lead at York University's Augmented Reality Lab
creators.bio: Andrew Roth handled Max/MSP programming and technical planning for 52 Card Psycho and other projects of Caitlin Fisher's AR Lab at York University, where marker-based AR was used for cinema, poetry and tabletop stories. On his own channel he documented lab experiments such as a tracked-cube poetry machine and an AR puzzle maker.
creators.why: His lab experiments show how early marker AR was bent toward literature and cinema rather than product demos.
creators.role_zh: 约克大学增强现实实验室技术负责人
creators.bio_zh: Andrew Roth 为 52 Card Psycho 以及 Caitlin Fisher 在约克大学的 AR 实验室的其他项目负责 Max/MSP 编程和技术规划，这个实验室把标记式 AR 用在电影、诗歌和桌面故事上。他在自己的频道记录了实验室的实验，比如一台用追踪立方体组合诗句的装置和一个 AR 拼图生成器。
creators.why_zh: 他的实验展示了早期标记式 AR 如何被引向文学和电影，而不是产品演示。

creators.name: Channel TWo (Adam Trowbridge & Jessica Westbrook)
creators.role: Artist duo making networked, critical media and locative AR
creators.bio: Adam Trowbridge and Jess Parris Westbrook work as Channel TWo (CH2), making critical media art about networks, power and identity. Their polyCopRiotNode_ placed geolocated 3D riot police in AR at sites of protest in Chicago and Washington DC, and they took part in the 2013 Bushwick AR Intervention.
creators.why: They use location-based AR to make invisible structures of power stand in the street where they operate.
creators.role_zh: 创作网络化批判媒体与定位 AR 的艺术家二人组
creators.bio_zh: Adam Trowbridge 和 Jess Parris Westbrook 以 Channel TWo（CH2）为名，创作关于网络、权力与身份的批判性媒体艺术。他们的 polyCopRiotNode_ 在芝加哥和华盛顿特区的抗议地点用 AR 放置了带地理定位的 3D 防暴警察，他们也参加了 2013 年的 Bushwick AR Intervention。
creators.why_zh: 他们用基于位置的 AR，让看不见的权力结构站在它们发生作用的街头。

creators.name: Joseph DeLappe
creators.role: Media artist known for protest performances inside online games and virtual worlds
creators.bio: Joseph DeLappe, long a professor at the University of Nevada, Reno and now at Abertay University, stages interventions in shared virtual spaces: typing the names of US soldiers killed in Iraq into the recruiting game America's Army, and walking Gandhi's 240-mile Salt March on a treadmill that drove his avatar through Second Life. His work also includes drawing machines and large-scale landscape performances.
creators.why: He shows how a body in a real room can act inside a shared virtual world, and how that world can be used for protest and memory.
creators.role_zh: 以在网络游戏和虚拟世界中进行抗议表演著称的媒体艺术家
creators.bio_zh: Joseph DeLappe 曾长期任教于内华达大学里诺分校，现任教于 Abertay University。他在共享的虚拟空间里做介入：在征兵游戏 America's Army 里逐个打出在伊拉克阵亡美军士兵的名字；在跑步机上走完甘地 240 英里的食盐进军，步伐驱动他的化身穿越 Second Life。他的作品还包括绘画机器和大尺度的地景表演。
creators.why_zh: 他展示了真实房间里的身体如何在共享虚拟世界中行动，以及这个世界如何被用于抗议和纪念。

creators.name: Marco Tempest
creators.role: Illusionist and techno-magician; MIT Media Lab Director's Fellow
creators.bio: Swiss-born magician who has combined illusion with augmented reality, projection tracking and robotics since the late 2000s, building his early AR card tricks and projection routines with Zach Lieberman in openFrameworks.
creators.why: He uses AR as a stage-magic tool, so the audience experiences virtual objects as tricks rather than as technology.
creators.role_zh: 魔术师、科技魔术师；MIT Media Lab 主任研究员
creators.bio_zh: 出生于瑞士的魔术师，从 2000 年代末起把魔术与增强现实、投影追踪和机器人结合；早期的 AR 纸牌魔术和投影表演是与 Zach Lieberman 一起用 openFrameworks 开发的。
creators.why_zh: 他把 AR 当作舞台魔术的道具，让观众把虚拟物体当成魔术本身来体验，而不是当成技术。

creators.name: Seb Lee-Delisle
creators.role: Digital artist; creator of large-scale interactive light and laser installations
creators.bio: British artist and coder whose public installations let crowds launch projected fireworks, play laser games and make music with lasers; PixelPyros and his early pieces were built in openFrameworks.
creators.why: He turns whole façades and city skylines into playable light, with interactions simple enough for thirty strangers at once.
creators.role_zh: 数字艺术家；大型互动灯光与激光装置创作者
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家兼程序员，他的公共装置让人群发射投影烟花、玩激光游戏、用激光演奏音乐；PixelPyros 等早期作品用 openFrameworks 制作。
creators.why_zh: 他把整面建筑和城市天际线变成可以玩的光，交互简单到三十个陌生人可以同时上手。

creators.name: Dpt.
creators.role: Montreal interactive studio for installations, AR and mixed-reality experiences
creators.bio: Montreal creative studio that started with openFrameworks projection-mapping experiments and now makes interactive installations, AR journeys and generative-AI prototypes for museums, festivals and brands.
creators.why: Their work keeps finding poetic physical triggers for digital behaviour: a swinging lamp, a magnifying glass, a crowd's phones.
creators.role_zh: 蒙特利尔互动工作室，做装置、AR 和混合现实体验
creators.bio_zh: 蒙特利尔创意工作室，从 openFrameworks 投影映射实验起步，如今为博物馆、艺术节和品牌制作互动装置、AR 路线和生成式 AI 原型。
creators.why_zh: 他们总能为数字行为找到有诗意的实体触发物：一盏摇晃的灯、一把放大镜、观众手里的手机。

creators.name: Kuflex (Igor Tatarnikov & Denis Perevalov)
creators.role: Interactive media-art lab for projection rooms and body-tracking installations
creators.bio: Lab of artist Igor Tatarnikov and programmer Denis Perevalov (author of books on openFrameworks) that builds depth-camera projection rooms, body-projection pieces and interactive walls, with tracking and rendering in openFrameworks.
creators.why: They make whole rooms react to the body, turning visitors into particles, mirrors and projected creatures.
creators.role_zh: 互动媒体艺术实验室，做投影空间和身体追踪装置
creators.bio_zh: 由艺术家 Igor Tatarnikov 和程序员 Denis Perevalov（多本 openFrameworks 书籍的作者）组成的实验室，用深度相机做投影房间、身体投影和互动墙，追踪与渲染都基于 openFrameworks。
creators.why_zh: 他们让整个房间对身体作出反应，把观众变成粒子、镜像和投影生物。
creators.based_zh: 柏林，德国（创立于莫斯科）

creators.name: Michael Flückiger
creators.role: Interaction designer and creative coder; lecturer at Bern University of the Arts
creators.bio: Swiss interaction designer who builds playful hacks and installations with openFrameworks, from a bicycle that casts an animal shadow to a game where one player remote-controls another.
creators.why: He gets striking AR-like effects out of the cheapest means: a projector, a speedometer and a shadow.
creators.role_zh: 交互设计师、创意编程者；伯尔尼艺术大学讲师
creators.bio_zh: 瑞士交互设计师，用 openFrameworks 做好玩的改装和装置，从会投出动物影子的自行车，到一个玩家遥控另一个玩家的游戏。
creators.why_zh: 他用最便宜的手段做出类似 AR 的惊艳效果：一台投影仪、一个码表和一道影子。

creators.name: Peter Uithoven
creators.role: Interaction designer; co-founder of Doodle3D
creators.bio: Dutch interaction designer who, as a student at HKU, made the shadow-boxing game ShadowFighter with openFrameworks, and later co-founded Doodle3D with Rick Companje.
creators.why: ShadowFighter proves that a real shadow plus a projected layer of feedback is already a full mixed-reality game.
creators.role_zh: 交互设计师；Doodle3D 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰交互设计师，在 HKU 读书时用 openFrameworks 做了影子格斗游戏 ShadowFighter，后来与 Rick Companje 共同创立 Doodle3D。
creators.why_zh: ShadowFighter 证明：真实的影子加一层投影反馈，本身就是一个完整的混合现实游戏。

creators.name: Teehan+Lax Labs
creators.role: R&D lab of the Toronto design agency Teehan+Lax
creators.bio: The experimental arm of the digital agency Teehan+Lax (2010-2014), which published short openFrameworks and hardware prototypes about new interfaces, from touching distant screens through a phone to physical ASCII art.
creators.why: Their Touch Vision Interface was an early, clear demonstration of using a phone camera view as a remote control for real surfaces.
creators.role_zh: 多伦多设计公司 Teehan+Lax 的研发实验室
creators.bio_zh: 数字设计公司 Teehan+Lax 的实验部门（2010–2014），发布过一系列用 openFrameworks 和硬件做的界面原型，从隔着手机触摸远处屏幕到实体 ASCII 艺术。
creators.why_zh: 他们的 Touch Vision Interface 很早就清楚展示了：可以把手机取景画面当作遥控真实表面的界面。

creators.name: Beam'Art (Benjamin Petit & Antoine Vanel)
creators.role: French visual-performance duo for interactive projection mapping
creators.bio: Duo of Benjamin Petit and Antoine Vanel who built their own openFrameworks and OpenNI tools for depth-camera projection: augmented dance floors on building façades and real-time mapping onto moving dancers.
creators.why: They were among the first to project live, body-tracked visuals back onto dancers and crowds with a Kinect.
creators.role_zh: 法国视觉表演二人组，做互动投影映射
creators.bio_zh: Benjamin Petit 和 Antoine Vanel 组成的二人组，用 openFrameworks 和 OpenNI 自研深度相机投影工具：把“增强舞池”投到建筑立面上，并实时把画面映射到移动的舞者身上。
creators.why_zh: 他们是最早用 Kinect 把实时追踪身体的影像投回舞者和人群身上的团队之一。

creators.name: Gene Kogan
creators.role: Artist and programmer; creator of ml4a and the Kinect Projector Toolkit
creators.based: New York, US and Berlin, Germany
creators.bio: Artist and educator working with machine learning and interactive projection; his openFrameworks Kinect Projector Toolkit aligns a projector with a depth camera, and his ml4a project teaches machine learning to artists.
creators.why: He opened body-aligned projection to many artists with a free toolkit, then turned neural style transfer into a live mirror.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、程序员；ml4a 和 Kinect Projector Toolkit 的作者
creators.bio_zh: 从事机器学习与互动投影的艺术家和教育者；他的 openFrameworks 工具 Kinect Projector Toolkit 能把投影仪和深度相机对齐，ml4a 项目则面向艺术家教授机器学习。
creators.why_zh: 他用一个免费工具包让许多艺术家能做贴合身体的投影，又把神经风格迁移变成一面实时镜子。

creators.name: Jayson Haebich
creators.role: Light and laser artist
creators.bio: Artist who writes his own openFrameworks laser software to draw beams through haze and make them respond to people tracked by a depth camera.
creators.why: He treats laser beams as touchable objects in mid-air, a physical cousin of holographic AR interfaces.
creators.role_zh: 光与激光艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 自己用 openFrameworks 编写激光控制软件的艺术家，让光束穿过烟雾显形，并对深度相机追踪到的人作出反应。
creators.why_zh: 他把激光束当成空中可以触摸的物体，是全息 AR 界面在物理世界里的近亲。
creators.based_zh: 墨尔本，澳大利亚；柏林，德国

creators.name: Local Projects
creators.role: Experience design studio for museums and public spaces (founded by Jake Barton)
creators.bio: New York studio behind media installations for the 9/11 Memorial Museum, Cooper Hewitt and the Cleveland Museum of Art's Gallery One, many built with openFrameworks.
creators.why: Their Gallery One pieces made visitors use their own bodies to look closely at art.
creators.role_zh: 面向博物馆和公共空间的体验设计工作室（Jake Barton 创立）
creators.bio_zh: 纽约工作室，为 9/11 纪念博物馆、Cooper Hewitt 和克利夫兰艺术博物馆 Gallery One 等做媒体装置，其中许多用 openFrameworks 制作。
creators.why_zh: 他们在 Gallery One 的作品让观众用自己的身体去仔细观察艺术品。

creators.name: Rick Companje
creators.role: Creative technologist; creator of Globe4D and co-founder of Doodle3D
creators.bio: Dutch creative technologist who co-created Globe4D, a physical globe you turn by hand while projected data and time layers move with it, and later co-founded Doodle3D.
creators.why: Globe4D makes a projected sphere into a tangible interface where turning the object is the whole interaction.
creators.role_zh: 创意技术专家；Globe4D 作者、Doodle3D 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰创意技术专家，共同开发了 Globe4D：一个用手转动的实体地球仪，投影的数据和时间层随之转动；后来共同创立 Doodle3D。
creators.why_zh: Globe4D 把投影球体变成实体界面，转动物体本身就是全部交互。

creators.name: Red Paper Heart
creators.role: Brooklyn art and technology studio for interactive installations
creators.bio: Brooklyn studio that makes interactive installations with sensors, projection and light, often using openFrameworks, for museums and brands.
creators.why: They hide digital behaviour inside familiar domestic things: wallpaper, a pendant lamp, stained glass.
creators.role_zh: 布鲁克林艺术与技术工作室，做互动装置
creators.bio_zh: 布鲁克林工作室，用传感器、投影和灯光为博物馆和品牌做互动装置，常用 openFrameworks。
creators.why_zh: 他们把数字行为藏进熟悉的家居物件里：墙纸、吊灯、彩色玻璃窗。

creators.name: Neil Mendoza
creators.role: Artist making robotic and interactive sculptures from everyday objects
creators.bio: Artist and openFrameworks developer who began with AR and big-screen pieces in Bristol (The Sancho Plan) and now builds humorous machines that watch, avoid or talk back to their viewers.
creators.why: His objects look back at you: screens that stare, a mirror that refuses your gaze.
creators.role_zh: 用日常物品做机械与互动雕塑的艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家兼 openFrameworks 开发者，早年在布里斯托参与 The Sancho Plan 的 AR 和大屏作品，如今做会注视、躲避或回应观众的幽默机器。
creators.why_zh: 他的物件会反过来看你：盯着你的屏幕、拒绝你目光的镜子。
creators.based_zh: 洛杉矶，美国（曾在英国布里斯托）

creators.name: Luxloop
creators.role: New York creative technology studio
creators.bio: New York studio that builds interactive installations and location-based audio experiences; its projection piece If The Walls Had Eyes was shown at Refest 2014.
creators.why: If The Walls Had Eyes turns online surveillance into a wall of eyes that physically follow you.
creators.role_zh: 纽约创意技术工作室
creators.bio_zh: 纽约工作室，做互动装置和基于位置的音频体验；投影作品 If The Walls Had Eyes 曾在 Refest 2014 展出。
creators.why_zh: If The Walls Had Eyes 把网络监视变成一面真的会跟着你转的眼睛墙。

creators.name: Keita Higuchi
creators.role: HCI researcher; Lead Research Scientist at SB Intuitions (PhD from Rekimoto Lab, University of Tokyo)
creators.bio: Did his PhD in Jun Rekimoto's lab at the University of Tokyo, where he built drone telepresence such as Flying Head, interned twice at Microsoft Research on the ImmerseBoard telepresence whiteboard, and later worked on egocentric video, accessibility and HCI for machine learning.
creators.why: His early projects treat the body as the controller of a remote or virtual self: your head steers a drone, your arm stretches across a room, a remote partner writes beside you on the same board.
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者；SB Intuitions 首席研究科学家（博士毕业于东京大学历本研究室）
creators.bio_zh: 在东京大学历本纯一研究室攻读博士期间做出了 Flying Head 等无人机远程临场项目，两次在微软研究院实习并参与 ImmerseBoard 远程协作白板，之后转向第一人称视频、无障碍技术和面向机器学习的人机交互研究。
creators.why_zh: 他早期的作品把身体当作远方或虚拟自我的控制器：用头去操纵无人机，让手臂伸过整个房间，让远方的伙伴站在你身边同一块白板上写字。

creators.name: Shohei Mori
creators.role: Mixed-reality researcher working on diminished reality and pseudo-weight illusions
creators.bio: Trained in Japan at Ritsumeikan and Keio universities and later a researcher at TU Graz, he builds diminished-reality systems that erase or see through real objects, and with Ritsumeikan's Reality Media lab studies how visually editing an object changes how heavy it feels.
creators.why: He treats AR as a way to edit physical sensation: stretch a stick or extend a phone screen in AR and the very same object feels lighter or heavier.
creators.role_zh: 混合现实研究者，研究削弱现实（diminished reality）与伪重量错觉
creators.bio_zh: 先后在日本立命馆大学和庆应义塾大学学习研究，后在格拉茨工业大学任研究员；他开发能抹除或透视真实物体的削弱现实系统，并与立命馆大学 Reality Media 实验室一起研究：在视觉上改变一个物体，会怎样改变它拿在手里的重量感。
creators.why_zh: 他把 AR 当作编辑身体感受的工具：在 AR 里把木棍加长、把手机屏幕延伸出去，同一个物体摸起来就变轻或变重了。

creators.name: Damien Rompapas
creators.role: XR researcher and game developer; founder of BEER Labs
creators.bio: Did his PhD at NAIST with Christian Sandor and Hirokazu Kato, where he led the large-scale AR game HoloRoyale and co-created AR Yōkai, then built the open-source Project Esky software for DIY headsets and founded BEER Labs to make XR games and research prototypes.
creators.why: He mixes game design with perception research, and his lab demos turn the user's own hand into a tool: a ruler that copies itself, or a brush that paints holograms.
creators.role_zh: XR 研究者与游戏开发者；BEER Labs 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 在奈良先端科学技术大学院大学跟随 Christian Sandor 和加藤博一攻读博士，主导了大型 AR 游戏 HoloRoyale 并参与创作 AR Yōkai；之后为 DIY 头显开发了开源的 Project Esky 软件框架，并创办 BEER Labs，制作 XR 游戏和研究原型。
creators.why_zh: 他把游戏设计与感知研究结合起来，实验室的演示常常把用户自己的手变成工具：一把会自我复制的尺子，或一支给全息物体上色的画笔。

creators.name: Yujie Tao
creators.role: HCI researcher at Stanford SHAPE Lab (previously UChicago Human Computer Integration Lab)
creators.bio: A PhD researcher in Sean Follmer's SHAPE Lab at Stanford working on audio augmented reality such as Audio Personas, after research with Pedro Lopes at the University of Chicago on haptic illusions and mixed reality.
creators.why: Her projects augment perception with sound, touch and even wind instead of graphics, and turn real-world interruptions into part of a virtual story.
creators.role_zh: 斯坦福 SHAPE 实验室人机交互研究者（此前在芝加哥大学人机融合实验室）
creators.bio_zh: 在斯坦福大学 Sean Follmer 的 SHAPE 实验室攻读博士，研究 Audio Personas 等音频增强现实；此前在芝加哥大学跟随 Pedro Lopes 研究触觉错觉与混合现实。
creators.why_zh: 她的作品不靠画面，而用声音、触感甚至风来增强感知，还把现实中的干扰变成虚拟故事的一部分。

creators.name: Raymond Lo
creators.role: Computer-vision engineer; co-founder and former CTO of Meta (Spaceglasses); student of Steve Mann
creators.bio: Studied with Steve Mann at the University of Toronto, where he built EyeTap prototypes and GPU-based HDR vision for welding glasses, co-founded the AR headset company Meta in 2012, and later worked on AI computer vision, including OpenVINO at Intel.
creators.why: His 2013 EyeTap X videos show bare-hand interaction and depth-based 'see in the dark' vision through a see-through wearable running on a phone processor, years before consumer headsets.
creators.role_zh: 计算机视觉工程师；Meta（Spaceglasses）联合创始人兼前 CTO；Steve Mann 的学生
creators.bio_zh: 在多伦多大学师从 Steve Mann，制作了 EyeTap 原型和基于 GPU 的焊接眼镜 HDR 视觉系统；2012 年联合创办 AR 头显公司 Meta，之后从事 AI 计算机视觉工作，包括在英特尔参与 OpenVINO。
creators.why_zh: 他 2013 年的 EyeTap X 视频展示了徒手交互和基于深度的“黑暗中看见”视觉，全部跑在手机处理器驱动的透视可穿戴设备上，比消费级头显早了好几年。

creators.name: Meta Company (Meron Gribetz)
creators.role: AR headset startup behind the Meta 1 and Meta 2 (2012–2019)
creators.bio: Founded by Meron Gribetz in 2012 with Steve Mann as chief scientist, Meta made the Meta 1 and Meta 2 see-through headsets with depth sensing for bare-hand interaction and promoted 'neuroscience-inspired' interfaces where you reach out and touch holograms. The company closed in 2019 and is unrelated to Facebook's later rename to Meta.
creators.why: Meta pushed the idea that AR interfaces should be touched directly with the hands like physical objects, and staged early shared-AR art such as its two-person brain journey at Sundance.
creators.role_zh: AR 头显创业公司，推出 Meta 1 和 Meta 2（2012–2019）
creators.bio_zh: 由 Meron Gribetz 于 2012 年创立，Steve Mann 任首席科学家；Meta 推出了带深度传感、支持徒手交互的 Meta 1 和 Meta 2 透视头显，倡导“受神经科学启发”的界面，让人伸手直接触碰全息物体。公司于 2019 年关闭，与后来改名为 Meta 的 Facebook 无关。
creators.why_zh: Meta 坚持 AR 界面应该像实物一样用手直接触碰，还在圣丹斯电影节推出了双人共享的大脑之旅等早期共享 AR 艺术作品。

creators.name: Mustafa Doga Dogan
creators.role: HCI researcher; Research Scientist at Adobe Research (PhD from MIT CSAIL)
creators.bio: Did his PhD in Stefanie Mueller's HCI Engineering Group at MIT CSAIL on invisible tags and fabrication-aware interfaces, worked with Google on XR-Objects, was a visiting postdoc at the University of Tokyo, and is now a research scientist at Adobe Research in Basel.
creators.why: He makes everyday objects and paper machine-readable for AR by hiding markers inside them, so the physical thing itself carries its digital layer.
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者；Adobe Research 研究科学家（博士毕业于 MIT CSAIL）
creators.bio_zh: 在 MIT CSAIL 的 Stefanie Mueller 人机交互工程组攻读博士，研究隐形标签和面向制造的交互界面；曾与谷歌合作完成 XR-Objects，在东京大学做过访问博士后，现为 Adobe Research 巴塞尔的研究科学家。
creators.why_zh: 他把标记藏进日常物品和纸张里，让它们能被 AR 读取，使实物本身就携带着自己的数字层。

creators.name: Christian Holz
creators.role: Associate professor at ETH Zurich (Sensing, Interaction & Perception Lab); formerly Microsoft Research
creators.bio: Did his PhD with Patrick Baudisch at the Hasso Plattner Institute, spent years as a researcher at Microsoft Research Redmond working on VR haptics and mixed reality with Eyal Ofek, Andy Wilson and Mar Gonzalez-Franco, and now leads SIPLAB at ETH Zurich.
creators.why: His projects keep asking what happens when the real and the virtual share cause and effect: a ball that exists only in the players' heads, a room whose events you can replay later, a machine that works without its key part.
creators.role_zh: 苏黎世联邦理工学院副教授（感知、交互与知觉实验室 SIPLAB）；曾任职微软研究院
creators.bio_zh: 在哈索·普拉特纳研究院跟随 Patrick Baudisch 攻读博士，之后多年在微软雷德蒙德研究院与 Eyal Ofek、Andy Wilson、Mar Gonzalez-Franco 等人研究 VR 触觉与混合现实，现领导苏黎世联邦理工学院的 SIPLAB。
creators.why_zh: 他的作品不断追问：当真实与虚拟共享因果关系时会发生什么——一颗只存在于球员脑中的球，一个可以稍后回放事件的房间，一台缺了关键部件却照样运转的机器。

creators.name: Jens Grubert
creators.role: Professor of human-computer interaction at Coburg University; mixed-reality researcher
creators.bio: Did his PhD at TU Graz on mobile augmented reality in public spaces, then became a professor at Coburg University, where he researches interaction across multiple displays and mixed reality for mobile knowledge work, often with Eyal Ofek.
creators.why: He designs interfaces that spread across several screens at once — glasses, phone, watch, a public poster — and asks how each one should hand information to the next.
creators.role_zh: 科堡应用科学大学人机交互教授；混合现实研究者
creators.bio_zh: 在格拉茨工业大学攻读博士，研究公共空间中的移动增强现实；之后在科堡应用科学大学任教授，研究跨多块显示屏的交互以及面向移动知识工作的混合现实，常与 Eyal Ofek 合作。
creators.why_zh: 他设计同时分布在多块屏幕上的界面——眼镜、手机、手表、公共海报——并研究每一块屏幕该如何把信息交给下一块。

creators.name: MSQRD (Masquerade Technologies)
creators.role: Face-filter app studio (2015–2016), acquired by Facebook
creators.bio: Masquerade Technologies, founded by Eugene Nevgen, Sergey Gonchar and Andrew Yanchurevich, launched the MSQRD selfie app in late 2015; its live face masks and face swaps went viral, and Facebook bought the company in March 2016 and folded the technology into its camera effects. The founders later started Loóna.
creators.why: MSQRD made live face-tracked masks a mass pastime just before Snapchat Lenses and Instagram filters took over, showing that AR on your own face is the most widely shared form of AR.
creators.role_zh: 人脸滤镜应用工作室（2015–2016），后被 Facebook 收购
creators.bio_zh: Masquerade Technologies 由 Eugene Nevgen、Sergey Gonchar 和 Andrew Yanchurevich 创立，2015 年底推出自拍应用 MSQRD；它的实时人脸面具和换脸效果迅速走红，Facebook 于 2016 年 3 月收购了这家公司，并把技术并入自家的相机特效。几位创始人后来创办了 Loóna。
creators.why_zh: 就在 Snapchat Lens 和 Instagram 滤镜普及之前，MSQRD 让实时追踪人脸的面具成了大众娱乐，证明了戴在自己脸上的 AR 是传播最广的 AR 形式。

creators.name: Lab212 (Béatrice Lartigue, Nicolas Guichard et al.)
creators.role: Art and design collective (interactive installations)
creators.bio: Paris collective founded in 2007 by Gobelins graduates including Béatrice Lartigue, Nicolas Guichard, Cyril Diagne, Juliette Champain, Pierre Thirion and Tobias Muthesius. Its installations turn swings, pebbles, post-it notes, strings of light and whole forests into interfaces, and have been shown at MuDA Zurich, Signal Film & Media, KADOC Leuven and Kunstsilo.
creators.why: Lab212 treats the body and simple everyday objects as the controller, so each piece is one clear gesture that changes a whole space.
creators.role_zh: 艺术与设计团体（互动装置）
creators.bio_zh: 2007 年由 Gobelins 毕业生在巴黎创立，成员包括 Béatrice Lartigue、Nicolas Guichard、Cyril Diagne、Juliette Champain、Pierre Thirion 和 Tobias Muthesius。他们的装置把秋千、鹅卵石、便利贴、发光的线乃至整片树林变成交互界面，曾在苏黎世 MuDA、Signal Film & Media、鲁汶 KADOC 和 Kunstsilo 等地展出。
creators.why_zh: Lab212 把身体和日常小物件当作控制器，每件作品都只靠一个清楚的动作，就能改变整个空间。

creators.name: Benjamin Kuperberg
creators.role: Creative technologist and tool maker (Chataigne, BenTo, NecTouch)
creators.bio: French creative technologist who wrote NecTouch, the Kinect multitouch layer behind Adrien M & Claire B's XYZT floor, and later the open-source show-control tools Chataigne and Blux. With the BenTo collective he builds interactive projection, LED juggling props, drone swarms and circus visuals.
creators.why: His experiments show how cheap sensors, props and projectors can be wired together so that a performer's movement drives light, image and even drones live.
creators.role_zh: 创意技术专家、工具开发者（Chataigne、BenTo、NecTouch）
creators.bio_zh: 法国创意技术专家，编写了 NecTouch——Adrien M & Claire B 的 XYZT 互动地面背后的 Kinect 多点触控层，之后又开发了开源演出控制软件 Chataigne 和 Blux。他与 BenTo 团队一起制作互动投影、LED 杂耍道具、无人机群和马戏视觉。
creators.why_zh: 他的实验展示了如何把廉价的传感器、道具和投影仪连在一起，让表演者的动作实时驱动灯光、影像，甚至无人机。

creators.name: Schnelle Bunte Bilder (with kling klang klong)
creators.role: Media art and design studio (interactive rooms and projections)
creators.bio: Berlin studio whose team includes Sebastian Huber, Johannes Timpernagel and Robert Pohle, often working with the sound studio kling klang klong. They build body-reactive rooms, floor projections and museum installations in vvvv, from the dance exhibits of the Deutsches Hygiene-Museum to swarms of projected fish.
creators.why: Their rooms make movement visible and audible at once, turning museum visitors into dancers without instructions.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术与设计工作室（互动空间与投影）
creators.bio_zh: 柏林工作室，团队成员包括 Sebastian Huber、Johannes Timpernagel 和 Robert Pohle，常与声音工作室 kling klang klong 合作。他们用 vvvv 制作对身体做出反应的空间、地面投影和博物馆装置，从德累斯顿德国卫生博物馆的舞蹈展项到投影出来的鱼群都有。
creators.why_zh: 他们的空间让动作同时变得可见、可听，不需要任何说明，就能让博物馆观众跳起舞来。

creators.name: onformative (Cedric Kiefer & Julia Laub)
creators.role: Studio for digital art and design
creators.bio: Berlin studio founded by Cedric Kiefer and Julia Laub; Laub co-authored the book Generative Gestaltung. Its generative and interactive installations range from perception experiments and responsive sculptures to augmented stage magic and choreography tools such as Pathfinder.
creators.why: onformative shows how generative code can make an object feel alive: screens that dissolve as you approach, orbs that listen and react, magic tricks that grow virtual graphics.
creators.role_zh: 数字艺术与设计工作室
creators.bio_zh: 柏林工作室，由 Cedric Kiefer 和 Julia Laub 创立，Laub 也是《Generative Gestaltung》一书的合著者之一。他们的生成式互动装置涵盖感知实验、会回应的雕塑、增强现实舞台魔术，以及 Pathfinder 这样的编舞工具。
creators.why_zh: onformative 展示了生成式代码如何让物体显得有生命：靠近就会瓦解的屏幕、会聆听并回应的光球、能长出虚拟图形的魔术。

creators.name: Tin & Ed (Tin Nguyen & Edward Cutting)
creators.role: Artist duo (AR, installation, interactive media)
creators.bio: Australian duo Tin Nguyen and Edward Cutting, now based in New York and alumni of the New Museum's NEW INC. Their AR apps, inflatable sculptures and body-tracked screens imagine hybrid life forms and deep time, shown at MoMA, the Getty, the Barbican and ArtScience Museum.
creators.why: They use AR as a lens on the living world: a phone reveals imagined plants in a museum garden, and furniture sprouts playful forms.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家组合（AR、装置、互动媒体）
creators.bio_zh: Tin Nguyen 与 Edward Cutting，来自澳大利亚、现居纽约的艺术家组合，New Museum 旗下孵化器 NEW INC 的成员。他们用 AR 应用、充气雕塑和带身体追踪的屏幕，想象杂交的生命形态和地质般漫长的时间，作品曾在 MoMA、Getty、Barbican 和新加坡艺术科学博物馆展出。
creators.why_zh: 他们把 AR 当作观察生命世界的透镜：手机让博物馆花园里出现想象中的植物，也让家具上长出好玩的形状。

creators.name: Yuri Suzuki
creators.role: Sound artist and designer; Pentagram partner from 2018
creators.bio: Japanese sound artist and designer based in London, who joined Pentagram as a partner in 2018. His horn sculptures, AI choirs and playful instruments invite the public to speak, sing and listen in shared space, and he made Sound Bubbles for SPACE10's Everyday Experiments.
creators.why: He treats sound as a material you can place, carry and share in public space, often with nothing more than horns, paper or a phone camera.
creators.role_zh: 声音艺术家、设计师；2018 年起任 Pentagram 合伙人
creators.bio_zh: 常驻伦敦的日本声音艺术家和设计师，2018 年成为 Pentagram 合伙人。他的号角雕塑、AI 合唱装置和好玩的乐器邀请公众在共享空间里说话、歌唱和聆听；他也为 SPACE10 的 Everyday Experiments 做了 Sound Bubbles。
creators.why_zh: 他把声音当作一种可以摆放、传递和分享的材料，常常只用号角、纸片或一部手机的摄像头。

creators.name: Random Studio
creators.role: Experience design studio
creators.bio: Amsterdam studio founded by Daan Lucas that builds interactive installations, spatial scenography and retail experiences for cultural institutions and brands. It also made Hidden Characters and Point & Repair for SPACE10's Everyday Experiments and runs an innovation studio for self-initiated prototypes.
creators.why: Their best pieces reduce interaction to one physical act, such as bouncing a ball or striking a pose, and let the whole room answer.
creators.role_zh: 体验设计工作室
creators.bio_zh: 由 Daan Lucas 创立的阿姆斯特丹工作室，为文化机构和品牌制作互动装置、空间场景和零售体验。他们也为 SPACE10 的 Everyday Experiments 做了 Hidden Characters 和 Point & Repair，并设有做自发原型的创新工作室。
creators.why_zh: 他们最好的作品把交互简化成一个身体动作，比如拍一下球、摆一个姿势，然后让整个空间来回应。

creators.name: USC World Building Media Lab (Alex McDowell, Bradley Newman et al.)
creators.role: Research lab for world building and immersive storytelling
creators.bio: Lab at the USC School of Cinematic Arts led by production designer Alex McDowell (Minority Report). With Intel Labs, including Ronald Azuma's team, it built the Leviathan Project: AR and VR experiments set in Scott Westerfeld's steampunk world, shown at CES 2014 and Sundance New Frontier 2016.
creators.why: Leviathan was an early large-scale demonstration of AR as shared spectacle, flying a virtual whale over a live audience of thousands.
creators.role_zh: 世界构建与沉浸式叙事研究实验室
creators.bio_zh: 南加州大学电影艺术学院的实验室，由《少数派报告》的美术设计师 Alex McDowell 领导。它与 Intel Labs（包括 Ronald Azuma 的团队）合作开发了 Leviathan Project：以 Scott Westerfeld 的蒸汽朋克小说世界为背景的 AR 与 VR 实验，曾在 CES 2014 和 2016 年 Sundance New Frontier 展出。
creators.why_zh: Leviathan 是较早的大规模 AR 公共演示之一：让一头虚拟鲸鱼飞过数千名现场观众的头顶。

creators.name: Seeing the Invisible (Jerusalem Botanical Garden & Outset Contemporary Art Fund)
creators.role: Touring AR contemporary art exhibition in botanical gardens
creators.bio: Exhibition initiated by the Jerusalem Botanical Garden and Outset Contemporary Art Fund, curated by Hadas Maor and Tal Michael Haring, which opened in 2021 in about a dozen botanical gardens around the world at the same time. Thirteen artists, including Ai Weiwei, El Anatsui, Refik Anadol, Daito Manabe, Isaac Julien and Jakob Kudsk Steensen, made site-specific AR works viewed through one app.
creators.why: It shows how one AR exhibition can be staged in many gardens at once, so the same artworks meet different plants, weather and light in each place.
creators.role_zh: 在植物园巡展的 AR 当代艺术展
creators.based_zh: 耶路撒冷，以色列（全球多地）
creators.bio_zh: 由耶路撒冷植物园和 Outset Contemporary Art Fund 发起、Hadas Maor 与 Tal Michael Haring 策展的展览，2021 年在全球约十二座植物园同时开幕。Ai Weiwei、El Anatsui、Refik Anadol、Daito Manabe、Isaac Julien、Jakob Kudsk Steensen 等十三位艺术家创作了因地制宜的 AR 作品，观众用同一个应用观看。
creators.why_zh: 它展示了一场 AR 展览如何同时在多座花园里上演：同样的作品在每个地方遇到不同的植物、天气和光线。

creators.name: Jorge Guevara
creators.role: Dancer, choreographer and researcher of dance in VR
creators.bio: Dancer and choreographer who has spent years improvising with Naoto Hieda in the live-coded Best Practices in Contemporary Dance series. As a fellow of the Akademie für Theater und Digitalität in Dortmund and a researcher at Motion Bank, he studies how an audience can still feel a dancing body when the dance is mediated by VR headsets.
creators.why: He treats the headset as a stage problem, asking how presence and empathy between dancer and audience survive the jump into virtual space.
creators.role_zh: 舞者、编舞，研究 VR 中的舞蹈
creators.bio_zh: 舞者兼编舞，多年来与 Naoto Hieda 合作即兴系列 Best Practices in Contemporary Dance：他跳舞，对方现场编程。他曾在多特蒙德的 Akademie für Theater und Digitalität 担任研究员，也在 Motion Bank 做研究，关注的问题是：当舞蹈要透过 VR 头显观看时，观众还能否感受到舞者的身体。
creators.why_zh: 他把头显当作剧场问题来研究：舞者与观众之间的在场感和共情，怎样才能跟着进入虚拟空间。

creators.name: Aphra Shemza
creators.role: Interactive light artist
creators.bio: British artist who makes interactive light sculptures, often from recycled plastic and old light fittings, that respond to how close visitors stand or how much noise they make. Much of her work reinterprets the geometric abstraction of her grandfather, the painter Anwar Jalal Shemza, and she co-created the installation Post Truth and Beauty with Tim Murray-Browne.
creators.why: Her sculptures make the viewer's position and voice the switch, so walking closer or talking becomes the way you read the work.
creators.role_zh: 互动灯光艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家，创作互动灯光雕塑，常用回收塑料和旧灯具制作，作品会根据观众站得多近、发出多大声音而变化。她的许多作品重新诠释了祖父、画家 Anwar Jalal Shemza 的几何抽象，并与 Tim Murray-Browne 合作了装置 Post Truth and Beauty。
creators.why_zh: 她让观众的位置和声音成为开关：走近一步或开口说话，就是读懂作品的方式。

creators.name: Lily Hassioti
creators.role: Sound and installation artist
creators.bio: Greek artist trained in computational arts at Goldsmiths who builds responsive sound installations out of plants, motors, metal sheets and thermal cameras. With Samuele Albani she made Passaggi // Presenze, where people passing through doors and moving through a room compose the sound together.
creators.why: She turns everyday presence, a touch on a leaf, a step into a room, body heat, into sound that visibly depends on you.
creators.role_zh: 声音与装置艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 希腊艺术家，在 Goldsmiths 学习计算艺术，用植物、电机、金属板和热成像摄像头搭建会回应人的声音装置。她与 Samuele Albani 合作了 Passaggi // Presenze：人们穿过门、在房间里走动，一起谱出声音。
creators.why_zh: 她把日常的在场——触碰一片叶子、走进房间、身体的热量——变成明显取决于你的声音。

creators.name: Simon East (Curvor / Flowfal)
creators.role: Mobile interaction designer; creator of the Flowfal motion-to-music system
creators.bio: Co-founder of the Leeds-area mobile studio Curvor, where he develops Flowfal, a low-latency system that turns the movement of phones, smartwatches and wands into control of Ableton Live, Max and TouchDesigner. He took part in the 2022 Choreographic Coding Lab at A+E Lab with Rebecca Evans of Pell Ensemble, and Flowfal now drives her motion-activated dance scores.
creators.why: He makes the body a music controller with devices people already wear, so a wrist turn or a raised arm plays and moves sound.
creators.role_zh: 移动交互设计师；Flowfal 动作转音乐系统的开发者
creators.bio_zh: 利兹附近的移动应用工作室 Curvor 联合创始人，开发了 Flowfal：一套低延迟系统，把手机、智能手表和手持棒的动作转换成对 Ableton Live、Max 和 TouchDesigner 的控制。2022 年他与 Pell Ensemble 的 Rebecca Evans 一起参加了 A+E Lab 的 Choreographic Coding Lab，如今 Flowfal 驱动着她由动作触发的舞蹈配乐。
creators.why_zh: 他用人们本来就戴在身上的设备把身体变成乐器：转一下手腕、抬一下手臂，就能演奏并移动声音。

creators.name: Jamie Gledhill
creators.role: Audio-visual artist and interaction designer
creators.bio: East Anglia artist and lecturer at Norwich University of the Arts whose installations use Kinect, Leap Motion and ordinary webcams for contact-free play, from body-outline projections to an interactive sculpture takeover and an AR trail of talking trees. He was lead artist of The Multitude, Collusion's two-player body-projection game.
creators.why: He designs playful public pieces that coax strangers into moving and playing together, using the simplest body tracking.
creators.role_zh: 视听艺术家、交互设计师
creators.bio_zh: 英国东安格利亚艺术家，任教于 Norwich University of the Arts。他的装置用 Kinect、Leap Motion 和普通摄像头实现无接触的游戏互动，从身体轮廓投影、公共雕塑的互动改造，到会说话的树组成的 AR 路线。他也是 Collusion 双人身体投影游戏 The Multitude 的主创艺术家。
creators.why_zh: 他用最简单的身体追踪做公共作品，引导陌生人一起动起来、一起玩。

creators.name: Uncharted Limbo Collective (George Adamopoulos, Eleana Polychronaki, Chris Waters)
creators.role: Creative coding studio for real-time visuals and performance
creators.bio: Studio of creative coders and visual artists working at the meeting point of code, interactive visuals and the performing arts. They built the motion-responsive visuals for Alexander Whitley's Anti-Body and co-created Chaotic Body and PRE-FIGURES with him, and develop dome and AI co-performer projects such as Protist Reverie and Monolith.
creators.why: They turn captured human motion into physical simulations, fluids, particles and slime-mould growth, that a performer can push around in real time.
creators.role_zh: 做实时视觉与表演的创意编程工作室
creators.bio_zh: 由创意程序员和视觉艺术家组成的工作室，工作在代码、互动视觉与表演艺术的交汇处。他们为 Alexander Whitley 的 Anti-Body 制作了随动作变化的视觉，并与他合作了 Chaotic Body 和 PRE-FIGURES；自己也在做球幕演出 Protist Reverie 和 AI 共演项目 Monolith。
creators.why_zh: 他们把捕捉到的人体动作变成流体、粒子、黏菌生长等物理模拟，让表演者可以实时推动它们。

creators.name: Children of the Light (Christopher Gabriel & Arnout Hulskamp)
creators.role: Light-art duo
creators.bio: Amsterdam duo who use light as their main material across performance, sculpture and immersive installations, from a darkened grid of reflective tubes lit only by visitors' phones to rotating halos and slowly rising lines of light. They made the kinetic light sculpture at the centre of Alexander Whitley's Overflow.
creators.why: They shape how a space feels with the fewest possible elements, often letting the audience's own light or movement complete the piece.
creators.role_zh: 灯光艺术二人组
creators.bio_zh: 阿姆斯特丹的艺术二人组，以光为主要材料，创作表演、雕塑和沉浸式装置：有只靠观众手机照亮的反光管阵列，也有旋转的光环和缓缓升降的光线。他们为 Alexander Whitley 的舞作 Overflow 制作了核心的动态灯光雕塑。
creators.why_zh: 他们用尽可能少的元素塑造空间的感受，经常让观众自己的光或动作来完成作品。

creators.name: Holosphere
creators.role: Spatial computing studio (VR, AR, projection)
creators.bio: Birmingham XR studio that builds VR, AR and real-time projection projects, from training simulations to live art. For Birmingham Royal Ballet it created a motion-capture-driven 35-metre backdrop, and it experiments with pose tracking on building facades and real-time mocap imagery in museums.
creators.why: They bring stage-scale motion capture out of the theatre and onto buildings and gallery floors where the public can try it.
creators.role_zh: 空间计算工作室（VR、AR、投影）
creators.bio_zh: 伯明翰的 XR 工作室，做 VR、AR 和实时投影项目，从培训模拟到现场艺术都有。它为 Birmingham Royal Ballet 制作了由动作捕捉驱动的 35 米背景屏，也在尝试把姿态追踪用于建筑立面、把实时动捕影像带进博物馆。
creators.why_zh: 他们把舞台级的动作捕捉带出剧院，搬到建筑外墙和展厅里，让普通观众也能亲手试。

creators.name: Tom Ward
creators.role: Digital artist and creative technologist
creators.bio: Kent-based digital artist working across 2D and 3D animation, modelling, games and installations, and a freelance creative technologist for Electric Medway since 2024. His AR pieces for Electric Medway fill night-time streets and rooms with glowing plants and deep-sea creatures, and he is adding AR windows to the Intra Stories murals.
creators.why: He uses phone AR to give community festivals a second, glowing layer that local audiences can find in familiar places.
creators.role_zh: 数字艺术家、创意技术人
creators.bio_zh: 肯特郡的数字艺术家，创作涵盖二维与三维动画、建模、游戏和装置，2024 年起担任 Electric Medway 的自由职业创意技术人。他为 Electric Medway 做的 AR 作品让夜晚的街道和房间长满发光植物、游满深海生物；他还在为 Intra Stories 壁画加上 AR 窗口。
creators.why_zh: 他用手机 AR 给社区艺术节加上一层发光的第二现实，让本地观众在熟悉的地方发现它。

creators.name: Zimoun
creators.role: Sound sculptor and installation artist
creators.bio: Swiss artist who builds large architectural installations from hundreds of identical cheap parts (dc-motors, cotton balls, cardboard boxes, wires, sticks) whose collective rattling becomes a dense, living sound field; each title simply lists its materials.
creators.why: He shows how a crowd of tiny identical agents, each doing one dumb thing, turns a whole room into an organism you can hear and walk through.
creators.role_zh: 声音雕塑家、装置艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 瑞士艺术家，用成百上千个廉价而相同的零件（直流电机、棉球、纸箱、铁丝、木棍）搭建建筑尺度的装置，它们集体的敲击声汇成一片密集而有生命感的声场；作品标题就是材料清单。
creators.why_zh: 他证明了：一大群只会做一件简单事情的小单元，就能把整个房间变成一个可以听、可以走进去的有机体。

creators.name: Reuben Margolin
creators.role: Kinetic sculptor
creators.bio: American kinetic sculptor who builds hanging wave sculptures from wood, strings, pulleys, bicycle wheels and glass, in which camshafts add sine waves together so that thousands of points ripple like water or a caterpillar's back.
creators.why: His pieces make the math of waves physically visible, a direct lesson for anyone animating many points in space from a few driving functions.
creators.role_zh: 动态雕塑家
creators.bio_zh: 美国动态雕塑家，用木头、绳子、滑轮、自行车轮和玻璃搭建悬挂式波浪雕塑：凸轮轴把几条正弦波叠加起来，让成千上万个点像水面或毛毛虫的背一样起伏。
creators.why_zh: 他的作品把波的数学变成看得见的实物，对任何想用几个驱动函数让空间中大量点运动起来的人都是直接的一课。

creators.name: Ned Kahn
creators.role: Environmental artist and sculptor
creators.bio: American artist, trained at the Exploratorium, whose façades and sculptures are skins of thousands of hinged aluminium or plastic panels, fog vortices and moving sand that reveal wind, water and light as they pass through.
creators.why: He treats buildings as sensors: his wind veils turn an invisible force into a moving image across a whole façade, with no electronics at all.
creators.role_zh: 环境艺术家、雕塑家
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，出身于旧金山探索馆（Exploratorium）。他的建筑立面和雕塑由成千上万块铰接的铝片或塑料片、雾气漩涡和流动的沙构成，让风、水和光经过时显形。
creators.why_zh: 他把建筑当成传感器：风幕把看不见的力变成整面墙上流动的影像，而且完全不用电子元件。
creators.based_zh: 美国加州塞巴斯托波尔

creators.name: Anthony Howe
creators.role: Kinetic wind sculptor
creators.bio: American sculptor who machines large stainless-steel wind sculptures whose hundreds of cups and blades rotate into shimmering, hypnotic 3D patterns; he designed the kinetic cauldron sculpture for the Rio 2016 Olympic Games.
creators.why: His sculptures show how nested rotations turn one input (wind) into an endlessly changing volumetric form, a model for procedural motion in AR.
creators.role_zh: 风动雕塑家
creators.bio_zh: 美国雕塑家，用数控加工的不锈钢制作大型风动雕塑，数百个杯片和叶片旋转出闪烁、令人着迷的三维图案；他设计了 2016 年里约奥运会的动态火炬台雕塑。
creators.why_zh: 他的雕塑说明，嵌套的旋转可以把单一输入（风）变成不断变化的立体形态，是 AR 程序化运动的好范本。
creators.based_zh: 美国华盛顿州奥卡斯岛

creators.name: Arthur Ganson
creators.role: Kinetic sculptor and engineer
creators.bio: American sculptor whose small hand-built machines of wire and gears perform poetic gestures: a wishbone that walks, a chair that explodes and reassembles, a gear train that ends in concrete; many are on long-term view at the MIT Museum.
creators.why: Ganson proves that a single, well-timed gesture of an ordinary object can carry more emotion than any spectacle, a core lesson for small AR interventions.
creators.role_zh: 动态雕塑家、工程师
creators.bio_zh: 美国雕塑家，用铁丝和齿轮亲手制作小型机器，让它们完成富有诗意的动作：会走路的许愿骨、会炸开又重新拼合的椅子、最后一个齿轮被浇进混凝土的齿轮组；许多作品长期陈列于 MIT 博物馆。
creators.why_zh: 他证明了普通物件一个时机恰当的动作，比任何大场面都更能打动人，这是做小型 AR 介入的核心一课。
creators.based_zh: 美国马萨诸塞州萨默维尔

creators.name: Ralfonso
creators.role: Kinetic, light and interactive sculptor
creators.bio: Swiss-born artist Ralf Alfonso (Ralfonso) creates wind-driven stainless-steel kinetic sculptures, light sculptures and interactive murals for public spaces worldwide, and co-founded the Kinetic Art Organization (KAO).
creators.why: His public wind-and-light pieces show how a sculpture can change character from day to night and with the weather, as an AR layer should.
creators.role_zh: 动态、光与互动雕塑家
creators.bio_zh: 瑞士出生的艺术家 Ralf Alfonso（Ralfonso）为世界各地的公共空间制作风动不锈钢动态雕塑、光雕塑和互动壁画，并参与创立了动态艺术组织 Kinetic Art Organization（KAO）。
creators.why_zh: 他的风与光公共雕塑会随昼夜和天气变换性格，这正是 AR 图层应有的样子。

creators.name: Jennifer Townley
creators.role: Mechanical sculptor
creators.bio: Dutch artist who designs precise mechanical sculptures of gears, spirals and repeated parts whose slightly different rotation speeds produce slowly shifting, hypnotic patterns, as well as drawing machines.
creators.why: Her work shows how two nearly identical rhythms drifting out of phase create endless variation, a cheap and elegant engine for generative AR motion.
creators.role_zh: 机械雕塑家
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰艺术家，用齿轮、螺旋和重复部件设计精密的机械雕塑，各部件转速略有不同，产生缓慢变化、令人着迷的图案；她也制作绘图机器。
creators.why_zh: 她的作品说明，两个几乎相同的节奏彼此错相，就能生成无穷的变化，是 AR 生成式运动便宜又优雅的引擎。

creators.name: Bruce Shapiro
creators.role: Kinetic artist and motion-control engineer
creators.bio: American artist and engineer who has built computer-controlled kinetic sculptures since the 1990s; his Sisyphus tables use a hidden magnet to roll a steel ball through sand, drawing and erasing patterns forever.
creators.why: Sisyphus is the purest example of a trace: a single moving point whose path becomes the artwork and then disappears.
creators.role_zh: 动态艺术家、运动控制工程师
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家兼工程师，自 1990 年代起制作计算机控制的动态雕塑；他的 Sisyphus 沙桌用隐藏磁铁推动钢珠在沙中滚动，永无止境地画出又抹去图案。
creators.why_zh: Sisyphus 是“痕迹”最纯粹的例子：一个移动的点，它的路径就是作品，随后又消失。

creators.name: John Edmark
creators.role: Artist, inventor and design lecturer
creators.bio: American artist and Stanford design lecturer who 3D-prints sculptures built on the golden angle; spun under a strobe light, his Blooms appear to unfold endlessly like living flowers.
creators.why: Edmark shows that the right geometry plus a synchronised flash turns a static object into animation, the same trick as frame-synced AR rendering.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、发明家、设计讲师
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，斯坦福大学设计讲师，用 3D 打印制作基于黄金角的雕塑；在频闪灯下旋转时，他的 Blooms 仿佛花朵在无限绽放。
creators.why_zh: 他证明了恰当的几何加上同步闪光，就能把静物变成动画，这与 AR 按帧同步渲染是同一个把戏。

creators.name: Akinori Goto
creators.role: Media artist
creators.bio: Japanese media artist who creates 3D-printed zoetropes: a spinning lattice of frozen figures lit by a thin projected line of light, so that a walking or dancing body appears to move inside the object.
creators.why: His toki- works show that light can select which slice of a physical object we see, letting a fixed form hold a whole animation.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 日本媒体艺术家，制作 3D 打印的走马灯（zoetrope）：一个由凝固人形组成的网格旋转，被一道细细的投影光线照亮，于是行走或舞蹈的身体仿佛在物体内部动了起来。
creators.why_zh: 他的 toki- 系列说明，光可以挑选我们看见物体的哪一个切片，让一个固定的形体容纳一整段动画。

creators.name: Gregory Barsamian
creators.role: Sculptor of stroboscopic 3D animation
creators.bio: American sculptor who since the 1980s has built large 3D zoetropes: dozens of sculpted objects spin on armatures while a synchronised strobe fuses them into dreamlike, morphing animations in physical space.
creators.why: Barsamian's rooms are animation without a screen, showing how motion can be embedded in real matter and revealed only by light timing.
creators.role_zh: 频闪立体动画雕塑家
creators.bio_zh: 美国雕塑家，自 1980 年代起制作大型立体走马灯：几十个雕塑件在支架上旋转，同步频闪灯把它们融合成在真实空间里变形的梦境动画。
creators.why_zh: 他的展厅是没有屏幕的动画，说明运动可以嵌进真实物质里，只靠光的时序显现出来。

creators.name: Toshio Iwai (岩井俊雄)
creators.role: Media artist and game designer
creators.bio: Japanese media artist whose early Time Stratum zoetropes used the flicker of TV monitors as a strobe; he later created Morphovision with NHK, the piano performance with Ryuichi Sakamoto, Electroplankton and the Tenori-on instrument.
creators.why: Iwai connects pre-cinema optical toys with interactive media, showing AR designers that timing light against motion is itself a display technology.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家、游戏设计师
creators.bio_zh: 日本媒体艺术家，早期的 Time Stratum（时间层）系列走马灯用电视显示器的闪烁充当频闪；后来与 NHK 合作 Morphovision，与坂本龙一合作钢琴演出，并创作了 Electroplankton 和 Tenori-on 乐器。
creators.why_zh: 他把电影诞生前的光学玩具与互动媒体连在一起，告诉 AR 设计者：让光的时序与运动对齐，本身就是一种显示技术。

creators.name: ART+COM Studios (Joachim Sauter)
creators.role: Berlin design studio for kinetic sculpture and media installations
creators.bio: Founded in 1988 by Joachim Sauter and others, ART+COM builds kinetic sculptures such as Kinetic Rain and the BMW Museum's Kinetic Sculpture, where hundreds of motor-driven elements draw shapes in the air.
creators.why: Their sculptures show how many small synchronized elements can form one shape in space, which is exactly how particle and voxel effects work in AR.
creators.role_zh: 柏林的动态雕塑与媒体装置设计工作室
creators.bio_zh: 由 Joachim Sauter 等人于 1988 年创立，代表作包括樟宜机场的 Kinetic Rain 和宝马博物馆的 Kinetic Sculpture：数百个由电机驱动的元素在空中拼出形状。
creators.why_zh: 他们的雕塑展示了大量小元素同步运动如何在空间中组成一个整体形状，这正是 AR 中粒子与体素效果的原理。

creators.name: Christopher Bauder / WHITEvoid
creators.role: Light and kinetic artist; founder of WHITEvoid and the Kinetic Lights system
creators.bio: Berlin artist whose studio WHITEvoid makes kinetic light installations and audiovisual shows, often with Robert Henke (Atom, GRID, DEEP WEB) and Kangding Ray (SKALAR), and who marked the Berlin Wall with 8,000 glowing balloons in Lichtgrenze.
creators.why: He choreographs light in 3D space with winches, spheres and mirrors, the physical version of animating virtual objects in a room.
creators.role_zh: 光与动态艺术家；WHITEvoid 工作室与 Kinetic Lights 系统创始人
creators.bio_zh: 柏林艺术家，其工作室 WHITEvoid 制作动态灯光装置与视听演出，常与 Robert Henke（Atom、GRID、DEEP WEB）和 Kangding Ray（SKALAR）合作；他还用 8000 个发光气球在 Lichtgrenze 中重现了柏林墙的走向。
creators.why_zh: 他用绞盘、光球和镜面在三维空间里编排光，这就是在房间里给虚拟物体做动画的实体版本。

creators.name: Troika (Eva Rucki, Conny Freyer & Sebastien Noel)
creators.role: London art collective working with perception, light and kinetic sculpture
creators.bio: Troika is a London collective founded in 2003 whose sculptures and installations, from the flip-dot Cloud at Heathrow to the rotating Dark Matter, play with perception, light and the gap between what we see and what we know.
creators.why: Their works make a viewer's position and movement part of the image, a core lesson for any AR piece that changes as you walk around it.
creators.role_zh: 关注感知、光与动态雕塑的伦敦艺术团体
creators.bio_zh: Troika 于 2003 年在伦敦成立，作品从希思罗机场的翻片装置 Cloud 到旋转雕塑 Dark Matter，都在玩弄感知与光，探讨我们看到的与我们知道的之间的落差。
creators.why_zh: 他们让观众的位置和移动成为图像的一部分，这正是任何“绕着走会变”的 AR 作品的核心课题。

creators.name: United Visual Artists (UVA)
creators.role: London art practice for light, sound and responsive installations
creators.bio: Founded by Matt Clark in 2003 after building stage visuals for Massive Attack, UVA makes installations such as Volume, Momentum and Our Time that use light, pendulums and sound to change how people feel space and time.
creators.why: UVA treats light as something you walk through and that answers your presence, the same design space as room-scale AR.
creators.role_zh: 以光、声音和互动装置为媒介的伦敦艺术团体
creators.bio_zh: 由 Matt Clark 于 2003 年创立，起步于为 Massive Attack 制作舞台视觉；代表作 Volume、Momentum 和 Our Time 用光、摆锤和声音改变人们对空间与时间的感受。
creators.why_zh: UVA 把光当作可以穿行其中、并会回应你存在的东西，这与房间尺度的 AR 是同一个设计空间。

creators.name: Studio Swine / A.A. Murakami (Azusa Murakami & Alexander Groves)
creators.role: Art and design duo making ephemeral sculptures from mist, bubbles and light
creators.bio: Japanese-British duo Azusa Murakami and Alexander Groves, who worked as Studio Swine and now as A.A. Murakami, build machines that make fleeting forms, such as mist-filled bubbles that bloom from a tree and burst on your hand.
creators.why: They design objects that exist for a few seconds, a strong model for AR content that appears, lives briefly and disappears.
creators.role_zh: 用雾、泡泡和光制作转瞬即逝雕塑的艺术设计二人组
creators.bio_zh: 日英二人组 Azusa Murakami 与 Alexander Groves，曾以 Studio Swine 为名，现以 A.A. Murakami 创作；他们制造会生成短暂形态的机器，比如从树上绽放、落在手上才破裂的雾气泡泡。
creators.why_zh: 他们设计只存在几秒钟的物体，这是 AR 内容“出现、短暂存在、消失”的极好范例。

creators.name: Conrad Shawcross
creators.role: Sculptor of machines, robots and light
creators.bio: British sculptor (born 1977, Royal Academician) whose mechanical sculptures, from Slow Arc Inside a Cube to the robot of The ADA Project, trace geometry, time and motion with a moving light or arm.
creators.why: His machines turn a single moving point into a whole architecture of shadow and light, a lesson in how simple motion creates volume.
creators.role_zh: 以机器、机械臂和光为材料的雕塑家
creators.bio_zh: 英国雕塑家（1977 年生，英国皇家艺术研究院院士），作品从 Slow Arc Inside a Cube 到 The ADA Project 的机械臂，用移动的光点或手臂描绘几何、时间与运动。
creators.why_zh: 他的机器让一个移动的点变成一整座光影建筑，说明简单的运动也能生成体积。

creators.name: Shinji Ohmaki (大巻伸嗣)
creators.role: Installation artist working with air, fabric, bubbles and light
creators.bio: Japanese artist (born 1971) who fills spaces with slowly floating fabric (Liminal Air Space-Time), streams of soap bubbles (Memorial Rebirth) and rotating lights, making air and time visible.
creators.why: He makes the invisible medium of a room, the air, into the artwork, a model for AR effects that visualize wind, breath or presence.
creators.role_zh: 以空气、布料、泡泡和光为材料的装置艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 日本艺术家大巻伸嗣（1971 年生），用缓慢漂浮的巨大布料（Liminal Air Space-Time）、如潮水般的肥皂泡（Memorial Rebirth）和旋转灯光填满空间，让空气与时间变得可见。
creators.why_zh: 他把房间里看不见的介质——空气——变成作品本身，为可视化风、呼吸或存在感的 AR 效果提供了范例。

creators.name: Humans since 1982 (Per Emanuelsson & Bastian Bischoff)
creators.role: Swedish-German art studio for kinetic clock installations
creators.bio: Studio founded in 2008 by Per Emanuelsson and Bastian Bischoff, known for ClockClock and A Million Times: grids of analogue clock hands that dance in unison and then settle to spell the current time.
creators.why: They turn hundreds of identical parts into a choreographed display, showing how a grid of simple rotating elements can carry both motion and information.
creators.role_zh: 制作动态时钟装置的瑞典-德国艺术工作室
creators.bio_zh: 由 Per Emanuelsson 与 Bastian Bischoff 于 2008 年创立，以 ClockClock 和 A Million Times 闻名：成百上千根模拟时钟指针整齐起舞，最后停下来拼出当前时间。
creators.why_zh: 他们把成百个相同的部件变成一场编排好的表演，说明一组简单的旋转元素既能表现运动，也能传达信息。

creators.name: Maarten Baas
creators.role: Dutch designer; author of the Real Time clock series
creators.bio: Dutch designer (born 1978) whose Real Time series films people drawing, sweeping or painting the hands of a clock in real time for twelve hours, turning a clock face into a performance.
creators.why: Real Time shows that a hidden human performance, played back in sync with the world, can replace a machine interface, a trick AR can use with recorded volumetric performers.
creators.role_zh: 荷兰设计师；Real Time 时钟系列作者
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰设计师 Maarten Baas（1978 年生），其 Real Time 系列拍摄真人连续 12 小时实时画出、扫出或涂出时钟指针，把钟面变成一场表演。
creators.why_zh: Real Time 说明，一段与现实时间同步播放的真人表演可以取代机械界面，AR 用录制的体积人像时也能用上这一招。

creators.name: Jonpasang (전파상)
creators.role: Seoul media art collective
creators.bio: Seoul collective of media artists and engineers that builds large kinetic works, best known for Hyper-Matrix, the moving cube wall of the Hyundai Motor Group Pavilion at Expo 2012 Yeosu.
creators.why: Hyper-Matrix proves that a wall of physical pixels can move like a screen, a reference for AR that pushes surfaces in and out of real architecture.
creators.role_zh: 首尔媒体艺术团体
creators.bio_zh: 首尔的媒体艺术家与工程师团体（전파상），擅长大型动态装置，代表作是 2012 年丽水世博会现代汽车集团馆的动态方块墙 Hyper-Matrix。
creators.why_zh: Hyper-Matrix 证明一面由实体像素组成的墙也能像屏幕一样运动，是 AR 让真实建筑表面起伏变形的参考。

creators.name: BREAKFAST (Andrew Zolty)
creators.role: Brooklyn studio for kinetic, data-driven flip-disc and Brixel artworks
creators.bio: Studio founded by Andrew Zolty that invents kinetic media such as flip-discs and rotating Brixels, making walls that mirror passers-by or visualize live wind, weather and ocean data.
creators.why: BREAKFAST shows how a physical display can react to bodies and live data at the same time, the two inputs most AR pieces also combine.
creators.role_zh: 制作翻片（flip-disc）与 Brixel 动态、数据驱动艺术的布鲁克林工作室
creators.bio_zh: 由 Andrew Zolty 创立，发明了翻片、可旋转的 Brixel 等动态媒介，做出能映照路人、或实时呈现风、天气与海洋数据的墙面。
creators.why_zh: BREAKFAST 展示了一块实体显示面如何同时回应身体与实时数据，而这两种输入也是很多 AR 作品会组合使用的。

creators.name: Nils Völker
creators.role: Berlin artist making kinetic installations from inflatable bags
creators.bio: German artist (born 1979) who builds large grids of plastic bags that inflate and deflate in computed waves, and machines that draw light patterns.
creators.why: He makes breathing, wave-like motion out of the cheapest material, proof that timing matters more than rendering fidelity.
creators.role_zh: 用充气塑料袋制作动态装置的柏林艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 德国艺术家 Nils Völker（1979 年生），用成片的塑料袋按计算好的波形充气、放气，也制作画光的绘图机器。
creators.why_zh: 他用最廉价的材料做出会呼吸般的波动，证明节奏比渲染精度更重要。

creators.name: Daniel Palacios
creators.role: Artist; kinetic and sound installations
creators.bio: Spanish artist who builds machines that make invisible processes visible: a spinning rope that turns the movement of visitors into waves and sound, and a laser that engraves growth rings as they happen.
creators.why: His Waves shows how a single line can become a living, readable response to a crowd.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；动态与声音装置
creators.bio_zh: 西班牙艺术家，擅长制造让看不见的过程显形的机器：一根旋转的绳子把观众的动作变成波浪和声音，一束激光把树木年轮的生长实时刻出来。
creators.why_zh: 他的《Waves》说明一根线就能变成对人群的鲜活、可读的回应。

creators.name: David Bowen
creators.role: Artist; professor at the University of Minnesota Duluth
creators.bio: American artist who connects robotic devices to natural systems — wind, waves, clouds, houseflies, plants — so that remote or invisible forces drive machines in the gallery.
creators.why: He treats live sensor data from nature as a puppeteer, the same pattern AR uses when it lets real-world signals move virtual things.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；明尼苏达大学德卢斯分校教授
creators.based_zh: 德卢斯，美国明尼苏达州
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，把机器人装置接到自然系统上——风、浪、云、苍蝇、植物——让远方或看不见的力量在展厅里驱动机器。
creators.why_zh: 他把来自自然的实时传感数据当作操偶师，这正是 AR 用真实世界信号驱动虚拟物体的思路。

creators.name: Julius Popp
creators.role: Artist; kinetic information sculptures
creators.bio: German artist best known for bit.fall, a waterfall whose drops are released by computer-controlled valves to write words taken live from news feeds.
creators.why: bit.fall turns falling water into a display that exists for one second — information made physical and temporary.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；动态信息雕塑
creators.bio_zh: 德国艺术家，最知名的作品是《bit.fall》：由电脑控制的阀门放出水滴，在下落的水帘中写出实时抓取的新闻词语。
creators.why_zh: 《bit.fall》把下落的水变成只存在一秒的显示屏——信息被物质化，而且转瞬即逝。

creators.name: Jason Bruges Studio
creators.role: Interactive art and architecture studio
creators.bio: London studio founded by Jason Bruges in 2001 that makes responsive light, kinetic and robotic installations for public spaces, hospitals and architecture.
creators.why: Their pieces treat buildings and corridors as sensing surfaces that notice passers-by and answer with light.
creators.role_zh: 互动艺术与建筑工作室
creators.bio_zh: Jason Bruges 于 2001 年在伦敦创立的工作室，为公共空间、医院和建筑制作会回应人的灯光、动态和机器人装置。
creators.why_zh: 他们把建筑和走廊当作会感知的表面，注意到路人并用光来回应。

creators.name: Philip Beesley / Living Architecture Systems Group
creators.role: Architect and artist; professor at the University of Waterloo
creators.bio: Canadian architect whose 'living architecture' installations are dense canopies of acrylic fronds, sensors, shape-memory actuators, lights and chemistry that breathe and ripple as visitors move through them.
creators.why: He shows how a whole room can feel alive when thousands of small elements react locally to a body nearby.
creators.role_zh: 建筑师、艺术家；滑铁卢大学教授
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大建筑师，他的“活的建筑”装置由亚克力叶片、传感器、形状记忆合金、灯光和化学组件密集编织成穹顶，观众经过时它会呼吸、起伏。
creators.why_zh: 他证明了当成千上万个小单元各自对附近的身体做出反应时，整个房间会显得有生命。

creators.name: Behnaz Farahi
creators.role: Designer and artist; interactive wearables and responsive architecture
creators.bio: Iranian-born designer who makes 3D-printed garments and kinetic surfaces that react to gaze, facial expression, speech and brain activity using cameras, soft robotics and shape-memory alloys.
creators.why: Her garments make the social signals between people visible on the body — a physical version of a face-tracking AR filter.
creators.role_zh: 设计师、艺术家；互动可穿戴与响应式建筑
creators.bio_zh: 出生于伊朗的设计师，用摄像头、软体机器人和形状记忆合金制作 3D 打印服装与动态表面，能对目光、表情、语音和脑电活动做出反应。
creators.why_zh: 她的服装把人与人之间的社交信号显现在身体上——相当于一个实体版的人脸追踪 AR 滤镜。

creators.name: Antonin Fourneau
creators.role: Artist and game designer
creators.bio: French artist who makes playful public installations and arcade machines; his Water Light Graffiti wall lights up wherever it is touched with water.
creators.why: He found a way to paint with light using nothing but a wet brush — drawing that leaves no trace.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、游戏设计师
creators.bio_zh: 法国艺术家，制作好玩的公共装置和街机；他的《Water Light Graffiti》墙面只要被水碰到就会亮起来。
creators.why_zh: 他找到了一种只用湿刷子就能用光作画的方法——画了不留痕迹。

creators.name: David Rokeby
creators.role: Artist; pioneer of interactive sound and vision installations
creators.bio: Canadian artist who since the early 1980s has built camera-based systems that answer body movement with sound (Very Nervous System) or look at objects and speak about them (The Giver of Names).
creators.why: Very Nervous System is one of the first works where the whole body in an empty room became the interface.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；互动声音与视觉装置先驱
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大艺术家，自 1980 年代初开始用摄像头搭建系统：用声音回应身体动作（《Very Nervous System》），或观看物体并说出关于它的句子（《The Giver of Names》）。
creators.why_zh: 《Very Nervous System》是最早把空房间里的整个身体变成界面的作品之一。

creators.name: Chico MacMurtrie / Amorphic Robot Works
creators.role: Artist; robotic and inflatable sculpture
creators.bio: American artist who leads Amorphic Robot Works, a collective building pneumatic robots and giant inflatable sculptures that breathe, unfold and move like bodies.
creators.why: His inflatables show how soft, breathing forms can make architecture feel like a creature.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；机器人与充气雕塑
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，领导 Amorphic Robot Works 团队，制作会像身体一样呼吸、展开和移动的气动机器人与巨型充气雕塑。
creators.why_zh: 他的充气作品说明柔软、会呼吸的形体能让建筑像生物一样。

creators.name: dECOi / Mark Goulthorpe (HypoSurface)
creators.role: Architecture practice; kinetic surface research
creators.bio: dECOi is the architecture practice of Mark Goulthorpe; with MIT they developed HypoSurface, a wall of hundreds of pneumatically driven metal plates that ripples into waves, patterns and letters in response to sound and movement.
creators.why: HypoSurface is an early full-size 'shape display' — a wall that moves like a screen.
creators.role_zh: 建筑事务所；动态表面研究
creators.based_zh: 巴黎，法国 / 剑桥，美国
creators.bio_zh: dECOi 是 Mark Goulthorpe 的建筑事务所，与 MIT 合作开发了 HypoSurface：由数百块气动金属片组成的墙，能根据声音和动作起伏成波浪、图案和文字。
creators.why_zh: HypoSurface 是早期的真人尺度“形状显示器”——一面像屏幕一样会动的墙。

creators.name: Aaron Sherwood
creators.role: Artist, composer and creative technologist
creators.bio: American media artist and composer (Purring Tiger, with Kiori Kawai) who builds interactive audiovisual installations and performances, including Firewall, a stretched spandex membrane that reacts to touch.
