creators.bio_zh: 1984 年由京都市立艺术大学的学生创立，成员包括古桥悌二（Teiji Furuhashi）和高谷史郎（Shiro Takatani），1990 年代起由池田亮司（Ryoji Ikeda）负责声音。代表作《pH》《S/N》《OR》《memorandum》把身体放进扫描的光、投影的文字和数据之中，2022 年代表日本参加威尼斯双年展。
creators.why_zh: Dumb Type 把舞台变成一块会扫描、计数并覆写表演者的屏幕，这正是身体与 AR 界面之间的关系。

creators.name: Walt Disney Imagineering (Haunted Mansion team: Yale Gracey, Rolly Crump, Marc Davis, X Atencio)
creators.role: Theme park design and engineering
creators.bio: Disney's design and engineering arm. For the Haunted Mansion (Disneyland, 1969), effects designer Yale Gracey and colleagues staged a room-sized Pepper's ghost ballroom and projected filmed faces onto sculpted heads, such as the fortune teller Madame Leota in her crystal ball.
creators.why: The Haunted Mansion is the classic reference for Pepper's-ghost holograms and face projection; later artists and researchers, including Michael Naimark, name it as their starting point.
creators.role_zh: 主题乐园设计与工程
creators.based_zh: 格伦代尔，加利福尼亚，美国
creators.bio_zh: 迪士尼的设计与工程部门。为 1969 年开放的迪士尼乐园“幽灵公馆”（Haunted Mansion），特效设计师 Yale Gracey 等人做出了整间舞厅大小的佩珀尔幻象，并把拍好的人脸投影到雕塑头像上，比如水晶球里的占卜师 Madame Leota。
creators.why_zh: 幽灵公馆是佩珀尔幻象“全息”和人脸投影的经典参照；包括 Michael Naimark 在内的许多艺术家和研究者都把它当作起点。

creators.name: Crypton Future Media (Hatsune Miku live concerts)
creators.role: Music software company; producer of Hatsune Miku concerts
creators.bio: Crypton released the Vocaloid voice Hatsune Miku in 2007. Since 2009–2010 her concerts have put the animated singer on stage with a live band, projected onto a transparent screen, and tours such as MIKU EXPO and Magical Mirai travel worldwide.
creators.why: Miku concerts prove that thousands of people will accept a projected virtual performer on a real stage when it shares timing and light with live musicians.
creators.role_zh: 音乐软件公司；初音未来演唱会制作方
creators.bio_zh: Crypton 于 2007 年推出 Vocaloid 歌声库“初音未来”。从 2009–2010 年起，她的演唱会把动画歌手投影在透明屏幕上，与现场乐队同台演出，MIKU EXPO 和“魔法未来”（Magical Mirai）等巡演走遍世界。
creators.why_zh: 初音未来的演唱会证明：只要虚拟表演者与现场乐手共享节奏和灯光，成千上万的观众就会接受一个被投在真实舞台上的虚拟歌手。

creators.name: Skullmapping (Filip Sterckx & Antoon Verbeeck)
creators.role: Projection mapping and animation studio
creators.bio: Belgian duo of animator Filip Sterckx and painter Antoon Verbeeck. They are known for Le Petit Chef, a tiny projected chef who cooks on the diner's plate, and for dynamic projections that let figures escape from paintings and walk through galleries and airports.
creators.why: Skullmapping makes projection feel like tabletop AR: a small character lives on your plate or jumps out of a painting, aligned to the real object it touches.
creators.role_zh: 投影映射与动画工作室
creators.bio_zh: 由动画师 Filip Sterckx 和画家 Antoon Verbeeck 组成的比利时二人组。代表作《Le Petit Chef》让一位投影出来的迷你厨师在客人的餐盘上做菜；他们还用动态投影让画中人物走出画框，在美术馆和机场里游走。
creators.why_zh: Skullmapping 让投影像桌面 AR 一样：一个小角色活在你的餐盘上，或从画里跳出来，并且始终贴合它所接触的真实物体。

creators.name: Craig Walsh
creators.role: Artist (site-specific projection on trees, landscapes and architecture)
creators.bio: Australian artist who projects video into found sites: faces of local residents onto trees (Humannature, Monuments), creatures into city drainage channels (Incursion), and community stories onto buildings (Digital Odyssey). His work has toured to Havana, Taipei, Toronto and San Jose.
creators.why: Walsh uses the landscape itself as the screen, so a projected face becomes part of a tree instead of an image in front of it.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家（在树木、风景和建筑上做特定场地投影）
creators.bio_zh: 澳大利亚艺术家，把影像投进现成的场地：把当地居民的脸投到树上（《Humannature》《Monuments》），把生物投进城市排水渠（《Incursion》），把社区故事投到建筑上（Digital Odyssey 项目）。作品曾巡展至哈瓦那、台北、多伦多和圣何塞。
creators.why_zh: Walsh 直接把风景当作屏幕，投上去的脸成了树的一部分，而不是挡在树前面的一张图。

creators.name: Bordos.ArtWorks (László Zsolt Bordos)
creators.role: Projection mapping artist
creators.bio: Hungarian artist László Zsolt Bordos, a pioneer of European architectural mapping since the late 2000s. His works include a stereoscopic 3D mapping on the Museum of Art and History at Mapping Festival Geneva 2012, Escape at Signal Festival Prague 2015 and generative light pieces such as Lux Formae.
creators.why: Bordos pushed building mapping into stereoscopic 3D and treats a facade as a volume that can open, fold and escape, not just a flat screen.
creators.role_zh: 投影映射艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 匈牙利艺术家 László Zsolt Bordos，2000 年代末以来欧洲建筑投影映射的先驱之一。作品包括 2012 年日内瓦 Mapping Festival 在艺术与历史博物馆上的立体 3D 投影、2015 年布拉格 Signal Festival 的《Escape》，以及《Lux Formae》等生成式光作品。
creators.why_zh: Bordos 把建筑投影推进到立体 3D，把立面当成一个可以打开、折叠、逃逸的体积，而不只是一块平面屏幕。

creators.name: Cai Guo-Qiang (蔡国强)
creators.role: Artist; gunpowder drawings and explosion events
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；火药画与爆破计划
creators.bio: Chinese artist from Quanzhou who works with gunpowder, fireworks and daytime smoke, from explosion drawings on paper to sky-scale events such as Sky Ladder and the Beijing 2008 Olympic footprints.
creators.bio_zh: 出生于泉州的中国艺术家，以火药、烟花和白天的彩色烟雾创作，从纸上的火药画到《天梯》、2008 北京奥运“大脚印”这样以天空为画布的爆破计划。
creators.why: He treats the whole sky as a temporary canvas and designs images that exist for seconds, exactly the time scale of a spectacular AR moment.
creators.why_zh: 他把整片天空当作临时画布，设计只存在几秒钟的图像，这正是 AR 奇观时刻的时间尺度。

creators.name: Judy Chicago
creators.role: Artist; feminist art pioneer, smoke sculptures
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；女性主义艺术先驱，烟雾雕塑
creators.bio: American artist best known for The Dinner Party; since the late 1960s her Atmospheres use coloured smoke and fireworks to soften and colour landscapes, a feminine answer to male-dominated land art.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，以《晚宴》闻名；自 1960 年代末起，她的《Atmospheres》系列用彩色烟雾和烟花柔化、染色风景，是对男性主导的大地艺术的一种女性回应。
creators.why: Her smoke pieces show how a few minutes of colour drifting over a real place can change how people feel about that place, a lesson for AR weather and atmosphere effects.
creators.why_zh: 她的烟雾作品说明：几分钟飘过真实场所的色彩，就能改变人们对这个地方的感受，这对 AR 中的天气和氛围效果很有启发。

creators.name: Ars Electronica Futurelab (Spaxels)
creators.role: Art-and-technology lab; drone swarm pioneers
creators.role_zh: 艺术科技实验室；无人机编队先驱
creators.bio: The research lab of Ars Electronica in Linz; its Spaxels project (from 2012) flew some of the first choreographed swarms of lit quadcopters, later scaled up with Intel for the 2015 Drone 100 record.
creators.bio_zh: 林茨电子艺术节旗下的研究实验室；其 Spaxels 项目（2012 年起）是最早一批让发光四旋翼按编排编队飞行的尝试，2015 年又与 Intel 合作完成了 Drone 100 纪录。
creators.why: They invented the idea of the drone as a 'space pixel', a flying point of light that can draw images in the air, which is the physical twin of an AR particle.
creators.why_zh: 他们提出了“空间像素”这一概念：无人机是一个会飞的光点，可以在空中组成图像，它是 AR 粒子在现实中的孪生体。

creators.name: Raffaello D'Andrea / Verity
creators.role: Roboticist; ETH Zurich professor and founder of Verity
creators.role_zh: 机器人学家；苏黎世联邦理工学院教授，Verity 创始人
creators.bio: Canadian-Italian-Swiss engineer who co-founded Kiva Systems and founded Verity; his flying machine arena at ETH Zurich produced drone-built architecture, the Cirque du Soleil short SPARKED and indoor drone swarms for Metallica and Broadway.
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大、意大利、瑞士籍工程师，Kiva Systems 联合创始人、Verity 创始人；他在苏黎世联邦理工学院的“飞行器竞技场”做出了无人机搭建的建筑、与太阳马戏团合作的短片 SPARKED，以及 Metallica 和百老汇演出中的室内无人机群。
creators.why: He shows how precisely tracked flying objects can perform next to people indoors, the same tracking problem AR solves for virtual objects.
creators.why_zh: 他展示了被精确追踪的飞行物如何在室内与人同台表演，这与 AR 为虚拟物体解决的追踪问题是同一个问题。

creators.name: Nova Sky Stories
creators.role: Drone light-show studio
creators.role_zh: 无人机灯光秀工作室
creators.bio: Drone-show company that frames its shows as 'sky stories': thousands of lit drones recreate artworks and historical scenes, such as Michelangelo's Sistine Chapel over St. Peter's Square in 2025.
creators.bio_zh: 一家无人机表演公司，把演出定位为“天空故事”：成千上万架发光无人机在空中重现艺术品和历史场景，例如 2025 年在圣彼得广场上空再现米开朗基罗的西斯廷礼拜堂。
creators.why: Their shows are a live lesson in storyboarding for the sky: which images read from a crowd hundreds of metres away, and how long each one must hold.
creators.why_zh: 他们的演出是一堂现场的“天空分镜”课：哪些图像能让几百米外的人群看懂，每个画面要停留多久。

creators.name: Groupe F
creators.role: Pyrotechnic art company
creators.role_zh: 烟火艺术团体
creators.bio: French collective of pyrotechnicians and artists founded in 1990 that stages fireworks, light and drones as open-air theatre, including the Eiffel Tower shows for Paris National Day and the Paris 2024 Olympics.
creators.bio_zh: 成立于 1990 年的法国烟火艺术团体，把烟花、灯光和无人机做成露天剧场，作品包括巴黎国庆日埃菲尔铁塔烟火和 2024 年巴黎奥运会的烟火演出。
creators.why: They use a monument as the stage set and time fire to its architecture, the same move an AR show makes when it anchors effects to a landmark.
creators.why_zh: 他们把一座纪念建筑当作舞台布景，让火焰的节奏贴合建筑结构，这正是 AR 演出把特效锚定在地标上的做法。

creators.name: Berndnaut Smilde
creators.role: Artist; indoor clouds
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；室内云
creators.bio: Dutch artist whose Nimbus series creates a single real cloud inside a gallery or church with a fog machine and humidity, then photographs it in the seconds before it dissolves.
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰艺术家，他的《Nimbus》系列用烟雾机和湿度控制，在美术馆或教堂里造出一朵真实的云，并在它消散前的几秒钟把它拍下来。
creators.why: One misplaced weather object makes an ordinary room feel uncanny, the simplest possible version of an AR intervention.
creators.why_zh: 一个放错地方的天气物体就能让普通房间变得怪异，这是 AR 介入最简单的形式。

creators.name: Janet Echelman
creators.role: Artist; aerial net sculptures
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；空中网状雕塑
creators.bio: American artist who suspends vast knotted-fibre nets between buildings; the soft forms move with the wind and are lit at night, sometimes interactively, as in Skies Painted with Unnumbered Sparks for TED 2014.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，她把巨大的编结纤维网悬挂在建筑之间；柔软的形体随风而动，夜晚被灯光点亮，有时还能互动，例如为 2014 年 TED 创作的《Skies Painted with Unnumbered Sparks》。
creators.why: Her nets turn the empty volume above a street into a place people look up at and gather under, which is exactly the space most city AR leaves unused.
creators.why_zh: 她的网把街道上方的空旷体积变成人们抬头观看、聚集其下的场所，而这正是大多数城市 AR 没有利用的空间。

creators.name: Anthony McCall
creators.role: Artist; solid-light works
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；“固体光”作品
creators.bio: British-born artist whose 'solid light' films, starting with Line Describing a Cone (1973), project slowly moving lines through haze so that the beam itself becomes a walk-in sculpture.
creators.bio_zh: 出生于英国的艺术家，他的“固体光”影片从《Line Describing a Cone》（1973）开始，把缓慢移动的线条投射进薄雾中，让光束本身成为可以走进去的雕塑。
creators.why: He moved attention from the image on the wall to the light in the air between projector and wall, the very volume in which AR content lives.
creators.why_zh: 他把注意力从墙上的图像转移到投影机与墙之间空气中的光，而那正是 AR 内容所在的空间。

creators.name: James Turrell
creators.role: Artist; Light and Space
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；“光与空间”运动
creators.based_zh: 亚利桑那州弗拉格斯塔夫，美国
creators.bio: American artist who has spent five decades shaping light and perception: Skyspaces that frame the sky through an opening in a ceiling, Ganzfeld rooms without visible edges, and Roden Crater, a naked-eye observatory built into an extinct volcano.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，五十年来一直在塑造光与感知：在天花板上开口框住天空的 Skyspace、看不到边界的 Ganzfeld 房间，以及建在死火山中的肉眼天文台 Roden Crater。
creators.why: He proves that the most powerful 'display' is the real sky or a coloured void once you control the frame and the viewer's adaptation, a core lesson for passthrough and optical AR.
creators.why_zh: 他证明了：只要控制好取景框和观者的适应过程，真实的天空或一片彩色虚空就是最强大的“显示器”，这是透视式和光学 AR 的核心一课。

creators.name: Doug Wheeler
creators.role: Artist; Light and Space
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；“光与空间”运动
creators.based_zh: 新墨西哥州圣塔菲，美国
creators.bio: American artist of the Light and Space movement who builds rooms with curved, seamless walls and carefully tuned light so that visitors lose all sense of depth and distance.
creators.bio_zh: 美国“光与空间”运动艺术家，他建造墙面弯曲无缝、光线精细调校的房间，让观众完全失去对深度和距离的判断。
creators.why: His 'infinity environments' show how removing edges and corners dissolves the brain's depth cues, the opposite of what spatial tracking relies on.
creators.why_zh: 他的“无限环境”说明：去掉边缘和墙角就会瓦解大脑的深度线索，这恰恰与空间追踪所依赖的东西相反。

creators.name: Robert Irwin
creators.role: Artist; Light and Space
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；“光与空间”运动
creators.bio: American artist (1928–2023) who moved from painting to 'conditional' works: translucent scrims, tape lines and daylight that make visitors notice how they perceive a specific room, culminating in untitled (dawn to dusk) in Marfa.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家（1928–2023），从绘画转向“有条件的”作品：半透明纱幕、胶带线条和自然光，让观众意识到自己是如何感知某个具体房间的，代表作是位于马法的《untitled (dawn to dusk)》。
creators.why: He designed with the existing daylight and architecture instead of adding objects, a model for AR that responds to a site rather than covering it.
creators.why_zh: 他用现场已有的日光和建筑来设计，而不是往里添加物件，这为“回应场地而非覆盖场地”的 AR 提供了范例。

creators.name: Ryoji Ikeda (池田亮司)
creators.role: Artist and composer; data and light
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、作曲家；数据与光
creators.bio: Japanese artist and composer who turns raw data, sine tones and pure white light into massive immersive installations and performances such as test pattern, the transfinite and the searchlight piece spectra.
creators.bio_zh: 日本艺术家、作曲家，把原始数据、正弦波音和纯白光变成大型沉浸式装置和演出，例如《test pattern》《the transfinite》以及探照灯作品《spectra》。
creators.why: He shows how binary patterns, strict sync between sound and image, and scale can make pure information feel physical, useful for any AR data layer.
creators.why_zh: 他展示了二进制图案、声画严格同步和尺度如何让纯粹的信息变得有身体感，对任何 AR 数据层都有启发。

creators.name: Chris Fraser
creators.role: Artist; light and camera obscura installations
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；光与暗箱装置
creators.bio: American artist who builds dark rooms and structures where narrow slits and lenses turn daylight or lamps into moving planes and projections that visitors walk through.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，他建造暗室和结构，用窄缝和透镜把日光或灯光变成可供观众穿行的移动光面和投影。
creators.why: His rooms make the optics of image-making visible and walkable, a good bridge from camera obscura to AR passthrough.
creators.why_zh: 他的房间让成像的光学原理变得看得见、走得进，是从暗箱通往 AR 透视画面的一座桥梁。

creators.name: Ann Veronica Janssens
creators.role: Artist; light, fog and perception
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；光、雾与感知
creators.bio: Belgian artist who fills rooms with dense coloured mist so that visitors lose sight of walls and each other and move inside colour itself.
creators.bio_zh: 比利时艺术家，她用浓密的彩色雾气填满房间，让观众看不见墙壁、也看不清彼此，仿佛在颜色本身之中移动。
creators.why: Her fog rooms remove the world instead of adding to it, a reminder that 'diminished reality' can be as strong as augmented reality.
creators.why_zh: 她的雾之房间是在抹去世界而不是添加内容，提醒我们“减弱现实”可以和增强现实一样有力量。

creators.name: Liz West
creators.role: Artist; colour and light installations
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；色彩与光装置
creators.bio: British artist who makes large, saturated colour-light installations, such as Our Colour Reflection, a floor of hundreds of coloured mirrors that throws colour onto historic interiors.
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家，创作大尺度、高饱和的色光装置，例如《Our Colour Reflection》：地面上铺满数百面彩色镜子，把颜色投射到历史建筑的内部。
creators.why: Her pieces show how one simple repeated element can re-colour an entire building, a lesson in cheap, scalable spatial effects.
creators.why_zh: 她的作品说明，一个简单元素的大量重复就能为整栋建筑重新着色，这是低成本、可扩展空间效果的一课。

creators.name: Tatsuo Miyajima (宮島達男)
creators.role: Artist; LED counters
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；LED 数字计数器
creators.bio: Japanese artist whose LED digits count from 1 to 9 (never 0) at different speeds, representing lives and time, from the Roppongi wall Counter Void to the building-sized projection Time Waterfall.
creators.bio_zh: 日本艺术家，他的 LED 数字以不同速度从 1 数到 9（从不出现 0），象征生命与时间，作品从六本木的墙面《Counter Void》到覆盖整栋楼的投影《Time Waterfall》。
creators.why: He reduces a whole philosophy to one counting digit, proof that a tiny, repeated symbol can carry meaning in public space.
creators.why_zh: 他把一整套哲学浓缩成一个会计数的数字，证明一个微小而重复的符号也能在公共空间里承载意义。

creators.name: Leo Villareal
creators.role: Artist; LED light sculpture
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；LED 光雕塑
creators.bio: American artist who writes custom software to animate thousands of LEDs in never-repeating sequences, most famously on the San Francisco Bay Bridge in The Bay Lights.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，他编写定制软件，让成千上万颗 LED 以永不重复的序列变化，最著名的是在旧金山海湾大桥上的《The Bay Lights》。
creators.why: He turned existing infrastructure into a low-resolution display that reads from kilometres away, a model for city-scale AR layers.
creators.why_zh: 他把现有的基础设施变成从几公里外就能看清的低分辨率屏幕，是城市尺度 AR 图层的范例。

creators.name: Squidsoup
creators.role: Art collective; volumetric light
creators.role_zh: 艺术团体；体积光
creators.bio: International art collective led by Anthony Rowe that hangs thousands of individually controlled LED points in space to make walk-in volumetric displays such as Submergence.
creators.bio_zh: 由 Anthony Rowe 带领的国际艺术团体，在空间中悬挂数千个可单独控制的 LED 光点，组成可以走进去的体积显示器，例如《Submergence》。
creators.why: A grid of points you can walk through is a physical voxel display, the most direct real-world preview of 3D AR particles around the body.
creators.why_zh: 一个可以穿行其中的光点阵列就是实体的体素显示器，是身体周围 3D AR 粒子最直接的现实预演。

creators.name: Jim Campbell
creators.role: Artist and engineer; low-resolution LED works
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、工程师；低分辨率 LED 作品
creators.bio: American artist and electrical engineer whose sparse grids of LEDs show blurry moving figures that only resolve from a distance or in motion, as in Exploded Views and Scattered Light.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家、电子工程师，他用稀疏的 LED 阵列显示模糊的移动人影，只有在远处或运动中才能看清，例如《Exploded Views》和《Scattered Light》。
creators.why: He found how little information the brain needs to see a walking person, a key idea for lightweight AR avatars and low-bandwidth telepresence.
creators.why_zh: 他找到了大脑认出一个行走的人所需要的最少信息量，这对轻量化 AR 化身和低带宽远程临场是关键思路。

creators.name: Robert Henke
creators.role: Artist and composer; laser and audiovisual works
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、作曲家；激光与视听作品
creators.bio: German composer (Monolake) and co-developer of Ableton Live who makes precise laser and kinetic works, including the Lumière laser performances and kinetic pieces with Christopher Bauder.
creators.bio_zh: 德国作曲家（Monolake），Ableton Live 的共同开发者，创作精确的激光和动态作品，包括《Lumière》激光演出，以及与 Christopher Bauder 合作的动态装置。
creators.why: His laser pieces draw vector light in real space with perfect sync to sound, a lesson in how crisp, minimal graphics can fill a large volume.
creators.why_zh: 他的激光作品在真实空间里画出与声音完全同步的矢量光线，示范了极简清晰的图形如何填满巨大空间。

creators.name: Dan Flavin
creators.role: Artist; fluorescent light
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；荧光灯
creators.bio: American minimalist (1933–1996) who used standard coloured fluorescent tubes as his only material, placing them in corners, corridors and a Milan church to flood architecture with coloured light.
creators.bio_zh: 美国极简主义艺术家（1933–1996），只使用标准彩色荧光灯管作为材料，把它们放在墙角、走廊甚至米兰的一座教堂里，让建筑沉浸在彩色光中。
creators.why: With off-the-shelf tubes he showed that where you place a light matters more than the light itself, a lesson for placing any virtual light source.
creators.why_zh: 他用现成的灯管证明：灯放在哪里比灯本身更重要，这对放置任何虚拟光源都有借鉴意义。

creators.name: Leandro Erlich
creators.role: Artist; architectural illusions
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；建筑错觉
creators.based_zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯，阿根廷／巴黎，法国
creators.bio: Argentine artist who builds everyday architecture that behaves impossibly: a swimming pool you can stand under, a house facade people 'climb' via a giant mirror, a house hanging from a crane.
creators.bio_zh: 阿根廷艺术家，他搭建行为不可思议的日常建筑：人可以站在水下的泳池、借助巨大镜子让人“攀爬”的房屋立面、被吊车吊起的整栋房子。
creators.why: His works use one hidden device (a mirror, a thin layer of water) to break a familiar rule of the everyday, the exact recipe for a memorable AR moment.
creators.why_zh: 他的作品用一个隐藏的装置（一面镜子、一层薄水）打破日常中熟悉的规则，这正是令人难忘的 AR 瞬间的配方。

creators.name: Felice Varini
creators.role: Artist; anamorphic paintings
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；变形透视绘画
creators.bio: Swiss painter who paints fragments of circles, ellipses and lines across buildings, rooms and whole towns so that the shapes align into one perfect figure only from a single viewpoint.
creators.bio_zh: 瑞士画家，他把圆、椭圆和线条的碎片画在建筑、房间乃至整座小镇上，只有站在一个特定视点时，这些碎片才会拼成完整的图形。
creators.why: His paintings are pure viewpoint-dependent rendering in the real world, the same geometry as an AR overlay that lines up only from the phone's camera.
creators.why_zh: 他的绘画是现实世界中纯粹依赖视点的渲染，和只在手机摄像头视角下才对齐的 AR 叠加是同一种几何。

creators.name: Georges Rousse
creators.role: Artist and photographer; anamorphic interventions
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、摄影师；变形透视介入
creators.bio: French artist who paints shapes across the walls, floors and debris of abandoned buildings so that they read as a flat, floating figure from the camera position, then photographs the result.
creators.bio_zh: 法国艺术家，他在废弃建筑的墙面、地面和瓦砾上作画，让图形在相机位置看起来是一个平面、悬浮的形状，然后把结果拍摄下来。
creators.why: He composes for one lens in a real room, which is exactly the problem of designing for a phone camera in AR.
creators.why_zh: 他为真实房间中的一个镜头构图，这正是 AR 中为手机摄像头设计时面对的问题。

creators.name: Michael Murphy (Perceptual Art)
creators.role: Artist; perceptual sculptures
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；感知雕塑
creators.bio: American artist whose studio Perceptual Art hangs hundreds of objects on strings in a volume so that they snap into a single image, such as a portrait or a gun, only from one spot.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，他的工作室 Perceptual Art 把数百个物件用线悬挂在空间中，只有从某一个位置看，它们才会合成一幅图像，例如一张肖像或一把枪。
creators.why: His sculptures are hand-made point clouds that resolve from one camera pose, a physical lesson in how depth and projection work in AR.
creators.why_zh: 他的雕塑是手工制作的点云，只在一个相机位姿下成像，是理解 AR 中深度与投影关系的实物课。

creators.name: Kumi Yamashita
creators.role: Artist; light and shadow
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；光与影
creators.bio: Japanese artist who places carved wood, folded paper or cut shapes under a single light so that their shadows become faces and figures, and who also 'draws' portraits with one thread wound around nails.
creators.bio_zh: 日本艺术家，她把雕刻的木块、折叠的纸或切割的形状放在单一光源下，让影子变成人脸和人形；她还用一根线绕在钉子上“画”出肖像。
creators.why: Her shadow works show that the invisible part (the shadow) can be the real image, a good prompt for AR that designs the effect of an object rather than the object.
creators.why_zh: 她的影子作品说明，看不见的部分（影子）才可能是真正的图像，这启发 AR 去设计物体产生的效果，而不是物体本身。

creators.name: Tim Noble & Sue Webster
creators.role: Artist duo; shadow sculptures
creators.role_zh: 艺术家组合；影子雕塑
creators.bio: British artist duo who pile rubbish, scrap metal or taxidermy into shapeless heaps that, lit from one lamp, cast precise shadow portraits of the two artists.
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家组合，他们把垃圾、废金属或动物标本堆成毫无形状的一堆，在一盏灯的照射下，却投出两位艺术家精确的侧影肖像。
creators.why: Their shadow sculptures prove that a chaotic object can hide an exact image for one light direction, the same logic as a projection that lines up only from one pose.
creators.why_zh: 他们的影子雕塑证明：一堆混乱的物体可以在一个光线方向上藏着一幅精确的图像，这与只在一个位姿下对齐的投影是同一逻辑。

creators.name: Shigeo Fukuda (福田繁雄)
creators.role: Graphic designer and sculptor; visual tricks
creators.role_zh: 平面设计师、雕塑家；视觉把戏
creators.bio: Japanese designer (1932–2009) famous for posters and sculptures built on visual tricks, such as Lunch with a Helmet On, a heap of welded cutlery whose shadow is a motorcycle.
creators.bio_zh: 日本设计师（1932–2009），以建立在视觉把戏上的海报和雕塑闻名，例如《Lunch with a Helmet On》：一堆焊接起来的餐具，影子却是一辆摩托车。
creators.why: He designed with a wink: the surprise comes from the gap between the object and what it projects, which is where good AR humour lives too.
creators.why_zh: 他的设计带着一种眨眼式的幽默：惊喜来自物体与它投射出的形象之间的落差，好的 AR 幽默也在这里。

creators.name: Patrick Hughes
creators.role: Artist; reverspective paintings
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；反透视绘画
creators.bio: British artist who invented 'reverspective': paintings on protruding pyramid-shaped panels where perspective is painted in reverse, so the scene seems to move and turn as the viewer walks past.
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家，发明了“反透视”：在凸起的金字塔形画板上反向绘制透视，观众走过时，画面仿佛在移动、转动。
creators.why: His paintings show how conflicting depth cues make a static object feel alive under a moving viewer, a trick AR can reuse with parallax.
creators.why_zh: 他的画作说明，相互冲突的深度线索会让静止物体在观者移动时显得有生命，AR 可以借助视差复用这个技巧。

creators.name: Yayoi Kusama (草間彌生)
creators.role: Artist; Infinity Mirror Rooms
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；无限镜屋
creators.bio: Japanese artist whose obsession with repetition and dots produced the Infinity Mirror Rooms, where mirrors multiply lights or objects into endless space, and the participatory Obliteration Room.
creators.bio_zh: 日本艺术家，她对重复和圆点的执念催生了“无限镜屋”，镜子把灯光或物体复制成无尽的空间；还有观众共同参与的《Obliteration Room》。
creators.why: Her mirror rooms create an infinite world inside a closet-sized box, the classic analogue portal and a benchmark for AR portal design.
creators.why_zh: 她的镜屋在一个衣柜大小的盒子里创造出无限的世界，是经典的模拟传送门，也是 AR 传送门设计的标杆。

creators.name: Chiharu Shiota (塩田千春)
creators.role: Artist; thread installations
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；线的装置
creators.bio: Japanese artist who weaves kilometres of red or black thread through rooms, around keys, shoes, boats or beds, turning memories into dense walk-in webs.
creators.bio_zh: 日本艺术家，她用数千米的红线或黑线编织整个房间，缠绕钥匙、鞋子、小船或床，把记忆变成可以走进去的密网。
creators.why: Her installations show how filling the air with one repeated line can make an invisible network of connections visible, a direct cue for AR data and relationship visualisation.
creators.why_zh: 她的装置说明，用一种重复的线填满空气，就能让看不见的连接网络显形，这直接启发 AR 的数据与关系可视化。

creators.name: Ernesto Neto
creators.role: Artist; soft walk-in sculptures
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；可进入的柔软雕塑
creators.bio: Brazilian artist who builds huge crocheted and stretch-fabric environments, often filled with spices or scented seeds, that visitors walk through, lie in and touch.
creators.bio_zh: 巴西艺术家，他用钩织和弹力织物搭建巨大的空间，里面常常装着香料或种子，观众可以穿行、躺卧和触摸。
creators.why: His soft architecture invites the whole body and smell into the experience, a reminder that immersive design is more than visuals.
creators.why_zh: 他的柔软建筑把整个身体和嗅觉都带入体验，提醒我们沉浸式设计不只是视觉。

creators.name: Es Devlin
creators.role: Artist and stage designer
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、舞台设计师
creators.bio: British artist and stage designer known for rotating sculptures, mirror mazes and light-and-text installations for public spaces, and for stage sets for opera, the Olympics, Beyoncé and The Weeknd.
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家、舞台设计师，以旋转雕塑、镜面迷宫和公共空间中的光与文字装置闻名，也为歌剧、奥运会、Beyoncé 和 The Weeknd 设计舞台。
creators.why: She combines mirrors, projection, text and live voices into public artworks that people complete by taking part, a model for participatory AR.
creators.why_zh: 她把镜子、投影、文字和现场人声结合成公共艺术，由参与者来完成作品，是参与式 AR 的范例。

creators.name: Philippe Parreno
creators.role: Artist; exhibitions as automated systems
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；作为自动系统的展览
creators.bio: French artist who treats exhibitions as scores: lights, screens, blinds, sound and floating objects are run by software or living systems, as in Anywhen at Tate Modern's Turbine Hall.
creators.bio_zh: 法国艺术家，把展览当作乐谱：灯光、屏幕、百叶、声音和漂浮物由软件或生命系统控制，例如泰特现代美术馆涡轮大厅的《Anywhen》。
creators.why: He designs space as a timeline of events rather than a set of objects, the right mindset for AR experiences that unfold over time.
creators.why_zh: 他把空间设计成一条事件的时间线，而不是一组物件，这正是随时间展开的 AR 体验所需要的思维。

creators.name: Joon Moon (Joon Y. Moon / 문준용)
creators.role: Media artist; creator of the Augmented Shadow series
creators.bio: South Korean media artist and engineer whose Augmented Shadow series (since 2010) mixes real objects and light with computer-generated shadows; the first piece was shown in MoMA's 2011 Talk to Me exhibition.
creators.why: He turns the humble shadow into an AR display, so the magic happens on the floor and wall instead of on a screen.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家；「增强影子」（Augmented Shadow）系列作者
creators.bio_zh: 韩国媒体艺术家兼工程师，自 2010 年起创作 Augmented Shadow 系列，把真实物体、灯光与计算机生成的影子混在一起；系列首作曾入选 MoMA 2011 年的 Talk to Me 展览。
creators.why_zh: 他把最普通的影子变成 AR 显示器，魔法发生在地面和墙上，而不是屏幕里。

creators.name: Lee Vermeulen
creators.role: Game developer (Alientrap, Modbox); XR physics prototyper
creators.bio: Co-founder of the indie studio Alientrap and creator of the VR/MR sandbox Modbox, he posts short passthrough-AR prototypes that combine hand tracking with liquid physics, portals and mirrors.
creators.why: His quick tests show how much playful magic comes from letting real hands touch simulated matter in your own room.
creators.role_zh: 游戏开发者（Alientrap、Modbox）；XR 物理原型作者
creators.bio_zh: 独立工作室 Alientrap 联合创始人、VR/MR 沙盒 Modbox 的作者，常发布透视 AR 小原型，把手部追踪与液体物理、传送门和镜子结合起来。
creators.why_zh: 他的快速实验说明：只要让真实的手去碰模拟出来的物质，自家房间就能变得好玩又神奇。

creators.name: THÉORIZ (David-Alexandre Chanel, Jonathan Richer & team)
creators.role: Art and technology studio; developers of the Augmenta tracking system
creators.bio: Lyon studio that builds immersive installations and live shows and developed Augmenta, a people-tracking system; in 2017 it combined VR trackers with projection mapping to create a perspective-correct mixed-reality room.
creators.why: They showed that a plain white room plus tracking and projectors can feel like a holodeck without anyone wearing a headset.
creators.role_zh: 艺术与技术工作室；Augmenta 人体追踪系统的开发者
creators.bio_zh: 里昂的工作室，制作沉浸式装置与现场演出，并开发了人体追踪系统 Augmenta；2017 年他们把 VR 追踪器与投影映射结合，做出了透视正确的混合现实房间。
creators.why_zh: 他们证明了：一间白房子加上追踪和投影，不戴头显也能有“全息甲板”的感觉。

creators.name: Iregular (Daniel Iregui)
creators.role: Digital art studio making interactive audiovisual installations
creators.bio: Montreal studio founded in 2010 by Colombian-Canadian artist Daniel Iregui; its minimal, generative installations react to the bodies and sounds of the visitors who enter them.
creators.why: Iregular's pieces make the audience the input device, turning a whole room into a reactive surface.
creators.role_zh: 制作交互式视听装置的数字艺术工作室
creators.bio_zh: 由哥伦比亚裔加拿大艺术家 Daniel Iregui 于 2010 年创立的蒙特利尔工作室，其极简的生成式装置会对走进来的观众的身体和声音做出反应。
creators.why_zh: Iregular 的作品把观众本身当成输入设备，让整个空间变成会回应的表面。

creators.name: MAOTIK (Mathieu Le Sourd)
creators.role: New media artist; immersive and interactive installations
creators.bio: French digital artist based in Montreal who designs immersive environments and interactive floors where generative visuals and sound respond to how people move through the space.
creators.why: His projected floors turn walking into painting and composing, a clear model of whole-body spatial interaction.
creators.role_zh: 新媒体艺术家；沉浸式与交互装置
creators.bio_zh: 旅居蒙特利尔的法国数字艺术家，设计沉浸式环境和交互地面，生成式影像与声音会随人们在空间中的移动而变化。
creators.why_zh: 他的投影地面让走路变成作画和作曲，是全身空间交互的清晰范例。

creators.name: Ksawery Komputery (Ksawery Kirklewski)
creators.role: New media artist and studio; interactive light installations
creators.bio: Studio led by new media artist Ksawery Kirklewski that builds large interactive LED installations on its own software and hardware, such as ENTER and FLUX, which mirror visitors as streams of light.
creators.why: His doorway-sized light pieces translate a person's silhouette and sound into light in real time, a physical cousin of the AR mirror.
creators.role_zh: 新媒体艺术家与工作室；交互式灯光装置
creators.bio_zh: 由新媒体艺术家 Ksawery Kirklewski 领导的工作室，用自研软硬件打造大型交互 LED 装置，例如 ENTER 和 FLUX，把观众映照成一道道光流。
creators.why_zh: 他那些门框大小的灯光作品，把人的轮廓和声音实时转译成光，像是 AR 镜子的实体版本。

creators.name: Lachlan Turczan
creators.role: Artist working with light, water and sound
creators.bio: American artist who has spent a decade exploring the optical and sonic properties of water and light; his Lucida light sculptures premiered at Milan Design Week 2025.
creators.why: He sculpts rooms out of pure light that responds to the body, a reminder that spatial media can be made of photons alone.
creators.role_zh: 以光、水和声音创作的艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，十年来一直研究水与光的光学和声学特性；他的 Lucida 光雕塑在 2025 年米兰设计周首次亮相。
creators.why_zh: 他用会回应身体的纯光来塑造空间，提醒我们空间媒体可以只由光构成。

creators.name: Studio Roosegaarde (Daan Roosegaarde)
creators.role: Design lab creating interactive landscapes of light
creators.bio: Daan Roosegaarde's studio makes 'techno-poetic' public works; DUNE, an interactive landscape of light fibres first installed along Rotterdam's Maastunnel, brightens as people walk and make sound.
creators.why: DUNE shows how responsive light can augment a public path without any screen or device.
creators.role_zh: 创作交互式光景观的设计实验室
creators.bio_zh: Daan Roosegaarde 的工作室以“技术诗意”的公共作品著称；DUNE 是一片由光纤组成的交互光景观，最早装在鹿特丹 Maastunnel 旁，行人走过或发出声音时就会亮起。
creators.why_zh: DUNE 说明响应式灯光不靠任何屏幕或设备，也能增强一条公共道路。

creators.name: Filipe Peregrino
creators.role: Graphic designer; multilingual AR typography
creators.bio: Brazilian graphic designer based in London whose London College of Communication project The Languages Around Us places animated, multi-script type installations into real spaces with AR.
creators.why: He uses AR type to make a city's invisible linguistic diversity visible, a strong example of AR as cultural storytelling.
creators.role_zh: 平面设计师；多语种 AR 字体设计
creators.bio_zh: 旅居伦敦的巴西平面设计师，他在伦敦传媒学院的毕业项目 The Languages Around Us 用 AR 把会动的多文字字体装置放进真实空间。
creators.why_zh: 他用 AR 字体把城市里看不见的语言多样性呈现出来，是把 AR 用于文化叙事的好例子。

creators.name: Masahiko Sato + EUPHRATES
creators.role: Creative group making educational media and experimental films
creators.bio: Group founded by Masahiko Sato (creator of Pythagora Switch) that turns ways of thinking into films, exhibitions and TV; Ballet Rotoscope (2011) traces a ballerina's movement into geometric curves.
creators.why: Their work makes invisible structure — motion paths, rules, geometry — visible, the core move of good information-layer AR.
creators.role_zh: 制作教育媒体与实验影像的创意团体
creators.bio_zh: 由佐藤雅彦（《毕达哥拉斯开关》创作者）发起的团体，把“思考方式”做成影像、展览和电视节目；《Ballet Rotoscope》（2011）把芭蕾舞者的动作描成几何曲线。
creators.why_zh: 他们把看不见的结构——运动轨迹、规则、几何——变得可见，这正是好的信息层 AR 的核心手法。

creators.name: PARRATORO (Rafael Parra Toro)
creators.role: Kinetic and optical artist; AR op-art books
creators.bio: Venezuelan-born artist-engineer based in Buenos Aires who makes op-art and kinetic prints and books, from the lenticular POP ON OP to the phone-activated POP AR.
creators.why: He extends op art's optical tricks into AR, so printed geometry literally lifts off the page.
creators.role_zh: 动态与光效艺术家；AR 欧普艺术书
creators.based_zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯，阿根廷
creators.bio_zh: 出生于委内瑞拉、定居布宜诺斯艾利斯的艺术家兼工程师，创作欧普艺术和动态印刷品与书籍，从光栅书 POP ON OP 到用手机激活的 POP AR。
creators.why_zh: 他把欧普艺术的视错觉延伸到 AR 里，让印刷的几何图形真的从书页上浮起来。

creators.name: Ouchhh (Ferdi Alıcı & Eylül Duranağaç)
creators.role: New media studio; data sculptures and projection mapping
creators.bio: Studio founded by Ferdi Alıcı and Eylül Duranağaç, known for AI and data-driven projections; their 2016 Dare to Dream combined real-time face tracking with face projection mapping.
creators.why: Dare to Dream is a clear early case of projecting live, tracked imagery onto a moving human face.
creators.role_zh: 新媒体工作室；数据雕塑与投影映射
creators.bio_zh: 由 Ferdi Alıcı 与 Eylül Duranağaç 创立的工作室，以 AI 与数据驱动的投影闻名；2016 年的 Dare to Dream 把实时人脸追踪与面部投影映射结合在一起。
creators.why_zh: Dare to Dream 是把实时追踪的影像投到一张会动的人脸上的早期清晰案例。

creators.name: Nicola Buttari (PROFORMA Videodesign)
creators.role: Video designer; projection mapping on large surfaces and garments
creators.bio: Italian video designer behind the PROFORMA studio, specialising in projection mapping on buildings, stages and fashion, often driven by Kinect depth cameras.
creators.why: His t-shirt mapping turns clothing into a live, body-tracked projection canvas.
creators.role_zh: 影像设计师；在大型表面与服装上做投影映射
creators.bio_zh: 意大利影像设计师，PROFORMA 工作室负责人，专注于在建筑、舞台和时装上做投影映射，常用 Kinect 深度相机驱动。
creators.why_zh: 他的 T 恤投影把衣服变成一块会跟着身体走的实时投影画布。

creators.name: Pixelcase
creators.role: Immersive media studio (VR, 360 video, AR)
creators.bio: Australian immersive studio founded in 2007 that produces VR, 360 video and AR experiences; in 2018 it shared AR portals captured at the Hobbiton movie set in New Zealand.
creators.why: Its Hobbiton portal is a textbook example of the walk-through AR portal that later became a standard mobile AR pattern.
creators.role_zh: 沉浸式媒体工作室（VR、360 视频、AR）
creators.bio_zh: 成立于 2007 年的澳大利亚沉浸式工作室，制作 VR、360 视频和 AR 体验；2018 年他们分享了在新西兰霍比屯片场拍摄的 AR 传送门。
creators.why_zh: 霍比屯传送门是“可走进的 AR 传送门”的教科书式例子，这种形式后来成了手机 AR 的常见模式。

creators.name: Onat Hekimoglu & Tobias Kreter
creators.role: Game designers (Cologne Game Lab); creators of Klanglichter
creators.bio: Onat Hekimoglu and Tobias Kreter built Klanglichter at Cologne Game Lab, a laser harp reimagined as the controller of an audiovisual game.
creators.why: Klanglichter makes light beams both the interface and the instrument, a tangible alternative to screen-based play.
creators.role_zh: 游戏设计师（Cologne Game Lab）；Klanglichter 的作者
creators.bio_zh: Onat Hekimoglu 与 Tobias Kreter 在科隆游戏实验室（Cologne Game Lab）制作了 Klanglichter，把激光竖琴改造成一款视听游戏的控制器。
creators.why_zh: Klanglichter 让光束同时成为界面和乐器，是屏幕游戏之外的可触摸替代方案。

creators.name: Henry Daubrez & Samuel Honigstein (Dogstudio / KIKK in Town)
creators.role: Curators and producers of the KIKK Festival 2018 AR art exhibit
creators.bio: Dogstudio founders Henry Daubrez and Samuel Honigstein conceived and produced the first AR art exhibit of KIKK in Town (2018): seven code-generated pieces by creative coders such as Bruno Simon, Matt DesLauriers and Edan Kwan, unlocked around Namur.
creators.why: It is a compact model for curating a city-wide AR exhibition of generative art.
creators.role_zh: KIKK 艺术节 2018 年 AR 艺术展的策展人与制作人
creators.bio_zh: Dogstudio 创始人 Henry Daubrez 与 Samuel Honigstein 构思并制作了首届 KIKK in Town（2018）的 AR 艺术展：七件由 Bruno Simon、Matt DesLauriers、Edan Kwan 等创意编程者创作的代码生成作品，分布在那慕尔城中等待解锁。
creators.why_zh: 这是策划一场全城范围生成艺术 AR 展的精简范例。

creators.name: Shahriar Shahrabi
creators.role: Technical artist and graphics programmer
creators.role_zh: 技术美术、图形程序员
creators.bio: Iranian technical artist in Berlin who open-sources his Unity shader and compute-shader studies (fluids, Matrix code rain, procedural painting) with long blog breakdowns.
creators.bio_zh: 生活在柏林的伊朗技术美术，把自己在 Unity 里做的着色器和计算着色器研究（流体、黑客帝国代码雨、程序化绘画）连同详细的博客拆解一起开源。
creators.why: Each of his experiments turns one graphics idea into a striking image and ships the full repo plus a step-by-step article, ideal for students.
creators.why_zh: 他的每个实验都把一个图形学点子做成一幅抓人的画面，并同时公开完整代码和逐步讲解的文章，非常适合教学。

creators.name: Sebastian Lague
creators.role: Programmer and educator; creator of the Coding Adventures series
creators.role_zh: 程序员、教育者；《Coding Adventures》系列作者
creators.bio: Makes the Coding Adventures videos, in which he builds fluids, ray marchers, clouds and boids from scratch in Unity and releases every project on GitHub.
creators.bio_zh: 《Coding Adventures》视频的作者：在 Unity 里从零实现流体、光线步进、体积云和鸟群，并把每个项目都放到 GitHub 上。
creators.why: He makes hard real-time graphics techniques feel approachable, and each video comes with a project students can open and change.
creators.why_zh: 他把高难度的实时图形技术讲得平易近人，每个视频都配有学生可以直接打开修改的工程。

creators.name: Mirza Beig
creators.role: Technical artist and VFX developer for Unity
creators.role_zh: Unity 技术美术与特效开发者
creators.bio: Unity VFX developer who posts shader and particle experiments almost every week and releases many of them as free open-source projects.
creators.bio_zh: Unity 特效开发者，几乎每周都会发布着色器和粒子实验，其中很多作为免费开源项目发布。
creators.why: His open repos (scan pulse, textureless fog, chromatic bubble, constellation ribbons) are compact, beautiful effects that drop straight into an AR scene.
creators.why_zh: 他开源的扫描波、无贴图雾、色散气泡、星座丝带等特效小巧精美，可以直接放进 AR 场景。

creators.name: hecomi
creators.role: Unity engineer and graphics blogger
creators.role_zh: Unity 工程师、图形技术博主
creators.bio: Japanese Unity engineer behind uRaymarching, UnityFurURP and uLipSync, who documents each experiment in depth on his blog tips.hecomi.com.
creators.bio_zh: 日本 Unity 工程师，uRaymarching、UnityFurURP、uLipSync 的作者，会在博客 tips.hecomi.com 上详细记录每个实验。
creators.why: His raymarching generator, fur shader and depth-sensor tricks are widely used open tools for mixing shader worlds with real geometry.
creators.why_zh: 他的光线步进生成器、毛发着色器和深度传感器技巧都是被广泛使用的开源工具，能把着色器世界和真实几何融合在一起。

creators.name: Hironori Sugino (sugi-cho)
creators.role: Freelance creative programmer
creators.role_zh: 自由创意程序员
creators.bio: Tokyo freelance programmer who builds GPU particle, projection-mapping and depth-camera visuals for installations and VJ sets, and co-authored the Unity Graphics Programming books.
creators.bio_zh: 东京的自由程序员，为装置和 VJ 演出制作 GPU 粒子、投影映射和深度相机视觉，也是《Unity Graphics Programming》系列的作者之一。
creators.why: His projection spray and screen-space particle collision show how to make virtual paint and particles respect real surfaces, which is the core problem of AR.
creators.why_zh: 他的投影喷漆和屏幕空间粒子碰撞展示了如何让虚拟颜料和粒子遵循真实表面，这正是 AR 的核心问题。

creators.name: Yuma Yanagisawa
creators.role: Media artist and creative coder
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家、创意程序员
creators.bio: Japanese artist who works with shaders, VFX Graph and data, from raindrop and ripple shaders to large projected data sculptures and AI flower pieces.
creators.bio_zh: 日本艺术家，用着色器、VFX Graph 和数据创作，从雨滴、水波着色器到大型投影数据雕塑和 AI 花卉作品。
creators.why: He publishes the Unity source of many of his shader studies, so students can go from a single effect to an installation.
creators.why_zh: 他公开了许多着色器习作的 Unity 源码，学生可以从一个单独的特效一路做到装置作品。

creators.name: Kodai Takao
creators.role: Computer graphics engineer specialising in physics simulation and live performance
creators.role_zh: 专注物理模拟与现场演出的图形工程师
creators.bio: Tokyo graphics engineer who implements fluid, snow and flocking simulations on the GPU in Unity and builds real-time visuals for live shows.
creators.bio_zh: 东京的图形工程师，在 Unity 里用 GPU 实现流体、雪和鸟群模拟，并为现场演出制作实时视觉。
creators.why: His open implementations of Position Based Fluids, FLIP and GPU boids are clear starting points for physically convincing AR effects.
creators.why_zh: 他开源的 Position Based Fluids、FLIP 流体和 GPU 鸟群实现，是做出物理上可信的 AR 特效的清晰起点。

creators.name: fuqunaga
creators.role: Game and interactive-art programmer
creators.role_zh: 游戏与互动艺术程序员
creators.bio: Japanese interactive-art programmer who open-sources compute-shader tools for Unity such as GpuTrail, VatBaker and RosettaUI.
creators.bio_zh: 日本互动艺术程序员，开源了 GpuTrail、VatBaker、RosettaUI 等 Unity 计算着色器工具。
creators.why: His GPU trails and VFX Graph hacks show how to push hundreds of thousands of moving lines and runtime point caches in real time.
creators.why_zh: 他的 GPU 拖尾和 VFX Graph 技巧展示了如何实时驱动几十万条运动线条和运行时点缓存。

creators.name: Andrei Iurin (NullTale)
creators.role: Indie developer and Unity VFX tool maker
creators.role_zh: 独立开发者、Unity 特效工具作者
creators.bio: Indie developer publishing as NullTale, who releases URP post-processing and lighting tools such as VolFx, GiLight2D, AsciiFx and PixelationFx.
creators.bio_zh: 以 NullTale 名义发布作品的独立开发者，开源了 VolFx、GiLight2D、AsciiFx、PixelationFx 等 URP 后期与光照工具。
creators.why: His tools apply stylised post effects to selected layers only, which is exactly what AR needs to restyle virtual content without touching the camera feed.
creators.why_zh: 他的工具可以只对选定图层做风格化后期，这正是 AR 需要的：只改虚拟内容，不动相机画面。

creators.name: Unity Visual Effect Graph team (Thomas Iché, Julien Fryer, Vlad Neykov and the Unity Demo Team)
creators.role: Unity Technologies team that builds VFX Graph and its showcase samples
creators.role_zh: Unity 公司中开发 VFX Graph 及其示范样例的团队
creators.bio: The Unity team behind the Visual Effect Graph, who publish the Spaceship Demo, the VFX Graph sample scenes and demo-team tools such as Mesh-to-SDF as open projects.
creators.bio_zh: 开发 Visual Effect Graph 的 Unity 团队，公开了 Spaceship Demo、VFX Graph 样例场景以及 Mesh-to-SDF 等演示团队工具。
creators.why: Their samples are the reference implementations every VFX Graph artist learns from, and they run as downloadable projects.
creators.why_zh: 他们的样例是每个 VFX Graph 创作者都会学习的参考实现，而且都是可以下载运行的工程。

creators.name: Dilmer Valecillos
creators.role: XR developer and educator (Learn XR)
creators.role_zh: XR 开发者与教育者（Learn XR）
creators.bio: XR developer who teaches AR Foundation, Quest and VFX Graph on YouTube and shares every tutorial project on GitHub.
creators.bio_zh: XR 开发者，在 YouTube 上教授 AR Foundation、Quest 和 VFX Graph，并把每个教程工程都放在 GitHub 上。
creators.why: He was among the first to show VFX Graph running inside AR Foundation and Quest hand tracking, with code students can reuse.
creators.why_zh: 他是最早演示 VFX Graph 在 AR Foundation 和 Quest 手部追踪中运行的人之一，代码可直接复用。

creators.name: Daniel Ilett
creators.role: Shader educator and indie developer
creators.role_zh: 着色器教育者、独立开发者
creators.bio: UK developer and PhD researcher who teaches Unity shaders on YouTube and his blog, recreating effects from games such as Antichamber and Portal.
creators.bio_zh: 英国开发者和博士研究者，在 YouTube 和博客上教 Unity 着色器，复刻《Antichamber》《Portal》等游戏中的效果。
creators.why: His stencil-shader projects make impossible spaces and portals easy to understand, which translates directly into AR portals.
creators.why_zh: 他的模板缓冲着色器项目让不可能空间和传送门变得易懂，可以直接转化为 AR 传送门。

creators.name: NoiseCrime
creators.role: Unity developer and graphics experimenter
creators.role_zh: Unity 开发者、图形实验者
creators.bio: Long-time Unity developer who publishes rendering experiments such as stencil portal cubes and instanced-indirect examples.
creators.bio_zh: 资深 Unity 开发者，发布了模板缓冲传送门立方体、间接实例化等渲染实验。
creators.why: His Portal Room Cubes demo is the classic open example of fitting several rooms inside one small box with the stencil buffer.
creators.why_zh: 他的 Portal Room Cubes 是用模板缓冲把好几个房间塞进一个小盒子的经典开源示例。

creators.name: Kaito Tsutsumi (にー兄さん / drumath2237)
creators.role: Software engineer working on WebXR, VFX Graph and Gaussian splatting
creators.role_zh: 从事 WebXR、VFX Graph 和高斯泼溅的软件工程师
creators.bio: Japanese engineer who publishes Azure Kinect + VFX Graph samples, a generative music-video pipeline, and Babylon.js / Gaussian splatting tools.
creators.bio_zh: 日本工程师，发布了 Azure Kinect + VFX Graph 样例、生成式音乐视频流程，以及 Babylon.js 和高斯泼溅工具。
creators.why: His small, well-documented repos connect depth sensors, SDFs and sound to VFX Graph, bridging to WebXR.
creators.why_zh: 他的小型仓库文档清楚，把深度传感器、SDF 和声音接到 VFX Graph 上，并延伸到 WebXR。

creators.name: Adrián Ciborro Montes
creators.role: Software engineer working on graphics and AI-driven streaming
creators.role_zh: 从事图形与 AI 驱动直播的软件工程师
creators.bio: Spanish engineer who published a Unity project that turns webcam-based 3D pose estimation into VFX Graph particles.
creators.bio_zh: 西班牙工程师，发布了一个把基于摄像头的三维姿态估计变成 VFX Graph 粒子的 Unity 项目。
creators.why: His mocap-vfx repo is a compact, open example of neural pose tracking driving particles on a normal webcam.
creators.why_zh: 他的 mocap-vfx 仓库是一个紧凑的开源示例：用普通摄像头的神经网络姿态追踪来驱动粒子。

creators.name: Dan Miller
creators.role: XR developer advocate; former Unity AR evangelist
creators.role_zh: XR 开发者布道师，前 Unity AR 技术布道师
creators.bio: San Francisco XR developer who spent years at Unity showing how AR Foundation works, and who open-sourced small samples that put URP post-processing, Shader Graph and VFX Graph on top of the phone camera.
creators.bio_zh: 旧金山的 XR 开发者，在 Unity 工作多年，专门演示 AR Foundation 的用法，并开源了一批小样例，把 URP 后处理、Shader Graph 和 VFX Graph 叠加到手机摄像头画面上。
creators.why: His minimal repos were among the first to prove that Unity's high-end VFX tools run in mobile AR, so they are ideal starting projects for students.
creators.why_zh: 他的精简仓库最早证明了 Unity 的高端特效工具可以在手机 AR 里运行，是学生入门的理想起点工程。

creators.name: Marek Šimoník (Record3D)
creators.role: Developer of the Record3D app
creators.role_zh: Record3D 应用开发者
creators.bio: Independent developer of Record3D, an iPhone/iPad app that records and streams TrueDepth and LiDAR depth video, with open Unity demos that feed the stream into VFX Graph.
creators.bio_zh: 独立开发者，开发了 Record3D：一款能录制并实时传输 iPhone/iPad 的 TrueDepth 与 LiDAR 深度视频的应用，并开源了把这路数据送进 VFX Graph 的 Unity 示例。
creators.why: Record3D turned any recent iPhone into a Kinect-style depth camera for real-time VFX, and his demo repo shows the whole pipeline.
creators.why_zh: Record3D 让任何一台较新的 iPhone 都能变成类似 Kinect 的实时特效深度相机，他的示例仓库完整展示了这条管线。

creators.name: Koki Ibukuro (asus4)
creators.role: Freelance creative technologist
creators.role_zh: 自由职业创意技术专家
creators.bio: Japanese creative technologist in Berlin who maintains the TensorFlow Lite and ONNX Runtime plugins for Unity and builds AR experiments that run neural networks on the phone camera in real time.
creators.bio_zh: 生活在柏林的日本创意技术专家，维护 Unity 的 TensorFlow Lite 与 ONNX Runtime 插件，并用它们做在手机摄像头上实时运行神经网络的 AR 实验。
creators.why: He makes on-device machine learning usable for AR artists, and his experiments show what segmentation and face models can do as visual effects.
creators.why_zh: 他让端侧机器学习真正能被 AR 艺术家使用，他的实验展示了分割和人脸模型作为视觉特效能做什么。

creators.name: Satoshi Hattori
creators.role: iOS and visionOS engineer
creators.role_zh: iOS 与 visionOS 工程师
creators.bio: Tokyo engineer who ran a public '100 days AR challenge' in 2021, posting one ARKit, Metal or Unity effect per day with the source on GitHub, and later did the same for visionOS.
creators.bio_zh: 东京的工程师，2021 年在网上发起“100 天 AR 挑战”，每天发布一个用 ARKit、Metal 或 Unity 实现的效果并把源码放到 GitHub，后来又为 visionOS 做了同样的挑战。
creators.why: His daily LiDAR, people-occlusion and face-mesh sketches form an open library of AR effects that each fit in one small, readable project.
creators.why_zh: 他每天一个的 LiDAR、人物遮挡和人脸网格小作品，构成了一个开源的 AR 特效库，每个效果都是一个小而易读的工程。

creators.name: Thomas Ratliff
creators.role: Indie XR game developer
creators.role_zh: 独立 XR 游戏开发者
creators.bio: Independent VR/MR game developer (Party Crashers) who posts mixed-reality experiments on Meta Quest 3, from passthrough camera shaders to LiDAR-style particle scans of his room.
creators.bio_zh: 独立 VR/MR 游戏开发者（代表作 Party Crashers），经常发布在 Meta Quest 3 上做的混合现实实验，从透视摄像头着色器到像 LiDAR 一样扫描房间的粒子效果。
creators.why: He treats the Quest passthrough image as a canvas and contributed his camera shaders to an open-source toolkit.
creators.why_zh: 他把 Quest 的透视画面当作画布，并把自己的摄像头着色器贡献给了一个开源工具包。

creators.name: Roberto Coviello
creators.role: XR and AI engineer
creators.role_zh: XR 与 AI 工程师
creators.bio: Zurich-based XR engineer who maintains QuestCameraKit, an open collection of Unity samples for the Meta Quest Passthrough Camera API: color sampling, object detection, camera shaders and streaming.
creators.bio_zh: 常驻苏黎世的 XR 工程师，维护 QuestCameraKit：一套基于 Meta Quest 透视摄像头 API 的开源 Unity 示例，包括取色、物体检测、摄像头着色器和视频推流。
creators.why: QuestCameraKit is the most complete open starting point for effects that read the headset's real camera image.
creators.why_zh: QuestCameraKit 是目前最完整的开源起点，可以做读取头显真实摄像头画面的特效。

creators.name: Julien Kipp (julienkay)
creators.role: XR and neural-rendering developer
creators.role_zh: XR 与神经渲染开发者
creators.bio: German Unity developer who ports research renderers to Unity, including MobileNeRF, SNeRG and MERF viewers, Google's layered light-field video and Sentis packages for depth estimation and diffusion.
creators.bio_zh: 德国的 Unity 开发者，把研究界的渲染方法移植进 Unity，包括 MobileNeRF、SNeRG、MERF 查看器，Google 的分层光场视频，以及用于深度估计和扩散模型的 Sentis 插件。
creators.why: He makes neural and volumetric capture formats playable in a game engine and on headsets, with every port open-sourced.
creators.why_zh: 他让神经渲染和体积捕捉格式能在游戏引擎和头显里直接播放，而且所有移植都开源。

creators.name: Jure Triglav
creators.role: WebXR and open-science software developer
creators.role_zh: WebXR 与开放科学软件开发者
creators.based_zh: 卢布尔雅那，斯洛文尼亚
creators.bio: Slovenian developer who builds open-science tools and WebXR experiments, including Shaderworlds, which puts raymarched Shadertoy worlds into a VR headset through the browser.
creators.bio_zh: 斯洛文尼亚的开发者，做开放科学工具和 WebXR 实验，其中 Shaderworlds 通过浏览器把光线步进的 Shadertoy 世界放进 VR 头显。
creators.why: Shaderworlds shows how a fragment shader can become a space you stand inside, with nothing to install.
creators.why_zh: Shaderworlds 展示了一个片元着色器如何变成人可以站在其中的空间，而且无需安装任何东西。

creators.name: Arghya Sur (Genesis Interactive)
creators.role: XR developer; founder of Genesis Interactive
creators.role_zh: XR 开发者，Genesis Interactive 创始人
creators.bio: Indian XR developer behind Genesis Interactive, a VR/AI studio that open-sourced QuestRoomScan, a real-time room reconstruction and Gaussian-splat pipeline for Meta Quest 3.
creators.bio_zh: 印度 XR 开发者，创办 VR/AI 工作室 Genesis Interactive，开源了 QuestRoomScan：一套在 Meta Quest 3 上实时重建房间并生成高斯泼溅的管线。
creators.why: QuestRoomScan turns a headset into a live scanner, making the room itself available as material for mixed-reality effects.
creators.why_zh: QuestRoomScan 把头显变成实时扫描仪，让房间本身成为混合现实特效的素材。

creators.name: Yasuhito Nagatomo
creators.role: visionOS and iOS developer
creators.role_zh: visionOS 与 iOS 开发者
creators.bio: Tokyo visionOS and iOS developer who publishes small open samples for RealityKit, ARKit and Shader Graph materials, often with a short screen recording on X.
creators.bio_zh: 东京的 visionOS 与 iOS 开发者，持续发布 RealityKit、ARKit 和 Shader Graph 材质的开源小样例，通常在 X 上配一段简短的录屏。
creators.why: His Shader Graph Material examples are the clearest open reference for writing visual effects on Apple Vision Pro.
creators.why_zh: 他的 Shader Graph 材质示例是在 Apple Vision Pro 上编写视觉特效最清晰的开源参考。

creators.name: Masatatsu Nakamura (mattatz)
creators.role: Graphics and tools programmer
creators.role_zh: 图形与工具程序员
creators.bio: Tokyo programmer who has open-sourced dozens of Unity geometry and GPU-simulation projects (voxelizer, Teddy, cellular growth, volume rendering) and now builds the browser CAD tool Nodi.
creators.bio_zh: 东京的程序员，开源了几十个 Unity 几何与 GPU 模拟项目（体素化、Teddy、细胞生长、体渲染），现在在开发浏览器端的 CAD 工具 Nodi。
creators.why: Each repository isolates one geometry algorithm and turns it into a moving image, so students can read a single clean implementation and reuse it.
creators.why_zh: 他的每个仓库只讲一种几何算法，并把它变成会动的画面，学生可以读懂一份干净的实现再拿去复用。

creators.name: Angela He (zephyo)
creators.role: Game developer and artist
creators.role_zh: 游戏开发者、艺术家
creators.bio: Artist-programmer who makes small narrative games and shares short Unity visual experiments (rain, anime skies, hair physics) with full source.
creators.bio_zh: 会画画也会写代码的游戏作者，做小型叙事游戏，并把一个个 Unity 视觉小实验（雨、动漫天空、头发物理）连同完整源码公开。
creators.why: Her experiments show how far RenderTextures and Shader Graph go in a 2D/2.5D scene, each posted as a short clip with the code.
creators.why_zh: 她的实验展示了 RenderTexture 和 Shader Graph 在 2D/2.5D 场景里能做到什么程度，每个都配一段短视频和代码。

creators.name: Eyez
creators.role: Real-time graphics artist
creators.role_zh: 实时图形艺术家
creators.bio: Real-time CG artist (formerly in Tokyo) who explores compute-shader simulations such as physarum, cellular automata and boids, and built a LiDAR-driven VFX Graph toolkit for iPad AR.
creators.bio_zh: 实时 CG 艺术家（曾在东京），用计算着色器探索黏菌、元胞自动机、鸟群等模拟，并做了一套在 iPad 上由 LiDAR 驱动的 VFX Graph AR 工具包。
creators.why: ARVolumeVFX is one of the few open toolkits that feeds LiDAR scene meshes and human stencils straight into VFX Graph particles on a phone.
creators.why_zh: ARVolumeVFX 是少数几个开源工具之一，能在手机上把 LiDAR 场景网格和人像遮罩直接送进 VFX Graph 粒子。

creators.name: setchi
creators.role: Unity engineer
creators.role_zh: Unity 工程师
creators.bio: Japanese Unity engineer known for the FancyScrollView UI library, who also writes compact animated ShaderLab sketches and GLSL tweets.
creators.bio_zh: 日本的 Unity 工程师，以 UI 库 FancyScrollView 闻名，也写短小的 ShaderLab 动画草图和“推特长度”的 GLSL。
creators.why: His shader sketches prove that a few lines of fragment code can produce a hypnotic pattern ready to texture any surface.
creators.why_zh: 他的着色器草图说明：几行片元代码就能做出催眠般的图案，随时贴到任何表面上。

creators.name: kaiware007
creators.role: Unity engineer and VJ
creators.role_zh: Unity 工程师、VJ
creators.bio: Japanese Unity engineer and VJ who shares GPU particle, plexus, hex-tiling and image-effect samples, plus slides from Unity shader study meetups.
creators.bio_zh: 日本的 Unity 工程师兼 VJ，分享 GPU 粒子、Plexus、六边形平铺和画面特效等示例，以及 Unity 着色器学习会的讲稿项目。
creators.why: He recreates effects people know from games and VJ sets in small, readable Unity projects.
creators.why_zh: 他把大家在游戏和 VJ 现场见过的效果，重做成小而易读的 Unity 项目。

creators.name: Nakata Nobuyuki (nobnak)
creators.role: Graphics programmer for digital-art installations
creators.role_zh: 数字艺术装置图形程序员
creators.bio: Tokyo programmer who builds real-time graphics for large digital-art installations and has open-sourced many Unity effects since 2013: watercolour filters, caustics, light streaks, smoke blur.
creators.bio_zh: 东京的程序员，为大型数字艺术装置做实时图形，从 2013 年起开源了许多 Unity 特效：水彩滤镜、焦散、光芒拖尾、烟雾模糊。
creators.why: His repos turn classic graphics papers (Kawase streaks, height-field caustics, procedural watercolour) into drop-in Unity effects with a demo video each.
creators.why_zh: 他把经典图形学论文（Kawase 光芒、高度场焦散、程序化水彩）做成可直接放进 Unity 的特效，每个都配有演示视频。

creators.name: Hiroaki Oishi (irishoak)
creators.role: VJ and interactive programmer
creators.role_zh: VJ、交互程序员
creators.bio: Tokyo VJ and programmer who performs at club events such as BRDG's CHANNEL series and publishes Unity post-processing, GPU fluid and TouchDesigner experiments.
creators.bio_zh: 东京的 VJ 和程序员，常在 BRDG 的 CHANNEL 等俱乐部活动中演出，并公开 Unity 后期处理、GPU 流体和 TouchDesigner 实验。
creators.why: His effects come straight from live VJ practice: fast, reactive and built to run on a single GPU all night.
creators.why_zh: 他的特效直接来自 VJ 现场：快速、有反应，并且能在一块 GPU 上整晚稳定运行。

creators.name: EsProgram
creators.role: Unity engineer
creators.role_zh: Unity 工程师
creators.bio: Tokyo Unity engineer behind InkPainter, a widely used open-source texture-painting library, and its companion water-wave shaders.
creators.bio_zh: 东京的 Unity 工程师，开源了被广泛使用的纹理绘制库 InkPainter，以及与之配套的水波着色器。
creators.why: InkPainter lets any mesh be painted at runtime, which is exactly what an AR app needs to let people draw onto the real world.
creators.why_zh: InkPainter 让任何网格都能在运行时被涂画，这正是 AR 应用让人在真实世界上作画所需要的能力。

creators.name: Codrin Mihail (Kodrin)
creators.role: Technical artist and interactive developer
creators.role_zh: 技术美术、交互开发者
creators.bio: Montreal technical artist working across Unity, Houdini and Unreal who open-sourced the URP-PSX retro shader kit, a compute-shader flow field and an HDRP VFX Graph workshop.
creators.bio_zh: 蒙特利尔的技术美术，横跨 Unity、Houdini 和 Unreal，开源了复古着色器套件 URP-PSX、计算着色器流场和一套 HDRP VFX Graph 工作坊。
creators.why: He packages what he learns into teaching material: every sample in his VFX Graph workshop is documented and free.
creators.why_zh: 他把学到的东西整理成教学材料：VFX Graph 工作坊里的每个示例都有文档并且免费。

creators.name: Cyan (Cyanilux)
creators.role: Shader artist and tutorial writer
creators.role_zh: 着色器艺术家、教程作者
creators.bio: Hobbyist Unity shader artist who posts stylised Shader Graph effects (water, fire, forcefields, CRT) and writes in-depth breakdowns and URP tools on cyanilux.com.
creators.bio_zh: 业余的 Unity 着色器艺术家，发布风格化的 Shader Graph 效果（水、火、力场、CRT），并在 cyanilux.com 写详细拆解和 URP 工具。
creators.why: Cyan's breakdowns are among the clearest Shader Graph teaching material online, and the key effects ship as open URP repositories.
creators.why_zh: Cyan 的拆解是网上最清楚的 Shader Graph 教学材料之一，关键效果还以开源 URP 仓库发布。

creators.name: Leon Denise
creators.role: Shader artist, designer and developer
creators.role_zh: 着色器艺术家、设计师、开发者
creators.bio: Paris shader artist from the demoscene who live-codes at Cookie Demoparty, teaches shader workshops and publishes Unity, Godot and Shadertoy experiments.
creators.bio_zh: 来自 demoscene 的巴黎着色器艺术家，在 Cookie Demoparty 现场写代码、教授着色器工作坊，并发布 Unity、Godot 和 Shadertoy 实验。
creators.why: He treats shaders as a sketchbook and shares the small tools and templates behind his pieces.
creators.why_zh: 他把着色器当作速写本，并把作品背后的小工具和模板一起分享出来。

creators.name: AMAGI (Takayosi Amagi)
creators.role: Web graphics developer and VJ
creators.role_zh: Web 图形开发者、VJ
creators.bio: Japanese web-graphics developer and VJ, author of the VEDA live-coding environment and the VFX-JS / REACT-VFX WebGL effect libraries, who also builds Unity VJ systems.
creators.bio_zh: 日本的 Web 图形开发者和 VJ，开发了现场编程环境 VEDA 以及 WebGL 特效库 VFX-JS / REACT-VFX，也做 Unity VJ 系统。
creators.why: He moves effects freely between the browser, Unity and live shows, and publishes the code for most of them.
creators.why_zh: 他让特效在浏览器、Unity 和现场演出之间自由流动，并公开了其中大部分代码。

creators.name: Acerola (Garrett Gunnell)
creators.role: Graphics programmer and YouTube educator
creators.role_zh: 图形程序员、YouTube 教学作者
creators.bio: Garrett Gunnell makes long-form videos as Acerola in which he rebuilds a rendering effect from a game or a paper (smoke, water, fur, pixel sorting, painterly filters) and publishes the Unity or Godot project on GitHub.
creators.bio_zh: Garrett Gunnell 以 Acerola 为名制作长篇视频：每期从某个游戏或论文出发，亲手重做一种渲染效果（烟雾、海洋、毛发、像素排序、绘画风滤镜），并把 Unity 或 Godot 工程开源在 GitHub 上。
creators.why: Each video pairs a striking real-time effect with a clear explanation of the math and a public repository, so students can go from idea to working shader in one sitting.
creators.why_zh: 每期视频都把一个抓眼的实时效果、清楚的数学讲解和公开仓库放在一起，学生看完就能从想法走到能跑的着色器。

creators.name: Benoit Arbelot
creators.role: Creative engineer and digital artist
creators.role_zh: 创意工程师、数字艺术家
creators.bio: French creative engineer who builds his own fluid and Physarum (slime-mould) simulation frameworks in Unity and uses them for short real-time films such as Lights of Nibel and Coriolis.
creators.bio_zh: 法国创意工程师，在 Unity 里自己写流体和多头绒泡菌（黏菌）模拟框架，并用它们制作《Lights of Nibel》《Coriolis》等实时短片。
creators.why: He open-sources the simulation frameworks behind his films, so the same code that makes a finished piece can be studied and reused.
creators.why_zh: 他把短片背后的模拟框架开源，完成作品所用的同一套代码可以直接拿来学习和复用。

creators.name: Erik Nordeus (Habrador)
creators.role: Developer, technical artist and tutorial author
creators.role_zh: 开发者、技术美术、教程作者
creators.bio: Swedish engineer who publishes Unity tutorials and open-source simulations under the name Habrador, from fluid solvers and tornadoes to ray-marched and parallax shaders.
creators.bio_zh: 瑞典工程师，以 Habrador 为名发布 Unity 教程和开源模拟：从流体解算、龙卷风到光线步进和视差着色器。
creators.why: His small, well-documented projects show a single physics or shader idea clearly enough to rebuild in a class.
creators.why_zh: 他的项目小而文档齐全，把一个物理或着色器点子讲得足够清楚，课堂上就能重做。

creators.name: Ming Wai Chan (cinight)
creators.role: Graphics developer
creators.role_zh: 图形开发者
creators.bio: Copenhagen-based graphics developer who keeps MinimalCompute, a widely used set of minimal Unity compute-shader scenes, plus custom SRP and shader samples, and posts short demo videos of each.
creators.bio_zh: 常驻哥本哈根的图形开发者，维护着被广泛使用的 MinimalCompute（一组最小化的 Unity 计算着色器示例场景），以及自定义渲染管线和着色器示例，并为每个示例发布简短演示视频。
creators.why: The minimal scenes strip GPU effects down to the few lines that matter, which makes them ideal starting points for AR experiments.
creators.why_zh: 这些示例把 GPU 特效精简到最关键的几行代码，是做 AR 实验的理想起点。

creators.name: Deniz Bicer
creators.role: Creative coder and Unity developer
creators.role_zh: 创意编程者、Unity 开发者
creators.bio: Creative coder who explores Physarum (slime-mould) simulations, flow agents and pixel sorting with Unity compute shaders and later published an interactive explainer of the Physarum algorithm.
creators.bio_zh: 创意编程者，用 Unity 计算着色器探索多头绒泡菌（黏菌）模拟、流动智能体和像素排序，之后还发布了一篇讲解黏菌算法的交互式文章。
creators.why: The open Physarum implementation and playful variations (vector fields, image stimuli) make a complex emergent system easy to try.
creators.why_zh: 开源的黏菌实现和各种好玩的变体（矢量场、图像刺激）让一个复杂的涌现系统变得容易上手。

creators.name: Aman Tiwari
creators.role: Artist and programmer
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、程序员
creators.bio: Artist and programmer who came through Golan Levin's courses at Carnegie Mellon and works across real-time graphics, openFrameworks and machine learning; his MeshToSDF converter became a standard companion to Unity's VFX Graph.
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家兼程序员，出自卡内基梅隆大学 Golan Levin 的课程，横跨实时图形、openFrameworks 和机器学习；他写的 MeshToSDF 转换器成了 Unity VFX Graph 的常用搭档。
creators.why: One small open tool of his unlocked a whole family of effects: particles that cling to and flow over animated meshes in real time.
creators.why_zh: 他的一个小型开源工具打开了一整类特效：粒子实时附着并流过动画网格。

creators.name: Owen (owenyuwono)
creators.role: Developer and founder of Pixel8 Labs
creators.role_zh: 开发者、Pixel8 Labs 创始人
creators.bio: Indonesian developer who in 2026 open-sourced a run of three.js + WebGPU prototypes: an FFT ocean (Poseidon), an SPH fluid (Tiamat), procedural grass (Gaia) and trees (Dryad).
creators.bio_zh: 印度尼西亚开发者，2026 年开源了一系列 three.js + WebGPU 原型：FFT 海洋（Poseidon）、SPH 流体（Tiamat）、程序化草地（Gaia）和树木（Dryad）。
creators.why: His browser-only simulations run on phones and are open source, so they are a direct path to WebXR effects.
creators.why_zh: 他的模拟只需浏览器、能在手机上运行而且开源，是通向 WebXR 特效的捷径。

creators.name: World of Zero (Sam Wronski)
creators.role: Developer and YouTube shader educator
creators.role_zh: 开发者、YouTube 着色器教学作者
creators.bio: Sam Wronski runs the World of Zero YouTube channel, live-building Unity shaders and image effects such as a revealing flashlight, an energy shield and a night-vision camera, and collects them in the open UnityVisualizations repository.
creators.bio_zh: Sam Wronski 运营 YouTube 频道 World of Zero，在视频里从零实现 Unity 着色器和画面特效，例如“显形手电筒”、能量护盾和夜视镜头，并把它们整理进开源仓库 UnityVisualizations。
creators.why: Each episode turns one small shader trick into a complete, reusable effect with source, a good pace for a classroom.
creators.why_zh: 每一期都把一个小的着色器技巧做成完整、可复用的效果并附上源码，节奏非常适合课堂。

creators.name: Przemyslaw Zaworski
creators.role: Graphics programmer
creators.role_zh: 图形程序员
creators.bio: Polish programmer who has published hundreds of small Unity shaders and compute-shader demos since 2016, many of them ShaderToy ports, each with a short YouTube video and MIT-licensed source.
creators.bio_zh: 波兰程序员，自 2016 年起发布了数百个 Unity 着色器和计算着色器小样，其中不少移植自 ShaderToy，每个都配有简短的 YouTube 视频和 MIT 许可的源码。
creators.why: His Unity3D-CG-programming repository is a huge open sketchbook: one file per effect, easy to drop into an AR project.
creators.why_zh: 他的 Unity3D-CG-programming 仓库是一本巨大的开源速写本：一个效果一个文件，很容易直接放进 AR 项目。

creators.name: CJT (CJT-Jackton)
creators.role: Shader developer
creators.role_zh: 着色器开发者
creators.bio: Graphics developer who publishes compact URP shader studies (crystal caustics, iridescence, anime crystal, knitwear) and an early mixed-reality theater system for HoloLens and Magic Leap.
creators.bio_zh: 图形开发者，发布了一系列精简的 URP 着色器研究（水晶焦散、虹彩、动漫水晶、针织材质），以及一个面向 HoloLens 和 Magic Leap 的早期混合现实剧场系统。
creators.why: Shows how a physically inspired effect such as caustics can be faked cheaply in real time, and how stage effects can be shared across AR glasses.
creators.why_zh: 展示了焦散这类基于物理的效果如何在实时中低成本地“伪造”出来，以及舞台特效如何在多副 AR 眼镜间同步呈现。

creators.name: Robin Seibold
creators.role: Game developer and devlog creator
creators.role_zh: 游戏开发者、开发日志视频作者
creators.bio: Swedish game developer who documents his stylised Unity rendering in carefully edited devlogs and open-sources the pieces, including a URP cel shader and a screen-space outline renderer feature.
creators.bio_zh: 瑞典游戏开发者，用精心剪辑的开发日志记录他的 Unity 风格化渲染，并把其中的部件开源，包括 URP 卡通着色器和屏幕空间描边渲染功能。
creators.why: His devlogs explain the thinking behind each rendering choice, and both repositories are small enough to study in one session.
creators.why_zh: 他的开发日志讲清了每个渲染选择背后的思路，两个仓库都小到可以在一次课里读完。

creators.name: MatrixRex
creators.role: Unity developer and 3D artist
creators.role_zh: Unity 开发者、3D 美术
creators.bio: Frontend and Unity developer from Dhaka who builds editor tools and stylised shaders, and released the highly customisable Uber Stylized Water shader for Unity 6 URP.
creators.bio_zh: 来自达卡的前端和 Unity 开发者，制作编辑器工具和风格化着色器，发布了可高度自定义的 Unity 6 URP 着色器 Uber Stylized Water。
creators.why: A complete, well-documented stylised water shader is a ready building block for AR puddles, ponds and portals.
creators.why_zh: 一套完整且文档齐全的风格化水面着色器，可以直接用来做 AR 里的水洼、池塘和传送门。

creators.name: Tooster (T3sT3ro)
creators.role: Programmer
creators.role_zh: 程序员
creators.bio: Programmer who built SdfManipulator, an interactive Unity editor for raymarched signed-distance-field scenes that generates HLSL shaders from gizmo-driven primitives, as his bachelor's thesis.
creators.bio_zh: 程序员，本科毕业设计做了 SdfManipulator：一个在 Unity 里交互式编辑光线步进 SDF 场景的编辑器，用可拖拽的基本体自动生成 HLSL 着色器。
creators.why: Turns SDF modelling, normally written by hand in shader code, into direct manipulation that students can play with.
creators.why_zh: 把原本需要手写着色器代码的 SDF 建模变成可以直接拖拽操作的工具，学生可以上手玩。

creators.name: Thibaud Goiffon (HeyTibo)
creators.role: Game developer and technical artist
creators.role_zh: 游戏开发者、技术美术
creators.bio: Game developer publishing as HeyTibo who shares quick Godot 4 visual-effect sketches, shaders and characters, and open-sourced the whole VFX sketchbook under MIT.
creators.bio_zh: 以 HeyTibo 为名发布作品的游戏开发者，分享用 Godot 4 做的快速视觉特效草图、着色器和角色，并以 MIT 许可开源了整本 VFX 速写本。
creators.why: Proves that expressive stylised VFX do not need a big engine: every sketch is small, readable and free to reuse.
creators.why_zh: 证明富有表现力的风格化特效不必依赖大型引擎：每个草图都小巧、易读、可以自由复用。

creators.name: Andy Duboc
creators.role: Creative technologist
creators.role_zh: 创意技术人
creators.bio: Montreal-based creative coder whose open Unity shader tests (hologram, frosted glass, Shader Graph sandbox, reaction-diffusion) became standard references, and who now makes real-time installations.
creators.bio_zh: 常驻蒙特利尔的创意程序员，他开源的 Unity 着色器实验（全息、磨砂玻璃、Shader Graph 示例集、反应扩散）成了常被引用的参考，现在也做实时影像装置。
creators.why: His small, clean shader repos show one material idea at a time, which makes them easy to adapt for AR.
creators.why_zh: 他的着色器仓库小而干净，每次只展示一个材质点子，很容易改造成 AR 效果。

creators.name: Rune Skovbo Johansen
creators.role: Indie game developer and procedural-generation researcher
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏开发者、程序化生成研究者
creators.bio: Indie developer behind The Cluster and LayerProcGen who invented Surface-Stable Fractal Dithering, a dither pattern that sticks to 3D surfaces and keeps constant dot size as you move.
creators.bio_zh: 独立开发者，作品包括 The Cluster 和 LayerProcGen，他发明了“表面稳定分形抖动”：一种贴在三维表面上、镜头移动时点的大小始终不变的抖动图案。
creators.why: A genuinely new rendering idea, explained step by step in video and released as open shader code.
creators.why_zh: 一个真正新颖的渲染点子，用视频一步步讲清楚，并以开源着色器代码发布。

creators.name: Michal Skalsky
creators.role: Graphics programmer
creators.role_zh: 图形程序员
creators.bio: Graphics programmer who released an open-source volumetric lighting system for Unity in 2016, raymarching light shafts for point, spot and directional lights.
creators.bio_zh: 图形程序员，2016 年开源了一套 Unity 体积光系统，用光线步进为点光源、聚光灯和平行光渲染光柱。
creators.why: One of the most starred open volumetric-light implementations; the code is a clear lesson in raymarching participating media.
creators.why_zh: 最受关注的开源体积光实现之一，代码是学习“参与介质光线步进”的清晰教材。

creators.name: Jaagup Kuhi
creators.role: Graphics programmer
creators.role_zh: 图形程序员
creators.bio: Estonian programmer who open-sourced a real-time raymarched volumetric cloud renderer for Unity, with weather maps, noise shapes and lighting controls.
creators.bio_zh: 爱沙尼亚程序员，开源了 Unity 实时光线步进体积云渲染器，包含天气图、噪声形状和光照控制。
creators.why: A readable, complete volumetric-cloud implementation that students can study and shrink to an AR-sized cloud.
creators.why_zh: 一个易读且完整的体积云实现，学生可以研究它，并把它缩小成 AR 尺度的一朵云。

creators.name: Alexandre Rivaux (Bonjour Lab)
creators.role: Creative technologist; co-founder of Bonjour Lab
creators.role_zh: 创意技术人、Bonjour Lab 联合创始人
creators.bio: Creative technologist at the Paris studio Bonjour Lab, which builds interactive installations and open-sources Unity tools such as VATUtils for driving Houdini vertex-animation textures from VFX Graph.
creators.bio_zh: 巴黎工作室 Bonjour Lab 的创意技术人，工作室制作互动装置，并开源 Unity 工具，例如用 VFX Graph 驱动 Houdini 顶点动画纹理的 VATUtils。
creators.why: Bridges offline Houdini simulations and real-time VFX Graph, a practical route for heavy effects on AR devices.
creators.why_zh: 把离线的 Houdini 模拟和实时 VFX Graph 连接起来，是在 AR 设备上呈现重型特效的实用路径。

creators.name: Nino Filiu
creators.role: Generative artist, VJ and web developer
creators.role_zh: 生成艺术家、VJ、网页开发者
creators.bio: Paris-based artist, VJ and developer who built Supermosh, the first browser-based datamosh editor, so anyone can glitch video without codecs or command lines.
creators.bio_zh: 常驻巴黎的艺术家、VJ 和开发者，做了第一个浏览器里的数据损坏（datamosh）编辑器 Supermosh，让任何人都能不碰编解码器和命令行就给视频做故障效果。
creators.why: Makes a notoriously technical glitch aesthetic accessible and open, a strong base for camera effects on the web.
creators.why_zh: 把一种出了名门槛高的故障美学变得人人可用且开源，是做网页相机特效的好起点。

creators.name: Xuan Luo
creators.role: Computer-vision and graphics researcher
creators.role_zh: 计算机视觉与图形学研究者
creators.bio: Researcher who, as a PhD student at the University of Washington, created Pepper's Cone with Jason Lawrence and Steven Seitz, a DIY 3D display made from a plastic cone and a tablet, with an open Unity implementation.
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，在华盛顿大学读博期间与 Jason Lawrence、Steven Seitz 一起做了 Pepper's Cone：用一个塑料锥和一台平板做成的 DIY 三维显示器，并开源了 Unity 实现。
creators.why: Shows how pre-warping a rendered image turns cheap materials into a convincing floating hologram.
creators.why_zh: 展示了如何通过对渲染图像预先变形，用廉价材料做出以假乱真的悬浮全息影像。

creators.name: Tasuku Takahashi
creators.role: Interactive art engineer at teamLab; VFX Graph and XR prototyper
creators.bio: An engineer at teamLab who spends his own time on real-time VFX in Unity: VFX Graph on the open-source Project North Star AR headset, volumetric dancers captured with Depthkit Studio, GPU fire and fluid solvers, and sci-fi hand interfaces. Almost every experiment is published on GitHub.
creators.why: He keeps turning Keijiro-style VFX Graph tricks into wearable and spatial experiments, and shares the full Unity projects so others can start from them.
creators.role_zh: teamLab 互动艺术工程师；VFX Graph 与 XR 原型开发者
creators.bio_zh: teamLab 的工程师，业余时间做 Unity 实时特效：在开源 AR 头显 Project North Star 上跑 VFX Graph，用 Depthkit Studio 拍体积视频舞者，写 GPU 火焰和流体求解器，做科幻风的手部界面。几乎每个实验都在 GitHub 上公开。
creators.why_zh: 他不断把 Keijiro 式的 VFX Graph 技巧变成可穿戴、可在空间里体验的实验，并公开完整的 Unity 工程，让别人可以直接接着做。

creators.name: Takahiro "Poly" Horikawa
creators.role: CEO and engineer at Curiosity Inc.; AR developer
creators.bio: Engineer and CEO of Curiosity Inc. in Tokyo (the company behind the Rememory volumetric capture studio) and a member of Placeholder. He rebuilds AR effects from commercial apps in a few lines of Unity code and shares the source.
creators.why: His AR MeshWave shows how a famous LiDAR effect from Apple Clips reduces to one short shader on the scanned room mesh.
creators.role_zh: Curiosity Inc. CEO 兼工程师；AR 开发者
creators.bio_zh: 东京 Curiosity Inc. 的工程师兼 CEO（Rememory 体积视频棚就是这家公司运营的），也是 Placeholder 的成员。他常把商业 App 里的 AR 效果用几行 Unity 代码重新实现，并公开源码。
creators.why_zh: 他的 AR MeshWave 证明：Apple Clips 里那个出名的 LiDAR 特效，归根结底只是扫描出的房间网格上的一个短小着色器。

creators.name: Jonathan Thorpe (Sonosthesia)
creators.role: XR developer; software architect at Opuscope; author of Sonosthesia
creators.bio: An XR and mobile developer since 2013 and software architect at Opuscope in Paris. Through his open-source Sonosthesia packages for Unity he turns audio descriptors, MIDI and hand gestures into signals that drive shaders, VFX Graph and mesh deformation.
creators.why: He builds a reusable signal pipeline from sound to visuals, so audio-reactive AR can be assembled from parts instead of written from scratch.
creators.role_zh: XR 开发者；Opuscope 软件架构师；Sonosthesia 作者
creators.bio_zh: 2013 年起做 XR 和移动开发，现为巴黎 Opuscope 的软件架构师。他的开源 Unity 工具包 Sonosthesia 把音频特征、MIDI 和手势变成信号，用来驱动着色器、VFX Graph 和网格形变。
creators.why_zh: 他搭了一条可复用的“声音到画面”的信号管线，让声音驱动的 AR 可以像搭积木一样组装，而不必从零写起。

creators.name: Youssef Afella
creators.role: VFX and technical artist; graphics programmer
creators.bio: A technical artist and graphics programmer who releases compact Unity URP rendering projects: an infinite GPU-instanced grass field, 2D global illumination with Radiance Cascades, and a glass shader that fakes refraction without ray tracing.
creators.why: Each repository isolates one rendering idea and makes it small enough to read in an afternoon, which is exactly what AR students need.
creators.role_zh: 特效与技术美术；图形程序员
creators.bio_zh: 技术美术兼图形程序员，发布了一系列精简的 Unity URP 渲染项目：无限延伸的 GPU 实例化草地、用 Radiance Cascades 做的 2D 全局光照，以及不用光线追踪就能“假装”折射的玻璃着色器。
creators.why_zh: 他的每个仓库只讲一个渲染想法，而且小到一个下午就能读懂，正适合 AR 学生入门。

creators.name: SCRN
creators.role: Shader developer and machine-learning tinkerer (VRChat)
creators.bio: A VRChat creator who implements neural networks entirely inside Unity fragment shaders: YOLOv4-tiny object detection, pix2pix, face-landmark tracking, a transformer translator and a voice-viseme classifier, plus raymarching experiments. Everything is open source.
creators.why: SCRN proves that a GPU shader alone can see, recognise and react, which reframes what an 'effect' can be in social XR.
creators.role_zh: 着色器开发者、机器学习玩家（VRChat）
creators.bio_zh: VRChat 创作者，把神经网络完整地写进 Unity 片元着色器：YOLOv4-tiny 物体检测、pix2pix、人脸关键点追踪、Transformer 翻译器、口型音素分类器，还有光线步进实验，全部开源。
creators.why_zh: SCRN 证明了仅靠 GPU 着色器就能“看见”、识别并作出反应，这改变了社交 XR 里“特效”的含义。

creators.name: Wita (witalosk)
creators.role: Creative technologist; Unity tool and shader developer
creators.bio: A Tokyo-based developer who writes Unity tools for live visuals, including a package that compiles fragment and compute shaders at runtime, and experiments with position-based and particle fluids.
creators.why: His runtime shader package brings live-coding to Unity, so effects can be rewritten during a show or an AR session without rebuilding.
creators.role_zh: 创意技术人；Unity 工具与着色器开发者
creators.bio_zh: 东京的开发者，为现场视觉编写 Unity 工具，其中包括一个能在运行时编译片元着色器和计算着色器的插件，也做基于位置的流体和粒子流体实验。
creators.why_zh: 他的运行时着色器插件把 live coding 带进了 Unity：演出或 AR 体验进行中也能改写特效，无需重新打包。

creators.name: Rob Cupisz
creators.role: Tech lead, Unity Demo Team
creators.bio: Tech lead of Unity's Demo Team (The Heretic, Enemies) and author of the classic LightShafts volumetric-shadow effect. He publishes small example projects that show how the team's real-time SDF and particle techniques work.
creators.why: His examples explain production-grade VFX tricks, such as live SDFs from an animated character or physically sensible embers, in projects small enough to learn from.
creators.role_zh: Unity Demo Team 技术负责人
creators.bio_zh: Unity Demo Team（《The Heretic》《Enemies》）的技术负责人，也是经典体积光影效果 LightShafts 的作者。他会发布小型示例工程，讲清团队的实时 SDF 和粒子技术是怎么做的。
creators.why_zh: 他的示例把电影级的特效技巧（比如从动画角色实时生成 SDF、符合物理的火星粒子）放进小工程里，方便学习。

creators.name: Aras Pranckevičius
creators.role: Graphics engineer; ex-Unity (2006–2021); open-source developer
creators.bio: One of Unity's earliest graphics engineers, who worked on the engine from 2006 to 2021 and now contributes to Blender. In 2023 he released UnityGaussianSplatting, an open-source real-time viewer for 3D Gaussian Splatting captures that became a standard starting point.
creators.why: His Gaussian Splatting project made photoreal captured scenes renderable in Unity, which opened the door to splat-based AR scenes.
creators.role_zh: 图形工程师；前 Unity 工程师（2006–2021）；开源开发者
creators.bio_zh: Unity 最早的一批图形工程师之一，2006 至 2021 年参与引擎开发，现在为 Blender 做贡献。2023 年他发布了开源的 UnityGaussianSplatting，可实时显示 3D 高斯泼溅扫描，成为很多人的起点。
creators.why_zh: 他的高斯泼溅项目让照片级的扫描场景能在 Unity 里实时渲染，为基于泼溅的 AR 场景打开了大门。

creators.name: Appletea
creators.role: VRChat and Meta Quest developer
creators.bio: A Japanese VRChat and Quest developer who builds shader-heavy tools, including Depth Scanner, which reads the Meta Quest 3 depth sensor and turns the surroundings into a live point cloud that can be exported as PLY.
creators.why: Depth Scanner shows that a consumer headset's own depth sensor can already capture the world as points, the raw material of many AR effects.
creators.role_zh: VRChat 与 Meta Quest 开发者
creators.bio_zh: 日本的 VRChat 与 Quest 开发者，擅长大量使用着色器的工具。代表作 Depth Scanner 读取 Meta Quest 3 的深度传感器，把周围环境变成实时点云，并能导出 PLY 文件。
creators.why_zh: Depth Scanner 说明：消费级头显自带的深度传感器已经能把世界记录成点，而点正是许多 AR 特效的原材料。

creators.name: Tatsuro Ogata (llcheesell)
creators.role: Director and producer of XR projects
creators.bio: A Tokyo-based director and producer of virtual live events and XR projects who builds his own production tools, including LEDScreenShader, a realistic LED-panel shader for Unity used for virtual stages.
creators.why: His LED shader copies the physical details of real stage screens (RGB subpixels, cabinet seams, distance-based fading that avoids moiré), a surface trick that makes virtual screens feel real in XR.
creators.role_zh: XR 项目导演、制作人
creators.bio_zh: 东京的虚拟演唱会与 XR 项目导演、制作人，会自己开发制作工具，其中包括用于虚拟舞台的逼真 LED 屏幕着色器 LEDScreenShader。
creators.why_zh: 他的 LED 着色器复刻了真实舞台屏幕的物理细节（RGB 子像素、箱体接缝、随距离淡化以避免摩尔纹），这种表面技巧能让 XR 里的虚拟屏幕显得真实。

creators.name: Noboru Seto (ruccho)
creators.role: Game and tool developer
creators.bio: A Japanese developer who publishes Unity tools under the name ruccho, best known for WaterRW, a 2D interactive water system whose waves are simulated on the GPU and react to rigidbodies.
creators.why: WaterRW shows a compact GPU wave simulation that responds to objects, the same idea that makes a virtual pond on a real table feel alive.
creators.role_zh: 游戏与工具开发者
creators.bio_zh: 以 ruccho 为名发布 Unity 工具的日本开发者，代表作 WaterRW 是一套 2D 可交互水面系统：水波在 GPU 上模拟，并会对刚体作出反应。
creators.why_zh: WaterRW 展示了一个紧凑的 GPU 水波模拟如何回应物体，这正是让“真实桌面上的虚拟水池”显得有生命的方法。

creators.name: Colin Leung (NiloCat)
