creators.role: Technical artist; creator of NiloToon
creators.bio: A technical artist who writes rendering code for anime-style games and created NiloToon, a toon shader for Unity URP. His free UnityURPToonLitShaderExample is one of the most-starred learning repositories for custom URP shaders.
creators.why: His open toon shader taught thousands of developers how to write lit URP shaders, the base of stylised AR characters.
creators.role_zh: 技术美术；NiloToon 作者
creators.bio_zh: 为二次元风格游戏编写渲染代码的技术美术，开发了 Unity URP 卡通着色器 NiloToon。他免费公开的 UnityURPToonLitShaderExample 是学习自定义 URP 着色器时最受欢迎的仓库之一。
creators.why_zh: 他开源的卡通着色器教会了成千上万的开发者如何写带光照的 URP 着色器，这是风格化 AR 角色的基础。

creators.name: MalyaWka (Pavel)
creators.role: Technical artist; shader developer
creators.bio: A technical artist who shares Unity URP rendering features, most notably URP-ScreenSpaceCavity, a port of Blender's viewport cavity effect that darkens creases and brightens edges in screen space.
creators.why: His cavity pass shows how one screen-space post-effect can make any geometry read more clearly, a useful trick for AR objects against busy camera images.
creators.role_zh: 技术美术；着色器开发者
creators.bio_zh: 分享 Unity URP 渲染功能的技术美术，代表作 URP-ScreenSpaceCavity 把 Blender 视口里的 Cavity 效果搬进 Unity：在屏幕空间里压暗凹缝、提亮边缘。
creators.why_zh: 他的 Cavity 后处理说明，一个屏幕空间效果就能让任何几何体更易读，这对叠加在杂乱相机画面上的 AR 物体很有用。

creators.name: Singtaa
creators.role: Developer of OneJS; Unity compute-shader tinkerer
creators.bio: The developer behind OneJS, which brings JavaScript UI to Unity, and Spark2D, an open library of compute shaders for noise, 2D signed distance fields, jump-flood SDF generation and gradients.
creators.why: Spark2D packs Inigo Quilez's 2D distance functions into reusable GPU building blocks, so procedural shapes and glows become easy to script.
creators.role_zh: OneJS 开发者；Unity 计算着色器玩家
creators.bio_zh: OneJS（把 JavaScript 界面带进 Unity）的开发者，也做了 Spark2D：一个开源计算着色器库，包含噪声、2D 有向距离场、跳跃泛洪 SDF 生成和渐变等功能。
creators.why_zh: Spark2D 把 Inigo Quilez 的 2D 距离函数做成可复用的 GPU 积木，程序化形状和光晕因此变得很容易用脚本控制。

creators.name: Eric Freeman
creators.role: Game developer
creators.bio: A game developer who shares small Unity utilities, including FakeStopMotion, a script that makes any animated character play back at a low, choppy frame rate like stop-motion puppetry.
creators.why: FakeStopMotion shows that changing time, not pixels, can be a whole visual style, and it works on any rig.
creators.role_zh: 游戏开发者
creators.bio_zh: 分享小型 Unity 工具的游戏开发者，其中 FakeStopMotion 脚本能让任何动画角色以低帧率、一顿一顿地播放，像定格动画里的木偶。
creators.why_zh: FakeStopMotion 说明改变时间而不是像素，也能形成一种完整的视觉风格，而且适用于任何骨骼动画。

creators.name: rngtm (Kamosoba)
creators.role: Unity technical artist; Shader Graph and VFX tool author
creators.bio: A Japanese Unity technical artist who writes widely read Shader Graph and VFX articles on Qiita and Hatena and publishes the matching projects, such as Unity-VFXToolBox with aura effects and procedural ring and cylinder meshes for particle effects.
creators.why: rngtm shows how game-style effects are built from simple procedural meshes plus scrolling textures, a light approach that also runs well on phones.
creators.role_zh: Unity 技术美术；Shader Graph 与特效工具作者
creators.bio_zh: 日本的 Unity 技术美术，在 Qiita 和 Hatena 上写了许多被广泛阅读的 Shader Graph 与特效文章，并公开配套工程，例如 Unity-VFXToolBox，其中有光环特效以及用于粒子特效的程序化圆环、圆柱网格。
creators.why_zh: rngtm 展示了游戏特效如何用简单的程序化网格加滚动贴图搭出来，这种轻量做法在手机上也跑得动。

creators.name: Shantell Martin
creators.role: Artist (line drawing, text, performance)
creators.bio: Artist known for continuous black-and-white line drawings and words; collaborated with Zach Lieberman on Poem World for Snap Spectacles.
creators.why: Brings a drawn, hand-made line into spatial text — words you walk through.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家（线描、文字、表演）
creators.bio_zh: 以连续的黑白线描和文字闻名的艺术家；曾与 Zach Lieberman 合作为 Snap Spectacles 创作 Poem World。
creators.why_zh: 她把手绘的线条带入空间文字之中——化作你可以穿行其间的词语。

creators.name: Zach Lieberman
creators.role: Artist; co-founder of openFrameworks and the School for Poetic Computation (SFPC); MIT Media Lab
creators.bio: New York artist and educator who builds experimental drawing, animation and computer-vision tools with code. Co-creator of openFrameworks, co-founder of SFPC and YesYesNo, and runs the Future Sketches group at the MIT Media Lab.
creators.why: Two decades of body-, face-, voice- and phone-AR works that turn gestures and sounds into living graphics, and the tools (openFrameworks) much of the field is built on.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；openFrameworks 与诗意计算学校（SFPC）联合创始人；MIT Media Lab
creators.bio_zh: 纽约艺术家和教育者，用代码构建实验性的绘画、动画与计算机视觉工具。他是 openFrameworks 的共同创作者、SFPC 和 YesYesNo 的联合创始人，并在 MIT Media Lab 主持 Future Sketches 研究组。
creators.why_zh: 二十年来，他以身体、面部、声音和手机 AR 创作，把手势与声音变成鲜活的图形；他参与打造的 openFrameworks 更是这一领域许多作品的基础工具。

creators.name: Molmol Kuo
creators.role: Artist; co-founder of YesYesNo; SFPC teacher
creators.bio: Taiwanese-born artist working with AR, body tracking and storytelling; co-founded the interactive studio YesYesNo with Zach Lieberman and was artist-in-residence for AR at Google Arts & Culture and Adobe.
creators.why: Co-author of the Weird Type and Weird Cuts AR apps and of body/face-augmenting installations that treat AR as a handmade, poetic medium.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；YesYesNo 联合创始人；SFPC 教师
creators.bio_zh: 出生于台湾的艺术家，创作涉及 AR、身体追踪与叙事；与 Zach Lieberman 共同创办互动工作室 YesYesNo，并曾任 Google Arts & Culture 和 Adobe 的 AR 驻留艺术家。
creators.why_zh: 她参与创作了 Weird Type 和 Weird Cuts 两款 AR 应用，以及多件增强身体与面部的装置，把 AR 当作一种手工的、诗意的媒介。

creators.name: Golan Levin
creators.role: Artist; Professor of Electronic Art, Carnegie Mellon University; director of the Frank-Ratchye STUDIO for Creative Inquiry
creators.bio: Artist and educator whose installations and performances explore abstract communication, the voice, the hand and the gaze through real-time computer vision and projection.
creators.why: A pioneer of projection- and camera-based augmentation of bodies, voices and hands (Messa di Voce, Footfalls, Augmented Hand Series) who keeps re-coding AR history for new platforms.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；卡内基梅隆大学电子艺术教授；Frank-Ratchye STUDIO for Creative Inquiry 主任
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家和教育者，他的装置与表演借助实时计算机视觉和投影，探索抽象沟通、声音、手与凝视。
creators.why_zh: 他是以投影和摄像头增强身体、声音与双手的先驱（Messa di Voce、Footfalls、Augmented Hand Series），并不断在新平台上重新编写 AR 的历史。

creators.name: Theo Watson
creators.role: Artist; co-founder of openFrameworks and Design I/O
creators.bio: Artist and creative technologist, co-creator of openFrameworks, member of Graffiti Research Lab and F.A.T. Lab, and co-founder of the interactive studio Design I/O with Emily Gobeille.
creators.why: Built some of the most joyful whole-body projection AR environments for children and the laser/projection graffiti tools that brought AR into the street.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；openFrameworks 与 Design I/O 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家和创意技术专家，openFrameworks 的共同创作者，Graffiti Research Lab 和 F.A.T. Lab 成员，并与 Emily Gobeille 共同创办互动工作室 Design I/O。
creators.why_zh: 他打造了一些最令人欢乐的儿童全身投影 AR 环境，以及把 AR 带上街头的激光/投影涂鸦工具。

creators.name: Emily Gobeille
creators.role: Designer and artist; co-founder of Design I/O
creators.bio: Visual designer and artist who co-founded Design I/O, creating immersive, illustrated interactive worlds for museums and children.
creators.why: Her art direction gives Design I/O's body-driven projection ecosystems their living, storybook quality.
creators.role_zh: 设计师、艺术家；Design I/O 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 视觉设计师和艺术家，联合创办了 Design I/O，为博物馆和儿童创作沉浸式、插画风格的互动世界。
creators.why_zh: 她的艺术指导赋予了 Design I/O 身体驱动的投影生态系统一种鲜活的绘本质感。

creators.name: Chris Sugrue
creators.role: Artist and programmer; EyeWriter team; SFPC teacher
creators.bio: American artist and programmer creating interactive installations and audio-visual performances that explore light, perception and the body; part of the EyeWriter team.
creators.why: Her works let digital creatures and geometry escape the screen onto hands and bodies, early poetic examples of body-scale mixed reality.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、程序员；EyeWriter 团队成员；SFPC 教师
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家和程序员，创作探索光、感知与身体的互动装置和视听表演；EyeWriter 团队成员之一。
creators.why_zh: 她的作品让数字生物和几何图形逃离屏幕，跑到手上和身体上，是身体尺度混合现实早期的诗意范例。

creators.name: Kyle McDonald
creators.role: Artist working with code; openFrameworks contributor
creators.bio: Media artist working with computer vision, machine learning and faces; co-created FaceOSC tools, real-time face substitution and many collaborative installations.
creators.why: Pioneered real-time face swapping and mirror-like installations that reflect you in other people's faces.
creators.role_zh: 以代码为媒介的艺术家；openFrameworks 贡献者
creators.bio_zh: 媒体艺术家，创作涉及计算机视觉、机器学习和人脸；参与开发了 FaceOSC 工具、实时换脸技术以及许多合作装置。
creators.why_zh: 他开创了实时换脸和镜像式装置，让你在他人的脸上看到自己的映像。

creators.name: Arturo Castro
creators.role: Artist; openFrameworks core developer
creators.bio: Spanish artist and programmer, long-time openFrameworks core developer working with computer vision, faces and real-time graphics.
creators.why: Co-created, with Kyle McDonald, what is widely cited as the first realistic real-time face substitution.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；openFrameworks 核心开发者
creators.bio_zh: 西班牙艺术家和程序员，长期担任 openFrameworks 核心开发者，创作涉及计算机视觉、人脸和实时图形。
creators.why_zh: 他与 Kyle McDonald 共同创作了被广泛认为是首个逼真的实时换脸作品。

creators.name: Lauren Lee McCarthy
creators.role: Artist; creator of p5.js; Professor, UCLA Design Media Arts
creators.bio: Artist examining social relationships amid surveillance, automation and algorithmic living; creator of the p5.js library and former SFPC teacher.
creators.why: Uses face analysis, gesture tracking and in-ear AI to augment intimate social situations, making AR a tool for questioning surveillance.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；p5.js 创建者；UCLA 设计媒体艺术系教授
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家，审视监控、自动化和算法化生活之下的社会关系；p5.js 库的创建者，曾在 SFPC 任教。
creators.why_zh: 她运用面部分析、手势追踪和入耳式 AI 来增强亲密的社交情境，让 AR 成为质疑监控的工具。

creators.name: Memo Akten
creators.role: Artist and researcher; Assistant Professor, UC San Diego
creators.bio: Turkish-born artist and computer scientist working with code, computer vision and machine learning; author of the ofxMSAFluid tools widely used in the openFrameworks community.
creators.why: Turned webcams into instruments and paintbrushes for the whole body, and later made live AI 'reality filters' of everyday objects.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者；加州大学圣迭戈分校助理教授
creators.bio_zh: 出生于土耳其的艺术家和计算机科学家，创作涉及代码、计算机视觉和机器学习；他开发的 ofxMSAFluid 工具在 openFrameworks 社区中被广泛使用。
creators.why_zh: 他把网络摄像头变成供全身使用的乐器和画笔，后来又为日常物品制作了实时 AI“现实滤镜”。

creators.name: Chris O'Shea
creators.role: Artist and creative technologist
creators.bio: British artist and designer making playful camera-based installations for public screens, museums and hospitals; long-time openFrameworks contributor.
creators.why: Made public-space mixed reality that plays pranks on passers-by, like a giant hand that plucks people off the street on BBC Big Screens.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、创意技术专家
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家和设计师，为公共屏幕、博物馆和医院创作趣味性的摄像头互动装置；长期为 openFrameworks 贡献代码。
creators.why_zh: 他创作了会捉弄路人的公共空间混合现实作品，比如在 BBC Big Screens 上把行人从街上拎起来的巨手。

creators.name: Nicole He
creators.role: Programmer and artist; former Google Creative Lab creative technologist
creators.bio: Programmer and artist making playful work with voice interfaces, games and AI; SFPC and ITP community member.
creators.why: Combined speech recognition with ARCore so you grow AR plants by talking to them.
creators.role_zh: 程序员、艺术家；前 Google Creative Lab 创意技术专家
creators.bio_zh: 程序员和艺术家，用语音界面、游戏和 AI 创作趣味作品；SFPC 与 ITP 社区成员。
creators.why_zh: 她将语音识别与 ARCore 结合，让你通过对 AR 植物说话来让它们生长。

works.title: A 20-million-splat San Francisco on the table
works.description: A 20M-splat scan of San Francisco runs on a phone in WebAR; moving the phone closer zooms into individual streets.
works.idea_zh: 把整座旧金山缩成桌上模型，手机靠近就钻进街道。

video.video_title:
20 million Gaussian splat of SF running all on a mobile device in WebAR. It’s really fun to move the phone around to zoom into different streets. Crazy to see the amount of detail in this scan 

Three

works.technique: A very large splat city is streamed with level-of-detail chunking, placed on a detected tabletop plane, and the renderer loads finer splats as the camera distance to each chunk shrinks.
works.exercise_zh: 把一张城市或校园的 3D 模型按三级 LOD 放在桌面上，手机靠近时切换到高精度版本；变体：靠近某栋楼时弹出一句关于它的语音介绍。
works.description_zh: 一份由 2000 万个高斯点（splat）组成的旧金山扫描，通过 WebAR 在手机上运行；把手机凑近，就能放大到一条条具体的街道。
works.idea_en: Shrink all of San Francisco into a tabletop model, then move the phone closer to dive into its streets.
works.technique_zh: 超大规模的高斯点城市按细节层级（LOD）分块流式加载，放置在检测到的桌面平面上；随着相机与各分块的距离缩短，渲染器会逐步加载更精细的高斯点。
works.exercise_en: Place a 3D model of a city or campus on a tabletop with three LOD levels, and switch to the high-detail version when the phone moves closer. Twist: when the phone approaches a particular building, play a one-line voice introduction about it.

works.title: A Moving Sanctuary
works.description: A cocoon-like pod made for Lexus at Milan Design Week: visitors lie down inside and their breathing and small body movements steer the light and sound around them.
works.description_zh: 为 Lexus 在米兰设计周打造的茧形空间：观众躺在里面，他们的呼吸和细微的身体动作引导着周围的光与声音。
works.idea_en: A room that breathes with you.
works.idea_zh: 一个和你一起呼吸的房间。
works.technique: Thermal sensing and computer vision detect breathing, a custom-trained AI model classifies inhale and exhale in real time, and the output drives a continuous choreography of light and sound.
works.technique_zh: 热成像和计算机视觉检测呼吸，定制训练的 AI 模型实时判断吸气与呼气，输出驱动光与声音的连续编排。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone accelerometer on the chest or a webcam to detect breathing and slowly pulse a projected light or LED strip in the same rhythm. Twist: the light gently leads the breath by breathing a little slower than you.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机放在胸口用加速度计，或用摄像头检测呼吸，让投影光或 LED 灯带以同样的节奏缓慢起伏；变体：让光比你呼吸得稍慢一点，温和地引导你放慢呼吸。

video.video_title: A Moving Sanctuary for Lexus at Milan Design Week 2026

works.title: A picture frame that is a window
works.description: A WebXR picture frame on the office wall that shows a persistent generated 3D world behind it, like a window into another place.
works.idea_zh: 墙上挂一个“相框”，里面其实是通往另一个 3D 世界的窗户。

video.video_title:
New picture frame in the office 

WebXR + Cursor + GPT-5.5 + Marble

I tried XR dev again with cursor earlier this year and still was a frustrating process. This past week I tried again and the tools

works.technique: A frame is anchored to a wall via plane detection, and a stencil mask limits rendering of a persistent 3D world to the frame's rectangle, so parallax makes it read as a window.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在墙上检测平面并放置一个相框，框内用 Stencil 渲染一个远景场景；变体：让框内的时间和天气跟随真实时钟变化。
works.description_zh: 办公室墙上挂着一个 WebXR 相框，框后是一个持续存在的生成式 3D 世界，看上去就像一扇通往别处的窗户。
works.idea_en: A 'picture frame' on the wall is really a window into another 3D world.
works.technique_zh: 通过平面检测把相框锚定在墙上，再用模板遮罩（stencil mask）把一个持续存在的 3D 世界的渲染限制在相框的矩形范围内，借助视差让它看起来像一扇窗。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation to detect a wall plane and place a picture frame on it, then render a distant scene inside the frame with a stencil. Twist: make the time of day and weather inside the frame follow the real clock.

salient.why_en: A picture frame on the wall is really a window: look into it and another 3D world sits behind the wall.
salient.why_zh: 墙上的画框其实是一扇窗，往里看，墙后藏着另一个立体世界。

works.title: A pocket holodeck in WebAR
works.description: Gaussian splats of about 5 MB each, generated from single images, placed around him in web AR like a miniature holodeck.
works.idea_zh: 每个 AI 生成的场景只有 5MB，放在身边就是随身全息甲板。

video.video_title:
Web augmented reality 

Each Gaussian Splat is only 5mb in size and generated from a single image. It’s like a mini sized Holodeck https://t.co/jANStJCIWk

works.technique: Several small single-image splats (about 5 MB each) are placed at fixed offsets around the user's starting pose in WebAR, forming a ring of scenes the user turns to face.
works.exercise_zh: 用单张图片生成 3D 场景的工具（或简单的 3D 模型替代）做 4 个小场景，按东南西北方向摆在自己周围；变体：让每个方向的场景对应一天中的一个时段。
works.description_zh: 由单张图片生成的高斯点场景，每个约 5 MB，通过网页 AR 摆放在他身边，宛如一座迷你全息甲板（holodeck）。
works.idea_en: Each AI-generated scene is only 5 MB, so a few of them placed around you become a holodeck you can carry in your pocket.
works.technique_zh: 在 WebAR 中，以用户初始位姿为中心、按固定偏移摆放若干个由单张图片生成的小型高斯点场景（每个约 5 MB），形成一圈场景，用户转身即可面对不同场景。
works.exercise_en: Make four small scenes with a single-image-to-3D tool (or simple 3D models as stand-ins) and place them around yourself facing north, south, east and west. Twist: let the scene in each direction stand for a different time of day.

works.title: AI Agent Vision: rebuilding a photo as an XR sketch
works.description: Claude is shown a photo of a cabin and rebuilds it inside Figmin XR as a fully editable 3D sketch in mixed reality; Claude and Codex are compared on the same task.
works.description_zh: 把一张小木屋照片给 Claude 看，它在 Figmin XR 里把小屋重建成可完全编辑的三维草图，并放在混合现实中；同一任务还对比了 Claude 和 Codex。
works.idea_en: An AI agent that sketches in 3D next to you, starting from a photo.
works.idea_zh: 一个从照片出发、在你身边画三维草图的 AI 智能体。
works.technique: An LLM agent with vision reads the image and calls Figmin's scripting API to place and shape primitive strokes, producing editable geometry rather than a frozen mesh.
works.technique_zh: 具备视觉能力的大语言模型智能体读图后调用 Figmin 的脚本 API，放置并塑形基础笔画，得到可编辑的几何体而不是固定网格。
works.exercise_en: Give an AI model a photo and ask it to describe the object as a list of 10 primitives (boxes, cylinders) with positions; place them in AR with A-Frame. Twist: ask for the same object as a child would build it.
works.exercise_zh: 给 AI 模型一张照片，让它把物体描述成 10 个基础形体（方块、圆柱）及其位置，用 A-Frame 在 AR 中摆出来。变体：让它按小孩子的搭法来搭同一个东西。

video.video_title: AI Agent Vision in Figmin XR

works.title: AI Building Blocks: multimodal LLMs in mixed reality
works.description: Conversational AI is added to a mixed-reality app with multimodal prompts that combine speech, images and video from the headset, for context-aware answers about the user's surroundings.
works.description_zh: 为混合现实应用加入对话式 AI，把头显的语音、图像和视频组合成多模态提示，针对用户周围环境给出有语境的回答。
works.idea_en: Ask your room a question and let the model see it before answering.
works.idea_zh: 向你的房间提问，让模型先看一眼再回答。
works.technique: Unity building blocks wrap speech-to-text, a multimodal LLM call with passthrough frames, and text-to-speech, so the reply is spoken and shown in space.
works.technique_zh: Unity 模块封装了语音转文字、带透视画面的多模态大语言模型调用以及文字转语音，回答以语音和空间文字呈现。
works.exercise_en: Chain speech-to-text, a vision LLM with one camera frame, and text-to-speech in a phone web page, and use it as a museum guide for objects on a shelf. Twist: the guide must answer as the object itself.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机网页里串起语音转文字、带一帧画面的视觉大语言模型和文字转语音，做成书架上物品的“博物馆讲解员”。变体：讲解员必须以物品本身的口吻回答。

video.video_title: How to Add LLMs to VR Apps with AI Building Blocks

works.title: AI Building Blocks: object detection in mixed reality
works.description: The first of a series on Meta's AI Building Blocks shows real objects in the room detected and labelled in mixed reality, running either on-device or in the cloud.
works.description_zh: 介绍 Meta AI Building Blocks 的系列第一集：房间里的真实物体在混合现实中被检测并加上标签，可在设备端或云端运行。
works.idea_en: Drop-in blocks make the headset name what it sees.
works.idea_zh: 即插即用的模块，让头显说出它看到了什么。
works.technique: Passthrough camera frames go to an object-detection model (on-device or cloud), and boxes are projected into 3D using the environment depth to anchor labels.
works.technique_zh: 透视摄像头画面送入物体检测模型（端侧或云端），再结合环境深度把边界框投射到三维中锚定标签。
works.exercise_en: Use Unity with a ready-made AI building block or a WebAR detection demo to label five classroom objects, then replace each label with a fun fact. Twist: only reveal a label when two people look at the same object.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Unity 的现成 AI 模块或 WebAR 检测示例给教室里的五件物品加标签，再把标签换成一个有趣冷知识。变体：只有两个人同时看着同一件物品时才显示标签。
tech: Meta XR SDK AI Building Blocks

video.video_title: AI Building Blocks Just Changed How We Build VR/MR Apps (Object Detection)

works.title: AI-transformed video call on Spectacles
works.description: A video call experiment on Spectacles in which the caller's live video is transformed by a real-time AI video model; the prototype was built in a few hours with an agentic coding loop.
works.description_zh: Spectacles 上的视频通话实验：对方的实时画面经过实时 AI 视频模型变换后再显示；原型借助智能体编程循环在几小时内完成。
works.idea_en: Telepresence where the person you see is re-imagined as they talk.
works.idea_zh: 远程在场时，你看到的人一边说话一边被重新想象。
works.technique: A native (NDK) WebRTC stream carries the call, frames pass through a hosted video-to-video model, and the transformed stream is shown as a floating panel in the lens.
works.technique_zh: 用原生 NDK 的 WebRTC 传输通话，画面经过在线视频转视频模型处理，转换后的视频以悬浮面板显示在镜片中。
works.exercise_en: Pair two phones on a video call where one side's feed goes through a live AI filter; decide together what the filter should reveal about the speaker. Twist: the filter changes with the speaker's tone of voice.
works.exercise_zh: 让两部手机视频通话，其中一方的画面经过实时 AI 滤镜；两人一起决定滤镜要揭示说话者的什么。变体：滤镜随说话语气变化。

video.video_title:
A quick side quest turned into a video call experiment on SPECS using Decart AI for real-time AI video transformation, powered by NDK and WebRTC.

Thanks to CLAD, less than 2–3 hours of testing was en

works.title: Agent Center for Spectacles
works.description: Agent Center connects a developer's command-line coding agents to Spectacles, so they can prompt agents in AR and keep track of their code while away from the desk.
works.description_zh: Agent Center 把开发者的命令行编程智能体连接到 Spectacles，让人离开工位时也能在 AR 中给智能体下指令并追踪代码进度。
works.idea_en: Your coding agents follow you around as floating panels.
works.idea_zh: 你的编程智能体以悬浮面板的形式跟着你走。
works.technique: A bridge relays prompts and agent output between CLI agents running on a computer and a Spectacles lens that shows sessions as spatial windows.
works.technique_zh: 一个桥接服务在电脑上的命令行智能体与 Spectacles 镜头之间转发提示和输出，镜头把各个会话显示为空间窗口。
works.exercise_en: Mirror the output of a long-running script to a phone WebAR panel that floats by your door, and add a button to send one-word replies back. Twist: the panel changes colour with the agent's mood.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个长时间运行脚本的输出同步到手机 WebAR 面板上，让它悬在门口，并加一个按钮回复一个词。变体：面板颜色随智能体的“情绪”变化。

video.video_title: Introducing Agent Center for Spectacles

works.title: AgentHands
works.description: An AI agent in XR gets a pair of virtual hands that point at, trace and hold up real and virtual objects while it talks, so its explanations are grounded in the space around you.
works.description_zh: XR 中的 AI 智能体拥有一双虚拟手，说话时会指向、描画并举起真实和虚拟的物体，让它的解释扎根于你周围的空间。
works.idea_en: Give a talking AI hands, so it can point instead of describe.
works.idea_zh: 给会说话的 AI 一双手，让它可以指给你看，而不是描述给你听。
works.technique: An LLM plans speech together with gesture tokens that reference scene objects, and a motion generator turns them into hand animations aligned to object positions.
works.technique_zh: 大语言模型同时规划语音和指向场景物体的手势标记，再由动作生成器把它们变成与物体位置对齐的手部动画。
works.exercise_en: In phone AR, add a floating virtual hand to a chatbot that points to a named object in the room when you ask 'where is my ...?'. Twist: let the hand act out the size of an object.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中为聊天机器人加一只悬浮的虚拟手，当你问“我的……在哪里？”时，它会指向房间里的对应物体。变体：让这只手比划出物体的大小。

video.video_title: AgentHands: Generating Interactive Hand Gestures for Spatially Grounded Agent Conversations in XR

works.title: America's founding story in the sky (Boston Pops)
works.description: Over the Charles River during the Boston Pops Fourth of July concert, more than 1,000 drones tell scenes from America's founding in a sequence of animated pictures.
works.description_zh: 在波士顿大众管弦乐团的七四独立日音乐会上，一千多架无人机在查尔斯河上空以一连串动画图像讲述美国建国的场景。
works.idea_en: A drone swarm can tell a story in scenes, like a storyboard in the sky; AR narratives outdoors also need few, bold frames that read from far away.
works.idea_zh: 无人机群可以按场景讲故事，就像天空中的分镜；户外的 AR 叙事同样需要少而醒目、远处也能看懂的画面。
works.technique: Scenes are storyboarded, converted to drone waypoints and flown to the orchestra's timing, with transitions animated between each picture.
works.technique_zh: 先画分镜，再把每个场景转成无人机航点，按管弦乐的节奏飞行，场景之间加入动画过渡。
works.exercise_en: Storyboard a local history in five sky frames and play them in AR above the actual site, each frame held for ten seconds and linked by a morph. Twist: tell the same story with only 30 points and compare which frames survive.
works.exercise_zh: 把一段本地历史画成五个天空分镜，在真实地点上空用 AR 播放，每帧停留十秒，帧与帧之间用变形过渡连接。变体：只用 30 个点讲同一个故事，比较哪些画面还能保留。

video.video_title: How We Brought America’s Founding Story to the Sky | Nova Sky Stories

works.title: An LLM turns a home scan into an editable scene with a portal
works.description: A 3D scan of his parents' old home is given to a multimodal LLM, which rebuilds it as an editable scene; he then turns down gravity and opens a portal inside it.
works.description_zh: 他把父母老房子的三维扫描交给多模态大语言模型，模型把它重建成可编辑场景；随后他调低了重力，并在其中打开了一扇传送门。
works.idea_en: Multimodal LLMs may have crossed the chasm on inverse graphics: scans become worlds you can direct.
works.idea_zh: 多模态大语言模型也许已跨过“逆向图形学”的门槛：扫描变成可以导演的世界。
works.technique: The model interprets the scan (likely images or mesh renders) and emits structured scene code with separate objects and physics, which can be edited by further prompts.
works.technique_zh: 模型解读扫描（很可能是图像或网格渲染），输出带独立物体和物理属性的结构化场景代码，之后可继续用提示修改。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a room from four angles and ask a multimodal LLM to output a three.js scene with boxes for each object; load it in WebXR and change one physical law. Twist: the rebuilt room is how you remember it, not how it is.
works.exercise_zh: 从四个角度拍一个房间，让多模态大语言模型输出一个 three.js 场景，每件物体用盒子表示；在 WebXR 中载入并改变一条物理规律。变体：重建的是你记忆中的房间，而不是它现在的样子。

video.video_title:
Gave Astra a 3D scan of my parents old home to make it an editable scene. Then I turned down gravity and opened a portal.

Turns out multimodal LLMs might have crossed the chasm on inverse graphics. T

works.title: Arcade Hoops: a mixed-reality game built with AI in 30 days
works.description: A walkthrough of building and shipping a full mixed-reality basketball game to the Meta Horizon Store with AI agents, including net physics, tabletop play and a feature that lets players smash their real walls and ceiling.
works.description_zh: 完整记录如何借助 AI 智能体开发并上架一款混合现实篮球游戏，包括球网物理、桌面玩法，以及可以砸碎真实墙壁和天花板的新功能。
works.idea_en: One developer plus coding agents can ship a mixed-reality game in a month.
works.idea_zh: 一个开发者加上编程智能体，一个月就能上架一款混合现实游戏。
works.technique: Unity MCP and Meta's agentic tools let an LLM create scene objects, write C# and wire up the room mesh, with the developer prompting and reviewing each feature.
works.technique_zh: Unity MCP 和 Meta 的智能体工具让大语言模型创建场景物体、编写 C# 并连接房间网格，开发者负责提示和审阅每个功能。
works.exercise_en: In one class session, pair-program a tiny WebXR throwing game with an AI assistant, keeping a log of every prompt. Twist: swap logs with another team and try to rebuild their game from prompts alone.
works.exercise_zh: 用一节课时间，和 AI 助手结对写一个小型 WebXR 投掷游戏，记录每一条提示。变体：与另一组交换记录，只凭提示重做对方的游戏。

video.video_title: I Built & Launched a VR/MR Game with AI in 30 Days!

works.title: Art Morph (Hands-on Hallucinations) at the Cleveland Museum of Art
works.description: In the new ArtLens gallery at the Cleveland Museum of Art, visitors use their hands in front of a camera and see themselves morphed into the style of artworks from the collection.
works.description_zh: 在克利夫兰艺术博物馆新的 ArtLens 展厅里，观众在摄像头前摆动双手，看到自己被“变形”成馆藏艺术品的风格。
works.idea_en: Your own hands become the brush that turns you into a museum painting.
works.idea_zh: 你的双手成了画笔，把你变进博物馆的画里。
works.technique: Likely a camera feed with hand or body segmentation drives an image-to-image diffusion model conditioned on artwork styles from the collection.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是摄像头画面经过手部或人体分割后，驱动以馆藏画作风格为条件的图生图扩散模型。
works.exercise_en: Set up a webcam and projector, pick three public-domain paintings as style references, and let visitors morph into them with a fast image-to-image model. Twist: the painting chosen depends on the pose the visitor holds.
works.exercise_zh: 架好摄像头和投影仪，选三幅公版名画作为风格参考，用快速图生图模型让观众“变身”进去。变体：变成哪幅画，取决于观众摆的姿势。

video.video_title:
Art Morph, adapted from my Hands-on Hallucinations explorations, is one of the many installations in the new ArtLens gallery at the Cleveland Museum of Art.

I love seeing outputs from the installatio

works.title: Carveout: object understanding inside Gaussian splats
works.description: Carveout segments a captured Gaussian-splat scene down to individual Gaussians and extracts labelled 3D objects, such as the furniture of a local barbershop, as separate pieces.
works.description_zh: Carveout 能把拍摄得到的高斯泼溅场景分割到单个高斯点的粒度，把带标签的三维物体（比如街角理发店的家具）逐个提取出来。
works.idea_en: A scan of a real place becomes a box of named, movable objects.
works.idea_zh: 一次真实场所的扫描，变成一盒有名字、可以挪动的物件。
works.technique: 2D segmentation masks from several views are lifted onto the Gaussians, and each cluster receives a label, likely from an open-vocabulary vision model.
works.technique_zh: 把多个视角的二维分割掩码提升到高斯点上，每个聚类获得一个标签，很可能来自开放词汇视觉模型。
works.exercise_en: Scan a desk with a free splat app, segment one object in two photos with a free segmentation tool, and hide or move only that object in a web splat viewer. Twist: swap objects between two students' scans.
works.exercise_zh: 用免费泼溅应用扫描一张桌子，用免费分割工具在两张照片里分割出一个物体，在网页泼溅查看器中只隐藏或移动它。变体：在两位同学的扫描之间交换物体。

video.video_title:
Carveout Explorations #01
⁣
I built Carveout to experiment with object understanding in 3D Gaussian Splat scene with segmentation down to the Gaussian level.

works.title: ChatMuse
works.description: A proactive mixed-reality agent for in-person small-group conversations: it reads everyone's verbal and non-verbal cues and quietly suggests to the wearer what to say, when to jump in or how to include a quiet friend, learning from how the wearer responds.
works.description_zh: 一个用于线下小组交谈的主动式混合现实智能体：它读取所有人的语言与非语言线索，悄悄提示佩戴者该说什么、何时插话、如何照顾沉默的朋友，并从佩戴者的反应中不断学习。
works.idea_en: An AI prompter whispering from the wings of a real conversation.
works.idea_zh: 在真实对话的侧幕里轻声提词的 AI。
works.technique: Speech transcription and non-verbal cue sensing from all participants feed an LLM that generates real-time verbal and behavioral guidance shown as MR overlays; the wearer's reactions refine later suggestions.
works.technique_zh: 对所有参与者进行语音转写和非语言线索感知，交给大语言模型生成实时的说话与行为建议，以 MR 叠加层呈现；佩戴者的反应又用来改进后续建议。
works.exercise_en: Run a three-person conversation in which one person sees a live transcript on a phone or headset; every 30 seconds an LLM reads the transcript and suggests one short action ('ask Mia about her trip'). Debrief on which hints felt helpful and which felt creepy. Twist: show the same hint to everyone at once and watch how the group dynamic changes.
works.exercise_zh: 组织一场三人对话，其中一人在手机或头显上看到实时转写；每 30 秒让大模型读取转写并给出一条简短的行动建议（“问问 Mia 她的旅行”）。结束后讨论哪些提示有帮助、哪些让人不舒服。变体：把同一条提示同时展示给所有人，观察群体氛围如何变化。

video.video_title: ChatMuse: Supporting Small-Group Conversation Experience with an Assistive AI Agent in Mixed Reality

works.title: Coit Tower in the living room
works.description: A 40M-splat scan of San Francisco's Coit Tower placed in his living room, running fully on-device on Quest 3 through WebXR.
works.idea_zh: 把一座真实地标的超大扫描模型搬进客厅，在头显里绕着看。

video.video_title:
40m Coit Tower Gaussian splat in my living room.

Built with GPT-5.5 + three.js (Spark 2.0 LoD). Running fully on-device via quest 3

If we could just get WebXR passthrough on Vision Pro too… https://

works.technique: A 40M-splat scan runs on a standalone headset through hierarchical LoD that culls and simplifies distant splats, keeping the per-frame splat budget within mobile GPU limits.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个高面数模型，分别测试原始版和减面版在 HoloKit 或手机上的帧率，找出流畅运行的上限；变体：用这个预算上限设计一个“把地标搬进客厅”的场景。
works.description_zh: 一份 4000 万个高斯点的旧金山科伊特塔（Coit Tower）扫描被放进他的客厅，通过 WebXR 在 Quest 3 上完全本地运行。
works.idea_en: Bring a huge scan of a real landmark into the living room and walk around it in a headset.
works.technique_zh: 这份 4000 万高斯点的扫描借助分层 LOD 在一体机头显上运行：远处的高斯点被剔除或简化，使每帧的高斯点数量保持在移动 GPU 的承受范围内。
works.exercise_en: Pick a high-poly model, measure the frame rate of the original and a decimated version on HoloKit or a phone, and find the limit for smooth playback. Twist: use that budget to design a scene that brings a landmark into your living room.

works.title: Cosmic XR: lighting on physical surfaces
works.description: An experiment in the Quest app Cosmic XR in which the glowing sun and planets placed in a living room cast light and reflections onto the real walls, floor and furniture.
works.description_zh: Quest 应用 Cosmic XR 中的一项实验：放在客厅里的发光太阳和行星，会把光线和反射投到真实的墙面、地板和家具上。
works.idea_en: Virtual objects feel present when their light lands on real surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 当虚拟物体的光落在真实表面上，它们才真正“在场”。
works.technique: Quest scene understanding supplies a mesh of the room; virtual point lights are rendered onto that invisible mesh and blended over passthrough to fake illumination on physical surfaces.
works.technique_zh: Quest 的场景理解提供房间网格；虚拟点光源照亮这层不可见的网格，再与透视画面混合，模拟真实表面上的照明效果。
works.exercise_en: In AR Foundation with meshing (LiDAR iPhone) or Quest scene mesh, add a glowing virtual object and render its light onto an invisible occlusion mesh so the real table appears lit. Twist: the light colour follows the music playing in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 在支持网格重建的 AR Foundation（LiDAR iPhone）或 Quest 场景网格上，加入一个发光的虚拟物体，并把它的光渲染到不可见的遮挡网格上，让真实桌面看起来被照亮；变体：光的颜色随房间里播放的音乐变化。

video.video_title: Cosmic XR - Lighting on physical surfaces

works.title: Cross-device product viewer (8th Wall open source)
works.description: After 8th Wall went open source, a single web codebase shows the same product visualisation on a phone, a desktop and Snap Spectacles, synced in real time and colocated between devices.
works.description_zh: 在 8th Wall 开源之后，用一套网页代码让同一个产品可视化同时运行在手机、电脑和 Snap Spectacles 上，并在设备间实时同步、共享同一空间。
works.idea_en: One link, every screen: the same AR object shared live across phones, laptops and glasses.
works.idea_zh: 一个链接、所有屏幕：同一个 AR 物体在手机、电脑和眼镜之间实时共享。
works.technique: Three.js with the open-source 8th Wall engine and the WebXR Device API renders the scene per device, while a realtime sync layer shares state and a common anchor.
works.technique_zh: 用 Three.js 加开源的 8th Wall 引擎和 WebXR Device API 在各设备上渲染场景，再通过实时同步层共享状态和共同锚点。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebAR page where rotating a 3D object on a laptop rotates it on every classmate's phone. Twist: each device shows a different material, as if seeing the object through a different lens.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个 WebAR 页面：在电脑上旋转一个 3D 物体，所有同学手机里的物体也会同步旋转；变体：每台设备显示不同材质，就像透过不同的镜片看同一个物体。

video.video_title: 8th Wall Goes Open Source, So I Built This

works.title: Dancing Self-Scan on Your Hand
works.description: His portfolio website, opened in the Spectacles browser, loads a small dancing 3D scan of himself that stands on the visitor's hand through WebXR.
works.description_zh: 他的作品集网站在 Spectacles 浏览器中打开时，会通过 WebXR 加载一个跳舞的迷你版三维扫描的他，站在访客的手上。
works.idea_en: A personal website that puts a tiny dancing you on the visitor's hand.
works.idea_zh: 个人网站会把一个跳舞的迷你版你放到访客手上。
works.technique: A rigged, animated 3D scan is loaded in a three.js WebXR session and parented to the tracked hand joints exposed by the WebXR Hand Input API.
works.technique_zh: 在 three.js 的 WebXR 会话中加载一个带骨骼动画的三维扫描模型，并把它挂到 WebXR Hand Input API 提供的手部关节上。
works.exercise_en: Scan yourself with Polycam, rig it with Mixamo and show it dancing on a hand in a three.js WebXR page on Quest or Spectacles. Twist: the figure jumps to the other hand when you clap.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Polycam 扫描自己，用 Mixamo 绑定骨骼，在 Quest 或 Spectacles 上的 three.js WebXR 网页里让它在手上跳舞；变体：拍手时小人会跳到另一只手上。

works.title: DreamPark arcade vending machine
works.description: A DreamPark 'vending machine' installed at Dave & Buster's Hollywood turns the entire arcade floor into a mixed-reality game.
works.idea_zh: 一台'售卖机'把整个电玩城变成混合现实游戏场。

video.video_title: just installed the first DreamPark vending machine at Dave & Busters Hollywood turning the entire arcade floor into a game! This was just an idea one month ago and now it’s at a major arcade https

works.technique: A fixed physical kiosk serves as the localization anchor and entry point for location-specific MR content laid over the arcade floor.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个实体'入口'（海报或纸箱机器），扫码后进入覆盖整个教室的 AR 游戏；加一个变化：入口每天出售不同的'道具'。
works.description_zh: DreamPark 在好莱坞 Dave & Buster's 电玩城里安放了一台“售卖机”，把整个电玩城的场地变成一场混合现实游戏。
works.idea_en: A 'vending machine' turns an entire arcade into a mixed-reality playground.
works.technique_zh: 一台固定的实体售卖亭既是定位锚点，也是入口，承载叠加在电玩城地面上的特定地点混合现实内容。
works.exercise_en: Design a physical 'entrance' (a poster or a cardboard machine) that, once scanned, starts an AR game covering the whole classroom. Twist: the entrance sells a different 'item' each day.

works.title: Drone text performance, Museum of Islamic Art, Doha
works.description: On the eve of the first Art Basel Qatar, the lights around I. M. Pei's Museum of Islamic Art in Doha go out and a surprise work by Holzer begins: a monumental text piece and drone performance writing words in the night sky. Documented by Art Basel (press upload).
works.description_zh: 在首届卡塔尔巴塞尔艺术展开幕前夜，多哈贝聿铭设计的伊斯兰艺术博物馆周围灯光熄灭，Holzer 的一件惊喜作品开始：一场巨型文字作品与无人机表演，在夜空中写出文字。视频由 Art Basel 发布（媒体上传）。
works.idea_en: Words written in the sky are read by an entire crowd at once; AR text in the sky can do the same, but for every phone pointing up.
works.idea_zh: 写在天空中的文字能被整群人同时读到；天空中的 AR 文字也能做到，只要每部手机都朝上看。
works.technique: A synchronised swarm of lit drones forms letters and phrases in the sky, likely combined with projected text on the museum.
works.technique_zh: 一群同步飞行的发光无人机在空中组成字母和短句，推测同时配合博物馆上的文字投影。
works.exercise_en: Write a short sentence in the sky above campus with WebXR or Lens Studio sky segmentation, letter by letter like drones arriving. Twist: the sentence rearranges into a new one when viewers clap.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 Lens Studio 的天空分割，在校园上空像无人机逐一到位那样一个字一个字地写出一句话；变体：观众拍手时句子重新排列成另一句。

video.video_title: Jenny Holzer stages a spectacular surprise in the skies over Doha

works.title: Dryad
works.description: Procedural trees grow from a seed in the browser, with every leaf rendered as its own card so whole canopies move volumetrically in the wind.
works.description_zh: 程序化的树从一个种子在浏览器里长出来，每片叶子都是单独的面片，整个树冠会在风中立体地摆动。
works.idea_en: A seed number is enough to grow a unique tree, down to each leaf.
works.idea_zh: 一个种子数就足以长出一棵独一无二的树，细到每一片叶子。
works.technique: Branches are generated by rules seeded from a number (and, per the repo, planet physics), and leaves are drawn as GPU-instanced cards animated by wind in three.js / WebGPU.
works.technique_zh: 枝干由一个种子数驱动的规则生成（仓库说明还结合了星球物理），叶子以 GPU 实例化面片绘制，并在 three.js / WebGPU 中随风摆动。
works.exercise_en: Grow a Dryad tree from a WebXR hit-test point on the floor, using the date or the user's name as the seed so everyone plants a different tree. Twist: let the tree grow a little each time the user returns to the same spot.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 命中测试得到的地面位置长出一棵 Dryad 树，用日期或用户名字作为种子，让每个人种出不同的树。变体：用户每次回到同一地点，树都会再长大一点。

works.title: Echoes (JR, La Caverne du Pont Neuf)
works.description: Inside JR's 120-metre artificial cave wrapped around the Pont Neuf, visitors on phones or Spectacles see bats leaving sculptural light trails, echoes of the bodies around them, and a story told through a rift in the rock.
works.description_zh: 在 JR 包裹巴黎新桥、长达 120 米的人造洞穴里，观众用手机或 Spectacles 眼镜可以看到蝙蝠拖出雕塑般的光轨、身边人的身体留下“回声”，以及从岩壁裂缝中展开的故事。
works.idea_en: Layer an invisible, living cave over a physical monumental artwork so the installation keeps changing as people walk through it.
works.idea_zh: 在一件实体巨型艺术装置上叠加一层看不见的“活洞穴”，让作品随观众走动不断变化。
works.technique: Three Lenses run on both Snapchat and Spectacles, using body tracking to create delayed 'echo' copies of visitors and world tracking to anchor bats and story scenes in the cave.
works.technique_zh: 三个 Lens 同时支持 Snapchat 手机端和 Spectacles，用人体追踪生成观众的延迟“回声”分身，用世界追踪把蝙蝠和故事场景固定在洞穴里。
works.exercise_en: Prototype a Lens that leaves a fading ghost copy of anyone who walks through a corridor, delayed by three seconds. Twist: ghosts from different people merge when their paths cross.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个原型 Lens：走过走廊的人都会留下一个延迟三秒、逐渐消散的“幽灵”分身；变体：不同人的幽灵在路径交叉时会融合在一起。

video.video_title: Echoes - JR x Snapchat

works.title: Fake Real Glass
works.description: Glass objects bend and tint the scene behind them with convincing refraction and edge highlights, without any ray tracing.
works.description_zh: 玻璃物体让背后的场景发生逼真的折射和着色，边缘带有高光，完全不需要光线追踪。
works.idea_en: Glass only has to look right from the camera, so fake the bending of light in screen space.
works.idea_zh: 玻璃只要从相机看过去是对的就行，那就在屏幕空间里伪造光的弯折。
works.technique: The shader reads the opaque scene colour behind the object and offsets the lookup using surface normals and an estimated thickness, adding Fresnel reflection and edge darkening instead of tracing rays.
works.technique_zh: 着色器读取物体背后的不透明场景颜色，用表面法线和估算的厚度偏移采样位置，再加上菲涅尔反射和边缘压暗，而不是去追踪光线。
works.exercise_en: Put a fake-glass sculpture on a real table in AR and refract the live camera image through it (the AR background is the scene colour). Twist: let the glass slowly melt into a puddle when you tap it.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一个假玻璃雕塑放在真实桌面上，让实时相机画面透过它折射（AR 背景就是场景颜色）。变体：点击时让玻璃慢慢融化成一滩水。

works.title: FlashGlitch: trigger-based glitch
works.description: Short, sharp bursts of glitch flash across the image on each trigger, made to hit in time with musical beats.
works.description_zh: 每次触发时，画面上闪过短促强烈的故障，专为与音乐节拍同步而做。
works.idea_en: A glitch that hits like a drum.
works.idea_zh: 像鼓点一样打出的故障效果。
works.technique: A URP renderer feature plays a short randomized glitch envelope (displacement, color inversion, slicing) whenever a trigger method is called.
works.technique_zh: URP 渲染器功能在每次调用触发方法时，播放一段短暂的随机故障包络（位移、反色、切片）。
works.exercise_en: Trigger a glitch flash on the AR Foundation camera feed from each kick drum detected by the microphone. Twist: the glitch is only visible through HoloKit on one eye.
works.exercise_zh: 用麦克风检测底鼓，每次触发时让 AR Foundation 相机画面闪一下故障。变体：通过 HoloKit 观看时只在一只眼睛里出现故障。

video.video_title:
Published FlashGlitch, a glitch effect package that adds trigger-based glitch effects as a URP renderer feature. Also included a simple tester UI in the sample project.

works.title: Fluctus
works.description: Life-size, top-down images capture the instant a bird takes off after being released from a wildlife recovery centre, showing wings, colour and structure from a bird's-eye view.
works.description_zh: 等大的俯视图像捕捉了鸟从野生动物救护中心放飞、振翅起飞的那一瞬间，以鸟瞰视角展示翅膀、颜色和结构。
works.idea_en: Changing the viewpoint (from below the sky to above the bird) reveals a new structure, a reminder that AR can offer impossible camera angles on real things.
works.idea_zh: 改变视点（从仰望天空到俯视飞鸟）揭示出新的结构，提醒我们 AR 可以为真实事物提供不可能的机位。
works.technique: A camera mounted above the release point shoots the bird's first wing strokes; sequential frames are likely composited to show the take-off motion.
works.technique_zh: 安装在放飞点上方的相机拍下鸟最初的几次振翅，很可能把连续帧合成以呈现起飞的动作。
works.exercise_en: Place a scanned or rigged bird in AR and let the user switch between a ground view and a locked top-down view of its take-off. Twist: leave a translucent copy of the bird at every wingbeat so the take-off becomes a sculpture.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中放一只扫描或绑定骨骼的鸟，让用户在地面视角和锁定的俯视视角之间切换观看它起飞；变体：每次振翅都留下一个半透明副本，让起飞过程变成一件雕塑。

video.video_title: FLUCTUS

works.title: Fourier Series in AR
works.description: Inspired by 3Blue1Brown, you draw a shape in the air with your hand on Spectacles and a chain of spinning circles (epicycles) redraws it; opening your hand stabilises the drawing.
works.description_zh: 受 3Blue1Brown 启发：戴着 Spectacles 用手在空中画一个形状，一串旋转的圆（本轮）会把它重新画出来；张开手掌可以让图形稳定下来。
works.idea_en: Watch spinning circles redraw the shape you just drew in the air.
works.idea_zh: 看一串旋转的圆把你刚在空中画的形状重新画出来。
works.technique: The hand-drawn path is sampled, a discrete Fourier transform turns it into rotating vectors, and these are rendered as nested circles in 3D whose tip traces the shape.
works.technique_zh: 对手绘路径采样，用离散傅里叶变换把它变成一组旋转向量，再在三维中渲染成层层嵌套的圆，末端描出原来的形状。
works.exercise_en: Record a finger or mouse drawing as 100 points, compute its DFT in JavaScript and animate the epicycles in a WebXR scene. Twist: let students limit the number of circles to see the drawing simplify.
works.exercise_zh: 把手指或鼠标画的线记录成 100 个点，用 JavaScript 计算离散傅里叶变换，并在 WebXR 场景中播放本轮动画；变体：让学生限制圆的数量，观察图形如何被简化。
