Fourier series animated in AR! Made for SPECS/Spectacles

Inspired by @3blue1brown's beautifully made video (https://t.co/dwFBl0pW0N)

Draw shapes with your hands, open your hand to stabilize & sl

works.title: Future whiteboard: marker strokes that come alive
works.description: On a whiteboard, lines drawn with a marker are detected in real time and projected light effects follow the pen and bring the strokes to life.
works.description_zh: 在白板上，用马克笔画出的线条被实时检测到，投影的光效追随笔尖移动，让笔画“活”起来。
works.idea_en: Handwriting becomes the trigger for light.
works.idea_zh: 手写成为触发光的开关。
works.technique: A camera watches the board and the pen tip, new strokes are detected as they appear, and a calibrated projector overlays light effects that follow them (likely).
works.technique_zh: 摄像头监视白板和笔尖，一出现新笔画就被检测到，经过标定的投影仪叠加追随笔画的光效（推测）。
works.exercise_en: Point a webcam and projector at a whiteboard, detect new marker strokes by frame differencing, and spawn projected sparks along them. Twist: sparks travel along the strokes and jump between lines that cross.
works.exercise_zh: 把摄像头和投影仪对准白板，通过帧差检测新画的笔画，并沿笔画生成投影火花；变体：火花沿笔画流动，并在交叉的线之间跳跃。

video.video_title:
【未来のホワイトボード】マーカーの動きに映像が連動する、インタラクティブなプロジェクションマッピング

Roelof Knol氏の作品で、手書きの線や動きをリアルタイムに検知し、光のエフェクトが追従して動き出す。ARと映像技術が融合した次世代の体験型アート

Roelof Knol氏についてはリプ欄。 https://t.co/OOiMAPvI3v

works.title: Galaxy Water
works.description: A liminal platform stands in dark water that reflects a starry galaxy, with sparkling particles drifting above the surface.
works.description_zh: 一个空灵的平台立在黑色水面上，水中倒映着星河，闪烁的粒子在水面上漂浮。
works.idea_en: Water that reflects a universe instead of the sky.
works.idea_zh: 倒映的是整个宇宙，而不是天空的水。
works.technique: A water shader combines normal-map ripples with a procedural starfield in the reflection, plus particle sparkles, in URP.
works.technique_zh: 在 URP 中，水面着色器把法线贴图波纹和反射中的程序化星空结合起来，再叠加闪烁粒子。
works.exercise_en: Turn a real floor into galaxy water in phone AR by placing the shader on the detected plane with people occlusion. Twist: footsteps create ripples of stars.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中把着色器放在检测到的地面上并开启人物遮挡，让真实地板变成星河之水。变体：脚步会激起星光涟漪。

video.video_title:
💖 Cosmic water shader,
++ particles in Unity. 🔵✨ https://t.co/QK2YqKwDZS

works.title: Game Boy graphics in real life
works.description: A living-room test that brings chunky Game Boy-style graphics into the real room.
works.idea_zh: 把 Game Boy 像素画风搬进真实客厅。

video.video_title: Love it. Bringing back gameboy graphics into real life is fun. I did a little test in my living room https://t.co/TbVGaDLIuc

works.technique: Low-poly content is rendered with nearest-neighbor texture filtering, a limited four-color palette and a pixelation post-process, then anchored to room planes so the retro style contrasts with the camera feed.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 场景中加一个像素化 + 四色调色板的后处理 Shader，把一个低多边形角色放在地面上；变体：把后处理也应用到相机画面上，让整个真实房间变成 Game Boy 画风。
works.description_zh: 一次在客厅里的测试：把粗颗粒的 Game Boy 风格画面带进真实房间。
works.idea_en: Bring the Game Boy pixel-art look into a real living room.
works.technique_zh: 低多边形内容使用最近邻纹理过滤、有限的四色调色板和像素化后处理进行渲染，再锚定到房间的平面上，让复古风格与相机画面形成对比。
works.exercise_en: Add a pixelation and four-color palette post-processing shader to an AR scene and place a low-poly character on the floor. Twist: apply the post-process to the camera feed too, so the whole real room turns into Game Boy style.

works.title: Gaussian splat capture in Quest mixed reality
works.description: A friend's Gaussian splat capture viewed in Quest passthrough MR via WebXR and Spark level-of-detail streaming.
works.idea_zh: 把真实场景的扫描放进 MR 里，和现实并排对照。

video.video_title: Really cool seeing this on the quest in mixed reality. I put together a quick demo using WebXR (Three.js), Spark (LoD), and Danny’s raspberry Gaussian splat capture. https://t.co/MMubdNpYci

works.technique: A captured splat is rendered over passthrough in WebXR immersive-ar mode, with LoD streaming loading detail progressively so the capture appears quickly and sharpens as it streams.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Scaniverse 或 Polycam 扫描一位同学或一件物品，导出后在 WebXR 中叠加到真实空间里查看；变体：把多份扫描放在一起，做成一个小型“扫描博物馆”。
works.description_zh: 通过 WebXR 和 Spark 的细节层级流式加载，在 Quest 透视混合现实中查看一位朋友拍摄的高斯点扫描。
works.idea_en: Put a scan of a real place into MR so it sits side by side with reality.
works.technique_zh: 在 WebXR 的 immersive-ar 模式下，把扫描得到的高斯点叠加在透视画面上渲染，并用 LOD 流式加载逐步补充细节，使扫描内容能很快出现，并在加载过程中越来越清晰。
works.exercise_en: Scan a classmate or an object with Scaniverse or Polycam, export it, and view it overlaid on real space in WebXR. Twist: gather several scans together into a small 'scan museum'.

works.title: Gemini Vision Navigator
works.description: A Gemini Live agent looks through the device camera, understands the indoor scene and guides the user by voice and AR cues toward a destination, submitted to the Gemini Live Agent Challenge.
works.description_zh: 一个 Gemini Live 智能体通过设备摄像头观察，理解室内场景，并用语音和 AR 提示把用户引导到目的地；作品参加了 Gemini Live Agent Challenge。
works.idea_en: Indoor navigation without beacons: an agent that reads the room and tells you where to go.
works.idea_zh: 无需信标的室内导航：一个读懂房间、告诉你往哪走的智能体。
works.technique: Camera frames and speech are streamed to the Gemini Live API, whose function calls place AR arrows and markers in the passthrough view.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头画面和语音流式发送到 Gemini Live 接口，它通过函数调用在透视画面中放置 AR 箭头和标记。
works.exercise_en: Use a multimodal live API on a phone to guide a blindfolded partner (with a spotter) from a classroom door to a chosen desk by voice only. Twist: the guide describes landmarks as characters in a story.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机上的多模态实时接口，只靠语音把蒙眼的同伴（旁边有人保护）从教室门口引到指定的桌子。变体：导航把地标描述成故事里的角色。

video.video_title: #GeminiLiveAgentChallenge - Gemini Vision Navigator - Submission video

works.title: Generative Muscle Stimulation
works.description: An AI that helps through your muscles: it looks at your pose and surroundings, understands a request such as opening a pill bottle, and generates electrical-muscle-stimulation instructions that physically move your hand and arm to do it.
works.description_zh: 一个通过你的肌肉来帮忙的 AI：它观察你的姿势与周围环境，理解诸如“打开药瓶”这样的请求，并生成肌肉电刺激指令，直接带动你的手和手臂完成动作。
works.idea_en: Instead of answering in words, the AI answers by moving your body.
works.idea_zh: AI 不用语言回答，而是通过移动你的身体来回答。
works.technique: Computer vision and a multimodal LLM propose movement steps from the user's context, which are constrained by a muscle-stimulation knowledge base and joint limits before being sent to an EMS device.
works.technique_zh: 计算机视觉与多模态大语言模型根据用户情境提出动作步骤，经过肌肉电刺激知识库与关节活动范围的约束后，再发送给 EMS 设备执行。
works.exercise_en: Without EMS hardware, prototype the same loop with visual guidance: send a photo of a task (open a jar, pour water) to a multimodal LLM that may only answer with a sequence of body actions from a fixed list (rotate wrist, grip, lift), and render each step as an AR ghost hand. Twist: make the AI refuse unsafe or impossible motions and discuss who is in control.
works.exercise_zh: 没有 EMS 硬件时，可以用视觉引导来原型化同样的流程：把任务照片（拧开罐子、倒水）发给多模态大模型，要求它只能从固定动作列表（转腕、握紧、抬起）中给出动作序列，并把每一步渲染成 AR 幽灵手。变体：要求 AI 拒绝不安全或做不到的动作，并讨论究竟是谁在掌控。

video.video_title: Generative Muscle Stimulation: Physical-AI by Constraining Multimodal-AI with Embodied Knowledge

salient.why_en: Ask the AI for help and it answers by moving your own hand through your muscles.
salient.why_zh: 向 AI 求助，它不用说话，而是通过肌肉电刺激直接带着你的手去做。

works.title: Inner Room (dance)
works.description: A ritual-like immersive dance where real-time motion capture of the performer transports the audience into a projected digital realm that shifts between friction and calm with her movement.
works.description_zh: 一场仪式般的沉浸式舞蹈：表演者的实时动作捕捉把观众带入投影的数字空间，空间随她的动作在摩擦与平静之间变化。
works.idea_en: The dancer's body becomes the weather of the room.
works.idea_zh: 舞者的身体成为整个房间的天气。
works.technique: Motion-capture data from the dancer drives real-time generative visuals (likely in TouchDesigner or Unreal) projected around the audience.
works.technique_zh: 舞者的动作捕捉数据驱动实时生成的影像（可能用 TouchDesigner 或 Unreal），投影在观众四周。
works.exercise_en: Map a performer's average speed from a webcam pose model to the colour and turbulence of a full-wall projected particle field. Twist: let an audience member's movement add counter-turbulence.
works.exercise_zh: 把摄像头姿态模型算出的表演者平均速度，映射到整面墙投影粒子场的颜色和湍流；变体：让一位观众的动作加入反向湍流。

video.video_title: Inner Room - Motion capture interactive dance

works.title: IronSight: 4D replays from Ray-Ban Meta clips
works.description: Clips recorded on Ray-Ban Meta glasses at a shooting range are reconstructed into 4D scenes that can be replayed from any angle, including an AR view that sees targets through walls.
works.description_zh: 在射击场用 Ray-Ban Meta 眼镜拍下的片段被重建成四维场景，可以从任意角度回放，其中还有一个能透过墙看到靶子的 AR 视图。
works.idea_en: First-person clips become replayable spaces you can re-enter from any angle.
works.idea_zh: 第一人称片段变成可以从任意角度重新进入的回放空间。
works.technique: Likely a feed-forward 4D reconstruction model estimates camera motion, depth and dynamic geometry from the glasses video, which is rendered as a navigable replay.
works.technique_zh: 很可能用前馈式四维重建模型从眼镜视频中估计相机运动、深度和动态几何，再渲染成可漫游的回放。
works.exercise_en: Record a 10-second first-person clip of a simple action (throwing a ball), reconstruct it with a free video-to-3D tool and replay it in AR at the same spot from a new angle. Twist: replay it from the ball's point of view.
works.exercise_zh: 录一段 10 秒的第一人称简单动作（扔球），用免费视频转三维工具重建，在原地用 AR 从新的角度回放。变体：从球的视角回放。

video.video_title: Loving how this turned out! IronSight turns Meta Ray-Ban clips (from the range) into 4D reconstructions you can replay from any angle -- including an AR view that sees targets straight through walls.

works.title: Karbon: live camera visuals with Launchpad
works.description: Live camera feeds of a singer are sliced, tinted and glitched in real time for a club event, controlled by pressing pads on a Novation Launchpad.
works.description_zh: 歌手的实时相机画面在俱乐部活动中被实时切片、染色和故障化，通过按 Novation Launchpad 上的按键来控制。
works.idea_en: Play camera effects like a drum machine.
works.idea_zh: 像打鼓机一样演奏相机特效。
works.technique: A UVC capture device brings the camera into Unity URP, where a stack of custom full-screen effects is mapped to Launchpad pads via Minis, including polyphonic aftertouch.
works.technique_zh: UVC 采集设备把相机画面接入 Unity URP，一组自定义全屏效果通过 Minis 映射到 Launchpad 按键上，还支持复音触后。
works.exercise_en: Map four camera effects on a phone AR app to four on-screen pads and perform them live over a friend's music. Twist: pressure or hold time controls the strength.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机 AR 应用里的四种相机特效映射到四个屏幕按键上，配合朋友的音乐现场演奏。变体：按压力度或时长控制强度。

video.video_title: This time I used Novation Launchpad X with the Unity MIDI Input plugin (Minis). It supports polyphonic aftertouch, letting me control multiple effects with touch pressure. This added expressiveness re

works.title: KinoGlitch URP: analog and digital glitch
works.description: A scene is hit with scan-line jitter, color drift, block noise and a new horizontal ripple, recreating broken video signals.
works.description_zh: 画面出现扫描线抖动、色彩漂移、块状噪点和新的水平波纹，重现损坏的视频信号。
works.idea_en: Broken signals as an expressive style.
works.idea_zh: 把坏掉的信号变成一种表现风格。
works.technique: Lightweight full-screen URP passes offset UVs per line and per block using noise, split RGB channels and are driven by camera-attached controller components.
works.technique_zh: 轻量的 URP 全屏通道用噪声按行、按块偏移 UV 并分离 RGB 通道，由挂在相机上的控制组件驱动。
works.exercise_en: Glitch the AR Foundation camera feed whenever a virtual object appears or disappears, so the reality seems to break. Twist: glitch strength grows the closer you get to a hidden anchor.
works.exercise_zh: 每当虚拟物体出现或消失时，让 AR Foundation 相机画面出现故障，好像现实坏掉了。变体：离隐藏锚点越近，故障越强。

video.video_title:
Ported my old KinoGlitch effect package to Unity 6 URP. I refactored and improved the existing effects and added a new "Horizontal Ripple" effect.
https://t.co/co3gOMUPTF https://t.co/U9RoNwKakl

works.title: LEGO AR glasses proof of concept
works.description: A Spectacles proof of concept that adds AR effects and characters to LEGO Smart Bricks builds, reacting to the physical bricks in play.
works.idea_zh: 给乐高智能积木叠加AR角色与特效，实体积木驱动虚拟内容。

video.video_title: Lego AR glasses proof of concept  - Spectacles

works.technique: Signals from the smart bricks (state, motion, identity) are read over a wireless link and mapped to AR effects anchored to the build's tracked position.
works.exercise_zh: 用一块 micro:bit 或手机传感器数据驱动 AR 效果：摇动真实积木时 AR 中喷出火花；变体：两块积木靠近时出现一段对话。
works.description_zh: 一个基于 Spectacles 的概念验证：为 LEGO Smart Bricks 搭建的作品加上 AR 特效和角色，它们会对游戏中的实体积木作出反应。
works.idea_en: AR characters and effects are layered onto LEGO smart bricks, so the physical bricks drive the virtual content.
works.technique_zh: 通过无线连接读取智能积木的信号（状态、运动、身份），并映射为锚定在作品追踪位置上的 AR 特效。
works.exercise_en: Drive an AR effect with a micro:bit or phone sensor data, so that shaking a real brick makes sparks burst out in AR. Twist: when two bricks come close, a short conversation appears.

works.title: La Caverne du Pont Neuf
works.description: Paris's oldest bridge, the Pont Neuf, is covered by an inflated structure printed with rock, so the bridge seems to have vanished into a cave; the AR companion is listed separately as Echoes (Paris AR Studio).
works.description_zh: 巴黎最古老的桥梁新桥被一座印有岩石图案的充气结构覆盖，桥仿佛消失在一个洞穴中；其 AR 配套作品另行收录为 Echoes（Paris AR Studio）。
works.idea_en: Turning a bridge into a cave is world replacement at city scale, and pairing it with a phone lens shows how physical and AR layers can tell one story.
works.idea_zh: 把一座桥变成洞穴，是城市尺度的“替换世界”，再配上手机滤镜，展示了实体图层与 AR 图层如何讲同一个故事。
works.technique: A large inflatable envelope printed with rock imagery is fitted over the bridge and walkway (timelapse footage by AP).
works.technique_zh: 一个印有岩石图像的大型充气外壳覆盖在桥体和步道上（美联社拍摄的延时影像）。
works.exercise_en: Scan a small bridge or passage on campus and in AR replace its surfaces with a cave material, adding dripping sounds inside. Twist: the cave grows stalactites the longer the bridge is empty.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描校园里的一座小桥或通道，在 AR 中把它的表面换成洞穴材质，并在里面加入滴水声；变体：桥上无人的时间越长，洞里的钟乳石长得越多。

video.video_title: French artist JR inflates a giant ‘cave’ over Paris’ oldest bridge

salient.why_en: Paris's oldest bridge disappears inside a rock cave.
salient.why_zh: 巴黎最古老的桥消失在一座岩洞里。

works.title: Leap Motion-style hand tracker with Meta Ray-Ban glasses
works.description: Video from Meta Ray-Ban glasses is streamed to a phone and on to a laptop webpage, where hand gestures seen from the wearer's point of view pinch and rotate 3D models on screen.
works.description_zh: 把 Meta Ray-Ban 眼镜拍到的画面传到手机、再传到电脑网页上，佩戴者视角中的手势可以捏合并旋转屏幕上的 3D 模型。
works.idea_en: Turn camera glasses into a hand controller for any screen, even one with no webcam.
works.idea_zh: 把带摄像头的眼镜变成任何屏幕的手势控制器，哪怕那块屏幕没有摄像头。
works.technique: The Wearables Developer Access Toolkit streams glasses video to an iPhone, which forwards frames over WebSocket to a web page running MediaPipe hand tracking.
works.technique_zh: 用 Wearables Developer Access Toolkit 把眼镜视频传到 iPhone，再通过 WebSocket 转发帧到运行 MediaPipe 手部追踪的网页上。
works.exercise_en: Stream a phone camera held at eye level to a laptop and use MediaPipe hands to rotate a 3D model with a pinch. Twist: add a second gesture that switches between models.
works.exercise_zh: 把举在眼睛高度的手机摄像头画面传到电脑上，用 MediaPipe 手部追踪通过捏合手势旋转 3D 模型；变体：加一个切换模型的第二种手势。

video.video_title: 👋 Built a Leap Motion-style hand tracker using my Meta Ray-Ban glasses

works.title: Light leak effect
works.description: Warm streaks and blobs of light drift across the frame like film light leaks, blending over the scene.
works.description_zh: 温暖的光条和光斑在画面上漂过，像胶片漏光一样叠在场景上。
works.idea_en: Borrow a film-camera accident as a mood.
works.idea_zh: 借用胶片相机的意外，营造氛围。
works.technique: Light leak sources made with Shader Graph and VFX Graph are rendered by an offscreen camera into a RenderTexture, then blurred and composited onto the main image.
works.technique_zh: 用 Shader Graph 和 VFX Graph 做出的漏光光源由离屏相机渲染到 RenderTexture，再模糊并合成到主画面上。
works.exercise_en: Add drifting light leaks to the AR Foundation camera feed and tie their color to the real room's light estimate. Twist: leaks enter from the direction of the nearest window.
works.exercise_zh: 给 AR Foundation 相机画面加漂移的漏光，颜色跟随真实房间的光照估计。变体：漏光从最近的窗户方向进入。

video.video_title:
Tried creating a light leak effect for Unity URP. This is more of an experimental exploration than a finished package, but it was a fun exercise.
https://t.co/Ru3Y7S9X8Q https://t.co/UVFMMr9Giv

works.title: Live Scene Analyzer: describing actions and checking tasks
works.description: A first-person AR headset feed is read by an AI model almost in real time: in Description Mode it narrates actions like typing, using a phone or petting a cat; in Scenario Mode it ticks off steps of a morning routine.
works.description_zh: AI 模型几乎实时地读取第一人称 AR 头显画面：描述模式下讲出打字、看手机、摸猫等动作；场景模式下逐项核对晨间流程是否完成。
works.idea_en: Your glasses watch what your hands do and keep your checklist for you.
works.idea_zh: 眼镜看着你的手在做什么，替你打勾完成清单。
works.technique: Short clips or frames from the headset camera are sent with a system prompt to a vision-language model that returns an action description or a task-completion verdict.
works.technique_zh: 把头显摄像头的短片段或帧连同系统提示发给视觉语言模型，返回动作描述或任务是否完成的判断。
works.exercise_en: Mount a phone on your head, send a frame every three seconds to a vision model with a five-step checklist (for example making tea), and tick steps on screen as they are seen. Twist: the checklist is a dance routine.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机戴在头上，每三秒发送一帧给视觉模型，配一张五步清单（例如泡茶），看到一步就在屏幕上打勾。变体：清单换成一段舞蹈动作。

video.video_title: Live Scene Analyzer: Describing Actions and Checking Tasks with AI

works.title: Living room redesign as WebAR splat
works.description: A generated interior redesign of his living room rendered as a Gaussian splat and aligned in WebAR, so he can walk through the future room on his phone.
works.idea_zh: 把 AI 设计的新客厅以 1:1 叠在旧客厅上，用手机走进“未来的房间”。

video.video_title: Testing sol 5.6 tonight. Built this using 8thWall webAR + sparkjs (open source) with a world labs gaussian splat generation of new interior design of my living room https://t.co/kROA4d127B

works.technique: A generated splat of the redesigned room is placed at 1:1 scale and manually aligned (origin + yaw) to the real room, so SLAM tracking lets the user walk through the future interior on a phone.
works.exercise_zh: 拍一张自己房间的照片交给图像模型改造，再用任意 3D 工具摆出简化版家具，按 1:1 比例放进 AR 中与真实房间对齐；变体：加一个滑块在“现在”和“改造后”之间切换透明度。
works.description_zh: 他把 AI 生成的客厅改造方案渲染成高斯点场景，在 WebAR 中与真实客厅对齐，于是可以拿着手机走进未来的房间。
works.idea_en: Overlay an AI-designed living room on the old one at 1:1 scale, and walk into the 'future room' with a phone.
works.technique_zh: 把改造后房间的生成式高斯点场景按 1:1 比例放置，并手动与真实房间对齐（原点加偏航角），借助 SLAM 追踪，用户可以拿着手机在未来的室内空间中走动。
works.exercise_en: Photograph your room and have an image model redesign it, then lay out simplified furniture in any 3D tool and place it in AR at 1:1 scale, aligned with the real room. Twist: add a slider that fades between 'now' and 'after the makeover'.

works.title: MagicPen
works.description: A stylus that physically grows and shrinks, so its tip always rests on the virtual surface you are drawing on in VR, giving you something solid to press against while sculpting.
works.description_zh: 一支可以实际伸缩的触控笔，让笔尖始终停在你在 VR 中绘画的虚拟表面上，雕塑时手里总有可以按压的实感。
works.idea_en: Fake a surface by moving the tool, not the world.
works.idea_zh: 通过移动工具而不是移动世界，来模拟出一个表面。
works.technique: A motorised telescoping shaft adjusts the pen's length in real time based on the distance to the virtual surface, braced against a physical desk so pressure is grounded.
works.technique_zh: 电动伸缩笔杆根据与虚拟表面的距离实时调整笔的长度，并抵在实体桌面上，让按压力有真实的支撑。
works.exercise_en: Draw on a virtual sphere floating above a table in phone AR while physically pressing a pencil on the table, and compare with drawing in mid-air. Twist: map pencil pressure to line thickness.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中，一边在桌上实际按压铅笔，一边在悬浮于桌面上方的虚拟球体上画画，并与悬空绘画比较。变体：把铅笔压力映射为线条粗细。

video.video_title: MagicPen UIST26

works.title: Me See I
works.description: A dancer guides the audience through a landscape of memory and the subconscious, while his live brain activity is visualised and animates the digital environment around him.
works.description_zh: 舞者带领观众穿过记忆与潜意识交织的景观，同时他的实时脑活动被可视化，驱动周围的数字环境。
works.idea_en: Let the performer's brain, not only his body, move the stage.
works.idea_zh: 让表演者的大脑，而不只是身体，推动舞台。
works.technique: A wearable neuroimaging headset (likely EEG or fNIRS) streams brain signals that are mapped to parameters of projected generative visuals.
works.technique_zh: 可穿戴的脑成像头戴设备（可能是 EEG 或 fNIRS）传出脑信号，映射到投影生成影像的参数上。
works.exercise_en: Use a consumer EEG band (or a heart-rate sensor as a stand-in) to change the density of a projected forest while a performer alternates between calm and active tasks. Twist: hide the signal from the performer and let the audience guess what drives it.
works.exercise_zh: 用消费级脑电头带（或用心率传感器代替）改变投影森林的密度，让表演者在平静和活跃任务之间切换；变体：不让表演者看到信号，让观众猜是什么在驱动画面。

video.video_title: Me See I - Brain-driven Interactive Dance Performance

works.title: MeshSlicer: cutting objects in real time
works.description: Wooden crates are cut along a plane and fall apart into pieces with clean new faces, in an interactive demo built with AI coding agents.
works.description_zh: 木箱沿一个平面被切开，碎成带有干净新切面的几块，这是一个借助 AI 编程代理完成的交互演示。
works.idea_en: Cut any mesh and fill the wound.
works.idea_zh: 切开任意网格，并把切口补上。
works.technique: The slicer splits triangles by a plane, generates cap geometry for the cut surface and turns the halves into physics objects; the code was written through Unity MCP with AI agents.
works.technique_zh: 切割器按平面拆分三角形，为切面生成封口几何体，再把两半变成物理物体；代码通过 Unity MCP 由 AI 代理编写。
works.exercise_en: Slice virtual objects placed on a real table in AR Foundation by swiping the phone through them. Twist: slice a scan of a real object and hide the real one.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中挥动手机穿过真实桌上的虚拟物体，把它们切开。变体：切开一个真实物体的扫描模型，并把真的藏起来。

video.video_title:
Unity でメッシュをスライスするやつのテスト
https://t.co/0QtqKCJtwX https://t.co/KSQfA3Wx34

works.title: Meta Ray-Ban AI City Tour Guide
works.description: A proof of concept built at In The Pocket: a location-aware AI tour guide on Meta Ray-Ban glasses that walks you through Ghent and describes what you look at.
works.idea_zh: 戴Ray-Ban Meta眼镜的AI城市导游，边走边讲解眼前所见。

video.video_title: Meta Ray-Ban AI City Tour Guide

works.technique: GPS location and a captured camera frame are sent to a multimodal LLM, which returns a spoken description through the glasses, giving audio-first AR without a display.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个校园语音导览：拍照 + GPS 发给多模态模型，模型用 30 秒语音介绍眼前建筑；变体：让导游用某位历史人物的口吻说话。
works.description_zh: 在 In The Pocket 完成的一个概念验证：运行在 Meta Ray-Ban 眼镜上的位置感知 AI 导游，带你漫步根特（Ghent），并讲解你眼前看到的东西。
works.idea_en: An AI city guide in Ray-Ban Meta glasses describes whatever you are looking at as you walk.
works.technique_zh: 把 GPS 位置和一帧相机画面发送给多模态大语言模型，模型返回的描述通过眼镜以语音播放，实现无需显示屏、以声音为主的 AR。
works.exercise_en: Build a campus audio tour: send a photo plus GPS to a multimodal model and have it introduce the building in front of you in a 30-second voice clip. Twist: make the guide speak in the voice of a historical figure.

works.title: Meta glasses fitness coach
works.description: A proof of concept counts squats in real time with body tracking from glasses video and could add hands-free coaching such as form cues, goals and exercise variations.
works.description_zh: 一个概念验证：利用眼镜视频做身体追踪，实时计数深蹲，并可扩展为免手动的指导，比如动作提示、目标和动作变化。
works.idea_en: A coach that watches your form from your own point of view.
works.idea_zh: 一个从你自己的视角看你动作的教练。
works.technique: Frames from the glasses camera (likely looking at a mirror or the legs) run through a pose model, and a simple state machine counts repetitions and triggers spoken cues.
works.technique_zh: 眼镜摄像头的画面（很可能对着镜子或腿部）经过姿态模型，简单的状态机计数重复次数并触发语音提示。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam pose model in the browser to count squats and speak encouragement at every fifth rep; show the count as large AR text. Twist: the coach gets more sarcastic as your form gets worse.
works.exercise_zh: 在浏览器里用摄像头姿态模型数深蹲，每五次说一句鼓励，把计数以大号 AR 文字显示。变体：动作越不标准，教练越爱挖苦。

video.video_title:
🏋️ Meta Glasses × Fitness Coach

Built a POC for real-time squat counting using body tracking, could also add hands-free coaching: form cues, goals, exercise variations.

Powered by the Meta Wearables

works.title: Micro Art
works.description: An AR lens that reveals an imagined microscopic world inside plants, rocks and other things you point it at in nature.
works.idea_zh: 对准自然界的物体，揭示其中想象的微观世界。

video.video_title: This AR Lens Reveals the Hidden Micro-World Inside Everything 🔬

works.technique: The lens segments or classifies the pointed-at natural object and anchors a generated microscopic scene to it, likely using a pre-generated asset per category.
works.exercise_zh: 对准一片树叶或石头，AR 中在它表面放大显示一个想象中的微观世界；变体：每种材质对应一个不同的微观生物族群。
works.description_zh: 一个 AR 滤镜（lens）：把它对准自然中的植物、岩石等物体，就能看到藏在其中的想象中的微观世界。
works.idea_en: Point at an object in nature to reveal an imagined microscopic world inside it.
works.technique_zh: 滤镜对所指向的自然物体进行分割或分类，再把生成的微观场景锚定在物体上，大概率是为每个类别预先生成了一套资源。
works.exercise_en: Point the camera at a leaf or a stone and show an imagined microscopic world magnified on its surface in AR. Twist: give each material its own family of microscopic creatures.

salient.why_en: Point at a rock or leaf and see the imagined microscopic world living inside it.
salient.why_zh: 对准一块石头或一片叶子，就能看到它内部想象出来的微观世界。

works.title: Mirror
works.description: Two dancers are watched by an AI system that first mirrors their actions on screen and then distorts, intervenes in and reshapes how they appear to each other, in a duet between bodies and a machine gaze.
works.description_zh: 两位舞者被一个 AI 系统注视：它先在屏幕上镜像他们的动作，随后开始扭曲、介入并重塑他们在彼此眼中的样子，形成身体与机器凝视之间的双人舞。
works.idea_en: An AI mirror that starts faithful and slowly lies.
works.idea_zh: 一面起初忠实、后来慢慢说谎的 AI 镜子。
works.technique: Live motion capture and photogrammetry-based avatars feed a generative AI pipeline that renders an altered mirror image of the dancers in real time (details of the models are likely custom).
works.technique_zh: 实时动作捕捉和基于摄影测量的化身输入生成式 AI 流程，实时渲染出被改写的舞者镜像（所用模型细节很可能为定制）。
works.exercise_en: Build a webcam 'mirror' that shows students their pose skeleton and slowly exaggerates one joint at a time. Twist: let a partner secretly choose which joint the mirror distorts, and see if the dancer notices.
works.exercise_zh: 做一面摄像头“镜子”，显示学生的姿态骨架，并逐个关节地慢慢夸大；变体：让搭档偷偷选择镜子扭曲哪个关节，看舞者能否察觉。

video.video_title: RITE OF SPRING AND MIRROR | ALEXANDER WHITLEY DANCE COMPANY

works.title: Navig-AI-tion
works.description: Walking directions are given as spatial audio cues combined with an AI that describes nearby landmarks from the camera, so you navigate by sound and context rather than by staring at a map.
works.description_zh: 步行导航通过空间音频提示给出，同时 AI 根据摄像头画面描述附近的地标，于是你靠声音和情境导航，而不是盯着地图。
works.idea_en: Navigation you can hear, grounded in what is actually around you.
works.idea_zh: 可以“听”的导航，建立在你身边真实存在的事物之上。
works.technique: A vision-language model describes landmarks from the egocentric camera, and turn directions are rendered as spatialised sound sources placed in the direction to walk.
works.technique_zh: 视觉语言模型根据第一人称摄像头描述地标，转向提示被渲染成放置在前进方向上的空间化声源。
works.exercise_en: Guide a blindfolded partner across a courtyard using only a spatial-audio beacon placed in AR on the target. Twist: add one spoken landmark hint per 20 metres.
works.exercise_zh: 只用一个在 AR 中放置于目标处的空间音频信标，引导蒙着眼的同伴穿过院子。变体：每 20 米增加一句提到地标的语音提示。

video.video_title: Navig-AI-tion: Navigation by Contextual AI and Spatial Audio

works.title: Objestures: Everyday Objects Meet Mid-Air Gestures for Expressive Interaction
works.description: A CHI 2026 design space (with Per Ola Kristensson) that lets each hand either handle an ordinary object or gesture in mid-air: squeeze a stuffed toy while sliding a finger along a book edge to play music, rotate a cup to change brush size while drawing, move a cup lid carrying a model building while a fist plays the sun to watch its shadow move, or steer a spaceship game along a window frame.
works.description_zh: 一个 CHI 2026 的设计空间（与 Per Ola Kristensson 合作）：每只手要么操作一件普通物品，要么在空中做手势。捏毛绒玩具、同时手指沿书脊滑动来演奏音乐；一边画画一边转杯子调笔刷粗细；移动托着建筑模型的杯盖，另一只握拳的手当太阳，看阴影如何移动；或者沿窗框滑动手指来操控飞船游戏。
works.idea_en: Any object within reach can become a controller without sensors: a cup is a dial, a book edge is a slider, a plush toy is a pressure pad.
works.idea_zh: 手边任何东西都能不加传感器就变成控制器：杯子是旋钮，书脊是滑条，毛绒玩具是压力垫。
works.technique: Uses only the Quest 3 built-in hand tracking in passthrough (Unity): after a thumbs-up to register an object's position, the system reads five interaction types (binary, linear, rotational, nonlinear, free) from finger and knuckle motion on the uninstrumented object, smoothed with an adaptive moving average.
works.technique_zh: 只用 Quest 3 自带的手部追踪（透视模式，Unity）：用竖大拇指的手势登记物体位置后，系统从手指和指节在未加改装的物体上的运动中读出五种交互类型（二值、线性、旋转、非线性、自由），并用自适应滑动平均去抖。
works.exercise_en: In a headset or phone-AR hand-tracking app, register a real mug and map its rotation, read from the tracked hand, to the pitch of a synth tone; add a mid-air pinch with the other hand to trigger notes. Twist: remap the same mug to something that contradicts its meaning and discuss why it feels wrong.
works.exercise_zh: 在头显或支持手部追踪的手机 AR 应用里，登记一个真实马克杯，用追踪到的手部转动来控制合成器音高，另一只手在空中捏合来触发音符。变体：把同一个杯子映射到一个与它本身含义相冲突的功能上，讨论为什么会觉得别扭。

video.video_title: [CHI '26] Objestures: Everyday Objects Meet Mid-Air Gestures for Expressive Interaction

works.title: Off-axis projection with face tracking
works.description: A head-coupled perspective demo: MediaPipe tracks the viewer's face so a 3D scanned shoe on a flat screen shifts perspective like a window.
works.idea_zh: 用摄像头追踪人脸，让普通屏幕变成有纵深的“窗口”，头动画面跟着变。

video.video_title:
Created an off-axis projection demo using mediapipe for face tracking, threejs and a 3D scanned shoe.

Try it out yourself… https://t.co/VMl2VTWimN

works.technique: MediaPipe face landmarks estimate the eye position relative to the screen, and an off-axis (asymmetric frustum) projection is recomputed each frame so the monitor behaves like a window with correct parallax.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 估算头部位置，在 three.js 中按头部坐标更新非对称视锥投影，让屏幕里的一只鞋产生视差；变体：让物体“探出”屏幕平面，测试错觉在哪个角度失效。
works.description_zh: 一个头部耦合透视的演示：MediaPipe 追踪观看者的脸，让平面屏幕上的一只 3D 扫描鞋子像隔着窗户一样随视角变化。
works.idea_en: A webcam tracks your face and turns an ordinary screen into a window with depth that shifts as your head moves.
works.technique_zh: 利用 MediaPipe 人脸关键点估算眼睛相对屏幕的位置，每帧重新计算离轴（非对称视锥）投影，让显示器像一扇具有正确视差的窗户。
works.exercise_en: Estimate head position with MediaPipe Face Mesh and update an asymmetric frustum projection in three.js from the head coordinates, so a shoe on screen shows parallax. Twist: make the object 'lean out' past the screen plane and test at what angle the illusion breaks.

works.title: Off-axis window into a generated world
works.description: Blender layout turned into a detailed World Labs splat, viewed through a face-tracked off-axis projection so the monitor becomes a window.
works.idea_zh: 先用简单体块搭场景，再用 AI 生成细节，最后用人脸追踪把屏幕变成通往世界的窗。

video.video_title:
Testing off-axis projection demo.

Basic scene layout in Blender 
glb -> detailed splat via World Labs
Three.js for engine
MediaPipe for face tracking

Next step is to add a character you can move

works.technique: A generated splat world is rendered with a head-coupled off-axis projection driven by webcam face tracking, placing the scene behind the monitor plane so it reads as a view through glass.
works.exercise_zh: 沿用人脸追踪的离轴投影，把屏幕后面换成一条长走廊或峡谷场景来放大纵深感；变体：头部靠近屏幕时让场景里的雾逐渐散开。
works.description_zh: 先在 Blender 中搭好布局，再用 World Labs 生成细节丰富的高斯点世界，最后通过人脸追踪的离轴投影观看，让显示器变成一扇窗。
works.idea_en: Block out a scene with simple shapes, let AI fill in the detail, then use face tracking to turn the screen into a window onto that world.
works.technique_zh: 生成的高斯点世界采用由网络摄像头人脸追踪驱动的头部耦合离轴投影进行渲染，场景被放在显示器平面之后，看起来就像透过玻璃望出去。
works.exercise_en: Reuse the face-tracked off-axis projection and replace what lies behind the screen with a long corridor or canyon to exaggerate the sense of depth. Twist: as your head moves closer to the screen, let the fog in the scene gradually clear.

works.title: On-device vision AI: scene understanding and prompt-based OCR
works.description: An LLM running entirely on a smartphone, without internet, either summarises the scene or reads only the text on an object you name, such as a label or a sign, and organises it into meaningful units.
works.description_zh: 一个完全在手机上离线运行的大语言模型：可以概括眼前场景，也可以只读取你点名的那个物体上的文字（比如标签或招牌），并整理成有意义的条目。
works.idea_en: Say what to read instead of framing it inside a scan box.
works.idea_zh: 说出要读什么，而不是把它对准扫描框。
works.technique: A small on-device multimodal model receives the camera frame plus a natural-language target and returns structured text, replacing the fixed region of interest of classic OCR.
works.technique_zh: 小型端侧多模态模型接收摄像头画面和一句自然语言目标，返回结构化文字，取代传统 OCR 固定的识别区域。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone page that sends a photo and a spoken request ('read the ingredients on the red box') to a vision model and pins the answer next to the object in AR. Twist: ask it to read things that have no text, like a face or a plant.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机页面，把照片和一句语音请求（“读一下红盒子上的配料”）发给视觉模型，并在 AR 中把答案钉在物体旁。变体：让它“读”没有文字的东西，比如一张脸或一株植物。

video.video_title: On-Device Vision AI: Scene Understanding & Prompt-Based OCR

works.title: One-click custom object detector for Spectacles
works.description: A pipeline turns raw footage into a trained object detector for Spectacles in one click: SAM 3 labels the objects, a small YOLO model trains in the cloud, and a SnapML-ready ONNX file drops into Lens Studio.
works.description_zh: 一条流水线一键把原始视频变成 Spectacles 可用的物体检测器：SAM 3 自动标注，云端训练小型 YOLO 模型，再输出 SnapML 可用的 ONNX 文件放进 Lens Studio。
works.idea_en: Teaching glasses to recognise your own objects should take a click, not a weekend.
works.idea_zh: 教眼镜认识你自己的物件，应该只需一次点击，而不是一个周末。
works.technique: A segmentation foundation model (SAM 3) auto-labels frames, which train a YOLOv7-tiny detector exported to ONNX for on-device SnapML inference.
works.technique_zh: 用分割基础模型（SAM 3）自动标注视频帧，训练 YOLOv7-tiny 检测器并导出 ONNX，供 SnapML 在设备端推理。
works.exercise_en: Film 30 seconds of one object, auto-label it with a free segmentation tool, train a tiny detector (Teachable Machine or YOLO in Colab) and trigger an AR label when it is seen. Twist: detect objects that should not be there and make them glow.
works.exercise_zh: 拍 30 秒某个物件，用免费分割工具自动标注，训练一个小检测器（Teachable Machine 或 Colab 里的 YOLO），看到它时弹出 AR 标签。变体：检测“不该出现在这里”的东西并让它发光。

video.video_title:
Training a custom object detector for Snap Spectacles used to take a whole weekend.

Now it's one click.

Footage in → SnapML-ready ONNX out. SAM3 labels, YOLOv7-tiny trains in the cloud, drops straig

works.title: Pell Ensemble x handmadesound x Thunkist: Magnitogorsk R&D
works.description: Proof of concept for a spatial-sound, 360° film dance work about the industrial history of Magnitogorsk: with a smartwatch on each wrist, dancer Rebecca Evans triggers the music and moves it around a surround-sound space.
works.description_zh: 一部关于马格尼托哥尔斯克工业史的空间声音、360° 影像舞蹈作品的概念验证：舞者 Rebecca Evans 两只手腕各戴一块智能手表，由她触发音乐，并把声音在环绕声空间中移来移去。
works.idea_en: The dancer's arms place each sound in the room around the audience.
works.idea_zh: 舞者的手臂把每个声音摆放到观众周围的空间里。
works.technique: Flowfal watch data is mapped in Ableton Live to clip triggers and to the pan and position of surround channels, and the result is rendered binaurally for the 360 video.
works.technique_zh: 在 Ableton Live 中把 Flowfal 手表数据映射到片段触发以及环绕声道的声像位置，结果再渲染成双耳音频配合 360 视频。
works.exercise_en: Set up four speakers in the room corners and map a phone's compass heading to which speaker a loop plays from, so a dancer can throw sound around the class. Twist: add a second dancer whose sound always plays from the opposite corner.
works.exercise_zh: 在房间四角各放一个音箱，把手机的指南针方向映射为循环音从哪个音箱发出，让舞者把声音在教室里“甩”来“甩”去；变体：加入第二位舞者，他的声音总是从相对的角落传出。

video.video_title: Pell Ensemble x handmadesound x Thunkist Collaboration

works.title: Pencil Effect
works.description: A rendered 3D scene is redrawn in real time as a hand-sketched pencil drawing with hatching strokes and paper grain.
works.description_zh: 渲染出的三维场景被实时重画成手绘铅笔素描，带有排线笔触和纸张纹理。
works.idea_en: Turn any live image into a moving sketchbook page.
works.idea_zh: 把任何实时画面变成会动的素描本。
works.technique: A single full-screen pixel shader detects edges in the source image and layers hash-based noise strokes whose density follows luminance, likely with a scale factor to control stroke size.
works.technique_zh: 一个全屏像素着色器检测源图像的边缘，并叠加基于哈希噪声的笔触，笔触密度随亮度变化，很可能用一个缩放系数控制笔触大小。
works.exercise_en: Run the pencil shader as a post effect on the passthrough camera image of an AR Foundation app so the real world looks hand-drawn while virtual objects stay colored. Twist: fade from sketch to photo wherever the user points the phone.
works.exercise_zh: 把铅笔着色器作为后期处理加在 AR Foundation 应用的相机画面上，让真实世界看起来像手绘，而虚拟物体保持彩色。变体：手机指向的地方从素描渐变回照片。

video.video_title: Pencil Effect (Full Source Code)

works.title: Physical Pokémon Cards in AR
works.description: Real Pokémon trading cards are recognised on Spectacles and their creatures appear on top of the table.
works.idea_zh: 识别实体宝可梦卡牌，让卡里的宝可梦跳上桌面。

video.video_title: Always wanteded to play with my physical Pokémon cards in AR: Astra + CLAD for SPECS. @specsfordevs

works.technique: Card artwork is recognized as image targets (or by a classifier) on Spectacles, and the matching 3D creature is spawned on the card's tracked pose on the table.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation 图像追踪识别三张自制卡牌，每张卡上出现对应的 3D 生物；变体：两张卡靠近时生物开始对战或互动。
works.description_zh: Spectacles 识别出真实的宝可梦集换式卡牌，卡上的精灵随即出现在桌面上。
works.idea_en: Recognize physical Pokémon cards and let the Pokémon jump out onto the table.
works.technique_zh: 在 Spectacles 上将卡面图案作为图像目标（或通过分类器）识别，并在卡牌于桌面上的追踪位姿处生成对应的 3D 精灵。
works.exercise_en: Use image tracking in Lens Studio or AR Foundation to recognize three homemade cards, each spawning its own 3D creature. Twist: when two cards come close, their creatures start to battle or interact.

works.title: Physio3D: mixed-reality physiotherapy with a real-time AI voice coach
works.description: A Vision Pro app places a 3D physiotherapy guide in the patient's room and adds a real-time AI voice coach that explains exercises, answers questions and tracks activity.
works.description_zh: 一款 Vision Pro 应用在患者房间里放置三维理疗指导，并加入实时 AI 语音教练，讲解动作、回答问题、记录训练情况。
works.idea_en: A therapist who talks back is placed where you actually exercise.
works.idea_zh: 一个会回话的理疗师，就站在你真正锻炼的地方。
works.technique: 3D exercise demonstrations are anchored in mixed reality while a speech-to-speech AI model with the training plan as context answers the user live.
works.technique_zh: 三维动作示范锚定在混合现实中，同时一个以训练计划为上下文的语音对语音 AI 模型实时回答用户。
works.exercise_en: Place an animated 3D figure doing a stretch next to the user in WebAR and connect a voice assistant that knows the three steps of the stretch. Twist: the coach adapts the exercise if the user says it hurts.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebAR 中把一个做拉伸的三维动画人放在用户旁边，并接入一个知道拉伸三个步骤的语音助手。变体：用户说疼时，教练会调整动作。

video.video_title: Physio3D on Apple Vision Pro — Mixed Reality Physiotherapy + Real-Time AI Voice

works.title: Poseidon
works.description: A photoreal open ocean with breaking crests, foam and golden-hour light runs entirely in the browser.
works.description_zh: 一片带着破碎浪尖、泡沫和黄昏光线的逼真海洋，完全在浏览器里运行。
works.idea_en: A film-grade ocean technique, now a web page.
works.idea_zh: 电影级的海洋技术，如今只是一张网页。
works.technique: Three cascades of Tessendorf inverse FFT run as WebGPU compute shaders (three.js TSL) to produce displacement and normals, shaded with measured water optics, subsurface scattering and foam.
works.technique_zh: 三级 Tessendorf 逆 FFT 以 WebGPU 计算着色器（three.js TSL）运行，生成位移和法线，再用实测的水体光学参数、次表面散射和泡沫着色。
works.exercise_en: Put a small patch of Poseidon inside a WebXR hit-test portal on the floor so the phone shows a sea below the room. Twist: sync the sun direction to the real time of day.
works.exercise_zh: 把一小块 Poseidon 海洋放进 WebXR 命中测试得到的地面传送门里，让手机里房间下面出现一片海。变体：让太阳方向与现实中的时间同步。

video.video_title: sneak peak of Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) ocean simulation in threejs again (I'm so threejs pilled right now) https://t.co/pt4ROv6OB7

works.title: Prop-Chromeleon
works.description: A mixed-reality system that turns any everyday object into a haptic prop: type 'a magic lantern' while holding a water bottle and a virtual lantern shaped to fit the bottle is generated and overlaid on it, so what you see matches what you feel.
works.description_zh: 一个把日常物品变成触觉道具的混合现实系统：手里拿着水瓶输入“魔法灯笼”，系统就生成一个贴合瓶子形状的虚拟灯笼叠加在瓶子上，让看到的和摸到的保持一致。
works.idea_en: Reskin the object in your hand with a prompt, using its real shape as the constraint.
works.idea_zh: 用一句提示词给手中的物体“换皮”，并以它真实的形状为约束。
works.technique: An AI pipeline captures the prop's geometry, generates a 3D asset from the text prompt under shape constraints, and anchors it to the tracked physical object in the headset.
works.technique_zh: AI 流程先获取道具的几何形状，在形状约束下根据文本提示生成三维素材，再把它锚定到头显中被追踪的实体物体上。
works.exercise_en: Pick three props with different shapes (a cylinder, a box, a ball), generate three virtual skins for each with a text-to-3D or text-to-texture tool, and attach them to the tracked objects with image or object tracking in Lens Studio or AR Foundation. Twist: let a squeeze or a shake trigger a new prompt, so the object transforms in your hand.
works.exercise_zh: 挑三个形状不同的道具（圆柱、盒子、球），用文本生成三维或文本生成纹理工具为每个道具生成三种虚拟外观，再在 Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation 中用图像或物体追踪把它们贴到实体上。变体：握紧或摇晃物体就触发新的提示词，让它在你手中变身。

video.video_title: Prop-Chromeleon: Adaptive Haptic Props in Mixed Reality through Generative AI

works.title: QuestRoomScan
works.description: Wearing a Meta Quest 3, the user looks around and the room is rebuilt as a colored 3D mesh in real time, then refined and optionally turned into Gaussian splats.
works.description_zh: 戴上 Meta Quest 3 四处看看，房间就被实时重建成一个带颜色的三维网格，随后可以进一步细化，并可选择转换成高斯泼溅。
works.idea_en: The headset can scan the room while you use it, so the real space becomes editable material.
works.idea_zh: 头显在你使用的同时就能扫描房间，让真实空间成为可编辑的材料。
works.technique: Depth API frames are fused into a GPU TSDF volume, Surface Nets extracts a mesh, and passthrough camera images texture it; scans can be sent to a server for Gaussian-splat training and rendered back on device.
works.technique_zh: 把 Depth API 的深度帧融合进 GPU 上的 TSDF 体积，用 Surface Nets 提取网格，再用透视摄像头图像给它贴图；扫描结果可发送到服务器训练高斯泼溅，再回到设备上渲染。
works.exercise_en: Scan a corner of the classroom with QuestRoomScan and apply a shader that makes the scanned mesh melt or ripple while passthrough shows the real room. Twist: freeze a scan, then compare it with the live room to reveal what moved.
works.exercise_zh: 用 QuestRoomScan 扫描教室一角，给扫描网格加一个让它融化或波动的着色器，同时透视画面显示真实房间。变体：冻结一次扫描，再与实时房间对比，找出哪些东西移动过。

video.video_title: I Turned My Room Into a 3D Model in Real Time — On a Meta Quest 3

works.title: Ray-Ban Meta product scanner
works.description: A hacked Ray-Ban Meta app explains unfamiliar products the wearer looks at in a shop and says where to buy them.
works.description_zh: 一个改造过的 Ray-Ban Meta 应用，能解释佩戴者在商店里看到的陌生商品，并告诉他在哪里能买到。
works.idea_en: Look at any product and hear what it is and where it comes from.
works.idea_zh: 看向任意商品，就能听到它是什么、从哪里来。
works.technique: The Meta Wearables SDK streams frames to a phone app that queries a vision model and a shopping search, then speaks the answer through the glasses.
works.technique_zh: Meta 可穿戴 SDK 把画面传到手机应用，应用调用视觉模型和购物搜索，再通过眼镜朗读答案。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone 'shelf explainer' that photographs a product and reads out a two-sentence explanation plus a cheaper alternative. Twist: explain the product as if to someone from 100 years ago.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机“货架讲解员”：拍下商品，朗读两句话介绍并推荐一个更便宜的替代品。变体：像给 100 年前的人解释一样介绍它。

video.video_title:
Just hacked my Ray-Ban Meta and built my own scanner with them

The US has a lot of crazy products, so I built an app that explains what I’m seeing and where to buy it

Used the @Meta SDK to connect i

works.title: Re-coaching a World Cup goal in AR
works.description: A real World Cup goal is rebuilt as a tabletop AR scene; you pause it, move a defender, and AI re-renders the alternate ending photorealistically.
works.idea_zh: 暂停真实世界杯进球，挪动防守球员，让AI重渲染另一种结局。

video.video_title: I Re‑Coached a Real World Cup Goal in AR, and AI Re‑Rendered It in Photoreal

works.technique: Player positions from match tracking data are replayed as tabletop 3D figures, and after the user edits a position the altered layout conditions a generative video model to render a new ending.
works.exercise_zh: 把一段球赛进球做成桌面 AR 回放（用简单小人和球的关键帧），允许暂停并拖动防守球员；变体：改动后让球的轨迹按简单物理重新计算。
works.description_zh: 一个真实的世界杯进球被重建成桌面 AR 场景：你可以暂停画面、挪动一名防守球员，再由 AI 以照片级真实感重新渲染出另一种结局。
works.idea_en: Pause a real World Cup goal, move a defender, and let AI re-render a different ending.
works.technique_zh: 用比赛追踪数据中的球员位置，把比赛以桌面 3D 小人的形式回放；用户修改某个位置后，调整后的布局作为条件输入生成式视频模型，渲染出新的结局。
works.exercise_en: Turn a goal from a match into a tabletop AR replay (keyframed simple figures and a ball) that can be paused so defenders can be dragged. Twist: after a change, recompute the ball's trajectory with simple physics.

works.title: Real-time AI style transfer on AR glasses
works.description: An educational experiment connects Spectacles to Decart's real-time video model and projects the transformed camera feed back into the wearer's view, so the world appears restyled live.
works.description_zh: 一个教学实验：把 Spectacles 连到 Decart 的实时视频模型，再把转换后的摄像头画面投回佩戴者视野，眼前的世界被实时换了画风。
works.idea_en: A reality filter that lives on your glasses rather than your phone screen.
works.idea_zh: 现实滤镜不再在手机屏幕上，而是戴在你的眼镜上。
works.technique: Camera frames are streamed over WebRTC to a hosted real-time video-to-video model and the returned frames are rendered as an overlay aligned to the camera's field of view.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头画面通过 WebRTC 流式发送到在线实时视频转视频模型，返回的画面按摄像头视场对齐叠加显示。
works.exercise_en: Stream a phone camera to a real-time diffusion API and display the result in a HoloKit or cardboard headset with a style chosen by voice. Twist: restyle only the part of the scene inside a hand-drawn frame.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机摄像头流式接入实时扩散接口，在 HoloKit 或纸盒头显中显示结果，用语音选择风格。变体：只重绘手比出的框里的那部分。

A real-time AI style-transfer filter, running directly on AR glasses. ⌐◨-◨

For this educational experiment, I connected Decart AI to Spectacles and projected the transformed camera feed back into the

works.title: Robust Video Matting on Mac
works.description: People in a video are cut out cleanly from difficult backgrounds, hair included, in real time inside Unity.
works.description_zh: 视频中的人在复杂背景下也能被实时干净地抠出来，连头发都保留，全部在 Unity 里完成。
works.idea_en: Clean mattes make any person a compositing layer.
works.idea_zh: 干净的抠像让任何人都能成为合成图层。
works.technique: The Robust Video Matting network runs through Core ML and Metal, using its recurrent state across frames to keep the alpha matte stable.
works.technique_zh: Robust Video Matting 网络通过 Core ML 和 Metal 运行，利用跨帧的循环状态保持透明遮罩稳定。
works.exercise_en: Cut out a performer with a matting model and place them as a floating cutout in an AR Foundation scene. Twist: surround the cutout with particles that only touch the background.
works.exercise_zh: 用抠像模型抠出表演者，把人像作为漂浮的剪影放进 AR Foundation 场景。变体：让粒子围着剪影飞，但只出现在背景区域。

video.video_title:
RVM CoreML for Unity をパッケージ化した。
https://t.co/ZBmkxredml
厳しい条件のソースでもかなり頑張ってくれる。いいね。 https://t.co/Lovoe7WzBD

works.title: Room restyled as Studio Ghibli, live on Vision Pro
works.description: An AI model reconstructs virtual objects located and sized exactly like the real furniture of a room, which can then be restyled, here as a Studio Ghibli scene, in real time on Vision Pro.
works.description_zh: AI 模型重建出与房间真实家具位置、尺寸完全一致的虚拟物体，并能实时重新风格化，这里在 Vision Pro 上被变成吉卜力动画风格。
works.idea_en: Rebuild your room as editable objects first, then restyle it any way you like.
works.idea_zh: 先把房间重建成可编辑的物体，再随心所欲地改画风。
works.technique: Room-scanning data and camera views are given to a multimodal model that proposes matching 3D objects, which are then placed over the real furniture and re-textured in a chosen style.
works.technique_zh: 把房间扫描数据和摄像头画面交给多模态模型，由它生成对应的三维物体，放在真实家具上，再按选定风格重新贴图。
works.exercise_en: Scan a corner of a room with a phone LiDAR app, replace each piece of furniture by a primitive of the same size, and texture them with AI images in one art style. Twist: every visitor sees a different style.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 LiDAR 应用扫描房间一角，把每件家具替换成同尺寸的基础形体，用同一画风的 AI 图像贴图。变体：每位访客看到的画风都不一样。

video.video_title:
