works.title: Sai-Fi: talk to a computer-use agent through Ray-Ban glasses
works.description: An open-source Android companion app lets the wearer speak to Sai, an autonomous computer-use agent, through Meta Ray-Ban glasses, sending it tasks it then carries out on a computer.
works.description_zh: 一个开源安卓伴侣应用，让佩戴者通过 Meta Ray-Ban 眼镜与自主操作电脑的智能体 Sai 对话，给它布置任务，由它在电脑上完成。
works.idea_en: Your glasses delegate; an agent does the clicking at home.
works.idea_zh: 眼镜负责派活，智能体在家里替你点鼠标。
works.technique: The phone app relays voice (and optionally camera) input from the glasses to a cloud agent that controls a desktop through screenshots, mouse and keyboard actions.
works.technique_zh: 手机应用把眼镜的语音（以及可选的摄像头）输入转发给云端智能体，智能体通过截屏、鼠标和键盘操作控制电脑。
works.exercise_en: Connect a voice note on your phone to a script that performs one safe desktop action (rename a file, open a playlist) and reports back by voice. Twist: the agent must describe what it did as a sports commentator.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机上的语音备忘接到一个脚本，执行一个安全的电脑操作（重命名文件、打开歌单），再用语音汇报。变体：智能体要像体育解说员一样讲述它做了什么。

video.video_title:
Introducing Sai-Fi: an open source app that lets you talk to AI agent Sai through a pair of Meta Ray-Ban glasses.

Sai is an autonomous computer-use agent. It can see the screen, move the mouse, type,

works.title: Scorched Earth Policy (US Pavilion, Venice Biennale)
works.description: An uninvited AR intervention at the 2026 Venice Biennale US Pavilion in which the pavilion appears to dry up and disintegrate into a burning wasteland around visitors.
works.idea_zh: 用AR让国家馆在观众眼前干涸、燃烧、崩解
works.technique: Geolocated mobile AR overlays disintegration and fire effects registered to the pavilion architecture, recorded as screen captures.
works.exercise_zh: 选一栋校园建筑，用AR叠加“未来100年”的风化或气候效果；变化：观众可以选择“修复”还是“放任”，看到两种结局。

video.video_title: Scorched Earth Policy, AR - US Pavilion 2026 Venice Biennale

works.description_zh: 在 2026 年威尼斯双年展美国馆进行的一次未经邀请的 AR 介入：在观众眼中，展馆逐渐干涸、崩解，化作四周燃烧的荒原。
works.idea_en: AR makes a national pavilion dry up, burn and fall apart before visitors' eyes.
works.technique_zh: 基于地理定位的移动 AR 把崩解和火焰特效与展馆建筑对齐叠加，并以录屏形式记录。
works.exercise_en: Choose a campus building and overlay AR effects showing its weathering or climate damage '100 years from now'. Twist: let viewers choose between 'repair' and 'let it go' and see the two different outcomes.

works.title: Shrunk to action-figure size on the coffee table
works.description: In mixed reality he shrinks himself to action-figure scale and explores a tiny generated world sitting on his living-room coffee table.
works.idea_zh: 把自己缩小成手办大小，在茶几上的迷你世界里探险。

video.video_title:
I shrunk myself down to action figure size and can now interact with and explore the tiny world on my living room coffee table.

Wait until 7 seconds in 👀🛋️ https://t.co/2g2HqZTHPQ

works.technique: A miniature world is placed on the coffee table in passthrough MR, and scaling the user rig (or inversely scaling the world) changes the effective eye height so the table feels human-sized.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 或 Unity 中把一个小场景放在桌面上，按下按钮时把整个场景放大 20 倍并以桌面为原点；变体：放大后让桌上的真实物件（如杯子）成为场景中的“巨型地标”。
works.description_zh: 在混合现实中，他把自己缩小到手办大小，去探索摆在客厅茶几上的一个生成出来的微缩世界。
works.idea_en: Shrink yourself to action-figure size and explore a miniature world on the coffee table.
works.technique_zh: 在透视混合现实中把微缩世界放在茶几上，通过缩放用户的相机装置（或反向放大世界）改变有效视高，让桌面感觉像人类尺度的空间。
works.exercise_en: Place a small scene on a tabletop in WebXR or Unity, and when a button is pressed, scale the whole scene up 20 times around the tabletop origin. Twist: after scaling, let real objects on the table (like a cup) become 'giant landmarks' in the scene.

works.title: Smart glasses AI tour guide
works.description: Walking around a city with an AI tour guide on MentraOS glasses that knows the history, geography and architecture of what the wearer is looking at, built over a weekend.
works.description_zh: 戴着 MentraOS 眼镜在城市里走，AI 导游了解佩戴者眼前事物的历史、地理和建筑，整个应用只用一个周末就做出来。
works.idea_en: A personal guide for any street, built in a weekend on open glasses.
works.idea_zh: 为任何一条街准备的私人导游，用开放眼镜一个周末就能做出来。
works.technique: GPS location and camera frames are sent with a guide persona to an LLM, and short spoken or displayed explanations come back as the wearer walks.
works.technique_zh: 把 GPS 位置和摄像头画面连同导游人设发给大语言模型，佩戴者走动时返回简短的语音或文字讲解。
works.exercise_en: Make a location-triggered WebAR tour of five spots on campus where a vision model describes each building from a photo, in the voice of a chosen historical figure. Twist: the guide gets the facts subtly wrong and students must catch it.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个基于位置触发的校园 WebAR 导览，五个点位由视觉模型根据照片介绍建筑，用选定历史人物的口吻。变体：导游故意说错一点，学生要找出来。

video.video_title: Smart Glasses AI Tour Guide

works.title: Smartwatch Theremin
works.description: Two ordinary Android watches approximate a theremin inside a Max patch: raising the right arm controls volume, rolling the left hand sets pitch and lifting the left arm adds vibrato.
works.description_zh: 两块普通的 Android 手表在 Max 程序里模拟出一台特雷门琴：抬起右臂控制音量，转动左手决定音高，抬起左臂加入颤音。
works.idea_en: Play an invisible theremin with two wristwatches.
works.idea_zh: 用两块手表演奏一台看不见的特雷门琴。
works.technique: Flowfal streams roll and pitch angles from each watch into a standalone Max patch, where arm angle maps to gain and wrist roll maps to oscillator frequency.
works.technique_zh: Flowfal 把每块手表的翻滚角和俯仰角传进独立的 Max 程序，手臂角度映射到音量，手腕翻转映射到振荡器频率。
works.exercise_en: Strap two phones to students' forearms and build a Web Audio theremin where one arm's angle is pitch and the other's is volume. Twist: snap the pitch to a pentatonic scale so the class can play a round together.
works.exercise_zh: 把两部手机绑在学生前臂上，用 Web Audio 做一台特雷门琴，一只手臂的角度决定音高，另一只决定音量；变体：把音高吸附到五声音阶上，让全班一起轮唱。

video.video_title: Max/MSP Theremin Demo

works.title: Snap2VoxelAR
works.description: A photo taken with the headset camera is converted by an AI workflow into voxel art and displayed back in AR next to the real object.
works.description_zh: 用头显摄像头拍下的照片，经 AI 工作流转换成体素艺术，再在 AR 中显示在真实物体旁边。
works.idea_en: Snap a photo and get back a toy-block version of the world.
works.idea_zh: 拍张照，拿回一个积木版的世界。
works.technique: Captured images are sent to a coding agent (Codex with GPT-5.5) that writes and runs an image-to-voxel conversion, and the resulting voxel model is loaded into the AR scene.
works.technique_zh: 把拍到的图像交给编程智能体（Codex 配 GPT-5.5），由它编写并运行图像转体素的程序，生成的体素模型再载入 AR 场景。
works.exercise_en: Photograph an object, downsample it into a 16x16x16 voxel grid with a script (or an image-to-3D tool plus voxeliser), and place the blocks in AR beside the real thing. Twist: let the voxel copy slowly fall apart when you look away.
works.exercise_zh: 给物体拍照，用脚本（或图生三维加体素化工具）降采样成 16×16×16 的体素网格，在 AR 中放在实物旁。变体：你一移开视线，体素复制品就慢慢散架。

video.video_title: Snap2VoxelAR

works.title: Spatial Search for Meta Quest
works.description: Type or say what you are looking for, and the matching points in Quest's spatial data of the room light up as the search result.
works.description_zh: 输入或说出你要找的东西，Quest 房间空间数据里匹配的点就会亮起来作为搜索结果。
works.idea_en: Search your room the way you search the web.
works.idea_zh: 像搜网页一样搜索你的房间。
works.technique: Image features from the headset camera are attached to the spatial point cloud (likely with a CLIP-style embedding), and a text query is embedded and matched against them to highlight regions.
works.technique_zh: 把头显摄像头的图像特征附加到空间点云上（很可能是 CLIP 类嵌入），再把文本查询编码并与之匹配，高亮相应区域。
works.exercise_en: Take 20 photos around a room with their positions (from a phone AR session), embed them with CLIP, and on a text query place a glowing marker where the best photo was taken. Twist: search for feelings, like 'somewhere cosy'.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 会话在房间里拍 20 张带位置的照片，用 CLIP 编码；输入文字查询时，在最匹配照片的拍摄位置放一个发光标记。变体：搜索感受，比如“一个温馨的角落”。

video.video_title: Spatial Search for Meta Quest

works.title: Spectacles controlling a Reachy Mini robot
works.description: For MIT Reality Hack 2026, Snap's developer team connected Spectacles to Hugging Face and Pollen Robotics' Reachy Mini, so AR interfaces can drive a small expressive desktop robot.
works.description_zh: 为 MIT Reality Hack 2026，Snap 开发者团队把 Spectacles 连上 Hugging Face 和 Pollen Robotics 的 Reachy Mini，让 AR 界面可以驱动这个表情丰富的小型桌面机器人。
works.idea_en: AR glasses become the remote control and face for an AI robot on your desk.
works.idea_zh: AR 眼镜成为桌上 AI 机器人的遥控器和“脸”。
works.technique: A Lens Studio lens sends commands over the network to the Reachy Mini's open-source Python SDK, whose head and antennas react to hand input and AI behaviours.
works.technique_zh: Lens Studio 镜头通过网络向 Reachy Mini 的开源 Python SDK 发送指令，机器人的头部和天线根据手势输入和 AI 行为做出反应。
works.exercise_en: Connect a phone AR app to a cheap servo toy over WebSocket, so pointing at it in AR makes it turn toward you. Twist: give the robot an LLM personality that comments on what the AR camera sees.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebSocket 把手机 AR 应用连到一个便宜的舵机玩具，在 AR 中指向它，它就转向你。变体：给机器人一个大语言模型人格，点评 AR 摄像头看到的东西。

video.video_title: We connected Spectacles to Reachy Mini 🤯🤯 (from Pollen Robotics and Hugging Face)

works.title: Splat worlds as AR camera stand-ins
works.description: Generated 3DGS environments act as a spatial reference for directing real-time AR camera moves; the capture is then restyled by a video model.
works.idea_zh: 用 AR 手机当“虚拟摄影机”，在生成的 3D 场景里走位拍镜头，再交给视频模型出成片。

video.video_title: Late night experiment. I built a demo that generates 3D environments from images into 3DGS, then uses them as a spatial reference for directing real-time AR camera movements. The capture is then run t

works.technique: A tracked phone acts as a virtual camera inside a splat environment, recording its 6DoF pose path as a camera move, and the rendered pass is then restyled frame-by-frame with a video diffusion model.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 录制手机的相机位姿轨迹，在 Unity 中用这段轨迹驱动虚拟相机穿过一个预制场景并导出视频；变体：把导出的视频交给视频风格化模型换成手绘风格。
works.description_zh: 生成的 3DGS 环境作为空间参照，用于实时调度 AR 摄像机运镜；拍下的画面再交给视频模型重新风格化。
works.idea_en: Use an AR phone as a virtual camera to block shots inside a generated 3D scene, then hand the footage to a video model for the final look.
works.technique_zh: 被追踪的手机在高斯点环境中充当虚拟摄像机，把自身的 6DoF 位姿路径记录为一条运镜轨迹；渲染出的画面再用视频扩散模型逐帧重新风格化。
works.exercise_en: Record the phone's camera pose path with AR Foundation, then use it in Unity to drive a virtual camera through a prebuilt scene and export the video. Twist: pass the exported video to a video stylization model to give it a hand-drawn look.

works.title: Standing inside your RAG embeddings
works.description: A Vision Pro prototype places the user inside a cloud of course descriptions; semantically similar courses float next to each other, and a spoken question lights up the matches.
works.description_zh: 一个 Vision Pro 原型把用户放进由课程简介组成的点云里；语义相近的课程彼此靠近，用户说出问题，相关课程就会亮起来。
works.idea_en: Walk around the vector space that powers a chatbot, instead of reading its answer.
works.idea_zh: 不看聊天机器人的答案，而是走进支撑它的向量空间里转一圈。
works.technique: Text is embedded into high-dimensional vectors, reduced to 3D positions (likely with UMAP or t-SNE), and a voice query is embedded the same way so its nearest neighbours can be highlighted in space.
works.technique_zh: 把文本编码成高维向量，再降维成三维坐标（很可能用 UMAP 或 t-SNE），语音提问用同样方式编码，最近的邻居在空间中被高亮。
works.exercise_en: Embed 50 short texts (song lyrics, class notes) with a free embedding API, project them to 3D and place them as floating labels in a WebXR room; ask a question aloud and highlight the nearest five. Twist: let two people's questions pull the cloud in different directions.
works.exercise_zh: 用免费的向量接口把 50 段短文本（歌词、课堂笔记）编码，降维到三维，在 WebXR 房间里做成漂浮标签；大声提问，高亮最近的五个。变体：让两个人的问题把点云往不同方向拉。

video.video_title:
Imagine stepping into your embeddings that power RAG. 📚 

In this proof of concept, you’re surrounded by courses. Semantically similar ones float right next to each other. 

I've built an XR prototype

works.title: StrobePages: page-turning post effect
works.description: The live scene is captured every few frames and each new capture flips over the previous one like a page, giving a stuttering flipbook look.
works.description_zh: 实时场景每隔几帧被截一张，每张新图像书页一样翻盖在上一张上，形成顿挫的翻页效果。
works.idea_en: Turn smooth motion into a stack of pages.
works.idea_zh: 把流畅的运动变成一叠书页。
works.technique: A URP renderer feature captures frames at a fixed interval and renders a page mesh that curls from the new frame onto the held previous frame.
works.technique_zh: URP 渲染器功能按固定间隔截帧，并渲染一张书页网格，从新帧卷起翻盖到保留的上一帧上。
works.exercise_en: Apply a page-flip effect to the AR Foundation camera feed and trigger each flip with a tap. Twist: flip automatically on each beat of a song.
works.exercise_zh: 给 AR Foundation 相机画面加翻页效果，每点一次翻一页。变体：跟着歌曲的节拍自动翻页。

video.video_title:
Added some improvements to StrobePages — a flipbook-style post-processing effect for Unity URP. I’ve also updated the sample scene with a more stylized look.
https://t.co/BMzVCQnlaQ https://t.co/Za0vg

works.title: Tap to launch orbs into a generated world
works.description: A WebAR scene built from a World Labs Gaussian splat of his room; tapping the phone fires glowing orbs that fly through the space.
works.idea_zh: 把 AI 生成的 3D 世界叠在真实房间里，点一下就向其中发射光球。

video.video_title:
More late night builds with gpt sol, world labs and webAR. This one is interactive, I can now send off orbs when I tap which is cool

goodnight 🔘 https://t.co/gvvpg0JOba

works.technique: A pre-generated Gaussian splat of the room is aligned to the SLAM world origin, and each tap spawns an emissive sphere at the camera position with a forward velocity vector, so projectiles appear to fly through the captured space.
works.exercise_zh: 用 three.js + WebXR 在相机位置生成发光小球并沿视线方向发射，场景里放一个简单的房间模型作为“世界”；变体：让小球碰到墙面后反弹或留下光斑。
works.description_zh: 一个基于 World Labs 为他房间生成的高斯点场景搭建的 WebAR 作品：点击手机屏幕，就会发射出在空间中飞行的发光光球。
works.idea_en: Overlay an AI-generated 3D world on a real room and tap to fire glowing orbs into it.
works.technique_zh: 预先生成的房间高斯点场景与 SLAM 世界原点对齐，每次点击都会在相机位置生成一个带有前向速度向量的自发光球体，看起来就像弹丸飞过扫描空间。
works.exercise_en: Use three.js and WebXR to spawn glowing balls at the camera position and launch them along the line of sight, with a simple room model as the 'world'. Twist: make the balls bounce off walls or leave a spot of light where they hit.

works.title: The Incredible Unknowns of the Louvre
works.description: Six overlooked Louvre masterpieces, including the Code of Hammurabi and the Kore of Samos, get a QR-code Lens that restores their lost shapes and colours and animates hidden details live on camera.
works.description_zh: 卢浮宫六件“被忽视的杰作”（如《汉谟拉比法典》石碑、萨摩斯少女像）旁各有一个二维码，扫码打开 Lens，就能在镜头里看到它们失落的形状与色彩被复原，隐藏细节也动了起来。
works.idea_en: Make visitors stop at the works everyone walks past by giving each one an AR secret.
works.idea_zh: 给每件被人匆匆走过的作品藏一个 AR 秘密，让观众停下来。
works.technique: Each Lens tracks a specific artwork (likely 3D object or image tracking from museum scans) and overlays curator-validated reconstructions built from historical archives.
works.technique_zh: 每个 Lens 追踪一件特定作品（很可能基于博物馆扫描做 3D 物体或图像追踪），叠加经策展人核实、依据历史档案制作的复原模型。
works.exercise_en: Pick the most ignored object in a local museum or school display and build an AR layer that reveals one fact nobody knows about it. Twist: the reveal only triggers if the viewer stands still for ten seconds.
works.exercise_zh: 在本地博物馆或学校展柜中挑一件最没人看的展品，做一个 AR 图层揭示一个没人知道的事实；变体：只有观者站定十秒后才会触发揭示。

video.video_title: The Incredible Unknowns of the Louvre Museum - 6 Masterpieces in Augmented Reality

works.title: The Mora Constellation
works.description: In Palazzo Mora during the Venice Biennale, a field of slender glowing elements hangs in space and flickers more intensely as visitors walk by, like candle flames disturbed by a passing breath.
works.description_zh: 威尼斯双年展期间的莫拉宫里，一片细长的发光元件悬挂在空中，观众走过时它们闪烁得更强烈，像被经过的呼吸扰动的烛火。
works.idea_en: A light field that notices your presence the way a candle does.
works.idea_zh: 一片会像烛火一样“察觉”你存在的光场。
works.technique: Presence sensors (likely motion or depth sensors) modulate the brightness and flicker of individually controlled light elements in real time.
works.technique_zh: 存在感应器（很可能是运动或深度传感器）实时调节每个可单独控制的发光元件的亮度与闪烁。
works.exercise_en: Hang twelve LEDs at different heights and use a webcam's motion detection so the ones nearest a moving person flicker like candles. Twist: make them calm down only when the room is silent.
works.exercise_zh: 在不同高度挂十二颗 LED，用摄像头运动检测，让离移动者最近的几颗像烛火一样闪烁；变体：只有房间完全安静时，它们才会平静下来。

video.video_title: Mora Constellation — Interactive Light Installation | Studio Waldemeyer

works.title: The holographic ballet Swan Lake
works.description: A 25-minute reinterpretation of Swan Lake as an immersive holographic ballet on a three-sided holographic set with a 270-degree view: dancers perform in a precise dialogue with layered visuals and large-scale projection. Year is the video upload year; the premiere date is not confirmed.
works.description_zh: 一部 25 分钟的全息芭蕾版《天鹅湖》，在三面环绕的全息舞台上呈现，视角达 270 度：舞者与多层视觉和大尺度投影进行精确的编舞对话。年份为视频上传年份，首演日期未确认。
works.idea_en: Wrapping layered holographic screens around dancers turns a flat stage into a volume; AR ballet can place swans and lakes in front of, beside and behind the dancer.
works.idea_zh: 把多层全息屏环绕在舞者四周，把平面舞台变成了一个立体空间；AR 芭蕾可以把天鹅和湖放在舞者的前、旁、后。
works.technique: Transparent holographic screens on three sides are projected with layered imagery, likely combined with a back projection, to create depth planes that dancers move between.
works.technique_zh: 在三面透明全息屏上投射分层影像，推测再配合背投，形成舞者可以穿行其间的多个深度层。
works.exercise_en: Choreograph one minute of dance with a flock of virtual birds in Unity AR Foundation, with birds passing in front of and behind the dancer via people occlusion. Twist: the flock follows the dancer's arms like a leader.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity AR Foundation 里为一群虚拟飞鸟编一分钟舞蹈，借助人物遮挡让鸟群从舞者前后穿过；变体：鸟群像跟随领舞一样跟随舞者的手臂。

video.video_title: The holographic ballet Swan Lake

works.title: Tiamat
works.description: Tens of thousands of water particles slosh inside the browser window, and on a phone the water follows the device's tilt through the gyroscope.
works.description_zh: 数万个水粒子在浏览器窗口里晃荡；在手机上，水会通过陀螺仪跟着设备的倾斜流动。
works.idea_en: Tilt the phone and the water inside it moves like water in a glass.
works.idea_zh: 倾斜手机，里面的水就像杯中水一样流动。
works.technique: An SPH (smoothed-particle hydrodynamics) solver runs 20k–100k particles in WebGPU compute shaders with the gravity vector taken from the device orientation, and the surface is ray-marched.
works.technique_zh: SPH（光滑粒子流体动力学）解算在 WebGPU 计算着色器里运行 2 万至 10 万个粒子，重力方向取自设备姿态，水面用光线步进渲染。
works.exercise_en: Pour Tiamat's fluid into a virtual glass anchored on a real table in WebXR and feed the phone's motion into the solver, so the water sloshes as the user walks around the glass. Twist: let the user tap to drop objects that splash.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 里把 Tiamat 的流体倒进一只锚定在真实桌面上的虚拟杯子，并把手机的运动传给解算器，用户绕着杯子走动时水会晃动。变体：点击屏幕投下会溅起水花的物体。

video.video_title:
finally put the threejs water sim on my personal site and added gyro for mobile devices

20k particles on wife’s 17 pro max, 100k on m3 air https://t.co/xADYEuzAKB

works.title: TouchPort / Allow me into your dream
works.description: A mixed-reality sharing protocol in which a handshake and pull signals intent, negotiates consent and opens a temporary shared layer between two people's separate mixed realities.
works.idea_zh: 握手一拉就把两个人各自的混合现实临时连接成共享空间。

video.video_title: Allow me into your dream / TouchPort: Sharing mixed realities through handshakes | SIGGRAPH 2026

works.technique: Hand tracking detects a handshake-and-pull gesture between two users, which triggers a consent handshake over the network and merges their separate AR layers into a shared session.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个两人手机 AR 流程：双方同时做出某个手势后，才能看到对方放在空间里的私人物品；变体：任何一方松手，共享层立即消失。
works.description_zh: 一种混合现实共享协议：一次握手加一拉的动作表达意图、协商同意，并在两个人各自独立的混合现实之间开启一个临时的共享层。
works.idea_en: A handshake and a pull temporarily join two people's separate mixed realities into one shared space.
works.technique_zh: 手部追踪识别两位用户之间“握手再拉”的手势，由此通过网络触发一次同意确认，并把双方各自的 AR 图层合并为一个共享会话。
works.exercise_en: Design a two-person phone AR flow in which each person can see the private objects the other has placed in space only after both make a certain gesture at the same time. Twist: the shared layer vanishes the moment either person lets go.

salient.why_en: A handshake and a pull is all it takes to merge two people's separate mixed realities into one.
salient.why_zh: 握手再一拉，两个人各自的混合现实就合成了一个共享空间。

works.title: Touching grass: two-prompt WebAR
works.description: An outdoor WebAR prototype with SLAM tracking, built with two prompts to an AI coding model, where he drags virtual objects across real grass.
works.idea_zh: 用两句 prompt 生成一个户外 WebAR 原型：AI 写代码，人直接在草地上摆弄虚拟物体。

video.video_title:
Finally touching grass. 

I’m testing fable5 tonight via web augmented reality. Using threejs + 8thWall (SLAM tracking), this took two prompts. Really exciting to see the potential here 

I’m dragging

works.technique: Outdoor SLAM with ground-plane detection lets a raycast from the touch point move an object along the detected plane, so dragged objects stay pinned to the grass.
works.exercise_zh: 只用两三条提示词让 AI 写出一个 WebAR 拖拽场景，记录每条提示词和结果；变体：让被拖动的物体在草地上留下一条轨迹线。
works.description_zh: 一个带 SLAM 追踪的户外 WebAR 原型，只用了两条提示词让 AI 编程模型写成；他可以在真实草地上拖动虚拟物体。
works.idea_en: Two prompts produce an outdoor WebAR prototype: the AI writes the code, and you play with virtual objects right on the grass.
works.technique_zh: 户外 SLAM 结合地平面检测，从触摸点发出射线，使物体沿检测到的平面移动，被拖动的物体始终贴在草地上。
works.exercise_en: Get an AI to write a WebAR drag-and-drop scene using only two or three prompts, and record each prompt and its result. Twist: make the dragged object leave a trail line on the grass.

works.title: Turn your memories into 3D Gaussian splats
works.description: Ordinary photos, even old film prints, are turned into 3D Gaussian splats and viewed in AR on Quest, so a memory stands on the table as a small 3D scene.
works.description_zh: 普通照片，甚至老胶片照片，都被转成三维高斯泼溅，在 Quest 上以 AR 方式观看，一段回忆就像小小的三维场景立在桌上。
works.idea_en: An old photo becomes a place you can lean into.
works.idea_zh: 一张旧照片变成可以探头进去看的地方。
works.technique: A single-image-to-3D model (Apple SHARP) predicts splats from each photo, which are then rendered in passthrough AR on Quest.
works.technique_zh: 用单图转三维模型（Apple SHARP）从每张照片预测高斯泼溅，再在 Quest 的透视 AR 中渲染。
works.exercise_en: Ask each student to bring one family photo, convert it with a free image-to-3D tool, and display it in WebAR on their desk. Twist: place the 3D photo exactly where it was originally taken.
works.exercise_zh: 让每位同学带一张家庭照片，用免费图生三维工具转换，在课桌上用 WebAR 展示。变体：把三维照片放回它当年拍摄的地点。

video.video_title: Turn Your Memories into 3D Gaussian Splatting

works.title: Ultrasound VR
works.description: An interactive music ecosystem for Apple Vision Pro: by drawing in the space around you, you place audio-reactive sound sculptures and layer them into compositions, with Spatial Audio putting each sound where its sculpture stands.
works.idea_zh: 在空中画画就是在作曲：每一笔都会变成一个声音雕塑，并从你画下它的位置发出声音。

video.video_title: Ultrasound VR - for Apple Vision Pro

works.description_zh: 一个为 Apple Vision Pro 打造的交互式音乐生态：你在身边的空间里画画，就会放置随音乐律动的声音雕塑，把它们一层层叠加成乐曲；空间音频让每个声音都从对应雕塑所在的位置传来。
works.idea_en: Draw in the air to compose music: every stroke becomes a sound sculpture that plays from where you drew it.
works.technique: Hand tracking captures drawing gestures that spawn generative, audio-reactive meshes; each one is bound to a looping sound layer rendered with Spatial Audio at its 3D position, and LiDAR scene understanding lets the sculptures sit on real surfaces.
works.technique_zh: 手部追踪捕捉作画手势，生成随音频律动的生成式网格；每个网格都绑定一条循环的声音图层，并用空间音频在它的三维位置播放；LiDAR 场景理解让这些雕塑能贴在真实表面上。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR or AR Foundation scene where each tap or drawn stroke places a shape that loops one sound sample from its position (use positional audio), so walking around the room remixes the piece. Twist: make each shape's size pulse with its own sound's volume.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 AR Foundation 做一个场景：每次点击或画一笔，就在该位置放置一个形体，并从这个位置循环播放一段声音采样（使用空间化音频），让人在房间里走动时就能重新混音；变体：让每个形体的大小随自身声音的音量跳动。

salient.why_en: Drawing becomes composing: every stroke you paint in the air turns into a sound that plays from where you drew it.
salient.why_zh: 绘画就是作曲：你在空中画下的每一笔都变成声音，并从你落笔的位置响起。

works.title: Ultrasound VR — virtual embellishment of surfaces
works.description: A test from Ultrasound VR in which audio-reactive sound sculptures attach to real walls and floors, embellishing the room's surfaces and pulsing with the music.
works.description_zh: Ultrasound VR 的一段测试：随音频律动的声音雕塑贴附在真实的墙面和地面上，装点房间的各个表面，并随音乐起伏。
works.idea_en: Let music grow on the walls: sound becomes living ornament on real surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 让音乐长在墙上：声音变成附着在真实表面上的活装饰。
works.technique: LiDAR scene reconstruction on Apple Vision Pro gives wall and floor planes; generative meshes are anchored to them and deformed by the audio spectrum in real time.
works.technique_zh: Apple Vision Pro 上的 LiDAR 场景重建提供墙面和地面平面，生成式网格锚定在这些平面上，并实时随音频频谱变形。
works.exercise_en: Detect vertical and horizontal planes with AR Foundation or WebXR, grow a pattern on each surface, and drive its scale or colour with an FFT of the microphone or a music track. Twist: give walls and floors different frequency bands, so the room becomes an equalizer.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 或 WebXR 检测竖直和水平平面，在每个表面上生长出图案，并用麦克风或音乐的 FFT 频谱驱动它的大小或颜色；变体：让墙面和地面分别响应不同的频段，把整个房间变成一台均衡器。

video.video_title: Ultrasound VR - virtual embellishment of surfaces

works.title: Unbounded: Object–Boundary Interaction in Mixed Reality
works.description: Eight passthrough mixed-reality prototypes (CHI 2026, with Per Ola Kristensson) in which walls, tables, shelves, windows and mirrors become interactive boundaries: a ball falls through the tabletop on its last bounce, a document is fed through a shelf and shredded, a virtual marker writes TODO on the wall, an acoustic partition slides out of the windowsill, and a painting, a hidden wall drawer and a magic mirror turn a room into an art exhibit.
works.description_zh: 一组共八个透视式混合现实原型（CHI 2026，与 Per Ola Kristensson 合作），让墙、桌面、搁板、窗户和镜子都变成可交互的“边界”：球在最后一次弹跳时穿过桌面，文件从搁板缝里塞进去就被碎掉，虚拟马克笔直接在墙上写下 TODO，隔音屏从窗台里拉出来，还有能拉出画框的画、藏在墙里的抽屉和一面魔镜，把房间变成一个展厅。
works.idea_en: A boundary is not just a limit: every wall, tabletop and window can let things bounce, pass through, hide, emerge or be written on.
works.idea_zh: 边界不只是阻挡：每一面墙、每一张桌面、每一扇窗，都可以让东西弹开、穿过、藏起来、冒出来，或者在上面写字。
works.technique: Built in Unity 6 with the Meta XR All-in-One SDK on Meta Quest 3 passthrough; the headset's scene understanding supplies wall, table and window planes, and scripted objects switch between colliding with a plane, passing through it or spawning from it, with occlusion hiding what is 'behind' the surface.
works.technique_zh: 在 Meta Quest 3 透视模式下用 Unity 6 和 Meta XR All-in-One SDK 实现；头显的场景理解提供墙面、桌面和窗户平面，脚本控制虚拟物体在平面上反弹、穿过或从平面里生成，并用遮挡隐藏“在表面后面”的部分。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation plane detection on a phone to make a virtual ball that bounces on a real table three times and then sinks through it, revealing a small hidden world under the tabletop through an occlusion mask. Twist: pick one of the five motions (rebound, reemerge, vanish, emerge, along) and apply it to a wall instead.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机上的 AR Foundation 平面检测，做一个在真实桌面上弹三下、然后沉进桌面的虚拟球，并用遮挡蒙版露出桌面下面藏着的小世界。变体：从反弹、穿出再返回、消失、冒出、沿表面移动这五种运动里挑一种，改用在墙上。

video.video_title: [CHI '26] Unbounded: Object–Boundary Interaction in Mixed Reality

salient.why_en: A ball rolls off a real table and keeps falling through the real floor, as if every surface were only a boundary you can switch off.
salient.why_zh: 一个球滚下真实的桌子，又穿过真实的地板继续往下掉，好像每个表面都只是一条可以关掉的边界。

works.title: ViSTAR
works.description: An AR basketball trainer: a 3D avatar demonstrates the shot, overlays and rhythm cues show your balance, posture and timing, and an AI coach turns your reconstructed 3D motion into short spoken tips.
works.description_zh: 一个 AR 篮球训练系统：三维虚拟人示范投篮，叠加画面和节奏提示展示你的平衡、姿势与时机，AI 教练再把重建出的三维动作转化为简短的口头建议。
works.idea_en: Let an LLM read your 3D motion data and talk like a coach.
works.idea_zh: 让大语言模型读懂你的三维动作数据，像教练一样说话。
works.technique: 3D motion reconstruction extracts spatio-temporal joint features that an LLM maps to natural-language coaching cues within a behavioral-skills-training loop of instruction, modeling, rehearsal and feedback.
works.technique_zh: 三维动作重建提取时空关节特征，由大语言模型在“讲解、示范、练习、反馈”的行为技能训练循环中，把它们转化为自然语言的指导语。
works.exercise_en: Record a squat or a free throw with MediaPipe Pose on a phone, compute three numbers (knee angle, back angle, timing), send them to an LLM with the prompt 'give one coaching cue in under eight words', and show the cue in AR next to your body. Twist: ask the LLM to coach in the style of a famous coach or a cartoon character.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机上的 MediaPipe Pose 录下一次深蹲或罚球，计算三个数值（膝盖角度、背部角度、时机），连同提示“用不超过八个词给一条指导”发给大语言模型，并在 AR 中把建议显示在身体旁边。变体：让大模型模仿某位著名教练或卡通角色的风格来指导。

video.video_title: [CHI 2026] ViSTAR: Virtual Skill Training with 3D Avatars and an LLM Coaching Agent

works.title: WireDrum
works.description: Several instructors' muscle signals are routed into one visitor's arms through EMS, so a novice can play a demanding drum rhythm by sharing their body with other people.
works.description_zh: 几位指导者的肌肉信号经电刺激汇入一位访客的手臂，让新手在与他人“共享身体”的状态下打出高难度的鼓点。
works.idea_en: Split a hard skill across several people and merge it inside one body.
works.idea_zh: 把一项难的技能拆给几个人，再在一具身体里合成。
works.technique: Combines custom biosignal sensing modules, a multi-channel electrical muscle stimulator, a visual-tactile tempo indicator and software that maps instructors' muscles onto the learner's.
works.technique_zh: 结合定制的生物信号采集模块、多通道肌肉电刺激器、视觉与触觉节拍提示，以及把指导者肌肉映射到学习者身上的软件。
works.exercise_en: Split a two-hand drum pattern among three students: two tap cues on the drummer's shoulders while a phone metronome flashes, and the drummer only follows touches. Twist: record it with a phone and overlay each person's contribution in a different colour.
works.exercise_zh: 把一段双手鼓点拆给三名学生：两人随着手机节拍器的闪光在鼓手肩上点拍，鼓手只按触觉提示击鼓；变体：用手机录下来，用不同颜色标出每个人的贡献。

video.video_title: WireDrum: An Interpersonal and Multimodal Skill-Sharing System for an Augmented Drumming Experience

works.title: World Mouse
works.description: A cursor that travels seamlessly from the desktop screen onto real surfaces and objects in the room, so you can point at a lamp or a wall with the mouse as precisely as at an icon.
works.description_zh: 一个光标可以从桌面屏幕无缝移动到房间里的真实表面和物体上，于是你能用鼠标像点图标一样精准地指向一盏灯或一面墙。
works.idea_en: Extend the humble mouse cursor into the physical world.
works.idea_zh: 把朴素的鼠标光标延伸到物理世界。
works.technique: The headset's scene mesh gives surfaces for the cursor to slide on, and mouse deltas are projected onto that mesh with depth-aware transitions off the monitor's edge.
works.technique_zh: 头显的场景网格为光标提供可以滑动的表面，鼠标位移被投射到网格上，在离开显示器边缘时进行考虑深度的过渡。
works.exercise_en: In phone AR, drive a cursor with a second phone's touchpad and let it slide over detected planes in the room to select virtual stickers. Twist: the cursor leaves a visible trail on real surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中，用另一部手机当触控板驱动光标，让它在房间里检测到的平面上滑动，选择虚拟贴纸。变体：光标在真实表面上留下可见的轨迹。

video.video_title: World Mouse: Exploring Interactions with a Cross-Reality Cursor

works.title: 1D ARCADE
works.description: Visitors play arcade and pinball-style games made from a single line of light pixels, discovering the rules without instructions by pressing buttons and moving.
works.description_zh: 观众在一条由单行像素光组成的装置上玩街机和弹球风格的小游戏，没有说明，靠按按钮和身体移动自己摸索规则。
works.idea_en: A whole video game squeezed into one line of light.
works.idea_zh: 把一整个电子游戏压缩进一条光线里。
works.technique: Each game is coded in MadMapper and output to LED pixel strips, reading simple physical controls in real time.
works.technique_zh: 每个游戏都在 MadMapper 中编写，输出到 LED 像素灯带，并实时读取简单的实体按钮输入。
works.exercise_en: Program a one-dimensional game on a 60-pixel LED strip (or a 1-pixel-tall canvas) with two buttons, such as tug-of-war or dodge the bullet. Twist: make it a two-player game where players stand at each end of a corridor.
works.exercise_zh: 用一条 60 像素的 LED 灯带（或只有一像素高的画布）和两个按钮编一个一维游戏，比如拔河或躲子弹；变体：做成双人游戏，两位玩家分别站在走廊两端。

video.video_title: 1D ARCADE - 1024 architecture

salient.why_en: A whole arcade game squeezed into a single line of light, and you still understand it at a glance.
salient.why_zh: 整个街机游戏被压缩进一条光线里，一眼就能看懂怎么玩。

works.title: AI Teleport
works.description: A portal lens for Spectacles that uses Google Gemini to generatively restyle the user's surroundings in real time.
works.idea_zh: 用生成式AI实时把周围环境'传送'成另一种世界。

video.video_title: AI Teleport - Spectacles

works.technique: Camera frames are sent to a multimodal image model that restyles the scene, and the result is displayed back as a portal overlay aligned to the view.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍下眼前场景，发给图像编辑模型改成另一种风格，再以 AR 画框的形式贴回原位置；变体：让同学只用一个词决定目标风格。
works.description_zh: 一个用于 Spectacles 的传送门滤镜，借助 Google Gemini 实时对用户周围的环境进行生成式风格重绘。
works.idea_en: Generative AI 'teleports' your surroundings into another world in real time.
works.technique_zh: 相机画面被发送给多模态图像模型进行风格重绘，结果再以与视野对齐的传送门叠加层的形式显示回来。
works.exercise_en: Photograph the scene in front of you with a phone, send it to an image-editing model to change its style, then paste it back in place as an AR picture frame. Twist: let a classmate choose the target style with a single word.

works.title: AI smart glasses that order a Big Mac
works.description: A spoken request on AugmentOS glasses launches a web agent that autonomously browses and orders a Big Mac, reporting progress in the wearer's view.
works.description_zh: 在 AugmentOS 眼镜上说一句话，就启动一个网页智能体，自主浏览网站并下单一个巨无霸，进度显示在佩戴者视野里。
works.idea_en: Glasses as the remote control for an agent that acts in the world for you.
works.idea_zh: 眼镜成为一个替你在世界上办事的智能体的遥控器。
works.technique: Voice commands from the glasses app are passed to Browser Use, an LLM agent that operates a web browser, and status updates stream back to the display.
works.technique_zh: 眼镜应用把语音指令交给 Browser Use（能操作浏览器的大语言模型智能体），状态更新再流回显示屏。
works.exercise_en: Connect a speech-to-text page to a browser-automation agent that can do one harmless task (search a library catalogue) and show each step as floating text in AR. Twist: the agent must ask permission with a nod before the final click.
works.exercise_zh: 把语音转文字页面接到一个只做无害任务（检索图书馆目录）的浏览器自动化智能体上，每一步都以漂浮文字显示在 AR 中。变体：最后一步点击前，智能体必须等你点头批准。

video.video_title: Building AI Smart Glasses that Order Me a Big Mac

works.title: AI wayfinding companion (Spatial 1)
works.description: A 3D-printed wearable that sees what you see, localizes with VPS, and speaks directions with Gemini and ElevenLabs.
works.idea_zh: 一个挂在胸前、能看路并说话的 AI 导航伙伴。

video.video_title:
Built my first hardware + software project in just a couple days for our internal hackathon: AI wayfinding companion

Used Midjourney, Bolt, Supabase, Gemini, Eleven Labs, and Niantic Spatial VPS to b

works.technique: A worn camera sends frames for VPS localization and to a multimodal LLM, which turns the pose and scene description into spoken directions through text-to-speech, giving audio-only AR guidance.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机摄像头拍一张照片发给多模态模型，让它结合预设目的地给出一句语音指路；变体：把指路者设定成一个有性格的角色，比如只会用比喻说话。
works.description_zh: 一个 3D 打印的可穿戴设备，能看到你所看到的东西，通过 VPS 定位，并借助 Gemini 和 ElevenLabs 用语音为你指路。
works.idea_en: An AI wayfinding companion worn on the chest that watches the road and talks to you.
works.technique_zh: 佩戴的摄像头把画面发送去做 VPS 定位，同时发给多模态大语言模型，模型把位姿和场景描述转化为方向指引，经文字转语音播出，实现纯音频的 AR 导航。
works.exercise_en: Take a photo with a phone camera and send it to a multimodal model, asking it to give a one-sentence spoken direction toward a preset destination. Twist: make the guide a character with a personality, for example one who only speaks in metaphors.

works.title: AI-powered scripting: a school of fish
works.description: A school of fish swimming around a real room is fully controlled by an AI-generated script, previewing a feature where you describe a behaviour and watch it come to life.
works.description_zh: 一群在真实房间里游动的鱼，完全由 AI 生成的脚本控制，预告了“描述行为就能让它活过来”的功能。
works.idea_en: Behaviours, not just objects, can be generated from words.
works.idea_zh: 不只是物体，连行为也可以用一句话生成。
works.technique: An LLM writes a flocking (boids-style) script against Figmin's API, which moves many instanced fish while respecting the room's space.
works.technique_zh: 大语言模型针对 Figmin 的 API 写出群集（boids 类）脚本，驱动大量鱼在房间空间内游动。
works.exercise_en: Ask an LLM for a boids script in three.js, then run it in WebXR so 50 paper birds fly around your classroom. Twist: make the flock avoid wherever people are standing.
works.exercise_zh: 请大语言模型写一段 three.js 的 boids 群集脚本，在 WebXR 中让 50 只纸鸟绕教室飞。变体：让鸟群避开有人站着的地方。

video.video_title: AI-Powered Scripting in Figmin XR

works.title: AI-scripted Playable Character
works.description: A cute robot character that walks, runs, jumps and emotes around a real room, with its behaviour written entirely by AI through Figmin's scripting API.
works.idea_zh: 用AI写脚本，让一个小机器人在你房间里跑跳玩耍。

video.video_title: 💥 A fully playable character in #FigminXR 💥

works.technique: An LLM generates Lua-style scripts against the app's API that drive character animation states and collisions with the room mesh.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生用ChatGPT生成一个Unity/Reality Composer行为脚本，使AR小角色在桌上巡逻并在碰到真实杯子时跳起；变化：用自然语言临时修改角色性格。
works.description_zh: 一个可爱的机器人角色在真实房间里走、跑、跳、做表情，它的行为完全由 AI 通过 Figmin 的脚本 API 编写。
works.idea_en: AI writes the script that makes a little robot run and jump around your room.
works.technique_zh: 大语言模型针对应用的 API 生成类 Lua 脚本，驱动角色的动画状态以及与房间网格的碰撞。
works.exercise_en: Have students use ChatGPT to generate a Unity or Reality Composer behavior script that makes a small AR character patrol the table and jump when it bumps into a real cup. Twist: change the character's personality on the fly with natural language.

works.title: AR Blasters on Snap Spectacles
works.description: A phone becomes a blaster controller over BLE for a shooting game on Snap Spectacles AR glasses.
works.idea_zh: 手机变成光枪控制器，在 Spectacles 眼镜里打 AR 射击。

video.video_title: AR Blasters on Specs AR Glasses with the Phone Controller and BLE API.

works.technique: The phone's IMU orientation and button presses are sent over BLE to Spectacles, where they drive the aim direction of a raycast blaster in the glasses' world-tracked scene.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebSocket 把手机陀螺仪方向实时传给另一台运行 WebXR 的设备，作为射击方向打飞虚拟目标；变体：把手机换成挥动的真实物品（如扫帚）绑上手机。
works.description_zh: 手机通过 BLE 变成射击控制器，用于 Snap Spectacles AR 眼镜上的一款射击游戏。
works.idea_en: A phone becomes a blaster controller for AR shooting in Spectacles.
works.technique_zh: 手机 IMU 的朝向和按键信息通过 BLE 发送到 Spectacles，用于控制眼镜世界追踪场景中射线式光枪的瞄准方向。
works.exercise_en: Stream the phone's gyroscope orientation over WebSocket to another device running WebXR and use it as the aiming direction to shoot down virtual targets. Twist: swap the phone for a real object you swing (such as a broom) with the phone strapped to it.

works.title: AR Flower Drawing
works.description: A Spectacles lens in which a trail of flowers grows along the path you draw in the world; the length of your flower line is submitted to a global leaderboard (his record is about 20 metres).
works.description_zh: 一个 Spectacles 滤镜：你在空间中画出的路径上会长出一串花；花带的长度会提交到全球排行榜（他的纪录约为 20 米）。
works.idea_en: Draw a line of flowers through the world and compete on its length.
works.idea_zh: 在世界里画出一条花带，比比谁画得更长。
works.technique: Likely a hand-tracked drawing path is converted into a trail mesh populated with instanced flowers, with its total length measured in world units and sent to an online leaderboard.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是把手部追踪的绘制路径转成带状网格，并在上面实例化生成花朵，再用世界单位计算总长度并上传到在线排行榜。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR drawing app that spawns a flower every 20 cm along the finger's path and shows the total length in metres. Twist: the flowers wilt if the line crosses itself.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 WebXR 绘画应用：沿着手指路径每 20 厘米生成一朵花，并显示总长度（米）；变体：如果线条自我交叉，花就会枯萎。

video.video_title:
I added highscores to AR Flower Drawing!

The length is now added to a global leaderboard. Let's see how long they can get 🌷🌺🪻

If you have Spectacles, go try and break my humble record of 20.77m / 68

works.title: AR Sundial
works.description: A virtual antique sundial placed outdoors that actually tells the time: it is rotated for your latitude and lit by the sun's real position, so its AR shadow reads the true solar time.
works.description_zh: 一个放在户外的虚拟古董日晷，而且真的能看时间：它按你所在的纬度旋转，并由太阳的真实位置照亮，所以它的 AR 影子读出的就是真实太阳时。
works.idea_en: A virtual object whose shadow is cast by the real sun and tells the time.
works.idea_zh: 一个由真实太阳投下影子、还能报时的虚拟物体。
works.technique: GPS location and time of day compute the sun's azimuth and elevation, which drive the directional light of his self-shadowing renderer (LUX) so virtual shadows align with real ones.
works.technique_zh: 用 GPS 位置和当前时间计算太阳的方位角和高度角，驱动他自研的自阴影渲染器（LUX）中的平行光，让虚拟影子与真实影子方向一致。
works.exercise_en: Use a sun-position library (e.g. SunCalc) in a WebXR app to aim a directional light and cast a virtual pole's shadow on the ground outdoors. Twist: compare it with a real stick's shadow at three times of day.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 应用中用太阳位置库（如 SunCalc）设置平行光方向，让一根虚拟杆子在户外地面上投下影子；变体：在一天中的三个时间点把它和真实木棍的影子对比。

video.video_title:
WIP sundial in AR! 🕰️🌞  (Lens Studio)

using the sun's real-time position + my self-shadowing renderer (LUX)

the dial is rotated based on your latitude. then its shadow reads the solar time!

sundial

salient.why_en: A virtual sundial lit by the real sun casts a shadow that tells the true time.
salient.why_zh: 一个被真实太阳照亮的虚拟日晷，投下的影子报出真实的时间。

works.title: AR pothole detection, grading and geotagging
works.description: A Quest 3 app detects potholes in the road view with a custom YOLO model, grades their severity and tags their location, turning a headset into a road-inspection tool.
works.description_zh: 一款 Quest 3 应用用自训练的 YOLO 模型在道路画面中检测坑洼，评估严重程度并记录位置，把头显变成道路巡检工具。
works.idea_en: Inspect a street by looking at it; the headset keeps the report.
works.idea_zh: 看一眼街道就完成巡检，报告由头显来写。
works.technique: A custom-trained YOLO detector runs on passthrough frames, and detections are graded by size and logged with coordinates.
works.technique_zh: 自训练的 YOLO 检测器在透视画面上运行，检测结果按大小评级，并连同坐标一起记录。
works.exercise_en: Train a small detector on 50 photos of cracks or litter on campus, run it on a phone walk, and drop an AR pin with a severity colour at each detection. Twist: the pins stay for the next person who walks by.
works.exercise_zh: 用校园里 50 张裂缝或垃圾照片训练一个小检测器，拿手机走一圈，在每个检测处放一个按严重程度着色的 AR 图钉。变体：图钉会留给下一位路过的人看到。

video.video_title:
AR pothole detection, grading, and geotagging in real time. we’re halfway there!

>ran a custom YOLO model locally to validate pothole detection on prerecorded video.
>built a Quest 3 app that r

works.title: Ad Block
works.description: An experimental Spectacles app that works as a real-world ad blocker: Gemini detects billboards and ads in view and covers them.
works.idea_zh: 现实世界的广告拦截器：识别并遮挡眼前的广告牌。

video.video_title: Ad Block - Spectacles

works.technique: A vision-language model detects ads and returns bounding boxes, which are projected into 3D and covered with opaque or replacement quads in the wearer's view.
works.exercise_zh: 用物体检测找到画面中的标志或海报，在 AR 中用一块纯色或自己的画作盖住；变体：不遮挡，而是把广告文字改写成一句诚实的话。
works.description_zh: 一款实验性的 Spectacles 应用，相当于现实世界的广告拦截器：Gemini 检测视野中的广告牌和广告，并把它们遮住。
works.idea_en: A real-world ad blocker that finds the billboards in front of you and covers them up.
works.technique_zh: 视觉语言模型检测广告并返回边界框，这些边界框被投射到 3D 空间，在佩戴者的视野中用不透明或替换内容的四边形面片覆盖。
works.exercise_en: Use object detection to find logos or posters in the frame and cover them in AR with a solid color block or your own artwork. Twist: instead of hiding the ad, rewrite its text into one honest sentence.

salient.why_en: An ad blocker for the street: billboards in front of you simply get covered up.
salient.why_zh: 给街道装上广告拦截：眼前的广告牌直接被遮掉。

works.title: Age of Mythology in AR
works.description: A fan-art homage to the classic real-time strategy game: tiny villagers, temples and water from Age of Mythology appear on his living-room floor and outdoors, and he commands units with his hands through Snap Spectacles.
works.description_zh: 向经典即时战略游戏致敬的同人作品：《神话时代》里的小村民、神庙和水面出现在他家客厅地板和户外，他戴着 Snap Spectacles 用手指挥单位。
works.idea_en: Play a classic top-down strategy game as a diorama on your own floor.
works.idea_zh: 把经典俯视角策略游戏变成铺在自家地板上的微缩沙盘来玩。
works.technique: Low-poly game scenes are placed on detected ground planes in Lens Studio and recorded live on Spectacles; hand tracking selects and moves units, and the water uses looping sprite-sheet animation in a shader.
works.technique_zh: 在 Lens Studio 中把低多边形游戏场景放到识别出的地面上，并在 Spectacles 上实时录制；手部追踪用来选择和移动单位，水面用着色器里循环播放的序列帧动画实现。
works.exercise_en: Build a tabletop mini-game in AR Foundation or WebXR where the player taps to send five tiny units to collect objects around a real table. Twist: make the units avoid real obstacles such as a cup placed on the table.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 或 WebXR 做一个桌面小游戏：点击屏幕，派五个小单位去收集真实桌面上的物品；变体：让小单位绕开桌上真实的障碍物，比如一个杯子。

video.video_title: Age of Mythology in AR! (fan art)

works.title: AiGet
works.description: A proactive assistant on AR smart glasses that notices where you look while you walk or shop and slips in surprising, personal facts about things you usually overlook, such as the plant by the path or the origin of a snack.
works.description_zh: AR 智能眼镜上的主动式助手：在你散步或购物时留意你的目光，适时推送与你相关的冷知识，比如路边那株植物、手中零食的来历——那些你平时会忽略的东西。
works.idea_en: Turn idle moments into curiosity: the AI notices what you glance at and tells you something you did not know.
works.idea_zh: 把无聊的片刻变成好奇心：AI 留意你瞥过的东西，告诉你一件你不知道的事。
works.technique: Gaze patterns, the egocentric camera view and a user profile are sent to an LLM that picks low-disruption, personalized knowledge and shows it briefly on the glasses.
works.technique_zh: 把注视模式、第一人称画面和用户画像发给大语言模型，由它挑选打扰最少、最个性化的知识，在眼镜上短暂显示。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone or glasses prototype that snaps a frame every 20 seconds during a walk and asks a multimodal LLM for 'one surprising fact about something in this image that a person who loves [your hobby] would enjoy', shown as a single line. Twist: only speak the fact when the user's walking pace slows down.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机或眼镜原型：散步时每 20 秒截取一帧，询问多模态大模型“画面里某样东西的一个冷知识，要适合喜欢[你的爱好]的人”，并只显示一行字。变体：只有在用户放慢脚步时才读出这条知识。

video.video_title: AiGet CHI 2025 Video

works.title: An Ark
works.description: Billed as the first play written for mixed reality, An Ark seats the audience in a circle while four volumetric actors, including Ian McKellen, appear among them in headsets and speak directly to them.
works.description_zh: 《An Ark》被称为第一部为混合现实创作的戏剧：观众围坐成一圈，戴上头显后，包括伊恩·麦克莱恩在内的四位体积捕捉演员出现在他们中间，直接对他们说话。
works.idea_en: Theater where actors sit among you in your own space instead of on a stage.
works.idea_zh: 演员不在舞台上，而是坐在你身边、在你的空间里演戏。
works.technique: Actors were captured volumetrically and placed in the shared physical room through synchronized mixed-reality headsets with spatial audio.
works.technique_zh: 演员通过体积捕捉录制，再借助同步的混合现实头显和空间音频放置进共享的实体房间中。
works.exercise_en: Write a 2-minute monologue addressed to someone sitting in a specific chair, record it volumetrically or as a cut-out video, and place it in AR facing that chair. Twist: the monologue changes if the listener stands up.
works.exercise_zh: 写一段两分钟的独白，对象是坐在某把特定椅子上的人；用体积捕捉或抠像视频录下来，以 AR 方式面向那把椅子放置；变体：如果听者站起来，独白就会改变。

video.video_title: A Communal Vision for Mixed Reality | AN ARK at THE SHED

works.title: Anatomy of Embodied Ecologies
works.description: A speculative real-time landscape of the Thames Estuary's intertidal mudflats, with microalgae and diatoms, reacts to the people moving in front of it, so bodies disturb and reshape the ecosystem on screen.
works.description_zh: 一个以泰晤士河口潮间带泥滩（含微藻和硅藻）为原型的思辨性实时景观，会对面前移动的人作出反应，人的身体扰动并重塑屏幕上的生态系统。
works.idea_en: Your movement becomes a force of nature inside a living digital mudflat.
works.idea_zh: 你的动作成为一片活的数字泥滩里的自然力量。
works.technique: Likely camera or motion-capture body tracking feeds positions into Unreal Engine, where particle and vegetation systems respond to presence and movement.
works.technique_zh: 很可能用摄像头或动作捕捉追踪人体，把位置传入 Unreal Engine，由粒子和植被系统对人的存在与动作作出反应。
works.exercise_en: Model a local habitat (pond, riverbank, lawn) as a particle system in TouchDesigner or p5.js, drive it with webcam body tracking, and project it at floor level. Twist: stillness should make the ecosystem recover, movement should damage it.
works.exercise_zh: 在 TouchDesigner 或 p5.js 里把一个本地栖息地（池塘、河岸、草坪）做成粒子系统，用摄像头人体追踪驱动它，并投影到地面；变体：静止不动会让生态恢复，走动则会破坏它。

video.video_title: ART+TECH Artist in Residency 2025 - Camille Dunlop

works.title: Android XR glasses live demo (TED)
works.description: On the TED stage Izadi demos prototype Android XR glasses with Gemini: live translation, memory of where you left objects, and contextual help overlaid in a see-through display.
works.idea_zh: 戴着AI眼镜上台，眼镜记得你刚把钥匙放在哪里。

video.video_title: The Next Computer? Your Glasses | Shahram Izadi | TED

works.technique: The glasses stream camera frames and audio to a multimodal model (Gemini), which returns translations, object memory and answers that are rendered as text in a monocular see-through display.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机摄像头 + 多模态大模型 API 做一个“记忆眼镜”原型：每隔几秒拍一帧并让模型记录物品位置，之后问“我的钥匙在哪”时在 AR 画面中标出上次看到的位置；变体：让它只记住一种你常丢的东西，并讨论隐私边界。
works.description_zh: Izadi 在 TED 舞台上演示了搭载 Gemini 的 Android XR 原型眼镜：实时翻译、记住你把东西放在了哪里，以及在透视显示屏中叠加情境化的帮助信息。
works.idea_en: Walk on stage wearing AI glasses that remember where you just put your keys.
works.technique_zh: 眼镜把相机画面和音频流式发送给多模态模型（Gemini），模型返回翻译、物品记忆和回答，以文字形式呈现在单目透视显示屏上。
works.exercise_en: Build a 'memory glasses' prototype with a phone camera and a multimodal LLM API: capture a frame every few seconds and have the model log where objects are, so that when you ask 'where are my keys?' it marks the last place it saw them in the AR view. Twist: have it remember only one thing you often lose, and discuss where the privacy boundaries should be.

works.title: Android XR glasses live demo with Gemini (Google I/O 2025)
works.description: On stage at Google I/O 2025, prototype Android XR glasses with Gemini remember where things were seen, give turn-by-turn directions, send messages and translate a conversation live, all shown in a small in-lens display.
works.description_zh: 在 Google I/O 2025 舞台上，搭载 Gemini 的 Android XR 原型眼镜记住东西在哪里见过、给出逐步导航、发送消息并实时翻译对话，都显示在镜片内的小屏上。
works.idea_en: Glasses with an assistant that remembers what you saw a minute ago.
works.idea_zh: 眼镜里的助手，记得你一分钟前看到过什么。
works.technique: Gemini Live receives the glasses' camera and audio stream, keeps short-term visual memory, and returns spoken answers plus minimal overlays in a monocular display.
works.technique_zh: Gemini Live 接收眼镜摄像头和音频流，保留短期视觉记忆，返回语音回答和单眼显示屏上的少量叠加信息。
works.exercise_en: Build a 'where did I leave it?' prototype: a phone camera logs a frame every five seconds with a caption from a vision model; later you ask by voice and get the last matching frame. Twist: the assistant can only answer by pointing, never with words.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个“我把它放哪了？”原型：手机摄像头每五秒记录一帧并用视觉模型生成说明；之后用语音提问，返回最后一次匹配的画面。变体：助手只能用“指”来回答，不能说话。

video.video_title: Android XR | I/O 2025 Keynote

works.title: Audio Augmentation of Manual Interactions for Mindfulness
works.description: Ordinary actions like pouring water or folding cloth are paired with gentle, responsive sounds, turning chores into a mindful audio experience.
works.description_zh: 倒水、叠衣服这样的日常动作被配上轻柔、随动作变化的声音，让家务变成一种正念的听觉体验。
works.idea_en: Add sound to everyday hand actions so people slow down and notice them.
works.idea_zh: 给日常的手部动作配上声音，让人放慢脚步、留意当下。
works.technique: Senses hand and object manipulation and maps motion features to real-time generated audio feedback delivered to the user.
works.technique_zh: 感知手部与物体的操作，把动作特征实时映射为生成的音频反馈传给用户。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone's accelerometer in a web page to play a soft tone whose pitch follows how slowly you pour a glass of water, then try the chore with and without it. Twist: map a different sound to washing hands.
works.exercise_zh: 在网页里调用手机加速度计，倒水时播放一段柔和的音调，音高随倒水的快慢变化，然后比较有无声音时做这件事的感受；变体：为洗手配上另一种声音。

video.video_title: Audio Augmentation of Manual Interactions to Support Mindfulness

works.title: Audio Personas
works.description: Each person in a room carries a personal sound, a short audio cue anchored to their body, so as you walk around you hear who is nearby and what they are like before you even look.
works.description_zh: 房间里的每个人都带着一段专属声音，这段简短的音频线索锚定在他们身上；你四处走动时，还没抬头就能听出谁在附近、对方是什么样的人。
works.idea_en: Give people an audible aura that others hear in space, a sound-based profile picture.
works.idea_zh: 给每个人一个能在空间中被听见的“声音光环”，就像用声音做的头像。
works.technique: Tracks people's positions and renders body-anchored spatial audio cues to each listener through headphones, studied for how they shape social perception.
works.technique_zh: 追踪人们的位置，通过耳机向每位听者渲染锚定在他人身上的空间音频线索，并研究其如何影响社交感知。
works.exercise_en: Give each student a phone playing a chosen looped sound in a pocket and walk around blindfolded partners who guess who is approaching. Twist: let the sound change with the person's mood or walking speed.
works.exercise_zh: 让每个学生在口袋里放一部循环播放自选声音的手机，在蒙眼的同伴周围走动，让他们猜是谁在靠近；变体：让声音随这个人的情绪或步速变化。

video.video_title: Audio Personas: Augmenting Social Perception via Body-Anchored Audio Cues

salient.why_en: Everyone carries a personal sound around their body, so you hear who is nearby before you look.
salient.why_zh: 每个人身上都带着一段专属声音，你还没转头就能听出谁在附近。

works.title: Augmented Reality Portal
works.description: A walk-in web AR portal that anyone can try from a link.
works.idea_zh: 一个打开链接就能走进去的 AR 传送门。

video.video_title:
Augmented Reality Portal🔮

Try it yourself… ⬇️ https://t.co/PuikPccuZI

works.technique: A walk-in portal uses a stencil or depth-mask shader on the doorway so the inner world is visible only through the frame, and it is distributed as a link through browser-based SLAM.
works.exercise_zh: 用 8th Wall 或 WebXR 做一个可以从链接打开的传送门，门内放一个 360 全景图；变体：门外能听到门内的声音，越近越清晰。
works.description_zh: 一个可以走进去的网页 AR 传送门，任何人点开链接就能体验。
works.idea_en: An AR portal you can walk into just by opening a link.
works.technique_zh: 这个可进入的传送门在门框上使用模板或深度遮罩着色器，使内部世界只能透过门框看到，并借助基于浏览器的 SLAM 以链接形式分发。
works.exercise_en: Build a portal that opens from a link using 8th Wall or WebXR, with a 360 panorama inside the door. Twist: let people outside hear sounds from inside, getting clearer as they approach.

works.title: BPlane Adventures
works.description: A relaxing flow game for Spectacles: you steer a small plane with head movements and use your hands to boost it through the space around you.
works.idea_zh: 用头部转动驾驶小飞机，用手加速，在身边空间穿梭飞行。

video.video_title: BPlane Adventures

works.technique: Head orientation steers the plane's heading, while a hand gesture triggers a speed boost, both mapped in world space around the user.
works.exercise_zh: 用头部朝向（HoloKit 或手机陀螺仪）控制一架纸飞机穿过房间里的 AR 圆环，张开手掌加速；变体：圆环摆放位置根据房间平面自动生成。
works.description_zh: 一款适合 Spectacles 的放松型心流游戏：用头部动作驾驶一架小飞机，再用手为它加速，穿梭于你身边的空间。
works.idea_en: Steer a small plane by turning your head and boost it with your hand as it weaves through the space around you.
works.technique_zh: 头部朝向控制飞机的航向，手势触发加速，二者都映射在用户周围的世界空间中。
works.exercise_en: Use head orientation (HoloKit or the phone gyroscope) to fly a paper plane through AR rings in the room, opening your palm to speed up. Twist: generate ring positions automatically from the room's planes.

works.title: Beyond the Phone
works.description: While wearing an XR headset, content on your phone can lift off the screen: maps expand into 3D, photos spread around you and the phone becomes a controller, with smooth transitions between views.
works.description_zh: 戴着 XR 头显时，手机上的内容可以“浮”出屏幕：地图展开成 3D，照片散布在你周围，手机变成控制器，各视图之间平滑过渡。
works.idea_en: The phone and the headset are one interface, and content can flow between them.
works.idea_zh: 手机和头显是同一个界面，内容可以在两者之间流动。
works.technique: The phone's pose is tracked by the headset, and apps define multiple views (on-screen, above-screen, world-anchored) with animated transitions triggered by gestures or context.
works.technique_zh: 头显追踪手机的姿态，应用为内容定义多个视图（屏幕内、屏幕上方、锚定在世界中），通过手势或情境触发带动画的过渡。
works.exercise_en: With phone AR, make a photo on a tablet lift up into 3D when the phone is held above it. Twist: pour the photo back by tilting the phone.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR，让平板上的一张照片在手机举到其上方时“升起”成 3D。变体：倾斜手机把照片“倒”回去。

video.video_title: Beyond the Phone: Exploring Phone-XR Integration through Multi-View Transitions

works.title: Body Oracle Translator
works.description: A handheld MR device translates people's body postures in real time into speculative AI-generated hieroglyphs inspired by Chinese oracle-bone script.
works.idea_zh: 把身体姿态实时翻译成AI生成的“甲骨文”。

video.video_title: “Body Oracle” Translator

works.technique: Classifies body poses with a pose-estimation model and maps them to a pre-generated glyph set rendered as AR overlays next to the person.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机人体姿态识别（Effect House/MediaPipe）把5种姿势映射成5个自创象形字，拍照时叠在人旁边；变化：连续姿势拼成一句“身体句子”。
works.description_zh: 一个手持式混合现实设备，把人的身体姿态实时翻译成受中国甲骨文启发、由 AI 生成的思辨性象形文字。
works.idea_en: Translate body postures into AI-generated 'oracle-bone script' in real time.
works.technique_zh: 用姿态估计模型对身体姿势进行分类，再映射到一套预先生成的字形，以 AR 叠加的方式显示在人物旁边。
works.exercise_en: Use phone body-pose recognition (Effect House or MediaPipe) to map five poses to five invented pictographs and overlay them next to the person when taking a photo. Twist: string a sequence of poses into a 'body sentence'.

works.title: Boulderverse
works.description: A Meta Quest 3 prototype for bouldering that overlays routes, holds and challenges on a climbing wall in mixed reality.
works.description_zh: 一款 Meta Quest 3 攀岩原型应用，用混合现实在攀岩墙上叠加路线、岩点和挑战。
works.idea_en: Turn any climbing wall into an endlessly re-settable game board.
works.idea_zh: 把任何一面攀岩墙都变成可以无限重新“定线”的游戏棋盘。
works.technique: Quest 3 passthrough and spatial anchors align virtual holds and route markers to a physical wall (likely).
works.technique_zh: 利用 Quest 3 的透视画面和空间锚点，把虚拟岩点和路线标记对齐到真实墙面上（推测）。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR 'floor is lava' course by placing virtual stepping stones on a real floor, then time classmates crossing it. Twist: the stones slowly move while you walk.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实地面上摆放虚拟踏脚石，设计一条 AR“地板是岩浆”赛道，并给同学计时通过；变体：你走的时候踏脚石会慢慢移动。

video.video_title: BOULDERVERSE

works.title: Bringing Everyday Objects to Life with AI-Powered Talking Characters
works.description: Household objects become talking AR characters: a kettle, a plant or a chair gets an animated face and a personality drawn from what it is, chats with you about the room and reacts when things around it change.
works.description_zh: 家里的物品变成会说话的 AR 角色：水壶、盆栽或椅子长出动画面孔，拥有由其功能和特点衍生出的性格，和你聊房间里的事，并在周围发生变化时作出反应。
works.idea_en: Give every object a voice and a personality that come from what the object is.
works.idea_zh: 让每件物品都有声音和性格，而这些都来自它本身是什么。
works.technique: Vision models recognize the object and its surroundings, an LLM generates a personality and dialogue grounded in the object's function, and speech synthesis with an animated overlay runs on HoloLens 2 or an Android phone.
works.technique_zh: 视觉模型识别物体及其周围环境，大语言模型依据物体的功能生成性格和对话，再配合语音合成与动画叠加，运行在 HoloLens 2 或安卓手机上。
works.exercise_en: Stick AR googly eyes on three objects with Lens Studio or web image tracking, write a one-line persona for each ('I am a stapler who hates loose paper'), and connect them to an LLM and text-to-speech so students can interview them. Twist: let two objects gossip with each other about the user.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或网页图像追踪给三件物品贴上 AR 大眼睛，为每件写一句人设（“我是一只讨厌散乱纸张的订书机”），接入大语言模型和语音合成，让学生去采访它们。变体：让两件物品互相八卦，话题就是用户本人。

video.video_title: Bringing Everyday Objects to Life in Augmented Reality with AI-Powered Talking Characters

salient.why_en: Every household object gets a face and a personality that come from what it is.
salient.why_zh: 每件家居物品都长出一张脸，性格由它本身是什么来决定。

works.title: Bringing an action figure to life in AR
works.description: A photo of a toy action figure is turned into a rigged 3D character that walks around in WebAR next to the real toy.
works.description_zh: 一张玩具手办的照片被变成带骨骼的三维角色，在 WebAR 里和真实玩具并肩走动。
works.idea_en: Photograph a toy and it steps out of its box as a living AR character.
works.idea_zh: 给玩具拍张照，它就从包装盒里走出来，成为会动的 AR 角色。
works.technique: An image model cleans up the figure into a character sheet, Tripo AI converts it into a textured, rigged 3D model, and 8th Wall places and animates it in the browser.
works.technique_zh: 先用图像模型把手办整理成角色设定图，再用 Tripo AI 转成带贴图和骨骼的三维模型，最后由 8th Wall 在浏览器中放置并驱动动画。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a small object, turn it into a 3D model with a free image-to-3D service, auto-rig it and place it on a table with WebAR or Reality Composer. Twist: make the AR copy mirror whatever pose you put the real toy in.
works.exercise_zh: 给一个小物件拍照，用免费图生三维服务生成模型并自动绑定骨骼，用 WebAR 或 Reality Composer 放到桌上。变体：你把真玩具摆成什么姿势，AR 分身就跟着摆什么姿势。

video.video_title: Bringing my action figure to life in AR with @OpenAI, @tripoai and @the8thwall https://t.co/PRiAGaxur5

salient.why_en: Photograph a toy and a living copy of it walks around next to the real one.
salient.why_zh: 给玩偶拍张照，一个活过来的它就在真玩偶旁边走来走去。

works.title: Bubbles
works.description: A Spectacles lens where you type a prompt, generate 3D models with Snap3D generative AI, and place several objects around you inside floating bubbles.
works.idea_zh: 输入文字即生成3D物体，装在泡泡里摆满你周围。

video.video_title: Spectacles Bubbles

works.technique: A text prompt is sent to a text-to-3D service, and the returned mesh is scaled into a transparent sphere container placed around the user via world tracking.
works.exercise_zh: 用文生 3D 工具生成三个小物体，在 AR 中分别放进透明泡泡，点破泡泡物体才会落地；变体：泡泡里的物体来自同学之间互相出题。
works.description_zh: 一个 Spectacles 滤镜：输入一段提示词，用 Snap3D 生成式 AI 生成 3D 模型，再把多个物体装进漂浮的泡泡里摆在你周围。
works.idea_en: Type some words to generate 3D objects, then fill the space around you with them, each sealed in a bubble.
works.technique_zh: 文本提示词被发送到文本生成 3D 服务，返回的网格被缩放后装进一个透明球体容器，并通过世界追踪放置在用户周围。
works.exercise_en: Generate three small objects with a text-to-3D tool and place each in a transparent bubble in AR, so an object only drops to the ground when its bubble is popped. Twist: have classmates set the prompts for each other's bubbles.

works.title: Buoyancé
works.description: Mobile robots reel helium balloons up and down by strings, forming floating 3D displays and interactive mid-air objects above a tabletop.
works.idea_zh: 机器人拉着氦气球升降，在空中形成可交互的立体显示。

video.video_title: Buoyancé: Reeling Helium-Inflated Balloons with Mobile Robots for Display and Interaction [UIST2025]

works.technique: Each tabletop robot winds a tether to set balloon height while driving to set x-y position, so a swarm places floating points in 3D space.
works.exercise_zh: 用气球、线和手动升降把桌面变成空中柱状图，再用手机AR给每个气球叠加标签；变化：同学拉动气球改变高度，AR中的数据随之更新。
works.description_zh: 移动机器人用细绳收放氦气球，让它们升降，在桌面上方形成漂浮的三维显示和可交互的空中物体。
works.idea_en: Robots reel helium balloons up and down to form an interactive 3D display in mid-air.
works.technique_zh: 每台桌面机器人通过收放系绳设定气球高度，同时移动自身来设定 x-y 位置，于是整个机器人集群可以在三维空间中布置漂浮的点。
works.exercise_en: Use balloons, string and manual raising and lowering to turn a tabletop into a mid-air bar chart, then add a label to each balloon with phone AR. Twist: when classmates pull a balloon to change its height, the data in AR updates with it.

works.title: Capybara
works.description: An AR visual-programming environment for children: they create 3D characters and accessories with text-to-3D AI, animate them with auto-rigging and their own body movements, and program how the characters react to real objects the camera recognizes.
works.description_zh: 面向儿童的 AR 可视化编程环境：孩子们用文本生成三维的 AI 创造角色和配饰，借助自动绑骨和自己的身体动作让角色动起来，再编程让角色对摄像头识别出的真实物体作出反应。
works.idea_en: Make children the creators of AI-powered AR, not just its audience.
works.idea_zh: 让孩子成为 AI 驱动 AR 的创作者，而不只是观众。
works.technique: Text-to-3D models generate the characters, auto-rigging and body tracking animate them, vision models recognize physical objects, and block-based code links recognition events to character behaviors.
works.technique_zh: 文本生成三维模型制作角色，自动绑骨和身体追踪让角色动起来，视觉模型识别实体物体，积木式代码把识别事件与角色行为连接起来。
works.exercise_en: Run a kids' workshop: each child types a character description into a text-to-3D tool, imports the model into a phone AR app, and uses a simple rule card ('when you see a banana, dance') implemented with an object detector to make it react. Twist: let children program two characters that react to each other, not only to objects.
works.exercise_zh: 办一场儿童工作坊：每个孩子把角色描述输入文本生成三维工具，把模型导入手机 AR 应用，再用一张简单的规则卡（“看到香蕉就跳舞”）配合物体检测让角色作出反应。变体：让孩子为两个角色编程，让它们彼此互动，而不只对物体反应。

video.video_title: Capybara: Empowering Children to Create AI-Enabled Augmented Reality Experiences

works.title: Chain-of-thought models designing XR puzzles
works.description: A reasoning model is asked to invent small puzzle games, and its generated three.js code runs directly as an XR puzzle.
works.description_zh: 让推理模型发明小型解谜游戏，它生成的 three.js 代码直接作为 XR 谜题运行。
works.idea_en: Let a reasoning model design the level, then step inside it.
works.idea_zh: 让推理模型来设计关卡，然后你走进去玩。
works.technique: A chain-of-thought LLM (DeepSeek) is prompted for a puzzle rule set and outputs three.js scene code, which is loaded into a WebXR page.
works.technique_zh: 向带思维链的大语言模型（DeepSeek）索要一套谜题规则，并让它输出 three.js 场景代码，加载到 WebXR 页面中。
works.exercise_en: Ask an LLM for a one-page WebXR puzzle (for example 'arrange four cubes so their shadows spell a letter'), paste the code into a template and test it on a phone. Twist: the class must solve it without knowing the rule, then guess the prompt.
works.exercise_zh: 请大语言模型写一个单页 WebXR 谜题（例如“摆放四个方块让影子拼出一个字母”），把代码贴进模板在手机上测试。变体：全班在不知道规则的情况下破解，再反推提示词。

video.video_title: I'm exploring how chain-of-thought models like DeepSeek can create unique (XR) puzzle games. I know there are more efficient solutions, but it's still fascinating! #threejs #deepseek https://t.co/hanH

works.title: ChatGPT 5 writing mixed-reality scripts in Figmin XR
works.description: A classic AI coding challenge is taken into 3D: GPT-5 writes a script for Figmin XR's scripting API and the result runs as an interactive object in the user's room.
works.description_zh: 把一个经典的 AI 编程挑战带进三维：GPT-5 为 Figmin XR 的脚本 API 写代码，结果作为交互物体在用户房间里运行。
works.idea_en: Describe a behaviour, and an object in your room starts doing it.
works.idea_zh: 描述一种行为，房间里的一个物体就开始照做。
works.technique: The LLM generates Lua-style code against Figmin's documented API; the code is loaded into an object and executed in the mixed-reality scene.
works.technique_zh: 大语言模型针对 Figmin 的公开 API 生成脚本代码，代码被装入物体并在混合现实场景中执行。
works.exercise_en: Give an LLM the documentation of a tiny AR scripting API (spin, move, change colour) and ask for a bouncing-ball script; run it in WebXR. Twist: the class writes prompts only, never code, and competes for the strangest physics.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个很小的 AR 脚本 API 文档（旋转、移动、变色）交给大语言模型，让它写弹球脚本，在 WebXR 中运行。变体：全班只写提示不写代码，比谁的物理最奇怪。

video.video_title: ChatGPT 5 with Figmin XR

works.title: Dansez Versailles
works.description: Four Lenses placed in the gardens of the Palace of Versailles dress visitors in Baroque costume and put them into historical court dances, with wigs and hats on the front camera and full-body dancers on the rear camera.
works.description_zh: 凡尔赛宫花园里的四个 Lens 让游客换上巴洛克服装、跳起宫廷舞：前置摄像头戴上假发和帽子，后置摄像头则把整个人变成舞者。
works.idea_en: Let visitors physically perform history in the exact place it happened.
works.idea_zh: 让游客在历史发生的原地，用身体把历史“跳”一遍。
works.technique: Face tracking dresses the selfie view while full-body tracking and garment/body-mesh templates restyle the whole figure, triggered at specific garden locations inside the palace app via Camera Kit.
works.technique_zh: 前置镜头用人脸追踪做装扮，后置镜头用全身追踪和服装/身体网格模板重塑整个人，并通过 Camera Kit 集成进凡尔赛官方应用，在花园特定地点触发。
works.exercise_en: Build a body-tracked Lens that teaches one historical or folk dance step by showing a ghost dancer to copy and a costume that appears only when you match the pose. Twist: two people must dance mirrored to unlock the full costume.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个人体追踪 Lens，展示一个“幽灵舞者”教你跳一段历史或民间舞步，只有动作对上时服装才会出现；变体：必须两个人镜像对跳才能解锁完整服装。

video.video_title: Dansez versailles - Chateau de Versailles x Snapchat

works.title: Decart XR: speak a prompt and transform the world
works.description: Built on QuestCameraKit, Decart XR lets the wearer speak a prompt and watch a real-time AI video model transform the passthrough view of their surroundings.
works.description_zh: Decart XR 基于 QuestCameraKit，佩戴者说出一句提示，就能看到实时 AI 视频模型改变透视画面中的周围环境。
works.idea_en: Say a world and step into it without leaving your room.
works.idea_zh: 说出一个世界，不出房间就走进去。
works.technique: Passthrough frames stream to Decart's real-time video-to-video model with a spoken prompt (speech-to-text), and the transformed stream replaces the passthrough view.
works.technique_zh: 透视画面流式发送到 Decart 实时视频转视频模型，配合语音转成的提示，转换后的画面替代原本的透视视图。
works.exercise_en: Wire speech-to-text to a real-time restyling API on a phone in a HoloKit or cardboard viewer, and hold a 'world-building' round where each student speaks one prompt. Twist: prompts must describe a smell or a sound, not a look.
works.exercise_zh: 在 HoloKit 或纸盒头显里的手机上，把语音转文字接到实时重绘接口，每位同学说一句提示来轮流“造世界”。变体：提示必须描述气味或声音，而不是外观。

video.video_title:
Building cool sh*t with QuestCameraKit 🖼️🔥

Now you can just speak a prompt and AI will transform the world around you!

Try Decart XR now FOR FREE on Sidequest: https://t.co/SdnLPcW6FH

works.title: DejaViewer: Replaying Past Motion in AR
works.description: Records motion in the field of view from Quest colour and depth cameras and replays it on the spot as a ghostly point cloud.
works.idea_zh: 把刚才发生在眼前的动作录下来，原地以点云“回放过去”。

video.video_title: DejaViewer: Replaying Past Motion in AR

works.technique: Passthrough color and depth frames are recorded, frame differencing isolates moving regions, and those regions are unprojected to point clouds that replay in place with fading transparency.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机深度相机录下一段人走过的画面，只保留运动部分转成点云，在原地以半透明“残影”循环回放；变体：残影越旧越碎。
works.description_zh: 利用 Quest 的彩色相机和深度相机记录视野中的动作，并在原地以幽灵般的点云回放出来。
works.idea_en: Record the motion that just happened in front of you and replay the past on the spot as a point cloud.
works.technique_zh: 记录透视的彩色帧和深度帧，通过帧差分离出运动区域，再把这些区域反投影为点云，在原地以逐渐变淡的透明度回放。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone depth camera to record someone walking past, keep only the moving parts as a point cloud, and loop them in place as semi-transparent 'afterimages'. Twist: the older an afterimage is, the more it breaks apart.

works.title: Desk-side web AR experiment
works.description: A quick web AR sketch built at his desk.
works.idea_zh: 桌面上的即兴 WebAR 小实验。

video.video_title: built a quick web AR experiment at the desk today. https://t.co/sZIzm3OgCq

works.technique: A minimal WebAR sketch most likely uses surface detection plus a hit test to place a single object, showing how fast a browser AR idea can be tested.
works.exercise_zh: 给自己 30 分钟，在桌边用 WebXR 模板做一个最小可运行的 AR 草图并录屏；变体：规定只能用一种几何体，但要表达一种情绪。
works.description_zh: 他在书桌前快速搭建的一个网页 AR 草图。
works.idea_en: A quick, improvised WebAR experiment on the desk.
works.technique_zh: 这个极简的 WebAR 草图大概率使用表面检测加命中测试（hit test）来放置一个物体，展示了在浏览器里验证一个 AR 想法可以有多快。
works.exercise_en: Give yourself 30 minutes to build a minimal working AR sketch at your desk from a WebXR template, and screen-record it. Twist: you may use only one kind of geometry, but it has to express an emotion.

works.title: Dream Park street access point
works.description: A public Dream Park access point on Santa Monica's Third Street Promenade turns the whole street into a mixed-reality game for passers-by.
works.idea_zh: 在街上装一个'入口'，整条街就变成可下载的混合现实主题乐园。

video.video_title: just installed the first public Dream Park access point on Third St Promenade turning the entire street into a game, coming soon to Quest 3 with camera access! First of many AR theme parks we’ll be se

works.technique: Game content is authored to a specific mapped location so devices localize against it and see the same attractions in the real street.
works.exercise_zh: 给校园设计一条'AR 主题乐园'路线，放三处可玩的 AR 小游戏点（Lens Studio/8th Wall）；加一个变化：只有凑齐三人才能开启最后一个景点。
works.description_zh: 在圣莫尼卡第三街步行街上设置的一个公共 Dream Park 接入点，把整条街变成路人都能参与的混合现实游戏。
works.idea_en: Install an 'entrance' on a street, and the whole street becomes a downloadable mixed-reality theme park.
works.technique_zh: 游戏内容针对某个已建图的具体地点制作，设备在该地点完成定位后，就能在真实街道上看到同样的游乐项目。
works.exercise_en: Design an 'AR theme park' route across campus with three playable AR mini-game stops (Lens Studio or 8th Wall). Twist: the last attraction opens only when three people are there together.

works.title: EchoVision (Ars Electronica Deep Space 8K edition)
works.description: A projection edition of EchoVision in Ars Electronica's Deep Space 8K: visitors' voices become visualised echolocation waves across the giant wall and floor, alongside AI-composed bat songs.
works.idea_zh: 在巨大的墙面和地面上，把观众的叫声变成蝙蝠的回声定位波
works.technique: Microphone input is analysed for pitch and loudness and rendered as expanding echo waves in the 8K wall-and-floor projection, likely with floor tracking of visitors.
works.exercise_zh: 在教室地面投影，用麦克风把喊声转成从中心扩散的波纹，碰到“障碍物”（放在地上的纸箱）会反射；变化：只有低沉的声音能看见远处的障碍。

video.video_title: EchoVision - Ars Electronica Deep Space 8k

works.description_zh: EchoVision 在电子艺术中心（Ars Electronica）Deep Space 8K 中的投影版本：观众的声音被可视化为回声定位波，在巨大的墙面和地面上扩散，同时伴随着 AI 创作的蝙蝠之歌。
works.idea_en: On a giant wall and floor, visitors' calls turn into bat-like echolocation waves.
works.technique_zh: 对麦克风输入进行音高和响度分析，在 8K 墙面与地面投影中渲染为不断扩散的回声波，可能还结合了对地面上观众位置的追踪。
works.exercise_en: Project onto a classroom floor and use a microphone to turn shouts into ripples spreading from the center that bounce off 'obstacles' (cardboard boxes placed on the floor). Twist: only low-pitched sounds can reveal distant obstacles.

works.title: Electric Sky
works.description: At LUMA Arles, a swarm of lit drones performs over the landscape, moving between cloud-like masses and lines that evoke weather and electricity in the sky.
works.description_zh: 在阿尔勒 LUMA，一群发光无人机在景观上空表演，在云团般的聚集和线条之间变换，让人联想到天空中的天气与电。
works.idea_en: A swarm can imitate weather instead of pictures; AR sky content does not have to show images, it can behave like natural phenomena.
works.idea_zh: 群体可以模仿天气而不是图像；AR 天空内容不一定要展示图画，它可以像自然现象一样运动。
works.technique: Drone trajectories are generated by DRIFT's software to mimic natural motion and flown as a light performance, likely with a soundtrack timeline.
works.technique_zh: 无人机轨迹由 DRIFT 的软件生成，模仿自然运动，作为灯光表演飞行，很可能配合一条音轨时间线。
works.exercise_en: Create an AR 'weather' swarm that drifts like a cloud, then snaps into lightning-like lines when the phone detects a loud sound. Twist: use real cloud cover from a weather API to decide how dense the swarm is.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个像云一样漂移的 AR“天气”群体，当手机检测到巨响时瞬间变成闪电般的线条。变体：用天气 API 的真实云量决定群体的密度。

video.video_title: Electric Sky Drone Performance - DRIFT at LUMA, Arles

works.title: EmBARDiment
works.description: An embodied AI agent in XR watches which windows and text you have been looking at and uses that as context, so you can ask 'summarise this' or 'what did I just read?' without copying anything.
works.description_zh: XR 中的具身 AI 智能体会留意你一直在看的窗口和文字，并以此作为上下文，所以你无需复制任何内容就能说“总结一下这个”或“我刚才读了什么？”。
works.idea_en: Your gaze history is the prompt.
works.idea_zh: 你的注视历史就是提示词。
works.technique: Eye tracking builds an attention-weighted memory of on-screen text, which is passed to an LLM agent represented by an avatar alongside the spoken request.
works.technique_zh: 眼动追踪建立一个按注意力加权的屏幕文字记忆，与语音请求一起传给以虚拟化身呈现的大语言模型智能体。
works.exercise_en: Log which of five AR text panels a user looks at longest (use head direction as a proxy) and feed only that text to a chatbot when they ask a question. Twist: let the agent say which panel it used.
works.exercise_zh: 记录用户看得最久的是五个 AR 文字面板中的哪一个（用头部朝向代替眼动），在他们提问时只把那段文字交给聊天机器人。变体：让智能体说出它用的是哪个面板。

video.video_title: EmBARDiment: an Embodied AI Agentfor Productivity in XR

works.title: FeltSight
works.description: A mixed-reality haptic experience inspired by the tactile navigation of animals like the star-nosed mole: you feel your way through space via fingertip haptics instead of sight.
works.idea_zh: 模仿星鼻鼹鼠的触觉导航，用指尖触感而非视觉感知空间。

video.video_title: FeltSight

works.technique: Distance from the fingertip to scanned geometry is mapped to vibration intensity on a wearable actuator, while visual feedback is reduced so touch becomes the main sense.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 LiDAR 或深度估计测量摄像头前方物体的距离，映射成手机震动强度，闭眼在教室里摸索前进；变体：把震动节奏换成不同“动物”的触觉语言。
works.description_zh: 一个混合现实触觉体验，灵感来自星鼻鼹鼠等动物的触觉导航：你不靠视觉，而是通过指尖的触觉反馈来摸索空间。
works.idea_en: Borrowing the star-nosed mole's tactile navigation, you sense space through your fingertips rather than your eyes.
works.technique_zh: 把指尖到扫描几何体的距离映射为可穿戴执行器的振动强度，同时削弱视觉反馈，让触觉成为主要感官。
works.exercise_en: Measure the distance to objects in front of the camera with phone LiDAR or depth estimation, map it to vibration strength, and feel your way across the classroom with your eyes closed. Twist: replace the vibration rhythm with the tactile 'language' of different animals.

salient.why_en: Borrow a star-nosed mole's sense: you feel the space around you through your fingertips instead of seeing it.
salient.why_zh: 借用星鼻鼹鼠的感官：用指尖去触摸周围的空间，而不是用眼睛去看。

works.title: Fireside Tales
works.description: Players on Snap Spectacles sit as marshmallow avatars around a virtual campfire, take turns telling a story, and watch AI generate artwork from what they say in real time.
works.description_zh: 戴着 Snap Spectacles 的玩家化身棉花糖角色围坐在虚拟篝火旁，轮流讲故事，AI 会根据他们说的话实时生成画面。
works.idea_en: A campfire where the spoken story instantly becomes pictures floating in the shared space.
works.idea_zh: 一堆篝火，大家讲出的故事立刻变成漂浮在共享空间里的画面。
works.technique: Speech is transcribed and sent through Snap Cloud/Supabase to an image-generation model, with results synced to all co-located Spectacles players.
works.technique_zh: 把语音转成文字，经由 Snap Cloud/Supabase 发送给图像生成模型，再把结果同步给同一空间里的所有 Spectacles 玩家。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR circle where each student speaks one sentence and an AI-generated image appears above their head. Twist: each new image must be generated from the previous two sentences combined.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 围圈游戏：每位同学说一句话，头顶就出现一张 AI 生成的图；变体：每张新图都要由前两句话合并生成。

video.video_title: We Built an AI Storytelling Game for AR Glasses (Snap Spectacles Hackathon)

works.title: Fluo: fluid and spectral color visualizer
works.description: Live camera footage dissolves into a bright, flowing fluid of mixed pigments, used as visuals at club events.
works.description_zh: 实时相机画面溶解成明亮流动的混色流体，用作俱乐部活动的视觉。
works.idea_en: The camera image becomes the dye in a fluid.
works.idea_zh: 相机画面成为流体里的颜料。
works.technique: Stable Fluids advects camera colors as dye while spectral.js mixes them like pigments; an iPhone streams the camera and controls to the host over NDI.
works.technique_zh: Stable Fluids 把相机颜色当作染料进行平流，spectral.js 像颜料一样混色；iPhone 通过 NDI 把相机画面和控制信号传给主机。
works.exercise_en: Stream the phone camera into a fluid shader and show the result on an AR panel that floats in front of the performer. Twist: the performer's movement adds force to the fluid.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机相机画面传进流体着色器，结果显示在表演者面前的 AR 浮动面板上。变体：表演者的动作给流体加力。

video.video_title: https://t.co/Ctim7fDNST https://t.co/6ByEYPtlCS

works.title: Flying Embers
works.description: Glowing embers drift and tumble through the air around a character and still look right in close-up and at grazing angles.
works.description_zh: 发光的火星在角色周围飘浮翻滚，即使在特写和掠射角度下也依然自然。
works.idea_en: Model how a real camera sees a moving hot spark instead of stretching a sprite.
works.idea_zh: 去模拟真实相机如何拍到一颗移动的炽热火星，而不是简单拉伸一张贴图。
works.technique: Instead of stretching quads along velocity, the VFX Graph and Shader Graph effect draws each ember as a camera-facing streak whose length and falloff approximate motion blur and depth-of-field, so it holds up from any angle.
works.technique_zh: 这个 VFX Graph 加 Shader Graph 特效不是沿速度方向拉伸面片，而是把每颗火星画成朝向相机的光痕，用其长度和衰减近似运动模糊与景深，因此从任何角度看都成立。
