works.exercise_en: Place a campfire in AR and compare velocity-stretched embers with camera-aware streaks while walking around it. Twist: the embers drift towards the phone's flashlight.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中放一堆篝火，绕着它走，对比按速度拉伸的火星和考虑相机的光痕。变体：让火星向手机手电筒的光飘去。

video.video_title:
For the love of our eyeballs, do not align your ember particles to velocity!

Don’t give them that comet texture either, ugh.

Let’s make
✨physically based flying embers✨

A Unity vfx graph implementa

works.title: Foldiverse
works.description: An MR origami trainer for autistic children: a virtual 3D origami model and a voice assistant called FoFo guide each fold step-by-step over the real paper.
works.idea_zh: AR折纸老师一步步引导孩子折纸。

video.video_title: Foldiverse

works.technique: Shows animated 3D fold steps registered near the child's paper with voice prompts from an assistant, advancing when a step is complete.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR在桌面上播放一步一步的3D折纸动画，并用语音按钮进入下一步；变化：让手机识别纸张形状自动判断是否完成当前步骤。
works.description_zh: 一款面向自闭症儿童的混合现实折纸训练工具：虚拟 3D 折纸模型和名为 FoFo 的语音助手在真实纸张上方，一步一步引导每一次折叠。
works.idea_en: An AR origami teacher guides a child through folding, step by step.
works.technique_zh: 在孩子的纸张附近对齐显示 3D 折叠步骤动画，并配合助手的语音提示，完成一步后再进入下一步。
works.exercise_en: Play a step-by-step 3D origami animation on a tabletop with phone AR, using a voice button to go to the next step. Twist: have the phone recognize the paper's shape to decide automatically whether the current step is done.

works.title: Frame-a-scene spatial pixel art (first Spectacles lens)
works.description: Making a frame with your fingers captures part of the view, and the lens generates pixel art from it that sits back in place, blending into the surroundings.
works.description_zh: 用手指比出一个取景框，镜片就截取这部分视野，生成像素画，并放回原位，融入周围环境。
works.idea_en: Your fingers are the camera; AI turns what you frame into pixel art in place.
works.idea_zh: 手指就是相机，AI 把你框住的东西就地变成像素画。
works.technique: A hand-tracking gesture defines a crop of the camera frame, which is sent to an image model with a pixel-art prompt, and the result is anchored as a quad at the framed location.
works.technique_zh: 用手势追踪确定摄像头画面的裁剪区域，送进带“像素风”提示的图像模型，结果作为平面贴片锚定在原来的位置。
works.exercise_en: In Lens Studio or a phone AR app, let users drag a rectangle on the camera view, send the crop to an image API with a style prompt, and pin the result where it was taken. Twist: each classmate chooses a different art style, and the room becomes a collage.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Lens Studio 或手机 AR 应用里，让用户在画面上拖出矩形，把截图连同风格提示发给图像接口，结果钉回原处。变体：每位同学选一种画风，整个房间变成拼贴画。

video.video_title: My first AR Lens for Spectacles! 📸 Frame a scene with your fingers, and it’ll generate spatial pixel art that blends into your surroundings. https://t.co/PNLhAKr803

works.title: From 2D video to 4D Gaussian splats on Vision Pro
works.description: Frames of the short film Big Buck Bunny are each turned into a Gaussian splat with Apple's SHARP model, compressed, and played back as a rough volumetric animation in Vision Pro.
works.description_zh: 短片《Big Buck Bunny》的每一帧都用苹果的 SHARP 模型转成高斯泼溅，压缩后在 Vision Pro 中作为粗糙的体积动画播放。
works.idea_en: Any flat video can become a scene you walk around, one generated frame at a time.
works.idea_zh: 任何平面视频都可以一帧一帧地被生成成可以绕着走的场景。
works.technique: A single-image-to-3D model (SHARP) predicts a splat per frame; the splats are compressed with PlayCanvas tools and swapped every frame to fake a 4D sequence.
works.technique_zh: 用单图转三维模型（SHARP）为每一帧预测一个泼溅，再用 PlayCanvas 工具压缩，逐帧切换，拼出伪四维序列。
works.exercise_en: Take 24 frames from a short clip, turn each into a 3D splat with a free image-to-3D tool, and flip through them in a WebXR viewer on a table. Twist: freeze time when the viewer walks behind the scene.
works.exercise_zh: 从一段短片里取 24 帧，每帧用免费图生三维工具转成泼溅，在桌面上的 WebXR 查看器中逐帧翻放。变体：观众绕到场景背后时，时间静止。

video.video_title:
From 2D video to a very rough 4D Gaussian Splatting POC on the Apple Vision Pro 👀

Took Big Buck Bunny frames, turned them into Gaussian splats with Sharp (Apple), compressed them with @playcanvas spl

works.title: From prompt to lens with an MCP server for Lens Studio
works.description: A walkthrough of building a first Model Context Protocol server so an AI coding agent can create and edit AR lenses inside Lens Studio from plain-language prompts.
works.description_zh: 一步步搭建第一个 Model Context Protocol 服务器，让 AI 编程智能体能够根据自然语言提示，在 Lens Studio 里创建和修改 AR 镜头。
works.idea_en: The AR editor becomes something an AI agent can operate for you.
works.idea_zh: AR 编辑器变成 AI 智能体可以替你操作的工具。
works.technique: An MCP server exposes Lens Studio actions (create objects, set properties, run scripts) as tools that an LLM agent in Cursor or Claude can call in a loop.
works.technique_zh: MCP 服务器把 Lens Studio 的操作（创建物体、设置属性、运行脚本）封装成工具，供 Cursor 或 Claude 中的大语言模型智能体循环调用。
works.exercise_en: Expose three functions of any 3D tool (add cube, set colour, move) through a tiny MCP server and ask an AI agent to build a scene from one sentence. Twist: the agent must explain each step aloud to a classmate who is building the same scene by hand.
works.exercise_zh: 用一个很小的 MCP 服务器暴露任意三维工具的三个功能（加方块、设颜色、移动），让 AI 智能体根据一句话搭场景。变体：智能体每一步都要讲给一位手工搭同样场景的同学听。

video.video_title: Your First MCP Server for AR: From Prompt to Lens with Lens Studio AI!

works.title: Fruit Defense
works.description: A single- and multiplayer Spectacles game in which real-world objects detected around you become active gameplay elements to defend.
works.idea_zh: 眼镜识别身边真实物体，把它们变成塔防游戏的一部分。

video.video_title: Fruit Defense - Spectacles

works.technique: An on-device object detection model finds real objects in view, and their estimated 3D positions become gameplay entities that enemies target.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或手机上的物体识别找出桌上的水杯，把它设为需要保护的“基地”，AR 小怪从四周涌来；变体：换一个物体，敌人的类型随之变化。
works.description_zh: 一款支持单人和多人的 Spectacles 游戏：你周围被检测到的真实物体会变成需要守护的游戏元素。
works.idea_en: The glasses recognize real objects around you and make them part of a tower-defense game.
works.technique_zh: 设备端物体检测模型找出视野中的真实物体，并把估算出的 3D 位置变成敌人会攻击的游戏实体。
works.exercise_en: Use object recognition in Lens Studio or on a phone to find a cup on the table, make it the 'base' you must protect, and send small AR monsters swarming in from all sides. Twist: switch to a different object and the enemy type changes with it.

works.title: Generative-AI earthquake rehearsal overlaid on a real room
works.description: From a single photo of a real room, a generative video model creates an earthquake scenario with falling ceiling panels, which is converted to spatial video and overlaid on the same room in Vision Pro, with rewind and slow motion.
works.description_zh: 仅凭一张真实房间照片，生成式视频模型就生成天花板面板掉落的地震情景，再转成空间视频，在 Vision Pro 中叠加回同一个房间，还能倒放和慢放。
works.idea_en: Rehearse a disaster in the exact room where it could happen.
works.idea_zh: 在可能发生灾害的那个房间里，直接预演一次灾害。
works.technique: An image-to-video model (such as Veo or Kling) animates the photo into a quake, a 2D-to-stereo step makes it a spatial video, and it is aligned to the real room in the headset.
works.technique_zh: 用图生视频模型（如 Veo 或 Kling）把照片做成地震动画，再通过二维转立体步骤变成空间视频，在头显中与真实房间对齐。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a corner of the classroom, generate a 5-second 'what if the shelves fell' video with an image-to-video tool, and play it in AR aligned to the real corner. Twist: students redesign the corner and generate again to see if it is safer.
works.exercise_zh: 拍下教室一角，用图生视频工具生成 5 秒的“如果书架倒下”视频，在 AR 中对齐真实角落播放。变体：学生重新布置这个角落，再生成一次看是否更安全。

video.video_title: 地震発災想定動画を写真1枚から生成AIで作成し、空間ビデオ化してApple Vision Proで現実空間に重ねて表示した例です。天井パネル落下の度合いを調整しました。巻き戻しやスローモーションもできます。 https://t.co/4CdoASYEkt

works.title: Grace for the World: the Sistine Chapel in drones
works.description: Above St. Peter's Square, 3,000 drones recreate images from Michelangelo's Sistine Chapel ceiling, including the hands of God and Adam, during the Grace for the World concert.
works.description_zh: 在圣彼得广场上空，3000 架无人机在“Grace for the World”音乐会上重现了米开朗基罗西斯廷礼拜堂天顶画中的图像，包括上帝与亚当的双手。
works.idea_en: Moving a ceiling painting into the open sky turns a private indoor view into a public one; AR can release images from inside buildings and show them outside.
works.idea_zh: 把天顶画搬到露天的天空，就把室内的私密观看变成了公共观看；AR 也可以把建筑内部的图像释放出来，展示在建筑外面。
works.technique: Artwork is converted into 3D point formations and flown by thousands of synchronised light drones with precise positioning and timed colour changes.
works.technique_zh: 把画作转换成三维点阵，由数千架同步的灯光无人机借助精确定位和定时换色飞出来。
works.exercise_en: Take a famous painting from inside a campus building and 'release' it in AR as a drone-point image hovering above the building's roof, with the two hands meeting last. Twist: the image assembles only when viewers stand where the original hangs inside.
works.exercise_zh: 把校园某栋楼里一幅著名画作用 AR“释放”出来，变成悬在楼顶上空的无人机点阵图像，最后才让两只手相遇。变体：只有观众站在原画所在位置的正下方时，图像才会拼合出来。

video.video_title: Vatican - Behind The Scenes - 3,000 Drones Recreate Michelangelo's Sistine Chapel - A Nova Sky Story

works.title: Growing
works.description: A 55-metre-wide projection shows invasive species spreading across a landscape. Real-time tracking detects people and boats, and the growth reacts to them.
works.description_zh: 一幅 55 米宽的投影展示入侵物种在大地上蔓延。实时追踪系统识别出人和船只，生长的形态随之作出反应。
works.idea_en: Let passers-by feed or disturb a spreading organism.
works.idea_zh: 让路人去喂养或打扰一个正在蔓延的生物。
works.technique: An object-detection model classifies people and boats in a camera feed under infrared light, and their positions steer a generative growth simulation projected across a huge surface.
works.technique_zh: 目标检测模型在红外照明下的摄像画面中识别人和船只，把它们的位置输入生成式生长模拟，再投影到巨大的表面上。
works.exercise_en: Run a YOLO or COCO-SSD detector in the browser on a window view and let each detected person or car seed a growing pattern on screen. Twist: the pattern only grows where nobody has walked for a while.
works.exercise_zh: 在浏览器里用 YOLO 或 COCO-SSD 检测窗外画面，让每个被识别出的人或车在屏幕上播下一个生长图案；变体：图案只在很久没人走过的地方生长。

video.video_title: Growing — real-time tracking (class: person, boat)

works.title: Guided Reality
works.description: LLMs and vision models generate step-by-step AR task guidance that highlights the exact real objects to touch, turning any instruction into visual in-situ help.
works.idea_zh: 大模型自动生成贴在真实物体上的AR操作指引。

video.video_title: [UIST 2025] Guided Reality: Generating Visually-Enriched AR Task Guidance with LLMs and Vision Model

works.technique: An LLM decomposes an instruction into steps, and a vision-language or detection model grounds each step to the relevant objects in the camera view, whose image locations are highlighted in MR.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍下桌面，把照片和一条任务指令（“冲一杯手冲咖啡”）发给多模态大模型，要求返回每一步对应物体的框坐标，并在画面中依次高亮；变体：让系统在你做错时给出提示，而不只是给步骤。
works.description_zh: 大语言模型和视觉模型生成分步骤的 AR 任务指引，高亮出需要触碰的具体真实物体，把任何一条指令都变成现场可见的视觉帮助。
works.idea_en: An LLM automatically generates AR instructions pinned to the real objects you need to handle.
works.technique_zh: 大语言模型把一条指令拆解为若干步骤，再由视觉语言模型或检测模型把每一步对应到相机画面中的相关物体，并在混合现实中高亮这些物体在图像中的位置。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a tabletop with a phone and send the photo plus a task instruction ('make a cup of pour-over coffee') to a multimodal LLM, asking it to return box coordinates for the object in each step, then highlight them one by one on screen. Twist: have the system give a hint when you make a mistake instead of only listing steps.

works.title: Halo and Noa: glasses that remember what you forgot
works.description: While running errands, Halo glasses with the Noa assistant remind the wearer of the small things they meant to buy, drawing on what it heard and saw earlier.
works.description_zh: 跑腿时，搭载 Noa 助手的 Halo 眼镜根据之前听到和看到的内容，提醒佩戴者那些原本打算买的小东西。
works.idea_en: Glasses as a memory that notices what slipped through the cracks.
works.idea_zh: 眼镜成为一份记忆，能注意到你遗漏的事情。
works.technique: Noa keeps a searchable memory of past conversations and views, and matches it against the current location or scene to trigger a reminder.
works.technique_zh: Noa 维护一份可检索的对话与画面记忆，并与当前位置或场景匹配，从而触发提醒。
works.exercise_en: Keep a spoken shopping list in a notes app, then use phone geolocation to show the relevant item as floating AR text when you enter a shop. Twist: the reminder only appears if you are looking at the right shelf.
works.exercise_zh: 在笔记应用里口述一张购物清单，用手机定位在你走进商店时，把相关条目作为漂浮 AR 文字显示出来。变体：只有当你看向正确货架时，提醒才出现。

video.video_title: Halo and Noa | what did I need from the store?

works.title: Hand-tracking watercolor
works.description: Moving your hands in front of a webcam leaves blooming watercolor strokes that bleed and dry over the live image.
works.idea_zh: 在空中挥手，就在画面上晕开水彩。

video.video_title: New TouchDesigner tutorial on creating a hand tracking watercolor effect is live! #mediapipe #touchdesigner https://t.co/G6QZdRwwhj

works.technique: Fingertip positions inject color into a feedback/diffusion shader that simulates pigment spreading and edge darkening.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 反馈缓冲区 + MediaPipe 指尖做空中水彩；加一个变化：握拳时颜料'干掉'固定下来。
works.description_zh: 在网络摄像头前挥动双手，实时画面上就会留下不断晕开的水彩笔触，它们会渗开，也会慢慢变干。
works.idea_en: Wave your hands in the air and watercolor blooms across the picture.
works.technique_zh: 指尖位置把颜色注入一个反馈/扩散着色器，模拟颜料的扩散和边缘加深效果。
works.exercise_en: Make mid-air watercolor with a p5.js feedback buffer and MediaPipe fingertip tracking. Twist: when you make a fist, the paint 'dries' and stays fixed.

works.title: Hands-free Gemini assistant with Vision Pro camera access
works.description: Using Vision Pro camera access, Gemini 2.0 Flash sees what the wearer sees and answers spoken questions in real time without any hands.
works.description_zh: 借助 Vision Pro 的摄像头权限，Gemini 2.0 Flash 看到佩戴者所见，实时回答语音提问，全程无需动手。
works.idea_en: An assistant that shares your point of view instead of waiting for a photo.
works.idea_zh: 一个与你共享视角的助手，而不是等你拍照上传。
works.technique: Main-camera frames and microphone audio are streamed to the Gemini Live (multimodal realtime) API, and responses are spoken and shown as floating text.
works.technique_zh: 把主摄像头画面和麦克风音频流式发送到 Gemini Live（多模态实时）接口，回答以语音和漂浮文字呈现。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone in a headset viewer with a free multimodal live API to build 'ask what you see'; test it on a bookshelf or a fridge. Twist: give the assistant a persona that only speaks in questions.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机放进头戴式支架，用免费的多模态实时接口做一个“看到什么就问什么”的应用，在书架或冰箱前测试。变体：给助手设定一个只用问句说话的角色。

video.video_title:
With camera access on Apple Vision Pro, the possibilities are endless! In this POC, I combined Gemini 2.0 Flash with XR to create a realtime hands-free experience.

💡 It sees what you see, responds to

works.title: Huk, the Jaguaress
works.description: An interactive installation where Huk, a digital jaguar deity, watches visitors through a robotic camera, senses them and speaks back, generating short films in real time about the burning of the Amazon.
works.description_zh: 一件互动装置：数字美洲豹女神 Huk 通过机器人摄像头注视观众、感知他们并开口回应，实时生成关于亚马逊大火的短片。
works.idea_en: A film that looks at you, judges you and answers.
works.idea_zh: 一部会看着你、评判你并回答你的电影。
works.technique: Five AI systems are chained together: computer vision on a robotic camera, sensors and emotion analysis feed a language model and real-time voice and image generation that cut the film live.
works.technique_zh: 五个 AI 系统串联：机器人摄像头上的计算机视觉、传感器和情绪分析输入语言模型，再由实时语音与图像生成即时剪出影片。
works.exercise_en: Build a webcam 'creature' that detects when a face appears and responds with one of five recorded lines based on how long the person stays. Twist: it forgets everyone after ten seconds, so returning visitors are greeted as strangers.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个摄像头“生物”：检测到人脸就根据对方停留的时长，从五句预录台词中选一句回应；变体：它十秒后就会忘记所有人，回来的观众会被当作陌生人。

video.video_title: The Making of Huk

works.title: I/O Brush re-creation (Genuary)
works.description: Re-creating MIT Tangible Media's I/O Brush, a webcam-tracked hand 'picks up' colors and textures from real objects and paints with them on screen.
works.idea_zh: 用手从现实里'蘸取'颜色和纹理，再拿来画画。

video.video_title:
Genuary Day 2 Prompt: Layers upon layers upon layers.
 I wanted to re-create the I/O brush from the Tangible Media Group at the Media Lab for this experiment. It’s pretty wild that it’s possible to cr

works.technique: MediaPipe hand tracking finds the fingertip, samples the camera pixels under it as the brush, then paints strokes into a feedback canvas.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js + MediaPipe Hands，让指尖碰到真实物体时吸取它的颜色，再在空中画画；加一个变化：吸取的是一小段动态视频而不是颜色。
works.description_zh: 复刻 MIT Tangible Media 小组的 I/O Brush：被网络摄像头追踪的手从真实物体上“蘸取”颜色和纹理，再用它们在屏幕上作画。
works.idea_en: Dip your hand into reality to pick up colors and textures, then paint with them.
works.technique_zh: MediaPipe 手部追踪找到指尖，把指尖下方的相机像素采样作为笔刷，再把笔触画进一个反馈画布。
works.exercise_en: Use p5.js and MediaPipe Hands so that touching a real object with your fingertip picks up its color, then paint in the air with it. Twist: pick up a short clip of live video instead of a color.

salient.why_en: Dip your hand into the real world to pick up its color and texture, then paint with it.
salient.why_zh: 把手伸进现实里蘸一下颜色和质感，再拿它来作画。

works.title: If My Apple Can Talk
works.description: A mixed-reality study that turns everyday objects such as an apple, a cup or a book into personalized AI agents, exploring how an object's shape, material and use can shape the agent's look, voice and personality.
works.description_zh: 一项混合现实研究：把苹果、杯子、书本等日常物品变成个性化 AI 智能体，探讨物品的形态、材质和用途如何塑造智能体的外观、声音与性格。
works.idea_en: An object's physical traits become the design brief for its AI personality.
works.idea_zh: 物体的物理特征，就是它 AI 性格的设计说明书。
works.technique: A formative study produced design dimensions for object agents; the mixed-reality prototype likely combines object recognition, an LLM persona and expressive virtual features anchored to the real object.
works.technique_zh: 通过前期研究得出物品智能体的设计维度；混合现实原型可能结合了物体识别、大语言模型人设以及锚定在真实物体上的表情化虚拟特征。
works.exercise_en: Choose one object and write its persona from four traits (shape, material, function and age), build a phone AR character on it with an LLM voice, and compare it with a classmate's persona for the same object. Twist: let the persona change as the object is used up, like an apple being eaten or a candle burning down.
works.exercise_zh: 选一件物品，从形状、材质、用途和“年龄”四个特征写出它的人设，在手机 AR 里给它做一个接入大模型语音的角色，再与同学为同一物品写的人设作比较。变体：让人设随着物品被消耗而改变，比如被吃掉的苹果、越烧越短的蜡烛。

video.video_title: "If My Apple Can Talk": Exploring the use of everyday objects as personalized AI agents in MR

works.title: ImaginateAR
works.description: A mobile outdoor AR authoring tool, made by Jaewook Lee with Niantic Spatial: say a scene such as 'a dragon enjoying a campfire' and AI generates the 3D assets and arranges them in the real park or street, ready to be adjusted by hand.
works.description_zh: 一个户外手机 AR 创作工具，由 Jaewook Lee 与 Niantic Spatial 合作完成：说出一个场景，比如“一条在篝火旁惬意休息的龙”，AI 就生成三维素材并把它们摆进真实的公园或街道，你还能再用手调整。
works.idea_en: Speak a story into the place where you stand and let AI build it there.
works.idea_zh: 站在一个地方把故事说出来，让 AI 当场把它搭起来。
works.technique: An offline scene-understanding pipeline builds an outdoor scene graph, an LLM plans which objects to create and where, and a fast text-to-3D generator produces assets that are placed on detected surfaces.
works.technique_zh: 离线场景理解流程构建户外场景图，大语言模型规划要生成哪些物体、放在哪里，再用快速的文本生成三维方法制作素材，放到检测到的表面上。
works.exercise_en: Prototype 'say it, place it' in Lens Studio or AR Foundation: send a spoken phrase to an LLM that returns a JSON list of objects and positions, map each object to a free 3D model (or a text-to-3D API such as Meshy) and place it on detected ground planes. Twist: photograph the site first and ask the LLM to build its story around what is already there.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation 里实现“说出来就摆出来”：把语音短语发给大语言模型，让它返回包含物体与位置的 JSON 列表，将每个物体对应到免费三维模型（或 Meshy 等文本生成三维 API），再放到检测到的地面上。变体：先给现场拍照，要求大模型围绕现场已有的东西来编故事。

video.video_title: ImaginateAR: AI-Assisted In-Situ Authoring in Augmented Reality [UIST 2025]

works.title: InSituTale
works.description: Physical objects on a table act as tangible handles for augmented data stories: moving and arranging objects drives AR charts and narration.
works.idea_zh: 用桌上的实物摆放来驱动AR数据故事的讲述。

video.video_title: [UIST 2025] InSituTale: Enhancing Augmented Data Storytelling with Physical Objects

works.technique: Tabletop objects are tracked by the camera (markers or object detection), and their positions and arrangement are mapped to parameters of AR charts and narration segments, making physical layout the story controller.
works.exercise_zh: 给 3 个杯子贴上 ArUco 或图像标记，用手机 AR 追踪它们的位置，把杯子间的距离映射成柱状图的高度或一段数据故事的播放进度；变体：用这些实体讲一个关于你自己作息或消费的数据故事。
works.description_zh: 桌上的实体物件成为增强数据故事的可触摸“把手”：移动和摆放这些物件，就能驱动 AR 图表和旁白叙述。
works.idea_en: Arranging real objects on a table drives how an AR data story unfolds.
works.technique_zh: 相机追踪桌面上的物体（通过标记或物体检测），并把它们的位置和排布映射为 AR 图表的参数和旁白片段，让实体布局成为讲述故事的控制器。
works.exercise_en: Put ArUco or image markers on three cups, track their positions with phone AR, and map the distances between cups to bar heights or to the playback progress of a data story. Twist: use these objects to tell a data story about your own daily routine or spending.

works.title: Inside[JOB]
works.description: JobBot leaps into your real room on Android XR; you fix quirky system settings, 'phish' for data and stream updates in playful hand-tracked mini-jobs across MR and VR.
works.idea_zh: JobBot机器人闯进你的真实房间，用双手完成搞笑的小工作。

video.video_title: Inside[JOB] Gameplay Trailer - 4K

works.technique: Uses high-fidelity hand tracking with physics-based grabbing so every virtual prop can be poked, pulled and thrown in passthrough space.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR手势识别做三个“荒诞小工作”（捏住虚拟插头插到真实插座旁、拍打故障屏幕等）；变化：每个任务只能用一只手完成。
works.description_zh: 在 Android XR 上，JobBot 跳进你的真实房间：你要修理古怪的系统设置、“钓鱼”获取数据、推送更新，在混合现实和虚拟现实之间完成一个个好玩的手部追踪小工作。
works.idea_en: The JobBot robot bursts into your real room and has you finish silly little jobs with your bare hands.
works.technique_zh: 采用高精度手部追踪和基于物理的抓取，让每一件虚拟道具都能在透视空间中被戳、拉、扔。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR gesture recognition to make three 'absurd little jobs' (pinching a virtual plug and plugging it in next to a real socket, slapping a glitching screen, and so on). Twist: each task can be done with one hand only.

works.title: La Tournoyante x Gamgie
works.description: In an improvised session with the circus company La Tournoyante, acrobats spin and move on a theatre stage while projected particle fields follow, swirl around and react to their bodies in real time.
works.description_zh: 在与马戏团 La Tournoyante 的即兴排练中，杂技演员在剧场舞台上旋转、移动，投影出的粒子场实时追随他们，在身体周围旋绕、回应。
works.idea_en: Projected particles that dance with acrobats as a live partner.
works.idea_zh: 投影粒子像现场搭档一样与杂技演员共舞。
works.technique: Augmenta LiDAR tracking sends performers' positions to the Oxipital particle engine (Unity/TouchDesigner), which Gamgie plays live like an instrument.
works.technique_zh: Augmenta 激光雷达追踪把演员的位置传给 Oxipital 粒子引擎（Unity/TouchDesigner），由 Gamgie 像演奏乐器一样现场操控。
works.exercise_en: Track one dancer from above with a webcam or Kinect in TouchDesigner and project particles that swirl around their position on the floor. Twist: the particles slowly remember and redraw the dancer's path.
works.exercise_zh: 在 TouchDesigner 中用俯拍摄像头或 Kinect 追踪一名舞者，把粒子投影到地面并围绕其位置旋转。变体：粒子慢慢记住并重绘舞者走过的路线。

video.video_title: La tournoyante X Gamgie

works.title: Lasertag
works.description: A mixed-reality laser tag game that scans your space and turns it into an arena for friends in the same room; beams stop at real walls and furniture.
works.idea_zh: 把任何空间变成同场多人激光枪战场，光束会被真实墙体遮挡。

video.video_title: Lasertag for Meta Quest - v2 update trailer

works.technique: The Depth API provides real-time depth, so laser raycasts are truncated at the reconstructed surfaces and real walls and furniture block shots.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 遮挡（深度）让 AR 光束在真实物体处被截断，做一个躲在柜子后面的对战原型；变体：被打中的真实表面留下持续几秒的光斑。
works.description_zh: 一款混合现实激光枪战游戏：它扫描你所在的空间，把它变成同一房间内朋友们的竞技场；光束会被真实的墙壁和家具挡住。
works.idea_en: Turn any space into a same-room multiplayer laser-tag arena where real walls block the beams.
works.technique_zh: Depth API 提供实时深度，激光射线在重建出的表面处被截断，因此真实的墙壁和家具会挡住射击。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation occlusion (depth) so that AR beams are cut off at real objects, and build a prototype where players duel from behind a cabinet. Twist: real surfaces that get hit keep a glowing spot for a few seconds.

works.title: Lasertag: synced room scanning
works.description: Demo of multiple Quest headsets building one shared depth reconstruction of a room in real time, so all players fight inside the same scanned geometry.
works.idea_zh: 多台头显实时同步扫描出同一个房间模型。

video.video_title: Meta Quest Lasertag - v2 synced room scanning demo

works.technique: Each headset fuses depth frames into a shared voxel or mesh reconstruction in a common anchor frame, and updates are merged over the network so all players see the same geometry.
works.exercise_zh: 两台带 LiDAR 的 iPhone 分别扫描房间的一半，通过共同的图像标记对齐后合成一个网格；变体：把扫描到的网格用两种颜色标出是谁扫的。
works.description_zh: 演示多台 Quest 头显实时共同构建同一个房间的深度重建，让所有玩家都在同一套扫描几何体中对战。
works.idea_en: Several headsets scan the same room together in real time, building one shared model.
works.technique_zh: 每台头显把深度帧融合进位于共同锚点坐标系中的共享体素或网格重建，更新通过网络合并，使所有玩家看到相同的几何体。
works.exercise_en: Have two LiDAR iPhones each scan half of a room, align them with a shared image marker, and merge the results into one mesh. Twist: color the scanned mesh in two colors to show who scanned which part.

works.title: Life Stories × World Labs: Night Lake
works.description: A true memory collected by Liquid City's AI interviewer is turned by their AI engine into descriptions, then images, and finally an explorable 3D Gaussian-splat world made with World Labs' Marble.
works.description_zh: Liquid City 的 AI 访谈员收集到一段真实回忆，他们的 AI 引擎把它依次变成文字描述、图像，最后用 World Labs 的 Marble 生成可以探索的三维高斯泼溅世界。
works.idea_en: A spoken memory becomes a place other people can walk through.
works.idea_zh: 一段口述回忆，变成别人可以走进去的地方。
works.technique: An LLM pipeline rewrites the interview into scene descriptions, an image model renders them, and a world model (Marble) lifts the images into navigable splats.
works.technique_zh: 大语言模型流水线把访谈改写成场景描述，图像模型渲染成图，再由世界模型（Marble）把图像提升为可漫游的泼溅场景。
works.exercise_en: Interview a classmate for two minutes about a place they miss, turn the transcript into a scene prompt, generate an image and then a 3D world, and view it in WebXR together. Twist: the interviewee must guide the others through it without seeing it first.
works.exercise_zh: 花两分钟采访同学一个他想念的地方，把文字稿改成场景提示，先生成图像再生成三维世界，一起用 WebXR 观看。变体：受访者在自己没看过的情况下为大家导览。

video.video_title: Life Stories * World Labs - Night Lake by Rod Mill

works.title: LightGridShader: LED display look
works.description: Images and animations are shown as if on a giant LED screen, with visible diodes glowing and bleeding into soft bokeh.
works.description_zh: 图像和动画像显示在巨大的 LED 屏上，能看到一颗颗发光二极管，并晕开成柔和光斑。
works.idea_en: Imitate a physical display's structure to make screens feel real.
works.idea_zh: 模仿实体屏幕的结构，让画面更真实。
works.technique: A Shader Graph quantizes UVs into a grid, samples the source per cell and draws each cell as an emissive dot, combined with MiniBokeh blur.
works.technique_zh: Shader Graph 把 UV 量化成网格，每格采样一次源图，把每格画成自发光点，再结合 MiniBokeh 虚化。
works.exercise_en: Place a virtual LED billboard on a real building facade in AR Foundation that shows the phone camera feed. Twist: the LEDs flicker off where people's shadows fall.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在真实建筑外墙上放一块虚拟 LED 广告屏，显示手机相机画面。变体：有人影落下的地方 LED 熄灭。

video.video_title: LED display shader + MiniBokeh https://t.co/Zgi8Hx9z1T https://t.co/17WWtHs5gY

works.title: Live caption glasses for the Deaf and hard of hearing
works.description: AugmentOS shows fast, free live captions of the people around you on several brands of display glasses, so Deaf and hard-of-hearing wearers can follow speech while looking at the speaker.
works.description_zh: AugmentOS 在多个品牌的显示眼镜上免费提供快速的实时字幕，让聋人和听障佩戴者在看着说话者的同时读懂对方的话。
works.idea_en: Subtitles for real life, placed where you are already looking.
works.idea_zh: 给现实生活加字幕，放在你本来就在看的地方。
works.technique: Streaming speech recognition runs on the phone or cloud and pushes rolling text to the glasses' micro-display with low latency.
works.technique_zh: 在手机或云端运行流式语音识别，把滚动文字低延迟推送到眼镜微显示屏。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone web page with live speech-to-text shown as large captions in a headset viewer, and test it in a noisy café. Twist: colour each speaker's words differently using voice direction.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机网页，把实时语音转文字以大字字幕显示在头戴支架里，在嘈杂咖啡馆测试。变体：根据声音方向给每个说话者的字上不同颜色。

video.video_title: Smart Caption Glasses for the Deaf - AugmentOS

salient.why_en: Subtitles for real life, floating next to the person who is speaking.
salient.why_zh: 给现实生活加字幕，字幕就浮在说话的人旁边。

works.title: Location-triggered AR scene
works.description: An older location-based AR experience: arrive at the spot, open the experience, and the scene comes to life in place.
works.idea_zh: 走到特定地点，AR 故事才会出现。

video.video_title:
A quick visual example of what I mean—this is from an older AR experience I built. 

You’d arrive at the location, open the app, launch the specific experience, and see it come to life. On your phone

works.technique: A location check (GPS geofence or VPS localization) gates the experience, and once the device is localized the scene is instantiated at a fixed real-world pose.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里选一个地点，用 GPS 距离判断是否到达，到达后才在 AR 中出现一个角色；变体：只有两个人同时在场时角色才会出现。
works.description_zh: 一个较早的基于位置的 AR 体验：走到指定地点、打开体验，场景就在原地活了过来。
works.idea_en: The AR story only appears once you walk to a particular place.
works.technique_zh: 通过位置判断（GPS 地理围栏或 VPS 定位）控制体验的开启；设备完成定位后，场景在一个固定的真实世界位姿处实例化。
works.exercise_en: Pick a spot on campus, use GPS distance to check whether someone has arrived, and only then make a character appear in AR. Twist: the character appears only when two people are there at the same time.

works.title: Lucida
works.description: Rooms sculpted from curtains of light that ripple, bend and seem to solidify into planes as visitors reach into them.
works.description_zh: 由光幕塑造的房间，观众伸手进去时，光会泛起涟漪、弯曲，仿佛凝固成一个个平面。
works.idea_en: Make light feel like a material you can touch and shape.
works.idea_zh: 让光变成一种可以触摸和塑形的材料。
works.technique: Likely projected light passed through water optics and haze, with sound and movement modulating the ripples, so the beams read as physical sheets.
works.technique_zh: 可能让投射光穿过水面光学结构和雾气，并用声音和动作调制波纹，使光束看起来像实体的薄片。
works.exercise_en: In a hazy dark room, shine a projector through a shallow tray of water and film how hand movements and a speaker under the tray change the light sheet. Twist: map a hand-tracking signal to the speaker so gestures 'play' the light.
works.exercise_zh: 在有雾的暗房里，让投影光穿过一个浅水盘，拍下手部动作和水盘下的扬声器如何改变光幕；变体：把手部追踪信号映射到扬声器上，让手势来“演奏”光。

video.video_title: Lucida, 2025

works.title: Meta Ray-Ban Display live demo (Connect 2025)
works.description: At Connect 2025, Mark Zuckerberg demonstrates Meta Ray-Ban Display glasses with a small in-lens display and an EMG wristband: live AI answers, translation, messages and navigation appear in view, controlled by tiny finger gestures.
works.description_zh: 在 Connect 2025 上，扎克伯格演示了 Meta Ray-Ban Display 眼镜：镜片内的小显示屏配合肌电腕带，AI 回答、翻译、消息和导航都出现在视野里，用细微手指动作控制。
works.idea_en: An AI assistant you see, not just hear, answering in the corner of your eye.
works.idea_zh: 一个不仅能听、还能看到的 AI 助手，在你眼角给出回答。
works.technique: A monocular waveguide display shows Meta AI responses grounded in the glasses' camera and microphone, while a surface-EMG wristband decodes finger gestures as input.
works.technique_zh: 单眼光波导显示屏呈现基于眼镜摄像头和麦克风的 Meta AI 回答，表面肌电腕带把手指动作解码为输入。
works.exercise_en: Prototype a 'corner of the eye' assistant: a phone in a headset viewer shows one line of AI answer in the top corner while the camera stays live, and one keyboard key acts as the pinch. Twist: limit every answer to five words.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个“眼角助手”原型：把手机放进头戴支架，摄像头画面保持实时，右上角只显示一行 AI 回答，用一个按键代替捏合手势。变体：每个回答限制在五个词以内。

video.video_title: Meet the World's Most Advanced AI Glasses | Meta Ray-Ban Display @ Connect 2025

works.title: Midjourney → splat → AR
works.description: A generated image turned into an 8 MB Gaussian splat and viewed in web AR.
works.idea_zh: 从一张 AI 图片到可以站进去的 AR 场景。

video.video_title:
Building on this workflow:

-> Midjourney 
-> Gaussian Splat  
-> Augmented Reality

All running on the web, not the best fps in AR but still pretty mind-bending. Exported splat as .spz 8mb i

works.technique: An AI image is lifted into a Gaussian splat by an image-to-3D pipeline, then compressed and rendered in a WebAR splat viewer on a hit-tested surface.
works.exercise_zh: 用文生图工具生成一张场景图，再转成 3D 放进手机 AR，比较生成前后的构图差异；变体：让全班用同一个提示词，把结果摆成一条 AR 画廊。
works.description_zh: 一张生成的图像被转换成 8 MB 的高斯点场景，并在网页 AR 中查看。
works.idea_en: Go from one AI image to an AR scene you can stand inside.
works.technique_zh: 通过图生 3D 流程把一张 AI 图像提升为高斯点场景，经过压缩后，在 WebAR 高斯点查看器中渲染到命中测试得到的表面上。
works.exercise_en: Generate a scene image with a text-to-image tool, convert it to 3D and place it in phone AR, then compare how the composition changed. Twist: have the whole class use the same prompt and line the results up as an AR gallery.

works.title: MiniBokeh: lightweight depth of field
works.description: Scenes with small bright lights get soft, round bokeh blur in the background, cheap enough for mobile and web.
works.description_zh: 带有小亮光的场景在背景中出现柔和的圆形光斑虚化，开销低到可以在手机和网页上运行。
works.idea_en: A cheap bokeh makes a scene feel photographed.
works.idea_zh: 便宜的散景虚化，让画面像被拍出来的。
works.technique: Instead of a depth texture, the effect assumes one reference plane and applies a separable circular blur whose size grows with distance from that plane.
works.technique_zh: 不读深度贴图，而是假设一个参考平面，按与该平面的距离使用可分离圆形模糊。
works.exercise_en: Add a bokeh blur to virtual lights in an AR Foundation scene so they match the phone camera's real blur. Twist: focus follows the nearest face.
works.exercise_zh: 给 AR Foundation 场景中的虚拟灯光加散景虚化，让它们与手机相机的真实虚化一致。变体：焦点跟随最近的人脸。

video.video_title: Adding more test scenes to the MiniBokeh repository — a lightweight DoF for URP. https://t.co/WlTTBXsAPo https://t.co/XK90Af0e3P

works.title: MiniMates
works.description: Remote meeting participants appear as miniature avatars that fit on your desk, so AR meetings work even in small physical spaces.
works.idea_zh: 把远程会议的人缩成桌上的小人，小房间也能开AR会议。

video.video_title: MiniMates: Miniature Avatars for AR Remote Meetings within Limited Physical Spaces

works.technique: Remote participants are represented as scaled-down avatars, and a layout algorithm fits them onto available tabletop area while retargeting their gaze and pointing toward the corresponding local objects.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中检测桌面，把三位远程同学的视频头像放在迷你化身上并排布在桌上，头像朝向正在说话的人；变体：让化身的大小随发言时长或音量变化。
works.description_zh: 远程会议的参与者以迷你化身的形式出现在你的桌面上，即使物理空间很小，AR 会议也能进行。
works.idea_en: Shrink remote colleagues into tiny figures on your desk, so even a small room can host an AR meeting.
works.technique_zh: 远程参与者以缩小的化身呈现，布局算法把他们安排在可用的桌面区域内，同时对他们的视线和指向进行重定向，使其对准本地对应的物体。
works.exercise_en: Detect a tabletop in AR Foundation, put the video faces of three remote classmates on mini avatars arranged across the table, and turn the faces toward whoever is speaking. Twist: make each avatar's size change with how long or how loudly that person speaks.

works.title: Mixed Reality + Diffusion with the Quest Passthrough Camera API
works.description: A mixed-reality prototype reads the Quest passthrough camera and replaces parts of the room with diffusion-generated imagery that stays in place as the wearer looks around.
works.description_zh: 一个混合现实原型读取 Quest 透视摄像头画面，把房间的部分区域替换成扩散模型生成的图像，佩戴者转头时图像仍留在原位。
works.idea_en: Paint over the real room with a prompt, from inside the headset.
works.idea_zh: 在头显里，用一句提示词把真实房间重新画一遍。
works.technique: Passthrough camera frames are sent to a fast diffusion model (image-to-image), and the generated images are re-projected onto the room surfaces from the capture pose.
works.technique_zh: 把透视摄像头帧送入快速扩散模型做图生图，再按拍摄时的位姿把生成图像重新投射到房间表面上。
works.exercise_en: Capture a photo of a wall in phone AR, restyle it with a fast image-to-image model and paste it back as a textured plane on the same wall. Twist: restyle the wall only where your hand shines a virtual flashlight.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中拍一面墙，用快速图生图模型重绘，再作为贴图平面贴回同一面墙。变体：只重绘你手中“虚拟手电筒”照到的地方。

video.video_title: Just updated my MR + Diffusion prototype to use @MetaQuestVR  Meta’s Passthrough Camera API. It’s a raw port for now; next, I'll focus on UX exploration. It’s now much easier to do a screen recording.

works.title: Mixed Reality Map of San Francisco
works.description: A web app for discovering location-based AR across San Francisco: open it on a phone, tap a pin, and launch the AR on the spot with no download.
works.idea_zh: 一张城市地图，点地图上的针就在原地打开 AR。

video.video_title:
Been working on a side project. A web app to discover location-based AR experiences across San Francisco

Open on your phone, tap a pin, and launch on the spot. No downloads. And AR glasses soon...

S

works.technique: A Mapbox web map lists geotagged AR experiences as pins, and tapping a pin deep-links to a WebAR URL, avoiding app installs.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Mapbox 或 Leaflet 做一张校园地图，每个图钉链接到一个 WebAR 页面；变体：只有走到图钉 50 米内时才解锁链接。
works.description_zh: 一个用来发现旧金山各处基于位置的 AR 作品的网页应用：在手机上打开，点一下图钉，就能在原地启动 AR，无需下载。
works.idea_en: A city map where tapping a pin opens AR right where you stand.
works.technique_zh: 一张 Mapbox 网页地图把带地理标签的 AR 体验列为图钉，点击图钉会深度链接到一个 WebAR 网址，免去安装应用。
works.exercise_en: Make a campus map with Mapbox or Leaflet where each pin links to a WebAR page. Twist: a link unlocks only when you are within 50 meters of its pin.

works.title: Mixed Reality RC Airplane
works.description: An AI-generated model airplane, coded entirely by an LLM, flies around the living room under the player's control and collides with real walls.
works.idea_zh: AI生成的遥控飞机在客厅里飞行，会撞上真实墙壁。

video.video_title: A #MixedReality RC Airplane!

works.technique: Uses the room mesh as colliders and an LLM-written flight script mapping controller input to lift, thrust and roll.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机陀螺仪控制AR中的纸飞机在教室飞行，撞到检测到的墙面就坠落；变化：设置穿过真实门框的“环”作为赛道。
works.description_zh: 一架由 AI 生成、代码完全由大语言模型编写的模型飞机，在玩家操控下绕着客厅飞行，还会撞上真实的墙壁。
works.idea_en: An AI-made RC plane flies around the living room and crashes into real walls.
works.technique_zh: 把房间网格用作碰撞体，并由大语言模型编写飞行脚本，把控制器输入映射为升力、推力和滚转。
works.exercise_en: Use the phone gyroscope to fly an AR paper plane around the classroom, and make it crash when it hits a detected wall. Twist: set up 'rings' through real doorframes to form a race course.

works.title: Monster Hunter Now Palico AR
works.description: In Monster Hunter Now, made with Capcom, the player's Palico cat companion can be placed in AR for photos alongside the monsters hunted in the real world.
works.idea_zh: 把陪伴狩猎的艾露猫放进现实世界合影。

video.video_title: Your Palico is making its AR debut! 🐾 #MHNow #monsterhunternow #PalicoAR #MHNowPhotoClub

works.technique: A companion character is placed on a detected surface in a photo mode with pose presets and camera capture, turning AR into a snapshot tool.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 拍照模式：放置角色、选择姿势、一键截图并保存；变体：截图时自动加一个与当前地点相关的边框。
works.description_zh: 在与 Capcom 合作开发的《Monster Hunter Now》中，玩家可以把自己的伙伴艾露猫放进 AR，和在现实世界中狩猎到的怪物合影。
works.idea_en: Bring your hunting companion, the Palico cat, into the real world for a photo together.
works.technique_zh: 在拍照模式中把伙伴角色放置在检测到的表面上，配合预设姿势和相机截图，让 AR 成为一个快照工具。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR photo mode: place a character, choose a pose, and capture and save a screenshot with one tap. Twist: automatically add a frame related to the current location when the photo is taken.

works.title: Morning stroll into a portal
works.description: Walking through a doorway-sized portal into a World Labs-generated environment.
works.idea_zh: 走进一扇门，门后是 AI 生成的世界。

video.video_title: Morning stroll into a @theworldlabs portal. I picture a future where you describe your environment and it instantly materializes around you. https://t.co/emyC26R1fN

works.technique: A doorway mesh placed on the ground uses a stencil buffer to show a generated environment only through the opening, and a camera-crossing check flips the render so the user ends up inside.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 平面检测放一扇门，门内用 Stencil 渲染一片森林，穿过门后切换为全景环境；变体：让门的另一侧是你小时候住过的地方。
works.description_zh: 穿过一扇门大小的传送门，走进一个由 World Labs 生成的环境。
works.idea_en: Walk through a door into a world generated by AI.
works.technique_zh: 放在地面上的门框网格利用模板缓冲区，只在门洞中显示生成的环境；当相机穿过门框时，检测逻辑会翻转渲染，让用户最终置身其中。
works.exercise_en: Place a door with AR Foundation plane detection, render a forest inside it with a stencil, and switch to a full surrounding environment once the user walks through. Twist: make the other side of the door the place where you lived as a child.

works.title: Myaku Myaku AR
works.description: Point the phone at a vase of flowers and it turns into a wobbling, glossy red-and-blue blob covered in eyes, the look of the Expo 2025 mascot Myaku-Myaku, while the rest of the room stays real.
works.description_zh: 把手机对准一瓶花，它就会变成一团晃动、带光泽、布满眼睛的红蓝色软体，也就是 2025 大阪世博会吉祥物“脉脉”（Myaku-Myaku）的样子，而房间的其他部分保持真实。
works.idea_en: Segment real objects and re-skin them as a character, so the world itself becomes the costume.
works.idea_zh: 把真实物体分割出来，再给它们换上角色的皮肤，让世界本身变成戏服。
works.technique: A YOLO11 segmentation model runs on-device (likely through his own ONNX Runtime plugin for Unity), and the object masks, likely combined with AR depth, are covered by a noisy, glossy blob shader with eyes.
works.technique_zh: YOLO11 分割模型在设备端运行（很可能通过作者自己的 Unity 版 ONNX Runtime 插件），物体遮罩（很可能结合了 AR 深度）上覆盖一层带噪声和光泽、长着眼睛的软体着色器。
works.exercise_en: Run a segmentation model on the AR camera and replace one object class (cups, plants, chairs) with a material of your choice. Twist: make the material react to the object's label, so every class gets its own creature.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 摄像头画面上运行分割模型，把某一类物体（杯子、植物、椅子）替换成你设计的材质。变体：让材质随物体类别变化，每一类都变成不同的生物。

salient.why_en: A vase of flowers turns into a wobbling blob covered in eyes while the rest of the room stays real.
salient.why_zh: 一瓶花变成布满眼睛、晃来晃去的团子，房间其余部分保持原样。

works.title: NARCISSE
works.description: A kinetic light installation where a ceiling of motorised light panels tilts and glows in sequence, and its movements are doubled in a reflective surface below, like a self-regarding light creature.
works.description_zh: 一件动态灯光装置：天花板上的电动灯板依次倾斜、发光，其动作被下方的反射面加倍映出，像一只凝视自己的光之生物。
works.idea_en: Light that watches its own reflection move.
works.idea_zh: 看着自己倒影移动的光。
works.technique: Arrays of servo-driven LED panels are choreographed from a timeline synced to sound, and a mirror-like floor surface reflects them to double the space (reflection setup likely varies per venue).
works.technique_zh: 由伺服电机驱动的 LED 灯板阵列按与声音同步的时间线编排运动，镜面般的地面把它们反射出来，使空间加倍（反射方式很可能因场地而异）。
works.exercise_en: Mount five phone screens on hinges showing white fields, animate their brightness to music and film their reflection in a tray of black water. Twist: film only the reflection and ask viewers which side is real.
works.exercise_zh: 把五块显示白色画面的手机屏装在铰链上，让亮度随音乐变化，并拍摄它们在一盘黑水中的倒影；变体：只拍倒影，让观众猜哪一边才是真的。

video.video_title: NONOTAK - NARCISSE V.4 OFFICIAL

works.title: Niantic Spatial launch + WebAR portal
works.description: Brand and product vision for Niantic Spatial's debut, including a working WebAR portal released with the launch film.
works.idea_zh: 把公司发布会本身做成一个可以走进去的 WebAR 传送门。

video.video_title: Niantic Spatial - AI that understands the physical world

works.technique: A launch-film WebAR portal likely reuses stencil portal rendering on a hit-tested surface, so viewers can open the same world shown in the film on their own phones.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个虚构产品拍一段 30 秒的概念短片，并配一个观众可以打开的 AR 传送门；变体：让传送门里的场景是短片最后一帧的延续。
works.description_zh: 为 Niantic Spatial 首次亮相所做的品牌与产品愿景，其中包括一个随发布影片一同推出、可以实际体验的 WebAR 传送门。
works.idea_en: Turn the company launch itself into a WebAR portal you can walk into.
works.technique_zh: 这个配合发布影片的 WebAR 传送门可能沿用了在命中测试表面上渲染模板传送门的做法，让观众能在自己的手机上打开影片中出现的同一个世界。
works.exercise_en: Shoot a 30-second concept film for a fictional product and pair it with an AR portal viewers can open. Twist: make the scene inside the portal continue from the film's last frame.

works.title: POP AR
works.description: A book of op-art pages; scanning a page with a phone makes the flat geometric artwork rise off the paper as animated 3D sculptures.
works.description_zh: 一本欧普艺术画册；用手机扫描书页，平面的几何作品就会以动态 3D 雕塑的形式从纸上升起。
works.idea_en: Extend op art's optical illusion into a real third dimension with AR.
works.idea_zh: 用 AR 把欧普艺术的视错觉延伸到真正的第三维。
works.technique: Each printed page is an image target; the app anchors animated 3D versions of the same geometric patterns to the page (likely image tracking in a mobile AR SDK).
works.technique_zh: 每一页都是一个图像目标，应用把同一图案的动态 3D 版本锚定在书页上（可能使用移动 AR SDK 的图像追踪）。
works.exercise_en: Draw a black-and-white stripe pattern, use it as an image target in Lens Studio or 8th Wall, and extrude its stripes into moving 3D fins. Twist: the fins flatten back into the print when the phone moves too close.
works.exercise_zh: 画一张黑白条纹图案，在 Lens Studio 或 8th Wall 中作为图像目标，把条纹挤出成会动的 3D 鳍片；变体：手机靠得太近时，鳍片会压回成平面印刷。

video.video_title: POP AR: A Book Where 3D Art Leaps Off the Page

works.title: Passthrough Camera Shaders (QuestCameraKit)
works.description: On Meta Quest 3 the user pinches a slider in the air and a region of the real room seen through passthrough becomes pixelated, one of several camera-image shaders.
works.description_zh: 在 Meta Quest 3 上，用户在空中捏动一个滑块，透视画面中的一块真实房间就变成马赛克，这是几种摄像头画面着色器之一。
works.idea_en: Once the headset camera is readable, the real world can be filtered like a photo, in place.
works.idea_zh: 一旦能读取头显摄像头，现实世界就可以像照片一样被原地加滤镜。
works.technique: The Passthrough Camera API delivers the headset camera image as a texture; the shaders likely reproject it onto world-space quads using the camera pose and intrinsics, then pixelate, blur or recolor it.
works.technique_zh: Passthrough Camera API 以纹理形式提供头显摄像头图像；着色器很可能根据相机位姿和内参把它重投影到世界空间的面片上，再做像素化、模糊或重新调色。
works.exercise_en: Open the camera-shader scene of QuestCameraKit and write a new filter (thermal vision, halftone, edge glow) for a hand-held window. Twist: let two hands define the window's corners.
works.exercise_zh: 打开 QuestCameraKit 的摄像头着色器场景，为一个手持窗口编写新滤镜（热成像、半色调、边缘发光）。变体：用两只手定义窗口的四角。

video.video_title:
Another fun camera shader idea 👾

#MetaQuest3 #MixedReality #Passthrough #MR #XR #MadeWithUnity https://t.co/TxPaAbq8vL

works.title: People I Saw But Never Met
works.description: Over 9,000 small steel silhouettes of people from 20 countries, drawn from photographs of strangers, stand together on the ground in Vila Nova de Cerveira, Portugal.
works.description_zh: 来自 20 个国家、以陌生人照片为原型的 9000 多个小钢制人影站在葡萄牙维拉诺瓦德塞尔维拉的地面上。
works.idea_en: A crowd of strangers at a small scale lets you walk among everyone at once, like an AR visualisation of a population.
works.idea_zh: 一群缩小的陌生人让你一次就能行走在所有人之间，就像人口的 AR 可视化。
works.technique: Silhouettes are traced from photos of passers-by, cut from steel and stood upright in a large grid on the floor.
works.technique_zh: 人影取自路人照片的轮廓，由钢板切割后以大网格直立在地面上。
works.exercise_en: Collect silhouettes of 100 people with body segmentation, turn them into small flat AR figures and stand them on a courtyard floor. Twist: each figure turns toward the visitor who resembles it most in height.
works.exercise_zh: 用人体分割收集 100 个人的剪影，把它们做成小型扁平 AR 人像，立在庭院地面上；变体：每个人像会转向身高与它最接近的访客。

video.video_title: People I Saw But Never Met | Vila Nova de Cerveira Portugal, 2025

works.title: Perceived Weight of Mediated Reality Sticks
works.description: Participants swing a real wooden stick while a headset shows it longer (AR extension), shorter (diminished reality) or with a section cut out of the middle; the longer the stick looks, the lighter it feels, while a stick with a visible gap still feels like one piece.
works.description_zh: 参与者挥动一根真实的木棍，头显里看到的木棍却被加长（AR 延伸）、缩短（削弱现实）或中间被挖掉一截；看起来越长，感觉越轻，而中间有缺口的棍子仍被感觉成一整根。
works.idea_en: Change only how a stick looks, and your hand reports a different weight.
works.idea_zh: 只改变木棍的样子，手感受到的重量就跟着变了。
works.technique: A tracked physical stick is visually lengthened with rendered geometry, or shortened and cut with diminished-reality inpainting, in a video see-through headset; users then judge its weight and centre of gravity by wielding it.
works.technique_zh: 在视频透视头显中，被追踪的真实木棍用渲染的几何体加长，或用削弱现实的图像修补把它变短、挖空，然后让用户挥动它来判断重量和重心。
works.exercise_en: Track a cardboard tube in AR (an image marker on its end) and render virtual extensions of different lengths; have classmates swing it and rank which version feels heaviest. Twist: keep the length but render the tube as a feather or a hammer.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中追踪一根纸筒（在末端贴图像标记），为它渲染不同长度的虚拟延长部分；请同学挥动并排出哪一种最重。变体：不改长度，而把纸筒渲染成羽毛或锤子。

video.video_title: [TVCG2025] Perceived Weight of Mediated Reality Sticks

works.title: Photo to WebAR world in real time
works.description: A single photo becomes a 5 MB Gaussian splat scene that runs in real time as a WebAR experience.
works.idea_zh: 一张照片变成可以走进去的 AR 场景。

video.video_title: real-time WebAR experience + 5MB gaussian splat. Generated this scene from a photo using World Labs. https://t.co/73ro8L1Q57

works.technique: A single photo is converted by an image-to-3D model into a compact splat, which is then loaded in a WebAR viewer and placed on a detected surface.
works.exercise_zh: 拍一张照片用图生 3D 工具转成模型，导入 WebAR 放在桌面上，并对比原照片找出生成错误的部分；变体：故意选一张画作或老照片，看它“立体化”后的样子。
works.description_zh: 一张照片变成一个 5 MB 的高斯点场景，作为 WebAR 体验实时运行。
works.idea_en: A single photo becomes an AR scene you can walk into.
works.technique_zh: 图生 3D 模型把单张照片转换为一个紧凑的高斯点场景，随后在 WebAR 查看器中加载，并放置在检测到的表面上。
works.exercise_en: Take a photo, turn it into a model with an image-to-3D tool, import it into WebAR on a tabletop, and compare it with the original photo to find what the generation got wrong. Twist: pick a painting or an old photo on purpose and see what it looks like in 3D.

works.title: Pigment-based color mixing: fluid art
works.description: A webcam image is swirled into flowing paint where colors mix like real pigments, yellow and blue making green rather than gray.
works.description_zh: 摄像头画面被搅成流动的颜料，颜色像真实颜料一样混合，黄加蓝变成绿色而不是灰色。
works.idea_en: Mix colors the way paint does, not the way light does.
works.idea_zh: 像颜料那样混色，而不是像光那样。
works.technique: Likely spectral.js-style Kubelka-Munk mixing converts colors to spectral reflectance before blending, applied inside a fluid advection shader.
works.technique_zh: 推测使用 spectral.js 风格的 Kubelka-Munk 混色，先把颜色转换为光谱反射率再混合，并在流体平流着色器中使用。
works.exercise_en: Turn the AR Foundation camera feed into pigment paint that swirls where you drag your finger. Twist: freeze the painting onto a real wall as a virtual canvas.
works.exercise_zh: 把 AR Foundation 相机画面变成颜料，手指拖到哪里就在哪里搅动。变体：把画作定格在真实墙面上，成为一块虚拟画布。

video.video_title: Something like fluid art. https://t.co/K5lorJxegw https://t.co/Oq84p5j0ns

works.title: Pinball table in your room (WebXR)
works.description: A web pinball game that also runs in AR on a headset: the table appears in your real space, wired up with about 100 lines of react-three/xr.
works.idea_zh: 把网页弹珠台一键变成摆在你房间里的 AR 版本。
works.technique: The existing three.js scene is wrapped in a WebXR AR session via react-three/xr, with the table anchored to a hit-tested floor or table surface and controller/hand input mapped to flippers.
works.exercise_zh: 把你之前做过的一个网页 3D 小游戏用 WebXR 改成 AR 版，摆在真实桌面上玩；变体：让桌子的真实边缘成为游戏里的墙。

video.video_title:
And of course the pinball table works in AR! Thanks to the amazing @react-three/xr library. Only a 100 lines of code or so to wire it up.

Load it up on your fav headset to play it in your space! http

works.description_zh: 一款网页弹珠台游戏，也能在头显上以 AR 形式运行：球台出现在你的真实空间里，只用了大约 100 行 react-three/xr 代码接入。
works.idea_en: Turn a web pinball table into an AR version sitting in your room with one step.
works.technique_zh: 通过 react-three/xr 把现有的 three.js 场景包进一个 WebXR AR 会话，球台锚定在命中测试得到的地面或桌面上，并把控制器或手部输入映射到挡板上。
works.exercise_en: Convert a small 3D web game you made before into an AR version with WebXR and play it on a real tabletop. Twist: make the real edges of the table act as walls in the game.

works.title: Pose Tracking R&D on the Aston Webb Building
works.description: Pose-tracking tests that use the University of Birmingham's Aston Webb Building as a canvas: people on the ground wave their arms and the projection on the facade reacts to their movement.
works.description_zh: 以伯明翰大学 Aston Webb 大楼为画布的姿态追踪测试：地面上的人挥动手臂，建筑立面上的投影随之做出反应。
works.idea_en: Wave your arms and a whole building moves with you.
works.idea_zh: 挥挥手臂，整栋楼就跟着你动。
works.technique: A camera with real-time pose estimation tracks a person's skeleton, and the joint data drives graphics that are mapped onto the scanned building facade.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头配合实时姿态估计追踪人的骨架，关节数据驱动映射到已扫描建筑立面上的图形。
works.exercise_en: Project onto the school building or a large wall and use MediaPipe pose in TouchDesigner so a student's arm angle opens and closes projected windows. Twist: the facade only reacts when three people strike the same pose.
works.exercise_zh: 把画面投到学校楼体或大墙上，在 TouchDesigner 里用 MediaPipe 姿态识别，让学生手臂的角度打开或关上投影出来的窗户；变体：只有三个人摆出相同姿势时立面才会响应。

video.video_title: Pose Tracking R&D - Aston Webb Building UoB 2025

works.title: ProMemAssist
works.description: Smart glasses that model your working memory in real time and time their help to it: they hold back a reminder while you are juggling numbers and deliver it at a natural break instead of interrupting.
works.description_zh: 一副实时建模你“工作记忆”的智能眼镜，据此决定何时提供帮助：你正在心算一串数字时，它会先按住提醒，等你自然停顿时再说，而不是打断你。
works.idea_en: An assistant that knows not only what to say but when your mind has room for it.
works.idea_zh: 一个不仅知道说什么、还知道你脑子什么时候腾得出空间的助手。
works.technique: Following cognitive theories of working memory, multimodal sensor signals are encoded as memory items subject to displacement and interference, and a timing predictor weighs the value of help against the cost of interruption.
works.technique_zh: 依据工作记忆的认知理论，把多模态传感信号编码为会被替换和干扰的记忆项，再由时机预测器在帮助的价值与打断的代价之间权衡。
works.exercise_en: Prototype an interruption-aware notifier: log what the user is doing (typing speed, speech, head motion from a phone or headset) and queue AI-generated reminders until a simple 'busy score' drops below a threshold. Twist: show queued reminders as small objects piling up in the corner of view.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个懂得“别打扰”的提醒原型：记录用户当前的状态（打字速度、说话、手机或头显检测到的头部运动），把 AI 生成的提醒排队，直到简单的“忙碌分数”低于阈值才弹出。变体：把排队中的提醒显示成视野角落里越堆越高的小物件。

video.video_title: ProMemAssist: Exploring Timely Proactive Assistance Through Working Memory Modeling in Multi-Moda...

works.title: Project Jade - Spatial Agents (Liquid City)
works.description: A spatial AI agent for AR glasses that sees what the wearer sees and responds with embodied, placed UI, shown at Snap Lens Fest 2025.
works.idea_zh: 能看见你所见、在空间中回应你的AI伙伴

video.video_title: Spatial Agents - Project Jade

works.technique: Egocentric camera frames are sent to a multimodal LLM, and responses are rendered as UI panels anchored near the referenced object using world tracking and raycasts.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 原型：拍下当前画面交给视觉语言模型，把回答作为标签钉在画面中对应物体附近；变体：让代理只能用图标和手势回应、不用文字，测试非语言的空间回答是否可理解。
works.description_zh: 一个面向 AR 眼镜的空间 AI 代理，能看到佩戴者所见，并以具身化、放置在空间中的界面作出回应，曾在 2025 年 Snap Lens Fest 上展示。
works.idea_en: An AI companion that sees what you see and answers you out in space.
works.technique_zh: 第一人称相机画面被发送给多模态大语言模型，回复则借助世界追踪和射线检测，渲染为锚定在所指物体附近的界面面板。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR prototype that sends the current view to a vision-language model and pins its answer as a label next to the matching object in the frame. Twist: let the agent reply only with icons and gestures, never text, and test whether nonverbal spatial answers can be understood.

works.title: Protist Reverie
works.description: A one-off live full-dome performance at Athens Digital Arts Festival where their algorithmic slime-mould organism fills the dome and responds in real time to the improvised music of Saber Rider.
works.description_zh: 在 Athens Digital Arts Festival 上的一次性球幕现场演出：他们的算法黏菌生物布满整个穹顶，并实时回应 Saber Rider 的即兴音乐。
works.idea_en: A digital organism lives across the whole dome and breathes with live music.
works.idea_zh: 一个数字生物栖息在整个穹顶上，随现场音乐呼吸。
works.technique: A real-time Physarum-style simulation rendered in fisheye for dome projection takes audio analysis of the live set as input to its growth and colour.
works.technique_zh: 实时的 Physarum 式模拟以鱼眼方式渲染用于球幕投影，并把现场演奏的音频分析作为其生长和色彩的输入。
works.exercise_en: Render an audio-reactive particle sketch in a fisheye projection and project it onto an umbrella or a paper dome that students lie under. Twist: let one student's voice feed the organism while another's starves it.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个音频响应的粒子草图渲染成鱼眼投影，投到学生躺在下面的雨伞或纸穹顶上；变体：让一名学生的声音喂养这个生物，另一名学生的声音让它挨饿。

video.video_title: Uncharted Limbo x Saber Rider – Live AV at ADAF 2025

works.title: QuestCameraKit: passthrough camera with object detection and more
works.description: On the day Quest opened its passthrough cameras, a set of open-source samples showed a colour picker, on-device object detection, QR code tracking, frosted-glass shaders and camera-to-LLM questions.
works.description_zh: 在 Quest 开放透视摄像头当天，一组开源示例展示了取色器、端侧物体检测、二维码追踪、磨砂玻璃着色器，以及把摄像头画面发给大语言模型提问。
works.idea_en: Once the headset camera is open, every AI model becomes a mixed-reality feature.
works.idea_zh: 头显摄像头一旦开放，每一个 AI 模型都能变成混合现实功能。
works.technique: Camera frames from the Passthrough Camera API are fed to Unity Sentis (YOLO) on device or to cloud models, and results are projected into the room with depth.
works.technique_zh: 透视摄像头 API 的画面送入设备端的 Unity Sentis（YOLO）或云端模型，结果结合深度投射到房间中。
works.exercise_en: Clone an open-source camera kit (or use a phone WebAR demo) and change the detector's output: instead of boxes, spawn a small animal on every detected cup. Twist: animals only appear on objects older than you.
works.exercise_zh: 克隆一个开源摄像头工具包（或用手机 WebAR 示例），改写检测器输出：不画框，而是在每个检测到的杯子上生成一只小动物。变体：只有比你年纪大的物品上才出现动物。

video.video_title: Meta Quest Passthrough Camera Access - Color Picker, Object Detection, QR Code, Frosted Glass & more

works.title: Radiance Cascades 2D GI
works.description: Coloured light from glowing shapes spreads, bounces and casts soft shadows across a 2D scene in real time, with lights of any shape.
works.description_zh: 发光形状发出的彩色光在 2D 场景中实时扩散、反弹，并投下柔和的阴影，光源可以是任意形状。
works.idea_en: Compute light the way it really travels, but cheaply, by sharing rays between nearby points.
works.idea_zh: 让光按真实的方式传播，但通过在相邻点之间共享光线来降低成本。
works.technique: Radiance Cascades stores light in several cascades of probes: near cascades are dense with short rays, far ones sparse with long rays; the cascades are merged from far to near to give full 2D global illumination each frame.
works.technique_zh: Radiance Cascades 把光照存放在多层探针里：近处的层探针密、光线短，远处的层探针稀、光线长；每帧从远到近合并各层，得到完整的 2D 全局光照。
works.exercise_en: Project a Radiance Cascades light pass onto a real tabletop in AR, treating paper shapes seen by the camera as occluders. Twist: players place virtual lamps to light a path to a goal.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把 Radiance Cascades 光照投到真实桌面上，把相机看到的纸片形状当作遮挡物。变体：玩家放置虚拟灯，照亮一条通往终点的路。

video.video_title:
Realtime 2D Global Illumination with Radiance Cascades in Unity, Finally done!
The tool is open source and simple to integrate in any project and works with any light shape.
Code here : https://t.co/2

works.title: Ray-Ban Meta safety assistant with a cloud VLM
works.description: Ray-Ban Meta glasses stream video to a vision-language model in the cloud that checks for safety risks, and the glasses speak back and vibrate when something is wrong.
works.description_zh: Ray-Ban Meta 眼镜把视频流式传到云端的视觉语言模型，检查安全隐患；发现问题时，眼镜会语音提醒并振动。
works.idea_en: Glasses that quietly watch for danger and tap you when they see it.
works.idea_zh: 默默帮你留意危险、看到就提醒你的眼镜。
works.technique: Meta's Wearables SDK exposes the camera stream to a phone app, which sends frames to a VLM with a safety prompt and returns spoken and haptic alerts.
works.technique_zh: Meta 的可穿戴 SDK 把摄像头画面开放给手机应用，应用把帧和“安全检查”提示一起发给视觉语言模型，再返回语音和振动提醒。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone web app that sends a camera frame every two seconds to a vision model asking 'is anything unsafe here?' and speaks the answer. Twist: tune it for a specific place, like a kitchen or a workshop.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机网页，每两秒把一帧画面发给视觉模型，问“这里有什么不安全的吗？”，并朗读答案。变体：针对特定场所调整，比如厨房或工作坊。

video.video_title: 😎 Built a tiny POC with Meta’s new Wearables SDK: Ray-Ban Meta glasses stream video, a VLM in the cloud analyzes safety, and the glasses speak back + vibrate. Lots of potential here. https://t.co/Imh4

works.title: Real-time AI video restyling an XR room
works.description: A room seen in XR is repainted by a live video model: first as a 'modern, Ikea style room', then as an 'industrial loft', with updates synced slowly to avoid dizziness.
works.description_zh: XR 里看到的房间被实时视频模型重新绘制：先是“现代宜家风格”，再变成“工业风阁楼”，更新节奏刻意放慢以免头晕。
works.idea_en: Type a style and your room is redecorated around you, live.
works.idea_zh: 输入一种风格，你身边的房间就被实时重新装修。
works.technique: The headset view is streamed to a real-time video-to-video diffusion model driven by a text prompt, and the restyled frames are composited back in XR at a reduced update rate to limit motion sickness.
works.technique_zh: 把头显画面流式送入由文字提示驱动的实时视频扩散模型，再把重绘后的画面降频合成回 XR，以减少晕动。
works.exercise_en: Capture a phone camera feed, send it to a hosted real-time diffusion API with two style prompts, and show the result full-screen in a cardboard or HoloKit viewer. Twist: let the room slowly drift from one style to another as you walk.
works.exercise_zh: 采集手机摄像头画面，发送到在线实时扩散接口，配两个风格提示，在纸盒或 HoloKit 眼镜里全屏显示。变体：随着你走动，房间从一种风格慢慢过渡到另一种。

video.video_title:
What if you could apply real-time AI video to your XR scene? That’s what I tried!

The first prompt was "Modern, Ikea style room", the second "Industrial loft style". To avoid dizziness, it syncs only

works.title: Reality Proxy
works.description: In MR, crowded or distant real objects (books on a high shelf, buildings across a city) are pulled toward you as small abstract proxies that you can select, group and filter with your hands.
works.description_zh: 在 MR 中，拥挤或遥远的真实物体（高处书架上的书、城市另一头的建筑）被拉到你面前，变成小巧的抽象代理物，你可以用手选择、分组和筛选。
works.idea_en: Interact with a stand-in instead of the hard-to-reach real thing.
works.idea_zh: 与替身互动，而不是去够那个难以触及的真实物体。
works.technique: Scene understanding and an AI model segment objects and attach semantic attributes, which are mapped to proxies laid out near the hand while staying linked to the real objects.
works.technique_zh: 场景理解与 AI 模型分割物体并附上语义属性，映射成排布在手边的代理物，同时与真实物体保持关联。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a bookshelf, detect each book spine and show small AR cards of them on the table in front of you; selecting a card highlights the real book. Twist: sort the cards by colour.
works.exercise_zh: 给书架拍照，识别每本书的书脊，并在面前的桌上以小型 AR 卡片显示；选择一张卡片会高亮对应的真书。变体：按颜色排序卡片。

video.video_title: Reality Proxy: Fluid Interactions with Real-World Objects in MR via Abstract Representations

works.title: RealitySummary
works.description: A mixed-reality reading assistant that always sees the page you are reading and, on demand, places summaries, timelines, comparison tables and answers next to the physical document.
works.description_zh: 一个混合现实阅读助手：它一直看着你正在读的纸页，需要时就在实体文档旁边放出摘要、时间线、对比表格和问答结果。
works.idea_en: Printed paper gets an AI sidekick that writes in the margins of space.
works.idea_zh: 纸质文档多了一个 AI 搭档，在空间的“页边”写批注。
works.technique: An always-on headset camera feeds OCR, and an LLM produces summaries and answers that are rendered as spatial visualizations anchored beside the tracked document.
works.technique_zh: 头显常开的摄像头把画面交给 OCR，大语言模型生成摘要与回答，并以空间可视化的形式锚定在被追踪的文档旁。
works.exercise_en: Point a phone at a printed article, run OCR (Apple Vision, Google ML Kit or Tesseract.js), ask an LLM for a three-bullet summary and a timeline, and pin both next to the page with image tracking. Twist: have the AI generate one question you should be able to answer after reading the page.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机对准一篇打印的文章，运行 OCR（Apple Vision、Google ML Kit 或 Tesseract.js），请大模型生成三条要点和一条时间线，再用图像追踪把它们钉在纸页旁边。变体：让 AI 生成一个“读完这页你应该能回答”的问题。

video.video_title: [SUI 2025] RealitySummary: Exploring On-Demand Mixed Reality Text Summarization and Question Answer

works.title: Realtime optical flow glitch machine
works.description: Live video smears and melts in the direction things move, like a datamosh glitch, but computed in real time.
works.description_zh: 实时画面沿物体运动方向涂抹、融化，像数据损坏的故障效果，但完全实时计算。
works.idea_en: Use motion itself to push pixels around.
works.idea_zh: 用运动本身去推动像素。
works.technique: A compute shader estimates optical flow with the Lucas-Kanade method, and a feedback pass displaces the previous frame along the flow vectors to fake datamoshing.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器用 Lucas-Kanade 方法估计光流，反馈通道沿光流向量位移上一帧，模拟数据损坏效果。
works.exercise_en: Apply an optical-flow smear to the AR Foundation camera feed so waving hands drag the room with them. Twist: only a virtual object's area is smeared.
works.exercise_zh: 给 AR Foundation 相机画面加光流涂抹，挥手时会把房间一起拖走。变体：只在虚拟物体覆盖的区域涂抹。

video.video_title:
realtime glitch machine
https://t.co/FAcKCNnXEV https://t.co/g4J9R5csjz

works.title: Redesigned living room, 1.5 MB per splat
works.description: Nano Banana image → World Labs world → WebAR: several living-room redesigns as tiny .spz splats he can switch between in place.
works.idea_zh: 在原地切换多套 AI 生成的客厅设计方案。

video.video_title:
Visualizing my re-designed living room in 3D

Nano banana -> World Labs -> WebAR (threejs)

Each of these gaussian splats are only 1.5 mb in size (.spz file type) https://t.co/E3el0eAMh1

works.technique: Multiple compressed .spz splats share one aligned anchor in the room, and a UI toggle swaps which splat is visible so each redesign appears in the same place.
works.exercise_zh: 为同一个角落准备三种风格的布置模型，共用一个锚点，点击按钮切换；变体：让同学投票选出最喜欢的方案并在 AR 中显示票数。
works.description_zh: Nano Banana 生成图像 → World Labs 生成世界 → WebAR：几套客厅改造方案被做成体积很小的 .spz 高斯点文件，他可以在原地来回切换。
works.idea_en: Switch between several AI-generated living-room designs right where they will go.
works.technique_zh: 多个压缩后的 .spz 高斯点场景共用房间中的同一个对齐锚点，通过界面开关切换显示哪一个，让每套改造方案都出现在同一位置。
works.exercise_en: Prepare layout models in three styles for the same corner, share one anchor among them, and switch between them with a button. Twist: let classmates vote for their favorite and show the vote count in AR.

works.title: Remote object detection with Hugging Face on Spectacles
works.description: A sample lens sends the Spectacles camera view to an object-detection model hosted on Hugging Face and draws labelled boxes on real objects in the wearer's view.
works.description_zh: 一个示例镜头把 Spectacles 的摄像头画面发送到 Hugging Face 上托管的物体检测模型，在佩戴者视野里给真实物体画出带标签的框。
works.idea_en: Borrow any open vision model from the web and see its answers on the world.
works.idea_zh: 从网上借来任意开源视觉模型，把它的答案直接标在世界上。
works.technique: Camera frames are posted to a hosted inference endpoint, and returned bounding boxes are unprojected into 3D using camera intrinsics and depth to anchor labels.
works.technique_zh: 把摄像头帧发送到在线推理端点，返回的边界框结合相机内参和深度反投影到三维，用来锚定标签。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone WebAR page to send a frame to a free Hugging Face detection model and place floating labels at the detected positions using hit tests. Twist: label objects with what they might be thinking instead of their names.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 WebAR 页面把一帧画面发给免费的 Hugging Face 检测模型，并用命中测试在检测位置放置漂浮标签。变体：标签写的不是物体名字，而是它“在想什么”。

video.video_title: Object Detection using Huggingface!

works.title: Replaying a broadcast basketball play on a real court in XR
works.description: From a single 2D TV broadcast, the court and players are detected and tracked, and the play is reconstructed in 3D and mapped onto a real basketball court for viewing in XR.
works.description_zh: 仅凭一段二维电视转播，就检测出球场与球员并跟踪，把这一回合重建成三维，映射到真实篮球场上，在 XR 中观看。
works.idea_en: Watch last night's play happen again on the court you are standing on.
works.idea_zh: 让昨晚的那一回合在你脚下的球场上重演。
works.technique: Court-line (pitch) detection gives a homography from the broadcast to the court plane, player detection and tracking give 2D paths, and these are lifted to 3D avatars placed on the real court.
works.technique_zh: 通过场地线检测求出转播画面到球场平面的单应变换，球员检测与追踪给出二维轨迹，再提升为三维角色放到真实球场上。
works.exercise_en: Download a short sports clip, track the players with a free detection model, map their feet to the floor plane using four court corners, and replay dots on a tabletop court in AR. Twist: let the viewer pause and move one player to test a different play.
works.exercise_zh: 下载一小段比赛视频，用免费检测模型追踪球员，用球场四个角把脚点映射到地面，在 AR 桌面球场上用圆点重放。变体：观众可以暂停并移动一名球员，试试另一种战术。

video.video_title: 🏀 I built this PoC using a single 2D broadcast video: applied pitch detection, player positioning, and movement tracking to reconstruct the play in 3D and map it onto a real basketball court in XR. ht

salient.why_en: Last night's televised play happens again, in 3D, on the court you are standing on.
salient.why_zh: 昨晚电视里的那一球，在你脚下的球场上以 3D 重新打一遍。

works.title: Revisiting Put-That-There
works.description: Bolt's 1980 'put that there' is rebuilt for XR with an LLM: you say 'move that over there' while looking and pointing, and windows rearrange themselves according to context.
works.description_zh: 把 Bolt 1980 年的“把那个放到那里”用大语言模型在 XR 中重新实现：你一边看、一边指，一边说“把那个移到那边”，窗口就会根据情境自动重新排布。
works.idea_en: Speech plus pointing is the oldest multimodal idea, and LLMs finally make its ambiguity solvable.
works.idea_zh: 语音加指向是最古老的多模态想法，而大语言模型终于能解决其中的歧义。
works.technique: Gaze and ray-pointing targets at the moment of each deictic word ('that', 'there') are passed with the transcript and window layout to an LLM, which outputs the layout change.
works.technique_zh: 在说出每个指示词（“那个”“那里”）的瞬间记录注视和射线指向的目标，连同转写文字和窗口布局一起交给大语言模型，由它输出布局变化。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR scene where saying 'that' selects the object at the screen centre and 'there' drops it where you point next. Twist: add 'those' for multiple objects.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 场景：说“那个”时选中屏幕中心的物体，说“那里”时把它放到你接下来指向的位置。变体：加入“那些”来选择多个物体。

video.video_title: Revisiting put-that-there, context aware window interactions via LLMs (ISMAR 2025)

works.title: Rose Wonders (Burning Man)
works.description: At Burning Man 2025 in the Nevada desert, Dambo's biggest sculpture yet, Rose Wonders, is a giant wooden troll figure in the playa, introduced with a poem.
works.description_zh: 在 2025 年内华达沙漠的火人节上，Dambo 迄今最大的雕塑《Rose Wonders》是一个伫立在干湖床上的巨型木制巨魔，并配有一首诗。
works.idea_en: A giant character in an empty desert becomes a gathering point for a temporary city, a model for AR landmarks at festivals.
works.idea_zh: 空旷沙漠中的巨型角色成为一座临时城市的聚集点，是节庆 AR 地标的范本。
works.technique: A large wooden structure of recycled timber was prefabricated and assembled on the playa.
works.technique_zh: 用回收木材制作的大型木结构经预制后在干湖床上组装。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR landmark character for a school festival that everyone can find from any point on the site and that recites a short poem when approached. Twist: add one line to the poem for every visitor.
works.exercise_zh: 为学校活动设计一个 AR 地标角色，场地任何位置都能看到它，靠近时它会朗诵一首短诗；变体：每来一位访客，诗就增加一行。

video.video_title: Rose Wonders at Burning Man 2025 — The Poem

works.title: Rubikon
works.description: An AR tutor for learning the Rubik's Cube: you hold and twist a real cube while the display shows an AR cube set to exactly the tricky state you need to practice, generated from your weak spots.
works.description_zh: 学魔方的 AR 智能导师：你手里转着一只真实魔方，屏幕上的 AR 魔方却被设成你最需要练的那个难点状态，由系统根据你的薄弱环节自动生成。
works.idea_en: Keep the real object in your hands but let AI rewrite its state, so every practice round targets your weak spot.
works.idea_zh: 手里始终是真实的物体，却让 AI 改写它的状态，让每一轮练习都命中你的弱点。
works.technique: The physical cube's moves are tracked and mirrored onto an AR-rendered cube whose starting configuration is generated by an intelligent tutoring model of the learner's skill components.
works.technique_zh: 追踪实体魔方的转动并同步到 AR 渲染的魔方上，AR 魔方的初始状态则由基于学习者技能要素的智能导师模型生成。
works.exercise_en: Pick a physical puzzle (a tangram, a knot, a guitar chord shape) and build a phone AR overlay that shows a target state; log the learner's errors and ask an LLM to choose the next target that practices the most frequent mistake. Twist: let the AI show a slightly wrong target on purpose and ask the learner to spot the error.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个实体谜题（七巧板、绳结、吉他和弦手型），做一个显示目标状态的手机 AR 叠加层；记录学习者的错误，让大模型挑选下一个针对最常见错误的练习目标。变体：让 AI 故意给出一个略有错误的目标，请学习者找出错在哪里。

video.video_title: [DIS 2025] Rubikon: Intelligent Tutoring Through AR-enabled Physical Task Reconfiguration (video)

works.title: Sensible Agent
works.description: A proactive AR assistant that decides not only what help to offer but how, choosing between a glanceable icon, audio or a question you answer with a nod or a gaze, depending on whether your hands are busy or you are in a conversation.
works.description_zh: 一个主动式 AR 助手，不仅决定提供什么帮助，还决定如何提供：根据你是否双手忙碌或正在交谈，在一眼可读的图标、语音，或用点头、注视即可回答的提问之间选择。
works.idea_en: A good assistant reads the social situation before it speaks.
works.idea_zh: 好的助手在开口之前会先读懂社交场合。
works.technique: A multimodal model reads egocentric video and audio to infer context, then a policy selects both the assistance and the least disruptive input and output modality, such as head gestures or gaze dwell.
works.technique_zh: 多模态模型读取第一人称视频和音频来推断情境，再由策略同时选择帮助内容和干扰最小的输入输出方式，比如头部手势或注视停留。
works.exercise_en: Design three delivery modes (icon, whisper, nod question) for one AR reminder, and act out when each is appropriate in class. Twist: the assistant must stay silent if two people are talking.
works.exercise_zh: 为同一条 AR 提醒设计三种呈现方式（图标、耳语、点头提问），并在课堂上表演出每种方式适合的场景。变体：如果有两个人在说话，助手必须保持沉默。

video.video_title: [UIST 2025] Sensible Agent: A Framework for Unobtrusive Interaction with Proactive AR Agent

works.title: Seven Wonders of the Ancient World
works.description: An 'augmented documentary series' made with Sandstone Global: Snapchat Lenses accompany the TV programme and rebuild the Seven Wonders, from the pyramids to the Colossus, as 3D models viewers can explore around them.
works.description_zh: 与 Sandstone Global 合作的“增强纪录片系列”：Snapchat 镜头配合电视节目播出，把从金字塔到太阳神巨像的古代七大奇迹重建成观众可以在身边探索的 3D 模型。
works.idea_en: Let a TV documentary spill its monuments into the viewer's room.
works.idea_zh: 让电视纪录片里的古迹走进观众的房间。
works.technique: Snapchat world Lenses likely place detailed reconstructions of each wonder on the floor or table, paired with each episode of the programme.
works.technique_zh: Snapchat 世界镜头很可能把每处奇迹的精细复原模型放在地面或桌面上，与节目的每一集配套。
works.exercise_en: Pick a documentary topic and build a companion AR scene (Lens Studio or model-viewer) that places one reconstructed object at true scale in the classroom. Twist: the object is revealed layer by layer as the documentary narration progresses.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个纪录片主题，做一个配套 AR 场景（Lens Studio 或 model-viewer），在教室里按真实比例放一个复原物体。变体：随着纪录片旁白推进，物体一层层显现。

video.video_title: 7 Wonders of the ancient world - Sandstone x Snapchat

works.title: Shadow Tuner
works.description: A rotating, upside-down Earth is projected onto a giant spherical balloon; passers-by at a camera station cast their shadows onto the globe, reshaping how the planet appears.
works.idea_zh: 路人的影子被投到巨大的地球气球上，改变地球的样子
works.technique: A camera at a station captures the passer-by's silhouette and composites it into the projected (or LED) spherical Earth animation in real time.
works.exercise_zh: 在白色气球或球灯上投影旋转地球，用摄像头剪影在地球上“打出”阴影；变化：影子遮住的区域显示该地区的一个真实数据。

video.video_title: Shadow Tuner - Montreal - 2025

works.description_zh: 一个旋转、上下颠倒的地球被投影在巨大的球形气球上；路人在摄像站前把自己的影子投到这颗地球上，改变了星球的样貌。
works.idea_en: Passers-by cast their shadows onto a giant Earth balloon and change how the planet looks.
works.technique_zh: 站点处的摄像头捕捉路人的剪影，并实时合成到投影（或 LED）的球形地球动画中。
works.exercise_en: Project a spinning Earth onto a white balloon or globe lamp, and use a camera silhouette to 'cast' a shadow onto it. Twist: the area covered by the shadow shows a real data point about that region.

works.title: Shape n' Swarm
works.description: Users sculpt a shape with their hands and describe it in speech; an LLM plans how a swarm of small tabletop robots should arrange and move to represent and animate it.
works.idea_zh: 用手比划加一句话，机器人群就排出并动起你想要的形状。

video.video_title: Shape n’ Swarm: Hands-on, Shape-aware Generative Authoring with Swarm UI and LLMs [UIST2025]

works.technique: Combines hand-sketched shape input with an LLM that outputs robot target positions and motion scripts for a swarm UI.
works.exercise_zh: 让同学用语音描述一个动物，由ChatGPT生成一组坐标，再由几名同学手持纸片按坐标在地面上排出这个形状；变化：要求形状“动起来”（如鸟扇动翅膀）。
works.description_zh: 用户用双手塑造一个形状，再用语言描述它；大语言模型据此规划一群桌面小机器人该如何排列和移动，把这个形状表现出来并让它动起来。
works.idea_en: Sketch a shape with your hands and say one sentence, and a robot swarm forms it and brings it to life.
works.technique_zh: 把手绘形状输入与大语言模型结合，由模型为群体界面输出机器人的目标位置和运动脚本。
works.exercise_en: Have a classmate describe an animal by voice, let ChatGPT turn it into a set of coordinates, and have several classmates holding paper cards line up on the floor to form the shape. Twist: require the shape to move (for example, a bird flapping its wings).

works.title: Sketch2Terrain
works.description: Draw a few freehand 3D strokes in AR and an AI model turns them into a complete terrain with hills and valleys in real time, so non-experts can sketch the landscapes they remember.
works.description_zh: 在 AR 中随手画几笔三维线条，AI 模型就会实时把它们变成带山丘和山谷的完整地形，让非专业人士也能画出记忆中的地貌。
works.idea_en: Sketch a few ridgelines in the air and let AI fill in the whole landscape.
works.idea_zh: 在空中画几条山脊线，让 AI 补全整片地形。
works.technique: Strokes are turned into a curve network and a height-map image, which a pix2pix image-to-image model completes into a terrain height map rendered as a 3D mesh in the headset.
works.technique_zh: 笔画被转换成曲线网络和高度图图像，由 pix2pix 图像到图像模型补全为地形高度图，再在头显中渲染成三维网格。
works.exercise_en: Have students draw a few contour lines on paper or in a web canvas, turn the image into a height map with an image-to-image model (or a height-map ControlNet), and load it as a displaced plane on a table in phone AR. Twist: a second student walks a tiny virtual figure across the terrain and describes the route in words.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生在纸上或网页画布上画几条等高线，用图像到图像模型（或高度图 ControlNet）把图像变成高度图，再在手机 AR 中把它作为置换平面放到桌上。变体：另一位同学在地形上走一个虚拟小人，并用文字描述这条路线。

video.video_title: CHI25 — Sketch2Terrain: AI-Driven Real-Time Terrain Sketch Mapping in AR  —  Video Figure

works.title: Sonify Anything
works.description: When a virtual object hits a real one in AR, the system recognizes the real material (glass, wood, metal) and synthesizes a physically plausible impact sound on the fly instead of a generic click.
works.description_zh: 在 AR 中，当虚拟物体撞上真实物体时，系统会识别真实物体的材质（玻璃、木头、金属），并实时合成符合物理规律的撞击声，而不是一声千篇一律的“咔哒”。
works.idea_en: Let the materials of the real world decide how virtual collisions sound.
works.idea_zh: 让真实世界的材质来决定虚拟碰撞的声音。
works.technique: Computer-vision models segment and classify the materials of real objects, and their physical properties plus the impact dynamics drive real-time modal sound synthesis.
works.technique_zh: 计算机视觉模型对真实物体的材质进行分割与分类，再用材质的物理属性和撞击动力学驱动实时模态声音合成。
works.exercise_en: Throw virtual balls at real furniture in a phone AR app; on each hit, classify the surface at the impact point with a material-recognition model or a vision-LLM prompt and play a synthesized sound (Tone.js or a physical-model patch) tuned to that material. Twist: exaggerate one material so the whole room sounds as if it were made of glass.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 应用中把虚拟小球扔向真实家具；每次击中时，用材质识别模型或视觉大模型提示判断撞击点表面的材质，播放针对该材质调好的合成音（Tone.js 或物理建模音色）。变体：夸大某一种材质，让整个房间听起来像是玻璃做的。

video.video_title: [ISMAR 25] Sonify Anything: Towards Context-Aware Sonic Interactions in AR

salient.why_en: A virtual ball sounds like glass, wood or metal depending on the real thing it hits.
salient.why_zh: 虚拟的球撞到玻璃、木头还是金属，就发出对应材质的声音。

works.title: Specs Racer
works.description: An arcade racing game for Snap Spectacles played in a physical installation with real steering wheels, pedals and start lights; Snap built the rig and he developed the game with Ninsky.
