works.description_zh: 为 Snap Spectacles 打造的街机赛车游戏，玩家坐进带有真实方向盘、踏板和起跑灯的实体装置中比赛；装置由 Snap 搭建，游戏由他与 Ninsky 共同开发。
works.idea_en: Race in AR glasses using real steering wheels and pedals.
works.idea_zh: 戴着 AR 眼镜，用真实的方向盘和踏板赛车。
works.technique: Physical controllers are likely connected to the Spectacles lens over a network bridge, and a race track with physics cars is rendered in the glasses on top of the real room.
works.technique_zh: 实体控制器很可能通过网络桥接连到 Spectacles 的 Lens 上，眼镜里在真实房间之上渲染出带物理车辆的赛道。
works.exercise_en: Connect a cheap USB gamepad or a phone's gyroscope to a WebXR scene and drive a toy car around a track drawn on the real floor. Twist: two players with two phones race on the same floor track.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个便宜的 USB 手柄或手机陀螺仪连接到 WebXR 场景，驾驶一辆玩具车绕着画在真实地板上的赛道跑；变体：两名玩家用两部手机在同一条地板赛道上比赛。

video.video_title:
I did a very fun collab with @Spectacles: Racing with physical steering wheels, pedals, and start lights 🚥

@Snap built the installation, and I teamed up with the great @Ninsky_AR to develop the game.

works.title: Spectacles AI release: Snap 3D and LLM integrations
works.description: The June 2025 Spectacles OS release adds OpenAI, Gemini and DeepSeek integrations, better speech-to-text, the Snap 3D generative API that creates 3D objects on demand, and new object-tracking samples.
works.description_zh: 2025 年 6 月的 Spectacles 系统更新加入了 OpenAI、Gemini 和 DeepSeek 集成、更好的语音转文字、可按需生成三维物体的 Snap 3D 生成接口，以及新的物体追踪示例。
works.idea_en: AR glasses where you can ask for a 3D object and it appears.
works.idea_zh: 在 AR 眼镜里说想要一个三维物体，它就出现了。
works.technique: Lens Studio exposes cloud LLMs and a text-to-3D endpoint (Snap 3D) to lenses, so a spoken prompt returns a mesh that is placed in the room.
works.technique_zh: Lens Studio 向镜头开放云端大语言模型和文生三维接口（Snap 3D），一句语音提示就能返回一个网格并放进房间。
works.exercise_en: Build a voice-to-3D toy: speech-to-text, then a free text-to-3D API, then place the result on a detected table in phone AR. Twist: every new object must be something the previous one would be afraid of.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个语音生三维小玩具：语音转文字，接免费文生三维接口，再放到手机 AR 检测到的桌面上。变体：每个新物体都必须是上一个物体会害怕的东西。

video.video_title: Snap Spectacles June OS Release: new AI/AR integrations, 3D asset generation, and more

works.title: Spectacles AI-powered translation challenge
works.description: Two people who speak different languages collaborate on a build: one instructs, one builds, and a Spectacles translation lens shows each spoken sentence as subtitles in the other's language.
works.description_zh: 两位说不同语言的人合作搭建：一人指挥、一人动手，Spectacles 的翻译镜头把每句话实时变成对方语言的字幕。
works.idea_en: Subtitles for real life let strangers build something together.
works.idea_zh: 给现实生活加上字幕，让陌生人可以一起动手做东西。
works.technique: Speech is transcribed, translated by an AI model and rendered as captions anchored near the speaker in the wearer's view.
works.technique_zh: 语音被转写后由 AI 模型翻译，再以字幕形式锚定在佩戴者视野中说话人附近。
works.exercise_en: Run a LEGO challenge where the instructor speaks one language and the builder reads live translated captions on a phone held in a headset viewer. Twist: translate into emoji only.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个乐高挑战：指挥者说一种语言，搭建者通过放在头戴支架里的手机读实时翻译字幕。变体：只翻译成表情符号。

video.video_title: Snap Spectacles: AI-powered Translation Challenge

works.title: Spectacular: The Art of Jonathan Yeo in Augmented Reality
works.description: The first AR art exhibition on Snap Spectacles: as visitors approach Jonathan Yeo's royal, celebrity and self-portraits, the paintings are recognised and transform and respond around the frame.
works.description_zh: 首个基于 Snap Spectacles 的 AR 艺术展：观众走近 Jonathan Yeo 的皇室、名人与自画像时，眼镜会识别画作，让画面在画框内外变化并对观众作出回应。
works.idea_en: Paintings that know you are looking and answer back.
works.idea_zh: 画作知道你在看它，并且会回应你。
works.technique: Snap trained recognition models on each painting so Spectacles detect and track the canvas, then play spatial animations registered to it.
works.technique_zh: Snap 针对每幅画训练了识别模型，让 Spectacles 检测并追踪画布，再播放与画面精确对齐的空间动画。
works.exercise_en: Choose one portrait and build an image-tracked AR layer where the subject reacts differently depending on how close the viewer stands. Twist: the portrait remembers the last visitor and greets the next one about them.
works.exercise_zh: 选一幅肖像，做一个图像追踪的 AR 图层，让画中人根据观者站得远近作出不同反应；变体：肖像会记住上一位观者，并向下一位观者“讲述”他。

video.video_title: Spectacular, the Art of Jonathan Yeo in Augmented Reality

works.title: SpeechCompass
works.description: A phone case with several microphones localises who is speaking in a group and shows each caption with an arrow or colour pointing toward that speaker.
works.description_zh: 带多个麦克风的手机壳可以定位群聊中是谁在说话，并在每条字幕旁用箭头或颜色指向对应的说话人。
works.idea_en: Captions that know where each voice comes from.
works.idea_zh: 知道每个声音来自哪里的字幕。
works.technique: Real-time multi-microphone sound localisation on a small microcontroller estimates direction of arrival, which is attached to each speech-to-text segment.
works.technique_zh: 小型微控制器上运行实时多麦克风声源定位，估计声音到达方向，并把方向附加到每一段语音转文字结果上。
works.exercise_en: Use two phones' microphones on a table to guess which side a voice comes from and colour the captions left or right. Twist: show the captions as speech bubbles in AR above each person.
works.exercise_zh: 把两部手机放在桌上，用麦克风判断声音来自哪一侧，并把字幕染成左侧或右侧的颜色。变体：在 AR 中把字幕显示为每个人头顶的对话气泡。

video.video_title: SpeechCompass: Enhancing Mobile Captioning via Multi-Microphone Localization [CHI 2025 Best Paper]

works.title: Stable Diffusion AR with Quest passthrough camera access
works.description: A step-by-step tutorial that reads the Quest 3 passthrough cameras in Unity, then uses them for object detection and for Stable Diffusion generations based on what the headset sees.
works.description_zh: 一个手把手教程：在 Unity 中读取 Quest 3 透视摄像头画面，用于物体检测，并根据头显看到的内容生成 Stable Diffusion 图像。
works.idea_en: The first day the headset can see, it can also dream about what it sees.
works.idea_zh: 头显能“看见”的第一天，也就能对看到的东西“做梦”。
works.technique: A WebCamTexture from the passthrough camera is sent to a Stable Diffusion image-to-image endpoint, and the output is displayed on a panel in the room.
works.technique_zh: 把透视摄像头的 WebCamTexture 发送到 Stable Diffusion 图生图接口，输出显示在房间里的面板上。
works.exercise_en: Follow a camera-access tutorial for any AR device, send one frame to an image-to-image API, and hang the result as a framed picture on your real wall. Twist: the picture updates only when someone new enters the room.
works.exercise_zh: 照着任意 AR 设备的摄像头权限教程，发一帧画面到图生图接口，把结果作为装裱的画挂在真实墙上。变体：只有新的人走进房间时画才会更新。

video.video_title: Step-by-step Meta Quest 3 Passthrough Camera Access in Unity | Stable Diffusion AR, Object Detection

works.title: Starship rocket in XR
works.description: A Spectacles experience that lets you launch a SpaceX Starship and guide the booster back to a 3D-printed launch tower on your table.
works.idea_zh: 发射星舰，再把助推器引导回桌上3D打印的发射塔。

video.video_title: Starship rocket in XR - Spectacles

works.technique: The printed tower is registered as a tracked object or placed anchor, and a simple physics or scripted trajectory lets the user steer the booster back to the physical catch point.
works.exercise_zh: 用一个真实物体（纸杯）作为着陆点，在 AR 中操控一枚火箭落回杯口，偏离太多就爆炸；变体：加入随机侧风。
works.description_zh: 一个 Spectacles 体验：你可以发射 SpaceX 星舰（Starship），再把助推器引导回桌上那座 3D 打印的发射塔。
works.idea_en: Launch a Starship, then guide the booster back to a 3D-printed launch tower on the table.
works.technique_zh: 打印的发射塔被注册为追踪物体或放置锚点，借助简单的物理模拟或脚本轨迹，用户可以把助推器操控回实体的回收点。
works.exercise_en: Use a real object (a paper cup) as the landing pad and steer a rocket in AR back into its mouth, making it explode if it drifts too far. Twist: add random crosswinds.

works.title: Step inside an AI-generated movie scene
works.description: A proof of concept that lets the viewer walk into the Dojo from The Matrix, where the environment, characters and movement were all generated by AI and replayed around them in XR.
works.description_zh: 一个概念验证：观众可以走进《黑客帝国》里的道场，环境、角色和动作全部由 AI 生成，并在 XR 中围绕观众回放。
works.idea_en: A film scene you stand inside, rebuilt entirely by generative models.
works.idea_zh: 一段可以站进去的电影场景，完全由生成模型重建。
works.technique: Likely a generative video model produces the fight, which is then lifted into 3D (Gaussian splats or 4D reconstruction) and streamed to the headset as a volumetric sequence.
works.technique_zh: 很可能先用生成式视频模型生成打斗片段，再提升成三维（高斯泼溅或四维重建），以体积序列的形式在头显中播放。
works.exercise_en: Generate a 5-second clip of two characters in a room, convert key frames into splats with a single-image-to-3D tool, and play them in sequence in WebXR at room scale. Twist: let the viewer's position choose which camera angle the AI generates next.
works.exercise_zh: 生成一段 5 秒的双人室内片段，用单图转三维工具把关键帧做成泼溅，在 WebXR 中按房间尺度依次播放。变体：让观众站的位置决定 AI 下一段生成的机位。

video.video_title:
🎬 What if you could step inside a movie scene, fully AI-generated? I created this proof of concept where you enter the Dojo from The Matrix.

The entire scene (environment, characters, and movement) w

works.title: Step into a persistent redesign, 1:1
works.description: Gemini designs a new living room, World Labs generates it in 3D, and VPS localizes it to his real room at 1:1 scale so he can step into it.
works.idea_zh: AI 设计 + AI 生成 + 定位对齐：在自己家里 1:1 走进重新设计的客厅。

video.video_title:
I reimagined my living room with World Labs. Gemini helped design it, World Labs generated the 3D environment, and VPS localized it to my space 1:1 scale.

I can now step into a persistent redesign in

works.technique: VPS localizes the phone against a prior map of the room, so a 1:1 generated redesign loads at the same real-world pose every session instead of needing manual alignment.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit ARWorldMap 或 AR Foundation 的持久化锚点保存房间里的布置，下次打开时自动恢复到原位；变体：让家具位置每次打开时根据当天天气略有变化。
works.description_zh: Gemini 设计新的客厅，World Labs 把它生成成 3D，再由 VPS 以 1:1 比例定位到他真实的房间里，让他可以走进去。
works.idea_en: AI design, AI generation and precise localization let you step into a redesigned living room at 1:1 scale in your own home.
works.technique_zh: VPS 根据房间事先建好的地图对手机进行定位，因此 1:1 的生成式改造方案每次都会加载在相同的真实世界位姿上，不需要手动对齐。
works.exercise_en: Save a room layout with ARKit ARWorldMap or persistent anchors in AR Foundation, and restore it to the same place automatically the next time the app opens. Twist: shift the furniture slightly each time based on that day's weather.

works.title: StickAR: Spatial Notes Beyond Typing
works.description: Hand-written or spoken notes are recognised and pinned as 3D sticky notes in space, avoiding keyboards in AR/VR.
works.idea_zh: 不用键盘，把手写或语音笔记变成贴在空间里的便利贴。

video.video_title: StickAR : Spatial notes & beyond typing (Final ver.)

works.technique: OCR or speech recognition converts handwritten or spoken input to text, which is spawned as a 3D sticky-note panel anchored at the hand or gaze position.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Web Speech API 把说的话变成文字，生成一张 3D 便利贴贴在屏幕中心射线命中的墙面上；变体：便利贴颜色根据内容类型（待办/想法）自动区分。
works.description_zh: 手写或口述的笔记被识别出来，以 3D 便利贴的形式钉在空间中，让人在 AR/VR 里不必再用键盘。
works.idea_en: Skip the keyboard and turn handwritten or spoken notes into sticky notes placed in space.
works.technique_zh: 通过 OCR 或语音识别把手写或语音输入转换为文字，生成一个锚定在手部或视线位置的 3D 便利贴面板。
works.exercise_en: Turn speech into text with the Web Speech API and generate a 3D sticky note on the wall hit by a ray from the center of the screen. Twist: color the notes automatically by content type (to-do or idea).

works.title: Strandbeest Evolution 2025
works.description: The 2025 update on the Strandbeest family, which has been evolving since 1990, shows the newest beast walking on the beach and its experiments with wind and water.
works.description_zh: 2025 年海滩生物家族的最新进展：这个家族自 1990 年起不断演化，影片展示最新一代在海滩上行走，以及它对风和水的实验。
works.idea_en: Thirty-five years of one idea show that depth comes from iterating on a single system, a lesson for long-running AR projects.
works.idea_zh: 一个想法持续三十五年，说明深度来自对同一系统的反复迭代，这是长期 AR 项目的一课。
works.technique: Continuation of the PVC linkage system with new adaptations tested on the beach.
works.technique_zh: 延续 PVC 连杆系统，并在海滩上测试新的适应性改进。
works.exercise_en: Give an AR creature three 'genes' (leg length, speed, sail size) and let the class breed a new generation each week by combining the fittest. Twist: fitness is measured by how far it walks in the real wind outside.
works.exercise_zh: 给一只 AR 生物三个“基因”（腿长、速度、帆的大小），让全班每周把表现最好的个体组合起来繁育新一代；变体：适应度以它在户外真实风中走了多远来衡量。

video.video_title: Strandbeest evolution 2025

works.title: Supermosh
works.description: A browser editor where clips are glitched with datamosh: motion from one shot drags the pixels of another, as shown in the author's tutorial.
works.description_zh: 一个浏览器编辑器，用 datamosh 给视频片段制造故障：一个镜头的运动拖拽着另一个镜头的像素，作者在教程里做了演示。
works.idea_en: Datamosh without codecs or command lines, right in the browser.
works.idea_zh: 不碰编解码器和命令行，直接在浏览器里做 datamosh。
works.technique: Supermosh likely decodes video in the browser, extracts per-block motion between frames and re-applies that motion to pixels of a held or different frame instead of refreshing them, reproducing the missing-keyframe glitch.
works.technique_zh: Supermosh 很可能在浏览器里解码视频，提取帧间的分块运动，再把这些运动施加到被保留的或另一段画面的像素上而不刷新它们，从而重现“缺失关键帧”的故障效果。
works.exercise_en: Recreate a real-time datamosh on a WebXR or phone camera feed by estimating motion with optical flow in a shader and advecting the previous frame instead of drawing the new one. Twist: only mosh inside a virtual portal placed in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 或手机相机画面上做实时 datamosh：用着色器中的光流估计运动，并用它平流上一帧而不是绘制新帧。变体：只在房间里放置的一个虚拟传送门里做 datamosh。

video.video_title: Supermosh v2 Tutorial

works.title: Surface-Stable Fractal Dithering
works.description: A 3D scene is rendered only with black-and-white dots that stick to the surfaces as the camera moves, while the dots keep the same size on screen through fractal subdivision.
works.description_zh: 三维场景只用黑白点渲染，镜头移动时这些点牢牢贴在物体表面上，同时借助分形细分让点在屏幕上保持相同大小。
works.idea_en: Dither that belongs to the surface, not the screen.
works.idea_zh: 属于表面、而不是屏幕的抖动图案。
works.technique: A 3D dither texture of Bayer-like dot layers is sampled in surface UV space, and the shader picks the fractal level from UV derivatives so dots subdivide smoothly as surfaces get closer or farther.
works.technique_zh: 着色器在表面 UV 空间采样一张由类 Bayer 点阵层组成的三维抖动纹理，并根据 UV 导数选择分形层级，使点在表面靠近或远离时平滑细分。
works.exercise_en: Apply the dither shader to virtual objects in an AR Foundation scene and to the LiDAR room mesh, so the whole space turns into a stable one-bit engraving as you walk. Twist: map dot density to sound volume.
works.exercise_zh: 把抖动着色器用在 AR Foundation 场景的虚拟物体和 LiDAR 房间网格上，让你走动时整个空间变成稳定的一位色版画。变体：让点的密度随声音音量变化。

video.video_title: Feature Demo of Surface-Stable Fractal Dithering

works.title: Tales of the Deep
works.description: An AR piece for Luton Lights 2025 in which a spectral pirate and deep-sea creatures swim into an ordinary community room through the visitor's phone.
works.description_zh: 为 Luton Lights 2025 创作的 AR 作品：透过观众的手机，一个幽灵海盗和各种深海生物游进一间普通的社区活动室。
works.idea_en: The sea floods an everyday room and brings its ghosts with it.
works.idea_zh: 大海淹没了一间普通房间，还带来了它的幽灵。
works.technique: Likely mobile AR with animated 3D characters and particle effects placed in the room using plane detection.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是手机 AR，利用平面检测把带动画的三维角色和粒子效果放进房间。
works.exercise_en: Place a swimming AR fish that follows the phone around the classroom, then add a larger creature that appears only in a dark corner. Twist: the water level rises the longer the room stays quiet.
works.exercise_zh: 放一条会跟着手机在教室里游动的 AR 鱼，再加一只只在暗角出现的大型生物；变体：房间越安静，水位涨得越高。

video.video_title: luton lights - Tales of the Deep

works.title: The Colours of Music (Royal Philharmonic Orchestra)
works.description: Scanning a musician or instrument with this Lens turns the notes being played into evolving 3D colours and shapes around the performer, inspired by chromesthesia.
works.description_zh: 用这个 Lens 扫描乐手或乐器，正在演奏的音符就会在演奏者周围化作不断变化的 3D 色彩与形状，灵感来自“色听联觉”。
works.idea_en: Let everyone, including people who are hard of hearing, see music the way synaesthetes do.
works.idea_zh: 让每个人（包括听力不便的人）都能像联觉者一样“看见”音乐。
works.technique: Machine learning detects instruments and analyses live audio pitch and timbre, mapping them to colour, form and motion of spatial particles anchored near the player.
works.technique_zh: 用机器学习识别乐器并分析现场音频的音高与音色，映射到锚定在演奏者附近的空间粒子的颜色、形态和运动上。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR visualiser that maps pitch to colour and loudness to size for sounds from one real instrument in class. Twist: each classmate designs their own colour mapping, and the class compares whose feels most 'right'.
works.exercise_zh: 为课堂上的一件真实乐器做一个 AR 可视化：音高对应颜色、音量对应大小；变体：每位同学设计自己的颜色映射，全班比较谁的最“对味”。

video.video_title: The Colours Of Music

works.title: The Gates in augmented reality (Bloomberg Connects)
works.description: For the 20th anniversary of The Gates, an AR experience in the Bloomberg Connects app puts the saffron gates back along Central Park's paths on visitors' phones.
works.description_zh: 在《The Gates》20 周年之际，Bloomberg Connects 应用中的 AR 体验让藏红花色门廊重新出现在观众手机中的中央公园小径上。
works.idea_en: A vanished temporary artwork can return in AR at its original site, turning an archive into a walkable experience.
works.idea_zh: 一件已消失的临时作品可以在原址以 AR 形式回归，把档案变成可以走进的体验。
works.technique: Likely geospatial AR anchoring of 3D gate models to their documented positions along the park paths.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是把 3D 门廊模型按照有记录的位置，以地理空间 AR 锚定在公园小径上。
works.exercise_en: Choose a past event or vanished structure on your campus, find an archive photo, and re-place it in AR at its exact original spot. Twist: add a 'then/now' slider that crossfades the old scene with the live view.
works.exercise_zh: 选择校园里一件过去的事件或已消失的建筑，找到档案照片，并在 AR 中把它放回原来的确切位置；变体：加入“过去/现在”滑块，在旧场景与实时画面之间淡入淡出。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Reveals Christo & Jeanne-Claude's The Gates - Central Park

salient.why_en: A vanished artwork returns to the exact paths in Central Park where it once stood.
salient.why_zh: 一件早已拆除的作品，回到它当年所在的中央公园小径上。

works.title: The Last Swan
works.description: An English National Ballet dancer performs Swan Lake inside a projection cube where watery haze and feathers ripple with her tracked movement; afterwards audience members step in and see their own presence reflected in the same environments.
works.description_zh: 英国国家芭蕾舞团的舞者在投影立方体中演绎天鹅湖，水雾和羽毛随她被追踪的动作泛起涟漪；演出结束后观众走进同一空间，看到自己的存在被映照在这些场景中。
works.idea_en: A classical ballet becomes a projection room the audience can enter and continue.
works.idea_zh: 古典芭蕾变成观众可以走进去、继续“跳下去”的投影空间。
works.technique: Motion capture on the dancer drives real-time visuals projected onto the walls of a cube, then an audience-facing tracking system switches the same generative scenes to respond to visitors.
works.technique_zh: 舞者身上的动作捕捉驱动实时影像并投到立方体的墙面，随后面向观众的追踪系统让同样的生成场景转而回应观众。
works.exercise_en: Turn a classroom corner into a two-wall projection 'lake' that ripples where a webcam sees people move. Twist: after one dancer's solo, replay her ripples at half opacity while the audience adds their own.
works.exercise_zh: 把教室一角变成两面墙的投影“湖面”，摄像头看到哪里有人移动，哪里就泛起涟漪；变体：一位舞者独舞后，以半透明方式重放她的涟漪，观众再在上面加入自己的。

video.video_title: Last Swan Trailer

works.title: The Living Pyramid
works.description: At Desert X 2025 in the Coachella Valley, a terraced earth pyramid is planted with native desert flowers and grasses, a new version of Denes's living pyramids first grown in New York and Luxembourg.
works.description_zh: 在 2025 年科切拉谷的 Desert X 展上，一座阶梯状土金字塔种满原生沙漠花草，是 Denes 在纽约和卢森堡种过的“活金字塔”的新版本。
works.idea_en: A monumental shape made of living plants changes with the seasons, showing how an AR form can have a growing skin.
works.idea_zh: 由活植物构成的纪念性形体随季节而变，说明 AR 形体可以有一层会生长的“皮肤”。
works.technique: An earth pyramid is built in stepped terraces, each planted with species chosen to bloom at different times.
works.technique_zh: 土金字塔分层筑成台阶，每层种植花期不同的物种。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR pyramid of terraces on a plaza and let its planting change by month using a list of local native plants. Twist: visitors water a terrace with a tap gesture, and it blooms early.
works.exercise_zh: 在广场上放一座阶梯状 AR 金字塔，根据本地原生植物列表让其种植随月份变化；变体：访客用点按手势给某一层浇水，它就会提前开花。

video.video_title: AGNES DENES : THE LIVING PYRAMID | DESERT X 2025

works.title: The Long Fall: A descent into the Ocean's Living Memory
works.description: A 15-minute audiovisual performance (with Manu Prakash and others) that takes the audience on an immersive descent with plankton, projected across wall and floor.
works.idea_zh: 随浮游生物一起“下沉”，看见海洋如何记住碳
works.technique: Microscopy footage and simulations of plankton are composed into a live wall-and-floor projection performance with spatial sound.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机微距拍水滴或植物细胞，把影像投到地上做一段“下沉”视觉叙事；变化：观众走到不同深度区（地面标线）触发不同的声音。

video.video_title: The Long Fall: A descent into the Ocean's Living Memory

works.description_zh: 一场时长 15 分钟的视听表演（与 Manu Prakash 等人合作），通过墙面和地面的投影，带观众与浮游生物一起沉浸式地下潜。
works.idea_en: Sink down with the plankton and see how the ocean remembers carbon.
works.technique_zh: 把浮游生物的显微影像和模拟结果组合成一场结合空间声音的墙面与地面现场投影表演。
works.exercise_en: Shoot water droplets or plant cells with a phone macro lens and project the footage onto the floor as a visual 'descent' narrative. Twist: when viewers walk into different depth zones (marked on the floor), different sounds play.

works.title: The Placeholders
works.description: Three performers: one dances, one films, one extracts still frames from the live feed; each frame is projected immediately next to an image from a curated dataset, so the audience watches random meaning form and collapse.
works.description_zh: 三位表演者：一人跳舞，一人拍摄，一人从实时画面中逐张截取静帧；每张静帧立刻与策划数据集中的一张图并排投影，观众看着随机的意义生成又崩塌。
works.idea_en: Make a stage where a camera, a dataset and dancers invent meaning together live.
works.idea_zh: 让摄像头、数据集和舞者在台上一起即兴“发明”意义。
works.technique: A camera feed is sampled frame by frame on a laptop and paired with images from a curated dataset on a dual-image projection.
works.technique_zh: 笔记本逐帧采样摄像头画面，并与策划数据集中的图片配对，以双图形式投影。
works.exercise_en: Let one student film a dancer with a phone while another grabs a frame every ten seconds and projects it beside a random image from a class photo folder. Twist: the dancer must react to the pairing on screen.
works.exercise_zh: 让一名学生用手机拍舞者，另一名每十秒截一帧，并与班级相册中的随机图片并排投影；变体：舞者必须对屏幕上的组合作出反应。

video.video_title: The Placeholders

works.title: The prompt engineer and the director
works.description: A father types prompts while his son directs what the mixed-reality diffusion system should turn their living room into, making the prototype a family game.
works.description_zh: 父亲负责输入提示词，儿子当导演，决定混合现实扩散系统把客厅变成什么样，原型成了一个家庭游戏。
works.idea_en: Generative AR works best as a conversation between two people.
works.idea_zh: 生成式 AR 最好玩的时候，是两个人之间的对话。
works.technique: The same passthrough-plus-SDXL Turbo pipeline runs with a second person giving directions, so prompts evolve from a child's instructions.
works.technique_zh: 沿用透视画面加 SDXL Turbo 的流程，由第二个人发出指令，提示词随孩子的要求不断演变。
works.exercise_en: In pairs, one student describes a transformation of the room aloud and the other must translate it into prompts for a live restyling demo. Twist: the director may only use sounds, not words.
works.exercise_zh: 两人一组：一人大声描述要把房间变成什么，另一人把它翻译成提示词，驱动实时重绘演示。变体：导演只能用声音，不能用词语。

video.video_title:
Today I’m the Prompt Engineer, and my son is the Director.

Mixed Reality + Diffusion prototype using @MetaforDevs Passthrough Camera API and @StabilityAI SDXL Turbo.⁣⁣

#MR #AI #Passthrough #StableDi

works.title: Thing2Reality
works.description: During an XR call, grab a 2D image or a physical object from the video feed and it materializes as a 3D object between the participants, generated as multiview renderings or 3D Gaussians that everyone can move and point at.
works.description_zh: 在 XR 通话中，从视频画面里“抓取”一张二维图片或一个实体物体，它就会在参与者之间变成三维物体——以多视角渲染或三维高斯的形式生成，所有人都能移动它、指着它讨论。
works.idea_en: Anything you can show on camera can instantly become a shared 3D object.
works.idea_zh: 只要能在镜头前展示的东西，都能立刻变成共享的三维物体。
works.technique: Segmented 2D content is lifted to 3D with image-to-multiview diffusion and 3D Gaussian reconstruction, then shared in the immersive call space.
works.technique_zh: 把分割出的二维内容通过图像到多视角扩散模型和三维高斯重建提升为三维，再共享到沉浸式通话空间中。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a small object, remove the background, send it to an image-to-3D service (TripoSR, Meshy or Luma) and drop the result into a shared AR scene that two phones can see, for example with Lens Studio Connected Lenses. Twist: generate the 3D object from a child's drawing instead of a photo.
works.exercise_zh: 给一个小物件拍照并去除背景，发送到图像生成三维服务（TripoSR、Meshy 或 Luma），再把结果放进两部手机都能看到的共享 AR 场景，比如 Lens Studio Connected Lenses。变体：用孩子画的画而不是照片来生成三维物体。

video.video_title: Thing2Reality: Enabling Spontaneous Creation of 3D Objects from 2D Content using Generative AI in...

works.title: TrackpadFluid: ten-finger fluid
works.description: All ten fingers on a Mac trackpad stir a colorful fluid simulation at once, each finger pushing its own swirl.
works.description_zh: 十根手指同时在 Mac 触控板上搅动彩色流体模拟，每根手指推出自己的漩涡。
works.idea_en: A trackpad becomes a multi-finger paint pool.
works.idea_zh: 触控板变成一个可以多指搅动的颜料池。
works.technique: A native plugin reads raw multitouch points from the trackpad and injects forces and dye into a GPU Stable Fluids solver.
works.technique_zh: 原生插件读取触控板的原始多点触控数据，把力和颜料注入 GPU 上的 Stable Fluids 求解器。
works.exercise_en: Run a stable fluids simulation on a virtual pool lying on a real table in AR Foundation and stir it with multitouch on the phone screen. Twist: two phones stir the same pool.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中让一个 Stable Fluids 虚拟水池躺在真实桌面上，用手机多点触控搅动。变体：两台手机搅动同一个水池。

video.video_title: Combined the multitouch plugin with the stable fluids demo. https://t.co/C4Z5vEhMy0

works.title: Triangle Splatting importer
works.description: A photoreal scene reconstructed with Triangle Splatting is loaded into Unity as a cloud of small colored triangles that can be viewed from any angle.
works.description_zh: 用 Triangle Splatting 重建的写实场景被导入 Unity，变成一团彩色小三角形，可以从任意角度观看。
works.idea_en: Scenes captured as triangles run on any normal renderer.
works.idea_zh: 用三角形采集的场景，普通渲染器就能跑。
works.technique: A custom importer (written with an AI coding agent) reads the .off triangle soup exported by Triangle Splatting and builds a vertex-colored mesh.
works.technique_zh: 一个自定义导入器（借助 AI 编程代理编写）读取 Triangle Splatting 导出的 .off 三角形汤，生成顶点着色网格。
works.exercise_en: Import a captured triangle soup and place it at real scale in AR Foundation, then let triangles fly off as particles when touched. Twist: reassemble the scene only when viewed from the capture position.
works.exercise_zh: 导入采集得到的三角形汤，在 AR Foundation 中按真实尺寸摆放，触碰时让三角形像粒子一样飞散。变体：只有从拍摄位置看时场景才重新拼合。

video.video_title:
Tried an agentic coding approach with Gemini CLI to create a Unity package — a custom importer for .off triangle-soup meshes generated with Triangle Splatting.
https://t.co/7Ai5SAVz1O https://t.co/vCs

works.title: Turning a child's drawing into a playable XR world
works.description: His niece's drawing is fed into the Mirage 2 world model and becomes a playable world that opens up in front of the viewer on Spectacles.
works.description_zh: 侄女画的一张画被送进 Mirage 2 世界模型，变成可以玩的世界，在 Spectacles 里展开在观者面前。
works.idea_en: A paper drawing is the level design; an AI world model builds the game.
works.idea_zh: 纸上的画就是关卡设计，AI 世界模型把游戏造出来。
works.technique: A photo of the drawing prompts an interactive world model (Mirage 2) that generates frames in response to controls; the stream is shown as a floating window or portal in the Spectacles lens.
works.technique_zh: 用画作照片提示一个可交互的世界模型（Mirage 2），它根据操作逐帧生成画面，画面以悬浮窗口或传送门形式显示在 Spectacles 镜片里。
works.exercise_en: Have students draw a level on paper, photograph it and generate a 3D environment with a free image-to-world or image-to-3D tool; place it on the table in AR as a tiny diorama. Twist: the child who drew it gives voice commands to change the weather.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生在纸上画关卡，拍照后用免费的图生世界或图生三维工具生成环境，在 AR 中放在桌上当微缩场景。变体：画画的孩子用语音改天气。

video.video_title:
🕹️ Turning drawings into XR worlds you can play in.

I built a POC for @Spectacles that turns imagination into reality.

My niece drew a picture and with the help of Mirage 2, I brought it to life in

works.title: University of Birmingham 125th Anniversary Projection Show
works.description: A 13-minute projection-mapped show on the Aston Webb Building that seems to open the facade to reveal interior spaces such as the Great Hall and its stained glass, built on drone scans of the building and campus.
works.description_zh: 投影在 Aston Webb 大楼上的 13 分钟光影秀，仿佛打开了建筑外墙，露出 Great Hall 及其彩色玻璃窗等室内空间；整场演出建立在对大楼和校园的无人机扫描之上。
works.idea_en: A building's facade opens to show what is inside it.
works.idea_zh: 建筑的外墙打开，让人看见里面的空间。
works.technique: Drone photogrammetry creates a digital twin of the facade used to pre-visualise the show, and scanned interiors are rendered in perspective so they appear to sit behind the wall.
works.technique_zh: 用无人机摄影测量为立面建立数字孪生并预演整场秀，再把扫描得到的室内空间按透视渲染，使其看起来就在墙后。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a classroom wall, model it quickly in Blender, and project a fake cutaway revealing the room behind it. Twist: reveal what the wall looked like fifty years ago.
works.exercise_zh: 拍下一面教室墙，在 Blender 里快速建模，投影出一个假的剖切口，露出墙后的房间；变体：展示这面墙五十年前的样子。

video.video_title: UoB 125 Anniversary Projection Mapping Film

works.title: VPS-anchored WebAR demo
works.description: A real-time WebAR experience anchored to a specific real-world location with a visual positioning system.
works.idea_zh: 内容钉在真实地点上，谁来都看到同一个位置的同一个东西。

video.video_title: real-time WebAR experience powered by VPS (anchored to a real world location) a fun demo I built. The web will also be spatial soon… https://t.co/bGccJmWg1R

works.technique: A browser-based VPS matches camera frames against a pre-scanned location map to recover a 6DoF pose, so content is anchored to an exact real-world spot rather than to the first detected plane.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪（在真实地点贴一张海报作为标记）模拟 VPS，把内容锚定在固定位置；变体：内容只在特定时间段出现。
works.description_zh: 一个借助视觉定位系统（VPS）锚定在特定真实地点的实时 WebAR 体验。
works.idea_en: Content pinned to a real place, so everyone who comes sees the same thing in the same spot.
works.technique_zh: 基于浏览器的 VPS 把相机画面与预先扫描的地点地图进行匹配，恢复 6DoF 位姿，因此内容被锚定在一个精确的真实位置，而不是第一个检测到的平面上。
works.exercise_en: Simulate VPS with image tracking (put a poster at a real location as the marker) and anchor content at a fixed spot. Twist: the content appears only during a certain time window.

works.title: Vibe-coding an AR game inside Quest 3 with Gemini 3
works.description: Without leaving the headset, the author asks Gemini 3 by voice in the Quest browser to build a WebXR game, and plays the generated AR game in his room moments later.
works.description_zh: 作者不摘头显，在 Quest 浏览器里用语音让 Gemini 3 做一个 WebXR 游戏，片刻之后就在自己的房间里玩上了生成的 AR 游戏。
works.idea_en: The holodeck is real: describe a game and play it in your room a minute later.
works.idea_zh: “全息甲板”成真了：描述一个游戏，一分钟后就在你房间里玩。
works.technique: Gemini's Canvas generates a single-page WebXR app from a spoken prompt, which runs immediately in the headset browser with passthrough.
works.technique_zh: Gemini 的 Canvas 根据语音提示生成单页 WebXR 应用，在头显浏览器里带透视画面立即运行。
works.exercise_en: In a headset or phone browser, ask an AI assistant for a one-file WebXR game in one sentence, play it, then improve it with three more spoken requests. Twist: the game must use the real floor as the main mechanic.
works.exercise_zh: 在头显或手机浏览器里，用一句话让 AI 助手写一个单文件 WebXR 游戏，玩一玩，再用三句语音请求改进它。变体：游戏的核心机制必须用到真实地板。

video.video_title:
Today I vibe coded an AR game entirely within my Meta Quest 3, using Gemini 3. The holodeck is real!

Just go to https://t.co/HTxjikXqef in the Meta browser, toggle canvas, and ask (via voice) for a W

works.title: Video2MR
works.description: Turns any online sports or exercise video into a mixed-reality coach: the person in the 2D video becomes a 3D avatar in your room, with highlighted posture differences, motion trails, speed control and repositioning for other viewpoints.
works.description_zh: 把任意网上的运动或健身视频变成混合现实教练：视频里的人成为你房间中的三维虚拟人，并提供姿势差异高亮、动作轨迹、速度控制以及换视角的重新摆位。
works.idea_en: Lift the person out of a YouTube video and make them your 3D trainer.
works.idea_zh: 把人从 YouTube 视频里“拎出来”，变成你的三维教练。
works.technique: AI motion capture (DeepMotion) extracts 3D motion from 2D video to drive an avatar on HoloLens 2, while Azure Kinect tracks the user to compare postures and trigger augmentations.
works.technique_zh: 用 AI 动作捕捉（DeepMotion）从二维视频中提取三维动作，驱动 HoloLens 2 中的虚拟人，同时用 Azure Kinect 追踪用户，对比姿势并触发各种增强效果。
works.exercise_en: Take a ten-second dance or yoga clip, extract 3D motion with a free AI mocap tool (DeepMotion, Rokoko Video or MediaPipe), retarget it to a Mixamo character and stand it on the floor next to you in phone AR. Twist: slow the avatar down whenever your own pose, tracked with MediaPipe, drifts too far from it.
works.exercise_zh: 选一段十秒的舞蹈或瑜伽片段，用免费的 AI 动作捕捉工具（DeepMotion、Rokoko Video 或 MediaPipe）提取三维动作，重定向到 Mixamo 角色，在手机 AR 中让它站在你身旁的地面上。变体：当你自己的姿势（由 MediaPipe 追踪）偏离太多时，让虚拟人自动放慢。

video.video_title: [IUI 2025] Video2MR: Automatically Generating Mixed Reality 3D Instructions by Augmenting ...

works.title: VideoCraft
works.description: A mixed-reality workflow for concept videos of real spaces: film a room, place and adjust new virtual objects in MR as spatial layers, and a video-to-video generation model renders the final footage with the new elements blended in.
works.description_zh: 一个用混合现实制作真实空间概念视频的工作流：先拍下房间，在 MR 中以空间图层的形式放置和调整新的虚拟物体，再由视频到视频生成模型渲染出新元素自然融入的成片。
works.idea_en: Use MR to direct a generative video model with precise spatial layers.
works.idea_zh: 用 MR 提供精确的空间图层，来“导演”生成式视频模型。
works.technique: Placing objects in MR yields depth-aware object layers and camera paths that condition a video-to-video diffusion model, so inserted objects stay in place across frames.
works.technique_zh: 在 MR 中摆放物体得到带深度的物体图层和相机路径，用它们为视频到视频扩散模型提供条件，使插入的物体在各帧中保持位置稳定。
works.exercise_en: Record a short phone AR video in which a grey cube stands in for a new object, then feed the clip and a prompt ('a vintage armchair') to a video-to-video or image-to-video model and check whether the placement survives. Twist: film the same shot with and without the placeholder and discuss what the AI needs from AR.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 拍一段短视频，用灰色方块代替新物体，再把视频和提示词（“一把复古扶手椅”）交给视频到视频或图生视频模型，看摆放位置能否被保留。变体：同一镜头分别拍有占位物和没有占位物的两版，讨论 AI 需要 AR 提供什么。

video.video_title: VideoCraft

works.title: Walking With Pride: The Colours of History
works.description: A town-wide augmented reality trail and exhibition in King's Lynn that reveals the town's LGBTQ+ histories at the places where they happened, co-created with local young creatives.
works.description_zh: 遍布金斯林全城的 AR 路线与展览，在事件发生的原址揭示这座小镇的 LGBTQ+ 历史，由当地年轻创作者共同完成。
works.idea_en: Hidden histories reappear exactly where they happened when you raise your phone.
works.idea_zh: 举起手机，被隐藏的历史就在它发生的地方重新出现。
works.technique: Location-anchored phone AR places illustrated figures and stories at sites around the town centre, supported by printed trail maps and a gallery exhibition (likely WebAR image or geo anchors).
works.technique_zh: 基于位置的手机 AR 在市中心各处放置插画人物和故事，配合印刷路线图和画廊展览（很可能使用 WebAR 图像或地理锚点）。
works.exercise_en: Research one forgotten story from your neighbourhood, draw its main character and anchor it with WebAR at the real location. Twist: the character must point toward the next stop of the trail.
works.exercise_zh: 调查你所在街区的一个被遗忘的故事，画出主角，用 WebAR 把它锚定在真实地点；变体：角色必须指向路线的下一站。

video.video_title: Collusion presents // Walking With Pride: The Colours of History - documentary

works.title: Wisp World (Liquid City)
works.description: An AR/AI game for Snap Spectacles and Vision Pro where the player talks with a small spirit character, Wisp, who explores and comments on the real room.
works.idea_zh: 与会说话的小精灵在真实房间里冒险的AI+AR游戏

video.video_title: Wisp World for Snap Spectacles - an AI / AR game

works.technique: Headset scene understanding (meshing/semantic labels) plus a camera-to-LLM loop lets a small animated character navigate real surfaces and speak about recognised objects.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity AR 中放一个会沿检测平面移动的小角色，用拍照 + 视觉语言模型让它对房间里的物品发表一句评论；变体：给角色一个固定性格（胆小、傲慢），让它的评论和行走路径都体现这种性格。
works.description_zh: 一款面向 Snap Spectacles 和 Vision Pro 的 AR/AI 游戏：玩家与一个名叫 Wisp 的小精灵角色对话，它会在真实房间里四处探索并发表评论。
works.idea_en: An AI and AR game in which you go on adventures with a talking little spirit in your real room.
works.technique_zh: 头显的场景理解（网格化和语义标签）加上“相机画面 → 大语言模型”的循环，让一个小动画角色能在真实表面上移动，并谈论它识别出的物体。
works.exercise_en: Place a small character in Unity AR that moves along detected planes, and use a photo plus a vision-language model to have it comment on an object in the room. Twist: give the character a fixed personality (timid or arrogant) that shows in both its comments and its walking path.

works.title: XR Blocks and Vibe Coding XR
works.description: An open-source WebXR framework that packages hands, depth, physics and AI agents into high-level blocks, so that a single text prompt to Gemini can generate a working interactive XR prototype.
works.description_zh: 一个开源 WebXR 框架，把手势、深度、物理和 AI 智能体封装成高层积木，于是只需给 Gemini 一句文字提示，就能生成一个可交互的 XR 原型。
works.idea_en: Make XR prototyping as quick as describing the idea in a sentence.
works.idea_zh: 让 XR 原型制作像用一句话描述想法一样快。
works.technique: The framework abstracts sensor input and scene understanding into a small script API, which an LLM can target reliably when it writes the app code.
works.technique_zh: 框架把传感器输入和场景理解抽象成简洁的脚本 API，大语言模型写应用代码时可以稳定地调用它。
works.exercise_en: In pairs, write a one-sentence XR idea, have an LLM generate a WebXR scene from it and iterate three times in class. Twist: swap prompts with another pair and remix.
works.exercise_zh: 两人一组写一句话的 XR 创意，让大语言模型生成 WebXR 场景，并在课堂上迭代三次。变体：与另一组交换提示词再混编。

video.video_title: Vibe Coding XR: Accelerating AI + XR Prototyping with XR Blocks and Gemini

works.title: XR Worlds
works.description: A Spectacles proof of concept that turns a 2D drawing on paper into a playable XR world, using a generative world model.
works.idea_zh: 把纸上的二维涂鸦变成可玩的XR世界。

video.video_title: XR Worlds - Spectacles

works.technique: A camera capture of a paper drawing is sent to a generative world model that returns a playable environment, which is then displayed in the glasses.
works.exercise_zh: 拍一张手绘关卡草图，识别其中的线条作为平台，在 AR 中生成可以让小球滚动的关卡；变体：用不同颜色的笔代表不同物理材质。
works.description_zh: 一个 Spectacles 概念验证：借助生成式世界模型，把纸上的一幅二维涂鸦变成可以游玩的 XR 世界。
works.idea_en: Turn a 2D doodle on paper into a playable XR world.
works.technique_zh: 相机拍下纸上的画，发送给生成式世界模型，模型返回一个可游玩的环境，随后在眼镜中显示。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a hand-drawn level sketch, detect its lines as platforms, and generate an AR level a ball can roll through. Twist: use pens of different colors to stand for different physical materials.

works.title: XR-penter
works.description: A casual woodworker registers a pile of scrap boards in a mixed-reality headset, designs a chair from exactly those pieces at full scale in the room, then sees cut lines overlaid on the real boards before sawing and drilling.
works.description_zh: 业余木工把一堆废木板录入混合现实头显，在房间里按真实尺寸用这些木板设计一把椅子，然后在锯切和钻孔之前看到叠加在真实木板上的切割线。
works.idea_en: Design furniture in place from the scrap wood you actually have.
works.idea_zh: 用你手头真有的废木料，在原地设计家具。
works.technique: The headset records each scrap board's dimensions, aligns the design frame to the floor using the scene mesh, and overlays cut positions on the physical boards.
works.technique_zh: 头显记录每块废木板的尺寸，借助场景网格把设计框架与地面对齐，并在实物木板上叠加切割位置。
works.exercise_en: Measure five cardboard pieces, load them as virtual blocks in a Quest or phone AR scene, and have students build a full-size stool from only those blocks. Twist: the stool must fit one particular corner of the classroom.
works.exercise_zh: 测量五块纸板，把它们作为虚拟积木导入 Quest 或手机 AR 场景，让学生只用这些积木按真实尺寸拼出一张凳子。变体：凳子必须正好放进教室的某个角落。

video.video_title: XR-penter: Material-Aware and In Situ Design of Scrap Wood Assemblies (CHI '25)

works.title: agentAR
works.description: An in-situ AR authoring system: describe an AR app in plain language and an LLM agent builds it on the spot, choosing tracking, interface and logic tools from a library distilled from AR research.
works.description_zh: 一个就地创作 AR 的系统：用自然语言描述你想要的 AR 应用，大语言模型智能体就会从提炼自 AR 研究的工具库中挑选追踪、界面和逻辑组件，当场替你搭建出来。
works.idea_en: Let an AI agent assemble AR apps from research-proven building blocks while you only describe what you want.
works.idea_zh: 你只管描述需求，让 AI 智能体用经过研究验证的积木拼出 AR 应用。
works.technique: A tool-augmented LLM agent plans against a structured AR application template and calls functions from a tool library (object detection, anchoring, UI, triggers) to generate and run the app in the headset.
works.technique_zh: 一个可调用工具的大语言模型智能体按照结构化的 AR 应用模板做规划，并调用工具库中的函数（物体检测、锚定、界面、触发器），在头显中生成并运行应用。
works.exercise_en: Define five Unity or Lens Studio functions (spawnObject, attachLabel, onObjectSeen, playSound, showTimer), expose them to an LLM through function calling, type 'remind me to drink when I look at my cup' and watch the agent wire them together. Twist: make the agent ask one clarifying question before it builds anything.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity 或 Lens Studio 里定义五个函数（spawnObject、attachLabel、onObjectSeen、playSound、showTimer），通过函数调用开放给大语言模型，输入“当我看向杯子时提醒我喝水”，观察智能体如何把它们串起来。变体：要求智能体在动手搭建之前先问一个澄清问题。

video.video_title: UIST 2025 agentAR: Creating AR Applications withTool-Augmented LLM-based Autonomous Agents

works.title: nino
works.description: A performance at Trafó Budapest in which dancers and then audience members animate avatars in surreal landscapes, captured without suits by an AI camera so anyone can step in and move a character.
works.description_zh: 在布达佩斯 Trafó 的演出：先是舞者、后是观众驱动超现实风景中的化身，由 AI 摄像头无需动捕服即可捕捉，任何人都能走进来操控一个角色。
works.idea_en: Suit-free mocap turns every visitor into a puppeteer of a dreamlike avatar.
works.idea_zh: 无需动捕服的动作捕捉，让每位观众都成为梦幻化身的操偶师。
works.technique: Markerless AI motion capture (RADiCAL) streams audience poses into Unreal Engine avatars projected on large vertical screens.
works.technique_zh: 无标记 AI 动作捕捉（RADiCAL）把观众姿态实时传入 Unreal Engine 化身，投映在大型竖幅屏幕上。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam pose model to drive a rigged character projected on a wall, and invite passers-by to take over. Twist: the avatar keeps the last visitor's habits for a few seconds after they leave.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头姿态模型驱动投在墙上的绑定角色，邀请路人轮流接管；变体：上一位观众离开后，化身还会保留他的动作习惯几秒钟。

video.video_title: Audience interaction

works.title: three.js in real life
works.description: A three.js scene pulled off the screen and placed in the physical world with AR.
works.idea_zh: 把网页 3D 引擎的效果搬到现实里。

video.video_title: This is what three.js looks like in real life https://t.co/h71pIPc5CG

works.technique: An existing three.js scene is wrapped in a WebXR immersive-ar session, placed at a hit-test point, and scaled to real-world units.
works.exercise_zh: 从 three.js 官方示例中挑一个，加上 WebXR AR 会话和 hit-test 放到真实地面上；变体：调整比例让它变得非常大或非常小，观察感受的变化。
works.description_zh: 把一个 three.js 场景从屏幕里“拽”出来，通过 AR 放进物理世界。
works.idea_en: Move the effects of a web 3D engine out into the real world.
works.technique_zh: 现有的 three.js 场景被包进一个 WebXR immersive-ar 会话，放在命中测试点上，并按真实世界单位进行缩放。
works.exercise_en: Pick one of the official three.js examples, add a WebXR AR session and a hit test, and put it on the real floor. Twist: change its scale to make it very large or very small, and notice how the experience changes.

works.title: A Rubik's Cube Game with a Real Cube
works.description: A Bluetooth smart Rubik's cube becomes the controller: every real twist rotates and changes a puzzle world he built in Unity.
works.idea_zh: 拧真实的魔方来操控游戏世界。

video.video_title: Making a Rubik's Cube Game with a Real Cube

works.technique: The GAN smart cube reports each face turn over Bluetooth, and Unity maps those moves to rotations of the in-game level.
works.exercise_zh: 用带陀螺仪的手机或 micro:bit 当'魔方'，转动它来旋转屏幕里的迷宫让小球滚到出口；加一个变化：摇一摇会让迷宫重新生成。
works.description_zh: 一个蓝牙智能魔方成为游戏手柄：每次拧动真实魔方，都会旋转并改变他在 Unity 中搭建的解谜世界。
works.idea_en: Twist a real Rubik's cube to control a game world.
works.technique_zh: GAN 智能魔方通过蓝牙上报每一次面的转动，Unity 再把这些操作映射为游戏关卡的旋转。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone with a gyroscope or a micro:bit as the 'cube', and rotate it to tilt an on-screen maze so a ball rolls to the exit. Twist: shaking it regenerates the maze.

works.title: AI-driven virtual try-on
works.description: A browser-based try-on concept dresses the user in a chosen garment using generative AI, with default outfits and a simple shop flow.
works.description_zh: 一个浏览器里的试穿概念：用生成式 AI 给用户穿上选中的衣服，带默认服装和简单购物流程。
works.idea_en: The mirror becomes a fitting room that can dress you in anything.
works.idea_zh: 镜子变成试衣间，能给你穿上任何衣服。
works.technique: A photo of the user and a garment image are sent to a virtual try-on diffusion model; the result is shown inside a WebAR/Mattercraft interface.
works.technique_zh: 把用户照片和服装图片发送给虚拟试穿扩散模型，结果显示在 WebAR / Mattercraft 界面中。
works.exercise_en: Build a webcam page that captures a selfie and calls a hosted try-on model with three garment images, then shows the results side by side. Twist: try on clothes from a painting in a museum.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个网页，用摄像头拍自拍，调用在线试穿模型配三件衣服，并排展示结果。变体：试穿博物馆画作里的衣服。

video.video_title:
Thrilled to share an improved version of my AI-driven try-on concept. Now built in Mattercraft (@ZapparApp). 

This brings a better experience with features like default clothing options, a simple e-c

works.title: AI-generated 3D models with Luma Genie in mixed reality
works.description: From inside Figmin XR's built-in web browser, users generate 3D models with Luma Genie from a text prompt and drop them straight into their mixed-reality scene.
works.description_zh: 在 Figmin XR 内置浏览器里，用户用文字提示通过 Luma Genie 生成三维模型，并直接放进自己的混合现实场景。
works.idea_en: Say an object and place it on your real table a minute later.
works.idea_zh: 说出一个物体，一分钟后把它放在你真实的桌子上。
works.technique: A text-to-3D service (Luma Genie) returns a textured mesh that is imported through the in-app browser into the MR scene graph.
works.technique_zh: 文生三维服务（Luma Genie）返回带贴图的网格，通过应用内浏览器导入混合现实场景。
works.exercise_en: Generate three props for a tiny story with a free text-to-3D tool and stage them on a desk with WebAR. Twist: each prop must be generated from a line of dialogue spoken by another prop.
works.exercise_zh: 用免费文生三维工具为一个小故事生成三件道具，用 WebAR 摆在桌上。变体：每件道具都必须由另一件道具说的一句台词生成。

video.video_title: AI generated 3D models with Luma Genie

works.title: AR with a magnifying glass
works.description: A real magnifying glass is moved over a table of drawings and objects; only the area inside the lens is transformed on screen by generative AI into detailed landscapes and hidden worlds.
works.description_zh: 一把真实的放大镜在摆满画和物件的桌面上移动；屏幕上只有镜片里的区域被生成式 AI 变成细致的风景和隐藏的世界。
works.idea_en: A magnifying glass that reveals imaginary worlds inside ordinary things.
works.idea_zh: 一把能在普通物件里看见想象世界的放大镜。
works.technique: The lens is tracked in real time and only its crop of the camera image is fed to a real-time diffusion model (StreamDiffusion-style), whose output is composited back inside the lens outline.
works.technique_zh: 实时追踪放大镜，只把镜片范围内的摄像画面送入实时扩散模型（类似 StreamDiffusion），生成结果再合成回镜片轮廓内。
works.exercise_en: Track a cardboard ring with a webcam and apply a strong filter or AI style only inside the ring. Twist: what appears inside depends on the colour of the object under it.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头追踪一个纸板圆环，只在圆环内部施加强烈滤镜或 AI 风格。变体：圆环里出现什么，取决于下面物体的颜色。

video.video_title: AR with a magnifying glass!

works.title: ARCADE
works.description: Players sit at retro arcade cabinets in a pitch-dark container and steer an avatar through a war-torn world; there is almost nothing to see, so the game plays out as 360-degree sound and physical effects around them.
works.description_zh: 玩家坐在漆黑集装箱里的复古街机前，操控一个化身穿越战火中的世界；几乎什么都看不见，游戏以环绕四周的 360 度声音和实体效果展开。
works.idea_en: A video game with the video removed: you become the avatar through sound.
works.idea_zh: 拿掉画面的电子游戏：你通过声音成为游戏里的角色。
works.technique: Branching choose-your-own-path audio is driven by arcade controls, with binaural sound and sensory effects replacing the screen.
works.technique_zh: 街机操纵杆驱动一条可自选路径的分支音频，双耳声音和感官效果取代了屏幕。
works.exercise_en: Make a 5-choice audio adventure controlled by a joystick or Makey Makey, played in a dark room with headphones. Twist: add one moment where the player must physically stand up or turn around to continue.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个用摇杆或 Makey Makey 控制、包含 5 个选择的音频冒险，在暗室里戴耳机游玩；变体：加入一个必须站起来或转身才能继续的时刻。

video.video_title: ARCADE Trailer - DARKFIELD

works.title: ARSports
works.description: A wearable AR prototype for low-vision players that outlines the ball and the other players with bright segmentation masks in near real time during basketball and tennis.
works.description_zh: 为低视力运动者打造的可穿戴 AR 原型：在篮球和网球中，近乎实时地用醒目的分割轮廓标出球和其他球员。
works.idea_en: Let a vision model highlight the only things that matter in a fast game: the ball and the people.
works.idea_zh: 让视觉模型在快节奏比赛里只高亮最重要的东西：球和人。
works.technique: Instance-segmentation models fine-tuned on new first-person basketball and tennis datasets process ZED Mini stereo video on a Quest 2 and render high-contrast masks over the passthrough view.
works.technique_zh: 在新采集的第一人称篮球与网球数据集上微调实例分割模型，处理 Quest 2 上 ZED Mini 双目视频，并在透视画面上渲染高对比度遮罩。
works.exercise_en: Run a pretrained ball-and-person detector (YOLO or MediaPipe) on the phone camera in a web AR page and draw thick neon outlines around the ball; play catch with a partner and tune the colors until the ball is easiest to follow. Twist: leave a fading trail behind the ball so its trajectory becomes readable.
works.exercise_zh: 在网页 AR 页面里对手机摄像头画面运行预训练的球和人检测模型（YOLO 或 MediaPipe），给球加上粗霓虹描边；和同伴玩抛接球，调整颜色直到球最容易追踪。变体：在球身后留下渐隐的轨迹，让它的运动路线一目了然。

video.video_title: Towards AI-Powered AR for Enhancing Sports Playability for People with Low Vision

works.title: AirDraw – Finger Paint AR for Vision Pro
works.description: Finger-painting in 3D space on Apple Vision Pro, later extended with the Logitech Muse stylus for 3D calligraphy and a voxel brush.
works.idea_zh: 在 Vision Pro 里直接用手指在空中作画。

video.video_title: AirDraw - Finger Paint AR for Vision Pro

works.technique: visionOS hand tracking gives fingertip joint positions each frame, and a pinch gesture starts appending those points to a stroke mesh in RealityKit.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands 在网页里追踪食指尖，捏合时在 three.js 场景中留下 3D 线条；变体：把笔刷换成方块体素，做一个空中积木。
works.description_zh: 在 Apple Vision Pro 上用手指在三维空间中作画，后来又加入了 Logitech Muse 触控笔，用于 3D 书法和体素笔刷。
works.idea_en: Paint in the air with your finger inside Vision Pro.
works.technique_zh: visionOS 手部追踪每帧提供指尖关节的位置，捏合手势开始后，这些点会被不断追加到 RealityKit 中的笔画网格上。
works.exercise_en: Track the index fingertip on a web page with MediaPipe Hands and leave 3D lines in a three.js scene while pinching. Twist: swap the brush for voxel cubes and build blocks in mid-air.

works.title: Audience-Controlled Tracks at Totally Wired EMOM
works.description: At an electronic music open mic in Chorlton, musician Thunkist hands Flowfal devices to people in the pub so the audience's movements shape the track being played.
works.description_zh: 在 Chorlton 的一场电子音乐开放麦上，音乐人 Thunkist 把 Flowfal 设备交给酒吧里的观众，让观众的动作塑造正在播放的曲子。
works.idea_en: The crowd, not the performer, holds the controls.
works.idea_zh: 掌握控制权的是观众，而不是表演者。
works.technique: Several phones or watches running Flowfal stream motion to Ableton Live, where each device is mapped to a different layer or effect of the track.
works.technique_zh: 多部运行 Flowfal 的手机或手表把动作数据传给 Ableton Live，每台设备映射到曲子中不同的声部或效果。
works.exercise_en: Give four students phones that each control one layer of a web loop by shaking them, and let the room build the track together. Twist: a layer only plays while its phone is being passed from hand to hand.
works.exercise_zh: 发给四名学生每人一部手机，摇动手机分别控制网页循环曲的一个声部，让全场一起搭出一首曲子；变体：某个声部只有在手机被人传来传去时才会响。

video.video_title: Thunkist using Flowfal at Totally Wired EMOM - Sept 2024

works.title: Augmented Burtonesque (The World of Tim Burton)
works.description: In the atrium of London's Design Museum, visitors raise their phones to open a space-themed Burtonesque fantasy world that extends Tim Burton's exhibition into the building itself.
works.description_zh: 在伦敦设计博物馆的中庭，观众举起手机就能打开一个太空主题的“伯顿风”奇幻世界，把 Tim Burton 的展览延伸到整栋建筑中。
works.idea_en: Extend an artist's exhibition beyond the gallery walls into the shared public space of the museum.
works.idea_zh: 把艺术家的展览延伸到展厅之外，进入博物馆的公共空间。
works.technique: A location-anchored world Lens (likely a custom Landmarker of the atrium) places large animated Burton-style characters and sets at architectural scale.
works.technique_zh: 用锚定在特定地点的世界 Lens（很可能是中庭的自定义地标）以建筑尺度摆放伯顿风格的大型动画角色与布景。
works.exercise_en: Pick a lobby or stairwell and design an AR 'takeover' in the visual style of an artist you admire, sized to the real architecture. Twist: the takeover only appears when the space is almost empty.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个大厅或楼梯间，按照你欣赏的艺术家的风格设计一次与真实建筑尺度匹配的 AR“占领”；变体：只有当空间几乎没人时，这次占领才会出现。

video.video_title: Augmented Burtonesque - The Design Museum x Snapchat

works.title: Augmented Inspection (Vision Hack)
works.description: An Apple Vision Pro app lets an operator monitor and teleoperate a Boston Dynamics Spot robot with hand gestures and voice, seeing its camera feed and point cloud in space.
works.idea_zh: 戴上头显，用手势和语音远程巡检、操控机器狗。

video.video_title: Team Circuit - Final Video Vision Hack (2024.09.15)

works.technique: Hand tracking and speech on Vision Pro drive robot commands, while the robot's camera stream and point cloud are rendered as spatial panels.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 和一个遥控小车，做'远程巡检'：手机上看到小车摄像头画面并用手势让它转向；加一个变化：发现某种颜色物体时自动标注。
works.description_zh: 一款 Apple Vision Pro 应用，操作员可以用手势和语音监控并远程操控 Boston Dynamics 的 Spot 机器狗，同时在空间中看到它的相机画面和点云。
works.idea_en: Put on a headset and use gestures and voice to inspect and steer a robot dog remotely.
works.technique_zh: Vision Pro 上的手部追踪和语音驱动机器人指令，同时把机器人的相机视频流和点云渲染为空间面板。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR and a remote-control car to run a 'remote inspection': watch the car's camera feed on the phone and steer it with hand gestures. Twist: automatically tag objects of a certain color when they are spotted.

works.title: Augmented Physics
works.description: Photograph a static physics textbook diagram and it becomes an interactive simulation in place: pendulums swing, pulleys move and parameters can be changed.
works.idea_zh: 拍一张课本里的物理图，图就活过来成为可以调参数的模拟。

video.video_title: [UIST 2024] Augmented Physics: Creating Interactive and Embedded Physics Simulations from Static ...

works.technique: Diagram elements in a textbook image are segmented (e.g. with SAM), recognized as physics primitives such as pendulums, pulleys or ramps, and reconstructed as a 2D physics simulation overlaid on the original figure.
works.exercise_zh: 拍一张物理课本的示意图（斜面、单摆或滑轮），手动或用分割工具裁出各部件，在 Matter.js 中重建为可运动的模拟并叠加回原图；变体：允许读者改动一个“现实里改不了”的参数（比如重力朝上）。
works.description_zh: 拍下物理课本上一张静态的示意图，它就会在原处变成可交互的模拟：单摆摆动，滑轮转动，参数也可以修改。
works.idea_en: Photograph a physics diagram in a textbook and it comes alive as a simulation you can tune.
works.technique_zh: 对课本图像中的示意图元素进行分割（例如使用 SAM），识别为单摆、滑轮、斜面等物理基元，再重建为叠加在原图上的二维物理模拟。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a diagram from a physics textbook (an incline, a pendulum or a pulley), cut out each part by hand or with a segmentation tool, rebuild it as a moving simulation in Matter.js and overlay it on the original figure. Twist: let readers change a parameter that cannot be changed in real life (such as gravity pointing up).

works.title: Between Information and Noise
works.description: A daily practice on dance and VR, recorded in 360° at the Akademie für Theater und Digitalität: Jorge dances among a seated audience while the virtual layer of the piece appears as projected light lines, and each session is shared as a 360 video.
works.description_zh: 在 Akademie für Theater und Digitalität 进行的一项舞蹈与 VR 日常练习，全程以 360° 录制：Jorge 在围坐的观众之间起舞，作品的虚拟层以投影光线的形式出现，每一次练习都作为 360 视频发布。
works.idea_en: Let the audience sit inside the dance and see both the body and its virtual trace at once.
works.idea_zh: 让观众坐在舞蹈之中，同时看到身体和它在虚拟空间中的痕迹。
works.technique: Likely a tracked VR headset or controllers feed his movement into a real-time 3D scene that is projected into the room, while a 360 camera records both layers from the centre.
works.technique_zh: 很可能用带追踪的 VR 头显或手柄把他的动作送入实时三维场景并投影到房间里，同时在中央架设 360 摄像机把两层画面一起记录下来。
works.exercise_en: Put a 360 camera in the middle of a circle of classmates and have a dancer draw light lines in a VR painting app that are projected on the wall behind them. Twist: rotate who wears the headset every minute.
works.exercise_zh: 在围坐的同学中间放一台 360 相机，让舞者在 VR 绘画应用里画出光线，同时投影到他们身后的墙上；变体：每分钟轮换一次戴头显的人。

video.video_title: 2024 01 26_ 45"_Performance_360-video }{ Between Information and Noise :: a Practice on dance and VR

works.title: Bioluminescence
works.description: Glowing sea creatures drawn by workshop participants swim across the historic buildings of Chatham Dockyard at night as a large projected artwork for Electric Medway's Nocturnal festival event.
works.description_zh: 工作坊参与者画出的发光海洋生物，在夜晚游过查塔姆历史船坞的建筑外墙，成为 Electric Medway 夜间活动 Nocturnal 上的大型投影作品。
works.idea_en: Everyone's hand-drawn deep-sea creature ends up glowing on a heritage building.
works.idea_zh: 每个人手绘的深海生物，最终都在历史建筑上发光游动。
works.technique: Participants draw creatures in Procreate, which are animated and composited in TouchDesigner and Resolume and then projection-mapped onto the facades with Projection Mapper (formerly Dynamapper).
works.technique_zh: 参与者先在 Procreate 里画出生物，再用 TouchDesigner 和 Resolume 做动画与合成，最后用 Projection Mapper（原 Dynamapper）投影映射到建筑立面上。
works.exercise_en: Have each student draw a glowing sea creature on a tablet, animate it with a simple wiggle, and project the whole school of creatures onto a classroom wall or the outside of the building at dusk. Twist: add a webcam so the creatures scatter when someone walks past.
works.exercise_zh: 让每位学生在平板上画一只发光的海洋生物，给它加上简单的摆动动画，傍晚时把所有生物一起投到教室墙面或建筑外墙上；变体：加一个摄像头，有人走过时生物四散游开。

video.video_title: Bioluminescence by Cybersaur Arts with The Historic Dockyard Chatham

works.title: Blackbox for Vision
works.description: Blackbox rebuilt for Apple Vision Pro: bubble-like puzzles float in your room and are solved by looking, reaching, speaking and moving through space instead of pressing buttons.
works.idea_zh: 没有按钮的谜题：用注视、手势、声音和身体移动去解开漂浮在房间里的谜。

video.video_title: Blackbox for Vision

works.technique: Puzzles hide their input rules in non-obvious channels such as gaze dwell, reach distance, voice and body movement, detected with visionOS gaze, hand tracking and audio input.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个没有按钮的 AR 谜题，玩家必须通过走近、说话或保持静止等非常规方式解开；变体：谜题的提示只能通过声音获得。
works.description_zh: 为 Apple Vision Pro 重新打造的 Blackbox：泡泡般的谜题漂浮在你的房间里，解谜靠的不是按按钮，而是注视、伸手、说话和在空间中移动。
works.idea_en: Puzzles with no buttons: solve the riddles floating in your room with your gaze, gestures, voice and body movement.
works.technique_zh: 谜题把输入规则藏在不显眼的通道里，例如注视停留、伸手距离、声音和身体移动，并通过 visionOS 的视线追踪、手部追踪和音频输入来检测。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR puzzle with no buttons that players must solve in unusual ways such as walking closer, speaking or staying still. Twist: the hints can only be heard, never seen.

works.title: BlendScape
works.description: Video-call participants type or speak a theme and their separate backgrounds are blended by AI into one shared scene, like a single cafe or classroom that everyone appears to sit in.
works.description_zh: 视频通话的参与者输入或说出一个主题，AI 就把各自的背景融合成一个共享场景，比如大家仿佛坐在同一间咖啡馆或教室里。
works.idea_en: Let meeting participants generate the shared place they meet in.
works.idea_zh: 让开会的人自己生成他们见面的地点。
works.technique: Composites segmented participants into AI-generated environments that blend their physical or digital backgrounds, steered with multimodal prompts and direct manipulation.
works.technique_zh: 把分割出来的参与者合成进 AI 生成的环境，这些环境融合了他们的实体或数字背景，并可通过多模态提示和直接操作来调整。
works.exercise_en: Run a class video call where each student picks a virtual background that continues a shared panorama, so together the tiles form one scene. Twist: change the scene in the middle of a story each student tells.
works.exercise_zh: 开一次班级视频通话，每个学生选择一张能接续共享全景图的虚拟背景，让所有画面拼成一个完整场景；变体：在每个学生讲故事的过程中切换场景。

video.video_title: BlendScape: Enabling End-User Customization of Video-Conferencing Environments through Generative AI

works.title: Chameleon
works.description: A camera-driven digital being that mimics passers-by's movement and appearance, shown on screens in East London streets, malls and later Venice and Beijing.
works.idea_zh: 街头会模仿你的数字变色龙生物

video.video_title: Chameleon in the streets, East London

works.technique: Camera-based computer vision (pose estimation plus colour sampling) lets a generative creature copy the passer-by's movement and clothing colours on a public screen.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 和摄像头取色，做一个模仿观众姿态并采用其衣服颜色的抽象生物；变体：让生物只模仿画面中最安静的那个人。
works.description_zh: 一个由摄像头驱动的数字生命，会模仿路人的动作和外貌，曾在伦敦东区的街头和商场屏幕上展出，后来又去了威尼斯和北京。
works.idea_en: A digital chameleon creature on the street that imitates you.
works.technique_zh: 基于摄像头的计算机视觉（姿态估计加颜色采样）让一个生成式生物在公共屏幕上模仿路人的动作和衣服颜色。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Pose and camera color sampling to make an abstract creature that mimics a viewer's pose and takes on the colors of their clothes. Twist: let the creature imitate only the stillest person in the frame.

salient.why_en: A digital creature on the street copies how passers-by move and look, like a chameleon.
salient.why_zh: 街头的数字生物像变色龙一样，模仿路人的动作和样子。

works.title: Chromatic Distortion Sphere
works.description: A floating bubble bends the scene behind it and splits the light into rainbow fringes, wobbling like a soap bubble.
works.description_zh: 一个漂浮的气泡扭曲了身后的场景，把光分成彩虹色的边缘，像肥皂泡一样晃动。
works.idea_en: A sphere that refracts the world with a rainbow edge instantly reads as magic.
works.idea_zh: 一个带彩虹边缘、折射世界的球，一眼就像魔法。
works.technique: The shader samples the opaque scene texture with offsets along the surface normal, separately for red, green and blue, and adds a Fresnel rim and vertex wobble.
works.technique_zh: 着色器沿表面法线偏移采样不透明场景纹理，红绿蓝三个通道分别偏移，再加上菲涅尔边缘光和顶点晃动。
works.exercise_en: Float the chromatic bubble in phone AR so it distorts the real camera image behind it, and let users pop it with a tap. Twist: the bubble follows the user's hand.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中让色散气泡漂浮起来，扭曲它后面的真实相机画面，用户点击就能戳破它。变体：气泡跟着用户的手走。

video.video_title: Chromatic Aberration Distortion Bubble Shader

works.title: City Carpet AR
works.description: A children's city play-rug comes alive: tiny cars drive along the printed roads, stop at red lights and move aside for police cars, seen through Spectacles or the Snapchat app. Left running, the carpet city eventually jams into full gridlock.
works.description_zh: 一块儿童城市游戏地毯活了过来：小汽车沿着印在地毯上的道路行驶，遇红灯停车，给警车让路，可以用 Spectacles 或 Snapchat 观看。放着不管，地毯城市最后会堵成一团。
works.idea_en: Bring a printed toy map to life with autonomous traffic.
works.idea_zh: 让印刷的玩具地图长出自动驾驶的交通。
works.technique: The rug is tracked as an image marker; cars follow hand-placed waypoints along the roads and use simple rules (collision checks, traffic lights, yielding to police) with only a few cars checking at a time for performance.
works.technique_zh: 地毯作为图像标记被追踪；小车沿着手工放置在道路上的路径点行驶，使用简单规则（碰撞检测、红绿灯、给警车让路），并且每帧只让少数车辆做检测以节省性能。
works.exercise_en: Print a simple road map on A3, track it as an image target in Lens Studio or AR Foundation and make three cars loop along waypoints. Twist: add a tappable traffic light that makes all cars stop.
works.exercise_zh: 在 A3 纸上打印一张简单的道路图，用 Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation 作为图像目标追踪，让三辆小车沿路径点循环行驶；变体：加一个可以点击的红绿灯，让所有车停下。

video.video_title: City Carpet in Augmented Reality

works.title: Coachella 'Luminous' filter
works.description: A glowing, light-reactive face effect created for Coachella on Instagram, with behind-the-scenes on the makeup design and technical build.
works.idea_zh: 音乐节主题的发光妆容滤镜，让脸像舞台灯一样闪耀。

video.video_title: How I Made the Coachella "Luminous" AR Instagram Filter using Spark AR

works.technique: Face-attached emissive materials with bloom are modulated by camera luminance or light estimation, so the glow reacts to the surrounding lighting.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个会根据环境亮度改变发光强度的脸部滤镜，暗处更亮、亮处更淡；变体：用麦克风音量代替亮度来驱动发光。
works.description_zh: 为 Coachella 在 Instagram 上制作的一款会发光、会对光线作出反应的面部特效，并附有妆容设计和技术搭建的幕后解析。
works.idea_en: A festival-themed glowing makeup filter that makes your face shine like stage lights.
works.technique_zh: 贴合面部的自发光材质配合泛光（bloom）效果，由相机亮度或光照估计进行调制，让光晕随周围光线变化。
works.exercise_en: Make a face filter whose glow changes with ambient brightness, getting brighter in the dark and fainter in bright light. Twist: drive the glow with microphone volume instead of brightness.

works.title: Coachella 'MetaButterfly' filter
works.description: An Instagram AR effect for a Coachella campaign with butterfly-themed makeup effects on the face; Piskin walks through the inspiration, makeup and tech.
works.idea_zh: 为音乐节设计的蝴蝶幻彩妆容与翅膀AR滤镜。

video.video_title: How I Made the Coachella "MetaButterfly" AR Instagram Filter Using Spark AR

works.technique: Face-tracked butterfly meshes and makeup textures are anchored to facial landmarks, with wing animations driven by time or facial movement.
works.exercise_zh: 在脸上放几只沿眉毛或颧骨停驻的 AR 蝴蝶，张嘴时它们飞走；变体：蝴蝶飞离后会停到画面中的真实物体上。
works.description_zh: 为 Coachella 宣传活动制作的一款 Instagram AR 特效，在脸上呈现以蝴蝶为主题的妆容效果；Piskin 分享了其中的灵感、妆容和技术。
works.idea_en: An AR filter of iridescent butterfly makeup and wings designed for a music festival.
works.technique_zh: 受面部追踪的蝴蝶网格和妆容纹理锚定在面部关键点上，翅膀动画由时间或面部动作驱动。
works.exercise_en: Place a few AR butterflies that rest along the eyebrows or cheekbones and fly away when the mouth opens. Twist: after flying off, the butterflies land on real objects in the frame.

works.title: Conducting a virtual choir like Jacob Collier
works.description: Hand gestures tracked from a webcam conduct pitches and harmonies, imitating how Jacob Collier conducts his audience as a choir.
works.idea_zh: 像 Jacob Collier 指挥观众合唱一样，用手势在空中'指挥'和声。

video.video_title: Trying to turn myself into a singer remotely as good as a @jacobcollier audience using TouchDesigner and the MediaPipe plugin developed by myself and Dom Scott https://t.co/MxjGOHJ3pb

works.technique: Hand landmark height and spread from MediaPipe are mapped to musical pitch and chord voicing, with graphics overlaid on the live camera image.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands + Tone.js：手的高度控制音高，张开程度控制和弦；加一个变化：两个人一起合奏成二重唱。
works.description_zh: 通过网络摄像头追踪的手势来指挥音高与和声，模仿 Jacob Collier 把观众当作合唱团来指挥的方式。
works.idea_en: Conduct harmonies in the air with hand gestures, the way Jacob Collier conducts his audience as a choir.
works.technique_zh: 把 MediaPipe 手部关键点的高度和张开程度映射为音高与和弦排列，并把图形叠加在实时相机画面上。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Hands and Tone.js so that hand height controls pitch and hand spread controls the chord. Twist: have two people play together as a duet.

works.title: Constellation Plexus Ribbons
works.description: Glowing ribbons connect drifting particles into constellations that follow the mouse, like star maps being drawn in the air.
works.description_zh: 发光的丝带把漂浮的粒子连成星座，并跟随鼠标移动，像在空中画星图。
works.idea_en: Connect nearby points with light and a cloud of dots becomes a constellation.
works.idea_zh: 用光把相邻的点连起来，一团点就变成了星座。
works.technique: Unity's particle system emits particles with trails, and a script connects neighbouring particles with ribbon lines whose opacity depends on distance (plexus effect).
works.technique_zh: Unity 粒子系统发射带拖尾的粒子，脚本把相邻粒子用丝带线连接，线的透明度随距离变化（plexus 效果）。
works.exercise_en: Attach the plexus emitter to a tracked hand or the phone in AR so students draw constellations around the room. Twist: each student's constellation links to the others when they stand close.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把 plexus 发射器绑到追踪的手或手机上，让学生在房间里画星座。变体：学生站得近时，各自的星座会互相连起来。

Constellation Ribbons VFX: a midnight gift! 🎁 
This project has been uploaded to GitHub.

🔗 https://t.co/2aQlxXQTZx

works.title: CookAR
works.description: A head-mounted AR system for people with low vision that colors kitchen tools by affordance in real time: the handle of a knife or pan glows in a safe color, the blade or hot surface in a warning color.
works.description_zh: 为低视力人群设计的头戴式 AR 系统：实时按“能抓/别碰”给厨具上色——刀柄和锅柄亮成安全色，刀刃和高温表面亮成警示色。
works.idea_en: Color the world by what is safe to grab and what can hurt you.
works.idea_zh: 按“能抓”和“会伤人”来给世界上色。
works.technique: A segmentation model fine-tuned on a new egocentric dataset of kitchen-tool affordances runs on stereo-camera passthrough video and draws graspable and hazardous parts as colored overlays.
works.technique_zh: 在新采集的第一人称厨具可供性数据集上微调分割模型，处理双目相机透视视频，把可抓握部分和危险部分绘制成彩色叠加层。
works.exercise_en: Train a two-class segmentation or detection model (for example with Roboflow or Teachable Machine) on photos of mugs split into 'handle' and 'hot body', then overlay green and red masks on the live camera in a phone or Lens Studio AR app. Twist: replace the colors with sound, a soft tone near the handle and a harsh one near the hot part.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Roboflow 或 Teachable Machine 等工具，以马克杯照片训练一个区分“把手”和“杯身”的两类分割或检测模型，再在手机或 Lens Studio AR 应用里给实时画面叠加绿、红遮罩。变体：把颜色换成声音——手靠近把手时响起柔和音，靠近高温部分时响起刺耳音。

video.video_title: CookAR: Affordance Augmentations in Wearable AR to Support Cooking for People with Low Vision

salient.why_en: Kitchen tools glow safe where you can grab them and warn where they can hurt you.
salient.why_zh: 厨具上能抓的地方亮起安全色，会伤人的地方亮起警告色。

works.title: Dcam2: Stable Diffusion VJ set with DUB-Russell
works.description: At Channel 24, DUB-Russell's live set is accompanied by visuals in which camera footage is repainted by Stable Diffusion into glitchy, saturated illustrations.
works.description_zh: 在 Channel 24，DUB-Russell 的现场演出配上的视觉中，相机画面被 Stable Diffusion 重绘成带故障感的高饱和插画。
works.idea_en: Mix generative AI with body tracking for live visuals.
works.idea_zh: 把生成式 AI 与人体追踪混合，做现场视觉。
works.technique: Stable Diffusion image-to-image runs in real time on a Mac, combined with BodyPix segmentation and keypoints to place extra effects on performers (link between this video and the Dcam2 repo is likely but not stated).
works.technique_zh: 在 Mac 上实时运行 Stable Diffusion 图生图，并结合 BodyPix 分割和关键点给表演者加上额外特效（视频与 Dcam2 仓库的对应关系是推测，未明确说明）。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR filter that segments people and sends only the background to an image-to-image model, then composites the painted background behind them. Twist: the style changes each time the beat drops.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 滤镜：分割出人像，只把背景发给图生图模型，再把绘制好的背景合成回人身后。变体：每次节拍落下时换一种风格。

video.video_title: DUB-Russell with Keijiro Takahashi at Channel 24

works.title: Depth Scanner for Meta Quest 3
works.description: Walking outdoors with a Meta Quest 3, the headset's depth sensor paints the surroundings as a live cloud of points over passthrough; moving people and hands are tracked too, and the scan can be saved as a PLY file.
works.description_zh: 戴着 Meta Quest 3 在户外行走，头显的深度传感器在透视画面上把周围环境实时画成一片点云；走动的人和手也会被跟踪，扫描结果可以保存成 PLY 文件。
works.idea_en: The headset already sees depth; just show the user what it sees.
works.idea_zh: 头显本来就能看见深度，那就把它看到的东西直接展示给用户。
works.technique: The Meta XR SDK depth API provides the Quest 3 ToF/stereo depth texture; a shader and compute pass unproject each depth pixel with the camera intrinsics and pose into world-space points that are rendered in real time and accumulated for PLY export.
works.technique_zh: Meta XR SDK 的深度 API 提供 Quest 3 的深度纹理；着色器和计算通道用相机内参与位姿把每个深度像素反投影成世界空间的点，实时渲染，并累积起来导出为 PLY。
works.exercise_en: Turn the depth map of a Quest 3 or LiDAR iPhone into VFX Graph points in AR, colour them by distance, and export one snapshot. Twist: only points that changed since the last snapshot glow, so moving people light up.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把 Quest 3 或 LiDAR iPhone 的深度图变成 VFX Graph 点云，按距离着色，并导出一张快照。变体：只让与上一张快照相比发生变化的点发光，于是走动的人会亮起来。

video.video_title:
Quest 3のToFセンサーを使って点群が取れるDepth Scannerを使うとどんな感じか前の動画だと分かりづらかったから外で試してみた！ฅ(>ω<ฅ)✨
実際に取れた点群データはこんな感じ！
