works.title: DexteriSync
works.description: A water-cooled exoskeleton chills or warms the fingers so the wearer's dexterity drops or recovers on demand, letting a designer feel what fine tasks are like for an older person or a cold hand.
works.description_zh: 一副通水冷却的外骨骼可以按需冷却或加温手指，让佩戴者的灵巧度下降或恢复，设计师因此能亲身体会老人或冻僵的手做精细动作的感觉。
works.idea_en: Temperature is a dial for dexterity: cool the fingers to borrow someone else's hands.
works.idea_zh: 温度是灵巧度的旋钮：把手指冷下来，就能“借用”别人的手。
works.technique: Circulates temperature-controlled water through silicone-copper tubes along each finger to change skin temperature and thus finger dexterity and thermal perception.
works.technique_zh: 让温控水流经沿手指布置的硅胶铜管，改变皮肤温度，从而改变手指的灵巧度和冷热感受。
works.exercise_en: Have students button a shirt and type on a phone after holding an ice pack for one minute, then redesign one app screen for cold, clumsy fingers. Twist: add gloves of different thickness and chart the error rate.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生握冰袋一分钟后去扣衬衫、在手机上打字，再为冻僵、笨拙的手指重新设计一个 App 界面；变体：戴上不同厚度的手套，画出错误率变化曲线。

video.video_title: DexteriSync: A Hand Thermal I/O Exoskeleton for Morphing Finger Dexterity Experience

works.title: Dialogue with Great Souls
works.description: A street exhibition on Daxue Road, Shanghai with Soul App: scan a code, place an AR 'Anywhere Door' anywhere and step through into a scene to converse with eight historical sages.
works.idea_zh: 在街头放下一扇AR任意门，穿过去与古代先贤对话。

video.video_title: SOUL APP Dialogue with Great Souls

works.technique: A phone AR portal with stencil masking hides the inner scene until the user walks through the door plane, anchored at user-chosen positions along the street.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR做一扇任意门，门后是你选的一位历史人物的场景和一段语音，穿门才能听到；变化：门只能放在校园里与该人物有关的地点。
works.description_zh: 与 Soul App 合作、在上海大学路举办的一场街头展览：扫码后，可以在任意位置放下一扇 AR“任意门”，穿门而入，与八位历史先贤对话。
works.idea_en: Set down an AR 'Anywhere Door' on the street and walk through it to talk with ancient sages.
works.technique_zh: 手机 AR 传送门采用模板遮罩，在用户穿过门所在平面之前隐藏门内场景，门可以锚定在街道上用户自选的位置。
works.exercise_en: Build an Anywhere Door with phone AR that hides a scene of a historical figure of your choice and a voice clip you can only hear after walking through. Twist: the door can only be placed at campus locations connected to that figure.

works.title: DreamSpace
works.description: Type a style such as 'Van Gogh' or 'cyberpunk' and your own scanned room is re-textured in that style end to end, with coherent textures across walls, floor and furniture that you can walk through in a headset.
works.description_zh: 输入一个风格，比如“梵高”或“赛博朋克”，你扫描下来的房间就会整体换上这种风格的纹理，墙面、地板和家具之间保持一致，戴上头显就能走进去。
works.idea_en: Repaint your real room with a sentence while keeping its real geometry.
works.idea_zh: 用一句话重新粉刷你真实的房间，同时保留它的真实结构。
works.technique: A diffusion model first imagines a stylized 360-degree panoramic texture from the room's center, which is then propagated to occluded areas with inpainting and imitation and baked onto the reconstructed mesh.
works.technique_zh: 先用扩散模型从房间中心“想象”出一张风格化的 360 度全景纹理，再通过补全与模仿把纹理传播到被遮挡区域，烘焙到重建的网格上。
works.exercise_en: Scan a room corner with a LiDAR phone (Polycam or Reality Composer), take a 360 photo from the middle, restyle it with an image-to-image diffusion model, and project the stylized panorama back onto the mesh in Unity or Blender to view in AR or VR. Twist: restyle only the surfaces you have touched, so the room changes as you move through it.
works.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的手机（Polycam 或 Reality Composer）扫描房间一角，在房间中央拍一张 360 度照片，用图像到图像扩散模型改变风格，再在 Unity 或 Blender 中把风格化全景投射回网格，用 AR 或 VR 观看。变体：只重绘你摸过的表面，让房间随着你的走动逐渐变样。

video.video_title: DreamSpace: Dreaming Your Room Space with Text-Driven Panoramic Texture Propagation

works.title: Drones and fireworks at the Eiffel Tower
works.description: For Paris's national day in 2024, drones draw figures and symbols in the sky beside the Eiffel Tower while fireworks burst from the tower, mixing drawn images with explosions.
works.description_zh: 2024 年巴黎国庆日，无人机在埃菲尔铁塔旁的天空中绘出图形和符号，同时烟火从铁塔上迸发，绘出的图像与爆炸交织。
works.idea_en: Drones draw precise images while fireworks give raw energy; AR design can pair a readable, precise layer with a looser particle layer for impact.
works.idea_zh: 无人机画出精确的图像，烟火带来原始的能量；AR 设计也可以把一层清晰可读的内容和一层松散的粒子效果搭配起来，增强冲击力。
works.technique: A drone swarm flies pre-programmed formations timed to the music while pyrotechnics on the tower are fired from the same show-control timeline.
works.technique_zh: 无人机群按与音乐同步的预设阵形飞行，铁塔上的烟火由同一条演出控制时间线点燃。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR sky scene with two layers above a real landmark: a crisp line drawing made of points and a chaotic firework particle system, sharing one timeline. Twist: let the audience choose which layer wins in the finale.
works.exercise_zh: 在一个真实地标上空做一个两层的 AR 天空场景：一层是由点组成的清晰线描，一层是混乱的烟火粒子系统，两者共用一条时间线。变体：让观众选择终场时哪一层胜出。

video.video_title: drones and fireworks at the Eiffel Tower for Paris national day 2024

works.title: DrumPadVFX: finger drum visualizer
works.description: Each hit on a Yamaha finger drum pad launches a matching burst of shapes and particles on screen, in sync with the rhythm.
works.description_zh: 在 Yamaha 手指鼓垫上每敲一下，屏幕上就爆出对应的形状和粒子，与节奏同步。
works.idea_en: Each pad gets its own visual voice.
works.idea_zh: 每个鼓垫都有自己的视觉声音。
works.technique: Minis reads MIDI from the pad through the Input System and input binders fire VFX Graph events per note, built without writing code.
works.technique_zh: Minis 通过 Input System 读取鼓垫的 MIDI，输入绑定器按音符触发 VFX Graph 事件，全程不用写代码。
works.exercise_en: Map each pad of a MIDI controller (or on-screen pads) to an effect anchored on a different real object in AR Foundation. Twist: a combo of pads triggers a bigger effect that links all objects.
works.exercise_zh: 把 MIDI 控制器（或屏幕上的打击垫）的每个垫子映射到 AR Foundation 中不同真实物体上的特效。变体：特定组合触发一个把所有物体连起来的大特效。

video.video_title: I’ve started finger drumming as a new hobby, so I created a visualizer for it with Unity. It was made without coding—just using VFX Graph and Input System with a MIDI extension. https://t.co/day0HF3nW

works.title: Dynamicland intro
works.description: An introduction to the current Dynamicland: communal, physical computing where every program is a visible, touchable object in the room.
works.idea_zh: 每一个程序都是房间里看得见摸得着的实物。

video.video_title: Dynamicland intro, Aug 2024

works.technique: A room-scale projector-camera system recognizes printed objects and runs Realtalk programs that are physically embodied on paper, making code, data and output co-located and visible to everyone in the space.
works.exercise_zh: 用一台投影仪和摄像头把教室墙面变成“公共程序墙”：任何人把带标记的纸贴上去就能改变墙上的共享动画；变体：规定所有状态都必须可见，禁止使用任何隐藏的屏幕或键盘。
works.description_zh: 对当下 Dynamicland 的介绍：一种共享的、实体化的计算方式，每一个程序都是房间里看得见、摸得着的物件。
works.idea_en: Every program is a physical object in the room that you can see and touch.
works.technique_zh: 房间尺度的投影仪-相机系统识别打印出来的物件，运行以纸张为实体载体的 Realtalk 程序，使代码、数据和输出处于同一位置，空间中的每个人都能看到。
works.exercise_en: Use a projector and a camera to turn a classroom wall into a 'public program wall', where anyone can change a shared animation by sticking a marked sheet of paper on it. Twist: require all state to be visible, and ban any hidden screen or keyboard.

works.title: EARLL
works.description: A language tutor for AR glasses that notices which everyday object you pick up and quietly shows its word in the language you are learning, turning chores into vocabulary practice.
works.description_zh: 一个 AR 眼镜上的语言学习助手：它会注意到你拿起了哪件日常物品，悄悄显示它在目标语言里的单词，把做家务变成背单词。
works.idea_en: Your hands choose the lesson: touch an object and learn its name.
works.idea_zh: 让你的手来决定学哪个词：碰到什么，就学它的名字。
works.technique: Real-time segmentation and depth sensing localize objects around the user, a hand-object contact check detects manipulation, and a vocabulary prompt for that object is triggered in the glasses.
works.technique_zh: 实时分割与深度感知定位用户周围的物体，再用手与物体的接触检测判断是否被拿起，从而在眼镜中触发该物体的外语单词提示。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone AR app with an object detector (Lens Studio's ML object detection or TensorFlow.js COCO-SSD) that shows the Spanish word above a cup, book or chair once it has stayed in view for two seconds. Twist: the learner must say the word aloud and pass a speech-recognition check before the label appears.
works.exercise_zh: 用物体检测（Lens Studio 的 ML 物体检测或 TensorFlow.js COCO-SSD）做一个手机 AR 应用：杯子、书或椅子在画面中停留两秒后，在它上方显示西班牙语单词。变体：学习者必须先大声说出这个词、通过语音识别核对，标签才会出现。

video.video_title: Embodied AR Language Learning Through Everyday Object Interactions: A Demonstration of EARLL

salient.why_en: Pick up an everyday object and its word in the language you are learning appears.
salient.why_zh: 拿起一件日常物品，它在你正在学的语言里的名字就出现在眼前。

works.title: EchoVision
works.description: A handheld mixed-reality mask that lets people experience bat echolocation: your voice triggers LiDAR-based 'echoes' that briefly reveal the surrounding space as a visualized sound wave.
works.idea_zh: 用声音触发LiDAR回声可视化，像蝙蝠一样'听见'空间。

video.video_title: EchoVision  A Handheld Mixed Reality Mask for Experiencing Bat Echolocation

works.technique: Microphone amplitude triggers a pulse, and a shader reveals the LiDAR scene mesh as an expanding spherical wavefront from the user that fades out, mimicking echolocation.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 网格重建和一个按距离扩散的 Shader，在检测到声音时让房间网格像声波一样短暂亮起；变体：声音越高，波速越快。
works.description_zh: 一个手持式混合现实面罩，让人亲身体验蝙蝠的回声定位：你的声音会触发基于 LiDAR 的“回声”，以可视化声波的形式短暂照亮周围的空间。
works.idea_en: Your voice triggers LiDAR echo visuals, so you 'hear' space the way a bat does.
works.technique_zh: 麦克风音量触发一次脉冲，着色器以用户为中心，让 LiDAR 场景网格随着一道不断扩张、逐渐淡去的球形波前显现出来，模拟回声定位。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation mesh reconstruction and a distance-based spreading shader so that the room mesh briefly lights up like a sound wave whenever a sound is detected. Twist: the higher the pitch, the faster the wave travels.

salient.why_en: Put on the mask and call out: your voice lights up the room in echoes, so you see like a bat.
salient.why_zh: 戴上面具发出声音，回声把空间照亮，你就像蝙蝠一样“听见”了空间。

works.title: EgoTouch
works.description: Uses the cameras already on AR/VR headsets to detect touches on your own skin, turning palm and forearm into buttons and sliders without extra hardware.
works.idea_zh: 只用头显自带摄像头，就能把手臂皮肤变成触控按钮。

video.video_title: EgoTouch: On-Body Touch Input Using AR/VR Headset Cameras (ACM UIST 2024)

works.technique: A CNN trained on headset camera images infers from the skin's appearance and shading whether a finger is touching the palm or forearm and where, without additional sensors.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机摄像头拍手掌，用 Teachable Machine 训练“触摸/悬停”两类图像，并结合 MediaPipe 指尖位置把手掌分成 4 个按钮；变体：用手掌上的按钮控制 HoloKit 或网页中的一个小游戏。
works.description_zh: 利用 AR/VR 头显上现有的摄像头检测你对自己皮肤的触摸，无需额外硬件，就能把手掌和前臂变成按钮和滑块。
works.idea_en: Using only a headset's built-in cameras, the skin on your arm becomes a set of touch buttons.
works.technique_zh: 一个基于头显相机图像训练的卷积神经网络（CNN）根据皮肤的外观和明暗推断手指是否触碰到手掌或前臂，以及触碰位置，不需要额外的传感器。
works.exercise_en: Photograph your palm with a phone camera, train two image classes ('touch' and 'hover') in Teachable Machine, and combine them with MediaPipe fingertip positions to divide the palm into four buttons. Twist: use the buttons on your palm to control a small game in HoloKit or on a web page.

works.title: En amour
works.description: An immersive, interactive installation-experience commissioned by the Musée de la musique – Philharmonie de Paris, with music by Laurent Bardainne and selected for the Cannes 2024 immersive competition: visitors move through projected light, colors, words and sounds that trace a symbolic metamorphosis around love and separation.
works.description_zh: 受巴黎爱乐音乐厅音乐博物馆委约的沉浸式互动装置体验，音乐由 Laurent Bardainne 合作，入选 2024 年戛纳电影节沉浸式单元：观众穿过投影的光、色彩、文字和声音，经历一场关于爱与分离的象征性蜕变。
works.idea_en: A walk-through ritual that lets a group feel a love story as changing light and sound.
works.idea_zh: 一场可以走过的仪式，让一群人把一段爱情故事感受为不断变化的光和声音。
works.technique: Projection on floors, walls and tulle is combined with visitor sensing and a composed soundtrack; the balance between interactive and scripted moments likely changes from scene to scene.
works.technique_zh: 地面、墙面和纱幕投影结合观众感知与作曲配乐；交互与预设编排之间的比例很可能随场景而变。
works.exercise_en: Storyboard a three-station walk-through (meeting, closeness, parting) and give each station one projected element and one sound that respond to how many people a webcam counts there. Twist: make the final station react only to pairs standing close together.
works.exercise_zh: 为一段三站式的步行体验（相遇、靠近、分离）画故事板，每一站设置一个投影元素和一个声音，根据摄像头数到的人数作出反应。变体：让最后一站只对靠得很近的两人作出反应。

video.video_title: En amour - Adrien M & Claire B TEASER

works.title: Encounter Dinosaurs
works.description: On Vision Pro a portal opens in your wall; a butterfly lands on your outstretched finger and dinosaurs step toward you, reacting when you move or reach out.
works.idea_zh: 墙上开出一扇门，恐龙探头出来和你互动，蝴蝶停在你的指尖。

video.video_title: Apple Vision Pro App Review: 'Encounter Dinosaurs'

works.technique: Renders a portal into a full environment anchored to a wall and drives creature behaviours from the user's head and hand positions.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR在墙上放一个门户，里面的角色会随手机靠近而后退或前进；变化：伸出手（手部检测）时让一只虚拟蝴蝶停在手上。
works.description_zh: 在 Vision Pro 上，你的墙上打开了一扇传送门：一只蝴蝶落在你伸出的指尖上，恐龙朝你走来，并会对你的移动或伸手作出反应。
works.idea_en: A door opens in the wall, dinosaurs lean out to interact with you, and a butterfly lands on your fingertip.
works.technique_zh: 渲染一个锚定在墙上、通向完整环境的传送门，并根据用户头部和手部的位置驱动生物的行为。
works.exercise_en: Place a portal on a wall with phone AR so the character inside backs away or steps forward as the phone gets closer. Twist: when you hold out your hand (detected by hand tracking), have a virtual butterfly land on it.

works.title: Encyclies
works.description: A light musical and visual duet with pianist Nathalie Morazin, the second piece of Mondot's Synesthésies cycle, in which images animated live act as a full partner to the piano, between abstraction and impressionism.
works.description_zh: 与钢琴家 Nathalie Morazin 合作的轻量音乐影像双人作品，是 Mondot“Synesthésies”（联觉）系列的第二部：现场生成的动画影像作为钢琴的完整搭档，在抽象与印象派之间游走。
works.idea_en: The image plays next to the pianist as a second instrument.
works.idea_zh: 影像作为第二件乐器，和钢琴家一起演奏。
works.technique: A compact touring setup projects images that Mondot animates live with custom software, likely steering particle and brush systems by hand in time with the score.
works.technique_zh: 一套可快速搭建的巡演设备投影影像，由 Mondot 用自己的软件现场操控，很可能是随乐谱手动驱动粒子和笔刷系统。
works.exercise_en: Choose a short piano piece and write an image score: three visual behaviors mapped to three controller knobs, then play the images live next to a recording until the pairing feels like a duet. Twist: replace the recording with a live musician who cannot see the screen.
works.exercise_zh: 选一首短钢琴曲，写一份“影像乐谱”：三种视觉行为对应三个控制旋钮，然后配合录音现场演奏影像，直到两者像一首二重奏。变体：把录音换成看不到屏幕的现场乐手。

video.video_title: Encyclies - trailer

works.title: Entomographies
works.description: With entomologist Adrian Smith, Bou turns the flight of insects into glowing patterns, drawing attention to their beauty and to their decline.
works.description_zh: Bou 与昆虫学家 Adrian Smith 合作，把昆虫的飞行变成发光的图案，让人注意到它们的美，也注意到它们正在减少。
works.idea_en: The same trace method works at insect scale, so an AR trail effect can make the tiny motion around a flower visible.
works.idea_zh: 同样的轨迹方法也适用于昆虫尺度，因此 AR 轨迹效果可以让花朵周围细微的运动显形。
works.technique: High-speed macro footage of insects in flight is stacked frame by frame into single trails, likely against dark or controlled backgrounds.
works.technique_zh: 昆虫飞行的高速微距影像被逐帧叠合成轨迹，很可能是在黑色或受控背景下拍摄。
works.exercise_en: Point a phone with a trail-shader effect at a flowering bush for five minutes and record the pattern of bees and flies. Twist: switch the trail colour according to the flight speed so hovering and darting look different.
works.exercise_zh: 用带轨迹着色器特效的手机对准一丛开花的灌木拍摄五分钟，记录蜜蜂和苍蝇的飞行图案；变体：按飞行速度切换轨迹颜色，让悬停与疾飞看起来不同。

video.video_title: ENTOMOGRAPHIES

salient.why_en: The flight of an insect is left behind as a glowing line in the air.
salient.why_zh: 昆虫飞过的路径，在空中留下一条发光的线。

works.title: Eternal rat prism AR pet
works.description: An internet meme, the spinning rat in a prism, becomes a Snapchat AR pet that follows you around wherever you go.
works.idea_zh: 把网络梗'旋转老鼠棱镜'变成一直跟着你走的 AR 宠物。

video.video_title: I brought the eternal rat prism to life as an AR pet that follows you around forever and ever and you can try it now on Snapchat! https://t.co/xfx3iiG4o7

works.technique: The pet is re-positioned each frame to trail the camera with smoothing so it appears to follow the user around.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个班级梗做成跟着你走的 AR 宠物（Lens Studio/Reality Composer）；加一个变化：你停下太久它会睡着。
works.description_zh: 一个网络梗——在棱镜里旋转的老鼠——被做成 Snapchat 上的 AR 宠物，你走到哪儿它就跟到哪儿。
works.idea_en: Turn the 'spinning rat in a prism' meme into an AR pet that follows you everywhere.
works.technique_zh: 每一帧都对宠物的位置进行平滑重定位，使它跟在相机后面，看起来就像一直跟着用户。
works.exercise_en: Turn a class in-joke into an AR pet that follows you around (Lens Studio or Reality Composer). Twist: if you stop for too long, it falls asleep.

works.title: Even AI on Even G1 glasses
works.description: Even G1 glasses include a built-in AI that listens when asked and answers with short text in a green micro-display that only the wearer can see.
works.description_zh: Even G1 眼镜内置 AI，被唤起后倾听并用简短文字回答，文字显示在只有佩戴者能看到的绿色微显示屏上。
works.idea_en: An assistant whose answers are private text in your line of sight.
works.idea_zh: 一个把回答化作私密文字、放在你视线中的助手。
works.technique: Speech is captured by the glasses' microphones, processed by a cloud LLM via the phone, and rendered as monochrome text on the waveguide display.
works.technique_zh: 眼镜麦克风采集语音，经手机调用云端大语言模型处理，再以单色文字渲染到光波导显示屏上。
works.exercise_en: Prototype a 'one-line assistant' in a phone headset viewer: every answer must fit in 40 characters, shown in green text at the bottom of the view. Twist: the assistant speaks only when you are silent for five seconds.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机头戴支架里做一个“一行助手”原型：每个回答不超过 40 个字符，以绿色文字显示在视野底部。变体：只有你沉默五秒后助手才开口。

video.video_title: Even AI: Reimagining AI

works.title: EyeShadows
works.description: Glance at an object and a 'shadow' copy of it appears in the periphery; looking at the copy selects it or opens its settings, making eye-only interaction fast and less error-prone.
works.description_zh: 瞥一眼某个物体，它的“影子”副本就出现在视野边缘；再看向副本即可选中它或打开设置，让纯眼动交互又快又不易出错。
works.idea_en: Pull a copy of what you looked at into your periphery so selecting by eye is easy.
works.idea_zh: 把你看过的东西复制到视野边缘，让用眼睛选择变得轻松。
works.technique: Spawns peripheral virtual copies of gazed objects and uses a gaze transition onto the copy as a confirm action, avoiding accidental 'Midas touch' selections.
works.technique_zh: 为被注视的物体在周边视野生成虚拟副本，把视线移到副本上作为确认动作，避免误选的“点石成金”问题。
works.exercise_en: Using phone face or eye tracking in a web AR demo, show a small copy of a gazed icon in a screen corner and select it by looking there for half a second. Twist: let the copy offer three options placed in different corners.
works.exercise_zh: 在网页 AR 演示中借助手机的人脸或眼动追踪，把被注视的图标在屏幕角落显示一个小副本，注视那里半秒即可选中；变体：让副本在不同角落给出三个选项。

video.video_title: Eye Tracking for Easy Selection in AR and VR: EyeShadows

works.title: Figmin XR: Create, Collect & Play
works.description: The app's trailer: users sketch, import 3D models, animate and play physics-driven creations that bounce off the real room in mixed reality.
works.idea_zh: 在混合现实里创作、收藏并玩你的3D作品。

video.video_title: Figmin XR Trailer - Available NOW

works.technique: Integrates sketching, model import, animation and a physics engine that uses the room mesh as colliders.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR导入同学各自扫描的小物件模型，在桌上组成一个“混合现实收藏馆”并让它们受物理影响掉落；变化：每件作品配一段语音介绍。
works.description_zh: 这款应用的预告片：用户可以绘制草图、导入 3D 模型、制作动画，并在混合现实中把受物理驱动的作品玩起来，让它们在真实房间里弹来弹去。
works.idea_en: Create, collect and play with your 3D works in mixed reality.
works.technique_zh: 整合了草图绘制、模型导入、动画制作，以及一个把房间网格用作碰撞体的物理引擎。
works.exercise_en: Import small object models that classmates each scanned into phone AR, arrange them on a table as a 'mixed-reality collection', and let them fall under physics. Twist: give each piece a short voice introduction.

works.title: FloatingHUD: floating interface effect
works.description: Transparent HUD panels, grids and scan lines float around an object in 3D space like a sci-fi interface.
works.description_zh: 透明的 HUD 面板、网格和扫描线漂浮在一个物体周围的三维空间里，像科幻电影的界面。
works.idea_en: Interface graphics as a visual effect in space.
works.idea_zh: 把界面图形当作空间中的视觉特效。
works.technique: VFX Graph spawns quads textured with Shader Graph HUD elements and a filtered webcam feed, arranged and animated around a center.
works.technique_zh: VFX Graph 生成面片，贴上 Shader Graph 做的 HUD 元素和经过滤镜处理的摄像头画面，围绕中心排列并动画。
works.exercise_en: Surround a real object with floating HUD panels in AR Foundation that show made-up data about it. Twist: the panels show real data, such as the room's noise level.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中用漂浮的 HUD 面板包围一个真实物体，显示关于它的虚构数据。变体：面板显示真实数据，比如房间噪音。

video.video_title: Floating HUD https://t.co/j4spHN0kWf

works.title: Floral Resonance
works.description: An interactive audiovisual installation in which a living plant responds to people: touching or approaching it shifts the surrounding sound and light, shown at Manar Abu Dhabi with the artist explaining the piece.
works.description_zh: 一件互动视听装置，活的植物会回应人：触摸或靠近它，周围的声音和灯光就会发生变化；视频拍摄于 Manar Abu Dhabi，艺术家本人讲解作品。
works.idea_en: Make the silent relationship between a person and a plant audible and visible.
works.idea_zh: 让人与植物之间无声的关系变得可听、可见。
works.technique: Electrodes pick up the plant's bioelectrical signals, which change with touch, and TouchDesigner and Ableton Live map them to generative sound and light.
works.technique_zh: 电极采集植物的生物电信号，这些信号会随触摸变化，再由 TouchDesigner 和 Ableton Live 映射成生成式声音和灯光。
works.exercise_en: Wire a houseplant to a Makey Makey or capacitive touch sensor (Arduino) and let each touch change a projected colour and a synth note. Twist: the plant 'sulks' and stays dark if it is touched too often.
works.exercise_zh: 把一盆绿植接到 Makey Makey 或电容触摸传感器（Arduino）上，每次触摸都改变投影颜色和一个合成器音符。变体：被摸得太频繁时，植物会“生气”并暗下来。

video.video_title: Christian Brinkmann shares insights into his light art installation ‘Floral Resonance’ (2024–ongoing), an interactive audiovisual artwork that makes the relationship between human and plant tangible t

works.title: Frame: open-source AI glasses
works.description: Frame is a lightweight pair of open-source AR glasses with a camera, microphone and display, whose assistant Noa answers questions about what you see and hear.
works.description_zh: Frame 是一副轻便的开源 AR 眼镜，带摄像头、麦克风和显示屏，内置助手 Noa 可以回答你所见所闻的相关问题。
works.idea_en: Open hardware so anyone can build their own seeing, talking glasses.
works.idea_zh: 开放的硬件，让任何人都能做出会看、会说的眼镜。
works.technique: The glasses run a small Lua runtime and send camera and audio over Bluetooth to a phone, which queries multimodal models and returns text to the display.
works.technique_zh: 眼镜运行一个小型 Lua 环境，通过蓝牙把摄像头和音频发给手机，由手机调用多模态模型再把文字回传到显示屏。
works.exercise_en: Using any camera-equipped glasses or a phone on a strap, build 'what am I looking at?' with a free vision API and show a one-line answer. Twist: answer as a poem of exactly seven syllables.
works.exercise_zh: 用任何带摄像头的眼镜或挂在胸前的手机，配免费视觉接口做“我在看什么？”，只显示一行答案。变体：用恰好七个音节的诗来回答。

video.video_title: This is Frame! Open source AI glasses for developers, hackers and superheroes.

works.title: FungiSync
works.description: A mixed-reality participatory ritual: participants wear mushroom-decorated MR masks and exchange 'worldviews' through secret handshakes, blending each other's visual filters like a mycorrhizal network.
works.idea_zh: 戴上蘑菇面具，用握手交换彼此眼中的世界。

video.video_title: Fungi sync

works.technique: Likely co-located phone-based MR headsets share an anchor and detect handshake gestures to swap and mix each participant's visual shader.
works.exercise_zh: 让每组同学各做一个手机AR滤镜代表自己的“世界观”，两人击掌（靠近检测或扫码）后交换滤镜；变化：三人以上相遇时滤镜混合。
works.description_zh: 一场混合现实参与式仪式：参与者戴上饰有蘑菇的混合现实面具，通过秘密握手交换彼此的“世界观”，像菌根网络一样融合彼此的视觉滤镜。
works.idea_en: Put on a mushroom mask and trade the way you see the world through a handshake.
works.technique_zh: 可能是多台同处一地、基于手机的混合现实头显共享同一个锚点，并检测握手手势，从而交换和混合每位参与者的视觉着色器。
works.exercise_en: Have each group of classmates make a phone AR filter that represents their own 'worldview', and swap filters when two people high-five (detected by proximity or a QR scan). Twist: when three or more people meet, their filters blend.

works.title: Future outfits for Zendaya's Mugler robot suit
works.description: Riffing on Zendaya's red-carpet entrance in Mugler's 1995 robot suit, ZERO10 dressed the same footage in several of its own retro-futuristic digital designs and asked viewers to pick a favourite.
works.description_zh: 借 Zendaya 身穿 Mugler 1995 年机器人战衣走红毯的热点，ZERO10 在同一段视频上给她换上多套自家的复古未来主义数字服装，并请观众投票选出最喜欢的一套。
works.idea_en: Remix a viral fashion moment by re-dressing the same footage with AR.
works.idea_zh: 用 AR 给同一段爆红的时尚画面“换衣服”，二次创作热点。
works.technique: Body tracking runs on existing video rather than a live camera, so digital garments are fitted frame by frame onto the celebrity footage and cut into a comparison edit.
works.technique_zh: 人体追踪作用于已有视频而非实时摄像头，数字服装被逐帧贴合到名人画面上，再剪辑成对比视频。
works.exercise_en: Pick a short public-domain or self-shot runway clip and run a body-tracking AR effect on it in Effect House or Lens Studio (video input mode) to produce three alternative outfits. Twist: each outfit must represent a different decade.
works.exercise_zh: 选一段公共领域或自己拍的走秀短片，在 Effect House 或 Lens Studio（视频输入模式）中用人体追踪 AR 效果为其生成三套替代服装；变体：每套服装必须代表一个不同的年代。

video.video_title:
Which design you prefer the most? 🗡️

We couldn’t pass @Zendaya entrance in @Mugler 1995 retro-futuristic costume. So we had to offer our vision of the future 🔮

Video credit: @OnlineEt https://t.co/l

works.title: GazeGPT
works.description: Smart eyewear that tells a multimodal LLM exactly what you are looking at: glance at a dog and ask 'what breed is this?', and the eye tracker tells the AI which of the many things in view you mean.
works.description_zh: 一副智能眼镜，能把你正注视的东西准确告诉多模态大模型：看向一只狗问“这是什么品种？”，眼动追踪就会告诉 AI 画面中众多物体里你指的是哪一个。
works.idea_en: Use your gaze as the pointer for an AI that looks through your glasses.
works.idea_zh: 把你的目光当作透过眼镜看世界的 AI 的指针。
works.technique: An eye tracker maps gaze into the world-facing camera image; the region around the gaze point is cropped and sent with the spoken question to a multimodal LLM.
works.technique_zh: 眼动仪把注视点映射到朝外摄像头的画面中，截取注视点周围区域，与语音问题一起发送给多模态大模型。
works.exercise_en: Without an eye tracker, fake gaze with the phone's screen center or a fingertip tracked by MediaPipe: crop that region, send it with a spoken question to a multimodal LLM, and compare answers with and without the crop on a cluttered desk. Twist: record where the user looked for a minute and ask the AI what they seem to be interested in.
works.exercise_zh: 没有眼动仪时，可以用手机屏幕中心或 MediaPipe 追踪的指尖来模拟注视：截取该区域，连同语音问题发给多模态大模型，在杂乱的桌面上比较裁切与不裁切时的回答差异。变体：记录用户一分钟内看过的位置，请 AI 推测他对什么感兴趣。

video.video_title: GazeGPT: Augmenting Human Capabilities using Gaze-contingent Contextual AI for Smart Eyewear

works.title: GazePointAR
works.description: A voice assistant on HoloLens 2 that knows what 'this' and 'that' mean: it combines eye gaze, pointing and conversation history, so you can look at a plant or a math problem and simply ask 'what is this?' or 'how do I solve that?'.
works.description_zh: 一个运行在 HoloLens 2 上、听得懂“这个”“那个”的语音助手：它结合眼动、手指指向和对话历史，你只要看着一盆植物或一道数学题问“这是什么？”“那个怎么解？”就能得到回答。
works.idea_en: Replace the pronouns in a spoken question with whatever your eyes and finger are pointing at.
works.idea_zh: 把语音提问里的代词，替换成你眼睛和手指正指着的东西。
works.technique: Gaze and hand rays from the headset select an image crop of the target, a vision model describes it, and that description replaces the pronoun before the query goes to a GPT-style LLM.
works.technique_zh: 头显的眼动射线与手部射线选出目标区域的图像裁切，由视觉模型生成描述并替换问句中的代词，再交给 GPT 类大语言模型回答。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR 'what is this?' button: on tap, capture the camera frame, crop around the screen center, send the crop plus the spoken question to a multimodal LLM API and show the answer as a floating label on the object. Twist: answer only with a small arrow and a single word anchored on the object.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR“这是什么？”按钮：点击时截取相机画面并以屏幕中心裁切，把裁切图和语音问题一起发给多模态大模型 API，再把回答作为浮动标签贴在物体上。变体：只用一个小箭头加一个词来回答，并锚定在物体上。

video.video_title: GazePointAR: Context-Aware Voice Assistant for Pronoun Disambiguation in Wearable Augmented Reality

works.title: Ghost the Most
works.description: A Snap Spectacles prototype fills the office with a knee-high haunted mist between bare trees; players wander through it with see-through glasses to find and collect treasures hidden in the fog.
works.description_zh: 一个 Snap Spectacles 原型让办公室里弥漫齐膝的鬼雾，还长出光秃秃的树；玩家戴着透视眼镜在雾中游走，寻找并收集藏在雾里的宝物。
works.idea_en: Hide treasures in a layer of fake fog that covers the real floor.
works.idea_zh: 在覆盖真实地面的一层虚拟雾里藏宝。
works.technique: A Spectacles Lens anchors a volumetric-looking mist layer and props to the tracked floor; collectibles are revealed by walking close (likely distance triggers).
works.technique_zh: Spectacles 镜头把看起来有体积感的雾层和道具固定在追踪到的地面上，走近时宝物才显现（很可能使用距离触发）。
works.exercise_en: Build a fog treasure hunt in Lens Studio or AR Foundation: cover the floor with a semi-transparent fog plane and hide three objects that fade in only within one metre. Twist: the fog thins wherever the player has already walked.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation 做一个雾中寻宝：用半透明雾面盖住地面，藏三件只有走到一米内才浮现的物品。变体：玩家走过的地方雾会变淡。

video.video_title:
🎃 Halloween is upon us! Perfect time to showcase our @SnapAR Spectacles "Ghost the most" prototype 👻 
Find & collect treasures hidden in the haunted mist. We are really impressed with the experien

works.title: Hand-frame photos left in space
works.description: At a Snap AR hackathon his team built a way to take a photo by framing a scene with your fingers and leave that photo floating in place for others to find.
works.idea_zh: 用手指比个取景框拍照，照片就留在原地等别人发现。

video.video_title: For the snap AR hackathon my team developed a new way to take photos with your hands and leave them in space for others to find! https://t.co/CnUYLoG8lV

works.technique: Hand tracking detects a two-hand frame gesture to crop the camera view, and the image is saved as a persistent anchored object (likely via cloud anchors).
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 手势识别'双手取景框'来截取摄像头画面；加一个变化：照片被挂在拍摄位置的地图上供全班寻宝。
works.description_zh: 在一次 Snap AR 黑客松上，他的团队做出了一种拍照方式：用手指框出取景画面拍下照片，照片就留在原地漂浮，等着别人发现。
works.idea_en: Frame a shot with your fingers to take a photo, and the photo stays where it was taken for others to find.
works.technique_zh: 手部追踪识别双手比出的取景框手势，据此裁剪相机画面，并把图像保存为一个持久锚定的物体（可能借助云锚点）。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe gesture recognition to detect a two-hand viewfinder and crop the camera image. Twist: pin each photo to a map at the spot where it was taken, for a class-wide treasure hunt.

salient.why_en: Frame a shot with your fingers and the photo stays hanging at that spot for the next person to find.
salient.why_zh: 用手指比个取景框就能拍照，照片留在拍摄的地方，等下一个人来发现。

works.title: Hatsune Miku live (MIKU EXPO 2024, Vancouver)
works.description: The animated singer Hatsune Miku performs life-size on stage beside a live band, projected onto a transparent screen, while the audience waves glow sticks in sync. This clip is from the 10th-anniversary MIKU EXPO North America tour.
works.description_zh: 动画歌手初音未来以真人大小出现在舞台上，被投影在透明屏幕上，与现场乐队同台演出，观众同步挥舞荧光棒。这段来自 MIKU EXPO 北美巡演十周年场次。
works.idea_en: A virtual performer becomes 'real' through shared rhythm, lighting and crowd ritual; social AR can borrow the same cues (timing, call-and-response, shared lights).
works.idea_zh: 虚拟表演者之所以“真实”，靠的是共同的节奏、灯光和观众的集体仪式；社交 AR 可以借用同样的线索（节拍、呼应、共同的灯光）。
works.technique: Pre-animated 3D choreography is rear- or front-projected onto a transparent screen at the front of the stage, locked to the band's click track and to stage lighting cues.
works.technique_zh: 预先制作好的 3D 舞蹈动画被投在舞台前方的透明屏幕上（背投或正投），与乐队的节拍轨和舞台灯光提示锁定同步。
works.exercise_en: Place an animated character in shared phone AR on a real stage or desk, sync its dance to a song, and let everyone's phone flash the same colour on the beat. Twist: the character points at whichever phone cheers loudest.
works.exercise_zh: 在一个真实的舞台或桌面上用多人共享手机 AR 放一个会跳舞的角色，让它的舞蹈与歌曲同步，并让所有人的手机按节拍闪同一种颜色；变体：角色会指向欢呼声最大的那台手机。

video.video_title: 【LIVE】 M@GICAL☆CURE! LOVE ♥ SHOT! by SAWTOWNE feat.Hatsune Miku 【MIKU EXPO 2024 North America】

works.title: Head-tracked Subtitles
works.description: Everything people around you say appears as live subtitles in a video see-through headset, following your head so conversation stays readable in noise or for hard-of-hearing users.
works.description_zh: 周围人说的话都以实时字幕出现在视频透视头显里，并随头部移动，让人在嘈杂环境或听力不佳时也能看懂对话。
works.idea_en: Caption the real world the way films are captioned.
works.idea_zh: 像给电影配字幕一样，给真实世界配字幕。
works.technique: Transcribes speech locally with Vosk, tidies it with the Llama 3 language model, and renders the text in Unity on a modified video see-through HTC Vive Pro.
works.technique_zh: 用 Vosk 在本地做语音转写，用 Llama 3 语言模型整理文本，再在 Unity 中渲染到改装为视频透视的 HTC Vive Pro 上。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone's live-caption or speech API in a web AR page to float captions under a detected face, then test it in a noisy hallway. Twist: colour each speaker differently and add live translation.
works.exercise_zh: 在网页 AR 页面中调用手机的实时字幕或语音识别接口，把字幕悬浮在识别到的人脸下方，然后到嘈杂的走廊测试；变体：用不同颜色区分说话人，并加上实时翻译。

video.video_title: Head-tracked Subtitles Using Augmented Reality

salient.why_en: Real life gets subtitles, shown beneath whoever is speaking, the way films caption dialogue.
salient.why_zh: 给现实生活加字幕，像电影字幕那样出现在说话的人下方。

works.title: Hello, Dot
works.description: A mixed-reality Peridot experience for Meta Quest 3 in which a Dot hatches in your room, recognises furniture and plays with you through passthrough.
works.idea_zh: 在头显的透视画面中，AR宠物在你房间里孵化并认识你的家具。

video.video_title: Hello, Dot – A Mixed Reality Peridot Experience from Niantic

works.technique: Passthrough plus scene understanding labels furniture in the room, and the pet uses those labels as navigation targets and interaction affordances.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中检测桌面和地面两个层级，让宠物学会从地面跳上桌子找你；变体：你把手机放下不动时，宠物会在桌上睡着。
works.description_zh: 一款为 Meta Quest 3 打造的 Peridot 混合现实体验：一只 Dot 在你的房间里孵化，认识你的家具，并通过透视画面和你一起玩。
works.idea_en: In a headset's passthrough view, an AR pet hatches in your room and learns your furniture.
works.technique_zh: 透视画面加上场景理解为房间中的家具打上标签，宠物把这些标签作为导航目标和可交互的对象。
works.exercise_en: Detect two levels in AR, the tabletop and the floor, and teach a pet to jump from the floor onto the table to find you. Twist: when you set the phone down and leave it still, the pet falls asleep on the table.

works.title: Hi-Tech Garden
works.description: In workshops at A+E Lab and Medway schools, children connect sensors to plants, read their biodata and turn it into sound and interactions, imagining a future garden where humans communicate with plants.
works.description_zh: 在 A+E Lab 和梅德韦各学校的工作坊里，孩子们给植物接上传感器，读取它们的生物数据并转化为声音和互动，想象一个人与植物能够交流的未来花园。
works.idea_en: Let children 'hear' a plant respond when they touch it.
works.idea_zh: 让孩子在触碰植物时“听见”它的回应。
works.technique: Likely capacitive or bio-electric sensors on leaves feed a microcontroller that maps changes in the plant's signal to sound and simple visuals.
works.technique_zh: 很可能在叶片上接电容或生物电传感器，由微控制器把植物信号的变化映射为声音和简单画面。
works.exercise_en: Wire a houseplant to a Makey Makey or capacitive-touch board so touching different leaves plays different notes, then compose a short 'plant duet'. Twist: map the plant's soil moisture to the tempo so a thirsty plant plays slower.
works.exercise_zh: 把一盆室内植物接到 Makey Makey 或电容触摸板上，触摸不同叶子弹出不同音符，再合作编一段简短的“植物二重奏”；变体：把土壤湿度映射为节奏，缺水的植物会越弹越慢。

video.video_title: Hi-Tech Garden by A+E Lab x HsienYu Cheng

works.title: Human I/O
works.description: An egocentric AI system that detects when your eyes, hands, ears or voice are busy, for example while carrying groceries or sitting in a loud café, so XR interfaces can adapt their input and output to what you can do right now.
works.description_zh: 一个第一人称视角的 AI 系统，能察觉你的眼睛、双手、耳朵或嗓音何时被占用，比如拎着购物袋或坐在嘈杂的咖啡馆里，从而让 XR 界面根据你此刻能做的事来调整输入和输出方式。
works.idea_en: Before deciding how to talk to you, the interface first asks which of your senses and limbs are free.
works.idea_zh: 在决定如何与你交流之前，界面先弄清你的哪些感官和肢体是空闲的。
works.technique: Egocentric video, audio and pose are analyzed by vision and audio models and reasoned over by an LLM with chain-of-thought prompting to estimate how available each human channel is.
works.technique_zh: 用视觉和音频模型分析第一人称视频、音频与姿态，再由大语言模型通过思维链推理，估计每个人体通道的可用程度。
works.exercise_en: Film five one-minute first-person clips (cooking, carrying boxes, a noisy street, a meeting, riding as a passenger), send key frames and a transcript to a multimodal LLM asking whether the user's hands, eyes, ears and voice are available, and design how your AR app should switch between voice, gaze and touch in each case. Twist: make the app say aloud why it just switched modes.
works.exercise_zh: 拍五段一分钟的第一人称视频（做饭、搬箱子、嘈杂街道、开会、坐在副驾），把关键帧和转写发给多模态大模型，询问用户的手、眼、耳、嗓是否可用，并为每种情况设计你的 AR 应用该如何在语音、注视和触控之间切换。变体：让应用在切换模式时说出原因。

video.video_title: Human I/O: Towards a Unified Approach to Detecting Situational Impairments

works.title: Hybrid Thinking smart glasses
works.description: AI smart glasses join everyday conversations and proactively surface ideas, facts and follow-up questions, a mode Cayden Pierce calls hybrid thinking.
works.description_zh: AI 智能眼镜参与日常对话，主动给出想法、事实和追问问题，Cayden Pierce 称之为“混合思考”。
works.idea_en: Thinking with an AI in the middle of a real conversation, not after it.
works.idea_zh: 在真实对话进行中就和 AI 一起思考，而不是事后再查。
works.technique: Proactive agents monitor the transcript, decide when a contribution is useful, and send brief text to the display without being asked.
works.technique_zh: 主动型智能体持续监听转写内容，判断何时插话有用，无需提问就把简短文字发到显示屏上。
works.exercise_en: Prototype a 'silent debate partner': a phone listens to a two-person discussion and every minute shows one question the listener could ask next. Twist: the partner must support the person who is losing.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个“沉默的辩论搭档”：手机听两人讨论，每分钟显示一个倾听者可以接着问的问题。变体：搭档必须帮正在输的那一方。

video.video_title: Hybrid Thinking Smart Glasses

works.title: Hybrid XRSpectator
works.description: At home, a fan watches a miniature stadium on the coffee table in AR, then dives into a surrounding 360 view of the real stadium with integrated stats and replays.
works.description_zh: 在家里，球迷先在茶几上用 AR 看一个微缩体育场，然后“潜入”环绕式的真实体育场 360 度画面，里面整合了数据和回放。
works.idea_en: Zoom between a toy-sized stadium on your table and being inside the crowd.
works.idea_zh: 在桌上玩具大小的体育场和置身人群之间自由缩放。
works.technique: Combines a tabletop AR stadium model with a transition into an indirect AR mode built on 360 video of the match.
works.technique_zh: 把桌面 AR 体育场模型与基于比赛 360 度视频的间接 AR 模式结合起来，并在两者之间过渡。
works.exercise_en: Build a tabletop AR mini-arena from a paper model and add a button that switches to a 360 photo taken from inside the real venue. Twist: let a tap on a tiny player open that player's first-person view.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸模型做一个桌面 AR 小场馆，再加一个按钮切换到在真实场馆内拍的 360 度照片；变体：点击一个小球员就进入他的第一人称视角。

video.video_title: Hybrid XRSpectator: A Hybrid Tabletop XR Sports Spectating Experience

works.title: Hydrogen Wave
works.description: An interactive space at Hyundai Motorstudio Senayan Park, Jakarta, where visitors' movements send waves through a large projected field of animated particles themed on hydrogen energy.
works.idea_zh: 用身体推动'氢能'粒子之浪

video.video_title: Hydrogen Wave – interactive space, Hyundai Motorstudio Senayan Park, Jakarta

works.technique: Depth cameras track visitors' positions and velocities, which inject forces into a GPU particle simulation projected across the floor and walls.
works.exercise_zh: 在 TouchDesigner 里用 Kinect 或摄像头光流驱动投影粒子场，让人的移动推出波纹；变体：把粒子换成代表一种你关心的看不见的物质（空气污染、Wi-Fi 信号）。
works.description_zh: 雅加达 Hyundai Motorstudio Senayan Park 中的一个互动空间：观众的动作会在一片以氢能为主题、大面积投影的粒子动画中掀起波浪。
works.idea_en: Push waves of 'hydrogen' particles with your body.
works.technique_zh: 深度相机追踪观众的位置和速度，并把它们作为力注入投影在地面和墙面上的 GPU 粒子模拟中。
works.exercise_en: Drive a projected particle field in TouchDesigner with a Kinect or camera optical flow, so people's movement pushes out ripples. Twist: make the particles stand for an invisible substance you care about (air pollution, Wi-Fi signals).

works.title: I-XRAY
works.description: Two students stream video from Ray-Ban Meta glasses, match strangers' faces against the public web and use an LLM to assemble names, addresses and relatives within seconds, to show how exposed people already are.
works.description_zh: 两名学生用 Ray-Ban Meta 眼镜直播视频，把陌生人的脸与公开网络比对，再用大语言模型在几秒内拼出姓名、住址和亲属信息，以此揭示人们早已暴露到什么程度。
works.idea_en: A privacy warning built as a working demo: glasses that dox at a glance.
works.idea_zh: 一个以可用演示形式发出的隐私警告：一眼就能人肉的眼镜。
works.technique: Livestreamed frames are sent to a reverse face-search engine, the resulting URLs are read by an LLM to infer identity, and people-search sites fill in personal details; the authors did not release the code.
works.technique_zh: 直播画面发送到反向人脸搜索引擎，大语言模型读取结果链接推断身份，再用人员搜索网站补全个人信息；作者没有公开代码。
works.exercise_en: Do not build face identification. Instead, design an AR 'privacy shield' concept: sketch and prototype in Figma or WebAR how glasses should signal recording and how bystanders could opt out. Twist: make the bystander's opt-out visible to the wearer.
works.exercise_zh: 不要做人脸识别。改为设计一个 AR“隐私护盾”概念：用 Figma 或 WebAR 原型化眼镜应如何提示正在录制、旁人如何选择退出。变体：让旁人的退出选择对佩戴者可见。

video.video_title:
Are we ready for a world where our data is exposed at a glance? @CaineArdayfio and I offer an answer to protect yourself here:

https://t.co/LhxModhDpk https://t.co/Oo35TxBNtD

salient.why_en: Look at a stranger and their name and address appear, showing how exposed everyone already is.
salient.why_zh: 看一眼陌生人，他的名字和住址就浮现出来，揭示每个人早已暴露到什么程度。

works.title: Immersive Memory (AlUla)
works.description: An interactive installation across three spaces in AlUla's Old Town, a UNESCO site of the incense trade, responds to visitors with visuals and a spatial audio score.
works.idea_zh: 在古城遗址里，观众的身体动作唤起香料之路的记忆影像与空间声音。

video.video_title:
I’m excited to share Immersive Memory, an interactive experience set in AlUla’s Old Town, a UNESCO World Heritage site with a rich history in incense trade.

This installation spans three distinct spa

works.technique: Camera-based body tracking drives projected generative visuals in each room, tied together by a multichannel spatial audio score (likely MediaPipe/depth tracking).
works.exercise_zh: 为校园一处老建筑做'记忆投影'：人靠近墙面时投影出老照片的粒子；加一个变化：多人同时靠近才能看清完整照片。
works.description_zh: 一件横跨 AlUla 古城三个空间的互动装置——这里是香料贸易之路上的联合国教科文组织世界遗产地——它以影像和空间音频配乐回应观众。
works.idea_en: Among the ruins of an old town, visitors' movements call up images and spatial sound from the memory of the incense route.
works.technique_zh: 每个房间中，基于摄像头的身体追踪驱动投影的生成式影像，再由多声道空间音频配乐将各个空间串联起来（可能使用 MediaPipe 或深度追踪）。
works.exercise_en: Make a 'memory projection' for an old building on campus, where old photos appear as particles when someone approaches the wall. Twist: the full photo only becomes clear when several people approach at once.

works.title: Infinite Grass Field
works.description: An endless meadow of grass blades sways in the wind around the camera; wherever you fly, fresh grass is already there.
works.description_zh: 一片无边无际的草地在镜头周围随风摇摆；无论飞到哪里，新的草都已经长在那里。
works.idea_en: Grow grass only where the camera can see it, so a field can be infinite at a fixed cost.
works.idea_zh: 只在镜头看得到的地方长草，这样草地可以无限大，而开销保持不变。
works.technique: A compute shader lays out blade positions on a world-space grid that follows the camera, culls them against the view frustum, and draws the survivors with GPU instancing; blades bend with scrolling wind noise (based on NiloCat's instanced grass example).
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器在跟随镜头的世界空间网格上排布草叶位置，用视锥剔除掉看不到的部分，再用 GPU 实例化绘制剩下的草叶；草叶随滚动的风噪声弯曲（参考了 NiloCat 的实例化草地示例）。
works.exercise_en: Cover a detected AR floor with GPU-instanced grass on a phone and let the grass bend away from your feet using the camera position. Twist: grass only grows where the LiDAR mesh says the floor is empty.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机上用 GPU 实例化草地铺满检测到的 AR 地面，并根据相机位置让草从你脚边弯开。变体：只在 LiDAR 网格显示为空地的地方长草。

works.title: Interfacing AI through physical paper
works.description: Highlighting and commenting on a printed page with a real pen and voice is synchronised to a digital copy, so the AI knows exactly which passage the reader is talking about.
works.description_zh: 用真笔在打印稿上划重点、用语音做批注，这些都会同步到数字副本中，AI 因此确切知道读者在说哪一段。
works.idea_en: Paper stays the interface; the headset quietly turns it into a conversation with AI.
works.idea_zh: 纸依然是界面，头显悄悄把它变成与 AI 的对话。
works.technique: The headset camera detects the page and highlighter marks, OCR maps them to the digital text, and spoken comments are attached to those passages for an LLM.
works.technique_zh: 头显摄像头识别纸页和荧光笔痕迹，OCR 把它们对应到数字文本，语音批注被挂到这些段落上交给大语言模型。
works.exercise_en: Print a one-page text, highlight three lines, photograph the page and have a vision model return the highlighted lines plus a summary pinned next to the page in AR. Twist: the AI argues with your highlights.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一页文字，划出三行，拍照后让视觉模型返回被划的句子和一段总结，在 AR 中钉在纸旁。变体：让 AI 反驳你划的重点。

video.video_title: Another prototype about interfacing artificial intelligence through paper with Quest 3. Highlight and comment text on physical paper, it synchronises the highlights and spoken comments with a digital

works.title: Jadu
works.description: A multiplayer AR fighting game in which holographic fighters battle on your floor or desk, controlled from the phone, with players able to walk around and film the fight.
works.description_zh: 一款多人 AR 格斗游戏：全息斗士在你的地板或书桌上对战，由手机操控，玩家可以绕着走动并拍下战斗。
works.idea_en: Bring the fighting-game arena into your real room.
works.idea_zh: 把格斗游戏的擂台搬进你真实的房间。
works.technique: Motion-captured and volumetric characters are placed on detected planes, with networked multiplayer synchronising both fighters' positions in each player's AR view.
works.technique_zh: 动作捕捉和体积影像角色被放置在检测到的平面上，联网多人模式在每位玩家的 AR 画面中同步双方斗士的位置。
works.exercise_en: Build a two-player phone AR game where each player's character stands on the same shared table and can push the other off the edge. Twist: the table's real edge is the ring boundary.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个双人手机 AR 游戏：两名玩家的角色站在同一张共享的桌子上，可以把对方推下桌边。变体：桌子的真实边缘就是擂台边界。

video.video_title: I Played a NEW Fighting Mobile Game IN REAL LIFE! (JADU AR)

works.title: LILITH.AEON
works.description: A 60-minute installation inside a monumental LED cube where Lilith, a virtual dancer reincarnated from a cryogenically frozen child, responds to how visitors move around her with AI-generated choreography.
works.description_zh: 在巨型 LED 立方体内进行的 60 分钟装置：虚拟舞者 Lilith 是一个被冷冻保存的孩子的数字化身，她会根据观众在周围的走动，以 AI 生成的舞蹈作出回应。
works.idea_en: A virtual being dances back at the crowd, so every visit becomes a new duet between people and an AI.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟生命对着人群起舞，每一次到访都成为人与 AI 之间的一段新双人舞。
works.technique: Audience positions are tracked in the space and fed to a motion-generation model that blends motion-captured dance clips of the character on the LED walls, likely with camera or depth sensing.
works.technique_zh: 系统追踪观众在空间中的位置，输入动作生成模型，在 LED 墙上混合角色的动捕舞蹈片段，很可能使用摄像头或深度传感。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe in the browser to find where a viewer stands, and have a projected avatar pick from five mocap clips so it turns towards or away from them. Twist: the avatar only dances when two viewers stand still together.
works.exercise_zh: 在浏览器里用 MediaPipe 找出观众站立的位置，让投影出来的虚拟角色从五段动捕片段中挑选动作，转向或背离观众；变体：只有两名观众一起静止站立时，角色才开始跳舞。

video.video_title: LILITH.AEON Trailer - AI driven XR and Dance Production by AΦE

works.title: LLMR
works.description: A framework for speaking interactive mixed-reality worlds into existence: type or say 'make a timer out of a rotating cube' or 'recolor the scene for a color-blind user' and an LLM writes and runs the Unity code live.
works.description_zh: 一个“用语言把可交互混合现实世界说出来”的框架：输入或说出“用一个旋转的方块做个计时器”“为色盲用户重新配色”，大语言模型就会实时编写并运行 Unity 代码。
works.idea_en: Language becomes the runtime: objects, behaviors and scene edits are generated as code while you are inside the world.
works.idea_zh: 语言即运行时：身处世界之中时，物体、行为与场景修改都作为代码即时生成。
works.technique: Several GPT-4 roles (scene analyzer, planner, builder, inspector) collaborate using a scene summary and memory, generate C# for Unity and debug it before execution.
works.technique_zh: 多个 GPT-4 角色（场景分析、规划、构建、检查）借助场景摘要和记忆协作，生成 Unity 的 C# 代码，并在执行前自我调试。
works.exercise_en: In Unity, expose a tiny runtime command layer (a JSON command set or Roslyn scripting) and let an LLM receive a scene summary plus a user request and return commands; try five requests ranging from spawning objects to changing physics. Twist: add an 'inspector' prompt that reviews generated code before it runs and count the errors it catches.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity 中开放一个小型运行时指令层（一套 JSON 指令或 Roslyn 脚本），让大语言模型接收场景摘要和用户请求并返回指令；从生成物体到修改物理，尝试五个请求。变体：增加一个“检查员”提示，在代码运行前审查生成结果，统计它拦下了多少错误。

video.video_title: LLMR: Real-time Prompting of Interactive Worlds using Large Language Models

works.title: Las Awichas
works.description: Andean grandmothers' stories live inside AR robotic animals, from geckos to jaguars, that appear around the viewer and respond to hand movements and voice commands while they narrate.
works.description_zh: 安第斯祖母们的故事住在 AR 机器动物体内，从壁虎到美洲豹，它们出现在观众周围，一边讲述，一边回应观众的手势和语音指令。
works.idea_en: Grandmothers' wisdom is carried by AR animals that listen back.
works.idea_zh: 祖母的智慧由会“听你说话”的 AR 动物来传递。
works.technique: Phone or headset AR anchors animated robotic animals in the room, while hand tracking and speech recognition feed an AI dialogue layer that makes each animal reply (built with King's College London).
works.technique_zh: 手机或头显 AR 把动画机器动物锚定在房间里，手部追踪和语音识别输入 AI 对话层，让每只动物作出回答（与伦敦国王学院合作）。
works.exercise_en: Record an elder in your family telling a short story, then attach it to an AR animal that plays the next sentence each time you wave. Twist: the animal asks the viewer a question back at the end.
works.exercise_zh: 录下家中长辈讲的一个小故事，把它挂在一只 AR 动物上，每挥一次手就播放下一句；变体：结尾时让动物反问观众一个问题。

video.video_title: Las Awichas

works.title: Laser Dance
works.description: A Quest 3 mixed-reality game that scans your living room and strings laser beams between your real walls and furniture; you dance, dodge and crawl through the beams to reach buttons.
works.idea_zh: 把自家客厅的真实墙面和家具变成激光迷阵，用全身躲避穿越。

video.video_title: Laser Dance - Early Access Trailer

works.technique: The Scene API supplies labeled room geometry (walls, floor, furniture boxes), and laser segments are generated between sampled points on those surfaces, with body collision checked against the headset and hand poses.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 平面检测拿到墙面和地面，在两面墙之间随机生成几条激光线，手机碰到激光就震动失败；变体：让激光随音乐节拍移动。
works.description_zh: 一款 Quest 3 混合现实游戏：它扫描你的客厅，在真实的墙壁和家具之间拉起激光束；你要跳舞、闪躲、匍匐穿过激光，去按下按钮。
works.idea_en: Turn the real walls and furniture of your living room into a laser maze you dodge through with your whole body.
works.technique_zh: Scene API 提供带标签的房间几何信息（墙面、地面、家具包围盒），激光线段在这些表面的采样点之间生成，并根据头显和手部位姿检测身体碰撞。
works.exercise_en: Get wall and floor planes with AR Foundation plane detection, generate a few random laser lines between two walls, and make the phone vibrate and fail when it touches a laser. Twist: make the lasers move to the beat of the music.

works.title: Lasertag: light VFX test
works.description: A test of laser shots that light up the real room: virtual beams cast light onto scanned walls and furniture in passthrough.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟激光照亮真实房间墙面的光效测试。

video.video_title: Meta Quest Lasertag - Light VFX test

works.technique: Virtual dynamic lights attached to laser beams illuminate an invisible scanned-room mesh with a shadow-receiving or additive-lighting material, so light appears to fall on real surfaces in passthrough.
works.exercise_zh: 在扫描得到的房间网格上用一个透明但能接收光照的材质，让虚拟手电筒在真实墙面上投出光斑；变体：光斑颜色随你说话的音量变化。
works.description_zh: 一次激光射击照亮真实房间的测试：在透视画面中，虚拟光束把光投在扫描出的墙壁和家具上。
works.idea_en: A lighting test in which virtual lasers light up the real walls of a room.
works.technique_zh: 附着在激光束上的虚拟动态光源照亮一个不可见的扫描房间网格，该网格使用可接收阴影或叠加光照的材质，从而在透视画面中呈现光线落在真实表面上的效果。
works.exercise_en: Give the scanned room mesh a transparent material that still receives light, so a virtual flashlight casts a spot of light on real walls. Twist: change the color of the light spot with the volume of your voice.

works.title: Live Blender preview on Vision Pro
works.description: A Blender scene streams live into Apple Vision Pro; edits made on the desktop appear instantly as a full-size object lit by your real room.
works.idea_zh: 在Blender里改模型，Vision Pro里即时出现被真实环境照亮的实物大小预览。

video.video_title:
Can't believe I got this working 🤯

Live preview of a Blender scene with the Vision Pro. https://t.co/F7DC9hj4fk

works.technique: Blender exports the scene (for example as USDZ) on each change and streams it to the headset, where RealityKit reloads the model and lights it with the room's environment probe.
works.exercise_zh: 写一个脚本，每次在 Blender 保存时导出 glTF，手机 WebAR 页面自动重新加载该模型；变体：让模型在 AR 中出现时带一段“生长”动画。
works.description_zh: Blender 场景实时串流到 Apple Vision Pro 中；在桌面电脑上做的修改会立刻呈现为一个被你真实房间光线照亮的等大物体。
works.idea_en: Edit a model in Blender and a life-size preview, lit by your real surroundings, appears instantly in Vision Pro.
works.technique_zh: Blender 在每次修改时导出场景（例如导出为 USDZ）并串流到头显，由 RealityKit 重新加载模型，并用房间的环境光探针为其照明。
works.exercise_en: Write a script that exports glTF every time you save in Blender, and have a phone WebAR page reload the model automatically. Twist: play a 'growing' animation when the model appears in AR.

works.title: Long Leif, the biggest troll
works.description: In Minnesota, Dambo builds Long Leif, his biggest troll yet, as part of a trail of nine sculptures and 700 birdhouses made from recycled materials.
works.description_zh: 在明尼苏达州，Dambo 建造了他迄今最大的巨魔 Long Leif，这是由回收材料制成的九座雕塑和 700 个鸟屋组成的路线的一部分。
works.idea_en: A network of characters with a story across a region shows how to design a multi-site AR world with one mythology.
works.idea_zh: 一整个地区里带有故事的角色网络，展示了如何用一套神话设计多地点 AR 世界。
works.technique: Large timber frames are clad with reclaimed wood; birdhouses from recycled materials are placed along the trail.
works.technique_zh: 大型木框架覆以回收木料；用回收材料制作的鸟屋沿路线安放。
works.exercise_en: Write a short myth for your neighbourhood and place its characters as AR figures at five real locations, with a map. Twist: add AR birdhouses that real birds' sounds can 'move into' when recorded nearby.
works.exercise_zh: 为你的社区写一个短神话，把其中角色作为 AR 人物放在五个真实地点，并配一张地图；变体：加入 AR 鸟屋，当附近录到真实鸟鸣时，“鸟”就会住进去。

video.video_title: THE BIGGEST TROLL IN THE WORLD

works.title: Look Up - Augmented Reality Architecture
works.description: AR experiments that attach digital sculptures and animated beings to building facades, inviting people to look up at architecture.
works.idea_zh: 在建筑立面上长出AR雕塑，邀请人们抬头看城市

video.video_title: Look Up - Augmented Reality Architecture

works.technique: Likely geospatial or VPS anchoring (or image tracking of the facade) places animated sculptures on building faces, with scale set so they read correctly from street level.
works.exercise_zh: 选一栋校园建筑，用 8th Wall 图像追踪或 ARCore Geospatial 在立面上放一个会动的雕塑；变体：让雕塑只在抬头角度超过 45 度时出现，逼观众真的“抬头看”。
works.description_zh: 一系列 AR 实验：把数字雕塑和会动的生命体附着在建筑立面上，邀请人们抬头看看建筑。
works.idea_en: AR sculptures sprout from building facades and invite people to look up at the city.
works.technique_zh: 可能借助地理空间锚定或 VPS 锚定（或对立面进行图像追踪），把动画雕塑放在建筑立面上，并设定合适的尺度，使其从街面上看起来比例正确。
works.exercise_en: Pick a campus building and place a moving sculpture on its facade with 8th Wall image tracking or ARCore Geospatial. Twist: make the sculpture appear only when the viewing angle tilts up past 45 degrees, forcing viewers to actually look up.

works.title: Loóna: Cozy Puzzle Games (Apple Vision Pro)
works.description: Floating 3D dioramas hover in the player's room; pinching and placing their pieces with the hands completes each little world, which then comes alive with sound and a friendly AI creature called Lumo.
works.description_zh: 立体小场景漂浮在玩家的房间里；用手捏取并放置零件拼好每个小世界后，它便伴随声音活起来，还有一只名叫 Lumo 的友善 AI 小生物陪伴。
works.idea_en: Puzzle solving as a calm ritual that rewards you by animating the finished world.
works.idea_zh: 把解谜变成一种安静的仪式，完成后整个小世界动起来作为奖励。
works.technique: visionOS gaze-and-pinch plus direct hand manipulation snap pieces into RealityKit scenes, with spatial audio layered as each part locks in.
works.technique_zh: 用 visionOS 的注视加捏合以及直接手部操作，把零件吸附进 RealityKit 场景，每拼好一块就叠加一层空间音频。
works.exercise_en: Build a five-piece 3D jigsaw that floats at chest height; each correctly placed piece adds one audio loop and one animation. Twist: hide one piece somewhere in the real room so the player must look around to find it.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个由五块零件组成、漂浮在胸口高度的 3D 拼图；每放对一块就加入一段循环音效和一段动画。变体：把其中一块藏在真实房间的某处，玩家必须四处寻找。

video.video_title: Introducing Loóna Puzzle Game for Apple Vision Pro

works.title: MELODIX•R
works.description: An XR design-fiction prototype on Quest 3 imagining a mixed-reality music experience placed in your real room.
works.idea_zh: 设计虚构：放在真实房间里的混合现实音乐体验。

video.video_title: MELODIX•R  - Quest3 - XR Design fiction prototype

works.technique: Hand-tracked gestures likely act on room-anchored musical objects, so reaching, pinching and placing notes in space shapes the music.
works.exercise_zh: 在房间里放几个会发声的 AR 小球，用手势抓起并放到不同高度来改变音高；变体：把小球放在真实家具上时改变音色。
works.description_zh: 一个在 Quest 3 上实现的 XR 设计虚构原型，设想了一种放置在你真实房间中的混合现实音乐体验。
works.idea_en: Design fiction: a mixed-reality music experience set in your real room.
works.technique_zh: 手部追踪的手势可能作用于锚定在房间中的音乐物件，于是伸手、捏合以及在空间中摆放音符都会塑造音乐。
works.exercise_en: Place a few sound-making AR balls in the room and grab them with hand gestures, moving them to different heights to change their pitch. Twist: change the timbre when a ball is placed on real furniture.

works.title: MOFA: The Ghost
works.description: An asymmetric social exertion game in spontaneous co-located MR: an invisible ghost player hunts others who can only see it through their devices, played in public spaces.
works.idea_zh: 非对称捉鬼游戏：只有通过设备才能看见的'鬼'在公共空间里追逐玩家。

video.video_title: MOFA The Ghost: Demonstrating an Asymmetrical Social Exertion Game in Spontaneous Collocated Mixe...

works.technique: All players share a colocalized coordinate frame, and the ghost's tracked pose is rendered only on the hunters' devices, creating asymmetric visibility in the same physical space.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个两人非对称游戏：一个人的位置只能通过另一个人的手机 AR 看到；变体：“隐形者”每隔一段时间会短暂现身并发出声音。
works.description_zh: 一款在即兴、同处一地的混合现实中进行的非对称社交运动游戏：一名隐形的“鬼”玩家在公共空间里追捕其他人，而其他人只能通过设备看到它。
works.idea_en: An asymmetric ghost-hunting game: a 'ghost' visible only through devices chases players across a public space.
works.technique_zh: 所有玩家共享一个共同定位的坐标系，“鬼”的追踪位姿只在猎人的设备上渲染，从而在同一物理空间中形成不对称的可见性。
works.exercise_en: Make a two-player asymmetric game in which one person's position can only be seen through the other person's phone AR. Twist: every so often the 'invisible' player briefly appears and makes a sound.

works.title: MRTransformer
works.description: Two people in rooms with different layouts collaborate in MR as avatars; the system rewrites where each avatar looks and points so the gestures still land on the right objects in the other person's room.
works.description_zh: 两个身处不同布局房间的人以虚拟化身在 MR 中协作；系统会改写每个化身的注视和指向方向，让手势在对方房间里仍然指向正确的物体。
works.idea_en: Translate body language between mismatched spaces, not just positions.
works.idea_zh: 在不对应的空间之间翻译肢体语言，而不仅仅是位置。
works.technique: The avatar's gaze and pointing targets are retargeted semantically to the equivalent objects in the remote room, and the motion is adjusted with inverse kinematics.
works.technique_zh: 把化身的注视和指向目标按语义重新映射到远端房间中对应的物体上，再用逆运动学调整动作。
works.exercise_en: Two students in different rooms each place the same three objects in different spots; show each other's pointing as an AR arrow that snaps to the matching object locally. Twist: add a shrug gesture meaning 'not here'.
works.exercise_zh: 两名学生在不同房间里把同样的三件物品放在不同位置；把对方的指向显示为 AR 箭头，并吸附到本地对应的物体上。变体：加一个表示“不在这儿”的耸肩手势。

video.video_title: MRTransformer: Transforming Avatar Nonverbal Behavior for Remote Collaboration in Incongruent Spaces

works.title: Magic Mirrors for cinemas and theme parks
works.description: ZERO10 Magic Mirrors in entertainment venues turn visitors into their favourite characters, for example standing in an underwater world as an Aquaman-style superhero, and invite them to share the result.
works.description_zh: ZERO10 的魔镜进入娱乐场所，把观众变成他们喜欢的角色，例如以类似 Aquaman 的超级英雄形象站在海底世界里，并鼓励他们分享出去。
works.idea_en: Step into the poster: the mirror swaps you into the movie's world.
works.idea_zh: 走进海报里：镜子把你换进电影的世界。
works.technique: Full-body tracking drives a character costume while background segmentation replaces the venue with a themed environment, all rendered live on a large portrait screen.
works.technique_zh: 全身追踪驱动角色服装，背景分割把场地替换为主题环境，全部实时渲染在一块大型竖屏上。
works.exercise_en: Build a webcam 'poster mirror' with MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation and Pose that replaces the background with a scene of your choice and adds one character accessory. Twist: the scene reacts when the visitor raises both arms.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 人像分割和姿态追踪做一面摄像头“海报镜子”：把背景替换成你选的场景，并加上一件角色配饰；变体：当来访者举起双臂时，场景会产生反应。

video.video_title:
🧜‍♂️ With magic Mirrors, people can visualize themselves as their favorite characters or inside virtual fantasy worlds. Sharing it online sparks social virality and brand awareness. 

🛍 AR solutions d

works.title: Math Notes on real paper
works.description: Handwritten equations on physical paper are read by the headset and solved, with answers appearing on the page like Apple's Math Notes, but for pen and paper.
works.description_zh: 写在实体纸上的算式被头显读取并求解，答案直接出现在纸上，就像苹果的 Math Notes，只不过用的是纸笔。
works.idea_en: Could mixed reality bring a renaissance of paper as a productivity tool?
works.idea_zh: 混合现实会不会让纸张作为生产力工具重新复兴？
works.technique: Camera frames are sent to handwriting OCR and an LLM that evaluates the expressions; results are rendered as handwriting-style text aligned to the page.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头画面送入手写识别和大语言模型求值，结果以手写风格文字对齐渲染在纸面上。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a handwritten sum with a phone, ask a vision model to solve it, and draw the answer in AR right after the equals sign. Twist: the AI writes the answer in the same handwriting as the student.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍下一道手写算式，让视觉模型求解，在 AR 中把答案写在等号后面。变体：AI 用和学生一样的笔迹写答案。

video.video_title:
Apple's Math Notes feature, but on real paper. 

Could camera access on mixed reality headsets in combination with OCR & LLMs lead to a renaissance of physical paper as a productivity tool? https:

works.title: MediaPipe TouchDesigner: Face-tracked Texture
works.description: A demo of the MediaPipe plugin for TouchDesigner that pins a 2D image onto a moving face in the webcam feed, following head rotation and position in real time.
works.description_zh: TouchDesigner MediaPipe 插件的演示：把一张 2D 图像钉在摄像头画面中移动的人脸上，实时跟随头部的转动和位置。
works.idea_en: Build your own face filter engine inside a visual programming tool instead of an app.
works.idea_zh: 不用滤镜 App，在可视化编程工具里自己搭一个脸部滤镜引擎。
works.technique: MediaPipe Face Landmarker runs on the GPU inside TouchDesigner and outputs a transformation matrix that drives a textured SOP aligned to the face.
works.technique_zh: MediaPipe Face Landmarker 在 TouchDesigner 中以 GPU 运行，输出变换矩阵，驱动一个贴图 SOP 与人脸对齐。
works.exercise_en: Use the free MediaPipe TouchDesigner plugin to attach a hand-drawn mask to your face and project the result on a wall. Twist: the mask changes drawing when you tilt your head.
works.exercise_zh: 用免费的 TouchDesigner MediaPipe 插件把一张手绘面具贴到脸上，并把结果投影到墙上；变体：歪头时面具会换成另一幅画。

video.video_title: MediaPipe TouchDesigner Transformation matrix example

works.title: Memoro
works.description: A wearable audio memory assistant: during a conversation it infers what you are trying to remember and whispers a concise hint, either when you ask or proactively without being asked.
works.description_zh: 一个可穿戴的音频记忆助手：在对话中推断你正想记起的内容，并轻声给出简短提示——可以在你询问时提供，也可以不等你开口就主动提供。
works.idea_en: A memory prosthesis that speaks up only with the one fact you are missing.
works.idea_zh: 一个记忆义肢：只在你缺的那一条信息上开口。
works.technique: Captured conversations become searchable memories; an LLM infers the current memory need from context, runs semantic search and returns a minimal audio suggestion in query and queryless modes.
works.technique_zh: 把录下的对话存为可检索的记忆；大语言模型根据上下文推断当前的记忆需求，进行语义检索，并以极简的音频提示返回，支持“提问模式”和“免提问模式”。
works.exercise_en: Collect a week of class notes as text, embed them in a small vector store, and build a phone app that listens to a live discussion, detects hesitation phrases ('what was it called…') and speaks back one retrieved fact. Twist: show the fact as an AR sticky note on the person who originally said it.
works.exercise_zh: 把一周的课堂笔记整理成文本，存进一个小型向量库，做一个手机应用：监听现场讨论，检测到犹豫的说法（“那个叫什么来着……”）时读出一条检索到的事实。变体：把这条事实做成 AR 便利贴，贴在最初说出它的人身上。

video.video_title: Memoro: Wearable Memory Assistant using Personal AI

works.title: Metafold 05, AR-activated digital print
works.description: A printed artwork from his Metafold series springs into an animated 3D sculpture when viewed through a phone, extending the static print into motion.
works.idea_zh: 一张静态版画，用手机一扫就长出会动的 3D 雕塑。

video.video_title: Metafold 05, AR activated Digital Print #bmw #bmw7series #i7 #ar #augmentedreality #digitalart

works.technique: Image-target tracking recognizes the print and overlays a registered animated 3D version on top of it (likely via an image-marker AR app).
works.exercise_zh: 把自己的一幅画当成图像识别标记（Artivive/Adobe Aero/8th Wall 都可），让画里的东西飞出来；加一个变化：从侧面看时显示画的'背面世界'。
works.description_zh: 他 Metafold 系列中的一幅版画作品，用手机观看时会跃然变成一座动态的 3D 雕塑，把静态的版画延伸为运动。
works.idea_en: Scan a static print with a phone and a moving 3D sculpture grows out of it.
works.technique_zh: 通过图像目标追踪识别版画，并在其上叠加一个对齐的动态 3D 版本（可能借助基于图像标记的 AR 应用）。
works.exercise_en: Use one of your own drawings as an image-recognition marker (Artivive, Adobe Aero or 8th Wall all work) and make things fly out of the picture. Twist: when viewed from the side, show the 'world behind' the picture.

works.title: Metavido VFX (WebGPU)
works.description: Volumetric clips captured with an iPhone Pro play back in a web browser, where the recorded person and space are re-rendered as particles and effects in 3D.
works.idea_zh: 把手机拍的'带深度的视频'放进网页，任何人都能在浏览器里围着它看特效。

video.video_title: I published a WebGPU build of the Metavido VFX sample (iPhone Lidar capture) https://t.co/GPVKZc6lZI https://t.co/IpBsQPUR7C

works.technique: Metavido stores LiDAR depth and camera metadata inside a standard video stream, which a Unity WebGPU build decodes to reconstruct points for VFX in the browser.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Record3D 或手机深度视频导入 three.js，在网页里把一段舞蹈重建成点云；加一个变化：观众点击后切换成'沙子'材质坍塌。
works.description_zh: 用 iPhone Pro 拍摄的体积视频片段在网页浏览器中播放，被记录下来的人和空间以粒子和特效的形式在 3D 中重新渲染。
works.idea_en: Put a phone video with depth onto a web page, so anyone can walk around its effects in a browser.
works.technique_zh: Metavido 把 LiDAR 深度和相机元数据存储在标准视频流中，Unity 的 WebGPU 构建版本对其解码，在浏览器中重建点云用于视觉特效。
works.exercise_en: Import a Record3D or phone depth video into three.js and rebuild a dance clip as a point cloud on a web page. Twist: when a viewer clicks, switch to a 'sand' material that collapses.

works.title: Mistral-OUI: contextual AR UI
works.description: On Magic Leap 2, a vision model recognizes what the wearer is looking at and a language model generates a custom interface for that context, shown floating in view.
works.idea_zh: 看到什么，AI 就当场为你生成对应的界面。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Contextual UI (Mistral-OUI)

works.technique: Camera frames are captioned by a vision-language model, and an LLM turns the description into HTML UI rendered as a panel in the headset.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍一张照片，让多模态大模型识别物体并生成一个'AR 便签' UI（网页 AR 显示）；加一个变化：UI 的风格随物体情绪改变。
works.description_zh: 在 Magic Leap 2 上，视觉模型识别出佩戴者正在看的东西，语言模型再为这一情境生成定制的界面，漂浮显示在视野中。
works.idea_en: Whatever you look at, AI generates a matching interface for it on the spot.
works.technique_zh: 视觉语言模型为相机画面生成描述，再由大语言模型把描述转换为 HTML 界面，以面板形式渲染在头显中。
works.exercise_en: Take a photo with a phone and have a multimodal LLM identify the object and generate an 'AR sticky note' UI (shown in web AR). Twist: change the UI's style to match the object's mood.

works.title: Mixed Reality Snowball Throwing
works.description: On Quest 3 in passthrough, snowballs thrown with the controllers splat against a real bed, walls and floor, bouncing and breaking apart exactly on the room's surfaces.
works.description_zh: 在 Quest 3 的透视画面里，用手柄扔出的雪球砸在真实的床、墙和地板上，恰好沿着房间表面弹跳、碎开。
works.idea_en: Use the room's own mesh as the playground for a snowball fight.
works.idea_zh: 把房间本身的网格当作打雪仗的场地。
works.technique: Quest 3 world meshing builds a detailed scene mesh that is used as a physics collider, so thrown snowballs collide and leave splats on real furniture.
works.technique_zh: Quest 3 的环境网格生成精细的场景网格并作为物理碰撞体，扔出的雪球会与真实家具碰撞并留下雪痕。
works.exercise_en: Use a LiDAR phone or Quest scene mesh to make a throw-and-splat game: every hit leaves a paint mark that stays on the real wall. Twist: marks slowly melt away after a minute.
works.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的手机或 Quest 场景网格做一个“扔出去就留下痕迹”的游戏：每次击中都在真实墙面留下颜料印记。变体：印记一分钟后慢慢融化消失。

video.video_title:
The Quest 3’s world meshing doesn’t get talked about enough 🗣️ 

To demonstrate it’s accuracy, we built a Mixed Reality snowball (throwing) experience ⛄️ 

The world meshing creates a detailed map of

works.title: Mixed Reality vs. Reality
works.description: Side-by-side POV captures compare playing ping-pong in Quest 3 passthrough mixed reality and with Ray-Ban Meta glasses in plain reality, noting how occlusion and gravity feel different.
works.idea_zh: 把同一个动作分别在混合现实和真实世界里做，对比两者的'物理感'。

video.video_title: Mixed Reality vs. Reality #metaquest3 #raybanmeta

works.technique: Quest 3 passthrough MR with scene understanding simulates the ball, while the glasses record the real throw for a direct comparison of occlusion and physics.
works.exercise_zh: 让同学同一动作（扔纸团进篮筐）在 AR 版本和真实版本里各做一次并并排剪辑；加一个变化：AR 版本里故意改变重力，让观众找不同。
works.description_zh: 并排的第一人称视角录像，对比在 Quest 3 透视混合现实中打乒乓球和戴着 Ray-Ban Meta 眼镜在真实世界中打乒乓球，指出遮挡和重力的感受有何不同。
works.idea_en: Do the same action once in mixed reality and once in the real world, and compare how 'physical' each feels.
works.technique_zh: 带场景理解的 Quest 3 透视混合现实负责模拟乒乓球，眼镜则记录真实的击球，从而直接对比遮挡和物理效果。
works.exercise_en: Have a classmate do the same action (tossing a paper ball into a basket) once in an AR version and once for real, then edit the two side by side. Twist: secretly change the gravity in the AR version and have viewers spot the difference.

works.title: Monolith
works.description: S+T+ARTS AIR residency project on whether a digital entity can perform alongside humans: a dancer's body, reconstructed from ordinary video, stirs a 3D fluid simulation in real time as part of a 'digital performer's brain'.
works.description_zh: S+T+ARTS AIR 驻留项目，追问数字实体能否与人同台表演：从普通视频中重建出的舞者身体，作为“数字表演者大脑”的一部分，实时搅动一个三维流体模拟。
works.idea_en: A dancer's body stirs a virtual fluid as if dancing in water.
works.idea_zh: 舞者的身体搅动虚拟流体，就像在水中起舞。
works.technique: GVHMR monocular human mesh recovery produces an SMPL body from video, and the per-vertex motion of that mesh is added to the velocity field of a real-time fluid simulation in Unity.
works.technique_zh: 用 GVHMR 单目人体网格重建从视频生成 SMPL 人体，再把网格每个顶点的运动叠加到 Unity 实时流体模拟的速度场中。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe pose on a webcam and inject each wrist's velocity into a 2D fluid shader projected on the floor. Twist: use the dancer's shadow instead of the skeleton as the obstacle.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头加 MediaPipe 姿态识别，把两只手腕的速度注入投在地面的二维流体着色器；变体：用舞者的影子而不是骨架作为流体的障碍物。

video.video_title: Motion Capture Human Drives 3D Fluid Simulation | Unity + GVHMR

works.title: Moon Story (Scientific and Fantastical)
works.description: A mobile AR story app for elementary schoolers that blends fantasy with astronomy and environmental science: story scenes appear in the child's own surroundings and LLM-driven characters let children talk with the story as they learn.
works.description_zh: 一个面向小学生的手机 AR 故事应用，把奇幻故事与天文、环境科学融在一起：故事场景出现在孩子自己身边，由大语言模型驱动的角色让孩子边学边与故事对话。
works.idea_en: Blend a fantasy story with real science and let the characters answer the child's own questions.
works.idea_zh: 把奇幻故事和真实科学揉在一起，让故事角色回答孩子自己的问题。
works.technique: AR scenes are anchored in the child's environment on a phone, while an LLM drives the characters' dialogue within the narrative and the lesson content.
works.technique_zh: 在手机上把 AR 场景锚定到孩子所处的环境中，同时由大语言模型在故事情节和课程内容的范围内驱动角色对话。
works.exercise_en: Write a five-scene AR story about the Moon for a nine-year-old, place each scene on a table with AR Foundation or Adobe Aero, and give the guide character an LLM system prompt that keeps answers scientifically accurate and under two sentences. Twist: ask the child where their family comes from and let the LLM retell one scene with a Moon myth from that culture.
works.exercise_zh: 为九岁孩子写一个五幕的月球 AR 故事，用 AR Foundation 或 Adobe Aero 把每一幕放到桌面上，并给向导角色写一段大模型系统提示，确保回答科学准确且不超过两句话。变体：问孩子家乡在哪里，让大模型用那种文化里关于月亮的神话重讲其中一幕。

video.video_title: Scientific and Fantastical: Creating Immersive, Culturally Relevant Learning Experiences with Aug...

works.title: Motion as input for real-time image generation
works.description: A person's movement captured by a Kinect drives a real-time image generator, so the picture morphs continuously as they move.
works.description_zh: Kinect 捕捉的人体动作驱动实时图像生成，画面随着人的动作不断变形。
works.idea_en: Dance the prompt instead of typing it.
works.idea_zh: 用舞蹈代替打字来写提示词。
works.technique: The Kinect depth or silhouette image is used as the init image (or control) for StreamDiffusion, producing new frames at interactive rates.
works.technique_zh: 把 Kinect 的深度图或轮廓图作为 StreamDiffusion 的初始图（或控制信号），以交互速率生成新画面。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam body-segmentation mask as the input to a fast image-to-image model and project the output on a wall behind the dancer. Twist: freeze the prompt word only when the dancer stops moving.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头人体分割遮罩作为快速图生图模型的输入，把结果投影在舞者身后的墙上。变体：只有舞者停下来时才切换提示词。

video.video_title: Playing around with motion as input for real-time image generation using Kinect and StreamDiffusion. https://t.co/f8OasAP8TV

works.title: Niantic Studio spatial anchoring
works.description: Developer workflow and demos for placing AR at real-world locations with VPS, including physics-driven content anchored to places.
works.idea_zh: 在编辑器里选一个真实地点，把 AR 内容精确钉上去。
works.technique: VPS-localized anchors give a stable real-world pose, and a physics engine simulates content relative to that anchor, so rigid bodies collide with approximated real geometry at a specific place.
works.exercise_zh: 在一个固定地点用图像标记定位，放置会滚下台阶的物理小球，并用简单碰撞体近似台阶；变体：让路过的人可以用手机“推”小球。
works.description_zh: 借助 VPS 把 AR 放置在真实世界地点的开发者工作流程和演示，其中包括锚定在具体地点、受物理驱动的内容。
works.idea_en: Pick a real place in the editor and pin AR content to it precisely.
works.technique_zh: 经 VPS 定位的锚点提供稳定的真实世界位姿，物理引擎则相对于该锚点模拟内容，使刚体在特定地点与近似的真实几何体发生碰撞。
works.exercise_en: Localize at a fixed spot with an image marker, place physics balls that roll down a set of steps, and approximate the steps with simple colliders. Twist: let passers-by 'push' the balls with their phones.

works.title: Nocturnal Fugue (with Matt McCorkle & Botao Hu)
works.description: A multisensory night journey beginning under Austin's Congress Bat Bridge, combining bat stories, sound and the EchoVision mixed-reality headsets to experience the bats' world.
works.idea_zh: 在蝙蝠桥下的夜晚，用声音与MR头显体验蝙蝠的感知世界
works.technique: Location-based sound composition is combined with HoloKit-based EchoVision headsets that visualise the participant's voice as echoes in the dark.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一条夜间校园“声音散步”路线，在每站用手机播放动物声音并用AR显示声波；变化：参与者必须用自己的声音“回声定位”找到下一站。

video.video_title: Nocturnal Fugue + EchoVision at the Contemporary Austin

works.description_zh: 一段从奥斯汀国会大道蝙蝠桥下出发的多感官夜间旅程，结合蝙蝠的故事、声音和 EchoVision 混合现实头显，让人体验蝙蝠的世界。
works.idea_en: On a night under a bat bridge, use sound and MR headsets to experience how bats perceive the world.
works.technique_zh: 把基于位置的声音创作与基于 HoloKit 的 EchoVision 头显相结合，后者把参与者的声音在黑暗中可视化为回声。
works.exercise_en: Design a nighttime 'sound walk' route across campus that plays animal sounds on a phone at each stop and shows the sound waves in AR. Twist: participants must use their own voices to 'echolocate' the next stop.

works.title: OmniActions
works.description: A pervasive-AR concept that predicts which digital action you may want to take on whatever you are seeing or hearing, such as saving a poster's date to your calendar or sharing a song, and offers it as a one-tap shortcut.
works.description_zh: 一个“无处不在的 AR”构想：针对你正看到或听到的东西，预测你可能想做的数字操作，比如把海报上的日期存进日历、分享正在播放的歌，并以一键快捷方式呈现。
works.idea_en: Turn anything you perceive into a ready-made next action.
works.idea_zh: 把你感知到的一切，变成现成的下一步操作。
works.technique: A diary study produced a taxonomy of follow-up actions; an LLM with chain-of-thought prompting reads multimodal sensory input and predicts the most likely action categories.
works.technique_zh: 作者通过日记研究总结出后续操作的分类体系，再由带思维链提示的大语言模型读取多模态感知输入，预测最可能的操作类别。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone camera app with three buttons the AI fills in: point at a poster, menu or product, send the frame to a multimodal LLM that returns the three most useful actions as JSON (label and app), and render them as AR chips next to the object. Twist: have the AI also predict one action the user should not take.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个带三个按钮的手机相机应用，按钮内容由 AI 填写：对准海报、菜单或商品，把画面发给多模态大模型，让它以 JSON 返回最有用的三个操作（名称与对应应用），并作为 AR 小标签显示在物体旁。变体：让 AI 同时预测一个用户最好不要做的操作。

video.video_title: OmniActions: Predicting Digital Actions in Response to Real-World Multimodal Sensory Inputs with ...

works.title: One for Sorrow
works.description: Made for the Birdsong Project, the film starts with plain footage of birds, then lets the traces appear and pile up, ending with mirrored swift trails that suggest symbols in the sky, like the omens read by Roman augurs.
works.description_zh: 为 Birdsong Project 创作的影片从普通的飞鸟画面开始，随后轨迹逐渐出现并叠加，最后以镜像的雨燕轨迹结尾，仿佛天空中浮现出符号，就像古罗马占卜师解读的征兆。
works.idea_en: Mirroring natural traces makes people read meaning into them, a way for AR to turn random motion into a message.
works.idea_zh: 镜像处理自然轨迹会让人从中读出意义，这是 AR 把随机运动变成信息的一种方式。
works.technique: The trail effect is revealed gradually over the footage and then mirrored left-right to create symmetric, sign-like shapes.
works.technique_zh: 轨迹效果在画面中逐步显现，随后左右镜像，形成对称、像符号一样的形状。
works.exercise_en: Add a vertical mirror to a live motion-trail camera effect so anything moving in front of the phone draws a symmetric figure. Twist: save the most symmetric figure of the day as a 'sign' and pin it in AR where it was made.
works.exercise_zh: 给实时运动轨迹相机特效加一面竖直镜像，让手机前任何移动的物体都画出对称图形；变体：把当天最对称的图形保存为“征兆”，钉在其产生的位置上供 AR 查看。

video.video_title: One for Sorrow

works.title: Optical theatre for 'From Kalila wa Dimna to La Fontaine' (Louvre Abu Dhabi)
works.description: For an exhibition on animal fables at the Louvre Abu Dhabi, Sorin built an optical theatre in which filmed actors and animals appear as small floating figures inside a miniature stage, acting out a fable among physical scenery.
works.description_zh: 为阿布扎比卢浮宫的动物寓言展，Sorin 做了一座光学剧场：拍好的演员与动物以小小的漂浮人物出现在微缩舞台里，在实体布景之间演出一则寓言。
works.idea_en: A museum vitrine can host a living scene without a headset; the same framing (a box, a window, a lit set) helps AR content feel placed and intentional.
works.idea_zh: 博物馆展柜不用头显也能容纳一个活的场景；同样的框景方式（盒子、窗口、被照亮的布景）能让 AR 内容显得有位置、有意图。
works.technique: A larger Pepper's-ghost vitrine: hidden screens reflect in angled glass over a lit physical set, with actors shot on black so only their figures appear.
works.technique_zh: 更大尺度的佩珀尔幻象展柜：隐藏屏幕映在倾斜玻璃上，叠加在被照亮的实体布景上；演员在黑底前拍摄，所以只显出人物本身。
works.exercise_en: Pick a short fable and stage it in AR on a real bookshelf: use image tracking on a book cover to anchor two tiny animated animals that act out the story. Twist: the moral appears as text only when the viewer leans closer.
