works.exercise_zh: 选一则短寓言，在一个真实书架上用 AR 演出来：用图像追踪识别一本书的封面，锚定两只会动的小动物演完故事；变体：只有当观众凑近时，寓意才以文字出现。

video.video_title: Théâtre optique de Pierrick Sorin pour l'exposition De Kalīla wa Dimna à La Fontaine

works.title: PANDALens
works.description: A travel companion on optical see-through glasses that notices interesting moments from what you see, hear and do, asks you short reflective questions, and then drafts a travel blog with an LLM from those moments and your answers.
works.description_zh: 一副光学透视眼镜上的旅行伙伴：它从你看到、听到和做的事情中捕捉有意思的瞬间，向你提几个简短的反思问题，再用大语言模型把这些瞬间和你的回答写成游记草稿。
works.idea_en: Glasses that interview you during the trip and write the diary with you.
works.idea_zh: 旅途中采访你、并和你一起写日记的眼镜。
works.technique: Multimodal context from the camera, audio and user behavior is used to detect notable moments that appear as prompts on a head-mounted display; an LLM turns the collected moments and replies into narrative text.
works.technique_zh: 利用摄像头、音频和用户行为等多模态情境检测值得记录的时刻，在头戴显示器上以提示呈现；大语言模型再把收集到的时刻和回答写成叙事文本。
works.exercise_en: Walk around campus for 30 minutes with a phone app that takes a photo whenever you pause for more than ten seconds, asks you one spoken question about it and records your answer; at the end, send photos and answers to an LLM to write a one-page story. Twist: have the AI write in the voice of the place instead of yours.
works.exercise_zh: 带着一个手机应用在校园里走 30 分钟：每当你停留超过十秒，它就拍一张照片、用语音问你一个相关问题并记录回答；最后把照片和回答交给大模型写成一页小故事。变体：让 AI 以这个地方的口吻来写，而不是你的口吻。

video.video_title: Demonstrating PANDALens: Enhancing Daily Activity Documentation with AI-assisted In-Context Writi...

works.title: Paris 1924
works.description: Marking 100 years since Paris last hosted the Olympics, fans in the city see the streets around them transform into 1924 Paris, while fans elsewhere are transported to the 1924 Yves-du-Manoir stadium.
works.description_zh: 为纪念巴黎上一次举办奥运会一百周年，身在巴黎的人能看到身边街道变回 1924 年的样子，其他地方的人则被“传送”到 1924 年的 Yves-du-Manoir 体育场。
works.idea_en: Time-travel the street you are standing on back exactly one hundred years.
works.idea_zh: 把你脚下这条街倒回整整一百年前。
works.technique: Two modes of one Lens: City/Landmarker tracking re-skins real Paris buildings on site, and a portal scene reconstructs the stadium for remote users.
works.technique_zh: 同一 Lens 有两种模式：现场用城市级地标追踪给真实巴黎建筑“换皮”，异地用户则通过传送门场景进入重建的体育场。
works.exercise_en: Find an old photo of a spot on campus and build an AR view that overlays the historical scene aligned to the present. Twist: add a portal for people who are not on site.
works.exercise_zh: 找一张校园某处的老照片，做一个 AR 视图，把历史画面与当下场景对齐叠加；变体：为不在现场的人加一个传送门入口。

video.video_title: Paris 1924 - Snapchat

salient.why_en: Hold up your phone and the street you are standing on goes back exactly one hundred years.
salient.why_zh: 举起手机，你脚下的这条街就回到了整整一百年前。

works.title: Parking-lot kart race
works.description: A mixed-reality game turns any empty parking lot into a Mario Kart-style race track with virtual boosts and items, playable at Two Bit Circus.
works.idea_zh: 把任何停车场变成马里奥赛车跑道。

video.video_title: I made a game that turns any parking lot into a mario kart-style race track and you can play it at two bit circus! https://t.co/QrcLHuGDO3

works.technique: A track, item boxes and boost pads are generated to fit the detected open ground and anchored in world space for players moving through it.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR 在篮球场上画出一条虚拟跑道和加速带，让同学推着椅子比赛；加一个变化：撞到虚拟香蕉皮要原地转一圈。
works.description_zh: 一款混合现实游戏，把任何一片空旷的停车场变成马里奥赛车风格的赛道，配有虚拟加速和道具，可以在 Two Bit Circus 体验。
works.idea_en: Turn any parking lot into a Mario Kart track.
works.technique_zh: 根据检测到的空旷地面生成适配的赛道、道具箱和加速垫，并锚定在世界空间中，供玩家穿行其间。
works.exercise_en: Draw a virtual track and boost strips on a basketball court in AR and have classmates race while pushing chairs. Twist: anyone who hits a virtual banana peel must spin around once on the spot.

works.title: Peridot Beyond
works.description: Peridot on Snap Spectacles: several people wearing glasses see and play with the same Dots in shared multiplayer AR.
works.idea_zh: 戴上Spectacles，几个人一起在现实中照顾同一只AR宠物。

video.video_title: Peridot Beyond – Experience the Magic of Multiplayer AR from Niantic on Snap’s Spectacles

works.technique: Multiple glasses join a shared session with colocalized coordinates, so the same pet entity and its state are replicated to every wearer.
works.exercise_zh: 让两三台设备共享同一只 AR 宠物，谁先扔球宠物就去追谁的球；变体：宠物会记住最常陪它玩的人。
works.description_zh: Snap Spectacles 上的 Peridot：几个戴着眼镜的人可以在共享的多人 AR 中看到同一群 Dot，并和它们一起玩。
works.idea_en: Wearing Spectacles, several people look after the same AR pet together in the real world.
works.technique_zh: 多副眼镜加入一个坐标共同定位的共享会话，同一只宠物实体及其状态会同步到每位佩戴者。
works.exercise_en: Have two or three devices share one AR pet that chases the ball of whoever throws first. Twist: the pet remembers who plays with it most.

works.title: Phish at Sphere
works.description: For Phish's four-night residency at Sphere in Las Vegas, Moment Factory created a different show each night on the venue's wraparound LED interior, with visuals played live alongside the band's improvisation.
works.description_zh: 在 Phish 乐队于拉斯维加斯 Sphere 的四晚驻场中，Moment Factory 每晚在场馆包围式的 LED 内壁上呈现不同的演出，视觉随乐队的即兴演奏现场演绎。
works.idea_en: An improvising band needs improvising visuals; live AR performances need real-time operators, not only pre-baked scenes.
works.idea_zh: 即兴演奏的乐队需要即兴的视觉；现场 AR 演出需要实时操作者，而不只是预先做好的场景。
works.technique: Real-time engines drive custom content on Sphere's interior display, with visual operators performing and switching scenes live (engine likely Unreal or Notch).
works.technique_zh: 用实时引擎驱动 Sphere 内屏上的定制内容，由视觉操作者现场演奏、切换场景（引擎推测为 Unreal 或 Notch）。
works.exercise_en: Build a shared AR concert scene in Unity with Netcode or a WebXR multiplayer template, where one student operates the visuals live from a laptop while others watch through phones. Twist: the operator can only use three knobs, forcing a clear visual language.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Unity Netcode 或 WebXR 多人模板做一个共享 AR 音乐会场景，一位同学在笔记本上现场操控视觉，其他人用手机观看；变体：操作者只能用三个旋钮，迫使视觉语言足够清晰。

video.video_title: Phish, Live at Sphere | Exclusive Behind-the-Scenes

works.title: Pocket Buddy
works.description: A virtual-pet game where you scan a friend to turn them into a pocket-sized pet; the pet has wishes, and you keep it happy by finding the requested real objects (over 30 are recognised) with your camera. It won Lens of the Year at Lens Fest 2024.
works.description_zh: 一款虚拟宠物游戏：扫描一个朋友，把他变成口袋大小的宠物；宠物会许愿，你要用摄像头在现实中找到它想要的物品（能识别 30 多种）来让它开心。该作品获得 Lens Fest 2024 年度 Lens 奖。
works.idea_en: Scan your friend into a pet that asks you to find real things.
works.idea_zh: 把朋友扫描成一只宠物，它会让你去现实中找东西。
works.technique: The lens captures the person's texture and name into persistent storage, maps it onto a small animated character, and uses an on-device object-detection model to check whether the item the pet wants is in view.
works.technique_zh: Lens 把人物的贴图和名字保存到持久化存储中，映射到一个会动的小角色身上，再用手机端的物体识别模型判断宠物想要的物品是否出现在画面里。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone AR pet with Teachable Machine or a COCO object detector that asks for one everyday object at a time and reacts happily when the camera sees it. Twist: the pet's mood slowly drops if you ignore it for a minute.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Teachable Machine 或 COCO 物体识别模型做一个手机 AR 宠物：它每次要一个日常物品，摄像头看到后它就开心地回应；变体：如果一分钟没理它，它的心情会慢慢变差。

video.video_title: Pocket Buddy (A Virtual Pet)

works.title: Pollen VFX Composition
works.description: Petal-like ribbons open and turn like a flower while clouds of pollen particles drift and flare with the rhythm of the music.
works.description_zh: 花瓣般的光带像花一样绽放、旋转，成团的花粉粒子随音乐节奏飘散、闪亮。
works.idea_en: Grow an organic form whose opening and shedding are timed by sound.
works.idea_zh: 培育一个有机形态，让它的绽放与飘落都由声音来定时。
works.technique: Spectral band energies from the track drive procedural mesh deformation of the petals and VFX Graph spawn rates for the pollen through Sonosthesia's mapping packages; it runs at about 260 fps on an M3 Pro.
works.technique_zh: 音轨的各频段能量通过 Sonosthesia 的映射包，驱动花瓣程序化网格的形变，以及 VFX Graph 中花粉的生成速率；在 M3 Pro 上约 260 fps。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR flower on a real plant pot and let the phone's microphone decide when it opens and releases pollen. Twist: the flower closes again when the room goes quiet.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实花盆上放一朵 AR 花，由手机麦克风决定它何时绽放、何时释放花粉。变体：房间安静下来时，花会重新合上。

video.video_title: Pollen VFX Composition

works.title: Project Astra: a universal AI assistant that sees
works.description: Google DeepMind's research prototype assistant uses a phone camera or prototype glasses to understand the world live, speak several languages, use tools such as Search and Maps, and remember what it has seen.
works.description_zh: Google DeepMind 的研究原型助手通过手机摄像头或原型眼镜实时理解世界，能说多种语言，会调用搜索和地图等工具，并记住看过的东西。
works.idea_en: A single assistant that lives in your camera and keeps the context of your day.
works.idea_zh: 一个住在你摄像头里、记着你一天上下文的助手。
works.technique: A low-latency multimodal model streams video and native audio, caches recent visual context as memory, and calls external tools before answering.
works.technique_zh: 低延迟多模态模型流式处理视频和原生音频，把最近的视觉上下文缓存为记忆，并在回答前调用外部工具。
works.exercise_en: With a free multimodal live API, walk students through a neighbourhood and let the assistant narrate the street's history; log what it gets wrong. Twist: give the assistant a secret goal it must steer you toward.
works.exercise_zh: 用免费的多模态实时接口，带同学在街区里走一圈，让助手讲解街道历史，并记录它说错的地方。变体：给助手一个秘密目标，它要悄悄把你引过去。

video.video_title: Project Astra | Exploring the future capabilities of a universal AI assistant

works.title: Project Revival
works.description: At the Egyptian Museum and the National Museum of Egyptian Civilization in Cairo, visitors scan a QR code next to an artefact, such as Thutmose IV's chariot, to see it restored to its original state in Instagram AR.
works.description_zh: 在开罗的埃及博物馆和埃及国家文明博物馆，观众扫描文物旁的二维码（例如图特摩斯四世的战车），就能在 Instagram AR 中看到文物恢复原貌。
works.idea_en: Stand in front of a broken artefact and see it whole again, exactly where it sits.
works.idea_zh: 站在残缺的文物前，就在它原地看到它完整的模样。
works.technique: Artefacts were LiDAR-scanned and photogrammetry-captured, manually restored in 3D with museum experts, then delivered as Instagram AR effects aligned to the objects.
works.technique_zh: 先用 LiDAR 扫描和摄影测量采集文物，在博物馆专家指导下手工进行 3D 修复，再以与文物对齐的 Instagram AR 特效形式发布。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a chipped mug or broken object from 30 angles, build a 3D model, repair it digitally, and overlay the repaired version on the real object. Twist: show the break happening in reverse as an animation.
works.exercise_zh: 从 30 个角度拍摄一只有缺口的杯子或破损物件，建出 3D 模型并做数字修复，再把修好的版本叠加到实物上；变体：用倒放动画展示“破碎复原”的过程。

video.video_title: Thutmose IV's Chariot

salient.why_en: Stand before a broken artefact and see it whole again, exactly where it sits.
salient.why_zh: 站在残破的文物前，就在它所在的位置看到它完整的样子。

works.title: Projected fish school for cats
works.description: A school of small fish is projected onto the floor and scatters away from a cat that chases it, turning a projection into interactive play for pets.
works.description_zh: 一群小鱼被投射到地板上，在猫追扑时四散逃开，把投影变成了给宠物玩的互动游戏。
works.idea_en: AR for an audience that cannot read screens: a cat.
works.idea_zh: 给一个不会看屏幕的观众做 AR：一只猫。
works.technique: A camera tracks the cat's position and a flocking (boids) simulation makes the projected fish flee from it in real time.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪猫的位置，集群（boids）模拟让投影出的鱼实时躲避它。
works.exercise_en: Project a boids swarm onto the floor and make it flee from the largest moving blob seen by a webcam (a person's foot or a pet). Twist: the swarm slowly learns to follow instead of flee.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个 boids 集群投影到地面上，让它躲避摄像头看到的最大移动色块（人的脚或宠物）；变体：这个集群慢慢学会跟随而不是逃跑。

video.video_title:
Roelof Knol is a media artist and developer, mainly working with projection mapping to create visual or augmented reality interactive projected effects, like this interactive entertainment for cats.
h

salient.why_en: Projected fish scatter across the floor when a cat chases them: AR for an audience that cannot read screens.
salient.why_zh: 投在地板上的鱼群被猫一追就四散逃开：给看不懂屏幕的观众做的 AR。

works.title: Prompt-your-own AR drone show
works.description: Users type a prompt to design a drone formation; an image model draws it as a drone-light figure, a video model animates it, and it plays in the night sky in AR.
works.description_zh: 用户输入提示来设计无人机编队：图像模型把它画成灯光无人机的图案，视频模型让它动起来，再在 AR 夜空中播放。
works.idea_en: Anyone can direct a drone show by describing it.
works.idea_zh: 描述一下，任何人都能导演一场无人机表演。
works.technique: A Flux LoRA trained on drone-show imagery generates the formation, Luma's Dream Machine animates it into a clip, and the clip is placed as a large billboard in the AR sky.
works.technique_zh: 用无人机表演图片训练的 Flux LoRA 生成编队图案，Luma Dream Machine 把它做成动画，再作为巨大的广告板放在 AR 天空中。
works.exercise_en: Generate a 'drone light' image from a prompt, turn the bright pixels into 200 glowing points, and animate them rising into formation above a real building in phone AR. Twist: the formation is chosen by the audience's votes.
works.exercise_zh: 用提示生成一张“无人机灯光”图，把亮像素变成 200 个发光点，在手机 AR 中让它们从真实建筑上方升起组成图案。变体：由观众投票决定图案。

video.video_title: 🤩 Bringing together AI, XR, and drones — three of my passions — in this exciting AR droneshow! Using Flux Lora, the user can prompt the drone formations, then it’s animated with @LumaLabsAI's Dream Ma

works.title: Prototype: Someone - a random mirror
works.description: A mirror prototype that reflects the viewer's pose but replaces them with a randomly generated other person.
works.idea_zh: 镜子里照出的永远是'别人'

video.video_title: Prototype : Someone - a random mirror

works.technique: Pose estimation extracts the viewer's skeleton, which drives a randomly generated human avatar (or a generative image model conditioned on pose) shown as the reflection.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 驱动一个从素材库中随机挑选的 3D 人物模型，做成“镜子”；变体：每次有人进入画面时换一个人物，并让人物外观与观众正好相反。
works.description_zh: 一个镜子原型：它映出观看者的姿态，但把观看者本人替换成一个随机生成的陌生人。
works.idea_en: The mirror always shows 'someone else'.
works.technique_zh: 姿态估计提取观看者的骨架，用它驱动一个随机生成的人物化身（或以姿态为条件的生成式图像模型），作为镜中的倒影显示。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Pose to drive a 3D human model picked at random from an asset library, and present it as a 'mirror'. Twist: switch to a new person each time someone enters the frame, and make that person look the exact opposite of the viewer.

salient.why_en: A mirror that never shows you, only someone else moving the way you move.
salient.why_zh: 一面从不照出你自己的镜子，镜中永远是另一个人在跟着你动。

works.title: Puzzling Places on Apple Vision Pro
works.description: The 3D jigsaw game redesigned for Vision Pro, with scanned places assembled in your room using eye-and-pinch input.
works.idea_zh: 在Vision Pro上用注视加捏合在房间里拼真实地点的立体拼图。

video.video_title: Puzzling Places on Apple Vision Pro - Announcement Trailer

works.technique: Photogrammetry models are pre-split into pieces, and eye-gaze targeting plus a pinch gesture selects and moves pieces, with snap detection when a piece is near its correct pose.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描一件真实物品并切成几块，在 AR 中用拖拽拼回原样，接近正确位置时自动吸附；变体：拼完后物品开始动起来讲述它的来历。
works.description_zh: 这款 3D 拼图游戏为 Vision Pro 重新设计，你可以用注视加捏合的方式，在自己的房间里拼合扫描得到的真实地点。
works.idea_en: On Vision Pro, use gaze and pinch to assemble 3D puzzles of real places in your room.
works.technique_zh: 摄影测量模型被预先切分成碎片，通过视线瞄准加捏合手势来选取和移动碎片，当碎片接近正确位姿时触发吸附检测。
works.exercise_en: Scan a real object, cut it into a few pieces, and drag them back together in AR, snapping each piece into place when it gets close to the right position. Twist: once assembled, the object comes alive and tells its own story.

works.title: Puzzling Places: Local Mixed Reality Multiplayer
works.description: Two people in the same room assemble a photogrammetry-scanned miniature landmark together over a real table in passthrough, passing pieces by hand.
works.idea_zh: 两个人在同一张真实桌子上合拼现实地标的微缩3D拼图。

video.video_title: Puzzling Places: Local Mixed Reality Multiplayer (Walkthrough)

works.technique: Shared spatial anchors give both headsets the same table frame, and piece ownership is transferred over the network when one player grabs a piece from the other.
works.exercise_zh: 用两台手机和一个共同的图像标记对齐坐标，一起把一个拆成 4 块的 3D 模型拼回原样；变体：每个人只能看到一半碎片。
works.description_zh: 同一房间里的两个人在透视画面中，围着一张真实的桌子共同拼合一座通过摄影测量扫描得到的微缩地标，彼此用手传递拼图块。
works.idea_en: Two people assemble a miniature 3D puzzle of a real landmark together on the same real table.
works.technique_zh: 共享空间锚点让两台头显获得同一个桌面坐标系；当一名玩家从另一名玩家手中抓取拼图块时，其归属权通过网络转移。
works.exercise_en: Align coordinates on two phones with a shared image marker and work together to put a 3D model split into four pieces back together. Twist: each person can see only half of the pieces.

works.title: Rcam3 for Masaya Matsuura's concert
works.description: A fixed iPhone on stage captures the performers' depth, and Unity turns their silhouettes into large-scale VFX shown behind the band during Masaya Matsuura's concert.
works.idea_zh: 把手机 LiDAR 当成舞台上的体积摄像头，实时生成演出视觉。

video.video_title: Rcam3, my third Unity VFX project using the iPhone LiDAR. It was developed for Masaya Matsuura’s concert last night. This time, I focused on utilizing the depth sensing capability rather than AR VFX,

works.technique: An iPhone controller app streams color and LiDAR depth to a host PC, where the depth is converted to point positions that drive VFX Graph for projection.
works.exercise_zh: 用一台手机拍乐手，在 TouchDesigner 里把人体轮廓转成粒子投影到身后；加一个变化：鼓点触发粒子爆开。
works.description_zh: 在松浦雅也的演唱会上，舞台上固定的一部 iPhone 捕捉表演者的深度信息，Unity 把他们的剪影转化为大尺度视觉特效，显示在乐队身后。
works.idea_en: Use a phone's LiDAR as a volumetric camera on stage to generate live show visuals.
works.technique_zh: iPhone 控制端应用把彩色画面和 LiDAR 深度串流到主机，主机把深度转换为点的位置，驱动 VFX Graph 生成投影画面。
works.exercise_en: Film a musician with a phone and turn their body outline into particles in TouchDesigner, projected behind them. Twist: make the drum hits burst the particles apart.

works.title: Real-time diffusion as a muse while painting on paper
works.description: While the user paints on a real sheet of paper, a Quest 3 shows a live diffusion image next to it that reinterprets every stroke, acting as a muse rather than a replacement.
works.description_zh: 用户在真实纸张上作画时，Quest 3 在旁边实时显示一幅扩散模型图像，重新诠释每一笔，像缪斯一样启发而不是替代。
works.idea_en: Keep the pencil; let the AI dream alongside your drawing.
works.idea_zh: 笔还在你手里，AI 在你的画旁边做梦。
works.technique: A view of the paper is streamed to StreamDiffusion (image-to-image at low steps), and the result is shown as a floating panel beside the physical page.
works.technique_zh: 把纸面画面流式送入 StreamDiffusion（低步数图生图），生成结果以悬浮面板形式显示在实体纸张旁边。
works.exercise_en: Point a phone at a sketchbook, send the image to a fast image-to-image model every second, and show the result in a headset viewer next to the page. Twist: the AI only sees what you erased.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机对准速写本，每秒把画面送进快速图生图模型，在头戴支架里把结果显示在纸旁边。变体：AI 只能看到你擦掉的部分。

video.video_title: Real-time image diffusion as a muse while painting on physical paper. Prototype using StreamDiffusion and Quest 3. https://t.co/zbnIywxsTc https://t.co/2EqJf0GXAs

works.title: RealityEffects
works.description: Volumetric videos are augmented with object-centric annotations and dynamic visual effects that follow people and objects through the 3D recording.
works.idea_zh: 给立体视频里的人和物体加上跟随式标注和特效。

video.video_title: [DIS 2024] RealityEffects: Augmenting 3D Volumetric Videos with Object-Centric Annotation and Dynami

works.technique: Objects and people are tracked across frames of a volumetric (RGB-D) recording, and annotation or particle effects are attached to those 3D tracks so they follow the subject when the recording is replayed from any viewpoint.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Record3D 或 Polycam 录一段带深度的视频，在 Unity 或 three.js 回放时给其中的人或球挂上尾迹、标签和爆炸粒子；变体：用特效把一段普通的生活片段剪成体育解说。
works.description_zh: 为体积视频添加以物体为中心的标注和动态视觉特效，它们会在 3D 录像中跟随人和物体移动。
works.idea_en: Add annotations and effects that follow the people and objects in a 3D video.
works.technique_zh: 在体积（RGB-D）录像的各帧中追踪物体和人物，并把标注或粒子特效附着在这些 3D 轨迹上，这样无论从哪个视角回放录像，特效都会跟随主体。
works.exercise_en: Record a video with depth using Record3D or Polycam, and during playback in Unity or three.js attach trails, labels and explosion particles to a person or a ball. Twist: use the effects to recut an ordinary everyday clip as a sports broadcast.

works.title: Reframe
works.description: An AR storyboarding tool where designers place characters and events in the real space to act out and analyse security and privacy threats of AR apps.
works.idea_zh: 在真实空间里用AR故事板演出隐私威胁场景。

video.video_title: Reframe: An Augmented Reality Storyboarding Tool for Character-Driven Analysis of Security & Priv...

works.technique: Provides placeable character and annotation primitives in AR plus a threat-modelling framework to structure character-driven scenarios.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR在教室里摆放“用户/旁观者/攻击者”的虚拟小人，演出一个AR眼镜偷拍场景并讨论如何设计防护；变化：每组为对方的场景设计一个隐私补丁。
works.description_zh: 一个 AR 故事板工具：设计师在真实空间中放置角色和事件，把 AR 应用的安全与隐私威胁演出来并进行分析。
works.idea_en: Act out privacy-threat scenarios with AR storyboards in real space.
works.technique_zh: 在 AR 中提供可放置的角色和标注基元，并配合一个威胁建模框架，用来组织由角色驱动的情景。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR to place virtual figures for 'user', 'bystander' and 'attacker' in the classroom, act out a scene of someone secretly filming with AR glasses, and discuss how to design protections. Twist: each group designs a privacy patch for another group's scene.

works.title: Rendering Millions of Particles
works.description: Tens of millions of particles trace glowing 3D fractal attractors that morph smoothly from one shape to another, lit with a brute-force ambient occlusion pass.
works.description_zh: 数千万个粒子勾勒出发光的三维分形吸引子，并在不同形状之间平滑变形，再用暴力环境光遮蔽来照明。
works.idea_en: Apply a few random affine maps over and over and a fractal appears out of points.
works.idea_zh: 反复套用几个随机仿射变换，分形就从一堆点里浮现出来。
works.technique: A compute shader runs the chaos game of an iterated function system for every particle each frame, interpolating the affine transforms between two systems, and draws the points with procedural instancing plus an occlusion estimate.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器每帧为每个粒子运行迭代函数系统的“混沌游戏”，并在两个系统的仿射变换之间插值，再用程序化实例绘制这些点，并估算遮蔽。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a fractal cloud from the repo on a tracked image in AR and let the phone's distance to the marker morph between two attractors. Twist: seed the affine maps from the user's hand-pose landmarks.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把仓库里的分形点云锚定在一张识别图上，用手机到识别图的距离在两个吸引子之间变形。变体：用手部姿态关键点来生成仿射变换。

video.video_title: I Tried Rendering Millions Of Particles

works.title: Rodney Mullen's Skatrix Pro (Apple Vision Pro)
works.description: A launch title for Apple Vision Pro, co-published by Niantic: a Rodney Mullen-inspired skater rides over the player's sofa, tables and floor, which the headset scans and turns into a skate park.
works.description_zh: Apple Vision Pro 首发作品之一，由 Niantic 联合发行：一个受 Rodney Mullen 启发的滑手在玩家的沙发、桌子和地板上滑行，头显把这些扫描下来变成滑板公园。
works.idea_en: Your living room furniture becomes a miniature skate park you watch from above like a god.
works.idea_zh: 客厅家具变成一座迷你滑板公园，你像上帝一样俯瞰。
works.technique: visionOS scene reconstruction provides a room mesh used as physics geometry, and gaze-and-pinch or a game controller steers the skater.
works.technique_zh: visionOS 场景重建提供房间网格作为物理几何体，玩家用注视加捏合或游戏手柄操控滑手。
works.exercise_en: Use a headset or LiDAR phone mesh to find the three highest flat surfaces in a room and link them with a virtual ramp route. Twist: award extra points for routes that cross between two different pieces of furniture.
works.exercise_zh: 用头显或带 LiDAR 手机的网格找出房间里最高的三个平面，并用一条虚拟坡道路线把它们连起来。变体：跨越两件不同家具的路线获得额外加分。

video.video_title:
excited to play Rodney Mullen's Skatrix day one on Vision Pro, congratulations @KasimirLehto & @NianticEng !
https://t.co/34t7CiUJ7v https://t.co/ORxbuzm3aj

works.title: Sandworm (Meta Quest 3 + Apple Vision Pro)
works.description: A short mixed-reality sketch in which a Dune-style sandworm rises out of real, uneven outdoor ground, built by combining a Meta Quest 3 and an Apple Vision Pro.
works.description_zh: 一段混合现实小作品：一条《沙丘》风格的沙虫从真实、崎岖的户外地面钻出，由 Meta Quest 3 与 Apple Vision Pro 配合完成。
works.idea_en: Make giant fiction erupt from the actual terrain around you, not from a flat floor.
works.idea_zh: 让巨大的虚构生物从你身边真实的地形里冒出来，而不是从平整的地板上。
works.technique: The Quest 3 is likely used to scan and place the creature on uneven terrain, while the Vision Pro views or records the passthrough composite.
works.technique_zh: 很可能用 Quest 3 扫描崎岖地形并放置生物，再用 Vision Pro 观看或录制透视合成画面。
works.exercise_en: Scan an outdoor patch of ground with a phone's LiDAR or photogrammetry and make a creature emerge from it that follows the real bumps. Twist: the creature must hide again when someone walks toward it.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 LiDAR 或摄影测量扫描一块户外地面，让一只生物顺着真实的起伏从地里钻出；变体：有人朝它走近时，它必须重新躲回去。

video.video_title: Meta Quest 3 & Vision Pro work well together to make a Sandworm #applevisionpro #dune

works.title: Scaniverse Gaussian splat map
works.description: UX for browsing Gaussian-splat captures of real places on a map, then jumping from map to 3D to AR views.
works.idea_zh: 在地图上浏览全世界人们扫描的真实地点，再一键放进 AR。

video.video_title: Scaniverse 4: Share your world in 3D

works.technique: Geotagged splat captures are indexed on a map, and the UI moves from 2D map to an orbitable 3D viewer to an AR placement mode, reusing the same asset at each step.
works.exercise_zh: 设计并用 Figma 或网页原型做出“地图 → 3D 预览 → AR 查看”的三步流程，放入 3 个自己扫描的物品；变体：每个扫描附带一段扫描者的语音留言。
works.description_zh: 一套在地图上浏览真实地点高斯点扫描的用户体验设计，可以从地图跳到 3D 视图，再跳到 AR 视图。
works.idea_en: Browse real places scanned by people around the world on a map, then drop one into AR with a single tap.
works.technique_zh: 带地理标签的高斯点扫描在地图上建立索引，界面依次从二维地图过渡到可环绕查看的 3D 查看器，再到 AR 放置模式，每一步复用同一份资源。
works.exercise_en: Design and prototype a three-step 'map → 3D preview → AR view' flow in Figma or on the web, featuring three objects you scanned yourself. Twist: attach a voice message from the person who made each scan.

works.title: Schiphol People's Clock
works.description: A new clock at Schiphol in which the hands are formed by many different people, one after another, so the time is shown by a changing crowd of performers.
works.description_zh: 史基浦机场的一座新钟，指针由许多不同的人轮流组成，时间由一群不断更换的表演者来显示。
works.idea_en: Letting many people 'be' the interface makes it communal — AR experiences can be built from crowd-contributed recordings.
works.idea_zh: 让许多人“成为”界面，界面就有了集体感——AR 体验可以由众人贡献的录像组成。
works.technique: Likely a sequence of recorded clips of many participants posing as hands, edited and played back in sync with real time.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是把众多参与者扮演指针的录像片段剪辑在一起，并与真实时间同步播放。
works.exercise_en: Collect short phone videos of classmates posing as clock hands and assemble them into an AR clock that plays each clip at the matching minute. Twist: let visitors record themselves and join the clock.
works.exercise_zh: 收集同学们扮演钟针的手机短视频，把它们组合成一个 AR 时钟，在对应的分钟播放各自的片段。变体：让访客录下自己并加入这座钟。

video.video_title: Schiphol People's Clock

salient.why_en: The hands of a giant clock are people, one after another, showing the time with their bodies.
salient.why_zh: 巨大时钟的指针是一个接一个的真人，用身体摆出时间。

works.title: Sculpt the World
works.description: A short film of Foreman's beach works over several years: stones sorted by size and colour into spirals, circles and gradients on Welsh beaches, before the tide returns.
works.description_zh: 一部汇集 Foreman 多年海滩作品的短片：在威尔士海滩上，把石头按大小和颜色排成螺旋、圆圈和渐变，赶在潮水回来之前完成。
works.idea_en: Imposing a simple order (size, colour) on natural material reads immediately as intention, useful for AR layout and generative placement.
works.idea_zh: 给自然材料施加简单的秩序（大小、颜色）会立即被读作意图，这对 AR 布局与生成式摆放很有用。
works.technique: Stones are gathered and placed by hand following a sketched geometry, working within one low tide.
works.technique_zh: 在一次低潮的时间里，依据草图几何手工收集和摆放石头。
works.exercise_en: Scan 30 real stones and write a script that places them in AR in a spiral sorted from smallest to largest on any detected floor. Twist: the user can switch the sorting rule (size, colour, roughness) live.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描 30 块真实石头，编写脚本在任意检测到的地面上用 AR 把它们按从小到大的顺序排成螺旋；变体：用户可以实时切换排序规则（大小、颜色、粗糙度）。

video.video_title: Jon Foreman : Sculpt The World  - Land Art through the years

works.title: SdfManipulator
works.description: In the Unity editor, smooth SDF shapes are dragged, blended and carved with gizmos while the raymarched result updates live.
works.description_zh: 在 Unity 编辑器里，用操作手柄拖动、融合和雕刻平滑的 SDF 形体，光线步进的结果实时更新。
works.idea_en: Model with distance fields the way you would with clay, without writing shader code.
works.idea_zh: 像捏黏土一样用距离场建模，而不用写着色器代码。
works.technique: A tree of SDF primitives and operators with editor controllers is compiled into an HLSL raymarching shader through a generated ShaderLab/HLSL syntax-tree API, so each gizmo edit rewrites or re-parameterises the shader.
works.technique_zh: 带编辑器控制器的 SDF 基本体和运算符树，通过自动生成的 ShaderLab/HLSL 语法树 API 编译成 HLSL 光线步进着色器，每次拖动手柄都会重写或重新设置着色器参数。
works.exercise_en: Export a scene built with SdfManipulator as a raymarched cube and place it on a table with AR Foundation, then let two fingers control the blend radius between shapes. Twist: drive one primitive with the user's hand position.
works.exercise_zh: 把 SdfManipulator 做出的场景导出成一个光线步进立方体，用 AR Foundation 放到桌面上，再让双指控制形体之间的融合半径。变体：让其中一个基本体跟随用户的手部位置。

works.title: Shader Graph Material Examples for visionOS
works.description: On Apple Vision Pro a model dissolves away along a noisy, glowing edge and reappears, one of a set of open Shader Graph materials that also includes fresnel, caustic waves, flowing rivers and gaseous motion.
works.description_zh: 在 Apple Vision Pro 上，一个模型沿着带噪声的发光边缘溶解消失又重新出现；这是一套开源 Shader Graph 材质之一，其中还包括菲涅耳、焦散波纹、流动的河流和气体流动效果。
works.idea_en: A small library of readable node graphs is the fastest way into shaders on a new platform.
works.idea_zh: 一小套易读的节点图，是进入新平台着色器开发的最快途径。
works.technique: Materials are built in Reality Composer Pro's Shader Graph: a noise texture compared against an animated threshold drives opacity and an emissive edge band, and the material is applied to entities in RealityKit.
works.technique_zh: 材质在 Reality Composer Pro 的 Shader Graph 中搭建：用噪声纹理与动画阈值比较，驱动不透明度和发光边缘带，再把材质应用到 RealityKit 实体上。
works.exercise_en: Rebuild the dissolve material in Reality Composer Pro or Unity Shader Graph and trigger it when a virtual object is placed in the room. Twist: make the dissolve start from the point the user touched.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Reality Composer Pro 或 Unity Shader Graph 中重建溶解材质，当虚拟物体被放进房间时触发。变体：让溶解从用户触碰的位置开始扩散。

video.video_title:
(cont) visionOS: Shader Graph Material (SGM) Examples🌛
Can use the Dissolve shader like this. https://t.co/mZvNwggetu

works.title: SharedNeRF
works.description: A remote collaborator inspects a physical prototype in photorealistic 3D from any angle, while a live point cloud shows the local person's hands and moving parts as they change.
works.description_zh: 远程协作者可以从任意角度以照片级三维效果查看实体原型，同时实时点云会显示本地人员的手和正在移动的部件。
works.idea_en: Blend a slow but beautiful NeRF with a fast but rough point cloud to share a real workbench.
works.idea_zh: 把慢而精美的 NeRF 与快而粗糙的点云混合起来，共享一张真实的工作台。
works.technique: Renders a Neural Radiance Field of the static workspace and overlays a real-time RGB-D point cloud for dynamic elements, with the remote viewpoint driven by a head-mounted camera.
works.technique_zh: 为静态工作区渲染神经辐射场（NeRF），并叠加实时 RGB-D 点云表现动态元素，远程视角由头戴相机驱动。
works.exercise_en: Capture a desk with a phone 3D-scan app, share the model with a remote partner, then add a live phone video window for hands; have the partner guide an assembly. Twist: rescan only the part that changed.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机三维扫描 App 扫一张书桌，把模型分享给远程同伴，再加一个实时手机视频窗口拍手部，让同伴远程指导装配；变体：只重新扫描发生变化的部分。

video.video_title: SharedNeRF: Leveraging Photorealistic & View-dependent Rendering for Real-time, Remote Collaboration

works.title: Simulon AR VFX
works.description: Blender physics simulations composited into real locations using Simulon's AR capture and real-world lighting.
works.idea_zh: 用手机 AR 在现场“拍”特效，光照与真实环境一致。
works.technique: The tracked camera path and an estimated environment light probe from the real location are imported into Blender, where simulations are rendered with matching lighting and composited over the footage.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 的光照估计读取环境光强度和方向，让放在桌上的虚拟物体阴影和真实物体对齐；变体：关灯开灯时让虚拟物体做出不同反应。
works.description_zh: 利用 Simulon 的 AR 采集和真实世界光照，把 Blender 物理模拟合成到真实地点中。
works.idea_en: Shoot visual effects on location with phone AR, with lighting that matches the real environment.
works.technique_zh: 把从真实地点获取的追踪相机路径和估算出的环境光探针导入 Blender，以匹配的光照渲染模拟效果，再合成到实拍画面上。
works.exercise_en: Read ambient light intensity and direction with AR Foundation light estimation so that the shadows of virtual objects on a table line up with those of real objects. Twist: make the virtual objects react differently when the lights are switched off and on.

works.title: SituationAdapt
works.description: Mixed-reality windows that rearrange themselves as you move through the world: a vision-language model judges whether a panel would block a person you are talking to, a sign or an obstacle, and an optimizer moves it somewhere better.
works.description_zh: 会随你在世界中移动而自动重排的混合现实窗口：视觉语言模型判断某个面板是否会挡住正在与你交谈的人、指示牌或障碍物，再由优化器把它挪到更合适的位置。
works.idea_en: Let a vision-language model act as the social and safety editor of your floating UI.
works.idea_zh: 让视觉语言模型充当悬浮界面的“社交与安全编辑”。
works.technique: A perception module detects objects and people, a vision-and-language model scores candidate UI placements for environmental and social suitability, and an optimization module computes the final layout.
works.technique_zh: 感知模块检测物体和人，视觉语言模型为候选界面位置的环境与社交适宜度打分，优化模块据此计算最终布局。
works.exercise_en: In a Quest passthrough or phone AR app, place three virtual panels, then every few seconds send a camera frame plus the panel positions to a vision-language model asking which panel blocks something important, and move that panel. Twist: add a rule that panels must never cover a face and test it in a crowded hallway.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Quest 透视或手机 AR 应用中放三个虚拟面板，每隔几秒把相机画面和面板位置发给视觉语言模型，询问哪个面板挡住了重要的东西，然后移动那个面板。变体：加上“面板绝不能遮住人脸”的规则，在拥挤的走廊里测试。

video.video_title: SituationAdapt: Contextual UI Optimization in Mixed Reality with Situation Awareness & LLM Reasoning

works.title: Solid Light (Tate Modern)
works.description: A retrospective of McCall's solid-light works fills darkened galleries at Tate Modern with horizontal and vertical light volumes that crowds explore together.
works.description_zh: McCall 的“固态光”作品回顾展，把 Tate Modern 的昏暗展厅填满横向和竖向的光体，人们一起在其中探索。
works.idea_en: When light has volume, the audience becomes part of the image: other people's bodies interrupting the beam are content, which is how shared AR scenes should feel.
works.idea_zh: 当光有了体积，观众就成了画面的一部分：别人的身体打断光束也是内容，共享 AR 场景也应该有这种感觉。
works.technique: Several rooms each hold one projector-and-haze piece, spaced so that beams never overlap and each volume can be circled.
works.technique_zh: 每个展厅放一件投影加雾气的作品，彼此隔开，光束不交叠，每一个光体都可以绕行一圈。
works.exercise_en: Make a shared AR session (Lens Studio Connected Lenses or a WebXR multiplayer demo) with one large light cone where each participant's phone position cuts a visible shadow slice into the volume. Twist: record the slices over five minutes and replay them as a ghost crowd.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个共享 AR 会话（Lens Studio Connected Lenses 或 WebXR 多人示例），放一个大光锥，每位参与者手机的位置都会在光体中切出一片可见的阴影。变体：把五分钟内的切片记录下来，回放成一群幽灵观众。

video.video_title: Anthony McCall's Solid Light exhibition at Tate Modern | Wallpaper*

salient.why_en: A projected beam becomes a solid-looking volume that you walk into and cut with your body.
salient.why_zh: 投影光束变成看似实体的空间，你走进去，用身体把它切开。

works.title: SonifyAR
works.description: An AR sound-authoring system: when a virtual ball drops onto a real wooden table, it works out what just happened and on which material, then recommends, retrieves or generates a matching sound effect.
works.description_zh: 一个 AR 声音创作系统：当虚拟小球落到真实木桌上时，它会判断刚刚发生了什么、撞上了什么材质，然后推荐、检索或直接生成相匹配的音效。
works.idea_en: Let AI decide what an AR scene should sound like from real materials and virtual actions.
works.idea_zh: 让 AI 根据真实材质和虚拟动作，推断 AR 场景该发出什么声音。
works.technique: A programming-by-demonstration pipeline logs AR events, vision models describe the real surface involved, and an LLM turns that context into text that drives sound recommendation, retrieval, text-to-audio generation or style transfer.
works.technique_zh: 通过示范编程记录 AR 事件，视觉模型描述涉及的真实表面，大语言模型把这些情境整理成文本，用于音效推荐、检索、文本生成音频或音色迁移。
works.exercise_en: In a phone AR app, drop virtual objects onto detected planes and, on each collision, send a crop of the surface to a vision model asking 'what material is this?'; then play a sound from a small library (wood, metal, fabric, water) or from a text-to-audio model. Twist: give the virtual object a material too and let the LLM describe the combined sound.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 应用中让虚拟物体掉到检测平面上，每次碰撞时把表面截图发给视觉模型询问“这是什么材质？”，再从小音效库（木头、金属、布料、水）或文本生成音频模型中播放声音。变体：给虚拟物体也设定材质，让大模型描述两者相撞的组合声音。

video.video_title: SonifyAR: Context-Aware Sound Effect Generation in Augmented Reality

works.title: Sonosthesia: GPU Sound Visualisation
works.description: A glowing ring of light wobbles, swells and changes colour in real time with the music, prototyped as a sound-controlled object for XR.
works.description_zh: 一圈发光的光环随着音乐实时抖动、膨胀、变色，是为 XR 设计的声音控制物体原型。
works.idea_en: Break sound into a few descriptor streams and wire each one to a visual parameter.
works.idea_zh: 把声音拆成几路特征信号，每一路接到一个视觉参数上。
works.technique: Sonosthesia extracts energy in several spectral bands from the audio source and streams these descriptors into Shader Graph properties that displace and colour the mesh every frame.
works.technique_zh: Sonosthesia 从音源中提取多个频段的能量，把这些特征信号实时传入 Shader Graph 属性，每帧驱动网格的位移和颜色。
works.exercise_en: Split the phone microphone into bass, mid and treble bands and map each to one property of a Shader Graph ring floating in AR. Twist: make the ring react only to the voice of the person looking at it.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机麦克风的声音分成低、中、高三个频段，分别映射到漂浮在 AR 中的 Shader Graph 光环的一个属性上。变体：让光环只对正在注视它的那个人的声音作出反应。

video.video_title: Working on GPU based sound visualisation for interactive control in XR. Using shader graph with sound descriptor streams controlling parameters in RT. Thanks @BenCloward and @PabloMakes for the helpfu

works.title: Soul Paint
works.description: In VR you stand before a translucent body and paint where you feel emotions and sensations, with colours, textures and movement, then walk through a gallery of other people's painted bodies.
works.description_zh: 在 VR 中，你站在一个半透明的人体前，用颜色、质感和动态画出自己在身体哪里感受到情绪和感觉，然后走进一座展示他人“身体画”的画廊。
works.idea_en: Paint your feelings where they live in your body, then see everyone else's.
works.idea_zh: 把情绪画在它在身体里所在的位置，再看看别人的。
works.technique: Hand-tracked 3D painting tools in a headset let participants body-map sensations onto a shared avatar template; finished maps are saved and displayed as a collective archive.
works.technique_zh: 头显中的手部追踪 3D 绘画工具让参与者把感觉“绘制”到统一的人体模板上；完成的身体地图被保存下来，组成集体档案展示。
works.exercise_en: Print an outline of a body, let each student colour where they feel 'nervous' and 'calm', then place all outlines in a WebXR room as floating panels. Twist: let viewers walk into a body and hear the owner's one-word description.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一个人体轮廓，让每位学生涂出自己感到“紧张”和“平静”的部位，再把所有轮廓作为漂浮面板放进一个 WebXR 空间；变体：观众走进某个身体时，能听到主人用一个词描述那种感受。

video.video_title: Soul Paint Trailer

salient.why_en: Paint your feelings onto a body where you feel them, then walk among everyone else's.
salient.why_zh: 把情绪画在身体上你感受到它的位置，再走进其他人画出的身体之间。

works.title: SpaceBlender
works.description: Two remote people each snap a photo of their room, and generative AI stitches both into one coherent 3D space where their avatars meet for a VR brainstorming session.
works.description_zh: 两位远程参与者各拍一张自己房间的照片，生成式 AI 把两个房间缝合成一个连贯的三维空间，他们的虚拟化身在其中开 VR 头脑风暴会。
works.idea_en: Merge everyone's real rooms into one imagined shared room.
works.idea_zh: 把每个人的真实房间融合成一个想象出来的共享房间。
works.technique: Estimates depth from user photos, aligns the meshes, and completes the gaps with diffusion-based inpainting guided by geometric priors and adaptive prompts.
works.technique_zh: 从用户照片估计深度，对齐网格，再用基于几何先验和自适应提示词引导的扩散模型补全空缺。
works.exercise_en: Have two groups photograph their corners of the school, then collage them in an image editor into one 'impossible room' and view it as a 360 image in a phone viewer. Twist: let an image generator fill the seams and discuss what it invented.
works.exercise_zh: 让两组学生分别拍下学校里的某个角落，在图像编辑器里拼成一个“不可能的房间”，再用手机以 360 度图片观看；变体：让图像生成模型填补接缝，讨论它“编造”了什么。

video.video_title: SpaceBlender: Creating Context-Rich Collaborative Spaces Through Generative 3D Scene Blending

works.title: Spark AR sketches (retrospective)
works.description: A reel of the face and world effects Zach made for Instagram's Spark AR before the platform shut down: generative type, face distortions and drawn trails.
works.idea_zh: 回顾自己在 Spark AR 上做的一系列即时可分享的脸部与世界特效。
works.technique: Face-mesh tracking and segmentation in Spark AR drive shader-based distortions and generative graphics that anyone can open instantly from a link.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 Effect House 做一个“一眼就能看懂”的脸部特效，并在 10 分钟内发给三个人试玩；变体：让效果只在两人同时入镜时出现。

video.video_title: remembering some spark AR things I made. RIP https://t.co/5mNyLDSnXd

works.description_zh: 一段合集，收录了 Zach 在 Instagram 的 Spark AR 平台关停之前为其制作的人脸与世界特效：生成式文字、面部扭曲和手绘轨迹。
works.idea_en: A look back at a series of instantly shareable face and world effects made in Spark AR.
works.technique_zh: Spark AR 中的面部网格追踪和分割驱动基于着色器的扭曲效果和生成式图形，任何人都能通过链接即时打开。
works.exercise_en: Make a face effect in Lens Studio or Effect House that people understand at a glance, and send it to three people to try within 10 minutes. Twist: make the effect appear only when two people are in the frame together.

works.title: Spark VFX Composition
works.description: A deforming sphere throws out branching electric sparks that crackle and pulse in sync with a piece of music.
works.description_zh: 一个不断变形的球体向外甩出分叉的电火花，火花随着音乐噼啪闪烁、脉动。
works.idea_en: Let each part of the music own one part of the effect: the core, the sparks, the glow.
works.idea_zh: 让音乐的每个部分各自掌管特效的一部分：核心、火花、光晕。
works.technique: Audio descriptors from a Timeline-played track are routed through Sonosthesia signal packages to mesh deformation on the sphere and to VFX Graph properties that spawn and shape the spark strips; it runs at about 98 fps on an M1 Pro.
works.technique_zh: 由 Timeline 播放的音轨提取出音频特征，经 Sonosthesia 的信号包分别送到球体的网格形变和 VFX Graph 属性上，控制火花条带的生成与形态；在 M1 Pro 上约 98 fps。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a sparking orb to a real speaker in AR and drive its sparks from the phone microphone's onsets. Twist: sparks jump towards whoever is standing closest.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一个会放电的球锚定在真实音箱上，用手机麦克风检测到的起音驱动火花。变体：让火花跳向离它最近的人。

video.video_title: Spark VFX Composition

works.title: Spark2D
works.description: Inigo Quilez's 2D distance-field shapes (hearts, stars, rounded boxes and more) morph, glow and blend live in a Unity UI, scripted from JavaScript.
works.description_zh: Inigo Quilez 的 2D 距离场形状（心形、星形、圆角矩形等）在 Unity 界面里实时变形、发光、融合，并由 JavaScript 脚本控制。
works.idea_en: Treat every shape as a distance function, and outlines, glows and blends come for free.
works.idea_zh: 把每个形状都当成距离函数，描边、光晕和融合就都是现成的。
works.technique: Compute shaders evaluate 2D signed distance functions, fBm noise and jump-flood SDF generation into textures, which gradient and blur kernels then colour; OneJS bindings expose them to JavaScript.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器把 2D 有向距离函数、fBm 噪声和跳跃泛洪 SDF 生成的结果写入纹理，再由渐变和模糊内核上色；OneJS 绑定把这些功能开放给 JavaScript。
works.exercise_en: Draw floating AR stickers from 2D SDF shapes whose glow radius follows the viewer's distance. Twist: two stickers melt together with a smooth-min blend when you push them close.
works.exercise_zh: 用 2D SDF 形状做漂浮的 AR 贴纸，让光晕半径随观看距离变化。变体：把两张贴纸推近时，用平滑最小值混合让它们融在一起。

video.video_title:
Playing around with @iquilezles 2D shapes in Unity. Works great with #OneJS. All the compute shader code are open source here: 

https://t.co/UxM38Agi1X

#VFX #Unity #madewithunity #javascript #uidesi

works.title: Spatial Ops
works.description: A mixed-reality FPS in which players lay out cover and objectives across a real space and fight co-located or remote opponents through their homes and offices.
works.idea_zh: 把家或办公室变成多人同场的混合现实射击战场。

video.video_title: Spatial Ops | Launch Trailer

works.technique: Players place virtual cover and objectives on a shared anchor map of the real space, and co-located players are synchronized through shared spatial anchors.
works.exercise_zh: 在教室里用 AR 布置几块虚拟掩体，另一台手机进入时能看到同样的布局；变体：掩体会随时间慢慢被“侵蚀”。
works.description_zh: 一款混合现实第一人称射击游戏：玩家在真实空间中布置掩体和目标，与同处一室或远程的对手在家中或办公室里对战。
works.idea_en: Turn your home or office into a mixed-reality shooting arena for players in the same space.
works.technique_zh: 玩家在真实空间的共享锚点地图上放置虚拟掩体和目标，同处一地的玩家通过共享空间锚点保持同步。
works.exercise_en: Set up a few virtual cover blocks in the classroom with AR so that a second phone joining the session sees the same layout. Twist: the cover slowly 'erodes' over time.

works.title: Spatial Vacuuming
works.description: A Quest controller strapped to a vacuum paints the floor as you clean in passthrough, so you can see which parts of the room you have already covered.
works.idea_zh: 吸尘时在地板上实时标出已清洁区域，再也不漏掉角落。

video.video_title:
Spatial Vacuuming

Never miss a spot again! https://t.co/VJlHaY9XIJ

works.technique: A tracked controller on the vacuum head writes its floor position into a render texture or grid, painting a coverage map over the floor plane in passthrough.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机绑在拖把或扫帚上，用 AR 追踪位置并在地面平面上涂色，显示已经扫过的区域；变体：给没扫到的角落加上逐渐长出来的 AR 灰尘怪。
works.description_zh: 把 Quest 手柄绑在吸尘器上，在透视画面中边打扫边在地板上涂色，让你看清房间里哪些地方已经吸过了。
works.idea_en: While vacuuming, mark the cleaned floor in real time so you never miss a corner.
works.technique_zh: 吸尘器头上被追踪的手柄把自己在地面上的位置写入一张渲染纹理或网格，在透视画面中的地面平面上绘出覆盖范围图。
works.exercise_en: Strap a phone to a mop or broom, track its position with AR, and paint the floor plane to show the area already swept. Twist: add AR dust monsters that slowly grow in the corners you missed.

salient.why_en: While you vacuum, the floor you have cleaned gets painted over, so the missed spots stand out.
salient.why_zh: 吸尘时，吸过的地面被实时涂上颜色，漏掉的角落一眼就看出来。

works.title: Spectacles walk RPG
works.description: A Snap Spectacles game made in a weekend turns an everyday walk into an RPG adventure, with monsters and loot appearing along the real path.
works.idea_zh: 戴上眼镜，日常散步变成打怪升级的冒险。

video.video_title: This weekend I made a Spectacles game that turns your daily walk into an RPG adventure!! https://t.co/ov5UFC8I2l

works.technique: World tracking on Spectacles places encounters at intervals along the walked path, and hand tracking is used to fight.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 做'上学路 RPG'：每走 50 步刷出一个怪，用手势打败它；加一个变化：怪物种类由天气决定。
works.description_zh: 一款用一个周末做出来的 Snap Spectacles 游戏，把日常散步变成一场 RPG 冒险，怪物和战利品会沿着真实路线出现。
works.idea_en: Put on the glasses and an everyday walk becomes a monster-fighting, level-up adventure.
works.technique_zh: Spectacles 的世界追踪沿着行走路线每隔一段距离放置遭遇事件，并用手部追踪进行战斗。
works.exercise_en: Make a 'walk-to-school RPG' in phone AR: a monster spawns every 50 steps and you defeat it with hand gestures. Twist: the type of monster depends on the weather.

works.title: Star Spirit of Creation (Dakota thoughts in Latvia)
works.description: An AR video piece made in Latvia in which Dakota star spirits and patterns appear over the people and places the artist visited.
works.idea_zh: 把达科他星辰神灵带到异国风景中，连接两地的祖先记忆
works.technique: AR animation is placed into real scenes and captured as screen recordings (likely with a mobile AR authoring tool).
works.exercise_zh: 为自己的家乡文化设计一个AR“守护灵”，在旅行或校园里拍摄它出现在各地的短片；变化：守护灵在不同地点展现不同的形态。

video.video_title: Star Spirit of Creation (Dakota thoughts in Latvia) - Augmented Reality

works.description_zh: 一件在拉脱维亚创作的 AR 影像作品：达科他（Dakota）的星辰神灵与纹样出现在艺术家所拜访的人和地点之上。
works.idea_en: Bring Dakota star spirits into a foreign landscape to connect the ancestral memories of two places.
works.technique_zh: 把 AR 动画放入真实场景并以录屏形式记录（可能使用移动端 AR 创作工具）。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR 'guardian spirit' for your hometown culture and film short clips of it appearing in places you travel to or around campus. Twist: the spirit takes a different form in each place.

works.title: Starship Home
works.description: A Quest 3 story game that converts your room into a starship: real walls get replaced by windows onto space, and you grow alien plants and pilot the ship with your hands.
works.idea_zh: 把自己的房间改造成星舰船舱，墙壁化为太空舷窗。

video.video_title: Starship Home Mixed Reality Full Reveal Trailer

works.technique: Scene API wall planes are replaced with window shaders that render space behind them, while furniture remains in passthrough, turning the room into a spacecraft interior.
works.exercise_zh: 检测一面墙，把它渲染成可以看到星空的舷窗，其他部分保留真实画面；变体：舷窗外的景色随房间里的真实灯光开关而变化。
works.description_zh: 一款 Quest 3 剧情游戏，把你的房间改造成一艘星舰：真实的墙壁被替换成眺望太空的舷窗，你在其中培育外星植物，并用双手驾驶飞船。
works.idea_en: Convert your own room into a starship cabin whose walls become windows onto space.
works.technique_zh: 把 Scene API 提供的墙面平面替换为在其后渲染太空景象的舷窗着色器，家具则保留在透视画面中，从而把房间变成飞船内部。
works.exercise_en: Detect a wall and render it as a porthole that looks out onto the stars, keeping the rest of the view real. Twist: change the view outside the porthole when the real lights in the room are switched on or off.

works.title: Stick&Slip
works.description: Tiny liquid coatings are dispensed onto the fingertip to change friction on the fly, making any real surface feel sticky or slippery in mixed reality.
works.idea_zh: 往指尖涂一层液体，就能让任何表面变滑或变涩。

video.video_title: Stick&Slip: Altering Fingerpad Friction via Liquid Coatings

works.technique: Pumps small amounts of lubricating or friction-raising liquids onto the fingerpad and removes them, altering finger-surface friction without instrumenting the surface.
works.exercise_zh: 准备护手霜、爽身粉、水三种指尖涂层，让同学摸同一张纸并描述感受，再配合手机AR给纸面换上冰面/沙地贴图；变化：盲测能否猜出涂层。
works.description_zh: 在指尖上涂布极少量的液体涂层，随时改变摩擦力，让混合现实中的任何真实表面摸起来都变得发黏或光滑。
works.idea_en: Coat your fingertip with a thin layer of liquid, and any surface feels slippery or rough.
works.technique_zh: 向指腹泵送少量起润滑作用或增大摩擦的液体，并可将其清除，从而在不改造物体表面的情况下改变手指与表面之间的摩擦力。
works.exercise_en: Prepare three fingertip coatings (hand cream, talcum powder and water), have classmates touch the same sheet of paper and describe how it feels, and pair this with phone AR that changes the paper's texture to ice or sand. Twist: run a blind test to see whether people can guess the coating.

works.title: StreamDiffusionTD: real-time diffusion in TouchDesigner
works.description: A TouchDesigner component that runs StreamDiffusion so any live camera, 3D render or audio-reactive visual can be repainted by a diffusion model in real time for installations and VJ sets.
works.description_zh: 一个在 TouchDesigner 中运行 StreamDiffusion 的组件，让任意实时摄像头、三维渲染或音频响应画面都能被扩散模型实时重绘，用于装置与 VJ 演出。
works.idea_en: Any live video signal can be restyled by a prompt as it happens.
works.idea_zh: 任何实时视频信号都能在发生的同时被一句提示重绘。
works.technique: StreamDiffusion's pipelined, few-step image-to-image generation runs on an NVIDIA GPU inside TouchDesigner, taking a texture input and a prompt and outputting frames at interactive rates.
works.technique_zh: StreamDiffusion 的流水线式少步数图生图在 TouchDesigner 中借助 NVIDIA 显卡运行，输入纹理和提示，以交互速率输出画面。
works.exercise_en: Point a webcam at a table with objects, run a real-time diffusion node (TouchDesigner or a hosted API), and project the restyled image back onto the same table. Twist: let the audience change the prompt by moving objects.
works.exercise_zh: 把摄像头对准放着物品的桌子，运行实时扩散节点（TouchDesigner 或在线接口），把重绘后的画面投影回同一张桌子。变体：观众通过移动物品来改变提示词。

video.video_title: Real-time diffusion in TouchDesigner - StreamdiffusionTD Setup + Install + Settings

works.title: Super Fruit Ninja (Apple Vision Pro)
works.description: Fruit flies up around the player's real room, and they slice it with their bare hands; juice splatters on the surroundings and a sensei character guides minigames in the space.
works.description_zh: 水果在玩家真实的房间里飞起，玩家直接用双手切开它们；果汁溅满四周，还有一位忍者师父角色在空间里引导各种小游戏。
works.idea_en: The oldest touchscreen swipe becomes a full-arm slice through the air of your own room.
works.idea_zh: 最经典的触屏划切，变成在自己房间里挥动整条手臂的空中劈砍。
works.technique: visionOS hand tracking provides hand joint velocities that are tested against fruit colliders, with splatter decals placed in the passthrough space.
works.technique_zh: visionOS 手部追踪提供手部关节的速度，与水果碰撞体做检测，并在透视画面的空间中贴上果汁飞溅的贴花。
works.exercise_en: Spawn objects that arc through the room and slice them with a tracked hand, scoring only swings above a velocity threshold. Twist: let sliced halves stick to real walls and stay there for the rest of the session.
works.exercise_zh: 在房间里生成沿抛物线飞行的物体，用追踪到的手去切，只有挥动速度超过阈值才得分。变体：让切开的两半粘在真实墙面上，在整个体验中一直留着。

video.video_title: Super Fruit Ninja // Apple Vision Pro Launch Trailer

works.title: Talk to the Mushrooms (Mushroom Music)
works.description: A patch of 100 glowing LED mushrooms on a woodland floor lights up and dances in response to visitors' voices or music.
works.description_zh: 林地上的一片 100 朵发光 LED 蘑菇，会随着观众的声音或音乐亮起、舞动。
works.idea_en: Augment a real forest floor with light that listens, without any screen at all.
works.idea_zh: 不用任何屏幕，用会“倾听”的灯光增强真实的林地。
works.technique: Microphone input is analysed for volume and frequency and mapped to addressable LEDs inside handmade mushroom caps over Wi-Fi-synced controllers (likely).
works.technique_zh: 分析麦克风输入的音量和频率，映射到手工蘑菇伞盖里的可寻址 LED 上，由 Wi-Fi 同步的控制器驱动（推测）。
works.exercise_en: Build five paper lanterns with LEDs that react to classmates' voices, each lantern listening to a different pitch range. Twist: the lanterns only glow when two people sing in harmony.
works.exercise_zh: 用 LED 做五个纸灯笼，让它们对同学的声音作出反应，每个灯笼“听”不同的音高范围；变体：只有两个人唱出和声时灯笼才会亮。

video.video_title: Mushroom Music

works.title: Techno-Botanica
works.description: An AR artwork for Nocturnal at Electric Medway Festival 2024: through a phone, a night-time courtyard fills with glowing, neon alien plants that people can walk among.
works.description_zh: 为 Electric Medway Festival 2024 的 Nocturnal 活动制作的 AR 作品：透过手机，夜晚的庭院长满发光的霓虹外星植物，人们可以在其间穿行。
works.idea_en: A dark courtyard becomes a glowing alien garden on your phone.
works.idea_zh: 在手机里，昏暗的庭院变成一座发光的外星花园。
works.technique: Likely a mobile AR scene anchored to the ground plane, with emissive 3D plant models animated in a game engine.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是锚定在地面上的手机 AR 场景，用游戏引擎给自发光的三维植物模型做动画。
works.exercise_en: Model three glowing plants in Blender, place them in a Lens Studio or 8th Wall ground scene, and plant a garden outside at dusk. Twist: the plants only bloom when the phone's microphone hears singing.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Blender 里做三株发光植物，放进 Lens Studio 或 8th Wall 的地面场景，傍晚到室外种出一座花园；变体：只有手机麦克风听到有人唱歌时植物才会开花。

video.video_title: Tecohno Botanica

works.title: Thanet Warn(m)ing
works.description: An immersive light and sound installation that wraps the viewer in coloured light and shifting audio driven by 60 years of temperature data from the Manston weather station in Thanet: the warmer the year, the warmer the colour and the louder the sound.
works.description_zh: 一件沉浸式光与声装置，用 Thanet 地区 Manston 气象站 60 年的气温数据驱动彩色灯光和起伏的声音，把观众包裹其中：年份越热，颜色越暖、声音越响。
works.idea_en: Stand inside sixty years of local warming, felt as colour and volume.
works.idea_zh: 站进本地六十年的变暖之中，用颜色和音量去感受它。
works.technique: Yearly temperature values are mapped to LED colour temperature and to the gain of a local field recording, played back in sequence as a timeline.
works.technique_zh: 把逐年气温映射到 LED 的色温和一段本地环境录音的音量上，按时间顺序依次播放。
works.exercise_en: Download your city's yearly temperature record and drive a phone flashlight colour app or an LED strip plus a sound loop from it, one year per second. Twist: let visitors scrub through the years by walking along a line on the floor.
works.exercise_zh: 下载你所在城市的逐年气温记录，用它驱动一条 LED 灯带（或手机屏幕颜色）和一段循环音，每秒走一年；变体：让观众沿地上的一条线行走来拖动年份。

video.video_title: Aphra Shemza Thanet Warn(m)ing, 2024

works.title: The Keywords Karaoke
works.description: A karaoke machine plays songs whose lyrics and music are generated by AI from the search keywords of the local area, inviting visitors to sing the data of their neighbourhood.
works.description_zh: 一台卡拉 OK 机播放 AI 生成的歌曲，歌词和音乐来自当地的搜索关键词，邀请观众把自己街区的数据唱出来。
works.idea_en: Sing your neighbourhood's search history.
works.idea_zh: 唱出你所在街区的搜索记录。
works.technique: Geo-localised keyword data is fed to AI models that generate lyrics and music, played back with karaoke-style on-screen lyrics.
works.technique_zh: 带地理位置的关键词数据输入 AI 模型生成歌词和音乐，并以卡拉 OK 式的屏幕歌词播放。
works.exercise_en: Collect ten words students see on the walk to school, have a text model write a chorus and perform it karaoke-style in class. Twist: each street gets its own verse.
works.exercise_zh: 收集学生上学路上看到的十个词，用文本模型写一段副歌，在课堂上以卡拉 OK 方式演唱；变体：每条街道各有一段主歌。

video.video_title: The Keywords Karaoke

works.title: Tony Hawk Pro Skater in AR
works.description: At Venice Beach Skatepark, skaters see AR score popups, trick names and collectibles over their real runs, remaking the video game on real concrete.
works.idea_zh: 把滑板游戏的计分和收集品叠加到真实滑板公园。

video.video_title: I remade tony hawk pro skater in AR and we just had a ton of fun testing it with skaters at Venice Beach Skatepark! https://t.co/lPtNaszMER

works.technique: Collectibles and score UI are anchored in the real park while the skater's motion is tracked relative to them (likely body/camera tracking).
works.exercise_zh: 在操场用 AR 放一串虚拟金币，同学跑步/骑车穿过它们计分；加一个变化：连续穿过三个金币触发'连击'特效。
works.description_zh: 在威尼斯海滩滑板公园，滑手们在真实滑行时会看到 AR 计分弹窗、动作名称和收集品，把这款电子游戏重新搬到了真实的水泥地上。
works.idea_en: Overlay a skateboarding game's scores and collectibles on a real skatepark.
works.technique_zh: 收集品和计分界面锚定在真实公园中，同时追踪滑手相对于这些内容的运动（可能借助身体追踪或相机追踪）。
works.exercise_en: Place a line of virtual coins on the sports field in AR, and score classmates as they run or cycle through them. Twist: passing through three coins in a row triggers a 'combo' effect.

works.title: Train Me
works.description: A coach records a movement with a phone or egocentric camera, and the trainee later replays it as a life-size 3D figure in an AR headset to copy it on the spot.
works.description_zh: 教练用手机或第一人称相机录下一个动作，学员之后在 AR 头显中以真人大小的三维形象回放，就地模仿。
works.idea_en: Record a coach once and replay them life-size wherever the athlete trains.
works.idea_zh: 教练只需录一次，就能在运动员训练的任何地方以真人大小回放。
works.technique: Captures sports movements with mobile or egocentric cameras, reconstructs them in 3D and visualises the instruction in an AR head-mounted display.
works.technique_zh: 用移动或第一人称相机捕捉运动动作，进行三维重建，并在 AR 头显中可视化动作指导。
works.exercise_en: Film a classmate's basketball free throw with a phone, place the video as a life-size AR billboard on the court, and have others mimic it side by side. Twist: slow the replay to half speed.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍下同学的罚球动作，把视频作为真人大小的 AR 画板放在球场上，让其他人并排模仿；变体：把回放放慢到一半速度。

video.video_title: Train Me: Exploring Mobile Sports Capture and Replay for Immersive Sports Coaching

works.title: Turning My Ceiling into a Planetarium
works.description: Mixed reality replaces the bedroom ceiling with a live star field and planets.
works.idea_zh: 用混合现实把卧室天花板变成星空天象馆。

video.video_title: I turned my CEILING into a PLANETARIUM! #metaquest #engineering #mixedreality

works.technique: The ceiling plane from the Quest room model is masked out of passthrough and replaced with a rendered sky dome, so stars appear through the ceiling while the walls stay real.
works.exercise_zh: 检测天花板平面后用遮罩把它替换成星空球面，通过手机仰头观看；变体：用手机指南针让星座方位与真实方向一致。
works.description_zh: 混合现实把卧室的天花板替换成实时的星空和行星。
works.idea_en: Use mixed reality to turn a bedroom ceiling into a planetarium.
works.technique_zh: 把 Quest 房间模型中的天花板平面从透视画面中遮罩掉，替换为渲染出的天空穹顶，于是星星透过天花板显现，而墙面依旧是真实的。
works.exercise_en: Detect the ceiling plane and replace it with a star-field dome using a mask, then look up at it through a phone. Twist: use the phone's compass so the constellations match their real directions.

works.title: Uber Stylized Water
works.description: A stylised cartoon water surface with depth colour, foam along shorelines and animated waves, shown in a short sneak peek before release.
works.description_zh: 一片风格化卡通水面，带有随深度变化的颜色、岸边泡沫和动画波浪，这是发布前的简短预览。
works.idea_en: Depth-based colour and foam make any shoreline read as water.
works.idea_zh: 基于深度的颜色和泡沫，让任何岸线一看就是水。
works.technique: The URP water shader compares scene depth with the water surface depth to blend shallow and deep colours and draw intersection foam, likely combined with vertex waves and scrolling normal maps.
works.technique_zh: URP 水面着色器比较场景深度和水面深度，混合浅水色和深水色并画出交界处的泡沫，很可能还结合了顶点波浪和滚动的法线贴图。
works.exercise_en: Place the water plane slightly above a real floor with AR Foundation and use LiDAR depth so foam appears where the water meets real feet and furniture. Twist: raise the water level slowly to flood the room.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 把水面放在真实地面稍上方，并用 LiDAR 深度，让泡沫出现在水面与真实的脚和家具相交处。变体：慢慢升高水位，让房间被淹没。

video.video_title: Uber Stylized Water for Unity6 [URP]- Sneak Peek

works.title: Un banquet augmenté (Château de Chantilly)
works.description: At the Château de Chantilly, visitors use a Lens to discover 19th-century court cooking as dishes and banquet scenes appear on the castle's real tables.
works.description_zh: 在尚蒂伊城堡，游客通过 Lens 了解 19 世纪的宫廷烹饪，菜肴和宴会场景会出现在城堡真实的餐桌上。
works.idea_en: Serve a historical feast on a real table so visitors learn food history by looking at their plate.
works.idea_zh: 在真实餐桌上“上菜”一场历史盛宴，让人看着盘子就学到饮食史。
works.technique: World and surface tracking place animated 3D dishes and table settings, likely recreated from historical recipes with a chef partner, at true scale on the château's tables.
works.technique_zh: 用世界与平面追踪把动画 3D 菜肴和餐具按真实尺寸放到城堡餐桌上，菜品很可能由合作厨师依据历史食谱复原。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR placemat that serves a dish from your family's or city's history, with labels for each ingredient's origin. Twist: the dish changes era every time someone takes a bite of real food.
works.exercise_zh: 做一张 AR 餐垫，端上一道来自你家族或城市历史的菜，并标注每种食材的来源；变体：每当有人咬一口真实食物，菜肴就换一个时代。

video.video_title: Un banquet augmenté - Château de Chantilly x Snapchat

works.title: Unity Runtime Shader
works.description: Fragment and compute shader code typed into a running Unity app recompiles instantly and repaints the output, like a live-coding session for visuals.
works.description_zh: 在运行中的 Unity 程序里输入片元着色器和计算着色器代码，画面立刻重新编译并刷新，就像一场视觉 live coding。
works.idea_en: Edit an effect while it is running, so tuning happens in front of the audience or inside the scene.
works.idea_zh: 在特效运行时直接修改它，让调试发生在观众面前或场景之中。
works.technique: The package compiles HLSL at runtime through the DirectX 11 shader compiler and writes the results into a RenderTexture or GraphicsBuffer that the rest of the scene can use (Windows and DX11 only).
works.technique_zh: 该插件在运行时通过 DirectX 11 着色器编译器编译 HLSL，把结果写进 RenderTexture 或 GraphicsBuffer，供场景其他部分使用（仅支持 Windows 和 DX11）。
works.exercise_en: Build a tiny live-coding panel in a WebXR page where a GLSL snippet paints a floating AR canvas and edits apply on save. Twist: two students edit the same canvas from two phones.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 网页里做一个小型 live coding 面板：一段 GLSL 代码绘制漂浮在 AR 中的画布，保存即生效。变体：两名学生用两部手机同时编辑同一块画布。

video.video_title:
Unityでランタイムでシェーダが書けるパッケージをひとまず公開しました〜
FragmentShaderとComputeShaderが書けます！(Windows & DX11 only)
https://t.co/wzGWCqQ13U
#unity #shader https://t.co/1tYfb5ZlYq

works.title: VFX Graph sketch: glowing lines on a moving figure
works.description: Red glowing lines trace and orbit around a moving figure in the dark, drawing its motion in light.
works.description_zh: 红色发光线条在黑暗中绕着一个运动的人形描画、环绕，用光画出动作。
works.idea_en: Draw a body only with the lines that follow it.
works.idea_zh: 只用跟随身体的线来画出身体。
works.technique: VFX Graph samples positions on an animated skinned mesh and draws particle strips that follow those points with a lag (likely using mesh sampling and strip outputs).
works.technique_zh: VFX Graph 在动画蒙皮网格上采样位置，画出延迟跟随这些点的粒子条带（推测使用网格采样和条带输出）。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation body tracking to attach light strips to a real dancer's joints and view it through HoloKit. Twist: the strips remember the last 5 seconds of movement.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 人体追踪把光带挂在真实舞者的关节上，用 HoloKit 观看。变体：光带保留最近 5 秒的动作。

video.video_title: https://t.co/MhTSsydBmW https://t.co/B1YzE5AL2s

works.title: Vision Pro pinball with pinch haptics
works.description: Pinball played on Apple Vision Pro using pinch gestures for the flippers; the tactile pinch of your own fingers stands in for button feedback.
works.idea_zh: 用手指捏合当弹珠台按钮：身体自带的触感就是反馈。
works.technique: visionOS hand tracking detects thumb–index pinch events and maps each hand's pinch to a flipper, relying on the self-contact of the fingers as passive haptic feedback.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个只用“捏合”手势的 AR 小游戏，利用手指相碰本身的触感当反馈；变体：左右手分别控制不同的机制。

video.video_title:
Vision Pro Pinball

Pinch haptics work surprisingly well https://t.co/Yipw9OkhUG

works.description_zh: 在 Apple Vision Pro 上玩弹珠台，用捏合手势控制挡板；自己手指相碰的触感替代了按钮反馈。
works.idea_en: Use a finger pinch as the pinball button, so the body's own sense of touch becomes the feedback.
works.technique_zh: visionOS 手部追踪检测拇指与食指的捏合事件，把每只手的捏合映射到一个挡板上，依靠手指之间的自我接触提供被动触觉反馈。
works.exercise_en: Design a small AR game that uses only a pinch gesture, relying on the feel of your fingers touching as the feedback. Twist: let the left and right hands control different mechanics.

works.title: VolFx
works.description: Scenes flip between dreamy, glitchy and painterly looks: blur, colour maps, flow and dithering are layered only onto chosen objects while the rest stays untouched.
works.description_zh: 画面在梦幻、故障、绘画等风格之间切换：模糊、色彩映射、流动和抖动只叠加在选定的物体上，其余部分保持不变。
works.idea_en: Post-processing does not have to apply to the whole screen; it can be a brush for chosen layers.
works.idea_zh: 后期处理不必作用于整个画面，它可以是只刷在选定图层上的画笔。
works.technique: A URP renderer feature renders selected layers into their own buffers and runs a stack of custom full-screen passes (blur, flow, colour map, dither) on them before compositing.
works.technique_zh: URP 渲染器特性把选定图层渲染到独立缓冲中，对它们执行一组自定义全屏 pass（模糊、流动、色彩映射、抖动），再合成回画面。
works.exercise_en: Use layer-selective post effects in phone AR so only the virtual creature is painted in watercolour while the camera feed stays real. Twist: switch the style when the creature is touched.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中使用按图层的后期效果，只把虚拟生物画成水彩，相机画面保持真实。变体：触摸生物时切换风格。

video.video_title: • VolFx ☄ - Trailer

works.title: Voyage au Centre de la Terre (Padirac cave mapping)
works.description: Deep inside the Gouffre de Padirac cave in France, an immersive theatre play ends with video mapping on the rock walls as the character Queen Siggi reawakens her powers.
works.description_zh: 在法国 Padirac 溶洞深处，一场沉浸式戏剧以岩壁上的投影映射收尾：角色 Siggi 女王重新唤醒了她的力量。
works.idea_en: Use a real cave as the screen and the stage for a journey to the centre of the Earth.
works.idea_zh: 把真实的溶洞当作屏幕和舞台，演一场“地心游记”。
works.technique: Particle and light content generated with Oxipital (Unity, TouchDesigner) is projection-mapped onto irregular cave rock and triggered through a custom web cue interface and Chataigne show control.
works.technique_zh: 用 Oxipital（Unity、TouchDesigner）生成的粒子与光影内容投影映射到不规则的洞壁岩石上，通过自制网页触发界面和 Chataigne 演出控制系统按需播放。
works.exercise_en: Project-map a short scene onto a rough, non-flat surface (crumpled paper, stones, a corner of the school) using MadMapper or TouchDesigner. Twist: let a performer trigger the next cue by stepping into a pool of light.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MadMapper 或 TouchDesigner 把一段短场景投影映射到粗糙、不平整的表面（揉皱的纸、石头、校园角落）。变体：让表演者踩进一片光中来触发下一段。

video.video_title: Video Mapping in Gouffre de Padirac cave

works.title: WOW+FLUTTER
works.description: A dual-site performance linking dancers in the North and South East of England, where AI-designed non-human avatars are animated live by the dancers via mocap and shown with video, virtual environments and live music.
works.description_zh: 连接英格兰北部与东南部两地舞者的双场地演出：由 AI 设计的非人类化身通过动捕由舞者实时驱动，并结合视频、虚拟环境和现场音乐呈现。
works.idea_en: Dancers in two cities share one body of non-human avatars.
works.idea_zh: 两座城市的舞者共用一群非人类化身的身体。
works.technique: Avatars generated from Midjourney prompts are modelled and rigged, then driven by live motion capture streamed between sites over a 10 Gb link into Unreal.
works.technique_zh: 由 Midjourney 提示生成的化身被建模、绑定，再由两地之间经 10 Gb 链路实时传输的动作捕捉数据在 Unreal 中驱动。
works.exercise_en: Generate a creature image with an AI tool, rig it with Mixamo, and drive it with a webcam pose stream from a partner in another room. Twist: each partner controls only half of the creature.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AI 工具生成一个生物形象，用 Mixamo 绑定，再用另一个房间里搭档的摄像头姿态流驱动它；变体：两位搭档各自只控制生物的一半身体。

video.video_title: WOW + FLUTTER (2024 Process documentation)

works.title: Wall Town Wonders
works.description: A Quest 3 mixed-reality town builder: tiny houses, streets and townsfolk grow out of your real walls, and you tend to their wishes by hand.
works.idea_zh: 在自家墙面上建一座会生活的小镇。

video.video_title: Wall Town Wonders | Announce Trailer | Meta Quest Platform

works.technique: Uses scene-understanding wall planes as the build grid so buildings attach to vertical surfaces and characters walk along them.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR竖直平面检测在教室墙上放置小房子和小人，小人沿墙“行走”；变化：墙上的真实窗户或海报成为小镇的地标。
works.description_zh: 一款 Quest 3 混合现实小镇建造游戏：小房子、街道和居民从你真实的墙面上长出来，你亲手满足他们的心愿。
works.idea_en: Build a living little town on the walls of your home.
works.technique_zh: 把场景理解得到的墙面平面用作建造网格，使建筑附着在竖直表面上，角色也沿着墙面行走。
works.exercise_en: Use vertical plane detection in phone AR to place little houses and people on a classroom wall and have the people 'walk' along it. Twist: make real windows or posters on the wall become landmarks in the town.

works.title: Waterhall Mocap Performance
works.description: For the reopening of the Waterhall at Birmingham Museum and Art Gallery, Birmingham Royal Ballet dancers Reina Fuchigami and Shuailun Wu perform while their movement paints real-time motion-capture imagery on a screen; visitors could also try it with their own bodies.
works.description_zh: 为伯明翰博物馆与美术馆 Waterhall 重新开放而作：Birmingham Royal Ballet 的舞者 Reina Fuchigami 和 Shuailun Wu 表演时，他们的动作在屏幕上实时绘出动作捕捉影像；观众也可以用自己的身体来尝试。
works.idea_en: A dancer's limbs leave painted trails that hang in the air behind them.
works.idea_zh: 舞者的四肢在身后留下悬在空中的彩色轨迹。
works.technique: Real-time motion capture tracks the dancers' joints, and the joint paths are rendered as brush-like ribbons in a game engine and shown live on a large screen.
works.technique_zh: 实时动作捕捉追踪舞者的关节，关节轨迹在游戏引擎里被渲染成笔刷般的彩带，并在大屏幕上实时显示。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam and MediaPipe to draw fading ribbons from a dancer's wrists and ankles on a projected screen, then invite the audience to try. Twist: each visitor's ribbons stay on screen until the next person replaces them.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头和 MediaPipe 从舞者的手腕和脚踝画出渐隐的彩带并投影出来，再邀请观众尝试；变体：每位观众的彩带都保留在屏幕上，直到下一个人把它们替换掉。

video.video_title: Reina Fuchigami and Shuailun Wu Mocap Performance at Birmingham Museum and Art Gallery

works.title: WebAR capture enhanced with GenAI video-to-video
works.description: Rough AR content captured in the browser is passed through Runway's video-to-video model so the virtual objects look far more photoreal in the final clip.
works.description_zh: 在浏览器里录下的粗糙 AR 画面被送进 Runway 的视频转视频模型，让虚拟物体在成片里显得更真实。
works.idea_en: Use AR as a rough sketch and let AI finish the rendering.
works.idea_zh: 把 AR 当草图，让 AI 完成最终渲染。
works.technique: A screen recording of WebAR is used as structure for a video-to-video diffusion model, which keeps the motion and layout but re-renders lighting and materials.
works.technique_zh: 把 WebAR 录屏当作结构参考，输入视频转视频扩散模型，保留运动和布局，重新渲染光照和材质。
works.exercise_en: Record a 5-second AR clip with a grey placeholder object, then run it through any video-to-video AI tool with a prompt describing the object. Twist: keep the same clip and try three prompts that change the object's story.
works.exercise_zh: 录一段放着灰色占位物体的 5 秒 AR 片段，用任意视频转视频 AI 工具配上描述该物体的提示重绘。变体：同一段素材试三个提示，让物体讲三个不同的故事。

video.video_title:
Capture AR content in the browser, then enhance it with GenAI video-to-video for improved quality ✨

Testing out this flow with Runway ML Gen-3 Alpha Turbo. https://t.co/v1xwlNvIGA

works.title: What others see / What we see
works.description: A split-screen joke after the 2024 Oscars: the top shows what everyone saw on stage, and the bottom shows what ZERO10 'sees', with the presenter dressed in AR as a boxy car-robot costume.
works.description_zh: 2024 年奥斯卡之后的一则分屏玩笑：上半部分是大家在舞台上看到的画面，下半部分是 ZERO10“看到的”，颁奖嘉宾被 AR 装扮成一身方方正正的汽车机器人造型。
works.idea_en: AR as a second way of seeing the same moment: what others see vs what we see.
works.idea_zh: AR 是看待同一时刻的第二种方式：别人看到的，和我们看到的。
works.technique: The same broadcast clip is tracked for body pose and a rigid 3D costume is attached to the torso and limbs, then stacked against the original for comparison.
works.technique_zh: 对同一段直播片段做人体姿态追踪，把一套硬质 3D 造型绑定到躯干和四肢上，再与原画面上下并列对比。
works.exercise_en: Record a 10-second clip of a classmate, then build a split-screen video where the lower half shows them in a body-tracked AR costume that changes their role (robot, knight, mascot). Twist: the costume must reveal something the top half hides.
works.exercise_zh: 录一段同学的 10 秒视频，做成上下分屏：下半部分用人体追踪 AR 服装改变他的身份（机器人、骑士、吉祥物）；变体：这套服装要揭示上半部分画面中隐藏的某种东西。

video.video_title:
👆 What others see
👇 What we see https://t.co/LVgVd5FDhz

works.title: Where We Meet
works.description: In an audio-based dance installation about mental health, visitors wander among solo dancers wearing headphones; walking close to a dancer triggers that dancer's inner monologue.
works.description_zh: 在一件关于心理健康的音频舞蹈装置中，观众戴着耳机在几位独舞者之间走动；靠近某位舞者时，就会听到那位舞者的内心独白。
works.idea_en: Walk close to someone and you hear what they are thinking.
works.idea_zh: 走近一个人，就能听见他在想什么。
works.technique: An indoor location-tracking system follows each visitor's position and triggers audio monologues on their headphones when they enter a zone around a performer.
works.technique_zh: 室内定位系统追踪每位观众的位置，当他们进入某位表演者周围的区域时，在耳机中触发独白音频。
works.exercise_en: Use Bluetooth beacons or printed markers plus a phone web app to play a different recorded 'thought' when a listener stands near each of three performers. Twist: the thought changes if two listeners stand there together.
works.exercise_zh: 用蓝牙信标或打印标记加手机网页，让听众站在三位表演者附近时分别播放不同的录音“心声”；变体：两位听众同时站在一起时，心声会改变。

video.video_title: Where We Meet 2024 - Trailer 01

works.title: WorldScribe
works.description: Live, context-aware visual descriptions for blind users: sweep a phone around and it speaks short, prioritized descriptions of what matters for your goal, adding detail when the scene is still and pausing when someone starts to talk.
works.description_zh: 为盲人用户提供实时、懂情境的画面描述：拿着手机环顾四周，它会围绕你的目标播报简短且有优先级的描述，画面静止时说得更细，有人开口说话时自动暂停。
works.idea_en: A narrator for the world that decides what to say, how much, and when to stay quiet.
works.idea_zh: 一个为世界配旁白的 AI：自己决定说什么、说多少、什么时候闭嘴。
works.technique: A cascade of fast object detectors and slower vision-language models produces descriptions at several levels of detail, ranked by semantic similarity to the user's stated intent, while sound recognition adjusts the volume and pauses speech.
works.technique_zh: 把快速的物体检测和较慢的视觉语言模型串联起来，生成不同详略层级的描述，并按与用户意图的语义相似度排序；声音识别则用来调节音量和暂停播报。
works.exercise_en: Build a web page that grabs a camera frame every few seconds, sends it with the prompt 'I am looking for my keys; describe only what helps, in under ten words' to a multimodal LLM, and reads the answer aloud with text-to-speech. Twist: change the intent (cooking, crossing a street, finding a friend) and compare how the narration changes.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个网页：每隔几秒截取一帧摄像头画面，连同提示“我在找钥匙，只描述有帮助的内容，不超过十个字”发给多模态大模型，并用语音合成读出回答。变体：更换意图（做饭、过马路、找朋友），比较旁白如何随之变化。

video.video_title: WorldScribe: Towards Context-Aware Live Visual Descriptions (UIST'24)

works.title: XR-Objects: Augmented Object Intelligence
works.description: Every real object in view gets its own small AR context menu: tap a pot of honey to ask for recipes, compare two bottles, or set a timer on a kettle, powered by object detection and a multimodal LLM.
works.description_zh: 视野中的每件真实物品都有自己的小型 AR 情境菜单：点一罐蜂蜜可以查菜谱，对比两瓶饮料，或者给水壶设置计时器，由物体检测和多模态大语言模型驱动。
works.idea_en: Treat every physical object as if it were a digital one you can click on.
works.idea_zh: 把每一件实体物品都当作可以点开的数字对象。
works.technique: Real-time object detection anchors semantic menus to each object in 3D, and a multimodal LLM answers queries using a cropped image of the selected object as context.
works.technique_zh: 实时物体检测把语义菜单锚定到三维空间中的每个物体上，多模态大语言模型以所选物体的裁剪图像为上下文回答问题。
works.exercise_en: In phone AR, detect three kitchen objects and attach a 'what can I do with this?' button to each that queries an LLM. Twist: allow a question that involves two objects at once.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中识别三件厨房物品，并给每件物品加一个“我能用它做什么？”按钮，调用大语言模型回答。变体：允许同时涉及两件物品的提问。

video.video_title: Augmented Object Intelligence with XR-Objects

works.title: XRchitects
works.description: A mixed-reality app for planning a home's new electrical layout by placing virtual sockets, switches and cable runs directly on the real walls instead of drawing on them.
works.description_zh: 一款混合现实应用，用来规划住宅的新电路布局：直接在真实墙面上摆放虚拟插座、开关和走线，而不必在墙上画线。
works.idea_en: Sketch renovation plans on the real walls without leaving a mark.
works.idea_zh: 在真实墙面上画装修方案，却不留下任何痕迹。
works.technique: Meta Quest scene understanding detects wall planes so users can anchor and snap electrical components and wire paths to them (likely).
works.technique_zh: 利用 Meta Quest 的场景理解识别墙面，用户可以把电气部件和走线吸附并锚定在墙上（推测）。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR tool that lets a student place three virtual shelves on a real wall and see their measurements. Twist: the tool warns when a shelf would cover a light switch.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 工具，让同学在真实墙上放置三块虚拟搁板并查看尺寸；变体：当搁板会挡住电灯开关时，工具会发出警告。

video.video_title: XRchitects Trailer

works.title: light lines
works.description: Dense parallel lines of warm light are projected across a table and react to the objects placed among them, such as a candle, so the stripes seem to flow around real things.
works.description_zh: 密集的暖色平行光线投射在桌面上，并对放在其间的物体（例如一支蜡烛）作出反应，让光条看起来绕着真实物体流动。
works.idea_en: Real objects bend the light around them.
works.idea_zh: 真实的物体让光绕着它弯曲。
works.technique: Object positions are detected from above and used to displace a field of projected line segments in real time (likely).
works.technique_zh: 从上方检测物体位置，实时用它们去扰动一片投影线段场（推测）。
works.exercise_en: Project a field of parallel lines onto a table and use webcam blob detection to push the lines away from any object placed on it. Twist: the lines slowly remember where objects used to be.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌面上投出一片平行线，用摄像头色块检测把线条从放上去的物体周围推开；变体：线条会慢慢“记住”物体曾经的位置。

works.title: walking in circles
works.description: A room-scale installation in which white bars and squares projected on the floor and walls shift around a person walking in circles, set to an ambient soundtrack.
works.description_zh: 一件房间尺度的装置：投在地面和墙上的白色光条与方块，围绕一个绕圈行走的人不断移动，并伴随氛围音乐。
works.idea_en: Your walking path rearranges the architecture of light around you.
works.idea_zh: 你的行走路径会重新编排身边的光之建筑。
works.technique: A person tracked in the room (likely by depth or overhead camera) drives the layout of projected geometry mapped across floor and walls.
works.technique_zh: 房间里的人被追踪（推测使用深度或顶部摄像头），其位置驱动映射在地面和墙面上的投影几何布局。
works.exercise_en: Map a projector to a floor and wall corner and make projected bars rotate to face a tracked walker. Twist: walking clockwise and counter-clockwise produce different sounds.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影仪映射到地面和墙角，让投影光条随着被追踪的行人转向；变体：顺时针和逆时针行走会发出不同的声音。
