works.title: 8 Mars 8 Femmes
works.description: For International Women's Day 2023, AR Lenses bring eight women from French history, including Simone Veil, Simone de Beauvoir, Joséphine Baker and Olympe de Gouges, to life as illustrated figures with their stories, likely placed at locations around Paris.
works.description_zh: 为 2023 年国际妇女节制作的 AR 镜头，把 Simone Veil、Simone de Beauvoir、Joséphine Baker、Olympe de Gouges 等八位法国历史女性以插画形象呈现并讲述她们的故事，很可能分布在巴黎各处的相关地点。
works.idea_en: Put forgotten women back into the city as life-size AR portraits.
works.idea_zh: 让被忽略的女性以真人大小的 AR 肖像重回城市。
works.technique: Snapchat Lenses likely combine location-based placement around Paris with illustrated 2D/3D characters and short narrated stories.
works.technique_zh: Snapchat 镜头很可能结合巴黎各地的定位摆放、插画风格的 2D/3D 人物和简短的讲述。
works.exercise_en: Choose five people connected to your school or neighbourhood and place an AR portrait of each at a meaningful spot with 8th Wall or Lens Studio. Twist: each portrait only speaks when the visitor stands where that person once stood.
works.exercise_zh: 选五位与学校或街区有关的人物，用 8th Wall 或 Lens Studio 在有意义的地点放置他们的 AR 肖像。变体：只有当观众站在那个人曾经站过的位置时，肖像才开口说话。

video.video_title: 8 Mars 8 Femmes - IWD x Snapchat

works.title: 8th Wall Sizzle Reel 2023
works.description: A showcase of WebAR projects built by agencies and creators on 8th Wall: face effects, portals, world tracking and image targets that open from a link in the phone browser.
works.idea_zh: 一段合集，展示无需App、点链接就能打开的各种网页AR作品。

video.video_title: 8th Wall Sizzle Reel 2023

works.technique: Browser-based SLAM, face tracking and image targets run in a mobile web page, so each experience opens from a link or QR code without an app install.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个 WebAR 模板（人脸、图像或世界追踪），在 2 小时内做一个能用二维码打开的小作品并现场分享；变体：作品必须与班级所在城市有关。
works.description_zh: 一段展示各机构和创作者在 8th Wall 上打造的 WebAR 项目的合集：人脸特效、传送门、世界追踪和图像目标，都能在手机浏览器中通过链接直接打开。
works.idea_en: A reel of web AR pieces that open from a link, with no app required.
works.technique_zh: 基于浏览器的 SLAM、人脸追踪和图像目标在移动网页中运行，因此每个体验都可以通过链接或二维码打开，无需安装应用。
works.exercise_en: Choose a WebAR template (face, image or world tracking), build a small piece in two hours that opens from a QR code, and share it on the spot. Twist: the piece must relate to the city where the class takes place.

works.title: 8th Wall hand tracking UX
works.description: Gesture patterns, guidelines and demos for hand-tracked interaction in browser-based AR.
works.idea_zh: 在网页 AR 里用手直接抓取、捏合虚拟物体的交互规范。

video.video_title: Introducing Hand Tracking on 8th Wall

works.technique: Browser hand tracking estimates 3D hand keypoints, and gestures such as pinch or open palm are classified from fingertip distances and mapped to AR actions.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands 识别捏合和张开两种手势，分别用来抓取和释放一个 AR 物体；变体：自创一个新手势并写一条使用说明给同学测试。
works.description_zh: 面向浏览器 AR 中手部追踪交互的手势模式、设计指南和演示。
works.idea_en: Interaction guidelines for grabbing and pinching virtual objects with your hands in web AR.
works.technique_zh: 浏览器端的手部追踪估算手部 3D 关键点，再根据指尖间距对捏合、张开手掌等手势进行分类，并映射为 AR 中的操作。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Hands to recognize two gestures, pinch and open hand, and use them to grab and release an AR object. Twist: invent a new gesture and write a one-line instruction for classmates to test.

works.title: 8th Wall moon portal
works.description: Showcase WebAR portal to the moon, built to demonstrate the R17 engine's portal rendering.
works.idea_zh: 在街上打开一个通往月球的门。
works.technique: A portal frame uses stencil masking so a lunar skybox and terrain render only through the opening, and an inside/outside test switches the full environment on when the camera crosses the plane.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Stencil 做一个通往月球的传送门，门内用低重力物理让物体缓慢飘落；变体：穿过门后连手机麦克风收到的声音也变得闷沉。
works.description_zh: 一个通往月球的 WebAR 传送门展示作品，用于演示 R17 引擎的传送门渲染能力。
works.idea_en: Open a door to the moon right on the street.
works.technique_zh: 传送门框使用模板遮罩，使月球天空盒和地形只在门洞中渲染；当相机穿过门所在的平面时，内外判断会切换为完整的环境。
works.exercise_en: Build a portal to the moon with a stencil, and use low-gravity physics inside so objects drift down slowly. Twist: after you step through, even the sound picked up by the phone microphone becomes muffled.

works.title: A Year in a Catalan Forest
works.description: On the edge of La Garriga in Spain, Byles spends a year building large sculptures in the forest from fallen branches and found materials, leaving them for walkers to discover and for nature to reclaim.
works.description_zh: 在西班牙拉加里加的边缘，Byles 花一年时间用倒下的树枝和拾得材料在森林中建造大型雕塑，留给步行者发现，也留给自然回收。
works.idea_en: Works hidden off the path reward exploration, like geo-anchored AR pieces placed away from main routes.
works.idea_zh: 藏在路旁的作品奖励探索，就像放在主路之外的地理锚定 AR 作品。
works.technique: Branches, vines and wood are woven and balanced into large forms using only what is found on site.
works.technique_zh: 只用现场找到的材料，把树枝、藤蔓和木头编织、平衡成大型形体。
works.exercise_en: Hide three AR sculptures made from scanned forest materials at least 20 metres off a trail, with only a vague hint to find them. Twist: each sculpture slowly decays after it has been found.
works.exercise_zh: 把三件由扫描林地材料制作的 AR 雕塑藏在距小径至少 20 米的地方，只给出模糊提示；变体：每件雕塑被发现后都会慢慢腐朽。

video.video_title: A Year in a Catalan Forest. www.spencerbyles.net

works.title: AI + AR Shopping Concept
works.description: A concept that takes the Shop app's ChatGPT-powered search into AR: in a real kitchen, the espresso machine and cups glow as the assistant responds, and a suggested lever espresso maker appears on the counter.
works.description_zh: 把 Shop 应用中接入 ChatGPT 的搜索延伸到 AR 的概念：在真实厨房里，助手回应时咖啡机和杯子会发光，一台推荐的手压意式咖啡机随即出现在台面上。
works.idea_en: Let AI answer shopping questions by lighting up the real world instead of a chat window.
works.idea_zh: 让 AI 通过点亮真实世界来回答购物问题，而不是在聊天框里回答。
works.technique: Likely a concept composite: a conversational AI interprets the request, object recognition picks out related items in the camera view, and glow shaders plus a placed 3D product visualise the answer.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是合成的概念视频：对话式 AI 理解需求，物体识别找出画面中的相关物品，再用发光着色器和放置的 3D 商品把答案呈现出来。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR demo where a typed or spoken question ('what do I need for tea?') highlights two or three recognised objects on a table and places one suggested product. Twist: the AI may only light things up, with no text at all.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 演示：输入或说出一个问题（“泡茶需要什么？”），桌上两三件被识别的物品高亮，并放置一件推荐商品；变体：AI 只能用发光来回答，完全不许出现文字。

video.video_title:
Every week that goes by we get closer to this. This is where we're is going. AI and AR coming together, not to block out the world, but to light it up 🌟

Our latest concept takes the @shop/@openai sea

works.title: AI style transfer on live AR camera
works.description: Live AI style transfer applied to an AR glasses camera, turning the surroundings into a painting in real time.
works.idea_zh: 用AI把眼前世界实时变成画作

video.video_title: AI style transfer on live AR camera

works.technique: Camera frames from AR glasses are passed through a neural style-transfer model (on-device or remote) and the stylised frames are displayed back with low latency.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ml5.js 或 Lens Studio 的风格迁移把手机相机画面实时变成某位画家的风格；变体：只对画面中的人或只对背景做风格化，比较两种效果的意义。
works.description_zh: 把实时 AI 风格迁移应用到 AR 眼镜的摄像头画面上，让周围环境实时变成一幅画。
works.idea_en: AI turns the world in front of you into a painting in real time.
works.technique_zh: AR 眼镜的相机画面经过神经风格迁移模型（在设备端或远程运行）处理，风格化后的画面再以低延迟显示回来。
works.exercise_en: Use style transfer in ml5.js or Lens Studio to render the phone camera feed in a painter's style in real time. Twist: stylize only the people or only the background, and compare what each choice means.

works.title: AIShader: ChatGPT shader generator
works.description: Typing a short text prompt in the Unity editor produces a working shader, and the material on screen instantly changes to match the description.
works.description_zh: 在 Unity 编辑器里输入一句提示词，就会生成可用的着色器，屏幕上的材质立刻变成描述的样子。
works.idea_en: Describe a surface in words and get a shader.
works.idea_zh: 用文字描述一个表面，就得到一个着色器。
works.technique: An editor extension sends the prompt with a fixed template to the ChatGPT API and imports the returned code as a Unity shader asset.
works.technique_zh: 编辑器扩展把提示词套进固定模板发给 ChatGPT API，再把返回的代码导入为 Unity 着色器资源。
works.exercise_en: Generate three shaders from text prompts with an LLM, apply them to scanned real objects and place them back in the room with AR Foundation. Twist: the audience writes the prompts.
works.exercise_zh: 用大模型根据文字提示生成三个着色器，贴到扫描的真实物体上，再用 AR Foundation 放回房间。变体：让观众来写提示词。

video.video_title:
I tried creating a proof-of-concept implementation of a ChatGPT-powered shader generator for Unity.

works.title: AR + AI effect: a generated scene that reacts to your hands
works.description: An AR filter whose imagery was extended with Photoshop's generative AI reacts to the viewer's hands, so the AI-painted scene moves and opens around them.
works.description_zh: 一个 AR 滤镜：画面先用 Photoshop 的生成式 AI 扩展，再做成对手部动作有反应的效果，AI 画出的场景会随手的动作展开和移动。
works.idea_en: Use generative fill to paint the world, then let your hands play inside it.
works.idea_zh: 先用生成式填充画出世界，再让双手在里面玩。
works.technique: The background art was inpainted with Photoshop's generative fill and layered into an interactive AR filter driven by hand tracking (built with collaborator Sergey Galkin, likely in Adobe's AR tools).
works.technique_zh: 背景画面用 Photoshop 的生成式填充补全，再分层做成由手部追踪驱动的交互 AR 滤镜（与合作者 Sergey Galkin 完成，很可能用 Adobe 的 AR 工具）。
works.exercise_en: Extend a photo of your classroom with any generative-fill tool into a fantasy scene, cut it into three depth layers and make them parallax with hand position in a web AR filter. Twist: each hand reveals a different season.
works.exercise_zh: 用任意生成式填充工具把教室照片扩展成奇幻场景，切成三层景深，在网页 AR 滤镜里随手的位置产生视差。变体：两只手各揭开一个不同的季节。

video.video_title:
AR + AI effect

We made an AR filter that interacts with your hands. 
I inpainted the image using Photoshop's new AI feature, and @sergeyglkn turned it into an interactive filter

Made for @adobe usin

works.title: AR CO2 Visualization System
works.description: Carbon dioxide levels in a room are shown as a 3D colour field in an AR headset, combining fixed sensors with a mobile sensor carried around, so stale corners become visible.
works.description_zh: 房间里的二氧化碳浓度在 AR 头显中显示为三维彩色场，把固定传感器和随身携带的移动传感器数据结合起来，让空气不流通的角落一目了然。
works.idea_en: See the air you share: invisible CO2 becomes a coloured cloud in the room.
works.idea_zh: 看见你们共享的空气：无形的二氧化碳变成屋里的一团彩色云。
works.technique: Interpolates readings from fixed and mobile CO2 sensors into a 3D concentration volume registered to the room and renders it as coloured voxels in AR.
works.technique_zh: 把固定和移动 CO2 传感器的读数插值成与房间配准的三维浓度体，并在 AR 中渲染为彩色体素。
works.exercise_en: Carry a phone around the classroom logging noise level or light level at marked spots, then place coloured AR spheres at those spots to reveal the field. Twist: repeat after opening the windows and compare.
works.exercise_zh: 拿着手机在教室里走动，在标记点记录噪声或光照强度，再在这些位置放上彩色 AR 球体，呈现出整个分布；变体：开窗后再测一次并对比。

video.video_title: AR CO2 Visualization System

salient.why_en: The air you share becomes visible: invisible CO2 turns into a colored cloud filling the stale corners of the room.
salient.why_zh: 让共享的空气看得见：无形的二氧化碳变成彩色的云，填满房间里不通风的角落。

works.title: AR Lens for Blind People
works.description: A Snapchat Lens that works as a digital cane: it senses nearby walls and obstacles through the phone's world mesh and speaks the names of detected objects aloud.
works.description_zh: 一个充当“数字手杖”的 Snapchat Lens：借助手机的世界网格感知附近的墙壁和障碍物，并把识别出的物体名称读出来。
works.idea_en: Use AR's understanding of space for someone who cannot see the screen at all.
works.idea_zh: 把 AR 对空间的理解用在完全看不到屏幕的人身上。
works.technique: An invisible physics 'cane' collides with the LiDAR/world mesh to trigger alerts, while object detection results are passed to text-to-speech.
works.technique_zh: 一根看不见的物理“手杖”与 LiDAR/世界网格碰撞以触发提醒，同时把物体识别结果交给文字转语音朗读。
works.exercise_en: Build an audio-only AR prototype that warns a blindfolded classmate before they walk into a wall and names one object in front of them. Twist: replace speech with spatial sound cues only.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个纯音频的 AR 原型：在蒙眼同学撞墙之前发出警告，并说出前方一个物体的名称；变体：只用空间音效提示，不用语音。

video.video_title: How to Make an AR Lens for Blind People | Lens Studio Tutorial

works.title: AR Lightning
works.description: Raise your hand and lightning shoots from it into the room, zapping whatever real surface you are looking at, from a fireplace to a wall.
works.description_zh: 抬起手，闪电就从掌心射进房间，劈向你正看着的任何真实表面，从壁炉到墙壁。
works.idea_en: Your hand becomes a lightning rod that strikes the real room.
works.idea_zh: 你的手变成闪电之源，劈向真实的房间。
works.technique: A Snap Lens combines hand tracking, the gaze or camera direction and a LiDAR-generated world mesh, raycasting to find the hit point where the particle lightning bolt ends.
works.technique_zh: Snap 镜头结合手部追踪、视线（相机朝向）和 LiDAR 生成的环境网格，通过射线检测找到命中点，粒子闪电就在那里落下。
works.exercise_en: Prototype a 'magic beam' in Lens Studio or AR Foundation: raycast from the camera to the scene mesh and draw a jagged line from the hand to the hit point. Twist: scorch marks stay where the beam hits.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation 做一个“魔法光束”原型：从相机向场景网格发射射线，从手到命中点画一条锯齿线。变体：光束击中的地方留下焦痕。

video.video_title:
We made an AR lightning system that uses raycasting to zap your surroundings ⚡️ 

This real-time experience built on @SnapAR detects the direction you are looking in, uses hand tracking, and the world

works.title: AR liquid physics puzzle game prototype
works.description: In passthrough AR on a desk, the player builds ramps and blocks with bare hands to guide a stream of simulated liquid into a bucket.
works.description_zh: 在书桌上的透视 AR 中，玩家徒手搭建斜坡和方块，把一股模拟液体引导进桶里。
works.idea_en: A classic marble-run puzzle becomes tactile when the liquid shares your real desk and hands.
works.idea_zh: 当液体与你真实的桌面和双手共处一处时，经典的导流谜题就变得可触摸。
works.technique: A GPU fluid solver (ZibraAI) runs in Unity with Ultraleap hand colliders, rendered over Varjo XR-3 passthrough so the liquid appears on the real table.
works.technique_zh: 在 Unity 中运行 GPU 流体求解器（ZibraAI），用 Ultraleap 手部碰撞体交互，并叠加到 Varjo XR-3 的透视画面上，让液体看起来就在真实桌面上。
works.exercise_en: Build a Quest passthrough or phone AR scene where particles fall from a spout and must reach a cup; let players place three planes to redirect them. Twist: the planes can only be placed on real surfaces detected by plane tracking.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Quest 透视或手机 AR 做一个场景：粒子从出水口落下，必须流进杯子，玩家可以放置三块板来改变方向；变体：板子只能贴在平面检测到的真实表面上。

video.video_title: AR liquid physics puzzle game prototype

works.title: ARephotography
works.description: Standing in front of a campus building, a phone shows how it looked in a historical photograph, with the old facade rebuilt as a textured 3D model sitting exactly over today's walls.
works.description_zh: 站在校园建筑前，手机就会显示它在历史照片中的样子：旧立面被重建成带纹理的三维模型，精确地覆盖在今天的墙面上。
works.idea_en: Turn an old photograph into a 3D time window placed on the same spot today.
works.idea_zh: 把一张老照片变成放在原地的三维时光之窗。
works.technique: Uses a machine-learning pipeline to turn a single historical photo into a textured 3D model and registers it over the current building in mobile AR.
works.technique_zh: 用机器学习流程把一张历史照片转成带纹理的三维模型，并在手机 AR 中把它配准到现有建筑上。
works.exercise_en: Find an old photo of your school, stand where it was taken, and overlay it semi-transparently on the live phone camera to align past and present. Twist: add a slider that wipes between the eras.
works.exercise_zh: 找一张学校的老照片，站到当年的拍摄位置，把它半透明地叠加到手机实时画面上，对齐过去和现在；变体：加一个滑块，在两个年代之间来回擦除切换。

video.video_title: ARephotography: Revisiting Historical Photographs using Augmented Reality

works.title: Agents (Liquid City)
works.description: A short film where AI agents appear as characters in AR glasses and negotiate a person's day, asking what kind of relationship we want with AI in mixed reality.
works.idea_zh: 把AI助手具象为住在AR眼镜里的角色，思考人与智能体的关系

video.video_title: Agents

works.technique: Design-fiction film where AI agents are rendered as characters composited into glasses POV; a prototype would pair an LLM dialogue loop with world-anchored animated avatars.
works.exercise_zh: 为自己的一天设计两三个“AI 代理角色”，用手机 AR 把它们放在房间里，由 LLM 生成对话并互相争夺你的注意力；变体：让其中一个角色代表你拒绝其他角色的请求。
works.description_zh: 一部短片：AI 代理以角色的形式出现在 AR 眼镜中，替一个人协商安排他的一天，追问在混合现实中我们想和 AI 建立怎样的关系。
works.idea_en: Give AI assistants a body as characters living in AR glasses, and think about how people relate to agents.
works.technique_zh: 一部设计虚构短片，AI 代理以角色形式被渲染并合成到眼镜的第一人称画面中；若要做成原型，可以把大语言模型对话循环与锚定在世界中的动画化身结合起来。
works.exercise_en: Design two or three 'AI agent characters' for your day, place them in your room with phone AR, and have an LLM generate dialogue in which they compete for your attention. Twist: let one character turn down the other characters' requests on your behalf.

works.title: Amazonia – The Interactive Forest
works.description: An immersive wall projection lets children explore the Amazon rainforest and discover stories of its Indigenous cultures by moving their own bodies.
works.description_zh: 一面沉浸式墙面投影让孩子们用自己的身体动作探索亚马孙雨林，并发现当地原住民文化的故事。
works.idea_en: Walk into a rainforest wall and let your movement uncover its stories.
works.idea_zh: 走进一面雨林墙，用你的动作揭开它的故事。
works.technique: Body tracking in front of the wall (likely depth cameras) lets children push foliage aside and trigger animated story scenes in a real-time projected environment.
works.technique_zh: 墙前的身体追踪（推测为深度摄像头）让孩子能拨开树叶，并在实时投影的环境中触发动画故事场景。
works.exercise_en: Project a dense leaf layer over a hidden picture and use webcam body segmentation to clear leaves wherever a child moves. Twist: the leaves grow back unless several children hold them open together.
works.exercise_zh: 在一幅隐藏的图片上投影一层茂密的树叶，用摄像头人体分割让孩子动到哪里，哪里的树叶就被拨开；变体：除非几个孩子一起撑住，否则树叶会重新长回来。

video.video_title: Amazonia - The interactive Forest

works.title: Any Object as a Push Button
works.description: A work-in-progress setup for Spectacles that turns any physical object into a push button: pressing the real object with your finger triggers a virtual response, giving AR interaction a physical feel.
works.description_zh: 为 Spectacles 做的一个进行中的原型：把任何实体物件变成按钮，用手指按下真实物体就会触发虚拟反馈，让 AR 交互有了实在的手感。
works.idea_en: Any real object can become a button you press with your finger.
works.idea_zh: 任何真实物体都可以变成用手指按下的按钮。
works.technique: Likely a virtual button collider is placed on the chosen object, and Spectacles fingertip tracking detects when the finger moves into it, triggering animation and sound.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是在选中的物体上放一个虚拟按钮碰撞体，由 Spectacles 的指尖追踪检测手指是否按入，再触发动画和声音。
works.exercise_en: Place an invisible button collider on a real mug using WebXR hand tracking or a Quest, and play a sound when the fingertip touches it. Twist: each object in the room plays a different note, making an instrument out of the desk.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 手部追踪或 Quest，在一个真实杯子上放一个隐形按钮碰撞体，指尖碰到时播放声音；变体：房间里每个物体发出不同的音，把书桌变成一件乐器。

video.video_title:
working on a setup that turns any object into a push button!

for more physical AR interaction, built for the @Spectacles (@SnapAR) https://t.co/hKpP6APSYm

works.title: Around 7 Meters is more fun
works.description: A participant steers a joystick at one end of a 7-metre structure while the image they draw appears on a screen at the far end that only observers can see; the drawer must rely on the observers' shouts and gestures, and the result cannot be photographed.
works.description_zh: 参与者在 7 米长装置的一端操纵摇杆作画，画面却显示在另一端只有观察者看得到的屏幕上；作画者只能依靠观察者的喊话和手势，而且画面无法被拍照记录。
works.idea_en: Split drawing and seeing across 7 metres so two strangers have to talk to make one image.
works.idea_zh: 把“画”和“看”拆开在 7 米两端，逼两个陌生人必须交流才能完成一幅画。
works.technique: Custom software draws the joystick trajectory in real time, while a camera with machine learning detects phones pointed at the screen and blocks recording.
works.technique_zh: 定制软件实时绘制摇杆轨迹，同时摄像头结合机器学习识别对准屏幕的手机并阻止拍摄。
works.exercise_en: Pair students: one draws on a phone web canvas facing away from a projector, the other describes what appears on the wall 7 metres away. Twist: the describer may only use sounds, not words.
works.exercise_zh: 两人一组：一人背对投影在手机网页画布上作画，另一人描述 7 米外墙上出现的画面；变体：描述者只能发出声音，不能说词语。

video.video_title: 鄭先喻個展[.user            ]｜2023 9/16 - 10/14｜誠品畫廊

works.title: Augmented Math
works.description: Point a tablet at a static math textbook and formulas and figures become explorable: sliders, animated graphs and linked highlights appear on the page.
works.idea_zh: 对准纸质数学课本，公式和图像立刻变成可拖动、可探索的动态解释。

video.video_title: [UIST 2023] Augmented Math: Authoring AR-Based Explorable Explanations by Augmenting Static Math ...

works.technique: The page is captured and processed with OCR and math-formula recognition to extract equations and figures, which are then turned into parametric interactive visualizations registered to the page through image tracking.
works.exercise_zh: 拍一页课本上的函数公式（如 y = a·sin(bx)），用 OCR 或手动录入解析参数，在 8th Wall 或 AR Foundation 图像追踪中把可拖动滑块和动态曲线叠加在该页上；变体：选一页你当年最看不懂的课本内容来改造。
works.description_zh: 把平板电脑对准一本静态的数学课本，公式和图形就变得可以探索：页面上出现滑块、动态图像和相互关联的高亮。
works.idea_en: Point at a printed math textbook and its formulas and graphs turn into live explanations you can drag and explore.
works.technique_zh: 拍下页面后，通过 OCR 和数学公式识别提取方程和图形，再将其转换为参数化的交互式可视化，借助图像追踪与页面对齐。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a function formula from a textbook page (such as y = a·sin(bx)), extract its parameters with OCR or by typing them in, and overlay draggable sliders and an animated curve on the page with 8th Wall or AR Foundation image tracking. Twist: pick the textbook page you found hardest to understand back then and rework it.

works.title: Augmented Reality 2023 (compilation)
works.description: A reel of his favourite real-time WebAR experiences built during 2023.
works.idea_zh: 一年的 WebAR 实验合集：适合当作“AR 能做什么”的速览。

video.video_title:
Augmented Reality 2023

A compilation of my favorite real-time AR experiences from this year. 

Thankful for all the amazing people I met along the way 🙏 the future is here. https://t.co/fVrXridgoe

works.technique: A reel of browser AR pieces built on the same core toolkit (SLAM world tracking, hit-test placement, image and face targets), showing how far a small set of techniques can stretch.
works.exercise_zh: 回顾本学期做过的 AR 草图，剪成一段 60 秒合集，并为每个片段标注它用到的核心技术；变体：只挑失败的原型剪一版“失败合集”。
works.description_zh: 他在 2023 年制作的最喜欢的实时 WebAR 体验合集。
works.idea_en: A year of WebAR experiments, handy as a quick tour of what AR can do.
works.technique_zh: 一组基于同一套核心工具（SLAM 世界追踪、命中测试放置、图像目标和人脸目标）制作的浏览器 AR 作品，展示了少数几种技术能延展出多大的空间。
works.exercise_en: Look back at the AR sketches you made this semester, cut them into a 60-second reel, and label each clip with the core technique it uses. Twist: make a 'failure reel' using only the prototypes that didn't work.

works.title: Augmented Reality 3D Gaussian Splatting in Real Time
works.description: A custom iOS Metal renderer places animated volumetric Gaussian-splat captures of people into the real world in AR.
works.idea_zh: 把高斯泼溅捕捉的动态真人实时放进 AR 空间。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality 3D Gaussian Splatting in real time on iPad!

works.technique: Captured Gaussian-splat sequences are sorted and rasterized in a custom Metal renderer each frame and placed at an ARKit anchor, so volumetric people appear in the real room.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Luma 或 Polycam 拍一个人的高斯泼溅，用 three.js + WebXR（或 Unity 插件）放到地面上；变体：拍同一人不同姿势的多个泼溅，按顺序切换做成定格动画。
works.description_zh: 一个自研的 iOS Metal 渲染器，把动态的体积高斯泼溅人物捕捉放进真实世界的 AR 中。
works.idea_en: Put moving people captured as Gaussian splats into AR space in real time.
works.technique_zh: 在自研的 Metal 渲染器中逐帧对捕捉到的高斯泼溅序列进行排序和光栅化，并放置在 ARKit 锚点上，让体积化的人物出现在真实房间中。
works.exercise_en: Capture a Gaussian splat of a person with Luma or Polycam and place it on the floor with three.js and WebXR (or a Unity plugin). Twist: capture several splats of the same person in different poses and switch between them in order as a stop-motion animation.

works.title: Becoming Performance in VR
works.description: The second research cycle of his Dance in VR fellowship at the Akademie für Theater und Digitalität: a studio showing where a dancer performs while spectators follow the dance through VR headsets, testing whether they can still feel the presence of the digital body.
works.description_zh: 他在 Akademie für Theater und Digitalität 研究项目 Dance in VR 的第二轮成果：舞者在工作室里表演，观众戴着 VR 头显观看，检验他们是否仍能感受到数字身体的存在。
works.idea_en: Ask what a headset audience needs in order to feel a dancer who is only there as data.
works.idea_zh: 追问：戴头显的观众需要什么，才能感受到一个只以数据形式存在的舞者。
works.technique: The dancer's movement is likely captured and streamed into a shared real-time VR scene viewed on standalone headsets, with the same scene projected for the rest of the room.
works.technique_zh: 舞者的动作很可能被捕捉并实时传进共享的 VR 场景，观众用一体机头显观看，同时把同一场景投影给房间里的其他人。
works.exercise_en: Stream a phone-tracked performer's position into a shared WebXR scene as a simple glowing figure and let classmates watch it in headsets while the real performer moves in the same room. Twist: hide the performer behind a curtain and compare how present the avatar feels.
works.exercise_zh: 把用手机追踪的表演者位置实时传进共享的 WebXR 场景，表现为一个简单的发光人形，让同学戴头显观看，而真实的表演者就在同一房间里移动；变体：把表演者藏到幕布后，比较虚拟形象的在场感有何变化。

video.video_title: 231207 Becoming Performance in VR - Dance in VR 2nd cycle research.

works.title: BodyPix body part tracking
works.description: A webcam image of a person is split into colored body parts in real time, with keypoints tracking arms, legs and face.
works.description_zh: 摄像头中的人被实时分割成不同颜色的身体部位，并用关键点追踪手臂、腿和脸。
works.idea_en: Know which part of the body is where, and give each part its own effect.
works.idea_zh: 知道身体每个部位在哪里，就能给每个部位不同的特效。
works.technique: The BodyPix model runs on Barracuda/Sentis and outputs a 24-part segmentation map plus keypoints; shaders color each part and a sample uses keypoints as game input.
works.technique_zh: BodyPix 模型在 Barracuda/Sentis 上运行，输出 24 个部位的分割图和关键点，着色器给每个部位上色，另一个示例把关键点当作游戏输入。
works.exercise_en: Use body segmentation in AR Foundation to make only your arms emit particles while the rest of the body stays normal. Twist: pixelate the face automatically for privacy.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中用人体分割，只让手臂发射粒子，身体其他部分保持正常。变体：自动把脸打上马赛克保护隐私。

video.video_title: I made a body part tracking sample with BodyPix and Unity Barracuda. https://t.co/VallvqR493 https://t.co/fLtJowJxFo

works.title: BrightMarker
works.description: Markers made of infrared-fluorescent filament are printed into coloured objects; a small imaging module on a phone or headset sees only the glowing markers, turning objects into tracked props, such as a speaker whose knobs set the AR volume or a paddle used as a VR haptic prop.
works.description_zh: 用红外荧光耗材把标记打印进彩色物体里；手机或头显上的小型成像模块只看得到发光的标记，让物体变成可追踪的道具，比如用旋钮调节 AR 音量的音箱，或当作 VR 触觉道具的球拍。
works.idea_en: Objects carry glowing markers that only a special camera can see, turning them into trackable props.
works.idea_zh: 物体里藏着只有特殊相机才看得见的发光标记，让它们变成可追踪的道具。
works.technique: An infrared-fluorescent filament shifts incoming light to a longer wavelength, and an optical filter on the camera passes only that emission, so the marker stays high-contrast whatever the object's surface colour.
works.technique_zh: 红外荧光耗材把入射光转换成更长的波长，相机前的滤光片只让这种发射光通过，因此无论物体表面是什么颜色，标记都保持高对比度。
works.exercise_en: Stick UV-reactive or retroreflective tape patterns on household objects and track them with a phone camera and flashlight to drive AR sliders and buttons. Twist: the same object controls different things depending on which face is up.
works.exercise_zh: 在家用物品上贴出紫外荧光或逆反射胶带图案，用手机相机加手电筒追踪它们，驱动 AR 滑块和按钮。变体：同一个物体哪一面朝上，就控制不同的东西。

video.video_title: 🔴 Unlocking the Secret of BrightMarker: 3D Printed Fluorescent Markers for Object Tracking

works.title: Bubbleu
works.description: An AR pet-breeding game in which you feed your creature by pointing the camera at real objects; because object detection often fails, the game is designed around that uncertainty through ambiguity, transparency and player control.
works.description_zh: 一款 AR 宠物养成游戏：把相机对准真实物品来喂养你的小怪兽；由于物体检测常常出错，游戏通过“模糊性、透明度、可控性”三种设计手法来驾驭这种不确定性。
works.idea_en: Treat the AI's mistakes as game material instead of hiding them.
works.idea_zh: 把 AI 的错误当作游戏素材，而不是把它藏起来。
works.technique: An object-detection model recognizes real items as food; game variants expose or hide the model's confidence, blur what counts as a match, or let players correct results, and were compared in a user study.
works.technique_zh: 用物体检测模型把真实物品识别为食物；游戏的不同版本分别展示或隐藏模型置信度、模糊匹配标准、或让玩家修正结果，并在用户研究中进行比较。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone game where a creature eats whatever the camera detects (COCO-SSD in the browser is enough), then make three versions: hide confidence, show confidence as the pet's mood, and let players argue with the pet when it is wrong. Twist: let the pet's personality grow out of its most frequent misrecognitions.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机游戏：小怪兽会吃掉摄像头检测到的任何东西（浏览器里的 COCO-SSD 就够用），再做三个版本——隐藏置信度、把置信度表现为宠物的心情、在识别出错时让玩家和宠物争论。变体：让宠物的性格从它最常见的误识别中长出来。

video.video_title: Bubbleu: Exploring Augmented Reality Game Design with Uncertain AI-based Interaction

works.title: CON/TOUCH #2
works.description: Two people wear wireless sensors on their shoulders; touching and pressing each other's shoulders generates and modulates sound, making a musical instrument out of social touch.
works.description_zh: 两个人在肩上佩戴无线传感器；触碰和按压对方的肩膀就会产生并调制声音，把社交触碰变成乐器。
works.idea_en: An instrument that can only be played by touching another person.
works.idea_zh: 一件只能通过触碰另一个人来演奏的乐器。
works.technique: Wireless wearable sensors measure haptic gestures on the shoulders and send them to a software synthesiser that maps them to frequency and timbre.
works.technique_zh: 无线可穿戴传感器测量肩部的触碰手势，发送给软件合成器映射为频率和音色。
works.exercise_en: Sew conductive fabric pads onto two shoulder straps and connect them to a Makey Makey or micro:bit so touch triggers notes. Twist: sound only plays while both people are touching at once.
works.exercise_zh: 在两条肩带上缝导电布片，接到 Makey Makey 或 micro:bit，触碰即触发音符；变体：只有两人同时触碰时才发声。

video.video_title: CON/TOUCH #2

salient.why_en: An instrument that only makes sound when two people touch each other's shoulders.
salient.why_zh: 一件乐器，只有两个人互相触碰肩膀时才会发出声音。

works.title: ChameleonControl
works.description: A remote operator guides a real human 'surrogate' through mixed reality gestures, turning a person into a teleoperated body for remote tasks.
works.idea_zh: 用MR手势远程'操控'一个真人替身，替你在现场完成动作。

video.video_title: [CHI 2023] ChameleonControl: Teleoperating Real Human Surrogates through MR Gestural Guidance

works.technique: The remote operator's hand gestures are captured and rendered in the surrogate's HoloLens as overlaid ghost hands, which the surrogate aligns their own hands with to replicate the motion.
works.exercise_zh: 让一位同学戴 HoloKit 或看手机 AR，远端同学的 MediaPipe 手部关键点实时传过来显示为“幽灵手”，本地同学模仿幽灵手完成一个折纸或搭积木任务；变体：幽灵手只给出一半提示，看看协作如何变化。
works.description_zh: 远程操作者通过混合现实手势引导一个真人“替身”，把一个人变成可被远程操控的身体，去完成远程任务。
works.idea_en: Use MR gestures to remotely 'steer' a human stand-in who carries out actions on site for you.
works.technique_zh: 捕捉远程操作者的手势，并在替身的 HoloLens 中渲染为叠加的“幽灵手”，替身把自己的手与幽灵手对齐，从而复现动作。
works.exercise_en: Have one classmate wear HoloKit or watch phone AR while a remote classmate's MediaPipe hand keypoints stream in live as 'ghost hands', and have the local classmate copy the ghost hands to finish an origami or block-building task. Twist: the ghost hands give only half the cues, and see how the collaboration changes.

works.title: Circle intersections: interactive pendulum projection
works.description: A pendulum swings over a projected frame on a dark carpet; circles drawn around the pendulum and fixed points intersect and shift as it swings, producing a constantly changing geometric figure.
works.description_zh: 摆锤在深色地毯上投影出的矩形框上方摆动；围绕摆锤和几个固定点画出的圆相互交叠，并随摆动不断移动，形成持续变化的几何图形。
works.idea_en: Physics as a drawing tool: gravity animates the geometry.
works.idea_zh: 把物理当作绘图工具：由重力来驱动几何图形。
works.technique: The pendulum bob is tracked from above and circle intersections between it and fixed centres are computed each frame and projected onto the floor.
works.technique_zh: 从上方追踪摆锤，每帧计算它与若干固定圆心之间的圆交点，并投影到地面上。
works.exercise_en: Track a hanging pendulum with a webcam and project circles around it and two fixed points, highlighting their intersections. Twist: leave a fading trail of past intersections to draw a pattern over time.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头追踪一个悬挂的摆锤，围绕它和两个固定点投出圆，并高亮显示交点；变体：保留逐渐淡去的历史交点轨迹，随时间画出一幅图案。

works.title: City-Scale AR Bowling
works.description: Giant bowling pins stand on famous buildings such as the Sacré-Cœur in Paris, and a phone player rolls a huge ball down the street to knock them over.
works.description_zh: 巨大的保龄球瓶立在巴黎圣心堂等著名建筑上，玩家用手机把一颗巨大的保龄球沿街滚过去，把球瓶撞倒。
works.idea_en: Turn a whole city block into a bowling lane.
works.idea_zh: 把整条街区变成保龄球道。
works.technique: Google's Geospatial API localises the phone with GPS plus Street View-based visual positioning, and ARCore in Unity simulates physics for pins anchored to the real buildings.
works.technique_zh: Google Geospatial API 结合 GPS 与基于街景的视觉定位确定手机位置，Unity 中的 ARCore 为固定在真实建筑上的球瓶做物理模拟。
works.exercise_en: Use Geospatial anchors (ARCore or 8th Wall) to place one giant object on a campus landmark, then add one physics interaction with it. Twist: the object reacts differently at night.
works.exercise_zh: 用地理空间锚点（ARCore 或 8th Wall）把一个巨大物体放在校园地标上，再为它加一个物理交互。变体：到了晚上它的反应会不同。

video.video_title:
Using the @GoogleARVR Geospatial API, we built the first city scale Augmented Reality bowling experience 🎳

All of these clips are real-time videos took in-app, where the experience combines Physics a

works.title: Climate Change Migration Stories AR
works.description: Life-size volumetric AR portraits of people displaced by climate change appear in public space and tell their own stories.
works.idea_zh: 气候移民以真人大小的AR形象现身讲述自己的故事

video.video_title: Climate Change Migration Stories AR

works.technique: Volumetric video captures of real people are anchored life-size in public space, with ground-plane detection placing them at the viewer's scale.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机录一段同学讲自己迁移或搬家故事的视频，抠像后做成真人大小的 AR 视频广告牌放在对应地点；变体：只在观众走近到 2 米内时才开始讲述。
works.description_zh: 因气候变化而流离失所的人们，以真人大小的体积 AR 肖像出现在公共空间中，讲述他们自己的故事。
works.idea_en: Climate migrants appear as life-size AR figures and tell their own stories.
works.technique_zh: 真实人物的体积视频被以真人尺寸锚定在公共空间中，借助地平面检测把他们放置在与观众相符的尺度上。
works.exercise_en: Record a classmate on a phone telling a story about migrating or moving house, key out the background, and turn it into a life-size AR video billboard at the matching location. Twist: the story starts only when a viewer comes within 2 meters.

works.title: Clo(o)k: Human-Time Interactions Through a Clock That "Looks"
works.description: A hand-built wall clock with a camera at its centre: it keeps normal time while you look at it but speeds up when you look away, pauses when it sees people talking, and when two people in London and Hangzhou look at their Clo(o)ks at the same moment, each shows the other's time. Swappable rings turn it into a planetary model, a face or kinetic art (CHI 2025 Best Video Showcase).
works.description_zh: 一只亲手做的挂钟，中央藏着一个摄像头：你看着它时它正常走，你一移开视线它就加速；看到有人在聊天时它会暂停；当伦敦和杭州的两个人同时看向各自的 Clo(o)k，表盘会显示对方那里的时间。可更换的表圈还能把它变成行星模型、一张脸或动态艺术（CHI 2025 最佳视频展示奖）。
works.idea_en: An everyday object that notices your attention can bend the time it shows: time rushes when ignored and stops for a conversation.
works.idea_zh: 一件能察觉你注意力的日常物品，可以扭曲它所显示的时间：没人看时时间飞逝，有人交谈时时间停下。
works.technique: An ESP32-CAM streams video to a laptop running OpenCV face detection, and the face count returned over serial drives two stepper motors (one via a custom-milled D11C board) that turn the hand rings.
works.technique_zh: ESP32-CAM 把视频传给运行 OpenCV 人脸检测的笔记本电脑，检测到的人脸数量通过串口发回，驱动两个步进电机（其中一个经由自制铣削的 D11C 电路板控制）转动指针环。
works.exercise_en: Build a web or phone-AR clock anchored on a real wall whose hands run at normal speed only while the front camera detects your face, and fast-forward when you look away. Twist: let two classmates' clocks sync over the network so they only stop when both are looking.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个锚定在真实墙面上的网页或手机 AR 时钟，只有前置摄像头检测到你的脸时指针才正常走，移开视线就快进。变体：让两位同学的时钟联网同步，只有两人同时看着时才停止快进。

video.video_title: [CHI '25 Video Showcase] Clo(o)k: Human-Time Interactions Through a Clock That “Looks”

salient.why_en: A clock that watches you: time speeds up when you look away and stops while people talk.
salient.why_zh: 一只会看人的钟：你不看它时时间变快，有人聊天时时间停下。

works.title: Clueless Closet
works.description: A real version of Cher's computerised closet from Clueless: photos of two fashionable friends and their clothes were used to teach an AI to render them wearing new outfit combinations in chosen poses and scenes.
works.description_zh: 把电影《独领风骚》（Clueless）里 Cher 的电脑衣橱做成真的：用两位时髦朋友和他们衣服的照片训练 AI，生成他们以指定姿势、在指定场景里穿上新搭配的样子。
works.idea_en: Movie-magic try-on: see yourself in any outfit combination instantly.
works.idea_zh: 电影般的试衣：瞬间看到自己穿上任意搭配。
works.technique: A LoRA is trained on Stable Diffusion 1.5 for each person, face and garment, then ControlNet pose detection and Segment Anything masks guide the generation, with a lot of manual prompting and editing.
works.technique_zh: 在 Stable Diffusion 1.5 上为每个人、每张脸、每件衣服分别训练 LoRA，再用 ControlNet 姿态检测和 Segment Anything 蒙版引导生成，过程中需要大量人工调整提示词和修图。
works.exercise_en: Build a webcam 'magic mirror' that segments the student's body and overlays a chosen garment image that follows their pose. Twist: let a classmate pick the outfit remotely from a phone.
works.exercise_zh: 做一面摄像头“魔镜”：分割出学生的身体，把选中的服装图片按姿态叠加上去；变体：让另一位同学用手机远程替他挑衣服。

video.video_title:
Remember Cher's high-tech closet from #Clueless? We took this gem of '90s movie magic and made it real with AI and our fashionable friends, @jessiechar and @nhyphenc!  

We taught AI to recreate our f

works.title: Coach Tabby AR Storefront and AR Mirror
works.description: For Coach's Tabby bag campaign, the SoHo store window at 143 Prince Street in New York became an AR Storefront: passers-by on the sidewalk see themselves on a pink screen in the window holding and wearing digital Tabby looks.
works.description_zh: 为 Coach 的 Tabby 手袋宣传活动，纽约 SoHo 王子街 143 号门店的橱窗变成了 AR 橱窗：人行道上的路人能在橱窗里的粉色屏幕上看到自己拎着、穿着数字版 Tabby 造型。
works.idea_en: The shop window watches the street and dresses whoever stops.
works.idea_zh: 橱窗看着街道，给停下脚步的人换装。
works.technique: A camera behind the glass tracks people on the sidewalk and renders digital bags and outfits on them in real time on a window-facing display; a second AR Mirror inside continues the experience.
works.technique_zh: 玻璃后面的摄像头追踪人行道上的路人，在面向街道的屏幕上实时为他们渲染数字手袋和服装；店内的另一面 AR 魔镜延续这一体验。
works.exercise_en: Point a webcam and a monitor out of a classroom window or doorway and build a 'street mirror' that adds one playful AR accessory to anyone who stops for three seconds. Twist: the accessory grows the longer they stay.
works.exercise_zh: 把摄像头和显示器对着教室窗外或门口，做一面“街头镜子”：任何停留三秒以上的人都会被加上一件有趣的 AR 配饰；变体：停留越久，配饰越大。

video.video_title:
Introducing ZERO10 AR Storefront and AR Mirror 🍧

Last Friday we celebrated the launch of @coach global Tabby Bag campaign and here is the recap of how it went. But don't let us just tell you about it

works.title: Coding Adventure: Simulating Fluids
works.description: Thousands of particles slosh, splash and settle as water in a box, first in 2D then in 3D, reacting to the mouse pushing and pulling them.
works.description_zh: 成千上万的粒子在盒子里像水一样晃动、飞溅、沉积，先是二维再到三维，并响应鼠标的推拉。
works.idea_en: Water is just many particles that try to keep a constant density.
works.idea_zh: 水不过是许多努力保持密度恒定的粒子。
works.technique: Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics runs in compute shaders: density and pressure are computed from neighbours found through a spatial hash, and particles are integrated each frame.
works.technique_zh: 在计算着色器中运行光滑粒子流体动力学（SPH）：通过空间哈希找到邻居，计算密度和压力，再逐帧积分粒子。
works.exercise_en: Run a small 2D SPH simulation on a phone and place its container on a real table in AR, tilting the water with the phone's gravity sensor. Twist: pour the water out onto the real floor plane.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机上运行一个小型二维 SPH 模拟，用 AR 把容器放在真实桌面上，用手机重力传感器让水倾斜。变体：把水倒到真实的地面平面上。

video.video_title: Coding Adventure: Simulating Fluids

works.title: Convoscope: live definitions and insights during conversation
works.description: An open-source smart-glasses app listens to your conversation and overlays real-time definitions, facts and insights in your view, so you can keep talking while the AI fills in the gaps.
works.description_zh: 一个开源智能眼镜应用，边听你的对话，边在视野里叠加实时的名词解释、事实和见解，让你在继续交谈时由 AI 帮你补足背景。
works.idea_en: An assistant that listens along and whispers context into your eye.
works.idea_zh: 一个跟着听、把背景信息悄悄写进你视野的助手。
works.technique: Continuous speech recognition feeds an LLM that extracts rare terms and entities, and short cards are pushed to the glasses display.
works.technique_zh: 持续的语音识别把内容送给大语言模型，提取生僻词和实体，再把简短卡片推送到眼镜显示屏。
works.exercise_en: Run live speech-to-text on a phone during a class discussion, have an LLM pick one unusual term every 30 seconds and show its definition in large text in a headset viewer. Twist: show a counter-argument instead of a definition.
works.exercise_zh: 在课堂讨论时用手机做实时语音转文字，让大语言模型每 30 秒挑一个生僻词，在头戴支架里用大字显示解释。变体：显示一个反方观点而不是解释。

video.video_title: AI Smart Glases: Convoscope

works.title: Copy and Paste Room Mesh with Meta Quest 3
works.description: Grabs a chunk of the scanned room mesh and pastes duplicates of real furniture elsewhere in passthrough.
works.idea_zh: 在 Quest 3 里把真实房间的一块网格复制粘贴到别处。

video.video_title: Copy and Paste Room Mesh with Meta Quest 3

works.technique: The Quest scene mesh is cropped with a user-placed bounding box, duplicated, and re-rendered with passthrough-sampled colors at a new position.
works.exercise_zh: 在 LiDAR 手机上用网格截取一块“椅子”区域并复制一份放到房间另一侧；变体：复制出的家具慢慢融化或长出植物。
works.description_zh: 抓取扫描得到的房间网格中的一块，在透视画面中把真实家具的副本粘贴到别处。
works.idea_en: In Quest 3, copy a chunk of the real room's mesh and paste it somewhere else.
works.technique_zh: 用用户放置的包围盒裁剪 Quest 场景网格，复制后在新位置重新渲染，颜色取自透视画面的采样。
works.exercise_en: On a LiDAR phone, cut out a 'chair' region from the mesh and place a copy on the other side of the room. Twist: make the copied furniture slowly melt or sprout plants.

works.title: Counter-Strike 2 Smoke Grenades
works.description: A smoke grenade fills a room with volumetric smoke that flows around walls, and gunshots and explosions punch holes that slowly close again.
works.description_zh: 一颗烟雾弹让体积烟充满房间，烟会绕着墙流动；枪弹和爆炸会在烟里打出洞，再慢慢合拢。
works.idea_en: Smoke that knows the room: it floods the free space and can be pushed away.
works.idea_zh: 懂得房间形状的烟：它填满空处，也能被推开。
works.technique: The level is voxelised, a compute shader flood-fills smoke through free voxels from the grenade, and the smoke is ray-marched with noise and lighting while bullet capsules carve temporary holes in the density.
works.technique_zh: 先把关卡体素化，计算着色器从烟雾弹位置沿空体素做洪水填充，再用噪声和光照对烟雾密度做光线步进渲染；子弹轨迹的胶囊体会在密度里暂时挖出空洞。
works.exercise_en: Voxelise a real room from the AR Foundation LiDAR mesh on an iPhone Pro and flood-fill the repo's smoke from a point the user taps, so it pours around real furniture. Twist: let a hand swipe (tracked by the camera) blow a hole through the cloud.
works.exercise_zh: 用 iPhone Pro 上 AR Foundation 的 LiDAR 网格把真实房间体素化，从用户点击的位置用仓库里的方法洪水填充烟雾，让烟绕着真实家具流动。变体：用摄像头追踪的手势挥动，把烟云打出一个洞。

video.video_title: I Tried Recreating Counter Strike 2's Smoke Grenades

works.title: Creating Lenses with GenAI Tools
works.description: Anne Horel presents her workflow of generating textures, characters and backgrounds with generative AI tools and turning them into playful Snapchat Lenses.
works.description_zh: Anne Horel 展示她的工作流程：用生成式 AI 工具生成纹理、角色和背景，再把它们做成好玩的 Snapchat Lens。
works.idea_en: Use generative AI as a sketchbook that feeds straight into a live AR effect.
works.idea_zh: 把生成式 AI 当成素描本，直接为实时 AR 特效供稿。
works.technique: Images made with text-to-image tools are cleaned up and mapped as face textures, 2D layers and environment art inside Lens Studio.
works.technique_zh: 用文生图工具生成图像，经过清理后在 Lens Studio 中作为脸部贴图、2D 图层和环境美术使用。
works.exercise_en: Generate five images with an AI tool from one prompt theme and build a face Lens that cycles through them when the user opens their mouth. Twist: the prompt must describe a feeling, not an object.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AI 工具围绕一个提示词主题生成五张图像，做一个张嘴就切换图像的脸部 Lens；变体：提示词必须描述一种感受，而不是一个物体。

video.video_title: Intro to Creating Lenses using GenAI Tools by Anne Horel

works.title: Cubism (Mixed Reality mode)
works.description: The hand-tracked block puzzle Cubism rebuilt for passthrough: colored polycube pieces float above your real table and you assemble them with your bare hands.
works.idea_zh: 用裸手在真实桌面上方拼装悬浮的彩色方块谜题。

video.video_title: Cubism - Mixed Reality Trailer

works.technique: Hand-tracking pinch grabs drive rigidbody pieces that snap to a voxel grid when released near a valid slot, while passthrough keeps the real table visible as the work surface.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 3×3×3 的格子，把三块多方块碎片拖到格子里，靠近时自动吸附到最近格点；变体：拼好后整个立方体变成一个会动的角色。
works.description_zh: 手部追踪方块拼图游戏 Cubism 的透视版本：彩色的多方块拼图块漂浮在你真实的桌面上方，你用裸手把它们拼起来。
works.idea_en: Assemble a floating colored block puzzle with your bare hands above a real table.
works.technique_zh: 手部追踪的捏合抓取驱动刚体拼图块，在有效位置附近松手时，拼图块会吸附到体素网格上；透视画面则让真实桌面始终可见，充当工作台面。
works.exercise_en: Make a 3×3×3 grid and drag three polycube pieces into it, snapping each to the nearest grid point when it gets close. Twist: once the cube is complete, it turns into a character that moves.

works.title: Daft Punk: Memories Unlocked
works.description: For the 10th anniversary of Random Access Memories, fans hunt AR treasures across ten global locations to unlock a music video, scan the 2013 album cover to hear a hidden track, and see billboards come alive.
works.description_zh: 为纪念专辑 Random Access Memories 发行十周年，歌迷在全球十个地点寻找 AR 宝藏来解锁一支 MV，扫描 2013 年的专辑封面还能听到隐藏曲目，街头广告牌也会“活”过来。
works.idea_en: Turn an album release into a worldwide AR treasure hunt where the cover art itself is a key.
works.idea_zh: 把专辑发行变成一场全球 AR 寻宝，专辑封面本身就是钥匙。
works.technique: Snap Lenses combine Landmarker location triggers, image-marker tracking of the album cover and billboards, and spatial audio playback.
works.technique_zh: Snap Lens 结合地标定位触发、对专辑封面和广告牌的图像标记追踪，以及空间音频播放。
works.exercise_en: Design a three-stop AR scavenger hunt around your building where scanning posters unlocks pieces of one song. Twist: the final stem only plays when all three pieces have been found by different people.
works.exercise_zh: 围绕教学楼设计一个三站式 AR 寻宝，扫描海报即可解锁同一首歌的不同片段；变体：只有当三段分别被不同的人找到后，最后一段音轨才会播放。

video.video_title: Memories Unlocked - Daft Punk x Snapchat

works.title: Dcam: realtime Stable Diffusion in live performance
works.description: During Metome's live show, the camera image of the stage is repainted by Stable Diffusion image-to-image a few times per second and projected as flowing painted frames.
works.description_zh: 在 Metome 的现场演出中，舞台的相机画面每秒被 Stable Diffusion 图生图重绘几次，以流动的绘画画面投影出来。
works.idea_en: Run image generation fast enough to become a live visual.
works.idea_zh: 让图像生成快到可以当作现场视觉。
works.technique: Apple's Core ML port of Stable Diffusion runs image-to-image on a Mac inside Unity, while an iPhone streams camera video and controls over NDI.
works.technique_zh: 在 Mac 上的 Unity 中运行 Apple 的 Core ML 版 Stable Diffusion 图生图，iPhone 通过 NDI 传输相机视频和控制信号。
works.exercise_en: Send phone camera frames to an image-to-image model (e.g., a fast SDXL-Turbo server) and show the result as a floating panel beside the real scene in AR Foundation. Twist: the prompt changes with the song section.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机相机画面发给图生图模型（比如快速的 SDXL-Turbo 服务），在 AR Foundation 中把结果作为浮动面板放在真实场景旁。变体：提示词随歌曲段落变化。

video.video_title: Realtime Stable Diffusion image-to-image in live performance

works.title: Deep Field
works.description: An interactive AR artwork for museum gardens and public spaces: through a phone, imagined plants that glow, shapeshift or sprout teeth grow around visitors, accompanied by recordings of animals and insects that are now gone.
works.description_zh: 一件为博物馆花园和公共空间创作的互动 AR 作品：透过手机，会发光、会变形、会长出牙齿的想象植物在观众周围生长，伴随着如今已经消失的动物和昆虫的录音。
works.idea_en: A phone reveals a speculative garden of plants that do not exist yet.
works.idea_zh: 用手机看见一座由尚不存在的植物组成的推想花园。
works.technique: Procedurally generated and hand-sculpted 3D plants are placed in the surroundings with markerless phone AR, while a soundscape from The Listening Planet's field recordings plays around them.
works.technique_zh: 程序生成和手工雕刻的三维植物通过无标记手机 AR 放置在周围环境中，同时播放来自 The Listening Planet 野外录音的声景。
works.exercise_en: Design one imaginary plant from two real species, model it simply in Reality Composer, Lens Studio or WebXR, and place it in the school garden with a matching sound. Twist: the plant only blooms when someone stays still next to it.
works.exercise_zh: 把两种真实植物组合成一种想象植物，在 Reality Composer、Lens Studio 或 WebXR 里简单建模，把它放进学校花园并配上相应的声音；变体：只有有人在它旁边静静待着时，它才会开花。

video.video_title: Tin&Ed - Deep Field

works.title: Demeo (Mixed Reality mode)
works.description: The tabletop dungeon crawler moved into passthrough: the game board sits on your real table and friends gather around it as avatars.
works.idea_zh: 把地下城桌游棋盘放到真实桌子上，朋友围坐一起玩。

video.video_title: Demeo is Now Available in Mixed Reality!

works.technique: The game board is anchored to a detected table plane, and remote players appear as networked avatars around the same board.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌上放一个 AR 小棋盘，远程同学的操作通过网络同步过来，用一个简单头像代表他；变体：棋盘大小随参与人数自动变化。
works.description_zh: 这款桌面地下城探险游戏被搬进了透视画面：游戏棋盘摆在你真实的桌子上，朋友们以化身形式围坐在周围。
works.idea_en: Put a dungeon board game on a real table and gather around it with friends.
works.technique_zh: 游戏棋盘锚定在检测到的桌面平面上，远程玩家以联网化身的形式出现在同一张棋盘周围。
works.exercise_en: Place a small AR game board on a table, sync a remote classmate's moves over the network, and represent them with a simple avatar. Twist: resize the board automatically according to the number of players.

works.title: Duotone image effect
works.description: A full-color scene is redrawn with just two colors plus dithering, giving a printed, poster-like look.
works.description_zh: 全彩场景被重绘成只有两种颜色加抖动的画面，像印刷海报。
works.idea_en: Reduce the palette to make an image graphic.
works.idea_zh: 减少颜色，让画面更有图形感。
works.technique: A URP full-screen pass maps luminance to a two-color gradient with extra dark and highlight colors and applies ordered dithering.
works.technique_zh: URP 全屏通道把亮度映射到双色渐变上，再加暗部和高光两个颜色，并做有序抖动。
works.exercise_en: Apply a duotone filter to the AR Foundation camera feed so the whole room looks like a risograph print. Twist: each person gets their own color pair.
works.exercise_zh: 给 AR Foundation 相机画面加双色调滤镜，让整个房间看起来像孔版印刷。变体：每个人有自己的一对颜色。

video.video_title:
Updated the Duotone effect package.
https://t.co/UgCdDpyXom https://t.co/0MwrPxNeoh

works.title: Echoes
works.description: At Art Basel Miami, each visitor's live pose is matched to the closest pose from previous visitors, so your movement is echoed by people who stood there before you.
works.idea_zh: 你的每个动作，都会召唤出之前某位观众做过的最相似动作。

video.video_title:
Excited to share “Echoes” an interactive artwork that I showed at Art Basel in Miami for the Beyond Basel @TrippyLabs  event.
 
Echoes is shaped by the collective motion of its participants, pairing e

works.technique: Pose landmarks from a camera are stored per visitor, and a nearest-neighbor search retrieves the closest past pose frame to display alongside the live body.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MoveNet 记录全班同学的姿势库，再让新来的人摆姿势时屏幕显示'最像你的同学'；加一个变化：匹配越准，画面越清晰。
works.description_zh: 在 Art Basel Miami，每位观众的实时姿态都会与之前观众中最相近的姿态进行匹配，于是你的动作会被曾站在这里的人“回响”出来。
works.idea_en: Every move you make summons the most similar move made by an earlier visitor.
works.technique_zh: 按观众分别存储摄像头捕捉到的姿态关键点，通过最近邻搜索找出最接近的历史姿态帧，与实时身体并排显示。
works.exercise_en: Record a pose library of the whole class with MoveNet, then when a newcomer strikes a pose, show 'the classmate most like you' on screen. Twist: the closer the match, the sharper the image.

salient.why_en: Every pose you strike is answered by the most similar pose of someone who stood there before you.
salient.why_zh: 你摆出的每个姿势，都会召唤出之前站在这里的人做过的最相似的姿势。

works.title: Eulerian Fluid Simulator
works.description: Smoke-like streams flow around an obstacle the user drags through a wind tunnel, shedding vortices, in a grid fluid simulator written from scratch in Unity.
works.description_zh: 用户在风洞里拖动一个障碍物，烟雾般的流线绕过它并甩出涡旋；这是在 Unity 里从零写的网格流体模拟。
works.idea_en: A fluid is just a grid of velocities kept divergence-free.
works.idea_zh: 流体不过是一张保持无散度的速度网格。
works.technique: A staggered-grid Eulerian solver (after Matthias Müller's Ten Minute Physics) applies Gauss-Seidel projection for incompressibility and semi-Lagrangian advection of velocity and smoke, all in C#.
works.technique_zh: 一个交错网格欧拉解算器（改编自 Matthias Müller 的 Ten Minute Physics），用 Gauss-Seidel 投影保证不可压缩，并对速度和烟雾做半拉格朗日平流，全部用 C# 实现。
works.exercise_en: Port the solver to a compute shader and project it onto an AR floor plane, using the tracked phone position as the moving obstacle so walking leaves a wake. Twist: add real walls from the LiDAR mesh as solid cells.
works.exercise_zh: 把解算器移植到计算着色器，投射到 AR 地面平面上，用追踪到的手机位置当作移动障碍物，让走动留下尾流。变体：把 LiDAR 网格中的真实墙面作为固体格子加入。

video.video_title: How to write an Eulerian fluid simulator in Unity (open source)

works.title: Eye-tracked Swipe Keyboard
works.description: A keyboard floats in video see-through AR and the user types whole words by sweeping their gaze across the letters, like swiping on a phone, with no hands at all.
works.description_zh: 一个键盘悬浮在视频透视 AR 中，用户用视线扫过字母就能输入整个单词，像在手机上滑动输入一样，完全不用手。
works.idea_en: Swipe-typing, but the finger is your gaze.
works.idea_zh: 滑动输入法，只是手指换成了视线。
works.technique: Records the gaze path over a virtual keyboard on a Varjo XR-3 and matches it against word templates with approximate path matching.
works.technique_zh: 在 Varjo XR-3 上记录视线扫过虚拟键盘的轨迹，用近似路径匹配与单词模板比对。
works.exercise_en: Print a large keyboard, have one student trace words with their eyes while a partner films their face with a phone, then try to decode the words from the video. Twist: design a shorter layout that makes gaze paths less ambiguous.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一张大键盘，一名学生用眼睛“描”出单词，同伴用手机拍下他的脸，再尝试从视频中解读出单词；变体：设计一个更紧凑的布局，让视线轨迹更不容易混淆。

video.video_title: An Eye-tracked Swipe Keyboard for Hands-free Typing in Augmented and Virtual Reality

works.title: FeetThrough
works.description: An electrotactile insole renders virtual textures and bumps under the feet while its thin design still lets the wearer feel the real ground.
works.idea_zh: 脚底既能感到虚拟地面，也不丢失真实地面的感觉。

video.video_title: FeetThrough: Electrotactile Foot Interface that Preserves Real-World Sensations

works.technique: Uses thin electrode arrays on the foot's arch and sides to deliver electrotactile patterns without covering the sole's pressure-sensing areas.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个手机GPS/AR“脚下提示”行走路线：到达关键点时通过口袋里的手机振动提示；变化：振动模式模拟不同地面（草地、沙子）。
works.description_zh: 一种电触觉鞋垫，能在脚下呈现虚拟的纹理和凸起，同时由于设计轻薄，佩戴者依然能感受到真实的地面。
works.idea_en: Your soles feel the virtual ground without losing touch with the real one.
works.technique_zh: 在足弓和脚两侧布置轻薄的电极阵列来输出电触觉图案，同时不覆盖脚底负责感知压力的区域。
works.exercise_en: Design a walking route with phone GPS or AR 'underfoot cues', where the phone in your pocket vibrates when you reach key points. Twist: use vibration patterns to simulate different ground surfaces (grass, sand).

works.title: First Encounters
works.description: Fluffy aliens attack after your ship crashes into your room; you shoot holes through your real walls to see space outside and chase aliens through them.
works.idea_zh: 打穿自家墙壁，看见外面的外星空间。

video.video_title: Meta Quest 3 First Encounters Room Scanning and Gameplay

works.technique: Scans the room into a scene mesh, then replaces passthrough with a virtual exterior wherever the player's shots break wall segments.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR检测墙面，被点击的地方贴出“破洞”并透出一张太空全景；变化：破洞越多，房间里的“外星生物”越多。
works.description_zh: 你的飞船撞进了房间，毛茸茸的外星生物随即发起进攻；你在真实的墙上打出一个个洞，看见外面的太空，并穿过这些洞追击外星生物。
works.idea_en: Blast through the walls of your home and see alien space outside.
works.technique_zh: 把房间扫描成场景网格，玩家的射击打碎哪段墙面，就在那里用虚拟的外部场景替换透视画面。
works.exercise_en: Detect a wall with phone AR, and wherever it is tapped, put a 'hole' that reveals a space panorama. Twist: the more holes there are, the more 'aliens' enter the room.

works.title: Flower Petal Controller
works.description: Hand gestures summon and steer a swirling cloud of flower petals through a living room, which scatter and gather as the fingers open and close.
works.description_zh: 用手势召唤并操控一团旋转的花瓣云穿过客厅，手指张开与合拢时，花瓣随之散开和聚拢。
works.idea_en: Conduct a cloud of petals with your hand.
works.idea_zh: 用手指挥一团花瓣。
works.technique: A Snap Lens uses hand tracking and gesture detection to drive forces in Lens Studio's GPU VFX particle system.
works.technique_zh: Snap 镜头用手部追踪和手势识别驱动 Lens Studio GPU 特效粒子系统中的力场。
works.exercise_en: Build a gesture-driven particle swarm with MediaPipe hands and three.js: open palm pushes particles away, a fist pulls them in. Twist: each gesture changes the particle colour.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 手部追踪和 three.js 做一个手势驱动的粒子群：张开手掌把粒子推开，握拳把它们吸回来。变体：每种手势改变粒子颜色。

video.video_title:
Nothing feels more magical than VFX in Augmented Reality ✨ 

For this experience we used @SnapAR hand tracking, gesture detection and VFX engine to create a “flower petal” controller 🥀 https://t.co/FS

works.title: Flowfal
works.description: At the Sónar+D exhibition in Barcelona, a visitor dances with a smartwatch on her wrist and her arm movements bend and trigger an Ableton sound in real time.
works.description_zh: 在巴塞罗那 Sónar+D 展览上，一位观众手腕戴着智能手表跳舞，她的手臂动作实时弯折并触发 Ableton 中的声音。
works.idea_en: Any phone or watch you already wear becomes a gesture instrument.
works.idea_zh: 你已经戴着的手机或手表，就能变成手势乐器。
works.technique: An app streams the device's orientation and acceleration over low-latency Wi-Fi to plug-ins in Ableton Live or Max, where each movement is mapped to parameters, MIDI notes or controllers.
works.technique_zh: 应用通过低延迟 Wi-Fi 把设备的姿态和加速度传给 Ableton Live 或 Max 里的插件，每个动作都能映射到参数、MIDI 音符或控制器。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone sensor-to-OSC app to send tilt data to a browser synth and let students dance a filter sweep. Twist: two phones, one controlling pitch and one controlling volume, so a duet is needed to play a melody.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机传感器转 OSC 的应用把倾斜数据发送给浏览器合成器，让学生用舞蹈扫出滤波变化；变体：两部手机，一部控制音高一部控制音量，必须两人合跳才能奏出旋律。

video.video_title: Flowfal Dancer at Sonar, June 2023

works.title: Furniture Madness
works.description: A glowing portal opens on the floor and spews sofas, chairs and tables that tumble and pile up around the user with physics, polished enough to look like a post-produced VFX shot.
works.description_zh: 地面上打开一个发光传送门，沙发、椅子和桌子从里面喷涌而出，在用户周围翻滚堆叠，物理效果逼真，精致得像后期合成的特效镜头。
works.idea_en: A live Lens that looks like a finished VFX shot by combining physics, particles and hand control.
works.idea_zh: 把物理、粒子和手势控制结合起来，让实时 Lens 看起来像完成的特效大片。
works.technique: Lens Studio physics bodies collide with the ground plane while VFX particles and hand tracking trigger and steer the spawning furniture (likely).
works.technique_zh: Lens Studio 的物理刚体与地面碰撞，粒子特效和手部追踪负责触发并引导家具喷出（推测）。
works.exercise_en: Make a Lens where a hand gesture opens a portal that spills 20 physics objects into the room. Twist: the objects must be things from the room itself, scanned or modelled by students.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 Lens：一个手势打开传送门，向房间里倾倒 20 个物理物体；变体：这些物体必须是同学们扫描或建模的房间里的真实物品。

video.video_title: Intro to Furniture Madness by Arthur Bouffard

works.title: Furniture Portal
works.description: A glowing portal opens outdoors when you gesture with hand or foot, and copies of household items (armchairs, chairs, lamps) tumble out and pile up with physics.
works.description_zh: 用手或脚做个动作，户外就打开一个发光的传送门，扶手椅、椅子、台灯等家居用品的复制品翻滚着涌出，按物理堆在一起。
works.idea_en: Open a portal and let copies of your furniture spill out.
works.idea_zh: 打开传送门，让家具的复制品倾泻而出。
works.technique: A Snap Lens duplicates 3D household objects (likely pre-scanned) and runs rigid-body physics with shadows and a VFX layer, triggered by hand and foot tracking.
works.technique_zh: Snap 镜头复制 3D 家居物件（很可能是事先扫描的），加上阴影和特效层做刚体物理模拟，由手部和脚部追踪触发。
works.exercise_en: Scan one object in class with a phone, then in an AR scene make a portal that spawns twenty physics copies of it on tap. Twist: each copy is slightly smaller than the last.
works.exercise_zh: 在课上用手机扫描一件物品，再在 AR 场景里做一个传送门，点一下就吐出二十个带物理的复制品。变体：每个复制品都比上一个小一点。

video.video_title:
AR today can reach post-production level visuals 🤳

We built a portal experience on @SnapAR which duplicates household items and applies physics to them 🪑

The result: an interactive effect where hand

works.title: GPU Fluid 3D
works.description: Coloured smoke swirls inside a 3D volume as a compute-shader fluid solver runs and a moving source keeps injecting density and force.
works.description_zh: 彩色烟雾在三维体积里翻卷：计算着色器运行流体解算，一个移动的源不断注入密度和力。
works.idea_en: A GPU fluid needs only a few kernels: advect, project, repeat.
works.idea_zh: GPU 流体只需要几个内核：平流、投影、重复。
works.technique: The MinimalCompute 01_4_Fluid_3D scene extends the GPU Gems stable-fluids solver to 3D render textures (advection, divergence, Jacobi pressure, projection) and ray-marches the density.
works.technique_zh: MinimalCompute 的 01_4_Fluid_3D 场景把 GPU Gems 的稳定流体解算扩展到三维渲染纹理（平流、散度、Jacobi 压力、投影），再对密度做光线步进。
works.exercise_en: Put the 3D fluid box in AR around a real object and inject smoke from the phone's position so the user can blow smoke at it. Twist: use the microphone to control injection strength.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把三维流体盒子罩在一个真实物体周围，从手机位置注入烟雾，让用户朝它“吹烟”。变体：用麦克风音量控制注入强度。

video.video_title: GPU Fluid 3D using compute shader in Unity

works.title: Gamma: live coding at GitHub Universe Recap
works.description: At a party in Tokyo, Keijiro live-codes shaders in KodeLife while a DJ plays; the code layers feedback swirls and color over a 3D scene rendered in Unity.
works.description_zh: 在东京的一场派对上，高桥启治郎在 KodeLife 里现场写着色器，DJ 同时放歌；代码把反馈漩涡和色彩叠加到 Unity 渲染的三维场景上。
works.idea_en: Writing code in front of an audience is the performance.
works.idea_zh: 当众写代码本身就是表演。
works.technique: Unity renders a 3D scene and likely shares it with KodeLife through Syphon, where a live-edited GLSL shader adds feedback and color effects while the code stays visible on screen.
works.technique_zh: Unity 渲染三维场景，推测通过 Syphon 共享给 KodeLife，在那里现场编辑的 GLSL 着色器加上反馈和色彩效果，代码同时显示在屏幕上。
works.exercise_en: Live-code a fragment shader (KodeLife or shadertoy-style WebGL) that processes a phone camera feed, then show it on a floating AR panel in the room. Twist: the audience shouts parameter values.
works.exercise_zh: 现场编写一个处理手机相机画面的片段着色器（KodeLife 或 shadertoy 风格的 WebGL），然后显示在房间里的 AR 浮动面板上。变体：观众喊出参数值。

video.video_title: Live coding session at GitHub Universe Recap party, 5h Dec 2023

works.title: Generative AI Virtual Try-on research
works.description: A research demo in which a single photo of a person is used to generate realistic images of them wearing different garments, aimed at seeing how clothes look on you before buying online.
works.description_zh: 一项研究演示：只用一张人物照片，就能生成此人穿上不同服装的逼真图像，目的是在网购前看到衣服穿在自己身上的效果。
works.idea_en: Swap real-time 3D for generative images: the model imagines you in the outfit.
works.idea_zh: 用生成式图像替代实时 3D：让模型去“想象”你穿上这件衣服的样子。
works.technique: A diffusion-based image model is conditioned on the person's photo, pose and the garment image to synthesize a new photo of the person wearing it (likely).
works.technique_zh: 一个基于扩散模型的图像生成器，以人物照片、姿态和服装图片为条件，合成此人穿着该服装的新照片（推测）。
works.exercise_en: Compare two try-on methods for the same garment: a body-tracked 3D AR filter and an open-source image try-on model, then have classmates rate realism and fun. Twist: feed the AI version an 'impossible' garment and see what it invents.
works.exercise_zh: 对同一件衣服比较两种试穿方式：基于人体追踪的 3D AR 滤镜，和一个开源的图像试穿模型，让同学为真实感和趣味性打分；变体：给 AI 版本输入一件“不可能存在”的衣服，看它会生成什么。

video.video_title:
🧵 Would you like to see how clothes look on you before buying online? Well, it may become possible very soon.

We're excited to share our latest research in #generativeAI Virtual Try-on. https://t.co/

works.title: Genesis: 3D Worlds from AI Skyboxes
works.description: A panorama generated from a text prompt is turned into a walkable 3D world in Unity by estimating its depth and extruding the sphere around the viewer.
works.description_zh: 用文字提示生成的全景图在 Unity 中被估计深度并向外挤出球面，变成一个可以走动的三维世界。
works.idea_en: Give a flat AI panorama depth and it becomes a stage set you can step into.
works.idea_zh: 给一张平面的 AI 全景图加上深度，它就成为可以走进去的舞台布景。
works.technique: An equirectangular Skybox Lab panorama is passed through a monocular depth network, and the depth map displaces a sphere mesh so parallax appears when the camera moves.
works.technique_zh: 把 Skybox Lab 生成的等距柱状全景图送入单目深度网络，再用深度图位移一个球面网格，让相机移动时出现视差。
works.exercise_en: Generate a panorama of an imagined place, run it through Genesis and open it as a portal in AR that the user can lean into. Twist: generate two panoramas and blend them by depth.
works.exercise_zh: 生成一个想象地点的全景图，用 Genesis 处理后在 AR 中作为传送门打开，让用户可以探身进去。变体：生成两张全景图并按深度混合。

video.video_title:
Having some fun generating 3D worlds in @unity  from panoramas generated with @BlockadeLabs text to skybox generator. Super useful for prototyping / moodboarding I imagine.
#madewithunity https://t.co

works.title: GiLight2D: Bad Apple!! in 2D Ray Tracing
works.description: The Bad Apple!! silhouette animation is relit with 2D ray-traced global illumination, so every shape glows, casts soft shadows and bounces light.
works.description_zh: 《Bad Apple!!》的剪影动画被二维光线追踪全局光照重新打光，每个形体都发光、投下柔和阴影并反射光线。
works.idea_en: Treat every bright pixel as a light and let rays find the shadows.
works.idea_zh: 把每个亮像素都当作光源，让光线自己找到阴影。
works.technique: A URP render feature builds a distance field with jump flooding and casts many rays per pixel through it to gather emissive light, producing 2D global illumination.
works.technique_zh: URP 渲染器特性用 jump flooding 构建距离场，再在其中为每个像素发射多条射线收集自发光，得到二维全局光照。
works.exercise_en: Run 2D GI on a top-down AR floor projection so glowing virtual objects cast soft light around students' real shadows. Twist: students' silhouettes from the people-occlusion mask become the light blockers.
works.exercise_zh: 在俯视的 AR 地面投影上运行二维全局光照，让发光的虚拟物体在学生真实影子周围投下柔光。变体：用人物遮挡蒙版中的学生剪影作为挡光物。

video.video_title: Bad Apple!! [But it's 2D Raytracing] ♪

works.title: Giant digital Tabby in New York
works.description: A giant pink Coach Tabby bag hangs between New York buildings in AR, promoting a giveaway in which winners could own the AR bag in the ZERO10 app.
works.description_zh: 一只巨大的粉色 Coach Tabby 手袋以 AR 形式悬挂在纽约的楼宇之间，用于宣传一次抽奖活动，获奖者可以在 ZERO10 App 里拥有这只 AR 手袋。
works.idea_en: Scale is the joke: a handbag the size of a building.
works.idea_zh: 尺度本身就是笑点：一只和大楼一样大的手袋。
works.technique: A 3D bag model is anchored in world space and rendered at architectural scale over camera footage of the street, most likely as a camera-tracked composite for the campaign video.
works.technique_zh: 3D 手袋模型被锚定在世界坐标中，以建筑尺度渲染在街景画面上，宣传视频很可能是基于摄像机追踪的合成。
works.exercise_en: Use world tracking in AR Foundation or 8th Wall to place an everyday object (a mug, a sneaker) at building scale outside, then record a short vertical video. Twist: the giant object must look like it is interacting with the architecture, for example hanging from a ledge.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 或 8th Wall 的世界追踪，把一个日常物品（杯子、球鞋）以建筑尺度放在户外，然后录一段竖屏短视频；变体：让巨物看起来在与建筑互动，比如挂在屋檐上。
