works.title: Graphical Representation of Dance in VR (Motion Bank)
works.description: Applied research at Motion Bank in which dancers wear VR headsets to create and move through graphic, three-dimensional versions of dance scores, testing how choreographic notation could exist in space rather than on paper.
works.description_zh: 在 Motion Bank 进行的应用研究：舞者戴上 VR 头显，创建并穿行于图形化的三维舞谱之中，探索编舞记谱能否存在于空间里，而不只是纸上。
works.idea_en: A dance score you can step inside instead of read.
works.idea_zh: 一份可以走进去、而不是拿来读的舞谱。
works.technique: Dancers likely use a VR drawing tool to record their movement paths as 3D strokes, which then remain in the room as a spatial score for others to follow.
works.technique_zh: 舞者很可能用 VR 绘画工具把动作轨迹记录成三维笔触，这些笔触留在空间里，成为别人可以跟随的空间舞谱。
works.exercise_en: In a WebXR or phone AR drawing app, have one student trace a 20-second phrase with the controller, then ask another to dance it only by following the strokes. Twist: colour each stroke by speed.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或手机 AR 绘画应用，让一名学生用手柄描出一段 20 秒的动作，再让另一名学生只看笔触把它跳出来；变体：按速度给每一笔上色。

video.video_title: Applied research: Graphical representation of dance in VR. A case of study at Motion Bank

works.title: HazARdSnap (AR Cyclocomputers)
works.description: A cyclist glances at the rider ahead and speed and route data snap onto that rider's back, so the eyes never leave the road and a sudden stop is still visible.
works.description_zh: 骑车人看向前面的骑手，速度和路线数据就“吸附”到对方后背上，眼睛不必离开路面，前车急停也能第一时间看到。
works.idea_en: Attach your dashboard to the thing you should be watching anyway.
works.idea_zh: 把仪表盘贴在你本来就该盯着的东西上。
works.technique: Uses eye gaze in a head-mounted display to decide when to show data and anchors it to the tracked cyclist in front instead of a fixed screen position.
works.technique_zh: 借助头显中的眼动注视判断何时显示数据，并把数据锚定在被追踪的前方骑手身上，而不是固定在屏幕某处。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR prototype that pins a speed readout to a person or object tracked in the camera view, then walk behind a classmate and compare with reading a phone held at waist height. Twist: show the data only while you look at the target for more than one second.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 原型，把速度读数钉在相机画面中被追踪的人或物体上，跟在同学后面走，与低头看腰间手机对比；变体：只有注视目标超过一秒时才显示数据。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Cyclocomputers

works.title: Hijacking Magritte's Treachery of Images
works.description: At LACMA he 'hijacked' René Magritte's famous painting of a pipe ('This is not a pipe'), using AR to continue the painting's story on the museum wall.
works.description_zh: 他在洛杉矶郡艺术博物馆（LACMA）用 AR“劫持”了马格利特那幅著名的烟斗画（《这不是一只烟斗》），在博物馆墙上接着讲下去这幅画的故事。
works.idea_en: Continue a famous artwork's narrative in AR, right in the museum.
works.idea_zh: 直接在博物馆里用 AR 为一件名作续写故事。
works.technique: The painting is likely tracked as an image marker in Lens Studio, with animated 3D content anchored to the canvas so the added story plays out in front of the original.
works.technique_zh: 画作很可能在 Lens Studio 中作为图像标记被追踪，把三维动画内容锚定在画布上，让续写的故事在原作前上演。
works.exercise_en: Choose a reproduction of a well-known painting, track it as an image target, and add one AR animation that answers the painting's question or joke. Twist: make the AR continuation disagree with the original.
works.exercise_zh: 选一幅名画的复制品作为图像目标，加一段回应画作问题或笑点的 AR 动画；变体：让 AR 续写与原作唱反调。

video.video_title:
🖼️ I ‘hijacked’ a painting, using Augmented Reality!
Magritte’s famous ‘The Treachery of Images’, at the amazing @LACMA

Here’s my attempt at continuing its narrative using AR https://t.co/kEsDVS569y

works.title: HoloBots
works.description: A remote user's hologram in HoloLens is paired with small mobile robots, so the remote person can physically push objects and touch hands through the robots.
works.idea_zh: 远程全息人像配上小机器人身体，能真的推动你桌上的东西。

video.video_title: [UIST 2023] HoloBots: Augmenting Holographic Telepresence with Mobile Robots for Tangible Remote ...

works.technique: The remote user's tracked hand motions in HoloLens are mapped onto the positions of Sony toio robots, which localize themselves on a position-encoded mat, and the hologram is rendered co-located with the robots.
works.exercise_zh: 用 toio、micro:bit 小车或一个被同学推动的纸盒作为“远程之手”的实体替身，远程一方在网页上拖动位置，本地手机 AR 在实体上叠加对方的虚拟手；变体：让实体替身做出拥抱、击掌等社交动作。
works.description_zh: HoloLens 中远程用户的全息影像与小型移动机器人配对，让远程的人可以通过机器人实际推动物体，甚至与你手碰手。
works.idea_en: A remote person's hologram gets a small robot body that can actually push things on your desk.
works.technique_zh: 把远程用户在 HoloLens 中被追踪的手部动作映射到 Sony toio 机器人的位置上，这些机器人在带位置编码的垫子上完成自身定位，全息影像则与机器人渲染在同一位置。
works.exercise_en: Use a toio, a micro:bit car or a cardboard box pushed by a classmate as the physical stand-in for a 'remote hand', let the remote side drag its position on a web page, and overlay the other person's virtual hand on the object with local phone AR. Twist: have the stand-in perform social gestures such as a hug or a high five.

works.title: Homme Plissé Issey Miyake show, Palais de Tokyo
works.description: Art direction for the Homme Plissé Issey Miyake show at Paris Fashion Week: a vast fluid membrane of particles appears on the walls and floor around the runway, pulsing, rippling and folding around dancing models.
works.description_zh: 为巴黎时装周 Homme Plissé Issey Miyake 秀场担任艺术指导：一张由无数粒子构成的巨大流动膜出现在秀道四周的墙面和地面上，围着起舞的模特脉动、起伏、折叠。
works.idea_en: A runway where the space itself pleats like the clothes.
works.idea_zh: 秀场空间本身像衣服一样起褶。
works.technique: Large-scale projection of a real-time particle membrane, likely built with eMotion, blurs the perception of space and gravity and is timed to the models' choreography.
works.technique_zh: 大规模投影出实时粒子膜（很可能用 eMotion 制作），模糊了对空间和重力的感知，并与模特的编舞同步。
works.exercise_en: Pick one fabric behavior (pleating, crumpling, fluttering) and build a projected particle cloth in TouchDesigner or p5.js that performs it on a wall; have a classmate walk past like a model and make the cloth fold as they pass. Twist: project onto the garment itself instead of the wall.
works.exercise_zh: 选一种布料的行为（打褶、揉皱、飘动），用 TouchDesigner 或 p5.js 做一块投在墙上的粒子“布”来表现它；请一位同学像模特一样走过，经过时让“布”折叠起来。变体：直接投影到衣服上，而不是墙上。

video.video_title: Adrien M & Claire B x Issey Miyake - Défilé Homme Plissé au Palais de Tokyo — fashion week Paris 2023

works.title: Hot Wheels: Rift Rally
works.description: A smart RC car with a camera, controlled from a phone or console, races through gates at home while the screen overlays a Hot Wheels track, other racers and rift effects.
works.idea_zh: 用带摄像头的智能风火轮小车在家中竞速，屏幕里叠加赛道与对手。

video.video_title: Hot Wheels™ Rift Rally — Smart RC Car + Video Game

works.technique: A camera car streams video to a phone or console that tracks gate markers for localization and overlays track geometry and effects in the car's perspective.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机远程查看另一台手机（放在小车上）的摄像头画面，并在画面上叠加 AR 赛道元素；变体：加入只在车经过某张图片后出现的“裂缝”特效。
works.description_zh: 一辆带摄像头的智能遥控车，用手机或游戏机控制，在家中穿过一道道关卡门竞速，屏幕上同时叠加风火轮赛道、其他赛车和裂隙特效。
works.idea_en: Race a smart Hot Wheels car with a camera around your home while the screen overlays the track and rivals.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头小车把视频串流到手机或游戏机，后者追踪关卡门上的标记进行定位，并在小车视角中叠加赛道几何和特效。
works.exercise_en: Watch the camera feed of a second phone (mounted on a small car) remotely from your phone and overlay AR track elements on it. Twist: add a 'rift' effect that appears only after the car passes a certain picture.

works.title: Illuminate
works.description: In an open space, a person's movement leaves glowing trails that appear in front of them in real time, as if the usually invisible wake of their motion were hanging in the air.
works.description_zh: 在开阔空间里，人的动作会在面前实时留下发光的轨迹，仿佛平常看不见的运动尾迹悬浮在空中。
works.idea_en: What would it be like if we could see our movement?
works.idea_zh: 如果我们能看见自己的动作，会是什么样？
works.technique: Camera-based body tracking feeds custom interactive visualization software that renders persistent motion trails onto a large projection or screen.
works.technique_zh: 基于摄像头的身体追踪把数据送入自研可视化软件，在大投影或屏幕上渲染持续的运动轨迹。
works.exercise_en: With MediaPipe Pose in the browser, draw fading ribbons from both wrists and project them life-size. Twist: each ribbon keeps the colour of the person who drew it so groups can 'sign' the space together.
works.exercise_zh: 在浏览器中用 MediaPipe Pose 从双手腕画出渐隐的彩带，并以真人大小投影；变体：每条彩带保留绘制者的颜色，让一群人一起在空间里“签名”。

video.video_title: Illuminate: What would it be like if we could see our movement?

works.title: Immersive Product Story (WebXR concept)
works.description: Starting from a tent on a web storefront, a full-size tent appears in the living room and the scene grows into an immersive camping experience, delivered through WebXR in Vision Pro's browser.
works.description_zh: 从网店里的一顶帐篷开始，一顶全尺寸帐篷出现在客厅，随后整个场景扩展成沉浸式露营体验，通过 Vision Pro 浏览器中的 WebXR 实现。
works.idea_en: Let a product bring its own world with it.
works.idea_zh: 让商品把它自己的世界一起带来。
works.technique: A concept for WebXR in Safari on Vision Pro: the storefront launches an immersive session that places the product at full scale and then replaces the room with a matching environment.
works.technique_zh: 设想在 Vision Pro 的 Safari 中使用 WebXR：网店启动沉浸式会话，先以真实尺寸放置商品，再用匹配的环境逐步替换房间。
works.exercise_en: Make a WebXR AR scene where one product (lamp, tent or drink) changes the room's mood as lighting, sound and a surrounding environment fade in around it. Twist: the transition only starts when the user walks up to the product.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 WebXR AR 场景：一件商品（台灯、帐篷或饮料）出现后，灯光、声音和周围环境逐渐浮现，改变房间氛围；变体：只有用户走近商品时才开始转换。

video.video_title:
Spatial Commerce powered by @Shopify will help brands immerse shoppers in a product story. ⛺🌲

With support for webXR, Vision Pro will help merchants deliver fully immersive VR experiences right from

works.title: Improvising cellular playgrounds in Realtalk
works.description: Live-improvised cellular automata and simulations built from paper and markers on a projected table, edited by hand in real time.
works.idea_zh: 用纸和马克笔即兴搭出会演化的细胞自动机游乐场。

video.video_title: Improvising cellular playgrounds in Realtalk, Aug 2023

works.technique: A camera reads marker-drawn cells and rule pages on paper, and a projector renders cellular automaton simulations directly over the drawings, so editing the paper edits the simulation live.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头读取纸上画的黑白格子作为初始状态，在投影中运行康威生命游戏并叠加回纸面，擦掉或添画格子后即时生效；变体：发明一条新的规则并写在一张规则卡上，换卡即换规则。
works.description_zh: 在投影桌面上用纸和马克笔现场即兴搭建细胞自动机和模拟，并能实时用手修改。
works.idea_en: Improvise an evolving cellular-automaton playground from paper and markers.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头读取纸上用马克笔画出的格子和规则页，投影仪把细胞自动机模拟直接渲染在这些图画上，因此修改纸面就能实时修改模拟。
works.exercise_en: Use a camera to read a black-and-white grid drawn on paper as the initial state, run Conway's Game of Life in a projection overlaid on the paper, and have erased or added cells take effect immediately. Twist: invent a new rule and write it on a rule card, so swapping cards swaps rules.

works.title: Inner Room (installation)
works.description: An immersive installation where the visitor's hand shapes both sound and space: moving it through the virtual room changes sound effects, textures and the architecture of the scene.
works.description_zh: 一件沉浸式装置：观众的手同时塑造声音和空间，在虚拟房间中移动手，就会改变音效、质感和场景结构。
works.idea_en: Your hand sculpts a room and its sound at the same time.
works.idea_zh: 你的手同时雕塑一个房间和它的声音。
works.technique: Hand tracking (likely Leap Motion) maps position and gesture to parameters of a real-time 3D scene and its audio.
works.technique_zh: 手部追踪（可能是 Leap Motion）把手的位置和手势映射到实时 3D 场景及其音频参数。
works.exercise_en: In a web page, use MediaPipe Hands so the distance between thumb and index finger scales a 3D room and pitches a drone. Twist: open palm freezes the room in place.
works.exercise_zh: 在网页里用 MediaPipe Hands，让拇指与食指的距离缩放一个 3D 房间并改变持续音音高；变体：张开手掌时房间定格。

video.video_title: 'Inner Room'

works.title: Interactive VJ with Azure Kinect
works.description: A DIY VJ system: the performer, seen by an Azure Kinect, is outlined in glowing blue lines and surrounded by effects that are switched from an on-screen control panel.
works.description_zh: 一套自制的 VJ 系统：Azure Kinect 拍到的表演者被勾勒上发光的蓝色线条，周围环绕着各种特效，可以在屏幕控制面板上切换。
works.idea_en: Turn your own body into the VJ source instead of a video clip.
works.idea_zh: 让自己的身体成为 VJ 素材，而不是一段视频。
works.technique: Azure Kinect colour and depth frames are converted to point positions and a body mask that feed VFX Graph effects (outlines, particles), with parameters exposed in a runtime GUI; likely built on Keijiro-style Kinect-to-VFX helpers.
works.technique_zh: Azure Kinect 的彩色和深度帧被转换成点的位置和人体遮罩，送入 VFX Graph 特效（轮廓线、粒子），参数通过运行时界面调节；很可能基于 Keijiro 式的 Kinect 转 VFX 工具。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone VJ mirror: use ARKit people segmentation to outline yourself with a glowing VFX Graph edge and switch between three looks with a tap. Twist: let the room's music volume set the glow width.
works.exercise_zh: 做一面手机 VJ 镜子：用 ARKit 人像分割给自己描上一圈发光的 VFX Graph 轮廓，轻点屏幕在三种风格间切换。变体：用房间里音乐的音量控制光晕的宽度。

works.title: JD Sports AR Mirror in a sports arena
works.description: For a JD Sports campaign developed by the agency Rumfoords, ZERO10's AR Mirror came to a sports arena: fans try on new sportswear virtually and can start a purchase directly from the mirror screen.
works.description_zh: 在由 Rumfoords 代理策划的 JD Sports 宣传活动中，ZERO10 的 AR 魔镜进入了体育场馆：球迷可以虚拟试穿新款运动服，还能直接在镜子屏幕上发起购买。
works.idea_en: Try-on and checkout collapse into one mirror at the stadium.
works.idea_zh: 在体育场里，试穿和下单合并在同一面镜子上。
works.technique: The AR Mirror combines body tracking and cloth simulation with an on-screen commerce flow, so a selected digital garment links to the matching product for purchase.
works.technique_zh: AR 魔镜把人体追踪、布料模拟和屏幕上的购物流程结合起来，选中的数字服装会直接关联到可购买的对应商品。
works.exercise_en: Build a body-tracked AR mirror that dresses players in a team jersey and shows a QR code linking to a (mock) product page when they hold a pose for two seconds. Twist: the jersey number updates to match how many jumps the person just did.
works.exercise_zh: 做一面基于人体追踪的 AR 镜子，给人穿上球队球衣；当对方保持某个姿势两秒时，显示一个指向（模拟）商品页的二维码；变体：球衣号码会变成这个人刚刚跳了多少下。

works.title: KAGAMI
works.description: Audiences sit in a circle wearing mixed-reality headsets and watch a volumetric recording of Ryuichi Sakamoto playing a grand piano in the middle of the room, surrounded by visual worlds that grow from his music.
works.description_zh: 观众围坐成一圈，戴着混合现实头显，看着坂本龙一的体积捕捉影像在房间中央弹奏三角钢琴，周围是从他的音乐中生长出来的视觉世界。
works.idea_en: A concert that can keep happening after the performer is gone, in the same room as you.
works.idea_zh: 一场在演奏者离开之后仍能继续、并且就在你身边发生的音乐会。
works.technique: Sakamoto's performance was captured volumetrically and rendered in synchronized mixed-reality headsets (Magic Leap), so every seat sees him from its own angle.
works.technique_zh: 坂本龙一的演奏被体积捕捉，在同步的混合现实头显（Magic Leap）中渲染，每个座位都能从自己的角度看到他。
works.exercise_en: Record a classmate playing an instrument with a phone depth or Gaussian-splat capture app and place the result on a real chair in AR for a small audience. Twist: let the room's lights dim as each piece builds.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机深度或高斯泼溅采集应用录下一位同学演奏乐器，再以 AR 方式把结果放到一把真实的椅子上给小观众观看；变体：随着每首曲子推进，让房间的灯光逐渐变暗。

video.video_title: KAGAMI: Ryuichi Sakamoto & Tin Drum | Asia TOPA | 19 February – 16 March 2025

works.title: Kohkoku: Reality and Illusion AR
works.description: AR artwork for the Japanese magazine Kohkoku's 'reality and illusion' issue, animating printed pages through the phone.
works.idea_zh: 为《广告》杂志“虚实”特辑做的 AR 作品，让纸面在手机里动起来。

video.video_title: 広告_虚実_AR

works.technique: Printed magazine pages are registered as tracking images, and animations or 3D elements are rendered on the tracked page pose.
works.exercise_zh: 用 8th Wall 或 MindAR 识别一张自己设计的海报，让画面元素从纸上浮起来动起来；变体：海报被翻转时显示隐藏的另一层内容。
works.description_zh: 为日本杂志《広告》（Kohkoku）“现实与幻象”专题创作的 AR 作品，通过手机让印刷页面动起来。
works.idea_en: An AR piece for the 'reality and illusion' issue of Kohkoku magazine that makes the printed pages move on a phone.
works.technique_zh: 把杂志印刷页注册为追踪图像，在追踪到的页面位姿上渲染动画或 3D 元素。
works.exercise_en: Use 8th Wall or MindAR to recognize a poster you designed, and make its elements lift off the paper and move. Twist: when the poster is flipped, reveal a hidden second layer of content.

works.title: Le Louvre: Egypt Augmented
works.description: Snapchat Lenses made with the Louvre bring ancient Egypt back to life: pointing the phone at the Obelisk on Place de la Concorde and at Egyptian antiquities restores their original gilding, colours and surroundings.
works.description_zh: 与卢浮宫合作的 Snapchat Lens 让古埃及“复活”：把手机对准协和广场上的方尖碑或埃及文物，就能看到它们原本的鎏金、色彩和周边环境。
works.idea_en: Use AR to show a monument as it looked on the day it was made, right on top of how it looks now.
works.idea_zh: 用 AR 把文物“刚完成那天”的样子叠加在它今天的样子上。
works.technique: Custom Landmarker / custom location tracking built from 3D scans locks restored models onto the real obelisk and artefacts in Lens Studio.
works.technique_zh: 在 Lens Studio 中用基于 3D 扫描的自定义地标（Custom Landmarker）追踪，把修复后的模型精准贴合到真实的方尖碑和文物上。
works.exercise_en: Scan a statue, doorway or old building on campus with a phone and build a Lens or AR scene that restores a missing part or its original colour. Twist: let a slider move the viewer through three different centuries.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机扫描校园里的一尊雕像、一道门或一栋老建筑，制作一个 Lens 或 AR 场景，补全它缺失的部分或还原原本的颜色；变体：加一个滑块，让观者在三个不同世纪之间切换。

video.video_title: Egypt Augmented

works.title: Light Particles: projection mapping + LED + AR
works.description: Swarms of bright light particles are projected onto a living-room floor and continue into LED light and an AR layer, blurring which light is physical and which is virtual.
works.description_zh: 一群明亮的光粒子被投射到客厅地板上，并延伸到 LED 灯光和 AR 图层中，让人分不清哪些光是真实的、哪些是虚拟的。
works.idea_en: Make one particle system flow across projector, LEDs and AR without a seam.
works.idea_zh: 让同一个粒子系统无缝穿行于投影、LED 和 AR 之间。
works.technique: A single real-time particle simulation is rendered to a floor projector, an LED fixture and a camera-based AR view that share one calibrated coordinate system (likely).
works.technique_zh: 同一个实时粒子模拟被分别渲染到地面投影、LED 灯具和基于摄像头的 AR 视图中，三者共享一个经过标定的坐标系（推测）。
works.exercise_en: Run one particle system in Unity or TouchDesigner that renders to a projector on the floor and to a phone AR view anchored to the same spot. Twist: particles that leave the projection area continue only in AR.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity 或 TouchDesigner 中运行一个粒子系统，同时输出到地面投影和锚定在同一位置的手机 AR 视图；变体：飞出投影区域的粒子只在 AR 中继续存在。

video.video_title:
Light Particles - Projection mapping + LED + AR

Video source: Roelof Knol (roelofknol)

works.title: Look, Pinch, Ask (Vision Pro concept)
works.description: A Vision Pro concept that pairs eye, hand and voice input with conversational AI: a shopper sitting on a velvet sofa looks, pinches and asks, and instant personalised product insights appear.
works.description_zh: Vision Pro 概念：把眼、手、语音输入与对话式 AI 结合。坐在丝绒沙发上的购物者看一眼、捏一下、问一句，个性化的商品信息立刻出现。
works.idea_en: Ask about the thing you are looking at, the moment you are curious.
works.idea_zh: 好奇的那一刻，就问眼前这件东西。
works.technique: Likely a concept video: gaze selects the product, a pinch confirms, speech goes to a conversational AI, and the answer is shown as a floating panel next to the object.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是概念视频：视线选中商品，捏合确认，语音发送给对话式 AI，答案以悬浮面板显示在物体旁边。
works.exercise_en: Prototype a 'look and ask' interaction in phone AR: the object at the screen centre is selected, a tap records a question, and a short AI answer is pinned beside it. Twist: the answer must be spoken back in the object's own voice.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中做一个“看了就问”的交互：屏幕中心对准的物体被选中，点一下录下问题，AI 的简短回答钉在物体旁边；变体：让物体用“自己的声音”把答案说出来。

video.video_title:
We’re always looking at better ways to shop @Shopify. 

Vision Pro’s intuitive eye, hand, and voice interactions could unlock instant, personalized insights when combined with the powers of conversati

works.title: MOFA: The Duel
works.description: A co-located magic duel in which players wearing HoloKit headsets cast spells with hand gestures while spectators on phones watch and join; CHI 2023 best interactivity demo.
works.idea_zh: 戴HoloKit用手势施法对决，旁观者用手机加入观看的同场魔法对战。

video.video_title: MOFA: Exploring Asymmetric Mixed Reality Design Strategy for Co-located Multiplayer Between Handh...

works.technique: Hand-pose recognition on the iPhone camera classifies spell gestures, and headsets and spectator phones share one coordinate system (likely via marker-based colocalization) so spells travel between real bodies.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 或 Apple Vision 手势识别区分两种手势，分别释放火球和护盾，两台设备通过网络同步；变体：让旁观者用手机为某一方加油来增强法术。
works.description_zh: 一场同处一地的魔法对决：戴着 HoloKit 头显的玩家用手势施放法术，旁观者则用手机观战并参与其中；获得 CHI 2023 最佳互动演示奖。
works.idea_en: A same-room magic duel in which players wearing HoloKit cast spells with gestures while spectators join in on their phones.
works.technique_zh: 基于 iPhone 摄像头的手势识别对施法手势进行分类，头显和旁观者手机共享同一个坐标系（可能通过基于标记的共同定位实现），让法术在真实的身体之间飞行。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe or Apple Vision hand-pose recognition to tell two gestures apart, one casting a fireball and one a shield, and sync the two devices over the network. Twist: let spectators cheer for one side on their phones to power up that side's spells.

works.title: Matrix Stockroom
works.description: A VR concept inspired by the infinite gun rack in The Matrix: a search spawns endless shelves of products around you, voice commands narrow them down, and any item can be pulled out for AR try-on.
works.description_zh: 向《黑客帝国》无限货架致敬的 VR 概念：一次搜索会在你周围生成无尽的商品货架，用语音指令逐步筛选，任何商品都能拿出来做 AR 试用。
works.idea_en: Show search results as an infinite room you walk through, then talk to narrow it down.
works.idea_zh: 把搜索结果变成一个可以走进去的无限房间，再用说话来筛选。
works.technique: A concept film combining Meta's Voice SDK with a large language model as the filter; the hands were motion-captured on a Quest with the team's open-source Handy tool and rendered in Blender (the filtering pipeline is likely simulated).
works.technique_zh: 概念影片设想用 Meta Voice SDK 加大语言模型做筛选；片中的手部动作由团队开源工具 Handy 在 Quest 上动捕后用 Blender 渲染（筛选流程很可能是模拟的）。
works.exercise_en: Build a VR or phone-AR scene that spawns a grid of 50 objects from a search word, then add two spoken filters ('only red', 'smaller') that remove items. Twist: sort the room by a feeling ('cozy', 'loud') instead of a category.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 VR 或手机 AR 场景：输入一个搜索词就生成 50 个物体的阵列，再加两个语音筛选（“只要红色”“更小的”）去掉不符合的物体；变体：按感觉（“温馨”“吵闹”）而不是类别来整理房间。

works.title: MediaPipe body tracking plugin for TouchDesigner
works.description: A free, no-setup webcam plugin tracks face, hands and body in TouchDesigner, shown driving real-time visuals over the performer's body.
works.idea_zh: 零门槛的网页摄像头全身追踪插件，让任何人都能做体感视觉。

video.video_title: So excited launch my new body tracking plugin for TouchDesigner!  It runs off the webcam and works with no setup on both Mac and PC. I’ve refined this based off many motion tracking projects I’ve work

works.technique: MediaPipe models run inside an embedded browser in TouchDesigner and stream landmark data as channels to drive visuals.
works.exercise_zh: 用这个插件（或网页版 MediaPipe）做一个'身体乐器'：不同关节碰到屏幕上的区域发出不同音；加一个变化：只有闭眼时才能演奏。
works.description_zh: 一款免费、无需配置的网络摄像头插件，可在 TouchDesigner 中追踪人脸、手部和身体，演示中它驱动着叠加在表演者身体上的实时视觉。
works.idea_en: A no-barrier webcam body-tracking plugin that lets anyone make motion-driven visuals.
works.technique_zh: MediaPipe 模型在 TouchDesigner 内嵌的浏览器中运行，并把关键点数据以通道形式输出，用来驱动视觉效果。
works.exercise_en: Use this plugin (or MediaPipe on the web) to build a 'body instrument' in which different joints play different notes when they touch areas on the screen. Twist: you can only play with your eyes closed.

works.title: Minecraft remade in AR
works.description: He rebuilt Minecraft mechanics in AR so you can dig into, fight on and build blocks over the real ground around you.
works.idea_zh: 在真实地面上像史蒂夫一样挖、打、建。

video.video_title: I remade Minecraft in AR so you can dig, fight, and build like Steve but in the real world!! https://t.co/YEOMiUIPBF

works.technique: Real-world meshing aligns a voxel grid to the ground so placed and dug blocks stick to real surfaces (likely Lightship meshing).
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 做一个在地面网格上放方块的建造玩具；加一个变化：方块会被真实阳光方向投下影子。
works.description_zh: 他在 AR 中重建了 Minecraft 的玩法，让你可以在身边的真实地面上挖掘、战斗和搭建方块。
works.idea_en: Dig, fight and build on the real ground just like Steve.
works.technique_zh: 真实世界网格化把体素网格与地面对齐，使放置或挖掉的方块贴合真实表面（可能使用 Lightship 网格化）。
works.exercise_en: Build a block-placing construction toy on a ground mesh with AR Foundation. Twist: blocks cast shadows in the direction of the real sunlight.

works.title: Mixed Reality Door for Meta Quest 3
works.description: A real door in the room becomes a portal: opening it in passthrough reveals a virtual world behind it.
works.idea_zh: 把家里一扇真实的门变成通往虚拟世界的传送门。

video.video_title: Mixed Reality (MR) Door for Meta Quest3

works.technique: A virtual portal plane is aligned to the real door frame in passthrough, with a stencil or depth mask so the virtual world is visible only where the real door opening is.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在一扇真实门框位置手动对齐一个 Stencil 门，门内渲染森林；变体：门后的世界根据当天日期或天气变化。
works.description_zh: 房间里一扇真实的门变成了传送门：在透视画面中打开它，门后便显露出一个虚拟世界。
works.idea_en: Turn a real door at home into a portal to a virtual world.
works.technique_zh: 在透视画面中把一个虚拟传送门平面与真实门框对齐，并使用模板或深度遮罩，让虚拟世界只在真实门洞处可见。
works.exercise_en: Manually align a stencil door to a real doorframe with AR Foundation and render a forest inside it. Twist: change the world behind the door based on the day's date or weather.

salient.why_en: Open the real door in your home and a virtual world is waiting on the other side.
salient.why_zh: 打开家里真实的门，门后是一个虚拟世界。

works.title: Morphing Identity
works.description: Two people face a screen where their live faces gradually morph into each other in real time, exploring where 'self' ends and 'other' begins.
works.idea_zh: 实时把你的脸慢慢变成对面那个人的脸。

video.video_title: Morphing Identity [CHI2023]

works.technique: Tracks facial landmarks on both live video feeds and warps and cross-dissolves the textures with a controllable blend ratio.
works.exercise_zh: 用Snap Lens Studio或Effect House做一个把自己脸与同桌脸按滑块比例融合的滤镜；变化：融合比例由两人说话音量决定。
works.description_zh: 两个人面对同一块屏幕，他们的实时面孔逐渐相互融合变形，借此探讨“自我”在哪里结束，“他者”又从哪里开始。
works.idea_en: Slowly morph your face into the face of the person opposite you, live.
works.technique_zh: 在两路实时视频中追踪面部关键点，对纹理进行变形和交叉溶解，混合比例可调。
works.exercise_en: Make a filter in Snap Lens Studio or Effect House that blends your face with your deskmate's face according to a slider. Twist: set the blend ratio by how loudly each person speaks.

salient.why_en: Your face slowly melts into the face of the person sitting across from you, live.
salient.why_zh: 你的脸实时地慢慢变成对面那个人的脸。

works.title: Morphose (Cie Ultreia)
works.description: In a museum about to close for two years, nine projectors bring 21 paintings, the ceiling and the walls to life, extending and transforming the canvases around the visitors.
works.description_zh: 在一座即将闭馆两年的博物馆里，九台投影仪让 21 幅画作以及天花板和墙面动了起来，把画布延伸、变形到观众四周。
works.idea_en: Let old paintings spill beyond their frames onto the room.
works.idea_zh: 让老画溢出画框，漫到整个房间。
works.technique: Nine projectors and four computers map content from TouchDesigner, Resolume, Chataigne and Oxipital onto the paintings, with some backgrounds expanded by DALL-E outpainting.
works.technique_zh: 九台投影仪和四台电脑把来自 TouchDesigner、Resolume、Chataigne 和 Oxipital 的内容映射到画作上，部分背景用 DALL-E 外扩生成。
works.exercise_en: Pick one painting (or a printed reproduction on the wall) and project an animated extension of it beyond the frame. Twist: the extension changes when a visitor stands in front of the painting.
works.exercise_zh: 选一幅画（或贴在墙上的复制品），把它的动画延伸部分投影到画框之外。变体：有观众站到画前时，延伸部分随之变化。

video.video_title: Cie Ultreia - Morphose | Teaser

works.title: Nuclei AR
works.description: Thousands of glowing particles cling to a person's body in 3D and copy their colours, while the real person underneath is painted out, so they seem to dissolve into a cloud of 'nuclei'. It was shown at the Max Ernst Museum and on Snap's AR mirrors.
works.description_zh: 成千上万个发光粒子在三维空间中附着在人的身体上并复制其颜色，而下方真实的人被抹除，看起来就像溶解成了一团“细胞核”。作品曾在马克斯·恩斯特博物馆和 Snap 办公室的 AR 魔镜上展示。
works.idea_en: Replace a person with a particle cloud that keeps their colours.
works.idea_zh: 用一团保留原本颜色的粒子云替换掉一个人。
works.technique: 3D body tracking drives particle emitters on the body mesh, particles sample the camera colour at their position, and person inpainting removes the real body before the particles are composited on top.
works.technique_zh: 三维人体追踪驱动附着在人体网格上的粒子发射器，粒子在所在位置采样摄像头颜色，同时用人像修补把真实身体抹掉，再把粒子合成上去。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe pose or a Lens Studio body template to emit particles from each joint, coloured by the camera pixel beneath them, over a blurred background. Twist: particles scatter when the person moves fast and regroup when they stand still.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 姿态或 Lens Studio 人体模板，从每个关节发射粒子，粒子颜色取自其下方的摄像头像素，背景做模糊处理；变体：人快速移动时粒子四散，静止时再重新聚拢。

works.title: PS1 Hagrid in AR
works.description: A nostalgic level built on top of his real office: low-poly Hagrid and other props from the PlayStation 1 Harry Potter games stand along a path, complete with wobbly vertices and warped textures.
works.description_zh: 在他真实办公室上搭建的一段怀旧关卡：PlayStation 1 版《哈利·波特》里的低多边形海格和各种道具沿着一条路径排开，连顶点抖动和贴图扭曲都原样再现。
works.idea_en: Overlay a retro video-game level, glitches included, on a real place.
works.idea_zh: 把一段连同瑕疵一起复刻的复古游戏关卡叠加到真实地点上。
works.technique: The office was 3D-scanned with Polycam and turned into a Custom Landmarker for alignment; custom shaders fake PS1 artefacts such as affine texture sampling and vertex snapping.
works.technique_zh: 先用 Polycam 三维扫描办公室，再做成 Custom Landmarker 来对齐场景；自定义着色器模拟 PS1 的仿射贴图采样和顶点抖动等画面瑕疵。
works.exercise_en: Scan a school corridor with Polycam, align a WebXR or Lens Studio scene to it and place three low-poly characters along the path. Twist: add a vertex-snapping shader so everything wobbles like a 1990s console.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Polycam 扫描学校走廊，在 WebXR 或 Lens Studio 里把场景对齐上去，沿路摆放三个低多边形角色；变体：加一个顶点吸附着色器，让一切像 90 年代游戏机那样抖动。

video.video_title: PS1 Graphics - Harry Potter

works.title: Palm-Through Interaction
works.description: Wearing an AR headset, you hold up your palm so a distant lamp or fan appears through it, then tap your own palm like a phone screen to control that device.
works.description_zh: 戴着 AR 头显举起手掌，让远处的台灯或风扇“透过”掌心出现，再像点手机屏幕一样点自己的掌心来控制它。
works.idea_en: Your palm becomes a remote touchscreen aimed at whatever you look at through it.
works.idea_zh: 手掌变成一块遥控触摸屏，对准的就是你透过它看到的东西。
works.technique: Tracks the hand in the AR headset, casts a ray through the palm to select the IoT device behind it, and maps touches on the palm to that device's UI, giving natural haptic feedback.
works.technique_zh: 在 AR 头显中追踪手部，从掌心发出射线选中其后的物联网设备，并把在掌心的触碰映射为该设备的界面操作，从而获得自然的触觉反馈。
works.exercise_en: Prototype with a phone: when the camera sees a printed marker on a lamp, show that lamp's controls; students then 'press' the buttons drawn on their own palm while a partner switches the lamp. Twist: use the back of the hand for a second device.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机做原型：相机识别到台灯上的打印标记时显示它的控制按钮，学生在自己掌心画出的按钮上“按下”，同伴负责开关台灯；变体：用手背控制第二个设备。

video.video_title: A Palm-Through Interaction Technique

works.title: Passaggi // Presenze
works.description: A site-specific installation made with Lily Hassioti: every time someone crosses a doorway the note of a synthesiser changes and their image is archived, while a camera maps where people stand so the crowd composes sound and visuals together.
works.description_zh: 与 Lily Hassioti 合作的特定场域装置：每当有人穿过门口，合成器的音符就会改变，其影像也被存档；摄像头同时标出人们站的位置，让人群一起创作声音和影像。
works.idea_en: Doorways and footsteps become the score of a room.
works.idea_zh: 门口和脚步成为一个房间的乐谱。
works.technique: Laser proximity sensors at the doors detect passages, and a machine-learning camera tracker maps visitor positions to sound parameters and projected visuals.
works.technique_zh: 门口的激光测距传感器检测通过，机器学习摄像头追踪把观众位置映射为声音参数和投影影像。
works.exercise_en: Put a phone camera over a classroom door and use a simple motion detector to change a chord every time someone walks through. Twist: record a snapshot of each passer and project the growing collage.
works.exercise_zh: 在教室门上方放一部手机摄像头，用简单的动作检测，每当有人走过就换一个和弦；变体：拍下每位通过者的快照，并投影不断增长的拼贴。

video.video_title: Passaggi//Presenze

works.title: Peridot
works.description: An AR virtual pet game where each 'Dot' is a unique creature that understands the real ground, grass, water and sand around you and plays fetch or digs in them.
works.idea_zh: 一只能识别草地、水面和沙地的AR电子宠物，和真实环境玩耍。

video.video_title: Peridot | Available Now | Global Launch Trailer

works.technique: Semantic segmentation labels ground pixels as grass, water, sand and so on, and the pet's behavior tree picks actions such as digging or swimming based on the class under it.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lightship 语义分割或简单的颜色判断区分草地和地板，让 AR 宠物在草地上打滚、在地板上走路；变体：把宠物放在水边时它会喝水。
works.description_zh: 一款 AR 虚拟宠物游戏，每只“Dot”都是独一无二的生物，它能理解你周围真实的地面、草地、水面和沙地，并在其中玩接球或挖土。
works.idea_en: An AR pet that recognizes grass, water and sand and plays with the real environment.
works.technique_zh: 语义分割把地面像素标注为草地、水面、沙地等类别，宠物的行为树再根据脚下的类别选择挖掘、游泳等动作。
works.exercise_en: Tell grass from floor with Lightship semantic segmentation or a simple color check, and make an AR pet roll on the grass and walk on the floor. Twist: when the pet is placed by water, it takes a drink.

works.title: Photorythms
works.description: A computational portrait series and public installation: visitors sit in front of a camera and see their face detected and augmented live with rhythmic generative forms, making portraits more expressive than a photo.
works.description_zh: 一组计算式肖像和公共装置：观众坐在摄像头前，看到自己的脸被实时识别并叠加有节奏的生成图形，让肖像比照片更有表现力。
works.idea_en: Augment a portrait with rhythms that follow the face, not filters that hide it.
works.idea_zh: 用跟随面孔的节奏来增强肖像，而不是用滤镜遮住它。
works.technique: Face detection finds facial landmarks in a live camera image, and generative forms are drawn from those points in real time.
works.technique_zh: 人脸检测在实时画面中找到面部关键点，再以这些点为基础实时绘制生成图形。
works.exercise_en: Build a p5.js face-mesh sketch that draws concentric rhythmic lines from each eye and the mouth. Twist: the rhythm speeds up when the sitter smiles.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 的人脸网格做一个草图，从双眼和嘴部画出同心的节奏线条；变体：被拍者微笑时节奏加快。

video.video_title: Photorythms - a computational art-based inquiry of portrait photography

works.title: Piano piano
works.description: A musical and visual duet: babx plays the piano while Adrien Mondot juggles and plays live images, and the piano and both performers are immersed in a space of moving projected marks.
works.description_zh: 一场音乐与影像的双人演出：babx 弹钢琴，Adrien Mondot 抛接杂耍并现场演奏影像，钢琴和两位表演者都浸没在投影出的流动笔触里。
works.idea_en: Music you can see: piano notes and juggled balls turn into brushstrokes in space.
works.idea_zh: 看得见的音乐：钢琴音符和被抛起的球变成空间里的笔触。
works.technique: Projection surrounds the stage and is generated live by Mondot's own software, likely reacting to the piano's sound and to Mondot's juggling and hand gestures.
works.technique_zh: 投影包围整个舞台，由 Mondot 自己的软件实时生成，很可能对钢琴声音以及他的抛接和手势作出反应。
works.exercise_en: Connect a MIDI keyboard (or microphone pitch detection) to a p5.js sketch so each note leaves a brushstroke whose height follows its pitch, project it behind the player, and perform a two-minute piece. Twist: add a second performer who throws a ball and catches strokes with it through webcam tracking.
works.exercise_zh: 把 MIDI 键盘（或麦克风音高检测）接到 p5.js，让每个音符留下一道笔触，高度随音高变化，投到演奏者身后，演一段 2 分钟的曲子。变体：加入第二位表演者抛球，通过摄像头追踪用球“接住”笔触。

video.video_title: Piano piano ⧸ Teaser

works.title: Pillow – Mixed Reality in Bed
works.description: A Quest mixed-reality app designed to be used lying in bed, with games, journaling and meditation projected over the ceiling and room.
works.idea_zh: 专为躺在床上设计的混合现实应用。

video.video_title: Pillow - Mixed Reality in Bed (Trailer)

works.technique: The ceiling is identified from room setup or plane classification, and UI and game content are placed on it so they face a user lying down, with input adapted to a supine posture.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 检测天花板（朝下的平面），在上面显示一个躺着玩的冥想呼吸动画；变体：用手机麦克风检测呼吸节奏控制动画。
works.description_zh: 一款专为躺在床上使用而设计的 Quest 混合现实应用，把游戏、日记和冥想投射到天花板和房间中。
works.idea_en: A mixed-reality app designed for lying in bed.
works.technique_zh: 通过房间设置或平面分类识别天花板，把界面和游戏内容放在天花板上，使其朝向躺着的用户，输入方式也针对仰卧姿势做了调整。
works.exercise_en: Detect the ceiling (a downward-facing plane) with AR Foundation and display a breathing-meditation animation on it to use while lying down. Twist: control the animation with your breathing rhythm, picked up by the phone microphone.

works.title: Pixel Sorting
works.description: Bright spans of each frame melt into long streaks as pixels are sorted by brightness in real time, turning a 3D scene into moving glitch art.
works.description_zh: 每一帧里的亮部被按亮度排序，拉成长长的条纹，把三维场景变成流动的故障艺术。
works.idea_en: A classic still-image glitch, made fast enough to run on live video.
works.idea_zh: 把经典的静态图像故障效果，做到能在实时画面上运行。
works.technique: A compute shader masks pixels by a luminance threshold, finds contiguous spans per row or column, and sorts each span on the GPU before compositing it back over the frame.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器先按亮度阈值选出像素，在每行或每列里找出连续片段，再在 GPU 上对每段排序，最后合成回画面。
works.exercise_en: Run the pixel-sort pass on the passthrough camera image of a phone AR app (AR Foundation camera background + a URP renderer feature) so the real street streaks when the user taps. Twist: sort only pixels inside the people-segmentation mask.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 应用的摄像头画面上（AR Foundation 摄像头背景 + URP 渲染器特性）运行像素排序，让用户点击时真实街景被拉成条纹。变体：只对人像分割蒙版内的像素排序。

video.video_title: I Tried Sorting Pixels

works.title: Polygon Studio
works.description: An open-source low-poly 3D modelling tool for AR glasses: you pinch and drag vertices with your fingers to build meshes in the air, walk around them, model together with friends in a shared session, and export the result as a sequence of QR codes.
works.description_zh: 一个面向 AR 眼镜的开源低多边形建模工具：用手指捏住并拖动顶点，在空中搭出网格，可以绕着作品走动，也能和朋友在共享会话里一起建模，最后把模型导出成一串二维码。
works.idea_en: Sculpt 3D models with your bare hands in the room, together with friends.
works.idea_zh: 徒手在房间里和朋友一起捏出三维模型。
works.technique: Spectacles hand tracking detects pinch gestures that grab and move mesh vertices, the mesh is rebuilt in real time with a MeshBuilder, the scene is synced via Snap's connected-lens multiplayer, and the model data is encoded into QR codes for export.
works.technique_zh: Spectacles 的手部追踪识别捏合手势来抓取和移动网格顶点，用 MeshBuilder 实时重建网格，通过 Snap 的联机 Lens 同步多人场景，并把模型数据编码成二维码导出。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR or Quest hand-tracking scene where pinching creates a point in the air and every three points form a triangle. Twist: let two people add points to the same shared shape.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 Quest 手部追踪做一个场景：捏一下就在空中生成一个点，每三个点连成一个三角面；变体：让两个人同时往同一个共享形体里加点。

video.video_title: Polygon Studio Connected - 3D Modeling with your hands (Spectacles 🕶️)

works.title: Portals in the liquid physics AR puzzle
works.description: Floating portal pairs are added to the AR liquid game; water poured into one ring pours out of another across the room, and hands can reach through the portals too.
works.description_zh: 在 AR 液体游戏中加入成对的漂浮传送门：倒进一个圆环的水会从房间另一头的圆环流出，手也能穿过传送门。
works.idea_en: Portals make space itself a puzzle piece in your own room.
works.idea_zh: 传送门让空间本身成为你房间里的一块拼图。
works.technique: Render-to-texture portal cameras (based on Tom Goethals' VR portal code) teleport fluid particles and hand colliders between linked transforms.
works.technique_zh: 用渲染到纹理的传送门相机（基于 Tom Goethals 的 VR 传送门代码），在两个相连的变换之间传送流体粒子和手部碰撞体。
works.exercise_en: Create two linked portal rings in AR Foundation and teleport any ball that enters one to the other with preserved velocity. Twist: place one portal on the ceiling so gravity keeps the ball looping.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 里做一对相连的传送门圆环，进入其中一个的小球会保持速度从另一个出来；变体：把一个传送门贴在天花板上，让小球在重力下无限循环。

video.video_title: Adding Portals to my liquid physics AR puzzle game

works.title: Prada Beauty 'Rethinking Beauty' AR filter
works.description: As Prada Beauty's Global Creative E-Makeup Artist, Alpha designed a three-mode Instagram AR filter with FFFACE.ME that layers futuristic e-makeup on the user's face.
works.idea_zh: 为奢侈品美妆设计的三种模式数字妆容滤镜。

video.video_title: FFFACE.ME x Prada Beauty | AR Filter in collaboration with Ines Alpha

works.technique: A multi-mode face filter switches between makeup looks via tap or picker UI, each combining face-mesh textures, attached 3D pieces and animated shaders.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个有三种模式的人脸滤镜，点击屏幕在模式间切换，每种模式代表一种对“未来妆容”的理解；变体：模式切换由眨眼触发。
works.description_zh: 作为 Prada Beauty 的全球创意数字化妆师，Alpha 与 FFFACE.ME 合作设计了一款拥有三种模式的 Instagram AR 滤镜，在用户脸上叠加未来感的数字妆容。
works.idea_en: A digital makeup filter with three modes, designed for a luxury beauty brand.
works.technique_zh: 一个多模式人脸滤镜，通过点击或选择器界面在不同妆容之间切换，每种妆容都组合了面部网格纹理、附着的 3D 部件和动画着色器。
works.exercise_en: Make a face filter with three modes that you switch between by tapping the screen, each mode expressing a different idea of 'future makeup'. Twist: trigger the mode switch with a blink.

works.title: Product as Platform
works.description: A concept for AR glasses in which physical objects carry their own apps: pick up a film camera and its controls and tips appear anchored to it, selected by gaze-and-pinch or by virtual buttons on the object's hard surfaces.
works.description_zh: AR 眼镜概念：实体物品自带“应用”。拿起一台胶片相机，它的控制项和使用提示就锚定在机身上，用“注视+捏合”或贴在物体硬表面上的虚拟按钮来操作。
works.idea_en: Every object you own could have an app living inside it.
works.idea_zh: 你拥有的每件物品，都可以住着一个自己的应用。
works.technique: Likely a passthrough prototype in which each product is recognised and tracked so a small UI stays attached to it, using pinch-and-gaze selection or virtual buttons backed by the object's real surfaces.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是透视式原型：识别并追踪每件商品，让小界面始终附着在物体上，通过注视+捏合或以物体真实表面为依托的虚拟按钮来选择。
works.exercise_en: Choose one classroom object and design its 'app': anchor three AR controls to it with an image marker that only appear when the user touches or looks at it. Twist: give the object a personality so its app is quirky rather than useful.
works.exercise_zh: 选一件教室里的物品，为它设计“应用”：用图像标记把三个 AR 控件锚定在物品上，只有被触摸或注视时才出现；变体：给物品一个性格，让它的应用古灵精怪而不是实用。

video.video_title: Could AR glasses let us "install" apps onto any object? Hoping those @apple rumors prove true 🤞 https://t.co/KiNGBkCDYS

works.title: Pulling Products off the Web (Spatial Commerce)
works.description: A Vision Pro spatial-commerce concept: while browsing a store's web page, the shopper pinches a product and pulls a full-size 3D demo out of the page into the room.
works.description_zh: Vision Pro 空间商务概念：浏览店铺网页时，购物者捏住一件商品，把全尺寸的 3D 演示直接从网页里拉进房间。
works.idea_en: The web page becomes a doorway that products can be pulled through.
works.idea_zh: 网页变成一道门，商品可以从里面被拉出来。
works.technique: A concept video likely simulating visionOS, where a 3D model embedded in the page is grabbed with a look-and-pinch gesture and dropped as a world-anchored object.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是模拟 visionOS 的概念视频：网页中嵌入的 3D 模型被“注视+捏合”抓起，放到房间里成为锚定在空间中的物体。
works.exercise_en: Make a web page with a 3D product that jumps into WebXR AR when the user drags it off the page. Twist: products can be pushed back into the page to 'return' them.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个带 3D 商品的网页，用户把商品拖出页面时就进入 WebXR AR 模式；变体：把商品推回网页就算“退货”。

video.video_title:
Exploring Spatial Commerce opportunities @Shopify with Vision Pro on the horizon…

It's going to be fun pulling product demos right off the webpage and into the room 🤏✨🤯 https://t.co/QbDiCzPfxj

works.title: REfract
works.description: A dancer shares the stage with avatars in a projected digital desert full of floating letters; her motion-captured body drives the avatars, which gradually evolve and negotiate agency with her.
works.description_zh: 舞者与化身同台，身后是漂浮着字母的投影数字沙漠；她被动作捕捉的身体驱动这些化身，而化身逐渐演化，与她争夺主导权。
works.idea_en: A dancer and her avatars share one body and argue over who leads.
works.idea_zh: 舞者与她的化身共用一个身体，争论谁来领舞。
works.technique: Motion-capture data from the dancer is streamed into a game engine that renders the avatars and desert live on a large screen behind her (likely Unity or Unreal with an inertial or AI mocap system).
works.technique_zh: 舞者的动作捕捉数据实时传入游戏引擎，在她身后的大屏上即时渲染化身和沙漠（很可能是 Unity 或 Unreal 搭配惯性或 AI 动捕系统）。
works.exercise_en: Drive a free avatar in a browser with webcam pose tracking and project it behind a dancer. Twist: every 30 seconds give the avatar one movement the dancer must copy instead of the other way round.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头姿态追踪在浏览器里驱动一个免费化身，并投在舞者身后；变体：每 30 秒让化身做一个动作，改由舞者模仿化身。

video.video_title: REfract_rehearsal at Spatial Storytelling stage_0719

works.title: Re-Vision (The Treasury, Petra)
works.description: Made for the first Petra Light Festival in Jordan, this mapping plays across the rock-cut facade of the Treasury (Al-Khazneh) with abstract light that traces its carved columns and reliefs without covering its heritage with figurative content.
works.description_zh: 为约旦首届佩特拉灯光节创作，投影在从岩石中凿出的卡兹尼神殿（宝库）立面上，用抽象的光勾勒雕刻出的柱子和浮雕，而不是用具象内容盖住这处遗产。
works.idea_en: On a sacred or heritage site, restraint is part of the design: light that only traces what is already there respects the place more than a new story would.
works.idea_zh: 在神圣或遗产场所，克制本身就是设计的一部分：只勾勒原有结构的光，比讲一个新故事更尊重这个地方。
works.technique: A detailed 3D model of the carved facade is used to generate edge-following, abstract animations that are projected in alignment with the stone.
works.technique_zh: 利用雕刻立面的精细三维模型，生成沿着边缘流动的抽象动画，再与石面对齐投影。
works.exercise_en: Choose a historic detail (a carved door, a statue) and design an AR layer in Lens Studio that only outlines and animates its existing edges in light. Twist: the light slowly fades if the viewer comes too close, asking for respect.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个历史细节（雕花门、雕像），在 Lens Studio 里设计一层只勾勒并让已有边缘发光流动的 AR；变体：观众靠得太近时光会慢慢消失，提醒保持敬意。

video.video_title: Re-Vision, A projection mapping on The Treasury at Petra, Jordan for Petra Light Festival

works.title: Real-Time AR Effect on Cat
works.description: Tracks his pet cat in real time and wraps it in animated AR effects that follow the animal as it moves.
works.idea_zh: 实时追踪家猫，给它身上叠加跟随的 AR 特效。

video.video_title: Real-time AR Effect on Cat

works.technique: An animal detection or segmentation model tracks the cat's bounding box or mask in real time, and particle effects are emitted from its position in screen or world space.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Object Detection（或 YOLO）在网页中识别猫或宠物玩偶，在它周围生成跟随的粒子光环；变体：动物移动越快，特效越夸张。
works.description_zh: 实时追踪他家的猫，用动态 AR 特效把它包裹起来，特效会跟随猫的移动。
works.idea_en: Track a house cat in real time and wrap it in AR effects that follow it around.
works.technique_zh: 动物检测或分割模型实时追踪猫的边界框或遮罩，粒子特效从它在屏幕空间或世界空间中的位置发射出来。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Object Detection (or YOLO) on a web page to recognize a cat or a stuffed toy animal, and generate a halo of particles that follows it. Twist: the faster the animal moves, the more exaggerated the effect.

works.title: Reality Rifts
works.description: Physical contraptions are built with a key part missing, such as a water wheel that turns under a tap with no water, yet they still respond plausibly when used, so people fill in the missing part in their imagination and feel a sense of wonder.
works.description_zh: 一些实体装置故意缺少关键部件，比如水龙头下没有水、水车却照样转动，但使用时它们的反应依然合理，于是人们在想象中补全缺失的部分，产生一种奇妙感。
works.idea_en: Remove the cause but keep the effect, and people imagine the rest.
works.idea_zh: 去掉原因、保留结果，人们会自己想象出其余部分。
works.technique: Hidden sensors track the user's action (for example a tracked tap handle) and embedded actuators reproduce the plausible outcome by simulating the missing component's dynamics.
works.technique_zh: 隐藏的传感器追踪用户的动作（例如被追踪的水龙头把手），内置执行器模拟缺失部件的动态，再现合理的结果。
works.exercise_en: Build a prototype in which turning a dry tap spins a paper water wheel through a hidden servo, and let classmates try it without explanation. Twist: add a phone AR view that shows the imagined water to only some of them.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个原型：拧动一个没有水的龙头，隐藏的舵机就让纸水车转起来，不加解释地让同学们试一试。变体：加一个手机 AR 视图，只让其中一部分人看到想象中的水。

video.video_title: [CHI 2023] Reality Rifts: Wonder-ful Interfaces by Disrupting Perceptual Causality

works.title: RealityCanvas
works.description: Scribble animation effects such as motion lines, smoke and speed lines onto real moving people and objects in AR, and they follow and react to the motion like a live cartoon.
works.idea_zh: 给真实世界加漫画式速度线和烟雾特效，跟着真人真物实时动起来。

video.video_title: [UIST 2023] RealityCanvas: Augmented Reality Sketching for Embedded and Responsive Scribble ...

works.technique: ARKit body tracking and object tracking give per-frame positions of moving targets, and hand-drawn strokes are attached to those points and animated with rules (trail, follow, emit) to produce cartoon effects.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 追踪同学的手腕或脚踝，让用户在画面上手绘一条速度线或一团烟，并将其绑定到关节随运动播放；变体：给运动的日常物品（开门、倒水）配上漫画音效字。
works.description_zh: 在 AR 中为真实移动的人和物体随手画上动画效果，比如运动线、烟雾和速度线，它们会像实时卡通一样跟随并回应运动。
works.idea_en: Add comic-style speed lines and smoke to the real world, moving live with real people and objects.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 身体追踪和物体追踪逐帧给出运动目标的位置，手绘笔画被附着到这些点上，并按规则（拖尾、跟随、发射）进行动画，产生卡通效果。
works.exercise_en: Track a classmate's wrist or ankle with MediaPipe Pose, let the user draw a speed line or a puff of smoke on screen, and bind it to the joint so it plays with the motion. Twist: add comic sound-effect lettering to everyday objects in motion (a door opening, water pouring).

works.title: RealityReplay
works.description: MR detects changes that happened in the room while you were not looking and replays them in place, e.g. showing who moved an object.
works.idea_zh: 在原地回放你没注意到的变化，看见刚刚发生过什么。

video.video_title: RealityReplay: Detecting and Replaying Temporal Changes In Situ using Mixed Reality

works.technique: The MR system keeps a 3D model of the room, detects geometric and appearance changes that happened outside the user's field of view, and replays the recorded change events in place as animated reconstructions.
works.exercise_zh: 用固定在角落的手机摄像头拍桌面，通过帧差检测物体被移动的时刻，并把这一段录像在 AR 中叠加回原位置回放；变体：只给用户提示“这里变了”，让他们猜发生了什么再揭晓。
works.description_zh: 混合现实系统检测你没在看的时候房间里发生的变化，并在原地回放，例如显示是谁挪动了某个物体。
works.idea_en: Replay the changes you missed right where they happened, so you can see what just took place.
works.technique_zh: 混合现实系统维护房间的 3D 模型，检测发生在用户视野之外的几何与外观变化，并在原地以动画重建的形式回放记录下来的变化事件。
works.exercise_en: Film a tabletop with a phone camera fixed in a corner, detect the moment an object is moved using frame differencing, and replay that clip in AR overlaid at its original location. Twist: only tell users 'something changed here', let them guess what happened, then reveal it.

works.title: RetroSphere
works.description: An IMWUT/UbiComp 2023 system with Google researchers: passive, battery-free controllers covered in retroreflective spheres are tracked in 3D by a self-contained AR headset.
works.description_zh: 与 Google 研究者合作的 IMWUT/UbiComp 2023 系统：表面覆盖回射小球的无源、无电池控制器，可以被一体式 AR 头显进行 3D 追踪。
works.idea_en: Tracked AR input does not need electronics: shiny passive markers are enough.
works.idea_zh: 可追踪的 AR 输入不一定需要电子元件：无源反光标记就够了。
works.technique: Near-infrared illumination makes the retroreflective spheres appear as bright blobs to the headset's cameras, and stereo triangulation recovers their 3D positions.
works.technique_zh: 近红外照明让回射小球在头显相机中呈现为亮点，再通过双目三角测量恢复它们的三维位置。
works.exercise_en: Tape retroreflective stickers to a stick and track the bright spots with a phone camera and flashlight in a browser. Twist: turn the stick into a light saber or paintbrush.
works.exercise_zh: 在一根棍子上贴回射贴纸，在浏览器里用手机摄像头和闪光灯追踪亮点。变体：把它变成光剑或画笔。

video.video_title: RetroSphere: Self-Contained Passive 3D Controller Tracking for Augmented Reality

works.title: Running AR videos through NeRF and Gaussian splatting
works.description: Phone videos that already contain AR content are fed to NeRF and Gaussian-splatting pipelines, so the virtual objects become part of a reconstructed 3D scene that can be flown through.
works.description_zh: 把已经含有 AR 内容的手机视频送进 NeRF 和高斯泼溅流程，虚拟物体就成了重建三维场景的一部分，可以在其中自由飞行浏览。
works.idea_en: Bake AR into reality: once reconstructed, the virtual and the real are the same material.
works.idea_zh: 把 AR 烘焙进现实：一旦重建，虚拟与真实就是同一种材料。
works.technique: Screen recordings of AR sessions are treated as multi-view captures; structure-from-motion recovers camera poses and a radiance field or splat model is trained on the composited frames.
works.technique_zh: 把 AR 录屏当作多视角拍摄，运动恢复结构求出相机位姿，再用合成后的帧训练辐射场或泼溅模型。
works.exercise_en: Record a slow orbit around an AR object on a table, train a Gaussian splat from the video with a free app, and view the result in a web viewer. Twist: place a second AR object inside the splat and record again, stacking layers of fake reality.
works.exercise_zh: 绕着桌上的 AR 物体慢慢录一圈，用免费应用从视频训练高斯泼溅，在网页查看器中观看。变体：在泼溅里再放一个 AR 物体重录，一层层叠加虚假的现实。

video.video_title:
Taking “AR” videos and running them through a NeRF pipeline is a fun thing to do. Turns out things look even more 🔥 with Gaussian Splatting.

works.title: SNeRG in Unity
works.description: A Sparse Neural Radiance Grid scene is raymarched inside Unity, including in stereo on a PC VR headset, so a captured neural scene can be walked around.
works.description_zh: 一个稀疏神经辐射网格（SNeRG）场景在 Unity 中通过光线步进渲染，也能在 PC VR 头显上以双目方式运行，让人可以在捕捉到的神经场景中走动。
works.idea_en: Raymarch a neural capture like a volume texture and it becomes a place you can stand in.
works.idea_zh: 像渲染体积纹理一样对神经捕捉做光线步进，它就成为一个人可以站在其中的地方。
works.technique: The viewer loads SNeRG's sparse 3D texture atlas and a small deferred MLP; a raymarching shader accumulates density and features, then evaluates the network per pixel, with manual depth testing for single-pass stereo.
works.technique_zh: 查看器加载 SNeRG 的稀疏三维纹理图集和一个小型延迟 MLP；光线步进着色器累积密度和特征，再逐像素计算网络，并为单通道立体渲染做手动深度测试。
works.exercise_en: Place a SNeRG scene inside a portal frame in AR so the neural room is only visible through the doorway. Twist: fade the grid in voxel by voxel as the user approaches.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一个 SNeRG 场景放进传送门框里，只能通过门洞看到这个神经房间。变体：用户靠近时，让网格一块体素一块体素地显现。

works.title: Sculpting Zero G Liquid in AR
works.description: Floating blobs of weightless liquid hang in the room and can be pushed and shaped with the hands, then stay where they are left like soft clay.
works.description_zh: 失重的液体团悬浮在房间中，可以用双手推挤塑形，放手后会像软黏土一样停在原处。
works.idea_en: Turn a fluid simulation into a sculpting material by making it forget to flow.
works.idea_zh: 让流体“忘记流动”，模拟就变成了雕塑材料。
works.technique: A custom compute shader damps particle velocity in a zero-gravity fluid sim so hand-tracked pushes leave persistent shapes.
works.technique_zh: 用自定义 compute shader 对零重力流体模拟中的粒子速度做阻尼，使手部推动留下持久的形状。
works.exercise_en: Spawn a cloud of particles in AR with no gravity and strong damping; let the hand (or phone position) push particles away within a radius. Twist: slowly restore gravity over one minute so the sculpture melts.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中生成一团没有重力、阻尼很强的粒子，让手（或手机位置）推开一定半径内的粒子；变体：一分钟内逐渐恢复重力，让雕塑慢慢融化。

video.video_title: Sculpting Zero G Liquid in AR

works.title: Self Absorbed
works.description: The artist moves in front of a large screen and floats through an AI-generated stream of images and sounds made from twenty years of his own photos and recordings, steering it only with his body.
works.description_zh: 艺术家在大屏幕前移动，只用身体在一条 AI 生成的影像和声音之流中漂游，素材来自他二十年来的照片和录音。
works.idea_en: Navigate an AI's memory of your life with your body, not a mouse.
works.idea_zh: 用身体而不是鼠标，在 AI 对你人生的“记忆”里航行。
works.technique: An unsupervised model trained on how the artist moves encodes live body tracking into a low-dimensional vector that steers the latent space of image (StyleGAN) and sound models trained on his personal archive.
works.technique_zh: 一个用艺术家自身动作训练的无监督模型，把实时身体追踪编码成低维向量，再用它驾驭以其个人档案训练的图像（StyleGAN）和声音模型的潜空间。
works.exercise_en: Map three body features from a webcam pose model (arm spread, height, lean) to sliders that blend between a small set of your own photos in a web page. Twist: swap the photo set for a classmate's and see if movement still feels personal.
works.exercise_zh: 从摄像头姿态模型提取三个身体特征（手臂张开、高度、倾斜），映射成网页滑块，在你自己的几张照片之间混合；变体：换成同学的照片，看动作是否仍然“属于你”。

video.video_title: Self Absorbed (rough edit of Machine Agencies residency, 12 May 2023)

works.title: ShadowClones
works.description: A single user controls several virtual bodies seen from multiple viewpoints; shadow-like cues keep track of where each body is so they can coordinate actions across perspectives.
works.idea_zh: 一个人分身成多个影子般的身体，并在多视角中协调它们。

video.video_title: ShadowClones [AHs' 23]

works.technique: Renders several avatar copies driven by one tracked body and overlays shadow projections of each clone to preserve body-space coordination across views.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机AR中放置三个会复制你动作的虚拟分身（用人体骨骼追踪），让你摆姿势让三个分身同时拍到目标；变化：每个分身动作延迟不同。
works.description_zh: 一个人同时操控多个虚拟身体，并从多个视角观看它们；影子般的提示标出每个身体的位置，让用户能在不同视角之间协调动作。
works.idea_en: One person splits into several shadow-like bodies and coordinates them across multiple viewpoints.
works.technique_zh: 由一个被追踪的身体驱动多个化身副本的渲染，并为每个分身叠加影子投影，以便在不同视角之间保持身体与空间的协调。
works.exercise_en: Place three virtual clones in phone AR that copy your movements using body skeleton tracking, and pose so that all three clones hit a target at the same moment. Twist: give each clone a different motion delay.

works.title: Shell Texturing Fur
works.description: Grass-like fur grows out of simple meshes and sways, made of many stacked transparent shells instead of individual hair geometry.
works.description_zh: 简单网格上长出像草一样的毛发并随风摆动；它不是一根根毛的几何体，而是许多层叠的半透明外壳。
works.idea_en: Stack enough thin slices and a flat surface becomes fuzzy volume.
works.idea_zh: 叠够多的薄层，平面就变成毛茸茸的体积。
works.technique: The mesh is drawn N times, each shell pushed out along the normal; a hashed noise texture decides per-strand height, and shells discard pixels above that height, with displacement for gravity and wind.
works.technique_zh: 把网格绘制 N 次，每一层沿法线向外推；用哈希噪声纹理决定每根毛的高度，高于该高度的像素被丢弃，再加上重力和风的位移。
works.exercise_en: Apply the shell-fur shader to a real object scanned with the phone (Object Capture or LiDAR mesh) and place it back in AR, so a real mug becomes furry. Twist: make the fur flatten where the user touches the screen.
works.exercise_zh: 把毛发外壳着色器用到手机扫描的真实物体上（Object Capture 或 LiDAR 网格），再放回 AR 场景，让一只真实的杯子长毛。变体：手指在屏幕上按到的地方，毛被压平。

video.video_title: How Do Games Render Fur?

works.title: Shopping with Friends (SharePlay concept)
works.description: A Vision Pro concept in which a friend joins via FaceTime as a floating video tile and both see the same miniature tent and campsite on the coffee table while deciding what to buy.
works.description_zh: Vision Pro 概念：朋友通过 FaceTime 以悬浮视频窗口加入，两人同时看到茶几上同一个迷你帐篷和露营场景，一起商量买什么。
works.idea_en: Bring the fun of shopping with friends into shared AR.
works.idea_zh: 把和朋友一起逛街的乐趣带进共享 AR。
works.technique: Likely built on visionOS SharePlay, which syncs the same 3D product scene between participants while the FaceTime call runs beside it.
works.technique_zh: 很可能基于 visionOS 的 SharePlay，在参与者之间同步同一个 3D 商品场景，旁边同时进行 FaceTime 通话。
works.exercise_en: Build a two-phone shared AR scene where both users see and rotate the same product and then vote on it. Twist: one user can only point and the other can only speak.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个双手机共享 AR 场景，两人看到并能旋转同一件商品，最后投票决定；变体：一个人只能指，另一个人只能说。

Shopping with friends IRL is a great vibe, but challenging to replicate online. 👯

works.title: Simulating the Entire Ocean
works.description: An endless ocean surface rolls under a moving camera, with foam, reflections and subsurface colour, built up from simple sine waves to an FFT spectrum.
works.description_zh: 镜头下是无边的海面，带着泡沫、反射和次表面颜色；效果从简单的正弦波一步步做到 FFT 频谱海洋。
works.idea_en: Real oceans are sums of thousands of waves, and the GPU can add them up every frame.
works.idea_zh: 真实海洋是成千上万个波的叠加，GPU 每帧都能把它们算出来。
works.technique: A JONSWAP wave spectrum is evolved in frequency space and inverse-FFT'd in compute shaders into displacement and normal maps, which a physically based water shader renders with foam from the Jacobian.
works.technique_zh: 在频域里演化 JONSWAP 海浪谱，用计算着色器做逆 FFT 得到位移和法线贴图，再由基于物理的水体着色器渲染，并用雅可比行列式生成泡沫。
works.exercise_en: Place a small patch of the repo's FFT ocean inside a floor portal in AR (AR Foundation plane + stencil mask) so the room floor opens onto a sea. Twist: drive wind speed from the phone microphone level.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 里把仓库的 FFT 海洋放进地面上的一个传送门（AR Foundation 平面 + 模板遮罩），让房间地板打开一片海。变体：用手机麦克风音量控制风速。

video.video_title: I Tried Simulating The Entire Ocean

works.title: Sound Mirrors
works.description: A large sound sculpture and projection in King's Lynn that played back young people's reflections on their identity and their town, inviting passers-by to stop and listen.
works.description_zh: 金斯林的一件大型声音雕塑与投影作品，播放年轻人对自身身份和家乡的感想，邀请路人驻足聆听。
works.idea_en: A town listens to its young people through a giant ear and a projected image.
works.idea_zh: 一座小镇通过一只巨大的“耳朵”和投影，倾听它的年轻人。
works.technique: A physical sound-mirror structure focuses recorded voices toward listeners while projected visuals on nearby surfaces show the words and imagery made in workshops.
works.technique_zh: 实体的声音反射结构把录制的人声聚向听众，附近表面的投影则展示工作坊中创作的文字和图像。
works.exercise_en: Record classmates answering 'what does this place sound like?', then play the clips from a parabolic umbrella so only one person at a time can hear them. Twist: project the transcript only when someone is standing at the listening spot.
works.exercise_zh: 录下同学回答“这个地方听起来像什么？”，再用抛物面雨伞播放，让同一时间只有一个人能听到；变体：只有当有人站在聆听点时，才投影出文字稿。

video.video_title: Collusion presents // SOUND MIRRORS - documentary

works.title: SplatVFX: 3D Gaussian Splatting in VFX Graph
works.description: A photoreal 3D scene captured with Gaussian Splatting renders in Unity as millions of soft splats, and can be scattered like particles.
works.description_zh: 用高斯泼溅采集的写实三维场景在 Unity 中以数百万个柔和的泼溅点渲染，还可以像粒子一样被打散。
works.idea_en: A photoreal capture that is also a particle system.
works.idea_zh: 一个写实采集，同时也是一个粒子系统。
works.technique: Gaussian splat data (position, scale, rotation, color) is loaded into buffers and VFX Graph draws each splat as an oriented, alpha-blended quad sorted by depth.
works.technique_zh: 把高斯泼溅数据（位置、缩放、旋转、颜色）载入缓冲区，VFX Graph 把每个泼溅画成有朝向、半透明的面片并按深度排序。
works.exercise_en: Capture a splat of an object with a phone app (Polycam or Luma), render it next to the real object in AR Foundation, and make it dissolve when touched. Twist: swap the real object and its splat and ask viewers which is real.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机应用（Polycam 或 Luma）采集一个物体的高斯泼溅，在 AR Foundation 中放在真实物体旁，触碰时让它散开。变体：交换真实物体和泼溅，让观众猜哪个是真的。
