works.title: StandARone
works.description: A printed restaurant menu carries its own AR app: an invisible infrared watermark in the paper encodes the AR content, so a phone scanning the page shows interactive dishes and personal options without downloading anything.
works.description_zh: 一张打印出来的餐厅菜单自带 AR 应用：纸上隐形的红外水印编码了 AR 内容，手机扫描页面就能显示可交互的菜品和个性化选项，无需下载任何东西。
works.idea_en: The paper document itself carries its AR experience, hidden in the ink.
works.idea_zh: 纸质文档本身就携带着它的 AR 体验，藏在墨水里。
works.technique: The AR scene description is encoded into a machine-readable watermark printed with IR-absorbing inks on an inkjet printer and decoded by a phone with an infrared camera.
works.technique_zh: AR 场景描述被编码进机器可读的水印，用喷墨打印机以吸收红外的墨水印出，再由带红外相机的手机解码。
works.exercise_en: Design a poster whose AR layer is encoded in a very faint QR code (light yellow on white) and write a web AR page that builds the scene from the code's text alone. Twist: two posters scanned together combine into a third scene.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一张海报，它的 AR 层编码在一个印得很淡（白底浅黄）的二维码里，写一个只根据码中文字生成场景的网页 AR。变体：两张海报一起被扫描时会合成第三个场景。

video.video_title: StandARone: Infrared-Watermarked Documents as Portable Containers of AR Interaction and Personali...

works.title: Studio
works.description: SPACE10's own Everyday Experiments app: a LiDAR scan turns your room into a 3D plan you can measure, restyle with furniture, relight with virtual lamps that switch on and off, and share.
works.description_zh: SPACE10 自己为 Everyday Experiments 开发的应用：用 LiDAR 扫描把房间变成可测量的 3D 平面图，可以用家具重新布置，用能开关的虚拟灯具重新照明，并分享出去。
works.idea_en: Turn the phone into a democratic interior design tool for the room you are standing in.
works.idea_zh: 把手机变成人人可用的室内设计工具，就用在你所站的房间里。
works.technique: The iPhone LiDAR sensor captures depth to build floor plans and surface meshes, and dynamic AR light sources are rendered with photorealistic lighting on the scanned geometry.
works.technique_zh: iPhone 的 LiDAR 传感器采集深度，生成平面图和表面网格，并在扫描几何体上以写实光照渲染动态 AR 光源。
works.exercise_en: Scan your dorm room, place one virtual lamp and toggle it on and off in AR to judge where light is needed. Twist: let a classmate redesign your room remotely from the scan.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描你的宿舍，放一盏虚拟台灯，在 AR 中开关它，判断哪里需要光。变体：让同学根据扫描远程重新设计你的房间。

video.video_title: Studio

works.title: SunForceOceanLife
works.description: At the Museum of Fine Arts, Houston, visitors take off their shoes and climb into a large crocheted, walkable structure whose soft floor moves under their feet.
works.description_zh: 在休斯敦美术馆，观众脱鞋爬进一个巨大的钩织结构里，脚下柔软的地面会随着走动起伏。
works.idea_en: When the floor itself gives way, visitors feel a space with their whole body; AR can borrow this by tying virtual space to balance, steps and posture, not only to sight.
works.idea_zh: 当地面本身会下陷，观众就用整个身体去感知空间：AR 也可以借鉴这一点，把虚拟空间和平衡、步伐、姿态联系起来，而不只是视觉。
works.technique: Hand-crocheted nets of cotton are tensioned from the gallery architecture to make a hammock-like floor and canopy (layout and materials likely similar to his earlier walk-in works).
works.technique_zh: 手工钩织的棉网从展厅结构上拉紧，形成吊床般的地面和顶棚（布局与材料推测与其早期可进入作品相似）。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone AR walk where the virtual floor appears to sag and ripple under each footstep detected by the phone's accelerometer. Twist: two users in the same space make shared ripples that meet and interfere.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 行走体验：用手机加速度计检测每一步，让虚拟地面在脚下下陷并泛起涟漪。变体：同一空间里的两位用户产生共享涟漪，彼此相遇并叠加。

video.video_title: Ernesto Neto: SunForceOceanLife

works.title: Supermarket AR Navigation (QR anchor)
works.description: A shopper scans a QR code on a supermarket shelf and an AR path appears on the floor, guiding them aisle by aisle to the product on their list.
works.description_zh: 顾客扫一下超市货架上的二维码，地面上便出现一条 AR 路线，一排排货架地把人引到购物清单上的商品前。
works.idea_en: A printed QR code works as a cheap indoor GPS fix that re-anchors an AR route inside a store.
works.idea_zh: 一张打印的二维码就是廉价的室内定位点，能在商店里重新锚定 AR 路线。
works.technique: The QR code gives a known pose that aligns a pre-authored store map with the AR session, after which world tracking keeps the floor arrows in place.
works.technique_zh: 二维码提供一个已知位姿，把预先制作的商店地图与 AR 会话对齐，之后由世界追踪让地面箭头保持在原位。
works.exercise_en: Map a corridor of your school with three QR codes as anchors and draw an AR arrow path from the entrance to a classroom. Twist: when two users' routes cross, show each of them the other's arrow in a different colour.
works.exercise_zh: 用三个二维码作为锚点，给学校的一段走廊建图，并画出一条从入口到某间教室的 AR 箭头路线。变体：当两名用户的路线交叉时，用不同颜色让双方看到对方的箭头。

video.video_title: Unity: Supermarket AR Demo. AR Navigation (QR-code as anchor point)

works.title: Syn: Unfolded Horizons of Bodily Senses
works.description: The opening show of TOKYO NODE: audiences walk onto a 1,500 m² stage where 24 dancers, a transforming space and mixed-reality experiences blur performer and spectator.
works.idea_zh: 观众走上舞台，与24位舞者和混合现实影像共同组成演出
works.technique: Combines live dancers with MR content, tracked stage elements and projection so the space reconfigures as visitors move through it.
works.exercise_zh: 把教室分区，观众走到不同区域触发不同投影和音乐，同学在其中表演；变化：观众手机AR里看到的舞者比现场多一个。

video.video_title: ELEVENPLAY x Rhizomatiks "syn" (2023)  multicam

works.description_zh: TOKYO NODE 的开幕演出：观众走上一座 1,500 平方米的舞台，24 位舞者、不断变化的空间与混合现实体验交织在一起，模糊了表演者与观众的边界。
works.idea_en: The audience walks onto the stage and forms the show together with 24 dancers and mixed-reality imagery.
works.technique_zh: 将现场舞者与 MR 内容、被追踪的舞台元素和投影结合，使空间随观众的移动而重新组合。
works.exercise_en: Divide the classroom into zones where walking into each zone triggers different projections and music, and have classmates perform inside them. Twist: in the audience's phone AR, there is one more dancer than on the actual stage.

works.title: Synth Riders Mixed Reality mode
works.description: The rhythm game's notes, rails and obstacles fly out of a portal into the player's passthrough living room, so dancing along the rails happens among their own furniture.
works.description_zh: 这款节奏游戏的音符、轨道和障碍物从一个传送门飞进玩家透视画面中的客厅，让人在自家家具之间顺着轨道起舞。
works.idea_en: Turn your living room into the dance floor by letting the level pour in through a portal.
works.idea_zh: 让关卡从传送门里倾泻而出，把客厅变成舞池。
works.technique: Quest passthrough replaces the virtual stage, with a stencil-masked portal where notes spawn and colour-tinted effects blended over the camera feed.
works.technique_zh: 用 Quest 透视画面替代虚拟舞台，在一个用模板遮罩做成的传送门里生成音符，并把着色特效叠加在摄像头画面上。
works.exercise_en: Make a passthrough rhythm prototype where beat-synced orbs emerge from a portal on a real wall and must be touched with the hands on the beat. Twist: let the song's intensity grow the portal until the virtual world covers the whole wall.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个透视节奏原型：随节拍生成的光球从真实墙面上的传送门里飞出，玩家必须踩着节拍用手去触碰。变体：让歌曲强度控制传送门大小，直到虚拟世界铺满整面墙。

video.video_title: Meta Quest 3 Mixed Reality Gameplay | Synth Riders

works.title: Teachable Reality
works.description: Train an on-device model by demonstrating with everyday objects (a lid open or closed, a toy moved) and bind those states to AR effects, prototyping tangible AR without code.
works.idea_zh: 用身边任何物件示范几次，就能把它变成触发AR效果的实体控制器。

video.video_title: [CHI 2023] Teachable Reality: Prototyping Tangible Augmented Reality with Everyday Objects

works.technique: An on-device image classifier is trained from a few user demonstrations of object states (interactive machine teaching), and state changes detected in the camera feed trigger AR effects bound to the tracked scene.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Teachable Machine 训练“杯盖开/关”或“书翻开/合上”两个状态，在网页 AR 中把状态变化连接到一个特效（盖子打开时冒出蒸汽）；变体：把一个毫无电子功能的日常物品变成游戏手柄。
works.description_zh: 用日常物件做几次示范（盖子打开或合上、玩具被挪动），就能在设备端训练一个模型，并把这些状态与 AR 效果绑定，无需写代码就能制作实体交互 AR 的原型。
works.idea_en: Demonstrate with any object at hand a few times and it becomes a physical controller for AR effects.
works.technique_zh: 设备端的图像分类器通过用户对物体状态的少量示范完成训练（交互式机器教学），摄像头画面中检测到的状态变化会触发绑定在被追踪场景上的 AR 效果。
works.exercise_en: Train two states with Teachable Machine, such as cup lid open/closed or book open/shut, and link the state change to an effect in web AR, like steam rising when the lid opens. Twist: turn an everyday object with no electronics into a game controller.

works.title: Tetris in WebAR, written by ChatGPT
works.description: A playable Tetris board floating in the room, with the WebAR code generated by ChatGPT.
works.idea_zh: 让 AI 写代码，把俄罗斯方块立在客厅里玩。

video.video_title: @LinusEkenstam I used ChatGPT to create Tetris in WebAR 👀 using similar concepts

works.technique: A 2D Tetris grid is rendered as a world-anchored vertical plane of cube meshes placed via hit test, with standard game logic running on a tick timer and on-screen buttons for input.
works.exercise_zh: 让 AI 生成一个在 AR 中漂浮的俄罗斯方块，记录需要手动修正的错误；变体：方块落到底后变成真实地面上可推倒的物理积木。
works.description_zh: 一块可以真正玩的俄罗斯方块棋盘漂浮在房间里，其 WebAR 代码由 ChatGPT 生成。
works.idea_en: Let AI write the code and stand a game of Tetris up in the living room.
works.technique_zh: 二维俄罗斯方块网格被渲染为一块由立方体网格组成、锚定在世界空间中的竖直平面，通过命中测试（hit test）放置；标准游戏逻辑由定时器驱动，屏幕按钮负责输入。
works.exercise_en: Have AI generate a Tetris game floating in AR and log every bug you have to fix by hand. Twist: when blocks land, they become physics blocks on the real floor that can be knocked over.

works.title: The Building (Liberty Science Center)
works.description: In a science museum in New Jersey, families crawl, dangle and pose on a brownstone facade laid on the floor, and watch themselves climbing it in a huge mirror overhead.
works.description_zh: 在新泽西的一座科学博物馆里，一家人在平铺于地面的褐石建筑立面上爬行、悬挂、摆姿势，并从头顶的巨大镜子里看到自己正在攀爬这栋楼。
works.idea_en: A proven illusion becomes a play space when you design the mirror as a stage: AR selfie effects work best when the camera image is the show and the physical set is the backstage.
works.idea_zh: 当你把镜子当成舞台来设计，一个成熟的幻象就变成了游戏空间：AR 自拍效果最好的时候，是摄像头画面才是演出，而实体场景只是后台。
works.technique: The Bâtiment principle is adapted for a museum: a printed facade on the floor and an angled mirror suspended above, sized so a whole family fits in the reflection.
works.technique_zh: 为博物馆改造的“Bâtiment”原理：地面上是印制的建筑立面，上方悬挂一面倾斜的镜子，尺寸大到能装下一整家人的倒影。
works.exercise_en: Make a Lens Studio ground-plane lens that turns a floor photo of your classroom into a wall to climb, and invite three classmates to invent poses for it. Twist: add a virtual pigeon that lands on whoever holds still longest.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Lens Studio 中做一个地面滤镜，把教室地面的照片变成一面可以攀爬的墙，请三位同学为它设计姿势。变体：加一只虚拟鸽子，落在保持不动最久的那个人身上。

video.video_title: Leandro Erlich, The Building, 2023. Liberty Science Center, NJ, USA

salient.why_en: Lie on a facade laid flat on the floor and a mirror overhead shows you hanging from a building.
salient.why_zh: 躺在铺在地上的楼房立面上，头顶的大镜子里你就挂在了楼外墙上。

works.title: The Floor Is Lava!
works.description: Using Figmin XR on Quest 3, the real living-room floor is covered with bubbling virtual lava while furniture remains safe islands.
works.idea_zh: 把客厅地板变成岩浆，只有家具是安全岛。

video.video_title: 🔥The floor is lava!🔥

works.technique: Places a lava material on the detected floor plane while the scene mesh keeps real furniture visible and occluding.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR检测地面铺满岩浆材质，并让玩家只能踩在贴有标记的“安全垫”上（图片识别）；变化：岩浆每30秒上涨一次。
works.description_zh: 在 Quest 3 上使用 Figmin XR，真实客厅的地板被翻滚冒泡的虚拟岩浆覆盖，而家具成了安全的小岛。
works.idea_en: The living-room floor turns into lava and only the furniture is safe to stand on.
works.technique_zh: 在检测到的地面平面上铺设岩浆材质，同时利用场景网格让真实家具保持可见并产生遮挡。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR to detect the floor and cover it with a lava material, and only let players step on safe mats marked with images that the app recognizes. Twist: the lava rises every 30 seconds.

salient.why_en: The childhood game made literal: the floor really turns to lava and only the furniture is safe.
salient.why_zh: 把童年游戏变成真的：地板真的变成岩浆，只有家具上才安全。

works.title: The Fool Tour (Jain)
works.description: Two Lenses for singer Jain's live show: the 'Jain Machine' deals anyone a playful prediction of their future, and a second Lens opens a cosmic world that fans see during the concert itself.
works.description_zh: 为歌手 Jain 的巡演制作的两个 Lens：“Jain Machine”给每个人抽一张俏皮的未来预言，另一个 Lens 则在演唱会现场为歌迷打开一个宇宙般的世界。
works.idea_en: Give a concert crowd a shared AR layer that only exists during the show.
works.idea_zh: 给演唱会观众一层只在演出期间存在的共享 AR 世界。
works.technique: A face-tracked fortune-telling Lens plus a world Lens timed to the live set, which likely anchors large-scale cosmic visuals to the stage direction.
works.technique_zh: 一个基于人脸追踪的占卜 Lens，加上一个与演出同步的世界 Lens，后者很可能把大尺度宇宙视觉锚定在舞台方向。
works.exercise_en: Create a Lens for a school performance that shows a different AR sky during each song of a three-song set. Twist: the audience's cheering volume decides how intense the sky becomes.
works.exercise_zh: 为一场学校演出做一个 Lens，三首歌分别对应三种不同的 AR 天空；变体：观众欢呼的音量决定天空的强烈程度。

video.video_title: The Fool Tour - Jain x Snapchat

works.title: The MetaBox
works.description: Participants step into an Igloo immersive projection room and instantly appear as volumetric holograms to remote colleagues in VR, so body language crosses between the two spaces.
works.description_zh: 参与者走进 Igloo 沉浸式投影房间，就会立刻以体积全息影像出现在远程 VR 同事面前，让肢体语言在两个空间之间传递。
works.idea_en: A room that turns whoever walks in into a hologram for someone far away.
works.idea_zh: 一个把走进来的人变成远方全息影像的房间。
works.technique: Depthkit volumetric capture inside the projection room streams participants into a shared VR scene, while the remote VR view is projected on the room's walls.
works.technique_zh: 投影房间内的 Depthkit 体积捕捉把参与者实时传入共享 VR 场景，同时远端 VR 画面被投影到房间的墙上。
works.exercise_en: Set up a corner with a projector showing a remote classmate's video on the wall while your phone streams you to them. Twist: only show the remote person when both of you face the wall.
works.exercise_zh: 布置一个角落：投影仪在墙上显示远程同学的视频，同时用手机把你传给对方。变体：只有你们都面对墙时才显示对方。

video.video_title: The MetaBox - Immersive Hybrid Collaboration powered by Volumetric Video

works.title: The Real World Is Your Canvas
works.description: An artist paints glowing strokes and objects around a real room in Figmin XR; the art wraps around furniture and stays anchored in place.
works.idea_zh: 在真实房间的家具间作画，画作永远留在原处。

video.video_title: 🎨 With #MixedReality the real world is your canvas 🎨

works.technique: Combines 3D brush strokes with persistent spatial anchors so drawings stay registered to the room between sessions.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR绘画App（如Just a Line的继任或Reality Composer）在教室某个角落画3D装置并保存锚点，下节课重新打开；变化：两人在同一锚点上接力完成作品。
works.description_zh: 一位艺术家在 Figmin XR 中围绕真实房间绘制发光的笔触和物体；作品环绕着家具，并固定停留在原处。
works.idea_en: Paint among the furniture of a real room, and the artwork stays where you left it.
works.technique_zh: 将三维笔刷笔触与持久化空间锚点结合，使绘画在不同使用时段之间始终与房间对齐。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone AR drawing app (such as a successor to Just a Line, or Reality Composer) to paint a 3D installation in a corner of the classroom, save the anchor, and reopen it next class. Twist: two people take turns finishing the piece on the same anchor.

works.title: Thermal Improvisations
works.description: An audiovisual performance at Goldsmiths that explores the thermal landscape of a space: a performer moves in front of a thermal camera whose heat image is projected, and the image shapes the improvised sound.
works.description_zh: 在 Goldsmiths 进行的一场视听表演，探索空间的热景观：表演者在热成像摄像头前移动，热图像被投影出来，并影响即兴的声音。
works.idea_en: Play the room with body heat that only a thermal camera can see.
works.idea_zh: 用只有热成像摄像头才看得见的体温，来演奏这个房间。
works.technique: A thermal camera feed is projected live and its temperature values are likely analysed in software to modulate sound in real time.
works.technique_zh: 热成像摄像头的画面实时投影，其温度数值很可能经软件分析后实时调制声音。
works.exercise_en: Clip a cheap phone thermal camera to a projector and project the live heat image; place a warm mug and ask students to leave handprints on the wall and watch them fade. Twist: map the hottest point's position to the pitch of a tone.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个便宜的手机热成像镜头接到投影仪上，投出实时热图；放一杯热水，请学生在墙上按手印并看它们慢慢消失；变体：把最热点的位置映射成一个音的音高。

video.video_title: Thermal Improvisations

works.title: This Fragile Earth: Day to Night
works.description: Day to Night images of endangered species and habitats — waterholes, migrations, ice — where animals arriving and leaving over a day share one frame.
works.description_zh: 以《Day to Night》手法拍摄的濒危物种与栖息地——水坑、迁徙、冰原——一天中来来去去的动物同时出现在同一画面里。
works.idea_en: Compressing a day of animal visits into one image reveals patterns of use no single moment shows; AR can do the same for how people use a space.
works.idea_zh: 把一天里动物的来访压缩进一张图，就能看出任何单一时刻都看不到的使用规律；AR 也可以这样呈现人们如何使用一个空间。
works.technique: A fixed long-lens camera records a location for a full day and selected animals from different hours are composited into one scene.
works.technique_zh: 固定的长焦相机拍下某地一整天，再把不同时段的动物选出来合成到同一画面。
works.exercise_en: Log where people stand in a hallway over a day with a phone and a person-detection model, then show all positions as colored ghosts by hour in AR at the real spot. Twist: let viewers filter to one hour by turning a virtual dial.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机和人物检测模型记录一天中人们在走廊里停留的位置，再在 AR 中把所有位置按小时用不同颜色的幽灵显示在原地；变体：让观众转动一个虚拟旋钮，只看某一个小时。

video.video_title: Stephen Wilkes: This Fragile Earth Day To Night

salient.why_en: One photograph holds a whole day, from daylight on one side to night on the other.
salient.why_zh: 一张照片装下一整天，一边是白昼，另一边是黑夜。

works.title: Tommy Hilfiger AR Mirror
works.description: An AR Mirror installed in Tommy Hilfiger's London store: shoppers walk up to a framed screen and see themselves wearing the digital version of the new collection, with extra visual effects.
works.description_zh: 安装在 Tommy Hilfiger 伦敦门店里的 AR 魔镜：顾客走到一块带框的屏幕前，就能看到自己穿上新系列的数字版本，还带有额外的视觉特效。
works.idea_en: The shop mirror that lets you wear the whole collection in seconds.
works.idea_zh: 一面几秒钟就能让你穿遍整个系列的店内镜子。
works.technique: A camera-and-screen kiosk runs real-time pose tracking, segmentation and cloth simulation to overlay digital twins of physical garments on the shopper, with a touch interface to switch looks.
works.technique_zh: 由摄像头和屏幕组成的终端运行实时姿态追踪、人像分割与布料模拟，把实体服装的数字孪生叠加到顾客身上，并通过触控界面切换造型。
works.exercise_en: Build a browser AR mirror with MediaPipe Pose that swaps between three outfits by a raised-hand gesture instead of touch. Twist: each outfit changes the background of the room too.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 在浏览器里做一面 AR 镜子，通过举手手势（而不是触屏）在三套服装之间切换；变体：每换一套衣服，房间背景也跟着改变。

video.video_title:
The future is here: introducing our latest solution for physical retail 💥

For the first time ever, we bring the AR Mirror to global Tommy Hilfiger retail stores. 

Already available in London! https:

works.title: Touch Grass lens
works.description: A tongue-in-cheek AR lens detects when you actually touch grass and rewards you, so you can prove online that you go outside.
works.idea_zh: 识别你真的'摸了草'，给你一张出门证明。

video.video_title: I made an AR lens that detects when you touch grass so you can prove to other people on the internet you go outside! https://t.co/eYLm0umbXt

works.technique: Hand tracking combined with a ground/grass segmentation or classification model checks that the hand overlaps real grass (likely Lens Studio ML).
works.exercise_zh: 用 Teachable Machine 训练'草地/非草地'分类器，手机拍到手放在草上就发放徽章；加一个变化：换成识别树叶、石头等校园自然物收集图鉴。
works.description_zh: 一个带点调侃意味的 AR 滤镜：它能识别你是否真的摸到了草，并给你奖励，让你在网上证明自己确实出过门。
works.idea_en: It checks that you really touched grass and hands you proof that you went outside.
works.technique_zh: 将手部追踪与地面/草地分割或分类模型结合，判断手是否与真实草地重叠（大概率使用 Lens Studio 的机器学习功能）。
works.exercise_en: Train a grass/not-grass classifier with Teachable Machine and award a badge when the phone sees a hand on grass. Twist: switch to recognizing leaves, stones and other natural objects on campus to fill a collection guide.

salient.why_en: The internet joke taken literally: the lens checks that you really touched grass and gives you proof.
salient.why_zh: 把网络梗当真：这个滤镜确认你真的摸到了草，并给你出去过的证明。

works.title: Tracky
works.description: An open-source iOS app and Blender plugin: film a clip while the phone records camera pose, focal length, LiDAR depth, planes, anchors and a person mask, then import it into Blender to add AR effects that stay locked to the scene.
works.description_zh: 开源的 iOS 应用加 Blender 插件：拍视频时手机同时记录相机位姿、焦距、LiDAR 深度、平面、锚点和人像蒙版，导入 Blender 后加上的 AR 效果会稳稳贴合场景。
works.idea_en: Sketch AR ideas as believable videos without building the real app.
works.idea_zh: 不用先开发应用，也能把 AR 创意做成可信的概念视频。
works.technique: ARKit logs per-frame camera transforms, intrinsics, depth maps, segmentation masks and planes into a JSON-based .bren file, which the Blender add-on turns into an animated camera and aligned scene.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 逐帧记录相机变换、内参、深度图、分割蒙版和平面，存成基于 JSON 的 .bren 文件，Blender 插件据此还原动画相机和对齐的场景。
works.exercise_en: Record a 10-second phone clip with a camera-tracking tool (Tracky or Blender motion tracking), add one fake AR object in Blender, and render a concept video. Twist: the object must interact with something real in the shot, such as hiding behind it or bouncing on it.
works.exercise_zh: 用相机追踪工具（Tracky 或 Blender 运动追踪）拍一段 10 秒的手机视频，在 Blender 里加一个假的 AR 物体并渲染成概念视频；变体：这个物体必须和画面里的真实物体互动，比如躲到它后面或在上面弹跳。

works.title: Turning RC Cars into Pets
works.description: Overhead computer vision tracks several Arduino-controlled RC cars in real time and gives each one a personality, so they roam the floor like pets that react to him.
works.idea_zh: 给遥控车装上'性格'，让它们像宠物一样在地上游走、回应你。

video.video_title: I Turned My RC-Cars Into Pets

works.technique: A camera tracks each car with CV markers, and a behavior script sends steering commands back over radio so the physical cars act on virtual rules.
works.exercise_zh: 用 micro:bit 小车 + 头顶摄像头追踪，让小车'害怕'同学的脚并逃开；加一个变化：给每辆车一个投影在地上的情绪表情。
works.description_zh: 头顶的计算机视觉系统实时追踪几辆由 Arduino 控制的遥控车，并给每辆车赋予一种性格，让它们像宠物一样在地上游走，对他作出反应。
works.idea_en: Give RC cars personalities so they wander the floor and respond to you like pets.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头通过计算机视觉标记追踪每辆车，行为脚本再通过无线电发回转向指令，让实体小车按照虚拟规则行动。
works.exercise_en: Use micro:bit cars and an overhead camera for tracking, and make the cars afraid of classmates' feet so they run away. Twist: project an emotion face on the floor for each car.

works.title: Unity Gaussian Splatting
works.description: A photographed garden scene with tools is flown through in real time, rendered from millions of soft coloured splats and compressed to under 8 MB.
works.description_zh: 一个拍摄得到的花园工具场景可以实时穿行，由数百万个柔和的彩色泼溅点渲染，数据被压缩到 8 MB 以内。
works.idea_en: A photo capture can be rendered directly as millions of fuzzy points, with no meshes or textures.
works.idea_zh: 照片扫描可以直接渲染成数百万个模糊的点，不需要网格和贴图。
works.technique: Trained 3D Gaussian Splatting data is compressed into GPU buffers, a compute shader sorts the splats by depth every frame, and each Gaussian is drawn as a screen-space ellipse blended back to front.
works.technique_zh: 训练好的 3D 高斯泼溅数据被压缩进 GPU 缓冲区，计算着色器每帧按深度对泼溅点排序，每个高斯被画成屏幕空间椭圆并从后往前混合。
works.exercise_en: Capture a classroom object as a Gaussian splat (Luma, Polycam or Scaniverse) and place it back in the same room in AR. Twist: let the splats scatter like dust when you walk through the object.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Luma、Polycam 或 Scaniverse 把教室里的一件物品拍成高斯泼溅，再在 AR 中把它放回同一个房间。变体：当你穿过物体时，让泼溅点像尘埃一样散开。

video.video_title: Garden tools scene: Gaussian Splatting in under 8MB

works.title: VFX Graph Smoke Portal Sample
works.description: A swirling ring of lit smoke and embers forms a portal, with the smoke catching light from the fire and the scene around it.
works.description_zh: 一圈被照亮的烟雾和火星旋转成一个传送门，烟雾接收来自火焰和周围场景的光照。
works.idea_en: Smoke that is lit like real smoke makes a portal feel physical.
works.idea_zh: 像真实烟雾一样受光的烟，让传送门显得有实体感。
works.technique: Flipbook smoke particles use six-way lighting (baked light maps from six directions) so they respond to scene lights, combined with VFX Graph spawning along a ring and distortion.
works.technique_zh: 翻页动画烟雾粒子使用六向光照（从六个方向烘焙的光照图），因此能响应场景灯光；再结合 VFX Graph 沿圆环生成粒子和扭曲效果。
works.exercise_en: Place the smoke portal on a real doorway with AR Foundation and light it with AR light estimation so the smoke matches the room. Twist: the portal only opens when two people stand on either side.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 把烟雾传送门放在真实门框上，并用 AR 光照估计照亮它，让烟与房间一致。变体：只有两人站在门两侧时传送门才打开。

video.video_title: Breakdown of VFX Graph smoke portal sample | Unity

works.title: VFX Graph as Mesh Deformer
works.description: A mesh ripples and deforms as if it were liquid, because each of its vertices is driven by a VFX Graph particle.
works.description_zh: 一个网格像液体一样起伏变形，因为它的每个顶点都由一个 VFX Graph 粒子驱动。
works.idea_en: Treat every vertex as a particle and all of VFX Graph's forces become mesh deformers.
works.idea_zh: 把每个顶点当成粒子，VFX Graph 的所有力都变成了网格变形器。
works.technique: VFX Graph writes particle positions into a GraphicsBuffer indexed like the mesh's vertices, and a shader reads that buffer to displace the mesh.
works.technique_zh: VFX Graph 把粒子位置写进一个按网格顶点索引排列的 GraphicsBuffer，着色器读取它来位移网格。
works.exercise_en: Use the trick on the AR face mesh (ARKit face tracking) so a turbulence field makes the user's face melt and reform. Twist: attract the vertices toward the user's hand position.
works.exercise_zh: 把这个技巧用到 AR 人脸网格上（ARKit 面部追踪），让湍流场使用户的脸融化又复原。变体：让顶点被吸向用户手的位置。

video.video_title: [Unity] (hacky!) Using VFX Graph as mesh deformer

works.title: VFX Graph custom HLSL: plexus network
works.description: Glowing points drift in space and connect to their nearest neighbors with thin lines, forming a moving network.
works.description_zh: 发光的点在空间中漂浮，并用细线连接最近的邻居，形成一张流动的网。
works.idea_en: Connect nearby points and a swarm becomes a web.
works.idea_zh: 把相邻的点连起来，粒子群就成了网。
works.technique: A Custom HLSL node in VFX Graph searches a buffer for each particle's nearest neighbor and outputs the target position used to draw connecting lines.
works.technique_zh: VFX Graph 中的自定义 HLSL 节点在缓冲区里为每个粒子寻找最近的邻居，输出目标位置用来画连线。
works.exercise_en: Spawn points on real surfaces from AR Foundation meshing and connect neighbors into a glowing web that covers the room. Twist: lines snap when someone walks through them.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 网格化在真实表面上生成点，把相邻点连成覆盖房间的发光网。变体：有人穿过时，线会断开。

video.video_title: I updated the VFX Graph custom HLSL node sample. Now it supports multiple outputs! https://t.co/KIJJrhPgK8 https://t.co/z53AM947Hh

works.title: VFX Sketchbook (Godot 4)
works.description: A montage of stylised real-time effects made in Godot 4, from fireballs, fireworks and a force field to portals, a tornado portal, butterflies and a water hand, each a small sketch.
works.description_zh: 一段 Godot 4 实时风格化特效合集：火球、烟花、力场、传送门、龙卷风传送门、蝴蝶和水之手等，每个都是一个小草图。
works.idea_en: A sketchbook habit: one quick effect at a time, all shared openly.
works.idea_zh: 速写本式的习惯：一次做一个小特效，全部公开分享。
works.technique: Each effect combines GPU particles with custom spatial shaders that scroll noise textures, erode alpha and push emissive colour, organised as reusable scenes in one project.
works.technique_zh: 每个特效都把 GPU 粒子和自定义空间着色器结合起来，滚动噪声纹理、侵蚀透明度并提高自发光颜色，作为可复用的场景组织在一个项目里。
works.exercise_en: Port one sketch to an AR-capable engine (Godot OpenXR passthrough or Unity AR Foundation) and trigger it on a real surface with a tap. Twist: chain three sketches into a spell that the user casts with a gesture sequence.
works.exercise_zh: 把其中一个草图移植到支持 AR 的引擎（Godot OpenXR 透视或 Unity AR Foundation），点一下就在真实表面上触发。变体：把三个草图串成一个法术，用户用一串手势施放。

video.video_title: VFX sketchbook 2023 [GODOT 4]

works.title: Virtual Stage x Holosphere
works.description: A BRB2 dancer performs in front of a 35-metre by 3-metre immersive backdrop, and his motion-captured body drives the real-time artwork around him as he dances.
works.description_zh: 一位 BRB2 舞者在 35 米长、3 米高的沉浸式背景前起舞，他被动作捕捉的身体在舞动中实时驱动周围的影像。
works.idea_en: A ballet dancer paints a 35-metre wall with his body in real time.
works.idea_zh: 芭蕾舞者用身体实时“绘制”一面 35 米长的墙。
works.technique: Low-latency VR-grade motion tracking feeds a distributed real-time rendering system of the kind used for virtual production, displayed across a giant LED or projection backdrop by Holosphere.
works.technique_zh: 低延迟、VR 级别的动作追踪数据输入一套虚拟制片常用的分布式实时渲染系统，由 Holosphere 显示在巨大的 LED 或投影背景上。
works.exercise_en: Split a long wall into three projector zones and let one dancer's tracked hands 'push' colour from one zone to the next. Twist: add a second dancer whose movement erases what the first one paints.
works.exercise_zh: 把一面长墙分成三个投影区，让一位舞者被追踪的双手把颜色从一个区“推”到下一个区；变体：加入第二位舞者，他的动作会擦掉第一位画出的内容。

video.video_title: Birmingham Royal Ballet Motion Capture Ballet Performance

works.title: Virtual Wearable
works.description: Holographic rings and app icons wrap around the user's wrist and hand; turning and closing the hand calls up and selects apps in a sci-fi interface.
works.description_zh: 全息圆环和应用图标缠绕在使用者的手腕和手上；转动、握拳就能调出并选择应用，像科幻电影里的界面。
works.idea_en: Replace rectangular screens with interfaces that are worn on the body like jewellery.
works.idea_zh: 用像首饰一样戴在身上的界面，取代长方形的屏幕。
works.technique: Ultraleap hand tracking gives the hand skeleton, VFX Graph and Shader Graph draw the circular holographic UI anchored to wrist and palm joints, and Vuforia registers the camera view.
works.technique_zh: Ultraleap 手部追踪提供手的骨骼，VFX Graph 和 Shader Graph 绘制锚定在手腕和手掌关节上的环形全息界面，Vuforia 用于对齐相机画面。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone's hand tracking (for example MediaPipe Hands or visionOS hand anchors) to attach a ring of three glowing icons to your wrist in AR. Twist: the ring only appears when you look at your palm.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机上的手部追踪（例如 MediaPipe Hands 或 visionOS 手部锚点）在 AR 中把一圈三个发光图标戴到手腕上。变体：只有当你看向掌心时，这圈图标才会出现。

works.title: Visual Captions
works.description: During a video call or in-person chat, the system listens to the conversation and suggests images, maps or emoji that illustrate what is being said, which speakers can show with one click.
works.description_zh: 在视频通话或面对面交谈中，系统聆听对话内容，推荐能说明所讲内容的图片、地图或表情，说话者一键即可展示。
works.idea_en: Live visuals that follow the conversation, like captions but in pictures.
works.idea_zh: 随对话实时出现的画面，就像字幕，只不过是图片。
works.technique: A fine-tuned large language model predicts from the last spoken sentence what visual would help and what kind, and image search fills it in with the user choosing how proactive it is.
works.technique_zh: 微调过的大语言模型根据最近一句话预测需要什么样的视觉内容，再用图像检索补全，用户可以选择系统有多主动。
works.exercise_en: Build a web page that transcribes speech and, for every noun it hears, shows a matching emoji floating next to the speaker in a phone AR view. Twist: only show images when two people say the same word.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个网页：转写语音，每听到一个名词，就在手机 AR 画面中说话人旁边浮现一个对应的表情。变体：只有两个人都说到同一个词时才显示图片。

video.video_title: [CHI 2023] Visual Captions Live Demo

works.title: Voice In My Head
works.description: Participants wear an earpiece through which an AI voice listens to their conversations and whispers real-time guidance, replacing their inner monologue as they move through social situations.
works.idea_zh: 耳机里有一个AI“内心声音”，在你与人交谈时实时耳语指导你。

video.video_title: Voice In My Head

works.technique: Speech recognition transcribes the wearer's surroundings, an LLM generates short suggestions conditioned on a personality profile, and text-to-speech delivers them through an earpiece with low latency.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机网页的语音识别加一个 LLM API，把对话摘要后生成一句建议，通过耳机用 TTS 悄悄念给你听；变体：给这个声音设定一个与你完全相反的性格，戴着它和同学聊 5 分钟再反思。
works.description_zh: 参与者戴上耳机，耳机里的 AI 声音会聆听他们的对话并实时低声给出指引，在各种社交场合中取代他们的内心独白。
works.idea_en: An AI inner voice in your earpiece whispers live advice while you talk to people.
works.technique_zh: 语音识别转写佩戴者周围的对话，LLM 根据设定的人格档案生成简短建议，再由文字转语音（TTS）以低延迟通过耳机播放。
works.exercise_en: Use speech recognition in a phone web page plus an LLM API to summarize a conversation into one suggestion, and have TTS read it quietly into your earphones. Twist: give the voice a personality that is the exact opposite of yours, chat with a classmate for 5 minutes while wearing it, then reflect.

works.title: Volumetric fog from VFX Graph
works.description: Soft purple smoke rises from a teapot and is lit as real volumetric fog, blending with the scene lighting.
works.description_zh: 柔和的紫色烟雾从茶壶里升起，被当作真正的体积雾来照明，与场景光融为一体。
works.idea_en: Particles can write into the fog instead of being sprites.
works.idea_zh: 粒子可以写进雾里，而不只是贴图片。
works.technique: VFX Graph's volumetric fog output (Unity 2023.1 HDRP) injects particle density into the local volumetric fog buffer so smoke receives scene lighting and shadows.
works.technique_zh: VFX Graph 的体积雾输出（Unity 2023.1 HDRP）把粒子密度写入局部体积雾缓冲区，让烟雾接收场景的光照和阴影。
works.exercise_en: Make smoke rise from a real cup in AR Foundation using soft particles, lit by the estimated room light. Twist: blowing into the microphone pushes the smoke away.
works.exercise_zh: 用柔和粒子在 AR Foundation 中让真实杯子冒出烟雾，并用估计的房间光照明。变体：对麦克风吹气可以把烟吹走。

video.video_title:
Volumetric fog output from VFX Graph (Unity 2023.1)

works.title: Voronoi Depth
works.description: A projected rectangle on a living-room floor opens into what looks like a recessed box whose Voronoi-patterned walls react to what is placed or moved inside it.
works.description_zh: 客厅地板上的投影矩形看起来像一个向下凹陷的盒子，盒壁上的 Voronoi 图案会对放入或移动的物体作出反应。
works.idea_en: Fake depth in the floor, then let real objects disturb it.
works.idea_zh: 在地板上伪造出深度，再让真实物体去扰动它。
works.technique: An anamorphic projection renders a box interior for a fixed viewpoint, while tracked objects act as seeds for a Voronoi pattern mapped onto the box walls (likely).
works.technique_zh: 变形透视投影为固定视角渲染出盒子内部，被追踪的物体作为种子点，驱动映射在盒壁上的 Voronoi 图案（推测）。
works.exercise_en: Project an anamorphic 'hole' onto the floor that looks correct from one marked spot, then add a simple reaction when a foot enters it. Twist: the hole gets deeper the longer someone stands in it.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面投影一个变形透视的“洞”，让它从某个标记位置看起来正确，然后在脚踏入时加入简单反应；变体：有人站得越久，洞就越深。

works.title: Waking Products (Vision Pro concept)
works.description: A spatial-computing concept released after Vision Pro was announced: a physical indoor herb garden on a kitchen counter is 'woken up' by the user, revealing a layer of digital functionality around the real product.
works.description_zh: Vision Pro 发布后推出的空间计算概念：厨房台面上的一台室内种植机被用户“唤醒”，真实商品周围随即展开一层数字功能。
works.idea_en: Buying a physical product could also unlock a digital layer attached to it.
works.idea_zh: 买下一件实体商品，也同时解锁附着在它身上的数字层。
works.technique: Likely a mixed-reality concept in which the product is recognised and a UI is anchored to it, triggered by gaze and pinch.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是混合现实概念：识别出商品并把界面锚定在它身上，通过注视和捏合手势触发。
works.exercise_en: Pick a household product and design its 'awake' AR state: an image marker or object tracker opens a panel with one useful function and one playful one. Twist: the product falls asleep again when it is ignored.
works.exercise_zh: 选一件家用品，设计它被“唤醒”后的 AR 状态：用图像标记或物体追踪打开一个面板，包含一个实用功能和一个好玩的功能；变体：被冷落一段时间后，它会重新“睡着”。

works.title: Waldwandel / Forest Flux
works.description: An immersive AR livestream installation, made with /p, in which Bavarian forest trees transform to show how climate change will reshape the forest, shown at Kunsthalle Munich and Chiostro del Bramante, Rome.
works.description_zh: 与 /p 合作的沉浸式 AR 直播装置：巴伐利亚森林中的树木不断变化，展示气候变化将如何重塑森林，曾在慕尼黑美术馆和罗马 Chiostro del Bramante 展出。
works.idea_en: Watch a forest's future unfold as a live mixed-reality projection.
works.idea_zh: 看着一片森林的未来，以实时混合现实投影的方式展开。
works.technique: An AR scene of evolving tree models is composited over a live camera feed and projected in the gallery as a livestream, based on forestry data on future species.
works.technique_zh: 根据关于未来树种的林业数据，把不断演变的树木模型合成到实时摄像画面上，并以直播形式投影在展厅中。
works.exercise_en: Film a campus tree with a phone, composite an AR layer that ages or replaces it with a species expected in 2080, and project the live result. Twist: the audience's movement speeds up time.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍一棵校园里的树，合成一层 AR，把它变老或替换成 2080 年预计会出现的树种，并把实时结果投影出来。变体：观众的移动会加快时间流逝。

video.video_title: Waldwandel/ForestFlux Chiostro del Bramante, Rome 2026

works.title: When the Sky Blooms with Sakura
works.description: On Yotsukura Beach in Iwaki, a coast struck by the 2011 tsunami, daytime fireworks release pink and white smoke blossoms that open over the sea like cherry trees.
works.description_zh: 在 2011 年遭受海啸重创的磐城市四仓海滩，日间烟火释放出粉色和白色的烟雾花朵，像樱花树一样在海面上空绽放。
works.idea_en: The same effect means something different in a place with memory; site-specific AR gains weight when its imagery answers the history of the exact location.
works.idea_zh: 同样的效果放在有记忆的地方，意义就不同了；场地特定的 AR，当它的图像回应这个地点的历史时，才会有分量。
works.technique: Daytime shells with pink, white and green smoke compositions are fired in layered clusters so the smoke forms blossom shapes and branches.
works.technique_zh: 装有粉、白、绿色烟雾药剂的日间烟花弹分层成簇发射，让烟雾组成花朵和枝干的形状。
works.exercise_en: Choose a place on campus with a story (an old tree, a closed building) and grow an AR smoke tree above it whose blossom colour comes from that story; show it to someone who knows the place. Twist: blossoms fall and gather on the ground only where people stand still.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里找一个有故事的地方（一棵老树、一栋关闭的楼），在它上方长出一棵 AR 烟雾之树，花的颜色来自这个故事，再请了解这个地方的人来看。变体：只有在人静静站着的地方，花瓣才会落下并堆积。

video.video_title: WHEN THE SKY BLOOMS WITH SAKURA BY CAI GUO-QIANG

works.title: Wol: AI owl guide to the redwoods
works.description: An AR owl you talk to about the redwood forest ecosystem, running on phones and MR headsets from one web build.
works.idea_zh: 和一只 AR 猫头鹰对话，让它带你认识红杉林。

video.video_title: Wol - a mixed reality experience for the web powered by 8th Wall

works.technique: An anchored animated character is wired to speech recognition, an LLM prompted with forest-ecology context, and text-to-speech, and one web build adapts to phone or headset input.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中放一个动物角色，用语音识别 + LLM + TTS 让它回答关于某个生态系统的问题；变体：给角色设定它不知道的知识边界，让它在超出范围时承认不懂。
works.description_zh: 一只可以对话的 AR 猫头鹰，和你聊红杉林的生态系统；同一个网页版本可同时运行在手机和 MR 头显上。
works.idea_en: Talk with an AR owl that shows you around the redwood forest.
works.technique_zh: 一个锚定在空间中的动画角色接入了语音识别、带有森林生态背景提示词的 LLM 以及文字转语音；同一个网页版本可适配手机或头显的输入方式。
works.exercise_en: Place an animal character in AR and use speech recognition, an LLM and TTS so it answers questions about an ecosystem. Twist: give the character a boundary of knowledge and make it admit when a question goes beyond it.

works.title: WonkaVision
works.description: Johnny Lee's 2007 Wii head-tracking trick revived in Chrome with a normal webcam: as you move your head, a miniature 3D storefront shifts in perspective as if behind a window, and objects appear to pop out of the screen.
works.description_zh: 在 Chrome 里用普通摄像头复活 Johnny Lee 2007 年的 Wii 头部追踪技巧：头一动，屏幕里的迷你 3D 店铺就像窗外的景物一样改变透视，物体甚至像要跳出屏幕。
works.idea_en: Turn a flat screen into a window with nothing but a webcam.
works.idea_zh: 只靠一个摄像头，把平面屏幕变成一扇窗。
works.technique: MediaPipe Face Mesh iris landmarks estimate the eye's 3D position from the near-constant iris diameter (about 11.7 mm), and the scene is rendered with an off-axis perspective projection from that eye, all in the browser via WebAssembly.
works.technique_zh: 利用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 的虹膜关键点，根据人眼虹膜直径几乎恒定（约 11.7 毫米）推算眼睛的 3D 位置，再以该位置做离轴透视投影渲染，全部通过 WebAssembly 在浏览器中运行。
works.exercise_en: Use a browser face tracker to move a three.js camera with the viewer's head so a box scene behind the screen feels deep. Twist: make one object escape through the screen when the viewer leans in.
works.exercise_zh: 用浏览器人脸追踪让 three.js 相机跟随观众头部移动，让屏幕后面的盒子场景产生纵深感；变体：观众凑近时，让一个物体“钻出”屏幕。

video.video_title:
Johnny Lee famously hacked a Wii Remote to turn a 2D screen into a 3D window. We revived this trick in Chrome using a standard webcam.

Here’s how we did it. 🧵👇 https://t.co/lcKybr3pZD

works.title: Wood Wide Web
works.description: Prints of forest imagery come alive in augmented reality: through a device, generative networks grow across the images like the fungal web that links tree roots underground.
works.description_zh: 森林主题的版画在增强现实中活了过来：透过设备观看，生成式的网络在画面上生长，就像地下连接树根的真菌网络。
works.idea_en: Reveal the hidden network that connects trees on top of a printed image.
works.idea_zh: 在一幅印刷图像上，显现出连接树木的隐秘网络。
works.technique: Printed images act as AR image targets, and generative growth algorithms inspired by mycelium are rendered on top of them in real time (details of the app likely custom).
works.technique_zh: 印刷图像作为 AR 识别目标，受菌丝启发的生成式生长算法实时渲染在图像之上（应用细节推测为定制开发）。
works.exercise_en: Print a photo of a tree, use it as an image target in Lens Studio or AR Foundation, and grow branching lines between the roots with an L-system. Twist: the network grows faster when two phones look at the print at the same time.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一张树的照片，在 Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation 中把它设为图像识别目标，用 L 系统在树根之间生长分叉线条；变体：两部手机同时看这张图时，网络长得更快。

video.video_title: Wood Wide Web, 2023

works.title: World Ensemble
works.description: Walking through a city with a phone, the user taps buildings to place instruments on them and taps the sky to switch the music and visual effects, so the street becomes a playable score.
works.description_zh: 拿着手机在城市里走，点一下建筑就在上面放一件乐器，点一下天空就切换音乐和视觉效果，整条街变成一份可以演奏的乐谱。
works.idea_en: Use the geometry of the city as a sequencer: every building you tag becomes a voice in the song.
works.idea_zh: 把城市的几何形体当成音序器：你标记的每一栋楼都成为歌曲里的一个声部。
works.technique: ARCore Geospatial and Photorealistic 3D Tiles localize the phone and provide building geometry; taps likely raycast against the tiles to anchor instruments, and the visual effects switch with the music (AR Foundation Replay is used to test walks in the editor).
works.technique_zh: ARCore Geospatial 与 Photorealistic 3D Tiles 为手机定位并提供建筑几何；点击时很可能对瓦片模型做射线检测来锚定乐器，视觉效果随音乐切换（作者用 AR Foundation Replay 在编辑器里测试行走录像）。
works.exercise_en: Record an AR Foundation replay of a walk around campus and map three buildings to three loops that start when you look at them. Twist: make the visual effect on each facade follow that building's loop.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里走一圈录制 AR Foundation 回放，把三栋建筑映射成三段循环，看向它们时开始播放。变体：让每面外墙上的视觉效果跟随该建筑的循环节奏。

video.video_title: World Ensemble Demo

salient.why_en: Tap the buildings on a street and each one becomes an instrument in a song.
salient.why_zh: 点一下街上的楼，每栋楼就成了一首曲子里的一件乐器。

works.title: XAIR
works.description: A design framework, with headset prototypes, for when and how AR assistants should explain their AI decisions, such as why a recipe step or a plant-watering reminder appears, and how much detail to show.
works.description_zh: 一个设计框架（附头显原型），回答 AR 助手应当在何时、以何种方式解释自己的 AI 决策，比如为什么弹出某个菜谱步骤或浇花提醒，以及要展示多少细节。
works.idea_en: Treat 'why is the AI showing me this?' as a first-class AR design question.
works.idea_zh: 把“AI 为什么给我看这个？”当作 AR 设计的头等问题。
works.technique: Built from a literature review, a survey of more than 500 users and expert workshops, XAIR splits explanation design into when to explain, what to explain and how to present it, and was validated with designers and a real-time AR prototype.
works.technique_zh: 基于文献综述、500 多人的问卷调查和专家工作坊，XAIR 把解释设计拆成“何时解释、解释什么、如何呈现”三个问题，并通过设计师研究和实时 AR 原型加以验证。
works.exercise_en: Take an AI-driven AR feature you have built (a label, a recommendation, a reminder) and design three explanation levels: none, a one-word reason, and a tap-to-expand panel; test them with classmates and note when the explanation helps or annoys. Twist: show the explanation only when the user's gaze lingers on the AI output.
works.exercise_zh: 拿一个你做过的 AI 驱动 AR 功能（标签、推荐或提醒），设计三种解释层级：不解释、一个词的理由、点开可展开的面板；请同学测试，记录解释何时有帮助、何时惹人烦。变体：只有当用户的目光停留在 AI 输出上时才显示解释。

video.video_title: XAIR: A Framework of Explainable AI in Augmented Reality

works.title: Your Voices
works.description: At Lincoln Center in New York, a tall revolving tree-like kinetic sculpture turns slowly and lights up with the words and voices of the public during the winter season.
works.description_zh: 在纽约林肯中心，一座高大的旋转树状动态雕塑缓缓转动，在冬季用公众的话语和声音把自己点亮。
works.idea_en: A slowly rotating object lets text be read from any side of a plaza; in AR, rotating an anchored object can replace UI for showing many messages in one place.
works.idea_zh: 缓慢旋转的物体，让文字在广场的任何一边都能被读到：在 AR 里，旋转一个锚定物体可以代替界面，在一个地方展示许多条信息。
works.technique: A motorised rotating structure carries light-emitting text surfaces, and contributed voice recordings are likely cued in sync with the lighting.
works.technique_zh: 电机驱动的旋转结构承载发光的文字面，公众投稿的录音推测与灯光同步播放。
works.exercise_en: Place a slowly rotating AR 'tree' in a courtyard whose branches display short messages recorded by classmates; the message facing the user plays aloud. Twist: speaking into the phone adds your voice as a new glowing branch.
works.exercise_zh: 在院子里放一棵缓慢旋转的 AR「树」，树枝上显示同学录下的短句，朝向用户的那一句会被朗读出来。变体：对着手机说话，就会长出一根带着你声音的新发光枝条。

video.video_title: Es Devlin honours ‘Your Voices’ through a revolving kinetic sculpture in NYC

works.title: arGPT fact-checking on the Monocle
works.description: The Monocle clip-on display runs arGPT, an always-on ChatGPT assistant that can translate, act as a tour guide or fact-check what someone just said, showing the answer in a tiny eyepiece.
works.description_zh: Monocle 夹片显示器运行 arGPT，这是一个常驻的 ChatGPT 助手，可以翻译、当导游，或对别人刚说的话进行事实核查，答案显示在小小的目镜里。
works.idea_en: A fact-checker that sits on your glasses during a conversation.
works.idea_zh: 一个在对话时坐在你眼镜上的事实核查员。
works.technique: Audio captured by the Monocle is transcribed on a paired phone, sent to ChatGPT with a fact-checking prompt, and the short answer is streamed back to the micro-display.
works.technique_zh: Monocle 录下的声音在配对手机上转写，连同事实核查提示发给 ChatGPT，简短答案再传回微显示屏。
works.exercise_en: Record a 20-second claim, transcribe it and ask an LLM to rate it true, false or unclear, showing the verdict in a headset viewer. Twist: fact-check a classmate's story about their weekend.
works.exercise_zh: 录下一段 20 秒的说法，转写后让大语言模型判断真、假或不确定，把结论显示在头戴支架里。变体：核查同学讲的周末故事。

video.video_title: Fact Checking with arGPT for Monocle AR Wearable by Brilliant Labs

works.title: distanze
works.description: A musical instrument for two players: a camera tracks both bodies and the distances between their noses, hips and hands control a synthesiser, so empty space becomes an invisible interface for music.
works.description_zh: 一件两人演奏的乐器：摄像头追踪两人身体，他们的鼻子、臀部和手之间的距离控制合成器，空无一物的空间成了看不见的音乐界面。
works.idea_en: Play music with the space between two bodies.
works.idea_zh: 用两个身体之间的空间演奏音乐。
works.technique: A machine-learning pose model analyses the camera image, and distances between chosen body keypoints of the two players are mapped to synthesiser parameters.
works.technique_zh: 机器学习姿态模型分析摄像头画面，两位演奏者指定身体关键点之间的距离被映射为合成器参数。
works.exercise_en: With ml5.js pose detection, map the distance between two people's wrists to pitch and between their heads to volume. Twist: add a third person whose presence changes the scale.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ml5.js 姿态识别，把两人手腕之间的距离映射为音高、头部之间的距离映射为音量；变体：加入第三人，他的出现会改变音阶。

video.video_title: distanze

works.title: the space in between
works.description: An immersive installation at Scottsdale Museum of Contemporary Art: in a dark gallery, minimal lines and planes of projected light respond to visitors' movements with sound, turning the room into a playful audiovisual space.
works.description_zh: 斯科茨代尔当代艺术博物馆（SMoCA）的沉浸式装置：在黑暗的展厅里，极简的投影光线和光面随观众的移动与声音作出反应，把整个空间变成一个好玩的视听场域。
works.idea_en: Make the empty space between people and walls the thing that reacts.
works.idea_zh: 让人与墙之间的“空白”成为会回应的主体。
works.technique: Visitors are tracked in the gallery (likely with depth or infrared cameras) and their positions drive projected geometry and sound in real time.
works.technique_zh: 展厅中的观众被追踪（推测使用深度或红外摄像头），他们的位置实时驱动投影几何和声音。
works.exercise_en: In a darkened classroom, project a single line across the floor that bends toward the nearest person tracked by a webcam. Twist: when two people approach each other, the line breaks into two.
works.exercise_zh: 在关灯的教室里，向地面投出一条线，让它弯向摄像头追踪到的最近的人；变体：当两个人彼此靠近时，这条线断成两条。

video.video_title: ROELOF KNOL AT SMOCA

works.title: 3DColAR
works.description: In a head-worn AR display, users pick colours from 3D colour spaces such as an RGB cube floating in the air, then paint a virtual 3D figure with a virtual pen they can grasp or directly with their fingertip.
works.description_zh: 在头戴式 AR 显示中，用户从漂浮在空中的 RGB 立方体等三维色彩空间里取色，然后用可以抓起的虚拟画笔，或直接用指尖，为一个虚拟三维人偶上色。
works.idea_en: Pick colours by reaching into a floating colour cube and paint holograms with your finger.
works.idea_zh: 伸手到漂浮的色彩立方体里取色，再用手指给全息物体上色。
works.technique: Mid-air hand tracking drives both 2D sliders and 3D colour-space widgets (RGB cube, HSV shapes), and surface painting writes colour into the model's texture where the tracked pen tip or fingertip touches it.
works.technique_zh: 空中手部追踪同时驱动二维滑块和三维色彩空间控件（RGB 立方体、HSV 形体）；上色时，在被追踪的笔尖或指尖接触模型的位置把颜色写入模型贴图。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR or Quest scene with a floating RGB cube: pinch inside it to pick a colour, then touch a 3D model to paint it. Twist: sample colours from real objects in the passthrough view instead of the cube.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 Quest 做一个漂浮的 RGB 立方体：在立方体内捏合取色，再触碰三维模型为它上色。变体：不用立方体，而是从透视画面里的真实物体上吸取颜色。

video.video_title: 3DColAR : Exploring 3D Color Selection and Surface Painting for Head Worn AR using Hand Gestures

works.title: AI Product Genie
works.description: Built right after Stable Diffusion came out: you speak a wish to a genie, it generates a custom product design such as a printed shirt or a plush toy, previews it in AR, and sends it to on-demand production.
works.description_zh: Stable Diffusion 一发布团队就做了这个“精灵”：你对它说出愿望，它生成定制商品图案（比如印花衬衫或毛绒玩具），在 AR 中预览，然后直接下单按需生产。
works.idea_en: Speak a wish, see the custom product in your room, buy it instantly.
works.idea_zh: 说出一个愿望，就能在房间里看到为你定制的商品并立刻买下。
works.technique: Speech becomes a Stable Diffusion prompt, the generated image is applied as a texture to a 3D product template shown in AR, and print-on-demand fulfilment likely sits behind the buy button.
works.technique_zh: 语音被转成 Stable Diffusion 提示词，生成的图像贴到 3D 商品模板上在 AR 中展示，购买按钮背后很可能接入按需印制。
works.exercise_en: Build a pipeline where a spoken prompt generates an image (any text-to-image API) that is wrapped onto a 3D mug or T-shirt and placed in AR. Twist: let a second student remix the wish by voice before it is placed.
works.exercise_zh: 搭一条流程：用语音提示生成图片（任意文生图 API），贴到 3D 马克杯或 T 恤上并放进 AR；变体：放置前让另一位同学用语音“改写”这个愿望。

works.title: AR Portal Gun
works.description: A working portal gun on a phone: you shoot two portals onto the walls of his living room or office and look through one to see the room from the other portal's position, running in real time.
works.description_zh: 手机上的一把能用的传送门枪：在他家客厅或办公室的墙上射出两个传送门，从一个门看进去，就能看到从另一个门位置看到的房间，实时运行。
works.idea_en: Shoot portals into real walls and see your own room from somewhere else.
works.idea_zh: 在真实墙面上射出传送门，从别的位置看见自己的房间。
works.technique: The rooms were pre-scanned with Metascan and aligned with Snap's Custom Landmarker, so the lens can render the scanned 3D room from the second portal's viewpoint; LiDAR or ML depth handles the wall hits.
works.technique_zh: 房间事先用 Metascan 扫描，并用 Snap 的 Custom Landmarker 对齐，因此 Lens 能从第二个传送门的视角渲染扫描出的三维房间；墙面命中由 LiDAR 或机器学习深度完成。
works.exercise_en: Scan a room with Polycam, load the model into a WebXR or Unity scene aligned to the real room, and place a portal whose view is rendered by a second camera at another spot. Twist: let the user tap to move the exit portal.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Polycam 扫描一个房间，把模型导入与真实房间对齐的 WebXR 或 Unity 场景，放一个传送门，门内画面由放在另一处的第二台相机渲染；变体：让用户点击来移动出口传送门。

salient.why_en: Shoot two portals onto real walls and look through one to see your room from the other.
salient.why_zh: 在真实的墙上打出两个传送门，透过一个门，从另一个门的位置看自己的房间。

works.title: AR Treasure Hunt
works.description: A pirate scavenger hunt that adapts to your room: a cannon faces the nearest wall and blasts a hole in it, minigames lead you on, and a hand-drawn pirate map of your actual surroundings shows the red X, made with Liisi Mononen at GoSpooky.
works.description_zh: 一个会适应你房间的海盗寻宝游戏：大炮会对准最近的墙并在上面轰出一个洞，一系列小游戏引导你前进，最后一张按你真实环境绘制的手绘风海盗地图标出红色 X；与 Liisi Mononen 在 GoSpooky 合作完成。
works.idea_en: Turn a scan of your own room into a pirate treasure map.
works.idea_zh: 把你自己房间的扫描结果变成一张海盗藏宝图。
works.technique: Real-time world meshing (LiDAR, with a machine-learning fallback) builds a model of the room; the map is rendered from that mesh in a hand-drawn style, and debris uses baked camera textures so the 'broken wall' matches the real one.
works.technique_zh: 实时世界网格（LiDAR，无 LiDAR 时用机器学习兜底）生成房间模型；地图基于这个网格以手绘风格渲染，碎片使用烘焙的摄像头贴图，让“被打破的墙”与真实墙面一致。
works.exercise_en: Use a LiDAR phone or WebXR plane detection to find the largest wall in the room and place an AR target there; draw a top-down sketch map of the detected planes. Twist: hide the treasure behind the wall so players must walk to find it.
works.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的手机或 WebXR 平面检测找出房间里最大的一面墙，在上面放一个 AR 靶子，并把检测到的平面画成俯视草图地图；变体：把宝藏藏在墙后，玩家必须走过去才能找到。

video.video_title: Treasure Hunt - An AR Scavenger Hunt Game

works.title: AR VJing + Volumetric Video
works.description: A dancer captured as volumetric video at the Rememory studio appears as a small hologram on a desk; hitting keys on a controller switches the VFX Graph effects (leaves, rain, orbits) that wrap around her body.
works.description_zh: 在 Rememory 棚里拍下的体积视频舞者，化作桌上的一个小全息人像；敲击控制器按键就能切换缠绕在她身体周围的 VFX Graph 特效（落叶、雨、环绕轨道）。
works.idea_en: VJ a captured human body in AR the way you would VJ a video clip.
works.idea_zh: 像给视频片段打 VJ 一样，在 AR 里给一段被捕捉下来的人体打 VJ。
works.technique: Depthkit Studio exports the capture as an mp4 with packed colour and depth plus a JSON of camera metadata; Unity decodes each frame into a point cloud whose positions feed VFX Graph emitters, and live input switches between effect graphs.
works.technique_zh: Depthkit Studio 把拍摄结果导出成打包了颜色与深度的 mp4，外加记录相机参数的 JSON；Unity 逐帧把它解码成点云，点的位置再喂给 VFX Graph 发射器，实时输入负责在不同特效之间切换。
works.exercise_en: Record a friend with an iPhone LiDAR volumetric app (or Record3D), play the clip back in AR Foundation as points, and bind three VFX Graph looks to three on-screen buttons. Twist: let the music's beat, not the buttons, trigger the switches.
works.exercise_zh: 用 iPhone LiDAR 体积拍摄 App（或 Record3D）拍一位朋友，在 AR Foundation 里把片段以点云回放，并把三种 VFX Graph 风格绑定到三个屏幕按钮。变体：不用按钮，改由音乐节拍来触发切换。
