works.title: Accelerating Dimension
works.description: Dancers act as game players who invite the audience into a multisensory adventure mixing live improvisation, motion capture, projections and AR, moving between physical and virtual dimensions.
works.description_zh: 舞者化身游戏玩家，邀请观众进入一场多感官冒险，把现场即兴、动作捕捉、投影和 AR 混在一起，在物理与虚拟维度之间穿梭。
works.idea_en: A dance show structured like a game that the audience co-plays.
works.idea_zh: 一场像游戏一样组织、由观众一起“玩”的舞蹈演出。
works.technique: Motion-capture suits drive projected avatars while AR views on audience devices add virtual layers to the room, with game-like choices shaping the sequence (details likely vary by version).
works.technique_zh: 动作捕捉服驱动投影中的化身，观众设备上的 AR 画面为空间添加虚拟层，类似游戏的选择决定段落顺序（细节很可能因版本而异）。
works.exercise_en: Design a three-level 'dance game': each level is a movement task, and the audience votes with phones which projected world the dancers enter next. Twist: add one AR object that only phone viewers can see and the dancers must react to by listening to them.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个三关的“舞蹈游戏”：每关是一个动作任务，观众用手机投票决定舞者接下来进入哪个投影世界；变体：加入一个只有手机观众能看到的 AR 物体，舞者只能靠观众的提示作出反应。

video.video_title: Accelerating Dimension 加速次元 (2022)_trailer

works.title: Anime Speed Lines
works.description: Manga-style speed lines burst from the screen edges toward the centre, flickering and pulsing as if the viewer were rushing forward.
works.description_zh: 漫画式的速度线从画面边缘向中心迸射、闪烁、跳动，仿佛观者正在向前冲。
works.idea_en: Borrow the manga shorthand for speed and surprise as a live camera effect.
works.idea_zh: 把漫画表现速度和惊讶的符号变成实时镜头效果。
works.technique: A full-screen post-process generates radial lines procedurally in polar coordinates with animated noise, masking the centre with an adjustable vignette.
works.technique_zh: 全屏后期在极坐标下用动态噪声程序化生成放射线，并用可调的暗角遮住中心。
works.exercise_en: Apply the speed lines to a phone's AR camera feed and trigger them when the phone moves fast. Twist: the lines point toward the nearest detected face.
works.exercise_zh: 把速度线用在手机 AR 相机画面上，手机快速移动时触发。变体：速度线指向画面中最近的人脸。

works.title: Augmented Keyboard
works.description: A tracked physical keyboard on Quest 2 gets one smart virtual screen and context-aware overlays instead of a wall of virtual monitors.
works.idea_zh: 给实体键盘配一块智能虚拟屏幕，而不是一堆虚拟显示器。

video.video_title: In the Metaverse computers are semi-virtual : Augmented Keyboard - Meta Quest 2

works.technique: A tracked-keyboard SDK provides the keyboard pose, and a single virtual screen plus context overlays are placed relative to it instead of fixed in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 给真实键盘上方挂一块 AR 小屏幕，只显示当前正在输入的一行文字；变体：输入时根据文字情绪改变屏幕颜色。
works.description_zh: 在 Quest 2 上，被追踪的实体键盘配上一块智能虚拟屏幕和随情境变化的叠加信息，而不是一整面墙的虚拟显示器。
works.idea_en: Pair a physical keyboard with one smart virtual screen instead of a wall of virtual monitors.
works.technique_zh: 键盘追踪 SDK 提供键盘的位姿，单块虚拟屏幕和情境叠加信息都相对于键盘放置，而不是固定在房间中。
works.exercise_en: Hang a small AR screen above a real keyboard that shows only the line you are currently typing. Twist: change the screen color according to the mood of the text as you type.

works.title: Augmented Reality Dakota Landmap of the Twin Cities
works.description: An illustrated map of the Twin Cities with Dakota place names that becomes a 3D animated landscape when viewed through Adobe Aero.
works.idea_zh: 一张用达科他语地名重绘的城市地图，在AR中立体动起来
works.technique: An Adobe Aero scene anchors layered 3D illustrations and animations to the printed map image.
works.exercise_zh: 画一张本地区地图，标上老地名或方言名，用Adobe Aero让地标立体弹出；变化：每个地标点开后播放一段关于它的声音。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Dakota Landmap of the Twin Cities

works.description_zh: 一幅标注了达科他语地名的双子城插画地图，通过 Adobe Aero 观看时会变成立体的动画地景。
works.idea_en: A city map redrawn with Dakota place names comes alive in 3D through AR.
works.technique_zh: Adobe Aero 场景将分层的三维插画和动画锚定在印刷地图的图像上。
works.exercise_en: Draw a map of your local area labeled with old or dialect place names, and use Adobe Aero to make the landmarks pop up in 3D. Twist: tapping each landmark plays a sound clip about it.

works.title: Augmented Shadow: Chasing Stars in Shadow
works.description: An immersive room where visitors carry lanterns among white objects; shadow children cross between 2D shadows and 3D objects, fishing and chasing stars as the lights move.
works.description_zh: 一个沉浸式房间里，观众提着灯在白色物体之间走动；影子孩子在二维影子和三维物体之间穿梭，随着灯光移动去钓鱼、追星星。
works.idea_en: Scale a tabletop shadow trick into a room-sized story that visitors light up themselves.
works.idea_zh: 把桌面上的影子戏法放大成房间尺度的故事，由观众自己点亮。
works.technique: Several tracked handheld lights act as virtual light sources; projectors render consistent synthetic shadows and animated characters on walls and floors in real time.
works.technique_zh: 多个被追踪的手持灯作为虚拟光源，投影仪实时在墙面和地面上渲染一致的合成影子和动画角色。
works.exercise_en: In a dark corner, give two students tracked flashlights and project a shared shadow scene where a character runs toward whichever light is closer. Twist: the character only becomes 3D (a physical cut-out) when both lights meet.
works.exercise_zh: 在昏暗的角落给两位同学各一支被追踪的手电筒，投出一个共享影子场景，角色会跑向离它更近的那束光；变体：只有两束光相遇时，角色才会“变成”立体的实物剪纸。

video.video_title: Augmented Shadow: Chasing Stars in Shadow (Trailer)

works.title: B-Handy
works.description: Wearing an AR headset, a user measures objects and distances in hand-lengths: the system tracks the hand and lays virtual copies of it end to end in space, so body-based measuring no longer relies on counting in your head.
works.description_zh: 戴上 AR 头显后，用户可以用“几只手长”来量物体和距离：系统追踪手，并在空间中把它的虚拟复制品首尾相接地排开，用身体测量时不再需要在脑子里默数。
works.idea_en: Your hand becomes a ruler that copies itself across space.
works.idea_zh: 你的手变成一把会自我复制、在空间里铺开的尺子。
works.technique: Hand tracking on an optical see-through headset records the hand's pose and size, then places virtual duplicates of the hand mesh at successive positions to visualise the measurement.
works.technique_zh: 光学透视头显上的手部追踪记录手的姿态和尺寸，然后在连续位置上放置手部网格的虚拟复制品，把测量过程可视化。
works.exercise_en: In a hand-tracked AR app (Quest passthrough or Lens Studio), let users stamp copies of their hand along a table edge and show the total in hands and centimetres. Twist: measure with your foot, or your whole body lying down.
works.exercise_zh: 在支持手部追踪的 AR 应用（Quest 透视或 Lens Studio）中，让用户沿桌边像盖章一样放下手的复制品，并显示总长是几只手、多少厘米。变体：用脚，或者整个人躺下来当尺子。

video.video_title: B-Handy: An Augmented Reality System for Biomechanical Measurement

works.title: Barragán wearable NFT drop with visual effects
works.description: A drop with the Mexican label Barragán in which each digital garment carries its own effect, such as a shirt that burns up, a dress with an animated oil-slick print and an X-rayed pocket vest, all worn in AR through the app.
works.description_zh: 与墨西哥品牌 Barragán 合作的数字服装系列，每件衣服都带有专属特效：会燃烧殆尽的衬衫、印着流动油膜图案的连衣裙、像 X 光片一样透视的口袋背心，都能在 App 里以 AR 形式穿上。
works.idea_en: A garment can do what fabric cannot: burn, flow or turn transparent while you wear it.
works.idea_zh: 衣服可以做到布料做不到的事：穿在身上时燃烧、流动或变得透明。
works.technique: Garments are authored as 3D assets with animated shaders and particle effects, then attached to the tracked body in the try-on engine so the effect plays on the wearer in real time.
works.technique_zh: 服装被制作成带动画着色器和粒子特效的 3D 资产，再挂到试穿引擎追踪到的身体上，让特效实时在穿着者身上播放。
works.exercise_en: Design one AR garment whose material changes over time (burning, melting, freezing) using a shader graph and body tracking in Lens Studio or Effect House. Twist: the effect triggers only when the wearer strikes a specific pose.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Lens Studio 或 Effect House 里用着色器图和人体追踪设计一件会随时间改变材质（燃烧、融化、结冰）的 AR 服装；变体：只有当穿着者摆出某个特定姿势时特效才会触发。

video.video_title: Barragan’s iconic “Pocket vest” is presented as a limited edition #wearable NFT. 10 #AR tokens for 0,1 ETH each are available to purchase on @rarible or directly through the ZERO10 app. https://t.co/W

works.title: BibcamStage: live show at Channel 22
works.description: In a live audiovisual set, iPhone LiDAR recordings of city streets are replayed as volumetric scenes with particles and glitches, while generative music plays from Bitwig.
works.description_zh: 在一场现场视听表演中，用 iPhone LiDAR 录下的城市街景被当作体积场景回放，加上粒子和故障特效，同时 Bitwig 播放生成音乐。
works.idea_en: Everyday walks recorded with a phone become stage material.
works.idea_zh: 用手机记录的日常散步，成了舞台素材。
works.technique: Bibcam videos store color, depth, human stencil and camera pose in one frame; Unity decodes them to rebuild the scene in 3D and applies VFX Graph effects synced to the music.
works.technique_zh: Bibcam 视频在一帧中存着颜色、深度、人像遮罩和相机位姿，Unity 解码后在三维中重建场景，并加上与音乐同步的 VFX Graph 特效。
works.exercise_en: Record a short walk with a LiDAR phone (Record3D or Metavido), replay it as a point cloud on your desk with AR Foundation, and set it to music. Twist: the scene rebuilds only on the beat.
works.exercise_zh: 用 LiDAR 手机（Record3D 或 Metavido）录一段散步，用 AR Foundation 在桌上以点云回放，并配上音乐。变体：场景只在节拍上重建。

video.video_title: Audio Visual Live Performance at Channel 22 (Highlights)

works.title: Biomolecular design in Realtalk
works.description: Scientists design proteins together on a Realtalk table, manipulating printed pages and physical controls that drive projected molecular models.
works.idea_zh: 科学家围着桌子，用纸和实物一起设计蛋白质分子。

video.video_title: Biomolecular design in Realtalk, Jul 2022

works.technique: Printed pages and physical controls such as knobs are tracked by Realtalk's camera system, and their state feeds a molecular modeling program whose output is projected onto the table for the group to manipulate together.
works.exercise_zh: 用俯视投影展示一个分子或数据模型，用贴了标记的纸条当“参数旋钮”（旋转角度被摄像头读取），多人同时操作不同参数；变体：换成你所在专业的一个复杂模型，看实体化是否帮助讨论。
works.description_zh: 科学家们在 Realtalk 桌面上一起设计蛋白质，通过操作打印的纸页和实体控件来驱动投影出的分子模型。
works.idea_en: Scientists gather around a table and design protein molecules together with paper and physical objects.
works.technique_zh: 打印纸页和旋钮等实体控件由 Realtalk 的摄像头系统追踪，其状态被输入分子建模程序，程序输出再投影到桌面上，供小组共同操作。
works.exercise_en: Show a molecule or data model with a top-down projector and use marker-tagged paper strips as parameter knobs whose rotation the camera reads, so several people can adjust different parameters at once. Twist: swap in a complex model from your own field and see whether making it physical helps the discussion.

works.title: Body Confetti lens
works.description: A Snapchat lens tracks the full body so bursts of confetti shoot out from the right limbs as you move and dance.
works.idea_zh: 跳舞时彩带从四肢喷出来。

video.video_title: Make Your Body a Confetti Party with Sallia Goldstein | Behind the Lens

works.technique: Lens Studio body-mesh tracking provides limb positions and velocities that trigger particle emitters attached to the body.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 身体追踪（或 MediaPipe Pose）让挥手时手上喷出彩纸；加一个变化：动作越快彩纸颜色越暖。
works.description_zh: 一个追踪全身的 Snapchat 滤镜：随着你移动和跳舞，彩色纸屑会从相应的肢体上喷射而出。
works.idea_en: Confetti bursts out of your limbs as you dance.
works.technique_zh: Lens Studio 的身体网格追踪提供肢体的位置和速度，用来触发附着在身体上的粒子发射器。
works.exercise_en: Use Lens Studio body tracking (or MediaPipe Pose) to make confetti spray from your hand when you wave. Twist: the faster you move, the warmer the confetti colors.

works.title: Bold and Brash IRL
works.description: A real copy of Squidward's famous 'Bold and Brash' painting from SpongeBob is augmented with a silly AR scene that recreates the cartoon moment, made with Cyriel Verkuijlen.
works.description_zh: 一幅真实复制的《海绵宝宝》中章鱼哥名画“Bold and Brash”，被叠加上一段搞笑的 AR 场景，重现动画里的经典桥段；与 Cyriel Verkuijlen 合作完成。
works.idea_en: Let a famous cartoon painting act out its own scene.
works.idea_zh: 让一幅著名的卡通画自己演出它的那场戏。
works.technique: The physical painting is tracked as an image marker in Lens Studio, and animated 3D elements modelled in Houdini are anchored to its frame.
works.technique_zh: 在 Lens Studio 中把实体画作当作图像标记追踪，把在 Houdini 中建模的三维动画元素锚定到画框上。
works.exercise_en: Pick a poster or painting in the school, track it as an image target and animate one element leaving the frame. Twist: the element reacts differently when the viewer steps closer.
works.exercise_zh: 在学校里选一张海报或画，把它作为图像目标追踪，让画中的一个元素动起来并走出画框；变体：观众靠近时，这个元素做出不同的反应。

video.video_title: Bold and Brash irl

works.title: Bringing AR to the Streets of NYC
works.description: A short street intervention in which virtual objects appear among passers-by on New York sidewalks.
works.idea_zh: 把 AR 奇观直接投放到纽约街头路人中间。

video.video_title: Bringing AR to the streets of NYC

works.technique: Objects are placed on detected ground planes in world-tracked space outdoors, relying on SLAM stability while real passers-by move through the camera view (likely with people occlusion).
works.exercise_zh: 在校园人行道上放一组巨型虚拟物体并开启人体遮挡，拍一段路人从旁经过的视频；变体：让物体只在有人经过时才出现。
works.description_zh: 一次简短的街头介入：虚拟物体出现在纽约人行道上的往来行人之间。
works.idea_en: Drop AR spectacles straight into the crowds on New York streets.
works.technique_zh: 物体被放置在户外世界追踪空间中检测到的地面平面上，依赖 SLAM 的稳定性，同时有真实行人在摄像头画面中穿行（可能使用了人体遮挡）。
works.exercise_en: Place a group of giant virtual objects on a campus sidewalk with people occlusion turned on, and film passers-by walking past. Twist: make the objects appear only when someone walks by.

works.title: Causality-preserving Asynchronous Reality
works.description: While a user works in a headset, a colleague comes in and writes on the whiteboard; the room is captured volumetrically and, when the user takes a break, only the events that matter are replayed in causal order so they can catch up.
works.description_zh: 用户戴着头显工作时，一位同事进来在白板上写字；房间被体积化记录下来，等用户休息时，系统只按因果顺序回放重要的事件，让他补看刚才发生的事。
works.idea_en: Let immersed users experience real-world events later, in the right causal order.
works.idea_zh: 让沉浸中的用户稍后再按正确的因果顺序经历现实中发生的事。
works.technique: Depth cameras reconstruct the room as a live point cloud, the system detects causal dependencies between actions and objects, and selectively plays back segments of reality in the headset.
works.technique_zh: 深度相机把房间实时重建为点云，系统检测动作与物体之间的因果依赖，并在头显中有选择地回放现实片段。
works.exercise_en: Record a phone video of a desk while someone moves objects, then build an AR viewer that shows ghost replays of each change anchored where it happened. Twist: replay the events in reverse and see if the story still makes sense.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机录一段有人在桌上挪动物品的视频，再做一个 AR 查看器，把每次变化以“幽灵”回放的形式锚定在发生的位置。变体：倒序回放这些事件，看故事是否还说得通。

video.video_title: Asynchronous Reality — where everything remains real except the flow of time #MR #VR #productivity

works.title: Cel Shading (Devlog 3)
works.description: Characters and props switch from smooth lighting to flat bands of light and shadow with sharp specular highlights, supporting several lights and cast shadows.
works.description_zh: 角色和道具从平滑光照变成扁平的明暗色带和锐利高光，并支持多个光源和投射阴影。
works.idea_en: Quantise light into a few bands and a 3D model reads like hand-painted animation.
works.idea_zh: 把光照量化成几个色阶，三维模型就像手绘动画。
works.technique: A custom URP lit shader computes diffuse, specular and rim terms per light and passes them through smoothstep thresholds, while sampling URP's shadow maps for the main and additional lights.
works.technique_zh: 自定义的 URP 光照着色器为每个光源计算漫反射、高光和边缘光，再用 smoothstep 阈值把它们分成色阶，同时采样 URP 的主光源和附加光源阴影贴图。
works.exercise_en: Use the cel shader on AR characters and drive the main light from AR Foundation light estimation so the toon shadows match the real room. Twist: add a slider that lets viewers change the number of light bands live.
works.exercise_zh: 把卡通着色器用在 AR 角色上，并用 AR Foundation 的光照估计驱动主光源，让卡通阴影和真实房间一致。变体：加一个滑块，让观众实时改变明暗色阶的数量。

video.video_title: Cel Shading - Devlog 3

works.title: Character Mashup (Lensathon 2022)
works.description: Users custom-build a mashup avatar, bring it to life with body tracking, and share it with friends through connected lenses.
works.idea_zh: 拼一个自己的怪物化身，用身体驱动它，再和朋友同屏互动。

video.video_title: Character Mashup - Lensathon 2022

works.technique: Selected body parts are assembled onto a rig driven by full-body tracking, and connected lenses sync avatars between users.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生用纸画出头、身体、腿三部分，拼成一个角色并用 MediaPipe Pose 驱动；加一个变化：和同桌交换一个部件。
works.description_zh: 用户自己拼装一个混搭化身，用身体追踪让它活起来，再通过联机滤镜与朋友分享。
works.idea_en: Assemble your own monster avatar, drive it with your body, then play with friends on the same screen.
works.technique_zh: 选定的身体部件被组装到一套由全身追踪驱动的骨骼绑定上，联机滤镜在用户之间同步化身。
works.exercise_en: Have students draw a head, a body and legs on paper, combine them into a character and drive it with MediaPipe Pose. Twist: swap one part with your deskmate.

works.title: Charlie Parker memorial Custom Landmarker
works.description: Using Lens Studio's Custom Landmarker, a real Charlie Parker memorial statue is scanned so AR effects wrap precisely around the sculpture on site.
works.idea_zh: 把真实的纪念雕像变成 AR 的'舞台'，特效精确贴合雕像。

video.video_title: Snapchat Lens Studio - Custom Landmarkers w/ Charlie Parker memorial - Experiment #1

works.technique: A pre-scanned 3D model of the statue is used as a tracking target so the lens localizes against the physical monument and aligns effects to it.
works.exercise_zh: 选校园里一座雕塑或门牌，用 Lens Studio Custom Landmarker/8th Wall 做一个贴合它的 AR 特效；加一个变化：特效讲述这件物体的历史。
works.description_zh: 借助 Lens Studio 的 Custom Landmarker，对一座真实的 Charlie Parker 纪念雕像进行扫描，让 AR 特效在现场精确地环绕雕塑。
works.idea_en: Turn a real memorial statue into an AR stage, with effects fitted precisely to its shape.
works.technique_zh: 以预先扫描的雕像三维模型作为追踪目标，使滤镜相对实体纪念碑完成定位，并将特效与其对齐。
works.exercise_en: Pick a sculpture or door sign on campus and build an AR effect fitted to it with Lens Studio Custom Landmarker or 8th Wall. Twist: make the effect tell the history of the object.

works.title: Choreographic Coding Lab at A+E Lab (CCL-14)
works.description: Documentation of the UK's first Choreographic Coding Lab in Chatham, where about twenty coders and dancers spent a week prototyping mocap particles, projected visuals and Isadora patches with facilitators from Motion Bank, Troika Ranch and Studio Wayne McGregor.
works.description_zh: 记录在查塔姆举办的英国首届 Choreographic Coding Lab：约二十位程序员和舞者用一周时间，与来自 Motion Bank、Troika Ranch 和 Studio Wayne McGregor 的引导者一起，做出动捕粒子、投影视觉和 Isadora 补丁等原型。
works.idea_en: A one-week lab format where code meets choreographic thinking, and dancers test prototypes on stage the same day.
works.idea_zh: 为期一周的实验室形式，让代码与编舞思维相遇，舞者当天就在舞台上测试原型。
works.technique: Participants worked from Motion Bank mocap datasets and Piecemaker annotations, and with live mocap suits, Isadora and TouchDesigner-style tools to drive projections from movement.
works.technique_zh: 参与者使用 Motion Bank 的动捕数据集和 Piecemaker 标注，并结合现场动捕服、Isadora 以及类似 TouchDesigner 的工具，用动作驱动投影。
works.exercise_en: Run a mini lab: pair each coder with a dancer, give them one mocap clip or webcam pose stream, and have each pair show a projected prototype within two hours. Twist: each pair must use one card from a choreographic prompt deck as its rule.
works.exercise_zh: 办一个迷你实验室：每位程序员与一位舞者组队，给他们一段动捕数据或一路摄像头姿态流，两小时内各组展示一个投影原型；变体：每组必须抽一张编舞提示卡，把它当作系统规则。

video.video_title: A+E Lab X Choreographic Coding Lab

works.title: Circle intersections: interactive magnets on whiteboard
works.description: Magnets placed on a whiteboard each get a projected circle of light; where the circles overlap, their intersections are drawn, so moving a magnet reshapes the whole geometric composition.
works.description_zh: 放在白板上的每块磁铁都有一个投影光圈；光圈重叠的地方会画出交点，移动一块磁铁就会改变整个几何构图。
works.idea_en: Play with geometry by hand: magnets are the control points of a live diagram.
works.idea_zh: 用手玩几何：磁铁就是一张实时图表的控制点。
works.technique: A camera detects the magnets' positions on the board, circles are computed around each one, their intersection points are solved geometrically, and the result is projected back onto the board.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头检测磁铁在白板上的位置，围绕每块磁铁计算一个圆，用几何方法求出圆与圆的交点，再把结果投影回白板上。
works.exercise_en: Track coloured magnets or bottle caps on a whiteboard with a webcam and project a circle around each, drawing a dot at every intersection. Twist: map the number of intersections to a musical chord.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头追踪白板上的彩色磁铁或瓶盖，在每个周围投出一个圆，并在每个交点处画一个点；变体：把交点数量映射成一个音乐和弦。

works.title: City
works.description: Begun in 1970 and opened in 2022, City is a complex of compacted-earth mounds, ramps and concrete forms about 2.4 kilometres long in a remote Nevada valley; only six visitors a day are admitted.
works.description_zh: 《City》始于 1970 年、2022 年开放，是内华达偏远山谷中长约 2.4 公里、由夯土丘、坡道和混凝土构件组成的建筑群；每天只接待六名访客。
works.idea_en: A walkable abstract architecture in the desert shows how pure geometry at huge scale can feel like a lost civilisation, a mood AR world-builders chase.
works.idea_zh: 沙漠中可以行走的抽象建筑说明，巨大尺度的纯几何能让人感觉像失落的文明，这是 AR 世界构建者追求的氛围。
works.technique: Earth from the site was excavated, compacted and shaped with heavy machinery into mounds and depressions, edged with concrete.
works.technique_zh: 用重型机械把场地的泥土挖出、压实并塑成土丘与凹地，边缘以混凝土收边。
works.exercise_en: Model a large geometric complex (ramps, mounds, sunken courts) in Blender and place it at 1:1 scale on a sports field in AR. Twist: allow only one viewer at a time, so each visit feels solitary.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Blender 中建模一个大型几何建筑群（坡道、土丘、下沉庭院），在 AR 中按 1:1 比例放在运动场上；变体：一次只允许一位观者进入，让每次参观都显得孤独。

video.video_title: Michael Heizer’s Earth Art is Bigger than Yours - the LARGEST Land Art

works.title: City of Sparkles
works.description: An immersive piece in which the audience embodies Zoe, an AI life form, wandering a sparkling New York built from four years of geotagged Twitter posts and reading scattered fragments of human memory.
works.description_zh: 一件沉浸式作品：观众化身 AI 生命体 Zoe，在由四年地理标记推文构成、闪烁着光点的纽约中游走，拾读散落的人类记忆碎片。
works.idea_en: How might an AI perceive our city? Let the audience see it through the AI's eyes.
works.idea_zh: AI 会如何感知我们的城市？让观众通过 AI 的眼睛去看。
works.technique: Geotagged social-media posts are spatialised as sparkles sampled from a photogrammetry model of the real city, and the viewer navigates them as the AI protagonist.
works.technique_zh: 把带地理标记的社交媒体帖子空间化，化作从真实城市摄影测量模型上采样的光点，观众以 AI 主角的身份在其中穿行。
works.exercise_en: Collect 100 geotagged posts or photos around your campus, place them as glowing points on a map-scaled WebXR model, and read them as an AI character looking for meaning. Twist: the AI can only read fragments one word at a time.
works.exercise_zh: 收集校园周边 100 条带地理标记的帖子或照片，在按地图比例的 WebXR 模型上化作发光点，以一个寻找意义的 AI 角色身份阅读它们。变体：AI 每次只能读到碎片中的一个词。

video.video_title: City_Of_Sparkles-website

works.title: Coachella: A Virtual Adventure
works.description: A case study of AR experiences built for Coachella that let festival-goers and remote fans unlock virtual worlds around the event.
works.idea_zh: 为音乐节做一场虚实混合的 AR 探险。

video.video_title: CASE STUDY: Coachella - A Virtual Adventure

works.technique: Location- and marker-triggered Instagram effects deliver themed AR scenes around the festival (likely world-anchored portals and target tracking).
works.exercise_zh: 为学校活动做一个 AR 寻宝：三个场地各扫出一个虚拟场景，集齐解锁终章；加一个变化：线上观众也能用同一特效参与。
works.description_zh: 一个为 Coachella 打造的 AR 体验案例：现场乐迷和远程粉丝都能在活动周边解锁虚拟世界。
works.idea_en: Build an AR adventure for a music festival that mixes the real and the virtual.
works.technique_zh: 由位置和标记触发的 Instagram 特效在音乐节各处呈现主题 AR 场景（大概率使用了锚定在世界空间中的传送门和目标追踪）。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR treasure hunt for a school event where each of three venues reveals a virtual scene and collecting all three unlocks the finale. Twist: online viewers can join with the same effect.

works.title: Color Quantization and Dithering
works.description: A 3D scene is reduced to a handful of colours and ordered-dither patterns, giving it the look of an old handheld console or a printed zine.
works.description_zh: 三维场景被压缩到少数几种颜色和有序抖动图案，看起来像老掌机画面或印刷小册子。
works.idea_en: Fewer colours plus a clever pattern read as a strong style instead of a loss.
works.idea_zh: 更少的颜色加上巧妙的图案，读起来是鲜明的风格，而不是损失。
works.technique: A post-processing pass downsamples the frame, adds a Bayer-matrix threshold offset per pixel, quantizes each channel to a few levels and optionally maps the result to a palette before upscaling with point sampling.
works.technique_zh: 后处理先对画面降采样，给每个像素加上 Bayer 矩阵阈值偏移，把每个通道量化到少数几级，可选地映射到调色板，再用点采样放大。
works.exercise_en: Apply the dithering pass to the phone's AR camera background so the world looks like a Game Boy screen, keeping virtual sprites in the same palette. Twist: switch palettes by pointing the camera at different colour cards.
works.exercise_zh: 把抖动效果应用到手机 AR 的摄像头背景上，让世界看起来像 Game Boy 屏幕，虚拟精灵也用同一调色板。变体：把镜头对准不同颜色的卡片来切换调色板。

video.video_title: Color Quantization and Dithering

works.title: Colorfield Weather App Series
works.description: Virtual AR voxels fall from the sky or expand across a site, leaving trails that 'paint' colour-field paintings onto the environment's topography and architecture.
works.idea_zh: 让AR彩色方块从天而降，在建筑和地形上“画”出色域画
works.technique: AR voxel particles with gravity and forces collide with detected surfaces and leave persistent coloured trails.
works.exercise_zh: 用Unity AR Foundation或网页AR让彩色方块下落并在地面平面上留下颜色；变化：天气数据（温度/风速）决定颜色和下落方向。

video.video_title: Colorfield Weather App Series, 2022+

works.description_zh: 虚拟 AR 体素从天而降或在场地上蔓延，留下的轨迹在环境的地形和建筑上“画”出色域绘画。
works.idea_en: Colored AR blocks fall from the sky and paint color-field paintings across buildings and terrain.
works.technique_zh: 受重力和外力作用的 AR 体素粒子与检测到的表面发生碰撞，并留下持久的彩色轨迹。
works.exercise_en: Use Unity AR Foundation or web AR to drop colored blocks that leave color on the floor plane. Twist: weather data such as temperature and wind speed decides the colors and the direction of the fall.

works.title: Come Home Again
works.description: In the garden of Tate Modern, a large sphere is drawn with 243 species from London's priority list of endangered animals and plants; at dusk it lights up and a choir sings from inside it.
works.description_zh: 在泰特现代美术馆的花园里，一个巨大球体上画满了伦敦优先保护名录中的 243 种濒危动植物；黄昏时球体亮起，合唱团在里面歌唱。
works.idea_en: Drawing hundreds of named species on one lit object makes an abstract list feel like a congregation; AR can turn data about a place into figures that surround the visitor.
works.idea_zh: 把数百个有名字的物种画在同一个发光体上，一份抽象的名单就像一群聚集的生命：AR 也可以把一个地方的数据变成环绕观众的形象。
works.technique: Hand-drawn species are printed on the skin of a domed structure, lit from within and by projection at night, and paired with live choral evensong.
works.technique_zh: 手绘的物种图案印在穹形结构的外皮上，夜间由内部灯光和投影照亮，并配以现场合唱。
works.exercise_en: Collect 20 species that live within 1 km of your school, draw each on paper, and place them on a sphere in AR at a real outdoor spot; tapping a species plays its sound or name. Twist: species fade out if they are locally endangered, leaving gaps in the sphere.
works.exercise_zh: 收集学校一公里内生活的 20 种物种，逐一画在纸上，在户外某处用 AR 把它们贴在一个球体上；点击物种会播放它的声音或名字。变体：本地濒危的物种会逐渐淡去，在球体上留下空洞。

video.video_title: Come Home Again by Es Devlin in Tate Modern Garden

works.title: Controlling a Soccer Game with a Real Ball
works.description: A webcam tracks a real football and his body pose so kicking the actual ball drives a digital football match in Unity.
works.idea_zh: 踢真球，屏幕里的比赛跟着动。

video.video_title: Controlling My Soccer Game With a REAL Ball

works.technique: Python computer vision detects the ball position and the player's pose from a webcam and streams them to Unity, which maps them into the game world.
works.exercise_zh: 用网页摄像头+颜色追踪让一个真实的纸团控制屏幕里的弹球；加一个变化：纸团撞到墙上的某块纸板区域时触发进球动画。
works.description_zh: 网络摄像头追踪一只真实足球和他的身体姿态，于是踢出真球就能驱动 Unity 中的一场数字足球比赛。
works.idea_en: Kick a real ball and the match on screen follows.
works.technique_zh: Python 计算机视觉程序从网络摄像头画面中检测球的位置和玩家姿态，并将数据实时传给 Unity，映射到游戏世界中。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam and color tracking so a real paper ball controls a pinball on screen. Twist: trigger a goal animation when the paper ball hits a particular cardboard area on the wall.

works.title: CyrWheel Visuals and Interactions Research
works.description: An acrobat spins inside an LED Cyr wheel whose light responds to the wheel's own rotation, synchronised with stage lighting, live music and a 3D tracking system.
works.description_zh: 一位杂技演员在一只 LED 西尔轮（Cyr wheel）里旋转，轮子的灯光随自身转动而变化，并与舞台灯光、现场音乐和三维追踪系统同步。
works.idea_en: Let a circus apparatus light itself according to how it moves.
works.idea_zh: 让马戏器械根据自己的运动来点亮自己。
works.technique: A motion sensor embedded in the wheel streams orientation to Chataigne, which drives the wheel's LEDs, Blux stage lighting and music, with position from Augmenta's Pleiades tracker.
works.technique_zh: 嵌在轮子里的运动传感器把方向数据传给 Chataigne，由它驱动轮上的 LED、Blux 舞台灯光和音乐，位置数据来自 Augmenta 的 Pleiades 追踪系统。
works.exercise_en: Tape a phone to a hula hoop or a bike wheel, stream its gyroscope to a laptop, and change projected colours with the rotation speed. Twist: when it stops, the light keeps spinning on the wall.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机绑在呼啦圈或自行车轮上，把陀螺仪数据传到电脑，用转速改变投影颜色；变体：轮子停下时，光还在墙上继续转。

video.video_title: CyrWheel Visuals and Interactions Research

works.title: DISCORDANCE
works.description: Dancers in London and New York, both in full motion capture, meet in the same virtual space, co-present with audience members in VR headsets and with spectators watching in a theatre.
works.description_zh: 伦敦和纽约的舞者都穿着全身动作捕捉服，在同一个虚拟空间相遇，与戴 VR 头显的观众同在，剧场里的观众也在观看。
works.idea_en: Two cities, one virtual stage, three kinds of audience.
works.idea_zh: 两座城市，一个虚拟舞台，三种观众。
works.technique: Motion-capture data from both cities is streamed into a shared real-time VR scene, which is also projected for the theatre audience.
works.technique_zh: 两地的动作捕捉数据实时传入共享的 VR 场景，同时投影给剧场观众。
works.exercise_en: Pair two groups in different rooms, each streaming pose data into one shared web scene, and choreograph a duet where avatars must 'touch' hands. Twist: add a one-second delay and make the delay part of the choreography.
works.exercise_zh: 让不同房间的两组人各自把姿态数据传入同一个网页场景，编一段两人化身必须“碰手”的双人舞；变体：加入一秒延迟，并把延迟编进舞蹈。

video.video_title: DISCORDANCE - trailer2

works.title: Dakota Sacred Hoop Walk
works.description: An AR exhibit that helps visitors understand nature, land and culture from a Dakota perspective through artwork revealed at stations along a walk.
works.idea_zh: 沿着“神圣之环”步道，用AR从达科他视角理解土地
works.technique: Phone-based AR triggered at stations along the path overlays animated Dakota artwork and teachings.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园选4个方位点，用AR分别展示与东南西北相关的自然知识；变化：只有按顺序走完一圈才解锁最后的动画。

video.video_title: New augmented reality exhibit Dakota Sacred Hoop Walk opens

works.description_zh: 一场 AR 展览：沿步道设置的各个站点展示艺术作品，帮助参观者从达科他人的视角理解自然、土地与文化。
works.idea_en: Walk the Sacred Hoop trail and use AR to understand the land from a Dakota perspective.
works.technique_zh: 沿路各站点触发的手机 AR 叠加显示达科他艺术作品动画和相关教诲。
works.exercise_en: Choose four points on campus for the four directions and use AR to show nature knowledge tied to east, south, west and north. Twist: the final animation unlocks only after you walk the full circle in order.

works.title: Death Star Ray Marching Shader
works.description: A Death Star floats in space, rendered not from a mesh but by a shader that marches rays into a signed distance field of a sphere with a carved dish.
works.description_zh: 一颗死星悬浮在太空中；它不是网格，而是着色器沿光线步进一个“挖去碟形凹坑的球体”距离场渲染出来的。
works.idea_en: Two spheres and a subtraction make an iconic shape without a single polygon.
works.idea_zh: 两个球加一次相减，不用一个多边形就能做出标志性的形状。
works.technique: A fragment shader on a cube ray-marches a signed distance field built from a sphere minus a smaller sphere, computes normals from the SDF gradient and shades the result.
works.technique_zh: 在一个立方体上的片元着色器对“大球减小球”的距离场做光线步进，用距离场梯度求法线再着色。
works.exercise_en: Put the ray-marched SDF inside a cube anchored in AR so it looks like a solid object hovering in the room, then add a second SDF that blends with it smoothly. Twist: let the user carve the shape by tapping to subtract spheres.
works.exercise_zh: 把光线步进的距离场放进一个锚定在 AR 里的立方体，让它看起来像悬浮在房间里的实体，再加入第二个距离场与之平滑融合。变体：用户点击就减去一个球，亲手雕刻形状。

video.video_title: Death Star Ray Marching Shader in Unity (Link to tutorial in description)

works.title: Depth lines on paper
works.description: Small paper cards on a dark table each show a projected tunnel of nested glowing squares, making the cards look like holes in the table; sliding a card by hand drags its tunnel along.
works.description_zh: 深色桌面上的几张小纸卡上各自投出层层嵌套的发光方框，看起来像桌面上的洞；用手滑动纸卡，“隧道”也跟着移动。
works.idea_en: A plain card becomes a portal into the table.
works.idea_zh: 一张普通卡片变成通往桌子内部的入口。
works.technique: Card positions are tracked by a camera and nested rectangles are projected with a perspective offset toward a vanishing point, creating a depth illusion on each card.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪纸卡位置，嵌套矩形带着朝向消失点的透视偏移被投影出来，在每张卡片上形成深度错觉。
works.exercise_en: Track paper rectangles on a table with a webcam and project nested shrinking squares onto each to fake a hole. Twist: drop a small virtual ball that falls into whichever hole you slide under it.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头追踪桌上的纸片，在每张上投射层层缩小的方框来伪造一个洞；变体：投下一颗虚拟小球，你把哪个洞滑到它下面，它就掉进哪个洞。

salient.why_en: A plain paper card becomes a hole into the table, and the hole moves when you slide the card.
salient.why_zh: 一张白纸卡变成桌面上的一个洞，推动纸卡，洞也跟着移动。

works.title: Dernière minute
works.description: A 30-minute immersive installation-experience about thresholds, rooted in scattering a father's ashes by the sea: visitors sit and lie on a floor of projected water and particles that ripple, rise and dissolve around them to music by Olivier Mellano.
works.description_zh: 一个 30 分钟的沉浸式装置体验，关于“临界时刻”，源于在海边撒下父亲骨灰的经历：观众坐着或躺在投影出的水面与粒子上，它们随着 Olivier Mellano 的音乐在身边泛起涟漪、上涨、消散。
works.idea_en: A ritual of passage in which the floor you lie on turns into rising water.
works.idea_zh: 一场过渡仪式：你躺着的地面变成了上涨的水。
works.technique: Floor and wall projections of filmed and simulated water are choreographed with a composed soundtrack into a fixed 30-minute sequence, likely with parts that respond to visitors' presence.
works.technique_zh: 地面和墙面投影出拍摄的与模拟的水，与作曲配乐一起编排成固定的 30 分钟序列，很可能其中部分段落会对观众的存在作出反应。
works.exercise_en: Design a five-minute projected ritual for one threshold moment (leaving home, a goodbye): choose one material (water, ash, light), project it on a floor where people lie down, and script how it changes with the music. Twist: let the material react to how still the group stays, measured by a top-down camera.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个“临界时刻”（离家、告别）设计一段 5 分钟的投影仪式：选一种物质（水、灰、光），投在人们躺下的地面上，并写好它如何随音乐变化。变体：用俯拍摄像头测量整组人有多安静，让物质对此作出反应。

video.video_title: Dernière minute - Une installation expérience immersive - trailer

works.title: DigituSync
works.description: Two people wear gloves linked by adjustable mechanical bars, so when a piano teacher curls a finger the learner's finger curls too, and both still feel the real keys.
works.description_zh: 两个人戴上由可调机械杆相连的手套：钢琴老师弯一下手指，学生的手指也跟着弯，而且两个人都还能感受到真实的琴键。
works.idea_en: Physically couple two hands so skills transfer by touch rather than by watching.
works.idea_zh: 把两只手在物理上连起来，让技能靠触觉而不是靠观看来传递。
works.technique: Uses passive four-bar linkages with a variable-length link to transmit finger motion and force between users and tune how strongly the leader intervenes.
works.technique_zh: 利用带可变长度连杆的被动四连杆机构，在两人之间传递手指的动作和力量，并调节引导者的干预强度。
works.exercise_en: Tie two students' index fingers together with elastic bands and a ruler splint, then play a simple phone piano app together; compare accuracy with watching a video tutorial. Twist: loosen the band halfway through to fade out the teacher.
works.exercise_zh: 用橡皮筋和尺子做成夹板，把两名学生的食指连在一起，用手机钢琴 App 合弹一首简单的曲子，并与看视频教程的准确率比较；变体：弹到一半把橡皮筋放松，让“老师”逐渐退出。

video.video_title: DigituSync: A Dual-User Passive Exoskeleton Glove That Adaptively Shares Hand Gestures

works.title: Dithered Hand as Physarum Stimulus
works.description: A dithered image of a hand is fed to a Physarum simulation, and the agents gather along its dots until a living, vein-like hand emerges (Genuary 2022, day 2).
works.description_zh: 把一张抖动处理过的手部图像喂给黏菌模拟，智能体沿着点阵聚集，直到浮现出一只像叶脉一样活着的手（Genuary 2022 第 2 天）。
works.idea_en: An image becomes food: the slime draws a picture by eating it.
works.idea_zh: 图像变成了食物：黏菌靠“吃”它把画面画了出来。
works.technique: The dithered hand texture is added to the trail map as a constant attractant, so agents that sense the trail concentrate on the image's dark dots (likely built on the published Physarum repo).
works.technique_zh: 抖动后的手部纹理作为恒定的吸引物加进痕迹图里，感知痕迹的智能体就会聚集到图像的暗点上（很可能基于公开的黏菌仓库）。
works.exercise_en: Feed the live people-segmentation mask from AR Foundation (or a hand mask from MediaPipe) into the Physarum trail map so slime grows over the user's real hand on screen. Twist: make the mask repel instead of attract, so the slime flees the body.
works.exercise_zh: 把 AR Foundation 的实时人像分割蒙版（或 MediaPipe 的手部蒙版）送进黏菌痕迹图，让黏菌在屏幕上爬满用户真实的手。变体：让蒙版改为排斥，黏菌就会逃离身体。

video.video_title:
Day 2: Dithering.
#Genuary2022

A dithered hand image is used as a stimuli to Physarum. https://t.co/hsB6TNFe7S

works.title: Dots on paper
works.description: A plain sheet of paper on a wooden table becomes a live canvas: dots on the paper drive projected graphics that animate in sync with music, framed exactly by the sheet's edges.
works.description_zh: 木桌上的一张白纸变成实时画布：纸上的点驱动投影图形随音乐同步变化，画面恰好被纸张边缘框住。
works.idea_en: A single sheet of paper is enough as a screen, a controller and a stage.
works.idea_zh: 一张纸就足以同时作为屏幕、控制器和舞台。
works.technique: The sheet is detected and tracked by a camera, dots on it are found by blob detection, and generative graphics are projection-mapped precisely onto the paper (likely).
works.technique_zh: 摄像头检测并追踪纸张，通过色块检测找到纸上的点，再把生成式图形精确地投影映射到纸面上（推测）。
works.exercise_en: Project onto an A4 sheet whose corners are tracked by a webcam, and make dots drawn with a marker become sources of animated ripples. Twist: erasing a dot makes its ripples collapse inward.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头追踪一张 A4 纸的四角并向其投影，让马克笔画上的点成为动画涟漪的源头；变体：擦掉一个点时，它的涟漪会向内塌缩。

works.title: DreamStream
works.description: Instead of watching a flat Twitch stream, spectators step into the streamer's VR world, look over their shoulder, wander off to explore and chat with the player in 3D.
works.description_zh: 观众不再看平面的 Twitch 直播，而是走进主播的 VR 世界，从主播肩后观看、独自走开探索，并在三维空间里和玩家交流。
works.idea_en: Stream the whole world, not just the player's window into it.
works.idea_zh: 直播整个世界，而不只是玩家看世界的那扇窗。
works.technique: Streams 3D scene state and player poses from existing VR apps to remote spectators who render the environment locally with free viewpoints.
works.technique_zh: 从现有 VR 应用中把三维场景状态和玩家位姿流式传给远程观众，观众在本地渲染环境，可自由选择视角。
works.exercise_en: Run a tabletop AR game on one phone and let three spectator phones join the same shared AR anchor so they can walk around the table independently. Twist: give spectators one ability, like dropping a hint marker.
works.exercise_zh: 在一部手机上运行桌面 AR 游戏，让另外三部“观众”手机加入同一个共享 AR 锚点，自由绕着桌子观看；变体：给观众一个能力，比如放下一个提示标记。

video.video_title: DreamStream: Immersive and Interactive Spectating in VR

works.title: Edward Crutchley AR showpiece
works.description: British designer Edward Crutchley's first augmented reality showpiece: a sculptural couture look with a shimmering, wing-like bodice that is worn on a real model inside an ordinary apartment.
works.description_zh: 英国设计师 Edward Crutchley 的第一件增强现实高定作品：一套带有闪烁翅膀状上身结构的雕塑感礼服，穿在普通公寓里的真人模特身上。
works.idea_en: Couture that ignores gravity and fabric cost, worn in an everyday room.
works.idea_zh: 不受重力和面料成本限制的高定礼服，穿在日常房间里。
works.technique: A high-poly couture garment is simulated and rendered on the tracked body in real time, with lighting estimated from the camera image so the piece sits in the room (likely).
works.technique_zh: 高精度的高定服装模型在追踪到的身体上实时模拟和渲染，并根据摄像头画面估计光照，让服装融入房间（推测）。
works.exercise_en: Sketch an 'impossible' accessory (floating wings, orbiting jewels, a halo) and build it as a body-tracked AR effect in Lens Studio or AR Foundation, then shoot it in a plain room. Twist: the accessory must interact with one real object in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 构思一件“不可能存在”的配饰（悬浮的翅膀、环绕身体的宝石、光环），在 Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation 中做成跟随身体的 AR 效果，再在一个普通房间里拍摄；变体：这件配饰必须与房间里的某个真实物体产生互动。

video.video_title: Edward Crutchley’s collaboration sees this same approach towards craftsmanship and artisanal skills, applied in the #digitalfashion space, taking his creative vision beyond what is physically possible

works.title: Electrical Head Actuation
works.description: Electrodes on the neck gently turn the wearer's head left, right, up or down, so a system can direct attention toward something in mixed reality without any arrow on screen.
works.description_zh: 贴在脖子上的电极能轻轻地把佩戴者的头转向左、右、上、下，系统无需在屏幕上画箭头，就能把注意力引向混合现实中的某个目标。
works.idea_en: Instead of drawing an arrow, the interface turns your head for you.
works.idea_zh: 界面不画箭头，而是直接帮你转头。
works.technique: Applies electrical muscle stimulation to specific neck muscles to actuate head yaw and pitch, calibrated per user for direction and strength.
works.technique_zh: 对特定的颈部肌肉施加电刺激来驱动头部的偏航和俯仰，并针对每个用户校准方向和强度。
works.exercise_en: Design a phone AR scene with a hidden object and compare three guidance cues: an arrow, spatial audio, and a partner gently tapping one shoulder; time how fast people find it. Twist: try the tap cue with eyes closed and describe how it feels to be steered.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 做一个藏着物体的场景，比较三种引导方式：箭头、空间音效、以及同伴轻拍一侧肩膀，记录找到目标所需时间；变体：闭上眼睛只用拍肩引导，描述“被操控”是什么感觉。

video.video_title: Electrical Head Actuation: Enabling Interactive Systems to Manipulate Head Orientation (CHI22)

salient.why_en: Instead of drawing an arrow to show you where to look, the interface turns your head for you.
salient.why_zh: 界面不再画箭头提示你往哪看，而是直接帮你把头转过去。

works.title: Embodied Machine
works.description: A dancer steers a forest of robotic light beams with her body: as she reaches and turns, the motorised lights swing to follow and illuminate her, while her movement also becomes synthetic vocal sound.
works.description_zh: 舞者用身体操控一片机器人光束“森林”：她伸展、转身，电动灯就随之摆动、照亮她，她的动作同时变成合成的人声。
works.idea_en: Turn stage lights into limbs that extend the dancer's gestures.
works.idea_zh: 把舞台灯变成延伸舞者动作的肢体。
works.technique: Wearable motion sensors are analysed for movement qualities and mapped to pan, tilt and intensity of DMX moving-head lights and to a voice synthesiser (likely custom Max or C++ software).
works.technique_zh: 可穿戴动作传感器的数据被分析出动作质感，再映射到 DMX 摇头灯的水平、俯仰和亮度，以及人声合成器（可能是自研的 Max 或 C++ 软件）。
works.exercise_en: Map a phone's orientation (via a WebSocket page) to the direction of a small servo-mounted torch so a performer 'points' light around a dark room. Twist: add a delay so the light follows like a lazy shadow.
works.exercise_zh: 用网页 + WebSocket 读取手机朝向，控制装在舵机上的小手电，让表演者在黑暗房间里“指挥”光线；变体：加入延迟，让光像懒洋洋的影子一样跟随。

video.video_title: EMBODIED MACHINE (interaction with robotic lights)

works.title: Exploding Stuff in AR
works.description: Objects in the room appear to blow up: smoke and debris burst out and bounce off the real floor and furniture, and they pick up the colours and textures of the surroundings, created for a project with BLNK Digital.
works.description_zh: 房间里的物体仿佛被炸开：烟雾和碎片喷射而出，在真实的地板和家具上弹跳，并带上周围环境的颜色和纹理；为与 BLNK Digital 合作的项目制作。
works.idea_en: Make real surroundings look destructible.
works.idea_zh: 让真实环境看起来可以被摧毁。
works.technique: A real-time LiDAR world mesh acts as a physics collider for debris, and the debris and smoke sample the camera image so they match the environment.
works.technique_zh: 实时 LiDAR 世界网格作为碎片的物理碰撞体，碎片和烟雾采样摄像头画面，使其与环境相匹配。
works.exercise_en: In AR Foundation with meshing or Reality Composer, spawn 30 physics cubes that fall and bounce on the real floor and table when you tap. Twist: colour each cube with the camera pixel where it was spawned.
works.exercise_zh: 用带网格功能的 AR Foundation 或 Reality Composer，点击屏幕时生成 30 个物理方块，在真实地板和桌面上掉落弹跳；变体：每个方块的颜色取自其生成位置的摄像头像素。

video.video_title:
💥 Exploding stuff, in AR! 💥

Real-time Lidar + physics make destruction possible.
The smoke & debris pick colors and texture from the environment

Created for a project with @blnkdigital!
A Snaple

works.title: Exploring Pseudo-Weight in AR Extended Displays
works.description: A user holds a phone whose screen is extended by a virtual panel shown in a headset; placing the panel farther from the hand makes the same phone feel lighter, and making the panel lag behind makes it feel heavier.
works.description_zh: 用户手持手机，头显里在手机旁显示一块虚拟扩展屏；扩展屏离手越远，手机感觉越轻；扩展屏跟随得越迟缓，手机就感觉越重。
works.idea_en: A virtual screen attached to a real phone changes how heavy the phone feels.
works.idea_zh: 挂在真实手机上的一块虚拟屏幕，会改变手机拿在手里的重量感。
works.technique: A video see-through headset tracks the phone and renders the virtual extension at a chosen offset and latency; the weight illusion comes purely from visual layout and delay (pseudo-haptics).
works.technique_zh: 视频透视头显追踪手机，并以设定的偏移距离和延迟渲染虚拟扩展屏；重量错觉完全来自视觉上的布局和延迟（伪触觉）。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a virtual panel to a tracked phone or box in WebXR or AR Foundation, add sliders for its offset and follow delay, and ask classmates to rate how heavy the object feels. Twist: make the panel wobble like jelly and see whether the object feels soft.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 或 AR Foundation 中把一块虚拟面板锚定在被追踪的手机或盒子上，加上调节偏移距离和跟随延迟的滑块，请同学评价物体拿起来有多重。变体：让面板像果冻一样晃动，看物体会不会显得更软。

video.video_title: [IEEE VR 2022] Exploring Pseudo-Weight in Augmented Reality Extended Displays

works.title: FACING LIFE [In Doc Tri Nation]
works.description: A real-time rendered installation about social conditioning in which visitors' presence and faces animate child-like avatars that are gradually 'adapted' by social codes.
works.idea_zh: 你的脸与动作驱动一个逐渐被社会规训的虚拟孩子
works.technique: Unity real-time rendering driven by a camera, likely using face and body tracking to map the viewer onto the projected avatar.
works.exercise_zh: 用Unity或网页面部追踪让同学驱动一个卡通孩子形象，再加入“规则”逐步限制它的表情；变化：由观众投票决定下一个被禁止的表情。

video.video_title: FACING LIFE [In Doc Tri Nation] - interactive audiovisual installation, Unity

works.description_zh: 一件关于社会规训的实时渲染装置：参观者的在场与面孔驱动着孩童般的化身，而这些化身会逐渐被社会规范“改造”。
works.idea_en: Your face and movement drive a virtual child who is gradually disciplined by society.
works.technique_zh: 由摄像头驱动的 Unity 实时渲染，可能利用面部和身体追踪将观众映射到投影出的化身上。
works.exercise_en: Use Unity or web face tracking so classmates drive a cartoon child, then add rules that gradually restrict its expressions. Twist: the audience votes on which expression gets banned next.

works.title: FLUX
works.description: A 6-by-13-metre wall of LED strips that captures passers-by with high-speed cameras and replays their silhouettes as rippling streams of light and sound.
works.description_zh: 一面 6 米高、13 米宽的 LED 灯带墙，用高速相机捕捉路人，再把他们的轮廓重现为波动的光流和声音。
works.idea_en: Visualise the invisible signal that carries us across networks by turning bodies into flowing light data.
works.idea_zh: 把身体变成流动的光数据，让承载我们穿越网络的无形信号变得可见。
works.technique: Four high-speed cameras feed custom software that maps silhouettes onto 144,000 LED pixels with time-delayed trails and an 8-speaker sound system.
works.technique_zh: 四台高速相机把画面送进自研软件，把轮廓映射到 14.4 万个 LED 像素上，带有时间延迟拖尾，并配合 8 声道音响。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam silhouette mask to drive a vertical strip visualisation in p5.js where each column shows a delayed slice of your body. Twist: make the delay depend on how fast you move.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头的人体轮廓遮罩，在 p5.js 里驱动竖条可视化，每一列显示你身体的一段延迟切片；变体：让延迟时长取决于你的移动速度。

video.video_title: FLUX – interactive installation @ Vilnius Light Festival (2024)

works.title: Fashion Twin
works.description: Point the camera at someone and 'steal' their outfit: their clothing style is transferred onto you in real time, creating an instant fashion twin.
works.description_zh: 把镜头对准别人，就能“偷走”对方的穿搭：衣服的风格实时转移到你身上，瞬间成为穿搭双胞胎。
works.idea_en: Borrow someone else's outfit with your camera.
works.idea_zh: 用相机借穿别人的衣服。
works.technique: A demo of Lens Studio 4.34's ML Garment Transfer component, which segments the upper-body garment in one image and re-renders its texture onto the tracked body.
works.technique_zh: 展示 Lens Studio 4.34 的机器学习“服装迁移”组件：从一张图中分割出上衣，再把它的纹理重新渲染到被追踪的身体上。
works.exercise_en: Design a 'swap' filter with Lens Studio or Effect House body segmentation: take a photo of a classmate's shirt pattern and apply it to your own silhouette. Twist: swap only the colour, not the pattern.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 Effect House 的人体分割做一个“交换”滤镜：拍下同学衬衫的图案，贴到自己的身形上。变体：只交换颜色，不交换图案。

video.video_title:
We are having a blast with @SnapAR's new Lens Studio 4.34 update. The Garment Transfer component Let's you 'steal' someone's style, or simply create your instant Fashion Twin!

#AugmentedReality #snap

works.title: Fiat Lux
works.description: A narrative light-painting short in 11 scenes made from 686 long-exposure photographs straight out of the camera, telling a story entirely with drawn light.
works.description_zh: 一部由 11 个场景组成的叙事光绘短片，686 张长曝光照片全部直出，完全用画出来的光讲故事。
works.idea_en: Story beats can be staged in real locations using only drawn light; AR stories can likewise lean on sparse, glowing marks rather than heavy 3D assets.
works.idea_zh: 只用画出的光就能在真实地点演出故事情节；AR 故事同样可以依靠稀疏的发光线条，而不是笨重的三维资产。
works.technique: Hundreds of in-camera light paintings are shot as a stop-motion sequence, without compositing.
works.technique_zh: 几百张相机内完成的光绘照片按定格动画顺序拍摄，不做后期合成。
works.exercise_en: Storyboard a three-scene AR story told only with glowing line drawings anchored at three spots in a park, each scene triggered when the viewer arrives. Twist: the drawings are traced by the viewer first, then animate on their own.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个三场景的 AR 故事画分镜，只用发光线条画面，分别锚定在公园里的三个点，观众走到时触发；变体：先让观众亲手描一遍线条，线条再自己动起来。

video.video_title: Fiat Lux - Light Painting Stop Motion Animation

works.title: Field of View
works.description: A webcam feed of the moving artist freezes frame after frame on top of itself, so every gesture leaves a painted trail across the image, recalling old Windows screen-drag glitches.
works.description_zh: 艺术家运动时的摄像头画面一帧帧叠印冻结，每个手势都在画面上留下绘画般的轨迹，令人想起旧版 Windows 窗口拖影的故障。
works.idea_en: Your movement paints itself as a glitch trail.
works.idea_zh: 你的动作把自己画成一串故障轨迹。
works.technique: In Unity the webcam texture is not cleared between frames, so new frames print on top of old ones and create persistent trails of movement.
works.technique_zh: 在 Unity 里不清除帧之间的摄像头纹理，新帧叠加在旧帧上，形成持久的运动轨迹。
works.exercise_en: In p5.js draw the webcam image without clearing the background, masked by a person-segmentation model, to create live body trails. Twist: reset the canvas whenever the performer claps.
works.exercise_zh: 在 p5.js 中绘制摄像头画面但不清背景，并用人物分割模型做遮罩，生成实时身体轨迹；变体：表演者拍手时清空画布。

video.video_title: Excerpt of 'Field Of View' ///  part of the MAE- Motion Aftereffect series

works.title: Generative VFX Music Video (Bitwig x Unity)
works.description: A generative music video where particles, lines and colours change by chance and react to the spectrum of generative music made in Bitwig Studio.
works.description_zh: 一支生成式音乐视频：粒子、线条和颜色随机变化，并响应 Bitwig Studio 生成的音乐频谱。
works.idea_en: Let probability, not a timeline, direct both the music and the visuals.
works.idea_zh: 让概率而不是时间线同时导演音乐和画面。
works.technique: Bitwig's Note Grid generates notes by probability, while Unity VFX Graph particle behaviour switches randomly and is driven by the audio spectrum of the track.
works.technique_zh: Bitwig 的 Note Grid 按概率生成音符，Unity 的 VFX Graph 粒子行为随机切换，并由曲目的音频频谱驱动。
works.exercise_en: Drive an AR particle sculpture on a phone from live microphone spectrum and random state changes, placed in the classroom. Twist: each student's clap chooses the next random scene.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机上用实时麦克风频谱和随机状态切换驱动一座 AR 粒子雕塑，放在教室里。变体：每位学生拍手决定下一个随机场景。

video.video_title: generative mv

works.title: Home Goods in AR (Shop app)
works.description: After Shopify brought on the Primer team (whose app previewed paint, tile and wallpaper on real walls), they shipped a 'Visualize before you buy' section in the Shop app where shoppers drop furniture and lamps into their own room.
works.description_zh: Shopify 收购 Primer 团队（其应用能在真实墙面上预览油漆、瓷砖和墙纸）后，团队在 Shop 应用里上线了“买之前先看看”板块，购物者可以把家具和灯具直接放进自己的房间。
works.idea_en: Put AR one tap away inside everyday shopping instead of in a separate app.
works.idea_zh: 把 AR 放进日常购物流程里，点一下就能用，而不是另开一个应用。
works.technique: Likely built on ARKit and AR Quick Look with USDZ product models, so any listing with a 3D model opens a true-scale preview in the shopper's room.
works.technique_zh: 很可能基于 ARKit 和 AR Quick Look，商品配有 USDZ 模型，任何带 3D 模型的商品都能一键以真实尺寸放进房间预览。
works.exercise_en: Build a three-product mini store page where each product opens a 1:1 AR preview (model-viewer or Quick Look), then run a quick 'which would you buy' test with classmates. Twist: add a 'will it fit?' check that warns when the model is larger than a measured spot.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个只有三件商品的迷你商店页面，每件商品都能打开 1:1 的 AR 预览（model-viewer 或 Quick Look），再让同学投票选出最想买的；变体：加一个“放得下吗？”检测，模型比量好的空位大时给出提醒。

video.video_title:
Since joining @shopify the @primersupply team has made seamless AR shopping available to millions of merchants and buyers in the Shop app.

We're democratizing the next major evolution in commerce and

works.title: INNER LIFE
works.description: An immersive interactive floor where visitors' footsteps generate watercolour-like, nature-inspired visuals and a changing sound composition; every two minutes the system switches to a new perspective of scale.
works.description_zh: 一个沉浸式交互地面，观众的脚步生成类似水彩、灵感来自自然的影像和不断变化的声音作品；系统每两分钟切换一次尺度视角。
works.idea_en: Walking becomes painting and composing on a floor that behaves like a living organism.
works.idea_zh: 在一块像活体一样的地面上，走路就是作画和作曲。
works.technique: Laser (LiDAR) touch tracking of feet feeds a TouchDesigner parametric audiovisual system projected on the floor.
works.technique_zh: 用激光（LiDAR）追踪脚步位置，输入 TouchDesigner 中的参数化视听系统，再投影到地面上。
works.exercise_en: Point a projector at the floor and use a webcam from above to find people's positions; spawn ink blobs that spread where they stand and play a note per blob. Twist: switch the 'zoom level' every two minutes so the same steps create cells, then galaxies.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影仪对准地面，用俯拍摄像头找出人的位置，在脚下生成会扩散的墨团，每个墨团播放一个音符；变体：每两分钟切换一次“缩放级别”，让同样的脚步先生成细胞、再生成星系。

video.video_title: INNER LIFE  BRATISLAVA

works.title: Impossible Geometry with Stencil Shaders
works.description: A cube shows a different world on each face, and a corridor leads to rooms that could not fit inside it, like in the game Antichamber.
works.description_zh: 一个立方体的每个面都显示不同的世界，一条走廊通向放不进它里面的房间，就像游戏《Antichamber》。
works.idea_en: Space can be bigger on the inside if each window only shows its own world.
works.idea_zh: 如果每扇窗只显示自己的世界，空间里面可以比外面大。
works.technique: Each window writes a unique stencil reference, and each hidden world's materials render only where their stencil value matches, in URP.
works.technique_zh: 在 URP 中，每扇窗写入唯一的模板参考值，每个隐藏世界的材质只在模板值匹配的地方渲染。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a stencil cube to an image marker in AR so each face shows a different miniature world. Twist: rotating the real marker changes which world is on top.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把模板立方体锚定到一个图像标记上，每个面显示一个不同的微缩世界。变体：转动真实标记会改变哪个世界在上面。

video.video_title: Impossible Geometry with Stencil Shaders in Unity URP

works.title: InfraredTags
works.description: QR codes and ArUco markers are 3D printed inside everyday objects such as a mug, a router or a speaker, invisible to the eye but readable by an infrared camera on a phone, so pointing the phone at an object brings up its controls or Wi-Fi password.
works.description_zh: 二维码和 ArUco 标记被 3D 打印在马克杯、路由器、音箱等日常物品内部，肉眼看不见，手机上的红外相机却能读出来；把手机对准物品，就能调出它的控制界面或 Wi-Fi 密码。
works.idea_en: Hide AR markers inside objects so the object itself quietly becomes the marker.
works.idea_zh: 把 AR 标记藏进物体内部，让物体本身悄悄成为标记。
works.technique: Objects are printed with an infrared-transmitting filament and the tag's bits are air gaps inside the shell, which show up at a different intensity in a near-infrared image.
works.technique_zh: 物体用可透红外的耗材打印，标记的每一位是外壳内部的空气间隙，在近红外图像中呈现出不同的亮度。
works.exercise_en: Glue a paper marker under a thin layer of translucent plastic, light it from behind, and build a phone AR app that reveals a control panel when the hidden marker is detected. Twist: hide a different secret message inside each classmate's object.
works.exercise_zh: 把纸质标记贴在一层半透明塑料下面，从背后打光，再做一个手机 AR 应用，检测到隐藏标记时弹出控制面板。变体：在每位同学的物体里藏一条不同的秘密消息。

video.video_title: InfraredTags: Embedding Invisible AR Markers & Barcodes Using Low-Cost 3D Printing & Imaging Tools

works.title: Instructional AR
works.description: Hands-free assembly with a Quest Pro: parts laid out on the floor are identified, wobbly guide lines show which pieces connect, tracked parts snap together with playful effects, and voice commands move between steps.
works.description_zh: 戴着 Quest Pro 免手持组装：地上摆好的零件被一一标出，弹性的引导线告诉你哪两个零件相连，被追踪的零件拼上时有俏皮的动效，用语音切换步骤。
works.idea_en: Replace a 15-page manual with instructions that live on the parts themselves.
works.idea_zh: 用长在零件上的指引，取代 15 页的说明书。
works.technique: Quest Pro controllers attached to physical parts give inside-out 6DoF tracking of the pieces, so Unity can draw 3D connection guides in passthrough while voice commands advance the steps.
works.technique_zh: 把 Quest Pro 手柄固定在实物零件上，利用手柄自带的 inside-out 六自由度追踪定位零件，Unity 在透视画面中绘制 3D 连接引导，语音指令切换步骤。
works.exercise_en: Pick a simple 3-5 step build (LEGO or a paper model) and make an AR guide that anchors each step's arrow or ghost part on the real pieces, with a voice command for 'next'. Twist: make the guide react when a step is done wrong.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个 3–5 步的简单拼装（乐高或纸模型），做一个 AR 指引，把每一步的箭头或半透明零件锚定在真实零件上，并用语音说“下一步”；变体：装错时让指引做出反应。

video.video_title:
Been there—15 pages deep in cryptic instructions, surrounded by scattered parts feeling like 😵‍💫

Now with headsets like Quest Pro enabling hands-free AR, you can see 3D build instructions right in yo

works.title: Integrating Real-World Distractions into Virtual Reality
works.description: Instead of blocking out the real room, the VR game absorbs it: a fan's gust sways a curtain in the virtual world, a sudden bang becomes an explosion and the coffee machine's noise becomes falling debris.
works.description_zh: VR 游戏不再屏蔽真实房间，而是把它“吸收”进来：风扇吹来的一阵风让虚拟世界里的帘子飘动，突然的一声巨响变成爆炸，咖啡机的噪音变成碎石落下的声音。
works.idea_en: Turn real-world interruptions into events inside the virtual story.
works.idea_zh: 把现实中的干扰变成虚拟故事里的事件。
works.technique: A small sensing module detects simple signals such as loud sounds, wind and temperature shifts, and the game maps each one to a matching virtual event at the same moment.
works.technique_zh: 一个小型传感模块检测响声、风、温度变化等简单信号，游戏把每一种信号即时映射成一个相应的虚拟事件。
works.exercise_en: Use the phone microphone in a WebXR or Unity scene to trigger thunder, a slammed door or rustling leaves whenever a real sound passes a threshold. Twist: map a classmate's footsteps to a giant walking nearby.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 或 Unity 场景中使用手机麦克风，每当真实声音超过阈值时就触发雷鸣、摔门或树叶沙沙声。变体：把同学走动的脚步声映射成附近一个巨人的脚步。

video.video_title: Integrating Real-World Distractions into Virtual Reality

salient.why_en: A real fan's gust becomes wind in the virtual world instead of breaking the illusion.
salient.why_zh: 真实风扇吹来的风变成了虚拟世界里的风，而不是打破沉浸感。

works.title: Just your shadow
works.description: A short choreographic piece co-created with choreographer Jann Gallois (Cie BurnOut) for ARTE's immersive night at the 2022 Festival d'Avignon, in the Célestins church: a body negotiates with its own shadow, which extends into luminous matter around the dancers.
works.description_zh: 与编舞家 Jann Gallois（Cie BurnOut）共同创作的短篇舞蹈作品，为 2022 年阿维尼翁戏剧节的 ARTE 沉浸之夜而作，在 Célestins 教堂演出：身体和自己的影子周旋，影子在舞者周围延伸成发光的物质。
works.idea_en: A dancer dances with a shadow that does not quite obey.
works.idea_zh: 舞者和一个不太听话的影子共舞。
works.technique: Live projection around the dancer; the shadow-like light matter is likely generated in real time with eMotion and played by an operator in sync with the choreography.
works.technique_zh: 围绕舞者进行现场投影；像影子一样的光之物质很可能由 eMotion 实时生成，并由操作者配合编舞现场演奏。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam silhouette (MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation) to project a student's shadow on a wall with a one-to-two-second delay and a small offset, then choreograph 60 seconds in which the dancer leads, follows and argues with it. Twist: let the shadow sometimes refuse to move, and design how the dancer reacts.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头人像分割（MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation）把学生的影子投到墙上，加 1–2 秒延迟和轻微偏移，然后编一段 60 秒的舞：舞者带领影子、跟随影子、和影子争执。变体：让影子偶尔“拒绝”移动，设计舞者如何回应。

video.video_title: BurnOut by artists Adrien M & Claire B

salient.why_en: A dancer negotiates with her own shadow, which refuses to simply follow.
salient.why_zh: 舞者和自己的影子讨价还价，而影子并不肯乖乖跟随。

works.title: KAWS: FAMILY AR experience (AGO)
works.description: At the Art Gallery of Ontario, visitors open the Acute Art app to see KAWS's giant sculptures appear inside the Galleria Italia alongside the physical exhibition.
works.idea_zh: 在美术馆长廊里用手机召唤出巨型KAWS雕塑
works.technique: Acute Art's app uses plane detection and site-specific placement to anchor large animated 3D sculptures in the gallery space.
works.exercise_zh: 为学校走廊设计一个超大尺寸的AR雕塑（Reality Composer/Adobe Aero），研究比例带来的震撼；变化：雕塑会看向离它最近的观众。

video.video_title: KAWS: FAMILY instructional video for AR experience

works.description_zh: 在安大略美术馆（Art Gallery of Ontario），参观者打开 Acute Art 应用，就能看到 KAWS 的巨型雕塑出现在 Galleria Italia 长廊中，与实体展览并置。
works.idea_en: Summon giant KAWS sculptures into a museum gallery with your phone.
works.technique_zh: Acute Art 应用利用平面检测和针对场地的定点放置，将大型三维动画雕塑锚定在美术馆空间中。
works.exercise_en: Design an oversized AR sculpture for a school corridor with Reality Composer or Adobe Aero, and study the impact that scale creates. Twist: the sculpture turns to look at the nearest viewer.

works.title: KAWS:HOLIDAY Changbai Mountain
works.description: For the eighth HOLIDAY, two COMPANION figures sitting together were built as a monumental snow sculpture at Changbai Mountain in Jilin, China.
works.description_zh: 第八站 HOLIDAY 在中国吉林长白山把两个并肩而坐的 COMPANION 做成了巨型雪雕。
works.idea_en: Making the character from the landscape's own material (snow) ties it to the season, an idea for AR objects whose material changes with weather.
works.idea_zh: 用风景本身的材料（雪）塑造角色，把它与季节绑定，这为材质随天气变化的 AR 物体提供了思路。
works.technique: The figures were carved from compacted snow on site at monumental scale.
works.technique_zh: 人偶在现场用压实的雪以巨大尺度雕刻而成。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR figure whose material switches between snow, grass and sand according to the current season or live weather at the location. Twist: it melts slowly when the temperature is above zero.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个 AR 人像，其材质根据当前季节或当地实时天气在雪、草和沙之间切换；变体：当气温高于零度时它会慢慢融化。

video.video_title: KAWS:HOLIDAY Changbai Mountain

works.title: Kuwahara Filter
works.description: A 3D game scene turns into a moving oil painting as the Kuwahara filter smooths flat areas into brush-like patches while keeping edges sharp.
works.description_zh: 三维游戏场景变成一幅会动的油画：Kuwahara 滤镜把平坦区域抹成笔触般的色块，同时保留清晰边缘。
works.idea_en: Pick the calmest neighbourhood around every pixel and the image paints itself.
works.idea_zh: 每个像素都取周围最“平静”的一块区域，画面就自己变成了油画。
works.technique: A post-processing shader compares the variance of several sectors around each pixel and outputs the mean of the least varied one; the anisotropic version orients the sectors along the local structure tensor.
works.technique_zh: 后处理着色器比较每个像素周围若干扇区的方差，输出方差最小扇区的平均色；各向异性版本会让扇区沿局部结构张量的方向排列。
works.exercise_en: Port the anisotropic Kuwahara pass to a URP renderer feature and apply it to the AR camera feed, so the real room becomes a painting while virtual objects stay crisp. Twist: blend from photo to painting as the user walks closer.
works.exercise_zh: 把各向异性 Kuwahara 移植成 URP 渲染器特性，应用到 AR 摄像头画面上，让真实房间变成油画而虚拟物体保持清晰。变体：用户越走近，画面越从照片过渡到油画。

video.video_title: This is the Kuwahara Filter

works.title: LEDScreenShader
works.description: A virtual stage screen looks like a real LED wall: from far away it shows a clean image, and up close individual red, green and blue diodes and cabinet seams appear.
works.description_zh: 一块虚拟舞台屏幕看起来就像真实的 LED 墙：远看是干净的画面，走近后能看到一颗颗红、绿、蓝发光二极管和箱体接缝。
works.idea_en: Imitate the physical structure of a display, not just its image, to make a virtual screen believable.
works.idea_zh: 要让虚拟屏幕可信，模仿的不只是画面，还有显示器的物理结构。
works.technique: The HLSL shader multiplies the input image by an RGB subpixel mask (texture or procedural stripe, grid or honeycomb layout), draws cabinet seams, and uses screen-space derivatives (ddx/ddy) to fade LED detail and avoid moiré at a distance.
works.technique_zh: 这个 HLSL 着色器把输入画面乘上 RGB 子像素遮罩（贴图或程序化的条纹、网格、蜂窝布局），画出箱体接缝，并用屏幕空间导数（ddx/ddy）在远处淡化 LED 细节以避免摩尔纹。
works.exercise_en: Hang a virtual LED billboard on a real wall in AR, feed it the phone camera or a video, and let viewers walk up to discover the diodes. Twist: the billboard shows a different message to each viewer depending on their distance.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一块虚拟 LED 广告牌挂到真实墙面上，把手机相机或一段视频作为输入，让观众走近去发现一颗颗二极管。变体：广告牌根据观众的距离给每个人显示不同的信息。

works.title: Language
works.description: Point the phone at the sky and giant anime-style mecha appear while one Kyoto School text is read; point it at the ground and a disintegrating scholar appears with another text; at the horizon there is nothing to see, only a voice speaking about absolute nothingness.
works.description_zh: 把手机指向天空，会出现巨大的动漫风格机甲，同时朗读一段京都学派的文本；指向地面，会出现一位正在瓦解的学者和另一段文本；指向地平线则什么也看不到，只听见谈论“绝对无”的声音。
works.idea_en: Where you point the phone (sky, ground, horizon) decides which story you hear.
works.idea_zh: 手机指向哪里（天空、地面、地平线），就决定你听到哪一段故事。
works.technique: Phone AR that reads the device's pitch from the gyroscope to switch between three layered scenes and audio tracks.
works.technique_zh: 手机 AR 通过陀螺仪读取设备俯仰角，在三层场景和音轨之间切换。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR or phone web page that plays three different audio stories depending on whether the phone points up, down or level. Twist: the level direction shows nothing on screen at all.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 WebXR 或手机网页，根据手机朝上、朝下或水平，播放三段不同的音频故事；变体：水平方向时屏幕上完全不显示任何东西。

video.video_title: Artist Interview | Language by Ho Tzu Nyen

works.title: Lightship VPS for Web
works.description: 8th Wall and Niantic brought centimetre-level visual positioning to the mobile browser, so WebAR content can be anchored to specific real-world locations without an app.
works.idea_zh: 无需下载App，在浏览器里就能把AR内容精确锚定在真实地点。

video.video_title: Introducing Lightship VPS for Web

works.technique: Browser camera frames are matched against a prebuilt map of a location to return a 6DoF pose, letting WebAR content be anchored to a specific place.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像标记在网页 AR 中模拟“地点定位”：扫描门口的海报后，内容固定出现在门框上；变体：每次打开时显示上一位访客留下的一句话。
works.description_zh: 8th Wall 与 Niantic 把厘米级的视觉定位带进了手机浏览器，WebAR 内容无需安装应用就能锚定在特定的真实地点。
works.idea_en: Anchor AR content precisely to real places right in the browser, with no app to download.
works.technique_zh: 将浏览器的摄像头画面与预先构建的地点地图进行匹配，返回 6DoF 位姿，从而把 WebAR 内容锚定在特定地点。
works.exercise_en: Simulate location-based positioning in web AR with an image marker: after scanning a poster by the door, content appears fixed on the door frame. Twist: each time it opens, show a sentence left by the previous visitor.

works.title: Live Music with My Clothes in AR
works.description: A live performance in which touching different parts of his outfit triggers AR instruments and visuals.
works.idea_zh: 拍打衣服的不同部位，就能用 AR 现场演奏音乐。

video.video_title: I used AR to make live music with my clothes #shorts

works.technique: Body or surface tracking locates regions of the outfit, and hand-to-region proximity triggers instrument samples and AR visuals (likely via body segmentation plus hand tracking).
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 把胸口、肩膀、膝盖设为“按键”，手碰到时播放对应乐器音色；变体：按键位置随衣服上贴的彩色贴纸决定。
works.description_zh: 一场现场表演：触碰服装的不同部位，就能触发 AR 乐器和视觉效果。
works.idea_en: Tap different parts of your clothes to play music live in AR.
works.technique_zh: 身体或表面追踪定位服装上的各个区域，手与区域的接近程度触发乐器采样和 AR 视觉效果（可能通过身体分割加手部追踪实现）。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Pose to turn your chest, shoulders and knees into keys that play different instrument sounds when your hand touches them. Twist: key positions are set by colored stickers on your clothes.

salient.why_en: Your outfit becomes an instrument: tap different parts of your clothes to play music.
salient.why_zh: 衣服变成乐器：拍打衣服的不同部位就能演奏音乐。

works.title: Look over there! Saliency Modulation
works.description: Instead of arrows or outlines, AR glasses subtly boost the target object and dampen its surroundings, so your eyes drift to the right place without any visible marker.
works.description_zh: AR 眼镜不用箭头或轮廓线，而是悄悄增强目标物体、弱化其周围，让你的视线在没有任何可见标记的情况下自然移向正确的位置。
works.idea_en: Guide attention by editing how noticeable reality is, not by adding more graphics.
works.idea_zh: 通过编辑现实的“显眼程度”来引导注意力，而不是再加更多图形。
works.technique: Computes a saliency map of the scene and applies local contrast and colour changes through the display to raise the target's saliency relative to distractors.
works.technique_zh: 计算场景的显著性图，并通过显示器施加局部对比度和色彩变化，提高目标相对于干扰物的显著性。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone camera filter that slightly desaturates everything except one tracked object, then ask classmates to name the first thing they notice. Twist: make the effect so subtle that people cannot say why they looked there.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机相机滤镜，除一个被追踪的物体外，其余一切都轻微去色，然后问同学最先注意到的是什么；变体：让效果细微到大家说不出自己为什么会看那里。

video.video_title: Investigating Saliency Modulation for Visual Guidance with Augmented Reality Glasses

works.title: Louise Bourgeois x Jenny Holzer: Projections, Basel
works.description: Alongside the exhibition 'Louise Bourgeois x Jenny Holzer' at the Kunstmuseum Basel, Holzer projects excerpts of Bourgeois's writings onto three public buildings in Basel at night. Documented by VernissageTV.
works.description_zh: 配合巴塞尔美术馆的“Louise Bourgeois x Jenny Holzer”展，Holzer 在夜里把布尔乔亚的文字片段投射到巴塞尔三座公共建筑上。视频由 VernissageTV 拍摄。
works.idea_en: Another artist's private words become public architecture; AR can carry a museum's content out into the city around it.
works.idea_zh: 另一位艺术家的私密文字变成了公共建筑；AR 可以把博物馆里的内容带到它周围的城市中。
works.technique: Xenon projectors cast slowly moving lines of text onto facades and a river bank, the same technique Holzer has refined since the 1990s.
works.technique_zh: 用氙灯投影机把缓慢移动的文字投在立面和河岸上，沿用 Holzer 自 1990 年代以来不断打磨的方式。
works.exercise_en: Take quotes from a book in the campus library and place them as AR text on buildings along a walking route with 8th Wall geo anchors. Twist: the route leads back to the shelf where the book stands.
works.exercise_zh: 从校图书馆的一本书里摘录句子，用 8th Wall 地理锚点把它们作为 AR 文字放在一条步行路线沿途的建筑上；变体：路线最后引导人回到那本书所在的书架。

video.video_title: Louise Bourgeois x Jenny Holzer Projections / Kunstmuseum Basel

works.title: Mesh-to-SDF
works.description: An animated character is wrapped in a live signed distance field, so particles and smoke flow around and cling to its moving body.
works.description_zh: 一个动画角色被包裹在实时的有符号距离场中，粒子和烟雾绕着它移动的身体流动并贴附其上。
works.idea_en: Give a moving body a distance field every frame and effects can feel its shape.
works.idea_zh: 每帧给运动的身体生成距离场，特效就能感知它的形状。
works.technique: A compute-shader generator splats the skinned mesh into a 3D texture and flood-fills distances every frame (Unity Demo Team), which VFX Graph samples for collision and attraction.
works.technique_zh: Unity 演示团队的计算着色器生成器每帧把蒙皮网格写入三维纹理并填充距离，VFX Graph 再采样它来做碰撞和吸附。
works.exercise_en: Generate an SDF from the AR body-tracking mesh and let VFX Graph smoke wrap around a classmate on the phone screen. Twist: the smoke is repelled by one hand and attracted by the other.
works.exercise_zh: 从 AR 人体追踪网格生成 SDF，让 VFX Graph 烟雾在手机屏幕上包裹一位同学。变体：一只手排斥烟雾，另一只手吸引烟雾。

works.title: Metawire: wireframe primitives for VFX
works.description: Glowing wireframe spheres, boxes and rings rotate and pulse as clean line graphics.
works.description_zh: 发光的线框球、立方体和圆环旋转、脉动，呈现干净的线条图形。
works.idea_en: Wireframes give a technical, holographic look with very little geometry.
works.idea_zh: 线框只用很少的几何体，就有科技感和全息感。
works.technique: A scripted asset importer generates line-topology meshes for primitive shapes, which are drawn with emissive materials or used as VFX sources.
works.technique_zh: 脚本化资源导入器为基本形体生成线段拓扑网格，用自发光材质绘制，或作为 VFX 来源。
works.exercise_en: Wrap a real object in a wireframe box that tracks it with AR Foundation image or object tracking. Twist: the wireframe unfolds when you touch the object.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 图像或物体追踪，给真实物体套上一个跟随的线框盒子。变体：碰到物体时线框展开。

video.video_title: Metawire - Line mesh generator as asset importer. It's handy for making wireframe VFX. https://t.co/gW23AFj8zp https://t.co/geCmuIOlFF

works.title: MoCap VFX
works.description: A person filmed by a normal webcam is tracked as a 3D skeleton, and glowing VFX Graph particles stream from their moving limbs.
works.description_zh: 普通摄像头拍到的人被追踪为三维骨架，发光的 VFX Graph 粒子从他们移动的四肢中涌出。
works.idea_en: No mocap suit: a neural network turns a webcam into a particle body.
works.idea_zh: 不需要动捕服：神经网络把一个摄像头变成粒子身体。
works.technique: A 3D pose-estimation network (ThreeDPoseUnityBarracuda) runs in Unity Barracuda to drive an avatar, whose skinned mesh emits VFX Graph particles.
works.technique_zh: 三维姿态估计网络（ThreeDPoseUnityBarracuda）在 Unity Barracuda 中运行并驱动一个角色，角色的蒙皮网格发射 VFX Graph 粒子。
works.exercise_en: Run a pose model (Sentis or MediaPipe) on the phone camera in AR and emit particles from the tracked joints of a dancing classmate. Twist: the particle colour follows the music's tempo.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中对手机相机运行姿态模型（Sentis 或 MediaPipe），从跳舞同学被追踪的关节发射粒子。变体：粒子颜色随音乐节奏变化。

video.video_title: Unity MoCap VFX

works.title: MobileNeRF in Unity
works.description: Scenes captured as MobileNeRF neural radiance fields play in Unity as ordinary meshes with a small neural shader, so view-dependent reflections render in real time.
works.description_zh: 以 MobileNeRF 神经辐射场捕捉的场景在 Unity 中以普通网格加一个小型神经着色器的形式播放，视角相关的反射可以实时渲染。
works.idea_en: A neural capture becomes a normal game asset when the network is baked into a shader.
works.idea_zh: 把神经网络烘焙进着色器，神经捕捉就能成为普通的游戏资源。
works.technique: The port imports MobileNeRF's textured polygon meshes and converts the tiny view-dependent MLP into generated shader code, so rasterization plus a per-pixel network evaluation reproduces the radiance field.
works.technique_zh: 移植工程导入 MobileNeRF 的带纹理多边形网格，并把视角相关的小型 MLP 转成自动生成的着色器代码，通过光栅化加逐像素网络计算重现辐射场。
works.exercise_en: Load a MobileNeRF scene in the viewer and place it at tabletop scale in AR Foundation as a miniature diorama. Twist: dissolve between the neural scene and the real table as the user walks around it.
works.exercise_zh: 在查看器中加载一个 MobileNeRF 场景，用 AR Foundation 把它按桌面比例放成微缩景观。变体：用户绕着走时，让神经场景与真实桌面之间互相溶解过渡。
