works.title: Monuments (Virginia Tech Drillfield)
works.description: Large-scale faces of Virginia Tech community members are projected onto three trees on the campus Drillfield at night, turning the trees into living monuments to people rather than to statues.
works.description_zh: 夜里，弗吉尼亚理工大学社区成员的巨大面孔被投影在校园 Drillfield 草坪上的三棵树上，让树成为献给人、而不是献给雕像的活纪念碑。
works.idea_en: Replacing the statue with a living face on a tree asks who deserves a monument; AR can place alternative monuments in public space the same way.
works.idea_zh: 用树上的一张活人面孔取代雕像，是在追问谁值得被纪念；AR 同样能在公共空间里放置另一种纪念碑。
works.technique: Projectors on the lawn throw portrait videos onto tree canopies, using the foliage as a three-dimensional, breathing screen.
works.technique_zh: 草坪上的投影机把人像视频投到树冠上，把枝叶当作立体、会呼吸的屏幕。
works.exercise_en: Pick one statue or plaque on campus and geo-anchor an AR 'counter-monument' next to it: a life-size portrait video of a person the community would honour. Twist: visitors vote with a tap, and the most-voted portrait grows larger.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里选一座雕像或纪念牌，在旁边用地理锚点放一个 AR“反纪念碑”：一位社区想纪念的人的真人大小肖像视频；变体：访客点击投票，票数最多的肖像会越长越大。

video.video_title: Drillfield projection installation, "Monuments"

works.title: Motion-Reactive Physarum
works.description: A real-time simulated slime mould that grows its vein-like networks in response to movement, used to augment the Blessed Art Foundation's launch party.
works.description_zh: 一个实时模拟的黏菌，会根据人的动作生长出叶脉般的网络，用来为 Blessed Art Foundation 的发布派对增添视觉。
works.idea_en: A living slime mould that grows toward the people moving in front of it.
works.idea_zh: 一株会朝着眼前移动的人生长的“活”黏菌。
works.technique: A GPU agent-based Physarum simulation deposits and follows trails, and a motion input, likely from a camera, adds attractant where people move.
works.technique_zh: 在 GPU 上运行的 Physarum 智能体模拟会留下并追随痕迹，而运动输入（很可能来自摄像头）在人移动的地方加入“诱食剂”。
works.exercise_en: Adapt an open-source Physarum shader in TouchDesigner or p5.js so webcam motion adds food to the trail map, and project it on a wall. Twist: stillness makes the network slowly retreat.
works.exercise_zh: 在 TouchDesigner 或 p5.js 里改造一个开源的 Physarum 着色器，让摄像头捕捉到的运动向轨迹图中加入“食物”，再投影到墙上；变体：人一静止，网络就慢慢退缩。

video.video_title: Motion-Reactive Physarum - Short 1 of 3

works.title: NAKED Yorumode 2022 Heian Jingu
works.description: A night visit to Kyoto's Heian Shrine where visitors carry glowing NAKED lanterns through the grounds while projections and light art animate the historic buildings around them.
works.description_zh: 在京都平安神宫的夜间参拜中，观众提着发光的 NAKED 灯笼穿过神社，周围的古建筑被投影和光艺术点亮。
works.idea_en: Giving each visitor a handheld light makes them a participant in the show, a model for AR where the phone itself is the lantern.
works.idea_zh: 给每位观众一盏手提灯，他们就成了演出的一部分，这正是把手机当作灯笼的 AR 体验的原型。
works.technique: Projection mapping on the shrine buildings is combined with lanterns that likely change colour through wireless control during the walk.
works.technique_zh: 神社建筑上的投影映射与灯笼结合，灯笼推测通过无线控制在参观路线上改变颜色。
works.exercise_en: Design a WebXR night walk where the phone acts as a lantern and reveals hidden AR creatures only inside its light cone. Twist: when two lanterns meet, a shared creature appears between them.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一条 WebXR 夜游路线，把手机当作灯笼，只有在光锥里才能看到隐藏的 AR 生物；变体：两盏灯笼相遇时，它们之间会出现一只共享的生物。

video.video_title: NAKEDヨルモウデ 2022 平安神宮

works.title: Nonverbal Interactions with Soli Radar
works.description: Devices use radar to read body language: a screen wakes as you approach, pauses a video when you turn away, and responds to leaning in or glancing, without cameras.
works.description_zh: 设备用雷达读懂肢体语言：你走近时屏幕亮起，你转身离开时视频暂停，还能回应你的前倾或瞥视，全程不需要摄像头。
works.idea_en: Devices that respond to social cues like approach and turning away, the way people do.
works.idea_zh: 设备像人一样回应“走近”“转身”这类社交信号。
works.technique: Soli millimetre-wave radar senses distance, orientation and motion of the body, and machine learning classifies movements such as approach, pass, turn and glance.
works.technique_zh: Soli 毫米波雷达感知身体的距离、朝向和运动，机器学习把这些动作分类为走近、路过、转身和瞥视等。
works.exercise_en: Use a laptop webcam's face detection to pause a video when you look away and resume when you turn back. Twist: make it respond differently to two people.
works.exercise_zh: 用笔记本摄像头的人脸检测，在你移开视线时暂停视频，转回来时继续播放。变体：让它对两个人作出不同的反应。

video.video_title: In the Lab with Google ATAP: Nonverbal Interactions with Soli Radar

works.title: Opportunistic Interfaces (Ad hoc UI)
works.description: A CHI 2022 Interactivity with Ruofei Du, Alex Olwal and colleagues at Google: any everyday object picked up from the desk, such as a cup or a marker, instantly becomes a tangible 6DoF controller for AR content.
works.description_zh: 与 Google 的 Ruofei Du、Alex Olwal 等人合作的 CHI 2022 互动展示：从桌上随手拿起的任何日常物品，比如杯子或马克笔，立刻就能变成控制 AR 内容的 6DoF 实体控制器。
works.idea_en: Whatever is at hand can become the controller.
works.idea_zh: 手边有什么，什么就能变成控制器。
works.technique: Likely real-time 6DoF pose estimation of arbitrary objects from the camera, mapping object translation and rotation to UI parameters on the fly.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是从相机实时估计任意物体的 6DoF 位姿，并即时把物体的平移和旋转映射到界面参数上。
works.exercise_en: Use a marker taped to any object and map its tilt and distance to two sliders in phone AR. Twist: let the user choose the mapping by shaking the object.
works.exercise_zh: 在任意物体上贴一个标记，把它的倾斜和距离映射到手机 AR 里的两个滑杆。变体：让用户通过摇动物体来选择映射方式。

video.video_title: [CHI 2022 Interactivity] Opportunistic Interfaces for Augmented Reality (Ad hoc UI preview)

works.title: PAN+TILT
works.description: A VR experience for two visitors inspired by Joan Skinner's Releasing Technique, in which motion capture and machine learning turn visitors' movement into exploration of a holographic landscape; shown at the BFI London Film Festival Expanded.
works.description_zh: 受 Joan Skinner 释放技巧启发、供两位观众同时体验的 VR 作品，动作捕捉和机器学习把观众的动作变成对全息风景的探索；曾在 BFI 伦敦电影节 Expanded 单元展出。
works.idea_en: Use a somatic dance technique as the controller for a virtual world.
works.idea_zh: 用一种身心舞蹈技巧作为虚拟世界的控制器。
works.technique: Visitors are motion-captured and their movement qualities, classified with machine learning, change how the Unreal environment responds.
works.technique_zh: 观众被动作捕捉，他们的动作质感由机器学习分类，进而改变 Unreal 环境的反应方式。
works.exercise_en: Write three Skinner-style spoken prompts, train a Teachable Machine pose model on how people respond to each, and let the detected class change a WebXR landscape. Twist: the landscape only answers slow movement.
works.exercise_zh: 写三条 Skinner 风格的口语提示，用 Teachable Machine 训练一个姿态模型，识别人们对每条提示的反应，并让识别结果改变 WebXR 风景；变体：风景只回应缓慢的动作。

video.video_title: PAN+TILT 2022 (extract 01)

works.title: PRE-FIGURES
works.description: A hybrid performance for BFI's Luminous event in which a live dance trio moves alongside dancers from the BFI national archive, whose flat film footage is reanimated as floating 3D figures on stage.
works.description_zh: 为 BFI 的 Luminous 活动创作的混合表演：现场三人舞与来自 BFI 国家档案馆的舞者同台，那些平面的影像资料被重新激活为舞台上漂浮的三维人形。
works.idea_en: Archive dancers step out of old film and share the stage with living ones.
works.idea_zh: 档案影像里的舞者走出老胶片，和活着的舞者同台共舞。
works.technique: Archive footage is passed through the MiDaS depth-estimation model inside Unity (via Barracuda), turning each frame into a displaced 3D surface that is rendered and projected in real time.
works.technique_zh: 档案影像在 Unity 中通过 Barracuda 运行 MiDaS 深度估计模型，把每一帧变成有起伏的三维曲面，并实时渲染投影。
works.exercise_en: Run a depth-estimation model on an old dance clip and display it as a point cloud in WebXR or phone AR next to a live classmate. Twist: let the live dancer copy the archive dancer with a two-second delay.
works.exercise_zh: 用深度估计模型处理一段老舞蹈片段，在 WebXR 或手机 AR 里把它显示为点云，放在现场同学身旁；变体：让现场舞者延迟两秒模仿档案里的舞者。

video.video_title: PRE-FIGURES | 2022

works.title: Parallel Ping-Pong
works.description: One user in VR controls two robot arms playing table tennis at two tables simultaneously, switching perspective between bodies to hit both balls.
works.idea_zh: 一个人同时操控两个身体打两场乒乓球。

video.video_title: Parallel Ping-Pong: Demonstrating Parallel Interaction through Multiple Bodies by a Single User

works.technique: Streams two robot-mounted camera views into an HMD and maps the user's single arm motion to whichever robot body is currently selected or blended.
works.exercise_zh: 用两部手机分别拍两个桌面小游戏，把画面并排投到一块屏幕上，让一名同学同时用双手远程指挥两位“替身”同学；变化：两个画面每10秒左右对调。
works.description_zh: 一名用户在 VR 中操控两条机械臂，同时在两张球台上打乒乓球，在两个身体之间切换视角，把两颗球都打回去。
works.idea_en: One person controls two bodies to play two ping-pong matches at once.
works.technique_zh: 将两个机器人身上摄像头的画面实时传入头显，并把用户单臂的动作映射到当前选中或混合的机器人身体上。
works.exercise_en: Film two tabletop mini-games with two phones, show the feeds side by side on one screen, and have one classmate use both hands to remotely direct two stand-in classmates at once. Twist: swap the two feeds roughly every 10 seconds.

salient.why_en: One mind, two bodies: a single person plays two ping-pong matches at the same time.
salient.why_zh: 一个意识，两个身体：一个人同时打两场乒乓球。

works.title: Pattern Regression
works.description: An installation version of Pattern Recognition: a solo dancer is surrounded by a responsive system of moving lights that tracks and reacts to her in real time, and visitors watch the dialogue at close range.
works.description_zh: Pattern Recognition 的装置版本：一位独舞者被一组响应式摇头灯包围，灯光实时追踪并回应她，观众可以近距离观看这场对话。
works.idea_en: A human and a lighting machine hold a kinetic conversation in a gallery.
works.idea_zh: 人与灯光机器在展厅里进行一场动态对话。
works.technique: The dancer's position is tracked and mapped to pan, tilt and intensity of moving-head fixtures designed by Memo Akten, running as a performance installation rather than a stage show.
works.technique_zh: 系统追踪舞者位置，并映射到 Memo Akten 设计的摇头灯的水平、俯仰和亮度上，以表演装置而非剧场演出的形式呈现。
works.exercise_en: Build a 'light buddy' with three phone flashlights on stands controlled over OSC from a laptop that tracks a student with a webcam. Twist: give each light a different personality: shy, curious and copycat.
works.exercise_zh: 用三支架在支架上的手机闪光灯做一个“光伙伴”，由笔记本通过 OSC 控制，笔记本用摄像头追踪一名学生；变体：给每盏灯设定不同个性：害羞、好奇、模仿者。

video.video_title: Pattern Regression

works.title: Playing Pompidou
works.description: An audio AR lens turns the Centre Pompidou into a musical instrument: visitors 'play' the building's surfaces and compose music from sounds recorded inside the museum.
works.idea_zh: 把整座蓬皮杜中心变成一件可以演奏的乐器。

video.video_title: Playing Pompidou: an audio AR Experience by Christian Marclay x Snapchat

works.technique: The lens localizes against the building and maps sound samples to architectural elements, so pointing and tapping at parts of the facade triggers and sequences them.
works.exercise_zh: 录下教学楼里的各种声音（门、楼梯、水管），用 AR 把它们贴到对应位置，点哪里就响哪里；加一个变化：把点击顺序录成一段旋律。
works.description_zh: 一个音频 AR 滤镜把蓬皮杜中心变成了一件乐器：参观者“演奏”建筑的各个表面，用在馆内录制的声音创作音乐。
works.idea_en: Turn the entire Centre Pompidou into an instrument you can play.
works.technique_zh: 滤镜相对建筑完成定位，并将声音采样映射到各个建筑构件上，指向并点击立面的不同部分即可触发和编排这些声音。
works.exercise_en: Record sounds around the teaching building (doors, stairs, water pipes), pin them to their locations in AR, and make each spot sound when tapped. Twist: record your tapping order as a melody.

works.title: Playing with realities in ShapeXR
works.description: Digital-twin experiments in ShapeXR where a virtual copy of his room lines up with the real one, letting him fade between passthrough and virtual versions of the same space.
works.idea_zh: 让房间的数字孪生与真实房间重合，在两者之间自由切换。

video.video_title: Playing with realities in ShapeXR - Meta Quest 2

works.technique: A digital-twin model of the room is aligned to the real room at 1:1, and a crossfade between passthrough and the twin lets the user compare or transition between the two.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Polycam 扫描教室一角，在 AR 中与真实空间对齐，并用滑块在真实和扫描版之间淡入淡出；变体：在扫描版里偷偷改动一个细节，让同学找出来。
works.description_zh: 在 ShapeXR 中进行的数字孪生实验：房间的虚拟副本与真实房间严丝合缝地重合，他可以在同一空间的透视画面与虚拟版本之间淡入淡出。
works.idea_en: Overlay a room's digital twin on the real room and switch freely between the two.
works.technique_zh: 房间的数字孪生模型以 1:1 比例与真实房间对齐，在透视画面与孪生模型之间交叉淡化，让用户对比或在两者之间过渡。
works.exercise_en: Scan a corner of the classroom with Polycam, align it with the real space in AR, and use a slider to fade between the real and scanned versions. Twist: secretly change one detail in the scan and have classmates find it.

works.title: Playscape: How to Build a Galaxy
works.description: A family show in which two dancers, Gabby and Ed, explore space while their motion-captured avatars build planets and stars on a large screen, inviting children to play along.
works.description_zh: 一部亲子演出：两位舞者 Gabby 和 Ed 探索太空，他们被动作捕捉的化身在大屏上建造行星与恒星，并邀请孩子们一起玩。
works.idea_en: Dancing bodies literally build a galaxy that children can watch grow.
works.idea_zh: 舞动的身体一点点搭建出一个星系，孩子们看着它长大。
works.technique: Dancers in motion-capture suits drive avatars and particle effects in a real-time engine that is projected behind them; it premiered in a mocap streaming residency (likely Rokoko suits with Unreal Engine).
works.technique_zh: 身穿动作捕捉服的舞者在实时引擎中驱动化身和粒子效果，并投影在身后；作品首演于一个动作捕捉直播驻留项目（很可能使用 Rokoko 动捕服和 Unreal Engine）。
works.exercise_en: Let children 'place' planets by freezing in a pose that a webcam detects; each pose spawns a different projected planet. Twist: planets only orbit while someone keeps dancing.
works.exercise_zh: 让孩子们摆出摄像头能识别的定格姿势来“放置”行星，每种姿势生成一个不同的投影行星；变体：只有有人一直跳舞，行星才会绕行。

video.video_title: 'Playscape: How to Build a Galaxy' Trailer 2023

works.title: Post-Processing Scan
works.description: A glowing sonar pulse sweeps outward through a scene, lighting up every surface it passes like a 3D scanner.
works.description_zh: 一道发光的声呐脉冲从一点向外扫过场景，像三维扫描仪一样照亮它经过的每个表面。
works.idea_en: A single expanding sphere reveals the hidden shape of the world.
works.idea_zh: 一个不断扩张的球面就能揭示世界隐藏的形状。
works.technique: A URP post-process reconstructs world position from the depth buffer and draws bands where the distance to the scan origin crosses a moving radius (a spherical SDF).
works.technique_zh: URP 后期处理从深度缓冲重建世界坐标，在到扫描原点的距离跨过移动半径（球形 SDF）的位置画出光带。
works.exercise_en: Run the scan over the AR camera's depth (LiDAR or ARCore depth) so a pulse ripples across the real room from where the user taps. Twist: the pulse speed follows the loudness of a clap.
works.exercise_zh: 把扫描效果作用在 AR 相机深度（LiDAR 或 ARCore 深度）上，让脉冲从用户点击的地方掠过真实房间。变体：脉冲速度跟随拍手的响度。

works.title: Procedural walk with Animation Rigging
works.description: A character walks and turns under keyboard control with no animation clips; its feet find the ground and its body leans naturally.
works.description_zh: 一个角色在键盘控制下行走、转身，没有任何动画片段；双脚自己找到地面，身体自然倾斜。
works.idea_en: Motion can be computed instead of keyframed.
works.idea_zh: 动作可以算出来，而不是逐帧摆出来。
works.technique: Animation Rigging constraints (two-bone IK and multi-aim) are driven by scripts that plan foot steps procedurally from the body's velocity.
works.technique_zh: 用脚本根据身体速度程序化规划落脚点，驱动 Animation Rigging 约束（双骨 IK 和多目标朝向）。
works.exercise_en: Make a small procedural walker that follows your phone around a real floor using AR Foundation plane detection. Twist: let it climb onto real steps it detects.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个程序化行走的小角色，用 AR Foundation 平面检测让它在真实地面上跟着手机走。变体：让它爬上检测到的真实台阶。

video.video_title:
I just made it controllable.
(procedural walk animation using Animation Rigging)

works.title: Raymarching with ShadowCaster
works.description: A raymarched SDF object inside a box casts correct shadows and sits in the scene depth like a normal mesh.
works.description_zh: 盒子里一个用光线步进绘制的 SDF 物体，能投下正确的阴影，并像普通网格一样处在场景深度中。
works.idea_en: Make distance-field shapes behave like real objects by marching them in the shadow pass too.
works.idea_zh: 让距离场形状在阴影通道里也做光线步进，它们就能表现得像真实物体一样。
works.technique: The SDF is also raymarched in the ShadowCaster pass so it casts shadows, and the resulting depth is read by the other passes so the shape writes correct depth and receives shadows.
works.technique_zh: 在 ShadowCaster 通道里同样对 SDF 做光线步进，使其能投射阴影；其他通道再读取这一步得到的深度，让形状写入正确深度并接收阴影。
works.exercise_en: Raymarch a blobby SDF sculpture on a real table in AR and make it write depth so real-world occlusion and virtual shadows line up. Twist: let the blobs merge when two phones point at the same spot.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中对放在真实桌面上的软泡状 SDF 雕塑做光线步进，并让它写入深度，使真实遮挡和虚拟阴影对齐。变体：两部手机对准同一处时，让这些泡泡融合在一起。

video.video_title: Playing with ray marchers in Unity again. Followed @d4rkpl4y3r_vr 's advice to march in the ShadowCaster pass for shadow casting. Then reading the output depth from the ShadowCaster for other passes t

works.title: Real Hole in the Wall Game
works.description: A full-body game based on Japan's Brain Wall: a webcam reads his pose and a heart-rate monitor adds pressure as walls with body-shaped holes rush toward him.
works.idea_zh: 根据《墙来了》：用身体摆出墙上洞的形状才能过关。

video.video_title: I Made a Real HOLE IN THE WALL Game

works.technique: MoveNet pose estimation extracts body keypoints from a webcam, which are compared against the silhouette of each incoming wall hole.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Teachable Machine 或 MoveNet 做一个'墙来了'：屏幕上出现姿势轮廓，同学要在 3 秒内摆出来；加一个变化：两个人合体才能过一面墙。
works.description_zh: 一款基于日本节目《墙来了》（Brain Wall）的全身游戏：网络摄像头读取他的姿态，心率监测器制造额外压力，而带着人形洞口的墙正朝他飞速逼近。
works.idea_en: Based on Brain Wall: shape your body to match the hole in the wall to get through.
works.technique_zh: MoveNet 姿态估计从网络摄像头画面中提取身体关键点，并与每面来袭墙体上洞口的轮廓进行比对。
works.exercise_en: Build a Hole in the Wall game with Teachable Machine or MoveNet where a pose outline appears on screen and a classmate has 3 seconds to match it. Twist: two people must combine their bodies to pass one wall.

works.title: Real-Time Body Clones
works.description: A Snapchat lens that freezes 3D copies of your body as you move; tap to leave a single clone or hold to paint a trail of textured bodies through the room.
works.description_zh: 一个 Snapchat 滤镜，会在你移动时把你的身体冻结成一个个三维复制品；点一下留下一个分身，按住就会在房间里拖出一串带贴图的身体轨迹。
works.idea_en: Leave frozen 3D copies of yourself behind as you move.
works.idea_zh: 边走边留下自己凝固的三维分身。
works.technique: The MeshBuilder API copies the current tracked 3D body mesh into a static mesh, then the camera texture from that moment is projected back onto it so the clone keeps your real clothes and colours.
works.technique_zh: 用 MeshBuilder API 把当前追踪到的三维人体网格复制成静态网格，再把那一刻的摄像头画面投射回网格上，让分身保留你真实的衣服和颜色。
works.exercise_en: Use a body-segmentation lens or MediaPipe selfie segmentation to snapshot the cut-out person every second and leave the snapshots floating in the scene. Twist: make older clones slowly fade and drift upward.
works.exercise_zh: 用人体分割滤镜或 MediaPipe 人像分割，每秒截取一次抠出的人像，让这些截图留在场景中；变体：让越早的分身越透明并慢慢向上飘走。

video.video_title:
I made a Snaplens that clones you in 3D! @SnapAR 
Tap, or tap & hold to make a trail

Check out that little preview mesh bottom of the screen🚶

salient.why_en: As you move, frozen 3D copies of your body stay behind in the room.
salient.why_zh: 你一边移动，身后一边留下被定格的立体分身。

works.title: Real-time perspective bounce detection
works.description: A small ball bounced on a table inside a projected rectangle: each bounce is detected in real time and the projected frame reacts with a perspective effect, as if the surface had depth.
works.description_zh: 一只小球在投影出的矩形中弹跳：每次落地都会被实时检测到，投影框随之产生透视效果，好像桌面有了深度。
works.idea_en: A bounce is enough input to make a flat table feel deep.
works.idea_zh: 一次弹跳就足以让平坦的桌面显得有纵深。
works.technique: Bounce moments are detected from the ball's tracked height or sound (likely), and the projected image is re-rendered with an anamorphic perspective for the viewer's position.
works.technique_zh: 通过追踪小球的高度或声音（推测）检测弹跳瞬间，并按观看者的位置以变形透视重新渲染投影画面。
works.exercise_en: Detect a ball bounce with a phone microphone or webcam and trigger a projected ripple at the bounce point. Twist: render the ripple anamorphically so it looks like a hole from one fixed viewpoint.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机麦克风或摄像头检测小球弹跳，在落点处触发一圈投影涟漪；变体：用变形透视渲染涟漪，让它从某个固定视角看起来像一个洞。

video.video_title: Roelof Knol is a media artist and developer, mainly working with projection mapping to create visual or augmented reality interactive projected effects, like this real time perspective bounce detectio

works.title: Reality Channels (Liquid City)
works.description: A prototype of the 'real-world metaverse' in which users switch between channels that re-skin the same street with different AR layers, characters and information.
works.idea_zh: 像换电视频道一样切换城市的AR皮肤

video.video_title: Reality Channels, a slice of the Real-World Metaverse

works.technique: Shared world-scale AR using Niantic Lightship meshing/VPS so several content layers are anchored to the same street and swapped at runtime like channels.
works.exercise_zh: 在同一张桌面或同一面墙上做三个 AR“频道”（如童话、监控、广告），用滑动手势切换；变体：让两台手机看到的频道不同，讨论共同空间里的不同现实。
works.description_zh: “现实世界元宇宙”的一个原型：用户可以在不同频道之间切换，每个频道都用不同的 AR 图层、角色和信息为同一条街道换上新皮肤。
works.idea_en: Switch the city's AR skins like changing TV channels.
works.technique_zh: 利用 Niantic Lightship 的网格重建和 VPS 实现共享的城市尺度 AR，多个内容图层锚定在同一条街道上，并能像频道一样在运行时切换。
works.exercise_en: Make three AR channels on the same tabletop or wall (for example fairy tale, surveillance and advertising) and switch between them with a swipe. Twist: let two phones see different channels and discuss the different realities in a shared space.

salient.why_en: Flip through the city like TV channels: the same street, re-skinned with each switch.
salient.why_zh: 像换电视频道一样切换城市：同一条街，每换一次就换一身皮肤。

works.title: RealityTalk
works.description: While a presenter speaks, keywords are recognized and turned into AR text, images and graphics that the presenter can grab and place with hand gestures around their body.
works.idea_zh: 边说话边让关键词变成AR图文漂浮在身边，用手抓过来讲故事。

video.video_title: [UIST 2022] RealityTalk: Real-time Speech-driven Augmented Presentation for AR Live Storytelling

works.technique: Streaming speech recognition extracts keywords, which are turned into text or images and placed in the camera view, while hand tracking lets the presenter grab and reposition them in the space around their body.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Web Speech API 识别演讲者说出的关键词，把对应的文字或 emoji 贴到摄像头画面中，并用 MediaPipe Hands 捏合手势移动它们；变体：做一个 60 秒的“AR 口头报告”，内容元素必须由你的话语召唤出来。
works.description_zh: 演讲者说话时，系统识别出关键词并把它们变成 AR 文字、图片和图形，演讲者可以用手势抓取这些元素，放到身体周围。
works.idea_en: As you talk, keywords turn into AR text and images floating around you that you can grab to tell your story.
works.technique_zh: 流式语音识别提取关键词，并将其转换为文字或图片放入摄像头画面中，同时手部追踪让演讲者能在身体周围的空间中抓取并重新摆放它们。
works.exercise_en: Use the Web Speech API to detect keywords a speaker says, stick matching text or emoji into the camera view, and move them with a MediaPipe Hands pinch gesture. Twist: give a 60-second AR talk in which every visual element must be summoned by your words.

works.title: Retail Research Kit
works.description: Volunteers wore a Quest Pro while shopping in Paxton Gate, a San Francisco curiosity shop; their gaze and touches were replayed on a 3D scan of the store as heatmaps so a small merchant can see what draws attention.
works.description_zh: 志愿者戴着 Quest Pro 在旧金山的奇物店 Paxton Gate 购物，他们的视线和触摸被映射到店铺 3D 扫描上生成热力图，让小商家看清顾客被什么吸引。
works.idea_en: Turn a headset's eye tracking into affordable shopper research for small shops.
works.idea_zh: 把头显的眼动追踪变成小店也用得起的顾客研究工具。
works.technique: The shop was scanned with Polycam and aligned in Unity; Quest Pro eye-tracking rays and hand-tracking contacts are painted onto the mesh with a texture-painting shader to build 3D gaze and touch heatmaps.
works.technique_zh: 用 Polycam 扫描店铺并在 Unity 中对齐，再把 Quest Pro 的眼动射线和手部接触点用纹理绘制着色器画到网格上，形成 3D 注视与触摸热力图。
works.exercise_en: Scan a classroom shelf, log where testers look or point (head direction in phone AR is fine), and paint the hits onto the scan as a heatmap. Twist: compare heatmaps for two different product arrangements.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描教室的一个书架，记录测试者看向或指向的位置（手机 AR 用头部朝向即可），把命中点画到扫描模型上形成热力图；变体：对比两种商品摆放方式的热力图。

video.video_title:

works.title: Reverse AR
works.description: Instead of placing a virtual sofa in a real room, a shopper sits on a real sofa in the store while the phone wraps a 3D scan of their own living room around it; two shoppers can share the view and spin the room with gestures.
works.description_zh: 不是把虚拟沙发放进真实房间，而是让顾客在店里坐上真沙发，手机把他家客厅的 3D 扫描包裹在沙发周围；两位顾客可以共享画面，并用手势旋转整个房间。
works.idea_en: Flip AR: keep the product real and make the room virtual.
works.idea_zh: 把 AR 反过来：商品是真的，房间是虚拟的。
works.technique: The home is captured with RoomPlan or photogrammetry, and in the store the real furniture is cut out of the camera feed with LiDAR depth-based segmentation inside a bounding box, then composited into the virtual room in Unity with AR Foundation.
works.technique_zh: 先用 RoomPlan 或摄影测量扫描家里；到了店里，用 LiDAR 深度在包围盒内把真实家具从画面中分割出来，再在 Unity + AR Foundation 中合成进虚拟房间。
works.exercise_en: Scan a room at home with a free photogrammetry app, bring it to class, and composite a real chair (cut out with a depth or person mask) into it on a phone. Twist: place the real object in an impossible room, such as underwater or on the Moon.
works.exercise_zh: 用免费摄影测量应用扫描家里的一个房间带到课堂，在手机上把一把真实椅子（用深度或人像蒙版抠出）合成进去；变体：把真实物体放进一个不可能的房间，比如海底或月球。

video.video_title:
Could you tell which room was virtual? 👀

Traditional AR can’t tell you how a couch feels. Our team @Shopify explored "Reverse AR" to wrap a virtual room around a real thing. Sit on a couch in-store w

salient.why_en: AR turned inside out: the product stays real and the room around it becomes virtual.
salient.why_zh: 把增强现实反过来用：商品是真实的，周围的房间却是虚拟的。

works.title: SUPER SLIT SCAN
works.description: A slit-scan camera app that smears time across the frame, turning moving people into stretched, warped sculptures.
works.idea_zh: 用狭缝扫描把时间铺进画面，把人变成扭曲的时空雕塑。

video.video_title: SUPER SLIT SCAN - iOS app

works.technique: Recent camera frames are stored in a 3D texture (ring buffer), and a shader samples each pixel row or column from a different time slice to produce slit-scan distortion.
works.exercise_zh: 在 p5.js 或 three.js 中保存最近 120 帧摄像头画面，每一行像素取不同帧的内容做出时间扫描效果；变体：把时间偏移改为按离画面中心的距离分布。
works.description_zh: 一款狭缝扫描相机应用，把时间涂抹在画面上，让移动的人变成被拉长、扭曲的雕塑。
works.idea_en: Spread time across the frame with slit-scan and turn people into warped sculptures of space and time.
works.technique_zh: 最近的摄像头帧被存入一张三维纹理（环形缓冲区），着色器让每一行或每一列像素从不同的时间切片采样，形成狭缝扫描式的变形。
works.exercise_en: Store the last 120 camera frames in p5.js or three.js and take each pixel row from a different frame to create a time-scan effect. Twist: distribute the time offset by distance from the center of the frame instead.

salient.why_en: Time is smeared across the frame, so moving people turn into stretched sculptures of their own motion.
salient.why_zh: 时间被铺展在画面上，移动的人变成被拉伸的、由自身动作构成的雕塑。

works.title: SURF-AR
works.description: A fitness Lens that teaches anyone to surf on dry land in four steps, guiding each pose and capturing a 3D version of the learner so they can inspect their own form from any angle.
works.description_zh: 一个健身 Lens，用四个步骤在陆地上教任何人冲浪：逐步引导每个姿势，并捕捉学习者的 3D 分身，让人从任意角度检查自己的动作。
works.idea_en: Let learners walk around a 3D replay of their own body to see what a coach would see.
works.idea_zh: 让学习者绕着自己身体的 3D 回放走一圈，看到教练眼中的自己。
works.technique: Full-body tracking and a 3D body mesh record the user's pose at each step, then place the captured figure in world space for review.
works.technique_zh: 用全身追踪和 3D 身体网格记录用户每一步的姿势，再把捕捉到的人形放到世界空间里供回看。
works.exercise_en: Build a body-tracked Lens that teaches one sport or yoga pose in three steps and freezes a 3D snapshot of the student at each step. Twist: overlay the teacher's snapshot in a different colour for comparison.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个人体追踪 Lens，分三步教一个运动或瑜伽动作，每一步都冻结一张学生的 3D 快照；变体：用另一种颜色叠加老师的快照做对比。

video.video_title: Become a SURF-AR | Lensathon Submission

works.title: Scanning My Son While He Slept
works.description: Mikko used Apple's Object Capture to scan his two-year-old son while he slept, imagining a future where he can put on a headset and see him at that age in perfect scale.
works.description_zh: Mikko 用苹果的 Object Capture 扫描了熟睡中两岁的儿子，想象将来戴上头显，就能以真实比例看到孩子这个年纪的样子。
works.idea_en: 3D scans as next-level family portraits and time capsules.
works.idea_zh: 把 3D 扫描当作升级版的全家福和时间胶囊。
works.technique: Photos taken around the still subject are processed by Apple's Object Capture photogrammetry API on a Mac into a textured USDZ model that can be viewed at 1:1 scale in AR.
works.technique_zh: 围绕静止的对象拍摄照片，在 Mac 上用苹果 Object Capture 摄影测量 API 生成带纹理的 USDZ 模型，可在 AR 中以 1:1 比例查看。
works.exercise_en: Make a 1:1 AR time capsule: scan a meaningful object or a very still classmate and attach a short note that appears next to it in AR. Twist: design how and when the capsule may be opened in ten years.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 1:1 的 AR 时间胶囊：扫描一件有意义的物品或一位保持不动的同学，并附上一段在 AR 中出现在旁边的留言；变体：设计十年后这个胶囊该如何、何时被打开。

video.video_title: Recently I scanned my son using Object Capture while he slept. It's mind blowing that when he's older I'll be able to slide on an AR/VR headset and see what he looked like at age 2 in perfect scale. N

works.title: Seaside
works.description: On a stormy North Sea beach in the Netherlands in winter, shells, sand ripples and beach grass light up with delicate projected patterns. The light moves with the rhythm of wind and waves, filmed on site at night.
works.description_zh: 冬天荷兰北海的海滩上风浪很大，贝壳、沙纹和海滩草被投上细腻的光影图案而亮起来。光的变化跟着风和浪的节奏，全部在夜里实地拍摄。
works.idea_en: Found objects can carry the story: a shell lit from outside becomes a small stage, and AR can pick out real objects rather than add new ones.
works.idea_zh: 拾来的物件本身就能讲故事：被外部光线照亮的一枚贝壳就是一个小舞台；AR 可以挑出真实的物体，而不是另外加东西。
works.technique: A portable projector was aimed at individual shells and grass tufts on the beach, with animations likely masked to each object's silhouette.
works.technique_zh: 把便携投影机对准海滩上的一枚枚贝壳和一丛丛草，动画很可能按每个物体的轮廓做了遮罩。
works.exercise_en: Collect five small natural objects, scan them with a phone and create an AR effect that traces glowing patterns over each one on a table. Twist: the patterns move in time with a recorded sound of waves, so the table breathes like a beach.
works.exercise_zh: 收集五件小的自然物件，用手机扫描，做一个 AR 效果，让桌上每件物件表面浮现发光的图案；变体：图案随录下的海浪声节奏变化，让整张桌子像海滩一样呼吸。

video.video_title: Seaside

works.title: Sensing Adjacency
works.description: An experimental piece where a dancer in a motion-capture suit performs next to her projected avatar, sensing how information is lost and distorted between her body and its digital double.
works.description_zh: 一部实验作品：身穿动作捕捉服的舞者在自己的投影化身旁起舞，感受信息在身体与数字分身之间如何丢失与变形。
works.idea_en: Choreograph the gap between a body and its imperfect digital double.
works.idea_zh: 为身体与它不完美的数字分身之间的缝隙编舞。
works.technique: An inertial (IMU) motion-capture suit streams rotations to a hub that animates an avatar in a virtual scene; the team tuned hip height and ground contact live and turned tracking errors into choreography.
works.technique_zh: 惯性（IMU）动作捕捉服把旋转数据传到中枢，驱动虚拟场景中的化身；团队现场调整胯部高度与地面接触，把追踪误差变成编舞素材。
works.exercise_en: Record a short phrase with phone pose tracking, play it back on an avatar and ask the dancer to learn the avatar's 'wrong' version. Twist: perform the original and the glitched version side by side.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机姿态追踪录一段短舞句，在化身上回放，再请舞者学会化身那个“错误”的版本；变体：把原版和出错版并排表演。

video.video_title: 《乜》M.U.D. 2022 ：《傳感鄰接》Sensing Adjacency -  譚之卓 Zelia ZZ TAN︳城市當代舞蹈團 CCDC

works.title: Silent Fall
works.description: In a dark gallery, a continuous fall of mist-filled bubbles drifts down onto a reflective floor and bursts into small clouds of vapour among the visitors.
works.description_zh: 在黑暗的展厅中，充满雾气的泡泡连绵不断地飘落到反光地面上，在观众之间破裂成一团团小雾。
works.idea_en: Constant gentle falling, like snow, is calming and endlessly watchable — AR ambient effects work best at slow, steady rates.
works.idea_zh: 像雪一样持续轻柔地下落让人平静、百看不厌——AR 环境效果以缓慢稳定的速度最有效。
works.technique: Machines above the room blow soap bubbles filled with mist that fall under gravity and burst on impact, releasing the vapour.
works.technique_zh: 房间上方的机器吹出充雾的肥皂泡，泡泡受重力下落，落地破裂时释放雾气。
works.exercise_en: Rain slow, glowing bubbles from the ceiling in AR that burst into mist when they hit the real floor or the user's body mesh. Twist: let the fall rate follow the room's quietness.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中从天花板落下缓慢发光的泡泡，撞到真实地面或用户身体网格时破成雾气。变体：让下落速度随房间的安静程度变化。

video.video_title: Silent Fall at Burlington Gardens | AA Murakami

works.title: Sketched Reality
works.description: Sketches in AR interact bidirectionally with small tabletop robots: a drawn ramp makes the robot move, and a robot bumping a drawn spring makes the sketch bounce.
works.idea_zh: 画出来的弹簧能弹开真实小机器人，机器人也能推动画出来的东西。

video.video_title: [UIST 2022] Sketched Reality: Sketching Bi-Directional Interactions Between Virtual & Physical World

works.technique: Small tabletop robots are tracked in the AR view and sketches are converted into physics bodies, so the simulation both sends motor commands to the robots and updates the sketch from the robots' measured positions.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 识别一个带标记的小车（或同学手推的玩具），在屏幕上画一条斜坡或墙壁，小车碰到时虚拟线条会弹动；变体：让画出来的东西去“指挥”真实小车（可用 micro:bit 小车）。
works.description_zh: AR 中的草图与桌面小机器人双向互动：画出的斜坡会让机器人移动，而机器人撞上画出的弹簧时，草图也会弹起来。
works.idea_en: A drawn spring can bounce a real little robot, and the robot can push drawn things too.
works.technique_zh: 桌面小机器人在 AR 视图中被追踪，草图被转换为物理刚体，因此物理模拟既向机器人发送电机指令，也根据机器人的实测位置更新草图。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR to recognize a small marker-tagged car (or a toy a classmate pushes by hand), draw a ramp or wall on screen, and make the virtual line bounce when the car hits it. Twist: let the drawn objects command the real car, for example a micro:bit car.

salient.why_en: A spring you draw on paper can bounce a real robot, and the robot can push your drawings back.
salient.why_zh: 纸上画的弹簧能把真实的小机器人弹开，机器人也能推动画出来的东西。

works.title: Social Sacrifice
works.description: Inside a dark space at the Venice Biennale, a school of glowing drone 'fish' circles overhead and scatters when a predator shape approaches, surrounding visitors with the swarm.
works.description_zh: 在威尼斯双年展的一个黑暗空间里，一群发光的无人机“鱼”在头顶盘旋，当捕食者形状靠近时四散，把观众包围在群体之中。
works.idea_en: Being inside the swarm feels different from watching it; AR swarms can be placed around the viewer's body so they move through the group.
works.idea_zh: 身处群体之中和从外面观看感觉完全不同；AR 群体可以围绕观众的身体放置，让人在群体中穿行。
works.technique: Indoor drones with lights are flown with a local positioning system, following behaviour-based software that models a fish school reacting to a predator.
works.technique_zh: 带灯的室内无人机依靠本地定位系统飞行，遵循模拟鱼群对捕食者反应的行为软件。
works.exercise_en: Build a headset or phone AR school of 150 fish that orbit the viewer at head height and part around their hand when they reach out. Twist: pick one student as the predator and let the school flee from their phone.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个头显或手机 AR 鱼群：150 条鱼在观众头部高度环绕，观众伸手时鱼群向两边分开。变体：选一位同学当捕食者，让鱼群躲着他的手机逃开。

video.video_title: Social Sacrifice Inside Drone Performance - DRIFT, Venice Biennale 2022

works.title: Space Eraser
works.description: An iPhone scans a room with Apple's RoomPlan, textures the scanned boxes with live camera pixels and lays this digital twin 1:1 over the room, so you can erase the sofa, the dog or everything and then swipe through new furniture sets.
works.description_zh: iPhone 用苹果的 RoomPlan 扫描房间，用实时画面给扫描出的方块贴图，再把这个数字孪生 1:1 叠回真实房间；你可以擦掉沙发、狗甚至所有家具，再滑动切换整套新家具。
works.idea_en: Give your room a reset button before you shop for furniture.
works.idea_zh: 买家具之前，先给房间按一下“重置键”。
works.technique: RoomPlan's semantically labelled USDZ boxes are realigned to the room with ARWorldMap, textured from live camera frames plus LiDAR depth, and the hidden areas are likely filled with ML inpainting.
works.technique_zh: RoomPlan 输出带语义标签的 USDZ 方块，用 ARWorldMap 与真实房间对齐，再结合实时画面和 LiDAR 深度贴图；被擦除区域很可能用机器学习补全（inpainting）。
works.exercise_en: Scan one corner of the classroom (RoomPlan, Polycam or a hand-built box model), overlay it in AR, and let users tap an object to hide it behind a painted wall texture. Twist: instead of erasing, swap the object for a funny replacement of the same size.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描教室的一个角落（RoomPlan、Polycam 或手工搭的方块模型），在 AR 中叠回原位，让用户点一下某个物体就用墙面贴图把它“藏起来”；变体：不擦除，而是换成一个同尺寸的搞笑替代物。

video.video_title:
We've had fun playing with @Apple's new #RoomPlan API @Shopify 

What if your room had a reset button? ✨ https://t.co/H50aROpne7

works.title: Spatial Admin
works.description: A Quest Pro prototype for merchants: open a virtual photo studio on your desk, arrange and light a 3D product, and capture product shots through a floating live-camera viewfinder controlled by hand pinches.
works.description_zh: 面向商家的 Quest Pro 原型：在桌面上打开一个虚拟摄影棚，摆放 3D 商品、调整灯光，再用捏合手势操作一个悬浮的实时取景器拍摄商品图。
works.idea_en: Let AR glasses turn any table into a product-photo studio.
works.idea_zh: 让 AR 眼镜把任何桌面变成商品摄影棚。
works.technique: Built in Unity with Meta's Interaction SDK hand tracking in Quest Pro passthrough; the team tested several capture metaphors (instant camera, reaching into a photo, live camera preview) before choosing the live cam.
works.technique_zh: 在 Unity 中用 Meta Interaction SDK 的手部追踪和 Quest Pro 透视画面实现；团队试过多种拍照隐喻（拍立得、伸手进照片、实时取景），最后选定实时取景器。
works.exercise_en: Prototype two different 'take a photo' gestures for a virtual camera in a headset or phone AR scene and have classmates rate which is faster and clearer. Twist: the photo must be taken with no buttons, only with the body.
works.exercise_zh: 在头显或手机 AR 场景里为虚拟相机设计两种不同的“拍照”手势，让同学评价哪种更快、更清楚；变体：不能用任何按钮，只能用身体动作拍照。

video.video_title:
Next-gen pro headsets from @Meta and @Apple are dropping soon. Had us curious what the future of work might look like for Shopify merchants. 🤔

Could AR glasses revolutionize product photography?
