works.title: Spatial Fusion
works.description: A browser-based mixed-reality experience for Quest 2 and Quest Pro: a tear opens a portal in your room, and you use fusion energy to repair a gravity-defying spacecraft that appears among your real walls and furniture.
works.description_zh: 一个在浏览器中运行的混合现实体验，面向 Quest 2 和 Quest Pro：房间里裂开一道传送门，你要用聚变能量修复一艘出现在真实墙壁和家具之间、违反重力的飞船。
works.idea_en: Open a portal in your own room straight from a web page.
works.idea_zh: 直接从网页在自己的房间里打开一道传送门。
works.technique: WebXR immersive-ar sessions with plane detection, spatial anchors and colour passthrough, built in three.js by PHORIA and Lusion with Meta; audio by Zelig.
works.technique_zh: 由 PHORIA 与 Lusion 在 Meta 支持下用 three.js 开发，利用 WebXR immersive-ar 会话的平面检测、空间锚点和彩色透视；音效由 Zelig 制作。
works.exercise_en: Use WebXR plane detection (or AR Foundation) to find the largest wall and cut a portal into it that shows a different world. Twist: the portal only opens when two people stand in front of it.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 平面检测（或 AR Foundation）找到最大的一面墙，在上面开一道通往另一个世界的门。变体：只有两个人同时站在门前时它才会打开。

video.video_title: Meta/Phoria - Spatial Fusion Trailer

works.title: Speed lines post effect
works.description: Manga-style speed lines radiate from the center of the screen over a 3D scene, like a comic panel in motion.
works.description_zh: 漫画风格的速度线从画面中心向外放射，叠在三维场景上，像动起来的漫画格。
works.idea_en: A comic convention turned into a screen effect.
works.idea_zh: 把漫画的表现手法变成画面特效。
works.technique: A full-screen Shader Graph draws radial lines with polar-coordinate noise, animated over time and injected with a URP renderer feature.
works.technique_zh: 全屏 Shader Graph 用极坐标噪声绘制放射线，随时间动画，并通过 URP 渲染器功能插入画面。
works.exercise_en: Add speed lines to the AR Foundation camera image whenever the phone moves fast. Twist: the lines point toward a hidden virtual object.
works.exercise_zh: 手机快速移动时，在 AR Foundation 相机画面上加速度线。变体：速度线指向一个隐藏的虚拟物体。

video.video_title: Added a speed lines example. https://t.co/zjBMj2hbEx https://t.co/ZLOSCLYds2

works.title: StickShow: a sea of glow sticks
works.description: A concert crowd of thousands of colored glow sticks sways in waves in front of a stage, all drawn in a single instanced call.
works.description_zh: 舞台前成千上万根彩色荧光棒像观众一样成片摇摆，全部用一次实例化绘制完成。
works.idea_en: A crowd is a repeated object with small differences.
works.idea_zh: 人群就是带着细微差别的重复物体。
works.technique: Graphics.RenderMeshInstanced draws one stick mesh thousands of times; per-instance data (color, phase) goes to a Shader Graph that swings each stick with a sine wave.
works.technique_zh: Graphics.RenderMeshInstanced 把同一根荧光棒网格绘制几千次，每个实例的数据（颜色、相位）传给 Shader Graph，用正弦波让每根棒子摆动。
works.exercise_en: Fill a real floor detected by AR Foundation with a field of instanced glow sticks that sway to music. Twist: sticks near the viewer turn to face them.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 检测到的真实地面上铺满实例化荧光棒，让它们随音乐摇摆。变体：靠近观众的荧光棒会转向观众。

video.video_title: https://t.co/6wH933wP8k https://t.co/mMFcVVhb5g

works.title: Summer Snow
works.description: In the middle of a hot summer day, a phone lens covers a sunny Dutch street in deep snow, with flakes still falling and a snow bank lying on the pavement.
works.description_zh: 在炎热的夏日，一个手机镜头让阳光下的荷兰街道铺满厚雪，雪花还在飘落，人行道上堆起雪堤。
works.idea_en: Overwrite the season: bring winter into a summer street.
works.idea_zh: 改写季节：把冬天搬进夏天的街道。
works.technique: A Lens Studio world lens likely uses ground tracking and a particle system for falling snow plus a deformable snow mesh laid on the detected ground plane.
works.technique_zh: 这个 Lens Studio 世界镜头很可能利用地面追踪，用粒子系统做飘雪，再在识别出的地面上铺一层可变形的雪网格。
works.exercise_en: Make a 'wrong season' AR filter for the schoolyard in Lens Studio or Effect House: falling leaves in spring or snow in summer. Twist: let footprints appear where people walk.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 Effect House 给校园做一个“错季”AR 滤镜：春天落叶，夏天下雪。变体：人走过的地方留下脚印。

video.video_title: It's middle of the summer, so no better time to experiment with some dynamic snow effects in Lens Studio @SnapAR https://t.co/5BDQETqwVO

salient.why_en: A sunny summer street is suddenly buried in snow.
salient.why_zh: 阳光明媚的夏日街道突然被大雪覆盖。

works.title: The <model> Element in iOS Safari
works.description: A quick test of WebKit's experimental HTML model element on iOS Safari: a Converse sneaker hosted on Shopify's CDN spins as a native 3D object inside an ordinary web page.
works.description_zh: 在 iOS Safari 上试用 WebKit 实验性的 HTML model 元素：一只托管在 Shopify CDN 上的 Converse 球鞋，作为原生 3D 对象在普通网页里旋转。
works.idea_en: Treat 3D objects as first-class web content, just like images.
works.idea_zh: 让 3D 物体像图片一样成为网页的一等公民。
works.technique: WebKit's experimental model tag embeds a USDZ file directly in HTML so the browser renders it and handles rotation without WebGL code, hinting at pages that can hand 3D straight to AR.
works.technique_zh: WebKit 实验性的 model 标签可以把 USDZ 文件直接嵌入 HTML，由浏览器负责渲染和旋转，无需写 WebGL 代码，也预示着网页能把 3D 内容直接交给 AR。
works.exercise_en: Build a product page that shows a 3D model with model-viewer (or the model element where supported) plus a 'view in your space' AR button. Twist: make the 3D model react to page scrolling.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个商品页面，用 model-viewer（或在支持的浏览器中用 model 元素）展示 3D 模型，并加一个“在你的空间中查看”的 AR 按钮；变体：让 3D 模型随页面滚动做出反应。

video.video_title: Interesting times ahead. This is the new <model> running in iOS Safari https://t.co/iaYZHXXSay

works.title: The Reading Light
works.description: A motion-tracked pendant lamp is swung past a textured wall, and digital letters appear only where its light falls, as if the words were part of the room.
works.description_zh: 一盏被动作追踪的吊灯在有纹理的墙前摆动，数字字母只在灯光照到的地方显现，仿佛文字本来就是房间的一部分。
works.idea_en: Words that exist only where the light shines.
works.idea_zh: 只在光照到的地方才存在的文字。
works.technique: The lamp's position is tracked and a projector likely renders text masked to the lamp's virtual light cone, so it appears to be revealed by the real light.
works.technique_zh: 追踪吊灯的位置，投影仪很可能只在灯的虚拟光锥范围内渲染文字，看起来像是被真实灯光照出来的。
works.exercise_en: Track a flashlight with a webcam and project a hidden poem that is only visible inside the flashlight's circle. Twist: the poem changes depending on how long the light rests on each line.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头追踪手电筒，投射一首隐藏的诗，只有在手电筒光圈里才看得见。变体：光在每一行停留的时间长短会改变诗的内容。

video.video_title: The Reading Light

works.title: The World Beyond
works.description: A Presence Platform showcase where you shine a flashlight to dissolve your real walls into an alien world and play with Oppy, a pet that responds to hand gestures and voice.
works.idea_zh: 用“手电”把真实墙壁溶解成外星世界，还有一只听你话的宠物。

video.video_title: The Future Of VR: The World Beyond

works.technique: Uses the Scene model to know wall planes, then masks passthrough with a shader where the virtual flashlight hits, revealing the VR world behind.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR检测墙面，在手机指向处挖出一个圆形“洞”显示另一个世界（遮罩着色器或Portal组件）；变化：洞只在你说出咒语时打开。
works.description_zh: 一个 Presence Platform 展示项目：你用手电筒一照，真实的墙壁便溶解成一个外星世界，还能和一只会回应手势与语音的宠物 Oppy 玩耍。
works.idea_en: Use a flashlight to dissolve real walls into an alien world, with a pet that listens to you.
works.technique_zh: 利用 Scene 模型获取墙面平面，再用着色器在虚拟手电筒照到的位置遮罩透视画面，露出后面的 VR 世界。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR to detect a wall and cut a round hole where the phone points to show another world, using a mask shader or a portal component. Twist: the hole only opens when you say a magic word.

works.title: Third-Person Perspective Avatar Embodiment in AR
works.description: Users see themselves from behind as a muscular avatar standing in the real room and moving with their body; after controlling it, their actual physical performance improves.
works.description_zh: 用户从身后以第三人称视角看到自己化身为一个肌肉发达的虚拟形象，站在真实房间里随身体一起动；操控它之后，他们真实的体能表现也有所提升。
works.idea_en: Wearing a stronger body in AR can make you physically stronger (the Proteus effect).
works.idea_zh: 在 AR 中“穿上”更强壮的身体，真的会让你更有力气（普罗透斯效应）。
works.technique: Tracks the user's body and drives a full-body avatar rendered from a third-person viewpoint in an AR headset.
works.technique_zh: 追踪用户身体，驱动一个在 AR 头显中以第三人称视角渲染的全身虚拟形象。
works.exercise_en: Film a classmate from behind with a phone running a body-tracking AR effect that swaps them for a superhero, show them the live feed while they do squats, and count reps against a normal-mirror round. Twist: try a tired, elderly avatar instead.
works.exercise_zh: 用运行人体追踪 AR 特效的手机从背后拍同学，把他换成超级英雄形象，让他一边看实时画面一边做深蹲，与照普通镜子时的次数比较；变体：换成一个疲惫的老人形象再试一次。

video.video_title: Third-Person Perspective Avatar Embodiment in Augmented Reality

works.title: Tilt Five — Gaming with Tabletop Holograms
works.description: Shipping Tilt Five games shown through the glasses: tabletop strategy, board games and toys that rise from the board and respond to the wand.
works.idea_zh: 游戏从桌面板上立起来，用魔杖直接操控全息棋子。

video.video_title: Tilt Five - Gaming With Tabletop Holograms!

works.technique: Content is authored in board-local coordinates in Unity, so miniatures appear to rise from the board and stay registered as players move their heads.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个从桌面“长出来”的小城市，城市建筑随你绕桌子行走的角度显示不同细节；变体：城市里的小人会朝你所在的方向看。
works.description_zh: 通过眼镜展示已发布的 Tilt Five 游戏：桌面策略游戏、棋盘游戏和玩具从游戏板上立起来，并对魔杖作出响应。
works.idea_en: Games rise up from the tabletop board and you move holographic pieces directly with a wand.
works.technique_zh: 在 Unity 中以游戏板的局部坐标系制作内容，因此微缩模型看起来像是从板面上升起，并在玩家移动头部时保持对齐。
works.exercise_en: Make a small city that grows out of the tabletop, with buildings revealing different details depending on the angle as you walk around the table. Twist: the little people in the city look toward wherever you are.

works.title: Touching The Droid: Understanding and Improving Touch Precision With Mobile Devices in Virtual Reality
works.description: An ISMAR 2022 study led by Fengyuan Zhu with Zhuoyue Lyu, Mauricio Sousa and Tovi Grossman (University of Toronto): people hold a real phone or tablet while wearing a VR headset and tap its virtual twin, first with no rendered hand at all, then with a calibration that realigns the virtual hand to the real touch.
works.description_zh: ISMAR 2022 的一项研究，由 Fengyuan Zhu 主导，合作者为 Zhuoyue Lyu、Mauricio Sousa 和 Tovi Grossman（多伦多大学）：用户戴着 VR 头显、手里拿着真实的手机或平板，去点按它在虚拟世界中的替身；先在完全不显示虚拟手的情况下测试，再用一种校准方法把虚拟手重新对齐到真实触点。
works.idea_en: A real phone in your hand can be a precise touch surface inside a virtual world, as long as the virtual hand is quietly corrected to match where you actually touch.
works.idea_zh: 只要悄悄把虚拟手校正到你真正触碰的位置，手里的真实手机就能在虚拟世界里成为一块精确的触控面板。
works.technique: The phone's touch events serve as ground truth to continuously estimate the offset between the tracked physical hand and its rendered model, and a dynamic calibration shifts the virtual hand to cancel it, raising touch accuracy by 43% and reducing 'screen penetration' and 'floating touch' errors.
works.technique_zh: 把手机屏幕的触摸事件当作真实参照，持续估计被追踪的真实手与渲染出来的虚拟手之间的偏移，再用动态校准移动虚拟手去抵消偏移，使触控准确率提高 43%，并减少“手指穿过屏幕”和“悬空触摸”的错误。
works.exercise_en: In WebXR on a headset, render a virtual copy of a phone held in the other hand and log where your fingertip appears versus where the phone registers the tap. Twist: hide the virtual hand completely and compare accuracy with and without it.
works.exercise_zh: 在头显的 WebXR 中，为另一只手里拿着的手机渲染一个虚拟副本，记录指尖在画面中出现的位置和手机实际记录到的点按位置。变体：完全隐藏虚拟手，对比有无虚拟手时的点按准确率。

video.video_title: ISMAR 2022: Touching the Droid

works.title: Tous les oiseaux du monde
works.description: Made with UCLouvain, the film asks whether we could ever count all the birds in the world: a computer-vision system frames each flying bird with coordinates while a text model answers with fluent nonsense.
works.description_zh: 与鲁汶大学合作完成的影片提出一个问题：我们能数清世界上所有的鸟吗？计算机视觉系统为每只飞鸟框出坐标，而一个文本模型则给出通顺却空洞的回答。
works.idea_en: Showing the machine's bounding boxes on nature exposes what the camera 'sees', a useful critical move for AR object detection.
works.idea_zh: 把机器在自然中画出的检测框显示出来，暴露了相机“看见”的东西，这对 AR 物体识别是一种有用的批判手法。
works.technique: A detector trained on bird silhouettes draws boxes and coordinates over each bird in the footage, alongside text from a pre-ChatGPT language model.
works.technique_zh: 一个用鸟类剪影训练的检测器在画面中的每只鸟上画出方框与坐标，并配以一个早于 ChatGPT 的语言模型生成的文字。
works.exercise_en: Run a COCO object detector (for example TensorFlow.js or Lens Studio ML) on a live camera feed outdoors and display a running count of 'birds' and 'people'. Twist: let the count also invent a poetic caption for each detection.
works.exercise_zh: 在户外实时相机画面上运行 COCO 物体检测器（如 TensorFlow.js 或 Lens Studio ML），显示“鸟”和“人”的累计数量；变体：为每个检测结果同时生成一句诗意的说明。

video.video_title: Tous les oiseaux du monde

works.title: Two projectors + augmented reality effects
works.description: Two projectors map audio-reactive rings and circles of light onto a coffee table, combined with augmented reality effects in the same scene so that projected and virtual layers read as one.
works.description_zh: 两台投影仪把随音乐律动的光环和圆圈投射到茶几上，并在同一场景中叠加增强现实效果，让投影层和虚拟层看起来融为一体。
works.idea_en: Stack projection and screen-based AR so light on the table and virtual content share one space.
works.idea_zh: 把投影和屏幕式 AR 叠在一起，让桌上的光和虚拟内容处在同一个空间里。
works.technique: Two calibrated projectors cover the table surface with audio-reactive graphics while a camera-based AR view renders matching 3D elements registered to the same table (likely).
works.technique_zh: 两台经过标定的投影仪在桌面上投出随音频变化的图形，同时一个基于摄像头的 AR 视图渲染与同一张桌子对齐的 3D 元素（推测）。
works.exercise_en: Project an audio-reactive circle onto a table, then build a phone AR scene with an image target on the table that adds a 3D element synced to the same music. Twist: the AR element should seem to cast a shadow into the projection.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个随音乐变化的圆投影到桌面上，再用桌上的图像标记做一个手机 AR 场景，加入一个与同一音乐同步的 3D 元素；变体：让 AR 元素看起来在投影上投下阴影。

video.video_title:
2 Projectors + Augmented Reality effects looks truly magical.

Video source: Roelof Knol from Instagram

#mixedreality #augmentedrealityart #audioreactive #audiovisualart #generativeart #projectionmap

works.title: Ukemochi
works.description: A person in a social VR world can eat real food: the headset cuts out just the plate, food and hands from the passthrough camera and pastes them seamlessly into the virtual scene.
works.description_zh: 在社交 VR 世界里的人也能吃真实的饭：头显只从透视摄像头画面中抠出餐盘、食物和手，无缝贴进虚拟场景。
works.idea_en: Let only the food cross the boundary between the real and the virtual world.
works.idea_zh: 只让食物穿过现实与虚拟之间的边界。
works.technique: Segments food, dishes and hands from the video see-through feed with a neural network and composites that region into the rendered VR environment in real time.
works.technique_zh: 用神经网络从视频透视画面中分割出食物、餐具和手，并实时把该区域合成到渲染出的 VR 环境里。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR portal that shows a virtual scene everywhere except a colour-keyed placemat area where the real camera image shows through, then eat a snack through it. Twist: swap roles and show only people's hands from reality.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 场景：除了一块用颜色抠像的餐垫区域透出真实画面外，其他地方都显示虚拟场景，然后透过它吃一份零食；变体：反过来，只让现实中人的手透进来。

video.video_title: Ukemochi: A Video See-through Food Overlay System for Eating Experience in the Metaverse (Video)

works.title: Unity Slices: Table
works.description: A Unity Labs demo on Quest 2 passthrough that slides a real table along the reality spectrum, from pure passthrough to fully virtual, while you play chess and other tabletop games on it.
works.idea_zh: 在同一张真实桌子上连续滑动于现实与虚拟之间玩桌游。

video.video_title: Unity Slices: Table. Sliding along the spectrum of realities.

works.technique: A virtual table is registered to the real one, and a blend parameter crossfades passthrough and virtual rendering with a mask or opacity ramp, moving the same object along the reality-virtuality spectrum.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实桌子上对齐一个同尺寸的虚拟桌面，用滑块从“完全真实”到“完全虚拟”逐步替换材质；变体：在每一档上玩同一局小游戏，记录感受差异。
works.description_zh: Unity Labs 在 Quest 2 透视模式下的一个演示：一张真实桌子沿着“现实光谱”滑动，从纯透视画面一直过渡到完全虚拟，你还可以在上面下国际象棋、玩其他桌游。
works.idea_en: Play board games on one real table while sliding continuously between reality and the virtual.
works.technique_zh: 虚拟桌子与真实桌子配准，一个混合参数借助遮罩或透明度渐变在透视画面与虚拟渲染之间交叉淡化，让同一个物体沿着现实—虚拟连续体移动。
works.exercise_en: Align a same-sized virtual tabletop on a real table and use a slider to replace materials step by step from fully real to fully virtual. Twist: play the same mini-game at every step and record how it feels different.

works.title: Unlearning Language
works.description: An installation and performance where an AI tracks participants' speech, gestures and expressions and responds with light and sound, pushing them to invent ways of communicating that algorithms cannot detect.
works.idea_zh: 被AI持续监测的房间里，人们要发明机器看不懂的新交流方式。

video.video_title: Unlearning Language

works.technique: Machine-learning classifiers (pose estimation, facial expression, speech recognition) detect recognisable human signals, and detection events drive light and sound feedback that participants try to evade.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 和 Teachable Machine 做一个会识别点头、挥手、微笑的系统，一识别到就亮灯报警，小组发明一种它识别不出的沟通方式；变体：成功“隐身”交流 1 分钟后，把你们发明的暗号教给另一组。
works.description_zh: 一件装置兼表演作品：AI 追踪参与者的语言、手势和表情，并用光和声音作出回应，迫使他们发明算法无法察觉的交流方式。
works.idea_en: In a room watched constantly by AI, people have to invent new ways of communicating that machines cannot read.
works.technique_zh: 机器学习分类器（姿态估计、面部表情识别、语音识别）检测可识别的人类信号，每次检测都会触发光和声音反馈，参与者则设法躲避检测。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe and Teachable Machine to build a system that recognizes nods, waves and smiles and flashes an alarm light when it does, and have your group invent a way to communicate that it cannot detect. Twist: after one minute of undetected communication, teach your secret code to another group.

works.title: Unwanted Waters
works.description: A dancer's live motion capture drives an avatar inside a WebXR scene that online audiences join from browsers or headsets, watching the performance unfold in a shared virtual space.
works.description_zh: 舞者的实时动作捕捉驱动 WebXR 场景中的化身，线上观众通过浏览器或头显进入同一个虚拟空间观看演出。
works.idea_en: A live dancer performs inside a web page that anyone can walk into.
works.idea_zh: 真人舞者在一个人人都能走进去的网页里演出。
works.technique: A motion-capture suit streams skeleton data over the network to a WebXR scene (on the OnBoardXR platform) where it animates an avatar in real time.
works.technique_zh: 动作捕捉服把骨架数据通过网络传到 WebXR 场景（OnBoardXR 平台），实时驱动化身。
works.exercise_en: Stream MediaPipe pose data from one laptop over WebSocket to a three.js or A-Frame scene where it moves a simple avatar that classmates view on their phones. Twist: let viewers change the room's lighting to affect the mood of the dance.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebSocket 把一台电脑上的 MediaPipe 姿态数据传到 three.js 或 A-Frame 场景，驱动一个简单化身，同学用手机观看；变体：让观众改变房间灯光，影响舞蹈情绪。

video.video_title: Unwanted Waters [Trailer]

works.title: VAT Utils for VFX Graph
works.description: Houdini rigid-body shatters, soft bodies and remeshing fluid simulations play back as many instanced meshes inside Unity VFX Graph.
works.description_zh: Houdini 里的刚体破碎、软体和重新网格化的流体模拟，在 Unity VFX Graph 中以大量实例化网格回放。
works.idea_en: Simulate offline, replay anywhere: baked physics becomes a real-time particle output.
works.idea_zh: 离线模拟、随处回放：烘焙好的物理变成实时粒子输出。
works.technique: SideFX Labs VAT 3.0 exports encode per-vertex positions and rotations into textures, and the package provides VFX Graph examples that use those VAT meshes as particle output with the matching shader, one per VAT type.
works.technique_zh: SideFX Labs 的 VAT 3.0 导出把逐顶点位置和旋转编码进纹理，这个包提供 VFX Graph 示例，把这些 VAT 网格作为粒子输出并配合对应着色器，每种 VAT 类型一个示例。
works.exercise_en: Bake a small Houdini shatter as a VAT, spawn it with VFX Graph on an AR Foundation plane, and replay it when the user taps a real object. Twist: spawn many copies with random time offsets so the floor keeps shattering like rain.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个小型 Houdini 破碎模拟烘焙成 VAT，用 VFX Graph 在 AR Foundation 平面上生成，用户点击真实物体时回放。变体：生成许多带随机时间偏移的副本，让地面像下雨一样不停碎裂。

video.video_title: VAT Utils package for VFX Graph Effect

works.title: VFX Dancer
works.description: An animated dancer sheds long glowing trails and particles from her whole body, so every turn of the choreography leaves ribbons of light in the air.
works.description_zh: 一位动画舞者从全身甩出长长的发光拖尾和粒子，舞蹈的每一次转身都在空中留下光带。
works.idea_en: Make motion visible by letting the body leave its own history behind as light.
works.idea_zh: 让身体把自己的运动历史留成光，动作就被看见了。
works.technique: VFX Graph samples positions on the animated skinned mesh every frame and spawns particles and trail strips there, inspired by Keijiro Takahashi's Skinner; the animation is a Mixamo clip.
works.technique_zh: 受 Keijiro Takahashi 的 Skinner 启发，VFX Graph 每帧在动画蒙皮网格表面采样位置，并在那里生成粒子和拖尾条带；舞蹈动画来自 Mixamo。
works.exercise_en: Drive a Mixamo or ARKit body-tracked avatar with a trail-emitting VFX Graph and view it at full scale in AR next to a real dancer. Twist: colour the trails by the speed of each limb.
works.exercise_zh: 用会发出拖尾的 VFX Graph 驱动一个 Mixamo 或 ARKit 人体追踪的角色，在 AR 中让它以真人尺寸站在真实舞者旁边。变体：按每个肢体的速度给拖尾上色。

video.video_title:
WIP. VFX Dancer. This VFXGraph trails are inspired by  Skinner.
#MadeWithUnity #VFXGraph

https://t.co/jEQFIXhZCl https://t.co/b8qBywCLMW

works.title: VFX with Unity AR Foundation
works.description: Live on an iPhone, glowing particles and lines grow over the real room and people in front of the camera, anchored to the LiDAR-scanned environment.
works.idea_zh: 直接在手机上实时让光效沿真实环境生长。

video.video_title: VFX with Unity AR Foundation https://t.co/ZuhkeYPRmY

works.technique: AR Foundation exposes the LiDAR environment depth and human stencil textures, which VFX Graph samples on-device to emit particles from real surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 或 Lens Studio 的深度纹理，让房间表面冒出萤火虫；加一个变化：人走过的地方萤火虫会散开。
works.description_zh: 在 iPhone 上实时运行：发光的粒子和线条在真实房间和镜头前的人身上生长，并锚定在 LiDAR 扫描出的环境中。
works.idea_en: Grow light effects along the real environment live on a phone.
works.technique_zh: AR Foundation 提供 LiDAR 环境深度和人体模板纹理，VFX Graph 在设备端对其采样，从真实表面发射粒子。
works.exercise_en: Use depth textures in AR Foundation or Lens Studio to make fireflies rise from the room's surfaces. Twist: fireflies scatter wherever a person walks.

works.title: Voronoi cells drawn by a pendulum
works.description: A pendulum ball swings over a coffee table covered in projected Voronoi cells; the cell pattern is continuously redrawn around the moving ball.
works.description_zh: 一只摆锤在投满 Voronoi 细胞图案的茶几上方来回摆动；细胞图案围绕移动的小球不断重新生成。
works.idea_en: Let a pendulum, not a person, conduct a generative drawing.
works.idea_zh: 让摆锤而不是人来指挥一幅生成式绘画。
works.technique: The pendulum's position is tracked from above and used as a moving seed point in a real-time Voronoi diagram that is projected back onto the table.
works.technique_zh: 从上方追踪摆锤位置，把它作为实时 Voronoi 图中的一个移动种子点，再把图案投影回桌面。
works.exercise_en: Hang a pendulum over a table, track it with a webcam, and project a Voronoi diagram whose seeds include the pendulum and a few fixed points. Twist: the pendulum's speed controls line thickness.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌子上方挂一个摆锤，用摄像头追踪它，并投影一张 Voronoi 图，种子点包括摆锤和几个固定点；变体：用摆锤速度控制线条粗细。

works.title: VzoVfx: triggering VFX from Bitwig
works.description: Drum hits in a Bitwig music project trigger particle bursts in Unity in exact sync with the beat.
works.description_zh: Bitwig 音乐工程中的鼓点在 Unity 中触发粒子爆发，与节拍精确同步。
works.idea_en: Let the music software drive the visuals directly.
works.idea_zh: 让音乐软件直接驱动画面。
works.technique: The VZO plugin sends note and parameter events from the DAW over OSC, and VzoVfx binders turn them into VFX Graph events with timing compensation.
works.technique_zh: VZO 插件把 DAW 中的音符和参数事件通过 OSC 发出，VzoVfx 绑定器把它们转换成带时间补偿的 VFX Graph 事件。
works.exercise_en: Send OSC from a music app to a phone running AR Foundation so each drum hit bursts particles on a real object. Twist: map each drum to a different object in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 从音乐软件向运行 AR Foundation 的手机发送 OSC，让每个鼓点在真实物体上爆出粒子。变体：每种鼓对应房间里不同的物体。

video.video_title:
Triggering Unity VFX from Bitwig.
https://t.co/HzpTqOQdpC https://t.co/6mFirJynlD

works.title: Walking a Taiwanese street with iPhone LiDAR
works.description: A night walk through a street in Taiwan is visualized as a sparse point-cloud world built live from the iPhone LiDAR, showing both the magic and the 5-meter range limit of the sensor.
works.idea_zh: 用 LiDAR 的'看不远'这一缺陷，本身做成一种梦境般的街景风格。

video.video_title: Walking around in a Taiwanese street with an iPhone LiDAR sensor. https://t.co/VL6rFaxtjs

works.technique: LiDAR depth samples are reprojected into world-space points each frame and accumulated, so the scene is reconstructed as a trail of colored points around the walker.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Polycam/Scaniverse 扫一条走廊，导出点云并用 three.js 只显示离你 5 米内的点；加一个变化：点云随脚步声闪烁。
works.description_zh: 在台湾一条街道上的夜间漫步，被呈现为一个由 iPhone LiDAR 实时构建的稀疏点云世界，既展现了这种传感器的神奇之处，也暴露了它 5 米的探测距离限制。
works.idea_en: Turn LiDAR's short sight into a dreamlike style of street scene.
works.technique_zh: 每一帧的 LiDAR 深度采样被重投影为世界空间中的点并不断累积，让场景重建为行走者周围的一道彩色点迹。
works.exercise_en: Scan a corridor with Polycam or Scaniverse, export the point cloud, and use three.js to show only the points within 5 meters of you. Twist: make the point cloud flicker with your footsteps.

works.title: World Lines (Colour Light Waves)
works.description: A short film of Friedlander's 'Colour Light Waves', his own invention: a spinning string lit by fast-changing coloured light forms glowing waves and knots that float in the dark. It mixes live performances at the Bookery Gallery in London (2021, 2022) with earlier installations in Valencia, Jerusalem, Shambala and Slane Castle.
works.description_zh: 一段关于 Friedlander 自创“彩色光波”的短片：一根高速旋转的弦在快速变色的光照下，形成悬浮在黑暗中的发光波纹和结。片中混合了 2021、2022 年在伦敦 Bookery 画廊的现场表演，以及早年在瓦伦西亚、耶路撒冷、Shambala 和斯莱恩城堡的装置。
works.idea_en: Persistence of vision can draw a 3D shape in thin air; many 'holographic' AR effects are just this — a fast-moving line that the eye fuses into a volume.
works.idea_zh: 视觉暂留可以在空中画出立体形状；很多“全息”AR 效果本质上就是这样——一条快速移动的线被眼睛融合成一个体积。
works.technique: A motor spins a taut string into a standing-wave shape while stroboscopic, colour-changing light synchronised to the rotation freezes or shifts the visible pattern.
works.technique_zh: 马达把绷紧的弦转成驻波形状，与转速同步的变色频闪光让可见图案定格或变化。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR or Three.js effect that draws a single glowing line moving fast along a sine wave in space, leaving a short trail so the eye sees a surface. Twist: map the wave's frequency to music from the microphone.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 Three.js 做一个效果：一条发光的线沿正弦波在空间中快速移动并留下短短的拖尾，让眼睛看到一个面；变体：用麦克风里的音乐控制波的频率。

video.video_title: World Lines   Paul Friedlander

works.title: ZERO10 x Crosby Studios store with digital-only clothing
works.description: A physical store in New York designed with Crosby Studios that sells clothes that exist only digitally: a visitor stands in front of a tall screen in a green-tiled room and sees herself wearing the digital jacket.
works.description_zh: 与 Crosby Studios 合作、位于纽约的实体店，出售只以数字形式存在的衣服：顾客站在绿色瓷砖房间里的一块竖屏前，就能看到自己穿上数字夹克的样子。
works.idea_en: A real shop for unreal clothes: the fitting room becomes a mirror screen.
works.idea_zh: 为不存在的衣服开一家真实的店：试衣间变成了一面屏幕镜子。
works.technique: A camera above a portrait display tracks the shopper's body and the try-on engine renders the selected digital garment on the live video, turning the screen into an AR mirror.
works.technique_zh: 竖屏上方的摄像头追踪顾客的身体，试穿引擎把选中的数字服装渲染到实时画面上，让屏幕变成一面 AR 镜子。
works.exercise_en: Turn a laptop and an external monitor rotated to portrait into an AR mirror with MediaPipe Pose and three.js that dresses visitors in one digital garment. Twist: the mirror only shows the garment when two people stand in front of it together.
works.exercise_zh: 用一台笔记本和一块竖放的外接显示器，结合 MediaPipe Pose 和 three.js，做一面给来访者“穿上”一件数字服装的 AR 镜子；变体：只有两个人同时站在镜子前时衣服才会出现。

video.video_title: We believe in being able to bridge the gap between the real and the virtual world. Instead of directly replacing physical spaces for brands, we offer #phygital solutions — integrating blended shopping

works.title: do.we.touch
works.description: Created at the Choreographic Coding Lab at A+E Lab, this contact-improvisation duet explores consent and intimacy: performers wear pulse sensors whose heartbeats trigger stage light and projection while depth-camera tracking follows their closeness.
works.description_zh: 诞生于 A+E Lab 的 Choreographic Coding Lab：这段接触即兴双人舞探讨同意与亲密，表演者佩戴脉搏传感器，心跳触发舞台灯光和投影，深度摄像头追踪两人的距离。
works.idea_en: Let heartbeats light up the space between two people who are negotiating touch.
works.idea_zh: 让心跳照亮两个正在协商触碰的人之间的空间。
works.technique: Arduino pulse sensors and Orbbec Astra movement tracking feed Isadora, which drives DMX lighting and projection.
works.technique_zh: Arduino 脉搏传感器和 Orbbec Astra 动作追踪把数据送入 Isadora，驱动 DMX 灯光和投影。
works.exercise_en: Stream two phone-camera heart-rate readings (or clip-on sensors) to a projection that brightens as the pair's pulses converge. Twist: projection only appears when the partners are within arm's length.
works.exercise_zh: 把两部手机摄像头测到的心率（或夹式传感器）传到投影，两人心跳越接近画面越亮；变体：只有两人相距一臂之内时才出现投影。

video.video_title: do.we.touch

works.title: godot-particles
works.description: Thousands of GPU particles swirl in curl-noise currents and gather toward targets, rendered as small shaded spheres; shared as a template for the Godot engine.
works.description_zh: 成千上万个 GPU 粒子在旋度噪声的气流中旋转，并向目标聚拢，以带明暗的小球渲染；作为 Godot 引擎的模板分享出来。
works.idea_en: A minimal GPU-particle template for an open-source engine.
works.idea_zh: 为开源引擎准备的一个最小 GPU 粒子模板。
works.technique: A Godot particles shader (shader_type particles) updates each particle with curl-noise, collision and 'go to' force-field rules, and a billboard shader draws every particle as a sphere impostor.
works.technique_zh: 一个 Godot 粒子着色器（shader_type particles）按旋度噪声、碰撞和“趋向目标”的力场规则更新每个粒子，再用公告板着色器把每个粒子画成球体替身（impostor）。
works.exercise_en: Port the template to a WebXR or Godot OpenXR passthrough scene and emit particles from the controllers or hands. Twist: freeze all particles in place when the user closes a fist.
works.exercise_zh: 把模板移植到 WebXR 或 Godot OpenXR 的透视场景中，从手柄或双手发射粒子。变体：用户握拳时所有粒子原地冻结。

video.video_title:
particles template for #GodotEngine
https://t.co/vuUpy9xBst https://t.co/fPrKDXPcFe

works.title: mesh-to-sdf VFX Examples
works.description: An animated character is turned into a signed distance field every frame; a pink particle figure conforms to it, electric 'Sparky' particles collide with it, and green bubbles are raymarched around it.
works.description_zh: 一个动画角色每帧都被转换成有向距离场；粉色粒子人形贴合它，电光“Sparky”粒子与它碰撞，绿色气泡则通过光线步进环绕着它。
works.idea_en: Rebuild the character's shape as a field every frame, and any number of effects can hug, avoid or fill it.
works.idea_zh: 每帧把角色的形状重建成一个场，任意数量的特效都能贴附、避开或填满它。
works.technique: Unity's mesh-to-sdf package voxelises a low-poly proxy of the animated character into a 3D SDF texture each frame; VFX Graph samples it with Position (SDF), Conform to SDF and Collide with SDF nodes, and a shader raymarches it.
works.technique_zh: Unity 的 mesh-to-sdf 包每帧把动画角色的低多边形代理体素化成三维 SDF 纹理；VFX Graph 用 Position (SDF)、Conform to SDF 和 Collide with SDF 节点采样它，另有一个着色器对它做光线步进。
works.exercise_en: Bake an SDF of a scanned real object (or an ARKit body-tracked avatar) and make VFX Graph particles swarm onto its surface in AR. Twist: the swarm leaves the body when the person stops moving.
works.exercise_zh: 为扫描得到的真实物体（或 ARKit 人体追踪角色）烘焙一个 SDF，让 VFX Graph 粒子在 AR 中蜂拥贴到它的表面。变体：当人停止移动时，粒子群离开身体。

video.video_title:
I’ve also published a project with examples of how to use the output SDF for visual effects.

That’s the video from the top there: dynamic SDFs being used by two VFX Graph effects, and a raymarching s

works.title: plant drone
works.description: A drone carries a live plant whose leaf signals decide the flight path; an LED on the drone and an open camera shutter on the ground turn the plant's piloting into long-exposure drawings in the night sky.
works.description_zh: 一架无人机载着一株活植物，由叶片的信号决定飞行路线；无人机上的 LED 加上地面相机的长时间曝光，把植物“驾驶”的轨迹变成夜空中的光绘。
works.idea_en: Letting a non-human pilot draw in the sky and capturing the path with long exposure is a ready-made recipe for AR light trails.
works.idea_zh: 让一个非人类的“飞行员”在天空作画，并用长曝光记录路径，这是 AR 光轨的现成配方。
works.technique: Variable-resistance readings from each leaf are mapped to the drone's roll, pitch and altitude, while a long-exposure photograph records the LED path.
works.technique_zh: 每片叶子的可变电阻读数被映射为无人机的横滚、俯仰和高度，同时用长曝光照片记录 LED 的路径。
works.exercise_en: Attach a virtual light to a moving real object (a toy car, your hand, a friend walking) with AR tracking and let it leave a persistent glowing trail in the room. Twist: let a random or plant-like signal steer a virtual drone instead of a person.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR 追踪把一个虚拟光点附着在移动的真实物体上（玩具车、你的手、走路的朋友），让它在房间里留下持久的发光轨迹。变体：改让随机的或类似植物的信号去操控一架虚拟无人机。

video.video_title: plant drone

salient.why_en: A living plant flies the drone, and its flight path is drawn in the night sky.
salient.why_zh: 一株活的植物驾驶无人机，它的飞行轨迹被画在夜空里。

works.title: shemza.digital #8
works.description: Visitors scan a QR code, make their own digital painting in the style of Anwar Shemza on their phone, and send it to an ever-growing archive that animates on the gallery wall; made with Stuart Batchelor and Peter Todd.
works.description_zh: 观众扫描二维码，在手机上以 Anwar Shemza 的风格画一幅数字画，再把它提交到不断增长的档案中，档案在展厅墙上以动画形式播放；与 Stuart Batchelor 和 Peter Todd 合作。
works.idea_en: Every visitor's phone painting joins a shared, living wall in the gallery.
works.idea_zh: 每位观众在手机上画的画，都会汇入展厅里一面共享的、活的墙。
works.technique: A web painting app reached by QR code saves each submission to an online archive, and a real-time animation on the gallery screen pulls in the new paintings as they arrive.
works.technique_zh: 通过二维码打开网页绘画应用，每件作品都存进在线档案，展厅屏幕上的实时动画会把新到的画作即时加入。
works.exercise_en: Build a p5.js drawing page limited to three shapes and five colours that posts each drawing to a shared wall projected in class. Twist: each new drawing pushes the oldest one off the wall.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 做一个只允许三种形状、五种颜色的绘画网页，每幅画都会发送到课堂投影的共享墙上；变体：每来一幅新画，就把最旧的一幅挤出墙面。

video.video_title: shemza digital #8, 2022 - Interactive digital painting application - Aphra Shemza & Stuart Batchelor

works.title: #1scanaday
works.description: Starting on New Year 2021, Mikko posted one 3D scan a day made with iPhone LiDAR and photogrammetry apps; day 100 was this bronze lion, and every scan was published on Sketchfab.
works.description_zh: 从 2021 年元旦起，Mikko 每天发布一个用 iPhone LiDAR 或摄影测量应用做的 3D 扫描，第 100 天是这只青铜狮子，所有扫描都公开在 Sketchfab 上。
works.idea_en: A daily capture habit teaches you what reality can and cannot be scanned.
works.idea_zh: 每天扫描一次，慢慢就知道现实中什么能扫、什么扫不了。
works.technique: Each object or space is captured with a LiDAR iPhone or with photo-based photogrammetry apps (3d Scanner App, Polycam, Trnio) and uploaded as a textured mesh to Sketchfab for web and AR viewing.
works.technique_zh: 每件物体或空间都用带 LiDAR 的 iPhone 或基于照片的摄影测量应用（3d Scanner App、Polycam、Trnio）捕捉，生成带纹理的网格上传到 Sketchfab，供网页和 AR 查看。
works.exercise_en: Scan one object a day for a week with a free phone scanner, log what failed (shiny, thin, dark), and place the best scan in AR. Twist: scan the same object with two different apps and compare.
works.exercise_zh: 一周内每天用免费手机扫描应用扫一个物体，记录失败原因（反光、太薄、太暗），把最好的扫描放进 AR；变体：用两个不同应用扫描同一物体并比较。

video.video_title:
Boom that's 1️⃣0️⃣0️⃣! 🦁

https://t.co/3aQKegBLz4 #1scanaday https://t.co/2GEBy0PB9p

works.title: +Panic
works.description: Thousands of projected fish swim in an exhibition foyer and sense the visitors. If people move calmly, the fish become curious and approach; fast movements spread panic through the swarm.
works.description_zh: 成千上万条投影出来的鱼在展厅门厅里游动，并能感知观众。如果人动作平缓，鱼会好奇地靠近；动作一快，恐慌就会在鱼群中蔓延。
works.idea_en: A school of fish that only trusts you if you are calm.
works.idea_zh: 一群只在你平静时才信任你的鱼。
works.technique: Overhead tracking measures visitors' positions and speeds, and a GPU swarm simulation in vvvv gamma gives each fish curiosity and contagious flight behaviours, with sound linked to the swarm.
works.technique_zh: 顶部追踪测量观众的位置和速度，vvvv gamma 中的 GPU 群体模拟赋予每条鱼好奇和相互传染的逃逸行为，声音也与鱼群联动。
works.exercise_en: Code a boids flock in p5.js that follows the mouse or a tracked hand when it moves slowly and scatters when it moves fast. Twist: panic spreads from fish to fish with a delay.
works.exercise_zh: 在 p5.js 里写一个 boids 鱼群，鼠标或被追踪的手慢慢移动时鱼群跟随，动作快时鱼群四散；变体：恐慌会带着延迟从一条鱼传到另一条鱼。

video.video_title: +Panic

salient.why_en: Projected fish come close only if you move calmly; rush and panic ripples through the swarm.
salient.why_zh: 投影出来的鱼只在你动作平缓时才靠近；一着急，恐慌就在鱼群里蔓延。

works.title: 3D Face Landmarks in Shaders
works.description: A VRChat avatar mirrors a real face in real time, including blinks, brow movements and eye direction, tracked by networks that run inside shaders.
works.description_zh: 一个 VRChat 角色实时模仿真人的脸，包括眨眼、眉毛动作和视线方向，追踪由运行在着色器中的神经网络完成。
works.idea_en: Put the whole face-tracking pipeline on the GPU so an avatar can see its owner without plugins.
works.idea_zh: 把整条人脸追踪管线放到 GPU 上，让角色无需插件就能“看见”自己的主人。
works.technique: MediaPipe's Facemesh and Iris models are rewritten as chained UnityCG/HLSL fragment passes that output 3D landmarks, which then drive blend shapes for blinking, brows and gaze.
works.technique_zh: 把 MediaPipe 的 Facemesh 和 Iris 模型改写成串联的 UnityCG/HLSL 片元通道，输出三维人脸关键点，再用它们驱动眨眼、眉毛和视线的混合形状。
works.exercise_en: Use ARKit face tracking on a phone to drive a particle mask whose emission follows your blinks and brow raises. Twist: the mask sheds particles only when you frown.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机上的 ARKit 人脸追踪驱动一个粒子面具，让粒子发射跟随你的眨眼和挑眉。变体：只有皱眉时面具才会掉落粒子。

video.video_title:
New and improved face tracking in #VRChat!

I added blinking, brow movements, and eye tracking 👀.

And I released the source here! https://t.co/amYdgEhX9x

Thanks to @MerlinVR_, @RalivDev for the help

works.title: 3D Volumetric Fire
works.description: A mesh bursts into volumetric flames that curl and rise in 3D, rendered as a glowing gas rather than flat fire sprites.
works.description_zh: 一个网格燃起三维的体积火焰，火苗卷曲上升，呈现为发光的气体，而不是扁平的火焰贴图。
works.idea_en: Simulate fire as a real 3D gas instead of faking it with billboards.
works.idea_zh: 把火当作真正的三维气体来模拟，而不是用贴图公告板去假装。
works.technique: A GPU grid fluid solver in compute shaders (after GPU Gems 3's 3D fluid chapter) advects velocity, temperature and density on a voxel grid, the source mesh is voxelised to emit fuel, and the volume is raymarched for display.
works.technique_zh: 用计算着色器写的 GPU 网格流体求解器（参考 GPU Gems 3 的三维流体章节）在体素网格上平流速度、温度和密度；发火源网格先被体素化来释放燃料，最后对体积做光线步进来显示。
works.exercise_en: Port a small voxel-grid smoke solver to a phone and anchor the volume above a real candle or cup with AR Foundation. Twist: let blowing into the microphone push the smoke sideways.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个小型体素网格烟雾求解器移植到手机上，用 AR Foundation 把体积锚定在真实的蜡烛或杯子上方。变体：对着麦克风吹气，把烟吹向一边。

video.video_title:
3D Volumetric Fire on Unity. In progress..
少しずつ炎に近づいてきた．あとは温度管理などすれば
#Unity #MadeWithUnity
https://t.co/YAWbwEU7dV https://t.co/mipaiucbPZ

works.title: A robot that tidies up ornaments
works.description: A virtual robot rolls around the real floor collecting fallen Christmas ornaments in WebAR.
works.idea_zh: 一个在真实地板上帮你收拾圣诞装饰的虚拟机器人。

video.video_title: Merry Christmas 🎄🙌🏼🎉 Here is a robot helping me collect some fallen ornaments this morning. #webar #8thwall #aframe https://t.co/u0ugtwmV4S

works.technique: Virtual ornaments and a robot share the detected floor plane, and the robot steers toward the nearest ornament with a simple seek behavior and collects it on contact.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 地面上随机撒下几个小物件，让一个小机器人按距离依次去捡；变体：你用手机点地面可以给机器人设路障。
works.description_zh: 在 WebAR 中，一个虚拟机器人在真实地板上滚来滚去，把掉落的圣诞装饰收集起来。
works.idea_en: A virtual robot tidies up Christmas ornaments on your real floor.
works.technique_zh: 虚拟装饰和机器人共享检测到的地面平面，机器人通过简单的寻的（seek）行为驶向最近的装饰，并在接触时将其收集。
works.exercise_en: Scatter a few small objects at random on the AR floor and have a small robot pick them up in order of distance. Twist: tap the floor with your phone to set up roadblocks for the robot.

works.title: AIive: Interactive Visualization and Sonification of Neural Networks in Virtual Reality
works.description: A VR piece (IEEE AIVR 2021, with Jiannan Li and Bryan Wang, Best Presentation Award) where a neural network is laid out around you as layers of glowing nodes; you grab and stretch its hyperparameters with your hands while its loss and accuracy are played back as sound during training.
works.description_zh: 一件 VR 作品（IEEE AIVR 2021，与 Jiannan Li、Bryan Wang 合作，获最佳报告奖）：一个神经网络以一层层发光节点的形式摆在你周围，你用双手抓取、拉伸它的超参数，训练过程中的损失和准确率会实时变成声音。
works.idea_en: Make an invisible process tangible: a learning machine you can walk around, touch and hear getting better.
works.idea_zh: 把看不见的过程变得可以触摸：一台正在学习的机器，你可以绕着它走、用手摸，还能听见它一点点变好。
works.technique: A Unity VR scene with hand tracking renders each network layer as nodes in space and maps grabbed handles to hyperparameters of a live training loop, likely streaming loss and accuracy values into pitch and rhythm of synthesized sound.
works.technique_zh: 在支持手部追踪的 Unity VR 场景中，把网络的每一层渲染成空间中的节点，把可抓取的手柄映射到实时训练循环的超参数上，并很可能把损失值和准确率实时转换为合成声音的音高与节奏。
works.exercise_en: Place a small neural network (for example a TensorFlow.js digit classifier) in WebXR or phone AR as a stack of spheres on your desk, and map its training loss to a tone that falls as it learns. Twist: let a hand pinch-and-drag set the learning rate and hear what happens when it is too high.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个小型神经网络（例如 TensorFlow.js 手写数字分类器）用 WebXR 或手机 AR 以一叠小球的形式放在桌面上，把训练损失映射成随学习逐渐降低的音调。变体：用手捏合拖动来设置学习率，听听学习率过高时会发生什么。

video.video_title: AIive: Interactive Visualization & Sonification of Neural Networks in Virtual Reality, IEEE AIVR'21

works.title: AR Light Saber with MediaPipe and p5.js
works.description: A browser toy that detects your hand with MediaPipe and draws a glowing lightsaber extending from it on the webcam feed.
works.idea_zh: 网页里用手势识别，从手中长出一把光剑。

video.video_title: AR Light Saber with Mediapipe and p5js

works.technique: MediaPipe Hands returns 2D landmarks each frame, and a glowing line is drawn along the direction from the wrist through the knuckles in p5.js over the webcam feed.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands + p5.js 从手腕沿手指方向画一根发光光剑，挥动时留下拖影；变体：两只手的光剑相交时发出火花和声音。
works.description_zh: 一个浏览器小玩具：用 MediaPipe 识别你的手，并在网络摄像头画面中从手里延伸出一把发光的光剑。
works.idea_en: Gesture tracking in a web page grows a lightsaber out of your hand.
works.technique_zh: MediaPipe Hands 每帧返回二维关键点，p5.js 沿着从手腕穿过指关节的方向，在摄像头画面上绘制一条发光的线。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Hands and p5.js to draw a glowing lightsaber from the wrist along the fingers that leaves a trail as you swing it. Twist: when the sabers in both hands cross, they throw sparks and make a sound.

works.title: AR MeshWave
works.description: A rainbow of 'gaming light' sweeps across the walls, floor and furniture of a real room, re-creating the LiDAR AR Spaces effect of Apple Clips in Unity.
works.description_zh: 一道彩虹般的“电竞灯光”扫过真实房间的墙壁、地板和家具，在 Unity 里重现了 Apple Clips 的 LiDAR AR Spaces 效果。
works.idea_en: A light wave that only exists on real surfaces makes the scanned room itself the effect.
works.idea_zh: 一道只存在于真实表面上的光波，让扫描出的房间本身成为特效。
works.technique: AR Foundation meshing turns LiDAR scans into a room mesh; a roughly 50-line shader colours each fragment by its world-space distance from an origin minus time, so rainbow bands expand over every real surface.
works.technique_zh: AR Foundation 的网格重建把 LiDAR 扫描变成房间网格；一个约 50 行的着色器根据每个片元到起点的世界空间距离减去时间来着色，于是彩虹色带在每个真实表面上向外扩散。
works.exercise_en: Re-create the mesh wave on a LiDAR iPhone with AR Foundation meshing and a distance-based Shader Graph material. Twist: start a new wave wherever you tap, and let waves from different taps interfere.
works.exercise_zh: 在带 LiDAR 的 iPhone 上用 AR Foundation 网格重建和基于距离的 Shader Graph 材质重现这种网格波。变体：在你点击的位置发出新的波，并让不同点击产生的波互相叠加干涉。

video.video_title: Reimplemented AR Spaces effect added to Apple Clips in Unity. Apple Clipsに搭載されたらしいLiDARを使ったs/ゲーミングライトプロジェクション/ARエフェクト/をUnityで再実装してみた。Unityなら50行Shaderを書くだけでできます。ソース⇒ https://t.co/pmXiUEJfIG #madewithun

works.title: AR Photoshop Plugin
works.description: A Photoshop plugin streams each layer of a document to a phone so the layers can be pulled out of the monitor and viewed in AR.
works.idea_zh: 把 Photoshop 图层从显示器里“拽”出来放进 AR。

video.video_title: Let’s Make an Augmented Reality Photoshop Plugin with UNITY.

works.technique: A Photoshop plugin exports each layer as an image over WebSockets, and the phone stacks them as quads offset in depth on the monitor (tracked by Vuforia), letting the user pull layers apart in space.
works.exercise_zh: 把一张分层海报的各图层导出为 PNG，在图像追踪的海报上按深度分层叠放，捏合手势拉开层间距；变体：让层间距随手机离海报的距离自动变化。
works.description_zh: 一个 Photoshop 插件把文档的每个图层实时传到手机上，让这些图层可以从显示器中被拉出来，在 AR 中查看。
works.idea_en: Pull Photoshop layers out of the monitor and into AR.
works.technique_zh: Photoshop 插件通过 WebSockets 把每个图层导出为图像，手机则在显示器上（由 Vuforia 追踪）将它们按深度错开叠放成若干四边形面片，用户可以在空间中把图层拉开。
works.exercise_en: Export each layer of a layered poster as a PNG, stack them by depth on the image-tracked poster, and use a pinch gesture to spread the layers apart. Twist: make the layer spacing change automatically with the phone's distance from the poster.

works.title: AR Shooter Shared Between Nreal Light and iPad
works.description: A co-located AR shooting game in which a glasses wearer and an iPad player see and fight the same virtual targets.
works.idea_zh: 眼镜玩家和 iPad 玩家在同一空间合作打 AR 射击。

video.video_title: AR Shooter: Sharing AR View Between Nreal Light and iPad

works.technique: Both devices align to a shared reference (likely a common image marker or anchor) so their coordinate frames match, and target states and hits are synced over the network.
works.exercise_zh: 用一张打印图片作为共同原点，让 HoloKit 头显和手机两端看到同一组靶子并同步击中状态；变体：两人能力不对称，一人射击一人移动靶子。
works.description_zh: 一款同处一地的 AR 射击游戏：戴眼镜的玩家和用 iPad 的玩家看到并攻击同一批虚拟目标。
works.idea_en: A glasses player and an iPad player team up for AR shooting in the same space.
works.technique_zh: 两台设备都对齐到一个共享参照物（大概率是同一个图像标记或锚点），使二者的坐标系一致，目标状态和命中情况通过网络同步。
works.exercise_en: Use a printed image as a shared origin so a HoloKit headset and a phone see the same set of targets and sync hit states. Twist: give the two players unequal abilities, with one shooting and the other moving the targets.

works.title: AR Task Guidance for ISS Stowage
works.description: Carmine Elvezio and colleagues guide astronauts' stowage operations with head-worn AR, highlighting where each item goes in cramped space-station racks.
works.idea_zh: 在空间站拥挤的货架上，用AR指出每件物品该放在哪里。

video.video_title: Augmented reality task guidance for international space station stowage operations

works.technique: A HoloLens is registered to the rack layout, and the application highlights the target stowage location with world-locked outlines and path cues while tracking task progress item by item.
works.exercise_zh: 给宿舍柜子或实验室抽屉建一份物品清单，在手机 AR 中逐件显示“这件放在哪一格”的高亮框；变体：反向设计为“找东西”模式，并测试比纯文字清单快多少。
works.description_zh: Carmine Elvezio 及其同事利用头戴式 AR 指导宇航员的货物存放作业，在空间站狭窄的货架中高亮标出每件物品应放的位置。
works.idea_en: On the space station's cramped racks, AR points out where each item belongs.
works.technique_zh: HoloLens 与货架布局完成配准，应用以锁定在世界空间中的轮廓和路径提示高亮目标存放位置，并逐件追踪任务进度。
works.exercise_en: Build an item list for a dorm cabinet or lab drawers and show a highlight box in phone AR for which slot each item goes in, one item at a time. Twist: reverse it into a find-things mode and test how much faster it is than a text-only list.

works.title: AR athletes in Google Search
works.description: Announced at Google I/O 2021: searching for athletes such as Simone Biles, Naomi Osaka or Megan Rapinoe lets you watch a captured 3D performance of their signature moves in your room; he worked on it from the early concept.
works.description_zh: 在 Google I/O 2021 上发布：搜索 Simone Biles、大坂直美或 Megan Rapinoe 等运动员，就能在自己的房间里观看他们招牌动作的 3D 捕捉表演；他从最初的概念阶段就参与了这个项目。
works.idea_en: Bring star athletes' movements into your living room at life size.
works.idea_zh: 把明星运动员的动作以真实大小带进你的客厅。
works.technique: Likely volumetric or motion-captured animations delivered as 3D assets through Search and placed with ARCore Scene Viewer.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是把体积捕捉或动作捕捉的动画作为 3D 资源，经搜索分发，并通过 ARCore Scene Viewer 放置。
works.exercise_en: Record a classmate doing one move with a phone and turn it into an animated 3D figure placed in AR. Twist: let viewers slow it down to study the form.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍下同学做一个动作，把它变成放在 AR 里的 3D 动画人物。变体：让观众可以放慢速度研究动作细节。

video.video_title: If you’ve ever wanted to see Megan Rapinoe, Naomi Osaka or Simone Biles perform their impressive feats up close, now you can. We’re bringing some of the world’s best athletes to AR in Search. #GoogleI

works.title: AR birding guide (Adobe Aero)
works.description: A postcard series for bird-lovers becomes an interactive AR birding guide: illustrated birds fly off the cards and can be explored in 3D.
works.idea_zh: 明信片上的鸟一扫就飞出来，变成可互动的观鸟图鉴。

video.video_title: Behind-the-Art: Adobe Aero Augmented Reality Experience by Velvet Spectrum | Adobe Creative Cloud

works.technique: Adobe Aero image anchors recognize each postcard and trigger animated 3D birds with tap behaviors.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Adobe Aero 把学生画的明信片做成 AR 图鉴，扫卡出现 3D 动物和科普文字；加一个变化：两张卡放在一起动物会互动。
works.description_zh: 一套为爱鸟人士设计的明信片变成了可互动的 AR 观鸟指南：插画中的鸟儿从卡片上飞出来，可以在三维中细细观察。
works.idea_en: Scan a postcard and its bird flies out, becoming an interactive birding guide.
works.technique_zh: Adobe Aero 的图像锚点识别每张明信片，并触发带有点击行为的三维鸟类动画。
works.exercise_en: Use Adobe Aero to turn postcards drawn by students into an AR field guide where scanning a card brings up a 3D animal and science facts. Twist: when two cards are placed together, their animals interact.

works.title: AR glasses superpowers for illustrators
works.description: A prototype imagining how AR glasses could let an illustrator or animator draw and see animated overlays directly on paper and the desk.
works.idea_zh: 想象 AR 眼镜给插画师的“超能力”：纸上的画直接动起来。
works.technique: Likely combines a tracked sheet of paper (image or plane tracking) with animated overlays rendered in-place so drawings and animation guides align with the physical page.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪识别一张手绘稿，在纸上叠加一段会动的动画；变体：让画中角色能“走出”纸面到桌上。

video.video_title: AR glasses will give superpowers to illustrators and animators. https://t.co/6M1Av28322

works.description_zh: 一个原型，设想 AR 眼镜如何让插画师或动画师直接在纸上和桌面上绘画，并看到动态的叠加内容。
works.idea_en: Imagine the superpowers AR glasses could give illustrators: drawings on paper come to life.
works.technique_zh: 大概率将被追踪的纸张（图像追踪或平面追踪）与原位渲染的动画叠加层结合，使画作和动画辅助线与实体纸面对齐。
works.exercise_en: Use image tracking to recognize a hand-drawn sketch and overlay a moving animation on the paper. Twist: let a character in the drawing walk off the page onto the desk.

works.title: ARVolumeVFX — Eyez Matrix
works.description: On an iPad, the room captured by LiDAR turns into streams of green particles that trace every wall, chair and surface around the viewer.
works.description_zh: 在 iPad 上，LiDAR 捕捉到的房间变成一串串绿色粒子，勾勒出观者周围的每面墙、每把椅子和每个表面。
works.idea_en: Rebuild the real room out of particles, live, from the device's depth sensor.
works.idea_zh: 用设备的深度传感器，实时用粒子把真实房间重建出来。
works.technique: A LidarDataProcessor reads AR Foundation's environment mesh and depth, and a VFX property binder passes the mesh vertices to VFX Graph, where a subgraph spawns particles on the environment-mesh positions.
works.technique_zh: LidarDataProcessor 读取 AR Foundation 的环境网格和深度，VFX 属性绑定器把网格顶点传给 VFX Graph，由一个子图在环境网格位置上生成粒子。
works.exercise_en: Build the toolkit's example scene on a LiDAR iPhone or iPad and replace the green 'matrix' look with your own particle style. Twist: make particles fall off surfaces like rain whenever the user claps.
works.exercise_zh: 在带 LiDAR 的 iPhone 或 iPad 上构建工具包的示例场景，把绿色“矩阵”外观换成你自己的粒子风格。变体：用户一拍手，粒子就像雨一样从表面上落下。

video.video_title:
Welcome to Eyez Matrix ✨
WIP

works.title: ARVolumeVFX — Human particles
works.description: A person in front of the iPad is filled with a cloud of particles that follows their silhouette while the background stays real.
works.description_zh: iPad 前的人被一团粒子填满，粒子跟随他的轮廓移动，而背景保持真实。
works.idea_en: Use the AR human stencil to keep particles only inside a person's body.
works.idea_zh: 用 AR 人像遮罩，让粒子只留在人的身体里。
works.technique: Human depth and stencil textures from ARKit people occlusion are bound into VFX Graph; a 'Human Froxel' subgraph places particles in the person's volume and a 'Kill Nonhuman' block removes any particle outside the stencil.
works.technique_zh: 把 ARKit 人物遮挡提供的人体深度和遮罩纹理绑定进 VFX Graph；“Human Froxel”子图把粒子放进人体体积内，“Kill Nonhuman”模块删除遮罩外的所有粒子。
works.exercise_en: Point the phone at a dancer and use the human stencil to turn them into a particle body; record a short clip. Twist: let particles that leave the silhouette keep flying so fast moves shed a trail.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机对准一位舞者，用人像遮罩把他变成粒子身体并录一段短片。变体：让离开轮廓的粒子继续飞行，快速动作会甩出一条尾迹。

works.title: Adding VFX to a Bibcam clip
works.description: A recorded Bibcam walk is post-processed so that particles and light trails wrap around the real buildings and people, with the effect following the real depth of the street.
works.idea_zh: 对一段已录好的深度视频做'空间感知'的后期特效。

video.video_title:
Adding VFX to a Bibcam clip (recorded with iPhone 13 Pro Max)
https://t.co/HYIIG7pEyz https://t.co/vDB5I8Ffby

works.technique: Depth and pose embedded in the video let VFX Graph sample the real geometry per frame, so particles can spawn on and collide with surfaces in the footage.
works.exercise_zh: 把一段深度视频导入 TouchDesigner，用深度通道控制粒子密度，让近处的人变成光点；加一个变化：粒子颜色随时间从白天过渡到夜晚。
works.description_zh: 对一段用 Bibcam 录制的行走视频进行后期处理，让粒子和光迹环绕真实的建筑与行人，特效随街道的真实深度而变化。
works.idea_en: Add space-aware post effects to a depth video that has already been recorded.
works.technique_zh: 视频中嵌入的深度和位姿信息让 VFX Graph 能逐帧采样真实几何，使粒子可以在画面中的表面上生成并与之碰撞。
works.exercise_en: Import a depth video into TouchDesigner and use the depth channel to control particle density so nearby people turn into points of light. Twist: shift the particle colors over time from day to night.

works.title: Altering Perceived Softness of Real Rigid Objects
works.description: A thin device restricts how the fingerpad deforms, so pressing a hard real object feels softer or harder than it is, useful for MR props.
works.idea_zh: 改变指腹变形，让硬桌子摸起来变软。

video.video_title: Altering Perceived Softness of Real Rigid Objects by Restricting Fingerpad Deformation (Best Paper)

works.technique: Constrains lateral fingerpad spread with a rigid ring and nail mount, changing the tactile cue the brain uses to judge compliance.
works.exercise_zh: 让同学分别用裸指和戴胶带缠紧的手指按同一块海绵/桌面，评估软硬感差异；变化：配合手机AR显示“软/硬”的视觉提示看是否能强化错觉。
works.description_zh: 一种轻薄装置通过限制指腹的变形，让按压真实的坚硬物体时感觉比实际更软或更硬，可用于 MR 道具。
works.idea_en: Change how the fingerpad deforms and a hard table feels soft.
works.technique_zh: 用刚性指环和指甲支架限制指腹的横向扩展，从而改变大脑用来判断软硬程度的触觉线索。
works.exercise_en: Have classmates press the same sponge or tabletop with a bare finger and with a finger tightly wrapped in tape, and rate the difference in softness. Twist: add a soft or hard visual cue in phone AR and see whether it strengthens the illusion.

works.title: Anti-Body
works.description: Three dancers, physically isolated but digitally connected, move between translucent screens while streams of motion-responsive code and particle imagery grow from their bodies, making them set, lighting and characters at once.
works.description_zh: 三位舞者在物理上彼此隔离、在数字上相互连接，他们穿梭于半透明幕之间，响应动作的代码流和粒子影像从身体里生长出来，使他们同时成为布景、灯光和角色。
works.idea_en: Live motion capture turns dancers into the light and scenery of the show.
works.idea_zh: 实时动作捕捉让舞者本身成为演出的灯光和布景。
works.technique: A live motion-capture system streams the performers' skeletons into real-time visuals by Uncharted Limbo Collective, which are projected onto layered translucent screens around them.
works.technique_zh: 实时动作捕捉系统把表演者的骨架数据传入 Uncharted Limbo Collective 制作的实时影像，再投到环绕他们的多层半透明幕上。
works.exercise_en: Hang two sheets of tulle one metre apart, project a particle system driven by a webcam skeleton onto both, and have a student dance between them. Twist: let the particles on the front sheet show where the dancer was one second ago.
works.exercise_zh: 挂两层相距一米的纱幕，把由摄像头骨架驱动的粒子系统投到两层纱上，让学生在中间起舞；变体：让前层纱上的粒子显示舞者一秒前的位置。

video.video_title: ANTI-BODY | 2022 Trailer

works.title: Audio Reactive FaceMap (AR 100 Days, Day 52)
works.description: The user's tracked face mesh changes color with the loudness of the sound around them, pulsing with speech and music.
works.description_zh: 用户被跟踪的人脸网格随周围声音的响度改变颜色，随说话和音乐一起脉动。
works.idea_en: Let the face become a VU meter.
works.idea_zh: 让脸变成一个音量表。
works.technique: ARKit face tracking provides the face geometry, and an AudioQueue input measures volume each frame to drive the mesh material color.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 面部跟踪提供人脸几何，AudioQueue 音频输入每帧测量音量，驱动网格材质的颜色。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation face tracking and the microphone to map loudness to a color ramp on the face mesh. Twist: map pitch instead of loudness so singing paints the face.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 面部跟踪和麦克风，把响度映射成人脸网格上的颜色渐变。变体：改为映射音高，让唱歌来给脸上色。

works.title: Augmented Games
works.description: Motion-tracked floor and wall projection that turns any space into a physical video-game playground and sports court.
works.idea_zh: 把任何场地变成可以跑跳的投影游戏场

video.video_title: Augmented Games | Transform Any Space Into Immersive Playground

works.technique: Overhead cameras or LiDAR track players' positions on the floor, and a game engine renders court graphics and game logic back through calibrated floor and wall projection.
works.exercise_zh: 用俯拍摄像头追踪地面上的人，在 TouchDesigner 或 Unity 中做一个投影到地面的小游戏（抢地盘、躲避方块）；变体：规则要求至少两人协作才能得分。
works.description_zh: 带动作追踪的地面与墙面投影，把任何空间变成可以跑跳的实体电子游戏场和运动场。
works.idea_en: Turn any space into a projected game field you can run and jump on.
works.technique_zh: 顶置摄像头或 LiDAR 追踪玩家在地面上的位置，游戏引擎渲染场地图形并运行游戏逻辑，再通过经过标定的地面与墙面投影呈现出来。
works.exercise_en: Track people on the floor with an overhead camera and build a small game projected onto the floor in TouchDesigner or Unity, such as claiming territory or dodging blocks. Twist: the rules require at least two people to cooperate to score.

works.title: Aura VFX Samples
works.description: Swirling aura effects rise around a point, built from particle systems and scrolling textures in a game-VFX style.
works.description_zh: 盘旋上升的光环特效在一个点周围升起，用粒子系统和滚动贴图做成，是典型的游戏特效风格。
works.idea_en: A convincing aura is a few simple meshes and particles with textures that flow over them.
works.idea_zh: 一个像样的光环，只需几个简单网格和粒子，再加上在上面流动的贴图。
works.technique: Unity ParticleSystem emitters use custom vertex streams and custom data to pass per-particle parameters to URP shaders that scroll and mask noise textures, and the toolbox generates the needed empty systems and shader presets.
works.technique_zh: Unity ParticleSystem 发射器通过自定义顶点流和自定义数据，把每个粒子的参数传给 URP 着色器，着色器滚动并遮罩噪声贴图；工具箱负责生成所需的空粒子系统和着色器预设。
works.exercise_en: Wrap an aura effect around a person's feet in AR using ARKit body tracking to place it. Twist: the aura's colour follows the loudness of the person's voice.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit 人体追踪定位，在 AR 中把光环特效围绕在一个人的脚边。变体：光环的颜色随这个人说话的音量变化。

works.title: Awkward Instance
works.description: Site-based AR 'paranormal apparitions' — glitchy dancing human forms made from stolen skins and mismatched motion-capture — appear in outdoor places.
works.idea_zh: 用错配的人皮与动捕数据做出会跳舞的“故障幽灵”
works.technique: Rigged 3D figures are driven by deliberately mismatched motion-capture clips and placed at sites with mobile AR.
works.exercise_zh: 从Mixamo下载角色和动作，故意把动作套到比例不对的角色上放进AR；变化：把全班录制的动作混搭给同一个角色。

video.video_title: Awkward Instance

works.description_zh: 出现在户外特定地点的 AR“灵异显现”：由盗用的人体皮肤贴图和错配的动作捕捉数据拼成、带着故障感的舞动人形。
works.idea_en: Mismatched human skins and motion-capture data become dancing glitch ghosts.
works.technique_zh: 绑定好骨骼的三维人形由刻意错配的动作捕捉片段驱动，并通过手机 AR 放置在特定场地。
works.exercise_en: Download characters and animations from Mixamo, deliberately apply motions to characters with the wrong proportions, and place them in AR. Twist: mix motions recorded by the whole class onto a single character.

works.title: Best Practices in Contemporary Dance
works.description: An ongoing improvised series with dancer Jorge Guevara: as he dances, Naoto live-codes glitch visuals in Hydra that sample and distort the webcam image of the dancer, and both react to each other.
works.description_zh: 与舞者 Jorge Guevara 长期进行的即兴系列：他跳舞时，Naoto 在 Hydra 中现场编程，采样并扭曲舞者的摄像头画面，两人互相回应。
works.idea_en: A dancer and a live coder improvise a duet through one webcam image.
works.idea_zh: 舞者和现场编程者通过同一个摄像头画面即兴合跳双人舞。
works.technique: Hydra, a browser-based video synth, takes the webcam as a source and chains feedback, displacement and colour functions typed live by the coder.
works.technique_zh: Hydra 是浏览器中的视频合成器，以摄像头为输入源，编程者现场输入反馈、位移和色彩函数链。
works.exercise_en: Open Hydra in a browser, use the webcam as source and take turns: one student dances for thirty seconds, the other changes one line of code. Twist: the dancer calls out words the coder must translate into effects.
works.exercise_zh: 在浏览器打开 Hydra，用摄像头作为源，两人轮流：一人跳舞三十秒，另一人改一行代码；变体：舞者喊出词语，编程者必须把它变成效果。

video.video_title: 2021 07 06 Best Practices (Naoto Hieda & Jorge Guevara)

works.title: Bibcam test in Shibuya
works.description: Street footage shot on an iPhone 13 Pro Max records depth and camera motion inside the video itself, so later the crossing in Shibuya can be re-lit and filled with 3D effects.
works.idea_zh: 录像时把深度和相机位姿一起'烙'进视频，之后就能给街景补上贴合空间的特效。

video.video_title: Bibcam Test with iPhone 13 Pro Max (Shibuya, 23rd Nov)

works.technique: Bibcam encodes the LiDAR depth map and camera pose as metadata burned into each recorded video frame, so Unity can later reconstruct the 3D scene for post-processed AR VFX.
works.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的手机录一段校园短片（或用 Record3D 导出），在 Unity/Blender 里给真实空间补上下雪或发光线条；加一个变化：特效只出现在离镜头 2 米之外。
works.description_zh: 用 iPhone 13 Pro Max 拍摄的街头影像把深度和相机运动直接记录在视频里，之后就能为涩谷十字路口重新打光，并填入三维特效。
works.idea_en: Burn depth and camera pose into the video as you record, so you can later add effects that fit the street space.
works.technique_zh: Bibcam 将 LiDAR 深度图和相机位姿作为元数据编码进每一帧录制画面，Unity 之后可据此重建三维场景，用于后期制作 AR 视觉特效。
works.exercise_en: Record a short campus clip with a LiDAR phone (or export one with Record3D), then add snow or glowing lines to the real space in Unity or Blender. Twist: make the effects appear only beyond 2 meters from the camera.

works.title: Björk: Arisen My Senses (concert visuals)
works.description: An audio-reactive excerpt of Gremmler's concert visuals for Björk's 'Arisen My Senses', transformed from a wide stage projection format into a circular arrangement of pulsing, flower-like shapes.
works.description_zh: Gremmler 为 Björk《Arisen My Senses》创作的演唱会视觉的一段随音频变化的节选，从宽幅舞台投影格式改编成圆形排列、不断脉动的花状形态。
works.idea_en: Reformatting the same visual system for a new shape (wide stage vs. circle) shows that good stage visuals are a system, not a single video, which is how AR effects should be designed too.
works.idea_zh: 把同一套视觉系统改编成新的形状（宽舞台与圆形），说明好的舞台视觉是一套系统而不是一段视频，AR 特效也应该这样设计。
works.technique: 3D forms are animated by audio analysis of the track (amplitude and frequency bands likely driving growth and colour) and rendered for stage projection.
works.technique_zh: 三维形态由对音轨的音频分析驱动（推测以振幅和频段控制生长与颜色），并渲染为舞台投影。
works.exercise_en: Build an audio-reactive AR 'flower' in Lens Studio or WebXR that opens and pulses with music from the microphone, placed on a real table. Twist: two phones hearing the same music grow two flowers that bloom in sync.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Lens Studio 或 WebXR 里做一朵随音频变化的 AR“花”，放在真实桌面上，随麦克风听到的音乐开合脉动；变体：两部手机听同一段音乐，长出的两朵花同步开放。

video.video_title: Björk, Arisen My Senses  (concert visuals)

works.title: BlazeFace face filters on Barracuda
works.description: A webcam face gets simple AR decorations placed on the eyes, nose and mouth, following head motion in real time.
works.description_zh: 摄像头中的人脸被加上简单的 AR 装饰，贴在眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴上，实时跟随头部动作。
works.idea_en: Six keypoints are enough to decorate a face.
works.idea_zh: 六个关键点就足够装饰一张脸。
works.technique: MediaPipe BlazeFace runs on Barracuda and outputs face boxes with six keypoints; weighted non-maximum suppression stabilizes them before the decorations are drawn.
works.technique_zh: MediaPipe BlazeFace 在 Barracuda 上运行，输出人脸框和六个关键点，经过加权非极大值抑制稳定后再绘制装饰。
works.exercise_en: Design a face filter from keypoints and run it with AR Foundation face tracking on a phone. Twist: the decoration reacts when two faces are close together.
works.exercise_zh: 基于关键点设计一个面部滤镜，用手机上的 AR Foundation 面部追踪运行。变体：两张脸靠近时，装饰会产生反应。

video.video_title: So now I can make face filters (BlazeFace on Unity Barracuda) https://t.co/6ffXyoZrtp https://t.co/taGvi2XVzE

works.title: BodyPix visual effects (NNCam)
works.description: A webcam segments the person from the background and body parts in real time, so particles, outlines and glitches can wrap only the human body in the live image.
works.idea_zh: 实时把人从背景里'抠'出来，特效只作用在人身上。

video.video_title: BodyPix Visual Effects with Unity Barracuda

works.technique: The BodyPix person-and-part segmentation network runs through Unity Barracuda, and its mask texture is used to emit and confine VFX Graph particles to the body.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation 或 TouchDesigner 把同学的身体变成流动的墨水而背景保持不动；加一个变化：只有举起的手会燃烧。
works.description_zh: 网络摄像头实时把人从背景中分割出来，并区分身体各部位，于是粒子、轮廓线和故障效果只会包裹实时画面中的人体。
works.idea_en: Cut the person out of the background in real time so effects only touch the body.
works.technique_zh: BodyPix 人体及部位分割网络通过 Unity Barracuda 运行，其遮罩纹理用于发射 VFX Graph 粒子，并把粒子限制在人体范围内。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation or TouchDesigner to turn a classmate's body into flowing ink while the background stays still. Twist: only a raised hand catches fire.

works.title: Butterflies AR
works.description: A flock of butterflies flutters around the room, lands on real surfaces such as plants and railings, avoids bumping into them and follows a moving point in space; he released it as a free Lens Studio asset.
works.description_zh: 一群蝴蝶在房间里飞舞，会落在植物、栏杆等真实物体表面，避开碰撞，并跟随空间中一个移动的点；他把它作为免费的 Lens Studio 素材发布。
works.idea_en: Let virtual butterflies land on the real objects around you.
works.idea_zh: 让虚拟蝴蝶停落在你身边的真实物体上。
works.technique: Each butterfly steers with simple flocking rules and raycasts against the LiDAR world mesh to find landing spots and avoid collisions; count, flight radius and flying 'character' are adjustable at runtime.
works.technique_zh: 每只蝴蝶按简单的群体规则飞行，并对 LiDAR 世界网格做射线检测来寻找落点、避免碰撞；数量、飞行半径和飞行“性格”都能在运行时调整。
works.exercise_en: Make five AR butterflies in WebXR or AR Foundation that fly randomly and land on the nearest detected plane after a few seconds. Twist: they fly away when the phone moves too close.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 或 AR Foundation 里做五只 AR 蝴蝶，随机飞行几秒后落到最近检测到的平面上；变体：手机靠得太近时它们会飞走。
