works.title: CMY Shadows Mirror
works.description: Rotating elements cast cyan, magenta and yellow shadows that mix on the wall into a coloured reflection of the viewer.
works.idea_zh: 用青、品、黄三色影子的叠加画出你的彩色镜像
works.technique: Motors rotate elements in front of coloured light sources so overlapping shadows subtractively mix into an image driven by the camera feed (likely).
works.exercise_zh: 用红绿蓝三盏手机灯照一个物体，观察彩色影子如何混合；变化：用舵机转动遮挡片，把摄像头亮度映射成彩色影子。

video.video_title: Daniel Rozin, "CMY Shadows Mirror", 2021 - MOA + L

works.description_zh: 旋转的元件投下青色、品红和黄色的影子，这些影子在墙上混合，形成观者的彩色映像。
works.idea_en: Overlapping cyan, magenta and yellow shadows paint a colored mirror image of you.
works.technique_zh: 电机转动彩色光源前方的元件，使重叠的影子以减色方式混合成由摄像头画面驱动的图像（可能如此实现）。
works.exercise_en: Light an object with three phone lights in red, green and blue and observe how the colored shadows mix. Twist: rotate blocking vanes with servos to map camera brightness into colored shadows.

salient.why_en: Three colored shadows overlap on the wall and mix into a colored reflection of you.
salient.why_zh: 青、品红、黄三色影子在墙上叠加，混合成你的彩色镜像。

works.title: Candy cane tower vs. robot
works.description: He stacks a physics-driven candy-cane tower on the floor in WebAR, and a small virtual robot knocks it down.
works.idea_zh: 在地板上搭一座会倒的虚拟糖果塔，再放一个捣蛋机器人。

video.video_title: I made a candy cane tower… but it was knocked down by my robot 😅🤖😖 #webxr #8thwall #aframe https://t.co/Jl3Sytu8kV

works.technique: A physics engine simulates stacked rigid bodies on an invisible ground collider at the detected floor, and a scripted robot applies forces on contact to topple the tower.
works.exercise_zh: 用 A-Frame 或 Unity 物理在地面上搭一座 AR 积木塔，再放一个会撞向它的小机器人；变体：让观众用手机倾斜角度控制机器人。
works.description_zh: 他在 WebAR 中于地板上搭起一座受物理驱动的拐杖糖塔，然后让一个小小的虚拟机器人把它撞倒。
works.idea_en: Build a topple-able virtual candy tower on the floor, then release a troublemaking robot.
works.technique_zh: 物理引擎在检测到的地面处放置一个不可见的地面碰撞体，模拟叠放的刚体；脚本控制的机器人在接触时施加力，把塔推倒。
works.exercise_en: Use A-Frame or Unity physics to build an AR block tower on the floor and add a small robot that crashes into it. Twist: let the audience steer the robot by tilting their phones.

works.title: Chain of Traceability
works.description: Point a phone at a household object and AR reveals its history: where its materials came from, how it was made, its carbon footprint and how it could be repurposed.
works.description_zh: 把手机对准一件家居物品，AR 就会展示它的来历：材料来自哪里、如何制造、碳足迹多少，以及未来可以怎样再利用。
works.idea_en: Let objects tell their own life story, from source to second life.
works.idea_zh: 让物品讲述自己的一生，从原料到“第二次生命”。
works.technique: Neural-network object recognition identifies the item, looks up a digital twin registered on a blockchain and renders its supply-chain data as AR layers around it.
works.technique_zh: 神经网络识别物品，查找登记在区块链上的数字孪生，并把供应链数据渲染成物品周围的 AR 图层。
works.exercise_en: Pick three objects in class, research where they came from and attach an AR timeline that unfolds from each when recognised. Twist: end each timeline with an idea for its next life.
works.exercise_zh: 在课堂上挑三件物品，调查它们的来源，并在识别时从每件物品上展开一条 AR 时间线。变体：每条时间线都以它“下一段生命”的创意结尾。

video.video_title: Everyday Experiments — Chain of Traceability by FIELD | STIRpad

works.title: Chaotic Body II: Liminal Phase
works.description: A motion-capture dance film for screen and augmented reality made with choreographer Alexander Whitley, in which the breath and movement of two dancers dissolve their bodies into flowing, chaos-theory-inspired forms.
works.description_zh: 与编舞家 Alexander Whitley 合作的动作捕捉舞蹈影片，面向屏幕与增强现实：两位舞者的呼吸和动作让身体消融成受混沌理论启发的流动形态。
works.idea_en: Breath dissolves the boundary between the dancers' bodies and their surroundings.
works.idea_zh: 呼吸溶解了舞者身体与周围环境之间的边界。
works.technique: Motion-capture data of the dancers drives real-time particle and fluid simulations in Unity whose behaviour follows chaotic attractor patterns.
works.technique_zh: 舞者的动作捕捉数据在 Unity 中驱动实时粒子和流体模拟，其运动遵循混沌吸引子的规律。
works.exercise_en: Record a short movement with a phone pose-tracking app and use the joint positions to drive a particle system in Lens Studio or three.js that is placed on the floor in AR. Twist: tie particle emission to the dancer's breathing rhythm.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机姿态追踪应用录下一小段动作，用关节位置在 Lens Studio 或 three.js 里驱动一个粒子系统，并以 AR 方式放在地面上；变体：让粒子的喷发跟随舞者的呼吸节奏。

video.video_title: Chaotic Body II: Liminal Phase  | TRAILER

works.title: Coding Adventure: Ant and Slime Simulations
works.description: Millions of agents leave glowing trails and follow each other's scent, forming slime-mould networks that branch, merge and pulse across the screen.
works.description_zh: 数以百万计的智能体留下发光的轨迹并追随彼此的气味，形成像黏菌一样不断分叉、汇合、脉动的网络。
works.idea_en: Simple agents that sense and deposit trails grow living networks.
works.idea_zh: 只会感知和留下痕迹的简单个体，能长出活的网络。
works.technique: A compute shader moves agents that sample a trail map with three sensors and steer toward the strongest, deposit into the map, and a diffuse-and-decay pass spreads the trails (Physarum model).
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器驱动智能体：每个体用三个传感器采样轨迹图并转向最强方向，同时写入轨迹；再用扩散衰减 pass 让轨迹蔓延（Physarum 模型）。
works.exercise_en: Project the slime simulation onto a detected AR floor plane and use the people-occlusion mask as food, so the network grows toward people standing in the room. Twist: the slime avoids anyone who moves too fast.
works.exercise_zh: 把黏菌模拟投到 AR 检测到的地面平面上，用人物遮挡蒙版当作食物，让网络朝房间里站着的人生长。变体：黏菌会避开移动太快的人。

video.video_title: Coding Adventure: Ant and Slime Simulations

works.title: Compute shader data into VFX Graph
works.description: Particles move in patterns computed by a separate compute shader, showing GPU simulation results fed straight into VFX Graph.
works.description_zh: 粒子按照另一个计算着色器算出的图案运动，展示如何把 GPU 模拟结果直接交给 VFX Graph。
works.idea_en: Simulate anywhere, render with VFX Graph.
works.idea_zh: 在哪里模拟都行，用 VFX Graph 来渲染。
works.technique: A compute shader writes positions into a GraphicsBuffer, and VFX Graph's buffer operators read them each frame without baking to textures.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器把位置写进 GraphicsBuffer，VFX Graph 的缓冲区节点每帧读取，无需烘焙成贴图。
works.exercise_en: Write a small compute simulation (e.g., boids), render it with VFX Graph and place it in AR Foundation above a table. Twist: the flock avoids the phone.
works.exercise_zh: 写一个小型计算模拟（比如 boids 鸟群），用 VFX Graph 渲染，并用 AR Foundation 放在桌子上方。变体：鸟群会躲开手机。

video.video_title: Trying out the newly introduced GraphicsBuffer operators with VFX Graph. Now I can receive data from compute shaders via GraphicsBuffer. No texture baking is needed any more. https://t.co/Z4snnbK7M1 h

works.title: ComputeMarchingCubes: GPU isosurfaces
works.description: A blobby, smoothly shaded surface forms and morphs in real time from a volume of values, and the same code can show CT scan data.
works.description_zh: 一个圆润平滑的表面从体数据中实时生成并变形，同样的代码也能显示 CT 扫描数据。
works.idea_en: Turn any 3D field into a solid surface in real time.
works.idea_zh: 把任何三维场实时变成实体表面。
works.technique: A compute shader runs marching cubes over a scalar grid, writes triangles straight into a mesh's GraphicsBuffer and reconstructs smooth normals from the field gradient.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器在标量网格上运行 marching cubes，把三角形直接写进网格的 GraphicsBuffer，并用场的梯度重建平滑法线。
works.exercise_en: Build a metaball sculpture whose blobs follow the phone and anchor it in the room with AR Foundation. Twist: add a blob wherever someone claps.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个元球雕塑，其中的球跟随手机移动，用 AR Foundation 固定在房间里。变体：有人拍手的地方就多出一个球。

video.video_title: Added smooth normal reconstruction with marching cubes. https://t.co/OhmNGp22SB https://t.co/HDmC0696Xf

works.title: Constellation of the Flesh
works.description: A VR experience made with Choy Ka Fai, based on a gathering of Buryat shamans, in which motion-captured trance movements become a sensory space the viewer is immersed in.
works.description_zh: 与 Choy Ka Fai 合作的 VR 体验，取材于一次布里亚特萨满聚会：动捕下来的出神动作化作一个让观众沉浸其中的感官空间。
works.idea_en: Can the dance of trance be digitised and felt from inside?
works.idea_zh: 出神状态下的舞蹈能否被数字化，并从内部被感受到？
works.technique: Dancers re-enacted shamanic movement in a motion-capture studio, and the data drive abstract bodies and particles in a real-time VR scene with spatial sound.
works.technique_zh: 舞者在动捕棚里重现萨满动作，数据驱动实时 VR 场景中的抽象身体和粒子，并配有空间声音。
works.exercise_en: Capture a repetitive, trance-like movement with a phone mocap app and render it in AR as a slowly growing trail of particles around the viewer. Twist: let the trail only grow while the viewer moves in sync with it.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机动捕 App 录下一段重复、近乎出神的动作，在 AR 中把它渲染成围绕观众慢慢生长的粒子轨迹；变体：只有观众与它同步运动时，轨迹才会生长。

video.video_title: Constellation of the flesh (trailer 01)

works.title: Controlling Air Conditioning via Augmented Reality
works.description: The invisible airflow of a directional air conditioner is drawn as streams in AR, and the user steers it with touch gestures to aim cool air where people sit.
works.description_zh: 定向空调原本看不见的气流在 AR 中被画成一道道流线，用户用触控手势调整方向，把冷风送到有人坐的地方。
works.idea_en: Make invisible airflow visible, then let people grab and steer it.
works.idea_zh: 把看不见的气流显示出来，再让人伸手去“抓”和引导它。
works.technique: Likely simulates the AC's flow field from vane angles and renders it as animated particle streams registered to the unit, sending gesture edits back as control commands.
works.technique_zh: 很可能根据导风板角度模拟空调的气流场，把它渲染成与空调位置对齐的动画粒子流，再把手势修改转成控制指令发送回去。
works.exercise_en: Hang ribbons in front of a desk fan, film them, then build a phone AR scene that draws matching animated particle streams from the fan; let classmates 'drag' the stream to aim it. Twist: visualise Wi-Fi strength or sound instead of air.
works.exercise_zh: 在台扇前挂几条丝带并拍下来，然后做一个手机 AR 场景，从风扇处画出对应的动画粒子流，让同学“拖动”气流改变方向；变体：把可视化对象换成 Wi-Fi 信号强度或声音。

video.video_title: Controlling Air Conditioning via Augmented Reality - IEEEVR 2021

salient.why_en: Invisible airflow becomes visible, and you steer the air conditioner by grabbing the stream itself.
salient.why_zh: 让看不见的气流显形，直接抓住气流就能控制空调吹的方向。

works.title: CoolMoves
works.description: From only a VR headset and two hand controllers, the user's avatar performs stylised full-body moves such as dance and martial-arts poses that follow the user's own timing but look like a trained performer.
works.description_zh: 只凭一台 VR 头显和两个手柄，用户的虚拟化身就能做出舞蹈、武术等风格化的全身动作，节奏跟随用户本人，看起来却像受过训练的表演者。
works.idea_en: Your small movements are accentuated into expressive full-body motion.
works.idea_zh: 把你的小动作放大成富有表现力的全身动作。
works.technique: Head and hand trajectories are matched in real time against a motion-capture database, and similar clips are interpolated to synthesise accentuated full-body motion.
works.technique_zh: 头部和双手的运动轨迹实时与动作捕捉数据库匹配，再对相似片段插值，合成被强化的全身动作。
works.exercise_en: Map webcam-detected arm motion to a character that plays a kung-fu or dance clip whenever the arm speed passes a threshold. Twist: the less you move, the more the character exaggerates.
works.exercise_zh: 把网络摄像头检测到的手臂动作映射到一个角色上，手臂速度超过阈值时就播放一段功夫或舞蹈片段。变体：你动得越少，角色就夸张得越厉害。

video.video_title: CoolMoves UbiComp 2021

works.title: Coriolis
works.description: A real-time journey through different scales of time and space, where Physarum networks and fluid currents form nebula-like structures that grow and dissolve.
works.description_zh: 一段穿越不同时空尺度的实时旅程：黏菌网络与流体洋流形成星云般的结构，不断生长又消散。
works.idea_en: The same growth rule reads as cells, rivers or galaxies depending on the scale.
works.idea_zh: 同一条生长规则，换一个尺度，看上去就是细胞、河流或星系。
works.technique: His Physarum and fluid simulation frameworks run together in Unity: agent trails form the structure while the fluid field advects and distorts them.
works.technique_zh: 他的黏菌与流体模拟框架在 Unity 中同时运行：智能体痕迹形成结构，流体场再平流并扭曲这些结构。
works.exercise_en: Place a Physarum-plus-fluid volume above a table in AR and let the phone's zoom (distance to the volume) change the simulation scale. Twist: freeze the growth when the user holds still, so the piece rewards patience.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把黏菌 + 流体的体积放在桌面上方，用手机与体积的距离改变模拟尺度。变体：用户保持不动时生长才会凝固，让作品奖励耐心。

video.video_title: Coriolis

works.title: Dakota Spirit Walk
works.description: A permanent AR public-art trail at the Bruce Vento Nature Sanctuary in Saint Paul where phones reveal Dakota spirits, stories and language at sacred sites.
works.idea_zh: 在圣地步道上用AR让达科他族的神灵与语言重新出现
works.technique: Image-marker or location-triggered AR (likely Adobe Aero/app) anchors animated Dakota artwork and audio narration to signs along the trail.
works.exercise_zh: 为校园一条小路设计3个AR站点，每站用图像标记呈现一个地方的“原名”和故事；变化：邀请当地长者录音作为旁白。

video.video_title: Dakota Spirit Walk - Augmented Reality Public Art (Marlena Myles interview)

works.description_zh: 位于圣保罗 Bruce Vento 自然保护区的一条永久性 AR 公共艺术步道，手机在各处圣地呈现达科他族的神灵、故事和语言。
works.idea_en: On a sacred trail, AR brings Dakota spirits and language back into view.
works.technique_zh: 通过图像标记或位置触发的 AR（大概率使用 Adobe Aero 或专用应用），将达科他艺术动画和语音讲述锚定在步道沿途的标牌上。
works.exercise_en: Design three AR stations along a campus path, each using an image marker to show a place's original name and its story. Twist: invite local elders to record the narration.

works.title: Depthkit Holoportation via webcam
works.description: A full-body volumetric person is captured with depth cameras and livestreamed as a hologram into AR and VR scenes for teleconferencing and performance.
works.description_zh: 用深度相机捕捉的全身体积影像人物，以全息形式实时直播进 AR 和 VR 场景，用于远程会议和表演。
works.idea_en: Stream a person, not a video rectangle.
works.idea_zh: 直播的是一个人，而不是一块视频方框。
works.technique: Depthkit Studio fuses several depth sensors into a textured mesh sequence, compresses it as video and streams it to a Unity or web client that reconstructs the hologram.
works.technique_zh: Depthkit Studio 把多个深度传感器的数据融合成带纹理的网格序列，压缩为视频流，发送到 Unity 或网页客户端重建全息影像。
works.exercise_en: Record a 10-second LiDAR point-cloud clip of a classmate and play it back life-size in phone AR in the hallway. Twist: make the hologram only visible from one side.
works.exercise_zh: 用 LiDAR 录一段同学 10 秒的点云片段，并在走廊里以真人大小在手机 AR 中回放。变体：让全息影像只能从一侧看到。

video.video_title: Depthkit Holoportation via Webcam  |  Intro

works.title: Digital Buddy
works.description: A small 3D avatar appears next to you in AR and explains long terms and conditions in plain language, for example answering whether a messaging app can read your private messages.
works.description_zh: 一个小小的 3D 化身在 AR 中出现在你身边，用通俗的话解释冗长的用户条款，比如回答某个聊天应用能不能读你的私信。
works.idea_en: A companion on your side that reads the fine print for you.
works.idea_zh: 一个站在你这边、替你读小字条款的伙伴。
works.technique: GPT-3 summarises and answers questions about privacy policies, and the answer is voiced by an animated AR character placed on a nearby surface.
works.technique_zh: 用 GPT-3 总结隐私政策并回答相关问题，答案由放在附近表面上的 AR 动画角色说出来。
works.exercise_en: Place a character in phone AR that reads a pasted app policy through an LLM and answers three yes/no questions. Twist: the character's mood changes with how privacy-friendly the answer is.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中放置一个角色，它通过大语言模型读取粘贴进来的应用条款，并回答三个是否题。变体：角色的情绪随答案的隐私友好程度变化。

video.video_title: FIELD x Space10 Digital Buddy: Privacy

works.title: Distant Hand
works.description: A hand-tracked AR prototype that extends your hand far into the space in front of you to touch distant objects.
works.idea_zh: 伸出一只能触到远方的AR长手

video.video_title: Distant Hand

works.technique: Hand tracking provides the wrist and finger joints, and a non-linear mapping extends the virtual hand far along the arm's ray so it can touch distant objects (akin to the Go-Go interaction technique).
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands 或 HoloKit 手势追踪做一只随手臂伸展而非线性变长的虚拟手，去“碰”远处的虚拟物体；变体：让长手在经过真实物体时留下触碰的痕迹。
works.description_zh: 一个基于手部追踪的 AR 原型，把你的手远远伸向前方空间，去触碰远处的物体。
works.idea_en: Stretch out a long AR hand that can reach faraway things.
works.technique_zh: 手部追踪提供手腕和手指关节，非线性映射沿手臂射线把虚拟手延伸到远处，使其能触碰远处物体（类似 Go-Go 交互技术）。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Hands or HoloKit hand tracking to build a virtual hand that grows non-linearly as you extend your arm, and touch distant virtual objects with it. Twist: make the long hand leave touch marks on real objects it passes.

salient.why_en: Your hand stretches far out in AR so you can touch things across the room.
salient.why_zh: 你的手在增强现实中伸得很长，可以碰到房间另一头的东西。

works.title: Doc Ock AR Digital Fashion
works.description: A wearable Snapchat filter that gives the user Doctor Octopus's animated mechanical tentacles, which move around the body as if attached to the spine.
works.description_zh: 一个可穿戴的 Snapchat 滤镜，给用户装上章鱼博士的机械触手，触手像连在脊柱上一样在身体周围摆动。
works.idea_en: Wear a movie character's signature prosthetic as digital fashion.
works.idea_zh: 把电影角色的标志性“义肢”当作数字时装穿在身上。
works.technique: Tentacles modelled and animated in Cinema 4D, textured in Substance 3D Painter, and attached to Lens Studio body tracking.
works.technique_zh: 触手在 Cinema 4D 中建模并制作动画，用 Substance 3D Painter 绘制材质，再绑定到 Lens Studio 的人体追踪上。
works.exercise_en: Design an extra limb (wing, tail or arm) as a body-tracked AR wearable that reacts to how fast you move. Twist: the limb must help you do something the real body cannot.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个额外的肢体（翅膀、尾巴或手臂）作为人体追踪 AR 穿戴，它会根据你的动作快慢作出反应；变体：这个肢体必须帮你完成真实身体做不到的事。

video.video_title: DOC OCK AR Digital Fashion - wearable Filter

works.title: Dragon Duel (HoloKit X demo)
works.description: A player in a HoloKit X headset battles a dragon that flies around the real room, dodging its fire and casting spells back at it.
works.description_zh: 戴着 HoloKit X 头显的玩家与一条在真实房间里盘旋的巨龙对战，一边躲避龙焰，一边向它施放法术。
works.idea_en: A boss fight staged in your own room, with you moving your whole body to dodge.
works.idea_zh: 在自己房间里上演一场首领战，要靠整个身体移动来躲闪。
works.technique: ARKit world tracking renders a stereo view on the iPhone inside the HoloKit X, and the dragon's flight path is likely scripted around the user's tracked head position.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 世界追踪在 HoloKit X 内的 iPhone 上渲染双目画面，巨龙的飞行路径很可能围绕用户被追踪的头部位置编排。
works.exercise_en: Script a flying creature that circles the player's head position in AR and periodically fires a slow projectile the player must physically sidestep. Twist: the creature lands on the largest detected horizontal surface when it gets tired.
works.exercise_zh: 编写一只在 AR 中围绕玩家头部位置盘旋的飞行生物，它会定期发射慢速投射物，玩家必须真实侧身躲开。变体：当它累了，就降落在检测到的最大水平面上。

video.video_title: Unity: HoloKit X Dragon duel (Unity demo)

works.title: Drawing in the Air
works.description: Lines drawn in mid-air settle into the room as persistent 3D ribbons.
works.idea_zh: 在空中画出的线化作留在房间里的立体丝带。

video.video_title: Drawing in the air

works.technique: Strokes are recorded as world-space points from the camera pose and converted into ribbon meshes that persist at their anchors (likely with physics-based settling).
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 画出空中丝带，松手后让丝带受重力轻轻飘落到地面平面上；变体：丝带落地后变成花或文字。
works.description_zh: 在半空中画出的线条会落定在房间里，化作持久存在的三维丝带。
works.idea_en: Lines drawn in the air become 3D ribbons that stay in the room.
works.technique_zh: 根据相机位姿把笔画记录为世界空间中的点，再转换为丝带网格并持久保留在锚点处（大概率使用基于物理的沉降效果）。
works.exercise_en: Draw ribbons in the air with AR Foundation and, once you let go, let them drift down gently under gravity onto the floor plane. Twist: after landing, the ribbons turn into flowers or words.

works.title: Drawing with Epicycles (DFT)
works.description: Chains of spinning circles redraw a picture line by line, each circle rotating at its own frequency, and the tip paints into a texture on the GPU.
works.description_zh: 一串旋转的圆一笔一笔重画出一幅图，每个圆以自己的频率旋转，末端在 GPU 上的纹理里作画。
works.idea_en: Any drawing can be rebuilt from rotating circles.
works.idea_zh: 任何一幅画都能用旋转的圆重新画出来。
works.technique: A discrete Fourier transform turns a traced path into circle frequencies and phases; the epicycle tip positions go through a StructuredBuffer to a compute shader that paints them into a render texture.
works.technique_zh: 离散傅里叶变换把描出的路径转成各个圆的频率和相位；本轮末端位置通过 StructuredBuffer 送进计算着色器，画进渲染纹理。
works.exercise_en: Let users trace a shape in the air with the phone in AR, then replay it as spinning epicycles hovering where it was drawn. Twist: drop the highest frequencies so the drawing becomes smoother and more abstract.
works.exercise_zh: 让用户在 AR 里用手机在空中描一个形状，然后在原位用旋转的本轮重放它。变体：去掉高频项，让图形变得更平滑、更抽象。

video.video_title: [Unity] Drawing with Epicycles using Discrete Fourier Transform

works.title: Duel of Wizards (HoloKit X demo)
works.description: Two players wearing HoloKit X face each other in the same room and aim their controllers like wands; spells fly across the real space and hit the opponent's shared-anchored avatar.
works.description_zh: 两名戴着 HoloKit X 的玩家在同一房间面对面，把手柄当魔杖瞄准对方；法术穿过真实空间，击中共享锚点上的对手化身。
works.idea_en: A wand duel where the opponent is a real person across the room, not a computer character.
works.idea_zh: 一场魔杖决斗，对手是房间另一头的真人，而不是电脑角色。
works.technique: Players join an ARKit Collaboration session over Apple Multipeer Connectivity to share one coordinate frame, while game logic syncs over UNET.
works.technique_zh: 玩家通过 Apple Multipeer Connectivity 加入 ARKit 协作会话来共享同一坐标系，游戏逻辑则通过 UNET 同步。
works.exercise_en: Build a two-phone AR duel where both devices share an anchor and a tap fires a projectile from one phone's position toward the other's. Twist: make projectiles bounce off real walls detected by plane detection.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个双手机 AR 对决：两台设备共享同一锚点，点击屏幕就从一台手机的位置朝另一台发射投射物。变体：让投射物在平面检测到的真实墙面上反弹。

video.video_title: Unity: Duel of wizards (HoloKit X demo, AR Collaboration )

works.title: ENTER
works.description: A door-sized frame of thirty-two 5-metre LED strips that reacts to sound and to the person standing in front of it, like a digital portal made of light.
works.description_zh: 一个门框大小的装置，由 32 条 5 米长的 LED 灯带组成，会对声音和站在它面前的人做出反应，像一道光做成的数字传送门。
works.idea_en: A doorway that shows you as signal, as if about to step through a network.
works.idea_zh: 一道把你显示成信号的门，仿佛你正要穿过网络。
works.technique: A high-framerate camera and audio input drive per-strip brightness patterns in custom software, turning the viewer into a stretched, time-smeared light portrait.
works.technique_zh: 高帧率相机和音频输入在自研软件中驱动每条灯带的亮度图案，把观众变成被拉伸、带时间拖影的光肖像。
works.exercise_en: Make a 'portal' on a vertical monitor that shows a webcam feed reduced to 32 glowing columns with slit-scan delay. Twist: a clap freezes the portal for five seconds.
works.exercise_zh: 在竖屏显示器上做一道“传送门”，把摄像头画面简化成 32 条发光竖条并加上狭缝扫描延迟；变体：拍一下手，传送门冻结五秒。

video.video_title: ENTER 2021 in detail

works.title: EULOGY
works.description: In a dark container each audience member is guided through an imaginary labyrinthine hotel; they answer questions aloud and the story reacts to what they say.
works.description_zh: 在漆黑的集装箱里，每位观众被引导穿过一座想象中的迷宫般的酒店；他们需要开口回答问题，故事会根据他们说的话作出反应。
works.idea_en: A whole building exists only in sound, and your spoken answers choose which room you enter.
works.idea_zh: 一整栋建筑只存在于声音中，你说出的回答决定你走进哪个房间。
works.technique: Binaural 360-degree audio builds the virtual architecture while speech recognition on each seat branches the narrative according to the participant's replies.
works.technique_zh: 360 度双耳音频构建虚拟建筑，每个座位上的语音识别根据参与者的回答让叙事分支。
works.exercise_en: Build a voice-controlled audio walk of an imaginary building with a web speech API: at each 'door' the listener says left or right. Twist: let the narrator remember a word the listener said earlier and use it against them.
works.exercise_zh: 用网页语音识别 API 做一段声控的“虚构建筑”音频漫游：每到一扇“门”，听众说出左或右；变体：让旁白记住听众早先说过的一个词，并在之后反过来用它。

video.video_title: EULOGY Trailer - DARKFIELD

works.title: Earthtime 1.26 Munich
works.description: In Munich, a large Earthtime net sculpture floats above a public space, its form linked to the 2010 Chile earthquake that shortened the Earth's day by 1.26 microseconds.
works.description_zh: 在慕尼黑，一座大型《Earthtime》网状雕塑漂浮在公共空间上空，它的形状与 2010 年智利地震相关，那次地震让地球的一天缩短了 1.26 微秒。
works.idea_en: A title that names an invisible change (a shorter day) gives a floating form a reason to exist; AR works benefit from linking a visible shape to an unseen fact.
works.idea_zh: 一个点出看不见的变化（一天变短了）的标题，给漂浮的形体一个存在的理由；AR 作品也会因为把可见的形状和看不见的事实联系起来而更有力量。
works.technique: Fibre netting modelled on earthquake data is rigged between supports and lit with programmed colour sequences that change through the evening.
works.technique_zh: 按地震数据建模的纤维网架设在支撑之间，用整晚变化的程序色彩序列照亮。
works.exercise_en: Pick an invisible number about your city (a daily CO2 value, noise level) and make an AR form above a square whose size or tension follows it, with a caption that states the fact. Twist: show last year's form beside it for comparison.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个关于你所在城市的看不见的数字（每日二氧化碳值、噪音水平），在广场上空做一个 AR 形体，让它的大小或张力随这个数字变化，并配上说明事实的文字。变体：在旁边显示去年的形体作对比。

video.video_title: "Earthtime 1.26 Munich," Germany (2021)

works.title: Eiffel Tower anamorphosis (Trocadéro)
works.description: On the Trocadéro esplanade in Paris, a giant ground collage makes the Eiffel Tower appear to stand on the edge of a rocky cliff when photographed from the right spot.
works.description_zh: 在巴黎特罗卡德罗广场，一幅巨大的地面拼贴让埃菲尔铁塔在正确位置拍摄时看起来像是立在岩石悬崖边上。
works.idea_en: A single viewpoint turns a flat print into a cliff that swallows a monument; AR can use the same 'magic spot' to guide where people stand.
works.idea_zh: 一个特定视点把平面印刷品变成吞噬纪念碑的悬崖；AR 也可以用同样的“魔法点”引导人们站在哪里。
works.technique: Rock photographs were distorted for one camera position and pasted in strips on the paving in front of the tower.
works.technique_zh: 岩石照片按一个相机位置进行变形，分条粘贴在铁塔前的地面上。
works.exercise_en: Pick a landmark visible from campus and design an AR ground illusion that makes it look like it sits on the edge of a chasm from one marked spot. Twist: the chasm grows until someone steps into the frame.
works.exercise_zh: 选一座校园可见的地标，设计一个 AR 地面错觉，让它从一个标记点看过去像是立在深渊边缘；变体：深渊不断扩大，直到有人走进画面。

video.video_title: French street artist JR creates Eiffel Tower optical illusion | AFP

salient.why_en: From one spot, a flat paper collage turns the ground into a cliff with the Eiffel Tower on its edge.
salient.why_zh: 站在一个特定位置看，地上一张平面拼贴变成悬崖，埃菲尔铁塔就立在崖边。

works.title: Emergence
works.description: Real footage of starling flocks is inverted and slowed down so each bird's relation to the whole becomes readable, over a soundtrack of nightingale, owl and starling calls slowed ten to twenty times.
works.description_zh: 真实的椋鸟群影像被反相并放慢，使每只鸟与整体的关系变得清晰可读；配乐是放慢十到二十倍的夜莺、猫头鹰和椋鸟叫声。
works.idea_en: Slowing and inverting reality is enough to reveal a hidden system, a cheap and strong AR filter idea.
works.idea_zh: 放慢和反相现实就足以揭示一个隐藏的系统，这是一个成本低、效果强的 AR 滤镜创意。
works.technique: The footage is colour-inverted and time-stretched, and bird calls are pitch-shifted down by slowing them, likely in standard video and audio editors.
works.technique_zh: 影像被色彩反相并拉伸时间，鸟鸣通过放慢而降调，很可能使用常规的视频与音频编辑软件完成。
works.exercise_en: Make a camera filter that inverts colours and plays the live microphone input slowed down four times, then walk through a park with it. Twist: slow the image only where something moves.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个相机滤镜，反相画面并把实时麦克风声音放慢四倍播放，然后带着它穿过公园；变体：只在有东西移动的区域放慢画面。

video.video_title: Emergence

works.title: Engendered Otherness (Ai Transmutations)
works.description: Kianí del Valle dances with Hamill Industries while computer vision reads her body and an AI generates a visual ensemble of not-yet-existing hybrid organisms that move with her choreography, to a score by Floating Points.
works.description_zh: Kianí del Valle 与 Hamill Industries 合作起舞：计算机视觉读取她的身体，AI 生成一群尚不存在的跨物种生物组成的视觉舞团，随她的编舞而动，配乐来自 Floating Points。
works.idea_en: A live dancer leads a chorus of AI-generated creatures that only exist while she moves.
works.idea_zh: 一位真人舞者带领一群 AI 生成的生物，它们只在她舞动时存在。
works.technique: Pose estimation on live camera footage feeds generative image models trained by researchers from UPC and ISTHMO, which synthesise creature forms following the detected body in real time.
works.technique_zh: 对现场摄像画面进行姿态估计，输入由 UPC 和 ISTHMO 研究者训练的生成式图像模型，实时合成跟随被检测身体的生物形态。
works.exercise_en: Feed MediaPipe Pose keypoints from a webcam into a pose-conditioned image generator (or a hand-made set of creature sprites mapped to limbs) and project the result behind a dancer. Twist: add a second creature that copies the dancer with a two-second delay.
works.exercise_zh: 把网络摄像头得到的 MediaPipe Pose 关键点输入一个以姿态为条件的图像生成器（或一组手绘、绑定到四肢的生物贴图），把结果投影在舞者身后；变体：再加一只延迟两秒模仿舞者的生物。

video.video_title: AI & Music S+T+ARTS Festival - Hamill Industries & Kiani del Valle ‘ENGENDERED OTHERNESS’

works.title: Enter the Plastocene
works.description: An AR/VR installation where plastic waste creatures swim through the exhibition space around visitors, shown at MEET Milan.
works.idea_zh: 塑料生物在展厅中游动的塑料纪

video.video_title: Enter the Plastocene @ MEET (15s pan with live AR video)

works.technique: ARKit world tracking places flocking creatures (boids-style steering) that swim through the exhibition volume around visitors.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity 里用简单 boids 算法让一群塑料瓶生物在房间中游动，并绕开观众（用相机位置作为排斥点）；变体：让生物数量随班级当天产生的塑料垃圾数量变化。
works.description_zh: 一件 AR/VR 装置：由塑料垃圾构成的生物在展厅中围绕观众游动，曾在米兰 MEET 展出。
works.idea_en: The Plastocene, where plastic creatures swim through the gallery.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 世界追踪放置成群游动的生物（boids 式转向行为），让它们在观众周围的展厅空间中穿梭。
works.exercise_en: Use a simple boids algorithm in Unity to make a school of plastic-bottle creatures swim around the room and avoid viewers, treating the camera position as a repulsion point. Twist: tie the number of creatures to the amount of plastic waste the class produces that day.

works.title: Everyday Experiments: Collaborative Futures
works.description: A film about the second round of Everyday Experiments, in which more than twenty studios tackled privacy, trust and well-being at home with AR, spatial audio and AI.
works.description_zh: 介绍 Everyday Experiments 第二轮的短片：二十多家工作室用 AR、空间音频和 AI 探讨家中的隐私、信任与身心健康。
works.idea_en: Use spatial computing to make invisible domestic issues (data, noise, mood) tangible.
works.idea_zh: 用空间计算让家中看不见的问题（数据、噪音、情绪）变得可感知。
works.technique: A curated commissioning model: each partner studio received a theme and produced a working prototype and film, published together on an open platform.
works.technique_zh: 一种策展式委托模式：每个合作工作室领到一个主题，做出可运行的原型和影片，统一发布在开放平台上。
works.exercise_en: Pick one invisible thing in your home (Wi-Fi, noise, air) and prototype a phone AR view that makes it visible for 30 seconds. Twist: make it visible only to one person in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个家里看不见的东西（Wi-Fi、噪音、空气），做一个让它可见 30 秒的手机 AR 原型。变体：只让房间里的某一个人看得见。

video.video_title: Everyday Experiments: Collaborative Futures

works.title: Extreme Measures
works.description: Instead of a tape measure, you place a virtual elephant under the bed or in a nook and it inflates until it fills the space, giving an intuitive sense of how much room is there.
works.description_zh: 不用卷尺，而是把一头虚拟大象放到床底或角落里，它会膨胀直到填满空间，让你直观感受那里到底有多大。
works.idea_en: Measure space by filling it with something absurd and friendly.
works.idea_zh: 用荒诞又友好的东西填满空间，以此来测量它。
works.technique: LiDAR depth defines the free volume around a placed anchor, and a character mesh scales until it collides with the surrounding geometry, reporting the resulting size.
works.technique_zh: LiDAR 深度确定放置锚点周围的空闲体积，角色网格不断缩放直到与周围几何体碰撞，并报告最终尺寸。
works.exercise_en: In phone AR, place a balloon in a shelf gap and grow it until it hits the planes around it, then show its volume in 'balloons'. Twist: choose a unit that makes people laugh.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中把一个气球放进书架空隙，让它不断变大直到碰到周围的平面，然后以“几个气球”为单位显示体积。变体：选一个能让人发笑的单位。

video.video_title: FIELD x Space10 Extreme Measures Lidar.mp4

salient.why_en: Measure a gap by inflating a virtual elephant until it fills the space.
salient.why_zh: 把一头虚拟大象吹胀到塞满空隙，用它来量空间有多大。

works.title: FaceMeshBarracuda face & eye tracker
works.description: A webcam face and iris tracker running in Unity overlays a dense face mesh and eye landmarks on the live video, ready for mask and gaze effects.
works.idea_zh: 在 Unity 里用一个摄像头实现脸部网格与眼球追踪，做面具和视线特效。

video.video_title: FaceMeshBarracuda: Face and Eye Landmark Tracker with Unity Barracuda

works.technique: MediaPipe face-mesh and iris models run via Barracuda to return 468 face vertices plus iris landmarks, which are used to texture and deform an overlay mesh.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Spark/Lens Studio 或 MediaPipe FaceMesh 做一个跟着眼球转动的'第三只眼'面具；加一个变化：眨眼时面具换一张脸。
works.description_zh: 一个在 Unity 中运行的网络摄像头面部与虹膜追踪器，在实时视频上叠加密集的面部网格和眼部关键点，可直接用于面具和视线特效。
works.idea_en: Get a face mesh and eye tracking from one camera in Unity for mask and gaze effects.
works.technique_zh: MediaPipe 面部网格与虹膜模型通过 Barracuda 运行，返回 468 个面部顶点和虹膜关键点，用于给叠加网格贴图并使其变形。
works.exercise_en: Use Spark, Lens Studio or MediaPipe FaceMesh to make a third-eye mask that follows your eye movements. Twist: the mask swaps to a different face when you blink.

works.title: Fake Stop Motion
works.description: A smoothly animated 3D character is made to move in choppy, held poses like a stop-motion puppet, while the rest of the game runs at full frame rate.
works.description_zh: 一个原本动作流畅的 3D 角色，被改成像定格动画木偶一样一顿一顿地摆出姿势，而游戏的其余部分仍以全帧率运行。
works.idea_en: Change the time signature of motion, not the look of pixels, to get a hand-made feel.
works.idea_zh: 改变动作的时间节奏，而不是像素的外观，就能得到手工制作的感觉。
works.technique: A script drives the Animator manually at a chosen low frame rate, advancing it in discrete steps instead of every frame, so it can be combined with any retro or PSX-style shader.
works.technique_zh: 一个脚本以设定的低帧率手动驱动 Animator，按离散步长推进，而不是每帧更新，因此可以与任何复古或 PS1 风格着色器搭配。
works.exercise_en: Put a stop-motion AR character on a real desk that updates at 8 fps while the camera image stays smooth. Twist: the frame rate rises the longer someone watches it.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实桌面上放一个定格动画风格的 AR 角色，让它以 8 fps 更新，而相机画面保持流畅。变体：有人注视得越久，它的帧率就越高。

video.video_title:
I pushed my fake stop motion effect for Unity up to GitHub. Customize what FPS the animator plays back at. Since this is not a shader you can still pair this effect with any retro psx shader.

https:/

works.title: Faune
works.description: Ten large posters, co-signed with the graphic design collective Brest Brest Brest, are pasted on city walls; seen through a free AR app, each printed landscape expands and the animal hidden in it bounces, slips away and reappears.
works.description_zh: 与平面设计团体 Brest Brest Brest 联合创作的十张大幅海报被贴在城市墙上；通过免费的 AR 应用去看，每张印刷风景都会向外展开，藏在里面的动物跳动、溜走、再次出现。
works.idea_en: Street posters hide animals that only appear when you stop and look through your phone.
works.idea_zh: 街头海报里藏着动物，只有停下来用手机看，它们才会现身。
works.technique: A custom mobile app tracks each printed poster as an image target and plays hand-drawn animations that extend the graphic landscape beyond the edges of the paper.
works.technique_zh: 定制的手机应用把每张印刷海报当作识别图来追踪，播放手绘动画，并把平面风景延伸到纸张边界之外。
works.exercise_en: Design one A3 poster whose landscape hides an animal, make it an image target in Lens Studio, AR Foundation or MindAR, and animate the animal escaping from its hiding place; paste it on campus and map a short trail. Twist: the animal only moves once the viewer has held still for three seconds.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一张 A3 海报，画中的风景里藏着一只动物，在 Lens Studio、AR Foundation 或 MindAR 里把它设为识别图，做一段动物从藏身处跑出来的动画；把海报贴在校园里，并设计一条小小的寻访路线。变体：只有当观看者保持静止三秒后，动物才开始动。

video.video_title: FAUNE teaser — Adrien M & Claire B × Brest Brest Brest

salient.why_en: Posters on city walls hide animals that only come out when you stop and look through a phone.
salient.why_zh: 城墙上的海报里藏着动物，只有停下来用手机看，它们才会出来。

works.title: Flipbook2: flip book with watercolor
works.description: A video clip is turned into a paper flip book whose pages turn in 3D, each page painted in watercolor style.
works.description_zh: 一段视频变成一本纸质翻页书，书页在三维中翻动，每一页都是水彩风格。
works.idea_en: Show video as a physical object: a stack of pages.
works.idea_zh: 把视频变成实体：一叠书页。
works.technique: Frames are captured into a texture array and applied to page meshes that curl with a Shader Graph vertex deformation, then KinoAqua adds the watercolor look.
works.technique_zh: 把视频帧存进纹理数组，贴到用 Shader Graph 顶点变形卷曲的书页网格上，再用 KinoAqua 加上水彩效果。
works.exercise_en: Capture phone camera frames and flip them as pages of a virtual book lying on a real table in AR Foundation. Twist: flip speed follows how fast you swipe.
works.exercise_zh: 采集手机相机帧，把它们做成一本放在真实桌面上的虚拟书，用 AR Foundation 翻页。变体：翻页速度跟随你滑动的速度。

video.video_title: Testing Flipbook2 with a video clip (flip book + watercolor effect) https://t.co/tPgTqRRpPL https://t.co/QLVpJ6VQLs

works.title: Floor Pit (AR 100 Days, Day 45)
works.description: A section of the real floor cracks into tiles that fall away, opening a pit under the user's feet.
works.description_zh: 一块真实的地板裂成碎片纷纷坠落，在用户脚下打开一个深坑。
works.idea_en: Cut the camera image into pieces and let reality itself fall apart.
works.idea_zh: 把摄像头画面切成碎片，让现实本身塌下去。
works.technique: The floor region of the camera image is likely projected as a texture onto a grid of tiles placed on the detected plane (following a Qiita article he credits); the tiles then fall, revealing a virtual pit beneath.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是把摄像头画面中地板区域的图像作为纹理投影到放在检测平面上的一组瓷砖上（参考了他致谢的一篇 Qiita 文章），再让瓷砖下落，露出下面的虚拟深坑。
works.exercise_en: On a detected floor plane, texture a grid of cubes with the camera image and drop them one by one when the user steps close. Twist: reveal a different world under each tile.
works.exercise_zh: 在检测到的地面平面上，用摄像头画面给一组方块贴图，并在用户靠近时逐个让它们掉落。变体：每块瓷砖下面露出不同的世界。

salient.why_zh: 真实的地板碎成方块掉下去，脚下出现一个深坑。

works.title: Fog Sculpture (Neue Nationalgalerie)
works.description: In the sculpture garden of the Neue Nationalgalerie in Berlin, clouds of pure water fog pour out at timed intervals, wrapping visitors, trees and Mies van der Rohe's building and drifting with the wind.
works.description_zh: 在柏林新国家美术馆的雕塑花园中，纯水雾按时喷出，包裹访客、树木和密斯·凡德罗的建筑，并随风飘移。
works.idea_en: Fog is a real volume that people walk into and that the weather shapes, the benchmark for any volumetric AR effect.
works.idea_zh: 雾是人们可以走进去、由天气塑造的真实体积，是所有体积化 AR 效果的标杆。
works.technique: High-pressure pumps push water through hundreds of tiny nozzles that create droplets small enough to hang in the air as fog.
works.technique_zh: 高压泵把水推过数百个微型喷嘴，产生细小到足以悬浮在空中形成雾的水滴。
works.exercise_en: Build a volumetric fog cloud in AR (raymarched or particle-based) that pours from a real bench at set times and drifts with live wind direction. Twist: the fog parts around people using body segmentation.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中制作一团体积雾（光线步进或粒子），按设定时间从一张真实长椅上涌出，并随实时风向飘移；变体：用人体分割让雾在人周围分开。

video.video_title: Fujiko Nakaya. Fog sculpture | Neue Nationalgalerie

salient.why_en: A sculpture made of fog that you walk into and that the wind keeps reshaping.
salient.why_zh: 一件用雾做成的雕塑，人可以走进去，风不断改变它的形状。

works.title: Fogged Line World (AR 100 Days, Day 35)
works.description: Near the phone the room looks normal, but a few meters away it dissolves into outlines, as if the world were being drawn as a wireframe in the distance.
works.description_zh: 靠近手机的地方房间看起来很正常，但几米之外就溶解成线条，仿佛远处的世界正在被画成线框。
works.idea_en: Use depth as a style switch: reality near, drawing far.
works.idea_zh: 用深度做风格开关：近处是现实，远处是素描。
works.technique: LiDAR scene depth is read per pixel in a shader; beyond a distance threshold the camera image is replaced by an edge-detected line rendering, blended through a fog-like gradient.
works.technique_zh: 在着色器中逐像素读取 LiDAR 场景深度；超过一定距离后，摄像头画面被替换为边缘检测后的线稿，并以类似雾的渐变过渡。
works.exercise_en: Use the AR Foundation environment depth texture to cross-fade between the camera image and a line-art filter at a chosen distance. Twist: let the threshold follow the player so the drawn world closes in over time.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 的环境深度纹理，在指定距离处让摄像头画面与线稿滤镜交叉淡化。变体：让阈值随时间逼近玩家，被“画出来”的世界越来越近。

video.video_title:
100日間 AR表現を作るチャレンジ Day35

"Fogged line world"

数メートル先から線になる世界を表現！
ゲームや探索で使えそう。

LiDAR使用。

Depthがリアルタイムで精度高く取れシェーダーのパラメータに使えるので他にも色々できる。

works.title: Forest of Us
works.description: At Superblue Miami, visitors walk through a mirror maze shaped like a bronchial tree, where narration and sound draw the likeness between the branches of trees and the airways of our lungs.
works.description_zh: 在迈阿密 Superblue，观众走进一座形如支气管树的镜面迷宫，旁白与声音讲述树枝与人肺气道之间的相似。
works.idea_en: One shape seen from the inside (a lung as a forest) can reframe a whole topic; AR scale shifts, putting the user inside a body or a tree, teach through the body.
works.idea_zh: 从内部看同一个形状（把肺当作森林）就能重新理解整个话题：AR 的尺度变化，让用户置身身体或树木之中，是用身体来学习。
works.technique: Mirrored walls follow a branching plan, so reflections multiply the branches, while a soundscape and spoken text guide the route.
works.technique_zh: 镜面墙沿着分叉的平面布局展开，反射让分枝不断增多，声音景观和旁白引导路线。
works.exercise_en: Model a branching tube (lung or tree) in Blender, scale it to 10 m and place it in a gym or courtyard in phone AR so students walk its corridors. Twist: sync the tube's glow to the user's breathing, measured with the microphone.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Blender 里做一个分叉的管道（肺或树），放大到 10 米，用手机 AR 放进体育馆或院子里，让学生在它的走廊里行走。变体：用麦克风测用户的呼吸，让管道的光随呼吸明暗。

video.video_title: Forest of Us by Es Devlin

works.title: Forever de Young
works.description: For her retrospective in San Francisco, Chicago wraps the de Young museum's tower and grounds in rolling clouds of coloured smoke that rise in rainbow layers.
works.description_zh: 为了她在旧金山的回顾展，朱迪·芝加哥用翻滚的彩色烟雾包裹了笛洋美术馆的塔楼和园区，烟雾以彩虹般的层次升起。
works.idea_en: Colour can dress an entire building for a few minutes; AR can temporarily re-skin a landmark with a transient layer rather than a permanent overlay.
works.idea_zh: 颜色能在几分钟里给整座建筑穿上外衣；AR 也可以用短暂的一层临时改变地标的外观，而不是永久覆盖它。
works.technique: Coloured smoke devices are mounted at several heights on the tower and landscape and fired in a colour sequence so the plumes stack like a rainbow.
works.technique_zh: 彩色烟雾装置安装在塔楼和园区的不同高度，按颜色顺序点燃，烟柱像彩虹一样层层叠起。
works.exercise_en: Anchor an AR effect to a real tower or tall building so coloured smoke pours from its windows level by level, from red at the bottom to violet at the top, over two minutes. Twist: each floor's colour is chosen live by people inside that floor.
works.exercise_zh: 把 AR 效果锚定在一座真实的塔楼或高楼上，让彩色烟雾在两分钟内从窗户里逐层涌出，从底层的红色到顶层的紫色。变体：每一层的颜色由那一层里的人实时选择。

video.video_title: Forever De Young: A Judy Chicago Performance

works.title: Four Scanner Apps, One Object
works.description: On day 88 of his scan diary, Mikko captured the same object with four iPhone scanner apps and showed the results side by side: LiDAR had improved on small objects, but photogrammetry still won on detail.
works.description_zh: 在扫描日记的第 88 天，Mikko 用四款 iPhone 扫描应用扫描同一个物体并并排比较：LiDAR 在小物体上进步明显，但细节上摄影测量仍然更胜一筹。
works.idea_en: Compare tools on one subject to understand what each is good at.
works.idea_zh: 用同一个对象比较不同工具，看清各自擅长什么。
works.technique: The same subject is captured with LiDAR-based and photogrammetry-based apps and the meshes are compared for geometry and texture quality.
works.technique_zh: 用基于 LiDAR 和基于摄影测量的应用分别捕捉同一对象，再比较网格的几何精度和纹理质量。
works.exercise_en: In teams, scan the same classroom object with two to four capture methods and present a side-by-side AR comparison. Twist: pick the object that makes the methods disagree the most.
works.exercise_zh: 分组用两到四种捕捉方式扫描教室里的同一物体，做一个并排对比的 AR 展示；变体：专门挑一个让各种方法结果差异最大的物体。

video.video_title:
8️⃣8️⃣ days scanning

works.title: Fully Functional Portals in URP
works.description: The player walks through seamless portals between rooms, seeing the connected space through each opening in real time.
works.description_zh: 玩家在房间之间穿过无缝传送门，透过每个开口实时看到相连的空间。
works.idea_en: Recreate the magic of Portal with render textures in a modern pipeline.
works.idea_zh: 在现代渲染管线中用渲染纹理重现《Portal》的魔法。
works.technique: Linked portal cameras render into textures sampled in screen space on the portal surface, with oblique clipping and teleport logic, adapted for URP.
works.technique_zh: 链接的传送门相机渲染到纹理，在门面上按屏幕空间采样，配合斜裁剪和传送逻辑，适配 URP。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR doorway that shows a virtual copy of another room, and let students step through it to swap worlds. Twist: the other side shows the same room one hour earlier (a recorded scan).
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 门框，显示另一个房间的虚拟副本，学生穿过去就交换世界。变体：另一边是同一个房间一小时前的样子（录制的扫描）。

video.video_title: Fully Functional Portals in Unity URP

works.title: GPU Fog Particles
works.description: Soft atmospheric fog drifts through a scene without any textures, blending smoothly into geometry and fading as the camera moves into it.
works.description_zh: 柔和的雾气在场景中飘荡，完全不用贴图，与几何体平滑融合，镜头进入时会逐渐淡去。
works.idea_en: Fog made purely from noise can hug the world without hard edges.
works.idea_zh: 纯粹由噪声构成的雾，能贴着世界而没有生硬边缘。
works.technique: Particle quads use a shader that samples animated 3D noise, softens intersections with scene depth, and fades near the camera instead of using sprite textures.
works.technique_zh: 粒子面片使用一个着色器：采样动态三维噪声，根据场景深度软化交界处，并在靠近相机时淡出，而不用精灵贴图。
works.exercise_en: Spawn the fog particles on the AR floor plane with depth softening against the AR occlusion depth, so fog pools around real furniture. Twist: the fog parts where people stand.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 地面平面上生成这些雾粒子，并用 AR 遮挡深度做软化，让雾积聚在真实家具周围。变体：人站的地方雾会散开。

video.video_title:
Now on Github! Made an atmospheric fog particle shader for #Unity3D that blends w/geometry and fades as you approach.

No textures, it's all generated in the shader! 🤩
https://t.co/mevE8o6RSI

#madewi

works.title: GPU Instanced Flocking on URP
works.description: Thousands of fish-like agents school and swirl together in real time in the Universal Render Pipeline.
works.description_zh: 成千上万条像鱼一样的个体在通用渲染管线中实时成群游动、盘旋。
works.idea_en: A school of thousands only needs local rules and the GPU.
works.idea_zh: 上千条鱼的鱼群只需要局部规则和 GPU。
works.technique: Boids rules are evaluated in a compute shader and the agents are drawn with GPU instancing (DrawMeshInstancedIndirect) in URP.
works.technique_zh: 在计算着色器中计算鸟群规则，再在 URP 中用 GPU 实例化（DrawMeshInstancedIndirect）绘制个体。
works.exercise_en: Release a school of fish in phone AR that swims around the room and flees from the camera. Twist: the fish follow the loudest sound source in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中放出一群鱼，在房间里游动并躲避镜头。变体：鱼会游向房间里最响的声源。

video.video_title: GPU instanced flocking simulation on Unity Universal Render Pipeline

works.title: GROW
works.description: A 20,000-square-metre field of leeks in the Netherlands is lit at night with moving red and blue light, a recipe that can boost plant growth and reduce pesticide use, making farming visible as art.
works.description_zh: 荷兰一片两万平方米的韭葱田在夜间被移动的红蓝光照亮，这种光配方可以促进植物生长、减少农药使用，让农业作为艺术被看见。
works.idea_en: Lighting a working landscape shows the hidden value of a place people normally drive past, a strong brief for AR in agriculture.
works.idea_zh: 照亮一片正在生产的土地，展示了人们通常驾车而过的地方的隐藏价值，是农业 AR 的有力命题。
works.technique: Linear lights sweep over the crop rows in patterns based on research into light recipes for plant growth.
works.technique_zh: 线性灯光按照植物生长光配方研究的图案扫过作物行。
works.exercise_en: In AR, sweep coloured light bars across a real lawn or garden and label each plant bed with its growth data. Twist: the light speeds up where plants need more care.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中让彩色光带扫过真实的草坪或花园，并为每块苗床标注生长数据；变体：植物越需要照料的地方，光带移动得越快。

video.video_title: GROW | 20,000m² Highlighting the Beauty of Agriculture by Studio Roosegaarde [Official Movie]

works.title: Gateway To Our Past
works.description: Code plaques on local walls invite passers-by to scan them with a phone and see artwork inspired by the history of that exact spot.
works.description_zh: 当地墙上的二维码标牌邀请路人用手机扫描，看到以该地点历史为灵感的艺术作品。
works.idea_en: Street walls become doorways to the history of the place you are standing in.
works.idea_zh: 街边的墙变成通往你脚下这片土地历史的入口。
works.technique: Likely QR codes linking to web-based animated artworks tied to each location, forming a walkable heritage trail.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是二维码链接到与各地点对应的网页动画作品，串成一条可步行的历史寻访路线。
works.exercise_en: Research three historic facts about places around your school, make a short animation for each, and put up QR posters at the exact spots. Twist: make the artwork only unlock when the phone's GPS is within 20 metres.
works.exercise_zh: 研究学校周边三个地点的历史，为每个地点做一段短动画，并把二维码海报贴在对应位置；变体：只有手机 GPS 距离该点 20 米以内时作品才会解锁。

video.video_title: Gateway To Our Past Cybersaur Arts Promo 2021

works.title: Ghost Forest
works.description: Forty-nine dead Atlantic white cedars, killed by saltwater from rising seas in New Jersey, stand in a grove in Madison Square Park, with a soundscape of animal calls from species once native to Manhattan.
works.description_zh: 49 棵因海平面上升导致海水倒灌而死亡的新泽西大西洋白雪松被立成一片树林，置于麦迪逊广场公园，并配有曾原生于曼哈顿的物种的叫声。
works.idea_en: Bringing the evidence of climate change into a busy park makes a distant event physical, a direct brief for climate-data AR.
works.idea_zh: 把气候变化的证据带进繁忙的公园，让遥远的事件变得具体可触，这是气候数据 AR 的直接命题。
works.technique: Salvaged trees were transported and set upright in the park; an audio piece plays through a phone link for visitors.
works.technique_zh: 回收的枯树被运来竖立在公园中；观众可以通过手机链接收听一段音频作品。
works.exercise_en: Place a grove of grey AR trees in a school courtyard and attach sounds of species that lived there 200 years ago (from local records). Twist: the grove grows by one dead tree for every centimetre of projected sea-level rise.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园庭院里放置一片灰色 AR 树林，并配上 200 年前曾生活在那里的物种的声音（取自当地记录）；变体：预计海平面每上升一厘米，树林就多一棵枯树。

video.video_title: Ghost Forest Full Documentary

salient.why_en: Trees killed by rising seas are planted in a Manhattan park, bringing a distant climate loss into the city.
salient.why_zh: 被海平面上升杀死的树被种进曼哈顿的公园，把远方的气候损失带进城市。

works.title: Ghost of Tsushima lanterns (VFX Graph)
works.description: Hundreds of glowing water lanterns bob and drift on a dark surface and part around the player, recreated from the duel scenes of Ghost of Tsushima.
works.description_zh: 数百盏发光的水灯在暗色水面上起伏漂流，并在玩家周围散开，重现了《对马岛之魂》决斗场景中的效果。
works.idea_en: Recreate a memorable game atmosphere entirely on the GPU.
works.idea_zh: 完全在 GPU 上重现一个令人难忘的游戏氛围。
works.technique: A fully commented HDRP VFX Graph spawns lantern meshes as particles on the water plane, animates bobbing and drift with noise, pushes them away from the player position, and a Shader Graph material adds emissive flicker.
works.technique_zh: 一个带完整注释的 HDRP VFX Graph 把灯笼网格作为粒子生成在水面上，用噪声驱动起伏和漂移，并把它们从玩家位置推开；Shader Graph 材质再加上闪烁的自发光。
works.exercise_en: Float the lanterns over a real floor or pond in AR and let them drift away from the viewer's feet. Twist: let each lantern light up when someone speaks near the phone.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中让灯笼漂浮在真实地面或池塘上方，并从观者脚边漂开。变体：有人在手机旁说话时，每盏灯笼逐一亮起。

video.video_title:
Made the Ghost Of Tsushima lantern VFX system that you see in duels. Everything you see is on the GPU with VFX graph and Shadergraph. Had a lot of fun exploring it on the weekend!

#madewithunity #Gho

works.title: Grove
works.description: At the 2021 Venice Architecture Biennale, a dense grove of hanging fronds, lights and speakers forms a walk-in environment that murmurs and glows around visitors.
works.description_zh: 在 2021 年威尼斯建筑双年展上，由悬挂的叶片、灯光和扬声器组成的密林形成一个可以走进去的环境，在观众周围低语、发光。
works.idea_en: Surrounding a visitor with many soft, reacting elements creates immersion without any screen — a reminder that AR can build space with layers, not just objects.
works.idea_zh: 用许多柔软、会回应的元素包围观众，不需要屏幕也能产生沉浸感——提醒我们 AR 可以用层次来构建空间，而不只是放物体。
works.technique: Networked sensors, lights and a multichannel sound system are embedded in a suspended structure of 3D-printed and laser-cut components.
works.technique_zh: 联网的传感器、灯光和多声道音响嵌入在由 3D 打印和激光切割构件组成的悬挂结构中。
works.exercise_en: Build a walk-in AR grove of translucent hanging strands with spatial audio sources that brighten and whisper as the viewer passes. Twist: let each strand hold a short voice recording left by a previous visitor.
works.exercise_zh: 搭建一个可以走进去的 AR 林子，挂满半透明的丝带和空间音源，观众经过时它们变亮并低语。变体：让每条丝带保存上一位访客留下的一段短语音。

video.video_title: Grove | Venice Biennale, 2021

works.title: HDRP VFX Graph Workshop (VFX-Essentials)
works.description: Grids of particles ripple in sine waves, rings and interference patterns — the first building blocks of a VFX Graph course.
works.description_zh: 一格格粒子按正弦波、圆环和干涉图案起伏——这是一套 VFX Graph 课程的第一批基础模块。
works.idea_en: Teach VFX Graph by starting from waves: position particles with simple math before anything else.
works.idea_zh: 从“波”开始教 VFX Graph：先用简单的数学摆放粒子，再学其他。
works.technique: Each sample drives particle positions in VFX Graph with sine, distance and time operators on a grid, then layers in noise, SDFs and textures in later sections.
works.technique_zh: 每个示例都在网格上用正弦、距离和时间算子驱动 VFX Graph 中的粒子位置，后面的章节再加入噪声、SDF 和纹理。
works.exercise_en: Rebuild the wave sample with AR Foundation + URP VFX Graph on a phone, laying the wave grid on the floor so it ripples out from the user. Twist: set the wave centre to wherever the user last tapped.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机上用 AR Foundation + URP VFX Graph 重做波动示例，把波形网格铺在地上，从用户脚下向外扩散。变体：把波心设为用户最后点击的位置。

video.video_title:
Releasing an open-source HDRP-VFX-Workshop soon that covers a lot of the building blocks behind Unity's VFX Graph. First section introduces waves and how to use them!

#vfxgraph #unity3d #shaders http

works.title: HandPoseBarracuda hand tracker
works.description: A single webcam tracks all finger joints in real time inside Unity, drawing a 3D hand skeleton over the live image as a building block for gesture-driven effects.
works.idea_zh: 只用普通摄像头就能在 Unity 里拿到手指关节，做手势特效的基础件。

video.video_title: HandPoseBarracuda: Hand Landmark Tracker with Unity Barracuda

works.technique: MediaPipe palm-detection and hand-landmark neural networks run on the GPU through Unity Barracuda to output 21 3D keypoints per frame.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands（网页版即可）追踪手指，让指尖在摄像头画面上拖出彩色光带；加一个变化：捏合手指时光带变成可抓的绳子。
works.description_zh: 只用一个网络摄像头，就能在 Unity 中实时追踪所有手指关节，并在实时画面上绘制三维手部骨架，作为手势驱动特效的基础构件。
works.idea_en: Get finger joints in Unity from an ordinary camera as a building block for gesture effects.
works.technique_zh: MediaPipe 手掌检测与手部关键点神经网络通过 Unity Barracuda 在 GPU 上运行，每帧输出 21 个三维关键点。
works.exercise_en: Track fingers with MediaPipe Hands (the web version is enough) and make your fingertips drag colored light trails across the camera view. Twist: when you pinch, the light trail becomes a rope you can grab.

works.title: Holo Cat: Perspective Expression by Head Tracking
works.description: A flat screen shows his cat as a 3D hologram whose perspective shifts with the viewer's head, with no headset needed.
works.idea_zh: 用头部追踪让平面屏幕上的猫咪看起来立体。

video.video_title: Holo Cat: Perspective Expression Based on Head Tracking

works.technique: The viewer's head is tracked (likely by a webcam face tracker) and the 3D scene is rendered with an off-axis projection matched to the screen rectangle, creating motion parallax so the display acts as a window.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 追踪头部位置，在 three.js 中做离轴投影，让屏幕里的小盒子像真的有深度；变体：盒子里的角色会转头看向你。
works.description_zh: 一块平面屏幕把他的猫呈现为立体全息影像，画面透视会随观者头部移动而变化，无需佩戴头显。
works.idea_en: Head tracking makes a cat on a flat screen look three-dimensional.
works.technique_zh: 追踪观者的头部（大概率使用网络摄像头面部追踪），并以与屏幕矩形匹配的离轴投影渲染三维场景，产生运动视差，让显示器像一扇窗户。
works.exercise_en: Track head position with MediaPipe Face Mesh and build an off-axis projection in three.js so a small box on screen seems to have real depth. Twist: the character inside the box turns its head to look at you.

works.title: HoloForge Lab: HoloParticles tennis
works.description: A HoloForge Lab experiment with holographic particle effects on HoloLens 2, ending in a mock holographic tennis rally with hand-tracked swings.
works.idea_zh: 用全息粒子与手部追踪打一场全息网球。

video.video_title: HoloForge Lab - Having fun with HoloParticles, ready for a holographic tennis match?

works.technique: GPU particle effects are world-anchored, and a hand-tracked palm or racket collider transfers velocity to a ball whose trajectory is simulated with simple physics.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机当球拍，挥动时根据加速度把 AR 小球打出去，并在轨迹上留下粒子尾迹；变体：让球撞到真实墙面后反弹回来。
works.description_zh: HoloForge Lab 在 HoloLens 2 上进行的全息粒子特效实验，最后以一场模拟的全息网球对打收尾，挥拍动作由手部追踪识别。
works.idea_en: Play a game of holographic tennis with holographic particles and hand tracking.
works.technique_zh: GPU 粒子特效锚定在世界空间中，经手部追踪的手掌或球拍碰撞体把速度传递给球，球的轨迹用简单物理进行模拟。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone as a racket that sends an AR ball flying based on acceleration when you swing, leaving a particle trail along its path. Twist: make the ball bounce back after hitting a real wall.

works.title: Hot Potato multiplayer lens
works.description: Friends pass a ticking virtual hot potato between their phones in a co-located Snapchat lens until it explodes on someone.
works.idea_zh: 在朋友之间传递会爆炸的虚拟土豆。

video.video_title: Multiplayer AR is now possible inside Snapchat so we made a Hot Potato game, play it now!! https://t.co/WsTQLKPbFE https://t.co/orY2zfqnUo

works.technique: A connected lens synchronizes ownership of a shared AR object and a countdown timer across participants.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个多人共享的'传炸弹' AR 游戏（Lens Studio 或 Unity Netcode）；加一个变化：只有对着对方手机才能把炸弹扔过去。
works.description_zh: 在一个同处一地的 Snapchat 滤镜中，朋友们在各自的手机之间传递一颗滴答作响的虚拟烫手山芋，直到它在某人手里爆炸。
works.idea_en: Pass an exploding virtual potato among friends.
works.technique_zh: 联机滤镜在参与者之间同步共享 AR 物体的归属权和倒计时。
works.exercise_en: Build a multiplayer pass-the-bomb AR game with Lens Studio or Unity Netcode. Twist: you can only throw the bomb by pointing at the other person's phone.

salient.why_en: Friends pass a ticking virtual potato phone to phone until it blows up on someone, a party game anyone already knows.
salient.why_zh: 朋友们用手机互相传一个滴答作响的虚拟土豆，直到它在某人手里爆炸，规则人人都懂。

works.title: How Games Render So Much Grass
works.description: Fields of millions of grass blades sway in the wind, built step by step from billboards and geometry shaders to GPU-instanced blades culled on the GPU.
works.description_zh: 数百万根草叶在风里摆动；效果从公告板、几何着色器一步步做到 GPU 实例化并在 GPU 上剔除的草叶。
works.idea_en: A meadow is one blade drawn a million times with small differences.
works.idea_zh: 一片草地，就是一根草画一百万次，每次略有不同。
works.technique: A compute shader scatters blade positions over a terrain, frustum-culls them into an append buffer, and DrawMeshInstancedIndirect renders them with vertex-shader wind from scrolling noise.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器在地形上撒布草叶位置，做视锥剔除后写入追加缓冲区，再用 DrawMeshInstancedIndirect 渲染，顶点着色器用滚动噪声模拟风。
works.exercise_en: Grow the repo's instanced grass on detected AR floor planes (AR Foundation) so a carpet of grass appears in the living room. Twist: bend the blades away from the phone's position as the user walks through.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 检测到的地面平面上生长仓库里的实例化草地，让客厅铺满草。变体：用户走过时，草叶朝远离手机的方向弯倒。

video.video_title: How Do Games Render So Much Grass?

works.title: Human Scales (Échelles Humaines)
works.description: An AR walk through Montreal neighbourhoods where monumental virtual statues of local unsung heroes stand in parks and streets, each with a podcast telling their story.
works.description_zh: 一条穿行蒙特利尔街区的 AR 路线：公园和街道上矗立着为本地无名英雄塑造的巨型虚拟雕像，每座雕像都配有讲述其故事的播客。
works.idea_en: Put giant statues of ordinary neighbours in public space, where only monuments to famous people usually stand.
works.idea_zh: 把普通邻居的巨型雕像放进公共空间，那里通常只有名人才能被立像。
works.technique: People were 3D-scanned, turned into stylized sculptures and anchored at geolocated sites in a mobile AR app with accompanying audio.
works.technique_zh: 对真人做 3D 扫描，转成风格化雕塑，放进移动 AR 应用中锚定在地理位置上，并配上音频。
works.exercise_en: 3D-scan a classmate with a phone and place a giant version of them at a campus spot in AR, with a 30-second recorded story. Twist: the statue's pose must be chosen by the person it honours.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 3D 扫描一位同学，把巨大的他/她以 AR 形式放在校园某处，并配一段 30 秒的录音故事。变体：雕像的姿势必须由被纪念的人自己决定。

video.video_title: Échelles Humaines - EN

works.title: HyperSpace AR
works.description: A LiDAR-based AR app for iPhone 12 / iPad Pro that fills your room with generative forms that respond to the scanned walls and furniture.
works.idea_zh: 用LiDAR扫描房间，让生成形态沿真实表面生长

video.video_title: HyperSpace AR - LIDAR based app for iPhone 12 / iPad Pro

works.technique: LiDAR scene reconstruction yields a room mesh, and generative geometry is spawned and grown along the mesh normals with occlusion so forms appear to emerge from walls and furniture.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 网格重建（或平面检测）让藤蔓或晶体沿墙面与桌面生长，并开启遮挡；变体：让生长只发生在你长时间注视的表面上。
works.description_zh: 一款面向 iPhone 12 和 iPad Pro 的 LiDAR AR 应用，让生成式形态充满你的房间，并对扫描到的墙面和家具作出反应。
works.idea_en: Scan the room with LiDAR and let generative forms grow along real surfaces.
works.technique_zh: LiDAR 场景重建生成房间网格，生成式几何体沿网格法线生成和生长，并启用遮挡，让形态看起来像是从墙面和家具中冒出来。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation meshing (or plane detection) to grow vines or crystals along walls and tabletops with occlusion turned on. Twist: growth happens only on surfaces you stare at for a long time.

works.title: I Turned My Girlfriend into a Musical Instrument
works.description: Body-tracked AR turns a dancer's limbs into triggers that play live music as she moves.
works.idea_zh: 用身体追踪让女友的每个动作都成为演奏的乐器。

video.video_title: I Turned My Girlfriend Into a Musical Instrument!

works.technique: Body tracking gives joint positions, and when limbs enter defined trigger zones or exceed a speed threshold, notes are played and visual effects spawn.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 在画面中划出几个区域，手或脚进入不同区域时弹奏不同音符；变体：两个人合奏，各自控制旋律和鼓点。
works.description_zh: 基于身体追踪的 AR 把舞者的四肢变成触发器，让她在移动时现场演奏音乐。
works.idea_en: Body tracking turns each of his girlfriend's movements into a playable instrument.
works.technique_zh: 身体追踪提供关节位置，当肢体进入设定的触发区域或速度超过阈值时，播放音符并生成视觉效果。
works.exercise_en: Mark out several zones in the frame with MediaPipe Pose so that a hand or foot entering each zone plays a different note. Twist: two people play together, one on melody and one on drums.

salient.why_en: Every movement of a dancer's body plays a note, so the person becomes the instrument.
salient.why_zh: 舞者身体的每个动作都奏出一个音，人本身就成了乐器。

works.title: Infinity
works.description: A generative installation of endlessly evolving digital beings; the interactive version lets visitors' presence and movement influence the figures on screen.
works.idea_zh: 观众的出现改变无尽行走的人群

video.video_title: Infinity - User Interaction

works.technique: A crowd of procedurally animated walkers is rendered in real time, and camera-based presence tracking (likely blob or pose detection) modulates their speed, density or appearance.
works.exercise_zh: 在 p5.js 或 TouchDesigner 中做一队无限行走的抽象人形，用摄像头检测观众人数和位置来改变队伍节奏；变体：观众离开后，人群保留他们留下的某种痕迹。
works.description_zh: 一件生成式装置，展示无尽演化的数字生命；在互动版本中，观众的在场与动作会影响屏幕上的人形。
works.idea_en: The arrival of viewers changes an endless crowd of walkers.
works.technique_zh: 实时渲染一群程序化动画的行走者，基于摄像头的在场追踪（可能是斑点检测或姿态检测）调节它们的速度、密度或外观。
works.exercise_en: Make a line of endlessly walking abstract figures in p5.js or TouchDesigner, and use a camera to detect how many viewers there are and where they stand to change the rhythm of the line. Twist: after viewers leave, the crowd keeps some trace of them.

works.title: Innerworld Prism
works.description: A large-scale projection in Saint Paul commissioned by the Great Northern Festival: a dreamlike animation about losing the human ego to regain nature.
works.idea_zh: 用巨型投影讲述“放下自我、回到自然”的梦境
works.technique: Animated Dakota-inspired illustration is projected at architectural scale onto an urban surface.
works.exercise_zh: 以本地自然或文化符号画一段30秒的循环动画，晚上投到教学楼外墙；变化：让动画中的元素从墙上的窗户“钻出来”。

video.video_title: Innerworld Prism - Large-Scale Projection | Saint Paul, MN (2021)

works.description_zh: 受 Great Northern Festival 委托在圣保罗创作的大型投影：一段关于放下人类自我、重新回归自然的梦幻动画。
works.idea_en: A giant projection tells a dream about letting go of the self and returning to nature.
works.technique_zh: 受达科他文化启发的插画动画以建筑尺度投影到城市表面。
works.exercise_en: Draw a 30-second looping animation using local natural or cultural symbols and project it onto the outer wall of a school building at night. Twist: make elements of the animation crawl out through the windows in the wall.

works.title: Interactive Volumetric Fog with Fluid Dynamics (The Vast Land)
works.description: A stylised valley is filled with volumetric fog that parts and swirls around a moving character and flows around the terrain as a real fluid.
works.description_zh: 一片风格化山谷里弥漫着体积雾，角色走过时雾被推开、翻卷，并像真实流体一样绕着地形流动。
works.idea_en: Fog becomes something you can push: a fluid simulation drives a raymarched fog volume.
works.idea_zh: 让雾变成可以被推开的东西：用流体模拟驱动光线步进的体积雾。
works.technique: The compute-shader fluid solver runs on a 3D grid with arbitrary boundaries taken from the scene, and the resulting density field is raymarched as volumetric fog with lighting.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器流体解算在一个三维网格上运行，边界取自场景几何；得到的密度场再用光线步进渲染成带光照的体积雾。
works.exercise_en: Fill a small AR room with low-resolution simulated fog on HoloKit or a phone, using the LiDAR mesh as the fluid boundary so fog flows around real furniture. Twist: let the user's hand position blow the fog away.
works.exercise_zh: 在 HoloKit 或手机上用低分辨率模拟雾填满一个小 AR 房间，把 LiDAR 网格作为流体边界，让雾绕着真实家具流动。变体：用手的位置把雾吹散。

video.video_title: Interactive Volumetric Fog With Fluid Dynamics in Unity 3D

works.title: Interactive projection mapping on paper
works.description: A hand slides a small printed card across a dark table; projected lines stream out from the card's pattern and keep flowing into new patterns as it moves.
works.description_zh: 一只手在深色桌面上滑动一张印有图案的小卡片；投影出的线条从卡片的图案中延伸出来，并随着卡片移动不断流动、变换成新的图案。
works.idea_en: A printed card becomes the source that the projected drawing grows out of.
works.idea_zh: 一张印刷卡片成为投影画面生长出来的源头。
works.technique: A camera tracks the card's position and rotation (likely via its printed pattern or contour) and a calibrated projector draws generative lines registered to the card in real time.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪卡片的位置和旋转（推测依靠印刷图案或轮廓），经过标定的投影仪实时绘制与卡片对齐的生成式线条。
works.exercise_en: Calibrate a webcam to a projector over a table, track an ArUco-marked card with OpenCV, and project lines that radiate from its edges. Twist: two cards brought close together merge their line fields.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌面上方把摄像头和投影仪标定对齐，用 OpenCV 追踪贴有 ArUco 标记的卡片，并从卡片边缘投射放射状的线条；变体：两张卡片靠近时，它们的线场会融合在一起。

works.title: IrisBarracuda: eye and iris tracking
works.description: A close-up of an eye is tracked in real time with points outlining the eyelid and the iris circle.
works.description_zh: 实时追踪一只眼睛的特写，用点勾出眼睑轮廓和虹膜圆圈。
works.idea_en: Knowing where the iris is opens up gaze-driven effects.
works.idea_zh: 知道虹膜在哪里，就能做由视线驱动的特效。
works.technique: The MediaPipe iris landmark model runs on Barracuda on a cropped eye region and returns eyelid contour points and the iris center and radius.
works.technique_zh: MediaPipe 虹膜关键点模型在 Barracuda 上对裁剪出的眼部区域运行，返回眼睑轮廓点以及虹膜中心和半径。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation eye tracking (or this model) to make particles shoot from where the user looks. Twist: blinking resets the scene.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 的眼动追踪（或这个模型）让粒子从用户注视的方向射出。变体：眨眼就重置场景。

video.video_title: MediaPipe iris landmark detection model on Unity Barracuda. https://t.co/M611pZtr9T https://t.co/76gMT70dTK

works.title: KAWS × Reese's Puffs WebAR
works.description: Scanning a QR code on KAWS-designed cereal boxes launches a WebAR game in which KAWS characters appear around the box.
works.idea_zh: 扫早餐麦片盒就能在桌上和KAWS角色玩AR游戏
works.technique: An on-pack QR code opens a browser-based AR experience built with the ZapWorks Universal AR SDK for Unity, tracking the packaging as the anchor.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个零食包装设计网页AR（如MindAR或8th Wall），扫包装出现小游戏；变化：包装背面的不同图案解锁不同关卡。

video.video_title: WebAR for Packaging: Acute Art – KAWS Puffs X General Mills

works.description_zh: 扫描 KAWS 设计的早餐麦片盒上的二维码，就会启动一款 WebAR 游戏，KAWS 角色出现在盒子周围。
works.idea_en: Scan a cereal box and play an AR game with KAWS characters on your table.
works.technique_zh: 包装上的二维码打开一个基于浏览器的 AR 体验，使用 ZapWorks Universal AR SDK for Unity 构建，以包装本身作为追踪锚点。
works.exercise_en: Design web AR for a snack package with MindAR or 8th Wall so that scanning the package launches a mini-game. Twist: different patterns on the back of the package unlock different levels.

works.title: KID A MNESIA EXHIBITION
works.description: A free explorable virtual exhibition where visitors wander an upside-down analogue/digital building made from Thom Yorke's and Stanley Donwood's artwork, with rooms that react to Radiohead's music.
works.description_zh: 一座免费的可探索虚拟展馆，观众在一座由 Thom Yorke 和 Stanley Donwood 的作品构成、颠倒的模拟/数字建筑中游荡，每个房间都会对 Radiohead 的音乐做出反应。
works.idea_en: An album becomes architecture: each song is a room you walk through.
works.idea_zh: 把专辑变成建筑：每首歌都是一间可以走过的房间。
works.technique: Built in Unreal Engine with Namethemachine and Epic Games, the spaces use original drawings as textures and spatialized stems that respond to the visitor's position.
works.technique_zh: 与 Namethemachine 和 Epic Games 合作，用 Unreal Engine 打造，空间以原始绘画为贴图，并使用随观众位置变化的空间化分轨音频。
works.exercise_en: Pick three songs and design a small walkable 3D room for each in a game engine, using your own drawings as textures and placing sounds so they get louder as you approach. Twist: make one room only reachable by walking backwards.
works.exercise_zh: 选三首歌，在游戏引擎中为每首歌设计一个可行走的小房间，用自己的绘画做贴图，并摆放越靠近越响的声音；变体：让其中一个房间只能倒着走才能进入。

video.video_title: KID A MNESIA EXHIBITION - OFFICIAL TRAILER

works.title: Kaleidoscopic Home AR
works.description: An Everyday Experiment for SPACE10 and IKEA: an AR app turns your home into a playground where colourful sculptural forms grow out of tables, chairs, floors and walls to nudge you into moving.
works.description_zh: 为 SPACE10 和 IKEA 的 Everyday Experiments 创作：一个 AR 应用把家变成游乐场，彩色的雕塑形体从桌子、椅子、地板和墙上长出来，引导你活动身体。
works.idea_en: Grow playground sculptures out of your furniture to get you moving.
works.idea_zh: 让家具上长出游乐场雕塑，引你动起来。
works.technique: Object recognition and plane detection find furniture and surfaces, and generative forms are anchored to them so they appear to emerge from the real room.
works.technique_zh: 物体识别和平面检测找到家具和表面，生成式形体锚定在上面，看起来就像从真实房间里长出来。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation or Lens Studio plane detection to spawn a twisting tube from every detected surface and ask a classmate to follow it with their body. Twist: the tube grows toward the person who has been sitting longest.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 或 Lens Studio 的平面检测，从每个识别到的表面长出一根扭曲的管子，请同学用身体沿着它走；变体：管子朝坐得最久的那个人生长。

video.video_title: 01 SPACE_10_X_T&E_HEALTH_&_WELLBEING_FINAL_20210514.MOV

works.title: Kernel
works.description: A large inflatable sculpture shaped like a seed pod stands in a garden; through an AR app it digitally germinates, sprouting new virtual life forms from the tips of its buds.
works.description_zh: 一件形似种荚的大型充气雕塑立在花园里；通过 AR 应用，它会以数字形式“发芽”，从每个芽尖长出新的虚拟生命形态。
works.idea_en: A physical sculpture that sprouts virtual life when you look through a phone.
works.idea_zh: 一件实体雕塑，透过手机看时会长出虚拟生命。
works.technique: Generative patterns at the tip of each bud act as AR tracking features on the physical sculpture, so virtual growths are registered precisely to the inflatable.
works.technique_zh: 每个芽尖上的生成图案作为实体雕塑上的 AR 追踪特征，使虚拟生长物能精确贴合在充气雕塑上。
works.exercise_en: Make a small paper or clay sculpture with printed patterns, scan it as an object target in Vuforia or Lens Studio, and let virtual sprouts grow from it. Twist: the sprouts are different for each viewer's birthday month.
works.exercise_zh: 做一件带印刷图案的小纸雕或黏土雕塑，在 Vuforia 或 Lens Studio 中把它扫描为物体识别目标，让虚拟嫩芽从上面长出来；变体：嫩芽的样子随观众的出生月份而不同。

video.video_title: Kernel

works.title: KinFuSDFVFX
works.description: A real room scanned with Azure Kinect becomes a distance field that VFX Graph particles crawl over and cling to.
works.description_zh: 用 Azure Kinect 扫描的真实房间变成一个距离场，VFX Graph 粒子在上面爬行、贴附。
works.idea_en: Scan a real space once and give particles its shape to hold on to.
works.idea_zh: 把真实空间扫描一次，让粒子能够贴住它的形状。
works.technique: Kinect Fusion scans are converted in Houdini into a signed distance field volume, which VFX Graph samples to conform particles to the scanned surfaces in HDRP.
works.technique_zh: 把 Kinect Fusion 的扫描在 Houdini 中转成有符号距离场体积，VFX Graph 在 HDRP 中采样它，让粒子贴合扫描表面。
works.exercise_en: Scan a classroom object with a LiDAR phone, bake it into an SDF, and let AR particles crawl over the real object in place. Twist: the particles flee from the phone's flashlight.
works.exercise_zh: 用 LiDAR 手机扫描一件教室里的物体，烘焙成 SDF，让 AR 粒子在原位的真实物体上爬行。变体：粒子会躲开手机手电筒的光。

video.video_title: KinFuSDFVFX

works.title: KinoAqua: watercolor effect with VFX Graph
works.description: Particle animations are rendered as if painted in watercolor, with soft edges, paper texture and pigment pooling.
works.description_zh: 粒子动画像用水彩画出来一样，有柔和的边缘、纸张纹理和颜料的晕染。
works.idea_en: A painterly filter makes computer graphics feel handmade.
works.idea_zh: 绘画风格的滤镜让电脑图形有手作感。
works.technique: A post-processing pass detects edges, darkens them like pigment pooling, adds noise-based wobble and multiplies a paper texture.
works.technique_zh: 后处理通道检测边缘，把边缘加深模拟颜料积聚，加上基于噪声的晃动，再乘上纸张纹理。
works.exercise_en: Apply a watercolor post effect to AR Foundation so both the real room and virtual objects look painted. Twist: the painting gets wetter where you point the phone for longer.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中加水彩后处理，让真实房间和虚拟物体都像画出来的。变体：手机停留越久的地方，画面越“湿”。

video.video_title: Watercolor effect + VFX Graph https://t.co/mVkADkWv7m https://t.co/Mf7RYXg9ve

works.title: L'Arc de Triomphe, Wrapped
works.description: Realised after Christo's death, the Arc de Triomphe in Paris was wrapped in 25,000 square metres of silver-blue fabric and 3,000 metres of red rope for 16 days.
works.description_zh: 在 Christo 去世后实现：巴黎凯旋门被 25000 平方米的银蓝色织物和 3000 米红色绳索包裹 16 天。
works.idea_en: A familiar monument turned into a soft, shimmering object is exactly what a city-scale AR material swap feels like.
works.idea_zh: 一座熟悉的纪念碑变成柔软闪亮的物体，这正是城市尺度 AR 材质替换带来的感觉。
works.technique: Recyclable fabric was lowered from the top over steel frames that protected the reliefs, and tied with red polypropylene rope.
works.technique_zh: 可回收织物从顶部沿保护浮雕的钢框架放下，再用红色聚丙烯绳捆扎。
works.exercise_en: Take a photogrammetry model of a local monument and, in AR, swap its material for silver fabric with red rope lines. Twist: the fabric shimmers more when the wind (device motion) is stronger.
works.exercise_zh: 取一座当地纪念碑的摄影测量模型，在 AR 中把它的材质替换为带红色绳线的银色织物；变体：“风”（设备晃动）越大，织物越闪亮。

video.video_title: Christo's wrapped Arc de Triomphe

salient.why_en: Wrapping a monument in fabric makes a familiar landmark look new.
salient.why_zh: 用布把纪念碑包起来，熟悉的地标一下子变得陌生。

works.title: La Ferita (The Wound)
works.description: On the facade of Palazzo Strozzi in Florence, a 28-metre collage appears to tear open the stone to reveal the courtyard, the library and Renaissance halls inside, a comment on museums closed during the pandemic.
works.description_zh: 在佛罗伦萨斯特罗齐宫的立面上，一幅 28 米高的拼贴仿佛把石墙撕开，露出内部的庭院、图书馆和文艺复兴大厅，影射疫情期间关闭的博物馆。
works.idea_en: A fake tear in a real wall that shows the interior is exactly an AR portal, done in paper.
works.idea_zh: 真实墙面上一道显露内部的假裂口，正是用纸做成的 AR 传送门。
works.technique: Photographs of the interior were composed into an anamorphic image aligned to the street view and pasted over the facade.
works.technique_zh: 把内部照片合成为与街道视角对齐的变形图像，并贴在立面上。
works.exercise_en: In AR, cut a jagged opening in a real wall with a depth mask and show a photo sphere of what is actually behind it (the room on the other side). Twist: the tear widens the longer you stand in front of it.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中用深度遮罩在真实墙面上切出一道参差的开口，显示墙后真实存在的内容（另一侧房间）的全景照片；变体：你在它面前站得越久，裂口就越宽。

video.video_title: "La Ferita": JR

salient.why_en: A paper tear in a closed museum's stone facade lets you see the halls inside.
salient.why_zh: 在闭馆博物馆的石墙上贴出一道“裂口”，让人看见里面的大厅。

works.title: Levitation 2
works.description: The second part of Sila Sveta's Levitation performance, which continues from the exact last frame of the first (seen more than 20 million times): a dancer appears to float and interact with objects and light in a space that mixes theatre, choreography and optical illusion.
works.description_zh: Sila Sveta《Levitation》表演的第二部，从第一部（观看量超过两千万）的最后一帧直接接续：舞者仿佛漂浮起来，并与物体和光互动，整个空间融合了剧场、编舞和视觉错觉。
works.idea_en: Illusions of weightlessness depend on hiding the support and controlling the viewpoint; AR can make real people seem to levitate with the same discipline.
works.idea_zh: 失重的错觉取决于藏住支撑并控制观看视角；AR 也可以用同样的严谨，让真人看起来悬浮起来。
works.technique: A performer on a hidden rig works with projected or holographic imagery and a locked camera or audience viewpoint so the body appears to float (exact rig likely wires or a hidden platform).
works.technique_zh: 表演者借助隐藏装置，与投影或全息影像配合，并锁定摄像机或观众视角，让身体看起来漂浮（具体装置推测为威亚或隐藏平台）。
works.exercise_en: Use ARKit or Lens Studio person segmentation to lift a live person off the floor on screen while hiding their feet with a virtual cloud. Twist: the person can only rise when they hold perfectly still.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit 或 Lens Studio 的人像分割，在屏幕上把真人从地面抬起，并用虚拟云朵遮住双脚；变体：只有当这个人完全静止时才会升起。

video.video_title: Levitation 2

works.title: LiDAR Radar (AR 100 Days, Day 21)
works.description: The LiDAR scan of the room is overlaid on the camera view as glowing dots, and a double tap flips to a top-down radar map of everything scanned so far.
works.description_zh: 房间的 LiDAR 扫描结果以发光点的形式叠加在摄像头画面上，双击后切换成俯视的雷达图，显示目前扫描到的一切。
works.idea_en: Show people what the device sees, then let them see it from above.
works.idea_zh: 先让人看到设备“看到”的东西，再让他们从上方俯瞰它。
works.technique: LiDAR depth points are accumulated and drawn with Metal as an overlay in RealityKit, then re-projected into an orthographic top view for the radar mode.
works.technique_zh: 把 LiDAR 深度点累积起来，在 RealityKit 中用 Metal 绘制成叠加层，再重投影成正交俯视图作为雷达模式。
works.exercise_en: Accumulate AR Foundation depth points into a point cloud and render a minimap corner view of the scanned room. Twist: add a sweeping radar line that only reveals points as it passes.
works.exercise_zh: 把 AR Foundation 的深度点累积成点云，在屏幕角落渲染已扫描房间的小地图。变体：加一条扫动的雷达线，只在经过时显示点。

ダブルタップで真上から見たレーダー表示への移行

部屋のスキャンが可視化できとても良い感じ
