works.title: Life Forces
works.description: Three LED screens show endlessly scrolling landscapes of moss, fungi and flowers. Viewers' bodies are tracked so they can roleplay as pollen and spores, feed as slime mould or sway as rock formations.
works.description_zh: 三块 LED 屏幕上是无尽滚动的苔藓、真菌和花朵景观。观众的身体被追踪，可以扮演花粉和孢子、像黏菌一样觅食，或像岩石一样摇摆。
works.idea_en: Your body becomes pollen, fungus or rock in a living diorama.
works.idea_zh: 在一座活的生态景箱里，你的身体变成花粉、真菌或岩石。
works.technique: An iPad Pro under each screen runs live body tracking, and a real-time 3D scene built from scanned plants responds to the viewer's pose and movement.
works.technique_zh: 每块屏幕下的 iPad Pro 运行实时身体追踪，由扫描植物构成的实时三维场景对观众的姿势和动作作出反应。
works.exercise_en: Use ARKit body tracking or MediaPipe pose to map a student's arms to swaying stems in a p5.js or Unity garden. Twist: each classmate controls a different species and the garden only thrives when all move together.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit 身体追踪或 MediaPipe 姿态估计，把同学的手臂映射成 p5.js 或 Unity 花园里摇摆的茎；变体：每位同学控制一种不同的植物，只有大家一起动，花园才会繁茂。

video.video_title: 01 Tin&Ed_Life_Forces_Barbican

works.title: Lil Cartoon Bratz Doll
works.description: A Snapchat lens that turns the user's face into a big-eyed, glossy-lipped 90s fashion-doll cartoon, inspired by Piskin's favourite childhood toy.
works.idea_zh: 把你的脸实时变成90年代时尚娃娃的卡通模样。

video.video_title: DREAM IT BUILD IT: LIL CARTOON BRATZ with PAIGE PISKIN

works.technique: A machine-learning face transformation (likely a GAN-based style model) restyles the face into a cartoon while keeping head pose and expression.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 的 ML 风格化或人脸变形工具，把脸变成一种你童年玩具的风格；变体：写一段说明，解释你保留了原脸的哪些特征。
works.description_zh: 一个 Snapchat 滤镜，把用户的脸变成大眼睛、亮晶晶嘴唇的 90 年代时尚娃娃卡通形象，灵感来自 Piskin 童年最爱的玩具。
works.idea_en: Turn your face into a 90s fashion-doll cartoon in real time.
works.technique_zh: 基于机器学习的人脸变换（大概率是基于 GAN 的风格模型）把脸部重绘为卡通风格，同时保留头部姿态和表情。
works.exercise_en: Use Lens Studio's ML stylization or face-distortion tools to turn a face into the style of a toy from your childhood. Twist: write a short note explaining which features of the original face you kept.

works.title: Lil Nas X Met Gala Armour Filter (in 4 hours)
works.description: Inspired by Lil Nas X's golden armour at the Met Gala, Don Allen III sculpts and publishes a wearable AR version on Snapchat within about four hours, showing every step.
works.description_zh: 受 Lil Nas X 在 Met Gala 上的金色盔甲启发，Don Allen III 在大约四小时内雕刻并发布了一个可穿戴的 Snapchat AR 版本，并展示了每一步。
works.idea_en: Treat AR fashion as real-time commentary: react to a pop-culture moment the same day.
works.idea_zh: 把 AR 时装当作实时评论：流行文化事件当天就作出回应。
works.technique: Armour sculpted in Gravity Sketch VR, refined in Cinema 4D and Substance 3D Painter, then skinned to the body mesh in Lens Studio.
works.technique_zh: 在 Gravity Sketch 中用 VR 雕刻盔甲，再在 Cinema 4D 和 Substance 3D Painter 中细化，最后在 Lens Studio 中蒙皮到身体网格上。
works.exercise_en: Pick a news or pop-culture moment from this week and make a wearable AR piece about it in under three hours. Twist: it must be readable without any text or logos.
works.exercise_zh: 挑选本周的一条新闻或流行文化事件，在三小时内做一件相关的可穿戴 AR 作品；变体：作品不能用任何文字或标志，也要让人看懂。

video.video_title: How to make LilNasX  fashion into an AR filter! In 4 hours Met Gala

works.title: Lune
works.description: A nude woman from one of Curtiss's paintings stands in AR with her back turned; however you walk around her, she keeps turning away and avoids your gaze.
works.description_zh: Curtiss 画中的一位裸体女子以 AR 形式背对观众站立；无论你怎么绕着她走，她都会不断转身，避开你的目光。
works.idea_en: A figure that always turns away makes the viewer aware of their own gaze.
works.idea_zh: 一个永远转身背对你的人物，让观众意识到自己的凝视。
works.technique: Phone AR where the figure's orientation is continuously driven by the camera position so that it always faces away from the viewer.
works.technique_zh: 手机 AR 中人物的朝向持续由摄像头位置驱动，使她始终背对观众。
works.exercise_en: Place a 3D figure in AR that rotates to keep its back to the camera, and ask classmates to try to see its face. Twist: let it turn around only when two phones look at it from opposite sides.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中放置一个始终转身背对摄像头的 3D 人物，让同学们尝试看到她的脸；变体：只有当两部手机从相对两侧同时看她时，她才转过身来。

video.video_title: Acute Art presents: Julie Curtiss introduces Lune

salient.why_en: However you walk around her, the painted figure keeps turning her back to you.
salient.why_zh: 无论你怎么绕着走，画中的女人总是转过身去背对你。

works.title: M-LSD line detection as VFX
works.description: Straight lines detected in a live camera image, like room edges and furniture outlines, are turned into glowing wires and particle sparks.
works.description_zh: 实时画面中检测到的直线，比如房间边缘和家具轮廓，被变成发光的线和粒子火花。
works.idea_en: The architecture of a room becomes the drawing.
works.idea_zh: 房间的结构本身就成了画。
works.technique: The M-LSD line segment detection model runs on Barracuda; detected segments are passed to VFX Graph through a buffer to spawn particles along them.
works.technique_zh: M-LSD 线段检测模型在 Barracuda 上运行，检测到的线段通过缓冲区传给 VFX Graph，沿线段生成粒子。
works.exercise_en: Detect lines in the AR Foundation camera image and trace them with sparks so the room's edges light up. Twist: only horizontal lines glow.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 相机画面中检测直线，用火花描出来，让房间的边缘亮起来。变体：只有水平线会发光。

video.video_title: Tried using the M-LSD line segment detector for visual effects with Unity VFX Graph. https://t.co/hWh4ZlCM7n https://t.co/ZW2OMHlf65

works.title: MLS-MPM Fluid in Unity
works.description: Thousands of particles slosh and splash as a liquid inside a box, simulated in real time on the GPU in Unity.
works.description_zh: 成千上万的粒子在盒子里像液体一样晃动、飞溅，在 Unity 中由 GPU 实时模拟。
works.idea_en: Use the same particle-grid method as film VFX to get believable liquid at interactive speed.
works.idea_zh: 用电影特效同款的粒子-网格方法，在可交互的速度下得到可信的液体。
works.technique: The Moving Least Squares Material Point Method moves particle momentum onto a background grid, updates the grid, and transfers velocities back each step in compute shaders, with lock-free atomic writes and a bitonic sort to keep neighbours together.
works.technique_zh: 移动最小二乘物质点法（MLS-MPM）在计算着色器中每一步把粒子动量转到背景网格，更新网格后再把速度传回粒子，并用无锁原子写入和双调排序让相邻粒子保持在一起。
works.exercise_en: Run a 2D MLS-MPM (for example the 88-line mpm88 algorithm) in a compute shader and show it on a virtual glass panel standing on a real table in AR. Twist: tilt the phone to change gravity.
works.exercise_zh: 用计算着色器实现一个 2D MLS-MPM（例如 88 行的 mpm88 算法），在 AR 中把它显示在立于真实桌面上的一块虚拟玻璃板里。变体：倾斜手机来改变重力方向。

video.video_title:

works.title: Mirror Self-Portraits
works.description: Mirrors break LiDAR and photogrammetry, so Mikko turned the failure into an effect: the scanner reconstructs the reflection as a warped room behind the glass, creating trippy 3D self-portraits.
works.description_zh: 镜子会让 LiDAR 和摄影测量失效，Mikko 干脆把这个失败变成效果：扫描器把镜中倒影当成真实空间，重建出镜子后面一个扭曲的房间，形成迷幻的 3D 自画像。
works.idea_en: Use a scanner's failure mode as a creative effect.
works.idea_zh: 把扫描器的失败模式当作创作手法。
works.technique: LiDAR and photogrammetry assume opaque surfaces, so a mirror's reflection is reconstructed as extra geometry behind the glass, yielding mirrored self-portrait meshes.
works.technique_zh: LiDAR 和摄影测量都假设表面不透明，于是镜中倒影被重建成玻璃后方多出来的几何体，得到镜像式的自画像网格。
works.exercise_en: Deliberately scan 'unscannable' things (mirror, glass, water, a moving person) and curate the most beautiful failures into an AR glitch gallery. Twist: design a scene that only makes sense because of the scanning error.
works.exercise_zh: 故意去扫描“扫不了”的东西（镜子、玻璃、水、移动的人），把最美的失败挑出来办一个 AR 故障画廊；变体：设计一个只有依靠扫描错误才成立的场景。

video.video_title:
Lidar and Photogrammetry will both fail on reflective surfaces. You can use mirrors to create some pretty trippy self portraits though

https://t.co/oTtBbUAUdP

#1scanaday https://t.co/AMP3whMg81

works.title: ModularHMD
works.description: A VR headset with three removable side displays: pop a module off to see the real person next to you or your phone, snap it back for full immersion.
works.description_zh: 一款带三个可拆卸侧面显示模块的 VR 头显：拔掉一个模块就能看到身边的人或手机，插回去又恢复完全沉浸。
works.idea_en: Make the headset's walls physically removable so reality can be let in piece by piece.
works.idea_zh: 让头显的“墙”可以物理拆卸，一块一块地放现实进来。
works.technique: Mounts three removable display modules in the periphery of a commercial HMD cowl, reconfigured by hand to switch between immersion and peripheral real-world awareness.
works.technique_zh: 在商用头显外壳周边安装三个可拆卸显示模块，手动重组即可在沉浸和感知周围现实之间切换。
works.exercise_en: Build a cardboard viewer with three flaps that fold open to reveal the real room, then play a phone VR game and note when you open each flap. Twist: let a partner open the flaps for you as a social signal.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个带三块可翻开挡板的纸盒眼镜，翻开挡板即可看到真实房间，玩一款手机 VR 游戏并记录何时打开哪块挡板；变体：让同伴替你打开挡板，把它当成一种社交信号。

video.video_title: A Reconfigurable Mobile Head-Mounted Display Supporting Real World Interactions

works.title: Multi-person AR fashion
works.description: Real-time AR garments dress several people at once, exploring shared digital fashion on the street.
works.idea_zh: 多人同时穿上AR数字时装

video.video_title: Multi-person AR fashion

works.technique: Lens Studio multi-body tracking attaches garment meshes or cloth simulations to several detected skeletons in the same camera frame.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 多人体追踪给画面里所有人穿上一套统一的数字服装；变体：让服装的颜色或纹样由两个人之间的距离决定，靠近时融合。
works.description_zh: 实时 AR 服装同时为多人穿上衣服，探索街头共享的数字时尚。
works.idea_en: Several people wear AR digital fashion at the same time.
works.technique_zh: Lens Studio 的多人身体追踪把服装网格或布料模拟附着到同一摄像头画面中检测到的多个骨架上。
works.exercise_en: Use Lens Studio multi-body tracking to dress everyone in the frame in one matching digital outfit. Twist: let the distance between two people set the color or pattern of the clothes, blending when they come close.

works.title: National Geographic / NASA JPL Mars AR filter
works.description: Timed with the Perseverance landing, an Instagram AR portal let 220 million followers step into a 360° panorama of Jezero Crater made from images only hours old.
works.idea_zh: 毅力号着陆当天，用最新火星照片做成可走进的 AR 传送门。

video.video_title: Behind The Scenes: National Geographic / NASA JPL - Mars AR Instagram Filter

works.technique: A world-anchored portal masks a spherical 360° panorama so it is visible only through the door, updated with near-real-time rover imagery.
works.exercise_zh: 用一张真实的 360 全景照（学校、太空、海底）做一扇 AR 传送门；加一个变化：门里的场景每天自动换成新照片。
works.description_zh: 配合毅力号着陆，一个 Instagram AR 传送门让 2.2 亿关注者走进由仅数小时前拍摄的图像拼成的耶泽罗陨石坑 360° 全景。
works.idea_en: On the day Perseverance landed, the newest Mars photos became an AR portal you could walk into.
works.technique_zh: 锚定在世界空间中的传送门对球形 360° 全景进行遮罩，使其只能透过门看到，全景内容以近乎实时的火星车图像更新。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR portal from a real 360 panorama photo of your school, space or the sea floor. Twist: the scene inside the portal automatically switches to a new photo every day.

works.title: Neon Face Paint
works.description: A Snapchat lens made with Liisi Mononen for Snap's Call for Creation in which you paint glowing neon strokes onto your own face; it was nominated in the Art & Expression category at Lens Fest.
works.description_zh: 与 Liisi Mononen 为 Snap “Call for Creation” 合作的 Snapchat 滤镜，可以在自己脸上画出发光的霓虹笔触；该作品入围 Lens Fest “艺术与表达”类别。
works.idea_en: Paint glowing neon lines directly onto your own face.
works.idea_zh: 直接在自己脸上画发光的霓虹线条。
works.technique: Touch strokes are likely projected onto the tracked face mesh and stored in its UV space, so the paint sticks to the skin as the face moves, with a bloom glow pass on top.
works.technique_zh: 触摸笔触很可能被投射到追踪的人脸网格上并存进其 UV 空间，因此脸部移动时颜料仍贴在皮肤上，最后再叠加一层泛光效果。
works.exercise_en: Use a face-mesh filter tool (Lens Studio, Effect House or MediaPipe Face Mesh) to let users draw on a face texture with a finger. Twist: the paint slowly drips down over time.
works.exercise_zh: 用人脸网格滤镜工具（Lens Studio、Effect House 或 MediaPipe Face Mesh）让用户用手指在人脸贴图上作画；变体：颜料会随时间慢慢往下流淌。

video.video_title:
Made this with Liisi for @SnapAR's Call For Creation.
It was nominated in the category 'Art & Expression' at Lens Fest :)

Try Neon Face Paint: https://t.co/TNIyoO9MYc https://t.co/uvMKmLOKse

works.title: Neon Human (AR 100 Days, Day 33)
works.description: People in the camera view are traced with bright neon outlines while the background stays dark, like an animated music-video look applied live.
works.description_zh: 摄像头画面里的人被亮色霓虹轮廓勾勒出来，背景保持暗色，就像实时套用了一段动画音乐录影带的风格。
works.idea_en: Draw light along the edge of the human silhouette to turn anyone into a music-video character.
works.idea_zh: 沿着人体轮廓的边缘画光，让任何人都变成音乐录影带里的角色。
works.technique: ARKit people occlusion (ARMatteGenerator) provides a person matte; a Metal shader likely detects its edges and draws glowing lines over a darkened camera image.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 的人物遮挡（ARMatteGenerator）提供人体遮罩；Metal 着色器很可能检测遮罩边缘，并在调暗的摄像头画面上绘制发光线条。
works.exercise_en: Take the human stencil texture from AR Foundation, run an edge-detect pass and composite neon lines over the camera feed. Twist: animate the line color with the beat of a song.
works.exercise_zh: 从 AR Foundation 获取人体模板纹理，做一次边缘检测，再把霓虹线合成到摄像头画面上。变体：让线条颜色随歌曲节拍变化。

works.title: Neural Cameras
works.description: Virtual objects inserted into a phone video pick up the same noise, blur, colour and lens quirks as the real camera, so they stop looking pasted on.
works.description_zh: 插入手机视频的虚拟物体会带上与真实相机相同的噪点、模糊、色彩和镜头特征，不再显得像贴上去的。
works.idea_en: Make virtual objects look filmed by the same imperfect camera as everything else.
works.idea_zh: 让虚拟物体看起来是被同一台不完美的相机拍下来的。
works.technique: Trains neural networks on image databases from a physical camera to jointly simulate its imaging pipeline and applies them to rendered objects before compositing.
works.technique_zh: 用某台实体相机拍摄的图像数据库训练神经网络，联合模拟其成像流程，并在合成前作用于渲染出的物体。
works.exercise_en: Place a 3D model into a phone AR scene, then add grain, slight blur and a colour tint until classmates can no longer tell which object is real. Twist: match a vintage camera look instead.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 场景中放入一个三维模型，然后加上颗粒、轻微模糊和色调，直到同学分辨不出哪个物体是真的；变体：改为模仿复古相机的风格。

video.video_title: Neural Cameras: Learning Camera Characteristics for Coherent Mixed Reality Rendering

works.title: NoiseBall6: compute shader mesh on mobile
works.description: A noisy, spiky ball deforms every frame on the GPU and runs on mobile phones as well as desktop.
works.description_zh: 一个尖刺状的噪声球每帧在 GPU 上变形，在手机和电脑上都能运行。
works.idea_en: Deform geometry directly on the GPU for heavy effects on phones.
works.idea_zh: 直接在 GPU 上变形几何体，让手机也能跑重特效。
works.technique: The Mesh API exposes vertex and index buffers as GraphicsBuffers, so a compute shader rewrites the mesh without any CPU work.
works.technique_zh: Mesh API 把顶点和索引缓冲暴露为 GraphicsBuffer，计算着色器直接改写网格，不占用 CPU。
works.exercise_en: Write a compute shader that deforms a mesh anchored with AR Foundation, and test its frame rate on your phone. Twist: the spikes point toward the nearest person.
works.exercise_zh: 写一个计算着色器，让 AR Foundation 锚定的网格变形，并在手机上测试帧率。变体：尖刺指向最近的人。

video.video_title: Trying the new mesh API (compute shader direct access) with mobile devices. Yes, it works on mobiles if the device supports GPU compute. https://t.co/KLUUN9eMOI https://t.co/sMnTMMnb22

works.title: OAK-D-Lite stereo depth particles
works.description: A person seen by a small OAK-D-Lite stereo camera becomes a flowing particle figure in real time.
works.description_zh: 小巧的 OAK-D-Lite 立体相机拍到的人，实时变成流动的粒子形象。
works.idea_en: A cheap stereo camera is enough for body particles.
works.idea_zh: 便宜的立体相机就足以做人体粒子。
works.technique: A small native plugin reads stereo depth from the DepthAI device, converts it to a position map and feeds VFX Graph.
works.technique_zh: 一个小型原生插件读取 DepthAI 设备的立体深度，转换成位置贴图交给 VFX Graph。
works.exercise_en: Compare the depth from a stereo camera with a LiDAR iPhone in AR Foundation using the same particle graph. Twist: mix both sources in one scene.
works.exercise_zh: 用同一个粒子图，对比立体相机和 LiDAR iPhone（AR Foundation）的深度效果。变体：把两种来源混在一个场景里。

video.video_title:
Particle effects with OAK-D-Lite stereo depth
https://t.co/TbUBSZ1Gys https://t.co/MpmRgov0FR

works.title: PONK connected lens
works.description: Two friends play classic Pong in AR, each hitting the ball from their own phone in a shared Snapchat lens.
works.idea_zh: 两个人在同一片现实空间里打 AR 版乒乓 Pong。

video.video_title: You can now play classic pong in AR with a friend in my new connected lens game PONK, try it out now! https://t.co/40DYMKGVmG https://t.co/kCqdwogo7f

works.technique: Snap Connected Lenses sync game state and a shared coordinate frame between devices so both players see the same ball and paddles.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio Connected Lens 或 Photon 做双人 AR 小游戏；加一个变化：球拍由玩家的脸部位置控制。
works.description_zh: 两个朋友在 AR 中玩经典的 Pong，在同一个 Snapchat 共享滤镜里各自用自己的手机击球。
works.idea_en: Two people play AR Pong in the same real space.
works.technique_zh: Snap Connected Lenses 在设备之间同步游戏状态和共享坐标系，使两位玩家看到同一个球和同样的球拍。
works.exercise_en: Build a two-player AR mini-game with Lens Studio Connected Lens or Photon. Twist: players control their paddles with the position of their faces.

works.title: Particle and LiDAR Scan (AR 100 Days, Day 25)
works.description: Particles fall onto a crumpled cloth on a table and slide along its real folds, because they collide with the LiDAR-scanned shape instead of a flat plane.
works.description_zh: 粒子落在桌上一块皱起的布上，沿着布的真实褶皱滑落，因为它们碰撞的是 LiDAR 扫描出的形状，而不是一个平面。
works.idea_en: Once particles can feel real geometry, every object becomes a landscape for them.
works.idea_zh: 一旦粒子能感知真实几何，每个物体都会成为它们的地形。
works.technique: The ARKit scene reconstruction mesh from LiDAR is used as a collision shape for a particle system, so particles bounce and slide along the scanned surfaces.
works.technique_zh: 把 ARKit 通过 LiDAR 得到的场景重建网格作为粒子系统的碰撞体，粒子沿扫描表面反弹和滑动。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation meshing as a VFX Graph or Shuriken collider and pour sand-like particles over objects on a desk. Twist: color each particle by the camera pixel it lands on.
works.exercise_zh: 把 AR Foundation 的网格重建作为 VFX Graph 或 Shuriken 的碰撞体，让沙子一样的粒子倾倒在桌上的物体上。变体：用粒子落点处的摄像头像素给它上色。

works.title: Piano&Dancer
works.description: On stage are a dancer and a piano but no pianist: as the dancer moves, the piano keys press themselves and the music answers her gestures without her ever touching the instrument.
works.description_zh: 舞台上只有一位舞者和一架钢琴，没有钢琴家：舞者一动，琴键就自己按下，音乐回应她的动作，而她从未碰到钢琴。
works.idea_en: A dancer plays a piano from across the room with her body alone.
works.idea_zh: 舞者隔着空间，只用身体弹钢琴。
works.technique: Sensors on the dancer are analysed for gesture features that an algorithm translates into MIDI notes for a self-playing mechanical piano.
works.technique_zh: 舞者身上的传感器被分析出动作特征，算法再把它们转换成 MIDI 音符，驱动自动演奏的机械钢琴。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam pose model (ml5.js / MediaPipe) to turn wrist height and speed into MIDI notes played on a laptop piano sound. Twist: only let slow movements make sound.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头姿态模型（ml5.js / MediaPipe）把手腕高度和速度转成 MIDI 音符，在电脑钢琴音色上演奏；变体：只有缓慢的动作才能发声。

video.video_title: Piano&Dancer (at Auditorio Conde Duque)

salient.why_en: A piano with no pianist plays itself in answer to a dancer who never touches it.
salient.why_zh: 一架没有钢琴师的钢琴自己弹奏，回应一位从不触碰它的舞者。

works.title: Pikmin Bloom
works.description: A walking game made with Nintendo: Pikmin sprout from your steps, follow you through the city and plant flowers along the path you walk, visible in AR.
works.idea_zh: 每走一步都在城市里种下花，皮克敏在AR里跟着你散步。

video.video_title: Pikmin Bloom Game Overview Trailer

works.technique: Pedometer and GPS trail data are drawn as a flower path on the map, and AR mode places followers on the ground plane behind the camera position.
works.exercise_zh: 记录一次散步的 GPS 轨迹，在地图上画成一条花径，并在 AR 中让一个小角色跟在你身后；变体：花的种类由你当时经过的地点类型决定。
works.description_zh: 与任天堂合作的一款步行游戏：皮克敏从你的脚步中萌发，跟着你穿过城市，沿你走过的路种下花朵，在 AR 中清晰可见。
works.idea_en: Every step plants flowers in the city, and Pikmin follow you on your walk in AR.
works.technique_zh: 计步器和 GPS 轨迹数据在地图上绘制成花径，AR 模式则把跟随的小角色放在相机位置后方的地面平面上。
works.exercise_en: Record the GPS track of a walk, draw it on a map as a flower path, and have a small character follow behind you in AR. Twist: the kind of flower depends on the type of place you were passing.

works.title: Pink Smog (AR 100 Days, Day 37)
works.description: A thick pink fog fills the street seen through the phone; objects fade into it with distance, so a car suddenly emerging from the haze feels dangerous.
works.description_zh: 手机里看到的街道被浓厚的粉色雾气填满；物体随距离逐渐隐入雾中，一辆车突然从雾里冲出来时显得十分危险。
works.idea_en: Real depth makes fake weather believable: the fog thickens exactly where the world gets farther away.
works.idea_zh: 真实的深度让虚构的天气变得可信：雾气恰好在世界变远的地方变浓。
works.technique: Per-pixel LiDAR depth drives an exponential fog blend over the camera image in a Metal shader, tinted pink as a homage to a reported pink smog event.
works.technique_zh: 在 Metal 着色器中用逐像素 LiDAR 深度驱动指数雾，与摄像头画面混合，并染成粉色，致敬一次传闻中的粉色雾霾事件。
works.exercise_en: Build depth fog with AR Foundation environment depth and give it a color that tells a story (smoke, pollen, toxic haze). Twist: let the fog clear in a circle around the user's hand.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 环境深度做深度雾，并给它一个讲故事的颜色（烟雾、花粉、毒雾）。变体：让雾在用户手部周围清出一个圆形空洞。

works.title: Poem Pavilion (UK Pavilion, Expo 2020 Dubai)
works.description: The UK Pavilion at Expo 2020 Dubai is a cone of wooden slats whose front face is a giant LED screen; every visitor adds one word and a machine-learning model turns all the words into a collective poem shown on the facade.
works.description_zh: 迪拜 2020 世博会英国馆是一座木条组成的锥形建筑，正面是一块巨大的 LED 屏；每位观众贡献一个词，机器学习模型把所有词合成一首集体诗，显示在立面上。
works.idea_en: A building that writes with its visitors' words is a public, readable record of who came; shared AR text anchored on architecture can do the same at any scale.
works.idea_zh: 用观众词语写诗的建筑，是一份公开、可读的来访记录：锚定在建筑上的共享 AR 文字，也能在任何尺度上做到这一点。
works.technique: Visitor words are collected at kiosks and fed to a language model, likely trained on a poetry corpus, whose output lines scroll across LED strips set into the slats.
works.technique_zh: 观众在终端输入词语，交给一个语言模型（推测以诗歌语料训练），生成的诗句在嵌入木条的 LED 灯带上滚动显示。
works.exercise_en: Build a Lens Studio or WebXR 'poem wall' on a real school facade: each visitor enters one word, and the app recombines all words into a short poem shown as floating text on the wall. Twist: words from people standing closer to the wall appear larger.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实的学校外墙上用 Lens Studio 或 WebXR 做一面「诗墙」：每位访客输入一个词，应用把所有词重组成一首短诗，以漂浮文字显示在墙上。变体：离墙越近的人输入的词显示得越大。

video.video_title: Es Devlin's UK pavilion for Dubai Expo 2020

works.title: Poem World (Snap Spectacles)
works.description: A short poem by Shantell Martin laid out as lines of text in space that you read by walking through them, recorded through Snap's AR Spectacles.
works.idea_zh: 一首可以走进去读的诗：文字排布在空间里，读诗就是走路。
works.technique: World-tracked text meshes are placed along a path in Lens Studio; the reading order is set by where the wearer walks rather than by scrolling.
works.exercise_zh: 把一首短诗拆成词句，用 AR 摆放在走廊或操场上，让“读”变成一条行走路线；变体：让某些词只在你停下来时才出现。

video.video_title: 🔈 had the oppourtunity to work with the new snap AR spectacles — and had the idea of a poem you could walk through.  collaborated with the amazing @shantell_martin who made a beautiful short poem and

works.description_zh: Shantell Martin 的一首短诗被排布成空间中的一行行文字，你要穿行其间才能读完，全程通过 Snap 的 AR Spectacles 录制。
works.idea_en: A poem you walk into: the words are laid out in space, and reading means walking.
works.technique_zh: 在 Lens Studio 中沿一条路径放置世界追踪的文字网格；阅读顺序由佩戴者走到哪里决定，而不是靠滚动。
works.exercise_en: Break a short poem into words and phrases and place them in AR along a corridor or across a sports field, so reading becomes a walking route. Twist: some words appear only when you stop.

salient.why_en: A poem is laid out in space, so reading it means walking through it.
salient.why_zh: 一首诗被摆放在空间里，读诗就变成了在诗中行走。

works.title: PointCloudExplorer
works.description: A walk through a city block rebuilt from millions of laser-scan points, with points that shimmer, scan and dissolve as the camera moves.
works.description_zh: 在由数百万个激光扫描点重建的街区中穿行，点会随着镜头移动闪烁、扫描和消散。
works.idea_en: Treat a real place scanned as points as a living material, not a finished model.
works.idea_zh: 把扫描得到的真实地点当成一种活的材料，而不是一个完成的模型。
works.technique: Point-cloud data is split into chunks and rendered with a custom point shader; the same code base drove the 'Virtual Hatsudai' app for NTT ICC, with scanlines, transitions and voxelization effects on the points.
works.technique_zh: 点云数据被切成若干块，用自定义点着色器渲染；同一套代码支撑了 NTT ICC 的“ヴァーチュアル初台”应用，并在点上做扫描线、过渡和体素化效果。
works.exercise_en: Scan a corridor with an iPhone LiDAR app, import the points into Unity and replay them in AR aligned to the real corridor, so the scan and the place overlap. Twist: let the points drift away wherever a person is standing.
works.exercise_zh: 用 iPhone 的 LiDAR 扫描应用扫一条走廊，把点云导入 Unity，再在 AR 中与真实走廊对齐回放，让扫描和实地重叠。变体：有人站着的地方，点云就飘散开。

video.video_title: Just uploaded a test project using point clouds in Unity to Github🚶 https://t.co/Jzb0uCriTH #madewithunity https://t.co/bcTGpXBoq5

works.title: Pokémon GO AR Mapping
works.description: Players scan PokéStops and Gyms with their camera during field research tasks, producing 3D scans that build Niantic's map for persistent, location-anchored AR.
works.idea_zh: 玩家扫描现实地标，众包建起一张供AR使用的三维世界地图。

video.video_title: Pokémon GO: AR Mapping Tasks

works.technique: Players capture short camera scans with pose data around landmarks, which are reconstructed into 3D maps used to build a visual positioning system.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Polycam 或 Scaniverse 扫描校园中的一个地标，把扫描模型放回 AR 与原物对齐；变体：全班扫描同一个地标，比较不同扫描路径的效果。
works.description_zh: 玩家在完成实地调查任务时用摄像头扫描宝可梦补给站和道馆，产出的三维扫描用来构建 Niantic 的地图，以实现持久且锚定于地点的 AR。
works.idea_en: Players scan real landmarks and crowdsource a 3D world map for AR.
works.technique_zh: 玩家围绕地标拍摄带位姿数据的简短摄像头扫描，这些扫描被重建为三维地图，用于构建视觉定位系统。
works.exercise_en: Scan a campus landmark with Polycam or Scaniverse and place the scanned model back in AR aligned with the original. Twist: have the whole class scan the same landmark and compare how different scanning paths turn out.

works.title: Procedural Ring Mesh VFX
works.description: Dark, spinning ring and disc effects are built from procedurally generated meshes with animated textures sliding across them.
works.description_zh: 由程序化生成的网格构成的暗色旋转圆环和圆盘特效，动态贴图在网格上滑过。
works.idea_en: Generate the effect's geometry in code, so its shape can be tuned like a parameter.
works.idea_zh: 用代码生成特效的几何体，形状就能像参数一样调节。
works.technique: A C# script builds ring, disc and cylinder meshes with tunable radius, segments and UV layout, and particle shaders scroll gradients and noise along the generated UVs.
works.technique_zh: 一个 C# 脚本生成半径、分段数和 UV 布局都可调的圆环、圆盘和圆柱网格，粒子着色器沿生成的 UV 滚动渐变和噪声。
works.exercise_en: Generate a ring mesh in code and use it as a portal rim on a detected AR wall. Twist: the ring's segment count drops as you walk away, turning it into a low-poly shape.
works.exercise_zh: 用代码生成一个圆环网格，把它作为检测到的 AR 墙面上的传送门边框。变体：走远时圆环的分段数减少，变成低多边形形状。

works.title: Project LFX: Steerable Projected Interfaces
works.description: A pan-and-tilt projector that moves projected interfaces around the room onto tables, walls and objects wherever they are needed.
works.idea_zh: 会转头的投影仪，把界面送到房间里任何表面。

video.video_title: Lightform announces Project LFX | Steerable Projected Interfaces

works.technique: Mounts a projector-camera on a motorized pan-tilt head and re-warps content in real time for each target surface in a scanned room model.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机投影仪放在可转动的台灯臂或旋转底座上，手动转动把一个“计时器界面”投到桌面、墙面、门上；变化：用舵机+Arduino让它自动跟随一个人。
works.description_zh: 一台可水平与俯仰转动的投影仪，能把投影界面移动到房间里需要的任何地方，投在桌面、墙面和物体上。
works.idea_en: A projector that turns its head to deliver interfaces onto any surface in the room.
works.technique_zh: 把投影仪-相机组安装在电动云台上，并根据扫描得到的房间模型，为每个目标表面实时重新变形投影内容。
works.exercise_en: Put a phone projector on a rotating desk-lamp arm or turntable and turn it by hand to project a timer interface onto the desk, the wall and the door. Twist: use a servo and Arduino to make it follow a person automatically.

works.title: Pulse Topology
works.description: Thousands of small light bulbs hang at different heights to form a landscape of peaks and valleys that visitors walk through, each bulb flickering with a recorded heartbeat.
works.description_zh: 数千颗小灯泡挂在不同高度，组成观众可以穿行其间的峰谷地形，每颗灯泡都随一段录下的心跳闪烁。
works.idea_en: Hanging data at different heights makes a walkable terrain of light; AR can let people walk through data landscapes at body scale.
works.idea_zh: 把数据挂在不同高度，就形成可步入的光之地形；AR 可以让人在身体尺度上穿行于数据景观中。
works.technique: Heart-rate sensors at the edges record visitors' pulses, which are distributed across about 3,000 bulbs suspended to a sculpted height map.
works.technique_zh: 场地边缘的心率传感器记录访客脉搏，这些脉搏被分配给约 3000 颗按雕塑化的高度图悬挂的灯泡。
works.exercise_en: Hang a field of virtual bulbs at heights from a terrain map across a room in AR and make each flicker to recorded taps; let viewers walk through at waist height. Twist: fill valleys with the newest data and raise older data into peaks.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中按地形图的高度把一片虚拟灯泡挂满房间，每颗随录下的敲击节奏闪烁，让观众在齐腰高度穿行。变体：最新数据填入山谷，旧数据被抬升成山峰。

video.video_title: Pulse Topology by Rafael Lozano-Hemmer | Lumiere 2023

salient.why_en: Thousands of bulbs each flicker with a recorded heartbeat, so you walk through a landscape of pulses.
salient.why_zh: 成千上万个灯泡各自随一段录下的心跳闪烁，人走在一片由脉搏组成的地形里。

works.title: ReWildAR
works.description: In the rotunda of the Smithsonian Arts and Industries Building, AR plants overgrow the historic hall, a meditation on invasive species and rewilding.
works.description_zh: 在史密森尼艺术与工业大楼的圆形大厅里，AR 植物爬满这座历史建筑，思考外来入侵物种与“再野化”。
works.idea_en: Let nature reclaim a monument to industry.
works.idea_zh: 让自然收复一座工业纪念建筑。
works.technique: Plant models are likely anchored to the rotunda's floor and columns with plane and image tracking in a mobile AR app, spreading over the architecture.
works.technique_zh: 植物模型很可能通过移动 AR 应用的平面与图像追踪，锚定在圆形大厅的地面和柱子上，并在建筑上蔓延。
works.exercise_en: Pick one invasive plant in your region and build an AR vine that climbs detected walls and floors in a hallway. Twist: users can 'weed' it by tapping, but it grows back somewhere else.
works.exercise_zh: 选一种你所在地区的入侵植物，做一株能沿着检测到的墙面和地面攀爬的 AR 藤蔓。变体：用户可以点击“除草”，但它会在别处重新长出来。

video.video_title: ReWildAR Smithsonian AIB Rotunda, 2021 (2:48)

works.title: Real World Splatoon (AR 100 Days, Day 39)
works.description: The user fires paint balls around the room and they splat onto the real walls, furniture and floor, following each surface's shape like the game Splatoon.
works.description_zh: 用户在房间里发射颜料球，它们溅在真实的墙壁、家具和地板上，像游戏 Splatoon 一样贴合每个表面的形状。
works.idea_en: Turn the scanned room into a paintable game surface.
works.idea_zh: 把扫描出的房间变成可以涂色的游戏表面。
works.technique: Projectiles collide with the live LiDAR scene mesh, and paint is likely written onto the reconstructed geometry rebuilt as custom SCNGeometry (which he studied the day before), so the paint wraps around real objects.
works.technique_zh: 弹丸与实时 LiDAR 场景网格碰撞，颜料很可能被写到用自定义 SCNGeometry 重建的几何上（他前一天刚研究过这个），因此颜料能包裹真实物体。
works.exercise_en: Reproduce the effect with AR Foundation meshing and decal projectors: tap to throw a ball, and leave a splat where it hits. Twist: two phones, two colors, and a timer to see who covers more of the room.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 网格重建和贴花投影器复现这个效果：点击抛出一个球，在命中处留下颜料斑。变体：两部手机、两种颜色，限时比赛谁覆盖的房间面积更大。

salient.why_en: Paint balls splat onto your real walls and furniture, as in Splatoon.
salient.why_zh: 像 Splatoon 一样，把颜料弹打在自己房间真实的墙面和家具上。

works.title: Realtime interactive football wall
works.description: A football is kicked against a wall covered with a projected grid of rectangles; the pattern reacts in real time wherever the ball hits.
works.description_zh: 一只足球被踢向投满矩形网格的墙面；球击中哪里，图案就在哪里实时作出反应。
works.idea_en: Any wall becomes a playable surface when the projector knows where the ball lands.
works.idea_zh: 只要投影仪知道球落在哪里，任何一面墙都能变成可以玩的界面。
works.technique: A camera or depth sensor detects the ball's impact point on the wall, which is mapped into projector coordinates to trigger changes in the generative grid (likely).
works.technique_zh: 摄像头或深度传感器检测球击中墙面的位置，并映射到投影坐标中，触发生成式网格的变化（推测）。
works.exercise_en: Project a grid onto a wall, detect ball hits with a webcam using frame differencing, and light up the hit cell. Twist: turn it into a two-player game where each player 'paints' cells in their own colour.
works.exercise_zh: 把网格投影到墙上，用摄像头帧差法检测球的击中点，并点亮被击中的格子；变体：做成双人游戏，每个玩家用自己的颜色“涂”格子。

video.video_title: Roelof Knol is a media artist and developer, mainly working with projection mapping to create visual or augmented reality interactive projected effects, like this realtime interactive football wall [s

works.title: Repairs
works.description: A mixed-reality installation where domestic objects on a shelving unit are 'repaired' by AR dancers, motion-captured performances by Freya Björg Olafson viewed on iPad.
works.description_zh: 一件混合现实装置：架子上的家用物件被 AR 舞者“修补”，舞者是 Freya Björg Olafson 的动作捕捉表演，用 iPad 观看。
works.idea_en: Virtual bodies tending to real, broken household things.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟的身体照料着真实而破损的家用物件。
works.technique: An iOS AR app anchors motion-captured dancers to physical objects on a formica shelf, likely using image or object tracking.
works.technique_zh: iOS AR 应用把动作捕捉的舞者锚定在福米卡贴面架子上的实物上，很可能使用图像或物体追踪。
works.exercise_en: Bring a broken object from home, scan or image-track it, and attach a tiny AR character that performs a 'repair' ritual on it. Twist: the ritual differs for each object's story.
works.exercise_zh: 从家里带来一件坏掉的物品，扫描或用图像追踪它，给它配一个小小的 AR 角色，在它身上完成一场“修补”仪式。变体：仪式根据每件物品的故事而不同。

video.video_title: Repairs Docu Video 1

works.title: Resize your present with a photo scan
works.description: A real gift is photo-scanned into a 3D model and re-imported into AR, where it can be scaled up or down.
works.idea_zh: 把真实礼物扫描成 3D 模型，再在 AR 里随意放大缩小。

video.video_title: Don’t like the size of your present? 🎁 Just photo scan it and then import it into AR. #webar #8thwall #aframe https://t.co/WP29By9Ir0

works.technique: Photogrammetry turns photos of a real object into a textured mesh, which is re-imported into AR and placed with hit test, with a pinch gesture mapped to uniform scale.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Polycam 或 Object Capture 扫描一件小物品，放回 AR 中用双指缩放到房间那么大；变体：放大后可以“走进”它的内部。
works.description_zh: 把一件真实礼物用照片扫描成三维模型，再导回 AR 中，就可以随意放大或缩小。
works.idea_en: Scan a real gift into a 3D model and scale it freely in AR.
works.technique_zh: 摄影测量把真实物体的照片转换为带纹理的网格，再导回 AR 中通过命中测试放置，并将双指捏合手势映射为等比缩放。
works.exercise_en: Scan a small object with Polycam or Object Capture, bring it back into AR and pinch to scale it up to the size of the room. Twist: once enlarged, you can walk inside it.

works.title: Rift
works.description: A full-body Snapchat Lens co-created by Don Allen Stevenson III and Paige Piskin: crystal shards burst from the wearer's shoulders and chest, the eyes glow white, and the scene shifts into a psychedelic colour palette.
works.description_zh: Don Allen Stevenson III 与 Paige Piskin 合作的全身 Snapchat Lens：水晶碎片从佩戴者的肩膀和胸口迸出，双眼发出白光，整个画面变成迷幻的配色。
works.idea_en: Two creators co-design one Lens that restyles the entire body, not just the face.
works.idea_zh: 两位创作者共同设计一个改造整个身体、而不只是脸的 Lens。
works.technique: Lens Studio full-body tracking and 3D body mesh attach rigged costume pieces and VFX to the user's skeleton.
works.technique_zh: 用 Lens Studio 的全身追踪和 3D 身体网格，把绑定好骨骼的服装部件和特效挂到用户的骨架上。
works.exercise_en: In pairs, design a full-body Lens where one partner makes the costume and the other makes the environment effect, then merge them. Twist: the costume must change when the wearer raises both arms.
works.exercise_zh: 两人一组设计一个全身 Lens：一人负责服装，一人负责环境特效，最后合并；变体：佩戴者举起双臂时服装必须发生变化。

video.video_title: DREAM IT BUILD IT: Rift with Don Allen Stevenson III & Paige Piskin

works.title: Robot arm follows a toio car
works.description: A small myCobot robot arm always turns to face a moving toio toy car without any computer vision, and simple AR collision effects burst when the cars meet.
works.description_zh: 一个小型 myCobot 机械臂始终转向正在移动的 toio 小车，完全不用计算机视觉；小车相撞时还会出现简单的 AR 碰撞特效。
works.idea_en: Let robots and tiny toy cars share one coordinate system so AR effects can join the physical play.
works.idea_zh: 让机械臂和小玩具车共享同一个坐标系，使 AR 特效能加入实体游戏。
works.technique: toio cars report their absolute position from the printed mat, which is sent over Wi-Fi to the arm's board so it computes the facing angle, while an AR layer uses the same positions for collision effects.
works.technique_zh: toio 小车通过印刷底垫读出绝对位置，经 Wi-Fi 发给机械臂的控制板计算朝向角，AR 图层也用这些位置来触发碰撞特效。
works.exercise_en: Use a toio, a robot vacuum or a phone on wheels as a tracked object and make a phone-AR effect follow it. Twist: the effect should predict where it will be in one second.
works.exercise_zh: 用 toio、扫地机器人或装在小车上的手机作为被追踪物体，让手机 AR 特效跟随它。变体：特效要预测它一秒后的位置。

video.video_title: Got a robot arm from MyCobot, pretty lightweight and easy to develop. Made a small demo of robot always facing the toio car with no CV tracking, and added some simple AR collision effect. More fun exp

works.title: Screen-Space Outlines
works.description: A stylised 3D scene gains crisp, even ink outlines around objects and creases, and the devlog walks through how they are detected.
works.description_zh: 一个风格化三维场景的物体轮廓和折痕上出现了清晰均匀的墨线，开发日志讲解了这些线是如何检测出来的。
works.idea_en: Edges found in depth and normals turn any render into an illustration.
works.idea_zh: 从深度和法线中找到的边缘，能把任何渲染画面变成插画。
works.technique: A URP renderer feature renders view-space normals and depth, then a full-screen pass runs Roberts-cross style edge detection on both and composites dark lines where the differences exceed thresholds.
works.technique_zh: 一个 URP 渲染功能先渲染视空间法线和深度，再用全屏 pass 对两者做 Roberts 交叉式的边缘检测，差异超过阈值的地方叠加深色线条。
works.exercise_en: Apply the outline renderer feature to virtual objects in an AR Foundation scene and also feed LiDAR depth so real furniture gets inked too, making the room look like a comic panel. Twist: vary line thickness with distance to the user.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 场景里给虚拟物体加上描边渲染功能，同时输入 LiDAR 深度，让真实家具也被描线，整个房间像一格漫画。变体：让线条粗细随与用户的距离变化。

video.video_title: Outlines - Devlog 2

works.title: Seeing the Invisible
works.description: An exhibition of thirteen AR artworks by artists such as Ai Weiwei, El Anatsui, Refik Anadol and Sigalit Landau, installed at the same time in botanical gardens around the world and viewed through one phone app while walking the grounds.
works.description_zh: 一场由十三件 AR 作品组成的展览，艺术家包括 Ai Weiwei、El Anatsui、Refik Anadol、Sigalit Landau 等；作品同时安放在全球多座植物园里，观众在园中漫步，用同一个手机应用观看。
works.idea_en: One exhibition that exists in many gardens at once, visible only through a phone.
works.idea_zh: 一场同时存在于多座花园、只能用手机看见的展览。
works.technique: Each artwork is geolocated to a spot in every participating garden and anchored with markerless phone AR, so visitors find the pieces by walking a route.
works.technique_zh: 每件作品都被定位到每座参展花园中的某个地点，并通过无标记手机 AR 锚定，观众沿着路线行走来寻找作品。
works.exercise_en: Have each student make one small AR piece in Lens Studio or WebXR about something invisible on campus (wind, noise, history) and place all of them along a walking route. Twist: install the same show in a second location and compare how the site changes each piece.
works.exercise_zh: 请每位同学用 Lens Studio 或 WebXR 做一件关于校园中某种看不见之物（风、噪声、历史）的小型 AR 作品，把它们沿一条步行路线放置；变体：在第二个地点布置同样的展览，比较场地如何改变每件作品。

video.video_title: Seeing The Invisible

works.title: SelfieBarracuda: virtual background on phones
works.description: A person is cut out from their surroundings in real time and placed on a new background, running smoothly on an iPhone X and a Pixel 5.
works.description_zh: 人被实时从环境中抠出来，放到新背景上，在 iPhone X 和 Pixel 5 上都运行流畅。
works.idea_en: Segmentation separates the person from the world, and each can get its own effect.
works.idea_zh: 分割把人和世界分开，两者可以各自加特效。
works.technique: The MediaPipe Selfie segmentation model runs on Barracuda on the GPU and outputs a person mask used to composite the camera image over another background.
works.technique_zh: MediaPipe Selfie 分割模型通过 Barracuda 在 GPU 上运行，输出人像遮罩，用来把相机画面合成到另一个背景上。
works.exercise_en: Use a segmentation mask in AR Foundation to replace everything except people with a VFX Graph world. Twist: the background world reacts to how much space the person fills.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中用分割遮罩把人以外的一切换成 VFX Graph 世界。变体：背景世界随人在画面中占的面积而变化。

video.video_title: Testing the virtual background sample (Unity Barracuda & MediaPipe Selfie segmentation) on iPhone X and Pixel 5. It runs smoothly on both of them. https://t.co/TlYBWgHhv3 https://t.co/3JV1LhU2lX

works.title: Shaderworlds
works.description: Raymarched Shadertoy landscapes such as clouds and entangled vines surround the viewer in a VR headset, opened simply from a web page; the controllers move the sun and vines.
works.description_zh: 云海、缠绕的藤蔓等光线步进的 Shadertoy 景观在 VR 头显中包围观众，只需打开一个网页即可进入；手柄可以移动太阳和藤蔓。
works.idea_en: A fragment shader is already a world; WebXR just lets you stand inside it.
works.idea_zh: 一个片元着色器本身就是一个世界，WebXR 只是让你站进去。
works.technique: three.js renders a raymarching shader per eye, likely rebuilding each ray from the WebXR view and projection matrices so the SDF scene has correct stereo depth; controller poses are passed in as shader uniforms.
works.technique_zh: three.js 为每只眼渲染光线步进着色器，很可能根据 WebXR 的视图和投影矩阵重建每条光线，使 SDF 场景具有正确的立体深度；手柄位姿作为着色器 uniform 传入。
works.exercise_en: Port one Shadertoy SDF scene into the Shaderworlds template and switch the session to immersive-ar so it renders only inside a sphere in the room. Twist: map a hand controller to a parameter of the SDF.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个 Shadertoy 的 SDF 场景移植到 Shaderworlds 模板中，并把会话切换为 immersive-ar，让它只在房间中的一个球体内渲染。变体：把手柄映射到 SDF 的某个参数上。

video.video_title: Shaderworlds.com

works.title: Siren Songs
works.description: An animated, immersive AR public artwork for Elevation 1049 in Gstaad and St. Moritz: drawn forms float in the Alpine landscape with a sung soundtrack.
works.idea_zh: 阿尔卑斯山间会唱歌的AR声音雕塑

video.video_title: Nancy Baker Cahill on the genesis of 'Siren Songs'

works.technique: Geolocated, large-scale animated drawings are anchored in open landscape with a synced spatial soundtrack, using GPS and compass for placement at distance.
works.exercise_zh: 选一处开阔景观，用 WebAR 放置随歌声起伏的漂浮线条，并录一段自己的哼唱作为声轨；变体：让线条形态由声音频谱实时生成。
works.description_zh: 为格施塔德和圣莫里茨的 Elevation 1049 创作的沉浸式 AR 动画公共艺术：手绘形态漂浮在阿尔卑斯山景中，伴随着一段歌声配乐。
works.idea_en: Singing AR sound sculptures among the Alps.
works.technique_zh: 带地理定位的大尺度绘画动画锚定在开阔景观中，配有同步的空间音轨，并借助 GPS 和指南针实现远距离放置。
works.exercise_en: Choose an open landscape and use WebAR to place floating lines that rise and fall with a song, recording your own humming as the soundtrack. Twist: generate the shape of the lines in real time from the sound spectrum.

works.title: Sleepwalking in the Forbidden City
works.description: In this VR work made with HTC VIVE Arts, the viewer floats through a dreamlike Forbidden City at night while fireworks and gunpowder explosions bloom around the palace roofs.
works.description_zh: 这件与 HTC VIVE Arts 合作的 VR 作品中，观众在梦境般的夜晚紫禁城中漂浮，烟火和火药爆炸在宫殿屋顶周围绽放。
works.idea_en: Virtual space lets an artist do the fireworks that are forbidden in reality; AR and VR can stage impossible events in sensitive places without touching them.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟空间能让艺术家完成现实中被禁止的烟火；AR 和 VR 可以在敏感场所上演不可能的事件，而不触碰实物。
works.technique: Likely a real-time VR scene built from 3D scans and models of the palace, with particle-based firework simulations and a guided floating camera path.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是一个实时 VR 场景：用宫殿的三维扫描和模型搭建，加上基于粒子的烟火模拟和一条引导式的漂浮镜头路径。
works.exercise_en: Scan a small landmark on campus with a photogrammetry app, place the model in a WebXR scene and let viewers trigger fireworks from its roof that would never be allowed in real life. Twist: switch to passthrough AR so the virtual fireworks explode above the real landmark.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄影测量应用扫描校园里一个小地标，把模型放进 WebXR 场景，让观众从它的屋顶放出现实中绝不允许的烟火。变体：切换到透视 AR，让虚拟烟火在真实地标上空炸开。

video.video_title: Trailer| Cai Guo-Qiang "Sleepwalking in the Forbidden City", Museum of Art Pudong, Shanghai

works.title: Sonic Bloom
works.description: A cluster of colourful horn-shaped structures in a London street captures and carries voices, so strangers can talk and listen to each other across the sculpture while city and nature sounds mix in.
works.description_zh: 伦敦街头的一组彩色号角形结构，能收集并传送人声，让陌生人隔着雕塑彼此交谈、聆听，同时混入城市和自然的声音。
works.idea_en: Horns that let strangers talk to each other across a street.
works.idea_zh: 让陌生人隔着街道彼此交谈的号角。
works.technique: Acoustic horns and pipes physically channel sound between listening points, likely combined with amplified ambient recordings.
works.technique_zh: 声学号角和管道在各个聆听点之间物理地传导声音，推测还结合了经过放大的环境录音。
works.exercise_en: Build two cardboard or plastic tube horns connected by a garden hose so two students can whisper across a room, then map the best listening spots. Twist: add a third horn that only plays birdsong.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸板或塑料做两只号角，用花园水管连接，让两位同学隔着房间悄悄说话，再标出最佳聆听位置；变体：加第三只号角，只播放鸟鸣。

video.video_title: SonicBloom_YuriSuzuki_AlterProjects_H264_FinalFilm-VideoCredit_AlbertoBalazs.mov

works.title: Sound Bubbles
works.description: An Everyday Experiment by sound designer Yuri Suzuki: spatial audio creates zones of privacy in a shared home, bubbles of silence where one person can take a call while others keep making noise.
works.description_zh: 声音设计师 Yuri Suzuki 为 Everyday Experiments 做的实验：用空间音频在共享的家中制造隐私区域，形成一个个“静音气泡”，让一个人能打电话，而其他人照常制造噪音。
works.idea_en: Use sound to create silence.
works.idea_zh: 用声音制造安静。
works.technique: Likely directional speakers and noise masking, coordinated through IoT devices, shape the sound field around a listener's position.
works.technique_zh: 很可能通过物联网设备协调定向扬声器和噪声掩蔽，在聆听者所在位置周围塑造声场。
works.exercise_en: Place a virtual 'quiet bubble' in phone AR; when a person stands inside it, lower the volume of music playing from other phones in the room. Twist: bubbles can be passed from person to person.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中放置一个虚拟“安静气泡”；当有人站进去时，降低房间里其他手机播放音乐的音量。变体：气泡可以在人与人之间传递。

video.video_title: Everyday Experiments — Sound Bubbles by Yuri Suzuki | STIRpad

works.title: SoundsRide
works.description: While driving, the car's music is remixed live so that musical highlights land exactly on moments along the route, like the car bursting out of a tunnel or merging onto the highway.
works.description_zh: 开车时，车里的音乐被实时重新混音，让乐曲的高潮正好落在路线上的时刻，比如汽车冲出隧道或驶上高速公路的那一刻。
works.idea_en: Score a car ride like a film, timing the music's drops to the road.
works.idea_zh: 像给电影配乐一样给一段车程配乐，让音乐的爆点对上道路。
works.technique: The system predicts arrival times at route affordances (tunnel exits, highway entrances) from navigation data and rearranges and time-stretches music segments so high-contrast musical events align with them.
works.technique_zh: 系统根据导航数据预测到达隧道出口、高速入口等路线节点的时间，并对音乐片段重新编排和时间伸缩，让音乐里反差强烈的段落与之对齐。
works.exercise_en: Write a web app that uses GPS and a list of landmarks on a walking route to fire a music drop exactly as you turn a corner or pass a gate. Twist: every walker on the route hears a different track synced to the same moments.
works.exercise_zh: 写一个网页应用，利用 GPS 和步行路线上的地标列表，在你转过街角或穿过大门的那一刻触发音乐的爆点。变体：同一路线上的每位行人听到不同的曲子，但都和同样的时刻同步。

video.video_title: SoundsRide: Affordance-Synchronized Music Mixing for In-Car Audio Augmented Reality

works.title: Space Distortion (AR 100 Days, Day 2)
works.description: A patch of the room seen through the phone warps and ripples as if the air itself were bending.
works.description_zh: 手机里看到的一块房间空间发生扭曲和波动，仿佛空气本身在弯曲。
works.idea_en: Bend the camera image locally so reality looks like it has a lens in it.
works.idea_zh: 对摄像头画面做局部扭曲，让现实看起来像被嵌进了一块透镜。
works.technique: Likely a Metal shader that offsets the UV coordinates of the captured ARKit camera image inside a region anchored in the scene, producing a refraction-like distortion.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是 Metal 着色器在场景中锚定的区域内偏移 ARKit 摄像头画面的 UV 坐标，产生类似折射的扭曲。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a sphere in AR and distort only the camera pixels behind it with an animated noise offset. Twist: make the distortion strength follow microphone volume.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中锚定一个球体，只对它背后的摄像头像素施加动态噪声偏移。变体：让扭曲强度跟随麦克风音量。

video.video_title:
100日間 AR表現を作るチャレンジ Day2

works.title: Space Voxels (AR 100 Days, Day 20)
works.description: Where the user drags a finger across the screen, cubes appear on the real surfaces, each colored with the camera color of the spot it covers, turning the room into voxels.
works.description_zh: 用户手指在屏幕上划过的地方，真实表面上会长出一个个方块，每个方块都取所覆盖位置的摄像头颜色，把房间变成体素。
works.idea_en: Paint the room into voxels that borrow their color from reality.
works.idea_zh: 把房间画成体素，颜色直接借自现实。
works.technique: Touch points are raycast against the LiDAR scene reconstruction, and a voxel is placed at each hit with its color sampled from the captured camera image at that pixel.
works.technique_zh: 把触摸点对 LiDAR 场景重建做射线检测，在每个命中点放置一个体素，颜色取自该像素处的摄像头图像。
works.exercise_en: Build the voxel brush with AR Foundation meshing on a LiDAR phone and let the class fill a corner of the room together. Twist: snap voxels to a coarse grid so the space turns into a Minecraft version of itself.
works.exercise_zh: 在带 LiDAR 的手机上用 AR Foundation 网格重建实现体素画笔，让全班一起把房间一角填满。变体：把体素吸附到粗网格上，让空间变成它自己的 Minecraft 版本。

works.title: Starry Interpose (with Sarah Slifer Swift)
works.description: A dance performance at the Manship Artists Residency in which live choreography interacts with Pappenheimer's AR artwork and poses from Paul Manship's sculptures.
works.idea_zh: 舞者与AR作品和雕塑姿态一起完成一场混合现实舞蹈
works.technique: Mobile AR content is placed at the performance site and filmed through devices while dancers enact sculpture poses around the virtual objects.
works.exercise_zh: 选校园一座雕塑，模仿它的姿势编一段舞，用手机AR在旁边放置虚拟元素一起拍摄；变化：观众手机里看到的虚拟元素会“复制”舞者动作。

video.video_title: Starry Interpose - Will Pappenheimer & Sarah Slifer Swift

works.description_zh: 在 Manship 艺术家驻留地上演的一场舞蹈表演：现场编舞与 Pappenheimer 的 AR 作品以及 Paul Manship 雕塑中的姿态相互呼应。
works.idea_en: Dancers perform a mixed-reality dance together with AR artworks and sculpture poses.
works.technique_zh: 在演出场地放置手机 AR 内容，并通过设备拍摄，舞者则在虚拟物体周围演绎雕塑姿态。
works.exercise_en: Pick a sculpture on campus, choreograph a dance that imitates its pose, and film it with virtual elements placed beside it in phone AR. Twist: the virtual elements on the audience's phones copy the dancers' movements.

works.title: Stealth Updates
works.description: Visual content changes in front of the viewer without being noticed, by morphing images gradually and timing changes to exploit change blindness.
works.idea_zh: 利用“变化盲视”，让画面在你眼前改变却察觉不到。

video.video_title: Stealth Updates [SAP 2021]

works.technique: Computes a smooth image morph between old and new content and plays it slowly enough to stay below the threshold of noticed change.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR把一张海报上的元素用30秒慢慢变换成另一张图，让同学盯着看并报告是否发现变化；变化：在对方眨眼或转头时再快速切换。
works.description_zh: 通过逐渐变形图像，并利用变化盲视安排变化的时机，让视觉内容在观者眼前改变而不被察觉。
works.idea_en: Use change blindness to alter an image right before your eyes without you noticing.
works.technique_zh: 在旧内容与新内容之间计算平滑的图像变形，并以足够慢的速度播放，使其低于可察觉变化的阈值。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR to slowly morph an element of a poster into another image over 30 seconds, have classmates stare at it and report whether they notice the change. Twist: switch quickly when the viewer blinks or turns their head.

works.title: Stencil Portal Halloween Scene
works.description: A small frame shows a spooky Halloween world inside it; as the camera moves, the hidden scene appears only through the portal opening.
works.description_zh: 一个小画框里藏着一个阴森的万圣节世界；镜头移动时，隐藏的场景只在传送门开口里出现。
works.idea_en: A doorway can hold a whole world that exists only when you look through it.
works.idea_zh: 一扇门里可以装下一个只有透过它才存在的世界。
works.technique: The portal mask writes a value into the stencil buffer, and the hidden scene's shaders only draw where the stencil matches.
works.technique_zh: 传送门遮罩向模板缓冲写入一个值，隐藏场景的着色器只在模板值匹配的地方绘制。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a stencil portal to a real door or picture frame with AR Foundation image tracking so a different world appears inside it. Twist: the world behind the portal changes with the time of day.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 图像追踪把模板传送门锚定到真实的门或画框上，让里面出现另一个世界。变体：传送门后的世界随一天中的时间变化。

video.video_title: Stencil Buffer in Unity - Halloween VFX Scene

works.title: Strandbeest Evolution 2021
works.description: Jansen's annual report: every spring he takes a new beast to the beach, tests it against wind, sand and water all summer, and in autumn declares it extinct and moves it to the 'bone yard'.
works.description_zh: Jansen 的年度报告：每年春天他带一只新生物去海滩，整个夏天在风、沙和水中测试它，秋天宣布它“灭绝”，把它送进“骨场”。
works.idea_en: Treating each version as a species with a life cycle turns iteration into narrative, a way to present AR prototypes as a lineage.
works.idea_zh: 把每个版本当作有生命周期的物种，把迭代变成了叙事，这是把 AR 原型呈现为一条谱系的方法。
works.technique: New leg mechanisms, sails and air-storage systems are built each year and tested on the beach with live wind.
works.technique_zh: 每年制作新的腿部机构、风帆和储气系统，并在海滩上用真实的风测试。
works.exercise_en: Show all versions of your semester's AR prototype side by side as a 'museum of extinct species' in one AR scene. Twist: each prototype has a label with its birth date, cause of extinction and descendant.
works.exercise_zh: 在一个 AR 场景中把本学期 AR 原型的所有版本并排展示为“灭绝物种博物馆”；变体：每个原型都有标签，写明诞生日期、灭绝原因和后代。

video.video_title: STRANDBEEST EVOLUTION 2021

works.title: Subway PONG
works.description: A playful AR glasses experiment: a game of Pong played across a real subway carriage with fellow passengers.
works.idea_zh: 在地铁车厢里用AR眼镜打乒乓

video.video_title: Subway PONG

works.technique: Likely Spectacles world tracking with a shared or co-located session places a Pong field across the carriage, with head or hand pose controlling the paddle.
works.exercise_zh: 用两台手机在同一 AR 空间中做一个跨越房间的 Pong 游戏，用手机位置当球拍；变体：把球场设在一个公共场所（电梯、走廊），规则要求不认识的人合作。
works.description_zh: 一个充满玩心的 AR 眼镜实验：和同车乘客在真实的地铁车厢里横跨车厢打一局 Pong。
works.idea_en: Play Pong with AR glasses in a subway car.
works.technique_zh: 大概率利用 Spectacles 的世界追踪，配合共享或同处一地的会话，在车厢里铺设一块横跨车厢的 Pong 场地，由头部或手部位姿控制球拍。
works.exercise_en: Use two phones in the same AR space to build a room-spanning Pong game, with each phone's position acting as the paddle. Twist: set the court in a public place such as an elevator or corridor, with rules that require strangers to cooperate.

works.title: SushiVfx: vaporizing a sushi
works.description: A photoscanned piece of sushi dissolves into a cloud of colored particles and reassembles.
works.description_zh: 一块扫描得到的寿司散成一团彩色粒子，又重新组合。
works.idea_en: Real food, scanned, becomes a playful effect.
works.idea_zh: 把真实食物扫描下来，就能变成有趣的特效。
works.technique: VFX Graph samples positions and colors from the scanned mesh surface, and particles are pushed off by noise and pulled back to their original points.
works.technique_zh: VFX Graph 从扫描网格表面采样位置和颜色，粒子被噪声推开，再被拉回原来的位置。
works.exercise_en: Scan a snack with Polycam, make it vaporize into particles, and place it on the real plate with AR Foundation. Twist: it vaporizes when you bring a real fork close.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Polycam 扫描一块零食，让它散成粒子，再用 AR Foundation 放在真实盘子上。变体：真的叉子靠近时它就散开。

video.video_title: Vaporizing a sushi using mesh sampling https://t.co/n6CdVlK2ra

works.title: The Changing Same
works.description: An episodic VR experience in which the participant travels through non-linear time and space to witness connected moments of racial injustice in the United States.
works.description_zh: 一部分集 VR 体验：参与者在非线性的时间与空间中穿行，见证美国种族不公的一系列相互关联的历史时刻。
works.idea_en: Time travel through one place to show that history repeats in cycles.
works.idea_zh: 在同一个地点穿越时间，展示历史如何循环往复。
works.technique: Volumetric performances captured with Depthkit are staged in Unity environments that transform between eras around the participant.
works.technique_zh: 用 Depthkit 捕捉的体积表演被安排在 Unity 环境中，环境围绕参与者在不同时代之间变换。
works.exercise_en: Choose one spot on campus and build a phone AR piece that shows three photos from different decades at the exact same viewpoint. Twist: make the transition happen when the viewer steps forward.
works.exercise_zh: 选校园里的一个地点，做一个手机 AR 作品，在完全相同的视角展示三个不同年代的照片。变体：让观众向前迈一步时触发切换。

video.video_title: The Changing Same: An American Pilgrimage | VR Experience |   Episode 1 The Dilemma  | Trailer

works.title: The Intergalactic Hanseatic League
works.description: A month-long sci-fi time-travel adventure across King's Lynn town centre and online, with projected transmissions on historic buildings telling a climate story co-created with local children.
works.description_zh: 一场持续一个月、横跨金斯林市中心与线上的科幻时空旅行冒险，投影在历史建筑上的“星际来电”讲述一个与当地孩子共创的气候故事。
works.idea_en: Historic buildings receive messages from the future about the town's climate.
works.idea_zh: 历史建筑收到来自未来、关于这座小镇气候的讯息。
works.technique: Large-format projection mapping on town-centre facades plays episodic 'transmissions', linked to online content and school workshops in which children wrote the story.
works.technique_zh: 在市中心建筑立面上进行大幅投影映射，按集播放“星际来电”，并与线上内容和孩子们编写故事的学校工作坊相连。
works.exercise_en: Write a one-minute 'message from 2100' about your street and project it onto the school building after dark with a borrowed projector. Twist: the message must refer to a real detail of the wall it is projected on.
works.exercise_zh: 写一段关于你们街道的一分钟“来自 2100 年的讯息”，天黑后用借来的投影仪投到校舍上；变体：讯息必须提到被投墙面上的一个真实细节。

video.video_title: Collusion Presents // THE INTERGALACTIC HANSEATIC LEAGUE - documentary

works.title: The Looking Glass: Darren Bader
works.description: Darren Bader's surreal AR sculptures on The Shed's plaza use humour to question art and contemporary life, visible through the Acute Art app.
works.idea_zh: 把荒诞幽默的AR雕塑放进城市广场，追问“什么是艺术”
works.technique: Mobile AR anchors absurd 3D object combinations at fixed plaza locations via the Acute Art app.
works.exercise_zh: 把两件毫不相干的日常物体组合成一个AR“雕塑”放在校园里并起标题；变化：让观众投票选出最荒诞的组合，下周替换。

video.video_title: Darren Bader on Love and Freedom in AR | "The Looking Glass" exhibition now at The Shed

works.description_zh: Darren Bader 在 The Shed 广场上的超现实 AR 雕塑以幽默的方式追问艺术与当代生活，观众可通过 Acute Art 应用观看。
works.idea_en: Place absurd, funny AR sculptures in a city plaza to ask what counts as art.
works.technique_zh: 手机 AR 通过 Acute Art 应用，将荒诞的三维物体组合锚定在广场上的固定位置。
works.exercise_en: Combine two unrelated everyday objects into an AR sculpture, place it on campus and give it a title. Twist: let viewers vote for the most absurd combination and swap it in next week.

works.title: The Looking Glass: Precious Okoyomon
works.description: On The Shed's public plaza and the High Line, Precious Okoyomon's AR works — creatures and nature-based forms — appear through the Acute Art app as part of the group show The Looking Glass.
works.idea_zh: 在城市广场上用AR召唤出关于自然与身份的柔软生物
works.technique: Site-specific AR placement in the Acute Art app anchors animated 3D sculptures to geolocated spots on the plaza.
works.exercise_zh: 为校园广场设计一个表达“自然回归”的AR生物，并决定它只出现在哪一块具体的地面上；变化：它会随一天中的时间改变颜色。

video.video_title: Precious Okoyomon on Revealing a Whole New Reality | "The Looking Glass" exhibition now at The Shed

works.description_zh: 在 The Shed 的公共广场和高线公园（High Line）上，Precious Okoyomon 的 AR 作品——各种生物和取材自然的形态——通过 Acute Art 应用出现，作为群展 The Looking Glass 的一部分。
works.idea_en: Summon soft creatures about nature and identity into a city plaza with AR.
works.technique_zh: Acute Art 应用中针对场地的 AR 放置功能，把三维动画雕塑锚定在广场上带地理坐标的特定位置。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR creature for a campus plaza that expresses the return of nature, and decide the exact patch of ground where it alone appears. Twist: it changes color with the time of day.

works.title: The Looking Glass: Tomás Saraceno (spiders in AR)
works.description: Tomás Saraceno's AR spiders crawl across The Shed's plaza, part of his project to make spiders and their webs part of our lives and rethink our relationship with other species.
works.idea_zh: 让AR蜘蛛在城市里爬行，重新思考人与其他物种的关系
works.technique: Scanned/animated spider models are placed with plane detection in the Acute Art app so they crawl on real ground surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 用Reality Composer或Adobe Aero放一只会沿地面爬行的AR昆虫，并写一句它的“视角”说明；变化：昆虫会避开观众的手机靠近。

video.video_title: Tomás Saraceno on Making Spiders Part of Our Lives  | "The Looking Glass" exhibition now at The Shed

works.description_zh: Tomás Saraceno 的 AR 蜘蛛在 The Shed 广场上爬行，这是他的一个项目的一部分：让蜘蛛和蛛网融入我们的生活，重新思考人与其他物种的关系。
works.idea_en: Let AR spiders crawl through the city to rethink how we relate to other species.
works.technique_zh: 在 Acute Art 应用中通过平面检测放置经扫描或制作动画的蜘蛛模型，使其在真实地面上爬行。
works.exercise_en: Use Reality Composer or Adobe Aero to place an AR insect that crawls along the ground, and write one line describing its point of view. Twist: the insect scurries away when a viewer's phone comes close.

works.title: The Multitude
works.description: A 20-minute playable story for two people who see projections of their own bodies and must use them to win over four elemental spirits of nature, some of whom are not impressed with humanity.
works.description_zh: 一个 20 分钟、供两人游玩的故事：玩家看到自己身体的投影，必须用身体去说服四位自然元素精灵，其中一些对人类的所作所为并不满意。
works.idea_en: Your projected body is the game controller in a quest to save nature.
works.idea_zh: 你被投影出的身体就是拯救自然之旅的游戏手柄。
works.technique: A depth or body-tracking camera turns the two players' silhouettes into projected characters that trigger story events when they reach, pose or cooperate (developed by Jamie Gledhill; likely Kinect with a game engine).
works.technique_zh: 深度或人体追踪摄像头把两位玩家的剪影变成投影角色，当他们伸手、摆姿势或协作时触发剧情（由 Jamie Gledhill 开发；很可能是 Kinect 加游戏引擎）。
works.exercise_en: Make a two-player shadow game: project each player's webcam silhouette in a different colour and ask them to overlap to 'unlock' a sound. Twist: one spirit only responds if the players move very slowly.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个双人影子游戏：把每位玩家的摄像头剪影用不同颜色投出来，要求两人的影子重叠才能“解锁”一个声音；变体：有一位精灵只在玩家动作非常缓慢时才回应。

video.video_title: Collusion presents // The Multitude by Jamie Gledhill

works.title: TinyYOLOv2 object detection in Unity
works.description: A live video shows people, cars and other objects outlined with labeled boxes, detected by a neural network inside Unity.
works.description_zh: 实时视频里的人、车和其他物体被神经网络识别出来，框上带标签的方框，全部在 Unity 里运行。
works.idea_en: Let the engine know what it is looking at.
works.idea_zh: 让引擎知道自己在看什么。
works.technique: The Tiny YOLOv2 ONNX model runs on Barracuda on the GPU; a compute shader decodes the output grid into boxes and removes overlaps before drawing.
works.technique_zh: Tiny YOLOv2 ONNX 模型在 GPU 上通过 Barracuda 运行，计算着色器把输出网格解码成方框并去除重叠后再绘制。
works.exercise_en: Run an object detector on the AR Foundation camera feed and spawn a VFX Graph effect on every detected cup or person. Twist: each class gets its own effect.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 相机画面上运行目标检测，在每个识别到的杯子或人身上生成 VFX Graph 特效。变体：每个类别对应一种特效。

video.video_title: Making a simple Tiny YOLOv2 object detector example with Unity Barracuda https://t.co/vYrx8iQ3AZ https://t.co/vu6RLlD2WD

works.title: Touch&Fold
works.description: A nail-mounted actuator unfolds a small pad onto the fingertip only when touching virtual objects, and folds away so the finger can feel real objects normally.
works.idea_zh: 指尖触觉器需要时展开、不需要时收起，虚实都能摸。

video.video_title: Touch&Fold: A Foldable Haptic Actuator for Rendering Touch in Mixed Reality

works.technique: Mounts a servo-driven folding tactor on the fingernail that rotates onto the pad for virtual contact and retracts for real-world touch.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个指套纸片装置：碰到手机AR中的虚拟物体时由同伴翻下纸片到指腹，碰真实物体时翻起；变化：纸片换成不同材质代表不同虚拟物。
works.description_zh: 一个装在指甲上的驱动器只在触碰虚拟物体时把小垫片展开到指尖，其余时候收起，让手指仍能正常感受真实物体。
works.idea_en: A fingertip haptic device folds out when needed and tucks away when not, so you can feel both virtual and real things.
works.technique_zh: 在指甲上安装一个由舵机驱动的折叠式触觉单元：接触虚拟物体时它转到指腹上，触摸真实物体时则收回。
works.exercise_en: Make a paper finger-flap device: when you touch a virtual object in phone AR, a partner flips the paper down onto your fingerpad, and flips it up when you touch a real object. Twist: swap the paper for different materials to stand for different virtual objects.

works.title: TransforMR
works.description: Pointing a tablet at a street, passers-by are replaced by animated creatures that copy their poses, cars become other vehicles and landmarks are swapped, composing an alternate reality from whatever happens to be in view.
works.description_zh: 把平板对准街道，路人被替换成模仿他们姿势的动画生物，汽车变成别的交通工具，地标也被置换，用眼前恰好出现的一切拼出另一个现实。
works.idea_en: Keep reality's motion but swap every object for something from another world.
works.idea_zh: 保留现实中的运动，却把每个物体换成另一个世界的东西。
works.technique: Semantic segmentation and 3D pose estimation find people and objects, inpainting removes them from the video, and pose-matched virtual substitutes are rendered in their place in real time with a server backend.
works.technique_zh: 语义分割和三维姿态估计识别出人和物体，图像修补把它们从视频中抹去，再借助服务器后端实时渲染姿态匹配的虚拟替身取而代之。
works.exercise_en: Use a body-tracking AR template (Lens Studio or ARKit) to replace each passer-by with a 3D character that mirrors their skeleton, and film a street corner. Twist: choose the substitute by how fast each person walks.
works.exercise_zh: 用身体追踪 AR 模板（Lens Studio 或 ARKit）把每个路人替换成跟随其骨骼动作的三维角色，然后拍一段街角。变体：根据每个人走路的快慢选择不同的替身。

video.video_title: TransforMR: Pose-Aware Object Substitution for Composing Alternate Mixed Realities (ISMAR '21)

works.title: URP Screen Space Cavity
works.description: Low-poly scenes gain crisp white ridges and dark creases, the Blender viewport 'cavity' look, applied to the whole camera image in Unity.
works.description_zh: 低多边形场景出现清晰的白色棱线和深色凹缝，也就是 Blender 视口里的 Cavity 效果，在 Unity 中作用于整个相机画面。
works.idea_en: Emphasise geometry by drawing its curvature, the way an illustrator inks edges.
works.idea_zh: 通过画出曲率来强调几何形体，就像插画师给边缘勾墨线一样。
works.technique: A URP renderer feature reads screen-space normals and depth, estimates curvature (ridges and valleys) and a cavity term by sampling neighbours, and composites light and dark accents into the lit image.
works.technique_zh: 一个 URP 渲染器功能读取屏幕空间法线和深度，通过采样相邻像素估算曲率（凸棱与凹谷）和 Cavity 项，再把亮暗强调叠加到光照后的画面上。
works.exercise_en: Add a cavity pass to virtual objects in an AR scene so their edges stay readable against the busy camera background. Twist: apply it to the LiDAR room mesh too and draw the real room like a sketch.
works.exercise_zh: 给 AR 场景中的虚拟物体加上 Cavity 通道，让它们的边缘在杂乱的相机背景前依然清晰。变体：也把它应用到 LiDAR 房间网格上，把真实房间画成素描。

video.video_title:
I decided to share my Cavity solution for Unity. You can find it here - https://t.co/JyWE9WRt4r

#Unity #unity3d #cavity #blender #Blender3d #shader https://t.co/MRsUI9SRyo

works.title: UltraFace: realtime emoji face overlay
works.description: Every face in a video, even in a crowd, is covered with an emoji that follows it in real time.
works.description_zh: 视频中的每张脸，即使在人群里，都被一个 emoji 实时盖住并跟随。
works.idea_en: Face detection plus a sticker is the simplest face filter.
works.idea_zh: 人脸检测加一张贴纸，就是最简单的面部滤镜。
works.technique: The lightweight UltraFace detector runs on Barracuda; its bounding boxes position emoji sprites over each detected face.
works.technique_zh: 轻量的 UltraFace 检测器在 Barracuda 上运行，用检测到的方框确定每张脸上 emoji 贴图的位置。
works.exercise_en: Detect faces in the AR Foundation camera feed and hide each one behind a different emoji. Twist: the emoji changes with the person's distance to the phone.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 相机画面里检测人脸，给每张脸盖上不同的 emoji。变体：emoji 随这个人离手机的远近而变化。

video.video_title: Added a realtime emoji overlay effect to the UltraFace-on-Barracuda example. https://t.co/HUekatPNIt https://t.co/CEjIbXZOBO

works.title: Underwater AR brain-sensing eyeglass
works.description: Mann swims in Lake Ontario wearing waterproof AR eyeglasses with a brain-sensing headband, capturing and overlaying information from below the waterline.
works.description_zh: Mann 戴着防水 AR 眼镜和脑电头带在安大略湖里游泳，在水面以下拍摄并叠加信息。
works.idea_en: Take wearable AR into water, where vision, sound and balance all behave differently.
works.idea_zh: 把可穿戴 AR 带进水里，那里的视觉、声音和平衡感都与陆地不同。
works.technique: Likely a sealed head-up display and camera paired with an EEG headband stream data to a waterproofed wearable computer.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是密封的抬头显示器和摄像头，加上脑电头带，把数据传给经过防水处理的可穿戴电脑。
works.exercise_en: Put a phone in a waterproof pouch, float it in a sink or pool and design an AR overlay that only makes sense underwater (depth, bubbles, refraction). Twist: make the overlay react to the water's movement.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机装进防水袋放进水槽或泳池，设计一个只在水下才有意义的 AR 叠加层（深度、气泡、折射）。变体：让叠加层随水的波动而变化。

video.video_title: Underwater augmented reality brain-sensing eyeglass compilation video for the 50th anniversary of OP

works.title: UnityFurURP (Shell / Fin Fur Shader)
works.description: Soft animal fur grows on a model and sways as it moves, rendered in real time with layered shells and fins.
works.description_zh: 柔软的动物毛发长在模型表面，随着模型移动而摇曳，用层叠的壳层和鳍片实时渲染。
works.idea_en: Stack many transparent copies of a surface and it turns into fur.
works.idea_zh: 把一个表面叠上许多层透明副本，它就变成了毛发。
works.technique: The URP shader extrudes the mesh along its normals into many shell layers (and fin quads at silhouettes), cutting each layer with a noise mask and moving it with gravity and wind.
works.technique_zh: URP 着色器沿法线把网格挤出成多层壳层（并在轮廓处生成鳍片），每层用噪声遮罩裁切，再用重力和风力让它摆动。
works.exercise_en: Grow fur on a real object in AR by applying the shell shader to a LiDAR scan placed over it, so a mug or chair becomes furry on screen. Twist: the fur bristles when someone moves the phone quickly.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把壳层毛发着色器用在覆盖真实物体的 LiDAR 扫描上，让杯子或椅子在屏幕上长出毛。变体：手机快速移动时毛会炸起来。

video.video_title: Unity URP Fur Shader (Shell / Fin)

works.title: Urban Lasergame AR
works.description: A location-based AR laser tag game played in city streets.
works.idea_zh: 把城市街道变成AR激光枪战场

video.video_title: Urban Lasergame AR

works.technique: Likely GPS positioning plus camera-based person detection (or shared AR sessions) registers hits when a player aims the phone at another player.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebAR + 人体检测做一个简化激光枪游戏：对准画面中的人并点击即算命中；变体：命中后不是“淘汰”，而是在对方身上留下一件 AR 装饰。
works.description_zh: 一款基于位置、在城市街道上进行的 AR 激光枪对战游戏。
works.idea_en: Turn city streets into an AR laser-tag battlefield.
works.technique_zh: 大概率结合 GPS 定位与基于摄像头的人体检测（或共享 AR 会话），当玩家把手机对准另一名玩家时判定命中。
works.exercise_en: Build a simple laser-tag game with WebAR and person detection, where aiming at a person in the frame and tapping counts as a hit. Twist: a hit does not knock the other player out but leaves an AR decoration on them.

works.title: VFX Graph Dragon
works.description: A flock of dragons made only of particle strips and scale-like quads snakes through a dark space; the number of dragons can be increased almost without limit.
works.description_zh: 一群完全由粒子条带和鳞片状面片组成的龙，在黑暗空间里蜿蜒游动，数量几乎可以无限增加。
works.idea_en: Build a creature out of particles, so one dragon becomes a thousand for free.
works.idea_zh: 用粒子来搭一个生物，一条龙就能零成本变成一千条。
works.technique: Likely a head particle follows a random-walk path while trail (strip) particles and instanced scale quads spawned behind it form the body, all inside VFX Graph without skinned meshes.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是：一个头部粒子沿随机游走路径前进，身后生成的拖尾条带粒子和实例化鳞片面片构成身体，全部在 VFX Graph 中完成，不需要蒙皮网格。
works.exercise_en: Make a particle serpent that follows a random-walk path around a detected AR plane on a phone. Twist: make the serpent flee from the phone camera when you get close.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机上做一条粒子蛇，让它沿随机游走路径绕着检测到的 AR 平面游动。变体：当你靠近时，让它躲开手机摄像头。

VFX Graph Dragon. Hope that VFX Graph supports Geometry Shader and VAT.
使わんけど，無限に増やせるドラゴンができた．
