works.title: VFX Graph with 300,000 particles
works.description: Hundreds of thousands of glowing particles swirl in dense ribbons and clouds, all simulated on the GPU in real time.
works.description_zh: 几十万颗发光粒子在密集的丝带和云团中旋转，全部在 GPU 上实时模拟。
works.idea_en: Scale changes the feeling: a crowd of particles becomes a material.
works.idea_zh: 数量改变感受：足够多的粒子就成了一种材质。
works.technique: VFX Graph simulates particles with curl-noise style turbulence and additive blending, relying on GPU compute to update 300,000 particles per frame.
works.technique_zh: VFX Graph 用类似卷曲噪声的湍流和加色混合模拟粒子，依靠 GPU 计算每帧更新 30 万颗粒子。
works.exercise_en: Test how many particles your phone can handle in an AR Foundation scene and design a piece at that limit. Twist: tie the particle count to the room's brightness.
works.exercise_zh: 测试你的手机在 AR Foundation 场景中能承受多少粒子，然后在这个上限附近设计作品。变体：粒子数量随房间亮度变化。

video.video_title:
Unity VFX Graph (300,000 particles)
https://t.co/XOfq5Zq5v1 https://t.co/EyO4JUbRD0

works.title: VarioLight 2: Rhythmic Gymnastics
works.description: Wide-range dynamic projection follows a rhythmic gymnast's ball and ribbon, painting light effects onto the apparatus during the routine.
works.idea_zh: 投影追着体操运动员的球和彩带，在表演中给它们'上色'。

video.video_title: VarioLight 2: Wide Dynamic Projection Mapping in Rhythmic Gymnastics

works.technique: High-speed vision tracks the gymnastics ball and ribbon, and galvanometer mirrors steer a projector to keep light effects registered on the fast-moving apparatus throughout the routine.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头颜色追踪一个抛接的彩色球，在投影仪或屏幕上让光效和粒子跟随球的轨迹，配合一段音乐完成 30 秒表演；变体：光效由球的速度或高度驱动音乐变化。
works.description_zh: 大范围动态投影跟随艺术体操运动员的球和彩带，在整套动作中把光效投射到器械上。
works.idea_en: Projection chases a gymnast's ball and ribbon and colors them during the routine.
works.technique_zh: 高速视觉追踪体操球和彩带，振镜引导投影仪的光路，在整套动作中让光效始终贴合在快速运动的器械上。
works.exercise_en: Use camera color tracking on a colored ball being tossed and caught, make light effects and particles follow its path on a projector or screen, and perform a 30-second routine to music. Twist: the ball's speed or height drives changes in the music.

works.title: Virtual Sky Mapping – The Dream
works.description: For Seattle's 2021 New Year's Eve, when crowds could not gather, the usual fireworks at the Space Needle were replaced by a virtual 'sky mapping' show: 3D light shapes and animations composited around the real tower in the broadcast and stream.
works.description_zh: 2021 年西雅图跨年夜因为不能聚集，太空针塔的传统烟花被一场虚拟的“天空映射”表演取代：三维光形和动画在直播画面里被合成到真实的塔周围。
works.idea_en: This is AR by broadcast: virtual content locked to a real landmark in a camera image, which is exactly what a phone AR fireworks show would be.
works.idea_zh: 这是通过直播实现的 AR：虚拟内容锁定在摄像机画面里的真实地标上，这正是一场手机 AR 烟花秀的样子。
works.technique: Tracked or fixed broadcast cameras film the Space Needle while 3D animations are rendered to match the camera position and composited in real time or in post (method likely virtual production).
works.technique_zh: 用固定或带追踪的直播机位拍摄太空针塔，按机位渲染三维动画并实时或后期合成（方法推测为虚拟制作）。
works.exercise_en: Build a 'virtual fireworks' WebXR or 8th Wall scene anchored above a tall landmark near campus, with bursts timed to music. Twist: each viewer's tap launches a firework everyone else sees too.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 8th Wall 做一场锚定在校园附近高楼上方的“虚拟烟花”，烟花随音乐绽放；变体：每位观众点一下就发射一发，其他人也能看到。

video.video_title: Virtual Sky Mapping – The Dream

works.title: Voice Recognition with Shaders
works.description: A small robot dog attached to a VRChat avatar obeys spoken commands, recognised by a shader-based neural network that only sees the lip-sync visemes the platform exposes.
works.description_zh: 挂在 VRChat 角色身上的一只小机器狗会听从口头命令；识别命令的是一个基于着色器的神经网络，它能看到的只有平台提供的口型音素数据。
works.idea_en: Recover speech from lip-sync signals when the raw audio is out of reach.
works.idea_zh: 拿不到原始音频时，就从口型同步信号里还原语音。
works.technique: Viseme weights over time form the input sequence to a small classifier implemented in fragment shaders; its output drives the robot dog's animation, showing that visemes retain enough information to recognise words.
works.technique_zh: 随时间变化的口型音素权重构成输入序列，送入一个用片元着色器实现的小型分类器；分类结果驱动机器狗的动作，说明口型音素保留了足以识别词语的信息。
works.exercise_en: Map spoken keywords (via on-device speech recognition) to three VFX Graph spells that appear in front of the speaker in AR. Twist: the spell only works if two people say it together.
works.exercise_zh: 用设备端语音识别把说出的关键词映射到三种 VFX Graph 法术，在 AR 中出现在说话者面前。变体：只有两个人同时说出咒语时才生效。

video.video_title: I attached a robotic dog to my Voice Recognition neural network in #VRChat and released the source code on https://t.co/WYW0ZMD6Q0 Have fun ^^ #MachineLearning #AI #shaders #Unity3D #AudioRecognition

works.title: Volumetric people with superpowers (Studio ANRK x Volograms)
works.description: Test Snapchat Lenses that drop volumetric captures of real people into the scene and give them superpowers, such as bursts of energy around their bodies.
works.description_zh: 一组 Snapchat 测试 Lens，把真人的体积视频捕捉放进场景里，并给他们加上“超能力”，比如环绕身体的能量爆发。
works.idea_en: Put a real, filmed human into social AR and then make them superhuman.
works.idea_zh: 把真实拍摄的人放进社交 AR，再让他们变成超人。
works.technique: Volograms turns single-camera video into volumetric 3D sequences that are imported into Lens Studio and combined with particle VFX.
works.technique_zh: Volograms 把单机位视频转换成体积 3D 序列，导入 Lens Studio 后与粒子特效结合。
works.exercise_en: Capture a classmate as a short volumetric clip (with a volumetric app or photogrammetry turntable) and place them in AR with one magical effect. Twist: the effect is triggered by the viewer's voice.
works.exercise_zh: 用体积捕捉应用或摄影测量转台把一位同学拍成一段体积视频，放进 AR 并加上一个魔法特效；变体：特效由观看者的声音触发。

video.video_title: Studio ANRK - playing around with Snap lenses with volograms and superpowers

works.title: Vuforia Spatial Toolbox – Remote Operator
works.description: PTC Reality Lab's open-source successor to the Reality Editor: a remote operator sees a live 3D scan of a factory and programs robots and machines by drawing spatial paths.
works.idea_zh: 远程在工厂的实时3D场景里画路径，直接给机器人编程。

video.video_title: Vuforia Spatial Toolbox - Remote Operator Interface

works.technique: A LiDAR scan of the space is streamed to a remote client as a 3D model, and paths drawn in that model are converted into waypoints in the shared coordinate frame and sent to the robot controller.
works.exercise_zh: 用 iPhone LiDAR 扫描应用（如 Polycam）扫描一个房间，在 three.js 里远程打开模型并点击画出一条路径，再把路径发送给另一部手机的 AR 视图显示为地面箭头；变体：让“机器人”由一位同学扮演，按照 AR 路径行走。
works.description_zh: PTC Reality Lab 推出的开源工具，是 Reality Editor 的后继者：远程操作员可以看到工厂的实时三维扫描，并通过绘制空间路径为机器人和机器编程。
works.idea_en: Draw paths remotely in a live 3D scene of a factory to program robots directly.
works.technique_zh: 空间的 LiDAR 扫描以三维模型形式传给远程客户端，在模型中绘制的路径被转换为共享坐标系中的路径点，再发送给机器人控制器。
works.exercise_en: Scan a room with an iPhone LiDAR app such as Polycam, open the model remotely in three.js and click to draw a path, then send the path to another phone's AR view to show as arrows on the floor. Twist: have a classmate play the robot and walk along the AR path.

works.title: Wand Duel
works.description: Players wearing Snap Spectacles face each other in a real room and cast spells by flicking a wand, duelling like wizards in a shared AR arena.
works.description_zh: 戴着 Snap Spectacles 的玩家在真实房间里面对面站立，挥动魔杖施放法术，在共享的 AR 竞技场里像巫师一样决斗。
works.idea_en: Turn AR glasses into a face-to-face magic duel where you can still see your opponent's real face.
works.idea_zh: 把 AR 眼镜变成面对面的魔法决斗，你依然能看到对手真实的脸。
works.technique: Co-located multiplayer on Spectacles syncs player positions and spell projectiles, with hand or controller gestures mapped to spells (likely).
works.technique_zh: 在 Spectacles 上做同空间多人联机，同步玩家位置和法术弹道，并把手势或控制器动作映射为不同法术（推测）。
works.exercise_en: Prototype a two-player phone AR duel where each player's phone position is their shield and a swipe fires a spell. Twist: spells bounce off real walls detected by the phone.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个双人手机 AR 决斗原型：手机的位置就是盾牌，滑动屏幕即可发射法术；变体：法术会在手机识别出的真实墙面上反弹。

video.video_title: Building An AR Wizard Duelling Game

works.title: WaterRW
works.description: A 2D water surface ripples and splashes when objects fall in; floating rigidbodies bob naturally on the waves.
works.description_zh: 一片 2D 水面在物体落入时泛起涟漪、溅起水花，漂浮的刚体自然地随波起伏。
works.idea_en: Simulate only the surface of the water, and it can be both cheap and interactive.
works.idea_zh: 只模拟水的表面，它就能既便宜又可交互。
works.technique: The wave equation is solved on the GPU along the water surface and the result deforms the surface mesh; rigidbodies push the height field and receive buoyancy back, and a shader renders reflection and refraction.
works.technique_zh: 在 GPU 上沿水面求解波动方程，并用结果形变水面网格；刚体推动高度场并得到回馈的浮力，着色器负责绘制反射与折射。
works.exercise_en: Put a GPU height-field pond on a real table in AR and let the phone's position drop virtual pebbles into it. Twist: real objects detected by the LiDAR mesh block the ripples.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一个 GPU 高度场水池放在真实桌面上，用手机的位置往里面投下虚拟石子。变体：LiDAR 网格检测到的真实物体会挡住涟漪。

波動計算とメッシュ変形をGPU上で行えるようになり、Rigidbodyとの干渉もより自然になっています。

works.title: World Skies
works.description: A flip-disc artwork that animates the colour and motion of skies from cities around the world, updating from live data.
works.description_zh: 一件翻片作品，根据实时数据呈现世界各城市天空的颜色与流动。
works.idea_en: Bringing a faraway sky into a room creates a window, not a screen — AR portals can use live data from real places.
works.idea_zh: 把远方的天空带进房间，得到的是一扇窗而不是一块屏——AR 传送门可以使用来自真实地点的实时数据。
works.technique: Likely live weather and sky imagery from multiple cities are processed into patterns rendered on a large flip-disc display.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是将多个城市的实时天气与天空图像处理成图案，再渲染到大型翻片显示屏上。
works.exercise_en: Open an AR window on your wall that shows the live sky of a city chosen by the user, using a weather API for cloud cover and time of day. Twist: the window slowly turns to a different city each time someone walks past.
works.exercise_zh: 在墙上打开一扇 AR 窗户，利用天气 API 的云量和时间数据显示用户所选城市的实时天空。变体：每当有人经过，窗户慢慢切换到另一座城市。

video.video_title: Flip-Disc Kinetic Art — World Skies

works.title: XRSpectator
works.description: Fans who cannot attend a match put on a VR headset and sit inside a 360 recording of the stadium, with the same AR stats and replays floating over the field as if they were there.
works.description_zh: 无法到场的球迷戴上 VR 头显，坐进体育场的 360 度录像里，同样的 AR 数据和回放漂浮在球场上方，仿佛身临其境。
works.idea_en: Recreate the in-stadium AR experience at home by augmenting a 360 video instead of reality.
works.idea_zh: 通过增强 360 度视频而不是现实，在家复现场内 AR 观赛体验。
works.technique: Wraps a 360 video of the live stadium around the user and registers the ARSpectator overlays to it, turning on-site AR into indirect AR on a VR HMD.
works.technique_zh: 把现场体育场的 360 度视频包裹在用户周围，并将 ARSpectator 的叠加内容配准到视频上，把现场 AR 变成 VR 头显中的间接 AR。
works.exercise_en: Film a school match with a 360 camera or phone panorama, then add floating labels to the panorama and watch it in a cardboard viewer. Twist: let viewers switch seats between two recording positions.
works.exercise_zh: 用 360 度相机或手机全景拍一场校内比赛，在全景画面中加入悬浮标签，然后用纸盒眼镜观看；变体：让观众在两个录制位置之间“换座位”。

video.video_title: XRSpectator: Immersive, Augmented Sports Spectating

works.title: XRStudio
works.description: A virtual production system for teaching in XR: the instructor's immersive session is mixed with real camera video and live-streamed so remote students can follow.
works.idea_zh: 把老师在XR里的讲课混合成直播画面给学生看。

video.video_title: XRStudio: A Virtual Production and Live Streaming System for Immersive Instructional Experiences

works.technique: Composites the instructor's tracked XR view with external camera footage and scene cameras into multiple switchable streams.
works.exercise_zh: 用OBS把一名同学手机AR画面和教室摄像头画面合成直播，让他用AR讲解一个3D模型；变化：观众通过弹幕控制AR中模型的颜色。
works.description_zh: 一个用于 XR 教学的虚拟制作系统：讲师的沉浸式课堂与真实摄像机画面混合后进行直播，让远程学生也能跟上。
works.idea_en: Mix a teacher's XR lecture into a live stream for students to watch.
works.technique_zh: 将讲师被追踪的 XR 视角与外部摄像机画面和场景相机画面合成为多路可切换的视频流。
works.exercise_en: Use OBS to combine a classmate's phone AR view with the classroom camera into a live stream while they explain a 3D model in AR. Twist: viewers change the model's color in AR through live chat comments.

works.title: YOLOv4-tiny in Fragment Shaders
works.description: An object detector written entirely in Unity fragment shaders draws labelled boxes around people and objects in a live video feed inside VRChat.
works.description_zh: 一个完全用 Unity 片元着色器写成的物体检测器，在 VRChat 里的实时视频画面中给人和物体画出带标签的框。
works.idea_en: Run a neural network where scripts are not allowed: inside the shader itself.
works.idea_zh: 在不允许写脚本的地方运行神经网络：就在着色器里。
works.technique: Each YOLOv4-tiny layer (convolutions, pooling, activations) is re-implemented as a fragment-shader pass that writes activations into render textures, chained frame by frame, with the trained weights baked into textures.
works.technique_zh: 把 YOLOv4-tiny 的每一层（卷积、池化、激活）重写成一个片元着色器通道，把激活值写进渲染纹理，逐帧串联；训练好的权重被烘焙进纹理。
works.exercise_en: Run a tiny detector on the AR camera image (Unity Sentis or a shader port) and attach a VFX Graph burst to every detected cup. Twist: the effect changes depending on how many objects of the same class are visible.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 相机画面上运行一个小型检测器（Unity Sentis 或着色器移植版），给每个检测到的杯子绑定一个 VFX Graph 爆发特效。变体：特效随画面中同类物体的数量而改变。

video.video_title: I recreated YOLOv4 tiny from scratch inside fragment shaders for #unity. Here's a demo of it running in #VRChat and I uploaded the code on GitHub https://t.co/95WHOFUtG4 Have fun ^^ #YOLO #DeepLearnin

works.title: ZERO10 app: digital fashion AR try-on
works.description: The launch film of the ZERO10 iPhone app: people on the street wear digital-only garments that follow their body in real time through the phone camera, ready to be recorded and shared.
works.description_zh: ZERO10 iPhone App 的发布短片：街头的人通过手机摄像头“穿上”纯数字服装，衣服实时贴合身体动作，可以直接录制并分享。
works.idea_en: Clothes that exist only as software, worn on your real body through the camera.
works.idea_zh: 只存在于软件里的衣服，通过摄像头穿在真实的身体上。
works.technique: Full-body tracking and segmentation estimate the wearer's pose and silhouette each frame, and a real-time cloth simulation drapes the 3D garment over that body with occlusion by arms and hair (likely).
works.technique_zh: 全身追踪与人像分割逐帧估计穿着者的姿态和轮廓，实时布料模拟把 3D 服装披挂在身体上，并处理手臂和头发的遮挡（推测）。
works.exercise_en: Use Lens Studio or Effect House body tracking to attach a simple 3D garment (a cape or oversized collar) to a person's upper body, then film a 15-second street 'outfit post'. Twist: the garment reacts to walking speed, getting bigger the faster you move.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 Effect House 的人体追踪，把一件简单的 3D 服装（披风或夸张的大领子）挂到人的上半身，然后拍一段 15 秒的街头“穿搭”视频；变体：衣服随走路速度变化，走得越快越大。

video.video_title: Introducing ZERO10 — a new generation digital fashion app for AR try-on. Now available on the App Store: https://t.co/njvuw9uMQB https://t.co/ElqDRIOcry

works.title: border 2021
works.description: An update of the 2015 'border' for post-COVID audiences: seated viewers ride personal mobility devices and watch real and virtual dancers merge through mixed-reality headsets, with an online version too.
works.idea_zh: 观众坐在自动移动的座椅上，戴MR眼镜看真实与虚拟舞者融合
works.technique: Tracked mobility chairs move audience members through the stage while mixed-reality headsets render virtual dancers registered to the physical space.
works.exercise_zh: 让观众坐在带轮椅子上被同学推着走，用手机AR看到预先放置的虚拟舞者；变化：真人舞者与虚拟舞者在某一刻交换位置。

video.video_title: ELEVENPLAY x Rhizomatiks  “border 2021”

works.description_zh: 2015 年作品《border》面向疫情后观众的更新版：观众坐在个人移动设备上，通过混合现实头显观看真实舞者与虚拟舞者融为一体，同时还提供线上版本。
works.idea_en: Seated on self-driving chairs, the audience wears MR headsets and watches real and virtual dancers merge.
works.technique_zh: 被追踪的移动座椅载着观众穿过舞台，混合现实头显则渲染与实体空间对齐的虚拟舞者。
works.exercise_en: Seat audience members on wheeled chairs pushed by classmates while they watch pre-placed virtual dancers in phone AR. Twist: at one moment the live dancer and the virtual dancer swap places.

works.title: eyemR-Vis
works.description: Bi-directional gaze cues between remote collaborators, visualized in MR so each person knows where the other is looking and whether they are attending.
works.idea_zh: 把两个人的视线互相可视化，知道对方在看哪儿、有没有在专注。

video.video_title: eyemR-Vis:A MR System to Visualise Bi-Directional Gaze Behavioural Cues Between Remote Collaborators

works.technique: Eye trackers on both sides capture gaze direction, which is exchanged and visualized as shared gaze rays or highlights in MR, with visual states indicating when both people look at the same object.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 的虹膜点或 WebGazer.js 近似估计两人在屏幕上的注视点，在共享画面中显示彼此的注视光标，两人同时看同一处时出现特效；变体：用“对视”来完成一个两人协作解谜。
works.description_zh: 远程协作者之间的双向视线提示，在 MR 中可视化呈现，让每个人都知道对方在看哪里、是否在专注。
works.idea_en: Show two people each other's gaze so they know where the other is looking and whether they are paying attention.
works.technique_zh: 双方的眼动追踪器捕捉视线方向，数据互相交换后在 MR 中以共享视线射线或高亮形式呈现，并用视觉状态提示两人何时在看同一个物体。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Face Mesh iris points or WebGazer.js to roughly estimate where two people are looking on screen, show each other's gaze cursor in a shared view, and trigger an effect when both look at the same spot. Twist: use mutual gaze to solve a two-person puzzle.

works.title: multiplex
works.description: Motion data from five dancers, projected images and five autonomously moving robot cubes share two exhibition spaces and an online version, hybridising real and virtual dancers.
works.idea_zh: 真实舞者数据、投影与自动移动的立方体共同组成混合现实舞台
works.technique: Recorded motion-capture data drives projection-mapped imagery on mobile robot cubes whose positions are tracked so the virtual dancers appear on their moving surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 把纸箱放在遥控小车上移动，用投影跟随纸箱投出舞者剪影；变化：观众用手机扫码切换看到的“虚拟舞者”视角。

video.video_title: Rhizomatiks x ELEVENPLAY "multiplex" (2021)

works.description_zh: 五位舞者的动作数据、投影影像与五个自主移动的机器人立方体共享两处展览空间和一个线上版本，让真实舞者与虚拟舞者交融。
works.idea_en: Real dancer data, projection and self-moving cubes together form a mixed-reality stage.
works.technique_zh: 录制的动作捕捉数据驱动投影映射到移动机器人立方体上的影像，立方体的位置被实时追踪，使虚拟舞者出现在它们移动的表面上。
works.exercise_en: Put cardboard boxes on RC cars and have a projector follow the boxes to cast dancer silhouettes on them. Twist: viewers scan a QR code on their phones to switch which virtual dancer view they see.

works.title: shemza.digital #5
works.description: A walk-through archway taken from Anwar Shemza's City Wall paintings, made in recycled green acrylic: as a visitor approaches, sensors make the arch light up and invite them to pass through it.
works.description_zh: 一座可以穿行的拱门，取自 Anwar Shemza 的 City Wall 系列画作，用回收绿色亚克力制成：观众走近时，传感器让拱门亮起，邀请人从中穿过。
works.idea_en: A painted arch becomes a real doorway that lights up to welcome you.
works.idea_zh: 画里的拱门变成真的门，会亮起来欢迎你。
works.technique: Ultrasonic sensors measure the visitor's distance and a bespoke circuit ramps up the LEDs inside the acrylic arch as they get closer.
works.technique_zh: 超声波传感器测量观众的距离，定制电路随着人靠近逐渐调亮亚克力拱门里的 LED。
works.exercise_en: Turn a classroom doorway into a threshold with a distance sensor and LED strip that brightens as someone approaches. Twist: make it fade out if two people try to pass at once.
works.exercise_zh: 用一个测距传感器和一条 LED 灯带把教室门口变成一道门槛，有人靠近就逐渐变亮；变体：如果两个人同时想穿过，灯就熄灭。

video.video_title: shemza digital #5, 2022 - Interactive light sculpture by Aphra Shemza

works.title: yaGrid
works.description: A dance meeting in a video-call grid, where human dancers share windows with Kinect-captured stick figures that act as neutral, non-human dance partners.
works.description_zh: 一场在视频会议网格里的舞蹈聚会，真人舞者与 Kinect 捕捉的火柴人共用窗口，火柴人成为中性的非人舞伴。
works.idea_en: Invite stick figures to your video call as dance partners.
works.idea_zh: 把火柴人请进视频会议当舞伴。
works.technique: Kinect skeleton data is rendered as minimal stick figures and composited into a Zoom-like grid alongside webcam feeds of human participants.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 骨架数据被渲染成极简火柴人，与真人的摄像头画面一起合成到类似 Zoom 的网格中。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe in the browser to turn each participant's webcam into a stick figure and show both views side by side in a shared grid. Twist: swap figures between windows so everyone dances with someone else's skeleton.
works.exercise_zh: 在浏览器中用 MediaPipe 把每个参与者的摄像头画面变成火柴人，并在共享网格里并排显示；变体：交换窗口中的火柴人，让每个人和别人的骨架跳舞。

video.video_title: yaGrid | Ειρήνη Καλαϊτζίδη | ONC8

works.title: $100 Wallpaper Using ARKit
works.description: Re-skins the walls of a real room with virtual wallpaper using LiDAR scene geometry.
works.idea_zh: 用 LiDAR 给真实房间换一张虚拟墙纸。

video.video_title: $100 wallpaper using ARKit

works.technique: Wall-classified LiDAR mesh faces receive a triplanar or world-space UV texture, with people occlusion so the wallpaper sits behind people in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 用竖直平面检测识别墙面并贴上重复图案的壁纸，开启人体遮挡；变体：壁纸图案随时间慢慢流动或变色。
works.description_zh: 利用 LiDAR 场景几何，为真实房间的墙面换上虚拟墙纸。
works.idea_en: Give a real room new virtual wallpaper with LiDAR.
works.technique_zh: 被分类为墙面的 LiDAR 网格面使用三平面映射或世界空间 UV 贴上纹理，并开启人体遮挡，让墙纸显示在房间中的人后方。
works.exercise_en: Use vertical plane detection to find walls, apply a repeating wallpaper pattern, and turn on people occlusion. Twist: the wallpaper pattern slowly flows or changes color over time.

works.title: 3D & AR on Shopify: Stroller Demo
works.description: A demo shown in Daniel Beauchamp's ShipIt! talk: a double stroller on a Shopify product page can be spun in 3D and then placed at real size on the street in AR.
works.description_zh: Daniel Beauchamp 在 ShipIt! 分享中展示的演示：Shopify 商品页上的双人婴儿车可以 3D 旋转查看，再以真实尺寸放到街道上进行 AR 预览。
works.idea_en: Let shoppers check a bulky product's real size in the place they will use it.
works.idea_zh: 让购物者在真正使用的地方确认大件商品的实际尺寸。
works.technique: Merchants upload a 3D model with the product; the storefront shows it in a web 3D viewer and hands a USDZ file to AR Quick Look on iPhone for true-scale placement.
works.technique_zh: 商家随商品上传 3D 模型，店铺用网页 3D 查看器展示，并在 iPhone 上把 USDZ 文件交给 AR Quick Look 进行真实比例放置。
works.exercise_en: Pick one bulky object (bike, stroller, instrument case), get or make its 3D model, and publish a page with a 3D viewer and an AR button; test it where the object would really be used. Twist: add a path animation showing it moving through a doorway.
works.exercise_zh: 选一件大件物品（自行车、婴儿车或琴盒），获取或制作 3D 模型，发布一个带 3D 查看器和 AR 按钮的页面，并在它真正的使用场所测试；变体：加一段它穿过门口的路径动画。

video.video_title: ShipIt! Presents: AR/VR at Shopify

works.title: 3D Moebius Transformations
works.description: A whole 3D scene folds, rotates and turns inside out through a 4D sphere, as if space itself were being twisted.
works.description_zh: 整个三维场景经由一个四维球面折叠、旋转、内外翻转，仿佛空间本身被拧动。
works.idea_en: Bend space instead of objects: send the scene to a 4D sphere, rotate it, and bring it back.
works.idea_zh: 弯曲的是空间而不是物体：把场景送到四维球面上旋转，再投影回来。
works.technique: In the vertex shader every vertex is mapped by inverse stereographic projection to a 3-sphere in 4D, rotated there, and projected back, producing Moebius transformations of the scene.
works.technique_zh: 在顶点着色器里，把每个顶点通过逆球极投影映射到四维中的三维球面，在那里旋转后再投影回来，得到场景的 Möbius 变换。
works.exercise_en: Apply the Moebius vertex shader to a virtual room placed in AR on a phone, so the walls curl around the viewer. Twist: tie the rotation angle to how far the user walks.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中放一个虚拟房间并套用这个 Möbius 顶点着色器，让墙壁绕着观众卷曲。变体：旋转角度由用户走了多远决定。

video.video_title: Moebius Transformations

works.title: 3D Scene Reconstruction with iPad Pro LiDAR
works.description: Scans a room live with the iPad Pro LiDAR and renders the growing mesh with shading and grid lines.
works.idea_zh: 用 iPad LiDAR 实时重建房间网格。

video.video_title: 3D Scene Reconstruction using ARKit and iPad Pro with LiDAR

works.technique: ARKit scene reconstruction mesh anchors are rendered in Metal with a normal-based shading and a world-space grid shader, updating as the mesh grows.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 网格管理器显示扫描出的房间网格，并用世界坐标网格线着色器渲染；变体：网格线按扫描先后时间渐变颜色。
works.description_zh: 用 iPad Pro 的 LiDAR 实时扫描房间，并以明暗着色和网格线渲染不断扩展的网格。
works.idea_en: Rebuild a room's mesh live with iPad LiDAR.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 场景重建得到的网格锚点在 Metal 中渲染，使用基于法线的着色和世界空间网格线着色器，并随网格扩展实时更新。
works.exercise_en: Show the scanned room mesh with the AR Foundation mesh manager and render it with a world-space grid-line shader. Twist: color the grid lines as a gradient by the order in which areas were scanned.

works.title: 4D Explorer (4D Raymarching)
works.description: The player moves through a world where objects slide in and out of a fourth dimension, growing, shrinking and vanishing as the 3D slice shifts.
works.description_zh: 玩家在一个物体会滑入滑出第四维的世界中移动；随着三维切片移动，物体变大、变小或消失。
works.idea_en: See a 4D world by walking through its 3D slices.
works.idea_zh: 通过在三维切片中行走来看见一个四维世界。
works.technique: Signed distance functions are defined in four dimensions and raymarched in a 3D slice whose W coordinate the player controls, with 4D rotations applied to the objects.
works.technique_zh: 在四维中定义有符号距离函数，并在一个由玩家控制 W 坐标的三维切片里做光线步进，对物体施加四维旋转。
works.exercise_en: Place a 4D object on a real table in phone AR and map the fourth coordinate to the phone's height above the floor. Twist: two students at different heights see different shapes at the same spot.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中把一个四维物体放在真实桌上，把第四维坐标映射到手机离地面的高度。变体：站在不同高度的两位学生在同一位置看到不同的形状。

video.video_title: Making a 4D Game - 4D Explorer

works.title: 4DViews volumetric video with VFX Graph
works.description: A volumetric recording of a performer is replayed in Unity and melts into drifting particles and outlines.
works.description_zh: 一段表演者的体积视频在 Unity 中回放，并融化成飘动的粒子和轮廓线。
works.idea_en: Studio volumetric capture can be remixed like any other footage.
works.idea_zh: 影棚拍的体积视频，也能像普通素材一样被再创作。
works.technique: The 4DViews clip is converted to Alembic meshes plus a HAP texture; a converter samples the meshes into point clouds that VFX Graph uses as a source.
works.technique_zh: 把 4DViews 片段转成 Alembic 网格加 HAP 贴图，再用转换器把网格采样成点云，交给 VFX Graph 当作粒子源。
works.exercise_en: Place a free volumetric clip on the floor with AR Foundation and let it dissolve into particles when viewers circle around it. Twist: freeze the performer when someone stands in front of them.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 把一段免费体积视频放在地面上，观众绕着走时人像逐渐散成粒子。变体：有人站到表演者正前方时，画面定格。

video.video_title:
4DViews volumetric video + Unity VFX Graph
https://t.co/EiwcBO1BGc https://t.co/sYmSlEpwM7

works.title: A Futuristic Portal to My Best Friend
works.description: A quarantine project: a mixed-reality 'portal' that opens a window from his apartment into his best friend's space so they can hang out as virtual roommates.
works.idea_zh: 疫情隔离期间，做一道连接好友家的混合现实传送门，当“虚拟室友”。

video.video_title: I Built a FUTURISTIC PORTAL To My Best Friend! (Quarantine Project)

works.technique: A wall-anchored portal renders a live volumetric or depth-video stream of the remote room behind the wall plane, using a stencil mask so the remote space appears to sit behind the real wall.
works.exercise_zh: 在墙上放一个 AR 窗口，窗口里播放朋友实时视频通话的画面（用深度或背景分离做出一点立体感）；变体：窗口只在两人同时站在墙前时打开。
works.description_zh: 一个隔离期间的项目：一道混合现实“传送门”从他的公寓打开一扇通往好友空间的窗户，让两人可以像虚拟室友一样一起消磨时光。
works.idea_en: During quarantine, build a mixed-reality portal into a friend's home and live as virtual roommates.
works.technique_zh: 锚定在墙上的传送门在墙面平面后方渲染远程房间的实时体积视频或深度视频流，并使用模板遮罩，让远程空间看起来就在真实墙壁后面。
works.exercise_en: Put an AR window on a wall that plays a live video call with a friend, using depth or background separation to add a bit of depth. Twist: the window opens only when both of you stand in front of your walls at the same time.

salient.why_en: A portal in the wall opens into a friend's home during lockdown, so two people live as virtual roommates.
salient.why_zh: 封控期间，墙上的一扇传送门通向朋友家，两人成了虚拟室友。

works.title: A Working Marauder's Map – Harry Potter AR
works.description: In a rented 'mini Hogwarts' castle in England, a physical parchment viewed through the phone shows everyone's live GPS position as walking footprints with name labels, like Harry Potter's Marauder's Map.
works.idea_zh: 做一张真能显示城堡里每个人实时位置的“活点地图”。

video.video_title: I Built a WORKING Marauder's Map! ⚡🗺️ - Harry Potter AR Special

works.technique: The parchment is tracked as an image target, and each participant's GPS coordinates are converted into map-space positions on it, where footprint animations and name labels are drawn.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪识别一张校园手绘地图，把几位同学的 GPS 位置实时显示为走动的脚印；变体：地图上只显示“正在移动”的人。
works.description_zh: 在英格兰一座租来的“迷你霍格沃茨”城堡里，透过手机观看一张实体羊皮纸，就能看到每个人的实时 GPS 位置以带名字标签的行走脚印呈现，就像《哈利·波特》中的活点地图。
works.idea_en: Make a Marauder's Map that really shows where everyone in the castle is right now.
works.technique_zh: 羊皮纸作为图像目标被追踪，每位参与者的 GPS 坐标被转换为羊皮纸上的地图坐标，并在相应位置绘制脚印动画和名字标签。
works.exercise_en: Use image tracking to recognize a hand-drawn campus map and show the live GPS positions of a few classmates as walking footprints. Twist: the map shows only the people who are moving.

salient.why_en: A parchment Marauder's Map that really shows where everyone in the castle is right now.
salient.why_zh: 一张真正能显示城堡里每个人此刻位置的活点地图。

works.title: AR Boxing Game
works.description: He places virtual opponents in his real living room with AR Foundation and punches at them, turning a fitness routine into an AR boxing match.
works.idea_zh: 把陪练对手放进自家客厅，对着空气打拳也能健身。

video.video_title: Making an AR Boxing Game so I don't Get Fat

works.technique: AR Foundation plane detection places the opponent on the floor and the phone's pose (held or strapped) is used to detect punches and dodges.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在地上放一个会出拳的沙袋人，玩家侧身躲避；加一个变化：心率越高对手越强。
works.description_zh: 他用 AR Foundation 把虚拟对手放进自家真实的客厅，并对着它们出拳，把日常健身变成一场 AR 拳击赛。
works.idea_en: Bring a sparring partner into your living room, so punching the air becomes a workout.
works.technique_zh: AR Foundation 平面检测把对手放在地面上，手机（手持或绑在身上）的位姿用于检测出拳和闪避。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation to place a punching-bag opponent on the floor that throws punches while the player dodges sideways. Twist: the higher your heart rate, the stronger the opponent.

works.title: AR Cut & Paste
works.description: Point a phone at an object in a book or on the desk, tap to 'cut' it, then point the phone at a laptop screen to 'paste' it straight into Photoshop or a slide at the exact spot you are aiming at.
works.description_zh: 把手机对准书上或桌上的物体，点一下就把它“剪”下来，再把手机对准电脑屏幕，它就会被“粘贴”到 Photoshop 或幻灯片里你正对着的位置。
works.idea_en: Copy and paste between the physical world and your computer with a phone camera.
works.idea_zh: 用手机摄像头在现实世界和电脑之间“复制粘贴”。
works.technique: A U²Net salient-object model cuts the object out of the photo, and SIFT feature matching between the phone camera and a screenshot finds where the phone is pointing on the screen, then a local server pastes the cut-out there.
works.technique_zh: 用 U²Net 显著物体分割模型把物体从照片中抠出，再用 SIFT 特征匹配比对手机画面与电脑截图，算出手机正对屏幕的哪个位置，最后由本地服务器把抠图贴到那里。
works.exercise_en: Build a two-step web prototype: photograph an object with a phone, remove the background with an off-the-shelf segmentation API, and send the cut-out to a laptop page where it drops at a random position. Twist: use a printed marker on the laptop bezel so the phone's aim decides where the object lands.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个两步的网页原型：用手机拍下物体，用现成的抠图 API 去掉背景，再把抠好的图发送到电脑网页上随机落下；变体：在电脑边框贴一个打印标记，让手机对准的位置决定物体落在哪里。

5/10 - From books to presentations in 10s with AR+ML

salient.why_en: Point a phone at a real object to cut it out, then point at your screen to paste it in.
salient.why_zh: 用手机对准真实物体把它“剪”下来，再对准电脑屏幕把它“贴”进去。

works.title: AR Drawing
works.description: Strokes drawn with the phone hang in space as stylised 3D lines.
works.idea_zh: 用手机在空中画出风格化的立体线条。

video.video_title: AR drawing

works.technique: Camera positions sampled while touching are converted into ribbon or tube meshes with stylized shading, anchored in world space.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 记录手机移动轨迹生成带状网格，并加卡通描边着色；变体：画完的线会慢慢被“风”吹动。
works.description_zh: 用手机画出的笔画以风格化的三维线条形式悬挂在空中。
works.idea_en: Draw stylized 3D lines in the air with your phone.
works.technique_zh: 在触摸屏幕期间采样的相机位置被转换为带风格化着色的带状或管状网格，并锚定在世界空间中。
works.exercise_en: Record the phone's movement path with AR Foundation to generate a ribbon mesh and add a cartoon outline shader. Twist: finished lines slowly sway in a virtual wind.

works.title: AR Foundation Demos: AR Shaders
works.description: A reel of shaders made for mobile AR: a wireframe over the room's LiDAR mesh, soft blurred shadows that ground objects on real tables, LiDAR depth fog and camera-grain-matched materials. The shaders were written by Arturo Nereu and Landon Townsend; Dan Miller put them into AR.
works.description_zh: 一组为手机 AR 制作的着色器集锦：覆盖在房间 LiDAR 网格上的线框、让物体稳稳落在真实桌面上的柔和模糊阴影、LiDAR 深度雾，以及与摄像头颗粒匹配的材质。着色器由 Arturo Nereu 和 Landon Townsend 编写，Dan Miller 负责把它们放进 AR。
works.idea_en: Shaders that ground and reveal virtual content are what make AR look real, and they can be shared as a library.
works.idea_zh: 让虚拟内容“落地”并显露真实空间的着色器决定了 AR 的真实感，它们可以作为一个库共享。
works.technique: URP Shader Graph shaders with custom HLSL nodes: barycentric vertex colors draw a wireframe on the ARKit mesh, stochastic contact shadows render on transparent planes, the ARKit background shader mixes in scene fog from LiDAR depth, and ARKit's camera-grain texture is applied to virtual materials.
works.technique_zh: 基于 URP Shader Graph 并带自定义 HLSL 节点：用重心坐标顶点色在 ARKit 网格上画线框，在透明平面上渲染随机采样的接触阴影，让 ARKit 背景着色器根据 LiDAR 深度混入场景雾，并把 ARKit 的摄像头颗粒纹理应用到虚拟材质上。
works.exercise_en: Import the AR shaders from arfoundation-demos, show the LiDAR mesh as a wireframe while scanning and ground each placed object with the blurred shadow. Twist: fade the wireframe out wherever the user has already placed content.
works.exercise_zh: 从 arfoundation-demos 导入 AR 着色器，扫描时用线框显示 LiDAR 网格，并用模糊阴影让每个放置的物体落地。变体：在用户已放置内容的地方让线框逐渐消失。

works.title: AR wallpaper lenses for Snap
works.description: Sketches for Zach's Snapchat lenses that wrap generative patterns across the walls and surfaces of a room like living wallpaper.
works.idea_zh: “AR就是新的墙纸”：把生成图案铺满房间的墙面和表面。

video.video_title: AR is the new wallpaper — excited to be working on some lenses for snap https://t.co/lFuM1oWbj8

works.technique: Lens Studio world mesh / plane detection supplies wall surfaces, and a generative shader with world-space UVs tiles animated patterns across them.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation 平面检测上给墙面铺一层会呼吸的程序化花纹（shader 用世界坐标做 UV）；变体：花纹随房间的环境光或声音改变，让宿舍墙变成“情绪壁纸”。
works.description_zh: Zach 为 Snapchat 滤镜做的草图：生成式图案像会呼吸的墙纸一样铺满房间的墙面和各个表面。
works.idea_en: AR is the new wallpaper: cover a room's walls and surfaces with generative patterns.
works.technique_zh: Lens Studio 的世界网格或平面检测提供墙面，使用世界空间 UV 的生成式着色器在墙面上平铺动态图案。
works.exercise_en: Lay a breathing procedural pattern over walls using plane detection in Lens Studio or AR Foundation, with a shader that uses world coordinates as UVs. Twist: the pattern changes with the room's ambient light or sound, turning a dorm wall into mood wallpaper.

works.title: AR-BEIT
works.description: Four interactive AR sculptures: a lamp that buries its head in the ground when you walk toward it, a silver spinning top that never stops, a watermelon striped like Mars floating in the air, and puzzle pieces of parallel universes you drag together.
works.description_zh: 四件可交互的 AR 雕塑：你走近时会把头埋进地里的台灯、永不停转的银色陀螺、条纹像火星一样悬浮在空中的西瓜，以及可以拖动拼合的“平行宇宙”拼图块。
works.idea_en: Everyday objects in AR behave in ways that question what is real.
works.idea_zh: AR 里的日常物件以出人意料的方式行动，让人怀疑什么才是真实。
works.technique: Phone AR placement via the Acute Art app with proximity triggers (the lamp reacts to the user's distance) and tap or drag gestures on the other pieces.
works.technique_zh: 通过 Acute Art App 在手机上放置 AR 作品，并使用距离触发（台灯根据用户距离做出反应）以及点击、拖动等手势来操作其他作品。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR object that reacts to how close the viewer comes: it hides, shrinks or turns away when approached. Twist: it only behaves normally when nobody is looking at it through the phone.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个会根据观众距离做出反应的 AR 物件：被靠近时它会躲起来、缩小或转身；变体：只有当没人用手机看着它时，它才恢复正常。

video.video_title: Alicja Kwade on Looking Twice at Everyday Objects | "The Looking Glass" exhibition now at The Shed

works.title: ARHide
works.description: A LiDAR-era experiment that makes real objects in the scene disappear or turn translucent in AR.
works.idea_zh: LiDAR 时代的“隐身”实验：让真实物体从画面中消失。

video.video_title: ARHide

works.technique: The LiDAR scene mesh is used to cut out a real object's region, which is filled with background captured earlier or rendered with reduced alpha to make the object vanish or turn translucent.
works.exercise_zh: 用 LiDAR 网格选中一件家具，用事先拍好的背景贴图把它覆盖掉；变体：让物体按时间逐渐变透明，像在“褪色”。
works.description_zh: 一个 LiDAR 时代的实验，让场景中的真实物体在 AR 中消失或变得半透明。
works.idea_en: A LiDAR-era invisibility experiment that makes real objects vanish from view.
works.technique_zh: 利用 LiDAR 场景网格抠出真实物体所在区域，再用事先采集的背景填充，或降低透明度渲染，使物体消失或变得半透明。
works.exercise_en: Select a piece of furniture with the LiDAR mesh and cover it with a background texture you photographed in advance. Twist: make the object turn transparent gradually over time, as if fading away.

works.title: Abcvfx: Alembic animation to VFX Graph
works.description: An Alembic-animated shape is turned into a stream of particles that follow and peel off its moving surface.
works.description_zh: 一个 Alembic 动画形体被变成粒子流，粒子跟随它移动的表面并不断剥落。
works.idea_en: Any baked animation can feed a particle system.
works.idea_zh: 任何烘焙好的动画都能喂给粒子系统。
works.technique: The Alembic mesh is sampled each frame (now via VFX Graph's dynamic mesh input) and particles spawn on its vertices with inherited velocity.
works.technique_zh: 每帧对 Alembic 网格采样（现在可用 VFX Graph 的动态网格输入），粒子在顶点上生成并继承速度。
works.exercise_en: Export a short Blender animation as Alembic, emit particles from it and place it on a real shelf with AR Foundation. Twist: particles stick to the real surfaces they fall on.
works.exercise_zh: 把一段 Blender 短动画导出为 Alembic，从它身上发射粒子，再用 AR Foundation 放到真实书架上。变体：粒子落到真实表面上会停住。

video.video_title: Alembic -> VFX Graph https://t.co/i2ZEYDrl8a https://t.co/p4FKoQwcQt

works.title: Acqua Alta – Crossing the Mirror (AR pop-up book)
works.description: A black-and-white ink pop-up book that, viewed through a phone or tablet, fills with animated rain, rising water and two dancing figures moving through its pages.
works.idea_zh: 透过手机看立体书，墨水画中的人物在页面间跳舞、被洪水淹没
works.technique: Marker-based AR recognises each pop-up spread and anchors motion-captured dance animation and water simulations to the paper geometry.
works.exercise_zh: 做一本3页的纸质立体书，用图像识别AR让每页出现一段动画；变化：翻页的顺序改变故事结局。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Pop Up Book By Adrien M & Claire B

works.description_zh: 一本黑白水墨立体书。透过手机或平板观看时，书页间会落下动画雨水、涨起洪水，两个舞动的人物在页面之间穿行。
works.idea_en: Through a phone, ink-drawn figures dance between the pages of a pop-up book and get swept up by a flood.
works.technique_zh: 基于标记的 AR 识别每一个立体跨页，把动作捕捉的舞蹈动画和水体模拟锚定在纸张的几何结构上。
works.exercise_en: Make a three-page paper pop-up book and use image-recognition AR to play an animation on each page. Twist: the order in which pages are turned changes the ending.

salient.why_en: A paper pop-up book where tiny figures live and drown in an ink flood you can only see through a tablet.
salient.why_zh: 一本纸做的立体书，只有透过平板才能看到里面的小人在墨水洪水中生活、沉没。

works.title: Akvj: Azure Kinect VJ set
works.description: Performers captured by an Azure Kinect are turned live into point clouds, meshes and particle storms for a VJ show.
works.description_zh: Azure Kinect 拍到的表演者被实时变成点云、网格和粒子风暴，用于 VJ 表演。
works.idea_en: A depth camera becomes a live visual instrument.
works.idea_zh: 深度相机变成一件现场视觉乐器。
works.technique: Akvfx turns Kinect depth into attribute maps and a surface mesh; HDRP renders several VFX Graph and shader effects that the VJ switches live.
works.technique_zh: Akvfx 把 Kinect 深度转换成属性贴图和表面网格，HDRP 渲染几套 VFX Graph 和着色器效果，由 VJ 现场切换。
works.exercise_en: Build three body effects on a LiDAR iPhone with AR Foundation and switch them with a MIDI pad or on-screen buttons during a short performance. Twist: let the dancer switch effects with a pose.
works.exercise_zh: 在 LiDAR iPhone 上用 AR Foundation 做三种人体特效，在一段短表演中用 MIDI 打击垫或屏幕按钮切换。变体：让舞者用一个姿势来切换特效。

video.video_title: Akvj - Azure Kinect with Unity

works.title: Anime-inspired scene (2D-Unity-Experiments)
works.description: A layered anime-style landscape with drifting clouds, glowing sky and parallax, composited live in Unity from flat layers.
works.description_zh: 一个分层的动漫风景：云在飘，天空在发光，前后景有视差，全部由平面图层在 Unity 中实时合成。
works.idea_en: Composite flat illustration layers with shaders until they feel like a living anime background.
works.idea_zh: 用着色器合成平面插画图层，直到它们像一张活的动漫背景。
works.technique: Separate cameras render layers to RenderTextures, and Shader Graph materials combine them with scrolling noise, gradient skies and bloom to animate a static illustration.
works.technique_zh: 多个相机把各图层渲染到 RenderTexture，再用 Shader Graph 材质叠加滚动噪声、渐变天空和泛光，让一张静态插画动起来。
works.exercise_en: Place the layered scene inside an AR portal on a wall so the anime sky moves with parallax as the phone moves. Twist: tint the sky layer with the real sky colour sampled from the camera.
works.exercise_zh: 把分层场景放进墙上的一个 AR 传送门里，手机移动时动漫天空产生视差。变体：用相机采样到的真实天空颜色给动漫天空上色。

video.video_title:
anime-inspired scene 
using @unity3d's RenderTextures / Shader Graph ✨

source: https://t.co/Emp8yOvNU6

#madewithunity #gamedev https://t.co/edDywEzKdW

works.title: Anti-Gone
works.description: A live mixed-reality performance (Sundance 2020) where a motion-captured performer drives an ork-like avatar through a simulated swamp in real time.
works.idea_zh: 动捕表演者实时驱动虚拟生物的沼泽剧场

video.video_title: Anti-Gone | Performance Preview (Sundance 2020 Premiere)

works.technique: Real-time motion capture streams the performer's skeleton into Unity, retargeted to a game avatar in a simulated environment and projected for a live audience.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 或手机动捕 App 实时驱动 Unity 里的一个奇怪生物，投影在墙上现场演一段 3 分钟的独白；变体：让观众通过手机投票改变生物所处环境的天气。
works.description_zh: 一场现场混合现实表演（2020 年圣丹斯电影节）：经动作捕捉的表演者实时驱动一个类似兽人的化身，穿行在模拟的沼泽中。
works.idea_en: A swamp theater where a motion-captured performer drives a virtual creature in real time.
works.technique_zh: 实时动作捕捉把表演者的骨骼数据传入 Unity，重定向到模拟环境中的游戏化身上，并投影给现场观众观看。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Pose or a phone motion-capture app to drive a strange creature in Unity in real time, and project it on a wall to perform a 3-minute monologue live. Twist: let the audience vote on their phones to change the weather in the creature's environment.

works.title: Antivanity Mirror
works.description: A small robotic mirror turns its face away whenever someone tries to look into it, so you can never see yourself.
works.description_zh: 一面小小的机械镜子，每当有人想照它时就把脸转开，让你永远看不到自己。
works.idea_en: A mirror that refuses to let you look at yourself.
works.idea_zh: 一面拒绝让你照见自己的镜子。
works.technique: A camera detects the viewer's face and servos rotate the mirror away from it in real time.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头检测观众的脸，舵机实时把镜子转离观众。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone app that shows the front camera but always pans or blurs the image away from any detected face. Twist: it only lets you see yourself when you close your eyes.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个显示前置摄像头的手机应用，但只要检测到人脸，就把画面移开或模糊掉。变体：只有当你闭上眼睛时，它才让你看见自己。

video.video_title: Antivanity Mirror

salient.why_en: A mirror that turns away whenever you try to look at yourself.
salient.why_zh: 一面每当你想照自己时就扭头躲开的镜子。

works.title: Aquatic: an AR journey into the deep sea
works.description: Wearing an AR headset, a visitor sees glowing deep-sea creatures and sparks of bioluminescence bloom over the coffee table and drift through a sunny office lounge.
works.description_zh: 戴上 AR 头显后，参观者看到发光的深海生物和点点生物荧光在咖啡桌上绽放，并飘过阳光充足的办公室休息区。
works.idea_en: Flood an ordinary room with the mysterious life of the deep sea.
works.idea_zh: 让普通房间充满深海里神秘的生命。
works.technique: Likely a head-worn AR display anchoring particle-based creatures to a table surface, with VFX for bioluminescent trails.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是用头戴式 AR 显示把粒子构成的生物锚定在桌面上，并用视觉特效做出生物荧光的轨迹。
works.exercise_en: Anchor one bioluminescent creature to a real object in phone AR and let it swim around that object. Twist: it only glows when the room lights are off.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 里把一只发光生物锚定在一个真实物体上，让它绕着物体游动。变体：只有关掉房间灯时它才会发光。

video.video_title: Aquatic: An augmented reality journey into mysterious deep sea

works.title: Audio Augmented Reality with face-tracking
works.description: An audio-first AR prototype that uses face tracking to follow your head and render spatial sound anchored in the room around you.
works.idea_zh: 用人脸追踪获取头部朝向，做只靠声音的空间AR。

video.video_title: Audio Augmented Reality with face-tracking

works.technique: Front-camera face tracking gives the head pose, which updates the audio listener orientation so sound sources stay world-anchored while the user turns their head.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit 人脸追踪获取头部转向，控制 Unity 中 AudioListener 的朝向，让一段声音固定在房间的某个方向；变体：做一个闭眼也能玩的“声音寻宝”。
works.description_zh: 一个以音频为核心的 AR 原型：利用人脸追踪跟随你的头部，渲染锚定在你周围房间中的空间声音。
works.idea_en: Use face tracking to get head direction and build spatial AR made only of sound.
works.technique_zh: 前置摄像头的人脸追踪提供头部位姿，并据此更新音频监听器的朝向，使用户转头时声源仍固定在世界空间中。
works.exercise_en: Use ARKit face tracking to get head rotation and drive the orientation of the AudioListener in Unity, so a sound stays fixed in one direction in the room. Twist: make a sound treasure hunt you can play with your eyes closed.

works.title: Augmented Empathy
works.description: An exhibition at FACT Liverpool built around Instagram AR face filters and installations that let visitors wear speculative future bodies and try on the feelings of other species.
works.description_zh: 在 FACT 利物浦举办的展览，以 Instagram AR 人脸滤镜和装置为核心，让观众“穿上”推想中的未来身体，试着感受其他物种的情绪。
works.idea_en: A face filter as a way to rehearse empathy with other beings.
works.idea_zh: 把人脸滤镜当作练习与其他生命共情的方式。
works.technique: Face-tracked effects built in Spark AR are published as Instagram filters and paired with gallery installations, so the work continues on visitors' own phones.
works.technique_zh: 用 Spark AR 制作的人脸追踪特效发布为 Instagram 滤镜，并与展厅装置配套，作品由此延续到观众自己的手机上。
works.exercise_en: Design a face filter that shows how a non-human (a tree, a bat, a river) might 'feel' today, using Lens Studio or Effect House. Twist: the filter changes only when two faces are in frame together.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 Effect House 设计一个人脸滤镜，表现一个非人类（一棵树、一只蝙蝠、一条河）今天的“心情”；变体：只有两张脸同时入镜时滤镜才会变化。

video.video_title: Keiken | Augmented Empathy | Artist Interview

works.title: Augmented Reality Gestures
works.description: A prototype of multi-touch gestures for navigating 3D AR content on a touch screen, with 3D pan, pinch and zoom mapped to the scene.
works.idea_zh: 为手机AR设计的一套三维多点触控手势。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Gestures - July 2020

works.technique: Multi-touch input is mapped to 3D transforms: one-finger drag pans along a plane, two-finger pinch scales, and twist rotates, with the mapping relative to the camera view.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中为一个模型实现单指平移、双指缩放和旋转，并请同学测试哪种手势最难懂；变体：设计一个新的三指手势。
works.description_zh: 一个在触摸屏上浏览三维 AR 内容的多点触控手势原型，把三维平移、捏合与缩放映射到场景上。
works.idea_en: A set of 3D multi-touch gestures designed for phone AR.
works.technique_zh: 多点触控输入被映射为三维变换：单指拖动沿平面平移，双指捏合缩放，扭转则旋转，映射均相对于相机视角。
works.exercise_en: Implement one-finger panning and two-finger scaling and rotation for a model in phone AR, and ask classmates to test which gesture is hardest to understand. Twist: design a new three-finger gesture.

works.title: BBC Earth - Micro Kingdoms: Senses
works.description: A leafcutter ant colony and a wandering spider appear on your floor at giant scale; narrated by Stephen Fry, you switch into their senses to perceive vibrations and smells as they do.
works.description_zh: 巨大的切叶蚁群落和游走蛛出现在你家地板上；在 Stephen Fry 的旁白中，你切换到它们的感官，像它们一样感知震动和气味。
works.idea_en: Put tiny creatures in your room at your size, then let you borrow their senses.
works.idea_zh: 把微小的生物放大到与你同等尺寸放进房间，再让你借用它们的感官。
works.technique: Places high-detail animated creatures on the mapped room surfaces of Magic Leap 1 and switches rendering modes to visualise non-human senses.
works.technique_zh: 在 Magic Leap 1 扫描出的房间表面上放置高精度的动画生物，并切换渲染模式来可视化非人类的感官。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone AR scene where a scaled-up insect walks on the table, then add a 'sense mode' button that turns vibrations from a tapped table into visible ripples. Twist: design a mode for a bat's echolocation using the microphone.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 场景，让一只放大的昆虫在桌上行走，再加一个“感官模式”按钮，把敲桌子产生的震动显示成可见的涟漪；变体：用麦克风为蝙蝠的回声定位设计一种模式。

video.video_title: BBC Earth - Micro Kingdoms: Senses on Magic Leap

works.title: Bosch AR
works.description: An iOS app that lets you pick one of five strange creatures from Hieronymus Bosch's Garden of Earthly Delights and release it, animated, into the world around you.
works.description_zh: 一款 iOS 应用，让你从博斯《人间乐园》中挑选五个怪异生物之一，把它以动画形式放进身边的真实世界。
works.idea_en: Let 500-year-old painted monsters walk out of the canvas and into your street.
works.idea_zh: 让五百年前画中的怪物走出画布，走上你家门口的街道。
works.technique: Characters redesigned in 3D from the painting, rigged and animated, then placed with ARKit plane detection in a Unity app.
works.technique_zh: 根据原画用 3D 重新设计角色，完成绑定与动画，再在 Unity 应用中用 ARKit 平面检测放置到现实中。
works.exercise_en: Choose a painting in the public domain, model one small character from it, and animate it walking on a real table in AR. Twist: the character reacts when it reaches the table edge.
works.exercise_zh: 选一幅公有领域的画作，为其中一个小角色建模，让它在 AR 中走在真实的桌面上；变体：角色走到桌边时会作出反应。

video.video_title: Bosch AR // Studio ANRK

salient.why_en: Monsters from a 500-year-old Bosch painting walk out of the canvas into your street.
salient.why_zh: 五百年前博斯画中的怪物走出画布，来到你的街道上。

works.title: Bruegel's Creatures
works.description: Monsters from Bruegel's 'The Fall of the Rebel Angels' crawl out of an engraving and roam Brussels Airport, while projection adds colour to the black-and-white print; the piece ends by revealing where the original painting hangs.
works.description_zh: 勃鲁盖尔《叛逆天使的堕落》中的怪物从一幅版画里爬出来，在布鲁塞尔机场里游荡，投影同时为黑白版画上色；结尾揭示原画收藏的地点。
works.idea_en: Colouring and animating a real print in place shows how AR can add a layer to an existing artefact without replacing it.
works.idea_zh: 在原地给真实版画上色、让它动起来，展示了 AR 如何在不替代原物的情况下，给现有作品加上一层。
works.technique: Projection mapped precisely onto an engraving adds colour fills, while 3D-animated creatures continue the motion onto surrounding surfaces.
works.technique_zh: 精确映射到版画上的投影负责填色，同时 3D 动画怪物把运动延续到周围的表面上。
works.exercise_en: Pick a black-and-white print, track it in Lens Studio or AR Foundation, and paint its regions with animated colour, then let one creature crawl off the edge onto the table. Twist: the colour spreads only where the viewer taps.
works.exercise_zh: 选一幅黑白版画，用 Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation 追踪它，给各个区域涂上会动的颜色，再让一只怪物从边缘爬到桌上；变体：颜色只在观众点击的地方扩散。

video.video_title: Bruegel's Creatures

works.title: BurstWig: flowing hair-like strands
works.description: Thousands of long strands grow out of a moving object and swing and flow like hair in the wind.
works.description_zh: 成千上万根长丝从一个运动的物体上长出来，像风中的头发一样摆动飘荡。
works.idea_en: Strands with simple spring physics feel organic.
works.idea_zh: 加上简单弹簧物理的细丝，就有了生命感。
works.technique: Each strand is a chain of points solved with Verlet-style spring constraints in Burst-compiled jobs, then drawn with VFX Graph particle strips.
works.technique_zh: 每根丝是一串点，在 Burst 编译的任务中用类似 Verlet 的弹簧约束求解，再用 VFX Graph 粒子条带绘制。
works.exercise_en: Attach a wig of strands to a tracked face with AR Foundation face tracking so it swings as you turn your head. Twist: let the wind come from the microphone.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 面部追踪给脸上接一顶丝状假发，转头时它会摆动。变体：风力来自麦克风。

video.video_title:
Burst Compiler, C# Job System, VFX Graph, HDRP
https://t.co/Il8lqcoWzs https://t.co/OlkQiaH0BJ

works.title: COVID-19 data visualization with HoloLens 2
works.description: An open-source HoloLens 2 app that shows COVID-19 case numbers as volumetric bars on a 3D globe floating in the room, which people rotate and inspect directly with their hands.
works.description_zh: 一款开源的 HoloLens 2 应用：把新冠病例数据以立体柱状图的形式呈现在房间中漂浮的 3D 地球上，人们可以直接用手旋转和查看。
works.idea_en: Put a global dataset on a globe you can hold in your hands.
works.idea_zh: 把全球数据放在一个可以捧在手里的地球上。
works.technique: Case data from ESRI's COVID-19 feature layer is mapped to bars on a globe mesh, with MRTK hand interactions for rotating, scaling and selecting countries.
works.technique_zh: 把 ESRI 新冠数据图层中的病例数据映射为地球网格上的柱体，并用 MRTK 手势交互来旋转、缩放和选择国家。
works.exercise_en: Load a small open dataset (for example, air quality by city) into a phone AR globe on a table, with bar height per city and tap-to-read labels. Twist: scrub time by walking around the globe.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个小型公开数据集（例如各城市空气质量）加载到桌面上的手机 AR 地球中，用柱高表示各城市数值，点击查看标签；变体：绕着地球走一圈就能拖动时间轴。

video.video_title: COVID19 (Coronavirus) Data Visualization with HoloLens2 + MRTK (Mixed Reality Toolkit)

works.title: Chimera: Particle Advection
works.description: VFX Graph particles are carried along by a live 2D fluid simulation, curling into vortices wherever the fluid is stirred.
works.description_zh: VFX Graph 粒子被实时二维流体带着走，在流体被搅动的地方卷成漩涡。
works.idea_en: Let a fluid, not a noise function, decide where particles go.
works.idea_zh: 让流体而不是噪声函数，决定粒子往哪里去。
works.technique: The fluid's velocity is stored in the R and G channels of a render texture, which VFX Graph samples each frame to set particle velocity.
works.technique_zh: 流体速度存放在渲染纹理的 R、G 通道里，VFX Graph 每帧采样这张纹理来设置粒子速度。
works.exercise_en: Lay the fluid texture over an AR table top and emit particles from a tracked real object as it slides across. Twist: make the particles sample the fluid only inside the camera's people-occlusion mask.
works.exercise_zh: 把流体纹理铺在 AR 桌面上，让一个被追踪的真实物体滑过时发射粒子。变体：粒子只在摄像头的人物遮挡蒙版内采样流体。

video.video_title:
Advecting #visualeffectgraph particles with a fluid simulation.
#unity3d #realtime #madewithunity https://t.co/PlfqNQt7xh

works.title: Coding Adventure: Portals
works.description: The player walks and throws objects through seamless portals that connect distant rooms, seeing through each one without a visible seam.
works.description_zh: 玩家穿过无缝的传送门行走、扔东西，门连接远处的房间，透过门看过去毫无破绽。
works.idea_en: A portal is a second camera whose image is pasted exactly where the doorway is.
works.idea_zh: 传送门就是第二台相机，把它的画面精确贴在门洞上。
works.technique: Each portal renders a linked camera into a texture using screen-space UVs, applies an oblique near-clip plane, handles recursion and slices objects that are halfway through.
works.technique_zh: 每扇门用链接的相机渲染到纹理，并按屏幕空间 UV 贴上；再使用斜近裁剪面、处理递归，并切开正穿过一半的物体。
works.exercise_en: Anchor two portals to two real doors in AR so the view through one shows the room behind the other. Twist: the linked room is a virtual copy of the classroom at night.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把两扇传送门锚在两扇真实的门上，透过一扇看到另一扇门后面的房间。变体：连接的房间是教室夜晚的虚拟副本。

video.video_title: Coding Adventure: Portals

works.title: Connected
works.description: An immersive room at Nxt Museum made with sound artist Marc Mahfoud: light projected on the floor links the visitors standing in it, turning each person's personal space into a shared space. Here it is the set of Benny Benassi and Bloom Twins' music video DayDream.
works.description_zh: 与声音艺术家 Marc Mahfoud 在 Nxt Museum 合作的沉浸式空间：投在地面上的光把站在其中的观众连接起来，让每个人的私人空间变成共享空间。这段视频是 Benny Benassi 与 Bloom Twins 的音乐录像 DayDream，就在这件作品中拍摄。
works.idea_en: Draw the invisible lines between strangers on the floor.
works.idea_zh: 把陌生人之间看不见的连线画在地板上。
works.technique: Overhead tracking (likely depth or infrared cameras) finds each visitor's position and a ceiling projector draws lines and shapes between them in real time, with a spatial soundscape.
works.technique_zh: 顶部追踪（推测为深度或红外摄像头）获取每位观众的位置，天花板上的投影仪实时在他们之间绘制线条和图形，并配合空间声景。
works.exercise_en: Mount a webcam and a cheap projector overhead, track people as blobs with OpenCV or TouchDesigner, and project a line between every pair of people. Twist: lines only appear between people who are standing still.
works.exercise_zh: 在头顶架设摄像头和廉价投影仪，用 OpenCV 或 TouchDesigner 把人识别为色块，在每两个人之间投出一条线；变体：只有站着不动的人之间才会出现连线。

video.video_title: Benny Benassi & Bloom Twins - DayDream (Official Video) [Ultra Music]

salient.why_en: Lines of light on the floor join the strangers standing in the room, so each person's personal space becomes shared.
salient.why_zh: 地面上的光线把房间里的陌生人连在一起，每个人的私人空间变成了共享空间。

works.title: Copy and paste into AR
works.description: Images and art copied on the phone are pasted straight into the surrounding space as AR objects, with no editing step.
works.idea_zh: 复制一张图，直接'粘贴'到现实空间里。

video.video_title: you can now copy and paste directly into AR, coming in the next update! https://t.co/Ttz1u4rqVv

works.technique: Clipboard images are background-removed and spawned as textured quads at the AR raycast hit point.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个网页 AR（8th Wall/WebXR）：从相册选图后贴到墙上当'虚拟海报'；加一个变化：贴上的图会被其他同学看到并留言。
works.description_zh: 在手机上复制的图片和艺术作品会直接作为 AR 物体粘贴到周围空间中，无需任何编辑步骤。
works.idea_en: Copy an image and paste it straight into real space.
works.technique_zh: 剪贴板中的图片经去除背景后，作为带纹理的四边形面片生成在 AR 射线检测的命中点上。
works.exercise_en: Build web AR with 8th Wall or WebXR that lets you pick an image from the photo album and stick it on a wall as a virtual poster. Twist: posted images can be seen and commented on by other classmates.

works.title: Copy printed text to desktop with AR+ML
works.description: The sixth of his ten AI+UX prototypes: aim the phone at a paragraph in a printed book, and the recognised text is pasted into a document on the computer where the phone points.
works.description_zh: 他十个 AI+UX 原型中的第六个：把手机对准纸质书上的一段文字，识别出的文本会被粘贴到电脑文档里手机所指的位置。
works.idea_en: Treat printed text as something you can pick up and drop into a digital document.
works.idea_zh: 把印刷文字当成可以“拿起来”再放进数字文档里的东西。
works.technique: Likely combines on-device OCR of the camera frame with the same screen-matching trick as AR Cut & Paste to locate the target point on the desktop.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是先对摄像头画面做文字识别（OCR），再用与 AR Cut & Paste 相同的屏幕匹配方法确定电脑上的目标位置。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone web app that reads a printed sentence with an OCR library and posts it to a shared class web page in real time. Twist: let the sentence appear in the page's font and size of the place where the phone is aimed.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机网页应用：用 OCR 库识别纸上的一句话，并实时发布到全班共享的网页上；变体：让这句话以手机所指位置的字体和字号出现在网页上。

Proto 6/10: Copy printed text to desktop with AR+ML

works.title: Cubism Shader
works.description: A 3D scene is broken into Voronoi shards, each showing the view from a slightly different angle, like a Cubist painting in motion.
works.description_zh: 三维场景被切成一块块 Voronoi 碎片，每块显示略微不同角度的画面，像一幅会动的立体主义画作。
works.idea_en: Show several viewpoints at once, as Picasso did, but live.
works.idea_zh: 像毕加索那样同时呈现多个视角，只不过是实时的。
works.technique: A post-process segments the screen with a Voronoi pattern and, per cell, samples the scene rendered from offset camera transforms, so each shard has its own perspective.
works.technique_zh: 后期处理用 Voronoi 图案把画面分块，每个单元从偏移过的相机视角采样场景，因此每块碎片都有自己的透视。
works.exercise_en: Apply the Voronoi cubism pass to the AR camera image on a phone, giving each cell a different delay or zoom. Twist: the cells grow bigger when the room gets louder.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机上对 AR 相机画面做 Voronoi 立体主义处理，让每个单元有不同的延迟或缩放。变体：房间越吵，碎片越大。

video.video_title: Cubism Shader in Unity 3D

works.title: DAZZLE: A Re-assembly of Bodies
works.description: A participatory VR dance ball inspired by the 1919 Chelsea Arts Club Dazzle Ball: visitors in zero-waste costumes are motion-captured and dance as avatars alongside live performers in mocap suits.
works.description_zh: 受 1919 年切尔西艺术俱乐部“炫目舞会”启发的参与式 VR 舞会：身着零浪费服装的观众被动作捕捉，以化身形式与穿着动捕服的现场舞者一起跳舞。
works.idea_en: A ball where everyone, audience included, dances as a live avatar.
works.idea_zh: 一场舞会，包括观众在内的每个人都以实时化身起舞。
works.technique: Live optical motion capture streams performers and visitors into a shared real-time VR world, with a virtual camera recording the event.
works.technique_zh: 现场光学动作捕捉把表演者和观众的动作实时传入共享的 VR 世界，并由虚拟摄像机记录全过程。
works.exercise_en: Stream two people's webcam poses into one shared web scene as abstract avatars, and play music so they dance together remotely. Twist: each avatar wears the other person's colours.
works.exercise_zh: 把两个人的摄像头姿态实时传到同一个网页场景里，以抽象化身呈现，放音乐让他们远程共舞；变体：每个化身都穿着对方的颜色。

video.video_title: DAZZLE: A Re-assembly of Bodies - a participatory dance in Virtual Reality (10 min)

works.title: DOUBLE (DARKFIELD RADIO)
works.description: Two people who live together sit at their own kitchen table facing each other, put on headphones and close their eyes; a phone app then plays a story about the Capgras delusion, the fear that a loved one has been replaced by an exact copy.
works.description_zh: 两位同住的人在自家厨房餐桌两侧相对而坐，戴上耳机、闭上眼睛；手机应用播放一个关于卡普格拉综合征的故事——害怕亲人被一模一样的替身取代。
works.idea_en: Your own kitchen and the person opposite you become the set of an audio play.
works.idea_zh: 你自家的厨房和对面的人，成了一出音频剧的布景。
works.technique: A phone app delivers a timed binaural recording scripted around a standard layout (two chairs, a table), so the sounds of footsteps and voices land convincingly in the listeners' own room.
works.technique_zh: 手机应用按时播放双耳录音，剧本围绕一种标准布局（两把椅子、一张桌子）编写，因此脚步声和人声能逼真地“落”在听众自己的房间里。
works.exercise_en: Script and record a 3-minute audio piece for two listeners at any table, including instructions such as 'reach out and touch the other person's hand'. Twist: give the two listeners slightly different tracks so they no longer trust each other.
works.exercise_zh: 为两位坐在任意桌边的听众编写并录制一段 3 分钟音频，其中包含“伸手碰一下对方的手”之类的指令；变体：给两人略有不同的音轨，让他们开始怀疑彼此。

video.video_title: DOUBLE - DARKFIELD Radio

works.title: Deep Dancing
works.description: A dancer's whole body becomes a musical instrument: in an immersive room, her tracked coordinates move and shape a spatial soundscape, so viewers can hear the quality of her movement as well as see it.
works.description_zh: 舞者整个身体变成乐器：在沉浸式空间里，她被追踪的坐标移动并塑造空间声景，观众不仅看见、也能听见她的动作质感。
works.idea_en: Hear how someone moves, not only see it.
works.idea_zh: 不只是看见，还能听见一个人怎样移动。
works.technique: Motion-capture data from a Motive system is sent to Max/MSP, where it drives spatial sound synthesis in the Immersive Arts Space at ZHdK.
works.technique_zh: Motive 动作捕捉系统的数据传入 Max/MSP，在苏黎世艺术大学的沉浸式艺术空间里驱动空间声音合成。
works.exercise_en: Map a performer's position from a webcam to left-right panning and hand height to pitch in a Web Audio page, played on four speakers around the room. Twist: sound only moves when the body moves smoothly.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Web Audio 网页中，把摄像头测到的表演者位置映射为左右声像、手的高度映射为音高，在房间四周四个扬声器播放；变体：只有身体流畅运动时声音才移动。

video.video_title: Deep Dancing by Irini Kalaitzidi & Julien Mercier (2020)

works.title: DepthLab
works.description: A library of dozens of phone-AR interactions built only from a depth map: virtual objects hide behind real furniture, splat paint on walls, cast shadows, bounce on the floor and get lit by virtual lights.
works.description_zh: 一个包含数十种手机 AR 交互的库，全部只依赖深度图：虚拟物体会躲到真实家具后面，把颜料溅到墙上，投下阴影，在地板上弹跳，并被虚拟灯光照亮。
works.idea_en: Once a phone knows depth, occlusion, physics and relighting become cheap building blocks for play.
works.idea_zh: 只要手机知道深度，遮挡、物理和重新打光就成了便宜好用的游戏积木。
works.technique: Monocular depth from the ARCore Depth API is used per pixel for occlusion, converted to a mesh for collisions and to surface normals for lighting and splats.
works.technique_zh: 利用 ARCore Depth API 提供的单目深度，逐像素处理遮挡，转换成网格用于碰撞，再计算表面法线用于光照和溅射效果。
works.exercise_en: Use AR occlusion and mesh collisions to make a ball that rolls under your real table and hides behind the chair. Twist: let the ball leave a paint trail on every real surface it touches.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR 遮挡和网格碰撞做一个会滚到真实桌子底下、躲到椅子后面的球。变体：让球在它碰到的每个真实表面上留下颜料痕迹。

video.video_title: DepthLab: Real-Time 3D Interaction With Depth Maps for Mobile Augmented Reality (UIST 2020)

works.title: Doodle face masks in the browser
works.description: Draw a doodle on a flat face template in the browser and it instantly becomes a mask that follows your real face in the webcam, stretching with every expression.
works.description_zh: 在浏览器里的平面脸部模板上随手涂鸦，涂鸦会立刻变成一张面具，贴合摄像头里你的真实脸部，并随每个表情拉伸变形。
works.idea_en: Anyone can design a face filter by drawing on a flat map of a face.
works.idea_zh: 任何人只要在一张平面脸谱上画画，就能设计出自己的脸部滤镜。
works.technique: TensorFlow.js FaceMesh predicts 468 face landmarks; a 3D mesh with a fixed UV layout is aligned to them each frame, so a 2D drawing on the UV texture wraps onto the moving face.
works.technique_zh: TensorFlow.js 的 FaceMesh 预测 468 个人脸关键点，每一帧把一个 UV 展开固定的 3D 网格对齐到这些点上，于是画在 UV 贴图上的二维涂鸦就能包裹在运动的脸上。
works.exercise_en: Use a MediaPipe FaceMesh web template to map a student's drawing onto the face texture, then hold a 'mask parade' where everyone wears a classmate's doodle. Twist: make parts of the drawing animate when the mouth opens.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe FaceMesh 网页模板把学生的画贴到脸部贴图上，再办一场“面具游行”，每人戴上同学画的面具；变体：让涂鸦的某些部分在张嘴时动起来。
