Doodle face masks right from the browser with #TensorflowJS and #FaceMesh

Demo: https://t.co/JfyzGjpnIx
Code: https://t.co/xLpsrJb4Sk

#FaceFilter #MadeWithTFJS  #AR #A

works.title: Dynamic hair and petals (2D-Unity-Experiments)
works.description: A 2D character's long hair sways and bounces as she moves while cherry petals fall around her.
works.description_zh: 一个 2D 角色的长发随着动作摇摆弹动，樱花花瓣在她周围飘落。
works.idea_en: Give flat 2D art physical secondary motion with a chain of joints.
works.idea_zh: 用一串关节给平面 2D 美术加上物理的二次运动。
works.technique: Hair strands are rigged with Unity's 2D Animation bones and connected with HingeJoint2D chains so physics drives the bones, while petals are a particle system.
works.technique_zh: 头发用 Unity 2D Animation 的骨骼绑定，再用 HingeJoint2D 链连接，让物理驱动骨骼；花瓣则是一个粒子系统。
works.exercise_en: Stand a 2D paper-doll character on an AR plane and let the phone's motion swing her hair through the joint chain. Twist: blow into the microphone to create wind that lifts the hair and petals.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个 2D 纸片人立在 AR 平面上，让手机的运动通过关节链甩动她的头发。变体：对着麦克风吹气产生风，吹起头发和花瓣。

video.video_title:
dynamic hair and petals 🌸
using @unity3d's 2d animation package + hinge joints 😳

source: https://t.co/Emp8yONpiG

#madewithunity #gamedev https://t.co/gxyvb8JCiz

works.title: Dynamicland (progress report)
works.description: A tour of the Oakland Dynamicland space: pages of code on paper, projected visualizations, tangible programming kits and collaborative projects.
works.idea_zh: 一座没有屏幕的计算机大楼：纸上的代码、桌上的投影、大家围在一起编程。

video.video_title: Dynamicland progress report, May 2020

works.technique: Every program is a printed page identified by dot codes, a room-wide camera-projector system (Realtalk) tracks pages and objects and runs their code, so programs communicate by statements about physical positions.
works.exercise_zh: 用投影仪 + 摄像头搭建一张“可编程桌子”：打印 5 张带标记的纸，每张对应一个函数（如“画圆”“变红”“向右移动”），把纸指向另一张纸时把效果作用在它上面；变体：设计一张能“读取”其他纸张内容的“元程序”纸。
works.description_zh: 带你参观奥克兰的 Dynamicland 空间：写在纸上的代码页、投影出的可视化、实体编程套件，以及各种协作项目。
works.idea_en: A computer the size of a building with no screens: code on paper, projections on tables, and people programming together around them.
works.technique_zh: 每个程序都是一张通过点阵码识别的打印纸页，覆盖整个房间的摄像头-投影仪系统（Realtalk）追踪纸页和物体并运行其中的代码，程序之间通过关于物理位置的陈述相互通信。
works.exercise_en: Build a programmable table with a projector and a camera: print 5 marker-tagged sheets, each standing for a function such as draw a circle, turn red or move right, and apply a sheet's effect to another sheet when you point it at that sheet. Twist: design a meta-program sheet that can read the contents of other sheets.

works.title: Earth Speakr
works.description: An AR app for children in which kids record their voice and facial expressions and 'lend' them to places and objects in the world — trees, rivers, buildings — to speak for the planet.
works.idea_zh: 孩子把自己的脸和声音借给树木、河流，让地球开口说话
works.technique: Face tracking captures the child's expressions and voice, which are mapped onto AR 'faces' placed on real objects detected through the phone camera.
works.exercise_zh: 用AR面部驱动（如Snap Lens或Reality Composer）把自己的表情贴到校园的一棵树上，录一句“树想说的话”；变化：全班的树组成一场对话。

video.video_title: Are you an Earth Speakr?

works.description_zh: 一款面向儿童的 AR 应用：孩子们录下自己的声音和面部表情，把它们“借给”世界上的地点和物体——树木、河流、建筑——让它们为地球发声。
works.idea_en: Children lend their faces and voices to trees and rivers so the Earth can speak.
works.technique_zh: 面部追踪捕捉孩子的表情和声音，并将其映射到手机摄像头检测到的真实物体上放置的 AR“脸”上。
works.exercise_en: Use AR face puppeteering, for example a Snap Lens or Reality Composer, to put your expressions on a tree on campus and record one line of what the tree wants to say. Twist: the whole class's trees form a conversation.

salient.why_en: Children lend their faces and voices to trees and rivers so the planet can speak.
salient.why_zh: 孩子把自己的脸和声音借给树木与河流，让地球开口说话。

works.title: Effluve (Faire corps)
works.description: In the Faire corps exhibition, visitors stand before a projected field of particles that drift like vapour and respond to their gestures and presence.
works.description_zh: 在 Faire corps 展览中，观众站在一片投影粒子场前，粒子像水汽一样飘散，并回应他们的手势和存在。
works.idea_en: Let visitors breathe life into a cloud of light with their bodies.
works.idea_zh: 让观众用身体为一团光注入生命。
works.technique: Body tracking likely drives a physics-based particle system (probably the studio's own eMotion tool) projected at human scale.
works.technique_zh: 可能由身体追踪驱动基于物理的粒子系统（大概率是工作室自研的 eMotion 工具），以人体尺度投影呈现。
works.exercise_en: Project a particle cloud on a wall and push it with a webcam optical-flow field so gestures blow the particles like mist. Twist: particles slowly form the silhouette of the last visitor.
works.exercise_zh: 在墙上投出一团粒子，用摄像头光流场推动它，让手势像吹雾一样吹动粒子；变体：粒子慢慢聚成上一位观众的轮廓。

video.video_title: Effluve - Faire corps - Adrien M & Claire B

works.title: ElaMorph Projection
works.description: Projection alone makes a rigid 3D object appear to stretch and deform elastically as it moves, exploiting high-speed tracking and perception.
works.idea_zh: 只靠投影就让坚硬的物体看起来像橡皮一样弹性变形。

video.video_title: ElaMorph Projection: Deformation of 3D Shape by Dynamic Projection Mapping

works.technique: The rigid object's motion is tracked at high speed and projected shading and texture are warped according to a simulated elastic deformation driven by that motion, exploiting perception so the object looks as if it stretches.
works.exercise_zh: 追踪一个手持的白色纸盒，给投影在上面的图案加上随加速度拉伸和回弹的形变（可用弹簧模型），让观众觉得盒子是软的；变体：做一段“硬物变软”的短视频，并调查观众是否真的被骗。
works.description_zh: 仅凭投影，就让一个坚硬的三维物体在运动时看起来像被弹性拉伸和变形，利用的是高速追踪与人的感知机制。
works.idea_en: Projection alone makes a hard object look as stretchy as rubber.
works.technique_zh: 高速追踪刚性物体的运动，并根据由该运动驱动的弹性形变模拟来扭曲投影的明暗和纹理，借助感知错觉使物体看起来像在拉伸。
works.exercise_en: Track a hand-held white paper box and give the pattern projected onto it a stretch-and-rebound deformation driven by acceleration, for example with a spring model, so viewers feel the box is soft. Twist: make a short video of a hard object turning soft and survey whether viewers are actually fooled.

salient.why_en: Projected light alone makes a rigid object look as stretchy as rubber.
salient.why_zh: 仅靠投影，就让一个坚硬的物体看起来像橡胶一样有弹性。

works.title: Embodied Axes
works.description: Three physical, motorised sliders arranged as x, y and z axes let users select ranges in a 3D data visualisation that floats above them in an AR headset.
works.description_zh: 三根带电机的实体滑轨组成 x、y、z 坐标轴，用户用它们在 AR 头显中悬浮于其上的 3D 数据可视化里选择数据范围。
works.idea_en: Turn the axes of a 3D chart into physical objects you can grab.
works.idea_zh: 把 3D 图表的坐标轴变成可以抓在手里的实体。
works.technique: The tangible controller is registered to a HoloLens scene, and actuated sliders both read the user's input and move to reflect selections made elsewhere.
works.technique_zh: 这个实体控制器与 HoloLens 场景对齐，带驱动的滑块既读取用户输入，也会移动以反映其他地方做出的选择。
works.exercise_en: Mark three rulers on a table as axes, track them with image markers and show a 3D scatter plot above them in phone AR; use a clothespin on each ruler to filter. Twist: let two people filter at once.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌上把三把尺子当作坐标轴，用图像标记追踪，并在手机 AR 中于其上方显示 3D 散点图；在每把尺子上夹一个夹子来筛选数据。变体：让两个人同时筛选。

video.video_title: Embodied Axes: Tangible, Actuated Interaction for 3D Augmented Reality Data Spaces

works.title: Embryogenesis (with Gabriel Schama)
works.description: A layered, laser-cut wooden relief by Gabriel Schama is brought to life by 4K projection mapping: light flows through its intricate layers so the static sculpture seems to grow like an embryo.
works.description_zh: Gabriel Schama 制作的多层激光切割木雕，被 4K 投影映射激活：光在复杂的层次间流动，让静止的雕塑看起来像胚胎一样在生长。
works.idea_en: A detailed physical object gives projected light something to hold on to; AR effects also read best when they follow the real depth and edges of an object.
works.idea_zh: 细节丰富的实体物件让投影的光有了可以附着的结构；AR 特效同样在贴合物体真实深度和边缘时最好看。
works.technique: Content is mapped layer by layer onto the carved wood from a digital model of the relief, projected with a single high-resolution Panasonic projector.
works.technique_zh: 根据木雕的数字模型逐层映射内容，用一台高分辨率 Panasonic 投影机投出。
works.exercise_en: Scan a textured object (a carved box, a plant) with LiDAR and write a Lens Studio or Unity shader that sends light waves across its real depth layers. Twist: the waves follow the viewer's breathing via the microphone.
works.exercise_zh: 用 LiDAR 扫描一个有纹理的物体（雕花盒子、植物），在 Lens Studio 或 Unity 里写一个让光波沿着真实深度层流动的着色器；变体：通过麦克风让光波跟随观者的呼吸。

video.video_title: Embryogenesis, 3D Projection Mapping on Intricate Wood Art, 2020

works.title: Everyday Experiments
works.description: The launch film of IKEA and SPACE10's collection of 18 spatial-computing experiments for the home, from rooms that rearrange themselves in AR to virtual forts built from your furniture.
works.description_zh: IKEA 与 SPACE10 推出的 18 个家居空间计算实验合集的发布短片，从在 AR 中自动重新布置的房间，到用家具搭成的虚拟城堡。
works.idea_en: Ask many small 'what if' questions about everyday home life and answer each with a quick prototype.
works.idea_zh: 针对日常家居生活提出许多小小的“如果……会怎样”，并用快速原型逐一回答。
works.technique: Each studio built a short phone prototype using ARKit, LiDAR, object detection or machine learning, documented as a video and a one-page idea.
works.technique_zh: 每个工作室用 ARKit、LiDAR、物体识别或机器学习做一个简短的手机原型，并以一段视频和一页创意说明记录下来。
works.exercise_en: Run a mini 'Everyday Experiments' sprint: each team picks one household chore and prototypes a 60-second phone AR idea that makes it more playful. Twist: the idea must work without any text.
works.exercise_zh: 做一次迷你版 Everyday Experiments：每组选一件家务，用手机 AR 做一个 60 秒的创意原型，让它变得更好玩。变体：创意必须完全不用文字。

video.video_title: Everyday Experiments

works.title: Eyeball: procedural iris that follows you
works.description: A realistic eyeball with a procedurally generated iris rolls to follow the mouse, its pupil tightening and widening.
works.description_zh: 一只逼真的眼球，虹膜是程序生成的，它会转动跟随鼠标，瞳孔会收缩放大。
works.idea_en: An object that looks back at you feels alive.
works.idea_zh: 会回看你的物体，就像活的。
works.technique: A VFX Shader Graph builds the iris from polar-coordinate noise and layered rings, and a script rotates the eye toward the pointer.
works.technique_zh: VFX Shader Graph 用极坐标噪声和多层圆环生成虹膜，脚本让眼球朝向指针旋转。
works.exercise_en: Place a procedural eyeball in AR Foundation that always turns to face the phone camera. Twist: fill a real wall with dozens of eyes that blink when you come close.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 里放一只程序化眼球，它总是转向手机镜头。变体：在真实墙上铺满几十只眼睛，你靠近时它们眨眼。

video.video_title: Made it interactive. https://t.co/TvBw2K4Wuo https://t.co/GNY6aAx34F

works.title: Face filter from a single photo
works.description: A face filter is generated from one photo of another person and mapped onto the user's live face so it follows expressions.
works.idea_zh: 只用一张照片，就能把别人的脸变成你的实时滤镜。

video.video_title: Face filter from a single photo

works.technique: Landmarks from a single photo are used to build a textured face mesh that is warped onto the live tracked face (likely a 2D morphable mapping).
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe FaceMesh 把一张名人或名画照片做成贴合自己脸的面具；加一个变化：面具只在你笑时出现。
works.description_zh: 根据另一个人的一张照片生成人脸滤镜，并映射到用户的实时面部上，跟随表情变化。
works.idea_en: From just one photo, turn someone else's face into your live filter.
works.technique_zh: 利用单张照片中的面部关键点构建带纹理的面部网格，并将其变形贴合到实时追踪的人脸上（大概率是一种二维可变形映射）。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe FaceMesh to turn a photo of a celebrity or a famous painting into a mask that fits your own face. Twist: the mask appears only when you smile.

works.title: Fast Plane Detection and Classification with LiDAR
works.description: Visualises the LiDAR iPad Pro instantly classifying floor, walls, ceiling and furniture as coloured surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 可视化 LiDAR 瞬间识别出地板、墙、天花板和家具。

video.video_title: Fast plane detection and classification with ARKit3.5 + iPad pro

works.technique: ARKit scene reconstruction on LiDAR provides per-face semantic classification (floor, wall, ceiling, table, seat), which is visualized by coloring mesh faces by class.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation ARMeshManager 读取网格分类，给地板、墙、桌子不同颜色；变体：只在“座椅”类表面上放一只会坐下的角色。
works.description_zh: 可视化呈现 LiDAR 版 iPad Pro 如何瞬间把地板、墙面、天花板和家具分类为不同颜色的表面。
works.idea_en: Visualize LiDAR instantly recognizing floors, walls, ceilings and furniture.
works.technique_zh: 基于 LiDAR 的 ARKit 场景重建为每个网格面提供语义分类（地板、墙面、天花板、桌子、座椅），并按类别为网格面着色进行可视化。
works.exercise_en: Read mesh classifications with AR Foundation's ARMeshManager and give floors, walls and tables different colors. Twist: place a character that sits down only on seat-class surfaces.

works.title: Fluid Simulation in Compute Shaders
works.description: Coloured dye swirls and curls around a 3D model as a full Navier-Stokes fluid solver runs on the GPU, reacting to where the user injects force.
works.description_zh: 彩色染料在一个三维模型周围旋转翻卷：完整的 Navier-Stokes 流体解算在 GPU 上运行，并对用户注入力的位置作出反应。
works.idea_en: A full fluid solver fits in a handful of compute-shader passes and can paint any surface with moving ink.
works.idea_zh: 一个完整的流体解算器只需几个计算着色器 pass，就能让任何表面流动起墨水。
works.technique: Stable-fluids style advection, divergence, pressure (Jacobi) and projection passes run as Unity compute shaders on 2D/3D render textures, and the velocity field advects a dye texture.
works.technique_zh: 按 stable fluids 思路，在 Unity 计算着色器里对二维/三维渲染纹理依次做平流、散度、压力（Jacobi 迭代）和投影，再用速度场平流一张染料纹理。
works.exercise_en: Port the repo's 2D solver to a phone and project it onto an AR plane found by AR Foundation, injecting dye where the user touches the floor. Twist: use the device's motion as the force so walking stirs the ink.
works.exercise_zh: 把仓库里的二维流体解算移植到手机，用 AR Foundation 找到地面平面并投在上面，用户点击地面的位置注入染料。变体：把手机的移动当作力，让走动就能搅动墨水。

video.video_title: Unity3D Fluid Simulation in Compute Shader

works.title: Fly with Aerocene Pacha
works.description: Over the Salinas Grandes salt flats in Argentina, Leticia Marqués made the world's most sustainable manned flight, lifted only by the sun in the Aerocene Pacha balloon, carrying the message 'Water and life are worth more than lithium'.
works.description_zh: 在阿根廷萨利纳斯格兰德盐沼上空，Leticia Marqués 乘坐仅靠太阳升空的 Aerocene Pacha 气球完成了世界上最可持续的载人飞行，气球上写着“水与生命比锂更珍贵”。
works.idea_en: A human lifted by the sun over a threatened landscape links a body, a message and a place, the three things a strong location AR work needs.
works.idea_zh: 一个被太阳托起、飞越受威胁风景的人，把身体、信息和地点联系在一起，这正是一件有力的位置 AR 作品所需的三要素。
works.technique: A large black solar balloon heats up in the sun and rises with a pilot; the flight set records for solar-only lighter-than-air flight.
works.technique_zh: 大型黑色太阳能气球在阳光下升温，载着飞行员升空；这次飞行创下了纯太阳能轻于空气飞行的纪录。
works.exercise_en: Stage an AR balloon launch on a real landscape under threat (a river, a green space) that carries a user-written message readable from below. Twist: the balloon only rises on sunny days.
works.exercise_zh: 在一处真实的受威胁风景（河流、绿地）上举行一次 AR 气球放飞，气球带着用户写下、从下方可读的信息；变体：气球只在晴天升起。

video.video_title: Fly with Pacha, Into the Aerocene - Art for Action - ART 2030

works.title: Fort Builder
works.description: Digital copies of your real sofa cushions, chairs and lamps can be stacked into a fort that ignores gravity until you let go, and then it all comes crashing down without breaking anything.
works.description_zh: 把你真实的沙发垫、椅子和台灯的数字副本堆成一座无视重力的城堡，直到你松手，它才轰然倒塌，而不会弄坏任何东西。
works.idea_en: The childhood joy of building and smashing a fort, without the mess.
works.idea_zh: 重温童年搭城堡、再推倒它的快乐，却不会弄得一团糟。
works.technique: Objects are captured from the room as meshes, stacked with physics suspended, then released into a rigid-body simulation that collides with the scanned room.
works.technique_zh: 从房间中把物体捕捉为网格，在暂停物理的情况下堆叠，然后释放到与扫描房间发生碰撞的刚体模拟中。
works.exercise_en: Stack AR copies of three scanned objects into a tower in phone AR, then tap to enable gravity. Twist: the tallest tower in class wins, but it must stand for five seconds.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中把三个扫描物体的 AR 副本叠成一座塔，然后点击开启重力。变体：全班最高的塔获胜，但必须屹立五秒。

video.video_title: FIELD x Space10 Fort Builder Sofa Smash.mp4

salient.why_en: Stack digital copies of your own cushions and chairs into a fort, then let it crash down without breaking anything.
salient.why_zh: 用自家靠垫和椅子的数字复制品搭一座堡垒，再让它轰然倒塌，什么都不会摔坏。

works.title: GPU-FlowField
works.description: Hundreds of thousands of particles stream through a 3D flow field, forming swirling ribbons of light.
works.description_zh: 数十万个粒子在三维流场中流动，汇成旋转的光带。
works.idea_en: Let a noise-based vector field steer a huge particle swarm.
works.idea_zh: 让基于噪声的向量场引导一大群粒子。
works.technique: A compute shader fills a 3D grid of direction vectors in URP; each particle reads the nearest grid point every frame to steer its velocity, and the particles are drawn procedurally from a structured buffer.
works.technique_zh: 在 URP 中，计算着色器填充一个三维方向向量网格；每个粒子每帧读取最近的网格点来改变速度，再从结构化缓冲区程序化地绘制粒子。
works.exercise_en: Fill a real room with the flow field in AR and let the phone act as an attractor the particles swirl around. Twist: bend the field around surfaces from the AR room mesh.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中让流场充满真实房间，并让手机成为粒子环绕的吸引点。变体：让流场绕开 AR 房间网格中的表面。
