works.title: Gnarls Barkley 'Crazy' + FaceMesh
works.description: A browser toy that recreates the Rorschach-inkblot look of the 'Crazy' music video on your own face: a live webcam face mesh is rendered as a symmetrical, shifting ink blot while the song plays.
works.description_zh: 一个浏览器小玩具，把《Crazy》音乐录像带里的罗夏墨迹风格搬到你自己的脸上：摄像头实时捕捉的人脸网格被渲染成对称、流动的墨迹，同时播放这首歌。
works.idea_en: Turn your face into a living Rorschach inkblot.
works.idea_zh: 把你的脸变成一团活的罗夏墨迹。
works.technique: TensorFlow.js FaceMesh tracks 468 face landmarks from the webcam; three.js turns them into a mesh shaded with a mirrored, noise-driven ink shader.
works.technique_zh: TensorFlow.js FaceMesh 从摄像头追踪 468 个人脸关键点，three.js 把它们变成网格，并用镜像的、由噪声驱动的墨水着色器渲染。
works.exercise_en: Pick a music video with a strong visual style and rebuild it as a face filter with MediaPipe Face Mesh and three.js (or Effect House). Twist: the effect reacts to the loudness of the song.
works.exercise_zh: 挑一支视觉风格鲜明的音乐录像带，用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 加 three.js（或 Effect House）把它做成人脸滤镜。变体：效果随歌曲音量变化。

video.video_title: Gnarls Barkley - Crazy + TensorFlow FaceMesh & Three.js

works.title: Google Search EDU AR
works.description: Searching for a topic such as the muscular or skeletal system on a phone lets students place a life-size 3D anatomy model in their room; he helped launch the content and designed the auto-scale feature used by AR animals and dinosaurs in Search.
works.description_zh: 在手机上搜索“肌肉系统”“骨骼系统”等主题，学生就能把真实大小的 3D 解剖模型放进房间；他参与了这批内容的上线，并为搜索中的 AR 动物和恐龙设计了自动缩放功能。
works.idea_en: Every search result can become an object you can walk around in your own room.
works.idea_zh: 每一个搜索结果都可以变成一个能在自己房间里绕着看的物体。
works.technique: Search results open Scene Viewer, which places a glTF model on an ARCore plane and auto-scales it to fit the available space.
works.technique_zh: 搜索结果打开 Scene Viewer，把 glTF 模型放在 ARCore 平面上，并根据可用空间自动缩放。
works.exercise_en: Build a model-viewer web page that shows a school topic in AR at true scale. Twist: add a button that shrinks it to fit on the desk and label what changes.
works.exercise_zh: 用 model-viewer 做一个网页，以真实比例在 AR 中展示一个课程主题。变体：加一个按钮把它缩小到能放在桌上，并标注哪些内容发生了变化。

video.video_title: Just helped launch new EDU AR content on Google Search. I wish I could have this when I was learning drawings at high school, so I don’t need the plaster statue for anatomy anymore https://t.co/EpftWj

works.title: Grass Geometry Shader (URP)
works.description: A field of grass blades sways in the wind, generated entirely on the GPU from a flat mesh.
works.description_zh: 一片草叶在风中摇摆，全部由 GPU 从一个平面网格生成。
works.idea_en: Grow a whole meadow from a plane by letting the GPU emit the blades.
works.idea_zh: 让 GPU 自己吐出草叶，从一个平面长出一整片草地。
works.technique: A hand-written URP geometry shader emits a few triangles per vertex as a blade, randomises height and bend per blade, and bends them with a scrolling wind texture (based on Roystan's tutorial).
works.technique_zh: 一个手写的 URP 几何着色器为每个顶点生成几个三角形作为草叶，随机化每片草的高度和弯曲，并用滚动的风纹理让它们摆动（基于 Roystan 的教程）。
works.exercise_en: Grow the grass on a detected AR floor plane and push the blades away from the phone's projected position so walking parts the grass. Twist: make the grass grow only where the camera sees green.
works.exercise_zh: 在检测到的 AR 地面上长草，并把草叶从手机的投影位置推开，走过时草会分开。变体：只在相机看到绿色的地方长草。

video.video_title:
Trying out geometry #shaders in URP (made via code, since shadergraph doesn't support geometry shaders).

This grass was based on @roystanhonks tutorial : https://t.co/Bq3UI8vEEA. (I skipped tessellat

works.title: HERMITS
works.description: Small self-propelled robots dock into interchangeable mechanical shells - a lever, a crank, a vehicle - gaining new physical interactions like hermit crabs changing shells.
works.idea_zh: 像寄居蟹换壳一样，小机器人钻进不同外壳就获得新功能。

video.video_title: HERMITS: Mechanical Shells for Reconfigurable Robotic Tangible Interfaces

works.technique: Uses toio robots with position tracking to drive into passive 3D-printed shells whose gears and levers convert robot motion into new actuation or input.
works.exercise_zh: 给一个遥控小车设计三种纸板“外壳”（推土铲、旗帜、小屋），用手机AR标注每个外壳的功能；变化：让小车根据二维码自动识别换上的外壳。
works.description_zh: 小型自走机器人可以钻进可互换的机械外壳——杠杆、曲柄、载具——像寄居蟹换壳一样获得新的物理交互能力。
works.idea_en: Like hermit crabs changing shells, small robots gain new functions by crawling into different shells.
works.technique_zh: 使用带位置追踪的 toio 机器人驶入被动式 3D 打印外壳，外壳中的齿轮和杠杆把机器人的运动转换为新的驱动或输入方式。
works.exercise_en: Design three cardboard shells for an RC car (a bulldozer blade, a flag and a little house) and label each shell's function in phone AR. Twist: have the car automatically recognize which shell it is wearing from a QR code.

works.title: Hand-Tracked Forces on VFX Particles (Quest)
works.description: In VR on an Oculus Quest, the user's bare hands push, pull and scatter a cloud of VFX Graph particles.
works.description_zh: 在 Oculus Quest 的 VR 中，用户用裸手推、拉、打散一团 VFX Graph 粒子。
works.idea_en: Your hands become force fields for particles.
works.idea_zh: 双手变成粒子的力场。
works.technique: Oculus hand-tracking bone positions are passed to VFX Graph as exposed properties and used as attractors and colliders, rendered with URP on Quest.
works.technique_zh: 把 Oculus 手部追踪的骨骼位置作为暴露属性传给 VFX Graph，用作吸引点和碰撞体，并在 Quest 上用 URP 渲染。
works.exercise_en: Bring the hand-force particles into passthrough MR on Quest 3 or HoloKit so students sculpt a particle cloud floating over a real table. Twist: two people's hands tear the cloud in opposite directions.
works.exercise_zh: 把手势力场粒子带到 Quest 3 透视 MR 或 HoloKit 中，让学生雕塑一团漂浮在真实桌子上方的粒子云。变体：两人的手从相反方向把粒子云撕开。

video.video_title: How To Apply Forces To VFX Particles With Hand Tracking? (Oculus Quest Development)

works.title: HandMorph
works.description: A passive exoskeleton puts a child-sized mechanical hand in front of the wearer's own; grasping real toys and tools through it makes everything feel bigger, with no headset involved.
works.description_zh: 一副被动外骨骼在佩戴者的手前面装了一只儿童尺寸的机械手；通过它去抓真实的玩具和工具，所有东西都显得更大，而且完全不需要头显。
works.idea_en: Change your body, not the picture: a mechanical small hand makes the real world feel oversized.
works.idea_zh: 改的不是画面而是身体：一只机械小手让真实世界显得巨大。
works.technique: Uses four-bar linkages to transmit each finger's motion and force to an anatomically scaled smaller hand, so haptic feedback stays congruent in the real environment.
works.technique_zh: 用四连杆机构把每根手指的动作和力量传到按比例缩小的仿生小手上，让触觉反馈在真实环境里保持一致。
works.exercise_en: Build a cardboard 'hand extender' with straws and string that mirrors finger bends onto a smaller cardboard hand, then try picking up objects of different sizes and rate how big they feel. Twist: make the hand larger instead and redesign a door handle for it.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸板、吸管和绳子做一个“手部延伸器”，把手指弯曲映射到一只更小的纸板手上，然后去拿不同大小的物体，给它们“感觉上的大小”打分；变体：把手做大，再为它重新设计一个门把手。

video.video_title: HandMorph: a Passive Exoskeleton that Miniaturizes Grasp (UIST 2020 Best Paper Award)

salient.why_en: Wearing a child-sized mechanical hand makes the real world feel oversized, with no screen at all.
salient.why_zh: 戴上一只孩子大小的机械手，真实世界就显得变大了，全程不需要任何屏幕。

works.title: HdrpVatExample: baked fluid and cloth with VAT
works.description: A splashing liquid and soft cloth, simulated offline in Houdini, play back in real time as smooth animated meshes inside Unity.
works.description_zh: 在 Houdini 里离线模拟的液体飞溅和柔软布料，在 Unity 里以平滑的动画网格实时回放。
works.idea_en: Simulate once offline, play it back anywhere.
works.idea_zh: 离线模拟一次，就能在任何地方回放。
works.technique: Houdini exports vertex animation textures (VAT) that store per-frame positions and normals; a Shader Graph reads them in the vertex stage and interpolates between frames.
works.technique_zh: Houdini 导出顶点动画贴图（VAT），里面存着每帧的位置和法线；Shader Graph 在顶点阶段读取并在帧之间插值。
works.exercise_en: Bake a simple splash or cloth VAT (Houdini Apprentice or Blender), and play it on a real table surface in AR Foundation. Twist: trigger the splash when a real cup is placed on an image marker.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Houdini Apprentice 或 Blender 烘焙一个简单的飞溅或布料 VAT，在 AR Foundation 中放到真实桌面上播放。变体：把真实杯子放到图像标记上时触发飞溅。

video.video_title: Added a fluid VAT (Vertex Animation Texture) example with Unity Shader Graph. https://t.co/FXOZYoLTRF https://t.co/wnePBVEGKV

works.title: Holiday Lights AR
works.description: Tap and drag to hang strings of festive lights on the walls and furniture of any room; the lights stick to the real surfaces. Made at GoSpooky and updated to use Snap's world meshing on ARKit and ARCore.
works.description_zh: 点按并拖动，就能在任何房间的墙壁和家具上挂起一串串节日彩灯，彩灯会贴合在真实表面上。作品在 GoSpooky 制作，后来升级为使用 Snap 在 ARKit 和 ARCore 上的世界网格功能。
works.idea_en: Decorate any room with light strings by drawing on its walls.
works.idea_zh: 在墙上画一笔，就能用彩灯装饰任何房间。
works.technique: Screen touches are raycast against a real-time world mesh (LiDAR or an ML fallback), and a string of emissive bulbs is spawned along the hit points so it follows the real geometry.
works.technique_zh: 屏幕触点对实时世界网格（LiDAR 或机器学习兜底）做射线检测，沿命中点生成一串自发光灯泡，使其顺着真实几何表面排布。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR hit-test app that places a glowing bulb wherever the finger drags across a detected surface, connected by a wire. Twist: make the bulbs blink in sequence to music from the phone microphone.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 WebXR 命中测试应用：手指在检测到的表面上拖动时，沿路放下发光灯泡并用电线连起来；变体：让灯泡随手机麦克风听到的音乐依次闪烁。

video.video_title:
Did an update on the Holiday Lights lens!

It now works with @SnapAR's new World Meshing capabilities on ARKit and ARCore

Go check it out at @gospookyhq's: https://t.co/88wF2kbpiK https://t.co/xEjep0

works.title: HoloBox with HoloLens 2
works.description: A physical box-shaped display and HoloLens 2 share synchronised objects that move seamlessly between the screen's 3D window and the air around it.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟物体在立体显示盒与 HoloLens 空间之间无缝穿梭。

video.video_title: HoloBox System That Works with HoloLens2

works.technique: The box display renders an off-axis perspective matched to the HoloLens user's head pose, and a shared coordinate frame lets objects hand over seamlessly between screen rendering and headset rendering.
works.exercise_zh: 用一台显示器做离轴透视窗口（用手机追踪头部位置），物体离开屏幕边缘时在 AR 手机中接着出现；变体：物体从屏幕“掉”到桌上会弹跳。
works.description_zh: 一个实体盒状显示器与 HoloLens 2 共享同步的物体，这些物体可以在屏幕的三维窗口与周围空气之间无缝穿梭。
works.idea_en: Virtual objects travel seamlessly between a 3D display box and the HoloLens space.
works.technique_zh: 盒状显示器按照 HoloLens 用户的头部位姿渲染匹配的离轴透视，共享坐标系则让物体在屏幕渲染与头显渲染之间无缝交接。
works.exercise_en: Use a monitor as an off-axis perspective window (tracking head position with a phone), and when an object leaves the edge of the screen, have it continue in an AR phone. Twist: objects that fall off the screen onto the desk bounce.

works.title: IMMATERIA: Forms On Forms
works.description: Shapes made of compute-shader particles grow on the surfaces of other shapes, layering soft forms on forms in a Unity scene.
works.description_zh: 由计算着色器粒子组成的形体，在其他形体的表面上生长，层层叠叠地形成“形上之形”。
works.idea_en: Chain simple compute-shader 'lifeforms' so one simulation lives on the surface of another.
works.idea_zh: 把简单的计算着色器“生命体”串起来，让一个模拟生活在另一个模拟的表面上。
works.technique: IMMATERIA wraps compute buffers ('forms') and kernels ('lifeforms') in reusable Unity components; bindings pass one form's vertices into another's simulation so particles are spawned and constrained on its surface.
works.technique_zh: IMMATERIA 把计算缓冲区（form）和内核（lifeform）封装成可复用的 Unity 组件；通过绑定把一个 form 的顶点传进另一个模拟，让粒子在其表面生成并受其约束。
works.exercise_en: Use the room mesh from AR Foundation as the first 'form' and grow a second particle form over the real furniture. Twist: let the grown form slowly retreat from wherever the phone points.
works.exercise_zh: 把 AR Foundation 的房间网格作为第一个 form，在真实家具上长出第二层粒子形体。变体：让长出的形体从手机指向的地方慢慢退开。

video.video_title: Forms On Forms

works.title: IMMATERIA: My First Gooey Mesh
works.description: A soft mesh wobbles and jiggles like jelly, its vertices pulled back to shape by springs after being disturbed.
works.description_zh: 一个柔软的网格像果冻一样晃动，顶点被扰动后又被弹簧拉回原形。
works.idea_en: Make any mesh gooey by simulating its vertices as springy particles on the GPU.
works.idea_zh: 把网格顶点当作带弹簧的粒子在 GPU 上模拟，让任何网格变得黏糊有弹性。
works.technique: Mesh vertices are copied into a compute buffer, a kernel applies spring forces toward their rest positions plus noise and damping, and the deformed positions are read back in the vertex shader.
works.technique_zh: 网格顶点被复制进计算缓冲区，内核施加朝向静止位置的弹簧力、噪声和阻尼，变形后的位置在顶点着色器中读取。
works.exercise_en: Make a gooey virtual object that sits on a real table in AR and wobbles whenever the user bumps the phone toward it. Twist: let the goo sag and drip over the table edge under gravity.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中做一个放在真实桌面上的黏糊物体，用户把手机朝它“撞”过去时它就晃动。变体：让它在重力作用下下垂，从桌边滴下去。

video.video_title: My First Gooey Mesh

works.title: Imaginary Friend
works.description: A large, flat-coloured figure in Abney's painting style appears in parks and squares; the sage-like character offers a blessing that its friend refuses, with the line 'sometimes we believe nothing good can ever happen to us'.
works.description_zh: 一个具有 Abney 绘画风格的大型平涂人物出现在公园和广场上；这位智者般的角色想给朋友送上祝福，却被拒绝，并留下一句“有时我们相信好事永远不会发生在自己身上”。
works.idea_en: A painted character becomes an always-available companion in public space.
works.idea_zh: 一个绘画角色变成公共空间里随叫随到的陪伴者。
works.technique: Phone AR via the Acute Art app, with the figure available at geolocated launch sites (London, New York) and placeable anywhere.
works.technique_zh: 通过 Acute Art App 进行手机 AR 体验，角色在伦敦、纽约等地理定位的首发地点出现，也可以放置在任何地方。
works.exercise_en: Turn a 2D character drawing into a flat, layered AR cut-out that says one short line when tapped. Twist: the line changes depending on how many people are standing in front of it.
works.exercise_zh: 把一幅二维角色画做成分层的平面 AR 剪影，点击时说出一句短台词；变体：台词根据站在它面前的人数而变化。

video.video_title: Imaginary Friend by Nina Chanel Abney

works.title: Instagram AR Filters (reel)
works.description: A reel of Anne Horel's face filters: pop, kitsch and surreal effects that stick pizza, glitter, emoji-like creatures and GIF-style loops onto the face and head.
works.description_zh: Anne Horel 的脸部滤镜合集：披萨、亮片、表情包般的小生物和 GIF 风格的循环动画被“粘”在脸和头上，波普、媚俗又超现实。
works.idea_en: Treat a face filter as a tiny wearable artwork in one consistent personal style.
works.idea_zh: 把脸部滤镜当成一件小小的可穿戴艺术品，并保持鲜明统一的个人风格。
works.technique: Spark AR face tracking attaches 2D sprite loops and 3D props to face landmarks, with segmentation and colour effects for the background.
works.technique_zh: 用 Spark AR 的人脸追踪把 2D 序列帧循环和 3D 道具绑定到面部关键点上，并用人像分割和调色处理背景。
works.exercise_en: Design three face filters that all share one invented visual style, using only hand-drawn 2D loops attached to face points. Twist: each filter must express a different mood without using text.
works.exercise_zh: 设计三个风格统一的脸部滤镜，只用手绘 2D 循环动画绑定在面部关键点上；变体：每个滤镜都要在不使用文字的情况下表达一种不同的情绪。

video.video_title: INSTAGRAM AR FILTERS🎭

works.title: Instrument for Dissonance
works.description: Motors swing ropes against suspended metal sheets in anxious, repeating loops; when a person enters, their position in the room shortens the loops and resets the rhythm.
works.description_zh: 电机甩动绳子，拍打悬挂的金属板，形成焦躁、重复的循环；当有人走进来时，他在房间里的位置会缩短循环，让节奏重新开始。
works.idea_en: A self-playing machine whose rhythm is interrupted by your presence.
works.idea_zh: 一台自己演奏的机器，节奏会被你的出现打断。
works.technique: A presence or distance sensor (likely) reads where the visitor stands and changes the timing of the motors that swing the ropes onto the metal sheets.
works.technique_zh: （很可能是）存在或测距传感器读出观众的位置，改变甩动绳子的电机的节拍。
works.exercise_en: Hang tin lids from a string, tap them with a servo on an Arduino in a steady loop, and let a distance sensor speed up the loop as someone approaches. Twist: the machine stops entirely if the visitor stands perfectly still.
works.exercise_zh: 用绳子挂起几个铁皮盖，用 Arduino 控制舵机按固定循环敲击，再用测距传感器让有人靠近时循环变快；变体：如果观众完全静止，机器就彻底停下。

video.video_title: Instrument for Dissonance

works.title: KAWS: Expanded Holiday
works.description: KAWS's giant COMPANION figure released as AR sculptures placed simultaneously in cities worldwide and in users' homes, sold as limited AR editions.
works.idea_zh: 全球同时出现的巨型AR玩偶雕塑，也可买回家

video.video_title: Acute Art Presents EXPANDED HOLIDAY: KAWS LAUNCHES NEW ART FORM

works.technique: Geolocated AR placement plus user-side plane detection: the same large sculpture model is anchored at fixed city coordinates and can also be placed on any detected ground plane at home.
works.exercise_zh: 为你设计的一个角色做一个巨型 AR 雕塑，在校园的三个 GPS 地点同时出现（可用 AR.js location-based）；变体：让雕塑在不同地点做出不同姿态，暗示它在城市中移动。
works.description_zh: KAWS 的巨型 COMPANION 形象以 AR 雕塑的形式发布，同时出现在全球多座城市和用户家中，并作为限量 AR 版本出售。
works.idea_en: Giant AR toy sculptures appear worldwide at the same time, and you can buy one to take home.
works.technique_zh: 结合地理定位 AR 放置和用户端平面检测：同一个大型雕塑模型既锚定在城市中的固定坐标上，也可以放置在家中任何检测到的地面平面上。
works.exercise_en: Make a giant AR sculpture of a character you designed and have it appear at three GPS locations on campus at once, for example with location-based AR.js. Twist: give the sculpture a different pose at each location, hinting that it moves around the city.

works.title: KAWS:HOLIDAY Space
works.description: To mark COMPANION's 20th anniversary, a small figure in an astronaut suit was carried by a sounding balloon to 41.5 kilometres into the stratosphere and filmed floating above the Earth.
works.description_zh: 为纪念 COMPANION 诞生 20 周年，一个穿着宇航服的小人偶被探空气球带到 41.5 公里高的平流层，并被拍下漂浮在地球上空的画面。
works.idea_en: A small figure filmed against the curve of the Earth plays with scale in the opposite direction from the giants, a reminder that AR can shrink as well as enlarge.
works.idea_zh: 一个小人偶以地球弧线为背景被拍摄，与巨人们的尺度玩法正好相反，提醒我们 AR 既可以放大也可以缩小。
works.technique: A figure and cameras on a weather-balloon payload rose for about eight hours before descending by parachute.
works.technique_zh: 人偶和相机随气象气球载荷升空约八小时，然后用降落伞返回。
works.exercise_en: Launch an AR figure from your hand that rises until it becomes a speck against the real sky, and track it with a compass arrow. Twist: other users in the city can see where it drifted.
works.exercise_zh: 从手中放飞一个 AR 人偶，让它一直上升到在真实天空中只剩一个小点，并用指南针箭头追踪它；变体：城市中的其他用户可以看到它飘到了哪里。

video.video_title: KAWS:HOLIDAY SPACE

works.title: KYKEON
works.description: An immersive VR trilogy that invites the audience into a new shamanic ritual performed by virtual dancers from tanzmainz, choreographed by Taneli Törmä.
works.description_zh: 一部沉浸式 VR 三部曲，邀请观众进入由 tanzmainz 舞者化身表演、Taneli Törmä 编舞的一场新的萨满仪式。
works.idea_en: Use VR to invent a shared ritual built from dancers' motion.
works.idea_zh: 用 VR 发明一场由舞者动作构成的共享仪式。
works.technique: Dancers were motion-captured and rendered as stylised avatars and particle forms in a real-time VR scene, co-produced with Motion Bank.
works.technique_zh: 舞者经动作捕捉后在实时 VR 场景中被渲染为风格化的化身和粒子形态，与 Motion Bank 联合制作。
works.exercise_en: Design a two-minute AR ritual for a group: each phone shows the same virtual circle of mocap dancers on the floor, and the group must perform one gesture together to advance the ritual. Twist: the ritual only continues if nobody speaks.
works.exercise_zh: 为一群人设计一段两分钟的 AR 仪式：每部手机都在地上看到同一圈动捕舞者，大家必须一起做出同一个手势才能推进仪式；变体：只要有人说话，仪式就停止。

video.video_title: KYKEON Trailer

works.title: Kat & Cassie Make A Ballet
works.description: American Ballet Theatre principal Cassandra Trenary dances alone in a motion-capture suit, and her movement is multiplied in a game engine into a whole ensemble of virtual dancers that repeat, delay and mirror her.
works.description_zh: 美国芭蕾舞剧院首席 Cassandra Trenary 穿着动捕服独舞，她的动作在游戏引擎里被复制成一整个虚拟舞团，彼此重复、延迟、镜像。
works.idea_en: One dancer, captured live, becomes an entire corps de ballet.
works.idea_zh: 一位舞者被实时捕捉，就能变成一整个群舞团。
works.technique: Optical motion capture streams Trenary's skeleton into Unreal Engine, where copies of her avatar are offset in time and space to build choreography with many bodies from one.
works.technique_zh: 光学动作捕捉把 Trenary 的骨骼数据实时送进 Unreal Engine，她的化身被复制出多份，并在时间和空间上错开，用一个身体编出多人舞蹈。
works.exercise_en: Record a 20-second phrase with a phone mocap app, import it into Unity or Blender, and arrange eight copies in a circle with 0.25-second delays to make a canon. Twist: place the ensemble in AR on the classroom floor and dance with it.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机动捕 App 录一段 20 秒的舞句，导入 Unity 或 Blender，把八个副本排成一圈，每个延迟 0.25 秒，做成一段卡农；变体：用 AR 把这个舞团放到教室地板上，自己加入一起跳。

video.video_title: WPA Virtual Commissions: "Kat & Cassie Make A Ballet" by Kat Sullivan and Cassandra Trenary

salient.why_en: One ballerina, captured live, is multiplied into an entire corps de ballet.
salient.why_zh: 一位芭蕾舞者被实时捕捉，复制成一整个群舞团。

works.title: Khoreo: procedural dance with the MC-101
works.description: A procedurally animated dancer made of light moves in sync with music played live on a Roland MC-101, surrounded by particles shed from its body.
works.description_zh: 一个由光组成、程序生成动作的舞者，随着 Roland MC-101 现场演奏的音乐起舞，身上不断散出粒子。
works.idea_en: The music plays the dancer.
works.idea_zh: 音乐在“演奏”舞者。
works.technique: Procedural motion scripts animate the character while MIDI clock from the MC-101 syncs the timing; Smrvfx emits particles from the skinned mesh.
works.technique_zh: 程序化动作脚本驱动角色，MC-101 的 MIDI 时钟负责同步节拍，Smrvfx 从蒙皮网格发射粒子。
works.exercise_en: Place a rigged character on the floor with AR Foundation and make its moves change with the beat of a song. Twist: let a second phone's microphone control a second dancer.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在地上放一个绑定骨骼的角色，让它的动作随歌曲节拍变化。变体：用第二台手机的麦克风控制第二个舞者。

video.video_title: Khoreo: An audiovisual project with Unity and Roland MC-101 groovebox. BRDG published the full-length video on YouTube. https://t.co/mfMNtUZsPV Also, I uploaded the Unity and MC-101 project files to G

works.title: Kinetic AR: robot motion programming in AR
works.description: Using a phone, you draw and edit a robot's motion path directly on the floor in AR and the physical robot follows it, making robot programming spatial and visual.
works.idea_zh: 直接在地上'画'出机器人的运动轨迹来编程。

video.video_title: Kinetic AR: Robotic Motion Planning and Programming using Augmented Reality Interfaces

works.technique: The AR interface tracks the robot and floor in a shared frame, and user-drawn spline paths are converted into motion commands sent to the robot.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 在地上放几个路径点，让扫地机器人/乐高小车按顺序经过；加一个变化：每个路径点可以设置'停下来跳舞'。
works.description_zh: 用手机直接在地面上以 AR 方式绘制和编辑机器人的运动路径，实体机器人会沿路径行进，让机器人编程变得空间化、可视化。
works.idea_en: Program a robot by drawing its path right on the floor.
works.technique_zh: AR 界面在共享坐标系中追踪机器人和地面，用户绘制的样条路径被转换为运动指令发送给机器人。
works.exercise_en: Place a few waypoints on the floor in phone AR and have a robot vacuum or LEGO car pass through them in order. Twist: each waypoint can be set to make the robot stop and dance.

works.title: KinoFeedback2: frame feedback with emoji particles
works.description: Emoji particles leave looping, zooming echoes of themselves, like pointing a video camera at its own monitor.
works.description_zh: emoji 粒子留下不断缩放、循环的残影，就像把摄像机对准自己的监视器。
works.idea_en: Feed the last frame back into the next one.
works.idea_zh: 把上一帧喂回下一帧。
works.technique: An HDRP custom pass copies the previous frame, scales, rotates and hue-shifts it slightly, and blends it under the new frame.
works.technique_zh: HDRP 自定义通道复制上一帧，稍微缩放、旋转并偏移色相，再混合到新一帧下面。
works.exercise_en: Add a feedback pass to the AR Foundation camera image so moving people leave spiraling trails. Twist: the trail only appears while the phone is still.
works.exercise_zh: 给 AR Foundation 的相机画面加反馈效果，让走动的人留下螺旋状残影。变体：只有手机静止时才出现残影。

video.video_title:
Frame feedback effect with Emoji particles
https://t.co/4ympOfHrXl https://t.co/4f4gvlsZx3

works.title: Krbv: colorful particle strip tunnel
works.description: The camera flies through an endless tunnel made of bright colored ribbons that twist and flow past.
works.description_zh: 镜头穿过一条无尽的隧道，隧道由扭动流过的彩色光带组成。
works.idea_en: Ribbons moving past the camera create a sense of speed.
works.idea_zh: 光带从镜头旁掠过，就有了速度感。
works.technique: VFX Graph spawns particle strips on a cylinder, moves them toward the camera and colors them with a gradient over time.
works.technique_zh: VFX Graph 在圆柱面上生成粒子条带，让它们朝镜头移动，并随时间按渐变上色。
works.exercise_en: Build a ribbon tunnel and anchor its mouth to a real doorway in AR Foundation, so walking through the door feels like entering it. Twist: the tunnel speeds up with your walking speed.
works.exercise_zh: 做一条光带隧道，用 AR Foundation 把入口锚定在真实门框上，走过门就像进入隧道。变体：隧道速度随你的步速变化。

video.video_title: Particle strip tunnel with Unity VFX Graph https://t.co/IHk33zFmwn https://t.co/agMaEjGfzI

works.title: Laser Light City
works.description: During the Covid lockdowns, powerful lasers on a rooftop draw patterns across Brighton's sky and buildings, and people at home can take control of the beams from their phones.
works.description_zh: 疫情封城期间，屋顶上的大功率激光在布莱顿的天空和建筑上绘出图案，居民可以在家用手机接管这些光束。
works.idea_en: Control lasers over your city from your window, together with neighbours you cannot meet.
works.idea_zh: 隔着窗户和见不到面的邻居一起，用手机操控城市上空的激光。
works.technique: A web interface sends each participant's input to the laser-show server, which turns it into beam positions and colours for the rooftop lasers.
works.technique_zh: 网页界面把每位参与者的输入发送到激光秀服务器，再转换成屋顶激光的光束位置和颜色。
works.exercise_en: Build a web page that lets classmates move a shape on a shared projected wall from their own phones. Twist: the shape only moves when at least three people push in the same direction.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个网页，让同学用自己的手机移动共享投影墙上的一个图形。变体：至少三个人朝同一方向推时，图形才会移动。

video.video_title: Laser Light City Brighton

works.title: Layered Light Field Video on Quest
works.description: Google's immersive light-field videos play on an Oculus Quest in Unity: a waterfall or a dog in a room shows real parallax as the viewer moves their head.
works.description_zh: Google 的沉浸式光场视频在 Unity 中于 Oculus Quest 上播放：观众移动头部时，瀑布或房间里的狗都会呈现真实的视差。
works.idea_en: Volumetric video can be a stack of video-textured shells rather than a point cloud.
works.idea_zh: 体积视频也可以是一层层贴着视频的壳体，而不是点云。
works.technique: The player reads the layered-mesh representation (a set of concentric meshes with per-frame geometry) and maps the decoded video atlas onto them, keeping geometry and video frames in sync.
works.technique_zh: 播放器读取分层网格表示（一组逐帧几何的同心网格），把解码后的视频图集映射上去，并保持几何与视频帧同步。
works.exercise_en: Play one of Google's sample light-field clips in passthrough on a Quest, cropped to a sphere floating in the room. Twist: let the viewer reach in and shrink the sphere to a snow-globe.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Quest 的透视模式下播放一段 Google 光场示例视频，裁成漂浮在房间里的球体。变体：让观众伸手把球缩成一个雪景球。

video.video_title:
Worked some more on getting googles light field videos to play on #OculusQuest via @unity3d

#madewithunity #lightfieldvideo https://t.co/rOZd9eNH2M

works.title: Lenses for Emotional Oranges 'All That'
works.description: Colorful 3D lenses in Velvet Spectrum's signature style transform the performers and scenes of the Emotional Oranges music video.
works.idea_zh: 把工作室的招牌 3D 视觉语言做成音乐 MV 里的 AR 滤镜。

video.video_title: Letting the AR Move You with Velvet Spectrum

works.technique: Face and world lenses with stylized 3D assets are layered over the performers and shot directly through the camera for the video.
works.exercise_zh: 为一首歌做一个 AR 滤镜 MV：用同一套配色和材质做 3 个不同镜头的滤镜；加一个变化：滤镜随副歌自动切换。
works.description_zh: 带有 Velvet Spectrum 标志性风格的多彩三维滤镜，改造了 Emotional Oranges 音乐录影带中的表演者和场景。
works.idea_en: Turn the studio's signature 3D visual language into AR filters for a music video.
works.technique_zh: 带有风格化三维素材的面部滤镜和世界滤镜叠加在表演者身上，并直接通过摄像头拍摄成视频。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR filter music video for a song, with three filters for different shots that share one palette and set of materials. Twist: the filters switch automatically on the chorus.

works.title: LiDAR Point Cloud Streaming with Cartoon Effect
works.description: The iPad's live point cloud of a room and person is re-rendered on the receiving side as a hand-drawn cartoon.
works.idea_zh: 把实时点云渲染成卡通风格的远程空间。

video.video_title: Streaming Point Cloud of iPad's LiDAR & Visualization with a Cartoon Like Effect

works.technique: The received point cloud is rendered with a non-photorealistic shader (edge detection from depth discontinuities plus flat color quantization) to look hand-drawn.
works.exercise_zh: 对一段点云或深度视频加色阶量化和描边着色器，做出卡通风格；变体：让风格随说话人的情绪（音量高低）切换。
works.description_zh: iPad 实时采集的房间和人物点云，在接收端被重新渲染成手绘风格的卡通画面。
works.idea_en: Render a live point cloud as a cartoon-style remote space.
works.technique_zh: 接收到的点云使用非真实感着色器渲染（根据深度不连续处做边缘检测，再进行平涂色彩量化），呈现手绘效果。
works.exercise_en: Apply color quantization and an outline shader to a point cloud or depth video to create a cartoon style. Twist: switch styles with the speaker's mood, judged by how loud they are.

works.title: Liberty Bell
works.description: A giant AR Liberty Bell rings over historic US sites (Philadelphia, Selma, Washington) as a call to civic action.
works.idea_zh: 在美国历史地点上空敲响AR自由钟

video.video_title: View Historic Landmarks With This Augmented Reality Art App | Future Blink

works.technique: Geolocated AR places a large animated bell model with spatial audio at historic sites, so the sound source is positioned in the sky above the viewer.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个与公共议题相关的地点设计一个悬在空中的 AR 声音物体，用 Unity 空间音频让声音随距离变化；变体：物体只有在多人同时对准时才会响起。
works.description_zh: 一口巨大的 AR 自由钟在美国多个历史地点（费城、塞尔玛、华盛顿）上空敲响，呼吁公民行动。
works.idea_en: Ring an AR Liberty Bell in the sky over historic American sites.
works.technique_zh: 地理定位 AR 在历史地点放置带空间音频的大型钟体动画模型，使声源位于观众头顶的天空中。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR sound object hanging in the air for a place tied to a public issue, and use Unity spatial audio so the sound changes with distance. Twist: the object only rings when several people aim at it together.

works.title: Lights of Nibel
works.description: A short real-time film inspired by the Ori games: spirits of light drift through a dark forest, stirring glowing fluid that swirls and fades behind them.
works.description_zh: 一部受《Ori》系列启发的实时短片：光之精灵在黑暗森林中飘动，搅起在身后旋转、消散的发光流体。
works.idea_en: Light as a liquid that creatures stir as they pass.
works.idea_zh: 把光当作液体，生灵经过时会把它搅动。
works.technique: Chimera, his 2D fluid framework, solves a fast vorticity-confined fluid in a custom render texture; emitters inject velocity and colour, and the velocity field advects dye and VFX Graph particles.
works.technique_zh: 他的二维流体框架 Chimera 在自定义渲染纹理里求解带涡度约束的快速流体；发射器注入速度和颜色，速度场再平流染料和 VFX Graph 粒子。
works.exercise_en: Map Chimera's fluid texture onto a detected AR wall and let virtual fireflies (VFX Graph particles) stir it, then let the user's finger become another emitter. Twist: use the room's real light level to set how bright the fluid glows.
works.exercise_zh: 把 Chimera 的流体纹理贴到 AR 检测到的墙面上，让虚拟萤火虫（VFX Graph 粒子）搅动它，再把用户的手指变成另一个发射器。变体：用房间的真实亮度决定流体的发光强度。

video.video_title: Lights of Nibel

works.title: Lines of Play
works.description: Build domino chains on real floors and furniture; with the ARCore Depth API the dominoes hide behind real obstacles, collide with real objects and topple with spatial audio.
works.idea_zh: 在真实地面摆AR多米诺骨牌，它们会被真实物体遮挡并撞到真实物体。

video.video_title: Lines of Play: An Experiment Using Depth API

works.technique: The ARCore Depth API supplies a depth map used for both occlusion and physics collision, so dominoes hide behind and bump into real objects.
works.exercise_zh: 开启环境深度，在桌面上摆一排 AR 多米诺骨牌，让它们撞到真实的书本后停下；变体：骨牌倒下时每块发出一个音阶，组成一段旋律。
works.description_zh: 在真实的地板和家具上搭建多米诺骨牌链；借助 ARCore Depth API，骨牌会隐藏在真实障碍物后面、与真实物体碰撞，并伴随空间音效依次倒下。
works.idea_en: Set up AR dominoes on a real floor, where real objects hide them and get in their way.
works.technique_zh: ARCore Depth API 提供的深度图同时用于遮挡和物理碰撞，使骨牌能藏在真实物体后面并撞上它们。
works.exercise_en: Turn on environment depth, line up AR dominoes on a tabletop and make them stop when they hit a real book. Twist: each domino plays a note of a scale as it falls, forming a melody.

works.title: Local Lenses
works.description: Persistent, shared AR that covers entire city blocks: multiple Snapchatters can paint and decorate real building facades together, and the changes stay in place for others.
works.idea_zh: 多人一起给整条街道的真实建筑涂装，AR内容会持久留在原地。

video.video_title: Introducing Local Lenses | Snap Partner Summit 2020

works.technique: A city-scale 3D map localizes users, and shared persistent state stores each paint stroke on building surfaces so later visitors see the accumulated changes.
works.exercise_zh: 用持久化锚点和一个简单后端（如 Firebase）做一面多人共享的 AR 涂鸦墙，涂鸦下次打开还在；变体：涂鸦会像真实油漆一样慢慢褪色。
works.description_zh: 覆盖整片城市街区的持久共享 AR：多位 Snapchat 用户可以一起给真实建筑立面上色和装饰，这些改动会保留在原处，供其他人看到。
works.idea_en: People paint real buildings along a whole street together, and the AR content stays where it was put.
works.technique_zh: 城市尺度的三维地图为用户定位，共享的持久化状态记录建筑表面上的每一笔涂装，后来的访客就能看到不断累积的改动。
works.exercise_en: Use persistent anchors and a simple backend such as Firebase to build a shared AR graffiti wall whose graffiti is still there the next time you open it. Twist: the graffiti slowly fades like real paint.

works.title: MEISAI – AR Filter App
works.description: An iOS AR effect app offering camouflage-like generative filters that reshape people and space in real time.
works.idea_zh: 像“迷彩”一样实时改写人和空间的生成式 AR 滤镜 App。

video.video_title: MEISAI - AR Filter App /  Kitasenju Design

works.technique: Person segmentation and depth masks drive full-screen shaders that re-texture people and space with generative camouflage patterns in real time.
works.exercise_zh: 用人体分割把人物区域替换成周围背景的采样纹理，做一个“迷彩隐身”滤镜；变体：只在人静止不动时隐身，一动就显形。
works.description_zh: 一款 iOS AR 特效应用，提供类似迷彩的生成式滤镜，实时重塑人与空间。
works.idea_en: A generative AR filter app that rewrites people and space in real time, like camouflage.
works.technique_zh: 人体分割和深度遮罩驱动全屏着色器，用生成式迷彩图案实时为人和空间重新贴图。
works.exercise_en: Use person segmentation to replace the person's area with texture sampled from the surrounding background, making a camouflage invisibility filter. Twist: you stay invisible only while standing still and reappear as soon as you move.

works.title: MRAT: Mixed Reality Analytics Toolkit
works.description: A toolkit that logs and visualises how users move, look and interact in mixed reality apps, replaying their paths and gaze as 3D traces in the room.
works.idea_zh: 把用户在MR里走过的路和看过的地方画成空间轨迹。

video.video_title: MRAT: The Mixed Reality Analytics Toolkit

works.technique: Instruments Unity MR apps to record head pose, gaze and input events and renders them as in-situ 3D heatmaps and trails.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR记录同学在教室里一次寻宝过程中手机的位置，事后在AR中回放为彩色轨迹线；变化：用颜色表示停留时间，讨论设计问题。
works.description_zh: 一个工具包，记录并可视化用户在混合现实应用中如何移动、观看和交互，以三维轨迹的形式在房间中回放他们的路径和视线。
works.idea_en: Draw where users walked and looked in MR as traces in space.
works.technique_zh: 对 Unity MR 应用进行埋点，记录头部位姿、视线和输入事件，并将其渲染为原位的三维热力图和轨迹。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR to record where a classmate's phone moves during a treasure hunt in the classroom, then replay it in AR as colored trails. Twist: use color to show dwell time and discuss the design problems it reveals.

works.title: Mario Kart Live: Home Circuit
works.description: A real RC kart with a camera drives around cardboard gates in your home; on the Switch, the camera feed becomes a Mario Kart track with items, rivals and weather overlaid on your rooms.
works.idea_zh: 一辆带摄像头的实体遥控卡丁车，把你家变成马力欧赛道。

video.video_title: Mario Kart Live: Home Circuit - Announcement Trailer - Nintendo Switch

works.technique: Fiducial markers on cardboard gates localize the RC car's onboard camera, so the track, items and rivals are rendered from the kart's viewpoint over its live video.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机固定在玩具车上，在地上放几张图像标记当“关卡门”，经过时在 AR 中显示加速道具；变体：把门的顺序设计成一条只有 AR 里才看得见的赛道。
works.description_zh: 一辆装有摄像头的真实遥控卡丁车绕着你家里的纸板关卡门行驶；在 Switch 上，摄像头画面变成一条马力欧赛车赛道，道具、对手和天气都叠加在你的房间里。
works.idea_en: A real RC kart with a camera turns your home into a Mario Kart track.
works.technique_zh: 纸板关卡门上的基准标记为遥控车的车载摄像头提供定位，赛道、道具和对手便以卡丁车的视角渲染在其实时视频之上。
works.exercise_en: Mount a phone on a toy car, lay a few image markers on the floor as gates, and show speed-boost items in AR when the car passes them. Twist: arrange the gates into a track that is visible only in AR.

works.title: Mario Kart Live: Home Circuit — developer interview
works.description: Velan Studios explains how they built the kart, the gate-based track system and the latency-sensitive AR rendering that makes a living room feel like a race course.
works.idea_zh: 开发者讲述如何让真实车辆与虚拟赛道无缝融合。

video.video_title: Mario Kart Live: Home Circuit- Developer Interview

works.technique: The gates both define the track path and correct camera pose drift, and rendering is tuned to minimize latency between the car's video and its overlays.
works.exercise_zh: 测量自己 AR 原型中从相机画面到叠加内容的延迟（如用高速录像），并尝试一种降低延迟的方法；变体：故意加大延迟，观察用户开始不舒服的临界点。
works.description_zh: Velan Studios 讲解他们如何打造这辆卡丁车、基于关卡门的赛道系统，以及对延迟高度敏感的 AR 渲染，让客厅真正有了赛道的感觉。
works.idea_en: The developers explain how they fused a real car with a virtual track.
works.technique_zh: 关卡门既用来定义赛道路径，也用来校正相机位姿漂移；渲染经过专门调校，尽量缩短车辆视频与叠加内容之间的延迟。
works.exercise_en: Measure the latency from camera frame to overlay in your own AR prototype, for example with high-speed video, and try one way to reduce it. Twist: deliberately increase the latency and find the threshold where users start to feel uncomfortable.

works.title: Matrix VFX
works.description: A 3D-scanned statue is covered in falling green Matrix code that wraps around its surface and slowly reveals the shape.
works.description_zh: 一座三维扫描雕像被黑客帝国式的绿色代码雨覆盖，字符沿着表面流下，慢慢勾勒出形体。
works.idea_en: Any object can be rewritten as digital rain that follows its shape.
works.idea_zh: 任何物体都能被改写成顺着它形状流下的数字雨。
works.technique: A shader uses triplanar mapping to project a procedurally animated glyph texture onto the mesh from three axes, with per-column random speeds and brightness trails.
works.technique_zh: 着色器用三平面映射从三个轴向把程序化动画的字符纹理投到网格上，每一列有随机速度和亮度拖尾。
works.exercise_en: Apply the Matrix shader to the ARKit scene mesh so the whole room turns into code rain on a LiDAR phone. Twist: only reveal the code where the user points a virtual flashlight.
works.exercise_zh: 在 LiDAR 手机上把这个 Matrix 着色器用在 ARKit 场景网格上，让整个房间变成代码雨。变体：只在用户手中虚拟手电筒照到的地方显示代码。

video.video_title: Matrix VFX Real time Shader in Unity 3D

works.title: Meander
works.description: A long hanging landscape in Cambridge, Ontario whose fronds, lights and sound respond to visitors with behaviours that learn and drift over time.
works.description_zh: 安大略省剑桥市的一条长长的悬挂景观，叶片、灯光和声音会回应观众，而且这些行为会随时间学习和漂移。
works.idea_en: A responsive space with its own slowly changing mood feels more alive than one that reacts identically every time — a lesson for persistent AR worlds.
works.idea_zh: 一个有自己缓慢变化“情绪”的响应空间，比每次都做出同样反应的空间更有生命感——这对持久化的 AR 世界是个启发。
works.technique: Sensor data from the crowd feeds behaviour software (reportedly with machine-learning components) that sets light, sound and actuator patterns across a distributed network.
works.technique_zh: 来自人群的传感数据输入行为软件（据介绍含有机器学习组件），在分布式网络上设定灯光、声音和执行器的模式。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR installation whose reaction to visitors (colour, speed, sound) slowly drifts based on how many people visited in the last hour, stored in a simple server. Twist: let it become 'sleepy' after crowds and 'curious' after silence.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 装置，它对访客的反应（颜色、速度、声音）根据过去一小时的访客数量缓慢变化，数据存在一个简单服务器上。变体：人多之后它变“困”，安静之后它变“好奇”。

video.video_title: Meander - Behavior, Software & Sound | Tapestry Hall Cambridge 2020

works.title: MediaPipe FaceMesh on Unity
works.description: A dense face mesh from MediaPipe tracks a person's face in the camera image in real time inside Unity, ready to be textured, lit or distorted.
works.description_zh: MediaPipe 的高密度人脸网格在 Unity 中实时跟踪摄像头画面里的脸，可以直接用来贴图、打光或变形。
works.idea_en: A face filter engine you own: run the face model yourself instead of relying on a platform's lens tools.
works.idea_zh: 一个属于你自己的人脸滤镜引擎：自己运行人脸模型，而不依赖平台的滤镜工具。
works.technique: BlazeFace detects the face and the MediaPipe Face Mesh TensorFlow Lite model regresses 468 landmarks, which the tf-lite-unity-sample project turns into a Unity mesh every frame.
works.technique_zh: BlazeFace 先检测人脸，再用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 的 TensorFlow Lite 模型回归出 468 个关键点，tf-lite-unity-sample 工程每帧把它们转成 Unity 网格。
works.exercise_en: Take the Face Mesh sample and paint the mesh with an animated shader (war paint, glowing veins, a glitch). Twist: detect a mouth-open gesture from the landmarks and emit particles from the lips.
works.exercise_zh: 基于 Face Mesh 示例，给网格加上动态着色器（战纹、发光血管、故障效果）。变体：从关键点判断张嘴动作，让粒子从嘴唇喷出。

video.video_title: MediaPipe FaceMesh on Unity

works.title: Mergereality: multi-device gestural interaction in AR
works.description: His CMU thesis and CHI 2020 paper: a set of passthrough-AR prototypes where bare hands move content between tablets, monitors, smart lights and the room, each borrowing a physical affordance such as a drawer, a book page or a dropper.
works.description_zh: 他在 CMU 的毕业设计与 CHI 2020 论文：一组透视式 AR 原型，用徒手在平板、显示器、智能灯和房间之间搬运内容，每个交互都借用一种现实中的可供性，比如抽屉、书页或滴管。
works.idea_en: Screens and devices become physical containers that your hands can reach into and pull content out of.
works.idea_zh: 把屏幕和设备当成可以伸手进去、把内容拉出来的实体容器。
works.technique: A VR headset with a ZED Mini stereo camera provides video passthrough, Leap Motion tracks the hands, and each screen's pose is registered in Unity so that pinches near its edge hand content over between 2D and 3D.
works.technique_zh: 在 VR 头显上加装 ZED Mini 双目相机实现视频透视，Leap Motion 追踪双手，并在 Unity 中标定每块屏幕的位置，使手在屏幕边缘捏取时内容能在 2D 与 3D 之间交接。
works.exercise_en: Pick one everyday metaphor (drawer, pocket, envelope) and prototype a phone-AR gesture that moves a photo from a laptop screen into the room using an image marker on the screen. Twist: make the reverse gesture put it back.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个日常隐喻（抽屉、口袋、信封），用手机 AR 和贴在笔记本屏幕上的图像标记，做一个把照片从屏幕“拿”到房间里的手势原型。变体：再设计一个反向手势把它放回去。

video.video_title: Affordances for Multi-device Gestural Interaction in Augmented Reality

works.title: Mesh Deformation with Compute Shaders on Quest
works.description: In VR on an Oculus Quest the user pushes into a soft mesh with a controller and it dents and springs back like clay or jelly.
works.description_zh: 在 Oculus Quest 的 VR 中，用户用手柄按压一个柔软的网格，它会像黏土或果冻一样凹陷并回弹。
works.idea_en: Make virtual surfaces soft to the touch on standalone mobile hardware.
works.idea_zh: 在一体机上让虚拟表面摸起来是软的。
works.technique: A compute shader displaces each vertex away from the controller with a falloff and integrates a spring back to its rest position, running on Android/Quest GPUs.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器按衰减把每个顶点从手柄位置推开，并用弹簧积分让它回到原位，可在 Android/Quest 的 GPU 上运行。
works.exercise_en: Place a deformable blob on a real table in passthrough MR or phone AR and let students poke it with a finger or controller. Twist: the blob remembers every poke and slowly heals.
works.exercise_zh: 在透视 MR 或手机 AR 中把一个可变形的团块放在真实桌面上，让学生用手指或手柄戳它。变体：团块记住每一次戳，并慢慢愈合。

video.video_title: Mesh Deformation With Compute Shader on Andriod/ Oculus Quest in Unity3D

works.title: Metal Particles v2
works.description: Metal-driven particle systems that flow over the LiDAR-scanned geometry of a real room.
works.idea_zh: 让 Metal 粒子沿着 LiDAR 扫描出的房间表面流动。

video.video_title: Metal Particles v2

works.technique: GPU particles sample positions and normals from the LiDAR scene mesh (or depth map) so they flow and collide along the real room surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Unity VFX Graph 从 AR 网格表面发射粒子，让粒子沿重力流过家具；变体：让粒子流动方向跟随手机移动方向。
works.description_zh: 由 Metal 驱动的粒子系统，沿着 LiDAR 扫描出的真实房间几何表面流动。
works.idea_en: Let Metal particles flow along the room surfaces scanned by LiDAR.
works.technique_zh: GPU 粒子从 LiDAR 场景网格（或深度图）中采样位置和法线，从而沿真实房间表面流动并与之碰撞。
works.exercise_en: Emit particles from the AR mesh surface with Unity VFX Graph and let them flow over the furniture under gravity. Twist: make the particles flow in the direction the phone is moving.

works.title: MiXR: Hybrid AR Sheet Music
works.description: A performer sees virtual sheet music floating on the music stand through an AR headset, turns pages and annotates bars from a phone and tablet without taking hands off the instrument for long.
works.description_zh: 演奏者通过 AR 头显看到悬浮在谱架上的虚拟乐谱，可以用手机和平板翻页、在小节上做批注，而不必长时间离开乐器。
works.idea_en: Sheet music that floats where you need it and can be marked up by anyone in the ensemble.
works.idea_zh: 乐谱漂浮在需要的地方，乐团里的任何人都能在上面做标记。
works.technique: Combines an AR headset, a smartphone and a tablet in one networked system to place, page and annotate virtual scores in the physical environment.
works.technique_zh: 把 AR 头显、智能手机和平板组成一个联网系统，在实体环境中放置、翻页和批注虚拟乐谱。
works.exercise_en: Place a song's lyrics or chords as an AR panel beside a real instrument and let a second phone act as a page-turn pedal. Twist: let the 'conductor' phone highlight the bar everyone should be on.
works.exercise_zh: 把一首歌的歌词或和弦做成 AR 面板放在真实乐器旁，再用第二部手机当翻页踏板；变体：让“指挥”的手机高亮大家当前应该演奏的小节。

video.video_title: MiXR: A Hybrid AR Sheet Music Interface for Live Performance - Demo Video

works.title: Micromonumental Mapping
works.description: For the Lille Video Mapping Festival, Limelight mapped a 1:40 scale 3D model of the Lille Opera House instead of the real building, so a full monumental mapping show plays on a tabletop.
works.description_zh: 为里尔视频映射节，Limelight 没有投在真实建筑上，而是投在一个 1:40 的里尔歌剧院三维模型上，让一整场宏伟的建筑投影在桌面上上演。
works.idea_en: A miniature model is a cheap, controllable stand-in for a building; a tabletop AR prototype is the fastest way to test a large site-specific idea.
works.idea_zh: 微缩模型是建筑的一种便宜、可控的替身；在桌面上做 AR 原型，是验证大型场地作品的最快方法。
works.technique: A physical scale model of the opera house is lit by a single projector with content rendered from the matching 3D model and viewpoint.
works.technique_zh: 用一台投影机照亮歌剧院的实体比例模型，投影内容由对应的三维模型和视角渲染。
works.exercise_en: Print or build a small model of a campus building, track it with an object or image target in Vuforia or Lens Studio, and play a mapping-style animation on it. Twist: move the model and let the animation follow in real time.
works.exercise_zh: 打印或做一个校园建筑的小模型，在 Vuforia 或 Lens Studio 里用物体或图像识别追踪它，在上面播放映射风格的动画；变体：移动模型时动画实时跟随。

video.video_title: Micromonumental Mapping

works.title: Microsoft Mixed Reality Capture holograms in WebAR
works.description: Volumetric video of real performers captured in Microsoft's Mixed Reality Capture Studios plays as life-size holograms in the phone browser through 8th Wall.
works.idea_zh: 真人全息视频直接在手机浏览器里以真人大小出现在你面前。

video.video_title: Microsoft's Mixed Reality Capture Studios Integrated with 8th Wall WebAR

works.technique: Volumetric video (a sequence of textured meshes) is streamed and played in sync with audio, and anchored at life size on a detected ground plane in the browser.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机抠像（背景分离）录一段同学的视频，作为面向镜头的平面“全息人”放在 AR 地面上；变体：让这个全息人在你走近时转头看你。
works.description_zh: 在微软混合现实捕捉工作室（Mixed Reality Capture Studios）中拍摄的真人表演者体积视频，通过 8th Wall 在手机浏览器中以真人大小的全息影像播放。
works.idea_en: Life-size holographic video of real people appears right in front of you in the phone browser.
works.technique_zh: 体积视频（一系列带纹理的网格）以流式方式传输并与音频同步播放，在浏览器中以真人比例锚定在检测到的地面平面上。
works.exercise_en: Record a video of a classmate with phone background removal and place it on the AR floor as a camera-facing flat hologram person. Twist: make the hologram turn its head to look at you as you approach.

works.title: Minecraft Filter
works.description: A LiDAR filter that renders the surrounding room as blocky Minecraft-style geometry.
works.idea_zh: 把身边的真实房间渲染成《我的世界》方块风格。

video.video_title: Minecraft Filter

works.technique: Scene depth or mesh is voxelized and each voxel is textured by sampling the camera color at its projected position, giving a blocky Minecraft-like rendering.
works.exercise_zh: 把房间网格体素化，每个方块用摄像头画面对应颜色上色，做出方块风格的房间；变体：只让手机前方一个球形范围内变成方块。
works.description_zh: 一个 LiDAR 滤镜，把周围的房间渲染成《我的世界》风格的方块几何体。
works.idea_en: Render the real room around you in Minecraft-style blocks.
works.technique_zh: 对场景深度或网格进行体素化，每个体素按其投影位置从摄像头画面中采样颜色作为贴图，呈现出类似《我的世界》的方块效果。
works.exercise_en: Voxelize the room mesh and color each block with the matching color from the camera image to make a block-style room. Twist: only a spherical zone in front of the phone turns into blocks.

works.title: Mixed Reality Light Fields for Remote Assistance
works.description: A local worker captures a light field of a workspace with a phone; the remote expert explores it with free viewpoints and places annotations that appear in the worker's AR view.
works.idea_zh: 用手机拍下光场，远程专家自由看角度并把标注放回现场AR。

video.video_title: CHI2020: Mixed Reality Light Fields for Interactive Remote Assistance

works.technique: Captures many registered images to render novel views of the scene for the remote helper, then anchors their 3D annotations back in the local tracking space.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生甲用手机从多个角度拍一个桌面故障（如接线），学生乙在照片上标注步骤，甲再用AR标签还原到现场；变化：限定乙只能看3张照片。
works.description_zh: 现场工作人员用手机拍摄工作区域的光场；远程专家可以自由切换视角进行查看，并放置标注，这些标注会出现在工作人员的 AR 视图中。
works.idea_en: Capture a light field with a phone so a remote expert can view it from any angle and place notes back into the on-site AR.
works.technique_zh: 采集大量经过配准的图像，为远程协助者渲染场景的新视角，再把他们的三维标注锚定回现场的追踪空间中。
works.exercise_en: Have student A photograph a desktop fault, such as wiring, from several angles with a phone, have student B annotate the steps on the photos, and have A restore them on site as AR labels. Twist: limit B to looking at only 3 photos.

works.title: MonoFxSketches: monochrome screen effects
works.description: A set of black-and-white full-screen effects that split, slide and posterize the image in rhythmic patterns.
works.description_zh: 一组黑白全屏特效，按节奏把画面切割、滑动、色调分离。
works.idea_en: Strong graphic effects work best with only two colors.
works.idea_zh: 只用黑白两色，图形效果最有力量。
works.technique: Full-screen shaders threshold the image and apply random slice offsets and mirroring driven by time and random seeds.
works.technique_zh: 全屏着色器先把画面二值化，再按时间和随机种子做随机切片偏移和镜像。
works.exercise_en: Apply a random-split monochrome shader to the AR Foundation camera feed and sync the splits to a metronome. Twist: people stay unsplit using human segmentation.
works.exercise_zh: 给 AR Foundation 相机画面加黑白随机切割着色器，并让切割与节拍器同步。变体：用人像分割让人保持完整不被切开。

video.video_title: Random split https://t.co/HoU3Rn5ZKz https://t.co/189wMD5WT9

works.title: Move: Build: Code
works.description: In a three-day summer workshop, 12–14-year-olds build and code a robot that responds to their own choreographed dance movements, ending in a performance with the robots.
works.description_zh: 在为期三天的夏季工作坊中，12 至 14 岁的学生制作并编程一个能响应自己编排舞蹈动作的机器人，最后与机器人同台演出。
works.idea_en: Kids learn to code by teaching a robot to answer their dance.
works.idea_zh: 孩子们通过教机器人回应自己的舞蹈来学习编程。
works.technique: Students wear or hold micro:bit-style sensor boards whose accelerometer readings are sent by radio to a small robot that reacts with movement and light (likely micro:bit).
works.technique_zh: 学生佩戴或手持类似 micro:bit 的传感器板，加速度数据通过无线电发给小机器人，机器人用动作和灯光作出反应（很可能使用 micro:bit）。
works.exercise_en: Tape a micro:bit to a wrist and send its tilt to a second micro:bit on a wheeled robot that drives when the dancer spins. Twist: make the robot copy the dance only after a four-count delay, like a canon.
works.exercise_zh: 把一块 micro:bit 贴在手腕上，把倾斜数据发给装在轮式机器人上的另一块 micro:bit，舞者旋转时机器人就移动；变体：让机器人延迟四拍再模仿，形成卡农。

video.video_title: MOVE BUILD CODE

works.title: Murmurations
works.description: Starling flocks drawing shifting shapes over the sky are traced so the whole murmuration reads as a moving sculpture; when a peregrine falcon attacks, the traces show the flock splitting and reforming.
works.description_zh: 椋鸟群在天空中变换形状，被描绘成一件运动的雕塑；当游隼发动攻击时，轨迹展示鸟群如何分裂又重组。
works.idea_en: Tracing a flock shows that form can emerge from many local decisions without a leader, an idea for AR swarms that react to a predator (the user).
works.idea_zh: 描绘鸟群说明形态可以在没有领导者的情况下从许多局部决策中涌现，这为会对“捕食者”（用户）作出反应的 AR 群体提供了思路。
works.technique: The Ornithographies trail effect is applied to long takes of starling murmurations so each bird leaves a short, fading line.
works.technique_zh: 把 Ornithographies 的轨迹效果应用到椋鸟群的长镜头上，让每只鸟留下一条短暂、渐隐的线。
works.exercise_en: Program a boids flock in Unity or three.js, place it in AR above a courtyard, and draw a short trail behind every bird. Twist: make the phone position a predator the flock avoids.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity 或 three.js 中编写 boids 鸟群，放在 AR 中的庭院上空，并在每只鸟身后画出短轨迹；变体：把手机位置当作捕食者，让鸟群躲避它。

video.video_title: Murmurations

salient.why_en: Tracing every starling turns a flock into one moving sculpture in the sky.
salient.why_zh: 把每只椋鸟的轨迹描出来，整个鸟群变成天空中一件流动的雕塑。

works.title: Olafur Eliasson: WUNDERKAMMER
works.description: A collection of AR objects by Olafur Eliasson (a sun, rain cloud, rainbow, puffin, compass) placed in the viewer's home during lockdown; the AR sun even charges a virtual Little Sun lamp.
works.idea_zh: 疫情期间把太阳、云、彩虹等自然现象用AR带进家里

video.video_title: Olafur Eliasson x Acute Art | WUNDERKAMMER

works.technique: Plane detection in the Acute Art app (ARKit/ARCore) places animated models of natural phenomena at real scale in the home, with simple interaction logic such as sun exposure charging a virtual lamp.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 做一个“家中自然现象”：在客厅放一朵会下雨的云或一个小太阳，并让它与另一个虚拟物体产生因果关系；变体：让现象只在现实天气相反时出现（外面下雨时室内出太阳）。
works.description_zh: Olafur Eliasson 创作的一组 AR 物件（太阳、雨云、彩虹、海鹦、指南针），在封城期间被放进观众家中；AR 太阳甚至能为一盏虚拟的 Little Sun 灯充电。
works.idea_en: During the pandemic, AR brought the sun, clouds, rainbows and other natural phenomena into people's homes.
works.technique_zh: Acute Art 应用中的平面检测（ARKit/ARCore）将自然现象的动画模型以真实尺度放置在家中，并配有简单的交互逻辑，例如晒太阳可以给虚拟灯充电。
works.exercise_en: Build a natural phenomenon at home with AR Foundation: put a raining cloud or a small sun in the living room and give it a cause-and-effect link with another virtual object. Twist: the phenomenon appears only when the real weather is the opposite, such as sunshine indoors while it rains outside.

works.title: Painted Mirror
works.description: A mirror installation for Springville Public Library that separates you from your surroundings with a depth camera and paints your portrait into an illustrated world, sharpening as you stand still.
works.idea_zh: 会画画的镜子：站得越久，你的肖像在插画世界里被描得越清楚。

video.video_title: Painted Mirror Timelapse

works.technique: A depth camera segments the person from the background, and a stroke-based painterly renderer draws the portrait with brush size shrinking the longer the person stands still.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 分割加 p5.js 画笔粒子，把人画成油画风格，静止越久笔触越细越清楚，一动就变模糊；变体：背景换成你们学校的某个场景，做一面“毕业照镜子”。
works.description_zh: 为斯普林维尔公共图书馆（Springville Public Library）创作的一面镜子装置：它用深度相机把你从周围环境中分离出来，将你的肖像画进一个插画世界，你站得越久，画像就越清晰。
works.idea_en: A mirror that paints: the longer you stand still, the clearer your portrait becomes in an illustrated world.
works.technique_zh: 深度相机把人从背景中分割出来，基于笔触的绘画风格渲染器描绘肖像，人静止的时间越长，笔刷就越细。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe segmentation and p5.js brush particles to paint a person in an oil-painting style, where strokes get finer and clearer the longer they stay still and blur as soon as they move. Twist: replace the background with a scene from your school to make a graduation-photo mirror.

salient.why_en: A mirror that paints you: the longer you stand still, the clearer your portrait becomes.
salient.why_zh: 一面会画你的镜子：你站得越久越静，画像就越清晰。

works.title: Particle depth of field with VFX Graph
works.description: Glowing particles in the foreground and background blur into soft bokeh discs while those at the focal distance stay sharp.
works.description_zh: 前景和背景的发光粒子虚化成柔和的光斑，只有焦点距离上的粒子保持清晰。
works.idea_en: Fake camera blur per particle to add depth cheaply.
works.idea_zh: 在每颗粒子上假装镜头虚化，便宜地增加景深感。
works.technique: A custom VFX Graph block computes each particle's circle of confusion from its distance to the focal plane and scales and fades a soft disc sprite accordingly.
works.technique_zh: 自定义 VFX Graph 模块根据粒子到焦平面的距离算出弥散圆大小，并相应放大、变淡柔和的圆盘贴图。
works.exercise_en: Use DoF particles in an AR Foundation scene so dust motes near the phone look blurred and those around a real object look sharp. Twist: move the focus to whatever the center of the screen touches.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 场景里使用景深粒子：靠近手机的灰尘是模糊的，围绕真实物体的灰尘是清晰的。变体：焦点自动移到屏幕中心对准的物体上。

video.video_title: Particle depth of field with Unity VFX Graph https://t.co/KombXWh0cy https://t.co/zsvztHegRF

works.title: PcxEffects3: point cloud effects
works.description: A photogrammetry point cloud of a scanned scene flickers, scatters and reforms as animated particles.
works.description_zh: 一个摄影测量得到的扫描点云不断闪烁、散开、再重组成动画粒子。
works.idea_en: A static scan becomes a living, breathing place.
works.idea_zh: 静态扫描变成会呼吸的场所。
works.technique: Pcx imports the .ply point cloud as a point cache, and VFX Graph reads positions and colors from it to spawn and animate particles.
works.technique_zh: Pcx 把 .ply 点云导入为点缓存，VFX Graph 从中读取位置和颜色来生成并驱动粒子。
works.exercise_en: Scan a corner of your room with Polycam, import the points, and align the particle version to the real corner in AR Foundation. Twist: let the particles drift away wherever the phone points.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Polycam 扫描房间一角，导入点云，在 AR Foundation 中把粒子版本对齐到真实角落。变体：手机指向哪里，那里的粒子就飘走。

video.video_title: https://t.co/O2oHp2jEGi https://t.co/hK276jF8GZ

works.title: Physics Simulation with ARKit 3.5
works.description: Virtual objects bounce and pile up on the LiDAR-scanned furniture and floor.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟物体在 LiDAR 扫描的家具上真实碰撞堆叠。

video.video_title: Physics simulation with ARKit3.5

works.technique: The LiDAR scene mesh is used as a MeshCollider, so rigidbodies spawned in Unity bounce off and pile up on real furniture.
works.exercise_zh: 给 AR 网格加 MeshCollider，点击屏幕从相机位置抛出小球，让它们落在真实沙发上；变体：只有打到某件家具才得分。
works.description_zh: 虚拟物体在 LiDAR 扫描出的家具和地面上弹跳、堆叠。
works.idea_en: Virtual objects collide and pile up realistically on LiDAR-scanned furniture.
works.technique_zh: 把 LiDAR 场景网格用作 MeshCollider，使 Unity 中生成的刚体能在真实家具上弹开并堆叠起来。
works.exercise_en: Add a MeshCollider to the AR mesh and tap the screen to throw balls from the camera position so they land on the real sofa. Twist: you score only when you hit a particular piece of furniture.

works.title: Pix2Pix in a Fragment Shader
works.description: A generative image-to-image network running entirely in a Unity shader turns simple line drawings into generated Pikachu, Mario or tree images in real time inside VRChat.
works.description_zh: 一个完全运行在 Unity 着色器中的图像到图像生成网络，在 VRChat 里把简单的线稿实时变成皮卡丘、马里奥或树木的生成图像。
works.idea_en: A GAN can be just another material on a surface.
works.idea_zh: 生成对抗网络也可以只是物体表面上的另一种材质。
works.technique: A pix2pix U-Net generator cut to a quarter of the original size is implemented layer by layer in Cg/HLSL fragment passes over render textures, with weights trained in Keras and stored in textures, so inference happens as part of rendering.
works.technique_zh: 把缩小到原模型四分之一的 pix2pix U-Net 生成器逐层写成作用于渲染纹理的 Cg/HLSL 片元通道，权重在 Keras 中训练后存进纹理，推理就成了渲染的一部分。
works.exercise_en: Let people doodle on a virtual canvas in AR and show a style-transferred version beside it using an on-device image-to-image model. Twist: the canvas reads a real paper drawing through the camera instead.
works.exercise_zh: 让人们在 AR 中的虚拟画布上涂鸦，并用设备端的图像到图像模型在旁边显示风格化后的版本。变体：画布改为通过相机读取真实纸上的画。

video.video_title: I released the code to my pix2pix implementation in UnityCG/HLSL! https://t.co/ozrmm7ddUv #VRChat #GANs #DeepLearning #MachineLearning #AI #shader #Unity3D https://t.co/wx9178K0xf

works.title: Point Cloud Garden
works.description: A scanned garden appears as millions of coloured points that drift, dissolve and reform as the camera glides through it.
works.description_zh: 一座扫描的花园以数百万个彩色点呈现，镜头穿过时这些点漂移、消散又重组。
works.idea_en: A scanned place becomes a living material when its points can move.
works.idea_zh: 当扫描得到的点能够移动，一个地方就成了活的材料。
works.technique: A PLY point cloud is baked into position and colour maps (following Keijiro's Pcx) and fed to VFX Graph, which spawns a particle per texel and animates it with noise in HDRP.
works.technique_zh: 按照 Keijiro 的 Pcx 做法，把 PLY 点云烘焙成位置和颜色贴图并输入 VFX Graph，每个纹素生成一个粒子，在 HDRP 中用噪声驱动动画。
works.exercise_en: Scan a corner of the campus with a LiDAR phone, bake it into point maps, and replay it as a dissolving point cloud in the same spot with AR Foundation. Twist: the points drift away in the wind direction of the day.
works.exercise_zh: 用 LiDAR 手机扫描校园一角，烘焙成点云贴图，再用 AR Foundation 在原地把它作为会消散的点云重放。变体：点按当天的风向飘散。

video.video_title: Point Cloud Garden, 2020

works.title: Pokémon GO Buddy Adventure
works.description: Buddy Pokémon follow the player and can be viewed in AR, where players feed them, play with them and take snapshots; the bond grows as you walk together.
works.idea_zh: 把宝可梦变成陪你散步的AR伙伴，可以喂食、互动、合影。

video.video_title: Pokemon GO - Official Buddy Adventures Feature Trailer

works.technique: An animated companion is placed on a detected plane, and touch interactions such as feeding and petting change a persistent affinity value that also grows with step count.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 小宠物，点击喂食、滑动抚摸会增加亲密度，亲密度达到阈值后解锁新动作；变体：亲密度也随你一天走的步数增长。
works.description_zh: 伙伴宝可梦会跟随玩家，并可在 AR 中查看；玩家可以喂食、陪它玩耍、给它拍照，一起走得越多，羁绊就越深。
works.idea_en: Turn a Pokémon into an AR companion that walks with you and that you can feed, play with and photograph.
works.technique_zh: 一个动画伙伴被放置在检测到的平面上，喂食、抚摸等触摸交互会改变一个持久保存的亲密度数值，该数值也会随步数增长。
works.exercise_en: Make a small AR pet whose affinity rises when you tap to feed it and swipe to pet it, unlocking a new move once affinity passes a threshold. Twist: affinity also grows with the number of steps you walk each day.

works.title: Pokémon GO Shared AR Experience
works.description: Nearby trainers join one shared AR session in which their buddy Pokémon appear together in the same real-world scene, so friends can play and take photos together.
works.idea_zh: 附近的玩家进入同一个AR场景，看到彼此的伙伴宝可梦一起玩耍。

video.video_title: Shared AR Experience Tutorial

works.technique: Nearby phones localize to a common anchor (via Lightship shared AR) so each player's companion is spawned at a shared pose and seen consistently by everyone.
works.exercise_zh: 两台手机通过共同图像标记对齐，各自放出一只宠物，让它们在对方屏幕里也出现并互相打招呼；变体：两只宠物靠近时一起做一个合体动作。
works.description_zh: 附近的训练家加入同一个共享 AR 会话，各自的伙伴宝可梦一同出现在同一个真实场景中，朋友们可以一起玩耍、合影。
works.idea_en: Nearby players enter the same AR scene and watch their buddy Pokémon play together.
works.technique_zh: 附近的手机定位到同一个共同锚点（通过 Lightship 共享 AR），使每位玩家的伙伴都在共享位姿处生成，所有人看到的效果一致。
works.exercise_en: Align two phones with a shared image marker, have each release a pet, and make each pet appear on the other screen too and greet the other pet. Twist: when the two pets come close, they perform a combined move together.

works.title: Potato Boss lens
works.description: A Snapchat/Snap Camera lens replaces you with a talking potato whose mouth and eyes are cut from your own face; it went viral when a manager got stuck with it in a video meeting.
works.idea_zh: 把你的脸变成会说话的土豆。

video.video_title: Why My Lens Blew with Phil Walton

works.technique: Face tracking crops the user's eyes and mouth textures and composites them onto a 3D potato model that follows head pose.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 把眼睛和嘴贴到一个水果/文具上做成'会说话的物品'；加一个变化：讲到关键词时物品会变色。
works.description_zh: 一个 Snapchat/Snap Camera 滤镜，把你替换成一颗会说话的土豆，土豆的嘴和眼睛取自你自己的脸；有位经理在视频会议中被这个滤镜卡住，让它一夜爆红。
works.idea_en: Turn your face into a talking potato.
works.technique_zh: 面部追踪裁剪出用户眼睛和嘴巴的纹理，并将其合成到一个跟随头部姿态的三维土豆模型上。
works.exercise_en: Use Lens Studio to paste your eyes and mouth onto a fruit or a piece of stationery to make a talking object. Twist: the object changes color when you say a keyword.

works.title: Procedural Painting with Genetic Evolution
works.description: A photo is repainted stroke by stroke: thousands of brush strokes evolve on the GPU until they reproduce the portrait as an expressive painting.
works.description_zh: 一张照片被一笔一笔重新画出来：成千上万的笔触在 GPU 上进化，直到拼成一幅富有表现力的肖像画。
works.idea_en: Let evolution, not a filter, decide where each brush stroke goes.
works.idea_zh: 让进化算法而不是滤镜来决定每一笔该落在哪里。
works.technique: A genetic algorithm implemented in compute shaders mutates populations of brush-stroke parameters, renders them, and scores each candidate against the target image to keep the fittest.
works.technique_zh: 在计算着色器里实现的遗传算法不断变异笔触参数群体、渲染出来，并与目标图像比较打分，保留最合适的个体。
works.exercise_en: Capture a camera frame on a phone, run a small stroke-evolution loop, and hang the resulting painting as a canvas on a real wall in AR. Twist: let the painting keep evolving each time someone looks at it.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机上截取一帧相机画面，运行一个小型笔触进化循环，把生成的画作为画布挂到 AR 中真实的墙上。变体：每次有人看它，画都会继续进化。

video.video_title: Procedural Painting in Unity 3D

works.title: Pronto
works.description: Germán Leiva, Cuong Nguyen, Rubaiat Habib Kazi and Paul Asente let designers prototype AR by sketching on video and acting out interactions, with sketches anchored in 3D.
works.idea_zh: 在视频里随手画、自己演，几分钟就做出AR交互原型。

video.video_title: Pronto: Rapid Augmented Reality Video Prototyping Using Sketches and Enaction

works.technique: ARKit records a video with camera poses, and sketches drawn on video frames are lifted into 3D using the tracked camera and detected planes so they stay anchored as the recorded scene is replayed.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Reality Composer 或 Adobe Aero 录一段 AR 视频，在其中用手绘草图和“演一遍”的方式快速做出一个 AR 应用的交互原型，在 30 分钟内完成两轮迭代；变体：原型必须只用手绘线条，不允许任何 3D 模型。
works.description_zh: Germán Leiva、Cuong Nguyen、Rubaiat Habib Kazi 和 Paul Asente 让设计师通过在视频上画草图、亲自表演交互来制作 AR 原型，草图会锚定在三维空间中。
works.idea_en: Sketch on video and act it out yourself to build an AR interaction prototype in minutes.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 录制带相机位姿的视频，在视频帧上画出的草图借助追踪到的相机和检测到的平面被提升到三维空间，使其在回放录制场景时保持锚定。
works.exercise_en: Record an AR video with Reality Composer or Adobe Aero and quickly prototype an AR app's interaction in it with hand-drawn sketches and acting it out, completing two rounds of iteration in 30 minutes. Twist: the prototype may use only hand-drawn lines and no 3D models at all.

works.title: Quantum Memories
works.description: At the NGV Triennial in Melbourne, a giant screen shows waves of nature imagery that seem to push out of the wall, generated from hundreds of millions of landscape photos combined with noise from a quantum computer.
works.description_zh: 在墨尔本 NGV 三年展上，一块巨大的屏幕播放着仿佛从墙里涌出的自然影像浪潮，它由数亿张风景照片与量子计算机噪声共同生成。
works.idea_en: A flat screen can feel volumetric when the content is rendered for one sweet spot; AR designers can use forced perspective to fake depth on flat surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 当内容针对某一个最佳观看点渲染时，平面屏幕也能显得有体积：AR 设计者可以用强制透视在平面上制造纵深。
works.technique: Images generated by a GAN are placed in a 3D point field whose motion uses quantum-computing noise, and rendered with forced perspective for the room.
works.technique_zh: GAN 生成的图像被放进一个三维点场，点的运动采用量子计算噪声，并按展厅视角用强制透视渲染。
works.exercise_en: Pin a flat AR panel to a real wall and render a point cloud behind it that only looks deep from one marked spot on the floor. Twist: when the user steps off the spot, the illusion breaks and the points spill out into the room.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实墙面上固定一块平面 AR 面板，在它背后渲染一片点云，只有站在地上某个标记点时才显得有纵深。变体：用户一离开标记点，幻觉就破裂，点云洒进房间。

video.video_title: Refik Anadol / Quantum Memories Case Study - NGV Triennial 2020

works.title: Rain shader (2D-Unity-Experiments)
works.description: Rain streaks down a window in front of a softly blurred scene; drops gather, slide and leave clear trails in the fogged glass.
works.description_zh: 雨水沿着窗户流下，窗外是柔和模糊的场景；水滴聚集、滑落，在起雾的玻璃上留下清晰的痕迹。
works.idea_en: Make the screen itself feel like wet glass between viewer and world.
works.idea_zh: 让屏幕本身像是隔在观者和世界之间的一块湿玻璃。
works.technique: A full-screen shader (based on a Shadertoy raindrop effect) renders the scene to a RenderTexture, then offsets and blurs its UVs with procedural drop normals so the drops refract the image behind them.
works.technique_zh: 一个全屏着色器（参考 Shadertoy 上的雨滴效果）先把场景渲染到 RenderTexture，再用程序化水滴法线偏移并模糊 UV，让水滴折射后面的画面。
works.exercise_en: Apply the rain shader to the AR camera feed so the real street looks like it is seen through a rainy window. Twist: wipe a clear patch with a finger swipe that slowly fogs up again.
works.exercise_zh: 把雨水着色器用在 AR 相机画面上，让真实街道看起来像是隔着雨窗。变体：手指一划擦出一块清晰区域，然后它慢慢重新起雾。

rain shader in @unity3d using RenderTexture ⛈️

works.title: Rcam2: Volumetric AR camera rig
works.description: An iPad Pro LiDAR rig streams color, depth and camera pose to a PC, where Unity wraps the real scene in glowing particle and line effects that stay locked to the room.
works.idea_zh: 把 iPad 的 LiDAR 当成可移动的体积摄像机，让特效贴着真实房间长出来。

video.video_title: Rcam2: Volumetric AR camera rig with Unity

works.technique: ARKit on an iPad Pro captures LiDAR depth, color and camera pose, streams them over NDI to a PC, and Unity reprojects the depth into world space to spawn VFX Graph effects.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Reality Composer 或 Unity AR Foundation 的 mesh 扫描，让粒子沿着真实墙面和家具流动；加一个变化：只在你指过的物体表面发光。
works.description_zh: 一套基于 iPad Pro LiDAR 的拍摄装置，把彩色画面、深度和相机位姿实时传到 PC，由 Unity 在真实场景外包裹上发光的粒子和线条特效，并始终锁定在房间中。
works.idea_en: Use an iPad's LiDAR as a mobile volumetric camera so effects grow right on the real room.
works.technique_zh: iPad Pro 上的 ARKit 采集 LiDAR 深度、彩色画面和相机位姿，通过 NDI 传输到 PC，Unity 再把深度重投影到世界空间，生成 VFX Graph 特效。
works.exercise_en: Use mesh scanning in Reality Composer or Unity AR Foundation to make particles flow along real walls and furniture. Twist: only the surfaces of objects you have pointed at light up.

works.title: Real-Time LiDAR Point Cloud Streaming from iPad Pro
works.description: Streams the iPad Pro's live LiDAR point cloud to a remote PC and other XR devices, later with a cartoon-style rendering.
works.idea_zh: 把 iPad LiDAR 实时点云直播给远端设备。

video.video_title: Real-Time Point Cloud Streaming Application Working with LiDAR Sensor of iPad Pro

works.technique: Depth-map pixels are unprojected to world-space points using camera intrinsics and pose each frame, then compressed and streamed over the network for remote rendering.
works.exercise_zh: 从 iPhone 深度图中每 N 个像素取一个点反投影成点云，通过 WebSocket 发送到电脑上的 three.js 页面显示；变体：接收端把点渲染成不同风格（如方块或文字）。
works.description_zh: 把 iPad Pro 实时的 LiDAR 点云传输到远程 PC 和其他 XR 设备上，后来还加入了卡通风格的渲染。
works.idea_en: Stream an iPad's live LiDAR point cloud to remote devices.
works.technique_zh: 每一帧利用相机内参和位姿，把深度图像素反投影为世界空间中的点，然后压缩并通过网络传输，在远端渲染。
works.exercise_en: Take one point every N pixels from an iPhone depth map, unproject them into a point cloud, and send it over WebSocket to a three.js page on a computer for display. Twist: render the points on the receiving side in a different style, such as blocks or text.

works.title: RealitySketch
works.description: Sketch lines, angles and graphs on a phone's AR view of a moving object (a pendulum, a rolling ball) and the drawings bind to it, updating live to visualize physics.
works.idea_zh: 随手画的线和角度会'粘'在真实运动的物体上，实时变成物理可视化。

video.video_title: [UIST 2020] RealitySketch: Embedding Responsive Graphics and Visualizations in AR

works.technique: ARKit tracks the device and a detected plane, the moving object is tracked in the camera image by color, and sketched elements are bound to the object's projected 3D position so lines, angles and plots update each frame.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中用颜色追踪标记一个摆动的吊坠或滚动的球，用户画一条线连接到它，线段长度和角度随运动实时更新并在旁边绘出曲线图；变体：用这个工具去测量你身边一个你好奇的周期运动。
works.description_zh: 在手机 AR 画面中，针对运动的物体（摆锤、滚动的球）画出线条、角度和图表，这些图形会与物体绑定并实时更新，把物理过程可视化。
works.idea_en: Lines and angles you sketch stick to real moving objects and become live physics visualizations.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 追踪设备和检测到的平面，运动物体通过颜色在摄像头画面中被追踪，绘制的元素绑定到物体投影后的三维位置上，使线条、角度和曲线图逐帧更新。
works.exercise_en: In phone AR, use color tracking to mark a swinging pendant or a rolling ball, let the user draw a line connected to it, and update the line's length and angle live while plotting a graph beside it. Twist: use the tool to measure some periodic motion around you that you are curious about.

works.title: Realtime Boxelization with ARKit4 and LiDAR
works.description: The whole room, including people, is converted in real time into a field of voxel boxes.
works.idea_zh: 把整个房间连同人实时体素化成方块。

video.video_title: Realtime Boxelization with ARKit4 and LiDAR

works.technique: The depth map is unprojected to world points each frame and quantized into a voxel grid, which is rendered as GPU-instanced cubes.
works.exercise_zh: 把 iPhone 深度图反投影成点并按 5cm 网格取整，用 GPU 实例化渲染成方块；变体：方块大小随音乐音量变化。
works.description_zh: 整个房间，连同其中的人，都被实时转换成一片体素方块。
works.idea_en: Voxelize the whole room, people included, into blocks in real time.
works.technique_zh: 每一帧将深度图反投影为世界空间中的点，并量化到体素网格中，再以 GPU 实例化的立方体进行渲染。
works.exercise_en: Unproject an iPhone depth map into points, snap them to a 5 cm grid, and render them as blocks with GPU instancing. Twist: make the block size change with the music volume.

works.title: Remnant
works.description: Visitors hold out their hands to gather matter into a star, pushing it through its lifecycle until it explodes into supernovae that leave nebulae, pulsars and black holes.
works.idea_zh: 伸手聚集物质造一颗星，直到它爆炸成超新星、留下黑洞。

video.video_title: Remnant

works.technique: Hand tracking (likely depth camera) detects open-hand gathering gestures, attracting particles to a point whose mass accumulates and triggers staged particle effects for each stellar lifecycle phase.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands 做“聚拢”手势，把投影里的粒子吸成一颗星，吸满后爆炸成星云；变体：星的颜色和寿命由参与人数决定，一个人只能做出一颗小红矮星。
works.description_zh: 参观者伸出双手，把物质聚拢成一颗恒星，推动它走完整个生命周期，直到它爆发为超新星，留下星云、脉冲星和黑洞。
works.idea_en: Reach out to gather matter into a star until it explodes into a supernova and leaves a black hole.
works.technique_zh: 手部追踪（大概率使用深度相机）检测张开双手的聚拢手势，把粒子吸引到一个点上，该点的质量不断累积，并在恒星生命周期的每个阶段触发相应的粒子特效。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Hands to detect a gathering gesture that pulls projected particles into a star, which explodes into a nebula once it is full. Twist: the number of participants decides the star's color and lifespan, so one person alone can only make a small red dwarf.

works.title: Research lab with Daniell Alnuma
works.description: An unedited improvisation from a lockdown research lab with dancer Daniell Alnuma: the dancer spins at the center of a floor projection while white lines spiral around the body, as if the rotation were drawing the vortex.
works.description_zh: 与舞者 Daniell Alnuma 在封控期间进行的一次研究工作坊，未经后期的即兴录像：舞者在地面投影的中心旋转，白色线条围绕身体螺旋展开，好像是旋转本身画出了漩涡。
works.idea_en: A spinning body becomes the center of gravity for a field of lines.
works.idea_zh: 旋转的身体成了一片线条的引力中心。
works.technique: A floor projection runs a real-time line simulation, likely eMotion, whose center of attraction follows the dancer (likely via camera tracking); the video is a single improvised take with no post-production.
works.technique_zh: 地面投影运行实时的线条模拟（很可能是 eMotion），吸引中心跟随舞者移动（很可能通过摄像头追踪）；视频是一次即兴的一镜到底，没有后期。
works.exercise_en: Project a p5.js vector field on the floor whose center follows a person tracked by a top-down webcam (blob centroid), and ask a student to improvise for two minutes using only spins and slow walks. Twist: add a second attractor for a second dancer and watch the lines negotiate between them.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面投一个 p5.js 向量场，场的中心跟随俯拍摄像头追踪到的人（取人形色块的中心），请一名学生只用旋转和慢走即兴两分钟。变体：为第二位舞者加上第二个吸引点，看线条如何在两人之间拉扯。

video.video_title: Research lab - Adrien M & Claire B with Daniell Alnuma

works.title: Retro CRT Shader
works.description: A 3D scene seen through an old CRT monitor: curved glass, scanlines, colour bleeding, static noise and rolling distortion.
works.description_zh: 透过一台老式 CRT 显示器看三维场景：弯曲的玻璃、扫描线、串色、雪花噪点和滚动的失真。
works.idea_en: Turn a clean render into a warm, flickering memory of old screens.
works.idea_zh: 把干净的渲染变成一段温暖、闪烁的老屏幕记忆。
works.technique: A Shader Graph applied to a camera RenderTexture warps UVs with a barrel distortion, multiplies scanline and RGB-mask patterns, and adds noise-driven static and vertical roll.
works.technique_zh: 一个用于相机 RenderTexture 的 Shader Graph，用桶形畸变扭曲 UV，乘上扫描线和 RGB 掩膜图案，再加入噪声驱动的雪花和垂直滚动。
works.exercise_en: Map the CRT shader onto a virtual TV placed in the room with AR, showing the live camera feed from the phone's other lens. Twist: increase the static the farther the viewer stands from the TV.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把 CRT 着色器贴到一台放在房间里的虚拟电视上，屏幕里播放手机另一颗镜头的实时画面。变体：观者离电视越远，雪花越多。

video.video_title:
Been working on a CRT monitor shader as part of a "retro" challenge. 📺✨ #madewithunity #shadergraph

You can grab the shadergraph + example setup here if interested :
