works.title: Room Scan with iPad LiDAR and AR Visualization
works.description: A prototype room scanner that builds a coloured mesh of the room with the new iPad Pro LiDAR and overlays it back onto reality.
works.idea_zh: 用 iPad LiDAR 扫描房间，并把网格叠回现实中查看。

video.video_title: Room Scan by using iPad's LiDAR and AR Visualization

works.technique: ARKit scene reconstruction produces a LiDAR mesh, vertex colors are sampled by projecting camera frames onto it, and the colored mesh is overlaid back on the room.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation ARMeshManager 实时生成房间网格，用线框材质叠回真实空间；变体：按网格法线方向给墙、地、天花板上不同颜色。
works.description_zh: 一个房间扫描原型：用新款 iPad Pro 的 LiDAR 构建房间的彩色网格，再把它叠加回现实中。
works.idea_en: Scan a room with iPad LiDAR and overlay the mesh back onto reality to view it.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 场景重建生成 LiDAR 网格，把摄像头画面投影到网格上以采样顶点颜色，再将彩色网格叠加回房间。
works.exercise_en: Generate a live room mesh with AR Foundation's ARMeshManager and overlay it on the real space with a wireframe material. Twist: color walls, floor and ceiling differently based on the mesh normal direction.

works.title: Room Shuffle
works.description: A prototype from Everyday Experiments, built by Bakken & Bæck, that scans a room, recognises the furniture and proposes new arrangements, shuffling your real chairs and tables into alternative layouts in AR.
works.description_zh: Everyday Experiments 中由 Bakken & Bæck 制作的原型：扫描房间、识别家具并提出新的布置方案，在 AR 中把你真实的桌椅“洗牌”成不同布局。
works.idea_en: See the untapped potential of the space you already have.
works.idea_zh: 看见你已有空间中尚未发掘的潜力。
works.technique: Object detection and spatial mapping estimate furniture footprints, and a layout algorithm generates responsive arrangements rendered as virtual replicas in place.
works.technique_zh: 物体识别和空间映射估算家具的占地范围，布局算法生成自适应的摆放方案，并以虚拟复制品在原地呈现。
works.exercise_en: Scan three pieces of furniture with a LiDAR phone and let a script randomly rearrange their AR copies in the room. Twist: the layout must keep a clear path to the door.
works.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的手机扫描三件家具，让脚本在房间里随机重新摆放它们的 AR 副本。变体：布局必须保留一条通往门口的通道。

video.video_title: SPACE10 – Everyday Experiments – Room Shuffle – Web – Video by Random Studio – 10

works.title: Rubens Cupid
works.description: At Brussels Airport, a cupid escapes from a Rubens painting reproduction and flies around the terminal, over travellers and luggage, before returning to the canvas and pointing to where the original hangs.
works.description_zh: 在布鲁塞尔机场，一个小天使从鲁本斯画作的复制品中飞出，在航站楼里、旅客和行李上方盘旋，最后回到画布，并指出原作收藏的地方。
works.idea_en: An artwork that leaves its frame to guide you to the real thing is a model for AR wayfinding and museum invitations.
works.idea_zh: 一件走出画框、把你引向真迹的作品，是 AR 导览和博物馆邀请的好范例。
works.technique: Projection mapping with a steerable projector and pre-rendered 3D animation of the cupid, mapped onto the painting and the surrounding airport architecture.
works.technique_zh: 用可转向投影机和预渲染的小天使 3D 动画做投影映射，映射到画作和周围的机场建筑上。
works.exercise_en: Anchor an AR character to a painting or poster on campus and have it fly off, guide the viewer down a corridor, and land at a real location such as the library. Twist: the character only continues when the viewer keeps it in view.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个 AR 角色锚定在校园里的一幅画或海报上，让它飞出来，引着观众穿过走廊，停在图书馆这样的真实地点；变体：只有观众一直把它保持在画面中，角色才会继续前进。

video.video_title: Rubens Cupid

salient.why_en: A cupid escapes a Rubens painting, flies over travellers, and points to where the original hangs.
salient.why_zh: 丘比特从 Rubens 的画里飞出来，掠过旅客头顶，再指向原作所在的地方。

works.title: S . P . A . C . E .
works.description: Made under social distancing, dancers are filmed by special camera rigs whose images are decomposed and rebuilt into geometric worlds that the body alone could not form.
works.idea_zh: 把舞者的身体信息拆解重组，生成身体本身做不到的几何世界
works.technique: Multi-camera capture and GPU image processing decompose each dancer's body data by rule sets and recompose it into real-time geometric visuals.
works.exercise_zh: 用MediaPipe Pose取得关节点，把关节点按规则复制、镜像、旋转成万花筒几何；变化：几位同学远程视频连线，各自的骨架拼成同一个图形。

video.video_title: ELEVENPLAY x Rhizomatiks "S . P . A . C . E ." (2020)

works.description_zh: 在保持社交距离的条件下创作：特殊的摄像装置拍摄舞者，影像被拆解并重建为身体本身无法构成的几何世界。
works.idea_en: Break down and reassemble dancers' body data to create geometric worlds the body itself cannot form.
works.technique_zh: 多机位拍摄和 GPU 图像处理按照规则集拆解每位舞者的身体数据，并将其实时重组为几何视觉效果。
works.exercise_en: Get joint points with MediaPipe Pose and copy, mirror and rotate them by rule into kaleidoscope geometry. Twist: several classmates join a remote video call and their skeletons combine into a single figure.

works.title: STRINGS
works.description: During lockdown a dancer performs live from her living room wearing electronic devices that react to the collective actions of an online audience, so remote viewers can literally hold and move her.
works.description_zh: 封城期间，舞者在自家客厅直播演出，身上的电子设备对线上观众的集体操作作出反应，远方的观众仿佛真的能“牵动”她。
works.idea_en: Dance together at a distance by letting an online crowd pull the dancer's strings.
works.idea_zh: 让线上观众拉动舞者的“线”，隔空一起跳舞。
works.technique: Audience input from a web interface is aggregated on a server and sent to networked haptic wearables on the dancer, who improvises in response on the live stream.
works.technique_zh: 网页界面收集观众输入，在服务器上汇总后发送到舞者身上的联网触觉可穿戴设备，舞者在直播中即兴回应。
works.exercise_en: Stream a performer on a video call while viewers vote with emoji on a shared web page; the majority vote vibrates a phone taped to the performer's arm or leg. Twist: require at least three people to agree before anything happens.
works.exercise_zh: 在视频通话里直播表演者，观众在共享网页上用表情投票，多数票会让绑在表演者手臂或腿上的手机振动；变体：至少三人同意才会触发。

video.video_title: STRINGS - Live-streamed & interactive performance [TRAILER]

works.title: Sinclair Snake
works.description: A Wonderscope story centred on a snake character, told in AR scenes around the child's home and advanced by speaking aloud.
works.idea_zh: 和一条AR小蛇对话，用声音推动故事。

video.video_title: New on Wonderscope: Sinclair Snake

works.technique: An animated character rig is anchored in the room, and scene transitions are triggered by the child's spoken responses via speech recognition.
works.exercise_zh: 让一个 AR 角色向你提问，根据你的语音回答分出两条不同的剧情分支；变体：角色会记住你上次的回答。
works.description_zh: 一个以蛇为主角的 Wonderscope 故事，在孩子家中的各处 AR 场景里展开，并通过孩子大声说话来推进剧情。
works.idea_en: Talk with a little AR snake and move the story forward with your voice.
works.technique_zh: 带骨骼绑定的动画角色锚定在房间中，场景切换由孩子的口头回答通过语音识别触发。
works.exercise_en: Have an AR character ask you a question and branch into two different storylines based on your spoken answer. Twist: the character remembers what you answered last time.

works.title: Skatrix
works.description: Players scan a real curb, ledge, stair or table with their phone, and a small virtual skater grinds, flips and jumps across it under finger control; replays can be filmed from any angle.
works.description_zh: 玩家用手机扫描真实的路沿、台阶、楼梯或桌子，一个小小的虚拟滑手在手指操控下在上面滑杆、翻板、跳跃；还能从任意角度录制回放。
works.idea_en: Anything in the world can become a skate spot once the phone understands its edges.
works.idea_zh: 只要手机理解了物体的边缘，世界上任何东西都能变成滑板场地。
works.technique: Scene meshing and plane detection (later Niantic Lightship) convert real surfaces into colliders and grind rails for a physics-driven skater avatar.
works.technique_zh: 用场景网格化和平面检测（后来采用 Niantic Lightship）把真实表面转成碰撞体和可滑的杆，供物理驱动的滑手化身使用。
works.exercise_en: Build a small character that detects edges of real surfaces from the AR mesh and slides along them when it reaches one. Twist: record the run and replay it from a camera that orbits the real object.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个小角色，能从 AR 网格中识别真实表面的边缘，到达边缘时就沿着它滑行。变体：把这段滑行录下来，用一个绕着真实物体旋转的镜头回放。

video.video_title: Skatrix - AWE - teaser

works.title: SlitScanCam: realtime slit-scan camera
works.description: A live camera image is rebuilt from slices taken at different moments, so moving people stretch and bend into elastic shapes.
works.description_zh: 实时相机画面由不同时刻的切片拼成，移动的人被拉长、弯折成有弹性的形状。
works.idea_en: Show time along one axis of the image.
works.idea_zh: 让画面的一个方向显示时间。
works.technique: Recent camera frames are stored in a texture array ring buffer, and each row of the output image samples a different frame by its vertical position.
works.technique_zh: 把最近的相机帧存进纹理数组环形缓冲区，输出画面的每一行根据纵向位置读取不同的帧。
works.exercise_en: Build a slit-scan filter on the AR Foundation camera feed and walk slowly past a friend. Twist: tie the time delay to depth, so nearer things lag more.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 相机画面上做一个狭缝扫描滤镜，然后慢慢从朋友身边走过。变体：延迟随深度变化，越近的东西越滞后。

video.video_title: Realtime Slit-Scan Camera with Unity

salient.why_en: Each slice of the live image comes from a different moment, so moving people stretch through time.
salient.why_zh: 实时画面的每一条切片来自不同时刻，走动的人被时间拉长、扭曲。

works.title: Social Distancing Shirt
works.description: A shirt with sensors on four sides detects when someone comes closer than two metres and plays a spoken warning, 'You are too close', until they step back.
works.description_zh: 一件四面装有传感器的衬衫，当有人靠近到两米以内时，它会播放语音警告“你太近了”，直到对方退开。
works.idea_en: Clothing that defends your personal space out loud.
works.idea_zh: 会大声捍卫你个人空间的衣服。
works.technique: Four ultrasonic distance sensors (front, back and sides) are read by a microcontroller that plays prerecorded tracks through two speakers when the 2 m threshold is crossed.
works.technique_zh: 微控制器读取前后左右四个超声波测距传感器，一旦越过两米阈值，就通过两个扬声器播放预录音频。
works.exercise_en: Tape an ultrasonic sensor and a buzzer to a jacket with an Arduino and set a personal-space radius that beeps faster as people approach. Twist: make it greet friends differently from strangers using a phone NFC tag.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Arduino 把超声波传感器和蜂鸣器固定在外套上，设定个人空间半径，人越近蜂鸣越快；变体：用手机 NFC 标签区分朋友和陌生人，给出不同的问候。

video.video_title: Social Distancing Shirt by Clemence Debaig

salient.why_en: A shirt that says 'You are too close' until the person near you steps back.
salient.why_zh: 一件会开口说“你靠得太近了”的衬衫，直到对方退后才停下。

works.title: Sounds in Space
works.description: An open-source toolkit for curating location-based audio in a room: sounds are placed in space and the phone plays a soundtrack that changes as the visitor walks.
works.idea_zh: 把声音放进空间里，随着你走动而变化的AR声景。

video.video_title: AR Experiment: Sounds in Space

works.technique: ARCore anchors store audio sources at positions in a room, and playback volume and panning follow the phone's tracked position.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在房间里放置几个带 3D 音效的隐形声音源，走动时听到不同的音乐层；变体：让观众自己录一段声音并放进空间里。
works.description_zh: 一个开源工具包，用于在房间中策划基于位置的音频：把声音放置在空间中，手机播放的配乐会随参观者的走动而变化。
works.idea_en: Place sounds in space to make an AR soundscape that changes as you walk.
works.technique_zh: ARCore 锚点把音源存储在房间中的特定位置，播放音量和声像随手机被追踪的位置而变化。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation to place several invisible sound sources with 3D audio in a room so you hear different music layers as you walk around. Twist: let visitors record their own sounds and place them in the space.

works.title: Sparkle Reflection Effect
works.description: Tiny star-shaped glints pop up only on the brightest highlights of the image, like light catching on glitter or wet surfaces.
works.description_zh: 只在画面最亮的高光处冒出小小的星形闪光，就像光落在亮片或湿润表面上。
works.idea_en: Let the image itself decide where the sparkles go.
works.idea_zh: 让画面自己决定闪光出现在哪里。
works.technique: A compute shader scans the frame for pixels above a brightness threshold, appends them to a buffer, and draws star sprites there with an indirect draw call, so no data returns to the CPU.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器扫描画面里亮度超过阈值的像素，把它们追加到缓冲区，再用间接绘制在这些位置画星形精灵，数据不必回到 CPU。
works.exercise_en: Run the sparkle pass on the AR camera image so real highlights (windows, jewellery, water) twinkle on the phone. Twist: tint each sparkle with the colour sampled from the pixel underneath.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 摄像头画面上运行闪光效果，让真实的高光（窗户、首饰、水面）在手机里闪烁。变体：用下方像素的颜色给每个闪光着色。

video.video_title: [Unity] Sparkle reflection effect with compute

works.title: Spatial Copy and Paste Shared with ARCore
works.description: Selects a region of the real room on HoloLens 2, 'copies' it as a mesh, and pastes the captured space into another user's ARCore view.
works.idea_zh: 在 HoloLens 上“复制”一块真实空间，再“粘贴”到别人的手机 AR 里。

video.video_title: HoloLens Demo:Spatial Copy and Paste and Sharing with ARCore

works.technique: A bounding box selects part of the HoloLens 2 spatial mesh, the cropped mesh with colors is sent over the network, and the ARCore client places it at a chosen anchor.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Polycam 扫描桌面一角导出模型，在另一台手机的 AR 中把它“粘贴”到另一张桌子上；变体：粘贴时把尺寸缩小十倍，做成微缩景观。
works.description_zh: 在 HoloLens 2 上框选真实房间中的一块区域，把它作为网格“复制”下来，再把捕捉到的空间“粘贴”到另一位用户的 ARCore 视图中。
works.idea_en: Copy a piece of real space on HoloLens and paste it into someone else's phone AR.
works.technique_zh: 用包围盒选取 HoloLens 2 空间网格的一部分，把裁剪后的带颜色网格通过网络发送出去，ARCore 客户端再把它放置在选定的锚点处。
works.exercise_en: Scan a corner of a desk with Polycam, export the model, and paste it onto another table in a second phone's AR. Twist: shrink it tenfold when pasting to make a miniature landscape.

works.title: Spatial Instruments
works.description: Moving a phone around the living room turns every object it sees into part of an ever-changing soundscape: shelves, lamps and sofas each play notes based on their shape, depth, colour and position.
works.description_zh: 拿着手机在客厅里移动，它看到的每件物品都会成为不断变化的声景的一部分：书架、台灯和沙发根据各自的形状、深度、颜色和位置发出不同的音符。
works.idea_en: Perceive your room through sound instead of sight, so rearranging furniture becomes composing.
works.idea_zh: 用声音而不是视觉感知房间，于是重新摆放家具就变成了作曲。
works.technique: LiDAR depth and object detection segment the room into objects, and each object's size, distance and colour are mapped to pitch, timbre and rhythm in a generative audio engine.
works.technique_zh: LiDAR 深度和物体识别把房间分割成一个个物体，再把每个物体的尺寸、距离和颜色映射成生成式音频引擎中的音高、音色和节奏。
works.exercise_en: Map the heights of detected AR planes in a room to notes and play them as the phone sweeps past. Twist: moving one chair must change the melody.
works.exercise_zh: 把房间里检测到的 AR 平面高度映射成音符，手机扫过时依次演奏。变体：移动一把椅子必须改变旋律。

video.video_title: Spatial Instrument for Everyday Experiments

works.title: Squarepusher 'Terminal Slam' music video
works.description: Through mixed-reality glasses, Shibuya's billboards and ads are erased and replaced by glitching visuals synced to the music (diminished reality).
works.idea_zh: 戴上MR眼镜，涩谷的广告被抹去并替换成音乐视觉

video.video_title: Squarepusher - Terminal Slam (Official Video)

works.technique: Diminished reality: the camera feed is analysed to detect billboard regions, which are masked, inpainted and replaced with music-synced visuals, then re-rendered into the headset view.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机相机识别并遮住画面里的文字或 logo（颜色分割或图像追踪），用节奏驱动的故障图形填充；变体：把被遮掉的广告换成空白或天空，体验“没有广告的城市”。
works.description_zh: 透过混合现实眼镜，涩谷的广告牌和广告被抹去，替换成与音乐同步的故障风视觉（减弱现实）。
works.idea_en: Put on MR glasses and Shibuya's ads are erased and replaced with music visuals.
works.technique_zh: 减弱现实：分析摄像头画面以检测广告牌区域，对其进行遮罩和图像修补，再替换为与音乐同步的视觉内容，然后重新渲染到头显视野中。
works.exercise_en: Use the phone camera to detect and cover text or logos in the frame (with color segmentation or image tracking), and fill them with rhythm-driven glitch graphics. Twist: replace the covered ads with blank space or sky to experience a city without ads.

salient.why_en: Through the glasses, Shibuya's billboards are erased and replaced by music visuals, AR that subtracts instead of adds.
salient.why_zh: 透过眼镜，涩谷的广告牌被抹去、换成音乐影像，这是做减法而不是做加法的 AR。

works.title: Super You (AR app)
works.description: An iPhone AR app that tracks your body and transforms you into a flowing digital being in real time.
works.idea_zh: 手机一扫，把自己变成流动的数字生命体

video.video_title: Super You  - AR app for iPhone 11 and above

works.technique: ARKit body tracking (or person segmentation) provides a skeleton and silhouette each frame, which drive particle or ribbon systems that replace the user's body in the camera view.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 ARKit 人体追踪，把全身替换成跟随关节流动的粒子或丝带；变体：给身体每个部位分配不同的“材料”（烟、水、文字），做一个表达自己性格的数字身体。
works.description_zh: 一款 iPhone AR 应用，追踪你的身体，把你实时变成一个流动的数字生命体。
works.idea_en: Point your phone at yourself and become a flowing digital being.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 身体追踪（或人体分割）每帧提供骨架和轮廓，驱动粒子或丝带系统，在摄像头画面中取代用户的身体。
works.exercise_en: Use Lens Studio or ARKit body tracking to replace your whole body with particles or ribbons that flow with your joints. Twist: assign each body part a different material, such as smoke, water or text, to make a digital body that expresses your personality.

salient.why_en: Point the phone at yourself and your body becomes a giant flowing digital being; the whole work is that one transformation.
salient.why_zh: 用手机对准自己，身体就变成一个巨大、流动的数字生命，整件作品就只做这一次变身。

works.title: Sword fighting effects with VFX Graph
works.description: Swinging blades leave bright arcs of light and sparks, like a fighting game.
works.description_zh: 挥动的刀刃留下明亮的光弧和火花，像格斗游戏一样。
works.idea_en: A trail turns a fast motion into a readable shape.
works.idea_zh: 拖尾把快速动作变成看得清的形状。
works.technique: VFX Graph particle strips follow a transform on the blade tip and hilt, fading out along their length, with spark bursts triggered on direction changes.
works.technique_zh: VFX Graph 粒子条带跟随刀尖和刀柄的位置，沿长度方向淡出，方向变化时触发火花爆发。
works.exercise_en: Attach a light trail to your phone in AR Foundation so swinging it draws arcs in the room. Twist: two players duel and the trails collide.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中把光带挂在手机上，挥动手机就在房间里画出光弧。变体：两名玩家对战，光带相撞会爆出火花。

video.video_title: Making sword fighting effects https://t.co/KombXWh0cy https://t.co/X7NdoMtvlg

works.title: The Cost of Your Words
works.description: A public sculpture outside the Royal Society of Sculptors advertises itself through Google Ads and displays, on its LED surface, the live price that words cost to reach people online.
works.description_zh: 英国皇家雕塑家协会门外的一件公共雕塑，它自己在 Google Ads 上投放广告，并在 LED 表面显示词语在网上触达人所花费的实时价格。
works.idea_en: Show passers-by what their words are worth to an algorithm.
works.idea_zh: 让路人看到他们的词语对算法值多少钱。
works.technique: The sculpture's ad account data (keywords and cost per click) is fetched from Google Ads and shown on an integrated LED display.
works.technique_zh: 从 Google Ads 获取雕塑广告账户的数据（关键词和单次点击价格），显示在集成的 LED 屏上。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone AR label or a paper sign that shows the live search-trend score of a word written on a classroom object. Twist: let visitors pick the word and see its value change.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 标签或纸质标牌，显示贴在教室物品上的词语的实时搜索热度；变体：让观众自选词语，看它的“价值”变化。

video.video_title: The Cost of Your Words

works.title: The Eternal Wave
works.description: Visitors in a headset start in a replica of the Hongxia Theatre kitchen from her film Nova and step through portals that jump across time and space, into early Chinese computer factories and the theatre's surroundings; an AR version later brought the kitchen to phones.
works.description_zh: 观众戴上头显，从她电影《新星》（Nova）中红霞剧院厨房的复制场景出发，穿过一道道传送门，在时空中跳跃，进入中国早期电子工厂和剧院周边；之后又推出了可在手机上体验的 AR 厨房版本。
works.idea_en: A real stage set becomes the doorway into a VR time-travel story.
works.idea_zh: 一个真实的舞台布景成为进入 VR 时空旅行故事的入口。
works.technique: Room-scale VR that matches a physical set, with portal transitions between scanned and modelled scenes; the AR follow-up lets users tap furniture to trigger changes.
works.technique_zh: 与实体布景对齐的房间级 VR，在扫描和建模场景之间用传送门转场；后续的 AR 版本让用户点击家具来触发变化。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR or AR Foundation scene where a real doorway in the classroom opens into a different era. Twist: an everyday object in the room must be the key that opens the portal.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 AR Foundation 做一个场景，让教室里一扇真实的门通向另一个年代；变体：必须用房间里某件日常物品作为打开传送门的钥匙。

video.video_title: VIVE Arts |Trailer - Cao Fei "The Eternal Wave"

works.title: The Four Temperaments AR
works.description: Four floating crystal balls each hold Cate Blanchett playing one of Galen's temperaments; each looks at the viewer and says 'I love you', and the meaning shifts from tender to threatening as you walk between them.
works.description_zh: 四个漂浮的水晶球里，Cate Blanchett 分别扮演盖伦提出的四种气质；每个角色都注视观众说“我爱你”，当你在它们之间走动时，这句话的意味从温柔变为威胁。
works.idea_en: The same line spoken by four versions of one actor changes meaning as you move among them.
works.idea_zh: 同一位演员的四个版本说出同一句台词，随着你在其间走动，意味不断变化。
works.technique: Video of the actor mapped inside transparent spheres placed in phone AR, each billboarded to face the viewer, with spatial audio for each sphere.
works.technique_zh: 把演员影像映射到手机 AR 中放置的透明球体里，每个球体始终朝向观众，并配有各自的空间音频。
works.exercise_en: Film a classmate saying one sentence in four different moods and place the four clips in AR as floating video spheres around the room. Twist: only the sphere you are closest to is audible.
works.exercise_zh: 拍一位同学用四种不同情绪说同一句话，把四段视频做成漂浮的 AR 视频球放在房间四周；变体：只有离你最近的那个球能被听见。

video.video_title: Watch Cate Blanchett from every haunting angle in this new AR project

works.title: The Great Story of the Infinite Drawing
works.description: A monumental black-and-white fresco of Elly Oldman's endless drawing covers a wall and a floor puzzle; visitors point tablets at it and the characters of her ecological fable start moving.
works.description_zh: Elly Oldman 的“无尽之画”被做成铺满墙面的巨型黑白壁画和地面拼图；观众把平板对准画面，她那则生态寓言里的角色便动了起来。
works.idea_en: A giant hand-drawn wall where every corner hides an animated scene.
works.idea_zh: 一面巨大的手绘墙，每个角落都藏着一段动画。
works.technique: Sections of the printed drawing serve as image targets for a tablet AR app (AR by Artefacto) that overlays frame-by-frame animations by &Friends in the same line style.
works.technique_zh: 印刷画面的各个局部作为平板 AR 应用（由 Artefacto 开发）的识别图，叠加 &Friends 用相同线条风格制作的逐帧动画。
works.exercise_en: Draw one long collaborative black-and-white strip on paper, then pick five details and make each one move in AR with Artivive or Lens Studio image markers. Twist: hide one animation that only appears when two tablets look at it together.
works.exercise_zh: 在长卷纸上合作画一幅黑白长画，挑出五个细节，用 Artivive 或 Lens Studio 的图像识别让它们在 AR 中动起来；变体：藏一段只有两台平板同时对准才会出现的动画。

video.video_title: La Grande Histoire du Dessin Sans Fin, Elly Oldman

works.title: The Languages Around Us
works.description: Animated words in more than 40 languages appear as AR typographic installations in real London spaces, morphing from one writing system into another.
works.description_zh: 40 多种语言的动态文字以 AR 字体装置的形式出现在伦敦的真实空间里，从一种文字系统变形为另一种。
works.idea_en: Make the many languages spoken around you visible in the places you share.
works.idea_zh: 让身边人们使用的多种语言，在共同生活的地方被看见。
works.technique: Words with similar stroke counts in Google Noto fonts are paired, stroke-animated and morphed on a timeline, then anchored in place as AR scenes.
works.technique_zh: 把 Google Noto 字体中笔画数相近的词配对，逐笔动画并在时间线上相互变形，再作为 AR 场景锚定在现场。
works.exercise_en: Collect the word 'hello' in the first languages of your classmates and animate a morph between two scripts, then place it in AR where that classmate usually sits. Twist: the word only appears when someone standing there speaks.
works.exercise_zh: 收集同学们母语里的“你好”，做一段两种文字之间的变形动画，再用 AR 放在那位同学常坐的位置；变体：只有有人站在那里说话时，这个词才会出现。

video.video_title: Overview – The Languages Around Us

works.title: TransceiVR
works.description: A person outside VR taps and draws on a tablet view of the virtual scene, and their annotations appear in the headset user's world, while they can also rewind or look around independently.
works.description_zh: VR 外的人在平板上的虚拟场景视图里点击和绘制，标注就出现在头显用户的世界中；外部用户还能独立回放或环顾场景。
works.idea_en: Give the people watching a headset user a real voice inside the virtual world.
works.idea_zh: 让旁观头显用户的人在虚拟世界里拥有真正的话语权。
works.technique: Hooks into VR platform APIs to capture scene views and poses for third-party apps without source code, streaming them to a tablet and projecting tablet annotations back into VR.
works.technique_zh: 借助 VR 平台接口，在无需源代码的情况下为第三方应用捕获场景画面与位姿，传到平板上，再把平板上的标注投射回 VR。
works.exercise_en: Pair a student wearing a phone VR viewer with a partner holding a second phone that mirrors the scene; the partner guides by drawing on their screen while the viewer finds objects. Twist: forbid speaking so all help must be drawn.
works.exercise_zh: 让一名戴手机 VR 眼镜的学生与拿着另一部镜像画面手机的同伴配对，同伴通过在屏幕上绘制来引导对方找东西；变体：禁止说话，所有帮助都只能画出来。

video.video_title: TransceiVR: Bridging Asymmetrical Communication Between VR Users and External Collaborators

works.title: URP-PSX
works.description: A modern Unity scene rendered to look like a PlayStation 1 game: wobbling vertices, pixelated textures, reduced colours and fog.
works.description_zh: 一个现代 Unity 场景被渲染成 PlayStation 1 游戏的样子：顶点抖动、纹理像素化、颜色减少、带雾。
works.idea_en: Deliberately degrade rendering to evoke a specific era of graphics.
works.idea_zh: 刻意降低渲染质量，唤起某个时代的图像记忆。
works.technique: Shader Graph materials snap vertex positions to a low-resolution grid in clip space and use affine texture mapping, while URP post effects add colour-depth reduction, dithering and pixelation.
works.technique_zh: Shader Graph 材质在裁剪空间里把顶点吸附到低分辨率网格，并使用仿射纹理映射；URP 后期效果再加上色深降低、抖动和像素化。
works.exercise_en: Render AR objects with the PSX look and apply the same pixelation to the camera feed, so the whole real room looks like a 1996 game level. Twist: let the resolution drop further the farther objects are from the phone.
works.exercise_zh: 用 PSX 风格渲染 AR 物体，并对相机画面做同样的像素化，让整个真实房间看起来像 1996 年的游戏关卡。变体：离手机越远，分辨率降得越低。

video.video_title:
I am releasing the first URP/Shadergraph PSX graphics plugin open-source for retro indie devs out there. 

It features:
- Vertex Snapping
- Color precision 
- Texture Pixelation 
- Retro Post effects

works.title: Unity MARS
works.description: An authoring tool for AR apps where content is placed by conditions (on a table at least 1 m wide, next to a face, on the floor near a wall) and tested in simulated rooms before being deployed to real ones.
works.description_zh: 一款 AR 应用创作工具：内容按条件放置（在宽度至少 1 米的桌子上、脸旁边、靠墙的地面上），部署到真实房间之前可以先在模拟房间中测试。
works.idea_en: Author AR against rules about reality rather than a single known room.
works.idea_zh: 针对“关于现实的规则”来创作 AR，而不是针对某一个已知的房间。
works.technique: Proxies with semantic and size conditions are matched at runtime against planes, images and faces reported by AR Foundation, and a simulation view replays recorded environments in the editor.
works.technique_zh: 带有语义和尺寸条件的代理物在运行时与 AR Foundation 报告的平面、图像和人脸进行匹配，模拟视图则在编辑器里回放录制的环境。
works.exercise_en: Write an AR scene whose three objects are placed only by rules (largest table, nearest wall, floor near a door) and test it in two rooms. Twist: add a fallback when no rule is satisfied.
works.exercise_zh: 写一个 AR 场景，其中三个物体只按规则放置（最大的桌子、最近的墙、门边的地面），并在两个房间里测试。变体：当所有规则都不满足时加一个后备方案。

video.video_title: Introducing Unity MARS

works.title: Unity URP Toon Lit Shader Example
works.description: An anime character is lit with clean cel shading, rim outlines and a special face-lighting option that keeps facial shadows tidy as the light moves.
works.description_zh: 一个动漫角色以干净的赛璐璐风格着色，带有轮廓描边和专门的面部光照选项，光源移动时脸上的阴影依然整洁。
works.idea_en: Stylised lighting is a few deliberate rules on top of real lights, not a filter.
works.idea_zh: 风格化光照是在真实光源之上加几条刻意的规则，而不是一个滤镜。
works.technique: A hand-written URP shader quantises the Lambert term into a ramp, adds rim light and an inverted-hull outline pass, and for the face option replaces normal-based shading with a lighting rule that keeps shadows smooth.
works.technique_zh: 一个手写的 URP 着色器把 Lambert 光照量化成色阶，加上边缘光和反向外壳描边通道；面部选项则用专门的光照规则代替基于法线的着色，让阴影保持平滑。
works.exercise_en: Apply a toon lit shader to a character in AR and use AR Foundation light estimation as its main light direction. Twist: the outline thickens when the real room gets darker.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中给角色使用卡通光照着色器，并把 AR Foundation 的光照估计作为主光方向。变体：真实房间变暗时，描边随之变粗。

video.video_title: [Unity Toon Lit Shader for URP (WIP)] +Anime Face Lighting option

works.title: Unity-chan and Occlusion
works.description: A dancing Unity-chan character is correctly hidden by real people and furniture using ARKit depth occlusion.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟角色会被真实的人和家具正确遮挡。

video.video_title: Unity-chan and Occulusion

works.technique: ARKit people occlusion and LiDAR environment depth are used in AR Foundation's AROcclusionManager, so the depth test hides the character behind real people and furniture.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中开启 AROcclusionManager，让一个跳舞角色在人和椅子后面被正确遮挡；变体：角色被挡住时会探头出来“偷看”。
works.description_zh: 借助 ARKit 深度遮挡，跳舞的 Unity-chan 角色能被真实的人和家具正确遮挡。
works.idea_en: A virtual character is correctly hidden behind real people and furniture.
works.technique_zh: 在 AR Foundation 的 AROcclusionManager 中使用 ARKit 人体遮挡和 LiDAR 环境深度，通过深度测试把角色隐藏在真实的人和家具后面。
works.exercise_en: Turn on AROcclusionManager in AR Foundation so a dancing character is correctly hidden behind people and chairs. Twist: when the character is blocked, it pokes its head out to peek.

works.title: Unreal City
works.description: An AR public art walk along London's Thames with 36 works by artists such as Olafur Eliasson, Cao Fei and Tomás Saraceno, curated with Dazed.
works.idea_zh: 泰晤士河畔的AR雕塑步道

video.video_title: The Curator’s Tour | Unreal City

works.technique: GPS/geolocated anchors (refined with local plane detection) place a sequence of sculptures along a walking route, with the app acting as a map-guided exhibition.
works.exercise_zh: 全班每人做一件 AR 作品，沿校园一条步道按 GPS 位置布展，用 WebAR 链接串起来；变体：给展览设计一个只有走完全程才能看到的“终点作品”。
works.description_zh: 沿伦敦泰晤士河展开的 AR 公共艺术步道，汇集了 Olafur Eliasson、曹斐、Tomás Saraceno 等艺术家的 36 件作品，与 Dazed 联合策划。
works.idea_en: A trail of AR sculptures along the Thames.
works.technique_zh: 基于 GPS 地理定位的锚点（再辅以局部平面检测进行精调）沿步行路线放置一系列雕塑，应用本身则充当由地图引导的展览。
works.exercise_en: Have each student in the class make one AR work, install them by GPS position along a campus walkway, and link them together with WebAR. Twist: design a final work for the exhibition that can be seen only after walking the whole route.

works.title: VertexAnimationJob: multithreaded vertex animation
works.description: Dense meshes twist, wave and break apart in real time while all CPU cores work on the vertex animation.
works.description_zh: 高密度网格实时扭曲、起伏、碎裂，所有 CPU 核心一起计算顶点动画。
works.idea_en: Push every vertex every frame, and a static model comes alive.
works.idea_zh: 每帧推动每个顶点，静态模型就活了。
works.technique: IJobParallelFor jobs compiled with Burst compute vertex positions in parallel and write them straight into mesh buffers using the Mesh API from Unity 2019.3.
works.technique_zh: 用 Burst 编译的 IJobParallelFor 任务并行计算顶点位置，再通过 Unity 2019.3 的 Mesh API 直接写入网格缓冲区。
works.exercise_en: Write a job that makes a scanned object ripple and place it in AR Foundation next to the real object. Twist: the ripple spreads from the point you tap.
works.exercise_zh: 写一个让扫描物体泛起波纹的任务，用 AR Foundation 放在真实物体旁边。变体：波纹从你点击的位置扩散开。

video.video_title: Another example of vertex animation using C# Job System and the new Mesh API. This time I managed to put full load on the CPU cores. https://t.co/r0uCwVTqfx https://t.co/kUrjslmVi4

works.title: VfxCrystal: growing crystals
works.description: Sharp crystal shards grow, spin and scatter in a small looping animation made entirely with particles.
works.description_zh: 尖锐的水晶碎片生长、旋转、散开，是一段完全由粒子做成的小循环动画。
works.idea_en: Mesh particles can build solid-looking forms.
works.idea_zh: 网格粒子也能拼出看似实心的形体。
works.technique: VFX Graph outputs lit mesh particles with random orientation and scale over life, arranged around a center to read as a crystal cluster.
works.technique_zh: VFX Graph 输出带光照的网格粒子，随生命周期随机改变朝向和大小，围绕中心排列成晶簇。
works.exercise_en: Grow a crystal cluster on a real surface detected by AR Foundation, spawning shards where you tap. Twist: crystals grow faster where the room is louder.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 检测到的真实表面上长出晶簇，点哪里就在哪里长出碎片。变体：房间越吵，水晶长得越快。

video.video_title: https://t.co/2p1Li86lsD https://t.co/QJEB7x5Oj8

works.title: Video-Annotated AR Assembly Tutorials
works.description: A normal 2D how-to video of assembling a toy is analysed automatically and turned into a 3D AR tutorial on the real object, with the original video clips pinned to each step.
works.description_zh: 一段组装玩具的普通二维教学视频被自动分析，变成叠加在真实物体上的三维 AR 教程，每一步还附上原视频片段。
works.idea_en: Convert any existing assembly video into step-by-step AR, keeping the video as backup.
works.idea_zh: 把任何现成的装配视频变成分步 AR 教程，同时保留视频作为参考。
works.technique: Tracks parts in the input video using a CAD model and an assembly graph of blocking relationships, then renders the detected steps in AR with the matching video snippets attached.
works.technique_zh: 借助 CAD 模型和记录部件遮挡关系的装配图在输入视频中追踪部件，再把识别出的步骤在 AR 中渲染出来，并附上对应的视频片段。
works.exercise_en: Pick a five-step LEGO model, film it, and build a phone AR guide that shows a 3D arrow and the matching video clip over each step on the real bricks. Twist: let the guide skip steps that the camera sees are already done.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个五步完成的乐高模型并拍下来，做一个手机 AR 指南，在真实积木上为每一步显示三维箭头和对应的视频片段；变体：当相机看到某步已完成时自动跳过。

video.video_title: Video-Annotated Augmented Reality Assembly Tutorials

works.title: Virtual Flowers Using ARKit
works.description: Generative flowers sprout and bloom across the scanned surfaces of a room.
works.idea_zh: 生成式花朵沿着房间表面生长绽放。

video.video_title: Virtual Flowers using ARKit3

works.technique: Points are sampled on the scanned mesh surface with their normals, and procedural flower instances grow along those normals with animated scale.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 网格或平面上随机采样点，沿法线生成逐渐长大的花；变体：花只长在手机镜头对准超过三秒的地方。
works.description_zh: 生成式花朵在房间的扫描表面上萌芽、绽放。
works.idea_en: Generative flowers grow and bloom along the room's surfaces.
works.technique_zh: 在扫描得到的网格表面上采样点及其法线，程序化的花朵实例沿法线方向生长，并带有尺寸变化的动画。
works.exercise_en: Randomly sample points on an AR mesh or plane and grow flowers along the normals that get bigger over time. Twist: flowers grow only where the phone camera has been aimed for more than three seconds.

works.title: Water's Soul
works.description: A 24-metre white head of a girl with a finger to her lips stands on a pier in Newport, Jersey City, facing Manhattan across the Hudson River, as a reminder to protect water.
works.description_zh: 一个 24 米高、手指抵唇的少女白色头像立在泽西城纽波特的码头上，隔着哈德逊河望向曼哈顿，提醒人们保护水资源。
works.idea_en: A 'hush' gesture aimed at a whole skyline speaks to a city at once, a model for AR figures that address a distant view.
works.idea_zh: 一个对着整条天际线的“嘘”的手势同时对整座城市说话，是向远景发声的 AR 形象的范本。
works.technique: A scanned figure is elongated and built in fibreglass and resin on a steel structure on the waterfront.
works.technique_zh: 扫描的人像被拉长，用玻璃钢和树脂在水岸边的钢结构上制作。
works.exercise_en: Place a giant AR figure on a riverbank or lake edge that makes a gesture toward the opposite shore, and add a soundscape that goes quiet when you face it. Twist: the figure's gesture changes with the live water level of the river.
works.exercise_zh: 在河岸或湖边放置一个面向对岸做手势的巨大 AR 人像，并加入一段当你面对它时就安静下来的声景；变体：人像的手势随河流实时水位而变化。

video.video_title: Water's Soul, 2020 | Jaume Plensa | Newport Jersey City

works.title: Wearable Subtitles
works.description: Lightweight eyewear shows live captions of the conversation in front of the wearer, letting deaf and hard-of-hearing people keep their eyes on the speaker instead of a phone.
works.description_zh: 轻便的眼镜在佩戴者眼前实时显示对话字幕，让聋人和听障人士可以看着说话人，而不必低头看手机。
works.idea_en: Captions belong in the line of sight, not in your hand.
works.idea_zh: 字幕应该在视线里，而不是在手里。
works.technique: A low-power head-worn display is paired with a phone running speech recognition, with a hybrid design that keeps glasses light and battery life near all-day.
works.technique_zh: 低功耗头戴显示器与运行语音识别的手机配合，这种混合设计让眼镜保持轻便，续航接近一整天。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone-in-headset (cardboard or HoloKit) captioning view that shows live speech-to-text above the speaker's head. Twist: shrink text when the speaker is far away.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸盒或 HoloKit 头显加手机，做一个把实时语音转文字显示在说话人头顶的字幕视图。变体：说话人离得远时字体变小。

video.video_title: Wearable Subtitles: Augmenting Spoken Communication with Lightweight Eyewear for All-day Captioning

works.title: WebXR Hand Trails
works.description: In a WebXR session with hand tracking, every fingertip drags its own glowing ribbon through space, so waving your hands leaves a bundle of flowing trails around you.
works.description_zh: 在支持手部追踪的 WebXR 会话中，每个指尖都拖着一条发光的丝带在空中移动，挥动双手就会在身边留下一束流动的轨迹。
works.idea_en: Every fingertip paints a ribbon in the air.
works.idea_zh: 每个指尖都在空中画出一条丝带。
works.technique: The WebXR Hand Input API provides joint poses each frame; three.js extrudes camera-facing ribbon geometry along the recent positions of each fingertip.
works.technique_zh: WebXR 手部输入 API 每帧提供关节姿态，three.js 沿每个指尖最近的位置挤出面向相机的丝带几何体。
works.exercise_en: Record fingertip positions with WebXR hands (Quest browser) or MediaPipe on a webcam and draw fading ribbons from them in three.js. Twist: ribbons play a note whenever two of them cross.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 手部追踪（Quest 浏览器）或摄像头加 MediaPipe 记录指尖位置，在 three.js 中画出会淡出的丝带。变体：两条丝带交叉时发出一个音。

video.video_title:
last version for now of #webxr #threejs trails
this one has multiple ribbons attached to each finger

next steps would be (in order of difficulty/result): fix the generation of the ribbons orthogonal

works.title: WebXR Sneakers Demo
works.description: A mock shoe-shop web page where tapping a button places a photoreal sneaker on the floor in AR straight from the mobile browser, without an app or plug-in.
works.description_zh: 一个仿造的球鞋商店网页，点一下按钮就能直接在手机浏览器里把逼真的球鞋放到地板上，不需要任何应用或插件。
works.idea_en: Let a web page put its product on your floor.
works.idea_zh: 让网页把商品直接放到你家地板上。
works.technique: The WebXR Device API's immersive-ar session with hit-testing places a three.js-rendered model on detected surfaces in Chrome on Android.
works.technique_zh: WebXR Device API 的 immersive-ar 会话配合命中测试，在安卓 Chrome 中把 three.js 渲染的模型放在识别出的平面上。
works.exercise_en: Build a one-page WebXR 'gallery shop' with three.js or model-viewer where each student's 3D object can be placed on a real table. Twist: let the object change when placed on the floor instead of a table.
works.exercise_zh: 用 three.js 或 model-viewer 做一个单页 WebXR“画廊商店”，每位同学的 3D 作品都能放到真实桌面上。变体：放在地板上而不是桌上时，物体会发生变化。

video.video_title: WebXR Sneakers Demo

works.title: Webcam Effect with Shader Graph
works.description: A live webcam image is fed into Shader Graph and turned into a stylised, animated effect on screen.
works.description_zh: 实时摄像头画面被送进 Shader Graph，变成屏幕上风格化的动态效果。
works.idea_en: The camera feed is just another texture you can shade.
works.idea_zh: 相机画面只是另一张可以着色的纹理。
works.technique: A script captures a WebCamTexture and assigns it to a material, and Shader Graph nodes then distort, posterise or displace the texture; an accompanying article explains the setup.
works.technique_zh: 脚本捕获 WebCamTexture 并赋给材质，再由 Shader Graph 节点对纹理进行扭曲、色调分离或位移；配套文章讲解了整个设置。
works.exercise_en: Replace the WebCamTexture with the AR Foundation camera background texture and build the same Shader Graph effect as a filter on the phone's view of the world. Twist: apply the effect only inside the human-segmentation mask.
works.exercise_zh: 把 WebCamTexture 换成 AR Foundation 的相机背景纹理，把同样的 Shader Graph 效果做成手机取景的滤镜。变体：只在人像分割遮罩内应用这个效果。

video.video_title:

works.title: Weird Type skate trails
works.description: Skateboarder Christopher Ledwig uses the Weird Type app to leave a trail of text following his skateboard's motion through space (shared by Zach).
works.idea_zh: 让一个 AR 文字工具被别人拿去玩出新花样：用文字画出滑板的轨迹。
works.technique: The app samples the phone's world-tracked pose each frame and emits typographic glyphs along that path, so moving the camera draws text in 3D.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个“移动手机就能在空中留下文字轨迹”的小工具，再请同学用运动（跑、跳、滑板）去用它；变体：让文字内容随速度变化。

video.video_title:
Using weird type to draw a trail of skate motion #Repost @christopherledwig (@get_repost)
・・・
augmented reality skateboard experiments #weirdtype #zachlieberman #northbrigade https://t.co/1MtstKHYDP

works.description_zh: 滑板手 Christopher Ledwig 用 Weird Type 应用让一串文字跟随滑板在空间中的运动留下轨迹（由 Zach 分享）。
works.idea_en: Someone else takes an AR text tool and finds a new trick: drawing a skateboard's path with words.
works.technique_zh: 应用每帧采样手机在世界追踪中的位姿，并沿这条路径发射文字字形，于是移动相机就能在三维空间中书写文字。
works.exercise_en: Make a small tool that leaves a trail of text in the air as you move your phone, then ask classmates to use it while running, jumping or skateboarding. Twist: make the text content change with speed.

salient.why_en: A skateboard leaves a trail of words behind it, so a ride becomes a sentence in the air.
salient.why_zh: 滑板身后拖出一串文字，一次滑行就成了空中的一句话。

works.title: WfcMaze: Wave Function Collapse maze
works.description: A 3D maze of connected blocks assembles itself piece by piece, each tile chosen to fit its neighbors.
works.description_zh: 一座三维迷宫一块一块地自动拼出来，每一块都根据邻居选择合适的形状。
works.idea_en: Local rules can build a coherent structure.
works.idea_zh: 局部规则就能搭出一个完整的结构。
works.technique: Wave Function Collapse keeps a list of allowed tiles per cell, collapses the cell with the fewest options and propagates the constraints to neighbors.
works.technique_zh: 波函数坍缩为每个格子保留可选图块列表，先坍缩选项最少的格子，再把约束传播给相邻格子。
works.exercise_en: Generate a small WFC maze on a detected table plane in AR Foundation and let a tiny character walk through it. Twist: regenerate the maze when you tap the table.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 检测到的桌面上用 WFC 生成一个小迷宫，让小角色在里面行走。变体：敲一下桌面，迷宫重新生成。

video.video_title: https://t.co/HvAMCcxvtt https://t.co/jkFIoQHXx1

works.title: Willowcrest Manor
works.description: A Wonderscope mystery set in a spooky mansion that unfolds around the child's room.
works.idea_zh: 一座神秘庄园在孩子的房间里展开推理故事。

video.video_title: New On Wonderscope: Willowcrest Manor

works.technique: Room-scale placement of set pieces and characters, likely with scripted triggers based on where the viewer looks, turns the child's room into a staged mystery.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个基于视线触发的 AR 悬疑场景：只有看向某个角落时才出现线索；变体：线索出现后如果你移开视线，它会换位置。
works.description_zh: 一个 Wonderscope 悬疑故事，发生在一座阴森的宅邸中，并在孩子的房间里徐徐展开。
works.idea_en: A mysterious manor unfolds a detective story in a child's bedroom.
works.technique_zh: 在房间尺度上放置场景道具和角色，大概率配合基于观看方向的脚本触发器，把孩子的房间变成一出悬疑剧的舞台。
works.exercise_en: Build a gaze-triggered AR mystery scene where a clue appears only when you look at a certain corner. Twist: once the clue appears, it moves somewhere else if you look away.

works.title: World in Progress
works.description: For the 75th anniversary of the United Nations, Saype painted two children drawing a round of people holding hands on the lawn of the Palais des Nations park in Geneva.
works.description_zh: 为纪念联合国成立 75 周年，Saype 在日内瓦万国宫公园的草坪上画出两个孩子正在描绘一圈手拉手的人。
works.idea_en: A picture of children drawing the world on the ground is a meta image of what location AR does: people drawing on the planet.
works.idea_zh: 孩子在地面上画世界的图像，是对位置 AR 所做之事的元描绘：人们在地球上作画。
works.technique: Painted with his biodegradable mix on the park's lawn at monumental scale.
works.technique_zh: 用他自制的可降解颜料在公园草坪上以巨大尺度绘制。
works.exercise_en: Make a shared AR ground-drawing app where each user adds one figure to a circle of held hands on a lawn. Twist: the circle closes only when it reaches one figure per country represented in the class.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个共享 AR 地面绘画应用，让每个用户在草坪上为一圈手拉手的人添加一个人物；变体：只有当人数达到班级中每个国家各一人时，圆圈才会闭合。

video.video_title: World in Progress by SAYPE - 2020

works.title: XRDirector
works.description: A role-based collaborative authoring tool where one person acts as director, others as actors or camera, puppeteering virtual characters in AR together like filming a scene.
works.idea_zh: 像拍电影一样分角色：导演、演员、摄影一起在AR中排演。

video.video_title: XRDirector: A Role-Based Collaborative Immersive Authoring System

works.technique: Synchronises a shared AR scene across devices and assigns each device a role with its own controls for moving characters, cameras and timelines.
works.exercise_zh: 分组用Reality Composer或共享AR App：一人做“导演”喊指令，两人各拿手机操控一个虚拟角色排演一个30秒短剧；变化：最后由“摄影师”手机录屏成片。
works.description_zh: 一个基于角色分工的协作创作工具：一人担任导演，其他人担任演员或摄影师，大家像拍摄一场戏一样在 AR 中共同操控虚拟角色。
works.idea_en: Split roles like on a film set: director, actors and camera rehearse together in AR.
works.technique_zh: 在多台设备之间同步共享的 AR 场景，并为每台设备分配角色，每个角色都有各自用于移动角色、相机和时间线的控制方式。
works.exercise_en: Work in groups with Reality Composer or a shared AR app: one person acts as director and calls out instructions while two others each control a virtual character with a phone to rehearse a 30-second skit. Twist: at the end, the camera operator screen-records the final cut on their phone.

works.title: You Are Strange
works.description: A short mixed-reality poem in which a dreamy painted figure and floating words appear around the artist in a real room, as if her imagination were leaking into the space.
works.description_zh: 一首简短的混合现实诗：一个梦幻的画中人和漂浮的文字出现在真实房间里艺术家的身边，仿佛她的想象力正渗进这个空间。
works.idea_en: Let a drawn daydream share the room with you.
works.idea_zh: 让画出来的白日梦与你共处一室。
works.technique: The 3D painting is created in VR and composited over footage of the real room from a tracked camera.
works.technique_zh: 三维绘画在 VR 中完成，再与被追踪摄像机拍到的真实房间画面合成。
works.exercise_en: Write a four-line poem and paint each line as a 3D element placed around a real person in a room using an AR drawing app. Twist: film it so the words are only readable from one camera position.
works.exercise_zh: 写一首四行小诗，用 AR 绘画应用把每一行画成一个三维元素，摆放在房间里真人的周围；变体：拍摄时让文字只有在某一个机位才能读懂。

video.video_title: You are strange... virtual reality painting - Mixed reality

works.title: iPad Pro LiDAR Matrix Simulation
works.description: The scanned room is texture-mapped with falling green Matrix code, turning his house into the digital rain.
works.idea_zh: 把扫描出的房间贴满《黑客帝国》的绿色代码雨。

video.video_title: iPad Pro LiDAR Matrix simulation

works.technique: The LiDAR mesh is shaded with a world-space projected shader that scrolls glyph textures downward over time, producing Matrix-style digital rain on every surface.
works.exercise_zh: 给 AR 网格写一个按世界坐标 Y 轴向下滚动字符贴图的着色器；变体：把字符换成你名字的字母或诗句。
works.description_zh: 扫描出的房间被贴满下落的《黑客帝国》绿色代码，把他的家变成一场数字雨。
works.idea_en: Cover the scanned room with the green code rain from The Matrix.
works.technique_zh: LiDAR 网格使用世界空间投影着色器进行着色，字符纹理随时间向下滚动，在每个表面上生成《黑客帝国》风格的数字雨。
works.exercise_en: Write a shader for the AR mesh that scrolls a glyph texture downward along the world-space Y axis. Twist: replace the glyphs with the letters of your name or lines of a poem.

works.title: 'Automaton' Instagram effect
works.description: A face effect that retextures and lights the face mesh to turn the user into a mechanical automaton with layered metal parts.
works.idea_zh: 把你的脸变成机械人偶。

video.video_title: Spark AR - Instagram Effect Breakdown ("Automaton")

works.technique: A custom texture and normal maps are applied to the tracked face mesh, with additional 3D parts attached to face anchors and lit in real time.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 面部网格贴图，把自己变成'文物'或'机器人'；加一个变化：张嘴时脸上的零件会弹开。
works.description_zh: 一个面部特效，为面部网格重新贴图并打光，把用户变成一个由层层金属部件构成的机械自动人偶。
works.idea_en: Turn your face into a mechanical automaton.
works.technique_zh: 在被追踪的面部网格上应用自定义纹理和法线贴图，并在面部锚点上附加额外的三维部件，进行实时打光。
works.exercise_en: Use face-mesh texturing in Lens Studio to turn yourself into a museum relic or a robot. Twist: the parts on your face spring open when you open your mouth.

works.title: 'Hole in the head' occlusion effect
works.description: A face-tracked effect cuts a convincing hole into the user's head where a tiny 3D scene sits inside.
works.idea_zh: 在脑袋上开个洞，里面藏着一个小世界。

video.video_title: Spark AR: Instagram Filters - “Hole in the head” with Occlusion

works.technique: An invisible occluder mesh around the head writes depth only, so a 3D model placed inside appears to sit in a cavity in the face.
works.exercise_zh: 用遮挡（occluder）材质在额头开一个洞，里面放一个旋转的小星球；加一个变化：眨眼时洞里的场景切换。
works.description_zh: 一个基于面部追踪的特效，在用户的头部切开一个以假乱真的洞，洞里藏着一个微缩的三维场景。
works.idea_en: Open a hole in your head with a tiny world hidden inside.
works.technique_zh: 头部周围一个不可见的遮挡网格只写入深度，使放在里面的三维模型看起来像是位于脸上的一个空腔中。
works.exercise_en: Use an occluder material to open a hole in your forehead and put a small spinning planet inside. Twist: the scene inside the hole switches when you blink.

salient.why_en: A hole opens in your head and there is a tiny world inside.
salient.why_zh: 头上开了一个洞，里面藏着一个微小的世界。

works.title: 'Wichita' Instagram effect
works.description: An Instagram effect inspired by the White Stripes' 'Seven Nation Army' video splits your face and background into layered, animated kaleidoscopic tunnels.
works.idea_zh: 把自拍变成《Seven Nation Army》MV 那样无限延伸的三角隧道。

video.video_title: Spark AR: Instagram Effect Breakdown ("Wichita")

works.technique: Person segmentation separates the user from the background, and scripted layers of scaled, offset camera textures create the recursive tunnel.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Spark/Lens Studio 或 p5.js 把摄像头画面做成向中心无限递归的隧道；加一个变化：递归层数随音乐音量变化。
works.description_zh: 这款 Instagram 特效的灵感来自 The White Stripes《Seven Nation Army》的 MV，它把你的脸和背景拆成一层层动态的万花筒式隧道。
works.idea_en: Turn a selfie into the endless triangular tunnel from the 'Seven Nation Army' video.
works.technique_zh: 人像分割把用户从背景中分离出来，再用脚本叠加多层经过缩放和偏移的相机纹理，形成递归隧道。
works.exercise_en: Use Spark/Lens Studio or p5.js to turn the camera feed into a tunnel that recurses endlessly toward the center. Twist: make the number of recursion layers follow the music volume.

works.title: 360proto
works.description: Paper sketches drawn on equirectangular 360 grids are photographed and instantly viewed as immersive VR/AR scenes, with layers for interactive prototypes.
works.idea_zh: 在纸上画360度全景草图，拍一下就能在头显里走进去。

video.video_title: 360proto: Making Interactive Virtual Reality & Augmented Reality Prototypes from Paper

works.technique: Maps hand-drawn sketches on a distorted 360 grid template onto a sphere around the viewer, with layered sketches for AR overlays.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一张等距柱状投影网格纸让学生画一个房间，拍照后用手机全景查看器浏览；变化：在同一场景中叠加一层“AR标签”草图。
works.description_zh: 在等距柱状 360 度网格纸上画好的草图，拍照后即可作为沉浸式 VR/AR 场景直接浏览，还能叠加图层制作可交互的原型。
works.idea_en: Sketch a 360-degree scene on paper, snap a photo, and step inside it in a headset.
works.technique_zh: 把画在畸变 360 度网格模板上的手绘草图映射到环绕观者的球面上，并用分层草图制作 AR 叠加层。
works.exercise_en: Print an equirectangular grid sheet, have students draw a room on it, then photograph it and browse it in a phone panorama viewer. Twist: overlay a second sketch layer of 'AR labels' on the same scene.

works.title: 3D Physarum Transport Networks
works.description: Millions of agents crawl through a 3D volume, leaving trails that they then follow, so glowing vein-like networks grow and reorganise on their own.
works.description_zh: 数百万个智能体在三维空间里爬行、留下痕迹又追随痕迹，发光的叶脉状网络自己生长并不断重组。
works.idea_en: Slime-mould logic in 3D: simple agents following their own trails build networks.
works.idea_zh: 三维的黏菌逻辑：追随自己痕迹的简单个体，编织出网络。
works.technique: Following Jeff Jones's Physarum model, compute shaders move agents that sense a 3D trail texture ahead of them, turn toward the strongest trail, deposit into it, and the trail volume is diffused and decayed each frame before volume rendering.
works.technique_zh: 按照 Jeff Jones 的多头绒泡菌模型，计算着色器让每个智能体感知前方三维痕迹纹理、转向最强的痕迹并沉积；痕迹体积每帧扩散和衰减，然后做体渲染。
works.exercise_en: Seed the Physarum agents from a LiDAR point cloud of a real room in AR so glowing networks grow along the furniture edges. Twist: let the user place food sources by tapping, and watch the network reroute.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中用真实房间的 LiDAR 点云作为黏菌智能体的起点，让发光的网络沿家具边缘生长。变体：用户点击放置“食物”，观察网络如何改道。

video.video_title: 3D Physarum Transport Networks

works.title: A Jester's Tale
works.description: A Magic Leap narrative that premiered at Sundance: you come home cold and tired for a bedtime story, and a psychologically unsettling children's fable spills into the physical room around you.
works.description_zh: 在圣丹斯首映的 Magic Leap 叙事作品：你又冷又累地回到家听一个睡前故事，一则令人心理不安的童话渐渐溢出到你身边的真实房间。
works.idea_en: Let a fairy tale invade your room until you are inside it.
works.idea_zh: 让童话一点点侵入你的房间，直到你身处其中。
works.technique: Magic Leap spatial mapping anchors volumetric and animated characters to the room's furniture, with interactions that respond to the viewer's position.
works.technique_zh: Magic Leap 的空间映射把体积影像和动画角色锚定在房间家具上，交互会根据观众的位置作出反应。
works.exercise_en: Write a three-scene bedtime story for phone AR where each scene is anchored to a different piece of real furniture. Twist: the last scene happens behind the viewer.
works.exercise_zh: 为手机 AR 写一个三场景的睡前故事，每个场景锚定在不同的真实家具上。变体：最后一幕发生在观众身后。

video.video_title: A Jester's Tale - AR experience from Asad J. Malik - Sundance 2019 Promo

works.title: A Purple Poem for Miami
works.description: On a Miami beach, a smoke performance unfolds in purple and other colours, with plumes rising from the sand and structures toward the sea for about ten minutes.
works.description_zh: 在迈阿密的海滩上，一场以紫色为主的烟雾表演展开，烟柱从沙地和构筑物中升起，飘向大海，持续约十分钟。
works.idea_en: A single dominant colour can title a whole event; limiting an AR palette to one hue makes a site-wide effect feel authored rather than noisy.
works.idea_zh: 一种主导颜色就能为整场活动命名；把 AR 的配色限制在一种色调，能让覆盖整个场地的效果显得有作者意图，而不是杂乱。
works.technique: Coloured smoke flares and pyrotechnic devices placed along the beach are fired in a timed score so the purple clouds build and move with the sea breeze.
works.technique_zh: 沿海滩布置的彩色烟雾弹和烟火装置按时间谱依次点燃，紫色烟云随着海风逐渐堆积和移动。
works.exercise_en: Write a one-colour AR 'poem': place five smoke emitters on a beach or lawn that each release a purple cloud with one word of a short poem hidden inside, revealed when you walk into it. Twist: the words dissolve when two people stand in the same cloud.
works.exercise_zh: 写一首单色的 AR“诗”：在海滩或草坪上放五个烟雾发射点，每个放出一团紫色烟云，里面藏着一首短诗中的一个词，走进烟里才看得到。变体：两个人站在同一团烟里时，词语就会消散。

video.video_title: ICA Performs: Judy Chicago, A Purple Poem for Miami, 2019 (full smoke performance)

works.title: A Vixen's Tale
works.description: Visitors walk through five wooden arches styled like a pop-up book and hold up a phone to follow an animated fox through gamified scenes from Janáček's opera The Cunning Little Vixen; a face filter lets them become the vixen.
works.description_zh: 观众穿过五座立体书风格的木拱门，举起手机追随一只动画狐狸，在游戏化的场景中了解雅纳切克的歌剧《狡猾的小狐狸》；脸部滤镜还能让他们变成狐狸。
works.idea_en: A physical pop-up-book set and AR together turn an opera into a walk-through game.
works.idea_zh: 实体立体书布景与 AR 结合，把一部歌剧变成可以走进去的游戏。
works.technique: Physical arches act as image targets and staging for phone AR vignettes that unlock chapters of the story with music from the opera, plus a face-tracking filter.
works.technique_zh: 实体拱门既是图像识别目标，也是舞台布景；手机 AR 小场景逐段解锁故事并播放歌剧音乐，另外还有人脸追踪滤镜。
works.exercise_en: Pick a song or story with five scenes, build five cardboard 'arches' with printed markers, and make one AR vignette per arch in Lens Studio or 8th Wall. Twist: the final arch only unlocks if the visitor has collected an item in each earlier scene.
works.exercise_zh: 选一首歌或一个有五个场景的故事，用纸板做五座贴有识别图的“拱门”，并用 Lens Studio 或 8th Wall 为每座拱门做一个 AR 小场景；变体：只有在前面每个场景都收集到物品，最后一座拱门才会解锁。

video.video_title: A Vixen's Tale

works.title: AR Body Tracking with Head and Hand Particles
works.description: On an iPhone, a person's tracked head and hands emit fire and particle effects that follow them as they move in the real room.
works.description_zh: 在 iPhone 上，被追踪的人的头和手会喷出火焰和粒子，随着他们在真实房间中移动而跟随。
works.idea_en: Give real people superpowers by attaching effects to their tracked joints.
works.idea_zh: 把特效绑在人体追踪关节上，让真实的人拥有超能力。
works.technique: AR Foundation's ARKit 3 human body tracking provides joint transforms, and particle emitters are parented to the head and hand joints each frame.
works.technique_zh: AR Foundation 的 ARKit 3 人体追踪提供关节变换，每帧把粒子发射器挂到头部和手部关节上。
works.exercise_en: Attach VFX Graph emitters to AR body-tracking joints and design a superpower for each classmate. Twist: the effect grows stronger the faster the joint moves.
works.exercise_zh: 把 VFX Graph 发射器绑到 AR 人体追踪关节上，为每位同学设计一种超能力。变体：关节移动越快，效果越强。

video.video_title: Unity3d with AR Foundation - How to Use Body Tracking With Head And Hand Particles?

works.title: AR Experiments (Boris Chimp 504 print)
works.description: Pointing a phone at a Boris Chimp 504 art print plays a track and grows a live sound visualisation on top of the printed image.
works.description_zh: 用手机对准一张 Boris Chimp 504 的版画，就会播放一首曲子，并在画面上方长出实时的声音可视化。
works.idea_en: A printed poster becomes a speaker whose sound you can see.
works.idea_zh: 一张印刷海报变成一个能“看见”声音的扬声器。
works.technique: Vuforia image tracking in Unity anchors the scene to the print, and the SimpleSpectrum asset turns the audio spectrum into 3D bars.
works.technique_zh: Unity 中的 Vuforia 图像追踪把场景锚定在版画上，SimpleSpectrum 插件把音频频谱变成 3D 柱体。
works.exercise_en: Make an image-tracked AR poster in AR Foundation or 8th Wall that plays a song and draws its spectrum as 3D shapes rising from the print. Twist: make the visualisation only appear when two phones look at the poster together.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 或 8th Wall 做一张图像追踪的 AR 海报：播放一首歌，把它的频谱画成从画面升起的 3D 形状；变体：只有两部手机同时对准海报时，可视化才出现。

video.video_title: AR Experiments

works.title: AR Foundation + VFX Graph
works.description: A glowing VFX Graph particle system floats on a real table, seen through the phone, showing that Unity's GPU particle tool can run on top of the AR camera feed.
works.description_zh: 一团发光的 VFX Graph 粒子漂浮在真实的桌面上，通过手机看到，证明 Unity 的 GPU 粒子工具可以直接运行在 AR 摄像头画面之上。
works.idea_en: Any VFX Graph effect becomes an AR effect once the render pipeline and the camera background agree.
works.idea_zh: 只要渲染管线和摄像头背景配置对了，任何 VFX Graph 特效都能变成 AR 特效。
works.technique: The project configures the Universal Render Pipeline with the AR Foundation background renderer feature, places a slimmed-down Unity Logo VFX Graph on a detected plane, and checks for Metal/Vulkan support at runtime.
works.technique_zh: 工程把 Universal Render Pipeline 与 AR Foundation 的背景渲染特性配置在一起，把精简过的 Unity Logo VFX Graph 放在检测到的平面上，并在运行时检查设备是否支持 Metal/Vulkan。
works.exercise_en: Use the repo as a template: swap the sample graph for your own particle effect and spawn it where the user taps a detected plane. Twist: make the particles collide with the AR plane so they pour off the table edge.
works.exercise_zh: 以这个仓库为模板：把示例图换成你自己的粒子特效，并在用户点击检测到的平面时生成。变体：让粒子与 AR 平面碰撞，从桌子边缘倾泻下去。

video.video_title: Did you know #ARFoundation supports Lightweight / Universal Render pipeline in @unity3d this lets you use the shader and VFX graph in #AR! #unitytips https://t.co/umUbXAwkRc

works.title: AR Foundation Post Processing
works.description: The live AR camera view gets cinematic post-processing: depth of field that follows the phone camera's real focus, film grain and motion blur on both the room and the virtual objects.
works.description_zh: 实时的 AR 摄像头画面被加上电影感的后期：景深跟随手机摄像头的真实对焦变化，房间和虚拟物体一起带上胶片颗粒和运动模糊。
works.idea_en: Make virtual objects sit in the camera image by giving them the same lens as the real camera.
works.idea_zh: 给虚拟物体套上和真实摄像头同样的“镜头”，让它们融进画面。
works.technique: A URP post-processing volume runs over the AR Foundation camera background, and a script reads ARKit camera intrinsics each frame to drive the depth-of-field focus distance, grain and motion blur.
works.technique_zh: 在 AR Foundation 的摄像头背景之上叠加 URP 后处理体积，脚本每帧读取 ARKit 的相机内参来驱动景深对焦距离，并加上颗粒和运动模糊。
works.exercise_en: Clone the repo, build it to a phone and place one glossy object on a table; tune depth of field so the object blurs exactly like the real background when you refocus. Twist: animate the grain and color grade to the time of day read from the device clock.
works.exercise_zh: 克隆仓库并构建到手机，在桌面上放一个有光泽的物体；调节景深，让它在重新对焦时和真实背景一样虚化。变体：根据设备时钟的时间动态调整颗粒和调色。

video.video_title: I worked on some post processing for mobile #AR with @unity3d It's built with ARFoundation and uses #ARKit camera intrinsics to link into the camera changing focus along with some grain and motion blu

works.title: AR Iron Man HUD
works.description: A phone-in-headset JARVIS HUD that tracks a real phone, listens to voice commands and wires in Alexa skills.
works.idea_zh: 用手机加廉价头盔自制钢铁侠 JARVIS 头显。

video.video_title: AR Iron Man HUD in Unity (tracking a phone)

works.technique: A phone-in-headset stereo view renders a HUD overlay, while Vuforia tracks a second physical phone as a target and voice commands are routed through Alexa skills.
works.exercise_zh: 用 HoloKit 双目模式做一个头部锁定的 HUD，显示时间和语音识别到的指令；变体：盯着桌上某个真实物体时 HUD 弹出它的“扫描信息”。
works.description_zh: 一套把手机插进头戴设备的 JARVIS 抬头显示：它能追踪一部真实的手机、听取语音指令，并接入 Alexa 技能。
works.idea_en: Build your own Iron Man JARVIS headset from a phone and a cheap helmet.
works.technique_zh: 手机插入头显形成双目立体视图并渲染 HUD 叠加层，同时用 Vuforia 把另一部实体手机当作追踪目标，语音指令则通过 Alexa 技能处理。
works.exercise_en: Build a head-locked HUD in HoloKit stereo mode that shows the time and the commands picked up by speech recognition. Twist: when you stare at a real object on the desk, the HUD pops up its 'scan info'.

works.title: AR Technical Demo: Virtual Plants
works.description: A short iOS 12 AR test in which a delicate stem of purple and white flowers grows and sways in real time on a wooden table next to a laptop.
works.description_zh: 一段 iOS 12 AR 测试：一枝紫白相间的纤细花茎在笔记本电脑旁的木桌上实时生长、摇曳。
works.idea_en: Grow a generative plant on your desk.
works.idea_zh: 在书桌上长出一株生成式植物。
works.technique: Procedurally generated plant geometry is animated in real time and anchored to a detected horizontal plane with ARKit on iOS 12 (with Yi-Wen Lin).
works.technique_zh: 程序化生成的植物几何体实时动画，并通过 iOS 12 的 ARKit 固定在检测到的水平面上（与 Yi-Wen Lin 合作）。
works.exercise_en: Write an L-system plant in three.js and place it on a table with WebXR hit-test so it grows over ten seconds. Twist: each tap on the table plants a different random species.
works.exercise_zh: 用 three.js 写一株 L 系统植物，通过 WebXR 命中测试放到桌上，让它在十秒内长出来。变体：每点一次桌面就种下一株随机的新品种。

video.video_title: AR Technical Demo – Virtual Plants

works.title: AR eyedropper for smart lights
works.description: A virtual eyedropper sucks a color from any real object with a pinch and squirts it into a smart lamp, which changes to that color, accompanied by the Deluminator sound from Harry Potter.
works.description_zh: 一个虚拟滴管，捏一下就从任何真实物体上吸取颜色，再挤进智能灯里，灯立刻变成同样的颜色，还配上《哈利·波特》熄灯器的音效。
works.idea_en: Treat the whole visible world as a color palette you can sample and pour into connected devices.
works.idea_zh: 把整个看得见的世界当成调色盘，取色后倒进联网设备里。
works.technique: A ray from the fingertip hits the passthrough video texture to read the pixel color, and virtual colliders registered to the real lamps send that color to the smart bulbs over their API.
works.technique_zh: 从指尖发出的射线命中透视视频纹理并读取像素颜色，再通过与真实灯具对齐的虚拟碰撞体，把颜色经 API 发给智能灯泡。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone app that samples the color at the screen center and sends it to a smart bulb or a web page background. Twist: mix two sampled colors before pouring.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机应用：取屏幕中心的颜色，发送给智能灯泡或网页背景。变体：先吸两种颜色，混合后再倒出去。

video.video_title: A virtual eye dropper in AR that can pick up colors from real world and apply it to smart lights. It feels a bit magical so I used the deluminator sound effect in #HarryPotter movie. Prototyping with

salient.why_en: An eyedropper sucks a color from any real object and squirts it into a lamp, so the world becomes a palette.
salient.why_zh: 用滴管从任何真实物体上吸取颜色，再挤进台灯，整个世界就成了调色盘。

works.title: ARKit3 Body Tracking Effects
works.description: Generative graphics attached to a tracked human skeleton follow a dancer's movements.
works.idea_zh: 给 ARKit3 追踪到的人体骨骼附上生成式图形。

video.video_title: ARKit3 Body Tracking Demo #1

works.technique: ARKit 3 body tracking provides a 3D skeleton, and generative meshes and trails are attached to joint transforms so they follow the dancer.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 追踪全身关节，在手腕和脚踝上挂彩色拖尾；变体：不同关节触发不同乐器的声音。
works.description_zh: 附着在被追踪人体骨骼上的生成式图形，随舞者的动作一起舞动。
works.idea_en: Hang generative graphics on the body skeleton that ARKit 3 tracks.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 3 人体追踪提供三维骨骼，生成式网格和拖尾挂在各关节的变换上，从而跟随舞者运动。
works.exercise_en: Track full-body joints with MediaPipe Pose and attach colorful trails to the wrists and ankles. Twist: each joint triggers the sound of a different instrument.

works.title: ARSpectator: MR Prototypes for Augmented Sports
works.description: Spectators in a rugby stadium hold up a phone and see player names, statistics and game information placed on the real pitch, prototyped first in the lab with a scale model.
works.description_zh: 橄榄球场的观众举起手机，就能看到球员姓名、统计数据和比赛信息摆放在真实的球场上；这些功能先在实验室里用缩比模型做了原型。
works.idea_en: Bring broadcast-style graphics to the fans actually sitting in the stadium.
works.idea_zh: 把转播画面里的图形信息带给真正坐在体育场里的观众。
works.technique: Localizes the phone against a prebuilt stadium model and overlays situated infographics, with lab prototypes simulating the field to test visualisations before live games.
works.technique_zh: 把手机定位到预先建好的体育场模型中并叠加情境化信息图，实验室原型会模拟球场，在正式比赛前测试可视化效果。
works.exercise_en: Print a mini football pitch, track it with a phone AR image target, and overlay live 'stats' for toy players moved by classmates. Twist: show different stats to home and away fans.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一个迷你足球场，用手机 AR 图像追踪识别它，为同学移动的玩具球员叠加实时“数据”；变体：给主队和客队球迷显示不同的数据。

video.video_title: Demonstrating Mixed Reality Prototypes for Augmented Sports Experiences

works.title: AR_Glitch
works.description: A generative glitch effect that tears and displaces the live camera image around the space.
works.idea_zh: 让现实画面在空间中产生生成式的故障撕裂。

video.video_title: AR_Glitch ver0.003

works.technique: A full-screen shader slices the camera image into blocks and offsets them with noise-driven displacement and RGB channel splitting, likely modulated by device motion.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity 或 three.js 里对摄像头画面写一个块状错位加 RGB 分离的故障着色器；变体：手机晃得越厉害故障越强。
works.description_zh: 一种生成式故障特效，把实时相机画面在空间中撕裂、错位。
works.idea_en: Make the real world tear apart in generative glitches across space.
works.technique_zh: 全屏着色器把相机画面切成方块，用噪声驱动的位移和 RGB 通道分离让它们错开，强度大概率随设备运动变化。
works.exercise_en: Write a glitch shader in Unity or three.js that offsets camera image blocks and splits RGB channels. Twist: the harder the phone shakes, the stronger the glitch.

works.title: ARt
works.description: A deadpan performance-demo (for TEDxTheWrong) launching 'the world's first platform for augmented reality art', satirising AR hype with face- and body-tracked artworks.
works.idea_zh: 一本正经地演示AR艺术的荒诞
works.technique: Face and body tracking attach artworks to the performer in real time, framed as a mock product launch; the technique is ordinary on purpose and the satire carries the piece.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 Effect House 做一个“艺术平台”滤镜，然后录一段 2 分钟一本正经的产品发布演示；变体：演示中必须有一个功能明显荒谬但被说得很重要。
works.description_zh: 一场为 TEDxTheWrong 创作的冷面表演式演示：艺术家郑重其事地发布“全球首个增强现实艺术平台”，借助人脸与身体追踪的作品，讽刺围绕 AR 的炒作。
works.idea_en: Demo the absurdity of AR art with a perfectly straight face.
works.technique_zh: 人脸和身体追踪把艺术作品实时附着在表演者身上，整体包装成一场假的产品发布会；技术刻意平平无奇，作品的力量来自讽刺。
works.exercise_en: Make an 'art platform' filter in Lens Studio or Effect House, then record a deadpan two-minute product launch demo. Twist: the demo must include one clearly absurd feature presented as crucial.

works.title: Accumul-Istic Quest ([AR]T Walk Soundsuits)
works.description: A stop on Apple's [AR]T Walk where Nick Cave's wearable Soundsuits are reimagined as AR figures and colourful elements that accumulate around the walking group in the street.
works.description_zh: Apple [AR]T Walk 路线上的一站：Nick Cave 的可穿戴 Soundsuits 被重新想象为 AR 角色和彩色元素，在街头围绕步行的观众不断聚集。
works.idea_en: A wearable sculpture becomes a crowd of AR figures you can walk among.
works.idea_zh: 可穿戴雕塑化身为一群可以在其中穿行的 AR 角色。
works.technique: Location-anchored ARKit scene on the guided [AR]T Walk, experienced on iPhones in small groups.
works.technique_zh: [AR]T Walk 导览路线上锚定位置的 ARKit 场景，观众以小组形式用 iPhone 体验。
works.exercise_en: Scan or model a costume and place several copies of it along a campus path as an AR procession that starts dancing when the group arrives. Twist: each copy responds to a different sound in the environment.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描或建模一套服装，把多个副本沿校园小路摆成 AR 游行队伍，当小组走到时开始跳舞；变体：每个副本对环境中不同的声音做出反应。

video.video_title: [AR]T ウォーク@新宿：Accumul-Istic Quest

works.title: Acqua Alta – Noir d'encre
works.description: The stage version of the Acqua Alta triptych: two performers play a couple whose house is swallowed by a sea of ink, and the projected black-and-white drawings of water and living hair move with their bodies.
works.description_zh: Acqua Alta 三部曲中的舞台版本：两位演员演一对夫妻，他们的房子被墨水之海吞没，投影出的黑白手绘水流和“活着的头发”随着他们的身体流动。
works.idea_en: A drawn world of ink that floods, flows and grows hair in dialogue with the performers.
works.idea_zh: 手绘的墨水世界会涨潮、流动、长出头发，和演员对话。
works.technique: Projections on the floor and on a vertical screen are played live with eMotion, so hand-drawn animation behaves like fluid and hair that react to where the performers are.
works.technique_zh: 投影覆盖地面和竖立的幕，由 eMotion 现场操控，让手绘动画像流体和头发一样，对演员所在的位置作出反应。
works.exercise_en: Draw a short ink-style loop (a wave, a strand of hair), project it on the floor, and use a top-down webcam with frame differencing so the strokes flow away from anyone who steps in; stage a one-minute scene in which the image is a second character. Twist: continue the same story on paper as an AR image target, as the company did with its pop-up book.
works.exercise_zh: 画一段水墨风格的短循环动画（一道浪、一缕头发）投到地面，用俯拍摄像头和帧差法让线条从踏进来的人身边流开；排一段 1 分钟的小场景，让影像充当第二个角色。变体：像该公司的立体书那样，把同一个故事延续到纸上，做成 AR 识别图。

video.video_title: Acqua Alta – Noir d'encre

works.title: Akvfx: Azure Kinect with VFX Graph
works.description: A person in front of an Azure Kinect appears as a live 3D point cloud that breaks into sparks and lines as they move.
works.description_zh: 站在 Azure Kinect 前的人以实时三维点云出现，一动就碎成火花和线条。
works.idea_en: Treat a depth sensor as a live particle source.
works.idea_zh: 把深度传感器当成实时粒子源。
works.technique: The plugin converts Azure Kinect color and depth frames into position and color attribute maps on the GPU; VFX Graph spawns particles from these maps every frame.
works.technique_zh: 插件在 GPU 上把 Azure Kinect 的彩色和深度帧转成位置和颜色属性贴图，VFX Graph 每帧从这些贴图生成粒子。
works.exercise_en: Recreate the effect on a phone: use AR Foundation's human depth or LiDAR depth to spawn points on people, and view it through HoloKit. Twist: let the points lag one second behind, so each person leaves a ghost.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机上重做：用 AR Foundation 的人体深度或 LiDAR 深度在人身上生成点，用 HoloKit 观看。变体：让点延迟一秒，每个人身后都留下一个幽灵。

video.video_title:
Playing around with Azure Kinect and Unity VFX Graph
https://t.co/VV5zCiXcUg https://t.co/OaNG9Jq44p

works.title: All My Confusing Pets
works.description: A mixed-reality performance where the artist interacts with glitchy virtual pets composited into the real space.
works.idea_zh: 与一群混乱的虚拟宠物同台的混合现实表演

video.video_title: All My Confusing Pets : A Mixed Reality Performance

works.technique: Mixed-reality compositing of glitchy AI-driven creatures in Unity into the real space, with the performer's tracked pose used for interaction and collision.
works.exercise_zh: 用 HoloKit 或手机 AR 放几只行为规则互相冲突的虚拟宠物（追你、躲你、模仿你），录一段你试图照顾它们的表演；变体：让宠物的故障（抖动、穿模）成为它们性格的一部分。
works.description_zh: 一场混合现实表演：艺术家与一群合成进真实空间、不断出故障的虚拟宠物互动。
works.idea_en: A mixed-reality performance where the artist shares the stage with a pack of chaotic virtual pets.
works.technique_zh: 在 Unity 中把由 AI 驱动、带故障感的生物以混合现实方式合成进真实空间，并利用表演者被追踪的姿态进行交互和碰撞。
works.exercise_en: Place a few virtual pets with conflicting behavior rules (chase you, avoid you, copy you) in HoloKit or phone AR, and record a performance of you trying to look after them. Twist: make the pets' glitches (jitter, clipping) part of their personalities.

works.title: Amass
works.description: Inside any Apple Store, opening the Apple Store app turns the shop into a swirling AR universe of Nick Cave's colourful 'Ikon Elements' that visitors collect and gather around them.
works.description_zh: 在任何一家 Apple Store 里打开 Apple Store App，店内空间就会变成一个旋转的 AR 宇宙，布满 Nick Cave 色彩缤纷的“Ikon Elements”，观众可以收集并让它们聚拢在自己周围。
works.idea_en: A chain of retail stores becomes one shared, global AR artwork.
works.idea_zh: 全球的连锁门店变成同一件共享的 AR 艺术作品。
works.technique: An ARKit experience inside the Apple Store app, likely triggered by store location and anchored to the store's floor and ceiling space.
works.technique_zh: 内置在 Apple Store App 中的 ARKit 体验，很可能按门店位置触发，并锚定在店内地面和天花板空间。
works.exercise_en: Create an AR scene in Lens Studio or Reality Composer where tapping collects floating colourful objects that then orbit around the user. Twist: the objects only appear in one specific room of the school.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Lens Studio 或 Reality Composer 中做一个 AR 场景：点击漂浮的彩色物体即可收集，收集后它们会绕着用户旋转；变体：这些物体只在学校某一个特定房间出现。

video.video_title: ［AR］T　Amass

works.title: An Augmented Reality Web Browser
works.description: Floating, resizable web pages placed around physical space, an early take on spatial-computing windows on Android.
works.idea_zh: 把网页窗口漂浮在真实空间中，早期的空间计算浏览器。

video.video_title: Let's Make an Augmented Reality Web Browser (Unity AR)

works.technique: Web pages are rendered to textures by an embedded browser plugin and mapped onto world-anchored quads in ARCore, with raycast input translated into page coordinates for clicks and resizing.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 场景里放三块悬浮面板，每块显示一张网页截图或 iframe 纹理，可拖动和缩放；变体：面板离你越远内容越简化（只剩标题）。
works.description_zh: 可自由缩放的网页漂浮在真实空间各处，是 Android 上对空间计算窗口的一次早期尝试。
works.idea_en: Float web page windows in real space, an early spatial-computing browser.
works.technique_zh: 内嵌浏览器插件把网页渲染成纹理，贴到 ARCore 中锚定在世界坐标的四边形上；射线检测的输入被换算成页面坐标，用来点击和调整大小。
works.exercise_en: Place three floating panels in a WebXR scene, each showing a web page screenshot or iframe texture that can be dragged and scaled. Twist: the farther a panel is from you, the simpler its content gets (only the title remains).

works.title: Angry Birds AR: Isle of Pigs
works.description: Pig fortresses are built on the player's floor at room scale; players walk around them to find weak points and then launch birds from a slingshot.
works.idea_zh: 把愤怒的小鸟城堡搭在你家地板上，绕着走一圈寻找弱点。

video.video_title: Angry Birds AR: Isle of Pigs - Launch Trailer

works.technique: Destructible physics structures are built at room scale on the floor plane, and a slingshot is aimed from the camera position so the player walks to find angles.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面上放一座 AR 积木塔，从手机位置用弹弓发射小球，鼓励玩家走到侧面找弱点；变体：塔的形状由真实房间的空地大小自动决定。
works.description_zh: 猪堡垒以房间尺度搭建在玩家家里的地板上，玩家要绕着它走动寻找薄弱点，再用弹弓发射小鸟。
works.idea_en: Build Angry Birds fortresses on your living-room floor and walk around them to find the weak spots.
works.technique_zh: 在地面平面上以房间尺度搭建可破坏的物理结构，弹弓从相机位置瞄准，玩家需要走动寻找角度。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR block tower on the floor and launch balls from a slingshot at the phone's position, nudging players to walk to the side to find weak spots. Twist: the tower's shape is set automatically by the amount of open floor in the real room.

works.title: Angry Birds FPS: First Person Slingshot
works.description: Angry Birds rebuilt for Magic Leap One: pig fortresses are built on your real tables and floor, and you pull back a hand-held slingshot to knock them down.
works.idea_zh: 在真实桌面和地板上搭猪堡，亲手拉弹弓把它们打垮。

video.video_title: Angry Birds FPS: First Person Slingshot – Test Session

works.technique: Structures are spawned on detected tables and floors, and a slingshot mechanic maps the controller pull-back vector to launch velocity for physics projectiles.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌面上堆一座 AR 积木塔，用手机向后拉的距离决定发射力度把球打过去；变体：用真实物体当掩体，挡住部分积木。
works.description_zh: 为 Magic Leap One 重新打造的《愤怒的小鸟》：猪堡垒搭在你真实的桌面和地板上，你拉开手中的弹弓把它们击垮。
works.idea_en: Build pig forts on your real tables and floor, then pull back a slingshot by hand to knock them down.
works.technique_zh: 在检测到的桌面和地板上生成结构，弹弓机制把手柄向后拉的向量映射为物理弹丸的发射速度。
works.exercise_en: Stack an AR block tower on a table and fire a ball at it, with launch power set by how far you pull the phone back. Twist: use real objects as cover that hides some of the blocks.

works.title: Augmented Painting
works.description: A projector maps animated particles onto a painted canvas by Ivo Teixeira, so the physical painting's shapes collide with, catch and scatter virtual particles in time with sound.
works.description_zh: 投影仪把动画粒子映射到 Ivo Teixeira 的一幅油画上，画中的形状与虚拟粒子碰撞、承接、四散，并与声音同步。
works.idea_en: A still painting becomes a physics world for moving light.
works.idea_zh: 一幅静止的画变成一个供光粒子运动的物理世界。
works.technique: Particles simulated in Processing with the Fisica physics library use the painting's shapes as colliders, and MadMapper aligns the projection to the canvas.
works.technique_zh: 在 Processing 中用 Fisica 物理库模拟粒子，以画中的形状作为碰撞体，再用 MadMapper 把投影对齐到画布上。
works.exercise_en: Pick a poster or a student drawing, trace its main shapes as colliders in a p5.js + Matter.js sketch, and projection-map falling particles onto it. Twist: let a microphone make the particles heavier when the room is loud.
works.exercise_zh: 选一张海报或学生的画，在 p5.js + Matter.js 中把主要形状描成碰撞体，把下落的粒子投影映射到画上；变体：用麦克风让房间越吵、粒子越重。

video.video_title: Augmented Painting

works.title: Augmented Reality Language Learning
works.description: Walking through a room with a headset, the learner sees everyday objects automatically recognised and labelled with their foreign-language words, anchored in place.
works.description_zh: 戴着头显在房间里走动时，日常物品被自动识别，并在原地贴上对应的外语单词标签。
works.idea_en: Turn your own home into a vocabulary flashcard deck.
works.idea_zh: 把自己的家变成一套单词卡片。
works.technique: Runs object detection on camera frames and registers each detected label to 3D positions in the headset's spatial map so labels stay attached to objects.
works.technique_zh: 对摄像头画面做物体检测，并把每个检测结果配准到头显空间地图中的三维位置，让标签始终贴在物体上。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone object-detection or image-tracking AR tool to label ten classroom objects in a second language, then quiz a partner by hiding the labels. Twist: show only the first letter and reveal the word when the learner says it aloud.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机的物体识别或图像追踪 AR 工具，给教室里十件物品贴上第二语言的标签，然后隐藏标签考同伴；变体：只显示首字母，学生大声说出单词后再揭晓。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Language Learning

works.title: AuthAR
works.description: While an expert assembles furniture, the system records video and 3D tracking to author an AR assembly tutorial at the same time, which learners then follow in a headset.
works.idea_zh: 边组装边自动生成AR教程。

video.video_title: AuthAR: Concurrent Authoring of Tutorials for AR Assembly Guidance

works.technique: Combines object tracking with synchronized video capture so each assembly step becomes a spatially anchored AR instruction with clips and annotations.
works.exercise_zh: 分成两人一组：一人组装乐高时用手机录制每一步，另一人用Reality Composer把每步视频/箭头放在对应零件位置上，给第三人使用；变化：教程不许用文字。
works.description_zh: 专家组装家具时，系统同步录制视频和三维追踪数据，顺手生成一份 AR 组装教程，学习者随后戴上头显照着操作即可。
works.idea_en: Generate an AR tutorial automatically while you assemble.
works.technique_zh: 把物体追踪与同步视频采集结合起来，让每个组装步骤都成为带视频片段和注释的空间锚定 AR 指引。
works.exercise_en: Work in pairs: one person records each step on a phone while building with LEGO, and the other uses Reality Composer to place each step's video or arrows at the matching part, for a third person to follow. Twist: the tutorial may not use any text.

works.title: Automata
works.description: A wearable kinetic costume whose parts move when the dancer moves, raising the question of who is controlling whom: the dancer the objects, or the objects the dancer.
works.description_zh: 一件可穿戴的动态服装，舞者一动，服装的部件也随之运动，引出一个问题：是舞者在操控物件，还是物件在操控舞者？
works.idea_en: A costume that dances back, blurring puppeteer and puppet.
works.idea_zh: 会“回舞”的服装，模糊了操偶师与木偶的界限。
works.technique: Accelerometers on the dancer's arms are read by a microcontroller that drives servo motors moving elements of the outfit.
works.technique_zh: 舞者手臂上的加速度计由微控制器读取，驱动舵机带动服装上的部件。
works.exercise_en: Attach a micro:bit to a wrist and make its tilt move a servo that flaps a paper wing on the shoulder. Twist: invert the mapping so the wing moves most when the arm is still.
works.exercise_zh: 把 micro:bit 绑在手腕上，用它的倾斜控制舵机，让肩上的纸翅膀扇动；变体：反转映射，手臂静止时翅膀动得最厉害。

video.video_title: Automata by Clemence Debaig

works.title: BLINK
works.description: A performance for three people that uses eye blinking as a performative tool: conscious and unconscious blinks, read as indicators of mood, generate a score of light and sound.
works.description_zh: 一个三人表演，把眨眼当作表演工具：有意和无意的眨眼被当作情绪的指标，生成一段光与声音的总谱。
works.idea_en: Blinking, which we never notice, becomes the score of a performance.
works.idea_zh: 我们从不留意的眨眼，成了一场表演的总谱。
works.technique: Blinks are detected per performer, likely with eye-tracking cameras or EOG electrodes, and each blink triggers light and sound events in a shared score.
