works.technique_zh: 逐一检测每位表演者的眨眼（推测使用眼动摄像头或眼电电极），每次眨眼都在共享总谱中触发灯光和声音事件。
works.exercise_en: Detect blinks with MediaPipe Face Mesh for three students sitting in a row and flash a lamp and play a click for each one, then compose a one-minute piece only with blinks. Twist: forbid blinking for 20 seconds and let the room hear the release.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 检测坐成一排的三位学生的眨眼，每眨一次就闪一下灯、响一声，只用眨眼创作一段一分钟的作品；变体：规定 20 秒不许眨眼，让全场听见憋住之后的释放。

video.video_title: BLINK

works.title: BOTHER
works.description: In a durational dance installation, audience members use a web interface to trigger actions on devices worn by the dancer, influencing her well-being positively or negatively and watching the effect in front of them.
works.description_zh: 在一场长时间的舞蹈装置中，观众通过网页界面触发舞者身上设备的动作，正面或负面地影响她的状态，并当场看到结果。
works.idea_en: Give strangers a remote control over a dancer and watch how they choose to use it.
works.idea_zh: 把一个舞者的“遥控器”交给陌生人，看他们如何使用。
works.technique: A web page sends audience commands over the network to microcontroller-driven wearables (likely vibration, light or moving elements) on the dancer's body.
works.technique_zh: 网页把观众的指令通过网络发送给舞者身上由微控制器驱动的可穿戴设备（可能是振动、灯光或可动部件）。
works.exercise_en: Build a web page with two buttons, 'care' and 'bother', that trigger a vibration motor or LED on a classmate's wrist via an ESP32 while they improvise. Twist: show the audience how many people pressed each button.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个只有“关心”和“打扰”两个按钮的网页，通过 ESP32 触发同学手腕上的振动马达或 LED，同时让他即兴表演；变体：向观众显示每个按钮被按了多少次。

video.video_title: BOTHER by Clemence Debaig

works.title: Back to the Moon AR
works.description: An AR version of the Emmy-nominated Google Spotlight Story about Georges Méliès, letting the animated film play out on your table.
works.idea_zh: 梅里爱的月球奇遇在桌面上AR重演

video.video_title: Back to the Moon AR | Fx Goby | Nexus Studios

works.technique: ARCore plane detection places an animated diorama on a tabletop, with the viewer's phone movement acting as the camera for a pre-authored real-time story.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌面上用 AR 搭一个 30 秒的小剧场（如一段经典默片场景），观众移动手机当镜头；变体：只有从某个特定角度看，隐藏的情节才会显现。
works.description_zh: 曾获艾美奖提名的 Google Spotlight Story 讲述了 Georges Méliès 的故事，这是它的 AR 版本，让整部动画短片在你的桌面上上演。
works.idea_en: Méliès's trip to the moon plays out again on your tabletop in AR.
works.technique_zh: ARCore 平面检测把一个动画立体场景放到桌面上，观众移动手机就相当于操控摄影机，观看一段预先编排的实时故事。
works.exercise_en: Build a 30-second tabletop theater in AR (for example, a scene from a classic silent film) where the audience moves the phone as the camera. Twist: a hidden plot point is revealed only from one specific angle.

works.title: Behind the Walls
works.description: At Rockefeller Center in New York, a 12-metre white head of a young woman covers her eyes with her hands, a comment on our choice not to see what is around us.
works.description_zh: 在纽约洛克菲勒中心，一个 12 米高的年轻女性白色头像用双手捂住眼睛，暗指我们选择对周围视而不见。
works.idea_en: A giant figure that refuses to look makes viewers aware of their own looking, a strong idea for gaze-aware AR.
works.idea_zh: 一个拒绝观看的巨大形象让观众意识到自己的观看，这是感知视线的 AR 的有力创意。
works.technique: A scanned head and hands are elongated and fabricated in resin with marble dust, mounted in a plaza.
works.technique_zh: 扫描的头部与双手被拉长后用树脂和大理石粉制作，安装在广场上。
works.exercise_en: Place a giant AR head that covers its eyes whenever the user points the camera straight at it and peeks when the camera looks away. Twist: invite two users, so the head only uncovers its eyes when both look away.
works.exercise_zh: 放置一个巨大的 AR 头像：当用户把相机正对它时它捂住眼睛，相机移开时它偷看；变体：邀请两位用户，只有两人都移开视线时它才露出眼睛。

video.video_title: Behind the Walls by Jaume Plensa at Rockefeller Center

works.title: Between Light
works.description: In the Gothic Oude Kerk in Amsterdam, a long, gently sagging line of light hangs in the empty nave and, over a 24-minute sequence, slowly rises and falls like a sunrise and sunset.
works.description_zh: 在阿姆斯特丹哥特式的 Oude Kerk 里，一条微微下垂的长光线悬在空旷的中殿中，在 24 分钟的循环里缓缓升起又落下，犹如日出日落。
works.idea_en: A single line of light becomes a horizon that rises and sets inside a church.
works.idea_zh: 一条光线化作地平线，在教堂里升起又落下。
works.technique: A suspended LED line on motorised winches is choreographed in height and brightness on a slow 24-minute cycle.
works.technique_zh: 悬挂的 LED 光条装在电动绞盘上，高度和亮度按 24 分钟的缓慢周期编排。
works.exercise_en: In phone AR, place a thin glowing line across a real room and animate it to rise and fall over five minutes while students sit and watch. Twist: tie the height of the line to the real sun's elevation at that moment.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 在真实房间里横放一条细细的发光线，让它在五分钟内缓缓升起再落下，学生坐着观看；变体：把光线的高度绑定到此刻真实太阳的高度角。

video.video_title: Between Light, Oude Kerk Amsterdam 2019

works.title: Beyond Walls
works.description: Started under the Eiffel Tower in 2019, Beyond Walls is a chain of giant painted hands clasping each other on grass across cities worldwide (Paris, Geneva, Berlin, Istanbul, Cape Town and more), each visible from the air.
works.description_zh: 2019 年从埃菲尔铁塔下开始，《Beyond Walls》是一条由巨大的相握双手组成、延伸至世界各地城市草地上的链条（巴黎、日内瓦、柏林、伊斯坦布尔、开普敦等），每一幅都能从空中看见。
works.idea_en: One motif repeated city by city builds a world-spanning chain, a model for a location AR campaign where each site adds a link.
works.idea_zh: 同一个图案一城接一城地重复，组成一条跨越世界的链条，是每个地点添加一环的位置 AR 活动的范本。
works.technique: Hands are sprayed on grass with a homemade biodegradable paint (chalk, charcoal, milk proteins), working from a grid drawn on the ground.
works.technique_zh: 双手图案用自制可降解颜料（粉笔、木炭、牛奶蛋白）喷在草地上，依据地面上画出的网格施工。
works.exercise_en: Create an AR 'hand' that any user can place at their location, anchored so that it links to the nearest other hand on a shared world map. Twist: the chain only glows when it forms an unbroken line across a whole city.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一只任何用户都能在自己所在地放置的 AR“手”，锚定后与共享世界地图上最近的另一只手相连；变体：只有当链条在一座城市中连成不间断的线时才会发光。

video.video_title: Beyond Walls Project

salient.why_en: Giant painted hands clasp each other on grass, city after city, forming a chain around the world.
salient.why_zh: 巨大的手在一座又一座城市的草地上彼此相握，连成一条环绕世界的链。

works.title: Beyond Walls, Champ de Mars
works.description: Under the Eiffel Tower, Saype painted a 600-metre chain of joined hands on the lawns of the Champ de Mars, the first step of Beyond Walls.
works.description_zh: 在埃菲尔铁塔下，Saype 在战神广场的草坪上画出一条 600 米长、手手相握的链条，这是《Beyond Walls》的第一步。
works.idea_en: Placing the image under a famous viewpoint (the Eiffel Tower) guarantees an audience from above, a tactic for AR content anchored near lookouts.
works.idea_zh: 把图像放在著名观景点（埃菲尔铁塔）下方，保证了来自上方的观众，这是在观景台附近锚定 AR 内容的策略。
works.technique: Paint was sprayed over several days across the lawn from a gridded plan, readable from the tower's viewing decks.
works.technique_zh: 按照网格方案，几天内在草坪上完成喷绘，从铁塔观景台上可以看清。
works.exercise_en: Find the highest publicly accessible point on campus and design an AR image on the ground below that only makes sense from there. Twist: add a matching small image at ground level that points people up to the lookout.
works.exercise_zh: 找到校园里公众可到达的最高点，设计一幅只有从那里俯看才有意义的地面 AR 图像；变体：在地面加一幅配套的小图，引导人们登上观景点。

video.video_title: Giant Graffiti on the Grass below Paris' Eiffel Tower | Streetart by Saype | Say Peace

works.title: Bimba y Lola x Ines Alpha filter
works.description: An Instagram face filter for the Bimba y Lola Fall/Winter 2019 collection that covers the face in Alpha's glossy sculptural 3D makeup.
works.idea_zh: 把品牌时装季的视觉变成人人可戴的3D数字妆容滤镜。

video.video_title: Serve Face With the Bimba Y Lola X Ines Alpha Face Filter

works.technique: Spark AR face tracking attaches glossy 3D makeup meshes to the face, with materials art-directed to match a fashion collection's palette.
works.exercise_zh: 从一件服装或一张海报中提取配色，做一个与之呼应的人脸 AR 滤镜；变体：滤镜根据镜头中服装颜色自动改变。
works.description_zh: 为 Bimba y Lola 2019 秋冬系列打造的 Instagram 人脸滤镜，用 Alpha 标志性的光泽雕塑感 3D 妆容覆盖整张脸。
works.idea_en: Turn a fashion season's look into 3D digital makeup anyone can wear as a filter.
works.technique_zh: Spark AR 人脸追踪把有光泽的 3D 妆容网格附着在脸上，材质经过美术调校，与时装系列的色调相呼应。
works.exercise_en: Pull a color palette from a garment or poster and build a face AR filter that echoes it. Twist: the filter changes automatically to match the colors of clothing in the shot.

works.title: Björk Cornucopia: Body Memory (stage visuals)
works.description: Stage visuals for 'Body Memory' in Björk's Cornucopia tour: organic, fungal and body-like forms grow and dissolve on the huge screens and curtains around the singer, extending the costumes and choreography into the stage space.
works.description_zh: 为 Björk Cornucopia 巡演中《Body Memory》创作的舞台视觉：有机的、菌类般的、身体般的形态在歌手周围巨大的屏幕和幕布上生长又消散，把服装和编舞延伸到整个舞台空间。
works.idea_en: Visuals that look like they grow out of the performer's body blur the line between costume and environment, which is the natural home of performance AR.
works.idea_zh: 看起来像从表演者身体里长出来的视觉，模糊了服装与环境的界限，而这正是演出类 AR 最自然的位置。
works.technique: Pre-rendered and likely partly generative 3D animations of organic forms are projected onto layered stage curtains and screens and timed to the music.
works.technique_zh: 预渲染、推测部分为生成式的有机形态三维动画，被投影到多层舞台幕布和屏幕上，并与音乐同步。
works.exercise_en: Make a Lens Studio or Effect House body-tracking lens where organic tendrils grow from a singer's shoulders and hands as they sing. Twist: the tendrils grow faster with louder voice.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 Effect House 的身体追踪做一个滤镜，让有机的触须随着歌手唱歌从肩膀和手上长出来；变体：声音越大，触须长得越快。

video.video_title: Stage visuals of Björk’s Cornucopia tour, for the wonderful song “Body Memory”

works.title: Bounce (elasticity test)
works.description: Dancer Roos van Berkel jumps on a trampoline whose sensors measure the elastic quality of her body, and the data turn the studio into a living, elastic room of sound and light.
works.description_zh: 舞者 Roos van Berkel 在蹦床上跳跃，传感器测量她身体的弹性，这些数据把工作室变成一个会伸缩、有生命的声光房间。
works.idea_en: Measure how a body bounces and let the whole room bounce with it.
works.idea_zh: 测量一个身体如何弹跳，让整个房间随之弹跳。
works.technique: Distance sensors designed by physicist Tom Bergman track the trampoline surface with high precision, and the data drive sound by Ivo Bol and light by Tränkle.
works.technique_zh: 物理学家 Tom Bergman 设计的距离传感器高精度追踪蹦床表面，数据驱动 Ivo Bol 的声音和 Tränkle 的灯光。
works.exercise_en: Place a phone under a mini-trampoline or on a springy board and use its accelerometer (via a web app) to map each bounce to a light flash and a pitch. Twist: map the time spent in the air, not the impact.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机放在迷你蹦床下或弹性板上，用网页应用读取加速度计，把每次弹跳映射为一次闪光和一个音高；变体：映射在空中停留的时间，而不是落地的冲击。

video.video_title: Elasticity test 18.06.2019

works.title: Bringing Tattoos to Life Using AR
works.description: Pointing the phone at people's tattoos animates them and plays the personal story behind each design.
works.idea_zh: 对准纹身，纹身图案动起来并讲出背后的故事。

video.video_title: Bringing Tattoos to Life Using AR

works.technique: Each tattoo is registered as an ARKit reference image, and when detected an animated overlay and audio clip are played on the tracked image anchor.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 图像追踪识别三张手绘贴纸，贴在手臂上时播放对应的动画和一段录音；变体：让每张贴纸讲述贴纸主人自己的一段故事。
works.description_zh: 把手机对准人们身上的纹身，纹身就会动起来，并讲出每个图案背后的个人故事。
works.idea_en: Point at a tattoo and it comes alive and tells the story behind it.
works.technique_zh: 每个纹身都注册为 ARKit 参考图像，检测到后在被追踪的图像锚点上播放动画叠加层和音频片段。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation image tracking to recognize three hand-drawn stickers, playing the matching animation and a voice recording when they are stuck on an arm. Twist: each sticker tells a story from its owner's own life.

salient.why_en: Point at a tattoo and it animates and tells the personal story behind it.
salient.why_zh: 对准一个纹身，它就动起来，讲出纹身背后的个人故事。

works.title: Brixel Mirror
works.description: Hundreds of mirrored rotating bricks turn to reflect or hide light, forming a moving image of the viewer standing in front.
works.description_zh: 数百块镜面旋转砖块转动，反射或遮蔽光线，拼出站在面前的观众的动态影像。
works.idea_en: A mirror made of real mirrors, each one choosing where to reflect, blends physical and computed reflection — like AR on a real surface.
works.idea_zh: 由真实镜子组成、每块都在“选择”反射方向的镜子，把物理反射与计算结合起来——就像在真实表面上的 AR。
works.technique: Each Brixel is a motor-driven rotating element with mirrored faces; the camera image is mapped to rotation angles per brick.
works.technique_zh: 每个 Brixel 都是一块由电机驱动、带镜面的旋转单元；摄像头图像被映射为每块砖的旋转角度。
works.exercise_en: Overlay a grid of virtual mirrored tiles on a real wall in AR that turn to reflect the environment map where the viewer's body is. Twist: let each tile hold the reflection of a different moment in time.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中于真实墙面上叠加一组虚拟镜面瓦片，在观众身体所在处转动以反射环境贴图。变体：让每块瓦片映出不同时刻的画面。

video.video_title: Brixel Mirror - Kinetic Art Installation

works.title: Building Bridges
works.description: For the 2019 Venice Biennale, six pairs of giant hands arch over the water of the Arsenale basin to meet, each pair standing for a universal value such as friendship, wisdom or hope.
works.description_zh: 为 2019 年威尼斯双年展，六对巨手在军械库水池上方拱起相握，每一对代表一种普世价值，如友谊、智慧或希望。
works.idea_en: Hands reaching across water to meet make a bridge out of a gesture, a model for shared AR interactions between two sides of a space.
works.idea_zh: 隔水伸出、在中间相握的手用一个手势搭起了桥，是空间两侧之间共享 AR 互动的范本。
works.technique: Six pairs of hands, 15 metres tall, were cast in sections and installed on foundations on both sides of the basin.
works.technique_zh: 六对 15 米高的手分段浇筑，安装在水池两侧的基础上。
works.exercise_en: Let two users on opposite sides of a courtyard each reach out with tracked hands; their giant AR hands meet in the middle only when both reach at the same time. Twist: each pair of hands is labelled with a value the users choose together.
works.exercise_zh: 让庭院两侧的两位用户各自用被追踪的手向前伸出；只有两人同时伸手时，他们的巨型 AR 手才会在中间相握；变体：每对手都标注一个由两位用户共同选择的价值。

video.video_title: "BUILDING BRIDGES" - VENICE ART BIENNALE 2019

works.title: Butterflies Lens for Spectacles 3
works.description: Filmed through Snap Spectacles 3 with director Karen X Cheng, huge hand-drawn butterflies flap around a person in a park and over a bridge, placed in depth in the captured scene.
works.description_zh: 通过 Snap Spectacles 3 拍摄，与导演 Karen X Cheng 合作：巨大的手绘蝴蝶围着公园里的人飞舞，又掠过一座桥，按深度摆放在拍下的场景中。
works.idea_en: Fill your own world with oversized, hand-drawn creatures to show how you feel inside it.
works.idea_zh: 让超大的手绘生物飞满你的世界，表达你在其中的感受。
works.technique: Spectacles 3's two cameras capture depth, and a Lens Studio lens likely uses that depth to place and occlude animated 2D butterfly sprites in 3D around the subject.
works.technique_zh: Spectacles 3 的双摄像头能采集深度，Lens Studio 镜头很可能借助深度把 2D 蝴蝶动画按前后层次摆放并产生遮挡。
works.exercise_en: Draw one animal on paper, scan it, and animate it as a flock in an AR scene (Lens Studio or Reality Composer) around a classmate. Twist: make the flock scatter when the person moves quickly.
works.exercise_zh: 在纸上画一种动物，扫描后在 AR 场景（Lens Studio 或 Reality Composer）里做成一群，围着同学飞。变体：人一快速移动，群体就四散飞开。

video.video_title:
Director Karen X worked with AR artist, Clara Bacou, to show how easy it can be to make a little magic with the right person.

Featuring @karenxcheng’s perspective and @clarabacou’s imagination. Captu

works.title: CarDrop-V
works.description: Phone viewers watch a highly detailed virtual car fall from the sky and smash into the real ground in slow motion.
works.idea_zh: 一辆虚拟汽车从天而降，慢动作砸在你面前的真实地面
works.technique: Mobile AR with ground-plane detection triggers a physics-driven slow-motion drop and impact animation of a car model.
works.exercise_zh: 用Reality Composer的物理功能让一个大物体从空中落到地面并慢放；变化：落地点由观众点击选定，并留下永久的“坑”。

video.video_title: CarDrop-V

works.description_zh: 观众透过手机，看着一辆细节极其丰富的虚拟汽车从天而降，以慢动作砸在真实地面上。
works.idea_en: A virtual car falls from the sky and smashes into the real ground in front of you in slow motion.
works.technique_zh: 基于地面平面检测的手机 AR 触发物理驱动的慢动作下落，并播放汽车模型的撞击动画。
works.exercise_en: Use Reality Composer's physics to drop a large object from the air onto the ground in slow motion. Twist: the viewer taps to choose the landing spot, and it leaves a permanent crater.

works.title: Changdeok ARirang
works.description: A location-based AR tour of Seoul's Changdeokgung palace with animated guides and historical stories anchored to the grounds.
works.idea_zh: 在昌德宫里由AR角色讲述历史

video.video_title: Changdeok ARirang | Nexus Studios

works.technique: Location-based AR with GPS plus local plane detection (and 5G streaming of heavy assets) anchors animated guides and scenes at specific palace locations.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里选三个有故事的地点，用 WebAR 分别放一个讲述该地点过去的动画角色，串成一段导览；变体：导览角色之间互相矛盾，让观众自己判断哪个版本是真的。
works.description_zh: 在首尔昌德宫进行的基于位置的 AR 导览，动画向导和历史故事锚定在宫苑各处。
works.idea_en: AR characters tell the history of Changdeokgung Palace on site.
works.technique_zh: 结合 GPS 与局部平面检测的位置 AR（大体量素材通过 5G 串流），把动画向导和场景锚定在宫内的特定地点。
works.exercise_en: Pick three campus spots with a story and use WebAR to place an animated character at each one telling its past, linked into a guided tour. Twist: the guides contradict each other, and visitors must decide which version is true.

works.title: Clio's Cosmic Quest
works.description: A space-adventure story on Wonderscope staged life-size in the child's room; like all Wonderscope stories, the child advances it by reading characters' lines aloud.
works.idea_zh: 在自己房间里展开一场需要开口对话的太空冒险。

video.video_title: New on Wonderscope: Clio's Cosmic Quest

works.technique: Story scenes are staged in room-scale world coordinates, and voice-recognition gates plus walking prompts pace the narrative.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个需要观众走到房间另一侧才能看到下一幕的 AR 故事；变体：观众必须说出某个星球的名字才能“起飞”。
works.description_zh: Wonderscope 上的一个太空冒险故事，以真人尺寸在孩子的房间里展开。和所有 Wonderscope 故事一样，孩子要大声念出角色的台词，才能推动剧情。
works.idea_en: A space adventure unfolds in your own room, and you have to speak up to move it along.
works.technique_zh: 故事场景布置在房间尺度的世界坐标中，由语音识别关卡和走动提示控制叙事节奏。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR story where viewers must walk to the other side of the room to see the next scene. Twist: viewers must say the name of a planet to 'take off'.

works.title: Coding Adventure: Boids
works.description: A flock of birds swirls through space, splitting around obstacles and regrouping, driven only by three local rules.
works.description_zh: 一群鸟在空中盘旋，遇到障碍分开再重新聚拢，全部只由三条局部规则驱动。
works.idea_en: Separation, alignment and cohesion are enough to make a flock.
works.idea_zh: 分离、对齐、聚合三条规则就足以形成鸟群。
works.technique: Each boid steers by separation, alignment and cohesion with neighbours computed in a compute shader, and avoids obstacles by casting rays along points of a golden-spiral sphere.
works.technique_zh: 每只鸟根据计算着色器算出的邻居做分离、对齐、聚合，并沿黄金螺旋球面上的方向发射射线来避开障碍。
works.exercise_en: Release a flock of boids in phone AR that uses the LiDAR mesh as obstacles, so birds fly around real furniture. Twist: the flock is attracted to the phone and scatters when you shake it.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中放出一群鸟，用 LiDAR 网格作为障碍，让鸟绕着真实家具飞。变体：鸟群会被手机吸引，一摇手机就四散。

video.video_title: Coding Adventure: Boids

works.title: Coding Adventure: Clouds
works.description: Soft volumetric clouds drift through the sky and light scatters through them, controlled live from 3D noise settings.
works.description_zh: 柔和的体积云在天空中飘动，光线在云中散射，可以实时调整三维噪声参数来控制云。
works.idea_en: Clouds are noise that light travels through.
works.idea_zh: 云就是光线穿过的一团噪声。
works.technique: A post-process raymarches a box volume, samples tiled 3D Worley and Perlin noise for density, and accumulates light with Beer's law and a phase function.
works.technique_zh: 后期处理在一个盒体内做光线步进，用平铺的三维 Worley 和 Perlin 噪声采样密度，再用 Beer 定律和相位函数累积光照。
works.exercise_en: Fill a room-sized AR box with raymarched clouds on a phone or HoloKit so students walk through them. Twist: the clouds thicken where the room is darkest in the camera image.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机或 HoloKit 上用光线步进云填满一个房间大小的 AR 盒子，让学生从云中走过。变体：相机画面里越暗的地方云越浓。

video.video_title: Coding Adventure: Clouds

works.title: Coding Adventure: Hydraulic Erosion
works.description: A rough noise terrain is weathered by hundreds of thousands of raindrops until it shows realistic valleys, ridges and river channels.
works.description_zh: 一片粗糙的噪声地形被几十万颗雨滴冲刷，最终出现逼真的山谷、山脊和河道。
works.idea_en: Let simulated rain, not an artist, carve the landscape.
works.idea_zh: 让模拟的雨而不是美术来雕刻地貌。
works.technique: Each droplet is simulated as a particle that follows the heightmap gradient, picks up and deposits sediment based on speed and capacity, and evaporates.
works.technique_zh: 每颗雨滴被模拟成一个粒子，沿高度图梯度流动，根据速度和携沙量带走或沉积泥沙，并逐渐蒸发。
works.exercise_en: Place a small terrain on a real table in AR and let students 'rain' on it by holding the phone above it until rivers form. Twist: the terrain uses a LiDAR scan of a crumpled paper sheet as its start.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一小块地形放在真实桌上，学生把手机举在上方就能对它下雨，直到出现河流。变体：用 LiDAR 扫描一张揉皱的纸作为初始地形。

video.video_title: Coding Adventure: Hydraulic Erosion

works.title: Coding Adventure: Marching Cubes
works.description: An endless cave and planet terrain is generated from 3D noise and turned into smooth meshes that the player can dig into.
works.description_zh: 由三维噪声生成的无尽洞穴和星球地形被转成光滑网格，玩家可以往里挖。
works.idea_en: Turn a field of numbers into a surface you can carve.
works.idea_zh: 把一片数值场变成可以雕刻的表面。
works.technique: Density values from noise are sampled on a grid in a compute shader, and the marching-cubes lookup table turns each cell into triangles along the iso-surface.
works.technique_zh: 在计算着色器中按网格采样噪声密度值，再用 Marching Cubes 查找表把每个单元沿等值面转成三角形。
works.exercise_en: Generate a marching-cubes blob on a real table in phone AR and let students carve it by tapping. Twist: carving adds material somewhere else so the total volume stays the same.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中于真实桌面上生成一个 Marching Cubes 团块，让学生点击雕刻。变体：挖掉的材料会在别处长出来，总体积不变。

video.video_title: Coding Adventure: Marching Cubes

works.title: Coding Adventure: Ray Marching
works.description: Shapes melt into each other, a Mandelbulb fractal unfolds, and objects cut holes into one another, all rendered from distance functions.
works.description_zh: 形体彼此融化，Mandelbulb 分形不断展开，物体相互挖洞，全部由距离函数渲染。
works.idea_en: Describe shapes as distance formulas and you get smooth blends and infinite fractals for free.
works.idea_zh: 把形状写成距离公式，平滑融合和无限分形就都顺手而来。
works.technique: A compute shader marches rays through signed distance functions, combining primitives with union, subtraction and smooth-min, and renders a Mandelbulb distance estimator.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器沿射线在有符号距离函数中步进，用并集、差集和 smooth-min 组合基本形体，并渲染 Mandelbulb 距离估计。
works.exercise_en: Place a raymarched Mandelbulb hovering above a real table in phone AR and let pinch gestures change its power. Twist: the fractal grows more detailed the closer you walk.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中让一个光线步进的 Mandelbulb 悬浮在真实桌面上方，用捏合手势改变它的指数。变体：走得越近，分形细节越多。

video.video_title: Coding Adventure: Ray Marching

works.title: Context-Aware Online Adaptation of MR Interfaces
works.description: An optimizer continuously decides which virtual apps to show, where and how detailed, based on the user's current task and cognitive load.
works.idea_zh: MR界面像懂你一样，根据你正在做什么自动决定显示多少、放在哪。

video.video_title: Context-Aware Online Adaptation of Mixed Reality Interfaces

works.technique: An integer linear program decides for each app whether it is shown, where it is placed and at what level of detail, given estimated cognitive load from the task and a utility model, and re-solves as context changes.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 里放 5 个虚拟信息面板（时间、消息、天气、导航、音乐），写一个简单规则或打分函数，根据用户是否在走动、说话或打字自动隐藏或缩小面板；变体：让用户可以“贿赂”系统保留某个面板，讨论谁拥有控制权。
works.description_zh: 一个优化器根据用户当前的任务和认知负荷，持续决定显示哪些虚拟应用、放在哪里、展示多少细节。
works.idea_en: An MR interface that seems to read you, deciding how much to show and where based on what you are doing.
works.technique_zh: 整数线性规划根据由任务估算的认知负荷和效用模型，为每个应用决定是否显示、放在何处以及以何种细节层级呈现，并在情境变化时重新求解。
works.exercise_en: Place five virtual info panels (time, messages, weather, navigation, music) in phone AR and write a simple rule or scoring function that hides or shrinks them depending on whether the user is walking, talking or typing. Twist: let the user 'bribe' the system to keep a panel, and discuss who holds control.

works.title: Coral Greenhouse
works.description: At the Museum of Underwater Art on the Great Barrier Reef, a steel greenhouse on the sea floor contains figures of students tending coral, designed as a nursery for reef life.
works.description_zh: 在大堡礁的水下艺术博物馆，一座海底钢结构温室中有学生照料珊瑚的人像，被设计为珊瑚礁生物的育苗场。
works.idea_en: A human-made structure designed to be colonised by life flips the relation between architecture and nature, a thought for AR spaces that host real processes.
works.idea_zh: 一个为了被生命占据而设计的人造结构，颠倒了建筑与自然的关系，这为承载真实过程的 AR 空间提供了思考。
works.technique: A marine-grade stainless steel and cement frame was sunk at John Brewer Reef, with planting trays for coral fragments.
works.technique_zh: 海洋级不锈钢与水泥框架沉放在 John Brewer 礁，设有供珊瑚碎片生长的种植托盘。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR greenhouse frame over a real garden bed or pot plant and log real observations (height, leaves) as notes attached to it. Twist: the virtual frame fills in with glass panels as the real plant grows.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实的花坛或盆栽上放一个 AR 温室框架，并把真实观察（高度、叶子数）作为附注记录在上面；变体：随着真实植物生长，虚拟框架逐渐装上玻璃板。

video.video_title: Coral Greenhouse Artist Jason deCaires Taylor / MOUA / Museum of Underwater Art

works.title: Crystal Caustics
works.description: A rotating crystal throws sharp, sparkling caustic light patterns onto the surfaces around it in real time.
works.description_zh: 一颗旋转的水晶在周围表面上实时投下锐利、闪烁的焦散光斑。
works.idea_en: Bake the expensive physics once, then replay it cheaply as light.
works.idea_zh: 把昂贵的物理计算只做一次，之后用光来低成本地重放。
works.technique: Caustics are pre-rendered with photon mapping into cubemaps for a set of light directions around a bounding icosahedron, and at runtime the point-light cookie blends the nearest cubemaps using barycentric weights of the light direction.
works.technique_zh: 先用光子映射为包围二十面体周围的一组光照方向预渲染焦散立方体贴图，运行时根据光线方向的重心坐标权重，在点光源 cookie 中混合最近的几张贴图。
works.exercise_en: Place a virtual gem on a real table with AR Foundation and project its caustic cookie onto the detected plane, using the AR light estimation direction as the light. Twist: let the user rotate the gem with a pinch so the caustics dance.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 把一颗虚拟宝石放到真实桌面上，以 AR 光照估计的方向作为光源，把焦散 cookie 投射到检测到的平面上。变体：让用户用双指旋转宝石，让焦散光斑跳动起来。

video.video_title: Caustics in Unity

works.title: Cubee
works.description: Dancer Maki Yokoyama appears to build, open and step through projected cubes, turning flat graphics into rooms she can enter.
works.description_zh: 舞者横山真希看起来在搭建、打开并穿过投影出的立方体，把平面图形变成她能走进去的房间。
works.idea_en: A flat screen can suggest depth when the body pretends to enter it, a cheap trick for making AR portals feel deep.
works.idea_zh: 身体假装走进屏幕时，平面也能显出深度，这是让 AR 传送门显得有纵深的廉价技巧。
works.technique: Perspective-drawn cube animation is projected behind the dancer and her movement is choreographed to match the implied depth.
works.technique_zh: 按透视绘制的立方体动画投在舞者身后，她的动作经过编排来配合画面暗示的深度。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR cube portal on the floor and film a classmate stepping 'into' it, using people occlusion so the cube edges pass in front of and behind them. Twist: the cube changes into a different room each time someone enters.
works.exercise_zh: 在地上放一个 AR 立方体传送门，拍同学“走进”去，用人物遮挡让立方体的边在他前后穿过；变体：每次有人进入，立方体就变成另一个房间。

video.video_title: enra " Cubee "

works.title: D.I.S.P.L.A.Y.E.D + Audio AR
works.description: Heidi Latsky Dance and Google Creative Lab added position-based audio AR to a living-sculpture dance performance, so visitors hear dancers' voices and stories as they walk up to each performer.
works.idea_zh: 观众走近舞者时，耳中响起专属于该舞者的空间声音叙事。

video.video_title: DISPLAYED + Audio AR: an experiment from Google's Creative Lab

works.technique: Indoor positioning estimates the visitor's location, and distance to each performer's position controls the volume of their audio track.
works.exercise_zh: 在教室里布置 4 个“声音点”，根据手机与每个点的距离调整对应音频的音量，形成可走动的声音地图；变体：声音点对应的是同学讲述的一段个人故事。
works.description_zh: Heidi Latsky Dance 与 Google Creative Lab 为一场“活雕塑”舞蹈表演加入了基于位置的音频 AR：观众走近每位舞者时，会听到他们的声音和故事。
works.idea_en: As you approach a dancer, a spatial audio story belonging only to that dancer plays in your ears.
works.technique_zh: 室内定位估算观众所在的位置，再根据观众与每位表演者之间的距离控制其音轨的音量。
works.exercise_en: Set up four 'sound spots' in the classroom and adjust each spot's audio volume by the phone's distance to it, creating a walkable sound map. Twist: each sound spot plays a personal story told by a classmate.

works.title: Desk weather diorama
works.description: A small 3D mountain diorama showing Pittsburgh's temperature and a three-day forecast sits on his real desk; he flips through days with his bare hand in passthrough AR.
works.description_zh: 一个小小的 3D 山体沙盘放在他真实的书桌上，显示匹兹堡的气温和三天预报；他在透视 AR 里徒手翻看每天的天气。
works.idea_en: Turn a data widget into a tiny physical-feeling landscape on your desk.
works.idea_zh: 把数据小组件变成桌面上一块有实体感的小景观。
works.technique: ZED Mini stereo passthrough on an Oculus Rift gives depth-correct AR, with Leap Motion hands pressing the day buttons on a Unity diorama.
works.technique_zh: 在 Oculus Rift 上用 ZED Mini 双目透视获得深度正确的 AR，Leap Motion 的手去按 Unity 沙盘上的日期按钮。
works.exercise_en: Design a tabletop AR diorama that visualizes one live data feed (weather, bus times, air quality). Twist: the terrain itself must change shape with the data.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个桌面 AR 沙盘，可视化一条实时数据（天气、公交时刻、空气质量）。变体：地形本身要随着数据改变形状。

video.video_title: Experiment with Zed mini + Leap Motion + Oculus Rift @LeapMotion @oculus @Stereolabs3D Please don’t judge on the messy cables 😂 https://t.co/WLcaoei71y

works.title: Digital Supernova
works.description: Generative geometric 'supernovae' are projected onto the Gothic vaults of Rodez Cathedral, turning the ceiling into a slowly exploding digital sky.
works.idea_zh: 把教堂穹顶变成不断爆发的数字超新星
works.technique: Real-time generative geometry is warped to the cathedral's vault surfaces using mapped projection and edge blending.
works.exercise_zh: 躺在地上向天花板投影旋转的生成几何，让大家仰望；变化：用同学的心跳（手机测）控制几何爆发的节奏。

video.video_title: Miguel CHEVALIER Supernova 2019 Notre Dame de Rodez

works.description_zh: 生成式几何“超新星”被投影到罗德兹大教堂的哥特式穹顶上，把天花板变成一片缓缓爆发的数字星空。
works.idea_en: Turn a cathedral vault into a sky of constantly exploding digital supernovae.
works.technique_zh: 通过映射投影和边缘融合，把实时生成的几何图形贴合到大教堂的穹顶表面。
works.exercise_en: Lie on the floor and project rotating generative geometry onto the ceiling for everyone to look up at. Twist: use a classmate's heartbeat (measured with a phone) to set the rhythm of the geometry's bursts.

works.title: Dissolving point-cloud face
works.description: A face captured as a depth image is rebuilt from a million real-time particles that dissolve and drift away.
works.description_zh: 用深度图捕捉的人脸由一百万个实时粒子重建，随后溶解飘散。
works.idea_en: Turn a depth scan of a person into living particles.
works.idea_zh: 把人的深度扫描变成会流动的粒子。
works.technique: The depth image is sampled into a point cache and fed to Unity's GPU Visual Effect Graph, where noise fields dissolve the particles.
works.technique_zh: 把深度图采样成点缓存，送入 Unity 基于 GPU 的 Visual Effect Graph，再用噪声场让粒子溶解。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone's depth or a TrueDepth face capture to spawn particles on a face and blow them away with a voice volume trigger. Twist: the face reforms only when you stay silent.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机深度或 TrueDepth 人脸捕捉在脸上生成粒子，用声音音量把它们吹散。变体：只有保持安静时脸才会重新聚合。

video.video_title: Using @unity3d Visual Effect Graph to dissolve a point-cloud face, and the face is generated from a depth image. #VisualEffectGraph is one of the most incredible tool I've ever used, it's also great f

works.title: Dkvfx: Depthkit volumetric video with VFX Graph
works.description: A dancer recorded with Depthkit plays back in 3D and is re-rendered as particles, lines and Kinect-style effects that can be viewed from any angle.
works.description_zh: 用 Depthkit 录下的舞者以三维形式回放，再被重新渲染成粒子、线条和类似 Kinect 的特效，可以从任意角度观看。
works.idea_en: Recorded volumetric video becomes raw material for particle effects.
works.idea_zh: 录好的体积视频，可以当作粒子特效的原材料。
works.technique: The Depthkit combined-per-pixel video (color plus encoded depth) is decoded in a shader into position and color maps, which VFX Graph uses as a point source.
works.technique_zh: 在着色器里解码 Depthkit 的彩色加深度合成视频，得到位置贴图和颜色贴图，再交给 VFX Graph 当作点的来源。
works.exercise_en: Record a 10-second clip of a friend with a depth-capable phone app (Record3D or a Depthkit export), play it in Unity as a point source, then place the result on a table with AR Foundation. Twist: let the figure dissolve into particles as you walk closer.
works.exercise_zh: 用能录深度的手机应用（Record3D 或 Depthkit 导出）给朋友录 10 秒视频，在 Unity 里作为点源播放，再用 AR Foundation 放到桌面上。变体：你走得越近，人像越快散成粒子。

video.video_title: Depthkit + Unity VFX Graph. It also can do usual Kinect-ish effects. https://t.co/7tpQRBlhTl

works.title: DoodleLens
works.description: Point your phone at a doodle on paper and it is lifted off the page into AR, inspired by an old camcorder chroma feature; later updates animate doodles like flipbooks and turn them into 3D models.
works.idea_zh: 对着纸上的涂鸦一拍，它就'撕'下来变成 AR 贴纸活过来。

video.video_title: I made a little app that lets you bring your doodles into AR, inspired by that old camcorder feature! https://t.co/D7fVQxFry5

works.technique: The camera image is thresholded to extract dark ink strokes into a transparent texture, which is placed on a billboard anchored in AR space.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 或 Lens Studio 把白纸上的涂鸦抠成透明贴图并放到 AR 里；加一个变化：连续拍四张涂鸦就组成一段逐帧动画。
works.description_zh: 把手机对准纸上的涂鸦，它就会从纸面上被“揭”下来进入 AR。灵感来自老式摄像机的色键功能；后来的更新还能让涂鸦像翻页书一样动起来，或变成 3D 模型。
works.idea_en: Snap a doodle on paper and it peels off the page as a living AR sticker.
works.technique_zh: 对相机画面做阈值处理，把深色墨线提取成透明纹理，再放到锚定在 AR 空间中的公告板上。
works.exercise_en: Use p5.js or Lens Studio to cut a doodle on white paper into a transparent texture and place it in AR. Twist: four doodles captured in a row form a frame-by-frame animation.

salient.why_en: A doodle on paper peels off the page and comes alive in the room.
salient.why_zh: 纸上的涂鸦从纸面上揭下来，在房间里活了过来。

works.title: DoodleLens flipbook animation
works.description: A series of doodles captured one after another plays back as a looping flipbook animation standing in the real world.
works.idea_zh: 把一叠涂鸦变成站在现实里的翻页动画。

video.video_title: you can now animate your doodles in AR just like an old flip book! https://t.co/5wdZQgASsj

works.technique: Each captured doodle becomes a frame in a sprite sequence that cycles on an AR-anchored quad.
works.exercise_zh: 让每位同学画一帧，拼成一段全班的逐帧动画放进 AR 教室；加一个变化：观众走近时播放速度变快。
works.description_zh: 一张接一张拍下的涂鸦，会作为循环播放的翻页动画立在真实世界里。
works.idea_en: Turn a stack of doodles into a flipbook animation standing in the real world.
works.technique_zh: 每张拍下的涂鸦都成为精灵序列中的一帧，在锚定于 AR 的四边形上循环播放。
works.exercise_en: Have each student draw one frame and combine them into a whole-class frame-by-frame animation placed in the AR classroom. Twist: playback speeds up as viewers get closer.

works.title: Doodles into 3D models
works.description: A flat drawing is extruded into a chunky 3D object that can be placed and walked around in AR.
works.idea_zh: 把平面涂鸦'挤出'成可以绕着看的 3D 物体。

video.video_title: you can now turn your doodles into 3D models, coming to the next doodlelens update! https://t.co/ll40OOUwHE

works.technique: The extracted doodle outline is triangulated and extruded into a mesh with the drawing as its front texture (likely contour extrusion).
works.exercise_zh: 在 Blender 或 three.js 里把一张手绘轮廓 SVG 挤出成 3D 并导入 AR；加一个变化：挤出厚度由画的颜色深浅决定。
works.description_zh: 一幅平面画被挤出成一个厚实的 3D 物体，可以放进 AR 并绕着它走动观看。
works.idea_en: Extrude a flat doodle into a 3D object you can walk around.
works.technique_zh: 对提取出的涂鸦轮廓进行三角剖分并挤出成网格，正面贴上原画作为纹理（大概率是轮廓挤出）。
works.exercise_en: Extrude a hand-drawn outline SVG into 3D in Blender or three.js and bring it into AR. Twist: the extrusion depth depends on how dark the drawing's colors are.

works.title: Doppler sonar vision system for the blind
works.description: A lab from Mann's wearable-computing course: a small sonar unit turns the Doppler shift of moving objects into audible tones, giving a sightless wearer a sense of motion around them.
works.description_zh: Mann 可穿戴计算课程中的实验：一个小型声呐装置把运动物体的多普勒频移转换成可听的声音，让看不见的佩戴者感知周围的运动。
works.idea_en: Hear motion: translate an invisible sensing channel directly into a sense you already have.
works.idea_zh: “听见”运动：把一种看不见的感知通道直接翻译成你已有的感官。
works.technique: An ultrasonic transmitter and receiver feed a homemade lock-in amplifier whose output frequency equals the Doppler shift, which is played through headphones.
works.technique_zh: 超声波发射器和接收器接入自制的锁相放大器，其输出频率等于多普勒频移，并通过耳机播放。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone's camera optical flow to turn the speed of moving things in front of you into pitch, then walk a hallway with eyes closed. Twist: map direction to left and right ears.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机摄像头的光流，把面前物体的运动速度转换成音高，然后闭着眼走一段走廊。变体：把运动方向映射到左右耳。

video.video_title: ECE516 Year 2019's Lab2: Doppler sonar vision system for the blind

works.title: Drawalong AR
works.description: Turns a YouTube drawing tutorial into virtual tracing paper: the video floats over your real sketchbook so you can trace along. Made with YouTube artist AmandaRachLee.
works.idea_zh: 把YouTube绘画教程变成浮在真实画本上的描图纸。

video.video_title: AR Experiment: Drawalong AR

works.technique: A video plane is anchored to a detected paper surface with adjustable transparency, so the user can trace the tutorial through the overlay.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌面平面上放一个半透明的视频或图片层，对齐真实纸张后描画；变体：让叠加内容逐笔出现，像一位老师在示范。
works.description_zh: 把 YouTube 绘画教程变成一张虚拟描图纸：视频浮在你真实的速写本上方，让你跟着描画。与 YouTube 艺术家 AmandaRachLee 合作完成。
works.idea_en: Turn a YouTube drawing tutorial into tracing paper floating over your real sketchbook.
works.technique_zh: 把视频平面锚定在检测到的纸面上，并允许调节透明度，用户可以透过叠加层描摹教程。
works.exercise_en: Place a semi-transparent video or image layer on a tabletop plane, line it up with a real sheet of paper, and trace it. Twist: have the overlay appear stroke by stroke, like a teacher demonstrating.

salient.why_en: A drawing tutorial video floats over your sketchbook as tracing paper.
salient.why_zh: 绘画教程视频浮在你的速写本上，变成一张描图纸。

works.title: DreamWalker
works.description: A person walks a real route of several hundred metres through city streets while wearing VR and sees a completely different virtual world, with obstacles and pedestrians safely mapped into it.
works.description_zh: 一个人戴着 VR 在城市街道中步行一段数百米的真实路线，看到的却是完全不同的虚拟世界，路上的障碍和行人都被安全地映射进这个世界。
works.idea_en: Replace the world while keeping its walkable shape.
works.idea_zh: 替换世界，但保留它可行走的形状。
works.technique: GPS, inside-out tracking and RGB-D cameras fuse to keep the user on a pre-planned route, and a virtual path is warped to match it while detected obstacles appear as virtual objects.
works.technique_zh: 融合 GPS、内向外追踪和 RGB-D 摄像头，让用户保持在预先规划的路线上；虚拟路径被扭曲以与之匹配，检测到的障碍物则以虚拟物体出现。
works.exercise_en: Walk a short corridor route with a phone in a headset showing only a virtual forest path mapped to it, with a spotter. Twist: turn each real door into a virtual gate.
works.exercise_zh: 在有人看护的情况下，戴着装有手机的头显走一段短走廊，头显里只显示映射到这条路线上的虚拟林间小路。变体：把每扇真实的门变成一道虚拟大门。

video.video_title: Dreamwalker UIST2019

works.title: Empa
works.description: A participatory installation where pairs swap live camera feeds through VR headsets, dancing and holding hands while each sees through the other's eyes, to test whether technology can create empathy.
works.description_zh: 一件参与式装置：两人一组，通过 VR 头显交换实时摄像画面，一边跳舞、牵手，一边透过对方的眼睛看世界，以此检验技术能否带来共情。
works.idea_en: See yourself through your partner's eyes while you move together.
works.idea_zh: 一起移动时，透过搭档的眼睛看见自己。
works.technique: Head-mounted cameras stream each participant's point of view to the other person's VR headset, creating a video see-through body swap (a setup similar to The Machine to Be Another).
works.technique_zh: 头戴摄像头把每位参与者的视角实时传到对方的 VR 头显，形成视频透视式的“身体交换”（类似 The Machine to Be Another 的装置）。
works.exercise_en: Pair students: one films at eye level with a phone while the other watches the live stream in a cardboard viewer, then they try to walk and mirror each other. Twist: swap roles mid-task without stopping.
works.exercise_zh: 两人一组：一人用手机在眼睛高度拍摄，另一人用纸盒眼镜观看实时画面，然后尝试一起行走、互相镜像；变体：在任务中途不停下来直接交换角色。

video.video_title: Empa 2019

salient.why_en: Two people swap eyes and dance hand in hand, each seeing through the other's view.
salient.why_zh: 两个人交换眼睛，手牵手跳舞，各自透过对方的视角看世界。

works.title: Evolution of Fish
works.description: An AR artwork of fish evolving into plastic-bag creatures; here the artist plays with video feedback in the AR view.
works.idea_zh: 鱼在AR中进化成塑料袋生物

video.video_title: Evolution of Fish AR artwork - playing with video feedback

works.technique: An ARKit plane-anchored animated model shows fish morphing into plastic forms (blend shapes or model swaps), and screen recording of a screen within the AR view produces video feedback.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Unity AR 做一条鱼逐步变形成塑料袋的动画（blend shape 或模型切换），放在水槽或饮水机旁；变体：用手机对着另一台播放 AR 画面的屏幕拍摄，制造视频反馈循环。
works.description_zh: 一件关于鱼逐渐进化成塑料袋生物的 AR 作品；在这段记录中，艺术家在 AR 视图里玩起了视频反馈。
works.idea_en: Fish evolve into plastic-bag creatures in AR.
works.technique_zh: 基于 ARKit 平面锚定的动画模型呈现鱼逐渐变形为塑料形态的过程（通过 blend shape 或模型切换），在 AR 视图中翻拍另一块屏幕则产生视频反馈。
works.exercise_en: Use Unity AR to animate a fish gradually morphing into a plastic bag (via blend shapes or model swaps) and place it next to a fish tank or water cooler. Twist: point the phone at another screen showing the AR view to create a video feedback loop.

works.title: Evolution of the Garden
works.description: A sound installation and performance at Athens Digital Arts Festival, made with Dimitra Kousteridou: touching potted plants wired into analogue and digital circuits adds voices to a growing soundscape.
works.description_zh: 在 Athens Digital Arts Festival 展出的声音装置与表演，与 Dimitra Kousteridou 合作：触碰连入模拟和数字电路的盆栽，就会给不断生长的声景加入新的声音。
works.idea_en: A garden you play by touching its leaves.
works.idea_zh: 一座靠触摸叶子来演奏的花园。
works.technique: Plants are connected to a Makey Makey and small analogue and digital circuits, so the body's touch closes a circuit that triggers or modulates sound through a mixer and speakers.
works.technique_zh: 植物连到 Makey Makey 以及几块小型模拟和数字电路上，人一碰就接通电路，经调音台和音箱触发或调制声音。
works.exercise_en: Wire three houseplants to a Makey Makey and map each to a sound loop in a browser sampler. Twist: a sound only plays while two people touch different plants and hold hands.
works.exercise_zh: 把三盆植物接到 Makey Makey 上，每盆对应浏览器采样器里的一段循环音；变体：只有两个人分别摸着不同植物并手拉手时声音才会响起。

video.video_title: Evolution of the Garden, 2019

works.title: FIELD
works.description: An ever-changing ecosystem where visitors pollinate the environment with their bodies: movement spreads color, makes flowers bloom and attracts butterflies across the seasons.
works.idea_zh: 用身体给虚拟花田授粉，引来蝴蝶，季节随之变化。

video.video_title: FIELD

works.technique: Camera or depth-based body tracking deposits color into a persistent field texture as visitors move, which drives flower spawning and butterfly agents that follow color gradients.
works.exercise_zh: 用投影和人体追踪让人走过的地方留下颜色，颜色浓的地方长花、蝴蝶飞过去；变体：场景按真实时间慢慢换季，冬天时只有两个人靠在一起的地方才会开花。
works.description_zh: 一个不断变化的生态系统：观众用身体为环境授粉，他们的动作会播撒色彩、让花朵绽放，并随着季节更替引来蝴蝶。
works.idea_en: Pollinate a virtual flower field with your body, attract butterflies, and watch the seasons turn.
works.technique_zh: 基于相机或深度的人体追踪在观众移动时把颜色写入一张持续保存的场纹理，由它驱动花朵生成，蝴蝶智能体则沿颜色梯度飞行。
works.exercise_en: Use projection and body tracking so that people leave color where they walk, with flowers growing where color is dense and butterflies flying toward it. Twist: the scene slowly changes season in real time, and in winter flowers bloom only where two people stand close together.

works.title: FLOWERS BY NAKED 2019
works.description: An immersive flower exhibition in Nihonbashi, Tokyo, where real flower installations and projected blossoms fill a hall, and visitors' movements make digital petals bloom and scatter.
works.description_zh: 东京日本桥的沉浸式花展：真实的花艺装置与投影的花朵充满整个展厅，观众的动作会让数字花瓣绽放、飘散。
works.idea_en: Mixing real flowers with projected ones blurs which is which, the core pleasure of a good AR blend.
works.idea_zh: 把真花和投影的花混在一起，让人分不清哪朵是真的，这正是好的 AR 融合带来的核心乐趣。
works.technique: Floor and wall projections are driven by sensors that detect visitors, likely depth cameras, and layered over physical flower arrangements.
works.technique_zh: 地面与墙面投影由检测观众的传感器驱动（推测为深度摄像机），叠加在真实的花艺装置上。
works.exercise_en: Put a real bouquet on a table and use Lens Studio or WebXR to grow AR flowers out of it that bloom when a hand comes close. Twist: petals fall faster the more people crowd around.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌上放一束真花，用 Lens Studio 或 WebXR 让 AR 花从花束里长出来，手靠近时绽放；变体：围观的人越多，花瓣掉落得越快。

video.video_title: FLOWERS BY NAKED 2019 ー東京・日本橋ー Digest Movie

works.title: Fabric Mirror
works.description: Strips of fabric twist and turn on motors to reveal their light or dark side, forming a soft woven silhouette of the viewer.
works.description_zh: 一条条布料在电机带动下扭转，露出浅色或深色的一面，编织出观众柔软的剪影。
works.idea_en: Even cloth can become a display when each strip has two faces, which suggests AR textiles that flip to show hidden content.
works.idea_zh: 只要每条布有两面，连布料都能变成显示屏，这启发了会翻转显示隐藏内容的 AR 织物。
works.technique: Motion tracking of the viewer drives motors that rotate two-toned fabric strips, likely using a depth camera to separate the body from the background.
works.technique_zh: 对观众的动作追踪驱动电机旋转双色布条，很可能用深度相机把身体和背景分开。
works.exercise_en: Hang a virtual curtain of two-coloured ribbons in a real doorway in AR and flip the ribbons to draw the silhouette of whoever walks through. Twist: make the ribbons remember the last person and slowly fade to the next.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中在真实门口挂一幅双色丝带虚拟帘子，翻转丝带画出走过者的轮廓。变体：让丝带记住上一个人，再慢慢过渡到下一个。

video.video_title: Daniel Rozin, "Fabric Mirror," 2019

salient.why_en: Strips of cloth turn their light or dark side to weave a soft picture of whoever stands in front.
salient.why_zh: 一条条布翻出浅色或深色的一面，织出站在面前的人的柔软影像。

works.title: Faire corps
works.description: An 'exhibition-experience' at Gaîté Lyrique where visitors enter projected, interactive environments that react to their bodies and invite them to move together.
works.idea_zh: 一个用身体集体进入、共同改变影像的展览空间
works.technique: Camera and depth sensing of visitors drives real-time projected particle and line environments on floors and walls.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个需要3人以上一起动作才会变化的投影空间（如一起跳让画面变色）；变化：加入一条只有全员静止才出现的隐藏画面。

video.video_title: Faire corps - Adrien M & Claire B - Une exposition-expérience à la Gaîté Lyrique

works.description_zh: 在 Gaîté Lyrique 举办的一场“展览体验”：观众走进可交互的投影环境，影像会对他们的身体做出反应，并邀请大家一起行动。
works.idea_en: An exhibition space that people enter together and change with their bodies.
works.technique_zh: 通过相机和深度传感感知观众，驱动投射在地面和墙面上的实时粒子与线条环境。
works.exercise_en: Design a projected space that changes only when three or more people move together (for example, jumping together changes the colors). Twist: add a hidden image that appears only when everyone is completely still.

works.title: Forest Giants (Bernheim Forest)
works.description: Three giant trolls built from scrap wood (a mother and two children) sit and lie along trails in Bernheim Forest, Kentucky, found by hikers exploring the woods.
works.description_zh: 三个用废木料搭建的巨型巨魔（一位母亲和两个孩子）坐卧在肯塔基州 Bernheim 森林的小径旁，等待徒步者在林中发现。
works.idea_en: Characters hidden along trails turn a walk into a search, the physical version of an AR scavenger hunt.
works.idea_zh: 藏在小径旁的角色把散步变成了寻找，是 AR 寻宝游戏的实体版本。
works.technique: Pallets and scrap wood are cut and screwed onto a timber frame, with faces sculpted from branches, built with local volunteers.
works.technique_zh: 托盘和废木料被切割并用螺丝固定在木框架上，面部用树枝塑造，由当地志愿者协助建造。
works.exercise_en: Hide three AR characters in a park with Niantic Lightship or 8th Wall, each with a riddle pointing to the next. Twist: each character only appears when the user is quiet (low microphone level).
works.exercise_zh: 用 Niantic Lightship 或 8th Wall 在公园里藏三个 AR 角色，每个都附有指向下一个的谜语；变体：只有当用户保持安静（麦克风音量低）时角色才会出现。

video.video_title: Forest Trolls - Kentucky 2019.

works.title: Fragment Shadow
works.description: Visitors' real shadows are split into several colored, offset shadows by precisely calibrated multiple projectors, so one body casts a fragmented, prismatic shadow.
works.idea_zh: 多台投影机让一个人的影子碎裂成好几个彩色影子。

video.video_title: Fragment Shadow :Exhibition Preview at SXSW2019

works.technique: Calibrates several projectors' geometry and color so their overlapping light sums to white, making each body occlusion reveal a different colored shadow.
works.exercise_zh: 用三盏红绿蓝LED灯（或三台手机手电加彩色玻璃纸）从不同角度照向白墙，让同学用身体做出彩色影子；变化：用编程让每盏灯随音乐轮流闪烁。
works.description_zh: 经过精确标定的多台投影机把观众真实的影子拆分成数个带颜色、彼此错开的影子，一个人的身体便投下碎裂的、棱镜般的影子。
works.idea_en: Several projectors split one person's shadow into multiple colored shadows.
works.technique_zh: 对多台投影机的几何和颜色进行标定，使重叠的光叠加为白色，这样身体的每一处遮挡都会显露出不同颜色的影子。
works.exercise_en: Shine three red, green and blue LED lights (or three phone flashlights with colored cellophane) at a white wall from different angles and let students make colored shadows with their bodies. Twist: program the lights to flash in turn with the music.

salient.why_en: One body casts several colored shadows at once, turning an everyday shadow into something strange.
salient.why_zh: 一个人同时投下好几道彩色影子，让最日常的影子变得陌生。

works.title: Frame Perspective
works.description: Coloured frames painted and lit across real architecture — walls, courtyards, streets — only line up into perfect rectangles from one point; from anywhere else they fall apart into broken shapes. Versions were shown in Metz, at Bristol Light Festival and in a drone-filmed version.
works.description_zh: 在真实建筑上——墙面、庭院、街道——绘制并照亮的彩色画框，只有从某一个点看才会对齐成完美的长方形；换个位置就散成破碎的形状。曾在梅斯、布里斯托灯光节展出，还有一个用无人机拍摄的版本。
works.idea_en: An anamorphic frame anchored to real buildings is AR without a screen: it only 'works' from the viewpoint the designer chose.
works.idea_zh: 锚定在真实建筑上的变形画框，就是不需要屏幕的 AR：它只在设计师选定的视点才“成立”。
works.technique: Rectangles are projected from the chosen viewpoint onto the architecture and then painted or lit along the projection lines, so they align only from that spot (anamorphosis).
works.technique_zh: 从选定视点把长方形投到建筑上，再沿投影线绘制或打光，因此只有从那个点看才会对齐（变形透视）。
works.exercise_en: Pick a courtyard, stand at one spot and use a phone AR app to place a floating rectangular frame that spans several walls; then walk around to see it break. Twist: mark the spot with nothing, and let people discover it by looking through the app.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个庭院，站在某一点，用手机 AR 放一个横跨几面墙的漂浮长方形画框，然后绕着走看它如何破碎；变体：不在地上做任何标记，让人们通过 App 自己发现那个点。

video.video_title: Frame Perpective - Olivier Ratsi

works.title: Future Gloss
works.description: Ines Alpha's first Snapchat lens: glossy, liquid 3D makeup that drips and flows over the user's face in real time.
works.idea_zh: 液态光泽的3D妆容在脸上实时流动，化妆不再受物理限制。

video.video_title: Future gloss by ines alpha

works.technique: A face mesh from face tracking drives 3D liquid geometry attached to facial landmarks, with glossy PBR materials and an environment map for reflections.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 Effect House 在脸上放一个跟随面部网格的 3D 液体造型，调出高光反射材质；变体：让液体随嘴巴张合流动。
works.description_zh: Ines Alpha 的第一个 Snapchat 镜头：光泽的液态 3D 妆容在用户脸上实时流淌。
works.idea_en: Glossy liquid 3D makeup flows over your face in real time, free from physical limits.
works.technique_zh: 人脸追踪得到的面部网格驱动附着在面部特征点上的 3D 液体几何体，配合有光泽的 PBR 材质和用于反射的环境贴图。
works.exercise_en: Use Lens Studio or Effect House to place a 3D liquid shape that follows the face mesh, and tune a glossy reflective material. Twist: make the liquid flow as the mouth opens and closes.

works.title: Future You
works.description: A motion-capture mirror that turns each viewer into a synthetic robotic figure; the harder you move, the stranger its 47,000 possible responses become.
works.idea_zh: 照见'未来的你'的动捕镜子，越动越奇异

video.video_title: Future You - Barbican, London

works.technique: A depth camera tracks the viewer's skeleton and a real-time engine retargets it to a generative robotic figure whose form parameters change with movement speed and energy.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 驱动一个由几何体拼成的“机器人分身”，动作越剧烈，分身的形态参数（尺寸、数量、颜色）越离谱；变体：让分身有一秒的“记忆”，逐渐把你过去的动作混进来。
works.description_zh: 一面动作捕捉镜子，把每位观众变成一个合成的机器人形象；你动得越用力，它在 47,000 种可能反应中呈现的样子就越怪异。
works.idea_en: A motion-capture mirror shows 'future you', and the more you move, the stranger it gets.
works.technique_zh: 深度相机追踪观众的骨骼，实时引擎把动作重定向到一个生成式机器人形象上，其形态参数随动作速度和能量变化。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Pose to drive a 'robot double' built from geometric shapes, whose form parameters (size, count, color) grow more outlandish the more intensely you move. Twist: give the double a one-second 'memory' that gradually mixes in your past movements.

works.title: GLADES
works.description: Visitors move in front of two displays: on one their body grows toxic blue algae on a virtual water surface, on the other an invasive python wraps around their silhouette, while a large projection shows an anhinga flying between them.
works.description_zh: 观众在两块屏幕前移动：一边他们的身体会在虚拟水面上长出有毒的蓝藻，另一边一条入侵的蟒蛇缠绕住他们的剪影，中间的大投影上一只蛇鹈在两者之间飞行、游动、降落。
works.idea_en: Your own silhouette becomes the source of ecological harm, so the message is felt, not read.
works.idea_zh: 你自己的剪影成了生态破坏的来源，信息不再是读到的，而是感受到的。
works.technique: Depth sensors track visitors' bodies without wearables, and openFrameworks (likely) simulates algae growth and a python rig that follows the silhouette.
works.technique_zh: 深度传感器在无需穿戴设备的情况下追踪观众身体，（很可能使用）openFrameworks 模拟蓝藻生长和一条跟随剪影的蟒蛇骨骼。
works.exercise_en: Use webcam body segmentation to make your silhouette leave a spreading 'pollution' trail on a projected pond, and a clean-up creature that follows others. Twist: the pond only recovers when everyone stands still.
works.exercise_zh: 用网络摄像头人体分割，让你的剪影在投影的池塘上留下不断扩散的“污染”痕迹，再加一只跟随其他人的清理生物；变体：只有所有人都静止不动时，池塘才会恢复。

video.video_title: GLADES

works.title: GeoVfx: world population as particles
works.description: A globe is built from particles whose heights show where people live, based on NASA SEDAC population data.
works.description_zh: 一个由粒子组成的地球，粒子的高度显示人口分布，数据来自 NASA SEDAC。
works.idea_en: Data becomes landscape when every value is a particle.
works.idea_zh: 每个数值变成一颗粒子，数据就变成了地形。
works.technique: Gridded population data is loaded into a GraphicsBuffer and VFX Graph maps each cell's latitude and longitude onto a sphere, scaling the particle height by density.
works.technique_zh: 把网格化人口数据载入 GraphicsBuffer，VFX Graph 把每个格子的经纬度映射到球面上，并按人口密度拉高粒子。
works.exercise_en: Load a small open dataset (e.g., city air quality) and render it as a particle globe that sits on your desk in AR Foundation. Twist: let people pinch to fly into one country.
works.exercise_zh: 载入一个小型开放数据集（比如城市空气质量），渲染成粒子地球，用 AR Foundation 放在桌上。变体：双指捏合就能飞进一个国家。

video.video_title: I updated the GeoVfx example (data visualization with VFX Graph) to use GraphicsBuffer instead of texture baking. This is a visualization of the world population based on data from NASA SEDAC. https:/

works.title: Geollery
works.description: A web-based mirrored world that rebuilds city streets from street-view and map data and fills them with geotagged social media posts that people can walk up to and chat around as avatars.
works.description_zh: 一个网页上的“镜像世界”：用街景和地图数据重建城市街道，并在其中放置带地理标签的社交媒体内容，人们以虚拟化身走过去围在一起聊天。
works.idea_en: Social media placed back where it happened, in a walkable 3D copy of the city.
works.idea_zh: 把社交媒体内容放回它发生的地方，放进一座可以行走的 3D 城市副本。
works.technique: A progressive pipeline extrudes buildings from OpenStreetMap footprints, textures them with street-view panoramas and streams geotagged posts as billboards, all rendered with WebGL.
works.technique_zh: 渐进式管线根据 OpenStreetMap 的建筑轮廓挤出楼体，贴上街景全景纹理，再把带地理标签的帖子作为广告牌流式加载，全部用 WebGL 渲染。
works.exercise_en: Collect ten geotagged photos from your campus and place them as floating cards at their real locations in a location-based AR app. Twist: let each card fade the longer ago it was taken.
works.exercise_zh: 收集校园里十张带地理标签的照片，用基于位置的 AR 应用把它们作为悬浮卡片放在真实位置。变体：照片拍得越久远，卡片就越透明。

video.video_title: Geollery: A Mixed Reality Social Media Metaverse (ACM CHI 2019)

works.title: Grordbattle (multiplayer)
works.description: A co-located multiplayer Magic Leap duel from Weta Gameshop: players in the same real room see each other's avatars and trade ray-gun fire around the furniture.
works.idea_zh: 同一房间里多人戴Magic Leap用射线枪对战。

video.video_title: Hands-On with Magic Leap Multiplayer: Grordbattle!

works.technique: Co-located players share a common coordinate frame (shared spatial anchor or map), and each player's head and weapon poses are networked so avatars and shots line up with real bodies.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Unity Netcode 和图像标记对齐两台手机的坐标系，让两人在同一房间互射 AR 光球；变体：真实家具可以挡子弹。
works.description_zh: Weta Gameshop 打造的同空间多人 Magic Leap 对战：同一个真实房间里的玩家能看到彼此的虚拟形象，并绕着家具用射线枪互相开火。
works.idea_en: Several players in the same room wear Magic Leap and fight with ray guns.
works.technique_zh: 同处一室的玩家共享一个公共坐标系（共享空间锚点或地图），每位玩家的头部和武器姿态通过网络同步，使虚拟形象和射击与真实身体对齐。
works.exercise_en: Use Unity Netcode and an image marker to align two phones' coordinate systems so two people can shoot AR light balls at each other in the same room. Twist: real furniture blocks the shots.

works.title: Grubo: MC-101 live performance at Channel #21
works.description: Keijiro plays a Roland MC-101 groovebox on stage while a Unity visualizer reacts to each track with shapes and particles projected behind him.
works.description_zh: 高桥启治郎在台上演奏 Roland MC-101 音乐盒，身后投影的 Unity 画面随每条音轨生成形状和粒子。
works.idea_en: One small groovebox drives both the music and the visuals.
works.idea_zh: 一台小小的音乐盒，同时驱动音乐和画面。
works.technique: The MC-101's multichannel USB audio is analyzed per track with LASP and its MIDI clock and notes arrive through Minis, so each part triggers its own effect.
works.technique_zh: 用 LASP 分别分析 MC-101 多通道 USB 音频的每条音轨，再通过 Minis 接收 MIDI 时钟和音符，让每个声部触发各自的特效。
works.exercise_en: Split a song into drums and melody, map each stem to its own AR Foundation VFX object in the room, and perform it live. Twist: let the audience move the objects by walking around with the phone.
works.exercise_zh: 把一首歌分成鼓和旋律两轨，各自对应房间里的一个 AR Foundation 特效物体，然后现场演奏。变体：观众拿着手机走动时可以移动这些物体。

video.video_title: Roland Groovebox MC-101 live performance at Channel #21 (with Unity visualizer)

works.title: Harry Potter: Wizards Unite
works.description: A location-based AR game with Warner Bros. where players trace spell glyphs on screen to free magical 'Foundables' that appear over the real world.
works.idea_zh: 在现实街道上画出咒语手势，解救散落在城市里的魔法物品。

video.video_title: Harry Potter: Wizards Unite | Gameplay Trailer

works.technique: Touch-path gesture recognition compares the traced stroke against template glyphs and scores accuracy and speed, with the encounter object overlaid on the camera view.
works.exercise_zh: 实现一个简单的手势路径识别（如 $1 Recognizer），画对符号时 AR 中的物体被释放；变体：让同学自己设计三种新符号及其效果。
works.description_zh: 与华纳兄弟合作的基于位置的 AR 游戏：玩家在屏幕上描画咒语符号，解救出现在现实世界中的魔法“Foundables”。
works.idea_en: Trace spell gestures on real streets to free magical objects scattered around the city.
works.technique_zh: 触摸路径手势识别把描画的笔迹与模板符号比对，给准确度和速度打分，遭遇到的物体叠加在相机画面上。
works.exercise_en: Implement simple gesture-path recognition (such as the $1 Recognizer) so that drawing the right symbol releases an object in AR. Twist: have students design three new symbols and their effects.

works.title: Hello, Shadow!
works.description: Visitors turn a handheld lighting device around a sculpture; the shadow on the wall is computer-generated and changes into unexpected shapes depending on the angle of the light.
works.description_zh: 观众手持灯具围着一件雕塑转动，墙上的影子由计算机生成，会随着灯光角度变成意想不到的形状。
works.idea_en: The light in your hand becomes a lens that reveals shadows the object does not actually cast.
works.idea_zh: 手里的灯变成一个镜头，照出物体本不会投下的影子。
works.technique: The pose of the handheld light is tracked and a shadow is rendered from that virtual light position onto the wall, likely with a projector aligned to the real lamp's frustum.
works.technique_zh: 追踪手持灯具的姿态，从对应的虚拟光源位置把影子渲染到墙上，可能用与真实灯光视锥对齐的投影仪实现。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone flashlight as a 'lamp', track its angle with the phone's gyroscope, and render a shadow on a projected wall that morphs between two silhouettes as the angle changes. Twist: hide a secret shape that only appears at one exact angle.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机手电筒当作“灯”，用陀螺仪读取角度，在投影墙上渲染一个随角度在两个剪影之间变形的影子；变体：藏一个只有在某个精确角度才会出现的秘密形状。

video.video_title: Hello Shadow

salient.why_en: Turn a light around a sculpture and its shadow on the wall becomes a shape the object could never cast.
salient.why_zh: 拿着灯绕着雕塑转，墙上的影子却变成物体本身不可能投出的形状。

works.title: Hide yourself
works.description: An ARKit test with Molmol Kuo, made as ARKit 3 introduced people segmentation, playing with hiding a person inside the AR scene around them.
works.idea_zh: 用AR把人从画面里“藏起来”，让身体在真实场景中消失。

video.video_title: Hide yourself - arkit testing w @openMolmol_MPS https://t.co/8Xv2VdpD3h

works.technique: ARKit 3 people segmentation with depth produces a per-pixel human matte, which is used to occlude or replace the person with the reconstructed background behind them.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 的 Human Segmentation（或网页端 MediaPipe 分割）把画面里的人替换成先拍好的背景，做一个“隐身术”；变体：不是让人完全消失，而是只留下影子或衣服，讲一个关于存在感的短片。
works.description_zh: 与 Molmol Kuo 合作的一次 ARKit 实验，诞生于 ARKit 3 刚推出人像分割之时，尝试把人藏进周围的 AR 场景里。
works.idea_en: Use AR to hide a person from the frame, making the body vanish into the real scene.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 3 结合深度的人像分割生成逐像素的人体蒙版，用来遮挡人物，或用其身后重建的背景替换掉人物。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation's Human Segmentation (or MediaPipe segmentation on the web) to replace people in the frame with a pre-shot background for an 'invisibility trick'. Twist: instead of making the person vanish completely, leave only their shadow or clothes, and tell a short story about presence.

works.title: Holoportation for ARCore with Multiple Azure Kinect
works.description: Several Azure Kinects capture a person as a live point cloud that is streamed into an ARCore phone as a life-size hologram.
works.idea_zh: 多台 Azure Kinect 实时捕捉真人点云，传送到手机 AR 里成为全息人。

video.video_title: Holoportation for ARCore with Multiple Azure Kinect

works.technique: Multiple calibrated Azure Kinect RGB-D streams are fused into a colored point cloud, streamed over the network, and rendered at life size at an ARCore anchor.
works.exercise_zh: 用 iPhone 的深度相机（Record3D 等）录一段人的 RGB-D 视频，转为点云在 AR 地面上以真人大小回放；变体：让点云随声音大小抖动或散开。
works.description_zh: 多台 Azure Kinect 把一个人捕捉成实时点云，串流到 ARCore 手机上，呈现为真人大小的全息影像。
works.idea_en: Several Azure Kinects capture a person's point cloud live and beam it into phone AR as a hologram.
works.technique_zh: 把多台经过标定的 Azure Kinect RGB-D 数据流融合成彩色点云，通过网络串流，并在 ARCore 锚点处以真人尺寸渲染。
works.exercise_en: Record an RGB-D video of a person with the iPhone depth camera (Record3D or similar), convert it to a point cloud, and replay it life-size on the floor in AR. Twist: make the point cloud shake or scatter with the loudness of sound.

works.title: Holotronica Live (British Science Festival)
works.description: Stuart Warren-Hill performs Holotronica's live audiovisual set at the British Science Festival: music and stereoscopic 3D visuals projected onto Hologauze make shapes seem to hang in the space between the stage and the audience.
works.description_zh: Stuart Warren-Hill 在英国科学节上表演 Holotronica 的现场视听演出：音乐配合投在 Hologauze 上的立体 3D 影像，让形状看起来悬挂在舞台与观众之间的空间里。
works.idea_en: Combining stereo 3D with a floating screen pushes images out into the room; AR music sets can place visuals between performer and audience rather than on a back wall.
works.idea_zh: 把立体 3D 和悬浮屏结合，可以把影像推到房间里；AR 音乐演出可以把画面放在表演者和观众之间，而不是只放在背后的墙上。
works.technique: Stereoscopic video, viewed with 3D glasses, is projected onto a Hologauze screen in front of the performer and driven live with the music.
works.technique_zh: 立体视频（观众戴 3D 眼镜观看）被投在表演者前方的 Hologauze 屏上，并随音乐实时驱动。
works.exercise_en: Perform a three-minute AR music set where audio-reactive shapes float between you and the audience, built in Unity AR Foundation or Lens Studio with microphone input. Twist: the audience's phones show the shapes from their own seats.
works.exercise_zh: 表演一段三分钟的 AR 音乐演出，让随声音变化的形状漂浮在你和观众之间，用 Unity AR Foundation 或 Lens Studio 接入麦克风制作；变体：观众用自己的手机从各自座位看到这些形状。

video.video_title: Holotronica Show on Hologauze at British Science Festival

works.title: Hybrid RTK GNSS and SLAM Outdoor AR
works.description: A wearable AR user walks a wide outdoor area and sees markers for assets given only by latitude and longitude, placed accurately over the real terrain.
works.description_zh: 佩戴 AR 设备的用户在大片户外区域行走，能看到仅以经纬度给出的目标标记精准地出现在真实地形上。
works.idea_en: Stitch small SLAM maps together with centimetre GPS to make city-scale AR.
works.idea_zh: 用厘米级 GPS 把一个个小 SLAM 地图缝合起来，实现城市尺度的 AR。
works.technique: Uses RTK GNSS positions to georegister and chain multiple local SLAM maps from the headset's tracker into one wide-area coordinate frame.
works.technique_zh: 利用 RTK GNSS 定位对头显追踪器生成的多个局部 SLAM 地图进行地理配准，并把它们串联成一个大范围坐标系。
works.exercise_en: Collect GPS coordinates of five spots around school with a phone, then place location-based AR markers at them and walk the route checking how far off each one appears. Twist: add a hidden treasure only visible within two metres.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机采集学校周围五个地点的 GPS 坐标，在这些位置放置基于位置的 AR 标记，沿路线走并检查每个标记偏差多少；变体：加一个只有走到两米内才看得见的隐藏宝物。

video.video_title: A Hybrid RTK GNSS and SLAM Outdoor Augmented Reality System

works.title: HyperCubes
works.description: Children arrange paper cubes printed with markers as coding blocks; the phone reads the sequence and an AR character executes it in space, teaching computational thinking.
works.idea_zh: 把纸方块排成一串就是'程序'，AR 角色按顺序执行。

video.video_title: HyperCubes: A Playful Introduction to Computational Thinking in Augmented Reality

works.technique: Paper cubes act as fiducial markers whose order and spatial arrangement are read as a sequence of instructions, and the result is animated in AR.
works.exercise_zh: 做一套纸质'代码积木'（前进/转弯/跳），用手机识别顺序并让 AR 机器人走迷宫；加一个变化：加入'循环'积木。
works.description_zh: 孩子们把印有标记的纸方块当作编程积木来排列，手机读取它们的顺序，AR 角色便在空间中执行这段程序，借此培养计算思维。
works.idea_en: Line up paper cubes to write a 'program', and an AR character carries it out in order.
works.technique_zh: 纸方块作为基准标记，其顺序和空间排列被读取为一串指令，执行结果以 AR 动画呈现。
works.exercise_en: Make a set of paper 'code blocks' (forward, turn, jump) and have a phone read their order so an AR robot walks through a maze. Twist: add a 'loop' block.

works.title: Interfaces by Morphosis AR app
works.description: The official AR app for Morphosis's Milan Design Week installation with Dassault Systèmes overlays animated architectural geometry and information on the physical installation.
works.idea_zh: 用 AR 给实体建筑装置叠加动态结构和设计信息。

video.video_title: Interfaces by Morphosis Demo Video

works.technique: Image or object tracking registers the phone to the installation so digital geometry and sound are aligned with the built structure (likely target-based).
works.exercise_zh: 给学校里一件雕塑或建筑模型做一个 AR 导览：扫一扫出现结构线和设计故事；加一个变化：可以'拆开'看内部结构。
works.description_zh: Morphosis 与 Dassault Systèmes 在米兰设计周装置的官方 AR 应用，在实体装置上叠加动态的建筑几何和信息。
works.idea_en: Overlay moving structure and design information on a physical architectural installation with AR.
works.technique_zh: 通过图像或物体追踪把手机与装置配准，使数字几何和声音与建成结构对齐（大概率基于目标识别）。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR guide for a sculpture or architectural model at school: scan it to reveal structural lines and the design story. Twist: let viewers 'take it apart' to see the inner structure.

works.title: International Liquid Finger Prayer
works.description: On Apple's [AR]T Walk, a shimmering liquid form bounces, taunts and sings through the city while participants race to catch it on their phones.
works.description_zh: 在 Apple [AR]T Walk 上，一个闪闪发光的液态形体在城市中蹦跳、挑逗、歌唱，参与者拿着手机争相去“抓”住它。
works.idea_en: Chase a singing, glittering blob through the city.
works.idea_zh: 在城市里追逐一团会唱歌、闪闪发光的液体。
works.technique: Location-anchored ARKit animation with spatial audio that moves along a path, turning the walk into a chase.
works.technique_zh: 锚定位置的 ARKit 动画配合空间音频，沿路径移动，把漫步变成一场追逐。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR creature that flees along a path when the phone gets within two metres, and plays a sound that gets louder as you close in. Twist: it can only be caught when two players corner it together.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 生物：手机靠近到两米内时它就沿路径逃跑，并发出越靠近越响的声音；变体：只有两名玩家一起把它逼到角落才能抓住它。

video.video_title: [AR]T ウォーク@新宿：インターナショナル・リッキッド・フィンガー・プレイヤー

works.title: Iridescence
works.description: A collar of 200 flipping quills, inspired by a hummingbird's throat, changes colour and pattern in response to the movement and emotions of people nearby.
works.description_zh: 一个由 200 根可翻转羽管组成的领饰，灵感来自蜂鸟的喉羽，会根据附近人的动作和情绪改变颜色和图案。
works.idea_en: Flipping two-coloured elements is a cheap, readable display — an AR designer can reuse the flip as a visual language for attention and mood.
works.idea_zh: 翻转双色单元是一种便宜又易读的显示方式——AR 设计者可以把“翻转”当作表达注意力和情绪的视觉语言。
works.technique: A facial-tracking camera feeds an interactive system that drives an array of electromagnetically flipped quills, producing colour waves across the collar.
works.technique_zh: 人脸追踪摄像头把数据送入互动系统，驱动一组电磁翻转的羽管，在领饰上形成色彩波纹。
works.exercise_en: Cover a real object (a chair, a jacket, a doorframe) with a grid of AR flip-tiles that turn over in a ripple toward whichever face the camera sees. Twist: map smiles to one colour and frowns to the other.
works.exercise_zh: 在一个真实物体（椅子、外套、门框）上覆盖一格格 AR 翻转片，让它们朝摄像头看到的那张脸波浪式翻转。变体：笑容对应一种颜色，皱眉对应另一种。

video.video_title: IRIDESCENCE || Color & Shape Changing Emotive Collar

works.title: Is that me? AR Mirror
works.description: People look into an AR mirror that shows a captured 3D version of their own body moving in real time, and researchers test whether they feel that reconstructed body is really theirs.
works.description_zh: 人们看向一面 AR 镜子，镜中显示的是自己身体实时捕捉的三维版本，研究者测试他们是否觉得这个重建的身体真的属于自己。
works.idea_en: An AR mirror can test how far your reflection can change before it stops being you.
works.idea_zh: AR 镜子可以测试：你的镜像改变到什么程度，就不再是“你”了。
works.technique: Captures the user with depth cameras into a live 3D representation and renders it in an AR mirror setup to measure ownership, agency and self-location.
works.technique_zh: 用深度相机把用户实时捕捉成三维形象，在 AR 镜子装置中渲染，以测量身体所有感、能动感和自我定位感。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone's front camera with a body-tracking effect as a mirror, gradually delaying or distorting the image, and ask classmates when it stops feeling like them. Twist: swap two students' bodies in the mirror.
works.exercise_zh: 把带人体追踪特效的手机前置摄像头当镜子，逐渐增加延迟或变形，问同学从什么时候开始觉得那不再是自己；变体：在镜子里交换两名学生的身体。

video.video_title: Is that me? - embodiment and body perception with an augmented reality mirror.

works.title: Journey of Colour
works.description: Visitors hold fabric and paint samples from the design center's showrooms up to a reader, and a long LED wall instantly washes into that exact color.
works.description_zh: 观众把设计中心各展厅的布料和油漆样品举到读取器前，一整面 LED 墙立即变成完全相同的颜色。
works.idea_en: Use a physical sample as a remote control for the color of a whole space.
works.idea_zh: 用一片实物样本，遥控整个空间的颜色。
works.technique: A camera reads the color of the held sample and maps it to the RGB output of the LEDs on the wall, with animated transitions.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头读取样本颜色，映射为墙上 LED 的 RGB 输出，并加入过渡动画。
works.exercise_en: Build a web page that samples the color of any object held in front of the phone camera and floods a projector or second screen with it. Twist: mix the colors of the last three objects into a gradient.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个网页，读取手机摄像头前任意物体的颜色，并让投影或第二块屏幕整个铺满这种颜色；变体：把最近三个物体的颜色混合成渐变。

video.video_title: Journey of Colour

works.title: KAWS:HOLIDAY Hong Kong
works.description: A 37-metre COMPANION floats on its back in Victoria Harbour in Hong Kong, moving between Tamar Park and Tsim Sha Tsui against the skyline.
works.description_zh: 一个 37 米长的 COMPANION 仰面漂浮在香港维多利亚港，在添马公园与尖沙咀之间移动，以天际线为背景。
works.idea_en: A floating giant that moves between harbour locations shows how an AR character can appear in different places on different days.
works.idea_zh: 一个在港口不同位置之间移动的漂浮巨人说明，AR 角色可以在不同日子出现在不同地点。
works.technique: The inflatable was mounted on a floating platform and towed between sites with the approval of harbour authorities.
works.technique_zh: 充气人偶安装在浮台上，经港务部门批准后在不同地点之间拖行。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR giant that appears at a different geolocated spot on campus each day, with a daily clue to find it. Twist: its route follows a real ferry or bus timetable.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个每天出现在校园不同地理位置的 AR 巨人，并每天发布寻找它的线索；变体：它的路线跟随真实的渡轮或公交时刻表。

video.video_title: KAWS:HOLIDAY HONG KONG

works.title: KAWS:HOLIDAY Japan
works.description: A 40-metre COMPANION lies on the grass of Fumotoppara campground with Mount Fuji behind it; visitors camp around the figure for a week.
works.description_zh: 一个 40 米长的 COMPANION 躺在富士山脚下麓原露营地的草地上，访客在它周围露营一周。
works.idea_en: Pairing a giant character with an iconic natural landmark gives every photo two anchors, a composition trick for AR.
works.idea_zh: 把巨型角色与标志性的自然地标搭配，让每张照片都有两个锚点，这是 AR 的构图技巧。
works.technique: An inflatable figure is anchored on the meadow, with camping infrastructure laid out around it.
works.technique_zh: 充气人偶固定在草地上，周围布置露营设施。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR character so it lines up with a real landmark (mountain, tower) from a marked photo spot. Twist: the character turns its head to look at the landmark at sunset.
works.exercise_zh: 放置一个 AR 角色，使其从标记好的拍照点看过去与真实地标（山、塔）对齐；变体：日落时角色会转头看向地标。

video.video_title: KAWS:HOLIDAY JAPAN

works.title: KAWS:HOLIDAY Taipei
works.description: A 36-metre seated COMPANION holding a smaller figure lies in Liberty Square in Taipei, in front of the Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall; the opening was organised with singer JJ Lin.
works.description_zh: 一个 36 米长、怀抱小人偶的坐姿 COMPANION 躺在台北自由广场、中正纪念堂前；开幕式与歌手林俊杰合作举办。
works.idea_en: A soft, casual giant in front of a formal monument changes how the square feels, a contrast AR creators can use deliberately.
works.idea_zh: 一个柔软随意的巨人放在庄重的纪念建筑前，改变了广场给人的感觉，AR 创作者可以有意使用这种对比。
works.technique: A giant inflatable is anchored on the square with ballast, lit at night.
works.technique_zh: 巨型充气人偶用压载物固定在广场上，夜间有灯光照明。
works.exercise_en: Place a relaxed giant AR character in front of the most formal building on campus and film reactions. Twist: the character sits up whenever someone takes a photo.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园最庄重的建筑前放一个姿态放松的巨型 AR 角色，拍下人们的反应；变体：每当有人拍照，角色就会坐起来。

video.video_title: 《KAWS:HOLIDAY》台北站開幕式 / Global Debut of “KAWS:HOLIDAY” in Taipei

works.title: KinoEight: 8-bit style post effect
works.description: A modern 3D scene is redrawn as a low-resolution image with an 8-color palette, dithering and tile-based color clash like old home computers.
works.description_zh: 现代三维场景被重绘成低分辨率画面：8 色调色板、抖动和按图块限制颜色，像老式家用电脑。
works.idea_en: Old hardware limits become a visual style.
works.idea_zh: 把老硬件的限制变成一种画风。
works.technique: A full-screen pass downsamples the image, picks the two best palette colors per 8x8 tile and dithers between them with a Bayer matrix.
works.technique_zh: 全屏后处理先降采样，再为每个 8x8 图块挑出两个最合适的调色板颜色，用 Bayer 矩阵在两者之间抖动。
works.exercise_en: Apply an 8-bit palette shader to the AR Foundation camera feed so the real room looks like a 1980s game screen. Twist: keep one real object in full color.
works.exercise_zh: 给 AR Foundation 的相机画面加一个 8 位调色板着色器，让真实房间看起来像 80 年代游戏画面。变体：只让一个真实物体保持全彩。

video.video_title: KinoEight - 8 bit-ish style post-processing effect for Unity HDRP https://t.co/MWRecHwp0o https://t.co/P9rZwtsQvW

works.title: LEGO Hidden Side
works.description: Physical LEGO sets such as a haunted school or graveyard are scanned by a phone app that reveals ghosts inside the model; players hunt them by moving around the build.
works.idea_zh: 拼好实体乐高，再用手机透视出藏在模型里的鬼魂。

video.video_title: LEGO Hidden Side Trailer | Comic-Con SD 2019

works.technique: The app recognizes the physical LEGO set (model or image-based tracking), and ghosts are rendered inside it with occlusion from a known digital model of the set.
works.exercise_zh: 用一个真实的纸盒模型和它的简化 3D 替身做遮挡，让 AR 幽灵躲在纸盒里的窗户后面；变体：打开真实盒子的某扇门会放出幽灵。
works.description_zh: 闹鬼的学校、墓地等实体乐高套装经手机应用扫描后，会显现出藏在模型里的鬼魂，玩家要绕着模型移动去搜寻它们。
works.idea_en: Build a physical LEGO set, then use a phone to see the ghosts hiding inside it.
works.technique_zh: 应用识别实体乐高套装（基于模型或图像追踪），并利用该套装已知的数字模型做遮挡，把鬼魂渲染在模型内部。
works.exercise_en: Use a real cardboard box model and a simplified 3D stand-in for occlusion so an AR ghost hides behind a window in the box. Twist: opening a door on the real box lets a ghost out.

works.title: Landmarkers
works.description: Lenses that recognise famous buildings such as the Eiffel Tower or Flatiron Building and transform their real facades with animation, e.g. making the structure melt or burst into rainbows.
works.idea_zh: 识别真实地标建筑，让整座埃菲尔铁塔在镜头里变形、融化、喷彩虹。

video.video_title: Introducing Landmarkers

works.technique: Landmark tracking matches the camera view to a prebuilt 3D model of a known building, so shaders and animations can be mapped precisely onto its real facade.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 的 Custom Landmarker 或图像追踪识别校园中一栋建筑立面，在它上面叠加融化或长草的动画；变体：让动画跟随真实时间变化。
works.description_zh: 这些镜头能识别埃菲尔铁塔、熨斗大厦等著名建筑，并用动画改造它们真实的立面，比如让建筑融化或迸发出彩虹。
works.idea_en: Recognize a real landmark and make the whole Eiffel Tower warp, melt or spray rainbows on camera.
works.technique_zh: 地标追踪把相机画面与已知建筑预先建好的 3D 模型匹配，从而把着色器和动画精确映射到其真实立面上。
works.exercise_en: Use Lens Studio's Custom Landmarker or image tracking to recognize a building facade on campus and overlay a melting or grass-growing animation on it. Twist: make the animation change with the real time of day.

salient.why_en: The real Eiffel Tower melts or sprays rainbows on camera, turning a monument into a toy.
salient.why_zh: 镜头里真实的埃菲尔铁塔融化或喷出彩虹，地标变成了玩具。

works.title: LaspVfx: audio-reactive VFX with LASP
works.description: Live audio is split into low, mid and high bands and drawn as three glowing waveforms and particle bursts that move with the music.
works.description_zh: 现场音频被分成低、中、高三个频段，画成三条发光的波形和随音乐跳动的粒子。
works.idea_en: Let the sound itself draw the shape.
works.idea_zh: 让声音自己画出形状。
works.technique: LASP captures low-latency audio input and filters it into bands; property binders push the waveform buffer and band levels into VFX Graph as textures and floats.
works.technique_zh: LASP 以低延迟采集音频并分频，属性绑定器把波形缓冲和各频段音量作为贴图和数值传给 VFX Graph。
works.exercise_en: Place a VFX Graph in AR Foundation that reads the phone microphone level and makes particles burst around a real speaker. Twist: map bass to particle size and treble to color, then play two songs and compare.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 放一个 VFX Graph，读取手机麦克风音量，让粒子围绕真实音箱爆开。变体：低音控制粒子大小、高音控制颜色，换两首歌对比效果。

video.video_title: Another example that uses LASP to render low/mid/high waveforms with a VFX graph. https://t.co/swflcCDYdg https://t.co/VCWoPRuqJR

works.title: Leytonstone TrailblazARs
works.description: A walking AR app along Leytonstone High Road where phones reveal dance, music and stories about the street's history, all created by local schoolgirls with Pell Ensemble.
works.description_zh: 一款沿 Leytonstone 大街步行使用的 AR 应用：举起手机就能看到关于这条街历史的舞蹈、音乐和故事，全部由当地女校学生与 Pell Ensemble 共同创作。
works.idea_en: Young residents hide their own dances in the history of their street.
works.idea_zh: 年轻居民把自己的舞蹈藏进街道的历史里。
works.technique: Students filmed performances and built the trail in Blippar, which triggers video and audio overlays when phones recognise images or locations on the high street.
works.technique_zh: 学生拍摄表演并用 Blippar 搭建路线：当手机识别到大街上的图像或地点时，便叠加视频和音频。
works.exercise_en: Pick five spots around school, film a ten-second dance at each that tells one fact about the place, and attach them as AR markers with a WebAR tool. Twist: the dance at the last stop must quote a move from each earlier stop.
works.exercise_zh: 在学校周边选五个地点，在每处拍一段十秒舞蹈讲述一个关于此地的事实，再用 WebAR 工具把它们挂到 AR 标记上；变体：最后一站的舞蹈必须引用前面每一站的一个动作。

video.video_title: Leytonstone TrailblazARs : The Making of

works.title: Light Wave Tree (Skopje)
works.description: A kinetic light installation for the Skopje Light Art District in North Macedonia: spinning, colour-lit strings form a glowing 'tree' of waves in a public space at night.
works.description_zh: 为北马其顿斯科普里光艺术区创作的动态光装置：旋转并被彩光照亮的弦，在夜晚的公共空间里组成一棵由波纹构成的发光“树”。
