works.idea_en: An organic form built from pure motion reads as alive; AR plants and creatures can also be made from motion rather than from detailed models.
works.idea_zh: 由纯粹运动构成的有机形态会被看作是活的；AR 里的植物和生物也可以用运动而不是精细模型来塑造。
works.technique: Multiple spinning strings are arranged as branches and lit by synchronised coloured strobes to create layered wave shapes.
works.technique_zh: 多根旋转的弦被布置成树枝状，用同步的彩色频闪光照亮，形成层层叠叠的波形。
works.exercise_en: Grow an AR tree in Lens Studio or Unity out of animated line waves (no meshes), placed on a real spot outside. Twist: the tree grows a new branch every time someone new looks at it.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Lens Studio 或 Unity 里用动画线条波（不用网格模型）长出一棵 AR 树，放在户外的一个真实位置；变体：每有一个新的人看它，它就长出一根新树枝。

video.video_title: Light Wave Tree

works.title: LightAnchors
works.description: Blinking point lights on everyday devices broadcast data; a phone camera decodes them and anchors live AR labels on thermostats, routers and cars.
works.idea_zh: 让设备上的小指示灯'闪'出数据，手机一照就浮现实时标签。

video.video_title: LightAnchors: Appropriating Point Lights for Spatially-Anchored Augmented Reality Interfaces

works.technique: LEDs blink in a known preamble pattern at frequencies detectable by a phone camera, and the app finds bright points across frames, decodes the temporal pattern into data, and anchors labels at the light's image position.
works.exercise_zh: 让 Arduino 或另一部手机的屏幕闪烁编码（如 8 位 ID），用手机摄像头逐帧检测亮点并解码，在亮点位置显示对应的 AR 标签；变体：把闪烁的信息做成“秘密消息”，只有扫到的人才能看到。
works.description_zh: 日常设备上闪烁的点光源在广播数据；手机摄像头将其解码，并在恒温器、路由器和汽车上锚定实时 AR 标签。
works.idea_en: Let a device's tiny indicator light blink out data, and a live label pops up when a phone looks at it.
works.technique_zh: LED 以手机摄像头可检测的频率、按已知前导码模式闪烁；应用在多帧中寻找亮点，把时间上的闪烁模式解码为数据，并在光点的图像位置锚定标签。
works.exercise_en: Have an Arduino or another phone's screen blink an encoded signal (such as an 8-bit ID), detect and decode the bright spot frame by frame with the phone camera, and show the matching AR label at its position. Twist: turn the blinking data into a 'secret message' only those who scan it can see.

works.title: Lightform LF2 and Lightform Creator
works.description: The LF2 projector-camera and Creator software scan a scene of objects and let designers select surfaces and apply animated effects in minutes.
works.idea_zh: 扫描一下场景，就能给每个物体表面选特效。

video.video_title: Lightform LF2 and LFC | Design Tools for Projection

works.technique: Captures a high-resolution scan from the projector's viewpoint so every pixel of the scan corresponds to a projector pixel, removing manual calibration.
works.exercise_zh: 把几个白色纸盒堆在桌上，用投影仪+OBS/MapMap为每个面分配不同颜色动画；变化：挪动一个盒子后在1分钟内重新对齐。
works.description_zh: LF2 投影相机一体机配合 Creator 软件，可以扫描摆满物体的场景，让设计师在几分钟内选中表面并添加动画效果。
works.idea_en: Scan a scene once and pick an effect for every object surface.
works.technique_zh: 从投影机的视点采集高分辨率扫描，让扫描图的每个像素都对应一个投影像素，从而省去手动标定。
works.exercise_en: Stack a few white paper boxes on a table and use a projector with OBS/MapMap to give each face a different color animation. Twist: move one box and realign everything within one minute.

works.title: Loki
works.description: A bi-directional mixed-reality telepresence system where teacher and learner can each switch between video, 3D capture and virtual-replica views to demonstrate physical tasks.
works.idea_zh: 师生双向混合现实远程教学，可在视频、3D和虚拟复本间切换。

video.video_title: Loki: Facilitating Remote Instruction of Physical Tasks Using Two-way MixedReality Telepresence

works.technique: Streams RGB-D point clouds of both spaces and lets either user record, annotate and replay 3D demonstrations inside the other's environment.
works.exercise_zh: 搭建两间教室间的视频通话+手机AR远程折纸课：老师的手部动作录成短视频挂在学生AR桌面上；变化：学生也能回传自己的错误动作让老师标注。
works.description_zh: 一个双向的混合现实远程临场系统：老师和学习者都可以在视频、3D 捕捉和虚拟复本视图之间切换，用来演示实体操作任务。
works.idea_en: Two-way mixed-reality remote teaching that switches between video, 3D and virtual replicas.
works.technique_zh: 串流双方空间的 RGB-D 点云，任一用户都可以在对方的环境中录制、标注和回放 3D 演示。
works.exercise_en: Set up a remote origami class between two classrooms using a video call plus phone AR, where the teacher's hand movements are recorded as short clips pinned to the student's AR desk. Twist: students can send back their own mistakes for the teacher to annotate.

works.title: Machine Hallucination
works.description: At ARTECHOUSE New York, walls and floor of a large room are filled with a moving 'dream' of the city generated by a neural network trained on millions of photographs of New York.
works.description_zh: 在纽约 ARTECHOUSE，一间大厅的墙面和地面铺满一段流动的城市「梦境」，由一个用数百万张纽约照片训练的神经网络生成。
works.idea_en: Walking through a model's latent space makes an invisible dataset feel like a place; AR can present data as an environment you stand inside rather than a chart.
works.idea_zh: 穿行于模型的潜在空间，让看不见的数据集变成一个地方：AR 可以把数据呈现为可以站在其中的环境，而不是图表。
works.technique: A GAN trained on a large photo archive of New York generates latent-space walks that are rendered and projection-mapped across walls and floor.
works.technique_zh: 用大量纽约照片训练的 GAN 生成潜在空间漫游，渲染后投影映射到墙面和地面上。
works.exercise_en: Collect 200 photos of your campus, train or fine-tune a small image model (or use an online GAN tool), and play the interpolation video on a floating AR panel at the real location. Twist: the interpolation step follows the user's walking speed.
works.exercise_zh: 收集 200 张校园照片，训练或微调一个小型图像模型（或使用在线 GAN 工具），把插值视频放在真实地点的漂浮 AR 面板上播放。变体：插值的步进跟随用户的行走速度。

video.video_title: MACHINE HALLUCINATION

works.title: Madame Tussauds Fame Cam
works.description: At Madame Tussauds London, visitors point a phone at 25 celebrity wax figures and watch them come to life, react to the visitor's facial expressions or transform the scene around them.
works.description_zh: 在伦敦杜莎夫人蜡像馆，观众把手机对准 25 尊名人蜡像，就能看到蜡像“活过来”、对观众的面部表情作出反应，或让周围场景发生变化。
works.idea_en: A wax figure that moves only when you look at it through your phone.
works.idea_zh: 只有透过手机看时才会动起来的蜡像。
works.technique: Object tracking on each wax figure anchors animated overlays, while front-camera face tracking lets the visitor's expressions trigger the figure's reactions.
works.technique_zh: 对每尊蜡像做物体追踪来锚定动画叠加层，同时用前置摄像头的人脸追踪，让观众的表情触发蜡像的反应。
works.exercise_en: Choose a statue or poster on campus and make a phone AR effect that makes it blink or speak when viewers smile at it. Twist: the statue only reacts to the second person who looks at it.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里选一座雕像或一张海报，做一个手机 AR 效果：观众对它微笑时，它会眨眼或开口说话；变体：雕像只对第二个看它的人作出反应。

video.video_title: Madame Tussaud Fame Cam

works.title: Manipulating 3D Anatomic Models in AR
works.description: A clinician whose hands are busy rotates and scales a 3D anatomy model in an AR headset using only head movement, compared with the usual hand-gesture approach.
works.description_zh: 双手正忙的临床医生仅靠头部动作，就能在 AR 头显中旋转和缩放三维解剖模型，研究将其与常规手势操作进行了比较。
works.idea_en: When your hands are busy, let your head drive the 3D model.
works.idea_zh: 双手没空的时候，就让头来操控三维模型。
works.technique: Maps head orientation and small head motions to rotation and scaling of a HoloLens hologram, with a hands-free mode switch.
works.technique_zh: 把头部朝向和细微的头部动作映射为 HoloLens 全息影像的旋转和缩放，并提供免手操作的模式切换。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR viewer where tilting the phone or your head rotates a 3D skull while you hold a pen in each hand, then time a labelling task. Twist: use voice to switch between rotate and zoom.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 查看器，双手各拿一支笔时，通过倾斜手机或头部来旋转一个三维头骨，并记录完成标注任务的时间；变体：用语音在旋转和缩放之间切换。

video.video_title: Manipulating 3D Anatomic Models in Augmented Reality

works.title: Marvellous Missenden
works.description: A proof-of-concept AR trail through the village of Great Missenden that places Roald Dahl quotations over the buildings and landscape that inspired them.
works.description_zh: 一条穿过大米森登村的 AR 步道原型：把罗尔德·达尔的名句叠加在当年启发他的建筑和风景上。
works.idea_en: Show readers the exact spot that inspired a line of a story.
works.idea_zh: 让读者看到启发某句故事的真实地点。
works.technique: An iOS ARKit app with geolocated points of interest superimposes text and illustrations on the village scenery at each stop of the trail.
works.technique_zh: 一款 iOS ARKit 应用，在步道每一站按地理位置把文字和插画叠加到村庄景色上。
works.exercise_en: Pick a book set in your city, find three real places mentioned in it, and make a location-based AR trail that places the quote in the sky above each place. Twist: let visitors add their own sentence at each stop for the next reader.
works.exercise_zh: 选一本以你所在城市为背景的书，找出书中提到的三个真实地点，做一条基于位置的 AR 步道，把引文放在每个地点上方的天空中；变体：让访客在每一站留下一句话给下一位读者。

video.video_title: Roald Dahl Marvellous Missenden

works.title: MeshToSDF
works.description: Particles swarm over and cling to an animated character as its mesh is converted into a signed distance field every frame and fed to Unity's VFX Graph.
works.description_zh: 粒子成群地附着在一个动画角色身上：角色网格每帧都被转换成有向距离场，再送进 Unity 的 VFX Graph。
works.idea_en: If a moving body becomes a distance field, particles can feel its surface.
works.idea_zh: 把运动的身体变成距离场，粒子就能“摸到”它的表面。
works.technique: A compute shader rasterises the mesh triangles into a 3D texture and runs a jump-flooding pass to fill it with distances, which VFX Graph's Conform to SDF and Collide with SDF blocks read in real time.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器把网格三角形光栅化进三维纹理，再用跳跃洪泛（jump flooding）填充距离值，VFX Graph 的 Conform to SDF 和 Collide with SDF 模块实时读取它。
works.exercise_en: Convert the ARKit body-tracking skeleton's skinned mesh (or the face mesh) to an SDF every frame and let VFX Graph particles cling to the user in AR. Twist: switch the particles from clinging to fleeing when the user claps.
works.exercise_zh: 每帧把 ARKit 人体追踪驱动的蒙皮网格（或人脸网格）转换成距离场，让 VFX Graph 粒子在 AR 中附着在用户身上。变体：用户拍手时，粒子从附着变成逃离。

video.video_title: Released the code for my real-time Mesh to SDF converter for Unity! https://t.co/jQGBRXJEql https://t.co/NFOFmwtIdo

works.title: Metaballs
works.description: Glossy liquid blobs float, merge and split apart like drops of mercury.
works.description_zh: 光亮的液体团块漂浮、融合又分开，像一滴滴水银。
works.idea_en: Blobs that merge smoothly feel alive.
works.idea_zh: 能平滑融合的团块看起来是活的。
works.technique: Metaballs are raymarched as a smooth-min union of sphere distance functions and shaded with environment reflections.
works.technique_zh: 用若干球体距离函数的 smooth-min 并集做光线步进渲染出 metaball，再用环境反射着色。
works.exercise_en: Float metaballs above a real table in AR and let each student's tracked hand be one of the balls. Twist: blobs reflect the real room using the AR environment probe.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中让 metaball 漂浮在真实桌面上方，每位学生被追踪的手就是其中一个球。变体：用 AR 环境探针让团块反射真实房间。

video.video_title: Unity | Metaballs

works.title: Minecraft Earth
works.description: Players collect blocks around their neighbourhood, build on tabletop 'build plates', then place builds at life size in the real world and play in them together.
works.idea_zh: 把我的世界的方块建筑以真实尺寸放在街头，大家一起进入。

video.video_title: Minecraft Earth: Apple WWDC Gameplay Reveal

works.technique: Build plates are authored at tabletop scale and rescaled to life size with the same anchor, while Azure Spatial Anchors let multiple players share the placement.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌上用 AR 方块搭一个小模型，一键放大到真实尺寸并走进去；变体：放大后另一位同学可以在同一位置看到它。
works.description_zh: 玩家在街区里收集方块，在桌面大小的“建造板”上搭建作品，再把它们以真实尺寸放到现实世界中，一起进去玩。
works.idea_en: Place Minecraft block builds life-size on the street and walk in together.
works.technique_zh: 建造板以桌面尺度制作，再沿用同一个锚点放大到真实尺寸；Azure Spatial Anchors 让多名玩家共享放置位置。
works.exercise_en: Build a small model from AR blocks on a table, then scale it to life size with one tap and walk inside. Twist: after scaling, another classmate can see it in the same spot.

works.title: Mirage Gstaad
works.description: For Elevation 1049 in Gstaad, Switzerland, the mirrored house moves to a snowy Alpine meadow, where it reflects mountains, snow and sky and changes with every season.
works.description_zh: 为瑞士格施塔德的 Elevation 1049 艺术节，这座镜面房屋来到白雪覆盖的阿尔卑斯草甸，映照群山、积雪和天空，并随季节而变。
works.idea_en: The same object in a new landscape becomes a new work, which shows why AR assets should be designed to take on the character of each site.
works.idea_zh: 同一件物体换到新的风景中就成了新作品，说明 AR 资产应当被设计成能吸收每个场地的特质。
works.technique: The mirror-clad structure was rebuilt on a mountain site and left through winter and summer so the reflected landscape transforms it.
works.technique_zh: 镜面结构在山区场地上重建，历经冬夏，让反射的风景不断改变它。
works.exercise_en: Use the same mirrored AR object in three different outdoor places (park, street, rooftop) and record how each site changes it. Twist: let the object keep a faint memory texture of the last place it was placed.
works.exercise_zh: 把同一个镜面 AR 物体放在三个不同的户外地点（公园、街道、屋顶），记录每个场地如何改变它；变体：让物体保留上一次放置地点的淡淡“记忆”纹理。

video.video_title: Doug Aitken: Mirage Gstaad

works.title: Mise-Unseen
works.description: In VR, objects are rearranged right inside the user's field of view without them noticing, because changes are applied only where eye tracking shows they are not looking or not paying attention.
works.description_zh: 在 VR 中，物体就在用户的视野里被重新摆放而不被察觉，因为只有当眼动追踪显示用户没在看或没注意时，改变才会发生。
works.idea_en: Change the world in plain sight by timing edits to the gaps in attention.
works.idea_zh: 抓住注意力的空隙，在众目睽睽之下改变世界。
works.technique: Gaze tracking builds models of attention, intention and spatial memory, and the system schedules scene changes in the periphery or during low-attention moments.
works.technique_zh: 通过眼动追踪建立注意力、意图和空间记忆模型，系统把场景变化安排在视野边缘或注意力低的时刻进行。
works.exercise_en: In a phone AR scene, change the colour of one virtual object only when it is off-screen, and ask classmates whether they notice. Twist: try doing it while they are reading a label.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 场景中，只在某个虚拟物体离开屏幕时改变它的颜色，询问同学是否察觉。变体：试着在他们阅读标签时进行改变。

video.video_title: Mise-Unseen: Using Eye Tracking to Hide Virtual Reality Scene Changes in Plain Sight

works.title: Mixed Reality Theater
works.description: During a live theater performance, audience members wearing AR glasses see virtual stage effects appear around the actors, triggered by the director.
works.description_zh: 现场戏剧演出中，观众戴着 AR 眼镜，看到导演触发的虚拟舞台特效出现在演员周围。
works.idea_en: Stage effects no longer need to be physical: every seat sees them through AR glasses.
works.idea_zh: 舞台特效不必再是实体的：每个座位都能透过 AR 眼镜看到它们。
works.technique: All headsets calibrate to a shared origin by scanning one tracked image, the director places effects that are stored as anchors on a server, and the server broadcasts cues so every device plays the effect at the same place and time.
works.technique_zh: 所有头显通过扫描同一张追踪图片校准到共同原点，导演摆放的特效以锚点形式存到服务器上，演出时服务器广播提示，让每台设备在同一位置、同一时刻播放特效。
works.exercise_en: Build a two-phone AR scene with image-target calibration and trigger a particle burst on both devices from a laptop cue. Twist: tie the cue to the stage lighting desk or a music beat.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像标记校准做一个双手机 AR 场景，并从笔记本电脑发送提示，同时在两台设备上触发粒子爆发。变体：把提示连到舞台灯光控台或音乐节拍上。

video.video_title: Mixed Reality theater performance (AI-Pollo)

works.title: Musical Chairs Against the Avengers in AR
works.description: A real game of musical chairs in which the other players are life-size virtual Avengers competing for real chairs.
works.idea_zh: 和真人尺寸的复仇者联盟一起抢真实的椅子。

video.video_title: I played musical chairs against the Avengers in AR

works.technique: Virtual characters are animated toward chair positions registered as anchors, with game logic comparing the player's camera position to those anchors when the music stops.
works.exercise_zh: 在房间里标记三把真椅子的位置，音乐停时让虚拟角色抢位，判断玩家（相机）是否先到达空椅；变体：把抢椅子改成抢一块真实的地毯或门口。
works.description_zh: 一场真实的抢椅子游戏，其他玩家是真人大小的虚拟复仇者，和你争抢真实的椅子。
works.idea_en: Fight life-size Avengers for real chairs.
works.technique_zh: 虚拟角色以动画方式跑向注册为锚点的椅子位置；音乐停止时，游戏逻辑比较玩家相机位置与这些锚点的关系。
works.exercise_en: Mark the positions of three real chairs in a room, have virtual characters race for seats when the music stops, and check whether the player (the camera) reaches an empty chair first. Twist: race for a real rug or doorway instead of chairs.

salient.why_en: Musical chairs where the rivals are life-size virtual Avengers competing for real chairs.
salient.why_zh: 抢椅子游戏里的对手是真人大小的虚拟复仇者，抢的却是真椅子。

works.title: MÆ – Motion Aftereffect
works.description: A solo performance about how XR changes the body: guided by internet monologues about VR gameplay, out-of-body experiences and avatar customisation, the performer moves between her body, a motion-captured avatar and a projected VR scene.
works.description_zh: 一场关于 XR 如何改变身体的独舞：伴随网上关于 VR 游戏、灵魂出窍和化身定制的独白，表演者在自己的身体、动作捕捉化身和投影的 VR 场景之间穿梭。
works.idea_en: Stage the gap between the body in the headset and the body in the room.
works.idea_zh: 把头显里的身体和房间里的身体之间的落差搬上舞台。
works.technique: The artist built a VR scene and motion-capture avatar that are projected live while she performs, combining ready-made 3D models with found audio monologues.
works.technique_zh: 艺术家自建 VR 场景和动作捕捉化身，演出时实时投影，并结合现成 3D 模型与网上找到的独白音频。
works.exercise_en: Have one student wear a phone VR headset in a simple WebXR scene while its view is cast to a projector, and a second student narrates what the first 'sees'. Twist: the narrator lies about the scene.
works.exercise_zh: 让一名学生戴手机 VR 头显进入简单的 WebXR 场景，画面投屏到投影仪，另一名学生讲述前者“看到”的东西；变体：讲述者故意说谎。

video.video_title: MÆ-Motion Aftereffect - Excerpts Trailer

works.title: New Horizon
works.description: A 30-metre mirrored hot-air balloon travelled across Massachusetts, rising at dawn and dusk to reflect the sky and land, with talks and music at each stop.
works.description_zh: 一只高 30 米的镜面热气球巡游马萨诸塞州，在黎明和黄昏升空，映照天空与大地，每一站都伴有讲座和音乐。
works.idea_en: A reflective object in the sky becomes a gathering point for a community, showing how a shared AR landmark can structure an event.
works.idea_zh: 天空中的反光物体成为社区聚集的焦点，说明共享的 AR 地标可以组织一场活动。
works.technique: A hot-air balloon envelope made of reflective fabric flies tethered and in free flight, lit at night from within.
works.technique_zh: 由反光织物制成的热气球球囊进行系留和自由飞行，夜间由内部照亮。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a large reflective AR sphere in the sky above a school event and let everybody's phone show the same sphere with synchronised lighting. Twist: the sphere rises higher as more people look at it.
works.exercise_zh: 在学校活动上空锚定一个巨大的反光 AR 球体，让所有人的手机看到同一个球体并同步灯光；变体：看它的人越多，它升得越高。

video.video_title: Doug Aitken - NEW HORIZON

works.title: Night Terrors: Bloody Mary
works.description: A follow-up that brings the Bloody Mary legend into the player's home, with the ghost stalking them through the phone's AR view.
works.idea_zh: 把血腥玛丽传说带进你家，鬼魂在AR中跟踪你。

video.video_title: Night Terrors: Bloody Mary Mobile AR Horror Game Trailer

works.technique: ARKit or ARCore world tracking lets a ghost character move through room space relative to the player, with audio cues giving direction.
works.exercise_zh: 让一个 AR 角色在你背后移动，只能通过声音判断它的位置，转身时它躲到视野外；变体：用前置摄像头检测你是否在“镜子”前。
works.description_zh: 续作把“血腥玛丽”传说带进玩家家中，鬼魂通过手机的 AR 画面一路尾随玩家。
works.idea_en: Bring the Bloody Mary legend into your home, with a ghost stalking you in AR.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 或 ARCore 世界追踪让鬼魂角色在房间空间中相对玩家移动，并用声音提示指示方向。
works.exercise_en: Have an AR character move behind you so you can only locate it by sound, and make it hide out of view when you turn around. Twist: use the front camera to detect whether you are standing in front of a 'mirror'.

works.title: NightBloom at the Conservatory of Flowers
works.description: An immersive night event at San Francisco's Conservatory of Flowers where projections wash over living plants and glasshouse structures.
works.idea_zh: 把投影打在真实植物上，让温室在夜里“开花”。

video.video_title: NightBloom: Lightform at The Conservatory Of Flowers

works.technique: Uses scan-based alignment to project organic animated textures onto irregular foliage and architecture.
works.exercise_zh: 在教室里把投影打在一盆植物上，投射缓慢变化的色彩和光点；变化：用手机麦克风让植物上的光随说话声“呼吸”。
works.description_zh: 旧金山花卉温室举办的一场沉浸式夜间活动，投影光影流淌在活体植物和玻璃温室结构上。
works.idea_en: Project onto real plants so the greenhouse 'blooms' at night.
works.technique_zh: 利用基于扫描的对齐，把有机感的动画纹理投射到不规则的枝叶和建筑上。
works.exercise_en: Project slowly shifting colors and points of light onto a potted plant in the classroom. Twist: use the phone microphone so the light on the plant 'breathes' with people's voices.

works.title: NoiseBall5: mesh deformed by the Job System
works.description: A sphere wobbles and ripples with noise every frame, its vertices moved by multithreaded C# jobs; it also runs on iPhone.
works.description_zh: 一个球体每帧随噪声起伏抖动，顶点由多线程 C# 任务推动，在 iPhone 上也能运行。
works.idea_en: A living blob is just noise applied to vertices.
works.idea_zh: 一个活物般的团块，就是给顶点加上噪声。
works.technique: Unity's new Mesh API writes vertex data from Burst-compiled C# jobs directly into the mesh buffer, avoiding extra copies.
works.technique_zh: Unity 新的 Mesh API 让 Burst 编译的 C# 任务直接把顶点数据写进网格缓冲区，省去额外拷贝。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a noise-deformed sphere to a real object with AR Foundation image tracking and let it pulse. Twist: drive the noise strength with the microphone.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 图像追踪把一个噪声变形的球固定在真实物体上，让它脉动。变体：用麦克风音量控制噪声强度。

video.video_title: NoiseBall5 - Unity 2019.3 new Mesh API example with C# Job System. Now you can generate/modify meshes using Burst-compiled and threaded jobs without extra memory copying. https://t.co/zSlEfPhmv5 https

works.title: Notable Women
works.description: With Google and former US Treasurer Rosie Rios, the app puts portraits of historic American women onto US banknotes in AR.
works.idea_zh: 用AR把杰出女性的头像印到美元上

video.video_title: Notable Women | Interactive AR | Nexus Studios

works.technique: ARCore augmented images detect banknote designs and replace the printed portrait region with a warped, lit portrait of a historic woman.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪识别一张钞票或证件照，替换其中的头像为一位你认为值得纪念但被忽视的人；变体：配一段 15 秒语音讲述这个人为什么应该在这里。
works.description_zh: 这款应用由 Google 与前美国财政部司库 Rosie Rios 合作推出，用 AR 把美国历史上杰出女性的肖像放到美元钞票上。
works.idea_en: Use AR to print portraits of notable women onto US dollars.
works.technique_zh: ARCore 增强图像识别钞票图案，并用经过变形和打光处理的历史女性肖像替换原本印刷的肖像区域。
works.exercise_en: Use image tracking to recognize a banknote or ID photo and replace the portrait with someone you think deserves remembrance but has been overlooked. Twist: add a 15-second voice clip explaining why this person belongs there.

salient.why_en: AR puts portraits of historic women onto US banknotes, asking who deserves to be on money.
salient.why_zh: AR 把历史上杰出女性的肖像印到美元上，追问谁才配出现在钞票上。

works.title: Now at the Dawn of My Life
works.description: On Apple's [AR]T Walk, bold rainbow-coloured words from Giorno's poems rise and float in the street, forming a journey of homespun wisdom against the city backdrop.
works.description_zh: 在 Apple [AR]T Walk 上，Giorno 诗句中醒目的彩虹色文字在街头升起、漂浮，在城市背景中铺出一段充满朴素智慧的旅程。
works.idea_en: Poetry becomes a rainbow sculpture of words in the street.
works.idea_zh: 诗歌化作街头的彩虹文字雕塑。
works.technique: Location-anchored ARKit scene of extruded 3D typography animated in rainbow gradients, following the style of Giorno's text paintings.
works.technique_zh: 锚定位置的 ARKit 场景，用挤出的 3D 文字配合彩虹渐变动画，延续 Giorno 文字画作的风格。
works.exercise_en: Write a four-line poem and place each line as 3D text at a different spot on a walking route using Lens Studio or WebXR. Twist: each line only appears when the previous one has been read aloud.
works.exercise_zh: 写一首四行诗，用 Lens Studio 或 WebXR 把每一行做成 3D 文字，放在步行路线的不同地点；变体：只有把上一行大声读出来，下一行才会出现。

video.video_title: [AR]T ウォーク@新宿：今、人生の夜明けにおいて

works.title: On the Shoulder of the Giant
works.description: The local AR user carries a miniature remote collaborator on their shoulder, who sees the world from that perspective and guides the work.
works.idea_zh: 把远方的同伴'放'在你肩膀上，和你同一视角一起干活。

video.video_title: On the Shoulder of the Giant: A Multi-Scale Mixed Reality Collaboration

works.technique: A miniature avatar of the remote collaborator is attached to the local user's tracked head or shoulder pose, and the remote viewpoint is rendered from that attached position so both share nearly the same perspective.
works.exercise_zh: 在 HoloKit 或手机 AR 中把一个小化身固定在屏幕左上方（模拟“肩膀上”），远端同学通过看你的摄像头画面给出指引，化身同步做出指向动作；变体：让肩膀上的化身是“过去的你”，播放你之前录下的提示。
works.description_zh: 本地 AR 用户的肩膀上“扛着”一个缩小版的远程协作者，对方从这个视角观察世界并指导工作。
works.idea_en: Put a distant partner on your shoulder so you work together from the same viewpoint.
works.technique_zh: 远程协作者的缩小化身附着在本地用户被追踪的头部或肩部姿态上，远端视角从这个附着位置渲染，使双方几乎共享同一视角。
works.exercise_en: Pin a small avatar to the top-left of the screen in HoloKit or phone AR (to mimic 'on the shoulder'), and have a remote classmate watch your camera feed and give directions while the avatar points along. Twist: make the shoulder avatar a 'past you' that plays back hints you recorded earlier.

works.title: Paper Classifier (openFrameworks + Wekinator)
works.description: Holding a sheet of paper in front of a webcam in five different ways triggers five different particle-system visuals, each with its own song.
works.description_zh: 拿着一张纸以五种不同方式出现在摄像头前，就会触发五种不同的粒子视觉效果，各自配一首歌。
works.idea_en: A plain piece of paper becomes a five-button controller once the camera learns its shapes.
works.idea_zh: 摄像头学会了纸的形状后，一张普通的纸就变成了有五个按钮的控制器。
works.technique: Webcam features are sent over OSC to Wekinator, which is trained on five classes of paper poses; the recognised class is sent back to an openFrameworks particle system that switches visuals and music.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头提取的特征通过 OSC 发给 Wekinator，训练它识别五类纸张姿态；识别结果再发回 openFrameworks 的粒子系统，切换画面和音乐。
works.exercise_en: Train Teachable Machine on three ways of holding a notebook and use each class to change a p5.js scene and sound. Twist: make the scene react only when two students hold their papers the same way.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Teachable Machine 训练三种拿笔记本的姿势，每一类切换一个 p5.js 场景和声音；变体：只有两名学生用同样方式举纸时场景才会响应。

video.video_title: OpenFrameworks - Computer vision - Particle System - Machine Learning - OSC control

works.title: Particles Face
works.description: The tracked face dissolves into a flowing compute-shader particle cloud.
works.idea_zh: 把追踪到的人脸分解成流动的粒子云。

video.video_title: Particles Face

works.technique: Face-mesh vertices are sampled as spawn points for a compute-shader particle system, and curl noise advects the particles away so the face appears to dissolve.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 的顶点作为粒子发射点，在 three.js 中让粒子随噪声飘散；变体：张嘴时脸部整体消散，闭嘴时重新聚合。
works.description_zh: 被追踪的人脸消散成一团流动的计算着色器粒子云。
works.idea_en: Break a tracked face apart into a flowing cloud of particles.
works.technique_zh: 对人脸网格的顶点进行采样，作为计算着色器粒子系统的发射点，再用旋度噪声把粒子带走，让脸看起来在溶解。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Face Mesh vertices as particle emitters and let the particles drift away on noise in three.js. Twist: the whole face dissolves when the mouth opens and gathers again when it closes.

works.title: Phaser
works.description: A drawing machine whose linked rotating arms guide a pen to trace dense, evolving geometric patterns on paper, recording the machine's motion as a drawing.
works.description_zh: 一台绘图机器，联动的旋转臂引导笔在纸上描出密集而不断演化的几何图案，把机器的运动记录成一幅画。
works.idea_en: The drawing is a record of motion over time; AR can leave persistent trails that turn movement into a lasting artefact.
works.idea_zh: 画作是运动随时间留下的记录；AR 可以留下持续的轨迹，把运动变成可保存的作品。
works.technique: Two or more rotating arms with slightly different periods combine like a harmonograph, so the pen path slowly precesses into a complex figure (year approximate).
works.technique_zh: 两根或多根周期略有不同的旋转臂像谐振记录仪一样组合，笔的路径缓慢进动，形成复杂图形（年份为估计）。
works.exercise_en: Attach a virtual pen to two rotating virtual arms on a real table in phone AR and let it draw a persistent line. Twist: let viewers nudge one arm's speed with a slider and compare drawings.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中给真桌上的两根虚拟旋转臂装一支虚拟笔，让它画出持久的线。变体：让观众用滑块微调其中一根臂的速度，并比较不同的画。

video.video_title: Phaser - Kinetic art sculpture by Jennifer Townley (drawingmachine)

works.title: Physarum with Vector Fields
works.description: Slime-mould agents spread their glowing trails across the screen, but an embedded vector field bends their paths into swirling, combed patterns.
works.description_zh: 黏菌智能体在屏幕上铺开发光的痕迹，而嵌入的矢量场把它们的路径弯成旋转、梳理过一般的图案。
works.idea_en: Add one outside force to an emergent system and it starts drawing with intent.
works.idea_zh: 给一个涌现系统加上一股外力，它就开始有意图地作画。
works.technique: A Unity compute shader implements Jeff Jones's Physarum model (sense, rotate, move, deposit, diffuse, decay); the vector-field variant adds a flow term to each agent's heading (the variant is likely an extension of the published repo).
works.technique_zh: Unity 计算着色器实现了 Jeff Jones 的黏菌模型（感知、转向、移动、沉积、扩散、衰减）；矢量场版本在每个智能体的朝向上加了一项流场分量（这个变体很可能是在公开仓库基础上的扩展）。
works.exercise_en: Run the Physarum simulation on a texture laid over an AR floor and derive the vector field from the phone's movement, so walking combs the slime. Twist: use the room's LiDAR depth edges as walls the agents cannot cross.
works.exercise_zh: 把黏菌模拟跑在铺在 AR 地面上的纹理里，并用手机的移动生成矢量场，让走动去“梳理”黏菌。变体：把房间 LiDAR 深度的边缘当作智能体无法穿越的墙。

video.video_title:
First attempt to embed vector fields into Physarum visualization

#madewithunity #unity3d #creativecoding #generative #generativeart https://t.co/AmSksVOuvp

works.title: Pixelation with Human Segmentation
works.description: People are cut out of the scene with ARKit3 segmentation and re-rendered as moving pixel mosaics.
works.idea_zh: 把画面里的人抠出来，变成流动的像素马赛克。

video.video_title: Pixelation with Human Segmentation

works.technique: ARKit 3 person segmentation outputs a human stencil mask, and a shader pixelates only the masked region of the camera image.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation 抠出人物，只对人物区域做马赛克像素化；变体：像素块大小随人离镜头的距离变化。
works.description_zh: 用 ARKit 3 的人像分割把人从场景中抠出来，再重新渲染成流动的像素马赛克。
works.idea_en: Cut people out of the frame and turn them into flowing pixel mosaics.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 3 人像分割输出人体模板蒙版，着色器只对相机画面中被蒙版覆盖的区域做像素化。
works.exercise_en: Cut out people with MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation and pixelate only the person region. Twist: the pixel block size changes with the person's distance from the camera.

works.title: Pokémon GO Snapshot
works.description: An AR photo mode where players place their Pokémon in the real world, approach and pose it, and take pictures; wild Pokémon sometimes photobomb the shot.
works.idea_zh: 在现实中给宝可梦拍写真，偶尔还会有野生宝可梦乱入。

video.video_title: Snap the perfect picture with Pokémon GO!

works.technique: A character is placed on a detected plane, and a photo mode lets the user move closer and frame the shot, with scripted random events adding a second character.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 拍照模式，拍照时有 20% 的概率冒出一个“乱入者”；变体：乱入者会根据画面中是否有人脸做出不同动作。
works.description_zh: 一个 AR 拍照模式：玩家把自己的宝可梦放到现实世界里，走近、摆好姿势再拍照，野生宝可梦有时还会突然乱入画面。
works.idea_en: Take photos of your Pokémon in the real world, with the odd wild Pokémon photobombing.
works.technique_zh: 角色被放置在检测到的平面上，拍照模式让用户靠近并构图，脚本化的随机事件会加入第二个角色。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR photo mode where a 'photobomber' has a 20% chance of popping up when a picture is taken. Twist: the photobomber acts differently depending on whether a face is in the frame.

works.title: Preemptive Action
works.description: Electrical muscle stimulation fires the user's arm a few milliseconds before they would react to a stimulus, speeding reaction time while the user still feels they moved by themselves.
works.idea_zh: 电刺激在你反应之前替你动手，但你仍觉得是自己动的。

video.video_title: Preemptive Action : Accelerating Human Reaction using Electrical Muscle Stimulation Without Compromising Agency

works.technique: Triggers EMS at a tuned latency just before the user's natural reaction, finding the window where the action is faster yet still judged as self-caused.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机做一个“看到信号就拍桌”的反应小游戏，并让同伴在你身后用轻拍肩膀提前提示；变化：比较提示和不提示时你是否觉得“是自己做的”。
works.description_zh: 肌肉电刺激在用户对刺激做出反应前几毫秒驱动其手臂，缩短反应时间，而用户仍觉得是自己在动。
works.idea_en: Electrical stimulation moves your hand before you react, yet you still feel you did it yourself.
works.technique_zh: 在用户自然反应之前以调校好的延迟触发 EMS，寻找一个动作更快、却仍被判定为自己发起的时间窗口。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone reaction game where you slap the table when a signal appears, and have a partner behind you give an early cue by tapping your shoulder. Twist: compare whether you feel 'I did it' with and without the cue.

works.title: ProcCharVfx: procedural letters and Matrix rain
works.description: Columns of invented glyphs rain down the screen like the Matrix; every letter is generated by a shader rather than drawn from a font.
works.description_zh: 一列列虚构的字符像《黑客帝国》那样往下落，每个字都是着色器生成的，不是字体。
works.idea_en: Generate an alphabet instead of loading one.
works.idea_zh: 字母表可以生成，而不是加载。
works.technique: A Shader Graph builds each glyph from a random seed on a small grid of strokes; VFX Graph spawns thousands of quads and passes each a seed so every character is unique.
works.technique_zh: Shader Graph 用随机种子在小网格上组合笔画生成字符，VFX Graph 生成成千上万个面片并给每个面片一个种子，所以每个字都不同。
works.exercise_en: Make a procedural glyph shader and pour glyph rain down a real wall in AR Foundation, using plane detection to find the wall. Twist: let the rain part around people's silhouettes.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个程序化字符着色器，用 AR Foundation 的平面检测找到真实墙面，让字符雨沿墙落下。变体：字符雨遇到人的轮廓时会分开绕过。

video.video_title: Matrix rain effect with procedurally generated letters (Unity Shader Graph and VFX Graph) https://t.co/imVPrzYHXI https://t.co/xziUzSx8my

works.title: Project North Star: Strange Attractors in VFX Graph
works.description: Thomas and Lorenz strange attractors, drawn by thousands of VFX Graph particles, hang in the air in front of the wearer of a Project North Star AR headset.
works.description_zh: 由成千上万个 VFX Graph 粒子画出的 Thomas 与 Lorenz 奇异吸引子，悬浮在佩戴 Project North Star AR 头显的人眼前。
works.idea_en: Let a chaotic equation, not an animator, choreograph a swarm of light in the room.
works.idea_zh: 让一个混沌方程而不是动画师，来编排房间里的一群光点。
works.technique: In the VFX Graph update context each particle's velocity is computed from the attractor's differential equations (Thomas cyclically symmetric and Lorenz systems), so the swarm traces the attractor's shape as it moves.
works.technique_zh: 在 VFX Graph 的 Update 阶段，用吸引子的微分方程（Thomas 循环对称系统和 Lorenz 系统）计算每个粒子的速度，粒子群在运动中就描出了吸引子的形状。
works.exercise_en: Place a Lorenz-attractor particle system on a detected table with AR Foundation and view it on a phone or HoloKit. Twist: map the attractor's parameters to your distance from it, so walking closer reshapes the chaos.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 检测桌面，在上面放一个 Lorenz 吸引子粒子系统，用手机或 HoloKit 观看。变体：把吸引子的参数和你与它的距离绑定，走近时混沌的形状随之改变。

video.video_title: Project North Star Demo 3: Attractors using Visual Effect Graph

works.title: Project North Star: VFX Graph with RealSense
works.description: Seen through the open-source Project North Star AR headset, the room captured by an Intel RealSense depth camera is redrawn as a cloud of glowing VFX Graph particles floating over the real space.
works.description_zh: 透过开源 AR 头显 Project North Star 看出去，Intel RealSense 深度相机拍到的房间被重新画成一团发光的 VFX Graph 粒子，漂浮在真实空间之上。
works.idea_en: Feed a live depth camera back into an AR headset so the room itself becomes particle material.
works.idea_zh: 把实时深度相机的数据送回 AR 头显，让房间本身变成粒子的原材料。
works.technique: Keijiro Takahashi's Rsvfx converts each RealSense depth and colour frame into position and colour maps, which VFX Graph samples to spawn particles; the scene is rendered for North Star's see-through reflectors with Leap Motion's North Star rig.
works.technique_zh: 借助 Keijiro Takahashi 的 Rsvfx，把 RealSense 每帧的深度和颜色转换成位置贴图与颜色贴图，由 VFX Graph 采样生成粒子；再用 Leap Motion 的 North Star 相机设置渲染到头显的半透反射镜上。
works.exercise_en: Stream the iPhone LiDAR depth map into a VFX Graph (AR Foundation plus a Keijiro-style depth-to-position map) and redraw the room as drifting points on the phone or in HoloKit. Twist: when you stand still, let the points slowly fall to the floor like sand.
works.exercise_zh: 把 iPhone LiDAR 深度图送进 VFX Graph（AR Foundation 加上 Keijiro 式的深度转位置贴图），在手机或 HoloKit 里把房间重画成漂浮的点。变体：当你站着不动时，让这些点像沙子一样慢慢落到地上。

video.video_title: Project North Star Demo 4: Visual Effect Graph with RealSense

works.title: Project Play (Magic Leap)
works.description: A throwback to his Magic Leap app where you could draw, animate and even program objects directly in mixed reality.
works.idea_zh: 在头显里直接画、做动画、甚至编程。

video.video_title: Throwback to my Magic Leap app “Project Play“ where you could draw, animate, and program anything! Eventually DoodleLens will include these concepts, just in a much easier way https://t.co/KCIDN7Q9I5

works.technique: Controller-driven 3D drawing strokes become objects that can be keyframed and given simple behaviors in Unity on Magic Leap.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Quest/手机 AR 画 3D 线条，再给线条加一个'跟随我'的行为；加一个变化：两条线相碰时发声。
works.description_zh: 回顾他当年的 Magic Leap 应用：你可以直接在混合现实中绘画、制作动画，甚至给物体编程。
works.idea_en: Draw, animate and even program directly inside a headset.
works.technique_zh: 在 Magic Leap 上的 Unity 中，用手柄画出的 3D 笔画变成物体，可以设置关键帧并赋予简单的行为。
works.exercise_en: Draw 3D lines in Quest or phone AR, then give a line a 'follow me' behavior. Twist: play a sound when two lines touch.

works.title: Propagason
works.description: An interactive installation that asks visitors to speak or sing their wishes into the sky; each voice becomes a ring of light that travels outward through space, joining a collective picture of everyone's sounds.
works.description_zh: 一件互动装置，邀请观众把愿望说出来或唱给天空；每一个声音都化作一圈向外传播的光环，汇入由所有人声音组成的集体画面。
works.idea_en: Send your voice into space and watch it travel.
works.idea_zh: 把你的声音送上太空，看它一路远去。
works.technique: Microphone input is analysed in real time and drives the size and brightness of expanding particle rings, likely built with Gamgie's Oxipital/TouchDesigner pipeline.
works.technique_zh: 实时分析麦克风输入，驱动不断扩散的粒子光环的大小和亮度，很可能基于 Gamgie 的 Oxipital/TouchDesigner 流程制作。
works.exercise_en: Make a 'voice to the sky' projection in p5.js: each sound above a threshold spawns a ring whose size follows loudness and whose colour follows pitch. Twist: rings from two voices at once merge into one.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 做一个“向天空发声”的投影：每个超过阈值的声音生成一个光环，大小随音量、颜色随音高变化。变体：两个人同时发声时，光环合二为一。

video.video_title: Propagason

works.title: Pull a 3D model out of the monitor like a drawer
works.description: While modeling on a desktop editor, he reaches toward the monitor and slides the 3D model out as if opening a drawer, so it lands at full size on the real desk for review.
works.description_zh: 在桌面 3D 软件里建模时，他把手伸向显示器，像拉开抽屉一样把模型拉出来，模型以真实尺寸落在桌面上供查看。
works.idea_en: A monitor is a drawer: pull to take the 3D model out into the world, push to put it back.
works.idea_zh: 显示器就是抽屉：拉一下把 3D 模型拿到现实中，推一下再放回去。
works.technique: The monitor's position is calibrated in passthrough AR, the editor's current mesh is mirrored into Unity, and a hand-tracked pull along the screen normal drives the drawer motion (likely a constrained slider joint).
works.technique_zh: 在透视 AR 中标定显示器的位置，把编辑器里的当前网格同步到 Unity，手沿屏幕法线方向的拉动驱动抽屉式运动（可能用了受约束的滑动关节）。
works.exercise_en: Prototype a phone-AR 'drawer' on a laptop: detect the screen with an image marker and let a swipe toward the camera slide a 3D object out onto the table. Twist: the object keeps the scale it had on screen until you let go.
works.exercise_zh: 在笔记本电脑上做一个手机 AR“抽屉”：用图像标记识别屏幕，朝镜头方向滑动就把 3D 物体拉到桌面上。变体：松手前物体保持屏幕上的尺寸，松手后才变成真实大小。

video.video_title: Pulling a 3D model from an editor display(e.g. Maya, C4D) to a real-world environment, as if the screen is a drawer. Fun and useful for industrial designers, 3D artists, and architects to quickly view

works.title: Pull a sticky note out of an iPad
works.description: He sketches a sticky note on an iPad, then pinches its edge and pulls it out of the screen into the room, where it springs free like a note slipped out of a book; a six-year-old understood it at once.
works.description_zh: 他在 iPad 上画一张便签，然后捏住边缘把它从屏幕里拉出来放进房间，便签像从书页里抽出的纸条一样带着弹性脱离；一个六岁的孩子也一看就会。
works.idea_en: The tablet screen becomes a book you can pull pages out of, bridging 2D creation and 3D placement.
works.idea_zh: 把平板屏幕当成一本书，可以把画好的页面直接抽出来放进空间，连接 2D 创作和 3D 摆放。
works.technique: Passthrough AR (ZED Mini on a Rift) plus Leap Motion hand tracking; the iPad's drawing is streamed to Unity and a spring joint animates the note as it leaves the registered screen plane.
works.technique_zh: 用 ZED Mini 加 Rift 实现透视 AR，Leap Motion 追踪手势；iPad 上的画面同步到 Unity，便签离开已标定的屏幕平面时由弹簧关节驱动动画。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebAR page where a doodle drawn on the phone screen can be flicked up to become a note pinned in the room. Twist: notes stick only to vertical surfaces and fall off horizontal ones.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 WebAR 页面：在手机屏幕上画的涂鸦，往上一划就变成钉在房间里的便签。变体：便签只能贴在竖直表面，放在水平面上会掉下来。

video.video_title: Draw a sticky note on an iPad and then pull it out into the AR world. I added little spring force and try to make the transition feel like pulling a physical note out of a book. Tested on a 6-year-old

salient.why_en: You pinch a sketch and pull it out of the iPad screen like a page from a book, which a child grasps at once.
salient.why_zh: 捏住平板上的草图，像从书里抽出一页纸一样把它拉进房间，孩子一看就懂。

works.title: Raymarching in Unity
works.description: Smooth distance-field shapes blend into each other inside a Unity scene and cast shadows onto normal meshes.
works.description_zh: 距离场定义的光滑形体在 Unity 场景里彼此融合，并把阴影投到普通网格上。
works.idea_en: Mix raymarched shapes with ordinary geometry so both live in one world.
works.idea_zh: 把光线步进的形体和普通几何混在一起，让两者处在同一个世界。
works.technique: A shader raymarches signed distance functions with smooth-min blending, writes depth so meshes occlude correctly, and samples Unity's shadow maps on the raymarched volumes.
works.technique_zh: 着色器对带 smooth-min 融合的有符号距离函数做光线步进，写入深度让网格正确遮挡，并在步进体上采样 Unity 的阴影贴图。
works.exercise_en: Render a raymarched blob on a real table in phone AR, writing depth so the AR occlusion works. Twist: let the blob melt into the table where it touches it.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中把一个光线步进的团块放到真实桌面上，并写入深度让遮挡正确。变体：团块碰到桌面的地方会融进去。

video.video_title: Raymarching Unity

works.title: Rcam at Channel #20 (live with umio)
works.description: A depth camera on stage streams a volumetric point cloud of the performer into Unity, where VFX Graph particles dissolve and rebuild her body in real time for a live concert.
works.idea_zh: 把舞台上的人实时扫成点云，再让粒子把人拆散、重组，成为现场演出的视觉。

video.video_title: Live performance with umio at Channel 20, Compilation of social media video posts

works.technique: A RealSense depth camera sends color+depth frames to Unity, which converts them into a point cloud that drives VFX Graph particles projected behind the performer.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Kinect/手机深度或 MediaPipe 人体分割把一位同学变成粒子剪影投影在墙上；加一个变化：音乐音量越大粒子越散。
works.description_zh: 舞台上的深度相机把表演者的体积点云串流进 Unity，VFX Graph 粒子在现场演唱会中实时将她的身体拆散又重建。
works.idea_en: Scan a performer into a live point cloud, then let particles tear the body apart and rebuild it as concert visuals.
works.technique_zh: RealSense 深度相机把彩色和深度帧发送给 Unity，转换成点云，驱动投影在表演者身后的 VFX Graph 粒子。
works.exercise_en: Use Kinect, phone depth or MediaPipe body segmentation to turn a classmate into a particle silhouette projected on the wall. Twist: the louder the music, the more the particles scatter.

works.title: Real Life Doodles (Creator Cam)
works.description: An AR app built in a week-long devlog that turns flat doodles into objects living in the real world.
works.idea_zh: 把随手涂鸦变成真实空间里的 AR 物体。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Devlog #2 | Real Life Doodles

works.technique: A photographed doodle is segmented from the white paper (thresholding or background removal) and applied as a cutout texture to a billboard or extruded mesh placed with plane detection.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍一张纸上涂鸦，去白底后作为贴图放到桌面上并让它轻轻弹跳；变体：给涂鸦加一个简单骨骼让它走路。
works.description_zh: 一个在为期一周的开发日志中做出来的 AR 应用，把平面涂鸦变成生活在真实世界里的物体。
works.idea_en: Turn quick doodles into AR objects in real space.
works.technique_zh: 把拍下的涂鸦从白纸背景中分割出来（阈值处理或去背景），作为镂空纹理贴到公告板或挤出网格上，再通过平面检测放置。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a doodle on paper with a phone, remove the white background, place it on a tabletop as a texture and make it bounce gently. Twist: give the doodle a simple skeleton so it can walk.

works.title: Real-time Raytracing x AR (Apollo 11)
works.description: A tribute to the 50th anniversary of the Apollo 11 landing: while moon-landing footage plays on a living-room TV, raytraced moon rocks float around the screen and through the real room, as if they had escaped the footage.
works.description_zh: 为阿波罗 11 号登月 50 周年致敬：客厅电视播放登月影像时，光线追踪渲染的月球岩石漂浮在屏幕周围和真实房间里，仿佛是从影像中逃出来的。
works.idea_en: Let objects from the film on your TV float out into your living room.
works.idea_zh: 让电视画面里的东西飘进你的客厅。
works.technique: Unity's HDRP with NVIDIA RTX raytracing renders reflective rocks composited over tracked camera footage (ARKit/ARCore-style tracking); likely an offline-tracked real-time render rather than a phone app.
works.technique_zh: 用 Unity HDRP 和 NVIDIA RTX 光线追踪渲染带反射的岩石，再叠加到经过追踪的实拍画面上（类似 ARKit/ARCore 的追踪）；很可能是离线追踪加实时渲染，而非手机应用。
works.exercise_en: Make something escape from a screen: play a short clip on a monitor and, with an image target on the monitor frame, spawn AR objects that fly out when the clip reaches a certain moment. Twist: the objects fly back when the video is paused.
works.exercise_zh: 让东西从屏幕里逃出来：在显示器上播放一段短片，在显示器边框上放图像目标，短片播到某一刻时就有 AR 物体飞出来。变体：视频暂停时它们飞回去。

video.video_title: Real-time Raytracing x AR RnD

works.title: RealityCheck
works.description: Inside existing VR games, real people, furniture and objects from the player's room are blended into the virtual world as live 3D reconstructions, so players can see a spectator, sit on the real sofa or pick up a real cup without taking off the headset.
works.description_zh: 在现有的 VR 游戏里，玩家房间中真实的人、家具和物品以实时三维重建的形式融入虚拟世界，玩家不用摘下头显就能看到旁观者、坐到真实的沙发上或拿起真实的杯子。
works.idea_en: Let the real room leak into any VR game wherever you need it.
works.idea_zh: 在需要的地方，让真实房间“渗入”任何一款 VR 游戏。
works.technique: Room-mounted depth cameras build a real-time 3D reconstruction that is composited into seven unmodified VR titles, with several blending styles (collision cues, visible spectators, stylised objects) to resolve conflicts.
works.technique_zh: 安装在房间里的深度相机构建实时三维重建，并合成到七款未经修改的 VR 游戏中，用多种融合方式（碰撞提示、可见的旁观者、风格化物体）化解冲突。
works.exercise_en: In a Quest passthrough scene, cut a passthrough window around real objects you tag (a chair, a table) and tint it in the game's art style. Twist: people entering the room appear as characters from the game.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Quest 透视场景中，给你标记的真实物体（椅子、桌子）周围切出一块透视窗口，并用游戏的美术风格着色。变体：走进房间的人以游戏角色的形象出现。

video.video_title: RealityCheck: Blending Virtual Environments with Situated Physical Reality

works.title: Record3D → Unity VFX Graph Point Cloud Streaming
works.description: A person filmed by an iPhone X's front depth camera appears in Unity as a live, Kinect-like point cloud, rendered and animated by a VFX Graph.
works.description_zh: iPhone X 前置深度摄像头拍到的人，在 Unity 里实时变成一团类似 Kinect 的点云，由 VFX Graph 渲染并做动画。
works.idea_en: The depth camera already in your pocket can replace a Kinect for live volumetric effects.
works.idea_zh: 口袋里的手机深度摄像头就能替代 Kinect，做实时体积特效。
works.technique: The Record3D app streams RGB and TrueDepth frames over USB; a native plugin in the Unity demo writes them into position and color textures that a VFX Graph samples as a point cache (the graph is one of Keijiro Takahashi's).
works.technique_zh: Record3D 应用通过 USB 传输 RGB 与 TrueDepth 帧；Unity 示例里的原生插件把它们写入位置和颜色纹理，VFX Graph 再把这些纹理当作点缓存来采样（使用的是 Keijiro Takahashi 的 VFX Graph）。
works.exercise_en: Stream yourself from an iPhone into the demo and restyle the point cloud with your own VFX Graph (sparks, dust, ribbons). Twist: bring it back into AR by recording with Record3D, then playing the capture as a floating hologram on a table with AR Foundation.
works.exercise_zh: 用 iPhone 把自己实时传进示例工程，用你自己的 VFX Graph 重新设计点云风格（火花、尘埃、丝带）。变体：用 Record3D 录制，再用 AR Foundation 把录像作为全息影像放回桌面上播放，把它带回 AR。

video.video_title: iPhone X + Unity VFX Graph = Kinect-like, real-time Point Cloud streaming via the Record3D app (https://t.co/RxHnqJEo6K). Used a VFX Graph of @_kzr for the demo. Source code: https://t.co/r8CFS4lUhx h

works.title: Revolutions / Margin of Error (Desert X)
works.description: Geolocated AR sculptures in the Coachella Valley desert for Desert X, including a writhing mass of drawn lines rising over a landfill site.
works.idea_zh: 沙漠中缠绕升起的巨型AR线条雕塑

video.video_title: Desert X Biennial 2019: Nancy Baker Cahill

works.technique: GPS-anchored animated line sculptures are placed at specific desert sites, with site choice (a landfill) carrying the meaning; local plane detection fixes the base on the ground.
works.exercise_zh: 找一个你认为“被忽视”的校园角落（垃圾站、配电房），用 AR 在上方放一团扭动升起的线条；变体：线条的颜色和扭动幅度由该地点的实时噪声或温度驱动。
works.description_zh: 为 Desert X 创作、放置在科切拉谷沙漠中的地理定位 AR 雕塑，其中包括一团在垃圾填埋场上空扭动升起的手绘线条。
works.idea_en: A giant AR sculpture of tangled lines rising over the desert.
works.technique_zh: 以 GPS 锚定的动画线条雕塑被放置在特定的沙漠地点，选址本身（一处垃圾填埋场）承载意义；局部平面检测把底座固定在地面上。
works.exercise_en: Find a campus corner you think is overlooked (a trash station, a power room) and use AR to place a writhing, rising mass of lines above it. Twist: drive the lines' color and motion with the spot's live noise level or temperature.

works.title: Roots
works.description: A show built from little-known folk tales, in which performers and musicians move among hand-drawn and cut-out animation projected across the stage.
works.description_zh: 一部由鲜为人知的民间故事组成的作品，演员和乐手在满台投影的手绘和剪纸动画之间移动。
works.idea_en: Folk tales told through simple drawn projection show that a story needs style more than fidelity; AR storytelling can choose a handmade look too.
works.idea_zh: 用简单的手绘投影讲民间故事，说明故事更需要风格而不是逼真；AR 叙事同样可以选择手工质感。
works.technique: Paul Barritt's drawn and cut-out animation is projected on screens while performers are lit and placed to share the frame.
works.technique_zh: Paul Barritt 的手绘与剪纸动画投在幕上，演员的站位和灯光让他们与画面同框。
works.exercise_en: Cut paper figures, photograph them, and animate them in AR around a real table to retell a folk tale in under two minutes. Twist: the story ending changes depending on where the viewer stands.
works.exercise_zh: 剪一些纸人，拍照后在 AR 中让它们绕着一张真实的桌子动起来，用两分钟以内讲一个民间故事；变体：观众站的位置不同，故事的结局也不同。

video.video_title: Roots trailer

works.title: Rsvfx: RealSense depth to VFX Graph
works.description: A person filmed by an Intel RealSense D415 turns into a live cloud of glowing particles that drift away from their body in real time.
works.description_zh: 用 Intel RealSense D415 拍到的人，实时变成一团发光粒子，粒子不断从身体上飘散开。
works.idea_en: A cheap depth camera turns a live person into particle material.
works.idea_zh: 一台便宜的深度相机，就能把真人实时变成粒子材料。
works.technique: A native plugin converts each RealSense depth frame into position and color textures (attribute maps), which a VFX Graph samples to spawn particles on the captured surface.
works.technique_zh: 插件把 RealSense 每一帧深度图转换成位置贴图和颜色贴图（属性贴图），VFX Graph 读取这些贴图，在拍到的表面上生成粒子。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR Foundation scene on a LiDAR iPhone that reads the environment depth texture into a VFX Graph and spawns particles on your classmate's body. Twist: make the particles fall like sand only when the person stands still.
works.exercise_zh: 在带 LiDAR 的 iPhone 上用 AR Foundation 读取环境深度贴图，传给 VFX Graph，在同学身上生成粒子。变体：只有当人站着不动时，粒子才像沙子一样往下掉。

video.video_title:
RealSense D415 + Unity VFX Graph
Pretty simple one, but I like it.
https://t.co/M8O67naCqW https://t.co/BqUKY6WsuI

works.title: SEA LIFE AR Chatbot (Roxy)
works.description: Children at the SEA LIFE London Aquarium chat with Roxy, an AR character in a little craft, who guides them through challenges about the animals in the tanks until they become Junior Rangers.
works.description_zh: 伦敦 SEA LIFE 水族馆里，孩子们与乘着小飞行器的 AR 角色 Roxy 聊天，她带着孩子完成关于水箱里动物的挑战，最后让他们成为“少年巡护员”。
works.idea_en: An AR companion that talks with children about the real animals in front of them.
works.idea_zh: 一个 AR 伙伴，和孩子们聊眼前真实的动物。
works.technique: A mobile AR app combines a placed 3D character, a scripted chatbot dialogue and collectible cards triggered at each tank.
works.technique_zh: 手机 AR 应用把放置在空间中的 3D 角色、预设脚本的聊天对话和在各个水箱触发的收集卡片结合在一起。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR guide character for a museum room that asks visitors one question per object and rewards correct looks with a collectible. Twist: the guide only answers questions whispered to it.
works.exercise_zh: 为博物馆的一个展厅设计一个 AR 导览角色：每件展品提一个问题，观众看对了就获得收藏卡；变体：导览员只回答对它轻声说出的问题。

video.video_title: SeaLife AR Chatbot

works.title: SVIATOVID
works.description: A 15-foot, four-faced sculpture inspired by the Slavic deity Sviatovid, presented at ISE 2019. Projection turns each face into stone, metal, fire or pattern, so the figure seems to look in every direction at once.
works.description_zh: 一座 15 英尺高、有四张脸的雕塑，灵感来自斯拉夫神祇 Sviatovid，在 2019 年 ISE 展会上展出。投影把每张脸变成石头、金属、火焰或图案，让这个形象仿佛同时望向四面八方。
works.idea_en: A sculpture with a face on every side rewards walking around it; AR objects should give each viewing direction its own reason to look.
works.idea_zh: 每一面都有脸的雕塑会鼓励人绕着它走；AR 物体也应该让每个观看方向都有值得看的东西。
works.technique: A 360° array of projectors is aligned to a 3D model of the sculpture, with content authored per face and blended at the edges.
works.technique_zh: 按雕塑的三维模型校准一圈 360° 投影机阵列，内容按每张脸分别制作，并在交界处融合。
works.exercise_en: Place a four-sided AR totem in a room (WebXR or AR Foundation) where each side shows a different face and element. Twist: the face you are not looking at changes while your back is turned.
works.exercise_zh: 在房间里放一个四面的 AR 图腾（WebXR 或 AR Foundation），每一面呈现不同的脸和元素；变体：你背对着的那一面，会在你转身时悄悄改变。

video.video_title: SVIATOVID | ISE 2019 | Projection-Mapped Sculpture

works.title: Scent Memo
works.description: Pointing a phone at a keepsake shows photos and memories linked to it, while a connected scent diffuser next to it releases a matching smell.
works.description_zh: 用手机对准一件纪念物，就会显示与它相关的照片和回忆，同时旁边联网的香氛机释放出相应的气味。
works.idea_en: Objects become keys that unlock memories through images and smell.
works.idea_zh: 物件变成钥匙，通过图像和气味打开回忆。
works.technique: Likely object or image recognition in a phone app that looks up linked media and signals a networked diffuser to release a stored scent.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是手机应用识别物体或图像，调出关联的媒体，并通知联网香氛机释放预设的气味。
works.exercise_en: Tag three personal objects with image markers and make each one open a photo memory in phone AR. Twist: add a sound or smell cue that plays before the image appears.
works.exercise_zh: 给三件个人物品贴上图像标记，让每件在手机 AR 中打开一段照片回忆。变体：在图像出现之前先播放一段声音或气味提示。

video.video_title: Scent Memo

works.title: SdfVfxSamples: particles shaped by distance fields
works.description: Particle trails are pulled onto the surface of a hidden shape, tracing its outline as they flow; the samples run in a web browser via WebGPU.
works.description_zh: 粒子轨迹被吸附到一个看不见的形状表面，一边流动一边描出它的轮廓；这些示例可以通过 WebGPU 在浏览器里运行。
works.idea_en: An invisible shape can be revealed by what flows around it.
works.idea_zh: 看不见的形状，可以靠绕着它流动的东西显现出来。
works.technique: A signed distance field baked from a mesh gives each particle the distance and direction to the surface; VFX Graph uses it for attraction forces and collision.
works.technique_zh: 从网格烘焙出的有符号距离场告诉每个粒子到表面的距离和方向，VFX Graph 用它计算吸引力和碰撞。
works.exercise_en: Bake an SDF from a scanned object, then use it in AR Foundation so particles wrap around the real object. Twist: swap the SDF every 10 seconds so the swarm morphs between objects.
works.exercise_zh: 把扫描得到的物体烘焙成 SDF，在 AR Foundation 中让粒子包裹住真实物体。变体：每 10 秒换一个 SDF，让粒子群在不同物体之间变形。

video.video_title: I ported my SDF (signed distance field) VFX samples to WebGPU. Now they run on browsers. https://t.co/jiIQiTru8J https://t.co/CPa4HYvMoc

works.title: SeeingVR
works.description: A toolkit of 14 visual and audio aids, such as magnification, edge enhancement, depth colouring and object descriptions, that can be added to any Unity VR app to make it usable for people with low vision.
works.description_zh: 一套包含 14 种视觉与听觉辅助的工具，比如放大、边缘增强、深度着色和物体描述，可加入任何 Unity VR 应用，让低视力人群也能使用。
works.idea_en: Accessibility filters for virtual worlds, applied like lenses over any app.
works.idea_zh: 为虚拟世界准备的无障碍滤镜，像镜片一样套在任何应用之上。
works.technique: Post-processing shaders and scene queries in a Unity plug-in add magnifiers, contrast and edge effects, depth-coded colour and text-to-speech labels without changing the app.
works.technique_zh: Unity 插件中的后处理着色器和场景查询加入放大镜、对比度与边缘效果、按深度着色，以及文字转语音标签，而无需改动原应用。
works.exercise_en: Add three low-vision aids (edge outline, magnifier, spoken label) to a phone AR scene and test them with blurred glasses. Twist: design an aid for AR that does not exist in the toolkit.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个手机 AR 场景加入三种低视力辅助（边缘描线、放大镜、语音标签），戴上模糊眼镜进行测试。变体：设计一种工具包里还没有的 AR 辅助。

video.video_title: SeeingVR Chi 2019

works.title: Slurp in AR
works.description: Inspired by the MIT Media Lab's 'Slurp' eyedropper, a hand-held virtual dropper sucks up a distant piece of content and squeezes it out somewhere else; he later revisited the idea in the DIS 2022 paper '"Slurp" Revisited'.
works.description_zh: 受 MIT Media Lab 的“Slurp”滴管启发，手中的虚拟滴管可以把远处的内容吸进来，再挤到别处；之后他在 DIS 2022 论文《“Slurp” Revisited》中重新研究了这个想法。
works.idea_en: Move digital content between places with a single squeeze-and-release gesture, even when it is far away.
works.idea_zh: 用一次“挤压—松开”的手势在不同位置之间搬运数字内容，即使内容离得很远。
works.technique: Leap Motion hand tracking drives a virtual dropper; a pinch while pointing at an object 'slurps' it into the bulb, and releasing over a target plays the reverse animation.
works.technique_zh: Leap Motion 手势追踪驱动一个虚拟滴管；指向物体时捏合就把它“吸”进滴管，在目标上方松开则播放反向动画。
works.exercise_en: Build a two-step phone-AR interaction: tap to suck a virtual object into a cursor, walk elsewhere, tap to squirt it out. Twist: the dropper can only hold one thing, so picking up a second swaps them.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个两步的手机 AR 交互：点一下把虚拟物体吸进光标，走到别处再点一下挤出来。变体：滴管一次只能装一个东西，吸第二个时会和第一个交换。

video.video_title: This concept is inspired by an old project from MIT @medialab "Slurp", slurping virtual contents from place to place, even the contents that are far away. There would be many interesting possibilities

works.title: Smrvfx: particles from a skinned mesh
works.description: An animated character sheds streams of particles and ribbons from its moving body, so the dance leaves glowing trails in the air.
works.description_zh: 一个动画角色在舞动时，身体不断甩出粒子流和光带，动作在空中留下发光的轨迹。
works.idea_en: Any animated body can become an emitter.
works.idea_zh: 任何会动的身体都可以变成粒子发射器。
works.technique: A script bakes the skinned mesh's vertex positions and velocities into textures every frame (later replaced by VFX Graph's Sample Skinned Mesh operator), and particles spawn from those points.
works.technique_zh: 脚本每帧把蒙皮网格的顶点位置和速度烘焙到贴图里（后来改用 VFX Graph 自带的 Sample Skinned Mesh 节点），粒子从这些点上生成。
works.exercise_en: Rig a Mixamo character, drive it with AR Foundation body tracking on an iPhone, and emit VFX Graph particles from its skinned mesh so it overlays a real dancer. Twist: emit particles only from the fastest-moving limb.
works.exercise_zh: 准备一个 Mixamo 角色，用 iPhone 上 AR Foundation 的人体追踪驱动它，从蒙皮网格上发射 VFX Graph 粒子，叠加在真人舞者身上。变体：只让动作最快的那只手或脚发射粒子。

video.video_title:
I added a few more effects to Smrvfx (skinned mesh to VFX example).
https://t.co/jz2hQ8XpCo https://t.co/Xl7RszHhcJ

works.title: Spark AR world effects
works.description: Marc Wakefield turns his drawn and painted characters and worlds into Instagram world effects that place them into the user's surroundings, including effects for U2.
works.idea_zh: 把手绘角色和奇幻世界变成可以放进现实的Instagram AR效果。

video.video_title: Marc Wakefield uses Spark AR Studio to create new worlds

works.technique: Hand-drawn 2D artwork is placed as billboards or layered planes in world space via plane tracking, preserving the illustration style in 3D.
works.exercise_zh: 把自己的手绘角色分成前、中、后三层平面，放进 AR 形成有视差的纸片剧场；变体：绕着它走时，角色永远转身面对你。
works.description_zh: Marc Wakefield 把自己手绘和彩绘的角色与世界做成 Instagram 世界特效，放进用户的周围环境中，其中也包括为 U2 制作的特效。
works.idea_en: Turn hand-drawn characters and fantasy worlds into Instagram AR effects you can drop into reality.
works.technique_zh: 借助平面追踪，把手绘二维作品以公告板或分层平面的形式放进世界空间，在三维中保留插画风格。
works.exercise_en: Split your own hand-drawn character into front, middle and back layers and place them in AR as a paper theater with parallax. Twist: as you walk around it, the character always turns to face you.

works.title: Spy Car (AR object recognition demo)
works.description: Pointing an Android phone at a toy spy car recognizes the physical object and layers labels, gadget descriptions and animations onto its real body.
works.description_zh: 把 Android 手机对准一辆玩具特工车，应用识别出这件实物，并在车身上叠加标注、装备说明和动画。
works.idea_en: A toy becomes its own interactive manual once the camera recognizes its 3D shape.
works.idea_zh: 摄像头一旦认出玩具的立体形状，玩具就变成了自己的互动说明书。
works.technique: Vuforia or VisionLib model-target tracking matches the toy against its 3D model, so annotations stay registered to the object as it is turned.
works.technique_zh: 用 Vuforia 或 VisionLib 的模型目标追踪，把玩具与其 3D 模型匹配，使标注在物体转动时依然贴合。
works.exercise_en: Scan a small physical object as an object target and attach three tappable hotspots that explain its hidden parts. Twist: reveal an animated X-ray view of the inside when the object is turned upside down.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个小实物扫描成物体识别目标，给它加上三个可点击的热点，解释其内部的隐藏部件。变体：当物体被倒过来时，显示内部结构的动画透视图。

video.video_title: Unity: Spy car (AR mode demo)

works.title: Star Wars: Project Porg
works.description: Adopt porgs that waddle around your real home, recognise surfaces and play fetch with you on Magic Leap.
works.idea_zh: 把星战里的Porg当宠物养在家里。

video.video_title: Project Porg  Bring Porgs Home in ILMxLAB's Latest Experiment!

works.technique: Character behaviour trees query the room mesh for walkable surfaces and toys so the pets navigate and play in the real space.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR做一个会在桌面上跟随手机移动、捡球的小宠物（导航网格或简单跟随脚本）；变化：宠物会记住你上次放玩具的位置。
works.description_zh: 在 Magic Leap 上领养 Porg，它们会在你真实的家里摇摇摆摆地走来走去，认得各种表面，还会陪你玩捡球。
works.idea_en: Keep a Star Wars porg as a pet at home.
works.technique_zh: 角色行为树查询房间网格中可行走的表面和玩具，让宠物在真实空间中导航和玩耍。
works.exercise_en: Make a small phone AR pet that follows the phone across a tabletop and fetches a ball (using a navmesh or a simple follow script). Twist: the pet remembers where you last put a toy.

works.title: Streaming Holograms to ARCore via YouTube
works.description: Encodes RGB-D point clouds into an ordinary YouTube live stream so anyone's phone can decode and view them as AR holograms (the basis of HoloTuberKit).
works.idea_zh: 把全息点云编码进普通 YouTube 直播，用手机解码成 AR 全息影像。

video.video_title: Streaming Hologram to ARCore Device via YouTube

works.technique: Depth and color are packed side by side into a regular video frame, streamed via YouTube Live, and a client shader decodes depth per pixel to rebuild a point cloud in AR.
works.exercise_zh: 把一段 RGB 和深度拼接成左右并排的视频，在 three.js 中用着色器把深度还原成点云并放到 WebXR 场景中；变体：尝试不同深度编码方式，比较压缩后的噪点。
works.description_zh: 把 RGB-D 点云编码进普通的 YouTube 直播，任何人的手机都能解码并以 AR 全息影像观看（这是 HoloTuberKit 的基础）。
works.idea_en: Encode hologram point clouds into an ordinary YouTube live stream and decode them into AR holograms on a phone.
works.technique_zh: 深度和颜色左右并排打包进普通视频帧，通过 YouTube Live 串流，客户端着色器逐像素解码深度，在 AR 中重建点云。
works.exercise_en: Combine RGB and depth into a side-by-side video, use a shader in three.js to rebuild the depth as a point cloud, and place it in a WebXR scene. Twist: try different depth encodings and compare the noise after compression.

works.title: Stuck inside
works.description: A projection-mapped wall of paper pyramids shows day passing and shadows moving, until a tiny figure appears inside the pyramids, knocking and looking for a way out.
works.description_zh: 一面由纸金字塔组成的墙被投影映射，先是日光流转、阴影移动，接着一个小人出现在金字塔里，敲打着寻找出口。
works.idea_en: Make a flat wall of folded paper feel like it has an inside.
works.idea_zh: 让一面折纸墙看起来像有“里面”。
works.technique: Generative animation is mapped onto each face of the folded paper pyramids (likely with ofxPiMapper on a Raspberry Pi), with fake light and shadow reinforcing the depth illusion.
works.technique_zh: 生成式动画被映射到纸金字塔的每个面上（可能使用树莓派上的 ofxPiMapper），假光影强化了纵深错觉。
works.exercise_en: Fold six paper pyramids, stick them on a board and projection-map a moving light source across their faces with MadMapper or a free mapper. Twist: add a character that seems trapped behind one face.
works.exercise_zh: 折六个纸金字塔贴在板上，用 MadMapper 或免费映射软件在各个面上投出移动的光源；变体：加入一个仿佛被困在某个面后面的角色。

video.video_title: Stuck inside - Projection-mapped generative artwork

works.title: Superman vs Giant
works.description: A multi-scale MR telepresence interface where the remote user can fly like Superman through a reconstructed space or tower over it as a giant.
works.idea_zh: 远程协作者可以像超人一样飞行穿越空间，或以巨人身份俯视。

video.video_title: Superman vs Giant: A Multi-Scale Mixed Reality Flying Telepresence Interface

works.technique: The remote user can change their viewpoint scale and fly freely through a 3D reconstruction, and their avatar is rendered to the local AR user at the corresponding scale and position within the shared coordinate frame.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity 中给 VR/桌面一方做“巨人”和“飞行”两种视角模式，AR 一方看到对方以巨型头像或小飞人形式出现，双方合作完成一次摆放任务；变体：比较哪种尺度最适合给指令。
works.description_zh: 一个多尺度的 MR 远程临场界面：远程用户可以像超人一样在重建的空间中飞行，也可以化身巨人俯瞰整个空间。
works.idea_en: A remote collaborator can fly through the space like Superman or look down on it as a giant.
works.technique_zh: 远程用户可以改变视点尺度，在 3D 重建中自由飞行；其化身在共享坐标系中以对应的尺度和位置呈现给本地 AR 用户。
works.exercise_en: In Unity, give the VR/desktop side two view modes, 'giant' and 'flying', while the AR side sees the partner as a giant head or a tiny flyer, and have both sides complete a placement task together. Twist: compare which scale works best for giving instructions.

works.title: TEMPEST
works.description: On the LED facade of Reykjavik's Harpa concert hall, visitors push a button to set off blinding lightning flashes and loud thunder across the building, placing the audience inside a storm.
works.description_zh: 在雷克雅未克 Harpa 音乐厅的 LED 立面上，观众按下按钮，整栋建筑便闪过刺眼的闪电，响起巨大的雷声，把观众置于一场风暴之中。
works.idea_en: One button lets a passer-by throw lightning across a whole building.
works.idea_zh: 一个按钮就让路人把闪电劈满整栋建筑。
works.technique: A real-time generative storm is rendered to the facade's low-resolution LED grid, and a physical button triggers lightning and synchronised thunder audio.
works.technique_zh: 实时生成的风暴画面输出到立面的低分辨率 LED 网格上，一个实体按钮触发闪电和同步的雷声。
works.exercise_en: Map a p5.js storm onto a classroom window or wall with a projector and wire one big button (Makey Makey or keyboard key) that triggers lightning and thunder. Twist: the storm grows calmer the longer nobody presses it.
works.exercise_zh: 用投影仪把一个 p5.js 风暴映射到教室窗户或墙上，再接一个大按钮（Makey Makey 或键盘键）触发闪电和雷声。变体：越久没人按，风暴越平静。

video.video_title: TEMPEST at Tiny/Massive, Reykjavik 2019 Winter Lights Festival

works.title: Talking Heads
works.description: Two large head sculptures by Viktor Vicsek, each covered with about 4,000 individually controllable LEDs, face each other and 'talk': their light patterns form facial expressions and emotions that answer one another.
works.description_zh: Viktor Vicsek 创作的两个巨大头部雕塑，每个表面约有 4000 颗可单独控制的 LED，它们面对面“交谈”：光的图案组成表情和情绪，彼此回应。
works.idea_en: Faces made only of light still read as characters; an AR agent does not need a realistic face, only readable expressions and turn-taking.
works.idea_zh: 只由光组成的脸依然会被看作角色；AR 虚拟角色不需要写实的脸，只需要读得懂的表情和一来一往的节奏。
works.technique: Thousands of addressable LEDs on a head-shaped form are driven by programmed light sequences (likely DMX or pixel-mapping software) that are choreographed as a dialogue.
works.technique_zh: 在头形结构上布置数千颗可寻址 LED，用编排成对话的灯光序列驱动（推测使用 DMX 或像素映射软件）。
works.exercise_en: Make two AR faces built only from dots of light in Lens Studio or Three.js, and script a short conversation between them using expressions only. Twist: one face mirrors the viewer's expression from face tracking.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Lens Studio 或 Three.js 里用光点做两张 AR 脸，只用表情编排一段简短的对话；变体：其中一张脸通过面部追踪模仿观者的表情。

video.video_title: Talking Heads, A Light Art Installation, 2019

works.title: Tangible UI: hand tracking on flat surfaces
works.description: Using early Quest hand tracking, any real table becomes a giant touch screen: virtual buttons and sliders are laid flat on the desk and pressed with your fingers.
works.idea_zh: 用手部追踪把任意真实桌面变成巨大的触摸屏。

video.video_title: Tangible UI in Oculus Quest - Hand tracking on flat surfaces (with Music)

works.technique: A table plane is calibrated, and fingertip positions from hand tracking are tested against virtual buttons laid flat on it, with a small distance threshold standing in for a touch event.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands 加桌面平面检测，把一组虚拟滑块贴在桌面上，用手指距离桌面的高度判断是否按下；变体：让不同手指控制不同功能。
works.description_zh: 借助早期 Quest 的手部追踪，任何一张真实的桌子都能变成巨大的触摸屏：虚拟按钮和滑块平铺在桌面上，用手指就能按。
works.idea_en: Use hand tracking to turn any real tabletop into a giant touch screen.
works.technique_zh: 先标定桌面平面，再用手部追踪得到的指尖位置与平铺在桌面上的虚拟按钮做检测，以一个很小的距离阈值代替触摸事件。
works.exercise_en: Combine MediaPipe Hands with tabletop plane detection to lay a set of virtual sliders on the desk, using the finger's height above the surface to decide whether it is pressed. Twist: let different fingers control different functions.

works.title: Tehachapi
works.description: In the yard of a maximum-security prison in Tehachapi, California, JR and inmates pasted a huge collage of prisoners' and guards' portraits on the ground, visible from the sky.
works.description_zh: 在加州特哈查皮一所最高安全级别监狱的放风场里，JR 与囚犯们在地面上贴出由囚犯和狱警肖像组成的巨大拼贴，从空中可见。
works.idea_en: An image made for the view from above, in a place people cannot leave, lets people be seen by the world; AR can give voice to spaces that are otherwise closed.
works.idea_zh: 一幅为俯视视角而作、位于人们无法离开之地的图像，让里面的人被世界看见；AR 可以为原本封闭的空间发声。
works.technique: Portrait strips were pasted over the yard's ground by participants following a grid, then photographed from a drone.
works.technique_zh: 参与者依照网格把肖像条贴满放风场地面，再由无人机拍摄。
works.exercise_en: Design a large ground collage of portraits in AR for a place with restricted access (a courtyard, a rooftop) and share only the aerial view publicly. Twist: each portrait speaks a sentence when you stand on it.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个限制进入的地方（庭院、屋顶）设计一幅大型地面肖像 AR 拼贴，只公开分享俯视画面；变体：当你站在某张肖像上时，它会说出一句话。

video.video_title: JR Chronicles : Tehachapi, Califoria, U.S.A., 2019

works.title: Texture Painting on Meshes
works.description: The user paints directly onto a 3D model in real time; strokes land in the model's texture and stay on the surface as it turns.
works.description_zh: 用户实时在三维模型上作画，笔触写进模型的贴图，模型转动时颜色仍留在表面上。
works.idea_en: Painting on an object should feel like painting on the real thing, not on a screen.
works.idea_zh: 在物体上作画应该像在真实物体上画，而不是在屏幕上画。
works.technique: The mesh is rendered into its UV space with a shader that tests each texel's world position against the brush, writing paint into a render texture, with a dilation pass to hide seams.
works.technique_zh: 用着色器把网格按 UV 空间展开渲染，逐个纹素比较其世界坐标与笔刷的距离，把颜料写入渲染纹理，并用膨胀 pass 隐藏接缝。
works.exercise_en: Scan a real object with a LiDAR phone, place the scan over it in AR, and let students spray-paint the object through the phone. Twist: the paint drips downward over time.
works.exercise_zh: 用 LiDAR 手机扫描一个真实物体，在 AR 中把扫描模型叠在它身上，让学生通过手机给物体喷漆。变体：颜料会随时间往下流。

video.video_title: Texture Painting in Unity

works.title: The Deep Listener
works.description: A location-based AR and sound walk through Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park in which five of London's species — plane trees, bats, parakeets, damselflies and reedbeds — appear as scanned, sonified creatures at their habitats.
works.idea_zh: 在公园里用AR“听见”五种城市物种的生命
works.technique: GPS-triggered AR places photogrammetry-scanned, game-engine-rendered species at specific park locations, paired with spatialised field recordings.
works.exercise_zh: 选校园里3种植物或动物，录下它们周边的声音并用AR在原地放置放大的模型；变化：只有安静站立10秒才会出现声音。

video.video_title: Jakob Kudsk Steensen: The Deep Listener | Serpentine Digital Commissions

works.description_zh: 一次穿行于肯辛顿花园和海德公园的基于位置的 AR 声音漫步：伦敦的五种物种——悬铃木、蝙蝠、长尾鹦鹉、豆娘和芦苇丛——以扫描建模、声音化的生物形态出现在各自的栖息地。
works.idea_en: Use AR in a park to 'hear' the lives of five urban species.
works.technique_zh: 由 GPS 触发的 AR 把经过摄影测量扫描、用游戏引擎渲染的物种放置在公园的特定位置，并搭配空间化的野外录音。
works.exercise_en: Pick three plants or animals on campus, record the sounds around them, and use AR to place enlarged models on the spot. Twist: the sound appears only after you stand still and quiet for 10 seconds.

works.title: The Life
works.description: The first mixed-reality performance artwork: a 19-minute volumetric capture of Abramović appears in the room through an MR headset, walking within a marked circle.
works.idea_zh: 通过MR头显，艺术家的全息分身在你面前表演

video.video_title: Marina Abramović’s 'The Life' — The World’s First Mixed Reality Performance Artwork | Christie's

works.technique: Volumetric capture of the performer (multi-camera studio) is played back as a 3D video mesh in a Magic Leap headset, anchored inside a physical circle so viewers walk around her.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 LiDAR 扫描或多视角视频录一段同学的 1 分钟静默表演，在 AR 中放入地上画好的圆圈里供人绕行观看；变体：观众进入圆圈时表演者停下并“注视”他们。
works.description_zh: 首件混合现实表演艺术作品：一段 19 分钟的 Abramović 体积捕捉影像通过 MR 头显出现在房间里，她在一个标记好的圆圈内行走。
works.idea_en: Through an MR headset, the artist's holographic double performs in front of you.
works.technique_zh: 表演者的体积捕捉（多相机摄影棚）在 Magic Leap 头显中以 3D 视频网格回放，并锚定在一个实体圆圈内，观众可以绕着她走动。
works.exercise_en: Capture a classmate's one-minute silent performance with a phone LiDAR scan or multi-angle video, and place it in AR inside a circle drawn on the floor for people to walk around. Twist: when a viewer steps into the circle, the performer stops and 'looks' at them.

salient.why_en: The artist's holographic double performs in the room with you, so a performance piece can exist without the performer.
salient.why_zh: 艺术家的全息分身在房间里为你表演，行为艺术从此可以脱离表演者本人存在。

works.title: The Secret of the Great Pyramid
works.description: For the pyramid's 30th anniversary, 400 volunteers pasted 2,000 paper strips across the Louvre's Napoleon courtyard; from above, the pyramid seems to rise out of a deep rocky quarry.
works.description_zh: 为纪念金字塔落成 30 周年，400 名志愿者在卢浮宫拿破仑庭院铺贴了 2000 条纸带；从高处看，金字塔仿佛从一座深深的岩石采石场中升起。
works.idea_en: An anamorphic ground image that reveals depth from one viewpoint is the analogue ancestor of AR depth illusions, and it dissolved as people walked on it.
works.idea_zh: 一幅从某个视点显出深度的变形地面图像，是 AR 深度错觉的模拟祖先，并随着人们在上面行走而逐渐消解。
works.technique: A photograph of rock was distorted to match the viewing angle from above and printed on paper strips glued to the paving.
works.technique_zh: 岩石照片按照上方观看角度进行变形，打印在纸条上并粘贴在地面上。
works.exercise_en: Create an anamorphic 'hole' image for a courtyard floor with a projection camera in Blender, print or display it in AR, and test the view from a balcony. Twist: let people's footsteps erase the image as they walk on it.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Blender 中用投影相机为庭院地面制作一幅变形“深坑”图像，在 AR 中显示并从阳台测试观看效果；变体：人们走在上面时，脚步会把图像擦掉。

video.video_title: JR au Louvre et le secret de la Grande Pyramide

salient.why_en: Paper pasted on a flat courtyard makes the Louvre pyramid seem to rise out of a deep quarry.
salient.why_zh: 贴在平整广场上的纸，让卢浮宫金字塔看起来像是从一个深深的采石坑里升起。

works.title: The Welcome Chorus
works.description: Twelve horns, one for each district of Kent, sing lyrics generated live by an AI trained on words contributed by local people; visitors speak or sing into a conductor sculpture and their words enter the chorus.
works.description_zh: 十二只号角各代表肯特郡的一个地区，唱着由 AI 实时生成的歌词，这个 AI 由当地居民贡献的文字训练而成；观众对着一个“指挥”雕塑说话或唱歌，他们的话就会加入合唱。
works.idea_en: A public choir of horns that learns new lyrics from passers-by.
works.idea_zh: 一支由号角组成的公共合唱团，从路人那里学习新歌词。
works.technique: A site-specific text generator trained on community lyrics feeds a singing synthesis system routed to twelve horn speakers, and a microphone in the conductor sculpture adds visitors' input to the model.
works.technique_zh: 用社区歌词训练的在地文本生成模型，驱动一个歌声合成系统，声音送到十二只号角扬声器；“指挥”雕塑中的麦克风把观众的输入加入模型。
works.exercise_en: Collect one sentence about the school from every student, generate new lines with a small text model or a random remix script, and play them from phones hidden in paper horns around the room. Twist: each horn only sings words from one class.
works.exercise_zh: 请每位同学写一句关于学校的话，用小型文本模型或随机重组脚本生成新句子，从藏在纸号角里的手机播放出来，分布在房间各处；变体：每只号角只唱某一个班级的句子。

video.video_title: Update: Welcome Chorus

works.title: This Is It
works.description: On Apple's [AR]T Walk, a seemingly hollow tree appears in the street and reveals the strange, magical digital creatures hiding inside, like an outlandish fairy tale.
works.description_zh: 在 Apple [AR]T Walk 上，街头出现一棵看似空心的树，树里藏着一群古怪而奇妙的数字生物，仿佛一则荒诞童话。
works.idea_en: An ordinary-looking tree hides a fairy-tale world inside.
works.idea_zh: 一棵看起来普通的树里藏着一个童话世界。
works.technique: Location-anchored ARKit scene with animated, scanned clay-style characters and Hans Berg's score as spatial audio.
works.technique_zh: 锚定位置的 ARKit 场景，包含扫描自黏土风格的动画角色，并以 Hans Berg 的配乐作为空间音频。
works.exercise_en: Pick a real tree or cupboard on campus and build an AR scene where creatures peek out of it and hide again when you come closer. Twist: the creatures tell a story only when the viewer stays completely still.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里选一棵真实的树或一个柜子，做一个 AR 场景：生物会从里面探出头，你一靠近又躲回去；变体：只有观众完全静止时，它们才开始讲故事。

video.video_title: [AR]T ウォーク@新宿：ディス・イズ・イット

works.title: Through
works.description: On Apple's [AR]T Walk, a portal opens in the street and takes viewers into a world without perspective, where the usual depth cues of the city disappear.
works.description_zh: 在 Apple [AR]T Walk 上，街头打开一道传送门，把观众带进一个“没有透视”的世界，城市里惯常的深度线索全部消失。
works.idea_en: Walk through a portal into a world that has no perspective.
works.idea_zh: 穿过传送门，进入一个没有透视的世界。
works.technique: An ARKit portal: a masked doorway shows a virtual interior rendered without perspective foreshortening, which replaces the camera view once the user steps through.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 传送门：用遮罩做出门洞，里面是渲染时去除透视缩短的虚拟空间，用户穿过门后它会替换整个摄像头画面。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR portal whose inside world is rendered with an orthographic camera, then compare how it feels to walk through versus a normal perspective portal. Twist: make the inside world flip upside down, echoing Höller's Upside-Down Goggles.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 传送门，门内世界用正交相机渲染，再比较穿过它与穿过普通透视传送门的感觉差异；变体：让门内世界上下颠倒，呼应 Höller 的倒置眼镜。

video.video_title: [AR]T ウォーク@新宿：スルー

works.title: Tilt Five Holographic Game System
works.description: The Tilt Five Kickstarter: lightweight glasses and a retro-reflective game board plus a wand controller, so friends around a table share holographic board and video games.
works.idea_zh: 一块反光游戏板和一副眼镜，让朋友们围桌共享全息桌游。

video.video_title: Tilt Five Holographic Game System- Now on Kickstarter

works.technique: Glasses project stereo images onto a retro-reflective board and track head pose against it, while a tracked wand gives a ray for pointing at tabletop content.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一张图像标记当成游戏棋盘，用手机射线（从屏幕中心发出）选择棋子并移动；变体：棋子可以“站起来”超出棋盘高度。
works.description_zh: Tilt Five 的 Kickstarter 项目：一副轻便眼镜、一块回射式游戏板再加一根魔杖手柄，让围坐在桌边的朋友共享全息桌游和电子游戏。
works.idea_en: A reflective game board and a pair of glasses let friends share holographic board games around a table.
works.technique_zh: 眼镜把立体图像投射到回射式游戏板上，并以游戏板为参照追踪头部姿态；被追踪的魔杖则发出一条射线，用来指向桌面上的内容。
works.exercise_en: Use an image marker as a game board in AR and select and move pieces with a ray cast from the center of the phone screen. Twist: pieces can 'stand up' taller than the board.

works.title: TrackCap
works.description: A small cap with a marker on the headset lets an ordinary smartphone track itself relative to the head, turning the phone into a precise 6DoF controller and second screen for mobile headsets.
works.description_zh: 在头显上加一个带标记的小帽子，普通智能手机就能相对头部追踪自身位置，变成移动头显的高精度六自由度控制器和第二块屏幕。
works.idea_en: Flip the tracking: the phone watches the headset, not the other way round.
works.idea_zh: 反转追踪关系：由手机看头显，而不是头显看手机。
works.technique: The phone's camera tracks a marker cap mounted on the HMD, and the inverse pose gives the phone's 6DoF position in the headset's frame, even outside the headset's field of view.
works.technique_zh: 手机摄像头追踪装在头显上的标记帽，反算位姿即得到手机在头显坐标系中的六自由度位置，即使手机在头显视野外也能工作。
works.exercise_en: Tape a printed marker to a cardboard viewer and use a second phone's image tracking to follow it, then use that phone as a pointer in a shared scene. Twist: turn the second phone's screen into a paint palette.
works.exercise_zh: 把打印好的标记贴在纸盒眼镜上，用第二部手机的图像追踪跟随它，再把这部手机当作共享场景里的指针；变体：把第二部手机的屏幕变成调色板。
