video.video_title: FLIGHT Trailer 1 - DARKFIELD

works.title: Finger ray for far interaction
works.description: Instead of only touching what is within arm's reach, a ray shoots from the index finger so that simple pinch gestures can select and move posters hanging far away.
works.description_zh: 不再只能触碰手臂范围内的东西，而是从食指射出一条射线，用简单的捏合手势选择并移动远处挂着的海报。
works.idea_en: Extend bare-hand input beyond arm's reach with a pointing ray plus a pinch.
works.idea_zh: 用指向射线加捏合，把徒手交互扩展到手够不着的距离。
works.technique: A raycast from the camera through the tracked index fingertip picks targets, and Leap Motion pinch state confirms selection and drag.
works.technique_zh: 从相机经过被追踪的食指指尖做射线检测来选中目标，再用 Leap Motion 的捏合状态确认选择和拖拽。
works.exercise_en: Using a webcam hand tracker (e.g. MediaPipe), build a pointer that selects items on a far wall projection when you pinch. Twist: the ray bends toward the nearest target like a magnet.
works.exercise_zh: 用网络摄像头手部追踪（如 MediaPipe）做一个指针：捏合时选中远处墙面投影上的物体。变体：射线像磁铁一样向最近的目标弯曲。

video.video_title: Leap motion hand is usually used for arm-reached distance interactions, but I tried to shoot a ray from the index finger, and combining with basic gestures, now we can interact with contents that are

works.title: Flipper (ADIRECTOR Channel)
works.description: Live visuals for ADIRECTOR Channel in Omotesando combine flip-book page turning with ribbons and shapes grown from animated skeletons.
works.description_zh: 为表参道 ADIRECTOR Channel 活动制作的现场视觉，把翻页书式的画面翻动与从动画骨骼生长出的缎带和形体结合在一起。
works.idea_en: Make a digital show feel like flipping through a printed book.
works.idea_zh: 让数字演出感觉像在翻一本印刷的书。
works.technique: The flipbook renderer captures frames into pages that turn with a bending mesh, combined with skeletal geometric effects built with geometry-shader instancing.
works.technique_zh: Flipbook 渲染器把画面截取成书页，并用弯曲的网格翻动，再结合用几何着色器实例化制作的骨骼几何效果。
works.exercise_en: Capture the AR camera view every half second and let the pages flip past on a virtual book lying on a real table. Twist: flip forward on a beat and backward on silence.
works.exercise_zh: 每半秒截取一次 AR 相机画面，让这些页面在一本放在真实桌面上的虚拟书里翻过；变体：有节拍时向前翻，安静时向后翻。

works.title: Floating by shadow offset
works.description: A small study showing that a virtual object reads as floating above a real surface just by separating it from its shadow, an idea inspired by designer Dixon Lo.
works.description_zh: 一个小研究：只要让虚拟物体和它的影子分开，看起来就像悬浮在真实桌面上，这个想法受设计师 Dixon Lo 启发。
works.idea_en: Shadows are the cheapest depth cue: move the shadow and the object seems to lift off.
works.idea_zh: 影子是最便宜的深度线索：把影子挪开，物体就像飘了起来。
works.technique: A blob shadow stays on the detected plane while the object's height is animated, so the gap between them conveys elevation.
works.technique_zh: 一个圆形软阴影固定在检测到的平面上，而物体高度做动画，两者之间的距离传达出高度感。
works.exercise_en: Put one virtual ball on a table in phone AR and test three versions: no shadow, attached shadow, offset shadow; ask classmates which floats. Twist: make the shadow move in the opposite direction of the ball.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 里把一个虚拟球放在桌上，做三个版本：无影子、贴地影子、偏移影子，请同学判断哪个在飘。变体：让影子朝球的反方向移动。

video.video_title: Make an object floating in AR by overlapping shadow. The concept is inspired by Dixon Lo. https://t.co/6KGW8p2K9n

salient.why_en: Move only the shadow and the object seems to lift off the table, showing the cheapest depth cue there is.
salient.why_zh: 只移动影子，物体就像离开了桌面，一眼看出最廉价的深度线索。

works.title: Floating islands between real surfaces
works.description: Another Google prototype: low-poly floating islands, towers and trees are generated to fill the gaps between detected surfaces, so the fantasy scene seems to grow out of the room.
works.description_zh: 另一个 Google 原型：在检测到的平面之间生成低多边形的浮岛、高塔和树木，让奇幻场景看起来像是从房间里长出来的。
works.idea_en: Fill the empty space between real surfaces with generated content so AR fits the room.
works.idea_zh: 用生成的内容填满真实平面之间的空隙，让 AR 与房间契合。
works.technique: Multiple ARCore planes are used as anchors; islands are spawned at heights between them with procedural decoration.
works.technique_zh: 以多个 ARCore 平面作为锚点，在它们之间的高度生成浮岛，并程序化地添加装饰。
works.exercise_en: Generate a floating object at the midpoint height between the floor and a table in AR Foundation. Twist: its species depends on the distance between the two surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中，在地面和桌面之间的中间高度生成一个漂浮物。变体：它的种类取决于两个平面之间的距离。

video.video_title: Another prototype I made @GoogleARVR using #ARCore to procedurally generate AR content based on physical space. The concept can leverage multiple detected surfaces and generates floating islands in be

works.title: Force Feedback for Mixed Reality via EMS
works.description: On HoloLens, virtual buttons, walls and heavy objects push back: EMS on the user's arm muscles creates resistance so the user feels them without holding any device.
works.idea_zh: 在HoloLens里按虚拟按钮、推虚拟墙，手臂真的感到阻力。

video.video_title: Adding Force Feedback to Mixed Reality Experiences and Games using Electrical Muscle Stimulation

works.technique: Detects hand contact with virtual objects and stimulates antagonist muscles to create counter-force while leaving the hands free to touch real objects.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机AR里放置一面虚拟墙，当手机穿过墙时让手机持续强振动并变红来表示“阻力”；变化：用弹力带绑住手臂模拟推墙的真实阻力。
works.description_zh: 在 HoloLens 上，虚拟按钮、墙壁和重物都会“顶回来”：通过对用户手臂肌肉施加 EMS 产生阻力，用户无需手持任何设备就能感受到它们。
works.idea_en: Press a virtual button or push a virtual wall in HoloLens and your arm really feels the resistance.
works.technique_zh: 检测手与虚拟物体的接触，并刺激拮抗肌产生反作用力，同时让双手保持空闲，可以触摸真实物体。
works.exercise_en: Place a virtual wall in phone AR, and when the phone passes through it, make the phone vibrate strongly and turn red to signal 'resistance'. Twist: tie a resistance band to your arm to simulate the real resistance of pushing a wall.

works.title: Fragmented Plane
works.description: A large installation in which a projected plane is broken across several physical surfaces at different depths; the image reads as one flat plane from the front and as scattered fragments as the audience moves around it. Sound by Thomas Vaquié.
works.description_zh: 一件大型装置：一张投影出来的平面被拆散到多个处于不同深度的实体表面上；从正面看是一张平整的面，观众绕着走动时又变成散落的碎片。声音由 Thomas Vaquié 设计。
works.idea_en: One flat image spread over many depths shows how fragile a 2D reading of 3D space is; AR designers can play with that moment of breaking.
works.idea_zh: 一张平面图像散布在多个深度上，揭示了用二维方式理解三维空间有多脆弱；AR 设计师可以利用这种“破裂”的瞬间。
works.technique: Projection content is mapped from a single viewpoint onto multiple surfaces placed at different distances, so it only coheres from the front (method likely anamorphic mapping).
works.technique_zh: 从单一视点把投影内容映射到放在不同距离的多个表面上，只有从正面看才会连贯（方法推测为变形透视映射）。
works.exercise_en: Place several AR panels at different depths with WebXR so that together they show one photo from the doorway, then fly apart as viewers walk in. Twist: the photo is the view the viewer would see if the room were not there.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 在不同深度放几块 AR 面板，让它们从门口看拼成一张照片，观众走进来时又散开；变体：这张照片是“如果房间不存在”时观众会看到的景色。

video.video_title: Fragmented Plane

works.title: Friction
works.description: An audiovisual instrument for the public: two facing laser beams draw three-dimensional shapes between two frames, and visitors bend the shapes and the sound with their hands.
works.description_zh: 一件面向公众的视听乐器：两道相对的激光在两个框架之间画出立体图形，观众用手弯折这些图形和声音。
works.idea_en: Play light and sound in the air between your hands.
works.idea_zh: 在双手之间的空气里演奏光与声音。
works.technique: Hand gestures, likely read by a Leap Motion sensor, control laser drawing parameters and a sound engine in real time.
works.technique_zh: 手势（推测由 Leap Motion 读取）实时控制激光绘制参数和声音引擎。
works.exercise_en: Build a gesture instrument where a phone's hand tracking controls a projected line drawing and a synth; hang a scrim or use haze so the lines read in space. Twist: require two players' hands to stretch one shape.
works.exercise_zh: 做一件手势乐器：用手机的手部追踪控制投影线条和合成器，挂纱幕或加雾让线条在空间中可见；变体：必须两个人的手一起才能拉伸同一个图形。

video.video_title: Friction

works.title: GPUVoxelParticleSystem (unity-voxel)
works.description: A 3D model is broken into glowing voxel cubes that scatter, swirl and snap back together into the original shape.
works.description_zh: 一个三维模型被拆成发光的体素方块，它们飞散、旋转，再拼回原来的形状。
works.idea_en: Turn any mesh into thousands of voxel particles that can leave and return to their home position.
works.idea_zh: 把任意网格变成成千上万个体素粒子，它们可以离开，也能回到原位。
works.technique: The mesh is voxelized on the GPU, each voxel becomes a particle moved by a compute shader (noise and home-position forces), and a geometry shader expands each particle into a cube.
works.technique_zh: 网格在 GPU 上被体素化，每个体素成为一个粒子，由计算着色器驱动（噪声力和回到原位的力），再由几何着色器把每个粒子扩展成立方体。
works.exercise_en: Voxelize a scanned object and place it on a real floor with AR Foundation; when the user walks through it, the voxels scatter around their body and slowly reassemble. Twist: let voxels that fly off stick to the detected room mesh.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个扫描来的物体体素化，用 AR Foundation 放在真实地面上；用户穿过它时体素绕身体散开，再慢慢重新拼合。变体：让飞出的体素粘到检测到的房间网格上。

video.video_title: Added GPUVoxelParticlleSystem demo to unity-voxel repository on github ! #unity  https://t.co/eR6MDwPXSV Render voxel particles with geometry shader and move it with compute shader⚡️ https://t.co/ldNl

works.title: GPUVoxelSkinnedMesh (unity-voxel)
works.description: An animated character is re-voxelized every frame, so a running figure made of cubes flickers and shimmers while it moves.
works.description_zh: 一个动画角色每帧都被重新体素化，于是一个由方块组成的奔跑人形一边运动一边闪烁。
works.idea_en: Voxelize a moving, skinned body in real time so motion itself becomes blocky sculpture.
works.idea_zh: 实时体素化一个带骨骼动画的身体，让动作本身变成方块雕塑。
works.technique: Each frame the SkinnedMeshRenderer is baked to a mesh, a compute shader rasterizes its triangles into a voxel grid, and the filled cells are drawn as instanced cubes.
works.technique_zh: 每帧把 SkinnedMeshRenderer 烘焙成网格，用计算着色器把三角形光栅化进体素网格，再把被填充的格子用实例化立方体画出来。
works.exercise_en: Drive the voxelizer with ARKit body tracking so a cube version of the user dances beside them on the phone screen. Twist: freeze the voxels every few seconds to leave a trail of cube statues on the floor.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit 身体追踪驱动体素化，让手机画面里出现一个跟着用户跳舞的方块分身。变体：每隔几秒把体素冻结，在地上留下一串方块雕像。

video.video_title: Created GPUVoxelSkinnedMesh demo to unity-voxel repository! 🆕 #unity  https://t.co/eR6MDx7yKt Sample a mesh from SkinnedMeshRenderer in every frame and voxelize it in realtime⚡️ https://t.co/eAkpzgg8W

works.title: GaiaMotherTree
works.description: In the main hall of Zurich's central station, a 20-metre hand-knotted cotton tree hangs from the roof; commuters walk inside it, sit on cushions and join talks and rituals.
works.description_zh: 在苏黎世中央火车站大厅里，一棵 20 米高、手工编结的棉线大树从屋顶垂下；通勤者走进树里，坐在垫子上，参加讲座和仪式。
works.idea_en: A room-within-a-room placed in a busy public hall creates a pause zone; AR can carve a calm, soft space inside a crowded place without moving anything physical.
works.idea_zh: 在繁忙的公共大厅里放一个「房中房」，就造出一块停顿区：AR 也可以在拥挤场所里开辟一个柔软安静的空间，而不移动任何实物。
works.technique: Colourful cotton strips are crocheted and knotted by hand into a net canopy suspended from the station roof, with hanging drops holding spices and seeds.
works.technique_zh: 彩色棉布条被手工钩织打结成网状树冠，悬挂在车站屋顶下，垂下的「果实」里装着香料和种子。
works.exercise_en: Design a location-based AR 'tree tent' for a busy public space: when the user stands at the anchor, a knotted canopy grows around them and city noise is replaced by soft sound. Twist: the canopy only grows while the user stays still for ten seconds.
works.exercise_zh: 为繁忙的公共空间设计一个定位 AR「树帐篷」：用户站到锚点上时，一个编结的树冠在身边长出来，城市噪音换成柔和的声音。变体：只有用户静止十秒，树冠才会继续生长。

video.video_title: Ernesto Neto: GaiaMotherTree / Fondation Beyeler at Zürich Main Station

works.title: Games of Deletion
works.description: A world-scale multiplayer mixed-reality game in which players tag and 'delete' urban art and architecture through their phones, competing over real city spaces.
works.idea_zh: 把城市里的建筑与街头艺术变成多人 AR 游戏里可以'抹除'和争夺的领地。

video.video_title: Games of Deletion - Realtime Demo

works.technique: Geolocated AR content is anchored to real urban sites and synced across players so each tag or deletion changes a shared world state.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园选 5 个建筑点，用 AR 给它们'涂鸦'或'擦除'并记录到共享地图上，两队比赛占领；加一个变化：被擦除的建筑在 AR 里真的变透明。
works.description_zh: 一款世界尺度的多人混合现实游戏：玩家通过手机标记并“删除”城市中的街头艺术和建筑，争夺真实的城市空间。
works.idea_en: Turn city buildings and street art into territory to erase and fight over in a multiplayer AR game.
works.technique_zh: 地理定位的 AR 内容锚定在真实的城市地点上，并在玩家之间同步，每一次标记或删除都会改变共享的世界状态。
works.exercise_en: Pick five buildings on campus, use AR to 'tag' or 'erase' them and record this on a shared map, with two teams competing to take them over. Twist: erased buildings actually turn transparent in AR.

works.title: Garden Friends
works.description: An AR + voice experiment with animator Eran Hilleli: you grow personalized trees and flowers on real surfaces by chatting with a quirky character, speech driving the scene.
works.idea_zh: 对着AR小植物说好话，它们就按你的对话长成独特的花草。

video.video_title: Garden Friends

works.technique: ARCore plane detection places plants on real surfaces, while speech recognition and an intent-matching dialog system (Dialogflow) map what you say to parameters that grow and style the plants.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 平面检测放一个小角色，用语音识别加关键词或 LLM 解析你说的话，决定长出什么花草；变体：角色只对夸奖有反应，骂它会让花园枯萎，体会“对机器说话”的礼貌。
works.description_zh: 与动画师 Eran Hilleli 合作的 AR 加语音实验：你和一个古怪的角色聊天，在真实表面上种出专属于你的树木和花朵，由话语驱动整个场景。
works.idea_en: Say nice things to little AR plants and they grow into unique flowers shaped by your conversation.
works.technique_zh: ARCore 平面检测把植物放在真实表面上，语音识别和意图匹配对话系统（Dialogflow）把你说的话映射成控制植物生长和外观的参数。
works.exercise_en: Place a small character with AR Foundation plane detection and use speech recognition plus keywords or an LLM to interpret what you say and decide which plants grow. Twist: the character responds only to praise, and scolding makes the garden wither, so you feel what politeness toward machines means.

works.title: Hand-summoned UI panel
works.description: A floating control panel glides into arm's reach only when the hand reaches for it and drifts back into the world when done; he imagined it for controlling smart lights, with a slider inspired by Leap Motion's Cat Explorer.
works.description_zh: 一个悬浮的控制面板只在手伸过去时才滑到手边，用完又退回空间里；他设想用于控制智能灯，滑杆设计参考了 Leap Motion 的 Cat Explorer。
works.idea_en: UI lives in the world but comes to your hand only when you need it.
works.idea_zh: 界面留在空间里，只在需要时才来到你手边。
works.technique: A hand-proximity trigger lerps the panel between a world anchor and a hand-relative anchor, with Leap Motion pinch detection driving the slider.
works.technique_zh: 通过手部接近触发，让面板在世界锚点和跟随手部的锚点之间插值移动，Leap Motion 的捏合检测驱动滑杆。
works.exercise_en: Create a WebXR or phone-AR panel that stays on a wall but slides toward the camera when you walk closer than one meter. Twist: it retreats faster if you look away.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 WebXR 或手机 AR 面板：平时挂在墙上，你走到一米以内时它会滑向镜头。变体：你把视线移开时它会更快地退回去。

video.video_title: Make UI panel moves to hand-reached space only when it's needed, and back away when it's done. I am imagining it's used for AR + IoT scenario (e.g. controlling smart light). The handle bar of the slid

works.title: Hawkeye Access
works.description: The shipped version of his prototype: browse any website hands-free on iOS by looking at links and blinking to open them.
works.idea_zh: 把眼控原型做成可上架的免手浏览器，服务无障碍需求。

video.video_title: Hawkeye Access | Control your iOS device with your eyes

works.technique: Calibrated gaze estimation from ARKit face tracking is smoothed and mapped to web page link targets, with dwell or blink detection triggering navigation.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebGazer.js 做一个网页，盯着某个链接 1.5 秒自动打开；变体：为一位特定用户（如手部受伤的人）设计凝视界面。
works.description_zh: 他那个原型的正式上架版本：在 iOS 上无需动手即可浏览任意网站，看向链接、眨眼即可打开。
works.idea_en: Turn an eye-control prototype into a hands-free browser on the App Store for accessibility.
works.technique_zh: 对 ARKit 人脸追踪得到的、经过校准的视线估计做平滑处理，映射到网页上的链接目标，并用停留或眨眼检测触发跳转。
works.exercise_en: Build a web page with WebGazer.js that opens a link automatically after you stare at it for 1.5 seconds. Twist: design a gaze interface for one specific user (such as someone with an injured hand).

works.title: HeadLight
works.description: A head-mounted projector with a fish-eye lens throws a very wide image onto the surroundings in front of the wearer, augmenting whatever the wearer faces without glasses.
works.idea_zh: 把投影仪戴在头上，眼前的整个空间就是屏幕。

video.video_title: HeadLight : a wearable wide-angle projector system for Egocentric visual augmentation.

works.technique: Pre-distorts the image to compensate for the fish-eye conversion lens and aligns it with head orientation so graphics land on the walls the wearer looks at.
works.exercise_zh: 用胶带把手机投影仪（或手机+镜子）固定在头盔上，让投影内容跟随视线出现在墙上；变化：投影内容是只有你转头时才会显现的“隐藏标记”。
works.description_zh: 一台装有鱼眼镜头的头戴式投影仪，把极宽的画面投射到佩戴者前方的环境中，无需眼镜就能增强佩戴者面对的一切。
works.idea_en: Wear a projector on your head and the whole space in front of you becomes a screen.
works.technique_zh: 预先对图像做畸变处理以补偿鱼眼转换镜头，并与头部朝向对齐，让图形落在佩戴者注视的墙面上。
works.exercise_en: Tape a phone projector (or a phone plus a mirror) to a helmet so the projected content appears on the wall wherever you look. Twist: project 'hidden markers' that appear only when you turn your head.

works.title: HeadPhones
works.description: Several ordinary phones lying on a table join into one large display simply by seeing the user's head with their front cameras, so a map spreads across all of them and the phones can be moved around freely.
works.description_zh: 几部普通手机平放在桌上，只要用前置相机看到用户的头，就能组合成一块大屏幕；地图会铺满所有手机，手机也可以随意挪动。
works.idea_en: Use the viewer's head as the shared reference that stitches many phones into one screen.
works.idea_zh: 以观看者的头为共同参照，把许多手机拼成一块屏幕。
works.technique: Each phone's front camera tracks the user's head; because every device sees the same head, their relative poses can be solved into one coordinate system over a local network, without markers or external cameras.
works.technique_zh: 每部手机的前置相机追踪用户的头部；由于所有设备看到的是同一个头，就能通过局域网把它们的相对位置解算到同一个坐标系中，不需要标记或外部相机。
works.exercise_en: Line up four phones, estimate each one's offset from the viewer with face tracking, and draw one continuous image across them in a web page. Twist: the image becomes a window into a 3D scene that shifts as you move your head.
works.exercise_zh: 把四部手机排成一排，用人脸追踪估计每部手机相对观看者的偏移，在网页中把一张连续的图片铺满它们。变体：图片变成一扇通向三维场景的窗户，随你的头部移动而变化。

video.video_title: Teaser: HeadPhones: Ad Hoc Mobile Multi-Display Environments through Head Tracking

works.title: HoloRoyale
works.description: Teams of players in HoloLens headsets battle across a large real space, with virtual robots and projectiles that hide behind, bounce off and collide with the actual walls and furniture.
works.description_zh: 戴着 HoloLens 的多支队伍在大片真实空间中对战，虚拟机器人和子弹会躲在真实墙壁和家具后面，也会从上面弹开或撞上它们。
works.idea_en: A multiplayer AR game at building scale where virtual action respects real architecture.
works.idea_zh: 一款建筑尺度的多人 AR 游戏，虚拟动作遵守真实的建筑结构。
works.technique: Maps a large venue in advance and shares a common coordinate frame across HoloLens devices so virtual elements get occlusion and physics against the real geometry.
works.technique_zh: 预先扫描大型场地，并在多台 HoloLens 之间共享坐标系，让虚拟元素相对真实几何体产生遮挡和物理效果。
works.exercise_en: Design a shared phone AR capture-the-flag game for the school hall where flags hide behind real pillars, using a common anchor on the floor. Twist: add a rule that you can only shoot what the other team cannot see.
works.exercise_zh: 为学校礼堂设计一款共享的手机 AR 夺旗游戏，把旗子藏在真实柱子后面，大家使用地面上的同一个锚点；变体：加一条规则，只能射击对方队伍看不到的目标。

video.video_title: HoloRoyale: A Large Scale High Fidelity Augmented Reality Game

works.title: Holograms That React to Music in Your Room
works.description: Paint audio-reactive holograms all over a room that pulse and morph with whatever music is playing (with Stephen Hodgson).
works.idea_zh: 在房间各处布置会随音乐跳动的全息图形。

video.video_title: Holograms that react to music in your room

works.technique: Painted stroke meshes have shader parameters (scale, emission, displacement) driven by real-time FFT bands of the playing music.
works.exercise_zh: 用空中画线生成 3D 笔画，再用音乐的 FFT 频段控制笔画粗细和亮度；变体：每条笔画绑定不同频段，低音粗高音亮。
works.description_zh: 在房间各处画满随音乐反应的全息图形，它们会跟着正在播放的音乐跳动、变形（与 Stephen Hodgson 合作）。
works.idea_en: Fill your room with holographic shapes that pulse to the music.
works.technique_zh: 绘制出的笔画网格的着色器参数（缩放、自发光、位移）由正在播放的音乐的实时 FFT 频段驱动。
works.exercise_en: Draw lines in the air to create 3D strokes, then use the music's FFT bands to control stroke thickness and brightness. Twist: bind each stroke to a different band, so bass makes strokes thicker and treble makes them brighter.

works.title: Hybrid UIs for Music Exploration in AR and VR
works.description: People browse an online music library together: some wear AR or VR headsets and grab genres and albums floating in 3D, others flick through the same collection on touch screens.
works.description_zh: 大家一起浏览在线音乐库：有人戴着 AR 或 VR 头显抓取悬浮在三维空间里的流派和专辑，有人在触摸屏上翻看同一个曲库。
works.idea_en: Let 2D touch screens and 3D headsets share one music collection in the same room.
works.idea_zh: 让二维触摸屏和三维头显在同一房间里共享同一个音乐库。
works.technique: Synchronises a 3D music-library visualisation across head-worn displays and multi-touch tablets, combining 3D hand tracking with 2D touch input.
works.technique_zh: 在头戴显示器和多点触控平板之间同步三维音乐库可视化，结合三维手部追踪和二维触控输入。
works.exercise_en: Lay out album covers as AR cards floating around the classroom and let students on laptops add songs to a shared playlist that phone users see appear in space. Twist: place songs by tempo from floor to ceiling.
works.exercise_zh: 把专辑封面做成漂浮在教室各处的 AR 卡片，让用笔记本电脑的学生往共享歌单里加歌，手机用户会看到新歌出现在空间中；变体：按节奏快慢把歌曲从地面排到天花板。

video.video_title: Hybrid UIs for Music Exploration in AR and VR

works.title: HydroRing
works.description: A thin ring pumps warm, cold or pulsing liquid through a latex tube on the fingertip to create pressure, vibration and temperature cues while leaving touch of real objects intact.
works.idea_zh: 用流动的液体在指尖产生冷热和压感，又不妨碍摸真实物体。

video.video_title: HydroRing: Supporting Mixed Reality Haptics using Liquid Flow

works.technique: Drives liquid through a thin tube over the fingerpad with pumps and heaters, modulating flow and temperature to render haptic effects.
works.exercise_zh: 让同学手指分别接触冷水袋和温水袋，同时在手机AR中看到“冰块/火焰”，讨论视觉与触觉一致时的真实感；变化：故意让视觉与温度相反。
works.description_zh: 一枚薄薄的指环，通过指尖上的乳胶管泵送温热、冰凉或脉动的液体，产生压力、振动和温度提示，同时不妨碍触摸真实物体。
works.idea_en: Use flowing liquid to create heat, cold and pressure at your fingertip without getting in the way of touching real things.
works.technique_zh: 用泵和加热器驱动液体流过贴在指腹上的细管，通过调节流量和温度呈现触觉效果。
works.exercise_en: Have classmates touch a cold water bag and a warm water bag with their fingers while seeing 'ice' or 'fire' in phone AR, and discuss how realistic it feels when sight and touch match. Twist: deliberately make the visuals contradict the temperature.

works.title: Hypnagogia
works.description: An installation-performance about the state between waking and dreaming: the artist wears an EEG headband whose brainwaves play an orchestrated light sequence while she reads her recorded dreams aloud.
works.description_zh: 关于清醒与梦境之间状态的装置表演：艺术家戴着脑电头带，脑波驱动编排好的灯光序列，同时她朗读自己记录的梦。
works.idea_en: Show the conscious brain as light while the voice reveals the unconscious.
works.idea_zh: 用光呈现清醒的大脑，用声音揭示潜意识。
works.technique: A Muse EEG headband streams brainwave data to Processing, which drives lights through Arduino Firmata.
works.technique_zh: Muse 脑电头带把脑波数据传给 Processing，再通过 Arduino Firmata 控制灯光。
works.exercise_en: Use a breathing or heart-rate sensor to dim and brighten a string of LEDs while a performer reads a dream diary aloud. Twist: the lights react to the audience's collective noise instead.
works.exercise_zh: 用呼吸或心率传感器控制一串 LED 明暗，同时表演者朗读梦境日记；变体：改为让灯光回应观众集体的声音。

video.video_title: HYPNAGOGIA - Video documentation (No Audio)

works.title: Indirect AR Browser for GIS Data
works.description: Pointing a phone at a street shows a pre-captured street-level panorama aligned to the view, with buildings and landmarks labelled perfectly because the labels live on the stored image.
works.description_zh: 把手机对准街道，屏幕显示与视角对齐的预采集街景全景图，建筑和地标的标签贴合得非常准确，因为标签是贴在存储图像上的。
works.idea_en: When live tracking is unreliable, augment a stored photo of the scene instead of the camera feed.
works.idea_zh: 实时追踪不可靠时，就去增强场景的存储照片，而不是摄像头画面。
works.technique: Replaces the live camera with crowd-sourced street-level imagery oriented by the phone's sensors and overlays geospatial data registered to that imagery.
works.technique_zh: 用手机传感器定向的众包街景图像替代实时摄像头画面，再把与图像配准的地理数据叠加上去。
works.exercise_en: Take a 360 photo of the school entrance, add labels on it in an editor, then show it on a phone that rotates with your gaze while standing at the same spot. Twist: switch between today's photo and an old photo of the same place.
works.exercise_zh: 在学校门口拍一张 360 度照片，在编辑器里加上标签，然后站在同一位置用会随视线转动的手机观看；变体：在今天的照片和同一地点的老照片之间切换。

video.video_title: Indirect Augmented Reality Browser for GIS Data

works.title: Instructions in AR
works.description: Hand-written technical instructions are attached to the real device they explain, using live image tracking.
works.idea_zh: 把手写的操作说明贴在它所说明的真实设备上。

video.video_title: Instructions in AR

works.technique: A photo of the device's panel is used as a reference image, and handwritten instruction images are attached as overlays at fixed offsets on the tracked image.
works.exercise_zh: 拍下打印机或咖啡机的面板作为识别图，在对应按钮旁贴上手写步骤说明；变体：步骤按顺序逐个出现，完成一步点一下再显示下一步。
works.description_zh: 借助实时图像追踪，把手写的技术说明贴在它所说明的真实设备上。
works.idea_en: Stick handwritten instructions onto the real device they explain.
works.technique_zh: 把设备面板的照片用作参考图像，手写说明图片以固定偏移作为叠加层附着在被追踪的图像上。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a printer or coffee machine panel as the recognition image and pin handwritten step instructions next to the matching buttons. Twist: steps appear one at a time, and each tap reveals the next.

works.title: It Will End in Stars
works.description: A VR fairy-tale landscape of charcoal drawings, text and scanned clay sculptures; a creature at its centre meets the viewer's gaze and responds to their movements, making them feel like a watched intruder.
works.description_zh: 由炭笔素描、文字和扫描黏土雕塑组成的 VR 童话风景；其中的一只生物会与观众对视，并对他们的动作做出反应，让观众觉得自己是被盯着的闯入者。
works.idea_en: The artwork looks back at you and reacts to your presence.
works.idea_zh: 作品会回看你，并对你的存在做出反应。
works.technique: Room-scale VR with photogrammetry-scanned clay figures and a creature whose head and eyes follow the headset position.
works.technique_zh: 房间级 VR，黏土角色经摄影测量扫描建模，其中一只生物的头部和眼睛会追随头显位置。
works.exercise_en: Place a character in AR or WebXR whose eyes always follow the camera, and add a rule that it steps back when stared at for three seconds. Twist: make it approach only while you look away.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 或 WebXR 中放置一个眼睛始终跟着摄像头的角色，并加一条规则：被盯着看三秒它就后退；变体：只有在你移开视线时它才靠近。

video.video_title: Acute Art presents Nathalie Djurberg & Hans Berg's It Will End in Stars

works.title: It's Lit! Projected AR Murals
works.description: Lettering artist Gemma O'Brien and Craig Winslow hand-paint a mural, then Lightform projects animated light that traces, fills and reveals the painted letters.
works.idea_zh: 手绘壁画 + 投影动画，让静态字母“亮”起来。

video.video_title: It’s Lit! Make Projected AR Murals with Lightform

works.technique: Scans the painted mural to extract its line work, then uses those edges as masks and paths for projected animated effects.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生在白纸板上用黑色马克笔写大字，再用投影仪和免费投影映射软件（如MapMap）沿笔画投射流光；变化：用声音音量控制光的亮度。
works.description_zh: 字体艺术家 Gemma O'Brien 和 Craig Winslow 手绘了一幅壁画，随后 Lightform 投射动画光影，沿着笔画勾勒、填充并逐步显现出画上的字母。
works.idea_en: A hand-painted mural plus projected animation makes still letters light up.
works.technique_zh: 扫描手绘壁画以提取线稿，再把这些边缘用作投影动画效果的遮罩和路径。
works.exercise_en: Have students write large letters with a black marker on white board, then use a projector and free projection-mapping software (such as MapMap) to send flowing light along the strokes. Twist: control the light's brightness with sound volume.

works.title: JIDO-RHYTHM Selfie Music Video
works.description: A selfie music-video app that deforms and animates your tracked face in time with the music.
works.idea_zh: 自拍音乐视频：脸部被追踪并随节奏变形。

video.video_title: Face Deformation / JIDO-RHYTHM

works.technique: ARKit face tracking provides a face mesh whose vertices are displaced by audio-analysis values (beat and amplitude), so the face deforms in time with music.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 MediaPipe Face Mesh 做一个随音乐节拍拉伸脸部的滤镜；变体：用你自己的哼唱而不是背景音乐驱动变形。
works.description_zh: 一款自拍音乐视频应用，让被追踪的脸随着音乐节奏变形、舞动。
works.idea_en: A selfie music video where your tracked face warps to the beat.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 人脸追踪提供面部网格，其顶点根据音频分析值（节拍和振幅）发生位移，让脸随音乐节奏变形。
works.exercise_en: Use Lens Studio or MediaPipe Face Mesh to build a filter that stretches the face to the music's beat. Twist: drive the deformation with your own humming instead of background music.

works.title: Julia
works.description: In Madrid's Plaza de Colón, a 12-metre elongated white head of a girl with closed eyes stands on a plinth once meant for a statue, in front of the city's traffic.
works.description_zh: 在马德里哥伦布广场，一个 12 米高、被拉长的闭眼少女白色头像立在原本为雕像准备的基座上，面对着城市车流。
works.idea_en: Seen from the side, the thin head almost disappears; from the front it fills the square, a lesson in designing AR objects that change with angle.
works.idea_zh: 从侧面看，这颗纤薄的头几乎消失；从正面看，它充满整个广场，这是设计随角度变化的 AR 物体的一课。
works.technique: The portrait is flattened in depth and stretched in height so its profile is very thin, then cast in resin with marble dust.
works.technique_zh: 肖像在深度上被压扁、在高度上被拉长，使侧面极薄，再以树脂和大理石粉浇铸。
works.exercise_en: Model an AR face that is only 10 cm thick but 10 m tall, place it on a plaza, and film how it appears and disappears as you walk around it. Twist: show a different person's face on the back side.
works.exercise_zh: 建模一张只有 10 厘米厚、却有 10 米高的 AR 面孔，放在广场上，拍摄绕行时它如何出现又消失；变体：在背面显示另一个人的脸。

video.video_title: Passing Julia - Jaume Plensa

works.title: Jumping across real surfaces
works.description: A character controlled by an on-screen joystick jumps between several real surfaces detected by ARCore, turning a table and the floor into platforms.
works.description_zh: 用屏幕上的虚拟摇杆控制一个角色，在 ARCore 检测到的多个真实平面之间跳跃，把桌子和地面变成平台关卡。
works.idea_en: Real furniture becomes platforms in a platformer game.
works.idea_zh: 真实家具变成平台跳跃游戏的平台。
works.technique: ARCore planes get colliders so a physics-driven character controller can land on them.
works.technique_zh: 给 ARCore 平面加上碰撞体，让基于物理的角色控制器可以落在上面。
works.exercise_en: Build a one-button jumping game on AR Foundation planes. Twist: the character can only land on surfaces of a certain color.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 平面上做一个单键跳跃游戏。变体：角色只能落在某种颜色的表面上。

video.video_title: Using virtual joystick to control a character jump on multiple physical surfaces with ARCore. https://t.co/11og8dDHQH

works.title: Just a Line
works.description: A minimal ARCore/ARKit app for drawing a single white line in the air; two people on Android and iPhone can draw together in the same space, and the result is a shareable video.
works.idea_zh: 只画一条线的AR涂鸦App，而且安卓和iPhone可以同场一起画。

video.video_title: Just a Line: The first cross-platform collaborative AR app (for doodling)

works.technique: The line is built from successive camera or touch-ray positions in world space extruded into a ribbon mesh, and Cloud Anchors share the anchor so two phones draw together.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 把手机移动时的位置连成一条 3D 线，再录屏导出；变体：线只能画一笔，中途松手就结束。
works.description_zh: 一款极简的 ARCore/ARKit 应用，只能在空中画一条白线；Android 和 iPhone 用户可以在同一空间里一起画，最终生成一段可分享的视频。
works.idea_en: An AR doodle app that draws just one line, and Android and iPhone users can draw together in the same space.
works.technique_zh: 把世界空间中连续的相机位置或触摸射线位置连起来，挤出成丝带状网格形成线条，再用 Cloud Anchors 共享锚点，让两部手机一起作画。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation to connect the phone's positions as it moves into a 3D line, then record and export the screen. Twist: you get only one stroke, and lifting your finger ends it.

salient.why_en: You can only draw one white line in the air, and that constraint makes spatial drawing obvious to anyone.
salient.why_zh: 只能在空中画一条白线，正是这个限制让任何人一看就懂什么是空间绘画。

works.title: Just a Line with Shantell Martin
works.description: Artist Shantell Martin extends her signature continuous black-line drawings into the air around her using Just a Line.
works.idea_zh: 艺术家把标志性的连续线条从墙面画进空气里。

video.video_title: Shantell Martin: See the world as your canvas with AR

works.technique: The same world-space line drawing is used by an artist whose single continuous stroke becomes a spatial drawing around her body.
works.exercise_zh: 邀请一位同学在 AR 中用一笔画绕着自己的身体画一幅画，并从多角度录像；变体：把画出来的线导出为模型，再 3D 打印。
works.description_zh: 艺术家 Shantell Martin 借助 Just a Line，把她标志性的连续黑色线条画延伸到身边的空气里。
works.idea_en: An artist carries her signature continuous line off the wall and into the air.
works.technique_zh: 沿用同样的世界空间画线技术，艺术家一笔到底的连续笔画变成了环绕她身体的空间绘画。
works.exercise_en: Invite a classmate to draw a single-stroke picture around their own body in AR and film it from several angles. Twist: export the line as a model and 3D print it.

works.title: KAWS:HOLIDAY Seoul
works.description: The first KAWS:HOLIDAY: a 28-metre inflatable COMPANION floats on its back on Seokchon Lake in Seoul, next to the Lotte World Tower, as if sunbathing during a heatwave.
works.description_zh: 第一站 KAWS:HOLIDAY：一个 28 米长的充气 COMPANION 仰面漂浮在首尔石村湖上，紧邻乐天世界塔，仿佛在热浪中晒太阳。
works.idea_en: A giant character doing something ordinary (sunbathing) in a real place is instantly shareable, the same reason giant AR characters spread online.
works.idea_zh: 一个巨大角色在真实地点做一件普通的事（晒太阳），立刻就适合分享，这也是巨型 AR 角色能在网上传播的原因。
works.technique: A large inflatable figure is tethered on the lake with anchors and ballast, produced with AllRightsReserved.
works.technique_zh: 大型充气人偶以锚和压载物系留在湖面上，由 AllRightsReserved 制作。
works.exercise_en: Place a 20-metre AR character lying on a real lake, pool or lawn, doing an everyday activity, and design the best photo spot for it. Twist: it changes its pose according to the local weather.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实的湖、泳池或草坪上放一个 20 米长、正在做日常活动的 AR 角色，并为它设计最佳拍照点；变体：它的姿势随当地天气变化。

video.video_title: [K-move] 'KAWS: HOLIDAY' on Seokchon Lake / YTN KOREAN

works.title: KIKK Festival 2018 – Augmented Reality Exhibit
works.description: Seven code-generated AR artworks by creative coders are hung around the city of Namur on physical frames; festival visitors unlock each one with a phone to watch it grow out of the wall.
works.description_zh: 七件由创意编程者创作的代码生成 AR 作品挂在那慕尔城中的实体画框上，艺术节观众用手机逐一解锁，看它们从墙上生长出来。
works.idea_en: Curate a street exhibition where the frames are real but the art only exists in AR.
works.idea_zh: 策划一场街头展览：画框是真的，作品只存在于 AR 中。
works.technique: Each physical frame is an image target for a festival app that renders a real-time generative WebGL-style piece anchored to it (artists included Bruno Simon, Matt DesLauriers and Edan Kwan).
works.technique_zh: 每个实体画框都是节日应用的图像目标，应用在画框上渲染一件实时生成的作品（参与艺术家包括 Bruno Simon、Matt DesLauriers 和 Edan Kwan）。
works.exercise_en: Hang five empty paper frames around the school, each an image target that loads a different student's generative sketch in WebAR. Twist: the pieces change with the time of day.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里挂五个空纸画框，每个都是图像目标，在 WebAR 中加载不同同学的生成式作品；变体：作品随一天中的时间变化。

video.video_title: KIKK Festival 2018 - Augmented Reality Exhibit

works.title: Kitchen Timers in Augmented Reality
works.description: Countdown timers float above real pots on the stove, rendered with motion blur, adaptive lighting and depth of field.
works.idea_zh: 让倒计时器悬浮在灶台上正在煮的锅上方。

video.video_title: Kitchen timers in augmented reality - iPhone ARKit demo

works.technique: Timers are placed as world anchors above detected pots, and renderer features (light estimation, motion blur, depth of field) make the overlay match the camera image.
works.exercise_zh: 点击锅的位置放一个悬浮倒计时，到时间变红并响铃；变体：多个计时器同时运行，按剩余时间自动排序高亮。
works.description_zh: 倒计时器悬浮在炉灶上真实的锅子上方，并带有运动模糊、自适应光照和景深效果。
works.idea_en: Float countdown timers above the pots cooking on the stove.
works.technique_zh: 计时器以世界锚点的形式放置在检测到的锅子上方，并借助渲染特性（光照估计、运动模糊、景深）使叠加层与相机画面融为一体。
works.exercise_en: Tap on a pot to place a floating countdown that turns red and rings when time is up. Twist: run several timers at once, automatically sorted and highlighted by time remaining.

salient.why_en: Countdown timers float right above the pots they are timing.
salient.why_zh: 倒计时直接浮在正在计时的锅上方。

works.title: L'ombre de la vapeur
works.description: A 900 m² immersive, interactive installation at the Fondation d'entreprise Martell in Cognac: a vast cloud of crumpled reflective material hangs over a floor of projected particles that visitors walk through and disturb, a tribute to the Torula fungus that once fed on the building's evaporating alcohol.
works.description_zh: 位于干邑 Fondation d'entreprise Martell 的 900 平方米沉浸式互动装置：一大片揉皱的反光材料像云一样悬在空中，下方地面铺满投影粒子，观众走进去就会搅动它们；作品向曾以建筑里蒸发的酒精为食、布满墙面的 Torula 真菌致敬。
works.idea_en: Make an invisible process, alcohol evaporating and the fungus living on it, into a landscape you can walk through.
works.idea_zh: 把一个看不见的过程——酒精蒸发，以及靠它生存的真菌——变成一片可以走进去的风景。
works.technique: Floor projection with presence sensing likely feeds eMotion particle systems that scatter around visitors, combined with a large physical sculpture that catches the light, so digital and material vapour share one space.
works.technique_zh: 地面投影结合人体感知，很可能由 eMotion 粒子系统驱动，让粒子绕着观众散开；再配合一个接住光线的大型实体雕塑，让数字的“蒸汽”和实物的“蒸汽”共处一室。
works.exercise_en: Choose an invisible process in your building (radiator heat, humidity, Wi-Fi traffic) and project a particle field on the floor that visitors disturb when a top-down webcam sees them; add one physical object that reflects or blocks the projection. Twist: make the particles slowly drift back toward where the invisible source really is.
works.exercise_zh: 在你所在的建筑里选一个看不见的过程（暖气散热、湿度、Wi-Fi 流量），在地面投一片粒子，俯拍摄像头看到有人走过时粒子会被搅动；再加一件会反射或遮挡投影的实物。变体：让粒子慢慢漂回那个看不见的源头真正所在的位置。

video.video_title: L'ombre de la vapeur

works.title: LUMOS
works.description: A tall geometric light sculpture in a Toronto park glows cold blue when alone; as people approach, a thermal camera senses their body heat and the light inside shifts to warm reds, oranges and yellows.
works.description_zh: 多伦多公园里一座高大的几何灯光雕塑，无人时发出冷蓝色的光；有人靠近时，热成像相机感知到人体热量，内部的光便转为温暖的红、橙、黄色。
works.idea_en: A winter beacon that turns warm when it feels your body heat.
works.idea_zh: 一座冬日灯塔，感受到你的体温就变暖。
works.technique: A thermal imaging camera detects warm bodies near the sculpture, and generative light code maps the detected heat to the colour of LEDs inside (with Jean-Michel Gariepy and Steven Mengin).
works.technique_zh: 热成像相机检测雕塑附近的人体热量，生成式灯光程序把检测到的热量映射成内部 LED 的颜色（合作者 Jean-Michel Gariepy 和 Steven Mengin）。
works.exercise_en: Build a lamp that reacts to presence: use a webcam person detector (or a cheap PIR/thermal sensor with Arduino) to fade a projected or LED colour from blue to warm as people come closer. Twist: it only turns fully warm when two people stand together.
works.exercise_zh: 做一盏感应“有人在场”的灯：用摄像头人体检测（或 Arduino 加廉价 PIR/热传感器），在人走近时把投影或 LED 的颜色从蓝色渐变为暖色。变体：只有两个人一起站着时才完全变暖。

video.video_title: LUMOS

salient.why_en: A cold blue beacon turns warm the moment it senses your body heat.
salient.why_zh: 冷蓝色的灯塔一感受到你的体温，就立刻变暖。

works.title: LUX FORMAE (Solid Light Festival, Rome)
works.description: Generative light patterns and architectural lighting move across the arches of a Roman building in time with electronic sound, tracing and reshaping its geometry instead of telling a story.
works.description_zh: 生成式光纹与建筑灯光随电子声音在罗马一座建筑的拱廊上移动，勾勒并重塑它的几何结构，而不是讲一个故事。
works.idea_en: Pure geometric light that follows the building's own lines can be more powerful than illustration; AR overlays can simply trace and emphasise real structure.
works.idea_zh: 沿着建筑自身线条走的纯几何光，可能比图画更有力量；AR 叠加也可以只是勾勒、强调真实结构。
works.technique: Real-time generative visuals are mapped onto the facade and combined with DMX-controlled lighting, cued to the soundtrack by Ondřej Skála.
works.technique_zh: 实时生成的影像被映射到立面上，并与 DMX 控制的灯光结合，按 Ondřej Skála 的配乐触发。
works.exercise_en: In AR, detect the edges of a real doorway or arch (manually outline them if needed) and animate glowing lines that travel along those edges to music. Twist: the line speed follows the loudness of the room.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中识别真实门洞或拱门的边缘（必要时手动描出），让发光线条随音乐沿这些边缘移动；变体：线条的速度跟随房间里的音量变化。

video.video_title: LUX FORMAE by Bordos.Artworks at SOLID LIGHT FESTIVAL 2018 ROMA

works.title: La Tabla
works.description: A game table in Dynamicland where physical game pieces and paper cards drive projected gameplay, shown at GDC's Experimental Gameplay Workshop.
works.idea_zh: 用真实卡片和棋子在投影桌上玩的'可编程'游戏。

video.video_title: La Tabla at the Experimental Gameplay Workshop, Mar 2018

works.technique: Realtalk's camera recognizes game pieces and paper cards by printed dot codes, and projection renders gameplay whose rules are themselves printed programs lying on the table.
works.exercise_zh: 用俯视投影 + ArUco 标记做一个桌游：棋子移动后投影显示路径和效果，桌边一张“规则卡”换成另一张时游戏规则随之改变；变体：让玩家在游戏中途修改规则卡。
works.description_zh: Dynamicland 中的一张游戏桌，实体棋子和纸质卡片驱动投影出来的游戏过程，曾在 GDC 的 Experimental Gameplay Workshop 上展示。
works.idea_en: A 'programmable' game played on a projection table with real cards and pieces.
works.technique_zh: Realtalk 的相机通过印刷的点阵码识别棋子和纸卡，投影则渲染游戏过程，而游戏规则本身就是摆在桌上的打印程序。
works.exercise_en: Build a board game with top-down projection and ArUco markers: when a piece moves, the projection shows its path and effects, and swapping the 'rule card' at the table's edge changes the rules. Twist: let players change the rule cards mid-game.

works.title: Languages of the Face
works.description: An augmented portrait made with the Sitka School District: two self-portraits, with and without glasses, reveal the names of facial features in Deg Xinag and Łingít when viewed through AR.
works.description_zh: 与锡特卡学区合作的增强肖像：两幅自画像（戴眼镜与不戴眼镜）在 AR 中显示用 Deg Xinag 语和 Łingít 语标注的五官名称。
works.idea_en: A portrait that teaches an endangered language.
works.idea_zh: 一幅能教授濒危语言的肖像。
works.technique: The printed portraits act as image targets, and an AR app overlays labels and likely audio pronunciations anchored to each facial feature.
works.technique_zh: 打印的肖像作为图像目标，AR 应用在每个五官位置叠加标注，很可能还带有语音发音。
works.exercise_en: Draw a self-portrait, use it as an image target, and label each feature in a heritage or minority language with recorded pronunciation. Twist: switch to face tracking so the labels follow a live face.
works.exercise_zh: 画一幅自画像作为图像目标，用一种传承语言或少数民族语言标注每个五官，并录下发音。变体：改用人脸追踪，让标注跟随真实的脸。

video.video_title: Languages of the Face, an Augmented Portrait

works.title: Laser Duck Hunt
works.description: The NES game Duck Hunt is redrawn in laser light on a wall, and players shoot the ducks with a hacked Zapper gun that puffs smoke when fired.
works.description_zh: 把任天堂红白机游戏 Duck Hunt 用激光重新画在墙上，玩家用改装过的 Zapper 光枪射鸭子，开枪时还会喷出烟雾。
works.idea_en: A screen game escapes onto the wall as laser light, played with its original toy gun.
works.idea_zh: 屏幕游戏以激光的形式跑到墙上，用原版玩具枪来玩。
works.technique: The hacked Zapper's aim is likely tracked with a camera or photo sensor, and the game is rendered as vector laser graphics through a laser DAC.
works.technique_zh: 改装 Zapper 的瞄准很可能用摄像头或光电传感器追踪，游戏以矢量激光图形通过激光 DAC 输出。
works.exercise_en: Pick a classic screen game and rebuild one level as a projected wall game played with a physical prop tracked by a webcam or phone. Twist: the prop must also produce a real-world effect (sound, air, light) when used.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个经典屏幕游戏，把其中一关改成投在墙上的游戏，用摄像头或手机追踪的实体道具来玩。变体：道具使用时必须同时产生一个真实效果（声音、风或光）。

video.video_title: Laser Duck Hunt

works.title: Lightflow (performance)
works.description: LED tubes reinterpret the water paths of old watermills in a gallery; in the performance version a dancer uses hand gestures to play the light and the field-recorded sound.
works.description_zh: LED 灯管在展厅里重新演绎古老水磨的水流路径；在表演版本中，舞者用手势演奏灯光和现场录音的声音。
works.idea_en: A landscape's water flow becomes a light instrument a dancer can play.
works.idea_zh: 一片土地的水流变成舞者可以演奏的灯光乐器。
works.technique: A Leap Motion gesture interface sends hand data to software that drives DMX-controlled LED tubes and layers of on-site sound recordings.
works.technique_zh: Leap Motion 手势接口把手部数据发给软件，驱动 DMX 控制的 LED 灯管和几层现场录音。
works.exercise_en: Record water sounds near your school, lay out a line of addressable LEDs along the floor, and map a phone's hand tracking to the speed of a light pulse and the sound mix. Twist: let the pulse only move downhill, like real water.
works.exercise_zh: 录下学校附近的水声，沿地面铺一排可寻址 LED，把手机的手部追踪映射到光脉冲的速度和声音混合上；变体：让光脉冲只能“往低处流”，像真正的水一样。

video.video_title: LIGHTFLOW (Performance)

works.title: Lightning Catchers
works.description: Laser lightning bolts strike down onto a courtyard, and players run with glowing LED sticks to catch them before they hit the ground.
works.description_zh: 激光闪电劈向广场，玩家举着发光的 LED 光棒奔跑，在闪电落地前把它接住。
works.idea_en: Catch virtual lightning with a real glowing stick.
works.idea_zh: 用一根真实的发光棒去接虚拟的闪电。
works.technique: A camera likely tracks the bright LED sticks and the software aims laser-drawn bolts, detecting a catch when a stick's position meets a bolt's end point.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头很可能追踪明亮的 LED 光棒，软件控制激光画出闪电，当光棒位置碰到闪电末端时判定为接住。
works.exercise_en: Track a phone flashlight or LED with a webcam and project falling objects that players must catch with the light. Twist: each catch makes the next object fall somewhere else in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头追踪手机闪光灯或 LED，投影下落的物体，玩家要用光去接住。变体：每接住一个，下一个就落到房间的另一处。

video.video_title: Lightning Catchers

works.title: Live VR Painting at the Louvre
works.description: In a live performance at the Louvre, the artist paints a three-dimensional interpretation of Delacroix's 'Liberty Leading the People' in VR while visitors watch the strokes appear on screens.
works.description_zh: 在卢浮宫的一场现场表演中，艺术家用 VR 画出德拉克洛瓦《自由引导人民》的三维诠释，观众通过屏幕看着笔触一笔笔出现。
works.idea_en: Step inside a famous painting and rebuild it as a space.
works.idea_zh: 走进一幅名画，把它重建成一个空间。
works.technique: A tracked VR headset with Tilt Brush is mirrored to large displays so the audience sees the 3D painting grow in real time.
works.technique_zh: 带追踪的 VR 头显运行 Tilt Brush，画面同步投到大屏上，观众可以实时看到三维画作逐渐生长。
works.exercise_en: Pick a classic painting and rebuild it as a 3D scene in an XR drawing tool, deciding what lies behind each figure. Twist: present it live while a partner narrates the history of the original.
works.exercise_zh: 选一幅经典名画，用 XR 绘画工具把它重建成三维场景，决定每个人物身后是什么；变体：现场作画，同时由搭档讲述原作的历史。

video.video_title: Live performance at the Louvre Museum Paris (virtual reality art)

works.title: Liverpool Mountain
works.description: A stack of brightly painted boulders stands on the Liverpool waterfront outside Tate Liverpool, bringing the desert totem idea into a port city.
works.description_zh: 一座由鲜艳彩绘巨石堆成的石柱立在利物浦泰特美术馆外的滨水区，把沙漠图腾的概念带进了港口城市。
works.idea_en: The same object placed in a new setting (desert to harbour) changes its meaning, which AR creators can test instantly by relocating content.
works.idea_zh: 同一件物体换了环境（从沙漠到港口）就改变了意义，AR 创作者可以通过移动内容立即检验这一点。
works.technique: Boulders were stacked on a steel core and painted in solid bright colours.
works.technique_zh: 巨石叠在钢芯上，并涂上纯色的鲜艳颜料。
works.exercise_en: Place the same bright AR totem in three places (a car park, a garden, a lobby) and interview passers-by about what it means in each. Twist: change one colour of the totem to match each site's dominant colour.
works.exercise_zh: 把同一个鲜艳的 AR 图腾放在三个地方（停车场、花园、大堂），询问路人在每处觉得它代表什么；变体：把图腾中的一种颜色换成每个场地的主色。

video.video_title: Ugo Rondinone – Liverpool Mountain | Tate

works.title: LumiWatch
works.description: The first fully functional projection smartwatch: a laser projector and depth sensing put a touchscreen on your forearm.
works.idea_zh: 第一块真正能用的投影手表，把触控屏直接打在你的前臂上。

video.video_title: LumiWatch: On-Arm Projected Graphics and Touch Input

works.technique: A small laser-scanning projector in the watch body projects onto the forearm with keystone correction, and a row of time-of-flight sensors along the watch edge measures finger position along the arm for 1D/2D touch.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机当“手表”：通过手机前置摄像头 + MediaPipe 检测手指在手臂上的位置，映射为一条滑块控制音量，并用小投影或屏幕显示反馈；变体：设计一个只能在手臂上完成、无法在手机屏幕上做的交互。
works.description_zh: 第一款功能完备的投影智能手表：激光投影仪加上深度感知，把一块触摸屏投到你的前臂上。
works.idea_en: The first projection watch that really works, putting a touch screen right on your forearm.
works.technique_zh: 表身内的小型激光扫描投影仪经梯形校正后投射到前臂上，表壳边缘的一排飞行时间（ToF）传感器测量手指在手臂上的位置，实现一维/二维触控。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone as the 'watch': detect your finger's position on your arm with the front camera and MediaPipe, map it to a slider that controls volume, and show feedback with a small projector or the screen. Twist: design an interaction that only works on the arm and cannot be done on a phone screen.

works.title: MIDAS Projection
works.description: Markerless, model-less dynamic projection mapping that makes objects appear to be made of a different material (metal, wood) while they move.
works.idea_zh: 不需要标记和模型，让移动中的物体看起来换了一种材质。

video.video_title: MIDAS Projection: Markerless and Modelless Dynamic Projection Mapping for Material Representation

works.technique: High-speed depth sensing measures the moving object's surface normals each frame, and a material shading model (e.g. metal reflections, wood grain) is computed per frame and projected so the object appears to be made of that material.
works.exercise_zh: 用深度相机或已知形状（白色立方体）估计表面法线，在 TouchDesigner 中渲染金属或木纹材质并投影回物体，转动物体观察高光是否跟随；变体：让物体看起来是“液体”或“毛绒”材质。
works.description_zh: 无需标记、也无需模型的动态投影映射，让物体在移动时看起来像是由另一种材质（金属、木头）做成的。
works.idea_en: Without markers or models, make a moving object look like it is made of a different material.
works.technique_zh: 高速深度感知每帧测量移动物体的表面法线，逐帧计算材质着色模型（例如金属反射、木纹）并投射出去，让物体看起来就是由这种材质制成的。
works.exercise_en: Estimate surface normals with a depth camera or a known shape (a white cube), render a metal or wood material in TouchDesigner and project it back onto the object, then rotate the object to see whether the highlights follow. Twist: make the object look like 'liquid' or 'fur'.

works.title: MRTouch
works.description: Adds touch input on real walls and tables to HoloLens: users drag out virtual screens on any surface and tap them directly.
works.idea_zh: 让HoloLens的全息界面贴在真实墙面上，可以直接用手指点按。

video.video_title: MRTouch: Adding Touch Input to Head-Mounted Mixed Reality

works.technique: HoloLens depth frames are segmented into planar surfaces, fingertips are detected in depth, and a touch is registered when the fingertip is within a small distance of the plane, letting users drag out virtual screens on real surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中检测墙面平面，用 AR 手部追踪或 MediaPipe 指尖位置判断是否贴近平面，贴近时可拉出一个矩形屏幕并在上面点击；变体：在门、窗、黑板上各放一个与其功能相关的虚拟屏幕。
works.description_zh: 为 HoloLens 增加了在真实墙面和桌面上的触控输入：用户可以在任意表面上拉出虚拟屏幕，并直接点按。
works.idea_en: Stick HoloLens holographic interfaces onto real walls and tap them directly with a finger.
works.technique_zh: 把 HoloLens 的深度帧分割成若干平面，在深度图中检测指尖，当指尖与平面的距离小于一个很小的阈值时记为一次触摸，让用户在真实表面上拉出虚拟屏幕。
works.exercise_en: Detect a wall plane in AR Foundation and use AR hand tracking or MediaPipe fingertip positions to tell whether a finger is close to it; when it is, let the user drag out a rectangular screen and tap on it. Twist: place a virtual screen related to each object's function on a door, a window and a blackboard.

works.title: Magic Leap Create
works.description: A mixed-reality toy box: place dinosaurs, knights, dominoes and paint strokes in your room, and they fight, topple and bounce off real furniture.
works.idea_zh: 在客厅里摆放恐龙、骑士和多米诺，它们会与真实家具互动。

video.video_title: Project Create (Magic Leap Studios) - Magic Leap

works.technique: Uses the headset's world mesh as a physics collider so user-placed toys and strokes land on, bounce off and hide behind real surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR的平面检测+物理（Reality Composer或Unity AR Foundation）搭一条跨越桌子和地面的虚拟多米诺；变化：必须利用一个真实物体作为机关。
works.description_zh: 一个混合现实玩具箱：在房间里摆上恐龙、骑士、多米诺骨牌和彩绘笔画，它们会打斗、倒下，并在真实家具上弹来弹去。
works.idea_en: Set dinosaurs, knights and dominoes loose in your living room, where they interact with real furniture.
works.technique_zh: 把头显的世界网格用作物理碰撞体，让用户放置的玩具和笔画能落在真实表面上、从上面弹开，或躲到它们后面。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR plane detection plus physics (Reality Composer or Unity AR Foundation) to build a virtual domino run that spans a table and the floor. Twist: it must use a real object as part of the contraption.

works.title: MathArt Lens
works.description: An early Snapchat world Lens that places a large, colourful parametric math sculpture in the room, which the user can walk around through the camera.
works.description_zh: 早期的 Snapchat 世界 Lens，在房间里放置一座大型、彩色的参数化数学雕塑，用户可以透过镜头绕着它走。
works.idea_en: Turn an equation into a sculpture you can stand next to.
works.idea_zh: 把一个方程变成可以站在旁边端详的雕塑。
works.technique: A parametric surface mesh (likely generated from a mathematical function) is placed with Lens Studio world tracking and ground detection.
works.technique_zh: 用 Lens Studio 的世界追踪和地面识别放置一个参数化曲面网格（很可能由数学函数生成）。
works.exercise_en: Generate a 3D surface from a math function in Python or Blender and place it at human scale in AR. Twist: let a slider change one parameter so the sculpture morphs live.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Python 或 Blender 根据一个数学函数生成 3D 曲面，并以人体尺度放进 AR；变体：加一个滑块改变某个参数，让雕塑实时变形。

video.video_title: Math Art Snapchat Lens

works.title: Media Scenography for Chinese Theater (with Tim Yip)
works.description: Stage visuals for a theatre show by Oscar-winning art director Tim Yip that blends traditional and modern theatre: digital sand, bamboo, fabric, water, stone and smoke transform into landscapes, walls, warriors and dragons around the actors. Sound by Benjamin Teare.
works.description_zh: 为奥斯卡获奖美术指导叶锦添（Tim Yip）的一部融合传统与现代的剧场作品创作的舞台视觉：数字化的沙、竹、布、水、石和烟，在演员周围变成山水、城墙、武士和龙。声音设计 Benjamin Teare。
works.idea_en: Building a stage language from a few elemental materials keeps digital scenery coherent; AR worlds also feel stronger when every effect comes from one material palette.
works.idea_zh: 用少数几种基本材质构建舞台语言，能让数字布景保持统一；AR 世界里如果每个特效都来自同一套材质，也会更有力量。
works.technique: Physical simulations of sand, cloth, water and smoke are rendered as projected scenery and morph between elements to match the drama.
works.technique_zh: 对沙、布、水和烟做物理模拟，渲染成投影布景，并随剧情在不同材质之间变形。
works.exercise_en: Choose one material (sand or smoke) and build three AR scenes in Unity VFX Graph or Lens Studio where it becomes a wall, a creature and a landscape around a real person. Twist: the transitions are triggered by the person's gestures.
works.exercise_zh: 选一种材质（沙或烟），在 Unity VFX Graph 或 Lens Studio 里做三个 AR 场景，让它在真人周围变成一堵墙、一只生物和一片风景；变体：由这个人的手势触发场景切换。

video.video_title: Media Scenography for Chinese Theater

works.title: Median
works.description: A group piece in which several dancers move through projected fields of light and particles that connect and separate them across the stage.
works.description_zh: 一件群舞作品：多位舞者在投影的光与粒子场中移动，这些光场在舞台上把他们连接又分开。
works.idea_en: A shared projected field turns several bodies into one system; multi-user AR can show relationships between people the same way.
works.idea_zh: 共享的投影场把多个身体变成一个系统；多人 AR 也可以用同样方式显示人与人之间的关系。
works.technique: Real-time generative imagery by Shoya Dozono and Gabor Papp is projected across the stage and synchronised with the choreography.
works.technique_zh: 堂園翔矢和 Gabor Papp 编写的实时生成影像投满整个舞台，并与编舞同步。
works.exercise_en: Build a shared AR session where lines of light connect every participant's phone and stretch or snap as people move apart. Twist: a line only reforms when both people face each other.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个共享 AR 会话，用光线连接每位参与者的手机，人们走远时光线被拉长或断开；变体：只有两个人面对面时，断开的线才会重新连上。

video.video_title: Median - excerpt

works.title: Mediate: A Spatial Tangible Interface for Mixed Reality
works.description: A shape-changing tangible interface that physically represents virtual content inside mixed reality, bridging headset holograms and touchable form.
works.idea_zh: 给混合现实里的虚拟物体配上可触摸、会变形的实体替身。

video.video_title: Mediate: A Spatial Tangible Interface for Mixed Reality

works.technique: A shape-changing tangible device is spatially registered to the MR headset so that its physical form is actuated to match the virtual object the user is reaching for, providing passive haptic proxy feedback.
works.exercise_zh: 在 HoloKit 或手机 AR 中把一个实体盒子注册为虚拟物体的“替身”，当虚拟物体变形时提示同学手动调整盒子（或用舵机撑开），让手摸到的形状与看到的一致；变体：故意让看到的和摸到的不一致，测试多大差别会被察觉。
works.description_zh: 一种可变形的实体交互界面，在混合现实中以物理形态呈现虚拟内容，连接起头显中的全息影像与可触摸的形体。
works.idea_en: Give virtual objects in mixed reality a touchable, shape-changing physical stand-in.
works.technique_zh: 可变形的实体装置在空间上与 MR 头显配准，其物理形态会被驱动变形，以匹配用户伸手去触碰的虚拟物体，从而提供被动的触觉代理反馈。
works.exercise_en: Register a physical box as the 'stand-in' for a virtual object in HoloKit or phone AR, and when the virtual object changes shape, prompt a classmate to adjust the box by hand (or push it open with a servo) so what the hand feels matches what the eye sees. Twist: deliberately mismatch what is seen and felt, and test how big a difference people notice.

works.title: Melting Memories
works.description: Large LED screens show slowly shifting, sculptural forms made from EEG recordings of people's brains while they recalled memories.
works.description_zh: 大幅 LED 屏上缓慢变化的雕塑般形体，来自人们回忆往事时记录下的脑电图数据。
works.idea_en: Biosignals become compelling when turned into matter-like forms; AR can visualise a user's heartbeat or breath as an object in the room instead of a number.
works.idea_zh: 生物信号变成物质般的形体时才动人：AR 可以把用户的心跳或呼吸可视化成房间里的一个物体，而不是一个数字。
works.technique: EEG signals recorded during memory recall are processed into parameters that drive 3D noise fields rendered as data sculptures on LED walls.
works.technique_zh: 记忆回想时记录的脑电信号被处理成参数，驱动三维噪声场，在 LED 墙上渲染成数据雕塑。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone camera heart-rate app or the microphone to capture a user's pulse or breath, and map it to the noise of a soft 3D blob floating beside them in AR. Twist: record one minute and replay it next to the live one, so past and present calm can be compared.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机摄像头心率应用或麦克风采集用户的脉搏或呼吸，把它映射成身旁一个漂浮在 AR 中的柔软三维团块的噪声。变体：录下一分钟，与实时数据并排回放，比较过去和现在的平静程度。

video.video_title: Melting Memories: Engram as data sculpture [Refik Anadol] // LEV Festival 2019

works.title: Memes + AR with Watson
works.description: Say a phrase aloud and the matching meme image is searched and dropped into the room on a detected ground plane.
works.idea_zh: 说出一句话，对应的表情包就出现在房间里。

video.video_title: Let’s Make A Unity App (MEMES + AR)

works.technique: Speech-to-text (IBM Watson) extracts a phrase, an image search API returns a matching image, and the image is spawned as a textured quad on a detected ground plane.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Web Speech API 识别一句话，从本地图库中按关键词找图并在 WebXR 地面上生成一张图片卡片；变体：图片大小随说话音量变化。
works.description_zh: 大声说出一句话，系统就会搜索对应的表情包图片，并把它放到房间里检测到的地面上。
works.idea_en: Say a phrase and the matching meme appears in your room.
works.technique_zh: 语音转文字（IBM Watson）提取短语，图片搜索 API 返回匹配的图片，再把图片作为带纹理的四边形生成在检测到的地面平面上。
works.exercise_en: Recognize a spoken phrase with the Web Speech API, find a matching image in a local library by keyword, and spawn it as an image card on the floor in WebXR. Twist: the image size follows how loudly you speak.

works.title: Merger
works.description: A 360-degree film of an office worker whose entire workspace is a floating AR interface, controlled by hand and voice, as she fights to stay relevant against automation.
works.idea_zh: 未来白领被全息工作界面包围，用手势对抗AI取代的焦虑

video.video_title: Merger

works.technique: 360-degree rendered film of a head-centred UI sphere; a live equivalent uses a headset with hand tracking and floating panels arranged on a body-anchored cylinder.
works.exercise_zh: 用 HoloKit 或 WebXR 做一个环绕自己的多窗口工作界面，用手势或捏合切换任务；变体：让窗口数量随时间不断增加，直到用户必须“放弃”某些任务才能看清前方。
works.description_zh: 一部 360 度影片，讲述一位上班族的整个工作空间都是一个悬浮的 AR 界面，她用手势和语音操控它，拼命不让自己被自动化淘汰。
works.idea_en: A future office worker, surrounded by holographic work screens, fights off the fear of being replaced by AI with hand gestures.
works.technique_zh: 以头部为中心的 UI 球面被渲染成 360 度影片；若要实时实现，可以用带手部追踪的头显，把悬浮面板排布在以身体为锚点的圆柱面上。
works.exercise_en: Build a multi-window work interface that surrounds you in HoloKit or WebXR, switching tasks with gestures or pinches. Twist: keep adding windows over time until the user must 'give up' some tasks to see what is in front of them.

works.title: Message from Future
works.description: In Geneva, a 5,000-square-metre painting of a girl folding a paper boat made of a map of the world supports the rescue ship Aquarius and migrants crossing the sea.
works.description_zh: 在日内瓦，一幅 5000 平方米的画作描绘一个女孩用世界地图折纸船，以声援救援船 Aquarius 与横渡大海的移民。
works.idea_en: A message painted into a landscape can speak for a cause at the scale of a city, a strong use of large-scale location AR.
works.idea_zh: 画进风景里的信息能以城市尺度为某个议题发声，这是大尺度位置 AR 的有力用法。
works.technique: Painted with biodegradable pigments on a lakeside lawn, sized to be read by drones and from surrounding buildings.
works.technique_zh: 用可降解颜料画在湖边草坪上，尺寸按无人机和周围建筑的视角设计。
works.exercise_en: Paint a message for a cause as a giant AR image on a lawn and share it as a geo-anchored post that others can visit. Twist: the image reveals a second message when seen from directly above.
works.exercise_zh: 把为某个议题发声的信息画成草坪上的巨大 AR 图像，并以地理锚定帖子的形式分享给他人前往观看；变体：从正上方看时，图像会显出第二条信息。

video.video_title: Message from Future | Saype -  Geneva 2018 | Le Sabe Prod

works.title: Mica
works.description: A photoreal digital human sits at your real table, makes eye contact, reacts to your gaze and shares small moments without speaking.
works.idea_zh: 一个会和你对视、坐在你真实桌旁的数字人。

video.video_title: Magic Leap's Mica Artificial Human From LeapCon

works.technique: Drives the character's gaze and expressions from the user's tracked eye direction and anchors her to detected table and chair surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR放置一个虚拟角色，使其头部始终转向手机镜头（LookAt），让同学体验被注视的感觉；变化：角色只在你不看它时移动。
works.description_zh: 一个照片级逼真的数字人坐在你真实的桌旁，与你目光交汇，对你的注视做出反应，不说一句话却与你分享一些小小的瞬间。
works.idea_en: A digital human who sits at your real table and meets your gaze.
works.technique_zh: 根据被追踪的用户视线方向驱动角色的目光和表情，并把她锚定在检测到的桌面和椅子表面上。
works.exercise_en: Place a virtual character with phone AR whose head always turns toward the phone camera (LookAt), so classmates feel what it is like to be watched. Twist: the character moves only when you are not looking at it.

works.title: Mini-Me
works.description: A remote VR collaborator appears as an adaptive miniature avatar that always stays in view of the AR user, with gaze and pointing redirected to stay accurate.
works.idea_zh: 远程伙伴变成始终在你视线里的'迷你小人'，指向和视线依旧准确。

video.video_title: Mini-Me: An Adaptive Avatar for Mixed Reality  Remote Collaboration

works.technique: The remote VR user's avatar is scaled down and repositioned to stay within the AR user's field of view, while their gaze and pointing directions are retargeted so they still point at the correct objects.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中放一个小人化身，始终跟随在屏幕边缘可见位置，远端同学点击某个物体时，小人转身指向它；变体：给小人加上情绪表达（点头、疑惑），测试它能否替代语音。
works.description_zh: 远程 VR 协作者以一个可自适应的迷你化身出现，始终保持在 AR 用户的视野之内，其视线和指向经过重定向，依然保持准确。
works.idea_en: A remote partner becomes a 'mini-me' that always stays in your view, still pointing and looking accurately.
works.technique_zh: 远程 VR 用户的化身被缩小并重新定位，以保持在 AR 用户的视野范围内，同时对其视线和指向方向做重定向，使它们仍然指向正确的物体。
works.exercise_en: Place a small avatar in phone AR that always stays visible at the edge of the screen, and when a remote classmate taps an object, the avatar turns to point at it. Twist: give the avatar emotional gestures (nodding, looking puzzled) and test whether they can replace voice.

works.title: Mixed Reality Test
works.description: A small demo mixing VR and AR: an ARKit iPhone and a VR headset share the same Normcore session so the phone sees the VR player's world placed in the real room.
works.idea_zh: 让iPhone AR与VR头显共享同一个多人空间。

video.video_title: Mixed Reality Test - November 2018

works.technique: A networked session (Normcore) shares object and player transforms, and the AR phone aligns its world origin to the VR play space so VR content appears in the real room.
works.exercise_zh: 让一台电脑上的 Unity 场景和一台手机 AR 共享同一组物体位置，电脑上移动的物体在手机里实时出现在桌面上；变体：手机也可以反过来推动物体。
works.description_zh: 一个混合 VR 与 AR 的小演示：一部 ARKit iPhone 和一台 VR 头显共享同一个 Normcore 会话，手机便能看到 VR 玩家的世界被放置在真实房间里。
works.idea_en: Let iPhone AR and a VR headset share the same multiplayer space.
works.technique_zh: 联网会话（Normcore）共享物体和玩家的变换，AR 手机把自己的世界原点对齐到 VR 游玩空间，使 VR 内容出现在真实房间中。
works.exercise_en: Have a Unity scene on a computer and a phone AR app share the same set of object positions, so objects moved on the computer show up on the phone's tabletop in real time. Twist: the phone can push objects back the other way.

works.title: Move Mirror
works.description: A web experiment where you move in front of your webcam and, frame by frame, it finds a photo of someone else in the same pose, turning your dance into a flipbook of strangers.
works.description_zh: 一个网页实验：你在摄像头前动起来，它会逐帧找到姿势相同的另一个人的照片，把你的舞蹈变成一本由陌生人组成的翻页书。
works.idea_en: Your body becomes a search query that finds strangers striking the same pose.
works.idea_zh: 你的身体变成一个搜索词，去找到摆出同样姿势的陌生人。
works.technique: PoseNet in TensorFlow.js estimates body keypoints in the browser and matches them against a database of pose vectors from 80,000 images.
works.technique_zh: 在浏览器中用 TensorFlow.js 的 PoseNet 估计身体关键点，再与 8 万张图片的姿势向量数据库进行匹配。
works.exercise_en: Collect 50 pose photos from classmates, then build a webcam page that shows the closest-matching photo to your current pose. Twist: match poses between two live webcams instead of a database.
works.exercise_zh: 收集同学们的 50 张姿势照片，做一个网页，用摄像头实时显示与你当前姿势最接近的照片；变体：不用数据库，改为在两个实时摄像头之间匹配姿势。

video.video_title: AI Experiments: Move Mirror

salient.why_en: Your pose becomes a search query that finds strangers striking the same pose, frame by frame.
salient.why_zh: 你的姿势就是搜索词，每一帧都找出一个摆着同样姿势的陌生人。

works.title: Museo del Prado 200 years
works.description: For the 200th anniversary of the Museo del Prado in Madrid, Onionlab mapped the museum's façade as part of the show 'Un lugar de memoria y futuro', with an aerial performance by La Fura dels Baus and fireworks. The stone front appears to breathe, crack and fill with paintings from the collection.
works.description_zh: 为庆祝马德里普拉多博物馆建馆 200 周年，Onionlab 为博物馆立面做了投影映射，作为演出《记忆与未来之地》的一部分，同场还有 La Fura dels Baus 的空中表演和烟火。石质立面仿佛在呼吸、开裂，并被馆藏名画填满。
works.idea_en: A museum can show what is inside on its outside; AR can turn any building's walls into a preview of its contents.
works.idea_zh: 博物馆可以在外墙上展示它里面有什么；AR 能把任何建筑的外墙变成其内部内容的预览。
works.technique: Large-scale architectural projection mapping synchronised with pyrotechnics and aerial performers for a live event.
works.technique_zh: 大规模建筑投影映射，与烟火和空中表演者在现场活动中同步。
works.exercise_en: Choose a library or museum near you and build an AR layer (8th Wall or Lens Studio) that shows three objects from its collection emerging from the façade. Twist: the objects appear in the windows closest to where they are really kept inside.
works.exercise_zh: 选一座附近的图书馆或博物馆，用 8th Wall 或 Lens Studio 做一个 AR 图层，让三件馆藏从立面中浮现；变体：每件物品出现在离它在馆内真实存放位置最近的窗户上。

video.video_title: Museo del Prado 200 years - 3D projection mapping

works.title: Museum (Channel 18)
works.description: Classical statues float in a Unity scene whose backgrounds and surfaces are live-coded in KodeLife during DUB-Russell's set at Channel 18.
works.description_zh: 在 DUB-Russell 于 Channel 18 的演出中，古典雕像漂浮在 Unity 场景里，背景和表面由 KodeLife 现场编写。
works.idea_en: Mix improvised code with prepared 3D props, like a museum curated live.
works.idea_zh: 把即兴代码和准备好的 3D 道具混在一起，像一座现场策展的博物馆。
works.technique: KodeLife's live-coded GLSL output is shared with Unity through Spout in real time, where it becomes the backdrop and texture for scanned statues with glitch post effects.
works.technique_zh: KodeLife 现场编写的 GLSL 画面通过 Spout 实时共享给 Unity，成为扫描雕像的背景和纹理，再叠加故障后期效果。
works.exercise_en: Place a scanned statue in AR and texture it with a shader that students live-edit in a browser. Twist: switch statues on every chorus of the song.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中放一座扫描雕像，用学生在浏览器里现场修改的着色器作为它的纹理；变体：每到歌曲副歌就换一座雕像。

video.video_title: CHANNEL#18 / DUB-Russell x Keijiro Takahashi

works.title: My Room Is Another Fish Bowl
works.description: Dozens of helium-filled mylar fish float at head height through a gallery, drifting with the air currents and gently bumping into visitors.
works.description_zh: 几十条充了氦气的聚酯薄膜鱼在展厅里漂浮在头部高度，随气流漂移，轻轻撞到观众身上。
works.idea_en: Objects that drift at eye level and react to air turn a room into water without any screen; AR creatures feel present when they avoid or bump into the body.
works.idea_zh: 在眼睛高度漂浮、会被气流推动的物体，不用任何屏幕就把房间变成了水：AR 生物只有在躲闪或碰到身体时，才显得真实在场。
works.technique: Balloons are weighted to neutral buoyancy so tiny drafts from visitors and ventilation steer them (weighting method likely small counterweights).
works.technique_zh: 气球被配重到接近中性浮力，观众走动和通风带来的微小气流就能推动它们（配重方式推测为小型坠物）。
works.exercise_en: Fill a room with 20 AR fish that hover at the user's eye height and drift away from the phone as if pushed by air. Twist: use the microphone so blowing on the phone makes the nearest fish swim off.
works.exercise_zh: 在房间里放 20 条 AR 鱼，悬浮在用户眼睛高度，并像被气流推开一样从手机前漂走。变体：用麦克风检测吹气，对着手机吹一口，最近的鱼就会游开。

video.video_title: Philippe Parreno 'My Room Is Another Fish Bowl' 2018

salient.why_en: Balloon fish drift at head height and bump into you, so the room becomes a fish tank.
salient.why_zh: 气球做的鱼在头的高度漂浮，还会轻轻撞到你，整个房间变成了鱼缸。

works.title: NYU Holodeck
works.description: The NSF-funded Holodeck project combines motion capture, headsets and Chalktalk into shared mixed reality for teaching and collaboration.
works.idea_zh: 把共享混合现实做成可以一起上课、协作的'全息甲板'。

video.video_title: NYU Holodeck: The Future Reality Lab with Ken Perlin

works.technique: Room-scale optical motion capture, networked headsets and a shared scene-graph server let multiple users and Chalktalk content occupy one synchronized mixed-reality space.
works.exercise_zh: 设计并测试一节 10 分钟的“共享 AR 小课”：用共享锚点让全班手机看到同一个 3D 模型（如心脏或分子），讲者点击时所有人看到同一个高亮；变体：让学生可以举手（在 AR 里放标记）向讲者提问。
works.description_zh: 由美国国家科学基金会（NSF）资助的 Holodeck 项目，把动作捕捉、头显和 Chalktalk 结合成一个共享的混合现实空间，用于教学与协作。
works.idea_en: Turn shared mixed reality into a 'holodeck' where people take classes and collaborate together.
works.technique_zh: 房间尺度的光学动作捕捉、联网头显和共享场景图服务器，让多名用户与 Chalktalk 内容共处于同一个同步的混合现实空间。
works.exercise_en: Design and test a 10-minute 'shared AR mini-lesson': use a shared anchor so every phone in the class sees the same 3D model (such as a heart or a molecule), and when the speaker taps it, everyone sees the same highlight. Twist: let students raise a hand (by placing a marker in AR) to ask the speaker a question.

works.title: Narcisse
works.description: A screen acts as a mirror, but the reflection of the visitor is gradually altered and deformed, asking at what point we stop recognising ourselves.
works.description_zh: 一块屏幕像镜子一样映出观众，但镜中的样子会被逐渐改变、扭曲，让人追问：变到什么程度，我们就不再认得自己？
works.idea_en: A mirror that slowly stops being you.
works.idea_zh: 一面慢慢不再像你的镜子。
works.technique: A depth sensor captures the visitor's body and the software re-renders it as a live mirror image with progressive distortions (the exact deformations are likely generative).
works.technique_zh: 深度传感器捕捉观众的身体，程序把它实时重新渲染成镜像，并逐步加入变形（具体变形方式推测为生成式）。
works.exercise_en: Build a webcam mirror in p5.js or TouchDesigner that becomes more distorted the longer a person stands still. Twist: the distortion copies the face of the previous visitor.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 或 TouchDesigner 做一面摄像头镜子，人站得越久，镜像扭曲得越厉害；变体：扭曲的方向是朝上一位观众的脸变形。

video.video_title: Narcisse

works.title: Nebula
works.description: A long dark room is covered with drifts of white paper particles. Nine fans switch on as visitors approach, so every step blows the particles into new landscapes that the next visitor inherits.
works.description_zh: 一个狭长的黑暗房间铺满了白色的纸屑。观众走近时，九台风扇依次启动，每一步都把纸屑吹成新的地貌，留给下一位观众。
works.idea_en: Your presence is the wind that reshapes a landscape.
works.idea_zh: 你的存在就是改变地貌的风。
works.technique: Proximity sensors read by Arduino boards switch fans on and off depending on where visitors move, and the system pauses to self-regulate once enough particles pile up.
works.technique_zh: 由 Arduino 读取的距离传感器根据观众走到的位置开关风扇；当纸屑堆积到一定程度时，系统会暂停并自我调节。
works.exercise_en: Build a tabletop version: place a small USB fan and a distance sensor at each side of a tray of confetti, and blow when a hand comes near. Twist: the fans blow away from the hand, so you can never reach the confetti.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个桌面版：在一盘彩纸屑的四周各放一个小 USB 风扇和一个距离传感器，手靠近时对应的风扇就吹；变体：风扇总是朝远离手的方向吹，让你永远碰不到纸屑。

video.video_title: Nebula, Under the Same Sky, Signal Film & Media, Barrow, United Kingdom, 2018

works.title: Ngx
works.description: Endless abstract VJ footage is generated frame by frame by a neural network that predicts the next frame, and two models can be crossfaded live.
works.description_zh: 一个预测下一帧的神经网络逐帧生成无尽的抽象 VJ 画面，两个模型还可以现场交叉淡入淡出。
works.idea_en: A neural network that hallucinates an infinite music video from a short clip.
works.idea_zh: 让神经网络从一小段视频出发，幻想出一部永不结束的音乐影像。
works.technique: pix2pix is trained as a next-frame predictor on pairs of consecutive frames from a clip (for example Beeple's VJ loops), and each output frame is fed back as the next input; two models are mixed by interpolating their outputs.
works.technique_zh: 把 pix2pix 训练成下一帧预测器，训练数据是一段视频（例如 Beeple 的 VJ 素材）中相邻帧的配对，每次输出的帧再作为下一次输入；两个模型通过插值混合输出。
works.exercise_en: Show a feedback-loop generative model on a floating AR screen and let viewers crossfade two models by moving the phone left or right. Twist: seed the loop with the live camera image of the room.
works.exercise_zh: 把反馈循环的生成模型显示在一块悬浮的 AR 屏幕上，观众左右移动手机即可在两个模型之间淡入淡出；变体：用房间的实时相机画面作为循环的起点。

video.video_title: Realtime pix2pix VJ system

works.title: OP-Z videolab visuals
works.description: Short 3D visual loops made in Unity are played by the steps and tracks of the Teenage Engineering OP-Z synthesizer and rendered live on an iPhone.
works.description_zh: 用 Unity 做的简短 3D 视觉循环由 Teenage Engineering OP-Z 合成器的步进和音轨“演奏”，在 iPhone 上实时渲染。
works.idea_en: Let a synthesizer's sequencer play 3D visuals directly.
works.idea_zh: 让合成器的音序器直接演奏 3D 视觉。
works.technique: Scenes built with the OP-Z videolab package are exported as videopaks; the OP-Z iOS app maps sequencer tracks and notes to animation triggers and vertex-shader parameters.
works.technique_zh: 用 OP-Z videolab 工具包制作的场景被导出为 videopak，OP-Z 的 iOS 应用把音序器的音轨和音符映射到动画触发和顶点着色器参数。
works.exercise_en: Map MIDI notes (or beats detected by the microphone) to VFX Graph events in a phone AR scene, one effect per drum. Twist: anchor each drum's effect to a different real object in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 场景中把 MIDI 音符（或麦克风检测到的节拍）映射为 VFX Graph 事件，每种鼓一个效果；变体：把每种鼓的效果锚定到房间里不同的真实物体上。

video.video_title: OP-Z videolab

works.title: Outside the Wall
works.description: A mixed-reality installation of a table, chair and domestic objects viewed through an iPad, where virtual elements break out of the domestic wall into the space.
works.idea_zh: 透过平板，家里的墙被打破，外面的世界涌进来
works.technique: An iOS AR app registers virtual content to a physical arrangement of furniture and objects so the scene extends beyond the real wall.
works.exercise_zh: 摆一张桌子和几件日常物，用AR让墙面“破开”显示另一个世界；变化：物体被移动后，墙外的景象也随之改变。

video.video_title: Outside the Wall

works.description_zh: 一件混合现实装置，由一张桌子、一把椅子和一些家居物品组成；透过 iPad 观看时，虚拟元素冲破家中的墙壁，涌入空间。
works.idea_en: Through a tablet, the wall at home breaks open and the outside world pours in.
works.technique_zh: iOS AR 应用把虚拟内容与家具和物品的实体摆设配准，使场景延伸到真实墙面之外。
works.exercise_en: Arrange a table and a few everyday objects, and use AR to 'break open' the wall and show another world. Twist: when the objects are moved, the view beyond the wall changes too.

works.title: Palimpsest
works.description: A smartphone audio walk of geotagged sound compositions in the language of audio description, which narrate dancers who are not there so they gradually appear in the listener's imagination in the real city.
works.description_zh: 一场手机声音漫步：用口述影像的语言写成的地理定位声音作品，讲述并不在场的舞者，让他们在真实城市中逐渐浮现在听者的想象里。
works.idea_en: Audio-only AR: describe a dance precisely enough and the city starts performing it.
works.idea_zh: 只用声音的 AR：把一段舞描述得足够精确，城市就开始上演它。
works.technique: A smartphone app triggers audio-description tracks by GPS location along a route, so each description matches what the listener is standing in front of.
works.technique_zh: 手机 App 沿路线根据 GPS 位置触发口述影像音轨，让每段描述都对应听者眼前的场景。
works.exercise_en: Write three 30-second audio descriptions of an imaginary dancer at three campus spots and trigger them by location in a web app. Twist: one description places the dancer right behind the listener.
works.exercise_zh: 为校园里的三个地点各写一段 30 秒的口述影像，描述一位想象中的舞者，并在网页 App 中按位置触发；变体：其中一段描述让舞者就站在听者身后。

video.video_title: Cie Nicole Seiler - Palimpsest Lausanne (2018)

works.title: Pix2Pix for Unity
works.description: A sketch drawn on screen is turned instantly into a photo-like image, such as edges into a cat, by a neural network running inside Unity.
works.description_zh: 在屏幕上画的草图被 Unity 里运行的神经网络即时变成类似照片的图像，比如把线条变成一只猫。
works.idea_en: Use real-time image-to-image translation as a drawing tool.
works.idea_zh: 把实时的图像到图像翻译变成一种绘画工具。
works.technique: A hand-written compute-shader inference engine runs a pre-trained pix2pix generator (a U-Net) in Unity without any external machine-learning framework.
works.technique_zh: 作者自己用计算着色器写了推理引擎，在 Unity 里直接运行预训练的 pix2pix 生成器（U-Net），不依赖任何外部机器学习框架。
works.exercise_en: Run a small image-to-image model with Unity Sentis on the phone camera feed and show the result on a floating AR panel. Twist: let students draw strokes in AR space and translate the drawing live.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Unity Sentis 在手机相机画面上运行一个小型图像到图像模型，把结果显示在一块悬浮的 AR 面板上；变体：让学生在 AR 空间里画线，并实时翻译他们的画。

video.video_title: Pix2Pix Unity

works.title: Please Feed the Lions
works.description: A fifth, fluorescent-red lion joins the four bronze lions in London's Trafalgar Square; the public types a word into it and the lion roars out a line of poetry that is also projected into its open mouth.
works.description_zh: 伦敦特拉法加广场的四只青铜狮子旁多了第五只荧光红狮子；公众向它输入一个词，它就吼出一句诗，诗句同时投影在它张开的嘴里。
works.idea_en: Giving a monument a voice that answers the public turns a statue into a conversation; AR layers on landmarks work best when they respond to what people bring.
works.idea_zh: 给纪念碑一个能回应公众的声音，雕像就变成了对话：地标上的 AR 层，最好能回应人们带来的东西。
works.technique: A text-generation model trained on 19th-century poetry, likely a Google-built system, takes each submitted word and composes a couplet that is spoken and projection-mapped onto the lion.
works.technique_zh: 一个用十九世纪诗歌训练的文本生成模型（推测由 Google 团队搭建）根据每个投稿词写出两行诗，再朗读出来并投影到狮子身上。
works.exercise_en: Anchor an AR creature to a real statue or landmark with image or location tracking; users type one word and the creature speaks a short generated poem with speech synthesis. Twist: every poem stays attached to the statue, so later visitors hear a chorus of all previous words.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像或定位追踪把一只 AR 生物锚定在真实雕像或地标上；用户输入一个词，它用语音合成念出一首生成的短诗。变体：每首诗都留在雕像上，后来的观众会听到之前所有词汇组成的合唱。

video.video_title: ES DEVLIN: Please Feed the Lions 🦁| Google Arts & Culture

salient.why_en: Feed a word to a lion in Trafalgar Square and it roars back a line of poetry.
salient.why_zh: 给 Trafalgar Square 的狮子喂一个词，它就吼出一句诗。

works.title: Pleins feux sur la Tour Eiffel
works.description: On Bastille Day, fireworks launched from the Eiffel Tower itself wrap the structure in light, cascades and colour, making the tower appear to burn and sparkle from within.
works.description_zh: 法国国庆日当晚，从埃菲尔铁塔本身发射的烟火把整座塔包裹在光芒、瀑布和色彩中，铁塔看起来像是从内部燃烧、闪烁。
works.idea_en: Firing from the landmark instead of behind it makes the building a performer; AR effects gain force when they emit from the architecture's own structure.
works.idea_zh: 从地标本身而不是它背后发射烟火，让建筑成了表演者；当 AR 效果从建筑自身的结构中发出时，会更有力量。
works.technique: Groupe F places pyrotechnic devices along the tower's girders and levels and fires them from a computer-controlled score synchronised with music.
