works.idea_en: A set of small open-source experiments released with ARCore that show how many creative directions AR can take.
works.technique_zh: 每个小实验只突出 ARCore 的一项能力，如平面检测、命中测试、光照估计或锚点，展示单一技术就足以撑起一个小玩具。
works.exercise_en: Have each group pick one basic AR capability (plane detection, light estimation, anchors, etc.) and build, within one hour, a small toy that relies on that capability alone. Twist: swap capabilities between groups and build another one.

works.title: AR Swimming Pool
works.description: A tiny pool with a rubber duck and fish lives inside a marker on the desk, seen through a cut-out in the table.
works.idea_zh: 桌面上嵌进去一个有小黄鸭和鱼的迷你泳池。

video.video_title: AR Swimming Pool

works.technique: A pool geometry sunk below the marker plane is framed by a depth-only occluder around the opening, creating the illusion of a cavity cut into the table.
works.exercise_zh: 在标记下方做一个小水池模型，用遮挡面让它看起来像桌子里挖出的洞，里面放会游动的鱼；变体：把水池换成一个地下蚁穴。
works.description_zh: 桌上的一个标记里藏着一座迷你泳池，里面有小黄鸭和鱼，看上去就像透过桌面上挖开的洞口往下看。
works.idea_en: A mini swimming pool with a rubber duck and fish sunk into the tabletop.
works.technique_zh: 泳池几何体沉在标记平面以下，开口四周用只写深度的遮挡体框住，营造出桌面被挖出一个空洞的错觉。
works.exercise_en: Build a small pool model below a marker, use occluder faces to make it look like a hole dug into the table, and fill it with swimming fish. Twist: replace the pool with an underground ant nest.

works.title: AR Wormhole
works.description: A thought experiment about stepping into the past: a live 360 camera streams to the phone with a 10-second delay, and walking through a portal lets you look around the moment that just happened.
works.idea_zh: 穿过一个虫洞，回到10秒前的现实并环顾四周。

video.video_title: AR Experiments: AR Wormhole

works.technique: A fixed 360 camera streams equirectangular video with a 10-second buffer, and an AR portal renders that delayed sphere so that looking through it shows the same place in the past from the phone's orientation.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Unity AR Foundation 做一扇传送门，门里贴一段在同一位置提前拍好的 360 视频，走进去看到“过去的这里”；变体：门里的时间差可以调，比如“一年前的这里”，讲这个地方的变化。
works.description_zh: 一个关于走进过去的思想实验：一台 360 相机把实时画面以 10 秒延迟传到手机上，穿过传送门后，你就能环顾刚刚发生过的那一刻。
works.idea_en: Step through a wormhole and look around the world as it was ten seconds ago.
works.technique_zh: 固定位置的 360 相机传输等距柱状投影视频，并缓存 10 秒；AR 传送门渲染这段延迟的球面画面，透过门看出去，就是按手机朝向呈现的同一地点的过去。
works.exercise_en: Build a portal in Unity AR Foundation and map onto it a 360 video shot earlier at the same spot, so walking in shows you "this place in the past." Twist: make the time gap adjustable, such as "this place one year ago," to tell how the place has changed.

salient.why_en: Step through a portal and look around the same place as it was ten seconds ago.
salient.why_zh: 穿过一道传送门，看到的是十秒钟前的同一个地方。

works.title: AR Yōkai
works.description: Visitors wearing HoloLens walk through Shunkoin, an old Kyoto temple, and meet nine yōkai spirits from classical Japanese paintings, placed into the scanned rooms as part of a shared ghost story.
works.description_zh: 访客戴着 HoloLens 走进京都古寺春光院，遇见来自日本古画的九种妖怪；它们被安置在扫描过的房间里，构成一段共享的怪谈故事。
works.idea_en: Let historical paintings haunt the very building they belong to.
works.idea_zh: 让古画里的妖怪回到它们所属的建筑中“作祟”。
works.technique: 3D scans the temple interior to situate animated yōkai models with occlusion and shared placement across multiple HoloLens users.
works.technique_zh: 对寺庙内部进行三维扫描，使多台 HoloLens 用户看到的动画妖怪模型具备遮挡效果并处在共享位置上。
works.exercise_en: Pick a local legend, model or collect one creature, and hide it with phone AR in the part of school where the story would happen; guide a small group through it. Twist: make the creature appear only when the lights are dimmed.
works.exercise_zh: 挑一个本地传说，制作或收集一个相关生物模型，用手机 AR 把它藏在学校中最适合故事发生的地方，并带一小组人走一遍；变体：只有灯光调暗时生物才会出现。

video.video_title: AR Yōkai: A Situated Augmented Reality Ghost Story

works.title: AR-Code: QR Code to AR in Under 5 Seconds
works.description: Scanning a QR code opens a web page that immediately shows AR content on the same marker, measuring cold-start time to AR.
works.idea_zh: 扫一个二维码，5 秒内进入网页 AR。

video.video_title: AR-Code : qrcode to augmented reality in less than 5sec!

works.technique: A QR code encodes the URL of a web AR page and doubles as the tracking marker (or sits beside one), so scanning it launches AR content aligned to the same printed code.
works.exercise_zh: 生成一个包含 AR 网页地址的二维码并在旁边印上 AR.js 标记，扫码后内容直接出现在标记上；变体：把它做成课程作业的“会说话的名片”。
works.description_zh: 扫描二维码即可打开网页，并立刻在同一个标记上显示 AR 内容；作品测量的是从冷启动到进入 AR 所需的时间。
works.idea_en: Scan a QR code and land in web AR in under five seconds.
works.technique_zh: 二维码中编码了网页 AR 的地址，同时兼作追踪标记（或放在标记旁边），扫码后启动的 AR 内容会与同一张印刷码对齐。
works.exercise_en: Generate a QR code that holds the address of an AR web page and print an AR.js marker next to it, so scanning it makes the content appear right on the marker. Twist: turn it into a "talking business card" for a course assignment.

works.title: AR.js on Tango with WebAR Playground
works.description: Markerless web AR on a Google Tango phone, placing A-Frame objects directly on real surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 在 Tango 手机上跑无需标记的网页 AR。

video.video_title: AR.js on Tango with WebAR Playground

works.technique: Tango's depth camera and motion tracking provide 6DoF pose and surface hits in the browser, letting A-Frame entities be placed on real surfaces without markers.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR Hit Test API（Chrome Android）在地面放一个 A-Frame 物体，对比 AR.js 标记方式的差别；变体：每点一次地面就种下一棵会长大的树。
works.description_zh: 在 Google Tango 手机上运行的无标记网页 AR，可以把 A-Frame 物体直接放到真实表面上。
works.idea_en: Markerless web AR running on a Tango phone.
works.technique_zh: Tango 的深度相机和运动追踪在浏览器中提供 6DoF 位姿和表面命中点，使 A-Frame 实体无需标记即可放置在真实表面上。
works.exercise_en: Use the WebXR Hit Test API (Chrome on Android) to place an A-Frame object on the floor, and compare it with the AR.js marker approach. Twist: every tap on the floor plants a tree that grows.

works.title: AR.js – Efficient Augmented Reality for the Web
works.description: Launch demo of AR.js: pure-JavaScript marker AR running at 60fps on an old phone, with no app install.
works.idea_zh: 纯网页、无需安装、老手机也能 60 帧运行的 AR。

video.video_title: AR.js - Efficient Augmented Reality for the Web

works.technique: An Emscripten-compiled ARToolKit runs marker pose estimation in the browser and feeds the pose to a three.js camera, giving marker AR with no app install.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR.js + A-Frame 写不超过 10 行 HTML 的标记 AR 网页，部署到 GitHub Pages 用手机打开；变体：设计自己的图案标记替换默认 Hiro。
works.description_zh: AR.js 的发布演示：纯 JavaScript 实现的标记 AR，在旧手机上也能跑到 60fps，而且无需安装任何应用。
works.idea_en: Pure web AR with no install that runs at 60 fps even on an old phone.
works.technique_zh: 用 Emscripten 编译的 ARToolKit 在浏览器中完成标记位姿估计，并把位姿传给 three.js 相机，实现无需安装应用的标记 AR。
works.exercise_en: Write a marker AR web page in no more than 10 lines of HTML using AR.js and A-Frame, deploy it to GitHub Pages, and open it on a phone. Twist: design your own pattern marker to replace the default Hiro.

works.title: ARCore Drawing (ofxARCore)
works.description: A simple demo for drawing 3D lines in space on an Android phone, made to show how openFrameworks and ARCore combine; the code became the ofxARCore addon.
works.idea_zh: 用openFrameworks和ARCore在空中画三维线条的开源示例。

video.video_title: AR Experiments: ARCore Drawing

works.technique: Camera pose from ARCore is exposed to openFrameworks, and positions sampled while touching are connected into 3D polylines rendered in world space.
works.exercise_zh: 不用 Unity，改用 three.js + WebXR 实现一个空中画线工具，比较两种工具链的开发体验；变体：线条颜色随画线速度变化。
works.description_zh: 一个在 Android 手机上于空间中绘制 3D 线条的简单演示，用来说明 openFrameworks 如何与 ARCore 结合；这段代码后来发展成了 ofxARCore 插件。
works.idea_en: An open-source example of drawing 3D lines in the air with openFrameworks and ARCore.
works.technique_zh: ARCore 的相机位姿被开放给 openFrameworks，触摸屏幕期间采样到的位置被连成 3D 折线，并在世界空间中渲染。
works.exercise_en: Skip Unity and build an air-drawing tool with three.js and WebXR instead, then compare the development experience of the two toolchains. Twist: make the line color change with drawing speed.

works.title: ARKit + CoreLocation
works.description: Floating labels pinned to real-world landmarks by GPS stay locked in place as he walks through London, combining ARKit tracking with CoreLocation.
works.idea_zh: 把 GPS 地标标签稳稳钉在真实街景上。

video.video_title: ARKit + CoreLocation https://t.co/nTdKyGrBmv

works.technique: GPS coordinates of landmarks are converted to bearings and distances from the device's location and heading, then placed as labels in ARKit's gravity-and-heading aligned world frame.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR + GPS 在校园几栋楼的经纬度上放悬浮文字标签，走动时标签固定在建筑方向；变体：标签显示这栋楼里你的一段个人记忆。
works.description_zh: 他在伦敦街头行走时，按 GPS 钉在真实地标上的悬浮标签始终稳稳停在原处；这个演示把 ARKit 追踪与 CoreLocation 结合在一起。
works.idea_en: GPS landmark labels pinned firmly onto the real street view.
works.technique_zh: 根据设备的位置和朝向，把地标的 GPS 坐标换算成方位角和距离，再以标签形式放入 ARKit 按重力和方向对齐的世界坐标系中。
works.exercise_en: Use AR plus GPS to place floating text labels at the coordinates of several campus buildings, so the labels stay fixed toward each building as you walk. Twist: have each label show a personal memory of yours from inside that building.

works.title: ARKit + CoreLocation Part 2: AR Turn-by-Turn Navigation
works.description: AR arrows and route lines are drawn on the actual street, leading the walker turn by turn to the destination.
works.idea_zh: 第一次把导航箭头直接画在真实街道上。

video.video_title: ARKit + CoreLocation, part 2 https://t.co/AyQiFyzlj3

works.technique: Route waypoints from a directions API are converted from GPS to local AR coordinates and drawn as arrows and lines on the ground plane, re-aligned as location updates arrive.
works.exercise_zh: 从地图 API 获取一条步行路线的几个点，用 AR 在地面上画出箭头引导到下一个路口；变体：路线不是最短路，而是经过校园里最安静的地方。
works.description_zh: AR 箭头和路线直接画在真实街道上，一步一步引导行人抵达目的地。
works.idea_en: Navigation arrows drawn straight onto the real street for the first time.
works.technique_zh: 把路线规划 API 返回的途经点从 GPS 坐标转换为本地 AR 坐标，在地面平面上绘制成箭头和线条，并在收到新的定位数据时重新对齐。
works.exercise_en: Get a few points of a walking route from a map API and use AR to draw arrows on the ground that lead to the next intersection. Twist: make the route pass through the quietest places on campus instead of taking the shortest path.

works.title: ARKit + Unity + Motion Capture: robot dancing
works.description: A robot character performs motion-captured dance moves in his living room, showing how real mocap data makes an AR character feel alive.
works.idea_zh: 用动捕数据让机器人在客厅里跳舞。

video.video_title: ARkit + Unity + Motion Capture Data

works.technique: A humanoid rig driven by recorded motion-capture clips is placed on an ARKit floor plane so the dance happens at human scale.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Mixamo 下载一段舞蹈动作绑到角色上，放进 AR 教室里；加一个变化：用手机麦克风的节拍控制播放速度。
works.description_zh: 一个机器人角色在他的客厅里跳着动作捕捉来的舞蹈，说明真实的动捕数据能让 AR 角色显得生动鲜活。
works.idea_en: Motion-capture data makes a robot dance in your living room.
works.technique_zh: 由录制的动作捕捉片段驱动的人形骨骼被放在 ARKit 检测到的地面平面上，让舞蹈以真人比例呈现。
works.exercise_en: Download a dance clip from Mixamo, bind it to a character, and place the character in your classroom in AR. Twist: use the beat picked up by the phone microphone to control playback speed.

works.title: ARKit 3D Point Cloud House Walk-through
works.description: Logs every raw ARKit feature point while walking through a house, revealing the building as a sparse point cloud with the camera path drawn in green.
works.idea_zh: 把 ARKit 看到的特征点全部记录下来，走一圈房子就长出点云。

video.video_title: ARKit 3d point cloud - House walk through

works.technique: Every frame's ARKit raw feature points and camera pose are accumulated into a persistent point buffer, then rendered as a point cloud with the camera trajectory as a line.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 的 ARPointCloudManager 累积所有特征点并记录相机路径，走完一圈后把点云缩小放到桌上查看；变体：按采集时间给点着色，看出行走顺序。
works.description_zh: 在房子里走一圈，记录下 ARKit 的每一个原始特征点，建筑便以稀疏点云的形式显现出来，相机路径用绿线标出。
works.idea_en: Record every feature point ARKit sees, and a walk around the house grows into a point cloud.
works.technique_zh: 把每一帧 ARKit 的原始特征点和相机位姿累积到一个持久的点缓冲区中，再渲染成点云，并把相机轨迹画成一条线。
works.exercise_en: Accumulate all feature points with AR Foundation's ARPointCloudManager while recording the camera path, then shrink the point cloud onto a table to inspect it after one lap. Twist: color the points by capture time to reveal the walking order.

works.title: ARKit Light Estimation Demo
works.description: A virtual cube brightens and dims as he switches real room lights on and off, showing ARKit light estimation.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟物体的明暗随房间真实灯光变化。

video.video_title: ARKit by Example - Light Estimation demo

works.technique: ARKit light estimation returns ambient intensity and color temperature each frame, which are applied to the scene's lights so virtual objects match the room lighting.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中开启光照估计，把估计值赋给场景灯光，开关房间灯观察虚拟物体明暗变化；变体：房间越暗，虚拟物体自己越亮，像夜灯。
works.description_zh: 他开关房间里的真实灯光时，虚拟立方体也随之变亮变暗，以此展示 ARKit 的光照估计。
works.idea_en: Virtual objects brighten and dim with the real lights in the room.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 光照估计每帧返回环境光强度和色温，将其应用到场景灯光上，使虚拟物体与房间光照保持一致。
works.exercise_en: Turn on light estimation in AR Foundation, feed the estimated values into the scene lights, and switch the room lights on and off to watch the virtual object change. Twist: the darker the room, the brighter the virtual object glows, like a night light.

works.title: ARKit Pokémon Go with Unity GPS and Mapbox
works.description: A Pokémon Go-style demo that combines ARKit tracking with Mapbox GPS so creatures stand at real-world locations.
works.idea_zh: 把 ARKit 和 GPS 地图结合，做真正落在街道上的宝可梦。

video.video_title: Apple ARkit Pokemon Go with Unity GPS and Mapbox

works.technique: Mapbox converts creature GPS coordinates into positions relative to the device's GPS location and compass heading, which are then placed in the ARKit world frame.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR + GPS 把一个虚拟生物放在校园某个经纬度上，走到附近才能看见并点击捕捉；变体：生物只在特定时间段或天气出现。
works.description_zh: 一个类似 Pokémon Go 的演示，把 ARKit 追踪与 Mapbox 的 GPS 结合起来，让小精灵站在真实世界的具体位置上。
works.idea_en: ARKit plus GPS maps put Pokémon that actually stand on the street.
works.technique_zh: Mapbox 把小精灵的 GPS 坐标换算为相对于设备 GPS 位置和罗盘朝向的位置，再放入 ARKit 的世界坐标系中。
works.exercise_en: Use AR plus GPS to place a virtual creature at a set coordinate on campus that can only be seen and tapped to catch when you walk nearby. Twist: the creature appears only at certain times of day or in certain weather.

works.title: ARKit Real-World Geometry Occlusion
works.description: Depth masks mapped onto real walls at runtime let physical architecture hide virtual objects behind it.
works.idea_zh: 给真实墙面贴上深度遮罩，让虚拟物体躲到墙后面。

video.video_title: ARKit - Mixed Reality - Real world geometry occlusion - Unity 3D

works.technique: Invisible occluder meshes that write only to the depth buffer are placed on detected wall planes at runtime, so real architecture hides virtual objects behind it.
works.exercise_zh: 在竖直平面上放只写深度不写颜色的遮挡材质，让一个虚拟角色走到墙后消失；变体：墙上开一个小窗，只能透过窗看到角色。
works.description_zh: 运行时把深度遮罩贴合到真实墙面上，让真实建筑能够挡住位于其后的虚拟物体。
works.idea_en: Depth masks on real walls let virtual objects hide behind them.
works.technique_zh: 运行时在检测到的墙面平面上放置只写入深度缓冲的隐形遮挡网格，让真实建筑遮住其后的虚拟物体。
works.exercise_en: Place a depth-only occlusion material on a vertical plane so a virtual character disappears when it walks behind the wall. Twist: cut a small window in the wall so the character can only be seen through it.

works.title: ARKit Virtual Van Gogh Bedroom Tour
works.description: A life-size 3D model of Van Gogh's painting 'Bedroom in Arles' is placed in his kitchen to walk around in.
works.idea_zh: 把梵高《阿尔的卧室》按真实尺寸搬进自家厨房里走进去看。

video.video_title: ARKit - Virtual Van Gogh Bedroom tour

works.technique: A 1:1 3D reconstruction of the painted room is placed on the detected floor plane, so the viewer walks through it using world tracking.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Blender 按一幅画搭一个简单 3D 房间，在 AR 中以真实尺寸放在教室里走进去；变体：选一幅不可能存在的超现实画作。
works.description_zh: 把梵高画作《阿尔的卧室》做成真实尺寸的 3D 模型，放进他的厨房里，可以在其中四处走动。
works.idea_en: Van Gogh's Bedroom in Arles moved into your kitchen at full size so you can walk inside.
works.technique_zh: 把画中房间按 1:1 重建的 3D 模型放在检测到的地面平面上，观众借助世界追踪在其中穿行。
works.exercise_en: Build a simple 3D room in Blender based on a painting and place it at real scale in the classroom in AR so people can walk in. Twist: pick a surreal painting of a place that could never exist.

works.title: ARKit re-code of Jeffrey Shaw's Golden Calf
works.description: A speed-project with Claire Hentschker that re-creates Shaw's 1994 Golden Calf for ARKit: a phone reveals a virtual golden calf standing on an empty plinth.
works.idea_zh: 用手机AR重做1994年经典作品：空底座上的金牛只在手机里可见。

video.video_title: ARKit Re-code (2017) of Jeffrey Shaw's Golden Calf (1994)

works.technique: ARKit horizontal plane detection (or an image marker on the plinth) anchors a reflective 3D model, and the environment probe reflects the real room on its gold surface.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Unity AR Foundation 把一件经典新媒体作品“重写”成手机 AR：在空台子上放一个带环境反射的金属模型；变体：换成你身边一件被忽视的物品，让它在空底座上被“供起来”。
works.description_zh: 与 Claire Hentschker 合作的一个快速项目，用 ARKit 重现 Shaw 1994 年的作品《Golden Calf》：透过手机可以看到一头虚拟金牛站在空空的底座上。
works.idea_en: A 1994 classic remade in phone AR: a golden calf on an empty plinth, visible only through the phone.
works.technique_zh: 利用 ARKit 水平平面检测（或底座上的图像标记）锚定一个具有反射效果的 3D 模型，并用环境探针把真实房间映在其金色表面上。
works.exercise_en: Use Unity AR Foundation to "rewrite" a classic new-media artwork as phone AR by placing a metallic model with environment reflections on an empty stand. Twist: swap in an overlooked object from around you and "enshrine" it on the empty plinth.

salient.why_en: An empty plinth holds a golden calf that exists only through the phone.
salient.why_zh: 空的底座上立着一头只有通过手机才能看到的金牛。

works.title: ARQUA!
works.description: An ARKit launch app for building a rainbow fantasy aquarium in your room—placing kelp, fish schools and crystal rods by moving your body as the controller (with Viacom NEXT).
works.idea_zh: 在房间里用身体当控制器，搭建一座彩虹梦幻水族馆。

video.video_title: ARQUA! IS! !!COMING!!

works.technique: Objects are spawned at or along the phone's camera pose as the user moves, so body movement becomes the placement controller, with flocking behaviors for fish schools.
works.exercise_zh: 在房间里按住屏幕走动时，沿路径放下水草和鱼群，鱼群用简单 Boids 算法游动；变体：鱼群会被手机靠近吓散。
works.description_zh: 一款随 ARKit 发布推出的应用（与 Viacom NEXT 合作），让你把身体当作控制器，在房间里搭建一座彩虹般梦幻的水族馆，放置海藻、鱼群和水晶棒。
works.idea_en: Use your body as the controller to build a rainbow fantasy aquarium in your room.
works.technique_zh: 物体随着用户移动在手机相机位姿处或沿其路径生成，使身体运动成为放置控制器，鱼群则使用集群行为模拟。
works.exercise_en: Hold the screen and walk around the room to drop kelp and fish schools along your path, and make the fish swim with a simple Boids algorithm. Twist: the school scatters when the phone gets close.

works.title: ARSpray – AR Spray Paint
works.description: Spray-paint graffiti onto real walls and floors with the phone as a virtual spray can.
works.idea_zh: 手机变喷漆罐，在真实墙面上涂鸦。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Spray Paint app - powered by ARKit

works.technique: Raycasts from the phone onto detected wall and floor planes stamp paint decals (or write into a surface texture) at the hit points, with spread and opacity based on distance.
works.exercise_zh: 用竖直平面检测识别墙面，按住屏幕时在射线命中点连续贴圆形贴花形成喷漆效果；变体：离墙越远喷得越散越淡。
works.description_zh: 把手机当作虚拟喷漆罐，在真实的墙面和地面上喷涂涂鸦。
works.idea_en: Your phone becomes a spray can for graffiti on real walls.
works.technique_zh: 从手机发出射线打到检测到的墙面和地面平面上，在命中点印上油漆贴花（或写入表面纹理），并根据距离调整扩散范围和不透明度。
works.exercise_en: Detect walls with vertical plane detection and, while the screen is held, keep stamping round decals at the ray hit point to create a spray-paint effect. Twist: the farther you are from the wall, the wider and fainter the spray.

works.title: ARise
works.description: A puzzle game where the player never touches the hero: you physically move and tilt your phone around a tabletop world until the paths line up from the right perspective.
works.idea_zh: 不用触屏，靠绕着桌子移动视角让路径对齐来解谜。

video.video_title: ARise - The Augmented Reality Puzzle Game

works.technique: Perspective-alignment puzzles check the camera's viewing angle relative to the diorama, and when disconnected paths line up in screen space the level treats them as connected.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌上放一组错位的 AR 积木，只有从某个特定角度看时它们才连成一条路；变体：做一个需要两个角度先后对齐的关卡。
works.description_zh: 一款解谜游戏，玩家从不直接操控主角：你要实际移动、倾斜手机，绕着桌面上的世界找角度，直到从正确的视角看过去时道路连成一线。
works.idea_en: Solve puzzles without touching the screen by moving around the table until the paths line up.
works.technique_zh: 视角对齐谜题会检测相机相对于立体场景的观察角度，当断开的道路在屏幕空间中对齐时，关卡便将其视为已连通。
works.exercise_en: Place a set of misaligned AR blocks on a table that form a single path only when seen from one particular angle. Twist: design a level that needs two angles to line up in sequence.

works.title: AURA
works.description: Projection mapping and light transform the interior of Montreal's Notre-Dame Basilica into an immersive audiovisual experience.
works.idea_zh: 把教堂内部变成沉浸式光影空间

video.video_title: AURA | A luminous experience in the heart of Montreal's Notre-Dame Basilica

works.technique: Interior architectural mapping with many projectors and programmable lighting synchronised by a show-control timeline, following the basilica's surveyed geometry.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个你熟悉的室内空间（礼堂、楼梯间）写一段 2 分钟的灯光与投影分镜，用小投影仪在纸模型上预演；变体：只用声音变化来驱动所有光的变化，不做时间线。
works.description_zh: 投影映射与灯光把蒙特利尔圣母大教堂的内部空间转化为一场沉浸式视听体验。
works.idea_en: A church interior turned into an immersive space of light and image.
works.technique_zh: 依据大教堂的测绘几何进行室内建筑投影映射，使用多台投影仪和可编程灯光，并由演出控制时间线统一同步。
works.exercise_en: Write a two-minute light-and-projection storyboard for an interior you know well (an auditorium, a stairwell) and rehearse it with a small projector on a paper model. Twist: drive every lighting change from changes in sound alone, with no timeline.

works.title: AdaptiVisor
works.description: An occlusion-capable see-through HMD selectively dims bright regions of the real world, like a sun visor per pixel, to help the eye adapt to glare.
works.idea_zh: 像素级墨镜：只把刺眼的那部分现实调暗。

video.video_title: AdaptiVisor: Assisting Eye Adaptation via Occlusive Optical See-Through HMDs (AH2017)

works.technique: Uses a camera to find over-bright regions and an LCD panel in the optical path to attenuate exactly those pixels of real-world light.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机摄像头实时检测画面中最亮的区域并在视频透视中把它涂暗，做一个“智能防眩”滤镜；变化：反过来只保留最亮区域、其余全部变暗。
works.description_zh: 一款具备遮挡能力的透视式头戴显示器，能有选择地调暗现实世界中过亮的区域，就像逐像素的遮阳板，帮助眼睛适应强光。
works.idea_en: Pixel-level sunglasses that dim only the glaring parts of reality.
works.technique_zh: 用相机找出过亮区域，再通过光路中的 LCD 面板精确衰减这些像素对应的现实光线。
works.exercise_en: Use the phone camera to detect the brightest regions of the image in real time and darken them in the video pass-through, making a "smart anti-glare" filter. Twist: flip it so only the brightest regions stay and everything else goes dark.

salient.why_en: Sunglasses that darken only the glaring pixels of the world and leave the rest untouched.
salient.why_zh: 一副只遮暗刺眼部分、其余保持原样的像素级墨镜。

works.title: After ALife Ahead
works.description: For Skulptur Projekte Münster, Huyghe cut open the concrete floor of a former ice rink, revealing layers of earth, water, algae, bees and a peacock; cancer cells growing in an incubator controlled the ceiling panels and an AR layer of pyramids.
works.description_zh: 为明斯特雕塑展，Huyghe 切开一座旧溜冰场的混凝土地面，露出土层、水、藻类、蜜蜂和一只孔雀；培养箱中生长的癌细胞控制着天花板面板和一层 AR 金字塔。
works.idea_en: A living process drives both physical architecture and digital overlays, showing how AR can be steered by a real-world signal rather than the user.
works.idea_zh: 一个活的过程同时驱动实体建筑和数字叠加，说明 AR 可以由现实世界的信号而非用户来驱动。
works.technique: Sensors track the growth of HeLa cells in an incubator and use the data to open ceiling panels and spawn augmented reality forms in an app.
works.technique_zh: 传感器追踪培养箱中 HeLa 细胞的生长，并用这些数据打开天花板面板、在应用中生成增强现实形体。
works.exercise_en: Connect a real-world signal (a plant's soil moisture sensor or a webcam of a fish tank) to the spawn rate of AR shapes in a room. Twist: when the signal stops changing, the AR layer slowly dies.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个现实世界信号（植物土壤湿度传感器或鱼缸摄像头）连接到房间中 AR 形体的生成速率；变体：当信号停止变化时，AR 图层慢慢死去。

video.video_title: Pierre Huyghe: After ALife Ahead / Skulptur Projekte Münster 2017

works.title: AirMeasure – AR Tape Measure
works.description: An early AR tape measure: tap two points on real surfaces to measure distance, later extended with floor plans, trajectories and building heights.
works.idea_zh: 用手机点两下就能在真实世界量尺寸的 AR 卷尺。

video.video_title: Air Measure App Demo - Augmented reality tape measure

works.technique: Two raycasts against detected planes or feature points give world-space hit positions, and the Euclidean distance between them is shown as a labeled line.
works.exercise_zh: 用平面射线点两次得到两点，画线并显示距离（厘米）；变体：把距离换算成“多少个香蕉长”或其他趣味单位。
works.description_zh: 一款早期的 AR 卷尺：在真实表面上点两下即可测量距离，后来又扩展出平面图、轨迹和建筑高度测量等功能。
works.idea_en: An AR tape measure that sizes up the real world with two taps.
works.technique_zh: 针对检测到的平面或特征点做两次射线检测，得到两个世界空间命中位置，并把两点间的欧氏距离显示为一条带标注的线。
works.exercise_en: Tap twice with plane raycasts to get two points, draw a line between them, and show the distance in centimeters. Twist: convert the distance into "how many bananas long" or another playful unit.

works.title: Another Time (Margate)
works.description: A single iron figure stands on the tidal rocks in front of Turner Contemporary in Margate, submerged at high tide and fully revealed at low tide.
works.description_zh: 一尊铸铁人像站在马盖特 Turner Contemporary 美术馆前的潮间带礁石上，涨潮时被淹没，退潮时完整显露。
works.idea_en: One figure in the sea becomes a clock for the tide, showing how an AR object can visualise a slow natural rhythm by how much of it is visible.
works.idea_zh: 海中的一个人像成了潮汐的时钟，说明 AR 物体可以通过露出多少来呈现缓慢的自然节律。
works.technique: A solid iron cast is bolted to the rock foreshore at a height chosen so that the tide range crosses the whole body.
works.technique_zh: 实心铸铁人像被固定在前滩礁石上，高度经过选择，使潮差恰好覆盖整个身体。
works.exercise_en: Fetch live tide data from a public API and drive a virtual water plane around an AR figure placed on a beach or a campus lawn. Twist: show where the water will be in six hours as a ghost line on the figure.
works.exercise_zh: 从公开 API 获取实时潮汐数据，驱动放在海滩或校园草坪上的 AR 人像周围的虚拟水面；变体：用一条幽灵线在人像上标出六小时后的水位。

video.video_title: Antony Gormley - 'ANOTHER TIME' | Margate | Turner Contemporary

salient.why_en: A lone iron figure in the sea is swallowed and revealed by the tide every day.
salient.why_zh: 海里一个孤零零的铁人，每天被潮水淹没，又被潮水露出来。

works.title: Apple ARKit Augmented Reality Minecraft
works.description: Place and break Minecraft blocks at life size on real ground, one of the most shared ARKit demos of summer 2017.
works.idea_zh: 把《我的世界》方块以真实尺寸搭在现实地面上。

video.video_title: Apple ArKit Augmented Reality MINECRAFT

works.technique: Raycasts onto detected planes and existing cube faces snap new blocks to a grid, and tapping a block removes it, reproducing Minecraft's voxel build logic in world space.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面平面上建立 10cm 网格，点击放置方块、长按删除方块，新方块可以堆叠在已有方块表面；变体：每种方块对应一个音符，搭出一段音乐。
works.description_zh: 在真实地面上以真实尺寸放置和破坏 Minecraft 方块，这是 2017 年夏天流传最广的 ARKit 演示之一。
works.idea_en: Minecraft blocks built at real size on the real ground.
works.technique_zh: 射线打到检测到的平面和已有方块的表面上，把新方块吸附到网格；点击方块即可移除，在世界空间中重现 Minecraft 的体素搭建逻辑。
works.exercise_en: Set up a 10 cm grid on the floor plane where tapping places a block and long-pressing removes one, and let new blocks stack on the faces of existing ones. Twist: give each block type a musical note so building makes a tune.

works.title: Area Learning with Multi-Markers
works.description: Several markers scattered around a room are learned together so content stays anchored across a larger area, even under hand occlusion.
works.idea_zh: 多个标记联合学习，让网页 AR 覆盖整个房间。

video.video_title: Area Learning with Multi-Markers in AR.js

works.technique: Relative poses between several markers are learned once, so any visible marker can recover the shared coordinate frame, keeping content anchored when others are occluded.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌上贴四张标记，先记录它们的相对位置，再让任意一张可见时都能显示同一个大模型；变体：用手挡住标记，比较单标记和多标记的稳定性。
works.description_zh: 把散布在房间各处的多个标记放在一起学习，使内容能在更大范围内保持锚定，即使部分标记被手挡住也不受影响。
works.idea_en: Several markers learned together let web AR cover a whole room.
works.technique_zh: 先一次性学习多个标记之间的相对位姿，之后任意一个可见的标记都能恢复共享坐标系，其他标记被遮挡时内容依然保持锚定。
works.exercise_en: Stick four markers on a table, record their relative positions first, then show the same large model whenever any one of them is visible. Twist: cover markers with your hand and compare the stability of single-marker and multi-marker tracking.

works.title: Ascension of Cod
works.description: At Salem Maritime National Historic Site, a great school of cod rises into the sky, a monument to the fish that built New England's economy and then collapsed.
works.description_zh: 在塞勒姆海事国家历史遗址，一大群鳕鱼升上天空，纪念曾支撑新英格兰经济、后来崩溃的鱼群。
works.idea_en: An ecological collapse rendered as a heavenly ascension.
works.idea_zh: 把一场生态崩溃表现为一次“升天”。
works.technique: Animated flocking cod models are geolocated above the historic wharf and viewed live on iPads for Boston Cyberarts' The Augmented Landscape.
works.technique_zh: 为 Boston Cyberarts 的 The Augmented Landscape 展而作：群游的鳕鱼动画模型被定位在历史码头上空，用 iPad 实时观看。
works.exercise_en: Make a flocking (boids) AR swarm of a species that has declined locally and let it rise above a campus landmark. Twist: the swarm size matches historical population data.
works.exercise_zh: 用群集（boids）算法做一群在本地减少的物种的 AR 集群，让它们从校园地标上空升起。变体：集群数量对应历史种群数据。

video.video_title: Then Augmented Landscape - Ascension of Cod - Live iPad view

works.title: Audio Walking Tour (AR)
works.description: An AR documentary piece in which border-crossing interview stories are tied to paper documents and body movement, so listeners walk and move through the stories in space.
works.idea_zh: 用AR和身体移动来“走进”移民跨境的口述故事。

video.video_title: Audio Walking Tour

works.technique: Image tracking recognises the printed documents as anchors, and ARKit world tracking positions audio clips relative to them so that the listener's movement between spots selects and pans the stories.
works.exercise_zh: 采访一位同学的迁徙或搬家故事，把录音分段挂在几张纸质证件/车票的图像锚点上（AR Foundation Image Tracking 或 8th Wall），走到哪张纸前就听哪段；变体：让某一段只有在你蹲下或弯腰时才能听见。
works.description_zh: 一件 AR 纪录作品，把跨越边境的访谈故事与纸质证件和身体动作联系起来，听众在空间中行走、移动，从而穿行于这些故事之间。
works.idea_en: Walk into oral histories of border crossing through AR and your own movement.
works.technique_zh: 图像追踪把印刷的证件识别为锚点，ARKit 世界追踪再以它们为参照放置音频片段，使听众在不同位置间的移动决定播放哪段故事以及声像方位。
works.exercise_en: Interview a classmate about a migration or moving story, split the recording into segments, and attach them to image anchors on a few paper documents or tickets (AR Foundation Image Tracking or 8th Wall), so you hear whichever segment belongs to the paper you walk up to. Twist: make one segment audible only when you crouch or bend down.

works.title: Audio in AR space
works.description: Every sound Zach makes is recorded at the phone's position and drawn as a white blob in the air; walking back through the trail replays the sounds, as if scrubbing a record through space.
works.idea_zh: 把声音录在空间里：边走边发声留下声音形状，倒着走回去就能倒放这些声音。

video.video_title: Audio in AR space by Zach Lieberman

works.technique: ARKit world tracking logs the phone's 6-DoF pose each frame alongside microphone buffers, so each audio chunk is stored at a 3D position and replayed when the camera comes back within a distance threshold of that point.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Unity AR Foundation 或 WebXR 边走边录音，每 0.5 秒在手机位置放一个随音量缩放的小球并存下对应音频片段，走近小球就播放它；变体：只保留你沉默时的环境声，做一条“别人声音的路径”。
works.description_zh: Zach 发出的每一个声音都在手机所在的位置被录下，并以白色团块的形式画在空中；沿着这条轨迹走回去，声音会被重新播放，就像在空间里来回搓一张唱片。
works.idea_en: Record sound into space: make noise as you walk to leave sound shapes, then walk back to play them in reverse.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 世界追踪逐帧记录手机的 6-DoF 位姿和麦克风缓冲，把每段音频存储在一个 3D 位置上，当相机回到该点一定距离阈值内时重新播放。
works.exercise_en: Record audio as you walk with Unity AR Foundation or WebXR, placing a small sphere scaled by volume at the phone's position every 0.5 seconds and saving the matching audio clip, then play each clip when you approach its sphere. Twist: keep only the ambient sound from moments when you are silent, making a "path of other people's voices."

salient.why_en: Every sound stays where it was made, so walking back through the trail plays it again.
salient.why_zh: 每个声音都留在它发出的位置，沿原路走回去就能再次听到。

works.title: Augmented Reality's A-ha Moment (Take On Me AR portal)
works.description: A door-sized portal in a real living room opens into the pencil-sketch world of a-ha's 'Take On Me'; stepping inside turns everything, including your own hand, into rotoscoped comic lines while real kids dance outside.
works.idea_zh: 穿过一道门就走进 a-ha《Take On Me》的铅笔漫画世界，连自己的手也变成线稿。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality's A-ha Moment

works.technique: An ARKit-anchored portal uses a stencil/depth mask so the sketch world renders only through the doorway, and a line-art shader restyles the camera feed once you cross it.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Reality Composer/Unity 做一扇传送门，里面是一张手绘线稿全景；加一个变化：进门后给摄像头画面加上描边滤镜，让现实也变成漫画。
works.description_zh: 真实客厅里一扇与门同大的传送门，通往 a-ha《Take On Me》的铅笔素描世界；走进去之后，一切连同你自己的手都变成转描动画式的漫画线条，而门外真实的孩子们仍在跳舞。
works.idea_en: Step through a door into the pencil-sketch world of a-ha's Take On Me, where even your own hand turns into line art.
works.technique_zh: 锚定在 ARKit 中的传送门使用模板/深度遮罩，让素描世界只在门框内渲染；穿过门后，线稿着色器会对相机画面重新风格化。
works.exercise_en: Build a portal in Reality Composer or Unity that contains a hand-drawn line-art panorama. Twist: once you step through, add an outline filter to the camera feed so reality turns into a comic too.

salient.why_en: Step through a door into a pencil-sketch world where even your own hand turns into line art.
salient.why_zh: 穿过一扇门进入铅笔素描世界，连自己的手也变成线条。

works.title: Augmenting Any Webpage with AR.js
works.description: A snippet that adds AR to an ordinary web page, so visitors see 3D content popping out of the page itself.
works.idea_zh: 给任意网页加一段代码，内容就从网页里跳出来。

video.video_title: Augmenting Webpage with AR.js - Bringing AR to any webpage

works.technique: A JavaScript snippet overlays a transparent WebGL canvas on the page and ties 3D content to DOM elements (or a marker), so models appear to pop out of ordinary HTML.
works.exercise_zh: 给自己的作品集网页加一个 three.js 透明画布，让某张图片滚动到视口时有 3D 物体从中弹出；变体：用 WebXR 让同一页面在手机上可以把物体放到桌面。
works.description_zh: 一小段代码就能给普通网页加上 AR，访问者会看到 3D 内容从页面本身跳出来。
works.idea_en: Add one snippet to any web page and its content jumps out of the page.
works.technique_zh: 一段 JavaScript 代码在页面上叠加透明的 WebGL 画布，并把 3D 内容绑定到 DOM 元素（或标记）上，让模型看起来从普通 HTML 中弹出来。
works.exercise_en: Add a transparent three.js canvas to your portfolio page so a 3D object pops out of a certain image when it scrolls into view. Twist: use WebXR so the same page lets phone users place the object on their desk.

works.title: Avocado Toast with ARKit
works.description: A small computer-vision and ARKit test that detects a real avocado and replaces it with avocado toast.
works.idea_zh: 识别真实牛油果，并把它变成牛油果吐司。

video.video_title: avocado toast with arkit

works.technique: An object detector (likely CoreML/Vision) finds the avocado in the 2D frame, and a raycast from its bounding-box center to the table plane places a 3D toast model at that spot.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Object Detection 或 Lens Studio 物体识别找到桌上的一个水果，在它的位置放一个替换模型；变体：让替换物是这个水果的“未来形态”（如烂掉或变成果汁）。
works.description_zh: 一个结合计算机视觉与 ARKit 的小测试：识别出真实的牛油果，并把它替换成牛油果吐司。
works.idea_en: Recognize a real avocado and turn it into avocado toast.
works.technique_zh: 物体检测器（大概率是 CoreML/Vision）在 2D 画面中找到牛油果，再从其包围框中心向桌面平面发射射线，在该处放置一个 3D 吐司模型。
works.exercise_en: Find a piece of fruit on the table with MediaPipe Object Detection or Lens Studio object recognition, and place a replacement model at its position. Twist: make the replacement the fruit's "future form," such as rotten or turned into juice.

works.title: BMW Art Car #18
works.description: A plain carbon-black BMW M6 GT3 that looks almost unpainted; seen through a phone app, trails of coloured light flow over the car's body, and a VR film extends the story of its future driver.
works.description_zh: 一辆看起来几乎没上色的碳黑色 BMW M6 GT3 赛车；透过手机 App 观看时，彩色光轨在车身上流动，另有一段 VR 影片延伸讲述它未来驾驶者的故事。
works.idea_en: The real artwork on the car is invisible until you look through a phone.
works.idea_zh: 车上真正的艺术品是隐形的，只有透过手机才能看到。
works.technique: A marker-less object-recognition AR app recognises the car and overlays animated light trails aligned to its body, while the physical car stays uncoloured.
works.technique_zh: 用无标记的物体识别 AR 应用识别整辆车，把动画光轨对齐叠加在车身上，而实体车本身保持无彩色。
works.exercise_en: Pick a plain object (a white box, a bike) and build an image- or object-tracking AR scene that paints animated light lines only visible through the phone. Twist: the lines move faster the faster the phone moves around the object.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个朴素物体（白色盒子、自行车），用图像或物体追踪做一个 AR 场景，让只有透过手机才看得到的动态光线“涂”在它上面；变体：手机绕物体移动得越快，光线流动得越快。

video.video_title: BMW Art Car #18 by Cao Fei

works.title: Beta (live coding at Channel 16)
works.description: Abstract shader patterns are live-coded in KodeLife and projected onto objects inside a Unity 3D scene, mixing improvisation with prepared assets.
works.description_zh: 在 KodeLife 里现场编写的抽象着色器图案被投射到 Unity 3D 场景中的物体上，把即兴与预先准备的素材混合在一起。
works.idea_en: Live-code the texture of a 3D world while the music plays.
works.idea_zh: 在音乐进行时，现场编写一个 3D 世界的纹理。
works.technique: KodeLife renders audio-reactive GLSL fragment shaders, the frames are shared with Unity through Spout, and Unity projects them onto meshes and overlays while a nanoKONTROL2 controls extra effects.
works.technique_zh: KodeLife 渲染对音频做出反应的 GLSL 片元着色器，画面通过 Spout 共享给 Unity，Unity 把它们投射到网格和叠加层上，再用 nanoKONTROL2 控制其他效果。
works.exercise_en: Live-code a fragment shader in a browser editor and use it as the texture of a virtual sculpture in a WebXR scene. Twist: each student gets 60 seconds to edit the code before passing it on.
works.exercise_zh: 在浏览器编辑器里现场编写片元着色器，把它作为 WebXR 场景中一座虚拟雕塑的纹理；变体：每位学生只有 60 秒改代码，然后传给下一个人。

video.video_title: Live coding experiment (KodeLife & Unity)

works.title: Binary Garden
works.description: Nine large touch screens grow sound-reactive 3D noise gardens, and visitors can also join from their own phones without installing an app to plant and remix patterns.
works.description_zh: 九块大型触摸屏上生长着随声音起伏的 3D 噪声花园，观众还能直接用自己的手机（无需安装应用）接入，播种并重新组合图案。
works.idea_en: Your phone becomes a seed pouch for a public, ever-growing garden.
works.idea_zh: 手机变成种子袋，往一座公共的、不断生长的花园里播种。
works.technique: A browser-based web app on visitors' phones sends input over WebSockets to real-time noise-driven WebGL scenes that also react to live audio (likely).
works.technique_zh: 观众手机上的网页应用通过 WebSocket 把输入发送到实时的噪声驱动 WebGL 场景，场景同时随现场声音变化（推测）。
works.exercise_en: Make a shared screen garden where each phone that opens a URL can plant one procedurally generated flower whose shape comes from the user's name. Twist: flowers wilt when the room goes quiet and bloom with applause.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个共享屏幕花园，每部打开网址的手机都能种下一朵程序化生成的花，花的形状由使用者的名字决定；变体：房间安静时花会枯萎，掌声响起时花会盛开。

video.video_title: Binary Garden

works.title: Bot Party
works.description: Made with Freida Abtan, a party game where players must hold hands and touch skin to skin to pass secret messages between their little bots, turning technology into a reason for physical contact.
works.description_zh: 与 Freida Abtan 合作的派对游戏：玩家必须牵手、皮肤相触，才能在各自的小机器人之间传递秘密信息，让技术成为身体接触的理由。
works.idea_en: Human touch is the network cable.
works.idea_zh: 人与人的触碰就是网线。
works.technique: Handheld bots send and receive signals through the players' bodies, likely by passing a low-level electrical or audio signal skin to skin, so a message only flows while people are touching.
works.technique_zh: 手持小机器人通过玩家的身体收发信号，很可能是让微弱的电信号或音频信号经皮肤传导，因此只有人们相互接触时信息才会流动。
works.exercise_en: Prototype a two-player game with touch-sensing (Makey Makey or capacitive pads) where a sound or AR effect plays only while players hold hands. Twist: the message changes each time a third person joins the chain.
works.exercise_zh: 用触摸感应（Makey Makey 或电容触点）做一个双人游戏原型：只有两人牵手时才播放声音或 AR 效果。变体：每有第三个人加入链条，信息就会改变。

video.video_title: Bot Party

salient.why_en: Players can only pass messages between their little bots by touching skin to skin, so the body becomes the network cable.
salient.why_zh: 玩家只有肌肤相触才能让小机器人互传消息，身体成了网线。

works.title: Chalktalk AR + Holojam
works.description: Several co-located people wearing tracked headsets draw Chalktalk objects together and see each other's living sketches in the same space.
works.idea_zh: 多人同处一室，共同在空中画出活的计算图形。

video.video_title: Ken Perlin: Chalktalk AR + Holojam

works.technique: Motion capture tracks all headsets in one room coordinate frame, and a networked server synchronizes Chalktalk sketch state so every co-located user sees the same living drawings in place.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 共享锚点或 WebXR + WebSocket，让两部手机在同一空间里同时画 3D 线条并实时同步；变体：一人的线条只能被另一人“激活”（点击后变成会动的物体）。
works.description_zh: 处在同一空间里的几个人戴着被追踪的头显，一起绘制 Chalktalk 对象，并在同一空间中看到彼此那些会动的草图。
works.idea_en: Several people in one room draw living computational graphics in the air together.
works.technique_zh: 动作捕捉系统在同一房间坐标系中追踪所有头显，联网服务器同步 Chalktalk 草图状态，让同处一室的每位用户都在原位看到相同的动态绘图。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation shared anchors or WebXR with WebSocket so two phones in the same space can draw 3D lines at once and sync them in real time. Twist: one person's lines can only be "activated" by the other person, turning into moving objects when tapped.

works.title: Chalktalk in Augmented Reality
works.description: Perlin draws simple sketches in the air that are recognized and come alive as 3D, simulating objects (a hypercube, a pendulum, a creature) floating in shared AR.
works.idea_zh: 在空中画几笔，草图就被识别成会动、会模拟的3D对象。

video.video_title: Ken Perlin:​ Chalktalk in Augmented Reality​

works.technique: Freehand strokes are matched against a library of glyph templates by shape recognition, and each recognized sketch is replaced by a procedural, animated 3D object rendered in a shared AR space.
works.exercise_zh: 在网页画板中识别 3 种简单手绘符号（圆、三角、波浪，可用 $1 Unistroke Recognizer），把它们替换为会动的 3D 物体放入 WebXR 场景；变体：让两个被识别的物体靠近时产生互动（比如太阳让花开）。
works.description_zh: Perlin 在空中画出简单的草图，它们被识别后化为 3D 形态活了过来，成为漂浮在共享 AR 空间中、可进行模拟的对象（超立方体、单摆、小生物）。
works.idea_en: Draw a few strokes in the air and the sketch is recognized as a living, simulated 3D object.
works.technique_zh: 通过形状识别把徒手笔画与字形模板库进行匹配，每个被识别的草图都会被替换为程序化生成、带动画的 3D 对象，并在共享 AR 空间中渲染。
works.exercise_en: Recognize three simple hand-drawn symbols (circle, triangle, wave) on a web canvas, for example with the $1 Unistroke Recognizer, and replace them with moving 3D objects in a WebXR scene. Twist: make two recognized objects interact when they come close, such as a sun making a flower bloom.

works.title: Changing the Appearance of Real-World Objects by Modifying Their Surroundings
works.description: Projection changes the environment around a real object, exploiting color and brightness perception so the object itself appears to change.
works.idea_zh: 不动物体本身，只改它周围的光，物体看起来就变了颜色。

video.video_title: Changing the Appearance of Real-World Objects by Modifying Their Surroundings

works.technique: Rather than projecting onto the object, the projector alters the color and brightness of the surrounding area, exploiting simultaneous contrast and lightness constancy so the unprojected object is perceived as changing.
works.exercise_zh: 把一张灰色纸片放在桌上，只对它周围投影不同颜色和亮度的背景，让观众判断纸片的颜色是否改变；变体：用这个错觉在一个静止物体上制造“心跳”或“呼吸”的感觉。
works.description_zh: 投影改变的是真实物体周围的环境，利用人对颜色和亮度的感知规律，让物体本身看起来发生了变化。
works.idea_en: Leave the object alone and change only the light around it, and it seems to change color.
works.technique_zh: 投影仪并不投射到物体上，而是改变其周围区域的颜色和亮度，利用同时对比和明度恒常性，使未被投影的物体被感知为发生了变化。
works.exercise_en: Put a gray paper card on a table, project backgrounds of different colors and brightness only around it, and ask viewers whether the card's color has changed. Twist: use the illusion to give a still object the feeling of a heartbeat or breathing.

works.title: Cloner
works.description: Thousands of small copies of a mesh sit on the vertices of a base model and ripple, twist and pulse together as one living form.
works.description_zh: 成千上万个小网格副本排布在一个基础模型的顶点上，一起起伏、扭转、跳动，像一个活的整体。
works.idea_en: Build a complex organic shape out of many clones of one simple part.
works.idea_zh: 用同一个简单零件的大量克隆，拼出复杂的有机形态。
works.technique: A compute shader animates a transform for each vertex of the base model from noise, and GPU procedural instancing draws the template mesh at every vertex with very little CPU cost.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器根据噪声为基础模型的每个顶点计算一个变换，再用 GPU 程序化实例化在每个顶点上绘制模板网格，几乎不占 CPU。
works.exercise_en: Place a sphere in AR and clone a tiny cube onto each of its vertices with VFX Graph or GPU instancing, animating the cubes' scale with noise. Twist: use the AR face mesh as the base so the clones cover a real face.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中放一个球体，用 VFX Graph 或 GPU 实例化在它的每个顶点上克隆一个小立方体，并用噪声控制大小；变体：以 AR 人脸网格为基础，让克隆体铺满一张真实的脸。

video.video_title: Instancing Test

works.title: Close Encounters
works.description: A bandstand in a town square becomes a spaceship: when someone approaches, light and sound establish contact with mysterious beings supposedly abducted from Earth decades ago.
works.description_zh: 小镇广场上的一座音乐亭变成了一艘飞船：当有人走近，灯光和声音就与几十年前据说被从地球带走的神秘生物“建立联系”。
works.idea_en: Walking up to a piece of street furniture opens a conversation with aliens.
works.idea_zh: 走近一件街头设施，就开启一场与外星人的对话。
works.technique: Presence sensors detect approaching visitors and trigger light sequences and sound narratives on the bandstand, by Boris Chimp 504 (Miguel Neto sound, Carvalho lights and interaction).
works.technique_zh: 存在传感器检测走近的访客，在音乐亭上触发灯光序列和声音叙事；作品由 Boris Chimp 504 创作（Miguel Neto 负责声音，Carvalho 负责灯光与交互）。
works.exercise_en: Choose an object on campus (a bench, a bus stop) and write a 30-second story that plays through a hidden speaker and light when a proximity sensor or phone geofence detects someone near. Twist: the story changes depending on how many people approach together.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里选一个物件（长椅、公交站），写一段 30 秒的故事，当接近传感器或手机地理围栏检测到有人靠近时，通过隐藏的扬声器和灯光播放；变体：故事随一起走近的人数而改变。

video.video_title: CLOSE ENCOUNTERS

works.title: CoVAR
works.description: A HoloLens user in a real room and a VR user in its 3D scan collaborate: the VR user can shrink, fly and share gaze and gestures with the AR user.
works.idea_zh: 现实房间里的AR用户和扫描副本里的VR用户同处一室协作。

video.video_title: CoVAR: A Collaborative Virtual and Augmented Reality System for Remote Collaboration

works.technique: The room is pre-scanned into a 3D model that the VR user inhabits, and both users are tracked in the same coordinate system so head pose, gaze rays and hand gestures are exchanged and rendered for each other.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Polycam 扫描一个房间导入 three.js 做成“VR 版”，一位同学在电脑上以第一人称浏览，另一位在现场用手机 AR，双方位置和视线方向通过 WebSocket 互相显示；变体：让 VR 一方可以缩小或放大自己。
works.description_zh: 真实房间中佩戴 HoloLens 的用户与身处该房间 3D 扫描模型中的 VR 用户协作：VR 用户可以缩小自己、飞行，并与 AR 用户共享视线和手势。
works.idea_en: An AR user in the real room and a VR user in its scanned copy work together in the same space.
works.technique_zh: 预先把房间扫描成 3D 模型供 VR 用户进入，两位用户在同一坐标系中被追踪，彼此交换并渲染对方的头部位姿、视线射线和手势。
works.exercise_en: Scan a room with Polycam and import it into three.js as a "VR version," have one classmate browse it in first person on a computer while another uses phone AR on site, and show each person's position and gaze direction to the other over WebSocket. Twist: let the VR user shrink or enlarge themselves.

works.title: Concept: AR cereal box
works.description: A 2017 Unity Labs concept from the 'future of mixed reality' series in which a cereal box becomes an interactive AR object with content attached to the packaging.
works.idea_zh: 把早餐麦片盒变成跳出内容的AR互动界面。

video.video_title: Concept: AR cereal box - 2017

works.technique: The packaging is recognized as a tracked image or object target, and 3D content is parented to the box so interactions such as opening or tilting drive animations.
works.exercise_zh: 用一个真实包装盒做图像目标，在盒子上叠加一个小游戏或角色；变体：倾斜盒子时 AR 中的麦片像液体一样流出来。
works.description_zh: Unity Labs 在 2017 年“混合现实的未来”系列中提出的概念：麦片盒变成可交互的 AR 对象，包装上附着着各种内容。
works.idea_en: A breakfast cereal box becomes an AR interface that pops out content.
works.technique_zh: 包装被识别为追踪的图像或物体目标，3D 内容挂在盒子上作为其子对象，打开或倾斜盒子等交互会驱动动画。
works.exercise_en: Use a real package as an image target and overlay a small game or character on the box. Twist: when you tilt the box, the AR cereal pours out like liquid.

works.title: Concrete Storm
works.description: Commissioned by Microsoft and Artsy, a mixed-reality artwork on HoloLens where virtual concrete pillars appear in a real room and shift as the viewer walks between them.
works.idea_zh: HoloLens里的虚拟混凝土柱林随脚步变化

video.video_title: CONCRETE STORM in collaboration with Artsy and Microsoft Hololens | by DRIFT

works.technique: HoloLens spatial mapping and head tracking place world-locked virtual pillars in the room, which animate and shift as the viewer's position changes.
works.exercise_zh: 用 HoloKit 或手机 AR 在房间里放一片虚拟柱林，让柱子根据观众距离下沉或升起；变体：让柱子的材质从混凝土慢慢变成另一种材料，暗示城市的另一种可能。
works.description_zh: 受 Microsoft 和 Artsy 委托创作的 HoloLens 混合现实作品：虚拟的混凝土柱出现在真实房间里，并随观众在柱间走动而变化位置。
works.idea_en: A forest of virtual concrete pillars in HoloLens that shifts with your steps.
works.technique_zh: HoloLens 空间映射和头部追踪把固定在世界中的虚拟柱子放置在房间里，柱子随观众位置的变化而产生动画和移动。
works.exercise_en: Use HoloKit or phone AR to place a forest of virtual pillars in a room that sink or rise based on the viewer's distance. Twist: let the pillars' material slowly change from concrete to another material, hinting at another possible city.

works.title: Contour Map Shader
works.description: A terrain is drawn as a cartographic map, with evenly spaced contour lines tracing its height.
works.description_zh: 一片地形被画成地图的样子，等间距的等高线勾勒出它的高度。
works.idea_en: Any surface can be read as a map by slicing it at regular heights.
works.idea_zh: 按固定高度切片，任何表面都能读成一张地图。
works.technique: The shader samples a heightmap, takes the fractional part of height divided by the line spacing, and draws a thin line where it crosses zero, using screen-space derivatives to keep line width constant.
works.technique_zh: 着色器采样高度图，用高度除以线距取小数部分，在它归零处画一条细线，并用屏幕空间导数保持线宽一致。
works.exercise_en: Apply the contour shader to the LiDAR scene mesh from AR Foundation meshing, using world height instead of a heightmap, so the whole room is overlaid with topographic lines. Twist: animate the line spacing so a flood level rises through the room.
works.exercise_zh: 把等高线着色器用在 AR Foundation 网格重建得到的 LiDAR 场景网格上，用世界坐标高度代替高度图，让整个房间覆盖上地形等高线。变体：让等高线动起来，像水位一样在房间里慢慢上涨。

video.video_title: Lets Make a Contour Map Shader

works.title: Conway's Game of Life on the GPU
works.description: A huge Game of Life grid evolves in real time, with gliders and patterns rippling across the screen.
works.description_zh: 一个巨大的生命游戏网格实时演化，滑翔机和各种图案在画面上涌动。
works.idea_en: Four rules on a grid produce endless emergent life.
works.idea_zh: 网格上的四条规则就能生出无穷的涌现生命。
works.technique: Each cell's state is updated in parallel in a compute shader from its eight neighbours and rendered as a texture.
works.technique_zh: 在计算着色器中根据八个邻居并行更新每个单元的状态，并渲染成纹理。
works.exercise_en: Map a Game of Life grid onto a real wall in AR and seed live cells where the camera sees dark pixels. Twist: the simulation speed follows the room's noise level.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把生命游戏网格贴到真实墙面上，在相机看到暗像素的地方播种活细胞。变体：模拟速度跟随房间噪音大小。

video.video_title: Conway's Game of Life in Unity Compute shader.

works.title: Conway's Game of Life with Compute Shaders
works.description: Conway's Game of Life runs entirely on the GPU, with cells blinking, gliding and dying across a large texture in real time.
works.description_zh: 康威生命游戏完全在 GPU 上运行，细胞在一张大纹理上实时闪烁、滑行和消亡。
works.idea_en: Four simple rules on a grid generate endless living patterns.
works.idea_zh: 网格上的四条简单规则，就能生成无穷无尽的“生命”图案。
works.technique: A compute shader reads the previous state texture, counts the eight neighbours of every cell and writes the next generation into a second render texture, swapping the two each frame.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器读取上一帧的状态纹理，统计每个细胞的八个邻居，把下一代写进第二张渲染纹理，每帧交换两张纹理。
works.exercise_en: Map the Game of Life texture onto a detected AR floor plane and let the user seed live cells by tapping or walking over the floor. Twist: seed cells from the camera image so real objects become starting patterns.
works.exercise_zh: 把生命游戏纹理贴到 AR 检测出的地面平面上，让用户点击或走过地面来播下活细胞。变体：用相机画面来播种，让真实物体成为初始图案。

video.video_title: Lets Make Conway's Game of Life with Compute Shaders

works.title: CyberSnake – Holographic Snake
works.description: The classic Snake game re-imagined in HoloLens: you are the snake, hunting burgers around your home while avoiding your own growing tail.
works.idea_zh: 你就是贪吃蛇：在家里走动吃汉堡，还要躲开自己的尾巴。

video.video_title: I Recreated Snake With Crazy Holographic Technology

works.technique: The snake head follows the headset's gaze direction at a fixed speed, body segments trail its recorded path, and a spatialized audio source on each target lets players find food outside the field of view.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机或 HoloKit 的朝向控制一条在房间里移动的贪吃蛇，食物只靠 3D 空间音频定位；变体：关掉画面，只用声音玩一局。
works.description_zh: 在 HoloLens 中重新演绎经典贪吃蛇游戏：你就是那条蛇，在家里四处追捕汉堡，同时还要避开自己越来越长的尾巴。
works.idea_en: You are the snake: walk around your home eating burgers while dodging your own tail.
works.technique_zh: 蛇头以固定速度沿头显的注视方向前进，身体各节跟随其记录下的路径；每个目标上都有一个空间化音源，让玩家找到视野之外的食物。
works.exercise_en: Use the orientation of a phone or HoloKit to steer a snake moving around the room, with food located only by 3D spatial audio. Twist: turn off the visuals and play a round with sound alone.

salient.why_en: You are the snake, walking through your home and dodging your own growing tail.
salient.why_zh: 你就是那条蛇，在家里走动并躲开自己越来越长的尾巴。

works.title: DUST
works.description: A four-minute VR dance piece in which the viewer is a particle of stardust drifting through space in the immediate presence of a dancer made of points, whose movement sweeps the viewer along.
works.description_zh: 一部四分钟的 VR 舞蹈作品：观众是一粒星尘，在一个由点构成的舞者身边漂浮，舞者的动作把观众卷着走。
works.idea_en: Experience dance from the point of view of a speck of dust inside it.
works.idea_zh: 从舞蹈内部一粒尘埃的视角去体验舞蹈。
works.technique: Motion-captured dance is rendered as a point cloud in a real-time engine, and the viewer's tracked head and hands interact with the particle field.
works.technique_zh: 动捕舞蹈在实时引擎中以点云渲染，观众被追踪的头部和双手与粒子场交互。
works.exercise_en: Convert a mocap clip into a particle system in Unity, place it in AR at life size, and let the phone act as a 'dust speck' that gets pushed away by the nearest joint. Twist: make the viewer's breath (microphone) scatter the dancer.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity 里把一段动捕转换成粒子系统，以真人大小放进 AR，让手机充当一粒“尘埃”，被最近的关节推开；变体：让观众的呼吸（麦克风）把舞者吹散。

video.video_title: DUST Interaction Preview

works.title: Descension
works.description: In Brooklyn Bridge Park, a circular pit of black-dyed water spins into a continuous whirlpool about eight metres across that seems to drain into the ground.
works.description_zh: 在布鲁克林大桥公园，一个圆形深坑中的黑色染水持续旋转成直径约八米的漩涡，仿佛要流入地下。
works.idea_en: A hole that seems to swallow the ground is the physical version of an AR 'portal into the floor' and shows how motion sells depth.
works.idea_zh: 一个仿佛吞噬地面的洞是 AR“地板传送门”的实体版本，也展示了运动如何让深度显得可信。
works.technique: Pumps spin black-dyed water in a round basin fast enough to form a stable vortex whose centre appears bottomless.
works.technique_zh: 水泵驱动圆形水池中的黑色染水快速旋转，形成稳定的漩涡，中心看起来深不见底。
works.exercise_en: Use an AR depth mask to cut a round hole in a real floor and fill it with a spinning black vortex shader. Twist: objects the user drops near it get pulled in.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR 深度遮罩在真实地面上切出一个圆洞，并用旋转的黑色漩涡着色器填充；变体：用户丢到附近的物体会被吸进去。

video.video_title: PAF40: Anish Kapoor: Descension

salient.why_en: A black whirlpool spins in the ground as if the floor were draining into the earth.
salient.why_zh: 一个黑色漩涡在地面上旋转，好像地板正在往地底下流走。

works.title: Desktopography
works.description: Projected apps on a real desk dodge, resize and move around coffee cups, papers and laptops so digital and physical clutter can coexist.
works.idea_zh: 投影在桌面上的窗口会自动绕开水杯和纸张，与杂物和平共处。

video.video_title: Desktopography: Supporting Responsive Cohabitation Between Virtual Interfaces and Physical Objects

works.technique: A depth camera segments physical objects on the desk and a layout optimizer moves and resizes projected windows to avoid occlusion by them while keeping them near their last positions.
works.exercise_zh: 用俯视摄像头检测桌上的物体轮廓（OpenCV 前景分割），让投影的便签窗口在碰到杯子或书时自动弹开或缩小；变体：让窗口“依附”在某个物体上，物体移走窗口也跟走。
works.description_zh: 投影在真实桌面上的应用会避让、缩放并移动，绕开咖啡杯、纸张和笔记本电脑，让数字杂物与实体杂物得以共存。
works.idea_en: Windows projected on a desk move out of the way of cups and papers and share the space with the clutter.
works.technique_zh: 深度相机分割出桌上的实体物体，布局优化器移动并缩放投影窗口，避免被这些物体遮挡，同时让窗口尽量靠近其上一次的位置。
works.exercise_en: Detect the outlines of objects on a desk with an overhead camera (OpenCV foreground segmentation), and make projected sticky-note windows bounce away or shrink when they hit a cup or book. Twist: let a window "attach" to an object so it follows when the object is moved away.

works.title: Dinosaur Passage: a HoloLens museum experience
works.description: A mixed-reality museum concept in which visitors wearing HoloLens see a life-size T. rex stride through the museum hall among virtual plants.
works.description_zh: 一个混合现实博物馆概念：戴着 HoloLens 的参观者看到一只真实大小的霸王龙在展厅的虚拟植物间走过。
works.idea_en: Bring extinct animals back at life size into the museum hall where their bones are shown.
works.idea_zh: 让灭绝的动物以真实大小回到展示它们骨骼的博物馆大厅。
works.technique: HoloLens spatial mapping anchors an animated dinosaur and vegetation to the hall's floor so they stay put as visitors walk around.
works.technique_zh: 利用 HoloLens 的空间映射，把带动画的恐龙和植物锚定在大厅地面上，参观者走动时它们保持不动。
works.exercise_en: Place a life-size animal model in a school hallway with phone AR and design a 3-stop guided walk around it. Twist: it reacts when a visitor gets too close.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 在学校走廊放一只真实大小的动物模型，并设计一条三站式导览路线。变体：参观者靠得太近时它会做出反应。

video.video_title: Dinosaur Passage: A Hololens Museum Experience

works.title: Down-ball tennis in the living room
works.description: An early ARKit game in which colourful virtual balls bounce across the real living-room floor and the player hits them with a racket held in front of the phone view. Video: NEXTREALITY.
works.description_zh: 早期 ARKit 游戏：五颜六色的虚拟球在真实客厅地板上弹跳，玩家用手机画面前方的球拍把球打回去。（视频来自 NEXTREALITY）
works.idea_en: The phone is both the window and the racket.
works.idea_zh: 手机既是看世界的窗口，也是手里的球拍。
works.technique: ARKit floor-plane detection gives the balls a physical bounce surface, and the racket is likely attached to the phone's tracked pose as a collider.
works.technique_zh: 用 ARKit 地面检测为球提供真实的弹跳面，球拍很可能绑定在手机被追踪到的位姿上充当碰撞体。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR game where the phone itself is the bat and a virtual ball bounces on the real floor. Twist: two phones rally the same ball.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 游戏：手机本身就是球拍，虚拟球在真实地板上弹跳；变体：两部手机对打同一个球。

video.video_title: NEXTREALITY: Play virtual down ball 🎾 in your living room with #augmentedreality by @bjarnel

works.title: Draw and Dance
works.description: You draw a stick figure on your phone and it becomes a dancing AR character that reacts to music and sounds around it, even perching on a Google Home speaker to dance to its output.
works.idea_zh: 画一个火柴人，它就在现实中跟着周围的声音和音乐跳舞。

video.video_title: AR Experiments: Draw and Dance

works.technique: A 2D drawing is rigged into a stick-figure skeleton, anchored with ARCore, and animated by microphone amplitude and voice commands via API.AI.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Scratch/p5.js 或 Lens Studio 让学生画的角色随麦克风音量跳舞并放到 AR 里；加一个变化：两个角色听到不同音高会跳不同舞步。
works.description_zh: 在手机上画一个火柴人，它就会变成一个 AR 舞者，随着周围的音乐和声音起舞，甚至会跳上 Google Home 音箱，跟着它播放的声音跳舞。
works.idea_en: Draw a stick figure and it dances in the real world to the sounds and music around it.
works.technique_zh: 把 2D 绘画绑定到火柴人骨骼上，用 ARCore 锚定，并由麦克风音量以及通过 API.AI 识别的语音指令驱动动画。
works.exercise_en: Use Scratch, p5.js or Lens Studio to make a student-drawn character dance to microphone volume and place it in AR. Twist: two characters dance different steps when they hear different pitches.

works.title: Drawing in 3D with ARKit
works.description: One of the first ARKit demos: a Tilt Brush-style prototype in which moving the phone leaves glowing strokes hanging in the room.
works.idea_zh: 把手机当画笔，在房间空气里画出立体笔触。

video.video_title: Drawing in 3d with ARKit

works.technique: The camera pose from world tracking is sampled each frame at a point slightly in front of the lens, and these points are extruded into a line or tube mesh that stays fixed in world space.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在按住屏幕时把相机前方 20cm 的位置加入 LineRenderer，画出悬浮在空中的光线；变体：让线条颜色随移动速度或声音音量变化。
works.description_zh: 最早的 ARKit 演示之一：一个类似 Tilt Brush 的原型，移动手机时，发光的笔触会留在房间里悬浮不动。
works.idea_en: Use your phone as a brush to paint 3D strokes in the air of your room.
works.technique_zh: 每帧从世界追踪得到的相机位姿中，采样镜头前方稍远处的一个点，再把这些点挤出成线条或管状网格，固定在世界空间中。
works.exercise_en: In AR Foundation, add the point 20 cm in front of the camera to a LineRenderer while the screen is held, drawing light trails that hang in the air. Twist: make the line color change with movement speed or sound volume.

works.title: Drifter
works.description: A full-size concrete block appears to float and drift slowly through a gallery, rising and turning above visitors' heads.
works.description_zh: 一块实物大小的混凝土块看似漂浮着，在展厅中缓慢移动，在观众头顶上升、转动。
works.idea_en: Taking weight away from a heavy object breaks our expectations more than any effect; AR can make the heaviest real-looking thing float.
works.idea_zh: 让沉重的物体失去重量，比任何特效都更能打破预期；AR 可以让看起来最沉的东西漂浮起来。
works.technique: The block is a lightweight replica filled with helium, likely steered by small internal motors and a control system so it follows a slow path.
works.technique_zh: 这块“混凝土”是一个充满氦气的轻质复制品，很可能由内部小型电机和控制系统驾驶，沿缓慢的路径移动。
works.exercise_en: Model a photoreal concrete block, anchor it in a real room at head height and let it drift slowly, with correct shadows on the floor and occlusion behind pillars. Twist: when two viewers stand under it, it sinks toward them as if tired.
works.exercise_zh: 建一块照片级真实的混凝土块，把它锚定在真实房间的头顶高度，让它缓慢漂移，并在地面投下正确的影子，在柱子后面被正确遮挡。变体：两位观众站在它下方时，它像累了一样向他们下沉。

video.video_title: DRIFTER | by DRIFT

salient.why_en: A heavy concrete block floats slowly through the room like a cloud.
salient.why_zh: 一块沉重的混凝土方块像云一样慢慢飘过房间。

works.title: Dürer's Dog (Ballett Nürnberg)
works.description: A ballet by Goyo Montero about Albrecht Dürer for Staatstheater Nürnberg, with Weiss's digital scenography projecting engraving-like imagery that shifts with the ensemble.
works.description_zh: Goyo Montero 为纽伦堡国家剧院创作的关于 Albrecht Dürer 的芭蕾，Weiss 的数字舞美投影出版画般的影像，随群舞变化。
works.idea_en: A painter's etchings come alive as a stage that moves with the dancers.
works.idea_zh: 画家的蚀刻版画活了过来，变成随舞者而动的舞台。
works.technique: Large-scale stage projection of generated, print-like graphics, likely partly driven by live tracking of the dancers.
works.technique_zh: 大尺度舞台投影生成的版画风格图形，很可能部分由对舞者的实时追踪驱动。
works.exercise_en: Take a public-domain engraving, split it into line layers, and project them so a dancer's position reveals or erases lines. Twist: the dancer can only reveal the drawing by standing still.
works.exercise_zh: 选一幅公有领域的版画，把线条拆成多层，投影出来，让舞者的位置显现或擦除线条；变体：舞者只有静止站立时才能让画面显现。

video.video_title: Staatstheater Nürnberg Ballett ::: Dürer's Dog (UA)

works.title: Energy Shield Shader
works.description: A translucent sci-fi force field flares with expanding ripples wherever projectiles hit it.
works.description_zh: 一个半透明的科幻力场，被投射物击中的位置会亮起并向外扩散波纹。
works.idea_en: Every impact leaves a ripple on an invisible barrier.
works.idea_zh: 每一次撞击都在无形的屏障上留下涟漪。
works.technique: A C# script sends an array of recent hit positions and times to the shader, which adds a fading ring around each hit on top of a fresnel rim glow.
works.technique_zh: C# 脚本把最近的撞击位置和时间作为数组传给着色器，着色器在菲涅尔边缘光之上，为每个撞击点叠加一个逐渐消退的光环。
works.exercise_en: Wrap a person or a real chair in an AR shield dome using AR Foundation body or plane anchors, and send a hit to the shader wherever the user taps the screen. Twist: let microphone claps trigger random impacts.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 的人体或平面锚点把一个人或一把真实的椅子罩进 AR 护盾里，用户点屏幕的位置就向着色器发送一次撞击。变体：让麦克风听到拍手时触发随机撞击。

video.video_title: Sending Array's To Shaders - Lets Make an Energy Shield - Part 1

works.title: Euclidean Lands AR
works.description: A turn-based puzzle game on a rotating cube world, adapted for ARKit so the Rubik's-cube-like diorama sits on the player's table and can be walked around.
works.idea_zh: 把魔方般旋转的解谜小世界放在桌面上，绕着它思考。

video.video_title: Euclidean Lands AR Trailer

works.technique: A rotating cube-world puzzle is placed on a detected table, and its grid-based rotation logic is unchanged while the camera view comes from the player walking around it.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个可以整体旋转的 AR 小立方体世界，旋转后角色可以走上新的路径；变体：旋转只能通过绕着桌子走来完成。
works.description_zh: 一款在可旋转立方体世界上进行的回合制解谜游戏，改编为 ARKit 版本后，这座魔方般的微缩场景就摆在玩家的桌上，可以绕着它走动观察。
works.idea_en: A puzzle world that rotates like a Rubik's cube sits on your table, and you walk around it to think.
works.technique_zh: 可旋转的立方体世界谜题被放置在检测到的桌面上，基于网格的旋转逻辑保持不变，而相机视角来自玩家绕着它的走动。
works.exercise_en: Build a small AR cube world that can rotate as a whole, so that after each rotation the character can walk onto a new path. Twist: the only way to rotate it is by walking around the table.

works.title: Experiment: Building a City in ARKit
works.description: Choose buildings from a menu and place them to grow a miniature town on the sofa.
works.idea_zh: 在沙发上一栋栋摆放建筑，搭出一座迷你城市。

video.video_title: Experiment: Building a City in ARKit - Apple / Unity

works.technique: Building prefabs chosen from a UI menu are placed with raycasts onto a detected surface, with grid snapping for a tidy miniature city layout.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌面平面上做一个网格，从菜单选楼房、树、路放上去拼成小城；变体：放下的建筑会自动“生活”，比如路上出现小车。
works.description_zh: 从菜单中挑选建筑并逐个摆放，在沙发上建起一座微缩小镇。
works.idea_en: Place buildings one by one on the sofa to build a miniature city.
works.technique_zh: 从 UI 菜单中选择的建筑预制体通过射线检测放置在检测到的表面上，并吸附到网格，形成整齐的微缩城市布局。
works.exercise_en: Make a grid on the tabletop plane and pick buildings, trees and roads from a menu to assemble a small town. Twist: placed buildings come to life on their own, for example with little cars appearing on the roads.

works.title: Extinct Systems
works.description: A large-scale immersive projection fills a hall with generative creatures and landscapes, and more than a hundred visitors shape the same canvas at once.
works.description_zh: 大尺度沉浸式投影铺满整个展厅，生成出的生物与地貌不断演化，上百名观众同时在同一块“画布”上参与塑造。
works.idea_en: One shared living world that a whole crowd grows together instead of one person at a time.
works.idea_zh: 让一整群人一起养育同一个活的世界，而不是一次只让一个人玩。
works.technique: Real-time WebGL generative graphics are projected at room scale, with many simultaneous inputs merged into one simulation (likely phones connecting through a browser).
works.technique_zh: 用 WebGL 实时生成图形并做房间尺度投影，把大量同时输入合并进同一个模拟（很可能是观众用手机浏览器接入）。
works.exercise_en: Build a projected pond where every student joins from their phone browser and spawns one creature that lives in the shared scene. Twist: creatures only reproduce when two phones tap at the same moment.
works.exercise_zh: 搭建一个投影池塘，每位同学用手机浏览器接入并生成一只生物，在共享场景中生活；变体：只有两部手机同时点击时，生物才会繁殖。

video.video_title: Extinct Systems

works.title: Eyemote
works.description: A visitor sits at a stand with household devices and switches on a lamp, a TV or a kettle just by looking at it, with projected animation and sound confirming each action.
works.description_zh: 观众坐在摆着家用电器的展台前，只要看一眼，就能打开台灯、电视或水壶，投影动画和声音会确认每个操作。
works.idea_en: Turn things on with a glance.
works.idea_zh: 看一眼就能打开东西。
works.technique: An affordable Tobii EyeX eye tracker is calibrated to the user, and gaze dwell on each device's region triggers relays and projected feedback.
works.technique_zh: 用平价的 Tobii EyeX 眼动仪为用户校准，视线在某个设备区域停留足够久时，就触发继电器和投影反馈。
works.exercise_en: Use head direction in AR (or a webcam gaze estimate) to switch a real LED or a virtual object on when you look at it for two seconds. Twist: looking away turns it off, so two people must cooperate to keep everything on.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR 中的头部朝向（或摄像头视线估计），注视两秒就打开一盏真实 LED 或一个虚拟物体。变体：一移开视线就关掉，所以要两个人合作才能让所有东西保持亮着。

video.video_title: Eyemote

works.title: FANTASTIC VOYAGE
works.description: Visitors explore the abstract interior of a sculpture with a light tool inspired by endoscopes; the generative world reacts to where they shine, and the sculpture's outside glows to mirror their journey.
works.description_zh: 观众手持受内窥镜启发的光源工具，探索一件雕塑的抽象内部；生成的世界对光照到的地方作出反应，雕塑外壳也随之发光，映出他们的探索旅程。
works.idea_en: Shine a light inside an object and it comes alive.
works.idea_zh: 把光照进一个物体，它就活了过来。
works.technique: A tracked handheld light acts as the controller for a real-time generative environment shown inside the sculpture, while LEDs on its shell replay the visitor's path.
works.technique_zh: 被追踪的手持光源作为控制器，操纵雕塑内部显示的实时生成环境，雕塑外壳上的 LED 则重现观众的探索路径。
works.exercise_en: Let students shine a phone flashlight into a cardboard box with a webcam inside, and grow generative shapes on a screen wherever the light hits. Twist: shapes only survive in the dark once the light moves on.
works.exercise_zh: 让同学用手机手电筒照进一个内置摄像头的纸箱，光照到哪里，屏幕上就在哪里长出生成图形；变体：光移开之后，图形只能在黑暗中存活。

video.video_title: FANTASTIC VOYAGE

works.title: Falcon 9 landing in a swimming pool
works.description: A SpaceX Falcon 9 booster descends with fire and smoke and lands on a drone ship floating in his real swimming pool.
works.idea_zh: 猎鹰 9 号火箭回收降落在自家泳池里的无人船上。

video.video_title: Falcon 9 landing at the ASDS / ARkit Demo

works.technique: An ARKit plane on the water surface anchors a Unity-animated rocket, drone ship and particle exhaust at a deliberate miniature scale.
works.exercise_zh: 找一个校园里的真实平面（水池、操场、台阶），把一段科学新闻做成缩小版 AR 重演；加一个变化：观众可以用手势'倒计时'启动。
works.description_zh: 一枚 SpaceX Falcon 9 助推器在火焰和烟雾中缓缓降落，停在他家真实泳池里漂浮的无人船上。
works.idea_en: A Falcon 9 rocket lands on a drone ship floating in your own swimming pool.
works.technique_zh: 以水面上的 ARKit 平面为锚点，放置在 Unity 中制作动画的火箭、无人船和尾焰粒子，并刻意采用微缩比例。
works.exercise_en: Find a real surface on campus (a pond, a playground, some steps) and restage a piece of science news on it as a miniature AR reenactment. Twist: viewers can launch it with a "countdown" hand gesture.

works.title: Fencing tracking and visualization system
works.description: An AR broadcast system (with Dentsu Lab Tokyo) that detects fencing sword tips too fast for the eye and overlays their trajectories live; later versions are markerless using deep learning.
works.idea_zh: 把肉眼看不清的击剑剑尖轨迹实时可视化叠加在转播画面上。

video.video_title: Making_Fencing_2017

works.technique: High-speed cameras detect the sword tips (first with markers, later with a trained deep-learning keypoint detector), triangulate their 3D positions, and render trajectory trails over the broadcast feed.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机慢动作拍一段挥羽毛球拍或擦白板的动作，用颜色追踪或 MediaPipe 手部点画出高速轨迹叠加到视频上；变体：把轨迹变成一种“书法”，比一比谁挥出的线条最好看。
works.description_zh: 一套 AR 转播系统（与 Dentsu Lab Tokyo 合作），能检测快到肉眼无法看清的击剑剑尖，并实时叠加其运动轨迹；后续版本借助深度学习实现了无标记追踪。
works.idea_en: Fencing blade tips too fast for the eye are drawn live as trails over the broadcast.
works.technique_zh: 高速相机检测剑尖（最初借助标记，后来改用训练好的深度学习关键点检测器），三角测量出其 3D 位置，并在转播画面上渲染运动轨迹。
works.exercise_en: Film a badminton swing or someone wiping a whiteboard in slow motion on a phone, and use color tracking or MediaPipe hand landmarks to draw the fast trajectory over the video. Twist: treat the trajectories as calligraphy and compare whose strokes look best.

works.title: Franchise Freedom
works.description: Hundreds of drones carrying lights fly as a flock over cities and deserts, swirling and splitting like starlings in a murmuration against the night sky.
works.description_zh: 数百架带灯的无人机像鸟群一样在城市和沙漠上空飞行，如同椋鸟群在夜空中翻卷、分离。
works.idea_en: Simple local rules produce a sky that feels alive; AR swarms should follow flocking rules rather than scripted paths to feel natural.
works.idea_zh: 简单的局部规则就能造出一片活着的天空；AR 群体也应该遵循集群规则而不是写死的路径，才会显得自然。
works.technique: Custom software, likely based on flocking algorithms derived from starling research, generates the drones' paths, which are then flown with positioning and synchronised LEDs.
works.technique_zh: 定制软件很可能基于源自椋鸟研究的集群算法生成无人机的航线，再借助定位和同步 LED 飞出来。
works.exercise_en: Implement a Boids flock of 200 glowing points in AR above an open space and let the viewer's phone position act as a predator the flock avoids. Twist: add a second phone as a second predator and watch the flock split.
works.exercise_zh: 在开阔场地上空用 AR 实现一个由 200 个发光点组成的 Boids 鸟群，把观众手机的位置当作鸟群要躲避的捕食者。变体：再加一部手机作为第二个捕食者，看鸟群如何分裂。

video.video_title: FRANCHISE FREEDOM in partnership with BMW | by DRIFT

works.title: GDisintegrator
works.description: A figure's surface peels off into drifting triangles that swirl away like ash, and then the body is restored.
works.description_zh: 人物的表面剥落成一片片三角形，像灰烬一样被卷走，随后身体又复原。
works.idea_en: Treat disintegration as a controllable, reversible material state.
works.idea_zh: 把“解体”当成一种可以控制、可以倒回的材质状态。
works.technique: A geometry shader detaches each triangle when a moving threshold reaches it, then moves, spins and shrinks the triangle with noise over time; it is the companion effect to GVoxelizer.
works.technique_zh: 几何着色器在移动的阈值到达时把每个三角形分离出来，再用噪声随时间移动、旋转并缩小它；这是 GVoxelizer 的姊妹效果。
works.exercise_en: Add a triangle-disintegration shader to a virtual statue in AR Foundation and drive the threshold with the distance between phone and statue. Twist: make the triangles fly toward the viewer's camera instead of away.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中给一座虚拟雕像加上三角面解体着色器，用手机与雕像的距离控制阈值；变体：让三角形朝观众的镜头飞来，而不是飞走。

video.video_title: GDisintegrator Test

works.title: GPU Accelerated 2D Wave Simulation
works.description: Waves spread from points of impact over a surface, bouncing off walls and interfering into complex patterns.
works.description_zh: 波从撞击点向外扩散，碰到边界反弹，相互干涉形成复杂的图案。
works.idea_en: A few lines of physics on the GPU turn a surface into a living membrane.
works.idea_zh: GPU 上几行物理代码就能把一个表面变成活的薄膜。
works.technique: The 2D wave equation is integrated with finite differences in a compute shader over a height grid, and the grid drives a displaced mesh.
works.technique_zh: 在计算着色器中用有限差分对高度网格积分二维波动方程，再用网格驱动顶点位移。
works.exercise_en: Lay the wave membrane over a real table in AR and trigger waves where students' fingers touch the screen. Twist: add walls by placing real books on the table, detected as obstacles.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把波动薄膜铺在真实桌面上，学生手指点击屏幕的地方产生波。变体：把真实的书放在桌上作为障碍物，被检测为边界。

video.video_title: Unity GPU Accelerated 2D Wave Simulation

works.title: GRID (with Robert Henke)
works.description: Horizontal LED rods hang in a grid on winches, lifting, tilting and changing colour to Robert Henke's music, so lines of light build planes and tunnels in space.
works.description_zh: 水平的 LED 灯杆以网格悬挂在绞盘上，随 Robert Henke 的音乐升降、倾斜、变色，光线在空间中组成平面和隧道。
works.idea_en: Tilting a line of light turns it into a plane — a few controllable lines can sketch whole architectures around the viewer.
works.idea_zh: 倾斜一条光线就能得到一个平面——少量可控的线就能在观众周围勾勒出整个建筑。
works.technique: Each rod hangs from two winches, so the difference in cable length sets its tilt; motion and colour are sequenced with the music.
works.technique_zh: 每根灯杆由两个绞盘吊起，两根缆绳的长度差决定倾角；运动和颜色与音乐一起编排。
works.exercise_en: Hang ten virtual light rods from the ceiling in AR and animate their tilt to form a tunnel the viewer can walk through. Twist: bind each rod's angle to the viewer's distance from it.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中从天花板吊下十根虚拟灯杆，让它们倾斜形成观众可以走进去的隧道。变体：让每根灯杆的角度与观众离它的距离绑定。

video.video_title: GRID –  kinetic installation by Christopher Bauder and Robert Henke

works.title: GVoxelizer
works.description: An animated character dissolves into flying voxel cubes and then reassembles, as if it were being teleported block by block.
works.description_zh: 一个动画角色分解成飞散的体素方块，然后又重新拼回来，像被一块一块地传送走。
works.idea_en: Turn any mesh into a voxel transition without preprocessing it.
works.idea_zh: 不做任何预处理，就能把任意网格变成体素化的转场。
works.technique: A geometry shader turns each triangle into a cube once a moving effector plane passes it, then pushes and scales the cubes with noise, so the effect runs in real time on any mesh.
works.technique_zh: 几何着色器在一个移动的效果平面扫过时把每个三角形变成立方体，再用噪声推动并缩放这些立方体，所以任何网格都能实时使用这个效果。
works.exercise_en: Apply a voxel-dissolve shader to a scanned object placed with AR Foundation so it breaks into cubes as the phone gets closer. Twist: reverse it so the object only builds itself up when the viewer steps back.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 里给一个扫描物体加上体素溶解着色器，手机越靠近它就越碎成方块；变体：反过来，只有观众后退时物体才一块块搭建起来。

video.video_title: GVoxelizer Test

works.title: Game of Thrones Premiere, Walt Disney Concert Hall
works.description: For the 2017 Game of Thrones season premiere in Los Angeles, Frank Gehry's curved steel Walt Disney Concert Hall was covered with projected ice, fire, dragons and banners from the series.
works.description_zh: 为 2017 年《权力的游戏》新季在洛杉矶的首映式，弗兰克·盖里设计的弧形钢板迪士尼音乐厅被投上剧中的冰、火、龙和旗帜。
works.idea_en: Free-form architecture forces content to follow curves instead of rectangles; AR on curved surfaces must be designed for the surface, not just placed on it.
works.idea_zh: 自由曲面建筑迫使内容顺着曲线而不是矩形来设计；在曲面上的 AR 必须为表面而设计，不能只是贴上去。
works.technique: Projection mapping on a highly curved façade requires an accurate 3D model and careful projector placement to avoid distortion across the steel sails.
works.technique_zh: 在高度弯曲的立面上做投影映射，需要精确的三维模型和谨慎的投影机布位，避免钢板曲面上的变形。
works.exercise_en: Scan a curved object such as a car, a bottle or a column with a LiDAR phone, then map an animated texture that flows along its curves in Reality Composer or Unity. Twist: the texture flows faster where the curvature is sharper.
works.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的手机扫描一辆车、一只瓶子或一根柱子这样的曲面物体，在 Reality Composer 或 Unity 里映射一段沿曲面流动的动画纹理；变体：曲率越大的地方，纹理流得越快。

video.video_title: Game of Thrones 2017 Premiere | Walt Disney Concert Hall Projection Mapping

works.title: Gate to the Upside Down
works.description: A Stranger Things-inspired ARKit test turns an ordinary pharmacy aisle into the dark, spore-filled 'Upside Down', with the real space darkened and overgrown around the camera.
works.idea_zh: 把超市货架变成《怪奇物语》的颠倒世界。

video.video_title: Gate to the Upside Down

works.technique: The camera feed is color-graded dark while floating particles and vine meshes are anchored to ARKit-detected planes to make the real room feel replaced.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个熟悉的教室角落，用滤镜+漂浮粒子+贴地藤蔓把它变成'另一个平行世界'；加一个变化：手机靠近某个真实物体时世界切回现实。
works.description_zh: 一个受《怪奇物语》启发的 ARKit 测试，把普通药店的货架通道变成黑暗、布满孢子的“颠倒世界”，相机周围的真实空间被调暗并爬满藤蔓。
works.idea_en: A store aisle turns into the Upside Down from Stranger Things.
works.technique_zh: 对相机画面进行暗调调色，同时把漂浮粒子和藤蔓网格锚定在 ARKit 检测到的平面上，让真实房间看起来像被替换了一样。
works.exercise_en: Pick a familiar corner of a classroom and turn it into "another parallel world" with a filter, floating particles and vines on the floor. Twist: the world switches back to reality when the phone gets close to a certain real object.

works.title: Giants: Kikito
works.description: A 20-metre photograph of a one-year-old boy, Kikito, peers over the US–Mexico border fence in Tecate, mounted on scaffolding on the Mexican side so he appears to look into the United States.
works.description_zh: 一张 20 米高的一岁男孩 Kikito 的照片在特卡特越过美墨边境墙向外张望；照片装在墨西哥一侧的脚手架上，看起来他正望向美国。
works.idea_en: A child's gaze across a wall turns a political barrier into a human moment, showing how an image aligned with a real structure can change its meaning.
works.idea_zh: 一个孩子越过墙的目光把政治屏障变成了人性的瞬间，说明与真实结构对齐的图像可以改变其意义。
works.technique: A cut-out photographic print was mounted on a scaffold structure behind the fence and aligned so the child appears to lean on it.
works.technique_zh: 剪裁好的照片印刷品安装在围栏后方的脚手架上，并经过对齐，使孩子看起来像是靠在围栏上。
works.exercise_en: Place a giant AR cut-out photo of a person behind a real wall or fence so that they appear to look over it at passers-by. Twist: the person's eyes follow whoever walks past.
