works.exercise_zh: 在真实的墙或围栏后放置一张巨大的 AR 人物剪影照片，让他看起来正越过墙望着路人；变体：人物的眼睛会跟随经过的人。

video.video_title: Inside Giants: Kikito on the US - Mexican Border

salient.why_en: A giant toddler peers over the US–Mexico border fence, turning a wall into a curious look.
salient.why_zh: 一个巨大的幼儿从美墨边境墙上探头张望，把一堵墙变成了一次好奇的注视。

works.title: GlitchDancer
works.description: A motion-captured dancer keeps breaking into shifting glitch fragments, rendered live at 60 fps on an iPhone as a pocket VJ tool.
works.description_zh: 一个动作捕捉的舞者不断碎裂成变化的故障碎片，在 iPhone 上以 60 fps 实时渲染，像一台口袋里的 VJ 设备。
works.idea_en: Show that a phone can run club-grade real-time 3D visuals.
works.idea_zh: 证明一部手机也能跑出夜店级别的实时 3D 视觉。
works.technique: Mocap clips drive a skinned character whose triangles are displaced and recolored by Skinner-style glitch shaders, tuned to hold 60 fps on an iPhone 6S; part of it was used for the Teenage Engineering OP-Z demo at NAMM 2017.
works.technique_zh: 动作捕捉片段驱动一个蒙皮角色，Skinner 风格的故障着色器对三角面做位移和变色，并针对 iPhone 6S 优化到稳定 60 fps；其中一部分用在了 NAMM 2017 上 Teenage Engineering OP-Z 的演示。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR scene where a mocap dancer stands on a table and its triangles glitch apart on every beat the microphone detects. Twist: tap the screen to freeze the glitch and walk around the frozen fragments.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 场景：动作捕捉舞者站在桌面上，麦克风每检测到一个节拍，它的三角面就故障式地散开；变体：点一下屏幕把故障定格，然后绕着定格的碎片走一圈。

video.video_title: GlitchDancer iOS

works.title: Good Fences Make Good Neighbors
works.description: Across New York City, Ai placed more than 300 fences, cages and banners, including a golden cage at Central Park's entrance and a mirrored passage under the Washington Square Arch, about migration and borders.
works.description_zh: 在纽约全城，艾未未放置了 300 多件围栏、笼子和横幅，包括中央公园入口处的金色笼子和华盛顿广场拱门下的镜面通道，主题关于移民与边界。
works.idea_en: Spreading one theme over hundreds of city sites makes a whole city the exhibition, a model for citywide AR shows.
works.idea_zh: 把一个主题分散到城市中数百处地点，让整座城市成为展览，是全城 AR 展览的范本。
works.technique: Site-specific fence structures were fabricated in steel and installed in parks, bus shelters and lamp posts in all five boroughs.
works.technique_zh: 为特定场地定制的钢制围栏结构被安装在五个行政区的公园、公交站和路灯杆上。
works.exercise_en: Create a citywide AR show: anchor 20 small cage or fence pieces at bus stops and gates around campus, each with a short story about a boundary. Twist: some pieces can only be seen from inside a fence.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一场全城 AR 展：在校园周边的公交站和大门处锚定 20 件小型笼子或围栏作品，每件附带一个关于边界的小故事；变体：有些作品只有站在围栏内才能看到。

video.video_title: PAF40: Ai Weiwei: Good Fences Make Good Neighbors

works.title: Google Tango Constructor
works.description: A developer tool for Tango phones such as the Asus Zenfone AR: walk around a space to capture a textured 3D scan, then view the result in VR on the same phone.
works.description_zh: 为 Asus Zenfone AR 等 Tango 手机开发的工具：绕着空间走一圈就能采集带贴图的 3D 扫描，然后在同一部手机上用 VR 查看结果。
works.idea_en: Capture a real room with a phone and step back into it in VR.
works.idea_zh: 用手机把真实房间“拍”下来，再在 VR 里走回去。
works.technique: Tango's depth sensor and visual-inertial tracking fuse depth frames into a mesh and project camera colour onto it for a textured model.
works.technique_zh: Tango 的深度传感器和视觉惯性追踪把深度帧融合成网格，再把相机颜色投射上去，得到带贴图的模型。
works.exercise_en: Scan a small corner of the school with a phone 3D-scanning app and place the scan in a WebXR scene as a 'memory room'. Twist: scan the same spot a week later and let viewers fade between the two.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 3D 扫描应用扫下学校的一个小角落，把扫描结果放进 WebXR 场景做成“记忆房间”。变体：一周后再扫一次同一地点，让观众在两次之间渐变切换。

video.video_title: Google Tango - Constructor Dev Tool

works.title: Google Tango Research Update
works.description: A short montage of research built on Google Tango phones, including rooms scanned into meshes and furniture automatically split and labelled by object type.
works.description_zh: 一段基于 Google Tango 手机的研究短片合集，包括把房间扫描成网格，以及自动把家具按类别分割、标注出来。
works.idea_en: Phones that do not just map a room but know what is in it.
works.idea_zh: 手机不仅能绘制房间地图，还知道房间里有什么。
works.technique: Tango's depth camera and motion tracking build a 3D reconstruction; research layers on top likely run semantic segmentation to colour each object class.
works.technique_zh: Tango 的深度相机和运动追踪构建 3D 重建，研究在其上叠加的处理很可能是语义分割，为每类物体着色。
works.exercise_en: Scan a classroom corner with a LiDAR phone app (Polycam or Scaniverse), then hand-label chairs, tables and walls in different colours in Blender. Twist: place one AR note that only appears on objects labelled 'table'.
works.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的手机应用（Polycam 或 Scaniverse）扫描教室一角，再在 Blender 里把椅子、桌子和墙分别涂上不同颜色标注。变体：放一条只会出现在“桌子”上的 AR 便签。

video.video_title: Google Tango - Research Update May 2017

works.title: GpuTrail: 100,000 Trails
works.description: One hundred thousand glowing trails stream through space at once, each following its own particle.
works.description_zh: 十万条发光的拖尾同时在空间中流动，每条跟随一个粒子。
works.idea_en: Trails, usually expensive, can be fully GPU-driven at massive scale.
works.idea_zh: 原本昂贵的拖尾可以完全交给 GPU，做到极大规模。
works.technique: Trail node positions are stored in compute buffers and updated per frame in a compute shader, then drawn as camera-facing strips with frustum culling and LOD.
works.technique_zh: 拖尾节点位置存在 compute buffer 中，每帧由计算着色器更新，再以面向相机的条带绘制，并做视锥剔除和 LOD。
works.exercise_en: Attach GPU trails to tracked hands or the phone in AR so movement leaves a long trace of light around the room. Twist: trails of different students attract each other.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把 GPU 拖尾绑到追踪的手或手机上，移动时在房间里留下长长的光迹。变体：不同学生的光迹会互相吸引。

video.video_title: 100000 trails Unity

works.title: Hatsune Miku Dancing in My Living Room
works.description: A dancing Hatsune Miku model performs on the living room floor using AR.js on Tango and A-Frame.
works.idea_zh: 让初音未来在自家客厅地板上跳舞。

video.video_title: Hatsune Miku Dancing in my living room!

works.technique: An MMD character with dance animation is loaded in A-Frame and placed on the floor using Tango's markerless tracking, so it stays fixed while the viewer walks around.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 平面检测把一个 Mixamo 跳舞角色放到地面并播放音乐；变体：角色跳舞节奏跟随麦克风检测到的节拍。
works.description_zh: 借助 Tango 上的 AR.js 和 A-Frame，一个会跳舞的初音未来模型在客厅地板上表演。
works.idea_en: Hatsune Miku dances on your living room floor.
works.technique_zh: 在 A-Frame 中加载带舞蹈动画的 MMD 角色，并利用 Tango 的无标记追踪把它放在地板上，观众四处走动时角色依然固定不动。
works.exercise_en: Use WebXR plane detection to put a dancing Mixamo character on the floor and play music. Twist: make the character's dance rhythm follow the beat detected by the microphone.

works.title: Hiding Stuff with ARKit
works.description: Live textures captured from the surroundings are laid over real objects so they seem to vanish from the scene.
works.idea_zh: 用周围环境的实时纹理盖住物体，让它“隐身”。

video.video_title: Hiding stuff with ARKit

works.technique: Camera frames of the surrounding surface are captured and projected onto proxy geometry covering the object (a diminished-reality inpainting trick), making it look like background.
works.exercise_zh: 先拍一张没有物体的桌面照片，再用这张照片投影到盖在物体上的平面，让物体“隐形”；变体：只隐藏一半，做成被刀切掉的效果。
works.description_zh: 把从周围环境实时采集的纹理覆盖到真实物体上，让它们看起来从场景中消失了。
works.idea_en: Cover an object with live textures of its surroundings to make it invisible.
works.technique_zh: 采集周围表面的相机画面，投射到覆盖物体的代理几何体上（一种削弱现实的修补技巧），让物体看起来就像背景。
works.exercise_en: First take a photo of the tabletop without the object, then project that photo onto a plane covering the object to make it "invisible." Twist: hide only half of it, as if it had been sliced off with a knife.

works.title: Hole in the Wall with AR.js
works.description: A marker on a surface opens a convincing hole that reveals a virtual space inside the wall.
works.idea_zh: 一张标记就在墙上开出一个洞，看见墙里的空间。

video.video_title: Hole in the Wall with AR js

works.technique: An inverted box rendered behind the marker plane is surrounded by an invisible depth-only occluder mesh, so the virtual interior is only visible through the opening.
works.exercise_zh: 用 three.js 或 AR.js 在标记下方做一个开口向上的盒子，四周用只写深度的遮挡面挡住，形成桌面上的洞；变体：洞里放一个会往外看的小生物。
works.description_zh: 表面上的一个标记会打开一个以假乱真的洞口，露出墙内的虚拟空间。
works.idea_en: A single marker opens a hole in the wall that shows the space inside it.
works.technique_zh: 在标记平面后方渲染一个内外翻转的盒子，四周围上只写深度的隐形遮挡网格，使虚拟内部空间只能透过开口看到。
works.exercise_en: Use three.js or AR.js to build a box opening upward below a marker, surrounded by depth-only occluder faces, forming a hole in the tabletop. Twist: put a small creature in the hole that peeks out.

works.title: HoloKit
works.description: An open-source cardboard headset that turns an iPhone into a stereoscopic optical see-through AR wearable, with ARKit tracking and holograms shown in both eyes.
works.idea_zh: 用纸板和iPhone做一台开源的立体光学透视AR头显。

video.video_title: HoloKit: affordable open source mixed reality experience

works.technique: An iPhone renders a stereo image pair that a mirror and lens reflect into each eye as an optical see-through overlay, while ARKit visual-inertial tracking places the holograms in the world.
works.exercise_zh: 用 HoloKit Unity SDK 把一个已有的手机 AR 场景改成立体模式，并对比单目和立体下的深度感；变体：做一个必须靠立体视觉才能判断远近的小游戏。
works.description_zh: 一款开源的纸板头显，把 iPhone 变成立体光学透视式 AR 可穿戴设备，借助 ARKit 追踪，全息影像同时呈现在双眼中。
works.idea_en: An open-source stereo optical see-through AR headset made from cardboard and an iPhone.
works.technique_zh: iPhone 渲染一对立体图像，经反射镜和透镜反射进双眼，形成光学透视叠加；同时由 ARKit 视觉惯性追踪把全息影像放置在世界中。
works.exercise_en: Convert an existing phone AR scene to stereo mode with the HoloKit Unity SDK, and compare the sense of depth in mono and stereo. Twist: make a small game where you can only judge distance with stereo vision.

works.title: HoloKit + Tango Demo
works.description: An early test of HoloKit's cardboard stereo optics driven by a Google Tango phone, placing stable holograms in the room.
works.idea_zh: 用纸盒头显+Tango手机实现早期空间稳定的立体AR。

video.video_title: HoloKit Demo

works.technique: Uses Tango's motion tracking for 6DoF pose and renders a side-by-side stereo image through HoloKit's mirror-and-Fresnel optics.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机AR场景改为左右分屏立体渲染，放入纸盒眼镜观看一个固定在桌上的方块；变化：比较单眼画面与立体画面的深度感。
works.description_zh: 用 Google Tango 手机驱动 HoloKit 纸板立体光学系统的早期测试，在房间中放置了稳定的全息影像。
works.idea_en: Early spatially stable stereo AR from a cardboard headset and a Tango phone.
works.technique_zh: 利用 Tango 的运动追踪获取 6DoF 位姿，并通过 HoloKit 的反射镜与菲涅尔透镜光学系统呈现左右并排的立体图像。
works.exercise_en: Change a phone AR scene to side-by-side stereo rendering and view a cube fixed on a table through a cardboard viewer. Twist: compare the sense of depth in the single-eye view and the stereo view.

works.title: HoloKit 4DViews Rocker Hologram
works.description: A volumetric-captured rock guitarist performs life-size in the room through a HoloKit stereo headset, viewable from any angle.
works.idea_zh: 真人体积视频摇滚歌手在你房间里演出。

video.video_title: Holokit / ARKit - 4DView (Rocker)

works.technique: Plays back a sequence of textured meshes from volumetric capture anchored on the floor and rendered stereoscopically.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍摄同学的一段短表演做成透明背景视频（抠像），放入AR场景作为“全息演出”；变化：多个同学的表演组成一支AR乐队。
works.description_zh: 通过 HoloKit 立体头显，一位体积捕捉的摇滚吉他手以真人大小在房间里演出，可以从任意角度观看。
works.idea_en: A volumetric video of a real rock singer performs in your room.
works.technique_zh: 回放一段来自体积捕捉的带纹理网格序列，锚定在地面上并以立体方式渲染。
works.exercise_en: Film a classmate's short performance on a phone, key it into a transparent-background video, and place it in an AR scene as a "hologram show." Twist: combine several classmates' performances into an AR band.

works.title: HoloKit Drone Attack
works.description: Two players wearing HoloKit cardboard headsets share one living room and shoot down virtual drones together in stereo AR, shown at SIGGRAPH 2017.
works.idea_zh: 两人戴纸盒AR头显，在同一房间合作打无人机。

video.video_title: Holokit / ARKit - Drone attack

works.technique: Both phones start from the same physical position and orientation to share a coordinate frame, then sync game state with UNet.
works.exercise_zh: 让两名同学各用手机（可放入HoloKit或纸盒）从同一起点启动AR，合作射击同一批虚拟目标；变化：一人只能看见目标，另一人只能射击。
works.description_zh: 两名玩家戴着 HoloKit 纸板头显同处一个客厅，在立体 AR 中合作击落虚拟无人机，曾在 SIGGRAPH 2017 上展出。
works.idea_en: Two people wearing cardboard AR headsets team up to shoot drones in the same room.
works.technique_zh: 两部手机从同一物理位置和朝向启动以共享坐标系，再通过 UNet 同步游戏状态。
works.exercise_en: Have two classmates start AR on their own phones (optionally inside HoloKit or a cardboard viewer) from the same starting point and shoot the same set of virtual targets together. Twist: one person can only see the targets, and the other can only shoot.

works.title: Hologram Bird in AR.js
works.description: A Star Wars-style hologram bird delivers a message from a marker, prototyping an AR business card.
works.idea_zh: 星战式全息小鸟从名片上跳出来传话。

video.video_title: Hologram Bird in AR js

works.technique: A marker on a business card triggers an animated bird rendered with an additive, scanline hologram shader and synced audio message.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR.js 在自己的名片标记上显示一个带扫描线全息着色器的小角色，播放 10 秒自我介绍；变体：角色根据时间段说不同问候语。
works.description_zh: 一只星球大战风格的全息小鸟从标记上现身传递消息，是 AR 名片的原型。
works.idea_en: A Star Wars-style hologram bird jumps out of a business card to deliver a message.
works.technique_zh: 名片上的标记触发一只带动画的小鸟，使用叠加混合的扫描线全息着色器渲染，并同步播放音频消息。
works.exercise_en: Use AR.js to show a small character with a scanline hologram shader on your own business-card marker, playing a 10-second self-introduction. Twist: the character says a different greeting depending on the time of day.

works.title: HotStepper
works.description: The first AR character-based wayfinding app: enter any address and an animated character walks ahead of you through the real street to lead the way.
works.idea_zh: 一个AR小人走在你前面为你带路

video.video_title: HotStepper AR App | Nexus Studios

works.technique: ARKit world tracking combined with Mapbox routing and GPS lets an animated character be placed a few metres ahead of the user along the computed path.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR 在地面放一个会走在你前面的小角色，沿着预先设定的几段路线带路去教室；变体：让角色有自己的想法，偶尔带你绕路去一个它“喜欢”的地方。
works.description_zh: 第一款以 AR 角色带路的导航应用：输入任意地址，一个动画角色就会在真实街道上走在你前面引路。
works.idea_en: A little AR figure walks ahead of you to show the way.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 世界追踪结合 Mapbox 路线规划与 GPS，把动画角色放在用户前方几米处，沿计算出的路径行进。
works.exercise_en: Use AR to place a small character on the ground that walks ahead of you and leads you to a classroom along a few preset route segments. Twist: give the character a mind of its own so it sometimes takes a detour to a place it "likes."

salient.why_en: A small character walks ahead of you on the real street to show the way.
salient.why_zh: 一个小人在真实街道上走在你前面带路。

works.title: INORI (Prayer)
works.description: Dancers AyaBambi's faces are mapped with high-speed projection (1000 fps tracking) so skulls, tears and eyes follow their fast choreography.
works.idea_zh: 千帧级高速追踪投影，让面部图像跟上激烈舞蹈

video.video_title: INORI (Prayer)

works.technique: A 1000 fps high-speed camera and a DynaFlash-type high-frame-rate projector close the tracking-to-projection loop within a few milliseconds, so imagery stays registered on fast-moving faces.
works.exercise_zh: 用普通投影仪和网页摄像头做人脸追踪投影，测量并记录延迟造成的“拖影”，再尝试预测运动（速度外推）来减轻它；变体：把拖影本身作为视觉语言，做一段刻意“跟不上”的舞蹈。
works.description_zh: 借助高速投影（1000 fps 追踪），骷髅、泪水和眼睛等图像被映射到舞者 AyaBambi 的脸上，紧紧跟随她们快速的舞蹈动作。
works.idea_en: Tracking and projection at a thousand frames per second keep face imagery locked onto intense dance.
works.technique_zh: 1000 fps 高速相机与 DynaFlash 类高帧率投影仪在几毫秒内完成从追踪到投影的闭环，使图像始终贴合在快速运动的脸上。
works.exercise_en: Build face-tracked projection with an ordinary projector and a webcam, measure and record the "ghost trail" caused by latency, then try to reduce it by predicting motion with velocity extrapolation. Twist: use the ghost trail itself as a visual language and make a dance that deliberately "can't keep up."

works.title: InkPainter with Google Tango
works.description: Holding a Tango phone, the user sprays ink onto a scanned room; the paint lands on real walls and furniture in the camera view.
works.description_zh: 用户拿着 Tango 手机向扫描好的房间喷墨，颜料落在相机画面里的真实墙壁和家具上。
works.idea_en: Graffiti on the real world by painting onto its scanned mesh.
works.idea_zh: 通过在扫描网格上作画，在真实世界里涂鸦。
works.technique: Google Tango's depth sensing reconstructs the room as a mesh; InkPainter paints into that mesh's texture from phone raycasts and the mesh is rendered invisibly except for the paint.
works.technique_zh: Google Tango 的深度感知把房间重建成网格；InkPainter 根据手机射线往这个网格的纹理里作画，网格本身隐形，只显示颜料。
works.exercise_en: Re-create this with AR Foundation meshing on a LiDAR iPhone: hide the room mesh and show only the ink. Twist: let the ink drip down vertical surfaces over time.
works.exercise_zh: 在带 LiDAR 的 iPhone 上用 AR Foundation 网格重建重做：隐藏房间网格，只显示墨水。变体：让墨水随着时间沿竖直表面往下流。

video.video_title: InkPainter with Google Tango

works.title: InstaSaber
works.description: Roll up a piece of paper and the iPhone turns it into a glowing lightsaber that follows the paper tube in your hand.
works.idea_zh: 一卷纸在手机里变成光剑。

video.video_title: InstaSaber Demo

works.technique: A custom vision model detects the paper tube's endpoints each frame and a blade mesh with glow is rendered along that line.
works.exercise_zh: 用颜色追踪识别一根彩色吸管/纸筒，在摄像头画面上画出发光剑身（p5.js/OpenCV.js）；加一个变化：两把剑相碰会发出火花和声音。
works.description_zh: 把一张纸卷起来，iPhone 就会把它变成一把发光的光剑，跟随你手中的纸筒移动。
works.idea_en: A rolled-up sheet of paper becomes a lightsaber on your phone.
works.technique_zh: 定制的视觉模型逐帧检测纸筒的两个端点，再沿这条线渲染带辉光效果的剑身网格。
works.exercise_en: Use color tracking to detect a colored straw or paper tube and draw a glowing blade over the camera image (p5.js or OpenCV.js). Twist: two blades throw sparks and make a sound when they clash.

salient.why_en: A rolled-up sheet of paper turns into a glowing lightsaber in your hand.
salient.why_zh: 一张卷起来的纸在手中变成发光的光剑。

works.title: Invisibility Cloak for AR.js
works.description: A Harry Potter-style cloak effect that makes the marker and objects on it vanish.
works.idea_zh: 哈利·波特式隐身斗篷，让标记和物体一起消失。

video.video_title: Invisibility Cloak for AR js

works.technique: An occluder mesh over the marker writes depth only, and a background patch (a captured or procedural texture) is drawn in its place so the marker and objects appear to vanish.
works.exercise_zh: 在标记上方放一块显示预拍背景照片的平面，让标记上的小物件“隐形”；变体：隐形区域边缘加一圈波纹扭曲，像魔法斗篷。
works.description_zh: 一种哈利·波特式的隐身斗篷效果，让标记及其上面的物体一起消失。
works.idea_en: A Harry Potter-style invisibility cloak that makes the marker and the objects on it vanish.
works.technique_zh: 覆盖在标记上的遮挡网格只写入深度，并在该位置绘制一块背景贴片（采集的或程序生成的纹理），使标记和物体看起来消失了。
works.exercise_en: Place a plane above a marker that shows a pre-shot photo of the background, so small objects on the marker become "invisible." Twist: add a rippling distortion around the edge of the invisible area, like a magic cloak.

works.title: Invisible Highway
works.description: Draw a path on the floor in AR and a real robot car follows it through the room, while the phone adds a generated highway and scenery along the route.
works.idea_zh: 在 AR 里画一条路，真实的小车就沿着它开。

video.video_title: Invisible Highway

works.technique: The drawn AR path is converted to world coordinates via Tango tracking and sent as waypoints to a robot car whose position is tracked to follow it.
works.exercise_zh: 用平板在地上'画'一条 AR 路线，再让 micro:bit 小车按坐标开过去（可用摄像头俯拍追踪）；加一个变化：路上放虚拟障碍，小车要绕行。
works.description_zh: 在 AR 中于地面上画出一条路径，一辆真实的机器人小车就会沿着它穿过房间，同时手机还会沿途生成公路和风景。
works.idea_en: Draw a road in AR and a real toy car drives along it.
works.technique_zh: 借助 Tango 追踪把绘制的 AR 路径转换为世界坐标，并作为途经点发送给机器人小车，小车的位置被持续追踪以沿路径行驶。
works.exercise_en: Draw an AR route on the floor with a tablet, then have a micro:bit car drive along the coordinates, using an overhead camera for tracking if needed. Twist: add virtual obstacles on the road that the car must steer around.

salient.why_en: Draw a road in AR and a real toy car drives along it.
salient.why_zh: 在增强现实中画一条路，真实的玩具车就沿着它开。

works.title: Invisible exhibition at the de Young (ARKit experiment)
works.description: With Marpi, he placed generative 3D sculptures in the de Young Museum that are only visible through an iPad, an 'invisible exhibition' blurring what is real in the galleries.
works.idea_zh: 在美术馆里办一场只有透过手机才看得见的'隐形展览'。

video.video_title: Experiment with ARKit

works.technique: A custom ARKit/Unity app anchors animated generative meshes to detected floor planes so they appear as sculptures standing in the real gallery.
works.exercise_zh: 在学校走廊策划一个'隐形展'：每位同学用 Reality Composer 放一件只能用手机看到的作品；加一个变化：作品只在特定时间段出现。
works.description_zh: 他与 Marpi 一起在 de Young 美术馆中放置了只能透过 iPad 看到的生成式 3D 雕塑，这场“隐形展览”模糊了展厅中真实与虚拟的界限。
works.idea_en: Hold an invisible exhibition in a museum that can only be seen through a phone.
works.technique_zh: 定制的 ARKit/Unity 应用把带动画的生成式网格锚定在检测到的地面平面上，使其看起来像是立在真实展厅里的雕塑。
works.exercise_en: Curate an "invisible exhibition" in a school hallway where each classmate uses Reality Composer to place a work visible only through a phone. Twist: the works appear only during certain times of day.

works.title: Ivy: Spatially Situated Visual Programming
works.description: In VR/AR, users see the sensors and actuators of a smart environment where they physically are and wire them together with visual-programming links in space.
works.idea_zh: 在真实房间里用连线把灯、传感器“编程”起来。

video.video_title: Ivy: Exploring Spatially Situated Visual Programming for ... Intelligent Environments

works.technique: Anchors node-graph widgets to each device's physical location and lets users draw dataflow connections between them in 3D.
works.exercise_zh: 给教室里的灯、门、窗贴二维码，用手机AR显示它们的“节点”，学生画线组合“门开→灯亮”的规则（可用Home自动化模拟）；变化：规则由两人合作一个画输入一个画输出。
works.description_zh: 在 VR/AR 中，用户能在智能环境中各个传感器和执行器的实际所在位置看到它们，并在空间中用可视化编程连线把它们连接起来。
works.idea_en: Program the lights and sensors in a real room by drawing wires between them.
works.technique_zh: 把节点图控件锚定在每台设备的实际物理位置上，让用户在 3D 空间中于设备之间绘制数据流连接。
works.exercise_en: Put QR codes on the classroom's lights, door and windows, show their "nodes" in phone AR, and have students draw lines to compose rules like "door opens, light turns on" (a home-automation simulator works). Twist: two people build a rule together, one drawing the input and the other drawing the output.

works.title: JackIn Space
works.description: A remote helper in VR can jump into a worker's first-person view and then smoothly fly out into a live 3D reconstruction of the room to look around on their own.
works.description_zh: 远程协助者戴上 VR 头显，可以“跳进”现场工作人员的第一人称视角，再平滑地飞出来，在实时重建的 3D 房间里自由查看。
works.idea_en: Blend first-person and third-person telepresence in one continuous camera move.
works.idea_zh: 把第一人称和第三人称的远程临场用一个连续的镜头运动融合起来。
works.technique: Several depth cameras reconstruct the room as a live point cloud, and the worker's head camera is placed inside it so the remote viewer can transition between the two views.
works.technique_zh: 多台深度摄像头把房间实时重建为点云，现场人员的头戴摄像头画面被放置在点云中，远程观看者可以在两种视角之间过渡。
works.exercise_en: Record a 360 video walking through a room plus a phone photogrammetry scan of the same room, and build a viewer that crossfades between the walker's view and a free-flying view. Twist: add a 'rubber band' that pulls the viewer back to the walker after five seconds.
works.exercise_zh: 拍一段在房间里行走的 360 视频，再用手机摄影测量扫描同一个房间，做一个可以在“行走者视角”和“自由飞行视角”之间交叉淡化的查看器；变体：加一根“橡皮筋”，五秒后把观看者拉回行走者身边。

video.video_title: JackIn Space AH2017

works.title: Jeff Koons x Snapchat
works.description: Geolocated AR versions of Jeff Koons sculptures such as Balloon Dog appeared at sites like Central Park and the Champ de Mars, visible only through a Snapchat lens at those places.
works.idea_zh: 把杰夫·昆斯的雕塑以AR形式'安放'在全球著名地点。

video.video_title: Jeff Koons x Snapchat

works.technique: Geofenced lenses become available only near specific coordinates, and the sculpture is placed with ground tracking at a fixed site.
works.exercise_zh: 为校园中的某个地点设计一件只在那里可见的 AR 雕塑，用 GPS 限制出现范围；变体：让同学在雕塑旁留下 AR 涂鸦，思考公共空间的归属问题。
works.description_zh: Jeff Koons 的《Balloon Dog》等雕塑以基于地理位置的 AR 形式出现在中央公园、战神广场等地，只有在这些地点通过 Snapchat 滤镜才能看到。
works.idea_en: Jeff Koons sculptures installed in AR at famous places around the world.
works.technique_zh: 地理围栏滤镜只在特定坐标附近开放，雕塑借助地面追踪放置在固定地点。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR sculpture for a spot on campus that is visible only there, using GPS to limit where it appears. Twist: let classmates leave AR graffiti next to the sculpture, and discuss who owns public space.

works.title: Jenny Holzer at Blenheim Palace
works.description: For the Blenheim Art Foundation, Holzer's texts about power, war and its aftermath — including words of veterans gathered with the Not Forgotten Association — appear as giant walls of projected light on Blenheim Palace, and in stone and LED works inside. Documented by NOWNESS.
works.description_zh: 应布伦海姆艺术基金会之邀，Holzer 关于权力、战争及其后果的文字——包括与 Not Forgotten 协会合作收集的退伍军人的话——以巨大的光墙形式投在布伦海姆宫上，宫内还有石刻和 LED 作品。视频由 NOWNESS 拍摄。
works.idea_en: Placing personal testimony on a monument of power creates a strong contrast; AR can layer many small human voices over an official place.
works.idea_zh: 把个人证词放在权力的纪念碑上，会形成强烈的反差；AR 可以把许多微小的人声叠加在一个“官方”的地方。
works.technique: Xenon or large-format projectors cast scrolling texts across the palace facade at night, complemented by LED signs indoors.
works.technique_zh: 夜间用氙灯或大画幅投影机把滚动文字投在宫殿立面上，室内另有 LED 字幕屏。
works.exercise_en: Collect short spoken statements from classmates about a place, transcribe them, and pin them as AR text to that place's facade with Lens Studio. Twist: the texts are only readable when two people stand together in front of it.
works.exercise_zh: 收集同学关于某个地方的简短口述，整理成文字，用 Lens Studio 钉在那里的立面上；变体：只有两个人一起站在前面时文字才看得清。

video.video_title: Private View: Jenny Holzer at Blenheim Palace

works.title: Journey to the Center of the Natural Machine
works.description: An AR piece at the Sundance Film Festival's New Frontier: two visitors sit face to face wearing Meta 2 headsets and watch a holographic human brain grow and evolve on the table between them, reaching out together to touch it.
works.description_zh: 在圣丹斯电影节 New Frontier 单元展出的 AR 作品：两位观众戴着 Meta 2 头显面对面坐着，看一颗全息人脑在两人之间的桌上生长、演化，并一起伸手去触碰它。
works.idea_en: Two people share one hologram face to face across a table, instead of each disappearing into their own world.
works.idea_zh: 两个人隔着桌子面对面共享同一个全息影像，而不是各自消失在自己的世界里。
works.technique: Two Meta 2 headsets run a synchronised scene anchored to a physical table, with hand interaction so both visitors can touch the same virtual brain.
works.technique_zh: 两台 Meta 2 头显运行锚定在一张真实桌子上的同步场景，配合手部交互，让两位观众能触碰同一颗虚拟大脑。
works.exercise_en: Make a two-phone shared AR scene anchored to a table (image marker or an ARKit collaborative session) where a virtual object only grows while both players touch it. Twist: each player sees a different stage of the object's evolution.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个锚定在桌面上的双手机共享 AR 场景（图像标记或 ARKit 协作会话），虚拟物体只有在两位玩家同时触碰时才会生长。变体：每位玩家看到的是物体演化的不同阶段。

video.video_title: At the 2017 Sundance Film Festival: Simultaneous Collaboration with Augmented Reality

works.title: Kacho-fugetsu
works.description: Seasonal Japanese motifs of flowers, birds, wind and moon are projected onto a moving face using real-time tracking.
works.idea_zh: 花鸟风月四季意象投映在活动的人脸上

video.video_title: 花鳥風月 [kacho-fugetsu] / real-time face tracking and projection mapping

works.technique: Likely the same face-tracked projection pipeline: tracked head pose drives a UV-mapped face model whose texture cycles through seasonal motifs, projected from a calibrated projector.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 Lens Studio 或 AR 人脸追踪做四个季节的面部贴图，并在转头时切换季节；变体：把四季换成自己城市的四种典型天气或声音。
works.description_zh: 借助实时追踪，把花、鸟、风、月等日本四季意象投射到一张正在活动的脸上。
works.idea_en: Seasonal motifs of flowers, birds, wind and moon are projected onto a moving face.
works.technique_zh: 可能沿用同一套面部追踪投影流程：追踪到的头部位姿驱动一个经过 UV 映射的面部模型，其纹理在四季图案间循环切换，再由已标定的投影仪投射出来。
works.exercise_en: Make face textures for the four seasons with Lens Studio or phone AR face tracking, and switch seasons when the head turns. Twist: replace the four seasons with four typical kinds of weather or sounds from your own city.

works.title: Kill the Lights
works.description: Glowing skeletons drawn in light dance, ride and wander through night landscapes in a stop-motion film built from long-exposure photographs.
works.description_zh: 用光画出的发光骷髅在夜晚的风景里跳舞、骑行、漫步，这部定格动画由长曝光照片组成。
works.idea_en: A character drawn only as outlines can live convincingly in a real landscape; AR characters do not need full shading to feel present.
works.idea_zh: 只用轮廓线画出的角色也能可信地活在真实风景里；AR 角色不必有完整的明暗也能让人感到它在场。
works.technique: Each frame is one long exposure in which the artist redraws the skeleton with handheld lights in a slightly new pose.
works.technique_zh: 每一帧都是一次长曝光，艺术家用手持光源把骷髅以略微不同的姿态重新画一遍。
works.exercise_en: Draw a wireframe skeleton in an AR drawing tool, rig it with a phone body-tracking skeleton so it copies a friend's dance, and anchor it outdoors at night. Twist: leave a faint trail of past poses behind each bone.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 绘画工具里画一副线框骷髅，用手机人体追踪骨架驱动它模仿同伴的舞蹈，并在夜晚的户外锚定；变体：让每根骨头身后留下淡淡的过往姿态轨迹。

video.video_title: Kill the Lights - Light Painting Stop Motion Animation

works.title: LASP audio-reactive particles
works.description: A particle system bursts and swells in tight sync with live audio input, demonstrating a low-latency audio plugin for Unity.
works.description_zh: 一个粒子系统随着实时音频输入迸发、膨胀，几乎没有延迟，演示了一个 Unity 的低延迟音频插件。
works.idea_en: Make visuals react to sound with no perceptible delay.
works.idea_zh: 让画面对声音的反应快到察觉不到延迟。
works.technique: LASP is a native plugin that captures audio input with minimal buffering and runs a three-band filter bank, and the band levels drive particle emission and size in real time.
works.technique_zh: LASP 是一个原生插件，以极小的缓冲采集音频输入并运行三段滤波器组，各频段电平实时驱动粒子的发射量和大小。
works.exercise_en: Use microphone levels split into low, mid and high bands to drive three VFX Graph emitters placed around a speaker in AR. Twist: measure the delay with a clap and try to make it shorter.
works.exercise_zh: 把麦克风电平分成低、中、高三段，驱动 AR 中放在音箱周围的三个 VFX Graph 发射器；变体：用拍手测量延迟，并想办法把它缩短。

works.title: Laser Cat AR
works.description: A minimalist AR game whose only goal is to entertain a virtual kitten on your floor with a laser pointer.
works.idea_zh: 唯一玩法是用激光笔逗一只虚拟小猫。

video.video_title: Laser Cat AR

works.technique: A raycast from the screen center onto the detected floor plane gives the laser dot position, and the cat's navigation logic steers toward that point.
works.exercise_zh: 从屏幕中心向地面平面射线得到一个红点，让一只虚拟小猫（或简单胶囊体）追着红点跑；变体：让宠物害怕手机靠近而逃跑。
works.description_zh: 一款极简 AR 游戏，唯一的目标就是用激光笔逗地板上的一只虚拟小猫玩。
works.idea_en: The only thing to do is tease a virtual kitten with a laser pointer.
works.technique_zh: 从屏幕中心向检测到的地面平面发射射线得到激光点位置，小猫的导航逻辑引导它朝该点移动。
works.exercise_en: Cast a ray from the screen center to the floor plane to get a red dot, and make a virtual kitten (or a simple capsule) chase it. Twist: make the pet afraid of the phone and run away when it comes close.

salient.why_en: The whole game is one gesture: tease a virtual kitten on your floor with a laser dot.
salient.why_zh: 整个游戏只有一件事：用激光点逗地板上的虚拟小猫。

works.title: Law of the Journey
works.description: A 60-metre black inflatable boat crowded with 258 faceless rubber refugee figures fills a hall, shown at the National Gallery in Prague and the 21st Biennale of Sydney.
works.description_zh: 一艘长 60 米、挤满 258 个无脸橡胶难民人偶的黑色充气船填满整个展厅，曾在布拉格国家美术馆和第 21 届悉尼双年展展出。
works.idea_en: Scaling up a news image until you must walk along it turns a picture into a body experience, what AR can do with a photograph.
works.idea_zh: 把新闻图像放大到你必须沿着它行走的程度，就把一张图片变成了身体经验，这正是 AR 可以对照片做的事。
works.technique: The boat and figures were made from the same black rubber used for refugee dinghies, fabricated in China.
works.technique_zh: 船与人偶使用与难民橡皮艇相同的黑色橡胶，在中国制作。
works.exercise_en: Take a news photo of a crowd and rebuild it as a 1:1 AR scene of simple figures that users can walk along. Twist: every figure has a short, real testimony that plays when approached.
works.exercise_zh: 选取一张人群的新闻照片，把它重建为 1:1 的 AR 场景，用简单人形表示，用户可以沿着它行走；变体：每个人形都附带一段真实证词，靠近时播放。

video.video_title: 21st Biennale of Sydney: Ai Weiwei

works.title: Leaning into the Wind
works.description: The second film by Thomas Riedelsheimer shows Goldsworthy using his own body: walking through a hedge, lying on the ground as rain starts so a dry 'rain shadow' remains, and throwing leaves.
works.description_zh: Thomas Riedelsheimer 的第二部影片展示 Goldsworthy 用身体创作：穿过一道树篱，在雨开始落下时躺在地上留下干燥的“雨影”，以及抛撒树叶。
works.idea_en: A body-shaped dry patch on wet ground is a trace of presence that disappears in minutes, a direct idea for AR silhouettes left by users.
works.idea_zh: 湿地上人形的干燥痕迹是几分钟内便会消失的“在场”痕迹，直接启发了由用户留下的 AR 剪影。
works.technique: The rain shadows are made by lying still on dry ground at the start of a shower and standing up once the ground around is wet.
works.technique_zh: “雨影”的做法是在阵雨开始时静躺在干燥地面上，等周围地面湿透后再站起来。
works.exercise_en: Use body segmentation (Lens Studio or MediaPipe) to capture a user's silhouette and leave it as a fading shadow decal on the ground in AR. Twist: shadows fade faster when many people walk over the same spot.
works.exercise_zh: 用人体分割（Lens Studio 或 MediaPipe）捕捉用户剪影，在 AR 中把它作为逐渐淡去的影子贴花留在地面上；变体：多人踩过同一位置时影子消退得更快。

video.video_title: Leaning Into The Wind - Official Trailer

works.title: Learning to See
works.description: A camera watches a table of everyday objects - cloth, cables, keys - and neural networks trained on waves, fire, clouds, flowers or Hubble images re-render the scene live as visitors rearrange it with their hands.
works.idea_zh: 手摆弄桌上的布和电线，AI实时把它们“看成”海浪、火焰或星云。

video.video_title: Learning to see: Gloomy Sunday (2017)

works.technique: An image-to-image network (pix2pix-style GAN) trained on a single domain such as waves or flowers takes the live camera image, edge-processed, as input and outputs a re-rendered frame in real time.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Runway 或预训练的 pix2pix/风格迁移模型，把摄像头拍到的桌面杂物实时渲染成云、火或海浪；变体：自己拍 100 张校园某处的照片训练一个小模型，让杂物“看见”那个地方。
works.description_zh: 一台相机注视着摆满日常物品的桌面——布料、电线、钥匙——用海浪、火焰、云、花或哈勃图像训练的神经网络实时重新渲染画面，观众用手重新摆放物品，画面也随之变化。
works.idea_en: As hands move cloth and cables on a table, AI sees them live as waves, fire or nebulae.
works.technique_zh: 在单一领域（如海浪或花朵）上训练的图像到图像网络（pix2pix 类 GAN）以经过边缘处理的实时相机画面作为输入，实时输出重新渲染的画面。
works.exercise_en: Use Runway or a pretrained pix2pix or style-transfer model to render the clutter on a desk seen by the camera as clouds, fire or waves in real time. Twist: take 100 photos of one place on campus to train a small model so the clutter "sees" that place.

salient.why_en: A neural network sees cloth and cables on a table as waves or fire, showing that a machine sees only what it was trained on.
salient.why_zh: 神经网络把桌上的布和线看成海浪或火焰，说明机器只能看见它学过的东西。

works.title: Light Capsules x Neon Museum
works.description: At the Neon Museum boneyard in Las Vegas, broken vintage neon signs that no longer work are made to 'light up' again with carefully mapped projection that imitates glowing tubes.
works.description_zh: 在拉斯维加斯霓虹博物馆的“霓虹墓地”里，早已损坏、无法点亮的老霓虹招牌，借助精准映射的投影模拟灯管光芒，再次“亮”了起来。
works.idea_en: Fake the light of a dead object so that it looks alive again.
works.idea_zh: 伪造一件“死去”物体的光，让它看起来重新活过来。
works.technique: Projection content is drawn to follow each tube path of the neon letters, with glow and flicker animated to mimic real neon.
works.technique_zh: 投影内容沿每根霓虹灯管的路径绘制，并加入光晕和闪烁动画来模仿真实霓虹。
works.exercise_en: Bend a word out of white wire or string on a board, then project a glowing, flickering neon animation precisely onto it. Twist: make one letter 'broken' and flicker on a random schedule.
works.exercise_zh: 用白色铁丝或绳子在板子上弯出一个单词，再把发光、闪烁的霓虹动画精准投到上面；变体：让其中一个字母“坏掉”，随机闪烁。

video.video_title: Light Capsules x Neon Museum

salient.why_en: Projection fakes the glow of broken neon signs so they seem lit again.
salient.why_zh: 投影模仿出光芒，让坏掉的霓虹招牌看起来重新亮起。

works.title: Light Harp (Shambala Festival)
works.description: At Shambala Festival in England, a row of glowing, vibrating strings stands in the night like a giant harp of light, their coloured wave shapes shifting in front of the festival crowd.
works.description_zh: 在英国 Shambala 音乐节的夜里，一排发光、振动的弦像一架巨大的光之竖琴立着，彩色的波形在人群面前不断变化。
works.idea_en: Turning an instrument into light makes sound visible; AR music tools can show vibration as form instead of as a flat visualiser.
works.idea_zh: 把乐器变成光，让声音变得可见；AR 音乐工具可以把振动显示为立体形态，而不是平面的可视化波形。
works.technique: Several strings are driven into motion and lit by synchronised coloured strobes so each string appears as a standing wave of light (link to live sound likely).
works.technique_zh: 多根弦被驱动运动，并被同步的彩色频闪光照亮，使每根弦显现为一道驻波光形（推测与现场声音相连）。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR 'light harp' in Unity AR Foundation or WebXR: five virtual strings in the room that vibrate as glowing waves and play notes when a hand passes through. Twist: two phones share the harp so two people can play together.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity AR Foundation 或 WebXR 里做一架 AR“光之竖琴”：房间里五根虚拟的弦，手穿过时会以发光的波形振动并发出音符；变体：两部手机共享同一架琴，两个人可以合奏。

video.video_title: Light Harp at Shambala Festival 2017

works.title: Light Sketch — El Cosmico
works.description: With no generator for the planned piece, the team spontaneously projection-maps their silver Airstream trailer in the Marfa desert, turning it into a glowing, pulsing object under the stars.
works.description_zh: 原计划的作品因为没有发电机而无法进行，团队便在马法沙漠里即兴给他们的银色 Airstream 房车做投影映射，让它在星空下发光、脉动。
works.idea_en: When the plan fails, map whatever you have with you.
works.idea_zh: 计划落空时，就给身边现有的东西做投影。
works.technique: A quick on-site mapping uses masks traced directly over the trailer's panels and rivet lines, running simple generative animation.
works.technique_zh: 现场快速映射，直接沿房车的板块和铆钉线描出遮罩，播放简单的生成式动画。
works.exercise_en: Give teams 45 minutes to map any object they carried to class (a bag, a bike, a helmet) and present it in a dark corner. Twist: the animation must reveal what the object 'dreams about'.
works.exercise_zh: 给每组 45 分钟，为自己带到课堂的任何物品（书包、自行车、头盔）做投影映射，并在暗角展示；变体：动画必须揭示这件物品“梦见了什么”。

video.video_title: Light Sketch — El Cosmico

works.title: Liquid Marker Matrix Style
works.description: The camera image around a marker ripples like liquid, 'liquifying reality' in the style of The Matrix.
works.idea_zh: 让标记周围的现实画面像液体一样波动。

video.video_title: Liquid Marker Matrix Style

works.technique: The video texture around the marker is remapped in a fragment shader with time-varying sinusoidal UV offsets centered on the marker pose, producing a ripple distortion.
works.exercise_zh: 在 three.js 中用着色器对摄像头画面做以标记为圆心的正弦波纹扭曲；变体：用手指点击屏幕位置投下新的“水滴”。
works.description_zh: 标记周围的相机画面像液体一样泛起涟漪，以《黑客帝国》的风格“液化现实”。
works.idea_en: The camera image around a marker ripples like liquid.
works.technique_zh: 在片元着色器中，以标记位姿为中心，用随时间变化的正弦 UV 偏移重新映射标记周围的视频纹理，产生波纹扭曲效果。
works.exercise_en: Use a shader in three.js to apply a sine-wave ripple distortion to the camera image, centered on the marker. Twist: tap the screen to drop a new "water drop" at that spot.

works.title: Magic Bench
works.description: Sit on a bench and see yourself in a big mirror-like screen next to a CG elephant or character who reacts to you, with haptic rumble in the bench, no glasses needed.
works.idea_zh: 坐上长椅，屏幕里的小象就坐到你身边，长椅还会跟着震动。

video.video_title: Magic Bench

works.technique: A depth camera reconstructs the bench area so a CG character can be composited into the mirror-view video with correct depth ordering and occlusion, while actuators in the bench deliver synchronized haptic effects.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Unity 或 Lens Studio 做一个“魔法镜子”：摄像头画面左右翻转显示在大屏上，用人体分割让虚拟角色站在人身后或身前（按深度遮挡），并用椅子下的手机震动配合角色动作；变体：角色对坐下的人做出不同反应。
works.description_zh: 坐到长椅上，就能在一块像镜子一样的大屏幕里看到自己身边坐着一头 CG 大象或其他角色，它会对你做出反应，长椅还会随之震动，全程无需佩戴眼镜。
works.idea_en: Sit on the bench and a baby elephant on the screen sits down beside you, while the bench rumbles along.
works.technique_zh: 深度相机重建长椅区域，使 CG 角色能以正确的深度顺序和遮挡关系合成到镜像视频中，长椅内的执行器同步提供触觉效果。
works.exercise_en: Make a "magic mirror" in Unity or Lens Studio: flip the camera image horizontally on a large screen, use body segmentation so a virtual character stands behind or in front of people by depth, and sync a phone vibrating under the chair with the character's actions. Twist: have the character react differently to each person who sits down.

works.title: Magic Floating iPhone
works.description: A real iPhone on the table is swapped for a virtual copy that lifts off and levitates, with particles in a second take.
works.idea_zh: 把桌上的真手机替换成虚拟副本，让它悬浮起来。

video.video_title: Magic Floating iPhone ( or ARKit )

works.technique: A virtual iPhone model is placed exactly over the real one, while the real object is hidden by a background patch (likely a captured texture of the table), so the copy appears to lift off.
works.exercise_zh: 拍下桌面空白处的照片作为贴图盖住一个真实小物件，再在同位置放它的 3D 模型让它缓缓升起；变体：让物体升起后在空中变形或碎裂。
works.description_zh: 桌上的一部真实 iPhone 被替换成虚拟副本，随即离开桌面悬浮起来；在第二段镜头中还加上了粒子效果。
works.idea_en: Swap the real phone on the table for a virtual copy and make it levitate.
works.technique_zh: 把一个虚拟 iPhone 模型精确放在真机上方，同时用一块背景贴片（大概率是采集到的桌面纹理）遮住真实物体，使副本看起来像是自己升了起来。
works.exercise_en: Photograph an empty part of the table and use it as a texture to cover a small real object, then place its 3D model in the same spot and let it slowly rise. Twist: make the object morph or shatter once it is in the air.

works.title: Magic Sudoku
works.description: Point the phone at a printed Sudoku and the solution appears written into the empty squares on the paper, using Vision, CoreML and ARKit.
works.idea_zh: 对准纸上的数独，答案直接“写”进空格里。

video.video_title: Just submitted our 1st #madewitharkit app for iOS11! @magicsudokuapp solves Sudokus using #CoreML, #Vision & #ARKit. https://t.co/UxFpA4fMHT https://t.co/PFeXfHdwmQ

works.technique: Vision detects the Sudoku grid rectangle, a CoreML digit classifier reads the cells, a solver fills in the answers, and the digits are rendered on the paper's plane via ARKit.
works.exercise_zh: 用 OCR（Tesseract.js）识别纸上的一道算术题，在答案位置用 AR 显示结果；变体：不直接给答案，而是给出一步提示。
works.description_zh: 把手机对准一张印刷的数独，答案就会写进纸上的空格里；作品使用了 Vision、CoreML 和 ARKit。
works.idea_en: Point at a Sudoku on paper and the answers are written right into the empty squares.
works.technique_zh: Vision 检测数独网格的矩形区域，CoreML 数字分类器读取各个格子，求解器算出答案，再借助 ARKit 把数字渲染在纸张所在的平面上。
works.exercise_en: Recognize an arithmetic problem on paper with OCR (Tesseract.js) and show the result at the answer position in AR. Twist: instead of giving the answer, give a one-step hint.

salient.why_en: Point at a paper Sudoku and the answers appear written in its empty squares.
salient.why_zh: 对准纸上的数独，答案直接写进空格里。

works.title: MakerStudio: sculpting and painting in ARKit
works.description: With an Apple Pencil on an iPad, he sculpts and paints a Halloween creature that stands in the room, using ARKit to walk around and refine it.
works.idea_zh: 用 Apple Pencil 在 iPad 上雕塑、上色，作品直接立在房间里。

video.video_title: MakerStudio ARKit

works.technique: Pencil strokes deform and paint a mesh while ARKit tracking lets the artist view and edit the sculpture from any angle in real space.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Reality Composer/Adobe Aero 把自己捏的黏土扫描模型放进 AR 并在手机上上色；加一个变化：同学围着模型各自加一笔。
works.description_zh: 他在 iPad 上用 Apple Pencil 雕塑并上色，做出一只立在房间里的万圣节怪物，借助 ARKit 可以绕着它走动并不断修改。
works.idea_en: Sculpt and paint with an Apple Pencil on an iPad, and the piece stands right in your room.
works.technique_zh: Pencil 笔触用于变形网格并为其上色，ARKit 追踪让创作者能在真实空间中从任意角度查看和编辑雕塑。
works.exercise_en: Put a scanned model of your own clay sculpture into AR with Reality Composer or Adobe Aero and paint it on your phone. Twist: classmates gather around the model and each add one stroke.

works.title: Makeup Lamps
works.description: Amit Bermano and colleagues project dynamic makeup onto a performer's moving face in real time with a high-speed projector-camera setup.
works.idea_zh: 用高速投影把动态妆容实时'画'在表演者移动的脸上。

video.video_title: Makeup Lamps: Live Augmentation of Human Faces via Projection

works.technique: A high-speed camera tracks facial landmarks and a low-latency projector, co-axially calibrated with it, renders makeup onto the face with latency short enough that the projection stays locked during motion.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 追踪一位同学的脸，把彩绘纹样投影到其面部（或在 Lens Studio 中做成滤镜），并测量头部快速转动时的错位程度；变体：让妆容随说话、表情或音乐节奏变化。
works.description_zh: Amit Bermano 与同事借助高速投影仪—相机系统，把动态妆容实时投射到表演者运动中的脸上。
works.idea_en: High-speed projection paints moving makeup onto a performer's face in real time.
works.technique_zh: 高速相机追踪面部特征点，与之同轴标定的低延迟投影仪把妆容渲染到脸上，延迟短到在运动中投影也能始终贴合。
works.exercise_en: Track a classmate's face with MediaPipe Face Mesh, project painted patterns onto it (or make it a filter in Lens Studio), and measure how far it drifts when the head turns quickly. Twist: make the makeup change with speech, facial expressions or musical rhythm.

works.title: Meadow
works.description: Large silk flowers hang upside down from the ceiling and slowly open and close in waves, like a field of blossoms reacting to the day.
works.description_zh: 巨大的丝绸花朵倒挂在天花板上，一波波缓慢地开放、闭合，像一片对白天作出反应的花田。
works.idea_en: Flipping a natural scene upside down and putting it overhead gives visitors a new relation to it; AR scenes can be placed on ceilings, not just floors.
works.idea_zh: 把自然场景倒过来挂到头顶，给观众一种全新的关系；AR 场景也可以放在天花板上，而不只是地面上。
works.technique: Motorised mechanisms raise, lower and open each silk flower in coordinated sequences driven by software.
works.technique_zh: 电机机构按软件驱动的协调序列升降、开合每一朵丝绸花。
works.exercise_en: Detect the ceiling plane and grow an upside-down AR meadow on it whose flowers open in a wave that follows the viewer across the room. Twist: open only the flowers directly above people who are lying on the floor.
works.exercise_zh: 检测天花板平面，在上面长出一片倒挂的 AR 花田，让花朵随着观众在房间里的移动一波波开放。变体：只让躺在地上的人正上方的花开放。

video.video_title: MEADOW | by DRIFT

works.title: Measure It with AR.js
works.description: Measures the distance between two AR markers in the browser and draws it as a live ruler.
works.idea_zh: 在浏览器里实时测量两个 AR 标记的距离。

video.video_title: Measure It with AR js

works.technique: Two tracked markers each give a pose in camera space, and the distance between their origins is drawn as a line with a live numeric label.
works.exercise_zh: 用两个标记测量桌上两物体的距离并实时显示数字；变体：距离达到某个值时播放提示音，做成“保持社交距离”游戏。
works.description_zh: 在浏览器中测量两个 AR 标记之间的距离，并将其绘制成一把实时刻度尺。
works.idea_en: Measure the distance between two AR markers live in the browser.
works.technique_zh: 两个被追踪的标记各自给出在相机空间中的位姿，二者原点之间的距离被画成一条线，并附带实时更新的数值标注。
works.exercise_en: Use two markers to measure the distance between two objects on a table and show the number live. Twist: play an alert sound when the distance reaches a set value, turning it into a "keep your social distance" game.

works.title: Medusa (Tilt Brush mixed reality)
works.description: Filmed in mixed reality, the artist spends two hours painting a life-size Medusa with living snake hair, and the camera circles the sculpture-like painting as she works inside it.
works.description_zh: 在混合现实拍摄中，艺术家花两小时画出一座真人大小、头发是活蛇的美杜莎，摄像机环绕这幅像雕塑一样的画作，她则在画中工作。
works.idea_en: Painting becomes sculpture when every brushstroke hangs in space.
works.idea_zh: 当每一笔都悬挂在空间中，绘画就变成了雕塑。
works.technique: Tilt Brush strokes are recorded in VR and composited with green-screen footage of the painter from a tracked camera.
works.technique_zh: 在 VR 中记录 Tilt Brush 笔触，并与被追踪摄像机拍摄的画家绿幕画面合成。
works.exercise_en: Paint a life-size figure in 3D in 30 minutes, then record a slow orbit around it that reveals something not visible from the front. Twist: paint only with light-emitting brushes in a dark scene.
works.exercise_zh: 用 30 分钟在三维空间中画一个真人大小的人物，再录制一段缓慢环绕的镜头，揭示正面看不到的东西；变体：在黑暗场景中只使用发光笔刷作画。

video.video_title: Tilt Brush mixed reality: Medusa

works.title: Memorial Rebirth
works.description: Dozens of machines release a flood of soap bubbles over a neighbourhood street or park, turning an ordinary place into a shared, fleeting celebration.
works.description_zh: 数十台机器向街区道路或公园放出如潮的肥皂泡，把平凡的地方变成一场共享而短暂的庆典。
works.idea_en: Something that fills the air and vanishes brings strangers together — ephemeral, city-scale AR events can do the same.
works.idea_zh: 充满空气又转瞬消失的东西能把陌生人聚到一起——短暂的城市尺度 AR 活动也能做到这一点。
works.technique: Arrays of bubble machines are placed around a site and run in sequence so that waves of bubbles drift with the wind across the crowd.
works.technique_zh: 成组的泡泡机布置在场地四周并依次运行，让一波波泡泡随风飘过人群。
works.exercise_en: Launch a shared AR bubble storm in a park where every participant's phone releases bubbles that everyone else can see and pop. Twist: popped bubbles leave a short sound so the park 'rings'.
works.exercise_zh: 在公园里发起一场共享 AR 泡泡风暴，每位参与者的手机都会放出所有人都能看见、戳破的泡泡。变体：泡泡破裂时发出短促声响，让整个公园“叮当”作响。

video.video_title: 大巻伸嗣「Memorial Rebirth 千住 2017 関屋」/Shinji Ohmaki “Memorial Rebirth Senju 2017 Sekiya”(Short version)

works.title: Merge Cube
works.description: A patterned foam cube that a phone camera tracks, so a hologram such as a planet, skull or artefact appears in the user's hand and can be turned and examined.
works.idea_zh: 一个泡沫方块，让孩子把全息物体真正'拿'在手里。

video.video_title: Meet the Merge Cube

works.technique: The cube's six unique patterns form a single tracked object target, giving full 6DoF pose so a hologram can be held and turned in the hand.
works.exercise_zh: 打印并折一个带图案的纸立方体，用 Vuforia 或 8th Wall 追踪它，在手中显示一颗可旋转的行星；变体：把两块立方体靠近时触发化学反应。
works.description_zh: 一个带图案的泡沫方块，手机相机可以追踪它，让行星、头骨或文物等全息影像出现在用户手中，可以转动和仔细端详。
works.idea_en: A foam cube that lets kids really hold a hologram in their hands.
works.technique_zh: 方块六个面上各不相同的图案共同组成一个被追踪的物体目标，提供完整的 6DoF 位姿，使全息影像可以握在手中转动。
works.exercise_en: Print and fold a patterned paper cube, track it with Vuforia or 8th Wall, and show a rotatable planet in your hand. Twist: bring two cubes close together to trigger a chemical reaction.

works.title: Metallica WorldWired Tour indoor drone swarm
works.description: During Metallica's WorldWired Tour, a swarm of small glowing drones hovers and dances above the arena stage, forming moving constellations over the band.
works.description_zh: 在 Metallica 的 WorldWired 巡演中，一群发光的小无人机在体育馆舞台上方悬停起舞，在乐队头顶组成不断变化的星座。
works.idea_en: Points of light above an audience create a shared focus without screens; AR concerts can place a few floating lights overhead instead of a flat virtual display.
works.idea_zh: 观众头顶的光点无需屏幕就能形成共同的焦点；AR 演出可以在头顶放几个漂浮的光点，而不是一块平面的虚拟屏幕。
works.technique: Verity's indoor drones use a local positioning system instead of GPS, flying autonomous, redundant formations timed to the show's cues.
works.technique_zh: Verity 的室内无人机不用 GPS，而是依靠本地定位系统，按演出提示自主地飞出带冗余的编队。
works.exercise_en: Stage a short AR concert moment: 20 glowing orbs gather above a performer's head during the chorus and scatter on the drum hit, triggered by audio beat detection. Twist: sync the orbs across all phones in the room so everyone sees the same swarm.
works.exercise_zh: 上演一段 AR 演出片段：副歌时 20 个发光球聚集到表演者头顶，鼓点一响就四散，由音频节拍检测触发。变体：让房间里所有手机同步，每个人看到同一群光球。

video.video_title: Metallica WorldWired Tour (2017 - 2019)

works.title: Mimic
works.description: An industrial robot arm tracks the people around it and responds through gesture alone, building an impression of each person and becoming more trusting, curious or cautious with them.
works.description_zh: 一台工业机械臂追踪周围的人，只通过姿态做出回应，对每个人形成印象，并对他们变得更信任、更好奇或更谨慎。
works.idea_en: A machine that forms a different relationship with each person shows how behaviour and memory, not visuals, make a character feel alive — key for AR companions.
works.idea_zh: 一台与每个人建立不同关系的机器，说明让角色显得有生命的是行为和记忆，而不是画面——这是 AR 伙伴的关键。
works.technique: Depth sensors track visitors, and custom software models per-person states such as trust, interest and curiosity that drive the robot arm's motion style.
works.technique_zh: 深度传感器追踪访客，自定义软件为每个人建模信任、兴趣、好奇等状态，驱动机械臂的运动风格。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR creature on a table that tracks each person's phone position and keeps a trust score per person — approaching those who move slowly and hiding from fast movers. Twist: let it greet returning visitors differently.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌上做一个 AR 生物，追踪每个人的手机位置，并为每人保留一个信任分数——接近动作慢的人，躲开动作快的人。变体：让它用不同方式迎接回来的访客。

video.video_title: Mimic

works.title: Mirage
works.description: For Desert X near Palm Springs, a single-storey ranch house is covered inside and out with mirrors, so it reflects the desert and mountains and seems to vanish into them.
works.description_zh: 为棕榈泉附近的 Desert X 展，一座单层牧场式住宅内外都覆满镜面，映出沙漠和群山，仿佛消失在其中。
works.idea_en: A mirrored object is only its surroundings, reframed: a perfect physical reference for environment-reflective AR materials and 'invisible' objects.
works.idea_zh: 镜面物体只是被重新框取的环境：这是环境反射 AR 材质和“隐形”物体的完美实体参考。
works.technique: A timber frame house shape is clad with mirror panels on every surface, including the interior, so views multiply inside.
works.technique_zh: 木框架房屋的每个表面（包括室内）都覆以镜面板，使室内景象层层倍增。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR house with a real-time environment-probe mirror material (ARKit environment texturing) in an open landscape and see how it disappears. Twist: open its door into a mirrored interior that reflects the user infinitely.
works.exercise_zh: 在开阔风景中放置一座使用实时环境探针镜面材质（ARKit 环境纹理）的 AR 房屋，观察它如何消失；变体：打开门进入一个无限反射用户的镜面室内。

video.video_title: Doug Aitken - MIRAGE

salient.why_en: A house covered in mirrors disappears into the desert it reflects.
salient.why_zh: 一栋贴满镜子的房子，消失在它所映照的沙漠里。

works.title: Mirages & miracles
works.description: An exhibition of drawn stones, landscapes and figures that come alive through tablets and holographic displays, where tiny dancers climb and breathe inside real rocks.
works.idea_zh: 透过平板看，真实的石头和手绘图中住着会呼吸的小人
works.technique: Image-tracked AR on tablets and Pepper's-ghost holographic boxes overlay captured dancers onto physical stones and drawings.
works.exercise_zh: 给一块石头或一幅手绘图做图像识别AR（如Unity/8th Wall），让一段录好的小人舞蹈出现在上面；变化：用手机屏幕+透明片做佩珀尔幻象小盒子。

video.video_title: Mirages   Miracles

works.description_zh: 一场展览中，手绘的石头、风景和人物通过平板电脑和全息显示装置活了过来，小小的舞者在真实的岩石中攀爬、呼吸。
works.idea_en: Seen through a tablet, real stones and hand drawings are home to tiny breathing people.
works.technique_zh: 平板上基于图像追踪的 AR 与佩珀尔幻象全息盒把拍摄的舞者叠加到实体石头和绘画上。
works.exercise_en: Make image-recognition AR for a stone or a hand drawing (e.g., with Unity or 8th Wall) so a recorded dance of a tiny figure appears on it. Twist: build a small Pepper's ghost box from a phone screen and a transparent sheet.

works.title: Mixed Reality room (RnD tests)
works.description: An empty white room fills with projected 3D objects and spaces that look correct from a tracked camera's or visitor's point of view as they walk around.
works.description_zh: 一个空白房间里投满了三维物体和空间，随着被追踪的摄像机或观众走动，从他们的视角看画面始终透视正确。
works.idea_en: Head-tracked projection turns bare walls into windows onto virtual space without headsets.
works.idea_zh: 头部追踪投影把空墙变成通向虚拟空间的窗户，不需要头显。
works.technique: Vive trackers and THÉORIZ's Augmenta tracking feed the viewer position to a renderer that computes off-axis projections for each projector (fish-tank VR style).
works.technique_zh: Vive 追踪器和 THÉORIZ 的 Augmenta 系统把观看者位置传给渲染器，为每台投影仪计算离轴投影（类似 fish-tank VR）。
works.exercise_en: Project a 3D box into a room corner and use a phone's AR pose (or a webcam face tracker) to update an off-axis camera so the box looks solid from one moving viewpoint. Twist: add a second viewer and see how the illusion breaks.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个 3D 盒子投到房间墙角，用手机的 AR 位姿（或摄像头人脸追踪）更新离轴相机，让一个移动视点看到的盒子像实物；变体：加入第二位观看者，观察错觉如何失效。

video.video_title: Mixed Reality - THEORIZ - RnD test 002

works.title: Mobile Holoportation
works.description: A car-mounted version of Holoportation streams a passenger's live 3D capture over a mobile network into a remote HoloLens.
works.idea_zh: 在行驶的汽车里也能把人实时全息'传送'出去。

video.video_title: Mobile Holoportation

works.technique: Depth cameras in the car capture the passenger, and the mesh is compressed aggressively (low-resolution geometry plus video-coded textures) to fit an LTE uplink before reconstruction on the remote HoloLens.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机的前置深度摄像头（或 MediaPipe 深度估计）采集人像点云，通过 WebRTC 以极低带宽传给另一部手机在 AR 中显示，并测试降低点数和帧率时的可接受下限；变体：只传输骨架和声音，在接收端用卡通化身还原。
works.description_zh: 车载版的 Holoportation，把乘客的实时 3D 捕捉数据通过移动网络传输到远端的 HoloLens 上。
works.idea_en: A person is holographically "teleported" live even from inside a moving car.
works.technique_zh: 车内的深度相机采集乘客，网格经过大幅压缩（低分辨率几何加视频编码纹理）以适应 LTE 上行带宽，再在远端 HoloLens 上重建。
works.exercise_en: Capture a point cloud of a person with a phone's front depth camera (or MediaPipe depth estimation), send it at very low bandwidth over WebRTC to another phone for display in AR, and test the lowest acceptable point count and frame rate. Twist: send only the skeleton and voice, and rebuild the person as a cartoon avatar on the receiving end.

works.title: Mobile hand tracking + ARKit
works.description: An early demo on an iPhone 7 combines 2020CV's own hand tracker with ARKit so a bare hand can interact with AR content.
works.idea_zh: 2017 年就在 iPhone 7 上实现徒手与 AR 物体交互。

video.video_title: 2020CV mobile hand tracking + Apple's ARKit

works.technique: A custom neural hand detector runs on-device alongside ARKit tracking to map the hand position into the AR scene.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Teachable Machine 训练 3 种手势（张开/握拳/指），在网页 AR 里分别触发出现、抓取、发射；加一个变化：手势序列组成'咒语'。
works.description_zh: 一个在 iPhone 7 上运行的早期演示，把 2020CV 自研的手部追踪器与 ARKit 结合，让徒手就能与 AR 内容交互。
works.idea_en: Bare-hand interaction with AR objects on an iPhone 7, back in 2017.
works.technique_zh: 定制的神经网络手部检测器与 ARKit 追踪同时在设备端运行，把手的位置映射到 AR 场景中。
works.exercise_en: Train three gestures (open hand, fist, pointing) with Teachable Machine and use them in web AR to trigger appear, grab and launch. Twist: combine gesture sequences into "spells."

works.title: Model3AR (Tesla Model 3 in AR)
works.description: A life-size Tesla Model 3 parked in the real world through an iPhone 7: you walk around it, swipe to drive it, switch its lights on and change its paint colour.
works.description_zh: 透过 iPhone 7 把一辆 1:1 的特斯拉 Model 3 停在现实中：你可以绕车走动、滑动屏幕让它行驶、打开车灯、更换车漆颜色。
works.idea_en: See a product that does not exist in your city yet, at true scale, in your own street.
works.idea_zh: 在自家街道上按真实尺寸看一件你所在城市还买不到的产品。
works.technique: An ARKit world-tracking app anchors a detailed car model to the detected ground plane, with touch controls for motion, lights and material swaps.
works.technique_zh: 基于 ARKit 世界追踪的应用把精细的汽车模型锚定在识别出的地面上，并提供触摸控制来驾驶、开灯和切换材质。
works.exercise_en: Place a true-scale model of something large (a car, a whale, a sofa) outside and let users change one property by touch. Twist: add a tape-measure mode so people can check it fits a real space.
works.exercise_zh: 在室外放置一个真实尺寸的大物件模型（汽车、鲸鱼或沙发），让用户通过触摸修改一项属性；变体：加一个卷尺模式，让人检查它能否放进真实空间。

video.video_title: Tesla Model3 in AR - Apple ARKit

works.title: Moon Landing @ Living Room
works.description: A larger version of the moon-landing test fills the living room floor, with a real dog wandering past the out-of-scale astronauts.
works.idea_zh: 登月场景铺满客厅地板，真狗从宇航员身边走过。

video.video_title: Moon Landing @ Living Room

works.technique: The same ARKit floor anchor is used with a scaled-up scene so real objects and pets walk through the virtual set.
works.exercise_zh: 把同一个 AR 场景做三种尺寸（手掌、桌面、房间）对比观感；加一个变化：让场景随真实宠物/同学的位置让路。
works.description_zh: 登月测试的放大版铺满了客厅地板，一只真实的狗从比例失调的宇航员身边溜达而过。
works.idea_en: A moon landing covers the living room floor as a real dog walks past the astronauts.
works.technique_zh: 沿用同一个 ARKit 地面锚点，但把场景放大，让真实物体和宠物能从虚拟布景中穿过。
works.exercise_en: Make the same AR scene in three sizes (palm, tabletop, room) and compare how each feels. Twist: have the scene make way for the positions of real pets or classmates.

works.title: Moon Landing @ my Kitchen
works.description: The Apollo lunar module lands on his kitchen counter and astronauts step out, captured in real time with one of the first ARKit builds.
works.idea_zh: 阿波罗登月发生在厨房台面上。

video.video_title: Moon landing @ my kitchen.

works.technique: ARKit horizontal plane detection anchors an animated Unity scene to the countertop and keeps it stable as the phone moves.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个历史事件做成桌面大小的 AR 动画（Reality Composer 即可）放到课桌上；加一个变化：观众离近时出现解说字幕。
works.description_zh: 阿波罗登月舱降落在他家厨房的台面上，宇航员走出舱外；这段画面是用最早的一批 ARKit 版本实时录制的。
works.idea_en: The Apollo moon landing happens on a kitchen counter.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 水平平面检测把 Unity 制作的动画场景锚定在台面上，手机移动时场景依然保持稳定。
works.exercise_en: Turn a historical event into a tabletop-sized AR animation (Reality Composer is enough) and place it on a desk. Twist: show narration subtitles when a viewer comes close.

works.title: Mudança de Dança
works.description: A dance piece made for the pixel media facade of the FIESP building on São Paulo's Paulista Avenue, where a dancer's abstracted body moves across an entire skyscraper at FILE LED SHOW 2017.
works.description_zh: 为圣保罗保利斯塔大道 FIESP 大楼像素媒体立面创作的舞蹈作品：在 FILE LED SHOW 2017 上，舞者被抽象化的身体在整座摩天大楼上移动。
works.idea_en: Scale a dancer up to the size of a building.
works.idea_zh: 把舞者放大到一整栋楼那么大。
works.technique: Dance footage choreographed by Kai-Wen Yang was processed into a low-resolution, high-contrast animation suited to the facade's coarse LED grid.
works.technique_zh: Kai-Wen Yang 编舞的影像被处理成低分辨率、高对比的动画，适配立面粗糙的 LED 网格。
works.exercise_en: Downsample a dance clip to a 20×30 pixel grid and play it on a wall of paper windows lit from behind, or on a building photo in AR. Twist: let the dancer only move in the lit windows.
works.exercise_zh: 把舞蹈片段降采样到 20×30 像素网格，在背光纸窗墙上播放，或在 AR 中贴到楼房照片上；变体：让舞者只在亮着的窗户里移动。

video.video_title: 'Mudança de Dança' @ FILE 2017

works.title: Multiplayer Paintball in ARKit
works.description: Two iPhones share an ARKit scene and players shoot paintballs that splat on virtual targets and each other.
works.idea_zh: 两部手机共享同一个 AR 空间打彩弹。

video.video_title: Multiplayer Paintball in ARKit !

works.technique: Devices align their ARKit world origins (likely via a shared starting marker) and sync projectile events over the network.
works.exercise_zh: 用 8th Wall/Lens Studio 多人共享做一个彩弹涂墙游戏，颜料留在真实墙面上；加一个变化：一分钟后涂色面积大的一方获胜。
works.description_zh: 两部 iPhone 共享同一个 ARKit 场景，玩家发射彩弹，彩弹会溅射在虚拟靶子和对方身上。
works.idea_en: Two phones share one AR space for a paintball fight.
works.technique_zh: 各设备对齐各自的 ARKit 世界原点（大概率借助一个共同的起始标记），并通过网络同步弹丸事件。
works.exercise_en: Build a multiplayer paint-the-wall game with 8th Wall or Lens Studio shared sessions, where the paint stays on real walls. Twist: after one minute, the side that has painted the larger area wins.

works.title: MyLab – Holographic Chemistry App
works.description: A HoloLens chemistry education app in which students build and inspect atoms and molecules as holograms in the room.
works.idea_zh: 在 HoloLens 里用全息原子分子学化学。

video.video_title: I made a Futuristic, Holographic Chemistry App!

works.technique: Atoms and molecules are 3D models in world space on HoloLens, manipulated with gaze-and-air-tap or hand gestures, and bonding rules are computed in the app logic.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在桌上放几个原子小球，拖动靠近时按规则自动成键形成水分子；变体：换成你本专业的其他“拼装单元”，如音符或电路元件。
works.description_zh: 一款 HoloLens 化学教育应用，学生可以在房间里以全息影像的形式搭建和观察原子与分子。
works.idea_en: Learn chemistry with holographic atoms and molecules in HoloLens.
works.technique_zh: 原子和分子是 HoloLens 世界空间中的 3D 模型，可通过注视加空中点击或手势操作，成键规则由应用逻辑计算。
works.exercise_en: Place a few atom balls on a table with AR Foundation, and let them bond automatically by rule into a water molecule when dragged close together. Twist: swap in other "building units" from your own field, such as musical notes or circuit components.

works.title: New Spring (for COS)
works.description: A tall aluminium tree releases bubbles filled with white mist from its branches; visitors wearing special gloves can hold and bounce them before they burst into a puff of vapour.
works.description_zh: 一棵高大的铝制树从枝头释放充满白雾的泡泡；观众戴上特制手套就能托住、弹起它们，直到它们破裂成一缕雾气。
works.idea_en: A form that lives a few seconds and responds to your hand is irresistible — ephemeral, touchable AR objects hold attention better than permanent ones.
works.idea_zh: 一个只存在几秒、又会回应你手的形体令人无法抗拒——短暂可触的 AR 物体比永久存在的物体更能抓住注意力。
works.technique: A machine in the tree forms soap bubbles and fills them with scented mist; special fabric gloves let the bubbles bounce without popping.
works.technique_zh: 树中的机器吹出肥皂泡并充入带香味的雾气；特制的织物手套让泡泡可以弹跳而不破裂。
works.exercise_en: Make virtual mist bubbles bloom from a real plant with AR and let hand tracking bounce them until they burst into a particle puff. Twist: bubbles only survive on the palm of a user who moves very gently.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR 让虚拟雾气泡从一株真实植物上绽放，借助手部追踪让它们在手上弹跳，最后破裂成一团粒子。变体：只有动作非常轻柔的用户才能让泡泡在掌心存活。

video.video_title: COS × Studio Swine, New Spring | 18

works.title: Night Vision Camera Effect
works.description: A dark scene is re-lit as a grainy green night-vision image, inspired by the camcorder in Outlast, where nearby surfaces glow brightest.
works.description_zh: 受《逃生》里摄像机的启发，漆黑的场景被重新照亮成带颗粒感的绿色夜视画面，离镜头越近的表面越亮。
works.idea_en: Depth becomes light: what is close to the camera is what you can see.
works.idea_zh: 深度就是光：离镜头近的东西才看得见。
works.technique: An image effect combines the depth texture with scene albedo so brightness falls off with distance, then tints the result green and adds animated noise and a vignette.
works.technique_zh: 画面特效把深度纹理和场景反照率结合起来，让亮度随距离衰减，再染成绿色并叠加动态噪点和暗角。
works.exercise_en: Rebuild the effect on the AR camera feed, using the LiDAR environment depth from AR Foundation's occlusion manager as the depth input so the real room turns into night vision. Twist: add virtual creatures that are only visible in the night-vision mode.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 相机画面上重做这个效果，把 AR Foundation 遮挡管理器提供的 LiDAR 环境深度当作深度输入，让真实房间变成夜视画面。变体：加入只有在夜视模式下才看得见的虚拟生物。

video.video_title: Lets Make a Night Vision Camera Effect

works.title: NormanAR
works.description: An open-source app that takes frame-by-frame animations drawn in VR with the Norman tool and lets you tap to place them in the real world, then walk around them.
works.description_zh: 一款开源应用：把用 Norman 工具在 VR 中逐帧手绘的动画拿出来，轻点屏幕放到真实世界里，再绕着它们走动观看。
works.idea_en: Hand-drawn 3D animation, made in VR, released into everyday places through a phone.
works.idea_zh: 在 VR 中手绘的 3D 动画，通过手机被放进日常空间。
works.technique: Built with openFrameworks and ARCore; exported Norman stroke animations are played back as 3D line geometry anchored to detected planes.
works.technique_zh: 基于 openFrameworks 和 ARCore 开发，把从 Norman 导出的笔触动画作为 3D 线条几何播放，并锚定在识别出的平面上。
works.exercise_en: Draw a 12-frame 3D loop in any VR or AR drawing app and place it somewhere unexpected on campus. Twist: the animation plays only when the viewer circles it.
works.exercise_zh: 在任意 VR 或 AR 绘画应用中画一段 12 帧的 3D 循环动画，把它放到校园里一个意想不到的地方；变体：只有观众绕着它走时动画才会播放。

video.video_title: NormanAR

works.title: Occlusion Leak Compensation
works.description: A see-through display that can make virtual objects truly opaque by blocking real light, and compensates the blurry 'leak' around the mask so edges look sharp.
works.idea_zh: 让透视AR里的虚拟物体真正挡住后面的现实。

video.video_title: Occlusion Leak Compensation: an occlusion-capable optical see-through display design

works.technique: Predicts the defocus blur of the occlusion mask and adds compensating light from the display so the combined image has crisp opaque edges.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机视频透视AR对比“半透明叠加”和“完全遮挡”两种虚拟物体渲染，观察哪种更像真的；变化：给虚拟物体加阴影后再比较。
works.description_zh: 一种透视式显示器，能通过阻挡真实光线让虚拟物体真正不透明，并补偿遮罩周围模糊的“漏光”，使边缘看起来清晰锐利。
works.idea_en: Make virtual objects in see-through AR truly block the reality behind them.
works.technique_zh: 预测遮挡遮罩的离焦模糊，并由显示器补上相应的补偿光线，使合成后的图像具有清晰、不透明的边缘。
works.exercise_en: In phone video pass-through AR, compare rendering a virtual object as a semi-transparent overlay versus fully occluding, and observe which looks more real. Twist: add shadows to the virtual object and compare again.

works.title: Opale
works.description: A garment covered in a forest of fibre-optic strands bristles, trembles or calms depending on the facial expressions of the people around the wearer.
works.description_zh: 一件覆盖着光纤丝“森林”的服装，会根据穿着者周围人的面部表情竖起、颤抖或平静下来。
works.idea_en: Clothing that reacts to others' emotions shows a new kind of expressive interface; AR face filters can move from decorating yourself to answering others.
works.idea_zh: 会对他人情绪做出反应的服装展示了一种新的表达界面；AR 面部滤镜可以从装饰自己转向回应他人。
works.technique: A camera classifies nearby faces into expressions and drives pneumatic soft-robotic chambers under a silicone skin filled with fibre-optic strands.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头把附近的人脸分类为不同表情，并驱动硅胶皮下的气动软体机器人腔体，皮上布满光纤丝。
works.exercise_en: Build a Lens Studio or ARKit effect that grows fur on the viewer's shoulders which bristles when the camera sees an angry face and softens for a smile. Twist: show the reaction on the person being filmed rather than the one filming.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 ARKit 做一个效果：在观众肩上长出毛发，摄像头看到生气的脸时毛发竖起，看到笑脸时变柔顺。变体：把反应显示在被拍的人身上，而不是拍摄者身上。

video.video_title: OPALE: Emotive Garment

works.title: Origin of String Theory (Phaeno)
works.description: The smallest of several works commissioned by the Phaeno Science Centre in Wolfsburg, seen on test in the studio: a single glowing string traces changing wave shapes that echo the idea of vibrating strings in physics.
works.description_zh: 沃尔夫斯堡 Phaeno 科学中心委托 Friedlander 创作的几件作品中最小的一件，这里是在工作室测试的画面：一根发光的弦描绘出不断变化的波形，呼应物理学中“振动的弦”的概念。
works.idea_en: A physics idea becomes understandable when you can watch it happen in 3D; AR science lessons can make abstract waves visible around a real object.
works.idea_zh: 当你能亲眼看到一个物理概念在立体空间中发生，它就变得好懂了；AR 科学课可以让抽象的波在真实物体周围显形。
works.technique: A motor-driven string is lit by stroboscopic light timed to its rotation so the wave pattern appears frozen or slowly drifting.
works.technique_zh: 由马达驱动的弦被与转速同步的频闪光照亮，让波形看起来定格或缓慢漂移。
works.exercise_en: Make a WebXR science demo in which students stretch a virtual string between two real points and pluck it to see standing waves of 1, 2 or 3 nodes. Twist: link the number of nodes to the note it plays.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 WebXR 科学演示：学生在两个真实点之间拉一根虚拟的弦，拨动后能看到 1、2、3 个节点的驻波；变体：节点数量对应它发出的音高。

video.video_title: Origin of String Theory

works.title: Paper Cubes
works.description: Printable paper cubes become physical controllers for a crowd of AR stick figures: show a cube and the figures jump, turn or stop, and an 'AI cube' makes them smarter.
works.idea_zh: 用剪纸做的方块当遥控器，指挥 AR 小人跳、转、停。

video.video_title: AR Experiments: Paper Cubes

works.technique: Each cube face is a Vuforia image target; the recognized face and cube pose trigger behaviors for AR characters walking over the table.
works.exercise_zh: 打印几个带图案的纸方块，用 8th Wall/Vuforia 识别，每个图案对应一种角色动作；加一个变化：两个方块靠近时组合成新指令。
works.description_zh: 可打印的纸方块成为一群 AR 火柴人的实体控制器：亮出一个方块，小人们就会跳跃、转身或停下，而一个“AI 方块”能让它们变得更聪明。
works.idea_en: Paper cubes become remote controls that make AR stick figures jump, turn and stop.
works.technique_zh: 方块的每个面都是一个 Vuforia 图像目标，识别出的面和方块位姿会触发桌面上行走的 AR 角色做出相应行为。
works.exercise_en: Print a few patterned paper cubes and recognize them with 8th Wall or Vuforia, with each pattern mapped to a character action. Twist: two cubes placed close together combine into a new command.

works.title: Parallax Occlusion Mapping Hole
works.description: A deep, mysterious hole appears in a flat ground plane and stays convincing as the camera moves, although the surface is a single flat quad.
works.description_zh: 平坦的地面上出现一个又深又神秘的洞，镜头移动时依然逼真，而这个表面其实只是一块平面。
works.idea_en: A flat surface can fake depth by shifting its texture with the view angle.
works.idea_zh: 平面也能伪造深度：让纹理随视角偏移。
works.technique: Parallax occlusion mapping steps along the view ray through a height map in the fragment shader and offsets the texture coordinates to where the ray hits, faking a deep cavity.
works.technique_zh: 视差遮挡映射在片元着色器里沿视线穿过高度图步进，把纹理坐标偏移到光线命中的位置，从而伪造出深坑。
works.exercise_en: Place the hole shader on an AR floor plane so a pit opens in the real floor and holds up as the user walks around it. Twist: animate the height map so something climbs out.
works.exercise_zh: 把这个洞的着色器放到 AR 地面平面上，让真实地板裂开一个坑，用户绕着走也不穿帮。变体：让高度图动起来，仿佛有东西从里面爬出来。

video.video_title: Parallax Occlusion Mapping Hole Shader in Unity (open source)

works.title: Parallel Parking with AR
works.description: A prototype AR guide that measures a parking spot from the sidewalk and shows whether and how the car will fit.
works.idea_zh: 先在路边量出车位，再用 AR 指引侧方停车。

video.video_title: Parallel Parking with Augmented Reality - by AirMeasure

works.technique: The user marks the corners of the parking gap by raycasting to the ground plane, and the measured length is compared to a car-sized bounding box shown in place.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面上点两点测出一段空位长度，放入一个指定大小的虚拟盒子并用红绿颜色提示是否放得下；变体：用它判断家具能否放进宿舍某个角落。
works.description_zh: 一个 AR 引导原型：在人行道上测量停车位，并显示车能否停进去以及该怎么停。
works.idea_en: Measure the parking space from the curb first, then let AR guide your parallel parking.
works.technique_zh: 用户通过向地面平面发射射线标出停车空位的各个角点，测得的长度与现场显示的车辆大小包围盒进行比较。
works.exercise_en: Tap two points on the ground to measure the length of a gap, drop in a virtual box of a given size, and use red or green to show whether it fits. Twist: use it to check whether a piece of furniture fits into a corner of your dorm room.

works.title: Pcx point cloud renderer
works.description: Scanned point clouds imported from .ply files are drawn in Unity as dense colored dots and animated with custom point shaders.
works.description_zh: 从 .ply 文件导入的扫描点云在 Unity 里被画成密集的彩色点，并用自定义的点着色器做动画。
works.idea_en: Make raw scan data a first-class, animatable material inside a game engine.
works.idea_zh: 让原始扫描数据在游戏引擎里变成可以直接做动画的材料。
works.technique: A custom asset importer reads binary PLY files into point-topology meshes or ComputeBuffers, and point and disk shaders render and animate millions of points; later versions also bake them into VFX Graph point caches (the video shows its predecessor PlypcImporter).
works.technique_zh: 自定义导入器把二进制 PLY 文件读成点拓扑网格或 ComputeBuffer，再由点和圆盘着色器渲染并驱动数百万个点；后来的版本还能烘焙成 VFX Graph 的点缓存（视频展示的是它的前身 PlypcImporter）。
works.exercise_en: Scan a room corner with a LiDAR phone app, export it as .ply, import it with Pcx and re-anchor the cloud onto the real corner in AR Foundation. Twist: make the points scatter wherever a hand appears in front of the camera.
works.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的手机扫描房间一角，导出 .ply，用 Pcx 导入后在 AR Foundation 中把点云重新对齐到真实的墙角；变体：镜头前出现手的位置，点云就被吹散。

video.video_title: Point cloud importer/shader experimentation

works.title: Pepper's Cone
works.description: A thin plastic cone on an iPad shows a 3D object suspended inside it, and the view stays perspective-correct as the display is rotated on its base (UIST 2017 video).
works.description_zh: 在 iPad 上放一个薄塑料锥，锥里就浮现出一个三维物体；把显示器在底座上旋转时，画面始终保持正确的透视（UIST 2017 视频）。
works.idea_en: A cheap cone plus a pre-warped image makes a walk-around hologram.
works.idea_zh: 一个便宜的锥体加一张预先变形的图像，就是一个能绕着看的全息影像。
works.technique: The Unity app reads the tablet's gyroscope to know the viewer's relative orientation, renders the object from that direction and pre-distorts the image so that its reflection in the cone appears as an undistorted, perspective-correct 3D object.
works.technique_zh: Unity 应用读取平板的陀螺仪来判断观众的相对方向，从这个方向渲染物体并对图像预先变形，使它在锥面上的反射看起来是不变形、透视正确的三维物体。
works.exercise_en: Build a Pepper's-ghost pyramid or cone for a phone and feed it a pre-warped render of an AR Foundation scene, using the phone's gyroscope or front-camera face tracking to update the view. Twist: display a live 3D scan of a classmate inside the cone.
works.exercise_zh: 为手机做一个佩珀尔幻象金字塔或锥体，输入经过预变形的 AR Foundation 场景渲染，用手机陀螺仪或前置摄像头的人脸追踪更新视角。变体：在锥体里显示一位同学的实时三维扫描。

video.video_title: Pepper's Cone: An Inexpensive Do-It-Yourself 3D Display

works.title: Pokémon GO AR+
works.description: An ARKit mode where Pokémon are anchored on the ground at real scale; walking closer can startle them, so players sneak up before throwing.
works.idea_zh: 宝可梦真实站在地面上，玩家要悄悄靠近才能捕捉。

video.video_title: Pokemon GO's new AR+ Mode for iOS

works.technique: ARKit plane detection anchors the creature at real scale on the ground, and the camera's distance and approach speed to the anchor drive a flee behavior.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在地面放一只小动物，手机移动太快靠近时它会逃开，慢慢靠近才能摸到它；变体：蹲低身体时它会变得更信任你。
works.description_zh: 一种 ARKit 模式，宝可梦以真实比例锚定在地面上；走得太近可能会惊动它们，因此玩家要先悄悄靠近再投球。
works.idea_en: Pokémon stand on the real ground, and you have to sneak up to catch them.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 平面检测把小精灵以真实比例锚定在地面上，相机与锚点之间的距离和接近速度驱动其逃跑行为。
works.exercise_en: Place a small animal on the ground with AR Foundation that runs away if the phone approaches too fast, so you can only touch it by moving in slowly. Twist: it trusts you more when you crouch down low.

works.title: Portal
works.description: A visitor stands in a mirrored room while kaleidoscopic projections react to their movement, multiplying their body into an endless symmetric pattern.
works.description_zh: 观众站在镜面房间里，万花筒式投影随动作变化，把身体复制成无尽的对称图案。
works.idea_en: Step inside a kaleidoscope and become its pattern.
works.idea_zh: 走进万花筒，自己成为其中的图案。
works.technique: Movement is likely tracked with a depth camera and drives symmetric generative projection, multiplied optically by mirrors on the walls and floor.
works.technique_zh: 很可能用深度相机追踪动作，驱动对称的生成式投影，再由墙面和地面的镜子光学地复制。
works.exercise_en: Tape two mirrors at 60 degrees, point a phone camera into them and make an app that paints your movement into the reflected pattern. Twist: the pattern freezes whenever you stop moving.
works.exercise_zh: 把两面镜子以 60 度角粘好，手机摄像头对准其中，做一个把你的动作画进反射图案的应用。变体：你一停止动作，图案就冻结。

video.video_title: Portal

works.title: Portal to an Alternative Reality
works.description: At Boston's Chinatown subway station, a portal opens onto photogrammetric scenes of Wuhan and Saint Petersburg, linking immigrant neighbourhoods to distant cities.
works.description_zh: 在波士顿唐人街地铁站，一扇传送门打开，通往用摄影测量重建的武汉和圣彼得堡街景，把移民社区与遥远城市相连。
works.idea_en: A transit stop becomes a doorway to another city.
works.idea_zh: 一个公交站变成通往另一座城市的门。
works.technique: Photogrammetry scans of real streets are placed behind a portal plane in a mobile AR app so viewers step through a subway entrance into a 3D replica.
works.technique_zh: 把真实街道的摄影测量扫描放在移动 AR 应用中的传送门平面之后，观众穿过地铁入口就走进 3D 复制的街景。
works.exercise_en: Scan a place that matters to a classmate's family with a phone photogrammetry app and put it behind an AR doorway on campus. Twist: add their recorded voice as the portal's guide.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机摄影测量应用扫描对某位同学家人有意义的地方，把它放在校园里的一扇 AR 门后。变体：用他们录制的声音做传送门的向导。

video.video_title: Portal to an Alternative Reality, Chinatown Station

works.title: Position Based Fluid
works.description: A block of water collapses and sloshes inside a box, simulated with tens of thousands of particles in real time.
works.description_zh: 一块水在盒子里坍塌、晃荡，由几万个粒子实时模拟。
works.idea_en: Fluids stay stable if you correct positions instead of forces.
works.idea_zh: 修正位置而不是力，流体模拟就能保持稳定。
works.technique: Position Based Fluids is solved in Unity compute shaders: particles are sorted into a grid for neighbour search and iteratively projected to satisfy a density constraint.
works.technique_zh: 在 Unity 计算着色器里求解 Position Based Fluids：粒子排序进网格做邻居搜索，并迭代投影以满足密度约束。
works.exercise_en: Run a small PBF simulation in a virtual glass on a real table in phone AR, tilting it with the phone's gyroscope. Twist: tapping the table sends a shock wave through the water.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中把一个小型 PBF 模拟放进真实桌面上的虚拟玻璃杯，用陀螺仪让它倾斜。变体：拍桌子会让水里产生冲击波。

video.video_title: Fast Position Based Fluid Solver

works.title: Post-Truth and Beauty
works.description: A visitor steps into a ring of speakers; as they move their head, light patterns and spatial sound change so that each viewpoint reveals only a partial glimpse of an abstract world.
works.description_zh: 观众走进一圈扬声器中，移动头部时灯光图案和空间声音随之改变，每个视角只能看到一个抽象世界的片段。
works.idea_en: Truth as something you only ever see partially, depending on where your head is.
works.idea_zh: 真相只能被部分看见，取决于你的头在哪里。
works.technique: The position of the visitor's head is tracked (likely with a depth camera) and mapped to light states and to the panning of sound across a circular speaker array.
works.technique_zh: 追踪观众头部位置（可能使用深度摄像头），映射到灯光状态以及环形扬声器阵列中的声像移动。
works.exercise_en: Use a laptop face tracker to change a projected abstract image and a stereo pan as the viewer leans left, right or closer. Twist: hide one 'secret' image that appears only from one exact spot.
