works.exercise_zh: 用笔记本的人脸追踪，让观众向左、向右或靠近时改变投影的抽象图像和左右声道；变体：藏一张只有在某个精确位置才出现的“秘密”图像。

video.video_title: Post Truth and Beauty, 2017 - Interactive installation created by Aphra Shemza & Tim Murray-Browne

works.title: Prisma (VRDG+H #4)
works.description: Huge floating figures and shapes appear as Pepper's ghost holograms in front of Merzbow and XXX Residents, with their shadows falling on a screen behind the performers.
works.description_zh: 巨大的人物和形体以佩珀尔幻象的方式悬浮在 Merzbow 与 XXX Residents 面前，它们的影子落在演出者身后的屏幕上。
works.idea_en: Place virtual objects between performers and audience by projecting onto a transparent screen.
works.idea_zh: 用透明屏幕投影，把虚拟物体放在演出者和观众之间。
works.technique: A large transparent screen at the front of DMM VR Theater creates the Pepper's ghost image, and a Shadow Slicer technique renders shadows onto the background screen without regenerating shadow maps, which kept the show at full frame rate.
works.technique_zh: DMM VR 剧场前方的大型透明屏幕形成佩珀尔幻象，Shadow Slicer 技术无需重新生成阴影贴图就能把阴影画到背景屏上，保证了演出的满帧率。
works.exercise_en: Render a Unity scene to a phone laid under a tilted sheet of acrylic to make a desktop Pepper's ghost, then view the same scene with HoloKit to compare the two kinds of holograms. Twist: make the virtual figure cast a shadow onto a real card behind the acrylic.
works.exercise_zh: 把 Unity 场景渲染到一部平放在倾斜亚克力板下的手机上，做一个桌面佩珀尔幻象，再用 HoloKit 观看同一场景，比较两种“全息”；变体：让虚拟人物在亚克力板后面的真实卡片上投下影子。

video.video_title: [4K] XXX RESIDENTS ensemble with MERZBOW x VJ Keijiro Takahashi

works.title: Projection Spray (VR Spray Drawing)
works.description: In VR the user sprays paint from a virtual can; colour lands on the surfaces of 3D objects exactly where the spray cone hits them.
works.description_zh: 在 VR 中，用户用虚拟喷罐喷漆，颜色精确地落在喷雾锥碰到的三维物体表面上。
works.idea_en: A spray can is just a projector that writes into the texture of whatever it hits.
works.idea_zh: 喷漆罐其实就是一台投影仪，把颜色写进它照到的物体的贴图里。
works.technique: The spray is modelled as a projector: a depth map from the can's view tests visibility, and each object's UV-space texture is updated where the projection hits.
works.technique_zh: 喷漆被建模成一台投影仪：从喷罐视角渲染深度图判断可见性，再在投影命中的地方更新每个物体 UV 空间的贴图。
works.exercise_en: Spray-paint a LiDAR scan of the classroom in AR using the phone as the can, with the paint projected from the phone's pose. Twist: each student's paint colour is picked from the real object they point at.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把手机当作喷罐，从手机位姿投射颜料，给教室的 LiDAR 扫描喷漆。变体：每位学生的颜色取自他们指着的真实物体。

video.video_title: VR Spray Drawing With Unity

works.title: RDSystem (reaction-diffusion)
works.description: Organic spots and maze-like stripes grow and flow across surfaces in real time, driven by a reaction-diffusion simulation.
works.description_zh: 有机的斑点和迷宫般的条纹在表面上实时生长、流动，背后是一个反应扩散模拟。
works.idea_en: Let a chemistry-style simulation paint living textures.
works.idea_zh: 让一个类似化学反应的模拟来绘制会生长的纹理。
works.technique: A Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion system runs inside a Unity Custom Render Texture that updates itself every frame, and the result drives the color and displacement of surface shaders.
works.technique_zh: Gray-Scott 反应扩散系统在 Unity 的 Custom Render Texture 里逐帧自我更新，结果再用于表面着色器的颜色和位移。
works.exercise_en: Run a reaction-diffusion Custom Render Texture on a quad anchored to a real wall in AR and seed new growth where the user taps. Twist: seed it from the edges of the camera image so real objects start the pattern.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把反应扩散的 Custom Render Texture 贴到一面真实墙上的平面，用户点哪里就在哪里播下新的“种子”；变体：用相机画面的边缘来播种，让真实物体长出图案。

video.video_title: Real time reaction-diffusion system with custom render texture (Unity 2017.01)

works.title: Rainbrow – Eyebrow-Controlled Game
works.description: An iPhone X game controlled with your face: raise your eyebrows to fly up, lower them to go down, using TrueDepth face tracking.
works.idea_zh: 用挑眉毛来控制角色上下的 iPhone X 游戏。

video.video_title: Rainbrow — iPhone X Eyebrow-Controlled Game

works.technique: ARKit face tracking on the TrueDepth camera exposes the browInnerUp/browDown blend-shape coefficients, which are mapped directly to the character's vertical position.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit 面部 blendshape（或 MediaPipe Face Landmarker）读取眉毛高度，控制一个小鸟上下飞过障碍；变体：改用张嘴程度或挑一边眉毛控制。
works.description_zh: 一款用脸控制的 iPhone X 游戏：借助 TrueDepth 面部追踪，挑起眉毛就往上飞，压低眉毛就往下落。
works.idea_en: An iPhone X game where raising your eyebrows moves the character up and down.
works.technique_zh: 基于 TrueDepth 相机的 ARKit 面部追踪提供 browInnerUp/browDown 等 blendshape 系数，直接映射为角色的垂直位置。
works.exercise_en: Read eyebrow height from ARKit face blendshapes (or MediaPipe Face Landmarker) to steer a little bird up and down past obstacles. Twist: control it with how wide your mouth opens or by raising one eyebrow instead.

salient.why_en: Raise your eyebrows to fly up: your face is the whole controller.
salient.why_zh: 扬起眉毛就往上飞，你的脸就是整个手柄。

works.title: Raindrops Shader
works.description: Raindrops run down a pane of glass in front of a city scene, each drop refracting and blurring the view behind it.
works.description_zh: 雨滴沿着城市景色前的玻璃流下，每一滴都折射并模糊了后面的景象。
works.idea_en: A rainy window can be drawn entirely in one shader.
works.idea_zh: 一扇下雨的窗户可以完全用一个着色器画出来。
works.technique: A fragment shader, ported from a Shadertoy approach, generates drop and trail masks procedurally in grid cells and uses them to offset and blur the sampled background.
works.technique_zh: 片元着色器（借鉴 Shadertoy 的做法）在网格单元中程序化生成雨滴和水痕遮罩，用它们偏移并模糊背景采样。
works.exercise_en: Apply the raindrop shader to the phone's AR camera feed so the real world looks like it is behind a rainy window. Twist: wiping the screen clears the drops for a moment.
works.exercise_zh: 把雨滴着色器用在手机 AR 相机画面上，让真实世界看起来在一扇下雨的窗后。变体：用手指擦屏幕能暂时擦掉雨滴。

video.video_title: Raindrops Shader, 2017

works.title: Real Life Arcade Game
works.description: One player holds a game controller in front of a screen; every button press is sent as a spoken order to a second player in another room, whose tracked movements move the on-screen figure.
works.description_zh: 一位玩家拿着手柄站在屏幕前；每按一个键，指令就以语音传给另一个房间里的第二位玩家，他被追踪的动作再驱动屏幕上的小人。
works.idea_en: A video game whose character is a real person following your button presses.
works.idea_zh: 一个游戏角色是真人的电子游戏：真人按你的按键去行动。
works.technique: An openFrameworks game converts controller input into audio instructions and moves the avatar from Pozyx ultra-wideband position tracking of the second player.
works.technique_zh: openFrameworks 游戏把手柄输入转成语音指令，并用 Pozyx 超宽带定位追踪第二位玩家，驱动屏幕上的角色。
works.exercise_en: Pair students: one sends commands from a phone, the other hears them in headphones and walks, while a webcam turns the walker's position into a game character. Twist: add a delay so the controller must plan ahead.
works.exercise_zh: 两人一组：一人用手机发指令，另一人戴耳机听指令行走，摄像头把行走者的位置变成游戏角色。变体：加入延迟，逼控制者提前规划。

video.video_title: Real Life Arcade Game

works.title: Realistic AR Brush Texture with Deep Learning
works.description: A neural network turns photos into painterly textures that are hung on real walls as AR paintings.
works.idea_zh: 用神经网络把照片变成油画笔触，挂到真实墙上。

video.video_title: Realistic AR brush texture with deep learning

works.technique: A style-transfer network (CoreML) converts a photo into a painted texture, which is applied to a framed quad placed on a detected vertical plane.
works.exercise_zh: 用在线风格迁移工具生成一张画作，用竖直平面检测把它挂在墙上并加画框；变体：拍下墙本身，风格化后贴回原处，让墙变成画。
works.description_zh: 神经网络把照片转换成具有绘画感的纹理，作为 AR 画作挂在真实墙面上。
works.idea_en: A neural network turns photos into oil-paint brushwork and hangs them on real walls.
works.technique_zh: 风格迁移网络（CoreML）把照片转换为绘画纹理，再贴到一个带画框的四边形上，放置在检测到的竖直平面上。
works.exercise_en: Generate a painting with an online style-transfer tool, hang it on a wall using vertical plane detection, and add a frame. Twist: photograph the wall itself, stylize it, and paste it back in place so the wall becomes a painting.

works.title: Reality Editor 2.0: A Web Browser for the Physical World
works.description: The second-generation Reality Editor treats every physical object as a web page: anchored AR UIs, logic crafting and spatial search for objects in the room.
works.idea_zh: 把现实世界当成网页来浏览，每个物体都是一个可交互的页面。

video.video_title: Reality Editor 2: A Web-Browser for the Physical World

works.technique: Objects are identified by image targets and each hosts HTML/JavaScript UIs served from a local node server, which the AR browser renders as anchored web views and connects through a visual logic editor.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 8th Wall 为教室里 3 个物体各做一个锚定的小网页面板（显示状态、可点击），并提供一个“搜索”按钮高亮指定物体；变体：让每个物体的网页可以被其他同学编辑，看看一小时后变成什么样。
works.description_zh: 第二代 Reality Editor 把每一个实体物体都当作一张网页：提供锚定的 AR 界面、逻辑编排，以及对房间中物体的空间搜索。
works.idea_en: Browse the physical world like the web, where every object is an interactive page.
works.technique_zh: 物体通过图像目标识别，每个物体承载由本地节点服务器提供的 HTML/JavaScript 界面，AR 浏览器把它们渲染为锚定的网页视图，并通过可视化逻辑编辑器相互连接。
works.exercise_en: Use WebXR or 8th Wall to make an anchored mini web panel for each of three objects in the classroom (showing status and clickable), plus a "search" button that highlights a chosen object. Twist: let classmates edit each object's page and see what it has become after an hour.

works.title: Realtime Glove-Controlled Drone Swarm
works.description: A juggler wearing sensor gloves conducts a small swarm of indoor drones: each hand can pick up drones, make them follow the leader, move in sync or form shapes, as a test for a circus show.
works.description_zh: 一位戴着传感手套的杂耍艺人指挥一小群室内无人机：每只手都能调动无人机，让它们跟随领头者、同步移动或排成图形。这是为一场马戏演出做的测试。
works.idea_en: Juggle with flying robots using only your hands.
works.idea_zh: 只用双手，和会飞的机器人一起杂耍。
works.technique: Crazyflie drones are positioned with a TDoA radio system, Specktr touch gloves and Vive trackers give hand position and gestures, and custom software maps gestures to swarm behaviours.
works.technique_zh: Crazyflie 无人机由 TDoA 无线电系统定位，Specktr 触控手套和 Vive 追踪器提供手的位置和手势，定制软件把手势映射为群体行为。
works.exercise_en: Simulate the idea in WebXR or Unity: track one hand with a phone or Quest and let a flock of virtual drones follow, orbit or mirror it. Twist: each finger commands a different drone.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 或 Unity 里模拟这个想法：用手机或 Quest 追踪一只手，让一群虚拟无人机跟随、环绕或镜像它；变体：每根手指指挥一架不同的无人机。

video.video_title: Realtime Glove-Controlled Drone Swarm - Tests 1

works.title: Refraction in AR.js
works.description: Glass-like virtual objects refract the live camera feed so they blend into the real desk; a larger glass torus fills his apartment.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟玻璃物体折射真实画面，与现实融为一体。

video.video_title: Refraction in AR js

works.technique: The live camera frame is used as an environment texture, and a refraction shader offsets its lookup by the surface normal so glass objects bend the real scene behind them.
works.exercise_zh: 在 three.js + WebXR 中把摄像头画面作为环境贴图，给一个玻璃球加折射材质放在桌上；变体：让玻璃物体的形状是你自己的名字 3D 字。
works.description_zh: 玻璃质感的虚拟物体折射实时相机画面，从而与真实桌面融为一体；一个更大的玻璃圆环则填满了他的公寓。
works.idea_en: Virtual glass objects refract the real scene and blend into reality.
works.technique_zh: 把实时相机画面用作环境纹理，折射着色器根据表面法线偏移采样位置，使玻璃物体弯折其后方的真实场景。
works.exercise_en: In three.js with WebXR, use the camera image as an environment map and put a glass sphere with a refractive material on the table. Twist: shape the glass object as 3D letters of your own name.

works.title: Rendez-vous in Mixed Reality
works.description: In a mixed-reality video, the artist paints a glowing cat in the air of her living room while her real cat Mimi watches and tries to catch the virtual one.
works.description_zh: 在一段混合现实视频中，艺术家在客厅的空中画出一只发光的猫，她家真实的猫 Mimi 盯着看，还试图去抓那只虚拟的猫。
works.idea_en: A real pet meeting a painted one reveals the magic and absurdity of mixed reality.
works.idea_zh: 真实的宠物遇见画出来的宠物，揭示了混合现实的魔力和荒诞。
works.technique: The painting is made in Tilt Brush on a tracked VR headset, and a separately tracked external camera composites the 3D strokes over real room footage.
works.technique_zh: 画作在带追踪的 VR 头显中用 Tilt Brush 完成，另一台被追踪的外部摄像机把三维笔触合成到真实房间的画面上。
works.exercise_en: Use Open Brush or an AR drawing app to paint a character that interacts with a real object or person in the frame, and film it from a second camera. Twist: have a real person or pet 'respond' to the drawing on cue.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Open Brush 或 AR 绘画应用画一个角色，让它与画面里真实的物体或人互动，并用第二台摄像机拍下来；变体：让一个真人或宠物按提示对这幅画“做出回应”。

video.video_title: Rendez-vous in Mixed Reality (Tilt Brush)

works.title: Republic (FEMM live)
works.description: Real-time visuals for FEMM's live performance at REPUBLIC, WOMB Shibuya, surround the performers with 3D graphics synced to the music.
works.description_zh: 为 FEMM 在涩谷 WOMB 的 REPUBLIC 活动现场制作的实时视觉，用与音乐同步的 3D 图形包围表演者。
works.idea_en: Match real-time 3D visuals to a pop act's choreography and music.
works.idea_zh: 让实时 3D 视觉与流行演出的编舞和音乐相匹配。
works.technique: A Unity project drives multiple displays on Windows with DX11, switching prepared 3D scenes and effects in time with the set.
works.technique_zh: Unity 项目在 Windows DX11 下驱动多块显示屏，随演出节奏切换预先准备的 3D 场景和效果。
works.exercise_en: Choreograph a 30-second AR sequence to a song: place three virtual objects around a dancer and trigger their animations on cue from a phone. Twist: let the dancer trigger the cues with gestures seen by a second phone's camera.
works.exercise_zh: 为一首歌编排 30 秒的 AR 段落：在舞者周围放三个虚拟物体，由一部手机按节拍触发它们的动画；变体：让第二部手机的相机识别舞者的手势来触发。

video.video_title: FEMM x VJ Keijiro Takahashi @WOMB_Tokyo (2017/6/24) #REPUBLIC https://t.co/dF3XNxvOgF

works.title: Retargeting Video Tutorials to AR
works.description: Tool paths in video tutorials (e.g. painting or sanding strokes on a surface) are extracted and replayed as 3D AR guides on the user's own object.
works.idea_zh: 把视频教程里的工具动作抽出来，变成叠在自己物体上的AR轨迹。

video.video_title: Retargeting Video Tutorials Showing Tools with Surface Contact to Augmented Reality

works.technique: Tracks the tool and its surface contact in the source video, reconstructs the 3D path, and renders it as animated guides registered to the target surface.
works.exercise_zh: 选一段书法或描线教学视频，手动描出其中的笔画路径，用手机AR叠加在学生自己的纸上跟写；变化：路径速度随学生书写速度自适应。
works.description_zh: 从视频教程中提取工具路径（例如在表面上涂刷或打磨的笔触），并在用户自己的物体上以 3D AR 引导的形式重放。
works.idea_en: Pull the tool motions out of a video tutorial and turn them into AR paths laid over your own object.
works.technique_zh: 在原始视频中追踪工具及其与表面的接触，重建 3D 路径，并将其渲染为配准到目标表面上的动画引导。
works.exercise_en: Pick a calligraphy or line-tracing tutorial video, trace its stroke paths by hand, and overlay them in phone AR on students' own paper so they can write along. Twist: have the path speed adapt to each student's writing speed.

works.title: SUN
works.description: Made with artist Philip Schuette: a giant bouncy ball controls a projected sunset, so bouncing and pushing the ball makes the sun rise and fall over a hyper-real horizon.
works.description_zh: 与艺术家 Philip Schuette 合作：一个巨大的弹力球控制着投影出来的落日，拍打、推动这个球，太阳就会在超现实的地平线上升起、落下。
works.idea_en: Bounce a ball to move the sun.
works.idea_zh: 拍一拍球，就能让太阳移动。
works.technique: The ball's position and bounces are tracked (likely with a camera or depth sensor) and mapped to the height and colour of a rendered sun in a real-time landscape.
works.technique_zh: 球的位置和弹跳被追踪（推测用摄像头或深度传感器），映射为实时风景中太阳的高度和颜色。
works.exercise_en: Track a coloured ball with a webcam in p5.js and map its height to the sun's position and sky colour in a simple gradient landscape. Twist: the moon is controlled by a second ball held by another student.
works.exercise_zh: 在 p5.js 里用摄像头追踪一个彩色球，把它的高度映射成简单渐变风景中太阳的位置和天空的颜色；变体：月亮由另一位同学手中的第二个球控制。

video.video_title: SUN BY PHILIP SCHUTTE x RANDOM STUDIO

salient.why_en: Bounce a giant ball and the sun rises and sets with it.
salient.why_zh: 拍一拍巨大的弹力球，太阳就随之升起、落下。

works.title: SWIM: Sequential Wave Imprinting Machine
works.description: A robotic arm sweeps a row of LEDs through space while they light up with the live signal of a sound or radio wave, so a long-exposure camera or the eye's persistence of vision sees the invisible wave frozen in the air where it really is.
works.description_zh: 机械臂带着一排 LED 在空中扫动，LED 按声波或无线电波的实时信号亮起，于是长曝光相机或人眼的视觉暂留会看到这道看不见的波被“冻结”在它真实所在的空间位置上。
works.idea_en: Phenomenal augmented reality: make real physical phenomena, not graphics, visible exactly where they exist.
works.idea_zh: “现象级”增强现实：让真实的物理现象（而不是图形）在它存在的地方直接显现。
works.technique: A lock-in amplifier demodulates the wave relative to its source, and the LED bar's brightness at each position is driven by that signal while it moves, imprinting the standing wave in space.
works.technique_zh: 锁相放大器以波源为参考解调信号，LED 灯条移动时每个位置的亮度都由该信号驱动，把驻波“印”在空间里。
works.exercise_en: Tape a phone flashlight to a stick, make it blink with the loudness of a speaker's tone, and sweep it past the speaker in a dark room while another phone takes a long exposure. Twist: sweep at different distances and compare the patterns.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机闪光灯绑在一根棍子上，让它随扬声器声音的响度闪烁，在暗室里从扬声器前扫过，同时用另一部手机长曝光拍摄。变体：在不同距离扫动并比较图案。

video.video_title: Daniel's first encounter with the SWIM (Sequential Wave Imprinting Machine).

salient.why_en: A sweeping row of lights freezes a sound or radio wave in the air, exactly where the wave really is.
salient.why_zh: 一排扫过空间的灯把声波或无线电波定格在空中，就在它真实所在的位置。

works.title: Sea of Clouds
works.description: A soft, rolling sea of clouds seen from above, inspired by the cloud kingdom in Super Mario Odyssey, drifting slowly under a bright sky.
works.description_zh: 从上方俯瞰一片柔软翻滚的云海，灵感来自《超级马力欧 奥德赛》的云之国，在明亮天空下缓缓漂移。
works.idea_en: Fake a volumetric cloud sea cheaply with a displaced, soft-shaded surface.
works.idea_zh: 用一个位移并柔化着色的表面，低成本地“假装”出体积云海。
works.technique: A subdivided plane is displaced by scrolling noise in the vertex shader and shaded with soft rim and subsurface-like lighting so it reads as fluffy cloud rather than a hard mesh (likely no raymarching).
works.technique_zh: 一个细分平面在顶点着色器中用滚动噪声做位移，再用柔和的边缘光和类似次表面散射的光照着色，让它看起来是蓬松的云而不是硬网格（很可能没有用光线步进）。
works.exercise_en: Place the cloud sea at knee height across a real room with AR Foundation so visitors wade through it. Twist: push the clouds away wherever the user's feet (tracked floor position of the phone) move.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 把云海铺在真实房间膝盖高度，让参观者在云里趟行。变体：用户脚下（手机在地面上的投影位置）经过的地方，云被推开。

video.video_title: Sea of clouds for Unity3D

works.title: Sea of Time – TOHOKU
works.description: A long-term project in which people from the areas hit by the 2011 tsunami each set the speed of one LED counter; thousands of counters are to glow under water as a memorial.
works.description_zh: 一个长期项目：来自 2011 年海啸受灾地区的人们，每人设定一个 LED 计数器的速度；数千个计数器将在水下发光，成为一座纪念碑。
works.idea_en: Letting each participant set one parameter of their own light makes a shared memorial personal; multi-user AR can collect such small choices into one collective piece.
works.idea_zh: 让每位参与者为自己的那盏光设定一个参数，使共享的纪念变得私人化；多人 AR 可以把这些小小的选择汇聚成一件集体作品。
works.technique: Individual LED counter units, each programmed with the speed chosen by one participant, are placed in a shallow pool of water (likely in stages over several years).
works.technique_zh: 每个 LED 计数器单元都按一位参与者选定的速度编程，被放入一个浅水池中（可能分几年逐步完成）。
works.exercise_en: Build a shared WebXR pond on the floor where each student sets the speed and colour of one glowing counter and drops it into the water. Twist: let counters fade when their author leaves the room and reappear when they return.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面上做一个共享的 WebXR 水池，每位同学设定一个发光计数器的速度和颜色，把它放进水里。变体：作者离开房间时计数器变暗，回来时重新亮起。

video.video_title: 「時の海-東北」プロジェクト、“Sea of Time – TOHOKU” Project

works.title: Seido (静動)
works.description: A seven-display rig shows live visuals for Masaya Matsuura's concerts in Osaka and Tokyo, with calm and dynamic scenes alternating across the screens.
works.description_zh: 一个七屏系统为松浦雅也在大阪和东京的演出呈现现场视觉，静与动的画面在各屏幕间交替。
works.idea_en: Turn a row of screens into one rhythmic, public-domain visual instrument.
works.idea_zh: 把一排屏幕变成一件有节奏感、并且开源到公有领域的视觉乐器。
works.technique: Unity's multi-display output feeds seven screens, and Klak components (audio input, cosine gradients, interpolators, game-view layouter) animate colors and motion from the music.
works.technique_zh: Unity 的多显示输出驱动七块屏幕，Klak 组件（音频输入、余弦渐变、插值器、游戏视图布局）根据音乐驱动颜色和运动。
works.exercise_en: Line up several phones on a shelf, each running the same AR scene from a different virtual camera, and sync them to one song. Twist: let the audience rearrange the phones during the song.
works.exercise_zh: 把几部手机排在架子上，每部用不同的虚拟相机运行同一个 AR 场景，并与同一首歌同步；变体：让观众在歌曲进行中重新排列手机。

works.title: ShaderSketches
works.description: A collection of small fragment-shader sketches written while commuting; in this one, geometric patterns pulse with an audio spectrum input.
works.description_zh: 一组在通勤路上写的小片元着色器草图；这一幅里，几何图案随着音频频谱输入跳动。
works.idea_en: Keep a daily habit of tiny shader sketches.
works.idea_zh: 养成每天写一个小着色器草图的习惯。
works.technique: Each sketch is a single GLSL fragment shader in KodeLife; this one reads the spectrum texture that KodeLife provides from audio input and maps bands to shape size and color.
works.technique_zh: 每幅草图都是 KodeLife 中的一个 GLSL 片元着色器；这一幅读取 KodeLife 从音频输入生成的频谱纹理，把各频段映射到形状的大小和颜色。
works.exercise_en: Write a one-screen audio-reactive shader and show it on a virtual poster in a WebXR scene that listens to the microphone. Twist: everyone writes a new sketch on the way to class for a week.
works.exercise_zh: 写一个一屏的声音反应着色器，把它显示在一个监听麦克风的 WebXR 场景里的虚拟海报上；变体：连续一周，每人在上课路上写一个新草图。

works.title: ShaderToy to Unity: Fluid Dynamics
works.description: Colourful fluid swirls endlessly across a texture as Florian Berger's ShaderToy fluid runs inside Unity.
works.description_zh: Florian Berger 的 ShaderToy 流体在 Unity 里运行，彩色流体在纹理上不停地旋转翻涌。
works.idea_en: A self-feeding texture is enough to make convincing, never-repeating fluid.
works.idea_zh: 一张不断把自己喂回去的纹理，就足以做出逼真且永不重复的流体。
works.technique: A compute shader reads the previous frame's texture, advects colour along a rotational velocity field, and writes to a second render texture; the two buffers swap every frame to accumulate the flow.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器读取上一帧的纹理，沿旋转速度场平流颜色，写进第二张渲染纹理；两个缓冲每帧交换，让流动不断累积。
works.exercise_en: Put the fluid texture on an AR plane under a real object and inject colour at the object's position each frame so it seems to stir paint on the table. Twist: use the phone's motion as the stirring force.
works.exercise_zh: 把流体纹理放在真实物体下方的 AR 平面上，每帧在物体位置注入颜色，看起来像它在桌上搅动颜料。变体：用手机的移动作为搅动的力。

video.video_title: ShaderToy to Unity - Fluid Dynamics (source code).

works.title: Shape
works.description: In a dark room filled with fog, large black polygons hang in space. A point marked on the floor shows where to stand: from there, the fragments and the light join into a perfect rectangle; step aside and the shape explodes.
works.description_zh: 在充满烟雾的暗室里，大块黑色多边形悬在空中。地上标出的一点提示观者站的位置：站在那里，碎片和光会拼成一个完美的长方形；往旁边走一步，形状就爆裂开来。
works.idea_en: An illusion that works only from one spot turns the viewer into a participant who must search; AR anchors can reward a precise viewpoint in the same way.
works.idea_zh: 只在一个位置成立的错觉，让观者变成必须去寻找的参与者；AR 锚点也可以用同样方式奖励一个精确的视角。
works.technique: Black planes are hung at different depths so that, together with projected light in haze, they line up into a rectangle only from the marked viewpoint (anamorphosis).
works.technique_zh: 黑色平面被悬挂在不同深度，配合烟雾中的投影光，只有从标记的视点看才会对齐成一个长方形（变形透视）。
works.exercise_en: Scatter virtual fragments across a room in Unity AR Foundation so they align into a word only from one marked spot. Twist: the word changes each time a new viewer finds the spot.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity AR Foundation 里把虚拟碎片散布在房间各处，让它们只有从一个标记点看才会拼成一个词；变体：每当有新的观者找到这个点，词就会换一个。

video.video_title: Shape

works.title: SharedSphere
works.description: A local worker streams a live 360 panorama; the remote expert, immersed in it, sees and points with hands and gaze shown back to the local worker in AR.
works.idea_zh: 远程专家'钻进'现场的360全景里，手势和视线实时回到现场AR中。

video.video_title: SharedSphere: MR collaboration through shared live panorama

works.technique: A 360 camera on the local worker streams a live panorama to the remote expert's VR view, and the expert's head gaze and Leap Motion hand gestures are sent back and rendered in the local worker's AR display.
works.exercise_zh: 用一部 360 相机（或手机全景直播）把现场画面传给远程同学，远程同学在画面上点击标注，本地同学在手机 AR 中看到对应方向的箭头；变体：只允许远程同学用手势，不允许说话，完成一次找物任务。
works.description_zh: 现场工作人员实时传输 360 全景画面；沉浸其中的远程专家可以观察并用手势指点，其手势和视线会以 AR 形式回传给现场人员。
works.idea_en: A remote expert steps into a live 360 view of the site, and their hands and gaze appear back on site in AR.
works.technique_zh: 现场人员身上的 360 相机把实时全景传到远程专家的 VR 视图中，专家的头部注视方向和 Leap Motion 手势被回传，并在现场人员的 AR 显示中渲染出来。
works.exercise_en: Stream the scene to a remote classmate with a 360 camera (or a phone panorama livestream), let the remote classmate tap to annotate the view, and have the local classmate see an arrow in that direction in phone AR. Twist: the remote classmate may only use gestures and cannot speak while completing a find-the-object task.

works.title: Snapchat World Lenses
works.description: Snapchat's rear-camera lenses place animated 3D objects, such as a rainbow-puking cloud or the Dancing Hot Dog, on the ground in the real scene that users can walk around and record.
works.idea_zh: 把动画3D角色放进后置镜头的真实世界，让AR成为全民表情包。

video.video_title: Introducing New World Lenses

works.technique: Rear-camera SLAM with ground detection anchors an animated character to the floor, and video recording captures the composited result for sharing.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 做一个地面上的动画角色 World Lens，录一段 10 秒短视频；变体：角色会模仿镜头前真人的动作（用身体追踪）。
works.description_zh: Snapchat 的后置摄像头滤镜把带动画的 3D 物体放在真实场景的地面上，比如吐彩虹的云朵或跳舞热狗，用户可以绕着它们走动并录制视频。
works.idea_en: Animated 3D characters dropped into the real world through the rear camera turned AR into everyone's meme.
works.technique_zh: 后置摄像头 SLAM 结合地面检测，把动画角色锚定在地面上，并通过视频录制捕捉合成后的画面用于分享。
works.exercise_en: Make a World Lens with an animated character on the ground in Lens Studio and record a 10-second clip. Twist: the character imitates the movements of a real person in front of the camera, using body tracking.

works.title: Spinning Cosmos
works.description: A dark room in which spinning, strobe-lit strings open into spirals, rings and nebula-like forms, like a small cosmos turning in front of the visitor.
works.description_zh: 在一间暗室里，被频闪光照亮的旋转弦展开成螺旋、光环和星云般的形状，就像一个小宇宙在观众面前转动。
works.idea_en: A simple physical mechanism plus darkness can create a sense of scale far larger than the object; AR scenes gain the same power from a dark, reduced surrounding.
works.idea_zh: 一个简单的物理装置加上黑暗，就能营造远大于物体本身的尺度感；AR 场景在暗而简洁的环境里也能获得同样的力量。
works.technique: Several strings rotated by motors at controlled speeds are lit by synchronised strobes so their moving shapes appear still or slowly morphing (exact control system likely custom).
works.technique_zh: 几根由马达以可控速度转动的弦，被同步频闪光照亮，使运动的形状看起来静止或缓慢变形（具体控制系统推测为自制）。
works.exercise_en: Darken a room, then use a phone AR app (Reality Composer or Lens Studio) to place a slowly turning spiral galaxy made only of lines around a small real object. Twist: the galaxy only appears when all room lights are off.
works.exercise_zh: 把房间调暗，用手机 AR（Reality Composer 或 Lens Studio）在一个小的真实物体周围放一个只由线组成、缓慢旋转的螺旋星系；变体：只有关掉所有灯时星系才会出现。

video.video_title: Spinning Cosmos

works.title: Studio Play
works.description: A gallery of installations at the Cleveland Museum of Art where families use movement to explore the collection, including a 4K wall that reveals and zooms artworks by body position.
works.idea_zh: 在美术馆里用身体动作去“揭开”和放大馆藏作品。

video.video_title: Studio Play

works.technique: Depth cameras estimate each visitor's position and distance from the wall, mapping it to pan and zoom within a high-resolution image of artworks.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 估计人离屏幕多远、站在左还是右，据此放大一幅高清名画的对应区域；变体：画作里的人物会转头看向你所站的位置。
works.description_zh: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆中的一组互动装置，家庭观众用身体动作探索馆藏，其中一面 4K 墙会根据人的身体位置揭示并放大艺术作品。
works.idea_en: Use your body to uncover and zoom into museum artworks.
works.technique_zh: 深度相机估计每位观众的位置及其与墙面的距离，并映射为在一幅高分辨率艺术作品图像中的平移和缩放。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe to estimate how far a person is from the screen and whether they stand left or right, and zoom into the matching region of a high-resolution famous painting. Twist: the figures in the painting turn their heads to look at where you stand.

works.title: Super Mario AR
works.description: A Super Mario World level is bent into a ring around the player; you turn in place to follow Mario and reach out to grab power-ups floating in real space and drop them onto him.
works.idea_zh: 把横版马里奥关卡卷成一圈围着你，你转身跟着跑，还能伸手抓道具丢给马里奥。

video.video_title: Super Mario AR

works.technique: The level geometry is wrapped onto a cylinder centered on the ARKit world origin so rotating the phone scrolls the game, and a raycast pick lets you move items.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个 2D 小游戏的关卡'卷'成围着玩家的一圈（在 Unity 或 Reality Composer 里），玩家原地转身来推进；加一个变化：玩家必须蹲下才能看到隐藏关。
works.description_zh: 一个《Super Mario World》关卡被弯成一圈环绕着玩家；你原地转身跟着马里奥前进，还能伸手抓住漂浮在真实空间中的道具，再把它们丢给马里奥。
works.idea_en: A side-scrolling Mario level wraps around you; you turn to follow him and reach out to grab power-ups for him.
works.technique_zh: 关卡几何被包裹到以 ARKit 世界原点为中心的圆柱面上，转动手机即可卷动游戏画面，通过射线拾取可以移动道具。
works.exercise_en: Wrap the level of a small 2D game into a ring around the player (in Unity or Reality Composer) so the player advances by turning in place. Twist: players must crouch to see a hidden level.

works.title: Super Mario Bros Recreated as Life-Size AR Game
works.description: He rebuilt World 1-1 of Super Mario Bros at life size and played it in first person in Central Park, hitting blocks and stomping Goombas through a HoloLens.
works.idea_zh: 把超级马里奥第一关按真人尺寸搬进中央公园，自己扮成马里奥去玩。

video.video_title: Super Mario Bros Recreated as Life Size Augmented Reality Game

works.technique: A life-size level built in Unity is anchored to a world origin on HoloLens so inside-out SLAM tracking lets the player walk through it, with collisions between the head position and block colliders triggering hits.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在地面上放一排 1:1 大小的问号方块，头（相机）碰到方块时弹出金币并计分；变体：把关卡换成你们校园里某条走廊的专属地图。
works.description_zh: 他按真人尺寸重建了《Super Mario Bros》的 1-1 关，戴着 HoloLens 在中央公园以第一人称游玩，顶砖块、踩栗子怪。
works.idea_en: The first level of Super Mario, rebuilt life-size in Central Park, with the player as Mario.
works.technique_zh: 在 Unity 中搭建的真人尺寸关卡锚定在 HoloLens 的世界原点上，借助 inside-out SLAM 追踪让玩家在其中行走，头部位置与方块碰撞体之间的碰撞会触发顶砖效果。
works.exercise_en: Place a row of life-size question blocks on the ground with AR Foundation, and pop out a coin and add to the score when the head (camera) hits a block. Twist: replace the level with a custom map of a hallway on your campus.

works.title: Support
works.description: Two giant white hands rise out of the Grand Canal in Venice to hold up the side of the Ca' Sagredo Hotel, a warning about rising seas and climate change.
works.description_zh: 一双巨大的白色手从威尼斯大运河中伸出，托住 Ca' Sagredo 酒店的侧墙，警示海平面上升与气候变化。
works.idea_en: Giant hands that seem to hold up a real building make a warning feel physical, a strong idea for AR interaction with architecture.
works.idea_zh: 仿佛托住真实建筑的巨手让警示变得具体可感，是 AR 与建筑互动的有力创意。
works.technique: Scanned hands of the artist's son were enlarged, built in resin over a steel core and anchored in the canal bed.
works.technique_zh: 艺术家儿子的手经扫描放大，以树脂覆盖钢芯制成，锚固在运河河床上。
works.exercise_en: Use hand tracking to capture a pair of hands, enlarge them in AR and place them rising out of the ground to 'hold up' a real building. Twist: the hands tremble more as a live sea-level or temperature value rises.
works.exercise_zh: 用手部追踪捕捉一双手，在 AR 中放大，让它们从地面伸出“托住”一栋真实建筑；变体：实时海平面或气温数值越高，双手颤抖得越厉害。

video.video_title: 'Support' by Lorenzo Quinn #Art4Climate

salient.why_en: Two giant hands rise from the canal to hold up a sinking Venice building.
salient.why_zh: 一双巨手从运河里伸出来，托住一栋正在下沉的威尼斯建筑。

works.title: Swarm
works.description: Thousands of glowing lines crawl over the surface of a shape, like insects swarming across a sculpture.
works.description_zh: 成千上万条发光的线在一个形体表面爬行，像一群昆虫爬满了雕塑。
works.idea_en: Constrain a noise-driven swarm so it hugs the surface of an object.
works.idea_zh: 让一群由噪声驱动的粒子紧紧贴着物体表面爬动。
works.technique: A compute shader moves particles through a divergence-free noise field while a distance-field volume pulls them toward the object surface, and the trails are drawn with procedural instancing (DrawMeshInstancedIndirect).
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器让粒子在无散度噪声场中运动，同时用距离场体积把它们拉向物体表面，轨迹再用程序化实例化（DrawMeshInstancedIndirect）绘制出来。
works.exercise_en: Bake a signed distance field of a real object, such as a box matching a table, and let a VFX Graph swarm crawl over it in AR Foundation. Twist: use the phone's LiDAR mesh so the swarm crawls over the actual room.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个真实物体（例如与桌子等大的盒子）烘焙有符号距离场，让 VFX Graph 粒子群在 AR Foundation 中沿它爬行；变体：改用手机 LiDAR 网格，让粒子群爬满整个房间。

video.video_title: Crawler swarm test

works.title: Symbiosis
works.description: A person stands in front of a dark wall and a projected creature grows around and over their body, with wings, antennae and patterns extending from their silhouette as they move.
works.description_zh: 一个人站在黑色墙前，投影的生物在其身体周围和身上生长，翅膀、触角和花纹随着动作从轮廓中延伸出来。
works.idea_en: Your body becomes the core of a projected creature.
works.idea_zh: 你的身体成了一只投影生物的躯干。
works.technique: A depth camera captures the visitor's silhouette and pose, and generative graphics are projected back aligned to the body, likely with openFrameworks.
works.technique_zh: 深度相机捕捉观众的轮廓和姿态，生成式图形对齐身体投射回去，很可能用 openFrameworks 制作。
works.exercise_en: Use body tracking (webcam pose estimation or Lens Studio) to attach generated wings and horns to a person and project them back at life size. Twist: the creature's shape depends on how still the person stands.
works.exercise_zh: 用身体追踪（摄像头姿态估计或 Lens Studio）给人加上生成的翅膀和角，再按真人大小投射回去。变体：生物的形态取决于这个人站得有多稳。

video.video_title: Symbiosis installation

works.title: TOKYO ART CITY by NAKED
works.description: A large white scale model of Tokyo, including the Tokyo Station building that NAKED once mapped at full size, is covered with projected light, traffic, particles and seasons that visitors watch from around the table.
works.description_zh: 一座巨大的白色东京模型，包括 NAKED 曾经以实际尺寸映射过的东京站，被投上光影、车流、粒子和四季，观众围着模型观看。
works.idea_en: Projecting onto a miniature city gives you a god's-eye view of a place, the same tabletop viewpoint that makes AR maps and city models so readable.
works.idea_zh: 把影像投到微缩城市上，让人以上帝视角看一个地方，这正是 AR 地图和城市模型好读的桌面视角。
works.technique: White 3D-printed or milled building models are mapped with several overhead projectors so each block receives its own animation.
works.technique_zh: 用多台顶投投影机映射白色的 3D 打印或加工的建筑模型，让每个街区都有自己的动画。
works.exercise_en: Place a white cardboard model of your campus on a table and use plane or object tracking to overlay AR traffic, weather and day-night cycles on it. Twist: tap one building to shrink yourself into its street view.
works.exercise_zh: 把校园的白色纸板模型放在桌上，用平面或物体追踪在上面叠加 AR 车流、天气和昼夜变化；变体：点一下某栋楼，就能缩小进入它的街景视角。

video.video_title: TOKYO ART CITY by NAKED Full Movie （渋谷ヒカリエ ヒカリエホールB開催時）

works.title: Tangible Mixed Reality 01: Oculus Touch & haptics
works.description: First of a series in which Oculus Touch controllers track real objects so they can be mirrored inside VR; here real surfaces give passive haptic feedback to a virtual interface.
works.idea_zh: 用真实物体给虚拟界面提供被动触觉反馈。

video.video_title: Tangible Mixed Reality 01 : Oculus Touch & haptics

works.technique: A tracked controller is mounted on a real object to provide its 6DoF pose, and a virtual panel is registered to the object's surface so touching the virtual UI hits real material (passive haptics).
works.exercise_zh: 在一块纸板上贴图像标记，用 AR 在纸板表面叠加一组虚拟按钮，手指点纸板时按钮高亮；变体：用不同材质（毛毡、铝箔）做表面，比较哪种按起来最像按钮。
works.description_zh: 系列作品的第一部，用 Oculus Touch 控制器追踪真实物体，使其能在 VR 中被同步映射；在这件作品里，真实表面为虚拟界面提供了被动触觉反馈。
works.idea_en: Real objects give virtual interfaces passive touch feedback.
works.technique_zh: 把被追踪的控制器安装在真实物体上以获取其 6DoF 位姿，并把虚拟面板配准到物体表面，使触碰虚拟界面时手指碰到的是真实材料（被动触觉）。
works.exercise_en: Stick an image marker on a piece of cardboard, overlay a set of virtual buttons on its surface in AR, and highlight a button when a finger taps the cardboard. Twist: make the surface from different materials (felt, foil) and compare which feels most like a button.

works.title: Tangible Mixed Reality 02: Oculus Touch & launchpad
works.description: A physical launchpad controller is tracked and mirrored in VR so its real pads can be pressed while wearing a headset, with virtual feedback attached.
works.idea_zh: 把真实MIDI打击垫变成混合现实中的空间视觉控制器。

video.video_title: Tangible Mixed Reality 02 : Oculus Touch & launchpad

works.technique: The physical launchpad is registered in the virtual scene by a rigidly attached tracker, and incoming MIDI note events trigger visual effects at each pad's virtual position.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个 MIDI 键盘或手机上的虚拟鼓垫连接到 Unity，每次按键在 AR 中对应位置冒出粒子；变体：让粒子飞向房间里的某个固定目标并留下痕迹。
works.description_zh: 一个实体 Launchpad 控制器被追踪并映射到 VR 中，戴着头显时也能按到真实的打击垫，同时附带虚拟反馈。
works.idea_en: A real MIDI pad controller becomes a spatial visual instrument in mixed reality.
works.technique_zh: 通过刚性固定的追踪器把实体 Launchpad 配准到虚拟场景中，传入的 MIDI 音符事件会在每个打击垫的虚拟位置上触发视觉效果。
works.exercise_en: Connect a MIDI keyboard or a virtual drum pad on a phone to Unity, so each key press bursts particles at the matching spot in AR. Twist: make the particles fly toward a fixed target in the room and leave traces.

works.title: Tangible Mixed Reality 03: Oculus Touch & synthesizer
works.description: A real hardware synthesizer is registered in the virtual scene so you can play and tweak it while immersed, with virtual visuals attached to the instrument.
works.idea_zh: 转动真实合成器的旋钮，在空间中塑造声音可视化。

video.video_title: Tangible Mixed Reality 03 : Oculus Touch & synthesizer

works.technique: A hardware synth is aligned to a virtual replica through a tracked offset, so knob and key positions match and virtual visualizations stay attached to the physical instrument.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个真实乐器（如尤克里里）做图像标记，在琴身周围叠加随声音振动的 AR 波形；变体：用麦克风识别音高，不同音高显示不同颜色。
works.description_zh: 一台真实的硬件合成器被配准到虚拟场景中，沉浸其中时也能演奏和调节它，乐器上还附有虚拟视觉效果。
works.idea_en: Turn the knobs of a real synthesizer to shape sound visuals in space.
works.technique_zh: 通过追踪得到的偏移量把硬件合成器与其虚拟复制品对齐，使旋钮和琴键位置一一对应，虚拟可视化效果始终附着在实体乐器上。
works.exercise_en: Make an image marker for a real instrument (such as a ukulele) and overlay AR waveforms around its body that vibrate with the sound. Twist: detect pitch with the microphone and show a different color for each pitch.

works.title: Tangible Mixed Reality 04: Oculus Touch & keyboard
works.description: A physical computer keyboard is tracked so you can type for real inside VR, with virtual labels and panels attached to the real keys.
works.idea_zh: 在VR中用真实键盘打字，并给实体按键叠加虚拟标签。

video.video_title: Tangible Mixed Reality 04 : Oculus Touch & keyboard

works.technique: A tracker fixed to the keyboard gives its pose, and a matching virtual keyboard model with per-key labels is overlaid so the user can type on real keys while immersed.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实键盘上用图像标记定位，给常用快捷键叠加 AR 标签；变体：按下某个键时在键盘上方浮现一句该键的“内心独白”。
works.description_zh: 一个实体电脑键盘被追踪，让你能在 VR 中真正打字，真实按键上还附着虚拟标签和面板。
works.idea_en: Type on a real keyboard in VR, with virtual labels laid over the physical keys.
works.technique_zh: 固定在键盘上的追踪器提供其位姿，再叠加一个与之匹配、每个键都带标签的虚拟键盘模型，让用户在沉浸状态下也能在真实按键上打字。
works.exercise_en: Locate a real keyboard with an image marker and overlay AR labels on commonly used shortcuts. Twist: when a key is pressed, a line of that key's "inner monologue" floats above the keyboard.

works.title: Tangible Mixed Reality 05: Oculus Touch & board game
works.description: A real board game is tracked and augmented with a virtual layer, pitching mixed reality as a way to 'uberize' ordinary physical objects the way MP3 did music.
works.idea_zh: 给真实桌游叠加虚拟棋子和动画，让普通物件被数字层重新定义。

video.video_title: Tangible Mixed Reality 05 : Oculus Touch & board game

works.technique: The board's pose is tracked with a controller or marker, and a virtual layer (animations, rules, scores) is rendered in board-local coordinates so it moves with the physical board.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个简单的棋盘游戏（如井字棋），用图像追踪识别棋盘并在格子上叠加动画和得分；变体：加入一条只有 AR 才能看到的隐藏规则。
works.description_zh: 一套真实的桌游被追踪并叠加上一层虚拟内容，借此提出混合现实可以像 MP3 之于音乐那样，把普通实体物品“优步化”。
works.idea_en: Virtual pieces and animations on a real board game let a digital layer redefine an ordinary object.
works.technique_zh: 用控制器或标记追踪棋盘位姿，并在棋盘局部坐标系中渲染一层虚拟内容（动画、规则、分数），使其随实体棋盘一起移动。
works.exercise_en: Pick a simple board game (such as tic-tac-toe), recognize the board with image tracking, and overlay animations and scores on the squares. Twist: add a hidden rule that only AR can reveal.

works.title: Tangible Mixed Reality 06: Oculus Touch & ROBOT
works.description: A small physical robot is tracked with an Oculus Touch controller and mirrored in the virtual scene, blending a real moving machine with a virtual character.
works.idea_zh: 给真实的小机器人套上虚拟外形和界面，实体与虚拟角色合一。

video.video_title: Tangible Mixed Reality 06 : Oculus Touch & ROBOT

works.technique: A tracker rides on a small robot so its live pose drives a virtual character or effect overlay, blending the physical motion with a digital skin.
works.exercise_zh: 给一辆遥控小车贴图像标记，在 AR 中把它换成一只动物角色；变体：小车撞到东西时，AR 角色做出夸张的表情。
works.description_zh: 一个小型实体机器人由 Oculus Touch 控制器追踪并映射到虚拟场景中，把一台真实运动的机器与一个虚拟角色融合在一起。
works.idea_en: A real little robot wears a virtual body and interface, merging machine and character.
works.technique_zh: 追踪器搭载在小机器人上，其实时位姿驱动一个虚拟角色或叠加特效，把实体运动与数字外皮融为一体。
works.exercise_en: Stick an image marker on a remote-controlled car and replace it with an animal character in AR. Twist: when the car bumps into something, the AR character makes an exaggerated face.

works.title: The Armada Arrives
works.description: A fleet of enormous spaceships hovers above his house, testing how very large virtual objects feel in ARKit.
works.idea_zh: 一支巨型舰队悬停在自家房子上空。

video.video_title: ARKit Unity Demo - The Armada Arrives!

works.technique: Very large models are placed far from the camera in world space with correct scale, atmospheric fog and shadows, so world tracking conveys their size above the house.
works.exercise_zh: 在户外放一个几百米大小的飞船悬在空中，加雾和阴影让它看起来够远够大；变体：飞船投下的阴影会随时间在地面上移动。
works.description_zh: 一支由巨型宇宙飞船组成的舰队悬停在他家房子上空，用来测试超大型虚拟物体在 ARKit 中给人的感受。
works.idea_en: A giant fleet hovers in the sky above your house.
works.technique_zh: 在世界空间中把超大模型以正确比例放置在远离相机的位置，配合大气雾效和阴影，使世界追踪能够传达出它们悬在房屋上方的巨大尺度。
works.exercise_en: Place a spaceship hundreds of meters long hovering in the air outdoors, and add fog and shadows so it looks far and big enough. Twist: the ship's shadow moves across the ground over time.

works.title: The Machines
works.description: The released game: 1v1 real-time multiplayer battles on a real table, where each phone is a moving camera over a shared miniature battlefield.
works.idea_zh: 两台手机在同一张桌上共享微缩战场，实时对战。

video.video_title: The Machines Launch Trailer

works.technique: Two phones share one tabletop anchor and a synchronized game state, with each phone acting as a free-moving camera over the miniature battlefield.
works.exercise_zh: 用网络同步做一个两人桌面 AR 对战，每人从自己的角度看同一张地图；变体：每个人只能看到自己单位附近的区域（战争迷雾）。
works.description_zh: 正式发布的游戏版本：在真实桌面上进行 1 对 1 实时多人对战，每部手机都是一台在共享微缩战场上方移动的摄像机。
works.idea_en: Two phones share a miniature battlefield on one table for a real-time battle.
works.technique_zh: 两部手机共享同一个桌面锚点和同步的游戏状态，每部手机都作为一台在微缩战场上方自由移动的摄像机。
works.exercise_en: Use network sync to build a two-player tabletop AR battle where each player sees the same map from their own angle. Twist: each player can only see the area near their own units (fog of war).

works.title: The Machines (Apple keynote reveal)
works.description: Shown at Apple's iPhone 8 event: a tabletop strategy battle in which players walk around the table to change the view and find openings in the enemy base.
works.idea_zh: 绕着桌子走动去观察战场，身体移动本身就是战术。

video.video_title: Directive Games Reveals The Machines | Apple Special Event 2017 | Unreal Engine

works.technique: ARKit world tracking places a detailed battlefield on the table, and the player's physical movement around it becomes the camera control, revealing new sightlines.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌上放一个 AR 迷宫城堡，只有走到某个角度才能看到隐藏的入口；变体：入口在两个人分别站在两侧时才会同时出现。
works.description_zh: 在 Apple 的 iPhone 8 发布会上亮相：一场桌面策略对战，玩家绕着桌子走动来改变视角，寻找敌方基地的破绽。
works.idea_en: Walk around the table to survey the battlefield, where moving your body is itself a tactic.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 世界追踪把一个细节丰富的战场放在桌上，玩家绕桌的身体移动成为相机控制，从而揭示新的视线。
works.exercise_en: Put an AR maze castle on a table whose hidden entrance is visible only from a certain angle. Twist: the entrance appears only when two people stand on opposite sides at the same time.

works.title: The Magic Revealing Flashlight Shader
works.description: A hidden message on a wall stays invisible until a flashlight beam sweeps over it; only the lit cone shows the secret texture.
works.description_zh: 墙上的隐藏信息平时看不见，只有手电筒光束扫过时，被照亮的光锥里才显出秘密纹理。
works.idea_en: Light itself becomes the key that reveals hidden content.
works.idea_zh: 光本身就是揭开隐藏内容的钥匙。
works.technique: The shader receives the spotlight's position, direction and cone angle as uniforms and, per pixel, outputs the hidden texture's alpha only where the surface point lies inside the cone.
works.technique_zh: 着色器把聚光灯的位置、方向和锥角作为参数传入，逐像素判断表面点是否落在光锥内，只有在锥内才输出隐藏纹理的透明度。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR Foundation plane on a real wall, attach the reveal shader, and drive the spotlight from the phone camera's pose so the phone acts as a torch that uncovers hidden writing. Twist: hide a different message for each of two phones so players must combine their beams.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在真实墙面上放一个平面并挂上显形着色器，用手机相机的位姿驱动聚光灯，让手机变成照出隐藏文字的手电筒。变体：给两台手机各藏一段信息，玩家必须把光束合在一起才能读全。

video.video_title: The Magic Revealing Flashlight Shader

works.title: The New Yorker Innovators Issue AR Cover (with Christoph Niemann)
works.description: Christoph Niemann's New Yorker cover of a subway platform opens in AR into a 3D Manhattan that rises out of the magazine.
works.idea_zh: 杂志封面上的地铁站升起整座立体曼哈顿

video.video_title: The New Yorker - Innovators Issue AR Cover | Nexus Studios

works.technique: Image tracking on the printed cover anchors an animated 3D city model in Unity/ARKit that rises out of the page with depth-consistent perspective.
works.exercise_zh: 给一张自己城市的明信片或海报做 AR：让画中的城市从纸面立体地升起；变体：让升起的城市是 50 年前或 50 年后的样子。
works.description_zh: Christoph Niemann 为《纽约客》绘制的地铁站台封面，在 AR 中展开成一座从杂志中升起的立体曼哈顿。
works.idea_en: A subway station on a magazine cover raises a whole 3D Manhattan.
works.technique_zh: 对印刷封面进行图像追踪，锚定一个在 Unity/ARKit 中制作的动画 3D 城市模型，让它以深度一致的透视从纸面上升起。
works.exercise_en: Make AR for a postcard or poster of your own city so the pictured city rises in 3D from the paper. Twist: the risen city shows what it looked like 50 years ago or will look like 50 years from now.

works.title: Time Waterfall
works.description: Commissioned by Art Basel, streams of numbers fall down the 490-metre facade of Hong Kong's International Commerce Centre like a waterfall, visible across Victoria Harbour.
works.description_zh: 受巴塞尔艺术展委托，一串串数字像瀑布一样沿香港环球贸易广场 490 米高的外立面落下，在维多利亚港两岸都能看到。
works.idea_en: Turning a skyscraper into a clock of falling numbers shows how city-scale surfaces can hold one simple idea; geo-AR can do the same on any tall building.
works.idea_zh: 把一座摩天楼变成一座由下落数字组成的时钟，说明城市尺度的表面可以承载一个简单的想法；地理 AR 可以在任何高楼上做到同样的事。
works.technique: The tower's LED lighting facade displays animated digits flowing downward, each column counting at its own pace.
works.technique_zh: 大楼的 LED 灯光外墙显示向下流动的数字动画，每一列都以自己的节奏计数。
works.exercise_en: Use ARCore Geospatial or a building image target to pour falling digits down the tallest building visible from school, with each column seeded by a classmate's birthday. Twist: freeze the waterfall whenever someone stands still and looks at it for five seconds.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARCore Geospatial 或建筑图像目标，让下落的数字沿着学校能看到的最高建筑倾泻而下，每一列以一位同学的生日为种子。变体：当有人站着看满五秒时，让数字瀑布静止。

video.video_title: Art Basel: Tatsuo Miyajima's 'Time Waterfall' - ICC building, Hong Kong

works.title: Titanic AR Demo
works.description: At a real lake, a full-size Titanic appears on the water and sails off into the distance.
works.idea_zh: 在真实湖面上，一艘等大的泰坦尼克号缓缓驶远。

video.video_title: Titanic AR Demo - ARKit augmented reality in Unity

works.technique: A full-scale ship model is placed at a distance on the water with a horizon-aligned anchor, and animated motion makes it sail away while tracking holds the world frame.
works.exercise_zh: 在操场或湖边放一艘真实尺寸的大船并让它缓慢驶远；变体：船只在你背对它时移动，转身才发现位置变了。
works.description_zh: 在一片真实的湖上，一艘原尺寸的泰坦尼克号出现在水面，并缓缓驶向远方。
works.idea_en: A full-size Titanic slowly sails away across a real lake.
works.technique_zh: 借助与地平线对齐的锚点，把原尺寸的船模放在远处水面上，通过动画让它驶离，同时追踪维持世界坐标系稳定。
works.exercise_en: Place a life-size ship on a sports field or by a lake and let it slowly sail away. Twist: the ship moves only when your back is turned, so you notice its new position when you turn around.

works.title: TouchDesignerPoliceAudioReactive
works.description: An audio-reactive video piece made for the TouchDesigner Advent Calendar 2017 that playfully 'polices' how the name TouchDesigner is written, with graphics pulsing to the music.
works.description_zh: 为 2017 年 TouchDesigner Advent Calendar 制作的声音驱动影像，以玩笑的方式“纠正”大家对 TouchDesigner 名字的写法，画面随音乐律动。
works.idea_en: Make an audio-reactive piece whose subject is a typo everyone makes.
works.idea_zh: 做一个声音驱动的作品，主题是大家都会犯的一个拼写错误。
works.technique: A TouchDesigner network analyses the audio and maps its levels to typography and graphic elements (details in the linked Qiita article); the project file is shared on GitHub.
works.technique_zh: 一个 TouchDesigner 网络分析音频，把音量映射到文字排版和图形元素上（细节见所附 Qiita 文章）；工程文件公开在 GitHub 上。
works.exercise_en: Rebuild the idea in AR: float a word that people often misspell in the room and make its letters jump to music from the phone's microphone. Twist: letters only snap into the correct spelling when the room gets loud.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中重做这个点子：让一个常被拼错的词浮在房间里，字母随手机麦克风收到的音乐跳动。变体：只有房间足够吵时，字母才跳成正确的拼写。

video.video_title: TouchDesignerPoliceAudioReactive

works.title: Towers for Tango
works.description: A tower-defence game for Google's Tango depth-sensing phones in which the battlefield and towers are placed on real floors and furniture.
works.idea_zh: 在深度感知手机上，把塔防战场放在真实的地板和家具上。

video.video_title: Towers for Tango Trailer - AR game for Tango

works.technique: Tango's depth sensor builds a room mesh, and towers and enemy paths are placed on real floors and furniture surfaces from that mesh.
works.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的 iPhone 做网格重建，把敌人的行进路线放在真实地面上并绕开家具；变体：玩家可以挪动真实椅子来改变路线。
works.description_zh: 一款为 Google Tango 深度感知手机开发的塔防游戏，战场和防御塔都放在真实的地板和家具上。
works.idea_en: On a depth-sensing phone, a tower-defense battlefield is laid across real floors and furniture.
works.technique_zh: Tango 的深度传感器构建房间网格，再依据该网格把防御塔和敌人路径放置在真实地板和家具表面上。
works.exercise_en: Reconstruct a mesh with a LiDAR iPhone and lay the enemies' route on the real floor so it steers around furniture. Twist: players can move real chairs to change the route.

works.title: Tree of Ténéré
works.description: At Burning Man, a huge tree made of steel and 25,000 LED leaves glows in the desert, its light pulsing and changing colour at night.
works.description_zh: 在火人节上，一棵由钢铁和 25000 片 LED 叶子组成的巨树在沙漠中发光，夜里它的光不断脉动、变换颜色。
works.idea_en: One large, lit landmark in an empty landscape becomes a meeting place; AR can put a single glowing anchor in open space for people to gather around.
works.idea_zh: 空旷景观中一个巨大的发光地标会成为聚集点；AR 可以在开阔地放一个发光的锚点，让人们围着它聚在一起。
works.technique: A steel trunk carries thousands of LED leaves on branches, controlled by a lighting system that plays programmed and likely sound-reactive patterns.
works.technique_zh: 钢制树干的枝上挂着数千片 LED 叶子，由灯光系统控制，播放编程的、很可能对声音有反应的图案。
works.exercise_en: Plant one large AR tree in a field that glows brighter as more phones gather within ten metres of it. Twist: each person's leaf colour is theirs, and the tree shows who has visited today.
works.exercise_zh: 在场地上种一棵巨大的 AR 树，十米范围内聚集的手机越多，它就越亮。变体：每个人都有属于自己颜色的叶子，树会显示今天谁来过。

video.video_title: TREE OF TÉNÉRÉ at Burning Man | by DRIFT

works.title: Trinity (Channel 17)
works.description: Triple-projector live visuals for DUB-Russell's set at Channel 17 react to kicks and snares with cloned, crawling and instanced geometry.
works.description_zh: 为 DUB-Russell 在 Channel 17 的演出制作的三投影现场视觉，随着底鼓和军鼓，用克隆、爬行和实例化的几何体做出反应。
works.idea_en: Let each drum hit trigger a different GPU effect across three screens.
works.idea_zh: 让每一个鼓点都在三块屏幕上触发不同的 GPU 效果。
works.technique: Audio from the default recording device and OSC triggers (kick and snare) drive Cloner, distance-field volume and instancing effects across three XGA projector outputs.
works.technique_zh: 默认录音设备的音频和 OSC 触发信号（底鼓和军鼓）驱动 Cloner、距离场体积和实例化效果，输出到三台 XGA 投影仪。
works.exercise_en: Map kick and snare detection from the phone microphone to two different VFX Graph bursts in an AR scene. Twist: put three phones side by side as a triptych and let each show a different reaction.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机麦克风检测到的底鼓和军鼓分别映射为 AR 场景中两种不同的 VFX Graph 迸发；变体：把三部手机并排当作三联屏，每部显示不同的反应。

works.title: TweetReality
works.description: The first augmented-reality Twitter client: your timeline appears as floating cards arranged around you in space, which you browse by moving the phone.
works.description_zh: 第一个增强现实版 Twitter 客户端：你的时间线化作漂浮的卡片环绕在身边，移动手机即可浏览。
works.idea_en: Unroll a social feed into the room so scrolling becomes turning your body.
works.idea_zh: 把社交信息流铺满房间，让“滑动”变成“转身”。
works.technique: ARKit world tracking lays out Twitter API content as floating 3D cards around the user, with tap-to-open, like and retweet buttons in space.
works.technique_zh: 用 ARKit 世界追踪把 Twitter API 内容排布成环绕用户的漂浮 3D 卡片，并在空间中提供点击展开、点赞和转发按钮。
works.exercise_en: Lay out ten messages from a class chat as cards in a circle around the viewer in AR. Twist: older messages drift farther away and fade.
works.exercise_zh: 把班级群的十条消息以卡片形式在 AR 中围成一圈排列在观者周围；变体：越早的消息离得越远、越模糊。

video.video_title: TweetReality - The First AR Client for Twitter

works.title: Two-Way AR Portal with A-Frame 360
works.description: A walk-through portal door that shows a 360 world from outside and the real room from inside.
works.idea_zh: 一扇双向传送门：外面看是 360 世界，进去回看是现实房间。

video.video_title: Portal door with A-Frame 360 using AR.js

works.technique: A stencil-masked door shows a 360 panorama from outside, and when the camera crosses the door plane the rendering inverts so the panorama surrounds the viewer and the real room is seen through the door.
works.exercise_zh: 用 three.js + WebXR 放一扇门，门里显示一张 360 全景照片，走进门后全景包围你、门外看到真实房间；变体：用你自己拍的全景照片。
works.description_zh: 一扇可以走进去的传送门：从外面看是 360 度的世界，从里面看则是真实的房间。
works.idea_en: A two-way portal: from outside you see a 360 world, and from inside you look back at the real room.
works.technique_zh: 带模板遮罩的门从外面显示 360 全景，当相机穿过门所在的平面时渲染反转，全景包围观众，而真实房间则透过门框可见。
works.exercise_en: Place a door with three.js and WebXR that shows a 360 panorama inside; after you walk through, the panorama surrounds you and the real room is visible through the door. Twist: use a panorama you shot yourself.

works.title: Unity FLIP Fluid
works.description: Splashing liquid is simulated with a hybrid of particles and a grid, keeping fine splashes while staying stable.
works.description_zh: 用粒子和网格混合的方法模拟飞溅的液体，既保留细小水花又保持稳定。
works.idea_en: Combine particles and grids to get detailed yet stable water.
works.idea_zh: 把粒子和网格结合起来，得到细节丰富又稳定的水。
works.technique: The FLIP method transfers particle velocities to a MAC grid, solves pressure there, and transfers the velocity change back to the particles (implemented on the GPU in Unity).
works.technique_zh: FLIP 方法把粒子速度转移到 MAC 网格上求解压力，再把速度变化转回粒子（在 Unity 中用 GPU 实现）。
works.exercise_en: Place a FLIP water tank in AR and let students pour virtual water from one real cup-shaped marker into another. Twist: the water changes colour when the two streams mix.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中放一个 FLIP 水箱，让学生把虚拟水从一个真实杯状标记倒进另一个。变体：两股水混合时会变色。

video.video_title: Unity FLIP Fluid

works.title: Unity-ShaderSketches
works.description: A grid of animated patterns — pulsing circles, rotating tiles, interference waves — each drawn by a few lines of ShaderLab code.
works.description_zh: 一格格动画图案——脉动的圆、旋转的瓷砖、干涉波——每一个都只用几行 ShaderLab 代码画出。
works.idea_en: A daily habit of tiny fragment-shader sketches builds a library of moving patterns.
works.idea_zh: 每天写一个很小的片元着色器草图，积累出一整套会动的图案库。
works.technique: Each sketch is a single unlit ShaderLab fragment shader that computes colour from UV, time and math (polar coordinates, fract tiling, smoothstep) with no textures.
works.technique_zh: 每个草图都是一个无光照的 ShaderLab 片元着色器，只用 UV、时间和数学（极坐标、fract 平铺、smoothstep）计算颜色，不用任何贴图。
works.exercise_en: Pick three sketches and apply them as materials on AR planes detected on the floor and walls, so the room is covered in moving patterns. Twist: feed the phone's distance to each surface into the shader so patterns speed up as you approach.
works.exercise_zh: 挑三个草图，作为材质贴到检测到的地面和墙面 AR 平面上，让房间铺满动态图案。变体：把手机到每个表面的距离传进着色器，走近时图案加速。

video.video_title:
ShaderLab で描きました
落ち着きなさすぎる感はある #unity3d #creativecoding https://t.co/dIFQuwfQzn https://t.co/SMmcCTFb2N

works.title: VideoPlayerEffects (keying)
works.description: Green-screen footage played by Unity's VideoPlayer is keyed live, with improved spill suppression so the subject blends into a 3D scene.
works.description_zh: Unity VideoPlayer 播放的绿幕素材被实时抠像，改进的溢色抑制让人物自然融入 3D 场景。
works.idea_en: Place filmed people into a real-time 3D world with a shader.
works.idea_zh: 用一个着色器，把拍摄的人放进实时 3D 世界。
works.technique: A chroma-key shader computes a matte from the green channel difference and removes green spill from the edges; the keyer later moved to the ProcAmp repository.
works.technique_zh: 色度键着色器根据绿色通道差值计算遮罩，并去除边缘的绿色溢色；这个抠像器后来迁移到了 ProcAmp 仓库。
works.exercise_en: Film a classmate against a green wall, key the clip with a shader and place it as a life-size video billboard in AR. Twist: make the billboard always face the viewer so the person follows you around.
works.exercise_zh: 让同学站在绿墙前拍一段视频，用着色器抠像后作为真人大小的视频广告牌放进 AR；变体：让广告牌始终朝向观众，好像那个人一直跟着你转。

works.title: WHIST
works.description: A one-hour physical-theatre installation where visitors move through a set of sculptural objects wearing VR headsets; where you look and which objects you approach choose which of 76 dream-like 360° scenes of a fictional family you see.
works.description_zh: 一小时的肢体剧场装置：观众戴着 VR 头显穿行于雕塑般的实体布景之间，你看向哪里、靠近哪件物体，决定了你会看到一个虚构家庭 76 段梦境式 360° 场景中的哪一段。
works.idea_en: The audience's own attention and wandering assemble a personal cut of a Freudian dance story.
works.idea_zh: 观众自己的注意力和游走路径，剪辑出一部专属于他的弗洛伊德式舞蹈故事。
works.technique: Physical props act as trigger zones and gaze targets that branch between pre-filmed 360° dance scenes with 3D sound, likely via positional tracking of each headset.
works.technique_zh: 实体道具充当触发区和注视目标，在预先拍摄的 360° 舞蹈场景与 3D 声音之间切换分支，很可能依靠对每台头显的位置追踪实现。
works.exercise_en: Film three short 360° dance clips, then build a WebXR or Cardboard scene where gazing at a real object in the room for two seconds switches to the matching clip. Twist: make the branch depend on which object the viewer ignores.
works.exercise_zh: 拍三段短的 360° 舞蹈片段，再用 WebXR 或 Cardboard 搭一个场景：注视房间里某件真实物体两秒，就切换到对应片段；变体：让分支取决于观众“忽略了”哪件物体。

video.video_title: WHIST Trailer - Virtual Reality and Dance Production

works.title: Walking in VR Using AR.js Tracking
works.description: Uses AR.js positional tracking to physically walk into the A-Frame logo in virtual reality.
works.idea_zh: 借用 AR.js 的定位，在 VR 里真正走进 A-Frame 标志。

video.video_title: Walking in Virtual Reality using AR.js on A-Frame

works.technique: AR positional tracking drives the VR camera, so physical walking translates 1:1 into movement through a fully virtual A-Frame scene.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 追踪手机位置，把画面替换成全虚拟场景，让学生在教室里走进一个巨大 logo；变体：虚拟场景的墙壁与真实教室墙对齐，防止撞墙。
works.description_zh: 利用 AR.js 的位置追踪，在虚拟现实中亲身走进 A-Frame 的标志。
works.idea_en: Borrow AR.js positioning to actually walk into the A-Frame logo in VR.
works.technique_zh: AR 位置追踪驱动 VR 相机，使现实中的行走 1:1 转化为在纯虚拟 A-Frame 场景中的移动。
works.exercise_en: Track the phone's position with WebXR, replace the view with a fully virtual scene, and have students walk into a giant logo in the classroom. Twist: align the walls of the virtual scene with the real classroom walls so no one bumps into them.

works.title: Warping Halos
works.description: A large motorised, illuminated ring hangs from the ceiling and revolves through the space, shifting colour and intensity with a soundscape so the halo seems to warp and multiply around the viewers.
works.description_zh: 一个巨大的电动发光圆环从天花板垂下，在空间中旋转，颜色和亮度随声景变化，让光环仿佛在观众周围扭曲、倍增。
works.idea_en: A single spinning ring of light turns into a halo that bends the room.
works.idea_zh: 一只旋转的光环，变成一道能让整个房间弯曲的光晕。
works.technique: An LED ring on a motorised mount is rotated on several axes and sequenced with DMX lighting and sound, so persistence of vision and haze create ghost circles.
works.technique_zh: 装在电动支架上的 LED 圆环绕多个轴旋转，并与 DMX 灯光和声音同步编排，利用视觉暂留和雾气产生幻影光圈。
works.exercise_en: Attach an LED hoop to a slow rotating motor or a lazy Susan in a dark room and film it with long exposure on phones. Twist: change the rotation speed with the loudness of music.
works.exercise_zh: 在暗室里把 LED 圆环装在慢速旋转的电机或转盘上，用手机长曝光拍摄；变体：让旋转速度随音乐音量变化。

video.video_title: Warping Halos by Children of the Light

works.title: Water Surface Simulation with CustomRenderTexture
works.description: Objects dropped onto a water plane send out ripples that spread, reflect off the edges and interfere with each other.
works.description_zh: 物体掉到水面上激起涟漪，涟漪向外扩散、在边缘反射并彼此干涉。
works.idea_en: A ripple simulation fits in a texture that updates itself every frame.
works.idea_zh: 一个涟漪模拟可以装进一张每帧自我更新的纹理里。
works.technique: A CustomRenderTexture runs the 2D wave equation in a shader, reading the previous two frames, adding impulses where objects hit, and feeding the height map into the water shader's normals.
works.technique_zh: CustomRenderTexture 在着色器中求解二维波动方程，读取前两帧、在物体撞击处加入冲量，再把高度图转成水面着色器的法线。
works.exercise_en: Turn a real tabletop into water in phone AR and create ripples wherever a tracked finger or object touches it. Twist: ripples also start when a sound is detected.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中把真实桌面变成水面，被追踪的手指或物体碰到哪里就激起涟漪。变体：检测到声音时也会起波纹。

video.video_title: Water Simulation using CustomRenderTexture from Unity 2017.1

works.title: Wave Propagation Shader (Water Ripple)
works.description: Touching the surface sends circular ripples across an image, which bend the picture as the waves travel and fade.
works.description_zh: 触碰画面会激起圆形涟漪，波纹传播、衰减时会扭曲整幅画面。
works.idea_en: Turn any image into a pond.
works.idea_zh: 把任何一幅图像变成一池水。
works.technique: A multi-pass shader stores wave height in ping-pong render textures, solves the wave equation each frame, and uses the height gradient to refract the image.
works.technique_zh: 多 pass 着色器把波高存在乒乓渲染纹理中，每帧求解波动方程，再用高度梯度折射图像。
works.exercise_en: Put the ripple shader on the camera feed in AR and trigger ripples where people's feet are detected. Twist: ripples only appear on the floor plane, not on walls.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把涟漪着色器加在相机画面上，在检测到人脚的地方激起涟漪。变体：涟漪只出现在地面平面上，墙上没有。

video.video_title: Wave Propagation Shader (Water Ripple)

works.title: When the Crowd Becomes Circus
works.description: A festival app lets the audience influence a live circus show by shaking, tapping or shouting into their phones, and its AR mode places tiny circus performers on the street.
works.description_zh: 一款艺术节应用让观众通过摇手机、点屏幕或对着麦克风喊叫来影响现场马戏表演；它的 AR 模式还把迷你马戏演员放到街道上。
works.idea_en: The crowd's phones become both a remote control for the show and a window onto a miniature street circus.
works.idea_zh: 观众的手机既是演出的遥控器，也是看见街头迷你马戏的窗口。
works.technique: A real-time server collects phone sensor input from the crowd and can push cues back to the phones' screens, speakers and flash, while an ARKit/ARCore-style mode anchors animated performers on the ground.
works.technique_zh: 实时服务器收集观众手机的传感器输入，也能反向控制手机的屏幕、扬声器和闪光灯；AR 模式（类似 ARKit/ARCore）把动画演员锚定在地面上。
works.exercise_en: Make a web app that turns classmates' phone shakes into a shared meter that changes a projected performer's action. Twist: at the end, the projection takes over everyone's phone flashlights for a finale.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个网页应用，把同学们摇手机的数据汇成一个共享数值，用来改变投影中表演者的动作。变体：结尾时由投影系统接管所有人的手机闪光灯来收场。

video.video_title: Quand la foule devient cirque - Augmented reality

works.title: Wingnut AR WWDC 2017 ARKit demo
works.description: On the WWDC 2017 stage, an iPad placed a desolate outpost on a real table; as the presenter walked around it, airships arrived, bombed the base and exploded into debris, all in Unreal Engine.
works.description_zh: 在 2017 年 WWDC 舞台上，一台 iPad 把一个荒凉的前哨基地放在真实桌面上；演示者绕着桌子走动时，飞艇飞来轰炸基地并炸出满地碎片，全部由 Unreal Engine 渲染。
works.idea_en: A tabletop becomes a cinematic miniature battlefield you can walk around like a film set.
works.idea_zh: 一张桌面变成可以绕着走的电影级微缩战场，像在片场里看戏。
works.technique: ARKit world tracking and horizontal plane detection anchor an Unreal Engine 4 scene to the table, with real-time lighting estimation and particle effects.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 的世界追踪和水平面检测把 Unreal Engine 4 场景锚定到桌面上，并配合实时光照估计和粒子特效。
works.exercise_en: Place a miniature diorama on a detected table plane and script a 30-second cinematic event (arrival, conflict, aftermath) that plays when the viewer walks to a marked viewpoint. Twist: let the viewer's distance to the table control the time scale.
works.exercise_zh: 在检测到的桌面平面上放置一个微缩场景，编排一段 30 秒的电影式事件（到来、冲突、余波），当观众走到指定观察点时触发播放。变体：让观众与桌子的距离控制时间流速。

video.video_title: Wingnut AR Unreal Engine Demo on iOS | WWDC 2017

works.title: Work Area Visualization by Multi-View Diminished Reality
works.description: Several cameras watch a workbench from different angles; the system removes the worker's hands and tools from the main view by filling them in from the other cameras, so the whole work piece stays visible while it is being assembled.
works.description_zh: 多台相机从不同角度拍摄工作台；系统用其他相机的画面把工人的手和工具从主视图中抹去并补全，让工件在装配过程中始终完整可见。
works.idea_en: See through your own hands to the work they are hiding.
works.idea_zh: 透过自己的双手，看到被它们挡住的工作区域。
works.technique: Multi-view diminished reality: the region occluded by hands in the main view is replaced with pixels from other calibrated cameras, warped into the main viewpoint.
works.technique_zh: 多视角削弱现实：主视图中被手遮挡的区域，用其他已标定相机的画面经视角变换后填补替换。
works.exercise_en: Film a desk with two phones on stands and blend the second view into the first wherever a hand is detected (a hand-tracking mask), so hands turn semi-transparent. Twist: make only the tool vanish so it seems to move by itself.
works.exercise_zh: 用两部架好的手机拍同一张桌子，在检测到手的区域（手部追踪遮罩）把第二台相机的画面混合进第一台中，让双手变成半透明。变体：只让工具消失，看上去像它自己在动。

video.video_title: [MTI] A Work Area Visualization by Multi-View Camera-Based Diminished Reality

works.title: ZapBox
works.description: A $30 cardboard headset turns a phone into a room-scale mixed-reality device: printed pointcode markers scattered on the floor map the room, and two cardboard controllers with codes act as tracked hands.
works.description_zh: 一个 30 美元的纸板头显把手机变成房间级混合现实设备：散放在地上的打印点码标记用于给房间建图，两个贴着码的纸板手柄充当被追踪的双手。
works.idea_en: Room-scale MR with tracked controllers, built from paper, cardboard and a phone camera.
works.idea_zh: 用纸、纸板和手机摄像头搭出带追踪手柄的房间级混合现实。
works.technique: The phone camera detects printed circular pointcodes to build a map of the room and track handheld cardboard controllers in 6DoF, with a fisheye lens widening the view.
works.technique_zh: 手机摄像头识别打印的圆形点码，建立房间地图并以六自由度追踪手持纸板手柄，同时用鱼眼镜头扩大视野。
works.exercise_en: Print six ArUco markers, tape two onto cardboard paddles, and build a phone AR scene where the paddles become tools that hit a floating ball. Twist: use a marker taped to the floor as a portal that swaps the ball into another world.
works.exercise_zh: 打印六个 ArUco 标记，把其中两个贴在纸板球拍上，做一个手机 AR 场景，让球拍变成击打漂浮小球的工具。变体：把一个贴在地上的标记当作传送门，让小球穿越到另一个世界。

video.video_title: ZapBox: Mixed Reality for Everyone

works.title: Zero Days VR
works.description: A VR documentary about the Stuxnet cyberweapon that places you inside the invisible world of computer code, travelling through data centres and centrifuges at human scale.
works.description_zh: 一部关于 Stuxnet 网络武器的 VR 纪录片，把你带进看不见的计算机代码世界，以人的尺度穿行于数据中心和离心机之间。
works.idea_en: Give an invisible event a body and a space you can stand in.
works.idea_zh: 给一个看不见的事件一个身体、一个你可以站进去的空间。
works.technique: Volumetric interviews captured with Depthkit are combined with abstract data visualisation in Unity to create a navigable space.
works.technique_zh: 用 Depthkit 捕捉的体积影像访谈与 Unity 中的抽象数据可视化结合，构成可以游历的空间。
works.exercise_en: Pick an invisible process (a text message being sent, Wi-Fi) and stage it in room-scale AR around the class as a journey. Twist: let the audience be the data packet.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个看不见的过程（一条短信被发送、Wi-Fi 信号），在教室里用房间尺度的 AR 把它演绎成一段旅程。变体：让观众自己成为数据包。

video.video_title: Zero Days VR 360° Trailer - Cinematic VR Experience

works.title: bioSync
works.description: Two people wear paired EMG/EMS armbands: when one tenses or relaxes a muscle, the other person's arm stiffens or loosens in sync, so a teacher can literally pass on a movement or a tremor.
works.description_zh: 两个人戴上成对的肌电感应/电刺激臂带：一个人绷紧或放松肌肉，另一个人的手臂就同步变硬或变软，老师可以把动作甚至手抖“传”给学生。
works.idea_en: Share muscle tension between two bodies as if it were a live video stream.
works.idea_zh: 像直播视频一样，在两具身体之间实时共享肌肉张力。
works.technique: Measures muscle activity with electromyography on one wearer and replays it as electrical muscle stimulation on the partner through the same electrodes, in both directions.
works.technique_zh: 在一位佩戴者身上用肌电图测量肌肉活动，再通过同一组电极以电刺激的形式在搭档身上回放，而且是双向的。
works.exercise_en: Pair students and have one guide the other's wrist with a light string and a phone vibration cue whenever the leader's phone accelerometer detects a flick; practise a drum pattern this way. Twist: swap roles mid-rhythm without stopping and see who is really leading.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生两两一组，一人手机的加速度计检测到甩腕时，就通过细绳牵引和另一部手机的震动提示带动搭档的手腕，用这种方式练一段鼓点；变体：节奏不停，中途交换角色，看看到底是谁在带谁。

video.video_title: bioSync: Synchronous Kinesthetic Experience among People

works.title: phosphere
works.description: A dance installation homage to Schlemmer's Triadic Ballet: dancers wearing wrist markers trigger light from 24 projectors mounted overhead, turning gestures into three-dimensional light geometry.
works.idea_zh: 舞者手腕上的标记点控制24台投影仪，把手势变成空间里的光之几何
works.technique: Wrist-marker motion tracking feeds a real-time system that aims light from 24 truss-mounted projectors at computed 3D positions around the dancers.
works.exercise_zh: 给同学手腕贴反光贴或彩色标记，用摄像头追踪后让投影仪在对应位置打出光圈；变化：两只手之间自动连成一条光线。

video.video_title: Rhizomatiks Research × ELEVENPLAY Dance Installation at Gallery AaMo “phosphere”

works.description_zh: 一件向 Schlemmer《三元芭蕾》致敬的舞蹈装置：舞者手腕佩戴标记，触发架设在头顶的 24 台投影仪发光，把手势化为三维的光之几何。
works.idea_en: Markers on dancers' wrists steer 24 projectors, turning gestures into geometry of light in space.
works.technique_zh: 手腕标记的动作追踪数据输入实时系统，控制架设在桁架上的 24 台投影仪，把光投向舞者周围计算出的 3D 位置。
works.exercise_en: Put reflective stickers or colored markers on a classmate's wrists, track them with a camera, and have a projector cast rings of light at the matching positions. Twist: automatically connect the two hands with a beam of light.

works.title: shapeShift
works.description: A compact pin-based shape display rides on a small robot across the table, rendering moving shapes you can feel and, paired with a headset, standing in physically for virtual objects.
works.description_zh: 一个紧凑的针阵形状显示器装在小机器人上在桌面移动，渲染出可以触摸的动态形状；配合头显使用时，它能充当虚拟物体的实体替身。
works.idea_en: Put a shape display on wheels so physical pixels can follow virtual objects around.
works.idea_zh: 给形状显示器装上轮子，让实体像素跟着虚拟物体走。
works.technique: Moves a 7 mm pitch actuated pin array on an omnidirectional robot base and synchronises its position and height map with tracked virtual content in a head-mounted display.
works.technique_zh: 把 7 毫米间距的驱动针阵装在全向机器人底座上，并将其位置和高度图与头显中被追踪的虚拟内容同步。
works.exercise_en: Stick a printed marker on a toy car or robot and anchor a virtual object to it in phone AR, so touching the real toy lets you 'touch' the virtual one. Twist: swap the virtual object while keeping the same physical proxy and discuss which feels right.
works.exercise_zh: 在玩具车或机器人上贴一个打印标记，在手机 AR 中把一个虚拟物体锚定在上面，这样触摸真实玩具就像“摸到”了虚拟物体；变体：保持同一个实体替身，更换虚拟物体，讨论哪种感觉最对。

video.video_title: shapeShift: A Mobile Tabletop Shape Display for Tangible and Haptic Interaction

works.title: unity-volume-rendering
works.description: A medical CT volume floats as a translucent 3D cloud; a slicing plane cuts into it to reveal the inner structure.
works.description_zh: 一组医学 CT 体数据像半透明的三维云一样悬浮，一个切割平面切进去，露出内部结构。
works.idea_en: Raymarch through a 3D texture so volumetric data becomes a glowing object you can slice.
works.idea_zh: 在三维纹理里做光线步进，让体数据变成可以被切开的发光物体。
works.technique: Object-space raymarching steps a ray through a Texture3D inside a cube, accumulates density with a transfer function and clips samples against a user-controlled plane.
works.technique_zh: 在物体空间里对立方体内的 Texture3D 做光线步进，用传递函数累积密度，并用用户控制的平面裁掉部分采样。
works.exercise_en: Place the volume cube on a real table with AR Foundation and use the phone itself as the slicing plane, so moving the phone cuts through the data. Twist: load a volume the class makes from stacked photos of a fruit sliced in real life.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 把体数据立方体放在真实桌面上，把手机本身当作切割平面，移动手机就能切开数据。变体：用全班把一只水果真实切片后拍照叠成的体数据来加载。

video.video_title: Volume rendering with raymarching入門編その2 #unity ボリュームを描画し始める境目を決められるようになった！ https://t.co/hOlYkqKrAy

works.title: (UN)FOCUSSED
works.description: Two performers wear EEG headsets and their brainwaves directly drive laser drawings, light and sound around them, revealing how closely their brains synchronise.
works.description_zh: 两位表演者戴着脑电头戴设备，他们的脑电波直接驱动周围的激光图形、灯光和声音，揭示两人大脑同步得有多紧密。
works.idea_en: Put two brains side by side as laser light and see when they synchronise.
works.idea_zh: 把两个大脑以激光的形式并排呈现，看它们何时同步。
works.technique: Hacked consumer EEG headsets stream brain-frequency bands that Alberto Novello maps directly to laser galvanometers and a sound composition by Ivo Bol.
works.technique_zh: 改装的消费级脑电设备输出各频段数据，由 Alberto Novello 直接映射到激光振镜和 Ivo Bol 的声音作品上。
works.exercise_en: Use a Muse or other consumer EEG band (or a heart-rate sensor as a stand-in) on two volunteers and draw each signal as a line on a projected oscilloscope, then ask them to try to synchronise. Twist: turn on a light only when both signals match.
works.exercise_zh: 给两位志愿者戴上 Muse 或其他消费级脑电头带（也可用心率传感器替代），把各自信号画成投影示波器上的一条线，请他们尝试同步；变体：只有两条信号吻合时才亮灯。

video.video_title: (UN)FOCUSSED _ brain-controlled laser performance (TEASER)-HD

works.title: 192 prepared dc-motors, wooden sticks 2.4m
works.description: Long wooden sticks hang from motors in a dense grid and knock against each other and the floor, creating a forest of clattering, swaying lines you can walk around.
works.description_zh: 长长的木棍挂在网格状排列的电机上，彼此碰撞、敲击地面，形成一片可以绕行的、摇摆作响的线之森林。
works.idea_en: A forest of long lines makes a room's height and depth legible; AR designers can use vertical elements the same way to reveal space.
works.idea_zh: 一片长线之林让房间的高度和纵深一目了然；AR 设计者也可以用竖向元素来揭示空间。
works.technique: Motors at the top of each 2.4 m stick create a small eccentric wobble that propagates down the stick, so the tips tap the floor in unpredictable patterns.
works.technique_zh: 每根 2.4 米木棍顶端的电机产生小幅偏心摆动，沿木棍向下传递，使棍尖以难以预测的方式敲击地面。
works.exercise_en: Hang 200 virtual sticks from the ceiling of a scanned room in AR Foundation, drive each with a small random pendulum motion and a knock sound on floor contact. Twist: let the sticks part like curtains as the viewer walks through.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中从扫描房间的天花板垂下 200 根虚拟木棍，用小幅随机摆动驱动，并在触地时发出敲击声。变体：观众走过时，木棍像帘子一样分开。

video.video_title: ZIMOUN - 192 Prepared DC-Motors, Wooden Sticks 2.4m, 2016-2019

works.title: A pound of flesh for 50p
works.description: A house built from 7,000 wax bricks slowly melts over a month in London, its walls and roof sagging until the structure collapses.
works.description_zh: 一座由 7000 块蜡砖砌成的房子在伦敦用一个月慢慢融化，墙和屋顶逐渐塌陷，直到整个结构倒塌。
works.idea_en: A building that changes over weeks makes time the material, a model for AR structures that decay slowly across visits.
works.idea_zh: 一座在数周内持续变化的建筑把时间变成了材料，是跨多次到访缓慢衰败的 AR 结构的范本。
works.technique: Bricks cast in wax are laid like normal masonry and heated from inside so the house deforms gradually.
works.technique_zh: 蜡制砖块像普通砖一样砌筑，从内部加热，使房屋逐渐变形。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR house on campus that melts a little each day using a vertex-displacement shader driven by the day count. Twist: speed up the melting on hotter days using live temperature.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里搭建一座 AR 房屋，用由天数驱动的顶点位移着色器让它每天融化一点；变体：用实时气温让它在热天融化得更快。

video.video_title: the movie - Melting House: A pound of flesh for 50p by Alex Chinneck

salient.why_en: A house built from wax bricks melts like a candle over a month.
salient.why_zh: 一栋用蜡砖砌成的房子，在一个月里像蜡烛一样慢慢融化。

works.title: AR Music Kit
works.description: A few printed paper cards turn a phone into a DIY instrument: when the camera sees a patterned code, the device plays the matching note, so you compose by arranging and moving paper.
works.description_zh: 几张印好的纸卡就能把手机变成一件自制乐器：摄像头看到带图案的编码时，设备就播放对应的音符，你只要排列、移动纸片就能作曲。
works.idea_en: Play music by showing paper to a phone camera.
works.idea_zh: 把纸片给手机摄像头看，就能演奏音乐。
works.technique: Printed fiducial markers are recognised by the phone's camera and each code is mapped to a sound sample.
works.technique_zh: 手机摄像头识别印刷的标记码，每个标记对应一个声音样本。
works.exercise_en: Print ArUco or image markers, recognise them in a WebAR page, and play a different sample for each marker seen. Twist: the order of markers from left to right becomes a melody.
works.exercise_zh: 打印 ArUco 码或图像标记，在 WebAR 网页中识别它们，每看到一个标记就播放一个不同的声音样本；变体：标记从左到右的排列顺序构成一段旋律。

video.video_title: AR Music Kit

works.title: AnimaStage
works.description: A tabletop stage with a hidden grid of actuators animates paper crafts and 3D-printed figures placed on it, turning hand-made props into puppets.
works.idea_zh: 在一个会动的舞台上，把纸片和手工道具变成会动的木偶。

video.video_title: Animastage

works.technique: Drives an array of linear actuators under a flexible stage surface so objects attached to it are pushed, tilted and bounced to perform scripted motions.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸板和手机振动（或小电机）做一个会抖动的纸偶舞台，并用手机AR叠加表情与台词；变化：让观众拍手的节奏驱动舞台动作。
works.description_zh: 一个桌面舞台，下方隐藏着一组执行器阵列，能让放在上面的纸艺和 3D 打印小人动起来，把手工道具变成木偶。
works.idea_en: A moving stage turns paper cutouts and handmade props into puppets.
works.technique_zh: 驱动柔性舞台表面下方的线性执行器阵列，推动、倾斜和弹跳附着在表面上的物体，让它们按脚本表演动作。
works.exercise_en: Build a shaking paper-puppet stage with cardboard and phone vibration (or a small motor), and overlay facial expressions and lines with phone AR. Twist: let the rhythm of the audience's clapping drive the stage's motion.

works.title: Anywhen
works.description: In Tate Modern's Turbine Hall, screens rise and fall, lights dim, fish balloons drift and sounds move around the space, all in a sequence partly steered by live microorganisms in a lab on site.
works.description_zh: 在泰特现代美术馆涡轮大厅，屏幕升降、灯光明灭、气球鱼漂浮、声音在空间里游走，这一切部分由现场实验室里活体微生物的反应来驱动。
works.idea_en: An exhibition can be a timeline, not a set of objects; AR experiences can choreograph when things appear, not only where.
works.idea_zh: 展览可以是一条时间线，而不是一组物件：AR 体验也可以编排「何时」出现，而不只是「何处」出现。
works.technique: A central control system triggers motorised screens, lighting rigs and speakers, with some cues driven by sensor readings from a bioreactor of microorganisms (link details likely).
works.technique_zh: 中央控制系统触发电动屏幕、灯光和音箱，其中部分指令来自微生物生物反应器的传感读数（具体联动方式为推测）。
works.exercise_en: Write a 10-minute AR 'score' for a hall: at set times, a floating screen, a light cone and a sound source appear, move and vanish, synced for every phone by the clock. Twist: let one cue be triggered by live data such as the room's noise level or the weather outside.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个大厅写一段 10 分钟的 AR「总谱」：在设定时刻，漂浮屏幕、光锥和声源依次出现、移动、消失，所有手机按时钟同步。变体：让其中一个指令由实时数据触发，比如房间噪音或室外天气。

video.video_title: Philippe Parreno: Anywhen / Turbine Hall, Tate Modern, London

works.title: Augmented Reality Linoleum Prints
