works.description: Hand-carved linoleum prints that come alive with animation when scanned, joining traditional printmaking with AR.
works.idea_zh: 传统版画与AR结合，手刻版画在镜头里活过来。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Linoleum Prints by Zenka

works.technique: High-contrast hand-carved prints serve as image targets with strong feature points, and animations are aligned to the printed forms.
works.exercise_zh: 用橡皮章或手绘做一张高对比度图案，测试它作为图像标记的识别效果，并加上对应动画；变体：印出多张有细微差异的版画，每张触发不同动画。
works.description_zh: 手工雕刻的麻胶版画在扫描时会随着动画活起来，把传统版画与 AR 结合在一起。
works.idea_en: Traditional printmaking meets AR, and hand-carved prints come alive through the lens.
works.technique_zh: 高对比度的手刻版画具有丰富的特征点，可作为图像目标，动画与印刷图形精确对齐。
works.exercise_en: Make a high-contrast pattern with a rubber stamp or by hand, test how well it is recognized as an image marker, and add a matching animation. Twist: print several slightly different copies, each triggering a different animation.

works.title: Axioma
works.description: A stereoscopic mapping show for Llum BCN festival in Barcelona: with glasses handed out before the show, points, lines, planes and polyhedra appear to float in front of the building, an interpretation of the axioms of geometry.
works.description_zh: 为巴塞罗那 Llum BCN 灯光节创作的立体投影映射：观众戴上开场前分发的眼镜，看到点、线、面和多面体悬浮在建筑前方，演绎几何学的公理。
works.idea_en: Pure geometry floating in front of a real façade shows how depth cues alone, without story, can hold an audience; AR primitives can be the content.
works.idea_zh: 纯粹的几何体悬浮在真实立面前，说明仅靠纵深线索、无需故事也能抓住观众；AR 的基本几何体本身就可以是内容。
works.technique: Stereo pairs of geometric animations are projected onto the façade; the screen plane is set at the wall so objects appear in front of and behind it.
works.technique_zh: 把几何动画的立体图像对投到立面上，零视差平面设在墙面，使物体看起来位于墙前或墙后。
works.exercise_en: In a headset or HoloKit, place a set of floating geometric primitives just in front of a real wall and animate them from point to line to plane to solid. Twist: each step only happens when two users look at the same object.
works.exercise_zh: 在头显或 HoloKit 中，把一组悬浮的几何体放在真实墙面前方，按点、线、面、体的顺序依次演化；变体：只有两位用户同时注视同一个物体时，才进入下一步。

video.video_title: Axioma - 3D Mapping for Llum BCN 2016

works.title: CPA [Consistent Partial Attention]
works.description: Three performers sight-read a choreographic score made of found internet videos of people dancing at home, playing on laptops, monitors, a projector and heads-up displays they wear, so the audience watches attention itself being split.
works.description_zh: 三位表演者现场“视奏”一份由网上居家跳舞视频拼成的编舞乐谱，乐谱播放在笔记本、显示器、投影和他们佩戴的抬头显示器上，观众看到的是被分散的注意力本身。
works.idea_en: A dance score delivered through screens, including one in front of the dancer's eye.
works.idea_zh: 通过屏幕传达的舞谱，其中一块就挂在舞者眼前。
works.technique: A digital video collage is distributed to multiple displays, including head-mounted displays, and the dancers follow it live without full rehearsal of the material.
works.technique_zh: 数字视频拼贴被分发到多块屏幕，包括头戴显示器，舞者在没有完整排练的情况下实时跟随。
works.exercise_en: Put a short dance video on a phone in a cardboard headset and have a classmate copy it live while the class watches both. Twist: play two different videos to two eyes or two phones at once.
works.exercise_zh: 把一段短舞蹈视频放进纸板头显里的手机，让同学一边看一边实时模仿，全班同时观看两者；变体：同时给两只眼睛或两部手机播放不同视频。

video.video_title: CPA [Consistent Partial Attention] - trailer of excerpts

works.title: Carte Blanche
works.description: A Unity Labs concept video for VR authoring aimed at non-programmers: users deal virtual cards to spawn objects, arrange a scene on a table-sized stage and give simple commands to a helper character.
works.description_zh: Unity Labs 面向非程序员的 VR 创作概念视频：用户像发牌一样“发出”虚拟卡片来生成物体，在桌面大小的舞台上布置场景，并给一个助手角色下达简单指令。
works.idea_en: Make world-building feel like a card game played on a tabletop.
works.idea_zh: 让搭建世界像在桌面上玩一场卡牌游戏。
works.technique: Likely a prototype where assets are represented as physical-feeling cards in a hand-tracked deck, with a miniature 'world in miniature' view for placement.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是一个原型：素材以手感真实的卡牌形式出现在可用手追踪的牌堆里，并通过“微缩世界”视图进行摆放。
works.exercise_en: Make a deck of printed image-marker cards; laying a card on the table in phone AR spawns its object in a miniature scene. Twist: stacking two cards combines their objects.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一副印有图像标记的卡牌；在手机 AR 中把卡牌放到桌上就会在微缩场景里生成对应物体。变体：叠放两张卡牌会把它们的物体组合在一起。

video.video_title: Carte Blanche concept

works.title: Cement Eclipses (Utsira)
works.description: On the Norwegian island of Utsira, Cordal places tiny cement figures of office workers on rocks, puddles and ledges, lost in a vast natural landscape.
works.description_zh: 在挪威乌特西拉岛上，Cordal 把小小的水泥上班族人偶放在岩石、水洼和岩架上，迷失在广阔的自然风景中。
works.idea_en: Tiny figures in a huge landscape reverse the usual scale, making viewers crouch and look closely, as small AR figures do.
works.idea_zh: 广阔风景中的微小人偶颠倒了通常的尺度，让观众蹲下细看，小型 AR 人偶也是如此。
works.technique: Figures are cast in cement from small sculpted models and placed on site, then photographed at ground level.
works.technique_zh: 人偶由雕塑小样翻模浇筑成水泥，放置到现场后贴地拍摄。
works.exercise_en: Place 10 tiny AR office workers on real rocks, puddles and kerbs, with occlusion so they hide behind real objects, and photograph them at ground level. Twist: they form a queue that moves toward the nearest puddle.
works.exercise_zh: 把 10 个微型 AR 上班族放在真实的石头、水洼和路缘上，并开启遮挡让它们躲在真实物体后面，贴地拍摄；变体：它们排成队伍，朝最近的水洼移动。

video.video_title: Cement Eclipses at Utsira, Norway | Isaac Cordal

works.title: ChainFORM
works.description: Modular chains with built-in touch sensing, angle sensing and LEDs that can be snapped together into shape-changing strips, wearables or creatures.
works.idea_zh: 可拼接的智能链条，能感触、显示和变形。

video.video_title: ChainFORM: A Linear Integrated Modular Hardware System for Shape Changing Interfaces

works.technique: Each module carries a servo, angle sensor, capacitive touch pad and LED on a shared bus, so a chain can both record and replay its own shape.
works.exercise_zh: 用积木或纸链条做一个“会记录形状”的原型，同时用手机AR给每一节标上颜色和数值；变化：把链条缠在手腕上变成可穿戴提醒器。
works.description_zh: 内置触摸感应、角度感应和 LED 的模块化链条，可以拼接成能变形的条带、可穿戴设备或小生物。
works.idea_en: Snap-together smart chains that can sense touch, display light and change shape.
works.technique_zh: 每个模块都在共享总线上集成了舵机、角度传感器、电容式触摸板和 LED，因此整条链既能记录也能重放自身的形状。
works.exercise_en: Build a prototype chain that "records its shape" from building blocks or paper links, and use phone AR to label each link with a color and value. Twist: wrap the chain around a wrist to make a wearable reminder.

works.title: Chicago 00: The Eastland Disaster
works.description: Along the Chicago Riverwalk, archival photographs of the 1915 capsizing of the SS Eastland are superimposed on the exact spot where it happened, in a narrated AR tour with the Chicago History Museum.
works.description_zh: 在芝加哥河滨步道上，1915 年 SS Eastland 号倾覆事故的档案照片被叠加在事发的准确位置，这是与芝加哥历史博物馆合作的一段有旁白的 AR 导览。
works.idea_en: Stand where history happened and see the archive photo aligned with the present.
works.idea_zh: 站在历史发生的地方，看档案照片与现在的景象对齐。
works.technique: Geolocated photo planes and 3D reconstructions from the museum's archive are anchored to riverwalk viewpoints in a mobile app, with a VR gallery for remote viewing.
works.technique_zh: 在移动应用中，把博物馆档案里的地理定位照片平面和 3D 重建锚定在河滨步道的观景点，另有供远程观看的 VR 画廊。
works.exercise_en: Find an old photo of a campus location, stand where it was taken, and build a phone-AR overlay that aligns it with the live view. Twist: add a slider to crossfade between past and present.
works.exercise_zh: 找一张校园某处的老照片，站到当年拍摄的位置，做一个让它与实时画面对齐的手机 AR 叠加。变体：加一个滑块，在过去与现在之间渐变。

video.video_title: Chicago00 :   The Eastland Disaster  (2016)

works.title: Cité Mémoire
works.description: A city-wide trail of about twenty projected tableaux on walls, trees and even the ground of Old Montreal, telling stories from the city's history; visitors listen to each scene through a free mobile app. The video shows the large historical tableau on the courthouse on the Champ-de-Mars.
works.description_zh: 蒙特利尔老城里一条由约二十幅投影画面组成的城市路线，投在墙面、树木甚至地面上，讲述城市历史中的故事；观众通过一个免费手机应用收听每一场的声音。视频记录的是投在战神广场法院大楼上的大型历史画面。
works.idea_en: Turning the city into a walkable anthology of site-specific scenes, with the phone carrying the sound, is a blueprint for location-based AR storytelling.
works.idea_zh: 把城市变成一本可以步行阅读的、与地点绑定的故事集，由手机负责声音，这就是基于位置的 AR 叙事蓝图。
works.technique: Permanent outdoor projectors trigger scenes on a schedule, while a geolocated app synchronises dialogue and music to what is on each wall (sync method likely timecode over the network). Created by Michel Lemieux and Victor Pilon with Michel Marc Bouchard, produced by Montréal en Histoires.
works.technique_zh: 常设的户外投影机按时间表触发各个场景，定位应用把对白和音乐与每面墙上的画面同步（同步方式可能是网络时间码）。由 Michel Lemieux、Victor Pilon 与 Michel Marc Bouchard 创作，Montréal en Histoires 制作。
works.exercise_en: Choose three spots around campus and create a short geolocated AR scene for each with 8th Wall or Niantic Lightship, each telling one moment of the campus's history. Twist: each scene shows a different decade, and the walking route is the timeline.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里选三个地点，用 8th Wall 或 Niantic Lightship 为每个地点做一段定位 AR 短场景，讲述校园历史的一个瞬间；变体：每个场景对应一个不同的年代，步行路线本身就是时间线。

video.video_title: Full Projection of Cité Mémoire’s Historical Grand tableau on Montreal's Courthouse building

works.title: CloudSkybox
works.description: A sky full of soft volumetric clouds drifts and changes, drawn entirely inside a skybox shader.
works.description_zh: 满天柔和的体积云缓缓飘动变化，全部在一个天空盒着色器里绘制。
works.idea_en: Put real volumetric clouds into the sky without any geometry.
works.idea_zh: 不用任何几何体，把真正的体积云放进天空。
works.technique: An extension of Unity's procedural skybox raymarches through a layer of animated 3D noise density and accumulates light scattering per step.
works.technique_zh: 它扩展了 Unity 的程序化天空盒，在一层动态 3D 噪声密度中做光线步进，并逐步累积光散射。
works.exercise_en: Cut a portal in a real ceiling in AR and show the volumetric cloud sky through it. Twist: link cloud density to the local weather forecast.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中给真实天花板开一个传送门，从门里看到体积云天空；变体：让云的密度跟随当地的天气预报变化。

video.video_title: CloudSkybox Test 3

works.title: Combining Shape-Changing Interfaces and Spatial AR
works.description: Projection and shape-changing objects work together so a physical object's appearance can extend and move beyond its real shape.
works.idea_zh: 投影+会变形的实物，让物体看上去能伸出自己本来的边界。

video.video_title: Combining Shape-Changing Interfaces and Spatial Augmented Reality Enables Extended Object Appearance

works.technique: Actuated objects are tracked and calibrated to a projector so that projected imagery extends the object's visible form beyond its physical shape and stays registered while it moves.
works.exercise_zh: 用一个舵机转动的纸盒和投影仪做投影映射，让投影把纸盒“延长”成一个动物，盒子动时投影的四肢跟着动；变体：让投影和实物运动故意错位，制造一个诡异的效果。
works.description_zh: 投影与可变形物体协同工作，使实体物体的外观能够延伸并运动到其真实形状之外。
works.idea_en: Projection plus a shape-changing object makes the object seem to reach past its own edges.
works.technique_zh: 对受驱动的物体进行追踪，并与投影仪标定，使投影图像把物体的可见形态延伸到其实体形状之外，且在运动中保持配准。
works.exercise_en: Do projection mapping on a servo-rotated paper box so the projection "extends" the box into an animal whose projected legs move when the box moves. Twist: deliberately misalign the projection and the physical motion to create an uncanny effect.

works.title: Control No Control
works.description: A minimal geometric structure covered in projections that react when visitors touch and move near it, shifting between order and chaos.
works.description_zh: 一座覆盖着投影的极简几何结构，观众触碰或靠近时画面会在秩序与混乱之间切换。
works.idea_en: Let the audience feel how much — and how little — control they have over a living surface.
works.idea_zh: 让观众体会自己对一个“活”表面的控制有多少、又有多少是失控的。
works.technique: Depth sensors detect hands and bodies around the structure and feed a generative system projection-mapped onto its faces (likely custom real-time software).
works.technique_zh: 深度传感器检测结构周围的手和身体，把数据送进生成式系统，再投影映射到结构各个面上（可能是自研实时软件）。
works.exercise_en: Build a cardboard pyramid, projection-map its faces, and use a webcam to detect how many people stand near it; more people means more chaotic patterns. Twist: one face ignores the crowd and only reacts to a single touch.
works.exercise_zh: 搭一个纸板金字塔并给各面做投影映射，用摄像头检测周围站了多少人，人越多图案越混乱；变体：其中一面忽略人群，只对单次触碰做出反应。

video.video_title: Control No Control by Iregular (Clip)

works.title: Crossing
works.description: Two vertical cones of light fall from ceiling projectors onto the floor; their outlines slowly cross and separate while a soundtrack plays, and visitors stand inside the beams.
works.description_zh: 天花板上的投影机向地面投下两个竖直的光锥，它们的轮廓随着声音缓慢交叉又分开，观众可以站进光束里。
works.idea_en: Projecting down instead of across turns light into standing figures: vertical volumes feel like companions, a cue for sizing AR presences to the human body.
works.idea_zh: 向下投射而不是横向投射，光就变成站立的身影：竖直的光体像是陪伴者，这提醒 AR 设计把虚拟存在的尺度对准人体。
works.technique: Ceiling-mounted projectors draw animated line drawings on the floor; haze makes the beams visible as vertical surfaces, and the sound is timed to the movement (likely a four-channel score).
works.technique_zh: 装在天花板上的投影机在地面画出动态线描，雾气让光束显现为竖直的面，声音与运动同步（可能是四声道配乐）。
works.exercise_en: Place two person-height virtual light cones in the classroom with WebXR, animate their floor outlines so they slowly cross, and add spatial audio to each. Twist: let the cones drift toward whichever student has been still the longest.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 在教室里放两个与人等高的虚拟光锥，让它们在地面上的轮廓慢慢交叉，并给每个光锥加上空间音频。变体：让光锥慢慢飘向站着不动最久的那位同学。

video.video_title: Anthony McCall introduces his light sculpture 'Crossing'

works.title: Crystal Cloud (Fête des Lumières)
works.description: The Coop Himmelb(l)au Musée des Confluences in Lyon is staged as a play between 'crystal' and 'cloud' — solid facets and soft vapour projected across its deconstructivist shell.
works.idea_zh: 在解构主义建筑上表演“水晶”与“云”的对话
works.technique: A precise 3D model of the irregular façade lets projected content switch between hard faceted lighting and soft volumetric effects.
works.exercise_zh: 用锡纸和棉花分别包两个纸盒，投影同一段动画，比较不同材质上的效果；变化：设计一段在两种材质间“迁移”的影像。

video.video_title: CRYSTAL CLOUD | Fête des Lumières 2016

works.description_zh: Coop Himmelb(l)au 设计的里昂汇流博物馆被演绎为“水晶”与“云”之间的一场对话——坚硬的切面与柔软的雾气交替投映在其解构主义外壳上。
works.idea_en: A dialogue between crystal and cloud performed on a deconstructivist building.
works.technique_zh: 依据不规则立面的精确 3D 模型，让投影内容在硬朗的切面光效与柔和的体积效果之间切换。
works.exercise_en: Wrap two paper boxes, one in foil and one in cotton, project the same animation onto both, and compare the effect on each material. Twist: design a piece of imagery that "migrates" from one material to the other.

works.title: Cubist Mirror
works.description: A screen shows the room and the people in front of it re-painted live in the style of a Cubist painting.
works.description_zh: 一块屏幕把房间和面前的人实时重绘成立体主义绘画的样子。
works.idea_en: A mirror that reflects you as a Cubist painting.
works.idea_zh: 一面把你照成立体主义画作的镜子。
works.technique: Real-time neural style transfer, a network trained on a Cubist painting, is applied frame by frame to the webcam feed.
works.technique_zh: 对摄像头画面逐帧应用实时神经风格迁移，所用网络以一幅立体主义画作训练。
works.exercise_en: Build a webcam or phone camera mirror that applies a real-time style model (for example ml5.js style transfer) chosen from three artworks. Twist: the style switches to whichever painting best matches the colours you are wearing.
works.exercise_zh: 做一面摄像头或手机镜子，从三件艺术作品中选择实时风格模型（例如 ml5.js 风格迁移）。变体：自动切换到与你衣服颜色最接近的那幅画的风格。

video.video_title: Cubist Mirror

works.title: DEEP WEB (with Robert Henke)
works.description: In a huge dark power station, 175 motorized white spheres rise and fall while laser beams hit them and draw connecting lines, forming a moving 3D web of light to a live score.
works.description_zh: 在巨大的黑暗发电厂中，175 个电动白色球体升降，激光束打在球上并连成线，随现场音乐构成不断变化的三维光网。
works.idea_en: Lines only appear when light hits an object in the air — AR can use real or virtual 'anchors' so that graphics connect points in space.
works.idea_zh: 只有当光打到空中的物体时，线条才会出现——AR 可以用真实或虚拟的“锚点”，让图形在空间中连接各个点。
works.technique: Sphere heights are driven by winches and laser projectors are calibrated to each sphere's known 3D position, so beams can jump between them.
works.technique_zh: 球的高度由绞盘控制，激光投影机按每个球的已知三维位置进行校准，使光束能在球之间跳转。
works.exercise_en: Hang a few real balls or paper lanterns, register their positions in AR, and draw animated laser-like lines between them from your phone. Twist: let the lines rewire themselves when someone walks through them.
works.exercise_zh: 挂几个真实的球或纸灯笼，在 AR 中登记它们的位置，并用手机在它们之间画出动态的“激光”连线。变体：有人穿过时让连线自动重新连接。

video.video_title: DEEP WEB - kinetic audiovisual installation and performance

works.title: Dancing with the Kinect
works.description: Two dancers move in front of a wall where their outlines are redrawn as glowing, colour-shifting contour lines that linger and overlap behind them.
works.description_zh: 两位舞者在墙前起舞，他们的轮廓被重新描绘成发光、变色的线条，在身后停留并彼此重叠。
works.idea_en: Your silhouette leaves coloured echoes on the wall.
works.idea_zh: 你的剪影在墙上留下彩色的回声。
works.technique: Kinect depth images are thresholded into body contours, and successive contours are drawn with fading colour to leave trails; the software is likely Processing or Max.
works.technique_zh: 把 Kinect 深度图阈值化为身体轮廓，再用逐渐褪色的颜色画出连续轮廓，形成拖尾；所用软件推测为 Processing 或 Max。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam with background subtraction or MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation to draw each frame's outline in a new colour and keep the last 30 outlines on screen, projected full-size. Twist: only keep outlines when the dancer freezes.
works.exercise_zh: 用网络摄像头配合背景减除或 MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation，每帧用一种新颜色描出轮廓，并在屏幕上保留最近 30 个轮廓，以真人大小投影；变体：只有舞者定格时才保留轮廓。

video.video_title: Dancing with the Kinect

works.title: Dare to Dream
works.description: Animated patterns and 'dreams' are projected onto a performer's face in real time, staying locked to her features as she moves.
works.description_zh: 动态图案和“梦境”被实时投影到表演者脸上，她移动时影像始终紧贴五官。
works.idea_en: Let dreams appear on a face as a living, tracked mask of light.
works.idea_zh: 让梦以一张被追踪的光之面具出现在脸上。
works.technique: Real-time face tracking (with Fikirbazzenger) estimates the face mesh each frame and re-renders the content from the projector's calibrated viewpoint.
works.technique_zh: 与 Fikirbazzenger 合作的实时人脸追踪每帧估计面部网格，再从标定过的投影仪视角重新渲染内容。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam face-mesh tracker and a projector aligned next to it to project a simple pattern onto a volunteer's face; calibrate with four points. Twist: the pattern reacts when the person closes their eyes.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头人脸网格追踪，配合旁边对齐的投影仪，把简单图案投到志愿者脸上，用四个点完成标定；变体：当人闭上眼睛时，图案做出反应。

video.video_title: Dare to Dream_Vodafone_Digital_Transformation / REAL-TIME FACE TRACKING & PROJECTION MAPPING

works.title: Dead Mall Chunks
works.description: Point clouds reconstructed from found videos of abandoned shopping malls float as ghostly fragments of storefronts, escalators and arcades.
works.description_zh: 从网上找到的废弃购物中心视频中重建出的点云，像幽灵一样漂浮着店面、扶梯和游戏厅的碎片。
works.idea_en: Use other people's videos to archive places that are disappearing.
works.idea_zh: 用别人拍下的视频，为正在消失的地方建档。
works.technique: Frames from walk-through videos on YouTube are processed with photogrammetry into point clouds that are then collected and rendered in 3D.
works.technique_zh: 把 YouTube 上的漫游视频逐帧提取，用摄影测量处理为点云，再收集起来在三维中渲染。
works.exercise_en: Find a public walk-through video of a place that no longer exists, reconstruct a fragment of it as a point cloud and place it in AR on your desk. Twist: add sound from the original video that plays only when you lean in.
works.exercise_zh: 找一段已不复存在的地方的公开漫游视频，把其中一段重建为点云，再以 AR 方式放到桌面上；变体：加入原视频的声音，只有靠近时才会播放。

video.video_title: Dead Mall Chunks // Front Entrance

works.title: Demonz (INITI Playground)
works.description: Kids and adults throw real balls at animated monsters projected on a large floor or wall, playing a digital version of dodgeball in the real space.
works.description_zh: 孩子和大人把真实的球扔向投在大面积地面或墙面上的动画怪物，在真实空间里玩数字版躲避球。
works.idea_en: Turn any flat surface into a giant touch screen for physical ball games.
works.idea_zh: 把任何平面变成一块巨大的触摸屏，玩真实的投球游戏。
works.technique: Motion tracking detects where balls and bodies hit the surface and the projection-mapped game responds, so the play area can scale to any size and number of players.
works.technique_zh: 运动追踪检测球和身体击中表面的位置，投影游戏随之响应，因此场地大小和玩家人数都可以任意扩展。
works.exercise_en: Project a target game on a wall and detect soft-ball hits with a webcam by frame differencing; each hit pops a creature. Twist: make creatures dodge when players aim too long.
works.exercise_zh: 在墙上投一个打靶游戏，用摄像头帧差法检测软球击中的位置，每次击中就让一只小怪物爆开；变体：玩家瞄准太久时，怪物会躲开。

video.video_title: Demonz - INITI Playground

works.title: Down the Rabbit Hole
works.description: At Blackpool's Lightpool festival, the Tower Ballroom façade becomes a portal into weightless space inspired by astronaut Tim Peake and Alice in Wonderland.
works.description_zh: 在布莱克浦灯光节上，塔楼舞厅的立面变成一个通往失重太空的入口，灵感来自宇航员 Tim Peake 和《爱丽丝梦游仙境》。
works.idea_en: A façade as a rabbit hole: the building opens onto another world.
works.idea_zh: 把立面当成兔子洞：建筑打开，通向另一个世界。
works.technique: A projection-mapped narrative renders false perspective 'openings' into the wall so the audience seems to look through it into space.
works.technique_zh: 投影叙事在墙面上渲染出假透视的“开口”，让观众仿佛透过墙面看进太空。
works.exercise_en: Create a projected 'hole' in a flat wall using forced perspective, and animate something falling into it. Twist: make the hole follow the position of the nearest viewer using a webcam.
works.exercise_zh: 用强制透视在一面平墙上投影出一个“洞”，再做一个物体掉进去的动画；变体：用摄像头让这个洞跟随最近观众的位置变化。

video.video_title: Down The Rabbit Hole

works.title: Drawing Constellation
works.description: A participatory AR drawing installation: visitors draw on phones or tablets, and each saved drawing joins a rotating galaxy of 20 or more drawings floating over a GPS-anchored site, later reappearing at other places such as a Brooklyn park.
works.description_zh: 一件参与式 AR 绘画装置：访客在手机或平板上作画，每幅保存的画都会加入一个由二十多幅画组成、在 GPS 锚定地点上空旋转的“星系”，之后又在布鲁克林公园等其他地方重新出现。
works.idea_en: Everyone's drawings orbit together as one communal sculpture in the air.
works.idea_zh: 所有人的画一起在空中环绕，组成一座公共雕塑。
works.technique: A modified Layar app uploads each drawing to a server that places it at the centre of an animated 3D constellation at a GPS location, pushing older drawings outward (made with Zachary Brady).
works.technique_zh: 改装的 Layar 应用把每幅画上传到服务器，服务器把它放在某个 GPS 位置上一个动画 3D 星座的中心，并把旧的画往外推（与 Zachary Brady 合作）。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR page where each student draws on a 2D canvas, saves, and sees their drawing added to a slowly rotating ring of everyone's drawings anchored above a table. Twist: newest drawings orbit fastest and slow down as they age.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 WebXR 页面：每位学生在 2D 画布上画画、保存，就能看到自己的画加入一个锚定在桌子上方、由所有人作品组成的缓慢旋转环；变体：最新的画转得最快，随着“变老”逐渐放慢。

video.video_title: Drawing Constellation at Maria Hernandez Park Brooklyn

works.title: Drawing on the Water Surface Created by the Dance of Koi and People - Infinity
works.description: Visitors wade knee-deep through water in a mirrored room while projected koi swim around their legs; when a koi touches a person it bursts into flowers.
works.description_zh: 观众在镜面房间里蹚着没膝的水前行，投影的锦鲤在他们腿边游动；锦鲤一碰到人，就化作一片花。
works.idea_en: Real water and projected fish together feel more alive than either alone; AR gains presence when it plays on a real material such as water or sand.
works.idea_zh: 真实的水与投影的鱼合在一起，比任何一个单独存在都更有生气：AR 叠加在水或沙这样的真实材质上时，更有在场感。
works.technique: Top-down projectors map the fish onto a shallow pool, and sensors track the legs of visitors so each fish's path and collisions respond in real time.
works.technique_zh: 顶部投影仪把鱼映射到浅水池上，传感器追踪观众的腿，让每条鱼的路线和碰撞实时反应。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone to detect a real puddle, pond or blue floor area and spawn AR koi that swim only on it and avoid the user's feet with people occlusion. Twist: every collision leaves a flower that floats for a minute.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机识别真实的水洼、池塘或蓝色地面，生成只在其上游动的 AR 锦鲤，并用人物遮挡让它们避开用户的脚。变体：每次碰撞都留下一朵漂浮一分钟的花。

video.video_title: Drawing on the Water Surface Created by the Dance of Koi and People - Infinity

works.title: Dynamic Projection Mapping onto Deforming Non-Rigid Surfaces
works.description: Images are projected onto cloth and paper as they fold and stretch, tracked at high speed so textures appear printed on the moving material.
works.idea_zh: 布料怎么揉捏折叠，投影的图案就怎么跟着变形，像印上去一样。

video.video_title: Dynamic projection mapping onto deforming non-rigid surface

works.technique: Invisible IR ink markers on the deformable surface are tracked by a high-speed camera, the surface mesh is reconstructed from the dot grid each frame, and the texture is warped onto it and projected by a high-speed projector.
works.exercise_zh: 在一块布或 T 恤上画一个点阵网格，用摄像头检测网格点（OpenCV 斑点检测），把图案按网格变形后投影回去，让投影随布料褶皱弯曲；变体：投影一件“会动的印花”，比如游动的鱼。
works.description_zh: 在布料和纸张折叠、拉伸的同时向其投射图像，借助高速追踪，纹理看起来就像印在运动的材料上一样。
works.idea_en: However the cloth is crumpled or folded, the projected pattern bends with it as if printed on.
works.technique_zh: 高速相机追踪可变形表面上肉眼不可见的红外墨水标记，每帧根据点阵重建表面网格，把纹理变形贴合上去，再由高速投影仪投射出来。
works.exercise_en: Draw a dot grid on a piece of cloth or a T-shirt, detect the grid points with a camera (OpenCV blob detection), warp a pattern to the grid, and project it back so it bends with the folds of the fabric. Twist: project a "moving print," such as swimming fish.

works.title: Dynamic VR Display
works.description: A head-tracked display setup in which 3D graphics are re-rendered from the viewer's eye position in real time, so flat screens combined with physical objects read as a continuous 3D space.
works.idea_zh: 跟踪观看者头部位置实时重绘画面，让平面屏幕与实物融成立体空间。

video.video_title: Dynamic VR Display (Rhizomatiks Research)

works.technique: Head tracking feeds an off-axis (asymmetric frustum) projection so each display renders the scene from the viewer's eye position, making flat screens behave like windows into a consistent 3D space.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 估计头部位置，在 three.js 里做离轴投影，让笔记本屏幕变成一个有深度的“窗口盒子”；变体：盒子里放一个只有从特定角度看才能拼完整的物体或文字。
works.description_zh: 一套头部追踪显示装置，根据观看者眼睛的位置实时重新渲染 3D 图形，让平面屏幕与实体物体组合在一起时，看起来像一个连续的立体空间。
works.idea_en: Tracking the viewer's head and redrawing the image in real time merges flat screens and real objects into one 3D space.
works.technique_zh: 头部追踪数据输入离轴（非对称视锥）投影，使每块显示屏都从观看者眼睛的位置渲染场景，让平面屏幕像是通往同一个一致 3D 空间的窗口。
works.exercise_en: Estimate head position with MediaPipe Face Mesh and build an off-axis projection in three.js so a laptop screen becomes a "window box" with depth. Twist: put an object or text in the box that only comes together from one particular angle.

works.title: Earthtime 1.8 London
works.description: Over Oxford Circus in London, a net sculpture whose form comes from data of the 2011 Japan earthquake hangs above the crossing and glows in shifting colours at night.
works.description_zh: 在伦敦牛津广场的十字路口上空，一座造型源自 2011 年日本地震数据的网状雕塑悬挂着，夜里在变化的色彩中发光。
works.idea_en: Scientific data can become a form that floats over daily life; AR can lift abstract datasets into the air above the places people pass every day.
works.idea_zh: 科学数据可以化为漂浮在日常生活之上的形体；AR 可以把抽象的数据集抬升到人们每天经过的地方上空。
works.technique: The net's shape is derived from a model of the tsunami's wave propagation, knitted from fibre and suspended from surrounding buildings, with programmed lighting.
works.technique_zh: 网的形状来自海啸波传播模型，用纤维编织而成，悬挂在周围建筑之间，并配有程序控制的灯光。
works.exercise_en: Turn a real dataset (earthquake waves, rainfall, commuting) into a 3D surface and hang it in AR above a busy crossing so passers-by see it overhead. Twist: update the surface live with today's value of that dataset.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个真实数据集（地震波、降雨、通勤人数）转成三维曲面，用 AR 挂在繁忙路口上空，让路人抬头看到。变体：用该数据集当天的数值实时更新曲面。

video.video_title: "Earthtime 1.8 London," UK (2016)

works.title: Echo (Flip-Discs)
works.description: A wall of flip-discs clatters to mirror the silhouette of a person moving in front of it, leaving a fading echo of their motion.
works.description_zh: 一面翻片墙哗啦作响地映出面前移动之人的剪影，并留下他们动作逐渐消散的“回声”。
works.idea_en: A low-resolution mirror with sound is more magical than a perfect one — AR body effects can be coarse if they are tactile and audible.
works.idea_zh: 带声音的低分辨率镜子比完美的镜子更有魔力——只要有触感和声响，AR 身体效果可以很粗糙。
works.technique: A camera or depth sensor segments the viewer; the silhouette is downsampled to the flip-disc grid, with a decay so past frames linger.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头或深度传感器分割出观众，剪影被降采样到翻片网格上，并加入衰减让之前的帧残留一会儿。
works.exercise_en: Build a Lens Studio or AR Foundation effect that turns the camera's person segmentation into a grid of flipping discs with a click sound per flip. Twist: make the discs lag behind so users see their own recent past.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation 做一个效果，把摄像头的人像分割变成一格格翻转的圆片，每翻一片发出一声咔嗒。变体：让圆片延迟翻转，用户能看见自己刚才的样子。

video.video_title: Echo - Flip-Discs Kinetic Artwork

salient.why_en: A wall of flip-discs clatters into your silhouette and keeps a fading echo of how you just moved.
salient.why_zh: 一面翻转圆片墙哗啦啦地翻出你的剪影，还留着你刚才动作的渐渐消失的回声。

works.title: EditorVR
works.description: On stage at the Vision VR/AR Summit, West puts on a headset and builds a Unity scene from inside VR, grabbing assets from floating panels and placing them with tracked controllers.
works.description_zh: 在 Vision VR/AR 峰会的舞台上，West 戴上头显，在 VR 内部搭建 Unity 场景：从漂浮的面板里抓取素材，用追踪手柄把它们放到场景中。
works.idea_en: Build spatial content where it will be experienced, with your hands, instead of on a flat monitor.
works.idea_zh: 在内容将被体验的空间里用双手创作，而不是在平面显示器上。
works.technique: The Unity editor's scene hierarchy, inspector and asset browser are re-exposed as 3D workspaces attached to the controllers, editing the same scene data as the desktop editor.
works.technique_zh: 把 Unity 编辑器的场景层级、属性面板和资源浏览器重新做成附着在手柄上的 3D 工作区，编辑的是与桌面编辑器相同的场景数据。
works.exercise_en: Design and paper-prototype a three-panel VR editing tool for arranging furniture, then build one panel in WebXR. Twist: every tool must be operable with one hand.
works.exercise_zh: 为摆放家具设计一个三面板的 VR 编辑工具并做纸面原型，再用 WebXR 实现其中一个面板。变体：每个工具都必须能单手操作。

video.video_title: Unity VR Editor Tool Demo with Timoni West

works.title: Enthusiast Overlay
works.description: Twelve tennis balls hang in front of an AR screen; on the screen each ball gets a rough, hand-drawn comic face and body that bounces with endless enthusiasm, like the internet's 'realistic doodles' drawn over video clips.
works.description_zh: 十二个网球悬挂在一块 AR 屏幕前；屏幕上每个网球都被加上潦草的手绘漫画脸和身体，永不停歇地热情蹦跳，就像网上那种在视频上乱涂的“写实涂鸦”。
works.idea_en: Scribbled cartoon characters bring ordinary hanging objects to life on a see-through screen.
works.idea_zh: 潦草的卡通角色让普通的悬挂物在屏幕中活了过来。
works.technique: A camera behind the screen likely tracks each suspended ball and pins pre-drawn, loosely animated doodle sprites to its position in real time.
works.technique_zh: 屏幕后的摄像头很可能实时追踪每个悬挂的网球，并把预先画好、动作松散的涂鸦动画贴在球的位置上。
works.exercise_en: Hang a few coloured balls on strings, track them by colour with a webcam in p5.js, and draw a scribbled face that sticks to each ball on a monitor placed in front. Twist: make each character react when two balls touch.
works.exercise_zh: 用绳子挂几个彩色小球，在 p5.js 里用摄像头按颜色追踪它们，并在前方显示器上给每个球画一张跟随的涂鸦脸；变体：两个球相碰时让角色做出反应。

video.video_title: Enthusiast Overlay

salient.why_en: Hanging tennis balls get scribbled cartoon faces and bodies and bounce around with endless enthusiasm.
salient.why_zh: 悬挂的网球被画上潦草的卡通脸和身体，带着无尽的热情蹦来蹦去。

works.title: ExoSkin
works.description: A hybrid fabrication system for designing and 3D-printing wearables directly on the body, combining on-body modelling with printing onto a body-shaped surface.
works.idea_zh: 直接在身体上设计并打印可穿戴物。

video.video_title: ExoSkin by Madeline Gannon, Tovi Grossman, and George Fitzmaurice :: Supported by FRFAF

works.technique: Scans the body part, lets the designer model around it in 3D, and prints the wearable in place on a body-shaped form.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机扫描同学的手腕（Polycam等），在3D软件里围绕模型画一条饰带并用纸条按比例还原；变化：在AR中先试戴再制作。
works.description_zh: 一套混合式制造系统，可以直接在身体上设计并 3D 打印可穿戴物，把贴身建模与在人体形状表面上打印结合起来。
works.idea_en: Design and print wearables directly on the body.
works.technique_zh: 扫描身体部位，让设计者围绕它进行 3D 建模，再在人体形状的模具上原位打印可穿戴物。
works.exercise_en: Scan a classmate's wrist with a phone (Polycam or similar), draw a band around the model in 3D software, and recreate it to scale with paper strips. Twist: try it on in AR before making it.

works.title: Fencing Visualized
works.description: An AR sports-broadcast system that tracks the tips of fencing swords and draws their trajectories over live footage so audiences can follow the fast bouts.
works.idea_zh: 把剑尖轨迹实时叠加在直播画面上，让看不清的击剑变得可见

video.video_title: Yuki Ota Fencing Visualized Project - MORE ENJOY FENCING（English Ver.）

works.technique: Computer vision (likely multi-camera marker-less tracking with deep learning) localises the sword tips in each frame, and their 3D trajectories are rendered as trails over the broadcast camera image.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands 或颜色追踪记录挥动一支彩色笔的轨迹，在视频上叠加渐隐的光带；变体：选一项你熟悉的快速动作（拍球、打字、翻书）做“可视化转播”。
works.description_zh: 一套 AR 体育转播系统，追踪击剑剑尖并把其运动轨迹绘制在直播画面上，让观众能够看清快速的交锋。
works.idea_en: Blade-tip trails drawn live over the broadcast make hard-to-see fencing visible.
works.technique_zh: 计算机视觉（可能是基于深度学习的多相机无标记追踪）在每一帧中定位剑尖，并把其 3D 轨迹渲染为叠加在转播画面上的拖尾。
works.exercise_en: Record the trajectory of a waving colored pen with MediaPipe Hands or color tracking, and overlay a fading band of light on the video. Twist: pick a fast motion you know well (bouncing a ball, typing, flipping pages) and make a "visualized broadcast" of it.

salient.why_en: Sword tips too fast to see are drawn as trails over live footage, so the bout becomes readable.
salient.why_zh: 快得看不清的剑尖被画成轨迹叠在直播画面上，比赛一下子看懂了。

works.title: Flipbook
works.description: A live 3D scene is sliced into pages that flip over like a book, each page freezing a moment of the animation.
works.description_zh: 实时 3D 场景被切成一页页，像书一样翻过，每一页都定格了动画的一个瞬间。
works.idea_en: Turn time into pages of a physical book.
works.idea_zh: 把时间变成一本实体书的书页。
works.technique: Frames are captured into a ring of render textures, and a vertex shader bends page meshes around a spine with speed parameters controlling the flip.
works.technique_zh: 画面被截取到一组循环使用的渲染纹理里，顶点着色器让书页网格绕书脊弯曲翻动，速度参数控制翻页。
works.exercise_en: Record the AR camera view into pages and flip them on a virtual book lying on a real desk. Twist: let the viewer turn pages by swiping in the air with hand tracking.
works.exercise_zh: 把 AR 相机画面录成书页，在一本放在真实桌面上的虚拟书上翻动；变体：用手部追踪，让观众在空中挥手翻页。

works.title: Flock: A Holojam Experience
works.description: David Lobser's co-located Holojam piece where participants become birds and create a flock together in shared space.
works.idea_zh: 一群人在共享空间里一起变成鸟群。

video.video_title: Flock: A Holojam Experience at FoST FEST

works.technique: Each participant's tracked position drives a bird avatar, and boids-style flocking rules (separation, alignment, cohesion) generate additional birds that respond to the participants' movements.
works.exercise_zh: 在 three.js 中实现 boids 鸟群，用摄像头检测到的人的位置作为“领头鸟”，投影到墙上或在 AR 中显示；变体：让鸟群对不同人的动作速度做出吸引或逃离的反应。
works.description_zh: David Lobser 创作的一件同场 Holojam 作品，参与者化身为鸟，在共享空间中一起组成鸟群。
works.idea_en: A group of people become a flock of birds together in a shared space.
works.technique_zh: 每位参与者被追踪的位置驱动一个鸟形化身，boids 式集群规则（分离、对齐、聚合）生成更多鸟，并对参与者的动作做出反应。
works.exercise_en: Implement a boids flock in three.js, use people's positions detected by a camera as "lead birds," and project it on a wall or show it in AR. Twist: make the flock be drawn to or flee from each person depending on how fast they move.

works.title: Fluid2D Blur Image Effect
works.description: A GPU fluid simulation smears and swirls the rendered image, so moving the mouse stirs the picture like ink in water.
works.description_zh: 一个 GPU 流体模拟把渲染画面涂抹、搅动，移动鼠标就像在水里搅墨一样搅动画面。
works.idea_en: Use a fluid simulation as a brush that distorts the screen image.
works.idea_zh: 把流体模拟当作画笔，用来扭曲屏幕画面。
works.technique: A 2D Navier-Stokes solver (ported from haxiomic's GPU Fluid Experiments) runs on render textures, and its velocity field offsets and blurs the camera image in a post-processing pass.
works.technique_zh: 一个二维 Navier-Stokes 解算器（移植自 haxiomic 的 GPU Fluid Experiments）在渲染纹理上运行，其速度场在后期处理中偏移并模糊相机画面。
works.exercise_en: Feed the AR camera image into the effect and let finger drags stir the real world like liquid paint. Twist: drive the fluid with optical flow so people walking past stir the image themselves.
works.exercise_zh: 把 AR 相机画面送进这个特效，让手指拖动像搅动液体颜料一样搅动真实世界。变体：用光流驱动流体，让路过的人自己搅动画面。

video.video_title: Fluid2DBlurImageEffectDemo

works.title: Forest of Resonating Lamps - One Stroke
works.description: Hundreds of Murano glass lamps hang in a mirrored room; when someone stands still near a lamp, it glows and its colour spreads lamp by lamp through the whole forest.
works.description_zh: 数百盏穆拉诺玻璃灯挂在镜面房间里；有人在某盏灯旁静止站立时，它就亮起，颜色一盏接一盏传遍整片灯林。
works.idea_en: A single local action that ripples through a whole system shows one person's influence at room scale; AR can propagate a tap into a visible chain reaction.
works.idea_zh: 一个局部动作在整个系统中荡开，把一个人的影响放大到房间尺度：AR 也可以把一次点击传播成看得见的连锁反应。
works.technique: Each lamp is individually addressable and lights by proximity sensing, then triggers its nearest neighbours in turn, a spreading algorithm like a wave on a graph.
works.technique_zh: 每盏灯都可以单独控制，靠近感应触发亮起，再依次触发最近的相邻灯，像在图结构上传播的波。
works.exercise_en: Place 100 AR lamps around the user; the lamp the user gazes at for two seconds lights, then passes its light to its three nearest neighbours every 0.3 s until all are lit. Twist: two users starting waves in different colours see where the colours meet and mix.
works.exercise_zh: 在用户周围放 100 盏 AR 灯；被注视两秒的灯亮起，每 0.3 秒把光传给最近的三盏，直到全部点亮。变体：两位用户用不同颜色发起光波，看颜色在哪里相遇、混合。

video.video_title: Forest of Resonating Lamps - One Stroke

works.title: Fragments
works.description: A HoloLens crime thriller that maps your home and stages the investigation inside it: life-size characters sit on your real furniture and clues and memory reconstructions appear in your room.
works.idea_zh: 把真实家里变成犯罪调查现场，虚拟角色坐在你的沙发上。

video.video_title: Microsoft HoloLens: Fragments

works.technique: Spatial mapping classifies seats, tables and floors in the home, and the story system places characters and clues on matching surfaces, so each room produces a different staging.
works.exercise_zh: 检测房间里的水平面，把一个“案发现场”的线索分别放在最高和最低的平面上；变体：让一个 AR 角色坐在真实椅子上讲述案情。
works.description_zh: 一款 HoloLens 犯罪惊悚游戏，会扫描你的家并把调查过程搬进其中：真人大小的角色坐在你真实的家具上，线索和记忆重现场景出现在你的房间里。
works.idea_en: Your real home becomes a crime scene, with virtual characters sitting on your sofa.
works.technique_zh: 空间映射对家中的座位、桌子和地面进行分类，故事系统把角色和线索放到相匹配的表面上，因此每个房间都会产生不同的场景布置。
works.exercise_en: Detect the horizontal surfaces in a room and place the clues of a "crime scene" on the highest and lowest ones. Twist: have an AR character sit on a real chair and describe the case.

works.title: Gallery Invasion
works.description: In a room hung with paintings, a character escapes from one canvas, runs along the walls, jumps between frames and knocks things over, all as a projection that moves around the room.
works.description_zh: 在一个挂满画的房间里，一个角色从一幅画中逃出来，沿着墙跑，在画框之间跳跃、撞倒东西，整个过程是一束在房间里移动的投影。
works.idea_en: When content can leave its frame and travel through the room, the room becomes the interface; AR can let characters jump from a poster into space the same way.
works.idea_zh: 当内容能离开画框、在房间里穿行时，房间本身就成了界面；AR 也可以同样让角色从海报跳进空间。
works.technique: Dynamic projection mapping: a motorized Mirror Head (Dynamic Projection Institute) steers the projector beam around the room, synchronized with a motion-captured 3D animation mapped to each wall and painting.
works.technique_zh: 动态投影映射：电动镜头装置 Mirror Head（Dynamic Projection Institute）引导投影光束在房间里移动，与映射到每面墙和每幅画上的动作捕捉 3D 动画同步。
works.exercise_en: Use image tracking on two posters in the classroom and make an AR character leap from one poster, walk along the detected wall and dive into the other. Twist: the character carries a colour from the first poster and repaints part of the second.
works.exercise_zh: 对教室里两张海报做图像追踪，让一个 AR 角色从一张海报跳出，沿着检测到的墙面走过去，钻进另一张；变体：角色从第一张海报带走一种颜色，把第二张的一部分重新上色。

video.video_title: Gallery Invasion

salient.why_en: A painted character escapes its frame and runs around the gallery walls.
salient.why_zh: 画里的角色逃出画框，在展厅的墙上四处乱跑。

works.title: Gardens of the Anthropocene
works.description: AR plants mutated by climate change (such as giant red algae) grow over real harbours and gardens.
works.idea_zh: 气候变化下变异的植物在真实港湾里生长

video.video_title: Garden of the Anthropocene - Giant Red Algae in Salem Harbor

works.technique: Geolocated and plane-anchored 3D plant models (built in Unity, shown via Layar) are placed over real harbours and gardens at plausible scale.
works.exercise_zh: 为校园里的一种真实植物设计它在 2100 年气候下的“变异版”，用 AR 放在原植物旁边；变体：加一个时间滑块，让植物从现在逐渐变异到未来。
works.description_zh: 因气候变化而变异的 AR 植物（如巨型红藻）生长在真实的港湾和花园之上。
works.idea_en: Plants mutated by climate change grow in a real harbor.
works.technique_zh: 基于地理位置和平面锚定的 3D 植物模型（用 Unity 制作，通过 Layar 展示）以合理的比例放置在真实的港湾和花园上。
works.exercise_en: Design a "mutated version" of a real plant on campus as it might look under the climate of 2100, and place it next to the original in AR. Twist: add a time slider so the plant gradually mutates from now into the future.

works.title: Giants, Rio 2016
works.description: During the Rio Olympics, JR installed giant photographs of athletes on scaffolds across the city, such as a high jumper appearing to leap over a building.
works.description_zh: 里约奥运会期间，JR 在城市各处的脚手架上安装运动员的巨幅照片，例如一位跳高运动员仿佛从一栋建筑上方跃过。
works.idea_en: A body frozen in mid-action at the scale of a building makes the city part of the movement, a trick for AR motion stills.
works.idea_zh: 一个在动作中被定格、尺度与建筑相当的身体，让城市成为动作的一部分，这是 AR 动作定格的技巧。
works.technique: Cut-out photographic prints were mounted on scaffolding and positioned so the athlete appears to interact with real buildings.
works.technique_zh: 剪裁的照片印刷品安装在脚手架上，并经过定位，使运动员看起来与真实建筑产生互动。
works.exercise_en: Capture a classmate mid-jump with body segmentation and place the cut-out at building scale so they appear to leap over a real rooftop in AR. Twist: shoot a sequence and play it as a slow flip-book as the viewer walks along the street.
works.exercise_zh: 用人体分割捕捉一位同学跳跃的瞬间，把剪影以建筑尺度放置，让他在 AR 中看起来正跃过真实屋顶；变体：拍一组连续画面，让观者沿街行走时像慢速翻页书一样播放。

video.video_title: JR on Giants: Olympics, Rio de Janeiro

works.title: GlassHands
works.description: A phone's front camera sees the user's hands above and around the phone reflected in their own eyeglasses, turning the space around the device into an input area.
works.description_zh: 手机前置摄像头通过用户自己眼镜上的反射，看到手机上方和周围的双手，把设备周围的空间变成输入区域。
works.idea_en: Use the user's eyeglasses as a mirror to extend the camera's view.
works.idea_zh: 把用户的眼镜当作镜子，扩展摄像头的视野。
works.technique: The front camera detects the reflection in the lenses of the user's glasses, rectifies it using the lens curvature and tracks hands in the reflected image.
works.technique_zh: 前置摄像头检测用户眼镜镜片中的反射图像，根据镜片曲率进行校正，并在反射图像中追踪双手。
works.exercise_en: Place a small mirror at an angle near a laptop webcam to see the desk, and use hand tracking on the reflection to control a slider. Twist: use a spoon as the mirror.
works.exercise_zh: 在笔记本摄像头旁斜放一面小镜子，让它看到桌面，并在反射画面上用手部追踪控制一个滑杆。变体：用勺子当镜子。

video.video_title: GlassHands

works.title: Graffiti Nature
works.description: Drawn animals and plants are scanned into a projected room-sized ecosystem where they eat each other and flee when visitors step on them.
works.idea_zh: 画出的动物进入会被踩、会捕食的投影生态

video.video_title: Graffiti Nature

works.technique: Scanned drawings become agents in a projected ecosystem simulation (predator-prey rules), and floor-facing depth sensors detect footsteps that make creatures flee or die.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 做一个简单的捕食模拟，每个同学画的生物扫描后成为其中一个个体，投影到地面并用摄像头检测脚步；变体：被踩“死”的生物会变成养分，长出新的植物。
works.description_zh: 手绘的动物和植物被扫描进一个投影在整个房间里的生态系统，它们彼此捕食，被观众踩到时会逃开。
works.idea_en: Drawn animals enter a projected ecosystem where they hunt and can be stepped on.
works.technique_zh: 扫描后的绘画成为投影生态模拟（捕食者与猎物规则）中的个体，朝向地面的深度传感器检测脚步，使生物逃跑或死亡。
works.exercise_en: Build a simple predator-prey simulation in p5.js where each creature a classmate draws is scanned in as one individual, project it on the floor, and detect footsteps with a camera. Twist: creatures stepped "to death" become nutrients that grow new plants.

works.title: Gravity and Grace
works.description: A huge perforated metal vase with an intense light inside slowly rises and falls in a dark room, throwing patterns of flowers and figures across the walls, floor and visitors.
works.description_zh: 一只巨大的镂空金属花瓶内有强光，在黑暗房间中缓慢升降，把花朵与人物的图案投满墙面、地面和观众身上。
works.idea_en: A single light inside a patterned shell can fill every surface of a room, including people — AR light projection should land on bodies too.
works.idea_zh: 镂空外壳里的一盏灯就能照满房间的每个表面，包括人身——AR 光投射也应该落在身体上。
works.technique: An extremely bright lamp inside a pierced metal vessel acts as a pattern projector; moving the light vertically changes the scale of the shadows.
works.technique_zh: 镂空金属容器里的高亮灯充当图案投影器；灯的上下移动改变阴影的尺度。
works.exercise_en: Place a virtual lantern with a cut-out pattern in the centre of a real room and project its light patterns onto walls and people using body segmentation. Twist: let the lantern pattern change based on who stands closest.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实房间中央放一盏带镂空图案的虚拟灯笼，借助人体分割把光斑图案投到墙面和人身上。变体：根据谁站得最近来改变灯笼的图案。

video.video_title: Gravity and Grace / Aichi Triennial 2016

works.title: Guided group beach mandala
works.description: Amador leads a group of participants who rake a large mandala together on the beach, each person responsible for part of the pattern.
works.description_zh: Amador 带领一群参与者在海滩上一起耙出一个巨大的曼陀罗，每人负责图案的一部分。
works.idea_en: Splitting a big image into simple local tasks lets strangers co-create, a model for multi-user AR drawing sessions.
works.idea_zh: 把一张大图拆成简单的局部任务，让陌生人也能共同创作，是多人 AR 绘画会话的范本。
works.technique: Each participant gets a sector and a simple instruction; the radial layout keeps everyone's parts aligned.
works.technique_zh: 每位参与者分到一个扇区和一条简单指令；径向布局让大家的部分保持对齐。
works.exercise_en: Run a shared AR drawing session where each student is assigned one sector of a ground mandala and can only draw inside it. Twist: sectors rotate every five minutes so everyone finishes someone else's work.
works.exercise_zh: 开展一次共享 AR 绘画会话，给每位学生分配地面曼陀罗的一个扇区，只能在其中作画；变体：每五分钟轮换扇区，让每个人都去完成别人的作品。

video.video_title: Guided group beach mandala

works.title: HYPER-REALITY
works.description: A POV short in Medellín where a woman's view is saturated with AR ads, game points and assistant UI; when her identity is hacked the overlay collapses.
works.idea_zh: 当AR完全接管视野，现实被游戏化与广告化后的眩晕与脆弱

video.video_title: HYPER-REALITY

works.technique: POV footage camera-tracked and composited with dense 3D UI layers; can be approximated live with phone world tracking plus a large number of world- and screen-space UI elements that collapse on an event.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 里把一条走廊塞满广告、游戏积分和助手提示，拍一段第一人称视频；变体：设计一个“身份被盗”的瞬间，让所有界面同时崩溃或变成陌生人的界面。
works.description_zh: 一部以麦德林为背景的第一人称短片：一位女性的视野被 AR 广告、游戏积分和助手界面塞满；当她的身份被黑客盗取时，叠加层随之崩塌。
works.idea_en: The dizziness and fragility of a reality turned into games and ads once AR takes over your whole view.
works.technique_zh: 对第一人称视角的实拍素材进行摄像机追踪，并合成密集的 3D 界面层；可以用手机世界追踪加上大量世界空间和屏幕空间的界面元素实时近似，并在某个事件发生时让它们一起崩溃。
works.exercise_en: Fill a hallway in phone AR with ads, game points and assistant prompts, and shoot a first-person video. Twist: design a moment of "identity theft" when every interface crashes at once or turns into a stranger's interface.

works.title: Hag-Seed interactive
works.description: An installation with Margaret Atwood for the London Literature Festival: text from her novel Hag-Seed becomes projected scenes that visitors play with using their bodies.
works.idea_zh: 把小说文字变成可以用身体玩的投影场景。

video.video_title: Hag-seed interactive

works.technique: Camera or depth-based body segmentation gives silhouettes and motion, which are used as collision shapes and forces for animated text particles in a projected scene.
works.exercise_zh: 选一首诗，把每个词变成投影墙上的物理粒子，用 MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation 的人体轮廓把词推散或接住；变体：只有两个人合作用身体搭出“容器”时，诗句才会按顺序排好。
works.description_zh: 与 Margaret Atwood 为伦敦文学节合作的装置：她的小说《Hag-Seed》中的文字化为投影场景，观众可以用身体与之互动。
works.idea_en: Turn the words of a novel into a projected scene you play with your body.
works.technique_zh: 基于相机或深度的人体分割提供轮廓和运动信息，用作投影场景中动画文字粒子的碰撞形状和作用力。
works.exercise_en: Choose a poem, turn each word into a physics particle on a projection wall, and use the body outline from MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation to push the words apart or catch them. Twist: the lines fall into order only when two people work together to form a "container" with their bodies.

works.title: HoloARt: Painting with Holograms
works.description: Judith Amores and Pattie Maes let users paint with hand gestures in HoloLens, splashing holographic paint that sticks to and drips on real surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 在真实房间里用手甩出全息颜料，颜料会粘在真实墙面上。

video.video_title: HoloARt: Painting with Holograms in Mixed Reality

works.technique: HoloLens spatial mapping provides a mesh of the room, and hand gestures spawn paint particles whose collisions with the mesh leave decals and drip simulations on real surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 的 Meshing（LiDAR iPhone）或平面检测，让手机点击屏幕发射颜料球，碰到真实表面后留下贴花并缓慢下流；变体：颜料的颜色或粘稠度由声音大小或手机倾斜角度控制。
works.description_zh: Judith Amores 和 Pattie Maes 让用户在 HoloLens 中用手势作画，泼出的全息颜料会粘在真实表面上并往下滴。
works.idea_en: Fling holographic paint with your hands in a real room, and it sticks to the real walls.
works.technique_zh: HoloLens 空间映射提供房间网格，手势生成颜料粒子，粒子与网格碰撞后在真实表面上留下贴花并进行滴落模拟。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation Meshing (on a LiDAR iPhone) or plane detection so tapping the screen fires paint balls that leave decals on real surfaces and slowly drip down. Twist: control the paint's color or thickness with sound volume or the phone's tilt.

works.title: HoloStudio
works.description: Build 3D models in 3D with holographic tools modelled on real ones, then send them to a 3D printer to become physical objects.
works.idea_zh: 用手势在空中搭建3D模型，再打印成实物。

video.video_title: Microsoft HoloLens:  HoloStudio

works.technique: Provides a toolbelt of primitive shapes and holographic tools manipulated with gaze and air-tap, exporting printable meshes.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR（如Reality Composer）拼搭一个桌面雕塑，截图导出后用纸板/黏土做实体版本；变化：规定只能使用三种基本形状。
works.description_zh: 借助仿照真实工具设计的全息工具，在三维空间中直接搭建 3D 模型，再发送到 3D 打印机，变成实体物品。
works.idea_en: Build 3D models in the air with gestures, then print them as real objects.
works.technique_zh: 提供一套由基本形体和全息工具组成的工具带，通过注视和空中点击操作，并可导出可打印的网格。
works.exercise_en: Assemble a tabletop sculpture in phone AR (e.g., Reality Composer), export screenshots, and make a physical version from cardboard or clay. Twist: allow only three basic shapes.

works.title: Holographic Type Sculpture
works.description: A tall sculpture of floating words and letterforms placed with HoloLens in the atrium and rooftop sculpture garden of the Bellevue Arts Museum; it stands among the physical artworks but is visible only through the headset, and each piece of type can be moved or rotated.
works.description_zh: 用 HoloLens 放置在贝尔维尤艺术博物馆中庭和屋顶雕塑花园里的一座高大“文字雕塑”，由漂浮的单词和字母组成；它立在实体艺术品之间，却只有戴上头显才能看到，每一块文字都可以被移动或旋转。
works.idea_en: An invisible artwork added to a real museum: AR as digital graffiti in the gallery.
works.idea_zh: 在真实美术馆里加上一件看不见的作品：AR 就是展厅里的数字涂鸦。
works.technique: Built with the author's Typography Insight app for HoloLens: 3D text objects are placed and anchored with HoloLens spatial mapping and world anchors, and recorded with Mixed Reality Capture.
works.technique_zh: 用作者自己的 Typography Insight for HoloLens 制作：借助 HoloLens 的空间映射和世界锚点放置并固定 3D 文字，再用混合现实捕捉录制视频。
works.exercise_en: Use persistent anchors in AR Foundation or WebXR to place a stack of 3D words as a 'sculpture' in a public corner of campus that only phone viewers can see. Twist: every visitor can add one word, so the sculpture grows over the week.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 或 WebXR 的持久化锚点，在校园某个公共角落放置一座由 3D 单词堆成的“雕塑”，只有用手机才能看到；变体：每位来访者都可以加一个词，让雕塑在一周内不断长高。

video.video_title: Holographic Type Sculpture (2016) for HoloLens

works.title: Holographic ribbons for VRDG+H
works.description: A floating statue and ribbons appear as virtual images in mid-air using a holographic optical setup, animated to DUB-Russell's music at the VRDG+H show.
works.idea_zh: 用光学'虚像'让 Unity 做的雕像和缎带悬浮在空中随音乐舞动。

video.video_title:
像とリボンは虚像。ホログラフィーの使い方が分かってきて楽しくなってきました！3/26 VRDG+H ではこれが DUB-Russell の音に乗って暴れます💥💥💥
https://t.co/o5MyM7fKGw https://t.co/NLB81mzBO1

works.technique: Unity renders are shown through a holographic / Pepper's-ghost-style optical element so the image is perceived as a virtual image floating in space (likely a half-mirror or holographic screen).
works.exercise_zh: 用一块斜放的透明亚克力和手机屏幕做佩珀尔幻象，让一个 3D 小雕像悬浮；加一个变化：拍手时缎带绕着它旋转。
works.description_zh: 在 VRDG+H 演出中，借助全息光学装置，一座雕像和几条缎带以虚像的形式悬浮在半空，随 DUB-Russell 的音乐舞动。
works.idea_en: An optical virtual image makes a Unity statue and ribbons float in the air and dance to music.
works.technique_zh: Unity 渲染的画面经由全息或佩珀尔幻象类光学元件呈现，使图像被感知为悬浮在空间中的虚像（可能是半透镜或全息屏幕）。
works.exercise_en: Make a Pepper's ghost with a tilted sheet of clear acrylic and a phone screen so a small 3D statue appears to float. Twist: ribbons spin around it when you clap.

works.title: Holoportation
works.description: Rings of depth cameras capture people in full 3D and stream them live into HoloLens, so a remote person appears life-size in your room; conversations can be recorded and replayed at miniature scale.
works.idea_zh: 把远方的人实时'传送'成真人大小的全息影像站在你面前。

video.video_title: Holoportation: Virtual 3D Teleportation in Real-Time

works.technique: Multiple RGB-D camera pods capture a person from all sides, the Fusion4D pipeline fuses them into a temporally consistent textured mesh in real time, and it is compressed and streamed to a HoloLens where it is rendered anchored in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 用 iPhone 录一段 Record3D 或 Polycam 的体积视频（或深度点云），导入 Unity 放到 HoloKit/手机 AR 的桌面上以缩小比例回放，像是“迷你版的你”在讲话；变体：让回放可以被暂停和绕到背后看，记录一段你想留给未来自己的话。
works.description_zh: 环形排布的深度相机对人进行完整的 3D 捕捉，并实时传输到 HoloLens 中，让远方的人以真人大小出现在你的房间里；对话还可以被录制下来，以微缩比例回放。
works.idea_en: Teleport a faraway person live as a life-size hologram standing in front of you.
works.technique_zh: 多组 RGB-D 相机从各个方向捕捉人物，Fusion4D 流程实时将其融合为时间上一致的带纹理网格，经压缩后传输到 HoloLens，并锚定在房间中渲染。
works.exercise_en: Record a volumetric video (or depth point cloud) with Record3D or Polycam on an iPhone, import it into Unity, and play it back at reduced scale on a tabletop in HoloKit or phone AR, like a "mini you" talking. Twist: make the playback pausable and viewable from behind, and record a message you want to leave for your future self.

works.title: Hypercard in the World
works.description: The precursor to Dynamicland at HARC/CDG: paper cards on tables and walls become live programs through projection and cameras, and people program the room together.
works.idea_zh: 把一张张纸卡变成程序，让整个房间成为可以一起编程的电脑。

video.video_title: Hypercard in the World, May 2016

works.technique: Ceiling-mounted cameras identify paper cards by printed color-dot codes, and projectors render each card's program output onto and around it, with programs reacting to the positions and adjacency of other cards.
works.exercise_zh: 给几张卡片印上 ArUco 码，用俯视摄像头 + OpenCV 识别，在投影仪上给每张卡片显示对应的输出（一个颜色、一段文字），当两张卡片靠近时触发组合效果；变体：让同学把卡片当作“程序语句”拼出一个小动画。
works.description_zh: Dynamicland 在 HARC/CDG 时期的前身：通过投影和相机，桌面和墙上的纸卡变成实时运行的程序，人们一起为整个房间编程。
works.idea_en: Turn paper cards into programs so the whole room becomes a computer people program together.
works.technique_zh: 安装在天花板上的相机通过印刷的彩色圆点编码识别纸卡，投影仪把每张卡片的程序输出渲染在卡片上及其周围，程序会对其他卡片的位置和相邻关系做出反应。
works.exercise_en: Print ArUco codes on a few cards, recognize them with an overhead camera and OpenCV, and use a projector to show each card's output (a color, a line of text), triggering a combined effect when two cards come close. Twist: have classmates use the cards as "program statements" to assemble a small animation.

works.title: I am Sound
works.description: Your face, captured by a camera, is projected as a fractured cubist portrait on a curtain of metal plates that is also a 12-tone metallophone, which plays a composition generated from your face.
works.description_zh: 摄像头捕捉你的脸，把它投影成一幅破碎的立体主义肖像，投在一排金属板组成的“帘子”上，而这排金属板本身就是一台十二音金属琴，会演奏根据你的脸生成的乐曲。
works.idea_en: Your face becomes a musical score played on the screen that shows it.
works.idea_zh: 你的脸变成乐谱，由显示它的那块“屏幕”演奏出来。
works.technique: Face detection extracts features that are mapped to notes struck on real metal plates, while the video is projected onto those same plates so the vibration shakes the image.
works.technique_zh: 用人脸检测提取特征并映射为音符，敲击真实的金属板；同时把影像投影到这些金属板上，振动会让画面随之颤动。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam face-tracking sketch (p5.js or TouchDesigner) to turn facial landmarks into notes and project the face onto a surface. Twist: two faces together play a duet.
works.exercise_zh: 用网络摄像头的人脸追踪草图（p5.js 或 TouchDesigner）把面部关键点转成音符，并把人脸投影到一个表面上。变体：两张脸一起出现时演奏二重奏。

video.video_title: "I am Sound," demo video of the interactive face-to-music video installation

works.title: In 20 Steps
works.description: Hanging glass rods move up and down in a wave, together tracing the shape of a bird's wing beat slowed into twenty steps.
works.description_zh: 悬挂的玻璃棒一起上下起伏成波浪，勾勒出一只鸟被放慢成二十步的振翅姿态。
works.idea_en: Many simple moving parts can draw a single motion through time; AR can break a movement into sampled positions to make it visible and study it.
works.idea_zh: 许多简单的运动部件可以共同画出一个随时间展开的动作；AR 可以把一个动作分解成采样位置，让它可见并便于研究。
works.technique: Rows of glass rods on individually motorised cables are raised and lowered to positions sampled from a recorded wing motion.
works.technique_zh: 一排排玻璃棒挂在各自由电机驱动的线缆上，被升降到从录制的翅膀运动中采样得到的位置。
works.exercise_en: Record a classmate's arm wave with body tracking, then play it back in AR as a curtain of 40 hanging rods whose heights follow the motion in 20 steps. Twist: freeze the curtain at any moment with a tap.
works.exercise_zh: 用人体追踪录下同学挥动手臂的动作，然后在 AR 中用 40 根悬挂的棒组成的帘子回放，棒的高度按 20 个步骤跟随动作。变体：点一下就能在任意时刻冻结帘子。

video.video_title: IN 20 STEPS at Venice Biennale represented by Pace Gallery | by DRIFT

works.title: InkPainter
works.description: The user splashes coloured ink onto 3D objects with the mouse; the paint wraps around curved surfaces and stays on them.
works.description_zh: 用户用鼠标把彩色墨水泼到三维物体上，颜料顺着曲面包裹并留在上面。
works.idea_en: Paint directly onto any mesh at runtime, like spraying ink on real objects.
works.idea_zh: 在运行时直接往任何网格上画，就像往真实物体上喷墨。
works.technique: A raycast hit gives the UV coordinate on the mesh, and a shader blits a brush texture into the object's RenderTexture at that UV, with blending modes and normal/height painting.
works.technique_zh: 射线命中给出网格上的 UV 坐标，着色器把笔刷纹理按该 UV 绘制进物体的 RenderTexture，并支持多种混合模式以及法线、高度绘制。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation meshing so the user can spray virtual ink onto the real room mesh with a tap. Twist: make two phones share the paint so a class can paint the same wall together.
works.exercise_zh: 借助 AR Foundation 的网格重建，让用户点一下就把虚拟墨水喷到真实房间的网格上。变体：让两台手机共享颜料，全班一起涂同一面墙。

video.video_title: InkPainter

works.title: Interconnection
works.description: The winning piece of the iMapp Bucharest 2016 contest, which took both the jury and the people's choice award. The facade moves from cells and neurons to cities and galaxies to show that the micro and macro, the individual and society, are connected.
works.description_zh: 2016 年 iMapp 布加勒斯特投影比赛的获胜作品，同时拿下评审奖和观众票选奖。立面从细胞、神经元一路变成城市和星系，表达微观与宏观、个人与社会彼此相连。
works.idea_en: Zooming between scales on one fixed surface is an easy-to-read storytelling device; AR can zoom through scales around a real object in the same way.
works.idea_zh: 在同一块固定表面上穿梭于不同尺度，是很容易看懂的叙事手法；AR 也可以用同样方式围绕真实物体在尺度之间穿梭。
works.technique: Scale-transition animations are built on a 3D model of the Palace of the Parliament and projected with many aligned, blended projectors.
works.technique_zh: 在议会宫三维模型上制作尺度转换动画，用多台对齐融合的投影机投出。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR 'powers of ten' zoom on a real object (a leaf, a coin) in Reality Composer or WebXR: pinch to fly from atoms to galaxies around it. Twist: the zoom is controlled by walking toward or away from the object.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Reality Composer 或 WebXR 里围绕一个真实物体（一片叶子、一枚硬币）做 AR“十的次方”缩放：捏合手势从原子飞到星系；变体：用走近或走远物体来控制缩放。

video.video_title: Interconnection - Visionary Projection Mapping, Winner of iMapp 2016, 4K

works.title: JR au Louvre
works.description: JR covered I. M. Pei's glass pyramid at the Louvre with a black-and-white photograph of the palace behind it, so from one point in the courtyard the pyramid seems to disappear.
works.description_zh: JR 用身后宫殿的黑白照片覆盖了贝聿铭设计的卢浮宫玻璃金字塔，于是从庭院中的某个位置看过去，金字塔仿佛消失了。
works.idea_en: Printing the background onto the object makes it vanish from one viewpoint: the physical version of diminished reality in AR.
works.idea_zh: 把背景印在物体上，使它从某个视点看来消失：这是 AR“削减现实”的实体版本。
works.technique: A photograph of the facade behind the pyramid was printed in strips and pasted on the glass, aligned to one viewing position.
works.technique_zh: 把金字塔后方立面的照片分条印刷，贴在玻璃上，并与某个观看位置对齐。
works.exercise_en: Photograph the wall behind a real object (a pillar, a sign) and in AR wrap the object with that photo so it disappears from one point. Twist: reveal the object again with a slow wipe when the user steps off the point.
works.exercise_zh: 拍下真实物体（柱子、标牌）背后的墙，在 AR 中用这张照片包裹物体，使其从某个位置看来消失；变体：当用户离开该位置时，用缓慢擦除的方式让物体重新显现。

video.video_title: JR on JR au Louvre

salient.why_en: The Louvre pyramid is covered with a photo of the palace behind it, so from one spot it simply vanishes.
salient.why_zh: 卢浮宫金字塔被贴上身后宫殿的照片，从某个位置看去，它就消失了。

works.title: Kinect V2 Depth into the G-Buffer
works.description: A live Kinect depth image becomes solid, lit geometry in a Unity scene, receiving virtual lights and shadows like any other object.
works.description_zh: 实时的 Kinect 深度图在 Unity 场景中变成实体、可被照亮的几何，像其他物体一样接受虚拟光照和阴影。
works.idea_en: Treat the depth camera image as part of the renderer, not as a texture.
works.idea_zh: 把深度相机画面当作渲染器的一部分，而不是一张贴图。
works.technique: A shader writes the Kinect V2 depth and reconstructed normals directly into Unity's deferred G-buffer, so the real person is lit by Unity lights.
works.technique_zh: 着色器把 Kinect V2 的深度和重建的法线直接写入 Unity 延迟渲染的 G-buffer，让真实的人被 Unity 的灯光照亮。
works.exercise_en: Do the same with the LiDAR depth on an iPhone: write it into the depth buffer and relight the real room with a moving virtual lamp. Twist: the virtual light casts coloured shadows of real people.
works.exercise_zh: 在 iPhone 上用 LiDAR 深度做同样的事：写入深度缓冲，用一盏移动的虚拟灯重新照亮真实房间。变体：虚拟灯让真人投下彩色影子。

video.video_title: [Unity] Draw Kinect V2 Depth Image into G-Buffer directly.

works.title: Kung Fu Motion Visualization
works.description: Kung fu forms performed by the masters Wong Yiu Kau and Li Shek Lin are motion-captured and turned into flowing ribbons, particles and abstract bodies that make the path and energy of each movement visible.
works.description_zh: Wong Yiu Kau 和 Li Shek Lin 两位师傅演练的功夫套路被动作捕捉，转化成流动的丝带、粒子和抽象身体，让每个动作的轨迹和力量变得可见。
works.idea_en: Making a movement's path visible teaches the movement; AR can leave the same traces around a real athlete or dancer for learning and spectacle.
works.idea_zh: 让动作的轨迹可见，本身就能教会这个动作；AR 可以在真实的运动员或舞者周围留下同样的轨迹，用于学习和观赏。
works.technique: Optical motion-capture data of the masters' joints is used to generate trails, ribbons and particle bodies in 3D software, each variation revealing a different aspect of the motion.
works.technique_zh: 用光学动作捕捉记录师傅们的关节数据，在三维软件中生成轨迹、丝带和粒子身体，每种变体揭示动作的不同侧面。
works.exercise_en: Record a classmate doing a martial arts or dance move with ARKit body tracking and draw ribbons from their wrists and ankles that stay in the air for three seconds. Twist: replay the saved ribbons so a second person can try to follow them.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit 身体追踪录下一位同学做一段武术或舞蹈动作，从他的手腕和脚踝画出在空中停留三秒的丝带；变体：回放保存下来的丝带，让另一个人尝试跟着它们做。

video.video_title: Kung Fu Motion Visualization

works.title: LEGACY (Schlosslichtspiele Karlsruhe)
works.description: A long mapping on Karlsruhe Palace, home of the Badisches Landesmuseum, for the Schlosslichtspiele festival: the facade opens like a cabinet to show the museum's collections and history to the crowd in the palace square.
works.description_zh: 为卡尔斯鲁厄宫灯光节（Schlosslichtspiele）创作的长篇投影。宫殿里是巴登州立博物馆，整面立面像柜子一样打开，把博物馆的藏品和历史展示给广场上的人群。
works.idea_en: A building can reveal what is inside it; AR can likewise 'open' a museum, a machine or a wall to show hidden content in place.
works.idea_zh: 建筑可以把它里面的东西展示出来；AR 同样可以“打开”一座博物馆、一台机器或一面墙，在原地展示隐藏的内容。
works.technique: Scenes of museum objects are composited into a 3D model of the palace facade so the building appears to open, then projected from towers in the square.
works.technique_zh: 把博物馆藏品的场景合成进宫殿立面的三维模型，让建筑看起来像被打开，再从广场上的投影塔投出。
works.exercise_en: Choose a closed door or cabinet on campus and build an AR 'x-ray' that opens it and shows what is inside with Lens Studio or WebXR image tracking. Twist: viewers must stand in a specific spot for the doors to open.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里选一扇关着的门或柜子，用 Lens Studio 或 WebXR 图像追踪做一个 AR“透视”，把它打开并展示里面的东西；变体：观众必须站在特定位置门才会打开。

video.video_title: LEGACY - Projection Mapping on Palace of Karlsruhe for Schlosslichtspiele 2016 by Maxin10sity (4K)

works.title: LONELY GHOUSTS
works.description: An early Project Tango AR game in which friendly creatures appear along your real walks and wait to be met and collected.
works.idea_zh: 在日常散步的路上遇见孤单的小幽灵。

video.video_title: LONELY GHOUSTS

works.technique: Tango motion tracking places animated creatures in world space so they stay put as you walk around them.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在校园路线上随机放置 5 个'孤单小怪'，走近时它们会跟你打招呼；加一个变化：收集后它们会跟在你身后排队。
works.description_zh: 一款早期的 Project Tango AR 游戏，友善的小生物会出现在你真实的散步路线上，等着你去遇见并收集它们。
works.idea_en: Meet lonely little ghosts along your everyday walks.
works.technique_zh: Tango 运动追踪把带动画的生物放在世界空间中，你绕着它们走动时它们会保持在原地。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation to scatter five "lonely little monsters" along a campus route that greet you when you get close. Twist: once collected, they line up and follow behind you.

works.title: LUCID
works.description: Simple geometric shapes made of electroluminescent wire, such as circles, triangles and lines, are placed in empty landscapes in Iceland and Austria. Each glowing figure sits in a lake, a cave or a mountain slope and turns the whole place into a quiet, surreal scene.
works.description_zh: 由电致发光线做成的简单几何形状，比如圆、三角形和直线，被放进冰岛和奥地利空旷的风景里。每个发光图形立在湖中、洞穴里或山坡上，让整片地方变成安静而超现实的场景。
works.idea_en: One luminous line placed in a vast landscape reframes the whole view; a single, well-placed AR primitive can do more than a crowded scene.
works.idea_zh: 在辽阔的风景中放一条发光的线，就能重新框定整个视野；一个放对位置的简单 AR 几何体，胜过一整堆内容。
works.technique: Battery-powered EL wire was bent over thin frames into circles and triangles and filmed at dusk with long exposures, so the lines read as pure light against the landscape.
works.technique_zh: 用电池供电的电致发光线绕在细框架上弯成圆形和三角形，在黄昏用较长曝光拍摄，使线条在风景前显得像纯粹的光。
works.exercise_en: Place a single glowing ring or triangle with WebXR or 8th Wall outdoors, anchored to the horizon line, and photograph it from three distances. Twist: the shape stays still in the world but its colour follows the time of day from the phone clock.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 8th Wall 在户外放置一个发光的圆环或三角形，锚定在地平线上，从三个距离拍照；变体：形状在世界中保持不动，但颜色随手机时钟显示的时间变化。

video.video_title: LUCID

works.title: La neige n'a pas de sens
works.description: The company's first monograph is also an AR book: pointing a tablet at six of its pages makes rain, a cloud, a wave, a tornado, a cocoon and grass rise out of the paper and move.
works.description_zh: 公司的第一本作品集同时也是一本 AR 书：把平板对准其中六页，雨、云、波浪、龙卷风、茧和草就会从纸面升起并动起来。
works.idea_en: A printed art book whose pages hold living, moving matter.
works.idea_zh: 一本印刷画册，书页里藏着会动的“活物质”。
works.technique: A custom mobile app recognizes the printed page images and anchors real-time generative animations of natural phenomena, likely eMotion-style particle systems, onto each page.
works.technique_zh: 定制的手机应用识别印刷页面图像，把自然现象的实时生成动画（很可能是 eMotion 风格的粒子系统）锚定在每一页上。
works.exercise_en: Print three abstract black-and-white patterns, make them image targets in Lens Studio, AR Foundation or MindAR, and attach a particle effect that grows out of each (rain, smoke, grass); test how the print design changes the feel of the animation. Twist: make the matter respond to tilting the book, as if it could spill off the page.
works.exercise_zh: 打印三张黑白抽象图案，在 Lens Studio、AR Foundation 或 MindAR 里设为识别图，给每张图挂上从纸面长出来的粒子效果（雨、烟、草），测试印刷图案的设计如何改变动画的感觉。变体：让这些物质响应书的倾斜，好像会从书页上洒出来。

video.video_title: Adrien M & Claire B : La neige n'a pas de sens

works.title: Laplacian Vision
works.description: AR glasses or a projector show the predicted future trajectory of a thrown ball as a line in the air, helping people anticipate and catch it.
works.idea_zh: 让你看到飞行物体未来的轨迹。

video.video_title: Laplacian Vision: Augmenting Motion Prediction via HMDs (AH2016)

works.technique: Tracks the object with cameras, fits a ballistic model and renders the extrapolated path in the user's view with latency compensation.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR检测一个滚动的球并用抛物线/直线外推画出它未来1秒的位置；变化：故意显示“错误的未来”看同学是否被误导。
works.description_zh: AR 眼镜或投影仪把一个被抛出的球预测的未来轨迹以空中的线条形式显示出来，帮助人们预判并接住它。
works.idea_en: See where a flying object is going to be.
works.technique_zh: 用相机追踪物体，拟合弹道模型，并在补偿延迟后把外推出的路径渲染到用户视野中。
works.exercise_en: Detect a rolling ball in phone AR and draw its position one second ahead by parabolic or linear extrapolation. Twist: deliberately show a "wrong future" and see whether classmates are misled.

salient.why_en: A line in the air shows where a thrown ball is about to go, so you see a moment into the future.
salient.why_zh: 空中的一条线提前画出球将要飞到哪里，让人看见下一刻。

works.title: Laser Light Synths
works.description: Visitors play large illuminated touch synthesizers; every note triggers laser graphics that sweep across the building and surround the players with beams.
works.description_zh: 观众弹奏发光的大型触摸合成器；每个音符都会触发激光图形扫过建筑，把演奏者包围在光束之中。
works.idea_en: Anyone can play music, and every note becomes light that fills the space.
works.idea_zh: 谁都能演奏，每个音符都化成充满空间的光。
works.technique: Custom touch-sensitive synths are locked to a musical scale so there are no wrong notes, and their input drives laser animations through laser-show software written by the artist.
works.technique_zh: 定制的触摸合成器锁定在一个音阶上，不会弹错音，输入信号驱动艺术家自己编写的激光秀软件生成激光动画。
works.exercise_en: Make a four-key instrument (touch pads or phone buttons) in a pentatonic scale, where each note sends a coloured beam or shape across a projected wall. Twist: two players must play the same note together to unlock a big effect.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个四键乐器（触摸板或手机按键），用五声音阶，每个音符在投影墙上发出一道彩色光束或图形。变体：两位演奏者必须同时弹同一个音，才能触发一个大效果。

video.video_title: Laser Light Synths v2

works.title: Leysin land art (world record)
works.description: In Leysin, Switzerland, Saype painted an ephemeral 10,000-square-metre figure on a hillside, then a world record for the largest painting on grass.
works.description_zh: 在瑞士莱森，Saype 在山坡上画出一幅面积达一万平方米的短暂人像，创下当时草地绘画面积的世界纪录。
works.idea_en: At this size the image becomes landscape, and it disappears as the grass grows: scale and decay are both part of the work.
works.idea_zh: 在这种尺度下，图像本身就成了风景，并随着草的生长而消失：尺度与消逝都是作品的一部分。
works.technique: Chalk-and-charcoal paint is sprayed across the hillside following a grid scaled up from a drawing.
works.technique_zh: 粉笔与木炭颜料按照从草图放大而来的网格，被喷在整个山坡上。
works.exercise_en: Place a 100-metre AR drawing on a sports field and check where it can be read from (ground, stairs, rooftop). Twist: the drawing fades a little each day, like grass growing over it.
works.exercise_zh: 在运动场上放一幅 100 米长的 AR 绘画，检查从哪些地方（地面、楼梯、屋顶）能读懂它；变体：画面每天淡去一点，像被生长的草覆盖。

video.video_title: Amazing Landart in Leysin (CH) World painting record

works.title: Light Barrier Third Edition
works.description: A larger edition at the Asian Culture Center in Gwangju: concave mirrors and projection materialize volumetric light objects and scenes in fog.
works.idea_zh: 更大尺度的光之屏障：光在雾中凝成体积感的影像与物体。

video.video_title: Light Barrier Third Edition [2016] (4K)

works.technique: Concave mirror arrays focus calibrated projector rays into haze, and mapping each pixel's reflected ray lets the system draw volumetric light objects at chosen positions in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 用一面凹面化妆镜反射投影进雾中，试着把光线汇聚成一个悬浮的光点并让它移动；变体：用这个光点讲一个“萤火虫”的小故事，光点会因观众靠近而逃走。
works.description_zh: 在光州亚洲文化殿堂展出的更大版本：凹面镜与投影在雾中凝结出具有体积感的光之物体和场景。
works.idea_en: A larger Light Barrier where light condenses in fog into volumetric images and objects.
works.technique_zh: 凹面镜阵列把经过标定的投影光线汇聚到雾气中，通过映射每个像素的反射光线，系统能在房间中的指定位置绘制出体积光物体。
works.exercise_en: Reflect a projection into fog with a concave makeup mirror and try to focus the light into a floating point of light that moves. Twist: use the point of light to tell a small "firefly" story in which it flees when viewers come close.

works.title: Light Capsule 004 — Astoria, Oregon
works.description: A faded hand-painted advertisement on an old building in Astoria is brought back to life at night: projection redraws the missing letters and colors exactly on top of the ghost sign.
works.description_zh: 阿斯托里亚一栋老建筑上褪色的手绘广告在夜晚复活：投影把缺失的字母和颜色精准地重画在“幽灵招牌”上。
works.idea_en: Use light to temporarily restore a city's forgotten layer of history.
works.idea_zh: 用光暂时修复城市被遗忘的历史图层。
works.technique: Archival photos and on-site research are used to redraw the sign as vector artwork, which is then projection-mapped and animated over the remaining paint.
works.technique_zh: 借助档案照片和实地考察，把招牌重绘为矢量图形，再投影映射到残存的油漆上并加入动画。
works.exercise_en: Find an old sign, faded poster or worn floor marking, photograph it, redraw what it once looked like, and project it back on site. Twist: animate the moment the sign was first painted.
works.exercise_zh: 找一块旧招牌、褪色海报或磨损的地面标识，拍照、重绘它原本的样子，再在现场投回去；变体：做一段动画，重现它当年被画出来的那一刻。

video.video_title: Light Capsule 004 — Astoria, Oregon

works.title: Light Capsule 013 — Detroit x Miss Van
works.description: In Detroit, a painted mural by street artist Miss Van and a neighboring ghost sign are augmented together with animated light that makes the painted figures glow and move.
works.description_zh: 在底特律，街头艺术家 Miss Van 的壁画与旁边的一块幽灵招牌一起被动态光影增强，画中的人物仿佛开始发光、移动。
works.idea_en: Add a time layer to a mural: light animates what paint can only freeze.
works.idea_zh: 给壁画加上时间维度：颜料只能定格的东西，光可以让它动起来。
works.technique: The mural is photographed straight-on, animation is drawn on top of the photo and projection-mapped back so light hits exactly the painted shapes.
works.technique_zh: 正面拍摄壁画，在照片上绘制动画，再投影映射回墙面，使光线精准地落在画中的形状上。
works.exercise_en: Choose a poster or drawing on the classroom wall, trace its shapes and animate one element (hair, water, eyes) with projected light. Twist: make the animation start only when someone stands in front of it.
works.exercise_zh: 挑一张教室墙上的海报或画，描出其中的形状，用投影让其中一个元素（头发、水、眼睛）动起来；变体：只有当有人站到它面前时动画才开始。

video.video_title: Light Capsule 013 — Detroit x Miss Van

works.title: Light Capsules — London Design Festival
works.description: During the London Design Festival, five ghost signs across the city are revived with projection, drawing crowds to walls they had walked past for years.
works.description_zh: 伦敦设计节期间，全城五处幽灵招牌被投影复活，吸引人们停下来注视这些多年来经过却从未留意的墙面。
works.idea_en: A tour of the city's ghost signs, each lit up for one night.
works.idea_zh: 一条城市幽灵招牌之旅，每一块都只亮一个晚上。
works.technique: Each sign is matched with historical sources, redrawn and projection-mapped, with animations that reveal the lettering stroke by stroke.
works.technique_zh: 每块招牌都与历史资料比对、重绘并做投影映射，动画一笔一画地揭示字母。
works.exercise_en: Map three locations on a campus walking route and design a projected reveal for each that connects into one story. Twist: publish a map so visitors can find them only at a set time.
works.exercise_zh: 在一条校园步行路线上选三个地点，为每个地点设计一段投影揭示，并把它们串成一个故事；变体：发布一张地图，访客只有在指定时间到达才能看到。

video.video_title: Light Capsules — LDF16: Part 1

works.title: Living Library
works.description: A giant projected book with real pages: a depth camera tracks hands so touching and turning pages triggers animated illustrations on the paper.
works.idea_zh: 巨大的实体书，翻页和触摸会让纸上的插画动起来。

video.video_title: Living Library

works.technique: A depth camera over a blank physical book detects hand touches and page turns, and a projector calibrated to the book surface projects illustrations aligned to the pages.
works.exercise_zh: 做一本白页手工书，用摄像头检测翻到第几页（可在页角贴色块），投影仪把对应动画投到书页上，手指点哪里哪里动；变体：写一个只有翻回上一页才会改变结局的故事。
works.description_zh: 一本配有真实书页的巨型投影书：深度相机追踪双手，触摸和翻动书页会让纸上的插画动起来。
works.idea_en: A giant real book whose illustrations move when you turn and touch the pages.
works.technique_zh: 安装在空白实体书上方的深度相机检测手的触摸和翻页，与书面标定好的投影仪把插画对齐投射到书页上。
works.exercise_en: Make a handmade book with blank pages, use a camera to detect which page is open (colored patches on the page corners help), and project the matching animation onto the page so whatever a finger touches moves. Twist: write a story whose ending changes only when you flip back to the previous page.

works.title: Lost Droids (MR test)
works.description: Shot through Magic Leap optics: R2-D2 and C-3PO appear in a real office, R2 projects a hologram message and the droids react to the viewer.
works.idea_zh: 星战机器人出现在真实办公室里并向你投射全息信息。

video.video_title: ILMxLAB and Magic Leap “Lost Droids” Mixed Reality Test

works.technique: Real-time rendered characters anchored to the physical room and filmed directly through the prototype's optics.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR让一个角色在教室里“投射”一段录好的视频留言（在角色上方播放视频平面）；变化：留言只在两人同时观看时播放。
works.description_zh: 透过 Magic Leap 光学系统拍摄：R2-D2 和 C-3PO 出现在一间真实的办公室里，R2 投射出一段全息消息，两个机器人还会对观看者做出反应。
works.idea_en: Star Wars droids show up in a real office and project a hologram message for you.
works.technique_zh: 实时渲染的角色锚定在实体房间中，并直接透过原型机的光学系统拍摄。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR to have a character in the classroom "project" a recorded video message by playing a video plane above it. Twist: the message plays only when two people watch at the same time.

works.title: Luma Paint — Interactive Light Graffiti
works.description: At the Luminale festival visitors pick up light pens and draw in front of a camera; a live long-exposure picture builds up on a large screen so everyone sees their strokes appear instantly.
works.description_zh: 在 Luminale 灯光节上，观众拿起光笔在摄像头前作画，大屏幕上实时累积出一张长曝光画面，每个人都能立刻看到自己的笔画。
works.idea_en: Turning a slow photographic technique into instant feedback makes it a public game: live accumulation of traces is a strong AR interaction on its own.
works.idea_zh: 把慢速的摄影技巧变成即时反馈，它就成了公共游戏：实时累积的轨迹本身就是很强的 AR 交互。
works.technique: A camera feed is processed in real time with a max-brightness accumulation buffer, likely in custom software, so light strokes persist on the display.
works.technique_zh: 相机画面经实时处理，用最大亮度累积缓冲让光的笔画留在屏幕上，可能是自研软件。
works.exercise_en: Write a WebAR or Lens Studio effect that keeps the brightest value of each pixel over time (a live long exposure) and invite people to wave phone flashlights in front of it. Twist: the accumulated image slowly drifts upward like smoke.
works.exercise_zh: 写一个 WebAR 或 Lens Studio 效果，让每个像素保留随时间出现过的最亮值（实时长曝光），请大家在镜头前挥动手机手电；变体：累积的画面像烟一样慢慢向上飘。

video.video_title: Luma Paint Interactive Light Graffiti at the Luminale 2016

works.title: Luminoscope
works.description: A sculpture made from an old umbrella and cardboard boxes becomes a glowing object when projection-mapped visuals are wrapped around it and changed by the visitor's hand gestures in the air.
works.description_zh: 一件用旧雨伞和纸箱做成的雕塑，被投影映射包裹后变成发光的物体，观众在空中的手势会改变影像。
works.idea_en: Found junk plus projection plus a hand sensor becomes a responsive sculpture.
works.idea_zh: 废旧物加投影再加手势传感器，就成了会回应人的雕塑。
works.technique: Visuals made in Modul8 are mapped onto the sculpture with MadMapper, and a Leap Motion (via Geco MIDI) turns hand gestures into MIDI controls.
works.technique_zh: 在 Modul8 中制作影像，用 MadMapper 映射到雕塑上，Leap Motion 通过 Geco MIDI 把手势转成 MIDI 控制。
