works.exercise_en: Projection-map a cardboard box sculpture and use a webcam hand tracker to change colours as visitors wave over it. Twist: each face of the box responds to a different hand.
works.exercise_zh: 给纸箱雕塑做投影映射，用摄像头手部追踪让观众挥手时改变颜色；变体：箱子的每个面只回应不同的手。

video.video_title: Luminoscope (prototype) (Modul8 + MadMapper + Leap + Geco MIDI)

works.title: MSQRD
works.description: A selfie video app that tracks the face live and turns it into a crying clown, an old man, a chimpanzee or a white dog, with masks that follow expressions and open mouths, recorded as short clips to share.
works.description_zh: 一款自拍视频应用：实时追踪人脸，把它变成流泪的小丑、老人、黑猩猩或白色小狗，面具会跟随表情和张嘴动作，录成短视频分享出去。
works.idea_en: Wear a living mask on your face through the phone camera.
works.idea_zh: 通过手机相机，在脸上戴一副会动的活面具。
works.technique: Real-time facial landmark tracking on the phone fits a face mesh every frame, onto which animated masks and face-swap textures are warped.
works.technique_zh: 手机上的实时人脸特征点追踪每帧拟合一个人脸网格，再把动态面具和换脸贴图变形贴合上去。
works.exercise_en: In Lens Studio or Effect House, make a face mask that switches character when the user opens their mouth or raises their eyebrows. Twist: the mask ages a little every time the user blinks.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Lens Studio 或 Effect House 里做一个面部面具，用户张嘴或挑眉时就切换成另一个角色。变体：用户每眨一次眼，面具就老一点。

video.video_title: MSQRD

works.title: Materiable
works.description: A shape display renders material properties such as elasticity, viscosity and flexibility, so touching the pins feels like pressing jelly, sand or rubber.
works.idea_zh: 让同一块针阵表面按你的手感'变成'果冻、沙子或橡胶。

video.video_title: Materiable

works.technique: Force sensing through the pins' motor current detects how hard a pin is pressed, and a per-pin physics model (spring, damper, fluid coupling) sets the pin response to simulate elasticity or viscosity, with projection showing the material.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机触屏压力或按压时长作为输入，在 AR 平面上渲染一块虚拟材料（果冻、沙子、橡胶），分别用弹簧、阻尼、扩散模型让它对按压作出不同反应并配合震动反馈；变体：发明一种现实中不存在的材料。
works.description_zh: 一台形状显示器能呈现弹性、黏性和柔韧性等材料属性，触摸针阵时的手感就像在按压果冻、沙子或橡胶。
works.idea_en: The same pin surface turns into jelly, sand or rubber under your hand.
works.technique_zh: 通过针脚电机电流进行力感知，检测每根针被按压的力度，再由逐针的物理模型（弹簧、阻尼、流体耦合）设定针的响应，模拟弹性或黏性，并用投影显示材料外观。
works.exercise_en: Use touchscreen pressure or press duration as input to render a block of virtual material (jelly, sand, rubber) on an AR plane, and make it respond differently to presses using spring, damping and diffusion models, with vibration feedback. Twist: invent a material that does not exist in reality.

works.title: Mirror Maze
works.description: In a Peckham warehouse, visitors wander a maze of mirrors where video, light and scent appear and disappear, a 'video sculpture' made for Chanel's The Fifth Sense with i-D.
works.description_zh: 在伦敦佩卡姆的一座仓库里，观众在镜子迷宫中游走，影像、灯光和气味时隐时现；这件「影像雕塑」是为 Chanel 与 i-D 的 The Fifth Sense 项目而做。
works.idea_en: A maze of mirrors hides where the real walls are, so projected content seems to float everywhere; AR can use the same confusion between real and reflected space.
works.idea_zh: 镜子迷宫藏起了真实墙面的位置，投影内容仿佛漂浮在各处：AR 也可以利用真实空间与反射空间之间的混淆。
works.technique: Angled mirror panels form corridors that multiply the visitor and hidden screens, while scent and sound are cued along the path (exact screen layout likely).
works.technique_zh: 倾斜的镜面板组成走廊，把观众和隐藏的屏幕不断复制，气味和声音沿路径依次触发（屏幕的具体布局为推测）。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR maze of virtual mirror panels in a real room, using render textures so each panel reflects the others and the user's camera. Twist: hide one 'true exit' panel that shows the real camera feed instead of a reflection.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实房间里用 WebXR 搭一个虚拟镜面迷宫，用渲染纹理让每块镜板反射其他镜板和用户的摄像机视角。变体：藏一块「真正的出口」镜板，它显示的是真实摄像头画面而不是反射。

video.video_title: Enter the Mirror Maze, Es Devlin's video sculpture, presented by The Fifth Sense

works.title: Motion Exposure: whitewater kayak
works.description: In the Elora Gorge in Ontario, LED sticks mounted on a kayak paddle change colour over time while a long exposure records the paddle's path over the whitewater.
works.description_zh: 在安大略省埃洛拉峡谷，装在皮划艇桨上的 LED 灯棒随时间变色，长曝光记录下船桨在激流上方的轨迹。
works.idea_en: Colour-coding time along a motion path turns one stroke into a readable diagram, a visual grammar for AR motion trails.
works.idea_zh: 沿运动路径用颜色编码时间，把一次划桨变成可读的图示，这是 AR 运动轨迹的视觉语法。
works.technique: Programmable LED strips attached to the paddle cycle through colours on a timer during a long camera exposure at night or dusk.
works.technique_zh: 固定在船桨上的可编程 LED 灯带在夜间或黄昏的长曝光中按计时循环变色。
works.exercise_en: Track the phone or a hand with AR and draw its path in a colour that changes every second, then freeze the result as a 3D sculpture. Twist: record a sports movement (a throw, a swing) and compare two people's traces.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR 追踪手机或手，画出颜色每秒变化的路径，并把结果凝固成一件三维雕塑；变体：记录一个运动动作（投掷、挥拍），比较两个人的轨迹。

video.video_title: Whitewater kayak light painting

works.title: MotionComposer
works.description: Robert Wechsler demonstrates a camera device that turns any movement, from a wave of the arm to a blink, into music, designed so that people with very different abilities can dance and compose together.
works.description_zh: Robert Wechsler 演示一台摄像设备：从挥臂到眨眼，任何动作都能变成音乐，它的设计让能力差异很大的人也能一起跳舞、一起作曲。
works.idea_en: Everyone is a dancer and a musician if the instrument listens to whatever movement they have.
works.idea_zh: 只要乐器能“听见”一个人拥有的任何动作，人人都是舞者和音乐家。
works.technique: Stereo and depth cameras track position, size and gesture of one or more people, and Palindrome-designed music environments in Pure Data and Csound map small and large movements to different sonic behaviour.
works.technique_zh: 立体与深度摄像头追踪一个或多个人的位置、体型和手势，Palindrome 设计的 Pure Data 与 Csound 音乐环境把大大小小的动作映射为不同的声音行为。
works.exercise_en: Design a movement-to-music web app with MediaPipe Pose that works equally for someone standing and someone seated, and test it with both. Twist: map only the smallest detected movement to melody, so stillness-with-intention becomes the main instrument.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 设计一个“动作变音乐”的网页应用，要让站立者和坐着的人都能同样好地使用，并分别测试；变体：只把检测到的最微小动作映射为旋律，让“带着意图的静止”成为主要乐器。

video.video_title: Introducing MotionComposer

works.title: Moving Stained Glass
works.description: Sunlight shines through a window whose coloured panes are generated and animated by a display, casting moving stained-glass patterns across the room.
works.description_zh: 阳光穿过一扇窗，窗上的彩色玻璃图案由显示屏生成并变化，把流动的彩色玻璃光影投满整个房间。
works.idea_en: Stained glass that moves, lit only by the sun.
works.idea_zh: 会动的彩色玻璃，只靠阳光照亮。
works.technique: Likely a transparent LCD without a backlight acts as a filter for natural sunlight, showing a generative art system that casts real coloured light.
works.technique_zh: 很可能用一块去掉背光的透明 LCD 作为自然阳光的滤镜，显示生成式图案，投下真实的彩色光。
works.exercise_en: Put a coloured transparent sheet (or an old phone screen with the backlight removed, if possible) in a sunny window and design patterns for the shadows it casts at different hours. Twist: the pattern tells the time.
works.exercise_zh: 在有阳光的窗户上放一张彩色透明片（如果可以，用拆掉背光的旧手机屏），为它在不同时间投下的光影设计图案。变体：让图案能显示时间。

video.video_title: Moving Stained Glass

works.title: Multi-player Pong on Globe4D
works.description: Several players stand around the projected sphere and play Pong on its curved surface, each defending a segment of the globe.
works.description_zh: 几位玩家围着投影球站成一圈，在球面上玩 Pong，每人防守球体的一段。
works.idea_en: A classic flat game wrapped onto a sphere so players stand around it.
works.idea_zh: 把经典平面游戏包到球面上，让玩家围着它站。
works.technique: The game is rendered in spherical coordinates and rear-projected inside the Globe4D sphere, with each player moving a paddle by touching the surface.
works.technique_zh: 游戏在球面坐标系中渲染，从 Globe4D 球体内部背投出来，每位玩家触摸球面来移动自己的球拍。
works.exercise_en: Take a simple two-player game and redesign it for a round table or ball so that players face each other around it. Twist: the ball's speed depends on how many people are playing.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个简单的双人游戏重新设计到圆桌或球体上，让玩家围着它面对面。变体：球速取决于参与人数。

video.video_title: Multi player PONG on Globe4D gx1000 system

works.title: Museo Atlántico
works.description: Europe's first underwater museum off Lanzarote holds works such as The Rubicon, a line of figures walking toward a gate, and a raft of refugees, 12 metres below the surface.
works.description_zh: 位于兰萨罗特岛外海、欧洲首座水下博物馆收藏着《The Rubicon》（一列走向一扇门的人像）和一艘难民木筏等作品，位于水下 12 米。
works.idea_en: A procession of figures walking toward a threshold turns the sea floor into a narrative scene, a pattern for AR storytelling with frozen crowds.
works.idea_zh: 一列走向门槛的人像把海底变成叙事场景，这是用凝固人群讲故事的 AR 模式。
works.technique: Figures cast from local people are fixed to the sandy floor in groups and arranged as scenes.
works.technique_zh: 以当地人为原型翻制的人像成组固定在沙质海底上，排列成场景。
works.exercise_en: Arrange a frozen AR procession of scanned people walking toward a real doorway on campus. Twist: the procession advances one step each time a real person walks through the door.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里安排一列扫描人像组成的凝固 AR 队伍，走向一扇真实的门；变体：每有一个真人穿过这扇门，队伍就前进一步。

video.video_title: Building Europe’s Only Underwater Museum | Museo Atlántico | Jason deCaires Taylor

works.title: Más Que la Cara
works.description: A public installation in downtown Houston that tracks passers-by's faces and overlays dozens of generative, illustrated masks that move with their eyebrows, lips and head.
works.idea_zh: “不只是脸”：公共空间的魔镜，把路人的脸实时变成会随表情变化的生成式面具。

video.video_title: Más Que la Cara installation

works.technique: A 2D facial landmark tracker (FaceTracker-style) fits dozens of points to each face on a live camera, and vector-illustrated mask parts are skinned to eyebrow, lip and head landmarks so they deform with expression.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 加 p5.js 画一个只由几何线条组成的面具，眉毛和嘴巴的关键点驱动图形形变；变体：每个人一靠近就随机换一张面具，做 10 种风格给路人“换脸”。
works.description_zh: 休斯敦市中心的一件公共装置，追踪路人的面孔，并叠加数十种生成式插画面具，面具会随眉毛、嘴唇和头部的动作而变化。
works.idea_en: "More than a face": a magic mirror in public space that turns passers-by's faces into generative masks that follow their expressions.
works.technique_zh: 2D 面部特征点追踪器（FaceTracker 类）在实时相机画面中为每张脸拟合数十个点，矢量插画的面具部件蒙皮到眉毛、嘴唇和头部特征点上，随表情一起变形。
works.exercise_en: Draw a mask made only of geometric lines with MediaPipe Face Mesh and p5.js, with eyebrow and mouth landmarks driving the shapes. Twist: give each person a random new mask as soon as they come close, with 10 styles to "swap faces" for passers-by.

works.title: Night Terrors
works.description: A survival horror game played at home in the dark with headphones: the phone becomes the only way to see the monsters and apparitions that move through your own rooms.
works.idea_zh: 关灯戴耳机，自己家变成怪物出没的恐怖游戏场景。

video.video_title: Night Terrors Trailer - Augmented Reality Horror Game

works.technique: The phone camera feed is darkened and lit by a virtual flashlight, and apparitions are overlaid with jump-scare timing and spatial audio through headphones.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个只在手机“手电筒”光圈里才显示 AR 内容的场景，配合耳机中的方位声音；变体：光圈越小，恐怖元素越近。
works.description_zh: 一款戴着耳机在漆黑的家中游玩的生存恐怖游戏：手机成为看见那些在你自己房间里游荡的怪物和幽灵的唯一途径。
works.idea_en: Lights off, headphones on, and your own home becomes a horror game full of monsters.
works.technique_zh: 手机相机画面被调暗，并由一支虚拟手电筒照亮；幽灵以精心设计的惊吓时机叠加出现，并通过耳机播放空间音频。
works.exercise_en: Build a scene where AR content appears only inside the phone's "flashlight" circle, paired with directional sound in headphones. Twist: the smaller the circle, the closer the horror gets.

works.title: OST Rift
works.description: A consumer VR headset converted into an optical see-through AR display with careful timing so virtual objects stay locked to the real world during head motion.
works.idea_zh: 把VR头显改装成光学透视AR，让虚拟物体稳稳“钉”在现实中。

video.video_title: OST Rift: Temporally Consistent Augmented Reality with a Consumer HMD (IEEE VR 2016, poster)

works.technique: Adds beam-splitter optics to a Rift and predicts head pose to compensate display latency, keeping overlays temporally consistent with the real scene.
works.exercise_zh: 用HoloKit或手机+半透镜做一个简易透视AR眼镜，比较快速转头时虚拟方块的漂移；变化：人为加入200ms延迟，让同学描述感受。
works.description_zh: 把一台消费级 VR 头显改装成光学透视式 AR 显示器，并精细处理时序，使虚拟物体在头部运动时仍然牢牢锁定在现实世界中。
works.idea_en: A VR headset converted to optical see-through AR, with virtual objects pinned firmly to reality.
works.technique_zh: 为 Rift 加装分光镜光学组件，并预测头部位姿以补偿显示延迟，使叠加内容与真实场景在时间上保持一致。
works.exercise_en: Build simple see-through AR glasses from HoloKit or a phone plus a half-mirror, and compare how a virtual cube drifts during fast head turns. Twist: add an artificial 200 ms delay and have classmates describe how it feels.

works.title: Ornithographies
works.description: A short film of the Ornithographies project: flights of gulls, swallows and starlings are shown as solid ribbons and braids that hang in the sky, with a soundtrack made from the birds' own waveforms.
works.description_zh: Ornithographies 项目的短片：海鸥、燕子和椋鸟的飞行被呈现为悬在天空中的实体飘带和发辫，配乐由鸟的声波生成。
works.idea_en: Stacking time into one frame makes the invisible shape of flight visible: the basic recipe for any AR motion trail over real footage.
works.idea_zh: 把时间叠进一帧，让飞行的隐形形状显现：这是在真实画面上做任何 AR 运动轨迹的基本配方。
works.technique: Bou records birds with a high-frame-rate video camera, then merges the frames of each flight into one image by keeping, per pixel, the darkest or most different value against the sky.
works.technique_zh: Bou 用高帧率摄像机拍摄飞鸟，再逐像素保留与天空差异最大（或最暗）的值，把每次飞行的所有帧合成一张图像。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone camera effect (Lens Studio or a WebGL shader) that keeps a fading buffer of the last two seconds of dark pixels against the sky, and point it at birds or passing cars. Twist: colour each trail by time so the start of the flight is blue and the end is red.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机相机特效（Lens Studio 或 WebGL 着色器），保留最近两秒内比天空更暗的像素并让其渐隐，对准飞鸟或过往车辆；变体：按时间给轨迹上色，飞行起点为蓝、终点为红。

video.video_title: Ornithographies

salient.why_en: Stacking the frames of a bird's flight into one image draws the invisible shape its wings leave in the air.
salient.why_zh: 把鸟飞行的每一帧叠进一张图里，画出了翅膀在空中留下的、原本看不见的形状。

works.title: Our Colour Reflection
works.description: Hundreds of coloured mirrored discs are laid across the floor of a cathedral nave; they reflect the architecture and throw patches of coloured light onto the vaults.
works.description_zh: 数百个彩色镜面圆片铺满大教堂的中殿地面，它们倒映出建筑，并把一块块彩色光斑投到拱顶上。
works.idea_en: Looking down to see up: a floor of reflective tiles lets people explore a ceiling; AR floor layers can reveal what is above or behind the viewer.
works.idea_zh: 低头看见上方：一片反光地板让人去探索天花板；AR 地面图层可以揭示观者上方或身后的东西。
works.technique: Coloured acrylic mirrors of different sizes are placed in a modular layout; each reflects the space above and tints the light it bounces.
works.technique_zh: 不同大小的彩色亚克力镜按模块布局摆放，每一块都倒映上方空间，并给反射的光染色。
works.exercise_en: Scatter virtual coloured mirror discs on the real floor with AR Foundation plane detection, each showing a tinted reflection of the ceiling from the camera feed. Twist: let students drag the discs to compose a new pattern of reflected light on the ceiling.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 的平面检测在真实地面上撒一些虚拟彩色镜片，每片都用摄像画面显示天花板的染色倒影。变体：让同学拖动镜片，在天花板上组合新的反射光图案。

video.video_title: Liz West - Our Colour Reflection Art Installation Timelapse at Chester Cathedral

works.title: Our Spectral Vision
works.description: A seven-metre wall of glowing colour made for the Natural History Museum's Colour and Vision exhibition surrounds visitors with saturated light from across the spectrum.
works.description_zh: 为伦敦自然历史博物馆“色彩与视觉”展览制作的一面七米长发光色墙，用整段光谱的饱和光包围观众。
works.idea_en: Colour can explain science: pairing a spectrum of light with how different animals see it is a model for AR that shows the world through another species' eyes.
works.idea_zh: 颜色可以解释科学：把一段光谱与不同动物的视觉联系起来，正是用 AR 展示“以另一种生物的眼睛看世界”的范例。
works.technique: Dichroic glass and acrylic panels in front of LEDs split and reflect light into shifting spectral colours depending on the viewing angle.
works.technique_zh: LED 前方的二向色玻璃和亚克力板把光分解、反射成随观看角度变化的光谱色彩。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR filter set that remaps the camera view to how a bee, a dog and a mantis shrimp might see colour, and let students switch between them in the room. Twist: add a hidden 'ultraviolet' message only visible in the bee mode.
works.exercise_zh: 做一组手机 AR 滤镜，把摄像画面重映射成蜜蜂、狗和螳螂虾可能看到的颜色，让同学在教室里切换。变体：加一条只有在蜜蜂模式下才能看到的隐藏“紫外线”讯息。

video.video_title: Our Spectral Vision, Liz West's art installation for Colour and Vision | Natural History Museum

works.title: Our Time
works.description: A grid of pendulums hangs from the ceiling in darkness; lights and sounds swing and change speed so the room seems to speed up, slow down and stretch time.
works.description_zh: 一组摆锤从天花板垂下；黑暗中灯光和声音摆动并改变速度，房间仿佛在加速、减速、拉伸时间。
works.idea_en: Changing the tempo of a whole space changes how long a minute feels — AR can shape subjective time, not just space.
works.idea_zh: 改变整个空间的节奏会改变一分钟的长短感——AR 可以塑造主观时间，而不只是空间。
works.technique: Motorized pendulums with lights are driven at shifting rates and phases, with sound tied to each pendulum's movement.
works.technique_zh: 带灯的电动摆锤以不断变化的速率和相位运动，声音与每根摆锤的运动绑定。
works.exercise_en: Fill a room with a grid of swinging virtual lights in AR and slowly change their tempo over three minutes, then ask participants how long they think they were inside. Twist: link the tempo to the room's noise level.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中用一组摆动的虚拟灯填满房间，在三分钟内缓慢改变节奏，然后问参与者觉得自己在里面待了多久。变体：让节奏与房间的噪音大小挂钩。

video.video_title: United Visual Artists – Our Time

works.title: PHANTOGEIST
works.description: A first-person shooter on a Project Tango phone spawns ghostly enemies and environments around you anywhere, from a small room to a football field, with no markers.
works.idea_zh: 在任何真实场地里打第一人称幽灵射击，场地大小游戏自己适配。

video.video_title: PHANTOGEIST Demo Mode, SF Alley

works.technique: Tango's inside-out motion tracking gives 6DoF pose so enemies can be placed in world coordinates and the play area scales to the available physical space.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 做一个在操场上刷怪的小游戏，敌人从远处走来；加一个变化：只有把手机举高才能看到飞在空中的敌人。
works.description_zh: 一款运行在 Project Tango 手机上的第一人称射击游戏，无需任何标记，就能在任何地方——从小房间到足球场——在你周围生成幽灵敌人和环境。
works.idea_en: A first-person ghost shooter for any real space, with the game adapting to the size of the site.
works.technique_zh: Tango 的 inside-out 运动追踪提供 6DoF 位姿，使敌人可以放置在世界坐标中，游戏区域也会根据可用的实际空间自动缩放。
works.exercise_en: Build a small game with AR Foundation that spawns monsters on a sports field, with enemies walking in from the distance. Twist: enemies flying in the air can only be seen when you hold the phone up high.

works.title: PHANTOGEIST Co-op 'Automatic Mixed Reality'
works.description: Two Tango devices share the same ghost battle, so one player can film the other fighting virtual enemies, producing mixed-reality footage automatically.
works.idea_zh: 两台设备共享同一场战斗，一人玩、一人当'摄影师'，自动产出混合现实视频。

video.video_title: PHANTOGEIST: Co-Op "Automatic Mixed Reality"

works.technique: Both devices localize into a shared coordinate frame (likely via Tango area learning) so enemies appear in the same physical place for each player.
works.exercise_zh: 用 8th Wall/Lens Studio 的多人共享或 ARKit 协作会话做一个双人游戏：一个人打怪，另一个人拍摄；加一个变化：摄影者的镜头可以'冻结'怪物。
works.description_zh: 两台 Tango 设备共享同一场幽灵战斗，一名玩家可以拍摄另一名玩家与虚拟敌人战斗的画面，自动生成混合现实视频。
works.idea_en: Two devices share one battle: one person plays, the other films, and mixed-reality video comes out automatically.
works.technique_zh: 两台设备都定位到同一个共享坐标系中（大概率通过 Tango 区域学习），使敌人对每位玩家都出现在同一个物理位置。
works.exercise_en: Build a two-player game with 8th Wall or Lens Studio shared sessions, or an ARKit collaborative session, where one person fights monsters and the other films. Twist: the camera operator's lens can "freeze" the monsters.

works.title: PanoVC
works.description: A video call where the caller's phone continuously builds a panorama of their surroundings, so the remote person can look around the other place freely instead of seeing a single camera frame.
works.description_zh: 在视频通话中，呼叫方的手机持续拼接周围环境的全景，远程用户可以自由环顾对方所在的地方，而不是只看到单个摄像头画面。
works.idea_en: Share your whole surroundings on a call, not just where your camera points.
works.idea_zh: 通话时分享你的整个周遭环境，而不只是摄像头对着的地方。
works.technique: Incrementally stitches and streams a panoramic map from the sender's phone camera while live frames update the part currently in view.
works.technique_zh: 从发送方的手机摄像头逐步拼接并传输全景图，同时用实时帧更新当前视野中的那部分。
works.exercise_en: Take a phone panorama of the classroom, send it to a partner in another room, and keep sending live photos of the spot they ask to see; let them guide you to find an object. Twist: mark where the remote person is looking with a sticky note.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍一张教室全景发给另一个房间的同伴，再根据对方的要求不断发送所指位置的实时照片，让对方引导你找到一件物品；变体：用便利贴标出远程者正在看的位置。

video.video_title: PanoVC: Pervasive Telepresence using Mobile Phones

works.title: Parallel Eyes
works.description: Four people wear HMDs showing a split screen of everyone's first-person views at once, then try to play hide-and-seek and coordinate while seeing through all bodies simultaneously.
works.idea_zh: 四个人同时看到彼此的第一人称视角，在“共享眼睛”里玩捉迷藏。

video.video_title: Parallel Eyes : Exploring Human Capability and Behaviors with Paralleled First Person View Sharing

works.technique: Streams each participant's head-mounted camera into a shared tiled video layout shown in every HMD, a collaboration with YCAM.
works.exercise_zh: 让四名同学各用手机前摄/后摄开视频会议并把画面并排显示，戴着手机眼镜玩找人游戏；变化：随机把你的画面和别人的画面互换位置。
works.description_zh: 四个人戴着头显，同时看到所有人的第一人称视角分屏画面，然后在同时透过所有人的身体观看的状态下，尝试玩捉迷藏并相互配合。
works.idea_en: Four people see through each other's eyes at once and play hide-and-seek with shared vision.
works.technique_zh: 把每位参与者头戴相机的画面实时传输到一个共享的平铺视频布局中，并显示在每台头显里；这是与 YCAM 的合作作品。
works.exercise_en: Have four classmates join a video call with their phones' front or rear cameras, show all feeds side by side, and play a find-the-person game wearing phone viewers. Twist: randomly swap the position of your feed with someone else's.

salient.why_en: Four people see through each other's eyes at once and try to play hide-and-seek.
salient.why_zh: 四个人同时看到彼此的视角，再试着玩捉迷藏。

works.title: Parsing our Silent Language
works.description: A Kinect watches two people talking and labels their body language live, projecting words such as 'Interested' or 'Disinterested' over each of them.
works.description_zh: Kinect 观察两个人交谈，实时判读他们的肢体语言，并在各自身上投影出“感兴趣”或“不感兴趣”等字样。
works.idea_en: Make the unspoken signals of body language visible as captions.
works.idea_zh: 把肢体语言中未说出口的信号，变成看得见的字幕。
works.technique: Kinect depth and skeleton data are compared against posture features learned from recorded actors, and the classified state is shown as text on the depth image or projection.
works.technique_zh: 把 Kinect 的深度和骨骼数据与从演员录像中学到的姿态特征进行比对，把分类结果以文字形式显示在深度图或投影上。
works.exercise_en: Train a tiny pose classifier (Teachable Machine) on three postures, such as open, closed and leaning in, and caption each person live in a phone AR view. Twist: let the caption lie on purpose and ask pairs to act against it.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Teachable Machine 训练一个只识别三种姿态（开放、封闭、前倾）的小分类器，在手机 AR 画面里为每个人实时加上字幕；变体：故意让字幕“说谎”，请两人一组表演去反驳它。

video.video_title: Parsing our Silent Language

salient.why_en: Body language gets live captions: 'Interested' or 'Disinterested' appears over each person.
salient.why_zh: 肢体语言有了实时字幕：每个人身上浮现“感兴趣”或“不感兴趣”。

works.title: Phantom (Phantom Sketch Mod.)
works.description: Heavy, cinematic real-time visuals with bloom, depth of field and motion blur were projected for Merzbow and other acts at the Phantom Sketch Mod. event in October 2016.
works.description_zh: 2016 年 10 月的 Phantom Sketch Mod. 活动中，为 Merzbow 等艺人投影了厚重、电影感的实时视觉，带有泛光、景深和运动模糊。
works.idea_en: Push a game engine's post-processing stack to cinematic quality for a live show.
works.idea_zh: 把游戏引擎的后期处理推到电影级的质感，用于现场演出。
works.technique: Unity's multi-display feature shows a VJ control UI on the monitor and sends clean renders to the projector, while GPU-heavy image effects (SSAO, DOF, motion blur and Kino filters) run at 60 fps on a GTX 1070.
works.technique_zh: 利用 Unity 的多显示器功能，在监视器上显示 VJ 控制界面，把干净的画面送到投影仪；SSAO、景深、运动模糊和 Kino 滤镜等高负载图像效果在 GTX 1070 上以 60 fps 运行。
works.exercise_en: Build a two-device AR show: one phone is the control panel for bloom, blur and color, the other shows the AR scene to the audience. Twist: hand the control phone to someone in the audience.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个双设备 AR 演出：一部手机作为泛光、模糊和色彩的控制台，另一部向观众展示 AR 场景；变体：把控制手机交给一位观众。

video.video_title: Merzbow x BRDG / Keijiro Takahashi, vokoi #dommune https://t.co/ivhAxdA6uK

works.title: Pixel Forest
works.description: Thousands of LED lights, each inside a hand-made resin crystal, hang on strings through a dark room; together they play a video, but visitors walk between the pixels instead of looking at a screen.
works.description_zh: 数千个 LED 灯，每个都包在手工制作的树脂晶体里，用细线挂满一间暗室；它们合起来播放一段影像，观众却是在像素之间穿行，而不是看屏幕。
works.idea_en: Exploding a screen into its pixels lets people walk inside an image; volumetric AR content can be shown as sparse points that surround the body.
works.idea_zh: 把屏幕炸开成一个个像素，人就能走进画面：体积化的 AR 内容也可以用稀疏的点来呈现，把身体包围起来。
works.technique: Addressable RGB LEDs are hung in a 3D grid and driven like a very low-resolution display, with video mapped onto their positions.
works.technique_zh: 可寻址 RGB LED 挂成三维网格，像一块分辨率很低的显示屏一样被驱动，影像按它们的位置映射上去。
works.exercise_en: Sample a short video into a 20×20×10 grid of glowing points in WebXR and let students walk through the room-sized image. Twist: points near the viewer brighten and grow, so your body leaves a trail through the picture.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 中把一段短视频采样到 20×20×10 的发光点阵里，让学生在房间大小的影像中穿行。变体：离观众近的点会变亮变大，身体在画面里留下一道轨迹。

video.video_title: Pipilotti Rist: Pixel Forest. Solo Exhibition at New Museum, New York City

works.title: Pokémon GO
works.description: Players walk their neighbourhood to find Pokémon that appear on the camera view over the real street, then throw Poké Balls to catch them; gyms and raids gather players at landmarks.
works.idea_zh: 让宝可梦出现在你家街角，用行走和相机去收集它们。

video.video_title: Discover Pokémon in the Real World with Pokémon GO!

works.technique: GPS and spawn tables place creatures near map locations, and the encounter screen overlays the creature on the camera feed using gyroscope orientation rather than full SLAM.
works.exercise_zh: 用陀螺仪控制一个叠加在摄像头画面上的角色，只有转向正确方向时才看得到它，滑动屏幕扔球捕捉；变体：角色只在特定天气或时段出现。
works.description_zh: 玩家在自己的街区里走动寻找宝可梦，它们会出现在相机画面中的真实街道上，玩家投出精灵球来捕捉；道馆和团体战则把玩家聚集到地标处。
works.idea_en: Pokémon show up on your street corner, and you collect them by walking and using the camera.
works.technique_zh: GPS 与刷新表把小精灵放在地图位置附近，遭遇界面借助陀螺仪朝向（而非完整的 SLAM）把小精灵叠加在相机画面上。
works.exercise_en: Use the gyroscope to control a character overlaid on the camera image that can be seen only when you face the right direction, and swipe to throw a ball and catch it. Twist: the character appears only in certain weather or at certain times.

works.title: Portals for Mortals
works.description: An interactive takeover of a public sculpture with four doorways in Peterborough's Nene Park: walking through one doorway plays one part of a fanfare recorded by locals, and only passing through all four, usually as a group, plays the full fanfare and unlocks the next one.
works.description_zh: 对彼得伯勒 Nene Park 里一座有四个门洞的公共雕塑进行的互动改造：穿过一个门洞会奏响由当地人录制的号角曲中的一个声部，只有穿过全部四个门洞（通常需要一群人一起）才能奏出完整号角曲并解锁下一首。
works.idea_en: Walk through all four doorways together to play the whole fanfare.
works.idea_zh: 一起穿过四个门洞，才能奏出完整的号角曲。
works.technique: Sensors in each doorway detect a person passing and trigger that doorway's part of a four-part recording; a controller checks when all four have fired to advance to the next fanfare.
works.technique_zh: 每个门洞里的传感器检测有人经过，触发四声部录音中对应的一部分；控制器判断四个门洞都被触发后，切换到下一首号角曲。
works.exercise_en: Tape four cheap motion sensors to four classroom doorways or chair gaps, each triggering one layer of a song, and make the full song play only when all four fire within five seconds. Twist: the order of passing changes the arrangement.
works.exercise_zh: 在教室的四个门口或椅子间隙贴上四个便宜的运动传感器，每个触发歌曲的一个声部，只有五秒内四个都被触发时才播放完整歌曲；变体：穿过的顺序会改变编曲。

video.video_title: Portals for Mortals

salient.why_en: Each doorway of the sculpture plays one part of a fanfare, so the full tune only sounds when a group walks through together.
salient.why_zh: 雕塑的每个门洞奏响号角曲的一个声部，只有一群人一起穿过，才能听到完整的曲子。

works.title: Remote Memories (with Laurent Delforge / Before Tigers)
works.description: A panoramic polyptych of projection-mapped panels and sound that slowly assembles a pictorial landscape of memories, also performed live.
works.idea_zh: 把记忆碎片拼成一幅需要慢慢看的全景投影画
works.technique: Video is mapped across several physical panels of different sizes and depths so a single composition spans the polyptych.
works.exercise_zh: 用5块不同大小的白板组成多联画，投影一段老照片动画跨越所有面板；变化：每块面板代表一个人讲述的记忆片段。

video.video_title: Remote Memories - Yannick Jacquet & Before Tigers

works.description_zh: 一件由投影映射面板和声音构成的全景多联画，缓缓拼合出一幅由记忆组成的画面风景，也曾以现场演出的形式呈现。
works.idea_en: Fragments of memory pieced into a panoramic projection you have to take in slowly.
works.technique_zh: 视频被映射到多块大小和深度各不相同的实体面板上，使单一画面构图横跨整幅多联画。
works.exercise_en: Arrange five whiteboards of different sizes into a polyptych and project an animation of old photos across all the panels. Twist: each panel stands for a fragment of memory told by a different person.

works.title: Rio 2016 Olympic Cauldron
works.description: For the Rio 2016 Olympic opening ceremony, a small cauldron flame was framed by a huge kinetic sun of reflective spheres and plates that spun and pulsed around it.
works.description_zh: 在 2016 年里约奥运会开幕式上，一个小小的圣火被一轮巨大的动态“太阳”环绕，反光球体和金属板围着它旋转、脉动。
works.idea_en: A small real flame amplified by a moving reflective frame shows how AR can enlarge a modest real event rather than replace it.
works.idea_zh: 一团小小的真实火焰，被一个运动的反光框架放大：AR 可以放大一个朴素的真实事件，而不是取代它。
works.technique: A motorised rotating structure of polished stainless elements reflects and multiplies the flame's light, turning a small fire into a stadium-scale sun.
works.technique_zh: 由抛光不锈钢元件组成的电动旋转结构反射并倍增火焰的光，把小火苗变成体育场尺度的太阳。
works.exercise_en: Detect a candle or phone flashlight with the camera, then surround it in AR with a rotating ring of mirrors that reflect its glow. Twist: let the ring grow as more people gather around.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头识别一支蜡烛或手机手电筒，在 AR 中用一圈旋转的镜面环绕它、反射它的光。变体：围观的人越多，光环越大。

video.video_title: Anthony Howe 2016 Rio Olympic Cauldron

works.title: RoboRaid
works.description: Alien robots burst through your actual walls, leaving cracks, and you shoot them with gaze and air-tap while physically dodging projectiles.
works.idea_zh: 外星机器人从你家真实墙壁破墙而入。

video.video_title: Microsoft HoloLens: RoboRaid

works.technique: Uses the spatial-mapping mesh to pick wall spawn points and render crack decals, with spatial audio signalling enemies behind the player.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR检测竖直墙面并在墙上生成“破洞”贴图和钻出的敌人，玩家用准星点击射击；变化：只用声音提示敌人方位。
works.description_zh: 外星机器人冲破你家真实的墙壁闯进来，留下裂痕；你用注视和空中点击射击它们，同时还要真实地闪躲飞来的弹丸。
works.idea_en: Alien robots break in through the real walls of your home.
works.technique_zh: 利用空间映射网格选取墙面上的生成点并渲染裂痕贴花，同时用空间音频提示玩家身后的敌人。
works.exercise_en: Detect vertical walls in phone AR and generate "broken hole" decals with enemies crawling out of them, which players shoot by tapping a crosshair. Twist: signal enemy positions with sound alone.

works.title: Room2Room
works.description: Life-size telepresence: a remote person is captured in 3D and projected into your room, sitting on your real couch at the correct scale.
works.idea_zh: 把远方的人按真人大小投影到你家沙发上，不用戴任何设备。

video.video_title: Room2Room: Life-Size Telepresence in a Projected Augmented Reality Environment

works.technique: A Kinect captures the remote person as a colored depth mesh, and projector-camera calibration plus the local user's head tracking renders them life-size with perspective correction onto a real piece of furniture.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation 把远端同学的视频抠像，投影成真人大小坐在本地真实椅子上，并通过视频通话交谈；变体：让远端的人只在你看向椅子时出现。
works.description_zh: 真人大小的远程临场：远方的人被 3D 捕捉后投影到你的房间里，以正确的比例坐在你真实的沙发上。
works.idea_en: Project a faraway person at life size onto your sofa, with no headset required.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 把远端的人捕捉为带颜色的深度网格，借助投影仪—相机标定以及本地用户的头部追踪，把其以真人大小、经透视校正后渲染到一件真实家具上。
works.exercise_en: Cut out a remote classmate from their video with MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation, project them at life size sitting on a real local chair, and talk over a video call. Twist: the remote person appears only when you look at the chair.

works.title: Safe Passage (Konzerthaus Berlin)
works.description: The columns of Berlin's Konzerthaus were wrapped with 14,000 life jackets collected from refugees who had landed on the Greek island of Lesbos, with a rubber boat hanging in front.
works.description_zh: 柏林音乐厅的立柱被包裹上 14000 件救生衣，这些救生衣收集自在希腊莱斯沃斯岛登岸的难民，门前还悬挂着一艘橡皮艇。
works.idea_en: Covering a cultural landmark with the objects of a crisis brings a distant fact onto a local building, a strategy for AR data overlays on monuments.
works.idea_zh: 用一场危机的物件覆盖一座文化地标，把遥远的事实带到本地建筑上，这是在纪念建筑上做 AR 数据叠加的策略。
works.technique: Real orange life jackets were attached in dense rows to the building's columns, forming a bright facade layer.
works.technique_zh: 真实的橙色救生衣被密集成排地固定在建筑的立柱上，形成一层醒目的立面。
works.exercise_en: Wrap the columns or facade of a real building in AR with a repeated object that stands for a dataset (one object per person affected). Twist: the count updates from a live public dataset.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中用一个重复的物件包裹真实建筑的立柱或立面，每个物件代表一个受影响的人；变体：数量随实时公开数据更新。

video.video_title: Ai Weiwei covers Berlin landmark in refugee life jackets

salient.why_en: Refugees' life jackets wrap the columns of a Berlin concert hall, bringing the sea crossing onto a landmark.
salient.why_zh: 难民留下的救生衣包裹住柏林音乐厅的立柱，把海上逃亡带到了地标建筑上。

works.title: Schiphol Clock
works.description: A huge clock at Amsterdam Schiphol Airport appears to hold a man in overalls who paints and wipes the clock hands from inside, minute by minute, all day.
works.description_zh: 阿姆斯特丹史基浦机场的一座巨型钟里仿佛有一个穿工装的人，整天一分钟一分钟地从里面画上又擦去指针。
works.idea_en: An endless small human task in a public place gives travellers a moment of empathy — AR in transit spaces can use tiny human stories.
works.idea_zh: 公共场所里一个永无止境的小小人类劳作，能让旅客产生片刻共情——交通空间中的 AR 可以运用微小的人物故事。
works.technique: A 12-hour video recorded in real time is shown on a screen inside a transparent clock housing, synced to local time.
works.technique_zh: 实时录制的 12 小时视频在透明钟壳内的屏幕上播放，并与当地时间同步。
works.exercise_en: Create a location-anchored AR clock at your school entrance where a recorded classmate 'paints' the time every minute. Twist: swap the performer each hour so a different student lives in the clock.
works.exercise_zh: 在学校入口创建一个位置锚定的 AR 时钟，由一位同学的录像每分钟“画出”时间。变体：每小时换一位表演者，让不同的同学住在钟里。

video.video_title: The hands of Maarten Baas' Schiphol clock are drawn on in real time

salient.why_en: A man inside a giant airport clock repaints the hands by hand every minute.
salient.why_zh: 机场巨大的时钟里有一个人，每分钟亲手重画一次指针。

works.title: Screen Space Collision GPU Particles
works.description: Hundreds of thousands of GPU particles pour over a scene and bounce off every visible surface without any physics colliders.
works.description_zh: 几十万个 GPU 粒子倾泻到场景中，在每个可见表面上弹跳，而不需要任何物理碰撞体。
works.idea_en: If you can see a surface, particles can bounce off it: use the depth buffer as the collider.
works.idea_zh: 只要看得见一个表面，粒子就能在它上面弹开：把深度缓冲当作碰撞体。
works.technique: Particle positions update in a shader that projects each particle into screen space, compares its depth with the G-buffer depth and normal, and reflects its velocity on contact.
works.technique_zh: 粒子位置在着色器中更新：把每个粒子投影到屏幕空间，比较它与 G-buffer 中的深度和法线，接触时反射速度。
works.exercise_en: Use the AR depth texture (LiDAR or ARCore Depth) as the collision surface so virtual snow settles on real furniture. Twist: particles stick and pile up where they land.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR 深度纹理（LiDAR 或 ARCore Depth）作为碰撞表面，让虚拟雪落在真实家具上。变体：粒子落下后会粘住并堆积起来。

video.video_title: [Unity] Screen Space Collision GPU Particles Demo

works.title: Screen Space Particle Collision
works.description: A fountain of GPU particles lands on a 3D scene and slides and bounces over its surfaces, computed entirely on the GPU.
works.description_zh: 一股 GPU 粒子喷泉落到三维场景上，在表面上滑动、弹跳，全部在 GPU 上计算。
works.idea_en: Use what the camera sees as the physics world for particles.
works.idea_zh: 把相机看到的东西当成粒子的物理世界。
works.technique: A GPU particle system reads the camera's depth and normal buffers, detects when a particle passes behind a visible surface, and reflects its velocity along the surface normal.
works.technique_zh: GPU 粒子系统读取相机的深度和法线缓冲，检测粒子何时穿到可见表面后面，并沿表面法线反射其速度。
works.exercise_en: Feed the AR camera's depth into the particle shader so glitter pours from the ceiling and bounces off real people and tables. Twist: the particles take their colour from the camera pixel where they bounce.
works.exercise_zh: 把 AR 相机深度输入粒子着色器，让亮片从天花板洒下，在真实的人和桌子上弹开。变体：粒子在弹开处取相机像素的颜色。

video.video_title: Screen Space Particle Collision

works.title: Seven Magic Mountains
works.description: Seven towers of stacked limestone boulders, painted in fluorescent colours and up to 11 metres tall, stand in the Nevada desert south of Las Vegas.
works.description_zh: 七座由石灰岩巨石堆叠而成、涂着荧光色、高达 11 米的石塔立在拉斯维加斯以南的内华达沙漠中。
works.idea_en: Bright artificial colour against a natural landscape reads instantly as 'placed', the look many AR objects have, used here on purpose.
works.idea_zh: 在自然风景中使用鲜艳的人工色彩，会立即被读作“被放置的”，这正是许多 AR 物体的样子，在这里被有意使用。
works.technique: Locally quarried boulders were stacked on steel pins and painted with bright, weather-resistant paint.
works.technique_zh: 就地开采的巨石用钢销叠放固定，并涂上鲜艳的耐候涂料。
works.exercise_en: Stack scanned rocks into seven AR totems in a desert-like space and paint each stone a flat bright colour. Twist: let visitors restack one stone per visit.
works.exercise_zh: 把扫描的石头在类似荒漠的空地上叠成七座 AR 图腾，并给每块石头涂上纯色；变体：让每位访客每次到访可以重新叠放一块石头。

video.video_title: Artist Ugo Rondinone on "Seven Magic Mountains"

works.title: Shining360
works.description: A 30-minute 360-degree film that reconstructs the spaces of Kubrick's The Shining as fragmented 3D models, letting viewers look around the hotel while the camera follows the original shots.
works.description_zh: 一部 30 分钟的 360 度影片，把库布里克《闪灵》中的空间重建为破碎的三维模型，观众可以环顾酒店，镜头则沿着原片的机位运动。
works.idea_en: Every film shot hides a 3D space that can be reconstructed and walked through.
works.idea_zh: 每一个电影镜头里都藏着一个可以被重建、可以走进去的三维空间。
works.technique: The film was split into frames, photogrammetry computed depth and 3D fragments from each scene, and the fragments were stitched along the original camera path for VR.
works.technique_zh: 把影片拆成逐帧画面，用摄影测量为每个场景计算深度和三维碎片，再沿原始摄像机路径拼接，供 VR 观看。
works.exercise_en: Take a 10-second tracking shot from a film or your own phone, extract frames and run them through a photogrammetry tool, then fly a virtual camera through the result. Twist: look at what the original camera never showed.
works.exercise_zh: 取一段 10 秒的电影跟拍镜头或自己用手机拍的视频，抽帧后用摄影测量工具处理，再让虚拟摄像机在结果中飞行；变体：去看看原来的镜头从未拍到的地方。

video.video_title: Shining360°

works.title: Sisyphus
works.description: A steel ball rolls silently through a bed of sand, pulled by a hidden magnet, drawing spirals and flower patterns that it then erases with the next drawing.
works.description_zh: 一颗钢珠在隐藏磁铁的牵引下无声地滚过沙床，画出螺旋和花形图案，又在画下一幅时将其抹去。
works.idea_en: A single moving point leaves a readable trace in a real material; AR trails that interact with real surfaces can feel as calm and physical as this.
works.idea_zh: 一个移动的点在真实材料中留下可读的痕迹；与真实表面互动的 AR 轨迹也可以像这样安静而有质感。
works.technique: A two-axis polar robot under the table moves a magnet along programmed paths; the ball follows above and displaces sand, so the path becomes a drawing.
works.technique_zh: 桌下的两轴极坐标机器人沿预设路径移动磁铁，上面的钢珠随之移动并推开沙子，路径就成了画。
works.exercise_en: Detect a real tabletop in phone AR and roll a virtual ball that carves a persistent groove into a sand shader along a parametric path. Twist: let the viewer draw the path with a finger and watch the ball follow it.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 识别真实桌面，让一颗虚拟钢珠沿参数化路径在沙质着色器上刻出持续的沟纹。变体：观众用手指画路径，钢珠随后跟着走。

video.video_title: SISYPHUS kinetic art table

works.title: Skinner
works.description: A dancing character sheds thousands of particles, glowing trails and glitchy triangle fragments straight from its animated skin while it moves.
works.description_zh: 一个跳舞的角色一边运动，一边从皮肤上甩出成千上万的粒子、发光拖尾和故障风的三角碎片。
works.idea_en: Use every vertex of a moving body as an emitter, so the motion itself paints the effect.
works.idea_zh: 把运动身体上的每个顶点都当作发射器，让动作本身来“画”出特效。
works.technique: A replacement shader bakes the skinned mesh's vertex positions for the current and previous frame into render textures, and GPU particle, trail and glitch renderers read those textures to spawn and move their elements.
works.technique_zh: 用替换着色器把蒙皮网格当前帧和上一帧的顶点位置写进渲染纹理，GPU 上的粒子、拖尾和故障渲染器读取这些纹理来生成并推动各自的元素。
works.exercise_en: Import a Mixamo dancer into Unity, sample its skinned mesh in a VFX Graph particle system and place the dancer on a detected floor with AR Foundation on a phone. Twist: switch to ARKit body tracking so a classmate's own body sheds the particles.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity 里导入一个 Mixamo 舞者，用 VFX Graph 采样它的蒙皮网格发射粒子，再用 AR Foundation 把舞者放到手机识别出的地面上；变体：改用 ARKit 人体追踪，让同学自己的身体甩出粒子。

video.video_title: Skinner: Special Effects with Skinned Mesh in Unity

works.title: SnapToReality
works.description: Virtual objects in AR automatically snap to real-world edges and planes, making precise alignment of holograms with furniture effortless.
works.idea_zh: 让全息物体像PPT吸附对齐一样'吸'到真实桌边和墙面上。

video.video_title: SnapToReality: Aligning Augmented Reality to the Real World

works.technique: Planes and dominant edges are extracted from the depth data in real time, and virtual objects being manipulated are snapped to the nearest aligned constraint when within a distance and angle threshold.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中实现拖动虚拟相框时自动吸附到最近的检测平面和平面边缘（距离小于 5cm 时吸附）；变体：设计一种“反吸附”，让某些物体总是躲开真实表面漂浮。
works.description_zh: AR 中的虚拟物体会自动吸附到真实世界的边缘和平面上，让全息影像与家具的精确对齐变得毫不费力。
works.idea_en: Holograms snap onto real table edges and walls, like the snap-to-align guides in slide software.
works.technique_zh: 从深度数据中实时提取平面和主要边缘，当被操作的虚拟物体进入距离和角度阈值范围内时，便吸附到最近的对齐约束上。
works.exercise_en: In AR Foundation, make a virtual picture frame snap to the nearest detected plane and plane edge while being dragged, when it is within 5 cm. Twist: design an "anti-snap" so some objects always float away from real surfaces.

works.title: Spectrum (Liquidroom 2016)
works.description: A real-time VJ rig for the 2016 end-of-year party at Liquidroom layers 3D scenes with datamosh, feedback, contour and binary-style screen effects.
works.description_zh: 为 2016 年 Liquidroom 跨年派对做的实时 VJ 系统，把 3D 场景和数据损坏、画面反馈、轮廓线、二值化等画面效果叠加在一起。
works.idea_en: Combine a whole library of screen effects into one playable party instrument.
works.idea_zh: 把一整套画面效果库组合成一件可以现场演奏的派对乐器。
works.technique: The Unity project stacks Keijiro's Kino image effects (Datamosh, Feedback, Contour, Binary and others) on top of animated scenes and switches them live.
works.technique_zh: 这个 Unity 项目在动画场景之上叠加 Keijiro 的 Kino 图像效果（Datamosh、Feedback、Contour、Binary 等），并在现场切换。
works.exercise_en: Stack three screen effects (feedback, datamosh, contour) on an AR camera view and switch them with on-screen buttons during a song. Twist: let the song's bass level choose the effect automatically.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 相机画面上叠加三种画面效果（反馈、数据损坏、轮廓线），在一首歌中用屏幕按钮切换；变体：让歌曲的低音强度自动选择效果。

works.title: Star glow shader (Kawase Light Streak)
works.description: Bright highlights in the scene burst into long cross-shaped star streaks, like a camera lens with a star filter.
works.description_zh: 场景里的亮点迸出长长的十字星芒，就像装了星光滤镜的相机镜头。
works.idea_en: Recreate a photographic star filter in real time.
works.idea_zh: 实时再现摄影用的星光滤镜。
works.technique: Following Masaki Kawase's GDC 2003 technique, bright pixels are extracted and blurred repeatedly along a few directions with growing sample offsets, then added back to the image.
works.technique_zh: 按照川濑正树 GDC 2003 的方法，先提取亮像素，再沿几个方向以逐渐增大的采样间距反复模糊，最后叠加回画面。
works.exercise_en: Apply the streak effect to an AR scene so real lamps and virtual objects both flare with star streaks. Twist: rotate the streak directions with the phone's roll angle.
works.exercise_zh: 把星芒效果用在 AR 场景里，让真实灯光和虚拟物体都迸出星芒。变体：让星芒方向跟随手机的横滚角旋转。

video.video_title: Star glow shader for Unity

works.title: SÉANCE
works.description: Twenty people sit around a table in a shipping container dressed as a Victorian séance room; the lights go out and, through headphones, a medium and unseen presences seem to move around and touch the group.
works.description_zh: 二十名观众围坐在一个布置成维多利亚时代降神会房间的集装箱里；灯灭之后，耳机里的通灵者和看不见的“存在”仿佛在众人身边走动，甚至触碰他们。
works.idea_en: Total darkness plus binaural sound makes a group believe something has entered the room.
works.idea_zh: 完全黑暗加上双耳立体声，让一群人相信有东西进入了房间。
works.technique: Pre-recorded binaural audio (recorded with a dummy head at each seat position) is played in sync to every headset while small physical effects such as air, vibration and touch are triggered in the dark container.
works.technique_zh: 每个座位位置都用仿真人头录制双耳音频，演出时同步播放到每副耳机，同时在黑暗的集装箱里触发气流、震动、触碰等小型实体效果。
works.exercise_en: Record a 3-minute binaural 'ghost story' with a dummy head or in-ear binaural mics in your classroom, then play it to classmates blindfolded in the same seats. Twist: add one real physical cue (a draught, a tap on the table) timed to the audio.
works.exercise_zh: 用仿真人头或入耳式双耳麦克风在教室里录一段 3 分钟的双耳“鬼故事”，再让同学蒙眼坐在同样的位置收听；变体：加入一个与音频同步的真实物理提示（一阵风、桌面的一次敲击）。

video.video_title: SÉANCE Trailer 1 - DARKFIELD

works.title: TOKYO TOWER CITY LIGHT FANTASIA – Spring Concerto
works.description: On the observation deck of Tokyo Tower, animations are projected onto the large windows so that cherry blossoms and light float over the real night view of Tokyo below.
works.description_zh: 在东京塔展望台，动画被投到大玻璃窗上，樱花和光点漂浮在窗外真实的东京夜景之上。
works.idea_en: A window is already a see-through display; drawing on it over a real skyline is exactly the optical idea of AR glasses.
works.idea_zh: 窗户本身就是一块透明显示器，在真实天际线上方作画，正是 AR 眼镜的光学原理。
works.technique: Projectors inside the deck likely throw images onto a semi-transparent film on the glass, so the city stays visible through the animation.
works.technique_zh: 推测展望台内的投影机把画面投到贴在玻璃上的半透明膜上，城市夜景可以透过动画看到。
works.exercise_en: Stand at a window with a view, anchor AR content to the skyline with world tracking, and let virtual petals drift over real buildings. Twist: each building lights up when a petal lands on it.
works.exercise_zh: 站在一扇能看到风景的窗前，用世界追踪把 AR 内容锚定在天际线上，让虚拟花瓣飘过真实的楼群；变体：花瓣落到哪栋楼上，哪栋楼就亮起来。

video.video_title: TOKYO TOWER CITY LIGHT FANTASIA -Spring Concerto-

works.title: The Cloud
works.description: A white cloud floats inside a glass vitrine; walking around it, you notice it is made of stacked glass sheets, each printed with one thin slice of the cloud.
works.description_zh: 一朵白云漂浮在玻璃展柜里；绕着它走一圈，你会发现它由一层层玻璃叠成，每一层只印着云的一个薄切片。
works.idea_en: Volume can be faked with a stack of flat layers: slicing a 3D shape into printed planes is a cheap way to make holograms or 'volumetric' AR content that reads from many angles.
works.idea_zh: 体积可以用一叠平面来伪造：把三维形状切成一层层印刷平面，是制作全息感或“体积感”AR 内容的便宜办法，而且从多个角度都能看。
works.technique: A 3D cloud model is cut into slices and each slice is printed with ceramic ink on a glass pane; the panes are stacked at even spacing so the image fuses into a volume.
works.technique_zh: 把三维云模型切片，每一片用陶瓷油墨印在一块玻璃上，再等距叠放，图像就融合成一个立体。
works.exercise_en: Slice a 3D model into 20 semi-transparent planes in Unity or three.js and anchor the stack in AR, then compare it with the solid mesh as you walk around. Twist: let each plane drift slightly with the phone's motion so the cloud 'breathes' when you move.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity 或 three.js 里把一个三维模型切成 20 层半透明平面，把这叠平面锚定在 AR 中，绕着走，和实心模型比较观感。变体：让每一层随手机移动轻微漂移，你一动，云就在“呼吸”。

video.video_title: What is more quiet than a cloud? Cloud, Leandro Erlich, Tokyo

works.title: The Floating Piers
works.description: Three kilometres of walkways covered in yellow fabric floated on Lake Iseo in Italy, letting 1.2 million people walk on water between the shore and two islands for 16 days.
works.description_zh: 三公里长、覆盖黄色织物的浮动步道漂在意大利伊塞奥湖上，16 天内让 120 万人在岸边与两座岛之间“行走于水面”。
works.idea_en: Walking on water is felt through the body (the piers move under your feet), a reminder that AR can borrow real physical sensations.
works.idea_zh: 水上行走是通过身体感受到的（浮桥在脚下起伏），提醒我们 AR 可以借用真实的身体感受。
works.technique: 220,000 floating polyethylene cubes formed a modular dock covered with shimmering fabric that changed colour when wet.
works.technique_zh: 22 万个漂浮的聚乙烯方块组成模块化浮台，上面覆盖着遇水变色的闪光织物。
works.exercise_en: In AR, lay a glowing path across a real pond or a car park and add subtle camera sway when the user walks on it. Twist: the path only extends one step ahead of the walker.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中，在真实的池塘或停车场上铺一条发光小路，当用户走上去时给镜头加入轻微晃动；变体：小路只在行人前方延伸一步。

video.video_title: These floating piers let visitors walk on water

works.title: Tornado Simulator
works.description: A twister sweeps across a small town, sucking up cars, cows and debris and flinging them around its funnel.
works.description_zh: 一股龙卷风扫过小镇，把汽车、奶牛和碎片吸进去，再沿漏斗甩出来。
works.idea_en: A tornado is a few forces: pull in, lift up, spin around.
works.idea_zh: 龙卷风就是几种力：向内吸、向上抬、绕圈转。
works.technique: Rigidbodies inside the funnel get a radial pull toward the axis, an upward lift and a tangential force, while particle systems draw the funnel and dust.
works.technique_zh: 漏斗内的刚体受到指向轴心的径向拉力、向上的升力和切向力，粒子系统负责画出漏斗和尘土。
works.exercise_en: Drop a miniature tornado onto an AR table top and let it pick up virtual objects the user has placed there. Twist: make it suck up a real object's scanned copy from the LiDAR mesh.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个迷你龙卷风放到 AR 桌面上，让它卷起用户放置的虚拟物体。变体：让它把 LiDAR 扫描出的真实物体副本也卷走。

video.video_title: Open Source Tornado Simulator Game in Unity

works.title: Treehugger: Wawona
works.description: Participants hug a physical sculpture of a giant sequoia and put their head into its knot; in the headset, they see water and nutrients flowing inside the tree, and the longer they hug, the deeper they drift into tree time.
works.description_zh: 参与者拥抱一棵巨型红杉的实体雕塑，把头伸进树洞；在头显里，他们看到水分和养分在树体内流动，拥抱得越久，就越深地沉入“树的时间”。
works.idea_en: A physical hug is the interface to the invisible life inside a tree.
works.idea_zh: 一个真实的拥抱，就是进入树内部隐秘生命的接口。
works.technique: A headset experience is aligned with a physical tree sculpture so touch matches the virtual trunk, with particle visuals and spatial audio driven by dwell time.
works.technique_zh: 头显体验与实体树雕塑对齐，触摸与虚拟树干一致，粒子画面和空间音频随停留时间推进。
works.exercise_en: Wrap a pillar or tree with a cardboard 'bark' and build a phone-in-headset scene that shows flowing particles inside it, advancing only while the user keeps both hands on it. Twist: add a fan or smell cue that appears at the deepest level.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸板“树皮”包住一根柱子或一棵树，做一个手机头显场景，显示其内部流动的粒子，只有用户双手一直扶着它时才会推进；变体：在最深的阶段加入风扇或气味提示。

video.video_title: Treehugger Trailer

salient.why_en: Hugging a tree is the interface that reveals the water flowing inside it.
salient.why_zh: 拥抱一棵树就是交互方式，由此看见树里流动的水。

works.title: Typography Insight for HoloLens
works.description: A HoloLens version of the typography learning app Typography Insight, with a 'Type Playground' where people place words in the real room in different typefaces, styles and sizes and walk around them to compare letterforms.
works.description_zh: 字体学习 App Typography Insight 的 HoloLens 版，带有一个“字体游乐场”：人们可以把不同字体、样式和大小的文字放进真实房间里，绕着它们走动来比较字形。
works.idea_en: Learn typography by walking around letters as if they were objects.
works.idea_zh: 像绕着实物走一样绕着字母走，从而学习字体。
works.technique: 3D text meshes generated from font outlines are placed with gaze and air-tap, anchored to the room through HoloLens spatial mapping.
works.technique_zh: 由字体轮廓生成的 3D 文字网格通过注视和空中点击放置，并借助 HoloLens 空间映射锚定在房间中。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR app that places the same word in three typefaces side by side on a table so students can compare them from all angles. Twist: letters grow a shadow that reveals each font's stroke contrast.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 应用，把同一个单词用三种字体并排放在桌面上，让学生从各个角度比较；变体：给字母加上投影，用阴影揭示每种字体的笔画粗细对比。

video.video_title: Typography Insight for HoloLens (2016)

works.title: Uncertain Journey
works.description: Red yarn spun from the gallery ceiling wraps around several bare metal boat frames, turning the whole white space into a dense red web the visitor walks through.
works.description_zh: 红色毛线从画廊天花板拉下，缠绕在几具裸露的金属船架上，把整个白色空间变成一张观众可以穿行的浓密红网。
works.idea_en: Thousands of thin lines in one color can turn an empty room into a solid-feeling volume; in AR, line density alone can define a space without any walls.
works.idea_zh: 成千上万根同色细线，就能让空房间变成看似实在的体量：在 AR 中，只靠线的密度就能定义空间，不需要墙。
works.technique: Red wool is tied point by point from ceiling to the boat frames, building up a web whose density reads as color and shadow.
works.technique_zh: 红色毛线一点一点从天花板系到船架上，密密层层的网在视觉上变成色块和阴影。
works.exercise_en: Write a Three.js/WebXR script that draws 2,000 random red lines between the detected ceiling height and a few anchor objects you place in a room. Twist: lines within a meter of the viewer loosen and sag, so walking carves a path through the web.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Three.js/WebXR 写一段脚本，在识别到的天花板高度与你放置的几个锚定物之间随机连出 2,000 根红线。变体：离观众一米以内的线会松弛下垂，走动就能在网中开出一条路。

video.video_title: Chiharu Shiota | Uncertain Journey | Opening at Blain|Southern

works.title: Underwater Pavilions
works.description: Off Catalina Island, three geodesic sculptures with mirrored and rough surfaces are anchored under the sea; divers swim through them as the reflections of fish and water shift.
works.description_zh: 在卡塔利娜岛外海，三件带有镜面和粗糙表面的网格球体雕塑被锚定在海下；潜水者穿行其间，鱼群和海水的倒影不断变化。
works.idea_en: A sculpture you can only visit by entering another element (water) shows how an AR piece can require a special trip or state to be seen.
works.idea_zh: 只有进入另一种介质（水）才能拜访的雕塑说明，AR 作品可以要求一段特殊的旅程或状态才能被看到。
works.technique: Faceted structures of mirror and textured panels were moored to the sea floor at depths reachable by recreational divers.
works.technique_zh: 由镜面与纹理面板构成的多面体结构被系泊在休闲潜水者可到达的海底深度。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR piece that only appears when the phone is inside a clear bag in a pool or bathtub (detected by camera blur or a colour cue). Twist: the piece reflects any fish or swimmers passing by.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一件只有当手机装在透明袋中、处于泳池或浴缸水下时才出现的 AR 作品（通过相机模糊或色彩线索检测）；变体：作品会反射经过的鱼或游泳者。

video.video_title: Doug Aitken - Underwater Pavilions

works.title: Unifield | Projection on Lasercut Sculpture
works.description: A laser-cut sculpture based on Coxeter's higher-dimensional geometry is projection-mapped so light seems to reveal a 4D object rotating through it.
works.idea_zh: 在激光切割雕塑上做投影映射，像一个四维物体在其中穿行。

video.video_title: Unifield | Projection on Lasercut Sculpture

works.technique: Projection mapping aligns rendered animation to the fabricated sculpture's facets so virtual light and motion appear to live on the physical form.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸板折一个多面体，投影映射让每个面依次亮起形成'旋转'错觉；加一个变化：观众走动时（用摄像头检测）光的旋转方向改变。
works.description_zh: 一件基于 Coxeter 高维几何的激光切割雕塑，经过投影映射后，光线仿佛揭示出一个在其中旋转穿行的四维物体。
works.idea_en: Projection mapping on a laser-cut sculpture makes it look like a 4D object is passing through it.
works.technique_zh: 投影映射把渲染的动画与制作完成的雕塑切面精确对齐，使虚拟的光与运动看起来就存在于实体形态之上。
works.exercise_en: Fold a polyhedron from cardboard and use projection mapping to light up its faces in sequence, creating the illusion of rotation. Twist: change the direction of the rotating light when viewers walk by, detected with a camera.

works.title: Volumetric Lights for Unity
works.description: Point lights and spotlights fill a hazy scene with visible light shafts and shadowed beams that react to occluders.
works.description_zh: 点光源和聚光灯让朦胧的场景里出现看得见的光柱，被遮挡的地方光束中也出现阴影。
works.idea_en: Make the air visible by marching rays through the light.
works.idea_zh: 沿着光线步进采样，让空气变得看得见。
works.technique: For each pixel the shader raymarches through the light volume at half resolution, samples the shadow map and a 3D noise at each step to accumulate in-scattering with a phase function, then upsamples bilaterally.
works.technique_zh: 着色器对每个像素以半分辨率在光照体积中做光线步进，每一步采样阴影贴图和三维噪声，用相位函数累积散射光，再做双边上采样。
works.exercise_en: Add a volumetric spotlight to an AR scene and anchor it to a real lamp detected with AR Foundation, so virtual dust glows in the beam. Twist: let the phone's flashlight direction steer the virtual beam.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 场景里加一个体积聚光灯，锚定到 AR Foundation 检测到的真实台灯上，让虚拟灰尘在光束中发亮。变体：让手机手电筒的方向控制虚拟光束。

video.video_title: Volumetric Lights in Unity

works.title: WaterColor Filter
works.description: A 3D scene is re-rendered as a watercolour painting, with wobbling edges, darkened pigment borders and paper texture.
works.description_zh: 一个三维场景被重新渲染成水彩画：边缘微微抖动，颜料边界加深，还有纸张纹理。
works.idea_en: Turn any real-time scene into a moving watercolour illustration.
works.idea_zh: 把任何实时场景变成会动的水彩插画。
works.technique: Tone-based diffuse shading, edge wobbling by noise-offset UVs, edge darkening from colour gradients and a paper-grain overlay are combined in an image-effect chain.
works.technique_zh: 在一条画面特效链中结合了基于色调的漫反射、用噪声偏移 UV 做的边缘抖动、根据颜色梯度的边缘加深和纸纹叠加。
works.exercise_en: Run the filter over the AR camera feed so the real room and the virtual objects share the same watercolour style. Twist: let the paper texture be a photo of real paper the students scan.
works.exercise_zh: 把滤镜用在 AR 相机画面上，让真实房间和虚拟物体呈现同一种水彩风格。变体：把学生扫描的真实纸张照片作为纸纹。

video.video_title: WaterColor Filter for Unity

works.title: Wilderness Wiggle
works.description: A body-controlled Alaskan wilderness play wall for children at the Alaska Native Medical Center, where movement makes animals and landscape respond.
works.idea_zh: 阿拉斯加医院里的体感荒野游戏墙，动作让动物与风景回应孩子。

video.video_title: Wilderness Wiggle

works.technique: A depth camera tracks body silhouettes and movement, which are mapped to responsive animal and landscape animations on a play wall.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个你家乡的自然景观，用摄像头和 p5.js 做一面体感墙，动作让当地动物出现或躲起来；变体：请一位来自不同地方的同学提供动物和声音素材，让墙讲述他的地方。
works.description_zh: 为阿拉斯加原住民医疗中心的孩子们打造的一面体感阿拉斯加荒野游戏墙，孩子们的动作会让动物和风景做出回应。
works.idea_en: A motion-sensing wilderness play wall in an Alaskan hospital where animals and landscape answer children's movements.
works.technique_zh: 深度相机追踪身体轮廓和动作，并将其映射为游戏墙上会做出回应的动物和风景动画。
works.exercise_en: Pick a natural landscape from your hometown and build a motion-sensing wall with a camera and p5.js where movement makes local animals appear or hide. Twist: ask a classmate from a different place to supply animals and sounds so the wall tells the story of their place.

works.title: Young Conker
works.description: A HoloLens platformer that scans your room and procedurally turns furniture and floors into levels for the squirrel Conker to run across.
works.idea_zh: 扫描房间，把家具和地面自动变成平台游戏关卡。

video.video_title: Microsoft HoloLens ~ Young Conker

works.technique: The room mesh is analyzed for walkable horizontal surfaces, and a procedural level generator places platforms, collectibles and paths across real furniture.
works.exercise_zh: 用平面检测找出房间里所有水平面，在它们之间自动生成跳跃路径和金币；变体：让角色在真实物体边缘会滑落。
works.description_zh: 一款 HoloLens 平台游戏，会扫描你的房间，并以程序化方式把家具和地面变成关卡，让松鼠 Conker 在上面奔跑。
works.idea_en: Scan the room and automatically turn furniture and floors into platformer levels.
works.technique_zh: 分析房间网格中可行走的水平表面，由程序化关卡生成器在真实家具上布置平台、收集品和路径。
works.exercise_en: Find all horizontal surfaces in a room with plane detection and automatically generate jump paths and coins between them. Twist: make the character slip off the edges of real objects.

works.title: Zooids
works.description: Dozens of small tabletop robots act like physical pixels, arranging themselves into charts, shapes and handles that users can push, drag and grab.
works.description_zh: 几十个桌面小机器人像实体像素一样，排列成图表、形状和把手，用户可以推、拖、抓。
works.idea_en: A display made of many tiny robots that you can touch, rearrange and hold.
works.idea_zh: 由许多小机器人组成、可以触摸、重新排列和握住的显示器。
works.technique: Tracks each robot with a projector-based optical system and drives them with collision-free motion planning so the swarm forms target layouts and responds to touch.
works.technique_zh: 用基于投影仪的光学系统追踪每个机器人，并通过无碰撞运动规划驱动它们，使群体排出目标布局并对触摸作出反应。
works.exercise_en: Have ten students act as 'pixels' on a gridded floor and follow phone instructions to form a bar chart of class data, then let a volunteer push one to change the data. Twist: use projection to show each pixel's target spot.
works.exercise_zh: 让十名学生在画好格子的地板上充当“像素”，按手机上的指令排成反映班级数据的柱状图，再让一位志愿者推动其中一个来改变数据；变体：用投影显示每个“像素”的目标位置。

video.video_title: Zooids: Building Block for Swarm User Interface

works.title: connected colors
works.description: Face-tracked projection mapping blooms plants, birds and patterns across a performer's face in sync with her movement.
works.idea_zh: 花鸟纹样在追踪的面孔上实时绽放

video.video_title: connected colors / real-time face tracking and 3d projection mapping

works.technique: Real-time face tracking feeds a projector-camera system that renders animated patterns in the face's UV space, so plants and birds appear to grow on the skin as the head turns.
works.exercise_zh: 在 TouchDesigner 里用 MediaPipe 人脸关键点驱动一段花纹生长动画，投影到戴白色面具的同学脸上；变体：让花纹的生长速度随音乐或呼吸声变化。
works.description_zh: 基于面部追踪的投影映射，让植物、鸟和纹样随表演者的动作在她的脸上同步绽放。
works.idea_en: Flower and bird patterns bloom live on a tracked face.
works.technique_zh: 实时面部追踪数据输入投影仪—相机系统，在面部 UV 空间中渲染动画纹样，使头部转动时植物和鸟仿佛从皮肤上生长出来。
works.exercise_en: In TouchDesigner, drive a pattern-growing animation with MediaPipe face landmarks and project it onto the face of a classmate wearing a white mask. Twist: make the growth speed follow the music or the sound of breathing.

works.title: live AR system test
works.description: A test of a live AR system for stage shows, with virtual graphics anchored to the physical stage as the broadcast camera moves.
works.idea_zh: 舞台直播中虚拟图形与真实舞台锁定的实时AR系统

video.video_title: live ar system test

works.technique: A broadcast camera with tracking (encoders or optical) streams its pose and lens data to a real-time engine that renders stage-anchored graphics matched to the camera's view.
works.exercise_zh: 用一台手机做“转播机位”，在 Unity AR 中给桌面小舞台加上固定位置的虚拟灯光和布景，另一名同学在舞台上表演；变体：让虚拟布景随表演者的声音大小变化。
works.description_zh: 一次面向舞台演出的实时 AR 系统测试，在转播摄像机移动时，虚拟图形始终锚定在实体舞台上。
works.idea_en: A live AR system that locks virtual graphics to the real stage during a live broadcast.
works.technique_zh: 带追踪功能（编码器或光学方式）的转播摄像机把位姿和镜头数据传给实时引擎，引擎渲染出锚定在舞台上、与摄像机视角匹配的图形。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone as the "broadcast camera" and add fixed virtual lights and scenery to a small tabletop stage in Unity AR while another classmate performs on it. Twist: make the virtual scenery change with the performer's voice volume.

works.title: t-shirt mapping
works.description: Generative graphics are projected onto a white t-shirt and follow the wearer's body, turning plain clothing into a moving display.
works.description_zh: 生成式图形被投影到一件白色 T 恤上并跟随穿着者的身体，把普通衣服变成会动的显示屏。
works.idea_en: Clothing becomes a screen when projection follows the body.
works.idea_zh: 当投影跟着身体走，衣服就成了屏幕。
works.technique: A Kinect depth camera segments the torso and drives a generative mask that is projection-mapped onto the shirt in real time.
works.technique_zh: 用 Kinect 深度相机分割出躯干，驱动一个生成式遮罩，并实时投影映射到 T 恤上。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam body-segmentation model to mask a projector's output so a pattern lands only on a white shirt. Twist: the pattern changes with the wearer's heartbeat or breathing sound.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头人体分割模型给投影输出加遮罩，让图案只落在白色 T 恤上；变体：图案随穿着者的心跳或呼吸声变化。

video.video_title: t-shirt mapping

works.title: toki-
works.description: A 3D-printed lattice of intertwined figures spins while a thin line of projected light cuts through it, revealing a single walking or dancing figure that moves in space.
works.description_zh: 一个由相互缠绕的人形组成的 3D 打印网格在旋转，一道细细的投影光线穿过它，照出一个在空间中行走或舞蹈的人形。
works.idea_en: Light chooses the frame: an AR designer learns that a sliced reveal can turn a dense, unreadable object into a clear animated moment.
works.idea_zh: 光在挑选画面：AR 设计者可以学到，用切片式揭示能把一个密集难读的物体变成清晰的动画瞬间。
works.technique: Every frame of an animation is arranged radially in one printed object; as it rotates, a static projected light plane illuminates only one frame's slice at a time.
works.technique_zh: 动画的每一帧被径向排列在同一个打印物体中；它旋转时，一个静止的投影光面每次只照亮其中一帧的切片。
works.exercise_en: Build a ring of 24 frozen poses of a figure in AR, rotate it, and render only the pose crossing a virtual light plane. Twist: let the viewer move the light plane with their phone to scrub time.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中用一个人物的 24 个定格姿势排成一个环并让它旋转，只渲染穿过虚拟光面的那个姿势。变体：让观众用手机移动光面来“拖动”时间。

video.video_title: Akinori Goto Unlocks the Secrets of Time with 3D Printing – Brought to you by Hyundai

works.title: uRaymarching
works.description: Raymarched distance-field shapes appear in a normal Unity scene with correct lighting, shadows and intersections with ordinary meshes.
works.description_zh: 光线步进的距离场形体出现在普通 Unity 场景中，光照、阴影以及与普通网格的穿插都正确。
works.idea_en: Write only a distance function and get a full, lit shader that behaves like any other object.
works.idea_zh: 只写一个距离函数，就能得到一个带完整光照、表现得和其他物体一样的着色器。
works.technique: An editor tool generates deferred/forward shaders from a template around a user-written distance function, outputting depth and G-buffer data so raymarched objects are lit and shadowed by Unity.
works.technique_zh: 一个编辑器工具把用户写的距离函数套进模板，生成延迟/前向渲染着色器，并输出深度和 G-buffer 数据，让步进物体由 Unity 正常打光和投影。
works.exercise_en: Generate a raymarched sculpture with uRaymarching and place it on a real plinth in phone AR, writing depth for occlusion. Twist: the distance function morphs with the time of day.
works.exercise_zh: 用 uRaymarching 生成一个光线步进雕塑，在手机 AR 中放到真实底座上，并写入深度实现遮挡。变体：距离函数随一天中的时间变形。

video.video_title: uRaymarching v0.0.1 Released : Raymarching Shader Generator in Unity

works.title: unity-teddy
works.description: The user draws a closed outline with the mouse and it instantly inflates into a soft 3D blob that can be rotated.
works.description_zh: 用户用鼠标画一个闭合的轮廓，它立刻膨胀成一个可以旋转的柔软三维团块。
works.idea_en: A 2D doodle becomes a 3D object the moment the stroke closes.
works.idea_zh: 一笔涂鸦在闭合的瞬间就变成三维物体。
works.technique: An implementation of Igarashi's Teddy algorithm: the outline is triangulated with constrained Delaunay, the chordal axis is extracted, and vertices are elevated along it to inflate a closed mesh.
works.technique_zh: 实现了 Igarashi 的 Teddy 算法：先对轮廓做约束 Delaunay 三角剖分，提取弦轴，再沿弦轴抬高顶点，把平面膨胀成封闭网格。
works.exercise_en: Let users trace a shape on the phone screen and spawn the inflated mesh onto a detected AR plane, where it drops with physics. Twist: sample the camera image inside the outline as the blob's texture, so you can 'lift' a drawing off real paper.
works.exercise_zh: 让用户在手机屏幕上描一个形状，把膨胀出的网格生成到检测到的 AR 平面上并让它带物理掉下来。变体：把轮廓内的相机画面采样成团块的贴图，像把真实纸上的画“拎”起来。

video.video_title: Teddy Demo

works.title: untitled (dawn to dusk)
works.description: A former army hospital in Marfa, Texas, is rebuilt with long corridors of translucent scrim and rows of windows; walking from one wing to the other, the building changes with the daylight from dawn to dusk.
works.description_zh: 得克萨斯州马法的一座旧军医院被改建，长长的走廊里挂着半透明纱幕，墙上开着一排排窗；从一翼走到另一翼，建筑随着从黎明到黄昏的日光而变化。
works.idea_en: The work is the changing light, not the building: an AR piece can be designed around time of day, looking different every hour at the same place.
works.idea_zh: 作品是变化的光，而不是建筑：AR 作品可以围绕一天中的时间来设计，在同一个地方每个小时看起来都不一样。
works.technique: A U-shaped building is split into a dark and a light wing; scrims hung in the corridors catch and layer daylight from carefully placed windows.
works.technique_zh: 一座 U 形建筑被分成暗翼和亮翼；挂在走廊中的纱幕承接并层叠从精心安排的窗户进入的日光。
works.exercise_en: Design a site-specific AR installation for one corridor at school with virtual translucent scrims whose opacity and tint follow the real clock time. Twist: let students visit at 9 am and 3 pm and compare notes.
works.exercise_zh: 为学校的一条走廊设计一个特定场域的 AR 装置，放置虚拟半透明纱幕，其透明度和色调跟随真实时间变化。变体：让同学在早上 9 点和下午 3 点各来一次，比较记录。

video.video_title: Touring Robert Irwin's Minimalist Marfa Masterpiece "Dawn to Dusk" | Artbound

works.title: Δ∞ [Infinite Delta]
works.description: A structure of triangular planes moved by servomotors reacts to the audience's movement, to sound and to generative sequences, changing its shape like a breathing creature.
works.description_zh: 由三角形面板组成、由舵机驱动的结构，对观众的动作、声音和生成序列作出反应，像呼吸的生物一样改变形状。
works.idea_en: An architectural surface that reshapes itself around the people near it.
works.idea_zh: 一面会围绕附近的人改变形状的建筑表面。
works.technique: Max and Arduino drive servomotors on each triangle, with audience movement and audio as inputs and audio-reactive visuals on the side (Boris Chimp 504 with Alma d'Arame).
works.technique_zh: Max 与 Arduino 驱动每块三角板上的舵机，以观众动作和音频为输入，旁边配有音频响应的影像（Boris Chimp 504 与 Alma d'Arame 合作）。
works.exercise_en: Build a small kinetic panel of three cardboard triangles on servos that tilt toward the nearest person using a webcam and simple blob tracking. Twist: when nobody is there, let it slowly 'breathe' on its own.
works.exercise_zh: 用三个装在舵机上的纸板三角形做一个小型动态面板，借网络摄像头和简单的色块追踪让它倾向最近的人；变体：没人时，让它自己慢慢“呼吸”。

video.video_title: Δ∞  [Infinite Delta]

works.title: 24 drones
works.description: Three dancers and 24 light-drones perform together; the drones form moving constellations of light that respond to and frame the choreography.
works.idea_zh: 24架发光无人机组成会跳舞的光点星座
works.technique: An indoor motion-capture system localises 24 custom light drones (designed by Motoi Ishibashi) whose light and position are programmed against the choreography.
works.exercise_zh: 让24位同学各拿一个手机闪光灯，在黑暗中按投影给出的坐标走位组成图形；变化：图形由舞者的姿势实时生成。

video.video_title: ELEVENPLAY x RZM "24 drones"

works.description_zh: 三位舞者与 24 架发光无人机同台演出；无人机组成流动的光之星座，回应并框定舞蹈编排。
works.idea_en: Twenty-four glowing drones form a dancing constellation of light.
works.technique_zh: 室内动作捕捉系统对 24 架定制发光无人机（由 Motoi Ishibashi 设计）进行定位，其灯光和位置均根据编舞进行编程。
works.exercise_en: Have 24 classmates each hold a phone flashlight and walk in the dark to coordinates given by a projection, forming shapes. Twist: generate the shapes in real time from a dancer's pose.

works.description: Lepage revisits his childhood apartment block at 887 Murray Avenue using a rotating miniature building, tiny figures filmed live and projections that zoom from model to full-size memory.
works.description_zh: Lepage 用一栋可以旋转的公寓楼模型、现场拍摄的微缩人偶和投影，重返他童年住过的 887 Murray 街公寓，镜头在模型和真实大小的回忆之间推拉。
works.idea_en: Scale jumps between a model and a life-size projection make memory spatial; AR can do this by letting a tabletop model open into a room-sized scene.
works.idea_zh: 在模型和真人大小的投影之间跳换尺度，让记忆有了空间感；AR 可以让桌面模型展开成房间大小的场景来做到这一点。
works.technique: A detailed dollhouse-like set is filmed with small live cameras and the feed is projected at large scale behind the actor.
works.technique_zh: 一个像娃娃屋的精细模型用小型摄像机现场拍摄，画面在演员身后放大投影。
works.exercise_en: Make a paper model of your childhood home, anchor it in AR, and tap a window to expand that room to life size around you. Twist: add a recorded voice memory that only plays inside the life-size room.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个你童年住所的纸模型并在 AR 中锚定，点其中一扇窗，那个房间就在你周围展开成真实大小；变体：加入一段录下的回忆声音，只在真实大小的房间里播放。

video.video_title: 887 Official trailer

works.title: ANIMA iki
works.description: A two-metre glowing sphere hangs in a dark room; shimmering patterns flow across it and tones change as it senses visitors' movements and sounds, like a creature getting to know them.
works.description_zh: 一个直径两米的发光球体悬在黑暗的房间里；闪烁的图案在球面上流动，声音也在变化，它感知观众的动作和声音，像一个正在认识他们的生物。
works.idea_en: A glowing orb that behaves like a shy living being.
works.idea_zh: 一个像害羞生物一样行事的发光球。
works.technique: Sensors read visitors' movement and sound, and generative visuals projected onto the sphere plus an interactive soundscape express the entity's changing moods.
works.technique_zh: 传感器读取观众的动作和声音，投影在球体上的生成式影像和互动声景一起表现这个“生物”不断变化的情绪。
works.exercise_en: Project a p5.js noise pattern onto a white balloon or paper lamp and make it calm, curious or startled depending on microphone level and webcam motion. Twist: the orb remembers the loudest person and turns away from them.
works.exercise_zh: 把 p5.js 噪声图案投影到白色气球或纸灯罩上，根据麦克风音量和摄像头检测到的动作，让它表现出平静、好奇或受惊；变体：光球会记住最吵的人，并转身背对他。

video.video_title: Anima - iki

works.title: AR Tornado
works.description: On a hilltop overlooking the Catskill Mountains in Columbia County, New York, a virtual tornado spins across an otherwise beautiful day.
works.description_zh: 在纽约哥伦比亚县一处俯瞰卡茨基尔山的山丘上，一个虚拟龙卷风在晴朗的日子里旋转着穿过。
works.idea_en: Bring a disaster into a peaceful landscape at true scale.
works.idea_zh: 把一场灾难以真实尺度带进宁静的风景。
works.technique: An animated tornado model is likely geolocated in the landscape so it stays fixed to a spot on the horizon as the viewer pans the phone.
works.technique_zh: 动画龙卷风模型很可能被地理定位在风景中，观众转动手机时它固定在地平线上的某个位置。
works.exercise_en: Build a large-scale AR weather event (tornado, storm cloud, aurora) anchored far away on the horizon with a compass-based placement. Twist: it moves closer when the real wind picks up.
works.exercise_zh: 用基于罗盘的定位，在远处地平线上锚定一个大尺度 AR 天气事件（龙卷风、雷雨云、极光）。变体：真实风力变大时，它会向你靠近。

video.video_title: AR Tornado in Coumbia County, NY

works.title: Aerocene
works.description: Aerocene is an open community project of balloon sculptures that float using only the heat of the sun and the air, without burning fuel or using helium; the Art21 film shows launches and Saraceno's studio.
works.description_zh: Aerocene 是一个开放的社群项目：气球雕塑只靠太阳和空气的热量漂浮，不燃烧燃料也不使用氦气；Art21 的影片展示了放飞现场和 Saraceno 的工作室。
works.idea_en: A shared, open tool for flying without fuel turns the sky into a commons, a frame for collaborative AR in the air.
works.idea_zh: 一个无需燃料即可飞行的共享开放工具，把天空变成了公共领域，这为空中协作 AR 提供了框架。
works.technique: Lightweight, dark-coloured envelopes absorb sunlight so the air inside warms and becomes lighter than the surrounding air.
works.technique_zh: 轻质深色的球囊吸收阳光，使内部空气升温变轻，比周围空气更轻而上升。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR balloon whose lift is driven by live solar irradiance data for your location, and launch it together with classmates. Twist: every balloon's flight path is saved and drawn as a trail over the city for the next group.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个 AR 气球，其升力由当地实时太阳辐照数据驱动，与同学一起放飞；变体：保存每只气球的飞行路径，并作为轨迹画在城市上空给下一组人看。

video.video_title: Tomás Saraceno in "Realms of the Real" – Season 12 | Art21

works.title: Affordance++
works.description: Objects 'tell' the user how to use them by actuating the user's own hand with EMS: grabbing a spray can makes you shake it, touching a hot mug makes your hand pull back.
works.idea_zh: 物体通过电刺激直接“教”你的手怎么用它。

video.video_title: Affordance++: allowing objects to communicate dynamic use (CHI 2015, Best Paper Award)

works.technique: Detects which object the hand approaches and plays a pre-recorded EMS pattern on forearm muscles that enacts the object's intended movement.
works.exercise_zh: 给教室里的几个物品贴二维码，用手机AR识别后在手上叠加“动态使用提示”（如抖动、旋转箭头）；变化：提示用手机振动节奏而非图像表示。
works.description_zh: 物体借助 EMS 驱动用户自己的手，“告诉”用户该如何使用它们：抓起喷漆罐时手会自动摇晃它，碰到烫手的杯子时手会自动缩回。
works.idea_en: Objects use electrical stimulation to teach your hand directly how to use them.
works.technique_zh: 检测手正在接近哪个物体，并在前臂肌肉上施加预先录制的 EMS 模式，让手做出该物体预期的使用动作。
works.exercise_en: Stick QR codes on a few objects in the classroom, recognize them in phone AR, and overlay "animated usage hints" (shaking, rotating arrows) on the hand. Twist: express the hints as phone vibration rhythms instead of images.

salient.why_en: Objects move your hand with electrical stimulation to show you how to use them.
salient.why_zh: 物体用电刺激直接带动你的手，告诉你该怎么用它。

works.title: AfterMath: Seeing the Future through AR
works.description: Point a tablet at a physical scene and AR predicts and shows what will happen next, e.g. where objects will fall or roll after a physical action.
works.idea_zh: 用AR提前预演物理世界的'下一秒'，看见即将发生的后果。

video.video_title: AfterMath: Seeing the Future through Augmented Reality

works.technique: The tablet tracks the scene with AR, reconstructs or fits the physical objects as rigid bodies, and runs a physics simulation forward in time to render predicted trajectories as ghost overlays.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity + AR Foundation 中检测桌面平面，放一个虚拟球并用物理引擎预演它被推出后的轨迹，以半透明残影显示“未来 2 秒”；变体：显示多个可能的未来分支，让用户选择想要的那一个。
works.description_zh: 把平板对准一处真实场景，AR 会预测并显示接下来将发生的事情，比如某个物理动作之后，物体会往哪里掉落、朝哪里滚动。
works.idea_en: Use AR to rehearse the physical world's next second, so you see the consequences before they happen.
works.technique_zh: 平板借助 AR 追踪场景，把其中的实体物体重建或拟合为刚体，再将物理模拟向前推演，把预测出的运动轨迹以半透明“残影”叠加渲染出来。
works.exercise_en: Detect a tabletop plane in Unity + AR Foundation, place a virtual ball, and use the physics engine to preview its path after a push, showing "the next 2 seconds" as semi-transparent ghost trails. Twist: show several possible future branches and let the user pick the one they want.

works.title: An (AR) Allegory of the (VR) Cave
works.description: A live lecture-performance at NYU in which the talk itself happens through AR, using Plato's cave to ask what screens, avatars and augmentation do to the self.
works.description_zh: 在纽约大学的一场现场讲座表演，讲座本身通过 AR 进行，借柏拉图的洞穴寓言追问屏幕、化身与增强对“自我”做了什么。
works.idea_en: A lecture that stages its own argument in augmented reality.
works.idea_zh: 一场用增强现实上演自身论点的讲座。
works.technique: Image-tracked slides and props on stage trigger AR video and 3D content that the audience sees through a projected camera view.
works.technique_zh: 舞台上被图像追踪的幻灯片和道具触发 AR 视频与 3D 内容，观众通过投影出来的相机画面观看。
works.exercise_en: Give a 5-minute talk where every key point is revealed by pointing a phone at a printed card, with the phone mirrored to a projector. Twist: one card reveals the audience itself.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 5 分钟的演讲，每个要点都要用手机对准一张打印卡片才会出现，并把手机画面投到投影仪上。变体：有一张卡片显示的是观众自己。

video.video_title: An (AR) Allegory of the (VR) Cave

works.title: As If It Were Already Here
works.description: Above the Rose Kennedy Greenway in Boston, a 600-foot net sculpture hangs between buildings, its bands of colour recalling the city's old traffic lanes and changing light at night.
works.description_zh: 在波士顿罗斯·肯尼迪绿道上空，一座 600 英尺长的网状雕塑悬挂在楼宇之间，彩色条带让人想起这里曾经的车道，夜里灯光不断变化。
works.idea_en: A sky object can hold the memory of what used to be on the ground below; AR can place a trace of a vanished street right above where it was.
works.idea_zh: 天空中的物体可以保存地面上曾经存在的记忆；AR 可以把一条消失的街道的痕迹，放在它原来位置的正上方。
works.technique: A lightweight fibre net is tensioned by ropes to three surrounding buildings, and coloured lighting is programmed to change through the night.
works.technique_zh: 轻质纤维网用绳索张拉在周围三栋建筑之间，彩色灯光按程序整夜变化。
works.exercise_en: Find an old map of your campus or street, and hang an AR net above today's site whose colour bands follow the old roads underneath. Twist: when the viewer looks straight up, the old map fades in on the ground.
works.exercise_zh: 找一张校园或街道的旧地图，在今天的场地上空挂一张 AR 网，让它的彩色条带沿着下方旧道路的走向。变体：观众抬头正对上方时，旧地图在地面上渐渐显现。

video.video_title: "As If It Were Already Here," Boston, MA (2015)

works.title: Asinas
works.description: Two interlocking spirals of white segments rotate at slightly different speeds, so a wave appears to travel through the sculpture while nothing actually moves forward.
works.description_zh: 两组相互嵌套的白色螺旋片以略有不同的速度旋转，仿佛有一道波穿过雕塑，其实没有任何东西真正向前移动。
works.idea_en: Apparent motion can emerge from two rotations; AR designers can create flowing effects without moving objects, just by phasing their parts.
works.idea_zh: 表观运动可以从两个旋转中浮现；AR 设计者不必移动物体，只需让部件错相就能制造流动感。
works.technique: A single motor drives two concentric spiral assemblies through gears with a slightly different ratio, so their relative phase drifts and creates travelling interference.
works.technique_zh: 一个电机通过传动比略有差异的齿轮驱动两组同心螺旋，它们的相对相位不断漂移，形成行进的干涉纹。
works.exercise_en: Build two nested virtual helices in phone AR rotating at speeds 1.00 and 1.03 and watch the moiré wave appear. Twist: let the viewer's tilt change the ratio.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中做两条嵌套的虚拟螺旋，转速分别为 1.00 和 1.03，观察摩尔纹波浪出现。变体：让手机的倾角改变转速比。

video.video_title: Asinas - Jennifer Townley - 2015 - Kinetic art

works.title: Atmosphere
