works.description: A tall circular steel structure fills a museum gallery; inside, a central column of glass tubes projects light onto the walls and casts the silhouettes of visitors who walk up a ramp around it.
works.description_zh: 一个高大的圆形钢结构占满美术馆展厅；内部中央一根由玻璃管组成的光柱把光投到墙上，并投出沿着坡道绕行的观众剪影。
works.idea_en: Putting the light source at the centre and people around it makes every visitor's shadow part of the image; AR effects that use the viewer's silhouette invite participation.
works.idea_zh: 把光源放在中心、人围在四周，每位观众的影子都成了画面的一部分；利用观众剪影的 AR 效果会让人愿意参与。
works.technique: A vertical array of glass tubes refracts a central light outward onto the curved inner wall, turning visitors' shadows into moving projections (likely a single light source).
works.technique_zh: 一排竖直玻璃管把中央光源向外折射到弧形内墙上，把观众的影子变成移动的投影（可能只用了一个光源）。
works.exercise_en: Use body segmentation in Lens Studio or AR Foundation to cast a virtual shadow of each person onto a curved virtual wall around a glowing column in the room. Twist: stretch the shadows longer the closer someone walks to the column.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation 里用人体分割，把每个人的虚拟影子投到房间里一根发光柱周围的弧形虚拟墙上。变体：人离光柱越近，影子被拉得越长。

video.video_title: CHRIS FRASER : ATMOSPHERE

works.title: Augmented Creativity
works.description: A collection of AR experiences that bridge real and virtual creative play: coloring, building and storytelling with physical toys brought to life.
works.idea_zh: 用AR把孩子的涂色、搭建和讲故事变成活的。

video.video_title: Augmented Creativity: Bridging the real and virtual worlds to enhance creative play

works.technique: A set of AR applications that track physical creative artifacts (colored drawings, built toys) with image and model-based tracking, then extract color and shape from them to drive animated virtual counterparts.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生用纸、黏土或乐高做一件实体作品，拍照后用 Lens Studio 或 Reality Composer 让它“活”起来（加动画、声音或会说话的脸）；变体：作品在 AR 中的行为必须由它的某个实体特征决定。
works.description_zh: 一组连接真实与虚拟创意游戏的 AR 体验：涂色、搭建和讲故事，让实体玩具活起来。
works.idea_en: AR turns children's coloring, building and storytelling into something alive.
works.technique_zh: 一系列 AR 应用通过图像追踪和基于模型的追踪来识别实体创作物（涂好色的画、搭好的玩具），从中提取颜色与形状，驱动对应的虚拟角色动起来。
works.exercise_en: Have students make a physical piece from paper, clay or LEGO, photograph it, and bring it to life in Lens Studio or Reality Composer with animation, sound or a talking face. Twist: the piece's behavior in AR must be driven by one of its physical features.

works.title: Blooms
works.description: 3D-printed sculptures spin under a strobe light and appear to bloom endlessly, petals flowing outward from the centre like a living flower.
works.description_zh: 3D 打印的雕塑在频闪灯下旋转，仿佛在无限绽放，花瓣从中心不断向外涌出，像一朵活着的花。
works.idea_en: When the flash is synchronised to the geometry, a static object becomes animation; AR depends on the same sync between rendering and real motion.
works.idea_zh: 当闪光与几何结构同步时，静态物体就成了动画；AR 同样依赖渲染与真实运动的同步。
works.technique: Petals are placed at successive golden-angle (137.5°) steps; spinning so that one rotation of 137.5° happens between flashes makes each petal appear to move to its neighbour's position.
works.technique_zh: 花瓣按黄金角（137.5°）依次排列；让雕塑在两次闪光之间正好转过 137.5°，每片花瓣看起来就移到了相邻花瓣的位置。
works.exercise_en: Generate a golden-angle bloom mesh in three.js WebXR and rotate it by exactly 137.5° per frame on a real table. Twist: let the viewer change the angle slightly and watch the bloom spiral in reverse.
works.exercise_zh: 在 three.js WebXR 中生成一个黄金角花形网格，放在真桌上每帧精确旋转 137.5°。变体：让观众稍微改变角度，看花朵反向盘旋。

video.video_title: Blooms: Strobe-Animated Sculptures

works.title: Blueprint
works.description: A 15-minute audiovisual installation of projected light on a technical line drawing, exploring the blueprint as the origin of structures.
works.idea_zh: 光在蓝图线稿上建构与解构

video.video_title: blueprint

works.technique: Projection mapped onto a technical line drawing builds and deconstructs structures with animated line work aligned to the printed lines.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一张建筑或机器的线稿，投影一段让它逐步“建造”再“拆解”的线条动画；变体：让建造过程在某一步出错，并从错误中长出另一种结构。
works.description_zh: 一件时长 15 分钟的视听装置：光投射在一幅技术线稿上，探讨蓝图作为一切结构起点的意义。
works.idea_en: Light builds and unbuilds structures on a blueprint's line drawing.
works.technique_zh: 将投影映射到一幅技术线稿上，与印刷线条精确对齐的线条动画不断搭建又拆解出各种结构。
works.exercise_en: Print a line drawing of a building or machine and project a line animation that gradually "builds" it and then "takes it apart". Twist: make the construction go wrong at one step, and let a different structure grow out of the mistake.

works.title: Butterfly under Glass
works.description: A music-dance-theatre piece for PODIUM Esslingen in which dancer Laurie Young moves inside an interactive video scenography by Weiss, alongside live soprano and ensemble.
works.description_zh: 为 PODIUM Esslingen 创作的音乐舞蹈剧场：舞者 Laurie Young 在 Weiss 设计的交互影像舞台中舞动，与现场女高音和乐团同台。
works.idea_en: A dancer pinned like a specimen inside living, reactive images.
works.idea_zh: 舞者像标本一样被“钉”在会反应的活影像里。
works.technique: Likely camera tracking of the dancer drives projected imagery around and on her body in real time, as in Weiss's other stage work.
works.technique_zh: 很可能与 Weiss 的其他舞台作品一样，用摄像头追踪舞者，实时驱动她身体周围和身上的投影影像。
works.exercise_en: Project a grid of butterfly shapes onto a wall, and use webcam pose tracking so they freeze when a performer's hand comes near. Twist: they flutter again only when the music gets quiet.
works.exercise_zh: 在墙上投影一片蝴蝶图形，用摄像头姿态追踪让表演者的手靠近时蝴蝶静止不动；变体：只有音乐变轻时，它们才会重新扇动翅膀。

video.video_title: Butterfly under Glass | Trailer (HD)

works.title: CHILDHOOD: Egocentric Smaller-person Experience
works.description: An adult wears a head-mounted display fed by a camera at child eye height plus passive hand exoskeletons, and suddenly sees furniture, doors and people from a small child's point of view while grasping with small hands.
works.description_zh: 成年人戴上头显，画面来自装在孩子眼睛高度的摄像头，手上再套一副被动外骨骼，于是家具、门和身边的人都变成了小孩子视角里的样子，连抓东西的手也变小了。
works.idea_en: Lower the camera and shrink the hands, and an adult can briefly live inside a child's body.
works.idea_zh: 把摄像头放低、把手“缩小”，成年人就能短暂地住进孩子的身体里。
works.technique: Streams a waist-mounted stereo camera to a video see-through HMD so eye height drops by about half, while linkage exoskeletons map the wearer's finger motion onto smaller hands.
works.technique_zh: 腰部的双目摄像头把画面实时送进视频透视头显，使视线高度下降约一半，同时连杆外骨骼把佩戴者的手指动作映射到更小的“手”上。
works.exercise_en: Strap a phone at waist height, stream its camera to a second phone in a cardboard viewer, and walk around the classroom for ten minutes; list what feels dangerous, huge or unreachable. Twist: mount the camera at a dog's or a giant's height and redesign one object for that body.
works.exercise_zh: 把一部手机绑在腰部高度，把它的摄像头画面实时传到另一部装在纸盒眼镜里的手机上，在教室里走十分钟，记录哪些东西显得危险、巨大或够不着；变体：把摄像头装到狗或巨人的视线高度，再为那个身体重新设计一件物品。

video.video_title: Wearable Device for Shaping Experience into that of a Smaller-person

salient.why_en: A low camera and small hands let an adult see and grasp the world as a child does.
salient.why_zh: 低处的摄像头和缩小的手，让成年人像孩子一样看世界、抓东西。

works.title: CHOREO
works.description: A dancer's recorded movements become a game: participants press keys to rearrange and trigger fragments of the performance, turning spectators into co-choreographers.
works.description_zh: 舞者录下的动作变成一个游戏：参与者按键重新排列、触发演出片段，观众变成共同编舞者。
works.idea_en: Play a recorded dancer like a video game character.
works.idea_zh: 像玩游戏角色一样“玩”一位录下来的舞者。
works.technique: Clips of a dancer are cut into short phrases in Isadora, and each key press switches or layers phrases on a projected display.
works.technique_zh: 在 Isadora 中把舞者片段剪成短句，每次按键会在投影画面上切换或叠加片段。
works.exercise_en: Film a classmate doing eight short moves, map them to keyboard keys in a web page and let others compose a dance by typing. Twist: the typed word decides the sequence.
works.exercise_zh: 拍同学做八个短动作，在网页中映射到键盘按键，让其他人用打字编舞；变体：打出的单词决定动作顺序。

video.video_title: CHOREO

works.title: Caress of the Gaze
works.description: A 3D-printed garment covered in quill-like spines ripples and lifts on the part of the body that an onlooker is looking at.
works.description_zh: 一件覆盖着羽刺状结构的 3D 打印服装，会在旁观者目光所及的身体部位起伏、竖起。
works.idea_en: Making another person's gaze visible on your body turns an invisible social signal into a physical response — the same move as gaze-driven AR effects.
works.idea_zh: 把别人的目光显现在你的身体上，就把一个看不见的社交信号变成了实体回应——这与由视线驱动的 AR 效果是同一种思路。
works.technique: A small camera with gaze and face tracking estimates where the viewer is looking, and shape-memory-alloy actuators under multi-material 3D-printed spines move that region.
works.technique_zh: 小型摄像头通过视线和人脸追踪估计观看者在看哪里，多材料 3D 打印羽刺下的形状记忆合金执行器就让那一片区域动起来。
works.exercise_en: Use face tracking on a phone pointed at a friend to detect where on their body you are looking, and grow AR spines or feathers at that spot. Twist: invert it so the feathers flatten and hide wherever they are looked at.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机对准朋友，用人脸追踪判断你在看他身体的哪个部位，并在那里长出 AR 刺或羽毛。变体：反过来，被看到的地方羽毛就收拢、躲起来。

video.video_title: Caress of the Gaze Teaser @WIRED

salient.why_en: A garment ripples wherever someone is looking at you, so a gaze becomes something you can see.
salient.why_zh: 别人看向你哪里，衣服的那一处就会起伏，目光变成了看得见的东西。

works.title: Central Children's Store permanent 3D mapping
works.description: A permanent indoor mapping in Moscow's Central Children's Store, billed as the largest of its kind: a colourful 3D animation about the history of Russia plays on a huge flat wall, and an automated system dims the store lights and starts each show. Year approximate (video uploaded 2016).
works.description_zh: 莫斯科中央儿童商店里的一件常设室内投影，被称为同类中最大：一段关于俄罗斯历史的彩色 3D 动画在一面巨大的平墙上播放，自动控制系统会调暗商店的灯光并启动每场表演。年份为估计（视频上传于 2016 年）。
works.idea_en: A flat wall can pretend to have depth if the animation invents it; AR on flat surfaces also works by drawing convincing fake depth.
works.idea_zh: 只要动画“发明”出深度，一面平墙也能假装有纵深；在平面上做 AR 同样靠画出令人信服的假深度。
works.technique: Trompe-l'oeil 3D animation is projected onto a large flat atrium wall, with a remote control system that dims the lighting and launches scheduled shows.
works.technique_zh: 把错视三维动画投到中庭的大面平墙上，配合远程控制系统调暗灯光并按时启动演出。
works.exercise_en: Pick a flat wall at school and make an AR 'window' in 8th Wall or Reality Composer that shows a deep 3D scene about the building's history. Twist: the scene starts only when the room lights are dimmed.
works.exercise_zh: 在学校选一面平墙，用 8th Wall 或 Reality Composer 做一个 AR“窗口”，展示关于这栋楼历史的纵深三维场景；变体：只有房间灯光调暗时场景才会开始。

video.video_title: Central Children Store: The Largest Permanent 3D Mapping Installation

works.title: Composition X
works.description: A sphere inside a pyramid inside a cube, after Kepler's model of the cosmos: ultrasonic sensors read how far each visitor stands, and several people moving around it mix the LED colours together while a mirrored centre opens into an infinite reflection.
works.description_zh: 立方体里套着金字塔，金字塔里套着球体，取自开普勒的宇宙模型：超声波传感器测量每位观众的距离，几个人围着它移动就能一起混合 LED 的颜色，而镜面中心则展开无限延伸的反射。
works.idea_en: Visitors mix the colour of the sculpture together just by where they stand.
works.idea_zh: 观众仅靠自己站的位置，就能一起调出雕塑的颜色。
works.technique: Ultrasonic distance sensors on each side feed a microcontroller that maps each visitor's distance to the LED colour channels, while two-way mirrors create the infinity effect.
works.technique_zh: 每一面的超声波测距传感器接到微控制器，把每位观众的距离映射到 LED 的颜色通道，双向镜营造出无限反射。
works.exercise_en: Build a cardboard lantern with three ultrasonic sensors and an addressable LED strip so each sensor controls red, green or blue by distance. Twist: the colour only turns white when all three people stand at the same distance.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸板做一个灯笼，装上三个超声波传感器和一条可寻址 LED 灯带，让每个传感器按距离分别控制红、绿、蓝；变体：只有三个人站在相同距离时颜色才会变白。

video.video_title: Composition X, 2012-2015 - Sound reactive interactive light sculpture by Aphra Shemza

works.title: Connected Worlds
works.description: A large-scale ecosystem at the New York Hall of Science: six projected habitats linked by a 3000 sq ft interactive floor and 45 ft waterfall; children move physical logs to route water and plant seeds with gestures.
works.idea_zh: 整个大厅就是一个生态系统：孩子搬动实物木头引水、用手播种，影响六个栖息地。

video.video_title: Connected Worlds

works.technique: Many Kinect depth cameras track the floor to detect physical logs and people, which redirect a projected 2D fluid simulation of water flowing between networked habitat simulations.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面投影一条水流，用俯拍摄像头识别几块彩色木板改变水流方向，把水分给墙上两个不同的小生态（沙漠/雨林）；变体：让两个生态之间有资源冲突，全班需要协商水怎么分。
works.description_zh: 位于纽约科学馆的大型生态系统装置：六个投影栖息地由一块 3000 平方英尺的互动地面和一道 45 英尺高的瀑布相连；孩子们搬动实物木头引导水流，用手势播撒种子。
works.idea_en: The whole hall is one ecosystem: children move real logs to steer water and plant seeds by hand, shaping six habitats.
works.technique_zh: 多台 Kinect 深度相机追踪地面，识别实物木头和人的位置，据此改变投影出的二维流体模拟，让水在彼此联网的各个栖息地模拟之间流动。
works.exercise_en: Project a stream of water onto the floor, use an overhead camera to detect a few colored boards that redirect the flow, and split the water between two small ecosystems on the wall (desert and rainforest). Twist: create a resource conflict between the two ecosystems so the class has to negotiate how the water is shared.

works.title: DELTΔ (Echolyse)
works.description: A site-specific installation in the Echolyse series built around the triangle of the Greek letter delta, originally a sign for a door: a wooden structure is mapped with single and multiple projections so the triangle opens and closes like a passage. Year approximate (Vimeo upload 2016).
works.description_zh: Echolyse 系列中的场地特定装置，围绕希腊字母 delta 的三角形展开——它最初是“门”的象形：木结构上以单台和多台投影映射，让三角形像一道通道一样开合。年份为估计（Vimeo 上传于 2016 年）。
works.idea_en: A simple geometric frame can act as a portal once light suggests depth inside it; AR portals work best when they sit in a clear physical frame.
works.idea_zh: 只要光在里面暗示出深度，一个简单的几何框架就能成为一道门；AR 传送门在清晰的实体框架里效果最好。
works.technique: Projection content is mapped onto a painted wood triangle structure, with light and shadow animations creating the illusion of openings and depth, synchronised to sound by Thomas Vaquié.
works.technique_zh: 在上漆的木质三角结构上映射投影内容，用光影动画制造出开口和深度的错觉，并与 Thomas Vaquié 的声音同步。
works.exercise_en: Build a triangular doorway from tape or cardboard and use image tracking in Lens Studio to turn its inside into an AR portal to another space. Twist: the portal only opens when the viewer is exactly centred in front of it.
works.exercise_zh: 用胶带或纸板做一个三角形门框，用 Lens Studio 的图像追踪把框内变成通往另一个空间的 AR 传送门；变体：只有观众正好站在门的正中时它才会打开。

video.video_title: DELTΔ

works.title: Dancing Light / D.O.PE.
works.description: A performer dances with computer-controlled projector light that shapes, cuts and follows her body in a dark space.
works.idea_zh: 让投影光本身成为与舞者对舞的伙伴
works.technique: A projector is used as a programmable spotlight whose masks are sequenced (and likely tracked) to sculpt the performer's silhouette in darkness.
works.exercise_zh: 在黑暗中用投影仪投出会移动的光形，让同学即兴与光“对舞”；变化：用摄像头让光形在人靠近时逃开。

video.video_title: Dancing Light – Klaus Obermaier feat. Tegest Pecht-Guido

works.description_zh: 黑暗空间中，一位舞者与计算机控制的投影光共舞，光不断塑造、切割并追随她的身体。
works.idea_en: Make projected light itself a dance partner for the performer.
works.technique_zh: 把投影仪当作可编程的追光灯，按序列切换遮罩（可能还结合了追踪），在黑暗中雕刻出舞者的轮廓。
works.exercise_en: Project moving shapes of light in a dark room and have a classmate improvise a "duet" with them. Twist: use a camera so the light shapes flee when a person gets close.

works.title: Decision (Isomeric Slides)
works.description: Two intertwined tubular slides spiral out of the Hayward Gallery; visitors choose one of two doors and exits throughout the exhibition, and leave by sliding down.
works.description_zh: 两条交缠的管状滑梯从海沃德美术馆螺旋而出；在整个展览中，观众要在两扇门和两个出口之间做选择，最后滑下离开。
works.idea_en: Choice is a material: an AR tour can split into two paths at a physical doorway, so the visitor's decision becomes part of the work.
works.idea_zh: 选择本身就是一种材料：AR 导览可以在一扇真实的门口分成两条路径，让观众的决定成为作品的一部分。
works.technique: Two mirror-image (isomeric) steel slides are mounted on the building exterior, paired with other decision-based pieces such as a dark corridor with two entrances.
works.technique_zh: 两条互为镜像（同分异构）的钢制滑梯安装在建筑外部，并与其他以选择为核心的作品搭配，例如有两个入口的黑暗走廊。
works.exercise_en: Build a two-door AR experience at a real fork in a hallway: each branch shows a different version of the same virtual creature. Twist: at the end, show how many classmates chose each branch.
works.exercise_zh: 在走廊的一个真实岔路口搭建一个“两扇门”的 AR 体验：每条分支显示同一只虚拟生物的不同版本。变体：最后显示有多少同学选择了每一条路。

video.video_title: Carsten Höller: Decision | Hayward Gallery

works.title: Diplopia
works.description: The first anaglyph 3D mapping made in Spain, shown at the opening of the International Mapping Festival of Girona: with red-cyan glasses, the audience sees shapes pop out of the façade. The piece is about binocular vision, how two eyes merge two images into one object.
works.description_zh: 西班牙第一件红蓝立体（anaglyph）投影映射作品，在赫罗纳国际投影映射节开幕式上展出：观众戴上红青眼镜，看到形体从立面中弹出。作品的主题就是双眼视觉：两只眼睛如何把两幅图像合成一个物体。
works.idea_en: Showing depth through two slightly different images reveals the core mechanism behind every stereo AR headset.
works.idea_zh: 用两幅略有差异的图像呈现纵深，揭示了每一台立体 AR 头显背后的核心原理。
works.technique: Left- and right-eye renders offset by the interocular distance are colour-encoded in red and cyan and projected together, then decoded by paper glasses.
works.technique_zh: 按两眼间距错开的左右眼渲染图，分别用红色和青色编码后一起投射，再由纸质眼镜分离。
works.exercise_en: Render the same AR object for a left and right eye in a WebXR or three.js scene and export an anaglyph image, then view it through cheap red-cyan glasses. Twist: make an object that is only visible to one eye and see how the brain reacts.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 或 three.js 场景里为左右眼分别渲染同一个 AR 物体，输出红蓝立体图，用便宜的红青眼镜观看；变体：做一个只有一只眼能看到的物体，观察大脑的反应。

video.video_title: Diplopia - 3D Mapping at The international Mapping Festival of Girona 2015

works.title: Drone 100
works.description: One hundred LED drones fly together in the night sky, forming shapes and animations and setting a world record for the most drones airborne at once.
works.description_zh: 一百架 LED 无人机同时在夜空中飞行，组成形状和动画，创下同时飞行无人机数量的世界纪录。
works.idea_en: Going from ten points to a hundred changes what shapes can be drawn; AR designers should test at what density a cloud of points starts to read as an image.
works.idea_zh: 从十个点到一百个点，能画出的形状完全不同；AR 设计者应该测试一团点要多密才能开始被读成图像。
works.technique: Intel drones with LED payloads follow choreographed trajectories from animation software, synchronised by a central system and GPS timing.
works.technique_zh: 搭载 LED 的 Intel 无人机按照动画软件编排的轨迹飞行，由中央系统和 GPS 时间同步。
works.exercise_en: Export a short 3D animation as point positions and replay it in AR as 100 glowing drones over a field, then remove points until the shape breaks. Twist: add a slow, 'realistic' flight between shapes to see how transitions change the story.
works.exercise_zh: 把一段简短的三维动画导出成点的位置，在 AR 中用 100 架发光无人机在场地上空重放，然后逐步删掉点，直到形状散掉。变体：在形状之间加上缓慢、“真实”的飞行过渡，看看过渡如何改变叙事。

video.video_title: Drone 100

works.title: Dropping an Ai Weiwei Urn in AR
works.description: The artist re-enacts Ai Weiwei's famous urn-dropping photo with a virtual urn in AR.
works.idea_zh: 用AR重演艾未未摔瓮

video.video_title: Dropping an Ai Wei Wei Urn in AR

works.technique: A virtual urn is anchored to the tracked hands or a plane and animated with physics to fall and shatter, re-staging a famous photographic sequence in AR.
works.exercise_zh: 选一张著名的行为艺术照片，用手机 AR 和物理引擎重演其中的关键物体动作并拍成三联照；变体：把被摔的物体换成一个你自己的“神圣物件”的虚拟版本。
works.description_zh: 艺术家在 AR 中用一只虚拟陶瓮，重演艾未未那组著名的摔瓮照片。
works.idea_en: Re-enact Ai Weiwei dropping the urn, in AR.
works.technique_zh: 把虚拟陶瓮锚定在被追踪的双手或某个平面上，用物理动画让它坠落、摔碎，在 AR 中重新上演一组著名的摄影序列。
works.exercise_en: Pick a famous performance-art photograph, re-enact the key object's action with phone AR and a physics engine, and shoot it as a triptych. Twist: replace the dropped object with a virtual version of your own "sacred object".

works.title: DynaFlash
works.description: A 1,000 fps, 3 ms latency projector keeps imagery locked to a sheet of paper as it is waved, bent and moved quickly in the hand.
works.idea_zh: 千帧投影仪让图像紧紧贴在你手中挥动的纸上。

video.video_title: DynaFlash: High-speed 8-bit image projector at 1,000fps with 3ms delay

works.technique: A 1,000 fps projector using a DLP chip with binary frames, paired with high-speed vision tracking of the paper's markers, closes the loop in about 3 ms so the projected image stays locked to a moving, bending surface.
works.exercise_zh: 用普通投影仪 + 摄像头追踪一张移动的纸（用四角标记或颜色检测），把图像实时投影到纸上，测量并记录挥动时的错位；变体：利用延迟本身设计一种“拖尾”美学效果。
works.description_zh: 一台每秒 1000 帧、延迟仅 3 毫秒的投影仪，即使手中的纸被快速挥动、弯折和移动，投出的图像也始终牢牢贴在纸面上。
works.idea_en: A thousand-frame projector keeps the image stuck to the paper waving in your hand.
works.technique_zh: 采用 DLP 芯片输出二值帧的 1000 fps 投影仪，配合对纸面标记的高速视觉追踪，整个闭环延迟约 3 毫秒，使投影图像始终锁定在移动、弯曲的表面上。
works.exercise_en: Use an ordinary projector and a camera to track a moving sheet of paper (with corner markers or color detection), project an image onto it in real time, and measure and record the misalignment as it is waved. Twist: use the latency itself to design a "motion trail" aesthetic.

works.title: EGO (with Stefano D'Alessio & Martina Menegon)
works.description: A large projection shows the viewer's mirror image, but their movements stretch, fragment and deform it into an abstract self that still feels like 'me'.
works.idea_zh: 镜像被你的动作扭曲成抽象形体，却依然像“你自己”
works.technique: A depth/video camera captures the viewer and a real-time mesh of their image is distorted by motion-driven parameters before projection.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头+网格变形做“哈哈镜”，挥手越快镜像越被拉扯；变化：加入声音，每种变形都有对应的音色。

video.video_title: EGO – Interactive Audiovisual Installation

works.description_zh: 一幅巨大的投影映出观众的镜像，而观众的动作会把镜像拉伸、打碎、扭曲，变成一个抽象却依然让人觉得“这就是我”的自我形象。
works.idea_en: Your movements warp your mirror image into an abstract shape that still looks like you.
works.technique_zh: 用深度相机或普通摄像头捕捉观众，把其影像实时生成网格，并由动作驱动的参数对网格进行变形后再投影出来。
works.exercise_en: Build a "funhouse mirror" with a camera and mesh deformation, so the faster you wave, the more your reflection gets stretched. Twist: add sound, giving each kind of deformation its own timbre.

works.title: ESCAPE (St. Ludmila Church, Signal Festival Prague)
works.description: The neo-Gothic facade of St. Ludmila Church in Prague appears to crack, breathe and let figures and abstract forms escape from its arches, set to music by Jóhann Jóhannsson.
works.description_zh: 布拉格圣卢德米拉教堂的新哥特式立面仿佛出现裂缝、开始呼吸，人物与抽象形体从拱门中逃逸而出，配乐来自 Jóhann Jóhannsson。
works.idea_en: Treating architecture as something that can break and release what is inside it is a strong dramatic arc for any AR piece anchored on a building.
works.idea_zh: 把建筑当作可以裂开、释放内部之物的东西，对任何锚定在建筑上的 AR 作品都是一条有力的戏剧线。
works.technique: Architectural projection mapping from a 3D model of the church, animating fake depth, lighting and crumbling geometry aligned to the real stonework.
works.technique_zh: 基于教堂 3D 模型的建筑投影映射，制作与真实石构对齐的假纵深、光影和崩解几何。
works.exercise_en: Scan a building facade with a LiDAR phone and make a short AR sequence where cracks spread along its real edges and a creature escapes from a window. Twist: the cracks follow the viewer's gaze.
works.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的手机扫描一座建筑的立面，做一段短 AR 片段：裂缝沿着真实边缘蔓延，一只生物从窗户里逃出来；变体：裂缝跟随观众的视线蔓延。

video.video_title: ESCAPE - mapping the St. Ludmila Church / Bordos.ArtWorks / SIGNAL FESTIVAL 2015 Prague (4K)

works.title: Elements
works.description: Visitors embody Earth, Wind, Fire or Water and sculpt a projected environment with their movements.
works.idea_zh: 每个人化身一种元素，用身体塑造投影世界。

video.video_title: Elements

works.technique: Depth cameras track each visitor's body and gesture velocity, which are mapped to element-specific particle and fluid systems (fire, wind, water, earth) in a projected environment.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 给四位同学各分配一种元素，手臂的速度生成火、风、水、土的粒子并投影；变体：两种元素相遇时会产生新东西，比如水加火起雾。
works.description_zh: 观众化身为土、风、火、水四种元素之一，用身体动作塑造一个投影出来的环境。
works.idea_en: Each person becomes an element and shapes the projected world with their body.
works.technique_zh: 深度相机追踪每位观众的身体和手势速度，并将其映射到投影环境中各元素对应的粒子与流体系统（火、风、水、土）。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Pose to assign one element to each of four classmates, so their arm speed spawns fire, wind, water or earth particles that are projected on the wall. Twist: when two elements meet they create something new, such as water plus fire making mist.

works.title: Elephant Walk
works.description: At night a bicycle rides through the city and casts the shadow of a walking elephant on the walls beside it; the faster the bike goes, the faster the elephant walks.
works.description_zh: 夜里，一辆自行车穿过城市，在旁边的墙上投下一头行走大象的影子；车骑得越快，大象走得越快。
works.idea_en: Your bike casts the shadow of an elephant.
works.idea_zh: 你的自行车投下的是一头大象的影子。
works.technique: A projector and car battery on the bike show a looped elephant animation driven by speedometer data, played by an openFrameworks app on an iPad mini.
works.technique_zh: 车上装着投影仪和汽车电池，iPad mini 上的 openFrameworks 程序根据码表数据播放循环的大象动画。
works.exercise_en: Mount a phone projector or phone screen on a moving object (bike, trolley, skateboard) and play a walk-cycle animation whose speed follows the phone's accelerometer. Twist: when the object stops, the creature sits down.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机投影仪或手机屏幕装在移动的物体（自行车、推车、滑板）上，播放一段行走循环动画，速度跟随手机加速度计。变体：物体停下时，这只生物就坐下来。

video.video_title: Elephant Walk - Bike casting an elephant shadow

salient.why_en: Ride a bike at night and its shadow is an elephant walking at your speed.
salient.why_zh: 夜里骑车，车的影子是一头跟着你速度行走的大象。

works.title: Empreintes
works.description: Visitors move their hands in front of a projection and leave sculptural traces of their gestures. The prints hang in space for a while, then slowly warp and fade.
works.description_zh: 观众在投影前挥动双手，留下自己手势的雕塑般的痕迹。这些“印记”会在空间里停留一会儿，然后慢慢变形、消散。
works.idea_en: Make a gesture tangible by printing it into the air.
works.idea_zh: 把一个手势“印”在空气里，让它变得可以触摸。
works.technique: A depth sensor tracks the hands and the software sweeps their silhouettes through time into 3D forms that are rendered and projected, then deformed over time.
works.technique_zh: 深度传感器追踪双手，程序把手的轮廓随时间扫掠成三维形体，渲染后投影出来，并让它们逐渐变形。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe hand tracking in the browser to record a hand's outline every frame and stack the outlines into a 3D ribbon you can orbit around. Twist: the print only stays if the hand moves very slowly.
works.exercise_zh: 在浏览器里用 MediaPipe 手部追踪，每一帧记录手的轮廓，把这些轮廓叠成一条可以绕着看的三维带子；变体：只有手动得非常慢，印记才会留下来。

video.video_title: Empreintes — Prints in motion

works.title: Entangled
works.description: Two layered projections on translucent scrims respond to visitors from both sides, so people on opposite sides tangle each other's painterly traces.
works.idea_zh: 半透明幕两侧的人互相“缠绕”对方留下的影像痕迹
works.technique: Two cameras track people on each side of stacked scrims and generative drawing layers are projected through the semi-transparent fabric, mixing both groups' traces.
works.exercise_zh: 挂一块薄纱，前后各放一台投影和摄像头，让两侧同学的动作轨迹叠在同一块纱上；变化：只有两侧的人对齐站位时图案才会连通。

video.video_title: Camille Utterback – Entangled

works.description_zh: 两层投影落在半透明纱幕上，同时回应幕布两侧的观众，站在两边的人会让彼此留下的绘画般的痕迹交织在一起。
works.idea_en: People on either side of a sheer screen tangle up each other's traces.
works.technique_zh: 两台摄像头分别追踪叠放纱幕两侧的人，生成式绘画图层透过半透明织物投射出来，把两侧人群留下的痕迹混合在一起。
works.exercise_en: Hang a piece of sheer fabric with a projector and a camera on each side, so the movement trails of classmates on both sides overlap on the same cloth. Twist: the pattern only connects when people on the two sides line up with each other.

works.title: Fiat Lux: Illuminating Our Common Home
works.description: On 8 December 2015, the façade and dome of St Peter's Basilica in Vatican City were covered with projected images of animals, oceans, forests and people, inspired by Pope Francis's encyclical on the environment. It was produced with the Oceanic Preservation Society; the video is their upload.
works.description_zh: 2015 年 12 月 8 日，梵蒂冈圣彼得大教堂的立面和穹顶被投上动物、海洋、森林和人的影像，灵感来自教宗方济各关于环境的通谕。作品与海洋保护协会（OPS）合作制作，视频由 OPS 上传。
works.idea_en: Placing living nature on the most symbolic human architecture creates a strong contrast; AR overlays gain meaning from what the place already stands for.
works.idea_zh: 把鲜活的自然放在人类最具象征意义的建筑上，会产生强烈的对比；AR 叠加的意义来自这个地方本来代表的东西。
works.technique: Multiple high-power projectors aligned to the basilica's façade and dome, playing a pre-rendered photographic sequence without the need for detailed geometric deformation.
works.technique_zh: 多台高功率投影机按大教堂立面和穹顶对位，播放预先渲染的摄影序列，无需复杂的几何变形。
works.exercise_en: Collect five nature photos from students, then place them in AR (WebXR or Lens Studio) as a slow slideshow on the most formal building on campus. Twist: the slideshow advances only when people nearby stay silent.
works.exercise_zh: 收集同学拍的五张自然照片，用 AR（WebXR 或 Lens Studio）把它们做成慢速幻灯片，放在校园里最庄重的建筑上；变体：只有周围的人保持安静，幻灯片才会翻到下一张。

video.video_title: FIAT LUX: Illuminating Our Common Home - Highlights

works.title: Floating Flower Garden
works.description: A room is packed with thousands of living orchids hanging to the floor; as a visitor approaches, the flowers near them rise upward, opening a dome of space that follows the person.
works.description_zh: 房间里挂满数千株垂到地面的活兰花；观众靠近时，身边的花会向上升起，形成一个跟随此人移动的圆顶空间。
works.idea_en: Content that clears space around the user instead of crowding them feels welcoming; AR clutter should retreat as the user approaches.
works.idea_zh: 为用户让出空间而不是挤压用户的内容，让人感到被接纳：AR 里的杂物应该在用户靠近时后退。
works.technique: Motorised lines raise and lower each plant pot, driven by sensors that track visitor positions (likely overhead depth cameras).
works.technique_zh: 电机牵引的线升降每个花盆，由追踪观众位置的传感器驱动（推测为顶部深度相机）。
works.exercise_en: Fill a room in phone AR with 500 hanging flowers down to the floor, and make every flower within one meter of the phone rise to the ceiling. Twist: two users close together create one larger shared dome.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 在房间里挂满 500 朵垂到地面的花，让离手机一米以内的花都升到天花板。变体：两位用户靠在一起时，会形成一个更大的共享圆顶。

video.video_title: Floating Flower Garden: Flowers and I are of the Same Root, the Garden and I are One

works.title: Flowers and People, Cannot be Controlled but Live Together
works.description: Projected flowers bloom and wither across the walls through the seasons; when visitors touch or stand still, petals scatter or grow around them.
works.idea_zh: 投影花朵因观众的触碰与停留而绽放或凋落

video.video_title: Flowers and People, Cannot be Controlled but Live Together @ PACE Art + Technology, California, USA

works.technique: A real-time generative flower simulation runs continuously, and depth or proximity sensors detect visitors' position and stillness to trigger blooming or scattering locally.
works.exercise_zh: 在 TouchDesigner 中用摄像头检测人的位置，投影花朵在人静止时生长、移动时凋落；变体：让花的种类随一天中的时间或季节改变。
works.description_zh: 投影出来的花朵在墙面上随四季开放又凋零；当观众触碰或静止不动时，身边的花瓣会散落或生长。
works.idea_en: Projected flowers bloom or fall as visitors touch them or stand still.
works.technique_zh: 实时生成的花朵模拟持续运行，深度或距离传感器检测观众的位置以及是否静止，在局部触发花开或花散。
works.exercise_en: In TouchDesigner, use a camera to detect where people are, so projected flowers grow while someone stands still and wither when they move. Twist: make the flower species change with the time of day or the season.

works.title: Flylight
works.description: A flock of glass tube lights hangs in a dark room and flickers in waves like birds; when visitors come close, the lights react and move away from them.
works.description_zh: 一群玻璃管灯悬挂在黑暗的房间里，像鸟群一样一波波闪烁；观众靠近时，灯光会作出反应并躲开他们。
works.idea_en: Light alone can behave like a flock that notices you; AR responses can be as simple as brightness waves moving away from a person.
works.idea_zh: 仅凭光就能像一群会注意到你的鸟；AR 的回应可以简单到让亮度波从人身边退开。
works.technique: Hundreds of glass tubes with LEDs are controlled by flocking software, and sensors track visitors so the pattern shifts away from them.
works.technique_zh: 数百根装有 LED 的玻璃管由集群软件控制，传感器追踪观众，让灯光图案避开他们。
works.exercise_en: Place a grid of 100 AR light tubes over a room and run a flocking brightness pattern across them that moves away from the phone's position. Twist: when the viewer stands still for ten seconds, the flock slowly returns to them.
works.exercise_zh: 在房间上方放一组由 100 根 AR 灯管组成的阵列，让集群式的亮度图案在灯管间流动，并避开手机的位置。变体：观众静止十秒后，鸟群慢慢回到他身边。

video.video_title: FLYLIGHT | by DRIFT

works.title: FoveAR
works.description: Combines an optical see-through headset for the central field of view with room projection for the periphery, giving AR a very wide field of view.
works.idea_zh: 眼镜负责视野中心，投影负责四周余光，拼出超大视场的AR。

video.video_title: FoveAR: Combining an Optically See-Through Near-Eye Display with Projector-Based Spatial ...

works.technique: An optical see-through HMD renders the central view while calibrated room projectors render the same scene in the periphery, with head tracking keeping both views registered.
works.exercise_zh: 让一位同学戴 HoloKit 看中心的虚拟物体，同时用投影仪在其周围墙面渲染同一场景的外围部分（如雨、星空），比较有无投影时的沉浸感；变体：故意让外围画面和中心画面讲不同的故事。
works.description_zh: 它把光学透视头显（负责中央视野）与房间投影（负责周边视野）结合起来，让 AR 获得极宽的视场。
works.idea_en: The glasses handle the center of your view and projection fills the edges, stitching together a very wide AR field of view.
works.technique_zh: 光学透视 HMD 渲染中央视野，经过标定的房间投影仪在周边渲染同一场景，头部追踪让两部分画面保持对齐。
works.exercise_en: Have one student wear HoloKit to look at a virtual object in the center while a projector renders the outer part of the same scene on the surrounding walls (rain, a starry sky), and compare how immersive it feels with and without the projection. Twist: deliberately make the peripheral and central imagery tell different stories.

works.title: Future Ruins
works.description: An installation for La Nuit des Images at the Musée de l'Elysée in which built structures and light imagine architecture as ruins seen from the future.
works.idea_zh: 用光和结构想象未来的人如何看待今天的建筑废墟
works.technique: Custom software (Hand Coded) drives projection or light onto purpose-built physical structures, likely using mapped geometry to animate their surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸板搭一座“废墟”，拍照后做对齐投影让它时而完整、时而崩塌；变化：由观众选择“一百年后”还是“一千年后”的状态。

video.video_title: Future Ruins

works.description_zh: 为爱丽舍博物馆（Musée de l'Elysée）的 La Nuit des Images 创作的装置，用搭建的结构和光线，把建筑想象成从未来回望的废墟。
works.idea_en: Use light and structure to imagine how future people will see today's buildings as ruins.
works.technique_zh: 定制软件（Hand Coded）驱动投影或灯光打在专门搭建的实体结构上，可能利用映射好的几何形体为结构表面制作动画。
works.exercise_en: Build a "ruin" out of cardboard, photograph it, and make an aligned projection that shows it sometimes whole and sometimes collapsing. Twist: let the audience choose between its state "100 years later" and "1,000 years later".

works.title: Globe4D
works.description: A large touch-sensitive sphere shows a projected Earth from the inside; visitors spin it with their hands and move through time to watch continental drift, seasons, disasters or flight routes change on the globe.
works.description_zh: 一个大型触摸球面从内部投射出地球；观众用手拨动它旋转，并在时间中前进，观看大陆漂移、季节、灾害或航线在球面上的变化。
works.idea_en: Touch and spin a glowing globe to travel through space and time.
works.idea_zh: 触摸并拨动一个发光的地球，在空间和时间中穿行。
works.technique: An acrylic hemisphere coated for rear projection is lit from inside by a projector with a wide lens, maps are rendered in real time with a shader (the early versions in openFrameworks), and infrared multi-touch tracking reads the hands.
works.technique_zh: 涂有背投涂层的亚克力半球由内部广角投影仪照亮，地图用着色器实时渲染（早期版本基于 openFrameworks），红外多点触控追踪双手。
works.exercise_en: Project a map onto a white ball (or use AR image tracking on a ball) and let rotating a second object, like a jar lid, scrub through ten years of data. Twist: the ball shows another planet when turned upside down.
works.exercise_zh: 把地图投射到一个白色球上（或对球体做 AR 图像追踪），再让转动另一个物体（比如瓶盖）来拖动十年的数据。变体：把球倒过来，就显示另一颗行星。

video.video_title: Globe4D gx1000 - interactive projection globe

works.title: H {N)Y P N(Y} OSIS
works.description: In the vast drill hall of New York's Park Avenue Armory, glowing marquees, film screens, a self-playing piano and rotating bleachers carrying the audience are switched on and off in a choreographed sequence.
works.description_zh: 在纽约公园大道军械库巨大的操练厅里，发光的门檐灯箱、电影屏幕、自动演奏的钢琴以及载着观众旋转的看台，按编排好的顺序开开关关。
works.idea_en: Moving the audience itself (rotating the seats) is a strong way to direct attention; AR can guide a viewer's body instead of adding arrows.
works.idea_zh: 让观众本身移动（旋转看台）是引导注意力的有力方式：AR 可以引导观众的身体，而不是加箭头。
works.technique: A computer-controlled score cues lights, films, sound and mechanised seating, so the hall behaves like one automaton.
works.technique_zh: 一套计算机控制的「乐谱」依次触发灯光、影片、声音和机械看台，让整个大厅像一台自动机器。
works.exercise_en: Create a phone AR tour in which the user stands on a marked spot and virtual light boxes and screens around them switch on in a set order, each drawing the gaze to a new direction. Twist: only one element may be lit at a time, forcing the user to turn their whole body.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 导览：用户站在标记点上，周围的虚拟灯箱和屏幕按设定顺序依次亮起，每次都把视线引向新的方向。变体：同一时刻只能亮一个元素，逼得用户转动整个身体。

video.video_title: Philippe Parreno:  H {N)Y P N(Y} OSIS

works.title: Halo Content
works.description: Emails, messages and notifications in a head-worn display drift out of the way whenever a person walks into view, forming a halo around their face instead of covering it.
works.description_zh: 头戴显示中的邮件、消息和通知在有人走进视野时自动让开，在对方脸部周围形成一圈“光环”，而不是挡住它。
works.idea_en: AR notifications should politely step aside when a real person appears.
works.idea_zh: 当真实的人出现时，AR 通知应该礼貌地让开。
works.technique: Detects faces and bodies in the camera feed and moves overlay elements with a simple force-directed layout so they orbit around, rather than occlude, the conversation partner.
works.technique_zh: 在摄像头画面中检测人脸和人体，用简单的力导向布局移动叠加元素，让它们绕着对话对象排布而不是遮挡。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone face-tracking AR app to attach three floating notification cards that orbit a detected face without covering it, then hold a two-minute conversation through the phone. Twist: make urgent cards come closer and quiet ones fade out.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机的人脸追踪 AR 做三张悬浮通知卡片，让它们绕着识别到的人脸转而不遮挡，然后透过手机进行两分钟对话；变体：让紧急的卡片靠得更近，不重要的逐渐淡出。

video.video_title: Halo Content: Non-invasive Augmented Reality (IUI 2015)

salient.why_en: Notifications move out of the way when a person walks into view and form a halo around their face.
salient.why_zh: 有人走进视野时，通知会自动让开，在对方脸周围围成一圈光环。

works.title: Heartbeat (Invasions)
works.description: A 54-metre cloud of 100,000 white balloons fills the Covent Garden market hall in London, lit by a slow pulsing light like a heartbeat.
works.description_zh: 由十万只白色气球组成、长 54 米的云团填满伦敦 Covent Garden 市场大厅，被一束缓慢脉动的光照亮，犹如心跳。
works.idea_en: A mass of one simple element plus a slow pulse makes a building feel alive, a cheap and effective AR composition.
works.idea_zh: 一种简单元素的大量聚集，加上缓慢的脉动，让一栋建筑显得有生命，这是廉价又有效的 AR 构图。
works.technique: Balloons are tied into nets and suspended in the hall; a lighting system inside pulses on a heartbeat rhythm.
works.technique_zh: 气球被绑进网中悬挂在大厅内，内部的灯光系统按心跳节奏脉动。
works.exercise_en: Fill a real room or atrium with thousands of instanced AR balloons and pulse their brightness to the user's heart rate from a watch or camera. Twist: the balloons drift out of the building one by one when the room is empty.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实房间或中庭里填满数千只实例化 AR 气球，并按手表或相机测得的用户心率让其亮度脉动；变体：房间无人时，气球会一只只飘出建筑。

video.video_title: Charles Pétillon’s 100,000 Balloon Installation in Covent Garden, London

works.title: Hidden Stories
works.description: Visitors press a cup-shaped listening device against a patterned wallpaper; each shape in the pattern plays a real person's story about an everyday object.
works.description_zh: 观众把一个杯子形状的聆听装置贴在花纹墙纸上；图案中的每个形状都会播放一个真人讲述的关于日常物品的故事。
works.idea_en: Wallpaper you can eavesdrop on, like pressing a glass to the wall.
works.idea_zh: 可以偷听的墙纸，就像把杯子贴在墙上听隔壁。
works.technique: Sensors hidden behind each wallpaper shape detect the listening cup, which plays the matching audio clip.
works.technique_zh: 藏在每个墙纸图形后的传感器检测聆听杯，然后播放对应的音频片段。
works.exercise_en: Put image markers or NFC tags behind a printed pattern and play a recorded story when a phone or cup touches each shape. Twist: two stories play only when two people listen at the same time.
works.exercise_zh: 在印花图案后面放图像标记或 NFC 标签，手机或杯子碰到某个形状时就播放一段录音。变体：有两个故事只有两个人同时听才会播放。

video.video_title: Hidden Stories

salient.why_en: Press a cup to the wallpaper and overhear the secret stories of everyday objects.
salient.why_zh: 把杯子贴在墙纸上，就能偷听日常物件的秘密故事。

works.title: Highsight
works.description: A 'virtual bungee jump through a real space': harnessed visitors wear an Oculus Rift showing a live camera on a wire as it drops through a diorama and into the crowd around them.
works.idea_zh: 戴上头显，视角来自一根线上的真实摄像头，从模型里一路坠落到人群中。

video.video_title: Highsight

works.technique: A live camera on a cable-guided rig streams low-latency video into a head-mounted display, so the viewer's vision is displaced into a moving remote viewpoint within the same physical space.
works.exercise_zh: 把一部手机绑在绳子或杆子上做“飞行摄像头”，用 WebRTC 把画面实时传到戴 HoloKit 的同学眼前，让他从天花板视角看自己；变体：让观看者只能通过这个视角找回房间里某件藏起来的东西。
works.description_zh: 一次“穿越真实空间的虚拟蹦极”：系好安全带的观众戴上 Oculus Rift，看到的是一根钢丝上摄像头的实时画面，镜头一路坠过微缩模型，落进他们身边的人群。
works.idea_en: Put on a headset and see through a real camera on a wire as it plunges through a model and into the crowd.
works.technique_zh: 安装在缆索导轨上的实时摄像头把低延迟视频传进头戴显示器，观众的视觉被转移到同一物理空间中一个不断移动的远程视点。
works.exercise_en: Tie a phone to a rope or pole as a "flying camera", stream its video over WebRTC to a classmate wearing HoloKit, and let them watch themselves from the ceiling. Twist: the viewer can only use this viewpoint to find an object hidden somewhere in the room.

works.title: Holojam
works.description: Untethered mobile headsets and optical motion capture let a group walk around one room as avatars, drawing 3D ribbons in the air together.
works.idea_zh: 一群人戴着无线头显在同一空间里变成卡通化身，一起在空中画画。

video.video_title: Holojam

works.technique: OptiTrack cameras track reflective markers on each untethered mobile headset and on the hands, and positions are streamed over Wi-Fi so every headset renders all users' avatars and 3D ribbons in the shared room.
works.exercise_zh: 用 HoloKit 或手机 AR 的共享坐标（图像目标作为共同原点），让多人在同一空间用手机位置画出 3D 彩带并看到彼此的化身；变体：彩带只能在两个人合作（同时按下）时才会画出。
works.description_zh: 借助无线移动头显和光学动作捕捉，一群人以化身形象在同一个房间里走动，一起在空中画出三维彩带。
works.idea_en: A group in wireless headsets becomes cartoon avatars in one room and draws in the air together.
works.technique_zh: OptiTrack 相机追踪每台无线移动头显和双手上的反光标记点，位置数据通过 Wi-Fi 实时传输，使每台头显都能渲染出共享房间里所有用户的化身和三维彩带。
works.exercise_en: Use a shared coordinate system in HoloKit or phone AR (an image target as the common origin) so several people draw 3D ribbons in the same space with their phone positions and see each other's avatars. Twist: ribbons only appear when two people cooperate by pressing at the same time.

works.title: Horizon Line Chamber
works.description: A stone chamber on the shore of Morecambe Bay works as a camera obscura: inside the dark room, a lens projects the moving sea, sky and horizon upside down onto the walls.
works.description_zh: 莫克姆湾岸边的一座石室就是一个暗箱：在黑暗的室内，透镜把移动的海、天和地平线倒着投到墙上。
works.idea_en: A dark room that shows the outside world live is the ancestor of AR passthrough: it reframes a familiar view by changing how it is delivered.
works.idea_zh: 一间实时呈现外部世界的暗室是 AR 视频透视的祖先：它通过改变呈现方式来重新框定熟悉的景色。
works.technique: A lens and mirror set into the roof or wall project the exterior view onto the interior surfaces; no electricity is used.
works.technique_zh: 安装在屋顶或墙上的透镜与镜子把外景投射到室内表面，全程不用电。
works.exercise_en: Build a cardboard camera obscura, then build the digital version: a phone app that flips the live camera upside down and projects it onto a wall with a pico projector. Twist: delay the image by one minute so people meet their past selves.
works.exercise_zh: 先做一个纸板暗箱，再做它的数字版：一个把实时画面上下翻转的手机应用，用微型投影仪投到墙上；变体：把画面延迟一分钟，让人们遇见过去的自己。

video.video_title: Horizon Line Chamber, by Chris Drury

works.title: ImmerseBoard
works.description: Two people collaborate through large touch whiteboards; a depth camera beside each board renders the remote partner life-sized and in 3D, so they seem to stand next to you or behind the glass, and their arm can stretch out to point at what they mean.
works.description_zh: 两个人通过大尺寸触控白板远程协作；每块白板旁的深度相机把远方的伙伴以真人大小、带立体感地渲染出来，对方仿佛就站在你身旁或玻璃后面，手臂还能伸出去指向他说的地方。
works.idea_en: Let a remote collaborator share the board as if standing beside you, so gaze and pointing survive the video call.
works.idea_zh: 让远程伙伴像站在你身边一样共用一块白板，视线和指向在视频通话里不再丢失。
works.technique: An RGB-D camera (Kinect) mounted at the side of the display captures the writer; the depth image is reprojected into a 3D scene rendered for the viewer, with modes such as a tilted board, a mirror and a stretched pointing arm.
works.technique_zh: 装在屏幕侧面的 RGB-D 相机（Kinect）捕捉书写者，深度图像被重投影到为观看者渲染的三维场景中，并提供倾斜白板、镜像、手臂延伸指向等多种模式。
works.exercise_en: Build a shared sketch canvas between two laptops in which each person's webcam silhouette is overlaid at the side where they stand, so partners see where the other is pointing. Twist: mirror the partner so it feels like writing on two sides of a glass window.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个两台笔记本电脑之间的共享画板，把每个人的摄像头人像剪影叠在画布上他所站的那一侧，让双方看到对方指向哪里。变体：把对方做成镜像，感觉像隔着一扇玻璃窗两面写字。

video.video_title: ImmerseBoard: Immersive Telepresence Experience using a Digital Whiteboard

works.title: Impacto
works.description: A wearable combining a tactile solenoid tap with EMS muscle contraction so virtual boxing punches and soccer headers feel like real impacts.
works.idea_zh: 让VR里的一拳真的打到你身上。

video.video_title: impacto: a wearable that simulates physical impact in VR

works.technique: Pairs a solenoid for the skin-level tap with EMS that jerks the limb backwards, together simulating the momentum of an impact.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机AR拳击游戏，被打中时同伴用泡沫棒轻拍你手臂（“人肉触觉”）；变化：比较有/无触觉时玩家的躲闪反应。
works.description_zh: 一款可穿戴设备，把螺线管的触觉敲击与 EMS 肌肉电刺激结合起来，让虚拟拳击的出拳和足球头球都有真实的冲击感。
works.idea_en: Make a punch in VR actually land on you.
works.technique_zh: 用螺线管在皮肤表层产生敲击感，同时用 EMS 让肢体向后抽动，两者配合模拟出撞击的冲量。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone AR boxing game where, whenever you get hit, a partner taps your arm with a foam stick as "human haptics". Twist: compare how players dodge with and without the touch feedback.

works.title: Imponderable
works.description: A 'total cinema' installation about spiritualism and early photography, built from Oursler's archive of séance images and trick photographs. Shown at MoMA in 2016, it uses Pepper's-ghost style apparitions, projected figures and physical effects such as moving seats and wind.
works.description_zh: 一件关于唯灵论和早期摄影的“全感官电影”装置，取材于 Oursler 收藏的降神会影像和特技照片。2016 年在 MoMA 展出，结合了佩珀尔幽灵式的幻影、投影人物以及座椅震动、吹风等实体效果。
works.idea_en: The history of spirit photography is a history of mixed reality; tricks that once convinced people ghosts were real are still the core of believable AR.
works.idea_zh: 灵魂摄影的历史就是一部混合现实的历史；当年让人相信鬼魂存在的把戏，至今仍是可信 AR 的核心。
works.technique: Pepper's-ghost reflections, a projected film and synchronised physical effects (seat movement, air) are layered in one screening room, first made at LUMA Foundation (likely 2015).
works.technique_zh: 在一个放映室里叠加佩珀尔幽灵式反射、投影影片以及同步的实体效果（座椅运动、风），最早在 LUMA 基金会制作（推测为 2015 年）。
works.exercise_en: Recreate a Victorian spirit photograph in AR: use a phone and a sheet of glass or a Pepper's-ghost prism to float a translucent figure next to a real person. Twist: the ghost appears only in the captured photo, not in the live view.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 里重现一张维多利亚时代的灵魂照片：用手机加一块玻璃或佩珀尔幽灵棱镜，让一个半透明的人影浮在真人身旁；变体：幽灵只出现在拍下的照片里，实时画面中看不到。

video.video_title: Tony Oursler - Imponderable

works.title: In the Eyes of the Animal
works.description: Visitors in a real forest wear headsets and see the same forest as a mosquito, dragonfly, frog or owl might, rendered from LiDAR and CT scans as flowing particles and sound.
works.description_zh: 观众置身真实森林，戴上头显，以蚊子、蜻蜓、青蛙或猫头鹰的视角看同一片森林，画面由激光雷达和 CT 扫描数据生成的流动粒子与声音构成。
works.idea_en: Swap human senses for animal senses inside the very place you are standing.
works.idea_zh: 就在你站立的地方，把人类的感官换成动物的感官。
works.technique: LiDAR scans of Grizedale Forest and CT scans of animals are turned into point-cloud worlds with spatial binaural audio, experienced in headsets on site.
works.technique_zh: Grizedale 森林的激光雷达扫描与动物 CT 扫描被转化为点云世界，配合空间双耳音频，在现场用头显体验。
works.exercise_en: Scan a corner of the school garden with a phone LiDAR app, import it as a point cloud and render it the way a bee might see it (only moving things and UV-like colors). Twist: shrink the camera to insect height and speed.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机激光雷达应用扫描校园花园的一角，以点云导入，并按蜜蜂的视角渲染（只看得见运动的东西和类似紫外线的颜色）；变体：把相机缩小到昆虫的高度和速度。

video.video_title: ITEOTA TEASER

salient.why_en: Stand in a forest and see it through the senses of a mosquito, frog or owl.
salient.why_zh: 站在森林里，用蚊子、青蛙或猫头鹰的感官去看这片森林。

works.title: Infinity Room
works.description: A mirrored room whose walls are flooded with projected generative patterns, creating the sensation of floating in an infinite, shifting space.
works.idea_zh: 用投影和镜子让一个小房间看起来无限延伸
works.technique: Projectors cover the walls and floor while mirrored surfaces multiply the generative, sound-driven imagery to dissolve the room's boundaries.
works.exercise_zh: 在纸箱里贴镜面纸，用手机或小投影投入图案，观察无限反射；变化：让图案随背景音乐频谱变化。

video.video_title: INFINITY ROOM -Temporary Immersive Environment Experiment by Refik Anadol | Exploratorium

works.description_zh: 一个四壁为镜面的房间，墙面被投影的生成式图案铺满，让人仿佛漂浮在一个无限延伸、不断变幻的空间中。
works.idea_en: Projection and mirrors make a small room look endless.
works.technique_zh: 投影仪覆盖墙面和地面，镜面把由声音驱动的生成式影像不断复制，消解了房间的边界。
works.exercise_en: Line a cardboard box with mirror paper, project patterns into it with a phone or small projector, and watch the infinite reflections. Twist: make the patterns change with the spectrum of the background music.

works.title: Intensional Particle
works.description: A solo in which a huge projected particle landscape on the floor and back wall surges and reacts around Umeda's movement, as if the body were a force field.
works.description_zh: 一段独舞：地面和后墙上巨大的投影粒子景观在梅田宏明周围涌动、回应他的动作，好像身体是一个力场。
works.idea_en: Treating the body as a force that bends a virtual field is an AR interaction model that needs no buttons at all.
works.idea_zh: 把身体当作能弯曲虚拟场的力，是一种完全不需要按钮的 AR 交互模式。
works.technique: Generative particle imagery programmed by Shoya Dozono is projected on floor and wall, likely driven in sync with the choreography and sound.
works.technique_zh: 由堂園翔矢编程的生成粒子影像投在地面和墙上，推测与编舞和声音同步驱动。
works.exercise_en: Create a WebXR floor of particles that are pushed outward by the phone's position like a magnet, then choreograph a one-minute solo with it. Twist: the push reverses into a pull on the chorus.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 WebXR 粒子地面，粒子像被磁铁排斥一样被手机位置推开，再用它编一段一分钟的独舞；变体：到副歌时推力反转成吸力。

video.video_title: Intensional Particle - excerpt

works.title: Invisibilia: Revealing Invisible Data
works.description: An AR view that visualizes the invisible signals around connected devices, such as Wi-Fi fields and data flows, as overlays in the room.
works.idea_zh: 把看不见的无线信号和数据流可视化在空间里。

video.video_title: Invisibilia: Revealing Invisible Data Using Augmented Reality and Internet Connected Devices.

works.technique: Device positions are registered in AR (markers or known anchors) and network data such as Wi-Fi signal strength or packet activity is sampled and rendered as volumetric fields or particle flows around each device.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 或 WebXR 在路由器、手机、音箱位置放置锚点，读取手机测到的 Wi-Fi 信号强度（或用模拟数据）渲染成粒子云和数据流线；变体：可视化另一种看不见的东西，比如噪声、温度或二氧化碳浓度。
works.description_zh: 一种 AR 视图，把联网设备周围看不见的信号（如 Wi-Fi 信号场和数据流）以叠加图层的形式呈现在房间中。
works.idea_en: Make invisible wireless signals and data flows visible in the room.
works.technique_zh: 通过 AR（标记或已知锚点）注册各设备的位置，采集 Wi-Fi 信号强度、数据包活动等网络数据，并在每台设备周围渲染成体积场或粒子流。
works.exercise_en: Place anchors at the router, phone and speaker with AR Foundation or WebXR, read the Wi-Fi signal strength measured by the phone (or use simulated data), and render it as particle clouds and data streamlines. Twist: visualize another invisible thing, such as noise, temperature or CO2 concentration.

works.title: JackIn Head
works.description: A head-worn omnidirectional camera streams stabilized 360-degree video so remote viewers can look anywhere around the wearer, independent of where the wearer turns their head.
works.idea_zh: 把别人头上的全景相机当作自己的眼睛，远程的人可以独立转头看四周。

video.video_title: JackIn Head: 1st person omnidirectional video for immersive experience

works.technique: Estimates head rotation from the spherical video and counter-rotates each frame so the 360 stream stays world-stable for remote HMD viewers.
works.exercise_zh: 把一台360相机绑在帽子上直播到另一位同学的手机VR眼镜中，观看者用手势指挥佩戴者走路；变化：让三个人同时“附身”同一个人，投票决定方向。
works.description_zh: 佩戴在头上的全景相机传出经过稳像的 360 度视频，远程观众可以自由环顾佩戴者四周，不受佩戴者转头方向的影响。
works.idea_en: Borrow the panoramic camera on someone else's head as your own eyes, and look around independently from afar.
works.technique_zh: 从球面视频中估算头部旋转，再对每一帧做反向旋转，让 360 度视频流对远程 HMD 观众保持与世界坐标稳定。
works.exercise_en: Strap a 360 camera to a hat and livestream it to a classmate's phone VR viewer, who then directs the wearer's walking with hand signals. Twist: let three people "possess" the same person at once and vote on which way to go.

works.title: Just another day in the office at Magic Leap
works.description: Early Magic Leap concept footage made with Weta: a worker checks email on a holographic screen, then a robot invasion breaks out and he fights it with a ray gun around the real office.
works.idea_zh: 办公室里的日常突然被穿墙而来的机器人入侵打断。

video.video_title: Just another day in the office at Magic Leap 2015

works.technique: Spatial meshing of the office lets robots occlude behind and collide with real desks and walls, and a tracked controller acts as the ray gun for raycast hits.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 做一个小机器人从桌子后面探出头的场景，利用遮挡让它藏在真实物体后面；变体：点击机器人后它会逃到另一个真实物体后面。
works.description_zh: Magic Leap 与 Weta 合作制作的早期概念影片：一名员工在全息屏幕上查看邮件，随后机器人大举入侵，他拿起射线枪在真实办公室里四处迎战。
works.idea_en: An ordinary office day is interrupted by robots bursting through the walls.
works.technique_zh: 对办公室做空间网格化，让机器人能被真实的桌子和墙壁遮挡并与之碰撞；一个被追踪的控制器充当射线枪，通过射线检测判定命中。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR scene where a small robot peeks out from behind a table, using occlusion to hide it behind real objects. Twist: when tapped, the robot flees behind a different real object.

works.title: Kinetic Blocks
works.description: A shape display that stacks, sorts and assembles passive blocks by itself, and can replay a user's remote block-building gestures.
works.idea_zh: 桌面自己动手搭积木，把数字指令变成物理组装。

video.video_title: Kinetic Blocks

works.technique: The shape display lifts, tilts and pushes passive blocks with sequenced pin motions (like a programmable conveyor), with tracked block positions and recorded gestures driving the manipulation plans.
works.exercise_zh: 用投影在桌面上画出“移动箭头”，让同学扮演执行器按箭头推动积木，程序根据摄像头检测到的积木位置计算下一步；变体：录下一位同学的搭建过程，再让系统“回放”指挥另一个人复刻。
works.description_zh: 一台形状显示器可以自己堆叠、分拣和组装被动积木，还能复现远程用户搭积木的手势。
works.idea_en: The tabletop builds with blocks by itself, turning digital commands into physical assembly.
works.technique_zh: 形状显示器通过按序列运动的针脚来抬起、倾斜和推动被动积木（类似可编程传送带），由追踪到的积木位置和录制的手势生成操作方案。
works.exercise_en: Project "move arrows" onto a table and have a classmate act as the actuator, pushing blocks as the arrows show, while a program computes the next step from the block positions detected by a camera. Twist: record one classmate's building process, then have the system "play it back" to guide another person in copying it.

works.title: KinoIsoline
works.description: Glowing contour lines sweep over the scene, drawing it like a topographic map in motion.
works.description_zh: 发光的等高线扫过场景，把它画成一张会动的地形图。
works.idea_en: See a 3D scene as moving contour lines.
works.idea_zh: 把 3D 场景看成不断移动的等高线。
works.technique: An image effect reconstructs world-space position from the depth buffer and draws lines wherever that position crosses a repeating interval along a chosen axis, with scrolling offset.
works.technique_zh: 图像效果从深度缓冲重建世界坐标，在该坐标沿指定轴穿过重复间隔的地方画线，并让偏移不断滚动。
works.exercise_en: Draw scrolling contour lines on the real room using the AR depth map or LiDAR mesh on a phone. Twist: let the lines rise with the viewer's height so the room seems to flood.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机上用 AR 深度图或 LiDAR 网格在真实房间上画出滚动的等高线；变体：让等高线随观众的身高上升，像房间正在被水淹没。

works.title: Klanglichter
works.description: A laser harp becomes a game controller: players interrupt visible laser beams with their hands to hit geometric objects in a projected world and trigger chain reactions of light and sound.
works.description_zh: 激光竖琴变成游戏控制器：玩家用手阻断可见的激光束，击中投影世界中的几何物体，引发光与声音的连锁反应。
works.idea_en: Touch photons: make light beams both the instrument and the joystick.
works.idea_zh: 触摸光子：让光束同时成为乐器和摇杆。
works.technique: Light sensors on an Arduino detect which beams are blocked and send events to a Unity game that renders the projected visuals and sound.
works.technique_zh: Arduino 上的光敏传感器检测哪些光束被挡住，把事件发送给 Unity 游戏，由它渲染投影画面和声音。
works.exercise_en: Make three 'beams' with a flashlight and light sensors (or virtual beams in AR) and map each blocked beam to a note and a projected burst. Twist: a chord of all three beams unlocks a hidden level.
works.exercise_zh: 用手电筒和光敏传感器做三道“光束”（或在 AR 里做虚拟光束），每挡住一道就触发一个音符和一次投影爆发；变体：三道同时挡住的“和弦”会解锁隐藏关卡。

video.video_title: Klanglichter - an interactive audiovisual experience

works.title: Kvant Spray
works.description: A continuous spray of thousands of small objects bursts out, tumbles and fades in a smooth GPU-driven stream.
works.description_zh: 成千上万个小物体连续喷射出来，翻滚、消散，形成一股流畅的 GPU 驱动的流。
works.idea_en: Treat any mesh as a particle and spray huge numbers of them.
works.idea_zh: 把任何网格都当作粒子，并大量喷射。
works.technique: Positions, velocities and rotations are simulated in float render textures by fragment shaders and read in the vertex shader of a pre-built bulk mesh, so many instances are drawn in few draw calls.
works.technique_zh: 位置、速度和旋转由片元着色器在浮点渲染纹理中模拟，再由一个预先合并好的大网格的顶点着色器读取，因此只用很少的绘制调用就能画出大量实例。
works.exercise_en: Spray thousands of small meshes in AR with VFX Graph mesh output, emitting from wherever the user taps on a detected plane. Twist: let the particles collide with the AR plane and pile up.
works.exercise_zh: 用 VFX Graph 的网格输出在 AR 里喷射成千上万个小网格，从用户在识别平面上点击的位置发射；变体：让粒子与 AR 平面碰撞并堆积起来。

video.video_title: Kvant Spray Test #1

works.title: Kvant Swarm
works.description: Thousands of flowing lines swirl through space like smoke trails or bundles of silk.
works.description_zh: 成千上万条流动的线在空间中盘旋，像烟的轨迹，又像一束束丝绸。
works.idea_en: Draw each particle's path as a line, so a swarm turns into flowing strands.
works.idea_zh: 把每个粒子的路径画成一条线，粒子群就变成了流动的丝线。
works.technique: Particle positions and their history are updated in float render textures by fragment shaders (GPGPU before compute shaders were common in Unity) and rendered as line strips following a noise field.
works.technique_zh: 粒子的位置和历史轨迹由片元着色器在浮点渲染纹理中更新（这是 Unity 普遍使用计算着色器之前的 GPGPU 做法），再沿着噪声场渲染成线条。
works.exercise_en: Recreate the flowing strands with VFX Graph particle strips anchored above a table in AR Foundation. Twist: make the strands bend away from the phone as if the viewer were blowing on them.
works.exercise_zh: 用 VFX Graph 的粒子条带重现这些流动的线，并在 AR Foundation 中锚定在桌子上方；变体：让线条避开手机弯曲，好像观众在对着它们吹气。

video.video_title: Swirl

works.title: LAND
works.description: For the 50th anniversary of the Landmark Trust, five iron figures in different poses were placed at five historic sites around the UK coast and waterways, such as a Martello tower and a sea-washed bay.
works.description_zh: 为纪念地标信托（Landmark Trust）成立 50 周年，五尊姿态各异的铸铁人像被安放在英国海岸与水道边的五处历史遗址，例如一座马泰洛塔和一处被海浪冲刷的海湾。
works.idea_en: Spreading five figures across a country connects distant sites into one work, a model for multi-location AR campaigns.
works.idea_zh: 把五个人像分散在全国各地，把遥远的场所连成一件作品，这是多地点 AR 活动的范本。
works.technique: Each cast-iron body was posed in response to its site (standing, crouching, looking) and installed for one year at a place where visitors could stay overnight.
works.technique_zh: 每尊铸铁人像的姿态都回应其所在场地（站立、蹲坐、凝望），在游客可以留宿的地方展出一年。
works.exercise_en: Create five AR figures, each tied by geolocation to a different building on campus, with a pose that answers that building. Twist: the fifth figure only appears once a user has visited the other four.
works.exercise_zh: 制作五个 AR 人像，各自用地理位置绑定到校园中的不同建筑，姿态回应该建筑；变体：只有当用户去过另外四处后，第五个人像才会出现。

video.video_title: LAND by Antony Gormley: 50 Years of the Landmark Trust

works.title: Land Art au col des Aravis
works.description: On a meadow at the Col des Aravis in the French Alps, Saype paints a giant figure on the steep grass, readable from the road and the opposite slope.
works.description_zh: 在法国阿尔卑斯山的阿拉维斯山口草甸上，Saype 在陡峭的草坡上画出一个巨大的人物，从公路和对面山坡都能看清。
works.idea_en: A picture painted on a slope is designed for the view from across the valley, an early lesson in anamorphic placement for AR.
works.idea_zh: 画在斜坡上的图像是为山谷对面的视角设计的，这是 AR 变形放置的早期一课。
works.technique: The artist sprays biodegradable paint freehand guided by points marked on the slope, correcting for the perspective of the viewing point.
works.technique_zh: 艺术家依据斜坡上标记的点徒手喷涂可降解颜料，并针对观看点的透视进行校正。
works.exercise_en: Project a drawing in AR onto a sloping lawn so that it looks correct only from one chosen viewing point across the field. Twist: show visitors the distorted version first and let them find the right spot.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一幅图投到倾斜的草坪上，使其只从场地对面某个选定观看点看起来正确；变体：先让访客看到变形版本，再让他们自己找到正确位置。

video.video_title: Land Art au col des Aravis - La Clusaz - Saype 2015

works.title: Le Petit Chef
works.description: A tiny animated chef appears on a diner's empty plate, lights a grill, cooks a steak and serves it, all projected from above onto the plate and table. It grew into a worldwide dining show in restaurants and hotels.
works.description_zh: 一位迷你动画厨师出现在客人的空盘子上，生火、煎牛排、上菜，全部从上方投影在盘子和餐桌上。后来它发展成风靡全球餐厅和酒店的用餐秀。
works.idea_en: The best AR scale is sometimes tiny: a character sized to your plate turns an ordinary object into a stage and makes the wait for food a story.
works.idea_zh: 最好的 AR 尺度有时很小：一个与你的盘子相称的角色，把日常物件变成舞台，把等菜的时间变成一个故事。
works.technique: A ceiling projector maps a pre-rendered 3D animation onto a fixed plate and table layout, with the plate rim and cutlery positions used as the animation's boundaries.
works.technique_zh: 天花板上的投影机把预渲染的 3D 动画映射到固定摆位的盘子和餐桌上，动画以盘沿和餐具的位置为边界。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a tiny AR chef to a real plate using image or plane tracking, and animate a 30-second 'cooking' sequence whose flames and smoke respect the plate's edge. Twist: the chef reacts when a real fork enters the plate.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像或平面追踪把一个迷你 AR 厨师锚定在真实盘子上，做一段 30 秒的“烹饪”动画，火焰和烟雾都不越过盘沿；变体：当一把真叉子伸进盘子时，厨师会作出反应。

video.video_title: Le Petit Chef

salient.why_en: A tiny projected chef cooks your meal right on your dinner plate.
salient.why_zh: 一个投影出来的小厨师，就在你的餐盘上给你做菜。

works.title: Le mouvement de l'air
works.description: Three dancers move through projected wind, water and particle landscapes that swirl around their bodies as if air had become visible.
works.idea_zh: 把看不见的空气流动变成围绕舞者的可见影像
works.technique: Real-time fluid and particle simulations in eMotion are projected on floor and backdrop and steered live with the dancers' movement.
works.exercise_zh: 用网页流体模拟（WebGL fluid）投影，用摄像头光流让同学的动作搅动“空气”；变化：用风扇吹的真实风与投影同步。

video.video_title: LE MOUVEMENT DE L’AIR / ADRIEN M & CLAIRE B

works.description_zh: 三位舞者穿行在投影出的风、水与粒子景观之中，这些影像在他们身体周围回旋，仿佛空气变得可见。
works.idea_en: Turn invisible air currents into visible imagery swirling around the dancers.
works.technique_zh: 用 eMotion 进行实时流体与粒子模拟，投影到地面和背景幕上，并随舞者的动作实时操控。
works.exercise_en: Project a web fluid simulation (WebGL fluid) and use camera optical flow so classmates' movements stir up the "air". Twist: sync real wind from a fan with the projection.

works.title: Level of Confidence
works.description: A face-recognition camera trained on the faces of the 43 disappeared Ayotzinapa students looks for them in each visitor's face and shows which student they most resemble and how confident the match is.
works.idea_zh: 用人脸识别在每位观众脸上寻找43位失踪学生，把监控技术变成纪念
works.technique: Eigenface/Fisherface and LBP face-recognition algorithms compare the live face against the students' portraits and display the best match with its confidence score.
works.exercise_zh: 用网页人脸特征库（face-api.js）把观众与一组历史人物照片比对并显示相似度；变化：由同学讨论选择一个值得被“寻找”的群体作为数据集。

video.video_title: Level of Confidence by Rafael Lozano-Hemmer, Mexico City, 2015

works.description_zh: 一台人脸识别摄像头以阿约齐纳帕（Ayotzinapa）43 名失踪学生的面孔为训练数据，在每位观众的脸上寻找他们，并显示观众最像哪一位学生以及匹配的置信度。
works.idea_en: Face recognition searches every visitor's face for the 43 missing students, turning surveillance into a memorial.
works.technique_zh: 采用 Eigenface/Fisherface 与 LBP 人脸识别算法，把实时人脸与学生肖像逐一比对，显示最佳匹配及其置信度分数。
works.exercise_en: Use a web face-recognition library (face-api.js) to compare visitors with a set of photos of historical figures and display the similarity scores. Twist: have the class discuss and choose a group worth "searching for" as the dataset.

salient.why_en: A face-recognition camera searches every visitor's face for 43 missing students, turning surveillance into a memorial.
salient.why_zh: 人脸识别在每位观众脸上寻找 43 名失踪学生，把监控变成纪念。

works.title: LineFORM
works.description: A snake-like chain of servo modules that can bend into shapes, wrap the wrist, act as a physical graph line, or constrain the user's hand motion.
works.idea_zh: 一条会自己弯曲的“线”，既能显示信息又能约束你的手。

video.video_title: UIST 2015 - LineFORM: Actuated Curve Interfaces for Display, Interaction, and Constraint

works.technique: Chains serially linked servo segments and computes joint angles by inverse kinematics so the line can take on target curves or respond to touch.
works.exercise_zh: 用吸管和扭扭棒做一条可弯曲的实体线，再用手机AR沿着线显示流动的数据或音乐波形；变化：同学改变线的形状时AR内容同步变化。
works.description_zh: 一条由舵机模块串成的蛇形链，能弯成各种形状、缠绕手腕、充当实体的曲线图，还能约束用户手部的动作。
works.idea_en: A line that bends itself, both displaying information and constraining your hand.
works.technique_zh: 把舵机单元串联成链，用逆运动学计算各关节角度，使这条线能摆出目标曲线或对触碰作出反应。
works.exercise_en: Make a bendable physical line from straws and pipe cleaners, then use phone AR to show flowing data or a music waveform along it. Twist: when a classmate reshapes the line, the AR content changes with it.

works.title: Live Texturing of AR Characters from Colored Drawings
works.description: Children color a page in a coloring book and a tablet instantly shows the drawn character as a 3D animated figure with their own coloring, even on hidden sides.
works.idea_zh: 孩子涂色的画一拿起平板就变成立体会动的角色，颜色完全是自己涂的。

video.video_title: Live Texturing of Augmented Reality Characters from Colored Drawings

works.technique: The coloring page is tracked and rectified, the drawn colors are sampled into the 3D character's UV texture through a precomputed mapping, and occluded parts are filled by a texture synthesis lookup from visible regions.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一张涂色线稿并在 Unity 中做一个对应的 3D 模型，用 AR 图像追踪拍到页面后把页面图像通过 UV 贴到模型上（可直接用平面映射近似）；变体：让涂色影响角色的行为，比如红色越多越暴躁。
works.description_zh: 孩子在涂色书上涂好一页，平板立刻把画中的角色变成带着他们自己配色的三维动画形象，就连看不到的背面也有颜色。
works.idea_en: Hold up a tablet and a child's coloring page becomes a moving 3D character wearing the child's own colors.
works.technique_zh: 追踪并校正涂色页面，通过预先计算的映射把画上的颜色采样到三维角色的 UV 贴图中，被遮挡的部分则从可见区域做纹理合成查找来填补。
works.exercise_en: Design a coloring line drawing and a matching 3D model in Unity, then use AR image tracking to capture the page and map its image onto the model through the UVs (a planar projection is a fine approximation). Twist: let the coloring affect the character's behavior, for example the more red, the grumpier it gets.

works.title: MAN A VR
works.description: A room-scale VR piece that pushes the viewer into the computer space of the MAN A dancers, surrounding them with choreographed avatars in dazzle-patterned bodies.
works.description_zh: 房间尺度的 VR 作品，把观众推进 MAN A 舞者所在的“计算机空间”，被身披炫目迷彩的编舞化身环绕。
works.idea_en: Step inside the camouflage and be surrounded by dancers you can walk among.
works.idea_zh: 走进迷彩内部，在可以穿行其间的舞者中间。
works.technique: Motion-captured choreography is played back on stylised avatars in a game engine, viewed through a room-scale headset or a customised mobile viewer.
works.technique_zh: 动作捕捉的编舞在游戏引擎中以风格化化身回放，观众通过房间尺度头显或定制的手机观看器体验。
works.exercise_en: Place three looping mocap dancers around the origin of a WebXR scene and give them a bold two-colour material. Twist: dancers only move when the viewer is not looking at them.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 场景原点周围放三个循环播放的动捕舞者，给他们一个醒目的双色材质；变体：只有观众不看他们时，舞者才会动。

video.video_title: MAN A for VR, Gibson / Martelli

works.title: MIRROR (M2)
works.description: A headset experiment in which the user's movement becomes sound, sound becomes light, and their mirrored body dissolves into a fluid stream of particles.
works.description_zh: 一次头戴设备实验：使用者的动作变成声音，声音又变成光，镜中的身体溶解为流动的粒子流。
works.idea_en: See yourself dissolve into the sound you make.
works.idea_zh: 看着自己溶进自己发出的声音里。
works.technique: An Oculus Rift and a Kinect 2 capture the body, a Max/MSP patch turns head and limb positions plus microphone input into sound, and vvvv renders a mirrored particle body driven by that sound.
works.technique_zh: Oculus Rift 和 Kinect 2 捕捉身体，Max/MSP 程序把头部和四肢位置以及麦克风输入转换成声音，vvvv 再用这些声音驱动一个镜像的粒子身体。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR or phone AR mirror where your tracked skeleton is drawn as particles whose size follows the microphone level. Twist: the particles lag behind the body by one second.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 WebXR 或手机 AR 镜子，把被追踪的骨架画成粒子，粒子大小跟随麦克风音量；变体：粒子比身体慢一秒。

video.video_title: MIRROR (M2)

works.title: ManyCubes
works.description: A dense cluster of cubes shuffles, rotates and reorganises itself in a looping animation.
works.description_zh: 一大团密集的立方体不断洗牌、旋转、重组，形成循环动画。
works.idea_en: Get rich motion from one shader and a hash function.
works.idea_zh: 只用一个着色器和一个哈希函数就得到丰富的运动。
works.technique: A cube-cluster shader positions and rotates each cube from an xxHash-based random value and time, and the scene is finished with ambient occlusion, bokeh and color grading.
works.technique_zh: 立方体簇着色器根据基于 xxHash 的随机值和时间，决定每个立方体的位置和旋转，再加上环境光遮蔽、焦外和调色完成画面。
works.exercise_en: Fill a real shelf in AR with a cluster of small cubes that shuffle every few seconds. Twist: let each cube carry a photo taken by a classmate.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中用一团小立方体填满真实的书架，每隔几秒重新洗牌；变体：每个立方体上贴一张同学拍的照片。

works.title: Minecraft for HoloLens (E3 demo)
works.description: On stage at E3, a player sees a Minecraft world built on a real coffee table, zooms into it, opens it like a dollhouse and commands it by voice.
works.idea_zh: 把整个Minecraft世界放在真实茶几上，用语音和手势操控。

video.video_title: HoloLens Minecraft Demo  - E3 2015 Microsoft Press Conference

works.technique: Anchors a scaled game world to a detected table surface and combines gaze, air-tap and voice for world manipulation.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR把一个方块小世界放在桌面上，并用语音指令（如iOS快捷指令或Web Speech）“爆炸/下雨”；变化：让观众在另一部手机上看到同一世界。
works.description_zh: 在 E3 舞台上，一位玩家看到一个搭建在真实茶几上的 Minecraft 世界，他可以放大进入其中，像打开玩偶屋一样把它掀开，还能用语音指挥它。
works.idea_en: Put an entire Minecraft world on a real coffee table and control it by voice and gesture.
works.technique_zh: 把缩小的游戏世界锚定在检测到的桌面上，并结合注视、空中点击（air-tap）和语音来操控这个世界。
works.exercise_en: Place a small block world on a table with phone AR and trigger "explode" or "rain" with voice commands (such as iOS Shortcuts or Web Speech). Twist: let the audience see the same world on another phone.

works.title: ModulAR
works.description: A video see-through headset with swappable camera-lens modules lets the wearer switch between telescopic zoom and wide-angle vision just by where they look, using built-in eye tracking.
works.description_zh: 一款视频透视头显配有可更换的摄像头镜头模块，佩戴者只需通过注视方式，就能在望远变焦和广角视野之间切换，靠的是内置眼动追踪。
works.idea_en: Vision superpowers as plug-in lenses you switch on with your eyes.
works.idea_zh: 把视觉超能力做成可插拔的镜头，用眼睛来开启。
works.technique: Combines interchangeable camera-lens modules on an HMD with eye tracking, so gaze gestures trigger on-demand zoom or field-of-view expansion in the video feed.
works.technique_zh: 在头显上组合可互换的摄像头镜头模块与眼动追踪，用注视手势按需触发视频画面的变焦或视野扩展。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone 'binocular' mode in a cardboard viewer that zooms the camera when you tilt your head up and returns to normal when you tilt down; test it on a board at the back of the room. Twist: trigger the zoom by blinking twice using front-camera face tracking.
works.exercise_zh: 在纸盒眼镜中的手机上做一个“望远镜”模式：抬头时相机放大，低头时恢复正常，用教室后面的黑板测试；变体：借助前置摄像头的人脸追踪，眨两下眼触发放大。

video.video_title: ISMAR 2015 - ModulAR: The Augmented Reality Vision Augmentation Display

works.title: MultiFi
works.description: A smartwatch, a phone and a head-mounted display act as one interface: the glasses show a large, low-resolution overview around the body, the watch or phone held in view shows the same content in sharp detail, and the forearm serves as a clipboard for widgets.
works.description_zh: 智能手表、手机和头戴显示器组成一个整体界面：眼镜在身体周围显示大范围、低分辨率的概览，举到视线里的手表或手机显示同一内容的清晰细节，前臂还能当作存放小组件的剪贴板。
works.idea_en: Treat glasses, watch and phone as one display with different levels of detail.
works.idea_zh: 把眼镜、手表和手机当作一块拥有不同精细度的显示器。
works.technique: The devices are tracked relative to the body, so the HMD renders the context layer and hands off detail to whichever touch display lines up with the user's gaze.
works.technique_zh: 各设备相对于身体被追踪，头显渲染上下文层，并把细节交给与用户视线对齐的那块触摸屏。
works.exercise_en: With a HoloKit or phone headset plus a second phone, show a campus map floating around you in the headset and the detail card of whatever building the handheld points at. Twist: the handheld becomes a magnifier that sharpens only what is behind it.
works.exercise_zh: 用 HoloKit 或手机头显再加一部手机：头显在你周围显示漂浮的校园地图，手持手机显示它指向的那栋楼的详细信息卡。变体：手持设备变成放大镜，只把它背后的内容变清晰。

video.video_title: MultiFi: Multi-Fidelity Interaction with Displays On and Around the Body

works.title: Musée de l'Homme in situ
works.description: A time-lapse shows Rousse painting a shape across the floors, walls and columns of the Musée de l'Homme in Paris; only through his camera does it become a clean flat figure floating in the room.
works.description_zh: 一段延时影像记录 Rousse 在巴黎人类博物馆的地面、墙面和柱子上作画；只有通过他的相机，这些色块才变成一个悬浮在空间中的干净平面图形。
works.idea_en: The camera is the only true viewer: in AR the phone is also a single eye, so a shape painted for one lens can feel more magical than one that works from everywhere.
works.idea_zh: 相机才是唯一真正的观众：在 AR 中手机同样只有一只眼睛，所以只为一个镜头绘制的图形，可能比任何角度都成立的图形更神奇。
works.technique: Rousse fixes a large-format camera, marks the shape through the ground glass onto the architecture, paints the pieces, and then photographs the finished image from the same point.
works.technique_zh: Rousse 固定一台大画幅相机，透过对焦屏把图形标到建筑上，把各部分画好，再从同一位置拍下完成的图像。
works.exercise_en: Paint a real shape in masking tape across a corner of the classroom, aligned through a phone on a tripod, then add an AR layer that only appears when the phone returns to the tripod pose. Twist: let the AR layer animate the taped shape into 3D when aligned.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机固定在三脚架上取景，在教室的一个角落用美纹纸贴出一个真实图形，再加一层 AR，只有手机回到三脚架位置时才出现。变体：对齐时让 AR 层把胶带图形动画成三维形体。

video.video_title: Timelapse Georges Rousse, Musée de l’Homme in situ

works.title: Nebula
works.description: A vast cloud of hanging glass pieces fills an atrium and slowly swells and folds in waves, catching light like a nebula breathing above the lobby.
works.description_zh: 一大片悬挂的玻璃块充满中庭，以波浪缓缓鼓起、折叠，捕捉光线，仿佛一团星云在大堂上方呼吸。
works.idea_en: A volume of points moving together reads as one creature; AR particle clouds gain presence when they move as coherent waves rather than noise.
works.idea_zh: 一整块点阵一起运动时会被读作一个生命体；AR 粒子云如果以连贯的波而非噪声运动，会更有存在感。
works.technique: Motor-driven camshafts above the ceiling feed summed wave motions down thousands of cables to the glass elements, turning a lobby into a 3D wave field.
works.technique_zh: 天花板上方由电机驱动的凸轮轴，通过数千根缆绳把叠加的波动传给玻璃元件，把大堂变成一个三维波场。
works.exercise_en: Fill a real room with 2,000 virtual glass shards in phone AR and move them with two summed 3D waves; add a refractive shader. Twist: let the cloud slowly lean toward the brightest window.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 在真实房间里放 2000 片虚拟玻璃，用两道叠加的三维波驱动，并加上折射着色器。变体：让这团“星云”慢慢倾向最亮的窗户。

video.video_title: Nebula

works.title: Optic Cloak
works.description: A 49-metre energy-centre flue in Greenwich is wrapped in faceted, perforated panels whose overlapping holes create shimmering moiré patterns that make the tower's outline dissolve.
works.description_zh: 伦敦格林尼治一座 49 米高的能源中心烟囱被包裹在多面穿孔板中，重叠的孔洞产生闪烁的莫尔纹，使塔身轮廓溶解。
works.idea_en: Camouflage can be dynamic: patterns that shift with your movement make a solid building look immaterial — a lesson for diminished-reality AR.
works.idea_zh: 迷彩可以是动态的：随你移动而变化的图案能让实体建筑看起来虚无——这是削弱现实（diminished reality）AR 的一课。
works.technique: Two layers of perforated triangular panels overlap at an offset so that parallax creates moiré interference as the viewer moves, inspired by dazzle camouflage.
works.technique_zh: 两层穿孔三角板错位重叠，观众移动时视差产生莫尔干涉，灵感来自一战的炫目迷彩。
works.exercise_en: Wrap a real pillar or building in AR with two layers of virtual perforated patterns that shimmer with the user's movement. Twist: tune the patterns so the object seems to disappear from one sweet spot.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中给一根真实柱子或建筑包上两层虚拟穿孔图案，让它们随用户移动而闪烁。变体：调整图案，使物体从某个最佳位置看去仿佛消失。

video.video_title: Optic Cloak (2015) by Conrad Shawcross RA for Greenwich Peninsula

works.title: Order picking with Google Glass
works.description: Warehouse workers see which bin to pick from and how many items to take on Google Glass; studies showed it was faster and caused fewer errors than paper lists or pick-by-light.
works.description_zh: 仓库工人在 Google Glass 上看到该从哪个货格取货、取多少件；研究显示它比纸质清单或亮灯拣货更快、出错更少。
works.idea_en: A glanceable head-up display beats elaborate AR when the task is repetitive and the hands are busy.
works.idea_zh: 当任务重复且双手忙碌时，一眼可读的抬头显示比复杂的 AR 更有效。
works.technique: A simple graphic of the shelf grid highlights the target bin on the HUD and advances as each pick is confirmed; an opaque display variant performed slightly better than the transparent one.
works.technique_zh: 抬头显示器上用简单的货架网格图高亮目标货格，每确认一次拣货就前进一步；不透明显示版本的表现略好于透明版本。
works.exercise_en: Build a glanceable phone overlay that guides a partner to collect five objects from labelled boxes in the right order, and time it against a paper list. Twist: remove all text and use only shapes.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个一眼可读的手机叠加界面，引导同伴按顺序从贴了标签的盒子里取出五件物品，并与纸质清单计时比较。变体：去掉所有文字，只用形状。

video.video_title: Order picking with Google Glass

works.title: Parallel Universes (Bolshoi Theatre)
works.description: A mapping on the Bolshoi Theatre in Moscow made for the Circle of Light Art Vision 2015 contest: the classical colonnade dissolves into alternative versions of itself, as if several parallel buildings were sliding through the same facade.
works.description_zh: 为 2015 年光之环（Circle of Light）Art Vision 比赛在莫斯科大剧院上创作的投影：古典柱廊溶解成它自己的多个版本，就像好几栋平行世界的建筑在同一面立面里滑过。
works.idea_en: Showing several 'versions' of the same real building in turn is a strong way to tell time or alternate realities; AR can do this on any street corner.
works.idea_zh: 让同一栋真实建筑依次呈现几种“版本”，是讲述时间或平行现实的有力方法；AR 可以在任何街角做到这一点。
works.technique: Animated 3D variations of the columns and pediment are rendered against a model of the building and projected in alignment, with light and shadow faked to sell depth.
works.technique_zh: 针对建筑模型渲染柱子和山墙的三维变体动画，对齐后投影，并用假的光影来营造深度。
works.exercise_en: Pick one building on campus and make three AR 'parallel versions' of it (ruined, future, underwater) in Reality Composer or Lens Studio, swapping them with a swipe. Twist: the version changes with the time of day on the phone clock.
works.exercise_zh: 选校园里一栋楼，在 Reality Composer 或 Lens Studio 里为它做三个 AR“平行版本”（废墟、未来、海底），滑动切换；变体：根据手机时钟的时间自动切换版本。

video.video_title: Parallel Universes - Projection Mapping on Bolshoi Theatre by Maxin10sity

works.title: Pattern Recognition
works.description: Two dancers move beneath a rig of motorised lights that track them, follow them and gradually improvise their own responses, turning the lighting into a third performer.
works.description_zh: 两位舞者在一组电动灯具下起舞，灯光追踪、跟随他们，并逐渐即兴出自己的回应，成为舞台上的第三位表演者。
works.idea_en: The lighting rig watches, learns and becomes a dance partner.
works.idea_zh: 灯光装置会观察、会学习，变成舞伴。
