works.technique: Memo Akten's system tracks the dancers from above and steers a grid of moving-head lights in real time, with behaviours that remember and vary earlier movement (likely custom openFrameworks software).
works.technique_zh: Memo Akten 的系统从上方追踪舞者，实时控制一组摇头灯，其行为会记住并变奏之前的动作（很可能是定制的 openFrameworks 软件）。
works.exercise_en: Mount a phone above a dark room and use it to track one person; drive a single desk lamp on a servo, or a projected spotlight, to follow them with a delay. Twist: let the light 'lose interest' and wander off when the dancer stays still too long.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机固定在黑暗房间上方追踪一个人，用舵机带动一盏台灯（或投影出的聚光圈）延迟跟随他；变体：当舞者静止太久时，让灯光“失去兴趣”自行游走。

video.video_title: Pattern Recognition promo

works.title: Penguins Mirror
works.description: 450 stuffed toy penguins on turntables rotate between their white bellies and black backs to form a silhouette of whoever stands before them.
works.idea_zh: 450只玩具企鹅转身，黑背白肚拼出你的剪影
works.technique: A camera extracts the viewer's silhouette and motorised turntables turn each penguin to show its white or black side as a binary pixel.
works.exercise_zh: 用几个双面黑白的小物件（纸杯、玩具）装在转盘上，用摄像头剪影控制正反面；变化：加入延迟，让“像素”像人浪一样依次翻转。

video.video_title: Daniel Rozin: Penguins Mirror

works.description_zh: 450 只毛绒玩具企鹅站在转盘上，在白肚皮和黑后背之间来回转动，拼出站在它们面前的人的剪影。
works.idea_en: 450 toy penguins turn around, their black backs and white bellies forming your silhouette.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头提取观众的剪影，电动转盘让每只企鹅露出白色或黑色的一面，充当一个二值像素。
works.exercise_en: Mount a few small objects that are black on one side and white on the other (paper cups, toys) on turntables, and flip them with a camera silhouette. Twist: add a delay so the "pixels" flip one after another like a stadium wave.

salient.why_en: Hundreds of toy penguins turn their black backs or white bellies to form your silhouette.
salient.why_zh: 几百只玩具企鹅转身露出黑背或白肚，拼出你的身影。

works.title: PhotoMosaic
works.description: The live 3D scene is rebuilt from hundreds of small photographs, each chosen to match the color of its tile.
works.description_zh: 实时的 3D 场景被数百张小照片重新拼出来，每张照片都按它所在格子的颜色挑选。
works.idea_en: Render a scene out of a photo album.
works.idea_zh: 用一本相册来渲染一个场景。
works.technique: An image effect samples the average color of each screen tile and picks the closest photo from an album texture atlas of 256x256 images, drawing it in the tile.
works.technique_zh: 图像效果采样每个屏幕格子的平均颜色，从由 256x256 照片组成的相册纹理图集中挑出最接近的一张画进格子。
works.exercise_en: Turn the AR camera view into a photo mosaic built from the class's own photos. Twist: only virtual objects are rendered as mosaic while the real world stays normal.
works.exercise_zh: 把 AR 相机画面变成由全班同学自己照片拼成的照片马赛克；变体：只有虚拟物体渲染成马赛克，真实世界保持原样。

works.title: Pixel Waves
works.description: Waves of pixel-like light roll across the floor and respond to people walking through them like a digital sea.
works.idea_zh: 在像素组成的光之海浪中行走，浪花会随你而动
works.technique: Floor projection of a height-field wave simulation, perturbed at the positions of people detected by an overhead tracking system (Voxels track).
works.exercise_zh: 用网页做二维波动方程模拟并投到地面，摄像头检测到人就在该点“投石子”；变化：让声音大小改变海浪的颜色。

video.video_title: Pixel Waves - Miguel Chevalier - Illuminate Adelaide

works.description_zh: 像素般的光浪在地面上翻滚，就像一片数字海洋，会对从中走过的人作出回应。
works.idea_en: Walk through a sea of pixel light whose waves move with you.
works.technique_zh: 在地面投影一个高度场波浪模拟，由俯视追踪系统（Voxels track）检测到的人所在位置对波面施加扰动。
works.exercise_en: Build a 2D wave-equation simulation on the web and project it onto the floor, dropping a "pebble" wherever the camera detects a person. Twist: let the volume of sound change the color of the waves.

works.title: Play Table
works.description: A multi-player audiovisual table: an interactive image is projected from above onto a large tabletop, and people standing around its edge push virtual objects that collide and make sound in surround, sometimes cooperating and sometimes competing.
works.description_zh: 一张多人视听桌：互动画面从上方投影到大桌面上，围在桌边的人推动虚拟物体，让它们碰撞并在环绕声中发声，时而合作、时而竞争。
works.idea_en: A table where strangers play with the same projected objects from all sides.
works.idea_zh: 一张桌子，陌生人从四面八方一起摆弄同一批投影出来的物体。
works.technique: An overhead camera or depth sensor tracks hands at the table edge, and a physics simulation projected from above turns those contacts into collisions and spatialised sound.
works.technique_zh: 顶部摄像头或深度传感器追踪桌边的手，从上方投影的物理模拟把这些接触变成碰撞和空间化的声音。
works.exercise_en: Point a projector and webcam down at a table and build a p5.js physics sketch where hand shapes push balls that play notes when they hit each other. Twist: the balls only move when two hands from opposite sides touch them.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影仪和摄像头朝下对准一张桌子，用 p5.js 做一个物理草图：手的形状推动小球，小球相撞时发出音符；变体：只有桌子两侧的两只手同时碰到时小球才会移动。

video.video_title: Play Table : Overview

works.title: PomPom Mirror
works.description: Hundreds of black and beige faux-fur pompoms are pushed forward or back by motors, forming a soft, fuzzy silhouette of the person standing in front.
works.description_zh: 数百个黑色和米色的人造毛绒球被电机前推或后拉，拼出站在前面的人的柔软、毛茸茸的轮廓。
works.idea_en: Rendering a live body with a soft, unexpected material makes the reflection funny and tender — AR body effects gain character from the choice of 'pixel' material.
works.idea_zh: 用一种柔软、出人意料的材料来呈现实时的身体，让倒影既有趣又温柔——AR 身体特效也能从“像素”材质的选择中获得性格。
works.technique: A depth camera segments the viewer's silhouette and 928 pompoms on motor-driven rods move forward or backward to show light or dark fur in the matching grid cells.
works.technique_zh: 深度相机分割出观众的轮廓，928 个装在电机驱动杆上的毛绒球前后移动，在对应的网格单元里露出浅色或深色的毛。
works.exercise_en: Use body segmentation on a phone to drive a grid of AR fur balls anchored on a real wall that push out where the person's silhouette is. Twist: swap fur for another material the class votes on (sponges, leaves, coins).
works.exercise_zh: 用手机的人体分割驱动一格 AR 毛绒球，锚定在真实墙面上，人的轮廓所在位置的毛球向外推出。变体：把毛绒换成全班投票选出的其他材料（海绵、树叶、硬币）。

video.video_title: Daniel Rozin, "PomPom Mirror," 2015

salient.why_en: A mirror made of soft fur pom-poms that shows your silhouette as it moves.
salient.why_zh: 一面由毛绒球组成的镜子，用柔软的毛球映出你移动的轮廓。

works.title: Project Jacquard
works.description: Conductive yarns woven into ordinary fabric turn a jacket sleeve into a touch surface: swipe or tap the cuff to control your phone.
works.idea_zh: 把衣袖织成触摸板。

video.video_title: Welcome to Project Jacquard

works.technique: Weaves a grid of conductive threads into the textile and reads capacitive changes from a snap-on tag that classifies swipes and taps.
works.exercise_zh: 用导电胶带或导电线缝在旧手套/袖子上，接Makey Makey控制手机AR里的场景切换；变化：不同的衣服部位代表不同的AR“魔法”。
works.description_zh: 把导电纱线织进普通面料，夹克袖子就变成了触控面板：在袖口上滑动或轻点，即可操控手机。
works.idea_en: Weave a jacket sleeve into a touchpad.
works.technique_zh: 在织物中织入导电纱线网格，由一枚扣在衣服上的标签读取电容变化，并识别滑动和轻点手势。
works.exercise_en: Sew conductive tape or conductive thread onto an old glove or sleeve and connect it to a Makey Makey to switch scenes in a phone AR app. Twist: let different parts of the clothing trigger different AR "spells".

works.title: Project Soli
works.description: A tiny radar chip senses sub-millimetre finger motions in the air, so rubbing fingers turns a virtual dial and tapping presses an invisible button.
works.idea_zh: 用手指在空中搓一搓就能转动看不见的旋钮。

video.video_title: Welcome to Project Soli

works.technique: Emits a broad radar beam and classifies the Doppler and range signature of micro-finger movements into 'virtual tool' gestures.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR手部追踪或MediaPipe实现“捏合转旋钮、双指点按钮”的空中微手势控制一个虚拟收音机；变化：只允许眼睛不看手完成操作。
works.description_zh: 一枚微型雷达芯片能感知手指在空中亚毫米级的动作：搓动手指可以转动虚拟旋钮，轻点则能按下一个看不见的按钮。
works.idea_en: Rub your fingers in the air to turn an invisible dial.
works.technique_zh: 发射宽波束雷达，根据手指微动作的多普勒与距离特征，把它们分类为“虚拟工具”手势。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR hand tracking or MediaPipe to build mid-air micro-gestures (pinch to turn a knob, two-finger tap to press a button) that control a virtual radio. Twist: the task must be done without looking at your hands.

works.title: Projecting Change: Empire State Building
works.description: Manta rays 40 storeys high, a snow leopard and swimming whales were projected across the Empire State Building for the film Racing Extinction. The work was created by director Louie Psihoyos and Obscura's Travis Threlkel to draw attention to endangered species.
works.description_zh: 40 层楼高的蝠鲼、雪豹和游动的鲸鱼被投射在帝国大厦上，为纪录片《海洋浩劫》(Racing Extinction) 发声。作品由导演 Louie Psihoyos 与 Obscura 的 Travis Threlkel 共同创作，唤起人们对濒危物种的关注。
works.idea_en: Scaling an animal to the size of a skyscraper makes an abstract statistic unforgettable; AR can use scale shifts to make data emotional.
works.idea_zh: 把一只动物放大到摩天楼的尺度，会让抽象的数字变得难以忘怀；AR 可以用尺度的变化让数据触动情感。
works.technique: A bank of high-lumen projectors on a nearby rooftop covered the tower's upper floors, with imagery pre-distorted for the tall, stepped façade.
works.technique_zh: 在附近屋顶架设一组高流明投影机覆盖大楼上部楼层，影像按高耸、阶梯状的立面预先变形。
works.exercise_en: Pick an endangered animal and use 8th Wall or Lens Studio to place it at building scale on a nearby tower, with one number about its population shown beside it. Twist: the animal fades a little each time someone takes a screenshot.
works.exercise_zh: 选一种濒危动物，用 8th Wall 或 Lens Studio 把它按建筑尺度放到附近一座楼上，旁边显示一个关于它种群数量的数字；变体：每有人截图一次，动物就淡去一点。

video.video_title: Projecting Change: Empire State Building

works.title: Projecting West
works.description: On a 15-day road trip from Portland, Oregon to Portland, Maine, the team makes impulsive projection installations each night on barns, motels, rocks and roadside signs.
works.description_zh: 在从俄勒冈州波特兰到缅因州波特兰的 15 天公路旅行中，团队每晚在谷仓、汽车旅馆、岩石和路边招牌上即兴创作投影装置。
works.idea_en: A road trip where each stop gets its own site-specific story in light.
works.idea_zh: 一场公路旅行，每一站都获得一个属于它自己的光之故事。
works.technique: A portable projector and generator are set up quickly and content is mapped on site to whatever surface each town offers.
works.technique_zh: 便携投影机和发电机快速架设，现场把内容映射到每个小镇能提供的任意表面上。
works.exercise_en: In teams, walk around campus for 30 minutes, pick an overlooked surface and make a 20-second projection about it using a laptop and pico projector. Twist: the content must use only what you learned from someone passing by.
works.exercise_zh: 分组在校园里走 30 分钟，挑一个被忽视的表面，用笔记本和微型投影仪为它做一段 20 秒的投影；变体：内容只能来自你从路人那里听到的信息。

video.video_title: Projecting West — Launch Trailer

works.title: Pulled by the Roots
works.description: A construction crane in Karlsruhe's market square holds a whole townhouse in the air, with its roots dangling beneath it like a tree pulled out of the ground.
works.description_zh: 卡尔斯鲁厄市集广场上的一台建筑吊车把一整栋联排住宅吊在半空，房子底下垂着树根，像一棵被连根拔起的树。
works.idea_en: An impossible object placed in a real public space works best when it borrows a familiar machine: attach AR fantasy to real cranes, poles or bridges so the city seems to be doing it.
works.idea_zh: 把不可能的物体放进真实的公共空间，最好借用一台大家熟悉的机器：把 AR 的奇想挂在真实的吊车、灯杆或桥上，好像是城市自己在做这件事。
works.technique: A lightweight replica of a house with sculpted roots is likely built from a steel frame and fibreglass skin so an ordinary tower crane can suspend it above the square.
works.technique_zh: 一个带雕塑树根的轻质房屋复制品，很可能用钢骨架加玻璃钢外壳做成，因此普通塔吊就能把它悬在广场上空。
works.exercise_en: Find a real hook, lamp post or crane on campus and use image or geo anchoring to hang a virtual building with roots from it in phone AR. Twist: make the roots slowly grow toward the ground the longer someone looks at it.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里找一个真实的吊钩、灯杆或吊车，用图像或地理锚点在手机 AR 中从它上面吊起一栋带树根的虚拟房子。变体：观看者盯着看得越久，树根就越慢慢向地面生长。

video.video_title: GLOBALE | zkm | Pulled By The Roots | KARLSRUHE

works.title: Quality Visualizing Tool (Kat Sullivan & Sergio Mora-Diaz, CCL 2015)
works.description: A set of live programs from the 4th Choreographic Coding Lab that visualise different trackable qualities of a dancer, such as speed, expansion and flow, as graphics drawn around the body.
works.description_zh: 第四届 Choreographic Coding Lab 上完成的一组实时程序，把舞者可追踪的不同动作质感（如速度、伸展、流动）以围绕身体的图形呈现出来。
works.idea_en: Make invisible movement qualities visible, one visual rule per quality.
works.idea_zh: 让看不见的动作质感变得可见，每一种质感对应一条视觉规则。
works.technique: An Asus Xtion depth camera feeds skeleton data to Cinder sketches that compute features like velocity or body volume and draw them in real time.
works.technique_zh: Asus Xtion 深度摄像头把骨架数据传给 Cinder 程序，计算速度、身体占据体积等特征并实时绘制。
works.exercise_en: Pick three movement words (sharp, heavy, expansive), compute a simple metric for each from webcam pose data, and give each its own visual layer. Twist: let a dancer perform without knowing which word is being measured.
works.exercise_zh: 选三个动作词（尖锐、沉重、舒展），从摄像头姿态数据中为每个词算出一个简单指标，并各自对应一层视觉；变体：让舞者在不知道哪个词正被测量的情况下表演。

video.video_title: Choreographic Coding Lab Demo

works.title: Quantum Space
works.description: A room whose walls are fully covered with interactive projection: as visitors move, their bodies dissolve into streams of light particles across all the walls.
works.description_zh: 一个四壁布满互动投影的房间：观众一动，身体就化作光粒子流，蔓延到所有墙面。
works.idea_en: Walk into a room and your body dissolves into quanta of light.
works.idea_zh: 走进房间，你的身体就分解成一粒粒光。
works.technique: Six depth cameras and six projectors driven by three computers track everyone in the room; tracking and rendering modules are written in openFrameworks, with Max for automation.
works.technique_zh: 三台电脑驱动六台深度相机和六台投影仪，追踪房间里所有人；追踪与渲染模块用 openFrameworks 编写，自动化控制用 Max。
works.exercise_en: Project a particle system on one wall and emit particles from a webcam silhouette of whoever stands in front of it. Twist: particles from two people who touch hands change colour.
works.exercise_zh: 在一面墙上投一个粒子系统，粒子从站在前面的人的摄像头轮廓中发射。变体：两个人牵手时，他们的粒子会变色。

video.video_title: Quantum Space / interactive room

works.title: RGB|CMY Kinetic
works.description: Five motor-driven discs move through beams of red, green and blue light, and their overlapping shadows and reflections mix into cyan, magenta and yellow.
works.description_zh: 五个由电机驱动的圆盘在红、绿、蓝三色光束中移动，它们交叠的影子和反光混合成青、品红和黄色。
works.idea_en: Colour appears where light paths cross — an AR designer can design with virtual light and shadow mixing, not just with coloured objects.
works.idea_zh: 颜色出现在光路交汇之处——AR 设计者可以设计虚拟光与影的混合，而不只是给物体上色。
works.technique: Three coloured spotlights shine on reflective discs whose height and tilt are animated, so additive mixing in the reflections and subtractive mixing in the shadows change continuously.
works.technique_zh: 三盏彩色射灯照向可调高度和倾角的反光圆盘，反光中的加色混合与影子中的减色混合随之不断变化。
works.exercise_en: Place three coloured virtual lights around a real table in AR and let the user drag floating discs to see coloured shadows mix on the real surface. Twist: tie the disc heights to a music track.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中围绕真实桌面放三盏彩色虚拟灯，让用户拖动悬浮圆盘，观察真实桌面上彩色影子的混合。变体：让圆盘高度随音乐变化。

video.video_title: RGB|CMY Kinetic, 2015

works.title: Reality Editor
works.description: The public Reality Editor app: connected objects carry visual markers; point your phone at them to see their capabilities and wire a light switch to a lamp or a chair to a car seat by drawing connections.
works.idea_zh: AR版'数字螺丝刀'：看一眼就能重新布线家里所有智能设备。

video.video_title: REALITY EDITOR

works.technique: Each object carries a visual marker recognized by Vuforia, its Open Hybrid server publishes I/O nodes over Wi-Fi, and drawn AR connections become routing rules between the objects' Arduino-driven inputs and outputs.
works.exercise_zh: 用两块 ESP32 各接一个按钮和一个灯，手机 WebAR 识别它们的贴纸标记后可以画线把按钮连到灯上（后端用 WebSocket 转发）；变体：把连接对象换成非电子物品（如椅子被坐下），想出一个有意思的“物体间对话”。
works.description_zh: 公开发布的 Reality Editor 应用：联网物体上贴有视觉标记，用手机对准它们就能看到各自的功能，并通过画线把电灯开关连到台灯，或把椅子连到汽车座椅。
works.idea_en: An AR "digital screwdriver": glance at your smart devices and rewire them all.
works.technique_zh: 每个物体都带有可被 Vuforia 识别的视觉标记，其 Open Hybrid 服务器通过 Wi-Fi 发布输入/输出节点；在 AR 中画出的连线会变成物体之间的路由规则，连接由 Arduino 驱动的输入与输出。
works.exercise_en: Connect a button and a light to each of two ESP32 boards, and have a phone WebAR app recognize their sticker markers so you can draw a line from the button to the light (with a WebSocket backend relaying messages). Twist: swap in non-electronic things, such as a chair being sat on, and invent an interesting "conversation between objects".

works.title: Reality Masher: multi-person AR
works.description: A Microsoft Research prototype with Jaron Lanier in which several people wearing early HoloLens headsets share and play with the same holograms in one room.
works.idea_zh: 多人戴头显，在同一个房间里共享同一批全息物体。

video.video_title: Reality Masher: Multi-Person Augmented Reality

works.technique: Multiple HoloLens devices share a common spatial anchor so holograms occupy the same physical location for every participant.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio Connected Lens 或 8th Wall 共享会话，让两台手机看到同一只虚拟宠物并轮流喂它；加一个变化：一人只能看到、另一人只能听到。
works.description_zh: 微软研究院与 Jaron Lanier 合作的原型：几个人戴着早期的 HoloLens 头显，在同一个房间里共享并把玩同一批全息影像。
works.idea_en: Several people in headsets share the same set of holograms in one room.
works.technique_zh: 多台 HoloLens 设备共享同一个空间锚点，使全息影像对每位参与者来说都位于同一物理位置。
works.exercise_en: Use Lens Studio Connected Lens or an 8th Wall shared session so two phones see the same virtual pet and take turns feeding it. Twist: one person can only see it and the other can only hear it.

works.title: Reflection Study (interactive edition)
works.description: A light table where visitors move laser-cut acrylic pieces; the software simulates 2D light bouncing off the physical shapes to create typography and graphic forms.
works.idea_zh: 在灯箱上摆动亚克力块，软件模拟光线在实物间反射，生成图形与字体。

video.video_title: reflection study / Interactive edition

works.technique: A camera under or over the light table extracts the contours of acrylic pieces, and a 2D ray-tracing simulation bounces light rays off those polygon edges, projected back onto the table.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌面上俯拍几张彩色卡纸，用 p5.js 提取轮廓后从一个光源发射射线在卡纸边缘反射，投影回桌面；变体：设计一组卡片形状，让光线最终能拼出你的名字首字母。
works.description_zh: 一张灯箱桌，观众可以挪动上面激光切割的亚克力块；软件模拟二维光线在这些实物形状上的反射，生成字体与图形。
works.idea_en: Move acrylic pieces on a light table and the software bounces simulated light off them to draw shapes and letters.
works.technique_zh: 位于灯箱桌下方或上方的摄像头提取亚克力块的轮廓，二维光线追踪模拟让光线在这些多边形边缘反射，再投影回桌面。
works.exercise_en: Shoot a few pieces of colored card from above, extract their outlines in p5.js, cast rays from a light source that bounce off the card edges, and project the result back onto the table. Twist: design a set of card shapes so the light rays end up spelling your initials.

works.title: Reflector Suits
works.description: Unable to show a light work in a bright space without haze, the duo became the artwork: they stand still in public in patterned retroreflective suits that flare into light whenever a camera flash or headlight hits them, here on the streets of Shibuya.
works.description_zh: 因为展览场地明亮又不能用烟雾，无法展示灯光作品，这对艺术家干脆把自己变成作品：他们穿着印有图案的回射反光服静立在公共场所，一旦被相机闪光灯或车灯照到就会亮起，这里是在东京涩谷街头。
works.idea_en: Two living sculptures that only light up in other people's cameras.
works.idea_zh: 两座活雕塑，只在别人的镜头里才会发光。
works.technique: Retroreflective fabric bounces light straight back to its source, so the suits look plain to the eye but glow in any photo taken with flash.
works.technique_zh: 回射面料把光直接反射回光源，所以衣服肉眼看来很普通，但在任何开闪光灯拍的照片里都会发亮。
works.exercise_en: Cut shapes from retroreflective tape, stick them on clothing or a wall, and compare what people see directly with what appears in flash photos. Twist: hide a message that only shows in a flash photo.
works.exercise_zh: 用回射反光胶带剪出图形，贴在衣服或墙上，比较肉眼所见和闪光灯照片里的差别；变体：藏一条只在闪光照片中才会显现的信息。

video.video_title: REFLECTOR SUITS Shibuya, Tokyo, 2015

works.title: Retargeting Technical Documentation to AR
works.description: Printed instruction manuals are automatically converted into 3D AR instructions: the arrows and steps from paper diagrams are mapped onto the real device.
works.idea_zh: 把纸质说明书自动变成叠在实物上的AR步骤。

video.video_title: Retargeting Technical Documentation to Augmented Reality

works.technique: Parses manual illustrations, registers them to a 3D model of the device, and re-renders arrows and motion cues in AR on the tracked real object.
works.exercise_zh: 挑一份宜家说明书的一页，学生用Reality Composer把其中的箭头和零件动画放到真实物件上；变化：比较纸质与AR版本谁装得更快。
works.description_zh: 把纸质说明书自动转换成三维 AR 说明：纸面示意图中的箭头和步骤会被映射到真实设备上。
works.idea_en: Automatically turn a paper manual into AR steps overlaid on the real object.
works.technique_zh: 解析说明书插图，把它们配准到设备的三维模型上，再在被追踪的真实物体上以 AR 重新渲染箭头和运动提示。
works.exercise_en: Pick one page of an IKEA manual and have students use Reality Composer to place its arrows and part animations on the real object. Twist: compare whether the paper or the AR version gets things assembled faster.

works.title: SHIRO
works.description: An audiovisual live show in which the two artists perform inside a structure of translucent screens while projected white lines and strobes pulse with the music, making the space seem to expand, collapse and flip.
works.description_zh: 一场视听现场演出：两位艺术家置身于半透明幕构成的结构中，投影的白色线条和频闪随音乐脉动，让空间看起来不断膨胀、坍缩、翻转。
works.idea_en: Performers disappear inside a room made only of projected light.
works.idea_zh: 表演者消失在一个只由投影光构成的房间里。
works.technique: Synchronised projectors map generative line patterns onto front and back layers of semi-transparent scrim around the performers, with visuals driven by the live sound (custom software).
works.technique_zh: 多台同步投影仪把生成式线条图案投到表演者前后两层半透明纱幕上，影像由现场声音驱动（定制软件）。
works.exercise_en: Hang a sheet of tulle in front of a wall, project the same moving line pattern on both with a slight offset, and let a student stand between them. Twist: tie the line speed to a microphone so claps make the space jump.
works.exercise_zh: 在墙前挂一层纱幕，把同一条运动的线条图案略微错位地同时投到纱幕和墙上，让学生站在两者之间；变体：把线条速度与麦克风绑定，拍手就能让空间跳动。

video.video_title: NONOTAK / SHIRO at MUTEK Montreal 2016

works.title: SIM/NEBULA
works.description: Inside Prague's Rudolfinum concert hall, the Czech Philharmonic plays while the ornate hall itself is mapped with 45 minutes of futuristic visuals about a cybernetic organism being born.
works.description_zh: 在布拉格鲁道夫音乐厅里，捷克爱乐乐团现场演奏，华丽的音乐厅内部被 45 分钟的未来感影像覆盖，讲述一个控制论生命体的诞生。
works.idea_en: Map the inside of a concert hall so the architecture performs alongside the orchestra.
works.idea_zh: 给音乐厅内部做投影，让建筑与乐团同台演出。
works.technique: Multiple artists created chapters rendered to a 3D model of the hall interior, and projectors covered walls, balconies and organ in sync with the live score.
works.technique_zh: 多位艺术家分章节创作，依据音乐厅内部 3D 模型渲染，投影覆盖墙面、包厢和管风琴，并与现场乐谱同步。
works.exercise_en: Pick a piece of classical music and map a classroom corner so that each instrument group 'lives' on a different surface. Twist: let the visuals react to a live microphone instead of a timeline.
works.exercise_zh: 选一首古典乐，给教室的一个角落做投影，让不同乐器组“住”在不同的表面上；变体：让画面对现场麦克风做出反应，而不是按时间轴播放。

video.video_title: SIM / NEBULA

works.title: SemanticPaint
works.description: While scanning a room, the user touches objects and names them by voice; the system learns and labels chairs, tables and walls in the live 3D map.
works.idea_zh: 边扫描房间边用手点、用嘴说，系统就学会认识每件家具。

video.video_title: SemanticPaint: Interactive 3D Labelling and Learning at your Fingertips

works.technique: A KinectFusion-style reconstruction is labeled online: user touch plus a spoken label seeds voxels, and a streaming random-forest classifier with CRF smoothing propagates labels across the 3D map.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation Meshing 扫描房间，用户点击某块网格并说出名字（语音转文字），给这片区域着色并存标签，同时展示检测到的平面分类（桌、墙、地面）；变体：给物体打上情绪或记忆标签，而不是名称。
works.description_zh: 在扫描房间的同时，用户触碰物体并用语音说出名字，系统便在实时三维地图中学会识别并标注椅子、桌子和墙面。
works.idea_en: Point and speak while scanning a room, and the system learns to recognize every piece of furniture.
works.technique_zh: 对 KinectFusion 式的三维重建进行在线标注：用户的触碰加上语音标签为体素提供初始标注，流式随机森林分类器配合 CRF 平滑把标签扩散到整张三维地图。
works.exercise_en: Scan a room with AR Foundation Meshing, let the user tap a patch of mesh and say its name (speech to text), color that region and store the label, and also show the detected plane classifications (table, wall, floor). Twist: tag objects with emotions or memories instead of names.

works.title: Sixty Eight
works.description: A large installation of 68 inflatable elements rises and falls in slow waves across a wall, like a surface breathing.
works.description_zh: 一件由 68 个充气单元组成的大型装置在墙面上以缓慢的波浪起伏，像一张会呼吸的表面。
works.idea_en: Slow, organic motion on a hard surface makes architecture feel alive — AR can animate walls with subtle breathing instead of loud effects.
works.idea_zh: 坚硬表面上缓慢而有机的运动让建筑显得有生命——AR 可以用轻微的呼吸感而不是夸张效果来驱动墙面。
works.technique: Individually controlled fans inflate and deflate each element following layered wave functions.
works.technique_zh: 单独控制的风扇按照叠加的波函数为每个单元充气、放气。
works.exercise_en: Make a real wall 'breathe' in AR with a displacement shader driven by overlapping sine waves. Twist: slow the breathing down as the room gets quieter.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中用多层正弦波驱动的位移着色器让一面真实的墙“呼吸”。变体：房间越安静，呼吸越慢。

video.video_title: Sixty Eight

works.title: Sky Ladder
works.description: A 500-metre ladder of fuses and fireworks, lifted by a giant helium balloon, burns upward from a fishing village harbour into the dawn sky for about two and a half minutes.
works.description_zh: 一架由巨大氦气球吊起、长约 500 米的导火索烟花梯，从渔村港口的黎明中点燃，火焰沿梯子一路烧向天空，持续约两分半钟。
works.idea_en: A single vertical line that climbs away from the viewer turns the whole sky into a destination; in AR, one tall anchored object can give an empty horizon a direction and a story.
works.idea_zh: 一条离观众越来越远的竖线，就能让整片天空变成目的地；在 AR 里，一个高高锚定的物体也能给空旷的地平线一个方向和故事。
works.technique: Quick-burning fuses and gold fireworks are fixed to a ladder frame hung from a helium balloon and ignited from the bottom so the flame travels upward in sequence.
works.technique_zh: 速燃导火索和金色烟花固定在梯形框架上，由氦气球吊起，从底部点燃，火焰依次向上蔓延。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a 300-metre virtual ladder at a real outdoor spot with a geospatial anchor and animate a flame that climbs it rung by rung over 60 seconds, so students must tilt their phones upward to follow it. Twist: let the burning speed follow the loudness of the crowd's cheering.
works.exercise_zh: 用地理空间锚点把一架 300 米高的虚拟梯子固定在真实的户外地点，让火焰在 60 秒内一级一级往上爬，迫使同学们抬起手机追着看。变体：让燃烧速度跟随现场欢呼声的大小变化。

video.video_title: Sky Ladder | Clip: "Cai Guo-Qiang" | Netflix

works.title: Smoke Blur Effect
works.description: The rendered scene melts into curling smoke: pixels are dragged along swirling flows so edges wisp away.
works.description_zh: 渲染出的场景融化成翻卷的烟雾：像素被卷曲的流动拖走，边缘化作缕缕青烟。
works.idea_en: Blur an image along a flow field so it looks like it is turning into smoke.
works.idea_zh: 沿着流场模糊画面，让它看起来正在化成烟。
works.technique: A post-processing pass advects the previous frame's colour through a curl-noise velocity field and blends it with the new frame, creating a feedback smoke trail.
works.technique_zh: 一个后期处理 pass 用旋度噪声速度场平流上一帧的颜色，再与新一帧混合，形成反馈式的烟雾拖尾。
works.exercise_en: Apply the smoke blur to the AR camera image masked by people segmentation, so only people dissolve into smoke as they move. Twist: tie the smoke strength to the loudness of the room.
works.exercise_zh: 把烟雾模糊用在 AR 相机画面上，并用人像分割做遮罩，让只有人一动就化成烟。变体：让烟雾强度跟随房间的音量。

video.video_title: Smoke Blur Effect for Unity

works.title: Spektr Scatter (polygon scatter)
works.description: A solid model breaks apart into scattered polygons that fly off and dissolve, then can come back together.
works.description_zh: 一个实体模型分解成四散的多边形，飞出去后消散，然后还能重新聚合。
works.idea_en: Build a poly-dissolve that works on any model with a single slider.
works.idea_zh: 做一个对任何模型都适用、只需一个滑块控制的多边形溶解效果。
works.technique: A shader works on a mesh whose triangles are split apart, moving each triangle along a direction and rotation derived from its centroid and a noise hash as the scatter amount increases.
works.technique_zh: 着色器作用于三角面已被拆开的网格，随着散开程度增大，按照三角形重心和噪声哈希算出的方向和旋转移动每个三角形。
works.exercise_en: Scatter the polygons of a virtual object in AR when the viewer walks through it, and reassemble it when they step away. Twist: let the fragments settle on the real floor plane.
works.exercise_zh: 观众穿过 AR 中的虚拟物体时让它的多边形四散，离开时再重新聚合；变体：让碎片落到真实的地面平面上。

works.title: Spider Projection v.02 (Nuit Blanche 2015)
works.description: For Nuit Blanche in Paris, huge spiders appear trapped behind the windows of a city building, creeping across the glass above the night crowd. The second version of the piece was later shown in Le Havre and for Yves Saint Laurent's Halloween windows.
works.description_zh: 在巴黎白夜艺术节上，巨大的蜘蛛仿佛被困在城市建筑的窗户后面，在夜晚人群头顶的玻璃上缓缓爬过。这件作品的第二版后来也在勒阿弗尔以及 Yves Saint Laurent 的万圣节橱窗中展出。
works.idea_en: Windows are ready-made screens with depth behind them; AR can treat every window as a portal into a hidden interior.
works.idea_zh: 窗户是现成的屏幕，而且背后有纵深；AR 可以把每一扇窗都当作通向隐藏室内的入口。
works.technique: As in the 2012 version, miniature footage of real spiders was likely filmed inside a model of the façade and projected from behind onto several windows at once.
works.technique_zh: 与 2012 年版本一样，很可能是在立面模型里拍摄真实蜘蛛的微缩影像，再从后方同时投到多扇窗户上。
works.exercise_en: Map the windows of your school building with an image target or a WebXR plane, and place a different animated creature behind each window. Twist: creatures move from window to window as if they live inside the building.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像识别或 WebXR 平面标出教学楼的窗户，在每扇窗后放一个不同的动画生物；变体：生物会从一扇窗移动到另一扇窗，好像它们真的住在楼里。

video.video_title: Spider Projection v.02 - Nuit Blanche 2015

works.title: Star Wars Mixed Reality Test
works.description: Recorded live on a Project Tango tablet, Star Wars ships and droids appear in a real room and hold their place as the camera walks around them.
works.idea_zh: 在真实房间里让星战机器人和飞船停在原地，你绕着它们走。

video.video_title: Star Wars Mixed Reality Test

works.technique: Tango motion tracking plus depth sensing anchors 3D models to the room so they keep position and scale while the device moves.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个你喜欢的电影道具模型放进教室，绕着它录一段'纪录片'；加一个变化：靠近时模型会转头看你。
works.description_zh: 用 Project Tango 平板实拍录制：星球大战的飞船和机器人出现在真实房间里，镜头绕着它们走动时，它们始终稳稳停在原处。
works.idea_en: Star Wars droids and ships stay put in a real room while you walk around them.
works.technique_zh: Tango 运动追踪结合深度感知把三维模型锚定在房间里，设备移动时模型的位置和比例保持不变。
works.exercise_en: Put a model of your favorite movie prop into the classroom and walk around it to shoot a short "documentary". Twist: the model turns its head to look at you when you get close.

works.title: Story of Light (Star Stomp)
works.description: An interactive floor where stomping makes strange sounds from 350 hidden contact microphones while projected graphics bloom around people's feet.
works.description_zh: 一块互动地板：跺脚时，地下 350 个接触式麦克风发出奇特的声音，同时投影图形在人们脚边绽放。
works.idea_en: Stomp on the floor to make both sound and light.
works.idea_zh: 在地上跺脚，同时产生声音和光。
works.technique: Piezo contact microphones under the floor produce the sound, and a ceiling Kinect and projector track feet and project graphics around them (with Alec Schachner).
works.technique_zh: 地板下的压电接触麦克风产生声音，天花板上的 Kinect 和投影仪追踪双脚并在周围投射图形（与 Alec Schachner 合作）。
works.exercise_en: Tape contact microphones or a phone under a board and trigger projected ripples at the spot where someone stomps (found with a webcam). Twist: louder stomps make ripples that travel to the other players.
works.exercise_zh: 在木板下贴接触麦克风或放一部手机，用摄像头找出跺脚的位置，在那里投射涟漪。变体：跺得越响，涟漪传得越远，能传到其他玩家脚下。

video.video_title: Story of Light

works.title: Study for Fifteen Points
works.description: Fifteen points of light on moving rods walk in the dark; with only these dots, the viewer sees a human figure walking.
works.description_zh: 十五个安装在移动杆上的光点在黑暗中行走；仅凭这些点，观众就能看到一个人在走路。
works.idea_en: The brain needs only 15 moving points to see a person (biological motion) — AR characters can be radically minimal.
works.idea_zh: 大脑只需要 15 个移动的点就能看出一个人（生物运动知觉）——AR 角色可以极度简化。
works.technique: Motion-capture data of a walking person drives 15 mechanical arms that move LED points through the recorded joint positions.
works.technique_zh: 一个行走之人的动作捕捉数据驱动 15 根机械杆，把 LED 光点移动到记录下的关节位置。
works.exercise_en: Place 15 glowing dots in AR driven by a motion-capture walk cycle and let viewers guess the gender, mood or age of the walker. Twist: record your own walk with body tracking and see if classmates can recognise you.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中放 15 个由动捕行走循环驱动的发光点，让观众猜走路者的性别、情绪或年龄。变体：用身体追踪录下你自己的走路，看同学能否认出你。

video.video_title: Study for Fifteen Points by Random International (2016)

salient.why_en: Fifteen moving dots of light are enough to see a person walking.
salient.why_zh: 只要十五个移动的光点，就能看出一个正在走路的人。

works.title: Subatomic (geometric mirroring)
works.description: A mesh is mirrored many times around a point, creating a kaleidoscope that is a real 3D object rather than a flat screen effect.
works.description_zh: 一个网格围绕一点被镜像许多次，形成一个真正的 3D 万花筒，而不是平面的画面效果。
works.idea_en: Make a kaleidoscope that exists in 3D space.
works.idea_zh: 做一个存在于三维空间里的万花筒。
works.technique: A custom mesh renderer draws the source mesh several times with reflection matrices in world space, so the mirroring behaves like a mesh modifier with correct lighting (inspired by the subatomic sequence in Ant-Man).
works.technique_zh: 自定义网格渲染器在世界空间中用反射矩阵把源网格绘制多次，因此镜像像网格修改器一样工作，光照也正确（灵感来自电影《蚁人》中的亚原子片段）。
works.exercise_en: Mirror a small virtual object eight times around an anchor in AR so viewers can walk around a 3D kaleidoscope. Twist: include the AR face mesh so the viewer's face becomes part of it.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一个小虚拟物体围绕锚点镜像八次，让观众绕着一个立体万花筒走动；变体：把 AR 人脸网格也放进去，让观众的脸成为万花筒的一部分。

works.title: Swarm Study / VII
works.description: A grid of brass rods tipped with lights shows glowing points moving through the structure like a school of fish or flock of birds.
works.description_zh: 由顶端带灯的黄铜杆组成的网格中，光点像鱼群或鸟群一样在结构里游走。
works.idea_en: Collective motion reads as life at any scale — a few hundred AR particles following flocking rules can feel like creatures.
works.idea_zh: 集体运动在任何尺度都读作生命——几百个遵循群集规则的 AR 粒子就能像生物一样。
works.technique: An array of individually addressable LEDs on rods renders a real-time swarm simulation in three dimensions.
works.technique_zh: 安装在杆上、可单独寻址的 LED 阵列以三维方式渲染实时群集模拟。
works.exercise_en: Build a sparse 3D grid of glowing rod tips in AR and render a flocking swarm through it so points only light up where a rod exists. Twist: let the swarm avoid the viewer's phone like fish avoiding a hand.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中搭一个稀疏的三维发光杆端阵列，让群集只在有杆的位置点亮来呈现鸟群。变体：让群体像鱼躲手一样躲开观众的手机。

video.video_title: RANDOM INTERNATIONAL | Swarm Study VII

works.title: Synapse
works.description: A 3D-printed helmet whose surface opens and closes in response to the wearer's brain activity, lighting up as attention rises.
works.description_zh: 一顶 3D 打印的头盔，表面会随着佩戴者的脑电活动开合，注意力升高时会亮起。
works.idea_en: Showing an inner state (attention) on the outside of the body is a strong idea for AR wearables and social filters.
works.idea_zh: 把内在状态（注意力）显示在身体外部，是 AR 可穿戴和社交滤镜的一个有力点子。
works.technique: An EEG headset reads attention levels and drives actuators and lights embedded in a multi-material 3D-printed shell.
works.technique_zh: 脑电头戴设备读取注意力水平，驱动嵌在多材料 3D 打印外壳中的执行器和灯光。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR head-halo that opens like petals when a simple input rises (heart rate from a watch, typing speed, or microphone level). Twist: show it only to other people, never to the wearer.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 头部光环，当某个简单输入升高时（手表心率、打字速度或麦克风音量）它像花瓣一样张开。变体：只让别人看到它，佩戴者自己看不到。

video.video_title: Synapse

works.title: TORN
works.description: A dance film in which performer Caitlin Sikora appears as a volumetric point-cloud figure that fractures, rotates and tears apart in a virtual space.
works.description_zh: 一部舞蹈影片：表演者 Caitlin Sikora 以体积化的点云形象出现，在虚拟空间中碎裂、旋转、撕开。
works.idea_en: Film a dancer as a 3D volume you can tear apart and fly around.
works.idea_zh: 把舞者拍成一个可以撕开、可以绕着飞的三维体积。
works.technique: A Kinect paired with a DSLR through the open-source DepthKit toolkit captures RGBD video, which is rendered as manipulable 3D geometry.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 与单反相机通过开源工具 DepthKit 配对，拍摄 RGBD 视频，再渲染为可操控的三维几何体。
works.exercise_en: Capture a 15-second clip with an iPhone LiDAR app (Record3D or Polycam video), import the point cloud into Unity, and place it life-size in AR so classmates can walk through the dancer. Twist: split the figure along the beat of the music.
works.exercise_zh: 用 iPhone 激光雷达 App（Record3D 或 Polycam 视频）拍一段 15 秒的片段，把点云导入 Unity，以真人大小放进 AR，让同学可以从舞者身体中穿过；变体：随音乐节拍把人物劈开。

video.video_title: TORN

works.title: Tactum
works.description: Touch and pinch gestures on your own forearm are tracked and a projector shows a live 3D-printable wearable form growing on your skin as you design it.
works.idea_zh: 在自己的手臂上用手势“捏”出一件可3D打印的饰品。

video.video_title: Tactum: Skin-Centric Design by Madeline Gannon

works.technique: Tracks the arm with a depth camera, interprets skin touches as modelling gestures and projection-maps the resulting geometry back onto the arm.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR手部追踪在手臂上放置可拉伸的虚拟手镯，并用手势调整形状后导出截图做纸模；变化：投影仪从上方把设计投在真实手臂上。
works.description_zh: 系统追踪用户在自己前臂上的触摸与捏合手势，投影仪把正在设计的、可直接 3D 打印的可穿戴形体实时投在皮肤上，看着它随设计过程逐渐生长。
works.idea_en: Pinch a 3D-printable piece of jewelry into shape right on your own arm.
works.technique_zh: 用深度相机追踪手臂，把对皮肤的触碰解读为建模手势，再把生成的几何形体投影映射回手臂上。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR hand tracking to place a stretchable virtual bracelet on your arm, adjust its shape with gestures, then export a screenshot and make a paper model from it. Twist: have a projector above cast the design onto a real arm.

works.title: Talking Trees of Chalkwell Park
works.description: An augmented reality trail in Southend's Chalkwell Park, commissioned by Metal: visitors find particular trees and, through their phones, meet them as characters who share the park's social history along with some frank opinions.
works.description_zh: 绍森德 Chalkwell Park 里的一条增强现实路线，由 Metal 委托：观众找到特定的树，通过手机与它们作为角色相遇，听它们讲公园的社会历史，外加一些直言不讳的看法。
works.idea_en: The park's trees become storytellers with a voice and a personality.
works.idea_zh: 公园里的树变成有声音、有个性的讲述者。
works.technique: A mobile AR app likely uses location or image triggers at each tree to overlay an animated character and play its recorded voice.
works.technique_zh: 手机 AR 应用很可能在每棵树旁用位置或图像触发，叠加动画角色并播放录好的配音。
works.exercise_en: Pick three trees on campus, write a short monologue for each from the tree's point of view, and anchor an animated face and audio to each with Lens Studio or an AR Foundation image marker. Twist: the trees disagree with each other about the same event.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里选三棵树，以树的视角各写一段独白，用 Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation 的图像标记给每棵树锚定一张动画脸和一段语音；变体：让这几棵树对同一件事意见不合。

video.video_title: Talking Trees of Chalkwell Park

works.title: TextAnimation
works.description: Letters and glyphs assemble, scatter and flicker in a prototype of shader-driven motion typography.
works.description_zh: 字母和字形不断组合、散开、闪烁，这是一个由着色器驱动的动态排版原型。
works.idea_en: Animate typography entirely in a shader.
works.idea_zh: 完全在着色器里做文字动画。
works.technique: A text animation shader offsets and reveals each glyph quad using its index and time, so many letters animate on the GPU without per-letter scripts.
works.technique_zh: 文字动画着色器根据每个字形四边形的序号和时间做偏移和显现，所以大量字母都在 GPU 上动起来，不需要逐字脚本。
works.exercise_en: Write a short sentence in AR space with TextMeshPro and animate each letter in a shader so it assembles when the viewer looks at it. Twist: letters scatter again when the viewer looks away.
works.exercise_zh: 用 TextMeshPro 在 AR 空间中写一句短句，并用着色器为每个字母做动画，观众看向它时文字才组合起来；变体：观众把视线移开时，字母重新散开。

works.title: The Dappled Light of the Sun
works.description: A cloud-like canopy of thousands of steel tetrahedra hovers above visitors' heads outdoors, breaking sunlight into dappled patches like a tree canopy.
works.description_zh: 一片由成千上万个钢制四面体组成、如云般的顶棚悬浮在户外观众头顶，把阳光打碎成树荫般的斑驳光影。
works.idea_en: A structure overhead can shape the light you walk through — outdoor AR can use the sky and sun as part of the composition.
works.idea_zh: 头顶的结构可以塑造你穿行其中的光——户外 AR 可以把天空与太阳当作构图的一部分。
works.technique: Tetrahedra of weathering steel are assembled in a branching, cloud-like mass on a few supports, letting sunlight filter through the gaps.
works.technique_zh: 耐候钢四面体以分支状、云团般的方式组装在少数支撑上，让阳光从缝隙中透下。
works.exercise_en: Float a canopy of virtual tetrahedra above an outdoor plaza in phone AR and cast shadows that match the real sun direction. Twist: make the canopy slowly grow new branches each time a visitor looks up.
works.exercise_zh: 在户外广场上方用手机 AR 悬浮一片虚拟四面体顶棚，并投下与真实太阳方向一致的影子。变体：每当有访客抬头，顶棚就慢慢长出新的枝杈。

video.video_title: Conrad Shawcross - The Dappled Light of the Sun IV - Frieze Sculpture Park - London October 2015

works.title: The Diffusion of Light
works.description: A white laser beam sweeps across a large pile of broken glass and mirrors, splitting into coloured reflections that move across the whole room.
works.description_zh: 一束白色激光扫过一大堆碎玻璃和镜子，分裂成彩色反射光，在整个房间里移动。
works.idea_en: One beam of white light turned into a room full of colour by broken glass.
works.idea_zh: 一束白光被碎玻璃变成满屋的色彩。
works.technique: Programmed laser paths are aimed across the glass pile so refraction and reflection scatter the light around the space.
works.technique_zh: 编程控制激光路径扫过玻璃堆，让折射和反射把光散射到整个空间。
works.exercise_en: Shine a moving phone flashlight or projector spot across a pile of clear objects and film how the room changes; then script the path to 'play' the reflections. Twist: add one coloured object and make it the star of the piece.
works.exercise_zh: 用移动的手机闪光灯或投影光点照过一堆透明物体，拍下房间的变化；再编排光点路径来“演奏”这些反射。变体：加入一个彩色物体，让它成为作品主角。

video.video_title: The Diffusion of Light

works.title: The Infinite Crystal Universe
works.description: Thousands of vertical LED strings fill a mirrored room; visitors use a phone app to throw elements such as stars or flowers into the space, which then burst through the lights around everyone.
works.description_zh: 成千上万串垂直的 LED 灯挂满一间镜面房间；观众用手机应用把星星或花等元素「扔」进空间，它们随即在所有人周围的灯光中炸开。
works.idea_en: A phone can be a remote control for a physical light volume shared by a crowd; AR can hand the same shared space to many users at once.
works.idea_zh: 手机可以成为一群人共享的实体光体的遥控器：AR 也可以把同一个共享空间同时交给许多用户。
works.technique: Point lights on hanging strings form a volumetric display mirrored to infinity, and a smartphone app sends chosen elements to the rendering engine in real time.
works.technique_zh: 悬挂灯串上的点光源组成体积显示，镜面让它无限延伸，手机应用把选中的元素实时发送给渲染引擎。
works.exercise_en: Build a shared WebXR room where each phone can fling one element (star, leaf, firework) into a common grid of glowing points that everyone sees. Twist: when two users throw elements at the same moment, they merge into a larger burst.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个共享 WebXR 房间：每部手机都能把一个元素（星星、树叶、烟花）抛进所有人都能看到的发光点阵。变体：两位用户同时抛出时，元素合并成更大的爆发。

video.video_title: The Infinite Crystal Universe

works.title: The Key in the Hand
works.description: In the Japan Pavilion at the Venice Biennale, a canopy of red yarn fills the room and holds about 50,000 old keys collected from the public, dangling above two wooden boats.
works.description_zh: 在威尼斯双年展日本馆里，红色毛线织成的网布满整个房间，挂着从公众手中收集来的约五万把旧钥匙，悬在两艘木船上方。
works.idea_en: Thousands of personal objects hung in one web make memory visible as a volume; AR can let a crowd's contributions hang in a shared space the same way.
works.idea_zh: 把成千上万件私人物品挂进同一张网，记忆就变成了看得见的体量：AR 也可以把众人的投稿悬挂在同一个共享空间里。
works.technique: Hand-knotted red wool lines run from ceiling to floor, each carrying keys, so the density of thread and objects builds a walk-under cloud.
works.technique_zh: 手工打结的红色毛线从天花板拉到地面，每根线上挂着钥匙，线与物的密度形成可以从下方穿行的一片云。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR or phone AR room where each participant uploads a photo of one key or small object; the app hangs it on a red line from the ceiling at their standing position. Twist: the line color changes with how long ago the object was added, so old memories fade to pink.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 WebXR 或手机 AR 房间：每位参与者上传一张钥匙或小物件的照片，应用把它用一根红线从天花板垂挂在其站立的位置。变体：线的颜色随投稿时间变化，越久远的记忆越褪成粉色。

video.video_title: Chiharu Shiota, The Key in the Hand, Biennale de Venise 2015

works.title: This Floating World
works.description: A dancer performs a solo inside projected vines and flowing forms that are shaped by her movement, while the score shifts with her body; later shown as an installation that visitors could dance in.
works.description_zh: 舞者在投影出的藤蔓和流动形态中独舞，这些形态随她的动作生长变化，配乐也随身体改变；后来也作为观众可以进入起舞的装置展出。
works.idea_en: The dancer grows the landscape she dances in, like a vine shaped by a wall.
works.idea_zh: 舞者“长出”她所在的风景，就像藤蔓被墙塑形。
works.technique: A 3D depth camera tracks the dancer; custom software analyses the movement and, with live input from an operator's laptop, generates the projected visuals and modulates the music.
works.technique_zh: 3D 深度摄像头追踪舞者，自研软件分析动作，并结合操作者笔记本的实时输入生成投影画面、调制音乐。
works.exercise_en: With a webcam and TouchDesigner or p5.js, project lines that grow from the performer's silhouette edges and slowly fade. Twist: let lines grow only where the dancer has stood still for three seconds.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头加 TouchDesigner 或 p5.js，从表演者轮廓边缘投影出不断生长、慢慢消退的线条；变体：只在舞者静止超过三秒的地方长出线条。

video.video_title: This Floating World (installation) - teaser for TedXTeen London 2016

works.title: Unfold 01 | Projection on Print
works.description: A morphogenesis-inspired form printed on a large canvas is overlaid with an exactly aligned projection, so the flat print seems to fold and breathe.
works.idea_zh: 投影精确叠在印刷画上，让平面图像像生物一样折叠、呼吸。

video.video_title: Unfold 01 | Projection on Print

works.technique: A projector is calibrated to the printed canvas so animated light and shadow are registered on top of the matching printed geometry.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一张黑白几何图，用投影仪 + MadMapper/TouchDesigner 精确对位投上动画光影；加一个变化：动画跟随环境音乐节奏。
works.description_zh: 一幅受形态发生启发的形体印在大幅画布上，再叠加一层精确对齐的投影，让平面的印刷画仿佛在折叠、呼吸。
works.idea_en: A projection laid exactly over a print makes the flat image fold and breathe like a living thing.
works.technique_zh: 将投影仪与印刷画布进行标定，使动态的光影精确叠合在对应的印刷几何图形之上。
works.exercise_en: Print a black-and-white geometric image and use a projector with MadMapper or TouchDesigner to align animated light and shadow precisely onto it. Twist: make the animation follow the rhythm of the ambient music.

works.title: VERSUS
works.description: An immersive audiovisual piece made for the Satosphere, a 360-degree projection dome, where monochrome geometric light patterns sweep over and around the audience lying and standing below.
works.description_zh: 为 Satosphere（360 度投影穹顶）创作的沉浸式视听作品，黑白几何光纹在躺着或站着的观众头顶与四周扫过。
works.idea_en: A whole dome becomes one moving optical illusion.
works.idea_zh: 整座穹顶变成一个运动中的视错觉。
works.technique: Generative line and grid patterns are rendered in dome-master format and mapped across the dome's projectors, synchronised with spatial sound.
works.technique_zh: 生成式线条与网格图案以穹顶母版格式渲染，映射到穹顶的多台投影仪上，并与空间声音同步。
works.exercise_en: Build a mini dome with an umbrella lined with white paper and a phone projector, then design a pattern that makes viewers feel they are rising. Twist: the pattern must work only when viewed from lying on the floor.
works.exercise_zh: 用内衬白纸的雨伞和手机投影仪做一个迷你穹顶，设计一种让观众感觉自己在上升的图案；变体：图案只有躺在地上看才成立。

video.video_title: NONOTAK - VERSUS at SAT MONTREAL

works.title: VJ04 (Channel #10)
works.description: Glossy 3D forms and figures pulse and morph to Nyolfen's live set at Channel #10, projected as club visuals.
works.description_zh: 光亮的 3D 形体和人物随着 Nyolfen 在 Channel #10 的现场演出脉动、变形，作为夜店视觉投影出来。
works.idea_en: Use physically based rendering to make club visuals look like product shots in motion.
works.idea_zh: 用基于物理的渲染，让夜店视觉看起来像动起来的产品摄影。
works.technique: Unity scenes lit with HDR image-based lighting (sIBL archive) are driven by Reaktion controllers mapped to audio input and MIDI CCs.
works.technique_zh: Unity 场景使用 HDR 图像照明（sIBL 素材），由映射到音频输入和 MIDI CC 的 Reaktion 控制器驱动。
works.exercise_en: Light a virtual chrome object in AR with the real environment probe and make it pulse to the music the phone hears. Twist: swap its material on every drum hit.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中用真实环境探针照亮一个虚拟镀铬物体，让它随手机听到的音乐脉动；变体：每一次鼓点都切换它的材质。

video.video_title: [CHANNEL#10] Nyolfen / VJ Keijiro Takahashi (2015/1/23)

works.title: VJ05 (Channel #12)
works.description: Live visuals for Katsuhiro Chiba at Channel #12, where HDR-lit 3D models and animations move with the music; the clip is an audience recording from the club.
works.description_zh: 为千叶加寿弘在 Channel #12 的现场演出制作的视觉：HDR 照明下的 3D 模型和动画随音乐运动；视频是观众在现场拍摄的。
works.idea_en: Build a reusable live-visual rig where every animated parameter is exposed to sound and MIDI.
works.idea_zh: 搭建一个可复用的现场视觉系统，把所有动画参数都开放给声音和 MIDI 控制。
works.technique: All models and animations are driven by Reaktion controllers (Reaktor components) that take audio analysis, optionally via Data Racket, and MIDI CC input.
works.technique_zh: 所有模型和动画都由 Reaktion 控制器（Reaktor 组件）驱动，输入来自音频分析（可选用 Data Racket）和 MIDI CC。
works.exercise_en: Expose five parameters of an AR scene (scale, color, rotation speed, spawn rate, camera shake) to the phone microphone and perform a one-minute set with a partner. Twist: the partner controls the parameters from a second phone over the network.
works.exercise_zh: 把 AR 场景的五个参数（大小、颜色、旋转速度、生成速率、镜头抖动）开放给手机麦克风，和搭档一起表演一分钟；变体：搭档用第二部手机通过网络控制这些参数。

video.video_title: Katsuhiro Chibaさん http://t.co/49sm5KuJyY

works.title: Virtual Replicas for Remote Assistance
works.description: A remote expert grabs a virtual copy of a part in the local worker's room and shows exactly where and how it should go; the local worker sees the ghost replica move into place through their AR headset.
works.description_zh: 远程专家抓起本地工人房间里某个部件的虚拟复制品，演示它应该放在哪里、怎样放；本地工人通过 AR 头显看到这个“幽灵”复制品移动到位。
works.idea_en: Point and demonstrate with a copy of the real object instead of with words or arrows.
works.idea_zh: 用真实物体的复制品来指示和示范，而不是靠语言或箭头。
works.technique: Tracks the physical objects and gives the remote VR or AR expert manipulable 3D replicas whose poses are mirrored as guidance in the local user's stereo head-worn display.
works.technique_zh: 追踪实体物体，为身处 VR 或 AR 的远程专家提供可操作的三维复制品，其位姿会作为指导同步显示在本地用户的立体头戴显示器中。
works.exercise_en: Put a printed marker on a toy part; a remote partner moves a virtual copy of it in a shared phone AR scene to show where it goes, and the local student assembles it. Twist: allow the expert only one gesture and no voice.
works.exercise_zh: 在玩具零件上贴一个打印标记，远程同伴在共享的手机 AR 场景中移动它的虚拟复制品来示范位置，本地学生照着组装；变体：专家只能用一个手势，不能说话。

video.video_title: Virtual Replicas for Remote Assistance in Virtual and Augmented Reality

works.title: WO1 Hologram
works.description: In an underground crypt at Leuven's city cemetery, where victims of the First World War rest, translucent figures of Belgian soldiers and civilians appear to float in the dark space as a memorial.
works.description_zh: 在鲁汶市立公墓的一座地下墓室里（安葬着第一次世界大战的遇难者），比利时士兵和平民的半透明身影仿佛漂浮在黑暗中，作为纪念。
works.idea_en: Placing ghostly figures in the real site of an event gives memory a location; site-specific AR memorials work the same way.
works.idea_zh: 把幽灵般的人物放在事件发生的真实地点，就让记忆有了位置；特定场地的 AR 纪念也是同样的道理。
works.technique: A holographic illusion, likely a projection onto transparent gauze or a Pepper's-ghost screen in a dark crypt, shows animated figures floating in space.
works.technique_zh: 一种全息幻象，推测是在黑暗墓室中把动画投在透明纱幕或佩珀尔幻象屏上，让人物仿佛悬浮在空中。
works.exercise_en: Choose a place on campus with a history, research one story, and place a translucent AR figure there that appears only at that GPS location and fades as you approach. Twist: visitors can leave a spoken note that the next visitor hears.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里选一个有历史的地方，查找一个故事，在那里放一个半透明的 AR 人物，只在该 GPS 位置出现，走近时渐渐淡去；变体：访客可以留下一段语音，下一位访客会听到。

video.video_title: WO1 Hologram

works.title: Whale in the Gym (concept)
works.description: A humpback whale bursts out of a school gym floor in front of students and splashes back down, a concept film for shared, room-scale mixed reality.
works.idea_zh: 一头鲸鱼从学校体育馆地板里跃出。

video.video_title: Whale Surprise Jumps into a Gym in Mixed Reality (Exciting) by Magic Leap

works.technique: Concept visualization (likely VFX compositing rather than live headset capture) of a large creature breaking through a real floor plane.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR（如Reality Composer）让一个巨大动物从教室地板“冲出”，并设计一个遮挡的洞口效果；变化：全班同时用多部手机看到同一只动物。
works.description_zh: 一头座头鲸在学生面前从学校体育馆的地板中破地而出，又溅起水花落回去。这是一支展示多人共享、房间尺度混合现实的概念影片。
works.idea_en: A whale leaps out of a school gym floor.
works.technique_zh: 概念可视化（大概率是 VFX 后期合成，而非头显实拍），表现一只巨大生物冲破真实地面的场景。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR (for example Reality Composer) to make a giant animal burst out of the classroom floor, and design an occluded hole effect. Twist: let the whole class see the same animal on several phones at once.

works.title: Where things start from
works.description: A sketch of an interactive sound space where holding a slow, sustained movement generates noise textures, tested with Kinect recordings of a dancer.
works.description_zh: 一个互动声音空间的草图：保持缓慢持续的动作会产生噪声纹理，用舞者的 Kinect 录像进行测试。
works.idea_en: Reward stillness and slowness with sound instead of fast gestures.
works.idea_zh: 用声音奖励静止和缓慢，而不是快速的手势。
works.technique: Kinect skeleton data is analysed for sustained low-velocity motion, which is mapped to the amplitude and filtering of a noise synthesiser.
works.technique_zh: 分析 Kinect 骨架数据中持续的低速运动，映射到噪声合成器的音量和滤波。
works.exercise_en: Build a web page where MediaPipe body tracking plays a drone that gets louder the slower you move. Twist: fast moves erase the sound for five seconds.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个网页：MediaPipe 身体追踪控制一个持续音，动作越慢声音越大；变体：快速动作会让声音消失五秒。

video.video_title: Where things start from: Experimenting with sound from sustained movement

works.title: Zoom Pavilion (with Krzysztof Wodiczko)
works.description: An immersive room of projections from 12 computerized surveillance cameras that detect visitors' faces and zoom in on them and on the spatial relationships between strangers.
works.idea_zh: 监控摄像头自动放大你与陌生人的关系，并投满整个房间
works.technique: Face-detection and tracking algorithms steer robotic zoom cameras and project their live feeds, recording distances between detected people.
works.exercise_zh: 用网页摄像头做人脸检测并自动“数码变焦”到每张脸，投影到墙上；变化：计算两人间距离并在画面中画线标出。

video.video_title: Rafael Lozano-Hemmer & Krzysztof Wodiczko 'Zoom Pavilion' 2015

works.description_zh: 一个沉浸式投影空间，影像来自 12 台由计算机控制的监控摄像头，它们检测观众的面孔并放大，也放大陌生人之间的空间关系。
works.idea_en: Surveillance cameras zoom in on how you relate to strangers and fill the whole room with it.
works.technique_zh: 人脸检测与追踪算法控制机械变焦摄像头，把它们的实时画面投影出来，同时记录被检测到的人之间的距离。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam to detect faces, automatically "digitally zoom" in on each one, and project the result onto a wall. Twist: compute the distance between two people and draw a line marking it in the image.

works.title: body(input);
works.description: A solo in which light is generated from the dancer's own heartbeat, breathing and muscle activity; at times the light follows her body exactly, at others it takes on a life of its own.
works.description_zh: 一段独舞：灯光由舞者自己的心跳、呼吸和肌肉活动生成；有时灯光紧紧跟随她的身体，有时又自行其是。
works.idea_en: Light is driven by what happens inside the body, not by its outline.
works.idea_zh: 驱动灯光的是身体内部发生的事，而不是身体的轮廓。
works.technique: Sensors worn on the body (heart rate, breath and EMG) send data wirelessly to software that generates the light and sound, with custom 3D-printed enclosures and PCBs.
works.technique_zh: 身上佩戴的传感器（心率、呼吸和肌电）把数据无线发送给生成灯光与声音的软件，外壳和电路板均为定制 3D 打印与自制 PCB。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone camera's heart-rate app or a cheap pulse sensor on an Arduino to drive the brightness of a lamp while a dancer performs; start in sync, then let the lamp slowly invent its own rhythm. Twist: invite a viewer to hold the sensor so the dancer follows a stranger's heartbeat.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机摄像头测心率的 App 或 Arduino 上的廉价脉搏传感器，在舞者表演时驱动一盏灯的亮度；开始时同步，然后让灯慢慢生出自己的节奏；变体：请一位观众握住传感器，让舞者去追随陌生人的心跳。

video.video_title: body(input); //spin off

works.title: border (Rhizomatiks Research x ELEVENPLAY)
works.description: Audience members ride automated wheelchairs wearing headsets whose view mixes live dancers with virtual ones, so they cannot tell which bodies are real.
works.idea_zh: 坐着自动轮椅戴头显，真假舞者在眼前交错

video.video_title: Border at Spiral

works.technique: Motion capture tracks both the audience wheelchairs and real dancers in a shared coordinate system, so HMD-rendered virtual dancers and scenery are registered precisely to the physical stage.
works.exercise_zh: 用 HoloKit 或手机 AR 在教室里放一个虚拟舞者，让观看者坐在带轮椅子上被同学推着走固定路线，真人舞者和虚拟舞者交替出现；变体：观看者看不到真人舞者什么时候替换了虚拟的，事后让他猜。
works.description_zh: 观众坐在自动轮椅上、戴着头显，眼前的画面把真人舞者和虚拟舞者混在一起，让人分不清哪些身体是真实的。
works.idea_en: Ride an automated wheelchair in a headset while real and virtual dancers weave past you.
works.technique_zh: 动作捕捉系统在同一坐标系中同时追踪观众的轮椅和真人舞者，使 HMD 渲染的虚拟舞者和场景与实体舞台精确对齐。
works.exercise_en: Place a virtual dancer in the classroom with HoloKit or phone AR, seat the viewer on a wheeled chair and have classmates push them along a fixed route while real and virtual dancers take turns appearing. Twist: the viewer cannot tell when a real dancer has replaced a virtual one, and has to guess afterward.

works.title: castAR SmartGlasses at AWE 2015
works.description: A later castAR prototype shown at AWE 2015 with tabletop games that several players see at once around the retro-reflective surface.
works.idea_zh: 多人围坐反光桌面，共同玩全息桌游。

video.video_title: Jeri Ellsworth (Cofounder, CastAR) - CastAR SmartGlasses at AWE 2015

works.technique: Because each wearer's projector image returns only to their own eyes, multiple players can share one surface with individually correct perspective views.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个多人桌面游戏，每个玩家看到的信息不同（比如手牌只有自己能看），用多台手机 AR 围绕同一张图像标记实现；变体：加入一张所有人都能看到的公共牌。
works.description_zh: castAR 在 AWE 2015 上展示的后期原型，配有桌面游戏，多位玩家可以围着回射反光表面同时看到游戏画面。
works.idea_en: Several players sit around a reflective table and play a holographic board game together.
works.technique_zh: 由于每位佩戴者的投影仪画面只会反射回他自己的眼睛，多名玩家可以共享同一块表面，并各自看到透视正确的画面。
works.exercise_en: Design a multiplayer tabletop game where each player sees different information (for example, only you can see your own hand of cards), built with several phones running AR around the same image marker. Twist: add one public card that everyone can see.

works.title: drone + AR test
works.description: Tests where flying drones are tracked and AR graphics are composited onto them in real time, previewing AR for live drone performances.
works.idea_zh: 给飞行中的无人机实时叠加AR图形

video.video_title: drone + AR test 01 (Rhizomatiks Research)

works.technique: Optical motion capture (e.g. retroreflective markers on drones) gives each drone's 6DoF pose, which drives CG attached to it and composited into the tracked camera view.
works.exercise_zh: 在一个遥控小车或手持物体上贴图像标记，用 AR 图像追踪给它叠加翅膀、尾迹等图形；变体：让尾迹记录它移动的完整路径，最后形成一幅“运动绘画”。
works.description_zh: 一系列测试：追踪飞行中的无人机，并实时把 AR 图形合成到它们身上，为无人机现场表演中的 AR 效果做预演。
works.idea_en: Overlay AR graphics on drones in flight, in real time.
works.technique_zh: 光学动作捕捉（例如贴在无人机上的回射标记点）获取每架无人机的 6DoF 位姿，驱动附着在其上的 CG，并合成进被追踪的摄像机画面。
works.exercise_en: Stick an image marker on a remote-control car or a handheld object and use AR image tracking to overlay wings, trails and other graphics on it. Twist: have the trail record its complete path, ending up as a "motion painting".

works.title: shadow (drone with a spotlight)
works.description: A single dancer is lit only by spotlights carried by drones; as the drones move, her shadows multiply, stretch and rotate on the walls.
works.idea_zh: 用无人机携带的聚光灯让影子成为舞蹈的一部分
works.technique: Light-carrying drones follow programmed paths so the light source position is choreographed, controlling the size and direction of the dancer's shadows.
works.exercise_zh: 关灯，用手机手电筒绑在长杆或小车上移动，让同学跳舞时影子在墙上变化；变化：用两个不同颜色的光源做出双色影子。

video.video_title: ELEVENPLAY x Rhizomatiks "shadow" (2015) drone with a spot light

works.description_zh: 一位舞者只被无人机携带的聚光灯照亮；随着无人机移动，她投在墙上的影子不断增多、拉长、旋转。
works.idea_en: Spotlights carried by drones make the dancer's shadows part of the dance.
works.technique_zh: 携带光源的无人机按编程路径飞行，从而编排光源的位置，控制舞者影子的大小和方向。
works.exercise_en: Turn off the lights, tie a phone flashlight to a long pole or a small cart, and move it while a classmate dances so their shadow shifts across the wall. Twist: use two light sources of different colors to make two-toned shadows.

salient.why_en: Drones carry the spotlights, so as they fly the dancer's shadows multiply and turn.
salient.why_zh: 聚光灯由无人机携带，它们一飞，舞者的影子就分裂、旋转。

works.title: yellowbluepink
works.description: A gallery at Wellcome Collection is filled with dense coloured mist; visitors walk into yellow, blue and pink light and lose sight of walls, floor and each other.
works.description_zh: Wellcome Collection 的一间展厅充满浓密的彩色雾气；观众走进黄、蓝、粉色的光里，看不见墙、地板，也看不见彼此。
works.idea_en: Colour can be something you are inside rather than something you look at; volumetric AR effects around the viewer shift the experience from watching to being immersed.
works.idea_zh: 颜色可以是你身处其中的东西，而不只是你看的东西；包围观者的体积 AR 效果，会把体验从观看变成沉浸。
works.technique: Haze machines saturate the room with fine mist, and coloured lamps light it in zones so that colour appears to hang in the air itself.
works.technique_zh: 雾机让房间充满细雾，彩灯分区照亮雾气，颜色看起来就悬浮在空气中。
works.exercise_en: Create a volumetric colour fog in Unity with AR Foundation that is densest around the viewer and changes from yellow to blue to pink as they walk across the room. Twist: when two phones are close, mix their colours.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Unity 和 AR Foundation 做一个体积彩雾，在观者周围最浓，随其穿过房间从黄色变成蓝色再到粉色。变体：两部手机靠近时，把它们的颜色混合起来。

video.video_title: States of Mind: Ann Veronica Janssens

works.title: 14th & AR
works.description: For Art in Odd Places on 14th Street, New York, ordinary street furniture such as a telephone booth, fire hydrant and newsstand is doubled or transformed in AR.
works.description_zh: 在纽约第 14 街的 Art in Odd Places 活动中，电话亭、消防栓、报亭等普通街道设施在 AR 中被复制或变形。
works.idea_en: Treat overlooked street furniture as monuments.
works.idea_zh: 把被忽视的街道设施当作纪念碑来对待。
works.technique: Photogrammetric scans of the street objects are geolocated back at or near their original spots in a mobile AR app, likely with animated distortions.
works.technique_zh: 把这些街道物件的摄影测量扫描，在移动 AR 应用中定位回原处或附近，很可能附带动画变形。
works.exercise_en: Scan a boring campus object with photogrammetry and re-place it in AR next to the original, but giant, melting or multiplied. Twist: passers-by vote which version stays.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄影测量扫描一个无聊的校园物件，在 AR 中把它放回原物旁边，但变得巨大、融化或成倍复制。变体：路人投票决定留下哪个版本。

video.video_title: 14th & AR: Telephone Booth

works.title: 3D Video Capture With Three Kinects
works.description: Three calibrated Kinects capture a person in full 3D and merge them with virtual environments for immersive tele-collaboration.
works.idea_zh: 三台Kinect合成完整3D真人，放进虚拟环境里远程协作。

video.video_title: 3D Video Capture With Three Kinects

works.technique: Three Kinects are extrinsically calibrated to one coordinate frame (e.g. by a shared calibration target), and their point clouds are merged into a single 3D representation rendered in a VR environment.
works.exercise_zh: 用两部手机从不同角度拍同一人的深度数据（或用 Polycam 分别扫描），在 CloudCompare 或 three.js 中通过共同标记点手动对齐合并；变体：比较只用一个视角与两个视角时，观众感受到的“在场感”有何不同。
works.description_zh: 三台经过标定的 Kinect 对人进行完整的三维捕捉，并与虚拟环境融合，实现沉浸式远程协作。
works.idea_en: Three Kinects combine into a full 3D person placed in a virtual space for remote collaboration.
works.technique_zh: 对三台 Kinect 做外参标定，统一到同一坐标系（例如借助共享的标定板），把各自的点云合并成一个三维表示，在 VR 环境中渲染。
works.exercise_en: Capture depth data of the same person from two angles with two phones (or scan separately with Polycam), then align and merge them by hand in CloudCompare or three.js using shared reference points. Twist: compare how much "presence" viewers feel with one viewpoint versus two.

works.title: A Million Times at Changi
works.description: A monumental wall of 1,008 clocks in Singapore Changi Airport performs choreographed patterns and time displays for passing travellers.
works.description_zh: 新加坡樟宜机场一面由 1008 个时钟组成的巨墙，为往来旅客表演编排好的图案并显示时间。
works.idea_en: Scale turns a clock into architecture — the same grid logic works on a phone screen or a building-sized AR overlay.
works.idea_zh: 尺度能把时钟变成建筑——同样的阵列逻辑既适用于手机屏幕，也适用于建筑尺度的 AR 叠加。
works.technique: Over a thousand clock modules with two motors each are networked and driven by a central choreography engine.
works.technique_zh: 一千多个时钟模块、每个带两台电机，联网后由中央编舞引擎驱动。
works.exercise_en: Cover a building facade in phone AR with a huge grid of clocks that ripple when a person enters the frame. Twist: show each traveller's home time zone when they point the phone at themselves.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 在一栋建筑立面上覆盖一大片时钟阵列，有人进入画面时泛起涟漪。变体：当旅客把手机对准自己时，显示他家乡的时区时间。

video.video_title: Humans since 1982, A Million Times at Changi, 2014 - 2018

works.title: Augmented Hand Series
works.description: Visitors insert a hand into a box and see it transformed in real time on screen: extra or missing fingers, lengthened digits, wobbling knuckles and other uncanny variations.
works.idea_zh: 把手伸进盒子，屏幕里的手多长一根手指、手指变长——实时而诡异的“手的变形”。

video.video_title: Augmented Hand Series (Demonstration, 2014)

works.technique: A Leap Motion (or camera) tracks hand joints, and an image-warping mesh is deformed per joint to add, remove, or stretch fingers on the live hand video.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands 拿到 21 个关键点，在 p5.js 里对手部视频做网格变形，让手指变长或多出一根；变体：设计一只“会自己动”的手，让某根手指在你不动时悄悄乱跑。
works.description_zh: 观众把手伸进一个盒子，屏幕上随即实时显示被改造过的手：多出或少了手指、手指被拉长、指节晃动，还有其他令人不安的变化。
works.idea_en: Put your hand in a box and watch it on screen grow an extra finger or longer fingers, live and uncanny.
works.technique_zh: 用 Leap Motion（或摄像头）追踪手部关节，按关节对图像变形网格进行形变，在实时手部视频中增加、删除或拉长手指。
works.exercise_en: Get the 21 keypoints from MediaPipe Hands and apply mesh warping to the hand video in p5.js to lengthen fingers or add one more. Twist: design a hand that "moves on its own", with one finger quietly wandering off while you hold still.

salient.why_en: Your own hand grows an extra finger on screen, live, and it feels uncanny.
salient.why_zh: 屏幕上你自己的手实时多长出一根手指，让人感到怪异。

works.title: Augmented Menu
works.description: A virtual AR waiter with automatic gestures, facial expressions and lip-sync appears at the table to present the daily menu and talk with diners.
works.idea_zh: 一个虚拟服务员出现在餐桌上，为你介绍今日菜单。

video.video_title: Augmented Menu

works.technique: An avatar anchored on a table marker is animated procedurally with gesture, head-look and lip-sync generated from the audio input.
works.exercise_zh: 做一张 AR 菜单卡：扫一下出现一个会说话的 3D 角色介绍菜品（Reality Composer + TTS）；加一个变化：角色会看向离它最近的人。
works.description_zh: 一位虚拟 AR 服务员出现在餐桌上，带着自动生成的手势、面部表情和口型同步，为食客介绍今日菜单并与他们交谈。
works.idea_en: A virtual waiter appears on your table to walk you through today's menu.
works.technique_zh: 锚定在桌面标记上的虚拟角色通过程序化方式生成动画，手势、头部朝向和口型同步都由音频输入驱动。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR menu card that, when scanned, brings up a talking 3D character who introduces the dishes (Reality Composer + TTS). Twist: the character looks at whoever is closest to it.

works.title: Augmented Reality Street Art
works.description: Wheat-pasted street art by Zenka that, seen through an AR app, animates on the wall.
works.idea_zh: 街头贴画在手机里动起来。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Street Art

works.technique: The printed artwork is registered as an image target, and a video or animation layer is aligned to it so the static piece appears to move.
works.exercise_zh: 用 8th Wall 或 Lens Studio 把一张自己的海报设为图像目标，扫描后播放它的动画版本；变体：动画只在有人站在海报前时继续。
works.description_zh: Zenka 用浆糊张贴的街头艺术作品，透过 AR 应用观看时会在墙上动起来。
works.idea_en: Street paste-ups start moving inside your phone.
works.technique_zh: 把印刷好的作品注册为图像目标，再将视频或动画图层与之对齐，让静态作品看起来在动。
works.exercise_en: Set one of your own posters as an image target in 8th Wall or Lens Studio, so scanning it plays an animated version. Twist: the animation only keeps going while someone stands in front of the poster.

works.title: BLINK OF AN EYE
works.description: Even the smallest movement leaves time-delayed images on the wall: wandering video strips, shadows of your past movements or painted light collages.
works.description_zh: 即使最细微的动作也会在墙上留下延时的影像：游走的视频条带、你过去动作的影子，或是用光拼贴出的画面。
works.idea_en: See your recent past moving next to you.
works.idea_zh: 看见刚刚过去的你在身边移动。
works.technique: A camera feed is buffered in time and re-composited as slit-scan strips, delayed shadows and painted trails before being projected at wall scale.
works.technique_zh: 摄像画面被按时间缓存，再重新合成成狭缝扫描条带、延迟的影子和绘画般的轨迹，以整面墙的尺度投影出来。
works.exercise_en: Build a webcam slit-scan or delay mirror in p5.js where each column of pixels shows a different moment in the last five seconds. Twist: the delay grows the closer you stand to the screen.
works.exercise_zh: 在 p5.js 里做一面狭缝扫描或延迟镜子，让每一列像素显示过去五秒中的不同时刻；变体：离屏幕越近，延迟越长。

video.video_title: BLINK OF AN EYE

works.title: Bioluminescent Forest (Projections in the Forest)
works.description: After six weeks in a forest, the artists projected glowing veins, luminous plants and pulsing mushrooms onto real trees, moss and fungi at night. Filmed as a short film, the forest seems to breathe with its own bioluminescence.
works.description_zh: 两位艺术家在森林里待了六周，然后在夜里把发光的叶脉、植物和一明一灭的蘑菇投射到真实的树木、苔藓和菌类上。拍成短片后，整片森林仿佛靠自身的生物荧光在呼吸。
works.idea_en: Light only the details nature already has, like a leaf's veins or a mushroom cap, and the real world looks enchanted rather than covered; AR overlays work best the same way.
works.idea_zh: 只点亮自然本来就有的细节，比如叶脉或蘑菇的菌盖，真实世界就会显得被施了魔法而不是被覆盖；AR 叠加也最适合这样做。
works.technique: Each plant and mushroom was likely photographed from the projector's position, then animated in 2D/3D so the light follows its exact outline before being projected back at night.
works.technique_zh: 每株植物和蘑菇很可能先从投影机的位置拍下，再按照它的精确轮廓做 2D/3D 动画，夜里再投回原处。
works.exercise_en: Scan a houseplant or a shoe with a phone (Polycam or Reality Composer), then build an AR effect in Lens Studio or AR Foundation that makes only its edges and veins glow and pulse slowly. Twist: the glow spreads to the next object only when the phone gets very close, like touching it.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机（Polycam 或 Reality Composer）扫描一盆绿植或一只鞋，在 Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation 中做一个效果，只让它的边缘和纹理发光、缓慢脉动；变体：只有当手机贴得很近、像是触碰它时，光才会蔓延到旁边的下一个物体。

video.video_title: Projections in the Forest

works.title: Boids
works.description: A flock of simple shapes moves as one body, splitting and regrouping as it chases a moving target.
works.description_zh: 一群简单的形体像一个整体一样移动，追逐一个移动目标时分开又重新聚拢。
works.idea_en: Three local rules are enough to make a lifelike flock.
works.idea_zh: 只要三条局部规则，就能做出栩栩如生的群体运动。
works.technique: Classic Reynolds boids: each agent steers by separation, alignment and cohesion with its neighbours plus attraction to a target, computed in C# every frame.
works.technique_zh: 经典的 Reynolds boids 算法：每个个体根据与邻居的分离、对齐和聚合，再加上对目标的吸引来转向，每帧用 C# 计算。
works.exercise_en: Spawn a flock of paper birds in AR Foundation that follows the phone's position through the room. Twist: add AR planes as obstacles so the flock swerves around real tables and walls.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中生成一群纸鸟，让它们跟着手机在房间里移动；变体：把 AR 平面当成障碍物，让鸟群绕开真实的桌子和墙。

video.video_title: An experiment in flocking behavior

works.title: Breakdown
works.description: A dancer inhabits a projected two-dimensional world whose physical rules are constantly changed by an unseen entity; he adapts, argues with the forces and finally breaks the world's rules.
works.description_zh: 一位舞者生活在投影出的二维世界里，这个世界的物理规则被一个看不见的存在不断修改；他适应、与这些力量对抗，最终打破了世界的规则。
works.idea_en: Perform against a world whose physics keep changing.
works.idea_zh: 在一个物理规则不断改变的世界里表演。
works.technique: Two Kinect cameras capture the dancers' movements and gestures, which interact with a simulated physics world whose gravity and forces are rewritten live.
works.technique_zh: 两台 Kinect 捕捉舞者的动作和手势，与一个模拟物理世界交互，这个世界的重力和各种力被实时改写。
works.exercise_en: Project a Matter.js world onto a wall where a tracked body acts as a collider, and have a partner change gravity and friction live during a one-minute improvisation. Twist: let the dancer earn control of the physics by holding still.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个 Matter.js 物理世界投到墙上，让被追踪的身体充当碰撞体，同伴在一分钟即兴中实时修改重力和摩擦；变体：舞者只要保持静止就能夺回物理规则的控制权。

video.video_title: BREAKDOWN [Full Performance]

works.title: CLOUDS
works.description: An interactive generative documentary about code and culture: dozens of creative coders filmed as flickering depth-camera point clouds, surrounded by live visual systems, with a story engine choosing what comes next.
works.description_zh: 一部关于代码与文化的交互式生成纪录片：几十位创意编程者被拍成闪烁的深度点云，周围环绕着实时运行的视觉系统，由“故事引擎”决定接下来播放什么。
works.idea_en: Film people as data, so the documentary itself can be rearranged and explored like code.
works.idea_zh: 把人拍成数据，让纪录片本身也能像代码一样被重组和探索。
works.technique: Interviews were shot with RGBD (a Kinect mounted on a DSLR, calibrated with the open-source RGBDToolkit), and an openFrameworks story engine sequences clips and generative scenes.
works.technique_zh: 访谈用 RGBD 方式拍摄（Kinect 装在单反相机上，用开源的 RGBDToolkit 标定），openFrameworks 编写的故事引擎负责编排片段和生成式场景。
works.exercise_en: Record a classmate's 30-second answer with a LiDAR phone as a point cloud and place it in AR next to the question written in 3D. Twist: dissolve the point cloud when the answer ends.
works.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的手机把同学 30 秒的回答录成点云，在 AR 中把它放在以 3D 文字写出的问题旁边。变体：回答结束时让点云消散。

video.video_title: CLOUDS by Minard and George :: Supported by FRFAF (#2014-13)

works.title: Composition for a drone
works.description: A short music piece written for a quadcopter: as the AR.Drone flies into different areas of a room, its position generates musical sequences on top of the sound of its own engines.
works.description_zh: 为一架四旋翼无人机写的短曲：AR.Drone 飞进房间的不同区域时，它的位置在自身引擎声之上生成音乐片段。
works.idea_en: Make a flying robot into a musical instrument whose score is space.
works.idea_zh: 把一架会飞的机器人变成乐器，乐谱就是空间。
works.technique: A Kinect depth image processed in vvvv locates the drone inside defined bounding boxes and sends its position to Pure Data, which triggers musical patterns.
works.technique_zh: vvvv 处理 Kinect 深度图，在划定的边界框中定位无人机，并把位置发给 Pure Data 触发音乐片段。
works.exercise_en: Divide the room into four zones with tape, track a toy (or a person holding it) with a webcam, and trigger a different loop in each zone to compose a piece by flying or walking a path. Twist: record the path once and replay it as a score someone else must follow.
works.exercise_zh: 用胶带把房间分成四个区域，用网络摄像头追踪一个玩具（或拿着它的人），每个区域触发不同的循环，通过飞行或行走路线来作曲；变体：把路线录下来，作为乐谱让别人照着走一遍。

video.video_title: Composition for a drone

works.title: Contact
works.description: At Fondation Louis Vuitton a line of light on the floor becomes a horizon: mirrors, a moving shadow and darkness make it seem like visitors are walking on the edge of a planet.
works.description_zh: 在路易威登基金会，地上一道光线变成地平线：镜子、移动的阴影和黑暗，让观众像是走在一颗行星的边缘。
works.idea_en: A single horizon line plus a mirror is enough to create a world beyond the wall; AR portals can work with equally minimal cues.
works.idea_zh: 一道地平线加一面镜子，就足以在墙后造出一个世界；AR 传送门也可以用同样极简的线索。
works.technique: A low slit of light is doubled by floor-to-ceiling mirrors into an endless horizon, and a slowly rotating lamp casts visitors' shadows across it (likely).
works.technique_zh: 一道贴近地面的光缝被落地镜复制成无尽的地平线，一盏缓慢旋转的灯把观众的影子投在上面（可能如此）。
works.exercise_en: Draw a glowing horizon line across a real wall in AR, render a mirrored copy of the room beyond it, and let the students' tracked bodies cast virtual shadows along the line. Twist: slowly tilt the horizon so the room feels like it is rolling.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 里沿真实墙面画一道发光的地平线，线后渲染一个镜像的房间，让追踪到的同学身体沿线投下虚拟影子。变体：让地平线慢慢倾斜，房间仿佛在翻滚。

video.video_title: Olafur Eliasson, Contact, Fondation Louis Vuitton, Paris 2014 - 2015

works.title: Cut-out Fx
works.description: Objects appear and disappear by being eaten away along animated, noisy edges.
works.description_zh: 物体沿着不断变化的噪声边缘被“吃掉”，从而出现或消失。
works.idea_en: A shader-only dissolve that can reveal or hide anything.
works.idea_zh: 只用着色器实现的溶解效果，可以让任何东西显现或隐去。
works.technique: An alpha cut-out shader compares a noise texture against an animated threshold and discards fragments below it, giving shapes a ragged, moving boundary.
works.technique_zh: 透明度裁剪着色器把噪声纹理与一个随时间变化的阈值比较，丢弃低于阈值的片元，让形状出现参差、流动的边界。
works.exercise_en: Make virtual furniture in an AR Foundation scene dissolve in when it is first placed and dissolve out when the user deletes it. Twist: use a hand-drawn texture instead of noise so each student's object dissolves in their own handwriting.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 场景中，让虚拟家具在放下时溶解出现、被删除时溶解消失；变体：用手绘纹理代替噪声，让每个学生的物体按自己的笔迹溶解。

video.video_title: Cut-out Fx Test

works.title: Dark Matter
works.description: Three black geometric objects rotate slowly; from certain angles each one looks like a perfect square or circle, then collapses into an unfamiliar shape as it turns.
works.description_zh: 三个黑色几何体缓慢旋转；在某些角度，它们看起来是完美的正方形或圆形，转动后又变成陌生的形状。
works.idea_en: A 3D object has as many identities as viewpoints — AR designers can hide a message that only resolves from one angle.
works.idea_zh: 一个三维物体有多少视角就有多少身份——AR 设计者可以藏一个只在某个角度才成立的信息。
works.technique: The objects are designed so their silhouettes are simple primitives from particular directions; rotation sweeps the viewer through these silhouettes.
works.technique_zh: 这些物体被设计成从特定方向看轮廓是简单几何形；旋转让观众依次看到这些轮廓。
works.exercise_en: Model a shape in Blender whose silhouette is a circle from the front and a square from the side, then place it in AR so visitors discover both. Twist: add a third hidden silhouette that spells a letter.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Blender 中建一个正面轮廓是圆、侧面轮廓是方的形体，放进 AR 让观众自己发现两种样子。变体：再藏一个能拼出字母的第三种轮廓。

video.video_title: Troika ‘Dark Matter’ @ Art Basel Unlimited

works.title: Depth Player (Android Lens Blur)
works.description: A web player that pulls the hidden depth map out of photos taken with Android's Lens Blur camera mode and shows them as 3D reliefs you can orbit in the browser, such as a window seen from inside a room.
works.description_zh: 一个网页播放器，从用安卓“镜头模糊”模式拍的照片中提取隐藏的深度图，把照片变成可以在浏览器里环绕查看的 3D 浮雕，比如从房间里望出去的一扇窗。
works.idea_en: Every phone photo secretly holds a 3D scene; pull it out.
works.idea_zh: 每张手机照片里都藏着一个 3D 场景，把它拉出来。
works.technique: A JavaScript extractor reads the depth map stored in the Lens Blur JPEG's XMP metadata, and three.js displaces a mesh or point cloud by that depth.
works.technique_zh: 一个 JavaScript 提取器读取“镜头模糊”JPEG 的 XMP 元数据中保存的深度图，three.js 按深度把网格或点云推出立体感。
works.exercise_en: Take portrait-mode photos on a phone, extract the depth map (or estimate it with a depth model), and display each as a displaced mesh in three.js that tilts with the mouse or phone gyroscope. Twist: animate a slow 'breathing' of the depth.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机人像模式拍照，提取深度图（或用深度估计模型生成），在 three.js 中把每张照片显示成随鼠标或手机陀螺仪倾斜的位移网格。变体：让深度缓慢地“呼吸”起伏。

video.video_title: Demo of Depth Player

works.title: Depthcue
works.description: Objects fade into flat color as they move away, turning depth into a clean graphic gradient.
works.description_zh: 物体越远就越融入平涂的颜色，把深度变成一道干净的图形渐变。
works.idea_en: Use depth as a stylistic color ramp.
works.idea_zh: 把深度当作一种有风格的颜色渐变。
works.technique: An image effect reads the depth buffer and blends each pixel toward a gradient color according to its linear depth, a stylised form of depth cueing.
works.technique_zh: 图像效果读取深度缓冲，根据每个像素的线性深度把它混向一种渐变色，是一种风格化的深度提示。
works.exercise_en: Use the AR depth texture (LiDAR or ARCore Depth) to tint the real camera image by distance on a phone. Twist: invert it so that near objects vanish and only the far wall stays visible.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机上用 AR 深度纹理（LiDAR 或 ARCore Depth）按距离给真实相机画面着色；变体：反过来，让近处的物体消失，只留下远处的墙。

video.video_title: Depth Cue Test

works.title: Dhalsim: Real-Time Body Transformation
works.description: A Kinect captures a person as a live 3D point cloud and places them in a virtual checkerboard world, where their arm stretches several metres, like the Street Fighter character, to reach a distant ball or punch a second player across the space.
works.description_zh: Kinect 把人实时捕捉成三维点云放进一个棋盘格虚拟空间，他的手臂可以像《街头霸王》里的达尔锡一样伸长好几米，去够远处的球，或者隔空打到另一位玩家。
works.idea_en: Your own live body, but with arms that stretch across the room.
works.idea_zh: 还是你自己的实时身体，只是手臂能伸过整个房间。
works.technique: The depth camera's point cloud of the user is split by skeleton joints and the forearm segment is likely scaled along the arm direction in real time, so the stretched arm keeps the user's real appearance.
works.technique_zh: 深度相机拍到的用户点云按骨骼关节分段，前臂那一段很可能沿手臂方向被实时拉长，所以伸长的手臂仍保留用户真实的外观。
