works.exercise_en: Use webcam body tracking (MediaPipe Pose in p5.js) to draw the user's arm as a line that grows longer the faster they punch, and let it knock virtual objects off the screen. Twist: arms only stretch when two players point at each other.
works.exercise_zh: 用网页摄像头的人体追踪（p5.js 加 MediaPipe Pose）把用户的手臂画成一条线，出拳越快线就越长，并能把虚拟物体打出屏幕。变体：只有两名玩家互相指向对方时手臂才会伸长。

video.video_title: Dhalsim (2014)

salient.why_en: Your live body, but your arm stretches across the room to punch or grab.
salient.why_zh: 还是你自己的实时身体，只是手臂能伸过整个房间去出拳或抓东西。

works.title: Di-Octo
works.description: Two stacked stainless-steel spheres of spoon-like cups turn in opposite directions in the wind, producing a mesmerising interference pattern that seems to fold in on itself.
works.description_zh: 两个上下叠放、由勺状杯片组成的不锈钢球体在风中反向旋转，产生一种仿佛向内折叠的迷幻干涉图案。
works.idea_en: Counter-rotating layers create depth and moiré; AR designers can use layered opposite motions to make a virtual object feel volumetric and alive.
works.idea_zh: 反向旋转的层次产生纵深与摩尔纹；AR 设计者可以用相反运动的叠层，让虚拟物体显得立体而有生命。
works.technique: Precision-machined cups catch wind on nested rotating frames; because each frame spins at its own rate, the sculpture never repeats the same configuration.
works.technique_zh: 精密加工的杯片在嵌套的旋转框架上兜风，每个框架以各自的速度转动，雕塑永远不会重复同一姿态。
works.exercise_en: Build two nested rings of reflective cups in phone AR spinning in opposite directions at speeds driven by the phone's microphone wind noise. Twist: let the viewer's walking speed set the rotation.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中做两层嵌套的反光杯片环，以相反方向旋转，转速由麦克风收到的风噪决定。变体：用观众的步行速度决定转速。

video.video_title: Di-Octo

works.title: EPILOG
works.description: A 25-minute room of light, sound and haze at the Deutsches Hygiene-Museum's dance exhibition: a floor projection reacts to visitors' movements and, through the haze, their movement builds three-dimensional spaces of light.
works.description_zh: 德累斯顿德国卫生博物馆舞蹈展中一个长达 25 分钟的光、声与雾的房间：地面投影对观众的动作作出反应，借助烟雾，他们的动作搭建出一个个三维的光之空间。
works.idea_en: Move and the light around you turns into walls and tunnels.
works.idea_zh: 你一动，周围的光就变成墙和隧道。
works.technique: Tracking cameras follow visitors on the floor, vvvv generates patterns that respond to them, and projectors shining through haze turn the flat patterns into volumetric beams.
works.technique_zh: 追踪摄像头跟随地面上的观众，vvvv 生成对他们作出反应的图案，投影光穿过烟雾，把平面图案变成立体光束。
works.exercise_en: In a dark room with a hazer or a spray bottle of water mist, project a white circle that follows a tracked student from a ceiling projector. Twist: the circle shrinks around people who stand still.
works.exercise_zh: 在黑暗的房间里用烟雾机或水雾喷瓶制造雾气，从天花板投影一个跟随被追踪同学的白色光圈；变体：站着不动的人，光圈会慢慢收紧。

video.video_title: EPILOG (Excerpts)

works.title: Early Meta Headset Prototype Demo
works.description: Filmed through the lens of an early Meta headset prototype: the wearer grabs a floating Meta logo, pulls up a row of app icons, opens virtual monitors and browser windows in the living room and pokes a glowing sphere.
works.description_zh: 透过早期 Meta 头显原型的镜片拍摄：佩戴者抓起漂浮的 Meta 标志，调出一排应用图标，在客厅里打开虚拟显示器和浏览器窗口，还伸手去戳一个发光的球体。
works.idea_en: Replace the desk monitor with windows you can grab and place anywhere in your room.
works.idea_zh: 用可以抓取、摆在房间任意位置的窗口取代桌上的显示器。
works.technique: A see-through headset with a depth camera likely tracks the hand as a point cloud and uses simple grab gestures to move windows anchored in the room.
works.technique_zh: 带深度相机的透视头显很可能把手当作点云来追踪，通过简单的抓取手势移动锚定在房间里的窗口。
works.exercise_en: In WebXR passthrough, let users pinch to spawn a browser panel and throw it onto a wall where it sticks. Twist: panels nobody has looked at for a minute slowly fade and drift away.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 透视模式中，让用户捏合生成一个浏览器面板，并把它扔到墙上贴住。变体：一分钟没人看过的面板会慢慢变淡并飘走。

video.video_title: Meta Old Demo

works.title: Earth Wall
works.description: A wall of rammed earth built from the Presidio's soil encloses the branches of a eucalyptus tree, which reach out through the wall's surface.
works.description_zh: 一面用 Presidio 泥土夯筑的墙把一棵桉树的枝干包在其中，枝条从墙面伸出。
works.idea_en: An object half-inside a wall reads as something passing through a boundary, a classic AR occlusion effect in physical form.
works.idea_zh: 一个半截嵌在墙里的物体看起来像正在穿过边界，这是实体版的经典 AR 遮挡效果。
works.technique: Earth from the site is compacted in layers inside formwork around the branches so they appear to grow out of the finished wall.
works.technique_zh: 现场的泥土在围绕枝干的模板中分层夯实，拆模后枝干仿佛从墙中长出。
works.exercise_en: Use AR occlusion (ARKit people and scene occlusion) to make a virtual branch or creature appear to push out of a real wall. Twist: let it pull back in when touched.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR 遮挡（ARKit 人物与场景遮挡）让一根虚拟树枝或一只生物看起来正从真实墙面中钻出；变体：被触碰时它会缩回墙内。

video.video_title: Andy Goldsworthy's Earth Wall

works.title: Earthscapes
works.description: At low tide on Californian beaches, Amador rakes huge fractal and organic patterns into the wet sand in a few hours; the rising tide erases them.
works.description_zh: 在加州海滩退潮时，Amador 用几个小时在湿沙上耙出巨大的分形与有机图案；涨潮后它们便被抹去。
works.idea_en: Working inside a fixed window of time (between tides) is a design constraint that AR events can borrow.
works.idea_zh: 在固定的时间窗口（两次潮汐之间）内工作，是 AR 活动可以借用的设计约束。
works.technique: He shades areas by raking the top layer of wet sand, creating contrast between smooth and textured surfaces, following a rough plan.
works.technique_zh: 他依据粗略的规划，耙动湿沙表层来“着色”，在平滑与粗糙的表面之间制造对比。
works.exercise_en: Create an AR drawing tool that works only during a set daily window (for example, the next low tide from a tide API), and erases everything when it closes. Twist: draw with texture instead of colour.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个只在每天固定时间窗口内（例如根据潮汐 API 得到的下一次低潮）可用的 AR 绘画工具，窗口关闭时一切都会被抹去；变体：用纹理而不是颜色作画。

video.video_title: Andres Amador's Earthscapes: Art that Goes Out with the Tide | KQED Arts

works.title: East-West/West-East
works.description: Four steel plates, each over 14 metres tall, stand in a line more than a kilometre long across a valley in the Brouq Nature Reserve in Qatar; their tops are level while the ground dips beneath them.
works.description_zh: 四块各高 14 米以上的钢板在卡塔尔 Brouq 自然保护区的一处山谷中排成一条长逾一公里的直线；钢板顶部齐平，而下方地面起伏下沉。
works.idea_en: Level tops over uneven ground turn a desert into a measuring device, a strong idea for AR objects that reveal terrain by staying level.
works.idea_zh: 起伏地面上齐平的顶部，把沙漠变成一件测量工具，这是通过保持水平来揭示地形的 AR 物体的有力创意。
works.technique: Plates of different heights were set in a surveyed line so that their tops share one elevation across the dip in the terrain.
works.technique_zh: 高度不一的钢板沿测量好的直线放置，使它们的顶端跨越地形凹陷保持同一海拔。
works.exercise_en: Place four tall AR slabs in a line across a sloping field with their tops locked to the same world height, and walk the line from end to end. Twist: add a fifth slab that the user places by eye, then check how far off it is.
works.exercise_zh: 在倾斜的场地上把四块高大的 AR 板排成一线，顶部锁定在同一世界高度，从一端走到另一端；变体：让用户凭目测放置第五块板，再检查偏差有多大。

video.video_title: Doha Desert | Richard Serra | East West - West East Sculpture

works.title: Elastic Light
works.description: A series of simple puzzles made from laser lines in the air: visitors rotate, stretch and warp the beams with their hands to complete each shape.
works.description_zh: 一组由空中激光线构成的简单谜题：观众用手旋转、拉伸和弯曲光束来完成每个形状。
works.idea_en: A gesture interface made of pure light in mid-air.
works.idea_zh: 悬在半空、完全由光构成的手势界面。
works.technique: Laser vectors are drawn through haze by openFrameworks software, and depth-camera hand tracking maps gestures onto beam transformations.
works.technique_zh: openFrameworks 软件把激光矢量画进烟雾中，深度相机追踪手部，把手势映射成光束的变换。
works.exercise_en: Design three AR puzzles where a floating line must be rotated or stretched by hand tracking to match a target outline. Twist: the line resists like a rubber band and snaps back if you let go too early.
works.exercise_zh: 设计三个 AR 谜题：用手部追踪旋转或拉伸一条悬浮的线，使它与目标轮廓吻合。变体：线像橡皮筋一样有阻力，松手太早就弹回原状。

video.video_title: Elastic Light

works.title: Electricus
works.description: Visitors see their outline surrounded by crackling electrical energy on a large screen; the bigger they move, the more intense the electricity looks and sounds.
works.description_zh: 观众在大屏幕上看到自己的轮廓被噼啪作响的电流包围；动作越大，电流的画面和声音就越强烈。
works.idea_en: Your movement charges your own body with electricity on screen.
works.idea_zh: 你的动作让屏幕上的自己充满电流。
works.technique: Camera-based motion detection measures the amount of movement around each silhouette and scales a lightning-style effect and sound to it.
works.technique_zh: 基于摄像头的动作检测测量每个轮廓周围的运动量，并据此放大闪电般的效果和声音。
works.exercise_en: In TouchDesigner or p5.js, use frame differencing to measure motion and draw jagged lines from the silhouette edge whose length follows that motion. Twist: the electricity jumps between two people when they almost touch.
works.exercise_zh: 在 TouchDesigner 或 p5.js 中用帧差法测量运动量，从轮廓边缘画出锯齿线，线长随运动量变化；变体：两个人几乎碰到时，电流会在两人之间跳跃。

video.video_title: Electricus

works.title: Elegy: Explosion Event for the Opening of The Ninth Wave
works.description: Over the Huangpu River in Shanghai, daytime fireworks release waves of black, grey and white smoke, a mourning piece for the opening of the exhibition The Ninth Wave.
works.description_zh: 在上海黄浦江上空，日间烟花释放出一波波黑、灰、白色的烟雾，作为《九级浪》展览开幕的一场哀悼。
works.idea_en: An effect in the sky can carry grief instead of celebration; AR designers can use pace, colour and fading to set an emotional tone, not only to impress.
works.idea_zh: 天空中的效果也可以承载哀伤，而不只是庆祝；AR 设计者可以用节奏、颜色和消散来定下情绪基调，而不只是制造惊叹。
works.technique: Daytime smoke shells in monochrome tones are fired in slow, successive layers above the river so each wave drifts before the next one arrives.
works.technique_zh: 单色调的日间烟雾弹在江面上空缓慢、分层地依次发射，让每一波烟雾先飘散，下一波再到来。
works.exercise_en: Design a 90-second AR sky elegy over a real street or river: grey smoke layers appear one by one, each staying longer than the last, with no sound. Twist: let each viewer tap once to release a layer for someone they miss.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实的街道或河面上空设计一段 90 秒的 AR 天空挽歌：灰色烟层一层层出现，每一层停留得比前一层更久，全程无声。变体：让每位观众点击一次，为自己思念的人释放一层烟。

video.video_title: Cai Guo-Qiang 蔡国强 Chapter One of Elegy Fireworks

works.title: FLARE: Fast Layout for AR
works.description: AR applications declare rules (a game board on a table, a screen on a wall, menus within reach) and the system automatically lays out their content to fit whatever room it runs in.
works.description_zh: AR 应用声明规则（棋盘放在桌上、屏幕挂在墙上、菜单伸手可及），系统就会自动布局内容，以适配运行时所在的任何房间。
works.idea_en: Describe AR content with constraints about the room, not coordinates, so it adapts to any space.
works.idea_zh: 用关于房间的约束而不是坐标来描述 AR 内容，使它适应任何空间。
works.technique: A Kinect scan is segmented into planes, and a declarative constraint solver places application objects on suitable surfaces in real time.
works.technique_zh: 把 Kinect 扫描结果分割成平面，再由声明式约束求解器实时把应用对象放到合适的表面上。
works.exercise_en: Write three layout rules for an AR app (e.g. 'lamp on highest surface') and implement them with AR plane detection, then test in three different rooms. Twist: add a rule that breaks ties randomly.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个 AR 应用写三条布局规则（例如“台灯放在最高的表面上”），用 AR 平面检测实现，并在三个不同房间测试。变体：加一条随机打破平局的规则。

video.video_title: FLARE  Fast Layout for Augmented Reality Applications 720p

works.title: FUJI
works.description: A 14-minute installation where projection over a large drawing of Mount Fuji creates shifting light, weather and geometric illusions.
works.idea_zh: 投影在富士山素描上营造光影与天气

video.video_title: FUJI (不死)

works.technique: Projection over a large pencil drawing uses precisely registered light to add clouds, sunrise and geometric overlays, with the drawing serving as a static luminance base.
works.exercise_zh: 画一幅简单的铅笔风景，在投影中模拟一天中光线、云影和天气的变化；变体：让天气变化由当天真实的天气 API 数据驱动。
works.description_zh: 一件时长 14 分钟的装置，投影覆盖在一幅巨大的富士山素描上，营造出变幻的光影、天气和几何错觉。
works.idea_en: Projection brings light and weather to a pencil drawing of Mount Fuji.
works.technique_zh: 在一幅大尺寸铅笔画上投影，用精确对位的光添加云层、日出和几何叠加效果，画作本身则作为静态的亮度底图。
works.exercise_en: Draw a simple pencil landscape and use projection to simulate how light, cloud shadows and weather change over a day. Twist: drive the weather changes with real data from that day's weather API.

works.title: Fisheye Vision
works.description: A modified Oculus Rift with a fisheye camera gives the wearer about 180 degrees of vision while keeping the center undistorted, plus a 'Matrix mode' that shows the world in green code.
works.description_zh: 改装的 Oculus Rift 配上鱼眼摄像头，让佩戴者拥有约 180 度的视野，同时中央区域不变形；还有一个把世界显示成绿色代码的“Matrix 模式”。
works.idea_en: Give people a wider-than-human field of view and let them keep a normal center.
works.idea_zh: 给人超过人类极限的视野，同时保留正常的中央视觉。
works.technique: Warps a fisheye video feed so the central region keeps natural magnification while the periphery is compressed into the display edges of a video see-through Rift.
works.technique_zh: 对鱼眼视频做变形：中央区域保持自然放大率，周边被压缩到视频透视 Rift 的显示边缘。
works.exercise_en: Clip a cheap fisheye lens onto a phone in a cardboard viewer and play catch or navigate a hallway for five minutes. Twist: compress only the left and right edges and test whether people notice someone approaching from the side sooner.
works.exercise_zh: 把廉价鱼眼镜头夹在放进纸盒眼镜的手机上，玩五分钟接球或走走廊；变体：只压缩左右边缘，测试大家能否更早发现从侧面走来的人。

video.video_title: UIST Fisheye Vision ARrift (Augmented Reality Oculus Rift)

works.title: FlyAR
works.description: A drone operator plans and watches a flight path on a tablet held up to the sky: planned waypoints and the live drone position appear directly over the real landscape and buildings.
works.description_zh: 无人机操作员把平板举向天空规划和监控航线：计划的航点和无人机的实时位置直接叠加在真实的地形和建筑上。
works.idea_en: Plan where a drone will fly by drawing in the actual sky, not on a 2D map.
works.idea_zh: 在真实的天空中画出无人机的航线，而不是在二维地图上。
works.technique: Registers the planned flight path and live telemetry of a micro aerial vehicle to the environment using GPS/INS plus a 3D model, rendered with depth cues on a handheld AR device.
works.technique_zh: 借助 GPS/惯导和三维模型，把微型飞行器的计划航线和实时遥测配准到环境中，并在手持 AR 设备上以深度线索渲染。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone AR app to place a chain of floating waypoints around the schoolyard, then have a classmate walk the path as the 'drone' while you check for collisions. Twist: add a no-fly zone that turns red when crossed.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 在校园里放一串悬浮航点，让同学扮演“无人机”沿路线行走，你来检查是否会撞上东西；变体：加一个禁飞区，被穿越时变红。

video.video_title: FlyAR: Augmented Reality Supported Micro Aerial Vehicle Navigation

works.title: Foresta Lumina
works.description: An illuminated night walk through a forest in Coaticook, Quebec, with projection, light and sound that tell a story along the trail.
works.idea_zh: 夜晚森林步道上的光影叙事

video.video_title: Foresta Lumina | An Enchanted Night Walk From Park to Illuminated Forest

works.technique: A network of projectors, lights and speakers distributed along a trail is triggered in sequence (likely show control with sensors), so a narrative unfolds as visitors walk.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园一段夜间小路上设置三个“光影节点”（手机投影、灯带、蓝牙音箱），串成一个完整的小故事；变体：让某个节点只有在观众安静时才触发。
works.description_zh: 在魁北克科阿蒂库克（Coaticook）的一片森林里，一段被点亮的夜游步道，投影、灯光和声音沿途讲述一个故事。
works.idea_en: A story told in light along a forest trail at night.
works.technique_zh: 沿步道分布的投影仪、灯光和扬声器网络依次触发（大概率借助传感器和演出控制系统），故事随观众的脚步逐步展开。
works.exercise_en: Set up three "light nodes" (a phone projector, an LED strip, a Bluetooth speaker) along a campus path at night and link them into one complete short story. Twist: one node only triggers when the audience is quiet.

works.title: Fragments
works.description: Shards, splinters and fragments tumble through space as particles, showing a mesh set designed for particle effects.
works.description_zh: 碎片、裂片和残块作为粒子在空中翻滚，展示一套专为粒子特效设计的模型。
works.idea_en: Better particle effects come from interesting shapes, not just from more particles.
works.idea_zh: 好的粒子效果来自有趣的形状，而不只是更多的粒子。
works.technique: A public-domain library of low-poly fragment meshes is used as mesh particles in Unity's Shuriken particle system, with lighting and rotation giving each shard a solid look.
works.technique_zh: 一套公有领域的低多边形碎片模型被用作 Unity Shuriken 粒子系统中的网格粒子，光照和旋转让每块碎片都显得有实体感。
works.exercise_en: Use custom shard meshes with VFX Graph mesh output to make a real window or mirror appear to shatter in AR. Twist: gather the shards back into place when the viewer claps.
works.exercise_zh: 用自定义碎片网格配合 VFX Graph 的网格输出，让 AR 中一扇真实的窗户或镜子看起来碎裂；变体：观众拍手时碎片重新飞回原位。

video.video_title: Fragments - A collection of 3D models for particle effects

works.title: GlitchFx
works.description: The whole image breaks into blocks, color shifts and tearing, like a corrupted digital video signal.
works.description_zh: 整个画面碎成色块、颜色错位和撕裂，像一段损坏的数字视频信号。
works.idea_en: Use controlled digital corruption as an aesthetic.
works.idea_zh: 把可控的数字损坏当作一种美学。
works.technique: A post-processing shader offsets blocks of the screen using a random noise texture that is refreshed at irregular intervals and splits the color channels; it is the precursor of KinoGlitch.
works.technique_zh: 一个后期着色器用不规则刷新的随机噪声纹理错位屏幕上的方块，并拆分颜色通道；它是 KinoGlitch 的前身。
works.exercise_en: Apply a block-glitch post effect to the AR camera image only inside the silhouette of a virtual object. Twist: make the glitch stronger the faster the phone moves.
works.exercise_zh: 只在虚拟物体的轮廓范围内对 AR 相机画面加上方块故障后期效果；变体：手机移动得越快，故障越强。

video.video_title: GlitchFx - Digital Glitch VFX for Unity

works.title: Golden Mirror Carousel
works.description: A gleaming gold carousel with mirrored panels turns very slowly; riders on swinging seats see themselves and the gallery fragmented and revolving in the reflections.
works.description_zh: 一座金光闪闪、镶着镜面板的旋转木马缓慢转动；坐在摇摆座椅上的人在反射中看到自己和展厅被切碎、不停旋转。
works.idea_en: Slowing a familiar ride down turns fun into contemplation: in AR, changing only the speed of a known motion can make viewers notice their own body and surroundings.
works.idea_zh: 把熟悉的游乐设施放慢，娱乐就变成了沉思：在 AR 中，只改变一个熟悉动作的速度，就能让观众注意到自己的身体和周围环境。
works.technique: A working carousel is clad in golden mirror panels and runs at a fraction of normal speed, so reflections become a slowly shifting kaleidoscope.
works.technique_zh: 一座可运转的旋转木马被包上金色镜面板，以远低于正常的速度运转，让反射变成缓慢变化的万花筒。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a slowly rotating ring of virtual mirror panels around a person in AR, each showing a delayed camera feed. Twist: tie rotation speed to the rider's breathing measured by phone motion.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中围绕一个人锚定一圈缓慢旋转的虚拟镜面板，每块板显示一段延迟的摄像头画面。变体：用手机运动测出的呼吸节奏控制旋转速度。

video.video_title: Carsten Höller: Golden Mirror Carousel Installation

works.title: Golem
works.description: A satire about technology in which a clay servant, the Golem, gradually takes over its owner's life; the actors perform inside animated cityscapes, clay characters and advertisements.
works.description_zh: 一部关于科技的讽刺剧：一个黏土仆人 Golem 逐渐接管主人的生活；演员在动画城市、黏土角色和广告中表演。
works.idea_en: A projected assistant that slowly takes control is a sharp warning for AR assistants; the form carries the critique.
works.idea_zh: 一个逐渐掌控一切的投影助手，是对 AR 助手的尖锐提醒；作品的形式本身就承载着批判。
works.technique: Hand-made clay animation and drawings are composited and projected on screens, with performers timed to them and live music on stage.
works.technique_zh: 手工黏土动画和手绘被合成后投在屏幕上，演员与画面对时，舞台上有现场音乐。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR assistant character that follows a user around the room and gradually covers more of their view with suggestions. Twist: the user must find a gesture that makes it shrink back.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个在房间里跟着用户走的 AR 助手角色，它会逐渐用建议挡住越来越多的视野；变体：用户必须找到一个能让它缩回去的手势。

video.video_title: 1927 Golem - Tour Trailer (2017)

works.title: Gun Country
works.description: Suspended pieces float in a loose cloud; from one angle they form the silhouette of a gun, and walking around it the image falls apart into the shape of the United States and back.
works.description_zh: 悬挂的碎片松散地漂浮成一团；从某个角度看，它们组成一把枪的剪影，绕着走一圈，图像散开并变成美国地图的轮廓，再变回来。
works.idea_en: One set of points can hold two readings from two viewpoints: AR artworks can hide a second, opposing message that appears only when the visitor walks to the other side.
works.idea_zh: 同一组点可以从两个视点读出两种含义：AR 作品可以藏起第二个相反的信息，只有观众走到另一侧才会出现。
works.technique: Objects are likely positioned by solving for two target silhouettes from two eye points, so each hanging element sits where both lines of sight are satisfied.
works.technique_zh: 物体的位置很可能是针对两个视点、两个目标剪影求解出来的，每个悬挂元素都落在同时满足两条视线的位置上。
works.exercise_en: Place AR cubes so that from the front they spell one word and from the side another; compute positions from two orthogonal pixel grids. Twist: pick two words that argue with each other.
works.exercise_zh: 放置一组 AR 方块，让它们从正面拼出一个词，从侧面拼出另一个词；用两个正交的像素网格计算位置。变体：选两个互相“争辩”的词。

video.video_title: Gun Country (NEW)

works.title: Hedgehog Labeling
works.description: Markus Tatzgern, Denis Kalkofen, Raphael Grasset and Dieter Schmalstieg arrange external AR labels in 3D like hedgehog spines so they stay readable and stable as you move.
works.idea_zh: 让AR标签像刺猬的刺一样在3D中排布，移动视角也不打架。

video.video_title: Hedgehog labeling: View management techniques for external labels in 3D space

works.technique: Labels are placed along 3D poles radiating from their anchors and their positions are optimized in 3D space (not per frame in screen space), which reduces overlap and avoids label jumping as the viewpoint changes.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中为一个物体（如自行车模型）的 10 个部件加标签，分别实现“屏幕空间避让”和“固定 3D 刺猬式放射”两种布局，绕物体走一圈比较稳定性；变体：让标签数量随用户距离自动增减。
works.description_zh: Markus Tatzgern、Denis Kalkofen、Raphael Grasset 和 Dieter Schmalstieg 把外部 AR 标签在三维空间中像刺猬的刺一样排布，让人在移动时标签依然清晰易读、位置稳定。
works.idea_en: Arrange AR labels in 3D like hedgehog spines so they don't collide when you change viewpoint.
works.technique_zh: 标签沿着从锚点向外放射的三维支杆放置，并在三维空间中（而不是逐帧在屏幕空间中）优化其位置，从而减少重叠，避免视角变化时标签跳动。
works.exercise_en: Label 10 parts of an object (such as a bicycle model) in AR, implement both a "screen-space avoidance" layout and a "fixed 3D hedgehog" radial layout, and walk around the object to compare their stability. Twist: make the number of labels grow or shrink with the user's distance.

works.title: Heliopolis
works.description: A dance-media performance-installation about a fictional city, where a light sculpture hovers like an obelisk and the dancing citizens are continuously 'scanned' and tracked, leaving trails of their presence as they interact with the city's sounds.
works.description_zh: 一部关于虚构城市的舞蹈媒体表演装置：灯光雕塑像方尖碑一样悬浮，起舞的“市民”被不断“扫描”和追踪，在与城市声音互动时留下存在的痕迹。
works.idea_en: A city that records every citizen's path as a visible trace.
works.idea_zh: 一座把每位市民的路径都记录成可见痕迹的城市。
works.technique: Motion tracking of the dancers drives projected traces and sound triggers, combined with a video screen that follows a person's day in the city.
works.technique_zh: 对舞者的动作追踪驱动投影痕迹和声音触发，并配合一块屏幕播放一个人在城市里的一天。
works.exercise_en: Track students walking across a projected floor map with an overhead webcam and leave a fading line behind each of them, then play a short sound when two paths cross. Twist: make the trails permanent and show the 'surveillance map' at the end.
works.exercise_zh: 用俯拍网络摄像头追踪在投影地图上走动的学生，在每人身后留下渐隐的线，两条路径相交时播放一段短声；变体：让轨迹永久保留，最后展示这张“监控地图”。

video.video_title: HELIOPOLIS (excerpts)

works.title: HexBokeh
works.description: Out-of-focus highlights bloom into hexagonal shapes, like the bokeh of a real camera lens.
works.description_zh: 失焦的高光绽放成六边形，就像真实相机镜头的焦外光斑。
works.idea_en: Bring the character of a physical lens aperture into real-time graphics.
works.idea_zh: 把实体镜头光圈的特征带进实时图形。
works.technique: A depth-of-field image effect uses three skewed separable blur passes (McIntosh's technique) to build hexagonal bokeh from the depth buffer at low cost.
works.technique_zh: 景深图像效果按照 McIntosh 的方法，用三次倾斜的可分离模糊，从深度缓冲中低成本地得到六边形焦外光斑。
works.exercise_en: Add a shallow depth-of-field effect with custom-shaped bokeh to an AR scene so virtual objects appear photographed with a real lens. Twist: let students design their own aperture shape, such as a star or heart.
works.exercise_zh: 给 AR 场景加上浅景深和自定义形状的焦外光斑，让虚拟物体看起来像用真实镜头拍摄；变体：让学生设计自己的光圈形状，比如星形或心形。

video.video_title: HexBokeh - depth of field with hexagonal apertures

works.title: HippopoThames
works.description: For the Totally Thames festival in London, a 21-metre wooden hippo floated in the Thames at Nine Elms, rising from the water as if wading through the river.
works.description_zh: 为伦敦 Totally Thames 艺术节，一只长 21 米的木制河马漂浮在九榆树附近的泰晤士河中，仿佛正从水里涉水而过。
works.idea_en: An animal half-submerged reads as alive and moving through the real river, a good use of the water line as an AR occlusion boundary.
works.idea_zh: 一只半身没在水中的动物看起来像活着、正在河中穿行，这是把水线当作 AR 遮挡边界的好用法。
works.technique: A timber-clad frame shaped like the upper half of a hippo was built on a floating barge.
works.technique_zh: 在浮动驳船上搭建一个以木板包覆、形似河马上半身的框架。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR animal in a real river or pond so that only the top half shows above the waterline, using a water-plane occluder. Twist: it slowly swims upstream against the current.
works.exercise_zh: 用水面遮挡体，在真实的河或池塘中放一只 AR 动物，只露出水线以上的上半身；变体：它会逆流缓缓向上游游去。

video.video_title: HippopoThames by Florentijn Hofman

works.title: HoloFire (57fire)
works.description: A thermal camera watches a touch pad; the warmer your touch, the higher a fire burns inside a Pepper's-ghost holographic display.
works.description_zh: 热像仪对准一块触摸板：你的触摸越温暖，佩珀尔幻象全息展示柜里的火焰就烧得越高。
works.idea_en: Power a virtual fire with the real heat of your hand.
works.idea_zh: 用手真实的热量点燃一团虚拟火焰。
works.technique: A thermal camera measures the heat footprint left on a surface and maps its intensity to the height of a flame animation reflected in a Pepper's-ghost pyramid.
works.technique_zh: 热像仪测量手在表面留下的热量印记，把强度映射为火焰动画的高度，并通过佩珀尔幻象金字塔反射显示。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone Pepper's-ghost pyramid from clear plastic and drive a flame animation from microphone loudness (blowing on it). Twist: blowing harder should put the fire out.
works.exercise_zh: 用透明塑料做一个手机佩珀尔幻象金字塔，用麦克风音量（对着它吹气）驱动火焰动画。变体：吹得更用力时火应该被吹灭。

video.video_title: HoloFire (57fire): Creating Live Fire Illusion in Holographic Display Using Thermal Power of Touch

works.title: Houston Penetrable
works.description: Some 24,000 hanging PVC tubes fill a hall; parts of them are painted yellow so that from a distance a floating ellipsoid appears, and it dissolves into rain-like strands once visitors walk inside.
works.description_zh: 约 2.4 万根悬挂的 PVC 管充满大厅；部分管子被涂成黄色，远看是一个悬浮的椭球体，走进去后它就散成雨丝般的线条。
works.idea_en: A volume that is solid from afar and dissolves when you enter it: AR can hide shapes in point grids that only resolve from certain distances or angles.
works.idea_zh: 远看是实体、走进去就消散的体积：AR 可以把形状藏在点阵里，只在特定距离或角度才显现。
works.technique: The hidden shape is painted segment by segment onto thousands of vertical tubes, so the ellipsoid reads as a volume only when the tubes are seen together from outside.
works.technique_zh: 隐藏的形状被分段画在成千上万根垂直管子上，只有从外面把它们作为整体看时，椭球体才显现为一个体积。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR or AR Foundation scene of a few thousand thin vertical lines anchored in a room, colouring the segments that fall inside a virtual sphere so the sphere appears from afar and disappears as the user walks in. Twist: make the lines sway and chime when the phone passes through them.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 AR Foundation 在房间里锚定几千根细竖线，把落在一个虚拟球体内的线段上色，让球体远看出现、走进去消失。变体：手机穿过这些线时，让它们摇晃并发出叮当声。

video.video_title: Soto: The Houston Penetrable

works.title: Icare (Icarus)
works.description: The myth of Icarus, the boy who flew too close to the sun, is told with dancers, aerial movement and projections that fill the space around them, so the performers appear to soar through clouds and light.
works.description_zh: 伊卡洛斯飞得离太阳太近的神话，通过舞者、空中动作和布满周围空间的投影来讲述，让表演者仿佛在云和光中翱翔。
works.idea_en: Flight is easy to fake when the surroundings move instead of the body; AR can make people feel they fly by moving the world around them.
works.idea_zh: 只要让周围动起来，而不是身体动，飞翔就很容易被模拟；AR 可以通过移动周围世界让人觉得自己在飞。
works.technique: Projected environments on transparent screens in front of and behind performers, combined with suspension rigs, likely create the layered flying effect.
works.technique_zh: 在表演者前后的透明幕上投射环境，并结合吊挂装置，很可能由此营造出层层叠叠的飞行效果。
works.exercise_en: Make a WebXR scene where clouds rush past the user when they spread their arms (tracked by the phone's front camera or a headset controller). Twist: the higher the arms go, the brighter and hotter the scene becomes, until the wings melt.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 WebXR 场景：当用户张开双臂（用手机前置摄像头或头显手柄追踪）时，云朵从身边疾驰而过；变体：手臂举得越高，场景越亮越热，直到翅膀融化。

video.video_title: Lemieux Pilon 4D Art - Icare | Icarus (2014)

works.title: Ice Watch
works.description: With geologist Minik Rosing, Eliasson placed twelve blocks of free-floating Greenland ice in a clock formation on public squares (Copenhagen, Paris during COP21, London) and let them melt while people touched them.
works.description_zh: Eliasson 与地质学家 Minik Rosing 合作，把十二块从格陵兰海面打捞的浮冰摆成钟面，放在哥本哈根、巴黎（COP21 期间）和伦敦的广场上，任其在人们触摸中融化。
works.idea_en: Touching melting ice makes climate data physical and felt, a lesson for data AR: let people feel the number in their hands.
works.idea_zh: 触摸正在融化的冰让气候数据变得可触可感，这是数据 AR 的一课：让人把数字握在手里。
works.technique: Ice that had calved from the Greenland ice sheet was harvested from a fjord, shipped in refrigerated containers and arranged like a clock face.
works.technique_zh: 从格陵兰冰盖崩解入峡湾的冰被打捞，用冷藏集装箱运输，再摆成钟面形状。
works.exercise_en: Place twelve AR ice blocks in a clock ring on a plaza and melt them in real time according to the day's temperature. Twist: each block shows how much of Greenland's ice is lost in the second it takes to walk around the ring.
works.exercise_zh: 在广场上把十二块 AR 冰块摆成钟面，并按当天气温实时融化；变体：每块冰显示走完一圈所需的时间里格陵兰失去了多少冰。

video.video_title: Encounters with Ice Watch, Place du Panthéon, Paris 2015

salient.why_en: Blocks of Greenland ice melt in a city square, so people can touch climate change with their hands.
salient.why_zh: 格陵兰的冰块在城市广场上融化，人们可以用手摸到气候变化。

works.title: If The Walls Had Eyes
works.description: A wall of projected video eyes turns to watch each visitor who walks past, following them along the gallery.
works.description_zh: 一面投影着许多视频眼睛的墙，会转过来盯着每位走过的观众，一路跟随。
works.idea_en: The digital eyes that watch us online become real eyes on the wall.
works.idea_zh: 网络上注视我们的数字眼睛，变成墙上真实的眼睛。
works.technique: A camera tracks passers-by and the software likely picks, for each projected eye, the video frame whose gaze direction points at the tracked person.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪路人，软件很可能为每只投影眼睛挑选视线方向正对被追踪者的视频帧。
works.exercise_en: Film an eye looking in nine directions and build a webcam piece that shows the frame looking at wherever the viewer stands. Twist: the eyes blink when the viewer takes out their phone.
works.exercise_zh: 拍一只眼睛看向九个方向的视频，做一个摄像头作品，显示正看向观众所在位置的那一帧。变体：观众掏出手机时，眼睛会眨一下。

video.video_title: If The Walls Had Eyes

works.title: Intrude
works.description: Giant white inflatable rabbits, up to seven metres tall and lit from within, sit in public squares and parks around the world; the video shows them at Townsville's Ephemera festival.
works.description_zh: 高达七米、内部发光的巨型白色充气兔子坐落在世界各地的广场和公园中；视频展示的是它们在汤斯维尔 Ephemera 艺术节上的样子。
works.idea_en: Cute, glowing giants in a city at night are the simplest crowd-pleasing AR scene, and here they carry an ecological message.
works.idea_zh: 城市夜晚中可爱发光的巨型动物是最简单、最讨人喜欢的 AR 场景，而在这里它们还承载着生态信息。
works.technique: Nylon inflatables with internal lights are anchored in public spaces and inflated with fans.
works.technique_zh: 内置灯光的尼龙充气体固定在公共空间中，用风扇充气。
works.exercise_en: Place a group of glowing AR animals in a dark courtyard and give them a short message about a local invasive species. Twist: the animals multiply every hour, like the species itself.
works.exercise_zh: 在黑暗的庭院里放一群发光的 AR 动物，并为它们配上一段关于本地入侵物种的短信息；变体：动物每小时繁殖一次，就像那个物种本身。

video.video_title: Intrude by Amanda Parer - Ephemera 2021

works.title: JackIn Eye
works.description: A remote viewer 'jacks into' a walking person's head-mounted camera; the system stitches past frames into an out-of-body third-person view so the viewer can look around beyond the wearer's gaze.
works.idea_zh: 远程的人“钻进”别人的第一人称视角，还能跳出身体从背后看他。

video.video_title: JackIn: Integrating First-Person View with Out-of-Body Vision Generation for Human-Human Augmentation (AH2014)

works.technique: Uses SLAM on the first-person video to register frames into a growing 3D panorama, then renders a virtual camera placed behind and above the wearer.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机直播一个同学的第一人称视角给另一位戴Cardboard的同学看，由观看者口头指挥他完成找物任务；变化：观看者只能看到5秒前的延迟画面。
works.description_zh: 远程观众“接入”一位行走者的头戴摄像头；系统把过去的画面拼接成一个“灵魂出窍”式的第三人称视角，让观众能看到佩戴者视线之外的四周。
works.idea_en: A remote person slips into someone's first-person view and can even step out of the body to watch from behind.
works.technique_zh: 对第一人称视频做 SLAM，把各帧配准进一幅不断扩展的三维全景，再从放在佩戴者后上方的虚拟相机进行渲染。
works.exercise_en: Livestream one classmate's first-person view from a phone to another classmate wearing Cardboard, who gives spoken directions to complete a find-the-object task. Twist: the viewer can only see a feed delayed by 5 seconds.

works.title: Jeu de modes
works.description: An interactive dance trio by Andreas Bergsland and Robert Wechsler exploring gesture from tiny finger movements to explosive swipes, each heard as a different kind of sound.
works.description_zh: Andreas Bergsland 与 Robert Wechsler 创作的互动舞蹈三人舞，探索从细微手指动作到爆发性挥臂的各种手势，每一种都被听成不同类型的声音。
works.idea_en: Map the scale of a gesture, small, conversational or explosive, to a mode of listening.
works.idea_zh: 把手势的尺度——细小、交谈式或爆发式——映射为不同的聆听方式。
works.technique: Camera motion tracking separates movement into size and energy ranges, and each range drives a different acousmatic sound behaviour inspired by Francois Bayle's categories such as rub, pull and push.
works.technique_zh: 摄像追踪把动作按大小和能量分档，每一档驱动一种不同的声学行为，灵感来自 Francois Bayle 的“摩擦、拉、推”等分类。
works.exercise_en: Track a performer's hand speed with MediaPipe and define three bands (tiny, medium, large), each with its own sound palette; perform a one-minute phrase that crosses all three. Twist: let two dancers share the tracker so the sound switches mode when they touch.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 追踪表演者的手速，划分“极小、中等、大”三档，每档对应一组声音；表演一段跨越三档的一分钟动作；变体：让两位舞者共用追踪器，他们一接触，声音就切换模式。

video.video_title: Jeu de modes (long) - 2014

works.title: Kvant Deformer
works.description: A smooth mesh bulges, twists and ripples under flowing noise, an early test of Keijiro's GPU effects library Kvant.
works.description_zh: 一个光滑的网格在流动的噪声下鼓起、扭转、起伏，这是 Keijiro 的 GPU 特效库 Kvant 的早期测试。
works.idea_en: Let noise sculpt a surface continuously on the GPU.
works.idea_zh: 让噪声在 GPU 上持续地雕刻一个表面。
works.technique: A vertex shader displaces each vertex along its normal by animated 3D noise, and normals are recalculated so lighting follows the deformation.
works.technique_zh: 顶点着色器沿法线方向用动画的 3D 噪声推动每个顶点，并重新计算法线，让光照跟随形变。
works.exercise_en: Deform a virtual blob placed on a table in AR with a noise vertex shader in Shader Graph. Twist: tie the noise strength to the microphone volume so the blob reacts when people talk.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Shader Graph 里用噪声顶点着色器让放在 AR 桌面上的虚拟团块变形；变体：把噪声强度绑定到麦克风音量，有人说话时团块就会反应。

video.video_title: Kvant Deformer Test

works.title: Leviathan Mixed Reality Props
works.description: In a VR story set in the Leviathan world, a real chair recreated with photogrammetry and a tracked book let participants physically touch the virtual scene while embodied as a floating jellyfish.
works.description_zh: 在一个以《Leviathan》世界为背景的 VR 故事里，一把用摄影测量重建的真实椅子和一本被追踪的书，让参与者在化身为漂浮水母的同时，能亲手触摸虚拟场景。
works.idea_en: Touch the virtual world through real furniture.
works.idea_zh: 通过真实的家具触摸虚拟世界。
works.technique: Photogrammetry scans of physical props are placed in Unity at the exact positions reported by a motion-capture system, so what users see and touch line up.
works.technique_zh: 实体道具的摄影测量扫描模型被放进 Unity，位置与动作捕捉系统报告的实际位置完全一致，因此用户看到的和摸到的对得上。
works.exercise_en: Scan a classroom chair with a phone photogrammetry app, place the model at the real chair's position in a Quest or WebXR scene, and have classmates sit on it blind. Twist: turn the chair into a different creature each time someone sits.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机摄影测量应用扫描一把教室椅子，在 Quest 或 WebXR 场景中把模型放到真实椅子的位置，让同学戴着头显坐上去；变体：每次有人坐下，椅子就变成另一种生物。

video.video_title: Mixed Reality Props

works.title: Leviathan at Intel CES 2014 Keynote
works.description: During Intel's CES 2014 keynote, a giant steampunk flying whale from Scott Westerfeld's Leviathan leaves the screen and swims above an audience of 2,500 people, visible on the big screens and a handheld tablet.
works.description_zh: 在 Intel 的 CES 2014 主题演讲上，一头来自 Scott Westerfeld 小说《Leviathan》的巨型蒸汽朋克飞鲸离开屏幕，在 2,500 名观众头顶游过，观众可以在大屏幕和一台手持平板上看到它。
works.idea_en: Fly a virtual whale over a live audience.
works.idea_zh: 让一头虚拟鲸鱼飞过现场观众头顶。
works.technique: Cameras and a tracked tablet in the hall are registered to the auditorium, and the animated whale is composited live from several points of view onto the stage screens.
works.technique_zh: 场馆内的摄像机和被追踪的平板与礼堂空间对齐，动画鲸鱼从多个视角实时合成到舞台屏幕上。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a large animated creature above the classroom in AR (8th Wall, Lens Studio or AR Foundation) and mirror one phone's view to the projector so everyone watches it pass overhead. Twist: the creature reacts when the class claps.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR（8th Wall、Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation）在教室上空放一只巨大的动画生物，把一部手机的画面投到投影仪上，让全班一起看它从头顶飞过；变体：全班鼓掌时，生物会作出反应。

video.video_title: Leviathan at Intel CES 2014 Keynote

works.title: Lichtgrenze
works.description: For the 25th anniversary of the fall of the Berlin Wall, 8,000 glowing balloons on poles traced 15 km of the former wall through the city and were released one by one into the night sky.
works.description_zh: 为纪念柏林墙倒塌 25 周年，8000 个立在杆上的发光气球沿柏林墙旧址穿城排出 15 公里，最后被逐个放飞到夜空中。
works.idea_en: Marking a vanished boundary on the real map, then letting people release it, is location-based AR in physical form.
works.idea_zh: 在真实地图上标出一条已消失的边界，再让人们亲手把它放走——这是实体形式的地理定位 AR。
works.technique: Balloons with LEDs were mounted on stands along the surveyed wall path; volunteer 'balloon patrons' released them in sequence at a set time.
works.technique_zh: 装有 LED 的气球沿测绘好的柏林墙路线安装在支架上，由志愿“气球守护人”在指定时间依次放飞。
works.exercise_en: Plot a vanished line in your town (an old wall, river or tram track) as a row of glowing geo-anchored markers in phone AR. Twist: let each visitor release one marker so the line disappears over the day.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 把你所在城市一条消失的线（旧城墙、河道或电车轨）标成一排地理锚定的发光标记。变体：让每位访客放飞一个标记，使这条线在一天中逐渐消失。

video.video_title: LICHTGRENZE - official documentation - a light art project for 25 years fall of the wall

salient.why_en: A line of glowing balloons redraws the vanished Berlin Wall through the city, then lets it float away.
salient.why_zh: 一排发光气球在城市中重新画出已消失的柏林墙，然后让它飘向夜空。

works.title: Light Barrier
works.description: Projected light is reflected by 200 curved mirrors into haze, forming floating volumetric shapes that seem to exist in mid-air.
works.idea_zh: 镜面阵列把投影光折射进雾中，形成悬浮光体

video.video_title: LIGHT BARRIER by Kimchi & Chips

works.technique: Structured-light scanning calibrates each projector pixel's ray after reflection by convex mirrors, and those rays are rendered as volumetric beams that intersect in haze to draw 3D shapes.
works.exercise_zh: 在烟雾机或加湿器的雾里打一台投影，用黑底白线图形做出光束扫过的“光膜”，编一段 1 分钟的光雕动画；变体：光束形状由现场音乐的频谱决定。
works.description_zh: 投影光经 200 面曲面镜反射进雾气之中，形成仿佛悬浮在半空的体积光形。
works.idea_en: A mirror array bends projected light into haze to form floating shapes of light.
works.technique_zh: 用结构光扫描标定每个投影像素经凸面镜反射后的光线路径，再把这些光线渲染成体积光束，在雾中交汇，勾勒出三维形体。
works.exercise_en: Shine a projector into the mist from a fog machine or humidifier, use white-line-on-black graphics to create sweeping "light sheets", and compose a one-minute light sculpture animation. Twist: let the spectrum of live music determine the shape of the beams.

works.title: Liminal Air Space-Time
works.description: A vast sheet of thin fabric floats and ripples above visitors in a large hall, lifted by fans so it rises, sinks and breathes like a living surface.
works.description_zh: 一大片极薄的布料在一座大厅中漂浮于观众头顶，被风扇托起，起伏、下沉，如同会呼吸的活表面。
works.idea_en: Air is invisible until something shows it — AR can visualize flow, wind and breath through a single responsive surface.
works.idea_zh: 空气在被某种东西显现之前是看不见的——AR 可以用一张会响应的表面来可视化气流、风和呼吸。
works.technique: Fans placed around the space create controlled air currents that keep a large, very light fabric sheet aloft and moving in slow waves.
works.technique_zh: 场地四周的风扇产生受控气流，让一大片极轻的布料悬浮在空中并缓慢起伏。
works.exercise_en: Simulate a giant cloth floating above the floor in AR that billows when the user blows into the phone microphone. Twist: let several phones in the room each act as a 'fan' from different directions.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中模拟一块漂浮在地面上方的巨大布料，用户对着手机麦克风吹气时布料鼓起。变体：让房间里的几部手机分别从不同方向充当“风扇”。

video.video_title: Liminal air Space-Time Echigotsumari 2014 / Shinji Ohmaki

works.title: Luminescence
works.description: When someone steps into the active zone in front of a large back-projected screen, an outline is drawn around them with swirling manga-like marks, and a fluxing energy thread links every person and object in the zone, building the soundtrack as more threads appear.
works.description_zh: 当有人踏进大型背投屏幕前的感应区，身体轮廓就会被勾勒出来，周围迸出漫画般的旋转笔触；感应区里的每个人和物体之间会连起一条跳动的能量线，线越多，配乐越浓烈。
works.idea_en: Energy threads connect everyone who steps into the frame.
works.idea_zh: 能量线把每个走进画面的人连接在一起。
works.technique: A Kinect infrared camera segments people and objects within a set depth range, and software draws outlines, motion-driven marks and threads between the detected blobs while their count drives the sound.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 红外摄像头在设定深度范围内分割出人和物体，软件为检测到的每个区块画出轮廓、随动作变化的笔触和彼此间的连线，同时用区块数量驱动声音。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam and background subtraction in p5.js or TouchDesigner to find each person's blob and draw a line between every pair. Twist: lines snap when two people move too far apart.
works.exercise_zh: 在 p5.js 或 TouchDesigner 里用摄像头和背景减除找出每个人的区块，并在每两人之间画线；变体：两人离得太远时，线就会断开。

video.video_title: Luminescence

works.title: MAN A
works.description: Large dazzle-camouflage wall prints that look flat until visitors scan them with a mobile app, revealing motion-captured dancers performing in AR on and around the pattern; shown at Selfridges and won a Lumen Prize Gold Award.
works.description_zh: 大幅“炫目迷彩”墙面印刷品，乍看是平面图案，观众用手机 App 扫描后，动作捕捉的舞者就在图案上和周围以 AR 形式起舞；曾在 Selfridges 展出，并获 Lumen Prize 金奖。
works.idea_en: Camouflage that hides dancers until a phone reveals them.
works.idea_zh: 把舞者藏起来的迷彩，只有手机能让他们现身。
works.technique: The dazzle patterns double as image-tracking markers, and the app anchors mocap-animated characters to them.
works.technique_zh: 炫目迷彩图案同时充当图像追踪标记，App 把动捕驱动的角色锚定在上面。
works.exercise_en: Design a black-and-white geometric poster, register it as an image target in Lens Studio or AR Foundation, and attach a Mixamo dance to it. Twist: each fragment of the pattern reveals a different body part.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一张黑白几何海报，在 Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation 中把它注册为图像目标，再挂上一段 Mixamo 舞蹈；变体：图案的每个碎片只显现身体的一个部位。

video.video_title: MAN A

works.title: MIRAGE
works.description: An architecture-scale painted mural in LA's Fashion District that becomes an interactive animated artwork when viewed through a companion AR app.
works.idea_zh: 一面巨型壁画只有透过手机才会“动起来”
works.technique: Image-recognition AR (developed with The Heavy Projects) tracks the painted façade and overlays animated layers aligned to the mural.
works.exercise_zh: 在大白纸上画一幅壁画，用图像识别AR给其中几个元素加动画；变化：同一壁画在白天和夜晚显示不同的AR层。

video.video_title: MIRAGE : RSH

works.description_zh: 洛杉矶时装区的一幅建筑尺度手绘壁画，透过配套的 AR 应用观看时，就会变成一件互动的动画作品。
works.idea_en: A giant mural only comes alive when you look through your phone.
works.technique_zh: 基于图像识别的 AR（与 The Heavy Projects 合作开发）追踪绘有壁画的外墙，叠加与壁画对齐的动画图层。
works.exercise_en: Paint a mural on a large sheet of white paper and use image-recognition AR to animate several of its elements. Twist: show different AR layers on the same mural by day and by night.

works.title: MOMENTUM (Schnelle Bunte Bilder & kling klang klong)
works.description: An interactive system shown through the Choreographic Coding Lab in which a person and their surroundings dissolve into a fluid particle creature, and body movement generates sound and music.
works.description_zh: 通过 Choreographic Coding Lab 展示的交互系统：人和周围环境一起溶解成流动的粒子生物，身体动作同时生成声音与音乐。
works.idea_en: Your body becomes a liquid creature whose motion is also the soundtrack.
works.idea_zh: 你的身体变成一只液态生物，它的运动同时就是配乐。
works.technique: A depth camera's point cloud seeds a particle system while movement speed and position are mapped to generative sound, built by Schnelle Bunte Bilder with sound studio kling klang klong.
works.technique_zh: 深度摄像头的点云生成粒子系统，动作的速度和位置映射到生成式声音上；由 Schnelle Bunte Bilder 与声音工作室 kling klang klong 共同开发。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone's LiDAR or a webcam depth model to turn a person into points, let the points drift with velocity, and map total movement to the volume of a synth. Twist: when the person freezes, the creature slowly forgets their shape.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 LiDAR 或摄像头深度模型把人变成点云，让点随速度漂移，并把整体运动量映射到合成器的音量；变体：人一旦静止，这只生物就慢慢忘记他的形状。

video.video_title: MOMENTUM

works.title: Magic Carpets
works.description: Generative carpets of light are projected across the floor of a historic courtyard; patterns ripple and reorganise wherever visitors walk.
works.idea_zh: 让古建筑地面变成一块会随脚步变化的魔毯
works.technique: Overhead cameras track visitors (Voxels tracking software) and generative pattern software reacts locally to their positions on the floor projection.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面投一块几何图案“地毯”，俯拍摄像头检测脚步位置产生涟漪；变化：两个人之间的连线会生成新的图案花纹。

video.video_title: Miguel CHEVALIER Magic Carpets 2014, Castel del Monte, Italy

works.description_zh: 生成式的光之地毯投射在一座历史庭院的地面上，观众走到哪里，图案就在哪里泛起涟漪、重新组合。
works.idea_en: Turn the floor of an old building into a magic carpet that changes with every step.
works.technique_zh: 俯视摄像头（配合 Voxels 追踪软件）追踪观众，生成式图案软件根据他们在地面投影上的位置作出局部响应。
works.exercise_en: Project a geometric-pattern "carpet" onto the floor and use an overhead camera to detect footsteps and spawn ripples. Twist: the line between two people generates new pattern motifs.

works.title: Mano-a-Mano (Dyadic Projected SAR)
works.description: Two people face each other in a projected room and each sees correct perspective 3D objects between them: throwing fireballs, passing a ball, playing catch with virtual objects.
works.idea_zh: 两个人面对面，都能在投影出的立体空间里看到对的透视，互相扔火球。

video.video_title: Dyadic Projected Spatial Augmented Reality

works.technique: Kinect tracks both users' heads, and each projected object is rendered with view-dependent perspective for one user so that, on the surfaces behind the opposite person, it appears to float in 3D between them.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face 追踪一位同学的头部位置，在投影墙上按其视角渲染一个“悬浮在空中”的球，另一人用手势把球“扔”过去；变体：两人轮流获得正确视角，讨论第三个旁观者看到了什么。
works.description_zh: 两个人在投影房间中面对面，各自都能看到两人之间透视正确的三维物体：互扔火球、传球，或者用虚拟物体玩接抛游戏。
works.idea_en: Two people face each other, both see correct 3D perspective in the projected space, and throw fireballs at each other.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 追踪两位用户的头部，每个投影物体都按其中一位用户的视角进行视点相关渲染，于是投在对方身后表面上的物体，看起来就像悬浮在两人之间的三维空间里。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Face to track one classmate's head position and render a ball "floating in mid-air" on the projection wall from their viewpoint, while another person "throws" it over with a gesture. Twist: the two take turns getting the correct viewpoint, then discuss what a third bystander saw.

works.title: Mesh-Based Watercolor Paint
works.description: Brush strokes spread and bleed like wet watercolour pigment, with darker edges and soft overlapping layers.
works.description_zh: 笔触像湿水彩颜料一样扩散、晕开，边缘更深，层层柔和叠加。
works.idea_en: Simulate watercolour as growing, deforming polygons rather than pixels.
works.idea_zh: 用不断生长、变形的多边形而不是像素来模拟水彩。
works.technique: Implements 'Painting with Polygons' (DiVerdi et al.): each stroke is a polygon whose vertices are displaced and subdivided step by step to imitate pigment flow, then composited with edge darkening.
works.technique_zh: 实现了论文 “Painting with Polygons”（DiVerdi 等）：每一笔是一个多边形，顶点被逐步位移和细分来模仿颜料流动，再加上边缘加深合成。
works.exercise_en: Let users paint watercolour strokes on a detected AR wall with a finger and watch them bleed over a minute. Twist: make strokes bleed faster when the phone's microphone hears running water.
works.exercise_zh: 让用户用手指在检测到的 AR 墙面上画水彩笔触，看它们在一分钟里慢慢晕开。变体：手机麦克风听到流水声时晕染加快。

video.video_title: Mesh-Based Watercolor Paint for Unity

works.title: Meta 1: Planets and 3D Printing
works.description: Through-the-glasses footage of the Meta 1 developer kit: the wearer holds a burning sun and planets in their palms, then sculpts a 3D object in mid-air with bare hands and sends it to a real 3D printer.
works.description_zh: 透过 Meta 1 开发者版眼镜拍摄的画面：佩戴者在手掌里托着燃烧的太阳和行星，接着徒手在空中雕塑一个三维物体，并把它送到一台真实的 3D 打印机上打印出来。
works.idea_en: Shape a hologram with your hands, then print it into a real object.
works.idea_zh: 用双手捏出一个全息物体，再把它打印成真实的东西。
works.technique: A depth camera on the glasses tracks hand and finger positions for 'ZeroUI' gestures in Unity, and the sculpted mesh is exported for 3D printing.
works.technique_zh: 眼镜上的深度相机追踪手和手指的位置，在 Unity 中实现“ZeroUI”手势操作，雕塑出的网格随后导出用于 3D 打印。
works.exercise_en: Build a hand-tracked AR scene where pinching and pulling deforms a sphere, then export it as an STL file. Twist: print the class's sculptures and place them next to their AR versions.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手部追踪的 AR 场景，通过捏合和拉扯让一个球体变形，然后导出为 STL 文件。变体：把全班的雕塑打印出来，再摆到它们的 AR 版本旁边。

video.video_title: Meta: Planets and 3D Printing Technical Demonstration

works.title: Micromigrations
works.description: An Atlantic short on Hlynsky's work, in which the paths of flies, starlings and crows are traced digitally so their hidden patterns of movement become ethereal illustrations.
works.description_zh: 《大西洋月刊》关于 Hlynsky 作品的短片：苍蝇、椋鸟和乌鸦的路径被数字化描绘，使其隐藏的运动图案变成空灵的插画。
works.idea_en: The same trace method works at many scales, from insects to flocks, so a single AR effect can reveal many kinds of motion in nature.
works.idea_zh: 同样的轨迹方法适用于从昆虫到鸟群的多种尺度，所以一个 AR 效果就能揭示自然中多种运动。
works.technique: Video frames are composited so each animal's position over time accumulates into a line, with contrast adjusted to isolate them.
works.technique_zh: 视频帧被合成，使每只动物随时间变化的位置累积成线，并调整对比度把它们分离出来。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone camera trail effect to record five different moving things outdoors (insects, leaves, birds, people, cars) and compare their trace shapes. Twist: guess the source from the trace alone.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机相机轨迹特效在户外记录五种不同的运动物体（昆虫、树叶、鸟、人、车），比较它们的轨迹形状；变体：只看轨迹来猜测来源。

video.video_title: Micromigrations

works.title: Modern Polaxis
works.description: A printed comic about a paranoid time-traveller; pointing a phone at each page brings panels to life with animation, sound and 3D depth.
works.idea_zh: 用手机扫描实体漫画，每一页都活了起来

video.video_title: Modern Polaxis Augmented Reality Comic - Trailer

works.technique: Vuforia image targets recognise each printed comic page, and Unity renders animated layers, 3D depth and sound anchored to the page.
works.exercise_zh: 画一页四格漫画并打印，用 MindAR 或 AR Foundation 图像追踪让其中一格动起来并加声音；变体：让 AR 层讲述与纸面相矛盾的“真相”。
works.description_zh: 一本讲述偏执时间旅行者的实体漫画；用手机对准每一页，画格就会动起来，还带有声音和三维纵深。
works.idea_en: Scan a printed comic with your phone and every page comes to life.
works.technique_zh: 用 Vuforia 图像目标识别每一页印刷漫画，由 Unity 渲染锚定在页面上的动画图层、三维纵深和声音。
works.exercise_en: Draw and print a four-panel comic, then use MindAR or AR Foundation image tracking to animate one panel and add sound. Twist: have the AR layer tell a "truth" that contradicts the page.

works.title: Momentum
works.description: Twelve pendulums carrying light and sound swing along the 90-metre curved Barbican gallery, sweeping shadows and beams across visitors in the dark.
works.description_zh: 十二根带着光和声音的摆锤在巴比肯 90 米长的弧形画廊中摆动，在黑暗中让影子和光束扫过观众。
works.idea_en: Movement of light makes time tangible — you feel the rhythm of the room through shadows passing over your own body.
works.idea_zh: 光的运动让时间可以被触摸——你能通过掠过自己身体的影子感受到房间的节奏。
works.technique: Robotic pendulums follow programmed swing patterns while their lights and speakers are sequenced so beams and sounds travel along the curve.
works.technique_zh: 机械摆锤按编程的摆动模式运动，同时灯光和扬声器被编排，让光束与声音沿弧形空间移动。
works.exercise_en: Place a virtual pendulum light in a dark room with AR and cast real-time shadows of the user's body onto the detected walls. Twist: let the pendulum slow down whenever the user stands still.
works.exercise_zh: 在黑暗房间中用 AR 放一盏虚拟摆锤灯，把用户身体的实时影子投到检测到的墙面上。变体：用户静止时让摆锤慢下来。

video.video_title: United Visual Artists: Momentum

works.title: Moon Rabbit
works.description: At the Taoyuan Land Art Festival in Taiwan, a 25-metre rabbit lies on its side gazing at the sky, a nod to the Mid-Autumn legend of the rabbit on the moon.
works.description_zh: 在台湾桃园地景艺术节上，一只 25 米长的兔子侧躺着凝望天空，呼应中秋节月兔的传说。
works.idea_en: Linking a giant figure to a local legend and festival gives it meaning beyond scale, a lesson for culturally specific AR.
works.idea_zh: 把巨型形象与当地传说和节日联系起来，赋予它尺度之外的意义，是在地文化 AR 的一课。
works.technique: A large fabric-covered form lies on the ground in the festival grounds, lit at night.
works.technique_zh: 一个覆有织物的大型形体卧在节日场地的地面上，夜间有灯光照明。
works.exercise_en: Choose a local legend and place its main character as a giant AR figure where the story is set. Twist: the figure appears only on the festival date or at the right moon phase.
works.exercise_zh: 选择一个本地传说，把主角作为巨型 AR 形象放在故事发生的地方；变体：形象只在节日当天或对应的月相出现。

video.video_title: Dutch artist debuts giant Moon Rabbit at Taoyuan Landscape Art Festival

works.title: MyMirrorCity
works.description: Visitors to Basel's Marktplatz decorate the square's buildings with their selfies, continuing the fresco tradition of the painted town hall.
works.description_zh: 巴塞尔集市广场的游客用自拍装饰广场四周的建筑，延续市政厅外墙壁画的传统。
works.idea_en: Selfies become the new civic frescoes.
works.idea_zh: 自拍成为新的市政壁画。
works.technique: User photos are uploaded and mapped as image panels onto geolocated building facades in a mobile AR app for Virtuale Switzerland.
works.technique_zh: 为 Virtuale Switzerland 展而作：用户上传的照片被映射成图像面板，贴在移动 AR 应用中地理定位的建筑立面上。
works.exercise_en: Let visitors take a selfie and place it as an AR mural on a campus facade using image or plane tracking. Twist: each new selfie pushes the oldest one off the wall.
works.exercise_zh: 让参观者拍一张自拍，用图像或平面追踪把它作为 AR 壁画贴在校园建筑立面上。变体：每张新自拍会把最早的那张挤下墙。

video.video_title: MyMirrorCity Basel

works.title: Nail Art Museum
works.description: An AR 'museum' that places tiny artworks and gallery spaces on the artist's fingernails, parodying the art market.
works.idea_zh: 把美术馆缩小搬到指甲上

video.video_title: Nail Art Museum (2014)

works.technique: Small printed markers on the fingernails are tracked by the camera, and miniature gallery models are rendered on each nail's pose.
works.exercise_zh: 在指甲或指尖贴小图像标记（或用 MediaPipe Hands 指尖位置），在上面放一个迷你美术馆和作品；变体：给这座美术馆写一段夸张的开幕致辞并录成视频。
works.description_zh: 一座 AR“美术馆”，把微型艺术品和展厅空间放在艺术家的指甲上，以此戏仿艺术市场。
works.idea_en: Shrink a museum and move it onto your fingernails.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪贴在指甲上的小型印刷标记，在每片指甲的位姿上渲染迷你展厅模型。
works.exercise_en: Stick small image markers on your nails or fingertips (or use fingertip positions from MediaPipe Hands) and place a mini museum with artworks on them. Twist: write an over-the-top opening speech for this museum and record it as a video.

works.title: Noisy Skeleton
works.description: An immersive room of abstract projected lines and digital sound that reacts to a visitor's movements, from precise control to accidental feedback.
works.description_zh: 一个满是抽象投影线条和数字声音的沉浸式房间，会回应观众的动作，从精确控制到偶然反馈。
works.idea_en: A dialogue between a body and a machine that listens with sound and space.
works.idea_zh: 身体与机器之间的一场对话，机器用声音和空间来“聆听”。
works.technique: Depth-camera skeleton tracking likely drives generative visuals projected around the room and a spatial soundscape that echoes the movement back.
works.technique_zh: 可能用深度相机追踪骨架，驱动投满房间的生成式影像和把动作回声化的空间声景。
works.exercise_en: Map a webcam pose tracker's wrist heights to pitch and line density in a projected sketch (p5.js + ml5). Twist: add a delay so the room answers your gesture two seconds later.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头姿态追踪，把手腕高度映射成投影草图中的音高和线条密度（p5.js + ml5）；变体：加一个延迟，让房间在两秒后才回应你的手势。

video.video_title: Noisy Skeleton

works.title: OMOTE
works.description: Real-time face tracking and projection mapping paint shifting digital makeup, cracks and masks onto a model's moving face.
works.idea_zh: 把人脸变成实时追踪的投影画布，数字妆容随表情移动

video.video_title: OMOTE / REAL-TIME FACE TRACKING & PROJECTION MAPPING

works.technique: Face tracking with markers or landmarks drives a 3D face mesh whose texture is projected by a calibrated projector, with latency kept low so makeup stays registered to the moving face.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 生成人脸网格，把一种“数字妆容”投影到白色面具或同学脸上（先用静止面具校准）；变体：让妆容随表情变化，比如张嘴时出现裂纹。
works.description_zh: 实时面部追踪与投影映射在模特活动的脸上绘出不断变化的数字妆容、裂纹和面具。
works.idea_en: Turn a face into a tracked projection canvas where digital makeup moves with every expression.
works.technique_zh: 借助标记点或面部特征点进行面部追踪，驱动三维人脸网格，其纹理由经过标定的投影仪投出；系统将延迟压到很低，使妆容始终贴合运动中的脸。
works.exercise_en: Generate a face mesh with MediaPipe Face Mesh and project a "digital makeup" onto a white mask or a classmate's face (calibrate on a still mask first). Twist: make the makeup change with expression, for example cracks appear when the mouth opens.

works.title: Ocean Atlas
works.description: Off Nassau in the Bahamas, a 5-metre, 60-ton figure of a local girl kneels on the sea floor and holds up the surface of the ocean on her back.
works.description_zh: 在巴哈马拿骚外海，一个 5 米高、重 60 吨、以当地女孩为原型的人像跪在海底，用背托起海面。
works.idea_en: A figure that carries the boundary between two worlds (water and air) is a strong image for AR works that sit on a surface between realities.
works.idea_zh: 一个托起两个世界（水与空气）之间边界的人像，是位于现实之间表面上的 AR 作品的有力意象。
works.technique: The sculpture was cast in sections of pH-neutral cement and assembled on the sea floor by divers and a crane barge.
works.technique_zh: 雕塑以 pH 中性水泥分段浇筑，由潜水员和起重驳船在海底组装。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR figure under a real table or water surface so it appears to hold it up, using the table plane as an occlusion boundary. Twist: when the user places objects on the table, the figure strains more.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个 AR 人像放在真实的桌面或水面下方，让它看起来正托着这个面，并以桌面平面作为遮挡边界；变体：当用户往桌上放东西时，人像会显得更吃力。

video.video_title: Building The World's Largest Underwater Sculpture

works.title: Parade
works.description: Inside a wooden cube a work lamp hangs over two slumped porcelain vases; when a visitor pushes the lamp, the vases' shadows on the wall come alive and dance in rhythm with the swinging light.
works.description_zh: 木箱里挂着一盏工作灯，灯下是两只瘫软的瓷瓶；观众一推灯，墙上瓷瓶的影子就活了过来，随着摇晃的灯光跳舞。
works.idea_en: Push the lamp and the shadows start to dance.
works.idea_zh: 推一下灯，影子就开始跳舞。
works.technique: The lamp's swing is motion-tracked, and projected shadow animations are rendered in real-time 3D so they match the position of the real light source (with ceramicist Laurent Craste).
works.technique_zh: 对灯的摆动做动作追踪，实时 3D 渲染投影出的影子动画，让它和真实光源的位置一致（与陶艺家 Laurent Craste 合作）。
works.exercise_en: Place a real object under a lamp, track the lamp with a phone or webcam, and project a fake shadow that follows the light but moves on its own. Twist: the shadow reacts differently when the lamp swings fast.
works.exercise_zh: 在灯下放一个真实物体，用手机或摄像头追踪灯的位置，投出一道跟随光源、却会自己动的假影子。变体：灯摆得快时，影子的反应完全不同。

video.video_title: Parade - Dancing Shadow Sculptures

salient.why_en: Push the lamp and the shadows of two sad vases start to dance.
salient.why_zh: 推一下灯，两只瘫软瓷瓶的影子就开始跳舞。

works.title: Pathfinder
works.description: A visual language that generates choreography: animated lines and paths on screen become instructions that dancers Raphael Hillebrand, Honji Wang and Christine Joy Alpuerto Ritter read and embody.
works.description_zh: 一种生成编舞的视觉语言：屏幕上的动画线条和路径成为指令，由舞者 Raphael Hillebrand、Honji Wang 和 Christine Joy Alpuerto Ritter 解读并用身体演绎。
works.idea_en: Reverse the usual pipeline: the graphics lead and the dancers follow.
works.idea_zh: 把常规流程反过来：由图形带领，舞者跟随。
works.technique: Generative path systems made with onformative are designed as a readable notation, so each visual behaviour (split, loop, spiral) maps to a movement task.
works.technique_zh: 与 onformative 合作开发的生成式路径系统被设计成可阅读的记谱法，每种视觉行为（分裂、回环、螺旋）都对应一项动作任务。
works.exercise_en: Write a p5.js sketch that draws one evolving line, show it on a projector, and ask a volunteer to dance whatever the line does. Twist: add a second line and see whether two dancers start to relate.
works.exercise_zh: 写一个 p5.js 草图，画出一条不断变化的线，投影出来，请一位志愿者跟着线条的变化跳舞；变体：再加第二条线，看两位舞者是否开始产生关系。

video.video_title: Pathfinder

works.title: Physical Telepresence
works.description: Remote participants' hands and objects are captured in 3D and rendered physically on a shape display, so someone far away can push and manipulate objects on your table.
works.idea_zh: 远程协作时，对方的手以实体形状出现在你桌上，能真的拨动物体。

video.video_title: Physical Telepresence

works.technique: A Kinect depth stream of the remote space is converted to a height map that drives the local shape display in real time, so remote hands physically push objects on the pins.
works.exercise_zh: 用两台电脑的摄像头 + MediaPipe Hands 实现远程“推”：A 端的手部位置控制 B 端投影在桌上的虚拟推板，推动 B 端桌面上被识别的纸片方块（或虚拟物体）；变体：只传递手的“影子”，讨论匿名的远程触碰是什么感觉。
works.description_zh: 远程参与者的手和物体被三维捕捉，并在形状显示器上以实体形式再现，让远方的人也能推动、摆弄你桌上的物体。
works.idea_en: In remote collaboration, the other person's hands appear as physical shapes on your table and can actually push things.
works.technique_zh: 把远端空间的 Kinect 深度流转换为高度图，实时驱动本地的形状显示器，让远程的手通过针脚真实地推动物体。
works.exercise_en: Build a remote "push" with two computers' cameras and MediaPipe Hands: the hand position on side A controls a virtual pusher projected on side B's table, which shoves detected paper squares (or virtual objects) there. Twist: transmit only the hand's "shadow", and discuss what anonymous remote touch feels like.

works.title: Pixel (with Mourad Merzouki / Compagnie Käfig)
works.description: Eleven hip-hop and circus dancers perform with projected points of light on the floor and backdrop that move, ripple and cascade with their bodies.
works.idea_zh: 街舞舞者与地面上的“光点像素”一起舞动
works.technique: Floor and back projections of particle fields are generated live with eMotion and synchronised with the choreography by a digital performer.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面投影一片光点，让同学跳街舞，光点随脚步涟漪扩散；变化：光点形成一条只有两人配合才能通过的“河”。

video.video_title: PIXEL | Création 2014 | Compagnie Käfig

works.description_zh: 十一位街舞与马戏舞者在地面和背景幕上的投影光点中表演，光点随着他们的身体移动、泛起涟漪、倾泻而下。
works.idea_en: Hip-hop dancers move together with pixels of light on the floor.
works.technique_zh: 地面投影和背景投影中的粒子场由 eMotion 实时生成，并由一位数字表演者现场操控，与编舞同步。
works.exercise_en: Project a field of light dots on the floor and have classmates breakdance while the dots ripple outward from their steps. Twist: make the dots form a "river" that can only be crossed when two people work together.

works.title: PolyFauna
works.description: A free app in which you look around a dark, evolving landscape of Stanley Donwood's drawings and creatures by moving your phone, follow a red dot, and hear Radiohead's 'Bloom' fragmented into the space.
works.description_zh: 一款免费应用：移动手机就能环顾一片由 Stanley Donwood 的绘画与生物构成、不断演化的黑暗风景，跟随一个红点前进，并听到被拆散到空间中的 Radiohead《Bloom》片段。
works.idea_en: Your phone is a window into a living world built from an album's sketchbook.
works.idea_zh: 手机是一扇窗，通向由专辑草图本长出来的活世界。
works.technique: The phone's gyroscope drives a 360-degree camera in a generative 3D environment, and touch spawns creatures whose shapes evolve over time (built by Universal Everything).
works.technique_zh: 手机陀螺仪驱动生成式 3D 环境中的 360 度相机，触摸会生成随时间演化形态的生物（由 Universal Everything 开发）。
works.exercise_en: Scan ten of your own sketches, turn them into textured 3D shapes and place them in a gyroscope-controlled web scene that people explore by turning their phones. Twist: let each visitor's touch leave a creature that later visitors meet.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描自己的十张草图，把它们变成带纹理的 3D 形体，放进一个由陀螺仪控制的网页场景，让人转动手机来探索；变体：每位访客的触摸会留下一只小生物，后来的访客都能遇见它。

video.video_title: Radiohead Polyfauna

works.title: Porsche Macan: 3D Mapping & Dance Performance
works.description: For the Russian premiere of the Porsche Macan at Barvikha Concert Hall, live dancers perform with their own projected copies and industrial motion graphics on a central podium and side screens; at the end the projected cube lifts to reveal the car.
works.description_zh: 在巴尔维哈音乐厅的保时捷 Macan 俄罗斯首发会上，现场舞者与自己的投影分身以及工业风动态图形在中央台和两侧屏幕上共舞；最后，被投影的立方体升起，露出新车。
works.idea_en: Pairing a real dancer with a projected double creates a dialogue between body and image; AR performance can use the same trick with a virtual clone.
works.idea_zh: 让真实舞者与投影分身配对，形成身体与影像之间的对话；AR 表演可以用虚拟分身做同样的事。
works.technique: Pre-recorded footage of the dancers is mapped onto a cube and screens and synchronised with a rehearsed live choreography.
works.technique_zh: 预先拍好的舞者影像被映射到立方体和屏幕上，与排练好的现场编舞精确同步。
works.exercise_en: Record a 30-second dance, then play it back as an AR clone next to the live dancer with body occlusion in Unity or Lens Studio, and choreograph a duet. Twist: the clone lags one beat behind, like an echo.
works.exercise_zh: 录一段 30 秒的舞蹈，在 Unity 或 Lens Studio 里借助身体遮挡，把它作为 AR 分身在现场舞者身边回放，编一段双人舞；变体：分身慢一拍，像回声一样。

video.video_title: Porsche Macan: 3D Mapping & Dance Performance

works.title: Portée/
works.description: Sixteen glowing electroluminescent wires are stretched across a room like the staves of a score. When visitors touch and pluck a wire, a real Disklavier grand piano plays the note assigned to it, so the room becomes a walk-in instrument.
works.description_zh: 十六根发光的电致发光线像乐谱的五线谱一样横跨整个房间。观众触碰、拨动其中一根线，一台真正的 Disklavier 自动钢琴就会弹出对应的音符，整个房间变成一件可以走进去演奏的乐器。
works.idea_en: Unfold a music score into space and let people play it by touching the lines.
works.idea_zh: 把乐谱展开到空间里，让人用手触碰线条来演奏。
works.technique: Vibration or touch sensors on each wire send events to a computer that triggers MIDI notes on a self-playing piano, while the wires themselves light up (sensor type likely capacitive or piezo).
works.technique_zh: 每根线上的振动或触摸传感器把信号传给电脑，由电脑向自动钢琴发送 MIDI 音符，同时发光线本身被点亮（传感器推测为电容或压电式）。
works.exercise_en: Stretch five strings or ribbons across the classroom, attach a piezo or capacitive sensor to each with an Arduino or Makey Makey, and map each string to a note in a browser synth. Twist: each string plays a different student's recorded voice instead of a note.
works.exercise_zh: 在教室里拉五根绳子或丝带，用 Arduino 或 Makey Makey 给每根绳子接上压电或电容传感器，在浏览器合成器里把每根绳子对应到一个音符；变体：每根绳子播放一位同学录下的声音，而不是音符。

video.video_title: Portée/ — Interactive unfold of a music score in space

works.title: Prince Mio improvise to Interactive Sound
works.description: A spontaneous rehearsal session for POW2045 in which the sound is completely attached to the dancer's body, so every pop and wave is heard as it happens.
works.description_zh: 为 POW2045 排练时的一段即兴：声音完全依附在舞者身体上，每一次 pop 和 wave 都即时被听见。
works.idea_en: The dancer does not dance to the music; the music comes out of the dance.
works.idea_zh: 不是舞者跟着音乐跳，而是音乐从舞蹈中流出来。
works.technique: A Kinect v2 depth camera tracks the body and maps joint motion to a sound collage by kling klang klong, with advice from Schnelle Bunte Bilder.
works.technique_zh: Kinect v2 深度摄像头追踪身体，把关节运动映射到 kling klang klong 制作的声音拼贴上，并由 Schnelle Bunte Bilder 提供技术建议。
works.exercise_en: Map wrist speed to a filter cutoff and sudden stops to a drum hit using webcam pose tracking and Tone.js. Twist: only the left side of the body makes sound.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头姿态追踪和 Tone.js，把手腕速度映射到滤波器截止频率，把突然停顿映射成鼓点；变体：只有身体左半边能发声。

video.video_title: Prince Mio improvise to Interactive Sound

works.title: Project Tango
works.description: Google ATAP introduces a phone prototype with depth sensors and motion tracking that maps rooms in 3D as you walk, hinting at indoor navigation, AR games and measuring spaces.
works.description_zh: Google ATAP 发布一款装有深度传感器和运动追踪的手机原型：你边走，它边以 3D 方式绘制房间，预示室内导航、AR 游戏和空间测量等可能。
works.idea_en: Give a phone a human-scale understanding of space and motion.
works.idea_zh: 赋予手机对空间和运动的人类尺度理解。
works.technique: A fisheye camera, a depth sensor and an IMU feed visual-inertial odometry and area learning that produce a live 6DoF pose and a 3D point cloud of the surroundings.
works.technique_zh: 鱼眼相机、深度传感器和惯性测量单元共同驱动视觉惯性里程计和区域学习，实时输出 6DoF 姿态和周围环境的 3D 点云。
works.exercise_en: Walk a hallway with an AR app that drops a breadcrumb every metre, then ask a partner to follow the crumbs back. Twist: hide one crumb that only appears when you crouch.
works.exercise_zh: 拿着 AR 应用走一段走廊，每走一米放一个“面包屑”，再让同伴沿着面包屑走回来。变体：藏一个只有蹲下才能看到的面包屑。

video.video_title: Say hello to Project Tango!

works.title: Project Tango: NASA SPHERES
works.description: A Tango phone is mounted on SPHERES, NASA's floating robots inside the International Space Station, giving them the ability to see and map the module to navigate on their own.
works.description_zh: 一部 Tango 手机被装在 NASA 的 SPHERES 漂浮机器人上，在国际空间站舱内帮助它们看见并绘制舱室地图，从而自主导航。
works.idea_en: The same spatial-awareness chip that plays AR games can guide a robot in zero gravity.
works.idea_zh: 能玩 AR 游戏的空间感知芯片，也能在失重环境里为机器人导航。
works.technique: Tango's visual-inertial tracking and depth mapping replace external beacons, feeding pose estimates to the free-flying robot's control system.
works.technique_zh: Tango 的视觉惯性追踪和深度建图取代了外部信标，把姿态估计提供给自由飞行机器人的控制系统。
works.exercise_en: Mount a phone on a toy car or robot and use AR world tracking to make it return to a marked start point. Twist: let a second phone see the robot's path as an AR trail.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机装在玩具车或机器人上，用 AR 世界追踪让它回到标记的起点。变体：让另一部手机以 AR 轨迹看到机器人的路径。

video.video_title: Project Tango: NASA SPHERES

works.title: Qbox: AR Magic Toy
works.description: Put a small toy inside a box and, through an AR interface, it comes to life, interacting with the box, the child and the world around it.
works.idea_zh: 把玩具放进魔法盒，透过屏幕它就活了。

video.video_title: Qbox - AR Magic Toy

works.technique: Marker tracking on the box registers an animated virtual version of the inserted toy on top of the physical one (likely marker/toy recognition).
works.exercise_zh: 做一个贴有识别图的纸盒，放入不同玩具时（换不同卡片）AR 里出现不同动画；加一个变化：摇晃盒子会让角色晕倒。
works.description_zh: 把一个小玩具放进盒子，透过 AR 界面，它就活了过来，能与盒子、孩子以及周围的世界互动。
works.idea_en: Put a toy into a magic box and it comes alive on the screen.
works.technique_zh: 通过追踪盒子上的标记，把放入的玩具对应的动画虚拟版本叠加在实体玩具之上（大概率结合了标记或玩具识别）。
works.exercise_en: Make a cardboard box with a recognition image, so different animations appear in AR when different toys go in (by swapping cards). Twist: shaking the box makes the character faint.

works.title: Queen Victoria
works.description: The statue of Queen Victoria in a Kitchener park takes on the face and hands of seven local residents, including refugees, who tell their life stories through her.
works.description_zh: 基奇纳市公园里的维多利亚女王雕像换上了七位当地居民（包括难民）的脸和手，由“女王”替他们讲述自己的人生故事。
works.idea_en: A colonial monument becomes a microphone for the community living around it.
works.idea_zh: 一座殖民时代的纪念像，变成周围社区居民的扩音器。
works.technique: Two cameras recorded each speaker, one head-mounted for the face and one for the torso, and the merged video was aligned to the statue's face and hands in projection.
works.technique_zh: 每位讲述者由两台摄像机拍摄，一台头戴拍脸，一台拍躯干和手，合成后的视频在投影时对齐到雕像的脸和手上。
works.exercise_en: Choose a local statue or portrait, collect three short voice stories from people who live nearby and map their faces onto a printed or 3D-printed copy. Twist: switch stories when someone steps closer.
works.exercise_zh: 选一座本地雕像或肖像，收集三位附近居民的简短口述，把他们的脸投影到打印或 3D 打印的复制品上；变体：有人走近时就切换到下一个故事。

video.video_title: Krzysztof Wodizcko and Gary Kirkham: Queen Victoria, Lamees #1

salient.why_en: A colonial statue takes on the faces and voices of local residents and tells their stories.
salient.why_zh: 一座殖民时代的雕像换上当地居民的脸和声音，讲述他们的故事。

works.title: Re+Public AR mural
works.description: Re+Public's AR app animates large street murals: pointing a phone at the wall makes the painted characters and shapes come alive.
works.idea_zh: 对准街头壁画，画中形象立刻动起来

video.video_title: Re+Public Augmented Reality Mural

works.technique: Image tracking recognises each mural as a target and overlays animated layers registered to the painting in the phone's camera view.
works.exercise_zh: 选校园里的一幅壁画或自己画一张海报，用 8th Wall / MindAR 图像追踪让画中元素动起来；变体：让动画只在特定时间段出现，比如只在傍晚“醒来”。
works.description_zh: Re+Public 的 AR 应用让大型街头壁画动起来：用手机对准墙面，画中的角色和形状就会活起来。
works.idea_en: Point at a street mural and the figures in it start to move.
works.technique_zh: 图像追踪把每幅壁画识别为目标，在手机摄像头画面中叠加与画作对齐的动画图层。
works.exercise_en: Pick a mural on campus or paint your own poster, and use 8th Wall or MindAR image tracking to animate elements in it. Twist: the animation only appears at certain times, for example it only "wakes up" at dusk.

works.title: Real-time Water Caustics Simulation
works.description: Rippling light patterns dance on the floor of a pool as the water surface above it moves.
works.description_zh: 水面起伏时，泳池底部跳动着波纹状的光斑。
works.idea_en: Compute where light lands after passing through a moving water surface.
works.idea_zh: 计算光线穿过起伏水面之后落在哪里。
works.technique: Following Yuksel and Keyser's height-field caustics method, rays refracted through the water height field are projected onto the floor and their density is accumulated into a caustics texture each frame.
works.technique_zh: 按照 Yuksel 与 Keyser 的高度场焦散方法，光线经水面高度场折射后投射到地面，每帧把光线密度累积成一张焦散纹理。
works.exercise_en: Project the caustics texture onto a real floor plane in AR with a light that follows the phone, so the room looks like it is under water. Twist: let taps on the screen drop ripples into the simulated surface.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把焦散纹理投到真实地面平面上，光源跟随手机，让房间看起来像在水下。变体：点击屏幕时在模拟水面上激起涟漪。

video.video_title: Real-time Water Caustics Simulation

works.title: Riverbed
works.description: At the Louisiana Museum in Denmark, a whole wing was filled with stones and gravel from Iceland and a stream running through it, so visitors walk a riverbed inside the museum.
works.description_zh: 在丹麦路易斯安那现代艺术博物馆，一整个展厅被来自冰岛的石头和砾石填满，一条溪流从中穿过，观众在博物馆内沿河床行走。
works.idea_en: Replacing a museum's floor with a landscape you have to climb over changes how the body moves, a strong case for full-room AR replacement.
works.idea_zh: 把博物馆地面替换成需要攀爬的风景，改变了身体的移动方式，这是全房间 AR 替换的有力案例。
works.technique: Tonnes of rock were brought in and shaped over the gallery floors, with a pumped stream circulating through the rooms.
works.technique_zh: 数吨岩石被运入并铺在展厅地面上，水泵驱动的溪流在各房间中循环。
works.exercise_en: Use ARKit scene reconstruction to replace a corridor floor with an AR riverbed of rocks and flowing water that respects real walls and doorways. Twist: water flows downhill according to the phone's measured floor slope.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit 场景重建把走廊地面替换成由岩石和流水组成的 AR 河床，并尊重真实的墙壁和门洞；变体：水依据手机测得的地面坡度向低处流。

video.video_title: Walking Riverbed

works.title: RoomAlive
works.description: Multiple auto-calibrating projector-camera units cover an entire living room so games can happen on every surface: whack-a-mole creatures crawl out of the couch, and you dodge traps with your body.
works.idea_zh: 整个客厅每一面墙、每件家具都成了游戏场，怪物从沙发里爬出来。

video.video_title: RoomAlive: Magical Experiences Enabled by Scalable, Adaptive Projector-Camera Units

works.technique: Each projector-camera unit auto-calibrates by projecting Gray-code structured light that its Kinect observes, yielding a unified 3D room model onto which games are rendered with per-surface projection mapping and depth-based body tracking.
works.exercise_zh: 用一台投影仪 + 摄像头做 Gray code 结构光标定（或手动四角映射），把房间一角变成打地鼠游戏：小怪物从沙发边缘钻出，用 MediaPipe 检测手拍到它的位置；变体：让怪物躲避你而不是等你打。
works.description_zh: 多台可自动标定的投影仪-相机单元覆盖整个客厅，让游戏可以发生在每一个表面上：打地鼠式的小怪物从沙发里爬出来，你还得用身体躲避陷阱。
works.idea_en: Every wall and piece of furniture in the living room becomes a game board, with monsters crawling out of the couch.
works.technique_zh: 每个投影仪-相机单元投射格雷码（Gray code）结构光并由 Kinect 观测，从而完成自动标定，得到统一的房间三维模型；游戏通过逐表面投影映射渲染到房间里，并用基于深度的身体追踪进行交互。
works.exercise_en: Calibrate a projector and camera with Gray-code structured light (or manual four-corner mapping) and turn a corner of the room into whack-a-mole: little monsters pop out from the edge of the couch, and MediaPipe detects where your hand slaps them. Twist: make the monsters dodge you instead of waiting to be hit.

works.title: RoomAlive: The Other Resident
works.description: A spooky narrative game built with the RoomAlive projection system, where a ghostly presence haunts the real room around the player.
works.idea_zh: 用房间级投影在自家客厅里上演一出闹鬼剧。

video.video_title: RoomAlive: The Other Resident

works.technique: Built on the RoomAlive Toolkit's calibrated projector-camera units, the game uses the scanned room model to place projected effects (shadows, apparitions, stains) on specific furniture, triggered by the player's tracked position.
works.exercise_zh: 用一台投影仪在宿舍或教室角落做一段 3 分钟的恐怖叙事：摄像头检测观众走到某个位置时，墙上出现影子、门框渗出污迹；变体：让“幽灵”只在观众背对它时移动。
works.description_zh: 一款基于 RoomAlive 投影系统制作的惊悚叙事游戏，一个幽灵般的存在在玩家身处的真实房间里作祟。
works.idea_en: Use room-scale projection to stage a haunting in your own living room.
works.technique_zh: 游戏基于 RoomAlive Toolkit 中经过标定的投影仪-相机单元，利用扫描得到的房间模型把投影效果（阴影、幽灵、污渍）放在特定家具上，并由玩家被追踪的位置触发。
works.exercise_en: Use one projector to create a 3-minute horror story in a corner of a dorm or classroom: when a camera detects the viewer reaching a certain spot, a shadow appears on the wall and a stain seeps from the door frame. Twist: the "ghost" only moves when the viewer has their back to it.

works.title: SOLANUM (Augmented Sculpture)
works.description: A site-specific augmented sculpture in the JW Marriott Houston lounge: layered physical forms and a custom-fit virtual skin melt together into one evolving object.
works.idea_zh: 实体层叠雕塑和贴合的虚拟外衣融为一体
works.technique: Layered physical slices are fabricated from the same 3D design as the projection content, enabling pixel-accurate mapping on every layer edge.
works.exercise_zh: 用多层泡沫板叠出一个形体，投影随层级变化的颜色扫描线；变化：让扫描线的速度由现场人数（摄像头计数）决定。

video.video_title: SOLANUM ǀ Augmented Sculpture

works.description_zh: 为休斯敦 JW Marriott 酒店大堂酒廊创作的一件场域特定增强雕塑：层层叠叠的实体形态与量身贴合的虚拟外皮融为一体，成为一个不断演变的物体。
works.idea_en: A layered physical sculpture and a close-fitting virtual skin merge into one.
works.technique_zh: 层叠的实体切片与投影内容出自同一个三维设计，从而能在每一层的边缘实现像素级精准的映射。
works.exercise_en: Stack several layers of foam board into a form and project scan lines whose color changes from layer to layer. Twist: let the number of people present (counted by a camera) set the speed of the scan lines.

works.title: SPARKED (with Cirque du Soleil)
works.description: In a short film made with Cirque du Soleil, ten quadcopters dressed as lampshades dance around an electrician in a workshop, becoming characters with moods of their own.
works.description_zh: 在与太阳马戏团合作的一部短片里，十架套着灯罩的四旋翼围着一位电工在工坊中起舞，成了各有情绪的角色。
works.idea_en: A flying lampshade becomes a character through timing and motion alone; AR objects can gain personality from how they move toward and away from people.
works.idea_zh: 一个会飞的灯罩只靠节奏和动作就成了角色；AR 物体也可以从它们如何靠近和远离人的方式中获得性格。
works.technique: Indoor quadcopters are tracked by motion capture and follow choreographed trajectories synchronised with the performer and music, with lightweight lampshades as costumes.
works.technique_zh: 室内四旋翼由动作捕捉追踪，按与演员和音乐同步的编排轨迹飞行，用轻质灯罩当作服装。
works.exercise_en: Create three AR lamps that float around a student and react to them: one shy (flees), one curious (follows), one sleepy (sinks when ignored). Twist: remove all faces and colours and see if people still name their moods.
works.exercise_zh: 做三盏漂浮在同学身边、会对人作出反应的 AR 灯：一盏害羞（逃开），一盏好奇（跟随），一盏困倦（被忽视时慢慢下沉）。变体：去掉所有面孔和颜色，看大家是否还能说出它们的情绪。

video.video_title: SPARKED: A Live Interaction Between Humans and Quadcopters | Cirque du Soleil

works.title: STEPSEQUENCER
works.description: Instead of music that makes people dance, dancing makes the music: visitors step on a round floor-projected instrument and use three physical stations for jumping and moving, and every action adds a sound or beat.
works.description_zh: 不是音乐让人跳舞，而是舞蹈创造音乐：观众踩在一个圆形地面投影乐器上，再加上三个供跳跃和活动的实体装置，每个动作都会加入一个声音或节拍。
works.idea_en: Your dance steps compose the beat.
works.idea_zh: 你的舞步谱出了节拍。
