works.technique: A camera tracks footsteps on a circular floor projection laid out like a step sequencer, and sensors in the side stations trigger additional sounds, all mixed live in the software.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪踩在圆形地面投影上的脚步，这个投影的布局就像一个步进音序器；侧面装置里的传感器触发更多声音，全部由软件实时混合。
works.exercise_en: Tape a 4x4 grid on the floor, detect which squares are occupied with a webcam from above, and loop a drum pattern from them in Tone.js. Twist: each square plays the voice of whoever stands on it.
works.exercise_zh: 在地上用胶带贴一个 4x4 网格，用顶部摄像头检测哪些格子有人，用 Tone.js 循环播放对应的鼓点；变体：每个格子播放站在上面那个人的声音。

video.video_title: STEPSEQUENCER

works.title: SWARM
works.description: An immersive installation-performance where simple projected visual cues call the audience into action, and only when the crowd coordinates and moves together does the piece reveal its full arc.
works.description_zh: 沉浸式装置演出：简单的投影视觉提示召唤观众行动，只有当人群彼此协调、一起移动时，作品才会展现完整的叙事。
works.idea_en: The audience is the dance company, and the piece only progresses through collective action.
works.idea_zh: 观众就是舞团，只有集体行动才能推动作品前进。
works.technique: Projected instructions and visual stimuli are driven by Isadora, likely with camera sensing of crowd position to decide when the group has completed a task.
works.technique_zh: 投影指令和视觉刺激由 Isadora 驱动，很可能用摄像头感测人群位置，判断群体是否完成了任务。
works.exercise_en: Project three coloured circles on the floor and use an overhead webcam to count people in each; the next scene starts only when every circle holds the same number. Twist: nobody is allowed to speak.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面投影三个彩色圆圈，用顶部摄像头统计每个圆里的人数，只有每个圆的人数都相同时才进入下一场景；变体：任何人都不许说话。

video.video_title: SWARM - Marshall University, February 2014

works.title: Sand drawings
works.description: Walking with a stick on the beach at low tide, Denevan draws huge circles and geometric patterns that can only be seen fully from the cliffs or the air before the tide erases them.
works.description_zh: Denevan 在退潮的海滩上拿着木棍边走边画，画出只能从悬崖或空中完整看到的巨大圆形和几何图案，随后被潮水抹去。
works.idea_en: Drawing at the scale of walking and seeing at the scale of flying is exactly the gap AR can close with a live overhead view.
works.idea_zh: 以步行尺度作画、以飞行尺度观看，这正是 AR 可以用实时俯视视角弥合的差距。
works.technique: He lays out circles by walking at a fixed distance from a centre and repeats forms with measured paces, using only a stick.
works.technique_zh: 他以与圆心保持固定距离的方式行走来画圆，并用计量步伐重复形状，只用一根木棍。
works.exercise_en: Walk a pattern on a field while a WebXR app records the path and shows it as a line on a live mini-map. Twist: add rules (for example, circles must touch) and draw as a team.
works.exercise_zh: 在操场上走出一个图案，同时用 WebXR 应用记录路径并在实时小地图上显示成线条；变体：加上规则（例如圆必须相切），以团队形式作画。

video.video_title: Lines in the Sand: When The Beach Becomes a Canvas

works.title: Seamless MR (hanacam test)
works.description: A test of seamless mixed-reality video where a tracked camera composites CG into a live scene in real time.
works.idea_zh: 追踪摄像机把CG无缝合成进实景的MR实验

video.video_title: Seamless MR a.k.a. hanacam test -01

works.technique: A tracked camera (encoder or optical tracking) supplies real-time pose to a render engine whose virtual camera matches it, so CG is keyed and composited into the live feed without drift.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 ARKit 位姿作为虚拟摄像机，在 Unity 中把一个 CG 物体合成到实景视频里，并对比加与不加阴影、遮挡的真实感差异；变体：让 CG 物体只在画面边缘“偷看”，制造若隐若现的存在感。
works.description_zh: 一次无缝混合现实影像测试：被追踪的摄像机把 CG 实时合成进实景画面。
works.idea_en: An MR test where a tracked camera blends CG seamlessly into a live scene.
works.technique_zh: 被追踪的摄像机（通过编码器或光学追踪）向渲染引擎实时提供位姿，引擎中的虚拟摄像机与之同步，使 CG 能无漂移地抠像并合成进实时画面。
works.exercise_en: Use the phone's ARKit pose as a virtual camera in Unity to composite a CG object into live-action video, and compare how real it looks with and without shadows and occlusion. Twist: have the CG object only "peek" in from the edge of the frame, creating a presence that is there one moment and gone the next.

works.title: Seward's Success (as seen in Indie Alaska)
works.description: A documentary on Shafer's AR work, centred on Seward's Success, a futuristic domed city planned for Anchorage in the 1960s but never built, which he rebuilds in AR on its intended site.
works.description_zh: 一部关于 Shafer AR 创作的纪录短片，核心是 Seward's Success：一座 60 年代为安克雷奇规划、却从未建成的未来主义穹顶城市，他在原定地点用 AR 把它重建出来。
works.idea_en: Build the city that was never built, where it was supposed to be.
works.idea_zh: 在它本该出现的地方，建起那座从未建成的城市。
works.technique: Architectural drawings of the unbuilt dome are modelled in 3D and geolocated at the planned site so phones show it on the skyline.
works.technique_zh: 根据未建穹顶的建筑图纸建立 3D 模型，并定位到原规划地点，让手机在天际线上显示它。
works.exercise_en: Find an unbuilt or demolished building plan for your city and place it in phone AR at its intended site and scale. Twist: let viewers step inside through a portal.
works.exercise_zh: 找一份你所在城市未建成或已拆除的建筑方案，用手机 AR 按原定位置和尺度把它放出来。变体：让观众通过传送门走进去。

video.video_title: I Am An Augmented Reality Creator | INDIE ALASKA

works.title: Shiver
works.description: A film-noir and horror-flavoured dance piece where a video system projects live, animated replicas of the dancers onto their own bodies, so reality and projection slip out of sync.
works.description_zh: 带有黑色电影和恐怖片风格的舞蹈作品：影像系统把舞者经过动画风格化处理的实时复制品投到他们自己的身体上，让现实与投影彼此错位。
works.idea_en: Your own live double, projected onto you, starts to behave suspiciously.
works.idea_zh: 投在你身上的实时分身，开始变得可疑。
works.technique: Live cameras capture the dancers, the feed is stylised with computer animation and re-projected onto the bodies with deliberate offsets and delays.
works.technique_zh: 现场摄像机拍下舞者，画面经计算机动画风格化处理后，带着刻意的偏移和延迟再投回他们身上。
works.exercise_en: Aim a projector and webcam at the same person, apply an edge or cartoon filter, and project it back onto them with a one-second delay. Twist: the projection starts moving before the person does.
works.exercise_zh: 让投影仪和摄像头对准同一个人，加上描边或卡通滤镜，延迟一秒投回他身上；变体：投影开始比人先动。

video.video_title: Cie Nicole Seiler - Shiver (2014), teaser

works.title: Shogyo Mujo (with Josh Harker)
works.description: A large white skull sculpture designed with artist Josh Harker is wrapped in 360° projection that makes it crack, bloom, burn and change skin. Made for Burning Man 2014, it was shown at Adobe MAX 2014 and SIGGRAPH 2015 Emerging Technologies before travelling to AREA15.
works.description_zh: 一座与艺术家 Josh Harker 共同设计的巨大白色骷髅雕塑，被 360° 投影包裹，看上去会开裂、开花、燃烧、更换表皮。作品为 2014 年 Burning Man 而作，曾在 2014 年 Adobe MAX 和 2015 年 SIGGRAPH 新兴技术展出，后来进驻 AREA15。
works.idea_en: A neutral white form is the perfect AR target: one physical shape can carry infinite materials and stories.
works.idea_zh: 中性的白色形体是完美的 AR 载体：一个实体形状可以承载无穷的材质和故事。
works.technique: Several projectors surround the sculpture and are calibrated to its 3D model, so textures wrap seamlessly all the way around.
works.technique_zh: 多台投影机环绕雕塑，并按其三维模型校准，使纹理无缝包覆整个外表。
works.exercise_en: 3D-print or buy a small white object, scan it, and use Vuforia Model Targets or Lens Studio object tracking to apply changing AR materials to it. Twist: the material changes each time a viewer walks a quarter turn around it.
works.exercise_zh: 3D 打印或买一个白色小物件，扫描后用 Vuforia Model Targets 或 Lens Studio 物体追踪给它叠加不断变化的 AR 材质；变体：观众每绕它走四分之一圈，材质就变换一次。

video.video_title: ‘Shogyo Mujo’ - Emerging Technologies Siggraph 2015

works.title: Shylight
works.description: Silk lamps descend from a high ceiling and bloom open like flowers, then close and shrink back upward, performing a slow choreography.
works.description_zh: 丝绸灯从高高的天花板降下，像花一样绽放，然后闭合，缩回上方，演出一段缓慢的舞蹈。
works.idea_en: An object that opens and closes feels like it breathes and has moods; AR objects gain life from simple cycles of growth and retreat.
works.idea_zh: 会开合的物体就像在呼吸、有情绪；AR 物体也能从简单的生长与退缩循环中获得生命。
works.technique: Motorised cables lower each lamp while an internal mechanism unfolds layered silk skirts, driven by programmed sequences.
works.technique_zh: 电机驱动的线缆放下每盏灯，内部机构展开层层丝绸裙摆，由编程序列驱动。
works.exercise_en: Hang three AR lamps from a real ceiling that descend and bloom when nobody looks at them and shyly close when the camera points at them. Twist: make one lamp brave so it keeps blooming under attention.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实的天花板上挂三盏 AR 灯：没人看时它们降下并绽放，摄像头一对准就害羞地合上。变体：让其中一盏灯很勇敢，被注视时仍然继续绽放。

video.video_title: SHYLIGHT | by DRIFT

works.title: Silhouettes
works.description: People walking past a wall see their shadows painted onto it in swirling fluid colours that linger after they move on.
works.description_zh: 从墙前走过的人会看到自己的影子被画成旋转流动的彩色液体，人走开后颜色还会停留一会儿。
works.idea_en: Paint walls with your shadow.
works.idea_zh: 用你的影子给墙上色。
works.technique: A Kinect calibrated to the projector with his toolkit feeds body contours into a fluid simulation (ofxFluid) that is projected back aligned with the real shadow.
works.technique_zh: 用他的工具包把 Kinect 与投影仪校准，身体轮廓输入流体模拟（ofxFluid），再对齐真实影子投回墙上。
works.exercise_en: Use webcam segmentation to inject colour into a fluid simulation wherever a person's shadow falls on a projected wall. Twist: each visitor gets their own colour that mixes with others.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头人像分割，把颜色注入流体模拟，落在人影在投影墙上的位置。变体：每位观众有自己的颜色，与别人的颜色混合。

video.video_title: Silhouettes @ Saigon Ranger

works.title: Sketch Town
works.description: Hand-drawn cars, buildings and UFOs are scanned into a shared 3D projected town where they drive and fly, and can be touched.
works.idea_zh: 手绘的车与房子进入共享的投影城市

video.video_title: Sketch Town / FUTURE WORLD: WHERE ART MEETS SCIENCE

works.technique: Scanned template drawings are UV-mapped onto 3D vehicle and building models and inserted into a shared projected city, with sensors detecting touch on the projection.
works.exercise_zh: 让同学在模板上画房子和车辆，扫描后贴图到简单模型上并放进投影城市；变体：规定每件作品都必须和别人的作品发生一次互动（碰撞、接送、连接）。
works.description_zh: 手绘的汽车、房屋和 UFO 被扫描进一座共享的三维投影小镇，在那里行驶、飞翔，还能被触摸。
works.idea_en: Hand-drawn cars and houses move into a shared projected city.
works.technique_zh: 扫描后的模板画作通过 UV 映射贴到三维车辆和建筑模型上，放入共享的投影城市中，传感器负责检测对投影的触摸。
works.exercise_en: Have classmates draw houses and vehicles on templates, then scan them, texture them onto simple models and put them into a projected city. Twist: every piece must interact with someone else's piece at least once (collide, pick up, connect).

works.title: SketchyFx
works.description: A 3D scene with a walking robot is rendered as if it were drawn in pencil on crumpled paper.
works.description_zh: 一个有机器人走动的 3D 场景被渲染得像是用铅笔画在皱纸上。
works.idea_en: Stack standard image effects to get a hand-drawn look.
works.idea_zh: 只靠叠加标准图像效果，得到手绘的质感。
works.technique: Edge detection, grayscale conversion and pencil and paper texture overlays from Unity's standard image effects are chained into a sketch filter.
works.technique_zh: 把 Unity 标准图像效果中的边缘检测、灰度转换以及铅笔和纸张纹理叠加串联起来，组成一个素描滤镜。
works.exercise_en: Apply a pencil-sketch filter to the AR camera image so the real room looks drawn, while virtual objects stay in full color. Twist: reverse it so only virtual objects look sketched.
works.exercise_zh: 给 AR 相机画面加上铅笔素描滤镜，让真实房间看起来像手绘，而虚拟物体保持全彩；变体：反过来，只让虚拟物体变成素描。

video.video_title: Sketch filter with the standard image effects (Unity)

works.title: Skies Painted with Unnumbered Sparks
works.description: A 745-foot net sculpture floats between buildings in Vancouver; at night visitors choreograph the projected light on it in real time with gestures on their phones.
works.description_zh: 一座长 745 英尺的网状雕塑漂浮在温哥华的建筑之间；夜里，观众用手机上的手势实时编排投射在网上的灯光。
works.idea_en: Phones in the crowd can paint on a shared canvas in the sky; the same model works for AR, where many small inputs add up to one large shared image.
works.idea_zh: 人群手中的手机可以在天空中的共享画布上作画；AR 也可以用同样的模式，让许多微小的输入汇成一幅巨大的共享图像。
works.technique: Projectors map light onto the suspended net while a web app, made with Aaron Koblin, turns visitors' touch gestures into light trails in real time.
works.technique_zh: 投影仪把光映射到悬挂的网上，与 Aaron Koblin 合作的网页应用把观众的触摸手势实时转化为光的轨迹。
works.exercise_en: Build a shared WebXR sky canvas anchored above a courtyard where each phone's swipe leaves a coloured light trail that everyone else sees. Twist: trails fade faster when too many people draw at once, forcing the crowd to take turns.
works.exercise_zh: 做一块锚定在庭院上空的共享 WebXR 天空画布，每部手机的滑动都会留下一道彩色光轨，所有人都能看到。变体：同时作画的人太多时光轨消失得更快，迫使人群轮流作画。

video.video_title: Skies Painted with Unnumbered Sparks: Interactive Lighting

works.title: SlicerFx
works.description: Every surface in the scene is cut into thin glowing stripes that slide along, as if the world were being scanned slice by slice.
works.description_zh: 场景里的每个表面都被切成细细的发光条纹并不断滑动，好像整个世界正被一层层扫描。
works.idea_en: Make a 3D scene look like it is being scanned in slices.
works.idea_zh: 让 3D 场景看起来像正在被逐层扫描。
works.technique: A replacement shader computes each fragment's world position and discards or lights it depending on where that position falls within a repeating slice interval, which runs even on Unity Free.
works.technique_zh: 替换着色器计算每个片元的世界坐标，根据它落在重复切片间隔中的位置决定丢弃还是点亮，因此在 Unity 免费版中也能运行。
works.exercise_en: Apply the slicing stripe shader to the LiDAR scene mesh from AR Foundation so the real room appears to be scanned in bands. Twist: let the bands start from wherever the user taps.
works.exercise_zh: 把切片条纹着色器应用到 AR Foundation 的 LiDAR 场景网格上，让真实房间看起来被一条条扫描；变体：让条纹从用户点击的位置开始扩散。

video.video_title: SlicerFx - Surface Slicing Full Screen Effect for Unity

works.title: SonarFx
works.description: Rings of light pulse outward across every surface, like a sonar wave revealing a dark scene.
works.description_zh: 一圈圈光环在所有表面上向外扩散，像声呐波揭示出黑暗中的场景。
works.idea_en: Reveal a space with an expanding pulse of light.
works.idea_zh: 用一道不断扩散的光脉冲来揭示一个空间。
works.technique: A replacement shader measures each fragment's distance from an origin point in world space and adds moving emissive bands with a sharp wavefront and fading tail.
works.technique_zh: 替换着色器计算每个片元到世界空间原点的距离，叠加移动的发光条带，前沿锐利，尾部渐隐。
works.exercise_en: Put the sonar shader on the AR mesh of a room so pulses spread out from the phone's position. Twist: trigger a new pulse whenever the microphone hears a clap.
works.exercise_zh: 把声呐着色器加到房间的 AR 网格上，让脉冲从手机的位置向外扩散；变体：麦克风每听到一次拍手就触发一道新的脉冲。

video.video_title: SonarFx - Full Screen Sonar Effect for Unity

works.title: Spotlight Stories
works.description: Animated short films made for the phone: you hold the phone up like a window and turn around to follow the story unfolding all around you, and the story waits for you to look.
works.description_zh: 为手机打造的动画短片：你把手机举起来当作一扇窗，转身跟随在你四周展开的故事，而故事会等你看过去再继续。
works.idea_en: Let the viewer hold the camera, and let the story wait for their attention.
works.idea_zh: 让观众掌控镜头，让故事等待观众的注意力。
works.technique: Phone orientation sensors drive the virtual camera in a real-time rendered 360° scene, with story beats triggered when the viewer looks at the right place.
works.technique_zh: 手机的方向传感器驱动实时渲染的 360° 场景中的虚拟相机，当观众看向正确位置时触发故事节点。
works.exercise_en: Make a 360° phone scene with three story beats placed around the viewer, each triggered only when they look at it. Twist: the story's ending depends on which beat they saw last.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个 360° 手机场景，在观众周围放三个故事节点，只有看向它时才触发。变体：故事结局取决于观众最后看到的是哪个节点。

video.video_title: Spotlight Stories presents: Spotlight on... The Beginning

works.title: Still
works.description: A mirrored man stands in the water of Loch Earn near St Fillians, reflecting the loch, the sky and the hills; the local community reinstalled it in 2023.
works.description_zh: 一个镜面人站在圣菲伦斯附近 Loch Earn 湖的水中，映出湖面、天空与山丘；当地社区在 2023 年重新安装了它。
works.idea_en: A figure standing in water that only shows water is a clean example of camouflage through reflection, useful for subtle AR presence.
works.idea_zh: 一个站在水中、只显示水的人形，是借助反射实现伪装的简洁例子，对含蓄的 AR 存在感很有用。
works.technique: A stainless-steel figure polished to a mirror finish is fixed on a base under the water surface.
works.technique_zh: 一个抛光至镜面的不锈钢人形固定在水面下的底座上。
works.exercise_en: Place a mirrored AR figure standing in a real pond or fountain with a screen-space reflection shader and film it at dawn and dusk. Twist: its reflection shows a different time of day than the real scene.
works.exercise_zh: 用屏幕空间反射着色器，在真实的池塘或喷泉中放置一个站立的镜面 AR 人形，并在黎明和黄昏拍摄；变体：它的倒影显示与真实场景不同的时刻。

video.video_title: ' Still ' aka Mirror man sculpture in Loch Earn, Scotland

works.title: Street installations
works.description: Life-size figures cast in packing tape and dressed in real clothes are placed in odd situations in the street (head in a wall, lying in a fountain); the video shows his piece for Nuit Blanche Paris 2014.
works.description_zh: 用封箱胶带翻制、穿着真衣服的等身人像被放在街头的奇怪情境中（头插进墙里、躺在喷泉中）；视频展示了他为 2014 年巴黎 Nuit Blanche 创作的作品。
works.idea_en: Realistic bodies in impossible poses test people's reactions, which is the social experiment behind every public AR character.
works.idea_zh: 以不可能的姿势出现的逼真身体测试了人们的反应，这正是每个公共 AR 角色背后的社会实验。
works.technique: Tape is wrapped around a model's body (sticky side out, then over), cut off and reassembled, then dressed and placed.
works.technique_zh: 用胶带缠绕模特身体（先粘面朝外，再覆盖一层），剪下后重新拼合，穿上衣服后放置到位。
works.exercise_en: Place a photoreal AR person in an absurd pose (half inside a wall, face down in a planter) and record passers-by through the phone. Twist: the figure changes pose when nobody is looking.
works.exercise_zh: 放置一个以荒诞姿势出现的逼真 AR 人物（半截身子在墙里、脸朝下埋在花盆里），并通过手机记录路人反应；变体：没人看时人物会改变姿势。

video.video_title: Nuit Blanche 2014 : Mark Jenkins

works.title: TRANSFORM
works.description: Three large shape displays form dynamic furniture shown at Milan Design Week: the surface flows like water, reacts to bodies and carries objects around.
works.idea_zh: 一张会像海浪一样起伏、能自己搬运物品的'活'桌子。

video.video_title: TRANSFORM: Nature and Machine by MIT Media Lab | Tangible Media Group

works.technique: Three shape displays run choreographed height-map animations and physics-style wave simulations, with Kinect tracking of visitors' bodies modulating the motion.
works.exercise_zh: 在 TouchDesigner 或 three.js 中做一张由上百根柱子组成的“流体桌面”，用摄像头检测人的位置让波纹从人身边荡开，投影到真实桌面上；变体：让桌面把一个虚拟物体“运送”到站在桌边的某个人面前。
works.description_zh: 在米兰设计周展出的动态家具，由三块大型形状显示器组成：表面像水一样流动，会对人的身体作出反应，还能把物品搬来搬去。
works.idea_en: A living table that heaves like ocean waves and carries objects around by itself.
works.technique_zh: 三块形状显示器运行编排好的高度图动画和物理风格的波浪模拟，并通过 Kinect 追踪观众身体来调制运动。
works.exercise_en: Build a "fluid tabletop" of hundreds of pillars in TouchDesigner or three.js, use a camera to detect people so ripples spread from wherever they stand, and project it onto a real table. Twist: have the table "deliver" a virtual object to one particular person standing beside it.

works.title: Take my lightning but don't steal my thunder
works.description: In Covent Garden Piazza, the top half of a classical stone building appears to float in the air, cut cleanly from its base, with no visible support.
works.description_zh: 在伦敦 Covent Garden 广场，一座古典石头建筑的上半部分似乎被整齐地切离底座，漂浮在空中，看不到任何支撑。
works.idea_en: A levitating building is a classic AR demo made physical; the hidden support shows how illusions depend on concealed anchors.
works.idea_zh: 一栋悬浮的建筑是经典 AR 演示的实体版；隐藏的支撑说明了错觉如何依赖被遮蔽的锚点。
works.technique: The upper section is built on a single hidden steel support concealed within the gap and the building's structure.
works.technique_zh: 上半部分依靠一根隐藏在缝隙和建筑结构中的钢支撑建造。
works.exercise_en: Scan a small building or kiosk and make its top half lift off and float in AR, leaving a clean cut. Twist: the gap widens as more people stand underneath.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描一座小建筑或售货亭，在 AR 中让它的上半部分抬起漂浮，留下整齐的切口；变体：站在下面的人越多，缝隙越宽。

video.video_title: Alex Chinneck Installation in Covent Garden - ‘Take my Lightning but Don’t Steal my Thunder’

works.title: The ADA Project
works.description: An industrial robot named ADA holds a light at the end of its arm and 'dances' to pieces by different composers, drawing arcs of light in a dark room.
works.description_zh: 一台名为 ADA 的工业机械臂末端握着一盏灯，随不同作曲家的作品“起舞”，在黑暗房间中画出光弧。
works.idea_en: A robot becomes a dancer when its motion follows music — AR characters don't need faces, only well-timed movement.
works.idea_zh: 当机械臂的运动跟随音乐时，它就成了舞者——AR 角色不需要脸，只需要恰到好处的运动。
works.technique: A six-axis industrial robot is programmed with motion paths synchronized to each commissioned score, with a lamp as its end effector.
works.technique_zh: 六轴工业机器人被编入与每首委约乐曲同步的运动路径，末端装着一盏灯。
works.exercise_en: Program a virtual robotic arm in AR with a light at its tip to dance to a 30-second track, and record its light trails as a long exposure. Twist: let a classmate compose the music and swap tracks without changing the motion.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中编程一只末端带灯的虚拟机械臂，随 30 秒音乐起舞，并把光轨录成长曝光。变体：让同学作曲，在不改动作的情况下换曲，看感受如何变化。

video.video_title: Robotics, sculpture and music: Conrad Shawcross's The ADA Project

works.title: The Measures Taken
works.description: Five dancers perform inside projected lines, particles and light planes that are generated from their own tracked movement in real time, so the set keeps redrawing itself around their bodies.
works.description_zh: 五位舞者在投影的线条、粒子和光面中起舞，这些影像由他们被追踪的动作实时生成，布景随身体不断重新绘制。
works.idea_en: A stage that is drawn by the way a machine 'sees' the dancers.
works.idea_zh: 舞台由机器“看见”舞者的方式绘制出来。
works.technique: Motion-tracking cameras (likely Kinect-style depth sensors) capture the dancers' positions and skeletons, and Marshmallow Laser Feast's real-time graphics project responsive visuals onto the stage and scrims.
works.technique_zh: 动作追踪摄像头（很可能是类似 Kinect 的深度传感器）捕捉舞者的位置和骨架，Marshmallow Laser Feast 的实时图形系统据此把响应式影像投到舞台和纱幕上。
works.exercise_en: Point a webcam and a projector at a wall, run a body-tracking sketch (MediaPipe or TouchDesigner) and draw lines that connect each student's joints to the nearest wall edge while they dance. Twist: make the lines lag by two seconds, so dancers duet with their own recent past.
works.exercise_zh: 把网络摄像头和投影仪对准一面墙，运行一个人体追踪程序（MediaPipe 或 TouchDesigner），在学生跳舞时画出连接各关节与墙边的线条；变体：让线条延迟两秒，舞者就能与刚才的自己共舞。

video.video_title: The Measures Taken Promo

works.title: The Numberlys IMAG-N-O-TRON
works.description: A companion app for the printed picture book The Numberlys: pointing an iPad at the pages makes the art-deco number characters and the letters they invent spring off the paper as animated 3D scenes with sound.
works.description_zh: 印刷绘本 The Numberlys 的配套应用：把 iPad 对准书页，装饰艺术风格的数字角色和它们发明的字母就从纸上跃出，变成带声音的 3D 动画场景。
works.idea_en: The printed book stays the main object; the tablet is a lens that animates what is already on the page.
works.idea_zh: 纸书始终是主角，平板只是一片让书页内容动起来的镜片。
works.technique: Likely natural-feature image tracking of each illustrated spread, with pre-authored 3D animation anchored to the page.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是对每一跨页插图做自然特征图像追踪，再把预先制作的 3D 动画锚定到书页上。
works.exercise_en: Pick a favorite children's book page, scan it as an image target, and animate one character stepping out of the illustration with a sound effect. Twist: the character should only appear when a second reader covers a specific word with a finger.
works.exercise_zh: 挑一页喜欢的儿童绘本，把它设为图像标记，让其中一个角色伴随音效从插画里走出来。变体：只有当另一位读者用手指盖住某个特定单词时，角色才会出现。

video.video_title: THE NUMBERLYS IMAG•N•O•TRON™

works.title: Thermal Touch
works.description: A prototype for smart glasses in which any surface, such as a poster, wall or car, becomes a touchscreen: an infrared camera sees the warm spot a finger leaves and triggers the AR content there.
works.description_zh: 一个为智能眼镜设计的原型：海报、墙面或汽车等任何表面都能变成触摸屏——红外摄像头看到手指留下的余温点，就在那里触发 AR 内容。
works.idea_en: The heat your fingertip leaves behind is the click.
works.idea_zh: 指尖留下的余温，就是一次点击。
works.technique: A thermal camera and a standard camera are calibrated together; residual heat from a touch is detected in the infrared image and mapped onto the tracked surface's AR coordinates.
works.technique_zh: 把热成像摄像头与普通摄像头联合标定；从红外图像中检测触摸后残留的热量，再映射到被追踪表面的 AR 坐标上。
works.exercise_en: Fake Thermal Touch with a normal camera: track a printed poster, detect a finger dwell on it via hand tracking, and leave a slowly fading glow at each touch point. Twist: make the glow fade at a rate based on how long the finger stayed.
works.exercise_zh: 用普通摄像头模拟 Thermal Touch：追踪一张打印海报，通过手部追踪检测手指在上面的停留，并在每个触点留下慢慢消退的光晕。变体：让光晕的消退速度取决于手指停留的时长。

video.video_title: Thermal Touch from Metaio  - A New Augmented Reality Interface for Wearables

salient.why_en: The warm spot your fingertip leaves on any surface becomes the click.
salient.why_zh: 指尖在任何表面上留下的余温就是一次点击。

works.title: Torque starter
works.description: Performer Yusaku Mochizuki juggles and spins real props while projected gears, sparks and machine parts react to every throw and catch.
works.description_zh: 表演者望月勇佑抛接、旋转真实道具，投影出的齿轮、火花和机械零件对每一次抛接做出反应。
works.idea_en: Mixing a real prop with virtual consequences is more convincing than a fully virtual object; AR shines when a real thing triggers the effect.
works.idea_zh: 真实道具加上虚拟后果比完全虚拟的物体更可信；当真实的东西触发特效时，AR 最有魅力。
works.technique: Pre-rendered animation is timed to a rehearsed juggling routine so projected effects start at each catch.
works.technique_zh: 预渲染动画与排练好的杂技动作对时，让投影特效在每一次接住时开始。
works.exercise_en: Track a real ball with object or colour tracking on a phone and spawn AR sparks and gears whenever it is caught. Twist: a missed catch makes the whole machine stall.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机的物体或颜色追踪识别一个真实的球，每次接住时生成 AR 火花和齿轮；变体：没接住，整台机器就会卡住停转。

video.video_title: enra " Torque starter "

works.title: Towards AR User Interfaces in 3D Media Production
works.description: A 3D artist models and animates with virtual objects floating over the real desk, using hand gestures in a headset instead of mouse and keyboard.
works.description_zh: 三维艺术家在头显中用手势对漂浮在真实桌面上方的虚拟物体进行建模和动画制作，而不是用鼠标和键盘。
works.idea_en: Bring professional 3D modelling off the monitor and into the space above your desk.
works.idea_zh: 把专业三维建模从显示器上搬到桌面上方的空间里。
works.technique: Likely combines a stereo HMD with 3D hand tracking to map familiar content-creation commands onto direct spatial manipulation.
works.technique_zh: 很可能把立体头显与三维手部追踪结合，把熟悉的内容创作命令映射为直接的空间操作。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone AR sculpting or drawing app to model a simple object above your desk, then time the same task in a desktop 3D tool. Twist: work in pairs where one person only moves the camera.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 雕刻或绘画 App 在桌面上方建一个简单模型，再用桌面三维软件完成同样任务并计时对比；变体：两人合作，其中一人只负责移动相机。

video.video_title: ISMAR 2014Demo Video:"Towards Augmented Reality user interfaces in 3D media production"

works.title: Towards User-Perspective AR for Public Displays
works.description: A tablet held in front of a public screen, such as a ski-resort map, shows that screen's live content as if the tablet were clear glass, rendered from the user's eye position rather than the camera's, with extra information layered on top.
works.description_zh: 把平板举到公共显示屏（比如滑雪场地图屏）前，平板会像一块透明玻璃一样显示那块屏幕的实时内容，画面按用户眼睛而非相机的位置渲染，并在上面叠加额外信息。
works.idea_en: Make the handheld truly see-through, from your eyes rather than the camera's.
works.idea_zh: 让手持设备真正“透明”——从你的眼睛而不是相机的角度看出去。
works.technique: The tablet decodes a QR code to receive the display's screencast over the network, tracks the display with natural-feature tracking, and re-renders the content with a user-perspective projection.
works.technique_zh: 平板解码二维码后通过网络接收公共屏幕的屏幕流，用自然特征追踪定位屏幕，再以用户视角投影重新渲染内容。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR app that tracks a poster and shows it through the phone like a window, using front-camera face tracking to match the rendering to the viewer's eye position. Twist: tilt the phone to peek behind the poster into a hidden layer.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 应用，追踪一张海报并把手机当成窗户来显示它，用前置相机的人脸追踪让渲染匹配观看者眼睛的位置。变体：倾斜手机就能从海报后面偷看到一个隐藏图层。

video.video_title: Towards User Perspective  Augmented Reality for Public Displays

works.title: Trois ellipses ouvertes en désordre
works.description: Across the roofs and facades of 99 buildings in Hasselt, three open ellipses become whole only from the hotel sky lounge; walking the streets, people meet puzzling orange fragments.
works.description_zh: 在哈瑟尔特 99 栋建筑的屋顶和立面上，三个开口椭圆只有从酒店顶层的空中酒廊才能看完整；走在街上，人们只会遇到令人困惑的橙色碎片。
works.idea_en: A work can have two lives, fragments on the ground and a whole image from above: AR city games can hide pieces in the street and reveal the full shape only from a high viewpoint.
works.idea_zh: 作品可以有两种生命：地面上的碎片和高处看到的整体图像。AR 城市游戏可以把碎片藏在街道里，只在高处的视点揭示完整形状。
works.technique: The ellipses are likely drawn by projecting from the lounge viewpoint and painting the resulting shapes onto rooftops and walls, so each fragment is a precise piece of one perspective projection.
works.technique_zh: 椭圆很可能是从酒廊的观看点投影、再把得到的形状画到屋顶和墙上，因此每块碎片都是同一透视投影中精确的一部分。
works.exercise_en: Use geospatial anchors (ARCore Geospatial or Niantic) to scatter fragments of one shape across three streets, visible as a whole only from a rooftop or bridge. Twist: collect fragments on foot first; each collected piece lights up in the rooftop view.
works.exercise_zh: 用地理空间锚点（ARCore Geospatial 或 Niantic）把一个图形的碎片分散在三条街上，只有从屋顶或桥上才能看全。变体：先步行收集碎片，每收集一块，它就在屋顶视角里亮起来。

video.video_title: De Unie Hasselt-Genk: The making of Trois ellipses ouvertes en désordre - Felice Varini

works.title: UNION 3
works.description: A wind-driven kinetic sculpture in Qingdao, China, that combines turning stainless-steel forms with coloured light, so it changes from a daytime sculpture into a night-time light work.
works.description_zh: 位于中国青岛的一座风动雕塑，旋转的不锈钢形体与彩色灯光结合，白天是雕塑，夜晚变成光的作品。
works.idea_en: Designing for both day and night states is essential in outdoor AR, where lighting conditions change what content reads well.
works.idea_zh: 为白天和夜晚分别设计状态，在户外 AR 中至关重要，因为光照条件会改变内容的可读性。
works.technique: Wind turns the steel elements while integrated LEDs colour them after dark, adding a second, programmable layer to the physical motion (year approximate).
works.technique_zh: 风转动钢构件，内置 LED 在天黑后为其着色，为物理运动叠加一层可编程的第二层次（年份为估计）。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR sculpture that switches between a reflective day material and a glowing night material using the device's ambient light estimate. Twist: let the colour follow the city's live temperature.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 雕塑，根据设备的环境光估计在白天反光材质和夜晚发光材质之间切换。变体：让颜色跟随城市的实时气温。

video.video_title: Ralfonso UNION 3 Kinetic Wind, Light & Color Sculpture in Qingdao, China

works.title: VJ01: Guitar Songs
works.description: An experimental visual generator made in Unity animates abstract forms to guitar music by Masaya Matsuura.
works.description_zh: 一个用 Unity 做的实验性视觉生成器，随着松浦雅也的吉他音乐驱动抽象形体。
works.idea_en: A generative visual system that listens to a song.
works.idea_zh: 一个会“听”歌曲的生成式视觉系统。
works.technique: Audio levels analysed in Unity drive procedural geometry, colors and camera moves, likely through an early version of Keijiro's Reaktion toolkit.
works.technique_zh: Unity 中分析出的音频电平驱动程序化几何体、颜色和镜头运动，很可能用的是 Keijiro 早期版本的 Reaktion 工具包。
works.exercise_en: Feed the phone microphone's spectrum into an AR scene where one object per frequency band grows and glows on a table. Twist: pick a song and have each student design the object for one instrument.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机麦克风的频谱接入 AR 场景，让桌面上每个频段对应的物体随之变大、发光；变体：选一首歌，每位学生为其中一种乐器设计一个物体。

video.video_title: VJ01: Guitar Songs

works.title: VJ02
works.description: Scrolling abstract geometry, spheres and shifting camera angles are performed live with a MIDI controller as club visuals for Channel #8.
works.description_zh: 滚动的抽象几何、球体和不断变换的镜头角度，被 VJ 用 MIDI 控制器现场演奏，作为 Channel #8 夜店活动的视觉。
works.idea_en: Play a 3D game-engine scene like an instrument, with faders.
works.idea_zh: 像演奏乐器一样，用推子现场操控一个 3D 游戏引擎场景。
works.technique: The Reaktion toolkit maps audio levels and MIDI CC faders (a KORG nanoKONTROL) to scroll speed, object selection and camera yaw and pitch in a Unity scene.
works.technique_zh: Reaktion 工具包把音频电平和 MIDI CC 推子（KORG nanoKONTROL）映射到 Unity 场景中的滚动速度、物体选择以及镜头的偏航和俯仰。
works.exercise_en: Build a small AR stage on a table and map three on-screen or MIDI sliders to scroll speed, object type and camera angle. Twist: let loud sounds from the microphone override the sliders.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌面上搭一个小型 AR 舞台，把三个屏幕滑块或 MIDI 推子映射到滚动速度、物体类型和镜头角度；变体：麦克风听到大声音时，自动接管滑块。

video.video_title: VJ02 - VJing software

works.title: Van Gogh Path
works.description: In Nuenen, where Van Gogh lived, a one-kilometre bicycle path is inlaid with thousands of stones that charge in daylight and glow at night in swirls inspired by The Starry Night.
works.description_zh: 在梵高曾经生活的纽南，一条一公里长的自行车道镶嵌着成千上万颗白天吸收光、夜间发光的石子，形成受《星月夜》启发的漩涡图案。
works.idea_en: A path that becomes a painting when you ride it at night ties art to movement and route, a model for AR guidance lines with character.
works.idea_zh: 一条在夜间骑行时就变成画作的小路，把艺术与移动和路线联系起来，是有个性的 AR 引导线的范本。
works.technique: Glow-in-the-dark stones and solar-powered LEDs are set into the path surface in a swirl pattern.
works.technique_zh: 夜光石和太阳能 LED 以漩涡图案嵌入路面。
works.exercise_en: Draw a glowing AR path that swirls along a real footpath and brightens under each walker's feet. Twist: the pattern is generated from a famous painting chosen by the user.
works.exercise_zh: 沿一条真实的步道画出一条旋转发光的 AR 小路，在每位行人脚下变亮；变体：图案由用户选择的一幅名画生成。

video.video_title: VAN GOGH PATH | Glowing path inspired by Starry Night by Studio Roosegaarde [OFFICIAL MOVIE]

works.title: Visions of America: Amériques
works.description: Inside Walt Disney Concert Hall, projections explode across the hall in response to the gestures and body language of conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen performing Varèse's Amériques.
works.idea_zh: 让指挥家的手势实时“指挥”整座音乐厅的投影
works.technique: A depth camera (Kinect) tracks the conductor's gestures and maps them to real-time generative visuals projected onto the hall's interior surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 用MediaPipe Pose追踪一位同学“指挥”的手臂动作，控制投影粒子的爆发和方向；变化：让全班演奏简单节奏，指挥手势决定哪一组的画面亮起。

video.video_title: Projecting a new immersive experience inside L.A.'s Disney Hall

works.description_zh: 在华特·迪士尼音乐厅内，指挥家 Esa-Pekka Salonen 演绎瓦雷兹（Varèse）的《美洲》（Amériques）时，投影随着他的手势和肢体语言在整个音乐厅中迸发。
works.idea_en: Let a conductor's gestures conduct the projections across an entire concert hall in real time.
works.technique_zh: 深度相机（Kinect）追踪指挥的手势，并将其映射为实时生成的视觉影像，投射到音乐厅的内部表面上。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Pose to track a classmate's "conducting" arm movements and control the bursts and direction of projected particles. Twist: have the class play a simple rhythm, with the conductor's gestures deciding which group's visuals light up.

works.title: Waltz Binaire — Dance and Interactive Media (Diesel Reboot)
works.description: A rehearsal of a piece for Diesel's Reboot campaign at Schauspielhaus Frankfurt where two dancers mixing urban and contemporary movement drive interactive graphics projected around them.
works.description_zh: 为 Diesel Reboot 活动在法兰克福话剧院演出的作品排练：两位融合街舞与现代舞的舞者驱动投影在他们周围的交互图形。
works.idea_en: A laptop, a Kinect and a projector are enough to make spontaneous dance visible.
works.idea_zh: 一台笔记本、一个 Kinect 和一台投影仪，就足以让即兴舞蹈变得可见。
works.technique: A low-weight setup of Kinect, notebook and projector evaluates the dancers' movement and renders interactive graphics designed to react to improvisation.
works.technique_zh: 由 Kinect、笔记本和投影仪组成的轻量系统，分析舞者的动作并渲染专为即兴设计的交互图形。
works.exercise_en: Pack a portable kit (laptop, webcam, pocket projector) and build a sketch that responds to two people at once, then perform it in a hallway. Twist: the graphics connect the two dancers with a line that breaks if they get too far apart.
works.exercise_zh: 准备一套便携设备（笔记本、摄像头、口袋投影仪），做一个能同时响应两个人的草图，然后在走廊里表演；变体：图形用一条线连接两位舞者，他们离得太远线就会断。

video.video_title: Waltz Binaire | Dance and interactive Media

works.title: Warning: A Wearable Electronic Dress Prototype
works.description: A stage costume whose servo-driven collar, inspired by the frill-necked lizard and the Elizabethan ruff, flares when someone comes close, while stripes of conductive paint on the body let the performer play the music by touch.
works.description_zh: 一件舞台服装：受伞蜥和伊丽莎白时代轮状领启发的舵机领子在有人靠近时张开，身上几道导电漆条纹则让表演者通过触摸演奏音乐。
works.idea_en: A costume that reacts to personal space like an animal.
works.idea_zh: 一件像动物一样对个人空间作出反应的服装。
works.technique: An ultrasonic sensor measures proximity and drives four servos in the collar, and six conductive-paint stripes act as touch inputs sending MIDI.
works.technique_zh: 超声波传感器测量距离，驱动领子里的四个舵机；六道导电漆条纹作为触摸输入发送 MIDI。
works.exercise_en: Prototype a wearable with an Arduino, one distance sensor and one servo that opens a paper collar when someone enters your personal space. Twist: make it close again only if the visitor speaks softly.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Arduino、一个距离传感器和一个舵机做一件可穿戴原型：有人进入你的个人空间时，纸做的领子就张开；变体：只有当对方轻声说话时，领子才重新合上。

video.video_title: Warning: A Wearable Electronic Dress Prototype

works.title: Watch Your Privacy
works.description: A Google Glass app shows surveillance cameras around the wearer, plus the live positions of other Glass users.
works.description_zh: 一款 Google Glass 应用，在佩戴者周围标出监控摄像头的位置，以及其他 Glass 用户的实时位置。
works.idea_en: Turn the watchers into the watched.
works.idea_zh: 让监视者变成被监视的人。
works.technique: OpenStreetMap's surveillance-camera data and shared GPS positions of Glass users are drawn as a real-time location overlay in the head-worn display.
works.technique_zh: 把 OpenStreetMap 中的监控摄像头数据和 Glass 用户共享的 GPS 位置，作为实时位置叠加层显示在头戴屏幕上。
works.exercise_en: Map the cameras on your campus into a small dataset and build a phone-AR overlay that marks them with viewing cones. Twist: add a 'blind-spot route' that avoids every cone.
works.exercise_zh: 把校园里的摄像头整理成一个小数据集，做一个用视锥标出它们的手机 AR 叠加层。变体：加一条避开所有视锥的“盲区路线”。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality and privacy?

works.title: Water Drops (pseudo refraction)
works.description: Clear water drops roll through a scene, bending and reflecting the environment behind them.
works.description_zh: 透明的水滴在场景中滚动，折射并反射着身后的环境。
works.idea_en: Fake refraction cheaply enough to use it everywhere.
works.idea_zh: 用足够便宜的方式假装折射，可以随处使用。
works.technique: A pseudo refraction shader samples an environment cube map along a bent view vector and mixes in reflections with a Fresnel term, simulating only the first refraction.
works.technique_zh: 伪折射着色器沿着偏折后的视线方向采样环境立方体贴图，并用菲涅尔项混合反射，只模拟第一次折射。
works.exercise_en: Drop virtual water blobs on a real table in AR and use the AR environment probe as the cube map so they refract the real room. Twist: let the blobs merge when they touch.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把虚拟水滴放到真实桌面上，并用 AR 环境探针作为立方体贴图，让水滴折射真实房间；变体：水滴相碰时融合在一起。

video.video_title: Water Drops (HDR)

works.title: Waterlily Invasion
works.description: Mutated AR water lilies that feed on the mediated human gaze grow and engulf viewers who keep looking at them through their phones.
works.description_zh: 变异的 AR 睡莲以人类透过屏幕的凝视为食，谁盯着它们看得越久，就会被长大的睡莲吞没。
works.idea_en: The more you look, the bigger it grows.
works.idea_zh: 你看得越久，它长得越大。
works.technique: A geolocated plant model scales up over time while it stays in the camera view, likely using the AR browser's focus or distance events.
works.technique_zh: 地理定位的植物模型只要保持在相机画面中就会随时间放大，很可能利用了 AR 浏览器的聚焦或距离事件。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR plant that grows only while it is in the centre of the camera view and shrinks when ignored. Twist: it spreads to a new spot when two people look at it at once.
works.exercise_zh: 做一株只在处于相机画面中心时才生长、被忽视时会缩小的 AR 植物。变体：两个人同时看它时，它会蔓延到新的位置。

video.video_title: Waterlily Invasion @ NTU School of Art, Design and Media

salient.why_en: Water lilies that feed on your gaze grow over you the longer you look at them through the phone.
salient.why_zh: 这些睡莲以你的目光为食，你透过手机看得越久，它们就长得越大，直到把你吞没。

works.title: ZEROTIME
works.description: A light installation without light: visitors enter a dark, hazy room and use their phone torches to find their way through a grid of retroreflective tubes that bounce the light straight back, while a program turns the phones' light into a five-channel soundscape.
works.description_zh: 一件没有光的灯光装置：观众走进黑暗、弥漫雾气的房间，用手机手电筒在一排排回射反光管之间摸索前行，光线被直接反射回来；同时程序把手机的光转化为五声道声景。
works.idea_en: You only receive as much light as you shine into the room.
works.idea_zh: 你照进房间多少光，就只能得到多少光。
works.technique: Retroreflective tubes return each phone's torch beam toward its source through haze, and light sensors in the space feed an interactive framework that generates the sound.
works.technique_zh: 回射材料的管子穿过雾气把每部手机的光束反射回光源方向，空间中的光感应器把数据送入互动程序生成声音。
works.exercise_en: Darken a room, hang strips of retroreflective tape on strings and let students explore with phone torches while a light sensor on an Arduino changes a drone sound. Twist: give only one student a torch and let them guide the others.
works.exercise_zh: 把房间弄暗，在绳子上挂满回射反光胶带，让学生拿手机手电筒探索，同时用 Arduino 上的光感应器改变一段持续音；变体：只给一名学生手电筒，由他为其他人引路。

video.video_title: ZEROTIME

salient.why_en: The room stays dark until your phone torch hits the reflective tubes, and you get back only the light you send.
salient.why_zh: 房间一片漆黑，直到你的手机手电照到反光管；你照出去多少光，就只能收回多少光。

works.title: cloud piano
works.description: A camera looks at the sky and a robot presses the keys of a real piano according to the shapes of the clouds passing over, so the clouds seem to play music.
works.description_zh: 摄像头对着天空，机器人根据飘过的云的形状按下真钢琴的琴键，看起来就像云在弹奏音乐。
works.idea_en: Reading the sky as a score shows that any live view can become an instrument — a direct pattern for camera-driven AR sound.
works.idea_zh: 把天空当乐谱读，说明任何实时画面都可以变成乐器——这是摄像头驱动 AR 声音的直接模式。
works.technique: Custom software maps cloud edges in the live video to key positions across the keyboard and drives a row of robotic fingers that press them.
works.technique_zh: 自定义软件把实时视频中云的边缘映射到键盘上的琴键位置，并驱动一排机械手指按下它们。
works.exercise_en: Point a phone at the sky, threshold the clouds, and let a virtual keyboard floating in AR play the notes that the cloud edges cross. Twist: aim it at a crowd or traffic instead of clouds.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机对准天空，对云做阈值分割，让漂浮在 AR 中的虚拟键盘弹出云的边缘经过的音符。变体：改对准人群或车流，而不是云。

video.video_title: cloud piano

salient.why_en: Passing clouds press the keys of a real piano, so the sky plays music.
salient.why_zh: 飘过的云按下真实钢琴的琴键，天空在弹奏音乐。

works.title: fly (dance with drones)
works.description: Dancers perform a duet with small drones that fly precise trajectories around their bodies, as if the objects were partners.
works.idea_zh: 让无人机成为舞伴，与舞者同步飞行
works.technique: Motion-capture tracking positions both dancers and drones in 3D space, and pre-programmed flight paths are synchronised to the choreography and music.
works.exercise_zh: 用一台小型可编程无人机（如Tello）或遥控小车，编好与音乐同步的路径让同学围绕它编舞；变化：让物体的路径由舞者手部的录制轨迹生成。

video.video_title: ELEVENPLAY x RZM "fly"  (dance with drones)

works.description_zh: 舞者与小型无人机合跳双人舞，无人机沿着精确的轨迹绕着他们的身体飞行，仿佛这些物体也是舞伴。
works.idea_en: Make drones dance partners that fly in sync with the dancers.
works.technique_zh: 动作捕捉在三维空间中同时定位舞者和无人机，预先编好的飞行路径与编舞和音乐保持同步。
works.exercise_en: Program a small drone (such as a Tello) or a remote-control car to follow a path synced to music, and have classmates choreograph around it. Twist: generate the object's path from a recorded trajectory of a dancer's hand.

works.title: iMapp Bucharest 555
works.description: The vast Palace of the Parliament in Bucharest is mapped for the city's 555th anniversary, with the façade dissolving into particles, mechanisms and flying fragments at enormous scale.
works.description_zh: 为庆祝布加勒斯特建城 555 周年，巨大的议会宫整面被投影覆盖，立面在超大尺度上溶解成粒子、机械和飞散的碎片。
works.idea_en: At building scale, a single illusion can make thousands of people feel the ground move.
works.idea_zh: 在建筑尺度上，一个错觉就能让成千上万人觉得脚下的地面在动。
works.technique: A large array of projectors covers one of the world's biggest façades, with content rendered to a 3D scan of the building (third-party footage of the show).
works.technique_zh: 大量投影机阵列覆盖这座世界上最大的建筑立面之一，内容依据建筑三维扫描渲染（视频为观众拍摄的现场记录）。
works.exercise_en: Design a mapping storyboard for the largest wall you can find, then prototype it at 1:100 on a printed photo with a pico projector. Twist: design one moment that only works from a single viewing spot.
works.exercise_zh: 为你能找到的最大一面墙设计投影分镜，再用微型投影仪在 1:100 的打印照片上做原型；变体：设计一个只有站在某个特定位置才能看懂的瞬间。

video.video_title: Bucuresti 555 ani - The Macula Czech Republic

works.title: spectra
works.description: Forty-nine searchlights in a grid near the Houses of Parliament send a single column of white light kilometres into the London night sky for the First World War centenary, with a sine-tone soundscape at ground level.
works.description_zh: 为纪念第一次世界大战一百周年，49 盏探照灯在伦敦议会大厦附近排成方阵，向夜空射出一根数公里高的白色光柱，地面伴有正弦波音景。
works.idea_en: One vertical beam can mark a place for a whole city; AR landmarks visible from far away (a pillar, a column) help people find and gather at a location.
works.idea_zh: 一道竖直光柱就能为整座城市标记一个地点；从远处可见的 AR 地标（柱子、光束）能帮助人们找到并聚集在某个地方。
works.technique: Searchlights aimed straight up form a single pillar that becomes visible where it scatters off moisture and dust in the air; speakers in the grid play pure tones.
works.technique_zh: 垂直向上的探照灯汇成一根光柱，在空气中的水汽和尘埃里散射而显形；方阵中的扬声器播放纯音。
works.exercise_en: Build a geolocated AR beam with 8th Wall or ARCore Geospatial that rises from a point on campus and can be seen from anywhere nearby, with its sound fading in as you approach. Twist: add a second beam that only appears when two people stand under the first.
works.exercise_zh: 用 8th Wall 或 ARCore Geospatial 做一根地理定位的 AR 光柱，从校园某点升起，附近任何地方都能看到，走近时声音渐强。变体：当两个人同时站在第一根光柱下时，出现第二根光柱。

video.video_title: Ryoji Ikeda's spectra in London, 2014

works.title: template/variant/friend/stranger
works.description: Large flat cut-out heads are covered with the dots and lines of face-recognition software, while projected eyes and mouths move within them. Shown at Art Basel Unlimited 2016, the installation asks what a face becomes when machines read it as data.
works.description_zh: 巨大的扁平人头剪影上布满了人脸识别软件的点和线，投影出来的眼睛和嘴在其中活动。作品在 2016 年 Art Basel Unlimited 展出，追问当机器把脸读成数据时，脸变成了什么。
works.idea_en: Showing the tracking mesh itself turns an invisible technology into the subject; AR face filters can reveal their landmarks instead of hiding them.
works.idea_zh: 直接展示追踪网格，就把看不见的技术变成了主题；AR 人脸滤镜也可以显露自己的特征点，而不是把它们藏起来。
works.technique: Printed facial-landmark diagrams on shaped panels are combined with projected video features aligned to those panels.
works.technique_zh: 在异形板上印出人脸特征点图示，并把对齐这些板面的视频五官投上去。
works.exercise_en: Make a face filter in Lens Studio or MediaPipe that draws the face mesh and landmark numbers on the user's face instead of any decoration. Twist: the mesh slowly drifts off the face when the user stays still, and snaps back when they move.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 MediaPipe 做一个人脸滤镜，不加任何装饰，只在用户脸上画出人脸网格和特征点编号；变体：用户静止时网格慢慢从脸上漂走，一动又立刻吸回来。

video.video_title: Tony Oursler 'template/variant/friend/stranger' 2014

works.title: 1000 Hands
works.description: Visitors contribute line drawings through a mobile app; each drawing is grown into a 3D form that joins a collective, evolving projected landscape in the gallery.
works.idea_zh: 上千名观众的手绘被生长成立体形态，汇入共同的投影风景

video.video_title: 1000 Hands interactive

works.technique: Line drawings from a mobile app are sent to a server, converted into procedurally extruded or grown 3D geometry, and added to a shared real-time scene that is projected in the gallery.
works.exercise_zh: 用网页表单收集全班的手绘线条，在 three.js 中把每条线挤出成会慢慢生长的 3D 形体并放进同一片投影风景；变体：让每个形体的生长方向由绘制者当时的心情选项决定。
works.description_zh: 观众通过手机应用提交线条画，每幅画都会生长成一个三维形体，汇入展厅中一片共同的、不断演变的投影风景。
works.idea_en: Drawings by a thousand visitors grow into 3D forms and join one shared projected landscape.
works.technique_zh: 手机应用中的线条画被发送到服务器，转换成程序化挤出或生长的三维几何体，并加入一个共享的实时场景，在展厅中投影出来。
works.exercise_en: Collect the whole class's hand-drawn lines with a web form, extrude each line in three.js into a slowly growing 3D form, and place them all in one projected landscape. Twist: let each form's growth direction depend on the mood option its drawer picked at the time.

works.title: 26th Floor (Augmented Sculpture)
works.description: An 'augmented sculpture' for the Four Seasons Hotel Beirut, where a white faceted object and its projected light skin were designed together.
works.idea_zh: 雕塑与投影一起设计，白色形体被光赋予流动的皮肤
works.technique: A faceted physical sculpture is built from the same digital model used to author the projection, so every face receives perfectly aligned content.
works.exercise_zh: 用白卡纸折一个多面体，在电脑里做同一模型并按面投影不同颜色的流动；变化：让一束“光”在各面之间传递，形成连续动画。

video.video_title: 26th Floor | Augmented Sculpture | INTERN VERSION

works.description_zh: 为贝鲁特四季酒店创作的一件“增强雕塑”，白色多面体与投射其上的光之外皮是一同设计的。
works.idea_en: Sculpture and projection are designed together, giving a white form a flowing skin of light.
works.technique_zh: 多面体实体雕塑与制作投影内容所用的是同一个数字模型，因此每个面都能获得完美对齐的内容。
works.exercise_en: Fold a polyhedron from white card, build the same model on the computer, and project different flowing colors face by face. Twist: pass a beam of "light" from face to face to form a continuous animation.

works.title: 320° Licht
works.description: Inside the 100-metre-high Gasometer Oberhausen, graphic patterns grow and change across 320 degrees of wall, turning the industrial cylinder into an immersive light space.
works.idea_zh: 把巨大的储气罐内壁变成不断变化的光之空间
works.technique: An array of projectors is blended across the cylindrical interior, with generative patterns designed to exploit the surface's extreme height.
works.exercise_zh: 在楼梯间或走廊用投影做纵向延伸的图案，让人仰头观看；变化：图案随观众站立的位置向上“生长”。

video.video_title: 320° LICHT | SPATIAL EXPERIENCE

works.description_zh: 在高达 100 米的奥伯豪森储气罐（Gasometer Oberhausen）内部，图形图案在 320 度的墙面上生长、变化，把这座工业圆筒变成沉浸式的光之空间。
works.idea_en: Turn the inside of a giant gas holder into an ever-changing space of light.
works.technique_zh: 多台投影仪在圆柱形内壁上进行边缘融合，生成式图案专门针对这一表面的超高尺度而设计。
works.exercise_en: Project vertically stretching patterns in a stairwell or corridor so people have to look up. Twist: make the patterns "grow" upward from wherever a viewer is standing.

works.title: 329 prepared dc-motors, cotton balls, toluene tank
works.description: Inside a huge empty steel toluene tank, 329 small motors swing cotton balls on wires against the curved wall; the tapping multiplies into a roaring, echoing rain you stand inside.
works.description_zh: 在一个巨大的空钢制甲苯储罐里，329 个小电机甩动挂在铁丝上的棉球敲击弧形罐壁；敲击声层层叠加，变成一场包围你的轰鸣回声雨。
works.idea_en: The space is the instrument: an AR designer learns that simple agents placed along a real surface can make the architecture itself sound and feel alive.
works.idea_zh: 空间本身就是乐器：AR 设计者可以学到，沿真实表面布置的简单单元，能让建筑本身发声、显得有生命。
works.technique: Each dc-motor carries a short wire with a cotton ball that randomly strikes the tank wall; the large reverberant volume blends hundreds of slightly different rhythms into one texture.
works.technique_zh: 每个直流电机带着一段挂棉球的短铁丝，随机敲击罐壁；巨大的混响空间把数百个略有差异的节奏融为一种声音质感。
works.exercise_en: Scan a real wall with phone AR plane detection, scatter 100 virtual tappers along it that play a spatialised click with random timing, and walk through the resulting sound field. Twist: let the tapping rate follow how close the viewer stands.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 平面检测扫描一面真墙，沿墙随机布置 100 个虚拟“敲击器”，各自以随机节奏播放空间化的咔哒声，然后走进这片声场。变体：让敲击频率随观众离墙的距离变化。

video.video_title: Zimoun : Sound Installation : 329 prepared dc-motors, cotton balls, toluene tank, 2013

works.title: A Million Times
works.description: A large wall of analogue clocks turns its hands into flowing patterns of waves, spirals and flocks before settling to show the time.
works.description_zh: 一面由大量模拟时钟组成的墙，让指针汇成波浪、漩涡和鸟群般流动的图案，最后停下来显示时间。
works.idea_en: Many identical rotating parts can move like a flock — emergent patterns from simple rules are an efficient way to animate AR grids.
works.idea_zh: 许多相同的旋转部件能像鸟群一样运动——由简单规则产生的涌现图案是驱动 AR 阵列动画的高效方法。
works.technique: Clock hands are driven individually and animated as a vector field sampled at each clock position, so the whole grid reads as flowing motion.
works.technique_zh: 每根指针单独驱动，动画以向量场的形式在每个时钟位置采样，使整个阵列看起来像流动的运动。
works.exercise_en: Animate a grid of virtual clock hands in AR as a vector field that flows around the user's hand position. Twist: stop the flow and spell the time whenever the user holds still for three seconds.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一组虚拟时钟指针做成向量场，让它们绕着用户手的位置流动。变体：用户保持不动三秒时，让流动停下并拼出时间。

video.video_title: Humans since 1982, A Million Times, 2013

works.title: AIREAL
works.description: Rajinder Sodhi, Ivan Poupyrev, Matthew Glisson and Ali Israr use a 3D-printed vortex cannon to fire rings of air so you can feel virtual butterflies and balls in free air.
works.idea_zh: 用空气涡环炮让你在空中'摸到'虚拟的蝴蝶和皮球。

video.video_title: AIREAL: Interactive Tactile Experiences in Free Air

works.technique: A flexible nozzle on a pan-tilt mount aims a speaker-driven air vortex ring at the tracked user's hand (via a depth camera), delivering localized tactile pulses in free air.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸杯或塑料瓶加气球膜做一个简易空气炮，配合手机 AR 中出现的虚拟蝴蝶，由一位同学在蝴蝶“碰到”手时手动发射空气环；变体：设计一个只有触感、没有视觉的“隐形”AR 生物。
works.description_zh: Rajinder Sodhi、Ivan Poupyrev、Matthew Glisson 和 Ali Israr 用一台 3D 打印的涡环炮发射空气环，让你能在空中感受到虚拟的蝴蝶和皮球。
works.idea_en: An air-vortex cannon lets you "touch" virtual butterflies and balls in mid-air.
works.technique_zh: 安装在云台上的柔性喷嘴由扬声器驱动产生空气涡环，并对准由深度相机追踪到的用户手部，在自由空间中提供局部的触觉脉冲。
works.exercise_en: Make a simple air cannon from a paper cup or plastic bottle and a balloon membrane, pair it with a virtual butterfly in phone AR, and have a classmate fire an air ring by hand whenever the butterfly "touches" someone's hand. Twist: design an "invisible" AR creature that you can only feel, not see.

works.title: Across the Buildings
works.description: In Granary Square at King's Cross, bold coloured bands wrap the heritage buildings; from street level they look like random shapes, from one point they align into a flat geometric figure.
works.description_zh: 在国王十字的粮仓广场，醒目的彩色色带包裹着历史建筑；在街面上看像随意的形状，从某一点看却对齐成一个平面几何图形。
works.idea_en: Graphics that fold over real architecture reveal its shape: an AR overlay that is designed flat from one view shows off the depth of the building from every other view.
works.idea_zh: 折叠在真实建筑上的图形会暴露建筑的形体：一个从某个视角设计成平面的 AR 叠加，在其他视角下反而会展示建筑的纵深。
works.technique: Shapes are projected from a chosen viewpoint onto the building surfaces and executed as temporary painted or adhesive bands that follow every corner and ledge.
works.technique_zh: 从选定的观看点把图形投射到建筑表面，再用临时的油漆或贴膜色带沿着每一个转角和檐口完成。
works.exercise_en: Project a flat logo from the phone's current pose onto the scanned room mesh (LiDAR) so it sticks to every surface, then walk sideways to see it break. Twist: let the viewer freeze a new projection point by tapping, layering several broken logos.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机当前的姿态把一个平面标志投射到 LiDAR 扫描的房间网格上，让它贴满每个表面，然后侧着走看它如何断裂。变体：观众点击屏幕即可冻结一个新的投射点，叠出几个断裂的标志。

video.video_title: King's Cross 'Across the Buildings' Public Art Project

works.title: Adaptive Ghosted Views for AR
works.description: Ghosted X-ray views that adapt which real-world features to keep visible, so hidden pipes or rooms behind a wall stay readable without losing the wall.
works.idea_zh: 自适应的“幽灵透视”：墙后管线可见，墙本身也不消失。

video.video_title: Adaptive ghosted views for Augmented Reality

works.technique: Computes importance from real-world image features and adapts the transparency of the occluder per pixel before revealing the hidden virtual layer.
works.exercise_zh: 给一面贴有海报的墙做AR“看穿墙”效果：把海报的主要线条保留为半透明，后面显示虚拟管道；变化：让同学评估保留多少细节最好。
works.description_zh: 自适应的“幽灵式”X 光透视视图，会自动决定保留哪些真实世界特征，让墙后隐藏的管道或房间清晰可辨，同时墙本身也不会消失。
works.idea_en: An adaptive ghosted see-through view: the pipes behind the wall show up and the wall stays.
works.technique_zh: 根据真实世界的图像特征计算重要度，逐像素调整遮挡物的透明度，再显示被遮挡的虚拟图层。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR "see through the wall" effect on a wall with a poster: keep the poster's main lines semi-transparent and show virtual pipes behind it. Twist: have classmates judge how much detail is best to keep.

works.title: Angles Mirror
works.description: A field of small white rods rotates to different angles so that the shadows and highlights they make form a moving image of the viewer.
works.description_zh: 一片白色小杆转到不同的角度，它们形成的阴影和高光拼出观众的动态影像。
works.idea_en: Using orientation instead of colour as the pixel value shows that angle alone can carry an image — a useful idea for AR fields of arrows, grass or fins.
works.idea_zh: 用方向而不是颜色作为像素值，说明仅凭角度就能承载图像——对 AR 中的箭头场、草地或鳍片阵列很有用。
works.technique: A camera image is sampled into a grid and each rod's motor rotates it so that its angle to the light creates the needed brightness.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头图像被采样成网格，每根杆子的电机让它转动，使其与光线的夹角产生所需的明暗。
works.exercise_en: Fill an AR plane with thin rods that rotate to match the brightness of the live camera image of the viewer, lit by one virtual light. Twist: move the virtual light and watch the portrait invert.
works.exercise_zh: 在一个 AR 平面上铺满细杆，让它们根据观众的实时摄像头图像亮度而转动，由一盏虚拟灯照亮。变体：移动虚拟灯，看肖像如何反相。

video.video_title: Daniel Rozin, "Angles Mirror," 2013

works.title: Arcades
works.description: Beams of light pass through haze and lenses and appear to bend into a row of glowing arches, so light seems to curve like architecture.
works.description_zh: 光束穿过雾气和透镜，看起来弯成一排发光的拱门，仿佛光像建筑一样弯曲。
works.idea_en: Light should travel in straight lines, so when it looks curved we stop and look — AR can break physical expectations in small, elegant ways.
works.idea_zh: 光本应走直线，所以当它看起来弯曲时我们会停下来看——AR 可以用小而优雅的方式打破物理常识。
works.technique: Beams are split and redirected by lenses and mirrors so that a sequence of straight segments in haze reads as a continuous arch.
works.technique_zh: 光束被透镜和镜面分段、改向，使雾中一段段直线读起来像一道连续的拱。
works.exercise_en: Draw a row of volumetric light arches over a real hallway in AR that look like bent beams of light. Twist: let the arches straighten out when the viewer stops walking.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中在真实走廊上方画一排看起来像弯曲光束的体积光拱门。变体：观众停下脚步时，让光拱慢慢变直。

video.video_title: [대림미술관] 트로이카 : 작품영상 05 - Arcades

works.title: Art Project in Miyagi
works.description: After the 2011 tsunami, Rousse works with residents in Miyagi, Japan, painting geometric shapes inside damaged buildings that come together as one figure in his photographs.
works.description_zh: 2011 年海啸之后，Rousse 与日本宫城县的居民一起，在受损建筑内部绘制几何形状，它们在他的照片中合成一个完整图形。
works.idea_en: A single aligned shape can hold a community's memory of a place: AR memorial layers work when locals help decide where the one meaningful viewpoint is.
works.idea_zh: 一个对齐的形状可以承载一个社区对某地的记忆：当当地人参与决定那个有意义的观看点时，AR 纪念层才真正成立。
works.technique: The same camera-aligned anamorphic process is carried out with volunteers, likely inside buildings awaiting demolition, and the photographs are exhibited locally.
works.technique_zh: 同样的相机对齐变形绘画流程与志愿者一起完成，很可能是在等待拆除的建筑里，照片随后在当地展出。
works.exercise_en: Interview a staff member about a room that matters to them, then place one AR shape and a short text that only align from the spot they chose. Twist: save the anchor so next year's class can find it again.
works.exercise_zh: 采访一位工作人员，了解一个对他们重要的房间，然后放一个 AR 图形和一段短文字，只在他们选的那个位置对齐。变体：保存锚点，让明年的学生还能找到它。

video.video_title: Documentary / Georges Rousse Art Project in Miyagi

works.title: Aten Reign
works.description: Visitors lie on benches under the Guggenheim rotunda, which is filled with nested elliptical rings of fabric lit by slowly shifting coloured light mixed with daylight from the skylight.
works.description_zh: 观众躺在古根海姆圆厅下的长椅上，头顶是一层层椭圆布环，被缓慢变化的彩色灯光和天窗透下的日光一起照亮。
works.idea_en: Layered, softly lit rings erase edges and make a building feel bottomless; AR can use nested translucent shells to change how deep a real ceiling looks.
works.idea_zh: 多层柔光圆环抹去边界，让建筑显得深不见底；AR 可以用嵌套的半透明壳层改变真实天花板看起来的深度。
works.technique: Five concentric fabric cones hang in the rotunda; computer-controlled LEDs light each ring separately while natural light enters from the oculus.
works.technique_zh: 五个同心布锥悬在圆厅中，电脑控制的 LED 分别照亮每一环，同时自然光从顶部圆窗进入。
works.exercise_en: Anchor five nested, glowing ellipses to the classroom ceiling in AR Foundation and cross-fade their colours over 60 seconds so that the ceiling seems to recede. Twist: sample the real room's light with the camera and blend it into the outermost ring.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 里把五个嵌套的发光椭圆锚定在教室天花板上，在 60 秒内交替渐变颜色，让天花板看起来在后退。变体：用摄像头采样真实房间的光色，混入最外一圈。

video.video_title: "Aten Reign" at the Guggenheim and James Turrell's Skyspaces

works.title: Augmediated Reality with Depth-based Surface Tracking
works.description: An early Meta/EyeTap prototype in which a depth camera on the glasses tracks bare surfaces without markers, so virtual windows stay attached to a table or sheet of paper as the wearer moves.
works.description_zh: 早期 Meta/EyeTap 原型：眼镜上的深度相机无需标记就能追踪普通表面，让虚拟窗口在佩戴者移动时依然贴在桌面或一张纸上。
works.idea_en: Any plain surface can become a screen if the glasses understand its shape.
works.idea_zh: 只要眼镜理解了表面的形状，任何普通平面都能成为屏幕。
works.technique: Structure-based tracking fits planes to the depth map every frame and runs side by side with the rendering engine, so no visual features or fiducials are needed.
works.technique_zh: 基于结构的追踪在每一帧深度图上拟合平面，并与渲染引擎并行运行，因此不需要视觉特征或标记。
works.exercise_en: Use AR plane detection to pin a note app to a blank sheet of paper and let the sheet move. Twist: when the paper is folded, split the content across the two halves.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR 平面检测把一个便签应用固定在一张白纸上，并让它随纸移动。变体：纸被折起来时，把内容分到两半上。

video.video_title: Augmediated Reality Interface with Depth-based Surface Tracking

works.title: Augmented Reality Freedom Stories
works.description: Seldom-told African Canadian histories of the Underground Railroad, including Harriet Tubman's journeys, come alive as AR documents and voices over hand-crafted objects made with community partners.
works.description_zh: 关于地下铁路、鲜少被讲述的非裔加拿大人历史（包括哈丽特·塔布曼的行动），以 AR 文献和声音的形式在与社区伙伴共同手工制作的物件上重现。
works.idea_en: Handle a replica document and hear the person it belonged to.
works.idea_zh: 拿起一份复制的历史文献，就能听到它的主人说话。
works.technique: Primary sources are printed onto physical artefacts used as image targets, and a tablet app overlays video, audio and animated text on them.
works.technique_zh: 把一手史料印在实体物件上作为图像目标，平板应用在上面叠加视频、音频和动态文字。
works.exercise_en: Pick a local historical figure, print three of their documents as image targets, and record a voice reading each one in AR. Twist: the voice speaks only when the document is held upright.
works.exercise_zh: 选一位本地历史人物，把他们的三份文献打印成图像目标，并在 AR 中为每份文献录制朗读。变体：只有把文献竖直拿着时，声音才会响起。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Freedom Stories

works.title: BeThere
works.description: A mobile 3D collaboration system where a remote user sees a reconstructed 3D copy of the local space and reaches in with tracked hands to point and manipulate.
works.idea_zh: 远程的人把手“伸进”你的空间指指点点。

video.video_title: BeThere: 3D Mobile Collaboration with Spatial Input

works.technique: Attaches a depth sensor to a mobile device to capture the scene and the user's hand, sharing both as 3D data so remote hands appear in the local AR view.
works.exercise_zh: 组织两人视频通话：远程者在截图上画圈画箭头，本地者用手机AR把这些标记放到真实物体上完成组装任务；变化：只允许用手势不许说话。
works.description_zh: 一套移动式三维协作系统：远程用户能看到本地空间重建出的三维副本，并用被追踪的双手“伸进”其中进行指点和操作。
works.idea_en: A remote person reaches their hands into your space to point things out.
works.technique_zh: 在移动设备上加装深度传感器，捕捉场景和用户的手，并将两者作为三维数据共享，使远程的手出现在本地的 AR 视图中。
works.exercise_en: Set up a two-person video call: the remote person draws circles and arrows on a screenshot, and the local person uses phone AR to place those marks on real objects to complete an assembly task. Twist: only gestures are allowed, no talking.

works.title: Blue Shirt
works.description: A 3D strobe animation shown at Wood Street Galleries in Pittsburgh in which a blue shirt and other everyday forms fold and transform in a continuous loop.
works.description_zh: 在匹兹堡 Wood Street Galleries 展出的立体频闪动画，一件蓝衬衫和其他日常形体在连续循环中折叠、变形。
works.idea_en: Everyday objects in impossible motion are the essence of good AR surprise: familiar enough to believe, strange enough to remember.
works.idea_zh: 日常物件做出不可能的动作，是好的 AR 惊喜的精髓：熟悉到让人相信，奇怪到让人记住。
works.technique: A motor-driven armature carries sculpted versions of the shirt at successive stages while a strobe tuned to the rotation freezes each stage into one fluid animation.
works.technique_zh: 电机驱动的支架载着衬衫在各阶段的雕塑版本，与转速匹配的频闪把每个阶段定格，融合成一段流畅的动画。
works.exercise_en: Scan a real shirt, rig it to fold itself in AR on a real chair, and render it at 8 fps like a strobe. Twist: let the folding speed up whenever someone laughs.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描一件真衬衫，在 AR 中让它在真实椅子上自己折叠，并以 8 帧/秒的频闪感渲染。变体：每当有人笑，折叠就加速。

video.video_title: Gregory Barsamian, Blue Shirt (2013)

works.title: Box
works.description: Two industrial robots move large panels while projection-mapped imagery on them stays locked to a robot-moved camera, creating illusions shot entirely in-camera.
works.idea_zh: 机械臂移动画布与摄像机，投影与运动精确同步的现场魔术

video.video_title: Box

works.technique: Motion-control industrial robots move both the screens and the camera on programmed paths, and projection is rendered from the known poses so the anamorphic imagery stays correct from the camera's viewpoint.
works.exercise_zh: 用手动移动的纸板屏幕和固定手机摄像头，在 TouchDesigner 中根据纸板上的 ArUco 标记实时调整投影，使画面始终“贴”在纸板上；变体：设计一个只有从摄像机视角才成立的错觉，现场观众看到的是乱码。
works.description_zh: 两台工业机器人移动大型面板，面板上的投影映射画面始终与一台由机器人移动的摄像机锁定，创造出完全在镜头内实拍完成的视觉错觉。
works.idea_en: Robot arms move the canvases and the camera, a live magic trick where projection and motion stay perfectly in sync.
works.technique_zh: 运动控制工业机器人按编程路径同时移动屏幕和摄像机，投影则依据已知位姿进行渲染，使变形透视影像从摄像机视角看始终正确。
works.exercise_en: Using a hand-moved cardboard screen and a fixed phone camera, adjust the projection in real time in TouchDesigner based on ArUco markers on the cardboard so the image always "sticks" to it. Twist: design an illusion that only works from the camera's viewpoint, while the live audience sees gibberish.

works.title: Cave of Sounds
works.description: Eight new electronic instruments stand in a circle around a glowing hub; visitors play them freely by moving hands through light, casting shadows or gesturing, and together improvise a shared piece of music.
works.description_zh: 八件新造的电子乐器围成一圈，中间是发光的中心；观众可以自由演奏，通过在光中移动双手、投下影子或做手势，一起即兴合奏。
works.idea_en: A circle of strange instruments turns strangers into a band without instructions.
works.idea_zh: 一圈奇特的乐器，不用说明就能把陌生人变成乐队。
works.technique: Each instrument was built by a different Music Hackspace member from sensors such as cameras, light sensors and Kinect, all synced to a shared tempo so any gesture fits the ensemble.
works.technique_zh: 每件乐器由 Music Hackspace 的不同成员制作，使用摄像头、光传感器和 Kinect 等，全部同步到同一节拍，因此任何手势都能融入合奏。
works.exercise_en: Build four 'instruments' from phone sensors in web pages (tilt, shake, microphone, camera brightness) that all quantise to one shared beat, and let visitors jam. Twist: make an instrument that only sounds when two people stand close.
works.exercise_zh: 用网页读取手机传感器（倾斜、摇晃、麦克风、摄像头亮度）做四件“乐器”，都对齐到同一节拍，让观众即兴合奏；变体：做一件只有两人靠近时才发声的乐器。

video.video_title: The Cave of Sounds

works.title: Choreophony
works.description: A lecture-performance where a dancer's movements trigger and shape live audio samples, so the audience can follow the causal and chance interplay between movement, space and sound.
works.description_zh: 一场讲演式表演：舞者的动作触发并塑造现场音频采样，观众可以看清动作、空间与声音之间既有因果又有偶然的关系。
works.idea_en: Choreography that writes its own polyphonic soundtrack.
works.idea_zh: 一段自己写出多声部配乐的编舞。
works.technique: Camera-based motion tracking maps the dancer's position and movement quality to several sample layers at once, producing an interactive polyphonic score.
works.technique_zh: 基于摄像头的动作追踪把舞者的位置和动作质感同时映射到多层采样上，形成互动的多声部总谱。
works.exercise_en: Map four stage zones and two movement speeds to eight short samples with a webcam and MediaPipe, then perform the same phrase twice in different places to hear two different pieces. Twist: explain the mapping to the audience first, then break it.
works.exercise_zh: 用网络摄像头和 MediaPipe 把四个舞台区域和两种动作速度映射到八段短采样上，在不同位置把同一段舞句跳两次，听出两首不同的曲子；变体：先向观众讲清映射规则，然后打破它。

video.video_title: CHOREOPHONY Lecture-Performance

works.title: Conduct The Orchestra
works.description: At Amsterdam's Concertgebouw, members of the public conduct their own orchestra: their arm movements set the tempo and dynamics of a recorded performance.
works.description_zh: 在阿姆斯特丹音乐厅，普通观众可以指挥属于自己的乐团：手臂的动作决定一段录制演奏的速度和强弱。
works.idea_en: Anyone can be the conductor of a great orchestra.
works.idea_zh: 谁都可以当一回伟大乐团的指挥。
works.technique: Motion tracking reads the conducting gesture and its speed and size are mapped to playback tempo and volume of the orchestral recording.
works.technique_zh: 动作追踪读取指挥手势，把手势的速度和幅度映射为管弦乐录音的播放速度和音量。
works.exercise_en: Track a hand with MediaPipe and map its up-down speed to the playback rate of a song in the browser. Twist: split the orchestra into sections that follow different students.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 追踪一只手，把它上下挥动的速度映射成浏览器中一首曲子的播放速度；变体：把乐团分成几个声部，各由一位同学指挥。

video.video_title: Conduct The Orchestra - at the Concertgebouw Amsterdam

works.title: Cubes
works.description: A column of cubes turns slowly, each at a slightly different speed, so the stack twists into ever-changing spirals and then realigns into a straight tower.
works.description_zh: 一列方块缓慢转动，每块的速度略有不同，于是整叠方块扭成不断变化的螺旋，然后又重新对齐成一座笔直的塔。
works.idea_en: Slow phase drift between identical parts creates a narrative arc of order, chaos and order again, a simple structure for time-based AR pieces.
works.idea_zh: 相同部件之间缓慢的相位漂移构成“有序—混乱—再有序”的叙事弧，是时间性 AR 作品的一种简单结构。
works.technique: A gear train gives each cube a marginally different rotation rate, so the stack only returns to alignment after a long common period (year approximate).
works.technique_zh: 齿轮组给每个方块稍微不同的转速，只有经过很长的公共周期后整叠方块才会重新对齐（年份为估计）。
works.exercise_en: Stack 20 virtual cubes on a real shelf in AR, rotating each at 1 + i/100 speed, and time how long until they realign. Twist: make the tower chime when it becomes straight again.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中于真实书架上叠 20 个虚拟方块，第 i 块以 1 + i/100 的速度旋转，计时它们多久重新对齐。变体：塔重新对齐时发出一声钟鸣。

video.video_title: Cubes - Kinetic art sculpture by Jennifer Townley

works.title: Cyber Cards Live
works.description: Four real cards lie on a table; with a wave of the hand their faces change, swap and vanish in the live HD camera image shown to the audience.
works.description_zh: 桌上放着四张真实的纸牌；手一挥，观众看到的高清实时画面里，牌面就会变换、互换或消失。
works.idea_en: Hand gestures over real cards trigger virtual changes that look like sleight of hand.
works.idea_zh: 在真实纸牌上方做手势，触发看起来像手法魔术的虚拟变化。
works.technique: Cards are recognized with SURF feature tracking and hand movement with motion-template gradients, and new card faces are composited onto the camera feed in openFrameworks.
works.technique_zh: 用 SURF 特征追踪识别纸牌，用运动模板梯度检测手部动作，再在 openFrameworks 中把新的牌面合成进摄像画面。
works.exercise_en: Use image tracking on four cards and a simple hand-motion detector so a swipe over a card swaps its face in the phone view. Twist: the swap only happens if nobody in the frame is looking at the card.
works.exercise_zh: 对四张牌做图像追踪，再加一个简单的手部运动检测，手在牌上一扫，手机画面里的牌面就被换掉。变体：只有当画面里没人盯着那张牌时才会换。

video.video_title: Cyber Cards Live v1.0

works.title: D.I.G.I.T.
works.description: A wall of hundreds of seven-segment displays acts as a mirror: the camera image of the person in front is drawn with digital number segments.
works.description_zh: 一面由数百个七段数码管组成的墙像镜子一样工作：用数码管的笔画画出站在前面的人的摄像画面。
works.idea_en: A mirror made of calculator digits.
works.idea_zh: 一面由计算器数字组成的镜子。
works.technique: The camera feed is downsampled and each cell's brightness pattern is matched to the closest seven-segment character, then sent to driver boards.
works.technique_zh: 对摄像画面降采样，把每个格子的亮度图案匹配到最接近的七段字符，再发送给驱动板。
works.exercise_en: Make a webcam mirror that redraws the image with only characters from a limited set (digits, emoji or letters of your name). Twist: the set of allowed characters changes with the time of day.
works.exercise_zh: 做一面摄像头镜子，只用有限的字符集合（数字、表情符号或你名字里的字母）重绘画面。变体：可用字符随一天中的时间变化。

video.video_title: D.I.G.I.T.

works.title: DAYDREAM
works.description: An installation where visitors stand inside a tunnel of two translucent screens on which projected lines move with sound, creating the illusion that the room is stretching, rotating or dissolving.
works.description_zh: 一件装置：观众站在由两层半透明幕构成的通道里，幕上投影的线条随声音移动，制造出房间被拉伸、旋转或溶解的错觉。
works.idea_en: Two layers of projected lines are enough to make a solid room feel liquid.
works.idea_zh: 两层投影线条就足以让坚实的房间变得像液体一样。
works.technique: Two projectors cover a front and a rear scrim; phase-shifted line animations on each layer create moiré and parallax depth cues that bend perceived space, synced to an original soundtrack.
works.technique_zh: 两台投影仪分别覆盖前后两层纱幕；两层上相位错开的线条动画产生莫尔纹和视差深度线索，扭曲人对空间的感知，并与原创音轨同步。
works.exercise_en: Project two slightly different stripe animations onto two layers of fabric and walk between them with the lights off. Twist: let a phone's gyroscope control the phase shift so one visitor 'tilts' the room for everyone.
works.exercise_zh: 关灯后，把两段略有差异的条纹动画投到两层布上，在它们之间行走；变体：让手机陀螺仪控制相位差，一位观众就能为所有人“倾斜”房间。

video.video_title: NONOTAK - DAYDREAM V.6

works.title: Dalston House (Bâtiment)
works.description: A full-size Victorian house facade lies flat on the ground in East London; a giant tilted mirror above it reflects visitors who lie on the facade so they appear to hang from window ledges and climb walls.
works.description_zh: 一座维多利亚式房屋的立面以原尺寸平铺在伦敦东区的地面上，上方一面倾斜的巨大镜子把躺在立面上的观众反射出来，看起来就像他们悬挂在窗台上、攀爬在墙面上。
works.idea_en: Swap the gravity axis and let people perform for their own reflection: an AR mirror that re-orients the floor turns every visitor into an acrobat without any rendering tricks on their body.
works.idea_zh: 把重力方向换一下，让人们对着自己的倒影表演：一面把地面“扶正”的 AR 镜子，不用给身体做任何特效，就能让每位观众变成杂技演员。
works.technique: A printed and built facade is laid horizontally and a large mirror angled at 45 degrees stands over it, rotating the scene by 90 degrees for anyone watching the mirror.
works.technique_zh: 把印制并搭建好的房屋立面水平放倒，上方立一面约 45 度倾斜的大镜子，让看镜子的人看到旋转了 90 度的画面。
works.exercise_en: Build a 'gravity mirror' in Lens Studio or WebXR: film the floor with the phone camera, rotate the feed 90 degrees and composite a building facade under the people lying on it. Twist: let a second phone show the unrotated view side by side so the audience sees both the trick and the result.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Lens Studio 或 WebXR 里做一面“重力镜子”：用手机摄像头拍地面，把画面旋转 90 度，并在躺在地上的人身下合成一面建筑立面。变体：用第二部手机并排显示未旋转的原始画面，让观众同时看到把戏和效果。

video.video_title: Leandro Erlich: Dalston House / Interview

salient.why_en: A house facade lies on the ground under a tilted mirror, so visitors lying on it appear to hang and climb up the building.
salient.why_zh: 房屋立面平铺在地上，上方斜挂一面大镜子，躺在上面的人在镜中就像挂在楼上攀爬。

works.title: Dynamic Compact Visualizations for AR
works.description: AR annotations and exploded views of a real object are laid out compactly and reorganise dynamically as the viewpoint changes, avoiding clutter.
works.idea_zh: AR标注和爆炸图随视角自动重新排布，永不杂乱。

video.video_title: Dynamic Compact Visualizations for Augmented Reality

works.technique: Uses view-management optimisation to cluster and position labels and explosion diagrams in screen space each frame.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR为一台拆开的旧电器零件加标签，让同学设计标签在转动视角时如何避免重叠；变化：只允许显示3个标签，其余折叠。
works.description_zh: 真实物体的 AR 标注和爆炸图以紧凑的方式排布，并随视角变化动态重组，避免画面杂乱。
works.idea_en: AR labels and exploded views rearrange themselves with the viewpoint and never get cluttered.
works.technique_zh: 采用视图管理优化，逐帧在屏幕空间中对标签和爆炸图进行聚类与定位。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR to label the parts of a disassembled old appliance, and have classmates design how the labels avoid overlapping as the view rotates. Twist: only 3 labels may be shown, and the rest fold away.

works.title: Evolució
works.description: An abstract building projection about evolution as transformation over time, first shown at the Mapping Festival in Geneva and then at Signal Festival in Prague. Lines, grids and volumes build and break the architecture to a tightly synced soundtrack.
works.description_zh: 一件以“演化即随时间变化”为主题的抽象建筑投影，先在日内瓦 Mapping Festival 展出，后在布拉格 Signal Festival 展出。线条、网格和体块随紧密同步的声轨，不断搭建又拆解建筑。
works.idea_en: Abstract geometry that follows the real edges of a building teaches the eye where the structure is; AR can use simple lines to reveal architecture.
works.idea_zh: 沿着建筑真实边缘运动的抽象几何，会告诉眼睛结构在哪里；AR 也可以用简单的线条揭示建筑。
works.technique: Content is animated on a 3D model of the façade so every line snaps to real edges, then projected with edge-blended projectors.
works.technique_zh: 内容在立面三维模型上制作动画，让每条线都贴合真实边缘，再用边缘融合的多台投影机投出。
works.exercise_en: Use WebXR or AR Foundation to trace the edges of a room with glowing lines that grow in sequence to music. Twist: the lines evolve from straight to organic curves over one minute.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 AR Foundation，让发光线条沿房间边缘随音乐依次生长；变体：一分钟内，线条从笔直逐渐演化为有机的曲线。

video.video_title: Evolució - 3D Mapping for Signal Festival 2013

works.title: EyeTap X: Depth Vision
works.description: A home-built EyeTap X wearable overlays a colour heat-map of depth onto the wearer's see-through view in real time, so near and far surfaces glow in different colours and the room stays readable even in darkness.
works.description_zh: 自制的 EyeTap X 可穿戴设备把深度热力图实时叠加在佩戴者的透视视野上，远近不同的表面呈现不同颜色，即使在黑暗中也能看清房间。
works.idea_en: See distance as colour, even in the dark.
works.idea_zh: 把距离看成颜色，黑暗里也能看见。
works.technique: A PrimeSense depth sensor feeds a quad-core Android board that colour-maps each depth value and draws it on a see-through display at about 25-30 fps.
works.technique_zh: PrimeSense 深度传感器把数据送到一块四核 Android 开发板，由它把每个深度值映射成颜色，以每秒约 25–30 帧画在透视显示屏上。
works.exercise_en: On a LiDAR iPhone, render the depth map as a false-colour overlay in a HoloKit or phone AR view and walk a dim corridor with it. Twist: turn depth into sound pitch instead of colour.
works.exercise_zh: 在带 LiDAR 的 iPhone 上，把深度图渲染成伪彩色叠加在 HoloKit 或手机 AR 画面中，戴着它走过一条昏暗的走廊。变体：把深度转换成音高而不是颜色。

video.video_title: EyeTap X

works.title: EyeTap X: Interface Cube
works.description: Through the EyeTap X glass, a coloured virtual cube floats in front of the wearer; the depth camera detects the hand grasping it, and the cube follows the hand as it moves.
works.description_zh: 透过 EyeTap X 的镜片，一个彩色虚拟立方体漂浮在佩戴者面前；深度相机检测到手的抓握，立方体就跟着手移动。
works.idea_en: Grab a hologram with your bare hand, no controller needed.
works.idea_zh: 不用控制器，徒手抓住一个全息物体。
works.technique: Depth-map gesture recognition segments the nearest hand blob, detects an open or closed grasp and moves a 3D overlay rendered with OpenGL ES to the tracked position.
works.technique_zh: 基于深度图的手势识别先分割出最近的手部区域，判断张开还是握拳，再把用 OpenGL ES 渲染的三维叠加物移动到追踪到的位置。
works.exercise_en: With MediaPipe Hands in the browser or Quest hand tracking, make a cube that can only be picked up with a closed fist and is dropped when the hand opens. Twist: the cube slips out if you grab it too fast.
works.exercise_zh: 用浏览器里的 MediaPipe Hands 或 Quest 手部追踪，做一个只能握拳拿起、张开手就放下的立方体。变体：抓得太快时立方体会滑脱。

video.video_title: EyeTap X - Interface Cube II

works.title: FLOW 1
works.description: A duet of hip-hop dance and interactive light where a dancer's flow is translated into projected shapes and trails that move with him on the wall.
works.description_zh: 街舞与交互光影的双人舞：舞者的律动被转化为投影出来的形状和轨迹，在墙上与他一同移动。
works.idea_en: Give the computer access to a street dancer's private flow.
works.idea_zh: 让计算机读取街舞舞者私人的律动。
works.technique: Kinect depth tracking drives Processing graphics projected behind the dancer, calibrated so shapes attach to his silhouette.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 深度追踪驱动 Processing 图形，投影在舞者身后，并经过标定使图形贴合他的剪影。
works.exercise_en: Project a silhouette from a webcam segmentation model and add trails to the hands and feet that fade on the beat. Twist: the trails only appear on popping hits (sudden stops).
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头分割模型投影出剪影，给手和脚加上随节拍消退的拖尾；变体：拖尾只在 popping 的发力点（突然停顿）时出现。

video.video_title: FLOW 1 | KINECT PROJECTOR DANCE

works.title: FUMA-KAI
works.description: Dancers and a juggler interact with projected wind, light trails and particles, as if their gestures generate storms of graphics around them.
works.description_zh: 舞者和杂技演员与投影出的风、光轨和粒子互动，好像他们的手势在身边刮起了图形的风暴。
works.idea_en: Graphics that seem to come from a gesture make the performer look powerful; AR effects should appear to start from the user's hand.
works.idea_zh: 看似由手势产生的图形让表演者显得有力量；AR 特效也应该看起来是从用户的手里发出的。
works.technique: Pre-rendered projected animation is choreographed so trails start exactly where the performers' hands are at each moment.
works.technique_zh: 预渲染的投影动画经过编排，让光轨恰好从表演者每一刻手所在的位置开始。
