works.exercise_en: Use hand tracking in Lens Studio or WebXR to emit particle trails from each fingertip, then choreograph a 30-second duet with a partner. Twist: one dancer's trails push the other's away.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 WebXR 的手部追踪从每个指尖发出粒子轨迹，再和同伴编一段 30 秒的双人舞；变体：一位舞者的轨迹会把另一位的推开。

video.video_title: enra " FUMA-KAI "

works.title: Face substitution tests
works.description: Early openFrameworks tests swap faces in live video, pasting another face onto the tracked face with matching position and expression.
works.idea_zh: 实时把另一张脸'贴'到你的脸上。

video.video_title: Face Substitution tests

works.technique: A face tracker fits a mesh to the live face and texture-maps a second face onto it with color blending (likely based on Kyle McDonald and Arturo Castro's openFrameworks FaceSubstitution code).
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe FaceMesh 把一幅名画的脸贴到自己脸上并跟随表情；加一个变化：两个同学互换脸。
works.description_zh: 早期的 openFrameworks 实验，在实时视频中换脸：把另一张脸贴到被追踪的脸上，位置和表情都同步匹配。
works.idea_en: Paste another face onto yours in real time.
works.technique_zh: 人脸追踪器把网格拟合到实时人脸上，再通过颜色融合把另一张脸作为纹理映射上去（大概率基于 Kyle McDonald 和 Arturo Castro 的 openFrameworks FaceSubstitution 代码）。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe FaceMesh to paste the face from a famous painting onto your own so it follows your expressions. Twist: two classmates swap faces.

works.title: Felice Varini at the Grand Palais
works.description: Inside the Grand Palais in Paris, Varini's new anamorphic paintings stretch over walls, stairs and ceilings of the galleries and resolve into circles and lines when you find the right spot.
works.description_zh: 在巴黎大皇宫的展厅里，Varini 的新变形绘画延伸到墙面、楼梯和天花板上，只有找到正确的位置，它们才会合成圆和线条。
works.idea_en: Searching for the viewpoint is itself the interaction: an AR piece can reward people for moving their body to one pose instead of tapping a button.
works.idea_zh: 寻找观看点本身就是互动：AR 作品可以奖励人们用身体移动到某个位置和姿态，而不是点一个按钮。
works.technique: Anamorphic painting: the figure is projected from a fixed eye point and painted onto whatever surfaces it falls on, so it is only coherent from that point.
works.technique_zh: 变形绘画：图形从固定的视点投射出去，落在哪些表面上就画在哪些表面上，因此只有从那个点看它才完整。
works.exercise_en: Hide a virtual shape across a hallway that only resolves from one pose, and show a faint 'hot-cold' hum as the phone approaches the right position. Twist: after it resolves, the shape follows the viewer for ten seconds before breaking apart.
works.exercise_zh: 在走廊里藏一个只在某个姿态下才能合成的虚拟图形，手机越接近正确位置，“冷热提示”的嗡声就越明显。变体：图形合成后跟随观众十秒，然后再散开。

video.video_title: Les créations inédites de Felice Varini

works.title: Flying Head
works.description: A person wearing a head-mounted display walks, crouches and turns their head, and a small drone copies the same motion in another space, so flying feels like moving your own head.
works.description_zh: 戴着头戴显示器的人走动、蹲下、转头，另一处的小型无人机就同步做出同样的动作，操控飞行就像移动自己的头一样。
works.idea_en: Your head becomes the joystick: body motion drives a flying camera.
works.idea_zh: 头就是摇杆：用身体动作驾驶一台会飞的摄像机。
works.technique: Motion capture tracks the user's head position and orientation and maps it one-to-one to the drone's pose, while the drone's camera feed is shown in the HMD.
works.technique_zh: 动作捕捉系统追踪用户头部的位置和朝向，一比一映射为无人机的姿态，同时把无人机摄像头画面显示在头显中。
works.exercise_en: Map a phone's head-tracked orientation (in a cardboard viewer) to a webcam on a pan-tilt servo or a virtual camera in another room scene. Twist: scale your movements by 10x and discuss how it changes your sense of body size.
works.exercise_zh: 把戴在纸板眼镜里的手机的头部朝向，映射到舵机云台上的摄像头或另一个虚拟房间里的摄像机；变体：把动作放大十倍，讨论这如何改变你对自身尺度的感觉。

video.video_title: Flying Head: A Head Motion Synchronization Mechanism for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Control

works.title: Forever Bicycles
works.description: For Nuit Blanche Toronto, 3,144 identical bicycles were linked into a huge tunnel-like structure over Nathan Phillips Square that shifts into different patterns as you walk around it.
works.description_zh: 为多伦多 Nuit Blanche 艺术节，3144 辆相同的自行车在内森·菲利普斯广场上连接成一个巨大的隧道般结构，绕行时会呈现不同的图案。
works.idea_en: Thousands of identical parts create moiré-like patterns that change with the viewer's position, a direct recipe for instanced AR structures.
works.idea_zh: 成千上万个相同部件产生随观者位置变化的莫尔纹般图案，是实例化 AR 结构的直接配方。
works.technique: Frames of 'Forever' brand bicycles, with wheels and handles removed, are bolted together in a modular grid.
works.technique_zh: 去掉车轮和把手的“永久”牌自行车车架被螺栓连接成模块化网格。
works.exercise_en: Instance 2,000 copies of one scanned object in a grid arch in AR over a walkway and walk through it to see how patterns shift. Twist: each copy rotates a few degrees according to the user's walking speed.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一个扫描物件实例化 2000 份，排成跨越人行道的网格拱，走过去观察图案如何变化；变体：每个副本按用户步速旋转几度。

video.video_title: Scotiabank Nuit Blanche 2013: Forever Bicycles by Ai Weiwei | Timelapse of Build

works.title: From the knees of my nose to the belly of my toes
works.description: The whole brick facade of a derelict house in Margate appears to slide off the building and slump into the front garden, while the house stays intact behind it.
works.description_zh: 马盖特一座废弃房屋的整面砖墙立面仿佛从楼上滑落、堆倒在前院里，而房屋本身在后面完好无损。
works.idea_en: Deforming a real facade with real materials is exactly what AR 'melt' filters do digitally, and it shows how much credibility depends on material detail.
works.idea_zh: 用真实材料让真实立面变形，正是 AR“融化”滤镜用数字方式做的事，也说明可信度有多依赖材质细节。
works.technique: A new brick skin was built on a hidden steel frame in a sliding curve, with real windows and doors bent to follow it.
works.technique_zh: 在隐藏的钢框架上砌出一层呈滑落曲线的新砖墙，并让真实的门窗随之弯曲。
works.exercise_en: Use a facade-tracking or scanned-building AR setup to make a real house front slide down into the garden with a physics animation. Twist: let the user push it back up by swiping.
works.exercise_zh: 用立面追踪或扫描建筑的 AR 方案，让真实房屋的立面带着物理动画滑落到院子里；变体：让用户通过滑动把它推回原位。

video.video_title: Alex Chinneck's Sliding House | Euromaxx

works.title: Galets Magiques
works.description: Children pick up and shake pebbles lying on a projected seashore. Each shake sends out a ripple, and fish and sea creatures hidden under the pebble swim out.
works.description_zh: 孩子们拿起投影出来的海滩上的鹅卵石摇一摇。每摇一次就荡开一圈波纹，藏在石头下面的鱼和海洋生物纷纷游出来。
works.idea_en: Shake a real pebble to reveal the animals hiding under it.
works.idea_zh: 摇一摇真实的石头，下面藏着的动物就会出来。
works.technique: Physical pebbles likely carry motion sensors (or are tracked by a camera) so the software knows which one was shaken, and a top-down projector draws a ripple and animated creatures around that pebble's position.
works.technique_zh: 实体鹅卵石里推测装有运动传感器（或由摄像头追踪），程序据此知道是哪一块被摇动，再由顶部投影仪在该石头位置周围画出波纹和动画生物。
works.exercise_en: Put three objects on a table under a projector or in a Lens Studio / AR Foundation scene, detect when one is lifted or moved, and spawn creatures from that spot. Twist: creatures only come out if the object is put back gently.
works.exercise_zh: 在投影仪下的桌面上（或在 Lens Studio / AR Foundation 场景中）放三个物体，检测其中一个被拿起或移动时，从那个位置生成小动物；变体：只有把物体轻轻放回原处，动物才会出来。

video.video_title: Galets Magiques

works.title: Garden of Russolo
works.description: Phonograph-like wooden boxes in the V&A's garden let visitors speak or sing into them and hear their own voice returned as a muffled, twisted atmospheric noise, a tribute to Futurist composer Luigi Russolo.
works.description_zh: V&A 花园里的一组留声机般的木箱，观众对着它们说话或唱歌，听到自己的声音变成沉闷、扭曲的氛围噪声返回，以此致敬未来主义作曲家 Luigi Russolo。
works.idea_en: Speak into a box and hear your voice turned into noise music.
works.idea_zh: 对着箱子说话，听自己的声音变成噪音音乐。
works.technique: Each box captures the voice with a microphone and re-plays it through filters and amplification that distort and reinterpret the input, following Suzuki's earlier white noise machines.
works.technique_zh: 每个箱子用麦克风收集人声，再经过滤波和放大，把输入扭曲、重新诠释后播放出来，延续了 Suzuki 早先的“白噪音机器”系列。
works.exercise_en: Build a web page that records one second of voice and loops it back through a random chain of Web Audio filters, then place phones in cardboard horns around the school. Twist: each horn replays the voice of the previous visitor.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个网页，录下一秒人声，再通过随机的 Web Audio 滤波器链循环播放，把手机放进纸号角里分布在校园各处；变体：每只号角播放的都是上一位观众的声音。

video.video_title: Garden of Russolo at The John Madejski Garden V&A 2013

works.title: Gravitacional (visiophone, CCL Frankfurt 2013)
works.description: A prototype from the first Choreographic Coding Lab by visiophone (Rodrigo Carvalho): a field of particles is pulled by a central gravity and by two extra forces that follow the dancer's hands.
works.description_zh: 首届 Choreographic Coding Lab 上由 visiophone（Rodrigo Carvalho）做的原型：一片粒子受中心引力牵引，另外两股力跟随舞者的双手移动。
works.idea_en: Turn the dancer's hands into gravity wells that sculpt a particle cloud.
works.idea_zh: 把舞者的双手变成引力井，用它们雕塑一团粒子云。
works.technique: Hand positions from a depth camera become attractor or repeller forces in a particle simulation, projected as a performative visual system.
works.technique_zh: 深度摄像头获取的双手位置在粒子模拟中变成吸引力或排斥力，作为可表演的视觉系统投影出来。
works.exercise_en: Track both hands with MediaPipe in p5.js and let each hand attract particles while a fixed centre pulls them back. Twist: closing a hand flips its force from attract to repel.
works.exercise_zh: 在 p5.js 里用 MediaPipe 追踪双手，让每只手吸引粒子，同时一个固定中心把粒子往回拉；变体：握拳时，这只手的力从吸引切换为排斥。

video.video_title: motionBank-Gravitacional

works.title: HYPER_
works.description: The performer's body shifts between 2D and 3D in front of a large immersive screen: with UV light and 3D glasses for the audience, her figure seems to dissolve into projected colour and step out of it again.
works.description_zh: 在巨大的沉浸式屏幕前，表演者的身体在二维与三维之间切换：借助紫外光和观众佩戴的 3D 眼镜，她的身形仿佛溶进投影的色彩，又从中走出来。
works.idea_en: Make a live body and a stereoscopic image trade places.
works.idea_zh: 让真人身体和立体影像互换位置。
works.technique: Stereoscopic video programmed in Isadora is projected behind and onto the performer while UV light isolates parts of her costume, so live and projected bodies merge in depth.
works.technique_zh: 用 Isadora 编排的立体影像投射在表演者身后和身上，同时紫外光只照亮服装的局部，让真实与投影的身体在纵深上融为一体。
works.exercise_en: Make red-cyan anaglyph video of a moving hand, project it on a white wall, and have a performer in white gloves align their hands with it while the audience wears paper 3D glasses. Twist: switch off the room light so only the gloves remain.
works.exercise_zh: 拍一段红蓝立体的手部动作视频投到白墙上，让戴白手套的表演者把手与影像对齐，观众戴纸质 3D 眼镜观看；变体：关掉室内灯，只剩手套可见。

video.video_title: 4 minutes of excerpts from HYPER_  with original sound

works.title: Hakanaï
works.description: A dancer inside a cube of tulle interacts with projected lines, grids and letters that are performed live around her; afterwards the audience can enter the cube.
works.idea_zh: 舞者在纱幕立方体中与实时投影的线条“对话”，像一首短诗
works.technique: Four-sided projection on tulle scrims is 'played' live by a digital performer using eMotion, with motion sensing linking the images to the dancer.
works.exercise_zh: 用4块纱或白布围成小立方体，投影线条动画，同学在里面随线条即兴；变化：让观众用手机遥控线条，与里面的人互动。

video.video_title: Adrien M & Claire B : Hakanaï

works.description_zh: 一位舞者置身于纱幕围成的立方体中，与四周现场演奏出的投影线条、网格和字母互动；演出结束后，观众可以走进这个立方体。
works.idea_en: A dancer in a cube of gauze converses with live projected lines, like a short poem.
works.technique_zh: 在四面纱幕上投影，由一位数字表演者用 eMotion 现场“演奏”影像，并通过动作感应把画面与舞者联系起来。
works.exercise_en: Enclose a small cube with four pieces of gauze or white cloth, project line animations onto it, and have a classmate improvise with the lines inside. Twist: let the audience control the lines from their phones to interact with the person inside.

works.title: Hans RichtAR
works.description: In LACMA's Hans Richter exhibition, iPads show floating abstract forms inspired by Richter's avant-garde films moving through the gallery around the real works.
works.description_zh: 在洛杉矶县立美术馆的 Hans Richter 展览中，iPad 画面里漂浮着受 Richter 先锋电影启发的抽象形体，在真实作品周围的展厅中游移。
works.idea_en: Let an abstract film escape the screen and move through the museum.
works.idea_zh: 让一部抽象电影逃出银幕，在美术馆里游走。
works.technique: Animated geometric shapes, likely modelled on Rhythmus 21, are placed in the gallery as geolocated or image-anchored augments viewed on tablets.
works.technique_zh: 动画几何形体（很可能参照 Rhythmus 21）被放进展厅，作为地理定位或图像锚定的增强内容，用平板观看。
works.exercise_en: Choose a short abstract animation and rebuild its shapes as 3D objects that fly around a real room with plane detection. Twist: sync their rhythm to music playing in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 选一段短的抽象动画，把其中的形体重建为 3D 物体，借助平面检测在真实房间里飞舞。变体：让它们的节奏与房间里播放的音乐同步。

video.video_title: Hans RichtAR @ Hans Richter: Encounters, LACMA

works.title: Hologauze
works.description: A showreel of Hologauze, a fine transparent mesh stretched in front of the stage that catches projected light so graphics seem to float in the air around performers, as in Eric Prydz's EPIC shows, Beyoncé's Tidal X performance and illusion acts. Uploaded by Stuart Warren-Hill in 2021; the product dates from about 2013 (year approximate).
works.description_zh: Hologauze 的作品集锦：一张绷在舞台前的细密透明网纱，能接住投影的光，让图形看起来漂浮在表演者周围的空中，例如 Eric Prydz 的 EPIC 演出、Beyoncé 的 Tidal X 表演和魔术表演。视频由 Stuart Warren-Hill 于 2021 年上传；该产品约出现于 2013 年（年份为估计）。
works.idea_en: A semi-transparent layer between audience and stage creates floating content without glasses; the same layering logic (content in front of, around and behind real people) is the grammar of AR.
works.idea_zh: 观众和舞台之间一层半透明的网，不用眼镜就能让内容漂浮；这种分层逻辑（内容在真人之前、周围和之后）正是 AR 的语法。
works.technique: A projector throws bright images onto a nearly invisible mesh that reflects part of the light while staying see-through, often combined with a second layer behind the performer for depth.
works.technique_zh: 投影机把明亮的画面投到几乎看不见的网纱上，网纱反射部分光线同时保持透明，常常再在表演者身后加一层以增加纵深。
works.exercise_en: Stage a two-layer AR scene with a performer: one virtual layer in front of them and one behind, using people occlusion in ARKit or Lens Studio. Twist: the performer 'grabs' a graphic from the front layer and throws it to the back.
works.exercise_zh: 为一位表演者搭一个双层 AR 场景：一层虚拟内容在他前面，一层在他后面，使用 ARKit 或 Lens Studio 的人物遮挡；变体：表演者从前层“抓起”一个图形扔到后层。

video.video_title: Hologauze® Showreel by Holotronica

works.title: Human Nature
works.description: Nine stone giants, 5 to 6 metres tall and made of stacked bluestone blocks, stood in Rockefeller Plaza in New York among the office towers.
works.description_zh: 九个由青石块堆叠而成、高五到六米的石头巨人立在纽约洛克菲勒广场的写字楼之间。
works.idea_en: Crude, ancient-looking figures in a polished business plaza create strong contrast, a design cue for AR figures that do not blend in.
works.idea_zh: 在光鲜的商业广场上放置粗犷、仿佛古老的人像，形成强烈对比，这是不试图融入环境的 AR 形象的设计提示。
works.technique: Rough-hewn bluestone slabs were stacked to form head, body and legs and fixed with internal steel.
works.technique_zh: 粗凿的青石板堆叠成头、身体和腿，并用内部钢件固定。
works.exercise_en: Build rough stacked-stone AR giants from three to five blocks each and place them among glass buildings on campus. Twist: the giants slowly rotate to face whoever is closest.
works.exercise_zh: 用三到五块石头搭成粗糙的叠石 AR 巨人，放在校园的玻璃建筑之间；变体：巨人会慢慢转身面向离它最近的人。

video.video_title: Ugo Rondinone: Human Nature / Rockefeller Plaza, New York

works.title: IllumiRoom
works.description: A projector around the TV extends Xbox games onto the living-room walls and furniture: snow falls in the room, the room shakes on explosions, the field of view grows beyond the screen.
works.idea_zh: 游戏画面冲出电视，雪花飘落在客厅墙上，爆炸时整个房间都在抖。

video.video_title: IllumiRoom by Microsoft Research: Peripheral Projected Illusions for Interactive Experiences

works.technique: A Kinect scans the geometry around the TV, the projector is calibrated to it, and game-driven effects (peripheral extension, edge highlighting, radial distortion) are rendered with depth-aware projection mapping around the screen.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影仪对准显示器周围的墙面，在 TouchDesigner 中实时抓取屏幕边缘颜色并向外扩展，同时在屏幕内出现爆炸时让投影画面震动；变体：让房间效果与剧情反着来，比如游戏越激烈，房间越安静。
works.description_zh: 电视周围的一台投影仪把 Xbox 游戏延伸到客厅的墙面和家具上：雪花在房间里飘落，爆炸时整个房间都在震动，视野也超出了屏幕的边界。
works.idea_en: The game bursts out of the TV: snow drifts down the living-room walls and the whole room shakes when things explode.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 扫描电视周围的几何形状，投影仪据此完成标定，再用具备深度感知的投影映射在屏幕四周渲染由游戏驱动的效果（外围视野延伸、边缘高亮、径向畸变）。
works.exercise_en: Aim a projector at the wall around a monitor, grab the colors at the screen's edges in real time in TouchDesigner and extend them outward, and shake the projected image whenever an explosion happens on screen. Twist: make the room effects run against the story, for example the more intense the game, the quieter the room.

works.title: Imaginary Reality Gaming: Quantum Basketball
works.description: Two teams play basketball in a hall with no ball at all; where the virtual ball is can only be inferred from how the other players act and from short audio cues, and power-ups change the rules mid-game.
works.description_zh: 两队人在馆里打一场根本没有球的篮球赛；虚拟球在哪儿，只能从其他球员的动作和简短的声音提示中推断，道具还会在比赛中途改变规则。
works.idea_en: A ball game without a ball, where the ball lives only in the players' shared imagination.
works.idea_zh: 没有球的球赛，球只存在于球员们共同的想象之中。
works.technique: Players wear fiducial markers tracked by overhead cameras; the game logic simulates the invisible ball and announces key events, such as receiving the ball, through audio.
works.technique_zh: 球员佩戴由顶部相机追踪的标记，游戏逻辑模拟那颗看不见的球，并用声音播报接球等关键事件。
works.exercise_en: Play catch with an invisible ball tracked by phones: the holder's phone vibrates and a speaker announces each pass, with no screens needed. Twist: add a power-up that makes the ball 'heavy' so the holder can only walk slowly.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机追踪一颗看不见的球来玩传球游戏：持球者的手机会震动，扬声器播报每一次传球，完全不需要屏幕。变体：加一个让球变“重”的道具，持球者只能慢慢走。

video.video_title: Basketball with an invisible ball

salient.why_en: A basketball game with no ball: players only know where it is from how everyone else moves.
salient.why_zh: 一场没有球的篮球赛：球在哪儿，只能从其他人的动作里看出来。

works.title: Improving Procedural Task Performance with AR Annotations
works.description: Participants press sequences of buttons on control panels while instructions are either shown on a monitor or projected directly onto the buttons to press next.
works.description_zh: 参与者在控制面板上按顺序按下按钮，操作指示要么显示在显示器上，要么直接投影在下一步要按的按钮上。
works.idea_en: Put the instruction exactly where the hand needs to go.
works.idea_zh: 把指示放在手正要去的地方。
works.technique: Projector-camera calibration places highlights and arrows on the physical panel, and the next step appears as each press is registered.
works.technique_zh: 通过投影仪-相机标定把高亮和箭头投射到实体面板上，每次按压被识别后显示下一步。
works.exercise_en: Project step-by-step highlights onto a board game or a set of light switches and time a partner doing a ten-step sequence against a printed manual. Twist: remove the highlight halfway and see who remembers.
works.exercise_zh: 把分步高亮投影到一个桌游或一组开关上，让同伴完成十步操作，并与纸质说明书计时比较。变体：做到一半撤掉高亮，看谁还能记得。

video.video_title: Improving Procedural Task Performance with Augmented Reality Annotations

works.title: In Passing
works.description: A corridor built around the edge of a gallery in Portland has narrow slits and openings; red, green and blue lights in the centre pass through them to form planes and bands of coloured light that change as visitors walk.
works.description_zh: 在波特兰一间画廊的四周建起一条走廊，墙上开着窄缝和开口；中央的红、绿、蓝三盏灯穿过它们，形成随观众走动而变化的彩色光面和光带。
works.idea_en: A slit turns a lamp into a drawing tool in space; in AR, thin light planes that respond to walking can guide people through a building.
works.idea_zh: 一道缝能把一盏灯变成在空间中画画的工具；在 AR 里，会对行走作出反应的细光面可以引导人穿过建筑。
works.technique: Three coloured lights at the centre of the room shine through cut apertures, projecting sheets of light and coloured shadows into the corridor, like a set of camera obscuras.
works.technique_zh: 房间中央的三盏彩灯穿过切开的孔洞，把光片和彩色阴影投进走廊，像一组暗箱。
works.exercise_en: Place three virtual coloured lights in the middle of the room in AR and add a virtual wall with slits so that thin coloured light planes cross the real floor. Twist: let students move the slits with a tap to design their own light path.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 里的房间中央放三盏虚拟彩灯，再加一面开着窄缝的虚拟墙，让细细的彩色光面穿过真实地面。变体：让同学点击移动窄缝，设计自己的光路。

video.video_title: Chris Fraser - IN PASSING - Disjecta - 3D Documentation

works.title: Infinity Mirrored Room – The Souls of Millions of Light Years Away
works.description: Inside a small mirrored cube, LED spheres hanging from the ceiling pulse through colours in a slow sequence while one or two visitors stand alone for under a minute.
works.description_zh: 在一个小小的镜面立方体里，天花板垂下的 LED 球按缓慢的节奏轮流变色；一两位观众在里面独处不到一分钟。
works.idea_en: A strict time limit turns a simple light loop into a precious moment; AR experiences can use scarcity of time the same way instead of running forever.
works.idea_zh: 严格的时间限制让一个简单的灯光循环变成珍贵的一刻：AR 体验也可以用「时间稀缺」来制造分量，而不是无限运行。
works.technique: Programmed LED globes are multiplied by mirrored walls, ceiling and floor, and a timed colour sequence gives the short visit a beginning and an end.
works.technique_zh: 镜面墙、天花和地面把可编程 LED 球不断复制，一段定时的变色序列让短暂的停留有了开头和结尾。
works.exercise_en: Make a 45-second WebXR or phone AR piece: spawn a field of glowing spheres around the user that runs one colour sequence and then dims to black and closes itself. Twist: allow each device to play it only once per hour, and show a countdown to the next visit.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 45 秒的 WebXR 或手机 AR 作品：在用户周围生成一片发光球体，跑完一段变色序列后熄灭并自动关闭。变体：每台设备每小时只能看一次，并显示距离下一次观看的倒计时。

video.video_title: yayoi kusama infinity mirrored room the souls of millions of light years away 1

works.title: Interactive Video Mapping on Canvas
works.description: Photographs hung on a wall are revealed by projection only when people come closer, in different visual styles, and fade away again when nobody is there.
works.description_zh: 挂在墙上的照片只有在有人走近时才会被投影“显影”出来，每次方式都不同；没人的时候，它们又慢慢消失。
works.idea_en: Pictures that only appear when someone is looking.
works.idea_zh: 只有有人在看时才会出现的照片。
works.technique: A depth camera measures visitors' distance to each frame and projection-mapped masks reveal or hide the image accordingly.
works.technique_zh: 深度摄像头测量观众到每幅画框的距离，投影映射的遮罩据此显示或隐藏图像。
works.exercise_en: Project onto three blank sheets of paper and use a webcam to detect which one a person stands in front of, then fade in a hidden drawing there. Twist: the picture shows a different image to each person.
works.exercise_zh: 向三张白纸投影，用摄像头判断有人站在哪一张前面，再在那张纸上淡入一幅隐藏的画；变体：每个人看到的画都不一样。

video.video_title: Interactive Video Mapping on Canvas - MFCK Party Setp. 2013

works.title: Interactive Window Projection – Zierikzee
works.description: A shop window in the Dutch town of Zierikzee becomes a large video screen whose animated content follows and reacts to the passers-by moving in front of it.
works.description_zh: 荷兰小城济里克泽的一扇橱窗变成巨大的视频屏幕，画面里的动画会跟随并回应从橱窗前走过的行人。
works.idea_en: An ordinary window becomes a portal the moment it notices you, a small-scale idea that transfers directly to AR shop fronts.
works.idea_zh: 一扇普通的窗户在察觉到你的那一刻就变成了传送门，这个小尺度的点子可以直接用在 AR 店面上。
works.technique: Rear-projection film on the glass shows the content, while a camera tracks moving people and objects to trigger the interaction.
works.technique_zh: 玻璃上的背投膜显示内容，摄像机追踪移动的人和物体来触发互动。
works.exercise_en: Anchor an AR portal on a real shop window with image tracking and fill it with fish that swim toward the viewer's phone position. Twist: the fish scatter if two viewers stand close together.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪在一扇真实的橱窗上锚定一个 AR 传送门，里面的鱼会朝观看者手机的位置游过来；变体：两位观众站得太近时，鱼会四散逃开。

video.video_title: NuFormer, Interactive Window Projection - Zierikzee, Netherlands - June 2013

works.title: Interactive particles @ La Bifurk
works.description: Party guests step into a box and dance; their bodies appear as sand-like particle figures, and when nobody is inside, geometric shapes animate to the music.
works.description_zh: 派对上的人走进一个盒子里跳舞，他们的身体变成沙粒般的粒子人形；没人时，几何图形随音乐动起来。
works.idea_en: Turn a dancing body into drifting sand.
works.idea_zh: 把跳舞的身体变成飘散的沙。
works.technique: An Intel Creative Gesture depth camera captures the dancers and the software converts the depth silhouette into particles, with the render controlled over DMX by the lighting technician.
works.technique_zh: Intel Creative Gesture 深度摄像头捕捉舞者，程序把深度剪影转换成粒子，渲染效果由灯光师通过 DMX 控制。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam and body segmentation in TouchDesigner or p5.js to turn a dancing student into particles that fall when they stop moving. Twist: the particles of two dancers mix when they touch.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头加人体分割（TouchDesigner 或 p5.js），把跳舞的同学变成粒子，一停下来粒子就掉落；变体：两位舞者碰到时，粒子会混在一起。

video.video_title: Interactive particles @ La Bifurk 05-10-2013

works.title: Invizimals: The Alliance / The Lost Kingdom
works.description: PS Vita AR capture game (The Alliance) paired with a PS3 adventure (The Lost Kingdom) where creatures captured in AR travel between the handheld and the console world.
works.idea_zh: 在掌机上用AR捕获怪兽，再带着它们进入主机冒险世界。

video.video_title: Invizimals: The Alliance and Invizimals: The Lost Kingdom Trailer | PS Vita - PS3

works.technique: Creatures captured in the handheld AR mode are saved to a shared profile and loaded as playable characters in a separate console game, linking two devices through data.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中“捕捉”一个角色并保存为 JSON，再在电脑上的 Unity 场景中读取它作为可控角色；变体：在电脑上升级后，手机 AR 里的角色外观也改变。
works.description_zh: PS Vita 上的 AR 捕捉游戏（The Alliance）与 PS3 上的冒险游戏（The Lost Kingdom）互相搭配，在 AR 中捕获的生物可以在掌机与主机世界之间来回穿梭。
works.idea_en: Catch monsters in AR on a handheld, then take them along into an adventure on the console.
works.technique_zh: 在掌机 AR 模式中捕获的生物被保存到共享的玩家档案中，并在另一款主机游戏里作为可操控角色载入，通过数据把两台设备连接起来。
works.exercise_en: "Catch" a character in phone AR and save it as JSON, then load it as a controllable character in a Unity scene on a computer. Twist: after leveling it up on the computer, the character's look in phone AR changes too.

works.title: Ishin-Den-Shin
works.description: A person speaks into a microphone and then touches someone's ear with a finger; the recorded message is heard only by the person being touched, transmitted through the body.
works.idea_zh: 用手指触碰对方耳朵，悄悄话通过身体传过去。

video.video_title: Ishin-Den-Shin

works.technique: Converts recorded speech into a modulated inaudible high-voltage signal on the speaker's body, and the touched earlobe vibrates as a tiny speaker.
works.exercise_zh: 用骨传导耳机或手机录音，设计“只有被触碰的人才能听到”的传声游戏（碰肩触发播放）；变化：信息沿一条人链逐个传递并逐渐变形。
works.description_zh: 一个人对着麦克风说话，然后用手指触碰另一个人的耳朵；录下的话语通过身体传递，只有被触碰的人才能听到。
works.idea_en: Touch someone's ear with your finger and a whisper travels through your body to them.
works.technique_zh: 把录下的语音转换成调制过的、人耳听不到的高压信号加载到说话者身上，被触碰的耳垂便像一个微型扬声器那样振动发声。
works.exercise_en: Use bone-conduction headphones or phone recordings to design a message-passing game where "only the person being touched can hear" (a tap on the shoulder triggers playback). Twist: pass the message along a human chain, letting it gradually change on the way.

salient.why_en: Touching someone's ear passes a whisper through your finger, so a message travels by touch alone.
salient.why_zh: 用手指碰一下对方的耳朵，悄悄话就顺着身体传过去，信息只靠触碰传递。

works.title: Kinect / Leap controlled realtime creature
works.description: A work-in-progress digital creature that moves and reacts in real time to a person's hands and body, controlled with a Kinect and a Leap Motion.
works.description_zh: 一只正在开发中的数字生物，通过 Kinect 和 Leap Motion 实时响应人的双手和身体，并随之移动。
works.idea_en: Puppeteer a creature with your bare hands.
works.idea_zh: 徒手操纵一只生物。
works.technique: Kinect body data and Leap Motion finger data drive the limbs and behaviour of a procedurally generated creature built with Processing 2.0.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 的身体数据和 Leap Motion 的手指数据驱动一只用 Processing 2.0 程序化生成的生物的肢体和行为。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe hand tracking to drive a simple tentacle creature in p5.js, with each finger controlling one limb. Twist: place it in AR so it crawls on your real desk.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 手部追踪在 p5.js 里驱动一只简单的触手生物，每根手指控制一条肢体；变体：把它放进 AR，让它在你真实的桌面上爬。

video.video_title: Kinect / Leap controlled realtime creature -  WIP

works.title: Kinetic projection mapping
works.description: Graphics are projected onto a rotating icosahedron and stay locked to its faces as it spins.
works.description_zh: 图像投射在一个旋转的二十面体上，随着它转动始终贴合各个面。
works.idea_en: Projection mapping that stays glued to a moving object.
works.idea_zh: 紧紧贴在运动物体上的投影映射。
works.technique: The object's rotation angle is known in software, and a modified version of Kyle McDonald's openFrameworks tool mapamok re-renders the 3D model from the projector's calibrated viewpoint every frame.
works.technique_zh: 软件知道物体的旋转角度，用改造过的 Kyle McDonald 的 openFrameworks 工具 mapamok，每帧从校准后的投影仪视角重新渲染 3D 模型。
works.exercise_en: Put a white box on a lazy Susan, measure its rotation with a phone gyroscope, and keep a projected pattern on each face as it turns. Twist: let each face show a different character who looks at the viewer.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个白盒子放在转盘上，用手机陀螺仪测量旋转角度，让每个面上的投影图案随之转动。变体：每个面上放一个不同的角色，始终看向观众。

video.video_title: kinetic projection mapping

works.title: Laser Forest
works.description: Visitors walk through a forest of 150 tall rods; tapping or shaking a rod plays a note and fires laser light across the dark hall, so the whole crowd becomes an orchestra.
works.description_zh: 观众穿行于由 150 根高杆组成的“森林”中，敲击或摇动一根杆就会发出一个音符并在黑暗大厅中射出激光，整个人群成了一支乐队。
works.idea_en: A walk-through instrument where every touch becomes sound and light in space.
works.idea_zh: 一件可以走进去的乐器，每一次触碰都变成空间中的声音和光。
works.technique: Each rod has a motion sensor that triggers synthesized sounds and laser patterns, with lasers and haze making beams visible between the rods.
works.technique_zh: 每根杆内都有运动传感器，触发合成声音和激光图案，激光与雾气让光束在杆之间清晰可见。
works.exercise_en: Make three 'trees' from cardboard tubes with a phone or micro:bit accelerometer inside; shaking each one plays a note and flashes a projected beam on the ceiling. Twist: make trees that only sound when shaken together.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸筒做三棵“树”，里面放手机或 micro:bit 加速度计，摇动一棵就发出一个音并在天花板上投出一道光；变体：有些树只有同时被摇动时才会发声。

video.video_title: Laser Forest by Marshmallow Laser Feast

works.title: Layar for Google Glass
works.description: Layar's image-recognition AR ported to Google Glass, so printed pages and posters trigger interactive content in the wearer's view.
works.idea_zh: 把印刷品识别AR带到Google眼镜上。

video.video_title: Layar Augmented Reality for Google Glass

works.technique: Image recognition matches printed pages against a database, triggering linked content in a head-worn display without needing a touch screen.
works.exercise_zh: 为一张课程海报做图像识别触发，扫描后播放一段 15 秒的介绍视频；变体：同一张海报在不同时间扫描显示不同内容。
works.description_zh: Layar 将其基于图像识别的 AR 移植到 Google Glass 上，印刷页面和海报可以直接在佩戴者的视野中触发互动内容。
works.idea_en: Bring print-recognition AR to Google Glass.
works.technique_zh: 图像识别把印刷页面与数据库进行匹配，在头戴显示器中触发关联内容，无需触摸屏。
works.exercise_en: Make a course poster into an image-recognition trigger that plays a 15-second introduction video when scanned. Twist: scanning the same poster at different times shows different content.

works.title: Les Voyageurs
works.description: Life-size bronze travellers carrying suitcases are missing large parts of their torsos, so the harbour behind them shows through; the video shows them at the port of Étaples.
works.description_zh: 等身青铜旅人拎着行李箱，身体大块缺失，身后的港口从中透出；视频展示了它们在埃塔普勒港的样子。
works.idea_en: The missing body is filled by the real landscape: the most direct physical example of diminished reality and see-through AR.
works.idea_zh: 缺失的身体由真实风景填补：这是“削减现实”和透视 AR 最直接的实体例子。
works.technique: Figures are modelled in clay, cast in bronze and cut away, with the remaining parts supported through the suitcase and legs.
works.technique_zh: 人像以黏土塑造后铸成青铜，再切去部分，剩余部分通过行李箱和双腿支撑。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR human figure on a street and cut a large hole through its body with a mask, so the real street shows through. Twist: the hole grows as the figure 'travels' further from home (GPS distance).
works.exercise_zh: 在街上放置一个 AR 人像，用遮罩在其身体上切出一个大洞，让真实街道透出来；变体：人像离“家”越远（按 GPS 距离），洞就越大。

video.video_title: Exposition au Port départemental d'Etaples : les voyageurs de Bruno Catalano

salient.why_en: Travellers with their bodies torn away, so the harbour behind them shows through.
salient.why_zh: 旅人的身体缺了一大块，身后的港口从空洞中透出来。

works.title: Light Leaks
works.description: With Jonas Jongejan: dozens of mirror balls reflect light from projectors calibrated with computer vision, filling a whole room with moving points of light.
works.idea_zh: 几十个迪斯科球反射投影光，整间屋子变成流动的光点空间。

video.video_title: Light Leaks

works.technique: Structured-light (Gray code) scanning maps each projector pixel to where its reflection lands in the room via the mirror balls, and the content is authored in that reflected space so light points move coherently.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影仪对准一个迪斯科球或几片镜子，在 TouchDesigner 里逐区域点亮，记录每块区域的光斑落在房间哪里，再编一段光点游走的动画；变体：让光点按一首歌的节奏在墙上“跳舞”。
works.description_zh: 与 Jonas Jongejan 合作：几十个镜面球反射由计算机视觉标定过的投影仪发出的光，让整个房间充满流动的光点。
works.idea_en: Dozens of disco balls reflect projector light and turn a whole room into a space of drifting light points.
works.technique_zh: 用结构光（格雷码）扫描，把每个投影像素经镜面球反射后落在房间里的位置对应起来，再在这个“反射空间”中制作内容，使光点能连贯地运动。
works.exercise_en: Aim a projector at a disco ball or a few mirror pieces, light it region by region in TouchDesigner, note where each region's light spot lands in the room, and then compose an animation of wandering light points. Twist: make the light points "dance" on the wall to the rhythm of a song.

works.title: Line Segments Space
works.description: A web of nylon threads spans a dark gallery; calibrated projection lights the strings to articulate dynamic imaginary forms in the physical volume.
works.idea_zh: 黑暗中一张尼龙线网，被精准投影点亮成流动的三维图形。

video.video_title: Line Segments Space 2014

works.technique: Calibrated projection (projector pose solved against the known string geometry) lights only the pixels that fall on each nylon thread, drawing shapes along lines in physical space.
works.exercise_zh: 在暗箱里拉几十根白线，投影仪用遮罩只照亮线上的像素，在 TouchDesigner 里让光沿线流动出一个立体轮廓；变体：线的排布由一段文字的笔画决定，让光把字“写”在空中。
works.description_zh: 一张尼龙线网横跨黑暗的展厅，经过标定的投影点亮这些细线，在实体空间中勾勒出不断变化的虚构形体。
works.idea_en: A web of nylon threads in the dark, lit by precise projection into flowing 3D shapes.
works.technique_zh: 经过标定的投影（根据已知的线网几何求解投影仪位姿）只点亮落在每根尼龙线上的像素，沿着实体空间中的线条绘出形体。
works.exercise_en: String a few dozen white threads inside a dark box, have the projector light only the pixels that fall on the threads using a mask, and make light flow along them in TouchDesigner to trace a 3D outline. Twist: arrange the threads by the strokes of a piece of text, so the light "writes" the characters in the air.

works.title: Lumière
works.description: In a dark hall, high-power lasers draw fast abstract vector shapes on a screen while each flash is fused with a sound, performed live by Robert Henke.
works.description_zh: 在昏暗的大厅里，大功率激光在屏幕上画出快速的抽象矢量图形，每一次闪光都与一个声音融为一体，由 Robert Henke 现场演出。
works.idea_en: When every visual event is also a sound event, the audience believes the image; AR feedback that pairs light and sound one-to-one feels physical.
works.idea_zh: 当每一个视觉事件同时也是一个声音事件，观众就会相信画面；光与声一一对应的 AR 反馈会显得有实体感。
works.technique: Custom software generates vector shapes for lasers and the matching synthesized sound from the same events, so image and audio stay locked together.
works.technique_zh: 定制软件从同一组事件中同时生成激光矢量图形和对应的合成声音，让图像和声音始终锁定在一起。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR instrument where tapping the air spawns a laser-like line shape and a matching synthesized note at that point in space. Twist: make the shape's size follow the pitch and ask others to play a duet.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 乐器：在空中点击时，在该点生成一个激光般的线形和一个与之对应的合成音。变体：让形状的大小跟随音高，并请另一个人一起合奏。

video.video_title: Robert Henke & Robin Fox - Lumière at the Barbican - ARTEFACT 005

works.title: Marquee
works.description: A white cinema marquee hangs in the gallery with no title on it, its bulbs and neon tubes flickering in patterns as if announcing a film that never arrives.
works.description_zh: 一块白色的影院门檐灯箱悬在展厅里，上面没有片名，灯泡和霓虹管闪烁着，仿佛在预告一部永远不会上映的电影。
works.idea_en: A familiar signal with its content removed makes people notice the signal itself; AR UI can be exhibited as an empty frame to make users feel anticipation.
works.idea_zh: 把熟悉信号中的内容拿掉，人们就会注意到信号本身：AR 界面也可以作为空框来展示，让用户产生期待。
works.technique: Incandescent bulbs, neon and acrylic panels are sequenced by a controller to reproduce the rhythm of classic theatre marquees.
works.technique_zh: 白炽灯泡、霓虹管和亚克力面板由控制器编程，重现老式影院门檐的闪烁节奏。
works.exercise_en: Model a blank marquee in Blender, bring it into Lens Studio and hang it over a real classroom door with blinking bulbs but no text. Twist: text appears only when a second user points their phone at the same marquee.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Blender 里做一块空白门檐灯箱，导入 Lens Studio，挂在真实教室门上，灯泡闪烁但没有文字。变体：只有第二位用户也用手机对准同一块灯箱时，文字才出现。

video.video_title: Philippe Parreno - Marquee (2013), Palazzo Grassi, Venice 2014

works.title: Memory of Form and Matter
works.description: Digitally fabricated sculptures are overlaid with projection-mapped simulations, so static printed structures appear to breathe and move with light.
works.idea_zh: 给3D打印雕塑投上模拟动画，让静止的实物像活物一样“呼吸”。

video.video_title: Memory of Form and Matter

works.technique: Projection mapping registers the projector to the 3D-printed sculpture's CAD model, and simulations (flow, displacement) are rendered in model space so light follows the physical geometry.
works.exercise_zh: 用 3D 打印或纸雕做一个小结构，用 TouchDesigner 的 Kantan Mapper 或投影映射把呼吸般的明暗动画投上去；变体：让它“呼吸”的节奏跟房间里的噪音同步。
works.description_zh: 数字制造的雕塑上叠加了投影映射的模拟动画，让静止的打印结构仿佛随着光在呼吸、在运动。
works.idea_en: Project simulations onto a 3D-printed sculpture so the still object seems to breathe like a living thing.
works.technique_zh: 投影映射把投影仪与 3D 打印雕塑的 CAD 模型对齐，模拟效果（流动、位移）在模型空间中渲染，使光线贴合实体几何。
works.exercise_en: Make a small structure by 3D printing or paper sculpture and project a breathing light-and-dark animation onto it using TouchDesigner's Kantan Mapper or projection mapping. Twist: sync its "breathing" to the noise in the room.

works.title: Mirror Noise
works.description: Five two-minute interactive portrait studies across three screens: your outline becomes neon shapes, sparks shower where you move, recent frames scramble into a time warp, a clap or shout distorts your image, and streams of data flow around you.
works.description_zh: 分布在三块屏幕上的五段两分钟互动肖像：你的轮廓变成霓虹图形，你动的地方洒下火花，最近几帧画面被打乱成时间扭曲，一声拍手或喊叫会让你的影像变形，数据流绕着你流动。
works.idea_en: A mirror that answers your movement and voice with five different moods.
works.idea_zh: 一面镜子，用五种不同的情绪回应你的动作和声音。
works.technique: Three webcams feed edge and movement detection, with a microphone driving the distortion study and a frame buffer shuffling recent frames for the time warp.
works.technique_zh: 三台摄像头提供边缘与运动检测，麦克风驱动变形效果，帧缓存打乱最近的画面形成时间扭曲。
works.exercise_en: Build a webcam mirror that swaps between three effects every minute: edge neon, motion sparks and a sound-triggered stretch. Twist: let a loud clap skip to the next effect.
works.exercise_zh: 做一面摄像头镜子，每分钟在三种效果之间切换：边缘霓虹、动作火花和声音触发的拉伸；变体：大声拍手就跳到下一个效果。

video.video_title: Mirror Noise @ The Forum, Norwich, 1/7/13

works.title: MonstAR Island
works.description: At the Dumbo Arts Festival, visitors on an 'island' are turned into monsters when seen through smartphones.
works.description_zh: 在 Dumbo 艺术节上，站在“小岛”上的参观者透过智能手机看，都变成了怪物。
works.idea_en: A place that transforms anyone who enters it.
works.idea_zh: 一个会把走进来的每个人都变形的地方。
works.technique: Monster models are overlaid on people within a geofenced area using the Semblance AR app, likely by anchoring avatars to viewer positions rather than full body tracking.
works.technique_zh: 借助 Semblance AR 应用，在地理围栏区域内把怪物模型叠加到人身上，很可能是把化身锚定到观众位置，而非完整身体追踪。
works.exercise_en: Make a body-tracking Lens or AR Foundation scene that turns anyone standing inside a taped square into a creature. Twist: the creature changes with how many people share the square.
works.exercise_zh: 用身体追踪的 Lens 或 AR Foundation 做一个场景：任何站进胶带方框的人都会变成怪物。变体：怪物形态随方框中人数变化。

video.video_title: MonstAR Island @ the Dumbo Arts Festival 2013!

works.title: Multitouch Wood Bar with NecTouch
works.description: A wooden bar counter becomes a projected multitouch surface: particles follow fingers across the top, climb a vertical stick when they touch it, and spill onto a front panel.
works.description_zh: 一张木质吧台变成了投影多点触控表面：粒子跟着手指在台面上移动，碰到竖杆就往上爬，再洒落到前面板上。
works.idea_en: Any piece of furniture can become a touchscreen.
works.idea_zh: 任何一件家具都能变成触摸屏。
works.technique: NecTouch uses a Kinect to detect touches on arbitrary surfaces and sends them as TUIO to an Adobe AIR app with a custom surface-warping library that maps content onto three surfaces.
works.technique_zh: NecTouch 用 Kinect 识别任意表面上的触碰，以 TUIO 协议发送给 Adobe AIR 程序，程序用定制的表面变形库把内容映射到三个表面上。
works.exercise_en: Project onto a desk and detect fingertips with a depth camera or a phone above it, then let virtual marbles roll toward touches and fall off the desk's edge onto the floor. Twist: objects on the desk act as obstacles.
works.exercise_zh: 向一张桌子投影，用深度摄像头或架在上方的手机识别指尖，让虚拟弹珠滚向触摸点，再从桌边掉到地上；变体：桌上的实物会成为障碍。

video.video_title: Multitouch Wood Bar with NecTouch and Surface Warper

works.title: Needles and Opium (Les Aiguilles et l'opium)
works.description: In this revival, performers move inside an open rotating cube whose walls receive projections of Paris hotel rooms and New York clubs, so the actor seems to float or walk on walls.
works.description_zh: 在这次复排中，演员在一个开放的旋转立方体里表演，墙面上投出巴黎旅馆房间和纽约爵士俱乐部，演员看起来在漂浮或在墙上行走。
works.idea_en: Rotate the room and gravity looks different; AR can reorient a virtual room around the user for the same disorientation.
works.idea_zh: 把房间转一下，重力看起来就变了；AR 可以把虚拟房间绕着用户重新定向，制造同样的迷失感。
works.technique: A three-sided cube rotates on its axis while projections on its inner walls keep the illusion of a fixed room, with actors on harnesses.
works.technique_zh: 一个三面立方体绕轴旋转，内壁上的投影维持一个固定房间的错觉，演员挂着保险绳表演。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR room around the viewer in WebXR that slowly rotates 90 degrees while furniture stays glued to the walls. Twist: only one object obeys real gravity and falls.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 中围绕观众搭一个 AR 房间，让它慢慢旋转 90 度，家具仍然粘在墙上；变体：只有一件物品服从真实重力掉下来。

video.video_title: Needles and Opium Trailer (English)

works.title: Netykavka
works.description: A cone of projected light in a hazy dark room, inspired by Anthony McCall's solid-light films, reacts when visitors put their hands into the beam.
works.description_zh: 在弥漫薄雾的暗室里，一束受 Anthony McCall“实体光”作品启发的投影光锥，会对观众伸进光束的手做出反应。
works.idea_en: Make a beam of light feel like a solid object you can touch.
works.idea_zh: 让一束光感觉像一个可以触摸的实体。
works.technique: Haze makes the projector's beam visible as a 3D volume, and a sensor (likely a depth camera) detects hands intersecting the beam to change the projected line drawing.
works.technique_zh: 雾气让投影光束显现为三维体积，传感器（很可能是深度摄像头）检测伸入光束的手，从而改变投影的线条图形。
works.exercise_en: In a dark room with a fog machine or hair spray, project a slowly growing circle outline and use a webcam to detect a hand in the beam so the circle breaks where it is 'touched'. Twist: make two beams that can only be merged by two people.
works.exercise_zh: 在暗室里用烟雾机营造雾气，投出一个缓慢生长的圆形轮廓，用摄像头检测伸入光束的手，让圆在被“摸到”的地方断开；变体：做两束光，只有两个人合作才能让它们融合。

video.video_title: Netykavka

works.title: Nosaj Thing 'Eclipse/Blue' music video
works.description: A dancer performs inside real-time projected graphics driven by motion capture, so the visuals wrap her body and the space live.
works.idea_zh: 动作捕捉驱动的投影随舞者身体实时变形

video.video_title: Nosaj Thing "Eclipse/Blue" [Official Video]

works.technique: Motion capture of the dancer drives real-time openFrameworks graphics that are projected onto the stage and her body, with the projector calibrated to the capture volume.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Kinect 或 MediaPipe Pose 追踪一个人，把线条和粒子投影到他身后的墙上并随动作变形；变体：让图形只在人静止时出现，动作越快画面越消散。
works.description_zh: 一位舞者在由动作捕捉驱动的实时投影图形中起舞，影像实时包裹着她的身体和整个空间。
works.idea_en: Motion-captured projections reshape themselves around the dancer's body in real time.
works.technique_zh: 对舞者进行动作捕捉，驱动 openFrameworks 实时生成图形，投影到舞台和她的身体上；投影仪已与动作捕捉空间完成标定。
works.exercise_en: Track a person with Kinect or MediaPipe Pose and project lines and particles onto the wall behind them that deform with their movement. Twist: the graphics only appear when the person is still, and dissolve faster the faster they move.

works.title: One Night Stand
works.description: During Nuit Blanche in Paris, fireworks along the Seine in front of the Musée d'Orsay stage an explosive love story, with shapes rising from the river and the bridges.
works.description_zh: 巴黎白夜艺术节期间，塞纳河上、奥赛博物馆前的烟火上演了一场爆炸式的爱情故事，烟火的形状从河面和桥上升起。
works.idea_en: A city river is a ready-made stage with a long axis and a reflecting floor; AR events can use existing urban lines like rivers and bridges to organise the audience's view.
works.idea_zh: 城市河道本身就是现成的舞台：有长长的轴线，也有会反光的水面；AR 活动可以借用河流、桥梁这些现有的城市线条来组织观众的视线。
works.technique: Fireworks are placed on barges and along the banks and fired in a choreographed sequence so the reflections on the water double every burst.
works.technique_zh: 烟火布置在驳船上和两岸，按编排好的顺序点燃，水面的倒影让每一次绽放都成倍放大。
works.exercise_en: Pick a river, pond or fountain and create an AR show that uses the water plane: every burst you place above it spawns a mirrored copy on the surface. Twist: let two phones control two lovers' fireworks that must meet in the middle of the water.
works.exercise_zh: 找一条河、一片池塘或喷泉，做一场利用水面的 AR 烟火秀：在水面上方放出的每一朵烟火都在水面生成一份倒影。变体：让两部手机分别控制两位恋人的烟火，它们要在水面中央相遇。

video.video_title: CAI Guo-Qiang "One Night Stand" 蔡国强《一夜情》

works.title: Onion Skin (Echolyse)
works.description: The first piece of the Echolyse project: two walls meeting at a right angle are covered with projected lines and planes that, from the right position, flatten the corner into a single image, then peel it apart in layers like an onion's skin, with 5.1 sound by Thomas Vaquié.
works.description_zh: Echolyse 系列的第一件作品：两面成直角相交的墙上投满了线条和平面，从正确的位置看，墙角会被压平成一张图像，然后又像洋葱皮一样一层层剥开，配有 Thomas Vaquié 的 5.1 声道声音。
works.idea_en: A projected image can cancel or exaggerate the real geometry it sits on; AR can flatten, fold or unfold a room corner in the same way.
works.idea_zh: 投影画面可以抵消或夸大它所在的真实几何；AR 同样可以把房间的墙角压平、折叠或展开。
works.technique: Content designed for one viewpoint is projected onto a physical two-wall module so the corner reads as a flat plane (anamorphosis), then animated to reveal the depth again.
works.technique_zh: 把为单一视点设计的内容投到实体的双墙模块上，让墙角看起来像一个平面（变形透视），再通过动画重新暴露深度。
works.exercise_en: Use a room corner and WebXR plane detection to place an image that looks flat from one spot and breaks apart as you move. Twist: add a floor marker for the 'sweet spot' and let viewers find it without instructions.
works.exercise_zh: 利用房间的一个墙角和 WebXR 平面检测，放一张从某个位置看是平的、一走动就裂开的图像；变体：在地上标出“最佳位置”，让观众在没有说明的情况下自己找到它。

video.video_title: Onion Skin by Olivier Ratsi

works.title: PLAYGROUND
works.description: A small shed is turned into a black-and-white projected world that reacts to music and to visitors' movements, and whoever holds the music controller conducts the whole room.
works.description_zh: 一间小木屋被变成黑白投影的世界，随音乐和观众的动作作出反应，拿着音乐控制器的人可以指挥整个房间。
works.idea_en: Walk into the music and see the room answer every sound.
works.idea_zh: 走进音乐里，看房间回应每一个声音。
works.technique: Five projectors map the interior walls, and a Kinect tracks movement while audio analysis of the playing track drives the geometric visuals (with Fake Love and Aramique).
works.technique_zh: 五台投影仪覆盖室内墙面，Kinect 追踪动作，对正在播放的音乐做音频分析来驱动几何图形（与 Fake Love 和 Aramique 合作）。
works.exercise_en: Project audio-reactive line drawings onto the corner of a room and let the position of the nearest person change the style. Twist: the room goes silent and still when nobody is inside.
works.exercise_zh: 把随音频变化的线条图投到房间一角，让离得最近的人的位置改变画风。变体：房间里没人时，画面和声音都静止。

video.video_title: PLAYGROUND

works.title: Perfume at Cannes Lions
works.description: Perfume performs with semi-translucent screens they move on stage; motion capture and a 3D-scanned venue let projections map onto the screens and dancers in real time, blending stage and virtual space.
works.idea_zh: 偶像团体在舞台上推动半透明幕布，实时投影与她们的动作融为一体。

video.video_title: Perfume Performance Cannes Lions

works.technique: Optical motion capture tracks the moving screens and dancers, and a 3D scan of the venue defines a virtual stage in which projector renders are updated per frame to stay mapped onto moving surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 给一块手持白板贴上 ArUco 或 AR 标记，用摄像头追踪它的位置，投影仪把画面始终投在移动的白板上，编一段 1 分钟的舞；变体：两块板靠近时画面会从一块“流”到另一块。
works.description_zh: Perfume 在舞台上一边表演一边推动半透明屏幕；借助动作捕捉和对场馆的三维扫描，投影实时映射到屏幕和舞者身上，舞台与虚拟空间融为一体。
works.idea_en: A pop group pushes translucent screens around the stage while live projection merges with their moves.
works.technique_zh: 光学动作捕捉追踪移动的屏幕和舞者，场馆的三维扫描定义出一个虚拟舞台，投影仪的渲染在其中逐帧更新，确保画面始终映射在移动的表面上。
works.exercise_en: Put an ArUco or AR marker on a handheld whiteboard, track its position with a camera so the projector always casts the image onto the moving board, and choreograph a one-minute dance. Twist: when two boards come close, the image "flows" from one to the other.

works.title: Portal Room Cubes via Stencil Buffer
works.description: A small cube holds a different room behind each face; walking around it reveals several full-size spaces packed into one box.
works.description_zh: 一个小立方体的每个面后面都藏着不同的房间；绕着它走一圈，会看到好几个完整空间塞在一个盒子里。
works.idea_en: Several rooms can share the same space if each is only visible through its own face.
works.idea_zh: 如果每个房间只能透过自己那一面看到，几个房间就能共享同一个空间。
works.technique: Each cube face writes its own stencil value, and each room's shaders test that value so the rooms render only through their faces.
works.technique_zh: 立方体的每个面写入自己的模板值，每个房间的着色器检测该值，因此房间只透过对应的面渲染。
works.exercise_en: Place a stencil room cube on a real desk in phone AR and let students design one room per face. Twist: the rooms connect so a ball rolling out of one face enters the next.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中把模板房间立方体放在真实书桌上，让学生每人设计一个面的房间。变体：房间是相通的，从一个面滚出的球会进入下一个面。

video.video_title: Unity 3D - Portal Room Cubes via Stencil Buffer

works.title: Projection + Dance
works.description: At a workshop in Ho Chi Minh City, real-time visuals are projected onto and around improvising dancers, following their bodies across the stage.
works.description_zh: 在胡志明市的一次工作坊中，实时影像被投射到即兴舞者身上和周围，随着身体在舞台上移动。
works.idea_en: Projection that knows where the dancer's body is in 3D.
works.idea_zh: 知道舞者身体在三维空间中位置的投影。
works.technique: His openFrameworks Kinect Projector Toolkit calibrates a projector to a depth camera so depth-camera points can be mapped directly to projector pixels.
works.technique_zh: 他的 openFrameworks 工具 Kinect Projector Toolkit 把投影仪和深度相机校准在一起，使深度相机中的点可以直接对应到投影像素。
works.exercise_en: Calibrate a projector to a depth camera (or use a webcam and four-point homography) and project a trail that follows a performer's hand. Twist: the trail stays on the floor after the dancer leaves.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影仪与深度相机校准（或用摄像头加四点单应性），投射一道跟随表演者手部的轨迹。变体：舞者离开后，轨迹留在地面上。

video.video_title: Projection + Dance @ Open Stage

works.title: Reality Editor: Programming Smarter Objects
works.description: Early Reality Editor demo: drag virtual lines between physical objects seen through a phone to connect their inputs and outputs, like patching cables in thin air.
works.idea_zh: 在手机画面里从一个物体拖线到另一个物体，就把它们'连'在一起了。

video.video_title: Reality Editor: Programming Smarter Objects

works.technique: Marker-based AR recognition overlays each object's inputs and outputs as nodes, and dragging a line between nodes on the touchscreen writes a data-flow link that the networked objects then execute.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中识别两张图卡（代表“开关”和“灯”），用手指从一个节点拖线到另一个节点建立连接，连接后按虚拟开关就能点亮虚拟灯；变体：在连线中间插入一个“逻辑盒”（延时、反转或计数）。
works.description_zh: Reality Editor 的早期演示：在手机画面中，在实体物体之间拖出虚拟连线，把它们的输入和输出连接起来，就像在空中接插线缆。
works.idea_en: Drag a line from one object to another on your phone screen and they are wired together.
works.technique_zh: 基于标记的 AR 识别把每个物体的输入和输出以节点形式叠加显示，在触摸屏上从一个节点拖线到另一个节点，就会写入一条数据流连接，再由联网的物体执行。
works.exercise_en: Recognize two image cards in phone AR (one standing for a "switch" and one for a "light"), drag a line with your finger from one node to the other to connect them, and then pressing the virtual switch lights the virtual lamp. Twist: insert a "logic box" (delay, invert or count) in the middle of the connection.

salient.why_en: Drag a line between two real objects on your phone and they are wired together.
salient.why_zh: 在手机画面里从一个实物拉一条线到另一个实物，它们就被连接起来。

works.title: Réflexions
works.description: A digital mirror shows each visitor as a digital twin that reacts to how they move and how loudly they speak, never reproducing them faithfully.
works.description_zh: 一面数字镜子把每位观众显示成一个数字分身，它会对观众的动作和说话音量作出反应，却从不忠实地复制他们。
works.idea_en: A mirror that listens and deliberately gets you wrong.
works.idea_zh: 一面会听你说话、却故意把你照错的镜子。
works.technique: A camera and microphone feed body silhouette and sound level into generative graphics, likely built with openFrameworks.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头和麦克风把身体轮廓和音量输入生成式图形，很可能用 openFrameworks 制作。
works.exercise_en: Build a webcam mirror in p5.js or Lens Studio where your outline is drawn with particles whose size follows your voice volume. Twist: when you are silent, the mirror image slowly walks away.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 或 Lens Studio 做一面摄像头镜子，用粒子画出你的轮廓，粒子大小随声音音量变化。变体：你不说话时，镜中的你会慢慢走开。

video.video_title: Réflexions

works.title: SFMOMA AR
works.description: An 'app-arition' by John Craig Freeman and Will Pappenheimer reimagines SFMOMA's future expansion as animated architecture and art that visitors see on the site with a phone.
works.description_zh: John Craig Freeman 与 Will Pappenheimer 的“应用幽灵”，把 SFMOMA 未来扩建想象成会动的建筑和艺术，观众用手机在现场观看。
works.idea_en: Preview a building that does not exist yet as a playful ghost on its site.
works.idea_zh: 把一座还不存在的建筑，以俏皮的幽灵形式在原址预演。
works.technique: Animated 3D architectural fragments and artworks are geolocated around the museum construction site in a mobile AR app with interactive triggers.
works.technique_zh: 动画 3D 建筑片段和艺术品被地理定位在美术馆施工现场周围，通过带交互触发的移动 AR 应用观看。
works.exercise_en: Pick a construction site or empty lot and build a phone-AR proposal of what should be built there. Twist: the proposal grows a new part each time someone taps it.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个工地或空地，用手机 AR 做一个“这里应该盖什么”的提案。变体：每次有人点击，提案就长出新的一部分。

video.video_title: SFMOMA AR

works.title: School Shootings eMorial
works.description: Made with Greg Ulmer for Manifest.AR at the Corcoran, a virtual memorial for victims of US school shootings appears in AR in Washington, D.C., in sight of the Capitol.
works.description_zh: 与 Greg Ulmer 合作、为 Manifest.AR 在科克伦美术馆展出而作：一座献给美国校园枪击案遇难者的虚拟纪念碑，以 AR 形式出现在华盛顿、国会大厦视野之内。
works.idea_en: A memorial placed where the policy decisions are made.
works.idea_zh: 把纪念碑放在做出政策决定的地方。
works.technique: A 3D memorial composed from victim data is geolocated near the National Mall and viewed on smartphones through a mobile AR browser.
works.technique_zh: 由遇难者数据组成的 3D 纪念碑被地理定位在国家广场附近，通过移动 AR 浏览器在智能手机上观看。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR memorial for an issue your class cares about and place it facing the decision-making building on campus. Twist: add one element per new news report.
works.exercise_zh: 为全班关心的一个议题设计 AR 纪念碑，放在校园里做决策的建筑对面。变体：每出现一则相关新闻就增加一个元素。

video.video_title: School Shootings eMorial

works.title: Sharing Faces
works.description: Linked mirror installations in Anyang, Korea and Yamaguchi, Japan: your expression and pose are matched in real time with photos of someone who once stood at the other site.
works.idea_zh: 跨国“镜子”：你看到的是另一国家某个人以相同表情和姿势的脸。

video.video_title: Sharing Faces

works.technique: Face tracking extracts head pose and expression parameters, which are used as a nearest-neighbour query into a growing database of photos captured at the remote site.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 提取头部朝向和嘴巴张开程度，从另一组同学提前拍好的照片库里找出姿势最像的一张实时显示；变体：两个教室互相连线，你只能用对方过去的照片“回应”对方。
works.description_zh: 分别位于韩国安养和日本山口的两面互相连通的“镜子”装置：你的表情和姿态会被实时匹配到曾经站在另一端的某个人的照片上。
works.idea_en: A cross-border mirror: you see the face of someone in another country with your same expression and pose.
works.technique_zh: 面部追踪提取头部姿态和表情参数，并以此作为最近邻查询条件，在另一端不断积累的照片数据库中检索。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe to extract head orientation and how wide the mouth is open, then find and display in real time the most similar pose from a photo library another group of classmates shot in advance. Twist: link two classrooms so you can only "reply" to the other side with their past photos.

works.title: Sketch Aquarium
works.description: Children colour paper fish that are scanned and immediately swim in a giant projected aquarium, where they react when touched.
works.idea_zh: 孩子画的鱼被扫描进投影水族馆里游动

video.video_title: Sketch Aquarium / お絵かき水族館

works.technique: Coloured template sheets are scanned, the drawing is texture-mapped onto a pre-made 3D fish model via the template's known layout, and the fish joins a projected real-time scene with touch or depth-sensor interaction.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一张生物涂色模板，用手机拍照后把纹理贴到 three.js 模型上，让它进入投影的共享水族箱；变体：让每个生物的行为（快慢、群游或独游）由涂色中的主色决定。
works.description_zh: 孩子们给纸上的鱼涂色，扫描后这些鱼立刻就在巨大的投影水族馆里游动，被触碰时还会作出反应。
works.idea_en: Fish drawn by children are scanned in and swim in a projected aquarium.
works.technique_zh: 扫描涂好色的模板纸，依据模板的已知版式把画作作为纹理映射到预先做好的三维鱼模型上，让鱼加入实时投影场景，并通过触摸或深度传感器进行交互。
works.exercise_en: Design a creature coloring template, photograph it with a phone, texture it onto a three.js model, and send it into a shared projected aquarium. Twist: let each creature's behavior (fast or slow, schooling or solitary) be decided by the dominant color in its coloring.

salient.why_en: A fish a child colors on paper is scanned in and swims away in the shared aquarium.
salient.why_zh: 孩子在纸上涂色的鱼被扫描进去，在共享的水族馆里游走。

works.title: Skwarek vs Hight: AR battle over Washington DC
works.description: For the Corcoran's Gallery 31 show, Jeremy Hight and Mark Skwarek staged an 'epic battle' in augmented reality: monsters, ships and poems attack the Capitol and other DC landmarks on visitors' phones, and the public can add its own augmentations.
works.description_zh: 在科科伦美术馆 Gallery 31 的展览中，Jeremy Hight 与 Mark Skwarek 用增强现实上演了一场“史诗大战”：怪兽、船只和诗句在观众手机里攻击国会大厦和华盛顿其他地标，公众也能加入自己的增强内容。
works.idea_en: Turn a capital city into the battlefield of a poetry war fought in AR.
works.idea_zh: 把一座首都变成一场用 AR 打的诗歌战争的战场。
works.technique: Geolocated 3D models and texts are placed with the creatAR tool on a Layar layer, so they appear at fixed GPS positions and heights over the landmarks.
works.technique_zh: 用 creatAR 工具把带地理坐标的 3D 模型和文字放到 Layar 图层上，使它们以固定的 GPS 位置和高度出现在地标上空。
works.exercise_en: In pairs, place geolocated AR objects around campus with a WebAR location tool or Adobe Aero, one student defending a landmark and the other attacking it, then walk the 'battlefield' together. Twist: every object must be a line of poetry whose height above the ground carries meaning.
works.exercise_zh: 两人一组，用 WebAR 定位工具或 Adobe Aero 在校园各处放置带地理位置的 AR 物体，一人守卫一处地标、另一人进攻，然后一起走一遍“战场”；变体：每个物体都必须是一句诗，诗句离地的高度要承载意义。

video.video_title: Washington DC AR Intervention - Skwarek vs Hight @ the Corcoran

works.title: Sky Petition City
works.description: Citizens' petitions are skywritten by a virtual plane in the air above centres of power such as the Capitol and the Pentagon.
works.description_zh: 市民的请愿内容由一架虚拟飞机写在国会大厦、五角大楼等权力中心上空。
works.idea_en: Turn online petitions into skywriting over the institutions they address.
works.idea_zh: 把网络请愿变成写在被请愿机构上空的字。
works.technique: With developer Zachary Brady, submitted petition text is rendered as a trail behind an animated plane geolocated above the target building in a mobile AR app.
works.technique_zh: 与开发者 Zachary Brady 合作，把提交的请愿文字渲染成一架动画飞机拖出的尾迹，地理定位在目标建筑上空，用移动 AR 应用观看。
works.exercise_en: Collect short requests from classmates via a form and make an AR plane write them above the administration building. Twist: only petitions with ten supporters get written.
works.exercise_zh: 用表单收集同学的简短诉求，让一架 AR 飞机把它们写在行政楼上空。变体：只有获得十人支持的诉求才会被写出来。

video.video_title: Sky Petition City - Pentagon - 2013

works.title: Skytower
works.description: A six-metre public sculpture in Airdrie, Scotland, made of 2,000 metres of steel rod shaped like willow and woven together, as if the wind had scattered and reshaped the structure.
works.description_zh: 苏格兰艾尔德里的一件六米高公共雕塑，由 2000 米长、弯成柳枝状的钢条编织而成，仿佛风吹散又重塑了这个结构。
works.idea_en: Steel drawn like wind-blown willow shows how a form can record a force, a starting point for AR sculptures shaped by real wind data.
works.idea_zh: 像被风吹动的柳条一样勾画的钢材说明，形体可以记录一种力量，这是用真实风数据塑造 AR 雕塑的起点。
works.technique: Over 2,000 metres of 12 mm steel rod were bent, interwoven and secured with more than 6,000 welds.
works.technique_zh: 超过 2000 米长的 12 毫米钢条被弯曲、编织，并用 6000 多个焊点固定。
works.exercise_en: Generate an AR tower of curved lines whose lean and spread follow the live wind direction and speed at your location. Twist: record a whole day and freeze the tower as a sculpture of that day's wind.
works.exercise_zh: 生成一座由曲线组成的 AR 塔，其倾斜与散开程度跟随当地实时风向和风速；变体：记录一整天，把塔凝固成当天之风的雕塑。

video.video_title: Skytower- rob mulholland

works.title: Smarter Objects
works.description: Point an iPad at a radio or lamp and a virtual control interface appears attached to it; you can reprogram what its physical knobs do and link objects together.
works.idea_zh: 用平板对准实物，就能看见并改写它'隐藏的界面'和行为逻辑。

video.video_title: Smarter Objects

works.technique: Vuforia image targets recognize each physical object and anchor a virtual UI to it, while an Arduino inside the object exchanges knob and actuator states with the iPad over the network so the virtual UI can remap physical controls.
works.exercise_zh: 用 8th Wall 图像识别或 AR Foundation Image Tracking 识别一个台灯或音箱上的贴图，弹出虚拟控制面板，并通过 ESP32/Arduino 控制一个 LED 的亮度；变体：让一个实体旋钮控制的东西可以在 AR 界面里被“重新指派”。
works.description_zh: 用 iPad 对准收音机或台灯，就会出现一个附着在物体上的虚拟控制界面；你可以重新定义它的实体旋钮的功能，还能把多个物体连接在一起。
works.idea_en: Point a tablet at an object to see and rewrite its hidden interface and behavior.
works.technique_zh: Vuforia 图像目标识别每个实体物体，并把虚拟 UI 锚定在其上；物体内部的 Arduino 通过网络与 iPad 交换旋钮和执行器的状态，使虚拟 UI 能够重新映射实体控件。
works.exercise_en: Use 8th Wall image recognition or AR Foundation Image Tracking to recognize a sticker on a lamp or speaker, pop up a virtual control panel, and control an LED's brightness through an ESP32/Arduino. Twist: let what a physical knob controls be "reassigned" in the AR interface.

works.title: Space Mural (Aurasma)
works.description: A painted space-themed mural that triggers animated AR content through Aurasma when viewed with a phone.
works.idea_zh: 一幅太空壁画在手机镜头下变成动态影像。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Art - Aurasma - Space Mural by Zenka #mocatvupload

works.technique: An image recognition service matches the mural and triggers an overlay animation registered to the painted surface.
works.exercise_zh: 在白板上画一幅简单壁画，用图像追踪让其中的元素飞出来；变体：邀请同学在壁画上添加一笔，观察识别是否仍然有效。
works.description_zh: 一幅以太空为主题的手绘壁画，用手机观看时会通过 Aurasma 触发 AR 动画内容。
works.idea_en: A space mural turns into moving images through a phone camera.
works.technique_zh: 图像识别服务匹配壁画，并触发与绘画表面对齐的叠加动画。
works.exercise_en: Draw a simple mural on a whiteboard and use image tracking to make its elements fly out. Twist: invite classmates to add one stroke to the mural and see whether recognition still works.

works.title: Space Shuttle Endeavour Projection Mapping
works.description: At the California Science Center in Los Angeles, the retired Space Shuttle Endeavour itself becomes the projection surface: light, colour, texture and animation move across its hull while the shape of the orbiter stays recognisable.
works.description_zh: 在洛杉矶加州科学中心，退役的“奋进号”航天飞机本身成了投影面：光、色彩、纹理和动画在机身上流动，而轨道器的外形依然清晰可辨。
works.idea_en: A real historic object is more moving than a replica; AR in museums should augment the artefact itself rather than a screen next to it.
works.idea_zh: 真实的历史物件比复制品更打动人；博物馆里的 AR 应该增强文物本身，而不是旁边的一块屏幕。
works.technique: Projectors positioned around the orbiter are mapped to its 3D geometry; the event date is likely 2012–2013, soon after the shuttle arrived at the museum.
works.technique_zh: 在航天飞机周围布置投影机，按其三维几何对位；活动日期推测为 2012–2013 年，即航天飞机进入博物馆后不久。
works.exercise_en: Pick a large object in your school, such as a piano, a statue or a bike, and create an AR layer that shows how it works inside, anchored with an object or image target. Twist: the layer tells the object's own life story in first person.
works.exercise_zh: 在学校里选一件大物件，比如钢琴、雕像或自行车，用物体或图像识别锚定，做一个展示其内部工作原理的 AR 图层；变体：这个图层用第一人称讲述物件自己的一生。

video.video_title: Space Shuttle Endeavour Projection Mapping | BARTKRESA studio

works.title: Spaxels
works.description: Dozens of LED-lit quadcopters fly in formation over Linz, playing a giant game of Pong in the night sky and morphing into a flying bird.
works.description_zh: 数十架带 LED 灯的四旋翼无人机在林茨夜空中编队飞行，玩起一场巨大的 Pong 游戏，又变成一只飞翔的鸟。
works.idea_en: Each drone is a pixel in 3D space, so the sky becomes a display you can walk under; AR designers can think of floating points as a low-resolution volumetric screen.
works.idea_zh: 每架无人机都是三维空间中的一个像素，天空就成了人们可以在下面行走的屏幕；AR 设计者可以把漂浮的点当作一块低分辨率的立体屏幕。
works.technique: A ground station sends precomputed flight paths and colours to each GPS-guided quadcopter, which carries bright LEDs, so the swarm forms shapes and animations.
works.technique_zh: 地面站把预先计算好的航线和颜色发送给每一架由 GPS 引导、装有明亮 LED 的四旋翼，让机群组成形状和动画。
works.exercise_en: Build a 'spaxel' display in AR: 50 glowing spheres anchored in the sky above a courtyard that fly into formations (a ball, a paddle, a bird) and play Pong controlled by two phones. Twist: limit the swarm to 12 points and see which shapes are still readable.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中做一个“空间像素”显示：在庭院上空锚定 50 个发光球，它们飞成各种阵形（球、球拍、鸟），并由两部手机控制玩 Pong。变体：把机群限制在 12 个点，看看哪些形状仍然认得出来。

video.video_title: Spaxels Testflight Linz/Austria, Ars Electronica Futurelab

works.title: St. Catharines
works.description: Over a week in St. Catharines, Ontario, Denevan drew a large land artwork of nested circles on open ground, filmed from the air by Peter Hinson.
works.description_zh: Denevan 在加拿大安大略省圣凯瑟琳斯用一周时间在空地上画出一件由嵌套圆组成的大型大地作品，由 Peter Hinson 航拍记录。
works.idea_en: Nested circles made one by one show how a big pattern can be built step by step by a single person, like incremental AR drawing.
works.idea_zh: 一个个画出的嵌套圆说明，一个人也能一步步建起巨大的图案，就像逐步增量的 AR 绘画。
works.technique: Circles are marked by walking around a fixed centre with a rope and cutting or raking the ground.
works.technique_zh: 用绳子绕固定圆心行走，并刻划或耙动地面来标出圆。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone as a 'rope': anchor a centre point in AR and draw a circle on the ground as you walk while keeping the distance constant. Twist: every new circle must touch two earlier ones.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机当作“绳子”：在 AR 中锚定一个中心点，一边保持距离一边行走，在地面画出圆；变体：每个新圆都必须与之前的两个圆相切。

video.video_title: St Catharines / Jim Denevan

works.title: Stickwork
works.description: At the Peabody Essex Museum, Dougherty and volunteers weave thousands of saplings into swirling hut-like forms that look like windblown drawings in 3D.
works.description_zh: 在皮博迪埃塞克斯博物馆，Dougherty 与志愿者把数千根树苗编成旋转的小屋状形体，看起来像被风吹动的三维素描。
works.idea_en: Line drawn in space with natural material shows how volumetric sketching can make architecture; AR 3D drawing apps can reach the same feeling.
works.idea_zh: 用自然材料在空间中画线，展示了体积化素描如何成为建筑；AR 三维绘画应用也能达到同样的感觉。
works.technique: Flexible saplings are bent and interwoven over a rough frame, with the outer layer of sticks laid in one direction to suggest motion.
works.technique_zh: 柔韧的树苗在粗略的框架上弯曲交织，外层枝条朝同一方向铺设，以暗示运动感。
works.exercise_en: Use a 3D drawing tool (Open Brush in passthrough or a WebXR line tool) to weave a hut-sized structure over a real bench or tree with a team. Twist: every stroke must follow the direction of the real wind.
works.exercise_zh: 用三维绘画工具（透视模式下的 Open Brush 或 WebXR 画线工具）与团队一起在真实的长椅或树上编出一个小屋大小的结构；变体：每一笔都必须顺着真实的风向。

video.video_title: Patrick Dougherty's Stickwork

works.title: Strandbeest evolution (archive)
works.description: A compilation of Strandbeests from 1990 onward walking along Dutch beaches, powered only by wind, from early fragile models to large beasts that store air in plastic bottles.
works.description_zh: 一部汇编影片，展示自 1990 年以来的海滩生物在荷兰海滩上仅凭风力行走，从早期脆弱的模型到能把空气储存在塑料瓶里的大型生物。
works.idea_en: A machine that walks by the wind makes an invisible force legible as a creature, a good model for AR creatures driven by real sensor data.
works.idea_zh: 一台靠风行走的机器，把无形的力量表现为一只生物，是由真实传感器数据驱动的 AR 生物的好范本。
works.technique: Each leg is a Jansen linkage of PVC tubes whose proportions (found by a genetic algorithm) turn rotation into a smooth walking step.
works.technique_zh: 每条腿都是由 PVC 管组成的 Jansen 连杆，其比例由遗传算法求得，把旋转转化为平稳的步行。
works.exercise_en: Simulate a Jansen linkage in Unity or p5.js, place the walking beast on a beach or lawn in AR and drive its speed with live wind data. Twist: it stops and 'anchors' itself when the wind gets too strong.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity 或 p5.js 中模拟 Jansen 连杆，把行走的生物放在 AR 中的海滩或草坪上，并用实时风数据驱动它的速度；变体：风太大时它会停下来“锚定”自己。

video.video_title: strandbeest evolution

salient.why_en: Creatures made of plastic tubes walk along the beach powered only by the wind.
salient.why_zh: 用塑料管做成的生物，只靠风力就在沙滩上行走。

works.title: Strike A Pose (Gallery One)
works.description: In the Cleveland Museum of Art's Gallery One, visitors copy the pose of a sculpture from the collection and a screen scores how closely their body matches it.
works.description_zh: 在克利夫兰艺术博物馆的 Gallery One，观众模仿馆藏雕塑的姿势，屏幕会为身体与雕塑的相似度打分。
works.idea_en: Understand a sculpture by imitating it with your own body.
works.idea_zh: 用自己的身体去模仿雕塑，从而理解它。
works.technique: A Kinect skeleton is compared joint by joint with a stored pose of each sculpture, and the similarity percentage is shown next to the artwork.
works.technique_zh: 把 Kinect 骨架与每件雕塑预存的姿势逐个关节比对，并在作品旁显示相似度百分比。
works.exercise_en: Use webcam pose estimation to score how well students match the pose of three artworks or photos. Twist: two people must together match a sculpture of two figures.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头姿态估计，为同学模仿三件艺术品或照片的姿势打分。变体：两个人要一起摆出一件双人雕塑的姿势。

video.video_title: Sculpture Lens - Strike A Pose - Cleveland Museum of Art

works.title: Sublimate
works.description: Combines a shape display with see-through stereoscopic AR so data can switch between physical form (pins) and virtual 'gas' form floating above the table.
works.idea_zh: 让数据像物质一样在'固态'实体和'气态'全息之间相变。

video.video_title: Sublimate 2013

works.technique: A shape display is registered with a head-tracked stereoscopic see-through display (half-silvered mirror or tracked tablet), so virtual geometry is rendered in the same coordinate space as the pins and can transition between physical and virtual.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一组实体方块（或乐高）当作“固态”数据，其余部分用半透明虚拟粒子显示在其上方，点击某一数据点时让它从虚拟“凝固”为需要用实体块摆出的形状；变体：反过来，让实体被拿走时化为虚拟的气体飘走。
works.description_zh: 将形状显示器与透视式立体 AR 结合，让数据可以在实体形态（针脚）和悬浮在桌面上方的虚拟“气态”之间切换。
works.idea_en: Let data change phase like matter, between solid physical form and gaseous hologram.
works.technique_zh: 形状显示器与带头部追踪的立体透视显示（半透半反镜或被追踪的平板）进行配准，使虚拟几何体与针脚在同一坐标空间中渲染，并能在实体与虚拟之间转换。
works.exercise_en: In AR, treat a set of physical blocks (or LEGO) as "solid" data and show the rest as semi-transparent virtual particles above them; when a data point is tapped, it "solidifies" from virtual into a shape you must build with physical blocks. Twist: do the reverse, so a physical piece evaporates into virtual gas when taken away.

works.title: Submergence
works.description: Thousands of suspended LED points fill a room as a walk-in 3D display; waves, swirls and figures of light move through the grid while visitors walk inside it.
works.description_zh: 数千个悬挂的 LED 光点充满房间，构成一个可以走进去的三维显示屏；波浪、漩涡和光的形体在点阵中移动，观众就在其中行走。
works.idea_en: A sparse grid of points is enough to make 3D forms you can stand inside; AR point clouds can create presence without heavy meshes.
works.idea_zh: 稀疏的点阵就足以形成可以站在其中的三维形体；AR 点云可以不靠复杂网格就营造出临场感。
works.technique: Hanging strings of addressable LEDs form a volumetric pixel grid, and software renders 3D animations into it, sometimes reacting to visitors' movement.
works.technique_zh: 一串串可寻址 LED 垂挂成体积像素网格，软件把三维动画渲染进去，有时会对观众的动作作出反应。
works.exercise_en: Fill the classroom with a 10 x 10 x 10 grid of AR points in AR Foundation and render a moving sphere of light through it by brightening the nearest points. Twist: let the sphere follow the student who is moving the fastest.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在教室里放一个 10×10×10 的 AR 点阵，通过点亮最近的点，让一个光球在其中移动。变体：让光球跟随移动最快的那位同学。

video.video_title: Submergence

works.title: Sunburst effects
works.description: Rays of light burst from a center and rotate in shifting stripes, like animated manga background effects.
works.description_zh: 光束从中心迸发，以不断变化的条纹旋转，像动态的漫画背景效果。
works.idea_en: Generate classic radial burst graphics as live meshes.
works.idea_zh: 把经典的放射状光芒图形做成实时网格动画。
works.technique: A C# script builds and animates triangle-fan meshes each frame, varying ray width, length and rotation.
works.technique_zh: C# 脚本逐帧生成并动画化扇形三角网格，改变光束的宽度、长度和旋转。
works.exercise_en: Attach a rotating sunburst mesh behind a real person's head using AR face tracking. Twist: let the burst speed up with the person's smile.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR 人脸追踪在真人头部后面挂一个旋转的放射光芒网格；变体：对方笑得越开，光芒转得越快。

video.video_title: Sunburst effects with mesh animation (Unity, C#)

works.title: Symphonie Cinétique – The Poetry of Motion
works.description: A kinetic installation and concert in which suspended light bars and shapes rise, tilt and fall in a dark hall in step with a musical score.
works.description_zh: 一场动态装置与音乐会结合的作品：悬挂的灯条和形体在黑暗大厅中随配乐升起、倾斜、落下。
works.idea_en: Movement itself can be the melody — AR scenes feel alive when objects move in time with sound rather than simply appearing.
works.idea_zh: 运动本身就可以是旋律——当物体随声音的节奏运动而不是突然出现时，AR 场景才会显得有生命。
works.technique: Motorized winches lift and tilt light elements along precomposed trajectories that are synchronized to the musical timeline.
works.technique_zh: 电动绞盘按照预先编排的轨迹抬升和倾斜发光元素，并与音乐时间轴同步。
works.exercise_en: Choreograph five glowing bars in AR that rise and tilt to a 60-second piece of music you pick, anchored in a dark room. Twist: let a clap from the audience trigger the next movement.
works.exercise_zh: 在黑暗房间中用 AR 编排五根发光条，随你挑选的 60 秒音乐升起和倾斜。变体：让观众的一次拍手触发下一段动作。

video.video_title: Symphonie Cinétique – The Poetry of Motion, 2013

works.title: TESSERACT (HyperCube)
works.description: A scaffolding cube in a public square is covered with projection and light so that, seen from the front, it appears to fold, rotate and unfold like a four-dimensional hypercube.
works.description_zh: 广场上的一座脚手架立方体被投影和灯光覆盖，从正面看，它仿佛像四维超立方体一样折叠、旋转、展开。
works.idea_en: Use a real 3D frame to make a fourth dimension feel visible.
works.idea_zh: 用真实的三维框架，让第四维度仿佛可见。
works.technique: Projection surfaces stretched inside a scaffold frame receive content rendered for the main viewing angle so layered surfaces create a volumetric illusion.
works.technique_zh: 绷在脚手架框架内的多层投影面接收按主要观看角度渲染的内容，层层叠加的表面形成体积错觉。
works.exercise_en: Build a cube frame from sticks and stretch two layers of tulle inside, then project content that seems to rotate a cube inside a cube. Twist: find the one viewing spot where the illusion is perfect and mark it on the floor.
works.exercise_zh: 用木条搭一个立方体框架，在里面绷两层薄纱，投影出“立方体套立方体”旋转的画面；变体：找到错觉最完美的那个观看位置，并在地上标出来。

video.video_title: TESSERACT aka HyperCube - 1024 architecture

works.title: The Ark (with Squeaky Lobster)
works.description: At night in the Oaxaca ethnobotanical garden, projections and sound make a grove of giant cacti appear to hold and transmit a luminous archive of the plants' history.
works.idea_zh: 把投影打在真实的仙人掌林上，让植物成为发光的档案
works.technique: Projectors are aligned to the silhouettes of real cacti so scanned outlines and patterns wrap organic, non-planar surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 用投影仪照射盆栽或树枝，按植物轮廓做遮罩动画；变化：用麦克风让植物“听到”声音后亮起纹理。

video.video_title: The Ark - Romain Tardy x Squeaky Lobster

works.description_zh: 夜晚的瓦哈卡民族植物园中，投影与声音让一片巨型仙人掌林仿佛承载并传递着一份关于植物历史的发光档案。
works.idea_en: Project onto a real grove of cacti and turn the plants into a glowing archive.
works.technique_zh: 投影仪与真实仙人掌的轮廓对齐，使扫描得到的外形线条和图案能包裹在这些有机的非平面表面上。
works.exercise_en: Shine a projector on a potted plant or branches and make a mask animation that follows the plant's outline. Twist: use a microphone so the plant lights up with patterns when it "hears" sound.

works.title: The Bay Lights
works.description: About 25,000 white LEDs strung along the vertical cables of the San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge play endless non-repeating patterns of light across the water.
works.description_zh: 旧金山-奥克兰海湾大桥的竖向钢索上挂着约 25,000 盏白色 LED，在水面上方持续播放不重复的光影图案。
works.idea_en: An existing structure's own geometry can be the display; AR at city scale works best when it follows the lines of real infrastructure.
works.idea_zh: 现有结构自身的几何就可以是显示屏；城市尺度的 AR，顺着真实基础设施的线条走时效果最好。
works.technique: Individually addressable LEDs are attached to each suspender cable and driven by generative software whose patterns are likely inspired by wind, water and traffic.
works.technique_zh: 每根吊索上都装着可单独寻址的 LED，由生成式软件驱动，图案可能受风、水和交通的启发。
works.exercise_en: Pick a real railing, fence or row of columns and attach AR light points along its lines with plane or image tracking, then animate slow generative waves through them. Twist: make passing people push the waves in their walking direction.
works.exercise_zh: 选一段真实的栏杆、围栏或一排柱子，用平面或图像追踪沿其线条挂上 AR 光点，让缓慢的生成波在其中流动。变体：让路过的人把光波推向他们行走的方向。

video.video_title: Impossible Light "280,000 Cars" Clip | KQED Truly CA

works.title: The Living, Breathing Wall
works.description: A kinetic wall panel of flexible cells changes shape in response to people's speech and movement, opening and closing like a breathing skin.
works.description_zh: 一面由柔性单元组成的动态墙板，会根据人的说话和动作改变形状，像呼吸的皮肤一样开合。
works.idea_en: A wall that recognises speech and answers with shape shows how architecture can listen; AR can let real walls 'listen' the same way.
works.idea_zh: 一面能识别语音并以形状回应的墙，展示了建筑如何“倾听”；AR 可以让真实的墙以同样的方式“倾听”。
works.technique: Speech recognition and motion sensing drive shape-memory-alloy actuators that deform flexible panels; details of the control are likely custom Arduino code.
works.technique_zh: 语音识别和运动感应驱动形状记忆合金执行器，使柔性面板变形；控制细节很可能是自定义的 Arduino 代码。
works.exercise_en: Detect a real wall with plane detection and cover it with AR cells that open when the microphone hears a keyword and close in silence. Twist: give each speaker's voice pitch its own region of the wall.
works.exercise_zh: 用平面检测找到一面真实的墙，覆盖上 AR 单元，麦克风听到某个关键词时它们张开，安静时合拢。变体：按说话人的音高把墙分成不同区域。

video.video_title: The Living, Breathing Wall

works.title: The Radar
works.description: Passers-by connect their own smartphones to a local Wi-Fi network and use them as controllers to solve a projected puzzle on a building façade together.
works.description_zh: 路人用自己的智能手机连上现场 Wi-Fi，把手机当手柄，一起解开投在建筑立面上的谜题。
works.idea_en: The crowd's phones become game controllers for a building-sized screen.
works.idea_zh: 人群手里的手机，变成一面建筑大屏的游戏手柄。
works.technique: A local web server hands each connected phone a control page and relays its inputs to the real-time mapping software, supporting several players at once.
works.technique_zh: 本地 Web 服务器给每台连接的手机下发控制页面，并把输入实时转发给投影软件，可同时支持多名玩家。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebSocket page that lets up to five phones steer dots on a projected wall, and design a puzzle that needs all five to cooperate. Twist: give each phone a different, secret ability.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 WebSocket 网页，让最多五部手机操控投影墙上的光点，并设计一个必须五人合作才能完成的谜题；变体：给每部手机一个不同的秘密能力。

video.video_title: The Radar - Interactive mapping installation for public controlled by mobile devices

works.title: The Shape of a Circle in the Mind of a Square
works.description: A black rotating sculpture turns steadily and its outline switches between a circle and a square, 'squaring the circle' in front of the viewer's eyes.
works.description_zh: 一件黑色旋转雕塑匀速转动，它的轮廓在圆与方之间切换，在观众眼前“化圆为方”。
works.idea_en: Rotation reveals that circle and square can be the same object — a clear demo of why AR must be judged from many viewpoints.
works.idea_zh: 旋转揭示出圆和方可以是同一个物体——这是一个说明为什么 AR 必须从多个视角检验的清晰例子。
works.technique: The sculpture's cross-sections are shaped so that its projected silhouette morphs between a circle and a square as it rotates about one axis.
works.technique_zh: 雕塑的截面经过设计，绕一根轴旋转时，投影轮廓在圆形与方形之间变化。
