works.exercise_en: Build a spinning AR object that looks like a circle to one user and a square to another standing 90° away, using shared anchors. Twist: let the users swap places and argue about what they saw.
works.exercise_zh: 用共享锚点做一个旋转的 AR 物体，让一位用户看到圆，站在 90° 外的另一位看到方。变体：让两人交换位置，讨论各自看到了什么。

video.video_title: Troika "The Shape Of A Circle In The Mind Of A Square"

works.title: Timepiece
works.description: In the domed Roundhouse, a huge three-armed mechanism turns like a clock with a light at its tip, sweeping shadows across the space and marking hours, minutes and seconds.
works.description_zh: 在圆顶的 Roundhouse 中，一个巨大的三臂机构像时钟一样转动，末端带着一盏灯，让影子扫过整个空间，标记时、分、秒。
works.idea_en: Turning a clock into a moving light makes time something you stand inside — AR can externalize invisible rhythms at architectural scale.
works.idea_zh: 把时钟变成一盏移动的灯，时间就成了你身处其中的东西——AR 可以把看不见的节奏放大到建筑尺度。
works.technique: Three nested rotating arms move at the rates of clock hands, carrying a lamp whose combined motion traces a complex path through the dome.
works.technique_zh: 三根嵌套旋转的手臂以时钟指针的速率运动，末端的灯在组合运动下在穹顶中描出复杂路径。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a room-sized virtual clock in AR whose three arms carry a light and cast shadows of real furniture over one class period. Twist: speed it up 60× when someone raises a hand.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中锚定一座房间大小的虚拟时钟，它的三根臂带着灯，在一节课的时间里投射出真实家具的影子。变体：有人举手时让它加速 60 倍。

video.video_title: Conrad Shawcross' spectacular Timepiece in action at the Roundhouse

works.title: Towards Intelligent View Management
works.description: While walking through streets with a video see-through display, users drag text panels where they prefer them; the recordings reveal clusters of 'safe' places that an automatic system can learn.
works.description_zh: 用户戴着视频透视显示器走在街上，把文字面板拖到自己喜欢的位置；记录显示出一些“安全区域”的聚集规律，可供自动系统学习。
works.idea_en: Learn where people want text to sit in their view before letting software place it.
works.idea_zh: 先弄清人们希望文字待在视野哪里，再让软件去自动摆放。
works.technique: Records manual placements of text overlays in mobile video see-through AR and clusters them against image features such as dark, uniform regions to derive placement rules.
works.technique_zh: 记录移动视频透视 AR 中用户手动放置文字的位置，并结合图像特征（如较暗、均匀的区域）做聚类，归纳出摆放规则。
works.exercise_en: Walk a route with a phone camera app and a sticky note on the screen; at ten stops move the note to where it bothers you least and screenshot it, then map the patterns as a class. Twist: repeat while talking to a partner and see where the note moves.
works.exercise_zh: 拿着开着相机的手机沿一条路线走，屏幕上贴一张便利贴；在十个停留点把便利贴移到最不碍事的位置并截图，全班一起总结规律；变体：边和同伴聊天边做一遍，看便利贴会被移到哪里。

video.video_title: ISMAR 2013 - Towards Intelligent View Management

works.title: Tree Fall
works.description: Inside a former gunpowder store in the Presidio, a eucalyptus trunk is suspended from the vaulted ceiling, and both ceiling and trunk are covered in cracked clay.
works.description_zh: 在 Presidio 一座旧火药库内，一根桉树树干悬挂在拱顶下，天花板和树干都覆盖着干裂的泥土。
works.idea_en: Bringing a tree indoors and coating the room around it creates a portal-like space, the same effect AR world replacement aims for.
works.idea_zh: 把一棵树带进室内并给整个房间覆上泥层，营造出传送门般的空间，这正是 AR 替换世界想要达到的效果。
works.technique: The trunk is hung from the ceiling and the surfaces are plastered with local clay that dries and cracks into a pattern.
works.technique_zh: 树干悬挂于天花板，墙面和树干抹上当地的泥土，干燥后裂出纹理。
works.exercise_en: Use LiDAR scene reconstruction (ARKit) to cover a real room's ceiling and walls with a cracked-clay material and hang a virtual tree from the ceiling. Twist: the cracks spread wherever the user looks longest.
works.exercise_zh: 用激光雷达场景重建（ARKit）给真实房间的天花板和墙面覆上干裂泥土材质，并从天花板上悬挂一棵虚拟树；变体：用户注视最久的地方裂纹蔓延得最快。

video.video_title: Andy Goldsworthy: Tree Fall

works.title: Turbulent Flow (particle animations)
works.description: Clouds of particles are pushed around by turbulence, attractors and bouncing forces in a series of short studies.
works.description_zh: 一系列小练习中，粒子云被湍流、吸引子和反弹力推来推去。
works.idea_en: Shape a particle system with external forces instead of emitter settings.
works.idea_zh: 用外力而不是发射器参数来塑造粒子系统。
works.technique: A script reads Shuriken particles every frame, applies custom forces such as noise turbulence and point attractors, and writes them back.
works.technique_zh: 脚本每帧读取 Shuriken 粒子，施加噪声湍流、点吸引子等自定义力，再写回粒子系统。
works.exercise_en: Place a particle cloud in AR and add an attractor at the phone position so the cloud follows the viewer. Twist: add a second attractor at a classmate's phone and let the cloud choose between them.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中放一团粒子，并在手机位置加一个吸引子，让粒子跟着观众走；变体：在另一位同学的手机上再加一个吸引子，让粒子在两人之间“选择”。

video.video_title: Turbulent Flow

works.title: Undulation
works.description: A field of slow-moving objects rises and falls in waves while a fast camera flies through them.
works.description_zh: 一片缓慢起伏的物体像波浪一样涨落，快速移动的镜头从中穿过。
works.idea_en: Contrast slow motion in the scene with a fast-moving camera.
works.idea_zh: 用场景中的慢动作和镜头的快速运动形成对比。
works.technique: Perlin noise drives the height and rotation of a grid of objects, while the camera follows a fast path through the field.
works.technique_zh: Perlin 噪声驱动一片网格状物体的高度和旋转，镜头则沿一条快速路径穿过其中。
works.exercise_en: Fill a room in AR with a field of cubes that rise and fall in noise waves, and let students walk through it with the phone. Twist: make the waves calmer the slower the viewer walks.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中用一片随噪声起伏的立方体填满房间，让学生拿着手机从中走过；变体：观众走得越慢，波浪就越平静。

video.video_title: Undulation (3)

works.title: Vanishing Point
works.description: Laser lines drawn in haze converge on a single point in the room, building and dissolving Renaissance-style perspective grids around the viewer.
works.description_zh: 在雾中画出的激光线汇聚到房间中的一个点，在观众周围搭建又消解文艺复兴式的透视网格。
works.idea_en: Perspective is a construction you can stand inside — AR designers can make the vanishing point itself a visible object.
works.idea_zh: 透视是一种可以走进去的构造——AR 设计者可以把消失点本身做成一个可见的物体。
works.technique: Lasers project lines through haze from a fixed origin so that all lines meet at a chosen vanishing point, animated to reveal and collapse the grid.
works.technique_zh: 激光从固定原点穿过雾气投射线条，所有线都汇向一个选定的消失点，并通过动画显现和收拢网格。
works.exercise_en: Draw glowing perspective lines in AR that all converge on one point in a real corridor, and let them rebuild the grid as the user walks. Twist: move the vanishing point to follow the user's head.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中画出汇聚到真实走廊中某一点的发光透视线，用户走动时让它们重新搭建网格。变体：让消失点跟随用户的头部移动。

video.video_title: United Visual Artists' Vanishing Point at Towner, Eastbourne (long version)

works.title: Virtual Kinetic Sculpture
works.description: Hundreds of suspended elements move up and down in interlocking waves, like a kinetic sculpture hanging in a museum atrium.
works.description_zh: 数百个悬挂的元素以交错的波浪上下移动，像博物馆中庭里悬挂的动态雕塑。
works.idea_en: Rebuild a physical kinetic sculpture as a virtual one.
works.idea_zh: 把实体的动态雕塑搬进虚拟空间。
works.technique: Each element's height is a sum of sine waves whose phases depend on its grid position, so simple math produces rolling interference patterns.
works.technique_zh: 每个元素的高度是几条正弦波之和，相位取决于它在网格中的位置，简单的数学就能产生滚动的干涉图案。
works.exercise_en: Hang a virtual kinetic sculpture of spheres from a real ceiling in AR and compute each sphere's height from sine waves. Twist: let a raised hand in front of the camera add a new wave.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一组球体组成的虚拟动态雕塑挂在真实的天花板下，用正弦波计算每个球的高度；变体：镜头前举起一只手，就加入一道新的波。

video.video_title: Virtual Kinetic Sculpture

works.title: Voice Tunnel
works.description: New York's Park Avenue Tunnel is closed to cars and lined with 300 theatre spotlights; people speak into an intercom and their voice becomes flickering light and sound that travels down the tunnel.
works.description_zh: 纽约公园大道隧道对车辆关闭，沿途布置了 300 盏舞台聚光灯；人们对着对讲机说话，声音化作闪烁的光和声音沿隧道传下去。
works.idea_en: A voice that travels as light along a real corridor turns sound into something you can see move — a clear pattern for spatial audio visualisation in AR.
works.idea_zh: 声音化作光沿真实走廊传播，让人看见声音在移动——这是 AR 空间声音可视化的清晰模式。
works.technique: Each recording's amplitude modulates the brightness of one spotlight and 150 speakers along the tunnel; new recordings push older ones further along the queue.
works.technique_zh: 每段录音的振幅调制一盏聚光灯和沿隧道 150 个扬声器之一；新录音把旧录音沿队列往后推。
works.exercise_en: Line a real hallway with AR lights whose brightness follows recorded voices, and make each new voice push the older ones one light farther away. Twist: let listeners walk to a light to hear that voice spatially.
works.exercise_zh: 在一条真实走廊两侧排列 AR 灯，亮度随录下的人声变化，每个新声音把旧的向远处推一盏灯。变体：让听众走到某盏灯旁，就能以空间音频听到那段声音。

video.video_title: Transforming the Park Avenue Tunnel with Light and Sound | Voice Tunnel

salient.why_en: Your voice becomes a wave of light that runs down a real tunnel.
salient.why_zh: 你的声音变成一道光波，沿着真实的隧道一路跑远。

works.title: Water Surface (isosurface)
works.description: A blobby liquid surface forms, wobbles and splits, generated as an isosurface from moving sources.
works.description_zh: 一个团状的液体表面不断形成、晃动、分裂，由移动的源点生成等值面。
works.idea_en: Build liquid shapes from invisible fields instead of modelled meshes.
works.idea_zh: 用看不见的场而不是建模的网格来生成液体形状。
works.technique: Metaball-like sources add up to a scalar field, and a marching cubes mesh generator extracts the isosurface every frame.
works.technique_zh: 类似 metaball 的源点叠加成一个标量场，再由 marching cubes 网格生成器逐帧提取等值面。
works.exercise_en: Generate a metaball liquid with marching cubes in AR and let the blobs sit on a real table. Twist: add a source at the tracked fingertip so the user can pull liquid out of the puddle.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中用 marching cubes 生成 metaball 液体，让它停在真实桌面上；变体：在追踪到的指尖加一个源点，让用户能从液面里拉出液体。

video.video_title: Water Surface

works.title: Weather Worlds
works.description: Real-time green-screening places children inside a dynamic weather world where body gestures conjure storms, tornadoes and lightning.
works.idea_zh: 孩子站进画面获得操控天气的超能力：挥手召唤风暴和闪电。

video.video_title: Weather Worlds

works.technique: Green-screen chroma keying composites children into a 3D weather scene, and gesture detection from the silhouette (arm raise, spin) triggers particle weather systems.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 分割把人抠进一个天气场景，举手下雨、转圈起风，投在墙上；变体：天气由情绪触发，比如大笑放晴、捂脸起雾。
works.description_zh: 实时绿幕抠像把孩子们放进一个动态的天气世界，他们用身体手势召唤风暴、龙卷风和闪电。
works.idea_en: Children step into the picture and gain the power to control weather, waving up storms and lightning.
works.technique_zh: 绿幕色度抠像把孩子合成进三维天气场景，再根据剪影识别手势（举臂、转圈），触发粒子天气系统。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe segmentation to cut people into a weather scene projected on the wall, where raising a hand brings rain and spinning brings wind. Twist: trigger weather with emotions, for example laughing clears the sky and covering your face brings fog.

works.title: Wonderbook: Book of Potions
works.description: A second Harry Potter Wonderbook where players brew potions in a virtual cauldron sitting on the book, grinding and pouring ingredients with the Move controller.
works.idea_zh: 在实体书上用手柄碾磨、倒入材料，调配AR魔药。

video.video_title: Wonderbook: Book of Potions - E3 Announce

works.technique: The book marker anchors a virtual cauldron, and controller motion patterns such as grinding and pouring are recognized from IMU data to add ingredients.
works.exercise_zh: 在图像标记上放一口 AR 锅，用手机的摇晃、倾倒动作（加速度计）添加不同原料，配方正确时冒出彩色烟雾；变体：配方需要按正确顺序加入。
works.description_zh: 哈利·波特系列的第二本 Wonderbook：玩家在放在书上的虚拟坩埚里熬制魔药，用 Move 手柄研磨、倾倒各种材料。
works.idea_en: Grind and pour ingredients with a controller over a real book to brew AR potions.
works.technique_zh: 书本标记用于锚定虚拟坩埚，系统根据 IMU 数据识别研磨、倾倒等手柄动作模式，从而加入相应材料。
works.exercise_en: Put an AR cauldron on an image marker and add different ingredients by shaking or tilting the phone (accelerometer), with colored smoke rising when the recipe is right. Twist: the ingredients must be added in the correct order.

works.title: Wonderbook: Diggs Nightcrawler
works.description: A film-noir detective story for Wonderbook: turning the pages of the physical book opens pop-up scenes of Library City, where players help bookworm detective Diggs investigate Humpty Dumpty's fall.
works.description_zh: 一部为 Wonderbook 打造的黑色电影风格侦探故事：翻动实体书页，Library City 的立体场景就从书中弹出，玩家帮助书虫侦探 Diggs 调查 Humpty Dumpty 摔落之谜。
works.idea_en: Turning a real page works like a camera cut in a detective movie.
works.idea_zh: 翻动真实的书页，就像侦探电影里的一次镜头切换。
works.technique: Page patterns printed in the Wonderbook are tracked by the PlayStation Eye so pop-up dioramas and characters stay glued to the open spread as it moves.
works.technique_zh: PlayStation Eye 追踪 Wonderbook 书页上印刷的图案，让立体布景和角色在书本移动时仍牢牢贴在翻开的书页上。
works.exercise_en: Write a three-page mystery and make each page an AR image target that shows one pop-up diorama with a hidden clue; readers must tilt the phone around the book to spot it. Twist: make the final page show a different culprit depending on which clues were tapped.
works.exercise_zh: 写一个三页的小悬疑故事，把每页做成 AR 图像标记，各呈现一个藏有线索的立体场景，读者必须绕着书移动手机才能发现线索。变体：根据读者点中了哪些线索，让最后一页揭示不同的凶手。

video.video_title: Wonderbook™: Diggs Nightcrawler™

works.title: Wonderbook: Walking with Dinosaurs
works.description: A BBC-licensed Wonderbook title: players dig fossils out of the pages of a physical marker book, then rebuild and feed dinosaurs that stomp out of the book into the living-room camera image.
works.description_zh: BBC 授权的 Wonderbook 游戏：玩家从实体标记书的书页里挖出化石，再把恐龙拼装复原、喂养，看着它们从书中走进电视画面里的客厅。
works.idea_en: A paper book becomes an excavation site, and each page turn advances a natural-history lesson.
works.idea_zh: 一本纸书变成考古挖掘现场，每翻一页，自然史课程就往前推进一步。
works.technique: The PlayStation Eye tracks printed patterns on each Wonderbook page to anchor 3D scenes to the book, while the Move controller acts as brush, hand or food.
works.technique_zh: PlayStation Eye 识别 Wonderbook 每页上的印刷图案，把 3D 场景锚定在书上；Move 手柄则充当刷子、手或食物。
works.exercise_en: Print four image-target pages and staple them into a booklet; in Unity with Vuforia or AR Foundation image tracking, make each page reveal one stage of a fossil dig (buried, brushed, assembled, alive). Twist: require the reader to tilt or shake the book to uncover the next layer.
works.exercise_zh: 打印四页图像识别标记并装订成小册子；在 Unity 中用 Vuforia 或 AR Foundation 图像追踪，让每一页依次呈现化石挖掘的一个阶段（掩埋、清理、拼装、复活）。变体：要求读者倾斜或摇晃书本才能露出下一层。

video.video_title: Wonderbook: Walking with Dinosaurs

works.title: Woodland Wiggle
works.description: A room-sized interactive TV at the Royal London Hospital where children step into a storybook woodland to paint, play music and summon weather with animated animals.
works.idea_zh: 医院里整面墙的互动童话森林，孩子用身体画画、奏乐、召唤天气。

video.video_title: Woodland Wiggle

works.technique: Kinect body tracking maps children's positions and gestures to triggers in a 2D animated scene (painting, playing instruments, calling weather), with large-scale display for full-body play.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个儿童候诊区设计一面体感墙：用 MediaPipe Pose 让伸手、跳跃、蹲下分别触发画画、敲鼓、下雪；变体：所有动作都要能在坐着或躺着时完成，适合行动不便的孩子。
works.description_zh: 伦敦皇家医院里一台房间大小的互动电视，孩子们走进童话般的林地，与动画动物一起画画、奏乐、召唤天气。
works.idea_en: A wall-sized interactive fairy-tale forest in a hospital, where children paint, make music and call up weather with their bodies.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 身体追踪把孩子的位置和手势映射为二维动画场景中的触发事件（画画、演奏乐器、召唤天气），配合大尺寸显示实现全身互动。
works.exercise_en: Design a motion-sensing wall for a children's waiting area: use MediaPipe Pose so reaching out, jumping and crouching trigger painting, drumming and snow. Twist: every action must be possible while sitting or lying down, for children with limited mobility.

works.title: Word Lens for Glass
works.description: Word Lens on Google Glass: the wearer looks at a sign and sees it translated in their view hands-free.
works.idea_zh: 戴上眼镜看招牌，翻译直接出现在视野里。

video.video_title: Introducing Word Lens for Glass

works.technique: The OCR and in-place replacement pipeline runs on head-worn camera frames, so translation appears in view without holding a device.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机前后摄像头模拟眼镜视角做“免手持”文字翻译，并讨论眼镜上需要如何简化界面；变体：只用语音朗读翻译结果，不显示文字。
works.description_zh: 运行在 Google Glass 上的 Word Lens：佩戴者看向一块招牌，无需动手，视野中就会出现翻译后的文字。
works.idea_en: Look at a sign through the glasses and the translation appears right in your view.
works.technique_zh: OCR 与原位替换流程直接处理头戴摄像头拍到的画面，无需手持设备就能在视野中看到翻译。
works.exercise_en: Simulate a glasses view with a phone's cameras to build hands-free text translation, and discuss how the interface would need to be simplified for glasses. Twist: only read the translation aloud by voice, with no text shown.

works.title: WorldKit
works.description: Paint an interface onto any surface with a sweep of the hand: buttons, sliders and displays are projected where you draw them and become touch-enabled.
works.idea_zh: 用手在任意桌面墙面上'刷'一下，就长出一个可触控的按钮或滑杆。

video.video_title: WorldKit

works.technique: A calibrated Kinect and projector let the user paint a region with a hand; the depth map within that region is used as a touch-sensing surface and the painted region becomes a projected widget.
works.exercise_zh: 用投影仪 + 摄像头实现：用手在墙上画一个矩形区域，系统在这里生成一个投影按钮或滑块，碰到时切换灯光或音乐；变体：让同学在教室里“布置”出一个只用投影的工作台。
works.description_zh: 只需挥手一扫，就能把界面“刷”到任何表面上：按钮、滑块和显示区域会被投影到你画出的位置，并且可以触控。
works.idea_en: Swipe your hand over any table or wall and a touchable button or slider appears there.
works.technique_zh: 经过标定的 Kinect 和投影仪让用户用手“涂”出一块区域；该区域内的深度图被用作触摸感应表面，涂出的区域则成为一个投影控件。
works.exercise_en: With a projector and a camera, draw a rectangle on the wall with your hand, and have the system generate a projected button or slider there that switches the lights or music when touched. Twist: have classmates "set up" a projection-only workstation in the classroom.

works.title: YouMove
works.description: An AR mirror records an expert's movement and then trains learners by overlaying skeleton guides and feedback on their mirror reflection, gradually removing guidance.
works.idea_zh: AR魔镜把老师的动作叠在你的镜像上，一步步教你跳。

video.video_title: YouMove: Enhancing Movement Training with an Augmented Reality Mirror

works.technique: Uses Kinect skeleton tracking behind a large half-silvered mirror to draw recorded motion guides aligned with the user's reflection and score their accuracy.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机前摄+人体姿态识别（如MediaPipe/Effect House）叠加一个“老师骨架”，学生跟着做一套广播操并获得评分；变化：逐步淡化骨架直到完全隐藏。
works.description_zh: 一面 AR 镜子先录下专家的动作，再在学习者的镜像上叠加骨架引导和反馈来训练他们，并逐步撤去引导。
works.idea_en: An AR mirror overlays the teacher's moves on your reflection and teaches you the dance step by step.
works.technique_zh: 在大面积半透半反镜后方用 Kinect 进行骨架追踪，绘制与用户镜像对齐的录制动作引导，并为动作的准确度打分。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone's front camera and body pose recognition (such as MediaPipe or Effect House) to overlay a "teacher skeleton", and have students follow a set of calisthenics and get a score. Twist: gradually fade the skeleton until it is completely hidden.

works.title: castAR Kickstarter
works.description: Glasses with tiny projectors that bounce light off a retro-reflective mat, so each wearer sees their own correct-perspective 3D holograms, such as board games, on the table.
works.idea_zh: 眼镜里的微型投影仪打到反光板上，让每个人看到桌面上的立体全息游戏。

video.video_title: CastAR Kickstarter

works.technique: Head-mounted projectors cast a stereo image onto a retro-reflective mat that returns light mainly to its source, so each wearer sees only their own head-tracked perspective.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机前置人脸追踪实现头部耦合透视，把桌面上的平板变成一个有纵深的“全息桌面”；变体：两人从不同角度看同一个平板，讨论为什么只有一人看到正确透视。
works.description_zh: 一副装有微型投影仪的眼镜，光线打到回射反光垫上再反射回来，让每位佩戴者都能在桌面上看到属于自己、透视正确的三维全息影像，比如桌游。
works.idea_en: Tiny projectors in the glasses bounce off a reflective board so everyone sees 3D holographic games on the table.
works.technique_zh: 头戴投影仪把立体影像投射到回射反光垫上，反光垫主要把光送回光源方向，因此每位佩戴者只能看到自己经头部追踪校正的透视画面。
works.exercise_en: Use front-camera face tracking on a phone to create head-coupled perspective, turning a tablet lying on the table into a "holographic tabletop" with depth. Twist: have two people look at the same tablet from different angles and discuss why only one sees the correct perspective.

works.title: castAR at Maker Faire 2013
works.description: Jeri Ellsworth demonstrates the castAR glasses and wand, explaining how the technology she started at Valve tracks the head and projects stereo images onto the mat.
works.idea_zh: 展示从Valve带出来的AR眼镜和魔杖原型。

video.video_title: Cast AR 3D augmented-reality glasses interview w/ Jeri Ellsworth | Maker Faire 2013 | Engadget

works.technique: Head tracking relative to the mat, likely via camera-tracked markers, updates the off-axis stereo projection so holograms stay locked to the table.
works.exercise_zh: 用一个低成本材料（反光胶带或手电筒）做一个小实验，观察回射材料如何把光送回光源；变体：据此画出一个你设想的桌面 AR 设备草图。
works.description_zh: Jeri Ellsworth 演示 castAR 眼镜和魔杖，讲解这项她在 Valve 开始研发的技术如何追踪头部，并把立体影像投射到反光垫上。
works.idea_en: A demo of the AR glasses and wand prototype that came out of Valve.
works.technique_zh: 通过相对反光垫进行头部追踪（大概率借助摄像头追踪标记点），实时更新离轴立体投影，使全息影像牢牢固定在桌面上。
works.exercise_en: Run a small experiment with cheap materials (reflective tape and a flashlight) to see how retroreflective material sends light back to its source. Twist: based on this, sketch a tabletop AR device of your own design.

works.title: cube (Sónar Tokyo)
works.description: ELEVENPLAY dancers perform inside and around cube frames while computer-vision tracking turns their movement into live graphics and LED light cues.
works.idea_zh: 舞者在立方体框架中舞动，动作被实时转成光与图形
works.technique: Computer-vision tracking (by Satoru Higa) of dancers drives real-time visuals and LED 'jockeying', likely projected onto and around the cube frames.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头追踪同学在纸箱框架里的手部位置，实时控制投影到框架上的线条；变化：每个框架只响应一个人，形成“光的合奏”。

video.video_title: ELEVENPLAY x Rhizomatiks "cube" (2013)

works.description_zh: ELEVENPLAY 的舞者在立方体框架内外起舞，计算机视觉追踪把她们的动作实时转化为图形和 LED 灯光效果。
works.idea_en: Dancers move inside cube frames as their motion turns into live light and graphics.
works.technique_zh: 由 Satoru Higa 负责的计算机视觉追踪捕捉舞者，驱动实时影像和 LED 灯光操控，影像可能投射在立方体框架上及其周围。
works.exercise_en: Use a camera to track the hand positions of classmates inside cardboard frames and control lines projected onto the frames in real time. Twist: each frame responds to only one person, forming an "ensemble of light".

works.title: eMotion × Leap Motion – Pepper's ghost test
works.description: A first test with the company's own software: hands tracked by a Leap Motion controller shape glowing strands of light that seem to float inside a small glass box in front of them.
works.description_zh: 用公司自研软件做的一次早期测试：Leap Motion 追踪双手，手势塑造出一束束发光的线条，它们看起来就悬浮在手前方的小玻璃盒里。
works.idea_en: Your hands sculpt light that hovers in mid-air, without any headset.
works.idea_zh: 不戴任何头显，双手就能塑造悬在半空中的光。
works.technique: eMotion, the company's real-time motion and physics software, reads hand positions from a Leap Motion and renders particle strands that are reflected in an angled glass sheet (Pepper's ghost), so they appear to float in physical space.
works.technique_zh: 公司自研的实时运动与物理软件 eMotion 读取 Leap Motion 的手部位置，渲染出粒子线条，再经一块斜放的玻璃反射（佩珀尔幻象），看起来就像浮在真实空间里。
works.exercise_en: Build a Pepper's ghost box from a clear plastic sheet angled at 45° over a tablet lying face up, run a browser particle sketch driven by MediaPipe Hands from a laptop webcam and mirror it to the tablet, and tune colors on black until the image reads as floating. Twist: let two people's hands pull on the same particles.
works.exercise_zh: 用一块透明塑料片以 45° 斜架在正面朝上的平板上，做一个佩珀尔幻象盒；在浏览器里跑一个由笔记本摄像头 + MediaPipe Hands 驱动的粒子草图并投屏到平板，在黑底上调整颜色，直到画面看起来像浮在空中。变体：让两个人的手同时拉扯同一团粒子。

video.video_title: eMotion with the Leap Motion - Pepper's Ghost technique

works.title: exTouch
works.description: Point a tablet at a small robot and drag its on-screen AR image with your finger; the real robot drives and rotates to match the gesture in physical space.
works.idea_zh: 在手机AR画面里拖动物体，现实中的机器人就跟着动：AR画面变成实体遥控器。

video.video_title: exTouch

works.technique: Tracks the robot's pose with the tablet camera and converts touch-drag gestures on its AR image into motor commands in the robot's own coordinate frame.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR识别一个遥控小车上的图片标记，在屏幕上拖动虚拟箭头来驱动实体小车（可用Arduino/蓝牙车）；变化：让两位同学各用一部手机从不同角度同时操控同一辆车。
works.description_zh: 把平板对准一台小机器人，用手指拖动屏幕上它的 AR 影像，真实的机器人就会在物理空间中移动、转向，与手势保持一致。
works.idea_en: Drag an object in the phone's AR view and the real robot follows, turning the AR screen into a physical remote control.
works.technique_zh: 用平板摄像头追踪机器人的位姿，把在其 AR 影像上的触摸拖动手势转换为机器人自身坐标系中的电机指令。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR to recognize an image marker on a remote-control car, and drag a virtual arrow on screen to drive the real car (an Arduino or Bluetooth car works). Twist: let two classmates control the same car at once, each with a phone from a different angle.

works.title: fly revolver
works.description: Houseflies live inside an acrylic sphere in front of a target; a camera tracks where they are and a robotic mount aims a revolver at that spot in real time, triggering it when a single fly is detected.
works.description_zh: 几只家蝇生活在靶子前的一个亚克力球里；摄像头追踪它们的位置，机械云台实时把一把左轮手枪对准那里，只检测到一只苍蝇时就扣动扳机。
works.idea_en: Handing control to an unpredictable living agent creates tension no script can — AR characters can borrow behaviour from real creatures tracked by the camera.
works.idea_zh: 把控制权交给一个不可预测的活物，会产生剧本给不了的张力——AR 角色可以借用摄像头追踪到的真实生物的行为。
works.technique: Video tracking finds the flies' positions on the target backdrop and custom software sends pan/tilt angles to a robotic device holding the (unloaded, dry-fired) revolver.
works.technique_zh: 视频追踪找出苍蝇在靶子背景上的位置，自定义软件把水平/俯仰角度发送给握着左轮（空枪击发）的机械装置。
works.exercise_en: Track a moving object in the camera feed (a fish, a ball, a pet) and make a virtual spotlight or creature in AR follow it and react when it stops. Twist: let the tracked animal 'choose' which of several AR buttons to press.
works.exercise_zh: 在摄像头画面中追踪一个移动物体（鱼、球、宠物），让 AR 中的虚拟聚光灯或生物跟随它，并在它停下时做出反应。变体：让被追踪的动物“选择”按下几个 AR 按钮中的哪一个。

video.video_title: fly revolver

works.title: in orbit
works.description: A three-level net of steel wire hangs more than 25 metres above the piazza of K21 in Düsseldorf; visitors climb in and feel every other person's movement through the net.
works.description_zh: 一张三层钢丝网悬挂在杜塞尔多夫 K21 美术馆中庭上方 25 米多的高处；观众爬进网中，能通过网感受到每个人的动作。
works.idea_en: A shared surface that transmits everyone's movement makes multiplayer presence physical, a model for shared AR spaces where others' actions are felt.
works.idea_zh: 一个能传递每个人动作的共享表面，让多人在场变得可以触摸，是能感受到他人动作的共享 AR 空间的范本。
works.technique: A tensioned net spans the glass dome of the building, with large PVC spheres suspended in it; the net's vibrations spread from each visitor.
works.technique_zh: 一张张拉的网横跨建筑的玻璃穹顶，网中悬挂着巨大的 PVC 球体；网的振动从每位观众身上扩散出去。
works.exercise_en: Build a shared AR net over a room (Photon or Lightship) where each user's position bends the net and sends ripples to others. Twist: link two rooms so the net carries movements between them.
works.exercise_zh: 搭建一张覆盖房间的共享 AR 网（Photon 或 Lightship），每个用户的位置都会让网下沉并把涟漪传给他人；变体：连接两个房间，让网在两地之间传递动作。

video.video_title: Trailer: Tomás Saraceno – in orbit

works.title: inFORM
works.description: Daniel Leithinger and Sean Follmer's 30x30 motorized pin display renders 3D content and remote users' hands physically; objects on the table can be moved by the surface itself.
works.idea_zh: 让屏幕上的像素变成能升降的实体'像素'，远方的手可以真的推动桌上的球。

video.video_title: inFORM - Interacting With a Dynamic Shape Display

works.technique: An array of 900 motorized pins is actuated to render a height map, a Kinect captures remote hands and objects as depth images that are downsampled to pin heights, and a projector colors the pin tops.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头或深度相机（或 MediaPipe 手部关键点）把手的形状转换成 10x10 的高度图，在 three.js 里用柱子阵列实时渲染，并把颜色投影到桌面；变体：做一个 3x3 的实体版本（舵机推动木棍）只显示最关键的一个信息。
works.description_zh: Daniel Leithinger 和 Sean Follmer 打造的 30×30 电动针脚显示器，能以实体形式呈现三维内容和远程用户的手；桌上的物体可以被表面本身推动。
works.idea_en: Turn screen pixels into physical pixels that rise and fall, so a faraway hand can really push a ball on your table.
works.technique_zh: 由 900 根电动针脚组成的阵列通过升降呈现高度图；Kinect 把远程的手和物体捕捉为深度图像，降采样为针脚高度；投影仪为针脚顶端上色。
works.exercise_en: Convert the shape of a hand into a 10x10 height map with a camera or depth camera (or MediaPipe hand keypoints), render it live as an array of pillars in three.js, and project the colors onto a table. Twist: build a 3x3 physical version (servos pushing wooden sticks) that shows only the single most important piece of information.

works.title: pleiades
works.description: Two dancers, Saya Watatani and Maki Yokoyama, move with projected stars, planets and orbits so precisely that they seem to spin constellations around themselves.
works.description_zh: 两位舞者 Saya Watatani 和 Maki Yokoyama 与投影的星星、行星和轨道同步起舞，精准到看起来像在身边转动星座。
works.idea_en: Two bodies and one shared cosmos show how a virtual layer can unite performers; shared AR works when everyone sees the same object respond.
works.idea_zh: 两个身体共享一个宇宙，展示了虚拟层如何把表演者联系在一起；共享 AR 之所以成立，是因为每个人都看到同一个物体在回应。
works.technique: Motion graphics by Nobuyuki Hanabusa and Seiya Ishii are pre-rendered and the choreography is built frame by frame around them.
works.technique_zh: 花房伸晃和石井成也制作的动态图形预先渲染，编舞围绕画面一帧一帧地设计。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a shared AR planet system between two people using a multiplayer AR session and choreograph them passing a moon to each other. Twist: the orbit speeds up when they move apart.
works.exercise_zh: 用多人 AR 会话在两个人之间锚定一个共享的行星系统，编排他们把一颗月亮传给对方；变体：两人离得越远，轨道转得越快。

video.video_title: enra " pleiades "

works.title: test pattern [100m version]
works.description: A 100-metre floor projection of flickering black-and-white barcodes runs at high speed in sync with pulses of sound; visitors walk and lie on the moving data.
works.description_zh: 一条 100 米长的地面投影，高速闪烁着黑白条码，与声音脉冲同步；观众在流动的数据上行走、躺下。
works.idea_en: Pure data rendered at human scale becomes a landscape; a floor-anchored AR layer can turn any stream (network traffic, sound) into terrain you walk on.
works.idea_zh: 按人体尺度呈现的纯数据会变成一片地形；锚定在地面的 AR 图层可以把任何数据流（网络流量、声音）变成可以行走的地面。
works.technique: Audio signals are converted in real time into binary barcode patterns (likely at many frames per second) and projected by a row of synchronised projectors.
works.technique_zh: 音频信号被实时转换成二进制条码图案（很可能每秒数十帧），由一排同步的投影机投射出来。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a long strip on the corridor floor in AR Foundation and fill it with black-and-white bars generated from the phone microphone's spectrum in real time. Twist: speed the pattern up when more than one phone joins.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在走廊地面锚定一条长带，用手机麦克风的实时频谱生成黑白条纹填满它。变体：当不止一部手机加入时，让图案加速。

video.video_title: Ryoji Ikeda : test pattern [100m version], 2013

works.title: us+
works.description: A Google Hangout app that analyzes speech and facial expressions during a video call and overlays live feedback and automatic interventions to 'improve' the conversation.
works.idea_zh: 视频通话里的AI“社交教练”：实时分析你的表情和话语并在画面上提醒你。

video.video_title: us+

works.technique: Webcam face tracking and speech-to-text with sentiment/word-count analysis run during the video call, and rule-based triggers overlay text prompts and auto-mute when thresholds are crossed.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Web Speech API 和 MediaPipe 做一个视频聊天“教练”网页，统计谁说话多、谁在笑，并弹出提示；变体：加入一条过分的自动干预规则（比如你说“我”太多就被静音），体验被算法管理的对话。
works.description_zh: 一款 Google Hangout 应用，在视频通话中分析说话内容和面部表情，并叠加实时反馈和自动干预，以“改善”对话。
works.idea_en: An AI "social coach" in video calls that reads your face and words and nudges you on screen in real time.
works.technique_zh: 视频通话过程中运行网络摄像头面部追踪和语音转文字，并进行情感和词频分析；一旦超过阈值，基于规则的触发器就会叠加文字提示或自动静音。
works.exercise_en: Build a video-chat "coach" web page with the Web Speech API and MediaPipe that tracks who talks most and who is smiling, and pops up prompts. Twist: add one excessive automatic intervention rule (for example, you get muted if you say "I" too often) and experience a conversation managed by an algorithm.

works.title: 2012 Whitney Biennial AR Intervention (Flood)
works.description: Around the Whitney Museum, a monumental virtual flood rises; cars are slowly carried off to sea and the museum lobby fills with water.
works.description_zh: 惠特尼美术馆周围涌起一场巨大的虚拟洪水，汽车被慢慢冲向大海，美术馆大厅也被淹没。
works.idea_en: Show a future climate disaster at full scale where people already are.
works.idea_zh: 在人们所在的地方，以真实尺度呈现未来的气候灾难。
works.technique: A large animated water plane and floating car models are geolocated around the museum in a mobile AR browser so the waterline appears at street level.
works.technique_zh: 在移动 AR 浏览器中，把大面积动态水面和漂浮汽车模型定位在美术馆周围，让水位线出现在街道高度。
works.exercise_en: Use plane detection to place a rising water surface in a room or courtyard at a projected sea-level height. Twist: tie the height to real projections for your city in 2100.
works.exercise_zh: 用平面检测在房间或庭院里放置一面缓缓上升的水面，高度对应预测的海平面。变体：用你所在城市 2100 年的真实预测数据决定水位。

video.video_title: 2012 Whitney Biennial AR Intervention

works.title: 3D Mocap Mapping (with Motek Entertainment)
works.description: A giant 3D character projected onto a building is driven live by a performer in a motion-capture suit, so it can talk to, wave at and play with the people standing below.
works.description_zh: 投射在建筑上的巨型 3D 角色由一位穿动作捕捉服的表演者实时驱动，能和楼下的观众对话、挥手、互动。
works.idea_en: A live puppeteer behind a virtual giant makes a projection feel alive; AR characters gain the same presence when a hidden human drives them.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟巨人背后有真人实时操控，投影就像活了；AR 角色由幕后真人驱动时，也能获得同样的存在感。
works.technique: Motion capture from Motek streams skeleton data into a real-time engine that renders the character onto the pre-mapped facade.
works.technique_zh: Motek 的动作捕捉把骨骼数据实时传入引擎，引擎把角色渲染到事先映射好的立面上。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a rigged avatar to a wall in AR and drive it live from a second phone running body tracking (ARKit or MediaPipe) over a WebSocket. Twist: the audience can only see the puppeteer's avatar, never the puppeteer.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一个绑定骨骼的角色锚定在墙上，用另一部运行身体追踪（ARKit 或 MediaPipe）的手机通过 WebSocket 实时驱动它；变体：观众只能看到角色，永远看不到操控者本人。

video.video_title: NuFormer, 3D Mocap Mapping - NuFormer/Motek, the Netherlands - March 2012 - Short Version (20 min)

works.title: 3D Video Mapping – Matenadaran, Yerevan
works.description: For Yerevan's year as UNESCO World Book Capital, the facade of the Matenadaran manuscript library is covered with animated illuminated manuscripts, letters and ornaments from Armenia's literary history.
works.description_zh: 为庆祝埃里温成为联合国教科文组织世界图书之都，古籍手稿馆 Matenadaran 的立面被动画化的彩绘手稿、字母和纹样覆盖，讲述亚美尼亚的文学史。
works.idea_en: The best overlay tells the story of the very building it covers, which is the strongest reason to anchor AR content to a specific place.
works.idea_zh: 最好的叠加讲述的正是它所覆盖的那座建筑的故事，这也是把 AR 内容锚定在特定地点最有力的理由。
works.technique: Motifs from the library's own manuscripts are animated in 3D and mapped onto the building's model so the ornaments follow its real arches and columns.
works.technique_zh: 把馆藏手稿里的图案做成 3D 动画，并映射到建筑模型上，让纹样沿着真实的拱门和柱子展开。
works.exercise_en: Pick a campus building, collect three archival images about its history, and anchor them as animated AR layers that unfold from its doors and windows. Twist: each layer appears only at the spot where the photo was originally taken.
works.exercise_zh: 选一栋校园建筑，找三张关于它历史的档案图片，把它们做成从门窗里展开的 AR 动画层；变体：每一层只在当年拍照的位置才会出现。

video.video_title: NuFormer, 3D video mapping - Matenadaran, Yerevan, Armenia - April 2012 - One Take

works.title: 49 Nord 6 EST 68 VEN 12 FL
works.description: Visitors enter a seamless white room with curved corners at David Zwirner; slow changes of light make the far wall dissolve, so the room seems to have no depth and no end.
works.description_zh: 观众走进 David Zwirner 画廊里一个圆角、无缝的白色房间；灯光的缓慢变化让远处的墙消失，房间看起来既没有深度也没有尽头。
works.idea_en: Remove corners and shadows and a room becomes infinite; in AR, hiding the edges of virtual content is often more convincing than adding detail.
works.idea_zh: 去掉墙角和阴影，房间就变得无限；在 AR 里，隐藏虚拟内容的边缘往往比增加细节更有说服力。
works.technique: Coved walls, a floor that curves up into the walls and evenly diffused, slowly programmed light remove every visual cue for distance.
works.technique_zh: 弧形墙面、向上弯入墙体的地面，以及均匀漫射、缓慢编程的灯光，去掉了所有判断距离的视觉线索。
works.exercise_en: In WebXR, cover one real wall with a virtual surface whose brightness gradient slowly erases its edges until it reads as open space. Twist: add a single floating dot and test whether it helps or hurts the sense of depth.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 里用一块虚拟表面盖住一面真实墙，让它的亮度渐变慢慢抹掉边缘，直到看起来像开阔的空间。变体：加一个悬浮的小点，测试它会加强还是削弱深度感。

video.video_title: Doug Wheeler, “49 Nord 6 EST 68 Ven 12 FL (2011-2012)” (1 of 2)

works.title: A Butterfly for Pomona
works.description: On the Pomona College football field, fireworks and road flares form a giant burning butterfly on the ground that flares, smokes and slowly burns out as the audience watches from the stands.
works.description_zh: 在波莫纳学院的橄榄球场上，烟火和道路信号焰在地面组成一只巨大的燃烧蝴蝶，它闪耀、冒烟，然后在看台观众的注视下慢慢熄灭。
works.idea_en: A drawing made on the ground for people watching from above uses the stands as the viewpoint; AR ground drawings should be designed for where the audience actually stands.
works.idea_zh: 为从高处观看的人而在地面上作的画，把看台当作视点；AR 地面绘画也应该按照观众真正所站的位置来设计。
works.technique: Road flares and ground fireworks are laid out on the field along the lines of a butterfly drawing and lit in sequence so the image appears and then collapses into smoke.
works.technique_zh: 道路信号焰和地面烟火沿着蝴蝶图形的线条铺在球场上，依次点燃，图像先出现，再化为烟雾。
works.exercise_en: Lay out a 20-metre AR butterfly of flames on a sports field or plaza with plane detection, designed to be read from a balcony or stairs; its wings burn out one segment at a time. Twist: viewers on the ground see only abstract fire, and the butterfly resolves only from the upper viewpoint.
works.exercise_zh: 用平面检测在运动场或广场上铺出一只 20 米长的 AR 火焰蝴蝶，设计成从阳台或台阶上看才清楚；它的翅膀一段一段地燃尽。变体：地面上的观众只看到抽象的火焰，只有站在高处才能看出蝴蝶。

video.video_title: A Butterfly for Pomona by Judy Chicago

works.title: A magical tale (with augmented reality)
works.description: On the TED stage Tempest tells a story about magic while a camera-projector rig augments what he holds: projected graphics land on cards and a small screen, and the live mixed image is shown to the audience.
works.description_zh: 在 TED 舞台上，Tempest 一边讲关于魔术的故事，一边用摄像头加投影的装置增强他手里的东西：图像落在纸牌和小屏幕上，混合后的实时画面同时投给观众。
works.idea_en: Storytelling in which every AR effect is timed like a magic reveal.
works.idea_zh: 讲故事时，每个 AR 效果都像魔术揭晓那样精确卡点。
works.technique: A head-mounted or tripod camera feeds an openFrameworks application that tracks the props and composites or projects synchronized graphics in real time; the exact rig is likely custom.
works.technique_zh: 头戴或三脚架上的摄像头把画面送入 openFrameworks 程序，程序追踪道具，并实时合成或投射同步图像；具体装置很可能是定制的。
works.exercise_en: Write a 90-second story and stage it with three AR reveals on handheld objects, rehearsed so each effect lands on a spoken line. Twist: one reveal must happen in the audience's view but not in the performer's.
works.exercise_zh: 写一个 90 秒的小故事，在手持物上安排三个 AR 揭晓点，排练到每个效果都卡在台词上。变体：其中一个揭晓只有观众看得见，表演者自己看不见。

video.video_title: Marco Tempest: A magical tale (with augmented reality)

works.title: Abraham Lincoln: War Veteran Projection
works.description: For a month, the bronze Abraham Lincoln statue in New York's Union Square speaks with the faces, gestures and voices of veterans of the Vietnam, Iraq and Afghanistan wars, projected precisely onto the statue.
works.description_zh: 整整一个月，纽约联合广场上的林肯铜像借用越战、伊拉克和阿富汗战争退伍军人的脸、手势和声音开口说话，影像被精准地投在雕像上。
works.idea_en: Let living people borrow a monument's body to tell the stories it never told.
works.idea_zh: 让普通人借用纪念碑的身体，讲出它从未讲过的故事。
works.technique: Veterans were filmed with a camera fixed to their head so the face stays still, then the footage was warped to match the statue's face and hands and projected at night.
works.technique_zh: 拍摄时摄像头固定在退伍军人头上，使脸部在画面中保持不动；之后把画面变形对齐到雕像的脸和手上，在夜间投影。
works.exercise_en: Film a classmate's face with a phone rigidly attached to their head, then use MadMapper or a projection-mapping web tool to fit the video onto a bust, mask or plaster head. Twist: let the object answer questions from the audience.
works.exercise_zh: 用固定在同学头上的手机拍摄他的脸，再用 MadMapper 或网页投影映射工具把视频贴合到一座胸像、面具或石膏头像上；变体：让这个物体回答观众的提问。

video.video_title: Abraham Lincoln: War Veteran Projection, 2012

works.title: All Hail Damien Hirst
works.description: During Damien Hirst's Tate Modern retrospective, a hail of Diamond Jubilee gold sovereigns pours down on the museum and on Hirst's own sculpture Hymn outside.
works.description_zh: 在达米恩·赫斯特于泰特现代美术馆举办回顾展期间，一场钻石禧年金币的“冰雹”倾泻在美术馆和门外赫斯特的雕塑 Hymn 上。
works.idea_en: A pun turned into weather: art-market money literally hailing on the star artist.
works.idea_zh: 把双关语变成天气：艺术市场的钱真的像冰雹一样砸在明星艺术家身上。
works.technique: Animated gold coin models are geolocated as a falling field above and around Tate Modern in a mobile AR browser.
works.technique_zh: 在移动 AR 浏览器中，把动画金币模型作为下落的粒子场，定位在泰特现代美术馆上空和周围。
works.exercise_en: Pick a pun about a place or person and build a phone-AR 'weather' effect that makes it literal. Twist: the effect intensifies when more visitors are counted.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个关于某地或某人的双关语，用手机 AR 做一种让它“成真”的天气效果。变体：统计到的参观者越多，效果越强。

video.video_title: "All Hail Damien Hirst" video @ Tate Modern retrospective - augmented reality art

works.title: All the Universe is Full of the Lives of Perfect Creatures
works.description: Looking into a mirror, the viewer sees an animal's head overlaid exactly on their own reflection, mimicking their head movement and facial expressions.
works.idea_zh: 照镜子时你的脸变成一只动物，并同步你的表情
works.technique: A camera behind a half-silvered mirror runs FaceTracker (ofxFaceTracker) and drives a 3D animal head rendered on a display so it aligns with the viewer's reflection.
works.exercise_zh: 用MediaPipe Face Mesh驱动一个动物头像，叠在镜像画面上同步眨眼张嘴；变化：用半透镜+显示器做成真正的“魔镜”，并让动物有时不听话。

video.video_title: All the Universe is Full of the Lives of Perfect Creatures

works.description_zh: 观众照镜子时，会看到一个动物头像精确地叠在自己的镜像上，模仿自己的头部动作和面部表情。
works.idea_en: Your face turns into an animal in the mirror and copies your expressions.
works.technique_zh: 半透半反镜后方的摄像头运行 FaceTracker（ofxFaceTracker），驱动显示器上渲染的三维动物头部，使其与观众的镜像对齐。
works.exercise_en: Drive an animal head with MediaPipe Face Mesh, overlaid on the mirrored video so it blinks and opens its mouth in sync. Twist: build a real "magic mirror" with a half-silvered mirror and a monitor, and have the animal sometimes disobey.

works.title: Appel d'Air
works.description: Toddlers blow on a tiny paper windmill, and an industrial fan across the room answers with a gust of wind as long and strong as their breath.
works.description_zh: 小朋友对着一个小小的纸风车吹气，房间另一边的工业风扇就回应一阵风，风的长短和强弱跟他们的气息一样。
works.idea_en: A small breath gets a big answer.
works.idea_zh: 小小的一口气，换来一阵大风的回应。
works.technique: A sensor on the paper windmill measures the speed and duration of its spin, and a controller drives the industrial fan in proportion.
works.technique_zh: 纸风车上的传感器测量它旋转的速度和时长，控制器按比例驱动工业风扇。
works.exercise_en: Attach a cheap anemometer or a DC motor used as a generator to a paper windmill and map its signal to a USB fan or a projected storm. Twist: the answer comes back from a different corner every time.
works.exercise_zh: 给纸风车接一个便宜的风速计，或把直流电机当发电机用，把信号映射到 USB 风扇或投影出来的风暴上；变体：每次回应的风都来自不同的角落。

video.video_title: Appel d'Air

salient.why_en: A child's breath on a tiny windmill comes back as a gust from a giant fan.
salient.why_zh: 孩子对着小风车吹的一口气，会变成一台巨大风扇吹回来的一阵风。

works.title: ArcelorMittal Orbit
works.description: Designed with engineer Cecil Balmond for the London 2012 Olympics, a 114-metre red steel structure loops around itself with a viewing platform and, since 2016, a spiral slide.
works.description_zh: 与工程师 Cecil Balmond 为 2012 年伦敦奥运会共同设计，这座高 114 米的红色钢结构自我缠绕，设有观景平台，2016 年起还加入了螺旋滑梯。
works.idea_en: A tower that twists around itself turns climbing into looping motion, a reference for AR landmarks you move through rather than look at.
works.idea_zh: 一座自我缠绕的塔把攀登变成环绕运动，是那种让人穿行而非仅仅观看的 AR 地标的参考。
works.technique: A continuous looping steel lattice is built around a central core; the structure's irregular curves were computed for stability.
works.technique_zh: 连续缠绕的钢格构围绕中央核心搭建；其不规则曲线经计算以确保稳定。
works.exercise_en: Generate a looping AR ribbon tower with a spline tool and let users ride a camera path along it. Twist: the ribbon's loop count equals the number of people currently in the session.
works.exercise_zh: 用样条工具生成一座环绕的 AR 飘带塔，让用户沿其上的相机路径“骑行”；变体：飘带的环数等于当前会话中的人数。

video.video_title: ArcelorMittal Orbit Launch Film

works.title: Archifon
works.description: Up to ten visitors aim laser pointers at the columns, arches and statues of a deconsecrated Baroque chapel, and each architectural element they hit lights up with projection and plays a sound, turning the chapel into a giant instrument.
works.description_zh: 最多十位观众拿着激光笔对准一座已废弃巴洛克礼拜堂的柱子、拱券和雕像，被照到的建筑构件就会亮起投影并发出声音，整座礼拜堂变成一件巨大的乐器。
works.idea_en: Play architecture like an instrument by pointing at it.
works.idea_zh: 用手指（激光笔）点一点，就能把建筑当乐器来演奏。
works.technique: A camera tracks the laser dots on the mapped interior, and each surface of the 3D-mapped chapel is linked to visuals and Max/MSP sound triggers.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪投影内部的激光光点，礼拜堂三维映射后的每个表面都与相应的画面和 Max/MSP 声音触发绑定。
works.exercise_en: Point a webcam at a projected wall, detect a red laser dot with OpenCV or p5.js, and divide the wall into six zones that each play a note and flash. Twist: make zones need two lasers at once to sound a chord.
works.exercise_zh: 把摄像头对准投影墙面，用 OpenCV 或 p5.js 检测红色激光点，把墙面分成六个区域，每个区域被照到时闪亮并发出一个音；变体：某些区域需要两支激光同时照射才能奏出和弦。

video.video_title: Archifon I. - Interactive Installation

works.title: Assembly
works.description: A hemisphere of 5,500 suspended white blocks is scanned and coated with pixels from external projectors, forming a habitat for digital forms inside physical space.
works.idea_zh: 5500块悬挂的方块被投影“涂上”像素，数字形体住进真实空间。

video.video_title: Assembly

works.technique: Projector-camera structured-light scanning locates each suspended block in 3D, so multiple projectors can address the blocks as volumetric pixels for animated forms.
works.exercise_zh: 在纸箱里吊 30 个白色小方块，投影仪逐块点亮并记录位置，做一个“体素屏幕”显示一个会游动的形状；变体：用全班每人做的一块方块组成，每块亮起时显示主人的名字。
works.description_zh: 由 5500 块悬挂白色方块组成的半球体，经过扫描后由外部投影仪为其“涂上”像素，在实体空间中为数字形体营造出一个栖息地。
works.idea_en: 5,500 hanging blocks are painted with projected pixels, letting digital forms live in real space.
works.technique_zh: 投影仪-相机结构光扫描确定每个悬挂方块在三维空间中的位置，使多台投影仪能把这些方块当作体素像素来寻址，呈现动态形体。
works.exercise_en: Hang 30 small white cubes in a cardboard box, light them one by one with a projector and record their positions, and build a "voxel screen" that shows a swimming shape. Twist: make it from one cube per student, each showing its owner's name when it lights up.

works.title: Augmented City
works.description: A vision video in which a phone and glasses recognize buildings, shop fronts and objects in a city block and layer navigation, offers and interactive content directly onto them.
works.description_zh: 一段愿景视频：手机和眼镜识别街区里的建筑、店面和物体，并直接在它们上面叠加导航、优惠和互动内容。
works.idea_en: Every surface of a city is a potential screen once the camera recognizes it.
works.idea_zh: 只要摄像头能认出来，城市里的每个表面都可能成为屏幕。
works.technique: Metaio's markerless 3D tracking and junaio channels recognize building facades and objects from edge and feature models to anchor content without GPS drift.
works.technique_zh: Metaio 的无标记 3D 追踪和 junaio 频道，通过边缘和特征模型识别建筑立面与物体，在不受 GPS 漂移影响的情况下锚定内容。
works.exercise_en: Photograph three storefronts or building entrances near campus, turn them into image targets, and attach one useful piece of information to each. Twist: make the information change with the time of day.
works.exercise_zh: 拍下校园附近的三个店面或建筑入口，把它们设为图像标记，给每个附上一条有用信息。变体：让信息随一天中的时间变化。

video.video_title: Metaio's Augmented City Demo

works.title: Augmented Gesture with Post-its
works.description: Cheap coloured Post-it notes on the fingers become gesture trackers for controlling a web 3D scene.
works.idea_zh: 把便利贴贴在手指上，就成了网页手势追踪器。

video.video_title: postit works so well for augmented gesture!

works.technique: Color thresholding on the webcam image finds the centroids of brightly colored Post-its on the fingers, which serve as low-cost gesture input points.
works.exercise_zh: 在网页中用颜色阈值追踪手指上的彩色便利贴，用它们的位置旋转一个 three.js 物体；变体：两种颜色距离变小时判定为“捏合”。
works.description_zh: 贴在手指上的廉价彩色便利贴变成手势追踪器，用来控制网页中的三维场景。
works.idea_en: Stick Post-its on your fingers and they become a web gesture tracker.
works.technique_zh: 对摄像头画面做颜色阈值分割，找出手指上鲜艳便利贴的质心，把它们作为低成本的手势输入点。
works.exercise_en: Track colored Post-its on your fingers with color thresholding in a web page and use their positions to rotate a three.js object. Twist: detect a "pinch" when the two colors get close to each other.

works.title: Augmented Pong in 3D
works.description: A 3D Pong game in which the paddles are driven by physical markers held in front of the webcam.
works.idea_zh: 拿着实体标记当球拍，在浏览器里打 3D 乒乓。

video.video_title: Augmented Pong in 3D

works.technique: Two fiducial markers are tracked from the webcam, and their screen positions are mapped to paddle positions in a three.js Pong game.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR.js 追踪两张标记卡作为球拍，在它们之间用 three.js 做一个来回弹的球；变体：球速随两张卡的距离变化。
works.description_zh: 一款三维乒乓（Pong）游戏，球拍由举在网络摄像头前的实体标记来控制。
works.idea_en: Hold physical markers as paddles and play 3D Pong in the browser.
works.technique_zh: 通过网络摄像头追踪两个基准标记，并把它们在屏幕上的位置映射为 three.js 乒乓游戏中的球拍位置。
works.exercise_en: Track two marker cards with AR.js as paddles and use three.js to make a ball bounce back and forth between them. Twist: the ball speed changes with the distance between the two cards.

works.title: Augmented Reality Sandbox
works.description: Shape real sand with your hands; a Kinect reads the terrain and a projector paints elevation colors and contour lines onto it, and holding out a hand makes virtual rain that flows downhill.
works.idea_zh: 用手堆沙子，投影实时画出等高线；伸手就能'下雨'，水顺着沙丘流下。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Sandbox with Real-Time Water Flow Simulation

works.technique: A Kinect above the sandbox measures the sand's height map, which is filtered and used to color an elevation map with contour lines projected back onto the sand, while a shallow-water simulation runs rain across the terrain.
works.exercise_zh: 用深度相机（或用一盘彩色黏土加 RGB 摄像头近似）测量高度，在 TouchDesigner 中生成等高线和海拔配色，投影回沙盘或黏土上；变体：把“雨水”换成另一种东西，比如人群、火或声音的传播。
works.description_zh: 用双手塑造真实的沙子，Kinect 读取地形，投影仪在沙面上绘出海拔配色和等高线；伸出一只手，就会降下虚拟的雨，雨水顺着地势向下流淌。
works.idea_en: Pile up sand by hand while projection draws contour lines live; hold out a hand to make it rain down the dunes.
works.technique_zh: 沙盘上方的 Kinect 测量沙面高度图，经过滤波后用于生成带等高线的海拔配色图并投影回沙面；同时运行浅水模拟，让雨水在地形上流动。
works.exercise_en: Measure height with a depth camera (or approximate it with a tray of colored clay and an RGB camera), generate contour lines and elevation colors in TouchDesigner, and project them back onto the sand or clay. Twist: replace the "rain" with something else that spreads, such as crowds, fire or sound.

salient.why_en: Pile up real sand and contour lines and water follow it instantly, so shaping a landscape is just moving sand.
salient.why_zh: 用手堆沙，等高线和水流立刻跟着变化，塑造地形就是推动沙子。

works.title: Augmented Reality in Your Browser
works.description: A 2012 screencast showing marker-based AR running in a desktop web browser via WebRTC webcam access and JSARToolKit.
works.idea_zh: 2012 年就在浏览器里跑起来的网页 AR。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality in your Browser

works.technique: WebRTC getUserMedia streams the webcam into a canvas, JSARToolKit detects square fiducial markers and estimates their pose, and three.js renders 3D content with that pose over the video.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR.js（或 MindAR）在网页中识别打印的 Hiro 标记并显示一个旋转的 3D 模型；变体：让模型根据标记倾斜的角度改变颜色。
works.description_zh: 一段 2012 年的录屏，展示借助 WebRTC 调用网络摄像头和 JSARToolKit，在桌面网页浏览器中运行基于标记的 AR。
works.idea_en: Web AR already running in the browser back in 2012.
works.technique_zh: WebRTC 的 getUserMedia 把摄像头画面传入 canvas，JSARToolKit 检测方形基准标记并估算其位姿，three.js 再按该位姿把三维内容渲染在视频之上。
works.exercise_en: Use AR.js (or MindAR) to recognize a printed Hiro marker in a web page and display a spinning 3D model. Twist: make the model change color according to how far the marker is tilted.

works.title: Augmented Silhouette
works.description: Visitors see their glowing silhouettes on a wall, and colourful particles pour out of their hands and bounce between people as they move.
works.description_zh: 观众在墙上看到自己发光的剪影，彩色粒子从手中涌出，随动作在人与人之间弹跳。
works.idea_en: Your silhouette becomes a light body that throws particles.
works.idea_zh: 你的剪影变成一个会抛洒粒子的光体。
works.technique: OpenNI user tracking extracts silhouettes and hand joints from a Kinect, and openFrameworks renders particles emitted from the hands.
works.technique_zh: OpenNI 用户追踪从 Kinect 中提取剪影和手部关节，openFrameworks 渲染从手中发射的粒子。
works.exercise_en: Use webcam body segmentation and hand tracking to draw a glowing silhouette that emits particles from the hands. Twist: particles thrown by one person stick to anyone else they touch.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头人体分割和手部追踪画出发光剪影，并从手中发射粒子。变体：一个人抛出的粒子碰到别人就粘在对方身上。

video.video_title: Augmented Silhouette

works.title: Beamatron
works.description: A steerable projector and Kinect on a pan-tilt head follow people around a room, projecting a virtual car that drives over real furniture and floors.
works.idea_zh: 会转头的投影机器人，让虚拟遥控车在真实房间的家具上开来开去。

video.video_title: Beamatron

works.technique: A projector and Kinect sit on a motorized pan-tilt head; the room is pre-scanned into a 3D model, and imagery is pre-distorted per surface as the head steers so content stays correct while moving across furniture.
works.exercise_zh: 把小投影仪放在可手动或舵机转动的云台上，用 TouchDesigner 根据角度切换画面，让一辆投影的小车沿墙和地板“开”过去；变体：让小车追着房间里的某个人（用摄像头检测）跑。
works.description_zh: 装在云台上的可转向投影仪和 Kinect 跟随房间里的人移动，投射出一辆虚拟小车，在真实的家具和地板上行驶。
works.idea_en: A head-turning projector robot lets a virtual RC car drive over the real furniture in a room.
works.technique_zh: 投影仪和 Kinect 安装在电动云台上；房间事先被扫描成三维模型，云台转动时按表面对画面进行预畸变，使内容在跨越家具移动时仍保持正确。
works.exercise_en: Put a small projector on a pan-tilt mount turned by hand or servo, switch the image in TouchDesigner based on the angle, and make a projected little car "drive" along the wall and floor. Twist: have the car chase a particular person in the room (detected by a camera).

works.title: Border Memorial: Frontera de los Muertos
works.description: Geolocated AR skeletal effigies (inspired by Día de los Muertos) mark the exact places where migrants died crossing the US-Mexico border.
works.idea_zh: 在移民死亡的确切地点放置AR亡灵纪念碑

video.video_title: Border Memorial: Frontera de los Muertos

works.technique: GPS-anchored Layar objects place skeletal effigies at the coordinates of recorded migrant deaths, turning a dataset into a geolocated memorial.
works.exercise_zh: 用一份与地点相关的公开数据（交通事故点、消失的小店），在 WebAR 中每个数据点放一个小纪念物；变体：让纪念物的形态由该数据点的具体信息生成。
works.description_zh: 基于地理位置的 AR 骷髅塑像（灵感来自亡灵节）标记出移民在穿越美墨边境时丧生的确切地点。
works.idea_en: Place AR memorials of the dead at the exact spots where migrants died.
works.technique_zh: 以 GPS 锚定的 Layar 对象把骷髅塑像放在有记录的移民死亡地点坐标上，把一份数据集变成一座基于地理位置的纪念碑。
works.exercise_en: Take a public place-based dataset (traffic accident sites, shops that have disappeared) and put a small memorial at each data point in WebAR. Twist: generate each memorial's form from the specific details of its data point.

works.title: Botanicus Interacticus
works.description: Living plants become interactive: stroking, pinching or sliding along a stem is sensed through the plant itself and triggers projected visuals and sound.
works.idea_zh: 抚摸一株真植物，它会发出声音和光影。

video.video_title: "BOTANICUS INTERACTICUS" SIGGRAPH 2012 installation

works.technique: Places a single electrode in the plant's soil and applies Touché-style swept-frequency sensing to locate and classify touches on the plant.
works.exercise_zh: 把盆栽接到Makey Makey或触摸传感器上，触摸叶片时在手机或投影上长出虚拟花朵并发声；变化：两人同时触摸时才会开花。
works.description_zh: 让活的植物变得可以互动：抚摸、捏住或沿着茎滑动，都能通过植物本身被感知，并触发投影影像和声音。
works.idea_en: Stroke a real plant and it answers with sound, light and shadow.
works.technique_zh: 在植物的土壤中插入一个电极，采用 Touché 式的扫频感应技术，对植物上的触摸进行定位和分类。
works.exercise_en: Connect a potted plant to a Makey Makey or touch sensor so touching a leaf grows virtual flowers with sound on a phone or projection. Twist: the flowers only bloom when two people touch the plant at the same time.

works.title: Breathing Flower
works.description: A giant red lotus inflatable, about nine metres across, slowly opens and closes its petals as if breathing, in plazas from Perth to San Francisco's Civic Center.
works.description_zh: 一朵直径约九米的巨型红色充气莲花缓缓开合花瓣，仿佛在呼吸，出现在从珀斯到旧金山市政中心的各个广场上。
works.idea_en: One slow looping motion gives an object life, a minimal animation principle for AR sculptures.
works.idea_zh: 一个缓慢循环的动作就能赋予物体生命，这是 AR 雕塑的极简动画原则。
works.technique: Fans inflate and deflate the petals in a timed cycle.
works.technique_zh: 风扇按设定周期为花瓣充气和放气。
works.exercise_en: Place a giant AR flower in a plaza that breathes in sync with the real breathing of the nearest user (microphone). Twist: when many people breathe slowly together, the flower blooms fully.
works.exercise_zh: 在广场上放置一朵巨型 AR 花，让它与最近的用户的真实呼吸（麦克风）同步“呼吸”；变体：当许多人一起慢慢呼吸时，花会完全绽放。

video.video_title: Choi Jeong Hwa's "Breathing Flower" Comes to Life in San Francisco

works.title: BubbleWhere
works.description: A proof of concept in which the phone finds any round object in view, such as a plate, coaster or logo, grabs its texture on the fly, and turns it into a trackable AR bubble.
works.description_zh: 一个概念验证：手机在画面里找到任何圆形物体，比如盘子、杯垫或标志，即时截取它的纹理，把它变成可追踪的 AR 气泡。
works.idea_en: Any circle in the world can become an instant AR marker.
works.idea_zh: 世界上的任何圆形都能瞬间变成 AR 标记。
works.technique: Real-time ellipse detection finds circles, rectifies and captures their texture, and then tracks the circle's pose as a new target without prior training.
works.technique_zh: 实时椭圆检测找出圆形，校正并截取其纹理，然后在无需事先训练的情况下把该圆作为新目标追踪其位姿。
works.exercise_en: Use OpenCV Hough circles on a phone camera feed to find round objects and pin a small animated creature onto each one. Twist: creatures jump between circles when two are close together.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机摄像头画面上用 OpenCV 霍夫圆检测找出圆形物体，在每个圆上放一只小动画生物。变体：当两个圆靠得很近时，小生物会在它们之间跳来跳去。

video.video_title: BubbleWhere - Augmented Reality Proof of Concept

works.title: Buckyball
works.description: Two nested geodesic spheres made of LED tubes stand in Madison Square Park; the tubes change colour in endless sequences that glow over the lawn at night.
works.description_zh: 麦迪逊广场公园里立着两层由 LED 灯管构成的嵌套测地线球体，灯管以无穷变化的序列变色，在夜晚照亮草坪。
works.idea_en: A molecule enlarged to the size of a pavilion becomes a gathering place; AR can blow up tiny scientific structures into public sculptures that people walk around.
works.idea_zh: 把一个分子放大到亭子大小，它就成了聚集的地方；AR 可以把微小的科学结构放大成人们绕着走的公共雕塑。
works.technique: Each edge of the two spheres is an LED tube, and software maps generative colour sequences onto the geometry of the carbon-60 molecule.
works.technique_zh: 两个球体的每一条边都是一根 LED 灯管，软件把生成式色彩序列映射到碳 60 分子的几何结构上。
works.exercise_en: Place a room-sized AR model of a molecule (C60, caffeine or DNA) in the schoolyard and animate colour waves along its bonds. Twist: let students walk inside it and trigger a sound when they touch a node.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里放一个房间大小的 AR 分子模型（C60、咖啡因或 DNA），让色彩波沿着化学键流动。变体：让同学走进去，碰到节点时触发声音。

video.video_title: Buckyball 10'

works.title: BurnAR
works.description: Looking at their own hands through a headset, users see flames and smoke rising from their skin; some report an involuntary feeling of heat although nothing is warm.
works.description_zh: 用户通过头显看自己的手，会看到火焰和烟从皮肤上冒出；尽管没有任何东西是热的，有些人仍会不由自主地感到发热。
works.idea_en: Convincing AR on your own body can trigger real bodily sensations.
works.idea_zh: 在自己身体上足够逼真的 AR，能引发真实的身体感受。
works.technique: Segments the user's hands in a video see-through HMD and overlays real-time volumetric fire and smoke that follow the hand motion.
works.technique_zh: 在视频透视头显中分割出用户的双手，并叠加随手部运动的实时体积火焰和烟雾。
works.exercise_en: Apply a phone hand-tracking AR effect that puts fire or ice on the hands, then ask classmates to rate warmth or cold on a scale while blindfolded partners compare. Twist: add a matching crackling sound and see if ratings rise.
works.exercise_zh: 使用手机手部追踪 AR 特效，在手上加火焰或冰霜，请同学按量表评估冷热感，再与蒙眼的对照组比较；变体：加上相应的噼啪声，看评分是否上升。

video.video_title: BurnAR: Feel the Heat (ISMAR 2012)

works.title: Cement Eclipses (Málaga)
works.description: In the streets of Málaga, tiny cement figures appear in gutters, on cornices and bus shelters, acting out scenes of city life that most passers-by miss.
works.description_zh: 在马拉加的街头，小小的水泥人偶出现在排水沟、檐口和公交候车亭上，演绎着大多数路人都会错过的城市生活场景。
works.idea_en: Small interventions that reward attention are a subtle alternative to loud AR content.
works.idea_zh: 奖励细心观察的小型介入，是喧闹 AR 内容之外的一种含蓄选择。
works.technique: Figures are glued or placed on urban surfaces at eye level or below, composed into small scenes.
works.technique_zh: 人偶被粘贴或放置在视线高度或以下的城市表面上，组成小场景。
works.exercise_en: Create five tiny AR scenes anchored to street furniture (bins, drains, railings) with image markers or plane detection. Twist: each scene is only visible when the phone is held below knee height.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像标记或平面检测，在街道设施（垃圾桶、排水口、栏杆）上锚定五个微型 AR 场景；变体：只有当手机低于膝盖高度时，场景才可见。

video.video_title: Cement Eclipses - Málaga, Septiembre 2012

works.title: ClonAR
works.description: A real object is scanned with a Kinect, and its clone appears in AR where the user can feel and sculpt it with a haptic pen before sending it off to be printed.
works.description_zh: 用 Kinect 扫描一个真实物体，它的克隆体出现在 AR 中，用户可以用触觉笔触摸并雕刻它，再拿去打印。
works.idea_en: Scan, touch and remix a real object in AR in one continuous loop.
works.idea_zh: 在 AR 中扫描、触摸并改造真实物体，一气呵成。
works.technique: Uses KinectFusion signed distance fields directly for both haptic rendering and GPU raymarched visuals, skipping mesh conversion.
works.technique_zh: 把 KinectFusion 生成的有符号距离场直接用于触觉渲染和 GPU 光线步进渲染，省去网格转换。
works.exercise_en: Scan a small object with a phone 3D-scan app, place the copy next to the original in AR, and use a sculpting app to redesign it. Twist: print or build the redesigned version from clay and compare.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机三维扫描 App 扫描一个小物件，在 AR 中把复制品放在原物旁边，再用雕刻 App 重新设计它；变体：用黏土把新设计做出来并与原物比较。

video.video_title: ClonAR: Rapid Redesign of Real-World Objects (ISMAR 2012)

works.title: Dance Jockey
works.description: An audiovisual dance performance with musician Yago de Quay in which a Kinect reads the dancer's position and arm movements to mix, move and distort both the music and the projected footage.
works.description_zh: 与音乐人 Yago de Quay 合作的视听舞蹈演出：Kinect 读取舞者的位置和手臂动作，用来混合、移动和扭曲音乐与投影影像。
works.idea_en: The dancer is the DJ and VJ at once.
works.idea_zh: 舞者同时是 DJ 和 VJ。
works.technique: Kinect skeleton data are mapped to video parameters such as position, opacity and distortion in Carvalho's visual system, and to music parameters on the sound side.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 骨骼数据在 Carvalho 的视觉系统中映射为位置、透明度和扭曲等视频参数，在声音一侧则映射为音乐参数。
works.exercise_en: Map three body features from MediaPipe Pose (arm height, hip position, hand distance) to three parameters of a music loop and a projected video, then perform a one-minute set. Twist: hand one parameter to an audience member's phone.
works.exercise_zh: 从 MediaPipe Pose 取三个身体特征（手臂高度、髋部位置、双手距离），映射到一段音乐循环和一段投影视频的三个参数上，再表演一分钟；变体：把其中一个参数交给观众的手机控制。

video.video_title: extracts of Dance Jockey

works.title: Discovering Columbus
works.description: Around the statue of Christopher Columbus in New York's Columbus Circle, Nishi built a fully furnished living room six storeys up, so visitors met the statue at eye level beside a sofa and TV.
works.description_zh: 在纽约哥伦布圆环的哥伦布雕像周围，Nishi 在六层楼高处搭建了一个陈设齐全的客厅，让访客在沙发和电视旁与雕像平视相遇。
works.idea_en: Changing the room around a monument changes what it means; AR portals can wrap a statue in an unexpected interior the same way.
works.idea_zh: 改变纪念碑周围的房间就改变了它的意义；AR 传送门也可以同样用一个意想不到的室内空间包裹雕像。
works.technique: A scaffold tower supports a room built around the top of the column, decorated with custom wallpaper and furniture.
works.technique_zh: 脚手架塔支撑着一个围绕柱顶搭建的房间，配以定制墙纸和家具。
works.exercise_en: Choose a statue and build an AR room around its head (walls, sofa, lamp) so a viewer standing on a bench is 'inside' with it. Twist: the wallpaper pattern tells the statue's history.
works.exercise_zh: 选择一座雕像，在它头部周围搭建一个 AR 房间（墙、沙发、台灯），让站在长椅上的观者与它同处“室内”；变体：墙纸图案讲述雕像的历史。

video.video_title: Mayor Bloomberg Joins Public Art Fund to Celebrate the Opening of Tatzu Nishi: Discovering Columbus

salient.why_en: A living room built around a statue six storeys up lets you sit next to it on the sofa.
salient.why_zh: 在六层楼高的雕像周围搭一间客厅，你可以坐在沙发上与它平视。

works.title: Drawn Together
works.description: Visitors draw with chalk on black paper at a drafting table while wearing 3D glasses and headphones; they hear their own marks amplified, and an artificial intelligence answers with its own lines projected in stereoscopic 3D above the page.
works.description_zh: 访客戴着 3D 眼镜和耳机，在制图桌上用粉笔在黑纸上作画；他们能听见自己笔触被放大的声音，一个人工智能则以立体 3D 投影在纸面上方画出自己的线条来回应。
works.idea_en: Draw a duet with a machine that replies in 3D above your paper.
works.idea_zh: 和一台机器一起画一段二重奏，它在你的纸上方用 3D 线条回应你。
works.technique: Contact microphones in the table body pick up the sound of drawing, cameras read the marks, and AI agents built in Field generate responsive strokes projected in stereo 3D onto the drawing.
works.technique_zh: 桌体内的接触式麦克风拾取画画的声音，摄像机读取笔迹，Field 中的 AI 代理生成回应的笔触，以立体 3D 投影到画面上。
works.exercise_en: Point a phone camera at paper, detect new pen strokes with simple frame differencing, and answer each one with a mirrored or rotated virtual stroke floating above the page in AR. Twist: let the machine answer only after you stop drawing, like a conversation.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机摄像头对准纸面，用简单的帧差法检测新笔画，并在 AR 中用一条镜像或旋转后的虚拟笔画悬浮在纸上方回应；变体：机器只在你停笔后才回应，像一场对话。

video.video_title: Drawn Together premiere Georgia Tech

works.title: EEG AR: Things We Have Lost
works.description: People are asked what they have lost; wearing an EEG headset, they concentrate to make the lost object appear in AR at the site, from Liverpool to LACMA's MacArthur Park.
works.description_zh: 艺术家询问路人失去了什么；戴上 EEG 脑电头环后，他们只要集中注意力，那件失物就会以 AR 形式出现在现场，从利物浦一直做到洛杉矶县立美术馆的麦克阿瑟公园。
works.idea_en: Summon something you lost into the world with the power of your attention.
works.idea_zh: 用你的专注力，把失去的东西召唤回现实世界。
works.technique: A consumer EEG headset streams an attention value; above a threshold, a pre-modelled 3D object from the interviews is spawned at the geolocation in a mobile AR app.
works.technique_zh: 消费级 EEG 头环实时输出注意力数值，超过阈值时，就在移动 AR 应用中于该地理位置生成根据访谈预先建模的 3D 物体。
works.exercise_en: Collect three 'lost things' from classmates, model them, and make them appear in phone AR only after a concentration timer (hold still, stare, or breathe slowly). Twist: use a real EEG or heart-rate sensor.
works.exercise_zh: 向同学征集三件“失去的东西”，建模后让它们只在专注计时结束后出现在手机 AR 中（保持不动、凝视或缓慢呼吸）。变体：接入真实的 EEG 或心率传感器。

video.video_title: EEG AR: Things We Have Lost, John Craig  Freeman

works.title: Exit Glacier Augmented Reality Terminus Project
works.description: At Exit Glacier in Kenai Fjords, Alaska, visitors see where the glacier's edge stood in past decades as AR ice rising from the now-empty valley.
works.description_zh: 在阿拉斯加基奈峡湾的 Exit Glacier，游客能看到过去几十年冰川边缘的位置：AR 冰体从如今空荡的山谷中升起。
works.idea_en: Show climate change on site by restoring what has melted.
works.idea_zh: 在现场复原已经融化的部分，让气候变化看得见。
works.technique: Historical terminus positions from park survey markers are rebuilt as 3D ice models and geolocated along the trail in the Layar AR browser.
works.technique_zh: 根据公园测量标记中的历史冰舌位置，重建 3D 冰体模型，并在 Layar AR 浏览器中沿步道进行地理定位。
works.exercise_en: Find historical data for something that has shrunk or moved near you (a shoreline, a tree line, a river) and place its past outline in phone AR at full scale. Twist: add a year slider.
works.exercise_zh: 找到你附近某种已缩小或移动的事物（海岸线、林线、河道）的历史数据，用手机 AR 以真实尺度放出它过去的轮廓。变体：加一个年份滑块。

video.video_title: Exit Glacier Augmented Reality Terminus Project

salient.why_en: In an empty Alaskan valley, the ice of Exit Glacier rises again where its edge stood decades ago.
salient.why_zh: 在阿拉斯加空荡荡的山谷里，Exit Glacier 的冰重新升起，回到几十年前冰川边缘所在的位置。

works.title: Eyebeam mixed-reality performance
works.description: At Eyebeam, Alan Sondheim projects Second Life onto the wall, Foofwa d'Imobilité dances in the room, Azure Carter sings, and Mark Skwarek adds AR that viewers see on their phones.
works.description_zh: 在 Eyebeam，Alan Sondheim 把 Second Life 投影到墙上，Foofwa d'Imobilité 在房间里起舞，Azure Carter 演唱，Mark Skwarek 叠加观众用手机看到的 AR 层。
works.idea_en: Stack three realities, a virtual world, a live dancer and an AR layer, in one room.
works.idea_zh: 在同一个房间里叠加三层现实：虚拟世界、现场舞者和 AR 图层。
works.technique: A projected Second Life session and a live dancer share the space while geolocated or marker-based AR objects are added on smartphones as a third layer.
works.technique_zh: 投影出的 Second Life 画面与现场舞者共享空间，同时通过基于位置或标记的智能手机 AR 叠加第三层物件。
works.exercise_en: Run a 10-minute performance where one student dances, one projects a game world and one places AR objects that the audience sees on phones. Twist: the dancer can only see the AR layer.
works.exercise_zh: 做一场 10 分钟的表演：一人跳舞、一人投影游戏世界、一人放置观众用手机观看的 AR 物件。变体：舞者只能看到 AR 图层。

video.video_title: eyebeam // alan sondheim/foofwa d'imobilite/azure carter/chris diasparra/mark skwarek

works.title: Firewall
works.description: A stretched sheet of spandex acts as a membrane: when people press into it, fire-like visuals bloom from the point of contact and music plays, louder and faster the deeper they push.
works.description_zh: 一张绷紧的弹力布充当薄膜：人按进去时，接触点涌出火焰般的影像并响起音乐，按得越深，音乐越响越快。
works.idea_en: A soft surface that you can physically push makes digital content feel touchable — a reminder that AR benefits from real material feedback.
works.idea_zh: 一个能真实按压的柔软表面让数字内容有了触感——提醒我们 AR 也能从真实材料的反馈中获益。
works.technique: A Kinect behind the fabric measures how deep each point is pushed, and the depth map drives a particle system projected onto the fabric and a generative music engine (software stack likely Max/MSP or openFrameworks).
works.technique_zh: 布后的 Kinect 测量每个点被按下的深度，深度图驱动投影在布上的粒子系统和生成式音乐引擎。
works.exercise_en: Stretch a sheet of fabric in a frame, track hands pushing into it with a depth camera or phone LiDAR, and render AR flames on the fabric at the press points. Twist: let two people pressing from opposite sides make the flames collide.
works.exercise_zh: 把一块布绷在框上，用深度相机或手机 LiDAR 追踪按进去的手，在按压点的布面上渲染 AR 火焰。变体：让两人从两侧同时按压，火焰相撞。

video.video_title: Firewall

works.title: Floating and scattering installations
works.description: Konrads builds site-specific works in forests and gardens where piles of stones seem to hover, fences break apart into flying sticks and gates dissolve into the air.
works.description_zh: Konrads 在森林和花园中创作场域作品：一堆堆石头仿佛悬浮，栅栏裂成飞散的木棍，大门消散在空气中。
works.idea_en: Natural objects frozen mid-explosion look like a paused physics simulation, an easy bridge to AR physics effects.
works.idea_zh: 在爆炸中途被凝固的自然物，看起来像暂停的物理模拟，是通往 AR 物理效果的便捷桥梁。
works.technique: Stones and sticks are held on thin hidden rods or wires so they appear suspended in mid-air.
works.technique_zh: 石头和木棍被细细的隐藏杆或线固定，看起来悬浮在半空中。
works.exercise_en: Scan a real pile of stones or a fence and, in AR, freeze it in mid-explosion using a physics simulation paused at one frame. Twist: let the user scrub time forward and backward to reassemble it.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描一堆真实的石头或一段栅栏，在 AR 中用暂停在某一帧的物理模拟把它凝固在爆炸中途；变体：让用户前后拖动时间，把它重新组合起来。

video.video_title: Land Art by Cornelia Konrads | Euromaxx

works.title: Forms
works.description: Footage of Commonwealth Games athletes — gymnasts, divers, weightlifters — is turned into abstract animated sculptures that trace the forces and paths of their movements.
works.description_zh: 英联邦运动会运动员（体操、跳水、举重）的影像被转化为抽象的动画雕塑，描出他们动作的力与轨迹。
works.idea_en: Turning an athlete's motion into a sculpture of lines and surfaces shows how AR can make the invisible physics of a body visible around the body itself.
works.idea_zh: 把运动员的动作变成由线和面构成的雕塑，展示了 AR 如何在身体周围显现身体看不见的物理规律。
works.technique: Made with Quayola: the athletes' movement is tracked from video and used to drive procedural geometry and simulations that visualise trajectories, forces and time.
works.technique_zh: 与 Quayola 合作：从视频中追踪运动员的动作，驱动程序化几何和模拟，把轨迹、力和时间可视化。
works.exercise_en: Record a friend jumping or throwing with body tracking, then play the motion back in AR as sweeping ribbons and arcs anchored where it happened. Twist: show only the forces (arrows) and hide the body.
works.exercise_zh: 用身体追踪录下朋友的跳跃或投掷，在 AR 中把动作以飘带和弧线的形式在原地回放。变体：只显示力（箭头），把身体隐藏起来。

video.video_title: "FORMS" (2012), excerpts - long

works.title: Future Self (with Wayne McGregor)
works.description: A three-dimensional sculpture of hanging LED rods renders a light-figure that mirrors and responds to the dancers or visitors moving in front of it.
works.idea_zh: 用LED杆阵组成会映出你动作的“光之分身”
works.technique: Depth cameras capture the body and drive a volumetric LED matrix so the silhouette is rendered as points of light in 3D.
works.exercise_zh: 用Kinect或手机深度相机把身体变成3D点云，在屏幕上用发光点显示；变化：让光之分身比真人慢半拍，成为“未来的你”的反面。

video.video_title: rAndom international: future self

works.description_zh: 一件由悬挂 LED 灯杆构成的三维雕塑，呈现出一个光之人形，映照并回应在它面前移动的舞者或观众。
works.idea_en: An array of LED rods forms a "light double" that mirrors your movements.
works.technique_zh: 深度相机捕捉人体，驱动一个体积式 LED 矩阵，把身体剪影以三维光点的形式呈现出来。
works.exercise_en: Turn your body into a 3D point cloud with a Kinect or a phone depth camera and display it as glowing dots on screen. Twist: make the light double lag half a beat behind you, the opposite of a "future you".

works.title: Global Augmented Reality Dance
works.description: The typical arm-waving of people looking at AR through phones is turned into a choreography that people all over the world perform at exactly the same moment.
works.description_zh: 人们举着手机看 AR 时那种典型的挥臂动作，被编成一段舞蹈，全世界的人在同一时刻一起跳。
works.idea_en: The awkward gestures of AR users become a synchronized global dance.
works.idea_zh: AR 用户笨拙的手势，变成一场全球同步的舞蹈。
works.technique: A web or AR app gives timed on-screen cues synchronized to a global clock so that users worldwide move their phones in the same pattern at the same time.
works.technique_zh: 网页或 AR 应用根据全球统一时钟给出定时屏幕提示，让世界各地的用户在同一时间以相同方式移动手机。
works.exercise_en: Choreograph a 30-second phone dance using motion sensors, with a synced start time, and perform it simultaneously with a partner class elsewhere. Twist: score how in-sync everyone was from gyro data.
works.exercise_zh: 利用手机运动传感器编一段 30 秒的“手机舞”，设定同步开始时间，与别处的合作班级同时表演。变体：用陀螺仪数据给大家的同步程度打分。

video.video_title: Global Augmented Reality Dance

works.title: Group Walk, Birmingham
works.description: At Curzon Park in Birmingham, Fulton led a group walk in which participants moved slowly along set lines, turning a derelict site into a collective, silent performance.
works.description_zh: 在伯明翰的 Curzon Park，Fulton 带领一次集体行走，参与者沿设定的线路缓慢移动，把一片废弃场地变成集体的、沉默的表演。
works.idea_en: A simple shared rule for walking becomes the artwork; an AR score can guide groups through a site in the same way.
works.idea_zh: 一条简单的共同行走规则就是作品本身；AR“乐谱”也可以用同样的方式引导群体穿越场地。
works.technique: Participants follow spoken instructions (walk slowly, in silence, along parallel lines), with no objects left behind.
works.technique_zh: 参与者遵循口头指令（缓慢、沉默地沿平行线行走），不留下任何物品。
works.exercise_en: Write an AR walking score where each participant sees a personal line on the ground and a speed indicator, and all lines converge at one point. Twist: the lines only appear while the walker keeps below a set speed.
works.exercise_zh: 编写一份 AR 行走乐谱：每位参与者在地面上看到一条属于自己的线和一个速度指示，所有线最终汇聚于一点；变体：只有当行走者保持在设定速度以下时，线才会出现。

video.video_title: Hamish Fulton Group Walk, Birmingham

works.title: Gunpowder drawings
works.description: In his studio, Cai lays paper stencils and trails of gunpowder on large sheets, covers them with cardboard and ignites them; the explosion leaves burnt drawings of trees, figures and landscapes.
works.description_zh: 在工作室里，蔡国强把纸模板和火药铺在大幅画纸上，盖上纸板后点燃；爆炸之后，纸上留下树木、人物和风景的焦痕。
works.idea_en: The drawing is the record of a few seconds of energy; AR can likewise leave a permanent trace of a brief action, turning a moment into a mark in space.
works.idea_zh: 画面是几秒钟能量释放的记录；AR 也可以把一个短暂的动作留作空间中的永久痕迹，把一瞬间变成一个印记。
works.technique: Gunpowder of different grain sizes is spread through stencils, weighted with boards and ignited, so the pressure of the burn controls how dark and sharp the marks become.
works.technique_zh: 不同颗粒大小的火药透过模板撒开，用板子压住后点燃，燃烧的压力决定了痕迹的深浅和清晰程度。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR 'explosion brush': students draw a path on a real wall with their finger, then trigger a burn that leaves a scorched decal texture where the path was. Twist: the scorch mark spreads further where the drawn line was thicker, like more powder.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR“爆炸画笔”：同学们用手指在真实墙面上画出路径，然后引爆，在路径处留下烧焦的贴图痕迹。变体：线条画得越粗的地方，焦痕扩散得越远，就像撒了更多火药。

video.video_title: Cai Guo-Qiang - Drawing with Gunpowder - The Artist's Studio - MOCAtv

works.title: HDR EyeGlass (welding helmet)
works.description: A welding helmet with a camera and display lets the welder see both the blinding arc and the dark metal around it clearly at the same time, by fusing several exposures in real time.
works.description_zh: 一个装有摄像头和显示器的焊接面罩，通过实时融合多张不同曝光的画面，让焊工同时看清刺眼的电弧和周围昏暗的金属。
works.idea_en: Give human vision a dynamic range it never had, so the brightest and darkest parts of a scene are visible together.
works.idea_zh: 赋予人眼从未有过的动态范围，让场景中最亮和最暗的部分同时可见。
works.technique: Frames with alternating exposures are combined with comparametric (quantigraphic) HDR compositing on the fly and tone-mapped to the head-worn display.
works.technique_zh: 交替曝光的画面通过 comparametric（quantigraphic）HDR 合成实时融合，再经色调映射显示在头戴屏幕上。
works.exercise_en: Point a phone at a window scene with a bright sky and a dark room, and build a live view that blends two exposures with a slider for the mix. Twist: map brightness to sound instead of image.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机对准一个既有明亮天空又有昏暗室内的窗景，做一个融合两种曝光的实时画面，并用滑杆调节混合比例。变体：把亮度映射成声音而不是图像。

video.video_title: HDR (High Dynamic Range) EyeGlass or welding helmet

works.title: HDRchitecture
works.description: A SIGGRAPH Emerging Technologies demo in which extreme-dynamic-range video from a wearable rig is combined with 3D sensing, so bright light sources and dark rooms are captured and seen together in real time.
works.description_zh: SIGGRAPH 新兴技术展演示：把可穿戴设备拍到的极高动态范围视频与 3D 感知结合，实时同时捕捉并呈现强光源和昏暗空间。
works.idea_en: Perceive a space's light and geometry at once, beyond what either an eye or a camera can see alone.
works.idea_zh: 同时感知空间的光与几何，超越单凭眼睛或相机所能看到的范围。
works.technique: GPU-based HDR fusion of bracketed exposures runs in real time and is mapped onto depth-sensed geometry for 3D viewing.
works.technique_zh: 用 GPU 实时融合包围曝光的画面，并映射到深度传感得到的几何体上进行 3D 观看。
works.exercise_en: Scan a room with a LiDAR phone twice, once with lights on and once with lights off, and toggle between the two meshes in AR. Twist: let a hand gesture paint 'daylight' onto parts of the dark scan.
works.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的手机把同一个房间开灯和关灯各扫描一次，在 AR 中切换两个网格。变体：用手势把“日光”涂到黑暗扫描的某些部分。

video.video_title: SIGGRAPH 2012 Emerging Technology - HDRchitecture

works.title: HoloDesk
works.description: A see-through display over a desk lets you reach under it and juggle, grasp and share virtual 3D objects with your real hands, with correct occlusion.
works.idea_zh: 把手伸到半透明镜面下，直接用真手托起、抛接虚拟小球。

video.video_title: HoloDesk - Direct 3D Interactions with a Situated See-Through Display

works.technique: A beam splitter shows a display's image in the volume under it, a head-tracking camera provides view-dependent rendering, and a Kinect's depth of the hands is converted into particle proxies that physically interact with and occlude virtual objects.
works.exercise_zh: 用平板加 45° 斜放的亚克力板做一个“佩珀尔幻象”盒子，把 MediaPipe 检测到的手部关键点接到物理引擎里，让手能在盒子里拨动虚拟方块；变体：在盒子里放一个真实物体，让虚拟物体绕开它。
works.description_zh: 桌面上方的一块透视显示屏让你可以把手伸到它下面，用真实的双手抛接、抓握并分享虚拟三维物体，遮挡关系也完全正确。
works.idea_en: Reach under a half-mirror and catch and toss virtual balls with your real hands.
works.technique_zh: 分光镜把显示器的画面呈现在其下方的空间里，头部追踪摄像头提供视点相关渲染，Kinect 获取的手部深度被转换为粒子代理，与虚拟物体发生物理交互并正确遮挡它们。
