works.exercise_en: Build a "Pepper's ghost" box from a tablet and a sheet of acrylic tilted at 45 degrees, and feed the hand keypoints detected by MediaPipe into a physics engine so your hand can nudge virtual cubes inside the box. Twist: put a real object in the box and make the virtual objects move around it.

works.title: Holoflector
works.description: A large half-silvered mirror with a display behind it and Kinect body tracking: virtual objects appear in your reflection and react to your real body.
works.idea_zh: 一面魔镜：镜中的你能接住虚拟的球，镜像与虚拟物体完美对位。

video.video_title: Holoflector

works.technique: A half-silvered mirror in front of an LCD combines the real reflection with rendered graphics, and Kinect skeleton tracking places virtual objects so they align with the user's reflected body.
works.exercise_zh: 用一台平板加一块亚克力半透镜（或用镜像的摄像头画面）做一面“魔镜”，用 MediaPipe Pose 让虚拟小球落在你反射的肩膀上并可被拍掉；变体：镜子里的你做出和你不一样的动作。
works.description_zh: 一面大尺寸半透半反镜，背后装有显示屏并配合 Kinect 身体追踪：虚拟物体会出现在你的镜像中，并对你真实的身体作出反应。
works.idea_en: A magic mirror where your reflection can catch a virtual ball, with the image and the virtual objects lined up exactly.
works.technique_zh: LCD 前方的半透半反镜把真实的镜像与渲染出的图形合在一起，Kinect 骨架追踪确定虚拟物体的位置，使其与用户镜像中的身体对齐。
works.exercise_en: Build a "magic mirror" from a tablet and an acrylic half-mirror (or a mirrored camera feed), and use MediaPipe Pose so a virtual ball lands on your reflected shoulder and can be brushed off. Twist: your reflection makes a different move from the one you make.

works.title: Hyper-Matrix (Hyundai Motor Group Pavilion, Expo 2012 Yeosu)
works.description: A giant wall made of thousands of white cubes pushed in and out by motors forms waves, faces and 3D patterns, with projected light enhancing the relief.
works.description_zh: 由数千个被电机推进推出的白色方块组成的巨墙，形成波浪、人脸和立体图案，投影光进一步增强浮雕效果。
works.idea_en: A wall that physically moves is shocking because walls never move — AR can make solid architecture appear to breathe.
works.idea_zh: 会动的墙令人震撼，因为墙从来不动——AR 可以让坚实的建筑看起来在呼吸。
works.technique: Each cube is likely mounted on a stepper-driven rod; a height-map animation is sent to the actuator grid and synchronized with projection.
works.technique_zh: 每个方块很可能装在步进电机驱动的推杆上；高度图动画被发送到执行器阵列，并与投影同步。
works.exercise_en: Replace a real wall in AR with a grid of cubes that push out to form the silhouette of whoever stands in front of it. Twist: use depth from the LiDAR to make the relief follow the user's body.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一面真实的墙替换成方块阵列，方块推出后形成站在它面前的人的轮廓。变体：用 LiDAR 深度让浮雕跟随用户的身体。

video.video_title: Hyper-Matrix (Official Video)

works.title: I Spy
works.description: A hanging mobile of four tablets showing eyes and mouths turns to follow visitors as they walk through the room, as if the gadgets were watching them.
works.description_zh: 由四台显示眼睛和嘴巴的平板组成的吊饰，会随着观众在房间中走动而转向他们，好像这些设备在监视人。
works.idea_en: Our gadgets finally stare back at us.
works.idea_zh: 我们的电子设备终于反过来盯着我们看。
works.technique: Two Kinects track people in the space and an openFrameworks app computes the servo angles of the mobile's arms so each tablet faces the nearest viewer.
works.technique_zh: 两台 Kinect 追踪空间中的人，openFrameworks 程序计算吊饰各臂的舵机角度，让每台平板都朝向最近的观众。
works.exercise_en: Place a phone showing an animated eye in the room and use body tracking so the eye always looks at the nearest person. Twist: with two people present, the eye looks at whoever is not looking at it.
works.exercise_zh: 在房间里放一部显示动画眼睛的手机，用人体追踪让眼睛始终看向最近的人。变体：有两个人时，眼睛看向没在看它的那个人。

video.video_title: I Spy

works.title: ISAM Live 2.0
works.description: The revised ISAM show, performed at Coachella and the Sydney Opera House, uses the same cube sculpture with new mapped visuals, including a transparent layer that reveals Tobin inside.
works.description_zh: 修订版 ISAM 演出在 Coachella 和悉尼歌剧院上演，沿用方块雕塑并加入新的映射影像，其中一层透明效果会露出坐在里面的 Tobin。
works.idea_en: Showing and hiding the performer through the mapped surface plays with what is real behind the image, a key tension in AR occlusion.
works.idea_zh: 通过映射表面时而露出、时而隐藏表演者，玩的是影像背后什么才是真实的，这正是 AR 遮挡中的关键张力。
works.technique: Updated projection content on the existing cube structure, with lighting inside the central cube likely used to make the surface appear transparent at moments.
works.technique_zh: 在原有方块结构上更新投影内容，推测借助中间方块内部的灯光，让表面在某些时刻显得透明。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR scene where a virtual wall covers a classmate and use people occlusion to let their silhouette punch through at chosen beats. Twist: the audience's claps decide when the wall opens.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 场景，让一面虚拟墙盖住一位同学，用人物遮挡在特定节拍让他的轮廓从墙中透出来；变体：由观众的掌声决定墙何时打开。

video.video_title: Amon Tobin : ISAM Live 2.0 (Europe 2013)

works.title: In Cloud Light III
works.description: A tall wind sculpture of stacked, spoke-mounted stainless discs rotates in the breeze, each tier turning at its own pace so the form constantly shimmers and reconfigures.
works.description_zh: 一件高大的风动雕塑，由层层叠放、装在辐条上的不锈钢圆片组成，每一层以自己的节奏转动，整体不断闪烁、重组。
works.idea_en: Reflection plus rotation make a sculpture borrow colour from the sky; AR materials that reflect the real environment gain the same site-specific shimmer.
works.idea_zh: 反射加旋转，让雕塑从天空借来颜色；能反射真实环境的 AR 材质也能获得同样因地而异的闪光。
works.technique: Each tier is balanced on its own bearing and sized so that the same wind drives it at a different speed, producing phasing patterns (year approximate).
works.technique_zh: 每一层都装在独立轴承上并经过配重，大小各异，同一阵风驱动它们以不同速度转动，产生相位交错的图案（年份为估计）。
works.exercise_en: Place a stack of five reflective rings in a real park with geospatial AR, use environment probes for real reflections, and spin each at a slightly different rate. Twist: link the spin to the live local wind speed.
works.exercise_zh: 用地理空间 AR 在真实公园里放一座五层反光圆环塔，用环境探针获得真实反射，每层转速略有不同。变体：把转速和当地实时风速绑定。

video.video_title: In Cloud Light III

works.title: Ingress
works.description: A location-based sci-fi game where two factions capture real-world landmarks as 'portals' by walking to them with a phone and link them into territory control fields.
works.idea_zh: 把真实城市地标变成两大阵营争夺的传送门，走路就是玩法。

video.video_title: Ingress - It's time to Move.

works.technique: GPS location is matched against a database of geotagged landmarks, and a proximity radius decides when a player can interact with a portal, making the map itself the AR layer.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园地图上标出 5 个“据点”，用浏览器定位 API 判断玩家是否在 30 米内，到达即可占领；变体：两个相邻据点都被同一方占领时自动连线成领地。
works.description_zh: 一款基于位置的科幻游戏：两大阵营的玩家拿着手机走到真实世界的地标处，把它们作为“传送门”占领，再把传送门连接起来形成控制领地。
works.idea_en: Real city landmarks become portals fought over by two factions, and walking is the gameplay.
works.technique_zh: 把 GPS 位置与带地理标签的地标数据库进行匹配，用一个邻近半径判定玩家何时可以与传送门互动，让地图本身成为 AR 图层。
works.exercise_en: Mark 5 "strongholds" on a campus map and use the browser Geolocation API to check whether a player is within 30 meters, capturing a stronghold on arrival. Twist: when two neighboring strongholds belong to the same side, they automatically link into territory.

works.title: It's You
works.description: Projected figures crowd around something hidden; when a pedestrian stands behind them as if to look over their shoulders, they step aside to reveal part of the scene, blocking it for others.
works.idea_zh: 投影人群挡住了秘密，只有你凑近时他们才让开给你看
works.technique: A camera detects a pedestrian's position in the interaction zone and triggers animation branches of the projected crowd that open a view at that spot.
works.exercise_zh: 投一群背对观众的剪影人，用摄像头检测谁站到后面，就让对应位置的人让开露出隐藏图像；变化：隐藏的内容由上一位观众留下的一句话组成。

video.video_title: It's You

works.description_zh: 投影出的人群围在某个隐藏的东西周围；当路人站到他们身后，像是要越过他们肩膀张望时，这些人就会让开，露出场景的一部分，同时又挡住了其他人的视线。
works.idea_en: A projected crowd hides a secret, and only steps aside when you lean in.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头检测路人在互动区域中的位置，触发投影人群的不同动画分支，在该位置让出一个观看的缺口。
works.exercise_en: Project a crowd of silhouettes with their backs to the audience, and use a camera to detect who steps behind them so the figures at that spot move aside and reveal a hidden image. Twist: the hidden content is a sentence left by the previous visitor.

works.title: KINECT | PROJECTOR DANCE
works.description: A demo of a lightweight Kinect-to-projector calibration in Processing, so a dancer's 3D movement is mirrored as abstract graphics on the wall they dance in front of.
works.description_zh: 一个用 Processing 实现的轻量 Kinect 与投影仪标定演示，让舞者的 3D 动作在他面前的墙上被镜像为抽象图形。
works.idea_en: A cheap calibration trick that turns any wall into a dancer's abstract mirror.
works.idea_zh: 一个低成本的标定技巧，让任何墙面都成为舞者的抽象镜子。
works.technique: A simple calibration maps Kinect depth coordinates onto projector pixels without OpenCV, so tracked joints line up with the projected image.
works.technique_zh: 一个不依赖 OpenCV 的简易标定，把 Kinect 深度坐标映射到投影像素上，使追踪到的关节与投影画面对齐。
works.exercise_en: Calibrate a webcam to a projector by clicking four projected corners, then draw circles on tracked wrists that land on the real wrists. Twist: make the circles repel each other.
works.exercise_zh: 点击投影出来的四个角，完成摄像头与投影仪的标定，然后在追踪到的手腕位置画圆，让圆落在真实手腕上；变体：让这些圆彼此排斥。

video.video_title: KINECT | PROJECTOR DANCE

works.title: Kid Icarus: Uprising AR Cards
works.description: Collectible AR cards for Kid Icarus: Uprising; placing two cards in front of the 3DS makes the characters appear and battle each other on the table.
works.idea_zh: 两张实体卡放在桌上，卡上的角色就跳出来对战。

video.video_title: Nintendo 3DS - Kid Icarus: Uprising How to Play Video 3

works.technique: Two cards are detected at once as image targets, and the relative pose between them determines the characters' facing and battle stats.
works.exercise_zh: 用两张图像标记卡各召唤一个角色，卡片距离越近两者越激动，对面朝向时开始战斗；变体：卡片叠放时两个角色合体。
works.description_zh: 《新光神话：帕尔提娜之镜》（Kid Icarus: Uprising）的收藏型 AR 卡片；把两张卡片放在 3DS 前面，卡上的角色就会出现在桌面上互相对战。
works.idea_en: Put two physical cards on the table and the characters jump out to fight.
works.technique_zh: 同时把两张卡片识别为图像目标，由两者之间的相对位姿决定角色的朝向和战斗数值。
works.exercise_en: Summon one character from each of two image marker cards, so the closer the cards the more excited the characters get, and they start fighting when facing each other. Twist: stacking the cards merges the two characters into one.

works.title: Kinetic Rain
works.description: Two fields of 608 copper-coloured raindrops each hang over the departure hall of Changi Airport and move in a 15-minute choreography, forming wings, kites and waves.
works.description_zh: 樟宜机场出发大厅上方悬挂着两组各 608 个铜色“雨滴”，在 15 分钟的编舞中组合出机翼、风筝和波浪。
works.idea_en: A slow, synchronized swarm above people's heads turns a transit space into a place to pause — AR can use the ceiling as a stage, not just the floor.
works.idea_zh: 在人们头顶缓慢同步运动的群体把过路空间变成了驻足的地方——AR 也可以把天花板当舞台，而不只是地面。
works.technique: Each drop hangs on a thin cable from its own motor; a timeline of 3D keyframes is resampled per drop so that the grid reads as one flowing surface.
works.technique_zh: 每个雨滴由细绳挂在各自的电机上；三维关键帧动画按每个雨滴的位置重新采样，使整组看起来像一个流动的曲面。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a grid of 200 virtual raindrops to the ceiling of your classroom with plane detection and animate them into two shapes with a looping timeline. Twist: make the drops part around the viewer's head as they walk underneath.
works.exercise_zh: 用平面检测把 200 个虚拟雨滴锚定在教室天花板上，并用循环时间轴让它们变换出两个形状。变体：当观众走到下方时，让雨滴绕开观众的头部。

video.video_title: Kinetic Rain, 2012

works.title: Laser interaction prototype
works.description: Laser beams cut through haze to form planes of light, and they bend and react when a person reaches into them.
works.description_zh: 激光束穿过烟雾形成光的平面，人伸手进去时，光束会弯曲并作出反应。
works.idea_en: Laser beams you can touch.
works.idea_zh: 可以触摸的激光束。
works.technique: Custom openFrameworks software sends vectors to the laser via a DAC, and a Kinect calibrated to the laser's 3D field detects when a hand intersects a beam.
works.technique_zh: 自制的 openFrameworks 软件通过 DAC 向激光器发送矢量，与激光三维空间校准的 Kinect 检测手何时与光束相交。
works.exercise_en: In a hazy room (or with a projector and a fog of dust), project thin lines through the air and use a webcam to detect when a hand blocks one, which then changes it. Twist: each line plays a note when touched.
works.exercise_zh: 在有烟雾的房间里（或用投影仪照亮空气中的灰尘），把细线投过空中，用摄像头检测手何时挡住某条线并改变它。变体：每条线被碰到时都会发出一个音符。

video.video_title: Laser interaction prototype

works.title: Levitated Mass
works.description: A 340-ton granite boulder sits on two ledges above a 139-metre concrete slot at LACMA in Los Angeles; visitors walk down the ramp and pass underneath it.
works.description_zh: 一块重 340 吨的花岗岩巨石架在洛杉矶郡立艺术博物馆一条长 139 米的混凝土沟槽上方的两处支座上；观众沿坡道走下去，从它下面经过。
works.idea_en: Walking under something heavy that seems to float creates real bodily tension, a cue AR can borrow with carefully scaled overhead objects.
works.idea_zh: 从一个看似漂浮的重物下面走过会产生真实的身体紧张感，AR 可以用尺度精确的头顶物体借用这种感觉。
works.technique: The boulder was moved 170 kilometres over 11 nights on a custom transporter and bolted onto steel shelves over the slot.
works.technique_zh: 巨石用特制运输车历时 11 个夜晚移动了 170 公里，再用螺栓固定在沟槽上方的钢托架上。
works.exercise_en: Place a photoreal AR boulder over a real corridor or doorway so people must walk under it, and add a faint rumble sound as they pass. Twist: the boulder rises a little higher for each person who walks under it.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实走廊或门口上方放置一块逼真的 AR 巨石，让人们必须从它下面走过，经过时加入低沉的隆隆声；变体：每有一个人从下面走过，巨石就升高一点。

video.video_title: Levitated Mass: The Story of Michael Heizer's Monolithic Sculpture

works.title: LightGuide
works.description: A ceiling projector draws arrows, color gradients and 3D cues directly on the user's hand to guide it along a precise movement path.
works.idea_zh: 把动作提示直接投影在你的手上，手跟着光走。

video.video_title: LightGuide: Projected Visualizations for Hand Movement Guidance

works.technique: Tracks the hand with a depth camera and renders movement-guidance visualizations warped onto the hand surface in real time.
works.exercise_zh: 用投影仪在桌面/手上投射一条动画路径，让同学用手跟随画出一个字母；变化：用手机AR改为在屏幕上把箭头贴在手上，比较两种引导的准确度。
works.description_zh: 天花板上的投影仪把箭头、颜色渐变和三维提示直接画在用户手上，引导手沿着精确的运动路径移动。
works.idea_en: Project movement cues straight onto your hand and let the hand follow the light.
works.technique_zh: 用深度相机追踪手部，实时把运动引导可视化内容经形变后渲染到手的表面上。
works.exercise_en: Project an animated path onto the table or a hand and have a classmate follow it with their hand to draw a letter. Twist: switch to phone AR that pins the arrows to the hand on screen, and compare the accuracy of the two kinds of guidance.

works.title: Lighting the Sails (Sydney Opera House)
works.description: A projected homage to Jørn Utzon in which the Opera House sails appear to be unfolded, rebuilt and given a human, breathing expression.
works.idea_zh: 让悉尼歌剧院的“帆”在投影中被拆解、重建并呼吸
works.technique: Laser-scanned geometry of the curved shells guides multi-projector content that exaggerates their construction logic with simulated depth and light.
works.exercise_zh: 用一张弯曲的纸或灯罩当“帆”，投影线框在上面拆分重组；变化：用呼吸声的大小控制“帆”的鼓起程度。

video.video_title: SYDNEY OPERA HOUSE | Facade projection

works.description_zh: 一场向约恩·伍重（Jørn Utzon）致敬的投影作品，悉尼歌剧院的“风帆”仿佛被展开、重建，并被赋予了人性化的、会呼吸的表情。
works.idea_en: The sails of the Sydney Opera House are taken apart, rebuilt and made to breathe in projection.
works.technique_zh: 以激光扫描得到的曲面壳体几何为依据制作多投影仪内容，用模拟的纵深和光影夸张地展现其建造逻辑。
works.exercise_en: Use a curved sheet of paper or a lampshade as a "sail" and project a wireframe onto it that splits apart and reassembles. Twist: let the loudness of breathing control how much the "sail" billows.

works.title: Loup-garou
works.description: In a dark, eerie space, anyone who stands in front of a projected full moon sees their silhouette turn into a werewolf that copies their pose.
works.description_zh: 在昏暗诡异的空间里，只要站到投影出来的满月前，观众的剪影就会变成一只模仿他们姿势的狼人。
works.idea_en: Stand in front of the moon and become a werewolf.
works.idea_zh: 站到月亮前面，你就变成狼人。
works.technique: A camera detects body positions and silhouettes, and the software swaps the silhouette for werewolf animations triggered by pose.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头检测身体位置和剪影，程序根据姿势把剪影替换成对应的狼人动画。
works.exercise_en: Use a pose-tracking model (MediaPipe or ml5.js) to replace a student's shadow with an animated creature when they step into a marked circle. Twist: the transformation only happens when two people stand close together.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 或 ml5.js 的姿态追踪，在同学走进地上标出的圆圈时，把他的影子替换成一个动画生物；变体：只有两个人靠在一起时才会变身。

video.video_title: Loup-garou - Festival PanOrama 2012

works.title: Lunar Trails
works.description: Visitors play the 1979 arcade game Lunar Lander on a real cabinet, and a large hanging drawing robot plots each player's flight path onto the gallery wall, building up a collective drawing.
works.description_zh: 观众在真实的街机上玩 1979 年的游戏 Lunar Lander，一台悬挂在墙上的大型绘图机器人把每位玩家的飞行轨迹画到展墙上，逐渐叠成一幅集体作品。
works.idea_en: Your path through a screen game is drawn out physically on the wall.
works.idea_zh: 你在屏幕游戏里的飞行路径被实体地画在墙上。
works.technique: The game's lander position is read in software and sent as coordinates to a polargraph-style hanging plotter that draws the trajectories in pen.
works.technique_zh: 软件读取游戏中着陆器的位置，把坐标发给一台悬挂式绘图仪，用笔画出轨迹。
works.exercise_en: Record the path of a player in a simple phone game and replay it as a drawing on paper with a pen plotter, or as a persistent AR trail in the room. Twist: overlay the trails of everyone in the class and see where they all crash.
works.exercise_zh: 记录玩家在一个简单手机游戏里的路径，用绘图仪画在纸上，或者作为留在房间里的 AR 轨迹。变体：把全班的轨迹叠在一起，看大家都在哪里坠毁。

video.video_title: Lunar Trails

works.title: Madonna Super Bowl XLVI Halftime Show
works.description: For Madonna's 2012 Super Bowl halftime show, Moment Factory turned the entire stadium field and stage into a projection surface: temples, palaces, patterns and giant typography rearranged themselves under the performers in a few minutes of live television.
works.description_zh: 在 2012 年麦当娜的超级碗中场秀中，Moment Factory 把整个球场和舞台变成投影面：神殿、宫殿、图案和巨大的文字在表演者脚下变换，全部在几分钟的电视直播中完成。
works.idea_en: Projecting on the floor seen from above transforms a whole venue; AR designers can treat the ground plane as the biggest, most flexible canvas.
works.idea_zh: 从高处看，投在地面上的影像能改变整个场地；AR 设计师可以把地面当作最大、最灵活的画布。
works.technique: The field and modular stage were covered with top-down projection mapped to a 3D model of the set and camera angles, cued to the music.
works.technique_zh: 场地和模块化舞台用俯视投影覆盖，按舞台三维模型和镜头角度对位，并跟随音乐触发。
works.exercise_en: Design a floor-based AR scene with WebXR plane detection that turns a classroom floor into a changing map as a performer walks across it. Twist: the pattern is only fully readable from the balcony or a raised phone.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 平面检测做一个地面 AR 场景，让表演者走过时教室地板变成不断变化的地图；变体：图案只有从楼上或举高的手机俯看时才完整可读。

video.video_title: Moment Factory - Madonna XLVI Super Bowl

works.title: Mandala I
works.description: A time-lapse shows Amador raking a large radially symmetric mandala into the sand, seen from above as the pattern grows ring by ring.
works.description_zh: 延时影像展示 Amador 在沙滩上耙出一个巨大的径向对称曼陀罗，从上方看，图案一圈圈地生长。
works.idea_en: Radial symmetry lets a human-scale gesture add up to a readable image from above, a principle for AR ground patterns.
works.idea_zh: 径向对称让人体尺度的动作累积成从上方可读的图像，这是 AR 地面图案的一条原则。
works.technique: He marks a centre, lays out rings with a rope and repeats the same motif around each ring.
works.technique_zh: 他先标出中心，用绳子定出圆环，再在每一圈重复同一个图案。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR mandala tool: anything the user draws on the ground is repeated eight times around a centre point. Twist: the symmetry count increases with each new ring.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个 AR 曼陀罗工具：用户在地面上画的任何东西都会围绕中心点重复八次；变体：每新增一圈，对称数就增加。

video.video_title: Andres Amador- Mandala I

works.title: Meet Your Creator
works.description: Sixteen quadrotor drones carrying LEDs and motorized mirrors fly in formation over a theater stage, bouncing beams of light and building glowing sculptures in the air above the audience.
works.description_zh: 十六架携带 LED 和电动镜子的四旋翼无人机在剧场舞台上空编队飞行，反射光束，在观众头顶构建出发光的空中雕塑。
works.idea_en: Flying robots as moving light pixels that draw in the air of a theater.
works.idea_zh: 让会飞的机器人成为移动的光像素，在剧场空中作画。
works.technique: A motion-capture system tracks each drone and choreography software sends synchronized flight paths, LED colors and mirror angles to bounce stage lights.
works.technique_zh: 动作捕捉系统追踪每架无人机，编排软件同步下发飞行路径、LED 颜色和镜面角度，用来反射舞台灯光。
works.exercise_en: Choreograph a 60-second light show for five virtual drones in a 3D web scene (three.js), timing positions and colors to a song. Twist: add one real flashlight and a mirror in the classroom and aim the beam to hit a marked target.
works.exercise_zh: 在三维网页场景（three.js）里为五架虚拟无人机编排一段 60 秒的灯光秀，让位置和颜色与一首歌的节拍对应；变体：在教室里加一支真实手电筒和一面镜子，把光束反射到指定目标上。

video.video_title: MEET YOUR CREATOR   QUADROTOR SHOW

works.title: MirageTable
works.description: A curved projected tabletop with stereo glasses and Kinect: users grab virtual 3D objects with bare hands and meet a remote partner rendered as if sitting across the table.
works.idea_zh: 弯曲桌面+立体投影，徒手抓取虚拟物体，并与远方的人'隔桌相对'。

video.video_title: MirageTable: Freehand Interaction on a Projected Augmented Reality Tabletop.

works.technique: A Kinect captures the user and the remote partner as depth meshes, head-tracked stereo projection onto a curved screen renders view-dependent 3D, and a physics engine lets hand geometry push virtual objects.
works.exercise_zh: 用 three.js 做一个基于人脸追踪（MediaPipe Face）的视差桌面：摄像头追踪头部，屏幕或投影上的 3D 物体随视角变化产生“离屏”错觉；变体：把另一台电脑传来的对方视频放进这个 3D 空间里，做一个“隔桌对坐”的小游戏。
works.description_zh: 一张配合立体眼镜和 Kinect 的弧形投影桌面：用户可以徒手抓取虚拟三维物体，还能与远程伙伴见面，对方看起来就像坐在桌子对面。
works.idea_en: A curved desk with stereo projection lets you grab virtual objects by hand and sit "across the table" from someone far away.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 把用户和远程伙伴采集为深度网格，带头部追踪的立体投影在弧形屏幕上渲染视点相关的三维画面，物理引擎让手部几何能推动虚拟物体。
works.exercise_en: Build a parallax tabletop in three.js driven by face tracking (MediaPipe Face): a camera tracks your head, and 3D objects on the screen or projection shift with your viewpoint to create an "off-screen" illusion. Twist: put the other person's video from another computer into this 3D space and make a small "sitting across the table" game.

works.title: Mystery Circle
works.description: For the opening of his exhibition at MOCA Los Angeles, about 40,000 rockets and fireworks mounted on the museum facade fired in sequence, drawing crop-circle patterns in light and smoke.
works.description_zh: 在洛杉矶当代艺术博物馆的展览开幕时，约四万枚火箭烟花安装在博物馆外墙上依次点燃，用光和烟画出麦田怪圈般的图案。
works.idea_en: A building facade can act as a launch surface, not just a screen; AR content that emerges from and returns to real architecture feels more rooted than content floating in front of it.
works.idea_zh: 建筑外立面可以是发射面，而不只是屏幕；从真实建筑里冒出、又回到建筑里的 AR 内容，比悬浮在建筑前面的内容更扎根。
works.technique: Rockets were fixed to a patterned frame on the facade and fired in timed rings so the trails and smoke formed spirals and circles.
works.technique_zh: 火箭固定在外墙上的图案框架上，按圆环分组定时点燃，尾迹和烟雾组成螺旋和圆圈。
works.exercise_en: Detect a building wall with plane detection and launch AR rockets from a circular pattern on it, whose trails leave a spiral that stays on the facade for a minute. Twist: let the pattern be drawn by the audience on a tablet before launch.
works.exercise_zh: 用平面检测识别一面建筑墙，从墙上的圆形图案里发射 AR 火箭，尾迹在外墙上留下一个持续一分钟的螺旋。变体：发射前让观众在平板上自己画出图案。

video.video_title: Cai Guo-Qiang - Rocket Blast Off for Mystery Circle - The Artist's Studio - MOCAtv

works.title: NerdHerder
works.description: A commercial tabletop AR game built with Qualcomm: herd panicking office nerds back to their cubicles by dangling donuts on a printed game board.
works.idea_zh: 在桌面上用甜甜圈引诱慌乱的书呆子回到工位。

video.video_title: NerdHerder Promo

works.technique: Vuforia image tracking of the printed board anchors a Unity game scene, and the phone's pose relative to the board is itself the controller, since the dangled donut follows where the camera points.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity + AR Foundation 中做一个“用手机位置当手柄”的小游戏：手机在图像目标上方的位置决定虚拟诱饵落点，引导虚拟小人走到目标区域；变体：诱饵换成声音或光，比较哪种引导更有趣。
works.description_zh: 与高通合作开发的商业桌面 AR 游戏：在一张印刷游戏板上晃动甜甜圈，把惊慌失措的办公室书呆子们赶回各自的工位。
works.idea_en: Lure panicking nerds back to their desks with a donut on your tabletop.
works.technique_zh: Vuforia 对印刷游戏板进行图像追踪，锚定 Unity 游戏场景；手机相对游戏板的位姿本身就是控制器，因为吊着的甜甜圈会跟随摄像头所指的位置移动。
works.exercise_en: Make a small game in Unity + AR Foundation that uses the phone's position as the controller: where the phone hovers above an image target decides where a virtual lure lands, guiding virtual little people to a goal area. Twist: swap the lure for sound or light, and compare which kind of guidance is more fun.

works.title: NikeFuel Station
works.description: The centrepiece of a London pop-up store turns anyone standing in front of it into a moving multi-pixel avatar that mirrors their body and energy.
works.description_zh: 伦敦一家快闪店的核心装置，把站在它前面的人变成一个由许多像素组成、会镜像其动作和活力的移动化身。
works.idea_en: Your body rebuilt as a cloud of glowing pixels.
works.idea_zh: 你的身体被重建为一团发光的像素。
works.technique: A Kinect captures the visitor's body and depth, and generative software renders it as a pixel-particle avatar on large screens (collaboration with AKQA London).
works.technique_zh: Kinect 捕捉观众的身体和深度，生成式软件在大屏幕上把它渲染成像素粒子化身（与 AKQA London 合作）。
works.exercise_en: Turn a webcam body segmentation into a grid of squares whose brightness follows how fast each body part moves. Twist: the avatar leaves a pixel trail that shows your whole day's activity.
works.exercise_zh: 把摄像头的人体分割变成方块网格，每个方块的亮度跟随对应身体部位的运动速度；变体：化身留下一条像素轨迹，显示你一整天的活动。

video.video_title: NikeFuel Station

works.title: Nikola Tesla in Sound and Light
works.description: Tempest tells the story of Nikola Tesla on a tabletop stage of pop-up paper structures; projection mapping lights up the paper, animates Tesla's inventions and syncs with sound and the performer's actions.
works.description_zh: Tempest 在一个由立体纸雕搭成的桌面舞台上讲述 Nikola Tesla 的故事；投影映射点亮纸雕，让 Tesla 的发明动起来，并与声音和表演者的动作同步。
works.idea_en: A pop-up book becomes a projection-mapped stage for a live magic story.
works.idea_zh: 把立体书变成投影映射的舞台，演一场现场魔术故事。
works.technique: White pop-up paper sculptures are mapped with pre-calibrated projection from an openFrameworks show system, with Arduino-triggered cues keeping the projection in step with the performance.
works.technique_zh: 由 openFrameworks 演出系统对白色立体纸雕做预先校准的投影映射，并用 Arduino 触发的提示让投影与表演同步。
works.exercise_en: Build a small pop-up scene from white paper and projection-map three animated states onto it with a phone projector or cheap projector. Twist: opening or closing a paper flap must switch the scene.
works.exercise_zh: 用白纸做一个小立体场景，用手机投影或廉价投影仪给它映射三种动画状态。变体：打开或合上某个纸片时，场景随之切换。

video.video_title: Nikola Tesla in Sound and Light

works.title: O (Omicron) (with Thomas Vaquié)
works.description: A permanent 360° projection on the concrete dome of Wrocław's Centennial Hall that reveals and reinterprets the ribbed structure of the 1913 building.
works.idea_zh: 用投影揭示一座百年混凝土穹顶的结构之美
works.technique: Multiple calibrated projectors cover the interior dome; content is authored on a 3D model of the rib structure so lines trace the real architecture.
works.exercise_zh: 把一把雨伞或纸圆顶当“穹顶”，用投影沿伞骨画出发光线条动画；变化：让线条沿结构“生长”，模拟建筑建造的过程。

video.video_title: O (Omicron)

works.description_zh: 弗罗茨瓦夫百年厅混凝土穹顶上的一件永久性 360° 投影作品，揭示并重新诠释了这座 1913 年建筑的肋拱结构。
works.idea_en: Use projection to reveal the structural beauty of a century-old concrete dome.
works.technique_zh: 多台经过标定的投影仪覆盖穹顶内侧，内容在肋拱结构的三维模型上制作，使线条能沿着真实建筑的走向描绘。
works.exercise_en: Use an umbrella or a paper dome as the "dome" and project glowing line animations along its ribs. Twist: make the lines "grow" along the structure to simulate the building being constructed.

works.title: Outdoor Game of Life
works.description: In front of the Albuquerque Museum, block organisms following Conway's Game of Life battle for the virtual space, visible through phones.
works.description_zh: 在阿尔伯克基博物馆门前，按照康威生命游戏规则演化的方块生物争夺虚拟空间，透过手机可见。
works.idea_en: A cellular automaton living on a real plaza.
works.idea_zh: 一个生活在真实广场上的元胞自动机。
works.technique: A server steps a Game of Life grid and publishes live cells as geolocated blocks in the Layar browser over the museum forecourt.
works.technique_zh: 服务器逐步运算生命游戏网格，把存活的格子作为地理定位的方块，发布到博物馆前广场上空的 Layar 浏览器中。
works.exercise_en: Run Conway's Game of Life on a grid anchored to a floor with plane detection, and let users tap to seed cells. Twist: two teams' colours compete for territory.
works.exercise_zh: 借助平面检测，在地面锚定的网格上运行康威生命游戏，用户点击就能播种细胞。变体：两队颜色互相争夺领地。

video.video_title: outdoor Game of Life  (augmented reality)

works.title: Painting with a Digital Brush
works.description: An ASCII-art image is painted into physical space in long-exposure photographs: a light stick moved across the room displays characters that build up the picture in mid-air.
works.description_zh: 在长曝光照片中把 ASCII 字符画“画”进真实空间：一根光棒在房间中移动，显示的字符在空中逐步拼出图像。
works.idea_en: Free ASCII art from the screen and paint it into the air with light.
works.idea_zh: 让 ASCII 艺术离开屏幕，用光画在空气里。
works.technique: The image is converted to characters and played column by column on an LED strip whose position is synchronized with the camera's long exposure.
works.technique_zh: 把图像转成字符，按列在 LED 灯条上播放，并让灯条位置与相机的长曝光同步。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone screen as a brush: show one slice of an image at a time while walking in front of a long-exposure camera. Twist: paint a message that is only readable from one position in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机屏幕当画笔：在长曝光相机前边走边一次显示图像的一条切片。变体：画一句只有从房间某个位置才能读出来的话。

video.video_title: Painting with a Digital Brush

works.title: Parking Lot Decorator
works.description: For the ZERO1 Biennial, the huge, dull parking lots around Silicon Valley tech campuses can be decorated with fantastic colour through a phone.
works.description_zh: 在 ZERO1 双年展上，硅谷科技园区周围巨大而乏味的停车场，可以通过手机被装点上奇幻的色彩。
works.idea_en: Let anyone repaint the most boring corporate space.
works.idea_zh: 让任何人都能重新粉刷最无聊的企业空间。
works.technique: Colourful patterns and objects are geolocated over large parking-lot areas in a mobile AR browser, with viewers choosing which decorations appear.
works.technique_zh: 在移动 AR 浏览器中，把彩色图案和物件定位在大片停车场上空，由观众选择出现哪些装饰。
works.exercise_en: Use plane detection to let users paint giant patterns onto a parking lot or empty plaza in AR. Twist: the patterns are generated from the car colours the camera sees.
works.exercise_zh: 用平面检测让用户在停车场或空旷广场上用 AR 涂出巨大的图案。变体：图案根据相机看到的汽车颜色自动生成。

video.video_title: Parking Lot Decorator

works.title: PixelPyros
works.description: A 20-metre projected fireworks display where the audience launches every rocket by waving a hand over sensors along the bottom of the screen; up to thirty people play at once.
works.description_zh: 一场 20 米宽的投影烟花秀，每一枚烟花都由观众在屏幕底部的传感器上挥手发射；最多三十人同时参与。
works.idea_en: Wave your hand and a firework launches from that spot; the crowd choreographs the show.
works.idea_zh: 在哪里挥手，哪里就升起一枚烟花；整场烟花由人群编排。
works.technique: Motion sensing along the base of the screen (likely camera-based in the original openFrameworks version) maps each hand position to a launch point, and particle fireworks are projected with high-power projectors and lasers.
works.technique_zh: 屏幕底部的动作感应（最初的 openFrameworks 版本很可能用摄像头）把每只手的位置对应到一个发射点，粒子烟花由大功率投影仪和激光投出。
works.exercise_en: Project a row of launch pads on a wall and use a webcam to detect hands passing over them; each detection fires a particle firework. Twist: fireworks launched within one second of each other combine into a bigger one.
works.exercise_zh: 在墙上投一排发射台，用摄像头检测手掠过，每次检测发射一枚粒子烟花。变体：一秒内相继发射的烟花会合并成更大的一朵。

video.video_title: PixelPyros official video

salient.why_en: Wave your hand and a firework launches from that exact spot.
salient.why_zh: 在哪儿挥手，哪儿就升起一枚烟花。

works.title: Playing it Real: Magic Lens Games in a Public Space
works.description: Players hunt cartoon monsters on a large printed poster in a public place, either looking through the phone as a magic lens over the poster or using a static peephole view on screen, and the study compares how people choose to play.
works.description_zh: 玩家在公共场所的大幅海报上捕捉卡通怪物，可以把手机当作“魔镜”对准海报透视观看，也可以使用屏幕上的静态窥视视图，研究比较人们会怎样选择玩法。
works.idea_en: Turn a public poster into a game board you play through your phone.
works.idea_zh: 把公共场所的海报变成一张要透过手机来玩的游戏棋盘。
works.technique: Natural-feature tracking registers the phone to the printed poster so game sprites appear in place, compared with an untracked peephole mode that scrolls the same content on screen.
works.technique_zh: 自然特征追踪把手机与印刷海报配准，使游戏角色出现在海报的对应位置；对照的窥视模式不做追踪，只在屏幕上滚动同一内容。
works.exercise_en: Print an A1 poster and build an image-tracking AR game where creatures hide in parts of the illustration and must be tapped through the phone. Twist: the creatures flee toward whichever part of the poster nobody is looking at.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一张 A1 海报，做一个图像追踪 AR 游戏：小怪物藏在插画的各个角落，要透过手机点中它们。变体：怪物会逃向没人在看的海报区域。

video.video_title: Magic Lens and Static Peephole Interfaces for Games in a Public Space

works.title: Punch a Doom Character in AR
works.description: A browser mini-game in which you punch a Doom monster that appears in your webcam view.
works.idea_zh: 对着摄像头挥拳，打浏览器里的 Doom 怪物。

video.video_title: Punch a Doom Character in Augmented Reality

works.technique: Frame differencing (motion detection) in regions of the webcam image registers punches at the monster's screen position, rendered in three.js over the video.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 做摄像头帧差检测，在画面某区域检测到大幅运动时让怪物被击飞；变体：怪物会躲闪，需要从不同方向出拳。
works.description_zh: 一款浏览器小游戏，你要挥拳击打出现在网络摄像头画面中的 Doom 怪物。
works.idea_en: Throw punches at the camera to hit a Doom monster in the browser.
works.technique_zh: 在网络摄像头画面的若干区域中进行帧差（运动检测），在怪物所在的屏幕位置判定出拳，并用 three.js 把怪物渲染在视频之上。
works.exercise_en: Build camera frame differencing in p5.js so the monster gets knocked flying when a big motion is detected in a certain region of the frame. Twist: the monster dodges, so you have to punch from different directions.

works.title: REVEL
works.description: Olivier Bau and Ivan Poupyrev's reverse electrovibration injects a tiny signal into the user's body so that projected or AR virtual objects on real surfaces gain touchable textures.
works.idea_zh: 往人体里注入微弱信号，让投影出的虚拟物体摸起来有纹理。

video.video_title: Revel: Programming the Sense of Touch

works.technique: Reverse electrovibration injects a weak time-varying electrical signal into the user's body, creating an oscillating electrostatic attraction between the sliding finger and any grounded conductive surface, which is perceived as texture and can be modulated per virtual object.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机震动（Vibration API 或 Unity Handheld.Vibrate）在 AR 中模拟触感纹理：手指划过不同虚拟物体时播放不同频率和节奏的震动（REVEL 的电刺激不适合课堂复现）；变体：让同学闭眼仅凭震动猜出是哪种材质。
works.description_zh: Olivier Bau 和 Ivan Poupyrev 提出的反向电振动技术，向用户身体注入一个微弱信号，让真实表面上投影或 AR 呈现的虚拟物体拥有可以触摸到的纹理。
works.idea_en: Send a faint signal through the body so projected virtual objects have texture you can feel.
works.technique_zh: 反向电振动向用户身体注入微弱的时变电信号，在滑动的手指与任意接地的导电表面之间产生振荡的静电吸引力，被感知为纹理，并可针对每个虚拟物体分别调制。
works.exercise_en: Simulate tactile textures in AR with phone vibration (the Vibration API or Unity Handheld.Vibrate): play vibrations of different frequencies and rhythms as a finger slides over different virtual objects (REVEL's electrical stimulation is not suitable to reproduce in class). Twist: have classmates close their eyes and guess the material from the vibration alone.

works.title: Rain Room
works.description: A 100 m² field of continuously falling water pauses wherever a person walks, so visitors move through rain without getting wet.
works.idea_zh: 在一场只为你停下的雨中行走
works.technique: 3D cameras track visitors from above and a grid of solenoid valves shuts off the water tiles directly around each person in real time.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头俯拍+地面投影做“虚拟雨”，雨点在人周围自动避开；变化：用电磁阀或小水泵做一个1米见方的实体原型。

video.video_title: Random International: Rain Room

works.description_zh: 一片 100 平方米、持续降落的水幕，人走到哪里，哪里的雨就会停下，观众得以在雨中穿行而不被淋湿。
works.idea_en: Walk through rain that stops just for you.
works.technique_zh: 3D 相机从上方追踪观众，由电磁阀组成的网格实时关闭每个人周围那几块区域的水流。
works.exercise_en: Make "virtual rain" with an overhead camera and floor projection, so raindrops automatically avoid the area around each person. Twist: build a one-meter-square physical prototype with solenoid valves or a small water pump.

salient.why_en: Rain falls everywhere except on you, so your body becomes the one dry spot in a storm.
salient.why_zh: 雨处处落下，唯独避开你，你的身体成了暴雨中唯一干燥的地方。

works.title: Reality Fighters
works.description: A PS Vita launch title in which players put their own photographed face on a fighter and brawl in AR on their real surroundings, filmed by the Vita's rear camera.
works.idea_zh: 把自己的脸贴到格斗角色上，在真实街道或客厅里AR对打。

video.video_title: Reality Fighters™ PS Vita Trailer

works.technique: A photographed face is mapped onto a fighter's head, and the characters are rendered over the rear camera feed anchored by an AR card.
works.exercise_zh: 用前置摄像头拍脸贴到 AR 格斗小人头上，在桌面上和同学的小人对打；变体：打输的一方脸部贴图会出现“伤痕”。
works.description_zh: PS Vita 的首发游戏之一：玩家把自己拍下的脸贴到格斗角色身上，在 Vita 后置摄像头拍到的真实环境中进行 AR 对打。
works.idea_en: Put your own face on a fighter and brawl in AR in a real street or living room.
works.technique_zh: 把拍下的人脸映射到格斗角色的头部，角色以 AR 卡片为锚点，渲染在后置摄像头的画面之上。
works.exercise_en: Take a photo of your face with the front camera, paste it onto the head of a tiny AR fighter, and fight a classmate's fighter on the table. Twist: the loser's face texture shows "scars".

works.title: Richard Long at The Hepworth Wakefield
works.description: Behind the scenes of Long's exhibition at The Hepworth Wakefield: stones laid out in large floor works and mud applied by hand directly to the walls.
works.description_zh: Long 在 Hepworth Wakefield 美术馆展览的幕后：石块在地面上铺成大型作品，泥浆被直接用手涂抹在墙上。
works.idea_en: Bringing a walk's materials indoors as a precise floor pattern shows how an outdoor trace can be translated into a room-scale layout, as AR can do.
works.idea_zh: 把行走中的材料带入室内，铺成精确的地面图案，说明户外轨迹可以转译成房间尺度的布局，AR 也能这样做。
works.technique: Stones are sorted and placed by hand following a simple geometry, and mud is applied to walls with the hands in rhythmic strokes.
works.technique_zh: 石块按简单几何手工分类摆放，泥浆则用手有节奏地抹到墙上。
works.exercise_en: Record a walk outdoors as a GPS track, then in a classroom lay it out at room scale in AR as a line of stones on the floor. Twist: add muddy hand-prints on the real walls in AR at the points where you stopped.
works.exercise_zh: 在户外把一次行走记录为 GPS 轨迹，然后在教室里用 AR 按房间尺度把它铺成地面上的一列石头；变体：在你停下的位置，用 AR 在真实墙面上印上泥手印。

video.video_title: Behind the scenes Richard Long at The Hepworth Wakefield

works.title: Robot Readable World
works.description: A short film assembled from computer-vision research footage: tracking boxes, feature points, depth maps and labels show how machines see streets, faces and objects.
works.description_zh: 一部由计算机视觉研究影像剪成的短片：追踪框、特征点、深度图和标签展示了机器如何“看见”街道、人脸和物体。
works.idea_en: The machine's view is itself a visual language; exposing tracking points and meshes can be a deliberate AR aesthetic instead of a debug mode.
works.idea_zh: 机器的视角本身就是一种视觉语言；把追踪点和网格暴露出来，可以是一种有意为之的 AR 美学，而不只是调试模式。
works.technique: Found footage from computer-vision demos, with overlays of feature detection, segmentation and tracking, edited into a single film.
works.technique_zh: 把计算机视觉演示中的现有影像（带特征检测、分割和追踪的叠加）剪辑成一部影片。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR filter that renders only the debug layers of AR tracking — feature points, plane meshes, depth — as the main visual style, and film a walk through a building with it. Twist: let the mesh age and fade so the machine's memory of the room becomes visible.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 滤镜，只把 AR 追踪的调试层——特征点、平面网格、深度——当作主要视觉风格来渲染，并用它拍一段在建筑中穿行的视频；变体：让网格随时间老化褪色，把机器对房间的“记忆”显现出来。

video.video_title: Robot readable world

works.title: SENSE #1
works.description: An interactive light mural and sculpture that doubles as a clock, lighting up in response to people passing and to the time of day.
works.description_zh: 一件互动的光壁画兼雕塑，同时也是一座时钟，会随路人经过和一天中的时间而亮起。
works.idea_en: Combining ambient information (time) with response to presence makes a public piece useful and playful at once, a good pattern for civic AR.
works.idea_zh: 把环境信息（时间）与对人的回应结合，让公共作品既有用又好玩，是城市 AR 的好模式。
works.technique: Presence sensors trigger light sequences while a clock logic shifts the base pattern through the day (details not documented; likely motion sensors).
works.technique_zh: 存在感应器触发灯光序列，时钟逻辑则让基础图案随时间推移变化（细节未公开，可能是运动传感器）。
works.exercise_en: Anchor an AR clock to a real wall whose hands are made of light particles that scatter when someone walks by. Twist: let the particles reassemble a little slower each hour.
works.exercise_zh: 在真墙上锚定一个 AR 时钟，指针由光粒子组成，有人走过时粒子散开。变体：每过一小时，粒子重新聚合得更慢一点。

video.video_title: Ralfonso - SENSE #1 - Interactive Light & Clock Mural and Sculpture

works.title: SENSESCAPES
works.description: A 360-degree room at the Grassi Museum in Leipzig where visitors call up graphic interpretations of design epochs from Art Nouveau to today, then shape and sound them with their movement.
works.description_zh: 莱比锡 Grassi 应用艺术博物馆里的一个 360 度房间：观众可以唤出从新艺术运动到当代各个设计时期的图形诠释，并用自己的动作改变它们的形态和声音。
works.idea_en: Stir a design epoch with your body.
works.idea_zh: 用身体去搅动一个设计时代。
works.technique: Four infrared cameras track visitors, and vvvv on five PCs drives eight projectors around the room, changing graphics and sound according to people's positions.
works.technique_zh: 四台红外摄像头追踪观众，五台电脑上的 vvvv 驱动房间四周的八台投影仪，根据人的位置改变图形和声音。
works.exercise_en: Pick three visual styles (for example Art Nouveau curves, Bauhaus blocks, pixel art) and let each corner of the room project one of them, blending as a tracked person walks between corners. Twist: the style mixes when two people stand in different corners.
works.exercise_zh: 选三种视觉风格（比如新艺术运动的曲线、包豪斯的方块、像素画），让房间的每个角落各投影一种，被追踪的人在角落之间走动时风格随之渐变；变体：两个人站在不同角落时，风格会混合。

video.video_title: SENSESCAPES

works.title: SLAM Computer Vision Tank: See Through Walls
works.description: At Augmented Reality Event 2012, an iPhone mapped a real wall and street with markerless SLAM, and a virtual tank blasted holes through it that revealed a virtual world behind.
works.description_zh: 在 2012 年 Augmented Reality Event 上，一部 iPhone 用无标记 SLAM 建立了真实墙面和街道的地图，一辆虚拟坦克在墙上炸出洞，露出墙后的虚拟世界。
works.idea_en: Blast a hole in a real wall and peek into the world behind it.
works.idea_zh: 在真实墙上炸出一个洞，窥看墙后的世界。
works.technique: Markerless monocular SLAM (credited to Robert Castle's PTAM-style work) estimates the wall plane, and depth-masked holes render the virtual scene behind it.
works.technique_zh: 无标记单目 SLAM（致谢 Robert Castle 的 PTAM 类工作）估计墙面平面，再用深度遮罩的洞口渲染墙后的虚拟场景。
works.exercise_en: Detect a vertical plane and let each tap punch a circular hole that reveals a different virtual room behind the wall. Twist: holes slowly heal over unless the player keeps looking at them.
works.exercise_zh: 检测一个竖直平面，每次点击就打出一个圆洞，露出墙后不同的虚拟房间。变体：除非玩家一直盯着看，否则洞会慢慢愈合。

video.video_title: SLAM Computer Vision Tank: See Through Walls

works.title: Sagrada Familia - Ode à la Vie
works.description: A monumental projection-mapping show on Gaudí's Sagrada Família façade for La Mercè festival, making the stone appear to grow, flood and bloom.
works.idea_zh: 让圣家堂石墙生长、涌流、开花的投影秀

video.video_title: Sagrada Familia, Barcelona | Ode à la Vie Light & Sound Show

works.technique: Large-scale multi-projector architectural mapping with edge blending, using a detailed 3D model of the facade to render growth and flooding effects that respect its relief.
works.exercise_zh: 用一件有浮雕或复杂表面的物体（石膏像、雕花盒）做投影，让表面看起来在生长、被水淹没或开花；变体：表达这个物体“内心”的一段情绪。
works.description_zh: 在梅尔塞节（La Mercè）期间，于高迪的圣家堂立面上上演的一场宏大投影映射秀，让石墙看起来在生长、涌流、开花。
works.idea_en: A projection show that makes the stone walls of the Sagrada Família grow, flood and bloom.
works.technique_zh: 采用多投影仪边缘融合的大型建筑投影映射，借助精细的立面三维模型渲染生长与水流效果，并与其浮雕起伏精确贴合。
works.exercise_en: Project onto an object with relief or a complex surface (a plaster bust, a carved box) so its surface seems to grow, flood or bloom. Twist: express an emotion from the object's "inner life".

works.title: Second Surface
works.description: Shunichi Kasahara, Valentin Heun and Austin Lee let several people draw and leave notes on real surfaces around them through tablets; the drawings stay anchored in space for others to see.
works.idea_zh: 多人在真实物体表面上共同涂鸦留言，内容留在原地供他人发现。

video.video_title: SECOND SURFACE: MULTI-USER SPATIAL COLLABORATION SYSTEM BASED ON AUGMENTED REALITY (IN COLLABORATION WITH TANGIBLE MEDIA GROUP)

works.technique: Natural feature tracking of the surface texture gives each tablet a 6DOF pose relative to the same physical surface, so strokes stored in surface coordinates are shared over the network and rendered from every viewpoint.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 的共享锚点（或同一张图像目标）让两部手机看到同一块墙面，在上面画画留言并实时同步；变体：留言只有在特定时间或特定人靠近时才会出现。
works.description_zh: Shunichi Kasahara、Valentin Heun 和 Austin Lee 让多人通过平板在身边的真实表面上画画、留言，这些涂鸦会固定在空间中，供其他人看到。
works.idea_en: Several people doodle and leave notes on real surfaces, and the notes stay put for others to find.
works.technique_zh: 对表面纹理进行自然特征追踪，为每台平板计算相对于同一实体表面的 6DOF 位姿；笔画以表面坐标存储并通过网络共享，从每个视角都能正确渲染。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation shared anchors (or the same image target) so two phones see the same wall, then draw and leave messages on it that sync in real time. Twist: messages only appear at a certain time or when a certain person comes near.

works.title: Sibyl
works.description: For the Sydney Biennale, a suspended cloud of lace-like meshes, glass flasks and lights shivers and pulses in response to visitors below.
works.description_zh: 为悉尼双年展制作的一团悬浮的蕾丝状网格云，挂着玻璃烧瓶和灯，会随下方观众而颤动、闪烁。
works.idea_en: A suspended form that trembles when you look up at it shows how overhead space — often ignored in AR — can host responsive content.
works.idea_zh: 一个你抬头看它就会颤动的悬浮形体，说明头顶的空间（AR 常常忽略的地方）也可以放置会回应的内容。
works.technique: A mesh of laser-cut components is threaded with sensors, LEDs and shape-memory actuators controlled by a networked set of microcontrollers.
works.technique_zh: 激光切割的构件编成网格，穿插着传感器、LED 和形状记忆执行器，由联网的一组微控制器控制。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a floating AR lattice above the viewer's head and make its nodes flicker and sag toward whoever is directly below. Twist: let two viewers' positions create interference patterns in the lattice.
works.exercise_zh: 在观众头顶锚定一个漂浮的 AR 网格，让它的节点朝正下方的人闪烁、下垂。变体：让两位观众的位置在网格里形成干涉图案。

video.video_title: Sibyl | Sydney Biennale, 2012

works.title: Sirènes Sylvestres
works.description: A night walk through the woods where small lights hidden in the trees switch on as walkers approach, luring them step by step off the lit path and deeper into the forest.
works.description_zh: 一场夜间森林漫步：藏在树间的小灯会在行人走近时亮起，一步步把人从有灯的小路上引开，走进森林深处。
works.idea_en: Lights that wake up as you come near and lead you into the dark.
works.idea_zh: 你一走近就亮起来的灯，把你引入黑暗。
works.technique: Autonomous light and motion-sensor modules are placed along a path in the forest; each module lights up when someone enters its range, forming a progressive trail.
works.technique_zh: 把自带灯和运动传感器的模块沿路线放在林中；有人进入感应范围时模块就亮起，连成一条逐步显现的光路。
works.exercise_en: Place five phones or PIR-sensor lamps along a school corridor or garden path so each lights up when someone passes and guides them to a hidden spot. Twist: the lights switch off behind you so you cannot go back.
works.exercise_zh: 在学校走廊或花园小路上放五部手机或带人体感应的小灯，有人经过就亮起，把他们引到一个隐藏的地点；变体：灯在你身后熄灭，让你无法回头。

video.video_title: Sirènes Sylvestres, a progressive light path through the woods

works.title: Skataviz
works.description: An iPhone attached to a skateboard records its motion and visualizes the board's rotation and tricks as 3D data augmented over live video of the run.
works.idea_zh: 滑板上绑手机，把翻板动作变成叠加在视频上的三维数据轨迹。

video.video_title: Skataviz - Prototype

works.technique: The phone's gyroscope and accelerometer are fused (IMU sensor fusion) into an orientation stream that animates a 3D board model and data traces overlaid on synchronized video.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机网页的 DeviceOrientation 接口把手机绑在滑板、自行车或者篮球上，记录转动并在视频上叠加一个 3D 轨迹；变体：把数据可视化成一只动物，让它在做动作时“叫”出来。
works.description_zh: 把一部 iPhone 固定在滑板上记录运动，并把滑板的旋转和花式动作以三维数据的形式可视化，叠加在滑行过程的实拍视频上。
works.idea_en: Strap a phone to a skateboard and turn board flips into 3D data trails over the video.
works.technique_zh: 对手机的陀螺仪和加速度计进行融合（IMU 传感器融合），得到姿态数据流，驱动三维滑板模型和数据轨迹，并叠加在同步的视频上。
works.exercise_en: Strap a phone to a skateboard, bicycle or basketball, use the DeviceOrientation API in a web page to record its rotation, and overlay a 3D trail on the video. Twist: visualize the data as an animal that "calls out" when a trick happens.

works.title: Skywrite AR: Ceci n'est pas une pipe
works.description: Over the Louvre and Notre Dame, Magritte's phrase 'Ceci n'est pas une pipe' is written across the sky in AR smoke letters.
works.description_zh: 在卢浮宫和巴黎圣母院上空，马格利特的名句“这不是一只烟斗”以 AR 烟雾字母写在天上。
works.idea_en: Skywriting without a plane: a message in the sky only phones can read.
works.idea_zh: 不用飞机的空中写字：只有手机能读到的天空留言。
works.technique: Text is rendered as smoky 3D letters and placed high above landmark coordinates as geolocated points of interest in a mobile AR browser.
works.technique_zh: 把文字渲染成烟雾状 3D 字母，作为地理定位兴趣点放在地标坐标的高空，通过移动 AR 浏览器观看。
works.exercise_en: Write a one-line statement as AR skywriting above a campus building using sky segmentation or a far-anchored object. Twist: the letters slowly drift and dissolve like real smoke.
works.exercise_zh: 用天空分割或远处锚定的物体，在校园建筑上空写一句 AR 空中文字。变体：字母像真正的烟一样慢慢飘散。

video.video_title: "Ceci n'est pas une pipe," Skywrite AR at the Louvre

works.title: SnapAR
works.description: Take virtual snapshots of a scene from different viewpoints on a handheld AR device and switch between them instantly instead of walking around.
works.idea_zh: 给场景拍几张'AR快照'，之后瞬间切换视角而不用来回走动。

video.video_title: SnapAR: Quick Viewpoint Switching for Hand-Held Augmented Reality Using Virtual Snapshots

works.technique: The handheld stores tracked camera images with their poses as snapshots, and the user switches the displayed view to a stored snapshot (with live AR overlays re-rendered for that pose) instead of physically walking to it.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中实现“存视角”按钮：保存当前相机截图和位姿，之后点击缩略图即可切换到该视角查看虚拟物体；变体：用这些快照做一个多视角“AR 对比图”说明作品。
works.description_zh: 在手持 AR 设备上从不同视角为场景拍下虚拟快照，之后无需来回走动，就能在这些视角之间即时切换。
works.idea_en: Take a few AR snapshots of a scene, then jump between viewpoints without walking around.
works.technique_zh: 手持设备把追踪到的相机图像连同位姿保存为快照，用户可以把显示画面切换到某张已存快照（并针对该位姿重新渲染实时 AR 叠加），而不必亲自走到那个位置。
works.exercise_en: Implement a "save viewpoint" button in AR Foundation that stores the current camera image and pose, so tapping a thumbnail later switches to that viewpoint to view the virtual objects. Twist: use these snapshots to make a multi-view "AR comparison sheet" that explains a piece of work.

works.title: Spider Projection / Araneola
works.description: Giant spiders seem to crawl inside a building in Saarbrücken, pressing against the windows from within. In fact two small spiders were filmed in a scale model of the building and the footage was projected from inside onto the window panes.
works.description_zh: 巨大的蜘蛛仿佛在萨尔布吕肯一栋楼里爬行，从里面贴着窗户移动。其实是两只小蜘蛛在这栋楼的缩尺模型里被拍摄下来，再从室内把影像投到窗玻璃上。
works.idea_en: Filming something real at miniature scale and projecting it at building scale creates a believable giant; matching scale and viewpoint matters more than polish.
works.idea_zh: 把真实的东西在微缩尺度下拍摄，再按建筑尺度投出来，就能造出可信的巨物；尺度和视点一致比画面精致更重要。
works.technique: Live spiders were placed in a scale model and filmed from the street viewer's perspective, then rear-projected onto diffused windows so the scale and angle line up with the real façade.
works.technique_zh: 把活蜘蛛放进缩尺模型，从街上观众的视角拍摄，再从内部背投到做过漫射处理的窗户上，让尺度和角度与真实立面对齐。
works.exercise_en: Film a small toy or insect on a tabletop with a phone, key out the background, and place the clip as a giant video plane behind a real window using AR Foundation or Lens Studio with occlusion from the window frame. Twist: the creature reacts when a viewer steps into the camera's view.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机在桌面上拍一个小玩具或昆虫，抠掉背景，然后用 AR Foundation 或 Lens Studio 把这段视频做成巨大的视频平面，放在真实窗户后面，并用窗框做遮挡；变体：当有人走进镜头时，这个生物会作出反应。

video.video_title: Spider Projection / Araneola

works.title: Spirit Camera: The Cursed Memoir
works.description: A Fatal Frame spin-off co-developed with Koei Tecmo: the 3DS becomes the haunted Camera Obscura, and a bundled cursed diary reveals ghosts that appear in your real room.
works.idea_zh: 3DS变成一台能拍到鬼的相机，随附的日记本在AR中显出幽灵。

video.video_title: Nintendo 3DS - Spirit Camera: The Cursed Memoir Launch Trailer

works.technique: Pages in a printed booklet act as image targets that trigger story events, while gyroscope-based aiming lets ghosts appear around the player in the camera view.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一本几页的纸质“诅咒日记”，每页扫描后触发一段 AR 鬼影或声音；变体：只能在熄灯时（摄像头亮度低时）看到鬼影。
works.description_zh: 与光荣特库摩（Koei Tecmo）共同开发的《零》系列外传：3DS 变成闹鬼的射影机，随游戏附赠的诅咒日记会让幽灵出现在你真实的房间里。
works.idea_en: The 3DS becomes a camera that can photograph ghosts, and the bundled diary reveals them in AR.
works.technique_zh: 印刷小册子的各页作为图像目标触发剧情事件，同时基于陀螺仪的瞄准让幽灵出现在摄像头画面中玩家的四周。
works.exercise_en: Make a paper "cursed diary" of a few pages, where scanning each page triggers an AR ghost or a sound. Twist: the ghosts can only be seen with the lights off (when camera brightness is low).

works.title: Starfield
works.description: A visitor sits on a real swing in front of a projection. As they swing back and forth, they fly through a galaxy of stars whose motion follows the rhythm of their body.
works.description_zh: 观众坐在投影前一架真实的秋千上。随着秋千前后摆动，他们在一片星空中穿行，星星的运动跟着身体的节奏走。
works.idea_en: A playground swing becomes a spaceship.
works.idea_zh: 游乐场的秋千变成了一艘宇宙飞船。
works.technique: A Kinect behind the swing tracks its position, and an openFrameworks app maps the swing's arc to the camera's forward speed through a particle starfield, with an optional anaglyph 3D mode.
works.technique_zh: 秋千后方的 Kinect 追踪秋千位置，openFrameworks 程序把秋千的摆动弧线映射为镜头在粒子星空中的前进速度，并可切换到红蓝立体 3D 模式。
works.exercise_en: Track a swinging object (a pendulum, a chair on a rope or a student on a swing) with a webcam or phone accelerometer and drive a starfield in p5.js or Unity with its speed. Twist: the stars only move while two people swing in sync.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头或手机加速度计追踪一个摆动的物体（摆锤、吊起的椅子或荡秋千的同学），用它的速度驱动 p5.js 或 Unity 里的星空；变体：只有两个人同步摆动时星星才会动。

video.video_title: Starfield

works.title: Stars (Skyway Festival, Toruń)
works.description: A 3D mapping for the Skyway light festival in Toruń, Poland, on the facade of the Collegium Maximum: the building fills with stars, constellations and the city's own 'stars' of culture and history, a nod to Toruń's most famous son, Copernicus.
works.description_zh: 为波兰托伦 Skyway 灯光节在 Collegium Maximum 立面上创作的 3D 投影：建筑里满是星星、星座和这座城市文化历史中的“明星”，也致敬了托伦最著名的人物哥白尼。
works.idea_en: Linking a building to the local story (here, astronomy in Copernicus's city) gives abstract visuals a reason to be on that exact wall; AR content also works best when it is site-specific.
works.idea_zh: 把建筑和本地故事（这里是哥白尼故乡的天文学）连在一起，让抽象画面有了出现在那面墙上的理由；AR 内容也同样是在场地专属时效果最好。
works.technique: A 3D model of the facade is animated with star fields and architectural deformations and projected in alignment from the square.
works.technique_zh: 在立面三维模型上制作星空和建筑变形动画，从广场上对齐投影。
works.exercise_en: Research one local story about a building on campus and make a 60-second AR scene in Adobe Aero or Lens Studio that plays on its facade. Twist: the scene only unlocks at night, using the camera's light level.
works.exercise_zh: 研究校园里某栋建筑的一个本地故事，用 Adobe Aero 或 Lens Studio 做一段在它立面上播放的 60 秒 AR 场景；变体：借助摄像头的亮度判断，只有夜里才会解锁。

video.video_title: Stars, 3D Projection Mapping for Skyway, Toruń, Poland, 2012, Official Video

works.title: Stereoscopic 3D mapping, Museum of Art and History (Mapping Festival Geneva)
works.description: The audience wears 3D glasses while the museum facade seems to push out toward them and fold open in true stereoscopic depth, ending in an interactive epilogue; the soundtrack is by Alva Noto.
works.description_zh: 观众戴上 3D 眼镜，博物馆立面仿佛朝他们推出来、再以真正的立体纵深折叠打开，最后是一段互动尾声；配乐来自 Alva Noto。
works.idea_en: Adding stereo depth to a building projection makes content leave the surface and occupy the air in front of it, which is what a head-worn AR display does by default.
works.idea_zh: 给建筑投影加上立体纵深，内容就离开墙面、占据墙前的空气——而这正是头戴式 AR 显示器的默认能力。
works.technique: Two projector sets with polarizing or shutter filters project left- and right-eye images mapped to the facade, viewed through 3D glasses (Bordos with Ivo Kovacs, Daniel Szalko and Andras Miklos Balogh).
works.technique_zh: 两组加了偏振或快门滤镜的投影机分别投出映射到立面上的左眼和右眼图像，观众通过 3D 眼镜观看（Bordos 与 Ivo Kovacs、Daniel Szalko、Andras Miklos Balogh 合作）。
works.exercise_en: Model a simple box facade, then in WebXR or HoloKit render geometry that grows out of the real wall toward the viewer in stereo. Twist: compare the same scene on a flat phone screen and in stereo and list what only stereo can do.
works.exercise_zh: 给一面墙建一个简单的立方体立面模型，再用 WebXR 或 HoloKit 以立体方式渲染从真实墙面朝观众长出来的几何体；变体：把同一场景分别放在平面手机屏幕和立体显示中，列出只有立体才能做到的事。

video.video_title: Stereo 3d mapping at Mapping Festival 2012 Geneva - OFFICIAL VIDEO (with the interactive epilogue)

works.title: Stop-iT
works.description: Visitors stick coloured post-it notes on a wall to compose music. Each colour is an instrument, the height of a note sets its pitch, and the melody loops while people rearrange it.
works.description_zh: 观众把彩色便利贴贴在墙上来作曲。每种颜色是一种乐器，贴的高度决定音高，旋律循环播放，大家可以随时重新排列。
works.idea_en: A wall of post-it notes is a music sequencer.
works.idea_zh: 一面贴满便利贴的墙就是一台音序器。
works.technique: A camera analyses the wall in real time, detects each note's colour and position, and an openFrameworks app turns the grid into MIDI loops.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头实时分析墙面，识别每张便利贴的颜色和位置，openFrameworks 程序把这个网格转换成循环播放的 MIDI 音乐。
works.exercise_en: Point a phone or webcam at a sheet of paper, detect coloured stickers with simple colour thresholding, and play a step sequence with Tone.js. Twist: use food on a plate instead of stickers.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机或摄像头对着一张纸，用简单的颜色阈值识别彩色贴纸，再用 Tone.js 播放步进音序；变体：把贴纸换成盘子里的食物。

video.video_title: Stop-iT

works.title: Super Mario Brush
works.description: Children draw a Super Mario level on paper with coloured pads for ground, blocks and enemies; a camera reads the drawing and the projected game becomes playable on top of it.
works.description_zh: 孩子们用代表地面、砖块和敌人的彩色贴片在纸上“画”出一关 Super Mario，摄像头识别后，投影出来的游戏就能直接在这张纸上玩。
works.idea_en: A paper drawing becomes a playable video game level.
works.idea_zh: 一张纸上的画变成可以玩的游戏关卡。
works.technique: A camera above the table segments the coloured pads by colour, converts them into tile types of a Mario-style level and projects the running game back onto the paper (made with Béatrice Lartigue for Lab212).
works.technique_zh: 桌子上方的摄像头按颜色识别彩色贴片，转换成马里奥式关卡中的不同方块类型，再把运行中的游戏投影回纸面（与 Béatrice Lartigue 以 Lab212 名义合作）。
works.exercise_en: Build a projector-and-webcam setup where red paper becomes lava and blue paper becomes platforms in a simple p5.js platformer. Twist: let a second player change the level by moving paper while the first is playing.
works.exercise_zh: 用投影仪和摄像头搭一个装置，在简单的 p5.js 平台游戏中，红纸变成岩浆、蓝纸变成平台；变体：让第二个玩家在第一个人玩的时候移动纸片改变关卡。

video.video_title: Super Mario Brush — Paper Video Game

salient.why_en: A Super Mario level drawn by a child on paper becomes the level Mario actually runs on.
salient.why_zh: 孩子在纸上画的超级马里奥关卡，直接变成马里奥真正在上面跑的关卡。

works.title: T(ether)
works.description: Spatially-aware tablets act as windows into a shared 3D scene above a table; several users sculpt and animate virtual objects with gestures behind the screens.
works.idea_zh: 多人把平板当作窗口，在桌上方的共享空间里用手捏塑和动画3D物体。

video.video_title: T(ether) – Spatially-Aware Handhelds, Gestures and Proprioception for Multi-User 3D Modeling and Animation

works.technique: Vicon motion capture tracks each iPad and the users' gloved hands, so each tablet renders a correct perspective view into a shared 3D scene and hand positions behind the screen manipulate virtual objects.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 的共享锚点让两三部手机看同一个虚拟雕塑，每部手机当作“窗口”从不同角度观看，并用点击拖动来捏合顶点；变体：每部手机只能看到或编辑雕塑的一部分，必须合作才能完成。
works.description_zh: 具备空间感知能力的平板充当观看桌面上方共享三维场景的窗口；多位用户在屏幕后方用手势雕塑虚拟物体并制作动画。
works.idea_en: Several people use tablets as windows and shape and animate 3D objects by hand in a shared space above a table.
works.technique_zh: Vicon 动作捕捉追踪每台 iPad 和用户戴手套的手，使每台平板都能渲染出进入共享三维场景的正确透视画面，屏幕后方的手部位置则用来操控虚拟物体。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation shared anchors so two or three phones see the same virtual sculpture, each acting as a "window" from a different angle, and pinch vertices by tapping and dragging. Twist: each phone can only see or edit part of the sculpture, so finishing it takes teamwork.

works.title: The Augmented Reality Human Body
works.description: Viewers see their own lungs and heart through the phone in real time; as they slow their breathing, the virtual lungs slow down too.
works.description_zh: 观众透过手机实时看到自己的肺和心脏；当他们放慢呼吸，虚拟的肺也跟着慢下来。
works.idea_en: Biofeedback made visible: see inside your own body and calm it by watching.
works.idea_zh: 把生物反馈可视化：看见自己身体内部，并通过观看让它平静下来。
works.technique: Breathing and heart-rate sensor data drive animated organ models registered to the viewer's torso in mobile AR, built by Skwarek's NYU Polytechnic AR class.
works.technique_zh: 呼吸和心率传感器数据驱动动态器官模型，在移动 AR 中对齐到观众的躯干上；由 Skwarek 在纽约大学理工学院的 AR 课程集体制作。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone camera heart-rate app or a cheap pulse sensor to drive an AR heart placed on a body-tracked chest (Lens Studio or AR Foundation). Twist: two people's hearts try to sync.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机摄像头心率应用或便宜的脉搏传感器，驱动一颗叠加在身体追踪胸口上的 AR 心脏（Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation）。变体：让两个人的心跳尝试同步。

video.video_title: The Augmented Reality Human Body / Mobile App / NYU Polytech

works.title: The Bottomless Pit
works.description: At the ZERO1 Biennial a virtual hole to the other side of the Earth opens in San Jose; the public drops objects through it to reach the antipode.
works.description_zh: 在 ZERO1 双年展上，一个通往地球另一面的虚拟洞口在圣何塞打开，公众可以把东西扔进去，送往地球对面。
works.idea_en: A playful impossible hole links two opposite points on the planet.
works.idea_zh: 一个不可能存在的洞，俏皮地连接起地球上两个相对的点。
works.technique: A geolocated 3D pit is anchored in a mobile AR browser, with a paired augment placed at the antipodal coordinates where dropped objects likely reappear.
works.technique_zh: 在移动 AR 浏览器中锚定一个地理定位的 3D 深坑，并在对跖点坐标放置对应的增强内容，被扔下的物体很可能会在那里出现。
works.exercise_en: Build a floor portal with plane detection that shows a live or recorded view from a partner location far away. Twist: objects thrown in on one phone appear on the other.
works.exercise_zh: 用平面检测在地面做一个“洞口”传送门，里面显示远方合作地点的实时或录制画面。变体：在一部手机上扔进去的物体，会出现在另一部手机上。

video.video_title: Zero 1 Biennial 2012, Seeking Silicon Valley /// The Bottomless Pit

salient.why_en: A virtual hole in a San Jose plaza goes straight through the Earth, and people drop things into it to reach the other side.
salient.why_zh: 圣何塞广场上的一个虚拟洞口直通地球另一端，人们往里扔东西，让它们掉到对跖点。

works.title: The Magic Flute (Die Zauberflöte, with Barrie Kosky)
works.description: Mozart's opera at the Komische Oper Berlin, staged by Barrie Kosky with 1927: singers stand on small revolving doors high in a white wall while animated elephants, spiders and hearts surround them.
works.description_zh: 由 Barrie Kosky 与 1927 在柏林喜歌剧院联合执导的莫扎特歌剧：歌手站在白墙高处的小旋转门里，周围是动画的大象、蜘蛛和心形。
works.idea_en: Pinning performers to fixed points on a projected wall trades freedom for perfect registration, a useful trade-off for AR scenes that must stay aligned.
works.idea_zh: 把演员固定在投影墙上的定点，用自由换取完美对位，这对必须保持对齐的 AR 场景是个有用的取舍。
works.technique: A flat wall with pivoting doors at several heights holds the singers while silent-film-style animation is projected across it.
works.technique_zh: 一面平墙在不同高度装有可转动的门，歌手站在门里，默片风格的动画投满整面墙。
works.exercise_en: Anchor an AR mural to a real wall and mark three spots where classmates stand, then animate characters that react to each person's pose. Twist: the animation changes when two people swap spots.
works.exercise_zh: 在一面真实的墙上锚定一幅 AR 壁画，标出三个同学站位，让动画角色对每个人的姿势做出反应；变体：两个人交换位置时，动画也跟着变。

video.video_title: DieZauberflöte The Magic Flute -  Komische Oper Trailer

works.title: The Nature Trail
works.description: Along a hospital corridor at Great Ormond Street, LED animals hidden behind a patterned wall appear and walk beside children as they are wheeled to surgery.
works.description_zh: 在大奥蒙德街儿童医院的一条走廊里，藏在图案墙后的 LED 动物会出现，陪着被推往手术室的孩子们一起“走”。
works.idea_en: Content that appears only when someone passes and walks with them turns a stressful route into a companion — a direct template for location-based AR wayfinding.
works.idea_zh: 只在有人经过时出现并陪着走的内容，把一段令人紧张的路变成了陪伴——这是基于位置的 AR 导引的直接模板。
works.technique: Motion sensors along the corridor trigger LED animations embedded behind laser-cut wall panels, so animals reveal themselves in sequence at the pace of the passer-by.
works.technique_zh: 沿走廊布置的运动传感器触发嵌在激光切割墙板后的 LED 动画，动物按路人的步速依次现身。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR walk along a real corridor where small animals peek out from anchored spots and follow the user at walking pace. Twist: make the animals shy — they only come out if the user walks slowly and quietly.
works.exercise_zh: 沿一条真实走廊做一段 AR 漫步，小动物从锚定的位置探出头，按用户的步速跟随。变体：让动物很害羞——只有用户慢慢地、安静地走时它们才出来。

video.video_title: The Nature Trail - Jason Bruges Studio

works.title: The Treachery of Sanctuary
works.description: A triptych of white screens: in the first a visitor's shadow disintegrates into flying birds, in the second birds peck the shadow apart, in the third the shadow grows giant wings and takes flight.
works.idea_zh: 你的影子在三块屏幕上经历“解体—被吞噬—长出翅膀飞翔”
works.technique: Kinect depth cameras capture each visitor's silhouette and skeleton, and openFrameworks/Unity-style real-time graphics replace parts of the shadow with animated birds and wings projected on the screens.
works.exercise_zh: 用MediaPipe Pose拿到手臂骨骼，在剪影上长出一对随手臂扇动的翅膀；变化：设计你自己的“三幕”，每一幕影子有不同命运。

video.video_title: Amazing Art Installation Turns You Into A Bird | Chris Milk "The Treachery of Sanctuary"

works.description_zh: 由三块白色屏幕组成的三联作品：在第一块屏幕上，观众的影子碎裂成四散飞走的鸟；在第二块上，群鸟把影子啄食殆尽；在第三块上，影子长出巨大的翅膀，腾空而起。
works.idea_en: Across three screens your shadow falls apart, is devoured, then grows wings and flies.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 深度相机捕捉每位观众的剪影和骨架，采用类似 openFrameworks/Unity 的实时图形，把影子的局部替换成动画飞鸟和翅膀，投影在屏幕上。
works.exercise_en: Get the arm skeleton from MediaPipe Pose and grow a pair of wings on the silhouette that flap with the arms. Twist: design your own "three acts", giving the shadow a different fate in each.

works.title: Thirty Six
works.description: Thirty-six silver bags on a wall swell and collapse in computed sequences, creating ripples that travel across the grid.
works.description_zh: 墙上三十六个银色袋子按计算好的顺序膨胀、瘪下，形成在网格上传递的涟漪。
works.idea_en: A tiny grid is enough to read waves — sequencing matters more than resolution when designing AR motion.
works.idea_zh: 很小的网格就足以读出波浪——设计 AR 动效时，编排顺序比分辨率更重要。
works.technique: Fans driven by a microcontroller inflate each bag according to a pre-programmed wave pattern with phase offsets per position.
works.technique_zh: 由微控制器驱动的风扇根据预编程的波形为每个袋子充气，不同位置带有相位差。
works.exercise_en: Animate a 6×6 grid of inflatable virtual cushions on a table in AR using a ripple function with phase offsets. Twist: let the user tap one cushion to start a new ripple from there.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中用带相位差的涟漪函数驱动桌面上 6×6 个可充气的虚拟软垫。变体：用户点击某个软垫时，从那里发起新的涟漪。

video.video_title: Thirty Six

works.title: Touché
works.description: Swept-frequency capacitive sensing that recognises how you touch a doorknob, a table, water or your own body - one pinch versus full grasp - with a single electrode.
works.idea_zh: 一根电极就能分辨你是捏、握还是整只手浸在水里。

video.video_title: Touché: Enhancing Touch Interaction on Humans, Screens, Liquids, and Everyday Objects

works.technique: Sweeps the excitation frequency across a range and classifies the resulting capacitive profile, because different grips change the body's impedance at different frequencies.
works.exercise_zh: 用Makey Makey或Arduino的电容触摸引脚连接水杯、水果或门把手，训练一个简单分类器识别“摸一下/握住”；变化：把不同握法映射成手机AR里不同的特效。
works.description_zh: 一种扫频电容感应技术，只用一个电极就能识别你触碰门把手、桌子、水或自己身体的方式，比如是用两指一捏还是整只手握住。
works.idea_en: A single electrode can tell whether you pinch, grasp, or plunge your whole hand into water.
works.technique_zh: 在一段频率范围内扫描激励频率，并对得到的电容曲线进行分类，因为不同的握法会在不同频率下改变人体阻抗。
works.exercise_en: Connect a water glass, a piece of fruit or a doorknob to a Makey Makey or an Arduino's capacitive touch pin, and train a simple classifier to tell "a touch" from "a grip". Twist: map the different grips to different effects in phone AR.

works.title: Transformation: mARping Lehel
works.description: In Munich's Lehel neighbourhood, AR waterwheels turn where old streams once crossed the streets, alongside other visions of a sustainable city 30 years from now.
works.description_zh: 在慕尼黑的 Lehel 街区，AR 水车在旧时溪流穿过街道的位置转动，与其他关于 30 年后可持续城市的想象并置。
works.idea_en: Map the invisible history and possible future of a neighbourhood onto its streets.
works.idea_zh: 把一个街区看不见的历史与可能的未来，映射到它的街道上。
works.technique: Historical stream maps are used to geolocate animated 3D waterwheels and future-city objects in a mobile AR browser across the district.
works.technique_zh: 根据历史溪流地图，在移动 AR 浏览器中把动画 3D 水车和未来城市物件地理定位到整个街区。
works.exercise_en: Find an old map of your campus area, locate a lost stream, path or building, and place an AR marker of it at the exact spot. Twist: add a second layer showing what could be there in 2050.
works.exercise_zh: 找一张校园周边的老地图，定位一条消失的溪流、小路或建筑，在准确位置放一个 AR 标记。变体：再加一层，展示 2050 年那里可能出现的东西。

video.video_title: "Transformation: mARping Lehel" (trailer) Augmented reality art project

works.title: Twilight Epiphany
works.description: A grass-covered pavilion at Rice University has a square opening in its roof; at sunrise and sunset, LEDs wash the ceiling with changing colours so the sky in the opening seems to turn solid and change colour itself.
works.description_zh: 莱斯大学一座覆盖草皮的亭子，屋顶开着一个方形洞口；日出日落时，LED 用变化的颜色照亮天花板，洞口里的天空仿佛变成实体并自己变色。
works.idea_en: Colour next to a window changes the colour we see through it; an AR layer placed around a real view can re-tint that view without touching it.
works.idea_zh: 窗边的颜色会改变我们透过窗看到的颜色；在真实景物周围放一层 AR，不碰它也能给它重新着色。
works.technique: A knife-edge aperture removes any visible roof thickness, and programmed LED sequences exploit simultaneous contrast to shift the perceived colour of the sky.
works.technique_zh: 刀锋般的开口让屋顶看不出厚度，编程控制的 LED 灯光利用同时对比效应，改变人们感知到的天空颜色。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR frame that surrounds a real window or patch of sky with a slowly changing coloured border and let students compare how the sky's colour appears to shift. Twist: drive the border colour from the actual time until sunset.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 画框，用缓慢变色的边框围住一扇真实的窗或一块天空，让同学比较天空颜色看起来如何变化。变体：用距离日落的真实时间来驱动边框颜色。

video.video_title: The Turrell skyspace at Rice University

works.title: Untilled
works.description: In a compost heap of Kassel's Karlsaue park for documenta 13, a reclining nude sculpture with a living beehive for a head, a white dog with a pink leg and toxic plants coexisted and changed without the artist.
works.description_zh: 在第 13 届卡塞尔文献展的卡尔绍公园堆肥场中，一尊头部是活蜂巢的斜卧裸女雕塑、一只一条腿被染成粉色的白狗和一些有毒植物共同生活，在没有艺术家干预的情况下不断变化。
works.idea_en: The work is a system of living parts left to run by itself, a model for AR ecosystems that evolve whether or not anyone is watching.
works.idea_zh: 作品是一个任其自行运转的活系统，是无论有无观众都在演化的 AR 生态系统的范本。
works.technique: Huyghe set conditions (plants, animals, a sculpture colonised by bees) and let biological processes shape the site over 100 days.
works.technique_zh: Huyghe 设定条件（植物、动物、被蜜蜂占据的雕塑），然后让生物过程在 100 天里塑造这片场地。
works.exercise_en: Build a small AR ecosystem on a table with simple agents (plants, insects, a creature) that keep evolving in a persistent cloud anchor between visits. Twist: users can only observe, never touch.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌面上用简单智能体（植物、昆虫、一只生物）搭建一个小型 AR 生态系统，它在持久化云锚点中持续演化，每次到访都不同；变体：用户只能观察，永远不能触碰。

video.video_title: Pierre Huyghe Documenta (13) 1:4.m4v

works.title: Vestige
works.description: Six life-size mirrored human figures stand among the trees at the David Marshall Lodge in Aberfoyle, Scotland, reflecting the forest so they almost vanish.
works.description_zh: 六个等身镜面人形站在苏格兰阿伯福伊尔 David Marshall Lodge 的林中，映照着森林，几乎消失不见。
works.idea_en: Figures made only of reflections are the physical form of an 'invisible' AR character that is noticed only when it moves or catches light.
works.idea_zh: 只由倒影构成的人形是“隐形” AR 角色的实体形式，只有在移动或闪光时才会被注意到。
works.technique: Flat human silhouettes are cut from mirror-polished stainless steel and placed at varied angles so they reflect the surrounding trees.
works.technique_zh: 从镜面抛光不锈钢上切割出扁平的人形剪影，并以不同角度放置，映照周围树木。
works.exercise_en: Place AR human silhouettes with a real-time reflection material in a wooded area and let users try to find them. Twist: figures slowly change position when nobody is looking.
works.exercise_zh: 在林地中放置使用实时反射材质的 AR 人形剪影，让用户尝试找到它们；变体：没人看时，人形会慢慢改变位置。

video.video_title: Vestige - Rob Mulholland.mpg

salient.why_en: Human figures made of mirrors vanish into the forest they reflect.
salient.why_zh: 用镜子做成的人形映出周围的树林，几乎消失在森林里。

works.title: Vision Funnels
works.description: At LACMA, nested AR frames open like funnels in the museum's walls and plazas, pulling the viewer's gaze into tunnel-like views of the architecture.
works.description_zh: 在洛杉矶县立美术馆，层层嵌套的 AR 画框像漏斗一样在墙面和广场上打开，把观众的视线引入隧道般的建筑景象。
works.idea_en: A frame within a frame turns any wall into a telescope.
works.idea_zh: 框中之框，把任何一面墙变成望远镜。
works.technique: Concentric rectangular frames are likely placed as geolocated 3D augments at fixed spots around the museum, viewed on tablets as part of the Project-O-rators series.
works.technique_zh: 同心矩形画框很可能作为地理定位的 3D 增强内容放在美术馆周围的固定位置，用平板观看，属于 Project-O-rators 系列。
works.exercise_en: Build a recursive AR frame (a frame containing a render of itself) on a wall with image tracking. Twist: the funnel shows the live camera feed from behind the wall.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪在墙上做一个递归 AR 画框（框里渲染着它自己）。变体：漏斗里显示墙后面的实时摄像画面。

video.video_title: Funnel Visions Documentation 1

works.title: Water Light Graffiti
works.description: A wall of thousands of LEDs lights up wherever it is touched with water, so people paint glowing messages with brushes, sprayers or wet fingers that fade as the water dries.
works.description_zh: 一面由数千颗 LED 组成的墙，被水碰到的地方就会亮起，人们用刷子、喷壶或湿手指画出发光的留言，水干了光也就消失了。
works.idea_en: Painting with an everyday material that leaves no mark teaches AR designers to link virtual ink to a real gesture and to let drawings fade on their own.
works.idea_zh: 用不留痕迹的日常材料作画，提醒 AR 设计者：把虚拟墨水绑定到真实的手势上，并让画面自己慢慢消失。
works.technique: Each LED sits between two contacts on the surface; water bridges the contacts, closes the circuit and powers the light until it evaporates.
works.technique_zh: 每颗 LED 位于表面两个触点之间；水把触点连通，电路闭合、灯亮，直到水蒸发。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR or Lens Studio wall where a tracked fingertip or a sprayed 'virtual water' particle leaves glowing strokes that dry and fade over 30 seconds. Twist: make the strokes last longer the more people add to the same spot.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 Lens Studio 做一面墙，被追踪的指尖或喷出的“虚拟水”粒子会留下发光笔触，并在 30 秒内干掉、消失。变体：同一处被越多人补画，笔触保留得越久。

video.video_title: WATER-LIGHT-GRAFFITI-Antonin-Fourneau

salient.why_en: Paint the wall with plain water and it glows, then fades as it dries.
salient.why_zh: 用清水在墙上画，笔迹就会发光，水干了便慢慢消失。

works.title: White Roads in the Red Matrix
works.description: Part of Ratsi's Deconstruction Time Again project: white lines of light run through a red grid in a dark space, forming and breaking perspective 'roads' that seem to recede into a depth that is not physically there.
works.description_zh: Ratsi 的 Deconstruction Time Again 系列之一：在黑暗空间中，白色光线穿过红色网格，形成又打破透视的“道路”，仿佛通向一个实际上并不存在的深处。
works.idea_en: A few lines of light can fake a deep space; AR designers can suggest depth with perspective cues alone before adding any 3D model.
works.idea_zh: 几条光线就能伪造出很深的空间；AR 设计师在加任何三维模型之前，仅靠透视线索就能暗示深度。
works.technique: Custom LED lines driven by software (developed by Anthony Gouvrillon, LEDs by Julien Guinard) animate perspective grids synchronised with Thomas Vaquié's sound.
works.technique_zh: 由软件驱动的定制 LED 线（软件由 Anthony Gouvrillon 开发，LED 由 Julien Guinard 制作）呈现透视网格动画，与 Thomas Vaquié 的声音同步。
works.exercise_en: Draw a perspective grid of glowing lines on a real wall in WebXR so it looks like a tunnel going through the wall. Twist: the vanishing point follows the viewer's head, so the tunnel always points at them.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 里在一面真实墙上画出发光的透视网格，让它看起来像穿墙而过的隧道；变体：灭点跟随观者的头部，隧道永远指向他。

video.video_title: White Roads in the Red Matrix

works.title: WiiPop
works.description: A dance-game prototype that rewards freestyle instead of copying: it rates a popping dancer's spacing, musicality and use of individual body parts.
works.description_zh: 一个奖励自由发挥而不是照搬动作的舞蹈游戏原型：它为 popping 舞者的空间运用、音乐性和身体各部位的使用打分。
works.idea_en: A dance game that scores creativity rather than imitation.
works.idea_zh: 一个给创造力而不是模仿打分的舞蹈游戏。
works.technique: Kinect tracks large spatial movement while a body-mounted Wii Remote catches fine hits, and the two streams are fused into freestyle quality metrics.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 追踪大幅度的空间运动，佩戴在身上的 Wii 遥控器捕捉细小的发力点，两路数据融合成自由舞的质量指标。
works.exercise_en: Use webcam pose tracking to score a 30-second freestyle on variety (how many joints moved) and coverage (how much floor was used). Twist: repeating a move lowers the score.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头姿态追踪给一段 30 秒的自由舞打分，指标是多样性（动了多少个关节）和覆盖度（用了多少地面）；变体：重复同一个动作会扣分。

video.video_title: WiiPop  DANCING VIDEO GAME Technolgy

works.title: Wonderbook: Book of Spells
works.description: Written with J.K. Rowling's Pottermore, a blank marker book becomes a pop-up spell book on screen; players wave the Move controller as a wand to cast spells that affect the pages and room.
works.idea_zh: 一本空白的实体书在屏幕里变成立体魔法书，用手柄当魔杖施咒。

video.video_title: Wonderbook: Book of Spells Trailer

works.technique: Each page of the book carries a distinct marker, so page identity and pose drive which pop-up scene is rendered, while the tracked Move wand gestures cast spells into it.
works.exercise_zh: 用一本小册子，每页贴一个不同的图像标记，翻页时在 AR 中弹出对应的立体场景；变体：用手机当魔杖，在页面上方挥动触发变化。
works.description_zh: 与 J.K. 罗琳的 Pottermore 合作撰写：一本印有标记的空白书在屏幕上变成立体弹出式咒语书，玩家把 Move 手柄当作魔杖挥动施咒，影响书页和房间。
works.idea_en: A blank physical book turns into a pop-up spellbook on screen, with the controller as your wand.
works.technique_zh: 书的每一页都印有不同的标记，页面的身份和位姿决定渲染哪个弹出式场景，被追踪的 Move 魔杖手势则向场景中施放咒语。
works.exercise_en: Put a different image marker on each page of a small booklet so turning the page pops up a matching 3D scene in AR. Twist: use the phone as a wand, waving it above the page to trigger changes.

works.title: polyCopRiotNode_
works.description: A network of low-poly 3D riot police in gas masks is placed in augmented reality at geolocations tied to local protest and policing, first in Chicago and then in Washington DC, visible to anyone who looks with a phone.
works.description_zh: 一组戴防毒面具的低多边形 3D 防暴警察被放置在增强现实中的特定地理位置上，这些地点与当地的抗议和警务相关，先在芝加哥、后在华盛顿特区，任何人用手机都能看到。
works.idea_en: Make the police response to protest visible as permanent virtual sentries at the sites where it happened.
works.idea_zh: 让警方对抗议的回应以永久的虚拟哨兵形式，显现在事件发生的地点。
works.technique: Low-poly riot-police models are published as geolocated augments in a location-based AR browser (likely Layar) at researched coordinates.
works.technique_zh: 把低多边形防暴警察模型作为带地理位置的增强内容，发布到基于位置的 AR 浏览器（推测为 Layar）中，放在经过调研的坐标上。
works.exercise_en: Research three places near school where an invisible rule or power operates, and place a simple 3D sentinel at each with a WebAR geolocation tool, adding a one-line caption. Twist: let the sentinels face whoever is looking at them.
works.exercise_zh: 调研学校附近三个存在某种看不见的规则或权力的地点，用 WebAR 地理定位工具在每处放一个简单的 3D“哨兵”，并配一行说明；变体：让哨兵始终面向正在看它的人。

video.video_title: polyCopRiotNode_

works.title: primitive
works.description: Five performers move in front of a projection screen and appear to strike, carry and ride the geometric shapes and lines that move across it.
works.description_zh: 五位表演者在投影幕前移动，看起来像在击打、搬运、驾驭屏幕上移动的几何形状和线条。
works.idea_en: Virtual objects feel solid when the body reacts at the exact right frame; timing, not tracking, sells the contact.
works.idea_zh: 当身体在正确的那一帧做出反应时，虚拟物体就显得有实体；让接触可信的是时机，而不是追踪。
