works.technique: The motion graphics are pre-rendered to music and the performers rehearse their moves to hit each cue precisely, with no live tracking.
works.technique_zh: 动态图形按音乐预先渲染，表演者反复排练让动作精确踩中每个节点，没有使用实时追踪。
works.exercise_en: Record a short AR animation of a ball crossing the room, then rehearse a classmate to 'catch' and 'throw' it on camera until it looks real. Twist: film it from a second angle and see whether the illusion breaks.
works.exercise_zh: 录一段 AR 动画：一个球穿过房间，让同学反复排练，在镜头里把它“接住”和“扔出去”，直到看起来像真的；变体：从另一个角度再拍一次，看看错觉会不会穿帮。

video.video_title: enra " primitive "

works.title: re-flex (Z33)
works.description: A projected light installation for Z33 that reveals and distorts the geometry of the room, discussed by the artist.
works.idea_zh: 光线揭示并扭曲房间几何的装置

video.video_title: Pablo Valbuena - re-flex - Mind the System, Find the Gap | Z33

works.technique: Projected light lines calibrated to the room's geometry reveal or contradict its perspective, relying on anamorphic alignment from chosen viewpoints.
works.exercise_zh: 在一个小房间里投出一组只有从某个位置看才连成完整图形的线（变形透视），其他位置看是碎片；变体：给观众在地上标一个错误的观看点，让他们自己找到正确位置。
works.description_zh: 为 Z33 创作的投影光装置，揭示并扭曲了房间的几何结构，片中由艺术家本人讲解。
works.idea_en: An installation where light reveals and warps the geometry of a room.
works.technique_zh: 与房间几何结构标定对齐的投影光线，通过从选定视点出发的变形透视对位，揭示或颠覆房间原有的透视关系。
works.exercise_en: Project a set of lines in a small room that only join into a complete figure from one position (anamorphic perspective) and look like fragments from anywhere else. Twist: mark a wrong viewing spot on the floor and let the audience find the right one themselves.

works.title: superposition
works.description: A stage performance about quantum mechanics in which two performers operate devices, type and tap Morse code while a wall of screens shows equations, data and live camera images.
works.description_zh: 一场关于量子力学的舞台演出：两位表演者操作设备、打字、敲摩尔斯电码，同时一整面屏幕墙显示公式、数据和实时摄像画面。
works.idea_en: Performers can be data operators rather than dancers; in AR theatre, visible live input (typing, tapping) makes the digital layer feel caused by people.
works.idea_zh: 表演者可以是数据操作员而不是舞者；在 AR 剧场里，看得见的实时输入（打字、敲击）让数字层显得是由人引发的。
works.technique: Live performer actions, cameras and signal generators are mixed with pre-computed visuals and sound on a synchronised multi-screen system.
works.technique_zh: 表演者的实时动作、摄像机和信号发生器，与预先计算的影像和声音一起，在同步的多屏系统上混合。
works.exercise_en: Stage a five-minute AR performance where one student taps Morse code on a table and each tap spawns a floating symbol visible to the audience's phones. Twist: let the audience decode the message together.
works.exercise_zh: 排演一段五分钟的 AR 表演：一位同学在桌上敲摩尔斯电码，每敲一下就生成一个观众手机可见的悬浮符号。变体：让观众一起解出这条讯息。

video.video_title: Ryoji Ikeda :: superposition

works.title: the radar
works.description: In Rio de Janeiro a large outdoor projection shows a slowly rotating radar-like map of the universe built from astronomical data, seen by crowds at night.
works.description_zh: 在里约热内卢，一块大型户外投影展示由天文数据构成、像雷达一样缓慢旋转的宇宙地图，夜里吸引众人观看。
works.idea_en: Showing the sky's hidden data under the real sky gives people a second sky; AR star maps work best when aligned with where the stars really are.
works.idea_zh: 在真实的天空下展示天空中隐藏的数据，就给人们第二片天空；AR 星图只有和真实星星的位置对齐时才最有力量。
works.technique: Astronomical survey data are rendered as a sweeping radar-style animation and projected at monumental scale outdoors (likely a single large screen).
works.technique_zh: 天文巡天数据被渲染成雷达扫描式动画，在户外以纪念碑般的尺度投射（可能是一块大屏幕）。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR sky overlay that uses compass and gyroscope to place a rotating radar sweep over the real night sky, revealing labels of real stars as the sweep passes. Twist: let each student mark a 'discovery' that others can see.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 天空叠加层，用指南针和陀螺仪在真实夜空上放一道旋转的雷达扫描线，扫过之处显示真实星星的名字。变体：让每位同学标记一个“发现”，其他人也能看到。

video.video_title: Ryoji Ikeda :: the radar, 7-9 SEP 2012, Rio de Janeiro, BR

works.title: twittAR Ideograms
works.description: At the ZERO1 Biennial, the Bay Area's changing Twitter trends are translated into floating 3D 'internet ideograms' that appear and disappear like a rebus puzzle.
works.description_zh: 在 ZERO1 双年展上，湾区不断变化的 Twitter 热门话题被转换成漂浮的 3D “网络象形文字”，像画谜一样出现又消失。
works.idea_en: Trending topics become cave paintings floating in the air.
works.idea_zh: 热门话题变成漂浮在空中的洞穴壁画。
works.technique: A Layar channel polls local Twitter trends and maps keywords to 3D icon models that are placed as geolocated objects around the Biennial site.
works.technique_zh: 一个 Layar 频道定期抓取本地 Twitter 热门话题，把关键词映射为 3D 图标模型，作为地理定位物体放在双年展现场周围。
works.exercise_en: Pull five trending words from any feed, map each to an emoji-like 3D model and float them over a campus plaza in AR. Twist: viewers have to guess the sentence the icons spell.
works.exercise_zh: 从任意信息流中抓取五个热门词，每个词对应一个类似表情符号的 3D 模型，让它们以 AR 形式漂浮在校园广场上空。变体：观众要猜出这些图标拼出的句子。

video.video_title: twittAR Ideograms - GARhodes (2012)

works.title: #occupymoney
works.description: Tweet with #occupy1dollar and your message appears on every one-dollar bill in the world when viewed through Layar Vision.
works.description_zh: 发一条带 #occupy1dollar 的推文，你的留言就会出现在全世界每一张一美元纸币上（通过 Layar Vision 观看）。
works.idea_en: Deliver a protest message straight into the core of the financial system: the banknote.
works.idea_zh: 把抗议留言直接送进金融系统的核心：纸币。
works.technique: Layar Vision image recognition tracks the one-dollar bill design and overlays the latest tweets fetched with the hashtag.
works.technique_zh: Layar Vision 的图像识别追踪一美元纸币的图案，并叠加根据话题标签抓取的最新推文。
works.exercise_en: Use image tracking on a common object everyone carries (a banknote, student card, coffee cup) to show messages submitted through a form. Twist: each viewer sees a different random message.
works.exercise_zh: 对一种人人都带着的常见物体（纸币、学生证、咖啡杯）做图像追踪，显示通过表单提交的留言。变体：每位观众看到的是一条随机的不同留言。

video.video_title: #occupymoney

works.title: 000000swan
works.description: A live music-and-game performance in which the performer's gestures, read by a hacked Kinect, move graphics through a real-time 3D game world.
works.description_zh: 一场音乐与游戏结合的现场表演：被改装的 Kinect 读取表演者的手势，驱动实时 3D 游戏世界中的图形。
works.idea_en: Teach the computer your own gestures instead of using its built-in ones.
works.idea_zh: 教电脑认识你自己的手势，而不是使用它内置的那一套。
works.technique: Kinect depth data is fed to Wekinator machine learning, trained on the performer's gestures rather than skeleton tracking, whose outputs control objects in Unity.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 深度数据输入 Wekinator 机器学习，训练的是表演者自己的手势而非骨骼追踪，其输出控制 Unity 中的物体。
works.exercise_en: Train Wekinator or Teachable Machine on three of your own gestures and map each to an effect in a projected scene or AR view. Twist: the gestures must come from a dance you already know.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Wekinator 或 Teachable Machine 训练你自己的三个手势，把每个手势映射为投影场景或 AR 视图中的一种效果。变体：手势必须取自一支你已经会跳的舞。

video.video_title: 000000swan, Kinect, Unity 3D + Wekinator

works.title: 275 prepared dc-motors, filler wire 1.0mm
works.description: Hundreds of thin wires sprout from motors mounted across a room's walls and spin, whirring and scratching, so the whole space shivers like a field of insects.
works.description_zh: 数百根细铁丝从装在墙上的电机中伸出并旋转，发出嗡嗡的刮擦声，整个空间像一片昆虫的原野般颤动。
works.idea_en: Covering an architectural surface with one repeated gesture reframes the whole room; AR can do the same by instancing one tiny behaviour across a scanned mesh.
works.idea_zh: 用同一个动作覆盖整片建筑表面，就能重塑整个房间；AR 可以把一个微小行为批量实例化到扫描出的网格上来做到这一点。
works.technique: Each motor spins a short length of 1 mm welding filler wire that scrapes the wall; the material list is the entire system (year from the exhibition, likely 2011).
works.technique_zh: 每个电机旋转一小段 1 毫米焊丝，刮擦墙面；材料清单就是整个系统（年份依展览推测，约 2011 年）。
works.exercise_en: Use LiDAR scene reconstruction to get the room mesh, instance 500 short spinning wires normal to the surfaces, and add a faint scratch sound to each. Twist: let wires near the viewer's hand spin faster.
works.exercise_zh: 用 LiDAR 场景重建获得房间网格，沿表面法线实例化 500 根旋转的短铁丝，每根加一点刮擦声。变体：靠近观众手部的铁丝转得更快。

video.video_title: Zimoun: 275 prepared dc-motors, filler wire 1.0mm

works.title: 3D Video Mapping Interactivity Test
works.description: A test in which spectators in front of a mapped building control the projected content with their movements, so logos and objects on the facade react to the crowd.
works.description_zh: 一次测试：站在被映射建筑前的观众用身体动作控制投影内容，立面上的标志和物体会对人群做出反应。
works.idea_en: Letting the audience drive a building-sized image turns passive watching into play, which is what makes location AR memorable.
works.idea_zh: 让观众驱动一整面建筑的影像，把被动观看变成游戏，这正是让地点型 AR 令人难忘的原因。
works.technique: Cameras or depth sensors likely track people in front of the building and send their positions to a real-time engine that renders the mapped content.
works.technique_zh: 推测用摄像机或深度传感器追踪建筑前的人，把位置传给实时引擎来渲染映射内容。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR or Lens Studio scene anchored to a building facade where virtual balls bounce off the wall and follow the phone holder's body position. Twist: two phones must cooperate to keep one ball alive.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个锚定在建筑立面上的 WebXR 或 Lens Studio 场景，虚拟小球在墙上弹跳，并跟随手机持有者的身体位置移动；变体：必须两部手机配合才能让一个球不掉下来。

video.video_title: NuFormer - 3D video mapping interactivity test, April 2011

works.title: AR Games (Nintendo 3DS)
works.description: Preinstalled on every 3DS: placing a '?' AR card on a table makes a dragon burst out of it or lets you fish in a lake that opens in the table, shoot archery targets and draw graffiti.
works.idea_zh: 把一张AR卡片放在桌上，桌面就裂开成湖泊、跳出巨龙。

video.video_title: Nintendo 3DS - New Owner's Guide: AR Games

works.technique: A known printed card provides a fiducial for camera pose, and the stereo 3D display renders content emerging from the table plane around the card.
works.exercise_zh: 用一张打印的图像标记做一个从桌面“裂开”钻出来的 AR 巨龙，可以用 Stencil 做出桌面洞口；变体：把标记放在不同表面上，巨龙的反应不同。
works.description_zh: 每台 3DS 都预装的游戏：把一张“?”AR 卡片放在桌上，就会有巨龙从中破出，你还可以在桌面裂开的湖里钓鱼、射箭打靶、随手涂鸦。
works.idea_en: Put an AR card on the table and the tabletop cracks open into a lake or a dragon bursts out.
works.technique_zh: 一张已知图案的印刷卡片作为基准标记提供相机位姿，裸眼立体 3D 屏幕则渲染从卡片周围桌面平面中冒出的内容。
works.exercise_en: Use a printed image marker to make an AR dragon that bursts "cracking" out of the tabletop, using a stencil to cut the hole in the table. Twist: put the marker on different surfaces and have the dragon react differently.

works.title: AR Games: Fishing
works.description: One of the 3DS AR Games modes: the table surface around the AR card turns into a pond, and the player fishes by moving and tilting the console.
works.idea_zh: 桌面在AR中化为池塘，移动掌机就能在自家桌上钓鱼。

video.video_title: Fishing in AR Games on the Nintendo 3DS (Complete)

works.technique: The card marks the table as a water plane using a stencil or depth mask, and tilting and moving the console are mapped to the fishing line and reel.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌面上用 Shader 做一个“水面”，倾斜手机抛竿，快速上抬手机收线；变体：鱼只在你保持安静时才会上钩（用麦克风判断）。
works.description_zh: 3DS 的 AR Games 模式之一：AR 卡片周围的桌面变成一片池塘，玩家通过移动和倾斜掌机来钓鱼。
works.idea_en: The tabletop turns into a pond in AR, and moving the handheld lets you fish at your own desk.
works.technique_zh: 卡片借助模板（stencil）或深度遮罩把桌面标记为水面，掌机的倾斜和移动被映射为鱼线和收线动作。
works.exercise_en: Make a "water surface" on the table with a shader, tilt the phone to cast, and lift it quickly to reel in. Twist: fish only bite when you stay quiet (judged by the microphone).

works.title: AR Pop-up Book
works.description: Opening an ordinary picture book in front of a camera makes 3D characters and scenes pop out of its pages, tracked from the printed illustrations themselves rather than black markers.
works.description_zh: 在摄像头前打开一本普通图画书，三维角色和场景就从书页里“弹”出来；追踪依据的是印刷插图本身，而不是黑色标记。
works.idea_en: Any printed page can become a pop-up book when the picture itself is the tracker.
works.idea_zh: 只要图片本身就是追踪目标，任何印刷页面都能变成立体书。
works.technique: Uses natural-feature texture tracking on the page images to estimate camera pose and render 3D content registered to each page.
works.technique_zh: 对页面图像做自然特征纹理追踪来估计相机位姿，并渲染与每一页配准的三维内容。
works.exercise_en: Pick a children's book page, set it as an image target in a phone AR tool, and make one character jump out when the page is opened. Twist: make characters from two pages talk to each other when both are visible.
works.exercise_zh: 选一页儿童读物，把它设为手机 AR 工具中的图像目标，让一个角色在翻开这页时跳出来；变体：当两页同时可见时，让两页的角色互相对话。

video.video_title: AR popup book based on texture tracking

works.title: AR in the Psychomotor Phase of a Procedural Task
works.description: Head-worn AR shows animated guidance for the hands-on part of an assembly task (aligning and inserting parts) directly on the physical engine combustor.
works.idea_zh: AR动画直接在真实零件上示范'手该怎么动'。

video.video_title: Augmented reality in the psychomotor phase of a procedural task

works.technique: The combustor parts are tracked in 6DOF, and animated overlays compare the current part pose with the target pose, showing alignment cues (arrows, rotation hints) until the part is correctly inserted.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪一块乐高底板和一个带贴纸的零件，在 AR 中显示目标位置的虚影，零件越接近目标，虚影颜色越绿；变体：去掉数字提示，只用声音引导对准。
works.description_zh: 头戴式 AR 直接在真实的发动机燃烧室上显示动画引导，指导装配任务中需要动手操作的环节（对准和插入零件）。
works.idea_en: AR animation demonstrates how your hands should move, right on the real part.
works.technique_zh: 对燃烧室零件进行 6DOF 追踪，动画叠加层比较零件当前位姿与目标位姿，持续显示对准提示（箭头、旋转提示），直到零件被正确插入。
works.exercise_en: Use image tracking on a LEGO baseplate and a part with a sticker, and show a ghost of the target position in AR that turns greener as the part gets closer. Twist: remove the visual hints and guide the alignment with sound alone.

works.title: Augmented Dance Floor (ADF')
works.description: At an outdoor music festival in Geneva, the crowd dancing in front of the Palais Eynard is captured in 3D and projected onto the building's façade as glowing point clouds inside a virtual grid room.
works.description_zh: 在日内瓦的户外音乐节上，Palais Eynard 前跳舞的人群被 3D 捕捉，并以发光点云的形式投射到建筑立面上的虚拟网格房间里。
works.idea_en: The dancing crowd sees itself as light on the building in front of it.
works.idea_zh: 跳舞的人群在面前的建筑上看见自己化作的光。
works.technique: Kinect depth data processed with OpenNI and openFrameworks is rendered as point clouds and 3D optical flow, then projection-mapped onto the façade.
works.technique_zh: 用 OpenNI 和 openFrameworks 处理 Kinect 深度数据，渲染成点云和 3D 光流，再投影映射到建筑立面上。
works.exercise_en: Capture a group with a depth camera or phone LiDAR and project their point cloud large on a wall behind them. Twist: the point cloud lags a few seconds, so the crowd dances with its past self.
works.exercise_zh: 用深度相机或手机 LiDAR 捕捉一群人，把点云大尺寸投到他们身后的墙上。变体：点云延迟几秒出现，让人群和过去的自己一起跳舞。

video.video_title: Augmented Dance Floor - ADF' @ Geneva June 2011 - HD

works.title: Ballet Rotoscope
works.description: A short film in which a ballerina's movements are precisely traced and overlaid with glowing curves, polygons and mathematical figures that reveal the geometry of each pose.
works.description_zh: 一部短片：精确描摹芭蕾舞者的动作，并叠加发光的曲线、多边形和数学图形，揭示每个姿态背后的几何结构。
works.idea_en: Reveal the hidden geometry of a dance by drawing its trajectories on top of the body.
works.idea_zh: 在身体之上画出轨迹，揭示舞蹈中隐藏的几何。
works.technique: Frame-by-frame rotoscoping extracts joint positions from filmed ballet, from which trajectory curves and computed geometric animations are generated and composited.
works.technique_zh: 逐帧描摹拍摄的芭蕾，提取关节位置，再据此生成轨迹曲线和计算得出的几何动画并合成到画面中。
works.exercise_en: Film a classmate doing a slow movement, run a pose estimator on the video, and draw the trails of wrists and ankles plus the triangle between hands and head. Twist: do it live in AR so the dancer sees the geometry while moving.
works.exercise_zh: 拍一位同学做缓慢的动作，对视频运行姿态估计，画出手腕和脚踝的轨迹以及双手与头部构成的三角形；变体：在 AR 中实时呈现，让舞者边跳边看到几何。

video.video_title: ballet rotoscope | バレエ・ロトスコープ

salient.why_en: Glowing curves and figures traced over a ballerina reveal the geometry hidden in every pose.
salient.why_zh: 在芭蕾舞者身上描出的发光曲线和几何图形，揭示了每个姿态里隐藏的几何。

works.title: Battling Pavilions
works.description: At the Venice Biennale, virtual pavilions extend the national pavilions into AR, and visitors anywhere can play a game that makes the pavilions fight for space.
works.description_zh: 在威尼斯双年展上，虚拟展馆把国家馆延伸到 AR 中，任何地方的访客都可以玩一个让这些展馆争夺空间的游戏。
works.idea_en: Turn the competition between national pavilions into an actual game.
works.idea_zh: 把国家馆之间的竞争变成一场真正的游戏。
works.technique: Pavilion blocks are geolocated in the Giardini in Layar, and remote and local players' actions update a shared server state that changes which pavilion occupies each spot.
works.technique_zh: 在 Layar 中把展馆方块定位在绿园城堡，现场和远程玩家的操作会更新共享的服务器状态，决定每个位置由哪个展馆占据。
works.exercise_en: Turn a campus quad into an AR territory game where teams claim tiles by standing on them with a phone. Twist: remote players online can also claim tiles.
works.exercise_zh: 把校园草坪变成 AR 领地游戏，团队拿着手机站上某块地砖就能占领它。变体：线上的远程玩家也能占领。

video.video_title: Battling Pavilions

works.title: Bending Space: the Durham Project
works.description: In old tobacco warehouses of Durham, North Carolina, Rousse and local volunteers paint and build shapes that, from the camera's point of view, float in the empty industrial rooms.
works.description_zh: 在北卡罗来纳州达勒姆的旧烟草仓库里，Rousse 和当地志愿者绘制、搭建出一些形状，从相机视角看，它们漂浮在空荡的工业房间中。
works.idea_en: Buildings about to change are perfect hosts for temporary images: AR can give abandoned or transitional spaces a last visible layer before they disappear.
works.idea_zh: 即将改变的建筑最适合承载临时图像：AR 可以在废弃或转型中的空间消失之前，为它们留下最后一层可见的影像。
works.technique: Anamorphic painting and cut-out constructions are aligned through a fixed camera; the photograph, not the room, is the finished work.
works.technique_zh: 变形绘画和切割搭建物通过固定相机对齐，最终作品是照片，而不是房间本身。
works.exercise_en: Pick a disused room on campus, scan it with LiDAR, and place one anamorphic AR shape that resolves from the doorway; record a 30-second video walking in. Twist: let students leave short voice notes about the room that play when the shape resolves.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个校园里闲置的房间，用 LiDAR 扫描，从门口的视角放一个会合成的变形 AR 图形，录一段 30 秒走进去的视频。变体：让同学留下关于这个房间的语音，图形合成时播放。

video.video_title: BENDING SPACE: Georges Rousse and the Durham Project - Trailer

works.title: Black Ceremony
works.description: In the Qatari desert, daytime fireworks release black and coloured smoke in shapes such as a rainbow, a circle and a pyramid, drawing a silent ceremony against the bright sky.
works.description_zh: 在卡塔尔的沙漠里，白天燃放的烟花释放出黑色和彩色的烟雾，画出彩虹、圆环和金字塔等形状，在明亮天空下完成一场无声的仪式。
works.idea_en: Fireworks do not need darkness: dark smoke shapes read best against a bright sky, a reminder that daylight AR content should use dark, high-contrast silhouettes instead of glow.
works.idea_zh: 烟花不一定需要黑夜：在明亮的天空下，深色烟雾的形状反而最清楚。这提醒我们，白天的 AR 内容应当用深色、高对比的剪影，而不是发光效果。
works.technique: Daytime shells loaded with black and dyed smoke compositions are fired in timed patterns so the smoke clouds form geometric figures that drift and fade.
works.technique_zh: 装有黑色和彩色烟雾药剂的日间烟花弹按时序发射，让烟团组成几何图形，然后慢慢飘散。
works.exercise_en: Build a daytime AR sky piece in Lens Studio or WebXR where dark particle clouds burst into a circle, then a rainbow, then fade with the wind direction; test it outdoors at noon. Twist: compare a glowing version and a black-smoke version and vote which one reads better in sunlight.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Lens Studio 或 WebXR 中做一个白天的 AR 天空作品：深色粒子云先炸成圆环，再变成彩虹，然后顺着风向散去；中午到户外测试。变体：同时做一个发光版本和一个黑烟版本，投票看哪个在阳光下更清楚。

video.video_title: Cai Guo-Qiang Black Ceremony

works.title: Body Swap
works.description: Two people stand side by side and each controls the other's body on screen like a puppet, making each other dance, jump and look silly.
works.idea_zh: 和旁边的人交换身体：你控制他的画面形象，他也在操控你。

video.video_title: Body Swap

works.technique: Kinect skeleton tracking of two players drives two on-screen puppets, with each player's joint data mapped to the other player's avatar.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 同时追踪两个人，把 A 的动作渲染在 B 的剪影人偶上，反之亦然；变体：只交换一半身体，比如你控制对方的腿、对方控制你的手，完成一个共同任务。
works.description_zh: 两个人并排站立，各自像操纵木偶一样控制屏幕上对方的身体，让对方跳舞、蹦跳、出洋相。
works.idea_en: Swap bodies with the person beside you: you control their on-screen figure while they control yours.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 骨架追踪两名玩家，驱动屏幕上的两个木偶，每位玩家的关节数据都被映射到对方的化身上。
works.exercise_en: Track two people at once with MediaPipe Pose and render A's movements on B's silhouette puppet and vice versa. Twist: swap only half the body, for example you control the other person's legs and they control your arms, to complete a shared task.

salient.why_en: You control the on-screen body of the person beside you while they control yours.
salient.why_zh: 你操控身旁那个人在屏幕上的身体，对方则操控你的。

works.title: CELL (with James Alliban)
works.description: An interactive installation where a depth camera tracks visitors and attaches floating identity tags drawn from social media to their bodies on a large mirror-screen.
works.idea_zh: 摄像头追踪人体，给每个路人实时贴上网络身份标签的数字镜子

video.video_title: CELL | 1 | Showreel

works.technique: A Kinect depth camera segments and tracks each visitor's skeleton, and openFrameworks renders text tags that follow the tracked head/torso positions on a mirror-like screen.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 在网页摄像头画面里追踪多人，把随机抓取的网络标签（话题、昵称、广告词）贴在每个人头顶；变体：让标签根据人的站姿或停留时长而改变，讨论“算法如何给你贴标签”。
works.description_zh: 一件互动装置：深度相机追踪观众，在一面大型镜面屏幕上把取自社交媒体的身份标签附着在他们身上，随人漂浮。
works.idea_en: A digital mirror that tracks bodies and slaps online identity tags on every passerby in real time.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 深度相机对每位观众进行分割并追踪其骨架，openFrameworks 渲染文字标签，使其在镜面般的屏幕上跟随被追踪的头部或躯干位置。
works.exercise_en: Track several people in a webcam feed with MediaPipe Pose on a web page and stick randomly scraped online tags (hashtags, nicknames, ad slogans) above each person's head. Twist: make the tags change with a person's stance or how long they stay, and discuss "how algorithms label you".

works.title: Carbon Sink: What Goes Around, Comes Around
works.description: At the University of Wyoming, a 11-metre spiral of beetle-killed pine logs and lumps of coal made a direct link between fossil fuels, a warming climate and dying forests; it was removed after protests from the coal industry.
works.description_zh: 在怀俄明大学，一个直径 11 米、由被甲虫害死的松木和煤块组成的螺旋，把化石燃料、气候变暖与森林死亡直接联系起来；在煤炭行业抗议后被拆除。
works.idea_en: A simple spiral of two materials tells a cause-and-effect story; AR data art can be this direct and this local.
works.idea_zh: 由两种材料组成的简单螺旋讲出了因果故事；AR 数据艺术也可以如此直接、如此在地。
works.technique: Logs from local forests killed by pine beetles were arranged in a whirlpool with coal at its centre.
works.technique_zh: 来自当地被松甲虫害死的森林的原木被排成漩涡状，中心是煤块。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR spiral on campus from two scanned materials that stand for a local cause and effect (for example, cars and dead trees). Twist: tie the spiral's size to today's local air-quality index.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里用两种扫描材料搭建一个 AR 螺旋，分别代表本地的因与果（例如汽车与枯树）；变体：让螺旋大小与当天本地空气质量指数挂钩。

video.video_title: Chris Drury's Carbon Sink: What Goes Around, Comes Around

works.title: Carnation Rain (Largo do Carmo)
works.description: An AR rain of red carnations over Lisbon's Largo do Carmo, where the 1974 Carnation Revolution ended.
works.idea_zh: 在革命发生的广场上空下起AR康乃馨雨

video.video_title: Carnation Rain (Largo do Carmo), by Tamiko Thiel, 2011

works.technique: A GPS-anchored particle-like object (animated falling flowers) is placed over the historic square, using location as the carrier of historical meaning.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个有历史事件的校园或城市地点，用 Unity AR 让与事件相关的物体从天而降；变体：用粒子系统让落下的物体在地面上慢慢堆积成一个符号。
works.description_zh: 在里斯本卡尔穆广场（Largo do Carmo）上空降下一场红色康乃馨的 AR 花雨，1974 年的康乃馨革命正是在这里落幕。
works.idea_en: An AR rain of carnations falls over the square where the revolution took place.
works.technique_zh: 把一个以 GPS 锚定、类似粒子效果的对象（下落的花朵动画）放置在这座历史广场上空，以地理位置作为历史意义的载体。
works.exercise_en: Pick a campus or city location tied to a historical event and use Unity AR to make objects related to that event fall from the sky. Twist: use a particle system so the fallen objects slowly pile up on the ground into a symbol.

salient.why_en: Virtual carnations rain down on the square where the Carnation Revolution happened, marking history in place.
salient.why_zh: 虚拟康乃馨落在康乃馨革命发生的广场上，在原地标记这段历史。

works.title: Chase No Face / BELL
works.description: A music video in which graphics are projected onto singer BELL's face in real time with a hacked Kinect, face tracker and LED projector, with no post-production.
works.idea_zh: 音乐录影带里所有脸上的图形都是实时投影上去的，没有后期。

video.video_title: Chase No Face / BELL

works.technique: A Kinect provides depth for head pose while a 2D FaceTracker fits landmarks, and a calibrated projector renders textures onto the singer's face in real time; the camera-projector pair is registered so no post-production is needed.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 和投影仪给一段 30 秒的歌曲做现场投脸 MV，一镜到底拍下来；变体：每一句歌词换一种脸部“皮肤”，风格由组员抽签决定。
works.description_zh: 一支音乐录影带：利用破解的 Kinect、面部追踪器和 LED 投影仪，把图形实时投射到歌手 BELL 的脸上，全程没有后期制作。
works.idea_en: Every graphic on the faces in this music video was projected live, with no post-production.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 提供深度数据用于估计头部姿态，二维 FaceTracker 拟合面部特征点，经过标定的投影仪实时把纹理渲染到歌手脸上；相机与投影仪已完成配准，因此无需后期。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Face Mesh and a projector to make a live face-projection music video for a 30-second song, shot in one continuous take. Twist: switch to a different face "skin" for each line of lyrics, with the style decided by team members drawing lots.

works.title: Circle
works.description: A tabletop AR theatre in which small scenes and voices appear on a circle of markers, letting the reader move around the table to assemble a story; shortlisted for the UK New Media Writing Award.
works.description_zh: 一个桌面 AR 剧场：小小的场景和声音出现在一圈标记上，读者绕着桌子走动来拼出故事；入围英国新媒体写作奖。
works.idea_en: Reading becomes walking around a miniature stage.
works.idea_zh: 阅读变成绕着一座微缩舞台行走。
works.technique: SnapDragonAR, the York AR Lab's marker-tracking tool, maps video and sound to markers arranged in a ring; a later version was rebuilt for iPad with Vuforia.
works.technique_zh: 用约克 AR Lab 自己的标记追踪工具 SnapDragonAR，把视频和声音映射到围成一圈的标记上；后来的版本用 Vuforia 为 iPad 重做。
works.exercise_en: Place eight image markers in a circle on a table and attach a short scene to each, so walking around tells a story. Twist: the ending depends on which direction the reader walks.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌上摆一圈八张图像标记，每张对应一个小场景，绕着走一圈就讲完一个故事。变体：结局取决于读者走的方向。

video.video_title: circle: tabletop theatre -- first iteration

works.title: Cloud Cities
works.description: At Hamburger Bahnhof in Berlin, dozens of polyhedral modules, some walkable, some with plants or mirrors, float in the hall like a cluster of bubbles or a city in the clouds.
works.description_zh: 在柏林汉堡火车站美术馆，数十个多面体模块（有的可以走进去，有的装有植物或镜子）像一簇气泡或云中城市般漂浮在大厅里。
works.idea_en: Clusters of connected cells suggest how an AR city could grow modularly in the air above us.
works.idea_zh: 一簇相互连接的单元暗示了 AR 城市如何在我们头顶的空中模块化生长。
works.technique: Geodesic and polyhedral frames are covered with transparent and reflective films and held by cables.
works.technique_zh: 测地线与多面体框架覆以透明和反射薄膜，由缆绳悬挂。
works.exercise_en: Generate a cluster of connected AR bubbles in a room using a Voronoi or foam algorithm and let users add a new cell by tapping. Twist: cells with more visitors inside grow larger.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Voronoi 或泡沫算法在房间里生成一簇相连的 AR 气泡，让用户点按即可添加新单元；变体：内部访客越多的单元长得越大。

video.video_title: Tomas Saraceno: Cloud Cities. Interview

works.title: Coïncidence
works.description: A 20-minute juggled and danced duet in a minimal black space: abstract shapes and words projected around Adrien Mondot come alive, fall and scatter with the juggler's gestures, while Claire Bardainne plays the images live.
works.description_zh: 一段约 20 分钟的杂耍与舞蹈双人作品：在极简的黑色空间里，投影在 Adrien Mondot 周围的抽象图形和文字随他的动作活过来、坠落、散开，而影像由 Claire Bardainne 现场演奏。
works.idea_en: A duet between a body and a live-played image, where letters behave like juggled objects.
works.idea_zh: 身体和现场演奏的影像跳双人舞，文字像被抛接的物体一样运动。
works.technique: Projected typography and particles are driven by eMotion's physics engine and steered live by a digital performer, so the timing comes from a human partner rather than full body tracking.
works.technique_zh: 投影里的文字和粒子由 eMotion 的物理引擎驱动，由一位“数字演奏者”现场操控，所以节奏来自人与人的配合，而不是全身追踪。
works.exercise_en: Pair students as performer and image-player: one moves in front of a projection, the other drives falling words in a p5.js + matter.js sketch with a MIDI controller or keyboard, and they rehearse until the words seem to answer the body. Twist: swap roles without rehearsal and compare how much the illusion depends on timing.
works.exercise_zh: 学生两人一组，一人表演、一人演奏影像：表演者在投影前移动，演奏者用 MIDI 控制器或键盘操控 p5.js + matter.js 里下落的文字，反复排练直到文字像在回应身体。变体：不排练直接互换角色，比较这种错觉有多依赖节奏配合。

video.video_title: Coincidence - trailer

works.title: Crystal Coffin
works.description: During the Venice Biennale, a crystal coffin topped with a red star appears in Piazza San Marco and the Giardini, evoking Mao's embalmed body in Beijing.
works.description_zh: 威尼斯双年展期间，一具顶着红星的水晶棺出现在圣马可广场和绿园城堡，让人联想到北京保存的毛泽东遗体。
works.idea_en: Transplant a charged political relic into a tourist square.
works.idea_zh: 把一件极具政治意味的圣物移植到旅游广场。
works.technique: A 3D coffin model is geolocated at Venice landmarks in a mobile AR browser as part of Manifest.AR's uninvited intervention.
works.technique_zh: 作为 Manifest.AR 不请自来的介入行动的一部分，一个 3D 棺材模型通过移动 AR 浏览器定位在威尼斯地标处。
works.exercise_en: Pick a politically loaded object from another country and place it in AR at the busiest spot on campus. Twist: its label changes language depending on who opens it.
works.exercise_zh: 选一件来自其他国家、带有政治意味的物件，用 AR 放在校园最热闹的地方。变体：它的说明文字随打开者的语言而变化。

video.video_title: Crystal Coffin, Lily & Honglei

works.title: DUMMY lab
works.description: A circus show by Eike von Stuckenbrok and Markus Pabst where an acrobat performs with a live soundtrack by Reecode inside Weiss's reactive video installation.
works.description_zh: Eike von Stuckenbrok 与 Markus Pabst 的马戏演出：杂技演员在 Weiss 的反应式影像装置中表演，由 Reecode 现场配乐。
works.idea_en: Acrobatics against a wall of light that answers every fall and lift.
works.idea_zh: 杂技演员面对一堵光墙，每一次跌落和托举都得到它的回应。
works.technique: Real-time camera tracking of the acrobat feeds generative video projected behind and onto him, likely synchronised with the live electronic music.
works.technique_zh: 对杂技演员进行实时摄像头追踪，驱动投影在他身后和身上的生成影像，很可能与现场电子音乐同步。
works.exercise_en: Track a jumper with a webcam and project a trail that records the height of every jump on the wall. Twist: the trail becomes a staircase the performer tries to climb.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头追踪一个人跳跃，在墙上投影出记录每次跳跃高度的轨迹；变体：轨迹变成一段楼梯，表演者要试着“爬上去”。

video.video_title: DUMMY lab Offical Trailer - CHAMÄLEON

works.title: Dancing House
works.description: Interactive projection mapping on historic façades: the building bends, sways and 'dances' in response to the movements of people standing in front of it.
works.idea_zh: 你一动，整栋老建筑就跟着你扭动起舞
works.technique: A camera tracks the audience's body movement and maps it onto deformation parameters of a 3D model of the façade that is projection-mapped onto the building.
works.exercise_zh: 给一面墙或纸盒建筑拍照建模，用身体姿态（如MediaPipe Pose）控制投影贴图的弯曲；变化：两个人同时做相反动作时建筑会“撕裂”。

video.video_title: Dancing House – Klaus Obermaier

works.description_zh: 在历史建筑立面上进行的互动投影映射：建筑会随着站在它面前的人的动作弯曲、摇摆、“跳舞”。
works.idea_en: When you move, the whole old building twists and dances with you.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪观众的身体动作，将其映射为立面三维模型的形变参数，再把该模型投影映射到建筑上。
works.exercise_en: Photograph and model a wall or a cardboard building, and use body pose (such as MediaPipe Pose) to bend the projected texture. Twist: when two people make opposite moves at the same time, the building "tears".

works.title: Dancing With Swarming Particles
works.description: A performer faces a projected avatar made of flocking particles that drift aimlessly until the energy of her movement pulls them together into a copy of her body; afterwards visitors try their own swarm.
works.description_zh: 表演者面对一个由群集粒子构成的投影化身：粒子原本漫无目的地漂浮，直到她的动作能量把它们聚拢成自己身体的样子；演出后观众也可以试试自己的粒子群。
works.idea_en: Your body is a magnet that gathers a swarm into your own shape.
works.idea_zh: 你的身体像磁铁，把一群粒子聚成你的形状。
works.technique: A Kinect skeleton sent over OSC by OSCeleton drives a Unity3D flocking system, whose attraction to the joints grows with the performer's movement energy.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 骨骼数据通过 OSCeleton 以 OSC 发出，驱动 Unity3D 里的群集系统，粒子对关节的吸引力随表演者的运动能量增强。
works.exercise_en: Build a p5.js boids sketch attracted to MediaPipe body landmarks, with attraction scaled by how fast the person moves, and project it life-size. Twist: when two people stand close, let their swarms swap bodies.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 写一个被 MediaPipe 身体关键点吸引的鸟群（boids）程序，吸引力随人的移动速度缩放，并按真人比例投影；变体：两个人靠近时，让他们的粒子群互换身体。

video.video_title: Dancing With Swarming Particles [extracts]

works.title: Dash Dodge Dive
works.description: Crowd games for the London 2012 Olympics big screens: people in public squares across the UK compete against each other using body movements seen by the screens' cameras.
works.idea_zh: 全英多个广场的大屏联网，人群用身体动作跨城对战小游戏。

video.video_title: Dash Dodge Dive

works.technique: Big-screen cameras use motion detection (frame differencing or blob tracking) to measure crowd movement per zone, and scores are synchronised over a network between sites.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 把摄像头画面分成左右两区，统计每区的运动量作为两队的“力气”，玩一场投影拔河；变体：两个教室通过网络对战，赢的一方可以在对方屏幕上留下一句话。
works.description_zh: 为 2012 年伦敦奥运会大屏幕设计的群体游戏：英国各地公共广场上的人们，通过大屏幕摄像头捕捉的身体动作彼此比拼。
works.idea_en: Big screens in squares across the UK are linked so crowds battle other cities with their bodies.
works.technique_zh: 大屏幕上的摄像头通过运动检测（帧差或斑点追踪）按区域测量人群的运动量，分数通过网络在各个地点之间同步。
works.exercise_en: Split the camera image into left and right zones in p5.js, measure the amount of motion in each as the two teams' "strength", and play a projected tug-of-war. Twist: two classrooms compete over the network, and the winners get to leave a message on the other side's screen.

works.title: Divide By Zero
works.description: A dance film in which a performer's movements, guided by a hypnotherapist, drive interactive graphics that connect unconscious content with digital interfaces.
works.idea_zh: 在催眠引导下的舞蹈，把潜意识动作变成可见的界面
works.technique: Camera tracking of the dancer drives real-time generative graphics composited around her body (likely openFrameworks).
works.exercise_zh: 让同学闭眼听一段引导语即兴动作，摄像头把动作轨迹画成线条；变化：结束后让本人看回放，写下对“潜意识图形”的解读。

video.video_title: Divide By Zero

works.description_zh: 一部舞蹈影片：表演者在催眠师的引导下起舞，她的动作驱动互动图形，把潜意识内容与数字界面联系在一起。
works.idea_en: A dance under hypnotic guidance turns unconscious movement into a visible interface.
works.technique_zh: 通过摄像头追踪舞者，驱动围绕她身体合成的实时生成图形（大概率使用 openFrameworks）。
works.exercise_en: Have a classmate close their eyes and improvise movement while listening to a guided script, as a camera draws their motion trail as lines. Twist: afterward, let them watch the playback and write down their reading of the "subconscious graphics".

works.title: Drawing with the Body
works.description: Early Kinect experiments in which hands, feet and head become brushes that leave coloured strokes hanging in 3D space around the dancer.
works.description_zh: 早期的 Kinect 实验：手、脚和头都变成画笔，在舞者周围的三维空间里留下悬浮的彩色笔触。
works.idea_en: Every joint of the body is a brush that paints in the air.
works.idea_zh: 身体的每个关节都是一支在空中作画的笔。
works.technique: Kinect skeleton tracking via OpenNI/NITE and OSCeleton streams joint positions over OSC into Unity3D, which leaves trails behind chosen joints.
works.technique_zh: 通过 OpenNI/NITE 和 OSCeleton 进行 Kinect 骨骼追踪，把关节位置以 OSC 传入 Unity3D，在选定关节后方留下轨迹。
works.exercise_en: In AR Foundation or a WebXR sketch, attach a trail renderer to body-tracked wrists and ankles so a short dance leaves a 3D drawing you can walk around afterwards. Twist: fade each stroke at the speed it was drawn.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 或 WebXR 中，给被追踪的手腕和脚踝加上拖尾渲染，让一小段舞蹈留下一幅可以绕着走看的 3D 画；变体：每一笔以它被画出的速度渐渐消失。

video.video_title: Drawing with the Body // Kinect Experiments

works.title: Du, Liebe
works.description: A chamber dance opera with dancer Eva Maria Christ and a countertenor, staged inside Weiss's projected visual stage that frames and reshapes the performers.
works.description_zh: 一部室内舞蹈歌剧，舞者 Eva Maria Christ 与一位假声男高音在 Weiss 设计的投影视觉舞台中演出，影像为表演者勾勒边框并改变其形态。
works.idea_en: Projection mapping that follows people instead of buildings.
works.idea_zh: 跟随人而不是建筑的投影映射。
works.technique: Mapped projection onto the set and performers, likely combined with camera tracking so graphics stay registered to the moving dancer.
works.technique_zh: 在布景和表演者身上做投影映射，很可能结合摄像头追踪，让图形始终贴合移动中的舞者。
works.exercise_en: Map a projector onto a white box and a person standing next to it, then use pose tracking so a projected frame follows the person's torso. Twist: the frame refuses to follow when the singer's voice is loud.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影映射到一个白色箱子和站在旁边的人身上，再用姿态追踪让投影出的边框跟随人的躯干；变体：歌声很响时，边框拒绝跟随。

video.video_title: Du, Liebe (2011)

works.title: Echo
works.description: A 13-metre white head of a young girl with closed eyes, elongated as if seen in a distorting mirror, sat in Madison Square Park, New York, among the office towers.
works.description_zh: 一个 13 米高、双眼紧闭的少女白色头像，被拉长得像是在哈哈镜中所见，坐落在纽约麦迪逊广场公园的写字楼之间。
works.idea_en: A dreaming face among skyscrapers slows the pace of a busy street, showing how an AR figure can set a mood rather than deliver information.
works.idea_zh: 摩天楼之间一张做梦的脸放慢了繁忙街道的节奏，说明 AR 形象可以营造氛围，而不只是传递信息。
works.technique: A 3D scan of a girl's face is stretched digitally, then fabricated in resin and marble dust over a steel frame.
works.technique_zh: 少女面部的 3D 扫描经过数字拉伸，再用树脂与大理石粉覆在钢架上制作完成。
works.exercise_en: Place a large, calm AR face in the busiest spot of your campus and measure (by observation) whether people slow down near it. Twist: the face breathes slowly, synced to the average walking speed of passers-by.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园最繁忙的地方放一张安静的大型 AR 面孔，观察人们靠近时是否会放慢脚步；变体：面孔缓缓呼吸，节奏与路人的平均步速同步。

video.video_title: Jaume Plensa "Echo" at Madison Square Park, NYC

works.title: Exploded Views
works.description: A large cloud of thousands of LEDs hangs in the SFMOMA atrium; from a distance, flickering points turn into shadowy figures walking, running and falling, but up close they break into dots.
works.description_zh: 数千盏 LED 组成的一大片光云悬在旧金山现代艺术博物馆的中庭；远看，闪烁的光点变成行走、奔跑、跌倒的模糊人影，走近后它们又散成点。
works.idea_en: The eye completes very low-resolution images; AR does not need high fidelity to be convincing, and distance-based detail can be a design choice.
works.idea_zh: 眼睛会补全分辨率极低的图像；AR 不需要高保真也能令人信服，按距离决定细节可以是一种设计选择。
works.technique: Video footage is downsampled and mapped onto thousands of LEDs arranged in a 3D grid, so the image reads only from certain distances and angles.
works.technique_zh: 视频画面被降采样后映射到排成三维网格的数千盏 LED 上，图像只在特定距离和角度下才能被读出。
works.exercise_en: Render a video of people walking as a sparse 3D grid of glowing points in AR and fade the points to random noise as the viewer walks closer. Twist: let students record their own silhouettes as the source video.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 里把一段人行走的视频渲染成稀疏的三维发光点阵，观者走近时让光点逐渐变成随机噪点。变体：让同学录下自己的剪影作为源视频。

video.video_title: A large and flickering grid of light by Jim Campbell

works.title: EyePet & Friends
works.description: Two players can each raise a pet that play together in the living room, with new costume, drawing and mini-game modes.
works.idea_zh: 两只AR宠物在你的客厅里一起玩耍。

video.video_title: EyePet & Friends Trailer

works.technique: Two tracked controllers and pet instances share the camera-based floor frame, letting two players' pets interact in the same augmented video.
works.exercise_zh: 在同一个 AR 画面里放两只宠物，分别由两名玩家控制，让它们根据距离做出互动；变体：两只宠物有各自的性格，会产生冲突。
works.description_zh: 两位玩家可以各养一只宠物，让它们在客厅里一起玩耍，还加入了新的服装、绘画和小游戏模式。
works.idea_en: Two AR pets play together in your living room.
works.technique_zh: 两个被追踪的手柄和两只宠物实例共享基于摄像头的地面坐标系，让两位玩家的宠物能在同一段增强视频中互动。
works.exercise_en: Put two pets in the same AR view, each controlled by a different player, and have them interact based on their distance. Twist: give each pet its own personality so the two come into conflict.

works.title: Eyeshine
works.description: An installation that captures, records and replays the red-eye retroreflections from observers' eyes, revealing a normally invisible property of the human retina.
works.idea_zh: 捕捉观众眼睛的“红眼”反光，让人看到自己像夜行动物一样发光的眼睛。

video.video_title: Eyeshine (Interactive Installation, 2011)

works.technique: An infrared light source placed coaxially with an IR camera produces retroreflection from the retina (the red-eye effect), which is detected as bright pupil blobs and recorded and replayed.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机闪光灯贴近镜头在暗处拍人眼，或用红外摄像头，找出瞳孔反光并在 p5.js 里单独保存，排成一面“眼光墙”；变体：只收集对视超过 3 秒的人的眼光，讨论“被看见”的伦理。
works.description_zh: 这件装置捕捉、记录并回放观众眼中的“红眼”逆反射，让人类视网膜一种平时看不见的特性显现出来。
works.idea_en: Catch the red-eye glint in visitors' eyes so they see their own eyes glowing like a night animal's.
works.technique_zh: 红外光源与红外摄像头同轴放置，使视网膜产生逆反射（即红眼效应），系统把它检测为明亮的瞳孔光斑，再加以记录和回放。
works.exercise_en: In a dark room, photograph people's eyes with the phone flash held right next to the lens (or use an IR camera), isolate the pupil glints in p5.js and save them, then arrange them into a 'wall of eyeshine'. Twist: collect glints only from people who hold eye contact for more than 3 seconds, and discuss the ethics of 'being seen'.

salient.why_en: The glint in your own eyes is caught and shown back so they glow like a night animal's.
salient.why_zh: 捕捉你眼中的反光再显示给你看，你的眼睛像夜行动物一样发亮。

works.title: Eyjafjallajökull
works.description: Light is projected onto a hand-drawn wireframe mountain so the drawing appears to erupt, shift and transform into a volcano.
works.idea_zh: 投影让手绘线稿山体仿佛火山喷发

video.video_title: EYJAFJALLAJÖKULL

works.technique: A projector is aligned to a large hand-drawn wireframe on paper, and projected light and animation reveal, erase and extend the lines to create the illusion of an erupting 3D mountain.
works.exercise_zh: 用黑笔在白纸上画一座山的线框，再把投影对齐到线稿上，让光在线条之间流动模拟火山喷发；变体：换成自己家乡的一处地形，并加入一种当地的自然现象。
works.description_zh: 光被投射到一座手绘线框山体上，画面仿佛开始喷发、移动，最终化作一座火山。
works.idea_en: Projection makes a hand-drawn line mountain look like an erupting volcano.
works.technique_zh: 投影仪与纸上的大幅手绘线框图精确对齐，投射的光和动画对线条进行显现、擦除和延伸，营造出一座三维山体正在喷发的错觉。
works.exercise_en: Draw the wireframe of a mountain in black pen on white paper, align a projector to the drawing, and make light flow between the lines to simulate an eruption. Twist: use a landform from your hometown instead and add one local natural phenomenon.

works.title: Face Raiders
works.description: The 3DS takes a photo of your face (or a friend's) and turns it into flying enemy heads that attack through holes in your real room; you turn your body to aim and shoot.
works.idea_zh: 把你自己的脸变成敌人，从真实房间墙面破洞中飞出来攻击你。

video.video_title: Nintendo 3DS - New Owner's Guide: Face Raiders

works.technique: A captured face photo is texture-mapped onto enemy meshes, and the gyroscope rotates the virtual camera so enemies surround the player in a 360-degree space overlaid on the camera feed.
works.exercise_zh: 用前置摄像头拍一张脸，贴到 AR 中飞来飞去的球体上，转身用陀螺仪瞄准射击；变体：被击中的脸会做出不同表情。
works.description_zh: 3DS 给你（或朋友）拍一张脸部照片，再把它变成会飞的敌人头像，从真实房间墙上的破洞里冲出来攻击你；你需要转动身体来瞄准射击。
works.idea_en: Your own face becomes the enemy, bursting out of holes in your real room's walls to attack you.
works.technique_zh: 拍下的人脸照片被作为纹理贴到敌人网格上，陀螺仪驱动虚拟相机旋转，让敌人在叠加于摄像头画面的 360 度空间中包围玩家。
works.exercise_en: Take a face photo with the front camera, map it onto spheres flying around in AR, and turn your body to aim and shoot using the gyroscope. Twist: faces pull different expressions when they are hit.

salient.why_en: Your own face turns into the enemy that bursts through the walls of your room.
salient.why_zh: 你自己的脸变成敌人，从房间墙壁里破墙而出。

works.title: Face Substitution
works.description: Widely cited as the first realistic real-time face swap: another person's face is fitted and blended onto yours live from a webcam.
works.idea_zh: 最早的实时换脸：摄像头里你的脸被无缝替换成别人的脸。

video.video_title: Face Substitution

works.technique: FaceTracker fits a deformable landmark mesh to both the source and live face, the source texture is warped onto the live mesh, and color-transfer plus Poisson-style blending hides the seam.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 的三角网格把一张名画人物的脸贴到自己脸上，做简单的颜色匹配后实时换脸；变体：只换半张脸，做一面“一半是你一半是祖先”的镜子。
works.description_zh: 这件作品常被视为第一个逼真的实时换脸：通过网络摄像头，另一个人的脸被实时贴合并融合到你的脸上。
works.idea_en: The earliest live face swap: your face on the webcam is seamlessly replaced with someone else's.
works.technique_zh: FaceTracker 分别在源人脸和实时人脸上拟合可变形的特征点网格，把源人脸纹理扭曲贴到实时网格上，再用颜色迁移加类泊松融合来消除接缝。
works.exercise_en: Use the triangle mesh from MediaPipe Face Mesh to map the face of a figure from a famous painting onto your own, apply simple color matching, and swap faces in real time. Twist: swap only half the face to make a mirror that is 'half you, half your ancestor'.

works.title: Flight Assembled Architecture (with Gramazio Kohler)
works.description: Small quadcopters pick up foam bricks one by one and stack 1,500 of them into a curved six-metre tower inside a gallery, the first building assembled by flying robots.
works.description_zh: 小型四旋翼逐块抓起泡沫砖，在展厅里把 1500 块砖垒成一座六米高的弯曲高塔，这是第一座由飞行机器人建造的建筑。
works.idea_en: Flying machines can build in places people cannot reach; AR can preview such aerial construction by showing each flight path and each placed piece in sequence.
works.idea_zh: 飞行器可以在人到不了的地方建造；AR 可以按顺序展示每一条航线和每一块放下的构件，预演这种空中建造。
works.technique: A motion-capture system tracks the quadcopters indoors while software plans each brick's pick-up and placement path from a digital architectural model.
works.technique_zh: 室内动作捕捉系统追踪四旋翼的位置，软件根据数字建筑模型规划每一块砖的抓取和放置路径。
works.exercise_en: Program an AR swarm of virtual drones that fetch blocks from a real table and stack them into a tower on the floor, one block per second, with visible flight lines. Twist: let a student change the tower's design mid-build and watch the drones re-plan.
works.exercise_zh: 编写一个 AR 虚拟无人机群：它们从真实桌面上取积木，每秒一块，把积木在地面上搭成一座塔，并显示飞行路线。变体：建到一半时让同学修改塔的设计，看无人机重新规划。

video.video_title: Flight Assembled Architecture, 2011-2012, FRAC Centre Orléans

works.title: Flow
works.description: An interactive floor-projection installation at the Cinedans Festival in Amsterdam where people walking and dancing across the floor set flowing visual fields in motion.
works.description_zh: 在阿姆斯特丹 Cinedans 电影舞蹈节展出的交互地面投影装置，人们在地面上行走、舞动，带动流动的视觉场。
works.idea_en: The floor behaves like water that remembers every step.
works.idea_zh: 地面像水一样，记住每一步。
works.technique: An overhead camera tracks bodies on the floor and injects their motion into a fluid-like simulation projected from above.
works.technique_zh: 顶部摄像头追踪地面上的人体，把他们的运动注入一个类似流体的模拟，再从上方投影下来。
works.exercise_en: Point a projector and webcam at the floor, use frame differences as forces in a 2D fluid simulation, and let people walk through it. Twist: two people moving in sync create a calm zone.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影仪和摄像头对准地面，用帧间差作为二维流体模拟的力，让人们从中走过；变体：两个人同步移动时，会形成一片平静区域。

video.video_title: Flow@Cinedans 2011, interactive video installation

works.title: Fruit Ninja Kinect
works.description: Players stand in front of the TV and see their own silhouette among flying fruit; any fast sweep of an arm or leg slices the fruit, so whole-body flailing becomes the controller.
works.description_zh: 玩家站在电视前，看到自己的身体剪影混在飞舞的水果中；手臂或腿的任何快速挥动都能切开水果，全身乱舞就是控制器。
works.idea_en: Your full-body silhouette is the blade.
works.idea_zh: 你的全身剪影就是刀刃。
works.technique: Kinect depth sensing segments the player's silhouette and skeleton; fast-moving limb joints generate slicing trails that hit fruit.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 深度感应分割出玩家的剪影和骨架，快速移动的肢体关节生成切割轨迹去击中水果。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam with MediaPipe Pose to draw the player's silhouette and make wrists and ankles leave slicing trails that cut falling shapes. Twist: allow two players and give points only when both slice the same object at once.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头加 MediaPipe Pose 绘制玩家剪影，让手腕和脚踝留下切割轨迹，切开下落的图形。变体：允许两名玩家同时参与，只有两人同时切中同一个物体才得分。

video.video_title: E3 2011: Fruit Ninja Kinect

works.title: Holistic Strata
works.description: Commissioned by YCAM, the piece surrounds Umeda with dense layers of projected particles and lines on the floor and screen, which seem to flow around and through his body.
works.description_zh: 这件由 YCAM 委托的作品用地板和屏幕上层层叠叠的投影粒子和线条包围梅田宏明，看起来像在他身体周围和体内流动。
works.idea_en: A particle field that behaves like a medium around the dancer shows how AR can make empty space feel thick and physical.
works.idea_zh: 像介质一样环绕舞者的粒子场，展示了 AR 如何让空荡的空间显得浓稠而有实体感。
works.technique: Sensing by YCAM engineers feeds programmed image systems by S20, Satoru Higa and Yoshito Onishi that render particle fields in real time.
works.technique_zh: YCAM 工程师搭建的感应系统把数据传给 S20、比嘉了和大西义人编写的影像程序，实时渲染粒子场。
works.exercise_en: Fill a room with an AR particle field in Unity AR Foundation that parts around a tracked body like water. Twist: particles remember where the body passed and slowly refill the gap.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Unity AR Foundation 在房间里铺满 AR 粒子场，粒子像水一样绕开被追踪的身体；变体：粒子会记住身体经过的路径，再慢慢把空隙填回去。

video.video_title: Holistic Strata - excerpt

works.title: ISAM Live
works.description: Amon Tobin performs his album ISAM from inside a large sculpture of stacked white cubes, which projection mapping turns into machines, spaceships, collapsing walls and landscapes in sync with the music.
works.description_zh: Amon Tobin 在一组巨大的白色方块堆叠雕塑里演出专辑 ISAM，投影映射把雕塑随音乐变成机器、飞船、崩塌的墙和风景。
works.idea_en: When the whole set is one mapped object, the performer becomes part of the image; AR stages can wrap virtual worlds around a real body the same way.
works.idea_zh: 当整个布景是一个被映射的物体时，表演者就成了画面的一部分；AR 舞台也可以用同样方式把虚拟世界包裹在真人周围。
works.technique: A cube structure designed by Vita Motus is mapped by V Squared Labs and Leviathan, with visuals cued to the music and the performer sitting inside a central cube.
works.technique_zh: 由 Vita Motus 设计的方块结构，由 V Squared Labs 和 Leviathan 进行映射，影像随音乐触发，表演者坐在中间的方块里。
works.exercise_en: Stack a few white boxes around a desk, track them in AR with image or object tracking, and play music while AR machinery unfolds across the boxes. Twist: the performer's hand gestures trigger each collapse.
works.exercise_zh: 在书桌周围堆几个白盒子，用图像或物体追踪在 AR 中识别它们，播放音乐时让 AR 机械在盒子上展开；变体：由表演者的手势触发每一次崩塌。

video.video_title: Amon Tobin 'ISAM' Live (Extended Trailer)

works.title: Imaginary Phone
works.description: Users operate their iPhone without taking it out of their pocket by tapping and swiping on the palm of their other hand, where they remember the phone's home-screen layout; a wearable depth camera sends those touches to the real phone.
works.description_zh: 用户不用把 iPhone 从口袋里拿出来，只要在另一只手的掌心上点按、滑动——他们记得手机主屏幕的布局——可穿戴深度相机就会把这些触摸传给真正的手机。
works.idea_en: Use your palm as a screenless phone, relying only on memory of where the icons are.
works.idea_zh: 把手掌当成没有屏幕的手机，只凭记忆知道图标在哪儿。
works.technique: A worn depth camera tracks the finger touching the palm and maps the touch position onto the phone's icon grid, transferring spatial memory from the physical device.
works.technique_zh: 佩戴的深度相机追踪手指触摸掌心的位置，并把它映射到手机的图标网格上，把人们对实体手机的空间记忆迁移过来。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Hands to detect which of nine palm zones your index finger touches and map them to phone actions (play music, next track, torch). Twist: design the imaginary interface on your forearm instead of your palm.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands 识别食指点中了掌心九宫格中的哪一格，并把它们映射到手机操作上（播放音乐、下一首、手电筒）。变体：把想象中的界面设计在前臂上，而不是掌心。

video.video_title: UIST 2011 - Imaginary Phone

works.title: Immaterials: Light painting WiFi
works.description: A 4 m rod of 80 LEDs shows the WiFi signal strength as a bar graph while it is walked through Oslo streets; long exposures turn the readings into glowing walls of data in the city.
works.description_zh: 一根装有 80 颗 LED、长 4 米的灯杆以柱状图显示 WiFi 信号强度，被人扛着走过奥斯陆街头；长曝光把这些读数变成城市中发光的数据墙。
works.idea_en: Walking a sensor through the city and drawing its readings in place is situated data visualization — the core promise of AR data overlays.
works.idea_zh: 带着传感器走过城市并在原地画出它的读数，就是“就地的数据可视化”——这正是 AR 数据叠加的核心承诺。
works.technique: A measuring rod with an LED bar graph displays live RSSI readings, photographed with long exposures as it moves along a path.
works.technique_zh: 装有 LED 柱状图的测量杆实时显示 RSSI 读数，沿路径移动时用长曝光拍下。
works.exercise_en: Log WiFi or cellular signal strength with GPS while walking a campus route, then display it as a vertical bar wall along the route in AR. Twist: let two groups log different networks and show both walls side by side.
works.exercise_zh: 沿校园路线步行，同时记录 WiFi 或蜂窝信号强度与 GPS，再在 AR 中沿路线显示成一堵竖直的柱状墙；变体：让两组人记录不同的网络，并排显示两堵墙。

video.video_title: Immaterials: Light painting WiFi

salient.why_en: A rod of lights walked down the street draws the invisible WiFi signal as a glowing wall.
salient.why_zh: 扛着一根灯杆走过街道，把看不见的 WiFi 信号画成一道发光的墙。

works.title: In-Place AR 3D Sketching of Mechanical Systems
works.description: Students sketch simple physics setups such as springs, masses and slopes on paper; the camera recognizes the diagram and runs a 3D simulation on top of it, which changes as the sketch is edited.
works.description_zh: 学生在纸上画出弹簧、质量块和斜面等简单物理装置；摄像头识别出示意图，并在上面运行 3D 模拟，修改草图时模拟也随之改变。
works.idea_en: A physics textbook diagram you draw yourself becomes a live experiment.
works.idea_zh: 自己画的物理课本示意图变成一场实时实验。
works.technique: Sketch parsing turns diagram symbols into rigid bodies and constraints for a physics engine, rendered in 3D over the tracked paper.
works.technique_zh: 草图解析把示意图符号转成物理引擎中的刚体和约束，并在被追踪的纸面上以 3D 渲染。
works.exercise_en: Let students draw a slope and a circle on paper, detect them, and simulate a ball rolling down in AR with adjustable gravity. Twist: add a spring symbol that bounces the ball back.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生在纸上画一个斜面和一个圆，识别后在 AR 中模拟小球沿斜面滚下，并可调节重力。变体：加入一个弹簧符号，把小球弹回去。

video.video_title: In-Place Augmented Reality 3D Sketching of Mechanical Systems

works.title: Infinity Mirrored Room – Filled with the Brilliance of Life
works.description: Visitors walk a path over a shallow pool inside a mirror-lined room where hundreds of coloured LEDs hang at different heights and slowly change colour, shown at Tate Modern in 2021–22.
works.description_zh: 观众沿着浅水池上的小路走进四壁皆镜的房间，数百盏彩色 LED 高低错落地悬挂并缓慢变色；该作品于 2021–22 年在泰特现代美术馆展出。
works.idea_en: When the body is inside the reflection, the viewer becomes part of the pattern; AR that includes the user's own reflection feels far more immersive than AR the user only looks at.
works.idea_zh: 当身体进入倒影之中，观众自己就成了图案的一部分：把用户自己也「反射」进去的 AR，比只让人旁观的 AR 更有包围感。
works.technique: Two-way recursive mirrors on walls and ceiling plus a reflective pool multiply a few hundred programmed LED bulbs into an apparently endless field.
works.technique_zh: 墙面和天花上的镜子互相反射，再加上水池倒影，把几百个可编程 LED 灯泡放大成看似无尽的光场。
works.exercise_en: Use Lens Studio or WebXR to hang 200 small coloured spheres around the user, then add a mirrored duplicate of the whole cluster below the floor and let colours cycle slowly. Twist: insert a simple avatar that copies the user's head position into the mirrored copy, so the user sees themself among the lights.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 WebXR 在用户周围悬挂 200 个彩色小球，再在地面下方复制一份镜像，让颜色慢慢循环。变体：在镜像中加入一个跟随用户头部位置的简易化身，让用户看到自己站在光点之间。

video.video_title: Yayoi Kusama: Infinity Mirror Rooms at Tate Modern | Tate

works.title: Inside - Out
works.description: A shop installation where cameras and projectors transport the activity of one space into another, creating surprising feedback loops between viewers and participants.
works.idea_zh: 把一个空间里的人实时投进另一个空间，形成互相观看的回路
works.technique: Live camera feeds from one room are processed and projected into the other (and back), forming a two-way video feedback loop.
works.exercise_zh: 用两台笔记本在走廊两端互相视频并投影到墙上，让两边的人玩“隔墙互动”；变化：只显示对方的剪影，并交换左右。

video.video_title: Inside - Out

works.description_zh: 一件店铺装置：摄像头和投影仪把一个空间里的活动传送到另一个空间，在观看者与参与者之间形成出人意料的反馈回路。
works.idea_en: Project people from one space live into another so both sides end up watching each other.
works.technique_zh: 一个房间的实时摄像画面经处理后投影到另一个房间（反之亦然），形成双向的视频反馈回路。
works.exercise_en: Set up two laptops at opposite ends of a hallway, video-call between them and project each feed onto the wall so people on both sides can play across the wall. Twist: show only the other side's silhouettes, mirrored left to right.

works.title: Inside Out Project
works.description: Funded by the TED Prize, Inside Out invites any community to send portraits that JR's team prints as posters, which people paste together on walls in their own town; over 500,000 people have taken part.
works.description_zh: 由 TED 奖资助的 Inside Out 项目邀请任何社区寄来肖像，JR 的团队把它们印成海报，由人们在自己的城镇墙上一起张贴；已有超过五十万人参与。
works.idea_en: A simple, repeatable format that anyone can deploy turns an artwork into a global platform, the dream of every social AR template.
works.idea_zh: 一个任何人都能部署的简单、可复制的形式，把一件作品变成了全球平台，这是每个社交 AR 模板的梦想。
works.technique: A photo-booth truck prints large black-and-white portraits on the spot; participants paste them with wheat paste.
works.technique_zh: 照相亭卡车现场打印大幅黑白肖像，参与者用面粉浆把它们贴上墙。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebAR 'photo booth' that turns a selfie into a black-and-white poster and pins it to a shared wall anchor where every visitor's poster accumulates. Twist: the wall shows only faces of people who are nearby right now.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个 WebAR“照相亭”，把自拍变成黑白海报并钉到一个共享的墙面锚点上，所有访客的海报在此累积；变体：墙上只显示此刻就在附近的人的面孔。

video.video_title: JR on Inside Out Project

works.title: Interactive Body Projection Mapping (Hypermetrop)
works.description: During a residency with hip-hop dancers, audio-reactive textures are projected precisely onto the dancers' moving bodies while they perform.
works.description_zh: 在与街舞舞者的驻留创作中，随音乐变化的纹理被精确投射到正在表演的舞者身上。
works.idea_en: Clothe moving dancers in live projected light.
works.idea_zh: 给正在移动的舞者穿上一件实时投影的光之衣。
works.technique: A Kinect calibrated to the projector segments the dancers' bodies, and openFrameworks renders audio-reactive graphics masked to their silhouettes.
works.technique_zh: 与投影仪校准的 Kinect 分割出舞者身体，openFrameworks 渲染随音频变化、只落在身体轮廓内的图形。
works.exercise_en: Calibrate a depth camera or webcam segmentation to a projector and project a pattern only onto a moving person. Twist: the pattern changes each time the dancer claps.
works.exercise_zh: 把深度相机或摄像头人像分割与投影仪校准，只在移动的人身上投射图案。变体：舞者每拍一次手，图案就换一次。

video.video_title: Interactive Body Projection Mapping for Hypermetrop - Test 2 - December 2011

works.title: Interactive Surface with Projection-based Wearable System
works.description: A wearable projector and camera turn nearby surfaces into touch interfaces: menus are projected onto a wall or table and the user taps them with a finger.
works.description_zh: 可穿戴的投影仪和摄像头把附近的表面变成触控界面：菜单被投射到墙面或桌面上，用户用手指点击即可操作。
works.idea_en: Carry your interface with you and project it onto whatever surface is nearby.
works.idea_zh: 把界面随身带着，投射到身边任何表面上。
works.technique: Likely calibrates a body-worn projector-camera pair so the camera detects fingertip contact on the projected image.
works.technique_zh: 很可能对佩戴在身上的投影仪与摄像头进行标定，让摄像头检测指尖在投影画面上的触碰。
works.exercise_en: Mount a pico projector or a phone projector on a strap, project three buttons on a desk, and use a second phone's camera to detect which one a finger covers. Twist: project on your own forearm.
works.exercise_zh: 把微型投影仪或手机投影绑在带子上，在桌面上投出三个按钮，用第二部手机的摄像头检测手指遮住了哪个；变体：投射到自己的前臂上。

video.video_title: Interactive surface with projection-based wearable system

works.title: Into the Forest
works.description: A stereoscopic 3D installation of a painterly forest where virtual children play; when a spotlight comes on, any visitor stepping into it is captured and placed inside the 3D world among the children.
works.description_zh: 一件立体 3D 装置：画意般的森林里有虚拟的孩子在玩耍；当聚光灯亮起，任何走进光圈的访客都会被捕捉下来，放进 3D 世界，与孩子们混在一起。
works.idea_en: Step into a spotlight and you become a figure in a painted 3D world.
works.idea_zh: 走进聚光灯，你就变成一个画中 3D 世界里的人物。
works.technique: A camera captures the visitor inside the lit area, and the extracted figure is rendered as a painterly element within a real-time stereoscopic scene built in Field.
works.technique_zh: 摄像机捕捉站在光圈内的访客，提取出的人物以绘画风格渲染进 Field 构建的实时立体场景中。
works.exercise_en: Mark a spot on the floor with tape and a lamp; when someone stands there, cut them out with segmentation and composite them into a projected illustrated scene. Twist: the longer they stand still, the more painterly they become.
works.exercise_zh: 用胶带和一盏灯在地上标出一个点；有人站上去时，用人像分割把他抠出来，合成进投影的插画场景；变体：站得越久不动，人物就越像画。

video.video_title: Into the Forest (interaction) at Museum of Moving Image 2010

works.title: Invisible Istanbul: Captured (for #RSF_RWB)
works.description: Tweets from Reporters Without Borders, with every meaningful word censored, are animated on the inside of a sphere that surrounds the viewer in Istanbul.
works.description_zh: 来自无国界记者组织的推文，所有有实际意义的词都被审查涂黑，在伊斯坦布尔以动画形式排列在包围观众的球体内壁上。
works.idea_en: Put the viewer inside a bubble of censored speech.
works.idea_zh: 把观众放进一个被审查言论组成的气泡里。
works.technique: Censored tweet text is mapped as animated textures onto the inner surface of a sphere geolocated around the viewer in a mobile AR browser, for ISEA2011 at the Istanbul Biennale.
works.technique_zh: 为伊斯坦布尔双年展期间的 ISEA2011 而作：把被审查的推文文字作为动画纹理贴在球体内壁上，并在移动 AR 浏览器中定位到观众周围。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR or phone-AR sphere around the viewer covered with live text from a feed, with keywords blacked out. Twist: blacked-out words reveal themselves when the viewer stands still.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或手机 AR 在观众周围做一个球体，内壁布满来自某个信息流的实时文字，关键词被涂黑。变体：观众站着不动时，被涂黑的词会显露出来。

video.video_title: "Invisible Istanbul: Captured (for #RSF_RWB)" Istanbul Biennale 2011 AR Intervention

works.title: Invizimals: The Lost Tribes
works.description: Third PSP entry with new tribes of Invizimals to hunt through the camera and battle on the marker trap card.
works.idea_zh: 用摄像头寻找新部族怪兽，并在卡片上对战。

video.video_title: Invizimals The Lost Tribes Gamescom 2011 Trailer PSP

works.technique: The marker card defines the arena origin, and creatures from different sets are rendered in the card's frame with turn-based battle animations.
works.exercise_zh: 用两张不同的图像标记卡分别召唤两个阵营的角色，让它们在桌上回合制对战；变体：把两张卡的距离作为攻击范围的一个参数。
works.description_zh: PSP 上的第三部作品，加入了新的 Invizimals 部族，玩家要通过摄像头搜寻它们，并在标记陷阱卡上展开对战。
works.idea_en: Hunt new tribes of monsters through the camera and battle them on a card.
works.technique_zh: 标记卡定义了竞技场的原点，不同系列的生物被渲染在卡片的坐标系中，并配有回合制战斗动画。
works.exercise_en: Use two different image-marker cards to summon characters from two factions and have them fight turn-based battles on the table. Twist: use the distance between the two cards as a parameter for attack range.

works.title: Jasmine Rain (birdcage)
works.description: A birdcage of falling jasmine blossoms, a symbol of the Arab Spring, is placed uninvited in MoMA's atrium, and also in Tahrir Square, Tiananmen Square and other sites.
works.description_zh: 一个由飘落茉莉花组成的鸟笼（阿拉伯之春的象征）不请自来地出现在 MoMA 中庭，也出现在解放广场、天安门广场等地。
works.idea_en: One symbolic object installed simultaneously in a museum and in sites of revolution.
works.idea_zh: 同一件象征物，同时装进美术馆和革命现场。
works.technique: The same animated 3D sculpture is published at multiple geolocations in a mobile AR browser, so it exists in several cities at once.
works.technique_zh: 把同一件动画 3D 雕塑发布到移动 AR 浏览器的多个地理坐标上，让它同时存在于多座城市。
works.exercise_en: Create one small AR sculpture and publish it at three distant locations with friends in other cities, then compare photos. Twist: each location changes its colour based on local news.
works.exercise_zh: 做一件小型 AR 雕塑，和其他城市的朋友一起把它发布到三个遥远的地点，再比较照片。变体：每个地点的颜色根据当地新闻变化。

video.video_title: "Jasmine Rain (birdcage)" in MoMA NY

works.title: KinectFusion
works.description: Sweep a Kinect around a room and a dense 3D model is built in real time; virtual particles then bounce off and splash onto real surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 拿着Kinect扫一圈，实时重建整个房间，虚拟粒子能撞到真实桌面上。

video.video_title: KinectFusion HQ

works.technique: Depth frames are aligned with ICP to estimate camera pose and fused into a GPU truncated signed distance function (TSDF) volume, whose ray-cast surface serves as a collision mesh for virtual particles.
works.exercise_zh: 用 LiDAR iPhone 的 AR Foundation Meshing 实时生成房间网格，然后撒下上千个虚拟粒子，让它们在真实桌面、沙发上弹跳堆积；变体：把粒子换成会“生长”的东西（苔藓、藤蔓）沿网格蔓延。
works.description_zh: 拿着 Kinect 在房间里扫一圈，就能实时构建出稠密的三维模型；随后虚拟粒子会在真实表面上弹跳、飞溅。
works.idea_en: Sweep a Kinect around once to rebuild the whole room live, and virtual particles can hit the real table.
works.technique_zh: 用 ICP 对齐深度帧来估计相机位姿，并把深度数据融合进 GPU 上的截断符号距离函数（TSDF）体素中；对该体素进行光线投射得到的表面，被用作虚拟粒子的碰撞网格。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation Meshing on a LiDAR iPhone to generate a live room mesh, then scatter thousands of virtual particles and let them bounce and pile up on the real table and sofa. Twist: replace the particles with something that 'grows' (moss, vines) and spreads along the mesh.

works.title: La Belle et la Bête
works.description: A contemporary retelling of Beauty and the Beast, co-produced with Théâtre du Nouveau Monde, where the Beast's enchanted castle, spirits and transformations appear as projected apparitions around the actors. It toured to Toronto's Luminato Festival, Boston and Taipei.
works.description_zh: 与新世界剧院（Théâtre du Nouveau Monde）合作的当代版《美女与野兽》，野兽的魔法城堡、精灵和变身都以投影幻象出现在演员周围。作品曾巡演至多伦多 Luminato 艺术节、波士顿和台北。
works.idea_en: Transformation is the most powerful AR moment: showing a body change in place, right next to real people, is more affecting than any new world.
works.idea_zh: 变形是最有力量的 AR 时刻：让一具身体就在真人身旁原地变化，比任何新世界都更打动人。
works.technique: Large-scale projections on transparent scrims create volumetric-looking illusions combined with live actors, lighting and film sequences.
works.technique_zh: 在透明纱幕上做大尺度投影，结合真人演员、灯光和影片段落，营造看似立体的幻象。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR 'transformation mirror': use body or face tracking so a user's outline slowly morphs into an animal silhouette over 30 seconds. Twist: the transformation reverses only when a second person steps into the frame.
works.exercise_zh: 做一面手机 AR“变身镜”：利用人体或人脸追踪，让用户的轮廓在 30 秒内慢慢变成动物剪影；变体：只有当第二个人走进画面时，变身才会逆转。

video.video_title: Lemieux Pilon 4D Art - La Belle et la Bête

works.title: Lit Tree
works.description: A small potted tree is scanned and projected onto so its leaves act as 3D pixels; visitors' hands are scanned over a plinth and reflected as volumes of light inside the tree.
works.idea_zh: 把一棵真树的叶子当作三维像素投影，人的手势在树里“亮”起来。

video.video_title: Lit Tree

works.technique: Structured-light scanning with a projector and Kinect maps every projector pixel to a 3D point on the leaves, turning the tree into a sparse volumetric display that lights voxels inside a scanned hand volume.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影仪对着一盆植物，用 TouchDesigner 逐行扫描记录哪些像素打到叶子上，再只点亮叶子画出上下移动的光平面；变体：用 MediaPipe 手的高度控制光平面，像用手抚摸这棵树。
works.description_zh: 一棵小盆栽树被扫描并投影，树叶因此成为三维像素；观众的手在底座上方被扫描，化作一团光出现在树冠之中。
works.idea_en: Use the leaves of a real tree as 3D pixels, so a visitor's hand gesture lights up inside the tree.
works.technique_zh: 利用投影仪和 Kinect 做结构光扫描，把每个投影像素对应到树叶上的一个三维点，从而把树变成一个稀疏的体积显示器，点亮位于扫描所得手部体积之内的体素。
works.exercise_en: Aim a projector at a potted plant, scan line by line in TouchDesigner to record which pixels land on leaves, then light only the leaves to draw a plane of light moving up and down. Twist: use hand height from MediaPipe to control the light plane, as if stroking the tree.

works.title: Little Magic Stories
works.description: Children perform stories on a small stage with drawn props and costumes; Kinect tracking and projection bring their imagined characters and scenery to life in front of an audience.
works.idea_zh: 孩子在小舞台上表演，自己画的角色和布景被投影实时“变活”。

video.video_title: Little Magic Stories

works.technique: Kinect skeleton and depth tracking follow the children on stage, and colored props are recognised to trigger projected characters and scenery tied to their positions.
works.exercise_zh: 给小组发几张画好的纸道具，用颜色识别触发投影背景和角色，用 MediaPipe Pose 让角色跟着表演者走，表演 3 分钟的小故事；变体：观众鼓掌的音量决定下一幕的场景。
works.description_zh: 孩子们用自己画的道具和服装在小舞台上表演故事；借助 Kinect 追踪和投影，他们想象中的角色与布景在观众面前活了起来。
works.idea_en: Children act on a small stage while the characters and sets they drew come alive through projection.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 的骨骼与深度追踪跟随舞台上的孩子，系统识别彩色道具来触发投影角色和布景，并将其与孩子的位置绑定。
works.exercise_en: Give each group a few drawn paper props, use color detection to trigger projected backgrounds and characters, use MediaPipe Pose to make characters follow the performers, and stage a 3-minute story. Twist: the loudness of the audience's applause picks the scene for the next act.

works.title: Lookout Rabbit
works.description: A 12-metre rabbit with a red dot on its side stands in Valkhof Park in Nijmegen; visitors can climb inside and look out over the river Waal.
works.description_zh: 一只 12 米高、身侧有一个红点的兔子立在奈梅亨的法尔克霍夫公园；游客可以爬进去俯瞰瓦尔河。
works.idea_en: A giant figure you can enter and look out of turns a sculpture into a viewpoint, an idea for AR creatures that become portals.
works.idea_zh: 一个可以进入并向外眺望的巨型形象，把雕塑变成了观景点，这为可变成传送门的 AR 生物提供了思路。
works.technique: A timber frame shaped like a rabbit contains stairs and a viewing opening at the red dot.
works.technique_zh: 兔子形状的木框架内设有楼梯，红点处是观景开口。
works.exercise_en: Place a giant AR animal with a door; when the user steps inside, switch to a view from its eyes, showing the landscape from its height. Twist: the animal's eyes follow wherever the user was looking before entering.
works.exercise_zh: 放置一只带门的巨型 AR 动物；当用户走进去，切换到它眼睛的视角，以它的高度观看风景；变体：动物的眼睛会看向用户进入前正在看的方向。

video.video_title: Lookout Rabbit 02.mov

works.title: Loops
works.description: An abstract portrait of Merce Cunningham built from motion capture of his solo dance for hands: the joints become nodes in a shifting cat's-cradle network while his voice, reading a boyhood diary, drives a virtual prepared piano.
works.description_zh: Merce Cunningham 的抽象肖像，来自他为双手创作的独舞的动作捕捉：关节变成不断变化的“翻花绳”网络中的节点，他朗读少年日记的声音驱动着一架虚拟预置钢琴。
works.idea_en: Portray a person by their motion, not their appearance.
works.idea_zh: 用一个人的动作而不是外貌来为他画像。
works.technique: Hand motion-capture data are treated as a network of nodes whose connections are rewired by autonomous agents in Field, rendered in 3D, and released as open-source choreography data.
works.technique_zh: 手部动捕数据被当作节点网络，其连接由 Field 中的自主代理不断重连，以 3D 渲染，并作为开源编舞数据公开。
works.exercise_en: Track a classmate's hands with MediaPipe for 30 seconds, then draw lines between all 42 landmarks whose distance is below a threshold, creating a moving web. Twist: sonify the number of connections as a piano pitch.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 追踪一位同学的双手 30 秒，在 42 个关键点中把距离低于阈值的点两两连线，形成一张流动的网；变体：把连线数量转成钢琴音高。

video.video_title: Loops — 3D version, 2011

works.title: Luminous Flux
works.description: For the Liver Building's 100th anniversary, Liverpool's waterfront landmark is covered in moving light that makes its clock towers ripple, fold and open up above the crowd.
works.description_zh: 为庆祝利物浦皇家利物大厦百年诞辰，这座海滨地标被流动的光覆盖，钟楼在人群头顶起伏、折叠、打开。
works.idea_en: A city celebrates a building by letting light rewrite its stone.
works.idea_zh: 一座城市用光改写石头，来为一栋建筑庆生。
works.technique: Animations are rendered against a surveyed model of the façade and played through edge-blended projectors so the illusions of depth line up with real ornaments.
works.technique_zh: 动画依据测绘得到的立面模型渲染，经边缘融合的投影机播放，使虚假的纵深感与真实的装饰构件对齐。
works.exercise_en: Map a staircase or doorway on campus and create one illusion that makes the real structure look soft, flexible or hollow. Twist: sync the illusion to a clock so it happens exactly on the hour.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里选一段楼梯或一个门洞做投影，创造一种让真实结构看起来变软、变弯或变空的错觉；变体：把错觉与时钟同步，每到整点准时出现。

video.video_title: Luminous Flux

works.title: MOTIV
works.description: Russ's SVA MFA thesis: a hacked Kinect follows a performer's body so that gestures shape the velocity and tempo of a playing song, while on-screen graphics mirror and guide the moves.
works.description_zh: Russ 在 SVA 的硕士毕业设计：破解的 Kinect 追踪表演者的身体，用手势实时控制正在播放的乐曲的力度和速度，屏幕上的图形同步反馈并引导动作。
works.idea_en: Let the body, not an instrument, control the emotion of music.
works.idea_zh: 不用学乐器，用身体动作直接控制音乐的情绪。
works.technique: A Kinect depth camera tracks the performer's movement and maps it in real time to expression parameters such as note velocity and tempo of a multi-track MIDI sequence.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 深度相机追踪表演者的动作，实时映射到多轨 MIDI 序列的表情参数上，例如音符力度和速度。
works.exercise_en: Map one tracked body feature (hand height or arm spread) to the volume and tempo of a looping track with a webcam pose tracker, then perform a 30-second piece. Twist: map two performers to different instruments so they must play together.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头姿态识别，把一个身体特征（手的高度或双臂张开程度）映射到循环音轨的音量和速度上，然后表演 30 秒；变体：让两位表演者各控制一种乐器，必须配合演奏。

video.video_title: Russ Maschmeyer presenting MOTIV at SVA's Open IXD

works.title: Make the Line Dance
works.description: A dancer moves in front of a projector and a Kinect, and lines of light are mapped onto their moving body, sticking to limbs as they turn and bend.
works.description_zh: 舞者在投影仪和 Kinect 前舞动，光线被投影映射到他们移动的身体上，转身、弯腰时依然贴合在四肢上。
works.idea_en: Projection mapping onto a moving body instead of a static building.
works.idea_zh: 把投影映射的对象从静止的建筑换成运动的身体。
works.technique: A Kinect tracks the dancer's skeleton, Quartz Composer draws graphics along the bones, and MadMapper aligns the projector view with the camera view.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 追踪舞者骨架，Quartz Composer 沿骨骼绘制图形，MadMapper 将投影视角与摄像头视角对齐。
works.exercise_en: Calibrate a projector to a webcam, run MediaPipe pose tracking and project a glowing line along one arm of a volunteer. Twist: make the line leave a trail that the dancer can 'dance with' a second later.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影仪与摄像头标定对齐，运行 MediaPipe 姿态追踪，把一条发光线条投到志愿者的一只手臂上；变体：让线条留下拖影，舞者可以在一秒后与自己的“残影”共舞。

video.video_title: Make the Line Dance - 1024 architecture

works.title: Mao Wants This Dollar!
works.description: Point a phone at any US dollar bill and it becomes an IOU with Mao announcing that the United States of America owes China one dollar.
works.description_zh: 把手机对准任何一张美元纸币，它就变成一张欠条，毛泽东宣布：美利坚合众国欠中国一美元。
works.idea_en: Every banknote in your wallet becomes a political cartoon.
works.idea_zh: 钱包里的每一张钞票都变成一幅政治漫画。
works.technique: The Junaio AR browser's image recognition tracks the one-dollar bill design and overlays an animated IOU and portrait, made for Manifest.AR at the Boston Cyberarts Festival.
works.technique_zh: Junaio AR 浏览器的图像识别追踪一美元纸币的图案，叠加动画欠条和人像，为 Manifest.AR 在波士顿 Cyberarts 艺术节的展出而作。
works.exercise_en: Image-track a common printed object (ticket, receipt, banknote) and overlay a short animation that rewrites its meaning. Twist: the overlay changes with today's exchange rate.
works.exercise_zh: 对一种常见印刷品（车票、收据、纸币）做图像追踪，叠加一段改写它含义的短动画。变体：叠加内容随当天汇率变化。

video.video_title: Mao wants this dollar!

salient.why_en: Any dollar bill seen through a phone turns into an IOU in which Mao says the United States owes China one dollar.
salient.why_zh: 透过手机看任何一张美元，它都会变成一张欠条，毛泽东宣布美国欠中国一美元。

works.title: Mécaniques Discursives (with Fred Penelle)
works.description: A wall of woodcut prints depicting a strange machine is brought to life by precise projection: gears turn, creatures move and light flows through the printed mechanism.
works.idea_zh: 用投影让墙上的版画机器真的转动起来
works.technique: Video is drawn to match the exact contours of hand-printed woodcuts on the wall and projected in registration so animation appears to live inside the paper.
works.exercise_zh: 先手绘一张黑白“机器”图贴在墙上，再拍照在电脑中逐个零件做旋转动画并投影对齐；变化：观众拍手时机器运转速度改变。

video.video_title: Mécaniques Discursives, short documentary by fred penelle & yannick jacquet

works.description_zh: 一整面墙的木刻版画描绘了一台奇异的机器，精确的投影让它活了过来：齿轮转动，生物游走，光在印出来的机械结构中流淌。
works.idea_en: Projection makes the printed machine on the wall actually turn.
works.technique_zh: 影像按照墙上手工木刻版画的精确轮廓绘制，并与之对位投影，让动画看起来就生长在纸面之中。
works.exercise_en: Hand-draw a black-and-white 'machine' and pin it to the wall, photograph it, animate each part rotating on the computer, and project it back in alignment. Twist: the machine changes speed when the audience claps.

works.title: Newtown Creek (oil spill)
works.description: Geolocated AR on Brooklyn's Newtown Creek visualising the huge hidden oil spill beneath it.
works.idea_zh: 让地下看不见的石油泄漏浮现在河面上

video.video_title: "Newtown Creek (oil spill)" documentary of AR art by Tamiko Thiel

works.technique: Geolocated AR places a large semi-transparent model of the underground oil plume at its real coordinates, making hidden environmental data spatially visible.
works.exercise_zh: 找一份本地环境数据（地下水、噪声、排水管网），用 AR 把它按真实位置可视化在地面上；变体：让可视化的规模与数据真实数值 1:1 对应，体验“看不见的量”。
works.description_zh: 在布鲁克林 Newtown Creek 上的地理定位 AR 作品，把河底下隐藏的巨大石油泄漏可视化。
works.idea_en: Bring an invisible underground oil spill up to the surface of the river.
works.technique_zh: 地理定位 AR 把地下油污羽流的大型半透明模型放在其真实坐标上，让隐藏的环境数据在空间中变得可见。
works.exercise_en: Find a local environmental dataset (groundwater, noise, drainage network) and use AR to visualize it on the ground at its real location. Twist: scale the visualization 1:1 with the real data values to feel the size of 'invisible quantities'.

works.title: Night Bright
works.description: Children use their bodies as flashlights to light up a projected nighttime forest and play hide-and-seek with nocturnal creatures they locate by sound.
works.idea_zh: 用身体当手电筒照亮夜晚森林，循声寻找藏着的动物。

video.video_title: Night Bright

works.technique: Depth or camera-based body tracking positions a light mask on each child, and a projected night scene is revealed only inside those regions, with spatial audio cues pointing to hidden creatures.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个全黑的投影场景，用 MediaPipe 追踪人的手或身体，只有被“身体手电筒”照到的地方才显示画面，并用左右声道提示动物位置；变体：找到所有动物后反过来它们会来“照”你。
works.description_zh: 孩子们把身体当作手电筒，照亮投影出的夜间森林，并循着声音与藏在林中的夜行动物玩捉迷藏。
works.idea_en: Use your body as a flashlight to light up a night forest and follow sounds to find hidden animals.
works.technique_zh: 基于深度相机或普通摄像头的人体追踪在每个孩子身上定位一块光照遮罩，投影的夜景只在这些区域内显现，同时用空间音频提示隐藏生物的位置。
works.exercise_en: Build an all-black projected scene, track people's hands or bodies with MediaPipe so imagery appears only where the 'body flashlight' shines, and use left/right audio channels to hint where animals are. Twist: once all the animals are found, they turn around and 'shine' on you.

works.title: Occupation Forces
works.description: Aliens occupy a Boston park and other sites: viewers with phones discover invading ships and troops that mimic military occupation abroad.
works.description_zh: 外星人占领了波士顿的公园等地：拿着手机的观众会发现入侵的飞船和部队，影射海外的军事占领。
works.idea_en: Borrow alien-invasion myth to make viewers feel what occupation of their own streets would be like.
works.idea_zh: 借外星入侵的神话，让观众体会自己的街道被占领是什么感觉。
works.technique: Animated 3D alien craft and troops are placed as site-specific geolocated augments viewed on iPhone, building a narrative across several locations.
works.technique_zh: 把动画 3D 外星飞船和士兵作为地点特定的地理定位增强内容放在 iPhone 上观看，在多个地点串起一个叙事。
works.exercise_en: Stage a three-stop AR 'invasion' trail on campus with location-based markers, each stop revealing more of a story. Twist: the invaders react to how many viewers are present.
works.exercise_zh: 用基于位置的标记在校园里做一条三站式的 AR“入侵”路线，每一站揭示故事的更多部分。变体：入侵者会根据在场观众人数做出反应。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Alien Invasion @ Greenway Conservancy, Boston MA!

works.title: Occupy Wall Street Bufo Colony
works.description: A colony of AR toads breaches the barricades at the NYSE, each carrying a pie chart of wealth distribution, and clumps over the Zuccotti Park drum circle around a giant 'uber toad'.
works.description_zh: 一群 AR 蟾蜍越过纽交所的路障，每只头上漂浮着一张财富分配饼图，并在祖科蒂公园的鼓圈上方聚成一团，围着一只巨大的“超级蟾蜍”。
works.idea_en: Absurd creatures carry hard data into a protest space.
works.idea_zh: 让荒诞的生物把硬数据带进抗议现场。
works.technique: Animated toad models with attached chart billboards are geolocated at Wall Street and Zuccotti Park in a mobile AR browser, part of the Virta-Flaneurazine series.
works.technique_zh: 带有图表广告牌的动画蟾蜍模型被地理定位在华尔街和祖科蒂公园，通过移动 AR 浏览器观看，属于 Virta-Flaneurazine 系列。
works.exercise_en: Pick a statistic about your campus and attach it to a swarm of small AR creatures that crowd around the relevant building. Twist: the swarm grows as the number gets worse.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个关于校园的统计数据，把它挂在一群小 AR 生物身上，让它们聚集在相关建筑周围。变体：数据越糟，生物越多。

video.video_title: Occupy Wall Street Bufo Colony

works.title: OmniTouch
