works.description: A shoulder-worn depth camera and projector turn hands, walls, notebooks and tables into multitouch surfaces on the fly.
works.idea_zh: 肩上的深度相机+投影，把手掌、墙面、笔记本随时变成多点触控屏。

video.video_title: OmniTouch - Demo Video - ACM UIST 2011

works.technique: A shoulder-mounted depth camera finds finger-like cylinders in the depth image and determines touch by checking whether the fingertip is within a few millimeters of the surface below it, while a calibrated pico projector renders onto the detected surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 用深度相机（RealSense、Kinect 或 LiDAR iPhone）检测手指与桌面的深度差来判断触摸，把一个投影键盘放在笔记本或手掌上；变体：让界面自动选择最大的可用平面出现。
works.description_zh: 一套戴在肩上的深度相机和投影仪，能随时把手掌、墙面、笔记本和桌面变成多点触控表面。
works.idea_en: A shoulder-mounted depth camera and projector turn your palm, a wall or a notebook into a multitouch screen on the spot.
works.technique_zh: 肩戴式深度相机在深度图像中寻找类似手指的圆柱体，并通过判断指尖是否距其下方表面仅几毫米来确定触摸；同时经过标定的微型投影仪把界面投射到检测到的表面上。
works.exercise_en: Use a depth camera (RealSense, Kinect or a LiDAR iPhone) to detect touch from the depth difference between finger and table, and place a projected keyboard on a notebook or your palm. Twist: make the interface automatically appear on the largest available surface.

works.title: Orators, Rostrums and Propaganda Stands
works.description: Virtual orators' podiums, inspired by early Soviet agitprop, are placed in public squares via AR for anyone to 'speak' from.
works.idea_zh: 在公共广场放置可发声的AR演讲台

video.video_title: Orators Rostrums and Propaganda Stands HSLU

works.technique: Geolocated AR podium models are placed in public squares, with the user physically stepping into the virtual rostrum; likely GPS positioning with compass-based orientation.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园广场放一个 AR 演讲台，站上去就触发录音，把每个人的发言留在台上供后来者听；变体：演讲台只播放与当前发言相反立场的上一条录音。
works.description_zh: 受早期苏联鼓动宣传艺术启发，作品通过 AR 在公共广场上放置虚拟演讲台，任何人都可以站上去“发言”。
works.idea_en: Place AR podiums in public squares that anyone can speak from.
works.technique_zh: 地理定位的 AR 演讲台模型被放置在公共广场上，用户可以亲身走进虚拟讲台；大概率采用 GPS 定位加指南针朝向。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR podium in a campus square: stepping onto it starts a recording, and each speech stays on the podium for later visitors to hear. Twist: the podium only plays back the previous recording that took the opposite position to the current speaker.

works.title: Para-Site (Mattress Factory)
works.description: Site-specific video projection on the architecture of the Mattress Factory, with light that seems to crawl along corners and surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 寄生在建筑角落上的光线投影

video.video_title: Pablo Valbuena - Para-Site [mattress factory]

works.technique: Site-specific projection mapping onto corners and edges of a room, with a keystone- or mesh-warped projection so thin light lines crawl precisely along architectural edges.
works.exercise_zh: 在教室的一个墙角用投影画出沿边缘缓慢爬行的细光线，用 mesh warp 精确贴合；变体：让光线像一只“寄生生物”一样对观众的靠近做出躲避反应（用摄像头检测）。
works.description_zh: 在 Mattress Factory 建筑上进行的在地视频投影，光线仿佛沿着墙角和表面缓缓爬行。
works.idea_en: Light projections that live like parasites on the corners of a building.
works.technique_zh: 针对房间墙角和边缘做在地投影映射，借助梯形校正或网格变形，让细细的光线精确地沿建筑边缘爬行。
works.exercise_en: Project thin lines of light that slowly crawl along the edges of one corner of your classroom, fitted precisely with mesh warp. Twist: make the light behave like a 'parasite' that shies away when viewers approach (detected with a camera).

works.title: Paranormal Activity: Sanctuary
works.description: A location-based multiplayer horror game tied to the film franchise: players see demons in the camera view around real places, exorcise them, and build safe-haven sanctuaries on the city map, while risking possession that turns them against allies.
works.description_zh: 一款与同名电影系列联动的基于地理位置的多人恐怖游戏：玩家在真实地点的摄像头画面中看到恶灵，驱除它们，并在城市地图上建立避难所，同时冒着被附身、反过来对付盟友的风险。
works.idea_en: A haunting that spreads across real city blocks, with players as exorcists or the possessed.
works.idea_zh: 闹鬼事件在真实街区蔓延，玩家要么是驱魔人，要么被附身。
works.technique: GPS and compass place spirits and sanctuaries at real locations and overlay them on the camera view, with shared server state for territory and possession.
works.technique_zh: 用 GPS 和指南针把灵体和避难所放在真实位置并叠加到摄像头画面上，服务器共享领地与附身状态。
works.exercise_en: Place five geolocated 'haunted' points around campus and make a phone AR view that shows a ghost when a player is within 20 m. Twist: players who fail to banish a ghost become visible as ghosts to other players.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里放置五个带地理坐标的“闹鬼”点，做一个手机 AR 视图：玩家走到 20 米以内时显示幽灵。变体：没能驱走幽灵的玩家，会在其他玩家眼中变成幽灵。

video.video_title: Paranormal Activity: Sanctuary Official Trailer

works.title: Peeling Layers of Space Out of Thin Air: AR by Architects
works.description: A group exhibition of AR architecture scattered over a 30-acre field at Omi International Arts Center, with a stated run time of 100 years, visited with phones.
works.description_zh: 一场分布在 Omi 国际艺术中心 30 英亩旷野上的 AR 建筑群展，标注的展期是 100 年，观众拿着手机参观。
works.idea_en: An exhibition of buildings with no materials, open for a century.
works.idea_zh: 一场没有建筑材料、展期长达一个世纪的建筑展。
works.technique: Architects' 3D models are geolocated as Layar points of interest across the field, so visitors walk the landscape to discover each virtual structure.
works.technique_zh: 建筑师们的 3D 模型作为 Layar 兴趣点分布在旷野各处，观众在地景中行走，逐一发现每座虚拟建筑。
works.exercise_en: Curate a class AR exhibition in one outdoor space where each student places one virtual structure with location anchors. Twist: set an expiry date after which each piece disappears.
works.exercise_zh: 在一个户外空间策划全班 AR 展，每位学生用位置锚点放置一座虚拟建筑。变体：为每件作品设定到期日，到期后消失。

video.video_title: Peeling Layers of Space Out of Thin Air: Augmented Reality by Architects @ OMI - Part 1

works.title: Perceptual Shift
works.description: Hundreds of black spheres hang on fishing line in a seemingly random cloud; as the camera moves to one position, they lock into a portrait of Barack Obama.
works.description_zh: 数百个黑色球体用鱼线悬挂，看上去像一团随机的点云；当镜头移动到某个位置时，它们瞬间拼成巴拉克·奥巴马的肖像。
works.idea_en: Depth hides the image and one viewpoint reveals it: a cloud of AR particles can carry a message that people have to physically find, which is far more memorable than showing it.
works.idea_zh: 纵深把图像藏起来，而一个视点把它揭示出来：一团 AR 粒子可以承载一个需要人们亲自去找的信息，这比直接展示更让人记得住。
works.technique: Each sphere is placed along the line of sight from the chosen eye point to a pixel of the portrait at a varied depth, so the 2D image survives only from that point.
works.technique_zh: 每个球体都放在从选定视点到肖像某个像素的视线上，但深度各不相同，因此平面图像只在那个点上成立。
works.exercise_en: Write a WebXR or Unity script that takes a 32x32 image, casts rays from the current camera pose and places spheres at random depths along each ray. Twist: let the spheres slowly drift back to random depths unless someone stands on the spot.
works.exercise_zh: 写一个 WebXR 或 Unity 脚本：读入一张 32x32 的图片，从当前相机位置沿每个像素发射射线，在随机深度放置球体。变体：如果没有人站在那个点上，球体就慢慢飘回随机深度。

video.video_title: Perceptual Shift

works.title: Puppet Parade
works.description: Children puppeteer giant projected creatures with their arms via Kinect skeleton tracking, while others step into the scene to pet and feed them.
works.idea_zh: 用手臂操纵巨型投影木偶，其他孩子走进画面去喂它们。

video.video_title: Puppet Parade - Interactive Kinect Puppets

works.technique: Kinect skeleton tracking maps the shoulder-elbow-wrist chain to the joints of a projected puppet, with separate body detection for others who walk in to interact.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 把手臂的三个关节映射到一个大型投影提线木偶，另一人走进画面可以喂它；变体：两个人各控制木偶的一半身体，必须配合才能让它走路。
works.description_zh: 孩子们借助 Kinect 骨骼追踪，用手臂操纵巨大的投影生物，其他孩子则走进画面去抚摸和喂养它们。
works.idea_en: Work giant projected puppets with your arms while other kids walk into the scene to feed them.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 骨骼追踪把肩-肘-腕关节链映射到投影木偶的关节上，并单独检测走进画面参与互动的其他人。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Pose to map three arm joints onto a large projected marionette, and let a second person walk into the frame to feed it. Twist: two people each control half of the puppet's body and must cooperate to make it walk.

works.title: Quimo
works.description: A white malleable material that designers shape with bare hands into a rough mock-up; once shaped it holds its form and becomes a projection surface for colours and details.
works.description_zh: 一种白色可塑材料，设计师徒手把它捏成粗略的模型；定形后它能保持形状，成为投影颜色和细节的表面。
works.idea_en: Quick mock-ups: sculpt by hand, then dress the rough shape with projected detail.
works.idea_zh: 快速模型：先用手捏出形状，再用投影为粗糙的形体“穿上”细节。
works.technique: Quimo is a white, shape-retaining foam material with embedded tracking markers so projectors can register imagery onto its freeform surface.
works.technique_zh: Quimo 是一种白色、能保持形状的泡沫材料，嵌有追踪标记，投影仪可以把图像准确投射到其自由曲面上。
works.exercise_en: Mould white clay into a toy shape, scan it with a LiDAR phone and project or AR-paint a texture onto it. Twist: re-mould it and see what breaks.
works.exercise_zh: 用白色黏土捏一个玩具形状，用带 LiDAR 的手机扫描，再把纹理投影或以 AR 方式绘制上去。变体：重新捏一次，看看哪里对不上了。

video.video_title: Quimo: A Deformable Material to Support Freeform Modeling in Spatial Augmented Reality Environments

works.title: Reign of Gold
works.description: In front of the New York Stock Exchange, a rain of US gold eagle coins surrounds the viewer and their object of protest, part of the AR Occupy Wall Street project.
works.description_zh: 在纽约证券交易所门前，一场美国金鹰金币雨将观众和他们抗议的对象包围，属于 AR Occupy Wall Street 项目。
works.idea_en: Make the abstract flow of money a literal downpour around you.
works.idea_zh: 把抽象的资金流动变成围绕你的一场真实的“雨”。
works.technique: A particle-like field of animated coin models is geolocated around the viewer's position in a mobile AR browser, so it can be carried to any protest site.
works.technique_zh: 在移动 AR 浏览器中，把类似粒子场的金币动画模型定位在观众周围，因此可以被带到任何抗议现场。
works.exercise_en: Make a location-independent AR particle rain of a symbolic object (coins, receipts, leaves) around the viewer. Twist: the rain rate follows a live stock or climate index.
works.exercise_zh: 做一场不依赖地点、围绕观众的 AR 粒子雨，雨滴是某种象征物（硬币、收据、树叶）。变体：雨量跟随实时股价或气候指数变化。

video.video_title: Occupy Wall Street - Reign of Gold AR artwork

works.title: Requiem
works.description: An augmented reality poem: holding a marked card releases imagery and spoken sound that unfold over it, one fragment of her tabletop AR novel Cardamom of the Dead.
works.description_zh: 一首增强现实诗：拿起一张带标记的卡片，图像和朗读声便在它上方展开，是她的桌面 AR 小说《Cardamom of the Dead》中的一个片段。
works.idea_en: A poem you hold in your hand and turn to read.
works.idea_zh: 一首拿在手里、转动着来读的诗。
works.technique: FLARToolkit tracks a black-and-white marker card and superimposes animated imagery and sound, later rebuilt in Unity with Vuforia.
works.technique_zh: FLARToolkit 追踪黑白标记卡片，叠加动画图像与声音；后来用 Unity 加 Vuforia 重新制作。
works.exercise_en: Write a six-line poem, give each line its own printed card, and use image tracking to make each card release an image and a recorded voice. Twist: the poem changes meaning depending on card order.
works.exercise_zh: 写一首六行诗，每行对应一张打印卡片，用图像追踪让每张卡片释放一幅图像和一段录音。变体：卡片顺序不同，诗的意思也随之改变。

video.video_title: Requiem documentation -- AR poem

works.title: Santa Eulalia 3D Projection Mapping
works.description: To open the new Passeig de Gràcia store of Barcelona fashion house Santa Eulalia (founded 1843), Onionlab mapped the building's façade: stone seems to fold, open like fabric and reveal tailoring patterns and sewing tools.
works.description_zh: 为庆祝巴塞罗那时装老店 Santa Eulalia（创立于 1843 年）在格拉西亚大道新店开张，Onionlab 为建筑立面做了投影映射：石墙仿佛像布料一样折叠、打开，露出裁剪纸样和缝纫工具。
works.idea_en: Treating a façade as a material that can be cut and sewn ties the illusion to the brand story; AR effects on buildings feel stronger when the building 'behaves' like the subject.
works.idea_zh: 把立面当成可以裁剪缝制的材料，让幻象与品牌故事绑定；当建筑的“表现”与主题一致时，建筑上的 AR 效果更有力量。
works.technique: 3D projection mapping aligned to a model of the façade, with animations of deforming geometry rendered from the audience's central viewpoint.
works.technique_zh: 按立面三维模型对位的 3D 投影映射，几何变形动画从观众的中心视点渲染。
works.exercise_en: Take a photo of a building front, rebuild its main planes in Blender, and make an AR effect with 8th Wall or Lens Studio City Landmarker where the façade peels open like cloth. Twist: the fabric pattern is drawn live by a student on an iPad.
works.exercise_zh: 给一栋楼的正面拍照，在 Blender 中重建它的主要平面，用 8th Wall 或 Lens Studio 的地标功能做一个 AR 效果，让立面像布一样被揭开；变体：布料图案由一位同学在 iPad 上实时绘制。

video.video_title: Santa Eulalia - 3D Projection Mapping, Barcelona 2011

works.title: Scramble Suit
works.description: Inspired by Philip K. Dick's A Scanner Darkly: the live face is continuously re-substituted with many different faces so the wearer becomes impossible to describe.
works.idea_zh: 《黑暗扫描仪》式的“乱码衣”：你的脸不断被换成不同的人。

video.video_title: Scramble Suit

works.technique: The same FaceTracker mesh-warp-and-blend pipeline as Face Substitution, cycling through a large database of source faces every few frames so identity never stabilises.
works.exercise_zh: 收集全班 20 张正脸照，用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 每隔半秒给摄像头里的人换一张，做一件“无法被描述的面具”；变体：让换脸速度随周围人数增加而加快，讨论监控与匿名。
works.description_zh: 灵感来自菲利普·K·迪克的《A Scanner Darkly》（《黑暗扫描仪》）：画面中的脸不断被替换成许多不同的面孔，佩戴者因此变得无法被描述。
works.idea_en: A 'scramble suit' from A Scanner Darkly: your face keeps being swapped for different people.
works.technique_zh: 沿用 Face Substitution 中同一套 FaceTracker 网格变形与融合流程，每隔几帧就在一个大型源人脸库中切换一次，使身份始终无法稳定下来。
works.exercise_en: Collect 20 front-facing photos from the class and use MediaPipe Face Mesh to give the person on camera a new face every half second, making an 'indescribable mask'. Twist: speed up the swapping as more people gather nearby, and discuss surveillance and anonymity.

works.title: Shades of Absence: Public Voids
works.description: Geolocated AR at the Venice Biennale placing golden silhouettes of censored artists in public squares.
works.idea_zh: 在威尼斯公共空间放置被审查艺术家的金色剪影

video.video_title: "Shades of Absence: Public Voids" @ Venice Biennial 2011

works.technique: GPS-anchored Layar content places flat golden silhouette billboards in public squares, relying on coarse geolocation and compass heading.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个与“缺席”有关的主题（被遗忘的人、拆掉的建筑），用 WebAR 在对应地点放置金色剪影；变体：剪影只在没有人站在那个位置时才可见。
works.description_zh: 威尼斯双年展期间的地理定位 AR 作品，在公共广场上放置遭审查艺术家的金色剪影。
works.idea_en: Place golden silhouettes of censored artists in Venice's public spaces.
works.technique_zh: 基于 GPS 锚定的 Layar 内容在公共广场上放置平面金色剪影广告牌，依赖粗略的地理定位和指南针朝向。
works.exercise_en: Pick a theme about absence (forgotten people, demolished buildings) and use WebAR to place golden silhouettes at the matching locations. Twist: a silhouette is visible only when nobody is standing in that spot.

works.title: Sketch-a-race
works.description: Draw any line on paper, point an iPad at it, and the sketch becomes a race track with cars driving along it; players race using only stop-and-go controls and can switch to a first-person view.
works.description_zh: 在纸上随手画一条线，用 iPad 对准它，草图就变成一条赛道，小车沿着它行驶；玩家只用“走/停”控制比赛，还能切换到第一人称视角。
works.idea_en: Your own doodle is the level design.
works.idea_zh: 你自己的涂鸦就是关卡设计。
works.technique: The camera extracts the drawn stroke from the paper, converts it into a path spline and tracks the page so the 3D track stays registered in real time.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头从纸上提取手绘笔画，转换成路径样条，并追踪纸张，使 3D 赛道实时贴合。
works.exercise_en: Use OpenCV or an AR image tracker to detect a dark hand-drawn line on white paper and send a small car along it in AR. Twist: let line thickness control speed.
works.exercise_zh: 用 OpenCV 或 AR 图像追踪器检测白纸上的深色手绘线条，让一辆小车在 AR 中沿线行驶。变体：让线条粗细控制车速。

video.video_title: Sketch-a-race iPad2 Augmented Reality demo by Ogmento

works.title: Sketching up the World
works.description: On an early smartphone, a user sketches and places 3D content directly onto buildings in an unprepared outdoor scene, leaving annotations that others can find later.
works.description_zh: 在早期智能手机上，用户直接在未经预处理的户外场景中给建筑绘制草图、放置三维内容，留下可供他人日后查看的注释。
works.idea_en: Anyone should be able to author AR content on the spot, with just a phone.
works.idea_zh: 任何人都应该能拿着手机，当场创作 AR 内容。
works.technique: Uses panoramic tracking with sensor fusion on the phone to register sketched and extruded content to the surroundings without a prior model.
works.technique_zh: 在手机上结合全景追踪与传感器融合，把绘制和挤出的内容配准到周围环境，无需预先建模。
works.exercise_en: Walk around campus with a phone AR drawing app and leave three spatial doodles that explain something about each place, then swap phones and hunt for each other's notes. Twist: allow only arrows and one word.
works.exercise_zh: 拿着手机 AR 绘画 App 在校园里走，给三个地点各留下一幅解释该地的空间涂鸦，然后交换手机寻找彼此的留言；变体：只允许画箭头并写一个词。

video.video_title: Sketching up the world: In situ authoring for mobile Augmented Reality

works.title: Sky Pavilions
works.description: Virtual 'cloudburst' pavilions filled with nonsensical and practical guidance float over the High Line in New York, land in gardens and appear in Venice; in one live performance the band Dewanatron grapples with them.
works.description_zh: 装满荒诞又实用“指引”的虚拟“云爆”亭子漂浮在纽约高线公园上空、降落在花园里、也出现在威尼斯；在一场现场表演中，乐队 Dewanatron 与它们“搏斗”。
works.idea_en: Architecture that flies in, lands and leaves like weather.
works.idea_zh: 像天气一样飞来、降落又离开的建筑。
works.technique: Animated 3D pavilions (about 3,000 polygons with animated textures) are served to the Layar browser through PorPOISe and placed as geolocated points of interest with tap-triggered actions.
works.technique_zh: 约 3000 个多边形、带动画贴图的 3D 亭子通过 PorPOISe 服务提供给 Layar 浏览器，作为可点击触发动作的地理定位兴趣点放置。
works.exercise_en: Design a small AR pavilion that 'lands' on a campus lawn with an animation, and add one tap interaction that gives advice. Twist: it takes off again when too many people gather.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个小型 AR 亭子，以动画“降落”在校园草坪上，并加入一个点击后给出建议的交互。变体：聚集的人太多时，它会再次起飞。

video.video_title: Sky Pavilions vs. Dewanatron; Augmented Reality Performance 4.30.11 Under the High Line NYC

works.title: Snowflake Sculpture, Time Square Seoul
works.description: A huge constellation of suspended snowflake shapes fills a shopping mall atrium; from most balconies it looks abstract, but from one hidden vantage point the pieces line up into a secret image.
works.description_zh: 巨大的悬挂雪花形体群填满购物中心中庭；从大多数楼层看它是抽象的，但在一个隐藏的观看点，这些碎片会对齐成一幅秘密图像。
works.idea_en: An anamorphic sculpture rewards the one person who finds the right spot.
works.idea_zh: 一座变形透视雕塑，只奖励找到正确位置的那个人。
works.technique: Each element is placed in 3D along lines of sight from a chosen viewpoint so that their projections align into one picture only from there (anamorphosis).
works.technique_zh: 每个构件都沿着从某个选定观看点出发的视线放置在三维空间中，只有在那一点看时它们的投影才对齐成一幅画（变形透视）。
works.exercise_en: Hang ten paper shapes at different depths in a room so that from one marked spot they form a letter or face, then build the same illusion in an AR scene. Twist: make two different images visible from two different spots.
works.exercise_zh: 在房间里把十个纸片形状挂在不同深度，使它们从一个标记点看过去拼成一个字母或一张脸，再在 AR 场景中实现同样的错觉；变体：从两个不同位置分别能看到两幅不同的图像。

video.video_title: Snowflake sculpture at Time Square Seoul 2011

works.title: Sony PlayStation Realtime Projection Mapping
works.description: A living room is transformed live, in camera, into three famous film scenes: projections track moving furniture and puppets, while pyrotechnics and real objects blend with the projected worlds.
works.description_zh: 一间客厅在镜头前被实时改造成三个著名电影场景：投影追踪移动的家具和木偶，烟火和真实物件与投影世界融为一体。
works.idea_en: Projection mapping that follows moving objects turns an ordinary room into a film set.
works.idea_zh: 能追踪移动物体的投影映射，把普通房间变成电影片场。
works.technique: Objects and puppets are tracked in 3D in real time and the projection content is re-rendered from the projector's viewpoint every frame, so the mapping stays locked to moving surfaces.
works.technique_zh: 物体和木偶被实时三维追踪，投影内容每一帧都从投影机视角重新渲染，从而让映射始终锁定在移动的表面上。
works.exercise_en: Track a white box with an ArUco marker from the projector's camera and keep a texture projected on it while a classmate moves it around. Twist: turn the box into a 'window' onto a movie scene that stays fixed in world space.
works.exercise_zh: 用贴了 ArUco 标记的白色纸盒，从投影机旁的摄像头追踪它，同学移动纸盒时让贴图始终投在盒子上；变体：把纸盒变成一扇“窗”，透过它看到一个固定在空间中的电影场景。

video.video_title: Sony Realtime Projection Mapping 1

works.title: Steelman
works.description: A 10-metre concrete bear holding a pillow under its arm stands in the Staalmanplein neighbourhood of Slotervaart, Amsterdam.
works.description_zh: 一只 10 米高、腋下夹着枕头的混凝土熊立在阿姆斯特丹斯洛特瓦特区的 Staalmanplein 社区中。
works.idea_en: A sleepy giant toy in a housing estate gives a neighbourhood a friendly mascot, a gentle model for community AR characters.
works.idea_zh: 住宅区里一只睡眼惺忪的巨型玩具熊为社区带来了友好的吉祥物，是社区 AR 角色的温和范本。
works.technique: The bear was cast in concrete in sections over a steel frame and finished on site.
works.technique_zh: 熊在钢框架上分段浇筑混凝土，并在现场完成修饰。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR mascot for your street that residents vote on, and place it where most neighbours pass. Twist: it yawns and goes to sleep at the neighbourhood's average bedtime.
works.exercise_zh: 为你所在的街道设计一个由居民投票选出的 AR 吉祥物，并把它放在大多数邻居经过的地方；变体：到了社区平均就寝时间，它会打哈欠睡去。

video.video_title: STAALMAN.mov

works.title: Stocos
works.description: Two dancers move inside a floor projection of an artificial swarm; the simulated agents, the music and the light react to their movement and in turn push the dancers into new patterns.
works.description_zh: 两位舞者在地面投影的人工群体中舞动；虚拟个体、音乐和灯光随她们的动作变化，又反过来推动舞者形成新的队形。
works.idea_en: Let dancers and a simulated swarm choreograph each other on the same floor.
works.idea_zh: 让舞者和一群虚拟生物在同一块地板上互相编舞。
works.technique: Body tracking feeds the dancers' positions into a swarm simulation whose agents are projected from above, and the same agent data drives stochastic sound synthesis and lighting.
works.technique_zh: 身体追踪把舞者的位置输入群体模拟，模拟出的个体从上方投影到地面，同一组数据还驱动随机声音合成和灯光。
works.exercise_en: Project a p5.js boids flock onto the floor with a cheap projector and use a webcam blob tracker so the flock avoids or follows a person walking through it. Twist: give each person a different 'smell' so the flock prefers one of them.
works.exercise_zh: 用便宜投影仪把 p5.js 的鸟群（boids）投到地面，再用摄像头追踪人的位置，让鸟群躲避或跟随走过的人；变体：给每个人不同的“气味”，让鸟群偏爱其中一人。

video.video_title: Pablo Palacio, Muriel Romero, Daniel Bisig, Stocos (suite) dance interactive (2011)

works.title: Study of Time
works.description: A hanging grid of LEDs displays the passing of time as a moving shadow of light that travels across it like the hand of a clock.
works.description_zh: 一块悬挂的 LED 网格以一道移动的光影显示时间的流逝，像钟针一样扫过网格。
works.idea_en: Time can be felt as a moving light rather than read as numbers — AR clocks can be ambient instead of literal.
works.idea_zh: 时间可以被感受为移动的光，而不是被读成数字——AR 时钟可以是氛围性的，而不是字面的。
works.technique: A grid of LEDs is driven by a clock routine that sweeps illumination and shadow across the surface as the hours pass.
works.technique_zh: LED 网格由时钟程序驱动，随着时间推移让光与影扫过表面。
works.exercise_en: Hang a virtual light panel over a real doorway in AR where a band of light sweeps across it once per minute. Twist: the sweep speed follows how many people walked through the door in the last hour.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中于真实门口上方挂一块虚拟光板，每分钟有一道光带扫过。变体：扫动速度随过去一小时穿过这扇门的人数变化。

video.video_title: RANDOM INTERNATIONAL | Study of Time

works.title: The Augmented Reality Korean Unification Project
works.description: At the Korean Demilitarized Zone, phones erase the border fortifications and show the land returned to nature, uniting North and South in AR.
works.description_zh: 在朝韩非军事区，手机画面抹去边境工事，呈现土地回归自然的样子，在 AR 中让南北统一。
works.idea_en: Use AR to preview a political future that is physically impossible today.
works.idea_zh: 用 AR 预演一个现实中暂时不可能实现的政治未来。
works.technique: Geolocated 3D landscape augments are anchored at DMZ viewpoints in a mobile AR browser so the fences and watchtowers are covered by virtual terrain and greenery.
works.technique_zh: 在非军事区观景点用移动 AR 浏览器锚定地理定位的 3D 地景，用虚拟地形和植被覆盖铁丝网与哨塔。
works.exercise_en: Find a fence, wall or barrier on campus and make a phone-AR scene that replaces it with what the space could become if it were removed. Twist: show both sides' wishes at once.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里找一道围栏、墙或障碍，用手机 AR 把它替换成拆除后可能出现的景象。变体：同时呈现两侧人的不同愿望。

video.video_title: The Augmented Reality Korean Unification Project -- Uniting Korea with Augmented Reality

works.title: The Island of Hope (Venice Biennale AR Intervention)
works.description: An uninvited AR island in Venice reads the day's most hopeful #hope tweets and answers the best ones with objects that erupt from its volcano and settle over the city.
works.description_zh: 威尼斯双年展上一座不请自来的 AR 小岛，读取当天最有希望的 #hope 推文，挑出最好的，让对应物体从火山中喷出并散落在城市上空。
works.idea_en: A live social feed becomes physical-looking objects raining over a real city.
works.idea_zh: 把实时社交信息流变成仿佛实体、洒落在真实城市上空的物件。
works.technique: A server script searches Twitter for #hope, picks tweets and spawns matching 3D objects as geolocated points of interest in a mobile AR browser around the Giardini and Venice.
works.technique_zh: 服务器脚本在 Twitter 上搜索 #hope，挑选推文后生成对应的 3D 物体，作为地理定位兴趣点放进威尼斯绿园城堡一带的移动 AR 浏览器。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone-AR scene where messages typed into a shared form become 3D objects that float up from one spot on campus. Twist: only the most upvoted wish is granted each hour.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 场景：大家在共享表单里写的愿望，会变成从校园某处升起的 3D 物体。变体：每小时只实现得票最高的那个愿望。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Intervention @ the Venice Biennial 2011 - The Island of Hope

works.title: The Merlion Hotel
works.description: For the Singapore Biennale, Nishi built a hotel room around the Merlion statue, so guests could sleep next to the city's symbol and visitors could see it indoors.
works.description_zh: 为新加坡双年展，Nishi 围绕鱼尾狮雕像建了一间酒店客房，客人可以睡在城市象征的旁边，访客也能在室内看到它。
works.idea_en: Turning a public icon into a private room flips the scale of intimacy, a prompt for AR rooms built around landmarks.
works.idea_zh: 把公共偶像变成私人房间，翻转了亲密的尺度，这为围绕地标搭建的 AR 房间提供了启发。
works.technique: A temporary structure enclosed the statue with walls, a bed and a bathroom, open to visitors by day and guests by night.
works.technique_zh: 一个临时结构用墙、床和浴室把雕像围住，白天向访客开放，夜晚接待住客。
works.exercise_en: Place a virtual bedroom around a campus landmark in AR so that the landmark sits by the bed. Twist: at night, the room's lights turn on and the landmark 'sleeps'.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中围绕校园地标放置一间虚拟卧室，让地标就在床边；变体：到了夜晚，房间的灯亮起，地标“入睡”。

video.video_title: Behind the scene: The Merlion Hotel - Tatzu Nishi (Japan)

works.title: The Walking Cube
works.description: A large cube frame is shaken and tilted by mechanical actuators, and synchronized light and video make it look like a living creature walking, breathing and stumbling.
works.description_zh: 一个大型立方体框架被机械装置摇晃和倾斜，同步的灯光与影像让它看起来像一只正在行走、呼吸、踉跄的生物。
works.idea_en: Combine small physical motion with light to give a simple shape a personality.
works.idea_zh: 把微小的实体运动和光结合起来，让一个简单几何体拥有性格。
works.technique: Pneumatic or motorized actuators under the legs are sequenced with lighting and video cues from the same timeline.
works.technique_zh: 腿部下方的气动或电机执行器与灯光、影像提示在同一条时间轴上编排。
works.exercise_en: Put a cardboard cube on four servo 'legs' controlled by an Arduino and sync LED strips to its movement to make it look scared, happy or tired. Twist: let it react to a clap.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个纸板立方体放在四个由 Arduino 控制的舵机“腿”上，用 LED 灯带配合动作，让它看起来害怕、开心或疲惫；变体：让它对拍手声做出反应。

video.video_title: The Walking Cube - 1024 architecture

works.title: Things are not what they seem (MIGZ Festival)
works.description: Sila Sveta's mapping for the MIGZ 3D Mapping Festival in Moscow's Gorky Park in September 2011: the building seems to break, shift and rebuild itself to music by Sasha Knyazev (Triangle Sun).
works.description_zh: Sila Sveta 为 2011 年 9 月莫斯科高尔基公园 MIGZ 3D 映射节创作的投影：建筑随着 Sasha Knyazev（Triangle Sun）的音乐仿佛碎裂、移位又重新组装。
works.idea_en: The title says it all: mapping is about making solid things look unstable, and AR can make the real world feel unsure of itself in the same way.
works.idea_zh: 标题已说明一切：映射就是让坚固的东西看起来不稳定，AR 也能以同样方式让真实世界显得“不确定”。
works.technique: 3D deformation animations rendered against a model of the building are projected in alignment, with fake lighting to suggest moving volumes.
works.technique_zh: 针对建筑模型渲染三维变形动画，对齐投影，并用虚拟光影暗示体块在移动。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR effect in Lens Studio's world mesh or ARKit scene reconstruction that makes a real wall bulge, crack and reassemble to a beat. Twist: the wall only breaks where the viewer is looking.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 的世界网格或 ARKit 场景重建做一个 AR 效果，让一面真实的墙随节拍鼓起、开裂又重新拼合；变体：墙只在观者注视的地方裂开。

video.video_title: Projection by Sila Sveta @ MIGZ 3D Mapping Festival 2011

works.title: Thixotropes
works.description: Hanging sculptures made of LED lines spin, and at speed the lines blur into solid-looking 3D volumes that change shape as the rotation shifts.
works.description_zh: 由 LED 线条组成的悬挂雕塑高速旋转，线条被眼睛融合成看似实心的立体形体，并随旋转变化而变形。
works.idea_en: Motion can create volume that isn't there — a single moving line in AR can suggest a full solid.
works.idea_zh: 运动可以造出并不存在的体积——AR 中一条移动的线就能暗示一个完整的实体。
works.technique: Rotating LED lines at high speed exploits persistence of vision, so the eye integrates their paths into surfaces of revolution.
works.technique_zh: 高速旋转的 LED 线条利用视觉暂留，让眼睛把它们的轨迹整合成回转曲面。
works.exercise_en: Spin a thin glowing line fast in AR with long motion trails so it sweeps out a vase-like volume above a table. Twist: let the user bend the line with a pinch gesture to reshape the volume.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中让一条细细的发光线快速旋转并留下长拖尾，在桌面上方“扫”出花瓶般的体积。变体：让用户用捏合手势弯曲这条线，改变体积形状。

video.video_title: Troika Thixotropes, 2011

works.title: Tiananmen SquARed
works.description: The Goddess of Democracy statue and Tank Man from the 1989 Tiananmen protests reappear in AR at the ICA Boston, Union Square and Wall Street, and virtually in Tiananmen Square itself.
works.description_zh: 1989 年天安门抗议中的“民主女神”雕像和“坦克人”以 AR 形式重现在波士顿当代艺术馆、联合广场、华尔街，也虚拟地回到天安门广场。
works.idea_en: Re-install a censored image at the exact coordinates where it cannot be shown.
works.idea_zh: 在无法展示某个被审查图像的坐标上，把它重新“安装”回去。
works.technique: 3D models of the statue and the tank-and-man scene are published as geolocated points of interest in a mobile AR browser, placed at multiple coordinates at once, credited to the collective 4Gentlemen.
works.technique_zh: 把雕像和坦克人场景做成 3D 模型，作为地理定位兴趣点发布在移动 AR 浏览器中，同时放在多个坐标上；署名为 4Gentlemen 小组。
works.exercise_en: Pick an image that was removed from a public place and restore it there in phone AR at its original scale. Twist: make it visible only on an anniversary date.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个曾被从公共场所移除的图像，用手机 AR 以原尺寸把它放回原处。变体：只在周年纪念日那天可见。

video.video_title: Goddess of Democracy ICA

works.title: Touch Vision Interface
works.description: A user points a phone camera at a distant screen or projection and draws or drags on the phone's live camera view; the change appears on the real surface as if touched directly.
works.description_zh: 用户把手机摄像头对准远处的屏幕或投影，在手机的实时取景画面上绘画或拖动；变化出现在真实表面上，就像直接摸到了它。
works.idea_en: Touch a far-away screen through your phone's camera view.
works.idea_zh: 透过手机取景画面去触摸远处的屏幕。
works.technique: The phone image is matched to the target display, and touch coordinates are transformed through that homography and sent over the network to the openFrameworks app running the screen.
works.technique_zh: 把手机画面与目标屏幕做匹配，触摸坐标经过单应性变换后，通过网络发送给驱动该屏幕的 openFrameworks 程序。
works.exercise_en: Use image tracking on a projected wall so that tapping it in a phone AR view places a sticker at the same spot on the real wall. Twist: several phones draw on the same wall at once.
works.exercise_zh: 对投影墙做图像追踪，在手机 AR 画面中点一下，真实墙面同一位置就出现一张贴纸。变体：几部手机同时在同一面墙上画。

video.video_title: Touch Vision Interface

works.title: Traces
works.description: An interactive artwork using a Kinect camera that reflects visitors as trails of light, turning movement into drawings.
works.idea_zh: Kinect把观众的动作变成光的轨迹

video.video_title: Traces - by James Alliban

works.technique: A Kinect depth image is thresholded into a body silhouette, and its contour or motion is accumulated over time in openFrameworks to draw fading light trails.
works.exercise_zh: 用 TouchDesigner 的 Kinect 或摄像头人体分割，把人的轮廓做成缓慢消退的光轨投到墙上；变体：让轨迹只记录两个人之间的“空隙”而不是身体本身。
works.description_zh: 一件使用 Kinect 相机的互动作品，把观众映照成一道道光的轨迹，让动作变成绘画。
works.idea_en: A Kinect turns visitors' movements into trails of light.
works.technique_zh: 对 Kinect 深度图像做阈值处理得到人体剪影，再在 openFrameworks 中随时间累积其轮廓或运动，绘制出逐渐消退的光轨。
works.exercise_en: Use Kinect or camera body segmentation in TouchDesigner to turn people's outlines into slowly fading light trails projected on a wall. Twist: make the trails record only the 'gap' between two people rather than their bodies.

works.title: US - Iraq War Memorial
works.description: A geolocated AR memorial lists and visualizes the dead of the Iraq war, placed in public space where no official monument exists.
works.description_zh: 一座地理定位的 AR 纪念碑，在没有官方纪念物的公共空间中，呈现伊拉克战争的死者。
works.idea_en: An uninvited memorial that anyone can visit with a phone.
works.idea_zh: 一座不请自来、任何人用手机就能参观的纪念碑。
works.technique: Casualty data is turned into 3D markers or text objects and published as geolocated points of interest in a mobile AR browser at symbolic sites.
works.technique_zh: 把伤亡数据转成 3D 标记或文字对象，作为地理定位兴趣点发布在移动 AR 浏览器中，放在具有象征意义的地点。
works.exercise_en: Take a public dataset about a hidden loss (trees cut, species lost, closed shops) and place one AR marker per item on a campus lawn. Twist: markers fade unless someone visits them.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个关于隐性损失的公开数据集（被砍的树、消失的物种、倒闭的店铺），在校园草坪上为每一项放一个 AR 标记。变体：没人来看的标记会慢慢消失。

video.video_title: US - Iraq War Memorial seen with Augmented Reality

works.title: Virtual Traffic Light
works.description: The Dutch island of Terschelling, which has no traffic lights, gets its first one: a virtual light in AR that actually tries to regulate traffic.
works.description_zh: 从没有红绿灯的荷兰泰尔斯海灵岛，迎来了第一盏红绿灯：一盏 AR 虚拟红绿灯，而且真的试图指挥交通。
works.idea_en: Test whether a purely virtual sign can change real behaviour.
works.idea_zh: 检验一个纯虚拟的标志能否改变真实行为。
works.technique: A traffic-light model with a timed state cycle is geolocated at a crossing in a mobile AR browser, shared by everyone viewing it.
works.technique_zh: 带有定时状态循环的红绿灯模型被定位在一个路口，通过移动 AR 浏览器观看，所有观看者看到的状态一致。
works.exercise_en: Place a virtual sign (queue marker, stop line, quiet zone) in a busy campus spot with shared AR state, and observe whether people obey it. Twist: let the crowd vote on the sign's rule.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园繁忙处放一个状态共享的虚拟标志（排队线、停止线、安静区），观察人们是否遵守。变体：让人群投票决定标志的规则。

video.video_title: Virtual Traffic Light (AR)

works.title: Water wARs
works.description: In front of the Venice Biennale's main pavilion, virtual shanty pavilions appear for undocumented artists, squatters and future water-war refugees.
works.description_zh: 在威尼斯双年展主展馆前，出现了一片为无证艺术家、占屋者和未来“水战争”难民搭建的虚拟棚屋展馆。
works.idea_en: Squat the most exclusive art venue with shelters for those it excludes.
works.idea_zh: 用给被排斥者的避难所，去“占领”最排外的艺术场地。
works.technique: Low-poly shelter models are geolocated in the Giardini through a mobile AR browser, as part of Manifest.AR's uninvited 2011 intervention.
works.technique_zh: 作为 Manifest.AR 2011 年不请自来的介入行动一部分，在移动 AR 浏览器中把低多边形的棚屋模型定位在绿园城堡。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR 'unofficial pavilion' for a group excluded from a campus space and place it at the entrance of that space. Twist: visitors can add a room to it.
works.exercise_zh: 为某个被排斥在校园某空间外的群体设计一个 AR“非官方展馆”，放在那个空间的入口。变体：参观者可以给它加盖一间房。

video.video_title: Testing Water wARs

works.title: Whatever happened, Happened
works.description: A machine slowly engraves concentric growth rings into a slice of virgin wood with a laser, so the viewer watches years of tree growth being written as a physical record.
works.description_zh: 一台机器用激光在一片原木切面上慢慢刻出同心的年轮，观众看着多年的树木生长被写成实物记录。
works.idea_en: Change we never see happen can be made visible by drawing its trace step by step — AR can do the same by recording and replaying slow processes where they happened.
works.idea_zh: 我们从未亲眼看到发生的变化，可以通过一步步画出它的痕迹来显形——AR 也可以在原地记录并回放缓慢的过程。
works.technique: A laser engraver is driven by a growth model that adds one ring at a time to the wood surface, so the image accumulates physically instead of being shown as a finished graphic.
works.technique_zh: 激光雕刻机由一个生长模型驱动，每次在木头表面加刻一圈年轮，图像是物理地累积出来的，而不是一张完成的图。
works.exercise_en: Record a plant, a shadow or a pile of objects with a phone every few minutes for an hour, then place the stacked outlines as rings around the real object in AR. Twist: let viewers scrub time by walking closer or farther away.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机每隔几分钟拍一次植物、影子或一堆物品，持续一小时，然后在 AR 中把叠加的轮廓作为“年轮”环绕在真实物体周围。变体：让观众通过走近或走远来拖动时间。

video.video_title: Whatever happened, Happened

works.title: Wind Arbor
works.description: A tall glass façade at Marina Bay Sands in Singapore is lined with hundreds of thousands of small hinged metal flaps that flutter with the wind and cast moving shadows into the atrium.
works.description_zh: 新加坡滨海湾金沙一面高大的玻璃立面上挂满数十万片铰接的小金属片，随风颤动，把流动的光影投进中庭。
works.idea_en: Shadows cast inside tell visitors what is happening outside; AR can likewise let outdoor data leak indoors as light and shadow.
works.idea_zh: 投进室内的影子告诉人们外面正在发生什么；AR 同样可以让户外数据以光影的形式渗进室内。
works.technique: Wind moves each flap independently and the changing pattern filters sunlight entering the building, creating a kinetic sunscreen (year approximate).
works.technique_zh: 风让每片金属片独立摆动，变化的图案过滤进入建筑的阳光，形成一面动态遮阳幕（年份为估计）。
works.exercise_en: Project virtual flapping shadows onto a real floor in AR, driven by live wind speed from a weather API. Twist: tie the shadow density to the day's air quality.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把虚拟的翻动影子投到真实地面上，由天气 API 的实时风速驱动。变体：让影子的密度对应当天的空气质量。

video.video_title: Wind Arbor

works.title: Wood Line
works.description: A 350-metre line of eucalyptus logs, laid end to end, snakes along the floor of a Presidio forest between the trunks, inviting people to walk on and beside it.
works.description_zh: 一条由桉树原木首尾相接而成、长约 350 米的线在 Presidio 森林的地面上蛇行穿过树干之间，邀请人们在上面和旁边行走。
works.idea_en: A single line on the ground turns a forest into a path and a drawing at once, the simplest form of guidance AR can give.
works.idea_zh: 地面上的一条线同时把森林变成了路径和绘画，这是 AR 能提供的最简单的引导形式。
works.technique: Branches from trees felled for forest management are laid in a continuous curving line, partly sunk into the ground.
works.technique_zh: 因森林管理而伐下的树枝被铺成一条连续弯曲的线，部分埋入地面。
works.exercise_en: Draw a continuous AR line on the ground with Lens Studio or WebXR hit-testing as you walk through trees, save it, and let the next visitor follow it. Twist: the line slowly sinks into the ground over a week.
works.exercise_zh: 边走过树林边用 Lens Studio 或 WebXR 命中测试在地面上画出一条连续的 AR 线，保存后让下一位访客沿线行走；变体：一周内这条线慢慢沉入地下。

video.video_title: Andy Goldsworthy: Wood Line

works.title: XYZT, Abstract Landscapes
works.description: An exhibition of ten interactive installations where visitors touch, blow on and walk through projected typographic and particle landscapes.
works.idea_zh: 用触摸、吹气、行走去改变由字母和粒子组成的风景
works.technique: Floor and wall projections use camera, depth and touch sensing to feed eMotion physics systems, so visuals respond like material.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个地面投影粒子池，用俯拍摄像头让走过的人“划开”粒子；变化：用麦克风吹气强度控制粒子飞散的方向。

video.video_title: Adrien M & Claire B : XYZT / 1min trailer

works.description_zh: 一个由十件互动装置组成的展览，观众可以触摸、吹气，或从投影出的文字与粒子风景中穿行而过。
works.idea_en: Touch, blow and walk to reshape landscapes made of letters and particles.
works.technique_zh: 地面和墙面投影利用摄像头、深度和触摸传感为 eMotion 物理系统提供输入，让画面像真实材料一样作出反应。
works.exercise_en: Build a floor-projected particle pool and use an overhead camera so people walking through 'part' the particles. Twist: use a microphone to let the strength of a breath control which way the particles scatter.

works.title: YouTube Symphony Orchestra, Sydney Opera House
works.description: For the YouTube Symphony Orchestra grand finale on 20 March 2011, Obscura turned the Sydney Opera House 'inside out and outside in': audio-reactive graphics and live digital painting were projected on the concert hall interior and on the famous sails at the same time.
works.description_zh: 在 2011 年 3 月 20 日 YouTube 交响乐团的压轴演出中，Obscura 让悉尼歌剧院“里外翻转”：随音乐变化的图形和现场数字绘画同时投在音乐厅内部和著名的帆形屋顶上。
works.idea_en: Visuals that react to live music tie a large audience to one shared moment; sound-reactive AR can make co-located viewers feel the same beat.
works.idea_zh: 随现场音乐反应的视觉，把大量观众连接到同一个时刻；声音驱动的 AR 可以让在场的人感受到同一个节拍。
works.technique: Audio from the orchestra fed real-time graphics engines, while artists painted digitally live; outputs were split to interior and exterior projector arrays.
works.technique_zh: 乐团的音频输入实时图形引擎，同时艺术家现场数字绘画；输出分别送往室内和室外的投影机阵列。
works.exercise_en: Build a shared AR scene (Lens Studio Connected Lenses or WebXR with WebSockets) where music from one phone drives shapes that everyone sees on the same real wall. Twist: one participant can paint strokes that then pulse to the music.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个共享 AR 场景（Lens Studio Connected Lenses 或 WebXR 加 WebSocket），一部手机播放的音乐驱动大家在同一面真实墙上看到的形状；变体：一位参与者可以画笔触，笔触随后随音乐跳动。

video.video_title: Visual Design and Projections by Obscura Digital for YTSO 2011

works.title: Your rainbow panorama
works.description: A 150-metre circular walkway of glass in every colour of the spectrum sits on top of the ARoS museum in Aarhus; walking around it tints the city view in changing hues.
works.description_zh: 奥胡斯 ARoS 美术馆的屋顶上有一条 150 米长的环形玻璃步道，玻璃涵盖光谱中的所有颜色；绕着它走，城市景色会被染上不断变化的色调。
works.idea_en: Where you stand decides what filter you see: in AR, mapping a colour or effect to compass direction turns walking into the interface.
works.idea_zh: 你站在哪里，就决定你看到哪种滤镜：在 AR 里把颜色或效果对应到方位，走路本身就成了交互界面。
works.technique: Coloured laminated glass panels are arranged in spectral order around a ring so that hue changes with the viewer's bearing.
works.technique_zh: 彩色夹胶玻璃按光谱顺序排成一圈，色调随观者的方位而变化。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR filter that tints the camera view according to compass heading, so that turning in a full circle sweeps through the spectrum. Twist: let two students stand opposite each other and see each other in complementary colours.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 滤镜，根据指南针方向给摄像画面染色，原地转一圈就扫过整个光谱。变体：让两位同学面对面站着，彼此看到对方是互补色。

video.video_title: Your rainbow panorama,  AROS, Aarhus, Denmark

salient.why_en: Walk around a ring of coloured glass and the city changes colour with every step.
salient.why_zh: 沿着一圈彩色玻璃走，城市的颜色随每一步变化。

works.title: Zoetrope meets AR
works.description: A spinning physical zoetrope is combined with augmented reality so the animation appears as 3D figures moving around the real drum.
works.description_zh: 一个旋转的实体走马灯与增强现实结合，动画以 3D 人偶的形式围着真实的转筒运动。
works.idea_en: Merge a 2,000-year-old animation device with AR.
works.idea_zh: 把一件有两千年历史的动画装置与 AR 结合。
works.technique: Marker or image tracking follows frames on the rotating drum and swaps in a sequence of 3D models, so the camera sees stroboscopic 3D animation.
works.technique_zh: 标记或图像追踪跟随转筒上的画面，逐帧替换成一系列 3D 模型，让相机看到频闪式的 3D 动画。
works.exercise_en: Print 12 image markers around a lazy Susan, map a 12-frame 3D animation onto them and spin it in front of a phone. Twist: use the phone's frame rate as the shutter.
works.exercise_zh: 在转盘四周贴 12 张图像标记，把一段 12 帧的 3D 动画映射到上面，在手机前转动。变体：把手机的帧率当作快门。

video.video_title: Zoetrope meets AR

works.title: dENiZEN — Light Painting Video
works.description: A music video painted over four cold nights in Cologne: dozens of friends draw flowing shapes, faces and words in light around streets and buildings, frame by frame.
works.description_zh: 在科隆四个寒冷的夜晚绘制的音乐录影带：几十位朋友在街道和建筑周围一帧一帧地用光画出流动的形状、人脸和文字。
works.idea_en: Many people drawing together in one frame produces a density no single artist could reach; shared AR drawing sessions can build the same collective scenes.
works.idea_zh: 许多人同时在一个画面里作画，能达到单个艺术家达不到的密度；多人共享的 AR 绘画也能构建出这样的集体场景。
works.technique: A large crew performs coordinated light strokes during each long exposure and repeats them with small changes for stop-motion.
works.technique_zh: 一大群人在每次长曝光中完成协调好的光笔画，再以细微变化重复，做成定格动画。
works.exercise_en: Set up a multi-user AR drawing room (e.g. Unity + Netcode or 8th Wall shared sessions) where four students draw simultaneously around one anchor for 60 seconds. Twist: each student may only draw in their assigned color and height band.
works.exercise_zh: 搭一个多人 AR 绘画空间（如 Unity + Netcode 或 8th Wall 共享会话），让四位学生围绕一个锚点同时画 60 秒；变体：每人只能用指定的颜色、只在指定的高度区间作画。

video.video_title: LICHTFAKTOR - dENiZEN - Light Painting Video

works.title: infiltr.AR
works.description: Two AR augments are placed inside the Oval Office and the Pentagon; their views are tracked live on a map to test whether anyone inside ever sees them.
works.description_zh: 两件 AR 作品被放进椭圆形办公室和五角大楼内部；它们被观看的记录实时显示在地图上，用来检验里面是否真的有人看到。
works.idea_en: Use geo-AR to place art where no artist is allowed to go, and measure who notices.
works.idea_zh: 用地理 AR 把艺术放进任何艺术家都进不去的地方，并统计谁注意到了。
works.technique: Augments are geolocated at the coordinates of the two buildings in the Layar browser, and each view request is logged server-side and plotted on a Google Map.
works.technique_zh: 在 Layar 浏览器中把作品定位到两栋建筑的坐标上，服务器记录每一次观看请求，并标注在 Google 地图上。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR object inside a room on campus that students cannot enter, and log every view with a simple analytics endpoint. Twist: the object changes after its first view from inside.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里学生进不去的房间内放一个 AR 物体，并用简单的统计接口记录每次观看。变体：它第一次被“里面的人”看到后就会改变。

video.video_title: infiltr.AR - infiltration of White House and Pentagon

works.title: particles
works.description: Balls with built-in LEDs roll along a large spiral rail and blink at precisely timed moments, so their light points draw floating shapes and afterimages in the dark.
works.description_zh: 内置 LED 的小球沿一条大型螺旋轨道滚动，并在精确计算的时刻闪烁，于是光点在黑暗中画出漂浮的形状和残影。
works.idea_en: Timing lights on moving objects can draw volumes that do not exist — a physical version of persistence-of-vision effects that AR can extend with tracked objects.
works.idea_zh: 给运动物体上的灯定好时机，就能画出并不存在的体积——这是视觉暂留效果的实体版本，AR 可以借助追踪物体进一步扩展。
works.technique: The position of each ball on the rail is tracked or predicted, and wireless control fires its LED when it passes a point that belongs to the target 3D shape.
works.technique_zh: 系统追踪或预测每个球在轨道上的位置，当它经过属于目标三维形状的点时，通过无线控制点亮它的 LED。
works.exercise_en: Attach a virtual light to a real rolling ball or toy train tracked in AR and switch it on only when it crosses the surface of an invisible 3D shape, leaving a short trail. Twist: let the audience pick the shape with a voice command.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一个虚拟灯附着在被追踪的真实滚球或玩具火车上，只在它穿过一个看不见的三维形状表面时点亮，并留下短暂的轨迹。变体：让观众用语音指令选择形状。

video.video_title: particles (2011)

works.title: protestAR / #arOCCUPYWALLSTREET
works.description: Occupy protesters barred from Wall Street are placed back in front of the New York Stock Exchange as virtual marchers and signs that police barricades cannot stop.
works.description_zh: 被警方挡在华尔街外的“占领”抗议者，以虚拟游行队伍和标语的形式重新出现在纽约证券交易所门前，路障拦不住他们。
works.idea_en: Virtual protesters can occupy space that real bodies are banned from.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟抗议者可以占领真实身体被禁止进入的空间。
works.technique: Protesters' avatars and signs are uploaded as geolocated 3D points of interest on the Layar AR browser at the NYSE coordinates, so anyone at Wall Street sees them through the camera.
works.technique_zh: 把抗议者的化身和标语作为地理定位的 3D 兴趣点上传到 Layar AR 浏览器，锚定在纽交所的坐标上，任何人在华尔街打开相机就能看到。
works.exercise_en: Let each student design a virtual placard and pin it with location-based WebXR or a Lens at a place on campus they cannot normally enter. Twist: the placards only appear when two or more phones are present.
works.exercise_zh: 让每位学生设计一块虚拟标语牌，用基于位置的 WebXR 或 Lens 把它放在校园里平时进不去的地方。变体：只有两部以上手机同时在场时标语才出现。

video.video_title: protestAR & the Augmented Reality Occupation of Wall Street -- Global Call

works.title: tele-present water
works.description: A large grid of wooden and wire segments hangs from motors and heaves up and down like the surface of a lake, replaying wave data recorded by a buoy on Lake Superior.
works.description_zh: 一张由木段和金属丝组成的大网格挂在电机下，像湖面一样起伏，重现苏必利尔湖上浮标记录的波浪数据。
works.idea_en: A remote sea can be rebuilt as a physical mesh in a room; AR can do the same with a virtual surface anchored to the floor.
works.idea_zh: 远方的海可以在房间里重建成一张实体网格；AR 也可以把一张虚拟水面锚定在地板上做同样的事。
works.technique: Wave intensity and acceleration from a buoy are scaled and sent to a row of motors on a ceiling grid that lift and drop the mesh points, turning a data stream into a moving topography.
works.technique_zh: 浮标的波浪强度和加速度数据经缩放后传给天花板网格上的一排电机，由它们提拉和放下网格节点，把数据流变成会动的地形。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a wire-mesh plane on the classroom floor in AR and animate its vertices from a public ocean-buoy data feed or a recorded CSV. Twist: let viewers stand under it and see the mesh from below like being underwater.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一张线框网格平面锚定在教室地面上，用公开的海洋浮标数据或录好的 CSV 驱动顶点起伏。变体：让观众站到网格下方，从下往上看，好像在水下。

video.video_title: tele-present water

works.title: the transfinite
works.description: In the Park Avenue Armory drill hall, a huge vertical screen and a floor are covered with streams of numbers, barcodes and flicker; visitors lie on the floor and walk behind the screen.
works.description_zh: 在纽约 Park Avenue Armory 的大厅里，一块巨大的竖直屏幕和地面布满了数字流、条码和闪烁；观众躺在地上，也可以走到屏幕后面。
works.idea_en: Scale changes meaning: the same data that is abstract on a laptop becomes overwhelming at 12 metres; AR can play with the size of information to make it felt.
works.idea_zh: 尺度改变意义：同样的数据在笔记本电脑上很抽象，放大到 12 米高就让人震撼；AR 可以通过信息的大小让人真正感受到它。
works.technique: Multiple projectors display mathematically generated data visuals on a front screen and a floor, synchronised with a multichannel electronic score.
works.technique_zh: 多台投影机在正面屏幕和地面上显示由数学生成的数据影像，与多声道电子乐同步。
works.exercise_en: Pick a dataset (for example, every step count in the class) and place it in AR as a floor-to-ceiling wall of scrolling numbers, then shrink it to palm size with a pinch. Twist: let the wall scroll at the speed of the loudest sound in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 选一组数据（例如全班每个人的步数），在 AR 里把它做成一堵从地面到天花板、不断滚动的数字墙，再用双指把它缩到手掌大小。变体：让数字墙的滚动速度跟随房间里最大的声音。

video.video_title: RYOJI IKEDA: the transfinite

works.title: 3D Video Capture with Kinect
works.description: Days after Kinect's release, Kreylos showed live 3D video of himself captured by a Kinect and viewed from any angle, an early step toward volumetric telepresence.
works.idea_zh: Kinect刚发售几天，就把人实时捕捉成可以任意角度观看的3D视频。

video.video_title: 3D Video Capture with Kinect

works.technique: The Kinect's depth image is back-projected into a 3D point cloud using its camera intrinsics and textured with the calibrated RGB image, so the capture can be rendered from any virtual viewpoint.
works.exercise_zh: 用 LiDAR iPhone 或 Record3D 采集自己的实时点云，在 three.js 中从任意角度旋转观看，并在其旁边放一个虚拟物体；变体：把点云风格化（体素、线框或粒子）拍一个 30 秒短片。
works.description_zh: Kinect 发售仅几天后，Kreylos 就展示了用 Kinect 实时捕捉、可从任意角度观看的自己的 3D 影像，这是迈向体积式远程临场的早期一步。
works.idea_en: Days after the Kinect came out, he captured a person as live 3D video you could view from any angle.
works.technique_zh: 利用 Kinect 相机内参把深度图像反投影成三维点云，再用标定后的 RGB 图像为其着色，使捕捉结果可以从任意虚拟视角渲染。
works.exercise_en: Capture a live point cloud of yourself with a LiDAR iPhone or Record3D, orbit it from any angle in three.js, and place a virtual object beside it. Twist: stylize the point cloud (voxels, wireframe or particles) and shoot a 30-second short.

works.title: 6 Times
works.description: Six life-size iron figures stand along the Water of Leith in Edinburgh, from the Gallery of Modern Art to the sea, four of them in the river itself, forming a walk through the city.
works.description_zh: 六尊等身铸铁人像沿爱丁堡的利斯河分布，从现代艺术馆一直到海边，其中四尊直接站在河水中，形成一条穿越城市的步行路线。
works.idea_en: Placing a figure at intervals along a river turns a walk into a narrative sequence, a structure location-based AR tours can copy.
works.idea_zh: 沿河间隔放置人像，把一次步行变成叙事序列，这种结构可以直接用于位置型 AR 导览。
works.technique: Identical figures are fixed on concrete footings in the riverbed and on the banks at irregular intervals along a four-mile route.
works.technique_zh: 相同的人像被固定在河床与河岸的混凝土基础上，沿约六公里的路线不规则分布。
works.exercise_en: Design a six-stop AR walk along a street or stream with 8th Wall or Lens Studio, placing one figure per stop, each a little closer to water. Twist: each figure points toward the next one so the walk needs no map.
works.exercise_zh: 用 8th Wall 或 Lens Studio 沿一条街道或小溪设计六站 AR 步行路线，每站放一个人像，一个比一个更接近水面；变体：每个人像都指向下一个人像，让整条路线无需地图。

video.video_title: Antony Gormley - 6 Times

works.title: AR Pop-up Book (Future Stories)
works.description: A do-it-yourself augmented reality pop-up book from York University's AR Lab: each page's marker makes images and video pop up in 3D, released as a kit anyone can fill with their own pictures.
works.description_zh: 约克大学 AR Lab 的自制增强现实立体书：每一页的标记会让图像和视频以 3D 形式弹出，并作为工具包发布，任何人都能放入自己的图片。
works.idea_en: Anyone can make a pop-up book whose pages come alive on screen.
works.idea_zh: 任何人都能做一本书页会在屏幕上活起来的立体书。
works.technique: A reusable FLARToolkit Flash template reads a playlist file, so each printed marker page shows the image or movie listed for it in a webcam view.
works.technique_zh: 一个可复用的 FLARToolkit Flash 模板读取播放列表文件，让每页打印的标记在网络摄像头画面中显示对应的图片或影片。
works.exercise_en: Make a four-page zine where each page is an image target that pops up a 3D scene in WebXR or Lens Studio. Twist: the last page shows the reader's own face.
works.exercise_zh: 做一本四页的小册子，每页都是图像目标，用 WebXR 或 Lens Studio 弹出一个 3D 场景。变体：最后一页显示的是读者自己的脸。

video.video_title: ArPopupBook.m4v

works.title: AR Sun Project
works.description: A virtual sun hangs in the sky of Dumbo, Brooklyn, tracking the real sun's path so that polluted or overshadowed places can still see a sun.
works.description_zh: 一颗虚拟太阳挂在布鲁克林 Dumbo 的天空中，沿着真实太阳的轨迹移动，让被污染或被遮挡的地方也能“看到”太阳。
works.idea_en: Replace a missing piece of nature with a synced virtual stand-in.
works.idea_zh: 用一个同步运行的虚拟替身，补上缺失的自然。
works.technique: The sun's azimuth and elevation are computed from time and location, and a glowing sphere is placed at that direction in a sensor-based mobile AR browser.
works.technique_zh: 根据时间和地点计算太阳的方位角与高度角，在基于传感器的移动 AR 浏览器里把发光球体放在那个方向上。
works.exercise_en: Use a sun-position formula and phone compass/gyro (WebXR or AR Foundation) to place a virtual sun exactly where the real one is. Twist: show the sun as it would be at this spot on your birthday.
works.exercise_zh: 用太阳位置公式加手机罗盘与陀螺仪（WebXR 或 AR Foundation），把虚拟太阳放在真实太阳的方向上。变体：显示你生日那天此地的太阳位置。

video.video_title: AR Sun Project DEMO seen in Dumbo, Brooklyn

works.title: AR X-Ray Vision Based on Visual Saliency
works.description: A user looks at a building and sees through its wall into the hidden room behind, while the most noticeable parts of the wall, like edges and signs, stay visible for context.
works.description_zh: 用户看向一栋建筑，就能透过墙看到后面隐藏的房间，同时墙面上最显眼的部分（如边缘和标识）仍然保留，提供上下文。
works.idea_en: See through walls, but keep just enough of the wall so your brain believes the depth.
works.idea_zh: 透视墙壁，但保留恰好足够的墙面，让大脑相信深度关系。
works.technique: Computes a visual saliency map of the occluding surface and uses it to decide which occluder pixels to keep over the rendered hidden content.
works.technique_zh: 计算遮挡表面的视觉显著性图，据此决定在渲染出的隐藏内容上方保留哪些遮挡物像素。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a door and the room behind it, then build a phone AR peephole that blends the hidden room over the live door while keeping the door's edges. Twist: let the hole follow a flashlight app's beam.
works.exercise_zh: 拍下一扇门和门后的房间，做一个手机 AR 窥视孔，把隐藏房间融合到实时的门上，同时保留门的边缘；变体：让窥视孔跟随手电筒 App 的光束移动。

video.video_title: An Augmented Reality X-Ray System Based on Visual Saliency (ISMAR 2010)

works.title: ARmonica
works.description: A collaborative sonic AR environment where users place and bounce virtual objects off physical bars to trigger musical notes together.
works.idea_zh: 多人在空间里摆放虚拟物体，让它们弹跳碰撞奏出音乐。

video.video_title: ARmonica: A Collaborative Sonic Environment

works.technique: Physical bars are tracked and modeled as colliders in a physics simulation, and virtual objects bouncing off them trigger pitched sound events rendered with spatial audio for all participants.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中检测桌面，把几根实体铅笔或尺子标记为“琴键”（手动放置对应虚拟碰撞体），让虚拟小球弹跳碰到时发出不同音高；变体：两人各控制一个发球点，合作弹出一段旋律。
works.description_zh: 一个协作式的声音 AR 环境：用户放置虚拟物体，让它们在实体横杆上弹跳，共同触发音符。
works.idea_en: Several people place virtual objects in space and let them bounce and collide to make music.
works.technique_zh: 实体横杆被追踪并在物理模拟中建模为碰撞体，虚拟物体弹到上面时触发带音高的声音事件，并以空间音频的形式呈现给所有参与者。
works.exercise_en: Detect a tabletop in AR, mark a few real pencils or rulers as 'keys' (placing matching virtual colliders by hand), and make virtual balls play different pitches when they bounce off them. Twist: two people each control a launch point and cooperate to play a melody.

works.title: After Ghostcatching
works.description: A stereoscopic 3D reworking of the 1999 Ghostcatching, in which Bill T. Jones's motion-captured dance and voice become drawn, multiplying figures that break out of their boxes.
works.description_zh: 对 1999 年作品 Ghostcatching 的立体 3D 重制：Bill T. Jones 被动捕的舞蹈和声音，化作不断增殖、冲破框格的手绘人物。
works.idea_en: A dancer's captured motion becomes drawn ghosts that escape their frame.
works.idea_zh: 舞者被捕捉的动作变成手绘的幽灵，挣脱画框逃逸。
works.technique: Jones's original motion-capture data are re-rendered in real time as stereoscopic line drawings in Field, with generative rules multiplying and trailing the figures.
works.technique_zh: 用 Field 把 Jones 的原始动捕数据实时重新渲染为立体线描，并以生成规则让人物增殖、拖尾。
works.exercise_en: Take one free mocap clip, render it as lines only (no mesh) in three.js, and add copies that follow the original with growing delay until they break a drawn box. Twist: view it in WebXR so the ghosts surround you.
works.exercise_zh: 拿一段免费动捕片段，在 three.js 中只用线条（不用网格）渲染，再加入越来越延迟地跟随原动作的副本，直到它们冲破画出的方框；变体：用 WebXR 观看，让幽灵环绕你。

video.video_title: After Ghostcatching HD excerpts

works.title: Argon AR Browser
works.description: Argon, the first AR web browser, renders standards-based web content (KHARMA/KML, later HTML/JavaScript) anchored to places and images, so anyone can author AR like a web page.
works.idea_zh: 用网页技术写AR，让现实世界可以像网页一样被发布和浏览。

video.video_title: Argon: Augmented Reality Browser

works.technique: Argon exposed AR as a web platform: pages written in KML/KHARMA and later HTML/JavaScript declared content anchored to geolocation or image targets, and the browser supplied the tracked camera pose to render it.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR（three.js）或 8th Wall 写一个完全用网页技术制作的 AR 页面，把 HTML 卡片锚定在一个平面或图像上，并分享链接给同学直接打开；变体：让同学通过编辑一个 JSON 文件就能往你的 AR 页面里添加内容。
works.description_zh: Argon 是第一款 AR 网页浏览器，它把基于标准的网页内容（KHARMA/KML，后来是 HTML/JavaScript）锚定在地点和图像上，让任何人都能像做网页一样创作 AR。
works.idea_en: Write AR with web technology so the real world can be published and browsed like a web page.
works.technique_zh: Argon 把 AR 做成一个网页平台：用 KML/KHARMA（后来是 HTML/JavaScript）编写的页面声明锚定于地理位置或图像目标的内容，浏览器则提供被追踪的相机位姿来渲染这些内容。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR page made entirely with web technology using WebXR (three.js) or 8th Wall, anchor an HTML card to a plane or image, and share the link so classmates can open it directly. Twist: let classmates add content to your AR page just by editing a JSON file.

works.title: Art Critic Face Matrix (We AR in MoMA)
works.description: Part of the uninvited AR show in MoMA: a matrix of critics' faces floats in the galleries, visible only through the Layar browser.
works.idea_zh: 在MoMA内部未经许可放置批评家面孔矩阵

video.video_title: Art Critic Face Matrix in MoMA (face detail)

works.technique: Layar geolocated POIs position billboarded 2D/3D content by GPS coordinates inside the museum, so anyone with the app sees it without the institution's permission.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR.js location-based 或 8th Wall 在学校某个“权威”空间（校长室门口、图书馆）放一组未经许可的虚拟面孔或评论；变体：让面孔的内容来自同学对这个空间的真实评价。
works.description_zh: 这是在 MoMA 举办的“不请自来”AR 展览的一部分：一组艺术评论家的面孔矩阵漂浮在展厅中，只有通过 Layar 浏览器才能看见。
works.idea_en: Put a matrix of critics' faces inside MoMA without permission.
works.technique_zh: Layar 的地理定位兴趣点按 GPS 坐标在博物馆内放置始终朝向观者的 2D/3D 内容，任何装了该应用的人都能看到，而无需机构许可。
works.exercise_en: Use location-based AR.js or 8th Wall to place a set of unauthorized virtual faces or comments in an 'authority' space at school (the principal's door, the library). Twist: draw the faces' content from classmates' real opinions of that space.

works.title: Augmented (hyper)Reality: Domestic Robocop
works.description: A first-person walk through a kitchen where every surface is covered in AR labels, recipes, ads and reward points; the film imagines how an 'augmented' home would be monetised.
works.idea_zh: 把家里每个平面都变成广告与界面，预演被信息淹没的增强生活

video.video_title: Augmented (hyper)Reality: Domestic Robocop

works.technique: Design-fiction compositing: a handheld first-person shot is camera-tracked in post (After Effects / 3D tracker) so UI labels are pinned to kitchen surfaces; a live version can be approximated with AR plane and image anchors.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 平面检测或 8th Wall 在厨房/宿舍的桌面、冰箱门上贴满标签、广告和积分弹窗，拍一段 30 秒第一人称视频；变体：让每个标签都要求用户“付费”或“看广告”才能关闭。
works.description_zh: 以第一人称视角走过一间厨房，每个表面都覆盖着 AR 标签、菜谱、广告和积分奖励；影片设想了一个被“增强”的家会如何被商业化。
works.idea_en: Turn every surface at home into ads and interfaces to rehearse a life drowning in information.
works.technique_zh: 设计虚构式的合成：手持第一人称镜头在后期中做摄像机追踪（After Effects / 3D 追踪器），把 UI 标签钉在厨房表面上；实时版本可以用 AR 平面锚点和图像锚点来近似实现。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation plane detection or 8th Wall to cover the tables and fridge door of a kitchen or dorm with labels, ads and points pop-ups, and shoot a 30-second first-person video. Twist: every label demands that the user 'pay' or 'watch an ad' before it can be closed.

works.title: Augmented City 3D
works.description: A stereoscopic film of a walk through a city whose AR layers can be customised, shared and hijacked, questioning who designs the augmented urban space.
works.idea_zh: 城市空间变成可订阅、可定制的AR图层，每个人看到不同的城市

video.video_title: Augmented City 3D [OFFICIAL]

works.technique: Stereoscopic 3D film with camera-tracked CG layers composited onto street footage; in a live build this maps to geolocated or VPS anchors with per-user layer sets.
works.exercise_zh: 选一段校园路线，在 WebXR 或 Unity 里做两套不同的 AR 图层（如“商业版”和“社群版”）并用按钮切换；变体：加入一个“被劫持”的图层，由另一名同学远程往你的城市里塞内容。
works.description_zh: 一部立体影片，带观众走过一座城市，城市中的 AR 图层可以被定制、分享和劫持，由此追问：增强后的城市空间由谁来设计？
works.idea_en: The city becomes subscribable, customizable AR layers, so everyone sees a different city.
works.technique_zh: 立体 3D 影片，把经过摄像机追踪的 CG 图层合成到街景素材上；若做成实时版本，则对应于地理定位或 VPS 锚点，加上按用户区分的图层集合。
works.exercise_en: Choose a campus route and build two different sets of AR layers in WebXR or Unity (say a 'commercial' version and a 'community' version), switched with a button. Twist: add a 'hijacked' layer that another classmate remotely stuffs with content in your city.

works.title: Augmented Foam Sculpting
works.description: A designer cuts a block of foam with a tracked hot-wire cutter while projected guides show where to cut, and the system records each cut to build a matching 3D model.
works.description_zh: 设计师用被追踪的热线切割器切割泡沫块，投影指引显示该在哪里下刀，系统记录每一刀并生成对应的 3D 模型。
works.idea_en: Capture a digital model as a side effect of making a physical one.
works.idea_zh: 在制作实体模型的同时，顺便得到它的数字模型。
works.technique: The foam and cutter are tracked, each cut plane is applied as a boolean subtraction to a virtual block, and projection shows cut lines and the evolving model on the foam.
works.technique_zh: 追踪泡沫和切割器，每一刀的切割平面都作为布尔减法作用在虚拟方块上，同时把切割线和逐步成形的模型投影到泡沫上。
works.exercise_en: Carve a potato or clay block while a phone on a tripod scans after each cut and shows the growing digital copy next to it in AR. Twist: project the next suggested cut onto the block.
works.exercise_zh: 雕刻一块土豆或黏土，三脚架上的手机在每次切割后扫描，并在旁边用 AR 显示逐渐成形的数字副本。变体：把下一刀的建议线投影到块体上。

video.video_title: Augmented Foam Sculpting for Capturing 3D Models

works.title: Augmented Shadow
works.description: A tabletop where visitors move real white blocks under a light; the shadows they cast are computer-generated and grow little houses, trees and characters that live only in the shadow world.
works.description_zh: 观众在一张桌面上移动真实的白色方块，灯光下投出的影子其实由计算机生成，影子里会长出小房子、树和角色，它们只存在于影子世界中。
works.idea_en: Fake the shadows of real objects so a hidden story can live inside them.
works.idea_zh: 伪造真实物体的影子，让一个隐藏的故事住在影子里。
works.technique: Tracked tabletop objects drive an openFrameworks renderer that projects computed shadow shapes from a virtual light, so shadow and object stay aligned as blocks move.
works.technique_zh: 用 openFrameworks 追踪桌面上的物体位置，再从一个虚拟光源计算阴影形状并投影出来，方块移动时影子始终与物体对齐。
works.exercise_en: Track two or three paper boxes on a table with a webcam and project fake shadows from a virtual lamp with a projector; add one shadow that behaves differently from its box. Twist: let the shadows walk away when nobody touches the boxes.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头追踪桌上两三个纸盒，再用投影仪从一盏虚拟台灯投出假影子，并让其中一个影子的行为与盒子不一致；变体：没人碰盒子时，让影子自己走开。

video.video_title: Augmented Shadow

salient.why_en: Plain white blocks cast shadows in which little houses, trees and people grow and live.
salient.why_zh: 普通的白色积木投下影子，影子里长出小房子、树和小人，过着自己的生活。

works.title: Bernstein's Mass, Royal Festival Hall
works.description: Yeast Culture designed the projected visuals for a staging of Leonard Bernstein's Mass at the Royal Festival Hall in London in summer 2010, framing the large choir and orchestra with shifting imagery.
works.description_zh: Yeast Culture 为 2010 年夏天在伦敦皇家节日音乐厅上演的伦纳德·伯恩斯坦《弥撒》设计投影视觉，用不断变化的影像框住庞大的合唱团和乐团。
works.idea_en: With a huge cast on stage, images must frame people rather than cover them; AR in crowded spaces should leave room for the humans.
works.idea_zh: 当舞台上人很多时，影像应当框住人，而不是盖住人；在拥挤空间里的 AR 要给人留出位置。
works.technique: Large-format projection above and behind the performers, cued to the score (likely operated live by the visual team).
works.technique_zh: 在表演者上方和身后做大画幅投影，跟随乐谱触发（很可能由视觉团队现场操作）。
works.exercise_en: Film a class choir or group and design an AR frame (Lens Studio or WebXR) that places imagery only in the empty space around people, using person segmentation. Twist: the imagery grows as more people join the frame.
works.exercise_zh: 拍摄班级合唱或一群人，用人像分割设计一个 AR 画框（Lens Studio 或 WebXR），只在人周围的空白处放置影像；变体：加入画面的人越多，影像长得越大。

video.video_title: Extract from Bernstien's Mass Opera - Yeast Culture - Royal Festival Hall

works.title: Big Screen Augmented Reality (with The Sancho Plan)
works.description: In Bristol's Millennium Square, people hold up white boards to the music and the BBC Big Screen shows animated characters and instruments standing on the boards in the live image.
works.description_zh: 在布里斯托千禧广场，人们随着音乐举起白板，BBC 大屏幕的实时画面里，动画角色和乐器就站在这些白板上。
works.idea_en: Public AR on a giant screen, where holding up a board brings a character to life for the whole square.
works.idea_zh: 巨型屏幕上的公共 AR：举起一块板，就为整个广场唤醒一个角色。
works.technique: A camera above the square tracks the boards as markers, and characters are composited onto them and shown on the big screen (likely openFrameworks; The Sancho Plan with Neil Mendoza and Pervasive Media Studio).
works.technique_zh: 广场上方的摄像头把白板当作标记追踪，把角色合成到白板上并在大屏幕播放（很可能用 openFrameworks；The Sancho Plan 与 Neil Mendoza、Pervasive Media Studio 合作）。
works.exercise_en: Film the class from above with a projector or big screen showing the feed, and make paper markers that each spawn a musical character when held up. Twist: characters only play when their markers are close together.
works.exercise_zh: 从上方拍摄全班，把画面投到大屏幕上，做几块纸标记，举起时各召唤一个音乐角色。变体：只有标记彼此靠近时，角色才一起演奏。

video.video_title: Big Screen Augmented Reality

works.title: BiggAR
works.description: The world's biggest interactive sculpture: 7,463,185,678 virtual blocks encapsulate the whole Earth, and anyone can change the colour of every block worldwide with one tap in the Layar app.
works.description_zh: 世界上最大的互动雕塑：74.6 亿个虚拟方块包裹整个地球，任何人在 Layar 应用里点一下，就能改变全球所有方块的颜色。
works.idea_en: A single sculpture covering the planet that everyone shares and anyone can change.
works.idea_zh: 一件覆盖整个星球、人人共享、任何人都能改变的雕塑。
works.technique: A server keeps one global colour state and the Layar browser generates the nearby blocks procedurally around each viewer's GPS position.
works.technique_zh: 服务器保存一个全球统一的颜色状态，Layar 浏览器围绕每个观众的 GPS 位置程序化生成附近的方块。
works.exercise_en: Build a shared AR grid of blocks around each user with a tiny server (e.g. Firebase) storing one global colour that any user can change. Twist: the colour decays back to grey unless changed every minute.
works.exercise_zh: 用一个小型服务器（如 Firebase）保存一个全球颜色，在每个用户周围生成共享的 AR 方块网格，任何人都能改颜色。变体：一分钟内没人改动，颜色就会褪回灰色。

video.video_title: Biggar - biggest interactive sculpture on earth - SNDRV

works.title: Blackfield
works.description: Thousands of tiny steel flowers are planted in white sand; from one side they are all black and burnt-looking, but when you walk around they turn into bright colours.
works.description_zh: 成千上万朵小钢花插在白沙中；从一侧看它们全是烧焦般的黑色，绕到另一侧，它们却变成鲜艳的色彩。
works.idea_en: The same field tells two opposite stories depending on where you stand, a direct model for viewpoint-dependent AR.
works.idea_zh: 同一片花田会因你站的位置不同而讲出两个相反的故事，是依赖视点的 AR 的直接范本。
works.technique: Each etched steel flower is painted black on one side and in colour on the other, and all are oriented the same way.
works.technique_zh: 每朵蚀刻钢花一面涂黑，另一面上色，并且全部朝向同一方向。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR field of flat flowers that are black when seen from the north and colourful when seen from the south, using a view-direction shader. Twist: the colours on the bright side come from photos visitors take.
works.exercise_zh: 用视线方向着色器制作一片 AR 扁平花田：从北面看是黑色，从南面看是彩色；变体：彩色一面的颜色取自访客拍摄的照片。

video.video_title: Zadok Ben-David - Blackfield Tel-Aviv Museum 2010  (Medium Quality version 275MB) SV.mpg

works.title: Border Crossers
works.description: Giant inflatable figures slowly rise and reach across a border line, bridging the space between two sides with soft, arching bodies.
works.description_zh: 巨大的充气人形缓缓升起，跨过一条边界线伸展，用柔软的拱形身体连接两边的空间。
works.idea_en: A figure that physically reaches across a real line gives the line meaning; AR can place bodies that bridge real boundaries on site.
works.idea_zh: 一个真实地跨越一条线的人形赋予了这条线意义；AR 可以在现场放置跨越真实边界的身体。
works.technique: Sequentially inflated fabric chambers and pneumatic control let very large figures stand, bend and lean without a rigid frame.
works.technique_zh: 依次充气的布腔和气动控制，让非常大的人形无需刚性框架也能站立、弯曲和倾身。
works.exercise_en: Anchor two AR figures on either side of a real line (a street, a fence, a crack in the pavement) that grow toward each other and touch when two phones point at them together. Twist: they only meet if both users stand still.
works.exercise_zh: 在一条真实的线（街道、围栏、人行道裂缝）两侧各锚定一个 AR 人形，当两部手机同时对准它们时，它们相向生长并触碰。变体：只有两位用户都站着不动时它们才会相遇。

video.video_title: Border Crosser Teaser by Chico MacMurtrie/Amorphic Robot Works

works.title: Cinématique
works.description: A dancer and a juggler-programmer perform inside projected letters, lines and particles that behave with physics and react to their gestures in real time.
works.idea_zh: 让投影里的文字和线条像有重量的物体一样被舞者推动
works.technique: Adrien Mondot's eMotion software runs physics-based particle and line systems, driven live by a digital performer and by motion sensing of the dancers.
works.exercise_zh: 用p5.js或Processing做有重力的文字粒子，投到墙上让同学用手势（摄像头）推开它们；变化：文字被推散后会慢慢组合成新的句子。

video.video_title: Adrien M & Claire B : Cinématique

works.description_zh: 一位舞者和一位兼任程序员的杂耍艺人在投影出的文字、线条和粒子中表演，这些元素遵循物理规律，并对他们的动作作出实时反应。
works.idea_en: Let a dancer push projected letters and lines as if they were objects with weight.
works.technique_zh: Adrien Mondot 的 eMotion 软件运行基于物理的粒子与线条系统，由一位数字表演者现场操控，同时接收舞者的动作感应数据。
works.exercise_en: Make text particles with gravity in p5.js or Processing, project them on a wall, and let classmates push them away with hand gestures (via camera). Twist: once scattered, the letters slowly reassemble into a new sentence.

works.title: Circle of Animals/Zodiac Heads
works.description: Twelve large bronze animal heads of the Chinese zodiac, based on the looted fountain-clock heads of the Old Summer Palace in Beijing, stand in a circle in public plazas such as the Pulitzer Fountain in New York.
works.description_zh: 十二个大型十二生肖青铜兽首以北京圆明园被掠夺的水力钟兽首为原型，在纽约普利策喷泉等公共广场上围成一圈。
works.idea_en: Re-staging lost heritage objects at monumental size in a public square asks who owns them, a question AR restitution projects also face.
works.idea_zh: 在公共广场上以巨大尺度重现遗失的文物，引出“它们属于谁”的问题，AR 文物回归项目也面临同样的问题。
works.technique: Each head was modelled from the surviving and missing originals, enlarged and cast in bronze on columns.
works.technique_zh: 每个兽首依据现存与遗失的原件建模，放大后铸成青铜，立在柱子上。
works.exercise_en: Scan or find 3D models of museum objects removed from their original site and place them back in AR at their place of origin. Twist: show the route each object travelled as an AR line on a map.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描或找到被带离原址的博物馆藏品的 3D 模型，用 AR 把它们放回原来的地方；变体：用地图上的 AR 线条显示每件物品流转的路线。

video.video_title: It's My Park: Circle of Animals/Zodiac Heads by Ai Weiwei

works.title: ClockClock
works.description: Twenty-four analogue clocks arranged in a grid rotate their hands in choreographed sweeps, then stop so that the hands together form the digits of the current time.
works.description_zh: 二十四个模拟时钟排成网格，指针按编排整齐旋转，然后停下来，所有指针合起来拼出当前时间的数字。
works.idea_en: A familiar object used in an unfamiliar grid becomes a new display — AR can recombine everyday objects as pixels.
works.idea_zh: 把熟悉的物件放进陌生的阵列里，它就成了一种新的显示器——AR 可以把日常物件重新组合成像素。
works.technique: Each clock has two independently driven hands on stepper motors; firmware animates transitions and then aligns hand angles into segment-style digits.
works.technique_zh: 每个时钟有两根由步进电机独立驱动的指针；固件先做过渡动画，再把指针角度对齐成类似数码管的数字。
works.exercise_en: Build a 6×4 grid of virtual clock faces on a real wall in AR whose hands swirl and then spell the current time or the user's initials. Twist: let the hands point at the viewer as they walk past.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中于真实墙面上做一个 6×4 的虚拟钟面阵列，指针旋转后拼出当前时间或用户姓名首字母。变体：观众走过时让所有指针指向他。

video.video_title: The clock clock by humans since 1982, 2010

works.title: Crossings
works.description: For Toronto's Nuit Blanche, huge drawn figures walked, climbed and crossed the angled glass-and-metal facets of Daniel Libeskind's Crystal extension of the Royal Ontario Museum all night.
works.description_zh: 在多伦多“白夜”艺术节上，巨大的手绘风格人物整夜在丹尼尔·里伯斯金设计的皇家安大略博物馆“水晶”扩建立面上行走、攀爬、穿越那些倾斜的玻璃与金属切面。
works.idea_en: Let figures walk across a building's broken geometry as if it were terrain.
works.idea_zh: 让人物把建筑破碎的几何形体当作地形来行走。
works.technique: Motion-captured figures rendered in Field are projection-mapped across the facade's facets with multiple projectors, in a 'site-specifiable' system that adapts to any complex architecture.
works.technique_zh: 在 Field 中渲染的动捕人物用多台投影仪映射到立面各切面上，这套“可适配场地”的系统能适应任何复杂建筑。
works.exercise_en: Projection-map a walking character onto two or three boxes stacked at angles in the classroom using MadMapper or a free mapping tool, so it seems to step from face to face. Twist: make the figure's gait change on each surface.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MadMapper 或免费映射工具，把一个行走角色映射到教室里几个斜放堆叠的箱子上，让它看起来从一个面跨到另一个面；变体：让人物在每个面上的步态都不同。

video.video_title: Crossings / Toronto

works.title: DUNE
works.description: A long landscape of thousands of light fibres along the Maastunnel in Rotterdam that brightens and pulses as pedestrians walk past and make sound.
works.description_zh: 沿鹿特丹 Maastunnel 延伸的一片由数千根光纤组成的景观，行人走过或发出声音时会亮起并脉动。
works.idea_en: Augment a public path with nature-like light that notices the people using it.
works.idea_zh: 用类似自然的光来增强一条公共道路，让它能“察觉”到经过的人。
works.technique: Motion and sound sensors along the installation control LEDs at the fibre tips section by section, creating a local wave of light around each passer-by.
works.technique_zh: 装置沿线的动作和声音传感器分段控制光纤末端的 LED，在每位路人周围形成局部的光浪。
works.exercise_en: Line a corridor with an addressable LED strip and an ultrasonic sensor every metre so light follows walkers. Twist: whispering makes it glow softer, shouting makes it hide.
works.exercise_zh: 在走廊里铺一条可寻址 LED 灯带，每隔一米装一个超声波传感器，让光跟随行人；变体：轻声说话时光变柔，大喊时光会“躲起来”。

video.video_title: DUNE | Interactive Landscape of Light in Rotterdam by Studio Roosegaarde [OFFICIAL MOVIE]

works.title: Der Ring des Nibelungen (Metropolitan Opera)
works.description: Lepage's Ring cycle at the Metropolitan Opera uses 'The Machine', a set of 24 rotating planks, onto which projections of rivers, rocks and forests move as singers climb on it.
works.description_zh: Lepage 在大都会歌剧院执导的《尼伯龙根的指环》使用了名为“机器”的布景：24 块可旋转的长板，河流、岩石和森林的投影随着歌手在上面攀爬而流动。
works.idea_en: A moving physical surface plus projection gives virtual landscapes real slopes to walk on, the same pairing AR needs between content and real geometry.
works.idea_zh: 会动的实体表面加上投影，让虚拟风景有了可以行走的真实坡度，这正是 AR 内容与真实几何需要的配合。
works.technique: Hydraulic planks reconfigure into shapes while video, some of it responding to the singers' movements, is projected onto their surfaces.
works.technique_zh: 液压长板组合出各种形状，影像投在板面上，其中一部分会回应歌手的动作。
works.exercise_en: Arrange a few tilted boards or stairs in the classroom, scan them with a LiDAR phone, and drape an AR river that flows down their real slopes. Twist: the river's direction flips when someone climbs onto a board.
works.exercise_zh: 在教室里摆几块倾斜的板子或台阶，用 LiDAR 手机扫描，让一条 AR 河顺着真实坡度流下；变体：有人爬上板子时，河流方向反转。

video.video_title: Der Ring Des Nibelungen Teaser

works.title: Din blinde passager (Your blind passenger)
works.description: Visitors walk through a 90-metre tunnel filled with dense fog; they can see only about a metre and a half ahead, and the colour of the light changes from one zone to the next.
works.description_zh: 观众穿过一条 90 米长、充满浓雾的隧道，只能看清前方一米半左右，灯光颜色在不同区段之间变化。
works.idea_en: When sight is reduced, the body navigates by sound and touch; AR does not have to add more to see, it can also take visibility away to make people feel space.
works.idea_zh: 视野受限时，身体会靠声音和触觉导航；AR 不一定要让人看到更多，也可以拿走可见性，让人感受空间。
works.technique: A haze system fills a narrow corridor with fog so dense that light scatters in every direction, and coloured fluorescent tubes set zones of yellow, white and blue (likely).
works.technique_zh: 雾机让狭长走廊充满浓雾，光向各个方向散射，彩色荧光灯管划分出黄、白、蓝等区段（可能如此）。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation's depth or mesh data to render a fog that hides everything farther than 1.5 m from the phone, and ask students to cross the room with it. Twist: change the fog colour depending on which part of the room they are in.
works.exercise_zh: 利用 AR Foundation 的深度或网格数据，渲染一层雾，遮住离手机超过 1.5 米的一切，让同学拿着它穿过房间。变体：根据他们所处的房间区域改变雾的颜色。

video.video_title: Olafur Eliasson 'Din Blinde Passager (Your Blind Passenger)' 2010

works.title: Exposure
works.description: A 26-metre crouching figure made of an open steel lattice sits on a dyke at Lelystad in Flevoland, on land reclaimed from the sea; from close up it dissolves into a web of beams.
works.description_zh: 一个高 26 米、由开放钢结构组成的蹲坐人形位于弗莱福兰省莱利斯塔德的堤坝上，这片土地是从海中围垦而来；走近看，它会溶解成一张钢梁之网。
works.idea_en: The figure reads as a body from far away and as pure structure up close, a lesson in designing AR objects for two viewing distances.
works.idea_zh: 远看是身体，近看是纯粹结构，这是为两种观看距离设计 AR 物体的一课。
works.technique: A digitised body pose was converted into a network of 14,000 steel members of varying length, so the lattice resolves into a figure only at a distance.
works.technique_zh: 把数字化的身体姿态转换成由 14000 根长短不一的钢构件组成的网络，只有从远处才会聚合成人形。
works.exercise_en: Convert a scanned body into a point-and-line wireframe (Blender geometry nodes) and place it outdoors in AR at 20 metres tall. Twist: fade the lines out as the viewer walks closer so the body disappears when you reach it.
works.exercise_zh: 把扫描人体转换成点线框架（Blender 几何节点），在户外 AR 中放置为 20 米高；变体：观者越走越近时线条逐渐淡出，走到跟前时身体完全消失。

video.video_title: Interview met Antony Gormley over het kunstwerk Exposure

works.title: EyePet (PlayStation Move edition)
works.description: EyePet updated for the PlayStation Move controller, which becomes tracked tools such as a hairdryer, shower head or paint brush in the pet's AR world.
works.idea_zh: 手里的Move手柄变成吹风机、画笔等AR工具，照顾宠物。

video.video_title: EyePet Move E3 Trailer

works.technique: The Move controller's glowing ball is tracked by the camera for position and its IMU for orientation, so it can be rendered as swappable virtual tools in the pet's space.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机当道具控制器，把它的姿态映射成 AR 中的吹风机、刷子等工具，给宠物梳洗；变体：每种工具有独特的声音反馈。
works.description_zh: 为 PlayStation Move 手柄推出的 EyePet 升级版，手柄在宠物的 AR 世界里变成可被追踪的工具，比如吹风机、花洒或画笔。
works.idea_en: The Move controller in your hand becomes an AR hairdryer or paintbrush for looking after your pet.
