works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪 Move 手柄上发光球的位置，IMU 提供其朝向，因此手柄可以在宠物空间中渲染为可切换的虚拟工具。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone as a prop controller, map its orientation to AR tools such as a hairdryer or brush, and groom a pet. Twist: give each tool its own distinctive sound feedback.

works.title: Face projection test
works.description: Real-time projection mapping onto a moving face: a face tracker drives graphics projected directly onto the performer's skin.
works.idea_zh: 把图形直接投影到会动的人脸上，脸成为实时屏幕。

video.video_title: face projection test

works.technique: A face tracker on a camera co-located with the projector detects landmarks, and a camera-projector homography (calibrated once) warps the rendered graphics so they land on the moving face.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影仪和摄像头并排放置，用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 检测脸，再通过四点标定把图形投到同学脸上（注意亮度和眼睛安全）；变体：只投射在脸上会“流下来”的动态纹理，讲一个关于情绪的小片段。
works.description_zh: 在移动的人脸上做实时投影映射：人脸追踪器驱动图形，直接投射到表演者的皮肤上。
works.idea_en: Project graphics straight onto a moving face so the face becomes a live screen.
works.technique_zh: 与投影仪放在一起的摄像头上运行人脸追踪器来检测特征点，再通过（只需标定一次的）相机-投影仪单应矩阵对渲染图形做变形，使其准确落在移动的脸上。
works.exercise_en: Place a projector and camera side by side, detect a face with MediaPipe Face Mesh, and use four-point calibration to project graphics onto a classmate's face (mind the brightness and eye safety). Twist: project only dynamic textures that 'run down' the face, telling a short piece about emotion.

works.title: Falling Light
works.description: Light shines through slowly turning glass lenses, and the focused spots on the floor look like drops of light that fall, grow and splash across the ground.
works.description_zh: 光线穿过缓慢转动的玻璃透镜，落在地面上的聚焦光斑像一滴滴下落、扩大、溅开的光。
works.idea_en: Caustics make light look like a liquid — animated light spots on the real floor are a cheap, convincing AR effect.
works.idea_zh: 焦散让光看起来像液体——在真实地面上移动的光斑是一种便宜又逼真的 AR 效果。
works.technique: Rotating lenses shift and refocus the beams from a light source above, so bright caustic spots move and pulse on the floor below.
works.technique_zh: 旋转的透镜不断移动和重新聚焦上方光源的光束，使明亮的焦散光斑在下方地面上移动、脉动。
works.exercise_en: Project virtual caustic 'raindrops' onto a detected floor plane in AR that fall from a point above and splash into rings. Twist: let the drops fall only where nobody is standing.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中向检测到的地面平面投射虚拟焦散“雨滴”，从上方一点落下并溅成光环。变体：只让雨滴落在没人站立的地方。

video.video_title: Troika, Falling Light

works.title: Fat Tag, Meet Projector
works.description: The Fat Tag iPhone graffiti app wired straight into a pocket projector, turning finger-drawn tags into instant projection bombing on city walls.
works.idea_zh: 手机上手指画的涂鸦直接投到街头墙面，最简“投影轰炸”。

video.video_title: Fat Tag, Meet Projector

works.technique: Touch strokes from a phone drawing app are streamed (likely over OSC or network) to a laptop that renders them to a pico projector aimed at a wall.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机网页画板，用 WebSocket 把笔画实时传到连投影仪的电脑并投到墙上；变体：限定只能画一种符号，全班在同一面墙上合作完成一幅“标签地图”。
works.description_zh: 把 iPhone 涂鸦应用 Fat Tag 直接接到口袋投影仪上，手指画出的涂鸦标签立刻就能“投影轰炸”到城市墙面上。
works.idea_en: Finger graffiti on a phone goes straight onto a street wall: the simplest projection bombing.
works.technique_zh: 手机绘画应用中的触摸笔画被实时传送（大概率通过 OSC 或网络）到一台笔记本电脑，由它渲染并输出到对准墙面的微型投影仪。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone web drawing pad, stream strokes over WebSocket to a computer connected to a projector, and project them onto a wall. Twist: allow only one kind of symbol, and have the whole class build a 'tag map' together on the same wall.

works.title: Feedback (with Todd Vanderlin)
works.description: A large interactive wall for Roundhouse CircusFest that turns performers' and visitors' movements into layered visual feedback; a later version used Kinect for 3D interaction.
works.idea_zh: 把人的动作不断回授成层层叠叠的视觉回声
works.technique: Camera (later Kinect depth) input is composited with its own previous frames to create a video-feedback trail driven by the body.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头画面叠加上一帧并略微缩放旋转，做出“视觉回声”投影；变化：用手的高度控制回声的旋转角度。

video.video_title: Feedback

works.description_zh: 为 Roundhouse CircusFest 制作的大型互动墙，把表演者和观众的动作变成层层叠叠的视觉反馈；后来的版本使用 Kinect 实现三维互动。
works.idea_en: Feed people's movements back into themselves as layer upon layer of visual echoes.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头（后来改为 Kinect 深度）输入与自身之前的帧进行合成，形成由身体驱动的视频反馈拖尾。
works.exercise_en: Overlay the camera image on the previous frame with a slight scale and rotation to project a 'visual echo'. Twist: use hand height to control the echo's rotation angle.

works.title: Fragments of RGB
works.description: What looks like a classic LED screen is simulated with projected light points; as viewers approach, the pixels change, scatter and dissolve with their movement and point of view.
works.description_zh: 看上去像一块传统 LED 屏幕，其实是用投影光点模拟出来的；观众走近时，像素随着他们的动作和视角改变、散开并消解。
works.idea_en: A screen that falls apart into pixels when you get close.
works.idea_zh: 你一靠近，屏幕就碎成像素。
works.technique: A camera tracks the viewer's position and a projection simulates an LED pixel grid whose pixels are displaced and dissolved according to distance and angle.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪观众位置，投影模拟出一个 LED 像素网格，像素根据距离和角度发生位移并消散。
works.exercise_en: Show a video as a grid of large dots in p5.js and use the webcam's face size to scatter the dots as the viewer leans in. Twist: the image only becomes readable from one exact spot.
works.exercise_zh: 在 p5.js 里把一段视频显示成大圆点网格，用摄像头检测到的人脸大小，在观众靠近时把圆点打散；变体：只有站在某一个位置时，图像才能看清。

video.video_title: fragments of RGB - 01

works.title: Ghost Projection for Richard III
works.description: Stage media for a Carnegie Mellon production of Richard III: computer vision tracks actors playing ghosts and projects static noise only onto their moving bodies.
works.idea_zh: 舞台上只在“鬼魂”演员身上投影雪花噪点，让他们变成幽灵。

video.video_title: Ghost Projection (Test) for Richard III

works.technique: Stage cameras (likely IR with background subtraction) segment the actors' bodies, and the resulting matte, warped through a camera-projector calibration, restricts projected video noise to their silhouettes.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 人体分割加投影仪，只在同学身上投电视雪花噪点，背景保持全黑；变体：写一段 1 分钟的“鬼魂独白”，让噪点随台词音量变强变弱。
works.description_zh: 为卡内基梅隆大学《理查三世》制作的舞台影像：计算机视觉追踪扮演鬼魂的演员，只在他们移动的身体上投射静电雪花噪点。
works.idea_en: Project static noise only onto the 'ghost' actors on stage, turning them into phantoms.
works.technique_zh: 舞台摄像头（可能是红外摄像头配合背景减除）把演员的身体分割出来，得到的遮罩经过相机-投影仪标定变换后，把投影的视频噪点限制在他们的剪影之内。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe body segmentation and a projector to cast TV static only onto a classmate, keeping the background completely black. Twist: write a one-minute 'ghost monologue' and let the static grow and fade with the loudness of the lines.

works.title: Growth (Virtual Public Art Project)
works.description: Visitors to Prospect Park in Brooklyn point an iPhone or Android phone at a spot in the park and see a 30-foot fractal polygon sculpture standing among the trees.
works.description_zh: 来到布鲁克林展望公园的游客把 iPhone 或安卓手机对准公园里某个位置，就能看到一座 9 米高的分形多边形雕塑矗立在树木之间。
works.idea_en: Install a giant public sculpture that costs nothing to build and exists only through phones.
works.idea_zh: 安装一座不花建造成本、只在手机中存在的巨型公共雕塑。
works.technique: A hand-made physical form was 3D-scanned and placed at GPS coordinates using an early location-based AR browser (likely Layar), viewable from all sides.
works.technique_zh: 先手工制作实体造型并三维扫描，再用早期的基于位置的 AR 浏览器（很可能是 Layar）放置到 GPS 坐标上，可从各个方向观看。
works.exercise_en: Sculpt a small object from clay, scan it with a phone, and place it in a campus square at large scale using a geolocated AR tool. Twist: design it so it only makes sense from one path through the square.
works.exercise_zh: 用黏土捏一个小物件，用手机扫描，再用基于地理位置的 AR 工具把它放大放置在校园广场上；变体：把它设计成只有沿着某条路线穿过广场时才能看懂。

video.video_title: The Virtual Public Art Project - Christopher Manzione

works.title: Guggenheim YouTube Play
works.description: For the 2010 YouTube Play biennial awards, Obscura mapped the Guggenheim Museum's spiral exterior and, at the same time, the entire interior rotunda, surrounding the audience with real-time graphics inside Frank Lloyd Wright's building.
works.description_zh: 在 2010 年 YouTube Play 双年展颁奖典礼上，Obscura 同时为古根海姆博物馆的螺旋外立面和整个内部圆形大厅做了投影，让观众在弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特的建筑中被实时图形包围。
works.idea_en: Mapping inside and outside at once makes one building a continuous experience; AR can link an exterior view with what happens inside.
works.idea_zh: 内外同时投影，让一座建筑成为连续的体验；AR 可以把外部看到的与内部发生的连接起来。
works.technique: Seamless projection on the curved exterior plus a 360° projection on the rotunda, driven by custom real-time video graphics systems.
works.technique_zh: 外部曲面的无缝投影，加上圆形大厅的 360° 投影，由定制的实时视频图形系统驱动。
works.exercise_en: Make a two-part AR piece: an effect on the outside of a building that hints at something, and a second effect inside that answers it (8th Wall or AR Foundation). Twist: what visitors do inside changes what people outside see.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个两部分的 AR 作品：建筑外部的效果留下一个悬念，内部的第二个效果给出回答（8th Wall 或 AR Foundation）；变体：室内观众的行为会改变室外的人看到的内容。

video.video_title: Obscura Digital mapping the Guggenheim for YouTube Play

works.title: HOME (Alice Springs)
works.description: Part of the Digital Odyssey project, portraits and stories of Alice Springs residents are projected onto local buildings and landscape features at night, made in collaboration with the community.
works.description_zh: 作为 Digital Odyssey 项目的一部分，艾丽斯斯普林斯居民的肖像与故事在夜里被投影到当地建筑和地貌上，与社区共同创作完成。
works.idea_en: The people of a place are the best content for that place; location-based AR can make residents visible on their own streets.
works.idea_zh: 一个地方的人，就是这个地方最好的内容；基于位置的 AR 可以让居民出现在他们自己的街道上。
works.technique: Community-recorded portrait videos are projected site-specifically onto walls and natural features from mobile projection rigs.
works.technique_zh: 由社区参与拍摄的人像视频，通过移动投影设备投在特定场地的墙面和自然地貌上。
works.exercise_en: Interview three people who live or work near a spot on campus, and geo-anchor their short video portraits to the walls they chose using location-based AR. Twist: the portrait speaks only when the viewer stands where that person usually stands.
works.exercise_zh: 采访三位在校园某处生活或工作的人，用基于位置的 AR 把他们的短视频肖像锚定到他们自己选的墙上；变体：只有当观众站在那个人平时站的位置，肖像才开口说话。

video.video_title: HOME (Alice Springs)

works.title: Horizon Field
works.description: One hundred cast-iron figures stand across 150 square kilometres of the Vorarlberg Alps, each at exactly 2,039 metres above sea level, so hikers meet them on slopes, ridges and near huts.
works.description_zh: 一百尊铸铁人像分布在奥地利福拉尔贝格州 150 平方公里的阿尔卑斯山区，每一尊都精确位于海拔 2039 米处，登山者会在山坡、山脊和小屋旁与它们相遇。
works.idea_en: All figures sit on one invisible contour line, so the landscape itself draws a horizontal line through the mountains: an AR layer can reveal a hidden datum in the same way.
works.idea_zh: 所有人像都位于同一条看不见的等高线上，于是山体本身在群山间画出一条水平线：AR 图层可以用同样方式揭示隐藏的基准面。
works.technique: Each figure was placed by survey at the same altitude, turning a contour line from the map into a visible, walkable line of bodies.
works.technique_zh: 每尊人像都经测量放置在同一海拔，把地图上的一条等高线变成一条看得见、走得到的人体连线。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone's barometer or GPS altitude in a WebXR page to place a virtual marker whenever the user is at one chosen height on a hill or staircase. Twist: have the whole class walk and leave markers, then view the shared contour line together.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 页面中读取手机气压计或 GPS 海拔，每当用户到达山坡或楼梯上的某个选定高度时放置一个虚拟标记；变体：全班一起走并留下标记，最后一起查看共享的等高线。

video.video_title: Antony Gormley I Horizon Field I Vorarlberg

works.title: Hylozoic Ground
works.description: At the Venice Architecture Biennale, a forest-like canopy of thousands of acrylic fronds, feathers and glass vessels ripples, breathes and glows as visitors walk beneath it.
works.description_zh: 在威尼斯建筑双年展上，由成千上万片亚克力叶片、羽毛和玻璃容器组成的森林般的穹顶，在观众从下方走过时起伏、呼吸、发光。
works.idea_en: Thousands of tiny local reactions add up to a room that feels alive; in AR, many small agents reacting to nearby people beat one big scripted animation.
works.idea_zh: 成千上万个微小的局部反应加起来，就是一个仿佛有生命的房间；在 AR 里，许多对附近人群做出反应的小单元胜过一个大型脚本动画。
works.technique: Capacitive and infrared proximity sensors feed a distributed network of microcontrollers that pull shape-memory-alloy wires, moving fronds and triggering lights in waves that spread outward.
works.technique_zh: 电容和红外接近传感器把信号送入一个分布式微控制器网络，由它们拉动形状记忆合金丝，带动叶片并触发灯光，形成向外扩散的波。
works.exercise_en: Fill a ceiling in AR with hundreds of simple fronds that each bend toward the nearest tracked hand and pass the motion on to their neighbours. Twist: add a slow 'breathing' rhythm that pauses when nobody is present.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把天花板铺满几百片简单的叶片，每片都朝最近的被追踪的手弯曲，并把动作传给相邻的叶片。变体：加一个缓慢的“呼吸”节律，没人时暂停。

video.video_title: Hylozoic Ground | Venice Biennale 2010

works.title: In-Place Sketching AR Games
works.description: Prototype games in which players draw walls, holes and characters on paper, and the camera turns the drawing into a playable AR level that updates as they keep sketching.
works.description_zh: 几款原型游戏：玩家在纸上画出墙、洞和角色，摄像头把画作变成可玩的 AR 关卡，而且随着继续作画实时更新。
works.idea_en: Drawing and playing happen on the same sheet at the same time.
works.idea_zh: 画画和玩游戏在同一张纸上同时发生。
works.technique: Sketch recognition classifies hand-drawn symbols into game elements and tracks the paper itself, based on research by Nate Hagbi, Raphael Grasset, Oriel Bergig, Mark Billinghurst and Jihad El-Sana (IEEE VR 2010).
works.technique_zh: 草图识别把手绘符号分类为游戏元素，同时追踪纸张本身；技术源自 Nate Hagbi、Raphael Grasset、Oriel Bergig、Mark Billinghurst 和 Jihad El-Sana 的研究（IEEE VR 2010）。
works.exercise_en: Define three drawn symbols (circle = hole, line = wall, X = goal) and build an AR ball-rolling game whose level is read from a photo of the paper. Twist: let a second player sabotage by drawing during play.
works.exercise_zh: 定义三种手绘符号（圆 = 洞，线 = 墙，X = 终点），做一个 AR 滚球游戏，关卡从纸张照片中读取。变体：允许第二位玩家在游戏过程中动笔搞破坏。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Hand Sketching Games

works.title: Incursion, 25.033°N / 121.633°E (Taipei)
works.description: A four-channel projection in a concrete drainage channel of Taipei's Zhonggang river corridor shows giant creatures and figures moving through the waterway in a 14-minute loop, as if the infrastructure were inhabited.
works.description_zh: 在台北中港大排的混凝土排水渠里，四路投影在 14 分钟的循环中呈现巨大的生物和人物穿过水道，仿佛这段城市基础设施里住着什么。
works.idea_en: Overlooked infrastructure becomes a stage when something unexpected appears in it at the right scale, a strong idea for city-scale AR.
works.idea_zh: 被忽视的城市设施，只要以合适的尺度出现一个意想不到的东西，就会变成舞台——这是城市尺度 AR 的有力思路。
works.technique: Four synchronized projectors map a looping video onto the walls and surfaces of an urban drainage channel.
works.technique_zh: 四台同步投影机把一段循环视频映射到城市排水渠的墙面和表面上。
works.exercise_en: Find a neglected corner of campus (a drain, stairwell, loading dock) and place a large animated creature there in phone AR that moves along the real geometry. Twist: the creature hides when more than one phone looks at it.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里找一个被忽视的角落（排水沟、楼梯井、卸货区），用手机 AR 在那里放一只沿真实结构移动的大型动画生物；变体：当不止一台手机看着它时，它会躲起来。

works.title: Intangible States (with Stray Dogs)
works.description: A live audiovisual performance where video by Legoman is projection-mapped onto a stage set of stacked boxes and screens, evoking the dream states of an urban nomad.
works.idea_zh: 把城市漂泊者的梦境投影到一堆箱子搭成的舞台上
works.technique: Live VJ software maps video onto each face of stacked boxes using masks and corner-pinning, performed in sync with live electronic music.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸箱堆出舞台，用免费映射软件（如MapMapper/Resolume试用版）把不同视频贴到每个面；变化：现场根据音乐切换每个箱子的画面。

video.video_title: ARCHIVE - Intangible States (by Stray Dogs & Legoman)

works.description_zh: 一场现场视听表演，Legoman 的影像被投影映射到由堆叠箱体和屏幕搭成的舞台布景上，呈现一个城市漂泊者的梦境状态。
works.idea_en: Project an urban drifter's dreams onto a stage built from a pile of boxes.
works.technique_zh: 现场 VJ 软件通过遮罩和四角定位把影像映射到堆叠箱体的各个面上，并与现场电子音乐同步演出。
works.exercise_en: Stack cardboard boxes into a stage and use free mapping software (such as MapMapper or a Resolume trial) to put different videos on each face. Twist: switch each box's image live in response to the music.

works.title: Invizimals: Shadow Zone
works.description: The sequel adds more creatures, new capture challenges and battles that play out around the camera-tracked trap card on the player's table.
works.idea_zh: 续作带来更多隐形生物和围绕陷阱卡的捕捉挑战。

video.video_title: inviZimals™: Shadow Zone Gameplay Trailer E3

works.technique: Marker-based tracking on the trap card anchors creatures and battle effects, with capture challenges requiring the player to move the handheld relative to the marker.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个需要移动手机围绕标记卡才能完成的捕捉挑战，例如从特定角度对准生物；变体：捕捉时间窗口随生物稀有度缩短。
works.description_zh: 续作加入了更多生物、新的捕捉挑战，以及围绕玩家桌上那张被摄像头追踪的陷阱卡展开的对战。
works.idea_en: The sequel adds more invisible creatures and capture challenges built around the trap card.
works.technique_zh: 对陷阱卡进行基于标记的追踪，以此锚定生物和战斗特效；捕捉挑战要求玩家相对于标记移动掌机。
works.exercise_en: Design a capture challenge that can only be completed by moving the phone around a marker card, for example lining up with the creature from a specific angle. Twist: the capture window gets shorter the rarer the creature is.

works.title: Kylie Minogue — Get Outta My Way
works.description: A music video shot at Pinewood Studios where Kylie Minogue and dancers perform inside huge interactive projections that ripple, stretch and light up in response to their bodies.
works.description_zh: 在 Pinewood 影棚拍摄的音乐录影带，Kylie Minogue 和舞者们在巨大的交互投影中表演，投影随他们的身体泛起涟漪、拉伸并亮起。
works.idea_en: Pop choreography shot live inside a responsive light set instead of adding effects in post.
works.idea_zh: 流行编舞直接在会回应的光影布景中实拍，而不是靠后期加特效。
works.technique: Two stages with large projector rigs ran Weiss's real-time tracking visuals, reacting to the performers while an ARRI Alexa filmed the result in camera.
works.technique_zh: 两个摄影棚配置大型投影系统，运行 Weiss 的实时追踪视觉，随表演者变化，由 ARRI Alexa 直接在机内拍下效果。
works.exercise_en: Film a 30-second phone music video where a projected pattern reacts to the dancer via webcam tracking, with no effects added afterwards. Twist: the projection only reacts to the beat when the dancer is on it.
works.exercise_zh: 拍一支 30 秒的手机音乐短片，投影图案通过摄像头追踪对舞者作出反应，拍完不加任何后期特效；变体：只有舞者踩在节拍上时，投影才会响应。

video.video_title: Kylie Minogue - Get Outta My Way (Official Video)

works.title: Lake Baikal
works.description: With a small crew over two weeks, Denevan carved a pattern of circles spanning nine square miles into the snow on the frozen surface of Lake Baikal in Siberia, then the world's largest artwork.
works.description_zh: Denevan 带领小团队用两周时间，在西伯利亚贝加尔湖冰面的积雪上刻出一组覆盖九平方英里的圆形图案，是当时世界上最大的艺术作品。
works.idea_en: The drawing's scale is so large that only aircraft can see it, raising the question of who an AR work is for when its full view is private.
works.idea_zh: 这幅画的尺度大到只有飞机才能看到，提出了一个问题：当完整视图只属于少数人时，AR 作品是为谁而做？
works.technique: Circles were laid out with ropes and marked by dragging tools behind vehicles and on foot across the snow-covered ice.
works.technique_zh: 用绳索确定圆形，再通过车辆拖拽工具和徒步在覆雪的冰面上划出线条。
works.exercise_en: Plan a drawing larger than your campus on a map, then place segments of it in AR at real GPS points so each walker sees only a piece. Twist: combine all walkers' screenshots into one aerial view at the end.
works.exercise_zh: 在地图上规划一幅比校园还大的画，然后在真实 GPS 点上用 AR 放置其片段，每个行走者只能看到一部分；变体：最后把所有人的截图合成为一张俯视图。

video.video_title: Siberia Aerial

works.title: LightSpace
works.description: Depth cameras and projectors make a whole room interactive: pick up a projected photo from a table, carry it on your hand and drop it onto a wall.
works.idea_zh: 把投影的照片从桌上'捧'起来，放在手上走过去，再'倒'到墙上。

video.video_title: LightSpace from Microsoft Research

works.technique: Several calibrated depth cameras and projectors share one room coordinate system, and virtual 'depth camera' projections of the point cloud detect when a hand touches a surface or holds a projected item, so content can move between surfaces and the body.
works.exercise_zh: 用一台投影仪和一个深度相机（或 MediaPipe 检测手掌位置）实现“捡起”投影在桌上的一张照片，让它跟随手掌移动，再“放”到墙上；变体：在搬运过程中让照片发生变化（翻面、变旧或变成声音）。
works.description_zh: 深度相机和投影仪让整个房间都能互动：从桌上拿起一张投影照片，托在手上走过去，再把它放到墙上。
works.idea_en: Scoop a projected photo off the table, carry it in your hand, and pour it onto the wall.
works.technique_zh: 多台经过标定的深度相机和投影仪共享同一个房间坐标系，对点云做虚拟“深度相机”投影，用于检测手何时触碰表面或托着投影物体，从而让内容在各个表面和身体之间移动。
works.exercise_en: With one projector and one depth camera (or MediaPipe palm detection), let people 'pick up' a photo projected on a table, have it follow the palm, and 'drop' it onto the wall. Twist: make the photo change while it is carried (flip over, age, or turn into sound).

salient.why_en: Scoop a projected photo off the table, carry it in your hand and pour it onto the wall, as if data were liquid.
salient.why_zh: 把投影照片从桌上捧起，托在手里，再倒到墙上，数据像液体一样可以搬运。

works.title: LuminAR
works.description: Natan Linder's robotic desk lamp whose 'bulb' is a projector-camera: the lamp arm moves on its own to project interactive surfaces onto the desk, follow objects and scan documents.
works.idea_zh: 把台灯换成会自己转头的投影机器人，桌面上的任何地方都能变成触控界面。

video.video_title: LuminAR Demos

works.technique: A projector-camera pair is mounted as the head of a motorized multi-joint lamp arm, and computer vision on the camera (with depth sensing) chooses where to point the arm, projecting interfaces onto the desk and scanning objects under it.
works.exercise_zh: 把一台小投影仪和手机固定在台灯支架上，用摄像头检测桌上的纸张或手，把按钮、提示投影到该物体旁边；变体：给台灯设计一种“性格”，比如在你离开时低头、看到新物体时凑过去（可用舵机或手动摆拍演示）。
works.description_zh: Natan Linder 设计的机器人台灯，它的“灯泡”是一套投影仪-摄像头：灯臂会自行移动，把互动界面投到桌面上、跟随物体并扫描文档。
works.idea_en: Swap a desk lamp for a projector robot that turns its own head, so any spot on the desk can become a touch interface.
works.technique_zh: 一对投影仪-摄像头安装在电动多关节灯臂的头部，摄像头上的计算机视觉（配合深度感知）决定灯臂指向哪里，从而把界面投射到桌面上，并扫描下方的物体。
works.exercise_en: Mount a small projector and a phone on a desk-lamp arm, use the camera to detect paper or hands on the desk, and project buttons and hints next to that object. Twist: give the lamp a 'personality', such as bowing its head when you leave or leaning in when it sees a new object (demo with servos or by posing it by hand).

works.title: Magic Projection (live at TEDxTokyo)
works.description: Tempest walks on stage holding a blank white board; a tracked projector keeps an animated stick man on the board as he moves it, and the character jumps, falls and interacts with Tempest's hands.
works.description_zh: Tempest 手持一块空白白板上台；被追踪的投影始终把一个动画火柴人投在白板上，他移动白板时，火柴人会跳、会摔，还会和他的手互动。
works.idea_en: A handheld blank board becomes a living screen because the projection follows it.
works.idea_zh: 投影跟着走，手里的空白板就成了一块活的屏幕。
works.technique: The board is tracked in the camera image (likely with infrared markers or brightness tracking, built with Zach Lieberman in openFrameworks) and the projected animation is warped to its corners in real time.
works.technique_zh: 在摄像画面中追踪白板（很可能用红外标记或亮度追踪，与 Zach Lieberman 用 openFrameworks 开发），并实时把投影动画按白板四角变形贴合。
works.exercise_en: Track a sheet of white cardboard with a webcam and keep a projected character on it while you move it around. Twist: when the board tilts past 45 degrees, the character slides off and lands on the floor projection.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头追踪一张白色卡纸，移动它时让投影角色始终留在纸上。变体：纸板倾斜超过 45 度时，角色滑下来落到地面投影上。

video.video_title: Magic Projection Live @ TEDxTokyo 2010

works.title: Making Future Magic: iPad light painting
works.description: Moving iPads through the air during long exposures, BERG and Dentsu London draw 3D letters and objects in light: the screen shows successive slices of a 3D model, so the tablet becomes a brush that paints solid forms.
works.description_zh: BERG 与 Dentsu London 在长曝光中挥动 iPad，用光在空中画出立体的字母和物体：屏幕依次显示三维模型的截面，平板就成了能画出实体形状的画笔。
works.idea_en: A moving screen can sweep out a volume: slicing a 3D model over time is a physical preview of how AR renders form in space.
works.idea_zh: 移动的屏幕可以扫出一个体积：随时间切分三维模型，是 AR 在空间中呈现形体的一种实体预演。
works.technique: An iPad app displays cross-sections of a 3D model in sequence as the tablet is pulled through space at a steady speed during a long exposure, with stop-motion animation of the results.
works.technique_zh: iPad 应用在平板以稳定速度划过空间时依次显示三维模型的截面，配合长曝光拍摄，再把结果做成定格动画。
works.exercise_en: Write a web page that plays the slices of a simple 3D model on a phone screen, pull the phone through the air during a 10-second long exposure on a second phone, and compare with the same model placed in WebXR. Twist: use the phone's gyroscope to advance slices with real motion instead of time.
works.exercise_zh: 写一个网页，在手机屏幕上依次播放一个简单三维模型的截面，用另一部手机拍 10 秒长曝光时把它划过空中，再和放在 WebXR 里的同一个模型比较；变体：用陀螺仪按真实移动而不是时间来推进截面。

video.video_title: Making Future Magic: iPad light painting

salient.why_en: A moving iPad becomes a brush that paints solid 3D words in the air.
salient.why_zh: 挥动的 iPad 成了画笔，在空中画出立体的文字。

works.title: Mimosa
works.description: A wall of mechanical OLED 'flowers' opens, closes and glows as visitors move in front of it, like a plant reacting to touch.
works.description_zh: 一面由机械 OLED“花朵”组成的墙，会随着观众在前方的移动而开合、发光，像一株对触碰有反应的植物。
works.idea_en: Borrowing a plant's reflex (the mimosa folds when touched) gives a responsive surface an instantly readable personality — useful for AR objects that should feel alive.
works.idea_zh: 借用植物的反射（含羞草被碰就合拢），能让一个响应式表面马上有可读的“性格”——适合需要显得有生命的 AR 物体。
works.technique: Likely camera or proximity sensing drives small motors that open petal-shaped OLED panels and set their brightness according to how close people are.
works.technique_zh: 很可能由摄像头或接近传感器驱动小电机，打开花瓣形的 OLED 面板，并根据人的远近调节亮度。
works.exercise_en: Place a bed of virtual flowers on a real wall in AR that fold shut when the phone or a tracked hand comes near and slowly reopen when it leaves. Twist: make them remember visitors and close faster for people who approach quickly.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一片虚拟花朵贴在真实墙面上，手机或被追踪的手靠近时它们合拢，离开后慢慢张开。变体：让它们“记住”访客，对快速靠近的人合得更快。

video.video_title: Mimosa - Jason Bruges Studio

works.title: Mobile Music Touch
works.description: A fingerless glove vibrates each finger in the order of a piano melody while the wearer does other work; later they can play the tune on a keyboard without having practised.
works.description_zh: 一只无指手套按照钢琴旋律的顺序依次振动每根手指，佩戴者同时在做别的工作；之后他们无需练习就能在琴键上弹出这段旋律。
works.idea_en: Passive haptic learning: the body learns a skill while your attention is elsewhere.
works.idea_zh: 被动触觉学习：在注意力放在别处时，身体也能学会一项技能。
works.technique: Vibration motors on each finger are driven in time with a melody played through headphones, repeating in the background to train finger sequence memory.
works.technique_zh: 每根手指上的振动马达随耳机中播放的旋律同步振动，在后台反复训练手指的序列记忆。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone vibrate a four-note rhythm while students read, then test whether they can tap it back on the desk. Twist: map notes to spatial positions around the body instead of fingers.
works.exercise_zh: 让手机在学生阅读时振动出一段四音节奏，然后测试他们能否在桌上敲出来。变体：把音符映射到身体周围的空间位置，而不是手指。

video.video_title: Mobile Music Touch:  Learning to Play Piano Melodies Without Attention

works.title: Mobility – Reflective Kinematronic II
works.description: A grid of small mirrors on rotating arms catches a single spotlight and throws moving patterns of light onto the surrounding walls.
works.description_zh: 一组装在旋转臂上的小镜子接住一束聚光灯，把移动的光斑图案投射到周围墙面上。
works.idea_en: One light source plus many angled reflectors can write anywhere in a room — AR designers can think of reflection as a way to place content on distant surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 一个光源加上许多角度可调的反射镜，就能在房间任意位置“写字”——AR 设计者可以把反射当作把内容放到远处表面的方式。
works.technique: Each mirror's angle is computed so that its reflected spot lands on a target point on the wall; together the spots form letters or shapes.
works.technique_zh: 每面镜子的角度都经过计算，使反射光点落在墙上的目标位置，众多光点组合成文字或形状。
works.exercise_en: Cast a virtual beam from a phone-held light in AR, bounce it off virtual mirrors placed by the user, and make it land on real walls to spell a word. Twist: turn it into a two-player puzzle where each player controls half the mirrors.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中从手机“光源”射出一束虚拟光，经用户摆放的虚拟镜子反射，落到真实墙面拼出一个词。变体：做成双人解谜，每人控制一半镜子。

video.video_title: Mobility – Reflective Kinematronic II, 2010

works.title: Moc
works.description: A projected landscape scrolls past. When a visitor whistles into a microphone, a tree grows in real time following the sound; when they speak, fantastic animals appear in the forest.
works.description_zh: 一幅投影风景缓缓流过。观众对着麦克风吹口哨，一棵树就会随着声音实时生长；开口说话时，森林里会冒出奇幻的动物。
works.idea_en: Your breath makes a tree grow.
works.idea_zh: 你的气息让一棵树长出来。
works.technique: The app extracts the dominant frequency of the incoming sound and maps it to the branching angle of a growing tree, pausing growth in silence.
works.technique_zh: 程序提取输入声音的主频，把它映射成树枝的分叉角度；安静时树就停止生长。
works.exercise_en: Build a p5.js sketch that grows a recursive tree only while the microphone hears a whistle, with pitch controlling branch angle. Twist: make it an AR scene where the tree grows from the table you whistle at.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 做一棵递归生长的树，只有麦克风听到口哨声时才生长，音高控制分叉角度；变体：做成 AR 场景，让树从你吹口哨的那张桌子上长出来。

video.video_title: Moc — Soundscapes Installation

salient.why_en: Whistle and a tree grows from your breath; stop and it stops.
salient.why_zh: 吹口哨，树就从你的气息里长出来；一停下，它也停下。

works.title: Mosaïka (Parliament Hill, Ottawa)
works.description: A 30-minute sound and light show projected onto the Parliament buildings and grounds in Ottawa, telling Canada's stories through interviews with 200 Canadians from diverse backgrounds. The Gothic façade becomes a canvas for landscapes, faces and voices.
works.description_zh: 一场 30 分钟的声光秀，投射在渥太华国会大楼和周围草坪上，通过对 200 位不同背景的加拿大人的访谈讲述加拿大的故事。哥特式立面变成风景、面孔和声音的画布。
works.idea_en: A national building can hold many small personal stories; civic AR works when it layers real voices onto symbolic places.
works.idea_zh: 一座国家象征性的建筑可以容纳许多个人的小故事；公共空间的 AR，要把真实的声音叠加在有象征意义的地方才有力量。
works.technique: Architectural projection mapping with multiple high-lumen projectors aligned to a 3D model of the façade, cued with a surround soundtrack of recorded interviews.
works.technique_zh: 用多台高流明投影机，按立面的三维模型对位进行建筑投影映射，并用访谈录音做环绕声轨来触发。
works.exercise_en: Record short interviews with five people about one building on campus, then place each voice as a spatial audio source with a small visual marker at a specific window using AR Foundation or 8th Wall. Twist: the voices only play when two phones are pointed at the building together.
works.exercise_zh: 采访五个人谈论校园里的一栋楼，用 AR Foundation 或 8th Wall 把每段声音作为空间音源放在一扇特定的窗户上，并配一个小的视觉标记；变体：只有两部手机同时对准这栋楼时声音才会播放。

video.video_title: Parliament Hill, Ottawa, Canada (2010): Mosaïka Sound & Light Show [DEMO]

works.title: Nelson's Ship in a Bottle
works.description: A 1:30 scale model of Nelson's flagship HMS Victory with sails of Dutch wax-print fabric sits in a giant glass bottle on the Fourth Plinth of Trafalgar Square, facing Nelson's Column.
works.description_zh: 一艘按 1:30 比例制作、以荷兰蜡染布为帆的纳尔逊旗舰胜利号模型装在一个巨大的玻璃瓶中，放在特拉法加广场“第四基座”上，面对纳尔逊纪念柱。
works.idea_en: An answer placed on a plinth beside an old monument rewrites the square's story, the way AR counter-monuments can.
works.idea_zh: 放在旧纪念碑旁基座上的一个回应，重写了广场的故事，AR 反纪念碑也可以这样做。
works.technique: A detailed ship model was built with printed-fabric sails and sealed in a large acrylic bottle.
works.technique_zh: 精细的船模配以印花布帆，封装在一个巨大的亚克力瓶中。
works.exercise_en: Find a monument near you and place an AR object on an empty plinth or ledge nearby that answers its story from another viewpoint. Twist: visitors vote each week on which answer stays.
works.exercise_zh: 找到你附近的一座纪念碑，在旁边空着的基座或台面上放一个从另一视角回应其故事的 AR 物体；变体：访客每周投票决定保留哪一个回应。

video.video_title: Yinka Shonibare CBE (RA): "Nelson's Ship in a Bottle" | Art21 "Extended Play"

works.title: Night Lights
works.description: YesYesNo turned the five-storey Auckland Ferry Building into an interactive playground: visitors' silhouettes, hand gestures and phones controlled projections amplified across the facade.
works.idea_zh: 把整栋渡轮大楼变成身体的放大镜：人的剪影和手势被投影放大到五层楼高。

video.video_title: night lights

works.technique: Cameras segment visitors' silhouettes and hand gestures (background subtraction plus contour analysis), and phone input is received over the network, all mapped to graphics projection-mapped onto the building facade.
works.exercise_zh: 用 TouchDesigner 或 p5.js 把摄像头里的人影轮廓放大投到教学楼窗户或走廊墙上，挥手触发灯光扫过；变体：加入手机网页控制，让远处的人也能通过手机在墙上“开灯”。
works.description_zh: YesYesNo 把五层楼高的奥克兰渡轮大楼变成了一座互动游乐场：观众的剪影、手势和手机控制着投影，并被放大到整个建筑立面上。
works.idea_en: Turn a whole ferry building into a magnifier for the body, blowing up silhouettes and gestures five storeys high.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头分割出观众的剪影和手势（背景减除加轮廓分析），手机输入则通过网络接收，全部映射为投影映射到建筑立面上的图形。
works.exercise_en: Use TouchDesigner or p5.js to enlarge people's silhouettes from a camera and project them onto classroom-building windows or a hallway wall, with a wave of the hand sending light sweeping across. Twist: add phone web control so people far away can also 'switch on the lights' on the wall.

works.title: Nimbus
works.description: A small white cloud hangs for a few seconds in the middle of an empty room before dissolving; the artist makes it with a fog machine and documents it as a photograph.
works.description_zh: 一小朵白云在空荡房间的中央悬浮几秒，然后消散；艺术家用造雾机制造它，并以照片记录下来。
works.idea_en: An outdoor thing in an indoor place instantly feels uncanny; AR's strongest effects often move one familiar element into the wrong context.
works.idea_zh: 把室外的东西放到室内，立刻就显得不可思议；AR 最有力的效果，往往是把一个熟悉的元素放进错误的环境里。
works.technique: Fog from a machine is mixed with moisture and released into still air under controlled temperature and lighting, and the cloud is photographed at its peak before it disperses.
works.technique_zh: 造雾机的雾与水汽混合，在温度和光线受控的静止空气中释放，在云团最完整、尚未散开的瞬间拍下照片。
works.exercise_en: Place one volumetric AR cloud in the middle of a real corridor or classroom, lit to match the room's light direction, that dissolves if anyone walks through it. Twist: make it rain only on the person who walks under it.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实的走廊或教室中央放一朵立体的 AR 云，让它的光照方向与房间一致；有人穿过它时，云就散开。变体：让它只在从下面走过的人头上下雨。

video.video_title: Nimbus by Berndnaut Smilde | Art at NeueHouse

salient.why_en: A real cloud floats for a moment in the middle of an empty room.
salient.why_zh: 一朵真正的云在空房间中央飘浮片刻。

works.title: Ocean of Light
works.description: An early Squidsoup volumetric light grid in which a cube of LEDs displays flocking and wave-like forms that respond to people nearby.
works.description_zh: Squidsoup 早期的体积光阵：一个 LED 立方体显示群游和波浪般的形态，并对附近的人作出反应。
works.idea_en: Think of light as a spatial medium with resolution: designing for a low-resolution 3D grid trains students to make forms readable with very few points.
works.idea_zh: 把光看作有分辨率的空间媒介：为低分辨率三维点阵做设计，能训练学生用极少的点让形体可读。
works.technique: A three-dimensional array of LEDs acts as voxels; motion sensing (likely ultrasonic or camera-based) steers the animated behaviours.
works.technique_zh: 三维 LED 阵列充当体素；运动感应（可能是超声波或摄像头）控制动画行为。
works.exercise_en: Build an 8 x 8 x 8 AR voxel cube on a desk and write a simple flocking system that lights the voxels; let hand tracking scare the flock away. Twist: limit yourself to 50 lit voxels at a time and see if the flock is still readable.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌上做一个 8×8×8 的 AR 体素立方体，写一个简单的群游系统来点亮体素；用手部追踪把鱼群吓跑。变体：限制同时只能亮 50 个体素，看鱼群是否仍然可读。

video.video_title: Ocean of Light

works.title: One Hundred and Eight
works.description: A wall of 108 plastic bags inflates and deflates in rolling waves; when a viewer approaches, the bags near them pull back as if breathing away.
works.description_zh: 由 108 个塑料袋组成的墙随波浪般的节奏充气、放气；观众靠近时，附近的袋子会像呼吸一样退缩。
works.idea_en: Cheap, soft material with good timing feels alive — AR effects gain life from rhythm and reaction, not detail.
works.idea_zh: 廉价柔软的材料配上好的节奏就会显得有生命——AR 效果的生命感来自节奏与反应，而不是细节。
works.technique: Each bag is inflated by a small fan controlled by a microcontroller; a camera detects the viewer and triggers local deflation waves.
works.technique_zh: 每个袋子由微控制器控制的小风扇充气；摄像头检测到观众后触发局部的放气波。
works.exercise_en: Cover a real wall in AR with a grid of soft virtual balloons that breathe in a wave and shrink away from the user's hand. Twist: make them breathe in sync with the user's own breathing picked up by the microphone.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中给真实墙面铺上一格格柔软的虚拟气囊，随波浪呼吸，并在用户的手靠近时收缩。变体：借助麦克风让它们与用户自己的呼吸同步。

video.video_title: One Hundred and Eight - Interactive Installation

works.title: Perspective Lyrique
works.description: At the Fête des Lumières in Lyon, members of the public sing or shout into a microphone and the projected face on the old Célestins theatre façade opens its mouth, stretches and deforms with their voice.
works.description_zh: 在里昂灯光节上，观众对着麦克风唱歌或喊叫，投在塞莱斯坦剧院旧立面上的巨大面孔就随着他们的声音张嘴、拉伸、变形。
works.idea_en: Give a building a face and let the crowd's voice control its expression.
works.idea_zh: 给建筑一张脸，让人群的声音控制它的表情。
works.technique: An audio-analysis algorithm maps microphone volume and frequency to the deformation of a 3D mesh of the façade, rendered live and projection-mapped back onto it.
works.technique_zh: 音频分析算法把麦克风的音量和频率映射为建筑立面三维网格的变形，实时渲染后再投影映射回立面上。
works.exercise_en: Project a simple face onto a box or wall and drive its mouth, eyes and wobble from microphone amplitude and pitch in p5.js. Twist: let two microphones control the left and right halves of the face.
works.exercise_zh: 把一张简笔脸投到纸箱或墙面上，用 p5.js 读取麦克风的音量和音高，驱动嘴巴、眼睛和抖动；变体：用两个麦克风分别控制脸的左右两半。

video.video_title: PERSPECTIVE LYRIQUE - 1024 architecture

works.title: Please Empty Your Pockets
works.description: Visitors place objects from their pockets on a conveyor belt; a camera scans them and when the real object comes out the other end, its image stays behind on the belt among thousands of earlier objects.
works.description_zh: 访客把口袋里的东西放在传送带上；摄像头扫描它们，实物从另一端出来后，它的影像留在传送带上，与此前成千上万件物品排在一起。
works.idea_en: An object leaving behind its image turns a simple action into an archive of everyone who came before — a model for AR ghosts of past visitors.
works.idea_zh: 物品离开后留下影像，让一个简单动作变成了此前所有人的档案——这是 AR 中“往昔访客幽灵”的范本。
works.technique: An overhead scanner photographs each object and a projector re-projects the stored images onto the moving belt in the same position, drawing from a database of about 600,000 items.
works.technique_zh: 上方扫描仪拍下每件物品，投影仪把存储的影像按同样位置重新投到移动的传送带上，影像来自约 60 万件物品的数据库。
works.exercise_en: Photograph objects people put on a table, then leave their AR images in place after the real objects are removed, slowly drifting away like a conveyor. Twist: mix in images from yesterday's session so the table remembers.
works.exercise_zh: 给人们放在桌上的物品拍照，实物拿走后在原位留下它们的 AR 影像，并像传送带一样慢慢漂走。变体：混入昨天的影像，让桌子“记得”过去。

video.video_title: Please Empty Your Pockets

salient.why_en: Your object leaves the conveyor belt, but its image stays behind among everyone else's.
salient.why_zh: 你放上传送带的东西被取走了，它的影像却留在带上，和之前所有人的物品在一起。

works.title: Pulse Index
works.description: A visitor puts a finger into a sensor; a camera records their fingerprint and heartbeat, and the enlarged pulsing fingerprint joins a wall of thousands of earlier participants.
works.description_zh: 访客把手指放进传感器；摄像头记录指纹和心跳，放大后的跳动指纹加入一面由此前成千上万参与者组成的墙。
works.idea_en: Showing each new person largest and letting older entries shrink into a crowd is a clear visual grammar for shared AR walls of contributions.
works.idea_zh: 让每个新人显示得最大、旧的条目缩小进人群里，是 AR 共享留言墙的一种清晰视觉语法。
works.technique: A microscope camera captures the fingerprint while a pulse sensor provides the rhythm, and software places the new recording at the top of a grid that shrinks older ones.
works.technique_zh: 显微摄像头拍下指纹，脉搏传感器提供节奏，软件把新记录放在网格顶端，并把旧记录缩小。
works.exercise_en: Build a shared AR wall where each visitor's selfie thumbnail pulses to their tapped rhythm, newest largest, older ones shrinking to the edges. Twist: let a visitor search the wall for themselves by walking along it.
works.exercise_zh: 做一面共享 AR 墙：每位访客的自拍缩略图按他们敲出的节奏跳动，最新的最大，旧的缩小到边缘。变体：让访客沿墙走动来寻找自己。

video.video_title: Pulse Index - plasma

works.title: Reactive Stage
works.description: A mutating graphic shape follows a dancer's position and size and changes colour and complexity with the music, projected onto three layers of transparent fabric so she seems to move inside it.
works.description_zh: 一个不断变形的图形追随舞者的位置和体型，并随音乐改变颜色与复杂度，被投影到三层透明纱幕上，让她仿佛在图形内部移动。
works.idea_en: Layer projections on sheer fabric to put a dancer inside the image.
works.idea_zh: 把投影叠在几层透明纱上，让舞者置身于图像之中。
works.technique: A camera tracking system sends the dancer's position and size to a Quartz Composer patch, which also analyses audio, and the output is projected through three stacked scrims for depth.
works.technique_zh: 摄像追踪系统把舞者的位置和大小发送给 Quartz Composer，同时分析音频，输出画面穿过三层纱幕投影，形成景深。
works.exercise_en: Hang two or three layers of tulle one metre apart, project one tracked shape onto all of them, and have a dancer move between the layers. Twist: give each layer a different delay so the shape trails through depth.
works.exercise_zh: 挂两到三层相距一米的纱网，把同一个被追踪的图形投在所有层上，让舞者在层与层之间移动；变体：给每层不同的延迟，让图形在纵深中拖出尾迹。

video.video_title: Reactive Stage

works.title: Real-time Panoramic Mapping and Tracking on Phones
works.description: The phone builds a 360-degree panorama of its surroundings as you turn and simultaneously tracks orientation against it for outdoor AR.
works.idea_zh: 转一圈手机就建好全景地图，并据此稳定地追踪方向。

video.video_title: Real time Panoramic Mapping and Tracking on Phones

works.technique: Assuming pure rotation, each camera frame is registered against a cylindrical panorama map being built incrementally, so the phone simultaneously extends the map and estimates its 3DOF orientation from it.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机陀螺仪（DeviceOrientation API）在网页中实现“原地转身看”的全景 AR：在 360 度方向上布置虚拟标签，并对照真实场景校准北向；变体：只在某一方向藏一个彩蛋，引导用户转身寻找。
works.description_zh: 当你转动手机时，它会构建周围环境的 360 度全景图，同时以此为参照追踪自身朝向，用于户外 AR。
works.idea_en: Turn the phone around once to build a panorama map, then track direction steadily against it.
works.technique_zh: 在纯旋转的假设下，每一帧相机画面都与正在增量构建的柱面全景图进行配准，手机因此能一边扩展地图，一边据此估计自身的 3DOF 朝向。
works.exercise_en: Use the phone gyroscope (DeviceOrientation API) to build a 'turn on the spot' panoramic AR web page: place virtual labels in all 360 degrees and calibrate north against the real scene. Twist: hide a single easter egg in one direction and lead the user to turn around and find it.

works.title: Rise and Fall
works.description: An interactive front-and-back magazine cover for Boards Magazine: holding the printed cover to a webcam and rotating it steers a story world rendered on top of it.
works.idea_zh: 拿着杂志封面对着摄像头旋转，封面上的世界随之展开故事。

video.video_title: Boards Interactive Magazine - Walkthrough

works.technique: Fiducial marker tracking on the printed cover estimates its 6-DoF pose from a webcam, and the cover's rotation angle drives gravity and scene state in a 3D world rendered on top.
works.exercise_zh: 用 8th Wall 或 AR Foundation 图像追踪识别一张自己设计的海报，海报倾斜角度决定虚拟小人往哪边滑，正反面各一个世界；变体：翻转海报时两个世界的故事会互相影响。
works.description_zh: 为 Boards 杂志设计的正反两面互动封面：把印刷封面举到网络摄像头前旋转，就能操控叠加其上的故事世界。
works.idea_en: Rotate a magazine cover in front of a webcam and the world on it unfolds a story.
works.technique_zh: 对印刷封面上的基准标记进行追踪，通过网络摄像头估计其 6DoF 位姿，封面的旋转角度驱动叠加其上的三维世界中的重力与场景状态。
works.exercise_en: Use 8th Wall or AR Foundation image tracking to recognize a poster you designed, let the poster's tilt decide which way a virtual figure slides, and give the front and back each their own world. Twist: flipping the poster makes the stories of the two worlds affect each other.

works.title: Rust Mirror
works.description: Hundreds of rusted steel strips rotate to reflect the viewer as a dark, grainy silhouette, and a projection of rain makes the image ripple over time.
works.description_zh: 数百条生锈的钢条转动，把观众映成一个深色、粗粝的剪影，一段雨水投影让画面随时间荡起涟漪。
works.idea_en: Combining a live reflection with a slow environmental effect (rain) makes a mirror feel like a place with weather — an idea for layering ambient effects on AR selfies.
works.idea_zh: 把实时倒影和缓慢的环境效果（雨）结合，让镜子像一个有天气的地方——这启发在 AR 自拍上叠加氛围效果。
works.technique: A camera and computer vision set the rotation of rusted steel tiles, while a simulated rain layer modulates the image so drops appear to fall across the reflection.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头和计算机视觉设定锈钢片的转角，同时一层模拟雨水调制图像，让雨滴看起来落在倒影上。
works.exercise_en: Create an AR mirror filter made of rusty metal tiles that tilt to show the user, with virtual raindrops that disturb the tiles as they fall. Twist: let the rain get heavier the longer the person stands still.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个由锈蚀金属片组成的 AR 镜子滤镜，金属片倾斜呈现用户，虚拟雨滴落下时扰动这些金属片。变体：人站得越久，雨下得越大。

video.video_title: "Rust Mirror" (2010) by Daniel Rozin

works.title: Sandbox (Relational Architecture 17)
works.description: On Santa Monica beach, tiny projections of beachgoers appear in two small sandboxes; when participants reach in, cameras relay their hands live to giant projectors that cover 8,000 m² of beach.
works.idea_zh: 你在小沙盒里伸出的手，被放大投射成覆盖整个海滩的巨手
works.technique: Infrared cameras capture people on the beach and hands over the sandboxes, cross-projecting each feed at opposite scales (tiny people in the box, giant hands on the beach).
works.exercise_zh: 一台手机拍桌上的手、另一台拍操场上的人，互相投到对方的空间里；变化：让小人和大手在投影中能“碰到”彼此并触发声音。

video.video_title: Sandbox

works.description_zh: 在圣莫尼卡海滩上，两个小沙盒里出现海滩游客的微缩投影；当参与者把手伸进沙盒，摄像头会把他们的手实时传给巨型投影仪，投满 8000 平方米的海滩。
works.idea_en: The hand you reach into a small sandbox is projected as a giant hand covering the whole beach.
works.technique_zh: 红外摄像头分别捕捉海滩上的人和沙盒上方的手，并以相反的尺度交叉投影各自的画面（盒子里是微小的人，海滩上是巨大的手）。
works.exercise_en: Have one phone film hands on a table and another film people on the sports field, and project each feed into the other's space. Twist: let the tiny people and the giant hands 'touch' each other in the projection and trigger sounds.

salient.why_en: The hand you put in a small sandbox appears as a giant hand over the whole beach.
salient.why_zh: 你伸进小沙盒的手，被投影成覆盖整片海滩的巨手。

works.title: Scattered Light
works.description: About 2,000 LED light bulbs hung in three grids over Madison Square Park show the blurred silhouettes of commuters walking, visible best from a distance at night.
works.description_zh: 约 2,000 盏 LED 灯泡在麦迪逊广场公园上空挂成三组网格，显示出通勤者行走时模糊的剪影，夜晚从远处看最清楚。
works.idea_en: Placing a ghostly crowd above a real park mirrors the people in it; AR can show a place's past or typical visitors as low-resolution presences.
works.idea_zh: 在真实公园上空放一群幽灵般的人群，映照着园中的人；AR 可以把一个地方的过去或常见访客显示为低分辨率的存在。
works.technique: Each bulb is one pixel; footage of pedestrians (likely filmed at Grand Central) is mapped across the layered grids so the image gains depth.
works.technique_zh: 每个灯泡是一个像素；行人的影像（可能拍摄于中央车站）被映射到多层网格上，让图像有了纵深。
works.exercise_en: Film classmates walking past a wall, reduce the clip to a 20 x 12 grid, and replay it as floating AR bulbs in the same place at night. Twist: show the ghosts only when the real place is empty.
works.exercise_zh: 拍下同学从一面墙前走过的视频，把它降到 20×12 的网格，晚上在同一地点以悬浮 AR 灯泡的形式回放。变体：只在真实地点空无一人时显示这些幽灵。

video.video_title: Jim Campbell: Scattered Light

works.title: Sekai Camera for iPad
works.description: Sekai Camera on the iPad: the larger screen becomes a window onto the air-tag layer around the user.
works.idea_zh: 把iPad变成看见城市中'空中标签'的大窗口。

video.video_title: Sekai Camera for iPad

works.technique: The same geotag overlay approach is applied on a larger screen, with the device treated as a handheld window onto the tag layer.
works.exercise_zh: 对比手机和平板上同一个 AR 标签界面，调整标签密度和字号以适配大屏；变体：设计一种只在大屏上才有意义的交互。
works.description_zh: iPad 版 Sekai Camera：更大的屏幕成了一扇窗，让用户看见身边那一层“空中标签”。
works.idea_en: Turn the iPad into a large window for seeing the 'air tags' floating around the city.
works.technique_zh: 沿用同样的地理标签叠加方式，只是换到了更大的屏幕上，把设备当作观看标签图层的手持窗口。
works.exercise_en: Compare the same AR tag interface on a phone and a tablet, and adjust tag density and font size to suit the larger screen. Twist: design an interaction that only makes sense on the big screen.

works.title: Shadow works
works.description: A single lamp hits a few carved wooden pieces, folded paper or cut numbers on a wall, and their shadows complete detailed faces and figures that the objects themselves do not show.
works.description_zh: 一盏灯照在墙上几块雕刻的木块、折纸或切割的数字上，它们的影子补全了精细的人脸和人物，而这些物体本身并看不出来。
works.idea_en: The shadow, not the object, is the content: in AR a virtual light can make a real object cast an unexpected virtual shadow, a quiet way to add story to everyday things.
works.idea_zh: 影子而不是物体才是内容：在 AR 中，一束虚拟光可以让真实物体投下意想不到的虚拟影子，这是给日常物品添加故事的一种安静方式。
works.technique: Relief shapes are carved or folded so that a light at a fixed angle casts a calculated silhouette; the lamp position is part of the work.
works.technique_zh: 浮雕形状经过雕刻或折叠，使固定角度的灯光投出计算好的剪影；灯的位置本身就是作品的一部分。
works.exercise_en: Detect a real object on a desk with image or object tracking and render a virtual shadow behind it that is a portrait, not its true outline. Twist: move a virtual lamp with your hand and let the portrait age as the shadow lengthens.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像或物体追踪识别桌上的一个真实物品，在它后面渲染一个虚拟影子，这个影子是一幅肖像而不是物体真实的轮廓。变体：用手移动一盏虚拟灯，影子越长，肖像就越苍老。

video.video_title: Amazing Shadow Art by Japanese Artist Kumi Yamashita Studio

salient.why_en: A few abstract pieces on a wall cast the shadow of a detailed human face.
salient.why_zh: 墙上几块抽象的碎片，投下的影子却是一张清晰的人脸。

works.title: ShadowFighter
works.description: Two players stand side by side in front of a white wall lit by two lamps and box in the air; their real shadows hit each other on the wall, and projected comic-book 'BANG!' effects and sounds score the fight.
works.description_zh: 两位玩家并排站在被两盏灯照亮的白墙前，对着空气出拳；墙上真实的影子互相击打，投影的漫画式“BANG!”特效和音效为比赛计分。
works.idea_en: Your shadow fights your opponent's shadow.
works.idea_zh: 你的影子和对手的影子打一架。
works.technique: A camera detects when the two shadows overlap on the wall, and an openFrameworks app projects hit effects and plays sounds; the game starts automatically when two players step in.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头检测墙上两道影子何时重叠，openFrameworks 程序投射击中特效并播放音效；两位玩家站定后游戏自动开始。
works.exercise_en: Light a wall with two desk lamps, detect shadow overlap with a webcam, and project a score and hit effects. Twist: make the shadows grow when a player gets hit.
works.exercise_zh: 用两盏台灯照亮一面墙，用摄像头检测影子重叠，并投射比分和击中特效。变体：被击中的玩家影子会变大。

video.video_title: ShadowFighter Promo

works.title: Skinput
works.description: An armband of vibration sensors detects finger taps on the forearm and hand; a pico projector shows menus and a game directly on your skin.
works.idea_zh: 用手臂当触摸屏：轻敲皮肤不同位置就能操作投影在身上的菜单。

video.video_title: Skinput: Appropriating the Body as an Input Surface (CHI 2010)

works.technique: Piezoelectric vibration sensors on an armband capture the bio-acoustic signals of taps propagating through bone and soft tissue, and an SVM classifies the tap location from spectral features.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机贴在前臂上，用加速度计记录敲击手臂不同位置的震动，用 Teachable Machine（声音或自定义特征）训练 3 个位置的分类器，并把菜单投影或显示在手臂上；变体：把敲击换成在桌面、墙面等其他身体外物体上。
works.description_zh: 一个装有振动传感器的臂环能检测手指在前臂和手上的敲击，微型投影仪则把菜单和游戏直接投射在皮肤上。
works.idea_en: Use your arm as a touchscreen: tap different spots on your skin to work a menu projected onto your body.
works.technique_zh: 臂环上的压电振动传感器捕捉敲击在骨骼和软组织中传播的生物声学信号，再由 SVM 根据频谱特征判断敲击位置。
works.exercise_en: Strap a phone to your forearm, record accelerometer vibrations from taps at different spots on the arm, train a three-location classifier with Teachable Machine (sound or custom features), and project or display a menu on the arm. Twist: move the taps onto objects outside the body, such as a tabletop or wall.

works.title: Spatial AR for Interactive Rapid Prototyping
works.description: Blank physical control panels get their buttons and dials projected onto them; users operate the projected controls just like real ones, and a study compared them with physical panels.
works.description_zh: 空白的实体控制面板上投影出按钮和旋钮，用户像操作真实控件一样操作投影控件，并通过实验与真实面板进行比较。
works.idea_en: Prototype a product's interface by projecting it onto a blank mock-up instead of manufacturing it.
works.idea_zh: 把界面投影到空白模型上来做产品原型，而不必把它制造出来。
works.technique: Calibrated projectors render controls onto the mock-up's known geometry, and finger or tool tracking detects presses on the projected widgets.
works.technique_zh: 经过标定的投影仪把控件渲染到已知几何形状的模型上，通过手指或工具追踪检测对投影控件的按压。
works.exercise_en: Project a microwave control panel onto a cardboard box, detect finger presses with a webcam and test two layouts with classmates. Twist: let the panel rearrange itself to fit the user's hand.
works.exercise_zh: 把微波炉控制面板投影到纸箱上，用网络摄像头检测手指按压，并让同学测试两种布局。变体：让面板根据用户的手自动重新排布。

video.video_title: Validating the use of Spatial Augmented Reality for Interactive Rapid Prototyping

works.title: Stainless — Shinjuku
works.description: A camera on a moving subway train records the waiting crowd on Shinjuku station's platform at a very high frame rate; played back, the commuters seem almost frozen, like living statues sliding past.
works.description_zh: 安装在行驶列车上的相机以极高帧率拍下新宿站台上等车的人群；回放时通勤者几乎静止，就像一排滑过的活雕塑。
works.idea_en: Changing the time scale of a crowd turns strangers into portraits; AR can slow a busy place down so people notice the individuals in it.
works.idea_zh: 改变人群的时间尺度，陌生人就变成了肖像；AR 可以把繁忙的地方放慢，让人注意到其中的每一个人。
works.technique: A custom rig built around an industrial high-speed camera, mounted in the train, records hundreds of frames per second so seconds stretch into minutes.
works.technique_zh: 装在列车上、以工业高速相机为核心的改装设备每秒记录数百帧，把几秒钟拉长成几分钟。
works.exercise_en: Film a busy corridor at 240 fps from a slowly moving cart, then place the clip at 1/10 speed as a window in AR on the same wall it was filmed along. Twist: faces become sharp only when the viewer stops walking.
works.exercise_zh: 推着小车以 240 fps 慢慢拍一条繁忙的走廊，在 AR 中把这段 1/10 速度的影像作为一扇窗贴在当初拍摄的那面墙上；变体：只有观众停下脚步时人脸才会变清晰。

video.video_title: Adam Magyar, Stainless - Shinjuku (excerpt)

works.title: Start the Party!
works.description: A PlayStation Move party game in which players see themselves on the TV and the glowing controller in their hand becomes a hair dryer, a fly swatter, a paintbrush or a sword inside the camera image.
works.description_zh: 一款 PlayStation Move 派对游戏：玩家在电视里看到自己，手中发光的手柄在摄像头画面里变成吹风机、苍蝇拍、画笔或宝剑。
works.idea_en: Your own mirror image is the game board, and one tracked stick turns into whatever tool each minigame needs.
works.idea_zh: 自己的镜像就是游戏棋盘，一根被追踪的手柄随小游戏变成需要的任何工具。
works.technique: The PlayStation Eye tracks the glowing Move sphere in 3D and the game replaces it with a virtual prop composited over the live mirrored video.
works.technique_zh: PlayStation Eye 在三维空间中追踪 Move 手柄顶端的发光球，游戏用虚拟道具替换它，并叠加在实时镜像视频上。
works.exercise_en: Build a webcam mirror game in p5.js or Unity: track a bright-colored object by color and replace it with a virtual tool that pops balloons drifting across the video. Twist: switch the tool every 15 seconds so players must change how they move.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 或 Unity 做一个摄像头镜像游戏：按颜色追踪一个鲜艳物体，把它替换成虚拟工具，去戳破在画面上飘过的气球。变体：每 15 秒切换一次工具，逼玩家改变动作方式。

video.video_title: Start the Party E3 Trailer

works.title: Sunflower Seeds
works.description: The floor of Tate Modern's Turbine Hall was covered with 100 million hand-painted porcelain sunflower seeds, made by about 1,600 craftspeople in Jingdezhen.
works.description_zh: 泰特现代美术馆涡轮大厅的地面铺满了一亿颗手绘瓷制葵花籽，由景德镇约 1600 名工匠制作。
works.idea_en: A landscape made of countless individual, handmade units shows the one and the many at once, a strong idea for AR crowds and data points.
works.idea_zh: 由无数独立手工单元组成的地景同时呈现了个体与群体，是 AR 群体与数据点的有力创意。
works.technique: Each seed was shaped, fired and hand-painted with a few brushstrokes, then spread in a layer about 10 cm deep.
works.technique_zh: 每颗瓜子都经过成型、烧制，并用几笔手工绘制，然后铺成约 10 厘米厚的一层。
works.exercise_en: Fill a room floor in AR with 100,000 instanced seeds and let each user 'paint' one unique seed that is added to the pile. Twist: the user can later find their own seed with a search function.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中用十万颗实例化的瓜子铺满房间地面，让每位用户“画”一颗独特的瓜子加入其中；变体：用户之后可以用搜索功能找到自己的那一颗。

video.video_title: Ai Weiwei – Sunflower Seeds | Artist Interview | Tate

works.title: Survival Suit Pod
works.description: At a Bushwick street corner, an AR survival pod designed for The Yes Men (a parody of their SurvivaBall climate-disaster suit) appears for passers-by with phones.
works.description_zh: 在布什维克的一个街角，一个为 The Yes Men 设计的 AR 生存舱（戏仿他们的 SurvivaBall 气候灾难防护服）出现在拿着手机的路人面前。
works.idea_en: A satirical climate-survival gadget parked on an ordinary street.
works.idea_zh: 一件讽刺性的气候求生装置，停在一条普通的街道上。
works.technique: A 3D model of the pod is geolocated at the corner of Irving and Flushing in a mobile AR browser for the Bushwick Augmented Reality Intervention.
works.technique_zh: 为布什维克增强现实介入展而作：生存舱的 3D 模型通过移动 AR 浏览器定位在 Irving 街和 Flushing 大道的路口。
works.exercise_en: Design an absurd AR 'survival device' for a near-future disaster and park it where students wait every day. Twist: tapping it plays an infomercial.
works.exercise_zh: 为一场近未来灾难设计一件荒诞的 AR“求生装置”，把它放在学生每天等待的地方。变体：点击它就播放一段电视购物广告。

video.video_title: Patrick Lichty's Survival Suit Pod in Bushwick

works.title: Swarm Light
works.description: Three cubes of hanging LEDs show points of light moving like a flock of birds, reacting to the sound of people in the room.
works.description_zh: 三个由悬挂 LED 组成的立方体中，光点像鸟群一样移动，并对房间里人的声音作出反应。
works.idea_en: A swarm drawn in real 3D pixels feels alive in a way a screen never does — AR flocks placed in real space inherit this power.
works.idea_zh: 用真实三维像素画出的群体，有屏幕永远没有的生命感——放在真实空间里的 AR 鸟群也继承了这种力量。
works.technique: A 3D grid of LEDs displays a flocking simulation; microphones in the room modulate the swarm's behaviour.
works.technique_zh: 三维 LED 阵列显示群集模拟；房间里的麦克风调节群体的行为。
works.exercise_en: Place a flock of 300 glowing points inside a wireframe cube on a real table in AR using a boids simulation, and scatter them when the microphone hears a loud sound. Twist: make the flock slowly follow whoever is quietest.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中用 boids 群集模拟，在真实桌面上的线框立方体里放 300 个发光点，麦克风听到大声时让它们四散。变体：让鸟群慢慢跟随最安静的人。

video.video_title: RANDOM INTERNATIONAL | Swarm Light

works.title: TETRA.TENNIS
works.description: The tennis court of the Paris Masters at Bercy is mapped from above between matches, with lines, grids and 3D illusions that make the flat court fold and break apart.
works.description_zh: 巴黎贝尔西大师赛的网球场在比赛间隙被从上方投影，线条、网格和三维错觉让平坦的球场仿佛折叠、碎裂。
works.idea_en: A sports field is a ready-made canvas whose lines can come alive.
works.idea_zh: 运动场本身就是现成的画布，场地线可以活过来。
works.technique: Overhead projectors aligned to the court's markings play animations that use the known line layout for perspective illusions visible to the audience in the stands.
works.technique_zh: 头顶投影机与球场标线对齐，播放利用已知场地线布局制作的透视错觉动画，供看台观众观看。
works.exercise_en: Map the lines of a basketball or badminton court (or a taped floor plan) from above and animate the lines turning into a maze. Twist: have a player walk the maze while the projection reacts to their position.
works.exercise_zh: 从上方投影篮球场或羽毛球场的场地线（或用胶带贴出的平面），让线条变成一座迷宫；变体：让一名玩家走迷宫，投影根据他的位置做出反应。

video.video_title: TETRA.TENNIS v3.0 - 1024 architecture

works.title: TeslaTouch
works.description: A touch screen that produces variable friction under a sliding finger using electrovibration, so flat images can feel rough, bumpy or sticky.
works.idea_zh: 让平板屏幕表面摸起来有纹理。

video.video_title: TeslaTouch: Electrovibration for Touch Surfaces (ACM UIST 2010)

works.technique: Applies a modulated high voltage to an insulated electrode so electrostatic attraction changes skin friction as the finger moves.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机振动API做一个“触觉纹理”画板：手指滑过不同颜色区域时产生不同节奏的振动；变化：让同伴闭眼只凭触感猜出图案。
works.description_zh: 一块触摸屏利用电振动在滑动的手指下产生可变摩擦力，让平面图像摸起来粗糙、凹凸不平或者发黏。
works.idea_en: Make the surface of a flat screen feel textured.
works.technique_zh: 向绝缘电极施加经过调制的高电压，使静电吸引力在手指移动时改变皮肤所受的摩擦力。
works.exercise_en: Use the phone vibration API to build a 'haptic texture' drawing board where a finger sliding over different colored areas triggers different vibration rhythms. Twist: have a partner close their eyes and guess the pattern by touch alone.

works.title: The 600 Years
works.description: For the 600th anniversary of Prague's Astronomical Clock, the medieval tower seems to crack, fill with gears, burn, rebuild itself and show its own history in a 10-minute mapping watched by thousands in Old Town Square.
works.description_zh: 为庆祝布拉格天文钟 600 周年，这座中世纪钟楼在十分钟的投影中仿佛裂开、塞满齿轮、燃烧、再自我重建，把自己的历史讲给老城广场上成千上万的观众。
works.idea_en: Make a monument narrate its own biography by pretending to take it apart.
works.idea_zh: 假装把一座建筑拆开，让它亲口讲述自己的一生。
works.technique: A precise 3D model of the tower is used to render animations that align to every ledge and window, projected from multiple overlapping high-lumen projectors.
works.technique_zh: 先建立钟楼的精确 3D 模型，依据它渲染与每个檐口和窗户完全对齐的动画，再由多台高亮度投影机重叠投射。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a shoebox 'building' head-on, trace its features in After Effects or p5.js, and make a 30-second mapping in which it breaks apart and reassembles. Twist: tell the building's fictional history in three chapters.
works.exercise_zh: 正面拍摄一个鞋盒做的“建筑”，在 After Effects 或 p5.js 中描出它的结构，做一段 30 秒的投影：它碎开又重新拼好；变体：分三个章节讲述这座建筑虚构的历史。

video.video_title: The 600 Years

works.title: The Animals and Children Took to the Streets
works.description: A dark comic tale set in the Bayou Mansions tenement, where three performers act, sing and play inside animated windows, staircases and crowds projected around them like a living graphic novel.
works.description_zh: 一个发生在 Bayou Mansions 贫民公寓里的黑色喜剧故事，三位演员在投影出来的动画窗户、楼梯和人群中表演、唱歌和演奏，像一部活起来的图像小说。
works.idea_en: Precise alignment between a live head and a drawn body makes one character from two media; AR face and body effects rely on the same registration.
works.idea_zh: 真人的头和画出来的身体精确对齐，两种媒介合成一个角色；AR 的脸部和身体特效靠的也是这种对位。
works.technique: Performers stand in small cut-outs and at marked positions on a projection surface so projected animated bodies, clothes and objects fit around them.
works.technique_zh: 演员站在投影面上的小开口和标记位置，让投影出来的动画身体、衣服和物体恰好贴合在他们周围。
works.exercise_en: Use face tracking in Lens Studio to attach a real face to a hand-drawn animated body that walks across the screen. Twist: the drawn body keeps walking when the real head stops, and they have to catch up.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 的脸部追踪把真人的脸接到一个手绘的动画身体上，让它走过屏幕；变体：真人的头停下时，画出来的身体还在走，两者必须重新对上。

video.video_title: The Animals and the Children took to the Streets - Trailer 1

works.title: The Great Firewall and Sunken City
works.description: At the Bushwick AR Intervention, a virtual Great Firewall rises across Flushing Avenue, blocking the street for anyone who looks through a phone.
works.description_zh: 在布什维克 AR 介入展上，一道虚拟的“防火长城”横跨法拉盛大道，任何透过手机看的人都会发现街道被挡住了。
works.idea_en: Make online censorship physical by walling off a real street.
works.idea_zh: 把网络审查变成实体：用一堵墙封住一条真实的街道。
works.technique: A wall model is geolocated across the avenue in a mobile AR browser, extending the duo's Second Life project Land of Illusion into the street.
works.technique_zh: 在移动 AR 浏览器中把一堵墙的模型定位在大道上，把两人在 Second Life 中的项目 Land of Illusion 延伸到街头。
works.exercise_en: Choose a website your class cannot access and build an AR wall with its name across a corridor. Twist: the wall lets you pass only if you type a password.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个你们班无法访问的网站，用 AR 在走廊上建一堵写着它名字的墙。变体：只有输入密码才能穿过这堵墙。

video.video_title: Great Firewall blocking Flushing Ave

salient.why_en: The Great Firewall becomes a real wall that blocks a Brooklyn street for anyone looking through a phone.
salient.why_zh: “防火长城”变成一堵真的墙，挡住了布鲁克林的一条街，只要透过手机看就能看到。

works.title: The Leak in Your Hometown
works.description: Point a phone at any BP logo and an AR broken pipe gushes oil out of it, bringing the Deepwater Horizon spill to your own street.
works.idea_zh: 对准任何BP标志，都会喷出AR原油

video.video_title: "The leak in your home town" documentation of BP oil spill app

works.technique: Image (logo) marker tracking in junaio detects any BP logo and anchors an animated broken pipe with an oil particle effect to it.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个你想批评的品牌 logo，用 MindAR 或 8th Wall 图像追踪让它“泄漏”出象征其问题的东西；变体：让泄漏量随观众对准的时间增加，最终淹没整个画面。
works.description_zh: 把手机对准任意一个 BP 标志，就会有一根破裂的 AR 管道从中喷出原油，把深水地平线漏油事件带到你家门口的街道上。
works.idea_en: Point at any BP logo and AR crude oil gushes out of it.
works.technique_zh: junaio 中的图像（标志）标记追踪能识别任何 BP 标志，并在其上锚定一根带有石油粒子特效的破裂管道动画。
works.exercise_en: Pick a brand logo you want to criticize and use MindAR or 8th Wall image tracking to make it 'leak' something that stands for its problem. Twist: let the leak grow the longer viewers point at it until it floods the whole screen.

salient.why_en: Point at any BP logo and crude oil gushes out of it, turning a brand into the scene of its own spill.
salient.why_zh: 对准任何 BP 标志，原油就从里面喷涌而出，品牌变成了它自己的漏油现场。

works.title: The Silent Evolution (MUSA)
works.description: Over 400 life-size figures cast from people of a local fishing village stand on the sea floor off Cancún, Mexico, in the Museo Subacuático de Arte, slowly covered by coral and algae.
works.description_zh: 400 多个以当地渔村居民为原型翻制的等身人像立在墨西哥坎昆外海的海底（Museo Subacuático de Arte），慢慢被珊瑚和藻类覆盖。
works.idea_en: A crowd that nature slowly transforms makes time and ecology visible, a model for AR figures that age with their environment.
works.idea_zh: 一群被自然慢慢改变的人像让时间和生态变得可见，是随环境老化的 AR 人像范本。
works.technique: Figures are cast in marine-grade cement that encourages coral growth and sunk onto the sea floor to divert divers from natural reefs.
works.technique_zh: 人像用利于珊瑚生长的海洋级水泥浇筑，沉入海底，以把潜水者从天然珊瑚礁引开。
works.exercise_en: Scan ten people and place them as an AR crowd in a pond or pool, then add a 'growth' shader that covers them with coral textures a little more each day. Twist: the growth speed follows real sea temperature data.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描十个人，把他们作为 AR 人群放在池塘或泳池中，并加入每天多覆盖一点珊瑚纹理的“生长”着色器；变体：生长速度跟随真实海温数据。

video.video_title: Jason deCaires Taylor and Museo Subaquatico de Arte

works.title: Variations on Pi (Light Drawing Machine)
works.description: A small machine moves a light along paths computed from the digits of pi, and long exposures turn its motion into glowing drawings.
works.description_zh: 一台小机器按圆周率的数字计算出的路径移动一盏灯，长曝光把它的运动变成发光的图画。
works.idea_en: A number sequence becomes a visible trace when motion is recorded over time — AR trails can reveal data as drawings.
works.idea_zh: 当运动被随时间记录下来时，一串数字就变成了可见的轨迹——AR 拖尾可以把数据显现为图画。
works.technique: A pen-plotter-like mechanism steers an LED along paths generated from successive digits of pi, photographed with long exposure.
works.technique_zh: 一个类似绘图仪的机构按圆周率的连续数字生成的路径移动 LED，并用长曝光拍摄。
works.exercise_en: Program a virtual light point in AR that moves along a path generated from the digits of pi or a friend's phone number and leaves a permanent glowing trail. Twist: two sequences draw at once and their lines interfere.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中编程一个虚拟光点，沿着由圆周率或朋友电话号码生成的路径移动，并留下永久的发光轨迹。变体：两串数字同时作画，线条相互交织。

video.video_title: Nils Völker - Variations on PI, Light Drawing Machine 2010

works.title: Warcraft ARmor
works.description: A marker-based AR demo that dresses the user's body in World of Warcraft-style armour on screen.
works.idea_zh: 把游戏盔甲穿到真人身上

video.video_title: Augmented Reality "Warcraft ARmor"  -- Demo

works.technique: Printed fiducial markers worn on the body are tracked by a webcam, and armour pieces are rendered at each marker's pose.
works.exercise_zh: 在手臂和胸前贴几张打印标记，用 MindAR 给身体“穿”上你设计的盔甲或服装；变体：把盔甲换成代表某种日常压力的装备（作业、通知）。
works.description_zh: 一个基于标记的 AR 演示，在屏幕上给用户的身体穿上《魔兽世界》风格的盔甲。
works.idea_en: Put game armor on a real person.
works.technique_zh: 网络摄像头追踪佩戴在身上的打印基准标记，并在每个标记的位姿处渲染相应的盔甲部件。
works.exercise_en: Stick a few printed markers on your arms and chest and use MindAR to 'dress' your body in armor or clothing you designed. Twist: replace the armor with gear that stands for some everyday pressure (homework, notifications).

works.title: We AR in MoMA
works.description: An uninvited AR exhibition inside MoMA New York: artworks by Manifest.AR members were geolocated into the galleries and visible only via the Layar app.
works.idea_zh: 不请自来，用AR在MoMA里开了一场展览

video.video_title: MoMA NYC augmented reality exhibition

works.technique: Geolocated Layar layers placed virtual works at GPS coordinates inside MoMA, exploiting the fact that the location-based layer could not be controlled by the institution.
works.exercise_zh: 在学校某个正式展厅里用 WebAR 办一场“不请自来”的展览，每人放一件作品并通过二维码传播；变体：作品必须回应展厅中某件真实展品。
works.description_zh: 一场在纽约 MoMA 内部举办的“不请自来”的 AR 展览：Manifest.AR 成员的作品被地理定位到各个展厅中，只有通过 Layar 应用才能看到。
works.idea_en: Show up uninvited and stage an AR exhibition inside MoMA.
works.technique_zh: 通过地理定位的 Layar 图层，把虚拟作品放在 MoMA 内部的 GPS 坐标上，利用了机构无法控制基于位置的图层这一点。
works.exercise_en: Stage an 'uninvited' WebAR exhibition in a formal gallery at your school, with each person placing one work and spreading it via QR codes. Twist: every work must respond to a real piece on display in that gallery.

salient.why_en: An uninvited AR show hangs inside MoMA, showing that no one controls who exhibits in virtual space.
salient.why_zh: 一场未经邀请的 AR 展览挂进了 MoMA，说明虚拟空间里没人能决定谁来展出。

works.title: White Heat
works.description: A flock of projected 'light-beings', inspired by the Game of Life and Reynolds' boids, reacts to visitors and to a collection of artists' books and evolves over the show.
works.idea_zh: 一群由规则驱动的光之生物，会围着观众和书本聚散演化
works.technique: openFrameworks runs boid flocking plus cellular-automaton rules, using camera-detected visitors as attractors or obstacles.
works.exercise_zh: 用p5.js写boids鸟群，把摄像头检测到的人当作吸引点投影在桌上；变化：在桌上放一本书，鸟群会避开或聚集在书周围。

video.video_title: White Heat

works.description_zh: 一群投影出来的“光之生物”受生命游戏和 Reynolds 的 boids 算法启发，会对观众和一批艺术家书作出反应，并在展期中不断演化。
works.idea_en: A swarm of rule-driven light creatures gathers, scatters and evolves around visitors and books.
works.technique_zh: openFrameworks 运行 boids 群集算法和元胞自动机规则，把摄像头检测到的观众当作吸引点或障碍物。
works.exercise_en: Write a boids flock in p5.js and project it onto a table, treating people detected by the camera as attractors. Twist: place a book on the table and have the flock avoid it or gather around it.

works.title: Within without
works.description: At the National Gallery of Australia, a ramp leads under a pool into a basalt stupa inside a pyramid; lying in the dome, visitors see the sky through a circular opening.
works.description_zh: 在澳大利亚国家美术馆，一条坡道从水池下穿过，通往金字塔中的玄武岩佛塔；躺在穹顶中，观众透过圆形开口看天空。
works.idea_en: A long approach prepares the eyes: before showing AR content, a staged transition (darkness, water, a tunnel) makes the reveal much stronger.
works.idea_zh: 漫长的进场让眼睛做好准备：在展示 AR 内容之前，安排一段过渡（黑暗、水面、隧道），揭晓的时刻会强烈得多。
works.technique: Visitors walk down through water and into a dark chamber so their eyes adapt, then look up at a sharp-edged circle of sky in a domed ceiling.
works.technique_zh: 观众先向下穿过水面进入昏暗的空间，让眼睛适应，然后抬头看穹顶上一个边缘锐利的圆形天空。
works.exercise_en: Design a three-stage WebXR sequence: a dimming tunnel, a floating circular window, and finally a live sky camera texture inside that circle. Twist: keep the circle closed until the user has stayed still and looked up for ten seconds.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个三段式 WebXR 体验：逐渐变暗的隧道、一扇悬浮的圆窗，最后在圆窗里显示实时天空画面。变体：只有当用户保持不动、抬头看满十秒时圆窗才打开。

video.video_title: Within without, James Turrell Skyspace

works.title: Word Lens
works.description: Point an iPhone at a sign or menu and the printed Spanish or English text is replaced in place, in the same style, with its translation, running offline in real time.
works.idea_zh: 对准外语招牌，文字当场被替换成母语，像魔法一样。

video.video_title: Introducing Word Lens

works.technique: On-device OCR finds text regions, a dictionary translates them, and the original text is painted over with sampled background color and redrawn in a matching font.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Google ML Kit 或 Tesseract 识别画面中的文字，把它替换成另一种语言或另一句话并贴回原位；变体：把所有标识都替换成反义词。
works.description_zh: 把 iPhone 对准路牌或菜单，上面印着的西班牙语或英语文字会在原位被替换成译文，字体风格保持一致，全程离线实时运行。
works.idea_en: Point at a foreign sign and the words turn into your own language on the spot, like magic.
works.technique_zh: 设备端 OCR 找出文字区域，用词典进行翻译，再用采样得到的背景色覆盖原文，并以匹配的字体重新绘制。
works.exercise_en: Use Google ML Kit or Tesseract to recognize text in the camera view, replace it with another language or another sentence, and paste it back in place. Twist: replace every sign with its antonym.

salient.why_en: Point the camera at a foreign sign and the words are replaced in place by your language.
salient.why_zh: 把镜头对准外文招牌，上面的字就地换成你的语言。

works.title: Your uncertain shadow (colour)
works.description: Five coloured lamps shine on a white wall; each visitor casts a row of overlapping coloured shadows that move with them, splitting the body into a spectrum.
works.idea_zh: 五盏彩色灯把你的影子分解成一串彩虹
works.technique: Coloured HMI lamps placed side by side produce additive-colour light; blocking one lamp leaves its complementary colour, so each shadow is a different hue.
works.exercise_zh: 用红绿蓝三盏手机灯（或彩色玻璃纸）照白墙，研究影子颜色；变化：用舞蹈动作让彩色影子拼出一个字母。

video.video_title: Olafur Eliasson 'Your Uncertain Shadow (Colour)' 2010

works.description_zh: 五盏彩色灯照在一面白墙上，每位观众都会投下一排相互重叠、随人移动的彩色影子，身体仿佛被拆分成一道光谱。
works.idea_en: Five colored lamps split your shadow into a string of rainbows.
works.technique_zh: 并排放置的彩色 HMI 灯通过加色混合发光；挡住其中一盏灯，就会留下它的补色，因此每个影子都呈现不同的色调。
works.exercise_en: Shine three phone lights in red, green and blue (or use colored cellophane) on a white wall and study the colors of the shadows. Twist: use dance moves to make the colored shadows spell out a letter.

salient.why_en: Five colored lamps split one shadow into a row of colored shadows that move with you.
salient.why_zh: 五盏彩色灯把一个影子拆成一排彩色影子，跟着你一起移动。

works.title: erasAR: Statue of Liberty erased
works.description: Through a phone pointed at Liberty Island, the Statue of Liberty is gone and only her empty pedestal remains.
works.description_zh: 把手机对准自由岛，自由女神像消失了，只剩下空荡荡的基座。
works.idea_en: Diminished reality as protest: erase a national monument instead of adding one.
works.idea_zh: 用“减法现实”做抗议：不是添加纪念碑，而是抹掉一座。
works.technique: A geolocated 3D patch of sky and empty pedestal is rendered over the statue's GPS position in a mobile AR browser, likely Layar, hiding the real monument behind a matched backdrop.
works.technique_zh: 在移动 AR 浏览器（很可能是 Layar）中，于雕像的 GPS 位置叠加一块与背景匹配的天空和空基座模型，把真实纪念碑“盖住”。
works.exercise_en: Pick a landmark visible from campus, photograph the empty sky behind it and build a phone-AR overlay that hides it from one viewpoint. Twist: let viewers vote on which landmark disappears next.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个从校园能看到的地标，拍下它背后的空天空，用手机 AR 做一个从某个视角把它“遮掉”的叠加层。变体：让观众投票决定下一个消失的地标。

video.video_title: Statue of Liberty erased with augmented reality, the eraAR project

salient.why_en: Point a phone at Liberty Island and the Statue of Liberty is gone, leaving only her empty pedestal.
salient.why_zh: 把手机对准自由岛，自由女神像消失了，只剩下空空的底座。

works.title: the concept of ... (here and now)
works.description: A dance piece choreographed not only for the audience's viewpoint but also for camera perspectives, so dancers' bodies combine into impossible figures on the projected image.
works.idea_zh: 同时为观众和摄像机两个视角编舞，让身体在画面里拼成不可能的形体
works.technique: Fixed live cameras film the stage from unusual angles and the feed is projected as a stereoscopic/composited view that only aligns from the camera's perspective.
works.exercise_zh: 固定一台摄像机从上方或侧面拍，让两三位同学在现场摆姿势使画面里拼成一个新形状；变化：观众只能看投影、不能看现场，猜真实站位。

video.video_title: the concept of ... (here and now) – Klaus Obermaier (2010)

works.description_zh: 这支舞作不仅为观众的视角编排，也为摄像机的视角编排，舞者的身体在投影画面中组合成不可能存在的形体。
works.idea_en: Choreograph for both the audience and the camera so bodies merge into impossible shapes on screen.
works.technique_zh: 固定的现场摄像机从不寻常的角度拍摄舞台，画面以立体/合成视图的形式投影出来，只有从摄像机的视角看才会对齐。
works.exercise_en: Fix a camera shooting from above or from the side, and have two or three classmates pose on site so their bodies combine into a new shape on screen. Twist: the audience may only watch the projection, not the live scene, and must guess where everyone is really standing.

works.title: 3D Video Mapping – Volvo, Frankfurt
works.description: A city building in Frankfurt appears to crack, fold and rebuild itself as 3D animation is projected exactly onto its facade for a Volvo campaign with Saatchi & Saatchi.
works.description_zh: 为沃尔沃与 Saatchi & Saatchi 合作的宣传，3D 动画被精确投射到法兰克福一栋建筑的立面上，整栋楼看起来在开裂、折叠并重新组装。
works.idea_en: A facade becomes believable 3D content only when the virtual geometry is modelled from the real one; AR occlusion and anchoring work the same way.
works.idea_zh: 只有当虚拟几何是照着真实建筑建模时，立面上的影像才显得立体可信；AR 的遮挡和锚定也是同样的道理。
works.technique: The building is surveyed and rebuilt as a 3D model, animation is rendered from the audience's viewpoint and projected with several aligned high-power projectors.
works.technique_zh: 先测绘建筑并重建 3D 模型，再从观众视角渲染动画，用多台对齐的大功率投影机投射出来。
works.exercise_en: Scan a campus wall with a LiDAR phone, rebuild it as a simple mesh in Reality Composer or Unity, and animate its bricks falling out and snapping back in AR. Twist: the bricks only move when someone walks past the wall.
works.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的手机扫描校园里的一面墙，在 Reality Composer 或 Unity 里重建成简单网格，在 AR 中让墙砖掉出来再弹回原位；变体：只有当有人从墙前走过时砖块才会动。

video.video_title: NuFormer 3D Video Mapping - Volvo, Frankfurt, September 2009

works.title: 555 KUBIK
works.description: 'How it would be if a house was dreaming': the cube façade of Hamburg's Galerie der Gegenwart appears to bulge, fold and dissolve under a projected 3D animation.
works.idea_zh: 假如一栋房子在做梦——让方正建筑看起来在弯曲、折叠
works.technique: A 3D model of the façade is animated with fake depth and lighting, then projected from the audience's viewpoint so the illusion of deformation holds.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸盒做建筑，在Blender里做同形状模型的变形动画，从观众角度投影对齐；变化：换一个观看角度，讨论为什么错觉消失。

video.video_title: 555 KUBIK | facade projection

works.description_zh: “假如一栋房子在做梦会是什么样”：在投影的三维动画下，汉堡当代美术馆（Galerie der Gegenwart）的立方体立面仿佛在鼓胀、折叠和消融。
works.idea_en: What if a house were dreaming? Make a boxy building look like it is bending and folding.
works.technique_zh: 对立面的三维模型施加假深度和光照动画，再从观众的视角投影，使变形的错觉得以成立。
works.exercise_en: Build a building from cardboard boxes, animate a deforming model of the same shape in Blender, and project it aligned from the viewer's position. Twist: change the viewing angle and discuss why the illusion disappears.

works.title: AR Tele-Echography (2009)
works.description: A remote doctor guides a local operator's ultrasound probe in real time using AR overlays that show where and how to move it.
works.idea_zh: 远程医生用 AR 叠加指引本地人员操作超声探头。

video.video_title: AR Tele-Echography: Remote Instruction of Ultrasound Probe Operation (2009)

works.technique: Fiducial markers on the probe and patient are tracked with OpenCV, and the remote doctor's target probe pose is streamed and rendered as an overlay guiding the local operator.
works.exercise_zh: 用两台手机，一人在远端屏幕上拖动虚拟箭头，另一人的 AR 画面中同步显示箭头指引他移动桌上的真实物体；变体：用于远程教别人叠一只纸鹤。
works.description_zh: 远程医生借助 AR 叠加信息，实时指导本地操作者移动超声探头，显示应该往哪里、以何种方式移动。
works.idea_en: A remote doctor uses AR overlays to guide a local helper in handling an ultrasound probe.
works.technique_zh: 用 OpenCV 追踪探头和患者身上的基准标记，远程医生设定的目标探头位姿被实时传输过来，并渲染为叠加画面来引导本地操作者。
works.exercise_en: With two phones, have one person drag a virtual arrow on a remote screen while the other's AR view shows the arrow in sync, guiding them to move a real object on the table. Twist: use it to teach someone remotely how to fold a paper crane.

works.title: ARMAR: AR for Maintenance and Repair
works.description: Steve Henderson and Steven Feiner guide a mechanic inside an armored personnel carrier turret with head-worn AR arrows, labels and animated tools, speeding up task localization.
works.idea_zh: 在装甲车炮塔里，头戴AR箭头直接指出下一颗要拧的螺丝。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality for Task Localization in Maintenance of an Armored Personnel Carrier Turret

works.technique: An optically tracked head-worn display renders arrows, labels and animated tool models registered to the vehicle interior, guiding attention to the next task location and demonstrating the procedure in place.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中用图像目标定位一台打印机或自行车，为一个 5 步维修流程做箭头、标签和动画扳手指引；变体：当用户视野里看不到目标部件时，显示屏幕边缘的方向提示。
works.description_zh: Steve Henderson 和 Steven Feiner 在装甲运兵车的炮塔内，通过头戴式 AR 显示的箭头、标签和工具动画来指导机械师作业，加快了定位任务位置的速度。
works.idea_en: Inside an armored vehicle turret, head-worn AR arrows point straight at the next bolt to turn.
works.technique_zh: 采用光学追踪的头戴式显示器渲染与车辆内部配准的箭头、标签和工具动画模型，把注意力引向下一个任务位置，并在原位演示操作步骤。
