works.exercise_en: In phone AR, use an image target to locate a printer or bicycle and build arrow, label and animated-wrench guidance for a five-step repair procedure. Twist: when the target part is out of view, show a direction hint at the edge of the screen.

works.title: ARhrrrr!
works.description: A zombie shooter on a tabletop city map: from a helicopter view on a mobile device you shoot zombies and can drop real Skittles candies onto the map as explosives.
works.idea_zh: 在桌上的城市地图里打僵尸，扔一颗真彩虹糖就是一枚炸弹。

video.video_title: ARhrrrr - An augmented reality shooter

works.technique: Natural feature tracking of a printed city map provides the camera pose on a GPU-accelerated handheld, and colored blobs (Skittles) placed on the map are detected by color segmentation and turned into explosive game objects.
works.exercise_zh: 用一张打印地图作为图像目标做一个 AR 射击或塔防游戏，并用颜色检测识别玩家放在地图上的真实彩色糖果或积木作为炸弹或障碍；变体：让真实物品的颜色决定它在游戏中的功能。
works.description_zh: 一款在桌面城市地图上进行的僵尸射击游戏：玩家在移动设备上以直升机视角射杀僵尸，还可以把真实的彩虹糖扔到地图上当作炸弹。
works.idea_en: Shoot zombies on a tabletop city map, where each real Skittle you drop is a bomb.
works.technique_zh: 在 GPU 加速的手持设备上，对打印的城市地图做自然特征追踪以获得相机位姿；放在地图上的彩色色块（彩虹糖）通过颜色分割被检测出来，并转换为会爆炸的游戏物体。
works.exercise_en: Use a printed map as an image target to make an AR shooting or tower-defense game, and use color detection to recognize real colored candies or blocks that players put on the map as bombs or obstacles. Twist: let the color of a real object decide its role in the game.

works.title: AVATAR
works.description: A solo performance on online self-display: the performer copies, mirrors and merges with projected webcam videos and internet footage of people documenting themselves, inspired by the mantra 'I post therefore I am'.
works.description_zh: 一场关于网络自我展示的独舞：表演者模仿、镜像并融入投影出来的摄像头视频和网上自拍记录，灵感来自“我发帖，故我在”。
works.idea_en: Perform the body as an internet profile picture come to life.
works.idea_zh: 把身体演成一张活过来的网络头像。
works.technique: Live and prerecorded webcam imagery is processed in Quartz Composer and projected on and around the performer, so live body and screen body overlap.
works.technique_zh: 现场与预录的摄像头影像经 Quartz Composer 处理后投射在表演者身上和周围，让真实身体与屏幕身体重叠。
works.exercise_en: Record ten seconds of a classmate's webcam selfie, project it at life size and have them perform a live duet with their own recording. Twist: slowly shift the projection off their body so the two selves drift apart.
works.exercise_zh: 录下同学十秒钟的摄像头自拍，按真人大小投影，让他和自己的录像跳一段双人舞；变体：慢慢把投影移出他的身体，让两个“自己”逐渐分离。

video.video_title: AVATAR (promotional video clip)

works.title: Aftermath of Obliteration of Eternity
works.description: From a walkway over dark water in a mirrored room, visitors watch hundreds of gold lantern-like lights glow up and then go out, like floating lanterns drifting away.
works.description_zh: 观众站在镜面房间里黑水之上的步道上，看着数百盏金色灯笼般的灯亮起又熄灭，像漂走的河灯。
works.idea_en: Light that appears and then vanishes on a timed breath reads as life and death; an AR designer can give virtual objects a short, visible lifespan to carry emotion.
works.idea_zh: 按呼吸般的节奏亮起又消失的光，会被读成生与死：AR 设计者可以给虚拟物体一个短暂而可见的寿命，来承载情感。
works.technique: Hanging LED lanterns fade in and out in sequence, and their reflections in mirrors and a black pool extend the flicker into an endless field.
works.technique_zh: 悬挂的 LED 灯笼按顺序渐亮渐灭，镜子和黑色水池里的倒影把这种闪烁延伸成一片无尽的光海。
works.exercise_en: Place 100 lantern lights over a real floor or pond with phone AR, make them brighten together and then die out one by one over 60 seconds. Twist: let the user relight one lantern by holding a finger on it, and only that lantern survives the next cycle.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 在真实地面或水面上方放 100 盏灯笼光，让它们一起亮起，再在 60 秒内逐盏熄灭。变体：用户按住某一盏可以把它重新点亮，只有这一盏能活过下一轮。

video.video_title: YAYOI KUSAMA : AFTERMATH OF OBLITERATION OF ETERNITY

works.title: AntiVJ - SONGDO
works.description: An audiovisual projection performance on architecture in New Songdo City, South Korea.
works.idea_zh: 在韩国新松岛城建筑上的视听投影

video.video_title: AntiVJ - SONGDO

works.technique: Architectural projection mapping with content built from the building's surveyed geometry and synced to a live audio performance.
works.exercise_zh: 用积木或纸盒搭一个“未来城市”模型，投影一段表现这座城市从空白到建成的视听动画；变体：在动画最后让城市慢慢被自然“收回”。
works.description_zh: 在韩国新松岛城建筑上进行的一场视听投影表演。
works.idea_en: An audiovisual projection on the buildings of New Songdo City in South Korea.
works.technique_zh: 建筑投影映射，内容依据建筑的实测几何结构制作，并与现场音频表演同步。
works.exercise_en: Build a 'future city' model from blocks or cardboard boxes and project an audiovisual animation of the city growing from empty ground to completion. Twist: at the end of the animation, let nature slowly 'take back' the city.

works.title: Art of Defense
works.description: A collaborative AR tower defense game played on a physical board with tangible tiles, shown at SIGGRAPH 2009.
works.idea_zh: 用实体板块搭建地图，多人合作玩AR塔防。

video.video_title: Art of Defense:  A collaborative Augmented Reality Game (SIGGRAPH 2009)

works.technique: Tangible tiles carry fiducial markers that are tracked by handheld cameras, and each tile's position and rotation define a tower's placement and aim in a shared tower-defense game rendered over the board.
works.exercise_zh: 用多张带 ArUco 标记的卡片作为“炮塔”，手机 AR 识别卡片位置并在上面显示炮塔，敌人沿虚拟路径进攻；变体：卡片的旋转角度决定炮塔的朝向，两位玩家必须分工摆放。
works.description_zh: 一款在实体棋盘上用可触摸板块进行的协作式 AR 塔防游戏，在 SIGGRAPH 2009 上展出。
works.idea_en: Build the map from physical tiles and play AR tower defense together.
works.technique_zh: 可触摸的板块上带有基准标记，由手持摄像头追踪；每块板的位置和旋转决定了炮塔的摆放和瞄准方向，共享的塔防游戏则渲染在棋盘之上。
works.exercise_en: Use several cards with ArUco markers as 'towers': phone AR recognizes each card's position and shows a tower on it while enemies attack along a virtual path. Twist: each card's rotation sets its tower's facing, and two players must split up the placement.

works.title: Augmented Reality Business Card
works.description: Holding up his printed business card to a webcam makes a 3D video of the artist pop out of it and introduce himself.
works.idea_zh: 举起名片，名片上弹出会说话的3D本人

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Business Card

works.technique: FLARToolKit tracks a square fiducial marker printed on the card in a Flash webcam app, and a video plane of the artist is rendered at the marker's pose with Papervision3D.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一张自己的名片，用 MindAR 让名片上弹出一段抠像的自我介绍视频；变体：让视频中的你对着观众的拿法做出反应（倾斜名片就“摔倒”）。
works.description_zh: 把他的印刷名片举到网络摄像头前，艺术家本人的 3D 视频就会从名片上弹出来做自我介绍。
works.idea_en: Hold up a business card and a talking 3D version of its owner pops out.
works.technique_zh: 在 Flash 网络摄像头应用中，用 FLARToolKit 追踪名片上印的方形基准标记，再用 Papervision3D 在标记位姿处渲染艺术家的视频平面。
works.exercise_en: Design your own business card and use MindAR to make a keyed self-introduction video pop out of it. Twist: have the video of you react to how the viewer holds the card (tilt it and you 'fall over').

works.title: Augmented Reality Magic 1.0
works.description: Tempest lays real playing cards on a table in front of a camera; on the screen animated jokers climb out of the cards, comment on the trick and help him find the chosen card.
works.description_zh: Tempest 把真实的扑克牌放在摄像头前的桌上；屏幕里，动画小丑从牌里爬出来，对魔术评头论足，还帮他找出观众选的牌。
works.idea_en: Marker-based AR as a close-up magic trick: the cards themselves are the markers.
works.idea_zh: 把基于标记的 AR 做成近景魔术：扑克牌本身就是标记。
works.technique: Each card face works as a fiducial marker tracked with ARToolKit inside an openFrameworks app written with Zach Lieberman and Theo Watson, and pre-animated characters are rendered on top of the live camera image.
works.technique_zh: 每张牌面都作为 ARToolKit 追踪的标记，运行在与 Zach Lieberman、Theo Watson 合作编写的 openFrameworks 程序里，预先做好的角色动画叠加在实时摄像画面上。
works.exercise_en: Print five image markers as playing cards and build a phone AR trick in which a character appears on the card the audience picked. Twist: the character must lie once, and the performer has to catch it.
works.exercise_zh: 把五张图像标记打印成扑克牌，用手机 AR 做一个魔术：角色只出现在观众选中的那张牌上。变体：让角色撒一次谎，表演者要当场识破。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Magic 1.0

works.title: Augmented Reality Marble Game
works.description: A tilting physical board controls virtual marbles rolling through AR mazes seen through a head-worn display.
works.idea_zh: 倾斜手中的真实板子，操控AR里的虚拟弹珠穿越迷宫。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Marble Game

works.technique: The tracked board's orientation relative to gravity is computed from the marker pose, and that tilt is fed as a gravity vector into a physics engine that rolls virtual marbles through a maze registered to the board.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一张打印的迷宫图作为图像目标，读取它相对于桌面的倾斜角度，驱动 Unity 物理引擎让虚拟弹珠滚动；变体：让两个人同时拿着同一块板合作过关。
works.description_zh: 倾斜一块实体板，就能操控虚拟弹珠在 AR 迷宫中滚动，玩家通过头戴式显示器观看。
works.idea_en: Tilt a real board in your hands to steer virtual marbles through an AR maze.
works.technique_zh: 根据标记位姿计算被追踪板子相对于重力的朝向，再把这个倾角作为重力向量输入物理引擎，让虚拟弹珠在与板子配准的迷宫中滚动。
works.exercise_en: In AR, use a printed maze as an image target, read its tilt relative to the table, and drive the Unity physics engine to roll a virtual marble. Twist: have two people hold the same board and clear the level together.

works.title: Augmented Reality Ribbons
works.description: Marker-tracked AR where flowing 3D ribbons spill out of a printed marker and follow its movement, reacting to music.
works.idea_zh: 从标记中涌出、随音乐飘动的AR丝带

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Ribbons

works.technique: A tracked fiducial marker emits procedurally generated ribbon geometry whose points trail the marker's recent positions, with amplitude driven by audio analysis.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MindAR 或 AR.js 让图像标记拖出一条记录其移动轨迹的 3D 丝带，并用麦克风音量控制丝带宽度；变体：把丝带换成由你最近聊天记录中的文字组成的“文字带”。
works.description_zh: 基于标记追踪的 AR：流动的 3D 丝带从印刷标记中涌出，随标记移动，并对音乐作出反应。
works.idea_en: AR ribbons pour out of a marker and sway to music.
works.technique_zh: 被追踪的基准标记发射程序化生成的丝带几何体，丝带上的点沿标记最近的位置拖尾，其振幅由音频分析驱动。
works.exercise_en: Use MindAR or AR.js to make an image marker trail a 3D ribbon that records its path, with microphone volume controlling the ribbon's width. Twist: replace the ribbon with a 'text band' made of words from your recent chats.

works.title: Beacon
works.description: Visitors walk through a grid of modified emergency beacon lights that turn and brighten to follow them, filling the dark space with sweeping, responsive beams.
works.description_zh: 观众穿过由改装应急信标灯组成的阵列，灯会转动、变亮来跟随他们，用扫动的光束填满黑暗空间。
works.idea_en: A field of lights that notices you and turns to look.
works.idea_zh: 一片会注意到你、并转头看你的灯。
works.technique: Thermal cameras track people, and a bespoke control system (openFrameworks) drives custom hardware inside each beacon to set reflector rotation and lamp brightness (with Cinimod Studio).
works.technique_zh: 热成像摄像头追踪人，定制控制系统（openFrameworks）驱动每个信标内的自制硬件，控制反光罩转向和灯光亮度（与 Cinimod Studio 合作）。
works.exercise_en: Line up several phones or small lamps on servos and make them all point toward the person tracked by a webcam. Twist: when two people are present, the lights split their attention unevenly.
works.exercise_zh: 把几部手机或小灯装在舵机上排成一排，让它们都指向摄像头追踪到的人。变体：有两个人时，灯的注意力不均匀地分配。

video.video_title: Beacon

works.title: Bird Watching (small brains series)
works.description: Ordinary footage of birds at a feeder and in flocks is processed so each bird leaves a trail, turning a backyard into swirling drawings of flight.
works.description_zh: 喂鸟器旁和鸟群的普通视频经过处理，让每只鸟留下一条轨迹，把后院变成飞行的旋转绘画。
works.idea_en: A cheap camera plus frame accumulation reveals hidden patterns of motion: the simplest version of an AR trail effect.
works.idea_zh: 一台廉价相机加上帧累积就能揭示隐藏的运动图案：这是 AR 轨迹效果最简单的版本。
works.technique: Clips from a Flip camera are unpacked into frames and processed in After Effects with echo and tonal effects so moving birds leave trails.
works.technique_zh: Flip 相机拍摄的片段被拆成单帧，在 After Effects 中用回声与色调效果处理，让移动的鸟留下轨迹。
works.exercise_en: Write a WebGL camera shader that blends each new frame with the last 60 frames using a 'darken' blend, and film birds, traffic or people. Twist: make trails longer for faster movers.
works.exercise_zh: 编写一个 WebGL 相机着色器，用“变暗”混合把每一帧与之前 60 帧叠加，然后拍摄鸟、车流或人群；变体：移动越快的物体，轨迹越长。

video.video_title: Bird Watching 006

salient.why_en: Every bird leaves a trail, so ordinary flight turns into drawings in the sky.
salient.why_zh: 每只鸟都留下轨迹，平常的飞行变成天空中的线条画。

works.title: Chase
works.description: An interactive mobile projection from a moving car in which projected characters chase along the street as the vehicle travels.
works.idea_zh: 让投影角色在街景中追逐行驶的汽车
works.technique: Likely the same car-mounted projection rig as Wildlife, with animation playback driven by vehicle motion data.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机投影或小投影仪边走边投，让角色速度与步行速度同步；变化：让观众用手机遥控角色在墙上跳过障碍。

video.video_title: Chase

works.description_zh: 一件从行驶的汽车上进行的互动移动投影作品，车辆前行时，投影出的角色沿着街道一路追逐。
works.idea_en: Projected characters chase a moving car along the street.
works.technique_zh: 大概率与 Wildlife 使用同一套车载投影装置，由车辆运动数据驱动动画播放。
works.exercise_en: Project from a phone projector or a small projector while walking, keeping the character's speed in sync with your walking pace. Twist: let viewers use their phones to make the character jump over obstacles on the wall.

works.title: Chorus
works.description: Tall pendulums, each carrying light and a speaker, swing in and out of phase in a dark space, sweeping beams and voices across the room.
works.description_zh: 黑暗空间中，一根根高大的摆锤各自带着灯和扬声器，时而同步时而错开地摆动，让光束和人声扫过整个房间。
works.idea_en: Phase is a composition tool: identical pendulums slightly out of sync produce endless patterns — useful for any repeating AR animation.
works.idea_zh: 相位是一种作曲工具：稍微不同步的相同摆锤会产生无尽的图案——对任何循环的 AR 动画都很有用。
works.technique: Motor-driven pendulums of equal length are started with different phases and each one carries a light and a speaker, so light and sound move together.
works.technique_zh: 等长的电动摆锤以不同相位启动，每根都带着灯和扬声器，使光与声一起移动。
works.exercise_en: Hang eight virtual pendulums with spot lights and spatial audio from the ceiling in AR, each with a slightly different period. Twist: let the user nudge one pendulum by walking into its path.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中从天花板挂下八根带聚光灯和空间音频的虚拟摆锤，每根周期略有不同。变体：用户走进摆动路径时，会推动其中一根。

video.video_title: Chorus - United Visual Artists

works.title: CueLight interactive pool table
works.description: A pool table in a Hard Rock Hotel & Casino suite in Las Vegas has projected graphics on its felt that follow the balls: ripples, trails and effects react to every shot, turning a classic game into a light show.
works.description_zh: 拉斯维加斯 Hard Rock Hotel & Casino 套房里的一张台球桌，台面上的投影图形会跟随台球移动：每一杆都会激起涟漪、轨迹和特效，把经典游戏变成一场光影秀。
works.idea_en: Augmenting an existing game with visual feedback keeps its rules and adds delight; the best AR games often start from a familiar physical game.
works.idea_zh: 给已有的游戏加上视觉反馈，保留规则又增添乐趣；最好的 AR 游戏往往从熟悉的实体游戏出发。
works.technique: An overhead camera likely tracks the balls on the felt and an overhead projector draws effects at their positions in real time.
works.technique_zh: 很可能由头顶的摄像头追踪台面上的球，再由头顶的投影机实时在球的位置画出效果。
works.exercise_en: Point a phone down at a table-top game (marbles, coins or a mini pool set) and use colour tracking in OpenCV.js or Lens Studio to draw AR trails behind each piece. Twist: trails become walls that later pieces bounce off.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机朝下对准一个桌面游戏（弹珠、硬币或迷你台球），用 OpenCV.js 或 Lens Studio 的颜色追踪给每个棋子画出 AR 轨迹；变体：轨迹会变成墙，后面的棋子会被它弹开。

video.video_title: Hard Rock Hotel & Casino "CueLight (tm)" pool table

works.title: Day to Night
works.description: From a fixed position high above a city or landscape, Wilkes shoots for up to 30 hours and blends the best moments into one photograph whose left side is day and right side is night.
works.description_zh: Wilkes 在城市或风景上方的固定高处连续拍摄长达 30 小时，把最精彩的瞬间融合成一张照片：画面一侧是白天，另一侧是夜晚。
works.idea_en: Time can be laid out across space so one glance shows a whole day: AR can map time onto a direction, letting viewers read history by looking left to right.
works.idea_zh: 时间可以铺在空间上，一眼就看到一整天：AR 可以把时间映射到一个方向上，让观众从左往右看就能读出历史。
works.technique: Hundreds to over a thousand frames from a locked camera are masked and blended so each region of the image comes from a different time.
works.technique_zh: 固定机位拍下的几百到一千多张照片经过蒙版与融合，画面的每个区域都来自不同的时间。
works.exercise_en: Record a 1-hour timelapse of a window view on a phone, then build an AR filter that shows each vertical slice of the live view from a different moment of the timelapse. Twist: tie the time gradient to the phone's compass heading instead of screen position.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍一段 1 小时的窗外延时，再做一个 AR 滤镜，让实时画面的每个竖条显示延时中不同时刻的画面；变体：让时间渐变跟随手机的指南针朝向，而不是屏幕位置。

video.video_title: The passing of time, caught in a single photo | Stephen Wilkes

salient.why_en: One photograph of a city runs from day on the left to night on the right.
salient.why_zh: 一张城市照片从左边的白天一路过渡到右边的夜晚。

works.title: Decrypted Reflections
works.description: Visitors move an analog array of mirrors to break apart and rearrange a projected generative image, scattering its fragments across the room.
works.idea_zh: 移动一组镜子，把投影的生成图形拆散、反射到空间各处。

video.video_title: Decrypted Reflections

works.technique: A projected generative image hits an array of physically adjustable mirrors, so rotating mirrors redirects fragments of the projection around the room in an analog, non-computed way.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影打到一排可转动的小镜子（或手机屏幕、镜面纸）上，让画面碎片反射到房间各处，大家转镜子重组图像；变体：设计一张只有所有碎片落在同一面墙上时才能读出的秘密信息。
works.description_zh: 观众移动一组模拟的镜子阵列，把投影出的生成图像打散、重新排列，让图像碎片散落在整个房间里。
works.idea_en: Move a set of mirrors to break a projected generative image apart and bounce it all over the room.
works.technique_zh: 投射出的生成图像打在一组可手动调节的镜子上，转动镜子就能以模拟、非计算的方式把投影碎片重新引向房间各处。
works.exercise_en: Project onto a row of small rotatable mirrors (or phone screens, mirror paper) so fragments bounce around the room, and let everyone turn the mirrors to reassemble the image. Twist: design a secret message that can only be read when every fragment lands on the same wall.

works.title: Digital Airbrushing with Spatial Augmented Reality
works.description: Holding a tracked airbrush and stencil, a designer sprays virtual paint onto a white physical object and the paint appears on it through projectors; the stencil's mask shape is virtual and can be redrawn.
works.description_zh: 设计师手持被追踪的喷枪和模板，向白色实物喷涂虚拟颜料，颜料通过投影仪显示在物体上；模板的遮罩形状是虚拟的，可以随时重画。
works.idea_en: Paint real objects with light using the familiar gestures of airbrushing.
works.idea_zh: 用熟悉的喷绘动作，以光为颜料给真实物体上色。
works.technique: Projectors are calibrated to a known object model, and tracked tool poses drive a projective-texture paint buffer that is projected back onto the object.
works.technique_zh: 投影仪根据已知的物体模型进行标定，被追踪的工具姿态驱动一个投影纹理的绘画缓冲区，再投射回物体表面。
works.exercise_en: Point a projector at a white box, track a phone as a 'spray can' and let it paint projected colour where it points. Twist: use a cardboard cut-out as a stencil that blocks paint.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影仪对准一个白盒子，用手机当“喷漆罐”被追踪，指向哪里就在哪里投射颜色。变体：用纸板剪影当模板遮挡颜料。

video.video_title: Digitial Airbrushing with Spatial Augmented Reality

works.title: Dismemberment, Site 1 (Gibbs Farm)
works.description: At Gibbs Farm in New Zealand, a red membrane 85 metres long is stretched between two steel ellipses across a valley, like a trumpet or a skin laid over the land. The video is a tour of Gibbs Farm that includes it.
works.description_zh: 在新西兰 Gibbs Farm，一张长 85 米的红色膜在一处山谷两端的两个钢椭圆之间张开，像一支小号，或一层覆在土地上的皮肤。视频是包含该作品的 Gibbs Farm 导览。
works.idea_en: A single stretched surface across a valley shows how one bold shape can frame an entire landscape.
works.idea_zh: 一张横跨山谷的张拉面说明，一个大胆的形体就能框住整片风景。
works.technique: A tensioned PVC fabric is stretched between two large steel rings anchored at either end of a gully.
works.technique_zh: 张拉的 PVC 织物绷在沟谷两端锚固的两个巨大钢环之间。
works.exercise_en: Stretch an AR membrane between two real points (trees, lamp posts) using a cloth simulation, and colour it strongly against the landscape. Twist: let users pluck it like a drum to make a low sound.
works.exercise_zh: 用布料模拟在两个真实点（树、路灯）之间拉起一张 AR 薄膜，并用与风景强烈对比的颜色；变体：让用户像拨鼓一样拨动它，发出低沉的声音。

video.video_title: Gibbs Farm : New Zealand's most unbelievable place

works.title: Dream
works.description: A 20-metre white head of a nine-year-old girl with closed eyes rises from the spoil heap of the former Sutton Manor colliery in St Helens, commissioned with ex-miners through Channel 4's Big Art Project.
works.description_zh: 一个 20 米高、双眼紧闭的九岁女孩白色头像从圣海伦斯前萨顿庄园煤矿的矸石山上升起，由前矿工参与、通过 Channel 4 的 Big Art Project 委托创作。
works.idea_en: A calm face on a scarred landscape changes what the place means for a whole town, showing that an AR landmark can carry collective memory.
works.idea_zh: 一张安静的脸放在满是伤痕的土地上，改变了这个地方对整个小镇的意义，说明 AR 地标可以承载集体记忆。
works.technique: A digitally elongated scan of a girl's head was cast in white dolomite-and-concrete sections on a pile foundation.
works.technique_zh: 女孩头部的扫描经过数字拉长，用白云石与混凝土分段浇筑，立在桩基础上。
works.exercise_en: Scan a classmate's face with eyes closed, stretch it vertically by 50% in Blender, and place it 15 metres tall on a hill or rooftop in AR. Twist: the eyes open only when nobody is looking directly at it.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描一位同学闭眼的脸，在 Blender 中竖向拉长 50%，在 AR 中把它以 15 米高度放在山丘或屋顶上；变体：只有当没有人直视它时，眼睛才会睁开。

video.video_title: Dream St Helens - Jaume Plensa

works.title: Déshérence (AntiVJ)
works.description: An audiovisual installation in Enghien-les-Bains where projection mapping makes a building façade appear to crack, peel and reassemble in sync with music by Squeaky Lobster.
works.idea_zh: 让建筑立面在投影中剥落、崩塌再重组
works.technique: Façade geometry is measured and modelled, then animations are rendered to that model and projected from a calibrated position so light aligns with each architectural edge.
works.exercise_zh: 给教室一面有门窗的墙拍正面照，在AE/网页里沿着门窗轮廓做“剥落”动画并用投影对齐；变化：让剥落顺序由音乐鼓点触发。

video.video_title: AntiVJ - Déshérence

works.description_zh: 在昂吉安莱班（Enghien-les-Bains）的一件视听装置，投影映射让建筑立面仿佛开裂、剥落并重新拼合，并与 Squeaky Lobster 的音乐同步。
works.idea_en: Make a building facade peel, crumble and reassemble in projection.
works.technique_zh: 先测量立面几何并建模，再针对该模型渲染动画，并从标定好的位置投影，使光线与每一条建筑边缘对齐。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a classroom wall with a door and windows head-on, animate a 'peeling' effect along their outlines in After Effects or a web page, and align it with a projector. Twist: let the drum beats of a piece of music trigger the order of the peeling.

works.title: EyePet
works.description: A virtual monkey-like pet appears on the living-room floor through the PlayStation Eye; players stroke, feed and wash it with their hands and draw toys on paper that it brings to life.
works.idea_zh: 一只会对你的手势做出反应的AR宠物，还能把你画在纸上的东西变成玩具。

video.video_title: EyePet™  trailer

works.technique: A fixed camera uses a marker card to locate the floor, and frame-differencing motion detection lets the player's hand movements near the pet count as touches.
works.exercise_zh: 用网页摄像头和帧差法检测手在画面某区域的移动，让屏幕上的虚拟宠物被“摸”时做出反应；变体：在纸上画一个圆，宠物把它当成球来玩。
works.description_zh: 通过 PlayStation Eye，一只像小猴子的虚拟宠物出现在客厅地板上；玩家可以用手抚摸、喂食和给它洗澡，还能在纸上画玩具，让它把画变成真的。
works.idea_en: An AR pet that reacts to your hand gestures and turns what you draw on paper into toys.
works.technique_zh: 固定摄像头借助一张标记卡定位地面，并用帧差法做运动检测，玩家的手在宠物附近移动就被视为触摸。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam and frame differencing to detect hand movement in one region of the image, and make an on-screen virtual pet react when it is 'stroked'. Twist: draw a circle on paper and have the pet play with it as a ball.

works.title: Filmmuseum augmented sand sculpture
works.description: An augmented projection that unveiled a five-metre sand sculpture of Amsterdam's future Film Museum building in stages using projection mapping.
works.idea_zh: 用投影在沙雕上逐步“揭幕”未来的电影博物馆大楼。

video.video_title: Filmmuseum- new building introduction

works.technique: Projection mapping aligns projector output to the physical sculpture using a 3D model or manually warped masks, then reveals textures and animations region by region.
works.exercise_zh: 用黏土或纸盒做一个小建筑，用 TouchDesigner 或 MadMapper 的遮罩把投影对准每个面，分阶段“揭幕”；变体：投影讲述这个建筑从建造到废墟的一生。
works.description_zh: 一件增强投影作品：通过投影映射，分阶段为一座五米高的沙雕“揭幕”，沙雕表现的是阿姆斯特丹未来的电影博物馆大楼。
works.idea_en: Use projection to unveil the future film museum on a sand sculpture step by step.
works.technique_zh: 投影映射借助三维模型或手动变形的遮罩，把投影输出与实体雕塑对齐，再逐区域揭示纹理和动画。
works.exercise_en: Make a small building from clay or cardboard, use masks in TouchDesigner or MadMapper to align the projection with each face, and 'unveil' it in stages. Twist: have the projection tell the building's whole life, from construction to ruin.

works.title: Grandfather Clock (Real Time)
works.description: A grandfather clock whose face is a screen showing a man inside who erases and redraws the hands with a marker every minute, as if he lived inside the clock.
works.description_zh: 一座落地大摆钟的钟面是一块屏幕，里面的人每分钟用马克笔擦掉并重画指针，好像他住在钟里一样。
works.idea_en: A screen inside a familiar object makes it feel inhabited — AR can place 'someone inside' everyday objects.
works.idea_zh: 在熟悉的物件里放一块屏幕，它就像有人住在里面——AR 可以让日常物件里“住进一个人”。
works.technique: A 12-hour video of the performer drawing the hands behind glass is played on a display hidden in a traditional clock case, synced to the real time.
works.technique_zh: 把表演者在玻璃后画指针的 12 小时视频放在传统钟壳里的隐藏屏幕上，并与真实时间同步。
works.exercise_en: Track a real picture frame or box with image tracking and play a short loop of a tiny person living inside it. Twist: the tiny person notices the viewer and waves.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪识别一个真实的相框或盒子，在里面循环播放一个小人在其中生活的短片。变体：小人发现观众后向他挥手。

video.video_title: Real Time - preview Grandfather Clock - Maarten Baas

salient.why_en: A man living inside a grandfather clock redraws its hands by hand every minute.
salient.why_zh: 一个人住在落地钟里，每分钟亲手擦掉再画出指针。

works.title: Hand from Above
works.description: On BBC Big Screens in Liverpool and beyond, a giant hand reaches into the live camera feed of the square to tickle, stretch, flick and remove unsuspecting passers-by.
works.idea_zh: 广场大屏上一只巨手伸进实时画面，挠痒、拉长、甚至“拎走”路人。

video.video_title: Hand from Above

works.technique: Background subtraction and blob tracking find pedestrians in the live square feed, and a pre-animated giant hand is composited to target a chosen person, warping or removing their pixels.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 检测监控视角画面里的人，从画面上方伸下一只动画大手去“戳”其中一个人，把他拉长或挤扁；变体：大手只挑低头看手机的人，做一个关于注意力的小恶作剧。
works.description_zh: 在利物浦等地的 BBC 户外大屏上，一只巨手伸进广场的实时摄像画面，给毫无防备的路人挠痒、把他们拉长、弹飞，甚至直接“拎走”。
works.idea_en: A giant hand reaches into the live feed on a square's big screen to tickle, stretch and even lift away passers-by.
works.technique_zh: 背景减除和色块追踪在广场的实时画面中找出行人，预先制作好的巨手动画被合成进来瞄准选中的某个人，对其像素进行变形或移除。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe to detect people in a CCTV-style view and have an animated giant hand reach down from the top of the frame to 'poke' one of them, stretching or squashing them. Twist: the hand only picks people looking down at their phones, making a small prank about attention.

salient.why_en: A giant hand reaches into the big-screen feed of a square and picks up passers-by like toys.
salient.why_zh: 一只巨手伸进广场大屏幕的实时画面，把路人像玩具一样拎起来。

works.title: Her Secret is Patience
works.description: Above a downtown park in Phoenix, a huge net sculpture shaped like a cactus bloom hangs from steel poles, rippling in the desert wind by day and glowing in shifting colours by night.
works.description_zh: 在凤凰城市中心公园上空，一座形似仙人掌花的巨大网状雕塑悬挂在钢柱之间，白天随沙漠的风起伏，夜晚在变幻的灯光中发亮。
works.idea_en: A soft, light form hung over a city makes the invisible wind visible; AR sky objects can reveal real forces by moving with them.
works.idea_zh: 悬在城市上空的轻柔形体，让看不见的风变得可见；AR 天空物体也可以通过随真实力量运动而让它们显形。
works.technique: Layers of knotted high-tenacity fibre netting are suspended from three steel poles, with coloured lighting projected onto the net at night.
works.technique_zh: 多层高强度纤维编织网由三根钢柱悬挂，夜晚用彩色灯光投射到网上。
works.exercise_en: Hang a virtual net mesh between three real points you tap (lamp posts, trees) and simulate it as cloth moved by the phone's measured wind or by a slider. Twist: at night mode, colour the net by the noise level of the street below.
works.exercise_zh: 在你点选的三个真实点（路灯、树）之间挂一张虚拟网格，把它当布料模拟，用手机测得的风或滑块驱动它摆动。变体：夜间模式下，按下方街道的噪音大小给网上色。

video.video_title: "Her Secret is Patience," Phoenix, AZ (2009)

works.title: Humannature (Adelaide)
works.description: At night, the huge faces of local residents are projected onto the canopies of park trees; the faces blink, look around and slowly change expression, so the trees seem to be watching the people below.
works.description_zh: 夜里，当地居民的巨大面孔被投影在公园大树的树冠上；这些脸会眨眼、四处张望、慢慢变换表情，树仿佛在注视着树下的人。
works.idea_en: A face on an organic, uneven surface feels alive because the surface breaks and animates it; AR faces on real objects gain presence from the material they sit on.
works.idea_zh: 脸投在有机、不平整的表面上会显得活着，因为表面把它打碎又让它流动；贴在真实物体上的 AR 脸，存在感来自它所依附的材质。
works.technique: High-lumen projectors aimed at tree canopies play long-take portrait videos, with the leaves acting as a textured, moving screen.
works.technique_zh: 高亮度投影机对准树冠，播放长镜头人像视频，树叶成了带纹理、会动的屏幕。
works.exercise_en: Film a 30-second close-up of a classmate slowly looking around, then in phone AR place it on a real tree or bush using a vertical anchor and a leaf-shaped mask. Twist: the face turns to look at whoever holds the phone.
works.exercise_zh: 拍一段 30 秒的同学面部特写，让他慢慢四处看，然后在手机 AR 里用竖直锚点和叶片形状的遮罩把它贴到一棵真实的树或灌木上；变体：这张脸会转向拿手机的人。

video.video_title: Humannature - Adelaide

works.title: Immaterials: the ghost in the field
works.description: An RFID reader with an LED that lights up whenever it detects a tag is moved around the tag in steps and photographed with long exposures, revealing the invisible 3D shape of the reading field.
works.description_zh: 一台检测到标签就会点亮 LED 的 RFID 读卡器绕着标签一步步移动，并用长曝光拍下，把看不见的读取场的三维形状显现出来。
works.idea_en: Invisible technical fields have shapes: AR can show the real reach of sensors, beacons and NFC so people understand where interactions work.
works.idea_zh: 看不见的技术场也有形状：AR 可以显示传感器、信标和 NFC 的实际作用范围，让人明白交互在哪里有效。
works.technique: An LED on the reader is switched on only when a tag is read; stepping the reader through space during long exposures and animating the frames builds a volumetric map.
works.technique_zh: 只有读到标签时读卡器上的 LED 才会点亮；在长曝光中让读卡器按步长穿过空间，再把画面做成动画，就得到一幅体积地图。
works.exercise_en: Walk a phone around a room while logging Bluetooth signal strength from a beacon, then render each sample as a colored sphere at the phone's AR position. Twist: animate the spheres to pulse at the beacon's advertising rate.
works.exercise_zh: 拿着手机在房间里走动，同时记录一个蓝牙信标的信号强度，再把每个采样点在手机的 AR 位置上画成彩色小球；变体：让小球按信标的广播频率闪动。

video.video_title: Immaterials: the ghost in the field

works.title: Improving Spatial Perception for AR X-Ray Vision
works.description: Walking outdoors with a head-worn display, users see through a building wall into the room behind it, with edges of the wall kept visible so the hidden space reads as behind rather than in front.
works.description_zh: 佩戴头戴显示器在户外行走，用户能透过建筑外墙看到墙后的房间，墙体边缘保持可见，让隐藏空间看起来确实在墙后而不是浮在前面。
works.idea_en: X-ray vision only works if you keep just enough of the occluder to show depth.
works.idea_zh: 透视只有在保留恰到好处的遮挡物时才成立，这样才能表现出深度。
works.technique: Edge detection on the video of the occluding wall is overlaid on the rendered hidden scene, providing an occlusion cue that restores correct depth ordering.
works.technique_zh: 对遮挡墙体的视频进行边缘检测，并把边缘叠加在渲染出的隐藏场景上，提供遮挡线索来恢复正确的前后关系。
works.exercise_en: In phone AR, place a virtual room behind a real wall and compare three looks: plain overlay, edge-outline wall, and a cut hole. Twist: let the hole follow your gaze.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中把一个虚拟房间放在真实墙后，比较三种效果：直接叠加、墙体边缘描线、挖一个洞。变体：让洞跟随你的视线移动。

video.video_title: Improving Spatial Perception for Augmented Reality X-Ray Vision

works.title: Installations at Montalvo Arts Center
works.description: At Montalvo Arts Center in California, Drury builds works that mirror natural patterns, including a woven structure up in the trees, and explains how his work follows the hidden patterns of nature.
works.description_zh: 在加州 Montalvo 艺术中心，Drury 创作了呼应自然纹样的作品，包括在树上编织的结构，并讲述他的作品如何追随自然中隐藏的纹样。
works.idea_en: Echoing a pattern you find in nature (veins, rivers, whirlpools) at a new scale makes the hidden structure visible, a strategy for AR generative forms.
works.idea_zh: 把在自然中发现的纹样（叶脉、河流、漩涡）以新的尺度复现，让隐藏的结构显形，这是 AR 生成形态的一种策略。
works.technique: He weaves branches and builds chambers on site, likely referencing drawn patterns of water flow and blood vessels.
works.technique_zh: 他在现场编织树枝、建造石室，很可能参考了水流与血管的图案。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a leaf's veins, trace them into a 3D path, and grow the pattern at tree scale between real trunks in AR. Twist: make the branches pulse like blood flow when touched.
works.exercise_zh: 拍摄一片叶子的叶脉，把它描成三维路径，在 AR 中把图案以树的尺度生长在真实树干之间；变体：触碰时让枝条像血流一样搏动。

video.video_title: Chris Drury | KQED Spark

works.title: Interzone
works.description: An audiovisual installation for transit spaces such as tunnels and stairways, which represents a post-apocalyptic zone where space-time anomalies appear as projections and sounds follow people passing through.
works.description_zh: 为隧道、走廊、楼梯等过渡空间设计的视听装置，呈现一个出现时空异常的末日区域，路人经过时投影和声音随之而动。
works.idea_en: Turn a corridor you pass through every day into a zone that notices you.
works.idea_zh: 把每天路过的走廊变成一个会“注意到你”的区域。
works.technique: Six infrared sensors connected to an Arduino detect a visitor's position and send it to Processing, which triggers projected effects and sound loops.
works.technique_zh: 六个红外传感器连接 Arduino，检测访客位置并发给 Processing，由它触发投影特效和声音循环。
works.exercise_en: Line a corridor with three cheap distance sensors on an Arduino and trigger different projected glitches and sounds as a person walks through. Twist: make the effects lag one step behind, as if the corridor remembers.
works.exercise_zh: 在走廊里用 Arduino 接三个便宜的距离传感器，当人走过时触发不同的投影故障效果和声音；变体：让效果总是慢一步出现，仿佛走廊还记得刚才的人。

video.video_title: Interzone

works.title: Invizimals
works.description: A PSP game with a clip-on camera: players scan their surroundings to detect invisible creatures, then trap them on a printed marker card where they fight on the tabletop.
works.idea_zh: 用掌机摄像头在家里'捕捉'隐形怪兽，放在卡片上对战。

video.video_title: Invizimals

works.technique: A printed fiducial card gives the camera pose for tabletop rendering, while a color-detection capture step (pointing the camera at certain hues) is used to spawn creatures.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头颜色检测“发现”隐藏生物：对准某种颜色的物体时出现提示，再在图像标记卡上召唤它；变体：不同颜色对应不同属性的生物。
works.description_zh: 一款外接夹式摄像头的 PSP 游戏：玩家扫描周围环境来探测隐形生物，再把它们困在一张印刷标记卡上，在桌面上展开对战。
works.idea_en: Use a handheld's camera to 'catch' invisible monsters at home and battle them on a card.
works.technique_zh: 印刷的基准卡为桌面渲染提供相机位姿，捕捉环节则通过颜色检测（把摄像头对准特定色调）来生成生物。
works.exercise_en: Use camera color detection to 'discover' hidden creatures: a hint appears when you point at an object of a certain color, and then you summon it onto an image-marker card. Twist: different colors map to creatures with different attributes.

works.title: Knee Deep
works.description: Children stomp into projected worlds of different scales with their feet, seeing themselves composited into oceans, cities and planets from impossible points of view.
works.idea_zh: 用脚踏进不同尺度的世界，看见自己踩在海洋、城市甚至星球里。

video.video_title: Knee Deep - Cinekid 2009

works.technique: Chroma keying or background subtraction isolates children's feet and legs from an overhead camera, which are then composited at a different scale into pre-rendered or live 3D worlds.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 人体分割把同学抠出来，缩放后合成进一张城市航拍或显微镜照片里，投到地上让大家“踩进”画面；变体：每走一步切换一个尺度，从蚂蚁视角到星球视角。
works.description_zh: 孩子们用脚踏进不同尺度的投影世界，从不可能的视角看见自己被合成进海洋、城市和星球之中。
works.idea_en: Step into worlds of different scales and see yourself standing in oceans, cities and even planets.
works.technique_zh: 利用色键抠像或背景减除，从俯拍摄像头画面中分离出孩子的脚和腿，再以不同的比例合成进预渲染或实时的三维世界里。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe body segmentation to cut out a classmate, scale them and composite them into a city aerial photo or a microscope image, then project it on the floor so everyone can 'step into' the picture. Twist: switch scale with every step, from an ant's view to a planet's.

works.title: LEGO Digital Box kiosk
works.description: In LEGO stores, a child holds a sealed LEGO box up to a screen-and-camera kiosk and sees the finished model built and animated on top of the box.
works.description_zh: 在乐高门店里，孩子把一个未拆封的乐高盒子举到带摄像头的展台屏幕前，就能看到拼好的模型在盒子上方组装完成并动起来。
works.idea_en: A closed package previews its own contents in 3D before purchase.
works.idea_zh: 未拆封的包装盒在购买前就能用 3D 展示里面的内容。
works.technique: The kiosk camera recognizes printed box art as a natural-feature target and renders the assembled 3D set on top of it, mirrored on a large screen.
works.technique_zh: 展台摄像头把印刷的包装图案识别为自然特征目标，在其上渲染拼好的 3D 套装，并在大屏上镜像显示。
works.exercise_en: Use a cereal or product box as an image target and show an animated 3D preview of what could be inside. Twist: reveal a different surprise when the box is shaken.
works.exercise_zh: 拿一个麦片盒或商品盒当图像标记，展示盒内可能内容的 3D 动画预览。变体：摇一摇盒子就揭晓一个不同的惊喜。

video.video_title: Lego AR Kiosk

works.title: Layar Reality Browser
works.description: The first mobile AR browser: on an Android phone, the camera view shows geolocated layers of nearby homes for sale, restaurants, ATMs and more, published by anyone through an open API.
works.idea_zh: 世界上第一个手机AR浏览器，把各种地理信息图层叠加在相机画面上。

video.video_title: Re: Layar, worlds first mobile Augmented Reality browser

works.technique: Points of interest from third-party layers are fetched by API and rendered as camera-overlay markers using GPS, compass and accelerometer for bearing and elevation.
works.exercise_zh: 用一个开放数据接口（如 OpenStreetMap）获取附近的咖啡店，用 GPS + 指南针在摄像头画面中按方向显示；变体：只显示你从没去过的地方。
works.description_zh: 第一款手机 AR 浏览器：在 Android 手机上，相机画面中会显示附近待售房屋、餐厅、ATM 等地理定位图层，任何人都可以通过开放 API 发布这些图层。
works.idea_en: The world's first phone AR browser, stacking layers of location data on the camera view.
works.technique_zh: 通过 API 获取第三方图层中的兴趣点，并利用 GPS、指南针和加速度计计算方位与仰角，以相机叠加标记的形式渲染出来。
works.exercise_en: Fetch nearby cafes from an open data API (such as OpenStreetMap) and show them by direction in the camera view using GPS and compass. Twist: show only places you have never been.

works.title: Live Motion Capture with Matthew Barley (with Centroid)
works.description: At Kings Place in London, cellist Matthew Barley performs while wearing motion-capture markers; his bowing and body movement drive projected 3D figures and abstract forms in real time, made with motion-capture experts Centroid.
works.description_zh: 在伦敦 Kings Place，大提琴家 Matthew Barley 佩戴动作捕捉标记进行演奏；他的运弓和身体动作实时驱动投影出来的三维人形和抽象形态，由动作捕捉专家 Centroid 协作完成。
works.idea_en: A musician's gesture is already choreography; capturing it lets the instrument play the visuals as well as the sound, as body-tracked AR can do.
works.idea_zh: 音乐家的动作本身就是编舞；捕捉这些动作，乐器就能同时“演奏”声音和画面，正如身体追踪的 AR 所能做到的。
works.technique: An optical motion-capture system streams skeleton data into a real-time 3D engine whose output is projected behind the performer.
works.technique_zh: 光学动作捕捉系统把骨骼数据流送入实时三维引擎，其输出投射在演奏者身后。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Pose in the browser to track a musician's arms and drive an AR ribbon that follows the bow or drumstick. Twist: the ribbon's thickness follows the loudness of the instrument.
works.exercise_zh: 在浏览器中用 MediaPipe Pose 追踪乐手的手臂，驱动一条跟随琴弓或鼓槌的 AR 彩带；变体：彩带的粗细随乐器的音量变化。

video.video_title: Matthew Barley / Yeast Culture / Centroid / Live Motion Capture Performance

works.title: Ludovico Einaudi at the Royal Albert Hall
works.description: Yeast Culture created the visuals and directed the film of Ludovico Einaudi's 2009 concert at the Royal Albert Hall, where slow, painterly images float above and around the pianist and ensemble.
works.description_zh: Yeast Culture 为 Ludovico Einaudi 2009 年在皇家阿尔伯特音乐厅的音乐会制作视觉并执导影片，缓慢而富有绘画感的影像漂浮在钢琴家和乐团的上方与周围。
works.idea_en: Quiet music needs quiet images; AR for a performance should match tempo and restraint, not compete with the performer.
works.idea_zh: 安静的音乐需要安静的影像；为演出设计的 AR 应该匹配节奏与克制，而不是和表演者抢戏。
works.technique: Pre-produced and live-mixed video is projected onto large screens in the hall, cued to the set list, and captured for a concert film.
works.technique_zh: 预制并现场混合的视频投到大厅的大屏上，按曲目触发，同时拍成音乐会影片。
works.exercise_en: Choose a slow piece of music and design an AR layer (WebXR or Lens Studio) of drifting shapes around a live player that moves at the tempo of the music. Twist: the shapes stop moving whenever the music rests.
works.exercise_zh: 选一首慢速乐曲，为现场演奏者设计一个 AR 图层（WebXR 或 Lens Studio），让漂浮的形状以音乐的速度环绕他移动；变体：音乐一停顿，形状就静止。

video.video_title: Extract from Ludovico Einaudi Royal Albert Hall show

works.title: PenLight
works.description: A digital pen with a built-in mini projector overlays digital content, such as building floor-plan layers, directly onto the paper where you are writing.
works.idea_zh: 笔尖自带投影，写在纸上的同时把数字图层投在纸上。

video.video_title: PenLight: Combining a Mobile Projector and a Digital Pen for Dynamic Visual Overlay

works.technique: Tracks the pen's position on dot-pattern paper and projects spatially registered overlays around the pen tip.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机投影仪对准一张打印的平面图，从上方投射“隐藏的水管/电路层”，学生用笔描出；变化：用手机AR替代投影，比较手持与投影的体验。
works.description_zh: 一支内置微型投影仪的数码笔，能把建筑平面图图层等数字内容直接叠加到你正在书写的纸上。
works.idea_en: A pen with its own projector casts digital layers onto the paper while you write.
works.technique_zh: 在点阵纸上追踪笔的位置，并在笔尖周围投射经过空间配准的叠加内容。
works.exercise_en: Aim a phone projector at a printed floor plan and project a 'hidden plumbing/wiring layer' from above for students to trace with a pen. Twist: replace the projector with phone AR and compare the handheld and projected experiences.

works.title: Put a Spell
works.description: A spelling game for children: a 3D panda appears on the iPhone screen above a table, and kids drop real letter cards into blank spaces to spell the word it asks for; the app recognizes and pronounces the letters.
works.description_zh: 一款儿童拼写游戏：iPhone 屏幕里的桌面上出现一只 3D 熊猫，孩子把真实的字母卡片放进空格里拼出它要求的单词，应用会识别并读出这些字母。
works.idea_en: Physical letter cards become the game controller for learning to spell.
works.idea_zh: 实体字母卡片变成学拼写的游戏手柄。
works.technique: Likely marker or card-art recognition identifies each letter card and its slot, while a 3D character is anchored to the table.
works.technique_zh: 很可能通过标记或卡面图案识别每张字母卡及其位置，同时把一个 3D 角色锚定在桌面上。
works.exercise_en: Print letter cards as image targets and make a phone AR scene where a creature appears only when the cards on the table spell its name. Twist: let the creature mispronounce misspelled words so children can hear the mistake.
works.exercise_zh: 把字母卡片打印成图像标记，做一个手机 AR 场景：只有当桌上的卡片拼出某个生物的名字时，它才会出现。变体：拼错时让生物读出错误的发音，让孩子听出哪里错了。

video.video_title: Put a Spell: Learn to spell with augmented reality - Teaser#1

works.title: Sekai Camera science museum navigation
works.description: Sekai Camera air tags used as a guide inside a science museum, pointing visitors to exhibits through the camera view.
works.idea_zh: 用空中标签在科学馆里为参观者导航。

video.video_title: Sekai Camera to navigate you at a Science Museum ( Tonchidot Japan )

works.technique: Location-tagged labels pointing to exhibits are overlaid on the camera view based on device position and heading, working as indoor wayfinding.
works.exercise_zh: 在教学楼里放几个二维码或图像标记，扫描后在 AR 中显示指向下一个地点的箭头；变体：箭头的样式由上一位访客的评价决定。
works.description_zh: 在科学馆里把 Sekai Camera 的空中标签用作导览，通过相机画面为参观者指向各个展品。
works.idea_en: Guide visitors through a science museum with air tags.
works.technique_zh: 根据设备的位置和朝向，把指向展品的位置标签叠加在相机画面上，实现室内导航。
works.exercise_en: Place a few QR codes or image markers around a teaching building so that scanning one shows an AR arrow pointing to the next spot. Twist: the arrow's style is decided by the previous visitor's rating.

works.title: Shake Menus
works.description: Shake a tangible AR marker to pop up a radial menu around it; menus are anchored to the object in your hand.
works.idea_zh: 摇一摇手里的物体，菜单就在它周围弹出来。

video.video_title: Shake Menus

works.technique: The tracked marker's pose history is analyzed for a rapid back-and-forth motion, and when a shake is detected a radial menu is instantiated in the marker's coordinate frame so it moves with the object.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪卡片或手机加速度计检测“摇一摇”，在卡片周围弹出一个环形 AR 菜单，倾斜卡片选择选项；变体：换成其他物理手势（翻转、敲击）并比较哪种最自然。
works.description_zh: 摇一摇可触摸的 AR 标记，一个环形菜单就会在它周围弹出；菜单锚定在你手中的物体上。
works.idea_en: Shake the object in your hand and a menu pops up around it.
works.technique_zh: 分析被追踪标记的位姿历史，寻找快速来回的运动；一旦检测到摇晃，就在标记的坐标系中生成环形菜单，使其随物体一起移动。
works.exercise_en: Detect a 'shake' with an image-tracked card or the phone accelerometer, pop up a ring-shaped AR menu around the card, and tilt the card to pick an option. Twist: swap in other physical gestures (flip, tap) and compare which feels most natural.

works.title: SixthSense (WUW – Wear Ur World)
works.description: A pendant with a pocket projector, mirror and camera projects interfaces onto walls, paper and hands; colored finger caps are tracked so you can frame a photo with your fingers, dial a phone on your palm or read live data projected onto a newspaper.
works.idea_zh: 把投影仪和摄像头挂在胸前，让整个世界、甚至自己的手掌都变成可用手势操作的屏幕。

video.video_title: SixthSense

works.technique: A webcam tracks colored finger caps by color thresholding and blob tracking, and a pico projector aimed via a mirror renders UI onto whatever surface is in front of the wearer, with the camera and projector roughly co-aligned so gestures map to projected content.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机前置摄像头加 MediaPipe Hands（或给指尖贴彩色胶带做颜色追踪）识别“双手取景框”等 3 个手势，并用小投影仪把对应界面投在桌面或手掌上；变体：只保留一个你每天真正会用的手势功能，并论证它为什么值得“挂在身上”。
works.description_zh: 一个挂在胸前的装置，内含口袋投影仪、镜子和摄像头，能把界面投射到墙面、纸张和手上；系统追踪指尖的彩色指套，你可以用手指框出画面拍照、在手掌上拨号，或看到投射在报纸上的实时数据。
works.idea_en: Hang a projector and camera on your chest so the whole world, even your own palm, becomes a gesture-driven screen.
works.technique_zh: 网络摄像头通过颜色阈值和色块追踪来跟踪彩色指套，经镜子折射的微型投影仪把 UI 渲染到佩戴者面前的任何表面上；摄像头与投影仪大致共轴，因此手势可以对应到投影内容上。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone's front camera with MediaPipe Hands (or colored tape on your fingertips for color tracking) to recognize three gestures such as a two-hand 'viewfinder frame', and use a small projector to cast the matching interface onto the desk or your palm. Twist: keep only one gesture feature you would really use every day, and argue why it deserves to be 'worn on the body'.

works.title: Slow Arc Inside a Cube IV
works.description: A robotic arm moves a single bright light slowly inside a cage cube, casting the shadow of the cage across the whole room so the walls seem to stretch and tilt.
works.description_zh: 一只机械臂在一个笼状立方体内缓慢移动一盏明亮的灯，把笼子的影子投满整个房间，墙面仿佛在伸展、倾斜。
works.idea_en: Moving one light inside a simple object turns the whole room into a moving drawing — AR shadows from virtual lights can transform real spaces.
works.idea_zh: 在一个简单物体内部移动一盏灯，就能把整个房间变成流动的图画——虚拟光源投下的 AR 影子可以改变真实空间。
works.technique: A mechanical arm traces a slow path (inspired by the motion of a molecule) with a lamp inside a lattice cube, projecting shifting perspective shadows.
works.technique_zh: 机械臂带着灯在格子立方体内沿一条缓慢轨迹（灵感来自分子运动）移动，投射出不断变化的透视阴影。
works.exercise_en: Put a virtual point light inside a virtual lattice cube in the middle of a real room and cast its shadows onto the scanned walls with AR occlusion. Twist: let the user drag the light with their hand and watch the room warp.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实房间中央放一个虚拟格子立方体，里面放一盏虚拟点光源，借助 AR 遮挡把阴影投到扫描过的墙面上。变体：让用户用手拖动光源，看房间扭曲。

video.video_title: Conrad Shawcross - Slow Arc Inside A Cube IV (2009)

works.title: Sniff (with James George)
works.description: A projected dog in a street-facing shop window follows passers-by, reads their gestures as friendly or aggressive and tries to get them to play.
works.idea_zh: 橱窗里的虚拟小狗会跟着路人走，并判断你对它是友好还是凶
works.technique: A camera tracks pedestrians outside the window with openFrameworks and feeds position and gesture speed to a Unity-animated dog with simple behaviour states.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头检测人的位置和挥手速度，驱动一只屏幕上的虚拟宠物转头、靠近或躲开；变化：给宠物加“记忆”，同一个人第二次来时反应不同。

video.video_title: Sniff

works.description_zh: 临街橱窗里一只投影出来的狗会跟着路人走，把他们的手势解读为友好或挑衅，并试着让他们陪自己玩。
works.idea_en: A virtual dog in a shop window follows passers-by and judges whether you are friendly or mean to it.
works.technique_zh: 用 openFrameworks 通过摄像头追踪橱窗外的行人，把位置和手势速度传给一只用 Unity 制作动画、带有简单行为状态的狗。
works.exercise_en: Use a camera to detect a person's position and waving speed, and drive an on-screen virtual pet to turn its head, approach or shy away. Twist: give the pet 'memory' so it reacts differently when the same person comes back.

works.title: Space-Distorting AR
works.description: To find points of interest hidden behind buildings or outside the view, the mobile AR scene bends like a fisheye or folds space so distant or occluded places swing into sight.
works.description_zh: 为了找到被建筑挡住或在视野外的兴趣点，移动 AR 画面会像鱼眼一样弯曲，或把空间折叠起来，让远处或被遮挡的地方转进视野。
works.idea_en: Bend space in AR to reveal what is behind or beside you.
works.idea_zh: 在 AR 中弯折空间，把身后和身旁的东西展示出来。
works.technique: Applies egocentric radial distortion and melting-style deformations to a 3D model of the surroundings and its POIs in mobile mixed reality.
works.technique_zh: 在移动混合现实中，对周围环境及兴趣点的三维模型施加以自我为中心的径向变形和“融化”式形变。
works.exercise_en: Take a phone 360 photo of the schoolyard, map it into a tiny-planet view, and mark three hidden spots so classmates can find them faster. Twist: compare with a normal flat map.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍一张校园 360 度照片，转换成“小行星”视图，标出三个隐藏地点，看同学能否更快找到；变体：与普通平面地图进行对比。

video.video_title: Space-Distorting Augmented Reality (ISMAR 09)

works.title: Storm King Wavefield
works.description: On a former gravel pit at Storm King Art Center, seven rows of grass-covered earth waves, up to 4.5 metres tall, roll across 4.4 hectares; walking into them, you lose sight of everything but the next wave.
works.description_zh: 在 Storm King 艺术中心的一处旧砾石坑上，七排覆草土浪高达 4.5 米，起伏铺满 4.4 公顷；走进其中，你只能看见下一道浪。
works.idea_en: A frozen water pattern made of earth lets people 'swim' with their bodies, a model for AR terrain that users walk through rather than look at.
works.idea_zh: 用泥土凝固的水波让人用身体去“游”，是让用户穿行其中而非仅仅观看的 AR 地形范本。
works.technique: Earth was shaped into sine-like waves based on the pattern of water waves, then grassed over.
works.technique_zh: 依据水波纹样把泥土塑造成近似正弦波的形状，再覆以草皮。
works.exercise_en: Generate an AR field of sine-wave ridges 1–2 metres high on a flat lawn with a height shader, and walk through it. Twist: let the waves slowly travel in the direction of the real wind.
works.exercise_zh: 用高度着色器在平坦草坪上生成一片 1–2 米高的正弦波 AR 土浪并在其中行走；变体：让波浪沿真实风向缓缓移动。

video.video_title: Maya Lin's "Wave Field" | The New York Times

works.title: Studierstube ES
works.description: Tech demo of TU Graz's handheld AR framework running multiplayer AR games, virtual characters and marker/natural feature tracking on 2009-era phones.
works.idea_zh: 在2009年的手机上就跑起了多人AR游戏和虚拟角色。

video.video_title: Studierstube ES Tech Demo   December 2009

works.technique: A lightweight fixed-point tracking library estimates 6DOF phone pose from square fiducial markers or natural features in real time on 2009-era mobile CPUs, and a scene-graph renderer draws characters over the camera image, with networking for multiplayer.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR.js 或 8th Wall 的标记追踪在一张打印卡上放一个会动的角色，并让两部手机通过网页同步看到同一个角色状态；变体：把运行帧率人为限制到 15fps、分辨率减半，体验 2009 年的约束并据此简化设计。
works.description_zh: 格拉茨工业大学手持 AR 框架的技术演示，在 2009 年前后的手机上运行多人 AR 游戏、虚拟角色，以及标记追踪和自然特征追踪。
works.idea_en: Multiplayer AR games and virtual characters already running on phones in 2009.
works.technique_zh: 一个轻量级的定点运算追踪库，在 2009 年前后的移动 CPU 上根据方形基准标记或自然特征实时估计手机的 6DOF 位姿；场景图渲染器在相机画面上绘制角色，并通过网络支持多人游戏。
works.exercise_en: Use marker tracking in AR.js or 8th Wall to place an animated character on a printed card, and let two phones see the same character state in sync through a web page. Twist: cap the frame rate at 15fps and halve the resolution to feel the constraints of 2009, then simplify the design to match.

works.title: Sweepers' Clock
works.description: Two street sweepers push lines of rubbish across the floor for twelve hours, constantly re-forming the hour and minute hands of a clock in real time.
works.description_zh: 两位清洁工连续 12 小时推动地上的两排垃圾，实时不断地重组出时钟的时针和分针。
works.idea_en: Time shown by a human performance feels warm and absurd — AR clocks, timers and progress bars could be performed rather than drawn.
works.idea_zh: 由真人表演显示的时间显得温暖又荒诞——AR 中的时钟、计时器和进度条也可以被“表演”，而不是被画出来。
works.technique: A continuous 12-hour video is filmed in one take per segment and played back in sync with the real time of day.
works.technique_zh: 拍摄一段连续 12 小时的视频，并与一天中的真实时间同步播放。
works.exercise_en: Record a volumetric or green-screen clip of yourself moving two objects as clock hands for one minute, and play it in AR on a real table in sync with the clock. Twist: let the performer react when the user taps the table.
works.exercise_zh: 录一段自己把两个物体当作钟针移动一分钟的体积视频或绿幕视频，在 AR 中与真实时间同步地放在桌面上播放。变体：用户敲桌子时让表演者做出反应。

video.video_title: Maarten Baas - Sweeper's Clock in real time

works.title: Terrarium
works.description: A sonic ecosystem powered by visitors' voices: sounds enter through vents and are digested by creatures that grow and sustain life in the projected world.
works.idea_zh: 对着装置说话，声音变成养活虚拟生态的食物。

video.video_title: Terrarium - Interactive Installation

works.technique: Microphones feed amplitude and pitch features into an agent-based simulation, where incoming sounds become food particles and creatures grow according to what they consume.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.sound 把声音转成掉进投影世界里的“食物”粒子，简单的生物吃到后长大、没吃到会饿死；变体：不同音高是不同食物，大家用声音“喂养”一个共同物种。
works.description_zh: 一个由观众声音驱动的声音生态系统：声音从通风口进入，被生物消化，它们在投影世界中生长并维持生命。
works.idea_en: Talk to the installation and your voice becomes food that keeps a virtual ecosystem alive.
works.technique_zh: 麦克风把振幅和音高特征输入一个基于智能体的模拟系统，进入的声音变成食物粒子，生物根据吃到的东西生长。
works.exercise_en: Use p5.sound to turn sounds into 'food' particles that drop into a projected world, where simple creatures grow when they eat and starve when they do not. Twist: different pitches are different foods, and everyone uses their voices to 'feed' one shared species.

works.title: The EyeWriter
works.description: A low-cost eye tracker that let paralyzed graffiti artist TEMPT1 draw tags with his eyes; the tags were projected live onto buildings across Los Angeles.
works.idea_zh: 用眼睛画涂鸦：瘫痪的涂鸦艺术家靠眼球追踪作画，作品实时投影到城市建筑上。

video.video_title: The EyeWriter

works.technique: An IR-illuminated camera on glasses tracks the dark pupil and corneal glint, and a calibration grid maps the pupil-glint vector to screen coordinates for drawing, with dwell time used as a click.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebGazer.js 或 MediaPipe 虹膜点做一个只用眼睛画画的网页，用注视停留 1 秒来落笔/抬笔，再投影到墙上；变体：给一位同学设定“不许动手”的限制，让他用眼睛签一个名字。
works.description_zh: 一套低成本眼动仪，让瘫痪的涂鸦艺术家 TEMPT1 能用眼睛画涂鸦标签，这些作品被实时投影到洛杉矶各处的建筑上。
works.idea_en: Graffiti drawn with the eyes: a paralyzed graffiti artist paints by eye tracking, and his work is projected live onto city buildings.
works.technique_zh: 眼镜上带红外照明的摄像头追踪暗瞳孔和角膜反光点，通过标定网格把瞳孔-反光点向量映射为屏幕坐标用于绘画，并以注视停留时间作为点击。
works.exercise_en: Use WebGazer.js or MediaPipe iris landmarks to build a web page for drawing with your eyes only, using a one-second gaze dwell to put the pen down or lift it, then project the result on a wall. Twist: forbid one classmate from using their hands and have them sign their name with their eyes.

salient.why_en: A paralyzed graffiti artist draws with his eyes and the tags appear live on city buildings.
salient.why_zh: 一位瘫痪的涂鸦艺术家用眼睛画画，作品实时出现在城市建筑上。

works.title: The Wolfsburg Project
works.description: In a huge white room at Kunstmuseum Wolfsburg, visitors walk into a field of uniform coloured light (a Ganzfeld) where walls, floor and distance disappear.
works.description_zh: 在沃尔夫斯堡美术馆一个巨大的白色空间里，观众走进一片均匀的彩色光场（Ganzfeld），墙、地板和距离感都消失了。
works.idea_en: Remove every edge and texture and the brain loses depth; AR designers can use uniform fields of colour to dissolve a room, or add a single object to re-anchor it.
works.idea_zh: 去掉所有边缘和纹理，大脑就失去深度感；AR 设计者可以用均匀色场让房间消失，也可以只加一个物体重新锚定空间。
works.technique: Rounded corners and a sloping floor hide all edges, and programmable colour light fills the space evenly so the eye cannot focus.
works.technique_zh: 圆角和倾斜的地面藏起所有边缘，可编程彩光均匀充满空间，眼睛无法对焦。
works.exercise_en: Using a HoloKit or phone headset, overlay a full-view colour fog that slowly shifts hue and fades out the passthrough image, then bring the room back gradually. Twist: leave one real object visible and ask students where they think the walls are.
works.exercise_zh: 用 HoloKit 或手机头显，在整个视野上叠加一层缓慢变色的彩雾，逐渐盖住透视画面，再慢慢让房间回来。变体：只留一个真实物体可见，问同学觉得墙在哪里。

video.video_title: James Turrell · The Wolfsburg Project (English subtitles)

works.title: Time remap – Anamorphose temporelle
works.description: Two people move in a park while each horizontal band of the image comes from a slightly different moment, so their bodies stretch, twist and smear through time.
works.description_zh: 两个人在公园里移动，画面中每一条横带都取自稍有不同的时刻，于是他们的身体在时间里被拉长、扭曲、拖出残影。
works.idea_en: Turn time into an axis of space, so a moving body becomes a sculpture of its own recent past.
works.idea_zh: 把时间变成空间里的一条轴，运动中的身体就成了自己刚刚过去的雕塑。
works.technique: A custom Quartz Composer plug-in stores the live video stream as a 3D texture (x, y, time) and samples each row from a different delay on the GPU at 60 fps; this slit-scan effect also runs live for visitors in the XYZT exhibition.
works.technique_zh: 自制的 Quartz Composer 插件把实时视频流存成三维纹理（x、y、时间），在 GPU 上以 60 fps 让每一行像素取自不同的延迟时刻，也就是“时间切片”（slit-scan）效果；它也在 XYZT 展览里供观众实时体验。
works.exercise_en: Build a live slit-scan mirror in p5.js or TouchDesigner: keep a buffer of the last 120 webcam frames and draw each row from an older frame the lower it sits on screen, then let students hunt for poses that look impossible. Twist: make the delay depend on distance from a tracked hand instead of the row, so time bends around a point.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 或 TouchDesigner 做一面实时“时间切片”镜子：缓存最近 120 帧摄像头画面，屏幕上越靠下的像素行取自越早的帧，让学生去找看起来不可能的姿势。变体：把延迟改为取决于离被追踪的手有多远，而不是行号，让时间围绕一个点弯曲。

video.video_title: Time remap - Anamorphose temporelle

salient.why_en: Each row of the image comes from a different moment, so a moving body twists into a sculpture of its own past.
salient.why_zh: 画面的每一行都来自不同的时刻，于是运动的身体扭成了自己过去的雕塑。

works.title: WUW / SixthSense gesture demo reel
works.description: Pranav Mistry's own demo reel of the wearable gestural interface: drawing in the air, projected watches on the wrist, augmented boarding passes and books.
works.idea_zh: 用手指画一个圈就看时间，拿起一本书就看到评分——信息随手势出现在实物上。

video.video_title: WUW / sixthsense - a wearable gestural interface

works.technique: Color-marker fingertip tracking from a chest-mounted webcam drives a gesture vocabulary (air drawing, wrist tap for a watch), while a pico projector renders the response in place on the body or on printed objects.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands 在网页里实现“空中画线”：食指捏合开始画、张手结束，把轨迹投影到墙上或叠加在摄像头画面中；变体：给轨迹加上一种物理属性（会下落、会褪色或会被风吹走）。
works.description_zh: Pranav Mistry 亲自制作的可穿戴手势界面演示片：在空中画画、手腕上投影出手表、增强的登机牌和书籍。
works.idea_en: Draw a circle with your finger to see the time, pick up a book to see its rating: information appears on objects as you gesture.
works.technique_zh: 胸前的网络摄像头通过彩色标记追踪指尖，驱动一套手势词汇（空中绘画、轻点手腕看表），同时微型投影仪把响应内容原位投射到身体或印刷品上。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Hands to build 'air drawing' in a web page: pinch your index finger to start drawing, open your hand to stop, and project the stroke on a wall or overlay it on the camera view. Twist: give the stroke a physical property (it falls, fades or gets blown away by the wind).

works.title: Wallpaper* Augmented Reality issue
works.description: A set of webcam AR pieces for Wallpaper* magazine's AR issue, bringing printed pages to life with animated 3D artworks.
works.idea_zh: 让设计杂志的纸页在摄像头前长出3D作品

video.video_title: Wallpaper Augmented Reality issue

works.technique: Printed magazine pages act as fiducial or natural-feature markers for a Flash webcam app that renders animated 3D pieces on each page.
works.exercise_zh: 为一本你喜欢的杂志做一页 AR 版面：用图像追踪让版面上的一个元素长成 3D 作品；变体：只有两页并排时才出现的“跨页”作品。
works.description_zh: 为 Wallpaper* 杂志 AR 特刊制作的一组网络摄像头 AR 作品，让印刷页面上长出会动的 3D 艺术作品。
works.idea_en: Make the pages of a design magazine grow 3D artworks in front of a webcam.
works.technique_zh: 印刷的杂志页面作为基准标记或自然特征标记，由 Flash 网络摄像头应用识别，并在每一页上渲染带动画的 3D 作品。
works.exercise_en: Make one AR page for a magazine you like, using image tracking to grow one element of the layout into a 3D piece. Twist: a 'spread' piece that only appears when two pages sit side by side.

works.title: Wind to Light
works.description: A field of small wind turbines each powers its own light, so gusts sweeping across the site show up as waves of brightness.
works.description_zh: 一片小型风力涡轮机各自为自己的灯供电，于是掠过场地的阵风就显现为一波波的亮度变化。
works.idea_en: Wiring each light to its own local sensor makes an invisible field (wind) readable at a glance; AR can overlay the same kind of field map on a real place.
works.idea_zh: 让每盏灯只连接自己的本地传感器，一个看不见的场（风）就能一眼读出来；AR 可以在真实场所上叠加同样的场分布图。
works.technique: Each micro turbine drives an LED directly or via a small controller, so brightness is a live measure of local wind speed; the exact electronics are a guess.
works.technique_zh: 每台微型涡轮直接或通过小控制器驱动一盏 LED，亮度就是当地风速的实时读数；具体电路为推测。
works.exercise_en: Scatter virtual lamps across a park or courtyard in AR and set each one's brightness from a shared wind or noise signal with a small delay per position, so gusts appear to travel. Twist: use the phone microphone so voices light up the field.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把虚拟灯撒在公园或庭院里，用同一个风或噪声信号按位置加一点延迟来设定每盏灯的亮度，让阵风看起来在移动。变体：改用手机麦克风，让人声点亮整片灯阵。

video.video_title: Wind to Light - Jason Bruges Studio

works.title: You Fade to Light
works.description: A wall of OLED panels translates the viewer's mirror image into glowing light that lingers and fades as they move.
works.idea_zh: 把你的镜像变成慢慢褪去的光
works.technique: A camera image is downsampled to the OLED grid and each panel's brightness follows the pixel with a slow decay, producing light 'afterimages'.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头画面做低分辨率像素镜像，每个像素加余晖衰减；变化：用LED灯带或纸灯笼做成实体版本。

video.video_title: RANDOM INTERNATIONAL | You Fade To Light

works.description_zh: 一面由 OLED 面板组成的墙把观众的镜像转化为发光的光影，随着观众移动，光影会停留片刻再慢慢褪去。
works.idea_en: Turn your mirror image into light that slowly fades away.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头画面被降采样到 OLED 网格的分辨率，每块面板的亮度跟随对应像素变化，并带有缓慢的衰减，从而形成光的“残影”。
works.exercise_en: Make a low-resolution pixel mirror from the camera image and add afterglow decay to each pixel. Twist: build a physical version with LED strips or paper lanterns.

works.title: Your atmospheric colour atlas
works.description: A room filled with thick fog is lit from the ceiling by coloured lights arranged in a grid; as you walk, the fog around you shifts from one colour to another and other visitors appear and vanish.
works.description_zh: 一个充满浓雾的房间被天花板上排成网格的彩色灯照亮；你走动时，周围的雾从一种颜色渐变到另一种，其他观众时隐时现。
works.idea_en: A room can be a colour map you walk through: AR can assign colour or sound to positions on a floor grid so that location becomes the controller.
works.idea_zh: 房间可以是一张可以走进去的色彩地图：AR 可以把颜色或声音分配到地面网格的位置上，让位置成为控制器。
works.technique: Fluorescent tubes in red, green and blue are mounted in a ceiling grid, and dense fog blends their light into gradients across the room.
works.technique_zh: 红、绿、蓝荧光灯管排布在天花板网格里，浓雾把它们的光在整个房间里混合成渐变。
works.exercise_en: Anchor an invisible 4 x 4 colour grid to the classroom floor with AR Foundation and fill the view with a fog tinted by the student's current cell, blending between neighbours. Twist: add a soft tone for each cell so the room can be played like an instrument.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在教室地面锚定一个看不见的 4×4 色彩网格，用当前所在格子的颜色给整个视野染上雾，并在相邻格子之间混合。变体：给每个格子加一个柔和音调，让房间可以像乐器一样被演奏。

video.video_title: Olafur Eliasson Your Atmospheric Colour Atlas AKA Fog Room at ARoS Museum Aarhus

works.title: de-surveillance
works.description: A police surveillance camera in Rotterdam appears to malfunction: anyone hiding behind a blue object becomes invisible on its screen.
works.description_zh: 鹿特丹一台警局监控摄像头似乎出了故障：任何躲在蓝色物体后面的人，在它的画面里都会隐形。
works.idea_en: A chroma-key hack that turns the colour blue into an invisibility cloak.
works.idea_zh: 一个色键技巧，把蓝色变成隐身斗篷。
works.technique: A public screen shows the camera feed with blue pixels keyed out and replaced by a clean background plate, so blue objects and whoever holds them disappear.
works.technique_zh: 公共屏幕播放监控画面，蓝色像素被抠除并替换成干净的背景画面，蓝色物体和拿着它的人就消失了。
works.exercise_en: Build a webcam chroma-key with a captured background plate so a coloured cloth becomes an invisibility cloak on a public screen. Twist: the cloak makes you invisible only to one of two cameras.
works.exercise_zh: 用网络摄像头加一张预先拍好的背景，做一个色键效果，让一块彩布在公共屏幕上变成隐身斗篷。变体：斗篷只能让你在两台相机中的一台里隐形。

video.video_title: de-surveillance - invisible for the surveillance camera

salient.why_en: Hold up something blue and you vanish from a police surveillance camera's screen.
salient.why_zh: 举起一块蓝色的东西，你就从警方监控摄像头的画面里消失了。

works.title: growth modeling device
works.description: Every 24 hours a laser scans an onion plant and a 3D printer builds a plastic model of it, then a conveyor moves on, leaving a row of models that record the plant's growth.
works.description_zh: 每 24 小时，激光扫描一次洋葱植株，3D 打印机据此打印一个塑料模型，传送带随后前移，留下一排记录植物生长的模型。
works.idea_en: Sampling a living thing at intervals and freezing each sample in space turns time into a line of objects — the core of any AR time-lapse trail.
works.idea_zh: 定时采样一个活物并把每次采样凝固在空间里，时间就变成了一排物体——这是所有 AR 延时轨迹的核心。
works.technique: A laser line scanner captures the plant from one of three angles each day and a fused-deposition 3D printer outputs the mesh in real time, after which a conveyor advances about 17 inches.
works.technique_zh: 激光线扫描仪每天从三个角度之一扫描植物，熔融沉积 3D 打印机实时输出网格，之后传送带前进约 17 英寸。
works.exercise_en: Scan a plant, a sleeping pet or a growing pile of dishes with a LiDAR phone every 15 minutes and place the meshes side by side in AR as a physical timeline. Twist: stack them in one spot with fading transparency instead of in a row.
works.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的手机每 15 分钟扫描一次植物、熟睡的宠物或越堆越高的碗盘，在 AR 中把这些网格并排摆成一条实体时间线。变体：不排成一行，而是在同一位置叠加，越早的越透明。

video.video_title: growth modeling device

works.title: loopdiver
works.description: A six-minute dance was videotaped and cut by software into a 60-minute score of loops, which the dancers then re-perform live with machine precision alongside looping video, sound and light.
works.description_zh: 一段六分钟的舞蹈被录像，并由软件剪成长达 60 分钟的循环舞谱，舞者随后以机器般的精确在现场重演，同步循环的还有影像、声音和灯光。
works.idea_en: Humans perform an edit made by a computer, glitches and all.
works.idea_zh: 人类去表演一段由计算机剪辑出来的作品，连故障一起。
works.technique: A custom looping tool turned the recorded performance into a timeline of repeated fragments, which became the choreographic score and cued synchronised media.
works.technique_zh: 定制的循环工具把录下的演出变成由重复片段组成的时间线，它既是编舞的舞谱，也用来触发同步的媒体。
works.exercise_en: Record 20 seconds of improvisation, write a script that cuts it into random short loops, and have the dancer learn and perform the new sequence. Twist: project the loop behind the dancer so the audience can spot every mistake.
works.exercise_zh: 录下 20 秒的即兴舞蹈，写个脚本把它随机切成短循环，再让舞者学会并表演这段新序列；变体：把循环视频投在舞者身后，让观众找出每一处失误。

video.video_title: loopdiver, The Dance Center, Chicago 2010 (excerpt_1)

works.title: tele-present wind
works.description: A dried plant stalk outdoors sways in the wind, and 42 stalks mounted on tilting robots inside the gallery sway in exact unison with it in real time.
works.description_zh: 室外一根干枯的植物茎在风中摇摆，展厅里装在倾斜机构上的 42 根茎同步地实时跟着摇动。
works.idea_en: Invisible wind from somewhere else becomes visible indoors by copying its motion onto many objects — a model for AR scenes driven by live remote data.
works.idea_zh: 把别处看不见的风的运动复制到许多物体上，它就在室内显形了——这是用远程实时数据驱动 AR 场景的范例。
works.technique: An accelerometer on the outdoor stalk streams x/y tilt to an array of servo-driven gimbals, each holding a real stalk, so the gallery field mirrors the wind with a small network delay.
works.technique_zh: 室外茎上的加速度计把 x/y 倾斜数据实时传给一组舵机云台，每个云台夹着一根真茎，于是展厅里的“草地”以很小的网络延迟镜像外面的风。
works.exercise_en: Stream a phone's accelerometer from a window ledge to a second phone that shows a field of virtual grass in AR, all bending with the real wind. Twist: route the data from a friend's city so the room shows someone else's weather.
works.exercise_zh: 把放在窗台上的手机的加速度计数据传到另一台手机，在 AR 中显示一片虚拟草地，所有草都随真实的风弯曲。变体：改用朋友所在城市的数据，让房间显示别处的天气。

video.video_title: tele-present wind

works.title: 52 Card Psycho
works.description: Fifty-two playing cards, each printed with a marker, are replaced in the viewer's view by the 52 shots of the shower scene in Hitchcock's Psycho; dealing, stacking or shuffling the cards re-edits the film.
works.description_zh: 52 张印有标记的扑克牌，在观众眼中被替换成希区柯克《惊魂记》浴室戏的 52 个镜头；发牌、叠牌或洗牌，就是在重新剪辑这部电影。
works.idea_en: A deck of cards as a physical, playable film edit.
works.idea_zh: 一副扑克牌就是一段可以拿在手里玩的实体电影剪辑。
works.technique: ARTag fiducial markers on each card are tracked by a camera and each marker plays its assigned video clip in place, with Max/MSP handling playback, built at York University's AR Lab.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪每张牌上的 ARTag 标记，每个标记在原位播放对应的视频片段，由 Max/MSP 负责播放控制，在约克大学 AR Lab 完成。
works.exercise_en: Cut a 20-second scene into 12 shots, assign each to a printed image marker, and let classmates arrange the cards to re-edit it in phone AR. Twist: card order also changes the soundtrack.
works.exercise_zh: 把一段 20 秒的场景切成 12 个镜头，每个镜头对应一张打印的图像标记，让同学在手机 AR 中通过排列卡片重新剪辑。变体：卡片顺序也会改变配乐。

video.video_title: 52Card Psycho : demonstration video #1

works.title: A Cable Plays
works.description: With Damian Stewart: two performers pin yarn across a game board while an augmented video of the board reveals generative creatures emerging between the strings.
works.idea_zh: 两人在棋盘上拉毛线，增强画面里线与线之间生出新的生命。

video.video_title: A Cable Plays

works.technique: A camera over the board detects the yarn lines (likely via color thresholding and Hough line detection), and the resulting polygon regions spawn generative creatures in the augmented video.
works.exercise_zh: 俯拍一块钉板，两人轮流拉彩色毛线，用 p5.js 检测线条围出的区域，在区域里生出小生物；变体：把它做成对弈游戏，谁围出的区域里的生物吃掉对方谁赢。
works.description_zh: 与 Damian Stewart 合作：两位表演者在一块游戏棋盘上钉拉毛线，而棋盘的增强视频中，线与线之间会浮现出生成式的生物。
works.idea_en: Two people stretch yarn across a game board, and new life grows between the strings in the augmented image.
works.technique_zh: 棋盘上方的摄像头检测毛线（可能通过颜色阈值和霍夫直线检测），由此得到的多边形区域在增强视频中生成生成式生物。
works.exercise_en: Film a pegboard from above while two people take turns stretching colored yarn, use p5.js to detect the areas enclosed by the strings, and spawn small creatures inside them. Twist: turn it into a two-player game where whoever's creatures eat the other's wins.

works.title: AD INFINITUM
works.description: A tall outdoor wind sculpture whose looping stainless-steel forms rotate in the breeze, drawing an endless figure that shifts as you walk around it.
works.description_zh: 一座高大的户外风动雕塑，环形的不锈钢形体在微风中旋转，勾勒出一个随你绕行而变化的无尽图形。
works.idea_en: A form that reads differently from every angle rewards walking around it, the key behaviour to design for in world-anchored AR.
works.idea_zh: 从每个角度看都不一样的形体会奖励绕行，这是世界锚定 AR 最需要设计的行为。
works.technique: Balanced stainless-steel elements on low-friction bearings turn in light wind, and their curved loops overlap into changing silhouettes (year approximate).
works.technique_zh: 配重平衡的不锈钢构件装在低摩擦轴承上，微风即可转动，弯曲的环相互重叠形成不断变化的轮廓（年份为估计）。
works.exercise_en: Place a looping virtual sculpture in an open square with geospatial AR, rotating slowly on two axes. Twist: reveal a hidden symbol that only aligns from one walking position.
works.exercise_zh: 用地理空间 AR 在开阔广场上放一座环形虚拟雕塑，绕两根轴缓慢旋转。变体：藏一个只有走到特定位置才会对齐的符号。

video.video_title: Ralfonso - AD INFINITUM - Kinetic Sculpture

works.title: ARWeather
works.description: A person wearing an outdoor AR backpack walks freely through simulated rain, snow or hail falling over the real campus.
works.description_zh: 背着户外 AR 背包的人在真实校园里自由走动，身边落下模拟的雨、雪或冰雹。
works.idea_en: Change the weather around one person, wherever they walk.
works.idea_zh: 无论走到哪里，都改变某一个人身边的天气。
works.technique: Renders particle-based precipitation in world coordinates on the Tinmith wearable system, tracked by GPS and head orientation sensors.
works.technique_zh: 在 Tinmith 可穿戴系统上以世界坐标渲染基于粒子的降水效果，靠 GPS 和头部朝向传感器追踪。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR effect that makes snow fall only inside a two-metre circle around a placed anchor, then walk in and out of it outdoors. Twist: add sound that grows louder as you enter.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 效果，只在放置锚点周围两米的圆圈内下雪，然后在户外走进走出；变体：加入走进时逐渐变响的声音。

video.video_title: An Augmented Reality Weather System

works.title: ARf
works.description: An AR virtual pet dog on the original iPhone that lives on a marker and can be played with by touch.
works.idea_zh: 在初代iPhone上就能养一只AR虚拟狗。

video.video_title: ARf, an Augmented Reality Virtual Pet on the iPhone

works.technique: A fiducial marker is tracked by the iPhone camera to anchor an animated 3D dog, and touch input on the screen is raycast onto the dog to trigger petting and play behaviors.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 或 8th Wall 在桌面放一个虚拟宠物，实现点击抚摸、拖动喂食两种互动和三种情绪状态；变体：宠物会对你的真实环境做出反应（黑暗时睡觉、听到声音时抬头）。
works.description_zh: 运行在初代 iPhone 上的 AR 虚拟宠物狗，它住在一张标记上，玩家可以通过触摸和它玩耍。
works.idea_en: Raise an AR virtual dog on the very first iPhone.
works.technique_zh: iPhone 摄像头追踪基准标记，以此锚定一只带动画的 3D 小狗；屏幕上的触摸输入通过射线投射落到小狗身上，触发抚摸和玩耍行为。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation or 8th Wall to put a virtual pet on a table, with two interactions (tap to pet, drag to feed) and three emotional states. Twist: have the pet react to your real surroundings (sleeping when it is dark, looking up when it hears a sound).

works.title: ASTOR: spatial AR on an industrial lathe
works.description: A transparent holographic window mounted in front of a CNC lathe shows 3D overlays, such as forces on the cutting tool, directly on the machining process, without glasses.
works.description_zh: 安装在数控车床前的透明全息窗口，直接在加工过程上显示 3D 叠加信息（例如切削刀具受到的力），无需佩戴眼镜。
works.idea_en: Turn the machine's safety window into an autostereoscopic AR display.
works.idea_zh: 把机器的安全观察窗变成裸眼立体 AR 显示屏。
works.technique: A holographic optical element redirects projected images to each eye from a transparent screen, creating an optical see-through, glasses-free 3D overlay registered to the machine.
works.technique_zh: 全息光学元件把投影图像从透明屏幕分别导向双眼，形成与机器对齐的光学透视、免眼镜的 3D 叠加。
works.exercise_en: Mount a sheet of acrylic in front of a desk object at 45° and reflect a phone screen onto it to overlay live labels (Pepper's ghost). Twist: make a label follow a moving part.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌上物体前以 45° 放一块亚克力板，把手机屏幕反射到上面叠加实时标签（佩珀尔幻象）。变体：让标签跟随一个运动的部件。

video.video_title: Spatial Augmented Reality on Industrial CNC machines

works.title: Adapting for Distortion
works.description: Projected moving stripes cover the floor and the dancer, creating optical vibration so the body seems to warp and dissolve into the pattern.
works.description_zh: 移动的条纹投影覆盖地板和舞者，产生视觉震颤，身体看起来在扭曲并溶进图案里。
works.idea_en: Projecting a pattern onto a body changes how we read its shape, a direct lesson for AR body effects and camouflage.
works.idea_zh: 把图案投到身体上会改变我们对身体形状的判断，这是 AR 身体特效和伪装效果的直接一课。
works.technique: High-contrast line patterns are projected from above onto the stage and the performer, with image design by Bertrand Baudry and S20.
works.technique_zh: 高对比度的线条图案从上方投到舞台和表演者身上，影像设计由 Bertrand Baudry 与 S20 完成。
works.exercise_en: Use body segmentation in Lens Studio to texture a person with moving stripes that continue seamlessly into the background. Twist: the stripes bend around the body as if it were a lens.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 的人体分割给人贴上移动条纹，条纹无缝延续到背景里；变体：条纹绕着身体弯曲，好像身体是一块透镜。

video.video_title: Adapting for Distortion - excerpt

works.title: AntiVJ - Grote Kerk
works.description: A live audiovisual projection performance on the interior of the Grote Kerk cathedral in Breda.
works.idea_zh: 在大教堂内部进行的现场投影表演

video.video_title: AntiVJ - Grote Kerk

works.technique: Interior projection mapping with multiple projectors warped onto vaults and columns, performed live and synced to audio.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个有拱顶或柱子的室内空间（楼梯间、走廊），用投影现场配合一段声音演出，强调空间的高度；变体：整场只用一种颜色的光，让结构本身成为主角。
works.description_zh: 在布雷达大教堂（Grote Kerk）内部进行的一场现场视听投影表演。
works.idea_en: A live projection performance inside a cathedral.
works.technique_zh: 室内投影映射，多台投影仪经变形校正后投射到拱顶和立柱上，现场演出并与音频同步。
works.exercise_en: Choose an indoor space with vaults or columns (a stairwell, a corridor) and perform a projection live with a piece of sound, emphasizing the height of the space. Twist: use light of only one color for the whole piece so the structure itself becomes the star.

works.title: Audience
works.description: A field of small head-sized mirrors sits idle until a visitor enters; then they all turn to follow and 'look at' that person, so the viewer sees themselves reflected everywhere.
works.idea_zh: 一群镜子像观众一样同时转头盯着你看
works.technique: A camera tracks the chosen visitor's position and each motorised mirror computes the pan/tilt needed to face them.
works.exercise_zh: 用舵机+小镜子做3–5个“眼睛”，用摄像头人脸位置控制它们转向；变化：当有两个人时，镜子会“分成两派”各看一人。

video.video_title: RANDOM INTERNATIONAL | Audience

works.description_zh: 一片与人头差不多大小的小镜子静静待着，直到有观众走进来；这时它们会一齐转向、跟随并“注视”这个人，让观众在四面八方看见自己的倒影。
works.idea_en: A crowd of mirrors turns its heads in unison to stare at you like an audience.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪被选中观众的位置，每面电动镜子据此计算朝向对方所需的水平和俯仰角度。
works.exercise_en: Build three to five 'eyes' from servos and small mirrors, and use the face position from a camera to turn them. Twist: when two people are present, the mirrors 'split into two camps', each watching one person.

salient.why_en: A crowd of mirrors turns in unison to stare at you, so the visitor becomes the one being watched.
salient.why_zh: 一群镜子齐刷刷转向盯着你，观众变成了被观看的人。

works.title: Augmented Reality Puzzle
works.description: A physical-digital puzzle made with the tools behind 52 Card Psycho: shuffled marker cards each show a fragment of an image or clip, and the player has to arrange them until the picture comes together on screen.
works.description_zh: 一个用 52 Card Psycho 同一套工具做成的实体-数字拼图：打乱的标记卡片各显示图像或影片的一部分，玩家要不断排列它们，直到画面在屏幕上拼合完整。
works.idea_en: A jigsaw whose pieces are plain cards and whose picture only exists in AR.
works.idea_zh: 一个拼图，碎片是普通卡片，完整画面只存在于 AR 中。
works.technique: A Max/MSP 'puzzle maker' slices a clip into tiles assigned to ARTag markers, and the tracker renders each tile on its card so the correct layout reveals the image.
works.technique_zh: 用 Max/MSP 写的“拼图生成器”把一段影片切成小块并分配给各个 ARTag 标记，追踪器把每块渲染在对应卡片上，排对了画面就显现出来。
works.exercise_en: Split a photo into nine tiles, assign each to a printed image marker in an AR web app, and let groups race to rebuild the picture on a table. Twist: make the tiles video frames so the correct order also plays the clip.
works.exercise_zh: 把一张照片切成九块，在 AR 网页应用中分配给九个打印的图像标记，让小组比赛在桌上把画面拼回来；变体：让每块都是视频帧，排对顺序时影片就会播放起来。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Puzzle Preview

works.title: Augmented Space (The Hague City Hall)
works.description: Architectural projection on The Hague city hall that traces and animates the building's own structural lines.
works.idea_zh: 沿着建筑自身结构线投影，让市政厅立面'活'过来

video.video_title: Pablo Valbuena: Augmented space (1) @ Today's Art 2008, The Hague

works.technique: Architectural projection mapping from a surveyed facade model: content is authored along the building's own structural lines so animation traces, splits and redraws the real geometry.
works.exercise_zh: 拍下教室一面墙或门框的正面照片，描出所有结构线，在投影中让这些线逐条亮起、错位、再复原；变体：只动一条线，其他全部静止，看最小改变能带来多大感知差异。
works.description_zh: 在海牙市政厅上进行的建筑投影，沿着建筑自身的结构线描绘并让它们动起来。
works.idea_en: Project along a building's own structural lines to bring a city hall facade to life.
works.technique_zh: 基于实测立面模型的建筑投影映射：内容沿着建筑自身的结构线制作，让动画描摹、拆分并重绘真实的几何形体。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a classroom wall or door frame head-on, trace all its structural lines, and in the projection make the lines light up one by one, shift out of place and return. Twist: move only one line and keep everything else still, to see how much perception a minimal change can shift.

works.title: BOOMBOX
works.description: A giant stack of cubes behind a DJ becomes a mapped sculpture whose faces light up, shift and pulse with the music across a worldwide tour of electronic parties.
