works.description_zh: DJ 身后巨大的立方体堆叠成为一座投影雕塑，在全球巡演的电子派对上，各个面随音乐亮起、移动、脉动。
works.idea_en: A stage made of simple boxes becomes a musical instrument of light.
works.idea_zh: 用简单箱体搭成的舞台，变成一件光的乐器。
works.technique: Pre-built cube geometry is mapped with projectors and animated live, with visuals triggered and modulated by the music.
works.technique_zh: 预先搭建的立方体结构由投影机覆盖映射，影像在现场实时演奏，并由音乐触发和调制。
works.exercise_en: Stack six cardboard boxes, map each face in MadMapper or a web mapper, and make a beat-reactive light show where each box is one drum sound. Twist: let the audience rearrange the boxes between songs.
works.exercise_zh: 堆六个纸箱，在 MadMapper 或网页映射工具里映射每个面，做一场随节拍变化的灯光秀，每个箱子对应一种鼓声；变体：每首歌之间让观众重新摆放箱子。

video.video_title: BOOMBOX - 1024 architecture

works.title: Base 8
works.description: A reflection through glass makes a world float in mid-air; as visitors reach in, geometric structures grow between their fingers and out of their hands.
works.idea_zh: 手伸进玻璃反射出的空中世界，几何结构从指缝间长出来。

video.video_title: Base 8

works.technique: A Pepper's ghost setup reflects a screen in angled glass to float graphics in a real volume, while a camera tracks hand positions behind the glass to grow geometry between the fingers.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机加一片斜 45 度的透明亚克力做 Pepper's ghost 小盒子，再用 MediaPipe Hands 让几何结构在手指之间生长；变体：结构只在两只手（可以是两个人的）靠近时才连接起来。
works.description_zh: 玻璃中的反射让一个世界悬浮在半空中；当观众把手伸进去，几何结构会在他们的指缝之间、从他们的手中生长出来。
works.idea_en: Reach into a world floating in a glass reflection, and geometry grows out from between your fingers.
works.technique_zh: 采用佩珀尔幻象（Pepper's ghost）装置，用斜放的玻璃反射屏幕，让图形悬浮在真实空间中；同时摄像头追踪玻璃后面的手部位置，在手指之间生成几何结构。
works.exercise_en: Build a small Pepper's ghost box from a phone and a sheet of clear acrylic angled at 45 degrees, then use MediaPipe Hands to grow geometry between your fingers. Twist: the structures only connect when two hands (possibly from two people) come close.

works.title: Body Paint
works.description: Visitors dance in front of a wall-sized projection and their movements splash and smear fluid paint in real time, turning the body into a brush.
works.idea_zh: 身体就是画笔：在投影墙前舞动，颜料随动作飞溅流淌。

video.video_title: "Body Paint" Installation at "Clicks or Mortar", March 2009

works.technique: Optical flow from a camera provides velocity vectors that inject dye and force into a GPU 2D fluid simulation (ofxMSAFluid), projected at wall scale.
works.exercise_zh: 用 TouchDesigner 或 p5.js 的光流把身体动作变成往流体里注入颜料的力，投到墙上当画布；变体：每个人穿一种颜色的衣服决定颜料颜色，最后合拍一张“全班身体画”。
works.description_zh: 观众在一整面墙大小的投影前舞动，他们的动作实时泼洒、涂抹出流动的颜料，身体就此成为画笔。
works.idea_en: Your body is the brush: dance in front of a projected wall and paint splashes and flows with your moves.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头的光流提供速度向量，把颜料和力注入 GPU 上的二维流体模拟（ofxMSAFluid），并以整面墙的尺度投影出来。
works.exercise_en: Use optical flow in TouchDesigner or p5.js to turn body movement into forces that inject paint into a fluid, and project it on a wall as a canvas. Twist: the color each person wears decides their paint color, and the class finishes with one group 'body painting'.

works.title: BragFish
works.description: A competitive handheld AR fishing game played around a shared physical pond board, exploring social play with co-located phones.
works.idea_zh: 围着一张实体'池塘'比赛钓鱼的多人手持AR游戏。

video.video_title: BragFish: a competitive handheld Augmented Reality game

works.technique: Each handheld tracks a shared printed pond board with markers, rendering fish and lures registered to it, and a networked game state makes players compete co-located around the same physical board.
works.exercise_zh: 把一张打印的池塘图作为共同图像目标，做一个 2–3 人手机 AR 钓鱼游戏，每人只能看到自己的鱼竿和共同的鱼；变体：加入一个只在物理上靠近对手时才能用的“偷鱼”机制。
works.description_zh: 一款围绕共享实体池塘棋盘进行的竞技类手持 AR 钓鱼游戏，探索多部手机在同一现场时的社交游戏方式。
works.idea_en: A multiplayer handheld AR game where players compete at fishing around a physical 'pond'.
works.technique_zh: 每台手持设备都通过标记追踪同一张打印的池塘棋盘，渲染与之配准的鱼和鱼饵；联网的游戏状态让玩家们在同一块实体棋盘周围同场竞技。
works.exercise_en: Use a printed pond picture as a shared image target and make a two- or three-player phone AR fishing game where each person sees only their own rod plus the shared fish. Twist: add a 'steal a fish' move that only works when you are physically close to an opponent.

works.title: Cloud
works.description: A 5-metre cloud-shaped sculpture at Heathrow Terminal 5 is covered in 4,638 flip-dots that flip between silver and black, sending ripples and patterns across its skin with a soft clicking sound.
works.description_zh: 希思罗机场 5 号航站楼中一座 5 米长的云形雕塑，表面覆盖 4638 个翻片，在银色与黑色之间翻转，发出轻微的咔嗒声，在表皮上荡起波纹和图案。
works.idea_en: A display wrapped around a sculptural form reads as a living skin — AR content feels more physical when it follows the curvature of a real object.
works.idea_zh: 包裹在雕塑形体上的显示面读起来像一层活的皮肤——当 AR 内容贴合真实物体的曲面时，会显得更有实体感。
works.technique: Electromagnetic flip-dots, each a disc with a black and a reflective side, are driven row by row so animations travel across the curved surface.
works.technique_zh: 电磁翻片一面黑、一面反光，按行驱动，使动画沿着弯曲表面流动。
works.exercise_en: Scan a real object (a chair, a sculpture) with LiDAR and cover its mesh in AR with thousands of tiny flipping tiles that ripple when you tap it. Twist: add a click sound per tile and let the ripple spread only as fast as sound would.
works.exercise_zh: 用 LiDAR 扫描一个真实物体（椅子或雕塑），在 AR 中给它的网格覆盖成千上万个会翻转的小方片，点击时泛起涟漪。变体：给每片加一个咔嗒声，并让涟漪以“声音速度”缓慢扩散。

video.video_title: Troika - 'Cloud' - digital sculpture for British Airways

works.title: Cows vs Aliens
works.description: A multiplayer handheld AR board game where players move around a tabletop map, making physical mobility and social interaction the core mechanic.
works.idea_zh: 多人围着桌子走动玩的AR棋盘游戏，走位本身就是玩法。

video.video_title: Cows Vs  Aliens Mobility and Social Interaction as Key Gameplay Element

works.technique: Each handheld device tracks the shared tabletop map with fiducial markers, so all players see the same registered game world, and players must physically move around the table to reach different areas.
works.exercise_zh: 用一张打印的 A3 地图作为图像目标，做一个 2 人手机 AR 桌游：必须走到桌子另一侧才能看到并点击某些目标；变体：让两人的视角互相遮挡，逼迫玩家移动身体交流。
works.description_zh: 一款多人手持 AR 桌游，玩家需要绕着桌面地图走动，身体移动和社交互动成为核心玩法。
works.idea_en: A multiplayer AR board game played by walking around a table, where moving yourself is the gameplay.
works.technique_zh: 每台手持设备都借助基准标记追踪共享的桌面地图，因此所有玩家看到的是同一个经过配准的游戏世界；玩家必须实际绕着桌子走动才能到达不同区域。
works.exercise_en: Use a printed A3 map as an image target and build a two-player phone AR board game where some targets can only be seen and tapped from the other side of the table. Twist: make the two players' views block each other, forcing them to move their bodies and talk.

works.title: Cybrid Landscape
works.description: A virtual 3D landscape represents a building's atrium; as people walk through the real space, their paths wear away the virtual terrain, leaving a visible history of movement over the day.
works.description_zh: 一片虚拟 3D 地形代表一栋建筑的中庭；人们在真实空间中行走时，走过的路径会磨蚀虚拟地形，留下一整天的移动痕迹。
works.idea_en: Footsteps in a real building erode a virtual landscape.
works.idea_zh: 真实建筑中的脚步，磨蚀着一片虚拟地形。
works.technique: Overhead cameras track people in the atrium, and each tracked position lowers the corresponding vertices of a 3D terrain mesh.
works.technique_zh: 顶部摄像头追踪中庭里的人，每个被追踪到的位置都会压低 3D 地形网格上对应的顶点。
works.exercise_en: Track classmates' positions in a room from above and let each step dig into a virtual sand terrain shown in AR on the floor. Twist: the terrain slowly heals, so only popular paths stay visible.
works.exercise_zh: 从上方追踪同学在房间里的位置，让每一步都在地面的 AR 虚拟沙地上挖出痕迹。变体：地形会慢慢恢复，只有常走的路径会留下来。

video.video_title: Cybrid Landscape

works.title: Digital Foam
works.description: A ball of conductive foam senses where and how hard it is squeezed, used as an input device for sculpting 3D shapes by pressing directly on a physical form.
works.description_zh: 一团导电泡沫能感知被挤压的位置和力度，被用作输入设备：直接按压实体形状来雕塑 3D 模型。
works.idea_en: Sculpt digital shape by squeezing a soft physical one.
works.idea_zh: 通过挤压柔软的实体来雕塑数字形状。
works.technique: Conductive foam sensors change resistance under compression, and an array of them across the surface reports a pressure map that deforms the matching virtual mesh.
works.technique_zh: 导电泡沫传感器受压时电阻变化，布满表面的一组传感器输出压力分布图，驱动对应虚拟网格变形。
works.exercise_en: Build a squeeze controller with a phone's pressure-sensitive touch or a DIY velostat sensor, and dent a 3D sphere in WebXR where you press. Twist: make the dents spring back slowly like memory foam.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机的压感触控或自制 velostat 压力传感器做一个“挤压控制器”，在 WebXR 里按哪儿就让 3D 球体在哪儿凹陷。变体：让凹陷像记忆海绵一样慢慢回弹。

video.video_title: DigitalFoamSummary.mpg

works.title: Drawing from Life
works.description: Museum visitors see a life-size projected image of themselves composed entirely of the letters A, C, G and T, the four bases of DNA.
works.idea_zh: 把你的实时镜像写成由DNA四个字母组成的人像
works.technique: Live video is sampled on a grid and each cell is rendered as one of four letters whose size or brightness follows the underlying pixel value (ASCII-art style).
works.exercise_zh: 用p5.js把摄像头画面做成ASCII字符人像，只用A、C、G、T四个字母；变化：换成与主题相关的一个词，让字母随声音大小抖动。

video.video_title: Camille Utterback - Drawing from Life

works.description_zh: 博物馆观众会看到一幅真人大小的自己的投影，整个人像完全由 A、C、G、T 这四个字母组成，也就是 DNA 的四种碱基。
works.idea_en: Write your live mirror image as a portrait made from the four letters of DNA.
works.technique_zh: 对实时视频按网格采样，每个单元格渲染为四个字母之一，字母的大小或亮度随对应像素值变化（类似 ASCII 字符画）。
works.exercise_en: Use p5.js to turn the camera image into an ASCII-character portrait using only the letters A, C, G and T. Twist: switch to a word related to your theme and make the letters jitter with the volume of sound.

works.title: Evolution and Theory
works.description: Hundreds of small aluminium figures inspired by Victorian science illustrations (hybrids of humans, animals and machines) stand in a field of sand, installed piece by piece in a time-lapse.
works.description_zh: 数百个受维多利亚时代科学插图启发的铝制小人偶（人、动物与机器的混合体）立在一片沙地中，延时影像记录了它们被逐个安装的过程。
works.idea_en: A crowd of tiny strange figures on sand becomes a world to lean over and explore, like a tabletop AR diorama.
works.idea_zh: 沙地上一群奇异的小人成了一个可以俯身探索的世界，就像桌面 AR 微缩场景。
works.technique: Figures are cut from aluminium sheet, hand-painted and stood in a bed of sand in a loose grid.
works.technique_zh: 人偶由铝板切割、手工上色，以松散的网格插在沙床上。
works.exercise_en: Place 200 tiny AR figures made from public-domain engravings on a table or sandbox and let users walk around them with a phone. Twist: figures slowly swap body parts with their neighbours over time.
works.exercise_zh: 用公共领域的版画人物制作 200 个小型 AR 人偶，放在桌面或沙盘上，让用户拿着手机绕行观看；变体：随着时间推移，人偶会慢慢与邻居交换身体部件。

video.video_title: Zadok Ben-David "Evolution and Theory" installation timelapse

works.title: Eye Movement
works.description: Robert Wechsler sits in close-up while his eye movements and blinks play piano notes and melodies and, in the piece Oklo, switch the stage lights.
works.description_zh: Robert Wechsler 坐在特写镜头前，眼球转动和眨眼会弹出钢琴音和旋律，在作品 Oklo 中还会切换舞台灯光。
works.idea_en: Turn the smallest, fastest movement of the body, the eyes, into an instrument.
works.idea_zh: 把身体最小、最快的动作——眼睛——变成乐器。
works.technique: A camera close on the face tracks changes in the eye region (and, in other versions, electrodes pick up eye muscle signals), and each change triggers a sound or a lighting cue; year and exact setup are likely.
works.technique_zh: 近距离对准面部的摄像机追踪眼部区域的变化（在其他版本中也用电极拾取眼部肌肉信号），每一次变化触发一个声音或灯光指令；年份和具体装置为推测。
works.exercise_en: Use a face-tracking library (MediaPipe Face Mesh) to detect blinks and gaze direction and map them to notes on a scale and to the colour of a lamp. Twist: make a piece that only works with your eyes closed, playing the moment you open them.
works.exercise_zh: 用人脸追踪库（MediaPipe Face Mesh）检测眨眼和视线方向，把它们映射为音阶上的音符和一盏灯的颜色；变体：做一个闭着眼才能演奏的作品，只在睁眼的一刻发声。

video.video_title: Eye Movement

works.title: Falling Girl (with Annie Loui)
works.description: An immersive narrative projection of a girl falling slowly past skyscraper windows; cameras place the live audience inside the apartments she passes as she ages during the fall.
works.idea_zh: 观众被实时放进大楼窗户里，成为坠落女孩一生中遇见的人
works.technique: Room cameras capture viewers and composite their live images into window regions of a pre-animated building while the scripted falling-girl animation plays in the centre.
works.exercise_zh: 画一栋有很多窗户的楼，把摄像头拍到的同学实时抠像贴进窗户里，再让一个角色从上往下经过；变化：角色经过谁的窗户就对谁做一个反应动作。

video.video_title: Falling Girl by Scott Snibbe and Annie Loui

works.description_zh: 一件沉浸式叙事投影：一个女孩缓缓坠落，经过摩天大楼的一扇扇窗户；摄像头把现场观众放进她经过的公寓里，而她在坠落中逐渐老去。
works.idea_en: Visitors are placed live into a building's windows and become the people a falling girl meets over her life.
works.technique_zh: 房间内的摄像头拍摄观众，把他们的实时影像合成到一栋预制动画大楼的窗户区域中，同时画面中央播放预先设定好的女孩坠落动画。
works.exercise_en: Draw a building with many windows, key classmates out of the camera feed live and place them in the windows, then have a character pass from top to bottom. Twist: the character makes a reaction gesture toward whoever's window it passes.

works.title: Footprints of History
works.description: During the Beijing 2008 Olympic opening, 29 giant footprints made of fireworks stepped one after another along the city's central axis toward the National Stadium.
works.description_zh: 2008 年北京奥运会开幕式上，29 个由烟花组成的巨大脚印沿着城市中轴线一步步走向国家体育场。
works.idea_en: A repeated mark that moves across a city makes an invisible giant walk; AR can use a sequence of simple anchored marks to suggest a presence far larger than the screen.
works.idea_zh: 一个在城市上空不断重复、逐步前进的记号，就能让一个看不见的巨人行走起来；AR 也可以用一串简单的锚定记号，暗示一个比屏幕大得多的存在。
works.technique: Fireworks shaped as footprints were fired from positions spaced along the axis and timed in sequence, so each step appears after the previous one.
works.technique_zh: 脚印形状的烟花从中轴线上等距分布的发射点按时序点燃，每一步都紧接在上一步之后出现。
works.exercise_en: Place a trail of glowing footprints across your campus with geospatial anchors, each one lighting up two seconds after the last so the invisible walker leads viewers to a meeting point. Twist: make the footprints change size so the walker seems to grow as it approaches.
works.exercise_zh: 用地理空间锚点在校园里摆出一串发光的脚印，每个脚印比前一个晚两秒亮起，让看不见的行者把观众带到一个集合点。变体：让脚印逐渐变大，看起来行者越走越近、越走越大。

video.video_title: fireworks of 2008 beijing olympics china super wonderful surpraising footprints

salient.why_en: Giant footprints of fireworks walk one by one across the city toward the stadium.
salient.why_zh: 烟花组成的巨大脚印一步一步走过城市，走向体育场。

works.title: For the Guggenheim
works.description: In her 2008 exhibition at the Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum in New York, a long LED text band runs up the museum's spiral ramp, so words race around the rotunda as visitors walk. Filmed by VernissageTV (museum-show documentation, not the artist's upload).
works.description_zh: 2008 年在纽约古根海姆博物馆的展览中，一条长长的 LED 文字带沿着博物馆的螺旋坡道向上延伸，观众行走时，文字在圆厅里环绕飞驰。视频由 VernissageTV 拍摄（展览记录，非艺术家本人上传）。
works.idea_en: Text that follows the architecture's path turns reading into walking; AR captions and messages can be laid along a route instead of floating in front of the face.
works.idea_zh: 沿着建筑路径流动的文字，把阅读变成了行走；AR 字幕和信息可以沿着路线铺开，而不是漂浮在脸前。
works.technique: A custom continuous LED sign is installed along the parapet of the Guggenheim ramp and programmed with scrolling texts.
works.technique_zh: 沿古根海姆坡道的矮墙安装一条定制的连续 LED 屏，并编程滚动文字。
works.exercise_en: Lay an AR text ribbon along a real staircase or corridor with Lens Studio or 8th Wall so it scrolls as you walk up. Twist: the text only advances while the viewer is moving.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 8th Wall 沿一段真实楼梯或走廊铺一条 AR 文字带，让它随你向上走而滚动；变体：只有观众在移动时文字才会前进。

video.video_title: VTV Classics (r3): Jenny Holzer: For the Guggenheim (2008)

works.title: Fractal Flowers
works.description: A virtual garden of generative fractal flowers grows, blooms and dies on a projection, bending and reacting as visitors move in front of it.
works.idea_zh: 一片会因你靠近而弯曲、绽放的分形花园
works.technique: L-system-like generative plant growth runs in real time and a camera tracks visitors' positions to bend or trigger blooms near them.
works.exercise_zh: 在p5.js里写一个递归分形花，摄像头检测到人靠近时花朵朝人弯曲；变化：每个观众的衣服颜色成为新长出花的颜色。

video.video_title: Miguel Chevalier - Fractal Flowers 2023

works.description_zh: 一座由生成式分形花朵组成的虚拟花园在投影中生长、绽放和凋零，当观众在它面前移动时，花朵会弯曲并作出反应。
works.idea_en: A fractal garden that bends and blooms as you come close.
works.technique_zh: 实时运行类似 L 系统的生成式植物生长算法，摄像头追踪观众的位置，让附近的花朵弯曲或开放。
works.exercise_en: Write a recursive fractal flower in p5.js and make the flowers bend toward a person when the camera detects them approaching. Twist: the color of each visitor's clothing becomes the color of the new flowers.

works.title: Generative Graffiti
works.description: With Graffiti Research Lab: particles spawn from the lit windows of the Maritime Hotel in New York, attracted to each other and repelled by dark windows, projected back onto the building.
works.idea_zh: 从酒店亮着灯的窗户里生长出粒子涂鸦，再投回建筑立面。

video.video_title: Generative Graffiti

works.technique: A camera image of the facade is thresholded to find lit windows, which act as particle emitters and attractors while dark windows act as repellers, projected back via camera-projector registration.
works.exercise_zh: 拍一张晚上教学楼的照片，找出亮着的窗户当粒子源，暗窗做排斥点，把动画投回同一面墙或模型上；变体：粒子代表楼里的人的“熬夜气息”，窗户熄灭后粒子会迁移。
works.description_zh: 与 Graffiti Research Lab 合作：粒子从纽约 Maritime Hotel 亮着灯的窗户里诞生，彼此吸引、被暗着的窗户排斥，再被投影回这栋建筑上。
works.idea_en: Particle graffiti grows out of a hotel's lit windows and is projected back onto the facade.
works.technique_zh: 对立面的摄像头画面做阈值处理找出亮着的窗户，把它们作为粒子发射源和吸引点，暗窗则作为排斥点，最后通过相机-投影仪配准投回建筑上。
works.exercise_en: Take a night photo of a teaching building, use the lit windows as particle sources and the dark ones as repellers, and project the animation back onto the same wall or a model. Twist: the particles stand for the 'late-night energy' of the people inside, and they migrate when a window goes dark.

works.title: Kinetic Sculpture – The Shape of Things to Come
works.description: 714 metal spheres hang on thin steel wires in the BMW Museum and rise and fall together, morphing from abstract waves into the outlines of car bodies.
works.description_zh: 宝马博物馆中，714 个金属球挂在细钢丝上同步升降，从抽象的波浪逐渐变形为汽车车身的轮廓。
works.idea_en: Hundreds of points, each moving only up and down, can draw any 3D shape — the physical ancestor of AR point clouds and voxel morphs.
works.idea_zh: 数百个只会上下移动的点就能画出任何三维形状——这正是 AR 点云和体素变形的实体祖先。
works.technique: Each sphere hangs from a computer-controlled stepper motor; software samples a 3D shape at every sphere's x/y position and sets its height.
works.technique_zh: 每个金属球由一台计算机控制的步进电机吊起；软件在每个球的平面位置对三维形状取样，决定它的高度。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR or AR Foundation grid of 20×20 floating spheres above a table that morph between a wave and a scanned object's height map. Twist: let the user's phone position become the peak of the wave.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌面上方用 WebXR 或 AR Foundation 搭一个 20×20 的悬浮小球阵列，让它在波浪和一个扫描物体的高度图之间变形。变体：让用户手机的位置成为波峰。

video.video_title: Kinetic Sculpture – The Shape of Things to Come, 2008

works.title: LUMAR: hybrid 2D/3D mobile AR
works.description: Pointing a phone at a printed apartment floor plan pops up a 3D model of the apartment on the phone, while the paper remains the overview: three layers of information from one printout.
works.description_zh: 把手机对准一张打印的户型图，手机上就会弹出公寓的 3D 模型，而纸张本身仍是总览图：一张打印稿提供三层信息。
works.idea_en: Let paper and phone work together: the static print gives context, the phone adds depth.
works.idea_zh: 让纸和手机协作：静态打印提供整体语境，手机补充深度。
works.technique: 2D tracking of the phone over the display surface is combined with 3D marker-based pose estimation, switching the phone view between an overlay and a 3D viewport.
works.technique_zh: 把手机在显示表面上的 2D 追踪与基于标记的 3D 姿态估计结合起来，让手机画面在叠加层和 3D 视窗之间切换。
works.exercise_en: Print a campus map and use image tracking so each building pops up in 3D when the phone hovers over it. Twist: tilting the phone flattens the model back into the map.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一张校园地图，用图像追踪让手机悬停在某栋楼上时它以 3D 形式弹出。变体：倾斜手机时模型重新压扁回地图里。

video.video_title: Hybrid Techniques for 2D and 3D Mobile Augmented Reality

works.title: Le Moulin à Images (The Image Mill)
works.description: For Québec City's 400th anniversary, a 40-minute projection on the Bunge grain silos in the Old Port tells the city's history across a surface about 600 metres long, then one of the largest architectural projections ever made.
works.description_zh: 为魁北克城建城 400 周年，一场 40 分钟的投影在老港的 Bunge 粮仓上讲述城市历史，投影面长约 600 米，是当时规模最大的建筑投影之一。
works.idea_en: An industrial ruin becomes a history book when you project the city's past onto it; site-specific AR can turn any large surface into a storytelling wall.
works.idea_zh: 把城市的过去投到一座工业遗迹上，它就变成了一本历史书；场地型 AR 能把任何大表面变成讲故事的墙。
works.technique: A bank of projectors covers the silo facade, with images and sound synchronised and broadcast to the audience across the harbour.
works.technique_zh: 一排投影机覆盖整面粮仓立面，影像与声音同步，传送给港口对岸的观众。
works.exercise_en: Choose the longest wall you can find, split its length into four decades, and anchor AR photos and sound for each decade along it so walking the wall walks through time. Twist: speed up the timeline when the viewer runs.
works.exercise_zh: 找一面尽可能长的墙，把长度分成四个年代，在墙上依次锚定每个年代的 AR 照片和声音，沿墙行走就是穿越时间；变体：观众跑起来时，时间线也加速。

video.video_title: Bande-annonce Le Moulin à Images / The Image Mill Trailer

works.title: Light Graffiti in Cologne (Tracks feature)
works.description: Arte's Tracks follows Lichtfaktor writing glowing letters and figures on Cologne streets with flashlights during long exposures, alongside other new graffiti forms.
works.description_zh: Arte 电视台的 Tracks 节目跟拍 Lichtfaktor 在科隆街头用手电在长曝光中写出发光的字母和人形，也介绍了其他新的涂鸦形式。
works.idea_en: Graffiti made of light leaves no mark on the wall; AR street art can be just as temporary and still tied to a specific corner.
works.idea_zh: 用光做的涂鸦不会在墙上留下痕迹；AR 街头艺术也可以一样短暂，却仍然绑定在某个具体的街角。
works.technique: Several painters draw with handheld LEDs in front of a camera on a tripod set to a long exposure.
works.technique_zh: 几位画手在三脚架上长曝光的相机前，用手持 LED 灯作画。
works.exercise_en: Make a geo-anchored light-graffiti app with persistent anchors (ARCore Geospatial or Niantic Lightship) where a stroke drawn in the air stays at that street corner for others to find. Twist: each tag fades a little every time someone views it.
works.exercise_zh: 用持久锚点（ARCore Geospatial 或 Niantic Lightship）做一个带地理锚定的光涂鸦应用，在空中画下的笔画会留在那个街角等别人发现；变体：每被看一次，涂鸦就变淡一点。

video.video_title: LICHTFAKTOR - Light Art Collective at TRACKS

works.title: LightSense: mixed-reality phone over a display
works.description: Holding a phone over a backlit Stockholm subway map shows context-sensitive information for the spot under it, turning the map into a lookup surface.
works.description_zh: 把手机放在背光的斯德哥尔摩地铁图上方，手机就会显示下方位置的相关信息，让地图变成一个可查询的表面。
works.idea_en: The phone's own light becomes its tracking system, so the map needs no markers.
works.idea_zh: 手机自身的光就是它的追踪系统，地图不需要任何标记。
works.technique: The phone's LED is tracked by a camera behind the translucent map, giving its position so the phone can show the matching content.
works.technique_zh: 半透明地图后面的摄像头追踪手机的 LED，得出手机位置，再让手机显示相应的内容。
works.exercise_en: Put a webcam under a glass table with a paper map on it and track a phone flashlight from below to trigger content on the phone. Twist: use two phones and show the route between them.
works.exercise_zh: 在玻璃桌下放一个网络摄像头，桌面放一张纸质地图，从下方追踪手机闪光灯的位置来触发手机上的内容。变体：用两部手机，并显示它们之间的路线。

video.video_title: Mixed Reality Mobile Phones through Environmental Sensing

works.title: Living-Room Dancers
works.description: A choreographic city walk where the audience, with binoculars and MP3 players, watches amateur dancers (tap, tango, pole, electro) performing in private apartments seen through their windows.
works.description_zh: 一场编舞式城市漫步：观众拿着望远镜和 MP3 播放器，透过窗户观看在私人公寓里跳舞的业余舞者（踢踏、探戈、钢管、电音舞等）。
works.idea_en: Turn a street of windows into a stage, with the soundtrack in each viewer's ears.
works.idea_zh: 把一整条街的窗户变成舞台，配乐只在每位观众的耳中响起。
works.technique: Low-tech augmentation: timed audio tracks on personal players are synchronised with live dancers in lit windows along a guided route.
works.technique_zh: 低技术的现实增强：个人播放器中的定时音轨与沿导览路线亮灯窗户里的现场舞者同步。
works.exercise_en: Map a short walking route, place a friend dancing in a visible window, and give walkers a geotagged audio track in a web app that starts when they arrive. Twist: the audio describes a dance that is not what they see.
works.exercise_zh: 规划一条短的步行路线，安排一位朋友在看得见的窗边跳舞，用网页 App 给行人一段地理定位音轨，到达时自动播放；变体：音轨描述的舞蹈和他们看到的并不一样。

video.video_title: Cie Nicole Seiler - Living-Room Dancers, Barcelone

works.title: Mirrors Mirror
works.description: 768 small polished steel mirrors tilt so each reflects a lighter or darker part of the room, composing the viewer's image out of reflections of the space.
works.idea_zh: 用无数小镜子反射房间的明暗，拼出你的样子
works.technique: A camera image controls motors that aim each steel tile toward bright or dark areas of the surrounding room.
works.exercise_zh: 用几块小镜片装在舵机上，让它们把窗外亮光或暗墙反射到观众眼中形成图案；变化：用激光笔验证每块镜片的反射方向。

video.video_title: "Mirrors Mirror" (2008) by Daniel Rozin

works.description_zh: 768 块抛光的小钢镜各自倾斜，分别反射房间里较亮或较暗的部分，用空间本身的反射拼出观众的影像。
works.idea_en: Countless small mirrors reflect the room's light and dark to piece together your image.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头画面控制电机，把每块钢片对准周围房间里较亮或较暗的区域。
works.exercise_en: Mount a few small mirror pieces on servos and make them reflect bright light from a window or a dark wall into the viewer's eyes to form a pattern. Twist: use a laser pointer to check each mirror's reflection direction.

works.title: Mortal Engine (Chunky Move)
works.description: A full-length piece for six dancers on a steep, dark stage where projections, lasers and sound respond to their movement, turning bodies into shifting, shimmering shapes that appear and dissolve.
works.description_zh: 六位舞者在陡峭而黑暗的斜台上演出的完整作品，投影、激光和声音随他们的动作响应，把身体变成不断变化、闪烁、时隐时现的形体。
works.idea_en: Darkness as the default, with the body only existing where the computer chooses to light it.
works.idea_zh: 默认一片黑暗，身体只在计算机选择照亮的地方存在。
works.technique: Infrared tracking of the dancers drives a projection-based lighting system that paints only their silhouettes and extends them with graphics, combined with Robin Fox's lasers and Ben Frost's reactive score.
works.technique_zh: 对舞者进行红外追踪，驱动以投影作为灯光的系统，只照亮他们的剪影并用图形延伸出去，结合 Robin Fox 的激光和 Ben Frost 的响应式配乐。
works.exercise_en: In a dark room, use a projector as the only light and a webcam silhouette mask so light falls only on the performer. Twist: make the light expand into the empty space whenever the performer stops moving.
works.exercise_zh: 在暗室里把投影仪当成唯一光源，用摄像头剪影遮罩让光只落在表演者身上；变体：表演者一停止运动，光就向空处扩散。

video.video_title: Mortal Engine by Chunky Move

works.title: Multi-Sequential Poetry
works.description: A York University AR Lab piece based on Raymond Queneau's and Christian Bök's combinatorial poems: a visitor holds a tracked cube in a room, and poem lines and media clips appear on it as they enter different zones.
works.description_zh: 约克大学 AR 实验室的作品，取材于 Raymond Queneau 和 Christian Bök 的组合诗：访客在房间里手持一个被追踪的立方体，走进不同区域时，诗句和媒体片段就出现在立方体上。
works.idea_en: Walk through a room to assemble a poem that never reads the same way twice.
works.idea_zh: 在房间里走动来拼出一首每次读都不一样的诗。
works.technique: A tracker combining sonic and gyroscopic positioning locates the user, and the Designer's Augmented Reality Toolkit (DART) triggers text and media clips on the tracked cube per zone.
works.technique_zh: 结合声学与陀螺仪定位的追踪器确定用户位置，Designer's Augmented Reality Toolkit（DART）按区域在被追踪的立方体上触发文字和媒体片段。
works.exercise_en: Print a cube with six image markers, and in an AR web app show a different line from a list of poem fragments on each face depending on which part of the room the phone is in. Twist: two readers with two cubes must stand together to complete a stanza.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一个六面都是图像标记的立方体，在 AR 网页应用中，根据手机所在房间区域，在每一面显示诗句片段列表中的不同一行；变体：两位读者各拿一个立方体，必须站在一起才能凑齐一节诗。

video.video_title: Multi-Sequential Poetry

works.title: Multiverse
works.description: In the underground walkway between two buildings of the National Gallery of Art in Washington, about 41,000 LEDs run along the ceiling and walls, sending pulses of light that race past people on the moving walkway.
works.description_zh: 在华盛顿国家美术馆两栋建筑之间的地下通道里，约 41,000 盏 LED 沿天花板和墙面排列，发出的光脉冲从移动步道上的人身边掠过。
works.idea_en: Light moving faster or slower than the viewer changes the sense of speed; AR motion cues in a corridor can make people feel they are accelerating or floating.
works.idea_zh: 比观者快或慢的光改变速度感；走廊中的 AR 运动线索可以让人觉得自己在加速或漂浮。
works.technique: Programmable LED strips run in channels along the tunnel, and custom sequencing software produces random, never-repeating light movements.
works.technique_zh: 可编程 LED 灯带沿隧道的凹槽铺设，定制的编排软件产生随机、不重复的光运动。
works.exercise_en: Line a real corridor with virtual light strips in AR Foundation that move in or against the user's walking direction at speeds tied to their pace. Twist: make the lights race ahead to guide a newcomer to a room.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 里用虚拟灯带铺满一条真实走廊，灯光顺着或逆着用户的行走方向移动，速度与步速挂钩。变体：让灯光跑在前面，把新来的人引到某个房间。

video.video_title: Multiverse, 2008, Leo Villareal, National Gallery of Art, Washington DC

works.title: Natural Feature Tracking at 30Hz on a Mobile Phone
works.description: The first real-time 6DOF tracking of ordinary printed images on a mobile phone, using modified SIFT and Ferns, so AR content can sit on any poster or book.
works.idea_zh: 第一次在手机上实时追踪普通图片，任何海报都能变成AR舞台。

video.video_title: Natural Feature Tracking at 30Hz on a Mobile Phone

works.technique: Keypoints detected in the camera frame are matched to a pre-trained database of the target image using simplified SIFT descriptors and Ferns classifiers, and the resulting correspondences give a robust 6DOF pose that is then refined by frame-to-frame patch tracking.
works.exercise_zh: 用 OpenCV（Python 或 OpenCV.js）实现 ORB 特征匹配 + 单应性估计，把一张图片贴到手机摄像头中的海报上；变体：测试哪种海报图案最难追踪，并设计一张“追踪友好”的海报。
works.description_zh: 首次在手机上实现对普通印刷图像的实时 6DOF 追踪，采用改进的 SIFT 和 Ferns 算法，让 AR 内容可以附着在任何海报或书本上。
works.idea_en: The first live tracking of ordinary pictures on a phone, turning any poster into an AR stage.
works.technique_zh: 在相机画面中检测关键点，用简化的 SIFT 描述子和 Ferns 分类器与预先训练好的目标图像数据库进行匹配，得到的对应关系给出稳健的 6DOF 位姿，再通过帧间图像块追踪加以精化。
works.exercise_en: Implement ORB feature matching plus homography estimation with OpenCV (Python or OpenCV.js) to paste an image onto a poster in the phone camera view. Twist: test which poster patterns are hardest to track, and design a 'tracking-friendly' poster.

works.title: Nine Inch Nails: Lights in the Sky
works.description: For Nine Inch Nails' 2008 tour, layered transparent LED screens and a projection floor surrounded the band; Trent Reznor could walk behind a wall of static and 'part' it with his body, or be framed inside glowing grids. The making-of shows how the interactive visuals were built with the band's team.
works.description_zh: 为九寸钉乐队 2008 年巡演打造的舞台，多层透明 LED 屏和投影地面包围着乐队；Trent Reznor 可以走到一面雪花噪点墙后，用身体把它“拨开”，或被框在发光的网格中。这段幕后花絮展示了互动视觉如何与乐队团队一起完成。
works.idea_en: When images respond to where the performer stands, the screen stops being a backdrop and becomes a partner; body-tracked AR should react to people, not just sit behind them.
works.idea_zh: 当影像回应表演者站立的位置时，屏幕就不再是背景而是搭档；追踪身体的 AR 应该回应人，而不只是待在人的身后。
works.technique: Infrared cameras tracked the musicians' positions and fed real-time generative graphics shown on semi-transparent LED panels (likely custom tracking software).
works.technique_zh: 红外摄像头追踪音乐人的位置，把数据送入实时生成的图形，显示在半透明 LED 屏上（很可能是定制追踪软件）。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone's body segmentation (Lens Studio or MediaPipe) to put a layer of noise or static in front of a performer that clears only where their body is. Twist: the static also reacts to the loudness of the music.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机的人体分割（Lens Studio 或 MediaPipe）在表演者前面放一层噪点或雪花，只在其身体所在处被清开；变体：雪花同时随音乐的响度变化。

video.video_title: 01. The Moment Factory Making-Of - This One Is On Us presents "Another Version Of The Truth : Bonus"

works.title: Pour Your Body Out (7354 Cubic Meters)
works.description: MoMA's atrium becomes a projection room: huge, saturated videos of bodies, fruit and water fill the walls while visitors lie on a giant round sofa in the middle.
works.description_zh: 纽约现代艺术博物馆的中庭变成一间投影室：身体、水果和水的巨幅饱和影像铺满墙面，观众躺在中间一张巨大的圆形沙发上。
works.idea_en: Giving people a place to lie down changes how long they stay; AR experiences gain depth when they design the body's posture, not only the content.
works.idea_zh: 给人一个可以躺下的地方，就改变了他们停留的时长：AR 体验如果设计身体的姿态，而不只是内容，就会更有深度。
works.technique: Multiple high-lumen projectors blend edge to edge across the atrium walls, and a soft circular seat invites people to recline and look up and around.
works.technique_zh: 多台高亮度投影仪在中庭墙面上边缘融合，一张柔软的圆形座椅邀请人们躺下，向上、向四周看。
works.exercise_en: Make a lying-down AR piece: the user lies on the floor, points the phone at the ceiling, and a slow video world unfolds across the real ceiling plane. Twist: the video speed follows how still the phone is held.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个躺着看的 AR 作品：用户躺在地上，把手机对着天花板，一段缓慢的影像世界在真实天花板上展开。变体：影像的速度跟随手机拿得有多稳而变化。

video.video_title: Behind the Scenes with Pipilotti Rist, Pour Your Body Out (7354 Cubic Meters), MoMA

works.title: Prince Charles hologram (World Future Energy Summit)
works.description: A life-size 3D-looking image of the Prince of Wales delivers a speech on the environment to world leaders at the World Future Energy Summit in Abu Dhabi, then vanishes, saving him the flight.
works.description_zh: 威尔士亲王以真人大小、看起来立体的影像，在阿布扎比世界未来能源峰会上向各国领导人发表环境演讲，随后消失——省去了一趟飞行。
works.idea_en: A virtual presence can replace travel when it respects the stage conventions of a real speaker; this is the idea behind holographic telepresence in AR.
works.idea_zh: 只要遵守真人演讲的舞台惯例，虚拟的在场就可以取代出行；这正是 AR 全息远程临场背后的想法。
works.technique: Recorded video of the speaker is projected onto a large angled foil in front of the stage so he appears standing at the lectern (Pepper's ghost).
works.technique_zh: 演讲者的录像被投到舞台前一张大尺寸斜置薄膜上，让他看起来站在讲台后（佩珀尔幻象）。
works.exercise_en: Stage an AR 'remote guest lecture': record a two-minute talk, place the speaker at a real lectern with image anchors, and invite the class to listen. Twist: the speaker answers one pre-recorded question when a student raises a hand.
works.exercise_zh: 策划一场 AR“远程客座讲座”：录一段两分钟的演讲，用图像锚点把演讲者放在真实讲台后，让全班来听；变体：学生举手时，演讲者会回答一个预录好的问题。

video.video_title: Hologram of Prince Charles - Musion Holographic Projection

works.title: Projection for Chicago
works.description: As part of her PROTECT PROTECT exhibition at the MCA Chicago, Holzer projects the poems of Wisława Szymborska in huge scrolling letters onto building facades around the city, including the Lyric Opera House and Riverside Plaza. Documented in Art21's Extended Play series (not the artist's upload).
works.description_zh: 作为芝加哥当代艺术博物馆 PROTECT PROTECT 展的一部分，Holzer 把辛波斯卡（Wisława Szymborska）的诗以巨大的滚动字母投射到城市各处的建筑立面上，包括抒情歌剧院和 Riverside Plaza。视频来自 Art21 的 Extended Play 系列（非艺术家本人上传）。
works.idea_en: A poem projected slowly on a building makes a whole street read together; location-based AR text can create the same shared, public reading.
works.idea_zh: 一首慢慢投在建筑上的诗，让整条街的人一起阅读；基于位置的 AR 文字也能创造这种共享的公共阅读。
works.technique: High-powered xenon projectors throw slowly scrolling text onto facades, following the xenon projection method Holzer has used since the 1990s.
works.technique_zh: 用大功率氙灯投影机把缓慢滚动的文字投在立面上，沿用 Holzer 自 1990 年代起使用的氙灯投影方式。
works.exercise_en: Choose a short poem and place it as slow-scrolling AR text on a real building facade with geo or image anchors in 8th Wall. Twist: each viewer can add one line that everyone else sees.
works.exercise_zh: 选一首短诗，在 8th Wall 里用地理或图像锚点把它作为缓慢滚动的 AR 文字放在真实建筑立面上；变体：每位观众可以加一句，所有人都能看到。

video.video_title: Jenny Holzer: "Projection for Chicago" | Art21 "Extended Play"

works.title: Pulse Spiral
works.description: A spiral chandelier of hundreds of light bulbs hangs overhead; heartbeats read from visitors below travel up the spiral as flickering light.
works.description_zh: 一盏由数百颗灯泡组成的螺旋吊灯挂在头顶；从下方访客读取的心跳化作闪烁的光沿螺旋向上传递。
works.idea_en: A spiral turns a history of inputs into a readable shape, so the newest heartbeat sits at the start and the oldest fades at the top — a layout idea for AR timelines.
works.idea_zh: 螺旋把输入的历史变成可读的形状：最新的心跳在起点，最早的在顶端消失——这是 AR 时间线的一种布局思路。
works.technique: Heart-rate sensors feed a controller that dims bulbs to each pulse and shifts the recordings along the spiral as new ones arrive.
works.technique_zh: 心率传感器把数据送入控制器，按每个脉搏调节灯泡亮度，并在新记录到来时让旧记录沿螺旋移动。
works.exercise_en: Model an AR helix of glowing points above a table that records each participant's tap rhythm and shifts it upward as the next person taps. Twist: let people find their own earlier rhythm by looking up.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌子上方做一个 AR 螺旋光点结构，记录每位参与者的敲击节奏，并在下一个人敲击时把它向上推移。变体：让人们抬头就能找到自己早先的节奏。

video.video_title: Pulse Spiral

works.title: Quickies: Intelligent Sticky Notes
works.description: Handwritten paper sticky notes are captured with a digital pen and RFID so they become searchable, can remind you, and can be found again by the computer.
works.idea_zh: 让最普通的纸质便利贴拥有数字记忆，能被搜索、会主动提醒你。

video.video_title: QUICKIES, intelligent sticky notes

works.technique: A digital pen (Anoto-style dot-pattern paper) captures the handwriting of each note and an RFID tag in the note identifies it, so handwriting recognition turns paper notes into searchable, locatable records.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍摄手写便利贴，调用 OCR（如 Tesseract.js 或系统文本识别）存成可搜索列表，并给每张便利贴贴一个二维码或 NFC 标签，扫码即可跳到它的数字记录；变体：让便利贴在某个时间或地点“主动提醒”你。
works.description_zh: 借助数码笔和 RFID 采集手写的纸质便利贴，使它们可以被搜索、能提醒你，还能被电脑重新找到。
works.idea_en: Give the humblest paper sticky note a digital memory so it can be searched and can remind you on its own.
works.technique_zh: 数码笔（Anoto 式点阵纸）记录每张便利贴上的笔迹，便利贴中的 RFID 标签则用来识别它，再通过手写识别把纸质便利贴变成可搜索、可定位的记录。
works.exercise_en: Photograph handwritten sticky notes with a phone, run OCR (such as Tesseract.js or the system's text recognition) to save them as a searchable list, and give each note a QR code or NFC tag that jumps to its digital record when scanned. Twist: have a sticky note 'remind' you on its own at a certain time or place.

works.title: Sekai Camera (TechCrunch50 demo)
works.description: The TechCrunch50 demo of Sekai Camera: point an iPhone at a street or shop and see floating 'air tags' left by other people, with notes, photos and voice memos attached to places.
works.idea_zh: 让人们把文字、照片和声音像气泡一样'留'在真实地点。

video.video_title: SekaiCameraDemoVideo of TechCrunch50

works.technique: GPS position and compass heading determine which geotagged notes lie in the camera's field of view, and tags are drawn as floating labels at their bearing.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 GPS 和指南针在网页上实现“浮空标签”：朝向某个方向时显示那里的留言；变体：标签字体大小按距离缩放，远处的留言变模糊。
works.description_zh: Sekai Camera 在 TechCrunch50 上的演示：把 iPhone 对准街道或店铺，就能看到其他人留下的漂浮“空中标签”，地点上附着着文字留言、照片和语音备忘。
works.idea_en: Let people leave words, photos and sounds at real places like floating bubbles.
works.technique_zh: 根据 GPS 位置和指南针朝向，判断哪些带地理标签的留言位于相机视野内，并按其方位把标签绘制成漂浮的标注。
works.exercise_en: Use the phone's GPS and compass to build 'floating tags' in a web page that show the messages left in whichever direction you face. Twist: scale tag font size by distance so faraway messages blur.

works.title: Spire
works.description: Thirty-seven cypress trunks from the Presidio's old forest are bound into a 30-metre spire, which the newly planted trees around it will slowly grow up to hide.
works.description_zh: 37 根来自 Presidio 老林的柏树树干被捆扎成一座 30 米高的尖塔，周围新种的树木会慢慢长高并把它遮住。
works.idea_en: The work is designed to be absorbed by the forest over decades, a model for AR installations with a planned lifespan.
works.idea_zh: 作品被设计为在几十年中被森林吸收，是具有计划寿命的 AR 装置的范本。
works.technique: Felled trunks are stacked and fixed into a tall cone at the centre of a replanting area so that surrounding growth measures time.
works.technique_zh: 伐下的树干在重新造林区中心被堆叠固定成高锥，让周围的生长成为时间的度量。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a tall AR spire in a park and add simulated trees that grow a little every day the app is opened, until they hide it. Twist: let every visitor plant one virtual tree that joins the forest for everyone.
works.exercise_zh: 在公园里锚定一座高大的 AR 尖塔，并加入每天打开应用时都会长高一点的模拟树木，直到它们把尖塔遮住；变体：让每位访客种下一棵所有人都能看到的虚拟树。

video.video_title: Andy Goldsworthy: Spire

works.title: SurfaceFusion
works.description: Physical objects placed on a Microsoft Surface table are identified by RFID and located by computer vision, so virtual content follows and responds to real things on the tabletop.
works.description_zh: 放在 Microsoft Surface 桌面上的实物通过 RFID 识别身份、通过计算机视觉确定位置，于是虚拟内容会跟随并回应桌上的真实物品。
works.idea_en: Combine two weak sensors to make ordinary objects first-class citizens of a touch table.
works.idea_zh: 把两种各有短板的传感器结合起来，让普通物品成为触控桌上的“一等公民”。
works.technique: Vision on the table's IR camera gives object position and RFID gives identity; fusing them removes the need for printed tags on every object.
works.technique_zh: 桌子的红外摄像头视觉提供物体位置，RFID 提供身份，融合两者后，物体上就不必贴印刷标签。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam over a table to track coloured objects and an NFC phone tap to name each one, then project labels that follow them. Twist: make objects react when they are placed near each other.
works.exercise_zh: 用桌子上方的网络摄像头追踪彩色物体，用手机 NFC 轻触为每个物体命名，然后投影出跟随它们的标签。变体：当物体彼此靠近时让它们产生反应。

video.video_title: SurfaceFusion - Microsoft Surface Augmented Reality

works.title: Telstra live hologram telepresence
works.description: In an Australian first, Telstra's Chief Technology Officer Dr Hugh Bradlow is beamed live from Melbourne into a business event in Adelaide as a life-size 'hologram' who talks to the audience in real time.
works.description_zh: 澳大利亚的首次尝试：Telstra 首席技术官 Hugh Bradlow 博士从墨尔本被实时“传送”到阿德莱德的一场商务活动上，以真人大小的“全息”形象与现场观众实时交谈。
works.idea_en: Live telepresence changes a projection effect into a conversation; the moment the remote person can answer, the audience treats them as present.
works.idea_zh: 实时远程临场把一个投影效果变成了一场对话；远方的人一旦能回应，观众就会把他当作在场的人。
works.technique: A live HD video feed of the speaker filmed against black in Melbourne is sent over a network link and projected onto an Eyeliner foil on the Adelaide stage.
works.technique_zh: 在墨尔本对着黑背景拍摄的实时高清画面，经网络传输后投到阿德莱德舞台上的 Eyeliner 薄膜上。
works.exercise_en: Connect two rooms with a video call, key out the background, and show the remote person as a life-size AR figure standing in the other room with WebRTC and WebXR. Twist: let the remote person point at real objects in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 用视频通话连接两个房间，抠掉背景，用 WebRTC 和 WebXR 把远方的人作为真人大小的 AR 形象放进另一个房间；变体：让远方的人能指向房间里的真实物体。

video.video_title: Telstra CEO live hologram using Musion Eyeliner

works.title: The Artvertiser
works.description: Custom binoculars recognise street billboards and replace each advert live with an artwork, turning advertising space into an exhibition surface.
works.idea_zh: 用改装望远镜把街头广告实时替换成艺术作品

video.video_title: THE ARTVERTISER at HACK THE CITY

works.technique: Natural-feature (Ferns keypoint) tracking in OpenCV recognises known billboard images and computes a homography so replacement artwork is warped onto the billboard in the video feed.
works.exercise_zh: 用 8th Wall / MindAR 图像追踪识别校园里的几张海报，实时替换成同学的作品；变体：把替换内容做成对原广告的回应或反讽，而不是简单覆盖。
works.description_zh: 一副特制双筒望远镜能识别街头广告牌，并把每条广告实时替换成艺术作品，把广告空间变成展览墙面。
works.idea_en: Use modified binoculars to swap street ads for artworks in real time.
works.technique_zh: 在 OpenCV 中用自然特征（Ferns 关键点）追踪识别已知的广告牌图像，并计算单应矩阵，把替换用的艺术作品变形贴到视频画面中的广告牌上。
works.exercise_en: Use 8th Wall or MindAR image tracking to recognize a few posters on campus and replace them live with classmates' work. Twist: make the replacement a response to or parody of the original ad rather than a simple cover-up.

salient.why_en: Look through binoculars and street ads are replaced by artworks, so you can switch off advertising.
salient.why_zh: 透过望远镜看，街头广告被换成艺术作品，广告可以被你关掉。

works.title: The New York City Waterfalls
works.description: Four artificial waterfalls, 27 to 37 metres tall, built from exposed scaffolding, poured river water back into New York's East River and harbour for three months.
works.description_zh: 四座高 27 至 37 米、以裸露脚手架搭成的人造瀑布，在三个月里把河水倒回纽约东河与港口。
works.idea_en: Showing the scaffold behind the illusion lets people see both the effect and how it is made, a stance many AR works could adopt.
works.idea_zh: 把幻觉背后的脚手架也展示出来，让人同时看见效果和其制作方式，许多 AR 作品都可以采用这种立场。
works.technique: Pumps lifted river water to the top of each scaffold tower and let it fall in a sheet back into the river.
works.technique_zh: 水泵把河水抽到每座脚手架塔的顶部，再让它以水幕形式落回河中。
works.exercise_en: Add an AR waterfall pouring off the edge of a real building or bridge, rendering the pump and scaffold as a wireframe. Twist: the flow volume follows real-time river gauge data.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实的建筑或桥梁边缘加一道倾泻而下的 AR 瀑布，并把水泵和脚手架以线框渲染出来；变体：水流量跟随实时河流水文数据变化。

video.video_title: Olafur Eliasson, The New York City Waterfalls, 2008

works.title: The Salt Satyagraha Online: Gandhi's March to Dandi
works.description: Over 26 days at Eyebeam in New York, Joseph DeLappe walked the full 240 miles of Gandhi's 1930 Salt March on a modified treadmill, and every step moved his avatar MGandhi Chakrabarti across Second Life, where others joined the march.
works.description_zh: 在纽约 Eyebeam 的 26 天里，Joseph DeLappe 在改装过的跑步机上走完了甘地 1930 年食盐进军的全部 240 英里，每一步都让他的化身 MGandhi Chakrabarti 在 Second Life 中前进，其他人也在线上加入了游行。
works.idea_en: A real body walking in a room carries its avatar through a shared virtual world.
works.idea_zh: 房间里一个真实行走的身体，带着它的化身穿越一个共享的虚拟世界。
works.technique: The treadmill's motion was converted into keyboard input for the Second Life client, so walking speed on the belt drove the avatar's forward movement in real time.
works.technique_zh: 跑步机的运动被转换成 Second Life 客户端的键盘输入，让传送带上的步行速度实时驱动化身前进。
works.exercise_en: Turn walking in place into movement in a virtual map: use a phone's step counter or accelerometer to move a marker along a real historical route on a projected map, and walk a symbolic distance as a class. Twist: show the route in AR on the floor so the walker sees how far is left.
works.exercise_zh: 把原地行走变成虚拟地图上的移动：用手机计步器或加速度计，让一个标记沿投影地图上的一条真实历史路线前进，全班一起走完一段有象征意义的距离；变体：用 AR 把路线铺在地板上，让行走者看到还剩多远。

video.video_title: Treadmill Powered Gandhi in Second Life

salient.why_en: Walking 240 miles on a treadmill carries an avatar along Gandhi's Salt March in Second Life.
salient.why_zh: 在跑步机上走完 240 英里，带着化身在 Second Life 里重走甘地的食盐进军。

works.title: The Very Angry Caterpillar
works.description: A light-painted caterpillar crawls, eats and grows across walls and floors, animated from hundreds of long exposures made with the BBC children's show Blue Peter.
works.description_zh: 一条光绘的毛毛虫在墙面和地面上爬行、进食、长大，由与 BBC 儿童节目 Blue Peter 合作拍摄的几百张长曝光照片组成。
works.idea_en: Stop-motion light drawing gives a character a real path through a real room — a low-tech prototype for AR characters that walk on real surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 定格光绘让角色在真实房间里走出一条真实的路线——这是会在真实表面上行走的 AR 角色的低技术原型。
works.technique: Each frame is a separate long exposure in which the painters redraw the character slightly further along its path; the frames are sequenced into video.
works.technique_zh: 每一帧都是一张单独的长曝光，画手们把角色沿路线往前挪一点重新画一遍，再把这些帧连成视频。
works.exercise_en: Record a hand-drawn 3D stroke creature in an AR drawing tool, then script it to crawl along a detected plane and climb a wall using plane detection. Twist: the creature grows one segment every time it reaches a real object.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 绘画工具里手绘一只三维线条小生物，然后用平面检测写脚本，让它沿地面爬行并爬上墙；变体：它每碰到一个真实物体就长出一节。

video.video_title: LICHTFAKTOR - "The Very Angry Caterpillar"

works.title: Traces
works.description: A responsive projection with Moritz Waldemeyer that turns visitors' movements into long-exposure-like light trails inspired by car tail-light photography.
works.idea_zh: 人的动作在投影中留下像长曝光车灯一样的光轨。

video.video_title: Traces

works.technique: Background subtraction extracts moving bright regions or silhouettes each frame, which are accumulated into a slowly decaying frame buffer to emulate long-exposure light trails.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 或 TouchDesigner 做帧累积加衰减（feedback），让人的动作留下长曝光一样的光轨并投影；变体：光轨只记录最慢的动作，快动作会被抹掉。
works.description_zh: 与 Moritz Waldemeyer 合作的一件响应式投影，受汽车尾灯摄影启发，把观众的动作变成类似长曝光的光轨。
works.idea_en: People's movements leave light trails in the projection, like long-exposure car lights.
works.technique_zh: 背景减除在每一帧中提取移动的亮区或剪影，并累积到一个缓慢衰减的帧缓冲中，模拟长曝光光轨。
works.exercise_en: Use frame accumulation with decay (feedback) in p5.js or TouchDesigner so people's movements leave long-exposure light trails, and project them. Twist: the trails record only the slowest movements, and fast ones are wiped out.

works.title: Tree Huts
works.description: In Berlin and other cities, Kawamata attaches small huts of scrap wood high in trees and on building corners, as if informal shelters were growing on the city.
works.description_zh: 在柏林等城市，Kawamata 把用废木料搭成的小屋高高地附着在树上和建筑转角处，仿佛非正式的庇护所正在城市上生长。
works.idea_en: Small structures attached to real surfaces at unexpected heights are a physical preview of facade-anchored AR content.
works.idea_zh: 在意想不到的高度附着于真实表面的小结构，是锚定在立面上的 AR 内容的实体预演。
works.technique: Huts are built from salvaged boards and fixed with brackets and ropes to trees and walls without damaging them.
works.technique_zh: 小屋用回收木板搭成，用支架和绳索固定在树和墙上，而不损伤它们。
works.exercise_en: Anchor five small AR huts to the corners and trees of real buildings using vertical plane detection, each containing a tiny scene. Twist: new huts appear wherever people linger longest.
works.exercise_zh: 用竖直平面检测把五座小型 AR 小屋锚定在真实建筑的转角和树上，每座里面都有一个小场景；变体：人们停留最久的地方会长出新的小屋。

video.video_title: Tadashi Kawamata: Berlin Tree Huts

works.title: Tree of 40 Fruit
works.description: By grafting, Van Aken makes single trees that bear up to 40 kinds of stone fruit; in spring they blossom in patches of pink, white and crimson, and the trees are planted in public places across the US.
works.description_zh: 通过嫁接，Van Aken 让一棵树结出多达 40 种核果；春天它们开出一片片粉、白、深红的花，这些树被种在美国各地的公共场所。
works.idea_en: An artwork that reveals its design only in one season and keeps an archive of lost varieties alive shows how living data can be an artwork.
works.idea_zh: 一件只在某个季节显露设计、同时保存着消失品种档案的作品，说明活的数据本身就可以是艺术。
works.technique: Buds of different varieties are grafted onto the branches of a host tree over several years following a planned map.
works.technique_zh: 按照预先规划的图谱，在数年间把不同品种的芽嫁接到宿主树的枝条上。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR tree in a courtyard whose branches blossom in different colours, each linked to a local heirloom variety with its story. Twist: the blossoms appear only during the real flowering week in your region.
works.exercise_zh: 在庭院里放一棵 AR 树，其枝条开出不同颜色的花，每种都链接一个本地传统品种及其故事；变体：花朵只在你所在地区真实的花期那一周出现。

video.video_title: How one tree grows 40 different kinds of fruit | Sam Van Aken

works.title: Untitled Sound Objects (with Pe Lang)
works.description: A series of small wall objects by Pe Lang and Zimoun in which motors make strings, paper and wires rustle and buzz, each box its own tiny mechanical sound machine.
works.description_zh: Pe Lang 与 Zimoun 合作的一系列小型壁挂装置，电机让线、纸和铁丝沙沙作响、嗡嗡振动，每个盒子都是一台小小的机械声音机器。
works.idea_en: Small, framed sound objects show that an AR piece can be intimate and wall-sized rather than room-sized.
works.idea_zh: 小巧的框装声音物件说明，AR 作品也可以是贴在墙上的亲密小件，而不必占满整个房间。
works.technique: Each object pairs a simple motor with one material so that the sound and the motion are the same event, visible and audible at once.
works.technique_zh: 每件作品把一个简单电机和一种材料配在一起，让声音和运动成为同一个事件，同时看得见、听得见。
works.exercise_en: Build three framed virtual boxes on a real wall with image tracking, each animating one material (string, paper, wire) with a matching sound. Twist: let visitors tap a box to change its material.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪在真墙上放三个带框的虚拟盒子，各自让一种材料（线、纸、铁丝）动起来并配上相应的声音。变体：观众点击盒子即可更换材料。

video.video_title: "Untitled Sound Objects" (2008) by Pe Lang + Zimoun

works.title: Video Terraform Dance Party
works.description: A webcam performance where the artist's body movements sculpt a 3D landscape around him live on screen.
works.idea_zh: 用舞蹈动作在屏幕中塑造地形

video.video_title: Video Terraform Dance Party (2008)

works.technique: Webcam-based motion tracking (likely colour or frame-difference tracking) maps body positions to height-field deformations of a 3D terrain rendered live around the performer.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 让双手的高度推起或压下一片 three.js 地形网格，自己在画面中“跳出”一座山；变体：把跳舞过程做成一场一本正经的“地形设计软件”产品演示。
works.description_zh: 一场网络摄像头表演：艺术家的身体动作在屏幕上实时塑造他周围的三维地景。
works.idea_en: Shape terrain on screen with dance moves.
works.technique_zh: 基于网络摄像头的动作追踪（可能是颜色追踪或帧差追踪）把身体位置映射为三维地形高度场的形变，地形在表演者周围实时渲染。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Pose so the height of your hands pushes up or presses down a three.js terrain mesh, and 'dance out' a mountain on screen. Twist: present the dance as a deadpan product demo for 'terrain design software'.

works.title: Women Are Heroes
works.description: In the favelas of Rio, the slums of Kibera and other places, JR pasted huge portraits of local women onto houses, stairways, trains and rooftops, so the community's faces cover the landscape.
works.description_zh: 在里约的贫民窟、内罗毕的基贝拉等地，JR 把当地女性的巨幅肖像贴在房屋、阶梯、火车和屋顶上，让社区自己的面孔覆盖整片地景。
works.idea_en: Pasting local faces on the architecture they live in gives a community authorship of the view, a model for participatory AR portraits.
works.idea_zh: 把当地人的面孔贴在他们居住的建筑上，让社区成为景观的作者，是参与式 AR 肖像的范本。
works.technique: Portraits of women's eyes and faces are printed in strips and pasted across many surfaces so they read as one image from a distance.
works.technique_zh: 女性的眼睛与面孔肖像被分条印刷，粘贴在许多表面上，从远处看连成一幅图像。
works.exercise_en: Take portraits of people on your street and in AR map their faces across the facades of the buildings they live or work in, split over several surfaces. Twist: the face assembles only from one viewpoint.
works.exercise_zh: 为你所在街道的人拍摄肖像，在 AR 中把他们的面孔跨越多个表面映射到他们居住或工作的建筑立面上；变体：面孔只从某一个视点才会拼合完整。

video.video_title: JR on Women are Heroes

works.title: bit.flow
works.description: Coloured liquid and air bubbles are pumped through a long transparent tube wound across a wall, forming pixel patterns and words that travel along the tube.
works.description_zh: 有色液体和气泡被泵入一条在墙上盘绕的长透明管道，形成像素图案和文字，沿着管道流动。
works.idea_en: Pixels do not need a screen: any flowing material can carry an image through space, which suggests AR content that travels along real pipes, rails or paths.
works.idea_zh: 像素不一定需要屏幕：任何流动的材料都能把图像带过空间，这启发 AR 内容沿真实的管道、栏杆或路径流动。
works.technique: Pumps and valves insert liquid and air segments at a computed rhythm so that, as the column moves through the coiled tube, the sequence lines up as a readable image; exact control is likely timing-based.
works.technique_zh: 水泵和阀门按计算好的节奏注入液体段和空气段，液柱在盘管中移动时这些段会排成可读的图像；精确控制很可能基于时序。
works.exercise_en: Trace a real handrail, cable or pipe with AR and send a stream of coloured pixel beads along it that spell a short message as they pass. Twist: let viewers tap the rail to inject their own colour into the stream.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中描出一段真实的扶手、电缆或管道，沿它送出一串彩色像素珠，经过时拼出一条短消息。变体：让观众轻点扶手，把自己的颜色注入流中。

video.video_title: BIT.FLOW

works.title: AR Façade
works.description: The AI interactive drama Façade re-staged in a physical apartment with AR: the player walks among life-size virtual characters Grace and Trip and speaks to them aloud.
works.idea_zh: 把AI互动剧《Façade》搬进真实公寓，玩家直接对着真人大小的角色说话。

video.video_title: AR Façade: An Immersive and Interactive Narrative Experience

works.technique: A video see-through HMD with tracking renders life-size characters in a physical apartment set, while a hidden operator transcribes the player's speech (Wizard of Oz) into the Façade drama manager that drives the characters.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中放一个真人大小的虚拟角色（可用 Mixamo 模型），由一位藏在后台的同学（绿野仙踪法）根据玩家说的话选择角色动画和台词；变体：让角色能“看见”玩家拿起的真实物品并评论它。
works.description_zh: 把 AI 互动剧《Façade》用 AR 搬进一间真实的公寓：玩家在真人大小的虚拟角色 Grace 和 Trip 之间走动，并直接开口和他们说话。
works.idea_en: Move the AI interactive drama Façade into a real apartment, where the player talks straight to life-size characters.
works.technique_zh: 带追踪的视频透视式头显在实体公寓布景中渲染真人大小的角色，同时一名隐藏的操作员把玩家的话转录下来（绿野仙踪法），输入驱动角色的 Façade 剧情管理器。
works.exercise_en: Place a life-size virtual character in phone AR (a Mixamo model works), and have a classmate hidden backstage (Wizard of Oz) pick the character's animations and lines based on what the player says. Twist: let the character 'see' a real object the player picks up and comment on it.

works.title: AR-Jig
works.description: A handheld pin-array 'jig' whose physical profile controls a projected/AR 3D curve, letting designers sculpt digital surfaces with a tangible tool.
works.idea_zh: 用一排可推动的实体针当手工具，直接'刮'出数字曲面。

video.video_title: AR-Jig 2007

works.technique: A handheld tool with an array of linear pins whose displacements are sensed is tracked in space, and the pin profile defines control points that deform a displayed 3D spline surface.
works.exercise_zh: 用一排可滑动的纸条或吸管（手机摄像头识别其高度）作为实体“曲线尺”，读出的轮廓实时生成 three.js 中的样条曲线并旋转成一个花瓶；变体：沿着桌面拖动这把尺子，扫出一整个曲面。
works.description_zh: 一个手持的针阵“夹具”，它的实体轮廓控制投影/AR 中的三维曲线，让设计师可以用一件实体工具来雕塑数字曲面。
works.idea_en: Use a row of pushable physical pins as a hand tool to scrape out a digital surface directly.
works.technique_zh: 一个带有一排直线针的手持工具在空间中被追踪，每根针的位移都会被感测，针阵的轮廓定义控制点，从而使显示出的三维样条曲面发生形变。
works.exercise_en: Use a row of sliding paper strips or straws (with the phone camera reading their heights) as a physical 'curve ruler', turn the profile into a live spline in three.js, and revolve it into a vase. Twist: drag the ruler along the table to sweep out a whole surface.

works.title: ATOM (with Robert Henke)
works.description: An 8×8 grid of glowing helium balloons on computer-controlled winches rises and sinks above the audience, forming shapes in sync with Robert Henke's electronic music.
works.description_zh: 一个 8×8 的发光氦气球阵列挂在电脑控制的绞盘上，在观众头顶升降，与 Robert Henke 的电子音乐同步组成形状。
works.idea_en: A low-resolution grid of 64 lights is enough to make a 3D display — AR effects don't need many elements if their motion is rhythmic.
works.idea_zh: 64 个光点组成的低分辨率阵列就足以成为三维显示器——只要运动有节奏，AR 效果并不需要很多元素。
works.technique: Each balloon hangs on a DMX-controlled winch; height and LED colour are sequenced from the same timeline as the music.
works.technique_zh: 每个气球挂在 DMX 控制的绞盘上；高度和 LED 颜色与音乐由同一条时间轴编排。
works.exercise_en: Make an 8×8 grid of glowing spheres float above the floor in AR and drive their heights from the frequency bands of live microphone input. Twist: let two audience members each control one half of the grid with their phones.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中让 8×8 个发光球悬浮在地面上方，用麦克风实时输入的各频段驱动它们的高度。变体：让两位观众用手机各控制半个阵列。

video.video_title: KINETIC LIGHTS - ATOM - kinetic audio-visual live show by Christopher Bauder and Robert Henke

works.title: Abundance
works.description: At night a camera on San Jose City Hall watches people walking across the plaza and projects a responsive animation of their paths onto the building's rotunda.
works.idea_zh: 广场上行人的路径被实时画成巨大的建筑投影
works.technique: A roof-mounted camera tracks pedestrians from above and their trajectories drive a generative animation projected onto the cylindrical façade.
works.exercise_zh: 从教学楼高处俯拍操场，把行人轨迹实时画成彩色流线投到墙上；变化：两条轨迹交叉时生成一朵“花”。

video.video_title: Camille Utterback - Abundance

works.description_zh: 夜晚，圣何塞市政厅上的摄像头注视着穿过广场的行人，把他们路径的响应式动画投射到建筑的圆形大厅外墙上。
works.idea_en: The paths of people crossing a plaza are drawn live as a giant projection on the building.
works.technique_zh: 安装在屋顶的摄像头从上方追踪行人，他们的轨迹驱动一段生成式动画，投射到圆柱形立面上。
works.exercise_en: Film the sports field from high up in a teaching building and draw pedestrians' paths live as colorful flow lines projected on a wall. Twist: when two paths cross, a 'flower' grows.

works.title: Augmented Sculpture v1.2
works.description: A white geometric sculpture is overlaid with precisely mapped projected light, so edges, planes and shadows appear to move, fold and rebuild the physical form.
works.idea_zh: 用精确投影让静止的白色体块产生时空变形

video.video_title: Pablo Valbuena, Augmented Sculpture v. 1.2

works.technique: A projector is calibrated to a white polyhedral sculpture whose exact 3D model is known, so rendered light and shadow on each face can simulate edges and planes moving over the static form.
works.exercise_zh: 用白色纸板折出两三个几何体，在 MadMapper 或 TouchDesigner 中逐面对齐投影，只用黑白线条让体块看起来在折叠和重组；变体：让一个面“缺失”——投成与背景同色，看它是否消失。
works.description_zh: 一件白色几何雕塑被叠加上精确映射的投影光，边缘、平面和阴影仿佛在移动、折叠，重新构建着这一实体形态。
works.idea_en: Precise projection makes still white blocks warp through space and time.
works.technique_zh: 投影仪针对一件已知精确三维模型的白色多面体雕塑进行标定，因此每个面上渲染的光影都能模拟边缘和平面在静止形体上移动。
works.exercise_en: Fold two or three geometric solids from white cardboard, align the projection face by face in MadMapper or TouchDesigner, and use only black and white lines to make the blocks look like they fold and rebuild. Twist: make one face 'go missing' by projecting the background color onto it, and see whether it disappears.

works.title: Augmented/Mediated Reality Concepts
works.description: A short concept film from Mann's EyeTap lab showing a wearer whose glasses not only add information but also remove or replace things in view, such as blocking out advertising billboards in the street.
works.description_zh: Mann 的 EyeTap 实验室制作的概念短片：主角的眼镜不仅添加信息，还会删除或替换视野中的东西，比如把街上的广告牌遮掉。
works.idea_en: AR can subtract as well as add: diminished reality lets you filter the world you do not want to see.
works.idea_zh: AR 不只是做加法，也可以做减法：削弱现实让你过滤掉不想看到的世界。
works.technique: Likely tracked planar regions such as billboards are detected in the head camera feed and overwritten with other imagery before being shown to the eye.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是在头戴摄像头画面中检测出广告牌等平面区域，再在显示给眼睛之前用其他图像覆盖掉。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR image tracking to detect one poster or logo on campus and cover it with a calm texture. Twist: replace every detected logo with a short personal note from a classmate.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 的图像追踪识别校园里的一张海报或标志，并用平静的纹理把它盖住。变体：把识别到的每个标志换成一条同学写的私人留言。

video.video_title: Augmented/Mediated Reality Concepts

works.title: Between the Devil and the Deep Blue Sea
works.description: 1927's debut cabaret places performers against a white screen filled with Paul Barritt's hand-drawn animations, so they walk through drawn streets and silent-film fairy tales with live music.
works.description_zh: 1927 的首部作品是一场歌舞表演，演员站在白幕前，幕上是 Paul Barritt 的手绘动画，他们在画出来的街道和默片式童话里穿行，现场有乐队伴奏。
works.idea_en: A drawn world becomes inhabitable when a real person stands in it; hand-drawn AR can feel warmer than realistic 3D.
works.idea_zh: 有真人站进去，画出来的世界就变得可以居住；手绘风格的 AR 往往比写实 3D 更有温度。
works.technique: Animation is projected onto a flat screen and the actors are placed and lit so their bodies line up with painted doors, windows and props.
works.technique_zh: 动画投在平面幕上，演员的站位和灯光经过设计，让身体与画出来的门、窗和道具对齐。
works.exercise_en: Draw a street scene on paper, scan it, and place it as a flat AR backdrop that a classmate can stand in while you film them opening a drawn door. Twist: the drawn door only opens when they knock.
works.exercise_zh: 在纸上画一条街，扫描后在 AR 中放成一块平面背景，让同学站进去，拍他打开一扇画出来的门；变体：只有敲门时，这扇画出来的门才会打开。

video.video_title: The Devil and the Deep Blue Sea Trailer

works.title: Breath
works.description: A public artwork at Lincoln Center where banners on Avery Fisher Hall's columns and a row of tall lightboxes in the colonnade brighten and dim with the ebb and flow of a live musical composition.
works.description_zh: 林肯中心的一件公共艺术作品：艾弗里·费舍尔音乐厅立柱上的横幅和柱廊里一排高大的灯箱，随着一段现场音乐的起伏而明暗变化。
works.idea_en: A building's facade breathes in time with music.
works.idea_zh: 建筑立面随着音乐一起呼吸。
works.technique: Software analyses a live musical composition and couples its dynamics to the lighting of the banners and lightboxes, for the month-long Mostly Mozart Festival.
works.technique_zh: 软件分析一段现场音乐作品，把它的力度变化与横幅和灯箱的照明联动，在为期一个月的莫扎特音乐节期间运行。
works.exercise_en: Connect a microphone to a row of smart bulbs or an LED strip so the loudness of a live singer makes a hallway or window 'breathe'. Twist: make the light lead the singer by a beat, so they have to follow it.
works.exercise_zh: 把麦克风接到一排智能灯泡或 LED 灯带上，让现场歌手的音量使走廊或窗户“呼吸”；变体：让灯光比歌手早一拍，迫使歌手去追随它。

video.video_title: Breath / OpenEnded Group opening at Lincoln Center

works.title: Central Mosaic
works.description: Shadows of passers-by are recorded and replayed as silhouettes that shrink and move outward into a fractal mosaic as newer recordings take the centre.
works.idea_zh: 每个路人的影子先占据中心，再被新来者推向边缘，成为分形马赛克
works.technique: Silhouette recordings are laid out in a recursive, self-similar tiling where each new clip pushes older clips one level outward and smaller.
works.exercise_zh: 把录下的剪影片段做成递归四分网格，新片段进中心、旧的向外缩小；变化：按录制时间给每层上不同颜色，形成“时间年轮”。

video.video_title: Central Mosaic (2007) by Scott Snibbe

works.description_zh: 路人的影子被记录下来并以剪影形式回放；随着新的录像占据中心，旧的剪影不断缩小、向外移动，形成一幅分形马赛克。
works.idea_en: Each passer-by's shadow takes the center until newcomers push it to the edge of a fractal mosaic.
works.technique_zh: 剪影录像以递归的自相似方式平铺排列，每段新片段都会把旧片段向外推一层并缩小。
works.exercise_en: Arrange recorded silhouette clips in a recursive quad grid, with new clips entering the center and old ones shrinking outward. Twist: color each layer by recording time to form 'growth rings of time'.

works.title: Delicate Boundaries
works.description: Small bugs made of light crawl out of a computer screen and onto the hands and arms of people who touch it.
works.idea_zh: 光做的小虫从屏幕里爬出来，爬到触碰它的人手上。

video.video_title: Delicate Boundaries

works.technique: A camera looking at the screen and arms detects hand contact and arm contours, and a projector calibrated to the same space lets agent-based bugs walk off the screen and follow those contours.
works.exercise_zh: 屏幕上养一群小虫，用 MediaPipe Hands 检测手指触碰屏幕边缘后，让虫子“爬”到投影到手臂上的画面中；变体：虫子在你手上待久了会生出你没想到的东西。
works.description_zh: 光做成的小虫从电脑屏幕里爬出来，爬到触碰屏幕的人的手上和手臂上。
works.idea_en: Little bugs made of light crawl out of the screen and onto the hands of whoever touches it.
works.technique_zh: 对着屏幕和手臂的摄像头检测手的接触和手臂轮廓，一台标定到同一空间的投影仪让基于智能体的虫子走出屏幕、沿着这些轮廓爬行。
works.exercise_en: Keep a swarm of bugs on screen, and when MediaPipe Hands detects a finger touching the screen edge, have the bugs 'crawl' into imagery projected onto the arm. Twist: bugs that stay on your hand too long grow into something you did not expect.

salient.why_en: Light bugs crawl out of the screen and onto the hand that touches it, so the image escapes its frame.
salient.why_zh: 光做的小虫从屏幕里爬出来，爬到触碰屏幕的手上，画面逃出了边框。

works.title: Event Horizon
works.description: Thirty-one body-form figures are placed on rooftops and pavements across a city (London, New York, São Paulo, Hong Kong), so people suddenly notice a lone man standing on the edge of a building.
works.description_zh: 三十一尊人像被安放在城市（伦敦、纽约、圣保罗、香港）的屋顶和街道上，路人会突然注意到有个孤独的人站在楼顶边缘。
works.idea_en: A figure on a skyline makes people look up and scan the city, showing that one well-placed AR character can redirect a crowd's attention.
works.idea_zh: 天际线上的一个人形让人们抬头扫视整座城市，说明一个放对位置的 AR 角色就能引导人群的注意力。
works.technique: Identical figures are mounted on rooftops at varied distances from a central viewpoint so that the eye links them into a constellation across the skyline.
works.technique_zh: 相同的人像被安装在与中心视点距离不同的屋顶上，让视线把它们在天际线上连成一个星座。
works.exercise_en: Anchor five life-size figures with geospatial AR (ARCore Geospatial API or Niantic Lightship) on rooftops visible from one plaza, and ask classmates to find them all. Twist: make each figure turn to face the nearest viewer.
works.exercise_zh: 用地理空间 AR（ARCore Geospatial API 或 Niantic Lightship）在一个广场可见的五处屋顶上放置等身人像，让同学把它们全部找出来；变体：让每个人像转身面向离它最近的观者。

video.video_title: In Focus: Antony Gormley on 'Event Horizon', Hong Kong (2015–2016) | White Cube

works.title: Expedition Schatzsuche (Museum AR Quest)
works.description: A handheld AR treasure hunt in a Vienna museum: children explore exhibits with PDAs that reveal virtual characters and puzzles on markers.
works.idea_zh: 孩子们举着PDA在博物馆里寻宝，展品旁浮现虚拟角色和谜题。

video.video_title: Museum Augmented Reality Quest   Expedition Schatzsuche

works.technique: Handheld PDAs track printed fiducial markers placed next to exhibits and overlay virtual characters and puzzle clues, with a game state machine sequencing the quest across the museum.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园或教学楼中贴 5 个图像标记，用 8th Wall 或 AR.js 做一个串联寻宝：每个标记出现一个角色和一条线索，指向下一个地点；变体：线索需要结合真实展品或环境细节才能解开。
works.description_zh: 维也纳一家博物馆里的手持 AR 寻宝游戏：孩子们拿着 PDA 探索展品，标记上会浮现虚拟角色和谜题。
works.idea_en: Kids hunt for treasure in a museum with PDAs, and virtual characters and puzzles appear beside the exhibits.
works.technique_zh: 手持 PDA 追踪放在展品旁的打印基准标记，叠加虚拟角色和谜题线索，并由游戏状态机串联起整个博物馆的探险流程。
works.exercise_en: Put five image markers around a campus or teaching building and use 8th Wall or AR.js to build a linked treasure hunt: each marker shows a character and a clue pointing to the next spot. Twist: the clues can only be solved using details of real exhibits or the surroundings.

works.title: Face 2 Face
works.description: With Marco, JR pasted pairs of huge portraits of Israelis and Palestinians doing the same job, pulling funny faces side by side, on both sides of the separation wall and in eight cities.
works.description_zh: JR 与 Marco 合作，把从事同样职业的以色列人和巴勒斯坦人做鬼脸的巨幅肖像成对并排张贴在隔离墙两侧以及八座城市中。
works.idea_en: Putting two faces side by side that people expect to see apart creates empathy, a pairing strategy AR face filters rarely use.
works.idea_zh: 把人们以为应该分开的两张脸并排放在一起，会引发共情，这是 AR 人脸滤镜很少使用的配对策略。
works.technique: Portraits taken with a wide-angle lens close up are printed large and pasted in pairs.
works.technique_zh: 用广角镜头近距离拍摄的肖像被大幅打印后成对张贴。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR wall where two users in different places each add a funny-face portrait that is pasted side by side. Twist: pair people only when they have the same job or hobby.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一面 AR 墙，让身处不同地方的两位用户各自添加一张鬼脸肖像，并排贴在一起；变体：只有职业或爱好相同的人才会被配对。

video.video_title: Inside the Face2Face Project - Israel and Palestine

works.title: Foldable Interactive Displays
works.description: Sheets of paper and card that fold, roll and fan out become displays: a projector keeps its image locked onto the moving, bending surface, tracked by a Wii Remote watching infrared LEDs on the corners.
works.description_zh: 可以折叠、卷起、展开的纸张和卡片变成了显示屏：Wii 遥控器追踪边角上的红外 LED，投影仪让画面始终贴合这块会移动、会弯折的表面。
works.idea_en: Pull a large display out of your pocket by projecting onto paper that folds.
works.idea_zh: 把画面投在可折叠的纸上，从口袋里掏出一块大屏幕。
works.technique: IR LEDs at the corners and folds of the surface are tracked by the Wii Remote, and the projected image is warped per segment to match the surface geometry (published at UIST 2008).
works.technique_zh: Wii 遥控器追踪表面边角与折痕处的红外 LED，投影画面按每一段表面的形状分别变形贴合（发表于 UIST 2008）。
works.exercise_en: Project a video onto a hand-held piece of card: track its four corners with coloured stickers and a webcam, and warp the image with a homography in TouchDesigner or p5.js. Twist: fold the card in half and warp each half separately.
works.exercise_zh: 把视频投到手持的卡片上：用彩色贴纸标出四角，用摄像头追踪，在 TouchDesigner 或 p5.js 里用单应性变换让画面贴合。变体：把卡片对折，两半分别变形。

video.video_title: Foldable Displays (tracked with the Wiimote)

works.title: Funky Forest
works.description: An interactive projected forest ecosystem: children grow trees by pressing their bodies into the forest and use physical logs and pillow 'rocks' to divert a digital stream to water them.
works.idea_zh: 孩子用身体种树、用实物“木头”改变投影河流的方向来灌溉森林。

video.video_title: Funky Forest - Interactive Ecosystem

works.technique: Overhead and frontal cameras segment children's bodies and tracked physical objects, which act as emitters and obstacles in a 2D fluid/particle stream simulation projected onto the floor and walls.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面投影一条流动的粒子小溪，用摄像头识别纸箱或书本作为可移动的挡板，引导水流去浇灌屏幕边上的树；变体：树长大的样子取决于它喝到的水来自哪几个同学。
works.description_zh: 一个互动投影森林生态系统：孩子们把身体压进森林来种树，并用实物木头和枕头“石头”改变一条数字溪流的方向来浇灌树木。
works.idea_en: Kids plant trees with their bodies and use real 'logs' to redirect a projected river to water the forest.
works.technique_zh: 俯拍和正面摄像头分割出孩子的身体以及被追踪的实物，这些都作为发射源和障碍物，参与投影在地面和墙面上的二维流体/粒子溪流模拟。
works.exercise_en: Project a flowing particle stream on the floor, use a camera to recognize cardboard boxes or books as movable barriers, and guide the water to trees at the edge of the screen. Twist: how a tree grows depends on which classmates the water it drank came from.

works.title: Ghost Pole Propagator
works.description: Visitors' silhouettes are reduced to skeletal centerline 'ghost poles' projected large on a wall, echoing their posture as calligraphic stick figures.
works.idea_zh: 把人的剪影提炼成骨架般的线条投影在墙上。

video.video_title: Ghost Pole Propagator I (2007, documented 2012; 1080p)

works.technique: Binary silhouettes are thinned by morphological skeletonization into centerline pixels, which are vectorized into poles and rendered as calligraphic strokes.
works.exercise_zh: 用 OpenCV 骨架化或 MediaPipe Pose 连线，把人的姿势变成书法笔画投到墙上，并保留前几秒的残影；变体：让全班依次摆姿势，拼出一个自己发明的“身体字母表”。
works.description_zh: 观众的剪影被简化成骨架般的中心线“幽灵杆”，大尺度投影在墙上，像书法般的火柴人一样复现他们的姿态。
works.idea_en: Distill a person's silhouette into skeleton-like lines projected on the wall.
works.technique_zh: 通过形态学骨架化把二值剪影细化成中心线像素，再矢量化为杆状线段，以书法笔画的形式渲染出来。
works.exercise_en: Use OpenCV skeletonization or MediaPipe Pose connections to turn a person's pose into calligraphic strokes projected on a wall, keeping afterimages from the last few seconds. Twist: have the class pose one after another to assemble a 'body alphabet' of your own invention.

works.title: Head Tracking for Desktop VR Displays
works.description: A Wii Remote under the TV watches two infrared LEDs on the viewer's glasses; as he moves his head, a field of targets on an ordinary screen shifts in perspective like a window, and objects seem to float in front of the glass.
works.description_zh: 电视下方的 Wii 遥控器盯着观众眼镜上的两颗红外 LED；他一移动头部，普通屏幕上的一排靶子就像窗外景物一样改变透视，物体仿佛浮在屏幕前方。
works.idea_en: Track the viewer's head instead of the scene, and a flat screen becomes a window into depth.
works.idea_zh: 追踪观看者的头而不是场景，平面屏幕就变成一扇有纵深的窗。
works.technique: The Wii Remote's infrared camera finds two LEDs on the head, estimates head position from their spacing and offset, and renders an off-axis (view-dependent) projection each frame.
works.technique_zh: Wii 遥控器的红外相机找到头上的两颗 LED，根据它们的间距和偏移估算头部位置，每帧用离轴（随视点变化的）投影重新渲染画面。
works.exercise_en: Build a head-coupled 'window' on a laptop: track the face with a webcam (MediaPipe or three.js face tracking) and move an off-axis camera so a 3D box appears to sit behind the screen. Twist: make one object poke out in front of the screen plane.
works.exercise_zh: 在笔记本电脑上做一个随头部变化的“窗口”：用摄像头追踪人脸（MediaPipe 或 three.js 人脸追踪），驱动离轴相机，让一个 3D 盒子看起来就在屏幕后面。变体：让一个物体从屏幕平面里伸出来。

video.video_title: Head Tracking for Desktop VR Displays using the WiiRemote

salient.why_en: Track the viewer's head and an ordinary TV turns into a window with real depth behind it.
salient.why_zh: 追踪观看者的头部，一台普通电视就变成一扇后面真有纵深的窗。

works.title: Inflatable Architectural Body
works.description: A large inflatable structure of fabric tubes rises, bends and arches as air is pumped in and out, turning a building-sized form into a slowly moving body.
works.description_zh: 一个由布管组成的大型充气结构随着空气泵入泵出而升起、弯曲、拱起，把建筑尺度的形体变成一个缓慢运动的身体。
works.idea_en: Soft inflation makes huge forms feel gentle and alive; AR objects can gain the same presence with slow breathing growth instead of instant appearance.
works.idea_zh: 柔软的充气让巨大的形体显得温和而有生命；AR 物体也可以用缓慢“呼吸”式的生长来代替瞬间出现，获得同样的存在感。
works.technique: Computer-controlled valves and blowers inflate sealed fabric chambers in sequence so the structure unfolds and moves like a muscle.
works.technique_zh: 由电脑控制的阀门和风机按顺序给密封布腔充气，让结构像肌肉一样展开和运动。
works.exercise_en: Grow a giant AR inflatable arch out of a real doorway that swells in sequence, tube by tube, when someone walks under it. Twist: make it deflate and slump if people crowd it.
works.exercise_zh: 让一个巨大的 AR 充气拱门从真实门口“长”出来，有人从下面走过时它一节一节依次鼓起。变体：人一拥挤，它就泄气瘫下来。

video.video_title: Chico MacMurtrie - Inflatable Architectural Body, Responsive Sculpture 2007

works.title: Interactive Focus and Context Visualization for AR
works.description: A magic-lens style AR view that reveals hidden internal parts of a real object (e.g. a car engine) while preserving key edges of the outside for depth cues.
works.idea_zh: 像透视镜一样看见物体内部，同时保留外壳轮廓帮你判断深度。

video.video_title: Interactive Focus and Context Visualization for Augmented Reality

works.technique: Renders hidden virtual structure inside a focus region and composites real-world edges extracted from the video as context to keep occlusion cues.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR在一个真实纸盒上叠加“内部结构”3D模型，并用描边保留盒子外轮廓，对比有无轮廓时的深度感；变化：让透视区域跟随手指移动。
works.description_zh: 一种魔术透镜式的 AR 视图，能揭示真实物体（例如汽车发动机）内部隐藏的部件，同时保留外部的关键边缘作为深度线索。
works.idea_en: See inside an object like an X-ray lens while keeping the shell outline to help you judge depth.
works.technique_zh: 在焦点区域内渲染隐藏的虚拟结构，并把从视频中提取的真实世界边缘作为上下文合成进来，以保留遮挡线索。
works.exercise_en: In phone AR, overlay a 3D model of the 'internal structure' on a real cardboard box, keep the box's outer outline with a stroke, and compare the sense of depth with and without the outline. Twist: make the see-through region follow your finger.

works.title: Interstitial Fragment Processor
works.description: The negative spaces between and within visitors' shadows are cut out and dropped as elastic red and blue objects that fall and collide with sound.
works.idea_zh: 把人与人影子之间的空隙变成会掉落、弹跳、发声的实体。

video.video_title: Interstitial Fragment Processor

works.technique: Silhouettes from background subtraction are analysed for enclosed holes (contour hierarchy / connected components), and those negative-space regions become rigid bodies in a 2D physics engine.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头抠出人影，找到人影中间“围出来”的空洞（如叉腰时手臂和身体间的洞），把空洞变成掉落碰撞的彩色块并发声；变体：大家合作用身体围出一个指定形状（心、星）才能释放它。
works.description_zh: 观众影子之间及影子内部的负空间被剪下，化作富有弹性的红色和蓝色物体掉落下来，碰撞时发出声音。
works.idea_en: Turn the gaps between people's shadows into solid things that fall, bounce and make sounds.
works.technique_zh: 分析背景减除得到的剪影，找出其中被围合的孔洞（轮廓层级/连通域），这些负空间区域在二维物理引擎中成为刚体。
works.exercise_en: Cut out people's shadows from a camera image, find the holes enclosed inside them (like the gap between arm and body with hands on hips), and turn those holes into colored blocks that fall, collide and make sounds. Twist: everyone must cooperate to enclose a given shape (a heart, a star) with their bodies to release it.

works.title: K Two
works.description: An improvised street performance in which two dancers move like video game characters, with glitches, loops and stiff animation cycles, as if the game had leaked into public space.
works.description_zh: 一场即兴街头表演：两位舞者像电子游戏角色一样移动，带着卡顿、循环和僵硬的动画节奏，仿佛游戏泄漏到了公共空间。
works.idea_en: Humans perform the limits of game animation in the street.
works.idea_zh: 真人在街头演出游戏动画的局限。
works.technique: No screens: the choreography is built from the movement grammar of game characters (idle loops, clipping, respawns), turning the body itself into the rendering.
works.technique_zh: 没有屏幕：编舞取材于游戏角色的动作语法（待机循环、穿模、重生），让身体本身成为渲染画面。
works.exercise_en: List five game animation glitches, turn each into a movement rule, and perform them in a corridor while classmates play a game soundtrack. Twist: passers-by can press an imaginary button to trigger a respawn.
works.exercise_zh: 列出五种游戏动画故障，把每种变成一条动作规则，在走廊里表演，同学们播放游戏配乐；变体：路人可以按下一个想象中的按钮，触发角色“重生”。

video.video_title: Cie Nicole Seiler - K Two (2006), Burkina Faso (2016)

works.title: L.A.S.E.R. Tag
works.description: Graffiti Research Lab's system for tagging buildings with a green laser pointer: a camera tracks the laser dot and a high-powered projector paints it as giant graffiti on the facade.
works.idea_zh: 用激光笔在整栋楼上“喷涂鸦”，摄像头追踪光点、投影仪实时画出巨大笔迹。

video.video_title: GRL-LASER_TAG-R&D

works.technique: A camera watches the building, thresholds for the bright green laser dot, maps its position through a camera-to-projector homography, and draws strokes at that point with the projector.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头追踪激光笔或手机手电的亮点，经四点标定后在投影墙上画出粗笔触（p5.js/TouchDesigner）；变体：笔触会根据画的速度变成不同笔刷，比如慢写滴墨、快写喷漆。
works.description_zh: Graffiti Research Lab 开发的系统，可以用绿色激光笔给建筑“涂鸦”：摄像头追踪激光点，大功率投影仪把它在立面上画成巨大的涂鸦。
works.idea_en: Tag a whole building with a laser pointer: a camera tracks the dot and a projector paints giant strokes in real time.
