works.technique_zh: 摄像头对着建筑，通过阈值找出明亮的绿色激光点，经相机-投影仪单应矩阵映射其位置，再由投影仪在该点绘制笔画。
works.exercise_en: Use a camera to track the bright dot of a laser pointer or phone flashlight and, after four-point calibration, paint thick strokes on a projected wall (p5.js or TouchDesigner). Twist: the stroke changes brush with drawing speed, dripping ink when slow and spraying paint when fast.

works.title: La Pietra del paragone (Rossini, Théâtre du Châtelet)
works.description: Singers perform in front of a blue screen on an almost empty stage, while cameras film them and miniature sets on tables; a large screen above shows them live, composited into a tiny painted world. The audience sees both the trick and the illusion at once.
works.description_zh: 歌手们在几乎空荡的舞台上对着蓝幕演唱，摄像机同时拍摄他们和桌上的微缩布景；上方的大屏幕实时播出合成画面，歌手被放进一个小小的彩绘世界。观众同时看到了把戏和幻象。
works.idea_en: Showing the real stage and the composited image side by side turns the seam into the show, a model for AR performances where the audience watches both the performer and the augmented feed.
works.idea_zh: 把真实舞台和合成画面并排呈现，接缝本身就成了表演——这是 AR 演出的一种模式：观众同时看表演者和增强后的画面。
works.technique: Live chroma key: stage cameras film singers against blue, other cameras film scale models, and a real-time keyer composites them on a big screen (staging by Giorgio Barberio Corsetti, video by Sorin).
works.technique_zh: 实时抠像：舞台摄像机在蓝幕前拍摄歌手，另一些摄像机拍摄比例模型，由实时抠像设备在大屏上合成（导演 Giorgio Barberio Corsetti，影像设计 Sorin）。
works.exercise_en: Film a classmate on a green cloth with one phone while a second phone films a shoebox diorama, and composite them live in OBS or Lens Studio on a projector. Twist: let the performer pick up a real prop that becomes giant in the diorama.
works.exercise_zh: 用一台手机在绿布前拍同学，另一台手机拍一个鞋盒微缩场景，用 OBS 或 Lens Studio 在投影上实时合成；变体：让表演者拿起一件真实道具，在微缩场景里它变成巨物。

video.video_title: La Pietra del paragone - Pierrick Sorin

works.title: Low-Cost Multi-touch Whiteboard using the Wiimote
works.description: A Wii Remote pointed at a projected image tracks pens with an infrared LED in the tip, turning any wall or screen into an interactive whiteboard with up to four pens for about the cost of the controller.
works.description_zh: 把 Wii 遥控器对准投影画面，它会追踪笔尖装有红外 LED 的笔，让任何墙面或屏幕都变成可同时用四支笔的互动白板，成本几乎只是一个手柄。
works.idea_en: Turn any projected wall into a touch surface with a game controller and a homemade pen.
works.idea_zh: 用一个游戏手柄加一支自制笔，把任何投影墙变成触控表面。
works.technique: The controller's IR camera sees the pen tips as bright blobs; a four-corner calibration maps camera coordinates to screen coordinates, which drive mouse events.
works.technique_zh: 手柄的红外相机把笔尖看成亮点；通过四角校准把相机坐标映射到屏幕坐标，再转成鼠标事件。
works.exercise_en: Make a projected drawing wall: use a webcam to track a bright LED or phone flashlight on a projected sketch in p5.js, calibrated with four corner clicks. Twist: let two pens draw in different colours.
works.exercise_zh: 做一面投影画墙：用摄像头追踪 LED 或手机闪光灯的亮点，在 p5.js 投影画面上作画，用四角点击完成校准。变体：让两支笔画出不同颜色。

video.video_title: Low-Cost Multi-touch Whiteboard using the Wiimote

works.title: Magic Wave
works.description: Hundreds of hanging points driven by a stack of turning wheels trace an undulating sheet that looks like ocean swell frozen in wood and string; the video shows how it is built.
works.description_zh: 数百个悬挂点由一叠转动的轮子驱动，勾勒出一张起伏的面，像被木头和绳子定格的海浪；视频展示了它的搭建过程。
works.idea_en: Seeing the mechanism beside the effect teaches AR designers to expose the 'engine' of an effect as part of the experience.
works.idea_zh: 把机械结构和效果并置展示，提醒 AR 设计者可以把效果背后的“引擎”也作为体验的一部分展示出来。
works.technique: Rotating eccentric wheels act as wave generators and a network of strings mechanically adds their motions at each hanging point (year approximate).
works.technique_zh: 偏心轮的转动充当波的发生器，绳网在每个悬挂点上机械地叠加它们的运动（年份为估计）。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR scene where three virtual wheels hover beside a hanging mesh and visibly drive it through connecting lines. Twist: let viewers grab a wheel and change its speed.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 中做三个悬浮的虚拟轮子，通过可见的连线驱动旁边一张悬挂的网面。变体：让观众抓住轮子改变转速。

video.video_title: Constructing the Magic Wave

works.title: NORMAN
works.description: A tribute to animator Norman McLaren, made with the National Film Board of Canada: dancer Peter Trosztmer performs with drawn lines, animated figures and multiplied images of himself projected around him, as if he had stepped into a McLaren film.
works.description_zh: 这是向动画大师 Norman McLaren 致敬的作品，与加拿大国家电影局合作：舞者 Peter Trosztmer 与投射在身边的手绘线条、动画人物和自己的多重影像共舞，仿佛走进了一部 McLaren 的影片。
works.idea_en: Hand-drawn animation next to a real dancer shows that AR does not have to be photoreal; a line that reacts to a body is already magic.
works.idea_zh: 手绘动画与真人舞者同台，说明 AR 不必追求照片级真实；一条会回应身体的线本身就是魔法。
works.technique: Pre-rendered and likely partly cued animations are projected on transparent screens and the back wall, choreographed to the dancer's positions on stage.
works.technique_zh: 预渲染、很可能部分实时触发的动画投在透明幕和后墙上，与舞者在台上的位置编排一致。
works.exercise_en: Draw a short loop in a hand-drawn style (Procreate or paper, scanned) and attach it to a person's hand with hand tracking in Lens Studio or MediaPipe. Twist: the drawing is left behind in space like a trail whenever the hand stops.
works.exercise_zh: 用手绘风格画一小段循环动画（Procreate 或纸上画好再扫描），用 Lens Studio 或 MediaPipe 的手部追踪把它挂在人的手上；变体：手一停下，画就会像轨迹一样留在空中。

video.video_title: Lemieux Pilon 4D Art - NORMAN (2007)

works.title: Out of Bounds
works.description: An 'x-ray torch' at the Design Museum London: shining a handheld light on the wall projects what lies behind it, as if boring through the museum's walls.
works.idea_zh: 拿着“X光手电筒”照墙，就能看到墙后面隐藏的空间。

video.video_title: Out of Bounds

works.technique: A camera tracks the position of the handheld torch's light spot on the wall, and the projector reveals a hidden image layer only inside a circular mask at that position.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头追踪手电筒在墙上的光斑，投影只在光斑处显示一张“墙后面”的图（管道、老鼠、隔壁教室）；变体：墙后的世界会慢慢察觉被照，开始躲避光。
works.description_zh: 伦敦设计博物馆里的一支“X 光手电筒”：用手持光源照向墙面，就会投出墙后面的景象，仿佛钻透了博物馆的墙壁。
works.idea_en: Shine an 'X-ray flashlight' at the wall to see the hidden space behind it.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪手电筒在墙上的光斑位置，投影仪只在该位置的圆形遮罩内显示一层隐藏的图像。
works.exercise_en: Use a camera to track a flashlight's spot on the wall and project a 'behind the wall' image (pipes, mice, the classroom next door) only inside the spot. Twist: the world behind the wall slowly notices it is being watched and starts to dodge the light.

salient.why_en: Shine an X-ray flashlight at a wall and see the hidden room behind it.
salient.why_zh: 用一支 X 光手电照向墙壁，就能看到墙后隐藏的空间。

works.title: Peg Mirror
works.description: 650 cylindrical wooden pegs with angled cut faces rotate so their shading forms the viewer's portrait in a circular composition.
works.idea_zh: 木钉旋转斜切面，用阴影拼出人像
works.technique: Each peg's cut face catches different light depending on rotation; a camera image sets each peg's angle via motors.
works.exercise_zh: 把斜切的木块或纸筒装在舵机上，比较不同角度的明暗，再用摄像头控制做3×3原型；变化：改为控制声音的“听觉镜子”。

video.video_title: "Peg Mirror" (2007) by Daniel Rozin

works.description_zh: 650 根带斜切面的圆柱形木钉各自旋转，用斜面上的明暗在圆形构图中拼出观众的肖像。
works.idea_en: Wooden pegs turn their angled faces to build a portrait out of shadows.
works.technique_zh: 每根木钉的切面随旋转角度不同而接收到不同的光线；摄像头画面通过电机设定每根木钉的角度。
works.exercise_en: Mount angled-cut wooden blocks or paper tubes on servos, compare how light and dark they look at different angles, then build a 3x3 prototype controlled by a camera. Twist: turn it into an 'audio mirror' that controls sound instead.

works.title: Poetic Cosmos of the Breath
works.description: A large balloon sewn from plastic bags rose over a field in the UK, heated only by the sun, as an early step toward Saraceno's ideas of floating cities.
works.description_zh: 一个用塑料袋缝制的大气球只靠阳光加热，在英国的一片田野上空升起，是 Saraceno“漂浮城市”构想的早期一步。
works.idea_en: Everyday waste turned into a flying object shows how humble materials can carry big visions, an attitude useful for low-tech AR prototypes.
works.idea_zh: 把日常废弃物变成飞行物，说明朴素的材料也能承载宏大的愿景，这种态度对低技术 AR 原型很有用。
works.technique: Plastic bags were taped together into a huge envelope; black bags absorb heat so the air inside becomes buoyant.
works.technique_zh: 塑料袋被胶带拼接成巨大的球囊；黑色袋子吸热，使内部空气产生浮力。
works.exercise_en: Scan crumpled plastic bags and use them as the texture of a huge AR balloon floating over the school. Twist: each student adds one 'bag' to the balloon, and it rises only once it has enough.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描揉皱的塑料袋，把它们作为纹理贴在一个漂浮于学校上空的巨大 AR 气球上；变体：每位学生为气球添加一只“袋子”，数量足够后它才会升起。

video.video_title: Poetic Cosmos of the Breath, Tomas Saraceno, 2007 (The Arts Catalyst)

works.title: Point A to B
works.description: A dual-screen installation inspired by parkour, in which virtual traceurs race through a vertiginous world where the two projections rarely line up and the space between them opens like a chasm.
works.description_zh: 一件受跑酷启发的双屏装置：虚拟跑酷者在令人眩晕的世界中疾驰，两块投影很少对齐，中间的空隙像一道深渊。
works.idea_en: Split one virtual space across two screens so the gap itself becomes part of the course.
works.idea_zh: 把一个虚拟空间拆到两块屏幕上，让屏幕之间的空隙本身成为赛道的一部分。
works.technique: Motion-captured parkour runs drive figures in a real-time renderer built on Field, displayed across two parallel projections that only occasionally form one panorama.
works.technique_zh: 动捕跑酷数据驱动基于 Field 的实时渲染器中的人物，画面分布在两块平行投影上，只偶尔拼成一幅全景。
works.exercise_en: Place two tablets or projections a metre apart and animate a runner who jumps from one to the other, timing the jump so the empty gap feels dangerous. Twist: let viewers widen the gap by moving one screen.
works.exercise_zh: 把两台平板或两块投影相隔一米摆放，做一个从一边跳到另一边的奔跑者动画，控制好跳跃时间，让中间的空当显得危险；变体：观众挪动一块屏幕就能加宽空隙。

video.video_title: Point A to B (excerpts, installation visualization)

works.title: Reface [Portrait Sequencer]
works.description: A face-tracking mirror that records slices of visitors' eyes, brows and mouths and remixes them into endless 'exquisite corpse' composite faces; blinking advances the combinations.
works.idea_zh: 像“拼贴人头”游戏的魔镜：把不同观众的眼、眉、嘴实时拼成新面孔，眨眼即切换。

video.video_title: Face-Scrambling Interactive Artwork

works.technique: Face tracking aligns each visitor's face to a canonical frame, horizontal strips (eyes, nose, mouth) are recorded as video slices, and blink detection triggers recombination of strips from different people.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 对齐人脸，把眼、鼻、嘴三条横带分别存下来，眨眼就随机拼一张全班的“合成脸”；变体：拼接规则由情绪决定，比如只拼所有人在笑时的嘴。
works.description_zh: 一面人脸追踪镜子，记录观众眼睛、眉毛和嘴巴的片段，把它们重新混编成无穷无尽的“精致尸体”式合成人脸；眨一下眼，组合就会切换。
works.idea_en: A magic mirror like an exquisite-corpse game: it mixes different visitors' eyes, brows and mouths into new faces live, and a blink switches them.
works.technique_zh: 人脸追踪把每位观众的脸对齐到标准坐标系，将横向条带（眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴）录制为视频切片，眨眼检测则触发把不同人的条带重新组合。
works.exercise_en: Align faces with MediaPipe Face Mesh, save three horizontal strips (eyes, nose, mouth) separately, and let each blink randomly assemble a 'composite face' from the whole class. Twist: let emotion set the splicing rule, such as using only mouths caught while everyone is smiling.

works.title: Rubber Duck
works.description: A giant yellow rubber duck, up to 26 metres tall, has floated in more than twenty harbours since 2007, from Saint-Nazaire and Osaka to Hong Kong and Sydney, drawing crowds to the waterfront.
works.description_zh: 一只高达 26 米的巨型黄色橡皮鸭自 2007 年起在二十多个港口漂浮过，从圣纳泽尔、大阪到香港和悉尼，把人群吸引到水边。
works.idea_en: Scaling up a bath toy makes the city look like a bathtub, a perfect example of how size change alone creates a new story in AR.
works.idea_zh: 把一个浴缸玩具放大，让整座城市看起来像个浴缸，完美说明了只靠尺度变化就能在 AR 中创造新故事。
works.technique: A PVC inflatable is mounted on a floating pontoon and inflated with blowers, then towed around the harbour.
works.technique_zh: PVC 充气体安装在浮筒上，用鼓风机充气，然后在港内拖行。
works.exercise_en: Scan a small everyday object and place it at 20 metres tall in a real body of water or a plaza in AR. Twist: the object bobs to the rhythm of live wave or wind data.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描一件日常小物，在 AR 中把它以 20 米的高度放在真实的水面或广场上；变体：物体随实时波浪或风数据的节奏起伏。

video.video_title: Rubber Duck

salient.why_en: A bath toy blown up to building size turns the whole harbour into a bathtub.
salient.why_zh: 把洗澡用的橡皮鸭放大到楼房那么高，整个港口就成了浴缸。

works.title: The Eye of Judgment
works.description: Physical trading cards laid on a 3x3 mat are read by the PlayStation Eye, and the creatures on them rise up as animated 3D monsters that fight on the TV image of the table.
works.idea_zh: 把实体卡牌对战升级：卡片上的怪兽在电视里的桌面上立体现身开战。

video.video_title: The Eye of Judgment PlayStation 3 Trailer - E3 2007 Trailer

works.technique: CyberCode markers on each card are decoded by an overhead camera to identify the card and its grid cell, and animated creatures are rendered on the video of the mat.
works.exercise_zh: 制作 4 张带不同图像标记的卡片，放在 2×2 格子上时召唤对应角色，并根据相邻关系判定胜负；变体：卡片旋转方向决定角色面朝哪边。
works.description_zh: 实体集换卡牌放在一张 3×3 的垫子上，由 PlayStation Eye 读取，卡上的生物化作带动画的 3D 怪兽站起来，在电视画面中的桌面上展开战斗。
works.idea_en: Level up physical card battles: the monsters on the cards appear in 3D and fight on the table shown on TV.
works.technique_zh: 俯拍摄像头解码每张卡上的 CyberCode 标记，识别卡片及其所在格子，并在垫子的视频画面上渲染带动画的生物。
works.exercise_en: Make four cards with different image markers that summon matching characters when placed on a 2x2 grid, and decide the winner from which cards sit next to each other. Twist: a card's rotation decides which way its character faces.

works.title: Tracking Fingers with the Wii Remote
works.description: An infrared LED ring lights up reflective tape on the fingertips so a Wii Remote can follow them; waving fingers in the air drags and scales items on a grid, a Minority Report style interface built from a game controller.
works.description_zh: 一圈红外 LED 照亮指尖的反光胶带，让 Wii 遥控器跟踪手指；在空中挥动手指就能拖动、缩放网格中的内容，用游戏手柄做出《少数派报告》式的界面。
works.idea_en: Mid-air gesture control from a game controller, some LEDs and reflective tape.
works.idea_zh: 用游戏手柄、几颗 LED 和反光胶带实现隔空手势操控。
works.technique: An IR LED array next to the Wii Remote illuminates retro-reflective tape; the controller's built-in blob tracker reports up to four points at 100 Hz to a C# and DirectX program.
works.technique_zh: Wii 遥控器旁的红外 LED 阵列照亮回归反光胶带，手柄内置的光点追踪以 100 Hz 输出最多四个点，交给 C# 与 DirectX 程序。
works.exercise_en: Prototype a two-finger mid-air zoom: put coloured tape on thumb and index finger, track both with a webcam in p5.js and map their distance to the zoom of a photo. Twist: add a pinch gesture that 'grabs' the image.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个隔空双指缩放原型：在拇指和食指上贴彩色胶带，用 p5.js 通过摄像头追踪，把两点距离映射为图片缩放。变体：加一个捏合手势来“抓住”图片。

video.video_title: Tracking fingers with the Wii Remote

works.title: Video Dress (for Hussein Chalayan)
works.description: A dress embedded with thousands of LEDs plays soft, low-resolution video of sea and flowers across its surface, so the garment becomes a moving screen worn on the body.
works.description_zh: 一条嵌入数千颗 LED 的裙子，表面播放柔和的低分辨率海浪和花朵影像，服装成了穿在身上的移动屏幕。
works.idea_en: Clothing as a display: the body carries its own moving image.
works.idea_zh: 把衣服当显示屏：身体携带着自己的动态影像。
works.technique: LED matrices sewn under a diffusing fabric layer are driven as a flexible low-resolution display playing prerecorded video.
works.technique_zh: 缝在柔光面料下的 LED 矩阵被当作柔性低分辨率显示器，播放预录视频。
works.exercise_en: Tape an LED strip or a phone flashlight array under a piece of translucent fabric and design a 10-second 'video' that suits the garment. Twist: make the pattern react to the wearer's movement with a phone accelerometer.
works.exercise_zh: 把 LED 灯带或几部手机的闪光灯贴在半透明布料下，为这件“衣服”设计一段 10 秒的“视频”；变体：用手机加速度计让图案随穿着者的动作变化。

video.video_title: Hussein Chalayan's Video Dress

works.title: Visuo-Haptic Augmented Reality
works.description: Wearing a video see-through headset, a user paints on a virtual object while a haptic stylus lets them feel its surface exactly where they see it.
works.description_zh: 戴着视频透视头显的用户在虚拟物体上作画，触觉笔让他在看到的地方准确地摸到物体表面。
works.idea_en: See and touch the same virtual object in the same place.
works.idea_zh: 在同一个位置，同时看见并触摸同一个虚拟物体。
works.technique: Co-locates a PHANToM-style haptic device with graphics rendered in a video see-through HMD, which outperformed half-mirror setups in the study.
works.technique_zh: 把 PHANToM 类触觉设备与视频透视头显中渲染的图形放在同一位置；实验中，这种方式的表现优于半透镜方案。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a virtual pot in phone AR on top of a real cup, then paint the pot on screen while your other hand feels the cup. Twist: offset the virtual pot by a few centimetres and note when touch and sight stop matching.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中把一个虚拟陶罐锚定在真实杯子上，一只手在屏幕上给陶罐上色，另一只手摸着杯子；变体：让虚拟陶罐偏离几厘米，记录何时触觉与视觉开始对不上。

video.video_title: Visuo-Haptic Augmented Reality

works.title: Weave Mirror
works.description: 768 C-shaped laminated prints rotate like woven strands to form a basket-like live reflection of the viewer.
works.idea_zh: 像编织一样把你的影像“织”出来
works.technique: Camera pixels drive motors that rotate each gradient-printed C-shape, exposing darker or lighter portions of the print.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一张黑白渐变纸条，贴在可旋转的圆柱上，用摄像头亮度控制旋转角度；变化：用颜色渐变代替黑白，做彩色镜像。

video.video_title: "Weave Mirror" (2007) by Daniel Rozin

works.description_zh: 768 个 C 形覆膜印刷片像编织的线股一样旋转，形成一幅如同篮筐编织般的观众实时镜像。
works.idea_en: Weave your image into being, strand by strand.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头像素驱动电机，旋转每个印有渐变的 C 形片，露出印刷面上较暗或较亮的部分。
works.exercise_en: Print a black-to-white gradient strip, wrap it around a rotating cylinder, and use camera brightness to control the rotation angle. Twist: use a color gradient instead of black and white to make a color mirror.

works.title: Webcam Piano
works.description: A webcam turns the space in front of a screen into an invisible grid of notes; body movement plays harmonious, classical-sounding music visualized as fluid.
works.idea_zh: 摄像头把空气变成隐形钢琴，挥动身体就能演奏和谐的音乐。

video.video_title: Webcam Piano 1.0 with fluids

works.technique: Frame differencing or optical flow over a grid of screen cells detects motion per cell, and each active cell triggers a note quantised to a musical scale, visualised with a fluid simulation.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 把摄像头画面切成 8×8 格子，哪格有运动就按五声音阶弹对应音符；变体：换一套音阶和音色，让一种特定动作（如扫地）变成一首歌。
works.description_zh: 网络摄像头把屏幕前的空间变成一张看不见的音符网格；身体的动作会奏出和谐的、带古典韵味的音乐，并以流体的形式呈现出来。
works.idea_en: A webcam turns the air into an invisible piano, so waving your body plays harmonious music.
works.technique_zh: 在屏幕单元格网格上用帧差或光流检测每个单元格内的运动，每个被激活的单元格触发一个量化到音阶上的音符，并用流体模拟进行可视化。
works.exercise_en: Use p5.js to split the camera image into an 8x8 grid and play the matching pentatonic note wherever there is motion. Twist: switch the scale and timbre so one specific action (such as sweeping the floor) becomes a song.

works.title: levelHead
works.description: A spatial memory game: tilting a real cube with printed markers moves a tiny character through rooms that appear inside the cube on screen.
works.idea_zh: 手中的方块里藏着多个房间，转动实物方块来引导小人

video.video_title: Julian Oliver : levelHead -  Interactive Game 2007

works.technique: ARToolKit fiducial markers on each cube face give the cube's 6DoF pose, and the tilt angle drives a physics-based character moving between rooms rendered inside the cube.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一个每面贴着不同图像标记的纸盒，用 MindAR 或 AR Foundation 在盒内渲染小房间，倾斜盒子让小球滚到下一个房间；变体：把房间做成自己童年记忆中的空间，走完才能拼出一个故事。
works.description_zh: 一款空间记忆游戏：倾斜一个印有标记的真实方块，就能让一个小人穿过屏幕上方块内部的一个个房间。
works.idea_en: Several rooms hide inside a cube in your hand, and turning the real cube guides a little figure through them.
works.technique_zh: 方块每个面上的 ARToolKit 基准标记给出方块的 6DoF 位姿，倾斜角度驱动一个基于物理的角色在方块内部渲染的房间之间移动。
works.exercise_en: Print a paper box with a different image marker on each face, use MindAR or AR Foundation to render small rooms inside it, and tilt the box to roll a ball into the next room. Twist: make the rooms spaces from your childhood memories, so a story comes together only once you have gone through them all.

salient.why_en: Rooms hide inside a cube in your hand, and tilting the real cube walks a tiny figure through them.
salient.why_zh: 几个房间藏在你手中的方块里，倾斜真实的方块就能带小人穿过它们。

works.title: 16 [R]evolutions
works.description: Four characters caught between animal and intellect are tracked by live cameras, and their movements generate real-time 3D imagery and sound that grow, trail and mutate around them.
works.description_zh: 四个在动物性与理性之间挣扎的角色被现场摄像机追踪，他们的动作实时生成 3D 影像与声音，在他们周围生长、拖尾、变形。
works.idea_en: Each gesture leaves a living 3D trace that becomes part of the set.
works.idea_zh: 每一个动作都留下一道活的 3D 痕迹，成为布景的一部分。
works.technique: Camera tracking of body points feeds Isadora and custom 3D rendering so dancers interactively manipulate the video and audio, as explained in the company's technology clip.
works.technique_zh: 对身体关键点的摄像头追踪数据输入 Isadora 和定制的 3D 渲染，让舞者交互式地操控影像与音频（舞团的技术短片有详细说明）。
works.exercise_en: Track one wrist with MediaPipe and draw a 3D ribbon in Three.js that follows it and never disappears, projected behind the dancer. Twist: ribbons from two dancers merge when they touch.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 追踪一只手腕，在 Three.js 中画出一条跟随它、永不消失的 3D 丝带，并投影在舞者身后；变体：两位舞者相碰时，他们的丝带融为一体。

video.video_title: 16 [R]evolutions (excerpt 2006)

works.title: A Human Conversation
works.description: A piece for five dancers built from sign language, gesture and touch, in which the performers' conversation of hands and bodies is turned into music by composer Dan Hosken's interactive score.
works.description_zh: 五位舞者以手语、手势和触碰构成的作品：舞者之间用手和身体进行的“对话”，被作曲家 Dan Hosken 的互动配乐转化为音乐。
works.idea_en: Let a silent conversation of gestures be heard as music.
works.idea_zh: 让一场无声的手势对话被听成音乐。
works.technique: Camera-based motion tracking with EyeCon and Palindrome's skin-contact sensors send gesture and touch data to a music computer, which plays and shapes the score live.
works.technique_zh: EyeCon 摄像追踪和 Palindrome 的皮肤接触传感器把手势与触碰数据发给音乐电脑，由它实时演奏并塑造配乐。
works.exercise_en: Teach pairs of students five signs, track their hands with MediaPipe in the browser, and map each recognised sign to a sound layer so a short signed dialogue becomes a duet. Twist: only play sound when both partners sign at the same time.
works.exercise_zh: 教每组学生五个手语动作，在浏览器里用 MediaPipe 追踪手部，把识别出的每个手势映射到一个声音层，让一段手语对话变成二重奏；变体：只有两人同时打手语时才发声。

video.video_title: A Human Conversation

works.title: AntiVJ - projection on building
works.description: An early experiment projecting live visuals onto a building and playing with its existing architecture, a seed of the AntiVJ label's mapping style.
works.idea_zh: 早期把实时视觉投到建筑上并与其结构互动的实验

video.video_title: AntiVJ - projection on building

works.technique: Early manual projection mapping: live VJ software output is masked and keystoned by hand to fit building features, with visuals designed around the existing architecture.
works.exercise_zh: 用一台投影仪和 VJ 软件（Resolume / TouchDesigner），手动遮罩一面有窗户的外墙并现场演一段 3 分钟的视觉；变体：每扇窗户都成为一个独立的“角色”，彼此之间传递图形。
works.description_zh: 一次把实时影像投射到建筑上、并与其既有结构互动的早期实验，也是 AntiVJ 厂牌投影映射风格的起点。
works.idea_en: An early experiment projecting live visuals onto a building and playing with its structure.
works.technique_zh: 早期的手动投影映射：现场 VJ 软件的输出经手工遮罩和梯形校正以贴合建筑特征，画面围绕既有建筑结构来设计。
works.exercise_en: Use one projector and VJ software (Resolume or TouchDesigner) to hand-mask an outside wall with windows, and perform a 3-minute visual set live. Twist: make each window an independent 'character' that passes graphics to the others.

works.title: Close-Up (ShadowBox 2)
works.description: The viewer's shadow on a screen is filled with up to 800 tiny surveillance videos of people who recently looked at the piece — and the viewer is recorded for the next person.
works.idea_zh: 你的影子里装满了之前看过这件作品的人的监控视频
works.technique: A camera records each viewer while their silhouette mask reveals a mosaic of previously recorded viewer clips; the database keeps the most recent 10,000.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头边录每个来访者，边把人影轮廓填满之前录下的小视频网格；变化：影子只显示与当前观众同一天来访的人。

video.video_title: Close-Up

works.description_zh: 观众投在屏幕上的影子里，填满了多达 800 段最近看过这件作品的人的微型监控视频，而观众自己也会被录下来，留给下一个人。
works.idea_en: Your shadow is filled with surveillance videos of everyone who looked at the piece before you.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头录下每位观众，同时用他们的剪影遮罩显露出由此前录制的观众片段组成的马赛克；数据库保留最近的 10000 段。
works.exercise_en: Use a camera to record each visitor while filling their silhouette with a grid of small videos recorded earlier. Twist: the shadow shows only people who visited on the same day as the current viewer.

works.title: Cloud Gate
works.description: A 10-metre, 110-ton mirror-polished steel bean in Chicago's Millennium Park reflects the skyline, the clouds and the crowds walking under its arch, distorting them in its curves.
works.description_zh: 芝加哥千禧公园中一颗高 10 米、重 110 吨的镜面不锈钢“豆子”映出天际线、云朵和在拱下行走的人群，并在曲面中扭曲它们。
works.idea_en: A mirror object puts the public and the city inside the sculpture; people come to see themselves, which is also why AR mirror filters spread.
works.idea_zh: 镜面物体把公众和城市放进雕塑里；人们来这里是为了看见自己，这也是 AR 镜像滤镜传播的原因。
works.technique: 168 stainless steel plates were welded and polished until the seams disappeared, creating a continuous curved mirror.
works.technique_zh: 168 块不锈钢板被焊接并抛光到接缝消失，形成一个连续的曲面镜。
works.exercise_en: Place a large AR blob with a real-time environment-reflection material in a plaza and let friends gather under it to see their distorted reflection. Twist: the blob slowly morphs its shape to exaggerate whoever is closest.
works.exercise_zh: 在广场上放置一个使用实时环境反射材质的巨大 AR 团块，让朋友们聚在下面看自己扭曲的倒影；变体：团块会慢慢变形，夸张地放大离它最近的人。

video.video_title: Artist Anish Kapoor on his "Bean"

works.title: Eye Contact (ShadowBox 1)
works.description: A display shows hundreds of tiny videos of people lying down; when a viewer is detected, all of them wake up and turn to stare directly at the viewer.
works.idea_zh: 你一出现，屏幕里的上百个人同时醒来盯着你
works.technique: A built-in camera detects the viewer's presence and silhouette, switching each video tile from its idle loop to a 'turn and look' clip.
works.exercise_zh: 让每位同学录一段“睡着→转头看镜头”的视频拼成网格，用摄像头检测到人就触发；变化：只有影子覆盖的格子里的人会醒来。

video.video_title: Eye Contact

works.description_zh: 一块显示屏上排列着数百段人们躺着的微型视频；一旦检测到有观众，他们会全部醒来，转过头直直地盯着观众。
works.idea_en: The moment you show up, hundreds of people on the screen wake up together and stare at you.
works.technique_zh: 内置摄像头检测观众的出现及其剪影，把每个视频格子从待机循环切换到“转头注视”的片段。
works.exercise_en: Have each classmate record a 'fall asleep, then turn to look at the camera' clip, assemble them into a grid, and trigger it when the camera detects a person. Twist: only the people in cells covered by a shadow wake up.

works.title: Footfalls
works.description: Stomping on the floor makes cascades of bouncy virtual objects fall from a six-metre projection; visitors catch and throw them with their silhouettes.
works.idea_zh: 跺脚越用力，天上掉下的虚拟物体越多，还能用影子接住扔回去。

video.video_title: Footfalls (2006) by Golan Levin and Zachary Lieberman

works.technique: Floor-mounted contact microphones detect stomp onsets and amplitude, spawning physics objects, while camera-based silhouette extraction provides collision boundaries for catching them.
works.exercise_zh: 用笔记本麦克风检测跺脚或拍手的音量峰值，每次峰值从投影墙顶部掉下一批物体，人的轮廓能接住它们；变体：不同力度掉下不同东西，比如轻跺落花、重跺落石。
works.description_zh: 在地板上跺脚，六米高的投影中就会落下一连串富有弹性的虚拟物体；观众可以用自己的剪影接住它们、再扔回去。
works.idea_en: The harder you stomp, the more virtual objects fall from the sky, and you can catch them with your shadow and throw them back.
works.technique_zh: 安装在地板上的接触式麦克风检测跺脚的起始时刻和振幅，据此生成物理对象；同时基于摄像头的剪影提取为接住这些物体提供碰撞边界。
works.exercise_en: Use a laptop microphone to detect volume peaks from stomps or claps, dropping a batch of objects from the top of the projected wall at each peak, and let people's outlines catch them. Twist: different strengths drop different things, such as petals for a light stomp and rocks for a hard one.

works.title: Glow (Chunky Move)
works.description: A 27-minute solo for Chunky Move in which a dancer lies and writhes on a white floor while projections react to her body, outlining it, stretching light from her limbs and hunting her with shadows.
works.description_zh: 为 Chunky Move 创作的 27 分钟独舞：舞者在白色地面上躺卧、扭动，投影随她的身体实时变化，勾勒轮廓、从四肢拉出光线，又用阴影追逐她。
works.idea_en: Light that behaves like a living skin, growing out of the body's silhouette.
works.idea_zh: 像活皮肤一样的光，从身体的轮廓里长出来。
works.technique: An overhead infrared camera segments the dancer's silhouette and Weiss's EyeCon-derived software draws contours, particles and fields from it, projected back onto the floor from above with minimal latency.
works.technique_zh: 顶部红外摄像头分割出舞者的剪影，Weiss 基于 EyeCon 的软件据此绘制轮廓、粒子和场，再以极低延迟从上方投回地面。
works.exercise_en: Mount a phone or webcam above a white sheet, segment the person lying on it, and project an outline that grows lines from their extremities. Twist: the light must slowly lag behind, like a memory of the pose.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机或摄像头架在一块白布上方，分割出躺在上面的人，投影出从肢体末端长出线条的轮廓；变体：让光慢慢滞后，像是对姿势的记忆。

video.video_title: Chunky Move - Glow

works.title: Hand of God
works.description: An indoor commander points at a map on a tabletop, and the outdoor AR user sees a giant 3D hand descend from the sky to show where to go or what to pick up.
works.description_zh: 室内指挥者在桌面地图上指点，户外的 AR 用户就会看到一只巨大的三维手从天而降，指示该去哪里或拿什么。
works.idea_en: Remote guidance delivered as a giant hand reaching down from the sky.
works.idea_zh: 把远程指导变成一只从天空伸下来的巨手。
works.technique: Captures the indoor user's hand and props on the tabletop as 3D video and renders them geolocated and scaled up in the outdoor user's Tinmith view.
works.technique_zh: 把室内用户在桌面上的手和道具捕捉为三维视频，按地理位置放大后渲染到户外用户的 Tinmith 视图中。
works.exercise_en: Have an indoor student point at a printed campus map on a video call, then show a giant hand image anchored above the pointed spot in the outdoor partner's phone AR. Twist: let the indoor student drop small toy props that appear outdoors.
works.exercise_zh: 让室内学生在视频通话中指着打印的校园地图，户外同伴的手机 AR 就在被指的位置上方显示一只巨手图像；变体：让室内学生放下小玩具道具，它们会出现在户外。

video.video_title: HOG-2006-pointing_gesture.mpg

works.title: Hungarian Parliament 1956–2006
works.description: For the 50th anniversary of the 1956 Hungarian revolution, images were projected across about 10,000 square metres of the Parliament building in Budapest with 18 high-power Pani projectors, one of the early large architectural projections in Europe.
works.description_zh: 为纪念 1956 年匈牙利革命 50 周年，他们用 18 台大功率 Pani 投影机，把影像投射到布达佩斯国会大厦约一万平方米的立面上，是欧洲早期的大型建筑投影之一。
works.idea_en: A building connected to a historical event is the best screen for remembering it: AR memorials can place archive images on the very place where things happened.
works.idea_zh: 与历史事件相关的建筑，是纪念这段历史的最佳屏幕：AR 纪念作品可以把档案影像放回事件发生的原地。
works.technique: High-power large-format projectors (Pani, likely using slides or early digital sources) are aligned to the Parliament facade to cover it with historical imagery.
works.technique_zh: 用大功率大画幅投影机（Pani，推测使用幻灯片或早期数字片源）对齐国会大厦立面，覆盖上历史影像。
works.exercise_en: Find an archive photo taken on your campus and use image or geo anchoring (8th Wall, ARKit) to place it exactly where it was shot, so viewers can compare then and now. Twist: fade between old and new as the viewer walks closer.
works.exercise_zh: 找一张在校园里拍的老照片，用图像或地理锚点（8th Wall、ARKit）把它放回拍摄原位，让观众比较过去和现在；变体：随着观众走近，画面在新旧之间渐变。

video.video_title: 3D Projection Mapping, Hungarian Parliament, Budapest, 1956-2006

works.title: Jenseits der Schatten
works.description: An opera by Vladimir Tarnopolsky on Plato's cave allegory, directed by Robert Wechsler for Bonn Opera, in which singers and dancers move on stepped platforms while interactive projections and shadows answer their movement.
works.description_zh: Vladimir Tarnopolsky 以柏拉图洞穴寓言为题的歌剧，由 Robert Wechsler 为波恩歌剧院执导：歌手和舞者在阶梯平台上移动，互动投影和影子回应他们的动作。
works.idea_en: Stage Plato's cave literally: the audience watches bodies and the shadows the system makes of them.
works.idea_zh: 把柏拉图的洞穴真正搬上舞台：观众看到的是身体，以及系统为这些身体生成的影子。
works.technique: Camera tracking by Frieder Weiss and Diana Wildschut drives projected shadow and light imagery on the set in real time, likely using EyeCon and Kalypso.
works.technique_zh: 由 Frieder Weiss 和 Diana Wildschut 设计的摄像追踪实时驱动布景上的投影影子和光影，推测使用 EyeCon 与 Kalypso。
works.exercise_en: Build a shadow cave with a projector and a webcam: record each visitor's silhouette and replay it a few seconds later beside them, so they meet their delayed shadow. Twist: let the shadow slowly drift away from the body when the person stands still.
works.exercise_zh: 用投影仪和网络摄像头搭一个“影子洞穴”：录下每位参与者的剪影，几秒后在其身旁回放，让他们遇见延迟的自己；变体：当人站着不动时，让影子慢慢离开身体。

video.video_title: Jenseits der Schatten

works.title: John McEnroe hologram (Wimbledon Lawn Tennis Museum)
works.description: In the gentlemen's dressing room of the new Wimbledon Lawn Tennis Museum, a virtual John McEnroe appears among the real lockers and talks visitors through the history of the room and the championship. Year of museum opening; video uploaded 2008.
works.description_zh: 在新的温布尔登草地网球博物馆的男子更衣室里，一个虚拟的约翰·麦肯罗出现在真实的储物柜之间，向观众讲述这个房间和锦标赛的历史。年份为博物馆开馆年，视频上传于 2008 年。
works.idea_en: A virtual guide placed in the exact room where history happened is more convincing than any screen; AR museum guides should stand in the space, not in a panel.
works.idea_zh: 一个出现在历史发生之处的虚拟向导，比任何屏幕都更有说服力；AR 博物馆导览应该站在空间里，而不是待在面板上。
works.technique: A hidden projector and angled foil (Pepper's ghost) place pre-recorded footage of McEnroe inside the real dressing-room set.
works.technique_zh: 隐藏的投影机和倾斜薄膜（佩珀尔幻象）把麦肯罗的预录影像放进真实的更衣室场景里。
works.exercise_en: Pick a room on campus with history, record a short guide monologue, and place the guide as an AR figure sitting on a real bench with Lens Studio or Reality Composer. Twist: the guide's story changes depending on which object the visitor looks at.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里选一个有历史的房间，录一段简短的导览独白，用 Lens Studio 或 Reality Composer 把向导作为 AR 人物放在一张真实的长椅上；变体：向导讲的故事随观众看向的物件而变化。

video.video_title: John McEnroe Hologram - Wimbledon Lawn Tennis Museum

works.title: Kubic's Cube
works.description: A robot called Kubic hangs in the centre of a cube of neon and LED lights and performs a live choreography to music by Francisco López, while the public walks freely around it and sees it from every side.
works.description_zh: 名为 Kubic 的机器人悬挂在由霓虹灯和 LED 灯构成的立方体中央，随 Francisco López 的音乐进行现场编舞，观众可以自由走动，从各个角度观看。
works.idea_en: A robot becomes the only dancer, and the audience walks around it like a sculpture.
works.idea_zh: 机器人成为唯一的舞者，观众像看雕塑一样绕着它走。
works.technique: A suspended robot built by Louis-Philippe Demers is operated live by Ventura, mixing static poses with chance-based interactive movement patterns that make it seem alive.
works.technique_zh: 由 Louis-Philippe Demers 制作的悬吊机器人由 Ventura 现场操控，把静止姿态与带随机性的互动动作模式混合，让它看起来像活的。
works.exercise_en: Hang a servo-driven object (a lamp or cardboard head) from the ceiling, program three poses and a random 'breathing' motion, and let visitors walk around it. Twist: make it turn toward whoever moves last.
works.exercise_zh: 从天花板悬挂一个舵机驱动的物体（台灯或纸板头），编好三个姿势和一段随机的“呼吸”动作，让参观者绕着它走；变体：让它转向最后一个移动的人。

video.video_title: Kubic's Cube at ISEA 2008, Singapore

works.title: Le Sacre du Printemps (The Rite of Spring)
works.description: A solo dancer is filmed by stereo cameras and turned in real time into a stereoscopic 3D projection that the audience watches with 3D glasses alongside a live orchestra.
works.idea_zh: 把舞者实时变成立体3D影像，让观众戴3D眼镜看“被重塑的身体”
works.technique: Stereo camera pairs capture the dancer and real-time software transforms the image into generative stereoscopic geometry projected with polarised 3D projection.
works.exercise_zh: 用两台手机并排拍同学跳舞，合成红蓝立体图并加上实时特效；变化：让音乐节拍控制身体的碎裂程度。

video.video_title: The Rite of Spring - Klaus Obermaier, Yuka Oishi & Ars Electronica Futurelab, Le Sacre du Printemps

works.description_zh: 一位独舞者被立体摄像机拍摄，并实时转化为立体 3D 投影，观众戴上 3D 眼镜，在现场管弦乐团的伴奏下观看。
works.idea_en: Turn a dancer into a live stereoscopic 3D image so the audience watches a 'reshaped body' through 3D glasses.
works.technique_zh: 成对的立体摄像机捕捉舞者，实时软件把影像转换为生成式的立体几何图形，再通过偏振 3D 投影呈现。
works.exercise_en: Film a classmate dancing with two phones side by side, combine the footage into a red-cyan anaglyph and add live effects. Twist: let the music's beat control how much the body shatters.

works.title: Little People
works.description: Hand-painted model-railway figures are left in London's streets in tiny scenes (a man fishing in a drain, a couple on a crisp packet) and photographed close-up, then left to be found or lost.
works.description_zh: 手绘的火车模型小人被留在伦敦街头的微型场景中（在排水口钓鱼的男人、坐在薯片袋上的情侣），被近距离拍摄后，便任人发现或遗失。
works.idea_en: Street details become full stories at 1:87 scale; AR can re-scale everyday surfaces into worlds in the same way.
works.idea_zh: 街头细节在 1:87 的尺度下成了完整的故事；AR 也能以同样方式把日常表面重新缩放成一个个世界。
works.technique: Commercial model figures are repainted and modified, placed in real street settings and photographed with a macro lens.
works.technique_zh: 商业模型人偶经过重新上色和改造，放在真实街景中，用微距镜头拍摄。
works.exercise_en: Scan or model tiny AR people and stage a story on a real kerb, drain or leaf, then take a macro-style AR photo. Twist: the scene reacts to real rain by opening tiny umbrellas.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描或建模微型 AR 小人，在真实的路缘、排水口或树叶上布置一个故事，并拍一张微距风格的 AR 照片；变体：场景会对真实下雨作出反应，撑起小伞。

video.video_title: Artist Creates Miniature Dramas On London’s Streets | NBC News

salient.why_en: Tiny figures turn a drain or a crisp packet on the street into a whole scene.
salient.why_zh: 几个微缩小人把街边的下水口或薯片袋变成一整个故事场景。

works.title: Léviathan Thot
works.description: Under the dome of the Panthéon in Paris, huge stretchy white lycra forms hang like the limbs of a giant creature, weighted with sand and spice-filled pods that bulge toward the visitors below.
works.description_zh: 在巴黎先贤祠的穹顶下，巨大的白色弹力莱卡织物像巨兽的肢体一样垂下，里面装满沙子和香料的袋子向下方的观众鼓起。
works.idea_en: A soft form hung in a hard, historic space changes how the whole building feels; AR overlays can soften or re-body architecture instead of just labeling it.
works.idea_zh: 在坚硬的历史建筑里挂上一个柔软的形体，就改变了整栋建筑的感觉：AR 叠加可以让建筑「长出身体」，而不只是贴标签。
works.technique: Tensioned lycra membranes are anchored to the building and shaped by the weight of filled pockets, so gravity sculpts the forms.
works.technique_zh: 绷紧的莱卡薄膜固定在建筑上，由装满物料的袋子的重量塑形，让重力来雕刻形体。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR piece that hangs a soft-body cloth creature from the ceiling of a real hall, using a cloth simulation in Unity AR Foundation pinned to detected ceiling points. Twist: add heavy 'drops' when the user taps, and watch the cloth sag toward them.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity AR Foundation 中用布料模拟，把一只柔软的布质生物钉在真实大厅的天花板点位上垂挂下来。变体：用户每点一下就加一颗重「液滴」，看布料向他们下垂。

video.video_title: Ernesto Neto _ Léviathan Thot, Paris 2006.

works.title: Pixel Babes
works.description: A trio in ten tableaux about the ideal body, from Jane Fonda aerobics to fashion and plastic surgery, where video images are projected directly onto the dancers' bodies.
works.description_zh: 关于理想身体的三人舞，分为十个场景，从 Jane Fonda 的健美操到时尚和整形手术，影像直接投射在舞者身上。
works.idea_en: Media images of perfect bodies are literally pasted onto real ones.
works.idea_zh: 把媒体中“完美身体”的影像直接贴到真实的身体上。
works.technique: Video is projection-mapped onto the performers' bodies and costumes, with choreography holding poses precisely inside the projected image.
works.technique_zh: 影像被投影映射到表演者的身体和服装上，编舞让他们精确地停留在投影画面之内。
works.exercise_en: Project a fitness video onto a person in white clothing and ask them to follow the moves while staying aligned with the projected body. Twist: speed the video up until the alignment breaks.
works.exercise_zh: 把一段健身视频投到穿白衣的人身上，请他跟着做动作，同时与投影出的身体保持对齐；变体：逐渐加快视频，直到对齐崩溃。

video.video_title: Cie Nicole Seiler - Pixel Babes (2006), teaser

works.title: Pulse Room
works.description: Hundreds of clear incandescent bulbs hang in a room; a visitor holds a sensor, their heartbeat makes the nearest bulb flash, and each new heartbeat pushes older ones down the grid.
works.description_zh: 数百颗透明白炽灯悬挂在房间里；访客握住传感器，他的心跳让最近的灯泡闪烁，每个新心跳都把旧的沿网格往后推。
works.idea_en: A room that keeps a queue of visitors' heartbeats shows how biometric input can become a shared, cumulative space — a model for multi-user AR memories.
works.idea_zh: 一个保存访客心跳队列的房间，展示了生物数据如何变成共享、累积的空间——这是多用户 AR 记忆的范本。
works.technique: A handheld heart-rate sensor detects the pulse and a controller dims each bulb to that rhythm, shifting the recording one bulb along the grid each time a new person grips the sensor.
works.technique_zh: 手持心率传感器检测脉搏，控制器让灯泡按该节奏明暗；每当有新的人握住传感器，记录就沿网格移动一颗灯泡。
works.exercise_en: Hang a grid of virtual bulbs from the ceiling in AR and make each one pulse to a heartbeat captured from a phone-camera fingertip reading, with newer beats pushing older ones away. Twist: let the grid persist across visitors via a shared anchor.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中从天花板挂一格虚拟灯泡，用手机摄像头读指尖获得心跳，让每颗灯泡按一个心跳闪烁，新心跳把旧的推开。变体：用共享锚点让灯阵在不同访客之间持续保留。

video.video_title: Pulse Room in Puebla, Mexico

salient.why_en: Your heartbeat becomes one flashing bulb among hundreds left by earlier visitors.
salient.why_zh: 你的心跳变成一只闪烁的灯泡，挂在之前访客留下的几百只灯泡之间。

works.title: Sixteen Birds
works.description: Sixteen inflatable birds glide along cables through a large public space, flapping their soft wings as air is pumped into them.
works.description_zh: 十六只充气鸟沿着缆绳滑过一个大型公共空间，随着空气泵入扇动柔软的翅膀。
works.idea_en: Moving creatures along fixed paths overhead fills a big volume with life using very simple motion — a cheap trick for AR flocks.
works.idea_zh: 让生物沿头顶的固定路径移动，用非常简单的运动就能让一个大空间充满生机——这是 AR 鸟群的一个便宜技巧。
works.technique: Inflatable bird bodies are driven along overhead cables while valves pulse air into the wings to create flapping.
works.technique_zh: 充气的鸟身沿头顶缆绳移动，同时阀门向翅膀脉冲式充气，形成扇动。
works.exercise_en: Draw a few spline paths across the ceiling of a real atrium in AR and send soft, flapping birds along them in a loop. Twist: let a raised hand call the nearest bird down to land on it.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中沿一个真实中庭的天花板画几条样条路径，让柔软扇翅的鸟沿路径循环飞行。变体：举手就能把最近的一只鸟唤下来落在手上。

video.video_title: Chico MacMurtrie: Sixteen Birds, Robot Sculptures 2006

works.title: Stellar Axis: Antarctica
works.description: Near the South Pole, Albuquerque led an expedition that placed 99 blue spheres on the ice, each at the position of a star in the sky above, making the first large ephemeral artwork on the continent.
works.description_zh: 在南极点附近，Albuquerque 带领考察队在冰面上放置了 99 个蓝色球体，每个都对应头顶天空中一颗星的位置，这是南极大陆上第一件大型短暂艺术作品。
works.idea_en: Mapping the sky onto the ground turns astronomy into a walkable place, a clear template for AR star maps anchored to terrain.
works.idea_zh: 把天空映射到地面，让天文学变成可以行走的地方，是锚定在地形上的 AR 星图的清晰模板。
works.technique: Fibreglass spheres of different sizes (by star brightness) were placed on the ice by GPS according to a projected star chart.
works.technique_zh: 大小不同（按星等）的玻璃钢球体依据投影星图，以 GPS 定位放置在冰面上。
works.exercise_en: Project tonight's star chart onto a field in AR, placing a sphere on the ground under each bright star, sized by magnitude. Twist: when the user looks up, draw a line from each sphere to its real star.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把今晚的星图投到操场上，在每颗亮星下方的地面上放一个球体，大小按星等决定；变体：当用户抬头时，从每个球体画一条线连到它对应的真实星星。

video.video_title: STELLAR AXIS

works.title: Test Site
works.description: Five giant spiral steel slides twist down through Tate Modern's Turbine Hall, and visitors ride them from different floors, shrieking into the hall below.
works.description_zh: 五条巨大的螺旋钢滑梯盘旋穿过泰特现代美术馆的涡轮大厅，观众从不同楼层滑下，尖叫着冲进下面的大厅。
works.idea_en: An artwork can be a body experience rather than an image: AR works gain force when they change how people move through a building, not only what they see.
works.idea_zh: 艺术作品可以是一种身体体验，而不只是一幅图像：当 AR 改变人们在建筑中移动的方式，而不仅是他们看到的东西时，它才更有力量。
works.technique: Stainless steel and transparent polycarbonate tubes form enclosed spiral slides engineered like fairground rides, with riders sliding on mats.
works.technique_zh: 不锈钢与透明聚碳酸酯管组成封闭的螺旋滑梯，按游乐设施的标准设计，乘坐者垫着滑垫滑下。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR 'slide' route down a real staircase with WebXR: arrows, speed lines and a sound that rises in pitch as you go down. Twist: record each run and replay classmates' ghost avatars sliding beside you.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 沿一段真实楼梯设计一条 AR“滑梯”路线：箭头、速度线，以及越往下音调越高的声音。变体：记录每一次“滑行”，回放同学的幽灵化身在你旁边滑下。

video.video_title: VTV Classics (r3): Carsten Höller: Test Site. Tate Modern, London (2006)

works.title: Third Person (ShadowBox 4)
works.description: The viewer's shadow is drawn entirely out of the verbs of a dictionary in English, Spanish or French, like a portrait written in actions.
works.idea_zh: 用词典里所有的动词拼出你的影子肖像
works.technique: Camera silhouette masking selects which cells of a dense text grid are rendered, with word size varying with distance from the screen.
works.exercise_zh: 在p5.js里把摄像头剪影区域用文字填满（用班级自选的一组词）；变化：离屏幕越近，词越小、越密。

video.video_title: Third Person

works.description_zh: 观众的影子完全由一部英语、西班牙语或法语词典中的动词构成，就像一幅用动作书写的肖像。
works.idea_en: Build your shadow portrait out of every verb in the dictionary.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头剪影遮罩决定密集文字网格中哪些单元格被渲染出来，文字大小随观众与屏幕的距离而变化。
works.exercise_en: In p5.js, fill the silhouette area from the camera with text (a set of words the class picks). Twist: the closer you get to the screen, the smaller and denser the words become.

works.title: Time Horizon
works.description: One hundred iron body casts are placed across a park (first in Calabria, later at Houghton Hall in Norfolk), all at the same height above sea level, so some are buried to the neck and others stand on columns.
works.description_zh: 一百尊铸铁人像分布在一片园林中（先在卡拉布里亚，后在诺福克的 Houghton Hall），全部位于同一海拔，于是有的被埋到脖子，有的站在高柱上。
works.idea_en: Keeping every figure on one absolute height makes the uneven ground visible, a way to use AR objects as measuring devices for terrain.
works.idea_zh: 让每个人像都保持在同一绝对高度，使起伏的地面显形，这是把 AR 物体当作地形测量工具的方法。
works.technique: Figures are set on plinths or sunk into pits so that all their heads share one surveyed altitude regardless of the terrain beneath.
works.technique_zh: 人像或立于基座之上，或沉入坑中，使所有头部都处在同一测量海拔，与下方地形无关。
works.exercise_en: In AR Foundation, place ten figures on a sloping lawn and lock all of their heads to one world-space height, filling the gap below with a column or hiding them in the ground. Twist: let viewers drag the shared height up and down live.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中把十个人像放在倾斜草坪上，并把它们的头部锁定在同一世界高度，下方空缺用柱子补足或让人像埋入地下；变体：让观者实时上下拖动这个共享高度。

video.video_title: Antony Gormley: Time Horizon | Houghton Hall, Norfolk

works.title: Urban Flow
works.description: Slit-scan panoramas of pedestrians crossing one line on a street: each person is recorded as they pass, so the image is a row of people from different moments, discussed here in a short documentary.
works.description_zh: 对街上一条线进行狭缝扫描拍摄的行人全景：每个人都在走过那条线时被记录下来，于是画面是一排来自不同时刻的人；视频是一部介绍他作品的短纪录片。
works.idea_en: A camera that records only one line turns time into the horizontal axis; AR slit-scan filters can make the passage of people readable at a glance.
works.idea_zh: 只记录一条线的相机把时间变成了横轴；AR 狭缝扫描滤镜可以让人流的经过一目了然。
works.technique: An industrial line-scan camera records a single column of pixels thousands of times per second, stacking them into an image where x is time (year of first works approximate).
works.technique_zh: 工业线扫描相机每秒对同一列像素记录数千次，把它们堆叠成一张横轴代表时间的图像（首批作品年份为大致时间）。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebAR slit-scan: take the center column of the camera feed each frame and append it to a growing panorama displayed on a virtual wall in AR. Twist: let the user rotate the slit to horizontal and see what changes.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 WebAR 狭缝扫描：每帧取相机画面的中间一列像素，追加到一幅不断变长的全景上，并显示在 AR 的一面虚拟墙上；变体：让用户把狭缝转成水平方向，看看会有什么不同。

video.video_title: The Slow Commute - The Thing About...Art & Artists - Adam Magyar

works.title: Volume
works.description: A field of 46 tall light columns in the V&A garden senses visitors walking among them and answers with waves of light and sound.
works.description_zh: 维多利亚与阿尔伯特博物馆花园里立着 46 根高大的光柱，感知在其间走动的观众，并以光与声的波动回应。
works.idea_en: People become the performers when a space answers their movement — AR in public spaces works best when crowds can 'play' it together.
works.idea_zh: 当空间回应人们的移动时，人就成了表演者——公共空间中的 AR 最好能让人群一起“演奏”。
works.technique: Infrared cameras track visitors' positions and a generative system maps proximity to the light and sound behaviour of each column.
works.technique_zh: 红外摄像头追踪观众位置，生成系统把人与每根光柱的距离映射为光和声音的变化。
works.exercise_en: Place 16 virtual light columns in a courtyard with shared AR anchors so that each one glows and hums when a participant walks close to it. Twist: make columns sing louder when two people stand near the same one.
works.exercise_zh: 用共享 AR 锚点在庭院中放 16 根虚拟光柱，参与者靠近时光柱就会发光并发出嗡鸣。变体：两个人同时靠近同一根时，让它唱得更响。

video.video_title: Volume by United Visual Artists

works.title: Waves
works.description: A long rope spun by motors at both ends hangs in a dark room; when nobody is there it is a still line, and as more people move in front of it, it whips into waves and chaotic shapes that also hum as they cut the air.
works.description_zh: 一根长绳两端由电机带动旋转，悬在暗室里；没人时它是一条静止的直线，观众越多、动得越多，它就甩成波浪和混乱的形状，划破空气时还会发出嗡嗡声。
works.idea_en: One line that goes from calm to chaos as a crowd grows teaches an AR designer to map audience activity to a single, readable visual parameter.
works.idea_zh: 一条随人群增多从平静变为混乱的线，提醒 AR 设计者：把观众活动映射到一个单一、易读的视觉参数上。
works.technique: Cameras measure how much motion is in front of the piece and set the speed of two motors that rotate a rope; the rope's standing-wave shape and sound follow from physics, not from rendered graphics.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头测量作品前方的运动量，据此控制两端电机的转速；绳子的驻波形状和声音由物理本身产生，而不是渲染出来的图像。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR scene with one glowing line strung between two anchors in the room, and drive its wave amplitude and frequency from the phone camera's frame-difference motion score. Twist: add a second person's phone and let the line only go wild when both people move at once.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 中在房间里两个锚点之间拉一条发光的线，用手机摄像头的帧差运动量来控制它的波幅和频率。变体：加入第二个人的手机，只有两人同时动起来时线才会狂舞。

video.video_title: Waves

works.title: Wildlife
works.description: A tiger is projected from a moving car onto the buildings it passes; the tiger runs alongside, speeding up and slowing down with the car and stopping when it stops.
works.idea_zh: 从行驶的汽车上把老虎投在街边建筑上，让它跟着车一起奔跑
works.technique: A sensor on the wheel measures rotation and sets the playback frame rate of the tiger's run cycle, which a car-mounted projector throws onto passing façades.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影仪放在推车或自行车上，用编码器/手机加速度计控制跑步动画的帧率，沿走廊投射；变化：速度过快时动物会“累倒”。

video.video_title: wildlife

works.description_zh: 一只老虎从行驶的汽车上被投射到沿途经过的建筑上；老虎在车旁奔跑，随着车加速、减速，车停下时它也停下。
works.idea_en: Project a tiger from a moving car onto roadside buildings so it runs alongside the car.
works.technique_zh: 车轮上的传感器测量转动，并据此设定老虎奔跑循环动画的播放帧率，再由车载投影仪投射到经过的建筑立面上。
works.exercise_en: Put a projector on a cart or bicycle, use an encoder or phone accelerometer to control the frame rate of a running animation, and project it along a corridor. Twist: the animal 'collapses from exhaustion' when you go too fast.

salient.why_en: A projected tiger runs along the buildings beside a moving car, keeping pace and stopping when the car stops.
salient.why_zh: 投影出的老虎沿着街边建筑与行驶的汽车并肩奔跑，车停它也停。

works.title: You and I, Horizontal II
works.description: A digital projector throws slowly morphing curved lines across a dark, hazy room; the light forms soft walls and folding membranes that visitors step through.
works.description_zh: 数字投影机在昏暗、弥漫雾气的房间里投出缓慢变形的曲线，光形成柔软的墙和折叠的薄膜，观众可以从中穿过。
works.idea_en: A slowly changing line on a flat plane becomes a moving architecture once it has depth: animate 2D shapes over time and they read as spatial rooms in AR.
works.idea_zh: 平面上缓慢变化的一条线，一旦有了纵深就成了会动的建筑：在 AR 里让二维形状随时间变化，它就会被读成一个空间。
works.technique: Computer-generated ellipses and travelling waves are projected horizontally through haze, so each line becomes a thin plane of light at eye level.
works.technique_zh: 用电脑生成的椭圆和行进波水平地投进雾气，每一条线都在视线高度变成一片薄薄的光面。
works.exercise_en: Extrude an animated 2D line (a sine wave that slowly morphs into an ellipse) into a translucent sheet anchored at chest height in AR Foundation, and ask classmates to walk through it. Twist: when two people stand on opposite sides, bend the sheet into a curve that connects them.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 里把一条动画化的二维线（慢慢变成椭圆的正弦波）挤出成半透明光片，固定在胸口高度，请同学从中走过。变体：当两个人分别站在两侧时，让光片弯成一条连接他们的曲面。

video.video_title: Anthony McCall: You and I - Horizontal II

works.title: bit.fall
works.description: A row of nozzles releases water drops in precise patterns so that, for a moment, falling water spells out words picked live from online news, lit from the side.
works.description_zh: 一排喷嘴按精确的图案放出水滴，于是在一瞬间，下落的水写出实时从网络新闻中抓取的词语，并被侧面的灯照亮。
works.idea_en: Information that exists only while it falls teaches AR designers that text in space can be temporary, physical-feeling and tied to gravity.
works.idea_zh: 只在下落时存在的信息提醒 AR 设计者：空间中的文字可以是短暂的、有物理感的、受重力支配的。
works.technique: Around 128 magnetic valves open for milliseconds in sequence, like a one-line printer, so each word is 'printed' as a curtain of drops whose shape holds for about a second.
works.technique_zh: 约 128 个电磁阀按顺序开启几毫秒，像一台单行打印机，每个词都被“打印”成一帘水滴，形状能保持大约一秒。
works.exercise_en: Make words from a live feed (headlines, chat messages) fall as particle drops from a line anchored to a real doorway or ceiling in AR, dissolving when they hit the floor. Twist: let the viewer's hand catch and hold a word.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中让实时来源的词语（新闻标题、聊天消息）化作粒子水滴，从锚定在真实门框或天花板上的一条线落下，落地即消散。变体：让观众用手接住并托住一个词。

video.video_title: Julius Popp - bit.fall, Kinetic Sculpture 2004

salient.why_en: Falling water drops spell words that exist only while they fall.
salient.why_zh: 落下的水滴拼出文字，只在下落的那一瞬间存在。

works.title: dead-in-iraq
works.description: Logged in as 'dead-in-iraq', DeLappe entered the US Army's recruiting game America's Army and typed, one by one, the name, age, branch and date of death of every US service member killed in Iraq into the game's text chat until he was killed or kicked out.
works.description_zh: DeLappe 以“dead-in-iraq”为名进入美军征兵游戏 America's Army，在游戏文字聊天里逐一打出每位在伊拉克阵亡美军士兵的姓名、年龄、军种和死亡日期，直到自己被击毙或被踢出游戏。
works.idea_en: Use a shared virtual space as a temporary memorial that its own players cannot ignore.
works.idea_zh: 把共享的虚拟空间变成一个临时纪念碑，让里面的玩家无法忽视。
works.technique: A manual performance through the game's standard text-message channel, recorded as machinima and shown as a large projection.
works.technique_zh: 通过游戏自带的文字消息频道手动完成的表演，被录成游戏影像（machinima），并以大幅投影展示。
works.exercise_en: Choose a shared digital space your classmates use (a group chat, a Minecraft server, a shared AR scene) and design a five-minute respectful intervention that places a list of names or facts where people will meet them. Twist: make the intervention disappear when someone reads it all.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个同学们都在使用的共享数字空间（群聊、Minecraft 服务器、共享 AR 场景），设计一段五分钟、态度尊重的介入，把一串名字或事实放在人们会遇到的地方；变体：有人完整读完后，介入就消失。

video.video_title: dead in iraq machinima america's army

works.title: Convergence 1.0
works.description: Adrien Mondot's founding piece: a juggler plays with real balls while virtual balls and objects, generated live by the software eMotion and projected behind the performer, join the routine so real and synthetic trajectories meet on stage.
works.description_zh: Adrien Mondot 的起点之作：杂耍艺人抛接真实的球，身后投影出由 eMotion 软件实时生成的虚拟球和物体，它们加入同一套动作，真实轨迹和合成轨迹在舞台上相遇。
works.idea_en: A juggler juggles with objects that only exist inside the computer.
works.idea_zh: 杂耍艺人和只存在于电脑里的物体一起抛接。
works.technique: Custom real-time software (the first version of eMotion) simulates objects with physical properties and projects them behind the performer; the match between real throws and virtual balls is likely a mix of rehearsed timing and partial tracking.
works.technique_zh: 自研的实时软件（eMotion 的第一个版本）模拟带物理属性的物体并投影在表演者身后；真实抛接和虚拟球之间的配合，很可能一部分靠排练出的节奏，一部分靠追踪。
works.exercise_en: Project a simple 2D physics scene (p5.js + matter.js) on a wall and have one student toss a real ball in front of it while a partner launches matching virtual balls with key presses; rehearse until real and virtual throws read as one routine. Twist: track a brightly colored ball with the webcam so the virtual balls bounce off the real one.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js + matter.js 做一个简单的 2D 物理场景投到墙上，一名学生在墙前抛真球，同伴按键发射对应的虚拟球，反复排练直到真假抛接看起来是同一套动作。变体：用摄像头追踪一个颜色鲜艳的球，让虚拟球能从真球上弹开。

video.video_title: Extraits Convergence

works.title: Daisies
works.description: A floor projection of daisies that wilt and die under visitors' feet and quickly grow back after they walk away; version 2.0 grows algorithmically generated flowers.
works.idea_zh: 花会在你脚下枯萎，离开后又重新长回来。

video.video_title: Daisies

works.technique: An overhead camera with background subtraction detects where feet are on the floor projection, and a per-flower state (height, health) decays under occlusion and regrows over time.
works.exercise_zh: 用俯拍摄像头和地面投影做一片会被踩倒、离开后慢慢长回来的草地（p5.js 或 TouchDesigner）；变体：每个人踩过后长出的花形状由他停留的时间决定。
works.description_zh: 投射在地面上的雏菊会在观众脚下枯萎死去，人走开后又很快重新长出来；2.0 版本则会生长出由算法生成的花朵。
works.idea_en: Flowers wilt under your feet and grow back after you leave.
works.technique_zh: 俯拍摄像头配合背景减除，检测脚在地面投影上的位置；每朵花都有自己的状态（高度、健康值），被遮挡时逐渐衰减，并随时间重新生长。
works.exercise_en: Use an overhead camera and floor projection to make a patch of grass that gets trampled and slowly grows back after people leave (p5.js or TouchDesigner). Twist: the shape of the flowers that grow after someone walks over depends on how long they stayed.

salient.why_en: Flowers wilt under your feet and grow back after you leave, so your presence leaves a visible mark.
salient.why_zh: 花朵在你脚下枯萎，你离开后又重新长出，你的存在留下看得见的痕迹。

works.title: Dolls/Dolls Live
works.description: A walk-through video installation where filmed dancing dolls and creatures appear as ghostly projections in the dark; in the live version two real dancers step into the installation alongside their projected doubles.
works.description_zh: 一个可以穿行的影像装置：拍摄的跳舞玩偶和奇异生物在黑暗中以幽灵般的投影出现；现场版中，两位真实舞者走进装置，与自己的投影分身同台。
works.idea_en: Put projected phantoms and living dancers in the same dark room and let visitors meet both.
works.idea_zh: 把投影幻影和真人舞者放进同一个暗室，让观众同时与两者相遇。
works.technique: Superimposed video loops are projected onto objects and surfaces around the space, with live performers matching their positions and costumes.
works.technique_zh: 叠加的影像循环投射在空间中的物体和表面上，现场表演者配合它们的位置和服装。
works.exercise_en: Film a friend dancing against black, project the clip onto a hanging sheet in a dark corridor, and have the same friend appear live next to it. Twist: the live dancer copies the projection a beat late.
works.exercise_zh: 拍朋友在黑色背景前跳舞，把视频投到暗走廊里悬挂的布上，再让这位朋友本人出现在旁边；变体：真人舞者晚一拍模仿投影。

video.video_title: Cie Nicole Seiler - Dolls/Dolls Live (2005), teaser

works.title: Drawn
works.description: Ink drawn by hand on paper is lifted off the page by software that alters the live video signal, so painted forms appear to come alive and can be pushed around by the hand.
works.idea_zh: 纸上墨迹被摄像头“抓起”，手画的形状立刻活过来、能被手拨动。

video.video_title: drawn (installation)

works.technique: Background subtraction and thresholding segment dark ink blobs from an overhead camera of the paper, converting them into physics bodies that are rendered back over the live video, with the hand tracked as a separate occluding mask.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头俯拍白纸，在 openFrameworks 或 p5.js 里把墨迹阈值分割成轮廓，变成会掉落、能被手推开的物体；变体：让墨迹根据笔画粗细决定是漂走还是沉下去。
works.description_zh: 在纸上手绘的墨迹被软件从纸面上“提”起来：软件改变实时视频信号，让画出的形状仿佛活了过来，还能被手推来推去。
works.idea_en: A camera 'lifts' ink off the paper, so hand-drawn shapes come alive and can be nudged by hand.
works.technique_zh: 俯拍纸面的摄像头通过背景减除和阈值处理分割出深色墨迹色块，把它们转换为物理刚体并重新渲染到实时视频上，手则作为单独的遮挡遮罩进行追踪。
works.exercise_en: Film a sheet of white paper from above, threshold the ink into contours in openFrameworks or p5.js, and turn them into objects that fall and can be pushed by hand. Twist: let stroke thickness decide whether an ink shape floats away or sinks.

works.title: Fragile Future
works.description: Real dandelion seed heads, glued seed by seed onto tiny LEDs, form a glowing wall of lights connected by phosphor-bronze circuits.
works.description_zh: 真正的蒲公英种子头被一粒粒粘到微小的 LED 上，由磷青铜电路连接，组成一面发光的灯墙。
works.idea_en: Pairing the most fragile natural object with technology makes both feel precious; AR designers can let real, delicate things carry the digital layer.
works.idea_zh: 把最脆弱的自然物和技术结合，会让两者都显得珍贵；AR 设计者可以让真实而脆弱的东西承载数字层。
works.technique: Dandelion seeds are picked and glued by hand onto LEDs, which sit on three-dimensional bronze circuit frames that carry the current.
works.technique_zh: 蒲公英种子被手工采下并粘到 LED 上，LED 安装在传导电流的立体青铜电路框架上。
works.exercise_en: Scan a real dried flower or seed head with a phone, place it in AR, and give each seed a tiny light that detaches and floats away when you blow on the microphone. Twist: the seeds that fly away settle and glow on real surfaces nearby.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机扫描一朵真实的干花或种子头，放进 AR 中，给每粒种子一盏小灯，对着麦克风吹气时它们脱落飘走。变体：飞走的种子落在附近真实的表面上继续发光。

video.video_title: FRAGILE FUTURE | by DRIFT

works.title: Gorillaz hologram (MTV Europe Music Awards)
works.description: At the 2005 MTV Europe Music Awards in Lisbon, the cartoon band Gorillaz appears to play live on stage as life-size 3D-looking characters, billed as the 'world's first 3D hologram performance'. The same system later put Gorillaz on stage with Madonna at the 2006 Grammys.
works.description_zh: 在 2005 年里斯本 MTV 欧洲音乐大奖上，卡通乐队 Gorillaz 以真人大小、看起来立体的角色“现场”登台演出，被宣传为“世界首场 3D 全息演出”。同一套系统后来还让 Gorillaz 在 2006 年格莱美上与麦当娜同台。
works.idea_en: A virtual character sharing a real stage is the core promise of AR performance, and this shows that a flat image works if the reflection, scale and lighting match the stage.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟角色与真人同台，正是 AR 演出的核心承诺；这件作品说明，只要反射、尺度和灯光与舞台一致，平面影像就足以成立。
works.technique: An HD projector (or LED source) is reflected by a thin, tensioned transparent foil angled at 45 degrees across the stage (Pepper's ghost), so the image appears in the stage space behind it.
works.technique_zh: 高清投影机（或 LED 光源）的画面被一张以 45 度斜拉在舞台上的薄透明膜反射（佩珀尔幻象），影像看起来就出现在膜后面的舞台空间里。
works.exercise_en: Build a tabletop Pepper's ghost with a phone and a sheet of clear plastic at 45 degrees, then play an animated character so it 'stands' on a small stage with a real toy. Twist: make the virtual character and a real puppet perform a duet.
works.exercise_zh: 用一部手机和一片成 45 度的透明塑料片做一个桌面佩珀尔幻象，播放一段角色动画，让它“站”在有真实玩具的小舞台上；变体：让虚拟角色和一个真实木偶合演一段二重唱。

video.video_title: Gorillaz Hologram MTV Awards - Created by Musion Eyeliner

works.title: Homo sapiens sapiens
works.description: In the Venetian church of San Stae, visitors lie on cushioned beds and watch a video projected across the ceiling, showing two women in a lush paradise-like landscape.
works.description_zh: 在威尼斯圣斯塔埃教堂里，观众躺在铺垫的床上，看投影在天花板上的影像：两位女子身处繁茂如天堂般的风景中。
works.idea_en: Putting the image where paintings of heaven used to be reuses the building's own logic; AR works well when content respects where people already look in a place.
works.idea_zh: 把影像放在原本画着天堂的位置，是在借用建筑自身的逻辑：当内容尊重人们在一个地方本来就会看向哪里时，AR 最有效。
works.technique: Projectors aimed at the vaulted ceiling fill it with video, and horizontal beds place the audience in the right viewing angle.
works.technique_zh: 投影仪对准拱顶，让天花板铺满影像，平放的床把观众安排在合适的观看角度。
works.exercise_en: Find a building part people already look up at (a stairwell, dome or tree canopy) and pin a looping AR video to it that reinterprets what used to be there. Twist: the video changes when two users look up at it together.
works.exercise_zh: 找一处人们原本就会抬头看的建筑部位（楼梯井、穹顶或树冠），在那里固定一段循环 AR 影像，重新诠释原本的内容。变体：当两位用户同时抬头看时，影像会改变。

video.video_title: homo sapiens sapiens

works.title: La Tempête (The Tempest)
works.description: Shakespeare's play of spirits and illusions is staged with Prospero's magic made visible: Ariel and other spirits appear as floating, translucent projections that fly, vanish and transform around the live actors.
works.description_zh: 这版莎士比亚的《暴风雨》让普洛斯彼罗的魔法变得可见：精灵爱丽儿等角色以漂浮、半透明的投影出现，在真人演员周围飞行、消失和变形。
works.idea_en: Magic in a story is the natural home for mixed reality: when a plot already contains spirits, virtual characters feel motivated rather than decorative.
works.idea_zh: 故事里的魔法是混合现实的天然舞台：当剧情本身就有精灵，虚拟角色就显得有理由存在，而不是装饰。
works.technique: Projections onto large transparent screens at the front of the stage create hologram-like figures (a Pepper's-ghost-style effect) that overlap with actors standing behind them.
works.technique_zh: 在舞台前方的大块透明幕上投影，形成类似全息的人物（佩珀尔幽灵式效果），与站在幕后的演员重叠。
works.exercise_en: Stage a two-minute scene from a play where one character is a spirit, played only as an AR character (WebXR or HoloKit) that the live actor can see through the headset or phone. Twist: the audience sees the spirit only through a single shared phone passed around.
works.exercise_zh: 排演一个两分钟的戏剧片段，其中一个角色是精灵，只以 AR 角色（WebXR 或 HoloKit）出现，真人演员通过头显或手机看到它；变体：观众只能通过一部轮流传递的共享手机看到精灵。

video.video_title: Lemieux Pilon 4D Art - The Tempest | La Tempête (2005)

works.title: Make Like a Tree
works.description: A projected forest in which each visitor's recorded shadow returns as a ghostly figure walking between the trees and fading into the distance.
works.idea_zh: 你的影子变成森林里的幽灵，在树之间游荡远去
works.technique: Recorded silhouettes are re-inserted into a layered forest image at different depths and scales, with depth-dependent fading to suggest distance.
works.exercise_zh: 拍一张多层景深的风景图，把同学录下的剪影按远近缩放插入不同图层；变化：影子越远越透明，并随时间慢慢“走进”画面深处。

video.video_title: Make Like a Tree (2005) by Scott Snibbe

works.description_zh: 一片投影森林，每位观众被录下的影子都会以幽灵般的身影重新出现，在树木之间行走，渐渐消失在远方。
works.idea_en: Your shadow becomes a ghost in the forest, wandering off between the trees.
works.technique_zh: 录下的剪影以不同的深度和比例重新插入分层的森林图像中，并根据深度渐隐来暗示距离。
works.exercise_en: Take a landscape photo with several layers of depth and insert classmates' recorded silhouettes into different layers, scaled by distance. Twist: shadows grow more transparent the farther they are and slowly 'walk' deeper into the picture over time.

works.title: Messa di Voce (installation)
works.description: Installation version of the 2003 performance: visitors' voices are visualized as projected bubbles and shapes that emerge from their mouths and can be pushed with their bodies.
works.idea_zh: 说话和唱歌的声音从嘴里“长出”可见的图形，并能用身体推动。

video.video_title: Messa di Voce (Installation, 2005)

works.technique: Camera tracking locates each visitor's head/mouth position, and real-time audio analysis (amplitude, pitch, spectral features) generates projected shapes emitted from that point, which then collide with body silhouettes.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 找到嘴的位置，用 p5.sound 分析音量和音高，从嘴里吐出不同形状的泡泡并投到墙上；变体：给元音 a/e/i/o/u 各设计一种形状，让大家用声音“写字”。
works.description_zh: 2003 年同名表演的装置版本：观众的声音被可视化为从嘴里冒出的投影泡泡和图形，并且可以用身体推动。
works.idea_en: Speech and song grow visible shapes out of your mouth that you can push with your body.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪定位每位观众头部和嘴部的位置，实时音频分析（振幅、音高、频谱特征）生成从该点发出的投影图形，这些图形随后与身体剪影发生碰撞。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe to find the mouth, analyze volume and pitch with p5.sound, and blow bubbles of different shapes out of the mouth, projected on a wall. Twist: design one shape for each vowel (a, e, i, o, u) and have everyone 'write' with their voice.

salient.why_en: Your voice grows visible shapes out of your mouth that you can then push around with your body.
salient.why_zh: 你的声音从嘴里长出看得见的形状，你还能用身体推动它们。

works.title: Moerenuma Park
works.description: Designed by Noguchi before his death in 1988 and completed in 2005, Moerenuma Park in Sapporo turns a garbage landfill into a park of geometric hills, a glass pyramid, fountains and sculptural playgrounds.
works.description_zh: 由 Noguchi 在 1988 年去世前设计、2005 年完工的札幌 Moerenuma 公园，把一座垃圾填埋场变成由几何山丘、玻璃金字塔、喷泉和雕塑游乐场组成的公园。
works.idea_en: A whole park conceived as one sculpture shows how land shape itself can be the interface for play, a guide for AR in parks.
works.idea_zh: 把整座公园构想为一件雕塑，说明土地形态本身就可以是游戏的界面，这是公园 AR 的指南。
works.technique: The landfill was capped and reshaped with earth into cones, a mound and a pyramid, following Noguchi's model.
works.technique_zh: 填埋场被封盖，并按照 Noguchi 的模型用泥土重塑成圆锥、土丘和金字塔。
works.exercise_en: Model a small park of geometric AR hills and play objects on a flat lawn, then test with children how they move through it. Twist: the shapes subtly reshape toward where people walk most.
works.exercise_zh: 在平坦草坪上建模一座由几何 AR 山丘和游戏物件组成的小公园，并与孩子们一起测试他们如何在其中移动；变体：形体会悄悄朝人们最常走的方向重塑。

video.video_title: Moerenuma Park, Designed by Isamu Noguchi

works.title: Morphovision
works.description: A small model house spins rapidly while a projector scans it line by line with light, so the solid house appears to bend, melt and twist like rubber.
works.description_zh: 一座小模型房屋高速旋转，投影机用光一行一行扫描它，于是这座实心房子看起来像橡皮一样弯曲、融化、扭转。
works.idea_en: By controlling which slice of a real object is lit and when, you can deform reality itself; this is diminished and altered reality done with light.
works.idea_zh: 通过控制真实物体哪个切片、在何时被照亮，就能让现实本身变形；这是用光实现的减弱现实与改写现实。
works.technique: Developed with NHK Science & Technology Research Laboratories: a high-speed projector illuminates the rotating model with a moving slit of light, so each horizontal slice is seen at a different rotation angle.
works.technique_zh: 与 NHK 放送技术研究所合作开发：高速投影机用移动的光缝照亮旋转模型，使每一条水平切片在不同的旋转角度被看到。
works.exercise_en: Rotate a scanned real object in AR and offset each horizontal slice's rotation by its height using a vertex shader. Twist: let the viewer's phone tilt control how much the object twists.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中旋转一个扫描来的真实物体，用顶点着色器按高度偏移每一层切片的旋转角。变体：让手机倾角控制物体扭曲的程度。

video.video_title: Morphovision by Toshio Iwai

salient.why_en: Scanning light makes a solid spinning house bend and melt like rubber.
salient.why_zh: 扫描的光让一座旋转的实心小房子像橡皮一样弯曲、融化。

works.title: Moveable Interactive Projected Displays
works.description: A hand-held board with light sensors in its corners can be carried around under a projector, and the projected content follows and fits it in real time, turning a piece of card into a movable, interactive screen.
works.description_zh: 四角装有光传感器的手持板子可以在投影仪下随意移动，投影内容实时跟随并贴合它，让一块纸板变成可以拿着走的互动屏幕。
works.idea_en: A projector that tracks the very surface it projects on, with no camera at all.
works.idea_zh: 不用任何摄像头，投影仪自己追踪它正在投射的表面。
works.technique: Small structured-light patterns are projected only around the sensors' last known positions, and are frequency-modulated so they look like flat grey patches while updating fast enough for interactive tracking.
works.technique_zh: 只在传感器上一次的位置附近投射小块结构光图案，并做频率调制，让它们看起来只是灰色色块，同时更新速度足以支持实时追踪。
works.exercise_en: Make a 'magic clipboard': track a board with a printed marker using a webcam and project a map that stays locked onto it as students carry it around. Twist: show a different layer when the board is tilted.
works.exercise_zh: 做一块“魔法写字板”：用摄像头追踪贴有标记的板子，把地图投影上去，同学拿着走动时画面始终贴在板上。变体：板子倾斜时显示另一图层。

video.video_title: Moveable Projected Displays using Projector Based Tracking

works.title: OpenVIDIA: Mediated Reality on the GPU
works.description: Filmed through EyeTap glasses, a technician looks at equipment while GPU-processed overlays are positioned live on it, and a remote expert can guide the work visually.
works.description_zh: 透过 EyeTap 眼镜拍摄：技术人员看着设备，GPU 实时处理的叠加图像被准确地贴在设备上，远程专家可以通过画面指导操作。
works.idea_en: Use the graphics card as a vision processor so a wearable can register overlays on the world in real time.
works.idea_zh: 把显卡当作视觉处理器，让可穿戴设备能实时把叠加图像对准现实世界。
works.technique: The OpenVIDIA library runs feature tracking and image warping as GPU shaders, so homography-based registration keeps overlays locked to surfaces at video rate.
works.technique_zh: OpenVIDIA 库把特征追踪和图像变形写成 GPU 着色器，基于单应矩阵的配准能以视频帧率让叠加图像牢牢贴在表面上。
works.exercise_en: Pair two students: one points a phone at a device (a coffee machine, a printer) while the other, remote, draws arrows that stay anchored on it in phone AR. Twist: the remote helper may only draw one stroke per step.
works.exercise_zh: 两人一组：一人用手机对准一台设备（咖啡机、打印机），另一人远程画箭头，箭头在手机 AR 中固定在设备上。变体：远程助手每一步只能画一笔。

video.video_title: OpenVIDIA Mediated Reality on the GPU

works.title: PlayAnywhere
works.description: Andy Wilson's compact front-projected tabletop: a projector and camera on a small cart turn any table into a touch and object-sensing surface for games, maps and photo sharing.
works.idea_zh: 一台小推车上的投影+摄像头，把任何桌子变成可触控的游戏桌。

video.video_title: PlayAnywhere

works.technique: A short-throw projector and an IR camera with IR illumination sense finger touches by analyzing shadows and contact, and use visual codes and optical flow to detect objects and paper on an ordinary table.
works.exercise_zh: 把小投影仪和手机摄像头装在支架上俯视桌面，通过手指与其影子的距离判断“触摸”，实现一个投影的拼图或地图拖动；变体：让桌上的真实物品（杯子、钥匙）成为游戏中的障碍物。
works.description_zh: Andy Wilson 设计的紧凑型前投式桌面系统：小推车上的投影仪和摄像头能把任何一张桌子变成可感知触摸和物体的表面，用于玩游戏、看地图和分享照片。
works.idea_en: A projector and camera on a small cart turn any table into a touch-enabled game table.
works.technique_zh: 短焦投影仪加上带红外照明的红外摄像头，通过分析阴影和接触来感知手指触摸，并利用视觉编码和光流检测普通桌面上的物体和纸张。
works.exercise_en: Mount a small projector and a phone camera on a stand looking down at a table, judge a 'touch' from the distance between a finger and its shadow, and build a projected jigsaw puzzle or draggable map. Twist: make real objects on the table (cups, keys) act as obstacles in the game.

works.title: Richard Branson hologram (Virgin Digital launch)
works.description: At the launch of Virgin Digital in Virgin's London Megastore, Sir Richard Branson appears 'digitally downloaded' on stage as a semi-transparent life-size figure, filmed with a degree of transparency to look like a hologram.
works.description_zh: 在维珍伦敦旗舰店的 Virgin Digital 发布会上，理查德·布兰森爵士以半透明、真人大小的形象“被数字下载”到舞台上，拍摄时刻意保留一定透明度，让他看起来像全息影像。
works.idea_en: The designers chose to make the figure slightly transparent on purpose; AR avatars also need a visual 'this is virtual' cue so people trust what they see.
works.idea_zh: 设计者刻意让人物稍微透明；AR 虚拟形象也需要一个“这是虚拟的”视觉提示，人们才会信任看到的东西。
works.technique: Pre-recorded footage of Branson shot against black is projected onto an angled Eyeliner foil so he appears to stand on the stage.
works.technique_zh: 预先在黑背景前拍好的布兰森影像，被投到倾斜的 Eyeliner 薄膜上，让他看起来站在舞台上。
works.exercise_en: Record a classmate against a black backdrop, key the video, and place them as a slightly transparent AR presenter on a real table with Reality Composer or 8th Wall. Twist: test three levels of transparency and ask viewers which feels most honest.
works.exercise_zh: 在黑背景前录一位同学，抠像后用 Reality Composer 或 8th Wall 把他作为稍微透明的 AR 主持人放在一张真实桌子上；变体：测试三种透明度，问观众哪一种最“诚实”。

video.video_title: Hologram of Richard Branson - Virgin Digital Launch 2005

works.title: Round rainbow
works.description: A slowly turning acrylic ring hangs in a dark room and a spotlight shines on it; the ring throws a circular rainbow and moving light onto the walls around the visitor.
works.description_zh: 一个缓慢旋转的亚克力环悬在黑暗的房间里，被聚光灯照亮；圆环把一圈彩虹和移动的光投到观众四周的墙上。
works.idea_en: One small rotating object can paint a whole room with light; in AR, a single animated emitter can be enough to occupy and redefine a space.
works.idea_zh: 一个小小的旋转物体就能用光涂满整个房间；在 AR 里，一个会动的发光源就足以占据并重新定义一个空间。
works.technique: A precisely cut acrylic ring refracts a beam into a spectrum, and a motor rotates it so the projected rainbow sweeps around the walls.
works.technique_zh: 精确切割的亚克力环把光束折射成光谱，马达带动它旋转，投射出的彩虹在墙上扫过。
works.exercise_en: Place a virtual rotating prism ring in AR and use the room mesh to project its rainbow caustics onto the real walls, updating as it turns. Twist: let the user's phone flashlight act as the light source.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 里放一个虚拟的旋转棱镜环，利用房间网格把它的彩虹焦散投到真实墙面上，并随旋转更新。变体：用手机手电筒作为光源。

video.video_title: Olafur Elaisson, Round rainbow, 2016 - Film by SHIMURAbros

works.title: Scrapple
works.description: Everyday objects placed on a table are read as marks on a live musical score; the scanned table plays them as sound while projection augments the objects with graphics.
works.idea_zh: 桌上随手摆的物件就是乐谱，实时演奏并被投影标注。

video.video_title: Scrapple (Introductory Overview, 2005)

works.technique: An overhead camera segments objects on the table (background subtraction and blob detection), treating the x-axis as time and the y-axis as pitch like a spectrogram score, with a scanning playhead that sonifies blobs and projection highlighting them.
works.exercise_zh: 俯拍桌面，用 p5.js 检测物体色块，横轴当时间、纵轴当音高，一条播放线扫过时发声并投影高亮；变体：规定只能用厨房用品作曲，给全班演奏一段 30 秒“早餐乐”。
works.description_zh: 摆在桌上的日常物品被读作一份实时乐谱上的音符；扫描桌面时把它们演奏成声音，同时投影为这些物品叠加上图形。
works.idea_en: Whatever you toss on the table becomes a score that plays live and gets marked up by projection.
works.technique_zh: 俯拍摄像头分割桌上的物体（背景减除加色块检测），像频谱图乐谱一样把横轴当作时间、纵轴当作音高，一条扫描的播放头把色块转成声音，投影则将它们高亮显示。
works.exercise_en: Film the table from above, detect object blobs in p5.js with the horizontal axis as time and the vertical axis as pitch, and play and highlight them by projection as a playhead sweeps across. Twist: compose using only kitchen items and play the class a 30-second 'breakfast tune'.

works.title: Shadow Bag
works.description: The projector captures a viewer's shadow and re-projects it with unpredictable variations: sometimes a true shadow, sometimes a disembodied copy that runs toward or away from them.
works.idea_zh: 影子不再听话：有时跟随你，有时离开你独自行动
works.technique: A camera silhouette buffer is replayed with randomly chosen transforms (delay, offset, scale, direction) chosen per interaction.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个影子投影程序，随机切换“正常、延迟、镜像、逃跑”四种模式；变化：让同学猜当前是哪种规则。

video.video_title: Shadow Bag (2005) by Scott Snibbe

works.description_zh: 投影仪捕捉观众的影子，再以难以预料的变化重新投射出来：有时是真实的影子，有时是一个脱离身体的副本，朝观众跑来或从观众身边跑开。
works.idea_en: Your shadow stops obeying: sometimes it follows you, sometimes it walks off on its own.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头的剪影缓冲按每次互动随机选取的变换（延迟、偏移、缩放、方向）进行回放。
works.exercise_en: Build a shadow projection program that randomly switches among four modes: normal, delayed, mirrored and running away. Twist: have classmates guess which rule is active.

works.title: Square Wave
works.description: A square grid of suspended wooden blocks rises and falls as two perpendicular waves pass through it, forming a rippling surface that constantly crosses and recombines.
works.description_zh: 一个由悬挂木块组成的方形网格随着两道相互垂直的波起伏，形成不断交错又重组的涟漪曲面。
works.idea_en: Two simple sine waves added together already produce a surface that feels alive; AR motion can be built from the same small set of summed waves.
works.idea_zh: 两条简单正弦波相加，就能产生一个感觉有生命的曲面；AR 中的运动也可以用同样少量叠加的波构建。
works.technique: Two rows of camshafts each generate a wave; strings running over pulleys sum the two displacements at every grid point, so each block's height is x-wave plus y-wave.
works.technique_zh: 两排凸轮轴各自产生一道波，绕过滑轮的绳子在每个网格点把两个位移相加，因此每个木块的高度等于 x 向波加 y 向波。
works.exercise_en: Place a 20×20 grid of floating cubes over a real table in phone AR and set each height to sin(x+t)+sin(y+t). Twist: let the viewer's phone position set the phase of one of the waves.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 在真桌上方放一个 20×20 的悬浮方块阵列，每块高度设为 sin(x+t)+sin(y+t)。变体：用观众手机的位置决定其中一道波的相位。

video.video_title: Square Wave 2005

works.title: Subtitled Public
works.description: In an empty room a surveillance system detects each visitor and projects a random third-person verb onto their chest; the only way to get rid of your word is to touch someone else, who then takes it.
works.idea_zh: 每个人身上被投上一个动词标签，只有触碰别人才能把它传出去
works.technique: Overhead camera tracking follows each person and steers projections of text onto their body, swapping labels when two tracked blobs touch.
works.exercise_zh: 用俯拍摄像头追踪同学，在每人身上投一个词；两人碰到时交换词语；变化：把词换成同学自己写的形容词，观察标签如何流动。

video.video_title: Subtitled Public - Mexico City - 2005

works.description_zh: 在一个空房间里，监控系统检测到每位来访者，并在他们胸前投射一个随机的第三人称动词；想摆脱自己的词，唯一的办法是触碰别人，由对方接过去。
works.idea_en: Everyone gets a verb label projected on their body, and the only way to pass it on is to touch someone else.
works.technique_zh: 俯拍摄像头追踪每个人，引导文字投影落在其身体上，当两个被追踪的色块相互接触时交换标签。
works.exercise_en: Track classmates with an overhead camera and project a word onto each person, swapping words when two people touch. Twist: replace the words with adjectives the classmates wrote themselves, and watch how the labels flow.

salient.why_en: Each visitor is labeled with a projected verb, and the only way to pass it on is to touch someone else.
salient.why_zh: 每位访客身上都投着一个动词，要摆脱它，只能去触碰别人。

works.title: Talking Bodies
works.description: A solo evening made with composer Dan Hosken in which dancer Emily Fernandez's movement makes the body speak: words are projected large beside her and sounds follow her gestures as a camera tracks her.
