works.description_zh: 与作曲家 Dan Hosken 合作的独舞晚会：摄像机追踪舞者 Emily Fernandez，她的动作让身体“说话”，巨大的文字投影在她身旁出现，声音随手势变化。
works.idea_en: Treat the moving body as a speaker that produces both sound and text.
works.idea_zh: 把运动中的身体当成一个会发声、也会出字的说话者。
works.technique: A video camera feeds EyeCon, which measures motion in zones around the dancer and triggers speech sounds and projected words, with Kalypso processing the live video.
works.technique_zh: 摄像机画面进入 EyeCon，由它测量舞者周围各区域的运动量，触发语音和投影文字，Kalypso 负责实时处理视频。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam and p5.js body tracking to project a word next to a performer whenever they move into a new zone of the stage, building a sentence from their path. Twist: let movement speed decide the font size, so a leap shouts.
works.exercise_zh: 用网络摄像头和 p5.js 身体追踪，在表演者每走进舞台的一个新区域时，在其身旁投影出一个词，用行走路线拼出一句话；变体：用动作速度决定字号，让一次跳跃变成大喊。

video.video_title: Talking Bodies

works.title: Temporary Printing Machine
works.description: A moving head of UV lights passes over a glow-in-the-dark surface and 'prints' images and text in light, which slowly fade away.
works.description_zh: 一排移动的紫外灯扫过夜光表面，用光“印”出图像和文字，随后慢慢褪去。
works.idea_en: An image that fades invites people to make more — temporary AR marks are playful because they do not last.
works.idea_zh: 会褪去的图像会邀请人们不断再画——临时的 AR 痕迹之所以有趣，正是因为它们不会持久。
works.technique: A row of UV LEDs is scanned across a phosphorescent surface and switched per pixel, so the charged pigment glows and fades over minutes.
works.technique_zh: 一排紫外 LED 扫过磷光表面并逐像素开关，被激发的颜料发光并在几分钟内褪去。
works.exercise_en: Let users 'print' glowing words onto a real wall in AR by sweeping their phone across it, with the marks fading over two minutes. Twist: a mark only stays if a second person sweeps over it again.
works.exercise_zh: 让用户在 AR 中用手机扫过真实墙面来“印”出发光文字，这些痕迹在两分钟内褪去。变体：只有另一个人再扫一遍，痕迹才会保留。

video.video_title: RANDOM INTERNATIONAL | Temporary Printing Machine

works.title: The Andersen Project (Le projet Andersen)
works.description: A solo show based on Hans Christian Andersen's tales in which a curved projection screen and small physical openings let the performer step between Paris streets, an opera house and a peep-show booth.
works.description_zh: 一部取材于安徒生童话的独角戏，弧形投影幕和布景上的小开口让表演者在巴黎街头、歌剧院和偷窥亭之间穿行。
works.idea_en: Small physical cut-outs in a projected world give the performer real places to enter, the way AR portals are strongest when framed by a real doorway.
works.idea_zh: 投影世界里的小开口给了表演者真正能走进去的位置，就像 AR 传送门在真实门框的框定下最有力量。
works.technique: Video is projected onto a concave screen with openings and moving elements that the actor passes through.
works.technique_zh: 影像投到一块带开口和活动部件的凹面幕上，演员可以从中穿过。
works.exercise_en: Find a real doorway and anchor an AR street scene inside it with image or plane tracking, so walking through the door changes the city. Twist: the city changes depending on which door you choose.
works.exercise_zh: 找一个真实的门洞，用图像或平面追踪在门里锚定一个 AR 街景，走过这扇门城市就变了；变体：选择不同的门会通向不同的城市。

video.video_title: Le projet Andersen / The Andersen Project

works.title: The Gates, Central Park
works.description: 7,503 saffron-coloured gates with hanging fabric lined 37 kilometres of footpaths in New York's Central Park for 16 days in February.
works.description_zh: 7503 座挂着织物的藏红花色门廊沿纽约中央公园 37 公里长的步道排列，在二月展出 16 天。
works.idea_en: Repeating one element along every path turns a park's circulation into a visible drawing, a strong pattern for AR wayfinding.
works.idea_zh: 沿每条小径重复同一个元素，把公园的动线变成一幅可见的图，这是 AR 导航的有力模式。
works.technique: Gates of different widths were made to fit each path and stood on steel bases, so no holes were drilled in the park.
works.technique_zh: 门廊按每条小径的宽度定制，立在钢制底座上，因此没有在公园里打一个孔。
works.exercise_en: Generate a repeated saffron gate every five metres along a path traced from GPS or a map in an AR walk. Twist: gates only unfurl in front of the walker and fold up behind them.
works.exercise_zh: 在一次 AR 步行中，沿着根据 GPS 或地图描出的路径每五米生成一座藏红花色门；变体：门只在行人前方展开，在身后收起。

video.video_title: Christo: The Gates | Gagosian

works.title: The Voices of Oakland
works.description: An audio-AR walking tour of Atlanta's historic Oakland Cemetery where dramatized voices of the people buried there tell their stories at their graves.
works.idea_zh: 走进墓园，墓主人的声音在他们的墓前讲述自己的故事。

video.video_title: The Voices of Oakland experience

works.technique: GPS position triggers location-based audio segments and the narrative is structured as an interactive tour where the user chooses which story branches to hear at each grave.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机网页 + Geolocation API 在校园里设置 4 个地理围栏，走到某处自动播放一段同学录制的“这里发生过的故事”；变体：内容根据你来的方向或停留时间分叉。
works.description_zh: 在亚特兰大历史悠久的奥克兰公墓进行的音频 AR 徒步导览，由演员演绎的逝者之声在各自墓前讲述他们的故事。
works.idea_en: Walk into a cemetery and hear the people buried there tell their own stories at their graves.
works.technique_zh: 由 GPS 位置触发基于地点的音频片段，叙事被组织为一段互动导览，用户在每座墓前选择要收听哪条故事分支。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone web page and the Geolocation API to set up four geofences on campus, so that arriving at a spot automatically plays a classmate's recording of 'a story that happened here'. Twist: the content branches depending on the direction you came from or how long you stay.

salient.why_en: Walk through a cemetery and hear the people buried there tell their stories at their own graves.
salient.why_zh: 走进墓园，在每座坟前听安葬在那里的人讲自己的故事。

works.title: Under Scan (Relational Architecture 11)
works.description: Town squares are flooded with white light; as pedestrians walk, video portraits of local people appear inside their shadows, look up at them, and vanish when they leave.
works.idea_zh: 走在广场上，你的影子里会出现一个陌生人抬头看你
works.technique: Computer vision tracks pedestrians from above and predicts their path, so projectors place a video portrait precisely inside each person's shadow a moment ahead of them.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面投白光，用摄像头找到人影位置，把同学事先录好的抬头视频投在影子里；变化：影子停留越久，视频里的人说出越长的一句话。

video.video_title: Underscan

works.description_zh: 城镇广场被白光笼罩；行人走过时，当地人的视频肖像会出现在他们的影子里，抬头看着他们，人一离开就消失不见。
works.idea_en: Walk across the square and a stranger appears in your shadow, looking up at you.
works.technique_zh: 计算机视觉从上方追踪行人并预测其路径，使投影仪能提前一刻把视频肖像精确地投进每个人的影子里。
works.exercise_en: Project white light onto the ground, use a camera to find where shadows are, and project classmates' pre-recorded 'looking up' videos inside them. Twist: the longer a shadow stays, the longer the sentence the person in the video speaks.

salient.why_en: A stranger's portrait appears inside your shadow and looks up at you, turning a passing shadow into a meeting.
salient.why_zh: 陌生人的影像出现在你的影子里抬头看你，路过的影子变成了一次相遇。

works.title: Visceral Cinema: Chien
works.description: Scenes from Buñuel and Dalí's Un Chien Andalou are projected; viewers' shadows enter the film and take over the role of the character pulling a grand piano.
works.idea_zh: 观众的影子走进超现实主义电影，替代主角演出
works.technique: Live camera silhouettes are composited into pre-segmented film footage so that the shadow triggers and drives key moments of the scene.
works.exercise_zh: 选一段经典电影片段，用摄像头剪影把同学“放进”画面并触发下一个镜头；变化：只有当影子做出与原角色相同姿势时画面才继续。

video.video_title: Visceral Cinema: Chien (2005) by Scott Snibbe

works.description_zh: 投影播放布努埃尔和达利的《一条安达鲁狗》（Un Chien Andalou）片段；观众的影子走进电影，取代了拖着三角钢琴的那个角色。
works.idea_en: Visitors' shadows walk into a surrealist film and take over the lead role.
works.technique_zh: 把摄像头实时捕捉的剪影合成进预先分割好的电影画面中，让影子触发并推动场景中的关键时刻。
works.exercise_en: Pick a classic film clip, use camera silhouettes to 'put' classmates into the frame and trigger the next shot. Twist: the scene continues only when a shadow strikes the same pose as the original character.

works.title: Apparition (with Ars Electronica Futurelab)
works.description: Two dancers perform inside an interactive projection that is generated in real time from their movements, both on the backdrop and directly on their bodies.
works.idea_zh: 舞者动作实时生成投影，投在背景和身体上，身体与影像相互牵引
works.technique: Infrared camera tracking extracts the dancers' silhouettes and motion, feeding physics-based generative visuals that are projected back on the performers and the screen in real time.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头提取舞者轮廓，驱动粒子或弹簧网格实时投回舞者身上；变化：让影像“拒绝”舞者——轮廓靠近时图案向外逃开。

video.video_title: Apparition – Klaus Obermaier & Ars Electronica Futurelab (2004)

works.description_zh: 两位舞者在互动投影中表演，投影根据他们的动作实时生成，既投在背景上，也直接投在他们的身体上。
works.idea_en: Dancers' moves generate projections live on the backdrop and on their bodies, so body and image pull on each other.
works.technique_zh: 红外摄像头追踪提取舞者的剪影和动作，输入基于物理的生成式视觉系统，再实时投射回表演者身上和屏幕上。
works.exercise_en: Extract a dancer's outline with a camera and use it to drive particles or a spring mesh projected back onto the dancer in real time. Twist: make the image 'reject' the dancer, with patterns fleeing outward as the outline approaches.

works.title: Articulated Cloud
works.description: The façade of the Children's Museum of Pittsburgh is a veil of thousands of translucent squares that shimmer in the wind like a cloud wrapped around the building.
works.description_zh: 匹兹堡儿童博物馆的立面是一层由数千块半透明方片组成的帘幕，随风闪动，像一朵裹住建筑的云。
works.idea_en: A soft, moving skin makes architecture feel weather-sensitive; AR façades can borrow this idea of a responsive veil over a fixed structure.
works.idea_zh: 柔软而流动的外皮让建筑显得对天气敏感；AR 立面可以借用这种“覆盖在固定结构上的会回应的帘幕”。
works.technique: Lightweight plastic tiles on hinged mounts respond individually to wind and scatter daylight, creating a large-scale analog display of turbulence.
works.technique_zh: 轻质塑料片装在铰接支架上，各自对风作出反应并散射日光，形成一个大尺度的湍流模拟显示屏。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a translucent tile veil to a real building with geospatial AR and animate each tile with Perlin-noise wind. Twist: make the veil part where people walk underneath.
works.exercise_zh: 用地理空间 AR 在真实建筑上锚定一层半透明方片帘幕，用 Perlin 噪声风驱动每一片。变体：有人从下面走过时，帘幕分开。

video.video_title: Articulated Cloud

works.title: Automatic Projector Calibration with Embedded Light Sensors
works.description: Light sensors hidden in the corners of a screen or object read a quick sequence of black-and-white stripe patterns, so the projector instantly knows where they are and fits its image exactly onto the target, even across several projectors or onto 3D shapes.
works.description_zh: 藏在屏幕或物体角落的光传感器读取一串快速闪过的黑白条纹图案，投影仪立刻知道它们在哪里，把画面精确贴合到目标上，也适用于多台投影仪拼接或 3D 物体。
works.idea_en: Let the surface tell the projector where it is.
works.idea_zh: 让被投影的表面自己告诉投影仪它在哪里。
works.technique: The projector shows Gray-coded binary patterns; each embedded photosensor decodes the on/off sequence it receives into its own pixel coordinate, which is used to pre-warp the image (UIST 2004, with Paul Dietz and Ramesh Raskar).
works.technique_zh: 投影仪依次投出格雷码二值图案，每个嵌入的光敏传感器把自己接收到的明暗序列解码成所在的像素坐标，用来预先变形画面（UIST 2004，合作者包括 Paul Dietz 和 Ramesh Raskar）。
works.exercise_en: Recreate structured-light calibration: project a sequence of stripe patterns and film them with a phone, then decode which pixel falls on a paper target to align an image to it. Twist: move the target and re-calibrate in under ten seconds.
works.exercise_zh: 复现结构光校准：投出一串条纹图案并用手机拍下，解码出落在纸板目标上的像素位置，再把画面对准它。变体：移动目标，在十秒内重新校准。

video.video_title: Automatic Projector Calibration with Embedded Light Sensors

works.title: Cause and Effect
works.description: Viewers' silhouettes are recorded as they bump into the shadow-recordings of previous visitors; replays show only the recorded movements, so reactions look like autonomous gestures.
works.idea_zh: 你的动作被录下来，与前人的影子互相推挤，形成跨时间的因果链
works.technique: Silhouette clips recorded from a camera are placed on sliding tiles whose positions are displaced by live shadows, chaining recordings of different visitors together.
works.exercise_zh: 录下每位同学的剪影片段并排成一排，让下一位的影子推动前面的片段滑动；变化：把推挤的顺序变成一条可回放的“多米诺”时间线。

video.video_title: Cause and Effect (2004) by Scott Snibbe

works.description_zh: 观众的剪影在撞上此前观众的影子录像时被记录下来；回放时只显示录下的动作，因此那些反应看起来像是自发的手势。
works.idea_en: Your movements are recorded and jostle with the shadows of earlier visitors, forming a chain of cause and effect across time.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头录下的剪影片段放在可滑动的格子上，格子的位置会被实时影子推移，从而把不同观众的录像串联起来。
works.exercise_en: Record a silhouette clip of each classmate, line them up in a row, and let the next person's shadow push the earlier clips along. Twist: turn the order of pushes into a replayable 'domino' timeline.

works.title: Crown Fountain
works.description: Two 15-metre glass-brick towers in Chicago's Millennium Park show video faces of a thousand Chicagoans; every few minutes a face purses its lips and water spouts from its mouth onto children playing in the pool.
works.description_zh: 芝加哥千禧公园里两座 15 米高的玻璃砖塔播放着一千位芝加哥市民的面孔视频；每隔几分钟，某张脸会撅起嘴，水从嘴中喷出，落在池中嬉戏的孩子身上。
works.idea_en: A giant face that suddenly does something physical (spits water) creates delight and play, a good cue for AR characters that trigger real-world effects.
works.idea_zh: 一张巨大的脸突然做出一个实体动作（喷水），带来惊喜和游戏，这是让 AR 角色触发现实效果的好提示。
works.technique: LED screens behind glass bricks play filmed portraits; a nozzle at the mouth position is synchronised with the video to release water.
works.technique_zh: 玻璃砖后的 LED 屏播放拍摄的人像；位于嘴部位置的喷嘴与视频同步喷水。
works.exercise_en: Record short face videos of classmates and place them as two huge AR screens facing each other on a plaza; when a face puckers, spawn an AR water jet between them. Twist: trigger the water with the real user's own lip pucker via face tracking.
works.exercise_zh: 录制同学的短面部视频，在广场上做成两块相对的巨大 AR 屏幕；当某张脸撅嘴时，在两屏之间生成 AR 水柱；变体：通过面部追踪，用真实用户自己的撅嘴动作触发喷水。

video.video_title: Jaume Plensa.  Crown Fountain.  2004. Millennium Park, Chicago

works.title: Dual Purpose Speech
works.description: While scheduling a meeting in conversation, the wearer phrases sentences like 'next Tuesday at three?' so that the other person hears a normal question and the wearable calendar hears a command.
works.description_zh: 在对话中约会议时，佩戴者说出诸如“下周二三点可以吗？”这样的句子：对方听到的是普通提问，可穿戴日历听到的却是一条指令。
works.idea_en: Speech that serves two listeners at once, the person and the computer, keeping interaction socially invisible.
works.idea_zh: 一句话同时说给两个听众：人和计算机，让交互在社交中变得不可察觉。
works.technique: A push-to-talk key marks the phrases to recognise, and a speech recogniser with a calendar grammar turns them into navigation of the head-up calendar.
works.technique_zh: 用一个按键标记需要识别的语句，语音识别器配合日历语法，把它们转换成对抬头日历的操作。
works.exercise_en: Design a voice UI for AR glasses where every command is also a natural sentence to a friend, and test it in a two-person role play. Twist: add a phrase that cancels without the friend noticing.
works.exercise_zh: 为 AR 眼镜设计一个语音界面，每条指令同时也是对朋友说的自然句子，并在两人角色扮演中测试。变体：加入一句能取消操作、而朋友察觉不到的话。

video.video_title: Wearable Computing:  Using Dual Purpose Speech to control a calendar program

works.title: Madame K
works.description: A multimedia solo where Madame K, a woman who wants to escape her imperfect body, is shaped and disguised by video projections that fall on her and around her.
works.description_zh: 一部多媒体独舞：想要逃离自己不完美身体的 Madame K，被落在她身上和周围的影像投影塑造、伪装。
works.idea_en: Projection as make-up: the image a body wants to show versus the body itself.
works.idea_zh: 把投影当作化妆：身体想展示的形象与身体本身之间的对峙。
works.technique: Pre-edited video is projected onto the performer and set, with choreography timed so her body fits into or breaks out of the projected shapes.
works.technique_zh: 预先剪辑好的影像投射到表演者和布景上，编舞精确卡点，让她的身体嵌入或挣脱投影出来的形状。
works.exercise_en: Project a filmed face or outfit onto a volunteer standing in a fixed spot, and choreograph 30 seconds of fitting in and slipping out of it. Twist: the projection is of a different person.
works.exercise_zh: 把拍好的一张脸或一套服装投到站在固定位置的志愿者身上，编排 30 秒“贴合”与“滑出”的动作；变体：投影的是另一个人。

video.video_title: Cie Nicole Seiler - Madame K (2004), teaser

works.title: Surfacing
works.description: Onstage cameras capture the dancers and trap their images inside a three-storey video screen, where their doubles fall in slow motion while the real bodies move freely below.
works.description_zh: 舞台上的摄像机捕捉舞者，把他们的影像“困”在三层楼高的屏幕里，影像分身在其中慢动作坠落，而真实的身体在下方自由移动。
works.idea_en: Your image is confined while your body is free, so which one are you?
works.idea_zh: 影像被囚禁，身体却自由，你究竟是哪一个？
works.technique: Live camera feeds are processed in Isadora (time-stretching, cropping, scaling) and projected at architectural scale in sync with the choreography.
works.technique_zh: 现场摄像画面在 Isadora 中处理（时间拉伸、裁切、缩放），再与编舞同步投影成建筑尺度。
works.exercise_en: Point a webcam at a performer, crop their image into a narrow projected box, and slow it to half speed. Twist: the box shrinks every time the performer leaves the camera's view.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头对准表演者，把画面裁进一个狭窄的投影框里，并放慢到半速；变体：表演者每离开一次镜头，框就缩小一点。

video.video_title: Surfacing, St. Marks Church, NYC 2004 (excerpt)

works.title: Time Scan
works.description: A screen shows the viewer through a slit-scan effect: each column of the image comes from a slightly different moment, so moving bodies stretch and bend in time.
works.description_zh: 屏幕通过狭缝扫描效果显示观众：画面的每一列来自稍有不同的时刻，于是运动的身体在时间里被拉长、弯折。
works.idea_en: Slit-scan turns time into a spatial axis, one of the simplest ways to make motion visible in a live AR camera effect.
works.idea_zh: 狭缝扫描把时间变成一条空间轴，是在实时 AR 摄像头效果中让运动可见的最简单方法之一。
works.technique: A buffer of recent video frames is kept, and each column of the output takes pixels from a frame further back in time.
works.technique_zh: 保存最近若干帧视频，输出画面的每一列从越来越早的帧中取像素。
works.exercise_en: Write a slit-scan camera shader for a phone that stores the last 120 frames and samples them by screen column, then point it at dancers. Twist: map time to distance from the phone using LiDAR depth instead of columns.
works.exercise_zh: 为手机写一个狭缝扫描摄像头着色器：保存最近 120 帧并按屏幕列采样，然后对准舞者。变体：用 LiDAR 深度代替列，把时间映射到离手机的距离。

video.video_title: Daniel Rozin, "Time Scan," 2004

works.title: Touching (e-touching)
works.description: Two dancers wrestle, lean and press their hands together, and every moment of skin-to-skin contact becomes audible: the harder or longer they touch, the more the sound changes.
works.description_zh: 两位舞者掰手腕、相互倚靠、手掌相抵，每一次皮肤接触都会变成声音：碰得越用力、越久，声音变化越大。
works.idea_en: Make touch between two people audible, because even the smallest contact carries meaning.
works.idea_zh: 让两个人之间的触碰被听见，因为再轻的接触也承载着意义。
works.technique: Custom electronics detect the tiny current that flows between two bodies when their skin touches and feed it into EyeCon's external-sensor input, which maps contact to sound.
works.technique_zh: 定制电路检测两人皮肤接触时流过身体的微弱电流，并送入 EyeCon 的外部传感器接口，把接触映射为声音。
works.exercise_en: Build a touch-to-sound duet with a Makey Makey or a capacitive-touch board: each partner holds one lead, and skin contact triggers a sound in a web page or Pure Data. Twist: map contact duration to pitch so a held hand becomes a slow glissando.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Makey Makey 或电容触摸板做一段“触碰发声”双人舞：两人各握一根导线，皮肤接触就在网页或 Pure Data 里触发声音；变体：把接触时长映射到音高，让握住的手变成一段缓慢的滑音。

video.video_title: Touching

salient.why_en: Skin-to-skin contact between two dancers becomes audible, so every touch is heard.
salient.why_zh: 两位舞者皮肤相触就会发声，每一次触碰都能被听见。

works.title: Untitled 5 (External Measures series)
works.description: A projected 'living painting' where visitors' movements leave soft, overlapping painterly marks that respond to how long and how fast people stay.
works.idea_zh: 人的停留与移动在墙上留下会生长的绘画笔触
works.technique: Camera-tracked body positions and motion history drive generative brush-stroke systems that accumulate and decay over time.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头运动检测驱动生成式笔刷，在投影上留下随停留时间变粗的笔触；变化：只有两个人靠近时才会出现连接两人的线条。

video.video_title: Camille Utterback - Untitled 5

works.description_zh: 一幅投影出来的“活的绘画”：观众的动作留下柔和、相互交叠的绘画笔触，并会根据人停留的时长和移动的速度作出回应。
works.idea_en: People's pauses and movements leave growing brushstrokes on the wall.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪的身体位置和运动历史驱动生成式笔触系统，笔触随时间累积并逐渐衰减。
works.exercise_en: Drive a generative brush with camera motion detection, leaving strokes on the projection that thicken the longer someone stays. Twist: a line connecting two people appears only when they come close to each other.

works.title: ZENetic Computer
works.description: The user arranges elements in a virtual ink-wash landscape, and the system answers with Zen-style riddles and stories built from Buddhist concepts, inviting reflection rather than tasks.
works.description_zh: 用户在虚拟水墨山水中摆放元素，系统以禅宗公案式的谜语和故事回应（基于佛教的五蕴概念），引导人反思而不是完成任务。
works.idea_en: A computer that asks you questions instead of answering them.
works.idea_zh: 一台向你提问、而不是替你回答的计算机。
works.technique: A tangible or pointer interface places symbolic objects in a sansui landscape, and a story engine maps their arrangement to the five skandhas to select koan-like dialogues.
works.technique_zh: 通过实体或指向式界面把象征物放进山水画中，故事引擎把它们的排列映射到五蕴，选出类似公案的对话。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR sand tray where placing three physical tokens produces a short, strange question generated from their combination. Twist: the question is spoken, never shown.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个 AR 沙盘：放下三枚实体标记，就会根据它们的组合生成一个简短而奇特的问题。变体：问题只读出来，从不显示。

video.video_title: Zenetic Computer

works.title: Compliant
works.description: A soft rectangle of projected light behaves like a rubber sheet: visitors' shadows push, dent and chase it around the wall.
works.idea_zh: 让屏幕像橡皮膜一样被人的影子推开、挤扁
works.technique: The shadow silhouette from a camera is used as a collision boundary for a spring-mesh (soft-body) simulation of the projected rectangle.
works.exercise_zh: 在p5.js里做一块弹簧网格方块，用摄像头人影轮廓当作碰撞体去推它并投影出来；变化：让方块被挤压时发出音调随形变变化的声音。

video.video_title: Compliant (2003) by Scott Snibbe

works.description_zh: 一块柔软的投影光矩形像橡皮膜一样：观众的影子可以推它、把它压出凹陷，还能追着它在墙上跑。
works.idea_en: Make the screen behave like a rubber sheet that people's shadows push and squash.
works.technique_zh: 把摄像头得到的影子剪影作为碰撞边界，用于投影矩形的弹簧网格（软体）模拟。
works.exercise_en: Build a spring-mesh square in p5.js, use the camera silhouette of a person as a collider to push it, and project the result. Twist: make the square emit a tone that changes pitch with its deformation when squeezed.

works.title: Counter Void
works.description: Six giant digital counters, each over three metres tall, glow on a glass wall in Roppongi, Tokyo, counting down from 9 to 1 at different speeds and never showing zero; after the 2011 earthquake it was switched off and is relit each March.
works.description_zh: 东京六本木一面玻璃墙上，六个各高三米多的巨大数字计数器发出光亮，以不同速度从 9 倒数到 1，从不显示 0；2011 年地震后它被关闭，此后每年三月重新点亮。
works.idea_en: Numbers counting at different speeds can speak about life and loss; a public AR piece can carry memory by being switched on only on certain days.
works.idea_zh: 以不同速度计数的数字可以讲述生命与失去；公共 AR 作品可以只在特定日子开启，以此承载记忆。
works.technique: Neon-lit seven-segment numerals behind a glass facade are driven by controllers that set a different counting rhythm for each digit.
works.technique_zh: 玻璃幕墙后的七段霓虹数字由控制器驱动，每一位数字都有不同的计数节奏。
works.exercise_en: Place a row of AR counters on a school wall with 8th Wall image targets, each counting down at a speed chosen by a different student and skipping zero. Twist: make the counters appear only on one date of the year that the class chooses.
works.exercise_zh: 用 8th Wall 图像目标在学校墙上放一排 AR 计数器，每个以不同同学选定的速度倒数，并跳过 0。变体：让计数器只在全班选定的某一天出现。

video.video_title: Counter Void by Tatsuo Miyajima in Relight Project at Roppongi,Tokyo

works.title: Frequency and Volume (Relational Architecture 9)
works.description: Visitors' shadows on a wall tune a radio: the position of the shadow selects a frequency and its size sets the volume, making the invisible airwaves audible and contested.
works.idea_zh: 用影子在墙上“调台”，收听城市里看不见的电波
works.technique: A camera tracks shadow position and size on the wall and maps them to frequency and volume of an array of computer-controlled radio receivers.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头检测墙上影子的水平位置控制音频播放的片段、大小控制音量；变化：让多个影子重叠时声音混合或互相干扰。

video.video_title: rafael lozano-hemmer: frequency and volume

works.description_zh: 观众投在墙上的影子可以调收音机：影子的位置选择频率，影子的大小决定音量，让看不见的电波变得可以听见，也变得可以争夺。
works.idea_en: Tune a radio with your shadow on the wall to hear the city's invisible airwaves.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪墙上影子的位置和大小，并把它们映射为一组计算机控制的无线电接收器的频率和音量。
works.exercise_en: Use a camera to detect a shadow on the wall, with its horizontal position choosing which audio clip plays and its size setting the volume. Twist: when several shadows overlap, their sounds mix or interfere with each other.

works.title: Future of Memory
works.description: A Bessie Award-winning piece in which four characters re-live memories while live video of their bodies is captured, looped, fragmented and replayed on stage, showing how recall rewrites the past.
works.description_zh: 获得 Bessie 奖的作品：四个角色重温记忆，同时他们身体的现场影像被捕捉、循环、切碎并在舞台上重放，呈现回忆如何改写过去。
works.idea_en: Live video as memory: what the camera keeps is distorted each time it is replayed.
works.idea_zh: 把实时影像当作记忆：摄像机留下的东西每次重放都会走样。
works.technique: Live cameras feed Isadora, where movement sensing triggers recording, looping and processing of the captured footage projected behind the performers.
works.technique_zh: 现场摄像机接入 Isadora，由动作感应触发对画面的录制、循环和处理，再投影到表演者身后。
works.exercise_en: Build a TouchDesigner or browser tool that records five seconds of webcam video whenever a person raises both arms and replays it with more glitch each time. Twist: the audience decides which memory gets deleted.
works.exercise_zh: 用 TouchDesigner 或浏览器做一个工具：人举起双臂时录下五秒摄像头画面，之后每次重放都加入更多故障效果；变体：由观众决定删除哪一段记忆。

video.video_title: Future of Memory, The Duke Theater, NYC 2003 (excerpt)

works.title: Inside Australia
works.description: Fifty-one thin black figures, based on body scans of the residents of the tiny town of Menzies, stand scattered over ten square kilometres of the dry salt lake Lake Ballard in Western Australia.
works.description_zh: 五十一尊纤细的黑色人像以西澳小镇 Menzies 居民的身体扫描为原型，散布在干涸盐湖 Lake Ballard 约十平方公里的湖面上。
works.idea_en: Scanning a whole community and placing their slimmed bodies in the desert makes a town's population visible as a landscape, something AR could do with volunteers' scans.
works.idea_zh: 扫描整个社区，把他们被“削瘦”的身体放在沙漠里，让一个小镇的人口变成一片风景；AR 也可以用志愿者的扫描做到这一点。
works.technique: Laser scans of each resident were digitally reduced to a thin core, then cast in an alloy that the salt and sun slowly rust.
works.technique_zh: 每位居民的激光扫描被数字化“削减”到只剩纤细的核心，然后用会被盐和阳光慢慢锈蚀的合金铸成。
works.exercise_en: Scan five classmates with Polycam, scale each model's thickness down to 30% in Blender, and place them far apart on a field in AR. Twist: tag each figure with its owner's spoken sentence that plays when you reach it.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Polycam 扫描五位同学，在 Blender 中把每个模型的厚度缩到 30%，再在 AR 中把它们相隔很远地放在操场上；变体：每个人像附带其本人的一句话，走到跟前时播放。

video.video_title: Antony Gormley Sculptures - Lake Ballard, Western Australia

works.title: La situazione antispettiva
works.description: A mirror-lined structure at the Venice Biennale folds the surrounding garden and visitors into kaleidoscopic repeats, so the outside world appears multiplied from within.
works.description_zh: 威尼斯双年展上一个内衬镜面的结构，把周围的花园和观众折叠成万花筒般的重复，外面的世界从里面看被成倍增加。
works.idea_en: Mirrors placed at exact angles turn one view into an infinite pattern; AR can use the live camera image as raw material for geometric multiplication.
works.idea_zh: 以精确角度摆放的镜子，把一个视角变成无限图案；AR 可以把实时摄像画面当作几何复制的原料。
works.technique: Mirror panels are joined at fixed angles (likely a kaleidoscopic polyhedron) so that reflections of the surroundings repeat in a regular tiling.
works.technique_zh: 镜面板以固定角度拼接（可能是一个万花筒式多面体），让周围环境的倒影按规则图案重复。
works.exercise_en: Build a Lens Studio or WebXR effect that slices the live camera feed into a triangle and repeats it in a kaleidoscope around a point anchored in space. Twist: make the number of mirror segments depend on how close the user walks.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Lens Studio 或 WebXR 里做一个效果：把实时摄像画面切成三角形，并在空间中某个锚点周围像万花筒一样重复。变体：让镜面的数量取决于用户走得有多近。

video.video_title: Olafur Eliasson, La situazione antispettiva, 2003

works.title: Schlamp
works.description: An interactive video installation made with Emily Fernandez for a virtual public square in Dresden, where visitors' movement smears and stirs projected video imagery.
works.description_zh: 与 Emily Fernandez 为德累斯顿一个虚拟公共广场创作的交互影像装置，观众的动作会涂抹、搅动投影出来的影像。
works.idea_en: Let passers-by paint with their bodies on a projected surface.
works.idea_zh: 让路人在投影表面上用身体作画。
works.technique: EyeCon motion sensing measures movement in the camera image and uses it to distort and blend video layers in real time.
works.technique_zh: EyeCon 动作感应测量摄像头画面中的运动，并据此实时扭曲、混合多层视频。
works.exercise_en: Compute frame differences from a webcam and use them as a mask that reveals a hidden video beneath a live one. Twist: the revealed areas heal back after ten seconds.
works.exercise_zh: 计算摄像头的帧间差，把它当作遮罩，在实时画面下方揭开一段隐藏的视频；变体：被揭开的区域十秒后会慢慢愈合。

video.video_title: Emily Schlamp

works.title: Shadows
works.description: A shadow play for dancer Emily Fernandez in which her shadow is projected by the computer, so it can lag, speed up, mirror, change colour or detach from her.
works.description_zh: 为舞者 Emily Fernandez 创作的影子戏：她的影子由计算机投影生成，可以延迟、加速、镜像、变色，甚至脱离她的身体。
works.idea_en: Your shadow stops obeying you.
works.idea_zh: 你的影子不再听你的话。
works.technique: A camera captures the dancer's silhouette and the software re-projects it as a shadow with digital delays, time stretching, translation and mirroring.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头捕捉舞者剪影，软件再把它作为影子投回，并加入延迟、时间拉伸、位移和镜像等数字处理。
works.exercise_en: Capture a silhouette with a webcam, store the last few seconds in a buffer, and project the delayed shadow next to the real one. Twist: the shadow copies you only when you are not looking at it.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头捕捉剪影，缓存最近几秒的画面，把延迟后的影子投在真实影子旁边；变体：只有你不看它的时候，影子才模仿你。

video.video_title: Shadows

salient.why_en: A dancer's shadow is drawn by a computer, so it lags, mirrors and finally walks away from her.
salient.why_zh: 舞者的影子由电脑画出，于是它会迟到、会反着动，最后干脆离她而去。

works.title: Shiny Balls Mirror
works.description: 921 hexagonal chrome tubes each hold a shiny ball; motors push the tubes in and out so the balls catch more or less light and form a reflection of the viewer, who also sees themselves in every ball.
works.description_zh: 921 根六角形镀铬管里各装着一颗闪亮的球；电机把管子推进推出，让球接收或多或少的光，拼出观众的倒影——观众同时也能在每颗球里看到自己。
works.idea_en: A mirror made of tiny mirrors creates two reflections at once, a playful layering an AR designer can reuse for picture-in-picture views.
works.idea_zh: 由小镜子组成的镜子同时产生两层倒影，这种有趣的叠加可被 AR 设计者用于画中画式的视图。
works.technique: A camera image is reduced to the tube grid and motors set each tube's depth; recessed balls look dark and extended balls reflect the room light.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头图像被降采样到管子网格，电机设定每根管子的深度；缩进的球显暗，伸出的球反射室内光线。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR grid of chrome spheres with real-time environment reflections, and push each sphere forward according to the brightness of the user's camera image. Twist: have each sphere show a different moment from the last minute.
works.exercise_zh: 搭一个带实时环境反射的 AR 镀铬球阵列，按用户摄像头图像的亮度把每颗球向前推。变体：让每颗球显示过去一分钟里的不同时刻。

video.video_title: Daniel Rozin, "Shiny Balls Mirror," 2003

works.title: The weather project
works.description: A giant semicircle of yellow lamps reflected in a mirrored ceiling forms a sun in Tate Modern's Turbine Hall; visitors lie on the floor in the mist and look for themselves in the ceiling.
works.description_zh: Tate Modern 涡轮大厅里，一个由黄色灯组成的巨大半圆，被镜面天花板反射成一轮太阳；观众在雾气中躺在地上，在天花板里寻找自己。
works.idea_en: Half an object plus a mirror makes a whole one, and a mirrored ceiling turns the audience into the show: an AR scene can add the viewers themselves to the spectacle.
works.idea_zh: 半个物体加一面镜子就成了完整的物体，镜面天花板让观众自己成为展品：AR 场景也可以把观众本身加进奇观里。
works.technique: Hundreds of single-frequency sodium-like lamps behind a semicircular screen emit narrow yellow light that flattens all other colours, while a mirror foil ceiling doubles the hall and a haze machine adds atmosphere.
works.technique_zh: 半圆形幕布后面的数百盏单频灯只发出窄波段黄光，使其他颜色都变得灰暗；镜面膜天花板让大厅翻倍，雾机制造出空气感。
works.exercise_en: Place a half-disc sun at the end of a corridor in AR and mirror the whole scene (including a live camera feed of the people) onto a virtual ceiling. Twist: switch the scene to a single yellow wavelength so every colour in the passthrough turns grey.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 里的走廊尽头放半个太阳，并把整个场景（包括人的实时摄像画面）镜像到一块虚拟天花板上。变体：把场景切换成单一黄色波长，让透视画面里的所有颜色都变成灰色。

video.video_title: The weather project, 2003

works.title: Anima
works.description: A touring company of performers is haunted by memories: on the road and in hotel rooms they illustrate excerpts of a BBC interview with anthropologist Desmond Morris, while projected bodies appear, dissolve and multiply beside the dancers.
works.description_zh: 一群巡演中的表演者被回忆纠缠：在路上、在旅馆里，他们演绎人类学家 Desmond Morris 接受 BBC 采访的片段，投影出来的身体在舞者身旁出现、消散、复制。
works.idea_en: The clash between a real body and its projected double makes the audience feel the gap between body and soul; AR doubles can carry meaning, not just spectacle.
works.idea_zh: 真实身体与投影分身之间的冲突，让观众感受到身体与灵魂的距离；AR 分身可以承载意义，而不只是奇观。
works.technique: Life-size projections on nearly invisible screens are placed downstage of the performers so projected and real bodies appear in the same depth plane.
works.technique_zh: 在几乎看不见的幕上投出真人大小的影像，放在表演者的前方，让投影与真人看起来处在同一景深。
works.exercise_en: Record a dancer's short phrase and place three delayed AR copies of it next to the live dancer with body tracking in Lens Studio or a WebXR app. Twist: each copy is delayed a little more, so the phrase becomes a canon in space.
works.exercise_zh: 录下一位舞者的一小段动作，用 Lens Studio 或 WebXR 应用的人体追踪，在现场舞者身旁放三个延迟的 AR 分身；变体：每个分身的延迟逐渐增加，让这段动作在空间里变成一首轮唱。

video.video_title: Lemieux Pilon 4D Art - Anima (2002)

works.title: Brother/Sister (Blinde Liebe)
works.description: An evening-length interactive opera about two teenagers who committed a murder, with two dancers, two actors, five musicians, projected interview footage and dancers whose tracked movement shapes the electronic sound.
works.description_zh: 一部讲述两名少年犯下谋杀案的长篇互动歌剧：两位舞者、两位演员、五位乐手，加上投影的真实访谈影像，舞者被追踪的动作塑造着电子声音。
works.idea_en: Let the dancers' bodies play part of an opera score in real time.
works.idea_zh: 让舞者的身体实时演奏歌剧配乐的一部分。
works.technique: EyeCon analyses the camera image of each dancer and sends motion data to Max/MSP, which triggers and modulates electroacoustic material, while Kalypso processes projected video.
works.technique_zh: EyeCon 分析每位舞者的摄像画面，把动作数据发给 Max/MSP 触发并调制电子声学素材，Kalypso 则处理投影视频。
works.exercise_en: Stage a two-minute scene where one actor speaks text and a dancer's tracked motion (webcam + Pose detection) controls a drone sound underneath; rehearse until movement and words argue with each other. Twist: freeze the sound whenever the dancer stops, so silence becomes a line of dialogue.
works.exercise_zh: 排一段两分钟的场景：一位演员念台词，另一位舞者被网络摄像头和姿态识别追踪，其动作控制底下的一层持续音；反复排练，直到动作与台词彼此争辩；变体：舞者一停，声音就冻结，让沉默也成为一句台词。

video.video_title: Brother/Sister

works.title: Deep Walls
works.description: A projected wall of sixteen small cupboards: when someone walks into the beam their shadow is recorded, then replayed forever in one of the cupboards as a looping shadow-film of past visitors.
works.idea_zh: 把路过的人影录下来，放进墙上的“影子橱柜”永远循环播放
works.technique: A camera segments the viewer's silhouette against the projection, records it while someone is in frame, and drops the clip into a grid cell that loops once the space is empty.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头抠出人影剪影、录成几秒循环，再拼成网格投影；变化：每个格子只保留某一种动作（如挥手或跳），由简单规则判断放入哪一格。

video.video_title: Deep Walls (2002) by Scott Snibbe

works.description_zh: 墙上投影出十六个小橱柜：有人走进光束时，他的影子会被录下，随后在某个橱柜里永远循环播放，成为一段往昔访客的影子电影。
works.idea_en: Record passing shadows and keep them looping forever in 'shadow cupboards' on the wall.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头以投影为背景分割出观众的剪影，在有人入画时进行录制，并在空间变空后把片段放进网格中的一个格子里循环播放。
works.exercise_en: Use a camera to cut out people's silhouettes, record them as loops a few seconds long, and assemble them into a projected grid. Twist: each cell keeps only one kind of action (such as waving or jumping), with a simple rule deciding which cell a clip goes into.

works.title: Fireflies on the Water
works.description: One visitor at a time steps onto a small platform in a dark mirrored room; about 150 tiny lights hang over a black pool and repeat endlessly in the mirrors and the water.
works.description_zh: 每次只允许一位观众走上小平台，站进一间漆黑的镜面房间；约 150 盏小灯悬在黑色水池上方，在镜子和水面里无限重复。
works.idea_en: A few points of light plus mirrors on every side are enough to make a closet feel like the night sky, so an AR scene does not need many assets, only the right reflections.
works.idea_zh: 几点光加上四面镜子，就能让一个小房间变成星空：AR 场景不需要堆素材，关键是反射。
works.technique: Mirror walls and a still water floor create recursive reflections of small hanging bulbs, and the one-person, short-visit rule keeps the illusion unbroken.
works.technique_zh: 镜面墙和静止的水面让悬挂的小灯泡不断互相反射；一次一人、限时观看的规则保证幻觉不被打破。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR 'mirror room' in AR Foundation: place 30 glowing points over a detected floor and render them again in a mirrored copy of the scene below the floor plane and in four virtual mirror walls. Twist: let each point fade out when the viewer's gaze rests on it, so looking makes the fireflies disappear.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 做一个手机 AR「镜屋」：在识别到的地面上方放 30 个发光点，并在地面以下和四面虚拟镜墙中各渲染一份镜像副本。变体：当视线停在某个光点上时，让它慢慢熄灭，看的行为本身让萤火虫消失。

video.video_title: Yayoi Kusama, Fireflies on the Water, 2002

works.title: Liquid Time Series
works.description: A viewer's movement fragments a pre-recorded street video: the closer they step to the projection screen, the deeper that part of the image slides into the past.
works.idea_zh: 你离屏幕越近，那一块画面就越退回到过去
works.technique: A camera measures each viewer's position and distance, and a slit-scan-style buffer picks older frames for image regions nearest to the viewer.
works.exercise_zh: 把一段视频存成帧缓冲，用摄像头检测人的位置，人所在的竖条显示更早的帧；变化：用手机距离传感或声音大小控制“回到过去”的深度。

video.video_title: Camille Utterback - Liquid Time Series - Tokyo and New York

works.description_zh: 观众的移动会把一段预先录制的街景视频打碎：他们离投影屏越近，那一部分画面就越深地滑回过去。
works.idea_en: The closer you get to the screen, the further that patch of the picture slips back into the past.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头测量每位观众的位置和距离，用类似狭缝扫描的缓冲区为离观众最近的图像区域选取更早的帧。
works.exercise_en: Store a video as a frame buffer, detect a person's position with a camera, and show earlier frames in the vertical strip where they stand. Twist: use the phone's proximity sensor or sound volume to control how far back into the past it goes.

salient.why_en: The closer you step to the image, the further that patch slips into the past, so distance becomes time.
salient.why_zh: 你离画面越近，那一块就越退回过去，距离变成了时间。

works.title: Maibaum (Baila Mi Ritmo)
works.description: A dark Rite of Spring for six dancers in loud costumes made of kite material: recordings of the rustling costumes are processed and played back under the control of the dancers' tracked movement, with cello and bass live.
works.description_zh: 一场黑暗版《春之祭》：六位舞者穿着风筝布料做的“响亮”服装，服装沙沙声的录音经过处理，由舞者被追踪的动作控制回放，大提琴与低音提琴现场伴奏。
works.idea_en: Make the costume itself part of the music, and let the dancers play it with their movement.
works.idea_zh: 让服装本身成为音乐的一部分，由舞者用动作去演奏它。
works.technique: EyeCon tracks movement in defined stage zones and scrubs and filters samples recorded from the costumes, so the sound of fabric is heard both acoustically and electronically.
works.technique_zh: EyeCon 追踪舞台上各指定区域的动作，并用它来拖动和过滤从服装录下的采样，让布料的声音同时以原声和电子声出现。
works.exercise_en: Record the sound of one garment (a raincoat, a tracksuit) and let a webcam's motion amount control the playback speed and filter of that recording while the wearer dances. Twist: swap garments between dancers so each moves to someone else's clothes.
works.exercise_zh: 录下一件衣服（雨衣、运动服）的声音，让网络摄像头检测到的运动量控制这段录音的回放速度和滤波，同时让穿着者跳舞；变体：让舞者互换服装，每个人随着别人衣服的声音起舞。

video.video_title: Maibaum

works.title: Pedestrian
works.description: A projector mounted high above a city sidewalk throws a miniature world onto the pavement: tiny people walk, gather and cross streets that seem to float on and inside the concrete under passers-by's feet.
works.description_zh: 装在城市人行道上方高处的投影仪把一个微缩世界投到路面上：小小的人在行走、聚集、过马路，这些街道仿佛漂浮在行人脚下的水泥表面上，又像嵌在里面。
works.idea_en: A tiny city of walking people appears in the pavement you are standing on.
works.idea_zh: 一座住满行人的微缩城市，出现在你脚下的路面里。
works.technique: Real-time 3D rendering from a large library of motion-captured walking is projected straight down, so the synthetic figures merge with the texture of the ground as a trompe-l'oeil.
works.technique_zh: 用大量动捕行走数据实时渲染 3D 人物，从正上方投射下去，让合成人物与地面纹理融为一体，形成视错觉。
works.exercise_en: Mount a projector or phone projector pointing at the floor and project looping top-down footage of tiny walking figures (Mixamo characters rendered from above) scaled to 5 cm tall. Twist: make the tiny people scatter when a real foot's shadow falls on them.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影仪或手机投影仪朝地面安装，投出从上往下看、高约 5 厘米的小人行走循环（可用 Mixamo 角色俯视渲染）；变体：当真人脚的影子落下时，让小人四散逃开。

video.video_title: Pedestrian (2002) projected on on 125th St sidewalk outside Studio Museum in Harlem

salient.why_en: A tiny city of walking people appears inside the pavement under your feet.
salient.why_zh: 一座住满小小行人的城市，出现在你脚下的路面里。

works.title: Refuges d'Art
works.description: In the mountains of Haute-Provence, Goldsworthy restored ruined farms, chapels and sheepfolds along a 150-kilometre hiking route and placed works inside; some can be slept in.
works.description_zh: 在上普罗旺斯的山区，Goldsworthy 沿一条 150 公里的徒步路线修复了废弃的农舍、小教堂和羊圈，并在其中放置作品，有些还可以留宿。
works.idea_en: Art that you reach only by walking days through a landscape makes the journey part of the work, a model for long-distance AR trails.
works.idea_zh: 只有步行几天穿越风景才能抵达的艺术，让旅程成为作品的一部分，是长距离 AR 路线的范本。
works.technique: Old stone buildings are rebuilt as shelters and each contains a stone or clay work made for that site, linked by a waymarked trail.
works.technique_zh: 旧石屋被重建为避难所，每处都有一件为该地制作的石或泥作品，并由一条有路标的步道相连。
works.exercise_en: Design a multi-day or multi-hour AR hiking route with geolocated 'refuges' where a virtual work appears only if the user arrived on foot (checked by step count). Twist: each refuge shows traces left by earlier hikers.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一条持续数小时或数天的 AR 徒步路线，在地理定位的“避难所”处，只有步行抵达的用户（以步数判断）才能看到虚拟作品；变体：每个避难所都显示先前徒步者留下的痕迹。

video.video_title: Les Refuges d'Art d'Andy Goldsworthy - Unesco Géoparc de Haute-Provence

works.title: Seen
works.description: Made for the Venice Biennale, video of St Mark's Square is processed so that moving people leave trails and patterns of their paths across the piazza.
works.description_zh: 为威尼斯双年展创作：圣马可广场的视频经过处理，走动的人在广场上留下轨迹和路径图案。
works.idea_en: Letting crowds draw their own paths across a square shows the hidden choreography of a place — a classic AR trace effect waiting to be anchored on site.
works.idea_zh: 让人群在广场上画出自己的路径，揭示了一个地方隐藏的编舞——这是一个等着锚定在现场的经典 AR 轨迹效果。
works.technique: Motion analysis over time accumulates the positions of moving pixels into trails that are layered back onto the video.
works.technique_zh: 随时间进行运动分析，把移动像素的位置累积成轨迹，再叠回视频上。
works.exercise_en: Film a busy square with a phone on a tripod, extract people's paths with a person detector, and replay the paths as glowing lines anchored to the real ground in AR. Twist: colour each path by walking speed.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机架在三脚架上拍一个热闹的广场，用人体检测提取行人路径，在 AR 中把这些路径作为发光的线锚定在真实地面上回放。变体：按行走速度给每条路径着色。

video.video_title: Seen (2002) video installation by David Rokeby

works.title: Shadow (Screen Series)
works.description: A plain rectangle of projected light; viewers cast ordinary shadows, but after they step away their shadow keeps moving on the screen, repeating their gestures a moment later.
works.idea_zh: 你离开了，你的影子却留下来重复你刚才的动作
works.technique: A camera captures the viewer's shadow silhouette and the system re-projects the delayed silhouette sequence onto the same screen once the live shadow disappears.
works.exercise_zh: 用网页摄像头做背景差分得到人影，加入3秒延迟后投回墙上；变化：让延迟影子逐渐变淡并反向播放。

video.video_title: Shadow (2002) by Scott Snibbe

works.description_zh: 一块简单的投影光矩形；观众投下的起初只是普通的影子，但当他们走开后，影子仍在屏幕上移动，片刻之后重复他们刚才的动作。
works.idea_en: You have left, but your shadow stays behind and repeats what you just did.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头捕捉观众的影子剪影，当实时影子消失后，系统把延迟的剪影序列重新投射到同一块屏幕上。
works.exercise_en: Use background differencing on a webcam feed to get a person's shadow, and project it back onto the wall with a 3-second delay. Twist: make the delayed shadow gradually fade and play in reverse.

salient.why_en: After you walk away your shadow stays behind and repeats what you just did.
salient.why_zh: 你走开之后，影子留在原地，重复你刚才的动作。

works.title: SmartSkin
works.description: A table surface senses several hands and fingers at once, even hovering just above it, so people can knead, spread and push projected shapes with both hands.
works.description_zh: 桌面能同时感应多只手、多根手指，甚至能感应悬停在表面上方的手，人们可以用双手揉、拉、推动投影出来的图形。
works.idea_en: Make any surface feel your whole hands, not just one pointer.
works.idea_zh: 让任何表面都能感知整只手，而不只是一个光标。
works.technique: A grid of transmitter and receiver electrodes under the surface measures capacitance changes caused by nearby hands, producing a proximity image that is interpreted as touch shapes.
works.technique_zh: 表面下方的发射和接收电极网格测量手靠近时引起的电容变化，形成一张“接近度图像”，再解释为触摸形状。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam under a glass table or a phone multi-touch page to build a 'dough' simulation that you can squeeze with two hands. Twist: make the dough remember where it was touched most and glow there.
works.exercise_zh: 用玻璃桌下方的摄像头或手机多点触控网页，做一个可以用双手揉捏的“面团”模拟；变体：让面团记住被触摸最多的地方并在那里发光。

video.video_title: SmartSkin: An Infrastructure for Freehand Manipulations on Interactive Surfaces (CHI2002)

works.title: Technorama Facade
works.description: The façade of the Swiss Science Center Technorama in Winterthur is covered with tens of thousands of small hinged aluminium plates that ripple in the wind, turning the building into a wind display.
works.description_zh: 瑞士温特图尔 Technorama 科学中心的立面覆盖着数万块铰接小铝板，随风起伏，整座建筑变成了风的显示屏。
works.idea_en: Every pixel here is a physical sensor and actuator in one, a reminder that the best AR displays may be the world's own surfaces reacting.
works.idea_zh: 这里的每个“像素”既是传感器又是执行器，提醒我们最好的 AR 显示也许就是世界自身表面的反应。
works.technique: Free-swinging aluminium plates mounted in a grid reflect the sky at varying angles, so pressure waves in the wind appear as moving patterns of light and shadow.
works.technique_zh: 网格排列的铝板自由摆动，以不同角度反射天空，风中的压力波于是呈现为流动的光影图案。
works.exercise_en: Map a grid of virtual plates onto a façade photo with image tracking and drive them with a fluid simulation. Twist: let the plates spell a word only when the wind stops.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪把虚拟金属片阵列贴到立面照片上，用流体模拟驱动。变体：只有风停时，金属片才拼出一个词。

video.video_title: Technorama Facade

works.title: The obliteration room
works.description: An all-white furnished apartment is handed over to visitors, who each get sheets of coloured dot stickers; over weeks the furniture, walls and floor disappear under thousands of dots.
works.description_zh: 一间全白的家具公寓交给观众，每人领到一张彩色圆点贴纸；几周之后，家具、墙面和地板都消失在成千上万的圆点之下。
works.idea_en: Letting every visitor add one small mark turns a room into a shared, growing record; persistent multi-user AR annotations can make a space change over time the same way.
works.idea_zh: 让每位观众只加一个小标记，房间就成了共同生长的记录：持久化的多人 AR 标注，也能让一个空间随时间慢慢改变。
works.technique: The work is a participatory rule, not an image: white surfaces, a fixed palette of round stickers and many visitors produce an emergent pattern.
works.technique_zh: 作品是一条参与规则而不是一幅图像：白色表面、固定配色的圆点贴纸和大量观众，共同生成一种涌现的图案。
works.exercise_en: Build a shared AR room with persistent anchors (e.g. ARCore Cloud Anchors or Niantic Lightship): each user may place five coloured dots on real surfaces, and all dots stay for the next users. Twist: dots slowly fade after a week, so the room is always half obliterated and half restored.
works.exercise_zh: 用持久锚点（如 ARCore Cloud Anchors 或 Niantic Lightship）做一个共享 AR 房间：每位用户只能在真实表面上贴五个彩色圆点，这些圆点会留给后来的人。变体：圆点一周后逐渐淡去，让房间永远处于一半被抹除、一半恢复的状态。

video.video_title: Yayoi Kusama's Obliteration Room | TateShots

salient.why_en: Every visitor adds colored dots until a white room disappears under them.
salient.why_zh: 每位观众贴上几颗彩色圆点，直到白色房间被圆点淹没。

works.title: Tinmith Glove User Interface
works.description: Menus are mapped onto the fingers of pinch gloves: the user presses thumb to finger to pick commands while walking outdoors in AR, and points with tracked thumbs to place objects.
works.description_zh: 菜单被映射到捏合手套的各个手指上：用户在户外 AR 中边走边用拇指碰手指选命令，并用被追踪的拇指指点来放置物体。
works.idea_en: Your fingers become the menu when there is no mouse outdoors.
works.idea_zh: 户外没有鼠标时，你的手指就是菜单。
works.technique: Uses conductive pinch gloves for discrete menu selection and fiducial markers on the thumbs for 3D cursor tracking by the head-mounted camera.
works.technique_zh: 用导电捏合手套进行离散的菜单选择，并借助拇指上的标记让头戴摄像头追踪三维光标。
works.exercise_en: Write four commands on your fingertips, and build a phone app where a partner triggers the matching AR action when you tap thumb to finger. Twist: design a two-level menu using both hands.
works.exercise_zh: 在指尖上写下四个命令，做一个手机应用，你用拇指碰某根手指时，同伴触发对应的 AR 动作；变体：用双手设计一个两级菜单。

video.video_title: Tinmith Outdoor Augmented Reality Modelling 2002 - tinmith-glove-user-interface-oct2002.mpg

works.title: Transient Rainbow
works.description: For MoMA's temporary move to Queens, a 300-metre rainbow of fireworks arched over the East River for about 15 seconds.
works.description_zh: 为纪念 MoMA 临时迁往皇后区，一道长约 300 米的烟火彩虹在东河上空划过，只持续了约 15 秒。
works.idea_en: A familiar sky shape made by unexpected means holds attention precisely because it disappears; short, one-time AR events can be more memorable than persistent content.
works.idea_zh: 用意想不到的方式造出一个熟悉的天空形状，正因为它会消失才让人记住；一次性的短暂 AR 事件，往往比一直存在的内容更让人难忘。
works.technique: About a thousand multicolour shells were launched from barges along the river in a timed arc so their bursts formed a rainbow shape.
works.technique_zh: 约一千枚多彩烟花弹从河面的驳船上按时序沿弧线发射，爆开后连成彩虹的形状。
works.exercise_en: Make a WebXR rainbow that can be triggered only once per day at a fixed geolocation and lasts 15 seconds, then leaves a faint trace in everyone's app gallery. Twist: the rainbow only appears if at least three people point their phones at the spot at the same time.
works.exercise_zh: 做一道 WebXR 彩虹：每天只能在一个固定地点触发一次，持续 15 秒，之后在每个人的应用相册里留下淡淡的痕迹。变体：只有至少三个人同时把手机对准那个地点，彩虹才会出现。

video.video_title: Cai Guo-Qiang | Transient Rainbow

works.title: Trash Mirror
works.description: Irregular pieces of trash collected from the streets become motorised pixels that tilt to reflect the viewer's image.
works.idea_zh: 用街头垃圾碎片做成会映照你的镜子
works.technique: Each irregular trash piece sits on a motor mapped to a region of the camera image, rotating to present a lighter or darker face.
works.exercise_zh: 收集教室里的废纸片做成不规则“像素”，用几个舵机+摄像头做一个小型原型；变化：每块碎片对应它在画面中的真实形状区域。

video.video_title: "Trash Mirror" (2002) by Daniel Rozin

works.description_zh: 从街头收集来的不规则垃圾碎片变成了电动像素，它们倾斜转动，映出观众的影像。
works.idea_en: Make a mirror that reflects you out of scraps of street trash.
works.technique_zh: 每块不规则的垃圾碎片都装在一个电机上，对应摄像头画面中的一个区域，通过旋转呈现较亮或较暗的一面。
works.exercise_en: Collect scrap paper from the classroom to make irregular 'pixels', and build a small prototype with a few servos and a camera. Twist: map each scrap to a region matching its real shape in the image.

works.title: Vivisector (with Chris Haring)
works.description: Four dancers are sculpted solely by projected light — no stage lighting — so their bodies appear sliced, dissolved and multiplied by the projection.
works.idea_zh: 只用投影光照亮舞者，让身体被光切片、溶解
works.technique: Projectors act as the only light source ('dancing light'), with video masks choreographed to reveal and fragment specific body regions.
works.exercise_zh: 关掉教室灯，只用投影仪的黑白遮罩照亮同学的局部身体；变化：用摄像头追踪手的位置让光斑自动跟随。

video.video_title: Vivisector, Part 4 – Klaus Obermaier, Chris Haring

works.description_zh: 四位舞者完全由投影光来塑造，没有任何舞台灯光，他们的身体在投影下仿佛被切片、溶解和复制。
works.idea_en: Light the dancers only with projection so their bodies get sliced and dissolved by light.
works.technique_zh: 投影仪是唯一的光源（“舞动的光”），经过编排的视频遮罩显现并切分身体的特定部位。
works.exercise_en: Turn off the classroom lights and use only black-and-white projector masks to light parts of a classmate's body. Twist: track the hand with a camera so the spot of light follows it automatically.

works.title: VorOrt
works.description: The piece starts on a live video feed of the dancer walking through the public square of the host city; she knocks on the theatre's back door and enters the stage where the audience has been watching her.
works.description_zh: 作品从一段直播画面开始：舞者走过所在城市的公共广场，敲响剧场后门，然后走上观众一直在看着她的舞台。
works.idea_en: Stitch three kinds of presence, recorded, live on screen and live in the room, into one continuous walk.
works.idea_zh: 把三种“在场”——录像、屏幕直播、真人现场——缝合成一次连续的行走。
works.technique: A Steadicam operator follows the dancer outside and transmits the signal wirelessly to the theatre projector until she physically arrives; the year is likely.
works.technique_zh: 斯坦尼康摄影师在室外跟拍舞者，并把信号无线传回剧场投影，直到她本人走进来；年份为推测。
works.exercise_en: Livestream a classmate walking from outside the building to your classroom on a phone video call projected on the wall, and time their entrance so the screen and the door open together. Twist: add an AR label on the feed that follows them in and stays on their real body.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机视频通话直播一位同学从楼外走到教室，并投影在墙上，安排好时间，让屏幕上的画面和教室门同时“打开”；变体：在直播画面上加一个跟随他的 AR 标签，他进门后标签也留在真人身上。

video.video_title: VorOrt

works.title: while going to a condition
works.description: Hiroaki Umeda dances alone in front of a wall of projected light and noise, his sharp, trembling moves synchronised with flickering images and sound.
works.description_zh: 梅田宏明独自在投影光与噪声组成的墙前起舞，锐利而颤动的动作与闪烁的影像和声音同步。
works.idea_en: One body and one field of light is enough; AR designers can learn how little content is needed when timing and contrast are strong.
works.idea_zh: 一个身体加一片光场就足够了；AR 设计者可以学到，只要节奏和对比足够强，需要的内容其实很少。
works.technique: Umeda composes sound and projected visuals himself under the name S20 and times them to his choreography.
works.technique_zh: 梅田宏明以 S20 的名义亲自制作声音和投影影像，并与自己的编舞对时。
works.exercise_en: Build a Lens Studio or WebXR effect that fills the room behind a dancer with a flickering noise field that pulses with the soundtrack. Twist: the field freezes whenever the dancer holds still.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 Lens Studio 或 WebXR 效果，让舞者身后的房间充满随音乐跳动的闪烁噪声场；变体：舞者一静止，光场就凝固。

video.video_title: while going to a condition - excerpt

works.title: Blue, Red and Yellow
works.description: A walk-in pavilion whose ceiling is covered with LED light filtered through red, blue and yellow is filled with fog; inside, colour seems to become a material and distances vanish.
works.description_zh: 一个可以走进去的小屋，天花板上布满经红、蓝、黄滤光的 LED 灯，屋内充满雾气；在里面，颜色似乎变成一种材料，距离感消失了。
works.idea_en: Three primary lights and fog are enough to erase architecture; AR designers can create a strong sense of place with atmosphere instead of objects.
works.idea_zh: 三种原色光加上雾，就足以抹去建筑；AR 设计者可以用氛围而不是物体营造强烈的场所感。
works.technique: LED panels behind primary colour filters light a closed room of artificial fog, so the fog scatters coloured light evenly in all directions.
works.technique_zh: LED 面板透过三原色滤光片照亮一个充满人工雾的封闭空间，雾把彩色光均匀地散射到各个方向。
works.exercise_en: Divide a real room into three zones with AR Foundation and render fog in red, blue and yellow for each, mixing where zones overlap. Twist: turn the fog off in steps and ask people to guess where the real walls are.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 把真实房间分成三个区域，分别渲染红、蓝、黄色的雾，在区域重叠处混色。变体：分几步关掉雾气，请大家猜真实的墙在哪里。

video.video_title: Ann Veronica Janssens Interview: To Walk Into a Painting

works.title: Body Movies (Relational Architecture 6)
works.description: Thousands of street portraits are projected onto a building façade but only become visible inside the giant shadows of passers-by, whose silhouettes grow from 2 to 25 metres depending on their distance from floor lights.
works.idea_zh: 你的巨大影子才是看见陌生人肖像的“窗口”
works.technique: Robotic projectors show portraits on a façade washed out by bright floor lamps; a camera tracks shadow regions, and when a shadow matches a portrait the scene advances.
works.exercise_zh: 一台投影仪投图片、另一盏强光灯把画面“冲白”，同学的影子里才能看见图片；变化：用摄像头检测影子是否完全盖住某张脸来触发下一张。

video.video_title: Body Movies

works.description_zh: 数千幅街头肖像被投射到建筑立面上，但只有在路人巨大的影子里才能看见；根据人与地面灯的距离，影子的高度从 2 米到 25 米不等。
works.idea_en: Your giant shadow is the only window through which strangers' portraits can be seen.
works.technique_zh: 机械投影仪把肖像投到被明亮地灯冲淡的立面上；摄像头追踪影子区域，当影子与某幅肖像重合时，场景便切换到下一幕。
works.exercise_en: Have one projector show images while a strong lamp washes the picture out, so the images are visible only inside classmates' shadows. Twist: use a camera to check whether a shadow fully covers a face, and trigger the next image when it does.

salient.why_en: Hidden portraits on a facade only show inside passers-by's giant shadows, so your shadow is the window.
salient.why_zh: 建筑立面上的肖像只在路人的巨大影子里显现，你的影子就是窗口。

works.title: Heisenberg's Uncertainty Principle
works.description: A 25-minute piece in which dancers perform behind and in front of a semi-transparent screen while projected words and video effects slide over their bodies, blurring where the dancers are.
works.description_zh: 一部 25 分钟的作品：舞者在半透明幕布前后表演，投影的文字和视频特效滑过他们的身体，让人看不清舞者究竟在哪里。
works.idea_en: Use projection on a see-through screen to make the dancers' position uncertain.
works.idea_zh: 用透明幕上的投影，让舞者的位置变得“不确定”。
works.technique: A semi-transparent projection screen at the front of the stage carries live and prepared video effects designed by Frieder Weiss, layering images over the dancers behind it.
works.technique_zh: 舞台前方的半透明投影幕承载 Frieder Weiss 设计的实时与预制视频特效，把图像叠加在幕后舞者身上。
works.exercise_en: Hang a tulle or mesh sheet, project text onto it, and have a performer move behind and in front of it so the words land on and miss their body. Twist: track the performer and make the words avoid them.
works.exercise_zh: 挂一块纱网，把文字投影在上面，让表演者在纱网前后移动，文字时而落在身上、时而错过；变体：追踪表演者，让文字主动躲开他。

video.video_title: Heisenberg's Uncertainty Principle

works.title: HypoSurface
works.description: A wall of hundreds of small metal plates driven by pneumatic pistons ripples into waves, patterns and even letters in response to sound and people moving in front of it.
works.description_zh: 一面由数百块小金属板组成的墙，由气动活塞驱动，随着声音和前方人的动作起伏成波浪、图案甚至文字。
works.idea_en: A physical surface that moves like a screen shows what AR could add to real walls: content that seems to deform the wall itself rather than float in front of it.
works.idea_zh: 一个像屏幕一样运动的实体表面，展示了 AR 能给真实墙面加上什么：内容看起来是在让墙本身变形，而不是漂在墙前。
works.technique: Each tile sits on pneumatic actuators under computer control; sensors (microphones, motion detection) feed a real-time pattern generator that sets piston positions.
works.technique_zh: 每块面板装在电脑控制的气动执行器上；传感器（麦克风、运动检测）把信号送入实时图案生成器，由它设定活塞位置。
works.exercise_en: Detect a real wall and apply a vertex-displacement shader in AR so the wall seems to bulge into waves around the user's hand or voice. Twist: make the ripples spell a word when viewed from exactly one spot.
works.exercise_zh: 检测一面真实的墙，在 AR 中用顶点位移着色器，让墙在用户的手或声音周围看起来鼓起波浪。变体：让波纹只有从某个精确位置看时才拼出一个词。

video.video_title: HypoSurface by dECOI/MIT: Summer 2011 Tomorrow Awards Winner

works.title: RedBall Project
works.description: A 4.6-metre red inflatable ball is squeezed into alleys, archways, bridges and doorways, a new site each day, in cities from Barcelona to Sydney; Danny Cooke's film follows its UK tour.
works.description_zh: 一个直径 4.6 米的红色充气球被塞进小巷、拱门、桥梁和门洞，在从巴塞罗那到悉尼的城市中每天换一处；Danny Cooke 的影片跟随了它的英国巡回。
works.idea_en: One simple object that deforms to each site's geometry is the ideal spatial-mapping demo, and people come back daily to see where it goes next.
works.idea_zh: 一个会随每个场地几何形状变形的简单物体，是理想的空间映射示范，人们每天都回来看它下一次会去哪里。
works.technique: The ball is inflated in place so its soft skin presses against the surrounding architecture.
works.technique_zh: 球在现场充气，柔软的外皮紧贴周围的建筑。
works.exercise_en: Use ARKit or AR Foundation mesh collision to squeeze a soft red AR ball into real doorways, gaps and corners so it deforms against real surfaces. Twist: publish a new location every day as a clue.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit 或 AR Foundation 的网格碰撞，把一个柔软的红色 AR 球塞进真实的门洞、缝隙和角落，让它贴合真实表面变形；变体：每天发布一个新地点作为线索。

video.video_title: Kurt Perschke's RedBall UK

salient.why_en: A giant red ball gets squeezed into a different gap in the city each day.
salient.why_zh: 一个巨大的红球，每天被塞进城市里不同的缝隙。

works.title: Reine Rien
works.description: An abstract piece inspired by Midwestern flatlands where dancing brings up projected trees, water and virtual rainfall, and when the dancers stop and make small gestures the images and voices fade away.
works.description_zh: 一部受美国中西部平原启发的抽象作品：舞蹈唤出投影的树、水和虚拟雨，当舞者停下来做细小动作时，影像和声音随之消散。
works.idea_en: Dancing makes weather; stillness makes silence.
works.idea_zh: 舞动就会下雨，静止就归于寂静。
works.technique: Movement sensing (likely MidiDancer and camera tracking) drives Coniglio's Isadora patches that crossfade landscape video and sound according to the dancers' activity.
works.technique_zh: 动作感应（很可能是 MidiDancer 加摄像头追踪）驱动 Coniglio 的 Isadora 补丁，根据舞者的活跃程度交叉淡化风景影像和声音。
works.exercise_en: Measure overall motion from a webcam and use it to control the density of projected rain particles and a rain sound. Twist: the smallest gesture makes lightning.
works.exercise_zh: 从摄像头测量整体运动量，用它控制投影雨滴粒子的密度和雨声大小；变体：最细微的手势会引发闪电。

video.video_title: Reine Rien, WAX, NYC 2001 (excerpt)

works.title: Rivers and Tides
works.description: Thomas Riedelsheimer's film follows Goldsworthy building icicle spirals, leaf chains that float down a river and a stone cone that the incoming tide swallows.
works.description_zh: Thomas Riedelsheimer 的纪录片跟拍 Goldsworthy 用冰柱搭出螺旋、让树叶链顺流漂走，以及建造一个被涨潮吞没的石锥。
works.idea_en: The artwork includes its own disappearance: designing for how a piece decays or is taken by nature is as important as how it appears.
works.idea_zh: 作品包含了它自身的消失：设计作品如何衰败或被自然带走，与设计它如何出现同样重要。
works.technique: He uses only found materials and their own properties (freezing, floating, balancing), working with the time of day and the tide.
works.technique_zh: 他只使用现场找到的材料及其自身特性（冻结、漂浮、平衡），配合一天中的时间和潮汐工作。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR sculpture from scanned leaves or stones on a real riverbank or puddle and program it to fall apart when a timer or the user's approach triggers it. Twist: let the pieces drift along the real water direction the user traces.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实的河岸或水洼边，用扫描的树叶或石头搭一个 AR 雕塑，并编程让它在计时器或用户靠近时解体；变体：让碎片沿用户描出的真实水流方向漂走。

video.video_title: Rivers and Tides: Andy Goldsworthy Working with Time - Trailer

works.title: Sky Mirror
works.description: A six-metre concave steel mirror tilted toward the sky brings the clouds down to the ground; one side shows the sky, the other the surroundings upside down. The film shows a version installed at De Pont museum in Tilburg.
works.description_zh: 一面直径六米、朝天倾斜的凹面钢镜把云朵带到地面上：一面映出天空，另一面则是倒转的周围景物。影片展示了在蒂尔堡 De Pont 美术馆安装的版本。
works.idea_en: Bringing the sky down to eye level with a mirror is exactly what an AR portal to the sky can do on a lawn.
works.idea_zh: 用一面镜子把天空带到视线高度，这正是草坪上一个通往天空的 AR 传送门能做的事。
works.technique: A large concave dish of polished stainless steel is tilted on a stand so its focal reflection frames the sky.
works.technique_zh: 一个抛光不锈钢大型凹面盘斜置于支架上，使其焦点反射恰好框住天空。
works.exercise_en: Place a circular AR portal on a lawn that shows the real sky above the user (from the phone's upward camera or a sky map). Twist: tilt the portal to show tomorrow's forecast sky.
works.exercise_zh: 在草坪上放一个圆形 AR 传送门，显示用户头顶的真实天空（来自手机向上的相机或天空贴图）；变体：倾斜传送门即可显示明天预报中的天空。

video.video_title: De making of Sky Mirror, Anish Kapoor (2018)

salient.why_en: A huge dish mirror brings the sky down to the ground.
salient.why_zh: 一面巨大的碟形镜子，把天空搬到了地面上。

works.title: Sphère (Esfera)
works.description: A large sphere made of hundreds of small coloured or mirrored plates suspended on threads; it reads as a solid ball from afar and breaks into flickering particles up close.
works.description_zh: 一个由数百片悬挂的彩色或镜面小片组成的大球体；远看是实心球，近看则碎成闪烁的粒子。
works.idea_en: A volume built from suspended particles is both an object and a cloud, a good way to present AR objects that should feel light and permeable.
works.idea_zh: 由悬浮粒子构成的体积既是物体又是云，适合用来表现需要轻盈、可穿透感的 AR 物体。
works.technique: Plates hung at calculated lengths inside a spherical frame define the sphere's surface as a sampled point cloud that shimmers as each plate turns.
works.technique_zh: 在球形框架内按计算长度悬挂的小片，把球面定义为一个采样点云，每片转动时整个球随之闪烁。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR sphere from 500 floating quads sampled on its surface, each slowly rotating and reflecting the environment, and anchor it in a real space. Twist: let the sphere scatter into particles when the phone comes closer than 1 m and re-form when it backs away.
works.exercise_zh: 用球面上采样的 500 个悬浮小方片搭一个 AR 球体，每片缓慢旋转并反射环境，把它锚定在真实空间中。变体：手机靠近到 1 米内时球体散成粒子，后退时重新聚合。

video.video_title: Julio Le Parc Esfera

works.title: Tijuana Projection
works.description: Women who work in Tijuana's maquiladora factories wear a head-mounted camera and microphone, and their faces and testimonies are projected live onto the huge sphere of the city's Omnimax theater.
works.description_zh: 在蒂华纳加工厂工作的女性戴上头戴摄像头和麦克风，她们的脸和讲述被实时投到城市球幕影院巨大的球面外墙上。
works.idea_en: A wearable camera turns a monument-sized building into the live face of one person.
works.idea_zh: 一个可穿戴摄像头，就能把纪念碑般的建筑变成一个人的实时面孔。
works.technique: A lightweight headset with a camera fixed on the wearer's face streams video and audio to projectors aimed at the 60-foot dome, mixed with prerecorded segments.
works.technique_zh: 固定对准佩戴者面部的轻型头戴摄像头把视频和音频传给对准 18 米球面的投影机，并与预录片段交替播放。
works.exercise_en: Mount a phone on a selfie-stick headband pointing at your face, stream it to a projector and project your talking face onto a round object (a balloon or dome) in class. Twist: let a classmate interview you live while the audience only sees the projected face.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机用自拍杆头带固定、镜头对准自己的脸，实时推流到投影仪，把说话的脸投到教室里一个圆形物体（气球或穹顶）上；变体：让同学现场采访你，观众只能看到投影出来的脸。

video.video_title: CLOSEUP Krzysztof Wodiczko, "Tijuana Projection", inSITE2000.

salient.why_en: A factory worker's live face and voice fill a giant public dome, so an unheard person takes over a monument.
salient.why_zh: 工厂女工的实时面孔和声音占满巨大的公共球幕，平时无人倾听的人接管了一座地标。

works.title: Tinmith-Metro Outdoor AR Modelling
works.description: Standing outside a building, the user wears pinch gloves and 'captures' its walls by pointing and pinching, building a 3D model of the real building on the spot.
works.description_zh: 站在建筑外，用户戴着捏合手套，通过指点和捏合“捕捉”墙面，现场建出真实建筑的三维模型。
works.idea_en: Model architecture by standing in front of it and grabbing its shape with your hands.
works.idea_zh: 站在建筑面前，用双手“抓取”它的形状来建模。
works.technique: Uses working-planes projected from the tracked head and gloves to intersect infinite planes into solid building geometry, all on a wearable backpack computer.
works.technique_zh: 在可穿戴背包电脑上，由追踪的头部和手套投射出工作平面，让无限平面相交生成实体建筑几何体。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone AR measuring or plane-detection app to trace the walls of a room and export a floor plan, then compare with a tape-measure drawing. Twist: model a building outside using only photos taken from the pavement.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 测量或平面检测 App 描出房间的墙面并导出平面图，再与卷尺手绘的图对比；变体：只用在人行道上拍的照片为室外建筑建模。

video.video_title: Tinmith Outdoor Augmented Reality Modelling 2001 - building-capture.avi

works.title: ZONE (Kuka robot choreography)
works.description: In the dance work ZONE, a large industrial Kuka robot arm made by robotlab performs a choreography by Pablo Ventura alongside the company's dancers.
works.description_zh: 在舞蹈作品 ZONE 中，robotlab 的一台大型 Kuka 工业机械臂与舞团的舞者同台，表演 Pablo Ventura 的编舞。
works.idea_en: Choreograph an industrial robot as a dancer next to humans.
works.idea_zh: 把一台工业机器人当作舞者，与人同台编舞。
works.technique: The Kuka arm's motion paths were programmed as dance phrases in collaboration with robotlab and timed against live dancers and music.
works.technique_zh: 与 robotlab 合作，把 Kuka 机械臂的运动路径编成舞句，并与现场舞者和音乐对时。
works.exercise_en: Program a cheap robot arm or a phone on a motorised selfie stick with a 30-second phrase, then choreograph a human duet partner around it. Twist: let the human copy the robot's timing but never its shape.
works.exercise_zh: 给一台廉价机械臂或装在电动自拍杆上的手机编一段 30 秒的舞句，再为它编一位人类舞伴；变体：人类只能模仿机器的节奏，绝不能模仿它的形状。

video.video_title: Kuka Robot Choreography by Pablo Ventura

works.title: ...seine hohle Form...
works.description: A Palindrome duet in which the music only exists while the dancers move: their positions and gestures in video-tracked zones trigger and shape real-time synthesis.
works.description_zh: Palindrome 的一段双人舞，音乐只在舞者移动时才存在：他们在视频追踪区域中的位置和手势会触发并塑造实时合成的声音。
works.idea_en: A piece of music that cannot be heard unless someone dances it.
works.idea_zh: 一首只有被跳出来才听得见的音乐。
works.technique: Weiss's EyeCon video-tracking software defines trigger lines and fields on the camera image, sending movement data to Butch Rovan's Max/MSP synthesis patch.
works.technique_zh: Weiss 的 EyeCon 视频追踪软件在摄像头画面上设置触发线和触发区，把动作数据发送给 Butch Rovan 的 Max/MSP 合成补丁。
works.exercise_en: Divide a webcam image into four zones, and have movement in each zone play and bend a different sound in Max, Pure Data or Web Audio. Twist: the zones slowly drift, so the dancer must chase the music.
works.exercise_zh: 把摄像头画面分成四个区域，在 Max、Pure Data 或 Web Audio 里让每个区域的动作播放并扭曲不同的声音；变体：区域会缓慢漂移，舞者必须追着音乐跑。

video.video_title: seine hohle Form

works.title: ARQuake
works.description: A player with a backpack computer, head-mounted display and toy gun walks across the university campus shooting Quake monsters that appear among the real buildings.
works.description_zh: 玩家背着背包电脑、戴着头显、手持玩具枪，在大学校园里行走，射击出现在真实建筑之间的 Quake 怪物。
works.idea_en: Turn a real campus into a first-person shooter level.
works.idea_zh: 把真实的校园变成第一人称射击游戏的关卡。
works.technique: Modifies the Quake engine to render only monsters and items in see-through view, driven by GPS, a head tracker and a campus model for occlusion.
works.technique_zh: 修改 Quake 引擎，在透视视图中只渲染怪物和道具，由 GPS、头部追踪器以及用于遮挡的校园模型驱动。
works.exercise_en: Design a location-based phone AR game where virtual creatures spawn at three GPS points on campus and players must reach them to catch them. Twist: let creatures hide behind real walls using a simple occlusion box.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一款基于位置的手机 AR 游戏，虚拟生物在校园三个 GPS 点出现，玩家必须跑到那里去捉；变体：用一个简单的遮挡盒让生物躲在真实墙后。

video.video_title: ARQuake 2006 - quake1.dv

works.title: Annular Eclipse
works.description: Stainless-steel rings balanced on arms rotate independently in the wind on Park Avenue, occasionally aligning to frame each other like an eclipse.
works.description_zh: 不锈钢圆环架在平衡臂上，在公园大道的风中各自旋转，偶尔对齐、相互框住，宛如日环食。
works.idea_en: Rare alignments are rewarding moments; AR works can design for the chance moment when parts line up from the viewer's point of view.
works.idea_zh: 罕见的对齐是令人惊喜的时刻；AR 作品可以专门为“从观者视角各部分恰好对齐”的偶然时刻而设计。
works.technique: Each ring sits on its own bearing with balanced weights, so independent wind-driven rotations occasionally produce concentric alignments.
works.technique_zh: 每个圆环都装在各自的轴承上并配平，风驱动的独立旋转偶尔会形成同心对齐。
works.exercise_en: Create an AR sculpture of two rings that rotate independently and glow brightly only when they align from the user's current viewpoint. Twist: make alignment rarer the longer the user stands still.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个由两个独立旋转圆环组成的 AR 雕塑，只有从用户当前视角看对齐时才发出强光。变体：用户站得越久，对齐越难出现。

video.video_title: Annular Eclipse on Park Avenue | 2000 | George Rickey, Kinetic Sculptor

works.title: Gesture Pendant
works.description: A pendant with an infrared camera and LEDs hangs on the chest; waving the hand in front of it controls lights and devices in the Georgia Tech Aware Home.
works.description_zh: 挂在胸前的吊坠里装有红外摄像头和 LED；在它前面挥手，就能控制佐治亚理工 Aware Home 里的灯光和设备。
works.idea_en: Wear the sensor instead of instrumenting the home: gestures travel with you.
works.idea_zh: 把传感器戴在身上，而不是装满整个房子：手势跟着你走。
works.technique: Self-illuminating infrared lights the hand so a small camera can segment it against any background, and simple gesture recognition maps motions to home-automation commands.
works.technique_zh: 自带红外照明把手照亮，让小摄像头在任何背景下都能分割出手部，再通过简单的手势识别映射到家居控制命令。
works.exercise_en: Hang a phone around your neck with the front camera facing out and map three hand shapes to smart-light colours. Twist: make one gesture only work while you look at the lamp.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机挂在脖子上、前置摄像头朝外，把三种手形映射成智能灯的颜色。变体：让某个手势只在你看着灯时才生效。

video.video_title: Gesture Pendant: Controlling mobile devices with touchless hand gesture interfaces

works.title: Perceptive Workbench
works.description: A projection table that reconstructs objects placed on it in 3D, tracks pointing gestures above it and hosts an AR game against a remote player who wears a mobile computer.
works.description_zh: 一张投影桌：能对放在上面的物体进行 3D 重建，追踪桌面上方的指向手势，还能与一名穿戴移动计算机的远程玩家进行 AR 对战。
works.idea_en: A table that sees what you put on it and where you point, linking a desk to a player in the field.
works.idea_zh: 一张能看见你放了什么、指向哪里的桌子，把桌面和户外的玩家连接起来。
works.technique: Infrared illuminators under the surface and cameras cast shadows of objects and arms; silhouettes from several lights are intersected to reconstruct shape and arm direction.
works.technique_zh: 桌面下的红外光源和摄像头拍下物体和手臂的影子，再把多个光源下的剪影求交，重建出物体形状和手臂指向。
works.exercise_en: Build a projector-camera table with a cheap projector and a webcam that detects dark shapes placed on paper and draws outlines around them. Twist: link it to a phone player who sees the same shapes as obstacles.
works.exercise_zh: 用便宜的投影仪和网络摄像头做一张投影桌，识别放在纸上的深色物体并在周围画出轮廓。变体：把它连接到一名手机玩家，对方把这些形状看作障碍物。

video.video_title: Perceptive Workbench

works.title: The Far Side of the Moon (La Face cachée de la Lune)
works.description: Robert Lepage plays two brothers in a solo show where a sliding mirrored wall and projections turn a laundromat, an apartment and zero gravity into the same small set.
works.description_zh: Robert Lepage 一人分饰两兄弟，一面会滑动的镜墙和投影让同一个小布景变成洗衣店、公寓乃至失重的太空。
works.idea_en: One reconfigurable surface can stand for many places; AR can reuse a single real wall the same way instead of building new sets.
works.idea_zh: 一个可以重新配置的表面能代表许多地方；AR 也可以这样反复利用同一面真墙，而不必搭建新布景。
works.technique: A large tilting mirror reflects the performer lying on the floor so he appears to float, combined with video projection on moving panels.
works.technique_zh: 一面可倾斜的大镜子反射躺在地上的表演者，让他看起来漂浮在空中，再配合投在移动板面上的影像。
works.exercise_en: Point a phone at a single blank wall and build three AR scenes (laundromat, bedroom, spacecraft) that swap when the user turns the phone. Twist: one scene flips gravity so objects fall toward the ceiling.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机对准一面空白墙，做三个 AR 场景（洗衣店、卧室、太空舱），用户转动手机时切换；变体：其中一个场景重力翻转，物体往天花板掉。

video.video_title: La Face cachée de la Lune / The Far Side of the Moon

works.title: The Influence Machine
works.description: At night in a park, giant faces are projected onto trees, buildings and drifting clouds of smoke, while voices tell the history of communication and the idea that spirits live in media. First staged in New York and London in 2000, it was revived outdoors at Stockholm University in 2016.
works.description_zh: 夜里的公园中，巨大的人脸被投到树木、建筑和飘动的烟雾上，同时有声音讲述通信的历史，以及“媒介中住着幽灵”的想法。这件作品 2000 年首次在纽约和伦敦上演，2016 年在斯德哥尔摩大学户外重演。
works.idea_en: Projecting onto smoke and foliage makes images feel like ghosts in a place; semi-transparent, wavering AR content can read as presence rather than as a screen.
works.idea_zh: 把影像投到烟雾和树叶上，会让它们像是附着在某个地方的幽灵；半透明、飘忽的 AR 内容会被感知为存在，而不是一块屏幕。
works.technique: Video projectors aimed at smoke generators and tree canopies turn moving particles into temporary screens, combined with a spatial soundtrack across the park.
works.technique_zh: 投影机对准烟雾机和树冠，把流动的颗粒变成临时屏幕，并配合遍布公园的空间声轨。
works.exercise_en: Create an outdoor WebXR or 8th Wall piece that places a semi-transparent talking face in a tree, with particles drifting through it. Twist: the face is only visible from one spot on the path, so visitors must search for the right place to stand.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 8th Wall 在户外做一件作品，在一棵树里放一张半透明的说话的脸，有颗粒从中飘过；变体：只有站在小路上的某一点才能看到这张脸，观众必须自己寻找合适的位置。

video.video_title: Video artist Tony Oursler's The Influence Machine at Stockholm University

works.title: Wind Veil
works.description: Tens of thousands of small hinged aluminium panels cover a parking-garage façade and flutter in the wind, so gusts sweep across the building as visible ripples of light.
works.description_zh: 数万块铰接的小铝片覆盖停车楼立面，随风翻动，阵风掠过时在建筑上形成可见的光之涟漪。
works.idea_en: Making an invisible force visible across a surface is AR's core promise; Kahn does it at building scale with no electronics.
works.idea_zh: 让看不见的力在表面上显形，正是 AR 的核心承诺；Kahn 在建筑尺度上做到了，而且不用任何电子元件。
works.technique: Each panel hangs freely on a hinge; wind pressure tilts it and changes how it reflects sky and sun, so the façade becomes a real-time map of airflow (year approximate).
works.technique_zh: 每片铝片自由挂在铰链上，风压使它倾斜并改变对天空与阳光的反射，整面立面成为实时的气流地图（年份为估计）。
works.exercise_en: Cover a real building façade in WebXR with a grid of small reflective flaps that tilt with live wind data from a weather API. Twist: let the viewer blow into the microphone to add a gust.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 中给一栋真实建筑立面铺满小反光片，用天气 API 的实时风速数据让它们翻动。变体：观众对着麦克风吹气可以加一阵风。

video.video_title: Wind Veil

works.title: Wind Wand
works.description: A 48 m flexible carbon-fibre pole on the New Plymouth waterfront, topped with a light, that bends and sways in the wind and glows at night.
works.description_zh: 新普利茅斯海滨一根 48 米高、顶部带灯的柔性碳纤维杆，在风中弯曲摇摆，夜间发光。
works.idea_en: A single flexible line on a coastline makes the invisible wind visible to the whole city; AR can visualise invisible forces with the simplest form.
works.idea_zh: 海岸线上一根柔性的线就让全城看见了无形的风；AR 也可以用最简单的形式把看不见的力可视化。
works.technique: A hollow carbon-fibre tube with a red glass ball and light at the tip flexes elastically, amplifying the wind into large, slow sweeps.
works.technique_zh: 中空的碳纤维管顶端装有红色玻璃球和灯，弹性弯曲，把风放大成大幅、缓慢的摆动。
works.exercise_en: Place a 50 m AR wand at a real waterfront or park with a geospatial anchor and bend it with live wind data, glowing at night. Twist: let a crowd of phones pushing together bend it further.
works.exercise_zh: 用地理空间锚点在真实海滨或公园放一根 50 米高的 AR 魔杖，用实时风力数据让它弯曲，夜间发光。变体：让一群手机一起“推”时把它弯得更厉害。

video.video_title: Len Lye Wind Wand

salient.why_en: One tall bending rod shows a whole city where the wind is.
salient.why_zh: 一根会弯的细长杆，让整座城市看见风在哪里。

works.title: Augmented Surfaces
works.description: Laptops placed on a projected table and wall become part of one continuous workspace: you drag a document off the laptop screen onto the table, and physical objects with tags get digital data attached to them.
works.description_zh: 把笔记本电脑放在投影桌面上，笔记本、桌面和墙面就连成一个连续的工作空间：文档可以从笔记本屏幕直接拖到桌面上，贴了标签的实物也能被“挂”上数字数据。
works.idea_en: The whole room becomes one desktop: data flows off screens onto tables, walls and objects.
works.idea_zh: 整间屋子变成一个大桌面：数据可以从屏幕流到桌子、墙面和实物上。
works.technique: Ceiling cameras recognize laptops and tagged objects and track their positions, while projectors draw the shared workspace; a 'hyperdragging' cursor crosses from the laptop into the projection.
works.technique_zh: 天花板上的摄像头识别并追踪笔记本和带标签的物体，投影仪绘制共享工作区；“超级拖拽”光标可以从笔记本屏幕一路移到投影区域。
works.exercise_en: Point a projector and webcam at a desk and let students drag a picture from a laptop browser onto the projected table, where it sticks to a paper marker. Twist: when two markers touch, merge their pictures.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影仪和摄像头对准一张桌子，让学生把浏览器里的图片从笔记本“拖”到投影桌面上，并粘在一张纸质标记上；变体：两个标记碰到一起时，把它们的图片合成一张。

video.video_title: Augmented Surfaces (CHI'99)

works.title: EyeTap Digital Eye Glass
works.description: Mann explains the EyeTap: a beam splitter in front of one eye sends the exact rays entering the eye to a camera and re-emits processed light back along the same path, so the computer can replace what the eye sees.
works.description_zh: Mann 讲解 EyeTap：眼前的分光镜把本应进入眼睛的光线送进摄像头，再把处理后的光沿同一路径射回眼睛，于是计算机可以替换眼睛看到的内容。
works.idea_en: Make the eye itself the camera and the display, so the computer sees exactly what you see and can rewrite it.
works.idea_zh: 让眼睛本身同时成为摄像机和显示器，计算机看到的就是你看到的，并且可以改写它。
works.technique: A diverter mirror places the camera's centre of projection at the eye's own centre of projection, and an aremac (reverse camera) re-draws the processed image with correct parallax.
works.technique_zh: 分光镜让摄像机的投影中心与眼睛的投影中心重合，再由 aremac（“反向相机”）以正确的视差重绘处理后的图像。
