works.exercise_en: Build a phone 'viewfinder eye': hold the phone in front of one eye and apply a live filter that changes one class of objects (text, faces, signs). Twist: close the other eye and walk a short path using only the mediated view.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机“取景器之眼”：把手机举在一只眼睛前，用实时滤镜改变某一类物体（文字、人脸、标志）。变体：闭上另一只眼，只靠被介导的画面走完一段短路。

video.video_title: Steve Mann explains the EyeTap

works.title: Maman
works.description: A spider more than nine metres tall, carrying a sac of marble eggs, stands on long thin legs over plazas in Bilbao, Ottawa, Tokyo and Seoul; visitors walk underneath it.
works.description_zh: 一只高逾九米、腹下挂着大理石卵囊的蜘蛛以细长的腿站在毕尔巴鄂、渥太华、东京和首尔的广场上；观众从它下面走过。
works.idea_en: A giant creature you can walk under creates awe and a feeling of being protected, a scale relationship AR creatures can reproduce.
works.idea_zh: 一只可以从下面走过的巨型生物带来敬畏和被守护的感觉，AR 生物可以复现这种尺度关系。
works.technique: Cast bronze and steel legs support a body with a mesh sac holding marble eggs.
works.technique_zh: 铸造的青铜与钢制腿支撑着身体，网状囊中装有大理石卵。
works.exercise_en: Place a giant AR creature with long legs over a courtyard so people can walk beneath it, and add soft footsteps that respond to their movement. Twist: the creature slowly steps to stay over the largest group of people.
works.exercise_zh: 在庭院上方放一只长腿的巨型 AR 生物，让人们可以从下面走过，并加入随人移动而响应的轻柔脚步声；变体：生物会慢慢挪步，始终停在人最多的那一群上方。

video.video_title: Louise Bourgeois: Maman

works.title: Penetrable BBL Bleu
works.description: A cube of hanging blue tubes that visitors push through; the tubes brush, swing and click around the body, and the moving crowd makes the whole block ripple.
works.description_zh: 一个由悬挂蓝色软管组成的立方体，观众可以穿行其中；软管擦过身体、摆动并发出声响，人群走动让整块“色体”泛起涟漪。
works.idea_en: The artwork is completed by bodies moving through it; in AR, letting virtual strands part and swing around the user makes presence physical.
works.idea_zh: 作品由穿行其中的身体来完成；在 AR 中，让虚拟丝线在用户身边分开、摆动，就能让“在场”变得有触感。
works.technique: Dense rows of flexible tubes hang from a ceiling grid so that touch and movement propagate as visible waves through the volume.
works.technique_zh: 密集的软管从天花板网格垂下，触碰和移动会在整个体积中以可见的波动传播开来。
works.exercise_en: Create a Lens Studio or Unity AR 'curtain' of blue strands with simple spring physics that part around the camera as the user walks through. Twist: record each visitor's path as a slow ripple that stays visible for the next person.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 Unity 做一个带简单弹簧物理的蓝色丝线“帘幕”，用户走过时丝线在镜头周围分开。变体：把每位访客的路径记录成缓慢的涟漪，留给下一个人看见。

video.video_title: Soto's Penetrable BBL Bleu

works.title: Sculpture park and houses to watch the sunset
works.description: In a Louisiana Channel film, Not Vital shows his sculpture park in Sent, his foundation in Tarasp Castle and the buildings he makes around the world, including houses built only to watch the sunset.
works.description_zh: 在 Louisiana Channel 的影片中，Not Vital 展示了他在森特的雕塑公园、塔拉斯普城堡中的基金会，以及他在世界各地建造的建筑，包括只为看日落而建的房子。
works.idea_en: A building that exists only to frame one moment of the day is a pure example of designing an experience around time and place, as AR can.
works.idea_zh: 一座只为框住一天中某个时刻而存在的建筑，是围绕时间和地点设计体验的纯粹例子，AR 也可以这样做。
works.technique: Simple sculptural structures with stairs and openings are oriented to the sunset and built with local materials and labour.
works.technique_zh: 带有阶梯和开口的简单雕塑性结构朝向日落，用当地材料与人力建造。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR platform with a single framed opening on a hill so it aligns with today's sunset azimuth, and invite people to climb it at sunset. Twist: the opening closes after the sun has gone down.
works.exercise_zh: 在山坡上放一个只有一个框形开口的 AR 平台，使其对准今天日落的方位角，并邀请人们在日落时登上去；变体：太阳落下后开口会关闭。

video.video_title: Artist Not Vital Builds His Own Habitat | Louisiana Channel

works.title: Swimming Pool
works.description: Seen from the deck, a pool looks full of water with people standing fully clothed at the bottom; they reached it through a side door, because only a thin sheet of water sits on a sealed glass ceiling.
works.description_zh: 从池边往下看，泳池里满是水，池底却站着衣着整齐的人；他们其实是从侧门走进来的，因为水只有薄薄一层，托在一块密封的玻璃顶上。
works.idea_en: Two audiences looking at each other through one surface create the story: an AR scene can give 'inside' and 'outside' viewers different roles in the same illusion.
works.idea_zh: 两群观众隔着同一层表面互相看，故事就产生了：AR 场景也可以让“里面”和“外面”的观众在同一个幻象中扮演不同角色。
works.technique: A glass slab about 10 cm below the rim holds a shallow layer of water, so light refraction fakes the depth of a full pool above a dry, walk-in room painted pool-blue.
works.technique_zh: 在池沿下约 10 厘米处架一块玻璃，上面铺一层浅水，光的折射伪造出满池的深度，下面则是漆成泳池蓝、可以走进去的干燥房间。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a virtual rippling water plane over a real table with phone AR, and have a classmate crouch under the table while others view through the phone. Twist: add caustic light and bubbles that follow the person underneath using body tracking.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 在一张真实桌面上锚定一层会起波纹的虚拟水面，让一位同学蹲到桌子下面，其他人通过手机观看。变体：用人体追踪让焦散光斑和气泡跟着桌下的人移动。

video.video_title: Leandro Erlich: Swimming Pool at P.S.1

salient.why_en: Look down into the pool and people stand at the bottom, dry and breathing.
salient.why_zh: 往泳池里看，池底站着人，衣服没湿，呼吸如常。

works.title: Text Rain (with Romy Achituv)
works.description: Participants see a mirrored video of themselves while coloured letters from a poem fall like rain; the letters land on and rest on anything dark, so people catch, lift and spill lines of text with their bodies.
works.idea_zh: 用身体接住从天而降的诗句字母
works.technique: Each falling letter checks the brightness of the live camera pixel below it and stops falling when the pixel is darker than a threshold, so the body's silhouette becomes a physical surface.
works.exercise_zh: 用p5.js摄像头做“字母雨”：每个字母遇到暗像素就停住；变化：换成自己写的一首诗，并让被接住的字母连成可读的词时发出声音。

video.video_title: Camille Utterback - Text Rain

works.description_zh: 参与者看到自己的镜像视频，同时一首诗的彩色字母像雨一样落下；字母会停落在任何深色的东西上，于是人们可以用身体接住、托起并洒落一行行文字。
works.idea_en: Catch the letters of a poem falling from the sky with your body.
works.technique_zh: 每个下落的字母都会检查其下方实时摄像头像素的亮度，当像素比阈值更暗时就停止下落，于是身体的剪影就成了一个实体表面。
works.exercise_en: Make 'letter rain' with a p5.js camera sketch, where each letter stops when it meets a dark pixel. Twist: use a poem you wrote yourself, and play a sound when caught letters line up into a readable word.

salient.why_en: Letters of a poem fall like rain and pile up on your silhouette, so reading becomes a physical act.
salient.why_zh: 诗句的字母像雨一样落下，堆在你的身影上，阅读变成了身体动作。

works.title: Titre variable n°1 (théâtre optique)
works.description: Inside a small box, a tiny filmed Pierrick Sorin appears to stand among real objects and act out a clumsy gag. The figure is a video reflection on a tilted glass, so it floats in the same space as the physical props.
works.description_zh: 一个小盒子里，拍好的迷你 Pierrick Sorin 看起来就站在真实物件之间，表演一个笨手笨脚的小笑话。人物其实是倾斜玻璃上的视频反射，所以能与实体道具漂浮在同一空间里。
works.idea_en: A tilted sheet of glass is the cheapest optical see-through display: it teaches how to place a virtual figure among real objects and how lighting decides whether it looks present.
works.idea_zh: 一块倾斜的玻璃就是最便宜的光学透视显示器：它教你如何把虚拟人物放进真实物件之间，以及光线如何决定它是否显得在场。
works.technique: Pepper's ghost: a hidden monitor below or above reflects in a 45° glass pane, superimposing the filmed performer (shot on black) onto the lit miniature set behind the glass.
works.technique_zh: 佩珀尔幻象：藏在上方或下方的显示器映在 45° 的玻璃上，把在黑底前拍摄的表演者叠加到玻璃后面被照亮的微缩场景中。
works.exercise_en: Build a shoebox Pepper's-ghost theatre with a phone screen and a sheet of acetate, then stage a 15-second clip of yourself (filmed on black) interacting with a real object inside the box. Twist: port the same scene to a HoloKit or phone AR and compare which feels more present.
works.exercise_zh: 用鞋盒、手机屏幕和一张透明胶片做一个佩珀尔幻象小剧场，再拍一段自己在黑底前的 15 秒视频，让它与盒中一件真实物件互动；变体：把同一场景搬到 HoloKit 或手机 AR 里，比较哪一个更有在场感。

video.video_title: « Titre variable n°1". Théâtre optique, 1999 »

works.title: Unconscious Flow
works.description: Two people hold sensors while two virtual mermaids represent them; the mermaids' behaviour reveals whether the pair are truly relaxed or tense with each other, whatever their faces say.
works.description_zh: 两人手握传感器，两条虚拟美人鱼代表他们；无论他们脸上表现如何，美人鱼的行为都会揭示两人彼此之间是真正放松还是紧张。
works.idea_en: Show the hidden emotional relationship between two people.
works.idea_zh: 呈现两人之间隐藏的情感关系。
works.technique: Heart-rate sensors measure each participant's arousal and synchrony, and the pair of values is mapped to how the CG mermaids approach, avoid or dance with each other.
works.technique_zh: 心率传感器测量每位参与者的兴奋度和同步程度，这组数值决定 CG 美人鱼彼此靠近、回避或共舞。
works.exercise_en: Give two people pulse sensors (or phone camera heart-rate apps) and map their heart-rate difference to the distance between two AR creatures. Twist: the creatures merge when hearts sync.
works.exercise_zh: 给两个人戴上脉搏传感器（或用手机摄像头心率应用），把两人心率差映射为两只 AR 生物之间的距离。变体：心跳同步时，两只生物合为一体。

video.video_title: unconscious flow

works.title: Vectorial Elevation
works.description: Robotic searchlights around Mexico City's Zócalo form huge light sculptures in the night sky, each designed by people over the internet and shown with their name.
works.description_zh: 墨西哥城宪法广场周围的机器人探照灯在夜空中组成巨大的光雕塑，每一个都由网友在网上设计，并附上设计者的名字。
works.idea_en: Letting remote people design something that appears over a real city shows how participation can reach physical space — a template for web-authored, site-anchored AR.
works.idea_zh: 让远方的人设计出现在真实城市上空的东西，说明参与可以延伸到物理空间——这是“网页创作、现场锚定”的 AR 的模板。
works.technique: A web interface with a 3D model of the square lets users aim 18 robotic searchlights; designs are queued and executed in sequence while webcams document each one back to its author.
works.technique_zh: 一个带广场三维模型的网页界面让用户调整 18 台机器人探照灯的方向；设计排队依次执行，网络摄像头拍下每一个并发回给作者。
works.exercise_en: Build a web page where remote users place light beams on a 3D model of your campus, then show the queued designs one by one as AR beams over the real site. Twist: credit each design with the author's city floating in the sky.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个网页，让远方用户在校园三维模型上放置光束，再把排队的设计逐一作为 AR 光束显示在真实场地上空。变体：在天空中浮现每个设计作者所在的城市名。

video.video_title: Vectorial Elevation - part 1

works.title: Wooden Mirror
works.description: 830 small wooden tiles tilt with individual motors so the light they catch forms a live, wooden reflection of whoever stands in front.
works.idea_zh: 用会转动的木片拼出你的实时镜像
works.technique: A hidden camera image is downsampled to the tile grid and each pixel's brightness sets a servo angle that changes how much light the wooden tile reflects.
works.exercise_zh: 用8×8舵机+卡纸片做一面“机械镜子”，由摄像头低分辨率图像控制角度；变化：换成自己选的材料（纽扣、瓶盖），比较不同材料的“像素感”。

video.video_title: "Wooden Mirror" (1999) by Daniel Rozin

works.description_zh: 830 块小木片由各自的电机控制倾斜，它们捕捉到的光形成了站在面前之人的实时木质倒影。
works.idea_en: Piece together your live mirror image from turning wooden tiles.
works.technique_zh: 隐藏摄像头的画面被降采样到木片网格的分辨率，每个像素的亮度决定一个舵机的角度，从而改变木片反射的光量。
works.exercise_en: Build a 'mechanical mirror' from an 8x8 grid of servos and card tiles, with angles controlled by a low-resolution camera image. Twist: switch to a material of your choice (buttons, bottle caps) and compare how 'pixel-like' different materials feel.

works.title: memorandum
works.description: Performers move behind and in front of a translucent screen that carries projected images, text and flickering data; they seem to be stored, erased and replayed like memories.
works.description_zh: 表演者在一块承载投影影像、文字和闪烁数据的半透明幕前后移动，仿佛被当作记忆存储、擦除、再重放。
works.idea_en: A semi-transparent layer between the viewer and the performer is exactly an AR display; memorandum shows how text and image on that layer can rewrite the person behind it.
works.idea_zh: 观众与表演者之间的一层半透明幕，本身就是一个 AR 显示层；《memorandum》展示了这层上的文字和影像如何改写它后面的人。
works.technique: A large scrim in front of the stage takes front projection while backlight reveals performers behind it, so projected content and live bodies overlap in one plane.
works.technique_zh: 舞台前一块大纱幕接受正面投影，后方灯光照出幕后的表演者，使投影内容与真人在同一平面上重叠。
works.exercise_en: Hang a sheet of tulle or tracing paper, project text onto it and have a classmate stand behind it lit from behind; then recreate the layer in phone AR with a transparent text plane that follows the person. Twist: the text shows the person's own spoken words transcribed live.
works.exercise_zh: 挂一块纱或描图纸，把文字投在上面，让一位同学站在后面并从背后打光；再用手机 AR 做一个跟随人物的透明文字平面来重现这一层；变体：文字是这个人实时说话的转写。

video.video_title: Dumb Type - memorandum

works.title: ASL recognition from a wearable camera
works.description: A cap-mounted camera looks down at the wearer's hands while they sign American Sign Language sentences, and a recogniser turns the signs into English words in real time.
works.description_zh: 戴在帽子上的摄像头向下拍摄佩戴者的双手，当他用美国手语打出句子时，识别器实时把手势翻译成英语单词。
works.idea_en: Point the camera at your own hands so the wearable understands the language they speak.
works.idea_zh: 把摄像头对准自己的双手，让可穿戴设备读懂双手所说的语言。
works.technique: Hand blobs are tracked from the downward-looking camera and fed as features to hidden Markov models trained on sentence-level ASL.
works.technique_zh: 从向下拍摄的画面中追踪手部区域，作为特征输入到用句子级美国手语训练的隐马尔可夫模型中。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe hand tracking on a phone worn on the chest to recognise five hand signs and speak them aloud. Twist: design a new five-sign vocabulary for controlling music.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机挂在胸前，用 MediaPipe 手部追踪识别五种手势并朗读出来。变体：为控制音乐设计一套新的五手势词汇。

video.video_title: ASL sign language recognition from a wearable camera 1994-1998

works.title: Angel of the North
works.description: A 20-metre steel angel with 54-metre wings stands on a former colliery hill beside the A1 motorway at Gateshead, seen by about 90,000 drivers a day.
works.description_zh: 一座高 20 米、翼展 54 米的钢铁天使矗立在盖茨黑德 A1 公路旁一座旧煤矿山丘上，每天约有九万名司机从它身边经过。
works.idea_en: A single giant figure on a hill becomes a landmark people navigate by, a reminder that the scale and silhouette of an AR landmark matter more than detail.
works.idea_zh: 山丘上的一个巨大人形成为人们辨认方向的地标，提醒我们 AR 地标的尺度与轮廓比细节更重要。
works.technique: The body-form is built from ribbed weathering steel sections anchored 20 metres into the hill so it can withstand winds of over 160 km/h.
works.technique_zh: 人形由带肋的耐候钢分段构成，锚入山体 20 米深，足以抵抗时速 160 公里以上的风。
works.exercise_en: Place a 20-metre virtual figure on the tallest point visible from your campus in AR and test from how far away its silhouette is still readable. Twist: let its wings open only when the viewer is moving fast (walking vs. driving speed).
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一个 20 米高的虚拟人形放在校园可见的最高点上，测试从多远还能认出它的轮廓；变体：只有当观者快速移动（步行与车速）时翅膀才展开。

video.video_title: theEYE - Antony Gormley - Angel of the North

works.title: Boundary Functions
works.description: An overhead projector draws lines on the floor between everyone standing in the room, dividing it into personal Voronoi cells that grow, shrink and snap as people move.
works.idea_zh: 把看不见的“个人空间”用地面上的沃罗诺伊线画出来，人越多空间越小
works.technique: An overhead camera tracks each person's floor position and a Voronoi diagram of those points is computed in real time and projected back onto the floor from above.
works.exercise_zh: 用俯拍摄像头+投影仪（或手机俯拍+p5.js）追踪同学站位，实时计算并投影沃罗诺伊分界线；加一个变化：让每个格子的颜色随其面积变化，面积越小越红。

video.video_title: Boundary Functions - Interactive Art by Scott Snibbe (1998) HD Version

works.description_zh: 一台俯投的投影仪在房间里每个站着的人之间画出线条，把地面划分成个人的沃罗诺伊（Voronoi）单元，随着人们移动，这些单元会扩大、缩小、骤然改变。
works.idea_en: Draw invisible 'personal space' on the floor as Voronoi lines, so the more people there are, the less space each gets.
works.technique_zh: 俯拍摄像头追踪每个人在地面上的位置，实时计算这些点的沃罗诺伊图，并从上方投射回地面。
works.exercise_en: Use an overhead camera and projector (or a phone filming from above with p5.js) to track where classmates stand, and compute and project Voronoi boundaries in real time. Twist: color each cell by its area, turning redder as it shrinks.

salient.why_en: Lines drawn between people on the floor show each person's personal space, which shrinks as more people arrive.
salient.why_zh: 地面上人与人之间画出的线标出每个人的个人空间，人越多，空间越小。

works.title: D.A.V.E. – digital amplified video engine (with Chris Haring)
works.description: A solo dancer's body becomes the projection screen: morphing faces, ageing and impossible body distortions are mapped precisely onto the moving performer.
works.idea_zh: 把舞者身体本身当成屏幕，投射出不可能的变形
works.technique: Pre-rendered video is choreographed frame-by-frame with the dancer so the projection lands on the body, relying on rehearsed timing rather than tracking.
works.exercise_zh: 让一位同学穿白衣站在投影前，按排练好的节奏把预先剪好的脸部/纹理视频投到身上；变化：加一个用摄像头实时跟随的小光斑。

video.video_title: Klaus Obermaier, Chris Haring: D.A.V.E. – digital amplified video engine - 1998/2000

works.description_zh: 独舞者的身体本身成了投影屏幕：变形的面孔、衰老过程和不可能的身体扭曲被精确地映射到运动中的表演者身上。
works.idea_en: Use the dancer's own body as the screen and project impossible transformations onto it.
works.technique_zh: 预渲染的视频与舞者逐帧编排，使投影落在身体上；依靠的是排练好的时机，而不是追踪。
works.exercise_en: Have a classmate in white clothes stand in front of the projector, and project pre-cut face or texture videos onto them following a rehearsed rhythm. Twist: add a small spot of light that follows them live via a camera.

works.title: DUCK! wearable agent for Patrol
works.description: In Patrol, a dart-gun tag game played in MIT buildings, each player wears a computer; the DUCK! agent uses location and gesture recognition to show teammates' positions on a head-up map and flash when someone is vulnerable while reloading.
works.description_zh: Patrol 是在 MIT 楼里玩的软弹枪对战游戏，每名玩家都穿戴计算机；DUCK! 智能体通过位置和手势识别，在抬头地图上显示队友位置，并在有人换弹暴露时闪烁提示。
works.idea_en: Let a wearable read the game from your body so teammates get tactical information without talking.
works.idea_zh: 让可穿戴设备从你的身体动作读懂游戏，队友无需说话就能获得战术信息。
works.technique: Room-level location beacons and accelerometer gesture recognition detect firing and reloading, and the states are shared over the network to everyone's HUD.
works.technique_zh: 房间级定位信标和加速度计手势识别检测开火与换弹动作，状态通过网络共享到每个人的抬头显示器。
works.exercise_en: Run a hide-and-seek round where each phone uses its accelerometer to detect a 'crouch' and shares it to a team map. Twist: reveal a player's position only when they move fast.
works.exercise_zh: 玩一轮捉迷藏：每部手机用加速度计识别“蹲下”，并把状态共享到团队地图。变体：只有当玩家快速移动时才暴露他的位置。

video.video_title: Wearable Computing:  Using location and gesture recognition to assist in a paintball-style game

works.title: Die Falle
works.description: A large stroboscopic sculpture shown in Science Gallery Dublin's ILLUSION exhibition, in which sculpted figures cycle through a looping, nightmarish transformation.
works.description_zh: 一件大型频闪雕塑，在都柏林科学美术馆的 ILLUSION 展中展出，雕塑人物循环经历一段梦魇般的变形。
works.idea_en: Showing an illusion in a science context invites people to explain what they see; AR can pair wonder with a reveal of how the trick works.
works.idea_zh: 在科学语境里展示幻象，会邀请人们去解释所见；AR 也可以把惊奇和“揭秘”搭配在一起。
works.technique: Persistence of vision: a rotating armature of sculpted stages is lit by brief flashes so each stage is seen only at one position (year approximate).
works.technique_zh: 视觉暂留：装有各阶段雕塑的支架旋转，短暂闪光使每个阶段只在一个位置被看见（年份为估计）。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR zoetrope with 12 models on a ring and add a toggle that switches between 'strobe' view and 'continuous' view. Twist: let viewers find the rotation speed that makes the animation lock in.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 走马灯，环上放 12 个模型，并加一个在“频闪”与“连续”视图之间切换的开关。变体：让观众自己找到使动画“锁定”的转速。

video.video_title: Die Falle at ILLUSION

works.title: Hand-drawn Spaces
works.description: A three-screen installation made with Merce Cunningham where life-size hand-drawn dancers perform his choreography in a limitless 3D space, walking out of one screen and into another across the viewers' space.
works.description_zh: 与 Merce Cunningham 合作的三屏装置：真人大小的手绘舞者在无限延展的 3D 空间里表演他的编舞，从一块屏幕走出、穿过观众所在的空间走进另一块。
works.idea_en: Motion-captured dancers drawn by hand travel through the room between screens.
works.idea_zh: 被动捕记录、又以手绘呈现的舞者，在屏幕之间穿越整个房间。
works.technique: Cunningham's choreography was motion-captured and rendered as drawn figures in a virtual space larger than the three projections, with spatial sound by Ron Kuivila tracking their positions.
works.technique_zh: Cunningham 的编舞经动作捕捉后被渲染为手绘人物，放在比三块投影更大的虚拟空间里，Ron Kuivila 的空间声音追随他们的位置。
works.exercise_en: Set up two projections on facing walls and animate a stick-figure dancer (from a mocap file) that exits one wall and, after a delay matching the walking time, enters the other. Twist: add a speaker path so you hear it cross the room.
works.exercise_zh: 在相对的两面墙上各投一个画面，让一个火柴人舞者（来自动捕文件）从一面墙走出，经过与步行时间相当的延迟后从另一面墙走进；变体：加一路扬声器，让人听见它穿过房间。

video.video_title: Hand-drawn Spaces - excerpt

works.title: Shadow sculptures (Dirty White Trash (With Gulls))
works.description: A heap of the artists' own rubbish sits on a plinth; a projector beam throws its shadow on the wall, where it becomes a crisp silhouette of the two artists sitting back to back.
works.description_zh: 底座上堆着艺术家自己的垃圾；一束投影灯光把它的影子打在墙上，墙上出现两位艺术家背靠背坐着的清晰剪影。
works.idea_en: The gap between a messy object and its clean projection is the punchline: AR can reveal a hidden portrait inside clutter by choosing where the virtual light comes from.
works.idea_zh: 杂乱物体和干净投影之间的落差就是笑点：AR 可以通过选择虚拟光源的位置，从一堆杂物中揭示一幅隐藏的肖像。
works.technique: The pile is arranged piece by piece under a single projector light until its shadow matches a traced silhouette of the artists.
works.technique_zh: 在一盏投影灯下一件件调整垃圾堆，直到它的影子和描下来的艺术家剪影吻合。
works.exercise_en: Scan a messy desk with LiDAR, then place a virtual spotlight whose shadow of the real mesh forms your classmate's profile (fake it by rendering the profile as the shadow). Twist: the portrait only appears when the desk is at its messiest.
works.exercise_zh: 用 LiDAR 扫描一张凌乱的书桌，放一盏虚拟聚光灯，让真实网格投下的影子形成同学的侧影（可以直接把侧影渲染成影子来“作弊”）。变体：只有书桌最乱的时候肖像才会出现。

video.video_title: Tim Noble and Sue Webster Interview: In Search of Imperfection

works.title: Storm King Wall
works.description: A dry-stone wall snakes between trees in a forest at Storm King Art Center, then runs down a hill, disappears into a pond and re-emerges on the far side.
works.description_zh: 一道干垒石墙在 Storm King 艺术中心的林中蛇行穿过树木，随后下坡，没入池塘，又在对岸重新出现。
works.idea_en: A line that dodges trees and dives under water shows how an anchored path can react to the site rather than ignore it.
works.idea_zh: 一条会绕开树木、潜入水下的线，说明锚定的路径可以回应场地，而不是无视它。
works.technique: Wallers built the 690-metre wall by hand from stones of old field walls on the site, curving it around each tree.
works.technique_zh: 工匠们用场地上旧田埂墙的石头手工垒起这道长 690 米的墙，并让它绕着每一棵树弯曲。
works.exercise_en: Generate an AR line with Unity AR Foundation plane and mesh detection that winds around detected obstacles (people, chairs, trees) instead of crossing them. Twist: let the line dive under a detected floor plane and re-emerge.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Unity AR Foundation 的平面与网格检测生成一条 AR 线，让它绕开检测到的障碍物（人、椅子、树）而不是穿过去；变体：让线潜入检测到的地面之下再重新冒出。

video.video_title: Why sculptor Andy Goldsworthy is tearing down walls -- and then rebuilding them

works.title: The Tarot Garden
works.description: On a Tuscan hillside at Garavicchio, Niki de Saint Phalle spent almost 20 years building 22 monumental figures of the tarot's Major Arcana covered in mirror, glass and ceramic mosaic, some of them inhabitable.
works.description_zh: 在托斯卡纳加拉维基奥的一处山坡上，Niki de Saint Phalle 花了近 20 年建造了 22 座对应塔罗大阿卡纳的巨型人像，覆满镜子、玻璃和陶瓷马赛克，其中有些可以居住。
works.idea_en: A walkable set of characters from one symbolic system turns a landscape into a story you move through, a model for AR theme trails.
works.idea_zh: 一整套出自同一象征体系、可以漫步其间的角色，把风景变成一个可以穿行的故事，是 AR 主题路线的范本。
works.technique: Steel armatures were sprayed with concrete and covered by hand in mirror and ceramic mosaic.
works.technique_zh: 钢骨架上喷涂混凝土，再手工覆盖镜面和陶瓷马赛克。
works.exercise_en: Choose a card set (tarot, zodiac, a local deck) and place each card's character as an AR figure along a park trail. Twist: each visitor draws a random card and the path reorders around it.
works.exercise_zh: 选择一套牌（塔罗、星座或本地纸牌），把每张牌的角色作为 AR 人物放在公园小径沿线；变体：每位访客随机抽一张牌，路线会围绕这张牌重新排列。

video.video_title: Niki de Saint Phalle : le Jardin des Tarots

works.title: Up and Under
works.description: In a former sand quarry in Nokia, Finland, a long grass-covered earth mound is pierced by concrete tunnels that frame views of the sky, water and each other.
works.description_zh: 在芬兰诺基亚市的一处旧采砂场中，一道长长的覆草土堤被数条混凝土隧道穿过，隧道框住天空、水面以及彼此的景象。
works.idea_en: Tunnels through a mound are viewfinders that tell you exactly where to stand and look, like AR markers that reward one viewpoint.
works.idea_zh: 穿过土堤的隧道就是取景器，明确告诉你站在哪里、看向哪里，就像只奖励某一视点的 AR 标记。
works.technique: Concrete pipes were laid through a shaped earthwork and grassed over; their axes are aligned with the landscape and cardinal points.
works.technique_zh: 混凝土管道穿过塑形后的土方工程并覆盖草皮，轴线与地景和方位对齐。
works.exercise_en: Place three AR tubes through a real hedge or building gap so each frames a different target (a tree, a window, the sky). Twist: show a hidden message only when the user stands inside a tube's axis.
works.exercise_zh: 穿过真实的树篱或建筑空隙放置三根 AR 管道，让每根框住不同的目标（一棵树、一扇窗、天空）；变体：只有当用户站在管道轴线上时才显示隐藏信息。

video.video_title: View to UP AND UNDER by Nancy Holt (1998)

works.title: Another Place
works.description: One hundred cast-iron figures of the artist's body stand spread over three kilometres of Crosby Beach near Liverpool, all staring out to sea; the tide slowly covers and reveals them.
works.description_zh: 一百尊以艺术家身体翻铸的铸铁人像分布在利物浦附近 Crosby 海滩约三公里的范围内，全部凝望大海；潮水涨落间，它们被慢慢淹没又重新露出。
works.idea_en: Many identical figures facing one horizon turn a whole beach into a stage: the same trick an AR scene can use by spreading copies of one anchor across a site.
works.idea_zh: 许多相同的人像面对同一条地平线，把整片海滩变成舞台：AR 场景也可以把同一个锚点的副本铺满整个场地，得到同样效果。
works.technique: Life-size cast-iron casts of the artist's body are fixed on foundations at different distances from the shore, so the tide and the viewer's distance vary how much of each is visible.
works.technique_zh: 以艺术家身体为模、等身大小的铸铁人像固定在距海岸不同距离的基座上，潮水和观者距离共同决定每尊人像露出多少。
works.exercise_en: Place 20 copies of one scanned human figure across a school field in WebXR or AR Foundation, all facing the same compass direction, and walk among them. Twist: add a rising virtual water plane that hides the figures one by one.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 或 AR Foundation 中把同一个扫描人像复制 20 份，分散放在学校操场上，全部朝向同一个方位，然后在其间行走；变体：加入一个缓缓上升的虚拟水面，让人像一个个被淹没。

video.video_title: Another Place | Anthony Gormley | Crosby | Liverpool

works.title: Cory's Yellow Chair
works.description: A small yellow chair continuously bursts apart into its separate pieces, which float outward and then come back together into a whole chair again.
works.description_zh: 一把黄色小椅子不断地炸开成零件，零件向外飘散，再重新合拢成一把完整的椅子。
works.idea_en: The exploded view is a powerful AR move: taking a real object apart in space and reassembling it explains it and delights at once.
works.idea_zh: 爆炸视图是 AR 中很有力的一招：把真实物体在空间中拆开再拼回去，既能讲解，又令人愉悦。
works.technique: Each chair part is held on its own wire arm driven by a shared cam system, so all pieces move out and back in coordinated radial paths.
works.technique_zh: 椅子的每个部件由各自的铁丝臂支撑，由同一套凸轮系统驱动，所有部件沿协调的径向路径散开又收回。
works.exercise_en: Scan a real chair, split the model into parts in Reality Composer or Unity, and animate an exploded view that loops around the real chair in AR. Twist: let the viewer's distance control how far the parts fly apart.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描一把真椅子，在 Reality Composer 或 Unity 中拆成零件，在 AR 中围绕真椅子循环播放爆炸视图。变体：观众离得越近，零件飞得越远。

video.video_title: Cory's Yellow Chair - Arthur Ganson

works.title: Ever Is Over All
works.description: Two overlapping projections fill a corner: on one side a woman in a blue dress walks down a street smashing car windows with a long flower while a policewoman salutes her; on the other, slow shots of a field of the same flowers.
works.description_zh: 两段投影在墙角交叠：一边是穿蓝裙的女子沿街走着，用一支长长的花砸碎车窗，女警向她敬礼；另一边是同一种花的花田慢镜头。
works.idea_en: Two images meeting in a corner make the viewer stitch cause and effect together; AR can split a story between two surfaces so the viewer's head turns do the editing.
works.idea_zh: 两幅画面在墙角相遇，让观众自己把因果缝合起来：AR 也可以把一个故事拆到两个表面上，让观众转头来完成剪辑。
works.technique: Two large video projections overlap at a corner, and slow motion plus a hummed soundtrack make the violent act feel light and dreamlike.
works.technique_zh: 两路大幅投影在墙角重叠，慢动作和哼唱的配乐让暴力动作显得轻盈如梦。
works.exercise_en: Shoot two 30-second clips, one of an action and one of an object, and pin them in AR on two walls meeting at a corner so they overlap. Twist: the second clip plays only when the user looks at the corner line.
works.exercise_zh: 拍两段 30 秒的片段，一段是动作，一段是物件，用 AR 贴到相交成墙角的两面墙上，让它们部分重叠。变体：只有当用户看向墙角交线时，第二段才开始播放。

video.video_title: Pipilotti Rist - Ever is Over All, 1997

works.title: Juggler
works.description: In a dark room a spinning sculpture comes alive under strobe light: objects arc through the air in a loop, mutating as they fly, like a juggling act in a dream.
works.description_zh: 在黑暗的房间里，一件旋转雕塑在频闪下活了过来：物件沿弧线在空中循环飞行，边飞边变形，像梦中的杂耍。
works.idea_en: Darkness plus a timed flash hides the mechanism and leaves only the illusion; AR benefits from similarly controlling what the viewer can and cannot see.
works.idea_zh: 黑暗加定时闪光隐藏了机械、只留下幻象；AR 同样受益于精心控制观众能看见什么、看不见什么。
works.technique: Sculpted keyframes spin on a large armature at a speed matched to the strobe frequency, so each flash reveals the next frame of the loop.
works.technique_zh: 雕塑关键帧装在大型支架上旋转，转速与频闪频率匹配，每次闪光揭示循环中的下一帧。
works.exercise_en: Make objects fly around the viewer in an arc in a dark room using HoloKit, each flashing into view once per second as a slightly different shape. Twist: sync the flash to the viewer's heartbeat or footsteps.
works.exercise_zh: 用 HoloKit 在暗室里让物体绕观众沿弧线飞行，每秒闪现一次，每次形状略有不同。变体：把闪光同步到观众的心跳或脚步。

video.video_title: Juggler Gregory Barsamian

works.title: OR
works.description: On a curved, blindingly white stage, performers appear and vanish in bursts of light, projection and sound by Ryoji Ikeda; the piece reflects on the thin line between life and death, as in an operating room.
works.description_zh: 在一个弯曲、白得刺眼的舞台上，表演者在强光、投影和池田亮司（Ryoji Ikeda）的声音中出现又消失；作品思考生与死之间的那条细线，就像手术室（OR）一样。
works.idea_en: Flashes of light can make a real person appear and disappear, a stage-scale version of the fades and occlusion an AR designer uses to add or remove things from reality.
works.idea_zh: 闪光可以让真人出现、消失——这是舞台尺度的淡入淡出与遮挡，AR 设计师正是用这些手法往现实里添加或抹去东西。
works.technique: A white curved cyclorama acts as both floor and screen; high-intensity strobes, video projection and precisely cued sound hide and reveal performers.
works.technique_zh: 白色弧形天幕同时是地面和屏幕；高强度频闪、视频投影和精确提示的声音让表演者时隐时现。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR people occlusion to make a classmate 'fade out' of the camera view when a white flash covers the screen, and fade back in with a delay. Twist: each disappearance leaves a lingering glowing outline in the spot.
works.exercise_zh: 利用手机 AR 的人物遮挡，在屏幕闪白时让同学从画面中“消失”，延迟一会儿再淡入；变体：每次消失都在原地留下一个久久不散的发光轮廓。

video.video_title: Dumb Type - OR

works.title: Open Shutter: Long-Exposure Construction Series
works.description: Cameras with tiny apertures stay open for up to three years over building sites such as Potsdamer Platz in Berlin, MoMA in New York and IMS Paulista in São Paulo, so cranes and new towers appear as translucent layers.
works.description_zh: 孔径极小的相机在柏林波茨坦广场、纽约 MoMA、圣保罗 IMS Paulista 等工地上方持续曝光长达三年，塔吊和新楼都以半透明图层的形式出现。
works.idea_en: A site's history can be shown as translucent layers in one view; AR 'time layers' over buildings can borrow this ghosted look.
works.idea_zh: 一个地方的历史可以在同一视图里显示为半透明的层；叠加在建筑上的 AR“时间图层”可以借用这种幽灵般的视觉。
works.technique: Custom cameras with very small apertures and heavy filtering expose one sheet of film for months or years (series from 1997 onward).
works.technique_zh: 自制相机采用极小光圈和重度滤镜，让一张底片曝光数月甚至数年（系列始于 1997 年）。
works.exercise_en: Collect 10 photos of one building from different years (archives, Street View history), align them in AR over the real facade, and blend them with a slider. Twist: let each layer appear only when the viewer stands where that photo was taken.
works.exercise_zh: 收集同一栋建筑不同年份的 10 张照片（档案、街景历史），在 AR 中与真实立面对齐，并用滑块混合；变体：只有观众站到当年拍摄的位置时，对应的图层才出现。

video.video_title: Michael Wesely: Coletando fragmentos de tempo

works.title: Pick-and-Drop
works.description: A user taps a file on one computer with a pen, physically carries the pen to another screen and taps again to drop it there, as if data were an object you can pick up.
works.description_zh: 用户用笔在一台电脑上点一下某个文件，拿着笔走到另一块屏幕前再点一下，文件就被“放”了过去，好像数据是可以拿起来的实物。
works.idea_en: Treat digital data like a physical thing you can pick up with one device and drop into another.
works.idea_zh: 把数字数据当成实物：在一个设备上拿起，到另一个设备上放下。
works.technique: Each pen has a unique ID; tapping registers the pen ID and the selected object with a network server, and tapping another screen with the same pen retrieves it.
works.technique_zh: 每支笔有唯一 ID；点选时服务器记录“这支笔拿着哪个对象”，用同一支笔点另一块屏幕时再把对象取出来。
works.exercise_en: Make two phones and a laptop share a 'grab' gesture: pinch on one screen to pick an image, then tap another device within five seconds to drop it there. Twist: let the image 'spill' if you walk too slowly.
works.exercise_zh: 让两部手机和一台笔记本共享一个“抓取”手势：在一块屏上捏合拿起一张图片，五秒内点另一台设备即可放下；变体：如果走得太慢，图片就会“洒出来”。

video.video_title: Pick-and-Drop (UIST'97, CHI'98)

salient.why_en: Pick up a file with a pen on one screen and drop it on another, treating data as a physical object.
salient.why_zh: 用笔在一块屏幕上拿起文件，放到另一块屏幕上，数据被当作实物对待。

works.title: Room for one colour
works.description: A white room is lit only by yellow mono-frequency lamps; visitors, their clothes and skin all turn shades of grey and yellow, as if colour had been switched off.
works.description_zh: 一个白色房间只用单频黄灯照明；观众、他们的衣服和皮肤都变成灰色和黄色，仿佛颜色被关掉了。
works.idea_en: Changing the light, not the objects, changes the whole world at once; a global colour grade in AR can transform a room more strongly than any added 3D model.
works.idea_zh: 改变光而不是物体，就能一下子改变整个世界；AR 里一次整体调色，可能比加任何三维模型更能改造一个房间。
works.technique: Low-pressure sodium lamps emit a single wavelength of yellow light, so the eye cannot distinguish other hues and perceives the scene in yellow and black.
works.technique_zh: 低压钠灯只发出单一波长的黄光，眼睛无法分辨其他色相，只能看到黄色和黑色。
works.exercise_en: Write a WebXR or Lens Studio shader that maps the passthrough camera to one hue and brightness only, and have students try to sort coloured objects while wearing it. Twist: let one object keep its true colour as the only exception.
works.exercise_zh: 写一个 WebXR 或 Lens Studio 着色器，把透视摄像画面映射成只剩一种色相和亮度，让同学戴着它尝试给彩色物体分类。变体：只让一个物体保留真实颜色，作为唯一的例外。

video.video_title: Olafur Eliasson's 'Room for one colour' | Monochrome: Painting in Black and White

works.title: Santa Maria Annunciata in Chiesa Rossa
works.description: Flavin's last work lights the nave, transept and apse of a Milan church with green, blue, pink, gold and ultraviolet fluorescent light, turning the building into a sequence of colour spaces.
works.description_zh: Flavin 的最后一件作品，用绿、蓝、粉、金和紫外荧光照亮米兰一座教堂的中殿、耳堂和后殿，把建筑变成一连串的色彩空间。
works.idea_en: Light can follow the story of a building (entrance, nave, altar); AR experiences in architecture can be sequenced along the route people already walk.
works.idea_zh: 光可以顺着一座建筑的叙事走（入口、中殿、祭坛）；建筑中的 AR 体验也可以沿着人们原本就会走的路线来编排。
works.technique: Fluorescent fixtures are hidden along the upper edges of the nave and transepts, washing each architectural zone in a different colour.
works.technique_zh: 荧光灯具藏在中殿和耳堂的上缘，把每个建筑区域洗成不同的颜色。
works.exercise_en: Map the route from your school entrance to the main hall and assign each section an AR colour wash that fades in as a visitor enters it. Twist: end the route with an ultraviolet-looking zone that reveals hidden text.
works.exercise_zh: 规划从学校入口到礼堂的路线，给每一段分配一种 AR 色彩光晕，访客进入时渐显。变体：路线终点设置一个类似紫外光的区域，显现隐藏的文字。

video.video_title: A spasso per Milano: la luce di Dan Flavin

works.title: sanctuarium
works.description: For Skulptur Projekte Münster 1997, de Vries fenced a circle of land in a city park with a wall and left it untouched, so wild plants grew freely inside, visible only through small openings.
works.description_zh: 为 1997 年明斯特雕塑展，de Vries 在一座城市公园里用围墙圈出一块圆形土地，任其不受打扰，让野生植物在内部自由生长，只能透过小开口看到。
works.idea_en: Protecting a patch of nature and letting time do the work makes an invisible process the artwork, a stance for slow AR.
works.idea_zh: 保护一块自然之地、让时间去完成作品，把一个看不见的过程变成了艺术，这是慢节奏 AR 的立场。
works.technique: A round enclosure with a few viewing slits is built around a plot of land that is then left unmanaged for years.
works.technique_zh: 围绕一块土地建起带有几道观察缝的圆形围墙，然后多年不加管理。
works.exercise_en: Mark a small patch of real ground in AR with a virtual fence and log photos of it once a week to build a time-lapse. Twist: the virtual fence grows taller the longer the patch remains undisturbed.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中用虚拟围栏标出一小块真实地面，每周拍照记录一次以制作延时影像；变体：这块地保持不受干扰的时间越长，虚拟围栏就长得越高。

video.video_title: Mapping Herman de Vries- sanctuarium

works.title: 3D CyberCode
works.description: Printed 2D barcode cards are placed in front of a camera and each one sprouts a 3D object that stays registered to the card as it is tilted and moved, years before ARToolKit.
works.description_zh: 把印有二维条码的卡片放到摄像头前，每张卡片上都会“长出”一个 3D 物体，卡片倾斜移动时物体也紧紧贴合，这比 ARToolKit 还早好几年。
works.idea_en: A printed code can be both an ID and a 3D anchor for virtual objects.
works.idea_zh: 一张印刷的码既是身份标识，也是虚拟物体的三维锚点。
works.technique: The system decodes a square 2D matrix code and estimates its 3D pose from the code's corner points, then renders a model on top of the camera image.
works.technique_zh: 系统解码方形二维矩阵码，并根据码的四个角点估算其三维姿态，再把模型渲染到摄像头画面上。
works.exercise_en: Make a deck of six marker cards with an AR library (for example AR.js or MindAR) and give each card a 3D creature; when two cards touch, spawn a third creature between them. Twist: let players trade cards so the creatures 'travel' between tables.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR 库（如 AR.js 或 MindAR）做一副六张的标记卡牌，每张卡对应一只 3D 小生物；两张卡靠在一起时，在中间生成第三只；变体：让同学交换卡牌，小生物就在不同桌子之间“旅行”。

video.video_title: 3D CyberCode 1996 (the origin of PS3 Eye of Judgment)

works.title: De Groene Kathedraal (The Green Cathedral)
works.description: In Almere, Flevoland, 178 Lombardy poplars are planted along the ground plan of Reims Cathedral, so the trees form the columns and nave of a living church; beside it, a clearing in the forest shows the same plan as a void.
works.description_zh: 在弗莱福兰省阿尔默勒，178 棵伦巴第杨树按照兰斯大教堂的平面图种植，树木构成一座活教堂的立柱与中殿；旁边的森林中还有一片以同样平面图留出的空地。
works.idea_en: An invisible building drawn with trees is exactly an architectural overlay on land, and its 'negative' twin shows the same plan by subtraction.
works.idea_zh: 用树“画”出的看不见的建筑，正是土地上的建筑叠加，而它的“负片”双胞胎用减法呈现同一平面。
works.technique: Trees were planted at the positions of the cathedral's columns; a nearby grove was cut to leave the same plan open.
works.technique_zh: 在教堂立柱的位置种下树木；附近一片树林被伐出同样的平面。
works.exercise_en: Take the floor plan of a famous building and place its columns as AR trees at 1:1 scale on a field. Twist: toggle between 'trees as columns' and 'empty plan cut from a forest'.
works.exercise_zh: 取一座著名建筑的平面图，把它的立柱以 1:1 比例作为 AR 树种在操场上；变体：在“树作立柱”与“从森林中切出的空平面”两种模式间切换。

video.video_title: Marinus Boezem over De Groene Kathedraal

works.title: Feral Fount
works.description: A spinning 3D zoetrope in which sculpted drops fall from a tap and transform into other forms, animated in real space by a synchronised strobe.
works.description_zh: 一个旋转的立体走马灯，雕塑的水滴从水龙头落下并变成别的形体，在同步频闪下于真实空间中动起来。
works.idea_en: Physical morphing in front of your eyes is more uncanny than screen animation; AR transformations of real objects can aim for the same dream logic.
works.idea_zh: 在眼前发生的实体变形比屏幕动画更诡异；AR 对真实物体的变形也可以追求同样的梦境逻辑。
works.technique: Dozens of sculpted stages of a transformation are mounted around a rotating armature; a strobe flashes once per stage so the eye fuses them into continuous motion.
works.technique_zh: 一个变形过程的几十个阶段被雕塑出来装在旋转支架上，频闪灯每到一个阶段闪一次，眼睛便把它们融合成连续的运动。
works.exercise_en: Model eight stages of a real object turning into something else, place them around a virtual turntable next to the real object, and flash one at a time. Twist: start the morph only when the viewer touches the real object.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个真实物体变成别的东西建模八个阶段，把它们排在该物体旁的虚拟转盘上，一次只闪现一个。变体：只有观众触摸真实物体时才开始变形。

video.video_title: Gregory Barsamian, Feral Fount

works.title: Music Plays Images x Images Play Music (with Ryuichi Sakamoto)
works.description: Ryuichi Sakamoto plays a self-playing grand piano while images projected onto a scrim above the keys both respond to and trigger the notes, so music and image perform together.
works.description_zh: 坂本龙一弹奏一台自动钢琴，投影在琴键上方纱幕上的影像既回应音符又触发音符，音乐与影像同台演出。
works.idea_en: Placing imagery exactly over the source of sound fuses the two senses; AR music visuals work best when they sit on the instrument itself.
works.idea_zh: 把影像精确放在声音来源的上方，会让两种感官融为一体；AR 音乐视觉最好直接附着在乐器本身。
works.technique: MIDI from the Disklavier piano drives projected graphics, and graphic events can send MIDI back to make the piano's keys move by themselves (Prix Ars Electronica Golden Nica 1997).
works.technique_zh: Disklavier 钢琴发出的 MIDI 驱动投影图形，图形事件也可以回传 MIDI，让钢琴琴键自己动起来（获 1997 年 Prix Ars Electronica 金尼卡奖）。
works.exercise_en: Track a real keyboard with image tracking and spawn AR particles above each key from Web MIDI input. Twist: let particles that fall back onto a key play that note.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪识别一台真实键盘，通过 Web MIDI 输入在每个琴键上方生成 AR 粒子。变体：粒子落回琴键时，演奏那个音。

video.video_title: Music Plays Images x Images Play Music / Toshio Iwai, Ryuichi Sakamoto; Ars Electronica1997

works.title: Remembrance Agent
works.description: In a 1996 interview with Alan Alda, Starner types notes on a one-handed keyboard while his head-up display quietly shows one-line summaries of old files that relate to what is being said.
works.description_zh: 在 1996 年接受 Alan Alda 采访时，Starner 一边用单手键盘记笔记，一边在抬头显示器上悄悄看到与当下对话相关的旧文件的一行摘要。
works.idea_en: A just-in-time memory: the wearable listens to what you are doing and surfaces your own past notes without being asked.
works.idea_zh: 即时记忆：可穿戴设备根据你正在做的事，主动浮现你自己过去的笔记。
works.technique: A background process continuously runs text similarity search over the user's files against the last few typed lines and displays the best matches at the bottom of the HUD.
works.technique_zh: 后台进程不断用最近输入的几行文字，对用户的文件做文本相似度检索，并把最匹配的结果显示在抬头显示器底部。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone overlay that listens to speech, transcribes keywords and shows one matching line from a class notes file. Twist: allow only one suggestion per minute so it stays unobtrusive.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机叠加层：监听语音、提取关键词，并从课堂笔记文件中显示一条匹配的内容。变体：每分钟最多只显示一条建议，保持不打扰。

video.video_title: Wearable Computing:  Remembrance Agent and Privacy

works.title: Tornado
works.description: A column of fog twists into a tall, stable vortex inside a frame; visitors can put their hands into it and watch the tornado bend and reform.
works.description_zh: 一根雾柱在框架内扭成高而稳定的漩涡；观众可以把手伸进去，看着龙卷风弯折又复原。
works.idea_en: Fog is a way to see flow; AR can use particles in the same way to show otherwise invisible currents, and invite the hand to disturb them.
works.idea_zh: 雾是看见流动的方法；AR 也可以用粒子展示原本看不见的气流，并邀请人用手去扰动它。
works.technique: Fans on top pull air upward while angled vents add rotation, and a fog machine seeds the flow so the vortex becomes visible (year approximate; Kahn has built tornados since the 1980s).
works.technique_zh: 顶部风扇向上抽气，倾斜的风口带来旋转，雾机向气流中注入雾气使漩涡显形（年份为估计；Kahn 自 1980 年代起就在制作龙卷风装置）。
works.exercise_en: Spawn a particle vortex on a real table in phone AR and let hand tracking push the particles away. Twist: let the vortex slowly drift toward the loudest sound in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 在真桌上生成一个粒子漩涡，并用手部追踪把粒子推开。变体：让漩涡慢慢漂向房间里最响的声音。

video.video_title: Tornado

works.title: TransVision
works.description: Several people around a table each hold a small palmtop display and see the same virtual 3D model sitting on the real table, so they can discuss and point at it together.
works.description_zh: 几个人围坐在桌边，各自拿着一块掌上屏幕，都能看到桌上“放着”同一个虚拟 3D 模型，于是可以一起讨论、一起指点。
works.idea_en: Shared handheld AR: many small windows onto one virtual object in the middle of a real table.
works.idea_zh: 共享手持 AR：多扇小窗口同时看向真实桌面中央的同一个虚拟物体。
works.technique: Each palmtop is a video see-through display whose position is tracked (likely by magnetic sensors), and a shared scene graph keeps the model in the same place for every viewer.
works.technique_zh: 每块掌上屏都是视频透视显示器，其位置被追踪（很可能使用电磁传感器），共享场景图保证每个观看者看到的模型位置一致。
works.exercise_en: Build a two-phone shared AR scene (for example with an image target or a shared anchor) where both players see the same virtual building on a desk and can move one block each. Twist: give each phone a different 'lens' that shows a different layer of the same object.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个两部手机共享的 AR 场景（可用图像目标或共享锚点），两人都能在桌上看到同一栋虚拟建筑，并各自移动一块积木；变体：给每部手机一个不同的“镜头”，分别看到同一物体的不同层次。

video.video_title: TransVision: Shared Hand-held Augmented Reality (1996)

works.title: Tree Mountain – A Living Time Capsule
works.description: In Ylöjärvi, Finland, 11,000 fir trees were planted by 11,000 people on a man-made mountain in a pattern derived from the golden ratio; each planter was given custodianship of a tree for 400 years.
works.description_zh: 在芬兰伊勒耶尔维，11000 人在一座人造山上按照源自黄金比例的图案种下 11000 棵冷杉；每位种树者都被授予一棵树 400 年的监护权。
works.idea_en: One person, one tree, one position in a pattern: a shared artwork that lasts centuries, a model for persistent multi-user AR.
works.idea_zh: 一人、一树、图案中的一个位置：一件延续数百年的共享作品，是持久多人 AR 的范本。
works.technique: Tree positions follow a spiral pattern inspired by pineapple and sunflower phyllotaxis, laid out on a reshaped gravel pit.
works.technique_zh: 树木位置依照受菠萝和向日葵叶序启发的螺旋图案，布置在重新塑形的砾石坑上。
works.exercise_en: Lay out a Fibonacci spiral of AR saplings on a lawn and let each classmate claim one with their name, stored in a shared database. Twist: saplings grow only on days their owner visits.
works.exercise_zh: 在草坪上按斐波那契螺旋布置 AR 树苗，让每位同学认领一棵并写上名字，存入共享数据库；变体：树苗只在主人到访的那天生长。

video.video_title: A Gift to the Future: Tree Mountain by Agnes Denes | IN THE WORKS | THE SHED

works.title: WearComp and the Wearable Wireless Webcam
works.description: A 1996 TV report follows Mann around MIT wearing a head-mounted display and camera wired to a backpack computer that streams what he sees to the web and overlays text in front of his eye.
works.description_zh: 1996 年的电视报道跟随 Mann 走在 MIT 校园里：他戴着头戴显示器和摄像头，连着背包电脑，把眼前所见实时传到网上，同时在眼前叠加文字信息。
works.idea_en: Wear the computer all day so that seeing, recording and sharing become one continuous act.
works.idea_zh: 把电脑穿在身上一整天，让“看见、记录、分享”变成同一个连续的动作。
works.technique: A self-built backpack computer drives a head-mounted display and a head-mounted camera, with a radio link uploading frames to a web page in near real time.
works.technique_zh: 自制的背包电脑驱动头戴显示器和头戴摄像头，通过无线电链路把画面近乎实时地上传到网页。
works.exercise_en: Wear a phone on a head strap for one hour and live-stream only what you look at to a shared page for classmates. Twist: let viewers send one-word messages that appear in your view.
works.exercise_zh: 用头带把手机固定在头上，戴一小时，只把你看着的画面直播到同学共享的页面。变体：让观众发送一个词的消息，显示在你的视野里。

video.video_title: From 1996: Meet the man who invented a wearable computer

works.title: Be Now Here
works.description: Visitors wear 3D glasses and stand on a 16-foot rotating floor in front of a stereoscopic projection of public plazas in endangered World Heritage cities such as Jerusalem, Dubrovnik, Timbuktu and Angkor. As the floor turns, the panorama turns with them, as if the place were live.
works.description_zh: 观众戴上 3D 眼镜，站在一块直径约 5 米的旋转地板上，面对耶路撒冷、杜布罗夫尼克、廷巴克图、吴哥等濒危世界遗产城市广场的立体投影。地板转动时，全景也随之转动，仿佛那个地方正在实时发生。
works.idea_en: Moving the viewer's body with the image (the rotating floor) creates a strong sense of place, a reminder that AR presence comes from the body, not only the eyes.
works.idea_zh: 让观众的身体随影像一起移动（旋转地板），会产生强烈的在地感——提醒我们 AR 的临场感来自身体，而不只是眼睛。
works.technique: Two 35mm cameras on a rotating tripod shot stereo panoramas; in the installation a stereoscopic projector and four-channel audio are synchronized with a rotating platform, and a pedestal lets visitors choose place and time.
works.technique_zh: 两台装在旋转三脚架上的 35mm 摄影机拍下立体全景；装置里，立体投影和四声道音频与旋转平台同步，观众可以在一个立柱控制台上选择地点和时间。
works.exercise_en: Capture a 360° photo of a campus plaza, open it in WebXR as a portal, and let classmates enter it while standing on an office chair that someone slowly turns in sync with the panorama. Twist: offer two times of day and let the viewer switch by stepping forward.
works.exercise_zh: 拍一张校园广场的 360° 照片，在 WebXR 里做成传送门，让同学坐在一把转椅上进入，由另一人按全景的节奏慢慢转动椅子；变体：提供同一地点的两个时段，观众向前迈一步就切换。

video.video_title: "BE NOW HERE" by Michael Naimark

works.title: Colors
works.description: A projected face animates a soft fabric figure, which talks obsessively about colours in Oursler's hypnotic, anxious style. The piece in the Margulies Collection in Miami runs for about an hour, as if the figure never stops thinking aloud.
works.description_zh: 一张投影出来的脸让一个柔软的布制人形活了过来，它以 Oursler 特有的催眠而焦虑的语气不停谈论各种颜色。这件收藏于迈阿密 Margulies Collection 的作品长约一小时，好像这个人形永远在自言自语。
works.idea_en: A long, looping monologue gives a projected character a mind; in AR, voice and persistence can matter more than animation quality.
works.idea_zh: 一段长长的、循环的独白让投影角色有了心智；在 AR 里，声音和持续存在感可能比动画质量更重要。
works.technique: A single video projector aimed at a stuffed form displays a recorded face performance with sound, the projector hidden so only the lit head is noticed.
works.technique_zh: 一台投影机对准填充人形，播放带声音的面部表演录像，投影机被藏起来，观众只注意到被照亮的头。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR character that is just a face on a sphere and let it speak one sentence per colour it sees, sampling the camera feed. Twist: it becomes more anxious when the room is dim.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 做一个角色：球体上的一张脸，从相机画面中采样颜色，每看到一种颜色就说一句话；变体：房间越暗，它越焦虑。

video.video_title: Tony Oursler: Colors (1995) / The Margulies Collection at the Warehouse

works.title: NaviCam
works.description: A palmtop screen with a small camera is held up to the world; when it sees color-coded ID tags on shelves or doors it overlays context information on the live video, like a magnifying glass for hidden data.
works.description_zh: 把带小摄像头的掌上屏幕举向周围环境，一旦看到书架或门上的彩色 ID 标签，就在实时画面上叠加相关信息，像一把能看见隐藏数据的放大镜。
works.idea_en: Hold a screen up to the world and it reveals the information attached to things.
works.idea_zh: 把屏幕举向世界，它就显示出物体身上“附着”的信息。
works.technique: A camera tethered to a workstation recognizes printed color-code tags in the video stream and draws text labels next to them on a handheld LCD (video see-through).
works.technique_zh: 摄像头画面传给工作站识别打印的彩色编码标签，再把文字标签绘制在手持液晶屏的实时视频上（视频透视式 AR）。
works.exercise_en: Print five ArUco markers, stick them on classroom objects and build a phone web page that shows a different 'secret note' next to each marker when the camera sees it. Twist: make the note change depending on how close the phone is to the marker.
works.exercise_zh: 打印五个 ArUco 标记贴在教室物品上，做一个手机网页：摄像头看到哪个标记，就在旁边显示一条对应的“秘密便签”；变体：让便签内容随手机与标记的距离远近而变化。

video.video_title: NaviCam hand held AR system (1994-1995)

works.title: Solar Rotary
works.description: At the University of South Florida, a ring with a circular hole on tall poles casts a spot of light that, on specific dates, falls on plaques marking events in local history; on the summer solstice it lands on a central seat.
works.description_zh: 在南佛罗里达大学，高杆上一个带圆孔的环投下一个光斑，在特定日期落在记录当地历史事件的铭牌上；夏至正午时它会落在中央的座椅上。
works.idea_en: Using the sun as a pointer that visits dated plaques turns a plaza into a calendar, a direct model for time-based AR annotations.
works.idea_zh: 把太阳当作指针，按日期依次照亮铭牌，把广场变成日历，这是基于时间的 AR 标注的直接范本。
works.technique: The aperture's position was calculated so the sun spot's path hits each plaque on its anniversary date.
works.technique_zh: 开孔位置经过计算，使光斑的轨迹在每个纪念日恰好照到对应铭牌。
works.exercise_en: Compute where the midday sun spot from a real opening (a window, a gate) falls through the year and pin AR notes on those floor points with the dates of campus events. Twist: the notes light up only when the real sun spot touches them.
works.exercise_zh: 计算一年中正午阳光穿过真实开口（窗户、门洞）后光斑落在地面的位置，在这些点上钉上标注校园事件日期的 AR 便签；变体：只有真实光斑触及时便签才会亮起。

video.video_title: Nancy Holt, Solar Rotary, Summer Solstice, June 21, 2019. time-lapse video by Chien Quoc Truong.

works.title: Watch
works.description: Two projections of a street: one shows only what moves (still things disappear), the other shows only what stays still (moving people blur into ghosts).
works.description_zh: 同一条街道的两个投影：一个只显示在动的东西（静止的消失了），另一个只显示静止的东西（走动的人变成模糊的幽灵）。
works.idea_en: Splitting a live view into 'what moves' and 'what stays' is a simple filter that reveals time; AR reality filters can do this on the camera feed.
works.idea_zh: 把实时画面分成“动的”和“不动的”，是一个能揭示时间的简单滤镜；AR 现实滤镜可以直接对摄像头画面这样做。
works.technique: Real-time video processing uses frame differencing for the motion image and a long running average for the stillness image.
works.technique_zh: 实时视频处理：用帧差得到运动图像，用长时间的滑动平均得到静止图像。
works.exercise_en: Write a camera shader with two modes — frame difference (only motion) and long-exposure average (only stillness) — and toggle it by tilting the phone. Twist: mix them so moving people leave colour while the city stays grey.
works.exercise_zh: 写一个摄像头着色器，有两种模式——帧差（只看运动）和长曝光平均（只看静止）——通过倾斜手机切换。变体：把两者混合，让走动的人留下颜色，城市保持灰色。

video.video_title: Watch (1995/2003) by David Rokeby

works.title: Wrapped Reichstag
works.description: After 24 years of lobbying, the German parliament building in Berlin was wrapped in silver fabric and blue rope for two weeks, drawing about five million visitors.
works.description_zh: 经过 24 年的游说，柏林的德国国会大厦被银色织物和蓝色绳索包裹两周，吸引了约五百万名观众。
works.idea_en: Hiding a loaded symbol makes people look at it again; an AR 'wrap' filter on a monument can do the same.
works.idea_zh: 把一个意义沉重的象征隐藏起来，反而让人们重新审视它；在纪念建筑上做 AR“包裹”滤镜也能达到同样效果。
works.technique: About 100,000 square metres of fabric and 15.6 kilometres of rope were fitted over steel frames that protected the building's sculptures.
works.technique_zh: 约十万平方米的织物和 15.6 公里的绳索覆盖在保护建筑雕塑的钢框架上。
works.exercise_en: Use Lens Studio City Landmarker or a scanned building model to wrap a famous local building in silver cloth in AR. Twist: let people pull the rope to unwrap it together.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 的城市地标模板或扫描的建筑模型，在 AR 中给当地一座著名建筑包上银色布料；变体：让大家一起拉动绳索把它解开。

video.video_title: Christo and Jeanne-Claude Wrap Up the Reichstag | Lost Art

works.title: Electronic effigies (talking dummies)
works.description: Small cloth dolls and dummies lie slumped on the floor or pinned under furniture, but each has a real human face projected onto its blank head that talks, complains or pleads with visitors. The SFMOMA video shows how these 'electronic effigies' sit between sculpture and media.
works.description_zh: 小小的布偶和人形软包瘫在地上或被家具压着，但每个空白的头上都投着一张真人的脸，对观众说话、抱怨或哀求。SFMOMA 的这段影片展示了这些“电子偶像”如何处在雕塑与媒体之间。
works.idea_en: A face projected onto the plainest object is enough to create a character with a point of view; AR characters do not need detailed bodies to feel present.
works.idea_zh: 把一张脸投到最简单的物体上，就足以造出一个有立场的角色；AR 角色不需要精细的身体也能有存在感。
works.technique: Small LCD video projectors throw recorded close-ups of actors' faces onto white cloth heads, positioned so the face wraps the curved surface.
works.technique_zh: 小型 LCD 投影机把演员脸部特写的录像投到白色布制头部上，调整位置让脸贴合曲面。
works.exercise_en: Record a 20-second talking face on a phone, then use Lens Studio or AR Foundation to paste it onto a real object such as a pillow or mug, masked to its shape. Twist: the face only talks when nobody is looking at it directly, and goes silent when the phone points straight at it.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机录一段 20 秒的说话脸，再用 Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation 把它贴到枕头或杯子这类真实物体上，按物体形状做遮罩；变体：只有没人正视它时脸才说话，手机直接对准它就安静下来。

video.video_title: Tony Oursler's "electronic effigies”: Between two spaces

works.title: Grand Hôtel des Étrangers
works.description: In a cramped hotel room a lone man, played by a live actor, meets virtual characters projected around him, and memories, dreams and the present blur together. It is one of 4D Art's first full plays built on the meeting of real and projected performers.
works.description_zh: 在一个狭小的旅馆房间里，一个孤独的男人（由真人演员扮演）遇见投射在他周围的虚拟人物，记忆、梦境与当下交织在一起。这是 4D Art 最早以真人与投影演员相遇为核心的完整剧作之一。
works.idea_en: A single room shared by one real body and several projected ones is the basic unit of mixed-reality drama.
works.idea_zh: 一个真人和几个投影人物共处一室，就是混合现实戏剧的基本单元。
works.technique: Pre-filmed actors are projected at life size onto transparent or gauze screens placed in the set, and the live actor times his movements to the recorded ones (likely rehearsed to a fixed video track).
works.technique_zh: 预先拍好的演员以真人大小投射到布景中的透明幕或纱幕上，真人演员按录像的节奏配合动作（很可能按固定的视频轨排练）。
works.exercise_en: Film a classmate saying five lines, then place the clip as a life-size, background-removed video in AR (Lens Studio or AR Foundation) in a real corner, and perform a live dialogue with it. Twist: the recorded partner sometimes answers before the live actor speaks.
works.exercise_zh: 拍一位同学说五句台词，把视频去掉背景后以真人大小放进 AR（Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation）中的一个真实角落，和它进行一场现场对话；变体：录像中的搭档有时会在真人开口前就抢先回答。

video.video_title: Lemieux Pilon 4D Art - Grand Hôtel des Étrangers (1994)

works.title: In Plane
works.description: A duet between dancer Dawn Stoppiello and her video double: sensors on her joints let her control the music, recall video images, change the lighting and slide a robotic projector along the stage.
works.description_zh: 舞者 Dawn Stoppiello 与自己的影像分身之间的双人舞：她关节上的传感器让她能控制音乐、调出影像、改变灯光，并让一台机器人投影仪沿舞台滑动。
works.idea_en: The dancer's joints are the mixing desk for the whole stage.
works.idea_zh: 舞者的关节就是整个舞台的调音台。
works.technique: The MidiDancer suit has eight flex sensors at elbows, wrists, hips and knees that send MIDI wirelessly to a computer controlling sound, LaserDisc video playback and a projector on a track.
works.technique_zh: MidiDancer 舞衣在肘、腕、髋、膝装有八个弯曲传感器，把 MIDI 信号无线发送给计算机，控制声音、LaserDisc 影像播放和轨道上的投影仪。
works.exercise_en: Tape a phone to a forearm, read its accelerometer in a web page, and map arm bend to video playback speed and a light's brightness. Twist: the video plays backwards when the arm moves away from the body.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机绑在前臂上，在网页中读取加速度计，把手臂弯曲程度映射到视频播放速度和灯光亮度；变体：手臂远离身体时，视频倒放。

video.video_title: In Plane, The Walker Art Center premier 1994

works.title: Le Cyclop
works.description: A 22.5 m walk-in head built in the forest of Milly-la-Forêt by Tinguely, Niki de Saint Phalle and friends over 25 years, with a mirrored face, moving machines and a ball run inside.
works.description_zh: Tinguely、Niki de Saint Phalle 和朋友们花了 25 年，在米伊拉福雷的森林里建起的 22.5 米高、可以走进去的巨大头像，脸部镶满镜片，内部有运转的机器和滚球轨道。
works.idea_en: A monumental object hidden in a forest that you enter becomes a destination; AR can hide large walk-in worlds at specific sites that reward the journey.
works.idea_zh: 藏在森林里、可以走进去的巨型物体本身就成了目的地；AR 也可以在特定地点藏入可走进的大型世界，让到达的旅程变得值得。
works.technique: A steel structure clad in mirror mosaic houses dozens of scrap-metal machines, a rolling-ball circuit and artworks by other artists; it was built by hand from 1969 to 1994.
works.technique_zh: 镜面马赛克包裹的钢结构内部容纳几十台废金属机器、滚球轨道和其他艺术家的作品，于 1969 至 1994 年间手工建造。
works.exercise_en: Place a giant walk-in AR head in a real park using geospatial anchors, with a portal mouth leading into a small kinetic interior. Twist: let each visitor add one moving part that stays for the next visitor.
works.exercise_zh: 用地理空间锚点在真实公园放置一个可以走进去的巨型 AR 头像，它的嘴是通往小型动态内部空间的传送门。变体：让每位访客添加一个运动部件，并留给下一个访客。

video.video_title: Au cœur de la forêt, les mille et une surprises du Cyclop de Jean Tinguely

works.title: Lovers (Teiji Furuhashi)
works.description: In a dark square room, life-size naked figures are projected onto the four walls; they walk, run, turn toward the visitor and embrace, and some respond to the visitor's presence. Text such as 'Love is everywhere' drifts across them.
works.description_zh: 在一个黑暗的方形房间里，真人大小的裸体人物被投影在四面墙上；他们行走、奔跑、转身面向观众、相拥，部分人物会对观众的出现作出反应。“Love is everywhere”之类的文字从他们身上飘过。
works.idea_en: Life-size figures that walk around you on the walls make a room feel inhabited; scale and eye contact matter more than realism when placing virtual people.
works.idea_zh: 在墙上绕着你走动的真人大小人物，让房间有了“住户”；放置虚拟人物时，尺寸和目光接触比写实更重要。
works.technique: Computer-controlled video projectors on a rotating central unit move the projected figures around the four walls, with sensors that likely trigger some figures to approach the visitor.
works.technique_zh: 中央旋转装置上的电脑控制投影机让人物影像在四面墙之间移动，传感器（推测）会触发部分人物走向观众。
works.exercise_en: Capture three classmates walking in a volumetric or green-screen video, then place them life-size in phone AR so they circle the viewer along the room's walls. Twist: when the viewer looks at one of them, that figure stops and turns to face them.
works.exercise_zh: 用体积视频或绿幕拍三位同学走路，再在手机 AR 里把他们以真人大小放出来，沿着房间墙边绕着观众走；变体：观众看向其中一人时，那个人停下并转身面对观众。

video.video_title: Dumb Type - Lovers

works.title: Upside-Down Goggles
works.description: Visitors put on heavy goggles that flip the world upside down and try to walk, pour or shake hands while their body slowly adapts.
works.description_zh: 观众戴上一副会把世界上下颠倒的沉重护目镜，尝试走路、倒水或握手，身体则慢慢开始适应。
works.idea_en: Perception is trainable: a headset or phone passthrough filter that simply flips or delays the world is already a powerful experience, no content needed.
works.idea_zh: 感知是可以训练的：一个只是把世界翻转或延迟的头显或手机透视滤镜，本身就是强烈的体验，根本不需要额外内容。
works.technique: Prism lenses invert the image on the retina, repeating classic perception experiments by George Stratton in the 1890s.
works.technique_zh: 棱镜镜片把视网膜上的图像倒转，重复了 19 世纪 90 年代 George Stratton 的经典知觉实验。
works.exercise_en: Make an upside-down passthrough in a HoloKit or Cardboard viewer by flipping the camera feed in Unity or WebXR, then time students pouring water. Twist: add a 300 ms delay instead of flipping and compare which is harder.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity 或 WebXR 中把摄像头画面上下翻转，放进 HoloKit 或 Cardboard 头显，给同学计时倒水。变体：不翻转而是加 300 毫秒延迟，比较哪个更难。

video.video_title: Carsten Holler at Hayward Gallery, #1 Upside Down glasses

salient.why_en: Goggles flip the world upside down, and you have to learn to walk and pour again.
salient.why_zh: 戴上护目镜，世界上下颠倒，你得重新学会走路、倒水。

works.title: Beauty
works.description: In a dark room a curtain of fine mist falls from the ceiling and a single spotlight shines through it; a rainbow appears only when you stand at the right angle and shifts as you move.
works.description_zh: 在黑暗的房间里，一道细密的水雾从天花板落下，一盏聚光灯穿过它；只有站在合适的角度才会看到彩虹，而且彩虹随你移动而变化。
works.idea_en: The rainbow exists only between light, droplets and your eye: effects that depend on viewer position are personal, and AR can make every visitor's version different.
works.idea_zh: 彩虹只存在于光、水滴和你的眼睛之间：依赖观者位置的效果是私人的，AR 可以让每位观众看到不同的版本。
works.technique: A perforated hose releases a sheet of droplets, and a lamp placed behind the viewer refracts through them at about 42 degrees, so each eye sees its own bow.
works.technique_zh: 带孔的水管放下一层水滴，灯光从观者身后照来，在约 42 度角处折射，每只眼睛都看到属于自己的彩虹。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR mist curtain in Lens Studio or AR Foundation whose rainbow is computed from the angle between a virtual light and the phone, so it only appears from certain spots. Twist: use two phones side by side to show that each sees a different arc.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation 里做一道 AR 水雾幕，彩虹根据虚拟光源和手机之间的角度计算，只在某些位置出现。变体：两部手机并排，证明它们各自看到不同的弧。

video.video_title: Beauty by Olafur Eliasson

works.title: Field for the British Isles
works.description: About 40,000 small clay figures, each shaped by hand by families in St Helens and pressed with two eye holes, fill a room from wall to wall and all look up at the visitor in the doorway.
works.description_zh: 约四万个小陶土人偶由圣海伦斯的家庭手工捏制，每个都戳出两个眼洞，从墙到墙铺满一个房间，全部抬头望向站在门口的观众。
works.idea_en: Tens of thousands of eyes looking back at you reverse who is watching whom, a strong idea for AR crowds that react to gaze.
works.idea_zh: 成千上万双眼睛回望着你，颠倒了“谁在看谁”，这是会对视线作出反应的 AR 人群的有力创意。
works.technique: Community volunteers each formed figures from a fist-sized lump of clay with two pencil-made eyes; the only rule was that they face the viewer.
works.technique_zh: 社区志愿者每人用拳头大小的泥块捏出人偶，用铅笔戳出两只眼睛；唯一的规则是它们必须面向观者。
works.exercise_en: Ask every student to model one tiny creature in a 3D app and combine them into a crowd of hundreds in AR, all rotating to face the phone. Twist: the crowd only looks at you when you stand still.
works.exercise_zh: 让每位学生用 3D 应用做一个小生物，在 AR 中组合成数百个的群体，全部转向手机；变体：只有当你静止不动时，人群才会看向你。

video.video_title: Antony Gormley: Field for the British Isles

works.title: Neuro-Baby
works.description: A computer-generated baby face on screen listens to the tone of your voice and responds with its own emotional expressions and sounds.
works.description_zh: 屏幕上一张计算机生成的婴儿脸，聆听你说话的语气，并用它自己的表情和声音回应你的情绪。
works.idea_en: A virtual being that responds to how you feel, not what you say.
works.idea_zh: 一个回应你“感受”而非你“说了什么”的虚拟生命。
works.technique: A neural network classifies emotion from the prosody of the user's voice and drives the facial animation of a 3D baby character.
works.technique_zh: 神经网络从用户语音的韵律中识别情绪，驱动 3D 婴儿角色的面部动画。
works.exercise_en: Build a character that reacts to voice loudness and pitch (p5.js sound input or Lens Studio audio) with different facial expressions. Twist: it mirrors the opposite emotion.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个根据声音大小和音高做出不同表情的角色（p5.js 声音输入或 Lens Studio 音频）。变体：它表现出相反的情绪。

video.video_title: NAOKO TOSA's Neuro-Baby

works.title: Machine with Concrete
works.description: A motor spins the first gear fast; through a chain of twelve 1:50 gear reductions the last gear is embedded in a block of concrete, since it would take over two trillion years to turn once.
works.description_zh: 电机让第一个齿轮飞快转动；经过十二级 1:50 的减速，最后一个齿轮被浇进一块混凝土里，因为它转一圈需要超过两万亿年。
works.idea_en: Motion can be made to disappear into deep time; an AR piece can show a process whose end lies far beyond a human life.
works.idea_zh: 运动可以消失在深远的时间里；AR 作品可以展示一个终点远超人类寿命的过程。
works.technique: Twelve worm-style reductions of 50:1 each multiply to 50^12, so the output speed is effectively zero and the concrete never feels it.
works.technique_zh: 十二级 50:1 减速相乘得到 50 的 12 次方，输出转速几乎为零，混凝土永远感觉不到它。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a virtual gear train to a real wall in AR that ends inside a real object, with each gear's real speed computed and displayed. Twist: display how many years until the last gear completes one turn, counting down live.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一串虚拟齿轮锚定在真墙上，最后一个齿轮“卡进”一个真实物体，按真实比例计算并显示每个齿轮的转速。变体：实时倒计时最后一个齿轮转完一圈还需要多少年。

video.video_title: Machine with Concrete - Arthur Ganson

works.title: Puppy
works.description: A 12-metre West Highland terrier covered in tens of thousands of living flowering plants guards the entrance of the Guggenheim Museum Bilbao; the flowers are replanted twice a year.
works.description_zh: 一只高 12 米、覆满数万株活开花植物的西高地白㹴守在毕尔巴鄂古根海姆美术馆的入口；花卉每年更换两次。
works.idea_en: A giant cute figure with a living, changing skin shows how an AR object's surface can follow seasons.
works.idea_zh: 一个表皮有生命且会变化的巨大可爱形象，说明 AR 物体的表面可以跟随季节。
works.technique: A steel armature holds soil and an internal irrigation system; flowers are planted in pockets over its surface.
works.technique_zh: 钢骨架承载土壤和内部灌溉系统；花卉种植在表面的种植袋中。
works.exercise_en: Place a giant AR animal on a plaza whose surface is covered with flowers that change by month using a seasonal flower list. Twist: users can plant a flower on it and see it grow over the week.
works.exercise_zh: 在广场上放一只巨型 AR 动物，其表面覆盖的花卉按照季节花卉列表逐月变化；变体：用户可以在它身上种一朵花，并在一周内看着它长大。

video.video_title: Jeff Koons's Puppy at the Guggenheim Museum

works.title: Surface Tension
works.description: A giant projected human eye on a wall follows the viewer wherever they move in the room.
works.description_zh: 墙上投影出一只巨大的人眼，无论观众走到房间哪里，它都跟着看。
works.idea_en: Being watched back by an image is one of the strongest ways to make a virtual thing feel present — AR characters that track the user's position use the same trick.
works.idea_zh: 被一幅图像反过来注视，是让虚拟之物显得“在场”的最强方式之一——会追随用户位置的 AR 角色用的正是这个技巧。
works.technique: A camera tracking system estimates the viewer's position and selects or interpolates pre-recorded video of an eye looking in that direction.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪系统估计观众位置，并选取或插值出预先拍好的、朝该方向看的眼睛视频。
works.exercise_en: Place a large AR eye on a real wall that rotates to look at the phone's position, and blinks when the user looks directly at it. Twist: add a second eye that only follows other people.
works.exercise_zh: 在一面真实墙上放一只大大的 AR 眼睛，它转向手机所在的位置，用户直视它时它会眨眼。变体：加第二只眼睛，只追随别人。

video.video_title: Surface Tension

salient.why_en: A giant eye on the wall follows you wherever you move.
salient.why_zh: 墙上一只巨大的眼睛，你走到哪里它就盯到哪里。

works.title: Zerseher / De-viewer
works.description: A framed Renaissance painting hangs on a wall; wherever the viewer looks, an eye tracker makes that part of the picture smear and dissolve.
works.description_zh: 墙上挂着一幅文艺复兴时期的画作；观众看向哪里，眼动追踪就让画面那一处涂抹、溶解。
works.idea_en: The act of looking can destroy what you look at — gaze is a powerful and underused input for headset AR.
works.idea_zh: “看”这个动作本身就能摧毁被看的东西——注视是头显 AR 中强大却少用的输入。
works.technique: A hidden camera tracks the viewer's eyes and maps the gaze point onto the digitized painting, where a displacement brush distorts pixels over time.
works.technique_zh: 隐藏摄像头追踪观众的眼睛，把注视点映射到数字化的画作上，由位移笔刷随时间扭曲像素。
works.exercise_en: Overlay a famous painting on a real wall with a headset or HoloKit and melt the pixels where the user's head direction points. Twist: make the painting slowly heal when nobody looks at it.
works.exercise_zh: 用头显或 HoloKit 把一幅名画叠加在真实墙面上，让用户头部朝向处的像素融化。变体：没人看时让画面慢慢复原。

video.video_title: Zerseher / De-viewer, 1992

salient.why_en: Wherever you look at the painting, your gaze smears it away.
salient.why_zh: 你的目光落在画上哪里，哪里就被抹花、溶解。

works.title: Margot's Cat
works.description: A tiny chair is repeatedly flung upward and caught by a delicate wire mechanism, so it seems to leap and land again like a playful cat.
works.description_zh: 一把小椅子被纤细的铁丝机构一次次抛起又接住，像一只贪玩的猫一样跳起、落下。
works.idea_en: Timing and anticipation make inanimate objects feel intentional; AR animations should borrow the rhythm of a real creature rather than smooth tweens (year approximate).
works.idea_zh: 时机与预备动作让无生命的物件显得有意图；AR 动画应借用真实生物的节奏，而不是平滑的补间（年份为估计）。
works.technique: A cam-driven arm stores and releases energy, launching the chair in a ballistic arc before a second arm catches it, repeated as a loop.
works.technique_zh: 由凸轮驱动的摆臂蓄能后释放，把椅子沿抛物线弹出，再由另一只摆臂接住，如此循环。
works.exercise_en: Make a small virtual chair on a real desk jump along a physics arc every few seconds in phone AR, with squash-and-stretch on landing. Twist: let it jump only when the viewer looks away.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中让真桌上的一把虚拟小椅子每隔几秒沿物理抛物线跳一次，落地时加挤压拉伸。变体：只有观众移开视线时它才跳。

video.video_title: Margot's Cat - Arthur Ganson

works.title: The Giver of Names
works.description: Visitors place any object on a pedestal; a computer looks at it with a camera and speaks aloud a strange, poetic sentence about what it thinks it sees.
works.description_zh: 观众把任何物品放在一个底座上；电脑用摄像头看着它，大声说出一句关于它“看到”了什么的奇怪而诗意的句子。
works.idea_en: A machine that names objects badly but beautifully shows how recognition can be poetic; AR object labels do not have to be literal.
works.idea_zh: 一台把物体命名得不准确却很美的机器，说明识别也可以是诗意的；AR 物体标签不必只做字面描述。
works.technique: The camera image is analysed for colour, shape and texture, and these features are fed into a network of word associations that generates grammatical sentences.
works.technique_zh: 系统分析摄像画面的颜色、形状和纹理，把这些特征输入一个词语联想网络，生成合乎语法的句子。
works.exercise_en: Point a phone at objects on a table and use an image-recognition model plus a language model to float a short poem above each item in AR. Twist: force the poem to avoid the object's real name.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机对准桌上的物品，用图像识别模型加语言模型，在 AR 中为每件物品上方漂浮一首短诗。变体：强制诗里不能出现物品的真实名称。

video.video_title: The Giver of Names (1991-) by David Rokeby

works.title: The Umbrellas, Japan–USA
works.description: 1,340 blue umbrellas opened in a valley in Ibaraki, Japan, and 1,760 yellow umbrellas in the hills north of Los Angeles at the same time, each six metres tall.
works.description_zh: 1340 把蓝色大伞在日本茨城县的山谷中、1760 把黄色大伞在洛杉矶以北的丘陵中同时撑开，每把高六米。
works.idea_en: Two simultaneous sites in two countries, one colour each, show how a shared event can link distant places, a model for synchronous multi-site AR.
works.idea_zh: 两个国家的两处场地同时展开，各用一种颜色，展示了共享事件如何连接遥远的地方，是同步多地点 AR 的范本。
works.technique: Steel-framed umbrellas were set in bases across private and public land and opened on the same morning in both countries.
works.technique_zh: 钢骨大伞安放在私人和公共土地上的底座中，并在两国的同一个早晨同时撑开。
works.exercise_en: Build a shared AR session (Niantic Lightship or Photon) where students in two classrooms each place coloured umbrellas and see the other room's umbrellas appear as a mirrored layer. Twist: umbrellas only open when both sites are online.
works.exercise_zh: 搭建一个共享 AR 会话（Niantic Lightship 或 Photon），让两个教室的学生各自放置彩色伞，并以镜像图层看到对方房间的伞出现；变体：只有两个地点都在线时伞才会撑开。

video.video_title: The Umbrellas | A Lasting Legacy of Christo’s Land Art

works.title: Concert for Anarchy
works.description: A grand piano hangs upside down from the ceiling; every few minutes its keyboard bursts out and its keys spill forward with a jarring chord before it slowly closes again.
works.description_zh: 一架三角钢琴倒挂在天花板上；每隔几分钟，琴键突然弹出、发出刺耳的和弦，然后又慢慢收回。
works.idea_en: Hanging a familiar object upside down and letting it erupt on a timer turns a museum room into suspense; AR objects gain drama from long stillness and sudden, rare events.
works.idea_zh: 把熟悉的物体倒挂并让它定时“爆发”，让展厅充满悬念；AR 物体也能从长时间的静止和突然、稀少的事件中获得戏剧性。
works.technique: Motors push the keyboard and keys outward and retract them on a cycle, while the inverted suspension makes an ordinary instrument feel unstable and alive.
works.technique_zh: 电机按周期把键盘和琴键推出再收回，倒挂的方式让普通乐器显得不稳定而有生命。
works.exercise_en: Anchor an upside-down virtual piano (or other furniture) to the real ceiling with ARKit or WebXR plane detection and make it burst open with sound at random intervals. Twist: make it erupt only when nobody is looking at it (use camera direction).
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit 或 WebXR 平面识别把一架倒置的虚拟钢琴（或其他家具）固定在真实天花板上，让它在随机时间伴随声音“爆开”。变体：只有当没人看它（根据相机朝向判断）时它才爆发。

video.video_title: CONCERT FOR ANARCHY REBECCA HORN - 720p - Sound by WS

works.title: Grass photographs
works.description: Ackroyd & Harvey grow grass on vertical walls and project a photographic negative onto it; where more light falls, the grass makes more chlorophyll, so a portrait appears in shades of green and yellow.
works.description_zh: Ackroyd & Harvey 在竖直墙面上种草，并把照片底片投射到草上；光照越多的地方，草产生的叶绿素越多，于是一幅由绿黄深浅构成的肖像便显现出来。
works.idea_en: Light as a slow printer on a living surface shows projection as a biological process, a poetic ancestor of projection AR.
works.idea_zh: 光在活表面上缓慢打印，展示了作为生物过程的投影，是投影 AR 的诗意祖先。
works.technique: Seedling grass grown on a vertical clay surface is exposed for days to a projected negative image, and chlorophyll develops according to light intensity.
works.technique_zh: 在竖直黏土表面上培育的草苗接受数天的负片投影曝光，叶绿素按光强生成。
works.exercise_en: Project a black-and-white portrait onto a tray of cress for a week using a cheap projector, then photograph the result; build an AR version that 'grows' a portrait on a real lawn. Twist: the AR portrait fades when the real weather is cloudy.
works.exercise_zh: 用廉价投影仪把一张黑白肖像投到一盘水芹上一周并拍摄结果；再做一个 AR 版本，在真实草坪上“长”出一幅肖像；变体：当真实天气阴天时，AR 肖像会淡去。

video.video_title: Artists Ackroyd & Harvey Grow Giant Photographs On Living Walls of Grass

works.title: Signaux lumineux (Bassin Takis, La Défense)
works.description: Forty-nine tall flexible steel masts topped with coloured blinking lights stand in a reflecting pool at La Défense, swaying slightly like signals at a railway yard or harbour.
works.description_zh: 49 根高高的柔性钢杆立在拉德芳斯的倒影池中，顶端是闪烁的彩灯，轻轻摇晃，像铁路站场或港口的信号灯。
works.idea_en: Blinking lights at different heights in a field read as a language of signals; AR wayfinding and data layers can borrow this calm, distributed signalling.
works.idea_zh: 不同高度的闪烁灯组成的阵列读起来像一种信号语言；AR 导航和数据层可以借鉴这种平静、分散的信号方式。
works.technique: Tall slender masts flex in the wind while lamps at their tips blink in varied rhythms, doubled by reflections in the water basin.
works.technique_zh: 细高的杆在风中弯曲，顶端的灯以不同节奏闪烁，并在水池中形成倒影。
works.exercise_en: Plant a field of AR signal masts on a real square, each blinking a rhythm tied to live data (bus arrivals, air quality). Twist: let users claim a mast and set its rhythm as a message for friends.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实广场上种一片 AR 信号杆，每根杆以与实时数据（公交到站、空气质量）相关的节奏闪烁。变体：让用户认领一根杆，把它的节奏设成给朋友的信息。

video.video_title: Signaux,  Panayotis Vassilakis Takis, Bassin Takis, La Defense, Paris

works.title: pH
works.description: Performers move on a white floor while a large motorized truss slowly scans back and forth above them, forcing them to duck, jump or lie flat; projected images and lines sweep the floor like a copier or scanner.
works.description_zh: 表演者在白色地面上移动，上方一根巨大的电动桁架缓慢地来回扫过，逼得他们弯腰、跳起或平躺；投影的影像和线条像复印机或扫描仪一样掠过地面。
works.idea_en: A machine that sweeps the space turns people into data being read; AR interfaces can also 'scan' users, and designers can make that sensing visible and physical.
works.idea_zh: 一台扫过空间的机器把人变成被读取的数据；AR 界面同样在“扫描”用户，设计师可以让这种感知变得可见、可被身体感受到。
works.technique: A moving overhead truss carrying lights and projectors travels across the stage on a timed cue sequence, with floor projection and strobes synchronized to the sound.
works.technique_zh: 一根装着灯和投影机的桁架按预设节奏在舞台上方来回移动，地面投影和频闪与声音同步。
works.exercise_en: Make a WebXR or Lens Studio scene where a virtual scanning bar sweeps across the real floor and people must dodge it; detect bodies with segmentation and flash red when they touch it. Twist: whoever is hit gets copied and left behind as a frozen silhouette.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 Lens Studio 做一个场景：一根虚拟扫描条横扫真实地面，人们必须躲开它；用人像分割检测身体，碰到就闪红；变体：被扫到的人会被“复印”下来，留下一个定格的剪影。

video.video_title: Dumb Type - pH

works.title: EAT
works.description: A visitor sits alone at a formally set dinner table and orders from a live waiter; when the plate cover is lifted, the 'food' is a video projected onto the empty plate. A large red button labelled EAT is on the table.
works.description_zh: 观众独自坐在一张正式布置的餐桌前，向一位真人服务员点菜；揭开餐盖时，“食物”是投影在空盘子上的影像。桌上还有一个写着 EAT 的红色大按钮。
works.idea_en: A familiar ritual (ordering, lifting the cloche) frames a virtual object so well that people accept it instantly; AR works best when it borrows an everyday script.
works.idea_zh: 熟悉的仪式（点菜、揭开餐盖）把虚拟物体框得恰到好处，人们立刻就接受了它；AR 借用日常的“剧本”时效果最好。
works.technique: A ceiling video projector aimed at the plate plays clips from a videodisc selected by a Mac II computer according to the order, with a live performer as waiter.
works.technique_zh: 天花板上的投影仪对准盘子，由 Mac II 电脑根据点单从影碟中选出片段播放，并由真人演员扮演服务员。
works.exercise_en: Set a real plate on a table, build a phone AR menu, and place an animated 3D dish on the plate when a paper menu item is tapped with image tracking. Twist: the dish slowly disappears bite by bite each time someone presses a big on-screen EAT button.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌上放一个真盘子，做一个手机 AR 菜单：用图像追踪识别纸质菜单上被点的菜，在盘子上放出一道会动的 3D 菜；变体：每按一次屏幕上的大 EAT 按钮，菜就被“吃掉”一口，慢慢消失。

video.video_title: "EAT," 1989 installation, SF Art Institute

works.title: Two Lines Oblique Gyratory II
works.description: Two long stainless-steel blades balanced on bearings sweep and cross each other slowly in the wind, drawing arcs against the sky.
works.description_zh: 两根细长的不锈钢叶片架在轴承上，在风中缓慢扫动、交错，在天空中划出弧线。
works.idea_en: Two lines moving in wind are enough to animate a whole landscape; AR objects outdoors can be kept minimal and let the environment drive them.
works.idea_zh: 两条在风中运动的线就足以让整片风景动起来；户外 AR 物体可以保持极简，让环境来驱动它们。
works.technique: Counterweighted blades on precision bearings respond to the lightest wind while their geometry keeps the blades from colliding.
works.technique_zh: 带配重的叶片安装在精密轴承上，对最轻的风作出反应，其几何设计避免叶片相撞。
works.exercise_en: Anchor two tall AR blades in an outdoor space and drive their rotation from live wind data (a weather API) or the phone microphone's wind noise. Twist: draw the blade tips' paths as fading lines in the sky.
works.exercise_zh: 在户外空间锚定两根高大的 AR 叶片，用实时风力数据（天气 API）或手机麦克风的风噪驱动它们旋转。变体：把叶片尖端的轨迹画成天空中渐隐的线。

video.video_title: Two Lines Oblique Gyratory II 1989 | George Rickey, Artist

works.title: Hirshhorn Museum, Washington, D.C.
