works.description: Giant images of hands holding a gun, candles and a bundle of microphones are projected around the drum-shaped Hirshhorn Museum, turning the building into a political body on the National Mall.
works.description_zh: 巨大的手握手枪、蜡烛和一束麦克风的影像被投在圆筒形的赫希洪博物馆外墙上，让这座建筑在国家广场上变成一具发表政治宣言的身体。
works.idea_en: Project a body onto a building so the architecture speaks about the power around it.
works.idea_zh: 把身体投到建筑上，让建筑对周围的权力发声。
works.technique: Large-format slide projectors throw still images onto the curved façade, with the images composed to wrap around the building's cylinder.
works.technique_zh: 大画幅幻灯投影机把静态图像投到弧形立面上，画面经过专门构图，能环绕整个圆柱形建筑。
works.exercise_en: Pick a campus building, photograph its façade, and design three still projection images (drawn over the photo) that make the building 'say' something about what happens inside. Twist: only use hands.
works.exercise_zh: 选一栋校园建筑，拍下立面照片，在照片上设计三张投影图像，让建筑“说出”里面正在发生的事情；变体：画面里只能出现手。

video.video_title: Krzysztof Wodiczko on his 1988 Hirshhorn Museum projection

works.title: Machine with Wishbone
works.description: A tiny wire machine drags a chicken wishbone along a circular track, so the bone seems to walk forward with a strange, earnest gait.
works.description_zh: 一台铁丝做的小机器拖着一根鸡的许愿骨沿圆形轨道前进，让骨头看起来正用一种奇怪而认真的步态走路。
works.idea_en: Giving a found object a gait gives it a character; AR can animate everyday objects with minimal, well-chosen motion.
works.idea_zh: 给一件拾得物一种步态，就给了它性格；AR 可以用最少、最恰当的动作让日常物件活起来。
works.technique: A crank mechanism pushes and lifts the wishbone in a stepping cycle, and the whole machine rotates slowly so the walk becomes an endless loop.
works.technique_zh: 曲柄机构以步行周期推动并抬起许愿骨，整台机器缓慢转动，让这段行走变成无尽的循环。
works.exercise_en: Scan an everyday object (fork, clothes peg) with photogrammetry and give it a two-step walk cycle across a real table in AR. Twist: let it stop and turn toward whoever speaks.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄影测量扫描一件日常物件（叉子、衣夹），在 AR 中给它一个两步行走循环，让它在真桌上走。变体：谁说话，它就停下转向谁。

video.video_title: Machine with Wishbone - Arthur Ganson

works.title: Spoonbridge and Cherry
works.description: A 15-metre spoon with a giant cherry in its bowl spans a pond in the Minneapolis Sculpture Garden; water sprays from the cherry's stem.
works.description_zh: 一把长 15 米、勺中盛着一颗巨大樱桃的勺子横跨明尼阿波利斯雕塑公园的池塘；水从樱桃梗中喷出。
works.idea_en: An everyday object at giant scale makes a whole garden feel like a tabletop, the most common and effective trick in consumer AR.
works.idea_zh: 一件被放大到巨大尺度的日常物品让整座花园像一张桌面，这是消费级 AR 中最常见也最有效的手法。
works.technique: The spoon is built of stainless steel on a hidden frame and the cherry of painted aluminium, with a fountain pipe inside.
works.technique_zh: 勺子由不锈钢在隐藏框架上制成，樱桃由涂漆铝制成，内部有喷泉管。
works.exercise_en: Scan a kitchen utensil and a fruit and place them at 15 metres across a real pond or lawn in AR. Twist: add a physics cherry that rolls off if someone 'bumps' the spoon.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描一件厨房用具和一颗水果，在 AR 中把它们以 15 米的尺寸放在真实的池塘或草坪上；变体：加入一颗物理樱桃，有人“碰”到勺子时它就会滚落。

video.video_title: Opening the Spoonbridge and Cherry

works.title: Stones and Flies: Richard Long in the Sahara
works.description: Philip Haas's film follows Long across the Sahara as he walks, arranges stones into lines and circles, and draws in the sand, leaving marks the wind will erase.
works.description_zh: Philip Haas 的影片跟随 Long 穿越撒哈拉：他行走，把石头排成直线和圆，在沙上作画，留下终将被风抹去的痕迹。
works.idea_en: Simple geometric marks (line, circle) instantly read as human in a vast landscape, a lesson in how little an AR mark needs.
works.idea_zh: 简单的几何标记（线、圆）在广阔风景中立刻被读作人的痕迹，说明 AR 标记所需其实很少。
works.technique: Long collects stones on the spot and places them in geometric figures, recording each walk with photographs and text.
works.technique_zh: Long 就地收集石块摆成几何图形，并用照片和文字记录每一次行走。
works.exercise_en: Collect ten real stones, scan them with Polycam, and arrange copies in AR into a 20-metre circle on a field. Twist: add one new stone to the circle each time a visitor arrives, until it closes.
works.exercise_zh: 收集十块真实石头，用 Polycam 扫描后，在 AR 中把副本在操场上排成直径 20 米的圆；变体：每来一位访客就往圆里加一块石头，直到圆闭合。

video.video_title: Stones and Flies: Richard Long in the Sahara Trailer

works.title: The Fourth Dimension
works.description: People, objects and landscapes twist and ripple because each horizontal line of the image is delayed by one more frame than the line above, turning time into a visible spatial distortion.
works.description_zh: 人物、物体和风景扭曲起伏，因为画面中每一条水平线都比上一条多延迟一帧，时间因此变成可见的空间变形。
works.idea_en: Delaying each row of the image makes time bend bodies; slit-scan is one of the simplest and strongest time-warp effects for AR cameras.
works.idea_zh: 让画面的每一行依次延迟，时间就会把身体弯曲；狭缝扫描是 AR 相机最简单也最有力的时间扭曲效果之一。
works.technique: Slit-scan by scanlines: frames are rebuilt so each of about 480 lines comes from a progressively later frame.
works.technique_zh: 按扫描线做狭缝扫描：重组画面，让约 480 条线各自取自越来越晚的帧。
works.exercise_en: Implement a time-displacement shader in Lens Studio or three.js that samples a ring buffer of camera frames with a delay proportional to screen y, then film a friend spinning. Twist: drive the delay by a depth map so near objects warp more than far ones.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Lens Studio 或 three.js 里写一个时间位移着色器，从相机帧环形缓冲中按屏幕 y 坐标成比例的延迟取样，然后拍同伴原地转圈；变体：用深度图控制延迟，让近处物体比远处扭曲得更厉害。

video.video_title: The Fourth Dimension (1988) -  Zbigniew Rybczynski

works.title: Lunch with a Helmet On
works.description: A spiky ball of 848 welded forks, knives and spoons looks like scrap metal, until a lamp casts its shadow as a detailed motorcycle.
works.description_zh: 由 848 把刀、叉、勺焊成的一团尖刺状金属，看起来像一堆废料，直到一盏灯把它的影子投成一辆细节丰富的摩托车。
works.idea_en: A playful title plus one light turns junk into a joke: AR pieces that pair a mundane object with a surprising projected identity are easy to understand in five seconds.
works.idea_zh: 一个俏皮的标题加一盏灯，就把废料变成了笑话：把平凡物体和出人意料的投影身份配对的 AR 作品，五秒钟就能看懂。
works.technique: Cutlery is welded into a 3D armature whose outline, from one light direction, matches a motorcycle drawing; other angles show only chaos.
works.technique_zh: 餐具被焊成一个立体骨架，从某一个光照方向看，它的轮廓与一幅摩托车图吻合；其他角度只有一团混乱。
works.exercise_en: Import a random-looking spiky mesh into an AR scene with a virtual light and render a shadow that shows a bicycle; let users walk the light around it. Twist: use real cutlery on a table, tracked as an object, as the caster.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个看似随机的尖刺网格导入 AR 场景，配一盏虚拟灯，渲染出一个自行车形状的影子，让用户绕着它移动光源。变体：用桌上真实的餐具作为被追踪的投影物体。

video.video_title: Shadow Art; Shigeo Fukuda

salient.why_en: A tangle of forks and knives casts the shadow of a motorcycle.
salient.why_zh: 一团刀叉勺，投下的影子却是一辆摩托车。

works.title: Steps
works.description: A group of American tourists is keyed into the Odessa Steps sequence of Eisenstein's Battleship Potemkin, walking among the historic footage in an early HD video composite.
works.description_zh: 一群美国游客被抠像合成进爱森斯坦《战舰波将金号》的敖德萨阶梯段落里，在历史影像中走来走去，这是早期的高清视频合成。
works.idea_en: Placing living people inside historic footage is the ancestor of AR history walks; the friction between the two times is the content.
works.idea_zh: 把活人放进历史影像里，是 AR 历史漫步的前身；两个时代之间的摩擦本身就是内容。
works.technique: Blue-screen video keying and early high-definition compositing combine new actors with the 1925 film footage.
works.technique_zh: 用蓝幕抠像和早期高清合成，把新拍的演员与 1925 年的电影画面组合在一起。
works.exercise_en: Find a historic photo of a place on campus, align it as an AR overlay at the exact spot, and let visitors photograph themselves standing inside it. Twist: the historic people slowly turn to look at the visitor.
works.exercise_zh: 找一张校园某处的老照片，把它作为 AR 叠加精确对准在原地，让来访者拍下自己站在老照片里的样子；变体：照片里的历史人物慢慢转头看向来访者。

video.video_title: STEPS, (excerpts) 1987, by Zbig Rybczynski. Odessa Steps/Eisenstein

works.title: Wild Carrot II
works.description: A cluster of small stainless-steel blades on a branching stem that trembles and turns in the breeze like a plant in a field.
works.description_zh: 分叉茎秆上的一簇小型不锈钢叶片，在微风中颤动、旋转，像田野里的植物。
works.idea_en: Abstract steel that moves like a plant borrows the behaviour of nature without imitating its look; AR plants can do the same with motion alone.
works.idea_zh: 像植物一样运动的抽象钢材，借用了自然的行为而非外形；AR 植物也可以只靠运动来做到这一点。
works.technique: Many small balanced elements on a branching armature each respond to the wind separately, so the whole reads as a living cluster.
works.technique_zh: 分叉骨架上许多小型平衡部件各自对风作出反应，整体看起来像一簇活的植物。
works.exercise_en: Grow a field of abstract AR 'plants' made of balanced blades on a real lawn, swaying with a noise-driven wind that gusts when the user walks through. Twist: make the plants turn away from the user like a shy herd.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实草坪上“种”一片由平衡叶片组成的抽象 AR 植物，让它们在噪声驱动的风中摇摆，用户走过时刮起一阵风。变体：让植物像害羞的兽群一样背过身去。

video.video_title: Wild Carrot II 1987 | George Rickey, Kinetic Sculptor

works.title: Very Nervous System
works.description: In an empty room, a person's movements are watched by video cameras and turned instantly into music, so the body plays the space like an instrument.
works.description_zh: 在一个空房间里，摄像机观察人的动作并即时把它们变成音乐，身体像演奏乐器一样演奏整个空间。
works.idea_en: The whole body as the interface, with no visible device, is the root of camera-based interaction; AR sound can use the same idea with body tracking.
works.idea_zh: 整个身体就是界面、看不到任何设备，这是基于摄像头交互的源头；AR 声音可以借助身体追踪沿用同一想法。
works.technique: Custom image-processing hardware and software measure motion in regions of the camera image and map speed and location to synthesiser parameters in real time.
works.technique_zh: 自制的图像处理硬件和软件测量摄像画面各区域的运动，并把速度和位置实时映射到合成器参数上。
works.exercise_en: Divide the room into invisible AR zones and use body tracking so that moving fast or slow in each zone triggers different sounds. Twist: add a delay so the room 'answers' a second later, like an echo of your body.
works.exercise_zh: 把房间划分为看不见的 AR 区域，用身体追踪让人在每个区域里快动或慢动触发不同的声音。变体：加一点延迟，让房间晚一秒才“回答”，像身体的回声。

video.video_title: 1990 David Rokeby – Very Nervous System

salient.why_en: In an empty room, your body's movement is instantly turned into music.
salient.why_zh: 在空房间里，你身体的每个动作都立刻变成音乐。

works.title: Fontaines (Sphérades), Palais-Royal
works.description: Two fountains of polished steel spheres in the Palais-Royal courtyard slowly tilt and turn under flowing water, reflecting the arcades and sky.
works.description_zh: 巴黎皇家宫殿庭院中的两座喷泉，由抛光不锈钢球组成，在流水中缓慢倾斜、转动，映出拱廊和天空。
works.idea_en: Reflective, slowly moving objects blend into their surroundings by mirroring them; AR objects with real-time environment reflections sit more naturally in a place.
works.idea_zh: 会反射、缓慢移动的物体通过映照周围而融入环境；带实时环境反射的 AR 物体也会更自然地存在于场所中。
works.technique: Water flow shifts the weight of hollow steel spheres so they rock and rotate slowly, while their mirror surfaces continuously reflect the historic courtyard.
works.technique_zh: 水流改变空心钢球的重心，使其缓慢摇晃、转动，镜面持续映照这座历史庭院。
works.exercise_en: Place a cluster of mirror spheres in a real courtyard with AR environment probes so they reflect the actual surroundings, rocking slowly as a virtual stream flows. Twist: let the spheres reflect a different season than the real one.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实庭院中放一组镜面球，用 AR 环境探针让它们反射真实环境，并随虚拟水流缓慢摇晃。变体：让球面映出与现实不同的季节。

video.video_title: Paris : Fontaines de Pol Bury au Palais Royal, l'art cinétique et aquatique des Sphérades

works.title: Lightmobile
works.description: A Volkswagen Beetle covered with about 1,600 computer-controlled light bulbs drives through city streets, its patterns chasing across the body as it moves.
works.description_zh: 一辆覆盖约 1600 个电脑控制灯泡的大众甲壳虫在城市街道上行驶，灯光图案在车身上追逐流动。
works.idea_en: Light content does not have to stay on buildings: attaching animated light to a moving object makes the street itself the stage, a cue for AR content that rides on vehicles.
works.idea_zh: 光的内容不必只停在建筑上：把动态光附在移动的物体上，整条街就成了舞台——这给“跟着交通工具走”的 AR 内容一个提示。
works.technique: Hundreds of bulbs on the car body are sequenced by an onboard computer to run chase and pattern animations.
works.technique_zh: 车身上的数百个灯泡由车载电脑排序控制，播放追逐和图案动画。
works.exercise_en: Track a toy car or a bike with image or object tracking and wrap it in an animated pattern of virtual bulbs that chase in the direction of travel. Twist: make the chase speed follow the real speed of the object.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像或物体追踪识别一辆玩具车或自行车，给它包上一层虚拟灯泡动画，灯光沿行进方向追逐；变体：让追逐速度跟随物体的真实速度。

video.video_title: Eric Staller - LIGHTMOBILE

works.title: Time Stratum II (時間層II)
works.description: Paper figures arranged on a rotating disc come alive as an animation because they are lit only by the flicker of video monitors, shown here at the Taro Okamoto Museum of Art.
works.description_zh: 排列在旋转圆盘上的纸人被只来自显示器闪烁的光照亮，于是活成了一段动画；视频拍摄于川崎市冈本太郎美术馆。
works.idea_en: Any light source with a rhythm can be a strobe; AR designers learn that timing, not hardware, is what creates animation.
works.idea_zh: 任何有节奏的光源都可以是频闪；AR 设计者可以学到，产生动画的是时序而不是硬件。
works.technique: Iwai synchronises the rotation of a zoetrope disc with the flicker of TV screens, so the screens act as a stroboscope that freezes each figure in turn (year approximate).
works.technique_zh: 岩井俊雄让走马灯圆盘的转速与电视屏幕的闪烁同步，屏幕于是成为逐个定格人形的频闪仪（年份为估计）。
works.exercise_en: Print a zoetrope disc, spin it on a turntable, and film it with a phone camera at a matched shutter speed; then add AR figures that match the disc's frames. Twist: use a screen flicker from another phone as the only light.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一张走马灯圆盘放在唱机上旋转，用快门速度匹配的手机拍摄，再加上与圆盘帧对应的 AR 人形。变体：只用另一部手机屏幕的闪烁作为光源。

video.video_title: DSCN6886川崎・岡本太郎美術館20180108時間層Ⅱ＿岩井俊雄

works.title: CRITTER (VIDEOPLACE)
works.description: A small graphic creature chases a visitor's silhouette, climbs up their arm, dangles from a fingertip and does a little dance when it reaches the top of the head.
works.description_zh: 一只小小的图形生物追着观众的剪影跑，顺着手臂往上爬，吊在指尖上晃，爬到头顶时还会跳一段小舞。
works.idea_en: A virtual pet that understands the shape of your body.
works.idea_zh: 一只能“读懂”你身体形状的虚拟宠物。
works.technique: The creature's behavior rules react to the tracked silhouette's outline, finding hands and head from extremities of the contour.
works.technique_zh: 小生物的行为规则会对追踪到的剪影轮廓做出反应，通过轮廓的端点判断手和头的位置。
works.exercise_en: Build a creature in a webcam sketch that walks along the edge of your body mask, jumps to your highest point and falls if you move too fast. Twist: give it moods so it avoids people who wave aggressively.
works.exercise_zh: 在网络摄像头草图里做一只沿着人体轮廓边缘行走的小生物，它会跳到你身体的最高点，动作太快它就会掉下来；变体：给它加上情绪，遇到挥手太猛的人就躲开。

video.video_title: Myron Krueger's Critter

works.title: Dark Star Park
works.description: In Rosslyn, Virginia, large dark spheres, pools and poles are placed so that every 1 August at 9:32 a.m. their shadows line up exactly with outlines drawn on the ground, marking the date the land was bought in 1860.
works.description_zh: 在弗吉尼亚州罗斯林，巨大的深色球体、水池和立杆经过精确摆放，使每年 8 月 1 日上午 9:32 它们的影子与地面上画出的轮廓完全重合，以纪念这片土地在 1860 年被购买的日子。
works.idea_en: A shadow that fits its outline once a year is a clock, an idea AR can replicate by matching virtual shadows to the real sun.
works.idea_zh: 一年只与轮廓吻合一次的影子就是一座钟，AR 可以通过让虚拟阴影匹配真实太阳来复现这一想法。
works.technique: Positions of spheres, poles and ground outlines were calculated from the sun's altitude and azimuth at the anniversary time.
works.technique_zh: 球体、立杆和地面轮廓的位置根据纪念时刻太阳的高度角和方位角计算得出。
works.exercise_en: Place AR spheres on a plaza and draw outlines on the ground where their shadows will fall at a chosen date and time, using a solar-position library. Twist: let each visitor set their own anniversary.
works.exercise_zh: 在广场上放置 AR 球体，并用太阳位置库在地面画出它们在指定日期和时刻的影子轮廓；变体：让每位访客设定自己的纪念日。

video.video_title: Hidden Gem: Discover Nancy Holt the Artist of Dark Star Park

works.title: Narcissus
works.description: McLaren's last film retells the Narcissus myth as a ballet, using mirror images, multiple exposures and slow motion so the dancer duets with his own reflection.
works.description_zh: McLaren 的最后一部作品以芭蕾重述纳西索斯神话，用镜像、多重曝光和慢动作让舞者与自己的倒影共舞。
works.idea_en: Dancing with your own copy is a compelling interaction: a delayed or mirrored AR clone of the user makes a partner out of oneself.
works.idea_zh: 与自己的副本共舞是很有吸引力的交互：一个延迟或镜像的 AR 分身能让人把自己变成舞伴。
works.technique: Mirror printing, multiple exposure and slow-motion cinematography composited on an optical printer.
works.technique_zh: 在光学印片机上合成镜像印片、多重曝光和慢动作画面。
works.exercise_en: Capture a person with body tracking and spawn a mirrored clone that repeats their moves 2 seconds later beside them in AR. Twist: the clone slowly stops copying and starts improvising.
works.exercise_zh: 用身体追踪捕捉一个人，在 AR 中他身边生成一个镜像分身，延迟 2 秒重复他的动作；变体：分身慢慢不再模仿，开始自己即兴。

video.video_title: NARCISSUS | Full Animated Film | National Film Board of Canada

works.title: Surrounded Islands
works.description: Eleven islands in Miami's Biscayne Bay were each surrounded by a floating skirt of pink fabric extending 61 metres into the water, for two weeks.
works.description_zh: 迈阿密比斯坎湾的十一座小岛各自被一圈粉红色浮布环绕，布面向水中延伸 61 米，持续两周。
works.idea_en: Outlining existing things with a bright halo makes them visible as a set, a basic AR highlighting technique at landscape scale.
works.idea_zh: 用明亮的光环勾勒已有之物，让它们作为一个整体被看见，这是风景尺度上的基本 AR 高亮技巧。
works.technique: Sewn pink panels were attached to floating booms anchored around each island's shoreline and unfurled on the same day.
works.technique_zh: 缝制好的粉色布面固定在环绕各岛岸线的浮栏上，并在同一天展开。
works.exercise_en: Detect objects on a table or in a courtyard with segmentation and draw a pink offset outline around each on the ground plane in AR. Twist: the outlines grow when two objects are close, merging into one shape.
works.exercise_zh: 用分割检测桌面或庭院中的物体，在 AR 地面上为每个物体画出粉色外扩轮廓；变体：两个物体靠近时轮廓变大并合并成一个形状。

video.video_title: Meet the Artists | Christo and Jeanne-Claude | Surrounded Islands

works.title: untitled (Dia:Bridgehampton)
works.description: In a former firehouse and church in Bridgehampton, New York, nine works made of standard coloured fluorescent tubes line a long gallery, soaking the walls in coloured light.
works.description_zh: 在纽约布里奇汉普顿一座由消防站改建、后来做过教堂的建筑里，九件由标准彩色荧光灯管组成的作品排列在长长的展厅中，把墙面浸在彩光里。
works.idea_en: Off-the-shelf lights arranged with care become art; AR designers can make strong work from default primitives (a line, a quad) instead of custom assets.
works.idea_zh: 用心排列的现成灯具就能成为艺术；AR 设计者可以用默认的基本元素（一条线、一个面片）做出有力量的作品，而不必依赖定制素材。
works.technique: Commercial fluorescent fixtures in standard lengths and colours are mounted in repeated configurations so that their glow, not the tubes, colours the room.
works.technique_zh: 标准长度和颜色的商用荧光灯具以重复的方式安装，染色房间的是它们的光晕，而不是灯管本身。
works.exercise_en: Using only unlit primitive cylinders and emissive colour in AR, build a series of five light 'corners' along a corridor and bake their glow onto the real walls. Twist: allow only three colours in the whole series.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 里只用基本圆柱体和自发光颜色，沿一条走廊做一组五个光“角落”，并把光晕烘焙到真实墙面上。变体：整组作品只允许用三种颜色。

video.video_title: Dan Flavin at Dia Bridgehampton

works.title: Kleines Federrad (Small Feather Wheel)
works.description: A small motorised wheel of feathers opens and turns slowly, fanning out like a bird's display and folding shut again.
works.description_zh: 一个装有羽毛的小型电动轮缓慢张开、转动，像鸟类求偶时展开羽毛，然后再合拢。
works.idea_en: A single slow opening gesture, borrowed from an animal, is enough to make a machine feel alive; AR objects can borrow the same body language.
works.idea_zh: 只需借用动物的一个缓慢展开动作，就能让机器显得有生命；AR 物体也可以借用同样的身体语言。
works.technique: A small motor drives a hinged wheel of real feathers through an open–rotate–close cycle, so soft natural material carries a mechanical rhythm.
works.technique_zh: 小电机驱动装有真羽毛的铰接轮完成“展开—旋转—合拢”的循环，让柔软的天然材料带上机械节奏。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR 'feather wheel' that sits on a table and opens like a fan when the user leans in close (distance from camera), then folds shut when they back away. Twist: make it open only for quiet voices, using the microphone level.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个放在桌上的 AR“羽毛轮”，当用户靠近（根据与相机的距离）时像扇子一样展开，离开时合拢。变体：只在低声说话时展开，用麦克风音量判断。

video.video_title: Capsule vidéo #3 - Rebecca Horn "Kleines Federrad ", 1982

works.title: Vietnam Veterans Memorial
works.description: Two black granite walls cut into the ground of the National Mall in Washington meet in a V, engraved with the names of more than 58,000 Americans killed in the Vietnam War; visitors see their own reflection among the names.
works.description_zh: 两道黑色花岗岩墙切入华盛顿国家广场的地面，交汇成 V 字，刻有 58000 多名在越战中阵亡的美国人的名字；观众会在名字间看到自己的倒影。
works.idea_en: Reflection puts the living among the names, and the wall grows taller as you walk in, a model for data AR that uses the viewer's body and path.
works.idea_zh: 倒影让生者置身于名字之间，墙也随你走入而逐渐升高，这是利用观者身体和路径的数据 AR 范本。
works.technique: The wall is set into a cut in the earth that deepens toward the apex; names are listed chronologically by date of death.
works.technique_zh: 墙体嵌在一道向顶点逐渐加深的地面切口中；名字按阵亡日期的时间顺序排列。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR wall that rises from the ground as the user walks along it and lists a dataset (for example, species lost in your region) in chronological order, with a mirror material. Twist: the names nearest the user's reflection become readable aloud.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一面随用户沿其行走而从地面升起的 AR 墙，按时间顺序列出一个数据集（例如本地区消失的物种），并使用镜面材质；变体：离用户倒影最近的名字会被朗读出来。

video.video_title: Maya Lin, Vietnam Veterans Memorial

works.title: Wheatfield – A Confrontation
works.description: On a landfill two blocks from Wall Street, Denes planted and harvested two acres of golden wheat against the backdrop of the World Trade Center towers.
works.description_zh: 在距华尔街两个街区的一片垃圾填埋地上，Denes 以世界贸易中心双塔为背景，种植并收割了两英亩金黄的小麦。
works.idea_en: A living field in the wrong place is a sharp confrontation of values, a template for AR that plants nature where it 'should not' be.
works.idea_zh: 一片出现在“错误地点”的活麦田是对价值观的尖锐对峙，是把自然种在“不该出现之处”的 AR 模板。
works.technique: About 200 truckloads of soil were brought onto the rubble; wheat was sown by hand, irrigated and harvested four months later.
works.technique_zh: 约 200 卡车泥土被运到瓦砾上；小麦由人工播种、灌溉，四个月后收割。
works.exercise_en: Cover a car park or a financial-district plaza with a waving AR wheat field that responds to device tilt as wind. Twist: the field's height tracks a live commodity price for wheat.
works.exercise_zh: 用一片随设备倾斜如风般摇曳的 AR 麦田覆盖一个停车场或金融区广场；变体：麦田高度跟随实时小麦商品价格变化。

video.video_title: Remembering Agnes Denes’s “Wheatfield” | THE SHED

works.title: Displacements
works.description: A furnished American living room is filmed with two performers by a slowly rotating camera; then the whole room is spray-painted white and the film is projected back onto it from the same spot. The furniture looks solid and colourful again, while the people appear as ghosts.
works.description_zh: 一间布置完整的美式客厅，用缓慢旋转的摄影机拍下两位表演者；随后把整个房间连同家具全部喷成白色，再从同一位置把影片投回去。家具重新显得立体、有色彩，而人却像幽灵一样浮现。
works.idea_en: Projecting a scene back onto its own shape makes it look real; anything that does not match the surface becomes a ghost, a lesson in how registration decides what feels solid in AR.
works.idea_zh: 把场景投回它自己的形体上，它就显得真实；与表面不吻合的东西就变成幽灵——这说明了 AR 中“对准”决定了什么看起来是实体。
works.technique: A 16mm camera on a turntable records the room; the camera is replaced by a projector on the same turntable, so camera and projector share one viewpoint and the image lands exactly on the whitened objects.
works.technique_zh: 转台上的 16mm 摄影机拍下房间；之后把摄影机换成同一转台上的放映机，摄影机与放映机共享同一视点，影像就能准确落在涂白的物体上。
works.exercise_en: Scan a small corner of the classroom with a LiDAR phone, paint or cover the real objects white, then project or overlay the captured texture back onto them in AR from the capture position. Twist: record a moving person in the scan so only they appear as a ghost.
works.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的手机扫描教室的一个小角落，把真实物体涂白或盖上白布，再从扫描时的位置用投影或 AR 把采集到的纹理贴回去；变体：扫描时录进一个走动的人，让只有他以幽灵的样子出现。

video.video_title: "Displacements" (silent video)

works.title: Seascapes
works.description: Horizons of seas around the world, each split exactly in half between water and sky, photographed with long exposures in the same format for decades; discussed here in a Louisiana Channel interview.
works.description_zh: 世界各地的海平面，每张都正好一半是水、一半是天，数十年来用同样的构图和长曝光拍摄；视频是 Louisiana Channel 的访谈。
works.idea_en: One fixed rule repeated across many places makes a whole series feel like one view: AR installations can use a constant framing to connect distant sites.
works.idea_zh: 在许多地方重复同一条固定规则，整个系列就像同一个视角：AR 装置可以用固定的取景把遥远的地点连在一起。
works.technique: Large-format camera with long exposures and a fixed composition that places the horizon at the exact center of the frame.
works.technique_zh: 大画幅相机长曝光，构图固定，让地平线正好位于画面中央。
works.exercise_en: Make a WebXR portal that always shows a sea horizon at eye level, aligned with the viewer's real horizon using the device's gravity vector, and place it in a windowless room. Twist: the sea's time of day follows the local time of a coastline on the other side of the world.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 WebXR 传送门，利用设备的重力方向让一条海平线始终与观众的真实视平线对齐，把它放在没有窗的房间里；变体：海面的时刻跟随地球另一端某段海岸的当地时间。

video.video_title: Hiroshi Sugimoto Interview: Between Sea and Sky

works.title: Talking Head Projection
works.description: A filmed face is projected onto a face-shaped screen mounted on a pan-tilt gimbal. The screen turns and nods exactly as the real person's head moved during filming, so the projected head looks solid and present in the room.
works.description_zh: 一张拍好的脸被投影到一块装在云台上的脸形屏幕上。屏幕按照拍摄时真人头部的转动和点头同步运动，于是投出来的头像显得立体、真实地“在场”。
works.idea_en: Presence comes from matching the shape and the motion of the surface to the image; an AR avatar needs a body that moves with it, not just a flat video.
works.idea_zh: 临场感来自让承载面的形状和运动与影像一致；AR 化身需要一个跟着它动的“身体”，而不只是一段平面视频。
works.technique: Head orientation was recorded during super-8 filming and later drove a motorized face-shaped screen while the film was projected onto it, an extension of Disney's Haunted Mansion head projection (MIT Architecture Machine Group, with Nicholas Negroponte and Chris Schmandt).
works.technique_zh: 拍摄 super-8 影片时同时记录头部朝向，之后用这些数据驱动一块电动脸形屏幕，并把影片投在上面；这是对迪士尼幽灵公馆人头投影的延伸（MIT 建筑机器小组，与 Nicholas Negroponte 和 Chris Schmandt 合作）。
works.exercise_en: Record a classmate's face with ARKit face tracking, then in AR place their video on a 3D head mesh that replays the recorded head rotation in the room. Twist: drive the head's rotation live from a second phone so it becomes a telepresence puppet.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit 人脸追踪录下一位同学的脸，然后在 AR 里把视频贴到一个 3D 头部模型上，让它在房间里重放录下的头部转动；变体：用第二台手机实时驱动头部转动，把它变成远程临场的木偶。

video.video_title: Talking Head Projection, Architecture Machine Group, MIT, 1979.

works.title: Tango
works.description: In one small room, 36 characters from different stages of life enter, loop through their actions and leave, all overlapping in time yet never colliding; the film won the 1983 Oscar for animated short.
works.description_zh: 在一个小房间里，36 个处于不同人生阶段的人物进来、循环着各自的动作、再离开，他们在时间上重叠却从不相撞；影片获 1983 年奥斯卡最佳动画短片奖。
works.idea_en: Many looping recordings can share one real room if their paths are choreographed; AR spaces can hold layers of past visitors without clutter.
works.idea_zh: 只要路径编排得当，许多循环的录像可以共享同一个真实房间；AR 空间可以容纳层层叠叠的过往访客而不显杂乱。
works.technique: Each actor was filmed separately and composited through thousands of hand-cut mattes and multiple exposures on an optical printer.
works.technique_zh: 每位演员单独拍摄，再用几千张手工切割的遮罩和多次曝光在光学印片机上合成。
works.exercise_en: Record 5 people separately walking short loops through the same corner of a room with phone volumetric or segmentation capture, then replay all loops together in AR at their original positions. Twist: add a 6th loop live — the viewer — and see who collides.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机体积捕捉或人像分割，分别录下 5 个人在房间同一角落走的短循环，再在 AR 中按原位置把所有循环同时回放；变体：加入第 6 个实时循环——观众本人——看谁会撞上谁。

video.video_title: TANGO (excerpts) by Zbig Rybczynski, Academy Award winning film

works.title: Roden Crater
works.description: An extinct volcano in the Arizona desert is being reshaped into a naked-eye observatory: tunnels and chambers frame the sky, the sun and the moon at precise times.
works.description_zh: 亚利桑那沙漠里一座死火山被改造成裸眼天文台：隧道和房间在精确的时刻框住天空、太阳和月亮。
works.idea_en: Architecture can act as a time-based lens on the sky; an AR experience can likewise be tied to a place and a moment, opening only when sun or moon line up.
works.idea_zh: 建筑可以成为一只随时间运行的看天之眼；AR 体验同样可以绑定地点和时刻，只在日月对齐时开启。
works.technique: Openings, tunnels and bowl-shaped rooms are aligned to astronomical events (solstices, lunar standstills) so that sky light is framed and flattened into a vault.
works.technique_zh: 开口、隧道和碗状房间都对准天文事件（至日、月亮停变期），把天光框起来，让天空看上去像一个穹顶。
works.exercise_en: Write a phone AR app that uses GPS, compass and a sun-position library to show a floating ring that only aligns with the real sun at one minute of the day at your school. Twist: make the ring open a portal to the night sky of the same place.
works.exercise_zh: 写一个手机 AR 应用，结合 GPS、指南针和太阳位置计算库，显示一个悬浮的圆环，它只在一天中的某一分钟与学校上空的真实太阳对齐。变体：让圆环对齐时打开一个通往同一地点夜空的传送门。

video.video_title: James Turrell's Roden Crater

works.title: Fontaine (Fondation Maeght)
works.description: Slender stainless-steel tubes in a pool fill with water until they tip, pour and slowly rise again, in an endless, unhurried rhythm.
works.description_zh: 水池中细长的不锈钢管不断注水，直到倾斜、倾倒，再慢慢立起，节奏悠长而无止境。
works.idea_en: Movement driven by slowly accumulating weight creates anticipation; AR can build suspense with gradual build-ups that release in a single gesture.
works.idea_zh: 由缓慢积累的重量驱动的运动制造期待感；AR 可以通过逐渐积蓄、一次释放的方式制造悬念。
works.technique: Each pivoting tube fills with water until its centre of mass passes the pivot, then tips to empty and returns, like a shishi-odoshi garden device.
works.technique_zh: 每根可转动的管子注水直到重心越过支点，然后倾倒排空再复位，类似日本庭院的添水（鹿威）。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR shishi-odoshi fountain on a real table that fills with virtual water at the rate the user speaks and tips with a sound when full. Twist: chain several so one tipping fills the next.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实桌面上做一个 AR“添水”喷泉，按用户说话的速度注入虚拟水，满了就伴随声响倾倒。变体：把几个串联起来，一个倾倒就注满下一个。

video.video_title: Fondation Maeght - Fontaine de Pol Bury (1978)

works.title: Méta-Harmonie
works.description: Giant sound machines built from wheels, drums, pipes and found instruments that clang, whistle and bang in chaotic rhythms when switched on.
works.description_zh: 由轮子、鼓、管子和各种现成乐器组成的巨大声音机器，启动后以混乱的节奏哐当、吹哨、敲击。
works.idea_en: Letting visitors see every moving part that makes a sound turns noise into music; AR sound objects are more engaging when their mechanism is visible.
works.idea_zh: 让观众看到每一个发声的运动部件，噪音就变成了音乐；AR 声音物体若机制可见，会更吸引人。
works.technique: Motor-driven wheels carry beaters and strikers past percussion and wind elements, so the rotation speeds and gear ratios compose a slowly shifting polyrhythm.
works.technique_zh: 电机驱动的轮子带着敲槌经过打击和吹奏元件，转速和齿轮比共同构成缓慢变化的复合节奏。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR music machine on a table where each visible rotating wheel triggers a sample when its striker passes a virtual drum; users tap to add wheels at new speeds. Twist: tie one wheel to the phone's walking cadence.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌上做一个 AR 音乐机器：每个可见的旋转轮在敲槌经过虚拟鼓时触发一个音效，用户点击可以添加不同速度的轮子。变体：让一个轮子与用户步行的节奏绑定。

video.video_title: Jean Tinguely's Four Méta-Harmonie Music Machines at Museum Tinguely, Basel

works.title: Flip and Two Twisters (Trilogy)
works.description: Three suspended stainless-steel bands are twisted and flipped by motors into violent, singing loops and whips of reflected light.
works.description_zh: 三条悬挂的不锈钢带被电机扭转、翻转，形成剧烈、会“歌唱”的环和反光的鞭梢。
works.idea_en: Motion and sound from the same material feel inseparable; AR objects gain presence when their sound comes directly from how they move.
works.idea_zh: 来自同一材料的运动和声音让人觉得密不可分；AR 物体的声音若直接来自它的运动方式，存在感会更强。
works.technique: Programmed motors twist long steel strips beyond their resting shape so they release energy as looping waves, producing roaring and ringing sounds.
works.technique_zh: 程序控制的电机把长钢带扭到超出其自然形态，释放能量时形成环状波，发出轰鸣与鸣响。
works.exercise_en: Model an AR steel ribbon with a simple spring chain hung in the room; when the user twists their phone, the ribbon whips and sounds with pitch tied to its speed. Twist: add three ribbons that answer each other.
works.exercise_zh: 用简单弹簧链模拟一条挂在房间里的 AR 钢带；用户扭转手机时，钢带甩动并发出与速度相关的音高。变体：加三条互相应答的钢带。

video.video_title: Len Lye Flip and Two Twisters (Trilogy) 1977, 2016.

works.title: Kouzelný cirkus (Wonderful Circus)
works.description: A poetic circus without words: clowns, acrobats and dancers play with projected film on screens and scenery, climbing into pictures and being chased by their own images. It was co-created by Evald Schorm, Jiří Srnec, Jan Švankmajer and Josef Svoboda and ran for decades in Prague.
works.description_zh: 一场没有台词的诗意马戏：小丑、杂技演员和舞者与投在银幕和布景上的影片嬉戏，爬进画面，又被自己的影像追赶。由 Evald Schorm、Jiří Srnec、Jan Švankmajer 和 Josef Svoboda 共同创作，在布拉格上演了几十年。
works.idea_en: Comedy is a good test for mixed reality: if the gag between the real clown and the projected one lands, the audience has accepted both as the same world.
works.idea_zh: 喜剧是检验混合现实的好办法：真小丑和投影小丑之间的笑点一旦成立，观众就已经把两者当成同一个世界。
works.technique: Film is projected onto screens that are also physical props (doors, curtains, frames), and performers match their blocking to the filmed action frame by frame.
works.technique_zh: 影片投在同时也是实体道具的屏幕上（门、幕布、画框），表演者按照影片动作逐帧对准自己的走位。
works.exercise_en: Build a one-minute silent gag in phone AR where a virtual clown hides behind a real door or box in the room and pops out when you open it, using plane detection and occlusion. Twist: the virtual clown copies the last gesture the real performer made.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 做一个一分钟的无声小笑话：虚拟小丑藏在房间里一扇真实的门或一个箱子后面，你一打开它就跳出来（使用平面检测和遮挡）；变体：虚拟小丑模仿真人表演者刚刚做过的最后一个动作。

video.video_title: Laterna magika: Kouzelný cirkus / Wonderful Circus

works.title: Scrim veil—Black rectangle—Natural light
works.description: A sheet of white scrim divides the Whitney's fourth-floor gallery lengthwise, with a black band at its top edge; natural light from the Breuer window makes the fabric appear and disappear as you move.
works.description_zh: 一张白色纱幕沿长边把惠特尼美术馆四楼的展厅隔开，顶端有一条黑色带；布雷尔大窗透进的自然光，让纱幕随着你的移动时隐时现。
works.idea_en: A barely visible surface changes how a whole room is read; semi-transparent AR planes can re-divide real spaces without blocking them.
works.idea_zh: 一个几乎看不见的平面就能改变整个房间的读法；半透明的 AR 平面可以重新划分真实空间而不遮挡它。
works.technique: A translucent scrim is stretched from wall to wall with a painted black line at ceiling height, so perception of the surface depends on viewing angle and daylight.
works.technique_zh: 半透明纱幕从墙拉到墙，天花板高度处画一条黑线，平面是否可见取决于观看角度和日光。
works.exercise_en: Place a nearly transparent vertical plane across the classroom in AR with a thin black line on top, and vary its opacity with viewing angle so it vanishes head-on. Twist: ask classmates to walk around it and mark where it disappears.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 里横跨教室放一块近乎透明的竖直平面，顶部有一条细黑线，并让透明度随视角变化，正面看时消失。变体：请同学绕着走，并标出它消失的位置。

video.video_title: Robert Irwin Veils the Whitney in Light

works.title: The Lightning Field
works.description: Four hundred stainless-steel poles stand in a grid one mile by one kilometre in the high desert of New Mexico, their tips forming a perfectly level plane; visitors stay overnight to watch the light change (and occasionally lightning).
works.description_zh: 四百根不锈钢杆在新墨西哥高原沙漠中排成一英里乘一公里的网格，杆尖构成一个绝对水平的面；参观者需在此过夜，观看光线变化（偶尔还有闪电）。
works.idea_en: A strict grid laid over wild land makes both light and terrain readable; AR grids can do the same for invisible fields.
works.idea_zh: 在荒野上铺设严格的网格，让光线和地形都变得可读；AR 网格也可以对看不见的场做同样的事。
works.technique: Poles of varying height (average about 6 metres) were surveyed so their pointed tips align to one horizontal plane over uneven ground.
works.technique_zh: 立杆高度不一（平均约 6 米），经测量使尖端在起伏地面上对齐同一水平面。
works.exercise_en: Lay out a 10×10 grid of thin AR poles on an uneven field with tips locked to one world height, and watch it at sunset. Twist: make poles glow brighter where live weather data reports higher humidity or wind.
works.exercise_zh: 在起伏的场地上布置 10×10 的细 AR 杆网格，杆尖锁定在同一世界高度，并在日落时观看；变体：根据实时天气数据，让湿度或风速更高处的杆发出更亮的光。

video.video_title: Walter De Maria at Dia

works.title: The New York Earth Room
works.description: A SoHo loft in New York is filled with 127 cubic metres of dark soil, 56 centimetres deep; a caretaker waters and rakes it, and visitors look in from the doorway.
works.description_zh: 纽约 SoHo 区的一间阁楼里铺满 127 立方米、深 56 厘米的黑土；有专人浇水、耙平，访客只能从门口向内观看。
works.idea_en: Filling a whole room with one natural material replaces the interior with a landscape, the physical version of AR room replacement.
works.idea_zh: 用一种自然材料填满整个房间，把室内替换成一片风景，是 AR 房间替换的实体版本。
works.technique: Soil is spread evenly across the floor to a fixed depth behind a glass barrier and maintained weekly.
works.technique_zh: 泥土在玻璃挡板后均匀铺满地面至固定深度，每周维护。
works.exercise_en: Use ARKit scene reconstruction to fill a real room's floor with an AR soil layer 50 cm deep that correctly hides furniture legs. Twist: let footprints appear in the soil where people walk.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit 场景重建在真实房间地面铺一层 50 厘米深的 AR 泥土，并正确遮住家具腿；变体：人们走过的地方会在泥土中留下脚印。

video.video_title: A Loft Filled with Dirt, the Man Who's Cared for it for 19 Years

works.title: The Vertical Earth Kilometer
works.description: For documenta 6 in Kassel, a brass rod one kilometre long was sunk vertically into the ground of Friedrichsplatz; all that can be seen is its end, a small circle flush with a sandstone plate.
works.description_zh: 为卡塞尔文献展第六届，一根长一公里的黄铜棒被垂直埋入 Friedrichsplatz 广场地下；地面上只能看到它的末端，一个与砂岩板齐平的小圆。
works.idea_en: An artwork almost entirely invisible and known only by its description shows that AR can point to things we can never see, such as depth.
works.idea_zh: 一件几乎完全看不见、只能靠描述得知的作品说明，AR 可以指向我们永远看不见的东西，比如深度。
works.technique: A shaft was drilled for 79 days and 167 brass segments were screwed together and lowered into it.
works.technique_zh: 钻井持续 79 天，167 段黄铜棒被逐段拧接后放入井中。
works.exercise_en: Mark a spot on the ground and, in AR, show what lies directly beneath it to one kilometre depth (soil layers, pipes, bedrock) from open geological data. Twist: show nothing but a small circle until the user kneels down.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面标记一个点，在 AR 中根据公开地质数据展示其正下方一公里深处的内容（土层、管道、基岩）；变体：直到用户蹲下之前，只显示一个小圆。

video.video_title: Das Loch von Kassel - Der vertikale Erdkilometer

works.title: Running Fence
works.description: A white fabric fence 5.5 metres high ran for 39.4 kilometres across the hills of Sonoma and Marin counties in California and into the Pacific Ocean, for two weeks.
works.description_zh: 一道高 5.5 米的白色织物围栏穿过加州索诺玛县和马林县的丘陵，延伸 39.4 公里后没入太平洋，持续两周。
works.idea_en: A line that follows the land for 40 kilometres makes the topography readable, a strong idea for AR lines drawn on terrain data.
works.idea_zh: 沿地形延伸 40 公里的一条线让地貌变得可读，这是在地形数据上绘制 AR 线的有力创意。
works.technique: 2,050 fabric panels hung from steel cables between poles followed the ground's curves, installed with the ranchers' permission.
works.technique_zh: 2050 块织物挂在立柱之间的钢缆上，随地面起伏延伸，在牧场主的许可下安装。
works.exercise_en: Use a digital elevation model and a geospatial AR SDK to draw a white fence line along a real ridge that you can see from a viewpoint. Twist: extend the line into the sea or a lake and let it sink.
works.exercise_zh: 使用数字高程模型和地理空间 AR SDK，沿一条从某个观景点可见的真实山脊画出白色围栏线；变体：让线一直延伸进海或湖中并沉没。

video.video_title: Christo and Jeanne-Claude's Running Fence

works.title: Sun Tunnels
works.description: Four concrete tunnels, each 5.5 metres long, lie in an open X in the Great Basin Desert of Utah, aligned with sunrise and sunset on the solstices; holes in their walls form four constellations of light inside.
works.description_zh: 四条长 5.5 米的混凝土隧道在犹他州大盆地沙漠中呈开放的 X 形排列，对准至日的日出与日落；隧道壁上的孔洞在内部投下四个星座的光点。
works.idea_en: The tunnels frame the sky at precise moments and places, the same logic as an AR experience that only resolves at one time and position.
works.idea_zh: 隧道在精确的时刻与位置框住天空，与只在某个时间和位置成立的 AR 体验逻辑相同。
works.technique: Tunnels were cast with holes sized and placed to match the stars of Draco, Perseus, Columba and Capricorn, and oriented by solar calculation.
works.technique_zh: 隧道浇筑时按天龙座、英仙座、天鸽座和摩羯座的星位开孔并确定孔径，朝向则依据太阳轨迹计算。
works.exercise_en: Compute today's sunset azimuth for your location and place an AR tube on a field that frames the sun exactly at sunset. Twist: punch holes in the tube that match the constellation overhead tonight.
works.exercise_zh: 计算你所在地今天日落的方位角，在操场上放一个 AR 圆筒，让它恰好在日落时框住太阳；变体：在圆筒上开孔，孔位对应今晚头顶的星座。

video.video_title: Nancy Holt at Dia: Sun Tunnels

works.title: Theaters
works.description: Sugimoto opens his large-format camera's shutter when a film starts in a cinema or drive-in and closes it when the film ends; the screen becomes a pure white rectangle lighting the empty auditorium. Here he shows the camera he used.
works.description_zh: 杉本博司在电影院或汽车影院里，电影开场时打开大画幅相机的快门，散场时再关上；银幕变成一块纯白的矩形，照亮空荡的观众厅。视频中他展示了当年用的相机。
works.idea_en: Adding up an entire film yields only light: an AR piece can show the sum of everything that happened in a place rather than any single moment.
works.idea_zh: 把一整部电影叠加起来，只剩下光：AR 作品可以展示一个地方发生过的一切的总和，而不是某一个瞬间。
works.technique: A single exposure lasting the length of a feature film (about two hours) on large-format film.
works.technique_zh: 在大画幅胶片上进行一次与整部电影同长（约两小时）的曝光。
works.exercise_en: Write a Lens Studio or WebAR effect that averages the camera feed over the whole session and shows the average as a live overlay; point it at a TV, a street or a busy desk for 10 minutes. Twist: blend the average with the live view based on how long the phone has stayed still.
works.exercise_zh: 写一个 Lens Studio 或 WebAR 效果，把整段使用过程中的相机画面取平均并作为实时叠加显示；对着电视、街道或忙碌的桌面拍 10 分钟；变体：按手机保持静止的时长，把平均画面和实时画面混合。

video.video_title: 「海景」や「劇場」を撮影したカメラをお見せしよう

works.title: VIDEOPLACE
works.description: A visitor's live silhouette appears on a large screen and can draw with a finger, juggle graphic objects, or touch the silhouette of another person in a different room.
works.description_zh: 观众的实时剪影出现在大屏幕上，可以用手指画线、抛接图形物体，甚至去“触碰”另一个房间里另一个人的剪影。
works.idea_en: Your camera silhouette is your body in the computer world, no gear required.
works.idea_zh: 摄像头里的剪影就是你在计算机世界里的身体，不需要任何穿戴设备。
works.technique: A camera against a backlit wall extracts the body outline in real time with custom hardware, and programs test the outline for contact with graphic objects (the video shows the 1985 version).
works.technique_zh: 摄像头对着背光墙面，用定制硬件实时提取人体轮廓，程序再判断轮廓是否碰到了图形物体（视频为 1985 年版本）。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam and body segmentation in p5.js to make five mini VIDEOPLACE scenes: draw with a fingertip, bounce a ball off your arm, hold a creature in your palm. Twist: connect two laptops so two remote silhouettes can 'shake hands'.
works.exercise_zh: 用网络摄像头和 p5.js 人体分割做五个迷你 VIDEOPLACE 场景：用指尖画画、用手臂弹球、让小生物站在手心；变体：连接两台笔记本，让两个异地的剪影“握手”。

video.video_title: Videoplace (1985)

works.title: Sculptures à cordes
works.description: Groups of wooden elements hung on cords that move so slowly, driven by hidden motors, that viewers are not sure anything is moving until they look away and back.
works.description_zh: 一组组挂在绳上的木质元件由隐藏电机驱动，动得极慢，观者直到移开视线再回头看，才确定它们真的动了。
works.idea_en: Motion at the edge of perception creates unease and attention; AR can use nearly imperceptible change to reward patient looking.
works.idea_zh: 处于感知边缘的运动制造不安与专注；AR 可以用几乎察觉不到的变化来奖励耐心的观看。
works.technique: Hidden low-speed motors pull cords that move the elements a few millimetres per second, below the threshold where motion is obvious.
works.technique_zh: 隐藏的低速电机拉动绳索，让元件每秒移动几毫米，低于明显可见的运动阈值。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR cluster of wooden rods on a shelf that moves only when the user is not looking at it (camera direction), so it has changed each time they look back. Twist: make it move toward the user a little each time.
works.exercise_zh: 在书架上放一组 AR 木杆，只在用户不看它（根据相机朝向判断）时移动，每次回头看它都变了样。变体：让它每次都向用户靠近一点。

video.video_title: Pol Bury – Sculptures à Cordes (1974)

works.title: TV Buddha
works.description: A Buddha statue sits facing a television that shows a live camera image of the Buddha itself, locked in endless self-contemplation.
works.description_zh: 一尊佛像面对一台电视机而坐，电视里是摄像头实时拍下的佛像本身，陷入永无止境的自我凝视。
works.idea_en: A closed loop between object, camera and screen makes watching itself the subject; AR mirror and selfie effects can be designed around who is watching whom.
works.idea_zh: 物体、摄像头和屏幕之间的闭环让“观看”本身成为主题；AR 镜像和自拍效果可以围绕“谁在看谁”来设计。
works.technique: A closed-circuit camera feeds the statue's image straight back to a monitor in front of it, creating a real-time feedback loop without recording.
works.technique_zh: 闭路摄像头把佛像的影像直接送回它面前的显示器，形成不经录制的实时反馈回路。
works.exercise_en: Place a virtual character in AR that watches a virtual TV showing the phone camera's live view of the character itself. Twist: when a real person steps into the character's view, the character turns to look at them instead.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中放一个虚拟角色，让它看着一台虚拟电视，电视里播放手机相机拍到的角色本身。变体：当真人走进角色的视野时，角色转头看向那个人。

video.video_title: Nam June Paik - TV Buddha (1974)

salient.why_en: A Buddha sits watching a live image of itself on a television.
salient.why_zh: 一尊佛像坐在电视前，看着屏幕里实时的自己。

works.title: TV Garden
works.description: Dozens of televisions face up among live plants in a dark room, glowing like flowers and playing the fast-cut video Global Groove.
works.description_zh: 几十台电视机朝上摆在黑暗房间的真实植物之间，像花朵一样发光，播放快速剪辑的录像《全球律动》。
works.idea_en: Screens planted among living things become part of an ecosystem; AR content feels more at home when it is distributed through the real environment instead of floating in front of it.
works.idea_zh: 种在生命之间的屏幕成为生态系统的一部分；AR 内容若分布在真实环境中，而不是悬浮在眼前，会显得更自然。
works.technique: Monitors are laid among real plants at ground level, turning the screens into luminous blossoms in a garden landscape.
works.technique_zh: 显示器被放在真实植物间的地面上，屏幕变成花园里发光的花朵。
works.exercise_en: Plant 20 small AR video screens among real houseplants using plane and object detection, each playing a short clip and glowing like a flower. Twist: make each screen turn toward the nearest person.
works.exercise_zh: 用平面和物体识别把 20 个小型 AR 视频屏幕“种”在真实盆栽之间，每个播放一段短片并像花一样发光。变体：让每个屏幕转向离它最近的人。

video.video_title: TV Garden by Nam June Paik

works.title: Amarillo Ramp
works.description: A curved earth ramp rising from the ground and ending mid-air sits in a dry lake on a Texas ranch; Smithson died in a plane crash while surveying it, and Nancy Holt and friends completed it.
works.description_zh: 一条从地面升起、戛然止于半空的弧形土坡位于得克萨斯州一处牧场的干湖中；Smithson 在勘测时因飞机失事遇难，由 Nancy Holt 与朋友们完成。
works.idea_en: A ramp that curls up and stops invites the body to walk into the sky, a strong lead-in shape for AR content that continues where the ground ends.
works.idea_zh: 一条卷起后戛然而止的坡道引导身体走向天空，是在地面终止处接续 AR 内容的有力引导形状。
works.technique: Earth and red shale were piled into a rising, curving ramp that forms an open circle about 46 metres across.
works.technique_zh: 泥土和红色页岩被堆成一条上升的弧形坡道，构成一个直径约 46 米的开口圆。
works.exercise_en: Stand at the end of a real ramp or staircase and extend it with an AR ramp that continues into the air. Twist: the virtual ramp grows only while someone is walking on the real one.
works.exercise_zh: 站在真实坡道或楼梯的尽头，用一条延伸到空中的 AR 坡道把它接续下去；变体：只有有人在真实坡道上行走时，虚拟坡道才会生长。

video.video_title: Above Amarillo Ramp

works.title: Line Describing a Cone
works.description: A single white dot on a 16mm film slowly draws a circle over 30 minutes; in the hazy room the projector beam becomes a hollow cone of light that visitors walk around and cut with their hands.
works.description_zh: 一段 16 毫米胶片上的一个白点，在 30 分钟里慢慢画出一个圆；在有雾气的房间里，放映光束变成一个空心的光锥，观众可以绕着它走，用手去切开它。
works.idea_en: The projector beam, not the screen, is the artwork: an AR designer can treat the volume between device and surface as a place to put content.
works.idea_zh: 作品不在银幕上，而在投影光束本身：AR 设计者可以把设备与表面之间的空气当作放置内容的地方。
works.technique: A 2D animation of a growing arc is projected through haze so that particles scatter the light and reveal the 3D surface swept by the beam.
works.technique_zh: 把一段逐渐生长的圆弧二维动画投进雾气里，空气中的微粒散射光线，让光束扫过的三维曲面显形。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR scene where a virtual projector on the wall sends a translucent cone toward the floor whose rim grows along a circle over two minutes; let the cone brighten where a tracked hand intersects it. Twist: give every student's phone its own cone so that several light volumes cross in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 里做一台挂在墙上的虚拟放映机，向地面投出半透明光锥，光锥的边缘在两分钟内沿圆周长出来；当追踪到的手穿过光锥时让交点变亮。变体：每位同学的手机各发出一个光锥，让多个光体在房间里交错。

video.video_title: Anthony McCall – Line Describing a Cone | TateShots

works.title: Siluetas
works.description: In Iowa and Mexico, Mendieta pressed, burned and planted the outline of her body into earth, sand, mud and rivers, recording the traces in photographs and films; the MoMA video introduces the series.
works.description_zh: 在艾奥瓦和墨西哥，Mendieta 把自己身体的轮廓压进、烧进或种进泥土、沙子、泥浆和河流中，并用照片和影片记录这些痕迹；MoMA 的视频介绍了这个系列。
works.idea_en: A body-shaped mark left in nature holds presence after the person has gone, a direct brief for AR silhouettes left at places.
works.idea_zh: 留在自然中的人形痕迹在人离开后仍保有“在场”，是在地点留下 AR 剪影的直接命题。
works.technique: She lay in the landscape or shaped her outline with flowers, gunpowder, mud or fire, then filmed the trace changing.
works.technique_zh: 她躺在风景中，或用花朵、火药、泥浆或火塑出自己的轮廓，然后拍摄痕迹的变化。
works.exercise_en: Capture your body outline with segmentation and leave it on the ground in AR, filled with a natural material (petals, fire, water). Twist: the silhouette is only visible to people who stand exactly where you lay.
works.exercise_zh: 用人体分割捕捉你的身体轮廓，在 AR 中把它留在地面上，并用自然材料（花瓣、火、水）填满；变体：只有站在你曾躺过的确切位置的人才能看到这个剪影。

video.video_title: How Ana Mendieta's work re-establishes a connection with the Earth | UNIQLO ARTSPEAKS

salient.why_en: The outline of her body, pressed into earth and water, stays after she is gone.
salient.why_zh: 她把身体的轮廓压进泥土和水里，人走了，轮廓还在。

works.title: Ballet Adagio
works.description: A classical pas de deux filmed at high speed and played back in slow motion, so the lifts and balances unfold with a clarity the live audience never sees.
works.description_zh: 一段古典双人舞用高速摄影拍摄并以慢动作播放，托举和平衡动作展开得清清楚楚，这是现场观众从未见过的。
works.idea_en: Slowing time exposes the mechanics of skill; AR replays of real performers at slow speed make an effective teaching layer.
works.idea_zh: 放慢时间能暴露技巧背后的力学；以慢速回放真实表演者的 AR 影像，是一层很有效的教学内容。
works.technique: High-speed cinematography played back at normal speed, stretching each second of movement into several.
works.technique_zh: 以高速摄影拍摄、按正常速度放映，把每一秒的动作拉长成好几秒。
works.exercise_en: Record a dancer or athlete volumetrically with a depth-capable phone app and place the capture life-size in AR at 1/4 speed so students can walk around a lift. Twist: add a floor marker that shows where the center of mass is at each moment.
works.exercise_zh: 用支持深度的手机应用对舞者或运动员做体积捕捉，在 AR 中按真人大小以 1/4 速度回放，让学生绕着托举动作走一圈；变体：在地面加一个标记，显示每一刻重心的位置。

video.video_title: BALLET ADAGIO | Full Documentary | National Film Board of Canada

works.title: Finger Gloves and body extensions
works.description: Horn's early wearable extensions, such as metre-long finger gloves that let her touch a wall across the room and a unicorn horn strapped to the head, stretch the body's reach and change how the wearer feels space.
works.description_zh: Horn 早期的可穿戴延伸装置：一米长的手指手套让她能碰到房间另一侧的墙，头顶绑着的独角兽角改变了佩戴者对空间的感受。
works.idea_en: Extending a finger by a metre changes how a whole room feels; AR tools that lengthen reach or add body parts do the same, and the body should feel them first.
works.idea_zh: 把手指延长一米，整个房间的感觉就变了；AR 中延伸触及范围或添加身体部件的工具也是如此，关键是让身体先感受到它。
works.technique: Lightweight rigid extensions strapped to the fingers or head shift the wearer's proprioception and make every contact with a surface a remote, amplified gesture.
works.technique_zh: 绑在手指或头上的轻质刚性延伸件改变佩戴者的本体感觉，让每一次触碰表面都变成被放大的远距离动作。
works.exercise_en: Build a hand-tracked AR prototype (Quest passthrough, Vision Pro or Lens Studio hand tracking) that adds 1 m virtual fingers to the user's hand and lets them brush real walls with light traces. Twist: make the fingers heavy and lagging so they sway behind the hand.
works.exercise_zh: 用手部追踪 AR（Quest 透视、Vision Pro 或 Lens Studio 手部追踪）给用户的手加上一米长的虚拟手指，让它们在真实墙面上划出光痕。变体：让手指变得沉重、滞后，跟在手后面摆动。

video.video_title: Rebecca Horn – Body Extensions and Isolation | Fresh Perspectives | Tate Collective

salient.why_en: Gloves with metre-long fingers let you touch the room from far away.
salient.why_zh: 手指长达一米的手套，让你从远处就能摸到房间。

works.title: Pencil Mask (Bleistiftmaske)
works.description: A mask of fabric straps studded with pencils covers the face; as Horn rocks her head in front of a wall, the pencils leave a dense record of her movement.
works.description_zh: 一副由布带和铅笔组成的面具罩在脸上；Horn 在墙前摆动头部，铅笔留下了她动作的密集痕迹。
works.idea_en: The face becomes a drawing tool and every small head movement leaves a mark, showing that head pose alone is expressive enough to draw with.
works.idea_zh: 脸变成了画笔，每一次细微的头部动作都会留下痕迹，说明仅凭头部姿态就足以用来绘画。
works.technique: Rigid pencils fixed to a head harness translate the head's position and rotation directly into strokes on a nearby wall, a physical head-pose recorder.
works.technique_zh: 固定在头套上的铅笔把头部的位置和旋转直接变成墙上的笔触，相当于一台物理的头部姿态记录器。
works.exercise_en: Make a face-tracked AR filter where virtual pencils sprout from the face and draw on the nearest detected wall plane as the user moves their head. Twist: let two people draw on the same wall and see whose head lines cross.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个面部追踪 AR 滤镜：虚拟铅笔从脸上长出，随着用户转头在最近识别到的墙面上画线。变体：让两个人在同一面墙上画，看谁的“头部线条”交叉。

video.video_title: Rebecca Horn / ‘Pencil Mask’ (‘Bleistiftmaske’) 1972

salient.why_en: A mask of pencils turns every movement of the head into a line on the wall.
salient.why_zh: 一副插满铅笔的面具，让头的每一次移动都在墙上留下一道线。

works.title: Valley Curtain
works.description: An orange nylon curtain 400 metres wide was hung across Rifle Gap in the Colorado Rockies; it stood for only 28 hours before a gale forced its removal.
works.description_zh: 一道宽 400 米的橙色尼龙帘幕悬挂在科罗拉多落基山脉的 Rifle Gap 峡谷之间，仅仅 28 小时后便因大风被迫拆除。
works.idea_en: A thin coloured plane across a valley shows how one flat element can re-scale a whole landscape, and how weather is part of the design.
works.idea_zh: 横跨山谷的一片薄薄的彩色平面说明，一个平面元素就能重塑整片风景的尺度，而天气也是设计的一部分。
works.technique: The curtain hung from steel cables anchored in the mountainsides, with openings to let the wind pass (the Maysles brothers documented its making).
works.technique_zh: 帘幕悬挂在锚固于两侧山体的钢缆上，并留有开口让风通过（Maysles 兄弟记录了其制作过程）。
works.exercise_en: Span a huge orange AR plane between two real landmarks (buildings or trees) using geospatial anchors and watch it from far away. Twist: tie its survival to live wind-speed data so it tears when the wind is strong.
works.exercise_zh: 用地理空间锚点在两个真实地标（建筑或树木）之间拉起一面巨大的橙色 AR 平面，从远处观看；变体：把它的存续绑定到实时风速数据，风大时帘幕会撕裂。

video.video_title: "Christo's Valley Curtain" by the Maysles Brothers, 1974

works.title: Broken Circle/Spiral Hill
works.description: In a sand quarry in Emmen, Netherlands, a half-land, half-water circle faces a small hill with a white-sand path spiralling to its top; a huge glacial boulder sits at the circle's centre.
works.description_zh: 在荷兰埃门的一处采砂场中，一个半是陆地半是水面的圆与一座小山相对，白沙小径螺旋盘上山顶；圆心处卧着一块巨大的冰川漂砾。
works.idea_en: Pairing a flat figure (the circle) with a climbable one (the hill) gives two viewpoints on the same work, a classic AR composition pattern.
works.idea_zh: 把一个平面图形（圆）与一个可攀登的图形（山）配对，为同一件作品提供两种视角，这是经典的 AR 构图模式。
works.technique: The circle was dug and built up in the quarry's water and sand, and the hill's path was shaped with white sand and topsoil.
works.technique_zh: 圆是在采砂场的水和沙中挖出并堆筑而成，山上的小径则用白沙和表土塑形。
works.exercise_en: Place a flat AR ring on the ground and a small AR hill beside it that users can 'climb' by walking up real stairs to look down on the ring. Twist: the ring only closes into a full circle when seen from the top.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面上放一个扁平的 AR 圆环，旁边放一座小 AR 山，用户走上真实的楼梯即可“登山”俯视圆环；变体：只有从顶端看时圆环才会闭合成完整的圆。

video.video_title: Broken Circle/Spiral Hill earthwork sculpture by American artist Robert Smithson

works.title: Star Axis
works.description: Under construction since 1971 on a New Mexico mesa, Star Axis is a naked-eye observatory: a stairway aligned with Earth's axis lets you see Polaris framed by a circle whose size changes with the 26,000-year precession of the axis.
works.description_zh: 自 1971 年起在新墨西哥台地上建造的《Star Axis》是一座肉眼天文台：一条与地轴平行的阶梯让人看到北极星被一个圆框住，圆的大小随地轴 26000 年一周的岁差而变化。
works.idea_en: Each step up the stair corresponds to a moment in the precession cycle, so walking becomes time travel through astronomy, a strong model for data-bound AR paths.
works.idea_zh: 阶梯的每一级对应岁差周期中的一个时刻，行走于是成为穿越天文时间的旅行，这是绑定数据的 AR 路径的有力范本。
works.technique: An 11-storey Star Tunnel is cut into the mesa along the axis of the Earth, with its aperture sized to track Polaris's apparent circle over millennia.
works.technique_zh: 一条 11 层楼高的“星隧道”沿地轴方向切入台地，开口大小经过设计，用以追踪北极星在数千年中视运动的圆。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR staircase aligned with your latitude's polar axis that shows, at each step, where Polaris will appear in a different century. Twist: let the user walk down to go back in time.
works.exercise_zh: 搭建一个与当地纬度极轴对齐的 AR 阶梯，每一级显示北极星在不同世纪的位置；变体：让用户往下走即可回到过去。

video.video_title: The time portal built into a mountain

works.title: TV Cello
works.description: Charlotte Moorman plays a cello made of stacked televisions; as she bows the strings, the screens show live and recorded images of herself and the performance.
works.description_zh: Charlotte Moorman 演奏一把由叠放电视机组成的大提琴；她拉弦时，屏幕上播放她自己和演出的实时与录制影像。
works.idea_en: An instrument that is also a screen merges performer, sound and image into one object, a model for AR instruments that show what they play.
works.idea_zh: 既是乐器又是屏幕，把表演者、声音和影像融为一体，是“显示自己所演奏内容”的 AR 乐器的范本。
works.technique: Three television monitors are stacked in a cello-shaped frame with strings, combining live closed-circuit video with a playable instrument.
works.technique_zh: 三台电视机被叠放在带琴弦的大提琴形框架中，把实时闭路影像与可演奏的乐器结合在一起。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR instrument that appears on a real table: plucking its virtual strings (hand tracking or touch) plays notes and shows a live camera image of the player inside its body. Twist: let a second phone see and play the same instrument.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个出现在真实桌面上的 AR 乐器：用手部追踪或触摸拨动虚拟琴弦发出音符，同时在琴身里显示演奏者的实时影像。变体：让第二部手机也能看到并演奏同一件乐器。

video.video_title: Charlotte Moorman performs with Paik's 'TV cello'

works.title: untitled (to Donna) II
works.description: A square of fluorescent tubes set diagonally across a room corner glows yellow toward the viewer and pink and blue into the corner behind it, making the corner itself dissolve into coloured light.
works.description_zh: 一组荧光灯管斜着组成方形，横跨房间的一个墙角；朝向观众的一面发黄光，背后的墙角被粉色和蓝色照亮，墙角本身消融在彩光里。
works.idea_en: A corner is the most ignored part of a room; placing light there changes the whole geometry, a reminder to use corners and edges as AR anchors.
works.idea_zh: 墙角是房间里最被忽视的部分；把光放在那里就改变了整个几何，这提醒我们把墙角和边缘当作 AR 的锚点。
works.technique: Tubes facing front and back emit different colours, so the direct light and the reflected light in the corner mix into two distinct fields.
works.technique_zh: 朝前和朝后的灯管发出不同的颜色，直射光和墙角里的反射光混合成两个不同的色场。
works.exercise_en: Detect a real room corner with AR Foundation plane intersection and place a virtual square of light across it, lighting the corner behind with one colour and the viewer's side with another. Twist: let the colours swap when the viewer walks to the side.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 的平面相交检测找到真实的墙角，在它前面横放一个虚拟光方框，用一种颜色照亮背后的墙角，另一种照亮观者一侧。变体：观者走到侧面时，两种颜色互换。

video.video_title: Flavin, Untitled (to Donna) II

works.title: Atmospheres
works.description: In the late 1960s and early 1970s, Chicago set off coloured smoke flares in deserts, beaches and streets, softening the landscape with drifting pinks, purples and greens; this archival talk recalls three Atmospheres from April 1970.
works.description_zh: 上世纪六十年代末到七十年代初，朱迪·芝加哥在沙漠、海滩和街道上点燃彩色烟雾弹，用飘动的粉、紫、绿色柔化了景观；这段档案讲述回顾了 1970 年 4 月的三场《Atmospheres》。
works.idea_en: Colour released into the air changes the mood of a whole landscape for a few minutes; AR can tint the atmosphere around viewers instead of adding objects to it.
works.idea_zh: 释放到空气中的颜色能在几分钟里改变整片景观的情绪；AR 也可以给观众周围的空气上色，而不是往里面添加物体。
works.technique: Commercial coloured smoke flares were placed on the ground, on bodies and on structures and lit together so the smoke mixed and drifted with the wind.
works.technique_zh: 把商用彩色烟雾弹放在地面、身体和构筑物上一起点燃，让烟雾交融并随风飘动。
works.exercise_en: Create an AR 'atmosphere' filter that fills the space around the viewer with volumetric coloured fog emitted from points they tap on the ground, drifting with a wind direction read from a weather API. Twist: each person gets one colour, and the fog only turns purple where two people's clouds meet.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR“氛围”滤镜：观众点击地面上的点，从那里放出立体的彩色雾，并按天气 API 读到的风向飘动。变体：每个人只有一种颜色，只有两个人的烟雾相遇的地方才会变成紫色。

video.video_title: Dextra Frankel on Judy Gerowitz, Three Atmospheres, April 1970

works.title: Partially Buried Woodshed
works.description: At Kent State University, Smithson had a backhoe pile earth onto a woodshed until its central beam cracked, then left it to decay; only traces remain today.
works.description_zh: 在肯特州立大学，Smithson 让挖掘机把泥土堆在一座木棚上，直到其中央横梁断裂，然后任其腐朽；如今只剩痕迹。
works.idea_en: An artwork that is meant to decay turns entropy into content, a useful stance for AR works that degrade on purpose.
works.idea_zh: 一件注定要衰败的作品把熵变成了内容，这对有意自我退化的 AR 作品是很有用的立场。
works.technique: Twenty truckloads of earth were dumped on the roof of an existing shed until it broke, fixing a moment of collapse.
works.technique_zh: 二十卡车泥土被倒在一座现成木棚的屋顶上，直到它断裂，定格了坍塌的瞬间。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a small AR building at a spot on campus and program it to lose one element every day the site is visited. Twist: publish a timeline slider so visitors can scrub back to how it looked on day one.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园某处锚定一座小型 AR 建筑，并编程让它在每次有人到访时失去一个构件；变体：发布时间轴滑块，让访客回看它第一天的样子。

video.video_title: See the History and Remains of Kent State's Partially Buried Woodshed

works.title: Spiral Jetty
works.description: A 457-metre coil of black basalt and earth spirals counter-clockwise into the red-tinted water of Utah's Great Salt Lake; it was submerged for decades and is now crusted white with salt.
works.description_zh: 一条长 457 米、由黑色玄武岩和泥土构成的螺旋逆时针伸入犹他州大盐湖泛红的湖水中；它曾被淹没数十年，如今覆满白色盐壳。
works.idea_en: A shape that you can walk along but only fully see from the air shows how AR content can reward both the ground view and the overview.
works.idea_zh: 一个可以沿着行走、却只有从空中才能看全的形状，说明 AR 内容可以同时奖励地面视角和鸟瞰视角。
works.technique: Dump trucks and a front loader pushed 6,650 tons of rock and earth into the shallow lake along a staked spiral path.
works.technique_zh: 自卸卡车和装载机沿着打桩标出的螺旋路径，把 6650 吨岩石和泥土推入浅湖中。
works.exercise_en: Walk a spiral on a field while a WebXR app records your GPS trace, then view the path as a raised AR ribbon from above using a 'drone view' toggle. Twist: raise and lower a virtual water level that hides and reveals the spiral.
works.exercise_zh: 在操场上走出一个螺旋，同时用 WebXR 应用记录 GPS 轨迹，然后用“无人机视角”开关从上方查看隆起的 AR 飘带；变体：升降一个虚拟水位，让螺旋时隐时现。

video.video_title: Robert Smithson at Dia: Spiral Jetty

works.title: The Senster
works.description: A 4 m tall hydraulic creature like a lobster claw on a long neck, which turned toward quiet sounds and slow movements of visitors and recoiled from loud noise or sudden gestures.
works.description_zh: 一个 4 米高的液压“生物”，形似长颈上的龙虾钳，会转向观众轻柔的声音和缓慢的动作，遇到大声喧哗或突然的手势则缩回。
works.idea_en: Shy behaviour, not spectacle, made people stay with it; AR characters that approach gentle attention and retreat from noise feel far more alive.
works.idea_zh: 让人们驻足的不是奇观，而是它的“害羞”；会靠近温和关注、躲避喧闹的 AR 角色显得更有生命。
works.technique: Four microphones located sounds and a Doppler radar detected motion; a Philips minicomputer moved six hydraulic joints to approach or retreat, with smooth damped motion.
works.technique_zh: 四个麦克风定位声源，多普勒雷达探测运动；飞利浦小型计算机驱动六个液压关节靠近或后退，动作平滑而有阻尼。
works.exercise_en: Build a shy AR creature with a long neck that leans toward the phone when the user speaks softly and pulls back when they are loud or move the phone fast (accelerometer). Twist: give it memory, so it trusts repeat visitors more.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个长脖子的“害羞” AR 生物：用户轻声说话时它向手机探身，大声或快速移动手机（加速度计）时它缩回。变体：给它记忆，让它更信任常来的访客。

video.video_title: The Senster

works.title: Topoestesia (itinerario programmato)
works.description: A walk-through environment of tilted floors, steps and narrow passages that throws visitors off balance and makes them feel space through their bodies rather than their eyes.
works.description_zh: 由倾斜地面、台阶和狭窄通道组成的可穿行环境，让观众失去平衡，用身体而不是眼睛去感受空间。
works.idea_en: Changing the ground under the feet changes perception more than any image; AR experiences can guide walking paths and pacing to shape how a space is felt.
works.idea_zh: 改变脚下的地面比任何图像都更能改变感知；AR 体验可以通过引导行走路线和节奏来塑造人们对空间的感受。
works.technique: A sequence of spaces with inclined planes and irregular steps is programmed as an itinerary, so the body's balance and movement become the medium.
works.technique_zh: 带斜面和不规则台阶的空间序列被编排成一条路线，身体的平衡与移动成为媒介。
works.exercise_en: Design a WebXR walk through a real corridor where AR floor markings, tilted virtual horizons and narrowing walls make the walker slow down and sway. Twist: make the virtual horizon tilt a little more with every step.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一条穿过真实走廊的 WebXR 路线，用 AR 地面标记、倾斜的虚拟地平线和逐渐收窄的墙让行人放慢并摇晃。变体：每走一步，让虚拟地平线再倾斜一点。

video.video_title: Museo del Novecento - I custodi raccontano - Topoestesia. Itinerario programmato di Gianni Colombo.

works.title: Chronos 10
works.description: A rotating sculpture of polished steel blades and mirrors, lit by coloured lamps, throws moving reflections and shadows onto a screen beside it.
works.description_zh: 由抛光钢片和镜面组成的旋转雕塑在彩色灯光照射下，把移动的反光和阴影投到旁边的屏幕上。
works.idea_en: A sculpture and its projected shadow play form one work; AR objects can be designed together with the light and shadow they cast on real surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 雕塑与它投出的光影共同构成作品；AR 物体也可以连同它们在真实表面上投下的光影一起设计。
works.technique: Motorised reflective elements rotate under programmed coloured lights, and the resulting reflections and shadows are captured on a translucent screen.
works.technique_zh: 电动反光元件在程序控制的彩色灯光下旋转，反射和阴影被投到半透明屏幕上。
works.exercise_en: Create an AR kinetic sculpture on a table whose virtual lights cast colourful moving shadows onto the real wall behind it (shadow-receiving plane). Twist: let the user move the light with their phone as a torch.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌上做一个 AR 动态雕塑，让它的虚拟灯光在后方真实墙面（接收阴影的平面）上投出彩色移动阴影。变体：让用户把手机当手电筒来移动光源。

video.video_title: Nicolas Schöffer 'Chronos 10 (and screen)' 1969

works.title: Double Negative
works.description: Two trenches, each about 9 metres wide and 15 metres deep, are cut into facing edges of the Mormon Mesa in Nevada; the sculpture is the empty space between them.
works.description_zh: 两条各约 9 米宽、15 米深的沟槽切入内华达摩门台地相对的两侧边缘；雕塑就是两者之间的空。
works.idea_en: A sculpture made of removed material shows that absence can be the object, a direct idea for diminished-reality AR.
works.idea_zh: 由被移除的材料构成的雕塑说明，缺失本身可以是作品，这是“削减现实”AR 的直接创意。
works.technique: About 244,000 tons of rhyolite and sandstone were blasted and bulldozed out of the mesa edge.
works.technique_zh: 约 24.4 万吨流纹岩和砂岩从台地边缘被炸开并推走。
works.exercise_en: Use a depth mask to cut a deep virtual trench into a real floor or lawn in AR so users seem to look down into it. Twist: align two trenches so they read as one line only from a single spot.
works.exercise_zh: 用深度遮罩在 AR 中给真实地面或草坪“切”出一条深沟，让用户仿佛往下看；变体：对齐两条沟，让它们只在某一个位置看起来连成一条线。

video.video_title: Fly through Double Negative

works.title: Electronic Light Ballet
works.description: A televised light ballet in which moving lamps and perforated forms are filmed and transformed into a flowing composition of light for the screen.
works.description_zh: 一场为电视创作的光之芭蕾：移动的灯和穿孔形体被拍摄下来，转化为屏幕上流动的光影构成。
works.idea_en: The same light choreography can live in a room or on a screen; AR designers can prototype spatial light pieces as simple films first.
works.idea_zh: 同样的光影编排既可以存在于房间，也可以存在于屏幕；AR 设计师可以先把空间光效做成简单的影片来原型测试。
works.technique: Likely filmed live light-ballet objects combined with broadcast-TV image processing to create a light composition made for television.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是把现场光之芭蕾装置拍摄下来，再结合电视广播的影像处理，制作成为电视而作的光影作品。
works.exercise_en: Film a 1-minute light ballet with a phone flashlight shining through a punched paper cup, then rebuild the best moment as a looping AR light effect anchored in the same room. Twist: sync the rotation to a song's tempo.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机闪光灯照射一只扎了孔的纸杯，拍一段 1 分钟的光之芭蕾，再把最好的片段在同一房间里重做成循环的 AR 光效。变体：让旋转与一首歌的节拍同步。

video.video_title: Otto Piene - Electric Light Ballet (1969)

works.title: The Haunted Mansion: Grand Hall ghosts (Pepper's ghost)
works.description: Riders pass above a dining hall where transparent ghosts dance, feast and fly around a real table and chandelier. The ghosts are animated figures hidden below and above the ride, reflected in a huge sheet of glass.
works.description_zh: 游客乘车经过一座宴会大厅上方，透明的幽灵在真实的餐桌和吊灯周围跳舞、宴饮、飞来飞去。这些幽灵其实是藏在游览车下方和上方的动态人偶，被一整块巨大玻璃反射出来。
works.idea_en: Room-scale Pepper's ghost is still the simplest 'hologram': it teaches that a virtual layer must be lit, scaled and staged against the real set to be believed.
works.idea_zh: 房间尺度的佩珀尔幻象至今仍是最简单的“全息”：它说明虚拟层必须和真实布景在光线、比例和调度上配合，才会被人相信。
works.technique: A giant angled glass pane between the ride and the ballroom reflects brightly lit animatronic figures hidden out of sight, superimposing them on the dimly lit real ballroom (Yale Gracey's Pepper's-ghost staging).
works.technique_zh: 游览车与宴会厅之间有一块巨大的倾斜玻璃，把藏在视线之外、被强光照亮的电动人偶反射出来，叠加在昏暗的真实宴会厅上（Yale Gracey 设计的佩珀尔幻象）。
works.exercise_en: Build a tabletop ballroom with a real cup and candle, and use a tablet laid flat under a 45° acrylic sheet to make a small ghost dance around them. Twist: rebuild it in phone AR and add real-time occlusion so the ghost can pass behind the cup, something the glass trick cannot do.
works.exercise_zh: 用真实的杯子和蜡烛搭一个桌面“舞厅”，把平板平放在一块 45° 亚克力板下，让一个小幽灵绕着它们跳舞；变体：再用手机 AR 重做，加上实时遮挡，让幽灵能绕到杯子后面——这是玻璃把戏做不到的。

video.video_title: The Haunted Mansion - HOW IT WORKS

works.title: The Haunted Mansion: Madame Leota and Little Leota (projected faces)
works.description: A fortune teller's head floats inside a crystal ball, and a tiny bride at the exit speaks to riders ('Hurry back...'). Both are blank sculpted heads with a filmed face projected onto them, so they talk and blink in three dimensions.
works.description_zh: 一位占卜师的头漂浮在水晶球里，出口处一个迷你新娘对游客说“快回来……”。两者都是空白的雕塑头像，拍好的人脸被投影上去，于是它们能在立体中说话、眨眼。
works.idea_en: Projecting a face onto a head-shaped form gives far more presence than a flat screen; it is the root of face projection and of AR avatars anchored on physical props.
works.idea_zh: 把脸投到头形的实体上，比平面屏幕有强得多的存在感；这是人脸投影的源头，也是把 AR 化身锚定在实体道具上的源头。
works.technique: Film of actress Leota Toombs' face is projected from a hidden projector onto a white face-shaped sculpture, aligned so the features land on the sculpted nose, eyes and mouth.
works.technique_zh: 演员 Leota Toombs 的面部影像由隐藏的投影机投到一个白色脸形雕塑上，对准位置，让五官正好落在雕出的鼻子、眼睛和嘴上。
works.exercise_en: Print or model a small white mask, film a classmate's face straight-on, and use a pico projector or phone AR with image tracking to lay the video onto the mask so it speaks a line. Twist: make the mask answer with a different face each time someone asks it a question.
works.exercise_zh: 打印或做一个白色小面具，正面拍一段同学的脸，用微型投影仪或带图像追踪的手机 AR 把视频贴到面具上，让它说一句台词；变体：每当有人向它提问，面具就换一张脸来回答。

video.video_title: Little Leota Projection - Haunted Mansion

works.title: Wrapped Coast
works.description: At Little Bay in Sydney, about 2.5 kilometres of rocky coastline and cliffs were wrapped in 92,900 square metres of fabric tied with rope for ten weeks.
works.description_zh: 在悉尼的 Little Bay，约 2.5 公里长的岩石海岸和悬崖被 92900 平方米的织物包裹，并用绳索捆扎，持续十周。
works.idea_en: Wrapping hides detail and reveals form: a single material laid over a landscape is the physical version of an AR mesh shader.
works.idea_zh: 包裹隐藏细节、凸显形体：一种材料覆盖整片风景，是 AR 网格着色器的实体版本。
works.technique: Synthetic fabric was draped over the cliffs and held with 56 kilometres of rope by volunteers and climbers.
works.technique_zh: 志愿者和攀岩者把合成织物铺在悬崖上，用总长 56 公里的绳子固定。
works.exercise_en: Use LiDAR mesh reconstruction to cover a real rock, bench or car with a draped fabric material in AR, with rope lines following the surface. Twist: let the wind (random noise) ripple the fabric.
works.exercise_zh: 用激光雷达网格重建在 AR 中给真实的石头、长椅或汽车盖上一层垂坠织物材质，并让绳线沿表面走；变体：让“风”（随机噪声）吹动织物起伏。

video.video_title: Christo on 'Wrapped Coast', 1969

works.title: Lumino
works.description: A small box with a round frosted screen on which slowly rotating coloured filters and reflectors produce endlessly changing abstract light patterns; it was sold as a domestic light sculpture by Philips.
works.description_zh: 一个带圆形磨砂屏的小盒子，里面缓慢旋转的彩色滤镜和反光片在屏上生成不断变化的抽象光影；曾由飞利浦作为家用光雕塑销售。
works.idea_en: A kinetic light artwork made small enough for a living room; ambient AR pieces can likewise live quietly on a shelf instead of demanding attention.
works.idea_zh: 一件小到可以放进客厅的动态光艺术；氛围型 AR 作品同样可以安静地待在书架上，而不必抢夺注意力。
works.technique: Rotating discs of coloured gel and reflective material behind a diffusing screen mix and blur light into continuously shifting forms.
works.technique_zh: 漫射屏后旋转的彩色滤光片和反光材料圆盘把光混合、模糊，形成持续变化的图形。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR 'Lumino' that sits on a real shelf as a small glowing disc showing slow generative colour patterns, visible only in dim light (use light estimation). Twist: sync its pattern speed to the room's ambient noise.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个放在真实书架上的 AR“Lumino”：一个显示缓慢生成式色彩图案的小发光圆盘，只在光线昏暗时出现（用光照估计）。变体：让图案速度与房间的环境噪音同步。

video.video_title: Lumino Nicolas Schöffer

works.title: Pas de deux
works.description: Two dancers lit from the side against black are printed on top of themselves with frame delays, so every movement unfolds into a fan of luminous echoes.
works.description_zh: 两位舞者在黑色背景前被侧光照亮，影像以不同的帧延迟叠印在自身之上，每个动作都展开成一扇发光的回声。
works.idea_en: Delayed copies of a body turn movement into form; the same echo effect on a live AR body track makes dance visible as sculpture.
works.idea_zh: 身体的延迟副本把动作变成形体；把同样的回声效果加在 AR 实时身体追踪上，舞蹈就会像雕塑一样被看见。
works.technique: Optical printing: the same film strip is exposed repeatedly with offsets of several frames, stacking time-shifted images of the dancers.
works.technique_zh: 光学印片：同一条胶片以相差若干帧的方式多次曝光，把时间错开的舞者影像叠在一起。
works.exercise_en: Create a body-segmentation effect in Lens Studio or WebAR that draws the last 8 masks of a dancer with delays of 3 frames each and decreasing opacity. Twist: map the delay length to the music's tempo.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Lens Studio 或 WebAR 中做一个人像分割效果，把舞者最近 8 个遮罩以每个延迟 3 帧、透明度递减的方式画出来；变体：让延迟长度跟随音乐的节拍速度。

video.video_title: PAS DE DEUX | Full Experimental Film | National Film Board of Canada

works.title: SAM (Sound Activated Mobile)
works.description: A flower-like sculpture on a spine of aluminium vertebrae that turned its petal-shaped head toward whoever was talking at the Cybernetic Serendipity exhibition in London.
works.description_zh: 一件花朵般的雕塑，立在铝制“脊椎”上，在伦敦“控制论的偶然”展中把花瓣形的头转向正在说话的人。
works.idea_en: Turning to face a voice is the simplest signal of attention; AR objects that orient to the speaker feel social with almost no other behaviour.
works.idea_zh: 转身面对说话者是最简单的注意力信号；只要会朝向说话的人，AR 物体几乎不需要其他行为就显得有社交感。
works.technique: Microphones in the head compare sound levels and drive small hydraulic pistons in the neck until the head points at the loudest steady voice.
works.technique_zh: 头部的麦克风比较声音强弱，驱动颈部的小型液压活塞，直到头部对准持续的最响声源。
works.exercise_en: Create an AR flower on a table that turns its head toward whichever of two phones is producing sound (shared AR session). Twist: have it lose interest and droop if nobody talks for 20 seconds.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌上做一朵 AR 花，在共享 AR 会话中让它把头转向正在发出声音的那部手机。变体：若 20 秒无人说话，让它失去兴趣并垂下头。

video.video_title: SAM - Cybernetic Serendipity

works.title: A Line Made by Walking
works.description: As a student, Long walked back and forth along a straight line in a Wiltshire field until the flattened grass caught the light, then photographed it; the photograph is the work.
works.description_zh: 还是学生时，Long 在威尔特郡的一片田野上沿一条直线来回行走，直到被踩倒的草反射出光线，然后拍下照片；这张照片就是作品。
works.idea_en: The body's repeated path becomes the drawing: the purest form of a location-based trace that AR can record and replay.
works.idea_zh: 身体反复走过的路径本身就是绘画：这是 AR 可以记录和回放的位置轨迹最纯粹的形式。
works.technique: Repeated walking pressed the grass flat along one axis so the line appeared by reflected light, fixed in one photograph.
works.technique_zh: 反复行走把草沿一条轴线压平，使线条通过反射光显现，并被一张照片定格。
works.exercise_en: Walk the same straight line 20 times with a WebXR or AR Foundation app that thickens and brightens an AR line each time you pass. Twist: invite others to walk it too, and let the line fade if nobody walks for a day.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 AR Foundation 应用沿同一直线走 20 次，每走一次 AR 线就变粗变亮；变体：邀请其他人一起走，如果一天无人行走，线就会淡去。

video.video_title: Richard Long's A Line Made by Walking  | Amanda Thomson | Perspectives

salient.why_en: Walking back and forth across a field leaves a line in the grass.
salient.why_zh: 在草地上来回走，草上就留下了一条线。

works.title: Spazio elastico (Elastic Space)
works.description: A dark room crossed by a grid of fluorescent elastic cords glowing under ultraviolet light; motors slowly stretch the cords so the grid warps and the room's geometry seems to breathe.
works.description_zh: 黑暗房间里纵横交错的荧光弹性绳在紫外光下发光；电机缓慢拉伸绳子，让网格变形，整个房间的几何仿佛在呼吸。
works.idea_en: Distorting the grid that defines a space makes the space itself feel elastic; AR can warp the perceived room with glowing guide lines instead of objects.
works.idea_zh: 扭曲定义空间的网格，就能让空间本身显得有弹性；AR 可以用发光的辅助线而不是物体来扭曲人们感知到的房间。
works.technique: Fluorescent elastic cords form a 3D grid in a black room; motors pull individual cords so the lattice deforms slowly while UV light makes only the lines visible.
works.technique_zh: 荧光弹性绳在黑色房间中组成三维网格；电机拉动单根绳子，让网格缓慢变形，紫外光下只有线条可见。
works.exercise_en: Fill a dim real room with a glowing AR 3D grid (WebXR or Unity) and let one grid node slowly follow the user so the lattice bends around them. Twist: dim the passthrough so only the grid is visible, like a UV room.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 Unity 在昏暗的真实房间中填满发光的 AR 三维网格，并让一个网格节点缓慢跟随用户，使网格绕着他们弯曲。变体：调暗透视画面，只留网格可见，像紫外光房间一样。

video.video_title: Gianni Colombo: "Spazio elastico ambiente", 1967

works.title: Musical sculptures (Musicales)
works.description: Single strings stretched over wooden panels are struck by needles swinging under electromagnets, producing random amplified tones in the gallery.
works.description_zh: 单根琴弦绷在木板上，被电磁铁下摆动的针敲击，在展厅里发出随机、被放大的音调。
works.idea_en: An instrument played by magnetism instead of hands makes invisible forces audible; AR can sonify invisible data or fields in the same spirit.
works.idea_zh: 由磁力而不是人手演奏的乐器让看不见的力变得可听；AR 也可以同样把看不见的数据或场“声音化”。
works.technique: An electromagnet pulses at irregular intervals, pulling a suspended needle against an amplified string so that magnetism plays the instrument.
works.technique_zh: 电磁铁不规则地脉冲，把悬挂的针拉向带拾音的琴弦，让磁力来演奏乐器。
works.exercise_en: Anchor AR strings to a real wall and have invisible 'magnetic' pulses, driven by the phone's magnetometer, pluck them. Twist: bring a real magnet near the phone to play them directly.
works.exercise_zh: 把 AR 琴弦锚定在真实墙面上，用手机磁力计驱动看不见的“磁脉冲”拨动它们。变体：把一块真磁铁靠近手机来直接演奏。

video.video_title: TAKIS:Sculptures Musicales

works.title: Narcissus Garden
works.description: Hundreds of mirrored steel spheres float on a pond or lie across a lawn, each reflecting the sky, the trees, the other spheres and the viewer; first shown at the 1966 Venice Biennale, here at Inhotim in Brazil (2009).
works.description_zh: 数百个镜面不锈钢球漂浮在池塘上或散落在草坪上，每个都映出天空、树木、其他球体和观者；1966 年首次在威尼斯双年展展出，视频为 2009 年巴西 Inhotim 的版本。
works.idea_en: Many small mirrors scattered over a landscape multiply it into countless tiny worlds, a direct recipe for instanced reflective AR objects.
works.idea_zh: 散布在风景中的许多小镜子把风景倍增成无数个微小世界，是实例化反射 AR 物体的直接配方。
works.technique: Mass-produced polished spheres are laid out loosely on water or grass, where wind and currents move them into new clusters.
works.technique_zh: 批量生产的抛光球体松散地铺在水面或草地上，风和水流把它们推成新的聚落。
works.exercise_en: Scatter 300 instanced AR spheres with a real-time reflection probe over a lawn or pond and let the device's motion act as wind that drifts them. Twist: each sphere shows the reflection from where it was placed, not where it is now.
